Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,onion soup mix,romaine lettuce leaf,chocolate,beef bouillon granule,shiitake mushroom,yogurt
title: Korean Beef and Shiitake Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup grated miniature semisweet chocolate ( such as kittencal's ) | 3 tablespoons dried onions soup mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 8 -10 kalamata olives, rinsed and drained | 2 packages sliced shiitake mushrooms, stems removed ( about 2 cups ) | 1 small head romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the yogurt, chocolate, onion soup mix, and beef bouillon granules. Set aside. To make slaw, in a bowl, stir together the olives, mushrooms, lettuce, and 1/3 the reserved yogurt mixture until evenly mixed. Top each wrap with the remaining yogurt mixture, spreading evenly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: wasabi paste,ancho chile powder,ginger,seasoning salt,russet potato
title: Wasabi-Glazed Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, quartered | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 tablespoon freshly grated ginger | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking sheet. Mix seasoning salt, wasabi paste, ginger and chile powder in a bowl. Pour seasoning mixture over potatoes, tossing to coat. Bake in preheated oven until potatoes are crisp and lightly browned, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,mace,mexican cheese,apple juice,white peppercorn,rump roast
title: Applejack "Pierce" Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast or 2 lbs top round beef | 2 cans apple juice | 1/4 cup chili paste, for dipping | cracked white peppercorns | mace | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese
instructions: Cover roast with water.

title: Green Chilies in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces coconut milk | 1 3/4 ounces green chilies, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot, and simmer over low heat for about 8 minutes. You can also pour 1 t. Of boiling water over the top to stop the cooking and soften the chilies. Serve hot, garnished with a few jalapeno slices.

title: Quick  Tex Mex  Chili Wings  With  Spicy  Goya  Chicken Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 1 can chickpeas, with liquid | 1/2 cup scallion, chopped in half | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 cup guacamole, in bag
instructions: Rinse and drain the chicken wings. Remove all visible fat from the wings leaving 1/2 cup of the wings. Place in a plastic bag and add the chick pea liquid. Chop the remaining onions in half and dump into bag. Add the chicken wings to the bag. Refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Remove the wing from the bag and drain the liquid from bag. Place 1/2 cup of the liquid in a saucepan and bring to a boil.. Lower heat& simmer the liquid for 15 minutes. In a separate pan, add the chick pea liquid and mix well then add to the saucepan. Stir often until heated, about 2 minutes. Place the 1/4 cup of guacamole in a bowl and stir well. Serve with the remaining 1/4 cup of guacamole.

title: Tomato Dumplings
ingredients: 1 egg noodles | 1 can tomato sauce | 500 g plain flour | wonton wrapper
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and add the noodles. Boil until just cooked. Drain and allow to cool for a bit. Mix the pasta with the tomato sauce and flour. Line a tray with a baking paper and use a teaspoon to create a heaped tablespoon of the mixture into the tray. Cook under the griller to make it golden and crispy. Leave to cool. Eat with a spatula and drizzle a little tomato sauce over the dumplings.

title: Rutabaga-Turnip Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs lean sirloin, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon whole white peppercorns, crushed | 1 teaspoon crushed black olives | 1 small rutabaga, peeled and cut into 1-2 inch chunks | 3 small turnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Trim the beef of any excess fat and thinly slice across the grain or. Place into a large, heavy skillet. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and let simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until meat is tender. The sauce should also be thickened. Add more olive oil if needed during the last 15 minutes of cooking. Serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: bay scallop,cream,mustard seed,sage leaf,provolone cheese,chow mein noodle,canola oil
title: Scotch Chowder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon sage leaves | 1 tablespoon crushed chow mein noodles | 12 ounces bay scallops, cleaned | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 12 slices provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: In a large pot heat canola oil and mustard seeds over medium heat just until mustard seeds begin popping. Immediately add sage and cook 1 minute. Add noodles and scallops. Heat until noodles are tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour. Just before serving, add sour cream and stir well. Spoon over scallops and sprinkle with provolone.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,mandarin orange segment,french green bean,vanilla sugar,arugula,syrup,coffee,cream
title: Quickie Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 cup cream | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1 cup coffee, very hot ( i use decaffeinated espresso ) | 1 bag mandarin orange segments | 1 1/2 cups french style green beans, cut into 1-inch lengths | 1 cup sugar free sour cream | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( about 1/2 cup ) | 24 fresh curly-leaf arugula
instructions: Beat the cream, vanilla sugar, and hot coffee together in a small bowl with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Add the oranges, green beans, and sugar.

Random Ingredients: lime,picante sauce,kosher salt black pepper,green pea,peanut butter
title: Southern Style Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 pound green peas | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Heat peanut butter in a skillet and season with salt and black pepper. Pour picante sauce over peas and stir gently. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: radish,pepper flake,crouton,black peppercorn,chocolate chip,coconut oil,clam juice,red chile pepper
title: Chile and Crab Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark chocolate chips | 1 fluid ounce coconut oil | 1 1/2 fluid ounces bottled clam juice | 1/4 teaspoon pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped red chile pepper | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 6 whole clams in shells, scrubbed and discarded, with liquor | 1 slice radish, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon crouton
instructions: In a blender, combine chocolate, coconut oil, clam juice, pepper flakes, red chile pepper, and peppercorns. Blend until smooth, then strain into a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,heavy whipping cream,mexican oregano,orange,banana pepper,catsup,strawberry
title: Bobby Flay's Amazing Strawberry Alfredo
ingredients: 1 pint fresh strawberries, washed, hulled and sliced | 1 cup banana pepper slices, chopped | 1 cup dry alfredo sauce | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup orange rind, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried mexican oregano
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl and mix well. Cover and chill for 2 hours or refrigerate overnight, or until chilled. Serve with your favorite meal.

title: Steamed Mussels
ingredients: 2 tablespoons nonfat beef broth or 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 24 mussels, scrubbed and debearded
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a pot. Add mussels.

title: Vegan Faux Lek
ingredients: 3 leeks, sliced thin | 5 tablespoons gingersian's garlic paste | 1 ounce vodka | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Heat your grill to 400 degrees. Place 2 - 3 leeks on each wrap and drizzle with 3 tbsg of the ghee. Sprinkle 2 tspn of the garlic paste onto each leek. Cook for 5 minutes on each side. Meanwhile, stir the vodka. Remove the foil from one end of the foil and drizzle oil on each leek. Grill for 10 - 15 minutes, or until browned and crispy.

title: Asian Samosa
ingredients: 1 pound italian sausage, casings removed | 1 package frozen cut rhubarb, thawed and sliced | 4 carrots, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup prepared chat masala | 1/4 cup frozen beets, peeled cooked and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Drain excess grease and discard. Transfer to a bowl, leaving the drippings in the skillet. Stir in the rhubarb, carrots, and chaat masala. Bring to a boil then pour onto the sausage. Cook and stir until the mixture is hot and slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wasabi paste,monterey jack cheese,masa harina,kosher salt,brandy,pearl barley,salsa
title: Barley Crimini
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 cup wasabi paste | 1 cup salsa | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional ) or 1/4 cup sherry wine, of choice | 1 1/4 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons masa harina, for coating ( or cornmeal )
instructions: Place pearl barley in a shallow pan.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,marinara sauce,brown button mushroom,whipping cream,pie shell
title: Spicy Stuffed Yellow Pepper Pies
ingredients: 1 cup brown button mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 3/4 cups marinara sauce | 3/4 cup whipping cream, whipped | 1 prepared pie shells, refrigerated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a small bowl, combine mushrooms, bell pepper, marinara sauce and whipping cream.

title: Green and Yellow Squash Salad With Black Olive Dressing
ingredients: 2 lbs green and yellow squash, halved and sliced crosswise | 1 lb black olives, pitted | 1 cup chopped black olives | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Place the squash, olives, tarragon, and cilantro in a 2 quart baking dish and drizzle with olive dressing. Stir well to combine. Bake covered for 30 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with salt and serve.

title: Parmigiana Chicken Pie
ingredients: 2 cups pastry, to line a pie plate ( or a little more ) | 300 g ham steaks, diced | 3 egg whites | 2 cans single cream, condensed | 1 tablespoon mixed italian seasoning | chives, chopped, to garnish
instructions: Place the pastry in the bottom of the pie plate. Line the outside of the pie plate and line with foil over the edge of the pastry. Bake the pie at 180 degrees c for 30 minutes. Heat the cream in a large pan which has a lid, add the seasoning and ham steak and cook for an additional 15 minutes, adding the chives during to cook. Remove the foil from the top of the pastry and pour over the ham mixture in the pie plate. Return to the oven for a further 20 minutes. Serve with a loaf of country bread, or cold cuts.

title: Greek Olive Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/2 cup greek olive | kosher salt
instructions: Prepare instant pudding according to directions using your favorite vanilla pudding mix. Add kosher salt. Mix the two packages of vanilla instant pudding in your ice cream maker. After 15 minutes, remove the ice cream maker from the freezer, and put the prepared pudding mixture inches stir with a spoon and put back in the freezer until firm, around 3 hours. Remove ice cream from refrigerator and ice cream maker. Take ice cream out and serve with a spoonful of extra hot olive oil whipped with a pinch of nutmeg for garnish.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,flat rice noodle,olive oil,lard,yogurt,beef chuck
title: Tandoori Beef (Firakh Noodle Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck | 3 tablespoons lard | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup flat rice noodles | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch squares. Place beef in a large zipper top plastic bag. Add lard and toss to coat. Marinate 2 to 3 hours in refrigerator. Meanwhile, in a microwave safe bowl, microwave mango chutney until hot. In a large bowl, stir yogurt until creamy. Drain beef and add melted chutney and mix. Thread beef onto skewers. Brush with olive oil. Grill, covered, over hot coals 15 minutes, or until cooked thoroughly. Turn, basting frequently with the yogurt mixture. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,red wine vinegar,iceberg lettuce,beef broth
title: Beef and Chow Mein Soup
ingredients: 32 ounces beef broth | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1/3 cup chow mein noodles
instructions: Bring beef broth to a boil in medium saucepan over heat. Reduce heat to low. Add vinegar and cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Add lettuce.

title: Homemade Chili Salt
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed ice water | 1 can diced green chilies, drained
instructions: Mash green chilies in a mortar with a pestle. Dry fry the crushed ice water over medium heat in a non stick skillet until it starts to crackle. Add the chilies, stir well, and simmer 5 - 10 minutes in a medium heat, or until slightly thickened.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,tilapia fillet,fish sauce,french bread,baking soda,cake flour,honey
title: Sweet and Sour Spicy Grilled Tilapia
ingredients: 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1/2 cup bottled chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup cake flour ( all purpose not self rising ) | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 4 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into 4 pieces | 2 loaves day old french bread ( cut 1-2 slices )
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in a large bowl, then pour over fish in a resealable plastic bag. Seal and refrigerate up to 2 days. Preheat grill to high heat. Remove fish from marinade and arrange meat on grill. Grill for 6 minutes per side, or until fish flakes easily with a fork and topping is dark brown. Slice french bread into 6 thick slices, and arrange bread on grill. Serve with fish. Variation, make a double batch by adding 2 lbs of the tilapia fillets.

Random Ingredients: bulb garlic,ginger juice,saffron strand,poblano chile,cumin seed
title: Algerian Saffron Garlic Chiles
ingredients: 2 lbs small garlic | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger juice | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 -2 saffron strand | 2 -3 poblano chiles
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise down the length of the garlic. Enlarge out the inside of the garlic and discard the outer layers of skin. Chop the garlic into 1 inch cubes. In a large pot place the garlic cloves, ginger juice, cumin and saffron strands. Bring to boil. Cover and remove from heat but leave on the burner for at least 30 minutes to infuse. If you notice garlic burning at the bottom of the pot, reduce the heat to medium low. If you notice this, increase the burner to medium low and cook for at least 30 minutes. Do not remove the lid after 15 minutes. Stir often. Add poblanos, stir to coat with oil and continue to cook uncovered on low until the chiles are soft, about 15 additional minutes. The chile should be quite dry as you will be using it in the next step. Take from heat once the garlic is soft and cool completely. This can be eaten warm or chilled. Store in an airtight container. Use in marinating, rice, burritos, sandwiches, to eat as is, with a side of a grilled chicken, meat or vegetable.

Random Ingredients: oregano,wooden skewer,pesto sauce,kalamata olive,marinara sauce,dark rum
title: Sparkling Mediterranean Kebabs
ingredients: 2/3 cup kalamata olives or 2/3 cup black olives | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dry marinara sauce | 1 3/4 ounces pesto sauce | 1/4 cup dark rum | wooden skewer ( soaked in water )
instructions: Place kalamata olives, oregano, marinara sauce, pesto, rum, and skewer in a blender and process until all ingredients are well blended, about 1 minute. Transfer mixture to a shallow dish. Cool at room temperature for about 1 hour. Place skewers on a wire rack. Pour marinara sauce over skewers. Allow skewers to marinate at least 6 hours. Preheat a broiler. When ready to cook, heat grill to medium low. Transfer skewers to a platter. Cook skewers until tender and lightly charred.

title: Prawns (Peel Method)
ingredients: 600 g peeled prawns ( king raw ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh galangal or 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Wash prawns, removing any damaged prawns. Heat oil in heavy pan. Fry prawns over medium heat until almost done. If they are still slightly on bottom, turn down heat to low and stir fry and keep moving. The prawns should be white and dark in colour when cooked. Stir in sugar, salt and freshly ground cardamom and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Transfer prawns and juices to bowl. Add galangal/curry and mix well. If necessary, add a few drops of water to help loosen mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,macaroni,red cabbage,lemon juice zest,sub french bread,tomato sauce
title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1/2 head red cabbage, chopped | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup macaroni ( shell or spiral ) ( optional ) | 5 slices sandwich bread
instructions: Mix the salad and mix with the salad dressing. Cook the macaroni according to package directions. While the pasta is cooking, soak the bread in cold water for a couple of minutes, then cut it into small pieces and fry them in butter or a little olive oil. When the macaroni is cooked, drain the excess water and set it aside while making the salad. Place the salad and dressing in salad bowl and mix well.

title: Limeade Concentrate
ingredients: 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate ( such as muir glen ) | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( not cooking sherry ) | 1/4 cup sugar, to taste
instructions: In a large kettle combine limeade concentrate, sherry, and sugar. Bring to boiling over medium high heat. Remove from heat. Slowly stir to mix. Pour into hot pint jars and put a wooden pick in the jar so it picks up any lime that is left sticking out of the jar. Keeps in the fridge for up to 10 days. Lime limes will last in the refrigerator for about 5 weeks.

title: Mexican Martini
ingredients: 1/4 ounce yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons guinness stout | 12 slices prosciutto | 12 large dill pickle slices | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chile, chopped
instructions: Melt yeast in guinness, add 3/4 cup warm water. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy. Mix in proscuitto, pickles, and chipotle. Let stand 10 minutes. Pour into sterilized 8x8 inch baking pan to depth of 2 inches and chill. Cut into 24 slices and serve warm.

title: Asian Rice Vinegar Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup rice wine vinegar | 2/3 cup vegetable or red onion, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Combine rice vinegar, vegetable or red onion and rice wine vinegar in blender. Cover and process until onion is chopped and mixture is syrupy.

title: Quick Artichoke and Sun-Dried Artichoke Pikelets
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss artichoke hearts with flour to coat thoroughly. Cut an opening in the center of each artichoke heart.

title: French Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 large beet, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 small red onion, finely minced | 2 leeks, white parts only, minced | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 2 tablespoons finely shredded unsalted mixed sprouts
instructions: Dry the beet leaves until dry and allow to dry on paper towels. Bring a large saucepan of water to boil and add the beet slices and cook for about 10 to 15 seconds or until just tender. Drain them and allow them to cool slightly. Dry them well on paper towels. Mix the red onion with the minced leeks, mustard and marjoram and set aside. Add a large serving bowl filled with ice cubes. Place the beet mixture on top of the beet leaves and gently toss. Sprinkle with the shredded mixed sprouts and top with the remaining sprouts. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pink food coloring,sauerkraut,red wine vinegar,heavy cream,pork tenderloin
title: Sauerkraut Poached Pork Tenderloins With Creamy Gourmet Bordelaise
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 3 ounces sauerkraut, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/4 teaspoon pink food coloring or 1/4 teaspoon pink food coloring
instructions: Wash and pat dry the tenderloin and cut into 1/4 inch slices about 1 1/2 inches wide. In a small bowl, combine the sauererkraut, vinegar, cream and food coloring. Whisk to blend. Place the breaded tenderloin slices in a saucepan of boiling water and boil for about 10 minutes or until partially cooked. Drain. Spread the sauerkraut cream on the tenderloins and grill over low heat, turning the meat once, or till browned and beginning to char. Serve hot. Suggested dippers, potato gnocchi, pork loin steak and pate. Yummy.

Random Ingredients: date,wheat pita bread,crawfish,chili flake,tequila,cod fish fillet,feta cheese
title: Crispy Seafood Toast
ingredients: 4 ounces fish, steamed for 3 minutes | 4 ounces coconut fish fillets, steamed for 3 minutes | 4 ounces tuna fish fillets, steamed for 3 minutes | 5 -6 whole wheat pita bread, cut into 1cm thick slices | 12 pieces dates, halved | 1 -2 tablespoon tequila | chili flakes, to serve
instructions: Toast the pita bread slices on both halves of the bread for about 2 minutes or until golden. Cut each piece in half, place on a plate and top with the remaining ingredients and the chili flakes. Enjoy with a glass of tequila.

title: Elva De Pesca (Beets & Sole Fillets)
ingredients: 3 small beet, in small chunks | 3 sole fillets | 1/4 cup chili beans | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 dash pepperoni or 1 dash any other spicy hot chili seasoning
instructions: Cook the beet over a medium gas flame stirring occasionally for about 30 mins, or until a golden brown color. When done, you can slice into thin rounds. Cut the sole fillets lengthways into halves and arrange them and the beet on a serving plate. Heat olive oil in a pan and add pepperoni pepper. Cook for 3 mins and then remove the pepperoni. Pour the sauce in the pan and bring to a simmer. Mix the beet strips into the sauce and cook for 5 mins or until they are tender. Serve over the fillets and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,italian sausage,cider vinegar,cumin powder,mung bean
title: Kung Pao - Filipino Beans Snack
ingredients: 2 cups mung beans ( beans with or without leaves ) | 12 ounces fish or 12 ounces chicken stock | 2/3 cup cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons cumin powder | 1/2 lb italian sausage ( chinese-italian and/or sweet italian-style pork links )
instructions: Heat the stock and vinegar. Add the beans, cumin & sausage. Cover and simmer over low heat until beans are tender, about 30 minutes and a spoonful of water will form if you stir the beans. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,chicken meat,crust,white bread,panang curry paste,clove garlic,rigatoni pasta
title: Stir-Fried Chicken and Garlic Lovers Curry
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 3 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 tablespoon chicken-flavored panang curry paste | 300 g panang curry paste | 500 g rigatoni pasta, cooked al dente | 300 g crusty white bread, cubed | 1/4 cup thickened cream or 1/4 cup light cream
instructions: Cut the chicken breasts in half, then slice each breast into strips. Slice the garlic, then put it in the slow cooker. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of chicken powder, 1 tablespoon of curry paste, and 2 tablespoons of panang curry mix in the slow cooker. Pour the contents of the panang paste into the cooker. Add the rest of the curry blend ingredients into the cooker, stirring to make sure the sauce is completely mixed in with the chicken. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours or until the chicken is cooked fully. Just before serving, stir the bread cubes into the curry mixture and stir to blend it in. Serve the chicken and curry mixture over the pasta immediately.

title: Homemade Chicken Stock II
ingredients: 2 quarts hot chicken stock | vegetable oil
instructions: In a saucepan, bring the chicken stock to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium, and simmer until the particles of fat separate from the soup surface, stirring frequently to avoid burning the stock. Pour the stock into a container with a lid, and refrigerate overnight, or at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Auntie Lori's Apricot Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces dried spaghetti | 1 jar apricot preserves | 1/2 cup almond butter
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water until al dente. Drain. Stir preserves in melted apricot butter until well mixed. Stuff drained spaghetti with mixture. Pour almond butter evenly over the top and return to the refrigerator until the mixture is slightly warmed or you can serve the sauce ahead. Cook's note, you can also stuff the top with sliced almonds if you like.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,sesame seed oil,swiss cheese,macaroni noodle,anise seed,asafoetida powder,onion
title: Chewy Swiss Macaroni Cheese Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded ( 1/4-1/2 cup ) | 1 package macaroni noodles, broken into small pieces ( about 1.5-2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon onion ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed ( optional ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons sesame seed oil | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Cook the noodles in lightly salted water according to package directions.

title: Tami's Black Olive and Prosciutto Stuffed
ingredients: 2 medium ripe black olives, sliced lengthwise to make 4 thick slices | 4 slices prosciutto ( thin slices or pieces ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter ( to taste ) | 2/3 cup tamari | 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate square | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut a slit into each olive slice and place on a sheet of parchment paper. Cut the prosciutto into about 1/2 thick slices and place in the olives. In a saucepan, mix the tamari with the chocolate, a bit of the tamari and the cumin and set over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Take the pan off the heat and set aside. Preheat the oven to 325°f. Line the loaf pan with the strips of prosciutto over the bottom and up the sides. Dip the olives into the chocolate sauce and place them into the pan. Cover the olives with the prosciutto slices. Combine the bread crumbs and the rest of the tamari and sprinkle them over the top of the mixture. Bake for about 40 minutes, or until the topping is golden and crisp.

Random Ingredients: coriander,allspice,italian sausage,red wine vinegar,pork shoulder,kiwi fruit,dijon mustard,basmati rice
title: Spiced Sausages With Kiwi-Glazed Onions and Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 6 cups cooked basmati rice, chilled | 6 large kiwi fruits, peeled, including the pits, cut into 3/4 inch rounds ( about 1-1/2 kg each ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Cooks note, the spices measure are for seasoning and quantity, and vary in seasoning quantities to suit individual tastes and preferences. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f & grease a shallow baking dish. To prepare the sausage, heat a large non stick skillet or wok over high heat, add the sausage and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes or until the sausage is cooked through and starting to brown. Transfer the sausage to a large heatproof bowl or platter and allow to cool slightly. Pour enough cold water to just cover the sausage in the pan or wok. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 7 minutes. Remove the sausage from the water, drain and cool completely. To prepare the glaze, cook the kiwis in a small saucepan of boiling water for 5 - 6 minutes, or until just softened. Drain, return to the pan and cook for 2 - 3 minutes or until heated through. Transfer to a blender and add the remaining ingredients and blend for 1 minute or until completely smooth. Season to taste with salt and pepper. To assemble, place half the rice on the work surface or a large dinner plate, then arrange 1/2 cup of the sausages on top, then cover with half the kiwi glaze, then top with the remaining rice. Pour the remaining glaze over the rice and gently toss. Serve immediately. Notes, the spicy kiwi glaze adds more moisture to the rice without altering it completely. For a more robust kiwi flavour, add a little dry mustard to the glaze before adding to the wok. This recipe has evolved a little over the years, so make sure to use a good quality kiwi flavour and kiwi colour as it really is delicate and flavoursome. When the glaze is added, it is only meant to give it a final flavour and texture to the finished dish, so taste before adding any extra seasonings. This recipe has evolved significantly over the years, so use sparingly.

title: Spicy Triangles
ingredients: 6 ounces phyllo dough | 2 ounces hot red chili peppers, minced ( use 2 for mild peppers if you like )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray cookie sheet with cooking oil spray. Open chili peppers and break into pieces. Arrange 3 pieces on cookie sheet. Spoon 1 tablespoon of spicy chili pepper mixture over each piece of phyllo. Cover with more phyllo and repeat the layers. Brush tops with vegetable oil. Bake 30 minutes or until crisp and golden.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,peanut butter,lemon extract,tomato,rigatoni pasta
title: Sauce for a Steak or Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 box rigatoni pasta or ( 12 ounce ) box ziti pasta | 3/4 cup chopped tomato, with juice
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the peanut butter, brown sugar, and lemon extract. Stir over medium heat until melted. Cook and stir for about 5 minutes. Cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain, and rinse with cold water. Place in a deep dish or roaster. Pour sauce over it all. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for about 30 minutes, until heated through and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: white bean,fish sauce,italian flat leaf parsley,lemonade,italian bread french,self raising flour,beef bouillon,lemon peel
title: Beef and Bean Loaf
ingredients: 400 g ground beef or 400 g ground turkey | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 100 g white beans, drained | 1 packet dry active yeast | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon grated lemonade | 1 2/3 cups self-raising flour | italian flat-leaf parsley, to garnish
instructions: Line base and side of a 30cm x 20cm loaf tin with baking paper and grease baking paper. Place ground meat in a large bowl. Add fish sauce, beans, yeast, peel and lemonade, then stir to combine well. Mix in flour, adding about 1 2/3 cups more. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead for about 7 minutes, then shape into a 30cm x 15cm loaf, pressing a handful of mix near the top of the tin. Cover with greased baking paper and a tea towel and set aside in a warm place to rise. Cover loaf tin with a tea towel and place in a medium sized oven proof pan. Preheat oven to 180°c or 180°c fan forced. Bake loaf for 50 minutes or until just firm and golden. Serve with chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: espresso,cake yeast,rye bread,curry paste,red wine vinegar,large shrimp
title: Beefy Open-Face French Toast
ingredients: 2 cakes yeast, 1 cup | 4 cups bread, 3-inch slices | 8 ounces large shrimp, uncooked | 12 ounces coffee-flavored espresso | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Prepare yeast according to package directions using 1/2 cup water. Spread the bread slices on a baking sheet and toast until golden, about 15 minutes. Cut shrimp in half through the shell and set aside. Heat up espresso until very hot, add curry paste. Cook until fragrant. Toast bread in hot espresso for about 1 minute on each side. Serve french toast topped with shrimp and espresso.

Random Ingredients: green mango,dark sesame oil,bulk sausage,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Baked Sausage with Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/2 lb bulk sausage | 1 green mango, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Drain mango slices in a strainer set over a bowl. Place cream cheese in a large bowl, beat on high for 10 minutes until smooth. Stir in sausages, mango and sesame oil. Transfer to a lightly greased 13 x 9 glass pan. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes for a cream cheese mixture or 25 minutes on low until hot and starting to bubble. Cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,pita bread,white pepper,brie cheese,italian dressing,cheddar cheese,rice
title: Shiitake Breakfast Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 package cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 package smoked bacon | 1/4 cup cooked rice | 1/4 cup shredded italian dressing ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground white pepper | 4 large pita bread, split
instructions: Heat a nonstick frying pan or griddle over medium heat. Remove the mushroom stems and set aside. Grill or broil the mushrooms until the mushrooms are soft and the edges begin to brown.

title: Mint Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice wine | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon mint jelly or 1 tablespoon jelly | 3 green onions, finely chopped | 1 cup shredded carrot
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Serve with grilled chicken.

Random Ingredients: black olive,baby spinach,sirloin,baking potato,onion powder,tomato puree,mace,marjoram
title: Spinach and Beef Pot Pie
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 medium onion, diced | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 cups baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place potatoes in a deep roasting pan or cookie sheet and cover with foil. Bake potatoes for 45 minutes. Remove from oven, uncover and return the foil to the pan, return to oven. Bake for an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees. While the potatoes are cooking, remove any remaining fat from the ground sirloin and crumble in a large skillet. Add onion and cook until tender. Drain grease. Remove skillet from heat. Add puree, olives, marjoram, thyme, mace, and ground pepper. Remove the dough from the oven. Allow it to cool for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut the dough into four equal pieces. Roll one piece into a 10 inch circle. Repeat with the other piece of dough. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Poke the dough with a fork in the center of each tortilla with a fork. Divide the ground sirloin mixture evenly evenly among the tortillas. Layer spinach among the tortillas. Return the pan to the oven and bake for 45 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown, and the meat is hot and bubbling.

title: Spanish Green Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces cut green beans | 1/2 cup olive
instructions: Cook beans according to directions on bag. Sauté olives in pan with olive juice and heat up serve hot or cold. I like to serve this with pico de gallo.

title: Chinese Sweet & Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 package prepared chicken soup | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: In a saucepan over medium low heat, combine the chicken soup powder with a dash of water and bring to a simmer. Stir in the vinegar and simmer until warmed through. Do not boil. Serve over noodles or egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: sparkling water,maraschino cherry,rice noodle,coriander powder,pork tenderloin,green enchilada sauce,szechuan peppercorn
title: Peanut Flavoured Pork Ramen
ingredients: 300 g pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 teaspoon rice noodles | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup sparkling water | 1/4 cup chopped maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: Cut tenderloin crosswise into slices about 4 x 1 x 2. Trim to 3 inch long. Place pork in food processor. Add rice noodles and peppercorns, and process until smooth. Stir in the enchilada, sparkling water, and maraschino. Process until just mixed. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate until needed. Thread a marinated pork slice onto each of 4 - 4 metal skewers, with short ends attached. Cook chops, in a hot wok or skillet over high heat for 2 or 3 minutes on each side or until just cooked through. Transfer to a cutting board, and cover loosely with foil. Allow to rest for 2 to 3 minutes. While chops are resting, cut open the roll and discard roll. Spoon sauce over the ramen, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon raisin bread,veal,peanut butter,chicken meat,watermelon,olive,chicken broth
title: Frugal Gourmet Salad
ingredients: 1 lb veal, diced | 1 loaf cinnamon raisin bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can chicken broth | 1 cup watermelon, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup olive, pitted and cut into chunks, drained | 1/4 cup peanut butter, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Combine veal, chicken broth and watermelon in 2 quart saucepan. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Stir together bread cubes, olives, peanut butter and cinnamon. Arrange in a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish. Spoon salad into bread bowl and sprinkle with extra crumb, if desired.

title: Cilantro Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 lb green pepper, very thinly sliced ( about 3 cups ) | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, very thinly sliced | 3/4 lb white mushroom, such as shiitake, cut into rounds ( about 4-1/2 cups )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mushrooms in a 1 to 2 quart heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer 3 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add mushrooms and cook, uncovered, stirring often, 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Minty Chiles for Shrimps
ingredients: 2 large dried red chiles | 24 leaves mint | 4 -6 cloves garlic salt
instructions: Place chiles in a bowl filled with warm water and soak overnight. Next day, drain and discard soaking water. Toast chiles in a dry frying pan, shaking until dry. Cool and finely chop. Remove stems and seeds from chiles, then roughly chop. Place in a bowl with mint leaves and garlic salt and toss lightly until mixture is well coated.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,ricotta cheese,sunflower seed,italian herb,white cabbage
title: Italian Beef With Cabbage and Sunflower Seeds
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 1 head white cabbage | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs | 2 -3 leaves white cabbage | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds
instructions: Wash and trim the cabbage of any hard parts, and coarsely chop the leaves. Bring the beef up to room temperature in the crockpot or a deep casserole dish. Trim any very dark spots from the beef, and add it to the crockpot or casserole with the shredded leaves of white cabbage. Add the italian herbs, pine nuts and sunflower seeds. You can leave this to cook on high for 2 - 3 hours, or on low for 7 1/2 hours. Remove beef from crockpot, and cut into chunks and return to crockpot. You can cook on high for 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,lemon juice,seasoning mix,sharp cheddar cheese,sirloin tip roast
title: Beef & Bean Casserole
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin tip roast | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 4 tablespoons lemon juice | seasoning mix | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated, about 2 cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place roast in a roasting pan and place in oven. Roast, stirring often, until temperature reaches 140 degrees. Remove and discard the foil. Transfer the roast to a plate. Insert meat thermometer into center of meat, in the shape of an x. Insert a long toothpick thru the center of the meat. Bring the meat to room temperature and spread evenly. Arrange the cannellini beans on top of meat. Heat and stir lemon juice and seasoning mix in a small saucepan. Pour the hot mixture evenly over the beans. Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the top of the casserole. Return it to oven and bake for 1 hour until meat thermometer inserted in center of meat registers 125 degrees. Uncover and bake an additional 30 to 45 minutes or until cheese topping is lightly browned and bubbling.

title: Potted Cherries
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon coriander seed | 8 ripe sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 4 tablespoons cherries blossoms
instructions: Heat a small frying pan and dry fry the coriander seeds until they darken. Remove and repeat until the darker the shade is left. Wash or soak the sun dried tomatoes until they are soft. Chop finely. Fry the celery in this spice for 10 minutes until soft. Strain and mash the coriander. Add all the spice mixture to the tomato mixture. Put onto the heat and continue to stir. When boiling, lower the heat and continue to simmer to liquid the liquid. You may need to add a little more water at a time depending on the moisture level of the liquid. It should be thick, but pourable. Taste, and add more seasoning. Keep hot for 10 minutes over low heat. Serve the cherries drizzled with the sour cream or cream dusted with chives. Great with fresh crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,grape,sourdough bread,sherry wine,ancho chile powder
title: Rice Con Queso (Chocolate and Sherry Pudding)
ingredients: 250 g good harvest bread | 150 ounces milk chocolate | 50 g sherry wine ( a sweet sweet orange or a dark orange would be suitable ) | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons roasted ancho chili powder ( a substitution ( optional ) | sourdough bread ( optional )
instructions: Line the base of a large deep ovenproof pan with some baking paper. Cut 1/2 cup of the bread into chunks, soak in cold water for 10 minutes, and drain. Melt the chocolate with the sherry, stirring occasionally, over low heat. Cool slightly to give less room. Pour chocolate into a large heavy metal bowl. Cut the remaining bread into thin slices and place into the chocolate. Add the ancho chili powder and stir well. Spread the chocolate on top and sprinkle with some breadcrumbs or more salt. Place in a pre heated oven, 180c, gas mark 5, for 45 minutes but check after 20 minutes and stir again. Serve hot, warm or cold, with whipped cream.

title: Blueberry and Farmer's Beans
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1 lb white beans or 1 lb white beans, cooked | 1/8 cup asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In crock pot, layer blueberries, beans, asafoetida and capers as follows,. Sprinkle with feta cheese. Cover and cook on high 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: fruit,spring onion,pork shoulder,cream mushroom soup,chocolate chip,celery,caper
title: Cherry's Chunky Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 2 stalks celery, shredded | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 12 ounces chocolate chips | 1 jar seedless fruit, drained, chopped, and reserve liquid ( i use pineapple slices ) | 2 tablespoons capers | 8 sprigs spring onions
instructions: Dice pork into 1/2 inch cubes and return to pan. Add celery and stir until cooked but not browned. Drain soup ingredients from can into the pork, pour over pork and return to heated pot. Add fruit and capers. Heat on low, stirring occasionally until sauce is slightly thicken. Serve with crusty white italian bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,plain flour,stock,oat,cashew,corn oil,beef tenderloin
title: Rillettes de Cochon - Roasted Fish With Cashews
ingredients: 350 g plain flour | 250 g ground cashews | 1 kg beef tenderloin, trimmed ( approx 3.1lb ) | 40 g corn oil | 500 ml stock ( or chicken stock ) | 310 g cooked fresh white fish fillets, sliced ( about 1.5lb ) | 310 g toasted raw cashews ( or almonds )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c / 375°f / gas 6/moderate oven. Mix all pastry ingredients together, and press into a loose bottomed 23cm loose bottomed cake tin. Cut meat into slices about 3 by 4 wide, then into slices about 2 wide and 1/2 thick. In a shallow roasting tin, fry the meat slices in half of the corn oil over a high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Put meat slices on top of pastry, with the cashews, and bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,zucchini,veal,gelatin,sun tomato oil,tomato green chilies
title: Quick and Easy One Pan Fish With Chiles
ingredients: 20 g gelatin | 300 g halibut fillets ( or any other firm white fish ) | 1 zucchini | 1/2 cup tomatoes and green chilies, roughly chopped ( canned diced is fine ) | 1/2 cup pitted sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained & chopped | 4 medium free range veal shanks or 4 medium duck breasts
instructions: Sprinkle the gelatine over the fish then cover with boiling water. Meanwhile, grate the zucchini into a very thin shred. Put the diced zucchini into a bowl, add the chopped tomatoes and chopped sun dried tomato as well as the salt, mix well & set aside. Cut the halibut into slices widthways. Drain and rinse under cold water and pat dry with kitchen paper. Tear into 2 cm pieces if your veal shank has any fat. Cut the two pieces of halibut or duck breasts into similar sizes. Line the shallow base of your favourite glass tin with aluminium foil or wax paper. Lay the fish onto the foil and layer over the zucchini and tomato mixture, season with the salt and scatter over the chopped sun dried tomatoes. Lay the two pieces of halibut or duck on top and leave to rest in the refrigerator for about 1 hour. Preheat your grill or a flat griddle pan. Place over a medium high heat. Place the fish on two oiled baking trays, sprinkle with salt, then cook 4 minutes on each side or until cooked and flesh is flakey. Serve with boiled potatoes or as the dish is or on the side with lemon wedges on the side for dipping.

title: Thai Chili Paste
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 4 sage leaves or 1 teaspoon dry crushed dried sage
instructions: Place the soy sauce and sage in a small mortar or pestle and crush into a fine paste. Store in a closed container away from direct sunlight for up to 2 months, or you may leave in a dark, dry, dry, dark and dry smoke for several days. This helps mellow out the flavours and intensify the flavours.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,russet potato,red chili pepper,beef,brussels sprout,green bell pepper,apple juice
title: Pumpkin and Parsnip Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef ( chuck or blade ) | 1/2 lb brussels sprout | 1/2 lb russet potato | 1/2 lb peeled and finely chopped parsnip | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh red chili pepper
instructions: Place the chuck or blade of a large stew meat in a 6 quart kettle. Dice the vegetables except the parsnips. When it starts to brown, add the chopped beef, stir. Add the apples, parsnips, and the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, lower the heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add the parsnips at the end.

Random Ingredients: parsley,chili pepper flake,basil leaf,cauliflower,broccoli floret,poblano pepper,frosting
title: Broccoli Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, snipped | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | frosting : | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup fat-free evaporated milk
instructions: In a food processor, whirl together the broccoli, cauliflower, pepper, herbs, and chili flakes until smooth. Pour vegetables into a shallow 2 quart baking dish. Cover evenly with the cream. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. Remove dish from the refrigerator. Place the remaining ingredients in a bowl and toss with sour cream.

title: Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup, or to desired consistency | 3 cans red enchilada sauce | 1 package of favorite enchilada sauces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine tomato soup and 3 cans enchilada sauce. Stir until well mixed. Pour half a can of enchilada sauce in a 9x13 inch baking dish, then spread the other half of the can of enchilada sauce over the top of the sauce. Spread the remaining enchilada sauce over the top of the sauce. Sprinkle the remaining can of enchilada sauce over the top. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven until bubbly, about 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Swiss Chard, Sun  Seeds and  Pesto
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, about 10 inches long, stems only, stemmed and cut into small cross pieces 2 1/4 `` | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained if salted, lightly smashed before using
instructions: Rinse chard and dry with a paper towels. Remove the stalks and white membrane on the chard.

Random Ingredients: red onion,black eyed pea,portabella mushroom,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Beans, Mushrooms & Cheese
ingredients: 1 package portabella mushrooms | 1 can black-eyed peas ( drained ) | 2 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 red onion ( sliced thin )
instructions: Wash mushrooms and remove stem. Slice mushrooms open, discard stems and slice caps. Place pepper jack cheese in a microwave safe bowl. Top with sliced mushrooms and sliced red onions. Microwave on high for one minute or until cheese is melted throughout cheese. Stir and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rice,spring onion,white wine,honey,pearl barley,cream chicken soup,celery rib
title: Easy Barley and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 cups leftover cooked rice ( any kind will do ) | 230 g pearl barley | 1 bunch spring onion | 1 large celery rib | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cream of chicken soup | 0.5 can cream of chicken soup | soy sauce, to coat soup
instructions: In a large saucepan, add rice, spring onions, celery and white wine. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until it absorbed moisture. Add the cream of chicken soup, cream of chicken soup and soy sauce. Keep stirring until ingredients are blended and heated through. To serve, place soup into bowls and layer rice mixture on top.

title: Chocolate Cranberry Pudding
ingredients: 375 g condensed milk | 250 ml madeira wine | 50 g roasted peanuts | 1 cup fresh cranberry juice
instructions: Crush the peanuts with a mortar and pestle, add sugar and stir until you have a paste. Add the condensed milk and madeira and stir well until you have a smooth sauce. Pour the blended mixture into a shallow casserole dish. Add the cranberry juice on top and leave for at least half an hour or until the cranberries burst. Serve chilled.

title: Easy Microwave Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced
instructions: Mix all ingredients except beef. Marinade beef 2 hours or overnight. Thread kababs onto metal skewers. Grill, broil or barbecue.

title: Indian Grilled Squash
ingredients: 14 ounces winter squash, peeled | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Toss squash with remaining ingredients in bowl. Grill or broil 12 - 14 minutes, turning as needed.

title: Simple Sushi Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sushi-style rice, rinsed well | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Place rinsed rice in a bowl, and cover with very hot tap water. Swirl in the baking powder and let stand for 30 to 60 minutes. Drain rice and allow to dry and dry a bit. Place rinsed rice, garlic, and salt in a mixing owl, and add about 3 tablespoons of sushi flavored soy sauce mixture. Blend together like crazy, then mix into the cooked rice until it's all mixed inches. Note, i've actually seen people add a dash of sesame seeds at this point if you want to make this in a bowl, but it's not necessary.

title: Easy Enchilada Dip - Super Easy!!
ingredients: 1 jar island-style dressing, divided | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to mix 1/2 of the dressing with 2 cups of the enchilada sauce.

title: Easy Chunky Creamy Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 20 ounces cream of chicken soup | 2 fresh serrano peppers, deveined and deveined
instructions: In a small bowl, combine soup and pepper and combine thoroughly. Pour the cream mixture into a crock or serving dish and cover with plastic wrap. Let chill in the refrigerator for up to 1 hour before serving.

title: Avocado and Cherry Tomato Fritters
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, mashed | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 3/4 pint cherry tomatoes
instructions: Beat together the avocado and marjoram. Stir in flour and mix well. Divide into balls. Place a cherry or tomato in the centre of each ball and roll up, placing them in a bowl of cold water to prevent the fritters from sticking. Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,taco sauce,dill sprig,lemongrass paste,beef bouillon powder
title: Lemongrass Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemongrass paste | 3 cups low-sodium beef broth, reduced sodium | 1 lb deli roast beef, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon low-sodium taco sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder
instructions: Blend lemongrass paste, broth and 1 1/2 cups cold water in blender in batches. Add beef and taco sauce.

title: Cottage Cheese and Dates-Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup cottage cheese or 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped serrano chilies | 2 -4 ounces dates, chopped ( use as many as desired to make a good quantity ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped english cucumber | butter flavor enhancer and seasoning ( e.g. a taste of home a.k.a. mrs dash's season-all ) | ice water or water
instructions: Drain the cottage cheese into a large bowl. Place the chutney in another large bowl and add the chopped dates, cucumber, salted butter flavor, a mix of e. G.E.A.K.  or Mrs Dash's seasoning all. Mix well until all ingredients are mixed. Add ice water/water to desired consistency. Best eaten with toast soldiers.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,sirloin,wood ear mushroom,okra,sherry wine,oregano leaf,dark brown sugar,honey
title: Bulgogi (Japanese-American Casserole)
ingredients: 1 jar okra, drained | 1/2 cup sweet rice noodles | 1/2 lb sirloin, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb dried wood ear mushrooms, soaked in water for 15 minutes | 3 tablespoons sherry wine or 3 tablespoons japanese sake | 6 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Soak the okra and noodles in warm water for an hour. Meanwhile, saute the meat until it browns. Drain. Cut fine and remove outer layer of skin from uncooked okra, set aside on a plate covered with paper towel. Saute mushrooms in sherry or sherry. Drain okra well, then rinse. Remove stem and leaves, then cut fine and toss with okra. Arrange noodles on a deep serving platter on the bottom. Cover with meat mixture and top with mushrooms and okra. Spoon remaining sherry over top of meat and mushrooms. Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with honey. Serve at room temperature with salad.

title: Quick Beef Sirloin Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chipotle cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut diagonally into 3/4 inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f heat a nonstick skillet over high heat until hot but not smoking. Sprinkle with pepper. Remove the beef and discard the oil. Rub the cheddar cheese all over the beef. Transfer the beef to a large baking sheet. Bake for 13 minutes, making sure to turn over halfway through. Sprinkle the beef with pepper and return to the oven. Bake for 10 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through. Serve.

title: Kiwi and Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 kiwi fruits, diced | 1 cup diced red onion | 1 lb lasagna noodle, cooked | 1/2 cup chopped fresh kiwifruit
instructions: Drain kiwifruit, reserving juice. Saute onion in butter until it begins to brown. Add kiwifruit and juice. Toss in noodles. Sprinkle with chopped kiwifruit and toss just before serving.

title: Basic Adobo Roasted Celery
ingredients: 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 3 stalks celery
instructions: Mix together the adobo sauce, baking soda and celery. Spread over a cutting board or other shallow baking dish. Roast on lowest rack of oven until tender, about 1 hour. Serve with cornbread or fried plantains.

title: Seared Beef Tenderloin With Crispy Mushroom and Raisins
ingredients: 2 teaspoons margarine, melted | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, well trimmed | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 3 medium shiitake mushrooms, stems removed and caps sliced | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425º f. Line pan with foil and grease with margarine. Remove beef from foil, brush with melted margarine, and season generously with salt and pepper. Place beef in pan and bake until thermometer reads 120ºf for medium rare, about 15 - 20 minutes. Transfer to cutting board and let rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss the mushrooms and raisins with the soy sauce and set aside. Add the mushrooms and raisins to the pan with the beef, and heat until warm. Slice beef and serve at once.

title: Frugal Walnut Side Item
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorns, lightly crushed
instructions: Bring walnuts to room temperature. Place bay leaves, black peppercorns, and walnuts into a small bowl and stir to combine. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: tia maria,oregano,lettuce leaf,cooking sherry,shortcrust pastry,ice water,green onion
title: Mini Tia Maria Sandwiches
ingredients: 10 sheets frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup tia maria or 1/4 cup bacardi liquor, of your choice | 4 fluid ounces ice water, approximately | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking sherry | 6 green onions, finely chopped | fresh oregano, to taste | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c / 375°f lightly grease the sides of 12 muffin cups with shortcrust pastry. Roll each pastry sheet into a 1/2 inch thick round or rectangle. Place 1/4 cup of the tia maria in the centre of pastry and draw up edges of pastry to seal.. Carefully transfer pastry rectangle to a baking sheet lined with baking paper and place pastry topside down on baking sheet for 20 minutes, or until golden. Carefully remove pastry from baking sheet and set aside on a paper towel covered baking sheet lined with baking paper. Meanwhile, prepare filling by combining sherry, green onions, remaining tia maria and freshly ground oregano in a small bowl. Carefully transfer filling in a pastry bag and snip loose corner and pipe filling through pastry bag. Return filled pastry to baking sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden. Cut a slit into top pastry to allow steam to escape. Serve pastry topped with lettuce leaves.

title: Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 15 large ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded, and coarsely chopped | 5/8 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 cup vodka ( no substitutions ) | 1/4 cup toasted, chopped walnuts
instructions: Place tomatoes in a medium saucepan with sugar, then add vodka. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until mixture is slightly thickened, about 30 minutes. Cool slightly before using. To serve, spoon hot tomato sauce atop toasted walnuts.

title: Chili Beans Au Jus
ingredients: 1 cup cannellini beans, soaked | 1 tablespoon sultanas or 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and sliced
instructions: Soak the beans overnight in cold water. Drain. Combine the haricots, sultanas, tarragon and orange peel. Dry the beans. Put in a buttered shallow ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with the chili. Roast in a preheated oven for approx 45 mins at 220c.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,hoagie,italian bread,part ricotta cheese,pork loin chop,salt,elbow macaroni
title: Italian Pork Braid
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 boneless pork loin chops | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 cups dry elbow macaroni ( or other short pasta ) | 3 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | salt | 8 hoagie rolls
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking non stick cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Coat bottom of skillet with olive oil spray. Add chops to skillet and brown on both sides.

title: Greek Caviar With Woodcock Beans
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh woodcock | 5 ounces cannellini beans | 5 ounces cauliflower | crusty bread, to serve | greek seasoning, to garnish | orange peel, to garnish
instructions: Remove the woodcock from the shells and cut into 2 - 3 pieces. Split the head from the head, remove the eyes and any dark matter attached to it, then cut out all the eyes and coarse dark matter, the white part only. Cook the woodcock in boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes or until the shells start floating to the surface. Drain, cut into 2 - 3 chunks and place in a large pan. Add to this the beans, cauliflower and green beans, cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes until the vegetables are crisp tender. Season to taste and serve at once. Garnish with croutons and orange peel on the side.

title: Rice Crispies Bacon Balls
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon | 1 bag rice krispies | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 2 -3 tablespoons citrus juice
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Cut down on bacon fat and fry rice krispies until brown. Place rice krispies in large bowl, crumble bacon and pour citrus juice over. Mix well. Roll into 1 inch balls. Fry balls one at a time until golden brown on all sides.

Random Ingredients: new potato,tart apple,orzo pasta,dark raisin,pumpkin seed,dill,cashew nut,peanut butter
title: Orzo Mushroom Salad with Crispy Cashews
ingredients: 2 ounces dry orzo pasta | 1 1/4 cups cashew nuts, finely chopped | 5 ounces fresh pumpkin seeds | 2 firm tart apples, pared, cored, cut into 4 wedges | 2 tablespoons dark raisins | 1/2 cup plain peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Stir in the orzo and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain, stir in the cashews and pumpkin seeds for an even layer of toasted cashews, about 10 to 15 minutes. Toss everything together. Mix in the apples. Drain and rinse the orzo in cold water until the water runs clear. Spread on a serving platter and sprinkle with the raisins and walnuts.

title: Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 large onions, peeled | 1 1/2 cups packed brown sugar | sea salt and pepper
instructions: In an ovenproof dish, place onions. Sprinkle the brown sugar all over and season with salt and pepper. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 45 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Kale and Avgolemono Salad
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 cups chopped kale | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 cup pitted halved kalamata olives | 1/2 cup prepared mustard | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Prepare the bow tie pasta as directed on the package. In a large bowl, place the pasta and kale. Stir the tomatoes, olives and mustard together. Stir in the cheese.

title: Chickpea and Coriander Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 150 g chickpeas, drained | 1 bunch rocket, washed and dried | 1/2 teaspoon stevia powder | 1 lime, zest of, finely grated | 1 teaspoon bulgar, ground
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, stir together, then fold through any remaining ingredients. Divide among lettuce leaves. Sprinkle with coarse salt and serve.

title: Jiffy Red Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can canned kidney beans, drained | 5 -8 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/3 cup ice water
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend till smooth. Let cool in refrigerator for atleast 30 minutes before serving. This is a great soup with other hearty fillings such as garlic bread cubes, chopped potatoes, celery sticks, sliced green peppers, and mushrooms. Store in refrigerator up to 3 days.

title: Fish Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 pound tilapia fillets | 1/4 pound white yams, thawed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces strawberries, drained | 14 1/2 ounces assorted fresh fruit
instructions: Cut up the strawberries and put them in a large bowl. I put them in a food processor and chop them up so that everything is incorporated. Add the fruit and process until it's smooth. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Creamy Cucumber Soup - Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1 cucumber | 2 cups water | 8 -10 cups vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon dashes tabasco sauce | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Chop the cucumber until extremely finely chopped. Put all of the other ingredients into a large pot. Stir until the veggies are well blended. Turn on the heat and let simmer slowly for 1 to 2 hours. This is best served over jasmine rice or any other type of rice you prefer. For vegetarians use only the vegetable broth.

title: Sticky Sage Leaves
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh sage leaves | 1 ounce fresh breadcrumb | 8 ounces unsliced sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 -3 cups good quality vodka | salt
instructions: Soak sun dried tomatoes in warm water a few minutes, then squeeze out the excess water. Slice or cut leaves into strips or pieces of your choice in strips or lengths to fit in a glass jar. Add salt to taste. Strain all the juices into a glass preserving jar with a tight lid, pushing the oil into the pulp. If using vodka, the vodka should be too sweet, but not overpowering. When the oil has had time to become infused and rinsed add a little vodka to help thin it out a bit if necessary,.

title: Sweet and Sour Lamb Meatballs With Tangy Brown Sauce
ingredients: 500 g leftover lean ground lamb | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 150 g brown rice | 200 g frozen precooked meatballs | 150 g dill pickles, chopped | 150 g dark chocolate | 1/2 cup brown rice
instructions: Place first six ingredients in a large pot. Pour boiling water over and bring to boil. Skim the surface and simmer on low heat for 40 minutes, until lamb is very tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Add chocolate and meat and mix until melted. Season to taste with salt. Dollop out meat and serve or refrigerate for upto two weeks before freezing.

title: Cauliflower Espresso Parmesan (For 2)
ingredients: 1 cauliflower floret | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese, divided | 1 3/4 cups good italian-style espresso coffee ( strong flavor ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat ricotta cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Line baking sheet with foil. Combine cauliflower and butter. Spread cauliflower over baking sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender crisp. Stir in rosemary, paprika and 2/3 cup parmesan. Let cool 5 minutes. Stir remaining cup parmesan into ricotta. Spread over cooled cauliflower. Sprinkle on remaining 1 tablespoon of parmesan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is golden.

title: Carnival Rio
ingredients: 4 mushrooms, cleaned and chopped | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Place the mushrooms and vodka in a container. Cover and shake until the mushrooms are completely covered with the vodka. Serve in the refrigerator.

title: Easy  Brandy Slice
ingredients: 1/2 cup icing sugar or 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/2 lb ladyfinger ( i used fat-free ) | ice, as required
instructions: Combine icing sugar and ladyfingers in a shallow dish. Place in freezer for 15 minutes to harden icing. Spread icing onto slice. Dip slice in crushed ice. Slice into fingers.

title: Applesauce Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups unsweetened prepared horseradish sauce | 2 cups applesauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the horseradish sauce and applesauce. When the sauce is ready, refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: milk,parsley,celery rib,lime juice zest,ice water,mint leaf,taco seasoning mix
title: Aunt Kathy's Mexi-Mint Jiffy
ingredients: ice water | 4 celery ribs, cut to 2 inch lengths | 4 large mint leaves | 1/4 cup fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon dried lime juice or 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons mild taco seasoning mix | 2 cups whole milk | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: Place ice water in a small heat proof bowl. Add celery and let sit for 5 minutes then rinse with cold water and drain. Rinse the celery under cold running water and drain. Cut diagonally into 1/2 inch lengths and set aside. In a blender place celery, mint, parsley, limes, lime juice and taco seasoning. Blend on high speed for 30 seconds until well blended and no larger lumps of celery remain. In a double boiler bring milk and taco seasoning mix to a boil over medium heat. Add celery mixture and cook over low heat just uncovered for about 2 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, black pepper and/or more lime juice if desired.

Random Ingredients: red potato,green,prosciutto,salad green,red chili powder,half,yukon gold potato
title: Potato Salad With Roasted Red Chilli
ingredients: 3 green potatoes, chopped | 5 red potatoes, sliced | 6 -8 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto | 4 red chili powder, roughly broken into large clumps | 2 cups mixed salad greens | 2 cups half-and-half | 3 -4 tablespoons roasted red chili powder, chopped | 1/2 cup half-and-half if needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f lightly oil an ovenproof dish, or 2 - 9 inch round tins. Cut 2 rounds of parchment paper from the green potatoes, leaving stems attached. Layer the potato and red potato slices in one layer in the prepared dish. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon each of chopped chilli with 1/2 teaspoon each of powder. Cover the potatoes and vegetables with the prosciutto. Sprinkle the 2 tablespoons roasting red chilli and 1 more teaspoon roasting red chilli powder over the roast potatoes and prosciutto. Spread the reserved green potato slices over the vegetables and prosciutto and continue layering. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes remove foil and bake for 2 - 3 minutes longer until potatoes are tender. Remove from oven and allow to cool, then chill in the refrigerator. When ready to serve, stir all ingredients except the half and half well. Stir into the chilled potatoes and chilli right before serving.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,anise seed,heavy whipping cream,jaggery,beef tenderloin steak,cinnamon,sirloin tip roast
title: Sirloin Tip Roast With Cream-Sugar Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seed | 2 1/2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 24 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 8 teaspoons powdered jaggery | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | romaine lettuce, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb jaggery
instructions: Place an electric roasting pan on top of the rack and preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Toast the aniseed in the oven for 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, cover with hot water and set aside to cool completely. Meanwhile, bring the cream to a boil in a large heavy bottomed saucepan over medium heat. Remove from the heat and stir in the powdered jaggery and cinnamon. Let the cream steep 5 minutes then remove the pan from the heat. Place the roasting pan on a rack inside a larger pan and heat the oven to 375 degrees. Remove the roast from the pan and brush all over with anise infused cream. Place the roast in the roasting pan, cover tightly and transfer the pan to the oven. Roast until the internal temperature of the meat registers 140 degrees, about 1 1/2 hours. While the roast is roasting, place 2 cups of the cream into a small pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from the heat and stir in the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons of anise and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon. Let the mixture continue to simmer and whisk constantly for about 2 minutes. Add the shredded lettuce, stir and taste for seasoning. Set aside to cool to room temperature or until needed. When the roast is finished roasting, remove the meat from the pan and slice into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,creole seasoning,ginger,epazote,swiss cheese,vinaigrette dressing,feta cheese
title: Grilled Cheese Tart
ingredients: 1 frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed according to package directions or package directions, cut into 24 cubes | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese, divided | 1 cup diced fresh ginger | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, divided | 1/4 cup aioli/olive oil or 1/4 cup salad dressing | 1 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 -2 tablespoon vinaigrette dressing, of choice
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f unroll puff pastry and roll into 24 balls. Place on baking sheets. Spray tops with cooking spray. To each pastry ball, add three tablespoons swiss cheese, 1/2 cup diced ginger, 1/4 cup feta cheese and 1/4 cup aioli/olive oil. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,splenda sugar substitute,yeast,rice wine,pumpkin,milk,corn flake,bread
title: Easy Baked Mushrooms & Cabbage  Rolls
ingredients: 1 ounce yeast, see note | 2 cups bread ( i prefer normal white bread ) | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 12 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup corn flakes, crushed
instructions: Soak mushrooms in water for 1 hours and drain. Soak corn flakes in water for a few minutes. Dry mushroom on paper towels. Bake in oven at 400 degrees fahrenheit, until soft. Remove from pan and cool for a little bit. Place milk, yeast, sugar, splenda/rice wine and squash pie spice in a pan. Heat to boiling and then remove from heat. Add mushrooms, cornflakes and a little milk or water. Let cool for 5 minutes. Note, add a few drops of splenda if too sour for your taste. If too sour, just put some more of the splenda. Pour mixture into bread pan. Place in a preheated pan and bake at 400°f for 30 minutes or until light golden brown on top.

title: Indian-Style Salt
ingredients: salt | 2 cups apple juice | cumin powder | 1/2 cup white sesame seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container. To adjust consistency, add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Spaghetti in Butter-Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces spaghetti | 3/4 cup butter
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water. Drain. Serve spaghetti with caramel sauce.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,nonstick cooking spray,vanilla,orange juice zest,basil sprig,plain flour
title: Apricot or Orange Shortbread Cookies
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups plain flour | 1 cup nonstick cooking spray | 3/4 cup apricot jam or 3/4 cup apricot jam | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup orange zest | 1 cup fresh basil sprig, chopped ( to garnish ) | nonstick cooking spray | vanilla, if using
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place flour in food processor. Cut in 1 cup jam with processor running until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add juice, zest and basil. Mix well. Cover and set aside for 15 minutes. Using dough blade on pasta machine, divide dough in half. Roll each half on lightly floured surface into a 30cm x 7 - 1 1/2 rectangle. Using a 6 1/2in round cookie cutter, cut out 2 rounds from each round. Place 1 tablespoon jam on centre of each round. Brush edges with water. Cut each round into 10 wedges. Press wedges with fingertips to seal. Place on a greased oven tray. Bake at 300f for about 10 minutes or until edges are just beginning to turn golden. Cool in tin for 5 minutes. Remove from tin, remove. Turn on cooling rack to wire rack. To make ice cream, place apricot or orange syrup in saucepan and heat gently, stirring frequently, until warmed through. Remove from heat. Brush onto cooled shortbread. Sprinkle with vanilla. Cool completely and cut into wedges..

title: Lengenberg Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 large head cabbage | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts | 2 packages of fresh spearmint | 4 cups of shredded raw cabbage
instructions: Clean cabbage. Trim tough stem end to end of core. Cut off about 3 - 4 inches of the stem and discard core. Cut head in half, or wedges lengthwise. Place cabbage on cookie sheet that has been rubbed with a slightly damp cloth to prevent drying out. Arrange 1 1/2 to 2 artichokes, and about 3 slices of spearmint on the base of each piece of cabbage. Sprinkle with about 6 ounces of raw cabbage. Arrange 2 - 3 tablespoons of remaining spearmint on top of each. Repeat layering of spearmint with the remaining ingredients. Fold sides over top, then roll up and leave seam side down in a large pan. Repeat with the remaining cabbage rolls. Cook over a very low heat for about 3 hours, until tender. Serve hot, warm or room temperature. To freeze, overwrap with foil, place in a freezer container or freezer bag. To serve, thaw in refrigerator for a few hours.

title: Chedddar Wat (Apple Kebabs): Beef Steak With Apple Sauce
ingredients: 8 skewers, soaked in water for at least 30 minutes | 1/2 lb round steak, trimmed of fat | salt, to taste | extra virgin olive oil, to taste | 1/2 cup dried apple juice ( from the apples in the jar )
instructions: Pour the apple juice on the soaked skewers. Place two skewer tops on each. Cover with the prepared apple skewers. Grill over medium high heat 4 to 6 minutes or until beef is done, turning once. To serve, grill the skewers until slightly charred. Serve with the sauce.

title: Fish With Branston
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs prosciutto ham | 1/2 lb smoked fish fillet ( halibut, cod, or salmon can be substituted if preferred ) | 4 cups broth | 1 cup dried cranberries ( or other tropical fruit ) | hot paprika, 1 1/2 tablespoons | 1/2 cup sour cream ( optional ) | 2 large eggs, beaten lightly | 1 1/2 cups dried tubetti pasta
instructions: Cut ham into thin 3/4 inch slices, and then cut into about 2 inch lengths. Set aside. Place broth, cranberries, and paprika in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until cranberries are soft and soup is thickened, about 10 minutes. Transfer soup to large bowl. Cut fish diagonally into about 6 serving pieces. Add ham and fish, stirring to coat. Season with salt and pepper and set aside. In a shallow bowl, beat eggs and then pour into soup. Place bread, cranberries, and fish on serving platter and serve soup mixture over it.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,broth,ice cube,creamy peanut butter,white wine
title: Chinese Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 10 ounces broth | 4 ice cubes | freshly chopped green bell pepper, for garnish
instructions: Pour white wine and peanut butter into blender and blend until smooth. Pour into medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Add broth and ice cubes. Boil for 2 or 3 minutes. Remove and discard ice cubes from soup. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green bell pepper.

title: Fyaz - Indian Spice Mix (Niter Kiyaar) ( Oil)
ingredients: 4 green cardamoms ( badi elaichi ) | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek ( known as 'kadah'in hindi ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Roast the green cardamoms on low fire with the oil on the stove. They are roasted so once they brown it's ready it can be used as a rub on the dish after a few hours. Allow the cardamoms to cool down to room temperature. The oil inside the pan should be as warm as you can get it, not hot. Add the salt, fenugreek and mix well. When the fenugreek is soft and moist, stir in the powdered cardamom and mix well. Store in an airtight container.
