Random Ingredients: zucchini,egg noodle,vegetable broth,tomato juice,mustard,white vinegar,chili sauce
title: Zucchini and Egg Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 zucchini, sliced | 1 egg noodles | 1/3 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 6 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly coat a shallow 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place the zucchini in a colander and turn the heat under the zucchini over. Let the excess water drip back into the bowl, then drain all excess liquid. In a large skillet, whisk the vegetable broth, tomato juice, chili sauce, vinegar and mustard together. Pour the broth mixture into the skillet and cook and stir over medium high heat until the mixture is thoroughly heated and the tomato juice is cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir the zucchini mixture into the noodles. Place the noodles in the prepared baking dish and bake in the preheated oven until heated fully, about 5 minutes.

title: Quick Curried Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup almung beans, washed and soaked | 2 dill sprigs, chopped | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 8 ounces spaghetti sauce, prepared | 1/4 teaspoon dill
instructions: Heat a medium saucepan over a medium heat, add the beans cooking liquid and stir to combine. When liquid boils, add the dill and curry powder.

Random Ingredients: cream coconut,pecorino romano cheese,olive oil,parsnip,chorizo sausage,corn,challah
title: Grilled Parsnips - Stuffed and Stuffed With Chorizo
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips | 2/3 cup olive oil | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 12 ounces chorizo sausage ( mild or hot ) | 1 can cream of coconut | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons dried parsley
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Peel and slice parsnips, and place under the broiler. While parsnips are cooking, mix the chorizo in a small skillet over medium heat with the olive oil and salt and pepper. Remove from heat when crispy, then drain fat from skillet. Remove the stems from the parsnips, then cut out a few on the top. Add the stuffing and parsley to the chorizo mixture, and mix well. Place two parsnips on the grill at a time, so the stuffing does not seep out of the parsnips. As they are grilling, brush tops and sides with olive oil and grill until golden, about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot, and top with sour cream. Or serve chorizo inside tortillas, as an appetizer, with or without chorizo bread.

title: Aussie Style Feta
ingredients: 500 g greek feta cheese | 250 g green peas | 2 -3 dashes adobo sauce | 2 -3 whole vanilla pods | 2 cups of diced beef
instructions: Soak everything except the dices of beef and put in saucepan. Add two cups of water and cover with lid. Add salt and pepper. Heat on high for about 15 minute. Serve with lots of crusty french bread and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,flat leaf italian parsley,black pepper,beef chuck,red snapper fillet,cayenne pepper,rump roast
title: Tasso-Style Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 pounds beef chuck bone | black pepper to taste | seasoning to taste | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 3 pounds red snapper fillets, skinned | 2 cups flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped, divided | 1 cup coarsely chopped rump roast
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the chuck roast into a wide glass baking dish. Sprinkle with black pepper.

Random Ingredients: deli ham,beer,dill,peppercorn steak sauce,mirin,chicken breast,tomato puree
title: Beer Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 8 chicken breasts | 1/2 cup beer | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 tablespoon dill | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh dill | 1/3 cup beer, or as desired | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon peppercorn steak sauce | 12 slices deli ham
instructions: Pound chicken breasts with meat mallet to 1/4 inch thickness, then cut chicken crosswise into halves or thirds and arrange on a dish. Mix 1/2 cup beer, tomato puree, chopped dill and 1 1/2 tablespoon dill together in a bowl. Pour over chicken. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour, or as long as overnight. Remove chicken from marinade and discard marinade. Grill chicken meat to desired doneness, about 10minutes per side. An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a chicken breast should read at least 165°f. Brush chicken with 1 tablespoon beer or glaze while grilling, then turn pieces over and brush with remaining glaze. Cooks' note, for extra flavor, grill chicken pieces over hot coals until lightly browned on both sides, about 20 - 30 minutes. Brush with more glaze during the last 5 minutes of grilling. To make the peppercorn mustard, combine 1 tablespoon minced dill and 1/3 cup beer or as needed to measure 1 tablespoon water. Pour into a small bowl. Add remaining 1½ tablespoons dill and 1½ tablespoons beer or as desired.

title: Mushroom Butter
ingredients: 10 fresh cremini mushrooms, cleaned and sliced in rounds ( more or less, depending on size ) | 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons shortening | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Whip eggs and set aside. Melt shortening in a small pan. Stir in mushrooms. Add egg yolks. Put over medium heat and stir constantly until thick. Turn heat down to very low. Beat egg whites for 2 minutes.

title: Polenta and Cauliflower
ingredients: 14 ounces cauliflower florets, chopped | 1 onion soup mix | 1/2 cup instant polenta | 1/4 cup lemon juice
instructions: Cook cauliflower and onion soup mix in 3 inch frying pan until cauliflower is crisp tender. Add polenta and lemon juice. Stir well.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,chicken broth,rhubarb,italian herb seasoning,lamb shoulder,vanilla essence
title: Lamb Stuffed With Rhubarb & Swiss
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb shoulder, cut about 1 inch thick | 2 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, coarsely grated | 2 -3 tablespoons mixed italian herbs seasoning | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla essence | 4 cans organic chicken broth | 1 lb frozen rhubarb, thawed, stalks removed
instructions: Cut lamb loin between large, 1 inch wide slices of plastic wrap to make a pocket. Place cheese in pockets. Combine all remaining ingredients, place in freezer bag and freeze. Remove meat from bag, place in a large mixing bowl. Cut lengthwise almost all the way through meat, then cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices and add to cheese mixture. Mix well. Place meat in a foil covered pan and refrigerate until serving. This can take up to 4 days under refrigeration.

Random Ingredients: coffee,green food coloring,asparagus spear,baby carrot,palm sugar,green apple,star anise
title: Karela (Shredded Asparagus) and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots | 8 ounces small asparagus spears, trimmed | 1 star anise | 2 teaspoons palm sugar ( or sucanat ) | 1 green apple, core removed, cut into pieces, and cut into bite size pieces | 1 teaspoon water | 1/4 teaspoon green food coloring | 8 tablespoons strong coffee
instructions: Place carrots, asparagus, star anise, palm sugar or sucanat, apple, water, and food coloring in a food processor and puree. Cover and refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Green Curry Brownies
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 - 3/4 cup green curry paste ( i prefer sharwood's curry curry paste curry green curry paste ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped ham | 1/2 cup finely chopped mixed fresh herbs (, basil, lemongrass & cilantro ) | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mixed herbs (, basil, lemongrass & cilantro )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f / 180°c. Lightly spray a 10 inch nonstick pan with cooking spray. Combine curry paste & ham in a small bowl. Spray the pan & set over medium high heat. Add curry paste mixture & mix well. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute. Continue adding curry paste mixture & mix well. Continue cooking over medium heat until mixture is hot & fragrant, 8 - 10 minutes. Add 1/4 cup mixed herbs, & mix well. Spread evenly in prepared pan. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup mixed herbs. Bake for 15 minutes or until the edges are firm. Allow to cool & cut into 16 squares. Serve warm.

title: Gourmet Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg lean stewing beef | 25 g dry yeast | 3 green peppers | 2 plantains ( i use yellow ) | 4 ounces rice noodles or 2 medium grain noodles ( or your fav ) | 1 plain yogurt
instructions: Start by washing the beef. Cut into long strips with kitchen shears. Cut the stringy ends off the peppers, put in a frying pan with the oil and cover with water, bring the water to boil. Meanwhile, put the noodles in boiling water and cook until soft, rinse with cold water, drain. Slice the plantains into long strips on the diagonal, put in a bowl. Put the garlic in the same pan and fry on med/low for about 2 mins until starting to colour. Add the beef and cook until brown on all sides. Add the rice noodles and let cook for another minute, then stir in the sprouts. Cover and remove from heat. After about two minutes, stir in the yoghurt. Cover. Leave to sit in a warm place for 10 - 15 minutes. Stir. Leave to serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate molasses,vegetable oil,kaiser,pineapple juice,black sesame seed
title: Baked Hawaiian Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | toasted pine nuts | 12 kaiser rolls, split lengthwise
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together the veg oils and molasses. On a baking sheet, spread each roll, then spread the heated oiled bun top with half the pomegranate molasses mixture. Place the sandwiches on top of the sandwiches and brush thoroughly with more of the olive oil mixture. Sprinkle top of sandwiches with pineaple nuts and top with remaining pomegranate molasses mixture.

title: Meatloaf With Vegetables & Dates
ingredients: 400 g beef tenderloin, trimmed of external fat and cut into 20 equal pieces ( i use topside and personal preference ) | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 2 teaspoons dry vermouth ( use any type of dry vermouth ) | 2/3 cup bulgur, uncooked ( i use fine grain ) | 1 teaspoon dried dates, crushed | 1/2 cabbage, shredded into ribbons ( optional ) | 100 g fresh vegetables, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c or fan180c. Spray an ovenproof dish with cooking spray, then arrange beef on dish. Cook for 25 minutes, then add honey and vermouth. Reduce heat to 170c / fan 160c / 250°f and continue cooking for a further 30 minutes. Meanwhile, place bulghar and dates in a sieve and pour boiling water over, to cover, and leave to soak for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Place bulghar in a large bowl. Place bulghar and dates in sieve, stir in vegetable. Spoon over beef fat, cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Put beef and vegetables in ovenproof dish. Cover with foil and cook for 1 hour 20 minutes, or until tender.

title: Mushroom Frites (Lamb Fritters)
ingredients: 6 tomatillos | 1 dozen mushroom ( shiitake, crimini ) | 8 egg yolks | 30 g cornflour | cherries
instructions: Cut the tomillos in half and remove the stones. Halve them lengthwise and then slice them into 8 pieces. Clean the mushrooms and cut into eight pieces. Mix together the egg yolks, cornflour and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl and then add half the tomatillos, mushroom pieces and cherries to the egg and egg white mixture and beat until the mixture thickens and the mushrooms are cooked, but not overcooked. Heat olive oil in a frypan. Pour the mixture carefully into the frypan and fry quickly on the first side, then turn them over and fry them until they are browned. Turn them over again and fry them on the remaining side.

title: Parsley Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh parsley flakes | 1/2 cup cumin or 1/2 cup cumin powder | 1 -2 serrano chili ( or more to taste ) or 1 -2 green chili, chopped ( or more to taste )
instructions: Grind the parsley flakes in a food processor. Sift in the dry spices. Use to sandwich up bread and add more if you wish.

title: Hot Soymilk
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds, lightly powdered | 5 teaspoons milk | 3/4 cup soy milk | 5 teaspoons granulated sugar | 2 beef bouillon cubes, crushed
instructions: Put cardamom, milk and soy milk into a saucepan and bring to a rolling boil. Stir slowly till it becomes thick. Add the sugar and boullion and simmer for 2 mins till its completely dissolved. Cool, remove cardamom pods, discard. Pour into a heat proof shallow glass bowl. Top with hot liquid in the bowl until saturated. Let stand 2 hours in the fridge. Serve at room temperature as a snack or as a sauce.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,asafoetida powder,cranberry juice,chick pea,enoki mushroom,cooking sherry
title: Simmered Szechuan Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned crushed chick-peas ( not sauce ) | 12 -15 ounces canned diced dried asafoetida powder | 1 -2 cup enoki mushrooms | 1 whole green pepper | 3 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cranberry juice
instructions: Combine chick peas, asafoetida, mushrooms, green pepper, cooking sherry and cranberry juice in a saucepan. Heat to a boil.

title: Crispy Vegetables Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, washed and dry | 8 ounces broccoli, washed, drained, cut into florets | 1 canned chipotle chile, canned | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Mix together all the dressing ingredients and chill. Toss the lettuce with the dressing. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Fish With Raspberry and Rosemary Cream
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1/4 lemon, juice of | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 cup raspberry preserves | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 2 tablespoons leeks, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Brush both sides of tilapia fillets with lemon juice. Place fillets on baking sheet. Sprinkle both sides with pepper, and set aside for 5 minutes. In an oven proof pan spread raspberry preserves over 2 x 1/2 inch thick. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Turn fish over. Drizzle lemon juice over fish. Sprinkle with pepper. For the cream spread, in a small bowl, mix powered sugar, cardamom and chopped leeks with chopped rosemary, chopped rosemary and chopped rosemary. Mix together on a sheet of waxed paper. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Return fillets to oven, and bake for 15 minutes, or until fish is cooked through. While fish is baking, prepare the glaze glaze. In a small bowl, mix 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary with 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary. When fish is done, place on a plate. Carefully pour glaze over fish, and allow to sit for 10 minutes at room temperature.

title: Cherry Cream
ingredients: 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 can or bottle light beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Fill a large, resealable plastic bag halfway with ice cubes, and pour the cherries into the bag. Shake the bag until cherries are evenly coated, and shake out excess. Transfer the soaked cherries to a bowl of chilled, hardening maraschino cherries. Pour the drained maraschino cherries into the container of a blender, and blend until liquefied. Pour the lemon flavored beer into the mixture, and blend on low until thoroughly mixed. Mix in whipped topping right before serving.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,apple juice,marinara sauce,dragee,chipotle chile,potato starch
title: Lennie's Smoorag (Filipino Stuffed Potatos or Wedges)
ingredients: 4 small waxy potatoes, peeled ( or 1 large potato, halved if large ) | 2 teaspoons apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile, roughly chopped | 1/4 green capsicum, sliced thinly ( or a mixture of the two ) | 2 tablespoons dragees, coarsely chopped ( fresh ) | 1 tablespoon potato starch ( or cornstarch )
instructions: Place the potato in a lightly oiled pan or frying pan with a lid. Cover with just enough water to cover and place over a high heat. Bring to a boil and add the lid. Reduce the heat, gently cooking the potato slices until they are slightly browned on both sides. Remove the lid and continue cooking until you have a firm knob of potato that is just slightly chewy. Transfer the potato to a baking paper lined tray, cut side up. Leave to cool for a few minutes then peel and cut into approximately 2 inch chunks. Place the chopped chipotle, green capsicum and dragees in a bowl and season with the potato starch. Melt the butter or oil in a frying pan over a medium low heat for about 2 minutes until very hot but not smoking. Add the potato wedges to the fat and fry, stirring, for a further 1 - 2 minutes until golden on the underside turning them over when pressed with a finger to flatten. Remove and place on paper towel lined baking tray. Serve hot, in small dishes.

title: Portuguese Omelet
ingredients: 2 large egg whites ( or 2 large eggnoggers ) | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce ( or more to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Place egg whites in a mixing bowl until frothy, about 10 minutes. Beat in egg yolks and tabasco for about a minute, until eggnog becomes fluffy. Add a bit more tabasco if you want it's really spicy. Pour into a baking dish and place in oven. Cook until eggnog is very thick, stirring frequently, about 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Garlic & Thyme Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 4 chicken breasts, skinless & boneless | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground ajwain ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Heat the oil in a baking dish, add the chicken and cook in the oven just until it changes colour. Transfer to a plate. Stir in the thyme leaves and ajwain. Serve immediately.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon guacamole | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Stir the guacamole and five spice powder together. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: black olive,sea salt,bamboo shoot,scotch whisky,maraschino cherry,walnut
title: Sukuma
ingredients: 200 g black olives ( pitted, or a mixture of both ) or 200 g green olives ( pitted, or a mixture of both ) | 1/2 bunch walnuts ( chopped finely, toasted ) | 1/2 liter marsala wine ( sweetened ) | 200 ml scotch whisky ( not sweetened ) | sea salt ( to taste ) | 1 bunch maraschino cherries ( mixed ) or 1 bunch maraschino cherry, leaves ( mixed )
instructions: Cut the olives into thin wedges. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Put the walnuts or almonds into a food processor or blender and put process into the water, just until they are the size of small pebbles, just barely starting to change color. Put nuts into a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and put another bowl of water in the same way. In a large serving bowl, add the walnuts or almonds, the marsala, and 1 tsp of salt. Add the cherries/cherries to the bowl with the liquid and mix together carefully with a spoon. To serve, add more liquid, if necessary. If desired, add more cherries to the liquid and mix with spoon to achieve a 'whirl' or 'whirl' texture. Variation, to create a smokey effect after adding the cherries and cherries, add a bit of sherry to the liquid before pouring mixture into a clean bowl. If possible, serve the sokuma with a few chopped walnut halves on top for a beautiful taste. Enjoy.

title: Vegetarian Lasagna
ingredients: 3/4 cup vegetable broth, divided | 1 package uncooked lasagna noodles | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring 3/4 cup of the broth to a boil in a saucepan. Cook the lasagna noodles as directed on the package. Drain. Bring the remaining broth to a boil. Pour the hot broth over the lasagna noodles, and stir to coat. Spread 1/4 cup of peanuts over the top, then spoon 1/4 of the noodles over the peanuts. Repeat layers of noodles, sauce, and remaining peanuts before putting into a casserole dish. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until bubbly. This is great with a fruit salad.

title: Houlettes De Boupée De Lèves (Tofu and Egg Tarts)
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled & cut into halves | 2 tablespoons cold water | 1 package tofu, in one piece | 1/4 cup gin | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/8 cup finely chopped onion | 1 cup cold water
instructions: Place egg half halves into a saucepan with cold water.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,fruit,egg white,pinto bean,black eyed pea,carrot,yukon gold potato
title: Gramma Oma's Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cups dried pinto beans | 2 cups dried black-eyed peas | 3 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced | 2 carrots, peeled and diced | 2 serrano chilies, seeded and chopped | 4 egg whites | 1/4 cup dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: The following day, if desired, drain beans and discard the liquid. Cover beans with fresh water, and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover, and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until beans are very tender. Drain, and allow to stand covered to absorb flavors for up to one day. Filling, in a small saucepan, bring about 4 cups water to boil. Add potatoes and boil until tender. Drain, cool and mash. Set aside. Dice chilies. Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets. Spread out potatoes evenly on baking sheets. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Filling will spread out easily. Remove from oven, and spread the cooled mashed beans evenly on the cookie sheets. Spread the chilies over the beans. Add filling to the top of the beans. Spread chopped dried fruit evenly over the top of the fillings and top with more filling if desired. Cover in aluminum foil, and bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,red wine vinegar,bay leaf,peanut,cream,deli ham,red chili pepper,red cabbage
title: Corn Glaze Pub Style
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons red chili peppers, strips minced | 1 small red cabbage, cored and finely shredded | 1/2 cup cream, low fat is good | 1 tablespoon coarsely grated smoked deli ham | 3/4 cup chopped unsalted dry roasted unsalted dry-roasted peanuts
instructions: Combine cornflour, vinegar, red chilly and chile in a small bowl. In a large bowl, toss chopped cabbage with cream then add to flour mixture. Fold in chopped ham and peanuts. Pour this onto a greased grill rack set 4 - 5 inches over boiling water. Grill until glaze is bubbly and starts to brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Kiss and Tell Us Manicotti!
ingredients: 14 manicotti, cooked according to package directions ( or any small size ) | 3 cups finely chopped fresh mushrooms | 5 cups shredded sweetened marshmallows | 1 cup dried diced cherry, chopped | 1 cup dried fenugreek, chopped | 1/3 cup dried basil, chopped
instructions: Prepare manicotti noodles according to package directions. Stir mushrooms and marshmallows together in a large bowl. Stir in dried fruit. Spoon 1/3 of noodles in the center of a sprayed 12x9 inch baking dish. Spoon stuffing mixture over the noodles. Sprinkle with the fenugreek and basil. Bake at 350 degrees 40 - 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Grilled Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cut into pieces about 1 inch square | 3 tablespoons brandy or 3 tablespoons beef broth | 3 tablespoons tamari | 6 tablespoons of chopped toasted nori ( we like springform pieces, and optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the ziti for approximately 10 mins, until barely al dente, and drain. Combine the flour and spices and coat the beef in the mixture. Heat a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat and sear the beef in batches 2 - 3 minutes each side. Transfer on a plate. Bring the water back to a boil. Add the ziti, and simmer until al dente. Combine the brandy, tamari and fish sauce and pour over the ziti.

title: The Golden Apple
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 large apples | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: To make syrup, heat golden syrup in large nonreactive skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, 2 to 3 minutes or until warm, but not browned. Meanwhile, scrub peel and pith from apples. Cut in half lengthwise. Cut into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange slices, flat side down, in a single layer in a shallow baking dish. Pour hot syrup over apple slices. Sprinkle with thyme. Cover and chill 1 hour. Preheat oven broiler. Broil apples 5 inches from heat, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until golden.

title: Baked Mexican Eggs
ingredients: 4 large eggs ( hard boiled, peeled and yolks removed ) | colby cheese, shredded ( can use shredded monterey jack ) | black olives, sliced ( optional ) | 1 fresh chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 medium tomatoes ( can use chopped onion )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. In a bowl, mix eggs, cheese, and black olives on a cookie sheet. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle chili flakes over mixture. Bake 25 minutes until eggs are set and cheese is melted. Place under broiler to get hot, taking care not to scorch.

Random Ingredients: bread,dungeness crab,coriander powder,black eyed pea,brown sugar,ice,rosemary sprig
title: Crayfish Toast and Beans
ingredients: 2 dungeness crabs, fresh or frozen | 125 ml ice, crushed | 1 slice bread | 50 g brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary sprig ( optional ) | 1/4 cup black-eyed peas
instructions: Thaw crab, if using frozen remove from freezer. Remove shell and gizzards leaving one whole or a bit of shell for decoration. Crack open the crab using large claws and claws. Rinse and dry thoroughly. Cut bread into bite size pieces & place in a small bowl. Add sugar, coriander and rosemary if using. Drain crab and add to bread & sugar mixture. Top with black eyed peas, cover top with bread cubes and cut a slit in top of bread several times. Spray a non stick frypan with oil and cook crab pieces in batches, shaking them when they become golden brown on all sides. To eat immediately place pieces on plates and garnish with black eyed peas if desired.

Random Ingredients: yeast,arborio rice,white vinegar,white chocolate chip,port wine,pork tenderloin,artichoke heart,soda water
title: Mediterranean Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 12 ounces white chocolate chips | 6 ounces white wine vinegar | 2 ounces dried artichoke hearts | 1 tablespoon dried yeast | 12 ounces pork tenderloin | 2 teaspoons dry arborio rice | 2 -3 tablespoons soda water | 1 1/2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: In a small bowl combine the first eight ingredients. Put pork on a tray and spray generously with cooking spray. Stuff the marinated pork with the rice stuffing. Brush on the chipotle marinade and place on the rack of a broiler pan or cookie sheet. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes. When done, remove and allow to cool for 15 minutes and transfer to a serving platter.

title: Tater Tot Hot Dogs-Camping Style
ingredients: 1 package dry tater tots | 1 can buttermilk | 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Heat buttermilk, agave nectar and thyme in a medium saucepan over medium heat until warm. Pour warm buttermilk mixture into slow cooker and sprinkle frozen tater tots over top. Cover and cook on low for 7 hours. Remove mixture from slow cooker, uncover and cool on a wire rack.

title: Spicy Red Enchillada Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar salsa | 1 can red enchilada sauce, divided | 30 taco shells | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spoon one bottle of salsa into the center of each taco shell, breaking the yucky ones up as they go. Divide the remaining contents of 1 can enchilada sauce among the shells, and place in the preheated oven for 5 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,provolone cheese,chicken bouillon,ramen noodle,tomato paste,olive
title: Italian Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crispy hash brown potatoes | 1 can tomato paste | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon, divided | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1 package top supreme shredded provolone cheese | 1 jar hot and sweet vermicelli, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the potatoes on a cookie sheet, and bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven. In a medium bowl, mash the tomato paste with the 1 tablespoon chicken base until smooth. Stir in the green olives and half of the provolone cheese to coat and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Stir in potato slices.

title: Mashed Corned Beef Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 1 lb corned beef cheese, shredded ( about 2 large cups ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon agave nectar
instructions: Heat 1 inch salted water to boiling in medium saucepan over high heat. Add the currants.

title: Italian Bread
ingredients: 4 slices pepperoni | 1 sliced green chili pepper
instructions: Split pepperoni and cut with a knife into long slices. On a bread slice, layer pepperoni. Add additional pepperoni. Add a little sauce on top. Serve with your favorite cheese or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,sharp cheddar cheese,egg,chilies,paprika,nam pla,chili paste,tomato puree
title: Hot and Spicy Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon paprika ( see note below ) | 1 teaspoon nam pla ( see note below ) | 2 fresh green chilies, sliced ( see note below ) | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon chili paste with variations ( see note below ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Note on custom italian chilies, use mild or hot. Also, you can substitute kero peppers for the cheddar. Crack eggs into bowl & beat with a fork. Add cheese, paprika, nam pla, chilies, tomato puree, chili paste and chopped parsley. Mix well & serve immediately. Note on custom i prefer to add 2 teaspoons chili paste & 2 tablespoons of chopped fresh chili pepper. I have also made this with chiles which have been seeded and finely chopped. Note on custom i prefer to use hot peppers & add just a tiny bit of the tomatoes to the eggs, and this is a popular dish.

title: French Quarter Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 12 crackers, crushed | 2 tablespoons fresh dill weed or 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 bottle of raugrated chilled gruyere cheese or 1 bottle emmenthaler cheese | 1 jar roasted cashews
instructions: Brown hamburger well and drain. In a large mixing bowl, combine crackers, dill weed and cheese. Add beef, then stir in cashews and mix well. Shape into four patties. Grill over coals 10 - 12 minutes until well done and well browned.

title: Kabitsha
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets | 1/2 saffron thread, soaked in | 1 tablespoon warm water
instructions: Boil the saffron in the water. Cut the fish into small chunks. Mix the saffron with 1/4 cup warm water. Marinate the fish pieces in the water. Heat the oil in a skillet over a medium heat. When smoking, add the fish, cook for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Angel Hair Pasta with Broccoli and Chicken
ingredients: 1 package capellini | 1 head broccoli, chopped | 1/2 pound uncooked spiral shaped broccoli, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 15 to 17 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,garam masala,cream cheese,topping,clear honey,anise seed,shiitake mushroom,turmeric
title: Spiced Mushrooms and Strawberry Appetizer
ingredients: 500 g shiitake mushrooms | 250 g fresh strawberries | 80 g cream cheese, softened | 1 teaspoon anise seed, lightly crushed ( optional ) | 100 g low-fat whipped topping | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Remove the hard stem ends from your strawberries, leave them whole if they are larger. Slice the strawberries thin and place in a microwave proof dish with the cream and aniseed if using. Heat on high for 10 minutes, or until warmed through. Allow to cool, and put the topping on to the dish. Mix the honey and spices, stir through. Add to the topping, and refrigerate for up to 24 hours to chill. Cut into 2 or 3 squares.

title: Simple Mojito Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pasta sauce | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Stir pasta sauce and dried mint together in a saucepan. Bring heat to simmer over low heat, then set aside to let flavors blend until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Tomato Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow sweet peppers | 2 ounces concentrated tomato puree
instructions: Cut 1 lb sweet pepper into 8 wedges. Arrange in an 8 cup food grade plastic bowl and crush in your hands using a rolling pin. Heat remaining 1 lb sweet pepper until it begins to soften but is not brown. Drain and place in a food processor. Add tomato puree and pulse, pulsing and pulsing frequently, until smooth. Return to bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Minty Mexican Chutney
ingredients: 4 cans italian plum tomatoes | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
instructions: In a blender, combine the tomatoes, mint and chopped cashews. Cover and process on high speed until the sauce is creamy and smooth. Add a dash of cumin, a final squeeze of lime juice if needed.

title: Grilled Banana and Oregano Skewers
ingredients: 1 banana, peeled and cut into 4 pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: In a glass bowl, mash banana lightly with a fork. Sprinkle with oregano.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,baking ammonia,wheat bread,sugar,mustard,coconut cream,red cayenne pepper
title: Indian Spiced Spaghetti With Coconut Cream and Mustard
ingredients: sugar | 4 slices whole wheat bread ( or stale bread ) | 2 tablespoons baking ammonia ( ammonium bihon ) | 3 tablespoons mustard ( powdered ) | 3 2 tablespoons coconut cream ( or soy cream if you want it thicker ) or 3 tablespoons light cream ( for heavier creamier pasta ) | 1 teaspoon red cayenne pepper | chopped crispy crispy-cut sun-dried tomato
instructions: Put a pot of water on to boil for cooking spaghetti. Break the bread into 1cm cubes and toast in a non stick pan on medium heat only until golden, about 1 minute on each side. Add the baking ammonia to the bread cubes in the pan and toast until it takes some color, about 1 minute. Add the mustard to the bread cubes in the pan and toast, stirring, for 1 minute. Add coconut cream to the bread cubes and toast in the pan for 1 second. Add ground coconut to the toast. Add the red cayenne pepper to the toast and toast in the pan for about 1 minute.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Olive Dip
ingredients: 1 cup fresh pitted kalamata olives | 1/2 cup honey | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to boil over a medium heat, then reduce heat to simmer. Cook about 10 minutes or until thickened and reduced by half.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,beef broth,center pork chop,jamaican jerk seasoning,french baguette
title: Apple Onion Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 center-cut pork chop, about 1/3 lb | 2 teaspoons jamaican jerk seasoning | 1 can beef broth, fat free and low sodium | 4 tablespoons fat-free jamaican jerk seasoning | french baguette, sliced | 1 large tart apple, peeled, cored and thinly sliced
instructions: Coat the insides of the pork chops with the 2 teaspoons of jerk spice, and place in a large baking pan. Sprinkle with 2 teaspoons of jamaican jerk seasoning and cover with 1 can of beef broth. Cover, and bake in an oven preheated to 350 degrees fahrenheit for 5 to 7 hours, or until the pork is tender. During the last 10 minutes of cooking, remove the pork from the oven, and top with 1 tablespoon of jamaican jerk seasoning, 1 tablespoon of fat free jerk seasoning and 1/4 cup sliced apple. Place the baguette slices on serving plates and serve.

title: Easy Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups grated pecorino romano cheese, divided | 1 small onion salt | 3 cans whole green chili
instructions: In each of the two bowls, stir together 1/2 the cheese, onion salt, and half the chiles until thoroughly combined. Serve chilled.

title: Green Chile Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb green stringy stringy veggie ( or green chilies ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Wash stringy veggie with water until water runs clear. Chop coarsely. Dissolve chicken bouillon cube in hot water. Place stringy stringy stringy veggies in a colander to drain water out. Place meat on stringy veggies and pour in bouillon. Stir to blend well. Place in bowl and let sit for an hour while you work with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: steak,pistachio nut,green chili pepper,italian salad dressing mix,tuna
title: Italian Tuna With Grilled Pistachio Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks ( trimmed but not very thick ) | 1 can tuna, drained | 2 tablespoons sliced green chili peppers, such as jalapenos, seeded | 3/4 cup fresh italian salad dressing mix | 2 tablespoons toasted pistachio nuts
instructions: Slice the steaks lengthwise into 1 by 1/2 thick strips. Mix all the ingredients except the pistachio nut in a large bowl until well combined.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,peppercorn,creme fraiche,chicken stock,button mushroom,italian bread crumb
title: Champagne
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces button mushrooms, halved | 8 fluid ounces hot chicken stock | 2 ounces guinness stout | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1 pinch cracked peppercorns | 1/2 cup italian seasoned dried bread crumbs
instructions: Put mushrooms into a bowl, pour in the chicken stock, and add the guinness. Stir well to mix, and transfer to a microwave safe plate. Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Stir in the crème fraîche and scatter with cracked peppercorns. Microwave the breadcrumb on high for about 45 seconds, stirring once, to make crumbs crunchy. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,yellow pepper,worcestershire sauce,dark soy sauce,hard egg,ginger garlic paste,water
title: Mongolian Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow pepper | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 cups dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 cups water
instructions: Roughly chop pepper and place in a blender. Add remaining ingredients to blender. Blend until smooth. Transfer sauce to a small bowl and coat peppers lightly. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. This sauce will keep for up to one week in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,broiler fryer chicken,pace picante sauce,bourbon whiskey,grape juice
title: Kansas Girl Favorite Bourbon Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 1 jar favorite style picante sauce | 1 bottle bourbon whiskey | 2 tablespoons freshly cracked rosemary | 1 cup frozen grapes with juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Open a large glass jar with the corner cut off. Place the chicken pieces in this jar. Pour picante sauce and whiskey over, and seal with a square of aluminum foil. Place chicken pieces in the oven, on the middle rack. Bake 45 minutes, or until the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,red potato,white pepper,fava bean,red wine
title: Sautéed Red Potatoes and Fava Beans
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, unpeeled | 8 ounces fava beans, shelled | 2 tablespoons dry red wine | 8 ounces mexican cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Quarter the potatoes, then boil them for 20 minutes or until tender. In a saucepan, steam the fava beans for 5 minutes. Drain the beans and reserve them separately. Preheat the broiler or on high. In a small sauté pan, combine the wine and cheese. Heat, but do not let it boil. Add the cooked fava beans and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat, cover and simmer for 6 minutes or until the mixture coats the back of a spoon. Pour the mixture into a casserole dish. Place the potatoes on top or on the top, and sprinkle the white pepper onto the potatoes. Place under the broiler, and broil for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until the cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: thai bird eye chile,ricotta cheese,rye bread,green olive,sugar,roux,beef sirloin,baking potato
title: Spicy Beef Bites With Roasted Sweet Potato Rounds
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, thinly sliced thin | 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 8 ounces roasted sweet potatoes, chopped | 20 -30 green olives, chopped | 2 -4 thai bird's eye chiles, crushed | 3 tablespoons sugar | 3 tablespoons crispy roux | 12 slices rye bread, makes 16 rounds ( ends trimmed )
instructions: Meat preparation instructions. Place meat in a dish. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for a minimum of 1 hour or up to 3 hours. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a mixing bowl combine the ricotta, sweet potatoes, olives, 2 or 3 of the chiles, and sugar. Mix well. Season with salt to taste. Spread about 2 teaspoons of the filling onto each rye round and sprinkle 1 - 2 teaspoons of the truffle powder over top. Carefully place an rye round on top. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly around the edges. You may serve these as is or top with other meal or serve as is.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,sirloin steak,lemon zest,golden delicious apple,chicken cutlet
title: Gluten Free Beef and Pork Goulash With Apple Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 2 golden delicious apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 150 g sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 1 chicken cutlet, cut into thick slices
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water until tender, 20 minutes or packet directions. Drain and cool slightly. Meanwhile, stir together zest and grated apples in a small bowl, then add beef, and toss to coat. Transfer to a lightly greased shallow baking dish and stir in chicken and rice. Bake in a moderate oven for about 5 minutes or until hot and bubbling. Serve with a salad.

title: Cheater's Southwest Masa Flour Tortilla
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 2 green bell peppers, sliced into 1/4 inch strips | 1/2 cup margarine or butter, melted | 1 1/2 cups warm water, or as needed | 1 package frozen water crackers
instructions: Mix masa harina, green bell pepper, margarine, and warm water.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,navy bean,hoisin sauce,naan bread,cream tartar,caraway seed,red potato,tzatziki
title: Antipasto
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, halved, quartered | 1 lb unpeeled small naan bread | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( kalonji ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 5 cups canned pinto beans, rinsed | 1 small head caraway seed, patted dry with a paper towel | 1 1/4 cups hoisin sauce | 1 1/4 cups cream of tartar | nu % sesame oil or tahini
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Pour the potatoes and bread into a large pot. Cover with several inches of water and a half inch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until fork tender. Drain. Place the naan on a baking sheet and bake until lightly toasted. Cool completely. While the bread is toasting, place the poppy seeds, caraway seeds, pinto beans and 1 - 2 inches of water in a roasting pan and boil, uncovered, for about 10 minutes, or until tender, and remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the remaining 1 1/4 cups of water in a pot. Place the seeds on top and bring to a boil, then immediately add the remaining 1 1/4 cups of water and boil, uncovered, for about 15 minutes, or until the seeds are tender and the sauce is slightly thickened. Strain to rid of excess solids, cover and set aside. Transfer the tomato ketchup to a serving saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Stir in the cream of tartar, then cook until reduced by half. Mix the softened bread into the tomato ketchup, then cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. When serving, stir in the toasted poppy seeds and drizzle with teriyaki marinade. Tzatziki. Place the red potato on a cutting board and cut into chunks about 1 1/2 inches wide so the potatoes are about 1/2 inch thick. Place in a mixing bowl and toss with 2 teaspoons of the tomato ketchup. Season to taste with salt. Transfer to a shallow baking dish or baking pans so that the potato chunks are not crowded and will not spill over.

title: Broccoli Meat Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb frozen chopped broccoli | 1/4 cup minced raw meat, from cooked meat | 2 tablespoons lard, from cooked meat | 3 slices naan bread | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 2 cups uncooked lasagna noodles | 1/2 teaspoon sumac
instructions: Boil broccoli with salt to taste for about 6 minutes. Rinse under cool running water and drain and set aside to cool. Meanwhile cut up the meat from cooked meat. Set aside. Prepare lasagna dish by placing lasagna noodles in bottom and sides of a large bowl, sprinkling with sumac then topping with meat from cooked meat and broccoli. Top with remaining lasagna noodles. Combine remaining meat from cooked meat and sauce and brush over all with this mixture. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 400 degrees for 35 - 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 15 minutes to brown top and brown crispy edges.

title: Smoked Fish in Turmeric (Coxinhas)
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb smoked fish | 1 dash turmeric powder ( cumin/fenugreek )
instructions: To smoke fish, pour a little smoke into a skillet, place fish in the skillet, add turmeric, cover and smoke one minute. Open lid, and smoke 2 or 3 minutes longer until fish is cooked.

title: Amaretto Honey Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces amaretto | 3/4 cup peeled cooked pears or 3/4 cup orange sweet potatoes | 3/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in a bowl. Cover and chill for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: white flour,peel,paprika,red potato,coriander powder,sea salt,saffron thread
title: Spiced Scottish Saffron Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread | sea salt | 400 g white flour | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 teaspoon coriander powder ( mild or hot ) | 1 teaspoon saffron mixed with 3 tbsp fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Cut the potatoes length ways into 1 inch pieces. In a large mixing bowl, use a pastry cutter to cut out 64 potatoes without peeling them, leaving the larger potatoes whole or in large chunks. Add the saffron threads and sea salt and knead until they get a firm dough. Divide the dough into 2 balls, with rolling pin, and roll each one with rolling pin between 2 sheets of non stick baking paper to about 1/4 inch thick. Bake them for about 45 minutes in a moderate oven. When the potatoes are finished cooking, remove them from the oven and place them flat on a cutting board. Cover with a tea towel and return them to the fridge. Make a paste using the flour, paprika, coriander powder, saffron, and coriander leaves, and place them in a clean food processor or blender. Pulse until the mixture forms a nice paste. Dip each potato into the flour mixture, shake off excess before dipping into the paste. Dip the soaked potato and return them to the baking paper, so the excess paste is absorbed. Cover and leave them to dry for about 15 minutes. To cook them faster, you can cook them in an oven for up to 10 minutes at 150 degrees c then reduce the heat and bake them for 40 minutes at 200 degrees c until they are all crispy and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,breadcrumb,white flour,cardamom seed,icing sugar,oregano leaf
title: Swiss Cheese Fingers II
ingredients: 4 slices swiss cheese | 1/4 cup white flour | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Slice the cheese slices 1/4 thick. Place flour in a shallow dish or on a plate. Dice the cheese into 1/4 slices. Stir into the flour the sugar, cardamom and oregano. Add the breadcrumbs and stir in the crumbs until thoroughly mixed. Dip the cheese slices in the batter and then in the crumbs. Place on a greased skillet and fry over medium low heat until crisp..

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,chicken thigh,tabasco sauce,lettuce,half,broccoli floret,beet,turnip
title: Noble House Beet And Chicken Salad
ingredients: 8 chicken thighs, skin on, trimmed, cut on diagonal into 1 1/2-inch-thick slices | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 8 cups torn lettuce | 3 cups fresh broccoli florets | 3/4 cup turnip, diced | 1 1/2 cups turnips, diced | 1 1/2 cups beet, diced
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with 1 tsp sesame oil, tabasco and 1/2 tsp each. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Prepare broiler/grill with a light mist of oil. Heat broiler/grill pan or grill pan to high. Toss salad ingredients until coated. Serve salad with 1/2 tsp reserved dressing. Add more sesame oil as required.

title: Spaghetti Squash and Chicken
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, cut lengthwise in half | 1 whole chicken, boned and cut into 8 pieces | crushed red pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cut squash halves on a baking sheet. Sprinkle each half with crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until chicken juices run clear. Serve on a bed of spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,semolina,peanut butter,cumin,pork sausage link,baking powder
title: Churros
ingredients: 1 cup semolina | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup grated onions or 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 9 -10 pork sausage links, halved lengthwise
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly combine all ingredients. Shape into 8 balls. Heat a skillet or griddle. Brown the pheasant on each side until golden brown, about 2 - 3 minutes per side. Serve hot or cold with beans, rice or pasta.

title: Chiles Rellenos for Burritos, Mexican
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing beef | 3 poblano chiles | 2 ounces pearl barley | 1/8 teaspoon black, ground cardamom ( optional ) | 2 ounces store brine-cured black beans ( optional )
instructions: Chop chilies and set aside. Soak poblanos in hot water for 20 minutes and remove stems, then rinse and coarsely chop. Dice beef and set aside, discarding remaining marinade ingredients. Preheat oven to 350^f. Place beef, peppers and barley in a roasting pan. Put on top rack of oven and roast for 1 hour. Add beans, adjust oven temperature to broil, place lid on pan, and broil for another 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes. Serve on hot flour tortillas or with rice. Variation, you can replace the black beans in with refried beans, you can also add a few dried chipotle peppers to the mixture with the peppers, or you can puree the contents of a blender, or use a food processor. Note, this dish can also be made into meatballs, using the reserved marinade.

title: Simple Short Rice
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks | 3/4 cup brown rice or 3/4 cup rice flour
instructions: Place meat in crock. Combine brown rice, flour and water. Stir into meat. Cover and let sit 8 hours in cool place, stirring occasionally.

title: Italian Lamb Salad (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1 kg mutton ( i used lamb cut into chunks ) | 3 italian plum tomatoes ( coarsely chopped ) | 1 orange, segments | 8 -10 cups arugula
instructions: Trim fat from lamb. Cut off dark brown outside of lamb. Slice lamb into 1/4 inch slices. Slice tomatoes into 1/2 inch strips. Mix pork with plum tomatoes and orange segments. Toss lightly and marinate in refrigerator for at least 1 - 2 hours heat oven to 190c or 160c gas mark 4, about 5minutes for meat and 15 - 20 minutes for veg. Serve lamb, tomato mixture and mixed veggies in large roasting tin or casserole dish with crusty bread to mop up juices. A nice crusty bread slice would be ideal.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,tuna steak,mint sprig,orange zest,palm sugar,great northern bean,fruit,kernel corn
title: Sweet and Savory Orange Tuna Fries with Roasted Corn and Mint
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks | 1 teaspoon freshly grated orange zest | 4 teaspoons freshly grated palm sugar | 1/2 cup dried great northern beans ( may also sub frozen peas, also known as canola oil or sunflower seeds ) | 2 tablespoons chopped frozen mixed fruit ( i use strawberries, pineapple or peaches ) | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Place steaks between sheets of plastic wrap, then pound to 1/2 by 2 3/4 thick. Sprinkle each steak with orange zest, palm sugar and beans. Drizzle each steak with 2 teaspoons orange zest and 1 1/2 teaspoons orange juice. Using your hands, massage 1 1/2 tablespoons orange zest into each steak. Sprinkle the italian seasoning evenly over all. Arrange each steak, fat side up, on a rack in a roasting pan and bake at 400 degree f for 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Meanwhile, warm 2 tablespoons of pine nut oil in a small saucepan over high heat. Using tongs, lift steaks out of pan and reserve on a plate. Spoon any fat remaining in pan and return to medium high heat. When pan is hot, add remaining juice and chopped mint. When mint begins to bubble, add fish, a few slices at a time, and cook 2 - 3 minutes per side or until crisp and a bit browned. Drizzle with orange juice and serve. If adding fruit to fries, arrange fish on serving plate and garnish with orange slices.

title: Jenny's Kidney Bean Pie(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1 tablespoon horseradish sauce | 2 tablespoons lychee, sauce or 2 tablespoons plum sauce | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Mix the kidney beans and cake flour in a bowl. Add the horseradish sauce, lychee sauce, and or plum sauce. Stir until thick and smooth, set aside to cool. Form the mixture into a patty shape, about the size of a fifty cent patty tin, and flatten into a circle by tilting the edges up. Top the patty with the tomatoe jam, or any other spread you like. Place on a tray and chill for 1 hour in the fridge. Turn the oven on to 375 and remove the patty. Cook for about 20 - 25 minutes, or until the patty is puffed and golden. Allow to sit for 5 minutes prior to serving. This pie can be made vegetarian, if desired. Serve with mashed potato or veggie fillings.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,red pepper,orange,celery,chicken bouillon cube,kielbasa,porcini mushroom,milk
title: Sausage  and Vegetable Pizzaiola
ingredients: 8 ounces sausage and vegetables in pancake type roll, cut in half | 12 ounces kielbasa, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup red pepper, slices roasted red pepper | 1/2 cup celery, sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley or 1 tablespoon basil | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 cup milk | 1/4 cup freshly grated rind from 1 orange | 1 pizza crust, baked
instructions: Preheat oven, meanwhile, put sausage, vegetables, roasted peppers, and celery in 13x9 x2 baking pan. Sprinkle with parsley or basil. Pour milk and bouillon over all. Bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Brush crust with melted margarine. Place pizza on pizza and top with sausage mixture. Bake another 5 minutes or until dough is browned.

title: Italian Easter Eggs and Pizza
ingredients: 12 slices pepperoni | 12 large eggs | 24 fluid ounces pizza sauce | 24 radishes, peeled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread pepperoni slices on a cookie sheet or piece of parchment paper. Bake for 3 to 5 minutes, until golden brown. Break an egg in one small bowl and break the yolk with a fork. Stir the yolk with fork into egg white mixture. Pour enough pizza sauce into a 9x13 inch baking dish to coat the sides of the bread. Arrange 5 radishes on the sauce. Spoon the egg yolk mixture over the radishes. Place remaining pepperoni slices around the radishes. Top with remaining sauce. Bake in preheated oven until egg whites are firm.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,cornflour,onion salt,greek oregano,mozzarella cheese,irish whiskey,kernel corn,baking powder
title: Irish Street Artichoke Cornbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornflour | 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1/3 cup grated parmesan's irish whiskey, divided | 1/2 teaspoon cornmeal | 1/2 cup onion salt | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f, spray an 8 x 5 loaf pan with cooking spray. Sift cornflour, 1/3 cup mozzarella, parmesan's, 1/2 cup irish whiskey, onion salt and baking powder into a bowl. Stir in the artichoke hearts and oregano.

title: Strawberry Ganache (Aka Greek Yogurt)
ingredients: 3 bunches strawberries, cleaned and halved | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Rinse and dry the strawberries with kitchen towels. Combine the strawberries, lemon zest, garam masala and olive oil in food processor. Process to desired consistency. If all the ingredients are very thick, add a bit of water. Serve immediately or refrigerate for 5 minutes.

title: Wasabi on Sesame Oiled Wasabi
ingredients: 3 teaspoons wasabi paste | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Place wasabi paste in a small bowl. Heat 1 teaspoon of wasabi between two sheets of wax paper and spread out with the back of a spoon to form a thin film. Let wasabi stand for 30 seconds. Remove wax paper and dry wasabi from can onto plate. Roll wasabi 1/2 inch thick and transfer to oiled bowl. Use remaining wasabi for dipping wasabi.

Random Ingredients: caesar salad dressing,hamburger,oriental flavor ramen noodle,anise seed
title: Chinese Style Noodle Burger
ingredients: 4 hamburger | 6 oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles | caesar salad dressing | ground anise seed
instructions: In a plastic bag, combine the hamburger, ramen noodles, caesar salad dressing, and anise seeds. Seal and knead well. Shape into 6 patties. Add a dash of black pepper with each burger if desired.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,dark rum,tomato soup,fish sauce,roast beef,red pepper flake,graham cracker crumb
title: Phyllo Fish Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 package prepared phyllo pastry | 2 lbs sliced roast beef | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/3 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Thaw phyllo sheets in refrigerator, but do not dry them. You use them for rolling up the filo in a 9x13 inch pan. Mix the beef, tomato soup, rum, fish sauce and crushed red pepper. Place one filo sheet on work surface. Spread the 1/3 cup of cracker crumbs on the other 1/3 of the filo sheets. Place one third of the mixture in the center of the filo sheet. Bring the edges of the remaining filo over the stuffing. Roll up the filo into crescents, pressing to seal. Place the seam side down on top of the rolls. Cut the rolls diagonally, across the stuffing, to make 6 smaller rolls. Put in a 9x13 inch pan. Let sit for 5 minutes. Unroll the filo and spread the remaining stuffing on it. Sprinkle crumbs on top evenly. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 15 - 15 minutes or until crust is golden.

title: Irish Cabbage and Beef Sandwich(Rabbit)
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs beef brisket | 4 cans hominy ( reserve one can ) | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables ( i had to use fresh mixed vegetables ) | 1 can v8 vegetable juice plus 2 tablespoons vodka ( use your favorite flavor ) | 2 cans baked beans | 1/2 head green cabbage ( cut into small shreds ) | 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese
instructions: Poke holes all over brisket. Place brisket between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound to 1/4 thick. Place in large dutch oven. Mix can of hominy, mixed vegies with juice. Cover and refridgerate overnight. The next morning, remove brisket. Cover and place in preheated 375° oven. Bake, uncovered, for 2 hours. Uncover and bake for an additional hour. Cool to room temperature. Cover and chill overnight. Remove fat and discard. Rinse and pat dry and slice cross grain. Set meat in a large platter. Cover with the warm hominy mixture. Spoon some of the juice from the can and ignite with a match. You want the flames going. If the flames go out, it will be pretty quickly. Top with some swiss cheese and return casserole to a simmer.

title: Chiles De Trip
ingredients: 4 large anaheim chilies | 1/2 cup white rum
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Trim any remaining seeds from the peppers. Remove seeds and stems and the white ribs from the chilies. Place peppers and ribs on a lightly oiled baking sheet and place under the broiler. Bake for 10 minutes or until skins are blistered. Turn peppers and cook for 15 - 20 minutes or until skins are charred. When done, remove peppers and let cool slightly. Remove chilies from oven and scrape the skin from the peppers. Cut peppers into strips, or smaller pieces if desired.

title: Sticky Orange Dates
ingredients: 6 dates, pitted, chopped | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill before using to allow flavors to mix.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,cognac,urad dal,dark brown sugar,colby monterey jack cheese,tequila,radish,vinegar
title: Raisin-Spiked Margaritas
ingredients: 3 cups colby-monterey jack cheese ( chopped fine ) | 2 lbs dark brown sugar ( packed ) | 1/4 cup sweet unsweetened cocoa | 3 tablespoons aged cognac | 3 tablespoons dark aged vinegar | 2 teaspoons gold temple bittersweet tequila ( or reola ) | 1/4 cup radish ( finely chopped ) | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( finely chopped ) | 3/4 cup colavita black uradish ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a 12 inch glass jar with a tight fitting lid, mix the first six ingredients. Cover and shake vigorously. Repeat with remaining cheeses. Transfer to freezer and chill. At least one hour before serving to develop flavor, add the tequila, radishes, raisins & sugar. If chilled longer, the sugar will harden & be difficult to detect. Makes about 5 drinks.

Random Ingredients: green onion,prosciutto,cake flour,black,monterey jack cheese,soymilk,wonton wrapper,cinnamon
title: Uncle Bill's Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup unbleached cake flour | 1/3 cup cold butter, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 package frozen miniature spring roll dough wrappers | 12 slices thinly sliced prosciutto | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green onion | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Make sure there are no sparks on the windows.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,savoy cabbage,dark chocolate,mint,red chile,arborio rice,purpose flour
title: Chocolate, Savoy and Mint Risotto
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice | 1/2 savoy cabbage, shredded | 3 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1/2 bunch chinese black fresh mint, stalks removed, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 red chile, seeded, diagonally sliced | 2 romaine lettuce
instructions: Place rice and cabbage in 2 - ½ qt pan, cover with water, bring to boil and then remove from the heat. Cover and stand for 10 minutes until all the water has been absorbed. Rinse rice until the water runs clear. Press the rice and cabbage through a sieve placed over a bowl, cover and set aside. Heat chocolate and chilies in a heavy non stick skillet over medium heat, stirring, for 3 - 4 minutes until melted and lightly golden around the edges. Add mint and flour and stir for 1 minute. Place rice and cabbage on a serving platter and top with chilies and mint dressing. Garnish with chilies, if desired. Serve.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,green chili pepper,pine nut,fettuccine pasta,tart apple,blueberry,cheese,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Fettuccine, Fruit & Cheese Salad
ingredients: 500 g dried fettuccine pasta | 1/2 cup blueberries | 1 small tart apple, cored and quartered | 1 green chili pepper, seeded, deveined, finely chopped | 1/2 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 3 tablespoons grated tasty cheese | 1 tablespoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Cook fettucine till al dente, drain. Meanwhile, combine blueberries, apple, chile, ra el hanout, pine nuts, cheese & orange peel. Toss with pasta. Serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,nonstick cooking spray,lemon peel,veal shank
title: Grilled Italian Veal Shank
ingredients: 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1/4 cup nonstick cooking spray | 12 thin-sliced veal shank, about 3 pounds total | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel
instructions: Spread pesto on grill rack or plate. Spray grate with cooking spray and place veal on grill rack. Sprinkle veal with lemon peel and turn once, cooking 1 to 2 minutes per side or until seared and just cooked through meanwhile, heat 1/2 inch oil in nonstick skillet over high heat until oil just begins to smoke, 2 to 3 minutes. Carefully place veal, overlapping, on heated grill rack, turning once and sprinkling with 2 tblsps pesto. Let stand for 3 minutes. Turn veal over and continue cooking until veal is crisp and lightly browned and dry. Transfer veal to heated platter.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,apricot jam,hoisin sauce,bean sprout,white peppercorn,taco sauce
title: Thai Apricot Tea Sandwiches (Banh Mi)
ingredients: 1 cup dried apricot jam | 3/4 cup apricot flavored bean sprouts | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | fresh cracked white peppercorns | 1 teaspoon light tasting taco sauce | 1/4 cup shaved fresh cranberries ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the jam, bean sprouts, hoisin sauce, white pepper and taco sauce. Spoon onto the upper two sides of a hot bbq plate. Place 1 tablespoon of shaved cranberries on top and let melt. Serve alongside.

title: Kathy's Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup whole berry cranberry sauce | 1 1/4 cups beef stock | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Place the cranberry sauce, stock and white wine in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth. Place the half and half in a heavy bottomed pot over low heat and bring to a boil. When bubbles form around the edge of the sauce, slowly add the half and half, stirring quickly until completely heated. Serve over your favorite meat, vegetable or mashed potato.

title: Szechwan Oyster Dippers
ingredients: 24 ounces fresh oysters, shucked | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Mash the tomatoes, chilies, and vanilla extract with a mixer. Add the garam masala to taste and mash well. Add more garam masala if desired, and mash again. Fill a large, heavy skillet and coat with oil. Cook over medium heat until hot, and lightly browned.

title: Lemon Rice
ingredients: 6 cups risotto rice | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon rind ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain risotto. Place rice in large saucepan and pour in enough hot water to cover. Over high heat, scald rice. Stir, cover and let sit 5 minutes. Use spatula to loosen from water and spread rice slightly. Remove rice from heat.

title: Pistachio Syrup
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark corn syrup ( i use karo but any will do fine ) | 4 tablespoons raw sugar | 4 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons shelled chopped pistachios
instructions: In a small saucepan, place sugar, vinegar, and 1 tbsp of the pistachios, stirring and heating together over medium heat until dissolved. Heat until syrup begins to boil, then remove pan from the heat and add the rest of the pistachios. Spread the hot syrup on a plate, place on a tray and allow to cool. Remove pistachios and press with the back of a spoon to extract most of the liquid. If you have it, you can just add some of the warm syrup to the syrup, then spoon back onto the pistachio and mix thoroughly. Chill the syrup, uncovered, before using.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,taco flour tortilla,egg substitute,sage,grand marnier,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon juice
title: Bite-Seared Bites
ingredients: 0.5 package taco-size flour tortilla | 3 tablespoons egg substitute, mixed with | 2 teaspoons grand marnier | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice ( about 1 tablespoon ) | 1/4 teaspoon sage | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package egg roll wraps
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Cut tortillas lengthwise in half.

title: Faux-Like Bacon and Peppers
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon bacon fat ( optional )
instructions: Slice the ends off of the green bell pepper, peel and slice the green bell pepper into rings. Heat the bacon fat in a frying pan over medium heat. When it is almost smoking, slice and drop the green bell pepper slices into the fat. As soon as they turn slightly crisp on the bottom, use a slotted spoon to remove them from the pan and transfer them to a plate. Slice and serve.

title: Hot Vodka
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/3 cup vodka
instructions: Mix together ingredients in a glass jar or bottle.

title: Seedies and Peas
ingredients: 1/2 pound black-eyed peas | 1/2 pound green peas | salt to taste | 5 tablespoons butter, divided
instructions: Place the black eyed peas into a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two. Remove from heat and allow to steam dry for a minute or two. Set aside and set aside. Place the green peas into a saucepan with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until tender, then remove from heat. Place 1 tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium high heat. Place about 2 teaspoons of peas into the butter, and fry until golden brown, turning once. Place 1 teaspoon of butter, about 4 to 5 tablespoons, into a microwave safe bowl, and microwave on high about 1 minute. Once the peas are fried, stir in green peas, then stir in the remaining tablespoon of butter. The peas with the butter may be served hot.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,ginger garlic paste,curry powder,egg white,curry paste
title: Eggs with Curried Dals
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain urad dal ( ground ) | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 beaten egg whites | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder ( more if desired, but i like lots! )
instructions: Mix spices together and blend well. Add egg whites and mix well until evenly mixed. Refrigerate for at least 3/4 hour to an hour for better texture. To test for moisture, scoop a teaspoon of into a teaspoon and see if it is sticky. If it floats on the spoon, it will swell up and crackle.

title: Macaroni Cheese With Jalapeno Peppers
ingredients: 12 ounces orecchiette pasta, uncooked | 1/2 cup low-sodium red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped seeded fresh jalapeno pepper | 2 cups raw macaroni
instructions: Cook pasta in rapidly boiling, salted water following package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta cooking water. Drain pasta well.

title: Granny's Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 5 large russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Prepare a large cookie sheet by lining it with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Cut frozen vegetables into 8 wedges each. Place wedges on the sheet about an inch apart, and sprinkle with a little sea salt and more sea salt. Bake for 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from oven, unwrap, and dry at least 5 minutes. Return wedges to baking sheet, and bake, uncovered, until wedges are browned and crisp, another 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,bulb garlic,bamboo shoot,cake flour,basmati rice,dark chocolate,tabasco sauce,chicken wing
title: Lemon Chocolate Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 piece barbecued chicken wings, sliced in half lengthways and at joints, about 10-15 per kilogram ( see technique below on how to buy, or visit recipe of your choice, see technique below ) | 200 g mixed medium size sliced bamboo shoots ( see technique below ) | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/2 cup lemon juice, divided | 3/4 cup finely chopped dark chocolate, such as lindt | 2 tablespoons finely chopped basil or 2 tablespoons parsley, plus extra, to serve | 3/4 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon grated lemon rind | cooked basmati rice, to serve
instructions: Place 1 piece of barbecued chicken wing at one end of a bamboo shoot and push a slice down the length of the bamboo shoot to cover the entire length. Place an additional piece of barbecued chicken on top of the bamboo shoot and push another piece of barbecued chicken on top. Repeat with the other piece of chicken. Heat 1 tablespoons of finely grated lemon rind in a saucepan over low heat. Add the rest of the barbecued chicken wings and marinate for 45 minutes or up to 1 hour.. While chicken is marinating, stir the chocolates together in a small bowl and set aside. Remove chicken from marinade and set aside. Sprinkle flour on a board, then using a rolling pin, mix the flour in, along with the tabasco, using a knife to push the flour through to create a marinating consistency, until it is a sticky powder. Add a tablespoon of lemon juice to keep the mixture from getting too dry. Lightly oil a large non stick frying pan over low heat and add the chicken wings in batches, turning them over until well coated on all sides. Add half the melted barbecued chicken wings to the pan, cook and turn them until they have just begun to colour. Continue cooking until most of the meat is turning golden, around 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Spoon half the barbecued chicken wings onto a bed of cooked basmati rice, top with half the chocolate sauce. Top each with a slice of barbecued bamboo shoots, remaining barbecued chicken wings, lime zest and extra chocolate sauce. Sprinkle with a large pinch of basil. Serve with some freshly ground black pepper.

title: Sweet Tortilla Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 jar baby carrots, including the juice | 3 slices deli-style cooked hamburger | 8 slices thinly sliced deli top round sliced cabbage | 4 bananas, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons prepared pizza crust | 1 dash anise seed | 1 packet tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Cook carrots in boiling water for one minute. Strain and cool. Place in a bowl. Place 1 slices hamburger and 1 slice of cabbage on each tortilla shell. Top each with a slice of the caramelized vegetables. Place a second tortilla over the vegetables. Roll up and seal with plastic wrap. Repeat wrapping process until the rolls are ready to go. Heat oven to 350°f lightly grease a cookie sheet with cooking spray and place rolls on it. Cook for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned on the bottom and crust. Remove from the oven. Top with the additional caramelized vegetables that have been heated through in the microwave. Allow to return to the oven for another 45 minutes to an hour or until the sauce is slightly thickened.

title: Fusion Dip
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 1 green onion, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Serve with warm pita.

title: Chile Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons brandy or 4 tablespoons red wine | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Pour the coiled brandy or wine into a mug and use a fork to mash into the brandy. If using a wooden spoon, stir slowly, then sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Tzatziki Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup masa harina | 2 teaspoons ttzatziki ( mizkan shiro )
instructions: Place the stock and masa harina in a wide, heavy pan with 1/2 tsp of tzatziki. Stir to combine. Heat on medium for 3 minutes. Add the remaining tzatziki and adjust seasoning to taste. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: currant,taco sauce,ra el hanout spice mix,meat,coriander seed
title: Moroccan Fried Meat (Lomo de Atum)  (Curried Turkey)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground meat, such as turkey or 2 lbs shoulder roast | 1/2 cup currants | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 3 tablespoons taco sauce ( chunky style chili sauce is best )
instructions: If using turkey, drain excess fat and cut it into 1/2 inch cubes. Toss meat with currants, raisins, and coriander seeds, adding a little hot water to moisten. Divide spices into equal quantities. Dump everything into a 9x13x2 inch metal baking dish or pan of your choice. Sprinkle with taco sauce. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour but preferably overnight. Preheat frying pan. If using fat free gravy, make your own using about a cup of water. Place pot over medium high heat. It should simmer for about 10 minutes but dont let it come to a boil. If using fat free gravy, make the gravy only if it is used up on the stove. Fry meat in oil until browned on all sides. Turn meat over in pan, cook until no longer pink. Remove meat from pan and cut into strips, using two forks. Serve with couscous.

title: Spanish Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Place the potato pieces into a bowl, fill with water, and set aside. Mash well with a fork before proceeding. Drain the potatoes, and gently toss with the potato flour to evenly coat. Stir the potato flour into the water using your hands until the potato is well coated with flour. Spread evenly in the prepared baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Jab and Jicama Salad
ingredients: 5 fresh bananas | 2 fresh peaches | 1 cup cooked garbanzo beans | 1/2 cup candied orange blossoms, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 lb imitation crab meat | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water
instructions: Peel and cut the bananas into 2 inch chunks. Put a few tablespoons of water in a bowl and set it aside. Cut the peach into small pieces. Dice the orange, and the thyme. Cut the crab in chunks. Place the garbanzo beans in a pot, and cover with water. Place over medium low heat and bring to a boil. Do not stir after 5 minutes and put a lid on the pot. Cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain the garbanzo beans and add them to a large salad bowl. Toss the banana and peaches with all the dressing ingredients in a bowl. Divide the hot salad among plates, then drizzle over the garbanzo bean salad. Serve at once.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 cups shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Warm lettuce in a skillet over medium heat until it begins to wilt. Spread a thin layer of confectioners' sugar onto a warm tortilla. Add lettuce to the sugar, and fold in the sides to form a cone shape. Repeat with remaining tortillas.

Random Ingredients: red chile,virgin olive oil,linguine,corn oil,greek oregano
title: Grilled Linguine
