ingredients: 1 lb linguine or 1 lb angel hair pasta | 4 tablespoons grapeseed corn oil | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon dried greek oregano | 1 teaspoon ground dried red chile
instructions: Prepare all spaghetti noodles according to directions on the package. While pasta is cooking, heat the oil in a large saute pan over medium heat. When oil is very hot, add the oregano and red chile and stir. Add the linguine and toss to coat with the hot oil. Remove linguine from the pan and drain. Toss pasta with sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,sugar snap pea,bratwurst,spanish onion,sugar,shiitake mushroom,corn oil
title: Sautéed Spicy Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package bratwursts ( about 1 1/4 lb/750 g ) or ( 10 ounce ) package smoked sausage links, cut into 1/2 inch slices ( about 1 1/4 lb/550 g ) | 1 lb brussels sprout, sliced in 1/2 inch rounds | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 small spanish onions or 3/4 medium vidalia onion, halved and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 can sliced shiitake mushrooms, drained | 0.5 package frozen sugar snap peas, thawed | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: In large bowl, combine bratwurst, sausage, and vegetables.

title: Persian Salmon Burgers and Raisins
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 lb salmon fillet, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1 can chopped red onions | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Brown the burger strips in a skillet. Stir in the remaining ingredients and serve on split buns.

title: Aurora (A Sour Sauce with Oyster Curd )
ingredients: 1 quart heavy whipping cream or 1 quart whipping cream | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 laurel leaves | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Combine cream, oyster sauce, laurel leaves and the salt in a saucepan. Heat over high heat, whisking constantly until liquid becomes reduced by about 1/. Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 minutes. Carefully pour mixture into a jar with a tight fitting lid. Place in a cool dark place. Will keep refrigerated for a month to develop flavor. To serve, pour over bread, eggs or any meat of your choice.

title: Warm Snow Pea Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb fresh snow pea pods | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce kahlua ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 dash rum or 1 dash rum-flavored flavoring ( to taste )
instructions: Wash the snow peas. Slice them lengthwise along the grain into 1/8 thick slices. Arrange the snow peas in a nonstick fry pan. Place a small spoonful of kahlua in the center of each snow pea slice. Add 1/8 to 1/4 cup boiling water, cover, and cook about 4 to 5 minutes, or until snow peas are tender and kahlua is melted. Stir in the extracts. Serve.

title: Batida(Berbere) - Indian Spice Mixture
ingredients: 500 g asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Blend the asafetida with an electric coffee grinder or a food processor. Store in an airtight container. Massage it into small balls if desired. Store in a cool dry place before use. Variation, add a little oil or melted coconut oil, or a little melted coconut, and a grinding of coconut powder to create a crisp texture.

title: Quick Kulfi
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon chat masala | 1 teaspoon louisiana-style hot sauce
instructions: Place yogurt in a sieve and remove all the liquid from the top. Allow to drain. Place 1 teaspoon of chaat masala and 1/4 cup of hot sauce in a medium bowl. Add drained yogurt and mix lightly. Refrigerate the mixture for 30 minutes before eating.

title: Avocado Fruit Dip
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, halved, peeled and pitted | 4 teaspoons apricot preserves
instructions: Place avocado slices and apricot preserves into the glass bowl of a blender.

title: Salmon With Cilantro and Onions
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 1 white onion, cut into thin rings | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f put salmon in a large baking dish. Arrange onion rings on salmon in a criss cross pattern to cover the whole surface. Cover with foil and bake 15 min, then remove from oven. Garnish with cilantro. Serve.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,cauliflower,dark rum,coriander leaf,chili sauce,tahini,golden syrup,rice wine vinegar
title: Bahama Curry Paste
ingredients: 450 g cauliflower, deseeded and cut into 2cm pieces | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, chopped | 150 g macadamia nuts, roasted and crushed
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the nuts in a food processor and process until finely textured. Transfer to a container and refrigerate until required. Place the nuts in a roasting tin and toast in a moderate oven until they are golden brown and fragrant. Remove from the oven and cool. Place the curry paste in a mortar and pestle pound or bash the nuts until they are a fine paste. Transfer to a mortar, adding the nuts, stir well to combine and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,hard egg,egg yolk,serrano pepper,lemon zest,mascarpone cheese,meat,sun tomato oil
title: Creamy Mexican Meat Turnovers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons minced serrano peppers or 2 tablespoons jalapeno, with seeds ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 14 1/4 ounces assorted cooked meat ( shredded ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped rindless orange peel or 1 tablespoon grated lime zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place sun dried tomato and jalapeno or serrano chili power, lemon zest, and lime zest in your food processor and process until finely minced. Place chopped eggs in a mixing bowl, pour over the mascarpone, and stir to combine. Place rindless orange peel in a mortar and pound with pestle until it becomes moist and soft. Then stir into the cheese mixture with the meat, then stir in the sun dried tomatoes. If using canned meat, drain and chop well.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,endive,havarti dill,mint sprig,mexican tomato,chicken bouillon,salt black pepper,red cabbage
title: Havarti Soup (Endives Soup)
ingredients: 1 package havarti with dill | 5 cups red cabbage, chopped | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 cup beef broth | 1 teaspoon dried mint sprigs | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place havarti, cabbage, tomatoes, broth, mint, salt, and pepper into a large pot and bring to a simmer over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,cream tartar,taco sauce,kiwi,apple cider vinegar
title: Kiwi and Apple Crisp
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1/2 lb kiwi, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 cup taco sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spread in a 9 inch x 13 inch pan.

title: Spicy Italian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon chili sauce
instructions: Mix all but cheese in small bowl.

title: Devilled Shrimp Burgers
ingredients: 600 g ground lamb | 200 g shrimp, peeled deveined and finely chopped | 125 g cheddar cheese, grated | 120 g lean ground veal | 150 ml lamb stock | 1 tablespoon good spice | oat, to serve ( optional ) | hamburger bun, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the burger ingredients together until thoroughly combined. Form the mixture into 4 patties. Heat a griddle and cook about 4 patties at a time until they are cooked to your liking. Serve with your favourite side salad and extra good balsamic vinegar.

Random Ingredients: vanilla vodka,red bell pepper,lime wedge,brown sugar
title: Sweet and Creamy Caribbean Peppers
ingredients: 1 red sweet bell pepper, seeded and cut into chunks | 1/2 cup vanilla flavored vodka, chilled | 1/4 cup light-brown sugar | 1/2 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl combine sweet pepper chunks, vodka and brown sugar. Gently stir to combine to combine. Pour the vodka mixture into a shallow glass pie plate or ceramic dish. Refrigerate until serving, about 4 hours. Fill a large pot 30 seconds or so before serving. Dip peppers into warm sauce and squeeze as much juice out of the bowl as possible. Garnish with lime wedges and serve.

title: Sukuma (Tamarind Piquant)
ingredients: 4 dried chile peppers, stemmed and seeded | 1 can crushed tomatoes with olive, drained | 3 tablespoons tamarind paste, chopped
instructions: Place the chile peppers in a bowl. Pour the crushed tomatoes over the peppers, and stir to combine. Mix in the tamarind paste, and cover. Chill overnight to blend flavors. Serve chilled.

title: Dahl With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups yellow lentils, washed | 1 1/4 cups low-fat yogurt
instructions: Pick over the lentils and wash thoroughly. Drain, wash and pat dry with paper towels. Place them in a saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the lentils are very soft and almost all the water has been absorbed, around 20 minutes. Allow the liquid to dry out. Allow this to cool to a room temperature, about 30 minutes. Stir gently and stir in the yogurt. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,green chilies,chinese five spice powder,baking powder,mint,sazon seasoning,eggplant,cauliflower
title: Chinese Five-Spice Eggplant (Aubergine) Brunch
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, peeled, and cut crosswise into 6 - 12 slices, and then into 1/2 - 1-inch thick rounds ( about 7 1/4 inches in diameter ) | 1 bag cauliflower, and cut florets ( florets only ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon sazon seasoning | 3 large green chilies, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup packed of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Lay out the rounds on your workspace and put them in a single layer on a rack. This will cause the remaining juices to run under the eggplant which will absorb the moisture and will stay in the eggplant. The exact procedure is put the eggplant on the rack in the oven and turn oven to 375 f. When the oven reaches 375 f, or when a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean, the eggplant is about half cooked. This way, the eggplant will steam as it simmers.

title: Ethiopian Sweet N' Sweet Mac
ingredients: 2 cups dry medium pasta | 1 1/2 cups honey | 1/3 cup tamari | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pods, or more to taste | 1/4 cup pasta sauce, such as durra | 1 pinch kosher salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain pasta, and rinse a second time. Transfer to a large bowl. Measure honey into a saucepan, and heat over medium heat until it just starts to bubble. Add tamari, sugar, and cardamom pods. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes, or until syrup is slightly thickened. Pour hot syrup over hot pasta.

title: Greek Dip with Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread ( i like italian bread ) | 2 yellow onions | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread into 1 inch cubes. Cut unpeeled onion in half and then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch medallions. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Place bread cubes in crock pot. Top with half of onions. Sprinkle remaining onions on top. Cover with another 1/2 of onions. Set on high for 6 hours. Turn to low and let cook for 2 hours. Remove from crock pot and let sit for 30 minutes. Note, the longer it rests you can cut your onion with a sharp knife and you can serve it on crackers, bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,tamari,chive,vanilla bean,dill pickle relish
title: Pillsbury Famous Creamy Danish Noodles (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup ( undiluted. note. can be found at kroger ) | 1/2 cup dill pickle relish | 1/4 cup dried minced chives | 1/4 cup sour cream ( reduced fat or fat free is fine, we don't like this, just plain ) | 1/2 teaspoon tamari ( optional )
instructions: Mix soup, pickle, sherry, sour cream and tamari together, refrigerate until ready to use. This can be made ahead and frozen in resealable freezer bag with a tight cover, refrigerate until ready to use. To defrost, transfer to a covered container and pop in the freezer for at least an hour.. Before serving, defrost in microwave on medium high for 1 - 2 minutes, stir once and serve with freshly grated coconut or cheese if desired.

title: Lemon Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed onion soup | ice, as required | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 3 drops food coloring ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel ( optional )
instructions: Put the soup and food colour in a bowl. Add coriander powder and lemon peel, if wanted. Pour into individual serving bowls. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,lemon peel,brown mustard seed,arrowroot,dark sesame oil
title: Lemon-Sesame Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely shredded lemon peel | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds ( may sub yellow ) | 1 teaspoon arrowroot ( cornstarch ) | 2 teaspoons crushed dark sesame oil ( may sub other 1 tsp. oil ) | 1 cup bean sprouts
instructions: In a bowl, stir together all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Sprinkle with black pepper before serving if desired.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,lamb shank,onion flake,tea,eggplant,rice vinegar,kosher salt black pepper
title: Eggplant and Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 large onion, cut into wedges | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 eggplant, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 pound lamb shanks, trimmed of excess fat, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 envelope instant tea | 1 package spaghetti
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add the pasta and cook until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a pot over high heat, pour in the vinegar, then stir in the lamb. Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the lamb is almost tender, about 20 minutes. Stir in the tea and cook for a further 40 minutes. Add the eggplant and cook just until heated through. Remove from the heat and stir in the cooked pasta. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Apricot Compote
ingredients: 1 ripe apricot, peeled | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce, or more to taste
instructions: Grill apricot over direct heat until charred and soft, stirring frequently, about 2 minutes per side. Spoon apricot into a small bowl. Drizzle with hoisin sauce.

title: Cheese in White
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon white peppercorns
instructions: In small bowl, mix ricotta, white peppercorns, and salt. Cover, and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Veal Arrabbiata
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry oregano | 3 tablespoons dried basil leaves | 2 tablespoons dried dill | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 lb veal cutlet | 1 lb jicama, peeled sliced into thin diagonal slices | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1/2 cup basil leaves | 1 cup fresh julienned basil leaf | 3 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Combine the oregano, basil, oregano and dill in a medium bowl and toss to mix. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper. Heat the oil over medium high heat in a wide, shallow skillet. Add the cutlets and cook until the cutlets are lightly browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Remove the cutlets to a paper towel lined plate and set aside. Add the jicama to the skillet and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add the oysters and stir to combine. Add the basil and julienned basil and stir to combine. Add the cooked pasta and toss to combine. Top with the shaved beef. Garnish with a sprinkle of tequila.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,parsley flake,grain mustard,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle-Spinach Salad
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach ( washed well ) | 2 tablespoons whole grain mustard | 2 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: In salad bowl, combine mustard, chiles, and parsley flakes. Dress salad and serve.

title: Welsh Scones for Christmas
ingredients: 1 pie crust, ready-made | 3 ounces self-raising flour | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c or 140°c if using a fan forced oven. In a small bowl, mix together the flour and mace. If using a fan forced oven or electric oven, put the oven rack on the middle shelf of the oven, so that it is at the lowest temperature but not above the hot point. Tip out the pastry and cut into 3/4 squares. Using a 5 cm round biscuit cutter, cut two 10 x 15 cm strips of pastry into 7 1/2 cm wide, long x 10cm squares. Add a little flour if the baking stone is hot. Then, using a very sharp knife, make a hole in the centre of each square with a little more flour. Push through the square with the back of a fork, then lightly prick the surface with a fork. Repeat with the other half of the pastry. Lightly prick holes in the top crust using a teaspoon, then lightly pour the topping mixture evenly over the top. Place on a non stick baking tray and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the topping is crusty and golden.

title: Vodka Pizza
ingredients: 1 -2 lb pizza crust | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | tostados
instructions: Roll pizza crusts on baking paper. Place dough on cookie sheet. Spread all ingredients on crust. Bake in preheated oven 425º for 20 - 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Tomato Sauce IV (Vegetable Mix)
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pour tomatoes into a 9x13 inch baking dish and season with salt and pepper. Cover dish with foil. Cook in the preheated oven until flavors blend, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,milk ricotta cheese,chicken breast
title: Creamy Low-Fat Chicken and Caramelized Ricotta Stuffed With a Ramekin
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, about 2 pounds | 1 1/2 cups roasted sweetened condensed milk and caramelized garlic sauce, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Pour one cup of the ricotta cheese into a bowl. Stir in the graham cracker crumbs.

title: South of the Border Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon fresh cinnamon | 4 slices fresh white bread | 1 can pizza sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon, divided
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Place poblanos on a foil lined grill rack. Lightly oil grill grate. Place poblanos on grill. Cook, turning occasionally, until lightly charred, about 5 minutes. Transfer poblanos to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Allow oven temperature to 325 degrees f. Roast bread slices until dry, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, warm 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Remove poblanos from oven. Spread 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon on each slice of bread. Spoon pizza sauce over top, dividing it evenly. Sprinkle poblanos with 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon and 1/4 teaspoon each of ground cinnamon. Return bread slices to oven and bake until poblanos are warmed, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb ( or a combo of italian and beef ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard ( or more, to taste ) | 1 lb ziti pasta ( or other tiny tubular pasta ) | 1 can whole beets, drained | 3 ounces canned crabmeat, drained & cut up ( or more, to taste ) |  molasses ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Cook ziti as directed on package, drain and rinse the pasta in a large mixing bowl. Set aside. In a skillet, brown lamb. Remove from skillet. Add mustard and allow to cool. Add mustard mixture to meat& mix well to combine. Drain beets and set aside. Add crabmeat and juice to the meat in the skillet& mix to combine. Pour meat mixture into a lightly greased 2 qt baking dish and bake for 20 minutes or until heated through and crumbly. Remove from the oven and top with beets and crab or other favorite veggies, if desired.

title: Caribbean Meatballs - Vegetarian or Canary, My Way
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup meat ( any meat, your choice, i prefer soy ) | 3/4 cup coconut milk ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Place meat, coconut milk, garlic powder, and celery seed in a plastic bag with plenty of holes or in a glass bowl. Mix well with hands until everything is well blended and place in fridge. I refrigerate for at least 1 hour but it varies on the size of the bag. Shape into meatballs about the size of a walnut. Bake over medium heat in a greasing pan. You may also freeze them for use later. I prefer freezing them on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,linguine,celery,vanilla extract,cola,dark brown sugar,dark rum
title: Aussie Linguine With Vanilla & Rum Glaze
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, uncooked | 1/2 cup slivered sweet cola or 1/2 cup carbonated beverage | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 pinch dark rum | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar substitute | 1 stalk celery, thinly sliced ( optional ) | salad oil, as needed
instructions: In a large frying pan, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add all the pasta and cook until tender but firm, stirring occasionally, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain pasta and toss with the cola, vanilla and rum. In a small bowl stir the brown sugar, celery or white wine, and a dash of your favorite salad oil. Toss to coat well with salad oil. Transfer mixture to a serving platter and serve immediately.

title: Chickpea Banh Mi
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes | 1 baguette | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons corn syrup | 3 cans chickpeas, drained | 1/2 cup rice wine
instructions: Cook potatoes until tender. Slice baguette into 1/4 inch thick rounds and toast on both sides in hot oil in a skillet until lightly browned.. Spread chickpeas on baguette and top with fries. Sprinkle lightly with rice wine and lightly with coconut oil. Broil 3 minutes or until bubbling.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil peanut,rose water,peanut,cardamom,red kidney bean,lemon wedge
title: Persian Kidney Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans ( or kidney beans may be used as an alternative ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 tablespoons rose water | 3 cardamoms, whole | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | lemon wedge, if desired
instructions: Drain beans, split beans and rinse well with cold water. Combine with water, in a medium saucepan and bring to boiling point. Cover and reduce heat as low as possible.

Random Ingredients: ice,tortilla,chicken breast,flat leaf parsley,french bread,molasses,coconut milk,yukon gold potato
title: Caribbean Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 cup crushed ice | 4 bone-in chicken breasts, bones and skin removed | 2 yukon gold potatoes, shredded | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 loaf french bread, cut into eighths | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 6 tortillas, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a 4 quart baking dish combine the rice, crushed ice, chicken, potatoes, coconut milk and molasses. Bake in the preheated oven 30 to 35 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Transfer mixture to a food processor and process until smooth and almost like a chunky puree. Arrange 1/4 of the bread pieces in a single layer on baking sheet. Top with 1/4 of the soup mixture, then top with remaining soup mixture. Using long handled tongs or strong chef's picks, gently crush the bread until coarse crumbs form, then sprinkle with parsley. Use wooden spoon to hold remaining bread in bowl and shape crumbs around soup and soup mixtures. Bake 10 minutes or until heated through. Serve with condiments of choice.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,purpose flour,flour tortilla,pinto bean,flat leaf parsley,fast rising yeast,mayonnaise
title: Beef and Bean Enchiladas from Abm
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 envelope fleischmann's fast rising yeast | 1 cup low sodium beef broth | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a large skillet, brown hamburger over medium heat until well browned and crumbly. Drain excess grease. Combine beans, parsley and half the parsley in a large bowl. Combine half the flour and yeast in a small cup and stir.

title: Filipino-Asian Meat Sauce on Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground turkey | 2 lbs thinly sliced scallops | 1 cup light soymilk | 1 cup low sodium soy milk | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 4 tablespoons louisiana hot sauce | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non metallic bowl. Place coated meat in a non reactive saucepan and add a small amount of water. Cover and bring to a boil. Place meat on hot skewers and cook 4 - 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: wheat hamburger bun,salmon fillet,pecan,italian seasoning,cooking oil,corn oil,lime wedge,minor beef base
title: Crispy Bacon Salmon Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced smoked salmon fillet | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons grated fresh pecans | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 4 whole wheat hamburger buns, split | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon minor beef base | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place salmon, italian seasoning, and pecans in a bowl and stir to combine. Heat the cooking oil in a small frying pan over medium low heat. Add the bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Spread two halves of each bun with the corn oil. Dip the salmon mixture in the oil and then, using a fork, coat with the crumbs, pressing lightly to coat. Grill until the salmon is done to taste and beginning to flake, 3 to 6 minutes. Transfer to the broiler and cook until heated through and crisp, 3 to 4 minutes more. Slice the sandwich into four and serve garnished with the lime wedges.

title: Tomatillo-Cardamom Molasses Ice Cube
ingredients: 8 1/2 ounces tomatillos | 1/4 cup raw molasses | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 cup ice cube
instructions: Dice onion and tomatillos. Combine with remaining ingredients in blender. Blend until smooth. Pour over ice cubes in a pretty glass.

title: Tuna Mash
ingredients: 1 lb fresh tuna, well packed and dried | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter )
instructions: Cut the tuna into fine 1/2 inch cubes. Use a small, heavy skillet or a heavy pot that will accommodate the pieces. In a small bowl, place the tuna and cover with just enough water to cover. Cover and bring to a simmer. Cook, over medium heat or until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to completely cool in the water. Skim out and discard any residue of fish remaining in the skillet. Pass the drained tuna through a strainer or food mill with some of the remaining water. Discard the remaining solids. To make the potatoes, combine the potatoes with the ghee in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir to blend. Cook, stirring frequently, until the potatoes are golden brown, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: honey,topping,cooking oil,chili powder,beet,black eyed pea,teriyaki sauce
title: Chinese Beetroot Hummus
ingredients: 1 package frozen beet, sliced | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground black-eyed peas | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 container fat-free whipped topping
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the honey, black eyed peas, chili powder and oil. Fold in the whipped topping. Drain the beets as much as possible. Put the cooked beetroot into the mixture. Mix everything together well and eat.

title: Molho Barfi
ingredients: 10 whole meno tablets or 10 tablets cholenteno cholasses ( or 1 tablets porcini ) | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1/4 cup lemon zest | sour cream ( optional ) | coffee ( optional ) | fresh herbs ( optional )
instructions: Boil 5 tablets. Drain them. Transfer the tablets with water to a pot. Add cream and leave to sit. Heat the oil and oil in a pan and brown the meno or porcini. When all the water is absorbed in the pan, stir in water lemon zest and coffee. Simmer this mixture until liquid is dried, about ten to fifteen minutes, depending on the strength of the meno tablets. If desired, garnish with herbs and serve warm.

title: Rigatoni With Capsicum & Corned Risoni
ingredients: 1/3 cup red lentil | 1/4 cup risoni pasta | 8 slices rye bread | 1 cup water | 1 pinch saffron | 3/4 teaspoon ground coriander | capsicum, rings
instructions: Put lentils and risoni in a large pan on high heat. Season well and cover. After around 10 minutes, bring to a boil and then reduce heat to lowest possible level and leave to cook for a further 45 minutes. While the lentils are cooking bring a pot of salted water to boil, and when it starts to boil, add the risoni and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and drain well. Add the risoni to the same pan, the water and season well. Stir until risoni is warmed through. When the risoni and lentils are done, add the saffron and coriander. Stir well, cover and leave to rest for 5 minutes. Stir through the capicum rings and serve.

title: French Herbed Herapy Syrup
ingredients: 2 cups dried sweet basil | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leave
instructions: Use a mortar and pestle to pound basil and thyme leaves until finely chopped. Put a small cup or two of basil, loosely packed, into a small serving bowl and pour the thyme syrup over it. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, or overnight. Lasts for up to 4 days.

title: Arugula Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 lb short-grain penne | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 4 ounces hazelnuts or 4 ounces salted nuts | 6 cups pomegranate seeds
instructions: Cook the short grain penne on the stove top in a pot of water. When it is just barely al dente, drain, rinse and set aside. In a food processor, place the hazelnuts and nuts. Process until the nuts turn the color of pine nuts. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add the arborio rice. Stir once and then drain. Combine the arborio rice with the roasted hazelnuts/nuts in a large bowl. Add the pine nuts, pomegranate seeds and pomegranate seeds.

title: Mexican Tuna
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks | 1 teaspoon dry mexican chocolate | 1 package frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Preheat a pan of water on medium to high heat. Dry the tuna in a paper towel. Place the steaks onto a plate and sprinkle with mexican chocolate on top. Place the spinach on top of each steak, and add the lid. Let steam for 3 - 4 min or until the spinach has steamed. Serve with fiesta dip and corn bread.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,tomato green chilies,ranch dressing mix,garlic clove,wheat flour,corn syrup
title: Ranch Macadamia and Tomato Dip
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes and green chilies, diced ( hunt's brand recommended ) | 1 packet hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, finely chopped | 1/3 cup whole wheat flour | 2 garlic cloves ( minced ) | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish. Bake at c for 20 - 25 mins, until golden brown, stirring all the while.

title: Beef and Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces dried cannellini beans | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 1 can corned beef chuck, diced
instructions: Sort and rinse the beans and bring to boil in 2 quart saucepan until tender. Drain and set aside. Add the mushrooms and cook until tender. Add beef and simmer until heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,mango chutney,oatmeal,pecorino cheese,cottage cheese,beef chuck,wild rice,eggplant
title: Raggi's Australian Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced lengthwise in half | 2 teaspoons oatmeal | 5 ounces lean ground beef chuck | 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 3 tablespoons low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 ounce pecorino cheese, grated or shaved
instructions: Cook meat in a pan over low heat until cooked through. Stir in seasoning. Cut eggplant slices lengthwise into half. Fill with meat mixture. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the grated cheese. Roll up tightly. Arrange in a large casserole dish. Add juice and remaining cheese to the pan drippings. Stir over low heat until melted. Pour over eggplant and serve hot or warm.

title: Chipotle-Glazed Dates and Apples
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups date bits ( soft dates ) | 1 1/2 cups stock | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened apple cider or 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle powder ( can use canned chipotle ) | 1/2 cup distilled white wine ( if you like a milder sauce, try white wine )
instructions: Cook and stir your dates, apple cider, vinegar, and chipotle powder in a pan or pot big enough to contain the dates and spices. When the dates and apples have started to swell, stir in the white wine and simmer until most of the liquid has been absorbed and the dates are very soft. Cool and store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,dark rum,lemongrass,parsley leaf,sun tomato oil,ghee
title: Gurka Barley Blend
ingredients: 8 lemongrass | 1/2 cup packed finely chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons oil or 2 tablespoons ghee | 1/2 - 3/4 cup raw pearl barley | 1/3 cup dark rum | chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: In a blender, finely chopped lemongrass stalks with the finely chopped sun drained tomatoes, oil, or ghee. Blend for about 45 seconds, or until well mixed. Transfer mixture to a saucepan. Stir in barley, rum and salt to taste. Cover& simmer over medium heat for about 30 minutes or until the mixture is creamy and the liquid has thickened. To serve, stir 1 tbsp hot barley mixture into the creamy gurka.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,arborio rice,cayenne,chuck steak,yogurt,pickapeppa sauce,vanilla extract
title: Chilled Beef Risotto
ingredients: 1 lb lean chuck steak, cut in fine 1 inch dice | 3/4 cup arborio rice or 3/4 cup risotto rice | 1 jar pickapeppa sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh ground black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: In a large nonreactive covered, heavy bottomed saucepan, over medium high heat, stir together the rice, pickapeppa sauce, vanilla, mustard seeds, and cayenne. Decrease heat to medium low.

title: Tuna and Peas in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1/2 lb tiny green peas or 1/2 lb frozen peas ( i just used frozen peas ) | corn tortilla chips
instructions: Pour tuna and green peas in skillet. Heat thru, remove from heat and sprinkle with peas. Top with corn chips, a little more chili powder if desired. Enjoy.

title: Prawns With Tomatoes and Dill
ingredients: 1 cup dry salad greens | 1 carrot, grated | 1 1/2 cups peas | 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup lemon juice, fresh squeezed | 1/4 cup plum, chopped fresh | 1/3 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: In large bowl, toss first 5 ingredients.

title: Spiced Eggplant
ingredients: 1 eggplant ( sliced lengthwise, lengthwise ) | salt | 1 tablespoon date ( chopped, about 1/2 tsp ) | 1 teaspoon saffron ( soaked in 1 tbsp. warm water for 20 minutes before use ) | 3 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta ( orzo ) | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Place sliced orzo in a colander with a tight fitting lid and let drain for 10 minutes. Place 1 tbsp. Of water on a plate and add 1 tablespoon. Oil. Place eggplant in this water and allow to drain for a few minutes. Remove eggplant from colander and pat dry with a paper towel. Dice into small bite size pieces. Place eggplant in oil and salt. Cook eggplant until slightly tender. Remove and set aside. Add date and saffron or any other vegetable you desire. Sauté for an additional 2 minutes. Mix in date syrup and oil. Drain orzo pasta as soon as it's al dente. Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Homemade Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 lb active dry yeast | 2 cups broth | 3 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm broth. In a small saucepan, simmer liquid until it becomes foamy, about 15 minutes. Cool to lukewarm. Whisk together broth, dijon style mustard and chili powder in a bowl, then stir into the yeast mixture. Let stand 5 minutes before using.

Random Ingredients: shortening,cumin seed,ouzo,linguica sausage,chinese egg noodle,beef tenderloin,wild mushroom,linguine
title: Sausage and Pasta Kugel
ingredients: 4 slices shortening | 4 ounces linguica sausage | 3 ounces fresh wild mushrooms | 12 ounces fresh chinese egg noodles | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut crosswise into 4 pieces | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, whole | 1 teaspoon ouzo | 4 ounces ouzo
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle the shortening into the pan and cook the linguica for 3 minutes, or until evenly browned. Remove from the skillet and reserve. In the same skillet, add the mushrooms. Remove and reserve. Cook the noodles until just soft and al dente, about 6 minutes. Drain well. Spread the noodle mixture onto a large baking sheet and place in the oven. Bake, uncovered, for 6 to 8 minutes. Meanwhile, melt the remaining 2 oz. Oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the beef and sauté, stirring occasionally, until browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the pan. Sprinkle with the cumin, and cook for 2 minutes longer. Add the meat, mushrooms and sauté for another 30 seconds. Sprinkle with the 1 tsp. Ouzo, and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly. Remove from heat, spoon over the noodles and serve.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,romano cheese,black pepper,plain yogurt,chili powder
title: Gourmet Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon chili powder, divided | 8 button mushrooms, rinsed and trimmed | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, divided | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Place the yogurt in a small serving bowl. Stir in 1 tablespoon of chili powder. Add the mushrooms and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. Mix well. Sprinkle with cheese just before serving.

title: Pecans and Seasonings
ingredients: 2 1/4 pounds pecans | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 piece fresh ginger paste, peeled
instructions: Mix pecans and seasoned salt together in a bowl. Score a few slits into the ginger paste with a sharp knife. Stuff the cayenne pepper into a pat of butter. Sprinkle the pecan nut mixture in with the seasoning salt. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,orange,salad green,broccoli,orzo pasta,peach,sea salt,green pea
title: Orzo and Broccoli Orzo, With Cream Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream cheese | 2 cups uncooked orzo pasta or 2 cups other small pasta, cooked | 4 ounces fresh broccoli or 4 ounces frozen broccoli, cut into small florets | 1/4 cup canned green pea, sliced | 2 large oranges, sections and pith cut crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon coarse sea salt | fresh green salad ( optional ) | chunky peach slices or peach slice, cut in decorative chunks ( optional ), to serve on top with a tossed salad ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cream cheese with 1 cup hot water and 1/4 cup cold water. Set aside. In a large saucepan, cook orzo according to the package directions. Drain and rinse under cold running water, drain again. Transfer orzo to a large platter and stir in broccoli, peas, orange sections, cream cheese mixture, salt and 1/2 cup hot water. Garnish with green salad.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,milk,lime wedge,part mozzarella cheese,pork shoulder,onion powder
title: Cheese, Onion & Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch strips, then trimmed of any fat | 6 tablespoons dry onion powder | 4 tablespoons cumin powder | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 3/4 cup skim milk | 3 tablespoons lime wedges or 3 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: In a large bowl, mix half of the dry onion powder with the cumin and use to coat the pork. Arrange the pork in layers on a non metallic foil lined baking dish. Add more dry spices to coat. Cover and refrigerate, uncovered, for 4 hours or overnight. Preheat grill or pan over medium high. Remove pork from the refrigerator and spread out on the baking sheet, fat side up. Cook until well browned, about 15 minutes. Turn meat and cook until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven. Meanwhile, melt 2 tbs. Of cheese in a small saucepan and stir in milk and remaining dry onion powder. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, and cook until thickened, about 10 minutes. Cool completely. Place 2 tbs. Of cheese in a bowl, then fold in the onion sauce, remaining 3/4 shredded cheese, lime juice and remaining 1/2 cup shredded cheese. Serve with the tacos, corn chips, chips or with beans and salad.

title: Lamb Korma
ingredients: 300 g lamb | yogurt
instructions: Mix yogurt with the lamb you will be cooking it inches leave overnight in the fridge. Cook it on a heated bbq with a little oil. Serve with lots of bread. You can leave it to sit for one hour and go. You could also make this on a grill with olives, or a casserole dish and grill it over a low heat for about 2 to 3 minutes on each side.

title: Maggie Beer's Easy Bolognese Apples and Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tart apples | 1 large maui onion | 8 radishes | 1 bottle bolognese sauce
instructions: Peel, core, and cut apples into small dice. Peel radishes and cut into slices. In a frying pan, cook on medium high heat the onions until they begin to turn translucent. Take care not to let them burn. Turn down heat to low, and add the apples. They should start to turn a little mushy. After about 30 minutes, add the bolognese sauce. Toss until all is mixed and cooked. Cover to let it begin to thicken. Turn down to low, and cook for another 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Thai Seafood Salad
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated shrimp | 1 can passion fruit nectar | 1 pound cooked salmon | 3/4 cup chopped dried shrimp | 1/3 cup coconut cream
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the passion fruit nectar and seafood. Place one can of the shrimp onto each shrimp. Shake the bowl to evenly distribute the seafood. Divide the seafood between serving plates. Top with coconut cream.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,vegetable oil,stewing beef,tahini,cherry tomato,mango chutney,navy bean
title: Tahini Beef Stew (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 19)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg stewing beef, cubed | 600 g pitted plump dried navy beans | 1 1/2 cups halved cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons nectarines or 2 tablespoons mango chutney | vegetable oil, for stir-frying | lime wedge, to serve, drizzled, to serve
instructions: Place the beef, beans, tomatoes and tahini in a large pan over high heat and cook for 2 minutes. Add the nectarines. Bring to the boil. Remove from the heat. Heat the vegetable oil in a shallow non stick frying pan. Cook the beef in batches, for 3 minutes on each side, until browned all over and cooked. Serve the beef with the yoghurt sprinkled with lime wedges and green beans.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,kiwi fruit,cheese ravioli,potato flake,nori,yogurt,italian parsley
title: A Kiwi Fruit Mousse
ingredients: 1 kg potato flakes | 200 g low-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup reduced-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley | 2 cans cheese ravioli | 500 g kiwi fruits
instructions: Dough, mix potato flakes, shredded cheddar cheese, sour cream or yogurt and herbs in a bowl. Place the ravioli in a large serving dish and pour in the cheese mixture. Scatter kiwifruit evenly over the cheese. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Marzipan Fritters
ingredients: 5 anchovy fillets, preferably anchovy fillets | 1/2 cup green olives | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 1 dash dijon mustard | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Place anchovies, olives, butter, mustard and the flour in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped, about 1 minute. Form mixture into small balls, the size of walnuts. Slightly flatten with your fingers. Drop them into oil in a large skillet. Cook over medium heat until dark brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Maurice's Porridge
ingredients: 1 kg pork shoulder, cut into small cubes | 1 kg vidalia onion, minced | 1/2 cup vinegar | 200 g goat's milk porridge oats ( soaked overnight ) | 20 g salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons bacon fat ( optional )
instructions: Heat the bacon fat in a non stick pan. Add the onion and sauté until clear and soft. Add the pork stirring well. Add the vinegar and salt and pepper. Simmer for 2 hours. Remove the meat mix from the pan. Add porridge oats and mix well until well blended. Bring to the boil and turn down the heat. Keep stirring and leave covered for another 45 minutes until the thickens slightly. Serve with cream. You may also use other meats or vegetables of your choice.

title: Liqueur a La Chocolat
ingredients: 20 -35 dried new mexico hot red chili peppers ( or a couple of hot chile peppers, stems removed ) | 6 -8 tablespoons grand marnier | ground turmeric
instructions: Remove stems from chiles and discard. Halve the chilies lengthwise. If you don't want a long slit in the chili, leave them intact, otherwise use a small canning knife. Blot chiles dry using a paper towel. Wash chiles and remove seeds if they didn't come off easily with a knife. Place chiles in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Paint with half each of the grand marnier and turmeric, stirring regularly until the mixture turns a slightly translucent, lightly browned color. Raise heat to medium high, and cook until the mixture dries a little. Turn up heat and boil chiles until most of their liquid has evaporated, about 5 minutes. Turn the heat again and cook, stirring, until the mixture is reduced by half, about 10 minutes and has thickened slightly, about 5 minutes. Place the mixture in a sealed jar, and keep indefinitely in the refrigerator. Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Easy and Simple Lime and Lime Roulades
ingredients: 2 limes, juiced | 1 3/4 cups self-raising flour, sifted
instructions: Squeeze juice from 4 limes into measuring cup and beat it together with the 1 3/4 cup of flour until you get a smooth consistency. Pour into small, greased plastic tubs and roll them in the flour. Leave in the fridge for 1 - 2 hours. Brush or spray with cooking spray and bake in a moderate oven until golden brown. Allow to cool, slice and serve with butter and fresh lime slices.

title: English Mustard
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,lamb,worcestershire sauce,corn kernel,shortening,white bean,irish cream,purpose white flour
title: Dublin Baked Beans - Crock-Pot Recipe
ingredients: 4 cups cooked fresh white beans ( or canned beans ) | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oatmeal, uncooked | 3/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup shortening | 2 cups corn kernels ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/3 cup worcestershire sauce ( or hot sauce ) | 1/2 cup irish cream ( optional, or sour cream ) | 8 ounces cooked lamb ( optional, if desired )
instructions: Prepare bean crumb. In a large bowl, mix the cooked beans, oatmeal, butter, shortening, corn and worcestershire sauce. Stir to combine. Transfer the bean mixture to an ungreased 3 3/4 to 4 quart slow cooker and stir to combine. Cover and cook for 8 to 9 hours on high or 4 to 5 hours on low. Add optional jalapeno chile and sour cream to crock pot, stir well and serve.

title: Guilt Free Guacamole
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes | 4 large leeks | 1 cup mixed dried fruit | 2 spring onions
instructions: Mash avocados in a bowl with a fork, add leeks and mix with hand. Add dried fruit, mix. Place in refrigerator until ready to use. Note, the mixture will lose some of its texture, so be gentle in blending. When ready to serve, mix and garnish with chopped onions. I sometimes add chopped walnuts and dried thyme at the end to make a light addition after cooking.

title: Simple Microwave Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant dashi stock, instant | 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a coffee grinder and pulse until finely ground..

title: Baked Tahini
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1 loaf country bread | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove crusts from bread, and cut a slit lengthwise into each slice. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Place in a resealable plastic bag, and fill with tahini. Squeeze out excess air, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve with pita or other bread pieces for dipping.

title: Easy Microwave Sweet Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup ( no canning ) | 1/4 cup caster sugar
instructions: Microwave sweet sour cream for 30 seconds on high. Stir in caster sugar and microwave for 30 seconds longer or until soft, stirring every minute until creamy through. If more sugar dissolves, microwave on high for 5 minutes more until creamy through the whole process. Alternatively, microwave on high for a further 30 seconds until very thick, stirring every minute until thickened again. Cool, serve, spread or use in recipes. Store in an airtight container.

title: Sicilian Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and patted dry | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place artichokes, cilantro, and confectioners' sugar in a small mixing bowl. Mix with a fork until cilantro is dissolved.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,green cardamom pod,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Nordic Queso Dip
ingredients: 2 cups low fat monterey jack pepper cheese, grated ( about 2 cups, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons green cardamom pods, smashed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in small bowl, stir together cheese, vinegar, and cardamom. Stir in pepper strips, about 3/4 cup per bite.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,snow pea sprout,red potato,wood chip
title: Microwave Potatoes With Snow Peas Sprouts
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs red potatoes | 1/2 lb snow pea sprouts ( not green ) | 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 package wood chips, soaked in water
instructions: Wash potatoes under running water. Drain well. Using paper towels, pat dry. Cut potatoes into half inch pieces and place in 2 1/2 quart casseroles, cut side up. Using the handle of a spoon, toss with about 1/4 cup of the oil and sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper. Microwave on high until potatoes are softened and beginning to brown on top, 5 to 7 minutes, stirring once. Transfer potatoes to shallow dish and bake 10 minutes. Turn potatoes and bake 10 minutes more or until potatoes are crisp and golden.

title: Tunisian Recipes: Sparerib Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saffron ( turkish spices ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: In a small bowl mix all the ingredients together. Rinse the spare ribs well after rubing them thoroughly on all sides. Pat the spices into the meat of your choice, and put the meat in a glass dish that will be the size of your dish. Pour the rub over the meat and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 to two days before eating it. This will give the meat a flavor that coats the meat and help it cook faster in the refrigerator. Cooking time reflects marinating time.

title: Shrimp Toast
ingredients: 8 slices toast | 1 cup large shrimp, cooked | 1 teaspoon sugar | butter or margarine | 4 tablespoons bourbon | salt
instructions: Cut toast into 6 wedges each and deep fry each wedge until golden brown. Remove from hot oil and drain on paper towels then spread a teaspoonful of butter onto the toast. Sprinkle with sugar. Add 3 - 2 tblsp Bourbon if using, mix gently and then top with shrimp and serve.

title: Lighter Pita Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 3 cloves crushed garlic | 1 package pita bread | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pita bread& vinegar in a microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on microwave for 2 minutes on high or to a minimum of 115 degrees f, stirring after 2 minutes. Cool completely, stir in pita bread.

title: Baklava
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 lb phyllo pastry | olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f, brush a square pan with olive oil or pam. Heat the mustard seeds. Cut sheets of filo into 4 triangles and brush with oil. Place 1 tsp of mustard seeds in the middle of each filo sheet and flatten so that it covers the mustard only. Fold the pastry into a triangle shape and brush with oil. Pinch the triangles to form triangles. Place them on the baking pan and then bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°f. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,milk,granny smith apple,great northern bean
title: German Style White Beans
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh great northern beans, washed | 5 pounds bone-in pork shoulder, cut into pieces | 2 granny smith apples - peeled, cored, and cut into wedges | 1 can reduced-fat evaporated milk
instructions: Place the navy beans and pork shoulder into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, and simmer until tender, about 1 hour. Drain liquid and reserve. Pour the beans with liquid into a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cook, uncovered, until thickened, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, discard any excess liquid and set the beans aside. Place the apples into the same saucepan with the reserved water, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cook until the apples are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside to cool slightly. Remove the cores, if desired, and place the beans into a large pot. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pork pieces on top of each other in a roasting dish. Roast the pork for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f when taken out of the oven. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f. Remove the pork from the oven, and place onto a cutting board. Place the cooked beans, pork wedges, apples, and evaporated milk into a pot. Place over medium low heat. Cook, stirring to stir every 4 to 5 minutes, until heated through. Stir the cooked beans with a pinch of salt into the stew.

title: Applesauce Lamb Tamale Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups dry corn husks | 1 pound ground lamb | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 3/4 cup ground mackerel ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1 can mackerel with sauce | 1/4 cup white sugar for decorating
instructions: Soak corn husks in water for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large, deep skillet or dutch oven, cook and stir the lamb and 1 tablespoon sugar until the lamb is browned and crumbly, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain off grease. Stir in the corn husks, 2 tablespoons oregano, mackerel, and 2 tablespoons sugar. Cover, and set aside. Bring 3/4 cup sugar and mackerel to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium, and simmer until the mixture is thick and reduced to a thick sauce, 5 to 6 minutes. Spoon some of the meat onto each corn husk, and roll up like a burrito. Repeat until all the husks have been used. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place 2 tamales in the pot, and reduce heat to medium low. Cook until the tamales are hot, about 20 minutes. Cut each tamale in thirds, and slice each roll into thirds. Serve with sauce and shredded mozzarella cheese.

title: Cod With Broccoli and Roasted Red Peppers (Colombia)
ingredients: 12 ounces cod ( fresh or a 10-ounce can ) | 6 cups broccoli, cut up in small florets ( from a 10-ounce package ) | 2/3 cup salted roasted red pepper flakes | 3/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place cod in a 2 1/2 quart baking pan. Arrange broccoli on top of cod. Heat red pepper flakes, cheese, and white pepper over medium low heat in a small skillet until cheese is melted. Pour melted cheese mixture over cod. Bake until cod is tender and sauce is slightly darkened, about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Classic English Almond Bread.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons fresh yeast, divided ( one package ), active dry | 3 tablespoons coarse grain mustard ( preferably colmans ) | 1/2 - 1 cup blanched whole almond
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 2 tsp. Of the dry mustard together by slowly whisking in 1/2 cup water and remaining dry mustard. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over dry yeast mixture, stirring to make a thick and sticky dough. Dough should not stick to your hands. Grease bowl of your choice and knead dough by hand in bowl. Place dough in a greased bowl, cover tightly with a moist towel and set in a warm place. Leave until doubled in size about 1 3/4 hours. Punch dough down before spreading with mustard or spread on bread. Cover loosely and let rise until doubled, about 30 - 40 minutes. Brush top with remaining mustard. Cut slashes across top and serve cold or warm. Sliced as desired with fruit and butter.

title: Grilled Plantains and Prosciutto Grilled
ingredients: 1 ripe plantain, peeled | 4 slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons canola oil, divided | 1 sprig fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium heat, 1 to 2 teaspoons oil per side, and place the plantain slices on the grill. Sprinkle with prosciutto slices, and grill just until crisp, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a work surface, and tent loosely with foil. Let rest for 5 minutes. Cut the plantain into wedges, and grill along with any juices on the bottom, turning once until charred on the top and lightly crisp on the bottom. Remove from grill, and sprinkle with fresh thyme, cumin, and more oil if necessary. Serve.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,taco seasoning mix,pecorino romano cheese,red wine vinegar,ritz cracker,pie crust,tomato sauce,date
title: Tapoicon (Cheese Pie)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pie crusts | 1/2 medium tomatoes, seeded and finely chopped or 2 cups chopped dates | 3/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese or 3/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( 2 1/2 ounces ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 12 ritz crackers, crushed | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients except crackers in pie pan. Cover with crust mixture and bake at 400°f oven for 10 minutes. Remove crust and bake 5 minutes or till crust is golden. In a separate bowl, mix tomato sauce and vinegar. Add crushed crackers and mix. Cool for 5 minutes on a wire rack. Spread tomato mixture in crust and bake additional 5 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,urad dal,hot italian sausage,purple onion,chili sauce,gingerroot,almond milk,mexican cheese
title: Indian Breakfast Bake
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked dry urad dal | 1 lb mild italian sausage | 4 teaspoons grated gingerroot | 1/4 cup yoshida chili sauce | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 8 ounces swiss cheese | 2 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 4 tablespoons fresh sliced purple onions
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Combine urad dal, sausage and ginger in a bowl and add one cup of yoshida and sweet chili sauce. Pour into lightly greased 2 qt casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 35 - 40 minutes or until hot& bubbly. Spread chili sauce over cooked mixture. Sprinkle with swiss cheese& onions. Place remaining 3/4 cup of yoshida over cheese and onion. Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Bake uncovered for 25 - 30 minutes or until top is lightly browned.

title: Danish Potato and Beet Pancakes
ingredients: 1 lb potato | 1 lb beet, peeled and diced | 3 tablespoons rye flour | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon celery, chopped
instructions: Place the potato and beet in a saucepan over low heat, cover and simmer until tender, 8 - 10 minutes. Allow to cool, then put vegetables through a ricer, or mash into large bowl and mash until smooth. Stir in the rye flour, seasoned salt and celery. Heat a nonstick griddle or skillet. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the potato mixture into the center, and spread out with a spatula. Cook over medium high heat for a minute or so, until hot but not smoking. Turn and cook for 30 seconds on the other side, making sure to flip the pancake. Remove to a dinner plate and serve hot.

title: Dilly French Fries
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon dill, chopped
instructions: Peal and slice potatoes. Combine ingredients and fry.

Random Ingredients: catsup,green curry paste,israeli couscous,red chile pepper
title: Curried Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups israeli couscous | 1 tablespoon hot green curry paste | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 red chile pepper, sliced, or more to taste
instructions: Combine the couscous, curry paste, catsup, and red chile pepper in a bowl, and mix to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Enchiladas Suizas (Tortillas & Cheese)
ingredients: 12 ounces tortillas | topping ( optional ) | tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cut tortillas in small strips. Using a cheese grater, grate or shred cheese finely. Put a line of tortilla strips on a plate. Sprinkle cheese on tortilla strips and roll up. Place tortillas on a large baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,heavy whipping cream,lettuce leaf,white pepper,red capsicum,grand marnier,maraschino cherry,black eyed pea
title: Mediterranean Black-Eyed Peas Salad
ingredients: 1 cup black-eyed peas, drained, rinsed, and chopped | 60 ml grand marnier | 4 1/2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 red capsicums, diced finely | shredded lettuce leaf | orange zest, for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beans, remaining ingredients, mix well, chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,red beet,turmeric powder,date,escarole,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,ginger garlic paste
title: Moroccan Baked Pumpkin
ingredients: 3 quarts pumpkin puree | 2 cups red beets, grated whole ( or diced in a food processor ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, pureed ( in adobo sauce ) | 1/4 cup chopped dates | 1/4 cup chopped escarole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash, and core beets. Toss with spices and marinate overnight, or at least 8 hours, in 1/4 cup adobo and 1/4 cup dates. Drain, and place in an ovenproof baking dish. Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes, or until beets are tender. Stir contents every 20 or 30 minutes while baking, and add extra dates on top. Bake for another 20 minutes, or until lightly brown.

title: Thai Sweet-And-Sour Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons packed light brown sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, combine fish sauce and brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: sauce,chocolate,garlic salt,flat leaf parsley,chinese chili sauce,stewing beef,banana pepper,red pepper
title: Chipped Beef (Chinese)
ingredients: 4 lbs steak, cut into thin strips | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 tablespoons chinese hot sauce ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( i use aji djan or sriracha ) | 6 fresh banana peppers, sliced or 1 can of drained sliced banana peppers | 1 red pepper, thinly sliced into strips | 1 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons chinese chili sauce ( or to taste ) | 10 ounces bittersweet chocolate, cut into pieces
instructions: Marinade, in bowl, toss beef strips with garlic salt and chinese hot sauce. Set aside 15 minutes. Meanwhile, place sliced bananas in foil lined shallow dish. Arrange banana peppers around the beef in single layers, and place under broiler, turning, until evenly blackened and lightly charred around the edges, about 7 to 8 minutes. Remove peppers and banana peppers from broiler and peel off the burnt skin. Chop peppers. Remove stems from pepper slices, discard, and set aside. Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt. Prepare chinese hot sauce, pour ingredients into large skillet and heat over low heat until hot, about 5 minutes. Serve over beef. Sprinkle with green onions and serve with sauce.

title: Barbecue Broccoli
ingredients: 1 pound frozen broccoli, thawed | 1 can minced clams with juice | 1 cup beef stock | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Combine broccoli, clam juice, beef stock, yogurt, and ketchup in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: pastry double crust pie,cooking spray,fruit spread,oregano leaf
title: Fresh Fruit Kebobs
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups prepared fruit spread, such as spice preserves | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1 package ready-to-use pastry dough for double-crust pie ( such as gold medal ) | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine fruit spread, oregano, and 1 cup water in small bowl, and stir until well blended. Transfer fruit topping to small bowl, and set aside. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface until 1/4 inch thickness. Cut in half crosshatch, and cut each half into 4 equal wedges. Place 1 wedge on prepared baking sheet, and brush with 1 teaspoon water. Sprinkle with remaining teaspoon water. Make a 1/2 inch slit in top of each wedge, and place 3 wedges on each wedge. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes on each side, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,salmon steak,wild rice,white pepper,white bread
title: Wild Rice and Salmon on White Bread
ingredients: 6 salmon steaks | 1/2 cup wild rice ( recipe below ) | black pepper, freshly ground | 1 -2 tablespoon red food coloring | 2 slices white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place salmon steaks in a medium ovenproof dish. Combine rice, pepper and food coloring in a small bowl, and coat salmon on both sides with the mixture. Place bread slices on a baking sheet, and place under the broiler until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,crabmeat,black mustard seed,tamarind pulp,extra beef,parsley leaf,kahlua,red curry paste
title: Spicy Thai Spiced Beef Noodle With Black Mustard Seed
ingredients: 500 g extra lean ground beef | 25 g black mustard seeds | 10 g tamarind pulp | 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 10 g dried crabmeat | 20 g kahlua ( liquor ) | 300 g dry fettuccine pasta
instructions: In a saucepan combine beef, tamarind pulp, curry paste, parsley, crab meat, kahlua and simmer until heated through. Cook fettucine in salted boiling water for 3 - 3 - 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain pasta and toss with the black mustard seed. Divide beef mixture among plates and serve. Garnish with parsley.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,artichoke heart,radish,pineapple juice
title: Sassy Artichoke Salad
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 ounces canned artichoke hearts, drained, liquid reserved | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 4 radishes, sliced
instructions: Spray a salad bowl with cooking spray. Arrange half the artichokes in the bottom of the bowl, keeping the hearts in the water. Combine the drained pineapple juice and reserved artichoke liquid. Pour this all over the artichokes. Add the radish slices.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,olive oil,coconut milk,heavy whipping cream,cream,red cayenne pepper
title: Easy White Chocolate Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream, divided | 1 cup coconut milk | 3/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground red cayenne pepper | shredded coconut, to serve on top ( optional )
instructions: Whip 2/3 cup cream, coconut milk, chocolate chips and olive oil with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Gently fold the mixture into the whipped cream. Cover and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours, or until chilled and slightly thickened. Serve with shredded coconut, toasted, if desired.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,baking potato,cocoa,pepper,beef roast,white pepper powder,beer,nori
title: Baked Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 5 tablespoons cocoa, or as needed | 1 tablespoon white pepper powder, or as needed | 1 tablespoon beef roast | 1 tablespoon kalamata olives, chopped | 1 teaspoon pepper, or as desired | 14 to 16 prepared nori ( dry seaweed ), cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 pound baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 cup beer
instructions: Mix 1 tablespoon cocoa, white pepper powder, beef roast, black olives, and pepper together in a bowl. Set aside. Lay the nori slices in a steamer basket, and place over boiling water. Bake in a steamer until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Set aside until cool enough to handle, about 5 minutes. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon cocoa in a skillet over medium heat. Dice the potatoes and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon cocoa, beer, and 1/2 teaspoon white pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil.

Random Ingredients: salad green,beef stock cube,grape leaf,thyme leave
title: Tasty Beef Roulades
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme leaves | 500 g good quality lean beef tip roast or 500 g similar lean stewing beef | 1 tablespoon salad greens | 1 beef stock cube, with herbs, such as sachet
instructions: Place the beef in the crock of a large bowl with the herbs. Pour over the stock & mix well. Add more stock if the dish is dry. Cover and marinate for 4 - 6 hours. Remove the beef from the fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Preheat the oven to 180c/350f/gas divide the beef into 2 equal pieces & transfer to a baking tray. Bake the beef for 15 - 20 minutes until it is cooked to your liking. Slice the beef thinly & serve on warmed salad leaves.

title: A Fresh Peach with a Temptation
ingredients: 2 fresh peaches, washed and sliced | 4 leaves fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Put the sliced peaches, sliced leaves of spinach, sherry and freshly ground black pepper into a heated frying pan, add a little extra sherry if using, and fry quickly until just tender about 1 minute serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,sherry,garlic salt,chicken breast meat,orange juice,lime,lasagna noodle
title: Easy Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cubed | 1/2 bottle dry sherry | 1 can or bottles roni grated orange juice | 4 cloves garlic salt | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 tablespoon lime rind, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: beef liver,egg noodle,broccoli floret,pork tenderloin,mint,curd cottage cheese,white flour
title: Beef and Pork Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground beef or 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | 1 egg noodle | 10 ounces broccoli florets, drained | 1/3 cup white flour | 8 ounces small curd cottage cheese | 4 large eggs | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook noodle according to package directions & set aside until cold. Cut meat into 1/2 inch cubes. Heat flour in large skillet till sizzling. Add beef/pork and noodles & saute 4 - 5 minutes or until noodles are tender. Add 3/4 cup water, broccoli & ricotta and simmer, stirring occasionally for 3 minutes. Beat eggs, mint & remaining 3/4 cup water. Stir into noodle mixture. Pour into greased shallow casserole dish. Bake approx 30 minutes. Remove from oven and leave for 1 minute. Serve immediately, topped with remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,italian plum tomato,tomato green chilies,celery
title: Hot Italian Green Chilies
ingredients: 3 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 1/2 cups diced celery | 1 teaspoon minced fresh lemon juice | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Stir tomatoes, celery, lemon juice, and italian plum tomatoes into the skillet. Cover, and bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven. If desired, remove cover for last 10 minutes to brown tops.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,currant,philadelphia cream cheese,oyster sauce,curry powder,kosher salt,cherry tomato,maraschino cherry
title: Curry Cheese Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 large ripe cherry tomatoes | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 packet philadelphia cream cheese | 1 tablespoon curry powder ( more or less to taste ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 cup dried currants ( more or less to taste or just use 1/2 cup if desired. refer notes below ) | 1/2 cup chopped maraschino cherry ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce ( additional to taste )
instructions: Remove stems from tomatoes if desired. Slice tops off of tomatoes and remove seeds, using a teaspoon. Stuff tomatoes with flour, dividing evenly among tomatoes. Whisk together cream cheese and remaining sauce ingredients, adding sour cream to desired thickness if needed for an oozing consistency. Spoon cream cheese mixture over tomatoes. Chill at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,cumin,tomato green chilies,ha avocadoes,celery root,cinnamon
title: Churrascos (Savory Guacamole)
ingredients: 1 large hass avocado, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup celery root, chopped | 1/8 cup light brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dried cinnamon | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: In medium bowl, mash avocados with fork. Mix in tomatoes and celery root. Sprinkle brown sugar, cinnamon, and cumin over mixture. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Moroccan Radishes
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 bunch radish, cut in half | pam cooking spray, for veggies
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine broth with cumin. Cover and simmer over medium heat. Add radish halves and cook, covered, for about 5 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat. Remove any browned radishes from broth and shake broth to remove residual bits from broth. Add to broth and heat until it begins to boil. Heat up oven to 300 degrees. Coat two jellyroll pans with cooking spray. Carefully lay out the radishes with one slice uncut and spray with cooking spray. Place into oven. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. You can also cook a batch right in the pan before serving.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,shiitake mushroom,dill weed,sugar pumpkin,mustard powder
title: Stove Top Mustard Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg peeled sugar pumpkin | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill weed | 3 teaspoons chopped fresh dill weed | 200 g sliced shiitake mushrooms | 3 tablespoons finely grated parmesan cheese | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon sugar ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill / broiler. Cut pumpkin in 1 cm pieces and grill or roast until tender. Remove and place on paper towel, drain off liquid. Mix remaining ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix well. Place pumpkin on a serving plate and spoon mustard mix over top. Serve immediately.

title: How to Make Perfect Pasta Dish
ingredients: 1 bag pasta | 1 can water chestnuts
instructions: In a large enough stockpot that can be covered with lid to start the boiling water on the pasta, add the pasta and stir in. Add 1 can of water or use 2 cans of pasta water. Add can of water. Turn on and let boil for about 15 - 20 minutes, or until water has reduced and pasta is slightly undercooked. You may use additional water to cover pasta if desired. Enjoy.

title: Quick Chinese Beef
ingredients: 1 head bibb lettuce or 1 head boston lettuce | 4 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce. Tear all together very very finely and divide in half. Wash and pat dry with paper towel. Place on two foil lined cookie sheets, cover the foil, and bake at 350f on a baking sheet just for 10 minutes. Cut into 8 equal portions. Remove the foil and slice into thin strips, about 1 x 3 inches. Use a spatula to separate the strips, and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,white onion,pesto sauce,green food coloring,serrano pepper,purpose flour,chicken wing,pistachio
title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1/2 white onion, finely diced | 4 serrano peppers, finely diced | 1 tablespoon green food coloring | 1 can chicken wings | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup finely chopped pistachios | 1 jar prepared pesto sauce
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, saute onion and serrano peppers until tender and soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in food coloring and cook until mixture boils and slightly thickens. Stir in chicken wings and cook until wings are no longer pink, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in flour and cook until browned. Pour 1 cup cheese and 1/2 cup pistachios into the green sauce in the skillet. Cook until sauce is smooth, stirring frequently.

title: Phyllo Rolls (Pistec E Fagioli)
ingredients: 12 phyllo pastry sheets, thawed according to package directions | 1 yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 cup finely chopped yellow onion ( about 2 t. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. In food processor. Process chopped onions into fine paste. Line a large bowl with a damp towel. Lightly spray 1 sheet of phyllo with cooking spray. Place a few teaspoons of chopped onions on the bottom of each damp towel. Spread a scant 2 1/2 tablespoons of chopped onions in the bottom of each phyllo sheet. Spoon approximately 3 t. Onion mixture into each phyllo sheet. Brush tops of phyllo sheets with remaining vegetable oil. Fold corners to center to form a half moon. Press edges firmly to seal. Arrange on wire racks so that they look flush with one another. Bake until tops are golden and crisp, about 25 minutes. Meanwhile heat 2 cups hot water until steam bubbles begin to rise. Carefully remove from oven. Sprinkle with finely chopped yellow onions and serve hot.

title: Chile Con Queso (Chile Greens)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chard leaves, washed thoroughly | 1 large poblano chile | 1 medium onion | 1 teaspoon msg ( to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning ( to taste )
instructions: Chop chile and onion. Put chile and onion in a blender and puree. In a wok or soup pot add chile puree, msg and 2 to 3 cups of water. Stir. Cut 1/2 stick chile and 1/2 onion into 1 inch slices. Add to the wok. Mix thoroughly. Cook 2 minutes. Add chile mixture. Cook 1 minute till hot.

title: Pistelli Di Melanzana (Sweet Rice Balls)
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts | 100 g mini marshmallows | 1 -2 saffron strand, dissolved in | 3 1/2 cups hot cooked short-grain rice, kept hot
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Using a mortar and pestle pound pine nuts to a fine paste. Keep a tbsp spoonful of ground nuts aside. Using a clean bowl with a large star nozzle, crush the marshmallows and saffron strands into a fine powder. Then combine all the remaining ingredients with the pine nuts. Using the dough hooks, mix thoroughly for a few seconds on a gentle speed. Do not over work the dough.
