Grease a shallow baking pan and place the rice balls into the butter, making each a little bigger than the rice balls will take. Bake in oven for 20 minutes or until the rice is golden brown. Cool 10 minutes before transferring the balls to a cutting board.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,steak,tomato soup,glutinous rice flour,orange juice,watercress,garam masala,apple
title: Curried Beef and Rice
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless sirloin, cut into thin strips | 1 cup chinese glutinous rice flour | 1 cup boiling water | 1 tablespoon tomato soup | 2 ripe apples, sliced or 2 apples, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 teaspoon ground garam masala | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 1/4 cup watercress or 1/4 cup spinach
instructions: Season meat strips with garam masala and olive oil and set aside. In a hot pan, saute the onion and mushrooms until tender and starting to brown. Add rice flour and mix well. Gradually add boiling water. Stir continuously until mixture boils. Simmer 20 minutes or until mixture has thickened. Pour into mixing bowl and stir in all remaining ingredients. Cover and cool. Serve as is or chill and refrigerate if possible.

title: Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 kg good quality canned tomato puree ( passata ) | 250 g cake flour | 1000 g consomme
instructions: Mix all of the above together in a thick saucepan until a thick thick tomato cream has formed and ready to use. When you taste the saucepot, it should be ready about 1 hour before the end of cooking time. This will make up to 3 cups/500ml of liquid. Pour the sauce into a jug, and store under refrigerator. Enjoy the rich tomato gravy.

title: Middle Eastern Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons basmati rice ( may use brown basmati rice ) | 1/4 lb smoked ham ( can use more, i have found that i use more )
instructions: Wash rice in a sieve, removing any dust. Shake cloth to remove any excess moisture. Place rice in a glass or ceramic bowl, and add water to cover. Cover bowl and set in a steamer over boiling water until rice is tender and water is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Take cooked rice from steamer and cut into chunks. Place rice chunks, ham, and salt in a large serving bowl. Mash rice with fork or wooden spoon so that it is no larger than 1/2 inch. Add more salt to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Cranberry Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 packages cream cheese, softened | 2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 1 3/4 teaspoons ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Stir the cream cheese, basil and ranch dressing mix together. Stir in sour cream just until blended. Cover and refrigerate for atleast one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: hot water,pepperoncini pepper,red lentil,chili oil,lasagna noodle,bosc pear
title: Easy Peasy Bearnaise
ingredients: 4 ounces red lentils ( red or yellow split lentils can be substituted ) | 4 ounces bosc pears, diced ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepperoncini pepper, minced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon hot water | 12 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Heat oil over medium in a frying pan. Add bosc pears. Saute a few minutes until tender. Stir in water, pepperoncini pepper if using and salt. Simmer, covered, for 5 minutes. Meanwhile prepare noodles and top with bosc pears and sauce. Garnish with extra peppers.

title: Cajun Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup portabella mushroom, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons salsa verde
instructions: Place mushrooms in a bowl and add 1/2 tsp of salsa verde. Allow to marinate for 10 minute. Place on a platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,brine,yellow bell pepper,sirloin
title: Italian Steak for Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin | 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup sliced yellow bell pepper | 1/2 cup brine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot.

title: Mexican Peaches and Chiles -- Party Time!
ingredients: 5 green chilies, whole and seeded | 1 can diced peaches or ( 11 ounce ) can pink peaches, drained
instructions: Cut open chiles and cut into slices. Open the can of pears, drain them and remove the seeds. Using a sharp knife or a food processor, work the chiles with the peaches until all the liquid is drained. If using canned peaches, drain them and use them in tacos, burritos, or in your favorite mexican dishes. Variations, add 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack or jalapeno cheese to the chiles.

title: Lentil Salad (From Eastenders Dieters)
ingredients: 300 g lentils | 500 g fresh spinach leaves | 1 kg lean meat, cut into small dice | 200 g marinated sweet italian meat, diced ( from eastenders ) | 375 ml dry vermouth or 375 ml dry white wine | 250 g icing sugar ( see notes ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Cook the lentils according to the package instructions and rinse until the water runs clear. Drain well in a sieve or colander to remove all the water. Meanwhile, cut the spinach into thin slices. Cook the spinach until it has softened. Drain and refresh under cold water. Squeeze to remove excess moisture and cook in a small saucepan of boiling water for about 3 - 4 minutes to soften. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Rinse the meat, mix together the meat, lentils and the vermouth. Whisk together until the mixture is well combined. To make the icing, mix the icing sugar, sesame oil and sesame oil in a bowl and add the icing sugar mixture. Add extra sesame oil if required to make the icing firm. Pour over the salad and toss to coat all and distribute the icing. Note, if using a wine vinaigrette as i do, you may need to add a little more wine.

Random Ingredients: potato,yukon gold potato,cheshire cheese,flat leaf parsley
title: Potato and Cheese Pierogi (Tequenos)
ingredients: 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, peeled and chopped | 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 bunch fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 container processed kraft zesty potato cheese, cubed
instructions: Place all the potatoes in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two. Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Place the potatoes in a large skillet over medium heat and mash with a potato masher. Stir in the parsley, processed cheese, and 1 cup water and heat through, 6 to 7 minutes.

title: How to Make Corn With Corn
ingredients: 2 ears corn | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Wash the corn and remove the husk. Slice from the cobs with a sharp knife into 1/4 inch rounds and place on a plate. Sprinkle generously with kosher salt and generously with pepper. Place 1/4 to 1/2 cup water into a heavy bottomed skillet over medium high heat and bring to a boil. As soon as liquid begins to bubble, immediately turn down the heat to a simmer. Wash the corn and repeat twice with each ear of corn. Transfer to a bowl and season with kosher salt and pepper before serving.

title: Creamy Tomato Dessert
ingredients: 2 ripe tomatoes | 1 lb icing sugar | 2 packages ladyfingers
instructions: Split tomatoes in half and remove the seeds. Cut each half cross way to form a small ring, and place in blender. In a large bowl, beat the icing sugar with an electric mixer. Add the tomatoes and mix thoroughly. Place a generous spoonful of cream on each tomato half and cover with plastic wrap. Put the ladyfingers side by side in a deep dish. Add cream to coat and cover with aluminium foil. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours to firm.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,green bell pepper,green onion,russet potato,vermouth,eggplant,tarragon,arborio rice
title: Caribbean Eggplant and Potato Stew
ingredients: 1 russet potato, scrubbed, seeded and cubed | 1 large eggplant, peeled and cubed | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 green onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 1 cup coconut milk | 3/4 cup arborio rice | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth
instructions: Place potato and eggplant in a large pot of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until potatoes are very tender. Drain. Stir potato, eggplant, bell pepper, and green onions into vegetable mixture. Puree coconut milk and arborio rice in a blender or food processor until smooth. Stir rice mixture into vegetables. Increase heat to high, bring to a boil, and cook until vegetables are hot and rice is beginning to dry, about 5 minutes.

title: Tasty & Easy Tasty  Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 large red capsicum, chopped finely | 1 chopped green chili, chopped finely | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large casserole dish and mix well. Cover with foil and cook in a moderate oven for about 1 hour or until beans are tender and sauce has thickened up. The dish can be reheated in the microwave for a few minutes if necessary.

title: Cousin Pete's Australian Chicken and Blackberry Soup
ingredients: 400 g beef flank steak ( trimmed of excess meat and cut into thin strips ) | 1 bunch blackberries ( or your favourite berries ) | 2 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 400 ml half's | 175 g quinoa ( optional ) | 3 cups cooked chicken ( shredded )
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the meat, berries and stock cube and pour over the half's and bring to the boil. Turn down heat, and simmer for 2 - 3 hours until the blackberries are soft and meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: green chile,curry paste,red curry paste,pear,cream celery soup,balsamic vinegar,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Curried Pears
ingredients: 2 medium pears, peeled, cored, and sliced | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can chopped green chiles | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cream of celery soup, green chiles, red curry paste, balsamic vinegar, curry paste, and ras el hanout. Cover, and refrigerate to blend the flavors, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer the pears to the slow cooker. Sprinkle with curry paste. Cover, and cook on low 8 hours, or on high 1 1/2 hours. Garnish with a pinch of ground cinnamon before serving.

title: Mediterranean-Style Tuna Chicken
ingredients: 4 ounces albacore tuna | 4 ounces cooked chicken, chopped
instructions: Mix the tuna, chicken and desired amount of albacore in a bowl.

title: Pistachio Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground chuck ( ground pork or veal shoulder is preferable ) | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachio nuts
instructions: Using your hands, mix the ground beef with a bit of rum and rum. Add the pistachio nuts. Mix until well combined. Store in air tight container.

title: Agua Fresca
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon ground caraway | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground espresso | 4 medium tomatoes with green chiles, seeded, flesh removed, finely chopped
instructions: Pour a small saucepan of water over the sugar and caraway in a small pan and set over moderate heat. Stir frequently and until caramelized, about 5 minutes. The caraway should be slightly reduced but the sugar should still be slightly wobbly. Pour a further tablespoon of caramel into a small metal bowl. Add the espresso and set aside. Lightly oil a 2 cup capacity ovenproof dish. Pour the prepared sugar mixture into the dish and sprinkle with half the chiles. Place in the oven and bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until the topping is light golden brown. Remove from the oven and leave to cool and set. Cut into squares.

title: Swiss Cheese Dressing
ingredients: 8 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 8 ounces seedless grapes or 8 ounces black grapes | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 pint fresh seedless raspberry
instructions: Place cheese and spices into a medium bowl. Toss with raspberries and place in refrigerator. Note, it's best to use a sharp knife for the scraping up cheese, rather than sharp mixing it with a wooden spoon. When you have a swiss cheese dressing of even thickness you can store it in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: pappadams,oregano,cream tartar,pesto sauce,spice,soy sauce,broccoli floret,lemon flavoring
title: Creamy Broccoli Salad on Appamoulia
ingredients: 1/2 cup light soy sauce | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon lemon flavoring | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon pappadams | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 2 cups broccoli florets
instructions: In measuring cup, combine soy sauce, sour cream, lemon juice and seasoning.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,dark brown sugar,rump roast,limeade concentrate
title: Lime Stuffed Beef
ingredients: 4 ounces prepared limeade concentrate | 1 1/3 pounds rump roast, trimmed | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 package prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the rump roast onto the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle liberally with brown sugar. Spread 1 1/3 to 2/3 cups of prepared limeade concentrate over the roast. Place the roast in the preheated oven, and bake for about 1 hour. Remove the beef from heat, and slice into about 1/2 inch thick slices. Place the sliced meat back onto the pan. Stir in pesto and return to oven, and continue to cook 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Shrimp and Chorizo in Jumbo Shrimp (Tapas)
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp, cleaned if necessary | 2 cups chorizo sausage, sliced julienne | 4 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Cut the shrimp in half lengthwise. Remove and discard the tail from the shrimp and remove any coral or other matter. Using a large spoon, take out the vein from each shrimp and cut the shrimp away from the back shell, being careful to retain the tail pieces. Rinse the shrimp with cold water. Pat dry with paper towels. Place the shrimp in a saucepan and add enough water to just cover them. Bring to a boil, and immediately lower the heat until they just barely touch the top of the shrimp. You may hear a crackle. Boil for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the shrimp are just cooked and tender. Do not overcook or they will toughen. Drain on paper towels. Heat a large non stick skillet over high heat for 1 minute. Quickly, but carefully flip the shrimp and let them cook for 30 seconds, until opaque and just cooked through. Remove the shrimp from the pan with a slotted spoon, and set aside on paper towels to drain. Remove all but 2 teaspoons of fat from the pan, but leave it. Add the chorizo to the pan and cook over high heat for 1 minute, stirring continuously. Add the shrimp to the chorizo. Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring quickly, for 1 minute. Return the shrimp along with the reserved shrimp juices to the pan and cook for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,french onion soup mix
title: French Onion Soup Cubes for OAMC
ingredients: 1 small french onion soup soup/cheese soup can | 1 vegetable bouillon cube
instructions: Empty soup can on bottom of soup can and put in the cheese soup mix to make a soup soup. Add boullion cube. Cook 1 - 2 hours or until soup cubes are bubbly. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles or rice. The vegetable boullion cube is not required for this recipe. Some of my family members like lots of sugar on top.

title: Grilled Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | 4 slices cucumber | 1 can chopped red chile peppers | kosher salt to taste | 1 pound kielbasa
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat. Cook the tenderloin in the preheated grill until the internal meat temperature, 180 degrees f, is 160 degrees f, and the internal meat temperature is 145 degrees f for medium well. While the beef is cooking, combine the cucumber, chile peppers, and kosher salt in a mixing bowl. Allow to rest at room temperature while you prepare the kielbasa. Remove the meat from the grill and thinly slice across the grain. Place the cooked tenderloin onto a plate and set aside. Pour the beef juices from the bottle into a saucepan over high heat, and bring to a boil. Add the kielbasa and reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: liver,red chilies,plain flour,coriander powder,italian sausage link,red chili powder,rice noodle
title: Italian Sausage and Liver
ingredients: 600 g dried sirloin steaks | 300 g fresh liver, boiled and finely grated if using frozen ( approximately.75kg ) | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 3 tablespoons red chili powder | 3 tablespoons coriander powder | 3 tablespoons red chilies, chopped | 150 g rice noodles | 200 g italian sausage links, sliced lengthways
instructions: Wash the meat and pat dry using your hands. Cut it into approximately 2 cm pieces. Mix the flour and chilli pepper powder. Coat the liver with this mix, then cook in a wok over a high heat until browned on all sides. Reduce the heat to medium and cook covered, stirring occasionally for approximately 20 minutes or until cooked to your requirements. Add the chilies, noodles and sausage. Return to the heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until the noodles are tender and sauce has thickened slightly. Garnish with a little fresh chopped coriander leaves from a bunch on a platter.

title: Rum Spiced Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1 tablespoon ginger, minced | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 orange, rind of
instructions: Combine ingredients and chill.

title: Roasted Thyme Duck With Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 4 duck breasts, in 1-inch slices | 1/3 cup catsup ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon grand marnier or 1 teaspoon orange liqueur | 1 teaspoon toasted unflavored gelatin | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/3 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Remove the duck’s giblets from the duck breasts and set aside. Arrange the duck on a rack in a roasting pan. Sprinkle a little kosher salt over the duck breast and roast in the oven for 15 minutes or until no longer pink when pierced with a skewer. Place the duck back in the oven for a further 15 minutes. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before serving. Meanwhile, mix the orange liqueur, cherry malt beverage, and unflavored gelatin in a small bowl. Pour the soymilk, cream soda, milk, thyme, and salt into a bowl and stir to combine. Serve the duck, topped with caramelized onions.

title: Cheesecake Sweet 'n Easy Dolores'
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 1/2 cups processed cheese cheesecake, cubed ( see note in description ) or 1 1/2 cups kraft singles cheese cut up, cold ( see note in description )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine brown rice and cheese in medium bowl. Place 1/2 cup cheese mixture into each of 6 - 8 ounce ovenproof glasses. Dollop some of the cheese into each glass, then top with rice mixture. Place in oven. Cook 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and begins to bubble around the edges.. If you're serving warm, return to oven. Bake 25 minutes longer, until bubbly. Let cool 30 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Italian Wedding Cakes (Puff Shells)
ingredients: 24 small candied citron peel | 12 thin lemon peel | 12 small white pearl onions or 12 pearl pearl pearl onions | 3 cups dry sherry | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 cups cold dry bread or 2 cups pastry dough, kneaded
instructions: Drain the candied citron, lemon peel and pearl onions and set aside in a colander to drain well. Add the sherry and turn up heat on oven to 400 degrees. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper and grease well. Roll out the dough a bit at a time, and cut out as many cakes as will fit in one sheet. Use a 2¼ inch cookie cutter to cut out as many circles as possible. Place a circle of dough on your cookie sheet and brush top with half of the sherry. Place 2 more circles on top, so each takes about an inch and a half from the edge. Repeat with all remaining cakes. Place a mound of the sauteed citron on top of each cake. Gently fold in the edges with a small cookie cutter. Place on wire racks to drain the excess sherry.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,whipping cream,cremini mushroom,lettuce leaf
title: Cheddar Grilled Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 cremini mushrooms | 12 large lettuce leaves | 3/4 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons whipping cream
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Remove the mushrooms stems, discard the caps and chop the caps finely. Combine the mushrooms, lettuce and cheese in a large bowl. Fold the cream into the mushroom mixture. Place on skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the cheese has melted and the cheese is lightly browned. Serve.

title: Marmie's Easy Spring Rolls on Herbed Glazed Corned Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornflour | 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 8 ounces bean sprouts | 1 -2 tablespoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 8 -12 fluid ounces water | 2 fluid ounces corn syrup | 1/4 cup marjoram | 8 -12 fluid ounces water | 6 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram or 3 teaspoons oregano | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: The morning before, mix corn flour and 1/2 cup water in a small bowl, then whisk until smooth and creamy. Stir in marjoram and set aside. Punch the bean sprouts a few times and leave at least 2 hours at room temperature. Combine the remaining cornflour, 1/2 cup water and marjoram in a saucepan. Stir over low heat until blended, then bring to the boil and immediately remove from heat. Dissolve the cornstarch in 4 tbsp water. Stir a few tablespoons of this mixture into cold water and bring it back to the boil, stirring constantly. Boil rapidly for a few seconds longer. Stir the cornstarch mixture rapidly into the bean sprouts to prevent lumping. Add more cornstarch water as needed. Add bean sprouts to the bean sprouts, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens and the bean sprouts are heated through. Serve at once sprinkled with additional marjoram and savory.

title: Cajun Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken fillets, cut into strips | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Place chicken into a shallow pan or casserole dish. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning. Preheat oven to 200c and bake for 35 mins or until chicken is tender, basting and turning chicken occasionally.

title: Easy Microwave Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1/4 cup grand marnier | 3/4 cup chicken bouillon
instructions: In a small cup, stir together the grand marnier and chicken bouillon. Microwave on high power on high power setting for 30 seconds. Stir and pour into a glass or ceramic bowl.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,jalapeno,white wine,pomegranate seed,wonton wrapper,lemon juice
title: Pomegranate Bites(Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cups pomegranate seeds | 1 lb wonton wrapper, found in asian grocery stores and can be found near wrappers | 4 tablespoons white wine, divided | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup sweet white wine | 1 small jalapeno, chopped ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: First make the wontons. In a small pot over low heat, put the pomegranate seeds and 1/4 cup water, and stir to mix. Leave in the pot. When water comes to a boil, put the wontons in a bowl of ice water and let cool. They will be less likely to fall apart. Place the cooled wontons in a bowl, cover with cold water and stir to coat. Place the wontons in the fridge to chill. Heat 2 tablespoons of the wine, the vanilla and the other tablespoon of wine in a medium sauce pan over medium heat, stirring often. When liquid reduces, remove from heat and stir in the lemon juice, if using, and the vanilla and jalapeno. Place the wontons in a small bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile in a small frying pan over low heat, toast the sesame seeds until golden brown. Keep in small bowl and clean out pan. Toast pomegranate seeds in remaining wine, shaking the pan occasionally. When cool enough to handle, peel them from skins. Set aside. When cool enough to handle, cut off stem end of the jalapeno and remove seeds. Set seeds aside. When cool enough to handle, scoop out the flesh. Use a spoon or two to break the flesh into small pieces. Discard skin. In a skillet over medium heat, melt the butter and stir in the seeds and the remaining tablespoon of wine. Let mixture boil until they open up and the oil separates. Be careful not to burn the seeds stir in the vanilla and the jalapenos and remove from heat. Place the wontons in a flat dish and spoon a little of the cooking liquid on top. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: havarti cheese,orange juice,cardamom pod,meat,sage,queso fresco,fennel seed
title: Baked Meat With Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lean meat,, cubed | 15 ounces goat cheese or 15 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 cup orange juice | 7 -8 ounces grated havarti cheese or 7 -8 ounces grated queso fresco | 4 bay leaves | 2 cardamom pods | 2 fennel seeds | 4 teaspoons grated fennel seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Bake meat cubes in oven until browned, about 10 minutes. Place in greased 9x13 baking dish. Put goat cheese on top, then spread evenly. Layer meat over cheese. Put oregano, bay leaves, and fennel seeds on meat. Pour orange juice on top. Bake about an hour till meat is bubbling and bubbly.

title: Homemade Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 2 teaspoons garlic salt, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Rinse your Arborio rice under cold water.

title: Lamb and Potato Cocktail #5FIX
ingredients: 10 ounces refrigerated potato flakes ( may substitute any flavor potato flakes ) | 3 ounces sliced provolone cheese | 1 lb very thinly sliced leg of lamb ( meaty ) | 2 large hard rolls, split
instructions: Heat the grill to medium. Mix potato flakes and provolone cheese. Slice the lamb thinly across the grain. Brush a small amount of potato mixture onto one side of each slice of meat. Roll meat and potato slices up and secure with skewers. Place on a foil covered cookie sheet and grill for 15 to 20 minutes or until meat begins to crisp. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: onion,american cheese,yellow capsicum,taco seasoning mix,vegetable broth,garlic clove,risotto rice,grape tomato
title: Chunky Rice Stuffed Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 15 large grape tomatoes | 2 tablespoons risotto rice or 2 tablespoons other risotto rice | 1 large onion, chopped | 150 ml vegetable broth | 150 g american cheese, cut into 4 slices | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow and red capsicums
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place the tomatoes on baking paper lined 2 large oven trays. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and bake them for 20 min until soft. Meanwhile, cook rice with chopped onions to soften. Cool slightly. In a large saucepan, pour 1tbsp broth over rice and stir to just cover. Bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minute. Spread rice on an oven tray and spread cheese on top. Bake in oven for 25 min until rice is soft. Stir rice gently to mix through and spread rice on top of cheese. Sprinkle tomato mixture, capsicum and chopped garlic on top.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,tortilla,yellow capsicum,vegetable,mushroom,rice vinegar,milk,italian salad dressing
title: Rice Vinegar Wraps With Capsicum and Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 cup skim milk | 1/4 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1 tablespoon fresh italian salad dressing | 1 tortilla, wrap | 1/2 small yellow capsicum, sliced | 2 small mushrooms, quartered | 1 tablespoon mixed vegetables, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Divide the mixture among the wraps. Place wrap on a cookie sheet lined with baking paper. Heat in a hot oven 12 - 15 minutes or until hot, turning the wraps once or twice.

title: Parmigiana Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans san marzano crushed tomatoes | 5 cups cake flour
instructions: Put tomatoes in a large bowl. Pour 1/3 cup of your favorite cake flour into a small mixing bowl. Add 1 can of san marzano crushed tomatoes into the bowl and mix until fully mixed. Slowly add cake flour until mixture is no longer liquidy. If you make a large quantity of sauce, you can make 1 can of tomato paste and stir it into the mixture. If you bake it to 1 week, wait 30 minutes and add. If it's made as individual portions, bake it for a couple hours and check to make sure it isn't over done. You can eat this warm, but i like my sauce hot. Use for flavoring. You can also use half a bottle of pasta sauce. Add 1 tablespoon of parmesan cheese for flavor.

title: Pesto French Fries
ingredients: 6 -8 medium white potatoes, scrubbed and boiled until tender | 3 tablespoons light pesto sauce
instructions: While potatoes are still hot, cut them in half lengthwise and then crosswise so they stay together in the pan. Add pesto and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Fennel and Sage Bean Soup
ingredients: 6 large stalks trimmed fennel bulbs | 2 cups dried kidney beans | 1/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaf | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 2 cups light cream | 1/2 cup unsweetened horseradish-flavored light sour cream
instructions: Place fennel bulb and kidney beans in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart pan.

title: Grilled Pepper Lettuce
ingredients: 1/2 yellow bell pepper | 2 leaves leaf lettuce
instructions: Trim the ends off the yellow bell pepper. Cut the pepper away from the seed core, cut off a thin layer of green pith, removing as many of the core as possible. Rinse. Place the pepper on a cutting board and cut into 1 1/2 inch thick pieces. Tie the pepper in a piece of butcher's twine with a toothpick. Grill the pepper pieces and toothpicks over direct medium high heat, turning frequently, for about 7 minutes, or until slightly charred but still slightly crisp in the center. Place the pepper on a platter for about 10 to 15 minutes to crisp if desired. Place a few pieces of lettuce on a serving plate and spoon some of the grilled pepper over them.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,rice wine vinegar,kaffir lime leaf,button mushroom
title: Aromatic Mushroom Kaffir Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 lb button mushroom, quartered | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon zest | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh lemon zest | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,green onion,coconut cream,graham cracker crumb
title: Chili Pepper Coconut Cookies
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup fresh chili pepper, chopped | 2 green onions, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl combine the coconut cream and graham cracker crumbs. Add and blend thoroughly. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet, and press cookies down slightly. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned. Set aside. In a large non stick deep skillet heat the chili and onions over medium heat. When the chili is just about ready, remove from heat. Roll each cookie into the desired serving size. Place on a paper towel and let cool. The cookies are best when eaten warm.

title: Simple Mexican Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 lb sausage, ground or 1 lb ground veggie | 1/4 - 1/3 cup celery salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix and knead well, form. Bake for about 8 minutes, check to be sure it's done. While it's baking, saute/brown ground meat in nonstick skillet. Add seasonings while meat is cooking. Use as a dip for tortilla chips.

title: Moroccan Garlic Pickles(No Salt)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( crushed ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/8 cup ground dried sweet white spices such as coriander, chille, fennel, and chilies ( not hot! ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine coriander, celery seed, and chile.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,ice water,dark chocolate,rice vinegar,alfredo sauce,irish cream
title: Elegant Irish Rice and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 5 tablespoons ice water | 1 can refrigerated alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup irish cream
instructions: Rinse and drain beans. Place beans in medium saucepan of cold water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse off any gritty liquid. Place beans in medium bowl. Add chocolate, vinegar, ice, and water. Cover and chill until cold. Stirring occasionally, heat alfredo sauce in small sauce pan. Drizzle over bean mixture.

title: Påtze  (Endives With Lima Beans)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups frozen belgian endive, defrosted | 1 lb fresh lima beans, preferably young
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in a 6 cup baking dish and bake 2 hours, turning dish every 15 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: white bread,sun tomato oil,rice noodle,spinach,black mustard seed,olive oil
title: Spinach and Sun-Dried Tomato Phyllo
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach | 1/4 cup cooked rice noodles, divided | 1/4 cup chopped peeled sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon white mustard seeds | 12 crisp slices firm white bread, crust removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cook and stir spinach, sun dried tomatoes, and green onions in a skillet over medium heat until heated through, about 3 minutes. Stir cooked rice noodles, sun dried tomatoes, olive oil, and mustard seeds into spinach mixture.

title: Polenta Bread--Easy Polenta-Soup for the Crock - Cooker
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups yellow cornmeal ( yellow not instant ) | 1 1/4 cups celery, chopped
instructions: Note, if using ground celery for veggie stock you may want to grind it in a spice grinder instead. Use cooking spray for oven and crock pot if you have it.

title: Spinach With Pecans and Pimentos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs russet potatoes ( about 5 medium ) | 3/4 lb spinach leaves, washed and chopped ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons pimientos, finely chopped | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper or a silpat. Line the outside of a 13 by 9 inch glass baking dish with parchment paper. Mince the potatoes and place in a large bowl. Add the spinach, pecans and pimientos.

title: Roti Mushrooms:  the Secret Recipe(Mozambique)
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom stem ( i use fresh mushrooms ) | 3 -4 tablespoons of any type tea, such as earlobe, scotch, or other herbal tea | 1/2 white onion | 1 liter chicken stock, preferably homemade, heated to boiling
instructions: Pound the mushrooms until very fine and leave to cool. You can leave the stems whole if you like. Using a mortar and pestle, pound the mushroom stems until they look all the way to large. Add a little water and mix well. Pour the mushrooms in a food processor and process until finely chopped. Transfer to a bowl or jug. Chop the onion finely and add it to the mushrooms. Using the back of a spoon, add the tea to the mushrooms, then mix well. Divide the mushroom mix among the four serving glasses. Heat a little vegetable oil in a shallow frying pan or deep sided frying pan until very very hot. Stir in the contents of the food processor. When the aroma of the food processor is released, pour it into the serving glasses and allow them to cool as quickly as possible until they are hot. This will allow the flavor to develop. Serve immediately, or leave in fridge to cool.

Random Ingredients: macaroni,celery seed,eggplant,green pea,mustard seed,ranch dressing mix,extra virgin olive oil,pancetta
title: Macaroni and Eggplant Salad With Mustard Seed Dressing
ingredients: 4 cups cooked macaroni, chilled | 2 large eggplants, peeled and sliced into long thin ribbons | 1 package hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 cup frozen frozen green pea, thawed | 1/4 lb pancetta, diced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except greens and pancetta in a large bowl. Stir to combine. Gently fold in drained macaroni. Let sit for 20 minutes and serve cold.

title: Sweet (And-Sour) Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 pinch saffron | 6 fresh marshmallows
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Brush tenderloins with vinegar. Set on grill. Cook for 45 minutes, turning occasionally. Remove from grill and rest for 10 minutes. Cut into strips. Remove marshmallows from their giblets and reserve. Using the remaining sauce, drizzle over med. Grill strips and drizzle with remaining sauce. Serve.

title: Pork and Spinach
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon chopped chinese cabbage | 5 slices lean pork chops, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 1/4 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Prepare grill for high heat. In a bowl, mix spinach and cabbage. Add pork. Add juices, but stir well with the spinach mixture. Grill 2 - 3 minutes, or until pork is cooked.

Random Ingredients: green bean,pickling cucumber,wheat flour,green pea,coconut,fruit jam
title: Coconut Cornbread Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 2 cups shredded fresh coconut ( a fine, unsweetened kind of shred from coconut milk can be obtained at most indian baker's ) | 3 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup chopped green pea | 1/3 cup chopped pickling cucumbers ( about 1-inch slices ) | 3/4 teaspoon fruit jam, or ( 1 ounce ) vegetable flavor jam | chopped fresh flat-leaf green cucumbers ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place shredded coconut in a bowl. Combine flour, pea, cucumber, and jam in another bowl. Stir flour mixture into coconut. Cut in coconut gradually with a fork. Mix well.

title: Smokey Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces quick-cooking grain rice | 1/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Place rice in a 1 quart microwave safe bowl or in a 2 cup measuring cup or 2 quart measuring cup, coated with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,red curry paste,veal,vanilla syrup,turmeric powder,peel
title: Kalam Pedas
ingredients: 1/4 kg veal, thinly sliced | 1/2 kg brussels sprout | 1 small red curry paste | 500 ml vanilla flavored syrup | 1/4 kg turmeric powder | 100 g roasted peels
instructions: Marinate the veal with turmeric powder for 20 - 30 minutes add the vanilla syrup and set aside for 3 hours. Remove the veal from the marinade and discard the solids. Mix everything well and let set until it turns light brown. Add the veal in and marinate for another 4 hours. Heat the marinade for 30 minutes and cook till tender. Serve hot.

title: Sukiyaki Shrimp
ingredients: 24 -30 small shrimp, shelled | 2 -3 cm gingerroot, minced
instructions: Rinse shrimp and let dry. Mix together ingredients and marinade about 15 minutes. Cook in a pan with low fat cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,prosciutto,tarragon,extra virgin olive oil,vodka,white radish,turkey
title: Gnocchi di Marmellata (Italian Thanksgiving Turkey Dogs): the Secret Recipe
ingredients: 16 ounces ground turkey | 16 ounces fresh sliced white radishes, preferably from the deli ( about 1/2 ) | 4 ounces prosciutto, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1/2 cup vodka | 3 teaspoons minced fresh tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a large bowl, mix turkey, radishes, prosciutto, vodka, fresh tarragon and baking soda. Place oil in a medium saucepan. Heat over medium heat until oil is just at the boiling point. Drop turkey mixture, in pieces, into oil, coating generously. Stir, and fry the turkey over medium heat until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,salt black pepper,fig,flat leaf italian parsley,honey
title: Honey Glazed Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon minced flat-leaf italian parsley | 8 -12 dried figs | salt and black pepper
instructions: Place spaghetti sauce and honey in a small bowl. Stir to mix and set aside. Chop figs into 1/4 pieces and add to spaghetti sauce. Sprinkle with fresh parsley. Heat on medium high until bubbles begin to form on sauce. Lower heat to medium. Watch carefully as the figs can burn. You may need to cover entire surface of sauce with foil to prevent burning. Bake uncovered for 50 minutes. Remove and discard foil. Serve immediately.

title: How to Sprinkle Rice Water
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, finely shredded | 1 -2 tablespoon rice flour ( optional )
instructions: You have several bowls ready for your meal. Place lettuce in a large glass bowl with just enough water in it to cover. Refrigerate about 15 - 20 minutes. Rinse and pat dry the head of lettuce. Shred into small pieces. Bring water to rolling boil in a pot. If you would like to use the extra water for sprouts, measure out 2 - 3 tablespoons of the shredded lettuce. Add rice flour to the water in the bowl, a drop by drop, a drop a drop by drop, until the excess water has drained. You will know when to add the more water if it has not. Serve immediately.

title: Russian Blackened BBQ Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup pure chili powder | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a spice mill, finely grind all ingredients together. Place in a covered container and store in a cool, dark place.

title: Simple Microwave Salsa
ingredients: 7 ounces tomato sauce | 7 ounces salsa ( i recommend pace mild )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in one bowl. Add water to thin to desired consistency.

title: Irish Corned Beef in Cream
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( or other cooking oil ) | 1 cup chicken broth ( may use vegetable broth ) | 1/4 cup madeira wine | 1/3 cup irish cream | 1/3 cup slivered almonds ( may add more than half at a time if almonds are toasted ) ( optional )
instructions: Cook corned beef brisket according to package directions, basting with oil after cooking. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Remove corned beef and cut across the grain into very thin slices. Place brisket in a large warmed casserole dish and set aside. Turn heat to medium and add broth and wine. Bring to boil, stirring until reduced by half. Pour broth and wine mixture over corned beef and set aside. Heat oven to 325 degrees. Bake until tender, 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender and a meat thermometer reads 160 degrees. Serve beef slices on large plates with sauce spooned over top. Sprinkle with almonds.

title: Faux Satay Meat

instructions: Combine peanut butter with curry. Add vegetables and mix well before serving.

title: Shrimp Crepes

instructions: Chop mushrooms and peel the skin off the shrimp. Cut orange peel into thin slices. Soak chinese noodles according to package directions or regular directions. Pour onto a plate and keep warm. Repeat steps 8 and 9 with mushrooms, onions and the mushrooms. Heat oil over medium heat. Put half of the crepe in the pan. Make sure it is hot enough. title: Baked Cod With Whiskey or Tequila
ingredients: 1 lb cod | 5 cups tea
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan. Meanwhile, rinse the cod under cold running water and pat dry. Remove any bones and cut the fish into slices the same length as the rings of fish. Arrange the fish slices onto a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake the fish in the hot broiler, 6 to 8 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. title: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 cups warm water | 2 active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups strong whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 cups cake flour
instructions: Stir warm water and yeast together until yeast is dissolved. In a large bowl, stir together flours, 1 cup at a time, until dough is slightly sticky. Turn dough onto floured surface. Knead until soft and elastic, about 6 minutes. Place in a large, lightly oiled bowl, and turn to coat. Cover bowl with a damp cloth, and let dough rise in a warm place until double in volume, about 20 minutes. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and divide dough into two pieces. Roll each piece into a rectangle 8x12 inches on an unfloured surface. Roll dough into a 10 inch thick, narrow pretzel. Place rectangles on a greased baking sheet, and cover. Let rise for 15 minutes. Punch dough down, and transfer to a floured surface. Roll dough into a 14 inch long rectangle, then fold into thirds. Press dough firmly together to seal the edges. Repeat with remaining half dough, placing each on the prepared baking sheet, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise about 40 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.

title: Chile-Radish Burritos
ingredients: 6 large radishes | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 12 tortillas, warmed | 1/2 cup mandarin oranges, peeled and diced ( reserve the juice ) | 2 poblano chiles, quartered, seeded, diced
instructions: To make the burritos spread tortillas, place 2 radishes over the tortillas. Sprinkle with 2 tbsp vanilla sugar. Spoon 1 tbsp mandarin juice over the radishes and roll up. Secure with a toothpick and set aside. Repeat with remaining radishes. To make the salsa, place the orange, poblano chile, and 3 tbsp water in a medium saucepan and cover. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the chile is tender crisp, about 20 minutes. Spoon 1/3 cup of the tomato salsa over the roll, reserving the remaining salsa for basting later if desired.

instructions: Heat peanut oil in a small skillet over medium heat. To the hot oil in the skillet, add the dry milk powder and beef bouillon. Mix briefly then bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to sit for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: My Mother's Harira

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place rice in 1 cup of warm water, and cover to keep warm. Place lamb in a large roasting pan. instructions: Brown and drain ground beef over medium heat in a nonstick pan or wok. When meat is nearly done, mix in sesame oil and season with salt and pepper. Add cooked fettuccine. Serve hot.

instructions: Cook peas to al dente stage according to package directions. While peas are cooking, in a large bowl, combine the sauce ingredients. Put 4 or 5 ladyfingers on each bottom half of your serving bowls or on 4 whole wheat tortillas, cut side down. Place the filled bowls on a plate, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to serve. To serve, ladle soup into bowls and float 1 or 2 pistachios on top. Variation, instead of pistachios, sprinkle the pistachios on top of each serving.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,angel hair pasta,saffron,green lentil
title: Green Lentil and Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 1 package fresh green lentils, rinsed | 1 package uncooked angel hair pasta | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the noodles and cook for 2 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,dulce de leche,mustard seed,red chilies,cooking oil
title: Spicy Curried Dipping Sauce  (Thai)
ingredients: 1/8 cup chinese mustard seeds | 250 ml cooking oil | 4 large red chilies, finely sliced | 3 tablespoons mild curry paste | 1 tablespoon dulce de leche
instructions: Crush the mustard seeds with a mortar and pestle or in a spice grinder. Grind the toasted mustard seeds with the hot oil very well. Remove the seeds from the food processor but do not process into fine powder. The idea is to leave a trail in the processor. Add the curry paste along with the dulce de leche. Blend all ingredients together very well. Use with fish.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,matzo cake meal,pumpkin pie spice,salmon,balsamic vinegar,bean,cornflour,cayenne
title: Low Fat, Low Cal Cheater Pumpkin and Salmon Cake
ingredients: 1 packet lemon zest | 350 g canned pumpkin pie spice | 50 g cornflour | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 140 g fat free refried beans | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 35 45 g raw fat free matzo cake meal
instructions: Heat oven to 200oc. Mix the lemons, pumpkin spice and cornflour together in a large bowl. Add the cayenne. Stir to combine. Mix the beans with the balsamic vinegar and set aside. Stir together the matzo cake meal and the pumpkin spice mix in a large bowl and set aside. Spread a little olive oil into the baking tin or baking tray, sprinkle with some of the matza meal. Bake the cake for 30 minutes or until golden brown and the loaf is firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Cut into 12 slices and serve with the nutty pumpkin and a salad of tomatoes and beans.

title: Ww 7 Points - Italian Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup flour | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 4 medium grape tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 4 lettuce leaves
instructions: To make the dressing, whisk the flour, vinegar, celery and tomatoes in a small bowl to blend. Gently stir in the dressing. Serve the salad garnished with the lettuce.

title: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 5 cups vegetables, cut fresh, such as baby carrots, broccoli, green beans and turnip greens, in 2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Position oven rack and rack in bottom third of oven. Preheat oven to 450°f place vegetables in large roasting pan and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoons salt. Roast vegetables until tender and shiny, about 20 minutes. Cool slightly. Arrange vegetables on serving platter and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Taro & Mango Chutney Pickles
ingredients: 500 g taro root, peeled and cut into 3 cm. slices | 1 tablespoon roasted coriander seed, crushed | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place taro root in a large saucepan. Cover with boiling water. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 10 - 12 minutes until tender. Drain and rinse with cold water. Place in a bowl and mash or press with a potato masher until the mixture is of coarse paste, add a little more water if needed. Combine the coriander seeds, mango chutney and lemon juice and mix well. Place the mixture in the jars and store in the fridge until needed.

title: Lentils with Pear and Bread
ingredients: 16 ounces lentils | 4 4 slices italian bread or 4 slices ciabatta | 4 pears ( use ripe, if they are not ripe, i can see how many )
instructions: Rinse lentils under cold water until you see how sticky or runny they will be. Place lentils in colander, and rinse under cold running water until your finger leaves the side easily. If the lentils are not already soaked, place in a pot. Add water to just cover the lentils.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,hot chili pepper,italian bread,yogurt,beef chuck,dark soy sauce,cheese tortellini
title: Tortellini with Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck or 1 1/2 lbs cross-cut veal loin | 6 ounces plain greek yogurt or 6 ounces sheep's milk yogurt | hot chili pepper, to taste | 6 ounces cheese tortellini | 3 3/4 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 loaf italian sandwich roll ( such as wonder bread )
instructions: Cut meat into thin bite size strips using scissors. Marinate in 4 oz. Dry type liquid and 1 cup of plain yogurt mixed with 1 1/2 t. Hot chili powder. Soak tortellini in water to cover until limp, about 15 minutes. Drain well and put aside. Slice cheese tortellini into 1/8s. Thick slices. Pour about 2 t. Yogurt sauce in a large bowl over low heat and let simmer at least 5 minutes, stirring from time to time. To serve, put a piece of cheese tortellini inside each of 8 dinner plates. Top with meat, yogurt sauce, chili peppers, tortellini and top with warm cheese tortellini. Serve remaining sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,sugar pumpkin,butternut squash,matzo cake meal,lentil,bell pepper,pita bread,szechwan pepper
title: Pumpkin & Lentil Baked With Pumpkin (Shanghai Style)
ingredients: 2 pita bread, round ( or regular size store bought ) | 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 3/4 lb butternut squash, peeled ( not peeled ) | 3/4 lb butternut squash, sliced ( not peeled ) | 1 bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup lentils | 1/2 cup sugar pumpkin ( or your favorite pumpkin ) | 1 -2 teaspoon szechwan pepper ( optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon fresh ground sichuan pepper ( optional )
instructions: Bake pita or regular size flatbread pieces in a very hot oven until just beginning to brown. Spread generously with butter. While bread is grilling, peel butternut squash and cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Preheat oven to 425°f. Cook lentils in 2 - 2 1/2 cups water over medium heat, until just tender. If using pumpkin then cook until tender. If you like your pumpkin thinner then 2 cups, you can leave out the seeds. If you desire more liquid, add liquid up to 1/2 cup. Drain and set aside. If using squash, you must cut into 2 inch cubes. Spread lentils/pumpkin/kashmiri mixture evenly over 1 1/2 cups of the bread, pressing down gently. Add cubed butternut squash and bell pepper to bread mixture. Spread mixture evenly over butternut squash mixture. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes until bread is browned. Spread pumpkin/broth over butternut/kashmiri mixture, again pressing down very lightly. Place the top of the buns on top of the buns, then place under the broiler for 1 - 2 minutes to brown the tops. You may need to place a sheet of foil over the top of the buns so it doesn't burn. Remove from oven and cut into pieces. Serve immediately, cut in squares.

title: Creamy Salmon and Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 250 g linguine | 500 g salmon | 300 g chickpeas
instructions: Cook linguine as per package directions. Drain the pasta and put it back in the pot. Slice the salmon and fry until golden brown on both sides in a frying pan. Dab salmon and chickpeas into the pot with the soup. Bake pasta according to directions. Drain pasta and place on top of the soup and chickpeas. Sauce for salmon and chickpeas is great. You can add a dash of sriracha sauce if you like this.

title: Breadsticks (Ma'amoul)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons flour | 1/2 teaspoon tomato paste ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Mix flour and tomato paste. Melt peanut butter over low heat. Add to flour mixture and mix well.

title: Quick Asparagus Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the asparagus in a medium baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until tender. Remove from the oven, and season with taco seasoning. Serve with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,curry powder,picante sauce,red chili pepper
title: Spicy Mexican Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce, mild | 4 dried thyme sprigs | 3 tablespoons mild curry powder | 1 teaspoon dry crushed red chili pepper
instructions: In medium bowl, combine picante sauce, thyme, curry powder and chili pepper. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: beet,vegetable oil,hazelnut,corn oil,garlic clove,corn tortilla,poppy seed
title: Hazelnut-Poppy Seed Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 8 ounces raw hazelnuts, shelled and skinned ( about 2 cups ) | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 large corn tortillas ( about 20 tortillas total ) | 2 teaspoons corn oil, divided | 2 teaspoons raw ground hazelnuts, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place hazelnuts in a food processor and chop until all of the nuts are small coarsely ground. Place the hazelnuts in a large bowl with the poppy seeds, 2 tablespoons of the oil, garlic, and 2 tablespoons of the oil.

title: Mexican Chorizo and Rice
ingredients: 3/4 lb chorizo sausage | 1 package long thin spaghetti ( with lines ) | 1 package frozen broccoli | 2 cups basmati rice | 10 -15 fresh thyme, leaves | 6 cups jicama, sliced ( about 2 cups ) | 9 cups brewed tea ( regular, earl grey, or h2o )
instructions: Cook and brown chorizo in large pot of boiling salted water 15 minutes or until no longer pink and drain. Add spaghetti and 2 cups of water. Return to boiling. Add frozen broccoli and cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add rice, thyme, 2 cups of jicama and remaining jicama. Cook and stir until vegetables are fork tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and leave in pot with chorizo and remaining 1/2 cup of jicama. Serve hot. You can also serve it at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,cream mushroom soup,oyster sauce
title: Chinese Roasted Red Pepper and Oyster Sauce Dip
ingredients: 3 large red bell peppers | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Trim and seed peppers, and place in a baking dish, and drizzle with oyster sauce. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes, then remove from oven. Serve warm, or refrigerate, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,tomato juice,heavy whipping cream,banana,maraschino cherry,onion,half
title: Creamy Banana Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mashed ripe bananas ( about 4 banana ) | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups light soya sauce ( regular or soy based ) | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chopped maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine the first five ingredients in a blender, food processor or blender. Whirl until smooth. Pour into a saucepan. Heat until thick. Remove from heat.

title: Seared Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 3 medium turnips, peeled and grated
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Slice the tenderloin into 2 inch lengths. Cook the tenderloin in batches until golden brown and cooked to your liking. Serve the tenderloin with turnip mash.

title: Homemade Herb Stock for a New Year's Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped savory | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 16 leaves fresh dill seeds
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine savory, mustard seeds, and dill. Add enough water to cover half of the herb mixture, and stir until well combined. Cover bowl, and refrigerate for 1 hour or over night. Store in a cool dark place until ready to use.

title: Sauerkraut & Swiss Cheese Scrolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 cups sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spread the sesame seeds on a baking sheet and cook in the oven for 6 minutes. Let cool. Place the thawed pastry sheet on a board and with a rolling pin, roll out the pastry into a 3x6 inch rectangle. Trim the edge with either a sharp knife or scissors on all sides, then lay the pastry on top. Arrange the sauerkraut over the pastry and then fold in the edges. Press together the pastry with your fingertips, then transfer it on top of the sauerkraut and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 425°f and bake for approx 20 minutes or until pastry is golden and sauerkraut is piping hot. Remove from oven, sprinkle cheese and thyme on top and return to oven for 1 - 2 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the sauce is bubbling. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby lima bean,beef broth,bow tie pasta,taco seasoning,bosc pear
title: Picnic Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 can beef broth | 1 bosc pear | 7 ounces bow tie pasta | 1 can baby lima beans
instructions: Spray the crockpot with nonstick spray. Add taco seasoning, beef broth and pear to crockpot. Stir all ingredients together and set on low. Cook for 6 - 8 hours on high or 4 - 6 hours on low. Add pasta and lima beans and cook for 1 - 2 hours more. It is important to stir the entire time.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,hot water,grape leaf,serrano chili,teriyaki sauce
title: Thai Chili Vinegar   Grape Leaves (Larb Grapes)
ingredients: 1 jar grape leaves, frozen | 3 tablespoons sweet and sour teriyaki sauce | 1 1/4 cups hot water | 1/2 cup minced serrano chili | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest
instructions: Place the grape leaves onto a baking sheet and drizzle with teriyaki sauce. Place under the broiler until the bottom lightens in color, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from the broiler and toss with the chili. Place in a bowl and garnish with the orange zest. Serve warm.

title: Baby Bok Choy
ingredients: 3 bunches baby bok choy or 3 bunches green cabbage | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled and chopped
instructions: Wash and trim the leaves and stalk of the baby bok choy or cabbage. Cut each bun lengthwise into eight equal portions. Arrange the bok choy or cabbage on a serving platter. Stir together the ginger and chopped bok choy or cabbage and pour over all.

title: Hannah's Irish Bread
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup fresh minced garlic
instructions: In large bowl, stir together flour, garlic and minced garlic. Stir in dried garlic. Turn out on lightly floured surface and knead until dough forms. Shape into ball.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,buttermilk biscuit,cilantro leaf,swiss chard,orange peel,chicken breast half,romaine lettuce,pernod
title: Spicy Steamed Chicken and Swiss Chard Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup buttermilk biscuits, crushed | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 ounces swiss chard, trimmed and coarsely chopped | 4 slices orange peel | 2 tablespoons pernod | 2 teaspoons dried pinchon peppercorns ( optional or fresh crushed peppercorns ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 romaine lettuce, leafs separated and washed | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, minced
instructions: Combine crushed biscuits, chicken, chard, orange peel, pernod and peppercorns in a medium size saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat then reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 7 minutes, until chard is tender. Stir chicken mixture gradually into warm biscuit mixture. Cool. To serve, place a lettuce leaf on a serving platter. Spoon chicken mixture over and sprinkle with cilantro leaves.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,cod,italian salad dressing,dijon mustard,almond extract,coriander leaf,olive oil
title: Creamy Cod With Dijon Dip
ingredients: 500 g cod, cleaned and cubed | 45 ml olive oil | 45 ml dijon mustard | 35 ml chili oil | 45 ml italian salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground coriander leaves, to garnish | 1/2 teaspoon ground almond extract ( or try almond blossom water )
instructions: Combine olive oil, dijon mustard and chili oil in ceramic bowl, toss until well blended. Add cod, toss to coat and cover with plastic wrap and chill in fridge up to 4 hours. Remove the cod from the fridge and drain the cod well. Combine dipping ingredients in bowl. Dip the cod, then divide between serving plates. Garnish with coriander leaves and glaze with almond extract. For presentation, serve chilled.

title: Scottish Tablet
ingredients: 1 cup dried currants | 2 tablespoons coffee powder
instructions: Cover a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Mix the dried currants and coffee powder in a small bowl with a spoon. Dip the dipped cookies in the coffee mixture.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,black olive,italian dressing,farfalle pasta,sharp cheddar cheese,lebanese cucumber,kale leaf
title: Kale and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian dressing | 10 ounces kale leaves, stems chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 4 large lebanese cucumbers, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced ( about 8 ounces total weight ) | 12 ounces stewing beef, cut into 1/2- to 3/4-inch pieces | 3 cups farfalle pasta ( bow-tie, shells orzo ) | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In a large bowl combine the dressing and 1/2 cup water. Add the kale and cucumber and mix well. Add the beef and combine. In a large casserole dish combine the farfalle pasta, 1 cup of the cheese and 1 1/4 cups of the olives. Spread the farfalle mixture over the top. Cover the casserole and bake for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until the pasta is tender.

title: Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wild rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Cook wild rice either on a stovetop, or in a rice cooker. Once cooked, allow to cool enough to handle. Drain any excess liquid. Combine wild rice, soy sauce, and dark soy sauce.

title: Spicy Steamed Fish
ingredients: 4 flounder fillets | 2 sprigs cilantro, leaves picked
instructions: Place the cilantro sprigs on the side of the fish fillets. Place a steamer in a large pan. Cover with boiling water. Bring to the boil, then immediately reduce the heat to lowest setting.

title: Aniseed Potato Wedges
ingredients: 14 red potatoes, scrubbed and thinly sliced crosswise | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 5 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/8 cup salsa | 1 -2 teaspoon old bay seasoning or 1 -2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheet with paper towels. Place potato slices on towels and cover with a cloth towel. Microwave on high in a microwave safe bowl about 30 seconds or until hot, moving to prevent scorching. Sprinkle with aniseed. Stir to coat. In a small bowl, combine the confectioners sugar, salsa and 1 - 2 tsp old bay or poultry seasoning. Dip potato slices into frosting. Place on baking sheet. Sprinkle potato slices with remaining 2 tsp old bay or poultry seasoning. Bake, rotating pan over the baking sheet as needed, for 20 minutes or until tender but crisp. Serve warm or cold. Store leftover frosted potato wedges wrapped in aluminum foil in a cookie tin at room temperature.

title: Linguini With Edible Miso Dressing
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups cooked rice vinegar ( or white ) | 3/4 cup can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary, crushed ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup miso ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 12 fresh arugula ( or 1 1/2 cups or use 2 bunches of mixed lettuce ) | 1 package linguine | seasoning ( optional )
instructions: To make the dressing, combine the miso, vinegar, and rosemary in a screw top jar. Cover tightly and shake until well blended and mixed. To prepare the rice linguini, rinse the rice and beans in cold water, then drain and rinse. Cook the pasta as directed on the package, then drain and rinse with cool water. While the pasta is cooking, mix together the dressing and set aside to allow the flavors to develop. Toss in the cooked rice and pasta and to combine thoroughly. Add the arugula or lettuce, cover, and serve.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,margarine,provolone cheese,beef hot dog,cornstarch,cayenne pepper,basil leaf,palak leaf
title: Auntie Lori's Braciole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 teaspoons minced palmak leaves | 2 tablespoons margarine, spread in pie dish | 1 lb lean ground beef hot dogs or 1 lb mild italian sausage, browned | 10 soft provolone cheese, sliced ( recommended ( carbonella ) | 2 cups enchilada sauce ( recommended ( cincatore albertson') | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Heat griddle to medium. Combine cornstarch and palmak leaves, stirring to dissolve. Mix in the margarine or butter. Stuff 1/16 to 1/4 of the crumb mixture onto griddle. When golden brown, lay the hot dogs on top, sprinkle with cheese. Grill until cheese is melted and the crumbs are well browned. Place cheese crumbles on a warm plate. Stir the cayenne pepper into the hot sauce. Spoon over hot dogs. Sprinkle on the basil. Pour the enchilada sauce on top or serve alongside.

title: No-Bake Alfredo Cheese
ingredients: 2 packages fresh ricotta cheese | 1 cup finely chopped pecans ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In small bowl combine ricotta and pecans. Mix well. Place on large baking sheet. Sprinkle top with more pecans, if desired. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: carrot,serving cooking spray,parmesan cheese,fruit,leek,dark soy sauce
title: Mixed Vegetables With Chilled Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 serving cooking spray | 1 leek, chopped | 1 carrot, chopped | 1 serving kitchen kitchen twine kitchen twine, trimmed | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce
instructions: Spray a large griddle pan with oil spray. Cook leek and carrot in oiled skillet over medium high heat, stirring, until vegetables are tender crisp, about 2 minutes. Sprinkle with dark soy sauces. Serve immediately with cooked vegetables.

title: Pork Sausage and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 french onion ( thinly sliced ) | 8 large button mushrooms ( thinly sliced ) | 1 carrot ( thinly sliced ) | 8 small sausages | 1/2 cup balsamic vinaigrette
instructions: Place the sausages on a cooking plate and coat them with the balsamic vinaigrette. Cook sausages for 5 minutes on each side or until well browned on each side. After browning, place the mushrooms on top of the sausages and cook a further 5 minutes. Turn over and cook the mushrooms for 5 - 10 minutes or until the sausages are cooked.

title: Mango Bars
ingredients: 1 package chocolate cake mix | 1 cup chopped mango | 1/2 cup chopped cashews
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f spray 13x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Beat cake mix, mango, cashews, and mango in large bowl with paddle at low speed 2 minutes on medium speed, scraping bowl as needed. Spread evenly in baking dish. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned and toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes cut into bars.

title: Lamb Chops With Strawberries & Dill
ingredients: 4 large fresh strawberries, washed, hulled and sliced | 4 red rose's stems removed and finely chopped | 8 thin green cardamom pods, split | 250 g blackstrap molasses | 250 g brandy with dill ( optional ) | 3/4 tablespoon cornflour | 4 large lamb loin chops
instructions: Make the yoghurt. Place all the yoghurt ingredients in a large mixing bowl and blend with a metal spoon. Set aside for at least one hour in the fridge. Cut the chops into 3cm strips and place them in a large shallow dish. Pour over the yoghurt and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight. Drain each time you take it out of the fridge. Dissolve the cornflour in a little hot water and then stir into the yoghurt just before serving, stir in the chopped berries and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,japanese eggplant,red chilies,bacon bit,white button mushroom,cannellini,buttermilk,beef chuck
title: Jerk Sausage Lovers' With Cannellini and Eggplant Toast
ingredients: 6 slices thin japanese eggplants, cut crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices | 1 lb italian lean ground beef chuck | 1 cup chopped white button mushroom | 4 slices bacon bits | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 can cannellini or ( 16 ounce ) can other white kidney beans, drained | 5 dried red chilies, stemmed, seeded, and cut into thin strips | 2 slices crusty crusty italian bread, cut crosswise into 4 sections
instructions: Place eggplant on a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Microwave on high power until very hot but not black and tender, 15 - 20 minutes, turning once. Turn onto a cutting board and cut into 1/8 inch slices. Discard foil. Brown ground chuck in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat, stirring to break up small pieces. Discard fat. Add mushrooms and bacon bits. Stir to coat and continue cooking until mushrooms are warmed through. Add buttermilk and blackened. Stir in beans. Cook, breaking up beans until heated through. Season with chiles and bread slices. Serve with bread.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,water,kalamata olive,guava,pear,white wine vinegar,orange,peanut butter
title: Guava Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs guavas, peeled | 2 cups water | 1/4 cup tomato soup ( or plain tomato and clam sauce ) | 1/4 cup tomato soup, condensed | 1/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup pimento-stuffed sliced kalamata olives | 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon orange rind, minced
instructions: Boil the guavas in 2 cups of water for 15 minutes. Drain, reserving the water, and peel off any black skin fragments. Cut the guava into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place the pieces on a plate or aluminum foil, and set aside. Heat the soup, reserved liquid, tomato soup, 1/3 cup of the vinegar, olives, and peanut butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until heated through, about 1 minute. Add the reserved water. Toss the guava pieces with the soup in a large bowl, and pour into soup plates. Garnish with the orange rind.

title: Naneh Ashta
ingredients: 8 slices pepperoni | 1 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Heat a skillet or fry pan over a medium low heat. Lay pieces of pepperoni on paper towel. Sprinkle coriander seeds over the top. Let it sit for about 15 - 20 seconds before shaking the same skillet away from you, or you may flip a few slices over, spread out, using paper towels as a guide to lift the pepperoni. Place back on cook top until crisp, about 5 minutes. Turn over after approximately 1 minute so the pepperoni will be done. Use a spatula to transfer cooked pepperoni to a large bowl or plate.

title: Corn Relish
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds fresh, or frozen, cut fresh from frozen | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely crushed asafoetida powder
instructions: Place the frozen asafetida into a large bowl. Add the corn flakes and mix thoroughly to coat the entire top. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes to soften before serving.

title: Beef and Vegetable Rolls
ingredients: 6 -8 small cremini mushrooms | 3/4 lb rump steak | 4 cups shredded cabbage | 2 cups fresh green beans | 1 cup prepared prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1/2 lb fresh oyster, halved, about | nuoc nam, sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place beef on a cutting board and using a very sharp knife, partially score the meat with the cut side of the knife. Using same method as for beef, lightly pound beef with the flat of the knife until about 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick, about 3 minutes per side. Cut mushrooms in half lengthwise, then cut into 1/2 inch slices. Place cabbage, green beans, noodles and mushrooms in the bottom of a 10x6 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Place beef on top. Cover with a layer of the cabbage mixture.

Random Ingredients: semolina,oregano tomato dressing,jasmine rice,pepperoni,graham cracker crumb,black bean,topping
title: Topped Arroz Con Salsa Di Riso
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups semolina | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano and 1 1/4 teaspoons minced garlic | 1/8 teaspoon black pepperoni | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese or 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup prepared jasmine rice ( cooked, cold, or hot ) | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the rice crumbs, oregano, and garlic. Mix in the pepperoni, cheese, rice, and beans. Spread the rice mixture on a shallow baking dish and top with the whipped topping. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight, to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,radish,lemon juice zest,vegetable oil cooking spray,lipton onion mushroom soup mix,cold water,baby spinach
title: Mushroom & Spinach Pate
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package lipton onion and mushroom soup mix | 1 1/2 lbs baby spinach | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | lemon juice and zest | 2 tablespoons cold water | radish
instructions: Spray 12x18 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and set aside. In mixing bowl, place the dry onion soup mix, spinach, cream and lemon rind. Pour the 1/2 cup of cold water into the dry soup mix and whisk. Add the lemon juice and heat until hot. Do not boil pour the hot liquid into a small bowl. Add the remaining cold water and stir in to dry soup mix. Spread the spinach mixture over the baking dish in a thin layer. Set aside. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutess. Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown. Serve garnished with radish.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,cornish hen,chile,sea salt,green pea,pearl barley,red enchilada sauce,shrimp
title: Mexican Cornish Game Hen With Shrimp Barley and Chiles
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried shrimp, coarsely chopped | 8 chiles, seeded and chopped | 2 cornish hens, split lengthwise | sea salt | 2 tablespoons chile enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon pearl barley | 1/2 cup frozen green pea, thawed
instructions: Put shrimp, chiles, chili enchilada sauce and barley in a medium bowl and toss to coat. Put hens in a large oven proof skillet, sprinkle with salt, and cook about 5 minutes on ea side, or until well browned and cooked through. Turn hens and cook until warmed through and beginning to crisp. Spoon shrimp mixture over hot cooked hens.

title: Mexican Meat With Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 lamb shanks | 1/2 lb mushroom, sliced | 1 cup macadamia nuts or 1 cup macadamia nuts ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 cup mexican cheese | butter or margarine
instructions: Place lamb shanks in a heavy bottomed, preferably rectangular casserole. Place some sliced mushrooms on top, if using, they must be cut in half but otherwise, use a slice to surround the lamb. Add half crushed nuts and cornflour, stir to blend well until no grits remain. Spread cheese across the top. Bake at 190c for 1 hour, until the top is lightly browned, turn and bake for another 45 minutes.

title: Pesto Prosciutto Prosciutto Wrapped in Prosciutto
ingredients: 12 slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the prosciutto slices in a 9x13 inch baking dish with a paper towel placed on a flat surface. Drizzle the prosciutto slices with the pesto and arrange on top of the prosciutto. Bake for 15 minutes, or until prosciutto is lightly browned and bubbly. Let stand for 5 minutes, then cut through slices to serve.

title: St. Patrick's Day Day Corn Syrup
ingredients: 3 cups light corn syrup | 3 cups yellow squash, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Pour 4 cups water into a 3 - 3 1/2 to 6 quart double boiler over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: natural yoghurt,hot chili pepper,nasturtium petal,peanut butter,salsa,baby spinach
title: Spinach-Nestle
ingredients: 2 bunches baby spinach | 3 medium nasturtium petals | 100 g salted peanuts, roughly chopped | 50 g natural yoghurt | 2 -3 tablespoons salsa or 2 -3 tablespoons chutney | 2 -3 hot chili peppers ( optional ) or 2 -3 red chili peppers, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and remove spinach from stems and spinches. Place the nastrales on a plate and heat in a small frying pan. Place a piece of parchment paper on the surface, if the paper is too thick, just cut a piece of parchment paper into small strips for easy removal. Place 3 nannet's on the paper and cover with a second paper on top to keep warm. Set aside until needed, then unwrap and set aside. Drain spinach and nannet's and place leaves and nannet's in a food processor with half the peanuts, yoghurt and salsa or chutney or chillies and process until the mixture forms a paste. Divide or transfer the mixture among 4 serving bowls. Spoon over the remaining peanuts and yoghurt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,apricot jam,white bean,chicken liver,turmeric powder
title: Chicken Liver Noodle
