ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken liver, finely chopped | 1/2 lb ziti pasta, medium broken into 1-inch bits | 2 cups white beans, washed, trimmed and drained | 1 1/2 cups apricot jam | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: In a large skillet put in the chicken livers, ziti and beans. Heat on medium heat until the onion is soft. Turn frequently, stir often. Add jam and turmeric and continue to heat all together. When the mixture starts to bubble on the surface add a little water, if necessary. Turn the heat up a bit, cover and reduce heat to low. Cook for 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Artichoke & Cream Fool
ingredients: 15 ounces artichoke hearts, drained ( approx 2 1/2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Place artichoke hearts, salt & sugar in a bowl & toss to coat them evenly. Place the balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan & add 2 - 2 tbsp water. Boil gently for 10 minutes & remove from heat. Stir in the cream & heat through but do not boil. Pour over the artichoke hearts & serve.

Random Ingredients: baby arugula,lime juice,red onion,chipotle chile,orange flower water
title: Arugula and Orange Flower Salad
ingredients: 2 cups baby arugula | 1 lime, juice of | 1/8 red onion, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon dried chipotle chile, chopped | 2 teaspoons orange flower water
instructions: Prepare the orange flower water, mix all ingredients together & pour over oranges.

title: Wild Mushrooms in Rice (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups wild mushrooms ( wild chanterelles ) | 4 cups wild rice
instructions: Clean the wild mushrooms and slice into pieces about 2/3 inch in size and set aside. Wash the wild mushrooms carefully in hot water and slice each into 2 equal pieces each. Add 1 c wild rice to water and bring back to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until wild mushrooms are tender. Use a slotted spoon to check them to see if they have fully cooked. Don't forget to stir the mushrooms after 5 - 10 minutes. Use only the wild mushrooms that have done not fully cooked. Use the rice to scoop out any mushroom water that has occurred and add back to the pan. Note, if the wild mushrooms in rice have not fully cooked, they can be placed in a colander over a bowl or container and served straight away. Also don't cook the wild mushrooms until they have no fully cooked or red showing up before the rice is ready and can be easily flaked with fork.

title: Asparagus With Mascarpone
ingredients: 2 bunches asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 fennel bulb, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced, tips discarded
instructions: Place the asparagus in a steamer over boiling water. Cover, and steam over high heat for 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and set aside. Toss flour into mascarpone cheese until blended. Heat non stick cooking spray in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook a few spears at a time in batches. Cook, stirring continuously, for 3 to 4 minutes. Brush the asparagus with the mascarpone mixture, and sprinkle with fennel. Serve warm.

title: Turkey or Veggie Fritters
ingredients: 3 cups cooked turkey or 3 cups cooked chicken, chopped | 1/2 cup peanut, finely chopped | 1 cup cornmeal ( cornflour works well ) ( optional ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients and shape into balls. Refrigerate for one hour or freeze for up to 8 hours. Bake as directed, either in 1 inch frying pan or in individual oven proof bowls or freezer proof bowls.

title: Macaroni with Pesto
ingredients: 14 ounces elbow macaroni | 3 -4 tablespoons pestachios
instructions: Begin to cook the macaroni according to package directions. They will be done in about 15 minutes while the pasta cooks. Add 2 tbsps of pesto and stir well to combine. Taste and adjust the amount of pesto you would love.

Random Ingredients: cubanelle pepper,thyme,italian seasoning,serrano pepper,marinara sauce,pineapple chunk
title: Easy Caribbean Peppers
ingredients: 4 sweetened red cubanelle peppers | 1 can pineapple chunks | 8 tablespoons italian seasoning | 3 slices serrano peppers, or more to taste | 5 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse peppers, remove seeds and veins, and slit into halves, or thirds if desired. Transfer peppers and chunks to a baking dish and sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the italian seasoning. Bake peppers in the preheated oven in the preheated oven until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain juice from pineapple and set aside. Place the remaining 1/4 cup of the italian seasoning, serrano peppers, thyme, and marinara sauce in a skillet over medium low heat. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and simmer until flavors have blended.

title: Ebleshake (Japanese-style processed cheese)
ingredients: 4 slices panko bread, 3 inches to 3 inches long | 1 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Spread some tomato paste on each slice of panko to cover. Place bread on a baking sheet and spread evenly with tomato paste. Top with bread croutons. Let rest for 20 minutes in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Chili Bean, Pancetta & Swiss Loaded Choko
ingredients: 500 g whole grain waxy choko ( long slender swedes ) | 125 g pancetta ( lean and fat free bacon ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 250 g kok choi ( baby rocket, spinach, or baby rocket ) | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs, mixed ( flat leaf )
instructions: Rinse the choko under cold running water. Cut in 1 1/2cm lengths. Heat 1 tbs oil in a large frying pan or wok over high heat. Add the choko and spread with pancetta. Cook for 5 minutes, turning once or twice, until heated through and crisp. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Wipe out the pan and heat the remaining 1 tbs oil over medium heat. Add kok choi and cook for 1 minute. Add bertolli and cook for a further 30 seconds or until crisp. Return choko to the pan along with mixed herbs and any remaining oil. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes, or until the bertolli has melted and everything is heated through. Transfer to a warm serving plate and serve warm or at room temperature. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,english mustard,tortilla chip,tarragon,heavy whipping cream,pear
title: Pear Tarragon Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 large pear, peeled, cored and sliced, or more to taste | 1 pinch dried tarragon, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon prepared english-style mustard | 1 package tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Mix sour cream, cream cheese, and pear together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Stir tarragon into dressing.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,cayenne powder,bread crumb,spaghetti sauce,coconut milk,tofu,cilantro leaf
title: Coconut Crumb Tofu Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain bread crumbs | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 lb firm tofu, chopped into bite size pieces | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed | 1 jar spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. In large bowl, combine bread crumbs, coconut milk, tofu, cilantro, cayenne, dill, and spaghetti sauce.

title: Tex-Mex Bean Sprouts Pie
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 package frozen southwest-style shredded food mix | 1 cup heavy whipping cream, refrigerated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix refried beans, southwest style shredded food mix, and cream together in a bowl. Spread mixture into an 8 inch glass pie plate. Bake in the preheated oven until browned and bubbling, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork,turnip,dark rum,brown rice,broccoli floret,watercress,beef bouillon cube
title: Steamed Lobster (Kao Saeng)
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1 lb ground beef/beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup brown rice | 7 -8 pieces broccoli florets | 3 turnips, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 8 medium broccoli florets, broken into pieces | 20 -24 fluid ounces watercress
instructions: Rinse the beef and beef bouillon cube. Add the 1/2 cup brown rice and the beef. Cook in the steamer over a pot of boiling water, with some flair. Steam until done to taste. About 30 minutes. Set aside and keep warm. Steam the broccoli over medium high heat until just done. Remove from heat and keep warm on the stove. Serve with some fried rice, garnished with watercress.

Random Ingredients: carrot,cost german pork schnitzel,spanish onion,asafoetida powder,parmigiano,parsnip,anchovy oil
title: Schnitzel Pil
ingredients: 200 g cheap thin smoked pork schnitzels ( schitzels, from kielbasa or gebhardt ) | 1 liter of cheap spanish onions or 1 liter of gjetost bitter cured spanish onions, sliced thinly | 4 small parsnips, sliced thinly | 1 piece of a saffron colored asafoetida powder or small pinch saffron powder | 6 large carrots or 3 very large carrots, sliced thinly | 1 -100 liter light tasting anchovies packed in oil, drained | 2 bottles of shelled fresh shelled anchovies packed in oil, drained | parmigiano
instructions: Poke holes with a fork or skewer to let in fat drain off. If using onions, slice very thinly. Cut pork into 6 equal sized pieces or cubes. Heat a good sized pan, add enough oil to cover the bottom or the bottom of the pan, and heat to medium temperature. Test pan with one piece of meat with a wooden skewer or toothpick. It should have a medium to thick crust on the bottom. It should be a good golden color and slightly crispy on the outside. Remove the crust or skewer as soon as it is close to the oil or the oil. If needed, add more oil. The goal is that the oil will not brown. Add a few pieces of sausage to the fried pan, if not use more onions. After sausage has been browned, remove from pan and put them on paper towels to drain any grease. When sausage is all browned, put the pan back on stove. Add more oil to fry the carrots, parsnips and anchovies. When oil begins to ripple, turn the heat low. It will brown in about 3 minutes. The vegetables should be cooked until they are slightly brown. When all vegetables are browned, add the asafoetida which is made by adding a little of the anchovy oil to the oil and heating it over medium heat for about a minute or two. Remove oil from the heat as soon as the anchovies melt. Turn heat to low. Place pan back on stove and put the beer in the saffron. Let this boil for a couple minutes and then pour it on to the pan. Stir this around to distribute the asafoetida. Turn off the stove. Sprinkle with a cup of freshly grated or grated parmigiano. Cover and let sit for an hour or two to marry flavors. Stir every so often. The beer should boil up while the alcohol cooks out. After this time, take the pan off the burner and put the rest of the ingredients into a big pot except the salt and stir them until they are mixed well or mixed with your sauce. Add the salt. Add the salted asafoetida if using and stir and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes. Taste and add more salt if needed. Serve with a bowl of hot crusty bread.

title: Barbecued Clam Chips
ingredients: 1 dozen clams or 1 dozen mussel | corn tortilla chips or crispbread ( optional )
instructions: Wash clams thoroughly. Heat a cast iron skillet or a skillet over high heat. When a bead of water bubbles, immediately remove with a slotted spoon, place on paper towels. Repeat until all clams have been cooked. Pour clams onto a baking sheet, leaving space between them. Grill clams until cooked through, about 3 minutes per side, turning once, or until crisp. Drain thoroughly. To serve, lightly toast or toast the corn tortillas as desired. Turn chips over, if using, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,lemon,soymilk,elbow macaroni,pepper,rice wine vinegar
title: Nembu Bar Laban - Arabic Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 225 g uncooked elbow macaroni | 2 2/3 cups soymilk or 2 2/3 cups soymilk | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | pepper, to sprinkle | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the instructions on the package. Drain the macaroni and return to the pan. Mix the soy milk, vinegar and lemon juice in a jug and stir until it is well incorporated. Pour the mixture over the macaroni and toss to coat. Scatter with the parsley and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: beef shank,cream chicken soup,chili paste,saffron,taco shell,monterey jack cheese,chicken stock,vanilla pudding mix
title: Crock Pot Shredded Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1 ounce vanilla pudding mix, yellow | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( to taste ) | 12 prepared taco shells | 1 lb beef shank | 1 pinch saffron | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, combine soup, stock, instant pudding mix and chili paste. Add beef shank and mix well. Pour soup mixture into crock pot. Cover and let set on high for 5 hours. Meanwhile, preheat grill. Drain meat and discard liquid. When meat is tender, strain juices and serve on a bed of taco shells topped with cheese.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,madras curry powder,red snapper,soya sauce
title: Crispy Red Snapper
ingredients: 1 red snapper | 1 teaspoon dried lima beans | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1 teaspoon soya sauce
instructions: Take the fish, remove any bones or scales and sprinkle with the curry powder on top. Mix well and leave for about 10 - 15 minutes or longer. Place in lightly oiled pot and add enough water to just cover a 1/4 inch over this fish. Bring to a boil and then cook over medium high heat for about 10 - 15 minutes or until done. Serve with rice, steamed veggies, steamed white rice or noodles.

title: Beef Cubes (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef bouillon powder | 1 cup beef stock
instructions: Mix together bouillon, stock and worcestershire sauce. Place beef cubes in crock pot, coat with the sauce.. Cook on high for 4 - 5 hours, then switch to low and cook for 7 - 8 hours.

title: Quickest, Tastiest and Best Fried Steak Rolls You Will Ever Eat!
ingredients: 6 cups plain soymilk ( or your favorite dry milk like milk ) | 2 tablespoons of your favorite cooking oil | 1 lb skirt steak or 1 lb flank steak, cut very thin across grain | 1 tablespoon steak spice | 2 -3 firm small ripe bananas, halved lengthwise and sliced crosswise | 1 stalk celery, sliced diagonally | 1 lb spaghetti ( cooked and drained, or other pasta shape ) | 12 kalamata olives ( optional )
instructions: Stir soymilk and steak spice in measuring cup to blend. Heat oil in large pot or skillet over high heat. Add meat and cook until browned on each side, about 3 - 5 minutes per side. Remove with slotted spoon. Add 1 to 2 bananas to the drippings in the pot and cook over high heat, stirring often, until lightly browned a little, but not as burned. Remove with slotted spoon. Add meat back to the pan and add soymilk mixture and 1/2 the celery, stirring often, until it is thoroughly blended. Cook until meat is thoroughly heated, but not soggy, around 3 - 4 minutes. Do not thicken the liquid or they will all boil out of the veg. Remove from heat and sprinkle with remaining celery leaves and banana halves. Serve with pasta, olives and steaks.

title: Hot Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 red chili pepper, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and use to marinade meat or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,beet,gorgonzola cheese,almond extract,ham hock
title: Gorgonzola Beet Nachos
ingredients: 5 cups sliced beets | 8 ounces gorgonzola cheese, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup finely chopped smoked ham hock | 1 package corn tortilla chips
instructions: Fill a large bowl of cold water. Add beet greens, cover and refrigerate until greens are softened, about 2 hours. Place beets in a large pot, cover, and just cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low. Simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, remove beets from water and allow to cool until able to handle, 10 to 15 minutes. Gently squeeze beets to remove excess water, then slice into matchsticks. Toss gorgonzola in a bowl with almond extract until evenly coated. Place a layer of corn chips in a warm tortilla chip, then top with a third of beet greens and 1/2 teaspoon of ham hock. Finish with a layer of remaining beet greens and ham hock. Garnish with remaining corn chips and drizzle with remaining ham hock. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: oat,white wine vinegar,red pepper,jicama,sirloin,red kidney bean,oil,green olive
title: Beef & Jicama Salad
ingredients: 3 cups of sliced sirloin or 3 cups skirt steaks | 3/4 cup old fashioned oats | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats | 3 tablespoons oil | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 large red pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 can red kidney beans or ( 19 ounce ) can pinto beans, drained | 1/2 cup sliced jicama | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green olives
instructions: For the dressing, put all dressing ingredients in a small bowl. Whisk together until combined. Pour over meat in a baking dish or on plate. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight, turning meat occasionally. Remove meat from the refrigerator to cool. Slice meat into small pieces.

title: Baby Carrots With Spiced Bread
ingredients: 2 cups baby carrots | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh coffee | 2 slices bread, crusts trimmed | 1 tablespoon finely grated icing sugar | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon light tasting instant coffee | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Cook baby carrots in a small saucepan of boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes or until cooked. Drain. Place carrots in a microwave safe bowl. Heat 1 tbs of the coffee and 1 tbs of the sesame paste in a small saucepan over moderately high heat until just hot. Spread on the cut side of the bread. Sprinkle on the grated icing sugar and drizzle with a little extra coffee. Drizzle the toast with remaining sesame paste. Cut into 2 cm pieces. Spread the cut side of the bread with some more coffee. Drain the carrots well, reserving the liquid separately, and arrange the carrot, carrot side down, on top of the toasted bread. Heat the remaining 1 tbs of coffee and the 1 tbs of sesame paste in a small, heavy based pan over moderate heat until just hot. Spread the reserved liquid over the top and sprinkle on the tamari. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,american cheese,lime wedge,ricotta cheese,beef chuck,jumbo shrimp,golden raisin
title: Shrimp and Ricotta
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2/3 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 container shredded american cheese | 4 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place beef in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle beef with garlic powder. Pour raisins over beef. Bake in the preheated oven until beef is crumbly and beef is no longer pink inside, about 30 minutes. In a medium bowl, mix ricotta with american cheese. Shrimp and shrimp are optional. Transfer the beef and shrimp mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread cheese mixture over beef and shrimp. Sprinkle crushed garlic over cheese and beef. Pour lime juice over beef, being sure to cover cheese mixture. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is golden brown, about 45 minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with lime wedges, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cashew,beef bouillon cube,pearl couscous,oregano leaf,brussels sprout,white sugar,fine breadcrumb,tapioca starch
title: Couscous With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 cups brussels sprouts ( the thick ones ) | 3 cups pearl couscous, uncooked | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup cashews ( salted or roasted, skins rubbed off ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons tapioca starch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350â°f. Boil brussels sprouts in water until brussels sprouts are tender and water is absorbed. Drain, reserve the cooking liquid. Rinse brussels sprouts and pat dry. Place in a pot along with couscous, bouillon, bread crumbs, cashews, oregano, and sugar. Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. Cover and transfer to the oven. Bake 30 minutes. If brussels sprouts are too dry, add 1/4 cup reserved cooking liquid to make them a bit softer. During the last five minutes, stir in the tapioca starch and stir until the mixture is smooth. Turn off the oven and leave the brussels sprouts in the pot.

title: Orange, Saffron & Cottage Cheese Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 12 ounces cottage cheese | 7 ounces sour cream or 7 ounces mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon dried summer savory ( or 2 tsp. powder of each ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme ( or 2 tsp. powder of each ) | 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed orange juice | 4 -6 soft whole wheat tortillas or 4 -6 flour tortillas, warmed | additional saffron or cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cottage cheese, sour cream, savory or thyme, orange juice, and ground spices. Add the tortillas, coating the cheese evenly with the mixture. Wrap them in parchment paper or aluminum foil and bake, uncovered, in a 350f oven for about 20 minutes or until warm and crisp. Top the quesadillas with the saffron glaze and serve warm.

title: Spicy Mexican Squash Pickle
ingredients: 6 zucchini, cut in 1 inch diagonal slices | 4 cups ice water | 2 cups ripe italian-style stewed tomatoes | 5 drops habanero sauce, or more to taste | 2 limes, wedges for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place zucchini in a bowl. Cover with ice water, and soak for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. Remove zucchini from ice water, and return to ice water. Press gently until tender. Drain off water and chill, about 1 hour. Peel tomatoes, and cut in wedges. Place in a medium bowl. Pour habanero sauce over the tomatoes. Spoon reserved zucchini over the tomatoes. Serve warm, garnished with lemon wedges wedges.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,cayenne,tomato juice,green capsicum,poppy seed,green olive,cream chicken soup
title: Chicken, Eggplant and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, peeled, very thinly sliced | 3 large green capsicums, sliced | 1 can chopped tomatoes with juice | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup oil-packed green olives, drained | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds ( optional )
instructions: Place eggplant and capsicum in a large saucepan sprayed with nonstick spray. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until tender. Add tomatoes with juice and soup. Cover and bring slightly to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in olives and heat through. Season with pepper. Sprinkle with poppyseeds before serving.

title: Low Fat Roasted Chickpeas and Pear Salad
ingredients: 250 g quick-cooking oats | 150 -150 g quick-cooking oats | 1 jar whole canned chickpeas, drained | pepperoncini pepper | 1 preserved lemon, diced | 1 jar roasted pears, in syrup, drained | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas spread out the oats on an oven tray and toast them for 5 to 7 minutes or until golden, stirring every now and then. Tip out the oat mixture onto a large chopping board. Mix together the oats, chickpeas, pepperoncini, preserved lemon, pears, lemon juice, and cardamom, until everything is coated in the marinade and well combined. Transfer the mixture to a large glass baking dish and scatter with the oat mixture. Bake for about 45 minutes until the mixture is warmed through and the topping is crunchy and lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: egg,chicken breast,queso fresco,beef tenderloin,chicken stock cube,white bean,chicken breast fillet,artichoke heart
title: Chicken Fricassée
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white beans ( canned or fresh ) | 14 1/2 ounces chicken breasts, diced | 14 1/2 ounces chicken breast fillets, diced | 12 ounces cooked chicken breast fillets, diced | 100 g queso fresco | 2 cups chicken stock cubes | 10 eggs, beaten | 1 can artichoke hearts
instructions: In a very large bowl, mix together beans, diced chicken, chicken, cheese and egg until well combined. Add stock cubes and artichoke hearts, mix together with a wooden spoon until you have a coarse mixture. Pour mixture into a large bowl and refrigerate for at least an hour. Cook for 40 - 45 minutes, stirring and replacing it regularly with the remaining can of white bean and chicken stock cubes.

title: Teddy's Croissant Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 1 1/2 cups grated palm oil ( or soy sauce ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 6 french baguettes ( optional ) or 5 sub roll french bread ( optional ) | mirin
instructions: Freeze baguette in baguette for 30 minutes. Slice into 1/4 slices and serve warm with condiments as listed above. For condiments, i usually make my marinated beef and condiments with giandu flavored rice vinegar and red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,red chilies,pouring cream,oyster mushroom,italian sausage,green tomato,bacon,rye bread
title: Mushroom and Bacon Stuffed With Sausage
ingredients: 7 -8 links sausages | 4 teaspoons oyster mushrooms | 1 green tomato, chopped | 1 red chilies, chopped | 4 slices raubergine bacon ( thin slices ) | 1 red chilli green chili pepper, finely chopped | 10 ml pouring cream | 8 slices rye bread
instructions: Mix mushroom, green tomato, chilli, bacon and cream in a bowl. Preheat a non stick frying pan, add sausage and cook till the sausage is browned. Place a slice of rye bread on a plate so the bread will soak up the grease. Spoon a spoonful of the mixture into the centre of the slice. Serve with a wedge of red chilli.

title: Red Capsicum and Mango Chutney Salad
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum, seeded and cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Place capsicum pieces and chutney in salad bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Rosemary & Mustard Rib Eyes
ingredients: 3 heads rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup gold syrup | 4 rib-eye steaks, fat trimmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 degrees f. Line a wire rack with a double layer aluminium foil. Place a rosemary head on the prepared tin foil. Drizzle with 1/4 cup golden syrup. Place steaks on top. Drizzle with remaining golden syrup. Tuck in the sides and roll up the ends of the rosemary to wrap into a tight roll. Place the tin foil on a baking sheet. Bake for 1 hour. The rosemary can now be garnished with chopped fresh rosemary, chopped fresh coriander and/or extra golden syrup.

title: Edamame and Mango Prosciutto Enchilada Meatballs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared mango chutney | 1 tablespoon finely chopped maraschino cherry, rinsed | 2 cups fresh edamame, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 1/2 cups green enchilada sauce | 6 thin slices prosciutto ( thin slices )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the mango chutney, chopped cherries and raisins. Set aside. Place the edamame in a large glass bowl and cover with boiling water. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap until fully chilled, about 2 minutes. Then, immerse the bowl in cold water until completely cold, about 15 minutes. Drain and run cold water over edamame. Pat dry with paper towels and set aside. Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Roll a prosciutto slice in a small piece of the reserved prosciutto just until the slices are beginning to crisp. Cut into 1 inch pieces. Place one layer of soaked edamame in an 11x18 inch baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 the chopped mango chutney mixture over edamame. Spread 1/4 the enchilada sauce over the chutney. Roll 2 more prosciutto slices over the enchilada sauce. Repeat layering 3 more times. Finally, top with remaining mango chutney mixture and then with the remaining 3 remaining prosciutto slices. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cheesy-Rhubarb Ham & Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ham, diced | 1 hass avocado, diced | 1 lb american cheese, cubed | 2 lbs rhubarb, chopped | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the beans. Put over medium heat in an oven safe dish. Broil until crispy brown.

title: Frozen Farmers Market Pinto Beans With Prosciutto (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | kosher sea salt | 1/4 lb prosciutto ( cut into 1-inch pieces, or you may use deli ham ) | 3 leeks, white and light green parts, thinly sliced ( about 4 cups total ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped leeks, white and light green parts separated | 1 tablespoon cayenne | 1/2 cup gold tequila. optional, for garnish on top for added steam ( optional )
instructions: Sort and rinse dry beans. In a large pot of boiling water, place the beans and a hefty pinch of salt and bring back to a rolling boil over medium heat. Boil for 2 minutes. Transfer the beans to a bowl of cold water and let sit for 8 minutes. When the beans are cool to the touch, scrape them out of the water and transfer them to a clean large bowl. Rinse the beans under cold water and set them aside. Heat oven to 300º. Place the prosciutto on a rimmed baking sheet. Cook them in the oven for about 10 minutes. Remove the prosciutto slices and dry them on paper towels. Sprinkle the leeks over the prosciutto, leeks should be slightly wilted, and then season with salt and cayenne. Drain the beans. Using your fingers, gently loosen the top 4 layers from the skins. Turn the beans over and put them back in the pot. Stir in tequila, if using. Transfer 2 ladles of bean liquid to the beans. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours. After the hour is up, transfer the beans to a food processor, remove excess liquid by spoonfuls, and purée them in batches in a food mill or blender to the desired consistency. Serve over toast. I personally like to serve this with grilled onions with tomatoes and green gardens, such as kale and corn or asparagus squash.

Random Ingredients: salsa verde,beef chuck roast,seasoning salt,eggplant,lamb fillet,amaretto,lamb
title: Lamb and Beef Patties With Vermicelli
ingredients: 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 lb lamb fillet, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips | 1 lb lamb fillet, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips | 2 lbs ground sirloin steak | 1 large eggplant, sliced ( or other eggplant ) | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 jar salsa verde | 1 jar chili con carne enchilada sauce ( or homemade )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the amaretto and lamb. Mix well. Shape into 1 1/2 to 1 1/2 patties. Heat a large, nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add patties and cook for 4 minutes per side. Remove, and keep warm. Return pan to high heat, and add the lamb and stir fry for 2 minutes. Mix in the eggplant, and cook for 3 minutes or until the eggplant is tender. Season with seasoned salt. In a medium bowl, combine the sauce and salsa verde. Stir well. Pour over the meat and stir to combine. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,steak,black cumin,mace,raisin,tomato ketchup,cayenne pepper,green
title: Mole Con Carne
ingredients: 1/2 kg round steaks, cut into cubes | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon black cumin | 1 teaspoon mace | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup raisins | 100 g greens, sliced
instructions: Place the sifted dry spices into a bowl and blend together well. Add all the tomatoes and ketchup and mix well again. Cover and place in the freezer. When very cold, add 1 tablespoon of oil at a time. When ready to serve, remove the cube from the freezer. With tongs, remove the meat from the fridge every few hours, and when cold, leave the meat in the bag overnight. This keeps the meat really tender. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Drain any excess oil from the bag and pour into a roasting dish. Arrange the meat on top of the tomato kebabs. Cover with the rest of the tomato ketchup. This dish is best prepared in the oven. Bake in the oven for about 5 hrs or until meat is cooked and gravy is thick. Add the raisons during the last 5 hours of cooking.

title: Toasted Bread in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry white wine | 4 slices white bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Heat the wine in an ovenproof skillet over medium high heat until it boils and thickens, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer the pan to the oven. Place the bread slices on a cutting board, and sprinkle on the wine. Serve hot.

title: Lebanese Chakshoka - Turkish Spiced Tea and Lemons
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated | 4 tablespoons saffron strands, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups boiling water
instructions: Place the lemon peel in a tea ball and pour the saffron and boiling water over. Leave to cool. Remove the tea ball and pour into a glass or ceramic bowl. Leave for 45 - 60 minutes to develop the flavor. Cut into bite sized chunks or smaller squares and serve in a tea cup with or without ice cubes, to keep the drink.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,enoki mushroom,pork tenderloin,cream coconut,flat leaf parsley
title: Ester Motoyaki (Stuffed Pork Tenderloin Rolls in Filipino Sauce)
ingredients: 2 ounces finely chopped oyster mushrooms | 2 ounces pork tenderloins | 2 tablespoons sour cream, to taste | 2 tablespoons grated unrefined white vinegar | 12 ounces enoki mushrooms ( available in philippine asian markets ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: The day before roasting the pork tenderloins, marinate the pork with salt and pepper. Turning the meat as necessary, marinate the pork at least 2 hours. Roll the enoki mushrooms, remove the stems and remove the veins. Slice into 3 lengths and then cut into halves. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking dish or rimmed baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, remove all of the meat from the marinade and slice into 1/2 inch wide strips. Slice the beef into 1/2 inch wide strips and cut each slice into 1/2 inch wide strips. Arrange the sliced meat in the prepared baking dish. Drizzle with the sour cream and sprinkle with the grated white vinegar. Roast, covered, for 40 minutes, turn, continue to roast until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Remove from heat and spoon juices into a medium bowl, discard any accumulated juices. Let the meat sit, covered, for 20 minutes to allow the juices to redistribute. Serve with fried or steamed vegetables and rice.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,lemon juice zest,basmati rice,onion salt,red capsicum,rosemary,vanilla flavor pudding pie filling mix
title: Low Fat Rosemary Rice Crumble
ingredients: 1 box vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling mix | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1 teaspoon salt | 3/4 cup basmati rice, cooked | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/4 teaspoon rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Prepare the pudding with the ingredients and set aside. Combine the topping ingredients. Spoon the rice and topping mixture into a 2 cup capacity oven proof casserole dish. Sprinkle with the crumb topping. Mix together and place in the centre of the oven. Bake for 30 mins at 220°c /430°f and it will be almost firm in the centre.

title: Cheese Biscuits - Biscotti Regina
ingredients: 8 ounces comino | 1 1/2 ounces self-raising flour | 1 large egg | pepper
instructions: In a large bowl mash the cheese with a fork. Add in the egg, mixing until well blended. Add pepper and mix.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,beef eye,green bean,self rising flour,ice,pea
title: Beef Wellingtons
ingredients: 2 lbs beef eye round ( chuck tip ) | 1 lb mixed fresh vegetables ( baby carrots, green beans, peas, mushrooms, mushrooms ) | 1 lb fresh peas | 4 tablespoons self rising flour | ice | shredded iceberg ( optional ) or shredded cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Brown beef well on all sides in cooking oil and drain. Add next 4 ingredients into beef. Cook at 325 degrees 15 minutes. Transfer meat to roaster and cover tightly with foil. Bake 45 minutes, stirring once or twice. Uncover, add 1 cup cheese and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Kofta
ingredients: 3 pounds ground lamb | 1/2 pound pepperjack cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/4 pound walnuts, crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together the ground lamb, pepperjack cheese, and walnuts. Press onto an ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until meat has browned and crumbly. Serve with pita bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,turmeric,double cream,banana,orange peel,wheat english muffin,vanilla ice cream,ladyfinger
title: Dirty Banana Muffins
ingredients: 100 g sweet whole grain rice or 100 g brown rice | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 cups vanilla ice cream, softened | 1 orange peel, sliced thinly | 150 g sliced banana | 300 g fresh soft ladyfingers | 150 g double cream | 2 whole wheat english muffins
instructions: Soak the rice and turmeric in cold water for 30 minutes then mix. Add ice cream, orange peel and bananas. Wrap the englishmuffins in foil and cook on high power for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove and keep warm. Whip cream with a bit of salt. Divide rice among the muffins, and serve with cream on the side.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,grand marnier,sea salt,spinach leaf,pistachio,liquid smoke
title: Spinach Spinach and Pistach Chicken Saute
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry shelled pistachios | 1/4 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 12 ounces spinach leaves, stemmed, washed and spun dry | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken breasts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine pistachios and salt in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,chuck,cornmeal,tahini,oyster sauce,tomato juice,red chili powder,cherry brandy
title: Beef With Cherry Tamarind
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 4 tablespoons tahini | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup cherry brandy | 1/4 cup oyster sauce, plus extra for drizzling | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped
instructions: Mix the chuck, cornmeal and chili powder into a 1 gallon ziploc. Add the tahini and stir. Place in refrigerator. Combine tomatoes, brandy and oyster sauce. Add the beef mixture and cook in a large dutch oven over medium heat for 1 hour. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer for 1 hour. Turn off heat and keep sauce warm and covered. To serve, spread the meat mixture on a dinner plate. Cover with tomato sauce and sprinkle with nuts.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,peanut,lemon juice zest,kalamata olive,chicken tender
title: Pollo al Ajillo (Chicken Skewers)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken tenders, with bones | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped ( or chopped almonds ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns, crushed | 20 kalamata olives
instructions: Cut the chicken tenders at an angle into 2 - 3 thick pieces. Thread the chicken onto 6 - 8 wooden skewers. Combine the remaining ingredients, except the olive oil, in a resealable plastic bag or nonmetal container with the lemon. Add the chicken tenders, turn to coat in the marinade, and let marinate for 1 hour or longer, turning the skewers occasionally. Cook the skewers on the grill or on a lightly oiled hot griddle or under the oven rack for 10 minutes on each side, or until nicely charred and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: ham,pineapple chunk,chicken broth,icing sugar,cilantro,japanese eggplant,flour tortilla
title: Lebanese Wrapped Easter Eggplant(Aubergine) Roll Ups
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants | 4 slices ham ( very thin slices ) | 4 flour tortillas ( or soft taco sized tortillas, about 15 inches long ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 8 tablespoons chicken stock or 8 tablespoons chicken broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons cilantro or 1 1/2 tablespoons mint leaves | 1 can pineapple chunks ( or tidbits, drained ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice ends off eggplants and then slice each slice on the bias into 1/2 inch thick semi circles. Place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and bake approx 18 minutes. They should have nice browned edges and a little crisp. Let cool for ten minutes or so, then carefully remove from cookie sheet and set aside. When cool enough to handle you can do one or two things. Remove the skin from the eggplant, and slice in half lengthwise, then crosswise. Lay out the two slices, one on top of the other, and spread a little of the icing sugar on one side and one on top of the other. Place the slices of ham over the saran wrap, and roll up tightly. When you have rolled all four ends up, dust each with icing sugar to keep them from sticking. The filling should come and be nice and thick.. Place each tortilla seam side down on cookie sheet. I do several rolled ups with this, then top with extra filling for each wrap. If desired, spoon some of the stock or broth from the cans into the pan and heat on medium high until boiling. When it boils, add the cilantro or mint leaves. Remove from heat, then remove from heat. Allow to sit for about 5 minutes, then cut, serve, and enjoy.

title: Caramel Apple Pie (No Time Machine)
ingredients: 3 oranges or 2 tablespoons fresh fruit juice ( juice from cooked oranges ) | 2 -3 tablespoons caramel topping
instructions: To caramelize the orange or lemon, place it on the ungreased cookie sheet. If necessary, you can sprinkle the caramel over the top of the caramel in different spots. Place in 350° oven for about 10 minutes or until caramel turns a light to golden color, stirring occasionally. When the caramel is ready, quickly pour the caramel into the apple pie crust. Use a pastry brush to coat the caramel on the apple pie.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,cooking oat,vegetable oil cooking spray,onion flake,bacon,spinach leaf,italian tomato,serrano ham
title: Italian Breakfast Oatmeal
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped onion flakes | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1 tablespoon dried dried onion flakes | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 cup dried quick-cooking oats | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, combine quick cooking oats with bacon, onion flakes, stewed tomatoes, dried onion flakes, and black pepper. Heat in microwave on high 3 minutes, stirring after 3 minutes. Coat an 8x8 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cover with cooked oats mixture. Sprinkle with spinach. Cover with foil if desired, and cook in the microwave for 8 minutes on high, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,veal,guinness stout,fennel,baking powder,plain nonfat yogurt,tea
title: Beer Braised Veal With Smoked Fennel and Irish Whiskey
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt veal, trim of fat | 1/2 cup beer ( guinness or other stout will do ) | 1 tablespoon instant tea, instant-brewed ( use irish tea or coffee filter ) | 1 teaspoon smoked fennel | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle pepper | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Place meat in a large pan and lightly cover, with a lid. Pour beer around the joint, using the back of a long handled wooden spoon. When the meat starts to color on the bottom of the pan, add the instant tea mix and fennel, and stir well. Cover the meat with a kitchen towel and place in the fridge for at least 1 hour, stirring twice. Preheat your grill or oven to 350 degrees f, or a hot outdoor grill pan, such as a cast iron. Remove the meat from the fridge and place on the greased surface. Brush grill or pan with some of the beer, place under preheated grill for about 4 minutes on each side to brown. When the meat is nearly finished, place it on a warmed platter and garnish with the remaining beer. Serve immediately, while still warm, with the yogurt.

title: Bruschetta with Hot-Brewed Au Jus
ingredients: 2 heads belgian endive, separated into leaves and stalks removed | 1 cup picante sauce, warmed | 1 bulb of garlic | 1 cup coffee
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil over high heat.

title: Simple Microwave Chicken Fajita Recipe
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 - 3 lbs chicken pieces, depending on size
instructions: Open the envelope of chicken boullion on your cutting board and place into bowl. Wash and cut the chicken pieces into 2 to 3 inch pieces. Use your fingers to push the bullion off the chicken.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,plum tomato,reynolds wrap foil,sesame seed,cranberry juice,orange zest
title: Gator
ingredients: 1 can plum tomatoes, drained & chopped | 1 can cranberry juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons ketchup | reynolds wrap foil | sesame seeds | orange zest
instructions: Place tomatoes, cranberry juice, ketchup and cumin in a microwave safe bowl. Heat in microwave until well mixed, about 3 minutes. Remove from microwave, stir in sesame seeds & orange zest. Microwave until oil is hot and sesame seeds are light brown.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,grand marnier,corn,mozzarella cheese,green bell pepper,chili oil
title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 green bell peppers or 2 red bell peppers, sliced into strips | 24 ounces mozzarella cheese | 12 ounces corn | 4 ounces chili oil ( i used the chili oil that i had purchased on hand ) | 8 ounces grand marnier | 1 tablespoon splenda granular
instructions: Preferably, it helps to slice the bell vegetables first. Slice the mozzarella or cut the block of cheese into strips about 2 inches long. Dissolve the splenda with the grand marnier in a small bowl and set aside. Saute the pepper strips in the chili oil until the peppers are soft, about 5 minutes. Spread a thin layer of the grand marnier on the bottom of a 9 x13 glass dish. Cover with a layer of a few strips of the bell peppers and mozzarella. Repeat this layering until all the ingredients are gone. Melt the remaining 1tbsp. Of the grand marnier and pour over the top and around the cheeses in the dish. Cover the casserole and set in the oven at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: tamari,green olive,chili oil,agave syrup,marinara sauce,balsamic vinegar
title: Italian Green Olive Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 green olives, pitted | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1 teaspoon agave syrup | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Put the olives in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil, tamari, sagar, balsamic and chili oil. Chill, then serve with a baguette or rustic bread sticks.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,black cardamom pod,fig,daikon radish,italian bread,tabasco sauce
title: Daklava With Tomatoes and Sugar Nuts
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dried figs, chopped ( in a blender or food processer ) | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon beef broth | 1/2 inch black cardamom pod | 1/2 inch daikon radish, peeled | 1 slice italian bread, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Soak the dried figs in warm water just until pliable. When they are cool, chop and discard any stems. In a large bowl, mix the figs with the tabasco sauce or worchestershire sauce and beef broth. Let stand at room temperature at cool room temperature for 1 hour. Add cardamom, radish and bread pieces. Stir to evenly coat.

title: Grated Grated Scallops
ingredients: 600 g scallops | 10 pieces kefalata olives, roughly chopped ( about 1/2 pound )
instructions: Using 1 tablespoon of olive oil spray, coat each piece of scallops evenly. On each piece, top 1/2 cup of grated grated scallops. Cover and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight, turning the scallops occasionally. Drain the scallops and arrange on serving platter or individual plates. Sprinkle olives over the top.

title: Savory Beef Steak
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut in 4 equal parts | 3 cups whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 5 packages frozen okra
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Combine all ingredients and store in the refrigerator. Cook 1 1/2 hrs.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,shrimp paste,spring onion,baking cocoa,butter,spaghetti,bibb lettuce,pearl barley
title: Ajis Curri's Chilli Barley Shrimp and Pepper Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 200 g spaghetti, broken into 3cm lengths | 150 g shrimp paste, such as sunjag work best | 2 teaspoons dried shrimp paste ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste with garlic | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper paste or 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped fine | 60 g butter, melted | 200 g bibb lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pot of boiling, salted water for 9 minutes, or until just tender. Stir in shrimp paste, sunjag and chilli paste and simmer for 1 minute. Pour in 1 cup of pearl barley and season with pepper, then stir in remaining barley. Place butter in a large bowl, add remaining spring onions, and set aside when finished. Drain pasta and toss in melted butter. Divide among lettuce leaves and top with the hot barley shrimp paste mixture.

Random Ingredients: walnut,feta cheese,ranch dressing mix,chicken broth,lamb chop,tart cherry,mushroom,cauliflower
title: Lamb Chops And Tarts With Tasty Cherry-Walnut Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb lamb chop | 1/2 bag mushroom | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1 can tart cherries ( in natural juices ) | 0.5 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1 can chicken broth | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese ( depending on taste ) | 1/2 small cauliflower or 1/2 small green cabbage, cut into tiny pieces
instructions: Brown meat of chops in skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and walnuts and cook 5 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients together, except for crumbled feta and cabbiflower. Pour over meat mixture and cook until heated through. Pour into small muffin tin pans and sprinkle with crumbled feta and cauliflower. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,lemon pepper,plain nonfat yogurt,white pepper,edamame,green chili,canadian bacon,red curry paste
title: Edamame and Canadian Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen sliced edamame ( or small fresh edamame ) | 1/2 lb plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 dash ground green chili | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 3 slices canadian bacon, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place frozen edamame in single layer on baking sheet, bake about 20 minutes or until heated through. Cool. Remove edamame and slice into 1/4 inch rounds. Combine cooled edamame, yogurt, lemon pepper, white pepper, onion salt, green chili, and curry paste in a medium bowl. Fold in the cheese. Spoon salad onto plates, top with crumbled bacon. Enjoy.

title: Vegan French Vanilla Pie
ingredients: 1 frozen pie crust, refrigerated ready made | 2 cups shredded vegetables | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon fresh sage, finely chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon fresh nutmeg, finely chopped | 1 tomatoes, chopped and seeded | 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In large bowl, combine vegetables and maple syrup. Add sage and nutmeg. Mix well. Pat into bottom and up sides of 9 inch pie plate. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until crust is lightly browned. Top with tomato, sprinkel with sesame oil and sprinkle top with paprika. This is a vegan dish and doesn't really thicken the sauce.. You can also use the soy milk or reduced fat soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,anaheim chili,coconut milk,soda water,feta,ice
title: Feta Cheese Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 4 ounces feta, crumbled, i like this with a little extra light, greek in flavour | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup soda water | 1 small anaheim chili, seeded and chopped ( just a little more to taste ) | 1 -2 cup ice, crushed
instructions: In a blender, puree coconut milk, feta and vinegar with your hands. Add soda water, and chile and process until smooth, about 15 seconds. Add crushed ice and process again. Chill before using and it's a bit pricey. If you want to keep it longer, chill in the fridge until serving.

title: Maple Fried Onions
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked bulgur | 2 teaspoons maple syrup ( optional ) | 1 lb cooked ham, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices
instructions: Place bulgur in a sieve, and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with maple syrup if using. Toss bulgur with ham until evenly coated with syrup. Refrigerate 4 to 8 hours, tossing every hour. Slice onions crosswise into 1/8 inch slices, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,tomato paste,sage leaf,canola oil,crabmeat,thyme
title: Sage and Crab Curry Powder - Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder ( plus more for sprinkling ) | 1 tablespoon ground thyme | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 ounce sage leaf ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons crushed fresh thyme
instructions: Whisk the oil and madras together in a small dish. Add the curry powder, thyme, tomato paste, sage and crushed fresh thyme and mix well. Add crab and stir well. Leave to settle for 5 minutes, then cover and leave to stand for a further 15 minutes to develop the flavours. Stir and adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve with crackers or eat right away.

title: Zucchini With Saute
ingredients: 1 zucchini, sliced in 1/4-inch slices | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat your broiler/grill. Place sliced zucchini on foil and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until tender.

title: Quick Paneer Raita
ingredients: 1/2 cup chilled panir, cut into small cubes | 2 tablespoons light molasses | 1/2 cup prepared marinate sauce, preferably homemade ( homemade is best ) | 3/4 cup frozen ice, thawed
instructions: In a food processor, combine the paneer cubes, molasses and marinate sauce. Process till smooth.

Random Ingredients: chicken cutlet,rice wine vinegar,lettuce leaf,cilantro stem,malt vinegar
title: Simple, Delicious & Easy Vietnamese Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 dozen fresh cilantro stems | 10 -12 lettuce leaves | 1/2 lb chicken cutlet ( i use chicken cutlets )
instructions: Place chicken, rice wine vinegar, and malt vineger in a resealable plastic bag and shake well to coat the chicken. Chop cilantro and add to bag. Squeeze out excess air from bag. Add chicken and shake to coat. Refrigerate for 20 minutes to 1 hour. Meanwhile arrange lettuce on 6 large serving platter. Top with chicken pieces, then top with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,cornflour,jumbo pasta shell,glutinous rice,black pepper,chicken liver,beef broth,tahini
title: Chicken Livers, Jumbo Pasta Shells.. Once Again... Pasta Shells With Glutinous Rice
ingredients: 1 package jumbo pasta shells, cooked | 1 lb chicken livers, deveined ( reserve tips and fat ) | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon jumbo pasta cooking oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon tahini ( optional, recipe didn't say this but it was a guess ) | 1/3 cup uncooked glutinous rice ( soaked over night and drained ) | black pepper, to taste | 1 cup penne pasta ( cooked according to package directions )
instructions: Rinse the pasta and drain them well. In a large frying pan add your livers and heat on high heat for 3 - 4 minutes and then add your cornflour to the pan and stir fry them for 3 more minutes. Add your beef broth, stirring to mix well. Bring to a boil, cooking for 5 minutes, then add the tahini and continue cooking on high heat for 2 - 3 minutes, making sure to stir well after each minute. Add your cooked rice to the sauce, and heat for 2 minutes stirring frequently. Add some black pepper to your taste, and then add in your reserved tips and meat, if you wish. Taste and stir to check for seasoning. Serve and enjoy.

title: Blenkakaer
ingredients: 2 ounces almond paste | cold, cold water | dijon mustard | fat ( for frying )
instructions: Blend the almond paste with the cold water. It will be very wet. Add the mustard and dilute a little bit with the cold water.

Random Ingredients: white flour,bay leaf,honey,malt biscuit,olive,iceberg lettuce,maple syrup,raisin
title: Cornflake Top and Crunchie (Cowboy Crunch)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 packet malt biscuit ( i use betty crocker deluxe soft naturalsons biscuits ) | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1 can pitted ripe olives | 2 tablespoons honey ( or sugar twin or cinnamon sugar ), divided | 1/4 cup raisins or 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon maple syrup ( or honey mixed with 1 tbsp corn syrup ) | 1 tablespoon distilled white flour
instructions: Cut off a bit of the end of the lettuce leaves, if they are large, and discard. Break them into smaller pieces, if large, and put aside. Remove one lettuce leaf from a bunch and blanch until tender. Drain and dry on paper towels. Cut it into 4 equal pieces. Split each biscuit in half, make them a wedge, put one wedge on a lettuce leaf, top it with a good dollop of the cornflake spread or a slice or two of the other lettuce leaf. Place one raisin/sugar/corn flakes and one tbsp of honey/maple syrup in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, put into the fridge for 3 days to marinate. After the 3 days, take off the plastic and put your wok, cast iron, or other heavy bottomed pan, on medium heat, add 1 tbsp of cornflour, stir for some seconds to create a light roux, then add 2 tbsp of cold water. Add the lettuce and raisins or olives, mix together and saute for about 5 minutes. Add 1 tbsp of maple syrup, mix well and add another tbsp of honey, stir. Add the bay leaf or other lettuce leaves to it stir, turn off the stove. Put back on the stove and stir well. Empty the boboli onto a plate or individual serving platter, spread the remaining 2 tbsp of cornflour on top of the boboli, and arrange the lettuce leaf around it. Turn the oven on to 400 degrees. Put the top back onto it, place it back in to the oven and roast for 15 minutes, until golden brown on top. Let it cool for a few minutes on the side, and serve with a dollop of maple syrup and a teaspoon of raisins or golden raisin bread flakes.

title: Lime Rice
ingredients: 4 cups water | 1/2 cup fresh lime zest | 4 cups rice, rinsed | oil, for deep frying
instructions: Pour into a large bowl the water, lime zest, and rice. Stir until the rice grains are well combined. Dip 2 of the lime scoops into the rice and set aside. Heat 1 inch of oil in a heavy pan to 275 degrees f. Fry the rice with the lime scoops until golden brown and puffed up, about 2 minutes. Drain and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,cheese,rice vermicelli,chocolate,baby bok choy,flour tortilla
title: Grilled Beef Wraps
ingredients: 300 g rump steak, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon flour | 2 large burrito-sized rice vermicelli | 300 g baby bok choy, cut into 16 wedges | 200 g grated cheese | 1/2 cup of crunchy plain melted chocolate
instructions: Place the meat and flour in a freezer bag. Print the contents and freeze them. Place them under the grill and sear each side. When done, remove them. Remove paper from bag and place wrap in microwave. Microwave for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 200c. Line baking tray with foil. Cut rice vermicelli in half lengthways. Wrap each half with one leaf of bok choy each. Place a wrap of meat and bok choy between the pieces of rice vermicelli. Mix together the melted chocolate with 2 tbsp of water. Arrange them in the tortillas. Put wraps on baking sheet and bake for 12 - 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream and/or guacamole.

title: Chili's Salsa Muffins
ingredients: 3 cups mixed vegetables ( zucchini, potatoes, carrots, zucchini etc ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 4 teaspoons instant chili flakes | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 cup prepared salsa
instructions: Heat oven to 200c / 425°f. Grease 12 hole mini muffin pans. Place mixed vegetables in a large bowl. Beat sugar, chili flakes and baking powder in a bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed. Add to vegetables and beat till well combined. Fold in salsa. Spoon mixture into prepared muffin pans. Bake 20 minutes until golden.

title: Chili Sauce for Grilled Fish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 cup strained tomato juice | 1 cup mineral water
instructions: In a large pot, simmer the chili paste for 15 - 20 minutes, or until it is fragrant. Add the strained tomato juice and mineral water. Stir as necessary to make sure the paste doesn't clump. Strain the chili paste through cheesecloth or a tea towel lined bowl. Keep the pot hot while you grill the fish, to minimize the escaping flavor of the fish and hot liquids. Serve the fish with chili sauce on each plate as an appetizer.

title: Beef and Spinach Dumplings in Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, ground | 1 lb fresh spinach leaves, washed and dried | 1 pint half-and-half cream | 2 quarts beef stock or 2 quarts beef stock | 1 lb spareribs, cut in half
instructions: Place beef, spinach, cream and stock in a large stock pot, bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 hours. To serve, make balls and steam on top of the pot dumplings until cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,asparagus spear,cooking spray,gorgonzola,caper,lemon juice zest,vegetable
title: Faux Veggie Appetizer
ingredients: 8 large asparagus spears, trimmed | cooking spray | 3/4 cup chopped mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, corn, potato mix ) | 1/4 cup chopped drained gorgonzola | 1 teaspoon minced canned chipotle chile | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon capers
instructions: Prepare and prepare the grill. Place asparagus, cooking spray, vegetables, gorgonzola, chile, lemon juice and capers in a large bowl. Toss to combine. Arrange on a large platter.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,salmon fillet,baking potato,egg noodle,basil leaf
title: Herbed Fish Cakes
ingredients: 2 cups dried egg noodles | 1 1/2 pounds fresh salmon fillet, cut into six inch pieces | 1 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped
instructions: Place the egg noodles in a large saucepan, cover with hot water, and bring to a boil. Cook, stirring occasionally until tender, about 6 to 8 minutes. Drain, and rinse with cold water. Cut the salmon fillet into six portions and place in the pan. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the salmon is firm and opaque in the center, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a bowl. Use a fork to mash the basil, lemon peel, and garlic in a small bowl. Gently fold the basil and lemon peel together in the bowl with the hot cooked noodles. Drain the noodles and serve.

title: The Great Barley Barley Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup barley or 1/2 cup red mill barley | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: In medium bowl, combine cream cheese and barley. Mix well. Spread into ungreased 9 or 10 pie plate. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese when serving. Dot as desired.

title: Pasta with Ham and Cheese
ingredients: 1 box linguine, cooked with drained but not drained | 2 cans condensed low fat cottage cheese | 2 packages crumbled camembert cheese | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 can tomato paste | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 cup dry pasta
instructions: Drain the pasta and set it aside. In a medium bowl, mix together the cottage cheese, cheese, cheese, vinegar, tomato paste, and tarragon. Set aside. In a large pot of water, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain once cooked through. Spray a 9x13 pan with pam cooking spray. Place the ham and cheese mixture into the pot of pasta and mix well. Pour hot pasta over the cheese/ham mixture and toss until the salad is well coated. Cover the salad and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. The best chance a day from serving is to use it for breakfast and dinner.

title: Scrub Parsnips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 package fennel tricolored sweet peel ( peel in strips ) | 4 medium parsnips, peeled and sliced into rounds
instructions: Place seeds. Trim and dry fennel tricolored sweet peel, cleaned of all white pith and core, into a large stainless steel bowl. Add 2 cups boiling water, stir to mix. Let steep 1 1/2 hours. Drain and rinse with cold water. Drain. Preheat broiler. In medium saucepan, place the brisket on a rack and broil, 4 - 5 inches from heat, until well browned all over, turning once. Transfer brisket to a bowl covered with plastic wrap, cover with foil and let stand 5 minutes. Unwrap and serve with brisket flavored with sugar, preserves, german soda or alcohol.

title: Spicy Szechwan Chicken Noodles
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon szechwan pepper | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: To clean noodles, bring a generous amount salted water to a boil. Add noodles and blanch quickly for one minute, or until noodles are crisp, not fully cooked. Using a slotted spoon remove, and drain noodles on paper towels. Add szechwan pepper, oyster sauce, and salt to noodles in bowl. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: egg,tomato green chilies,seasoning salt,anaheim chilies,lemon peel,pork loin,graham cracker crumb,chicken bouillon cube
title: Mexican Pork Loin With Chile Rellenos and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped seeded anaheim chilies ( fresh peppers will also work ) | 2 large eggs | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies ( muir glen mexican style ) | 2 cups pork loin, cut into 1-inch, 1-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 36 graham cracker crumbs ( i use the kraft brand )
instructions: Spray the inside of a 4 quart slow cooker with cooking spray. Heat 1/2 cup of the diced chiles in a 10 inch skillet on medium heat until just softened, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,enchilada sauce,shallot,italian breadcrumb,cream tomato soup,hominy,lime,lime juice
title: The King's French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of tomato soup | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2/3 cup dry italian-style breadcrumbs ( approx ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped shallot | 2 limes, juice of | 1/4 cup lime juice | 12 slices crusty rye bread ( approx ) | 12 slices thick rye bread ( approx )
instructions: In saucepan, combine soup and enchilada sauce. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. In medium bowl, combine bread crumbs, shallots. Squeeze juice from limes, then stir limes into soup mixture. Cut bread into 6 equal sized sections and place on a baking sheet. Top bread with soup mixture. Bake 20 minutes at 400 degrees. Turn bread slices over and bake an additional 5 minutes until bread is lightly browned. Place bread on serving platter, put soup mixture on top and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: prego spaghetti sauce,angostura bitter,prosciutto,italian sausage,puff pastry,balsamic vinegar,lettuce,lamb
title: Clam Patties - Spritetti
ingredients: 12 ounces ground lamb | 8 ounces italian sausage | 8 ounces prego spaghetti sauce, from the jars | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup italian sausages ( sausages prefereably, with the casings removed ) | 1 tablespoon angostura bitters | 1 tablespoon roll pastry ( puff pastry, all purpose, not for dough in the refrigerator ) | 1 large egg | lettuce, to garnish
instructions: Combine the lamb, sausage, spaghetti sauce, vinegar and bitters. Mix well. On lightly floured board roll out each slice of dough to 1/8 thick to slightly thinner. Cut each into 3 - 5 squares. Cut each square into 3 - 4 pieces. Place 2 - 3 tbsp of meat mixture in the center of each piece of pastry. Moisten pastry edges and fold over into a half moon shape. Press to seal. Preheat a non stick sauté pan over medium heat. Brush sauté pan with a little oil and place patties in the pan. Cook until lightly browned, about 3 - 4 minutes per side, depending on size and thickness. Remove and keep warm. Repeat process with remaining patties. Serve with a side of lettuces and a tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,potato flake
title: Easy Peppered Yellow Pepper & Potato Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 bag potato flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a 10 x 7 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Place the bell pepper in a dry fry pan over medium high heat and cook, stirring occasionally until it begins to soften, 3 to 5 minutes. Add the potato flakes to the mixture with a large spoon and mix well. Add the vegetable oil to hot pan. Drop the chips in the pan and spread evenly. Bake in preheated oven for about 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,italian salad dressing mix,italian sausage,cantaloupe
title: Tuscan Sausage and Melon in Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 1 medium cantaloupe | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 1/4 ounces italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Slice the melon and remove the pit. Wash with soap and water. Cut into bite size sticks about 5 cm long and 2 in diameter. Cut the sausage into 2 - 3 sections and put them in a bowl. Add the rice vinegar, and mix it with hands to break them up. Dip the melon sticks in the vinegar. Place them on a foil or wood. Bake on a foil lined plate in the oven for about 20 minutes, or until melon are softened and they are starting to roll. Serve very hot.

title: Tangerines With Shrimp & Fish Sauce #RSC
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon chinese fish sauce | 1 tablespoon canned corn, drained | 2 teaspoons tangerine, flesh chopped | 1 red snapper fillet, scaled & chopped | 3 1/2 ounces cheese tortellini, small | 1/2 cup shrimp, cooked
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise with the egg, fish sauce, chinese rice wine, corn, tangerine pulp & chilies. Chill for at least 4 hours. Cook the tortellini until al dente, drain & set aside. Add the snapper fillet & shrimp to the mayo mixture & gently stir. Add the tortellini to the shrimp & fish sauce mixture & gently stir to combine. Serve over tortellini.

title: Chinese Rice with fruit
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon dried mixed fruit
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until rice is cooked, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,dark chocolate,seasoning sauce,black olive,crescent dough,sage,annatto seed
title: Taquito Enchiladas (Saints)
ingredients: 1 can sliced black olives | 1 cup taco sauce ( like las palmas ) | 2 tablespoons taco sauce, mild ( like harnachos ) | 3 teaspoons ground annatto seeds | 2 cups crescent roll dough | 1/4 cup dark chocolate, grated | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning sauce | 1/4 teaspoon sage | 1 ounce dark chocolate, grated ( for topping, see note )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Toast annatto seeds in shallow dish, breaking them as necessary, until golden brown, about about 10 minutes set aside. Using a mortar and pestle, grind beans. To assemble, lightly moisten hands with a little oil. Place 1/2 cup bean and 1/2 cup olive in center of 2 dough sheets. Bring 2 adjacent dough sheets together on work surface, and gently press to seal tightly. Using a 6 inch star shaped cookie cutter, cut dough into 2 strips. Repeat with remaining dough strips, laying each on parchment paper lined cookie sheets to avoid forming cracks. Prick one side of each cookie with fingers, brush with a little oil, and sprinkle with a little seasoning. Using a sharp knife, cut a cross from 2 opposite dough sheets at 2 inches apart. Carefully pull one corner of each strip off the paper, letting the folded strips fall into the folded strips as they go, and letting them fall into the heated baking dish. Repeat until all of the tortillas have been stuffed. Bake until crisp, about 20 - 25 minutes. Using fork, dip a few enchiladas into hot sauce, turning over halfway through. Continue until all are puffed and heated through, but not browned, about 10 - 15 minutes. Set aside. To make dark chocolate topping, use an electric mixer to beat chocolate, without stirring, in a bowl. Remove dough from pot and transfer to plastic storage bag.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,dark sesame oil,pepper,pasta,mango,artichoke heart,cayenne pepper,corn
title: Mexican Pasta With Honey-Mango Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup cooked and drained medium pasta | 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, drained | 1/4 cup diced mango | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper | crushed corn | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except grated cheese. Set aside. Place pasta in serving bowl, pour over sauce, toss. Sprinkle grated cheese over.

title: Baked Spanish Rice
ingredients: 3 quarts russet potatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 3/4 cups uncooked long grain white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place rice and potato in large bowl. Mix in a large roasting pan. Pour boiling water over potatoes. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake 2 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove foil, increase temperature to 400f. Continue baking, loosely covered with foil, until rice is creamy and golden, 45 - 60 minutes more. Note, if using a cast iron pan, place in a roasting pan with water to cover, about 1 1/2 inches above top of pan. Stir in cornstarch, if desired. Note, cook time reflects 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: caper,tiger shrimp,cilantro leaf,olive oil,romaine lettuce,linguine,egg white
title: Spicy Spanish Tortilla with Prawns
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 2 large egg whites | olive oil | capers ( optional, add more to taste ) | fresh cilantro leaves | linguine, warmed | romaine lettuce
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile, whisk egg whites. Dip shrimp gently into egg whites and set aside, keeping the eye and shape the shrimp as they cook. Cook linguine and toss with drained linguine. Add the prawns and capers and top with cilantro leaves. Serve pasta with romaine leaves and olive oil, if desired.

title: Refried Kidney Beans
ingredients: 8 cups canned kidney beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups white vinegar, or as needed
instructions: Place the kidney beans and white vinegar in a large container and cover with several inches of cool water.

Random Ingredients: chat masala,sesame oil,chicken tender,vegetable bouillon cube,red chili pepper,butterscotch chip
title: Simple and Easy Sesame Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken tenders | 3 -4 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 4 teaspoons chat masala ( or try curry powder ) | 1 red chili pepper | 2 cups butterscotch chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Arrange the chicken onto a cookie sheet or roasting pan. Drizzle with sesame oil. Bake at 325 f for about 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked. Remove chicken from oven and set aside. Boil water. Add all other ingredients except butterscotch chips. Allow to come to a boil. Cook for 5 - 10 minutes or until hot. Pour butterscotch over chicken and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken,cheddar cheese,serrano chilies,ricotta cheese,large shrimp,black peppercorn,raisin
title: Nachos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs whole chickens, cut into 8 serving pieces | 5 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined ( tails on ) | 4 serrano chilies, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 cup raisins | 2 cups shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup raisins | 4 cloves fresh garlic, peeled and cut into slivers | 4 tablespoons cracked black peppercorns | 24 whole unopened cans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a large dutch oven, combine the chicken, shrimp, chiles, and raisins. Toss with 2 cup of the cheese and set aside. In the remaining dutch oven, combine remaining cheese with the black peppercorns, garlic and peppercorns. Add the drained and rinsed chicken and tomato mixture, and toss to coat evenly. In a small, heavy skillet, cook the sliced green onion in the remaining butter over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until tender, about 5 minutes. Place the chicken mixture in the slow cooker with the remaining sauce and cover. Cook on high for 2 hours. Serve warm in warm soup plates.

title: Traditional Spanish Sandwich Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup whole whole wheat bread flour | 1 hard-boiled egg, cut into 8 wedges | 1 can adobo sauce
instructions: Whisk together the bread flour and egg with a fork in a bowl until dough is smooth. Roll dough into a ball, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add the adobo sauce. The sauce should just coat the bottom of the pan, but not line the bottom of the skillet. Remove dough from the refrigerator, and dust with flour, shaking off the excess flour. Add the dough to the hot skillet, and flatten into a 5 inch disk. Cook for 1 minute. The bread should be very hot. Turn the tortilla over, and let it cook 2 to 3 minutes more. Flip the tortilla, cook for an additional 2 to 3 minutes, and remove onto the pan. If not eating right away, store warm in fridge.

title: Jicama With Chili & Water
ingredients: 1 lb sicama or 1 lb potato, peeled | 1/4 cup chili powder | 1/2 cup water, plus | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Wash well the sicama and cut into pieces. Place in a saucepan with the chili powder and 1/2 cup water. Cover with a lid and simmer for 10 to 20 minutes or until the sicama is done. Drain the water from the pan and add to the sicama. Simmer until tender, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,salt black pepper,vegetable,cauliflower floret,maraschino cherry
title: Cauliflower-Vegetable Platter
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret, about the size of an orange, cut into 2-3 florets, washed well and drained | 1/4 cup mixed vegetables, frozen | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 4 dashes tabasco sauce | 1 jar maraschino cherries or 12 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: In medium mixing bowl, arrange thawed sliced cauliflower, frozen vegetables, salt, pepper, and tabasco and mix well. Arrange cherry tomatoes on tomato halves and mound a quarter of the cauliflower mixture around the cherry tomatoes in the center. Sprinkle with maraschino cherries. Serve immediately.

title: Madeira Onions
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red onions, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon madeira wine | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Heat half an olive oil in a frying pan and dry fry the onions gently until golden.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,food coloring,monterey jack pepper cheese,pork roast,beef bouillon,yogurt
title: Chile Con Carne (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 lb beef bouillon | 1 boneless pork roast | 2 cans chicken wings | 1/3 cup yogurt | 5 green food coloring | 1 container shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( reserve some cheese for top )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into crockpot and cook on low 6 - 7 hours. Remove bones and shred pork and return to crockpot. Stir together. Turn onto serving platter and top with provolone cheese.

title: American Chocolate Drink
ingredients: 600 ml dark beer | 1 celery rib | 1 celery rib | 50 g chocolate
instructions: Cut celery and celery into small pieces. Put celery into blender with remaining ingredients. Blend until finely chopped. Pour into glass and serve.

title: Sweet Asian Slaw
ingredients: 11 ounces sweet italian sausage | 3 cups chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup salsa | 1 tablespoon peeled and chopped fresh ginger root | 2 cups crushed ice
