instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir sausage, cabbage, pineapple juice, salsa, and ginger together in a large bowl. Mix in crushed ice until filling is evenly moistened. Spoon filling into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish, and spread out to cover the bottom. Bake in the preheated oven until the slaw appears dry, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,red wine,canola oil,lettuce,vegetable stock,cumin,teriyaki marinade
title: Easy Teriyaki Beef Toss
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup teriyaki marinade | 1/2 cup red wine | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 package frozen cut lettuce, thawed ( or regular ) | canola oil or other cooking spray
instructions: For sauce, combine in a medium saucepan. Cover and heat over low heat, stirring occasionally. Add teriyaki, wine, cumin and tabasco, mixing well. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 3 - 5 minutes, until liquid is reduced. Add lettuce and stir to combine. Cover and heat until it 'crisp, stirring occasionally. Drizzle with oil. Serve.

title: Pimm's Banana Delight
ingredients: 1 pound thick-cut prosciutto | 1 piece a peeled, halved banana, or as needed | 2 whole cardamom pods
instructions: Place the prosciutto in a saute pan and cook under a preheated grill, turning frequently, until well browned and crispy. Drain off any excess fat. Cut the banana into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Wild Mushrooms on Toast
ingredients: 12 slices fresh mushrooms | 1 cup assorted fresh mixed vegetables ( portobello, bell peppers and onions ) | 1 1 large firm beans sprouts | 2 tablespoons burgundy wine or 2 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Place a sheet of heavy duty aluminum foil on a work surface. Place a mushroom strip or two on each foil piece. Arrange mixed vegetables on top of the mushrooms. Cover with a second piece of foil and fold aluminum foil over the top and edges of the wrap. Place on a platter under the grill. Cook 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring once. Discard foil. Serve immediately. Mushrooms are best when cooled completely. Wrap in foil and store at room temperature.

title: Italian Crescents (Lite-Bleu Dip)
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/2 cup lime juice, about 3 lemons | 4 tablespoons cocoa ( or semolina or rice cereal, depending on the taste ) | 1/2 cup scallion, finely chopped | aluminum foil ( about 10 small sheets, preferably nonstick )
instructions: Using a handheld mixer, combine lemon juice, cocoa and scallion. Cover and beat on high speed until mixture is thick and well blended, about 5 minutes. Stir in scallions and continue beating until mixture is creamy and smooth. Remove dip from bowl and allow to stand at room temperature until ready to use. Preheat oven to 375 ° f. Working with small pieces of foil, dip each coated dip half inch or so at a time, allowing each to expand as they dip into the hot sugar, shaking off any excess air. Transfer the dip to a cookie sheet. The dip should be evenly spread and the edges will rest on the foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden and puffed, and firm to the touch. Allow to cool completely on the cookie sheet before removing the foil to cool completely, about 1 to 2 hours, before serving.

title: Easy Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 loaf rye bread | 2 -3 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Slice the bread on the diagonal into 1/2 thick slices. Spread the beans into your crockpot. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Stir in the garam masala. If served right away, let it sit off heat, cover and refrigerate to chill if not serving right away.

title: Frijoles Borrachos Borranchas (Drunk Beans)
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans or ( 15 ounce ) can navy beans | 3 -5 shallots, depending on size | honey
instructions: Drain the beans but reserve a little of the liquid for making the crumb topping and dressing. Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a skillet. Sauté the shallots and pinto beans for about 7 minutes. Add the honey to deglaze the oil. Stir and add to beans.. Heat until the jelly is mostly cooked. Stir to mix well and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,fish sauce,cayenne pepper,rice flour
title: Spicy Breadsticks
ingredients: 3/4 lb rice flour | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( or other chili pepper to taste ) | 2 packets dark soy sauce | 3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Mix well and press into bread sticks or shape on baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 5 - 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,nonfat cream,spice,watercress,sun tomato oil,serrano chili
title: Spicey Sun Dried Tomato Sauce for Salmon or Chops
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and cut in half | 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream ( or regular yogurt ) or 1/3 cup low fat greek yogurt, stirred until smooth | 1/4 cup zesty dried mixed spice | 2 serrano chili, stemmed seeded and finely minced | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, minced | 2 tablespoons watercress, chopped
instructions: Place sundried tomatoes, sour cream, zesty dried mixed spice, serrano chili, parsley, and watercress in blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,rose water,orange zest,tomato juice,cider vinegar,chuck
title: Crock Pot  Beef  With  Orange
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, ground | 10 ounces soya sauce | 2 cans tomatoes with juice, drained ( reserve juice ) | 4 -5 tablespoons grated orange zest ( optional ) | 2 -4 tablespoons rose water | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Cook on low for 6 to 7 hours.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,chili powder,broccoli floret,chunky salsa,lime juice zest,confectioner sugar,ginger
title: Sarasota's Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound broccoli florets, rinsed and dried | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, divided | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 can tomato juice | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Mix broccoli and 1/4 cup lime juice together in a large bowl. Sprinkle with ginger and chili powder and stir. Place remaining 1/4 cup lime juice, tomato juice, salsa, and confectioners' sugar in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake well. Pour dressing over hot broccoli mixture and toss. Serve at once.

title: Homemade Tequila Marinade
ingredients: 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons tequila
instructions: Whisk together tomato paste, cayenne pepper, and tequila in a glass or plastic bowl until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,white vinegar,white corn syrup,white onion,sirloin
title: Mom's Sirloin Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1/2 medium white onion, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 cups romaine lettuce - shredded | 1 cup white corn syrup | 1 cup white vinegar, or more as needed | 1 1/2 cups diced fresh white corn kernels
instructions: Place sirloin pieces into a large skillet over high heat, and cook until evenly brown. Drain the pan, and transfer to a bowl. Reduce heat to medium, and stir in the sliced onion. In a medium bowl, mix the romaine lettuce and corn syrup, and pour into the skillet. Stir the corn syrup mixture, and cook, stirring continuously, until mixture is hot. To cool, cover, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Taco Seasoning for Spring Rolls
ingredients: 5 cups self rising flour, divided | 1 1/2 cups cumin
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together 3 cups self rising flour and cumin. Mix in remaining 3 cups of self rising flour. Turn dough out onto a floured surface.

title: The Best Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage | 1 can red curd beef broth | 1 cucumber, sliced | alfredo sauce
instructions: Chop the cabbage, and shred it using two forks. Pour the entire can of beef broth over the cabbage. Cut the cucumber in half, remove seeds and cut each half into wedges. Add cucumber to soup, and stir to combine. Serve with alfredo sauce.

title: Cuban Style Dip or Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: In a medium size frying pan, begin layering the bottom of a glass bowl. Dip hamburger and place on top of the bottom of bowl so that it can soak up the juice and absorb in the bowl. Spread picante sauce on top of hamburger. Serve with favorite tortilla chips.

title: Clam-Orange Clam Pizza
ingredients: 30 ounces refrigerated pizza sauce | 1/2 cup clam juice, fresh squeezed ( from a can with clams ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1/4 cup orange, grated zest | confectioners'sugar, coarsely sprinkling
instructions: Combine clam juice and vanilla bean in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium. Simmer, covered, for 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Remove vanilla bean from cream. Strain sauce through a fine sieve into a small bowl. Add cream and vanilla bean mixture, stirring to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a serving dish or pizza crust. Sprinkle with zest. Place on pizza peel. Garnish with orange zest or more sugar.

title: Iranian Shish Taouk (Iranian Lamb and Avocado Skewers)
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb, well trimmed and cut into bite sized pieces ( or 2 of each ) | 1 avocado
instructions: Cut meat into about 1 inch by 1/8 inch by 1 inch squares. Thread on eight bamboo skewers. Refrigerate for 1 hour prior to grilling. Grill until browned on all sides. Serve on a bed of shredded lettuce. Note, the recipe does not call for shish tawook, but i'm sure other country bread would do.

title: Beef & Quinoa
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak, cubed | 1 cup quinoa, lightly toasted and cooled | 3/4 cup beef drippings ( from a deep freezer bag )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 2 qt baking dish. Add beef to baking dish. Cover beef with hot, cool dry quinoa and drippings. Tuck the quinoa in between your hands. Pour oil into baking dish to fill jar. Bake uncovered 35 - 40 minutes, or until meat is cooked to your liking.

title: Black Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 400 g dried black-eyed peas | 400 -500 g fresh vegetables | 3 tablespoons tahini or 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Soak black eyed peas in cold water for at least 15 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Place in a bowl with 4 - 5 cups cold water. Leave them to soften and absorb moisture. Rinse under running water to rinse off excess water. Place in a bowl with 3 tbsp water. Mix well. Allow to stand for at least one hour to absorb the water. When ready to serve, mix well with cooked vegetables. Add other ingredients and taste dressing as required.

title: Jicama Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 cup jicama, cubed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Allow to sit for at least 1 hour to blend flavors before serving.

title: Easy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1/4 cup fresh pomegranate juice or 1/4 cup lime juice | 1 -2 teaspoon red curry paste ( depending on taste )
instructions: Finely grind peanuts and pomegranate juice in a food processor, pulsing until finely ground. Transfer to glass bowl, mix in green curry paste, cover.

title: Apple Stuffed Mexican Coffee Balls
ingredients: 4 tart apples - peeled, cored and sliced | 4 cubes ground mexican cheese | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the apple slices, cheese, coffee granules, and almond extract.

title: Gorgonzola
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatoes, skinned, peeled, and sliced | 1 cup gorgonzola cheese, crumbled ( can substitute parmesan )
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cheese, and pepper mill in medium sized bowl. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Sunflower Seed, Canadian Bacon and Boursin Spread
ingredients: 2 -3 slices canadian bacon, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds, toasted | 3 tablespoons boursin cheese, grated ( low-fat is fine )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for 20 minutes serve as a spread or spread with crackers or other favourite vegetables. Also you may want to sprinkle the top with finely chopped cedar or parsley.

title: Tahini Spaghetti (Spaghetti With Spicy Spices) or Spaghetti
ingredients: 200 g spaghetti | 150 g fresh habanero tahini or 150 g tahini, stirred | 200 g spaghetti, broken into 2 inch bits | 4 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons horseradish ( preferably freshly grated ) | 1/2 cup ice
instructions: Boil lots of water to cook the pasta in circa 5 minutes or according to the instructions on the box. In a huge bowl, combine the pasta, habanero and tahini with 250 ml or more of boiling water. In a separate bowl, mix the remaining tahini with the bicarbonate of soda, horseradish and ice. Add the baking soda soda mixture to the pasta. Cook for approximately 30 minutes, or until the temperature of the pasta is almost completely cooked. Drain pasta and toss with the spicy spice mix. Serve warm.

title: Aioli (aka Coco Cream)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 400 ml coconut milk
instructions: Heat butter in saucepan. Add vanilla sugar, coconut milk, and enough water to make a very thick but thin sauce. Bring to a boil, and let simmer until thick, about 30 to 90 seconds. Use immediately, or refrigerate and use within 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,fennel bulb,wheat flour,turmeric powder,gruyere cheese,corn chip
title: Artichoke and Fennel Flatbread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 fennel bulb, halved and thinly sliced | 2 roasted artichoke hearts, chopped | 1/3 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup crushed corn chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a shallow dish, toss the fennel into the flour with the turmeric powder and salt and pepper to taste. Place the fennel mixture onto a griddle or frying pan. Heat over medium heat until the fennel begins to soften, about 2 to 3 minutes. Scatter the artichoke heart on top. Remove and sprinkle with cheese and the roasted fennel, then sprinkle with crushed corn chips. Cook until cheese is melted and bubbly and crusty, about 2 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Lettuce (Chinese Straining Greens)
ingredients: 1 small chinese cabbage, about 15-inches long ( about 8 cups ) | 1 cup loosely packed spinach leaves | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads ( about 1-2 tsp. ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Cut stem end off cabbage and discard. Cut cabbage crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Wash, de stem and separate into leaves. Arrange leaves in a single layer on a platter. Sprinkle with saffron, turmeric and saffron halves and other aromatics over leaves. Cover. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Pour marinade into a jar. Close lid securely and shake to combine. Refrigerate for up to one week. Cooks notes,. The cabbage can be drained and saved for other dishes. Separate pieces into smaller leaves and wrap individually in foil. Wrap each leaf in a strip of plastic wrap and freeze until ready to use. Cooks note, cabbage can be refrigerated for up to 6 weeks.

title: Faux Mexicana (Fried Whole Beans With Corn on the Cob)
ingredients: 8 ounces masa harina | 3 cups corn kernels | 6 ounces cannellini beans, drained | maple syrup
instructions: Mix harina and corn well. Dough should be slightly sticky. Divide dough into 9 equal portions. Roll with rolling pin in a thin circle. Flatten each circle flat with the rolling pin. Fry until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,rice vinegar,sage leaf,thyme,tamarind juice,asadero cheese
title: Sage Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 tablespoons asadero cheese | 1/2 cup shredded velveeta cheese | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup tamarind juice ( i use lime juice but this is optional, i don't'like tamarindy. you decide what ) | 6 fresh sage leaves ( or more, i've used dried sage )
instructions: Roll up tightly but leave open if you want. Cut roll ups in 1/2 and serve while hot. If you want to freeze you can freeze the rolls in a ziplock bag in your freezer. Just remove the roll ups from the bag and just pop them back into the freezer, wrap in plastic wrap and place in the fridge for up to a week. You can serve in a small pita or taco or party pitas. Or use a large scoop of ice cream and a shot of tamarind.

title: Italian Game Hens
ingredients: 3 cornish hens | garlic salt | fennel seed
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees f. Wash and dry the hens. Salt them all over. Place them on the grill and cook for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes per side. Cover and let them continue cooking in the oven until they are a little hard. Meanwhile brush off any residual oil that has accumulated on the grill. Sprinkle the fennel with garlic salt and place them under the grill. Turn the hens over and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the grill, brush with garlic salt, and cut into the game hens.

title: Cardamom-Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 2 packages egg noodles | 2 scallions | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Put noodles, scallions, mustard and cardamom in a large serving bowl. Pour over the colomomomom and toss till well combined. Store in refrigerator.

title: Roman Cheese Wraps from the Pros Shop
ingredients: 2 tablespoons greek olives, chopped | 1 pint light brie cheese, diced | 1 pint extra light brie cheese, diced
instructions: Prepare the cheese according to the package directions and then mix in the diced brie cheese. Spoon a little olive/brie mixture down the center of each wrap. Sear the edges lightly with hot oil on both sides before rolling.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,apricot jam,aubergine,farfalle pasta,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Aubergine and Pecorino
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 large aubergine, chopped into very small cubes | 1 package apricot jam | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling, slated water for 10 - 12 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, heat the jam in a saucepan until steaming. Add the aubergine and simmer gently for 5 minutes pour over the pasta and season to taste. Spray a small frying pan with oil and heat gently for 1 - 2 minutes. Ladle the sauce into a large serving dish and sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,chili sauce,vanilla extract,garlic salt,taco sauce,rigatoni pasta,lasagna,peanut oil
title: Taco Shells
ingredients: 12 lasagna sheets | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces penne | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1/4 cup prepared chili sauce ( store bought ) | 1/2 cup bottled taco sauce ( store bought ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon chili sauce ( store bought ) | 2 teaspoons salad oil
instructions: Make the pesto sauce and set aside. Cook and drain pasta until al dente. Set aside. Make the taco sauce through step in a small sauce pan add the 1 ingredients and simmer until you reach the texture of honey. In a large bowl combine everything together and set aside till its time to use. Drain pasta and set aside. Add the remaining pesto to the tortilla sauce and coat them well. Add the pasta to the tortilla sauce, toss well. Spoon into a large platter or individual serving dishes and sprinkle with the peanuts before serving.

title: Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 piece italian bread, cut into triangles, or as desired | 2 slices pocketless pita bread, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange bread triangles on a baking sheet. Bake triangles in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, 8 to 10 minutes. Heat pita bread in the preheated oven until warmed through, about 5 minutes. Top bread triangles with warmed pita bread triangles, and place bread triangles onto a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,orange,marsala wine,vegetable shortening,chicken wing,sea salt,broccoli floret,dark rum
title: Chicken Wings and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/2 cup dark rum | 4 large skinless chicken wings | 1 orange, peeled, halved, and cut into wedges | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | sea salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl, cream the fat and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in the rum. Lay the chicken wings in a single layer in a roasting pan in single layers. Bake for 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Place the orange strips around the chicken and broil for 5 minutes or until starting to crisp. Arrange broccoli florets around chicken and pour sauteed orange juice into the pan. Cover tightly and bake in a preheated oven for 15 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: apple,pork tenderloin,chicken broth,coriander cilantro,plain flour,golden raisin
title: Roast Pork Tenderloin With Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 apple, peeled cored, chopped | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 3 tablespoons coriander ( cilantro ) or 3 tablespoons cilantro, chopped
instructions: Rub the tenderloins with the flour, and place in a roasting tin. Add the chicken stock. Roast at 190°c for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the pork is well cooked. Remove from the oven, and remove the tenderloins from the tin and place on serving plates. Cover with the apple, raisins and chopped coriander.

title: Lazy Pierogi Squares
ingredients: 1 pint part-skim mozzarella cheese, diced | 1/2 cucumber, peeled and shredded | 12 maraschino cherries, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon bottled garlic salt | 1 tablespoon salad dressing or 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1/4 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( about 2 cups )
instructions: In a medium bowl combine mozzarella cheese, cucumber, cherries, garlic salt, salad dressing and 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese. Using a fork, mash together until the desired texture is achieved. Pat into a 10 to 12 inch square baking dish and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese. Bake at 375°f for 15 minutes, until top is lightly browned and bubbly and the bottoms are slightly jiggly. Let cool for 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Noodle Salad Ala Hoagie
ingredients: 12 ounces cellophane noodles | 1 lb udon noodles | 2 cups orange juice ( or enough to coat noodles ) | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 1/2 cup masala | 4 hoagie rolls, heated
instructions: In a large pot boil the noodles till tender, about 5 minute drain in a colander and rinse with cold water. Drain and set aside. In a blender, add the noodles, orange juice and masala. Mix till you get a nice smooth dressing. Add back to noodles and toss till coated. Divide into 4 pieces and chill in refrigerator till ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,pesto sauce,walnut oil,chunk tuna,flour tortilla,lasagna noodle
title: Tuna and Walnut Fajita Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can chunk tuna | 1 package dry ranch-style dressing mix | 1 container pesto sauce | 12 flour tortillas | 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 cup chopped walnuts oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place tuna and salad dressing mix in a saucepan, and heat until warm. Layer 1 tortillas with half the tuna mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer with remaining tortillas, tuna mixture and pesto sauce. Top with remaining tortillas. Heat 1/2 cup pesto sauce in a microwave until hot, and pour over panadas. Cover, and cook in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Remove cover, and bake 25 minutes. Place remaining pesto on baking sheet. Sprinkle with nuts, and let cool for 5 minutes. Cut into 9 servings.

title: Broiled Haggis With Cauliflower and Mediterranean Dressing
ingredients: 6 cups cauliflower, cut into small florets, stems on | 1 red bell pepper, roasted and peeled | 1/4 lb tempeh ( or other fat content of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 bag farfalle pasta ( bowtie size )
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions, drain and set aside. In the meantime, boil 2 cups water, and bring it just to a boil. Add the cauliflower and bell pepper to the boiling hot water. Turn off heat. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse the cauliflower, and cut into very thin shreds. Set aside. Cook the tempeh in the water for 3 minutes. While it is still boiling, add the thyme leaves, mixing well. Drain and set aside. Add the pasta to the boiling salted water and cook to the consistency of spaghetti. Drain and pat dry with a paper towel. In a large bowl, combine the pasta, tempeh, vegetables and crumbs and mix well until combined well. Place into a 9 x 13 inch baking pan or large casserole dish and top evenly with the pasta mixture. Cover and cook in a 375 degree f oven for 25 minutes or until heated through and the top is browns and bubbly.

title: Avocado and Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon filling | 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 2 ripe hass avocados - peeled, pitted and diced | 1 pound salmon fillets, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place meat in a large baking dish, fill with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute, then reduce heat to low and simmer until meat reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees f. Drain in a colander set in the sink, and set aside. Remove meat from the baking dish, reserveing broth. Stir in a few tablespoons of the reserved broth and fill cavity of meat with the prepared filling.

title: Prunes in Lemony
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 16 tablespoons prunes, pitted, coarsely chopped | 8 teaspoons thyme, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except prunes in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers.

title: Peaches Romanoff
ingredients: 4 firm ripe peaches, sliced into thirds | 1 cup canned chopped grape tomatoes | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: In a bowl, mash the peaches together with the grape tomatoes into a puree. Stir in the vodka just before using. Serve at once, or store in the refrigerator.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus extra, for garnish | radish ( optional ) or green onion, for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl. Garnish with additional grated cheese, if desired.

title: Spinach Enchilada Dessert
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 pint half-and-half cream | 5 cups fresh spinach | 1 dash chili powder
instructions: Spread the honey mustard on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Lay one can of enchilada sauce on top of the mustard. Spread half and half cream on top of the enchilada. Repeat layers, finishing with chili powder and remaining sauce. You may top with shredded cheddar if desired. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for about 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Cod With Orange and Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb cod fish fillet | 6 orange zest strips | 1/2 cup italian parsley | 1 cup orange juice, mixed with a bit of water
instructions: Cook cod according to package directions using an orange zest. Remove and place in a serving dish, cut side down. Sprinkle with oranges and parsley. Drizzle orange/syrup over everything. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,lemon pepper,turmeric powder,tomato paste,white pepper,polenta,italian bread french,honey mustard
title: Vegan French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs white onions, washed, peeled and sliced about 4 large | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning or 1 tablespoon curry powder ( i use 1 tablespoon of mild curry ) | 6 teaspoons tomato paste | 2 3/4 cups prepared polenta ( i use french's french style ) | 2 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper ( or more to taste ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add all the dry onions and cook until very soft.

title: Warm Whole Wheat Tortillas
ingredients: 4 large whole wheat tortillas or 4 large white burritos | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Lay out a platter. Warm the tortillas on a large platter. Spread 1 to 2 tablespoons of vinegar on top and sides of each tortilla. Heat and grease a cast iron pan over medium low heat. Quickly lower 2 flour tortillas into pan. Cook for 3 minutes. Turn over and cook 2 minutes more, or until tortillas are warm through. Eat warm.

title: Sour Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 fresh white mushrooms, cleaned and cleaned | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
instructions: Place mushrooms into a bowl with about 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Mix in pepper and cilantro. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,xanthan gum,lettuce leaf,thyme sprig,chocolate chip,dark rum,chicken meat
title: Brazilian Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 cups finely diced cooked chicken meat | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 3 cups chilled lettuce leaves | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the sugar, xanthan gum and chicken. Add the gruyere cheese, thyme, and lettuce. Serve with chocolate.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,mozzarella cheese,flat leaf italian parsley,caper,philadelphia cream cheese,filet beef,yellow pepper
title: Cheeseburger Roll
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced filet of beef ( can sub other beef, but i usually get it very thin ) | 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1/3 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped, plus additional for garnish | 1/2 cup red pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon capers | 1/2 cup tri-colored cheese blend, shredded ( such as kraft's ) | 1/4 cup freshly shredded mozzarella cheese ( or more )
instructions: Cut a pocket in 1 side crust of each beef strip by inserting meat in a flat, long slice of cream cheese. Reserve a cup of each mixture for topping. Stir créme fraîche, italian parsley and red peppers in a small bowl. Arrange beef strips in a flat serving dish and scatter with capers and cheese. Spoon créme fraîche mixture over beef, pressing the cheese into beef. Serve.

title: Baked Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup minced fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wash the tenderloin and pat dry with a paper towel. Cut the tenderloins in half lengthwise. Open each half.

title: Crab Ceviche
ingredients: 3 large ripe avocados, peeled, pitted and cut into chunks | 2 cans canned crabmeat, drained | 1 cup finely chopped hazelnut liqueur | 1 bottle fish stock | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | cooking spray
instructions: Make sure your oven has a convection oven and place the baking dish in it. If you don't, simply turn your oven on to 200f degrees. Place the avocados, crabmeat, hazelnut liquor, and fish stock in the bottom of the oven proof pan. Cover the crabmeat mixture with aluminum foil. Place the baking dish in a larger pan of hot water. The ceviche will rise when the water hits the top. Remove, fill a blender or food processor with ice cubes and process until smooth. Return the ceviche to the baking dish and let set for about 10 minutes. Heat the oven to 350f degrees. Mist the exposed foil with cooking oil. Bake the ceviche for about about 30 to 40 minutes, until the top is lightly browned and bubbly. Carefully, remove ceviche from the oven. Let it cool completely before serving. Serve with toasted pecorino romano cheese or toasted italian bread slices.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,onion powder,xanthan gum,cooking spray,vanilla ice cream,yogurt,yeast
title: Yogurt Buns
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 teaspoons yeast | 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 cups quick-rise prepared mustard and spread | 4 cups finely crushed vanilla ice cream, divided | 1 1/2 cups finely crushed yomeans plain yogurt, divided
instructions: Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Sprinkle yeast over yogurt.

title: Fajitas
ingredients: 1 gallon flour tortilla | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves ( optional )
instructions: Warm up the tortillas in a cast iron fry pan on the stove top until they are a uniform, not crisp, color. After warming up the tortillas, place them right on a plate with a rim, close up and roll them like a burrito. Place them in the oven at 100 degrees celcius to keep warm and warm until the fajitas are done. Serve with pico de gallo, guac, salsa, salsa verde.

title: Linda's Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups rice | 2 tablespoons chili sauce
instructions: Drain the rice into a bowl, sprinkle a small amount of salt over the water, stir and let sit a couple of minutes, then rinse under cold water and drain. In a skillet, heat the chili sauce over high heat and stir in the rice. Heat through, then remove and keep warm.

title: Garbanzos (Quick Preserved Garbanzos)
ingredients: 3 cans garbanzo beans, drained | 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon ground almonds, lightly toasted
instructions: In a blender or food processing bowl, combine garbanzo beans, cinnamon, and ground almonds. Process until mixture is coarsely chopped. Transfer mixture in sealed container and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: green,half cream,brown sugar,taco seasoning,hot italian sausage,maraschino cherry,turbinado sugar
title: Taco Sauce for Dips
ingredients: 5 pounds hot italian sausage | 3 gallons half-and-half cream | 3 cups packed brown sugar | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 jars maraschino cherries, drained | 1 package turbinado sugar | 1 cup light brown sugar
instructions: Crumble the sausages into a large stockpot. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown on all sides, about 20 minutes. Drain the juices from the sausages into a clean stockpot. Return the pork and juices to the skillet. Pour half and half into the skillet with the juices. Stir to mix. Stir in remaining ingredients by hand. Cover, and simmer over low heat until thickened, about 2 hours. Use to dip drained cherry shells into the hot sauce after they've cooked to preserve the juices. Store leftovers in the refrigerator.

title: Tortoni Rustica (A Culinary Recipe for Tortoni Rustica)
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 cup mango, peeled and diced | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 pinch saffron strand
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. While you are cooking the linguine, combine the mozzarella, raisins, and saffron. Drain the linguine in a colander, then add the cheese mixture, and toss until the cheese is melted. Cut the saffron strands into small pieces, and scatter them over the top to serve.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,cherry,salt black pepper,salmon fillet,mustard,garlic clove,red chilies
title: Baked Salmon With Chilli Mustard
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon fillets, skinned, pin bones removed | 1/2 pint cherry tomatoes ( in natural juices ) | 1 garlic clove, roughly chopped | 4 small red chilies, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard | 1 tablespoon coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place all ingredients in a large bowl, stir well to combine. Transfer salmon to a baking tray and brush with oil and bake in a preheated oven for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 200°f. Transfer fish to a warmed serving dish. Pour cherry tomatoes and garlic over fish.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,cumin seed,pesto sauce,extra sharp cheddar cheese,enchilada sauce
title: Quick Red Beans a la Pizzas
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 6 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the pizzas. Pour the enchilada sauce into a medium saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: spinach,tomato puree,wheat spaghetti,whipping cream,pineapple chunk,red wine vinegar,arugula
title: Spinach and Pineapple Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1/2 package whole wheat spaghetti | 1/2 pound fresh spinach | 1/2 cup pineapple chunks | 1/4 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 cup grape-garlic tomato puree | 1 cup whipping cream, chilled | 1 cup thinly sliced arugula
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse spinach in a strainer set in the sink. Pat dry with a paper towel. Drain well. Cook spinach in a skillet over medium high heat until just wilted, about 3 minutes. Drain well and place in a large bowl. Add drained spaghetti, pineapples, vinegar and tomatoes and toss gently. Chill at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend.

title: Baked French Fries
ingredients: 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Combine catsup, chili sauce, golden syrup, oregano and parsley. Spread on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 375°f until heated through and bubbly, about 25 minutes.

title: Apricot Crunch
ingredients: 4 -5 apricots | 2 teaspoons flax seeds, ground
instructions: Dry the flaxseed with a paper towel. Sprinkle or rub the ground flaxse around it to make an easily to spreadable snack. Sprinkle or press the flaxse powder into the flaked apricots. Store in an airtight container.

title: Portuguese Omelette
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 1/4 cup chopped spanish onion | 1/4 cup chopped green pepper | 1 can lima beans, drained | 1 1/4 cups broth
instructions: Beat egg whites until whites stiff peaks form. Beat in chopped onion, green pepper and beans until well combined. Heat 1 1/4 c broth in a 10 inch ovenproof skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking. Pour 1/3 cup of egg mixture into hot skillet and cook until bottom is browned, about two minutes. Turn omelette over. Spread with remaining omelette mixture and cook until bottom is browned, about two minutes. Slide omelette on omelette to a warm platter. Cut into 4 wedges.

title: Easy and Easy Warm Spinach & Eggs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice or 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 lb fresh spinach | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar or 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Cut up spinach according to directions on bag. Place in microwave safe dish, cover with lid, microwave on high for 5 minutes, turn over and microwave on medium for 5 minutes. Remove spinach from microwave, place on plate. Return to microwave for 2 minutes, drain. While the spinach is cooking, mix together the vinegar and fish sauce. Add the vinegar/fish sauce to spinach and stir to combine. Add the drained spinach and mix gently. Serve with egg rolls or crackers.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,apple jelly,corn oil,corn,beef steak,natural yoghurt,artichoke heart
title: Beef Steak With Artichokes, Yogurt and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 4 beef steaks ( one 1 inch thick ) | 3 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts ( drained and chopped ) | 1/2 cup apple jelly | 40 g mini chocolate chip | 2 tablespoons corn oil ( to shallow fry )
instructions: Slice each steak into four pieces. Place the 4 pieces of meat into a shallow baking tray or a deep dish. Mix together the yoghurt, corn oil and artichokes, pour over the steaks and coat well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 200c. Remove the steaks from the marinade and dry on paper towels for 20 minutes. Heat 1/2 tsp oil in a nonstick frying pan. Fry the marinated artichokes for 3 mins on each side or till browned. Turn as needed and keep warm. Pour 1/2 tbsp oil into a shallow oven proof frying pan. Turn the steaks and cook for 4 mins each side or until cooked to your liking. Place the steaks onto serving plates, spoon over the yoghurt/artichokes mix and top with the yoghurt/artichoke mixture. Melt the chocolate chips in the microwave or in a small bowl place in a small saucepan and stir over low heat till melted. Drizzle over the meat to serve.

title: Chinese Strawberry Tofu
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, cut into 1/3-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh strawberries | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric ( optional )
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Saute tofu cubes in oil until golden brown, about 1 minute per side. Remove tofu from skillet, slice tofu into bite sized pieces, and arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle strawberries on top. Season with turmeric to serve.

Random Ingredients: sprite,cider vinegar,focaccia bread,button mushroom,ginger garlic paste
title: Ginger Garlic Mushroom and Bread Appetizer
ingredients: 1/4 cup ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 10 small button mushrooms | 10 slices focaccia bread | sprite | 1/8 cup sprite ( optional )
instructions: Grind ginger and garlic paste together in a food processor or blender. Heat vinegar in a small saucepan for 2 minutes or until just boiling and add ginger garlic paste and mushrooms. Season with Sprite if desired and cook on low for 5 minutes, stirring periodically so mixture does not stick to pan. Heat oven to 400°f wrap bread in aluminum foil and place on cookie sheet and bake until golden brown on either side and heated through.

title: Jalapeno-Cayenne Molasses
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh jalapeno, coarsely chopped ( the size of a small cherry or anjou pear ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Combine the jalapenos, cayenne and cajun spice in a small bowl.

title: Tamarind Chile Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, grated | 4 teaspoons triple sec, divided | 3 lbs roasting chickens
instructions: Make the spice rub by combining 1 tblsp. Of the spice rub with 1/4 cup of the tamarind paste, ginger and 1/2 teaspoon of the triple sec. Place the chicken in a shallow roasting pan. Spoon the spice mix on the chicken. Cover the thighs with plastic wrap and refrigerate for no less than 4 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 400°°f. Remove chicken from the refrigerator 30 minutes before roasting to allow the pan juices to redistribute evenly. Meanwhile, bring the remaining 1/2 cup of tamarind juice to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add the remaining 1/4 cup of spice rub and simmer 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,kalamata olive,cardamom pod,plain flour,chili pepper flake,summer squash,peanut,ear corn
title: Spice Islands
ingredients: peanuts ( optional ) | 4 ears corn, cut from cob ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sweet chili pepper flakes | fresh chili pepper pepper flakes, 1/2 teaspoon ( to taste ) | freshly ground cardamom pod ( optional ) | plain flour ( optional ) | 1 cup roasted and salted peanuts ( optional ) | cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook the kernels of corn on a dry ridged tray with a coating of oil or cooking spray. When hot, remove the kernels and put aside. Heat a frying pan using medium heat. Season the spices. Place the peanuts in the pan to darken and heat for 3 - 4 minutes, just until they start to brown. Add the hot peanut kernels to the pan. When the kernels start to darken, turn up the heat to medium high. Stir for a minute or two. Add the corn kernels and continue stirring frequently. Once the mixture starts to darken, turn down the heat to medium and add the spice mixture. Reduce the heat to medium and stir regularly until the spices are hot. Turn off heat, remove all solids, or serve the spicy mixture in wedges with plenty of plain flour mixed with hot cereal. If there is any remaining spice mixture in the pan, break up into small pieces and add to the pan. When the mixture is hot and the peanuts are toasted remove from pan and serve. Great served with steamed seasonal greens.

Random Ingredients: lemon pudding mix,chili oil,red pepper,milk,hard egg,serrano chilies
title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: 6 cans sweetened condensed milk | 2 packages instant lemon pudding mix | 2 cans chili oil ( your choice ) | 3 tablespoons of canned canned serrano chilies, with seeds | 3 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 3 small red peppers, broken into chunks
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in the large bowl. Cover and chill for 2 hours to overnight.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,feta cheese,pita bread,linguine,cod fish fillet,ice water,red chili pepper
title: Linguine With Cod
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 3 cups ice water | 1 lb linguine | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and sliced into rings ( seeded if you like spicy ) | 4 -6 ounces cod fish fillets, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 4 pita bread, warmed, cut into triangles
instructions: In a large pot bring the canola oil and 3 cup water to a simmer. Add the linguine and cook until al dente. About 7 minutes. While the pasta is cooking, heat the chile and fish sauce until chile is roasted and flavors are blended. Drain the pasta and transfer it to 4 serving plates. Add the fish and cheese to the sauce and mix well to coat. Top with the triangles of pita bake.

title: Kaffir Lime Pie
ingredients: 2 sheets phyllo pastry ( phyllo dough, thawed or leftover pastry for a birthday cake and keep frozen for future birthdays..my special favorite is to double the sheets and thaw them slightly )
instructions: Bake pastry sheet on lightly buttered/floured baking pan 10x1 3/4x1 1/2 inches until puffed. Remove from pan. Place frozen pastry sheets next to each other in small circle around edge. Place frozen filled pastry on top of phyllo sheets 1/2 inch or less from outer circle. Brush top pastry with water and sprinkle generously with finely chopped fresh chopped lime leaves. Bake at 400 for 10 - 12 minutes or till pastry is lightly browned. Enjoy.

title: Microwave Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, stems trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried hot pepper flakes | 1/4 cup cornmeal
instructions: Cut off ends of beans and snap into 2inch lengths. In a medium bowl, combine beans and hot pepper and pour boiling water over. Cover, and microwave on high 5 minutes, or until heated through. Spread cornmeal on a 9 - ½ x 13 - ½ baking dish. Sprinkle with hot bean mixture, turning once. Microwave on high 2 minutes, or until beginning to brown. Turn, and bake about 45 minutes, or until beans are lightly browned and crisp. Can be reheated in microwave. Note, to prepare, microwave ovens on high for 5 minutes, or until hot, and allow to cool. Store hot.

Random Ingredients: apricot,tomato juice,salad oil,parchment paper,asian chili sauce,black bean
title: Chili Apricot Black Beans Salad With Paper
ingredients: 1 cup cooked black beans | 3 tablespoons tomato juice | 1 tablespoon asian sweet chili sauce | 3 tablespoons salad oil | sliced apricot | 4 sheets parchment paper
instructions: Combine beans, tomato juice, and sweet chili sauce in small bowl. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Dip parchment paper in sauce to cover. Add hot bean mixture.

title: Cashew Crisp With Honey
ingredients: 1 ear of corn tortilla chips | 2 teaspoons honey | 1 tablespoon cashews, ground
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°c. Dip ear of corn into honey and coat well. Place on a baking tray. Roast for 10 minutes. Combine cashew nuts and crushed tortilla chips. Quickly roll up the corns and toss into the bag. Eat.

title: Pineapple Cakes (Curried Eggs)
ingredients: 1 firm ripe pineapple | 2 large hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon of dried mint
instructions: Skin the pineapple and cut it into thin slices. Place the slices in a mixing bowl, add the eggs and mix well so they are all mixed. Add the curry powder and mint. Add the pineapple slices, mix gently to coat everything and set aside to marinate for about an hour or so in the fridge. Using a large grater, shred the pineapple finely. The pieces should be very finely minced. Keep the minced pineapple in a clean bowl until serving times. To serve the pineapple cakes, put the grated pineapple on a heated plate, top it with a crumbly, crumbly mix that you made the night before with the mint. Garnish plate with slices of fresh pineapple or cherries when serving.

title: Quick  Noodle Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 7 ounces cornichons ( frozen for easier slicing ) | 2 ounces golden syrup | 3 teaspoons chili flakes | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade | 300 g noodles ( gluten free, uncooked )
instructions: Cook pasta according to the instructions on the package. Drain and plunge into cold water. Slice cornichons into thin strips and add to water. Bring to the boil, add golden syrup, chilli flakes and noodles. Add marmalade and mix together all. Serve warm with crusty bread, garlic bread, chips or biscuits.

title: Italian Tripe With Beans and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 beef tripe | 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup roasted pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place tripe in bottom of greased baking dish. Slice tripe into 1/2 wide slabs and arrange on top of beans. Combine beans with meat mixture. Sprinkle pistachios on top. Bake, covered, for 40 minutes. Serve immediately. Note, to make ahead, thaw tripe, place in crock pot on high. Cover and cook on low 8 hours.

title: Taco Seasoning for Fish and Chips #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package light sour cream or 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 envelope taco seasoning
instructions: Stir cream cheese and taco seasoning together in large bowl, adding flour gradually as desired. Spread on hot, greased or floured fish. Cool 5 to 10 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,cauliflower,ham hock,coconut rum,orange bell pepper,turmeric powder
title: Prawn With Cauliflower Coconut Sauce.
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower | 8 ham hocks | 2 ounces coconut rum | orange sweet bell pepper, sliced | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 125 ml irish cream
instructions: Roasted the cauliflower until it is soft. Wash and cut the leaves into small pieces. Heat the oven to 500 degrees. Boil the cauliflower for 10 - 15 minutes. Rinse the cauliflower and add to the oven dish along with the ham hocks. Roast for 8 10min or according to directions. Heat the rum and add to the cauliflower for the last 2 minute. Add bell pepper and the turmeric. When cauliflower is ready, mix in the cream and serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: paprika,green chili,garbanzo bean,vanilla ice cream,phyllo pastry,onion powder,pear,orange juice
title: Chile, Banana, Pear, and Cheese Pie
ingredients: 2 packages phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 package frozen miniature peaches, thawed, sliced | 2 green chili, finely chopped | 1 pint vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9 inch pie dish with parchment paper or aluminum foil. In a blender, combine garbanzo beans, orange juice, paprika, and onion powder and blend until smooth.

title: Hot and Sour Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons taco sauce
instructions: Mix all together.

title: Herbed Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mixed dried herbs ( eg parsley, dill, chives ) | 1/3 lb thickly sliced herb baguette ( or other hearty crusty bread )
instructions: Using a sharp knife slice the baguette or the thick slice of day old bread, preferably on a 1/8 inch thick. Arrange 2 tablespoons of mixed fresh herbs on each slice of bread, then top with the slices of herb. Cut into pieces, drizzle with 2 tablespoons of cream and drizzle with remaining cream. Note, bread can be eaten immediately after it has been toasted or refrigerate.

title: Pork Roasted in Parsley
ingredients: 6 lbs pork belly | 6 cups fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Wash pork belly thoroughly in warm water and pat thoroughly dry using paper towels. Place pork belly on rack in roasting pan and place in preheated oven. Bake until just browned, 1.5 hours or 1 hour unstuffed. Remove from the oven and set on a cutting board. Increase oven temperature to 450 degrees f. Place roasting pan in oven and dry pork thoroughly in oven. Bake for an additional 15 minutes, basting twice during baking to brown the meat. Remove the pork from the oven, remove skin and fat and reserve meat. Tear off pieces of pork about 2 by 2 inches. Garnish with parsley. Serve, in sandwiches with crusty french bread and pickles.

title: Provence Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsulphured vinegar | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence, plus more for finishing
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk the vinegar and herbes de provence until the herbs are dissolved. If necessary, mix in a little water to loosen. Cover and refrigerate until use, at least 1 hour or up to 12 months.

title: Crispy Masala Cashew Shake
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 2 1/2 teaspoons chili paste with garlic | 2 teaspoons masala | 2 ounces cashews, dry roasted | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Line a baking tray with aluminum foil or parchment paper. In a bowl, marinate the mix in the following order, masala, cashews, chili paste, garlic, nutmeg. Toss to coat. Spread onto the baking tray evenly. Place on the lower rack of the oven, close the door, and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, turn off oven and let the cashew bake on another tray for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, let stand for 10 minutes, then rub off excess moisture. Cut into squares, drizzle with sweet pickled veggies or jam, and serve.

title: Caribbean Rum and Orange Peel
ingredients: 8 strips fresh orange peel | 2 ounces dark rum
instructions: Score the peel on the rind with a sharp knife, using the cuts as well as a cross. Place in a dry pan and dry over a slow, dry fire until soft but not colouring, or in a mortar and pestle and use a funnel to stir in the rum. Store in an airtight container. It will keep indefinitely. Invert, peel away and discard the peel and slice into thin strips. Store in a glass jar until used for flavouring. Note, the flavour improves if left for a few hours, but no more than a week. It is good to leave overnight, which improves the flavour of the rum and other preparations.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,plain yogurt,prosciutto,irish whiskey,bacon dripping,nonfat cream,parchment paper,potato starch
title: Irish Bacon Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb potato starch | 10 ounces nonfat sour cream | 6 slices prosciutto | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 6 ounces plain low fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 teaspoon bacon drippings | parchment paper
instructions: For the dough, sift the potato starch into a large bowl. Add the sour cream, guacamole, and yogurt. Stir to combine. Divide the mixture in half, and press each dough half into a 1/2 inch thick rectangle on a lightly floured surface. Cut each rectangle into 8 slices, each about 3/8 inch thick. Place about 1 tsp of the bacon drippings in a non stick skillet or griddle. When the pan is hot add half of the potato flour. Cook over medium high heat until sticky and lightly browned. Add the remaining potato flour and continue cooking, stirring for 2 minutes or until the bottom of the potato flour mixture has formed a ball that is firm but not tough. Remove from the heat and pour on the flavored flour and stir until lightly coated. Let the bacon roll warm up in the skillet, stirring once or twice, until crisp and brown. Slice the roll into 1 inch pieces. Serve with a dollop of guacamole and a sprinkle of your favorite irish sandwich toppings.

title: Potato and Chilie Soup
ingredients: 1 lb fresh potato ( optional ) | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 1 large red chilies | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Peel potatoes when almost cooked. Cut into medium dice. Chop finely or place in blender. Boil water, add beef and mix with potato until potatoes and chilie are cooked.

title: Seitan Potato, Potato and Chicken Pie for the Dutch Antilles
ingredients: 9 sheets pies for single crust | 6 tablespoons chicken liver, chopped | 4 tablespoons seitan, chopped | 1 can frozen peas, drained | 1 bag baby potatoes, halved and chopped ( use your favourite, like yukon gold ) | 12 large slices sweet potato, baked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Place the oven rack in the middle of the oven. Place pie crust sheets on a baking sheet, and bake for 5 minutes, or until golden. Mix the liver, seitan, peas, potatoes and pie filling in a large bowl. Distribute the potato layer in half, top with half the liver mixture and top with remaining pie filling. Bake for 45 mins for low/medium, 45 - 60 mins for well done. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes. Slice and serve hot, topped with sour cream if desired, if desired.

title: Homemade Italian Beef Nuggets
ingredients: 1 pound ground round | 1/2 cup seasoned dry bread crumbs
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the ground round, bread crumbs, and pepper. Form the crumb mixture into 1 1/2 patties. Place them on a baking sheet, and place them in a preheated 400 degrees f oven. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes, or until no longer pink inside and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: thai chile pepper,orange extract,tomato green chilies
title: Fresh and Easy Green Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 cans canned orange-flavored green chilies | 1 tablespoon thai chile pepper
instructions: Combine together in a 4 quart or larger slow cooker. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,white wine vinegar,pineapple tidbit,self rising flour,orange zest,guava nectar,nonfat milk,dashi stock
title: Pineapple and Guava Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups guava nectar | 1 cup nonfat milk | 3/4 cup instant dashi stock | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/3 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup fresh pineapple tidbits, chopped
instructions: Stir guava nectar, milk, dijon soup base, vinegar, orange zest, and taco seasoning together in a saucepan over medium heat until hot but not boiling, about 20 seconds. Whisk flour into guava mixture.

title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread | 1 liter milk | 1 lb gruyere cheese, grated | 1 lb linguine or 1 lb other pastas
instructions: Cut the bread in small pieces and place it in a heavy skillet or stew pot with the milk. Simmer uncovered until a thick crust forms on it. Meanwhile, bring a small pan of water to boil, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Drain well. Pass the bread through a strainer. Add grated cheese to the bread and mix well. Heat through and taste for seasoning. Remove crusts and bread from milk and reheat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,fennel seed,dark sesame oil,allspice,anchovy fillet,plum sauce,cardamom seed
title: Fennel-Sesame Smoked Gouda Slice
ingredients: 500 g gouda cheese, coarsely grated | 3 anchovy fillets, chopped | 1 cup plum sauce, not drained | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Process cheese, anchovies, plum sauce, sesame oil and spices in a food processor until smooth, stopping occasionally to scrape down the side of the bowl. Serve mixture sprinkled with some remaining grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,peanut oil,thai peanut sauce,thyme leaf,cream cheese,currant,spaghetti
title: Spaghetti with Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb spaghetti | 8 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1 cup chopped unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 3 tablespoons chopped thai peanut sauce | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water until al dente. Drain. Combine the peanut butter, peanuts, cream cheese, peanut sauce, thyme, and currants in a bowl until blended. Put the spaghetti in a large, well buttered, serving dish. Pour the peanut sauce over the top and toss to coat evenly. Cover with foil and continue topping with the currants.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,black tea,spanish onion,dijon mustard,green pea,dark sesame oil,mix
title: Green Tea Irish Mustard Bread
ingredients: 1 english onion | 1 package instant green tea ( not instant low-fat ) | splash black tea | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 cups dry mix | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard or 1 tablespoon brown mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Finely chop the onion and finely chop the green tea into 1/8 dice. Place the onion, onion, green tea, tea, black tea, and sesame oil in a food processor and blend to combine. Turn the mixture into a large bowl. To make mustard, combine dry mix, buttermilk and mustard and mix. Add 1 tablespoons of mustard to the dry ingredients and mix.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,apple,coconut,russet potato,mushroom,oregano leaf,glutinous rice flour
title: Coconut and Smoked Beer Pizza(Okinawan Pizza Cooker)
ingredients: 4 cups peeled diced russet potatoes | 2 cups fresh sliced mushrooms | 1/2 cup sliced peeled apple | 1/4 cup dark beer | 1 1/2 cups glutinous-rice flour ( soy bean flour ) | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup dried oregano leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in the rice cooker, select the light or dark beer and bake in a medium microwave safe bowl for 20 minutes.

title: Sichuan Sauced Mushrooms: Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons safflower oil or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 lb whole large mushroom
instructions: Heat oil or butter in pan. Brown mushrooms, remove from pan. Pour sauce through a strainer or wok and use the water to cook the mushrooms with the mushrooms. Continue to stir sauce while mushrooms are cooking for about 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Swiss Hot Mustard
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard seeds | 1 cup water
instructions: Whisk cream and mustard seeds in heavy small saucepan until thickened, about 20 minutes. Stir in water.

title: Easy Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup basmati rice ( i used jasmine ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons tomato and green chilies | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cheese, grated ( i used cooper sharp ) | lettuce leaf
instructions: Boil rice till just done. Rinse with cold water so it doesn't catch. Once the rice is cool, drain well. Spread rice on a small plate. Place in a heated oven at 375°f. Top rice with the cheese. Place under the broiler just till cheese is melted. Remove from oven and serve with lettuce. Note, i often like to add about 3 tbsp of sour cream to the cheese after i've made this and it was crispy on top.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,ginger,rice,marsala wine,beef stew
title: Truffled Roast Beef on the Weekend
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew, trimmed and tied | seasoned sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 1/2 cups rice ( preferably long grain ) | 1/4 cup sweet marsala wine | 1 inch cinnamon stick, broken into small pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Place the beef in a roasting pan. Season the beef generously with salt and pepper. Rub the outside of the meat with the cinnamon stick, then add the marsala and enough water to come halfway up the sides of the meat. Cover the pan and transfer it to the oven. Braise for 1 1/2 hours. When the beef is tender, remove the cinnamon stick before serving.

title: Truffles De Parsnips (St. Vincent Parsnips)
ingredients: 2 lbs pared parsnips | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1/2 cup marmalade, such as marsala
instructions: In a large pan of boiling water, cook parsnips for 10, 1/2 minutes per lb. Drain and cool. Cut in 1/4 inch slices. Melt shortening in large frying pan. Add parsnips, toss until coated. Add marsala, toss well. Heat, stirring, until hot but not boiling. Serve at once.

title: Baked Beans With Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg frozen white beans | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 350 g peas, shelled | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | oat | freshly grated peat, to serve
instructions: Place the beans into a saucepan of boiling, salted water and simmer for 5 minutes. Cover and cook over a medium heat for 30 minutes until tender, adding more water if necessary. Drain. Cook the peas in a saucepan of boiling, salted water for 10 minutes, until tender. Drain. Heat oil in a frying pan, add the peas and the peas, season with pepper and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in the oats. Sprinkle over the peat mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,swiss cheese,chipotle chile,green chile pepper,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chili Con Queso (chile con Queso)
ingredients: 2 cups shredded swiss cheese or 2 cups colby or 2 cups colby cheese, divided | 4 tablespoons fat-free extra virgin olive oil, divided | 7 ounces canned diced green chile peppers, drained | 2 green chile peppers, drained and finely chopped | 1 chipotle chile, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 can red enchilada sauce
instructions: Heat 1/3 cup of cheese in medium saucepan over medium heat until just melted. Add oil, green chile peppers, green chiles, and chile de arbol.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,baby salad leaf,cauliflower,curry powder,ice water,vanilla extract,cherry pie filling,pork sparerib
title: Aunt Mary's Pasta Caprese (Sweet Potatoes, Cauliflower and Pork)
ingredients: 1 can baby salad leaves, drained | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 lb boneless country-style pork spareribs, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can pork-style spareribs, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1 small cauliflower, chopped | 1/4 cup sweet potato pie filling ( terra-sweet potato ) | 1 package dry penne pasta, cooked
instructions: In a large soup pot, combine the salad leaves, vanilla and curry powder. Add the pork and spareribs and cover, cooking over medium high heat for about 5 minutes until all the spare ribs are evenly browned. Do not add any water. Remove from heat and drain all but 1 tablespoon of the cooking liquid from the pot. Add the cauliflower, sweet potato pie filling and pasta, stirring to combine. Cover and cook over medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook until the sauce thickens, about 4 minutes.

title: Chinese Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cubed | 1 can sliced beet | 1 can sliced dry red chilies | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon tamarind pulp | 1 teaspoon ketchup
instructions: Mix mustard and tamarind. Cut beef in large size cubes. Mix meat cubes with mustard mixture and sauté in oil, add to stew in pot. Turn down heat and let it stand 1 hour. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sugar,dijon mustard,tomato green chile pepper,milk,tea,lamb loin chop,chocolate chip,turnip
title: Grilled Sweet Lamb Chops and Mexi-Chocolate Chip Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb lamb loin chop | 1/2 cup milk | 1/4 cup chocolate chips | 1/3 cup instant tea | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 can rotel-style tomatoes and green chiles with liquid | 1/2 cup chopped turnip
instructions: Pound chops to 1/4 inch thickness on both sides of chops.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,cucumber,egg yolk,whipping cream,bacon,rom tomato,tea,white wine vinegar
title: Cold Soba Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces soba noodles | 2 roma tomatoes | 1 cucumber | 4 slices bacon or 4 slices ham | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 egg yolks | 4 slices dry white wine vinegar
instructions: Wash and rinse soba noodles in cold water and set aside. Peel tomato and cucumber and cut into cubes. Slice the bacon into 1in pieces and fry until crisp. Remove from the pan and keep aside. Dice the cucumber. Wash the tomatoes and put them into the bowl with the noodles and the tomatoes. Add the white wine vinegar, white wine and salt and pepper to taste. Beat together the egg yolks and 4 tbsp cream and pour into the bowl. Cut the bacon into 1in squares and then fry to crisp. Remove from the pan and cut into 1 lengths. Put all 4 ingredients into the bowl and let stand at room temperature for at least an hour and up to 6 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,malt vinegar,pumpkin,hazelnut,artichoke heart,asiago cheese,onion soup mix,oatmeal
title: Pumpkin Hazelnut & Artichoke Bread
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin, well-drained, mashed | 1 ounce grated asiago cheese or 1 ounce provolone cheese | 1 packet dry onion soup mix or ( 3 1/4 ounce ) package vegetarian onion soup mix | 1 cup hazelnuts, toasted ( see note note ) | 1 cup oatmeal | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 3 tablespoons maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese or 1/4 cup provolone cheese | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 170c /. Butter loaf tin and line the base with baking paper. Combine pumpkin, cheese, soup mix, hazelnuts, oatmeal, vinegar and cherries in a large bowl and beat to a paste. Strain through a sieve lined with kitchen paper. Spoon into prepared loaf tin and sprinkle with extra asiago or provolone or grated cheese. Bake about 1 hour, testing for doneness with a skewer and adding more water if necessary. Remove from oven and cool for 30 minutes. Cut into slices and serve warm. Note, hazelnuts act as skins for salads and a topping for meats and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: red pepper paste,cream chicken soup,cocoa powder
title: Creamy Red Pepper Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon red pepper paste | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Mix soup in a bowl with red pepper paste and cocoa.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,parsley,salad oil,panettone,ginger powder,tortilla,shallot,beef broth
title: Panettone Fritters
ingredients: 4 slices panettone, fried | 1 1/2 cups beef broth | 1/4 cup chopped shallots or 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1/2 tablespoon parsley, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon fresh ginger powder | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 6 tortillas
instructions: In a saucepan, combine broth, shallots, bouillon, parsley, ginger powder and oil. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 seconds. Stir in fritters and remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,gelatin powder,snow pea pod,creole seasoning,white sugar,lime
title: Creole Vegetable Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 3 large mushrooms, sliced | 4 ounces snow pea pods | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon unflavored gelatin powder | 1/2 lime, juiced | 1/4 teaspoon creole seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss together the mushrooms, snow peas, sugar, and gelatin powder. Stir lime juice and creole seasoning into gelatin and milk.

title: Artichoke, Mushroom and Sauerkraut Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 tablespoons low-fat sour yogurt | 1 small fresh thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons sauerkraut | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed, toasted | 1 cup sauerkraut, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 2 small cremini mushrooms, stemmed, halved, caps thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°. Combine the yogurt and thyme sprigs in a bowl, set aside. In a dry 15 x 10 inch jelly roll pan, spread the sauerkraut on the bottom. Place the thyme, sauerkraut, and cumin in the prepared pan. Pour any collected juices over the top. Bake until the yogurt begins to caramelize and the filling is hot, about 1 hour.

title: Chicken With Peanuts and Sugared
ingredients: 350 g caster sugar | 800 g chicken breasts, in thin strips ( i use thighs ) | sea salt | 50 g peanuts, chopped
instructions: Boil the sugar until it melts. Add the chicken and cook for 8 minutes. Add salt, peanuts and cook for 8 minutes. Toss until well coated. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Beer Scented Nuts
ingredients: 4 cups matzo cake meal | 1 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 can beer, chilled | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice berries
instructions: Combine matzo cake meal and remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well. Sprinkle nuts on a baking sheet using 1/4 cup for a single layer only. Bake in preheated 350 degree f oven for about 35 - 45 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy. Let cool before storing in airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

title: Chipotle Chiles
ingredients: 8 ounces chipotle chiles, roasted in a skillet, skin left on, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch strips | ice, as needed
instructions: Place roasted chiles on a plate. Pour boiling water over chiles. Let chiles steam in the hot water until soft and sticky, 30 to 60 minutes. Drain chiles well. Place chiles in a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 to 4 hours. Once chilled, remove chiles from chiles. Serve on spanish papery cloth, cellophane, or spanish spanish rye bread using a sharp serrated knife.

title: Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 2 ounces fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Empty stewed tomatoes into a bowl. Add spinach and let sit to soften. Place all ingredients into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Turn down to a simmer and cook 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,simple syrup,gruyere cheese,corn,corn tortilla chip,coffee granule,pepper,cannellini bean
title: Stacked Bean and Corn Nachos
ingredients: 6 baked corn tortillas, room temperature | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar roasted sweet peppers, drained and cut in half | 1 jar sweet corn, drained | 1/3 cup minced pimento stuffed olives | 1/4 cup brewed coffee granules | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Place oven rack in lower third of oven. Lightly grease a 10x15 inch baking dish. Place tortillas on baking sheet. Lightly spray both sides of each tortilla with cooking spray. Bake at 375 degrees f for about 6 minutes, or until light brown. Immediately, spread out beans on baking sheet. Place sweet corn, black olives, black pepper, sugar and espresso granules in a large bowl. Toss well. Spread 1/4 cup on each tortilla. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of cheese on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Let stand for a few minutes before cutting. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,sage,pecorino romano cheese,pork sausage link,eggnog,vegetable
title: Eggnog Sauvia
ingredients: 3 quarts eggnog | 10 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 lb pork sausage link ( cut 1/2 inch long x 1/4 inch wide ) | 3 1/2 cups bread flour | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 teaspoons dried sage ( optional )
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl until frothy. Slowly stir in sausage and bread flour until well mixed. Add grated cheese and sage and mix to blend. Pour mixture into a large bowl. Cover and chill dough overnight. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Sprinkle with more cheese. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Irish Colcannon or Cabbage Salad (Irish)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 tablespoons ice water | 1/4 cup marjoram, chopped | 2 cups white cabbage, finely chopped
instructions: Mix the yoghurt, water, and marjoram together in a cup. Add the finely chopped cabbage. Mix well and garnish with grated cheese or crouton.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,french onion soup,black pepper,bacon,chicken breast
title: The Best Chicken Ever!
ingredients: 10 boneless chicken breasts | 2 cans condensed french onion soup | 2 -4 slices bacon ( optional, depending on your favourite ) | 1/2 cup key lime juice | black pepper
instructions: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound until flat and about 1/4 inch thick. Heat frying pan with a little olive oil over medium high heat until pan is getting hot. Place 2 or 3 pieces of chicken into pan and cook until golden on both sides. Add onion soup and bacon. Add lime juice and pepper. Allow to simmer until thickened and bubbly. Do not simmer to dry chicken. Serve over spelt rice or brown rice.

title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 2 cups unsalted cashews, skins removed and divided | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a bowl, mix cashews and parsley and toss to blend evenly. Spread mixture on foil and bake until golden, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Tortilla Chip Casserole
ingredients: 8 slices caraway seed | 3 ounces sweetcorn | 8 ounces tortilla | 4 ounces double cream | 3 ounces tortilla chips or 3 ounces chopped cornadilla chips
instructions: Place the corn into a microwave safe bowl and sprinkle over a good pinch of caraway seeds. Heat for about 1 minute. Spread cream over the tortilla chips and place under the grill for 3 - 4 minutes until the cream starts to bubble. In a buttered ovenproof dish, layer the corn chips, cream, and tortilla chips. Put into an oven for 20 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: white onion,cotija cheese,date,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pear,garam masala,wine vinegar
title: Pear, White Onion and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 4 firm ripe pears ( about 2 lbs ) | 2 teaspoons white onions, finely chopped, about 1 medium | 3/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 3/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese ( about 3 oz. ) | 2 teaspoons minced dates or 2 teaspoons pistachios
instructions: Remove and discard the core from the pears. Cut pears crosswise into 1/4 inch thick wedges. Place pears in a bowl. Drizzle with 1 teaspoon of the chopped onion and 1/4 teaspoon of the chopped chile. Toss to coat on both sides. Let stand at room temperature about 30 minutes. While pears stand, prepare the salad dressing, in a small bowl, combine the remaining chopped onion, cheese, garam masala, 2 teaspoons of the wine vinegar and the remaining 1/4 teaspoon chile. Sprinkle evenly over pears and toss to coat. Arrange the pear salad in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 teaspoon onion and 3/4 teaspoon chile over the top. Sprinkle with cotija cheese and nuts. Stir to combine. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white wine,tequila,brown rice,orzo pasta,oregano leaf,vegetable oil
title: Orzo With Tequila and Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup orzo pasta or 1/2 cup rotini pasta | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 4 -6 tablespoons tequila | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves or 1 tablespoon thyme leaves | 1/3 cup dry white wine ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons mild brown rice
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions, drain & set aside. Heat oil in frying pan. Add the orzo to the pan & cook over medium heat. Cook, stirring often, until golden brown, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat & stir in tequila & oregano. If using wine, add to pan with orzo.

title: Spiceful Orange Raisin and Raisin Soup
ingredients: 2 cups dark raisins, soaked in cold water about 30 minutes, drained well and rinsed in a sieve | 8 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons finely grated orange zest | 3 tablespoons anise seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to the boil over medium heat, stirring often. Reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, or until the raisins are thick and syrupy. Ladle into warmed china bowl, and let cool slightly. Divide among serving bowls and top with fresh ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,ham hock,lemon juice zest,fenugreek seed,watercress,red chilies,white flour
title: Nepalese Phoronata
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 small dried red chilies | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup ketchup ( heinz ) | 5 cups white flour | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 4 1/4 cups watercress, washed, chopped roughly, stems left on
instructions: In a bowl, mix together 1 tbsp. Of the fenugreek and 2 finely chopped red chilies. Add the ketchup and lemon peel.

title: Crispy Bakes
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
