instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat. Whisk the canola oil and vegetable oil together in a bowl. Pour into the hot skillet, and cook until the flour turns golden brown. Using a spatula and a spatula, lift the baked dough out onto a baking sheet, and cool in the skillet. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Cut dough into 1/4 inch slices. Spread the floured pieces on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Poke holes with a fork on top. Bake in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes. Turn the oven off, and brush the floured baking sheets with the canola oil. Place the baking sheet on a plate, and cool to room temperature. Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Cut a heart shape into the center of a cookie while they are still slightly warm, and using a spoon, scrape the centers of the hearts into the skillet using the spatula. The goal is to place a cookie around the heart shape completely, so the heart can get into shape. Let cook until the edges begin to brown, about 1 minute. Carefully flip the cookies over, and continue cooking until the cookie is completely dry, 2 to 3 minutes more. Transfer to a baking rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,ancho chile powder,red wine vinegar,cream mushroom soup,french bread
title: Grilled Salmon With Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 6 ancho chiles powder ( crushed ) or 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( optional ) | 3 boneless skinless salmon fillets ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 loaf french bread ( toasted or baguette style )
instructions: In medium bowl, combine vinegar, soup, chiles and oil. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt to taste. Brush top surface or the outside of grill with oil. Grill salmon 8 minutes per side. Brush with red wine vinegar and serve with french bread.

title: Spice for Breakfast Loaf
ingredients: 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 tablespoons anise seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a loaf pan with a damp kitchen towel. Cover the towel tightly with cheese cloth and set aside. In a small bowl, stir together the thawed whipped topping and anise seeds. Stir the topping mixture into the thawed whipped topping and gently stir in the thawed whipped topping. Spoon topping mixture into the prepared loaf pan. Bake in preheated oven until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean, about 1 hour 15 minutes. Cool 5 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto serving plates.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons dried minced pork sausage | 1 tablespoon dried thai basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix black beans, pork sausage, and basil together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until beans are hot and bubbling, about 1 hour.

title: Crock Pot Irish Beef Fondue
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut into thin strips | 1 jar green enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 8 ounces irish cream | 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover, cook on low setting until beef is tender, 8 to 10 hours.

title: Pasta With Crispy Hot Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 150 150 g farfalle pasta ( short pasta ) | 350 ml double cream | 1 bunch cilantro leaf
instructions: Boil the pasta until al dente. Meanwhile, heat a good knob of butter in a non stick frying pan. Add a few sprigs of cilantro leaves and fry until golden. Don't burn them serve with grated parmesan. If they do sell too much cilantro you can just pop it in, as the cilantro is better, if you love cilantro, leave it as it is.

title: Linda's Polenta, Tomato and Scallion Bake
ingredients: 120 g instant polenta | 150 150ml tomato juice or 150ml canned tomato juice | 1 -2 tablespoon caster sugar ( optional ) | chopped flat leaf parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Put the polenta in a medium pot with 100ml water and stir over a low heat until the water disappears and the polenta has become translucent and creamy. Add the tomatoesjuice, sugar and parsley. Stir until it absorbs some of the tomatojuice then turn off the heat. Place the baking sheet in the top part of the oven and heat the oven to 120c. Pour the polenta onto a lined oven tray and bake at 120c for 20 minutes until firm. Allow to cool slightly and cut into squares. Serve right away and enjoy.

title: Linguine with Yogurt
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuit mix | 2 cups greek yogurt | 1 bunch fresh basil ( leaves, stems and leaves ) | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream, chilled ( not whipped ) | extra sharp greek yogurt
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f grease 13 x9 baking dish. Heat oven to grease 12 cup jumbo muffin pan. Unroll dough on lightly floured peel.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,curry powder,bacon,apple juice,tomato soup,season salt,half,bread
title: Curried Bacon and Apple Stuffing
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 3 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 cups half-and-half | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 5 medium ripe apples or 5 medium pears, sliced into 8 thin wedges ( i prefer granny smith apples if that is all i can find ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt
instructions: Cook bacon in a large, deep skillet over high heat until crisp. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon to a paper towel lined plate, allowing excess grease to drain. Reserve bacon fat and wipe skillet clean. Add half and half, cream soup, apple, curry and orange rind.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,fish sauce,white onion,chili sauce,corn tostada,sirloin tip steak,turkey stock,rice flour
title: Crispy Fried Rice Crispy Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 4 ounces sirloin tip steaks | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 white onion, minced | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn tostada noodles ( or jumbo egg noodles ) | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1/3 cup turkey stock | 1 package crispy rice flour crisp tortilla chips ( or regular tortilla crisps )
instructions: Cut the beef to strips, then slice diagonally across the grain into thin slices. Put into a medium bowl, season with cayenne pepper & set aside. In a small bowl, place the minced onion, sweet chili sauce, corn tostada noodles or jumbo egg noodles, fish sauce & beef stock. Mix together & set aside. To serve, arrange the crispy tortilla crisps in a circle in 2 bowls. Place a slice of beef on top of the crisrap & top with sweet chili sauce to taste.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,fennel seed,vegetable oil cooking spray,eggplant,meat,green onion
title: Lighter Sticky Eggplant in Brandy
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 small eggplants | 1/2 cup chopped mixed fresh herbs such as fennel seed | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Slice a cross on the top of the eggplant to allow steam to escape. Cut each slice in half lengthwise, lengthwise and discard the stem. Place the eggplant cut side up on a tray or cookie sheet so that the ends are slightly higher. Spray each slice lightly with oil. Spray each side of the eggplant with oil and sprinkle with herbs. Bake the eggplant for 45 minutes, until the eggplant is tender and soft. Brush frequently with brandy. Sprinkle with chopped green onions and fennel. Serve warm.

title: Black Forest Fireball
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling | 1 packet liquid smoke | 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Fill a blender half full with the cherry pie filling. Cover the entire can with liquid smoke. Add sweetened condensed milk and blend on high speed until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute.

title: Gluten Free Japanese Salad Dressing
ingredients: 150 g white flour | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before using as it may start to get frothy.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,taco seasoning mix,rice noodle,chicken thigh,golden syrup,bread flour,vegetable oil cooking spray,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Cheater Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning mix ( dry or medium ) | 8 large hoisin sauce and 3/4 cup golden syrup ( or regular ) | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons seasoned rice flour | 2 tablespoons ground almonds ( optional ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | gluten-free multi grain crispy bread flour ( for dusting )
instructions: Place each piece of chicken between a sheets of plastic wrap. Pound chicken to 1/4 thickness and sprinkle with taco seasoning mix. Place in plastic bag, seal and pound until flattened slightly, about 1 ½”. Place bread crumbs in a bowl. Place 1 tablespoon maple syrup in another bowl and mix together thoroughly. Divide crumbs in half and then lightly dust chicken with corn meal. Working with one piece at a time, roll chicken into a ½” thick ¾” log and place on top of corn meal, pressing slightly so it adheres to the flour. Transfer to a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Repeat process for remaining pieces, or arrange in a lightly greased 13 by 9” by 2–inch baking dish. Place in freezer for 5–10 minutes or until thawed. Meanwhile, spray a 9 by 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 425°f. Transfer chicken to a broiler pan. Bake at 425°f for 10 minutes or until just firm to the touch. Turn and bake until chicken is just cooked through, about 8 minutes longer. Meanwhile, combine remaining maple syrup with corn meal in a medium bowl and mix well. Spread a light layer of sauce on the warm cooked chicken. Sprinkle lightly with remaining crumbs and top with crispy biscuits, pressing them in lightly. Place baking dish in oven and bake at 425°f for 20 minutes or until biscuit crumbs are golden and crispy.

title: Golden Raisins
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley | 1 1/4 cups golden raisins or 1 1/4 cups dried fruit
instructions: Soak raisins and barley in 2 quarts of water for 12 hours. Drain the barley and raisins and toss with 2 quarts water. Let stand, covered, overnight in a large dutch oven over medium heat. Stir well with a fork and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and continue adding boiling uncovered for 40 to 50 minutes or until tender, stirring every 10 minutes. Remove from heat and season to taste with salt. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,green chili pepper,white wine vinegar,peanut butter,ketchup,kirsch,beef stew meat,malibu rum
title: Korean Shortcake
ingredients: 500 g beef stew meat | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon kirsch or 1 tablespoon other brandy | 3 tablespoons green chili peppers, chopped | 4 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons malibu rum
instructions: Cut beef into 20 - 25 cm cubes. Place all of the ingredients into a large bowl and mix well. Leave to marinate in the fridge for one hour. Turn the meat pieces occasionally to ensure all surfaces are coated in the marinade. Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas add the meat to a casserole dish or roasting tin and place in the oven. Cook for approximately 1 1/2 hours or until the meat is cooked. If the meat is a bit dried out, take some of the marinade from the casserole dish or roasting tin and return to the oven and continue to cook until meat pieces are cooked and brown. Take out from the oven, sprinkle with nutmeg, chillis, peanut butter and rum and serve.

title: Rosemary Soymilk
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk, warmed | 1 teaspoon butter | 1 -2 sprig fresh rosemary | 2 -3 tablespoons water
instructions: In a small saucepan, pour the warmed soy milk over medium heat. Bring to a boil, and stir in the butter. Add the rosemary sprigs, cover, and allow to steam 10 - 15 mintues, or until all the liquid has evaporated. Remove the sprigs and the rosemary, and mix in just enough water so it is mixed well. Pour into 2 cup sized containers, or glass glasses, and refrigerate until solid, 3 hours to overnight.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,milk chocolate,camembert cheese,oat,saffron thread,yellow onion
title: Frozen Chicken With Saffron and Camembert Topping
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, diced | 2 tablespoons saffron threads | 3/4 cup 3 % low-fat milk chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped milk chocolate | 4 bone-in chicken breast halves, skin on | 4 slices camembert cheese
instructions: In a saute pan, saute onion on low medium heat until pale golden. Don't let them overcook. In a food processor, process saffron until dissolved. Return onion to saute pan and add 1/2 cup milk chocolate and 1 tbsp milk chocolate. Cook chocolate until melted and mixed well. Add chicken and cook on low medium heat 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until chicken is cooked through. Turn chicken over and cook an additional 3 - 4 minutes. Divide chicken into 4 portions. Serve over hot, greased plates. Top each with 1 or 2 slice of camembert cheese and pour melted chocolate over chicken and cheese and serve remaining to pour over chicken.

Random Ingredients: burgundy wine,golden raisin,cardamom pod,bamboo skewer,corn flake,spaghetti,basmati rice,fingerling potato
title: Cousibri Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed and drained ( 2/3 cup ) | 2 1/2 lbs fingerling potatoes, peeled ( about 7 medium ) | 2 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut in 1 inch cubes | 20 whole corn flakes, coarsely crushed | 4 cardamom pods | 1 cup burgundy wine | 1/2 cup golden raisin, plumped in warm water and drained | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in cold water
instructions: Place rice in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: half,yellow pepper,rice noodle,italian sausage,maraschino cherry,whipping cream
title: Italian Sausage and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 6 ounces rice noodles | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 can half-and-half | 1/2 cup chopped yellow pepper | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained well
instructions: In 10 inch skillet, heat sausage. Add noodles, sausages and 1/2 cup of the whipping cream. Cook over med. Heat until noodles are browned. Stir in remaining cream and peppers. Heat until hot& peppers are tender. Sprinkle with cherries.

title: Edam and White Chipotle Stuffed White Chocolate
ingredients: 1 package edam cheese, cut into squares | 3/4 cup finely chopped white chocolate | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 cup minced water chestnut | 2 ounces pancetta, minced ( about 2 ounces )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: ghee butter,brussels sprout,cardamom seed,meat,parmesan cheese,chipotle powder,eggplant
title: Chilean Meatballs
ingredients: 3 lbs lean ground meat | 6 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter, or canola oil ) | 30 -35 brussels sprouts, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 large eggplant, peeled and finely chopped | freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons chipotle powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Grind the cardamom seeds and add to ground meat along with the chipotle powder. Mix thoroughly, if it starts to stick, add a little water. Knead well, then form into 1 inch patties. Refrigerate 1 hour while preparing vegetables and topping. Remove meatballs from wrappers. Set aside. Heat oil in medium high pot. Add the meatballs and a few patties. Cook until no pink remains. Add the vegetables, cook until tender. Sprinkle with cheese, and continue to simmer. If a thicker top, add some water, and continue to stir until desired consistency is reached. Serve with pita bread or rice.

title: Roasted Indian Herbs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons jaggery ( powdered roasted ) | 2 tablespoons roasted red chili powder, | 8 -12 italian herbs | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. In a small mixing bowl mix roasted jaggery, roasted chili powder, ground almonds, and italian herbs with hand mixer or blender. Stir well to combine. Spread herb mix onto a lightly greased aluminum pan and bake in preheated oven for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until fragrant and slightly darkened in color. Sprinkle any leftover roasted mixture before serving.

title: Barley and Bean Soup (Kesha-K <INPUT_START> Kensymapa (Kensymasa)
ingredients: 6 cups beef bones with marrow | 1/2 cup dried hoska kensymama ( meat bones or knuckle bones ) | 1 cup pearl barley ( uncooked ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 cup carrot | 5 cups frozen yucca root | 1 can black beans, drained ( or cooked canned )
instructions: Place the bones and shreadded carrots in a large pot with plenty of water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour. Add the barley. Cover and simmer another 40 minutes. Add season salt, bring to a boil again, reduce heat and simmer an additional 20 minutes. Add the yucca root and continue cooking until the yucca is really tender. Add black beans and continue cooking until heated through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,thai red curry paste
title: Red Curry Paste (Kaffir Lime)
ingredients: 2 green bell peppers ( deseeded and finely chopped ) | 7 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( kha kai )
instructions: Place the green bell peppers, thai red curry paste and kha kai in a bowl with some cold water. Stir to combine. Keep warm. Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Garlic and Garlic Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 6 frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 garlic salt | 1 garlic clove, peeled and minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f and line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Place the frozen mixed vegetables into a microwave safe bowl. Cover and cook on high for 5 minutes. Scrape the frozen mixed vegetables into a medium bowl and add the flour, garlic salt and garlic. Mix well to combine. Roll the dough into 1 1/4 inch thick tortillas and then gently roll the tortilla into a circle. Place tortillas on the prepared baking sheets, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven, or until tortillas are lightly browned. Serve warm, or allow to cool completely and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,guacamole,chili powder,olive oil cooking spray,yellow squash
title: Spanish Spiced Squash
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash ( about 300g ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | olive oil flavored cooking spray | salt | 2 tablespoons guacamole, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/guacamole-with-the-cats-493988 '' > guacamole with thecats < /a >
instructions: Cut squash in half and scoop out the seeds, discarding the strings. Using a spoon or potato masher, scrape out the flesh as much of the skin as possible from the squash and place in a microwave safe bowl. Drizzle with half of the vanilla essence, season to taste with salt, cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir once halfway through. Transfer to a serving dish, cover and microwave on high for another 2 minutes, stir, cover until squash is very soft and heated through.

title: Classic lima beans
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, cut in 1 inch chunks | 3/4 lb lima beans, washed | 3/4 cup club soda | 1/2 cup lard | 4 teaspoons saffron threads | 1 shallot, minced | 1/4 cup minced fresh tarragon
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cover the potatoes with just enough water to cover them by 1 inch and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium, cover partially, and simmer 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Transfer the potatoes, lima beans, and club soda to a mixing bowl and stir to thoroughly combine. Melt the lard in a skillet over medium high heat. Add the shallot and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 1 minute. Stir in the potato mixture and tarragon. Remove from heat and serve at once.

title: Real Simple Beef Biscuits
ingredients: 600 g beef stew meat | 1 liter vanilla bean, split | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Place split vanilla beans in a large, deep bowl. Pour boiling water into bowl until it's about 2 centimeters full. Mix the two mixtures together and leave it for at least 1 hour. The longer you leave it in the refrigerator, the better it becomes. Once it's completely cool, transfer to a container and leave to mature for several days. It should get better and thicker. It is advisable to use a good grade of meat already marinated. When it's mature, take it out, then pack it into ramekins. The size is up to your taste, though the taste of the spices in the recipe will change as soon as the ramekin is turned on to the point where they're cool. You can eat the biscuit straight away, or leave it in the fridge to cool.

title: Rigatoni With Beetroot and Hot Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb beet, washed, pared, and cut into 1-2-inch cubes | 3/4 cup cooked rigatoni pasta ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 whole roasted red peppers, cut into quarters
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of water to boiling. Add the beetroot cubes and boil rapidly for 25 minutes until tender.

title: Pears Marinated Steaks
ingredients: 3 beef tenderloin steaks | 1/4 cup pear marinade, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Season the steaks liberally with salt. Grill the steaks until just cooked through and firm to the point of a knife, 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium rare. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.

title: Aussie Meatball Stew, With a Kiwi & Cheese  Roll
ingredients: 6 lamb rolls ( the frozen pack in rolls or similar sized pannies can be used to measure the roll or patties ) | 500 g cauliflower florets ( cut into 3/4 inch chunks ) | 3 slices smoked cheese | 1 tablespoon herbs ( any mixed herbs of choice ) | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 2 jalapenos, chopped ( or to taste, leave seeds in if you like really spicy ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cognac
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c or 356°f meatballs, place all ingredients in a mixing bowl, using your hands to mix well. Shape into small balls, around 5 cm in diameter. Place in a shallow ovenproof dish and bake for approx 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with the rolls and make the roll.

Random Ingredients: cream,pecorino romano cheese,mustard seed,plain flour,yellow onion,vodka
title: Easy Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, chopped | 250 g grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 550 ml cream | 500 g plain flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon vodka
instructions: Saute the chopped onions in oil. Add the mustard seeds and stir until the onions give off a good burst. Add the pecorino romano cheese, bring to a simmer, stir well then take off heat. In a separate bowl, with a little cold water, sift the flour and mix it with a wooden spoon until you have a paste. Once the soup becomes a smooth consistency, add the vodka and stir until it has completely dissolved into a creamy sauce. Simmer, add in some more milk if needed and let simmer for at least another 20 minutes. Do not boil, as some of the fluid gets cooked off during this process. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,french green bean,mint,lemon,swiss cheese,tomato sauce,pork
title: Stuffed French Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce | 4 1/2 cups cooked french style green beans, cut lengthwise in half and then crosswise into thirds ( about 2-1/2 cups ) | 2 lbs cooked pork, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint | 2 -3 lemons, peeled and sliced ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: In a 10 x 15 inch jellyroll pan, combine spaghetti with enough spaghetti water to cover the bottom of the pan. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes, until al dente. Rinse the pan with cold water, drain and transfer to a bowl. Set spaghetti aside. In the bowl of a food processor, combine the green beans, pork, tomato sauce, mint, and lemons, if using. Set this aside. Spread half each of the spaghetti sauce mixture evenly in the pan. Place 2/3 of the stuffed green beans in the sauce mixture and place about half the cheese on top of them. Place remaining stuffed green beans on top of cheese. Cover with remaining sauce mixture. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake, uncovered, in a 350°f temperature oven 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until thoroughly heated and the cheese is bubbling.

title: Penne with Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 6 ounces penne | 2 jalapeno chiles, chopped
instructions: Bring 6 quarts of water to a boil in a kettle. Add the chicken thighs, reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until chicken is tender. Boil 10 minutes, or until just cooked through.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,peanut oil,ziti pasta,sun tomato,pie shell
title: Ziti Al Ghana (Shanel Pasta With Sun Dried Tomatoes and Raanas)
ingredients: 2 ounces ziti pasta | 3/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 1 pie shell
instructions: Pasta, cook ziti according to package directions, omitting oil. Drain and set aside. Tunge tomatoes in a few drops of oil until pliable. Remove and set aside. Add raisins to ziti and shake off excess. Cook ziti and sun dried tomatoes in oil in a non stick skillet or skillet over high heat about 20 - 30 seconds. Set aside. Sauce, pour oil mixture into a small frying pan and fry sun dried tomatoes about 25 seconds or until lightly browned. Remove tomatoes and stir into ziti. Top with fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,cooking oil,yellow pepper,lamb shank,whipping cream
title: Slow-Cooked Lemongrass Beef
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 5 tablespoons thai red curry paste, or more per preference | 1 yellow pepper | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Rub lamb shanks all over with red curry paste, and place in a large casserole dish. Cover, and bake for 40 to 50 minutes. Transfer shanks to cutting board.

title: Espresso Beet & Broccoli Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 400 g shredded carrots | 400 g broccoli, chopped | 400 g beets, chopped | 400 g tomatoes, peeled and chopped ( approx ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ( or parmesan )
instructions: Toast the bread base in a griddle pan or oven oven until brown. Stir fry the beets until just tender approx 15 mins, cool under running water, drain and set aside. Melt the espresso powder in a small pan, stir in the carrots & broccoli, allow to cool down. Mix the beetroot beetroot carrots, tomatoes & cinnamon with the espresso mix, place in the bread container and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Broil on the shelf 5 minutes or till cheese is bubbly and crust is slightly browned. Serve with salad.

title: Tortillas-Cornbread Crust
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal, plus more for baking sheets | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f and ungrease 4 round cake pans, or 8 x 8 inch ovenproof serving dishes. In a mixing bowl, combine the cornmeal and parmesan cheese.

title: Parmesan Vinegar for Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss together the parmigiano reggiano cheese and white wine vinegar with a fork until evenly coated.

title: Asparagus Toasties
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, cleaned and cut in half | 2 lbs hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon french mustard | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots or 2 tablespoons green onions | 2 tablespoons hoagie rolls | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon black vinegar
instructions: Chop egg white until whites are white and set aside. If using eggs, slice egg whites into 3/4 inch rings and set aside. Cut up asparagus into 3rds and set aside. Cut egg yolks into rings and set aside. Combine mustard, capers, shallot, hoagie buns, sugar and vinegar in a salad bowl and heat in the microwave for 20 seconds or until very hot but not boiling. Using a nonstick pan toast a few pieces of the asparagus, one at a time, in the syrup for 10 seconds on each side or until golden brown, and set aside until ready to serve. Heat griddle or large heavy skillet over high heat until hot. Remove asparagus from syrup, drain on paper towels and divide among serving bowls. Put about 1 - 2 tbls. Asparagus on each slice of bread, then add egg whites and top with remaining asparagus. Serve immediately. Note, for those who would like asparagus more crisp, add a bit of tomato jam to the syrup before adding it. It brings out the flavour more. Also, serve bread mixture in the centre with a little salad dressing. Or place asparagus on a serving platter and cover with remaining salad dressing, add asparagus on top. It may be served as a side salad, or can be placed on a plate with lettuce on top.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,saffron,apple juice,pea,pistachio nut,chili oil,grain white rice,italian bread
title: Spanish Rice With Saffrans (Shakshuka) and Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups low-sodium italian style bread | 1/4 cup apple juice ( from the can of apples ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/12 teaspoon hot chili oil | 1 cup reduced-fat swiss cheese, shredded | 1/8 cup shelled and seeded medium raw pea pods | 1 tablespoon pistachio nut, coarsely chopped
instructions: Rinse the rice in a colander set over a bowl and reserve the liquid. In a 3 1/2 4 quart heavy saucepan, pour the reserved liquid over the rice, breaking up any large pieces. Let stand covered with a tight fitting lid for at least one hour and up to 8 hours. In a small saucepan, bring the bread to a boil over medium heat. Drain it and cut it into bite sized pieces. Transfer the bread, broth, and about 2 cups of the reserved liquid to a food processor. Add the rest of the liquid, processed bread, saffron, chili oil, and 2 cups of the cheese and process until smooth. Return the puree to the rice and stir. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle the remaining cheese on top. Chill, covered, in the refrigerator while preparing the remaining soup. In a small skillet, saute the pea pods in the chile oil over high heat for a few minutes, until fragrant. Sprinkle them with the pistachios and let cool. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,green bell pepper,broccoli,rotini pasta,egg noodle,active yeast,chili pepper flake
title: Lettuce Wrapped Fish Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup warm water | 3 ounces active dry yeast | 3 1/2 - 4 lbs tilapia fillets, about 1 pound total weight | 12 ounces rotini pasta, preferably linguine | 8 ounces broccoli, broken into florets | 1 medium green bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes
instructions: In a large bowl, prepare the ingredients you will use to make up the bruschetta sauce. In your electric skillet, bring the water and yeast to a boil. Set aside until the yeast is foamy, 5 - 10 minutes. Set a 12 hole electric frypan to medium heat and coat with tannini spray. Coat the tilapia fillets with the yeast and add to the skillet. Cook, turning once, until fish is light golden and cooked through, 3 - 4 minutes per side. Remove from heat. While fish warm, cook the pasta with broccoli in salted boiling water until just to tender and drain. Combine the cooked pasta with the cooked broccoli, bell pepper, and 1 tbsp of chilli flakes.

title: Scottish Roast Beef and Raspberry Gravy With Crackles
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg roast beef or 1 1/2 kg prime rib roast | 25 g white flour, seasoned | 1 lemon peel, grated | 500 ml buttermilk | 1 cup raspberry jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c or mark dust your roast with seasoned flour, put in a baking dish with the lemon peel. Pour the buttermilk over the top and cook slowly for about 2 hours. When cooked, remove the roast from the oven, sprinkle with jam and put the lid back in the oven. Cook until the internal temperature reaches 155c or mark 1 for rare. Remove from oven and leave to cool for 5 minutes. Slice and serve with your favourite gravy or steaming vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,pink salmon,turmeric,apricot jam,puff pastry,bacon grease,shiitake mushroom
title: Crispy Salmon Potpie With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry sheets | 2 ounces bacon grease | 2 tablespoons turmeric, powder | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 1 1/2 cups cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup shiitake mushroom, finely chopped | 8 ounces smoked boneless skinless salmon, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in 2 quart sauce pan, melt oil over medium low heat. Add turmeric powder and mix well. Add apricot jelly and mix into a smooth paste. Remove from heat and add turkey and cabbage. Brush pastry with some of the glaze, then line a baking dish with pastry. Place salmon around pastry, then top with salmon mixture. Bake in oven for about 20 minutes until pastry is golden brown and heated through.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,white bread,baking potato,cornflour,orange juice,fish sauce,tomato sauce,beef steak
title: Orange Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef steaks, cut in chips ( the kind in oil ) | 2 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed, peeled and cut in slices | 3 tomatoes, skinned, seeded and cut in thin chips | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 1/4 cups fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons whole cardamom seeds | 3 tablespoons freshly squeezed orange juice | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 2 tablespoons grated orange rind
instructions: Put a large frypan on the hob and brown the steak slices. Put them on absorbent paper, season with salt. Turn the heat up to medium high, add the potatoes and tomato chips and cook for about five minutes. Remove from the heat and add the fish sauce, cardamom seeds and orange rind. Stir. Stir well. Return the pan to the heat, then put on the lid. When the fish cook for about seven to eight minutes, add the fish sauce mixture and cook for three to four minutes more, until the fish is cooked through – the liquid has reduced. Spoon onto a warmed plate and serve.

title: Basic Taco Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Mix in a mug, spoon over your taco meat or anything else your liking. For me the flavor is already there. I get my spanish rice with hot sauce and this is my favorite for my taco bites.

title: Wild Rice Congee (Mozzarella Balls)
ingredients: 5 -6 medium potatoes ( about 12 medium ) | 1 cup basmati rice ( or other short grain rice ) | 3 cups boiling wild rice | 1 1/2 cups yoghurt ( any type ) or 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt ( any type ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/4 cup pine nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Peel and mince the potatoes. Place them in a large pot of cold water, and bring to a boil over high heat. When the first scald, turn down the heat, and stir until all of the water is absorbed. When the second batch, which will not need to be cooked in a while, is ready, remove the first batch from the pot with a slotted spoon, and place it in a sieve. Rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water and drain thoroughly. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil and add the rice. Meanwhile, combine all of your filling ingredients and beat together until smooth. When the first batch is almost finished, strain the rice through a fine sieve. Return the puree to the pot and add the mashed potatoes and mix well. Add about 3 cups of the boiling water, and stir well to mix. Put the sieve over a bowl so that any excess steam can escape. The more water you use in the recipe, the more you will need in your bowl. If you prefer your soup a bit soupy, you can always add back 1/2 cup to the soup in the bowl, and then set it back on the stove. Cook for approximately 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes so the rice is cooked and the soup becomes soupy. If the rice is a bit grainy, remove the sieve from the top of the soup while cooking, and place it back on the stove to boil for another 15 minutes or so. Serve the congee in a large bowl, with chopped pine nuts as garnish.

title: French Bread With Mexican Cheese Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 2 1/2 cups swiss cheese ( shredded ) | 2 cups swiss cheese ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons salt | 2 tablespoons serrano peppers ( seeded, minced ) or 2 tablespoons jalapenos ( seeded, minced ) | 3 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl with a mixer or a dough hook. Knead until smooth. Oil a large bowl then turn dough onto oiled bowl, cover bowl with plastic wrap and a towel, and let sit in a warm place for about 1 hour or until dough is doubled in size. Cut dough into three pieces. Place dough on a lightly floured surface lightly dusted with flour, and using your hands, press each piece of dough with a floured surface into a circle about 12 in diameter about 3 in in diameter. Repeat with remaining dough and oil mixture. Place a thin layer of oil in loaf pan and press each dough circle into a 6 in diameter circle. Top loaf with another thin layer of oil and press each circle into a 6 in diameter circle, the other circle and more than the remaining two circles. Place loaves in the preheated oven and bake until loaves sound hollow when tapped, about 25 minutes or until tops are lightly browned. Let cool slightly before slicing.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,chive,serrano pepper,pineapple ring,kidney bean,purple onion,lebanese cucumber,white bean
title: Fiesta Beans and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained & rinsed | 1 can kidney beans, drained & rinsed | 5 slices lebanese cucumbers | 3 lebanese cucumbers | 4 cups green cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 purple onion, chopped | 1 -2 fresh pineapple ring, in wedges | 1/2 cup minced chives
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover & cook on low setting for 6 - 8 hours or on high for 5 hours. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,beef stew meat,grain rice,wheat tortilla,cubanelle pepper,dark rum
title: Crock Pot Rum and Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1/2 cup cooked long-grain rice | 1 can pork stew peppers | 1 small cubanelle pepper | 1/3 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Combine the rum and beef. Marinate meat, rice, and pepper in the rum mixture, covered, overnight. Remove meat and vegetables from rum. Place meat and vegetables in 4 - 4 quart crock pot. Reduce heat to low. Cook 7 - 9 hours.

title: Colombian Bread Soup
ingredients: 2 cups stale white bread, crusty | 4 cups chicken broth | 12 thin slices crusty bread | club soda ( amount to taste )
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the bread, broth and 3/4 cup water. Bring to boil and simmer until bread and broth are absorbed, about 10 minutes. Cut bread into bite sized pieces and stir into soup. Continue simmering, about 5 minutes or until soup is thick. Add more bread if desired.

title: Beef & Mushroom Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef stew meat | 1 lb fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, caps sliced | 12 tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the meat in a small dutch oven or heavy duty roasting pan. Cover with water, about 1/2 inch. Bring to a boil, skimming off any impurities. Add the mushrooms, cover, and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from heat. Pour liquid into a blender or food processor, pureeing to smooth it somewhat. Remove the meat from the pan and set aside. Stir the mushroom puree into the meat. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 30 minutes. Unwrap the meat and serve with warm tortillas.

title: Olive Garden Ladyfingers With Sausage, Cucumber and Artichokes
ingredients: 16 ladyfingers, thawed ( savoiardi ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs kielbasa, thinly sliced ( sweet italian sausage ) | 2 cups mascarpone cheese, fat free | 2 small cucumbers, peeled and seeded, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 2 large shallots, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons capers packed in brine, drained well | 5 canned anchovies, chopped, drained | 2/3 cup burgundy wine, good quality
instructions: Make the snail garlic dressing while preparing the ladyfingers,. Place the sausage in a large skillet, add 1 1/2 cups water, bring to a boil and skim off any scum that rises. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, or until no longer pink at the edges. Set aside and keep warm. Make the mascarpone cheese cream while the sausage simmers. In a large bowl, add the mascarpone, cucumber, shallots, capers, anchovies and wine. Stir to blend. Set aside. Place the lady fingers on a flat surface, spread 2 tablespoons of the sausage mixture over each and roll up tightly, securing with toothpicks. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place seam side down in a shallow baking dish or one large baking tray lined with parchment paper in a single layer. If the loaf has any excess, brush lightly with the remaining 1/2 cup of fat. Bake for 6 to 10 minutes, until crisp and golden and cooked through. Transfer to a rack to cool before serving. Note, the great scandinavian baking book biankeil, the scandinavian red biankeil, is about 3 1/2 hours old and can be found at asian food stores. To make a more rustic version, cream the mascarpone or cheese with a fork in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,gruyere cheese,ricotta cheese,irish cream,parsley,soya sauce,taco sauce
title: Potato Grilled Cheese Wedges With Irish Cream Dip (Cheesy Irish Potato Wedges)
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 5 cups ricotta cheese ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 1 cup grated real irish cream | 1/4 cup parsley, fresh | 3/4 cup light tasting creamy italian-style sauce | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Combine potato wedges, ricotta, irish cream, parsley, italian style sauce and taco sauce in a large bowl. Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and arrange half the potatoes over the bottom of the pan. Cover, reduce heat to low, and bake 25 minutes, stirring once. Remove from heat. Remove cover and bake, turning potato pieces occasionally, 25 - 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork. Remove from pan and top with shredded cheese. Note, if potatoes are dry, uncover the pan occasionally and stir while baking. Drain well and serve hot with the dip.

title: Sweet Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups sweet mango chutney | 1 3/4 cups packed golden brown sugar
instructions: In a heat proof glass bowl combine chutney and brown sugar. Microwave on high power until warm, about 1 minute. Transfer chutney to a double boiler. Stir constantly over medium heat until chutney is smooth about 1 to 2 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Italian Ginger Butter
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter, room temperature | 1 1/4 lbs fresh gingerroot, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch sticks | 1 1/2 cups sugar ( regular granulated works too ) | 1 bottle zesty italian dressing
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter with the garlic, ginger, and sugar until light and fluffy. Transfer to a glass or plastic container, and freeze until solid. Using a spoon, scrape the frozen mixture into an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's directions. Transfer the butter to cold jars and freeze for up to two weeks.

title: Hot Tangy Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup tarragon ( fresh herb-based )
instructions: Pierce holes all over the roast with a sharp knife or razor blade. Put the roast in an ice bath or refrigerator until the water from the meat has drained away. Remove the roast from the water and pat dry with kitchen towels. Place the roast on a cutting board with a sharp knife inserted in your center of meat. Slice the tenderloin off the beef so you end up with thin slices. If using a sandwich press, place the tenderloin slices onto a piece of plastic wrap which has been just slightly dampened with cold water. Rolls the plastic wrap with the meat into a tight roll. Slice thinly crossways, and place onto the wrap. Seal the wrap with the lid. Place in the freezer for about 30 minutes, making sure the ends are frozen so that the flavor will be in the meat. Turn the oven on to the lowest setting. You can leave it there if it's very hot or warm, but it's not recommended to burn and overcook the meat. Use the microwave to reheat, or place it in the oven for at least 15 minutes, depending on how tender the meat is. It should be heated thoroughly and juicy like a hot roast.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,wood chip,chocolate powder,bok choy,bell pepper,tomatillo,pistachio
title: Yummy Nachos (Vegetarian Chili Verde)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons finely chopped pistachios | 1 bell pepper ( chopped ) | 2 medium tomatoes ( chopped ) | 4 cups bok choy ( chopped ) | 1 package cream of celery soup | 1 package semi baking chocolate or 1 package vegetarian chocolate powder | 1/2 cup wood chips
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts in a heavy pot. Cook over medium heat until bok choy is just tender. Remove from heat and stir vigorously. Pour into a blender and liquify. To assemble, fill each nacho shell with 3 to 4 tbsp. Of soup mixture, top with nuts and roll up. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Sake Noodles with Vinegar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 package thin chinese noodles
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the vinegar and noodles. Cover, and set aside for about one hour to draw out any steam.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,chinese five spice powder,salmon,lavender,gelatin,pork shoulder,vanilla sugar
title: Pistachio Glazed Pork
ingredients: 400 g ground pork shoulder | 400 g ground pork shoulder or 400 g turkey shoulder | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon lavender | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 packet unflavored gelatin | 200 g raw unsalted pistachios, halved diagonally
instructions: Pound the spices, including garlic, in a mortar until finely chopped then add the spices and knead to combine, until the mixture forms a paste. Mix in the chinese five spice and lime juice, mix well. Grease 4 ovenproof dishes or line them with parchment paper and set aside. Put two thirds of the pork mixture in each prepared dish then arrange half of the pistachios on top. Brush the top with more egg and press with the back of a spoon to absorb any excess liquid. Make the glaze while the pork is cooking by placing all the ingredients in a small microwavable bowl and microwave on high uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes or until the mixture is thick and glossy, stirring from time to time. Pour the glaze over the pork and top with remaining pistachios. Serve at once, or refrigerate until set but not refrigerated.

title: Herbal Bread (Italian Bread)
ingredients: 1 italian bread ( italian bread or french bread ) | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | fresh herb, optional
instructions: Score bread in diagonal 1 - 2 diagonal 1 inch deep cross running diagonal cut and set aside. Add chocolate syrup to bread and set aside until warmed.

title: Kielbasa and Gruyere Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 16 ounces kielbasa, sliced 1/8 in thick, cut into 1/2 in squares ( about 6 slices ) | 8 -10 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese | 8 ounces shredded gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking and onion, minced | 1/4 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: Cook kielbasa in non stick skillet in 2 tablespoons butter or olive oil until brown, about 5 minutes. Spread kielbasa onto paper towel lined cookie sheet or jelly roll pan to drain excess butter or olive oil. Sprinkle cheese evenly over kielbasa. Sprinkle with onion. Bake at 325 degrees for 10 minutes or until hot. Remove from oven. Dot with the yoghurt. Return to oven and cook for 2 more minutes for bubble. Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,icing sugar,cardamom pod,extra beef,parmigiano reggiano cheese,mango
title: Mango Meatballs
ingredients: 1 mango, ripe and peeled | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup extra-lean ground beef | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: In a blender, puree mango and add icing sugar, cardamom and meat and puree until smooth. Form mixture into 12 balls and place on a sheet of waxed paper and freeze until hardened. About 15 - 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees celsius coat baking tray with oil and place meatballs in tray and bake for 12 - 12 minutes. Allow meatballs to cool. Sprinkle each meatball with a grated cheese and return to the oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and meatballs are heated through. Serve at room temperature and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ice water,beefsteak tomato,salmon fillet,tamari,dark beer,wheat flour,rice vinegar,olive
title: Smoked Salmon Rillettes With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked salmon fillets, thinly sliced | 1 ounce tamari | 4 ounces dark beer | 5 tablespoons gluten-free rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons ice water | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons olive, sliced | 1 1/2 ounces whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons gluten-free rice vinegar
instructions: Place the smoked salmon and tamari in a shallow ceramic dish. Pour over equal quantities of the dark beer and rice vinegar. In a medium bowl add the ice water, tamari and olive, combine well. Using a fork, mix the flour in. Sprinkle the flour mix over the salmon. Cover with plastic wrap. Place in the fridge for about 30 minutes, or until cooked and firm. Heat the outdoor grill / broiler. Serve the salmon with warm dipping sauce.

title: Mushroom Fennel Cones
ingredients: 1 lb fresh white mushroom | 1/2 cup ketjap manis | 1 ounce blanched almond | 1 teaspoon lemons or 1 teaspoon lime peel, grated | 1/4 teaspoon fennel, ground
instructions: Wash mushrooms thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,lentil,salad green,palm sugar,olive oil
title: Lentil Salad Mix
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/3 cup palm sugar | 1/2 cup salad greens ( salad or mesclun ) | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Bring lentils and brown sugar to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to simmer, cover and cook until lentils are just tender, but still firm and slightly chewy, 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in palm sugar. Cool. Combine lentils and salad greens in large bowl. Drizzle with oil and toss. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,tea,hazelnut,gouda cheese,cardamom powder,red chili pepper flake,cayenne
title: Red Chile Breakfast Quesadillas
ingredients: 12 -16 flour tortillas ( i used whole wheat ) | 6 slices gouda cheese | 1/2 cup tea, freshly brewed | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat skillet and spray with non stick cooking spray. Place tortillas on cookie sheet and bake each side till brown. Spread out one side of each tortilla with a thin layer of cheese. Layer with 1/4 cup shiced red chili peppers, 1/4 cup toasted hazelnuts and 1 tbsp teh coffee powder. Top with a second tortilla, repeat. If you like, place tortilla on cookie sheet and bake till cheeses are melted. Place on plate top with a side of sliced avocado if desired or sour cream and salsa.

title: Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped capers | 2 tablespoons crushed asian pears | 1 tablespoon ground turmeric | 1 beef brisket, trimmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a small bowl, stir together the capers and pears with the turmeric. Rub the jerk seasoning mixture onto the brisket. Place the brisket on a baking sheet, and cover loosely with aluminum foil. Arrange the brisket in the prepared pan. Bake for 1/2 hour in the preheated oven, until the meat is tender, removing the aluminum foil and basted meat to a platter for the last 10 minutes.

title: Zucchini (Aubergine) Rollups
ingredients: 12 roma tomatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 1 zucchini ( about 3 1/2 pounds total ) | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f cut a horizontal slit in each tomato. Set the tomatoes upright on a baking sheet, skin side down. Cut a slit along the core of the tomato and peel away the skin. Slice the tomatoes crosswise in half lengthwise. Remove the tomato flesh from the cut side of the tomato, leaving the stem intact. Cut the pulp from the tomato into 1 inch pieces with a knife. Rinse the tomato pulp and pulp and return to the baking sheet. Sprinkle well with oregano and toss to coat evenly. Spread the tomato paste equally along the cut surface of each tomato, leaving a 1/2 inch border. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil on the stove. When the water is boiling, place 1 tomato skin side up, face up, into the water. Bake until the skin separates from the tomato and cracks about 10 minutes. Remove and let cool slightly. Using the tip of a sharp knife, score the pulp on all sides, about 1/2 inch deep.. Cut each tomato crosswise into 6 wedges.. Transfer the tomatoes to a serving platter and garnish with oregano. Place the zucchini cut side up on a cookie sheet, skin side up. Place in the oven. Bake 10 - 15 minutes, until just starting to brown and soften. Remove from oven. Sprinkle zucchini with cocoa and let cool until just warm. Wrap tightly with foil. Store covered in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,chili powder,bread crumb,barley,mirin,japanese mayonnaise,pepperjack cheese,pineapple tidbit
title: Hawaiian-Style Asparagus Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed asparagus, thawed and sliced in thirds lengthwise | 1/2 cup water left on pineapple tidbits or 1/2 cup drained canned pineapple tidbits | 1/4 cup barley, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons japanese mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet cooking wine ) | 1 teaspoon sweet chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepperjack cheese | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs, or as needed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh asparagus, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Arrange 1/4 each of the asparagus spears in the bottom of a skillet. Sprinkle evenly with 1/4 of the barley, mayonnaise, mirin, chili powder and pepperjack cheese. Roll the asparagus in the bread crumbs until coated. In a small skillet, heat 1/8 inch of water until simmering. Cook the asparagus steaks in the hot water until lightly browned, about 2 minutes on the first side. Slice the steaks in half and top each with 2 tablespoons of remaining barley, mayonnaise, and hot sauce.

title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat beans in saucepan until bubbly on top.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,basil,italian plum tomato,red chili pepper flake,grain rice,water,rice noodle
title: Rice Noodle Salad in Tomato Wine
ingredients: 5 italian plums ( such as san marzano ) | 1 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 3 cups hot cooked long grain rice, and | 1/2 cup sliced pepper sauce | 1 can diced italian plum tomatoes, drained
instructions: Cut plums in half and remove pits. Place plums and 3/4 cup water in a small bowl or saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat, and simmer until plums are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Cut plums in half if large. Remove white juices and seeds from plums and drain. Chop and set aside. Place the remaining 1/2 cup water in a saucepan over medium low heat. Add rice and basil and cook, covered, until rice is tender and water is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Add pepper sauce and diced tomatoes and simmer until heated through, about 2 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,italian seasoning,mace,tomato juice,cottage cheese,red pepper
title: Italian-Seasoned Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup italian seasoning | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1 can fat-free cottage cheese | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Season pork with italian seasoning. Refrigerate. Combine tomatoes and mace and set aside. Spray a skillet with canola cooking spray. Remove pork from marinade and place in skillet. Top with cheese and red pepper halves. Cook until cheese is melted.

title: Chili Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef top round or lbs top round meat, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 2 cans chickpeas, undrained | 1 can red pepper green chilies, undrained | 1 can beef tenderloin, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Heat oven to place meat and chilis in greased 13 by 9 by 2 inch baking dish. Spoon 1/2 cup undrained chickpeas onto beef in dish. Sprinkle beef with cayenne.

title: Honey Lime and Fruit Spread

title: Pasta and Chicken in Curry and Soba

title: Spicy and Creamy Moroccan Style Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon peel, finely grated | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon papaya, finely diced ( or other papaya pulp ) | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste or 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 lb salmon fillet
instructions: Combine the lemon peel, sugar, papaya, anchovy paste and garlic in a shallow dish. Rub salmon with half the lemon peel mixture, then with the other half of the lemon peel mixture. Serve with a salad and vegetables.

title: Baked Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili powder | 3 medium tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped | 3 medium chicken breasts, skin removed and sliced | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Place apples in a lightly greased baking dish and place in the oven to cook through. While apples are cooking, combine chili powder, lemon zest and 1/2 cup water and rub over chicken. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup water and lemon zest. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked.

title: Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 cup sunflower oil | 3 tablespoons simple syrup
instructions: Mix 1 cup of breadcrumbs and 3 tbsp of sunflower oil in a bowl. Mix well. Press the mix into a greased pie plate.. Prick bread crumbs with a fork. Pour 1 tbsp of syrup around the bread crumbs. Bake in a 375f oven until the crust is golden brown.

title: Filipino Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 12 small firm vegies, sliced in half ( vietnamese ) | 2 tablespoons cognac ( or brandy ) | 2 green onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a pan over high heat, add vegies, and stir fry about 10 minutes, turning once. Stir in cognac/brandy and continue to stir fry about 5 minutes, or until liquid from the vegies evaporates. Serve immediately.

title: Cherry Wraps
ingredients: 1 can of whole sweetened cherries | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 5 flour tortillas
instructions: Pour cherries into a large mixing bowl. Add cornstarch and mix well. Stir in cherries. Wrap and chill in refregerator for 1 hour. Heat an ungreased griddle or skillet. Spoon a few tablespoons of mixture onto center of warm tortilla, roll, and serve.

title: Mexican Spiced Bean Dip
ingredients: 100 g artichoke hearts, roasted, chopped | 100 g fat-free refried beans | 6 -10 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped ( not oil packed ) | 1 tablespoon spices, advieh ( mixed spice, or dried chipiffles )
instructions: In a non stick pan heat the oil over medium heat until very hot but not smoking, add the artichokes, sauteeing for 3 - 5 minutes, add the beans, sundried tomato and advieh mixed spice, stir. Reduce the heat to low, simmer on low for 30 minutes.

title: Fennel and Caraway Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons dried sage | 1 cup fish stock | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage
instructions: Combine caraway seeds, fennel seeds and sage in a small skillet over low heat.

title: Apricot Stuffing
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves | salt & pepper, to taste

title: Pasta, Macaroni & Tahini

instructions: Cook macaroni till tender in water with a dash of salt. Drain well. Combine macaroni with remaining ingredients and mix well. Put in individual serving bowls. Serve with more tahini and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,coriander,pesto sauce,potato,sauza commemorativo tequila,anise seed,greek yogurt
title: Red Lentils With Sweet Potato Puree and Yogurt (Bhindian Spiced Lentil Stew)
ingredients: 1/4 cup sauza commemorativo tequila | 12 ounces small sweet potato, peeled ( about 24 small ones. do not use a potato that has been cut into small chunks. ) | 1/2 cup red lentil, rinsed and picked over | 2 1/4 cups greek yogurt ( preferably using regular-fat greek yogurt, if yoghurt is not available ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh coriander or 1 1/2 tablespoons parsley leaves, divided | 1 pinch anise seed ( optional ) | granulated garlic and salt or red pepper flakes, for garnish

Add sweet potato and continue cooking until the potato is browned slightly on the bottom. It should have a little crunch, but it should still be warm. Stir in lentils, breaking up any large clumps with a spoon. Stir in 10 cups of yogurt and coriander or parsely. Turn heat down to medium low. Continue cooking until mixture begins to thicken as it simmers, 5 to 10 more minutes, stirring often. Add anise seeds if using. Season with salt or pepper flakes to taste. Serve immediately, garnished with remaining coriander and remaining 1/4 cup tequila.

title: Chicken Apple Salad for Two

Place the apple and carrot in a large, non stick sauté pan over medium high heat. Cook, stirring often until lightly browned, about 1 - 2 minutes. Stir in the sour cream, followed with the chicken, pecans and cooked apple pieces. Serve immediately or cool to room temperature cover and refrigerate up to 8 hours before serving. This salad is especially delicious with a scoop of ice cream, apple wedges and a crisp green salad.

instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Rinse & drain.

instructions: In a bowl, mix jam and vinegar. Set aside. In another bowl, tear bread into pieces. Toast bread lightly, and spread with a little jam mixture on both sides. title: Easy No-Stick Pudding
ingredients: 8 ounces self raising flour, sifted | 2 ounces butter & chocolate pudding mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1 cup butterscotch pudding mix ( vanilla flavour is lovely ) or 1 cup rosella non sweet potato pudding mix ( vanilla flavour is lovely )
instructions: Mix the butter & puddings together. Add the sifted dry ingredients & mix well. The mix should be the consistency of a thickie batter. Grease a 2lb pudding basin lightly but don't press it. Place the batter in the pudding basin & smooth the surface as much as possible. title: Soup Soup

instructions: Put the icing sugar, buttermilk and salt in a large pan and bring to the boil. Add the soup and cook for about 10 minutes. Random Ingredients: margarine,beet,whipping cream,thai chili sauce,green apple,pineapple juice,curry paste
title: Curried Beet and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 medium fresh beet, peeled | 1/2 cup canned crushed pineapple with juice | 1/4 cup unsalted margarine or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 -2 tablespoon thai hot curry paste | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1 tablespoon coconut milk or 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 large green apple ( cut into eighths )
instructions: Using a mandolin peel, finely shred beet and reserve. Rinse and drain pineapple, pat dry. Cut into pieces about the size of the beet, adding the pieces in the order given. Set aside while preparing the salad. Use the reserved beet soaking liquid to bring a good consistency to the dressing, and also to season. In a small bowl, use the same cut of oil to pour dressing over beet. Let sit for a few minutes to give a bit of moisture to the dressing and soften the pieces. Toss apple pieces with reserved beet soaking liquid. To cook on the grill, place beet on a hot griddle, cover, and turn over frequently until tender and browned. Place into a large bowl of cold water to cook, about 10 minutes or until tender. Drain well. If you are grilling the beet, you will have to cover them in the dressing. Transfer a bit of cooking liquid on them. Serve the salad with a dollop of whipped cream, or use the whipped cream to drizzle dressing. Note, if you have no method of using the dressing, you can leave out the whipped cream and the coconut milk, which would make this lovely salad a little too sweet.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,yellow pepper,broth,active yeast,lentil,almond extract,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Moroccan Shrimp and Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 1 large zucchini, finely diced into 1/2 inch pieces or | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, finely diced into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 lb shrimp, peeled deveined | 1/8 cup slivered almonds, toasted lightly | 1/2 cup ra el hanout spices ( can be found in middle eastern specialty food stores ) | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups broth | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold water and place in a large bowl. Rinse well and pick out any damaged lentils and rocks. Place in a large pot along with the zucchini, yellow pepper, and yeast. Add the shrimp, then cover and let ferment in a warm place for about an hour or until the shrimp and lentils are all well mixed. Drain the shrimp and lentils and discard the bones. Place the shrimp mixture back in the empty pot, add the almonds and raillein and knead with a mixer until smooth and creamy. Transfer to an oiled or parchment lined bowl coated with oil. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume. Add the almond extract and knead with the mixer a few times. Remove onto parchment lined baking sheet sprayed with oil. Cover and let rise again until doubled and doubled. Bake in pre heated oven at 400 degrees fahrenheit for about 60 minutes until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Roast Pomegranate and Chile Salad
ingredients: 100 g ricotta salata, cut into chunks | 400 g dried red chiles ( such ) | 1 pomegranate | 1 red chile, deseeded | 1/2 fresh parsley sprig | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Place the ricotta in a bowl with the dried chiles. Stir well to coat. Cut the pomegranate in half crossways, remove the seeds and scrape out the flesh. Cut the pomegranate into chunks and then cut into chunks. Cut a slit in the rind of the red chile and scrape out all the seeds. Place in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Let sit for 10 - 15 minutes until softened. Drain all of the water and return the rind to the bowl. Dry fry the red chili for a few minutes until it starts to soften. Add the dried parsley and fry another 2 - 3 minutes until lightly golden. Pour over the roasted ricotta. Garnish with the pomegranate and serve.

title: Chianti Veal Sandwich
ingredients: 2 veal cutlets | 8 slices deli ham | 3 ounces canned bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup pecans | 8 ounces chianti wine
instructions: Pound veal with a mallet or other heavy pan. Spread 1/4 cup chianti over the cutlets. Place one ham slice on top of each slice of veal. Remove string from ham. Spread with pecans. Place second slice of veal on top of the ham and put the sandwich between two pans. Heat up the bbq, place a napkin under hot grill and turn the sandwich over. Cook veal for about 3 minutes. Take sandwich from bbq and let sit 3 minutes while you make a dressing.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,chicken wing,lemon peel,lime zest
title: Easy Shredded Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 -9 lbs chicken wings | 1 -2 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 2 -3 tablespoons lime zest | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place chicken wings in a large pot of melted butter. Cover with water and bring to a simmer. Simmer until wings are tender but no longer bright green. Drain well and rinse with cold water. Return to pot. Add lemon peel and lime zest. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Turn off heat when butter has melted and wings are cooked through. Spoon into a 4 or 5 quart baking dish.. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake until golden.

title: Vanilla Bean Pudding
ingredients: 2 lbs ground nuts ( almonds, hazelnuts, pecans, hazelnuts- try nutella! ) | 5 lbs vanilla beans, scraped
instructions: In the bottom of an 8 quart pan add the ground nuts. The recipe suggests getting a big pan big enough with enough moisture for you to go spoon. If you get less, be sure to use 2 quarts of water, as it makes for quite unpleasant pudding. Put the scrapings of vanilla beans in the bottom of the pan. If using a regular vanilla bean you will need only the scrapings of two of these very large pieces. Cover the mixture with clean hot water and bring slowly to a boil, skimming the surface occasionally to prevent the water from boiling over. Stir frequently and continue to boil for three or four minutes. Cover and simmer very slowly until only about three puffs are left, about two hours. Remove from stove and place a baking dish on top, so the pudding collects in the corners and stays separated from the water. Cover with foil and place in a warm spot while making the vanilla bean praline filling. Remove the plastic covering from the praline and break off little pieces with a knife. This makes a lot of praline and keeps for one month. When ready to serve, boil about two cups of water in a large pot. Break off about two lbs of vanilla bean scrapings and add into the boiling water, and stir with a large spoon until the scrapes come to a boil. When the water boils again, add the split vanilla bean scrape and return to a boil. Skim the scum as it starts to rise. The water should boil down, but there should still be some whole vanilla beans that may be floating. Simmer for 30 - 40 minutes, stirring frequently. When the praline is just heated through remove from heat and stir in the hazelnut or cashew nutella. Place the bowl on top of a large plate and spoon the praline filling into it. This is optional but makes a beautiful presentation. You can decorate them by sprinkling lightly with vanilla powder or you can drizzle with icing sugar, grated chocolate chips or anything you like.

title: Italian Parsley Wine

instructions: Cut away root ends of parsley and gently remove the tough outer leaves if necessary. Place leaves in a saucepan of cold water, then bring quickly to a boil over medium heat. Lower heat and boil gently for about 5 minutes. Cool slightly. Remove stems from parsley and set aside. Using a mortar and pestle, crush parsley leaves with a flat blade of the blade. Heat wine in a large pan until boiling. Turn down heat and simmer over low heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Add parsley to pan, then let cool for a minute or two before serving.

Goes well on top of grilled chicken.

title: Easy Kale Noodle Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces soba noodles | 1/2 cup kalamata olive
instructions: Cook soba noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse with cold water. Place the noodles in a large bowl. Add kalamata olives and toss to coat salad lightly.

Random Ingredients: texas toast bread,chili powder,green olive,guacamole,egg,corn tortilla chip,shiitake mushroom,nori
title: Maggie's Fajitas
ingredients: 4 large eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup corn tortilla chips | 1 dash chili powder | 4 ounces sliced shiitake mushrooms ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon sliced green olives ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon guacamole | 8 thick slices texas toast bread ( optional ) | 1 sheet nori, broken into pieces
instructions: Mix eggs, tortillas and chili powder. Dip mushrooms in egg mixture then place on top of tortilla chips. Spread guacamole over shrimp mixture. Sprinkle with olives and sprinkle with cheese. Wrap in plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,cardamom seed,roasting chicken,cauliflower floret,white bean,red snapper,bicarbonate soda
title: Maurice's Mulligatawny Soup
ingredients: 350 g roasting chickens | 150 g cauliflower florets | 250 g small white beans | 300 g sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom seed ( a small grind ) | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Clean, wash and soak the chicken in a pot for minimum four hours.. Remove the pieces of chicken at the joints if necessary, and remove any remaining organs. Boil the cauliflower and beans with plenty of water in a large pan, until the cauliflower and beans are tender. This should take about four to five minutes. Meanwhile, add the bicarb soda to a cup of water and add to the soup with one half of the cheese cubes dissolved in it, stirring the mixture. When the soup thickens it should be rather thin and smooth. Remove the chicken pieces, reserving the oil for the garnish, and allow to cool. Cut the chicken into small pieces and set it aside. Remove all the bones from the chicken and add it to the soup. Heat up the remaining cheese in a pan and add the spices. Add the chicken legs and the cauliflower and beans when the soup is boiling. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for fifteen minutes at least. Serve the soup warm with lots of bread for the soup with a little bit of fresh bread alongside it for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: baguette,almond extract,puff pastry,beef tenderloin,heavy whipping cream,turmeric powder
title: Beef Tenderloins With Almonds and Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 pinch turmeric powder | 4 beef tenderloin | 32 small baguette, rounds | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed, thawed according to package directions
instructions: In medium bowl, combine the cream, almond extract and turmeric.

title: Grilled Chinese Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb bacon | 2 tablespoons soy sauce, regular soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( to taste )
instructions: Cut bacon into strips or squares or you could pound your strips or slice into strips on individual serving plates. Mix 1/2 teaspoon of salt with the soy sauce. In a skillet over medium heat, saute the bacon in the soy sauce. Turn occasionally until slightly crisp on edges, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,no salt tomato,vanilla pudding mix,lard,lime peel
title: No Salt Tomato Dessert
ingredients: 1 package frozen lime peel | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 2 tablespoons lard | 2 cups no-salt-added crushed tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 2 quart ovenproof bowl and place over medium simmering water. Cover, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until slightly thickened at the top. Remove from heat, and pour into serving dish. Serve immediately.

title: Ethiopian Sweet Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 kg vidalia onion | 2 1/2 kg red onions | 4 large red onions ( or 1lb each )
instructions: Peel the red onions and onions and slice up the roots into smaller wedges, peel the onions and cut into small wedges, boil the onions and red onion until they are almost translucent. When the onions are clear, peel and cut up the red onions with your hand and mix all the ingredients together until well mixed. Simmer for at least 45 minutes. Serve with plenty of injera.

title: Dill Picker's Famous Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon fillet | 1 teaspoon mustard | 3 lbs round steaks
instructions: Clean the salmon fillet and cut lengthwise into 5 slices. Arrange in a small shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle mustard on top of fillet and then pour remaining bottle of beer or water over fish. Cover tightly and roast at 450 degrees degrees for 15 to 20 minutes. The fish should flake easily with a fork. If you have leftovers, it should be tender but not tough.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,tomato ketchup,cherry tomato,lime juice zest,gluten flour,worcestershire sauce
title: Tomato Based Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2/3 cup soy flour | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of | 1 1/3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 14 cherry tomatoes | 1 tomatoes ketchup ( i use heinz ) | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Add your barbecue sauce to a pan on the stove and simmer. For a lighter based sauce, use a crockpot on the stove. I normally boil the sauce for 10 minutes to thicken it for a few minutes before adding to the sauce i have found that i always make this sauce on the bbq and when cooking on the bbq i add the tomato ketchup and simmer for 4 - 5 minutes.

title: Duck Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups all-purpose white flour | 1 duck, boned and cut into chunks | 2 pounds shiitake mushrooms | 24 maraschino cherries | 5 pounds flank steak, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 6 cups vinegar, divided
instructions: Place flour into a large plastic bag. Place duck pieces, mushrooms, and cherry pieces into the bag. Dredge the duck pieces in flour. Place the bag of duck into a pressure cooker with water to cover. Lock the lid onto the pressure cooker. Cook 15 minutes. Remove lid and cook an additional 15 minutes to release steam. Remove duck, mushrooms, and cherries. Whisk 2 cups vinegar into the remaining vinegar in the pressure cooker. Heat vinegar mixture over medium high heat until boiling. Turn down heat to medium low as steam rises from the vinegar. Cook, maintaining high pressure, until the duck is tender enough to be flied between your thumb and finger, 30 to 45 minutes. Use tongs for easy removal from the pot and serving.

title: Baileys Irish Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup baileys irish cream | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender & mix with whisk. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pickle relish,thyme sprig,seasoning mix,pistachio nut,doritos,worcestershire sauce
title: Crispy Dorito Bars (Patatas Bravasi)
ingredients: 2 cups finely crushed dorito snacks, crushed ( or any crushed flavored ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon prepared sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme ( or 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted pistachio nuts or 1 tablespoon chopped cashews ( or more ) | chopped fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Lightly coat a jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Mash the doritos with a fork in a mixing bowl and then add the worcestershire sauce, relish, sweet pickle relish, and thyme. Stir well. Press the mixture into the pan. Sprinkle the topping over the dorito. Sprinkle with the nuts or cashews. Press the nuts into the patatas. Allow to set up. Cut into squares when firm.

title: Homemade Buttermilk Taco Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups buttermilk | 1 1/4 cups tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups taco sauce
instructions: Place the buttermilk, tomato puree and taco sauce in a deep pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and bubbles, about 10 minutes.

title: Nigerian-Flavoured Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped mixed fresh herbs ( such as parsley, chives, chinese celery seeds ) | 3 green pepper rings, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup finely shredded coleslaw | 1/4 cup finely chopped unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh chives | 8 8-inch flour tortillas or 8 -12 corn tortillas
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the herbs, peppers, coleslaw and peanuts. Mix well. Spread a heaping tablespoon of filling on each tortilla about 3/4 of the way up. Fold in half and press to fit. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil to cover the bottom. When the oil is very hot and starting to smoke slightly, add 2 quesadillas. When they have browned on one side, flip them over and brown the other side. Remove the quesadillas from the skillet using a slotted spoon, and set on paper towels. When all the quesadillas have been fried, heat the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons oil in the skillet. Add the remaining quesadillas to the skillet and cook until golden and just heated through, about 5 seconds per side. Serve the quesadillas warm or at room temperature. Variation, to lightly cook the tortillas in oil, cut one side of each tortilla in half.

title: Egg Bakes
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons oriental sesame oil | 1 tablespoon margarine, melted
