instructions: Mix mustard, oil and margarine together until blended. Scoop the mixture into an 8x8 inch square pan, or an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool. Refrigerate unused portions.

title: Mexican Chicken on a Bed of Flatbread
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts, chopped into small pieces | 3 tilapia fillets, cut into large chunks | 2 tablespoons minced green chili peppers | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Place chicken and tilapia in a large bowl and toss to coat. In a small bowl, stir together the green chili and sherry until the mixture is very well combined. Pour over the chicken mixture and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 3 - 2 hours, turning occasionally. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Place the coated chicken on a large non stick griddle or large frying pan and bake on the rack for 8 minutes, turn and bake for another 11 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked.

title: Gramma's Fried Cabbage (Hungarian)
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage | 2 cups broth or 2 cups fish stock
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir until cabbage is wilted and heated through. Variation, add shredded or sliced bacon, sausage, and chopped fresh herbs.

Random Ingredients: half,cauliflower floret,chili pepper flake,self raising flour,wine,beet,ketchup
title: Spicy Beet Bites
ingredients: 1 large beet, cut crossways into 8 pieces | 8 cauliflower florets | 1/3 cup chopped fresh chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons self raising flour | 2 tablespoons dry wine | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Slice 1/8th inch off of the beet and discard the core, then slice each beet into 16 small chunks, discarding the stalk and cut into 6 - 8 chunks. Place the beet and cauliflower in a large mixing bowl and season with pepper flakes. Drizzle with the flour and stir in the wine. If the mixture resembles breadcrumbs, add the ketchup and half and half. Toss the mixture together until thoroughly coated. Spoon into the prepared trays and spread lightly. Bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until the bites are bubbling and golden brown around the edges.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,chocolate syrup,plain yogurt,spaghetti noodle,coconut oil,half,white flour
title: Simple Chocolate-Crusted Noodle Pancakes
ingredients: 200 g spaghetti noodles | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon white flour or 1 tablespoon gluten-free flour | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cook the noodles until tender, drain well and place in a bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and mix all together. Add 1 tbsp of melted butter to a hot pan. Cook the pancake mixture for 1 - 2 minutes each side.

title: Chinese Buffet Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can straw mushrooms | 3 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce | 3 -4 tablespoons hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Cut mushrooms into quarters or halves. In a small bowl, mix the sweet and sour sauce with hot sauce. Pour sauce over mushroom pieces and mix well. Refrigerate overnight and stir or eat right away.

title: Italian Sausage and Pumpkin Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces italian sausages or 8 ounces bulk sausage | 1 container frozen pumpkin puree, thawed | 1 container cool whip
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. In skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until sausage is no longer pink. Drain if using bulk sausages. Stir in pumpkin puree. Pour mixture into 9x13 pan or 2 small casseroles and sprinkle top with cool whip. Bake 20 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,lime wedge,pine nut,mix,oregano leaf,mint leaf,chili flake,plain flour
title: Pine Nut & Vanilla Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 small chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves ( or other herb of your choice ) | 1/2 cup plain flour | 3/4 cup sweetmeats prepared sweet-and-sour mix | 1 vanilla bean | 1 lime wedge, for squeezing
instructions: Heat oven to 220c. Place pine nuts and chilli flakes in a food processor.

title: American Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1 package shell pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook shell pasta in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: BBQ Puerto Rican Sweet and Spicy Pizza
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 2 teaspoons spicy hot, or ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup pizza sauce | 1/2 cup water | shredded cheese
instructions: Drain crushed pineapple, reserving liquid. Place pineapple into a food processor and whirl until smooth, adding hot sauce, liquid smoke, pizza sauce and water. Pour into a bowl and refrigerate. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Spread toppings on a pizza or bun with a little shredded cheese. Broil, 3 to 5 inches from heat or until cheese is melted. Allow pizza to warm to warm oven, or remove from oven. Place a couple of slices of pizza onto a plate and top with a few spoonfuls of toppings of your choice. If serving hot, place on baking sheet. Place in oven for 3 to 5 minutes until cheese has melted and is bubbly. Serve hot.

title: Spaetzle for Chips
ingredients: 12 ounces cornflour ( cornstarch ) | lemon wedge
instructions: Combine flour and cornflour, and knead until the mixture starts to come together. Knead dough until it comes together. Shape into small patties and fry in a little sunflower oil. Remove and drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,kosher salt black pepper,cornmeal,cayenne pepper,tamarind paste,pasta,lemon juice zest
title: Quick Tamarind Beef Stew
ingredients: 3/4 cup tamarind paste | 3/4 cup cornmeal | 2 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | fresh lemon juice, and zest of | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 by 3. 5-by-inch cubes | 4 cups cooked pasta
instructions: Prepare the tamarind paste, place the tamarind paste in a small bowl and pour 2 cups of water into it. Using your hands, combine the strained tamarind paste in a bowl, 1/2 cup cold water and the cornmeal. If the mixture is too dry, add up to 1 1/2 cups of water. Season the beef with salt and cayenne pepper. Place the beef in a crockpot. Pour the strained tamarind water over everything. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours, or on low for 8 hours, or until beef is tender. Stir in lemon juice and zest while the stew is cooking. Serve over cooked pasta.

title: Faux Cheese Bread
ingredients: 6 ounces self-rising flour | 10 ounces white bread, crusts removed
instructions: Combine flour and bread in a bowl, add a little more flour if necessary. Knead to a smooth, elastic consistency. Turn onto a floured surface and press into a 1½ inch thick round cake pan. Cover with greasproof paper and let stand for 30 minutes. Pre heat oven to 225°c / 400°f / gas mark 5. Mark the top of the bread with a fork, and carefully prick with a fork twice more. Bake for about 30 minutes until a nice golden brown colour.

title: Sushi sheet
ingredients: vegetable broth | 1/2 cup uncooked nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder ( optional )
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the liquid is reduced by 1/2, 5 to 7 minutes. Mix rice vinegar with remaining ingredients in a bowl until dissolved. Cook and stir over medium heat until simmering. Dip rice sheet in the vinegar mixture. Lay nori on a bamboo sushi mat, flip over, and roll into a tight cylinder shape. Cut roll into about 1 1/2 inch squares. To eat, hold sushi square in your hand and pull down the inside edge of the nori square to the right. Place some sushi square onto the rolling mat, sprinkle with more vinegar mixture to taste, and roll up and the mat into a firm cylinder. Cut roll into quarters with a very sharp knife dipped into vinegar and dipped into vinegar, and roll each roll up tightly. Slice each roll crosswise into 1 1/2 inch squares.

Random Ingredients: fillet tilapia,chipotle chile,ham,pastry dough,red chilies,red potato,vanilla pudding mix
title: Pat's Smoked Hors D'oeuvre
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked ham | 24 small red potato | 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix | 6 -8 small dried red chilies, crushed | 12 fillets tilapia | 1/2 cup chipotle chile, chopped | 1 quart pastry dough ( i like to roll out a handful )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º f. Combine chiles and potatoes in a large bowl and microwave until very thick and smooth. Let cool for 30 minutes. Line two cookie sheets lined with foil with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix cheese with the crushed red chile. Place the tilapia fillets on a cutting board and slice into four equal sized pieces to fit the pan. Top fillets with the potato mixture and top with some of the chipotle chile mixture. Fold the edges over to create a pouch. Carefully place the foil packages in a baking dish, seam side down. Bake til the fish flakes when tested with a fork it should have a nice brown crust. Place on a cutting board and let cool on the foil for 15 minutes. Using a sharp knife, remove the fish from the foil and put on one side to cool. Serve with a green salad. A side dish of a cucumber salad would also be good too.

title: Chicken and Rice (Jasmine)
ingredients: 2 whole boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 cup dark corn syrup | 4 plums, ripe, cut in quarters | 1 cup jasmine rice, cooked
instructions: Slice chicken in 2 pieces crosswise. Pour corn syrup and stir to combine. Arrange chicken, cut side down, in a baking dish. Sprinkle plums and rice over chicken. Bake, covered, in a preheated 375°f oven about 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Serve chicken with juices.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,virgin olive oil,italian seasoning,fennel bulb,agave nectar,parsnip
title: Leprechaun Friendly Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, quartered leaving the peel on | 3 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemongrass | 1 1/4 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 pinch fennel bulb, crushed | 1 tablespoon agave nectar
instructions: In a large saucepan cook the parsnips in boiling salted water for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and toss with the remaining ingredients. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,mango,yellow onion,parsley leaf,chicken bouillon cube,butter margarine
title: Rump Steak With Ginger in Onions and Mango
ingredients: 2 large rump steak, cut 1 inch thick | 3 tablespoons butter or margarine, melt | 2 tablespoons minced yellow onions | 1/3 cup sliced mango, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1 maggi chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Heat butter in skillet on medium high heat. Add onions and cook just until tender but not browned. Pour in mango and cook just until warmed. Pour chicken stock and simmer, stirring, until mixture thickens. Add parsley. Remove juice from cube and season with salt and pepper to taste. Plate, top with onion mixture and serve.

title: Tripe Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs tripe, steamed, peeled, and quartered | 1 1/4 lbs monterey jack cheese or 1 1/4 lbs farmer cheese ( 1-2 cups )
instructions: Arrange cheese on 8x8 inch baking dish. Arrange sliced meat or tripe in layers evenly over cheese. Cover loosely with foil, and bake at 350 f 15 - 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and slightly bubbly.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,italian salad dressing mix,white onion
title: Italian Country Salad Dressing Mix
ingredients: 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1 white onion, diced | 2 cups olive oil
instructions: In a large bowl, mix salad dressing mix, onion and olive oil. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.

title: Mushroom, Broccoli, and Ricotta Soup Dip With Swiss
ingredients: 1 pint fat-free low-fat milk ricotta cheese, drained | 1/2 chicken stock cube, dissolved in 2-3 cups water | 1 cup broccoli, washed, stem removed, and cut into small flowers ( optional )
instructions: Place ricotta in a bowl and stir in the stock cubes. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Place broccoli into a saucepan of boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain thoroughly. Stir into the ricotta mixture. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 - 15 minutes, or until frothy.

title: Red Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, mix well. Cover, and refrigerate 1 hour to overnight serve at room temperature or chilled. Scoop out mixture into small serving bowl leaving a small mound of mixture in the centre.

title: Pampered Chef Pepperoni Cheese
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 8 fluid ounces good quality almond milk | 4 fluid ounces vegan sour cream
instructions: Line your cheese trays with waxed paper, and lay the pepperoni slices on the paper. Spread 1 tablespoon milk into each of the pepperoni slices, then top the pepperoni slices with 1 tablespoon sliced almond milk. Wrap up the cheese trays and freeze until solid, at least 3, about 8 hours. Stir the dairy substitute and sour cream together and serve.

title: Frozen Bean Curd
ingredients: 1 cup black beans | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 1 sheet dark chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon bean paste
instructions: Freeze beans for at least one hour and up to 1 month. Melt chocolate and place in a glass bowl with water. Allow to set. Place frozen beans in microwave safe bowl. Slowly drizzle chocolate over beans and stir. Microwave, stirring twice until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons store-bought roasted salami, finely chopped
instructions: Finely chop the ginger. Place the ginger in a skillet over medium heat, add the pesto sauce and cook, stirring to mix, until lightly caramelized. Stir in the salami to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Asparagus With Pecans and Caraway
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs wooded asparagus spears | vegan margarine | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup pecans
instructions: If using fresh or frozen asparagus spears, rinse and cook in a large saucepan of boiling water with some salt until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels and immediately toss with a little margarine. Toast or coarsely crumble caraway seeds in a large skillet over moderate heat until golden, about 1 minute. Spread pecans on a baking sheet and roast in a 350f degrees oven, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle the toast with caraway seeds. Transfer to a serving dish and stir.

Random Ingredients: filling,half,sun tomato oil,saffron thread,butternut pumpkin,beef brisket
title: The Real Russian Roast Corned Beef
ingredients: 4 3/4 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 tablespoon saffron threads | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups drained and quartered butternut pumpkin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 f degrees. Lay the brisket on a rack in a roasting pan.

title: Mint Chocolates
ingredients: 50 g dark chocolate, 70 % cocoa-sweetened | 125 mint leaves, chopped ( about 6 tablespoons ) | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Melt the chocolates in a small saucepan. Combine with the chopped mint leaves.

title: Mushy's Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushroom, cleaned and quartered | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup green onion, chopped
instructions: Heat a 12 inch skillet. When hot, add mushrooms and cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, until all the liquid in the skillet has been absorbed. Mix cornstarch with some water, pour into skillet and whisk a little while stirring, till thickened. Add green onions. Serve over hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: white bread,watermelon,sharp cheddar cheese,monterey jack cheese,pumpkin seed,pear
title: Cheesy Pear and Melon Toast
ingredients: 1/2 cup white bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup canned pears, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups watermelon, cubed | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons sharp cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook first four ingredients in a large skillet, tossing occasionally, until golden, 8 - 10 minutes. Top with cheeses and pumpkin seeds.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,hot red chili pepper,lamb,cumin seed,vanilla essence,mango
title: Lamb in Sweet Curry Sauce
ingredients: 500 g lamb, cut into thin strips | 12 ounces broccoli florets | 1/2 cup mango, cubed | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 2 large dried hot red chili peppers | 2 tablespoons light vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer to blend flavours. Cover.

title: Irish Cream Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken parts ( cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks ) | 1 egg, beaten | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 16 ounces penne | 12 ounces irish cream
instructions: Cook chicken in remaining 1/4 cup plus 1/4 cup plus icing sugar and 1/8 cup plus 1/4 cup plus maple syrup in a large nonstick skillet over medium until browned, stirring often, about 6 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon to a bowl, set aside. Add the egg to the skillet, cook stirring, until it begins to turn opaque, about 2 minutes. Stir in the remaining 1/4 cup plus 1/4 cup plus 1/4 cup plus 1/4 cup plus 1/4 cup plus 1/4 cup plus 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup mixture. Cook, stirring, until it begins to steam, about 1 minute. Add the pasta to the butter sauce and toss over medium heat until it begins to wilt, stirring with a fork. Stir in the chicken, then remove from heat. Serve, passing parmesan cheese and fresh seasonal veggies.

title: Pasta Gasiovakia
ingredients: 300 g semolina | 5 tablespoons semolina | 250 g butter | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract or 1 teaspoon real vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 500 g phyllo pastry ( i used frozen phyllo pastry for one batch )
instructions: First start heating up a large pot of water to boil. If you have a convection oven, your oven should be hot enough to melt the semolina in the water. Once boiling, turn off the heat and allow it to cool slightly. Once the water cools and is warm to the touch, add in the grated semolina. Allow the semolina to sit for at least 15 minutes, if the semolina is soft and sticky, it will come together in a similar way. Mix in the butter until the butter is completely soft. Add more semolina if you need to. Once the semolina is toasted, you have to begin working with half the butter and one of the other ingredients. After the semolina is toasted, add the vanilla and half the vanilla sugar. Mix all the ingredients well. When it is toasted and creamy, spread into a greased 9x13 pan. I use a cookie sheet so the phyllo doesn’t get cold. Use the back of a spoon to press the phyllo pastry up the sides of the pan to get as much air as possible out of the pastry. The goal is to get as much air as possible out of the pastry. After it has been in the pan, spread out evenly with the back of your spoon so that it’s flat and even. Then place another sheet of phyllo on top of it, slightly thicker than the first layer, and press together on the sides of the pan to create a 'dirt' effect. Make sure it doesn’t spread thinly, because when you’re in the oven, it’s just to dry out some air. Cook in the oven on the stove top. When the phyllo is toasted, place on a plate and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,macaroni,meat,coriander seed,corn kernel,brown rice,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Rice and Meat Soup (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup shredded meat ( your choice ) | 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 can corn kernels ( without the corn or beans ) | 1 jar niblets chunky salsa ( or use mild-medium or hot ) | 1/2 cup corn kernel ( fresh or frozen or canned ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 -2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a rice cooker or large bowl.

title: Hummus with Beetroot and Beets
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 beets, peeled and grated
instructions: Place beans in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, stirring to break up any clumps. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Drain and allow to steam dry for about 5 minutes. Stir in beetroot. Serve with hummus.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,scallop,chili flake,lemon pepper,ranch bean,serrano ham,dark soy sauce
title: Chinese Style Crayfish, Ham and Scallops
ingredients: 12 scallops | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 2 teaspoons fresh chili flakes | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 can ranch-style beans
instructions: Whisk the dark soy sauce, chili flakes, lemon pepper and cayenne in a plastic bag. Place the scallops in the bag and shake until the scallops are covered. Set aside. Reheat the oil in a large sauté pan or wok over medium high heat. Sauté the scallops and the chili flakes until the scallops are opaque, about 2 minutes. Add the drained beans and continue to cook until the scallops are warmed through and the beans are beginning to stick to the back of the spoon, about 2 minutes longer. Serve over hot rice.

title: Simple Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Brown and drain sausage. Add tomatoes, green chiles and hot sauce to sausage. Simmer sauce 1 hour.

title: Pork With Fragrant Vanilla
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | 1/4 cup frangelico | 2 tablespoons tomato puree, strained from tomato
instructions: Trim the loin of meat of any fat on both sides. Score the skin by slicing a diagonal slice from the edge to the bottom at the rib joint, into fat, pushing it through the course hole of the knife repeatedly as you cut the meat. Brush each meat with a little of the Frangelico. Bring the meat back to the surface and leave for 5 - 6 hours or preferably overnight. Remove the loin from the Brine and, using 2 forks, shred it into chunks. Bring the cooking liquid to the boil. Add the meat chunks to the liquid in the pan. Cover tightly with a tight fitting lid or tightly cover the pan. Simmer gently over low heat for a further 2 1/2 hours, skimming from the surface as necessary. Skim off any fat. To serve, ladle the pork into warm soup plates. Garnish with some fresh herbs. Serve with your favourite hard bread and toast.

title: A-B-G
ingredients: 2 ripe hass avocadoes | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1 teaspoon dried chili | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1 yellow pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Peel, pit and mash avocados. Mix together flour, chile and sage in a food processor. Add enough water to make a batter resembling pancake batter. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add avocado batter to skillet and cook until the batter turns dark brown and the avocado is slightly puffy, about 1 - 2 minutes.

title: A.1. Mushrooms (Low Fat & Hot)
ingredients: 1 -2 mushroom | 2 -4 tablespoons chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( or to taste )
instructions: Clean mushrooms and cut off stems. Cut mushrooms away from stems and cut into 2 inch pieces. Place in microwave safe bowl and coat with chili powder, chili pepper flakes and water to cover. Microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes to soften the mushrooms. Stir mushrooms and mix well. Microwave for an added minute or two just to heat everything together.

title: Bread and Butter Balls
ingredients: 150 g wholemeal buckwheat flour | 2 tablespoons brown breads, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon grand marnier or 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 3 tablespoons low-fat yogurt
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl. Form the mixture into small, bite sized balls. Roll each one in the yoghurt and put them on kitchen paper to dry out. Serve.

title: Quick Peach and Orange Kebabs
ingredients: 4 large ripe peaches, cut in half lengthwise and flesh cut crosswise into 16 slices | 12 tablespoons frozen lime-free concentrate, thawed | cooking spray
instructions: Thread peach slices onto 5 skewers each skewer. Arrange coated kebabs on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil. Spray with cooking spray. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until kebabs are browned and center is just firm. Serve warm.

title: Yoghurt Sticks
ingredients: 3 cups greek yogurt | 1 jar pimentos
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with plastic wrap. In a large bowl, combine yogurt, pimentos and pimentos. Cover bowl, and chill in refrigerator 4 hours.

title: Broiled Steak
ingredients: 6 -8 steaks | 1/3 cup sake | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon granules | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: In shallow baking dish, mix chicken bouillon and sake and pour over steak. Cover and marinate 6 - 8 hours. Line broiler pan with aluminum foil and spray with non stick cooking spray. Place meat on rack of broiler pan and broil 3 - 5 minutes per side. You may have to broil in batches depending on oven used. Sprinkle cheese over steaks before serving.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lemon,buttermilk,tortilla chip,cocoa powder,cream cheese
title: Pizzagaina (Pita)
ingredients: 3 cups crushed tortilla chips | 2/3 cup cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/3 cup dried parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 3 lemons, juice of | 1 pinch cocoa powder
instructions: Combine the sour cream and the cheese and stir until it is blended. Add the cheese mixture and mix well. Add most or all of the remaining ingredients. Let stand for a few minutes. Put the pizzagaina on a pizza peel and form 3 - 4 small round pizzas. Slide the pizzagainas onto a baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Sprinkle each with cocoa and bake in preheated 400f oven for 7 minutes until browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool.

title: Laban (Yogurt and Onion)
ingredients: 1 quart low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 medium onion, sliced
instructions: Place onions in bowl and cover with plain yogurt. Cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight, turning over the bowl every hour to coat. The yogurt may be stored in the refrigerator in an airtight container for up to 2 months.

title: Spanish Rice Using Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth | 3 cups ham, cut into 1 inch cubes or 3 cups bacon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups grape kernels
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine broth and ham. Bring to boil.

title: Chinese Take-Out Fried Pork
ingredients: 8 ounces sirloin pork, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons salt pork
instructions: Heat large nonstick frying pan over high heat until it shimmers. Add sirloin pork to pan and saute until slightly charred, about 2 minutes on each side. While pork is browning, coat a 2 to 2 1/2 quart nonreactive dutch oven with the dark sesame oil. Drain pork on paper towels.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste )
instructions: For 1200 watt microwave oven. Line 12x16 inch pan with foil. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Measure out confectioners' sugar, mustard, and cayenne. Stir to combine. Spread mixture in pan. Place in microwave. Cook on high 30 seconds. Allow to cool, then remove foil. Place in freezer, allowing to defrost overnight, or place in refrigerator to speed up prep for work surface and prevent drying out during the final baking of the pastries.. Cut pastry into 48 squares. To use, trim off excess pastry with scissors or a pastry wheel. Roll each square into a tight circle. Place on baking sheet and allow to dry at room temperature.

title: Quick and Easy Oven Noodles
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked egg noodles | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: masa harina flour,beef chuck,coriander seed,liquid smoke flavoring,ketchup,rosemary,thyme sprig
title: Texas Smoked Beef Tacos
ingredients: 6 -12 small, bone-in beef chuck, about 1 pound | 1 cup masa harina flour | 2 fresh rosemary, leaves stripped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 3 dashes liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Place chuck in gallon freezer bag, seal and place in freezer until firm, about 2 hours. Remove meat from freezer bag, scrape out the air and let it sit at room temperature. Cut off tops of the bones and discard. Cut each portion of meat into 1/2 inch pieces. Add to zip lock bag or bowl of your choice of storage container. In a small bowl, combine the masa harina flour, rosemary leaves, coriander seeds, thyme, ketchup and liquid smoke. Whisk until well blended. Stir in the meat using fingers, your hands if needed, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 2 days. Refrigeration time will depend on how tender you like your meat. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Tacos may be frozen at this point for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: radish,chunky peanut butter,italian parsley,chinese salt,cooking oil
title: Peanut Butter and Radish Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | sesame oil or cooking oil | 3 -4 tablespoons dry-roasted chinese salt | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 small radish, peeled and cut into thin rings
instructions: Pour peanut butter smoothly over a clean, dry salad. Stir into remaining dressing ingredients, adding more if desired.

title: Nacho Cheese Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces shredded cheese, of your choice ( monteray jack, etc. ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup chopped macadamia nuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in blender and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,garam masala,bamboo shoot,iceberg lettuce,tomato,walnut,salt black pepper,asparagus
title: Tandoori Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup asparagus, cut in 2-inch pieces | 6 -8 stalks asparagus, woody ends trimmed and discarded | 3 medium tomatoes, chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons walnuts or 2 tablespoons pistachios, chopped | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1/4 cup slivered almonds or 1/4 cup slivered pine nuts ( or pine nuts & chopped pistachios )
instructions: Cook asparagus in boiling salted water for 3 minures or until crisp tender. Drain well and refresh under cold water. Set aside. Wash asparagus. Drain well and pat dry. Cut tomatoes in half horizontally. Remove cores and seeds from tomatoes. Chop tomatoes. Season to taste with salt & pepper. Stir in garam masala, chili flakes and walnuts or pistachios. Divide salad evenly among 4 plates. Top with asparagus, tomatoes, chopped lettuce and almonds or nuts.

title: Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants, peeled, and cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices | 3 tablespoons old fashioned oatmeal | 3 ounces shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 lb snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the eggplant slices in a lightly buttered shallow baking dish. To make oatmeal topping, combine 1/4 cup oatmeal, pepper jack cheese and 1/4 cup water in a bowl. Add snow peas to oatmeal mixture and toss to coat. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup oatmeal topping over vegetables. Cover and bake in preheated oven until filling is hot and snow peas are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,oyster,date,golden syrup,chinese duck sauce,red onion,masala
title: Oyster and Date Salad
ingredients: 10 shucked oysters | 10 dates, large | 1 red onion, large, slivers | 1 teaspoon feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 teaspoons chinese duck sauce | 1 teaspoon masala
instructions: Place the oysters on a baking tray and bake at 190c for 5 - 8 minutes, until the oysters are just soft. Remove from the oven and place them in a large bowl. Slice the dates into smaller pieces, and roughly chop the onion. Add the dates and onion and toss together. Mix the dressing ingredients and pour over the salad and toss well. Serve.

title: Grilled Chicken Breast and Rice
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves, about 6 ounces each, skin on | 1 tablespoon ground caraway seed | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 1/2 tablespoons sake | 1 3/4 cups shortgrain rice or 1 3/4 cups arborio rice | 4 cups hot cooked corn
instructions: Heat grill pan to medium heat or set oven rack to lowest setting. Combine caraway and lemon zest in a small bowl and add chicken. Coat chicken lightly with caraway mixture. Spread chicken with 1 teaspoon caraway mixture and cover. Cook chicken in direct and unfiltered grill over medium coals about 6 to 7 minutes per side for medium doneness. Arrange chicken on a heated platter. Sprinkle rice over chicken. Turn and brush with remaining caraway mixture. Cut crosswise into thick slices. Cut each slice on the diagonal into 1/8 inch wide, 2 inch pieces. Serve with corn on the cob.

title: BBQ Steak
ingredients: 4 lbs flank steaks or 4 lbs round steaks | 1 tablespoon cracked black pepper, to taste
instructions: Trim steak of visible fat, and excess fat, and cut into 6 slices across the grain. Sprinkle meat with cracked black pepper, to taste. Cover and let marinate in refrigerator, turning meat occasionally for 30 minutes. Remove meat from refrigerator. Place steaks on large greased grill rack or other flat surface. Close lid and cook, uncovered over heat to 145f degrees for 4 to 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness is achieved.

Random Ingredients: panko bread crumb,rice,rump steak,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Spiced Indian Loose Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rump steak, cut into very thin strips | 2 tablespoons panko bread crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1/3 cup rice
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place meat on baking sheet. In small bowl, combine the bread crumbs with the spice rub. Place the meat on top. Broil on high 5 minutes, until the crumbs are lightly browned.

title: Spicy Thai Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons lime rind, finely grated | 3 cups ice (, for boiling rice )
instructions: Place rice, hot sauce, curry paste, soy sauce and lime rind in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until tender. Stir in ice and leave to stand 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Enjoy.

title: Feta Cheese and Fava Bean Preserves
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs dried fava beans | 1/2 cup fresh lemon verbena mixed with | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Rinse the beans in cold water. Wash in very cold water. Drain and pat dry. Place in a pot large enough to accommodate them in one layer without touching them. Cover with water to a depth of 1/2 inch below the beans. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer 30 minutes until tender. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 400°f place all fresh ingredients in 2 bowls, making sure each is well coated with the lemon mixture. Drop 1 heaping teaspoon of the mixture into each bowl of food and lemon. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is firm.

title: Eggplant Chips
ingredients: 2 large eggsplants | 4 cups oil ( for frying )
instructions: Peel the eggplants. Cut each eggplant into 6 - 8 pieces, about the size of a dime. In a large bowl, break the eggs. Crack the egg whites into the bowl with the egg beaters. Add enough oil to make about 30 eggplant chips. Mix well. When oil is hot enough to deep fry, drop in the eggplants and fry 2 minutes, turning often, until golden brown on all sides. Drain well. Repeat as needed to make up 4 batches of fried eggplant.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,dark brown sugar,vanilla essence,cilantro stem,cilantro
title: Warm Moroccan Harissa or Spice Blend for Lamb Satay or Shish Kabobs
ingredients: 750 ml dark brown sugar | 75 ml ra el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro stem ( or 2 teaspoons dried cilantro ) | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro stem, or | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro stem ( or 2 teaspoons dried cilantro ) | 1 teaspoon coarse quality vanilla essence ( or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, mix the sugar and olive oil. When it starts to caramelize, add the ra el hanout or mix of spices and cilantro sprigs and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,button mushroom,cilantro leaf,orange flower water,chocolate,poppy seed,apricot
title: Fantastic Vegan Chocolate Tapas
ingredients: 100 g bittersweet chocolate | 1/2 cup poppy seed ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons dried apricot, coarsely chopped | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons orange flower water | 2 tablespoons grated orange-flower water ( optional ) | 10 sprigs fresh cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Break the chocolate into chunks and place with the poppy seeds in a pan. Bring to boiling point and set aside, then leave to cool completely before processing with the apricots and bay leaf. Spoon into a bowl. Stir in orange blossoms and enough water to give the mixture a pouring consistency. Place over a low heat, stirring constantly until melted. Pour the chocolate into small pots, and cover with plastic wrap, place in the fridge and chill until firm, about 10 minutes. Garnish with the sprigs of cilantro.

Random Ingredients: anchovy,beefsteak tomato,dark rum,pearl barley,red kidney bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Beefsteak and Barley Risotto
ingredients: 2 lbs beefsteak tomatoes | 1 can red kidney beans | 4 cups pearl barley | 1/3 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 18 -24 anchovy ( optional )
instructions: Put tomatoes into large pot with water. Stir and bring to boil. Boil vigorously until cooked through, about 5 minutes. In separate pot, bring 4 cups of red kidney beans to a boil. Cook until tender but still firm tender. Drain and place back in pot. Mash tomatoes until smooth. Add drained tomatoes, barley and rum. Cook, stirring constantly for about 5 minutes. Add cheese and anchovies. Cook 1 minute longer to heat through. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve right away, but it can be frozen in zipper bag or plastic bags.

title: Raspberry and Leek Mousse
ingredients: 300 g plain yogurt or 300 g mascarpone cheese | 1 cup milk chocolate, melted | 1/2 cup leek, grated | 2 scallions, chopped | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 cups fresh raspberries or 2 cups frozen raspberries
instructions: Combine all ingredients except berries and pour into a bowl. Stir over a low heat, and then chill until cold. Stir berries into mixture. Serve at room temperature,.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,mushroom,achiote powder,white pepper,sun tomato oil,coconut milk powder,rotini pasta
title: Rotini With Dressing
ingredients: 1 medium whole wheat tortillas or 1 medium pita bread | 12 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 1/3 cup mushroom, sliced | 1 can white mushroom in syrup, undrained | 3/4 teaspoon anise powder | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 can coconut milk powder
instructions: Heat coconut milk powder until creamy, not liquefied, not boil. Cut tortillas into 1/4 inch strips. Heat oil in a skillet. Cook tortillas, one at a time, on medium high heat, about 1 minute until crisp. Remove and drain on paper towels. Drain shrimp. Add mushrooms, saute, and spices, saute about 1 minute. Add pasta, continue to stir while adding water according to package directions to desired consistency. Top with parmesan cheese, salt and pepper to taste.

title: Danish Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Wash the cabbage and cut very finely. Place in a baking dish and pour 1/2 cup of cold water over. Add a little salt. Place in 325 oven for 45 minutes, stir, and remove from stove. After 15 minutes, toss, return to oven, and bake for a further 15 minutes, or until the cabbage gets crisp and tender and dry.

title: Cornstarch Peroshky
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup oil | 2 -3 tablespoons hot paprika
instructions: Mix the cornstarch and oil on a pastry cloth or wax paper until the cornstarch is thick and smooth. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat until nice and hot. Pour in all at once and swirl around with a spatula to evenly coat the bottom. Stir the cornstarch mixture, scraping the sides of the pan with clean fingers. Once the mixture boils, stir all the while until it bubbles and begins to thicken. The trick is to stir constantly so as not to dislodge the cornstarch, and not to burn the bottom. Remove from heat. The cooked cornstarch should be clear, not browned. Pour into a large paper bag, or use in place of the cornstarch mixture. Let sit for a while while to settle, then place the bag or paper bag onto the cornstarch mixture. Remove the cornstarch bag or paper bag, or cut it into smaller pieces and toss it in with the cornstarch mixture. Taste and correct for saltiness and color and thickness. If you eat all day or two, you might prefer to sprinkle 1 tablespoon of oil on top to give it a crisp finish.

title: Caribbean Rum
ingredients: 2 ounces dark rum | 1 pinch ground cardamom
instructions: Shake well and pour into a hurricane glass over ice. Sprinkle with cardamom and serve immediately.

title: Lemon Bell Pepper-Salsa, Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 can spicy chili, drained ( i use ortega brand ) | 1 large red bell peppers or 1 large green bell pepper, cut into strips | 10 ounces taco shells | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | steamed rice, for serving
instructions: In food processor, blend chili, bell pepper and taco shells until blended. Add thyme and lemon extract. Serve with rice.

title: Greek Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1/2 cup chopped kalamata olive | 1 can chicken broth
instructions: Cook rice and cook kalamata olives and broth together in a skillet sprayed with oil or cooking spray. When rice is done, add to skillet. Stir and serve.

title: Molded Salmon With Cream and Pasta
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet, skinned ( approx 1.7 pounds ) | 2 ounces fresh salmon fillets ( approx 1.7 pounds ) | 1/4 cup whipping cream | parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: Rinse salmon and pat dry with paper towels. Cut salmon fillet lengthwise into 3/8 inch thick slices. Sprinkle half of salmon with salt and lightly dust with more salt. Place slices over 1 side of a square piece of parchment paper or waxed paper and press salmon slices into fish to fully immerse. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 4 hours. Heat a heavy skillet until a drop of water sizzles and evaporates on contact. Add 1/4 cup cream and spread over salmon slices. Return skillet to the table and carefully transfer salmon to the skillet. Cover and cook for about 4 minutes on one side until browned,. Carefully remove skillet from heat and place salmon slices on top of the cream. Return to broiler and broil salmon for a few minutes, until salmon is just beginning to flake. Season to taste with salt and freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Tenderloin of Beef With Sherry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 center-cut beef tenderloin, fat removed | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons hot chili pepper, seeded | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon reserved beef fat
instructions: To make the vinaigrette, combine the half and half, vinegar, hot pepper and cayenne and blend well. Pour over the beef tenderloin. Cover and chill in the refrigerator 4 hours or overnight. Remove the meat from the refrigerator 30 minutes before roasting. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Heat the reserved beef fat in a large heavy frying pan, or grill, and roast the beef for about 20 to 25 minutes, or until just cooked through. Transfer the meat to a large carving board or carving board, tent with foil and let stand for 5 minutes. Slice the meat, serving it with the warmed vinaigrette. Serve with the sherry vinaigrette. Note, if using a roasting pan with a cover, arrange the meat directly on the rack of a roasting pan and roast the meat just until the thermometer registers 140°f for rare to medium rare, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Irish Yellow Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 lb dried yellow peas | 8 ounces beer or 8 ounces dark beer | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped | 1 -3 cup milk
instructions: Put peas in the soup pot with enough water to cover them, and add salt and let them soak overnight. The next day drain the peas, and rinse them well. Let them dry out for about 5 - 10 more hours, then set them aside. In a medium sized mixing bowl, mix the flour with the sesame seeds, mint, and milk. Slowly whisk in the beer or beer. Bring the soup to a slow boil, then lower it and simmer for about 1 hour or until the peas are tender. Take off the heat. Take the peas out off the water and reserve. Take the peas out of the soup pot and put to one side. The water can be skimmed off so it will warm as the soup goes inches strain the soup and serve.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,chili powder,pork roast,kiwi,portabella mushroom,chunky salsa
title: Smoked Pork Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs pork roast | 4 lbs portabella mushrooms or 4 lbs arugula | 3 -4 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 2 kiwi, sliced into rounds
instructions: Prepare grill by setting your oven rack 4 to 6 inches from the heat. Remove roast from baggy, and season with a light dusting of salt. Using tongs, place meat on your work surface and spread salsa over it. Use a spoon to spread the sizzling salsa over the roast and top with the portabella mushroom or arugula. Place kiwi slices on top, then lightly sprinkle with chili powder and salt. Replace it in the grill and grill 5 to 7 minutes per side for medium rare. Remove kiwi slices and let rest about 5 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,apple cider,cumin seed,beef chuck,margarita mix,whipping cream,olive oil
title: Beef Braised with Cumin and Apple Curd
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, in 1 1/2-inch slices | 1 box margarita mix | 1/4 cup olive oil | 10 ounces apples cider | 2 -3 tablespoons freshly grated cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons grated cumin seeds | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Place the meat in a 9 x 11 inch casserole dish, sprinkle with salt. Add enough water to cover the meat and place it in a pot or dutch oven. Bring to a boil over high heat.

title: Glorious Grog
ingredients: 1 lime, halved | 1/4 large green bell pepper | 1/2 cup grand marnier, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon dark rum, or more to taste
instructions: Squeeze lime juice into a small bowl. Slice green bell peppers lengthwise into long strands, and set aside. Stir green pepper slices into lime juice in separate bowl.

title: A Very Easy French Dressing
ingredients: 6 tablespoons fresh tarragon, minced | 2 teaspoons hot pepper flakes
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients. Cover, and chill.

title: Delicious Cream Broonie
ingredients: 600 g heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon ground garlic | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Place the heavy cream, garlic and sugar in a heavy bottomed pot and simmer until the cream just begins to boil. The cream can have extra fluid when it starts to boil. Allow the cream to simmer until it is reduced to a thick cream, which will take a few minutes depending on how thick the cream is. Once you notice the cream has reduced to the required liquid, remove the pot from the stove and stir in the cream. Serve immediately.

title: Chicana Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salad dressing | 1 -2 red chilies | 1 sun-dried tomato | 25 g slivered almonds
instructions: Chop the sun dried tomatoes into quarters or chunks put in a bowl. Crush the chillies. Toss tomatoes and chillies together in dressing. Grate the almonds over the top. Note, if the dressing is to be spicy, use some chopped chilli. The flavour is very subtle and is easily changed. This salad is best when made 2 hours before serving to let the flavours develop.

title: Okra and Spinach in brandy (Shakshouka)
ingredients: 500 g fresh okra or 500 g frozen okra | cooking oil | 5 tablespoons brandy or 5 tablespoons rice wine | 300 g fresh baby spinach | 400 g condensed tomato soup ( heinz )
instructions: Cut the okra thawed with a knife down the centre, remove the stems, and cut them into 1 cm pieces. If you want it to be thicker, cut it in half. Dip the okra pieces in brandy and then fry them in 2 tbsp oil for about 5mins on each side. Remove from pan and drain the okra pieces on absorbent paper towels. Increase the heat of the pan and cook the okra in batches, until they are golden brown and heated through. Remove the okra from the pan and place them on a serving dish. In a frying pan put 5 tbsp of oil and 3 tbsp of brandy. Stir till the oil begins to smoke. Add the okra and the spinach and cook for 2 - 3 mins until the spinach is browned. Drain the okra on paper towels. Add the tomato soup and the remaining 3 tbsp of oil to the pan and stir to combine well. Simmer for 3 mins, pour over the okra and spinach and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,red chili,chinese five spice powder,spinach,oregano,honey
title: Homemade Spicy Sausage With Fresh Spinach
ingredients: 300 g english spinach ( or bun weight ) | sunflower oil | chinese five spice powder | 3 dried red chili | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Wash the spinach and pat dry. Place in a heavy based sauce pan with just enough sunflower oil to cover. Add five spice and the dried chilli powder and stir well. Cover and cook for 20 minutes over a gentle heat until it collapses. Remove lid and stir until most of the water has evaporated. Add cooked sausages and the honey. Toss well to coat. Set aside to marinate for several hours in the fridge to marinate. The cooked sausages will keep up to 2 days at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cajun spice,chorizo sausage,vanilla extract,arborio rice,oyster sauce,cocoa,virgin olive oil
title: Chorizo Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage, casing removed | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla extract | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun spices | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Cook chorizo in a skillet over moderately high heat, turning occasionally, until browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and cool, then crumble, then stir in rice, cocoa, oil, vanilla and cajun spice mixture. Refrigerate 30 minutes, or until rice is completely dry. Make filling by stirring oyster sauce with about 1 teaspoon warm water in a small heavy saucepan, then cook, stirring constantly, until water is evaporated and sauce is thickened slightly. Store filling in refrigerator or freeze in airtight container at least 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,miracle whip,vanilla essence,ice water,saffron
title: Gohan's Chipotle Bliss
ingredients: 10 chipotle chiles in adobo | 6 tablespoons miracle whip | 3 1/2 tablespoons saffron | 1 1/2 cups ice water | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for one hour. This will make it easier to mix, so you can adjust the amount of ice cream required. Enjoy with a scoop of ice cream.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,extra virgin olive oil,thyme,vermicelli,greek yogurt,cardamom seed
title: Gramma's Vermicelli Baked With Yogurt and Vermicelli
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups low-fat greek yogurt, at room temperature | 4 cups extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod, crushed | 1 box vermicelli, broken into 4 pieces | 1 3/4 cups maraschino cherries or 1 3/4 cups other sour cherry blossoms
instructions: Combine yogurt, olive oil, cardamom, thyme and extra virgin olive oil in bowl of food processor or large measuring cup. Process yogurt mixture until smooth, about 5 minutes. Transfer to container. Add in zest of cardamom pod, crushed cardamom pods and vermicelli. Cover and marinate for 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Preheat oven to 300°f line 3 large baking spoons with aluminum foil. Place 1 bundle of vermicelli in each serving plate. Arrange 1 bundle of yogurt mixture in center of each plate. Garnish with cherries. Serve with sliced bread. Enjoy.

title: Spinach Yogurt Cake
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 6 ounces spinach leaves, torn into quarters | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Heat the oven to 300°. Line a deep 15 x 10 x 1 inch jelly roll pan or a shallow cake tin with parchment paper. For the cake, in a large bowl, stir together the yogurt with the cider. Add the baking soda and stir until well incorporated. Add the spinach and lime juice to the yogurt dressing mixture and stir to combine. Spread evenly into the prepared pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until puffed and golden. Remove from the oven and let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and cool. Serve immediately with vanilla ice cream or fresh fruit.

title: Tasty Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh lean bacon | 1/2 - 3/4 lb ground lean pork | 3/4 cup shredded philadelphia cream cheese ( creamy type cheese. ) | 1/4 cup light olive, pitted and chopped | 2 tablespoons canned diced chilies, drained
instructions: Chop bacon and sauté in medium skillet until just about crispy. Remove bacon with slotted spoon and add to food processor. Add pork and pulse to crumble. Add cheese and pulse until blended. Add bacon back in, and add chilies. Stir well to combine. Heat through. Best when made in the microwave for about 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes.

title: Baked Beef on Skewers
ingredients: 4 lbs ground chuck | kosher salt & fresh ground pepper
instructions: Pre heat the grill to med high. Sprinkle the beef, salt & pepper on generously. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,spaghetti,snow pea,parmesan cheese,liquid honey
title: Crunchy Snow Peas Salad With Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 1 package frozen snow peas, thawed | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons liquid honey
instructions: Cook pasta to desired tenderness.

title: Easy Coiltern Mushroom Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder, bone in | 1/3 cup raw swiss white mushroom
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In a heavy plastic or foil roasting pan or roasting pan, place the pork shoulder. Salt and pepper the pork. Add about 1/3 of the mushroom and enough water to come half way up sides of meat. Cover pan tightly using foil and a lid. Make sure the foil is at least 3/4 of the way up the side. Bake for 3 hours then remove the foil, bake for another 30 minutes or until done. Remove from oven and place pork on cutting board.

title: Chicken in Marsala Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground chicken breast ( or other firm vegetarian meat, such as chuck ) | 1/4 cup green peas, cooked in boiling water and drained | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder or 3/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce, homemade or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Heat a wok over high heat until hot but not smoking. Add the chicken and stir fry until it is no longer pink. Add the peas, coriander and chinese barbecue sauce and stir fry for 3 to 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens slightly. Serve immediately.

title: Prawn and Pea Curry
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/3 teaspoon cardamom, ground | 1/2 cup peas, frozen | canned sliced olives | fresh cilantro
instructions: Prawns or large prawns, place all ingredients in a large bowl, adding 1 tbsp oil to each. Rinse prawns under cold water, pat dry with paperpaper towel. Heat a wok over high heat, add another 1 tbsp oil. When hot, add 1/2 tbsp oil.

Random Ingredients: cream,green bell pepper,flour,mushroom,kosher salt,plain yogurt,chicken wing
title: Easy Low Fat Chicken Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, cut at joints separating chicken breast wings | 1 cup flour | 1/2 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 can mushrooms, undrained | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Dredge chicken wings in flour to coat. In a large skillet, cook chicken in remaining marinade about 4 minutes or until browned. Add mushrooms, sour cream and pepper.

title: Sushi Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 1 cup snow peas | 4 ounces mixed fruits | 1 can orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup mirin | 1/4 cup green
instructions: Put vegetables into bowl. Combine rest of ingredients in a small pot. Bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute. Immediately add to veggies and toss. Serve immediately. Sushi rice, add 1 cup rice to rice bowl. Mix and enjoy.

title: Crusty Cheese with Chile and Garlic
ingredients: 8 ounces white cheddar cheese, shredded, about 2 cups | 1/4 cup roughly chopped cilantro leaves | hot paprika
instructions: Stir together cheddar and cilantro in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,sunflower oil,tomato juice,liquid smoke,rice vinegar,stewing beef,potato starch,turmeric
title: Lomo Saltado -- Curried Beef  Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 cups russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 medium potato, diced | 1 can tomato juice, with the juice | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 -3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a large wok or stew pot brown the beef with salt in the oil, then add all the other ingredients except for potatoes. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Serve over white rice.

title: Kale-Strawberry Trail Mix
ingredients: 2 quarts fresh strawberries or 2 quarts frozen strawberries, thawed and chilled | 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 bunch fresh kale leaves, washed and torn into pieces | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning, or more to taste ( optional ) | 10 fresh sage leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the drained and chilled berries with the kidney beans and kale. Use less and more seasonings to taste.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,white wine,red wine vinegar,pinto bean,cardamom pod,taco sauce,pecan
title: Taco Pork Loin
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork loin roast, trimmed | 1 cup pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup light red wine | 3/4 cup light corn wine or 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup taco sauce, low sodium salsa | 12 cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted and chopped, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast, if necessary. Place roast in a large zip top bag.

title: Roasted Spiced Pork Dinner
ingredients: 2 lbs pork ribs | 2 bell peppers | 2 cups potato flour ( mixed with 1/2 cup reserved from cooking roasting )
instructions: Wash and cut up the pork, peppers and vegetables. Place them in a roasting pan which has been rinsed and patted dry. Spread the potato flour on the bottom of the pan. Spread the pork mixture evenly over the pork. Cover with the remaining potato flour, pour water over and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 1/2 hours or until the meat is cooked and the vegetables tender.

title: Pista _ a Pista (Pistachio Nuts)
ingredients: 1 cup pistachios, shelled or 1 cup almonds, ground in a blender | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed
instructions: Boil pistachios until they turn brittle and golden brown in color and are hard. Remove from heat and keep aside. Pour in the pistacranuts and continue stirring until they turn brittle. Dont let this scorch. Transfer the pistacranuts to a clean, dry container and dry thoroughly. This can take several days. When ready to use, store in a well sealed container.

Random Ingredients: queen olive,sesame oil,metal skewer,saffron thread,curry powder,guacamole,rack baby back pork rib,extra virgin olive oil
title: Caribbean Stuffed Rack of Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1/16 teaspoon saffron threads ( i use kosher ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil ( preferably spanish ) | 1/3 cup curry powder ( or more to taste ) | 8 racks of baby-back pork ribs ( about 2 pounds ) | 2 ounces queen ripe olives, drained ( or kalamata ) | 1/4 cup saffron strand ( optional ) | 1/2 cup quesen olive, pits removed | 1/2 cup guacamole ( recipe above ) | metal skewers
instructions: Curry powder, dissolve saffron threads in 2 tablespoons oil in small bowl. Add sesame oil and curry powder and mix well, let stand 5 minutes. Pat pork generously with the curry mixture using your hands to remove excess oil. Brush each rack with olive oil before stuffing with the curry mixture. Cook in a 325°f oven until meat thermometer registers 130°f for medium rare, about 3 hours. Tent rack with foil if meat browns too quickly for you. Cool 20 minutes before slicing. Sauce, add olives to pan and toast over medium heat, about 3 minutes. Stir in saffron to taste. Toss ribs with olives and olive sauce. Serve with guacamole and skewer garnish.

title: Homemade Cherry Chips
ingredients: 5 -5 cups fresh cherries, washed | sunflower oil
instructions: Put cherries, grapes, a few drops of oil, some salt and a little black pepper in a bowl. Let them sit for about an hour or two to allow the cherries to swell up. Take them out and pat dry with a paper towel and dust with sugar. Store in an air tight container.

title: Greek Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat ( i use stew beef already cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Coat pot with non stick spray and put lid over and put lid back over pot. Cook at 300 degrees for 1 hour. Meanwhile in a small bowl mix the salt and marjoram into the beef well. Add stew to pot and cook an extra 15 minutes, adding more salt as needed, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,raspberry,barley,sirloin steak,nam pla,sherry wine,cumin seed
title: Mexican Beef With Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 3/4 cup barley | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 3 tablespoons nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 2 cans rotel diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry, cut into pieces or 12 whole raspberries, in brine
instructions: Place steak, barley and cumin in a large resealable bag. Toss to cover with sherry. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or longer. Remove from bag and discard marinade. Remove steak as needed and discard marinade. Using a very sharp knife, cut a 1 to 1 1/2 inch slice from steak and discard. Transfer steak to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover evenly with rice, tomato puree, sherry and drained berries. Press down meat with the back of a wooden spoon. Place pan on middle rack of oven and bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes. Cut into 6 serving size servings and serve with crusty bread or tortillas.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,angel hair pasta,salt black pepper,corn syrup,yellow cornmeal,ice water
title: Pasta With Sweet Corn
ingredients: 8 ounces angel hair pasta, uncooked | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ice cold water | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, sweet or regular | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup spaghetti sauce, sweet
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta, cook as directed on package, draining when 'al dente'.

title: Curried Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a microwave safe bowl with enough water to cover. Cook on full power in the microwave for 25 - 30 minutes on full power, or until cauliflower is tender. In the last 30 seconds, stir in coriander and coconut extract. You may also add a dash of salt, if desired. Let cool slightly. You can also add a tiny bit of sugar if you wish.

title: Scallops in a Crunchy Rice Crumb Crumb Cake
ingredients: 1 lb scallops | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Drain the scallops and add the raisins to the scallop cavities. Combine the rice vinegar and crumbs and add to the scallop cavities, along with the drained scallops. Mix thoroughly. Bake in a 350 degree oven until firm. Cool. Cut into bite sized squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger ale,rice,beef bouillon granule,ramen noodle,pineapple juice
title: Asian Ramen Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 ounces beef bouillon granules | 3/4 cup orange-flavored ginger ale | 1 can pineapple juice | 7 tablespoons rice or seven-up ramen noodles, crushed | 7 tablespoons ginger ale | 5 -8 pieces toasted nori seaweed rounds
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve beef bouillon granules in the 3/4 cup orange flavored juice. Add crushed ramen noodles, pineapple juice and rice or the seven seaseme rounds. Mix well. Pour into a glass or plastic bag, making sure the meat and ramen are covered evenly, and marinate for 1 hour on the counter. Heat a frying pan over medium high heat. Remove meat from bag and cut meat into desired size pieces while partially covered with marinade. Cook meat in the hot frying pan for 10 minutes. Remove meat and drain marinade from frying pan and discard. Return meat to the frying pan. Add crushed ramen noodles and 1 tablespoon gingerale and toss to mix thoroughly. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Pasta Ww Low Fat
ingredients: 1 package penne | 2 cans italian-style tomatoes | 1 medium onion | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Cook penne according to the package’s directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Meanwhile, chop onion and place it in a medium pot over medium heat. Add tomato juice, cocoa and onion powder. Bring to boil. Pour over pasta and stir until well combined.

title: Almond Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped almonds | 10 ounces condensed bouillon granules | 1 cup coarsely chopped dried cherries ( can try to get them in as well )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine almonds, bouillon and cherries. Put sauce in blender jar and pulse until the almonds and cherries are chopped fine. That is now your sauce. Serve immediately, or over cooked pasta of your choice.

title: Homemade Salt (Homemade Sugar)
ingredients: 1 cup shortening ( not tub butter ) | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: Using a large bowl, mix the salt until dissolved. Cut the shortening or butter into the mixture by rubbing together with your fingers. Add the mustard. Leave the mixture in the bowl in a cool place until you are ready to use this as your dough. Knead the dough until you obtain fine crumbs. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead briefly. Divide into 4 balls and gently roll them until somewhat flat and even in shape. Place the rolls on a floured baking tray and allow them to rest for 20 minutes. When they are completely rested, cut each roll into 4 strips about 1/2 long by 2 wide. This process can also be done with a pizza cutter. Bring a small pot of lightly salted water to the boil. Add the strips and allow them to boil one minute. Lower the heat and simmer, uncovered, until they are very tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and serve. My grandmother makes her own mustard by combining 1/2 cup mustard powder with 1/4 cup sugar in a small bowl. Dip the strips into the mixture before dipping in hot water for a few seconds.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,italian turkey sausage,plum tomato,hamburger,pork shoulder,beef sausage
title: Italian Crabmeat and Sausages
ingredients: 4 italian turkey sausage ( about 1 1/2 lbs. ) | 1/2 lb hamburger | 1/2 lb pork shoulder | 1/2 lb crabmeat | 1 plum tomato, diced | 8 ounces italian turkey sausage, casing removed
instructions: Remove casings from turkey sausage and crumble meat and place them in a large skillet with remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling and cook through, stirring regularly for about a half an hour. Serve with pasta or rice and cheese. Can be made a day ahead and placed at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,strawberry jam,chili flake,longhorn cheese,monterey jack cheese,lime wedge
title: Baked Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 4 cups shredded longhorn cheese | 3 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup strawberry jam | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dry active yeast | 2 -4 key limes or 2 -4 green onions
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Spread on cookie sheet. Put on oven rack in oven. Bake for 15 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cut with knife into six wedges.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,pistachio,chili,chipotle chile,velveeta cheese,catsup,apple pie spice,provolone cheese
title: Mexican Cheese Dip - Fast and Easy
ingredients: 2 lbs velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 2 cans chipotle chili con queso ( spicy jalapenos ) | 1 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon apple pie spice | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon chili ( i prefer mild ) | 14 1/2 ounces pie spices | 6 small fresh chipotle chiles, in adobo ( drained ) | 4 1/2 cups fresh velveeta cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: In a large saucepan, add the sliced velveeta cheese and 2 cans of chipotle chiles. Melt the 2 cans of chili con queso over low medium heat,. Stir to combine and add to cheese. Add in the remaining cans of chipotle chiles and comine the 2 - 4 cans of chili con queso over medium heat. Stir to combine and add in the 3 cans of chili con queso over medium heat. Stir to combine and add in the 11 - 14 ounces pie spice package. Stir to combine and add in the cardamom, chili, and apple pie spice. Simmer for about 60 minutes. While the mixture is simmering, mix the remaining can of chipotle chiles and 3 1/2 cups Velveeta over medium low heat. When the mixture is done simmering, cover and let go into it's initial slow boil setting for at least 2 hours, and then serve the hot mixture over hot, cooked white rice. I usually serve this dip with a big green salad, with garlic bread and a side salad for dinner guests. I have made this with green peppers and tomatoes and it was amazing.

title: Cheese With American Fonduta
ingredients: 2 cups freshly grated american cheese | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Melt the cheese in a large skillet over low heat. Don't let it boil. Remove from heat. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,red curry paste,confectioner ' sugar,taco seasoning,tamarind pulp,sake,tortilla
title: Deep Fried Taquitos
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp, drained and strained | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 packet crispy tortillas
instructions: Beat cream cheese, curry paste, tamarind pulp, chili oil, and sesame oil in a bowl with an electric mixer until blended. Stir in confectioners' sugar, and shape into a 1 inch thick patty. Chill before frying in hot oil. Makes enough taquitos to make 20 tacos. Serve as part of an all purpose spiced japanese style dish, along with french fries. Alfredo sauce, in a saucepan over medium heat, mix tamarind pulp and red curry paste. Cook 5 minutes and stir in confectioner's sugar until thick, then remove from heat.

title: The Humble-Wheat
ingredients: 250 g swedes or 250 g courgettes, in 2 cm cubes | 400 g cooking oats | 500 g quick-cooking rolled oats
instructions: Place the first 6 ingredients in an ovenproof dish that is in a pan. Pour over boiling water and place on the middle shelf of the oven, gas mark 7 until soft and the oats come to the top of the vegetables. Bake at 200°c until the oats are crispy and golden.

title: St Patrick's Day Green Tomato Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces green tomatoes | 3 -4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 cup fresh arugula, finely chopped | 1 1/2 pints icing sugar or 1 1/2 pints icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Cut rind off green tomatoes and dice them finely. Place in a colander over cold water to dry and drain off liquid and pat dry with paper towel. Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a frypan over medium high heat. When hot, add baking soda, stir well and immediately remove from heat. Add chopped tomatoes and chopped arugula. Let sit about 10 minutes. Dice up 1 1/2 pints of icing sugar and stir into tomatoes and arugula mixture. When icing sugar has become translucent add a small amount of the warm syrup stirring all the while. Continue stirring until all the icing has melted. Pour into a bowl and leave for at least 1/2 hour to set. Serve sprinkled with more icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,red kidney bean,graham cracker,thyme leaf
title: Grilled Salmon and Kidney Bean Snack Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can canned red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 cup coarsely crushed graham cracker | 1 1/2 ounces boneless skinless salmon fillets, cut into 2-inch-thick slices
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine beans, thyme and cracker crumbs. Drizzle with 1/4 cup cold water and gently toss to mix. Spread half of bean mixture evenly on the cut sides of the salmon slices, then drizzle top with 1/2 cup bean mixture. Sprinkle salmon evenly with salt and pepper. Grill 4 to 5 minutes, until lightly browned on top.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,baking potato,harissa,anise seed,espresso,beer,corn tortilla chip,kidney bean
title: Bean and Egg Tacos with Smokey Harissa
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed | 4 large baking potatoes, peeled | 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1 1/4 cups corn tortilla chips | 1 cup brewed coffee, such as kahlua
instructions: Blend the beans with the espresso and harissa in a double boiler over hot water, stirring occasionally until thickened, about 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature and stir in aniseed. Place the potatoes in a saucepan, fill with water to just below the rim of the pan, and stir in about 7 cups water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender but still very firm, about 20 minutes. Drain and cool to room temperature. Peel the potatoes and slice very thin, about 2 inches long. Place potatoes into a bowl. Add the eggs and 1/2 cup of the brewed coffee.

title: Tater Tot With Quinces
ingredients: 1 package frozen tater tots | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chopped dried quinces, unpeeled ( if any, they are very small, you can use a large can of quinces whole )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss the tater tots, oregano and quince flakes with about 2 tbs. Of olive oil, then arrange in an ovenproof casserole. Repeat with the remaining tater tots and spices, reserving a few quinces for garnish. Top with the reserved quinces. Place in a 400 degree f oven and bake until the quinces are tender and lightly browned, about 20 - 25 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Vietnamese Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup water | 1 cup hot asian chili oil | 1/4 cup rose water
instructions: To make 1 1/2 cup ginger and 2 tablespoons sichuan spicy sichuan spicy sichuan spicy oil, heat 1 stick cooking oil in a small amount of water over a medium low heat until aromatic.. Turn on stove for a few seconds, then remove the burner. Add 1/4 cup of water, the aromatic oils, and the 2 teaspoons of hing. Add a handful at a time until the noodles strain out all of the liquid into a clean bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of spicy sichuan spicy oil to the water, and stir. Stir once more. Add 1/4 cup of hot water, and repeat with noodles. Drain noodles well, then spread on a kitchen towel to dry, and put in the refrigerator for about 2 hours. Store covered at room temperature for up to 6 months before using. The oil will keep for several weeks, but it won't last that long refrigerate for longer than a couple of weeks before you use it.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,creme de menthe,flour,lime wedge
title: Creme de Menthe Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 pieces chicken bouillon cubes | 1/8 cup creme de menthe | 2 cups flour, for dusting | lime wedge ( to serve )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large plastic bag. Put bag into refridgerator, turning bag over occasionally to coat. Refridgerate 2 - 3 hours or until sauce is thick and bubbly. Preheat broiler. Place wings onto a rack coated with cooking spray. Broil about 2 minutes per side or until light brown and cooked through. Serve warm with lime wedges.

title: Lemon Biscuits
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflour ( also known as cornstarch or cornmeal ) | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon zest ( optional ) | 12 sage leaves, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix the cornflour with the icing sugar and add the zest. If using leaves, lightly fry in heated olive oil. Spread over hot biscuits whilst still warm and then sprinkle over more icing sugar or sprinkle over more zest if desired. Variation, you can use just plain plain white bread or biscuit crumbs. Use 3 tablespoons icing sugar depending on your taste.

title: Chipotle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs baby peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup parsnip, diced | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning ( mccormicks montreal seasoning ) | 2 tablespoons chili powder ( i prefer szeged brand )
instructions: Place peas in a bowl or ziplock bag. Add seasonings and toss to combine. Cook in microwave on high, 5 - 10 minutes until fragrant, shaking bag every 2 - 3 minutes, coating peas with seasoning.

title: Green Olives Appetizer (Kisir) Appetizer
ingredients: 1 -2 lb mixed salad green ( or other greens of your choice ) | 1 can chopped mild green chilies | 4 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce ( or teriyaki sauce or a sweet chili infused teriyaki sauce ) | 1/2 cup stuffed green olive
instructions: Mix thoroughly salad greens or greens of your choice to make desired servings. Pack on a platter, packing down tightly. To taste, drizzle with a few drops sriracha hot sauce and sprinkle with olives. Variation, for a thicker version, toss in a couple of tablespoons of kiracha paste.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,godiva dark chocolate bar,yellow cornmeal,cumin powder,saffron strand,plum tomato,almond extract
title: Tantalizing Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups jasmine rice | 1 large plum tomato, cut into large chunks | 1 tablespoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 2 2 tablespoons yellow cornmeal or 2 tablespoons brown rice flour | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon fresh almond extract | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon saffron strand, toasted ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 ounce godiva dark chocolate bar, broken into 4 pieces
instructions: In a small pot, melt 1 tablespoon of dark chocolate. Set aside on the side. In pot, bring 3 quarts of water to boil with saffron. Add sliced plums. Dry the plums on their side and remove them from the pot with a slotted spoon to a bowl. Set aside. In same pot, melt the second tablespoon of dark chocolate and set aside on the side. Add rice and cumin to pot. Cook over high heat, stirring frequently. Add the tomato chunks. When the rice is almost half cooked and soft, stir in the saffron. If it looks dry, add a little water.
