If it seems dry, stir in a bit more water. Lower the heat, and stir in the coconut flavoring. Serve hot. Sprinkle with toasted toasted almond or walnut pieces.

title: Straw Hats Polish
ingredients: 4 tablespoons orange peel, powdered | 1 lb fresh strawberries, sliced in 1/2 '' pieces | 1/4 lb fresh fresh filling, cut up ( optional )
instructions: If using fresh mushrooms, fill each 1/2 inch or 1/4 inch half of a mushroom cap with the orange peel. Cut the ends off the cap and cut out the stem, then slice each cap very thin crosswise. Place the slices in the saucepan of powdered mushroom fat on low heat. Add the strawberry and filling, if using, and cook 20 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Note, you can also fill a pastry ball with the mixture.

Random Ingredients: white wheat flour,penne,dark sesame oil,tomato sauce,wheat bagel,oregano,chinese mushroom
title: Pasta With Mushrooms and Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 3 tomatoes, medium-sized, sliced | 1 lb white wheat flour | 3 tablespoons wheat bagels, split | 1/4 cup wheat sesame oil ( more or less, depending on your taste ) | 8 ounces chinese mushrooms, sliced ( more or less, depending on your taste ) | 2 teaspoons dry oregano | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Mix the tomato slices, flour, wheat bagels, sesame oil, and mushrooms together to form an evenly distributed dough. Bring a wide pot of water to a boil with 2 tbsp oil. Sprinkle with half of the oregano & sesame oil. Dip the pasta and cook until just shy of al dente. Drain & set aside. Repeat steps 7 10, using a large measuring cup to scoop out excess flour & place in pan in a single layer. Cook on low heat for about 7 minutes, stirring constantly with a fork, or until the dough forms a thick, slightly translucent crust on top. You may have to give a few stirs to ensure that nothing sticks to the bottom. Don't worry about adding water or any leftover dough, just toss it in well & toss it in again. Serve right away, or cook& serve cold. I like the cooked pasta to be tossed in my spaghetti sauce a day or so in advance.

title: Quick and Easy Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Stir taco sauce and white pepper together in a small bowl. Pour into a wide, shallow dish. Place the dish in the oven and turn off, about 3 to 5 minutes. The sauce should be bubbling and slightly thickened.

title: Best Ever Refreshing Refreshed Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 can pinto beans | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Drain excess liquid from cans and reserve. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Place in a covered container and refrigerate 2 - 3 hours.

title: Basmati Cake Flour and Wheat Flour  Rolls
ingredients: 400 g light cream or 400 g lukewarm cream | 100 g cake flour | 1 cup basmati rice, soaked in water for 30 mins, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350°f. Mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl for about 1 - 2 mins on low speed until very light and fluffy. Place 2 tbsp onto a floured rectangle cutting board with a 3mm round cutter, and form the dough using your hands. Cut into 12 squares or a regular rectangle with two rectangular slices on the outside. Place on a baking tray, and prick all over with a fork. Bake the rolls about 20 minutes until golden.

title: Radish and Mustard Seed Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 radishes, trimmed of all but leaves | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon finely minced of fresh mint
instructions: Place radishes in a salad bowl, and dress with all the ingredients.

title: Quick and Easy Turkey & Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 large sweet chili with beans | 1 can kidney beans or ( 19 ounce ) can black beans, drained | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 packet turkey meat, crumbles or 500 g turkey, cooked, drained
instructions: Place thawed chili in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in beans and sugar. Cover and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Stir in turkey, and cooked to preference serve.

title: Individual Breakfast Pie Crusts
ingredients: pastry dough pie ( recipe id # 90166, see note ) | 1 1/4 - 2 cups of leftover breakfast tea, from cooked to your own breakfast ( i like decaffeinated, sweetened condensed milk & butter, but use your favorite flavor )
instructions: Line your pie pan with pastry to avoid the edges of your pan.

Random Ingredients: elderflower liqueur,asparagus,pearl onion,green chili pepper,vegetable,asafoetida powder,caramel topping
title: Vegetable Delight - Adapted from Vij's Family Recipe!
ingredients: 4 green chili peppers, slit vertically | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or 4 tablespoons olive oil | 100 g carrots, grated | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon elderflower liqueur | 225 g fresh peas or 225 g frozen peas | 1 large prawns or 1 large fish, cut into bite-sized pieces | 25 g candy sprinkles ( optional ) or 25 g candy sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp. Oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Once its hot, add the asafoetida and chilli peppers. Stir fry for a few seconds. Add the carrots stir fry for 3 minutes. Add the peas and continue to stir fry for a few minutes. In the meantime, blend the elderflower liqueur and vegetable base and stir into the vegetables. Cover and let it cook for a few minutes, stirring periodically for 5 minutes, then add the prawns or fish and season with salt and pepper. Serve and stir the prawns or fish onto a plate when ready to serve. Sprinkle with the candy sprinkles.

title: Savory Swiss Beef Cottage Pie
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into large pieces | 4 scallions, chopped | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: In large pot of boiling water, simmer beef and scallions until onion is tender. Stir in cheese. Sift flour over beef and vegetable mixture. Place in 8 inch greased round cake pan and bake at 425 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Gran-Yellow Pea Toast
ingredients: 1 yellow split peas | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 4 slices bread
instructions: Preheat your grill, setting the heat to high, or pre heat a frying pan on the stove. Split split peas in 2 or 3 pieces, keeping each split peas separate. Place split peas & grand marnier on a plate. Place 1 slice of bread in bowl of electric mixer on medium high, & mix in the split peas, then top with the other slice, making 4 bread slices as it bakes. Cut each piece using a sharp paring knife, but only between 2 & 3 places so the slices are not being cut too thick. Lightly butter your griddle & put 1 bread slice aside. Place 2 sandwiches together & place them under the hot grill, or turn to high. Cook each side for just 2 minutes or till lightly browned.

title: Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 medium red pepper | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Using a mortar and pestle, grind together red pepper and poppy seeds. Transfer to a greased baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, then store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,onion,milk,french bread,stir fry sauce
title: Creamy French Onion Bites
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 3/4 cup finely chopped sweet onion | 4 tablespoons frozen stir fry sauce | 2 tablespoons milk | 1 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut french bread lengthwise into 4 slices about 1 inch thick. Slice each slice diagonally into 1/2 inch thick slabs and place on baking sheets. Bake at 400 degrees for 5 - 7 minutes or until golden. Remove and drain on paper towels. Combine tomatoes, onions, stir fry sauce, and milk in a medium bowl. Spoon 2 t. Of the tomato mixture onto each slice of bread. Top evenly with bread slabs and cut a slit along the top about 1/2 inch from the top. Broil 3 - 4 from heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Moroccan Beef on Toast
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 beef chuck roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Grind coriander and aniseeds with a mortar and pestle, or pound with a rolling pin until fine. Rub mixture all over beef and leave outside for an hour or so. Cook on oven proofed rack, uncovered for 2 1/2 hours. Remove from oven. Slice thinly, serve with salad and french fries for a nice compliment to the meal.

title: Pernod
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 slice country-style white bread, torn into bite-size pieces | 1 teaspoon dry vermouth
instructions: Toss the green pepper with the peanut oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir the green pepper until tender, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the green pepper from the skillet, and stir in the bread. Return the green pepper to the skillet, cover, and stir in the vermouth. Heat and stir until simmering. Serve hot.

title: Rice With Eggplant (Eggplant) & Tomato
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups water | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon mace, ground | 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 cup eggplant, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup canned tomato, drained | 2 tablespoons pearl barley
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine water and fish sauce. Cook over high heat until bubbles form around edge of pan. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,sage leaf,lemon zest,milk,habanero pepper,beef steak,lime zest
title: Grilled Beef Cubes With Lime Chile Salsa
ingredients: 4 beef boneless top round steaks, trimmed ( about 1. 75oz each ) | sage leaf ( for garnish ) | lemon zest | 8 lime wedges | lemon zest | 12 small fresh habanero peppers ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon dried rubbed sage leaves | 1/4 pint 2 % low-fat milk
instructions: Prepare grill for direct heat grilling. For the beef cubes, lightly oil grate. Place all steak pieces on grill rack and grill, turning once and using tongs, until they are nicely toasted, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer the meat to a cutting board and let stand 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the steaks to a cutting board. Finely slice 1/4 inch thick slices from the steak pieces. Cut along the grain of the steak and arrange 1 slice in the center of each serving plate. Sprinkle on the toasted sage leaves and serve immediately with the salsa. For the lime chili salsa, toast the chile slices in a dry skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until golden, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a heatproof bowl, cover and keep warm in the oven until all are ready and use as directed above for the salsa. For the lime grate, combine the zest with the milk and sage leaves and let stand 30 minutes or until zest is slighly soft. Using a vegetable peeler, press the zest onto both sides of the grate. Place on a griddle pan, grilling surface, grilling until charred all over but a little charred on top, about 5 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, then press with a metal spatula. Using a fine grater or vegetable peeler, press down on the zest with a small slotted spoon to remove the white pith. Slice and stir in the lime juice with the chile salsa, then serve. Note on habanero pepper, see note below. The habanero peppers can be purchased from asian markets.

title: Mexican Chocolate Fondue
ingredients: 24 ounces honey | 1/4 cup cream of tartar | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 cup mild cocoa | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 2 tablespoons chicken base | 1 ounce lime
instructions: Combine sugar, cream of tartar, tamari, and coca powder in a saucepan. Add chicken base, and cook until bubbly. Reduce heat to simmer, add honey, and stir. Continue cooking for 2 - 3 minutes, or until thickened. Remove from heat, and stir in lime. Place in fondue pot, and set aside to serve.

Random Ingredients: japanese eggplant,sage leaf,saffron thread,dark beer,slab bacon
title: Smuggrels (A Japanese Savoury Eggplant-Manager)
ingredients: 2 lbs japanese eggplants or 2 lbs other yellow fleshed eggplants, unpeeled | 1 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 12 slices thick slab bacon, 1 inch thick, cut into chunks | 24 sage leaves, torn in pieces | 6 ounces dark beer
instructions: Trim the length of both ends of the eggplants, then cut away the excess peel.

title: Tetenizing Pretzels (Italian Bread)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients to your bread machine according to manufacturer's instructions. Allow to stand about 10 minutes until ingredients are well blended and dough is somewhat tacky. Transfer to a floured surface and divide into 10 pieces. Dip a rolling pin in flour then into the pine nuts, working the nuts quickly into the dough. Arrange on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Spray tops with water. Allow to rise to doubled in size, about 45 minutes. When ready to bake, bake at 500 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly golden. Allow to cool completely before splitting, removing to rack and separating with a spatula.

title: Fast and Easy Beef Wellingtons
ingredients: 6 beef tenderloin | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 cans drained german-style dill pickle relish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut a slice off the top of each beef piece, and scoop out 1 teaspoon of each meat. Scoop out every vestige and place the beef on a clean dry surface, keeping the sand from rolling. Reserve the bread for stuffing later in the week. Lay the beef onto a clean dry surface, and slice 1/2 thick through the thick end. Carefully roll each strip of beef around the cream cheese, taking care not to tear it. Place onto a baking sheet, and place into the preheated oven. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until meat no longer pink and juices run clear.

title: Avocado Fritters
ingredients: 1 ripe avocado, chopped | 1/4 cup plain flour
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the avocados and plain flour until blended. Drop small spoonfuls onto a lined tray. Preheat oven to 200 deg c or 200 deg c if fan forced. Bake in batches for 5 - 10 minutes or until golden on top.

title: Creamy Fish Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 can chicken broth | 2 cups fresh fruit, sliced | 1/2 cup minced garlic
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot over medium heat. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve topped with fresh fruit or serve with bread crusted wheat bread and cheese for dipping.

Random Ingredients: bacon,vanilla essence,sherry wine,red chili pepper,cabbage leaf
title: Hot Bacon Wrapped in Cabbage Leaves
ingredients: 20 cabbage leaves | 10 slices bacon | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Fry bacon in a wok for several minutes and remove to a plate. Add chili and sauté for 1 minute then add bacon. Stir until bacon has cooked and add vanilla and sherry. Cook briefly to thicken and serve.

Random Ingredients: red potato,plum tomato,self raising flour,sugar,chipotle chile,bamboo
title: Mashed Potato Chapati
ingredients: 800 g red potatoes, peeled and sliced | 50 g unbleached self raising flour | 3 medium plum tomatoes, coarsley chopped | 2 canned chipotle chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sugar | 75 g soft bamboo, soaked in boiling water for 10 minutes and drained
instructions: Heat the oven to 180c. Place 3 tablespoons of the potato, flour, tomatoes and chiles into a mixing bowl and mix well. Add half the sugar. Using a spoon, gently mix in the soaked bamboo until the mixture is homogenous. Place the mixture in an ovenproof dish and bake in the oven for 12 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. Let it cool slightly then place it on a serving plate. Make sure it is completely cool before taking it out of the oven.

title: Lima Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1 can lima beans, drained | 1/2 cup dry white wine ( i don't know the size ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 12 hamburger rolls
instructions: Combine drained fava beans, wine, and garlic powder in medium bowl. Heat griddle or large frying pan over medium high heat. Form mixture into 6 patties. Cook patties 5 minutes per side or until desired doneness. Serve on buns with desired toppings.

title: Easy Lemon Lamb Roast
ingredients: 1 lamb shoulder, trimmed of fat | 2 -3 lemons, juice of | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to about 190 degrees centigrade. Place the trimmed roasting joint in a roasting tin. Juice all the lemons and add the juice to the lemon juice and stir well, then add the sesame seeds. Smooth the top. Turn out onto a rack and roast slowly until cooked to your liking. To serve, remove from the oven and brush with some of the lemon juice. Serve with salad for dinner and tea for breakfast.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile,black mustard seed,baking soda,kalamata olive,cream celery soup,tomato green chilies,mexican cheese
title: The Perfect Cheesy Momma's Salsa
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1/4 cup pickled sliced black mustard seeds | 1 cup chopped fresh mexican cheese | 2 1/2 tablespoons coarse ground ancho chiles | 2 tablespoons white or black mustard seeds | 2/3 cup kalamata olives
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cream of celery soup, diced tomatoes with green chilies, mustard seeds, mexican cheese, ground ancho chilies, and white or black mustard seeds. Cover and set aside to marinate at least one hour. Right before serving, stir in the chopped olives.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,black bean,oregano leaf,salt,white mushroom,poppy seed
title: Fried Rice With Mushrooms and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice, washed and drained | 1 lb white mushroom, sliced | 3 cups black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons oregano leaves | 2 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees. Spread the poppy seeds on a baking sheet. Bake, stirring occasionally, until brownish, about 20 minutes. Let cool. Set aside 10 to 20 minutes. Place the rice and mushrooms in a large skillet. Add water to cover, about 2 inches above the rice. Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Add oregano and salt. Cook, uncovered over medium heat until the rice is well browned, about 5 minutes. Spread 2 cups of cooked rice in a casserole. Top with mushroom mixture.

Random Ingredients: caper,sherry,parmigiano reggiano cheese,beef stew meat,mexican cheese,icing sugar,cumin powder
title: Capellini (Beef & Garlic Fondue)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 2 1/4 inch cubes | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 cups of medium sherry | 4 -8 ounces fresh grated mexican blend cheese | 2 small capers, chopped | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Put beef into oven safe dutch oven, over medium heat, turning often. When meat is browned, pour in enough sherry to come 1 1/4's of the way up the side of the meat. Add all other ingredients except cheese. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer, covered for 1 1/2 hours and 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the meat is very tender. Serve with a sprinkling of cheese and a few dallops of sour cream. Serve with warm flour tortillas or fresh bread for dipping it into.

title: Potato Candy for ZWT-9
ingredients: 12 russet potatoes | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wash potatoes and cut tops off. Place potatoes in a large bowl and mix in remaining ingredients. Mold in cooled bread.

title: Creamy Italian Bread Crumbs for Fish
ingredients: 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs, or more to taste | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup
instructions: Combine panko bread crumbs and cream of celery soup together in a glass bowl. Sprinkle panko crumbs over mixture. Cover bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Soy's Noodles With Ramen Ramen Slices
ingredients: 6 ounces refrigerated ramen noodles | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles and toss with graham cracker crumbs. Serve.

title: Braised Lamb Shank
ingredients: 6 lamb shanks ( approx. 10 pounds ) | 2/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 2 medium onions, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Pour 1/4 cup of the bread crumbs onto a piece of waxed paper. Sprinkle the lamb with 3/4 cup of the bread crumbs, and set aside with the onions in the bottom of a large roasting pan on the top rack. Arrange the meat on top of the onions, then sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs. Cook, uncovered, for 15 to 20 minutes until meat is brown on the outside. Serve at once, or refrigerate for up to 1 week. For the second cooking of step, heat remaining 1/4 cup of bread crumbs in a small frying pan over medium heat. Lightly brown the lamb for about 5 to 7 minutes on each side, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,margarine,cheese,cumin,sugar,white wine vinegar,cream cheese,cabbage
title: Costa Rican Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | salt & pepper, to taste | 1 cup margarine | 6 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f degrees. Core the cabbage, removing the core and any undesirable portions that may be inside. Slice the core into large pieces. In a medium sauce pan over medium heat, melt the margarine. Add the cream cheese and blend well. Stir in the white wine vinegar, cumin, and salt and pepper to taste. Cover and cook for about 3 or 4 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent the cheese from getting melted. Remove to a bowl, and mix in the shredded cabbage. Set aside. Mix the flour into the melted margarine until well blended. Add the chopped cabbage to the softened cream cheese and mix well. The cream cheese will not be spread evenly. Divide the cabbage filling into about 2 portions. Roll each cabbage piece with your hands into a log and place on aluminum foil. Place in the oven until the rolls are heated through, about 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and serve warm.

title: Curried Fried Okra (Or Spinach)
ingredients: 2 lbs okra, chopped ( or spinach ) | 1 jar pizza sauce ( or hot ) | 3 tablespoons red curry paste ( or to taste ) | 4 -5 tablespoons freshly grated breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup black vinegar | 3 tablespoons coffee
instructions: If using fresh okra thaw completely, then drain. Place in mixing bowl and add hot curry paste. Stir until well combined. Heat olive oil in skillet over medium high heat. Dip okra in curry sauce. Add to skillet and fry for 2 minutes, or until golden golden brown on the outside and tender inside. Place on plate lined with paper towels. Sprinkle toast crumbs on top or just toast the breadcrumbs if using them. Serve with the coffee.

title: Chinese Style Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 1 cup hot cocoa powder | 1 cup unsweetened canned chili bean sauce | 2 tablespoons sugar-free artificial sweetener, as needed
instructions: Combine hot cocoa powder and chili bean sauce in a jar with a tight fitting lid.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,jasmine rice,red currant jelly,spaghettini,ginger root,yellow squash
title: Jasmine Rice and Squash with Red Currant Jelly
ingredients: 1 package uncooked jasmine rice | 1 small yellow squash - peeled, seeded, and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and cut into matchsticks | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 pound uncooked spaghettini
instructions: Place the rice, yellow squash, ginger, and red currant jelly in a saucepan, and pour in enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,red chilies,apricot,salsa,thyme sprig,red chile pepper
title: Spicy Apricot Strudel
ingredients: 2 sheets filo pastry | 1 jar salsa | 3/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1/2 small red chile pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1 small hot red chile pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place apricots and red chile in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,green onion,orange zest,cream chicken soup,greek yogurt,rice vinegar,veal
title: Veal & Cabbage Stuffed Sweet Orange Bell Peppers
ingredients: 8 large green cabbage | 12 green onions, green part only, finely chopped | 3/4 lb ground veal | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated
instructions: Wash and core the green cabbage and slice them into strips about 1/8 inch wide and 1/8 inch long. Mix the meat with the seasoning listed. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray cookie sheet with pam or lightly oil. Divide the meat and green cabbage among the bottom of each cabbage ring with the green parts toward the top. Place stuffed bell peppers over the meat and vegetables. In a small bowl, combine soup, sour cream or nonfat sour cream, and vinegar. Brush the dressing over the onions, cover with foil, and bake for 50 - 60 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 - 8 minutes longer or until desired doneness.

title: Quickly  Easy Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef roast ( or whatever meat you have on hand ) | 5 -6 green cardamoms ( depending on how much you like cardamom, my addition ) | 1 can tomato soup ( or any other tomato sauce you have on hand )
instructions: Put roast, cardamom, tomato soup, and any other gravy in slow cooker. Cook at low for 6 8hrs or at high for 5 7hrs. Remove meat to plate, slice, and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice,semolina flour,orange peel,walnut half,cayenne powder,cream tartar
title: Rice Flour Balls in Orange Syrup
ingredients: 2/3 cup rice | 1 3/4 cups semolina flour | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 cup walnut halves | 4 orange peel
instructions: Stir water into the rice flour, then stir until smooth.

title: Perfect Pesto Bread (No Dry Mix)
ingredients: 1/2 kg white onion ( sliced into rings ) | 1/2 kg prepared pesto sauce ( the homemade kind is best, but any type of store bought pesto is fine ) | 1 kg cornmeal
instructions: In a large oven proof pan, layer onion rings, pesto and cornmeal till the base of the pan is about 5cm deep. The mix should be spread evenly, so that the cornmeal does not get over soaked.. Bake in slow oven, covered, for 40 minutes and turn out of the oven. Set on a plate, and leave at room temperature for 30 minutes to cool. Serve with a drizzle of olive oil on top.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,poblano chile,yellow onion,white bean,pimiento,cannellini bean
title: White Beans With Sopes and Green Onions
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, undrained | 1 can white beans, undrained | 1/2 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1 jar diced pimientos, drained | 2 1/2 teaspoons chili pepper
instructions: Combine beans and all remaining ingredients, except pimentos, in a large saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until thickened to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,white chocolate chip,courgette,chicken bouillon,corn,lettuce,brandy,water chestnut
title: Cousin Pete's Vegetable Pie
ingredients: 1/3 cup corn, frozen shelled canned drained | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1/3 cup water chestnut, sliced | 1/3 cup white chocolate chips | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, instant | 3/4 cup celery, chopped | 1 can vegetable creamed corn, milk and 2 tbsp. brandy | 1 -2 leaf lettuce, torn into small pieces | freshly packaged rolled phyllo dough
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough completely. Cut phyllo dough into 3 - 6 squares. Mix together all filling ingredients and place filling mixture into phyllo squares. Brush 2 tbsp brandy over filling. Cover with a layer of torn leaves. Top with remaining phyllo, and cut remaining pieces to make 4 squares. Bake in oven at 180°c/400°f for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cheshire Okra With Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 lb okra | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon ( dried ) | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Cook the ziti in a large pot of boiling water until done, about 8 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile put the okra in a frying pan with 2 of a tablespoons of olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook over medium high heat until it starts to soften, about 4 minutes. Then cover and cook until most of the water evaporates, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, cook the ziti in the same pan with the okra. Drain and mix with cooked okra and cheshire sauce to combine. Toss with cooked ziti.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,cayenne pepper,flat leaf italian parsley,wine,bell pepper,cider vinegar,ice water,guacamole
title: Spanish Corn Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons ice water | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup sweet red wine | 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped ( bell pepper or yellow pepper ) | 4 teaspoons guacamole
instructions: Combine vinegar, water, parsley and cayenne in medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,pomegranate juice,canning,ranch dressing mix,maple syrup,sherry wine,lemon peel,tahini
title: Easy Hidden Valley Original Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons dried onion flakes ( or more if desired ) | 1 package hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise or 2 tablespoons low fat mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon tahini | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, chopped | 2 teaspoons dry sherry or 2 teaspoons other sweet white wine ( omit if using wine ) | 1/2 cup onion juice or 1/2 cup tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup canning jar filled with juice ( pomegranate-grapefruit juice can also be used. ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oven on the lowest setting. Mix all ingredients together. Do not overdo the mixing. Seal the jars. Chill for several hours. To use, drain the juice from the jar and refrigerate for a few days or overnight, stirring every so often. Shake the container vigorously, making sure the juice covers the contents of the jar. If using canning, cover the canning ring with a cloth secured with a double layer of heavy duty aluminum foil. Place jar on rack in a large pan of hot water. Do not bring to a boil. Turn the jar upside down, and remove the lid. Place jars in a boiling water bath and return to a boil after 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cover. Allow the jars to stand in hot water for 20 minutes. Remove jars and cool them on a wire rack for 10 minutes. Remove the lid, then place a paper towel on top and peel them. Wearing rubber gloves, wipe jars from the cloth with a small souse. Place the jars in a bowl of cool water until ready to use. Store the drained sterilized jars in a cool, dark, dry place. They will keep for up to 1 year.

title: Mama's Mincemeat
ingredients: 1 kg lamb | 200 g curd cottage cheese, drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 200 g meatballs, fried | 2 shallots, finely minced | 2 tablespoons concentrated tamarind pulp
instructions: Cut lamb into slices and brown on all sides in a large skillet. Remove from skillet and put to side. Add cottage cheese to skillet over low heat. Sprinkle with mace, meatballs, shallots and tamarind pulp. Pour enough boiling water over to cover meat and cottage cheese. Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently for 45 minutes. Serve with potato salad and bread.

title: Spanish Bread
ingredients: 4 large crusty sandwich croissants | 2 tablespoons salsa | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons brewed tea
instructions: Preheat oven on the broiler setting. Slice open each croissant into 8 wedges. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Spread one side of each croissant wedge with the marinated salsa. Broil croissants for 5 minutes. Cut into wedges.

title: Macaroni With Beef and Tomatoes
ingredients: 200 g elbow macaroni ( we like whole wheat ) | 1 1/2 kg stewing beef, in medium sized chunks | 1 jar stewed tomatoes | 400 g canned green peas, drained | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 jar of sliced pimientos, drained
instructions: The water for macaroni and beef is boiling. You will also need 8 cups boiling water for macaroni and beef or 8 cups boiling water for stewed tomatoes. Once the water comes to a boil, add the macaroni and boil for a few minutes. Meanwhile, in a large stew pot, add the stewed tomatoes, 2 - 3 cups water or enough to cover all the ingredients. Bring to a boil then lower the heat. Simmer for 1 hour. Add the stewed peas and the pimientos. Simmer another 1 hour or until the beef is tender. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add cilantro or parsley and serve.

title: Bolognese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices crusty french bread | 8 ounces deli-style ground turkey | 2 leaves fresh thyme sprigs | 1 small turnip, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 large egg noodles | fresh chervil ( to garnish ) | 3 ounces deli-style roast beef or 3 ounces deli deli lean ground beef, finely chopped
instructions: Toast bread on both side under broiler. Spread 1/4 of turkey crumbs over each bread slice and top with 1/4 of turnip slices and 1/4 of thyme leaves. Cut egg noodles into half lengthwise and set aside. Lay cut sides of each bread slice on a cutting board. Place 1/4 of chopped deli beef or ground beef onto one end of each bread slice. Roll up each bread slice and slice diagonally. Serve with cherryvil sprinkled over the top. Vary the ingredients if needed to suit your taste preferences.

Random Ingredients: green pea,white rice,garlic paste,zucchini,dill,yellow pea,cherry tomato,scallion
title: Garlic Polow (Zucchini Rice Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup white rice, washed ( you should use basmati rice ) | 1 cup zucchini, chopped | 1 cup yellow peas ( fresh or frozen are fine ) | 1 cup green peas ( fresh or frozen are fine ) | 1 fresh cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 2 -3 scallions, in thin layers ( white and green parts, yellow parts ) | 4 tablespoons chopped garlic paste | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill, in small bits
instructions: Saute garlic paste in a pinch of oil over medium heat.

title: Kale With Rice, Amaretto, and Raspberry
ingredients: 6 cups kale leaves, steamed | 1 teaspoon baking potato | 2 teaspoons amaretto liqueur | 1 cup raspberries
instructions: Place kale into saucepan with water. Cover and bring to a boil. Cook until tender but still firm. Drain and cool.

title: Smoked Salmon and Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless fresh salmon, bones left on ( i use a whole salmon, which is just plain smoked ) | 1 medium eggplant, peeled and cut into 2 x 1 1/4-inch sticks ( about 6 cups ) | 1 jar of rinsed and cleaned hot peppers | 1/2 - 1 cup chopped celery flakes ( or to taste, if your pepper sauce is really hot ) | 1 -2 red chile, crushed ( to taste )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crockpot, except the red chiles, and mix, if you are using them. On top of each other, layer the red chiles. Cover and cook on low for about 7 hours.. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Melon Balls
ingredients: 500 g cantaloupes | 1/2 cup rice wine
instructions: Using your hands, work cantaloupes and rice wine into a mound on a bamboo leaf lined with cling wrap. Once flattened, make small balls the size of a small cherry. Place on lightly greased baking tray and flatten slightly. Allow to rest in the refrigerator for 1 hour to dry out. Serve with your favourite soup or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,pork rib,onion soup mix
title: Slow Cooker Carnitas
ingredients: 1 pound country-style boneless pork ribs, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup chopped onion soup mix | 2/3 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place pork ribs in a 4 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle the onion soup mix over pork, then add cream. Cover slow cooker, set to low, and cook 8 to 10 hours. Serve with tortilla chips, mexican beans, and sour cream. Cook's note, to make this delicious Carnitas, combine 2 cans black beans with 1 cup water in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,vegetable stock,salt black pepper,poblano chile,grainy mustard
title: Queso Blanco over Coconut Chiles
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1 tablespoon mango powder or 1 tablespoon paprika | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 3 -4 tablespoons coarse grainy mustard or 1 -2 tablespoon prepared sweet-and-sour mustard | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high. Place poblano chiles on foil lined baking sheet, broil 2 - 3 minutes per side or until blackened on all sides. Transfer chiles to plastic bag and seal.

title: Pear and Lager Applesauce
ingredients: 1 pear, peeled, cored and cubed | 4 ounces quick-cooking oats | 1 can or bottle lager-style beer
instructions: Combine pear cubes and oats in a large bowl. Pour 1 cup beer into a large, nonreactive bowl, and carefully stir remaining beer into the oats and rice.

title: Boiled Beef for Your Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast | 3 cups broth, heated
instructions: Place your pressure cooker on heat and bring to full pressure. When done, adjust heat to stabilize pressure. Once the roast comes out of pressure, remove the roast for a moment to cool for your pressure cooker bowl. Using your hand, remove the meat from the plastic wrap and place into a bowl. Use a knife to make a slight indentation in the meat and place the broth into the hole. Let the broth float on the fat. Once the meat is cool, slice against the grain and serve.

title: Broccoli Oat Bars
ingredients: 2 cups sliced broccoli | 1/4 cup butter, melted | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats, crushed | 1/4 cup chopped red onion
instructions: Preheat oven to combine broccoli, butter, and oats. Press into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish and top with onion. Bake at 350 degrees c for 35 minutes.

title: Simple Cheese Soufflés
ingredients: 2 lbs white cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup syrup ( from cooking the soup )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a large baking or soufflé dish. On a large plate, arrange the grated cheese in a thin layer. In a small bowl, mix together the grated cheese and syrup. Add about half the cheese mixture to the top of the cheese in a thin swirl. Repeat the layers two more times, ending with top grated cheese on top. Bake for 10 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Rigatoni with Pine Nuts and Brandy
ingredients: 3 cups rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/4 cup chopped pine nuts | 1/3 cup mild taco sauce | 1/2 cup brandy
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions. Place margarine and nuts in a large skillet, and cook over medium heat, stirring, until lightly toasted, about 3 minutes. Pour in tabasco sauce, then stir in pasta. Pour brandy over pasta, and serve.

title: Turkish Orange & Pistachios Salad
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, red, finely diced | 3/4 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 1 tablespoon wine
instructions: Passionate the peppers, drain well and dry with paper towels. Mix the rest of the ingredients together in a bowl and season to taste with salt and pepper. Dress salad with the warm pepper mixture.

Random Ingredients: chat masala,peanut oil,malt vinegar,chicken tender,beef consomme,peppercorn,garlic paste
title: Garlic & Pepper Chicken in Mild Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 -3 lbs chicken tenders | 2 teaspoons crushed peppercorns | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons chat masala | 1 can beef consomme
instructions: Combine oil, ginger, garlic paste, garam masala and chat in a large saucepan. Stir to mix. Add chicken and cook, covered over medium low heat until chicken is tender, about 30 minutes. Add consume and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: mint,apple,red bell pepper,red salmon,sultana,extra virgin olive oil
title: Salmon Salad With Sultanas and Smoked Elegant Almonds
ingredients: 1 large red red bell pepper | 10 ounces red salmon | 4 sultanas | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint | 4 slices apple ( i used granny smith )
instructions: Line the base of a 6 - 6 serving bowl with foil. Cut the red bell pepper crossways into 8 thin strips, then cut each strip into four equal wedges. Cut the salmon into four equal crossways slices, then arrange slices and red bell pepper strips on top. Pour the olive oil over and scatter with mint leaves and smoked salmon slices. Serve drizzled with a little extra virgin olive oil and sprinkled with smoked almonds.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,green cabbage,cabbage,lime zest,stew meat,pork sausage,irish cream
title: Sweet and Savory Irish Cabbage and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat ( ground chuck or turkey is nice ) | 1 lb smoked pork sausage or 1 lb kielbasa | 1/2 small head green cabbage, shredded | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 lime, zest of | 1 cup irish cream ( heaping )
instructions: Cook sausage in frying pan until done. Drain and set aside. In crock pot add all remaining ingredients. Cover, cook on low for approx 6 to 8hrs, or until cabbage is tender. Serve over brown rice.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,kalamata olive,caster sugar,clam,cranberry,chinese cabbage,plain yogurt
title: Lamb Lapp (Willy)
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/3 cup caster sugar | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and finely chopped | 6 ounces chopped clams | 5 kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped | 2 ounces cranberries ( optional ) | 1/2 bunch chinese cabbage
instructions: Toss together the yogurt, sugar and ginger in a bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients. Cover and marinate overnight or at least 4 hours. Thread lamb onto skewers. Grill lamb for about 5 minutes on each side until browned and cooked to your liking. Serve with salads and chinese cabbages.

title: Ranch Macaroni Sandwich
ingredients: 14 ounces macaroni, uncooked | 1 can chipotle chiles, chopped & drained | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, place chipotle in a blender or food processor and blend until chiles are finely crushed and slightly smooth. Add remaining ingredients including macaroni. Blend until well blended and smooth but not too thick. To assemble, place cheese on 4 slices of bread and add 2 teaspoons of macaroni and sauce. Serve hot or cold, with other suggested accompaniments, such as grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,alfredo sauce,zucchini,egg white,ramen noodle,balsamic vinegar,walnut oil
title: Easy Zucchini Slices & Rramen
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1/2 lb zucchini, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 4 tablespoons alfredo sauce | 1 egg white | 1 package ramen noodles ( or 1 3 ounce packet oxo ) | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat walnut oil in heavy large skillet on medium heat. Add zucchini.

title: Peanut Butter and Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 375 g creamy peanut butter | 6 -8 medium tomatoes | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1/4 lb hot italian sausage, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf and lightly grease a baking tray with cooking spray. Combine peanut butter, whole tomatoes, chopped parsley and sausage. Whiz in food processor until completely smooth. Pour sauce into the baking dish leaving a 1/2 inch border on all sides. Bake uncovered 30 - 45 minutes or until bubbling. Serve with pasta.

Random Ingredients: fusilli,red pepper hot heat,ranch dressing,red onion,onion,fruit cocktail
title: Fusilli, Fruit Slices and Red Onion Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces tri-colored fusilli or 16 ounces rotini pasta, cooked & drained | 1 cup red onion, minced | 1/2 cup red pepper hot pepper, minced ( optional ) | 1 container fruit cocktail, drained | 1/2 cup fat free ranch dressing | 1/4 teaspoon dried red onion or 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped fresh red onion, green part
instructions: Add all ingredients to a large bowl. Stir to combine well. Serve warm or cool. Note, this tastes great served over penne or rigatoni.

Random Ingredients: vanilla wafer crumb,black eyed pea,meyer lemon zest,spring onion
title: Black-Eyed Peas and Fresh Spring Onions
ingredients: 1 package vanilla wafer crumbs | 12 ounces black-eyed peas, rinsed | 1/4 cup spring onion | 1 meyer lemon, zest of
instructions: Soak dried black eye peas overnight then remove from heat and put through a food processor. Squeeze out excess water then combine with other ingredients. Shape into small balls and roll in crushed wafer crumbs until covered and coated well, place on parchment lined baking sheet. To keep chilled place waxed paper on the top to keep them from drying out. Bake in 350 degree f oven for 10 minutes then remove paper and sprinkle with paprika salt. Cool. You will get about 2 dozen servings of these.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,grain rice,mango chutney,caraway seed,butter bean,kosher salt black pepper
title: Spaghetti With Sweet Rice and Caraway Seeds
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter beans ( or a combination of the two ) or 1/4 cup olive oil ( or a combination of the two ) | 2 cups short-grain rice | 1 teaspoon caraway seed, smashed ( optional ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup mango chutney ( such as major greys ) | 1 small uncooked spaghetti
instructions: In a large pot with water bring to the boil. Meanwhile, cut the caraway seeds into tiny matchsticks. While water comes to a boil, heat a 6 to 8 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Add the oil, beans, and rice and stir to coat rice slices with oil. Season to taste with salt and pepper and cook for 45 seconds to 1 minute, stirring constantly. Pour in the chutney and stir well. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve immediately.

title: Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 32 ounces low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 cup fresh cilantro, chopped or 2 tablespoons dried cilantro, divided | 2 tablespoons fresh dill or 2 tablespoons dried dill or 2 teaspoons dried dill, divided | 1 lemon, juice of | 12 lasagna noodles ( i like thin ones that are not completely submerged in water ) or 12 small flat lasagna noodles ( i like thin ones that are not completely submerged in water ) | romaine lettuce, shredded | roast beef or duck sausage, sliced thinly ( optional )
instructions: Drain ricotta and half the cilantro. Mix remaining cilantro with lemon juice until smooth. Spread 2 tspful of sauce on bottom of 13x9x2 inchx2 baking dish. Place 2 noodles on top of sauce & spread thin layer of cheese mixture then layer with 3 more noodles. Spread remaining cheese mixture over noodles then layer with 3 more noodles. Spread remaining cheese mixture on top, spreading thin layer of cheese & layering with 3 more layers of cheese & 2 tspps. Wrap tightly & refrigerate for at least 24 hours or overnight.

title: Sausage Gravy II
ingredients: 2 pounds lean ground turkey ( i use spicy ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons onion powder | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 2 jars turkey gravy
instructions: In a large, heavy skillet, cook ground turkey over medium high heat until crumbly and no longer pink. Stir in onion powder. Stir in cherries. Pour gravy over all.

title: Crispy Fish
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Slice the fish fillet crosswise into 1/16 thick rounds. Spray two muffin tins with cooking spray. Spread fish on each muffin cup in a single layer. Pour liquid smoke over fish. Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,cream celery soup,graham cracker crumb,confectioner ' sugar
title: Super Easy Delicious Crock Pot Gf
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 bag fresh graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup finely minced greek sweet adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons minced confectioners'sugar
instructions: Add the soup to the crock pot and mix well. Add the graham cracker crumbs to the bowl. Add the adobo sauce and mix and stir again. The adobo sauce will give it a nice, unique taste.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,ginger,basil pesto,graham cracker,white poppy seed
title: Harry's Thai Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces prepared basil pesto | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies | 14 ounces white poppy seeds | 2 ounces fresh ginger, chopped | 1 cup graham crackers
instructions: Bring all ingredients except graham crackers to boil in saucepan over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer about 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in graham crackers. Chill several hours before using this sauce for dipping pizza.

title: Halibut with Asafoetida
ingredients: 1 pound halibut fillets | 1 1/2 cups water chestnuts, sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Place halibut in a shallow dish. Pour 1 1/2 cups water chestnut slices over fish. Season the fish with vegetable oil and 1 teaspoon of asafoetida powder, season with the salt, and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of asafoetida powder. Oil the grill grate. Close lid of grill and cook fish for 3 minutes, or according to the directions on the packet, or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,red chili pepper,peanut,parmesan cheese,garam masala,quinoa,cream tartar
title: Spicy Indian Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chili pepper, or more to taste | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix quinoa, bread crumbs, peanuts, chile pepper, cream of tartar, and garam masala together in a bowl. Sprinkle with panko if desired. Spoon mixture into a greased, 2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over quinoa.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,red enchilada sauce,heavy whipping cream,chili
title: Sweet Chilli Pudding
ingredients: 375 ml heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chili ( optional )
instructions: Combine cream and sugar in saucepan. Over low heat, bring cream mixture to boil then stir through chilli if using. Pour mixture into individual cups with slotted spoon, leaving 2 inch clear space in the centre for the sauce to run down during cooking. Cover with a piece of foil and bake for 50 - 60 minutes until mixture has thickened, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,soymilk,apple,green capsicum,baking powder,poultry seasoning
title: Baby Spinach & Apple Salsa
ingredients: 1 apple, peeled, cored & chopped | 400 g baby spinach leaves | 2 green capsicum or 2 red capsicums, sliced | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon dried poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/fan 160c/gas toss apple in a large bowl with the spinach, capsicum & soy milk then transfer to an ovenproof dish, sprinkle with baking powder & sprinkle over the poultry seasoning. Bake for 25 - 30 mins, until apple is tender & spinach is crisp.

title: Dees Cheese Chicken Soup(Fyazhos Dais)
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin, cubed | 1 cup yellow split peas | 3 cups non-fat milk | 1 cup chopped tomato ( optional ) | 1/2 lb cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours. After about 1 hour, add cheese and serve.

title: Marmie's Italian Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 50 g dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon orange extract | 1 small pear, washed, peeled and sliced | 5 -6 romaine lettuce, washed and very finely chopped | 1/3 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Break the chocolate into small pieces and heat in a small saucepan with the amaretto, almond extract, and orange extract slowly, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. As soon as the chocolate is melted, stir in a small amount of the pear slices and stir to mix. Remove from heat and stir in the chocolate and the salad. Top with almonds. Serve immediately.

title: Moldavian Nachos With Tomatillos
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa, homemade is best | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 2 tablespoons cornstarch, extra virgin | salt & fresh ground pepper, to taste | 9 tomatillos, husked, rinsed, but not peeled | 3 tablespoons cornstarch, extra virgin | 1 cup crouton, homemade is best ( store bought, about one cup )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine salsa and 1/2 cup water and set aside. In a 3 1/2 5 - 3 quart pot, combine 1/2 cup cornstarch and remaining water and combine until mixture resembles a thin paste. Add tomatillos and gently toss to combine. Cover and heat very slowly until mixture comes to a boil but still thick, about 45 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon cold water to sauce mixture, stirring to dissolve cornstarch. Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook until sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Garnish with croutons and serve.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,parsnip,lemon juice zest,salmon,active yeast,red currant jelly
title: Raspberry, Parsnip and Salmon Mini-Cubes
ingredients: 7 1/2 ounces active dry yeast | 1 cup raspberry jam | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 10 ounces cranberry-raspberry, mixed salad and | parsnip, chopped | dried red currant jelly
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over 1/4 cup warm water in a large bowl and allow to rest for 5 - 10 minutes to release the yeast action. Add the raspberry jam and lemon zest and stir to combine. Stir in the cranberries and then divide the mixture among the 12 mini muffin tins. Cover with greaseproof paper and prove in a warm place for 12 - 15 minutes. Remove foil half way through to stop the top from browning. Allow to cool completely before removing from the tins. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dark, cool place.

title: Quick Fluffy Puff Pastry
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 cup fat free plain yogurt or 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 teaspoon cake flour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Roll pastry sheet out 1/4 inch thick. Drain the excess flour. Line your baking sheets with parchment paper. Cut pastry into pieces or cut out 3 circles according to the size of your pastry sheets. Put a spoonful of yogurt in the center of each piece of pastry. Sprinkle with a dash of flour and fold over each pastry to make a triangle.. Poke a sliver of fresh ginger in the center of each triangle. Put dough on prepared baking sheets allowing room for rising. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mock Chocolate Parsnips & Chips
ingredients: 500 g parsnips | 75 g walnuts | 5 tablespoons chocolate morsels | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Peel the parsnips using a sharp knife. Peel after slicing them into chips. Dice the walnuts into chips on a grater. Melt the chocolate morsel. Drain the parselys and add to melted chocolate and walnuts. Mix carefully. Dip in toasted chips.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 red peppers, roasted, peeled, patted dry and seeded | 8 ounces pork sausage, sliced in thin strips | 10 cups chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread roasted red peppers and sausage out in a baking dish. Stir the broth in a large pan and pour it on top of the peppers and sausage. Cover with foil and cook in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,saffron thread,bread crumb,adobo seasoning,red kidney bean
title: Chipotle Beans II
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans, drained | 1 pinch saffron threads | 2 chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Fill a medium bowl with water and add the saffron threads and chipotle pepper. Place bread crumbs in a bag and add to the bowl with the beans. Toss the beans with the bread crumbs until the bread crumbs are coated in the bowl with the bean. Gently press the bag to soak excess water out. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with adobo seasoning and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until chilled, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,pineapple chunk juice,oregano,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Pineapple Cheese Melt
ingredients: 225 g shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 100 ml pineapple chunk juice, cold | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 2 teaspoons grated fresh oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and line a shallow ovenproof dish with baking paper. Combine the cheeses, pineapple juice, cardamom, oregano and pepper powder in a bowl then pour into the dish. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Asparagus Alla Vodka
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh asparagus spears | 2 ounces bacon or 2 slices sausages, cut in 1/2-inch chunks about 1-1/2 ounces | 2 teaspoons vodka ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons lemon juice ( optional )
instructions: Slice each piece of asparagus into three 3/4 lengths. Snap the ends off of the asparagus spears and cut into halves or thirds. Place the bacon or sausages on a heat proof platter. Add the vodka if using and cook over high heat 1 1/2 minutes to drive off alcohol. Raise the heat under the bacon or sausages and stir quickly until the asparagus is just heated through. Spoon the vodka over the asparagus or bacon and serve.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,orange zest,cornflour,chipotle chile,pineapple juice,fennel seed,vegetable chicken stock,monterey jack cheese
title: Fennel-Roasted Chicken With Orange
ingredients: 1 cup canned pineapple in juice | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chile, chopped ( or other hot chile, if you like the heat ) | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Put the orange zest in a small bowl and add a tablespoon of oil. When it zests a little bit, add the orange zest to a small pot on low heat. In a heavy skillet, heat the remaining oil over med high heat. Add the chile powder, onion powder, fennel seeds, and chipotle and stir to mix. Add the stock and orange zest, bring to a boil, decrease the heat and simmer until the liquid is thick, about 1 minute. Turn off the heat and stir in the cheese. Spoon the sauce over the chicken and bake for about 1 hour or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly.. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: shoulder lamb chop,cream celery soup,cream may,vinegar,wonton wrapper,guinness stout,green pepper,brandy
title: Lamb Shashlyk With Guinness Sour Cream Dill Stroganoff
ingredients: 1/2 lb green pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup guinness stout, good quality | 1 tablespoon cream of celery soup ( optional ) | 2 ounces sour cream ( optional ) | 48 wonton wrappers | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Mix green pepper, green pepper, guinness, soup, sour cream and brandy together in a bowl. Add 1 tsp of vinegar. Heat 1 tb oil in a frying pan at medium. Add 2 tb oil to hot pan, drop in 2 tb of reserved mushroom mixture and fry until fragrant. Lay wonton wrappers on work surface with wide sides. Scoop 1/2 t of filling in center of the wrapper. Fold both sides over the filling. Seal with a fork or toothpick. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Heat remaining oil to medium high in a large frying pan. Place 4 shaparma at a time in oil and fry, turning once or twice, until cooked. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

title: Lime Crumb Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 lb fine dry breadcrumb | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup fresh lime juice | 1 large lime leaves, crushed, stems removed
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the bread crumbs, yeast, lime juice, and lime leaves. Cover and let stand in a warm place until bubbly. Stir to blend. Place a large sheet of baking mat over the bowl. With slightly damp hands form 1 inch diameter round or rectangle sized balls of crumb mixture. Arrange about 2 inches apart on the baking mat, pressing edges to seal. Allow to rise for about 15 minutes to double in size. Gently turn the dough out onto a lightly floured board and cut off about half a teaspoon of crumb mixture per loaf. Repeat with remaining bread crumbs. Place the breadsticks on baking sheets and let rise for about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees farenheit. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Easy Low Fat Apple Kebabs
ingredients: 24 ounces tart apples, peeled and sliced small- about 1/4-inch | 2 inches piece lemon zest | cumin powder
instructions: Place apple slices in a bowl, rub lemon zest on top. Sprinkle ground cumin over apple. Refrigerate until ready to grill. Serves.

title: Yummy Frijoles
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drain and rinse ( or beans that have already been well rinsed ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons sage leaves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place the beans through the sieve and remove all the beans, but do not discard the liquid. Place all ingredients in a food mill and process until pureed. I have found that if i just add water, the texture will be the best if i just use water, but if it seems dry, add an additional cup of water.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,red grape,arborio rice,black eyed pea
title: Rice With Black-Eyed Peas & Grape (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 jar arborio rice ( or other medium-grain white rice ) | 1 can or bottle white-colored light beer ( such as corona or tecate ) | 1 1/2 lbs medium-large fresh black-eyed peas or 1 1/2 lbs frozen black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup red grapes, cut in half or 1/2 cup green pea pods
instructions: Note, the arborio rice can be picked off the shelf in the same jar you use for beer. Rice can be found at several good health food markets. Rice can be left in the can in the can. An old elderly bird will work well in this recipe with residual blood.

Random Ingredients: fruit sugar superfine,parmigiano reggiano cheese,coriander seed,phyllo dough
title: Easy Phyllo Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 phyllo dough, defrosted if frozen | 2 tablespoons dried fruit sugar ( superfine sugar or white sugar ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | coriander seeds
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f. Place unrolled phyllo sheet in a baking sheet and spray or brush with oil.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,sage,pancetta,pear,purple onion,garbanzo bean,lentil,chuck
title: Lentils and Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried garbanzo beans | 1 lb ground chuck | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped pancetta | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup dried lentils | 1 small purple onion, diced | fresh sage, chopped | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 2 peaches, chopped
instructions: Rinse and pick over the garbanzos, removing any debris or hard fiber pieces. Soak them in water over night, drain, and squeeze out excess water. Add the ground chuck and pancetta to the soup pot.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,red chili powder,milk,poblano chile,dark sesame oil
title: Queso Cotija (Chile Pepper Fritters)
ingredients: 2 lbs poblano chiles | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup whole milk
instructions: Wash the peppers, remove cores, seeds and membrane. Cut into 2inch pieces, wash and slice on the diagonal. Place in a pot with water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover the pot and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove the lid and simmer for another 10 to 15 minutes or until softened. Meanwhile, heat the sesame oil in a medium pot. Add half the chile pieces and cook over medium to medium high heat for a minute or two until they are fragrant. Add the milk, remaining chile, salt, and pepper to taste. Cook until the chiles are very soft. Drain the chiles and return to the pot. Stir well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,beef bouillon,plain flour,beef chuck,almond extract,worcestershire sauce,plum,pork
title: Scotch Roast Beef and Pork
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon | 6 ounces ground pork ( lean, shoulder ) | 6 ounces ground beef chuck ( lean, shoulder ) | 10 ounces creme fraiche | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 4 tablespoons sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Put flour, beef bouillon and ground pork and shoulder in a bowl and mix together with a wooden spoon or your hands. The mixture should have the consistency of breadcrumbs. Stir in creme fraiche, worcestershire sauce and almond extract. Make a well in the centre and pour in the meat mixture to form a smooth meat crust. Stir in the almonds, cover and put in the oven for 2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove from the oven and place on a platter and use kitchen paper handles to remove the breadcrumb crust and nuts. Serve with your choice of vegetables.

title: Penne and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 liter dry red lentils | 500 -600 g lean stewing beef, in 2cm cubes | 250 g penne, cooked, drained and buttered | 5 -8 ounces fresh robusto cheese, in cubes | 1 can navy beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Add all of the main ingredients and mash well. Transfer mixture to a casserole dish and top with the Robusto cheese cubes and the cooked penne. Bake about 30 minutes until browned and bubbling. Serve with a salad of greens.

title: Crispy Cashews
ingredients: 2 cups cashews | 2 teaspoons grated fresh tarragon | 3/4 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Place cashews in a dry skillet over medium high heat. Toast cashews until browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in tarragon and sesame oil. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,spinach leaf,egg substitute,red wine vinegar,gouda cheese,red curry paste
title: Spinach Cakes With Red Curry
ingredients: 250 g frozen spinach leaves | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 100 g aged gouda cheese or 100 g edam cheese | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 egg substitute | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Remove gouda cheese from block. Chop into bite size pieces. Break off leaves, cut off ends and then make them into 2 - 3 bite sized pieces. Put 1 tsp of corn oil on a fry pan. Put the cheese, egg substitute, and vinegar in a bowl. Mix it together with a fork until the dressing is creamy and creamy. Add 1 tsp of red curry paste to the bowl and mix it really well. Use your hands to shape the pesto into mini pancakes or balls. When all of the spinach is used, stir the spinach together and use as a filling for the cakes.

title: Habanero Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, fat trimmed of external fat, coarsely cut | 1/3 cup habanero sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line baking sheets with foil. Cut slits about 1 inch deep across the top of the beef, taking care not to cut all the way through. instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Quick and Easy Garlic Chicken

title: Homemade Beef Stock for Salisbury Steak

Serve with mashed potato.

instructions: Blend cream of mushroom soup, golden syrup, red chili pepper & cashew nuts in a food processor until smooth until combined. Drain prawns, reserving cooking liquid & prawn liquid. instructions: Combine ginger and garlic paste, in small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently. Add chicken and stir to coat browned pieces with mixture. In a small bowl, combine sesame oil and dark sesame oil and stir to mix. Pour sesame oil mixture over chicken, cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or on high for 5 - 7 hours. Serve chicken over mash potatoes..

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut steak diagonally into thick slices and place on a greased 13x9 baking dish. Cut peppers into strips and place over steak. title: Dairy-Oil Pasta Chips

instructions: Drain beans and rinse with water. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray, and line it with the wonton wrappers. Place the beef cubes on the baking sheet. title: Eggplant and Bacon Burgers

instructions: Pre heated grill or grill pan. Heat the oil in a large skillet. Add the eggplant and cook over medium high heat. While the eggplant is cooking, cook the meat. Add prawns and fry lightly for 2 minutes, add wine, bring to boil. Cover and simmer for 10 mins until prawns are cooked. Stir once or twice. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Chicken and Fig Salad

instructions: If doing on the grill, spray grill rack with nonstick spray and preheat grill to medium. Cut peppers in half widthwise. Remove stems from leaves by cutting into thin ribbons, and reserve. Trim ribs and tendons if desired. Slice into thin strips. Transfer to a bowl and add the spinach leaves. In a medium bowl, whisk together coconut milk, ground chuck, hot pepper flakes. Add to bowl with spinach. Add beef mixture. Stir thoroughly. Spray grill rack with nonstick spray and preheat to high. Grill chicken, turning several times, until cooked through and lightly browned on underside, 3 to 4 minutes. Using tongs, cut the chicken into small pieces. Serve with green salad or fresh green vegetables.

instructions: Mix together the crushed cookies, flour, red pepper flakes, worcestershire sauce, dill or parsley and seasonings. Place on a non stick baking sheet. Roll dough into small circular rings and press a fork into each ring. Spray a saucepan with oil and bring water to the boil. Place rings in the boiling water, cook for 2 minutes, turn over and cook another 2 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Irish Asparagus and Spinach Salad

instructions: Toss spinach, asparagus, and whiskey together in a bowl.

title: Torshi
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes ( or 4 medium, if available ) | 1 slice bread
instructions: Peel potatoes and slice thick, if possible. Place slices on foil and heat in oven, until browned, about 12 minutes. Drain. Break out bread of the foil, and place on a plate to cool. Divid bread into 6 portions. Flatten each into a criss cross pattern about 1 1/2 inches deep. Toast criss cross on both sides in a preheated 375°f oven for 10 minutes. Serve with a scoop of yogurt, and a sprinkle of salt if desired.

title: Prawns (Shrimp) With Sesame Oil
ingredients: 600 g raw prawns, peeled and deveined | 4 tablespoons salad oil | 3 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan. Deep fry prawns to desired'doneness'. Set aside. Add sesame oil to frying pan. Heat until smoking hot. Toss shrimp in sesame oil for 1 minute, just until pink and cooked through. Serve on a bed of greens. Yum.

title: Rye-Style English Toasts
ingredients: 3 cups rye bread, torn in pieces | 1/4 cup romano cheese, finely grated | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly grease two baking sheets. Set aside. Combine bread and cheese in medium bowl and sprinkle with flour and allspice. Work into a smooth, soft dough. Knead until smooth. Form dough into two loaves, each about 5 to 6 inches in diameter and about 3 1/2 inches high. Place loaves on prepared baking sheets. Bake 20 minutes or until loaves are light golden and crusts are crisp, brushing every 2 to 3 minutes with dry bread. Let cool for a few minutes before running a knife under hot water and sliding off the bread with a fork.

title: Lite Eggplant (Aubergine)  With Creamy Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 8 medium organic eggplants | 3 tablespoons water | 1 1/3 cups low-fat beef consomme, can be used with beef consomme | 1 tablespoon ginger, minced fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( try my kale-style spread with herbs )
instructions: Halve eggplants lengthwise and peel in large slices.. Place in a colander, sprinkle salt all over and drain for an hour. Place eggplant slices on baking sheets in one layer, skin side up. Broil for 30 to 35 minutes or until slightly browned and tender. In a medium saucepan, add 2 tablespoons of water bring to a boil and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Place over high heat and boil until reduced by half. Strain broth through a fine mesh sieve into a medium bowl to remove all the solids. Place broth and sliced eggplant in a blender and puree until smooth. Return liquid to saucepan, add 1 tablespoon of ginger and allow to simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in 2 tablespoons of pesto. Serve with a side of french bread or toasted baguettes, for dipping.

title: Baked Salmon With Lemon & Lemon Preserves (Sbd P1)

Put the fillets in a shallow baking dish, 1 inch deep. Sprinkle half the lemon zest over the fish. Pour about 1/3 cup of the olive oil over the fish and sprinkle with the remaining lemon zest. Bake for about 10 minutes or until the fillets are just beginning to turn a nice, crusty brown.

title: Melt Down Snow Peas With Sherry & Vanilla

instructions: Wash snow peas and cut diagonally across the back until you can pick them out of the shell. title: Tomato Bacon Balls (Pensalata) Recipe
ingredients: 1 slice bacon | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 lb fresh tomato paste ( approximately 7-8 cans of each )
instructions: Start by starting to fry the bacon in a skillet. Once it is quite crispy enough, remove all of the bacon oil from the skillet before measuring. When all the garlic is cooked, remove the bacon from the pan and set aside. Add all the cans of tomatoes to the bacon fat and stir them quickly to mix it into the mixture. Add a bit of tomato paste if your tomatoes are not well soaked or else you will need a bit more or a bit of water to make the mixture really a thick sauce. Simmer for an hour or two and taste for salt. The longer or shorter you simmer before adding the tomato paste, the drier your sauce will be. I prefer to boil this longer, so i taste the sauce as it thins out before i put it in fridge for a few hours or longer before serving. Serve on top of pasta of your favourite way. You can also put on top of a grilled chicken breast, as is, or the traditional way of doing a grilled chicken breast. Grated sharp cheddar cheese and freshly grated pepper jack cheese are to taste on the base of this dish to distinguish it from the bacon pieces. When the bacon is fried, remove the pieces of bacon that are in chunks and place them back into the pan with the sauce and simmer on low until sauce is thick and creamy. Enjoy.
