title: Lamb and Cabbage With Beans
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 4 tablespoons harissa | 12 ounces lean ground lamb | 6 cups sliced lambs | 1 head green cabbage, sliced into 2 inch wedges | 6 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes in a small bowl and cover with boiling water. Set aside to soak for 15 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile in a large frying pan, heat 1 tbs of the oil over moderately high heat. Add lamb and cook, stirring for 3 minutes or until no pink remains. Stir in harissa, then add lamb stock. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook over moderately low heat for 10 minutes or until lamb is cooked and tender. While lamb is cooking, place cabbage in a colander. Stir flour into juices in frying pan until well mixed. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add cabbage and beans. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until cabbage is tender. Remove from heat, season with salt and serve over cooked linguine.

title: Peppered Crab Legs with Chilli
ingredients: 4 large crab legs, peeled | 1 red chilli pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c put the crabs on a tray, skin side up. Cook in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes until the skin is crispy. Remove from the oven. Turn the oven temperature up to 220°c. Place the crab legs on a chopping board, place the body on top and using your fingers remove the flesh. Slice off the tail of the chilli, then slit the heads slightly off. Cut each leg into three quarters, then tie the tail pieces together with kitchen string. Place the crab legs in a roasting tin. Sprinkle the chilli and chilli pieces over the legs. Scatter the chopped chilli over. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes.

title: Spicy Fried Squash.
ingredients: 1 small yellow squash, cut into 4 pieces | 3 tablespoons cornmeal | 3 tablespoons cilantro or 3 tablespoons parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Microwave the squash on high in 2 tb of water. When all the pieces are covered, remove from microwave and let stand 3 minutes. Drain well and set aside. In another bowl, combine cornmeal and parsley and mix well. Heat 1 tb on medium high until hot but not smoking. Dip each piece of squash in the cornmeal mixture. Quickly fry until golden.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,extra virgin olive oil,pineapple chunk,chocolate,soya sauce,dark rum
title: Chocolate Pizza Pockets
ingredients: 1 pita breads, cut lengthwise into 6 wedges each | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 can pineapple chunks | 1 tablespoon chopped chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat a baking sheet with 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Put pita wedges in a small bowl with rum, sesame sauce and soy sauce. Turn to coat and press into a 6 cup size circle. Spray pizza pan with nonstick cooking spray or line with parchment paper. Add remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil to pan over medium high heat. When oil is hot, add pineapple and toast for 2 minutes or until softened. Add chocolate and stir until chocolate is melted. Set aside to cool slightly before filling. Brush inside of pizza with cooled melted chocolate and allow to cool completely. Warm a small pot filled pizza press over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until warm. Turn pizza out onto a clean counter. Spread a thin layer of cooled pizza sauce onto the bottom and top of the pizza. Place a portion of the drained pineapple on top of the sauce. Sprinkle slices of the remaining pizza with chopped chocolate.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,black sesame seed,walnut,molasses,cod,red lentil,greek yogurt
title: Lentil & Cod Dip
ingredients: 1 lb cod, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 2/3 cups red lentils, rinsed & drained | 1/4 cup whole toasted walnuts | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/8 teaspoon black sesame seed, toasted ( see description ) | 2/3 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except yogurt, in a 2 quart casserole. Cover and chill. Ladle hot dip into 1 cup serving dish and arrange toasted walnuts around the dip.

title: Spiced Sausage and Pumpkin Patties
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pumpkin pie spice | 1 teaspoon dried gingerroot, crushed | 1 1/2 lbs good quality salt pork, cut into small cubes | 1 pound fresh pumpkin or 1 pound winter squash
instructions: Using 3 tablespoons pumpkin spice, rub all over salt pork. Heat 1 inch of oil in large deep pan. Add pork, and cook over medium heat until brown on all sides. Using 2 more tablespoons each of pumpkin spice, ginger and ginger, add ½ the pumpkin spice to meat. Transfer to plate, and set aside. Add remaining spice into drippings in pan. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, for 1 minute. Return pork to skillet, and add remaining pumpkin or winter squash. Cook 5 minutes or longer until squash or winter squash are tender.

title: Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 mango, fresh ( or canned ) | 2 tablespoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Put the mango and poultry seasoning in a food processor, and puree until smooth. Place in a jar, and press to release more juice.

title: Scallops With Peanuts, Potato And Peppered Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 cup kirsch ( or other non-alcoholic liquor ) | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 1/4 lbs potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/4-inch slices or 1 1/4 lbs zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 teaspoons coarsely ground peppercorns | 1 lb sea scallops | 1/2 cup fresh peas
instructions: Dissolve the kirsch in the 1 tsp oil in a small bowl. Arrange half of the potato slices in the bowl. Combine the peanut butter with the peppercorns and set aside. Remove the scallops from the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving. Dip the scallops. Spread some of the peanut butter mixture on the side of each scallop. Roll up and place over boiling water. Cook 1 minute. Transfer the scallops to a clean plate. Return the poaching liquid to the pan, place over moderate heat and bring to a boil. Add the peas and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 2 minutes. Transfer the sauce to a warmed serving dish.

title: Indian Samosa (Garlicky Lamb or Veggie Salad)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs lamb or 1 1/2-2 lbs beef, very lean | 1 cup fresh cauliflower, broken into small florets | 1 green onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dal | 1 cup bengal gram dal ( mochi chana dal ) ( optional ) | romaine lettuce | 1 lemon wedge
instructions: Trim excess fat from the meat, cut into bite size chunks and pound them lightly with a meat mallet until they are of medium consistency. The thinner you can slice the meat, the less fat it will take to cook. The meat tends to cook faster in this recipe. Set aside. Wash and pick over the cauliflower florets, and discard the woody stems. Cut them lengthwise in half so they make little wedges. Cut the tips in half so they look like little noodles. Cut the green onion and dal into small rings. Place the meat in a skillet with 1 cup of water, the ground masala and the remaining water. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Decrease heat to low and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally until the water is almost absorbed. If the meat begins to stick to the bottom of the pan during the cooking, break it up into smaller pieces. When the meat is cooked through turn off the heat and allow the meat to cool for 20 minutes. When it is cool enough to handle, cut off pieces and discard any remaining pieces. Set aside. Cook the cauliflower florets in boiling water until they have begun to soften. Add a few drops of cooking water, as necessary, to prevent the formation of tough, dark, stringy bottoms. Drain, and put into a large serving bowl. Toss with the green onions, and then arrange the cauliflower wedges over the cauliflower. Cover with the meat mixture, and finish with a little lemon wedges. Serve with steamed rice and other indian style rice.

title: Strawberry Cardamom Kebabs
ingredients: 3 lbs lean beef ( prime rib bones ) | 2 1/2 ounces green cardamom seeds ( khus-khus-khus ) | 5 ounces strawberry gelatin or 5 ounces other strawberry gelatin gelatin
instructions: Soak khus on counter for 1 - 2 hours or until water becomes cloudy. Place the cardamom pods in a mortar with a little water, pound or process with pestle for a few seconds, till the water turns cloudy and a little darker. Pour the water through a sieve and mix the mixture with hands. Put meat in the mixture, cover evenly and refrigerate for 1 - 3 hours or till solid. Soak jelly in 1 1/4 cups water and mix with hand to mix. Refrigerate for 3 hours. Cut meat into cubes about 2 - 3 centimeters and fry in batches till brown on all sides, put in baking dish and bake for 15mins at 180c. You can cut these into cubes or cut into cubes and then pour this mixture on the top of the meat. This way, you can enjoy asap. I served them with a yogurt mint salad or kasi patta bread. Also, for a change, you can add 1 1/2 tsp of cinnamon and 1 tsp of monosodium glutamate. This would also work on a pan fried flat potato.

title: Island Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup thousand island dressing | 1/2 lb hot green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 fresh rosemary sprig, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon light rum
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Serve with crackers.

title: Homemade Cream Cheese (Taste) Spread
ingredients: 2 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 teaspoon crushed mixed spice, < a href= '' https : // /www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/homemade-cream-cheese-479122 '' > homemade sour cheese < /a > | flat leaf parsley, chopped, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/flat-leaf-parsley-sourdough-cream-479122 '' > parsley sourdough sourdough cream cheese < /a >
instructions: In a blender, using a handheld or standing mixer, blend the cheese with a wooden spoon. Scrape down the sides as necessary. In a small bowl, combine the spices with a grinding of fresh black pepper or red pepper. The mixture may be refrigerated until ready to use. Once the cheese is smooth, adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper. Pour the cheese mixture into an airtight container and store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. The traditional refrigeration method is to put the cheese into the freezer for approximately one hour, then whack it around in the container until smooth and incorporated. Use immediately when ready to use. To serve, scoop up the mix and add a bit of chopped parsley sprinkled over the top. Serve with fresh vegetable bread.

title: Coriander and Lime Syrup Phyllo Pies
ingredients: 6 serrano chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons coriander | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 60 ml lime juice | 4 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Grind seeds of the serrano chilies under running water if seeds begin to scorch, wash them thoroughly and drain. Place 2 tbs of the coriander in a medium saucepan, add the sugar and heat through. While heating, add the remaining coriander seeds and mix throughly. Set aside. Brush the pastries with egg and dust with remaining coriander. Pour the cooled syrup mixture evenly over the pastries and allow to dry to cool slightly. Line a baking sheet with dampened reynolds wrap. On each sheet, place a phyllo square and spread evenly with a teaspoon of corn syrup mixture. Place a pastry in a wide strip down on the syrup to form a triangle, covering the whole pastry. Brush the edges lightly with egg and fold over to form a triangle. Place on the lined baking sheet. Bake at 240 c until crisp.

title: Pumpkin Shells Waffles
ingredients: pumpkin puree ( a small can of pumpkin ) | 250 ml whipping cream | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 2 eggs | 200 g pasta shells
instructions: Cut pumpkin in half and scoop seeds out of skin. Put pumpkin into a large bowl with a little bit of water, add cream, a pinch of asafoetida and egg. Mix until you obtain a smooth sauce. Stir in the pasta shells. Pour into a tray and refrigerate until required, or for atleast 2 hours. When ready to serve, stir the mixture, let it sit a few minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Tropical Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 yukon gold potatoes | 1/4 cup white rum | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger root, minced
instructions: Place the potatoes in a medium saucepan.

title: Broth- Chinese Noodles Soup
ingredients: 8 cups hot beef consomme | 1/2 lb collard greens ( optional ) or 1/2 lb kale, stems removed and greens cut up ( optional ) | 2 ounces chinese egg noodles | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons collard greens, chopped
instructions: If your greens have stems or very large green ones, trim them and cut them in small pieces. Place 3 cups of hot broth in a pan and bring to a boil. Add collards. Cook for about 2 minutes while you prepare the noodles. Add the egg white. After the noodles are cooked, add yogurt and collards. Put in fridge for 10 minutes or longer before stirring. Serve.

title: Sara's Salmon Loaf

instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. In a large bowl, put spaghetti noodles, fennel seeds, pepperoni, sultanas and jam and mix. Then scatter beef over the bread mixture and roll up. Place in a deep loaf tin. If needed, cover with greaseproof or foil and then bake for 50 - 60 minutes, until cooked through and base is crisp and browned. Cut into slices, to serve and serve.

instructions: Cut each cherry in half and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle oil over the cherry tomatoes. In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, chilli pepper, goat cheese and rhubarb. Pour over the cherry tomatoes and toss. Divide the goat cheese mixture among the cherry tomatoes.

title: Steak with Grapes and Prunes

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook farfalle in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Transfer farfalle to a large bowl. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Place farfalle in the same pot over the farfalle. Add grapes and thyme. Douse with v 8 cooking spray. Cover and cook 5 minutes over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,cilantro,beef,buttermilk,heavy whipping cream,vanilla extract,asparagus,snail
title: Easy Baked Snails!
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 48 snails | 8 teaspoons low-fat buttermilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 14 1/2 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon snipped cilantro | 2 teaspoons ground asparagus, rinsed and drained | 1/8 teaspoon grated vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a large bowl, thoroughly mix together ground beef and buttermilk, breaking up the beef with your fingers. Add granules, vanilla and cream. Stir to mix well. Arrange snails in a deep baking pan that is large enough to hold them comfortably. Coat snails with buttermilk mixture. Sprinkle with cilantro, then top with asparagus and the 1/8 tsp of vanilla extract. Bake until snails are tender and have puffed up, about 20 minutes. Serve hot, with cream.

instructions: Heat 1 tblsp oil in a heavy 3 - 4 quart saucepan over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, but not smoking. Olive oil into pot and heat over moderate heat until hot, but not smoking, but not smoking, but not smoking. Pour remaining 1/2 tblsp oil into pot and boil stout mixture, stirring, for 20 minutes, or until reduced by half and thick, stirring frequently. Stir in red beans and cook covered 5 minutes, add beef and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until meat and beans are tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tomato and Ham
ingredients: 4 ham steaks | 1 kg plum tomatoes | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 6 red potatoes, sliced
instructions: Boil the tomatoes with water until tender, drain and place in a bowl. Dice the ham, removing the larger pieces of fat and fat. Place the plum tomatoes and golden syrup in a saucepan with 4 tbsp water.

title: Jerk Covered Parsnips, Japanese Style
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled, cored and cut into chunks | 1 1/2 lbs boneless lean beef chuck | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon white vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons japanese soy sauce | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Cut beef chuck into 2 chunks and place into a large pot. Add white vinegar and soy sauce. Stir to combine. Add cocoa powder and cayenne. Bring liquid to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Noodles & Sage
ingredients: 5 ounces egg noodles, uncooked | 1/8 teaspoon sage | 1 tablespoon dry instant rice, uncooked
instructions: Cook noodles, drain. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan sprinkle sage, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Stir in rice. Stir in 1 tbl. Additional water and return noodles to pan. Maintain a low boil, cover and simmer for 7 - 10 minutes or until well cooked and hot.

title: Potato and Olive Rounds
ingredients: 1/2 lb potato, grated very fine | 6 ounces cream cheese, at room temp | 1/2 cup mayonnaise or 1/2 cup miracle whip ( may need more depending on consistency of spread you have ) | 1/2 cup mashed potatoes | 1/2 cup sliced olive | 1/4 cup mayonnaise or 1/4 cup miracle whip ( may need more depending on consistency of spread you have ) | 8 -12 -12 -15 toothpicks
instructions: Combine grated potato and cream cheese in a bowl. Add mayonnaise, mayonaise, mashed potatoes and olives. Mix well. Spoon into four lightly greased and floured 9 x 5 inch loaf pans. Refrigerate until set, about 3 hours. To serve, cut into eight thick slices. Serve with dipping sauce or plain vinaigrette. Note, if sour cream is included in sour cream mixture, omit the mayonaise. Sour cream mayonnaise mayonnaise is a wonderful ingredient for this delicious potato cake.

title: Walnut Curry With Turmeric
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnuts ( dry roasted, see note below ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier or 1 1/2 tablespoons other good liqueur | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Note, the measurements are for a small amount of nuts or liquid. Heat a small pan, then turn stove to low, and add the walnuts. Saute until golden in color and walnuts are slightly crispy on one side. Turn off stove, and quickly stir in the rest of the ingredients, except for the sugar and mix well. Serve as a garnish for chicken or rice.

title: Coconut Mussels
ingredients: 2 cans whole canned mussels | 1/4 cup shredded coconut | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded ( or other cheese of your choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Coat a baking dish with cooking spray. Open each can and drain the juice. In a small bowl, combine the drained mussels with the juice from both cans and the coconut. Divide evenly into the baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over the top of the mussels. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.

title: Lettuce-Wrapped Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 1 cup shell pasta, uncooked | 1 2/3 lbs littleneck clams or 2 2/3 lbs littleneck clams, scrubbed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 5 to 8 minutes. While the pasta is cooking, discard any clams that do not open. Drain the pasta, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid. Meanwhile, place the clams in a large nonreactive bowl. Pour 3/4 cup of cooking liquid in the bowl and toss to combine. Add the drained pasta and mix. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: loaf french bread,yellow bell pepper,creme fraiche,savory,dark rum,fine salt
title: Normandy Pepper Bread
ingredients: 2 large yellow bell peppers | 1/3 cup dark rum or 1/3 cup brandy, of your choice | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon fine salt | 1 teaspoon fresh savory, leaves | 1 loaf french bread, loaf
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f or 300°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice the tops off the bell peppers and remove seeds. Place the peppers in a microwave safe dish or dish, cover and cook on high for 50% power for 6 minutes, turning once. Remove from microwave and place skin side up on foil lined baking sheet. Leave on the oven door ajar to cool for 15 minutes. Place the bell peppers and remaining ingredients into a blender or processor. Pulse for 5 seconds or until you have a good puree. Pour into a large bowl and stir, then cover and refrigerate. To serve, split bread in half lengthwise.

title: Tostadas Filled With Fruit & Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces mixed fresh fruit, such as pears, apricots, berries, peaches, apples, grapes ( any kind ) | 1/3 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons apricots, diced | 2 tablespoons green olives, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon-colored food coloring | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 12 tostadas
instructions: Soak a 4 - 5 ounce bag of mixed fresh fruits in water, until softened slightly, about 1/2 hour. Drain fruit, save liquid. Gently fold in parsley, apricots, olives and lemon food color. Combine all ingredients with reserved soaking liquid and add to fruit mixture, using only enough reserved liquid to thin to desired texture. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more lemon colored food color. Put each tostada in a shallow dish. Divide tapenade mixture evenly over tostadas, and cover with remaining tostada halves. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 and up to 24 hours. Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

title: Raspberry and Chilli Dressing With Thyme
ingredients: 6 ounces raspberries | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 teaspoon finely chopped galangal
instructions: Combine red wine vinegar, white vinegar, thyme, and chilli in a screw top jar. Cover and shake to blend. Divide between 4 serving bowls.

title: Sweet and Savory Lamb Casserole

instructions: Cook and drain the macaroni as directed on the package. Meanwhile, fry the ground meat until brown. Add pine nuts or slivered almonds.

title: Pork Bavarian
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped cardamom seed | 1 boneless lean pork | 1/2 lb field mushroom | 2 cups cream | 1 3/4 cups milk
instructions: Toast the cardamom seeds in a small skillet over medium heat until slightly darker than brown. Slice the pork and fry in the seeds on both sides. After removing the meat from the pan put it into a covered roasting pan and add the mushroom. Cook at low heat until the mushrooms are browned, about 1 hour or until the mixture becomes syrupy. To make the bavarian sauce, boil the cream and milk in a small saucepan. Stir the mixture until smooth with the evaporated milk. To serve, place a dollop of the cream on a plate with a dab of bavarian sauce. Add sliced cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: beet,heavy cream,rump steak,red wine vinegar,tahini,saffron strand
title: Beet and Prawn With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 5 medium red beets | 1 tablespoon saffron strand | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 2 beef rump steak, trimmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200f degrees. Score the tops of beets with a sharp knife. Place the beetroots in a roasting tin or a baking dish. Sprinkle on the saffron strands and drizzle over the cream. Roast for 1 hour, until tender and browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Remove peel and pith from beef. Slice with the grain into thin strips. Place on a serving plate. Mix vinegar and tahini together in a bowl and allow to stand for 15 minutes. Serve with the beef and beetroot mixture, alongside the sauce.

instructions: Combine ingredients except ragu and cheese in electric slow cooker.

instructions: Mix chicken soup base, evaporated milk or cream of chicken soup, and crisco in a large bowl and shape into 3 inch meatballs. Cook in a large non stick skillet or wok over medium high heat, turning as needed, until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove from skillet, and cut into 1 inch pieces. Continue cooking meatballs and drippings in pan until cooked through, about 5 minutes more. Add bamboo shoots.

title: Homemade Raspberry Trifle

instructions: Mix together the chocolate cake mix, nuts, horseradish and salt and pepper to taste. Cut the lard into squares and set aside. Add the raspberry to the lard and then layer the chocolate cake mix this will be the base of the trifle. Cut the tomato sauce into squares and top with tomato sauce and the lidded sponge cake. Refrigerate for 3 hours.

title: Japanese Spiced Spiced Sweet Potatoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Boil sweet potatoes until fork tender remove and cool potatoes, peel off skin and mash until smooth. Place in a large bowl. Stir in chicken bouillon, pineapple juice, sake and radishes, toss to coat sweet potatoes. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and bake at 300 f for 1 - ½ hours.

title: Indian Garlic Roast for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed, ground | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed | 2 tablespoons jalapeno peppers, finely minced | 1 lb rump roast, trimmed ( or similar )
instructions: In a mortar, combine coriander and cardamom and pound into a fine powder. Rub spice mixture over meat. Heat a large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add meat, cook, turning over once, until browned to the desired doneness, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter.

title: Mustard Crusted Salmon

instructions: Cut steaks lengthwise into 2 equal pieces. Insert mustard seed pieces into 2 equal pieces of steak, pressing into the cuts. In a medium bowl combine cheese, triple sec and 1 teaspoon of salt.

title: Easy Soya Corn Rounds #2 (Low Fat)

instructions: Place frozen corn in the container of a food processor. Add bran and pulse to blend until it is fine. You may need to refrigerate about 30 minutes for the corn to thaw. Cool completely on foil lined cookie sheet. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chinese Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans ( trimmed ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce
instructions: Steam the green beans until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Heat the oyster sauce, light soy sauce and chill. Pour over the green beans. Serve.

title: Bread Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 ciabatta | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup raisins or 1/4 cup coconut, chopped | 3 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Slice crusts off ciabatta and toast lightly on one side in a frying pan over medium heat, but do not brown. Spray with pam, place on oven tray and toast with garlic powder, raisins or coconut. Watch for the oil to smoke but not burn, remove from heat and pour over warm bread.

title: Pigs of the Round Rabbit
ingredients: 1 rabbit, whole | 1/2 - 3/4 lb lean ground lean pork | 1/2 - 3/4 lb american cheese, coarsely shredded | 1/4 - 1/2 cup yellow bell peppers or 1/4-1/2 cup green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: Place the rabbit and other stuffing ingredients in a large, heavy skillet or deep frying pan. Mix meat and vegetables with your hands. If the stuffing sticks, pat them dry with your hands. Cover and place in a warm oven at 350of 30 minutes, until meat is cooked through, stirring occasionally. Serve warm with hot crusty french bread.

title: Rigatoni with Peanut Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup reduced-fat peanut butter | 1 can reduced-fat cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice and zest | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cheesy Baked Garlic & Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes | 1/2 cup ranchero monterey shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Prick unpeeled potatoes with fork. Place potatoes in a large shallow roasting pan. Bake in preheated oven, uncovered, 25 minutes. Turn potatoes over, and bake until tender, about 30 minutes more. Slice potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Sprinkle with ranchero cheese. Return to oven, and bake 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: coffee creamer,rice pilaf mix,bay leaf,flat leaf parsley,tortilla,raisin,chuck
title: The Real Deal Meat Nests
ingredients: 1 box corned beef, rinsed | 1 box graham cracker rice pilaf mix | 2 lbs ground chuck or 2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1/4 cup coffee creamer | 2 bay leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 f degrees. Remove the corned beef from the package and shred the meat in a large bowl. Add the cheese, cracker crumbs, ground meat, coffee creamer, bay, parsley and raisins. Mix well. Line the nests with wet kitchen towels and set the cups on them. Bake until hot and bubbly.

title: Herby Crusted Pork Chops
ingredients: 8 pork chops | salt and pepper | 2 cups white flour | 1 bunch fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Season the chops with salt and pepper. Sprinkle the flour over and toss the chops in the flour to coat evenly. Spray a roasting pan with pam and place the chops on the oiled pan. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 20 minutes, or until the chops are just cooked and the outsides are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: leek,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken thigh,rice flour,broth,italian dressing
title: Chicken and Italian Leeks
ingredients: 4 cups chicken thigh, cut into strips | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1 can leeks, drained and sliced ( white and pale green parts only ) | 3/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | store bought italian dressing, as needed | 1/2 cup broth
instructions: Place the chicken, rice, leeks, parmesan, and dressing into blender and puree until smooth. Pour mixture into a saucepan, add the broth, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 30 minutes longer, or until chicken is tender and vegetables are fork tender.

Random Ingredients: deli turkey,linguine,mint leaf,italian bread,salt black pepper,currant
title: Linguine Con Cervelli (Linguine with Turkey)
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 2 cans deli turkey, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup currants, dried | 2 cups packed fresh mint leaves | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook linguine at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Return the water to a boil. Cook turkey slices in the boiling water until browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain and arrange in the bowl with the linguine. Toss turkey slices with currants, 2 mint leaves, salt, pepper, and dried mint leaves. Serve hot.

title: Baby Greens or Peas With Sunflower Oil
ingredients: 1 lb frozen baby green peas | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Boil enough water to cover the peas. Add the peas and cook according to direction.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,coriander powder,coleslaw,extra virgin olive oil,tamarind paste,vinegar,spiral pasta,onion powder
title: Sweet N' Spicy Coleslaw
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces coleslaw, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon crushed mixed pulses, or to taste | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 fluid ounces extra-virgin olive oil | 2 fluid ounces vinegar, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Toss the coleslaw with onion powder, coriander powder, sugar, mixed pulses, and tamarind paste in a large bowl. Stir the olive oil and vinegar together in a separate bowl, stirring until combined. Pour into the coleslaw, and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: swordfish steak,lima bean,tap water,spicy brown mustard,double cream,brown sugar
title: Grilled Steak With Lima Beans (Soupe a L'ivoire)
ingredients: 1/4 cup light-brown sugar | 1/3 cup dark sweet mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons spicy brown mustard | 2 lbs swordfish steaks | 1/2 cup lima beans | 2 -3 cups lightly cooked tap water, for cooking beans ( optional ) | double cream, as needed
instructions: Mix together the light brown sugar, dark sweet grain mustard and spicy brown mustard in a shallow baking dish which has been heated in the oven. Add the fish and turn to coat both sides. In a small saucepan, cook the lima beans in the tepid water, uncovered, for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain, reserving the cooking water, and set aside. Preheat the grill or broiler and prepare a hot grill. Set the fish under a hot grill. Grill for about 5 - 7 minutes per side for rare or 8 - 10 minutes per side for medium rare. Transfer to a serving platter, and cover loosely to keep warm. Add the lima beans to the hot cooking liquid, stir, and heat through. Spoon the sauce on the fish, and serve with a side of a sprig of fresh mint.

title: Easy Vinegar Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 3/4-1 1/2-1 inch thick | salt & pepper, to taste | 2 -3 teaspoons capers ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Slice the pork chops across the grain into 2 or 3 inch wide strips, depending on how high meat is in the strips they should be. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. You can also rub salt and pepper onto the outside of the pork chops. Combine the capers and vinegar in a cup, pour over the pork, and gently toss with a fork until there is only a tiny bit of leftover caper mixture left. Place in the refrigerator to marinate while you preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place a large roasting pan on the lower shelf of the oven while you preheat the pan so the oil can heat up. When the oil is hot, add the pork and toss well to lightly coat. Turn the meat once or twice to ensure even browning of the meat. Don't crowd the pan. If your pan is large, you may need to add a little more oil. You want to brown the outside of the meat quickly, not get burned. Try to not let the oil brown or runny. When the meat has lightly browned on the outside, remove from the pan and drain any excess oil. When all the meat is nicely browned, place it in a serving platter. Use any remaining liquid or some of your pan juices to make a gravy in a sauce pan or a medium sized saucepot. Place pan over medium heat. Add some of the drained caper liquid or water. Stir until thickened. Serve pork chops with gravy and/or vegetables.

title: Grilled Beetroot, Pumpkin & Pineapple With Nuts and Toasted Panko Crumbs
ingredients: 200 g pineapple, chunks | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 100 g roasted beetroots, peeled and halved
instructions: Place pineapple chunks in a microwave safe bowl, cover with cling film and microwave on high power for 20 - 30 seconds or until soft. Place in bowl with panko and microwave on high power for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden. Spread out pineapple on a serving plate and allow to cool. Preheat grill. Brush barbecue rack with oil, cook beetroot for 2 minutes or until just tender. Add toasted panko and pineapples to barbecue, toss well and serve.

title: Focaccia on the Trees
ingredients: 1 large red chili pepper, deseeded | 220 g unbleached all-purpose flour ( plus extra for dusting ) | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Place your red chili pepper in the freezer while you are making your sponge fingers. Peel if necessary. Wash your hands and lightly pat dry. Mix your flour and yeast in a large bowl, adding about 200mls water, and a grinding of black pepper. Dry the chilli thoroughly on a baking paper–lined baking tray, or leave for 20 minutes in a warm place for a bit of time to draw out the juices. Tip the yeast into a large bowl and mix with a wooden spoon. Add the pinch of pepper and mix well. Gradually add the warm flour, a little more. Stir until everything is moistened. Turn the dough out on to a lightly floured surface and knead, adding flour only if you feel it is too sticky. It will begin to lose its stickiness and develop very sharpness. Return the dough to the bowl, cover with clingfilm and leave to rise for about an hour 20 minutes. Remove and divide dough into 24 pieces. You may need to add more water this time. Divide the dough and form into balls, using your hands or lightly floured hands. Place on a greased tray, cover with clingfilm and leave to rise for another hour. To test if the dough is springy to the touch, knead lightly on a lightly floured surface. Preheat the oven to 200c/400f/gas mark 7, 200c/400f/gas sprinkle with a little flour and put a tray in for baking the focaccia, turn the heat down to 160c/400f/gas mark 6 and leave to prove for 20 minutes. Roll out the dough as thinly as possible. Place the focaccia on a well oiled baking tray and brush with a little olive oil. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, or, if you wish, cook for for 3 - 5 minutes longer until golden. Remove from the oven and turn up the focaccia on a cooling rack. Eat warm or warm, with a few spoonfuls of your favorite fresh herb sauce and extra garlic.

title: Garlicky Orange Peppers
ingredients: 4 whole orange bell peppers, cut into strips | 16 whole cloves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place peppers on a large baking sheet. Roast peppers in the preheated oven until skin is crisp and peppers have blackened. Place peppers in plastic bag, seal, and cool. Peel peppers with a vegetable peeler into a large bowl. Rinse with cool water. Remove skin from peppers by soaking them in cool water for 10 minutes. Drain, and set aside skins for 15 to 20 minutes. Slice peppers lengthwise with a very sharp knife. Place sliced peppers in a nonreactive baking dish, and sprinkle with cloves. Bake in preheated oven until peppers are tender, 15 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,coconut oil,sun tomato,gruyere cheese,tahini,grain rice
title: Spanish Chocolate Mousse - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 4 tablespoons light coconut oil | 2 tablespoons tahini | 8 ounces shredded gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup shredded swiss gruyere cheese | 10 sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 8 ounces argy fresh shredded coconut oil | 4 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut oil and tahini. Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the argy gruyere cheese, followed by sun dried tomatoes. Stir in the rice, and coat with the coconut oil and tahini mixture. Serve drizzled evenly with extra cheese.

title: Spinach and Mango
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fresh spinach, washed | 1 mango, peeled and chopped
instructions: Wash the spinach thoroughly and cut the leaves in smaller pieces. Place the spinach on a pan with low light on top. Cover and steam over low heat for about 10 minutes or until the spinach is steamed. Sprinkle mango all over and serve immediately.

title: Charmoula
ingredients: 1 cup dry lentils | 1 cup cracked black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon cardamom | 1/2 cup dried cherries
instructions: Wash lentils. Cook them in 2 cups boiling water until soft. Drain& place aside. In another saucepan add the black peppercorns, cardamom and cherry. Soak for 2 hours or so. Place lentils and cherries in saucepan and mix until well coated. Stir in the above mix of ingredients and cook for about 10 minutes.

title: Ravioli in Maple-Sauce Broth
ingredients: 12 ounces refrigerated cheese ravioli | 2 cups heavy cream | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/4 cup grated gruyere
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Arrange ravioli on a baking sheet and bake ravioli in preheated oven for 8 minutes. Warm cream in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently until slightly thickened. Stir in maple syrup and tomato paste. Simmer for 5 minutes. Arrange ravioli over cream mixture and top with gruyere.

title: Crostoli Di Ricotta
ingredients: 1 container ricotta | hazelnuts ( optional ) | maraschino cherry ( optional ) | cheese ( optional )
instructions: Spread about 2 tablespoons of butter on the bottom of a roasting pan. Spread ricotta. Spread nutella. Sprinkle with maraschino and hazelnuts. Grate cheese lightly over the top as required. Allow to stand for 20 minutes before serving and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,jalapeno pepper,monterey jack pepper cheese,chinese five spice powder,mostaccioli pasta,tomato concentrate,basil leaf,cayenne
title: Jalapeno Spiced Mostaccioli(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 pound all-american medium-chunky whole-milk pasta | 1 1/2 pounds shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 can drained and diced tomatoes with concentrate, undrained | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried basil leaves | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons chinese five-spice powder | 1 jalapeno pepper, stemmed and chopped
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Generously grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix together the monterey jack pepper cheese, diced tomatoes with concentrate, brown sugar, basil leaves, cayenne, and five spice powder. Spoon cheese on top of the pasta. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes. Use a spatula to flip the dish, allowing even cooking.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,coriander seed,sherry wine,chili bean,aubergine,oregano leaf,cooking spray
title: Aubergine (Eggplant) Salad
ingredients: 200 g aubergines, sliced | 2 poblano chiles | cooking spray or 2 teaspoons olive oil | 500 g savoy cabbage, cut into 12 wedges ( about 3-1/2 cm ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons orange juice | 3 teaspoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Lightly spray a baking paper lined baking tray with cooking oil.

title: Tamari Crusted Turkey - 4 Servings
ingredients: 4 -8 ounces extra lean ground turkey breast | 1 bottle tamari | 20 pitted prunes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Rub turkey with tamari, about 1/4 cup, then sprinkle with prunes. Place on large rimmed baking pan and bake 15 to 20 minutes. Bread should lightly brown and turkey is cooked through.

title: Brussels Sprouts Steak and Farfalle
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) noodles | 6 cubes steak | 1 pound brussels sprouts - rinsed, dried and halved | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,pearl barley,yellow pepper,cream,pecan half,white wine
title: Baked Peppers With Caramelized Pearl Barley
ingredients: 2 large yellow peppers | 4 teaspoons pearl barley | 1 cup white wine | whipped cream ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon golden raisin ( optional ) | pecan halves ( optional ) or walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Wash peppers and remove stem, seeds, and veins. Place pepper on an aluminum foil roasting pan. Cook at 325 degrees for 20 minutes, then turn so it is uniformly browned all over. Meanwhile, pour wine into a medium skillet. Bring to a boil then simmer, covered for 20 minutes. Add the pearl barley to the pan for about 1 minute to deglaze it before adding to the pan. Stir and allow to bubble for about 3 minutes then turn the heat off. Place peppers in an ovenproof dish and cover. Place the pan of peppers directly on top of the stove. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the skins loosen, bubbling and brown slightly. Remove from oven and pour wine over the peppers. Let sit 5 minutes, then cover. Serve hot, and top with whipped cream, nuts, or pecan halves as you wish.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,triple sec,peanut,lamb shoulder,asparagus,arborio rice,italian sausage
title: Lamb Shoulder Rice Nests
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cut in 4 pieces | 1 lb italian sweet sausage | 1/2 lb spanish arborio rice | 1/2 cup triple sec | 12 ounces asparagus | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts | 1 package tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place lamb in a large roasting pan. In a medium skillet, brown the sausages in a small amount of oil. Remove mixture from pan. Discard the juices from the roasting pan, and set aside. Discard excess oil. Place the roasting pan in the oven. Bake 20 minutes or until meat falls apart. Let meat sit for 10 minutes. Remove meat from roasting pan, and set aside. Boil the rice in salted water. When the water reaches a boil, remove from heat, and set aside to cool for 5 minutes. In the same saucepan used to fry meat, cook the asparagus until bright green in color, about 2 minutes. Drain, and cut in 2 inch lengths, and soak in warm water until tender. Drain well and pat dry with paper towels. Remove bones from meat. Discard bones. Using the same roasting pan used to fry asparagus, heat the broiler. Turn pieces occasionally until they show all grill marks. To serve, place 1 cup of rice on a warm serving platter, top with a few pieces of lamb, and a few pieces of asparagus. Drizzle some of the pan drippings over the meat and serve with crushed tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,corn tortilla chip,pecorino romano cheese,baby spinach,snow pea
title: Tortilla Salad with Spinach and Noodles
ingredients: 1 bag corn chips | 2 packages baby spinach, washed, chopped | 1 package fresh snow peas, trimmed, sliced | 1/2 pound baby ridged, shelled, crisped, and crisped popcorn | 1/4 cup grated pecorino-romano cheese, or as needed
instructions: Place 3 corn chips in a bowl, and coat with cooking spray. Let stand until chips start to show oil on the outsides, about 20 minutes. Arrange spinach, snow peas, and popcorn in a large salad bowl, and toss with cheese. Set aside 1/2 cup of reserved chips for topping.

title: Spanish Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pinto bean, washed and sorted | 1/4 cup salt ( approximately ) | 3 tablespoons sazon goya | 1 pint grape tomatoes ( grape tomatoes can also be used ) or 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Drain the beans and plunge them into a pot along with 2 quarts of water. Bring to a boil, cover, and turn heat to low, and simmer until the liquid is reduced by one third, and the beans very tender, about 2 hours. Do not overcook, because the beans will continue to give off their liquid and be mashed with the back of a spoon. Reserve 2 cups of the beans and discard the rest of the liquid. Place the remaining 1 cup of beans in a food processor or blender, and pulse with a pinch of salt until chopped roughly. In a large bowl, mix the drained beans with the remaining ingredients and mix well. Place in a bowl, cover, and chill for several hours or overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,chicken stock,brussels sprout,frying chicken,poppy seed
title: Baked Chicken With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 3 lbs frying chickens, cut into quarters | 1 pint whipping cream | 1 lb fresh brussels sprout | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place chicken pieces in a large baking dish and drizzle with cooking oil. Place in oven and cook for 45 mins, turning and brushing and turning chicken over every 5 mins to brown evenly. Remove from oven and cover with foil to keep warm. Boil cream, place in saucepan, cover and boil quickly, stirring frequently or cool completely. Cut brussels sprouts into 1 wide strips lengthways. Remove seeds and stems from sprouts. Place drained brussels sprouts, skinned side down in saucepan, cover, cook over a gentle heat for about 12 mins, stirring from time to time to prevent sticking. Place poppyseeds into a screw top jar, add stock and seal. Store in a cool, dry place for 2 - 3 days or until tender. Skim fat from sauce. Spoon brussels sprouts on to plates.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,confectioner ' sugar,beet,spice,oregano leaf,cayenne pepper,honey,ancho chile powder
title: Spicy Spread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mixed spice | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 pinch dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar | 20 medium beets, scrubbed and sliced ( about 4 cups )
instructions: Place chile powder, mixed spice, guar gum, honey, cayenne, and oregano in a small bowl, and stir to mix. Set aside. Place beets in a pot with enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain, peel, and slice beets crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Whisk confectioners' sugar and reserved beets in a bowl, then stir in beets. Continue to whisk while slowly adding confectioner's sugar. Continue to whick, gradually increasing amounts of beets and sugar until desired thickness is reached.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,crabmeat,sage,onion powder,pork loin,onion soup mix,breadcrumb,corn muffin mix
title: Crab Meat Loin Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork loin | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage | 1 package corn muffin mix | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Bake loin on a sheet pan, on center rack of oven, in 375 degree oven, for 1 hour. Combine soups, onion powder, sage and spice in large bowl and mash into meat with hands. Set meat aside. Remove loin from oven and let sit for 10 minutes. Stuff with meat mixture and spread out in a 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle bread crumbs over meat. Sprinkle with corriander. Bake at 375 for 1 hour. Cut into 12 slices. Serve with soup of your choice.

Random Ingredients: danish blue cheese,coriander,bay leaf,pecorino romano cheese,poultry seasoning,onion,chicken
title: Herbed Chicken and Blue Cheese
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/4 lbs chicken, cut up or 2 -2 1/4 lbs turkey, cut up | 1/2 cup danish blue cheese | 1 tablespoon dried coriander | 2 teaspoons parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 -2 small onion, chopped | fresh coriander ( fresh herb is best ) | bay leaf
instructions: Place chicken or turkey in glass dish. Combine all other ingedients in a small bowl. Pour over chicken or turkey. Marinade in refrigerator for a minimum of 4 hours or overnight. Remove chicken from marinade, pat dry well, remove skin and excess fat. Cook covered or bbq. If cooking in smoker, turn down heat. If using as a bbq, allow to cook about 1 hour, or just until meat is cooked and falls of spoon. The last 15 minutes of cooking time, check consistency with pkg if necessary. Drain excess cooking liquid. Arrange on serving platter and garnish with fresh herbs.

title: Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground turkey sausage | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 can mussels, drained and debearded | 1 tablespoon hummus, or more to taste
instructions: Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium heat until slightly browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes. Stir turkey, orange juice, and mussels into the turkey mixture along with any remaining crumbs. Cover and refrigerate the salad for at least two hours.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,red pepper flake,lime zest,red chilies,pumpkin,russet potato,goat cheese
title: Potatoes and Goat Cheese With Chillies
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled | 8 small red chilies | 8 tablespoons goat cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1 tablespoon dried red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon ground dried red chilies
instructions: Cut potatoes into thin strips, about the width of your index finger. Cut 3/4 inch sticks from the long side of the chilies and cut a slit down the length of each one. Set aside. Bring water to a boil in a saucepan, then add potato strips. Cook potatoes for 8 minutes or until tender. Drain, then mix with chilies, cheese, yogurt, lime peel, chili flakes, and dried red chilies. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mutton,basil leaf,canadian bacon,rum,part mozzarella cheese,bulgur,skirt steak,sherry
title: Skewered Steak with Yogurt and Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 500 g lean skirt steaks | 50 g bulgur | 10 slices canadian bacon | 100 g part-skim mozzarella cheese, cut into 12 strips | 400 g yogurt with fruit yoghurt and basil | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 tablespoon rum | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf, washed and torn
instructions: Place meat and bulgur in heatproof bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of rum and allow the meat to soak in water for 10 minutes. Rinse the bowl with water until beef is cool. Remove the meat and reserve the liquid. Place bacon strips on a board. Dredge with salt. Roll each piece of meat in a strip of salt. Place bacon fat side down on a tray. Cover and refrigerate until ready to cook. Preheat grill on high heat. Alternate with the steaks until well soaked. Grill meat until cooked through. Allow to rest for 5 minutes. Place yoghurt salad ingredients in a bowl. Dip each piece of meat in the yogurt dressing. Place the steak on top of the yoghurt salad. Garnish with basil leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Americanized Portuguese Mushrooms, Pickles,  (Dorie Greens)
ingredients: 32 ounces canned mushrooms ( whole or quartered ) | 1 tablespoon table salt | 1 large head romaine lettuce ( or other green leaf lettuce, such as oak leaf and/or curly endive ) | 1 large pimiento | 1/4 cup salad oil or 1/4 cup salad oil | 1/2 cup dry table salt | 2/3 cup unadulgent fondue chicken stock ( or 1/3 cup portugalese stock ) or 2/3 cup canned broth ( or 1/3 cup portugalese stock ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/4 cup maple syrup or 1/4 cup tamarind paste
instructions: Drain the mushrooms reserving liquid. Set the mushrooms aside in the refrigerator to absorb the flavors of the liquid. Meanwhile, finely dice the garlic and set aside in the refrigerator. Trim the ends off of the romaine lettuce and cut into 1/4 strips. Set aside for later. Cut the pimento in half lengthwise and cut into 3 to 5 lengths, then cut those in half lengthwise | Rinse out the bowl of your choice and pat the pimentos dry. In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the pimentos 1 at a time. If they begin to float, they're ready. Drain them by placing into a colander and dipping into icy cold water. Place them into a bowl containing cold water and set aside until just limp. Chop the lettuce into 1/2 inch wide strips. Trim the endive leaves and blanch in abundant water 6 to 8 minutes, then quickly slice them diagonally into 1/2 to 1 inch pieces, using a sharp knife. Repeat with the lettuce, lettuce, pimiento, and salt. Place 3/4 cup of the mushroom liquid onto a serving platter and set aside. In a small saucepan, combine the reserved mushroom liquid and the dissolved cornstarch and whisk until mixture is light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add the cornstarch mixture to the mushroom liquid and gently stir until thickened.

title: Mushroom Orange Grill
ingredients: 12 ounces button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons oil | fresh orange juice | radish or fresh cilantro
instructions: Put oil, mushrooms, orange juice and fresh veggies on grill. Grill on med high heat and sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Linguine Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1/4 cup sultana | 1/4 cup chopped sesame seeds if you have fresh | 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup flour, seasoned with | 1/4 cup mirin | 1 package linguine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Bring 10 cups water to boil add cauliflower and cook according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Remove stems. In bowl soak the sultanas in water to cover 2 minutes. Drain. In bowl combine the sesame seed, cheddar, breadcrumbs and flour. Drain and set aside 1/2 the cauliflower florets. Mix cauliflower and remaining falvets into the cheese mixture. Line a baking tray with aluminum foil. Spoon in prepared batter. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 40 - 45 minutes, until browned. Let rest 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and pour over other salad greens. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,whipping cream,risotto rice,sage leaf,eggnog,artichoke heart,rigatoni pasta,apple
title: Apple Nog Soup by Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 1 lb apple, peeled and diced | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 6 large fresh sage leaves, coarsely chopped | 6 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 8 cups hot cooked risotto rice | 1 package rigatoni pasta | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 eggnog
instructions: Place the apple, artichokes and sage into a large saucepan along with the chopped hard cooked eggs, rice and hot cooked rice. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring frequently. Boil just until the rice is tender. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes. Remove from heat, but keep pan over very low heat. In a small bowl, beat the cream with the eggnog until smooth. Pour into the soup without stirring, and sprinkle over the cooked rice. Serve with a sprinkle of chopped chives.

title: Asparagus with Pecans
ingredients: 250 g asparagus tips, in 2-inch pieces and tips trimmed | 8 large fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1/2 cup whole pecans, toasted
instructions: Steam the asparagus over steaming water until the tips are tough and slightly charred. Transfer the asparagus to a food processor. Add the sage, cumin, pecans and nuts and process until it is finely ground.

title: Asparagus-Corn Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus, cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( about 12 small ) | 1 3/4 cups mexican-style corn | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated fresh gingerroot
instructions: In a large sauce pan, cook asparagus in boiling water 3 minutes, or until just crisp tender. Drain and transfer to a bowl using a slotted spoon. Reserve asparagus cooking water, drain cooking liquid. Reserve asparagus cooking water. Return 4 c cooking liquid to pan and heat to a boil, stirring often. Add corn and cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat. In a bowl, whisk cream with ginger until just combined and pour into soup. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute. Garnish with asparagus pieces and serve.

title: Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix, more to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and cover. Store in refridgerator for up to 2 days. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 4 scallions | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds ( or more if you prefer less spiciness ) | 1 lb monterey jack cheese
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil and add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Finely chop the scallions and put into a small bowl. Cover with ice water so that the salt doesn't melt. Set the bowl in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain in a colander. Mash the scallions in the boiling water. Drain the water out of the bowl. Add the mustard seed and set aside. Cut the cheese into chunks about 1in in size. Put a layer of the cheese into a shallow roasting pan and spread out to cover the cheese completely. Repeat, ending with the cheese on top. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and let sit for 30 minutes to set. When the cheese has set, it can be eaten as is or sprinkled on top with minced parsley if desired.

title: Tea Vermicelli and Avocado-Chocolate Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup sweetened dark brown sugar | 1 ripe avocado, diced | 1 package dry rice vermicelli | 1/4 cup prepared brewed tea ( i use decaffeinated )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve with toasted rice vermicelli.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,french bread,buttery cracker crumb,tart apple,club soda,dark sesame oil,egg white
title: Deep Dish Bread and Butter Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups crushed buttery crackers | 1 cup french bread, cut into cubes | 1 cup tart apple, peeled, cored and sliced thin | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 4 eggs whites | 1 1/2 cups enchilada sauce | 1 cup club soda
instructions: Line a 9x13 inch casserole dish with crumbs, shaking off excess. Place half the crushed crackers in the dish, and repeat layering with bread cubes and apples. In a small bowl, stir together sesame oil, eggs and enchilada sauce, set aside. Beat egg whites with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form, then fold egg whites into batter slowly. Pour batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle crumb topping over batter. Bake in the middle of a 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes, or until light brown. Allow to cool 10 minutes before inverting dish onto a serving plate.

title: Simple Chocoly Bark
ingredients: 1 ounce bittersweet chocolate, grated | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 ounces bittersweet chocolate, grated
instructions: Put grated chocolate in a small bowl and drizzle with the vegetable oil. Mix well. Put into a baking tray or large container. Pour hot water about 2 inches in around the chocolate and let it sit about 2 hours or up to two nights. Dry off with paper towel. You can use it to baste some chocolate chips on while eating.

Random Ingredients: deli ham,yellow bell pepper,asparagus,anise seed,kaffir lime leaf
title: Achar
ingredients: 1 lb thin asparagus, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into slices | 2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 lb deli ham, halved horizontally then cut across into 1/2 inch wide strips | 3 kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place asparagus, bell pepper, and anise seeds in 3 cups boiling water and bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Boil for 5 minutes, then transfer to a 2 quart baking dish. Cover with remaining ham and lime leaves. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving the next day.

title: Raspberry and Apple Jumble Potatoes
ingredients: 900 g ziti pasta | 2 cans raspberries | 4 large apples, chopped | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 450 -725 g potatoes, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 190oc. Cook ziti according to directions on package in a large saucepan or stockpot. Drain and add raspberries and apples to ziti and mix well. Place potatoes on a baking tray, top with raspberries, and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden and bubbling,. Sprinkle top with jam and enjoy.

title: Lobster Halibut (No Cooked)
ingredients: 4 small lobster tails, cooked | 2 tablespoons raisins | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the shellfish in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Mix together the raisins and saffron and sprinkle over the lobster. Pour about 1/2 of the orange juice mixture evenly over the lobster, then scatter the remaining orange juice mixture evenly over the top. Bake in preheated oven until the shrimp are pink and opaque, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,kaffir lime leaf,natural bran,garam masala
title: Indian Fried Bran
ingredients: 8 ounces natural bran | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Soak bran in warm water, until it is soft. When it is soft again, drain well. Grind to a fine powder. Mix with rest of ingredients and stir well. Spread onto an ungreased tray and bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until the top of the bran browns slightly.

title: Sesame-Olive Oil Furniture Polish
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame oil | 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups ghee ( clarified butter ), or as needed | 1 1/2 cups galliano
instructions: Combine sesame oil and cooking spray in the bottom of a glass jar with a sealable lid, making sure the lid is tightly tight. Shake ghee and pour onto lid. Remove lid and shake well. Fill glass jar with oil and pour oil and fragrance over jar. Cover jar with plastic wrap and place in a cool, dry place for 5 days after the five days, shaking jar daily to mix. Pour oil mixture into a jar and let the polish dry at least 24 hours. To use, stir oil until completely mixed with flavor.

title: Saute Cashew Green Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon orange rind, grated | 2 tablespoons kikkoman soy sauce | 2 tablespoons water | 1 ounce cashews, chopped, toasted and cooled | 1 ounce green olives, halved
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the oranges, soy sauce, and water.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,red curry paste,sage leaf,yukon gold potato,kosher salt,pistachio,stew meat
title: Pot Roast with Chilli Seeds
ingredients: 4 large yukon gold potatoes, chopped into quarters | 1 large stew meat, cut in 2. 5-inch pieces | 1/2 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups roasted pistachios, chopped
instructions: Spread potatoes in a large casserole dish.

title: Rote Grød - Norwegian Peas Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh peas or 2 lbs frozen peas | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 2 pinches vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rapid boil. Add peas and cook until slightly firm but still crisp in the middle. Do not overcook. Drain completely and reserve about 1/4 cup cooking water. Combine liquid into a large bowl. Add cream and salt and pepper to taste and mix well. Add peas and stir well. Cover and leave in the residual 1/4 cup cooking water in the pan for 2 or 3 minutes before serving.

title: Tomato Feta Spread
ingredients: 1 cup mascarpone cheese, at room temperature | 1/3 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 can tomatoes with green chilies, drained and chopped, with juice | 3 tablespoons fresh-fine-dried french-fried bread | 2 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: In food processor or blender, combine the mascarpone, feta cheese, tomatoes, and french fried bread. Process until smooth. Stop the motor slows so the mixture is still chunky. Stop the motor as soon as the mixture has the consistency of coarsely ground cornmeal.

title: Greek Foil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1 1/4 inches piece dark rum ( or rum or brandy )
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium low heat. When it shimmers, put the fenugreek in the skillet. Stir frequently until it cracks. Immediately pour in alcohol or cream. Remove from heat and let cool slightly to remove any residue. Transfer to a clean tea towel lined jar. Shake off any excess fenugreek oil. Store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,chili pepper,rice vinegar,vegetable broth,blueberry,creme de cacao,tomato juice
title: Blueberry Sweet and Savory Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 2 cups tomato juice ( from a carton ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 small dried chili peppers ( or 1 teaspoon hot pepper flakes, depending on your taste, i like hot! ) | 1/3 cup creme de cacao ( optional ) | 3 cups frozen blueberries, thawed | 1 bell pepper, cut into thin strips ( red, green, or yellow )
instructions: Whisk together the vegetable broth, tomato juice, rice vinegar, and hot peppers in small bowl. Set aside. Add the creme de cacao and mix. Pour half of mixture into another small bowl. Set aside. Add the blueberries to the empty reserved tomato juice in the last small bowl in the last 2 minutes of cooking. Drain the blueberries, reserving juice. Pour the tomato juice mixture back into the pot. Stir to coat. Add the blueberries and simmer, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and serve.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 10 ounces cottage cheese | 1 bunch fresh basil, leaves stripped, washed well and finely chopped
instructions: Drain most of the moisture/oil from the cottage cheese by placing it in a bowl or strainer. Gradually add the drained cottage cheese to the cheese along with the basil. Place the cottage cheese in a large clean kitchen bowl. Pour boiling water over to cover the cottage cheese, place bowl in refrigerator, and let sit for 1 - 2 hours. Remove bowl from refrigerator, cover with damp kitchen cloth, and put in the refrigerator to solidify. At this point you can either store in refrigerator, or remove the cloth and let sit out for approximately 1 - 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: quince,water chestnut,marshmallow,water artichoke heart,vegetable broth,sambal oelek chili paste,deli roast beef
title: Sherri's Thai Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef | 1/2 lb water chestnut, sliced, canned okay | 10 ounces water-packed artichoke hearts, drained | 8 ounces marshmallows | 4 cups vegetable broth ( home made or low fat ) | 1 -1 tablespoon sambal oelek chili paste ( thai sauce with chili ) | 1/2 cup water and 2 tablespoons marsala ( just a sprinkle )
instructions: Spray crockpot with pam. Place all ingredients into the crockpot. Stir. Cover. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Serve with rice and noodles.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cardamom powder,no salt tomato paste,peanut,onion juice,frying chicken,hamburger
title: Indonesian Spiced Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanuts, roasted | 1/4 cup no-salt-added tomato paste | 1/2 cup onion juice | 2 -4 lbs frying chickens, cut up | 1 cup dry roasted salted peanut, ground | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a large dutch oven, combine peanuts, tomato paste and 1/2 cup onion juice. Add chicken and simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours, or until chicken is cooked through and tender. Add ground peanuts, remaining 1/2 cup onion juice, ground roasted peanuts, cardamom powder, salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: egg white,tomato green chilies,elbow macaroni,pineapple chunk,whipping cream,beef steak,red wine
title: Tiramama Beef With Pineapple
ingredients: 1 lb beef steak | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 can pineapple chunks | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 cup red wine, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Trim any fat from steak. Slice steak across the grain in very thin slices. Set aside. In a large skillet on medium heat, add steak, diced tomatoes with chilies, pineapple and 1/2 cup water. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Remove cover and allow to steam for 2 minutes. Transfer to bowl with lid and reserve. Add egg to skillet. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the macaroni to skillet, then stir, scraping the skillet bottom, until well coated. Reduce heat to simmer, cover and let sit 10 - 15 minutes. Stir occasionally while cooking. Remove beef from skillet, reserving juices. Drain excess fat. Add cream and wine to skillet, stir, bring to boil and cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Add meat, stirring until heated through. Serve over hot cooked noodles.

title: Taco Salad (Taco House Mix)
ingredients: 12 leaves salad greens | 1 container thousand island dressing ( or more )
instructions: Wash and dry the salad leaves very well. In a salad bowl, mix all the ingredients very well. Cover and let stand for at least an hour before serving.

title: Chilled Red Cheddar and Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 package unflavored gelatin, 1 package | 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup coffee | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup red cabbage, shredded | 2/3 cup sweet corn kernel
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup each of the undrained chickpeas and the coffee. Heat in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until gelatin is dissolved and mixture begins to boil. Remove from heat. Cool. Pour gelatin mixture into a small heat proof bowl. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Sprinkle gelatin over the boiling water and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Cover tightly and chill for at least 3 hours. Serve chilled.

title: Chayote and Vegetable
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs turnips | 2 cups cooked cannellini beans | 3 tablespoons corn syrup | 3 tablespoons scotch whisky | cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Trim turnips of all but very finely. Cut in half lengthwise and crossways. Arrange halves in a lightly greased 8 pie dish, but don't slice or cut all the way through. Combine the beans, corn syrup, and whisky in a pan and bring to a boil, stirring often. Transfer to oven and bake for about 40 minutes, until light brown and tender. Serve turnip and bean mixture hot sprinkled with cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,velveeta cheese,mustard,miracle whip,chow mein noodle,leg lamb
title: The Easiest Leg of Lamb Ever  - Paula Deen
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs ontario leg of lamb | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 ounces velveeta cheese, cubed | 1 box chow mein noodles
instructions: Put the lamb in a roasting pan with enough water to cover. It needs to be deep enough to come up about half of the way up the leg. Cook in the oven for approx 1 hour. Remove from oven. Place back in the oven turn the heat to its high and cook for an additional 15 - 50 minutes until done to your liking. Let cool. When it's done, remove from the oven, open and slice in half. Serve on a bun with chow mein noodles on the side. You can also make this in a crockpot, put on low and warm until very tender. The longer the meat is kept in the crockpot, the more tender it gets. This is where you end up placing the temp on for the first 2 hours at low/medium heat. It should be temp that's not undercooked at all. Just add a little more water during the second 40 minutes of cooking. After the last 15 minutes of cooking, turn the heat off and enjoy the delicious gravy. This reheats and reheats beautifully and makes a great side dish for stir fried rice.

title: Roasted Asparagus
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons thawed beef broth or 3 -4 tablespoons water | 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Fill large resealable gallon size plastic bag with asparagus leaves. Add broth. Refrigerate overnight, stirring every hour. When ready to eat, remove asparagus pieces and let sit 10 - 15 minutes so as not to let them dry out. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,white flour,black cardamom pod,green pepper,linguine,chipotle powder,manchego cheese,red pepper sauce
title: Mexican Linguine With Grilled Chipotle Cheese
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/4 ounces linguine | 1 teaspoon white flour | 10 whole black cardamom pods | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 small green pepper, seeded and chopped ( capsicum ) | 1 chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper sauce | 1 ounce mexican manchego cheese
instructions: Soak the linguine in salted water while preparing the other ingredients. Drain the linguine well then toss with the flour. Heat a non stick griddle/griddle pan, with a tight fitting lid, on the heat for one minute. Transfer the linguine to a large plate and then slice into 3 inch lengths. Sprinkle each plate with a little salt then spread the sliced linguine all over. Toast the cardamom pods in the grill until dark golden and a few seconds per side are usually required. Remove from the grill and place in a mortar or pestle with the chile and peppers and grind to a paste. Add the chile mixture, chipotle powder, oil, pepper sauce and cheese and mix to make a stiff paste. If the mixture is too stiff to handle, add a little water, until required. Taste and add a little salt and more pepper if required. Pour the mix and cheese over the linguine.

Random Ingredients: lard,monterey jack cheese,bamboo shoot,sultana,onion soup mix,avocado
title: Avocado Dip
ingredients: 6 avocados, peeled, and chopped | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 3 tablespoons bamboo shoots, chopped | 1 package onion soup mix | 2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated | 5 tablespoons lard, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a bowl, combine the avocado, sultanas, bamboo shoots, soup powder and grated cheese. Transfer mixture to a shallow baking dish, cover and put in oven. Bake 30 minutes, or until heated through and bubbly. Serve warm with pita or corn chips.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,tomato,lettuce,celery,tomato onion,cream chicken soup,wheat flour,icing sugar
title: Boom Chakorias (Chokos' Cheese Ball)
ingredients: 8 ounces soft wheat flour | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/2 stalk celery, shredded | 1 tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/2 onion, finely chopped | 1 large handful lettuce, chopped
instructions: Mix the flour and sugar together well. Stir the soup, chipotle powder, celery, tomato, and onion into the flour. Gradually stir in the water. Add the lettuce.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,tomato puree,yellow squash,italian bread crumb,velveeta cheese,vegetable oil,dark beer,grand marnier
title: Italian Pork Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork chop, about 4 thick | 1 cup progresso italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded velveeta cheese | 5 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 2 medium yellow squash, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Mix together bread crumbs and cheese. Dip both sides of each pork chop into the bread crumb mixture, pressing crumbs firmly onto sides. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add chops.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,mango chutney,brown rice,peanut oil,lemon,white flour,bamboo shoot,oat
title: Chili Fruit and Nut Brown Rice
ingredients: 150 g brown rice or 150 g rice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 lemons or 2 lemons, juice of | 120 g chopped bamboo shoots | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon virgin olive oil | 75 g shredded mango chutney | 60 g whole wheat oats | 100 g white flour or 100 g all purpose flour
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add bamboo shoots. Stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in rice and fry for 3 - 4 minutes or until heated. Stir in lemon juice. Add mango chutney, olives, all purpose flour and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, or until combined. Drain rice. Stir into mixture. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,monterey jack cheese,no boil lasagna noodle,fennel seed,chicken drumstick,ice
title: Chicken in Creamy Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 6 uncooked no-boil lasagna noodles | 2 cans chicken drumsticks | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 20 fluid ounces light cream of tartar | 3 cups grated monterey jack cheese | 5 cups crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook chicken in boiling water until no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes.

title: Chopen's Chiles:  for Dry Rub on Food
ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled roasted red chili pepper,, or to taste | 24 maraschino cherries, stems removed
instructions: Blend dried chiles with a mortar and pestle until coarsely ground.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,green bell pepper,plain nonfat yogurt,rice krispies,bean,rice noodle,burrito flour tortilla
title: Easy Microwave Thai Noodles
ingredients: cooking spray or 1 tablespoon rice bran oil, such as pam | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 8 burrito-size flour tortillas or 8 gluten-free flour tortillas, heated until softened | 4 servings rice krispies, divided | 2 cups prepared rice krispies for topping | 1 green bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Spray a 2 quart casserole with cooking spray, or use 1 or 2 tablespoon rice bran oil. Layer the rice krispies, beans, and noodles on the bottom of the casserole. Place the tortillas over the krispies, breaking them as necessary so they are covered with layers of noodles and vegetables. Sprinkle with cooking spray, then half of the remaining yogurt. Repeat layers and top with remaining yogurt and sliced bell pepper. Cover and microwave on high for 7 to 10 minutes, or until noodles are tender and mixture is hot.

title: Peanut Butter Vibels
