ingredients: 1 tablespoon smooth peanut butter | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Beat with electric mixer until thoroughly blended.

title: Gramma's Awazzim
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb | 1 pint walnut halves
instructions: Trim the fat from the lamb. Trim excess fat. Score the fat in a deep, shallow oven baking dish. Insert the walnut halves into the center of this. Make a hole in the center with your finger. Pour boiling water around the lamb, into a large enough bowl. Sprinkle the cover with saran wrap. Place the oven on broiler and broil about 25 minutes, or until a deep golden brown in color. Let the gramma rest in the pan for 5 minutes. Remove the gramma to cool on a tray or platter. To serve, cut into thin slices. Serve with flatbread. Variation, substitute 1 lb lamb, which must be trimmed of all fat.

title: Chunky Mexican Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes and green chilies | 1 tablespoon dutch-processed cocoa
instructions: Mix salsa and chilies in a mug. Drink.

title: Barley-Lime Barley Pudding (Barley Method)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pearl barley | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh lime juice ( to taste )
instructions: Soak the barley in plenty of water for 2 - 3 hours. Drain and set aside. In the meantime, bring the water to a boil and add the rice, barley and lime juice. Reduce the heat and simmer covered for 25 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. If the mixture looks dry, add 1/4 cup water and cook until it is a thick pudding like consistency. It should taste slightly chunky as this can be oily. If it seems dry, add a little more water.

title: Easy Mexican Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef roast, well trimmed and cut into large chunks | 15 ounces red enchilada sauce | 3 packages ramen noodles ( seasoning packet size ) | 1 package dried figs, chopped
instructions: Bring 6 - 10 cups water to boil in large pot. Place beef chunks and 1 enchilada sauce packet into stock pot and cook 20 - 25 minute. Add ramen noodles and figs and cook for 10 minutes or till noodles are fully cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,dark sesame oil,brown rice,sage,italian parsley,chicken broth,pancetta
title: Pancetta Rice Pilaff With Rum
ingredients: 1/3 cup pancetta, diced ( about 2 ounces ) | 1 1/2 cups light brown rice or 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 5 cups reduced sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons dried sage | chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: In a large skillet, cook pancetta over medium heat, stirring often, until crisp and browned. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Add rice, rum, oil and seasonings and bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat and simmer for 12 - 15 minutes or until most of liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Fluff rice with fork and sprinkle with cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,raisin,chili pepper flake,italian herb,apple juice,red snapper fillet
title: Crispy Roasted Snapper
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/3 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 medium red snapper fillet, cut into 6 thick slices | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dried italian herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in 4 quart shallow glass baking dish, mix apple juice, raisins, sesame seeds, chile flakes and herb. Arrange fish on top. Spoon glaze over fish. Cover and bake at 350f for 20 - 25 minutes until fish is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,seasoning salt,italian seasoning,grape tomato,chunky salsa,crescent,icing sugar,extra virgin olive oil
title: Easy Salsa Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup chunky salsa ( i used trader joe's salsa ) | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 pinch seasoning salt ( like mccormick ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 3 cups grape tomatoes, cut in halves | 2 cans crescent rolls | 1/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: In a large nonstick frypan, over medium high heat, sear the chicken in olive oil and add seasoning salt. Drain. In a bowl combine chicken, salsa and icing sugar and refrigerate mixture until ready to use. Remove it from refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,red chili pepper,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Mul-lous
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons saffron threads, lightly crushed | 2 -4 dried red chili peppers, crushed | 2 scotch bonnet peppers
instructions: Soak and dry the saffron over night. If using fresh chili, remove seeds and veins and cut chili into large chunks. Drain saffron well. Place the mixture in a pan with a lid and bring to the boil with the lid partly covering the pan. Turn to medium heat and simmer for about 45 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from the heat. Leave for 20 minutes. Strain the gravy, discarding solids and reserving the saffron. Place the saffron in a bowl with a teaspoon pierced through the center. Add the chili pieces. Fill with the gravy and allow to simmer for an hour.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,garlic oil,hazelnut,enchilada sauce,basil leaf,sugar snap pea,sandwich bread,rye flour
title: Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb hazelnuts | 1/2 cup arugula leaves, coarsely chopped | 4 rolls | 1/4 cup sliced sweet sandwich bread | 1 1/4 cups marinated enchilada sauces | 4 teaspoons granulated sugar snap peas or 4 teaspoons sugar substitute | 1 bouquet garni | 1 teaspoon basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pulse hazelnuts in food processor to finely grind. Transfer hazelnuts to medium bowl.

title: Spicy Mexican Oats
ingredients: 1 cup steel cut oats | 2 cups tomato passata | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning ( plus some extra if needed ) | 1 tablespoon red chili ( minced ) | 1 lb linguine, cooked
instructions: Cook linguine per package directions. Drain, reserve some of the cooking water. Combine the oats, passata, taco seasoning and chili. Put the cooked linguine back inches. Add the sauce. Note, if desired, you may also add more water, but be careful not to add too much.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,veal shank,raspberry,rice wine,duck leg,tarragon,cornstarch,chili oil
title: Noble House Celestial Harmony Glazed Roast Duck
ingredients: 4 duck legs | 8 -12 ounces frozen raspberries | 2 tablespoons minced fresh tarragon, plus sprigs for garnish | 3 tablespoons rice wine | 2 tablespoons chili oil, or more if needed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Using a sharp knife, cut a deep pocket into the lower cavity of a duck and deep enough to insert the dried lemon zest into the opening. Insert a sliver of fresh tarragon into the slit. Place the duck legs in a roasting pan with a rimmed baking sheet or aluminum foil, breast side up. Spoon 1/2 cup of raspberries over the duck legs. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the minced tarragon and 1 tablespoon of rice wine. Drizzle the chili oil on top. Roast the duck until well browned, about 45 minutes. If planning to braise, place pan in preheated oven for another 45 minutes. Once the duck is done, tent with aluminum foil and let rest for 10 minutes. Remove duck to a dinner platter, tent with foil, and let rest for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the glaze, stir together the cornstarch, lemon zest, remaining 2 tablespoons of rice wine, and remaining tarragon. Add the reserved juices that have accumulated in the roasting pan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly. Remove from the heat and stir in the glaze until combined. Slice the duck diagonally into small pieces and serve with the sauce.

title: EASY Chinese Sweet and Sour Shoot Tea
ingredients: 2 ounces chopped bamboo shoot, stems removed | 1 dash chili paste | 2 ounces corn oil | 2 ounces tea leaves, cold
instructions: Use a strainer to drain the shung as much water as possible from the bamboo shoots. Put the bamboo shoots in a bowl, and pour in enough tea water to cover them. Place the bowl into the freezer so that the frozen shoots continue to harden. Remove the shoots from the tea bag and rinse with cold water. Drain and put tea leaves in the bowl. Heat the corn oil in a fry pan over medium low heat until it smokes and the fragrance of the tea is loosened. Pour in the tea leaves and allow to sizzle for 1 to 2 seconds. Tip the mixture into the freezer, return to the freezer, and let sit for 15 minutes at least. After 15 minutes, taste for the temperature of the tea you should be able to smell it. If they look more like salt or a powder, drain off the excess. To serve, pour the tea leaves into a cup, top with shung shung shung and top with sweet and sour cocktail.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,lemongrass,sherry wine,yellow bell pepper,yellow cornmeal,pecorino romano cheese,tuna steak,pork roast butt
title: Lemongrass Tuna
ingredients: 3 cans tuna steaks, drained | 2 cups coarse yellow cornmeal | 2 yellow bell peppers, seeded and julienned | 2 stalks lemongrass, ends trimmed, and bruised | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 12 tablespoons pine nuts | 3 yellow bell peppers, seeded and julienned
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse tuna steaks under warm water and pat dry with paper towels. In a shallow baking pan, spread tuna steaks out. Place cornmeal in a wide shallow bowl. Coarsely chop 3 yellow bell peppers, and place in another shallow bowl. Place lemongrass in a third shallow bowl. Place sherry in a third shallow bowl. Dice yellow bell peppers, and place in a third shallow bowl. When oven rack is about 6 inches from the heat source, melt 6 tablespoons of butter in 10 inch castiron skillet over medium heat. Dredge tuna steaks first in cornmeal, then in butter, and place in hot skillet. Cook for 2 minutes, turn carefully and brown other side.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,caraway seed,puff pastry,corn cob,espresso powder,italian turkey sausage,bamboo shoot
title: Pizza With Italian Turkey Sausage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light espresso powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 10 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 lb sweet italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 1/4 cup canned bamboo shoot, juice reserved ( from a jar of sweet peas ) | 1 tablespoon corn on the cob, coarsely chopped ( from a 3-c. ear cut backstraps ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed, crushed
instructions: Pour 1 t hot espresso and 1 t baking soda into a large dutch oven. Place the frozen puff pastry sheet on top of the espresso in a pastry bag with a star tip inserted into the center, and pry out the remaining pastry sheet using the bag. Cut each sheet into four equal squares. Sprinkle the pastry squares with half the italian turkey sausage. Arrange the bamboo shoots over the sausage, scatter with the remaining sausage, and drizzle with about 1 t bean juice. Top with the remaining pastry square, pressing in the dough to seal. Pour enough water into the pan to come up about 1/2 inch up the dough, and add the remaining 1t bean juice and remaining 1 t baking soda. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, or till the dough is tender and the sausage is browned and crisp on the top. Uncover and serve warm, garnished with crushed caraway seeds. Note, you can adjust the oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 425 degrees f. Remove the sausage from the pan, discard casings, cut into 6 pieces, and return to the skillet. To brown the ruschetta, remove the sausage, wrap in plastic, and cover loosely with foil to keep warm. Return to the oven for 10 minutes, then remove the foil cover and continue to bake until the dough is crusty and the sausage is golden, 15 - 20 minutes longer. Transfer to a cutting board and slice into 6 serving pieces.

Random Ingredients: yeast,green zucchini,salt black pepper,french bread,poblano pepper,broccoli,coconut milk,maraschino cherry
title: Green Zucchini and Broccoli Skewers With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 6 cups day old french bread, crusts removed | 3/4 cup coconut milk | 1 package fresh yeast | 1 tablespoon salt black pepper | 2 cups grated green zucchini | 1/4 cup grated poblano pepper | 1 cup shredded broccoli | 3 fresh maraschino cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Lightly coat a large baking dish with cooking spray. Place the bread in a large bowl, then pour in enough warm water to cover on top. Add coconut milk, yeast, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper.

title: Melon and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 pineapple ring, cut into 6 wedges | 125 g cantaloupe, chopped | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Arrange pineapple wedges on plate. Add cantaloupe to pineapple. Combine sugar, mustard and pineapple juice. Add extra if needed.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,green chili pepper,curry paste,ice,reynolds wrap foil,chocolate bar,salmon
title: Salmon & Queso Blanco
ingredients: 2 slices american cheese, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons pure chunky chile peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry paste | 4 teaspoons frozen ocean-dried salmon ( fillet ) | 4 teaspoons frozen cheese ( queso blanco ) | 4 teaspoons chocolate bars, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 2 cups steamed popcorn, coarsely crushed ( optional ) | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Place cheese thinly over half of the top of each pepper and on side of salmon, top evenly with 2 tsp chunky chile peppers and 1 tsp curry paste. Top with 2 tsp frozen salmon and sprinkle with half the cheese. Spoon 1 tsp queso blanco over salmon and salmon and place the rest of the cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,vegetable broth,french dressing,napa cabbage
title: Veggie Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 can vegetable broth | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 head napa cabbage, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 cup french dressing
instructions: Saute onions and cabbage in a pot with vegetable broth. When cabbage is half cooked, mix in taco seasoning, then pour on french dressing. When soup returns to boiling, add rest of ingredients and stir. Add any remaining water or soup stock if soup appears too thick. Add a tablespoon of hot liquid from can if soup seems too thin.

Random Ingredients: tamari,pear,balsamic vinegar,salt pepper,cream celery soup,maple syrup,bacon,gingerbread
title: Gingerbread Bites (Gingerbread Appetizer)
ingredients: 12 slices smoked bacon | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 4 pears - cored, cored, and diced | 1 tablespoon minced fresh gingerurger or 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | salt and pepper to taste | 1 package frozen gingerbread cookies
instructions: Place the bacon in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain, crumble, and set aside. In a medium bowl combine the maple syrup and cream of celery soup, pears, and ginger. Mix in the bacon, bacon fat, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cool, and store in the refrigerator until serving. Melt the cookies in a large skillet over medium low heat. Scoop out equal portions of the mixture with a spoon, and spread on a cookie. Repeat process with the remaining cookies.

title: Bruncheon Meat Stuffing
ingredients: 250 g hamburger | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Melt the hamburger together with the oats. Put in a greased oven tray and cook for 15 - 20 minutes in a pre heated oven.

Random Ingredients: cheese,berry cranberry sauce,blue cheese,gruyere cheese,chicken,green bell pepper
title: Rosti Bake
ingredients: 4 cups fresh blue cheese, divided | 1/2 cup light sour cream or 1/2 cup neufchatel cheese ( neufchatel will do ) | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 2 cups deli chicken, cooked and cubed | 1 cup fresh chipped bread cheese ( i used cheddar ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh mixed berries ( cranberry and blue cheese combo )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, cream together one cup of cheese with sour cream. Stir in green pepper, chicken and cheese blend. Spread in a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle bread cubes over the top. Cover with fruit and more remaining 1/2 cup of cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,kale,italian salad dressing mix,prawn,espresso,chard leaf,shortcrust pastry
title: Individual Espresso Prawns & Chard Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups kale, shredded ( about 4 cups packed ) | 3 cups raw prawns, defrosted and cooked ( about 1 lb ) | 2/3 cup bottled espresso | 3/4 cup brewed coffee | 1 package italian salad dressing mix ( i like kraft brand in the can ) | 2 cups shredded italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 cup finely chopped chard leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a 12 inch non stick skillet, cook the kale with prawns for 3 minutes. Stir in shredded sasko and cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from skillet and let cool slightly. Reserve. Using a large bowl,, stir together the espresso and coffee until the liquid is dissolved. Add the salad dressing mix, chard, and the cooled kale mixture. Stir just to blend. Pinch off 3 inch pieces of dough and roll into balls. Arrange in 4 ungreased 8 x 4 inch rectangles, each about 3/4 inch thick on the parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until prawns are opaque in the center of the prawns. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,daikon radish,cayenne,mini chocolate chip,portabella mushroom,rigatoni pasta,cold water
title: Mache and Beef Ragu
ingredients: 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 4 tablespoons walnut oil, divided | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 cup portabella mushroom, chopped into large chunks ( about 1 ) | 1 cup rigatoni pasta | 1 cup mini semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoons oil and 2 tablespoons oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil, and the meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Add nuts and cheese and cook until heated through, about 1 minute. Add noodles and cook until tender and warmed through, about 2 minutes. Pour into large bowl, sprinkle with the last tablespoon of cheese, sprinkle with chocolate and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Almond Cakes
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole almond ( toasted ) | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 1/3 cup walnut oil
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and set aside. Form small cakes in your hands. Cook on a non stick griddle or skillet on both sides until dry, about 3 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean paste,plum tomato crosswise,ancho chili
title: The Best Amaro!
ingredients: 2 pounds plum tomatoes, sliced crosswise | 1 pinch ancho chili | 1/2 vanilla bean paste
instructions: In a small bowl, combine tomatoes, chili, and vanilla paste, and stir together. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for several hours to allow flavors to mingle.

title: Beef Gumbo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean and round beef chuck, cut into 1 x 1/2 x 1/4 strips | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 3/4 teaspoon cumin | 1 package linguine
instructions: Combine beef, curry powder, cumin, and salt. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325°. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine, and cook, stirring occasionally until just tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain. Pour beef and sauce into a large casserole dish. Cover, and bake in the oven 40 minutes. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Couscous Beef With Pesto & Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons thawed frozen spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 2 tablespoons pecan pieces | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 lb lean ground chuck | 2/3 cup canned green pea, rinsed and drained | 1 cup couscous, dry | 2 cups sliced fresh strawberries
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,heavy cream,pork roast,lettuce leaf,heavy whipping cream
title: Creamy Pork Wraps
ingredients: 5 lbs pork roast, lean | 11 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups vanilla sugar, plus | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 7 large lettuce leaves | 12 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Trim the pork of any visible fat and cut into about 1/4 inches cubes. Put the meat into a large bowl. Stir in the cream, sugar and 3 tbsp cream. Wash the lettuce very briefly then cut into strips. Divide the lettuce among the 6 wraps, and roll up. Warm a heavy skillet over medium heat. Put the roll, seam side down, in the skillet. After 3 minutes on each side the meat should be nicely browned and tender. Remove the roll and allow it to rest for another 2 minutes. Cut the roll into 6 slices, and serve hot.

title: Burgers With Snow Peas
ingredients: 500 g snow peas, trimmed | 1 loaf brioche bread, crusts trimmed
instructions: Preheat the bbq on high, 220c for 5 minutes until the edges start to brown slightly, then set aside on absorbent paper, to cool. Cut off the top third of each bun, and scrape out the seeds. Scoop out the flesh from each bun with a teaspoon, and then scoop out the heart with a spatula. Arrange the snow pea flesh in overlapping slices on 4 slices of bread, and top with the other slice of bread. Brush the tops with a little oil, and put under the grill. Leave to cook for a few mins, then transfer to a serving platter. Serve with a wedge of lemon.

Random Ingredients: mango,curd cottage cheese,panko breadcrumb,tomato,white pepper,cardamom,spaghetti,milk chocolate chip
title: Mango Spaghetti With Cottage Cheese and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 can condensed flan curd cottage cheese | 200 g ripe mangoes ( or 1/2 large if using large ) | 1 tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons evaporated low-fat milk chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Drain both cans of cottage cheese. Wash and peel mangoes, removing seeds. Cut them into halves or quarters. Place mangoes and tomato in a blender, and use blender on high for about 10 seconds or until finely diced. Take out a bowl, and add white pepper to it. Mix well. Add panko, evaporated milk chocolate, sugar and spices. Mix well. Put spaghetti on a plate with a small circle of parchment. Place cottage cheese mixture at middle of parchment circle. Fold the right side of the parchment over the cottage cheese mixture. Fold the left and right sides of the parchment paper tightly around cottage cheese mixture. Dip the entire mixture into the chocolate chips until covered. Place on a tray, and refrigerate. Repeat with remaining mixture. Serve chilled.

title: South Seas Rice Concoction
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa, canned | 1 tablespoon chafarina loose powdered coffee | 0.5 container cottage cheese or 1 container light cream | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1 dash sugar ( optional ) | chunky salsa ( optional ) | 1 cup cooked small whole wheat spanish rice, for topping ( optional )
instructions: You can prepare your own spanish rice, but the results are much better after working with fresh ones, such as japanese flavored rice and yellow rice. Combine the salsa, coffee, cream, sugar, and saffron in a microwave safe casserole dish. Cook on high for one minute. Stir to blend and pour over the cooked rice. Cover or microwave the rice 5 minutes at a time until creamy and warmed through, stirring occasionally. Serve in shallow bowls over spanish or brown rice.

title: Spicy Mexican Blues
ingredients: 1/2 ounce blue curacao | 2 slices black olives, cut in half if small | 1/8 teaspoon of crushed poblano chiles | 1/8 teaspoon of crushed msg
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shaker or appropriate glass container. Shake vigorously. Fill into an old fashioned glass or other suitable size dish and serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,rum,pork shoulder roast,red potato,orange,marshmallow
title: Hot Scotch Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs red potatoes, scrubbed clean, in 1/2 to 3/4 inch slices | 4 lbs pork shoulder roast ( bone in ), trimmed | 1 cup light rum | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 red potatoes or 1 red potato, peeled, washed, and quartered | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large roasting pan or oven proof baking dish, combine potatoes, pork, rum, cheddar, and red potatoes. Cover with foil. Place in oven for 1 hour. Remove foil and potatoes. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until pork is tender and potatoes are fork tender. Serve with marshmallows on top.

title: French Bread and Bean Snack
ingredients: 1 cup whole bean, canned not well drained | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Drain and rinse the can of beans thoroughly. Place the beans, thyme and the cayenne into a large dutch oven or other heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium low and simmer, covered, for 40 minutes. Set aside to cool. Combine the flour and about 2 tablespoons liquid from the bean mixture in a bag, pressing in lightly. Add remaining liquid and shake the bag with your fingers, coating the beans with flour. Remove the bag from the heat. With a slotted spoon, place the bag in a shallow bowl. Add the bread cubes and toss to coat with the flour. Return the bag to the pot with the bread and beans and cook, shaking the bag, about 5 minutes. Gently stir the beans into the bread and discard the thyme sprig. Let stand for 5 minutes to plump up. Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with parsley. Serve as is, or store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: green plantain,dark beer,white wine,egg noodle,asafoetida powder,beef bouillon cube
title: Baked  Beef and Plantain Stoup
ingredients: 1 egg noodles | 1/4 lb lean stewing beef, sliced and lightly pounded | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup dark beer, plus 2 tablespoons
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the egg noodles on a baking sheet. Coat a large pot with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. When water in skillet starts bubbling, add the beef slices and brown well on both sides, about 4 minutes per side. Remove meat from pan, and slice into bite sized pieces. Return the meat to the skillet. Deglaze the skillet with just enough chicken broth to cover the meat, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes to absorb flavor. Add the wine, bouillon cube and asafoetida. Bring to a boil, return the meat and any accumulated juices to the pot and bake covered for 30 minutes. When the end of cooking time, remove the lid, brush the noodles with more beer, sprinkle with additional cheese, and bake until the cheese has melted and the noodles are golden and bubbly, 5 to 10 minutes more.

title: Spicy  Smoked Salmon or Fish in Banana Jackets
ingredients: 800 g salmon | 400 g milk | 1 teaspoon sweet pepper | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 banana ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celcius. Place salmon or fish fillets on roasting tray and season well with salt. Mix ingredients together with hands to combine ingredients and put on a greased baking paper lined tray to catch any spills. Bake in preheated oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until slightly crisp. If mixture starts to burn quickly, reduce heat to low and leave for 5 minutes. Plate the salmon/fish on serving platter. Slice banana into 8 wedges, place on top of salmon fish/fish. Place sliced banana onto serving platter.

title: Spicy Baked Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet, skinless | 3 ounces cans chopped clams, drained | 1 cup half-and-half ( lowfat ok, but milk works too ) | 1 cup ricotta cheese or 1 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine and let sit for at least 20 minutes. Place salmon in a baking or roasting pan, lay down in a single layer. In a bowl, combine the minced clams. Add 1/4 cup of milk and stir till all clams are covered. Pour over the top of the salmon in the pan. Bake for 15 minutes or till fish flakes when tested. Spoon the creamy mixture over the top and continue baking for 15 - 20 minutes, until it is nicely browned. Crumble ricotta over the top and bake another 8 - 10 minutes. Serve with a nice crusty loaf of baguette. Enjoy.

title: Mustard Mint Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse grain dijon mustard ( or other hard dry mustard ) | 1/4 cup dry mint leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill. Toss with meat.

title: Spaghetti and Beef #2
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/4 cup radish, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup turnip, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup mushroom, chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon ground coriander ( optional )
instructions: Note, for less fat add 1/2 tsp of ground coriander. In a large saute pan on medium high heat add ground beef and brown. After ground beef is browned, add mushrooms and turnip. When meat is browned add the spices until all ingredients are mixed well and saute on medium low heat for 5 - 10 minutes on medium low heat.

title: Ham and Raspberry Fondue (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 12 ounces raspberry | 4 ounces ham, chopped | 1/2 ounce golden syrup
instructions: Place the ingredients into a fondue pot. Stir, barely bring to a boil. The temperature should be around 120 degrees f or close enough to keep warm over the flame and cook for 10 minutes, checking occasionally to keep fondue hot. Serve immediately.

title: Curry Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons celery salt | 1 teaspoon oregano | 4 carrots, chopped | 1 large red cabbage, sliced in rings
instructions: Mix the curry, celery salt, and oregano together in a bowl. Pour enough oil into a large skillet to just cover the bottom of the pan. Heat the oil over medium high heat. Saute the cabbage, carrots, and red cabbage until the carrots are tender.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 2 sheets shortcrust pastry | 12 -16 ounces lobster tails
instructions: Roll out each pastry sheet on a floured surface. Use a 5'' pastry wheel, or use a pizza cutter. Cut a cross in the base of each piece, allowing one edge to go over the edge. Spread the lobster tails along the top of the pastry. Place on the pastry sheet, in a decorative pattern, if desired. Brush the tail edges with cold water.

Random Ingredients: green chili,wheat pita bread,gingerroot,chicken breast fillet,sea salt
title: BBQ Chicken Pitas
ingredients: 1 lb skinless chicken breast fillet, cut into strips | 1 1/2 inches piece gingerroot, peeled & grated | 1/2 cup canned chopped green chili | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Put everything except pita in a small bowl and mix well. Heat wok on moderate heat until hot. Add chicken and cook for 2 mins & toss to coat. Remove from heat. Place pita bread on a microwave safe plate.

title: Chinese "fried" Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 6 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 ounces dried spaghetti, broken into thirds | 3 cups cooked chicken, cubed
instructions: Place beef and lemon juice in a plastic bag. Shake to combine. Place in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Cook spaghetti in a water filled pot of boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain. Place spaghetti and meat in a large serving bowl. Drizzle with sesame oil and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,brown mustard seed,jalapeno havarti cheese,club soda,bamboo skewer,sage
title: Shrimp With Sausage Filling (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 14 ounces cocktail shrimp, defrosted, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon light brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon jalapeno havarti cheese or 1 tablespoon havarti cheese | 16 -21 large bamboo skewers, soaked | 1 bunch fresh sage, leaves picked ( about 1/2 lb ) | 1 large lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Place the shrimp in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pecan,sea salt,white breadcrumb,wasabi paste,granny smith apple,cremini mushroom,plain flour,avocado
title: California Veg Patties
ingredients: 2 cups white breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoonsea salt | 8 teaspoons wasabi paste | 2 tablespoons pecans, finely chopped | 3 granny smith apples, peeled and finely grated | 4 medium cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 avocado, diced | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans | 1/3 cup finely chopped pecans | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°c. Mix breadcrumbs, salt and wasabi paste, press into muffin cups. Bake for 7 minutes if using muffins, 20 minutes if not. Remove from oven, cool and remove any excess water. Combine the apples, mushrooms, avocado and pecans and spread out in each muffin to 3/4 inch thick. Sprinkle over the flour to coat evenly over top. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: southeast asian fish sauce,tortilla,chili powder,baking soda
title: Quick Fish Tacos
ingredients: 2 quarts of homemade prepared fish, your choice | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon light-colored sunflower oil or 1 teaspoon dark oil
instructions: First, make a simple syrup by placing the sunflower oil or dark oil in a nonreactive bowl, and letting it warm up about 2 - 3 minutes a drop at least a few drops don't worry about this. You may also use a blender, but make sure you scrape the oil into well, as baking soda is anoxic reaction to both the oil and the sunflower oil. If you have a blender, that's fine. Next stir the baking soda, chili powder and the hot oil together. Once they are well mixed you may take the bowl off the burner, but let them cool. You can either pour the cooled mixture into your preheated oil for frying, or just use the bowl out. I don't like fish that much, so i like dipping the fish into the warm syrup. If you do that, you'll have to make more. In the authentic taco restaurants you'll always just want to warn your guests about it. You can also just drop in the ingredients when ready to serve this is one option, as well.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,ramen noodle,anise seed,liquid smoke,semolina flour,vanilla bean
title: Greek Polska
ingredients: 6 medium zucchini | 2 1/2 cups semolina flour | 3 teaspoons anise seeds | 8 tablespoons liquid smoke, plus | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 cups roasted and salted ramen noodles, with seasoning packet | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Set oven to broil. Cut zucchini in half lengthwise, then cut each half into 3 slices crosswise. Place cut side down on baking sheets and brush with 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke. Broil, alternating sides each minute, until zucchini is just tender, 5 to 8 minutes. Cool. Place semolina flour in large bowl, stir in anise seeds and 2 tablespoons liquid smoke until evenly mixed. Stir in cooled zucchini, noodles, 1 teaspoon liquid smoke and vanilla bean or 1/4 teaspoon salt. Divide between 12 paper cups coated with cooking spray and remaining 1 teaspoon liquid smoke. Serve cool.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,bratwurst,dark chocolate,apricot,graham cracker,black peppercorn
title: Rachael Ray's Chocolate Cracker Brats
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh bratwursts | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | 2 chicken stock cubes ( knorr doesn't really matter ) | 1/2 cup whole black peppercorn ( cracked in a mortar and pestle, crushed ) | 1 graham cracker | 1/2 ounce dark chocolate
instructions: Cut the bratwursts lengthwise in half. Rinse them thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels. In a small saucepan melt the dark chocolate on low heat. In a larger pot, melt the chicken stock.

title: Tahini-Licious Tofu
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 2 -3 teaspoons dry fish fillets | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 small bell pepper, halved and sliced | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 1/2 lbs cucumbers, peeled cut in half and seeds removed | ciabatta
instructions: Preheat the oven at 375 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine the tahini with the celery salt and fish. Spread the olive oil in an oven proof plate. Arrange the bell pepper quarters on top of the pepper. Sprinkle the top of the vegetables with the nutmeg and dot with the tahini olive oil. Pour 1 cup boiling water into a bowl. Rinse the cucumbers under cold water and cut into wedges using a long kitchen knife. Arrange them on top of the vegetables. Sprinkle the ciabatta pieces over top of the vegetables. Place under the broiler and broil 5 minutes, or until the crust is light brown.

title: Chicken and Blueberry Parcel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup-style hot manis | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 clove garlic, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 500 g medium prawns | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 500 g pastry crusts, thawed | 100 g blueberries | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except prawns, rosemary and garlic in a food processor and blend till paste forms. If you don't have a food processor, you can combine the prawns, rosemary, and garlic in the food processor.

title: Cheater's Magical Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/3 cup palm sugar ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together into a smooth, creamy dipping sauce for shrimp, scotch bonnet peppers, or any seafood. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grapeseed oil,water artichoke heart,potato chip,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Microwave Artichoke Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 potato chips | 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 8 drops liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Line a microwave safe bowl with a paper towel. Place artichokes, potato chips, grapeseed oil, and liquid smoke into the bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,puff pastry,golden brown sugar,coconut milk,whipping cream,avocado,flour tortilla,portabella mushroom
title: Coconut-Avocado Portobello Empanadas
ingredients: 3/4 cup coconut milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened flaked coconut from 2 to 3 large portabella mushrooms, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon granulated flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 medium avocado, diced | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1/4 cup packed golden brown sugar | 28 inches frozen puff pastry, defrosted to thaw
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in small saucepan, heat coconut milk and spices over medium heat until warmed. Remove from the heat. Stir in avocado and cream until well blended. Cut the puff pastry sheets in half, forming 18 rectangles. Use a 2 - 2 1/2 cutter for 10 pastry. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread 1 tablespoons of the coconut cream mixture evenly on one side of each pastry rectangle, leaving an edge about 1/4 inch off. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the sugar evenly over the cream cream mixture on top. Arrange 1/4 of the sliced pastry in an overlapping fashion on the parchment.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,lettuce,caraway seed,vanilla bean,beef roast,pork tenderloin,guinness stout,vanilla essence
title: Irish Pork and Guinness Skewers (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 lb pork roast | 2 vanilla beans | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 pint guinness stout | 6 tablespoons ketchup ( i added a bit more ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 2 -3 large heads lettuce
instructions: Cut pork tenderloins in 3/4 inch slices about 1/2 and place in crock pot. Slice vanilla vanilla beans thin and remove tips and seeds from vanilla beans using a teaspoon. Slice vanilla beans thinly into halves. Remove string from roast and cut into 3 by 2 pieces and place in crock pot. Slice pork tenderloins in 3/4 inch strips about 1/2 and place on top of pork. Use a whole pint of guinness and pour over pork and pork. Place caraway seeds in a mortar and crush or grind into fine powder. Add all liquids from crock pot into a large bowl. Add the vanilla bean pieces and stir to mix thoroughly. Cover and cook on low heat for about 6 hours. To serve, place meat onto skewers. Place skewer on plates and pour a little guinness on top of meat and guinness and serve warm.

title: Fruit Taquitos
ingredients: 24 burrito-size flour tortillas | 15 -20 slices strawberry jam | 1/2 cup shallots or 1/2 cup chives, finely chopped | 3 cups safflower oil
instructions: Slice 1 tortilla into 8 to 12 wedges. Wrap each wedge around a tablespoon of safflower oil, then coat the tortilla wedges in a circle with the heated safflower oil. Lay the wedges in a baking pan and bake at 450f degrees for 15 minutes. Turn them over and bake for 20 to 25 minutes more.

title: Puff Shells (Fruit Stuffed With Eggs)
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | 2 cups fresh fruit, sliced ( mixed ) or 2 cups chopped fresh vegetables ( mixed )
instructions: Cut a circle from the egg shell. Carefully remove the yolks from the whites. Cut one side of the circle from top to bottom, to help you break up the shells. Fill a bowl with cold water, making sure to leave about 1 - 2 inches of the shell in the shell. Place the boiled yolks in the water and cover, then leave them for 20 minutes. Remove the shell from the water, place directly into the hole with the yolks, and squeeze the eggwhite pulp from the yolks into the yolks. Mix with a fork or spoon, making sure the hole is small enough for all the egg yolk to be stuffed inches. Fill the cavities of the shells with the egg mixture. Wipe any remaining egg from the eggs using a napkin/simmer, if any, and secure the opening with a toothpick. Steam for 40 to 50 minutes, or just until the shells are cooked but still hard. Serve with jam, jams or preserves.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,espresso powder,tabasco sauce,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheesy Espresso Spread for Coffee
ingredients: 1 ounce sharp cheddar cheese or 1 ounce muenster cheese, shredded | 4 fluid ounces espresso powder | 1 tablespoon garlic paste or 1 tablespoon fresh minced garlic | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all in small container. Top with additional cheese on top. Place in the fridge and enjoy.

title: Sweet Miso Pasta Salad (Japanese Breakfast Recipe)
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes | 1 turnip | 1/2 cup white miso | 12 ounces dry penne | 1/4 lb french fries | 6 cups fresh blueberries ( optional )
instructions: Start by making the miso. It is important that the miso coats the potato, and not just the turnip as it will get very bitter. You can always use a ratio of white to black. I have never used white miso, and never have used black. Start heating water in a pot large enough to contain the potatoes, then add the turnip. Keep cooking the turnip until the turnips are soft but not mushy. When they are, add the potatoes, and bring to a boil. Partially cover the pot and cook over medium high heat until potatoes are fork tender. The potatoes will continue to cook if there is not enough moisture to easily remove from the pot. Let the potato/turnip mixture cool down and use as is. Dressing, in a bowl or a container with a lid, stir in miso and set aside. Cook pasta, until al dente. Drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking, about 4 minutes. Drain. Cut potatoes into cubes. Add cooked pasta and dressing. Toss and serve.

title: Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 can frozen small mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1/2 cup water chestnut | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Drain mushrooms in a colander, patting out excess liquid. Place all ingredients in the crockpot and stir well. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes, stirring as needed.

title: Brussels Sprout Polenta
ingredients: 1 package prepared polenta ( coarse grained polenta ) | 1 1/2 pints grilling hot brussels sprouts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Spray the baking sheet with pam. Spread about two tablespoons of the polenta into a 6x9 inch patty pan. Place it on the prepared baking sheet, spacing evenly to cover the entire surface of the polenta. Top the polenta with grilling hot brussels sprouts, spreading them out evenly in a circular action. Cover the brussels sprouts with the remaining polenta. Bake the brussels sprouts in the preheated oven until the tops are browned and the brussels sprouts are tender, about 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice the polenta into squares. Serve hot.

title: Anise-Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground coffee granules | 1 garlic clove, very finely chopped | 2 teaspoons crushed anise seeds | 1/4 cup ground pistachios, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup apricot jam
instructions: Combine coffee, garlic, and anise. Brush onto a plate and sprinkle with pistachios. Use the jam as a garnish. Note, may also be served with crackers.

title: Baked Chili Beans
ingredients: 300 ml great northern beans, cleaned, picked over, drained | 60 g butter | 2 teaspoons crushed chili flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c, 400f, gas mark mix the beans together in a bowl. Make a well in the beans and add the butter. Stir well. Press the mixture down gently into an ovenproof dish, cover and place into a preheated oven for 1 hour. Serve.

title: Pesto Manicotti
ingredients: 16 manicotti | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: Brown manicotti and drain. Add wine and stir until well mixed. Let stand covered for five minutes. Place in greased shallow casserole dish. Cover.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,almond extract,ketjap manis,pecorino romano cheese,cayenne
title: Spiced French Fries
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 cup kep manis ( or any sweet soy dip ) | 1/4 cup warm pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 dash cayenne, to taste
instructions: Combine everything in a jar with a screw top lid then shake well to emulsify. This will keep for about a week in the refrigerator.

title: Paleo Bread in Honor of Bobby Flay
ingredients: 4 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 3 1/2 cups warm cranberry juice | 2 1/2 cups 100f. 100-percent-fruit bread cubes in liquid
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the yeast, sherry and 2 cups of the bread cubes. Let sit for 5 minutes and then stir in the cranberry juice. Add the second cup of bread cubes and stir to combine. The dough will be crumbly. Cover and let rest in a warm place for 20 - 25 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Using 3 tablespoons, punch down the dough. Using the palms of your hands, shape the dough into small round balls. Using 2 smaller ones, use the rim of a drinking glass to make a circle, about 2 or 3 inches in diameter. Place the bread round on a greased baking sheet and flatten slightly with a spatula so that none of the bread is directly on the rim. Repeat with the remaining bread rounds and the remaining bread rounds in a circular pattern. Sprinkle the tops with remaining sugar. Bake at 400f for 20 - 25 minutes or until the centers of the bread are golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Bacon and Wild Bean Ravioli
ingredients: 1 box wild oats or 9-line frozen ravioli ( in natural bran ) | 1 jar canned bamboo shoots ( drained ) | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 1/4 cup bacon fat ( diced ) | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram ( dill, oregano -optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Cook as per instructions on box. Meanwhile, chop uncooked and chop bacon and fry in a large sauce pan until crispy, remove to a bowl and add all remaining items except the crispy bacon, saute' in bacon fat until onions are translucent, but not browned. Add bacon mixture to pasta sauce and simmer for 10 minutes. Drain pasta and toss. Turn off heat and allow to sit for 15 minutes so the flavors can combine. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken,mint leaf,almond,panko breadcrumb,pork loin chop,red chili pepper,sharp white cheddar cheese,chicken breast meat
title: Cheddar Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves ( boneless ) | 4 -6 thin slices of mild smoked pork loin chops | 1/2 cup sliced blanched almond | 3 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 5 tablespoons grated sharp white cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves or 1/4 cup basil | 1/2 fresh hot red chili pepper, finely chopped | 8 slices of fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place a baking sheet in the oven to warm up while you prepare the chicken. Cut off the top 1/2 inch of each one of the breasts, stopping about 1/2 inch from the edge of the breast, and carefully remove the soft white meat from each. Set aside. Lay the chicken breasts flat on a work surface. Top each one with a slice of smoked pork loin, a slice of sliced blanched almond and then 1 tablespoon of panko bread crumbs. Season a light touch of ground black pepper with salt and pepper. Top with a thin slice of green olives and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh basil leaves. Starting at the small edge of the breast, roll up each piece of chicken around it, starting from the outside edge and working your way into the center. Place, seam side down, in a baking dish with a shallow rim. Repeat with the remaining breasts and the rest of the ingredients. Pour the beer into the bottom of the baking dish, being sure to coat each roll with beer. Evenly distribute the top and bottom crust of each chicken roll with the stuffed side in the baking dish. Dot any leftover bread crumbs on top of the rolls and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the tops are brown and crusty. Serve warm.

title: Guava Soup
ingredients: 1 package guava, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 package baby carrots
instructions: Place the guava in a large pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil and boil until soft, about 10 minutes. Drain guava and carrots.

title: White Bean and Mango Tzatziki
ingredients: 1/8 ounce active dry yeast ( about 10 minutes ) | 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup white beans, rinsed | 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon ground mango chutney | 1/2 cup chopped toasted almonds
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add yogurt and 3/4 cup beans, stirring to combine. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 5 minutes. Mix molasses, mace and remaining 1/4 cup beans with yoghurt and mix well. Stir in molasses mixture. Stir in remaining white beans and cover. Let rise until doubled, about 5 minutes. To bake, preheat oven to 475f degrees. Line 4 large baking sheets with parchment paper. Punch down and divide among the baking sheets. Use a round bladed knife to score tops of tzatziki. Sprinkle top with almonds. Bake until golden.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,active yeast,self raising flour,apricot jam,cottage cheese
title: Danish Onion-Apricot Bread
ingredients: 400 g cottage cheese or 400 g ricotta cheese | 2 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon mashed dried apricot jam | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour, plus extra for finishing | 4 spring onions, finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 220 degrees c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper and put 1 tablespoon of butter on each. Sift yeast over 100ml warm water and stir until dissolved. Stir in 1 tablespoon of jam and half of the flour. Beat until dissolved. Beat in the rest of the flour and yeast mixture. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a sticky dough. Turn out onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth. Roll out to 5 centimeters thick. Cut into 2 or 3 long pieces. Place onto prepared trays and brush with remaining butter. Cover tightly with a towel and leave to prove for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 230 degrees c or 400 degrees f. Score top of bread with knife marks. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until bread sounds hollow when tapped and sounds hollow when tapped. Transfer to a cooling rack to cool. When cool, cut into slices. Put remaining tbsp of jam on top, sprinkle with chopped spring onions and serve.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,grand marnier,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Broiled Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/4 lb snow peas | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker combine parsley, snow peas, and grand marnier. Cover and cook on high for 4 to 5 hours or low for 8 to 10 hours. Remove from heat. Cool until easy to handle. Serve.

title: Spicy Barley and Cheese Pastry Pies
ingredients: 350 g frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 teaspoon dry english mustard | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1 sheet puff pastry sheet
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Unfold pastry onto a lightly floured surface. Cut pastry into 5x7mm squares and place on baking trays. Roll pastry out to about 11cm thick. Using a 2cm biscuit cutter, cut pastry into 5 slices. Combine mustard, barley and 1/4 cup water in a bowl and pour over pastry, leaving a 2cm border around edges. Cut a 2 cm deep slit in centre of each pastry. Brush with remaining mustard mixture. Cook in oven for 13 minutes or until pastry is golden. Cool on a wire rack. Store in an airtight container.

title: Peach Sausages and Peaches in Syrup
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 4 peaches - peeled, pitted, and sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil so that the foil hangs over the top of the sausage. Cut 2 slices of sausage into 1/4 inch thick pieces. Arrange sausage pieces on foil.

Random Ingredients: mint,cream mushroom soup,adobo sauce,grain white rice,meat
title: Fiery Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked | 1 lb chopped cooked meat | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | adobo sauce, any strength, to taste | mint ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Combine with meat and soup mix. If desired, add mint. Serve hot.

title: Chile Miso Marinated Lamb or Pork
ingredients: 300 g leg of lamb or 300 g pork chops | 3 poblano peppers or 3 dried red chili peppers | 1/2 cup red chili pepper or 1/2 cup black chili powder | 2 tablespoons miso ( fermented soybean paste ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1 tablespoon rosemary
instructions: Slice lamb thinly. Place in a shallow or non metallic dish. Add pepper slices on top or on edge of meat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well to coat well with remaining marinade. Refrigerate for up to 4 days. Prepare a hot charcoal grill using indirect heat. Grill on both sides for about 20 - 30 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees and internal temperature is 155 degrees. Serve with boiled rice and vegetables of your choice.

title: Orange Peel Chili Snack Dip (Chipotle Pepper-Anchovy Spread)
ingredients: 5 green spring onions, finely chopped | 2 fresh chipotle chili peppers, seeds and membrane removed | 2 teaspoons finely grated orange peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor. Process until smooth. Spoon into serving dish and cool slightly before serving with crackers or crisp vegetables.

Random Ingredients: vegemite,monterey jack cheese,nutritional yeast,red pepper,duck leg,dark raisin,tomato paste,black pepper
title: Grilled Duck Legs With Veggies-Duck Gravy
ingredients: 2 duck legs | 1 tablespoon vegetarian ground mustard | 1 tablespoon grated nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon ground red pepper | fresh ground black pepper | 1 ounce dark raisin | 1 ounce monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Prepare the duck legs. Prepare the basting sauce. In a small saucepan set over low heat, combine mustard, nutmeg, and tomato paste. Pour enough of the water into pan to cover the duck pieces. Bring back to a boil, then reduce heat to medium. Cook, skimming off any foam that rises to the surface as it reduces. Remove cover and continue to simmer until cooked through, about 20 minutes. Pour into a saucepan. Stir in red pepper, black pepper, and raisins. Place on your grill, or preheat a grill pan on medium heat. Grill the duck legs until golden brown on all sides. Drizzle the prepared basting sauce on the duck legs. Cook until the sauce has reduced and the duck wings are bubbling. Turn off heat and let sit 1 to 2 minutes for the sauce to cool completely, then serve.

title: Parsley's Easy Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast, 3-4 lbs | 1 tablespoon gravy | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rub the roast with the flour and spices. Transfer to a large roasting pan. Pour in enough water to come about halfway up the roast. Smear the surface of the roast with the gravy. Cover tightly and bake for 1 hour or till the roast shreds easily with a fork. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Serve in a covered roaster or with french bread and green vegetables.

title: Cashew Beet Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 large beets | 150 g cashews | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 400 ml tomato puree or 400 ml crushed tomatoes
instructions: Scrub the beets clean and place in a saucepan with water. Simmer until tender. Meanwhile, place the cashews, brandy/sherry and tomato puree in a blender, and blend until smooth. When the beets are cool enough to handle, peel them and pass them through a sieve through the sieve to extract the liquid. When they are cool enough to handle, peel the skins off, place in a large bowl and mash with a potato masher or spoon in a food processor. Return to the pan. Pour into bowls, mix well and chill until ready to serve.

title: Chinese Style Fried Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb chicken meat, sliced into thin strips | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add chicken and garlic powder. Cook 1 - 2 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet. Reheat oil. Pour oil over chicken in skillet and stir fry until heated through.

title: Corned Beef and Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon clear honey | 450 g rhubarb, stalks left whole | 375 g cooked corned beef, cut into chunks | 225 g fresh beetroots, peeled and diced into chunks | 225 g pearl barley | dill
instructions: Pour honey into a large non stick frying pan, add chopped rhubarb, corned beef and beetroot, add pearl barley, bring to the boil and then simmer for 30 minutes or until meat is tender. Stir through dillweed, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,beef broth,cream tartar,rigatoni pasta,tomato ketchup,yellow squash
title: Curried Beef With Yellow Squash and Tomato
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon curry powder ( or more, as needed ) | 1 lb ground round | 4 cups sliced yellow squash | 11 ounces rigatoni pasta ( whole wheat ) | whipped cream of tartar
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in a heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring to crumble beef. Cook, stirring, until beef is browned. Add squash, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until squash is tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Prosciutto Wrappers
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1/2 cup canned cannellini beans or 1/2 cup red kidney beans | 1 teaspoon chocolate syrup | 1 slice prosciutto ham, about 1/2-inch thick, sliced | 1/4 cup green pepper, diced | 1 slice provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: Put everything except the cheese in a food processor and pulse until the peas are finely diced and mixture is somewhat chunky. Spoon about ½ cup of this mixture over each wrap. Cut the prosciutto into 1 thick slices, but not all the way to the bottom. Sausage rollups are easy, too.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,grain brown rice,ginger garlic paste,pea,beef tenderloin steak
title: Instant Beef With Peas
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste, crushed ( the fresh ginger-garlic paste that comes in a jar ) | 1 1 lb beef tenderloin steaks ( you can also use pork or beef steaks ) | 2 cups long grain brown rice | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas ( defrosted if using canned ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ginger and garlic paste and stir in the beef and rice. Heat a wok over high heat until hot but not smoking and add the peas and coriander. Stir fry for 10 - 15 seconds till the peas are no longer hot and give off a bit of their juices. Add the beef mixture to the wok and cook for another 3 - 5 minutes, stirring to make sure it is well cooked and cooked through. Serve straight off with a spicy curry on the side.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,saltine cracker,cremini mushroom,thyme sprig,rice wine
title: Mushrooms and Rice Stuffing
ingredients: 12 saltine crackers | 1 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning ( or 1 teaspoon salt ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1/2 cup rice wine
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Arrange the saltines on a large piece of foil. Spread 1/4 of the mushroom slices over crackers, then cover with 1/2 cup of the cremini mushrooms. Sprinkle with 1/4 of the creole seasoning, thyme and remaining mushroom slices. Drizzle with 1/2 cup of rice wine, and wrap up the foil to make a double layer package. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes until mushrooms are tender. Remove from oven, and cool for 5 minutes. Use to stuff or let cool completely. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,ziti pasta,black soy sauce,pork loin,white wine vinegar,garam masala powder,olive oil
title: Blueberry Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta ( short or medium, depending on preference ) | 1/2 lb pork loin or 1/2 lb chicken | 1 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons black soy sauce | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | freshly sliced pimento stuffed olive oil
instructions: Prepare the ziti according to your favourite package directions. While waiting for the pasta to cook, slice meat into 1/4 slices. When the pasta is tender, drain the pasta completely, return to the empty pot, and add the slices and pork. Saute over low heat until pork has cooked through. Dice the veggies or leave them whole. To serve, plate pasta and cover with the meat, veggies/loices. Drizzle with a little olive oil and drizzle with a little good balsamic vinegar. Add a little black pepper and a little garam masala powder to balance the flavours.

title: Sour Cream and Pepper Pockets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1/2 jalapeno pepper, minced | 4 small jalapeno peppers, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons dry red wine | 1 tablespoon dry white wine or 1 tablespoon chicken stock | 2 cups croutons ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons ground blanched almond ( optional ) | crushed garlic clove ( optional )
instructions: In small bowl combine the rosemary with the arrowroot, minced red chilies, ground black pepper, garlic and half the jalapeños. Stir into the sour cream mixture. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,poblano pepper,bamboo shoot,coriander powder,rice cereal,serrano chili
title: Mexican Rice Blend Mix
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, deseeded, deveined and chopped | 1 serrano chili, deseeded, deseeded and chopped | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced | 1/4 cup coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 cup rice cereal, such as rice krispies ( i used rice krispies )
instructions: In a medium bowl, add all the dry ingredients and the chopped peppers. Mix well. Store in an airtight container, in an airtight container. Makes 1/2 cup of mix.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,beef stew meat,garlic powder,red wine,cabbage,chicken bouillon cube
title: Slow Cooker Red-Cooked Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 medium red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch squares | 1 cabbage, large cut into 1-inch wedges | 1 cup red wine, burgundy ( c burgundy is your best choice ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cook stew beef in 3 1/2 quart slow cooker until browned, about 5 hours on high. Remove beef from slow cooker and place in 3 1/2 quart slow cooker with remaining ingredients except bouillon and wine. Cover.

title: Creamy White-Chickpea Flour Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 cup chickpea flour | 1 cup white flour | 1 1/2 - 3 cups warm water | 2 1/4 lbs seedless watermelon, with peel, cut into 8 wedges | 3/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Make the peanut butter, in a small bowl sift the peanut butter into a large bowl. Stir in the tamarind paste and mix to a paste with a spoon or fork until smooth. Stir in the chickpea flour, white flour, and warm water until the mixture comes together in a ball of dough. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it for two minutes only. Roll out to about 1/8 inch thickness on an oval shaped machine. Cut into four 2 inch squares or 6 inch squares and divide the greens among 4 salad plates. Place equal amounts of the peanut butter mixture on the greens, distributing them evenly. Whip the cream until stiff peaks form, then add the cream to the cream. Drizzle the cream over each salad, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,oatmeal,beef broth,beef sausage,spaghetti,wheat flour,corn tortilla chip,beef bouillon granule
title: Sausage Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef sausage | 1 cup broken wheat flour | 2 tablespoons beef broth, or more as needed | 1 1/2 tablespoons quick oats ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 12 ounces spaghetti | 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 11 ounces corn tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cook and stir ground beef sausage in a skillet over medium low heat until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,rice vinegar,liquid honey,black eyed pea
title: Honeyed Black Eyed Peas and Beans - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 bag frozen black-eyed peas, thawed | 4 tablespoons reduced sodium rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon liquid honey
instructions: Place undrained cannellini beans in a crock pot. Add peas. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.

title: Green Tomato Soup With Spicy Shellfish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs green tomatoes, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 1/3 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine tomatoes, water and cayenne and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until thickened. Stirring occasionally, remove cayenne pepper and discard. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,yellow bell pepper,alfredo sauce,pesto sauce,blueberry,baking soda,poundcake
title: Baked Italian-style Poundcake Cake
ingredients: 2 pounds poundcake, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 eggs | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 3 cups drained fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 jar alfredo sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Layer pound cake, eggs, pesto sauce, blueberries, yellow bell pepper, bouillon cube and baking soda in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour alfredo sauce over all. Cover, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until a knife inserted in the center of the pound cake comes out clean.

title: Apple Cobbler
ingredients: 2 lbs raspberries ( fresh or frozen, you may also use frozen chopped strawberries, strawberries or raspberries, or try blueberries ) | 2 lbs parsnips ( peeled, cleaned and cut into chunks ) | 5 tablespoons of grated unbleached all-purpose flour | 4 -6 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | pepper, to taste | 1 medium apple ( peeled, cored and cubed ) | 10 ounces apple cider ( cold or hot )
instructions: Prep the berry salad while the breading you wish to bake the fruit. Combine the vinegar, garlic powder, pepper and bread crumbs and mix well. In a separate bowl combine the fruit with the breadcrumb mixture. Pour hot apple cider over fruit mixture and toss. Let sit for 1 hour. Then stir into the batter. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. The batter will have a thick marbled consistency. Remove from refrigerator and serve on chilled plates.

title: Low-sodium Honey-Lentil
ingredients: 600 g small eggplants, cut into large chunks | 500 g light-colored honey-roasted chicken thighs | 300 ml plain nonfat yogurt | 300 g low-fat yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees centigrade. Toast the eggplant slices and bake on a shelf for about 10 to 15 minutes until they are browned.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,pork loin,anchovy fillet,liquid smoke,clove,calamari,cheese,coconut flake
title: Anise Pork Adobo
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup fish sauce or 1/4 cup ketjap manis ( see description ) | 1 ounce garlic & ginger paste | 1/2 cup finely crushed coconut flakes | 1/2 cup liquid smoke ( i use kc masterpiece ) | 5 anchovy fillets | 3 whole cloves | 1 cup coarsely chopped cheese ( i like gruyere )
instructions: Place pork in a nonstick dutch oven, add fish sauce, garlic, ginger, coconut, liquid smoke and anchovies. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until pork is cooked through. Place in a serving dish and sprinkle with coarsely chopped cheese.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,chunky salsa,orange peel,deep dish pie shell,garnish
title: Baked Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 7 cups sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 1/2 cups thick & chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon coarsely grated orange peel | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 large ready-made deep dish pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange half the mushrooms in bottom of pie shell. Scatter on all, and add half the sour cream. Top with half the salsa. Repeat twice with half the remaining mushrooms. Spoon over remaining sour cream. Bake about 40 minutes until bubbly and beginning to brown. Cut into four sections, and serve with remaining salsa.

title: Quick and Easy Corn and Parsnip Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 parsnip | 1 box frozen whole kernel corn | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon oregano ( optional )
instructions: Boil all ingredients together for about 10 minutes. Pour into a bowl and top with chopped fresh parsley or green onion tops to serve.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,chayote,apple juice concentrate,red potato,chocolate pudding mix
title: Tunisian Chayote Appetizers
ingredients: 2 cans chayotes | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 3 tablespoons apple juice concentrate | 1 1/4 ounces unsweetened chocolate chips, melted
instructions: Microwave chayotes in microwave for 10 minutes, then remove and cool. Slice into julienne strips and steam over boiling water for about 5 minutes. Cool. In mixing bowl dissolve one box of instant pudding mix with one package of chocolate pudding mix. In a separate bowl, combine the chayotes, onion, potato, remaining 1 1/4 oz. Choco powder and remaining chocolate pudding. Mix with a spoon until just mixed. Place a large sheet of waxed paper on waxed paper or plastic wrap. Spread the chayote mixture over the waxed paper. Sprinkle lightly with the melted chocolate chips. Cover and refrigerate until firm, at least 1 hour. Keeps well in the refrigerator.

title: Pepperoni Rugelach
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 2 cups chopped walnuts
instructions: Unwrap pepperoni and slice thin.

Random Ingredients: japanese soy sauce,lavender,dark soy sauce,vanilla sugar,coriander,beef rib,italian herb
title: Grilled Short Ribs (Brisket)
ingredients: 1/3 cup japanese soy sauce | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb ( marjoram, oregano etc ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried lavender | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef short ribs, bone in
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients. Rub marinade into ribs and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Grill over direct medium coals, brushing often with sauce. Cook until meat turns golden, about 1 1/2 hours. Pierce to make sure it is cooked thoroughly.

title: Easy Potato-Zucchini Bites
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes | 1/2 cup tzatziki | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 8 slices french bread
instructions: Preheat your broiler. Cut ends off the potato and peel the potato. Place, cut side down, on a baking sheet, and broil for about 2 minutes or until easily flaked with a fork. If not quite hot enough, move the potato to closer to the broiler. Set potato aside to cool slightly, then carefully peel and cut into about 1 inch chunks. Stir together the tzatziki, baking soda, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Brush potatoes with the tzatziki mix in, then place on a baking sheet. Cut french bread into 8 slices. Place a chunk of potato on the top, and then press together until the chunks of potato are flat and about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle tops with remaining tzatziki mix, and broil another 5 minutes or until heated through and top is browned.

title: Rice Shells With Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 package fresh small shell pasta, such as ditalini, or other small shell pasta | 1 jar sliced pimientos | 1/2 cup fresh chopped parsley leaves | 2 teaspoons red pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. While boiling, cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Homemade Beef Noodle Bake
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles | 2 pounds pork roast, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna noodles, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: avocado,coriander powder,wheat flour,broiler fryer chicken,pecorino romano cheese,mint leaf,coconut milk
title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken | 4 tablespoons cracked wheat flour | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 400 ml smooth coconut milk | 1 avocado | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese, plus more for sprinkling on top | fresh coriander leaves, to serve
instructions: Pound chicken to 1cm thick. Sprinkle with cracked wheat flour, and mix well. Heat a little olive or coconut oil, and cook chicken over high heat for 5 minutes each side, until golden brown. Set aside, and mix together the remaining ingredients. Spoon into the chicken, sprinkle with pecorino romano, and return to low heat. Keep warm, and serve with fresh coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,banana,parmigiano reggiano cheese,lemon peel,rigatoni pasta
title: Apple and Banana Riggies
ingredients: 4 cups peeled and grated peeled tart apples | 3 tablespoons grated lemon peel | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 2 1/2 cups sliced bananas
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Mix together the apples, lemon peel, and grated parmigiano reggiano in a bowl and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the rigatoni, about 1/2 cup at a time, and cook until al dente, about 6 minutes. Drain the pasta, reserving 1/4 cup of each of the banana slices and cream separately, and toss with the reserved 1/4 cup of banana slices and the cream. When the pasta is done, transfer it to a large serving bowl or platter and pour the apple mixture over the top.

title: Santa Fe Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 2 cans whole baby corn, drained | 11 ounces frozen chopped tomatoes, thawed | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 2 packages frozen chopped strawberries, thawed | 3 tablespoons reduced sodium flour
instructions: Combine tomatoes and corn, picante sauce, strawberries and 1 tbsp flour in a medium bowl. Drain corn mixture well, reserving 1/3 cup juice. Gently stir reserved juice into tomato mixture, adding reserved tomato liquid if desired. Chill at least 5 hours. Sprinkle with remaining flour and stir to coat evenly.

title: Spicy Roast Capsicum With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 lb chickpeas, washed and cooked | 1 red capsicum, washed, trimmed and halved | 1 green pepper, washed, trimmed and halved | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f combine all ingredients, except salt and pepper in a heavy based roasting tin. Sprinkle over salt and pepper and roast for 35 minutes before vegetables are cooked. Toss vegetables with the pan juices and transfer to a serving bowl.

title: Spanish Spiced Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste, or to taste | 3/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat cream in a skillet over low heat.

title: Cabbage and Fenugreek Leaves
ingredients: 500 g cabbage | 50 g dried currants | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 3 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Cook cabbage and soak currants in 3/4 cup of water for approximately 2 hours, then drain. Bring cabbage to boil in a large pan of water, add sugar and fenugreek leaves. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon,mandarin orange section,coconut milk,red onion,taco seasoning,kosher salt
title: Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 2 cans coconut milk | 2 tablespoons sweet red onions or 2 tablespoons red onion, diced | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs skinless boneless fish cakes, about 4-inch in diameter, cut into 1/4-inch strips | 1/2 lemon, juice of | finely grated red onion or lemon rind | kosher salt
instructions: Spray grill with cooking spray on high heat and preheat to high. Mix taco seasoning with coconut milk. Set aside. Lightly oil grill rack or line with heavy duty foil, then grill salmon, turning once, until browned, 8 - 10 minutes per side or til just cooked through, 4 - 5 minutes total. Tacos may be made ahead, covered. Refrigerate, covered until chilled, up to 3 days. Warm coconut milk while resting fish in a small saucepan. Place coconut in a small microwave safe bowl or glass measuring cup.

Random Ingredients: green grape,chicken thigh,butter,salt black pepper,green pea,orange juice
title: Lighter Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 1 chicken thigh, sliced or | 1/4 lb green pea, frozen | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons orange juice | salt & freshly ground black pepper, as needed | 1 green grape, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Butter a baking dish or roasting pan and place the chicken in the dish or roasting pan. Pour the orange juice over the chicken and spread butter evenly. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place a grape on top of the chicken and place in the heated oven for 45 minutes, then cover and roast for another 45 minutes or until the chicken is tender and the juice runs clear. Remove chicken from the oven and carefully transfer the chicken thighs and any juices to a serving platter. Using a slotted spoon, remove the grape from the pan and arrange on top of the chicken with any juices that have accumulated on the platter. Serve hot.

title: Souper Easy Caramelized Chicken in Honey-Sherry Crust
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared caramel sauce | 1 cup chicken broth | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 pound crumbled feta cheese | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread out the caramel sauce on a cookie sheet, and sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the caramelized sauce onto the caramel sauce. Place in the oven, and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until it is fragrant. Meanwhile, bring the chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Stir in the sherry. Sprinkle with the cheese, and drizzle over the remaining caramel sauce. Stir the honey into the sauce until melted, about 15 minutes.

title: Soojiya (Fried Spiced Flat Bread)
ingredients: 3 cups whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 3 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix flour, confectioners' sugar, ground asafoetida, vanilla sugar, and bread crumbs together in a large bowl.
