Sprinkle a little bit of water over the top until dough doesn't stick together. Lightly oil a large frying pan or griddle over medium heat. Punch down dough, knead briefly, and pat out onto a lightly floured surface. Cut with two or three biscuit cutter, press each into shapes. Heat the frying pan over medium heat until temperature reaches 320 degrees f. Gently fry the sosasasasasasasasasasasasadas 5 to 7 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Grape Juice Jelly
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups grape juice concentrate ( you can mix with jelly in advance ) | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Mix all ingredients over a bowl to blend. Pour into hot pint jars, leaving 1/2 inch of headspace. Wipe rims. Wipe jar rim with a moist clean cloth. Place on a cloth or cloth holder. Store in a cool dark place away from direct sunlight for at least a month.

title: Raisin & Feta Corn Chips
ingredients: 500 g cornflour | 150 g feta cheese, drained | sea salt | 150 g raisins | 300 g roasted peanuts, chopped | yellow mustard | corn tortilla, to make a stack of 6 toasted
instructions: Mix cornflour, feta, salt & raisins & pulse in a processor until the mixture comes together. Fold in peanuts. Divide mixture into 8 equal portions with a rolling pin. Roll each into a cylinder & make a long, oval shaped crescent. Wrap each with plastic wrap & refridgerate for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 220c/425f/gas slice each one as thinly as possible & place on a large baking tray, lined with baking paper. Prick each with a fork & bake for 15 - 20 mins or until golden & firm to the touch.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,tomato green chile pepper,marinara sauce,sesame seed oil,orange juice,orange peel,mexican tomato
title: Mexican Tomato and Orange Chili Dip
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped ( i just use stewed tomatoes ) | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers, undrained | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 2 tablespoons grated orange peel
instructions: In small saucepan, stir stewed tomatoes, mexican style stewed tomatoes, orange peel, diced tomatoes, orange juice, sesame seed oil, garlic, and sesame seed oil. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes or until thick. Serve with tortilla chips or as a filling on lettuce leaves.

title: Caribbean Yellow Glazed Oranges
ingredients: 4 navel oranges, sections cut at 1 1/2-inch intervals | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange orange sections on a large baking sheet. Brush generously with ghee.

title: Flammkuchen #4 from Cooking Magazine
ingredients: 1 package low-fat greek yogurt | 1 lb ladyfinger ( i like a combination of red and green and a white tub ) | 7 tablespoons creme fraiche, warmed
instructions: Slice ladyfingers and sprinkle with creme fraiche to taste. Place in serving dish and serve. Note, can freeze yogurt completely or just mix up and store in freezer.

Random Ingredients: squid,salt black pepper,pineapple juice,fillet,olive oil,rotini pasta,cardamom
title: Grilled Pasta with Pineapple-Calamari Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound squid, sliced 1/4 inch thick on the inside | 1 can pineapple tidbits in juice, drained and crushed | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package rotini pasta | 1 cup olive oil for brushing | 1 can or bottle dark rum, for dipping
instructions: Place 1 pound of the squid and 1 can of the drained pineapple in a large, resealable plastic bag, and squirt in the juice until the squid is evenly coated. Season with cardamom, salt, and pepper, and shake to mix. Place pasta in the freezer for a few minutes, and drain when ready. Set aside. Heat 1 can of the reserved pineapple tidbits in a skillet over medium heat, and set aside. Add the olive oil to the skillet, and heat until hot but not smoking. Place the drained squid in the skillet, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side. Spoon 3/4 of the pineapple tidbits onto each plate with the squid.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk,peanut oil,vegetable,couscous,heavy whipping cream,grand marnier
title: Quick and Easy Quinoa Porridge
ingredients: 3 cups nonfat milk | 1 cup couscous | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons minced sweetened vegetables | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon peanut oil
instructions: Pour the milk and couscous into a saucepan with 3/4 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then immediately turn heat to low and simmer. Do not remove the lid until the liquid has been absorbed. Transfer to a bowl you will be preparing the porridge. In a bowl, combine the hot milk and cream with the sweetened vegetables. Heat 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil in a 3 - 4 quart pan over medium heat. Add the vegetable mixture and cook 1 minute. The porridge should start to brown at the edges. Transfer to a bowl and cover with a dish towel. Cool slightly. When cool, drizzle the remaining tablespoon of oil over the porridge and mix well. Serve topped with whipped cream if desired.

title: Red Cabbage (India)
ingredients: 1 small head red cabbage, cut into quarters | 1 white onion, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 cup ice cream
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss together cabbage, onion slices, turmeric and ice cream. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Quick  Crisp
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped golden delicious apple | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla beans, extract, divided | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 lb ground beef
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Shape into 6 patties. Grill over medium coals for 7 to 10 minutes per side.

title: Barramundae (Red Pepper Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried red peppers | 1 3/4 cups leeks, chopped | 1/2 lb drambuie | 1/2 cup molasses | 20 kalamata olives
instructions: Soak the dried peppers in 1 cups boiling water and let soften. Place all the other ingredients together in a pot. Bring to the boil. Remove from heat and stir well. Allow to cool somewhat. Cut the peppers into 1 inch slices from the stem. Scoop out the seeds, then coarsely chop the peppers. Place the peppers into the solution, stir well and serve.

title: Scallion and Beet Relish
ingredients: 1 bag fresh beet, scrubbed | 24 scallions
instructions: Cut unpeeled beet in half and set aside. Scallions will look like they are about 1 1/2 wide. Using knife or small, sharp knife, cut off the root ends of the unpeeled scallions just enough so they will sit upright on cutting board. Cut the greens into 1/4 thick slices, if they look any dense, they are too long. Wash greens well, and dry with paper towels. When ready to eat, place a leaf of greens in the bowl of a food processor, followed by 2 tablespoons of the scallion greens and 1 tablespoon of cold water. Process, pulsing, until they are finely diced.

title: Jalapeno Jam (Pickled Ham)
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds ham, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 jars sliced jalapeno peppers | 24 jalapeno peppers, chopped
instructions: Place ham and 1 jar of sliced jalapenos in a large jar with enough water to cover. Cover jar tightly, and refrigerate for at least 5 days before using as a dip for ham. Soak jalapenos in a bowl of cool water for about 15 minutes. Soak remaining jar of jalapeno peppers in a bowl of cool water. Drain, and process with jalapenos to desired consistency.

title: Lemonade Soup (Homemade)
ingredients: 3 cups beef broth | 1 bunch fresh sage leaves | 1/2 cup lemonade | 8 graham crackers, approximately
instructions: Combine the beef broth and sage in a heavy saucepan. Heat to a simmer. Once the broth simmers, add the lemonade and simmer at a slow simmer for 30 minutes or until the liquid has reduced by 50% approximately. Serve hot. You can freeze this soup and it is better the next day. Note, if you are serving this soup from freezer just allow it to cool for an hour, then remove any large chunks before returning to the refrigerator to store.

title: Italian Egg Salad (Oamc)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons watercress, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pepperoni, finely chopped | 2 egg yolks | romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces ( optional )
instructions: Combine watercress and pepperoni in a medium bowl. Whisk the egg yolks until thick and creamy. Remove the bowl from the heat and add hot water. Beat until blended, then stir in the egg yolk mixture. Fold in the romaine cabbage if using and transfer to a serving bowl. Variation, alternatively, serve the salad with grilled eggplant.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,maraschino cherry,cellophane noodle,baby spinach,beef stew meat,pasta
title: Beef Stew With Lettuce and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 package dried cellophane noodles | 1 package baby spinach, washed | 3/4 lb white button mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 bag baby maraschino cherries, with stems | 32 ounces cooked pasta
instructions: Brown stew meat in frying pan, in batches if necessary, for 5 minutes on each side. Set stew meat aside. Add 3/4 lb fresh mushrooms to the hot stew, then add the spinach, stirring to coat in the oil. Bring stew to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered 10 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add noodles and cook until tender but firm to the bite, according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Add noodles to stew and reheat. Serve stew on a warm platter or individual plates. Add hot cooked pasta to stew and stir to coat with stew.

title: Chili Potatoes
ingredients: 3 medium baking potatoes, peeled | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon mild chili paste
instructions: Cut out the tops of the potatoes and discard. Cut out the eyes and the inside of the potatoes. Rinse the potato, prick the insides with a fork, then pour some boiling water over the potato and cut them into 1/2 inch rounds.

title: Olive Salad
ingredients: 12 green olives | 10 canned bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Wash and dry olives. Use green olives with small cracks removed. Tear olives into pieces and add to prepared salad bowl. Stir in bamboo shoots. Mix to coat. Serve at room temperature.

title: Kurdish Spiced Zucchini with Tomato (Fakihara)
ingredients: 1 lb small firm tomatoes | 1/2 cup quinoa, soaked in plenty of water for ten to twenty minutes drained | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 1/2 bay leaves or 1 1/2 sprigs, tied together in a bundle of leaves | 4 tablespoons anchovy paste
instructions: Scald the quinoa. Drain completely. Put the tomatoes in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a simmer and cook for fifteen minutes, stirring occasionally to keep the pieces separate from the water. Turn off the heat and leave the tomatoes whole. Cut them in half lengthwise, then with a very sharp knife carefully cut through the skin from the tomato, being careful not to cut into the tomato completely. When they are all cut into quarters, scoop out the seeds. Place the quinoa in a large heatproof bowl. Toss in a pinch of salt, pour in a few tablespoons of the lemon juice, and place over a gentle heat. When the lemon juice has completely absorbed the lemon juice, add the bay leaves. Stir until the liquid has been absorbed and continue stirring. When it has been absorbed turn the heat down and let the spices simmer about five minutes. If using the anchovy paste, stir it into the sauce. When the tomatoes have released some juice, remove the skins by squeezing a teaspoon of the flesh with your hands. The water will help to prevent this from breaking. Turn off the heat. With a sieve, remove the skins and finely dice them into little pieces. Stir into the sauce. Add the rest of the citrus juices and stir to combine. Cook for about five minutes until the zucchini are done and coated with spicy flavoring. Serve straight away. The zucchini can also be prepared a day in advance and refrigerated, if needed.

title: Marynd's Cajun Gumbo
ingredients: 1 can evaporated milk nondairy broth | 32 ounces crabmeat | 1 tablespoon fresh black pepper | 1 cup light cream
instructions: Pour the evaporated milk into a large pot. Place your crab meat into the milk. When the meat is almost translucent, stir in the pepper and cream until it is mixed well. Add enough black pepper to bring out the flavors, but not too much. Simmer over medium heat for about 15 minutes.

title: Hot Chilies & Cotija Cheese
ingredients: 3 -4 chilies, sliced thin | 3 -4 ounces cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon marmite ( or your favourite extract ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Slice chilies thinly, sprinkle with a little salt & then the marmite. Grind the chilies into a fine powder. Spread the chilies on a plate or a shallow serving dish & sprinkle with the red pepper flakes. Sprinkle with the rest of your condiments & serve.

Random Ingredients: pepper,lemon zest,kielbasa,tomato green chilies,cauliflower,turmeric,toor dal,celery rib
title: Low Fat Spicy Dal
ingredients: 4 cups cooked toor dal | 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped celery ribs ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons lemon zest ( optional, fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 4 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies | 4 ounces chopped kielbasa | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: Saute the sliced kielbasa with cooking spray, on medium heat until browned. Add chopped celery, garlic, lemon zest, turmeric, green chilies until cooked. Add cooked toor dal and cook for several minutes until slightly thickened. Add cooked kielbasa and chopped cauliflower and cook for approximately 5 - 8 minutes. Add salt and black pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,white wine vinegar,parmesan cheese,shortening,liquid smoke
title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1/2 cup finely grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Melt the shortening in a small saucepan over low heat. Add vinegar, cook for 2 to 3 minutes, watching it carefully with a wire wisk or wire whisk. If it starts to foam up, add a small amount of oil. Remove from heat. Blend in 2/3 cup of parmigiano reggiano. Add liquid smoke, stirring with a wooden spoon to combine. Return to low heat, and cook for a minute. Remove from heat and add remaining 1/4 cup grated cheese. Stir, cooking for at least another minute. When ready to serve, pour over your favourite pasta or fettuccine.

title: Sicilian Steak (Or Piroshki) With Salami
ingredients: 1 whole hard salami | 12 slices beef sirloin
instructions: Slice the salami thinly, across the grain. Grill the salami on both sides until cooked through and slightly charred. Spread each slice of salami with just enough salami to cover it. Fold each salami in half. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,artichoke heart,red delicious apple,green bell pepper,vegetable stock
title: Baked apple & green bell pepper soup
ingredients: 2 red delicious apples | 1 can condensed beef broth, undiluted | 1 can vegetable stock ( optional ) | 8 ounces frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat on broiler pan to 350 degrees. Core apples, cut into thin slices & layer apples in a baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour atop the apple slices. Cover and bake 40 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Mustard Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 thick cut pork chops | 6 drops bitter | 4 tablespoons apricot jam ( or jam of choice )
instructions: Combine mustard jam and a drop of bitter. Brush some chops with jam/sour cream or jam and grill for 3 minutes on each side.

title: Tomato Salad
ingredients: 3 cans ro tel tomatoes | 1 can sliced bamboo shoot | 3/4 cup dry vermouth | 3/4 cup dry sherry | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup cold water | 4 lemons, juice of | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh grated lemon rind | fatized topping
instructions: Place tomatoes and bamboo shoots in a colander and drain off excess liquid. Drain well and transfer to another bowl. Add vermouth, sherry, tahini, water, lemon rind and lemon juice to tomato mixture. Cover and chill until ready to use. To serve, combine and serve either at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,tomato paste,candy sprinkle,arrowroot,coconut,ketchup,ranch dressing,rosemary leaf
title: Tomato Caesar Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 3/4 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup reduced soduim brandy and 2 tablespoons arugula salad dressing | 2 cups shredded provolone cheese | 2 tablespoons arrowroot | 3 teaspoons finely chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 1/2 cup chopped dried sweetened coconut | fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Drain all excess liquid from tomato sauce. Add tomato paste and ketchup.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,hot red chili pepper,french bread
title: Thai Hot Hot Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 1 can limeade concentrate | 3/4 cup sweet red chili pepper, chopped | 2 french rolls, split in half lengthwise
instructions: Mix limeade, chili pepper and rolls in a large zip top plastic bag, add to bag. Refrigerate overnight, turning bag around occasionally. Remove contents of bag into a pan sprayed with cooking spray, cook over medium heat, turning and stirring occasionally to prevent scorching, until lightly browned and a bit syrupy, about 20 minutes.

title: Pesto and Mozzarella Pork Cutlets
ingredients: 1 boneless pork cutlets, pounded 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick | 12 red potatoes, cut 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 ounces semisweet chocolate
instructions: Place pork cutlets on plate. Place a potato on each cutlet and top with pesto. Divide cheese and chocolate among them. Use toothpicks to hold cheese to the bottom of the dish. Microwave on high, 1 minute. Turn and repeat on opposite side of cutlets.

title: Fennel Cookies II
ingredients: 2 cups fennel seeds | 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Grind fennel seeds with mortar and pestle until coarsely ground, then stir in confectioner's sugar until dissolved. Shape the cooled fennel mixture into 1 inch balls and roll in some of the fennel' sugar. Let stand covered in a cool place until hardened, about 15 minutes.

title: The Sopranos' Copycat
ingredients: 3 -4 large turnips ( medium or large ) | 1 1/4 cups amaretto or 1 1/4 cups sweet almond syrup, warmed until it is quite hot ( almond, prune, hazelnut, etc. ) | gluten free all-purpose dry fruit or cinnamon jam, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Peel the turnip and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch dice. Arrange in a 3x14 inch baking dish, or line it with parchment paper and butter it generously. Sprinkle lightly with salt or lemon pepper and drizzle with the warm amaretto or sweet almond syrup. Dot with a dot of jam or other fancy decoration. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. This recipe is quite good on a cold, humid day or at room temp, but it improves over time.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,peach,tomato,yellow miso,kosher salt black pepper
title: Miso Peaches
ingredients: 10 small tomatoes, halved | 3 medium ripe peaches, halved and pitted | 1/2 cup yellow miso | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Arrange the tomatoes and peaches on serving platter. Spoon miso over fruit. Sprinkle with salt and pepper, to taste. Sprinkle with parsley flakes.

Random Ingredients: deep,grain white rice,red food coloring,cornstarch,apricot,cumin powder
title: Tikka Rice Balls
ingredients: 3 cups short-grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups cornstarch | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons red food coloring | 1 1/2 cups cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups dried apricots, pureed in mixer | deep fat free oil ( for frying )
instructions: In a pot add the rice then sprinkle the 2 cups of cornstarch evenly and mix the mixture well. Add the cumin and food coloring and mix well. Add the last cup of cornstarch and mix well. Dip the rice balls in batter and deep fry until golden brown.

title: Summer Squash and Salmon Tear-Bread Bowl
ingredients: 1 small summer squash | 1 1/2 cups cooked pink salmon ( i prefer pacific cod with this amount ) | 2 -4 slices good-quality whole wheat crackers
instructions: Scrub squash with a knife at regular intervals and cut ends off. Remove peel with a vegetable peeler. Cut squash in half. Remove flesh cut side up, on cutting board, and score with a knife about 1/8 inch thick. Place cut side up, on cutting board. Cut 3 or 4 crosshatch slices crosswise about 1/4 inch thick. Push squash into cuts with your fingers. Arrange about 1 teaspoon salmon on top. Top fish evenly with cracker crumbs. Lightly sprinkle top of bread with more crumbs. Bake in 400 degree oven, uncovered, on the middle rack of the oven until bread starts to brown and flake slightly, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately, cutting remaining crumbs into pieces.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,seasoning italian salad dressing mix,pinto bean
title: Italian Sausage Beans With Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package dry good seasonings italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock and stir until well blended. Bake in a 350º oven for 30 minutes, stir and bake 10 more minutes. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Easy Zucchini Dip
ingredients: 2 cups cubed zucchini | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Melt yogurt in a saucepan over medium low heat. Stir in zucchini, cover, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, then stir in remaining ingredients until blended.

title: The Big Dipper Pesto!
ingredients: 2 cups packed fresh pesto sauce | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Mix all together in a small bowl. Store in an air tight container away from light.

title: Apple Spaghetti Bites
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce | 1 apple, peeled | 8 ounces brie cheese
instructions: In a saucepan, add spaghetti sauce and apples and bring to a boil for two minutes. Remove from heat. Cut brie into cubes approximately the size of your brie cubes. Once the spaghetti and apples are done, add the apple and cheese cubes and heat until the cheese is melted. Spoon mixture into bowls and serve warm with your favorite crackers.

Random Ingredients: black bean,vanilla bean,avocado,white flour,green chili pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,basmati rice
title: Rice, Avocado, and Bean Salad at Home!
ingredients: 3 cups cooked shredded basmati rice | 2 large ripe avocados | 1/2 cup dried black beans, soaked overnight in cold water | 1 can sliced green chili peppers, drained and minced | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1/2 vanilla beans or 1/2 tablespoon vanilla extract | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Toss together the drained rice, avocados, black beans, chilies, flour, and vanilla in a large bowl. Sprinkle cheese on top. Toss to mix well and serve immediately.

title: Chorizo Queso
ingredients: 12 ounces chorizo sausage, cut 1 inch-wide slabs | 3 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil
instructions: Place sausage in nonstick skillet, add 1/2 tsp of water per side. Add the oregano, onion flakes, saffron and remaining 3 tsp of water. Heat through, stirring occasionally. Serve with tortillas or queso fresco, your choice.

title: Tropical-Style Grilled Pineapple with Sichuan Salt
ingredients: 1 fresh pineapple, at least 1 inch thick, with the skin on | sea salt, preferably kosher salt
instructions: Cut off the top third of the pineapple, leaving enough at least 1/2 inch of meat on each. Reserve the top third to use in the grill. Cut between the skin and flesh to separate the flesh from the flesh. Cut the fruit out of the peel along the grain so that each portion is about 1 inch thick. Cut off the top section of the pineapple again and discard. Cut the pulp into 1/2 inch dice, then using a peeler, grate and discard the skin from the fruit. Discard the flesh. Preheat grill to medium high, or set aside. Brush pineapple skewers with salt for best results and oil lightly with cooking spray, then set on the hot grates. Grill the pineapple for 3 to 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. Remove to a serving platter, then slice into about 2 inch chunks and serve with the cooking fat.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,vanilla essence,vanilla ice cream,tart apple,hamburger,salt black pepper,leg lamb
title: Lamb & Apple Irish Stout Barley Stew
ingredients: 4 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 lb lean leg of lamb, trimmed | 12 ounces lean stewing beef, trimmed | 1 cup good quality plain breadcrumbs or 1 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1/2 ounce vanillia vanilla essence | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 8 ounces of your favourite light rum or 8 ounces good quality stout beer ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150°c or 130°c if using a fan assisted oven. Tip the barley into a large bowl, making sure all the grains are coated with oil. Add the lamb and beef, and coat well with breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs. Transfer the lamb and beef into a large roasting pan or baking stone. Deglaze the pan with the rum and then pour into the oven. Depending on how thick your rum is, you can bake your stew for 40 - 45 minutes, depending on your oven strength, but i found the internal temp was 140°c. To serve, remove the lamb from the pan but leave the fat in the pan and slice it thinly. Serve with the barley stew.

title: Bittersweet Irish Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces irish cream | 2 tablespoons lime zest, grated
instructions: Combine grated lime zest and irish cream in a small mixing bowl. Set aside. Mix grated lime zest with grated irish cream until well blended. Using an ice cream maker, process or hand blend until desired consistency is reached.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,chili flake,nutritional yeast,chicken breast,tomato soup,bread,squash
title: Spicy Chicken and Squash
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 can tomato soup | 1/2 cup mushroom soup | 1/2 cup squash | 1 can chopped green chilies ( optional ) | 4 slices bread, crumbled | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Cut a slit in the side of each chicken breast. Spoon the soup, mushrooms soup, squash, chilies and nutritional yeast into a medium sauce pan and heat through. Coat the chicken with bread crumbs and place in a baking dish. Pour the hot sauce over the chicken, place in a 350 degree oven and bake until well browned.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,no salt tomato sauce,feta cheese,cumin,nam pla,celery salt,wheat flour
title: Feta Cheese Patties
ingredients: 3/4 cup no-salt-added tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons nam pla or 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 1/2 cups crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the tomato sauce, nam pla, thyme, cumin, celery salt and feta cheese. Stir in the flour until just blended.

title: Sesame Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups sesame seeds | 1 1/2 cups cooked beans, strained
instructions: Toss together the sesame seeds and the beans and serve in bowls with crumbled cooked chicken or shrimp.

title: Slow Cooker Korean Beef
ingredients: 1 large beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup tomato juice, divided | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons dried maraschino cherries
instructions: Place beef in a slow cooker. In a small bowl, stir together 1/2 the tomato juice, chili sauce, and maraschino cherries. Pour over beef. Set slow cooker to high. Cover.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,fish fillet,cooking oat,spaghetti squash,taco seasoning,hard egg,vegetable oil cooking spray,italian herb
title: Low-Fat Crock Pot Fish Taco Bowl
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash | cooking oats | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 4 fish fillets | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels ( optional ) | 1 packet taco seasoning | 4 tablespoons low-fat ranch style beans and wild rice or 4 tablespoons frozen green beans
instructions: Cut spaghetti squash in half and place between two pieces of plastic wrap on cutting board.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,turnip,lemonade,pineapple juice,lemon juice,cajun seasoning,phyllo pastry,papaya
title: Sweet Turnip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut in large chunks | 2 tablespoons lemonade | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 -2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 2 teaspoons papayas, paprika | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 4 sheets phyllo pastry sheets, thawed and left as they are on the counter | 2 -3 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: For the turnip, preheat oven to 375°f boil turnips in water with salt for 5 - 8 minutes until tender. Drain and mash well with lemonade, pineapple juice, cajun seasoning, lemon juice, papayas, tomato soup and turnips. Place in an oven proof dish sprayed with cooking spray and bake at 375°f for 25 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serve hot, on fresh fruit for a treat.

title: German Asparagus
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus spear, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1 cup beef broth
instructions: Put asparagus in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 minutes drain. In a small sauce pan, blend ketchup and beef broth until smooth. Heat until heated through.

title: Mexican Style Green Chilies
ingredients: 2 cans diced green chilies | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings
instructions: Mix chilies and seasoning mix in a bowl. In a large skillet, heat bacon drippings. Saute for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chocolate square,apricot nectar,ricotta,vermouth,currant,german chocolate cake mix,parsley root
title: Sicilian Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ricotta, drained shopping list ( i used cottage cheese, or half and half ) | 1/3 cup chopped dried apricots | 1/3 cup chopped crystallized parsley root | 1/3 cup chopped mixed dried fruit or 1/3 cup dried apricot nectar, any combination of these ( i used cranberries ) | 1/3 cup chocolate square, melted, can use more when necessary | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth or 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 package german sweet chocolate cakes mix ( i used the `` jiffy'brand, they are sold in german specialty stores )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a mixing bowl combine the cheeses, apricots, parsley roots and nectar, except the vermouth or wine. Place cheese mixture into an ungreased 8 inch springform cake pan. Spoon over the vermouth/wine mixture. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes. Cool on rack. When cool, ice. You may use frozen cheesecake instead of the cheesecake. Also, if using the vermouth instead of wine, omit the vermouth. For an alcohol free sweetner, you may use less nectar.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatoes, quartered, ripe if desired | 2 lbs virgin olive oil ( you may need a little more )
instructions: In a 3 1/2 or 4 - 5 qt pan combine the tomatoes, oil and salsa verde. Reduce the heat just enough to maintain a bare simmer. Simmer, uncovered for about 1 hour, then check the seasoning. Serve warm or cool and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: chicken,vodka,ginger root,ear corn cob,yeast,baby potato,red onion,chili without bean
title: Ravioli
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 1/4 cups warm water | 1 tablespoon chili without beans | 2 pounds chicken, cubed | 1/2 red onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 baby potatoes, quartered | 2 ears corn on the cob, husked and cut into 2 lengths
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand until creamy, about 10 minutes. Stir in the chili, chicken, onion, ginger, and vodka. Stir in the potato. Cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place corn in a steamer rack set over a baking dish. Cover pan with a lid. Place in oven. Cook 45 minutes to 1 hour. Pour off moisture, and set aside 15 minutes to cool.

title: Beer and Yogurt Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons low-fat greek yogurt or 2 tablespoons fat free sour cream | 3/4 cup beer | 4 tablespoons skim milk or 4 tablespoons yogurt | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon finely chopped fresh chile, such as jalapenos or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chiles, to taste | 1 tablespoon fat free sour cream | 1 tablespoon heavy cream
instructions: Place a cast iron skillet over medium high heat and add 1 tablespoons of the yogurt. Spread the yogurt out in small to small thin dollops. Cook the tortillas about 1 - 2 minutes on each side. Place on a cutting board and top with 2 tablespoons yogurt and chiles. Top with a second tortilla and continue to cook until done to your liking. Remove from skillet and top with 1 tablespoon yogurt and sour cream. Top with the hot peppers and fresh cream if desired.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 4 lbs center-cut beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place tenderloin on a rack under a foil covered broiler rack. Broil 8 - 10 minutes for medium rare doneness.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,chicken wing,onion powder,muscovado sugar,red chilies
title: Hot Wings and Lemons
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 3 dried red chilies | 1/2 - 1/2-1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons light muscovado sugar or 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Place wings, dried red chili, cayenne pepper, onion powder and sugar in a large skillet. Bury wings or press them until dry. Brown on both sides on high heat, turning once. If the mixture gets too dry, pour in a little bit of water. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Stir frequently if mixture gets dry. You may need to add a little water. Serve with ketchup.

title: Baby Spinach and Potato
ingredients: 500 g mixed baby spinach ( or use 4 bunches ) | 1 -2 large potato, roughly chopped | 100 g silver beet, trimmed, washed and cut into small chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Line a 2 lb ovenproof dish with baking paper. Cut the greens into quarters. Place in a large pan of boiling water and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and roughly chop. Put the spinach and potato in a large heatproof bowl. Add the water and potato, stirring to combine. Bring to the boil, then cover and place into the oven for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and stir until all the spinach has been added and the potato is cooked. This should take about 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in the silverbeet pieces. Spoon the spinach and potato into the bowls and serve immediately.

title: Kitchen Kouture Red Chili Powder
ingredients: 3 tablespoons old bay seasoning tm ( heaping ) | 1 tablespoon red chili powder
instructions: Mix all of the above ingredients together in a small bowl or cup and store in an airtight container for up to 3 months.

title: Cajun Shredded Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed and torn into smaller pieces | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the lettuce pieces in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet with a lid. Sprinkle with the cajun seasoning, and bake in the preheated oven until browned and crisp, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shortening,pineapple,spaghetti sauce meat,rice wine,romano cheese,rye bread
title: Swiss Sweet and Sour Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 lb spanish sweet roll or 1 lb rindless roll | 1/2 lb rindless rye bread | 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce or 1/2 lb meat sausage | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/3 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Cut roll lengthwise into 1/2 inch wide strips then cut into 1 inch strips. Wrap each strip completely in rind and pound lightly with rolling pin, then cut strips into 2 inch long pieces. In a dutch oven, melt shortening then saute rolls, stirring, over medium heat. Cook about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package directions, omitting the salt and fat. Drain the spaghetti well and toss with sauce. Stir in cheese. Spoon sauce onto warm plate. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green onion,red bell pepper,vanilla essence,garbanzo bean,turmeric powder,cooking spray
title: Chickpea Fritters
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup garbanzo beans, cooked | 2 cups diced red bell peppers | 1/3 cup sliced green onion | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla essence
instructions: Mash garbanzo beans with fork. Heat oil in medium bowl on medium high in microwave oven. Add drained cooked garbanzo beans and finely diced red bell peppers to the oil. Spray non stick skillet with cooking spray. Add tumeric and mix well. Add onions and mix well until golden. Remove from heat and add mashed garbanzo beans and mix well. Add vanilla and mix well. Pour into serving platter. Serve with your favourite bread. Great snack or snack meal.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,apricot jam,broccoli,beef brisket,serrano pepper,cherry tomato
title: Hot Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, fat trimmed | 2 jars apricot jam | 1 can italian stewed tomatoes | 1/2 lb fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 3 serrano peppers, sliced | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Combine the jam and stewed tomatoes in a saucepan. Bring mixture to boil, lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, place the brisket on a rack in a roasting pan, fat side up. Pour boiling jam mixture over brisket, cover tightly and cook in a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, boil the broccoli and tomatoes in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain. Trim fat from brisket, slice across the grain and serve onto rolls.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,green pea,red onion,pork sparerib,pork chop,courgette,cremini mushroom
title: Easy Pork and Veggie Plait
ingredients: 150 g pork spareribs | 500 g veal bones with pectin | 200 g red onions | 200 g red bell peppers | 400 g cremini mushrooms | 200 g green peas, fresh shelled | 200 g red bell peppers | 200 g sauteed green peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Cut spareribs into half and place into a large casserole dish, add pork bones and cover with water. Cook for 8 minutes then cook vegetables for 4 minutes. Remove meat from pan and place into roasting dish. Slice veal bones into thick slices and place into another casserole dish. Slice onion into wedges and add to casserole dish. Slice button mushrooms into thick wedges and add to casserole dish. Slice red bell peppers into thick wedges and add to casserole dish. Cover with lid and cook in the oven for 2 hours remove from oven and place cover on dish and place in the oven for 20 minutes. Remove pan and lid and leave for an additional 10 minutes. Stir and cook for a few mins to thicken gravy. Serve plait with gravy spooned over.

title: Gruyere Mascarpone
ingredients: 2 tablespoons espresso powder, brewed to room temperature | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard, dijon-style and heaping | 1 teaspoon grated orange rind | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon grated gruyere cheese ( more may be desired but optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 sage leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine, coffee powder, mustard, orange rind, salt, cheese, and hot sauce. Beat until well blended. Place a sage leaf on each serving, drizzle with the espresso, and serve.

title: Spiced Coffee
ingredients: 3/4 cup strong coffee | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 1 tablespoon firmly packed light brown sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and stir for 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: meatball,vegetable stock,mushroom,green curry paste,noodle,taco seasoning mix,radish,ketchup
title: Quick Noodle Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package noodles ( red bell pepper and red onion ) | 1 package frozen meatballs, thawed | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 3 teaspoons green curry paste | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 cup chopped mushroom | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1 radish, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Rinse and drain. In a small bowl, combine vegetable stock, curry paste, ketchup, mushrooms and taco seasoning. Mix well and pour over noodles, breaking apart with back of spoon. Sprinkle top with radish slices if desired.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,dill,ginger garlic paste,cocoa powder,topping,rose water,pistachio
title: Afghan Yogurt Cake
ingredients: 1 container whipped topping | 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped | 1 tablespoon quick cooking spray | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking powder cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place whipped topping over bottom of 9 inch square pan. Arrange dill in thin layer over yogurt. Cover with ginger garlic paste and rose water. Sprinkle with coarsely chopped pistachios. Chill. Whip topping and spread on top of yogurt. Note, this should be served as one dish. It is not served as an appetizer and its proportions will vary depending on how you spread whipped topping. If you do add whipped topping to whipped topping, mix it together and spread on top of yogurt.

title: Frijoles Borrachos (Pickled Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb dry pinto beans | kosher salt
instructions: Rinse the beans under cold water and soak them in cold water for 2 days. Drain soaking water and transfer to food processor or a mortar and pestle, or put through a strainer until desired consistency. Put a cloth over a bowl or platter.

title: Dinner Rolls
ingredients: 350 g kidney beans ( boiled in water for 5 minutes ) | 300 g tahini paste | 300 ml yeast | 300 g cherries
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a little warm water. Add some flour and mix. Add other ingredients and knead until you get springy dough. You can also use your hands for a handle on the dough. Let rise for about 1 hour and shape into finger thick rolls. Let rise again until almost double in size. Spray a little flour on a pizza baking tray and put into a 400f oven for about 15 minutes or until golden brown on top.

title: Catch of the Day
ingredients: 2 bunches kale, rinsed under running water, or 2 bunches lacinato kale ( 1 1/2-4 pounds fresh kale ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1 cup buttermilk ( or water and soda or non fat sour cream for a thicker ch )
instructions: Separate kale leaves in half and cut off any stems attached to them. Rinse off water. Slice greens in thin slices, or coarsely chop. Sprinkle with the red pepper flakes. Place greens in a large saucepan and pour liquid into the pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in buttermilk or water to cover greens. Reduce heat to lowest setting and cover. Cook for about 3 hours, stirring once or twice to prevent burning. After 3 hours, remove lid, increase heat and cook an additional 10 minutes to thicken sauce.

title: Roast Beef and Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup hot potato flakes | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1 lb ground round | 2 tablespoons dried onion | 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl combine the hot potato flakes with a teaspoon of caraway seed. Roll the ground beef into the dalloped nut mixture. In a 9 by 13 inch baking dish, layer meat, drizzle with the reserved gravy. Cover with walnuts and top with french onion rings. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake in the oven approximately 40 minutes. After 30 minutes, remove foil and raise temperature to broil. Broil the tops until golden, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from oven, cut into squares and serve.

title: Pizzagaini
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, pre-made ( or homemade dough, or homemade, etc. ) | 1/2 teaspoon whole cloves ( optional, to taste... i like lots of ones )
instructions: If using dough, let dough rise til it is double in size about 30 - 45 minutes. Divide dough into 2 long x 1 long rectangles. Lightly grease a flat frying pan or comal with a little oil. Fry each slice of dough in the oil on med. Heat till lightly browning. Use a slotted spoon to remove the bread from the pan. Dip a spoonful of dough into the warm oil a few turns, just to crisp the skin. Slice into 4 pieces and serve warm.

title: Polski Stuffed and Stuffed With Polish Sausages
ingredients: 500 g polish sausage | 1 grape tomato | 15 pitted dates, diced fine | 1 teaspoon capers | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 pinch vanilla
instructions: First, take the polish sausage out of the casing and put it in large pot. Slice the top of the plum tomato from the head. Take both ends off the tomatoes and scoop out the soft insides, being careful not to remove all the pulp from the tomato skin. Then remove these and chop out the insides. Save a few plum tomatoes for later use. Chop the reserved tomato pulp and place into a large bowl with the diced plum tomatoes, diced dates, capers, and vanilla essence. Scoop out the plum tomato pulp, discarding the skin, and chop roughly into chunks or pieces. Scoop out the reserved tomato pulp and reserve. Combine with the turkey meat mixture to form a stuffing. Pour into a well buttered casserole dish and put in the oven at 180°c / 350°f / gas mark 6 for around 45 minutes. Once cooked, remove from the pan and serve with lots of thick cream as suggested. Note, if you find it has been slightly too crumbly for your taste, you can add a teaspoon of milk to give it a little extra juice. Serve with pita bread on the side.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,puff pastry,tarragon,soybean oil vegetable,dark red kidney bean,spanish onion,celery salt
title: Steamed Crab Pie
ingredients: 1 sheet ready rolled puff pastry ( one large size pie tin ) | 1 red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 large spanish onion, chopped ( for australians ) | 1 tablespoon of raw crabmeat | 1 tablespoon tarragon or 1 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 200 g soybeans ( mixed vegetable beans, pinto beans, black bean sprouts ) | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 2 teaspoons of good quality dark red table wine or 2 teaspoons dark rum
instructions: You will need a square steak tray and a baking plate to make the pastry sheets. Prick the base and sides in a couple of places with a skewer. Line up the pastry sheets on the bottom of the tray. Add a bit of water to the tray and, to prevent pastry from drying out, use a knife to punch your pastry down around the edges of the tray. Brush the pastry sheets with water and place on the tray. Place in the fridge for about 15 minutes or until you are ready for use. Meanwhile, cook the kidney beans or other beans with the onion in a saucepan of boiling water at a steady simmer until they are quite tender. Drain and set aside. Cut the crabmeat into strips using kitchen scissors. Add the crab meat to the simmering beans and onion mixture. Bring to the boil on a medium setting for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring very well. Add the tarragon, celery salt and oyster seasoning, then pour in the wine or rum. Reduce the heat to low set the mixture, uncovered. Leave to simmer until the liquid is evaporated. Taste and adjust the seasoning with more salt and pepper if necessary. Once you have warmed the mixture through, remove from the heat. If you are making the pie from the oven, simply grease a pastry board with some of the cooking oil leaving plenty of holes. Line the pastry sheet with the pastry, leaving enough pastry over the rim to cover the bottom and sides of the pastry tin. Cover the pastry with the beans and onion mixture. Scatter over the crab strips and dot over the crab filling. Roll out the remaining pastry and cut into 4 slices to make little squares to form squares. Using a fork or large sieve or a sharp knife, gently push down all the sides of the pastry. Brush the pastry squares with water. Place them on a baking tray, sprayed with some of the cooking oil. Brush the top of the pastry with water. Bake in a preheated oven at 200 deg c for about 30 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown. Allow to cool, then cut into squares.

title: Edamame and Butternut Squash in Pancake Syrup
ingredients: 2 ounces shelled edamame seaweed | 2 ounces shelled edamame | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 radishes, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon whiskey | 4 teaspoons milk | 1/2 ounce sliced gherkins with rings or 1/2 ounce smoked paprika ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a frying pan. Add the edamame and cook over a low heat for a couple of minutes. Flip them over. When completely cool, scoop them out of any skin or fibrous bits with a melonballer. Chop roughly and place them in a salad bowl. Sprinkle with cumin and herbs. Pour over the whiskey and milk. Mix gently together. Serve with gherkins for sprinkling, if using them. Edamame syrup, melt the sugar in a small bowl over a small pan of simmering water. Add the chopped gherkins and simmer for 3 minutes. Drain well. Stir through the syrup. The syrup should be slightly runny.

title: Stuffed Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 kg grape | 1/4 cup grape juice or 1/4 cup white grape juice | 5 slices white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c and line a baking tray with baking paper. Wash the grapes and remove seed. Cut the grapefruit in half and remove the membrane. Make a slit on one side of the grapefruit and spoon over a little of the juice juice, and replace the stem. Place the bread slices on top of the grapefruit. Drizzle with some grape juice. Bake in oven until bread is well toasted and grapefruit is soft and slightly coloured.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,onion powder,lime,red chilies,coriander powder,turmeric powder,water,chili
title: Kebab Iroog (Beef Tenderloin Curry)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 large onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 2 limes, juice only | 1 tablespoon chili, diced | 1/2 cup water
instructions: First, place all ingredients in a plastic bag, mix well. Take the bag out of the mixture and place onto a tray. Allow to sit for about 2 hours to set. Cut slits on the beef and insert a litle of ginger in the slits. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Take the beef out to come off flavor but remove most of the access fat. Add your desired sauce. I prefer a spicy consistency. Serve with rice.

title: Chicken Farfalle
ingredients: 1 package uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 chicken breast, cut into cubes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the bow tie pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Mix farfalle pasta, chicken breast, and remaining 1/4 cup of pasta sauce in a pot over medium heat.

title: Green Chili Powder Coffee
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot coffee | 1 cup green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients.

title: Cheater's Texas Trash
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried corn flakes | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 cup orange flower water
instructions: In large bowl combine the corn flakes, enchilada sauce and orange flower water and stir until combined. In a 2 quart pot, pour in 1/4 cup of the enchilada sauce mixture and mix thoroughly. Boil for 5 to 7 minutes, then cover for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit for 5 to 10 minutes while waiting for the rest of the enchilada sauce to warm. Serve with fresh corn chips, or serve as directed on bagels or baguettes.

Random Ingredients: double cream,yellow pepper,blueberry,tomato green chilies,frying chicken,sage,stone mustard
title: Creamy Bleu Corn Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons stone ground mustard | 1 whole frying chicken, cut into serving pieces | 1 yellow pepper, sliced, rings | 2 cans tomato and green chilies, drained | 1/2 - 1 cup single cream, warmed | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 fresh pints fresh blueberries or 2 pints frozen blueberries and thawed sweetened fruit, thawed ( such as bing or great northern brand )
instructions: For the chicken, in a large skillet, warm mustard over direct medium heat until it begins to bubble. Add chicken pieces and cook slowly for about 5 to 7 minutes per side or until browned and juices run clear. Add yellow pepper rings and heat through. For the sauce, in a microwave safe container or bowl, combine tomato and green chilies, cream and sage. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stirring twice. Place 1/3 cup cream in a shallow dish. Dip chicken pieces into cream mixture coating evenly. Place coated chicken in microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Turn chicken pieces, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and cook on high for 1 to 2 minutes more. Drain excess cream from dish. In a large serving bowl, combine thawed blueberries and thawed sweetened fruit. Spoon half the sauce over chicken and sprinkle with sage.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,plain yogurt,tomato green chile pepper,creole seasoning,bay leaf,taco seasoning mix,ramen noodle,flour tortilla
title: Lazy Night Tacos
ingredients: 1 package dry taco seasoning mix | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning, or to taste | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon crushed bay leaves | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 10 flour tortillas | 24 ramen noodles
instructions: Combine taco seasoning mix, yogurt, creole seasoning, cumin seeds and crushed bay leaves in a bowl and stir until completely dissolved. Place about 1 tablespoon of the tomato sauce in the bottom of a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir to blend the taco seasoning mixture and simmer for about 10 minutes or until reduced by half. Heat 1/4 inch of water in a skillet over medium high heat. Place a few tortillas in the pan and fry them on both sides until both sides are browned. Add 1 tablespoon of the taco sauce and stir until heated through and the sauce thickens. Place 2 remaining tortillas over the taco mixture and top with 1/4 cup of the tomato sauce. Repeat with rest of the tortillas.

title: Apple-Rum Punch
ingredients: 2 fuji apples | 1/4 cup light rum
instructions: Peel apples and cut into bite sized chunks. Wash rum and combine with apple chunks. Allow to chill for 2 to 3 hours. Serve.

Random Ingredients: black bean,fine breadcrumb,garlic clove,paprika,grain wheat flour,cod,tamarind paste
title: Cod and Black Bean Patties (Breaded Cod Fish)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 minced garlic clove | 1 ounce tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 2 1/4 cups cooked black beans | 1 ounce diced cod | 2 teaspoons fine quality grain wheat flour
instructions: Mix the bread crumbs with the garlic, tamarind and smoked paprika, set aside. Place the beans and cod into a bowl. Add the breadcrumb mixture to the fish and stir to combine. Add the breadcrumbs mixture to the fish, stir to ensure all ingredients are moistened. Shape the mixture into 6 patties. Coat the fish with flour and fry in a pan or on medium heat until cooked. Serve on top of freshly grated cheese and chopped herbs.

title: Grilled Kale Wraps
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons pineapples with juice | 8 flour tortillas | 1 cup hazelnuts, toasted | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: Prepare grill for direct heat and lightly oil the grate. Spread hazelnuts on a work surface and lightly toast under the broiler. Scoop nuts onto a plate to cool and set aside. Place kale in a bowl with pineapple juice and turn over to coat. Cover and refrigerate until leaves soften, about 30 minutes. Preheat grill for direct heat. Place warm tortillas, 2 at a time, on the preheated grill and sprinkle with hazelnuts. Grill until lightly browned, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from grill and sprinkle hazelnuts with salt and black pepper. Spread 2 tablespoons hazelnut mixture on a warm tortilla. Place 2 tablespoons chives on top of hazelnuts. Slice the grilled kale leaves crosswise to 1/3 inch thick pieces and roll into tortillas. Arrange rolled tortillas on a platter and garnish with the remaining 2 tablespoons fresh chives. Serve hot.

title: Elegant Stock from Scratch
ingredients: 4 stalks lemongrass | 2 teaspoons dried savory
instructions: Trim and separate stalks from root ends. Cut lemongrass off stems. Cut savory roots into 1 to 1 1/2 inch lengths. Cut ginger root into strips. Wash and rinse the stalk thoroughly under cold water. Tie each stalk with kitchen twine. Place in a shallow pan or pan, and rub with savory and other spices. Cover with cold tap water. Cover and cook over low heat for 2 1/2 hours or until liquid has reduced to about half. Remove leaves from liquid and serve at once.

title: Sweet and Spicy Calves of Zucchini with Herbs
ingredients: 8 zucchini, unpeeled cut into 1-inch chunks ( about 3 pounds ) | 8 parsnips, peeled cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon dried onion salt | 1/2 cup instant bisquick | additional fresh parsley, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Transfer a large baking sheet with kitchen shears, letting excess hang over edges of the foil. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Add zucchini, parsnip, vegetable broth, lemon peel and onion salt.

title: Farfalle With Butternut Squash and Roasted Squash
ingredients: 1 quart broth | 2 cups cubed butternut squash | 1/2 lb farfalle pasta, uncooked, preferably tubetti | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Pour broth and squash into a medium size sauce pan. Boil until squash is tender. Meanwhile, cook farfalle according to package directions omitting butter and salt. Drain farfalle and transfer to a large bowl. Add flour and stir til a ball forms. Turn the dough out onto a floured board and knead for 1 - 2 minutes. Dough should be soft but still slightly tacky. If dough seems sticky, add water a tablespoon at a time. Shape dough into a round. Heat oven to 375°f. Add squash to baking pan.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,swiss cheese,beef stock,tomato green chilies,pasta,banana leaf,oil,fennel seed
title: Chile Cheese Ravioli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 6 ounces dried chilies, crushed, divided | 500 g swiss cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 500 g hot beef stock | 3 ounces pasta sheets ( thin ) | 1 banana leaf, torn ( about 10cm long )
instructions: Put oil, fennel seeds and 1/4 tsp chilies in a medium saucepan over medium high heat and warm, stirring often, for 1 minute or until aromatic but not burned. Add 1/2 grated swiss cheese and stir until melted. Add 1/4 cup beef stock and bring to boil. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, for about 1 minute. Season with extra salt and pepper to taste. Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water for 8 minutes or until just tender. Drain and transfer to an attractive serving dish. Pour the sauce overtop and serve with additional cheese.

title: Chocolate, Nut and Wine Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons chocolate hazelnut spread ( nut and chocolate hazelnut spread ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.

title: Asparagus in Spicy Mustard and Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 3 cardamom pods, cracked | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Bring water to a boil over high heat in a large skillet. Add the tips of asparagus spears and asparagus and cook until asparagus is tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the msg and cardamom pods. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Ricotta Dip  (No Egg)
ingredients: 2 lbs evaporated milk ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup finely chopped onion ( about ) | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios
instructions: Dump contents of ricotta container into a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,taco seasoning,italian salad dressing,red swiss chard
title: Swiss Chard Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 bunches italian swiss chard | 1 package taco seasoning, blend | italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 - 1 1/2 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Remove leaf portions from chard and finely chop the stems. Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the swiss chard stems. Rinse the leaves and dry them by dropping them into a colander and gently pat dry with paper towels. Combine the chard stems, taco seasoning, bread crumbs, and salad dressing. Spread the mixture into 12 - 12 shallow sandwich buns.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,raspberry,yeast,lima bean,plain yogurt,sirloin,chipotle chile,corn tortilla
title: Beef-And-Raspberry Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile ( minced ) | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 cup frozen lima beans, thawed | 1 cup frozen raspberries, thawed and patted dry | 12 corn tortillas | plain yogurt
instructions: Crumble yeast into a bowl and set aside to soften. Heat cream, chipotle chilies and sirloin in a large skillet for 5 minutes or until beef is cooked through. Transfer to a bowl, turn to coat and cool slightly. Stir in the lima beans and raspberries. Warm tortillas until warm. Spread half of the beef and beans mixture on half of each tortilla and top with yogurt and toppings.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,maple syrup,cream chicken soup,swiss chard,serrano pepper,tortilla,asafoetida powder,plantain
title: Creamy Plantain Chapati
ingredients: 2 medium plantains | 6 tablespoons cream of chicken soup, canned | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped swiss chard, plus additional | swiss chard, for garnish garnish | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1 tortillas, for burritos
instructions: Peel the plantains, cut ends off, and cut at the same 1/4 inch intervals and lengthwise. Cut the plantain crosswise into chunks, about 5 to 6 inches long and 1 inch wide. Combine the soup with the maple syrup in a skillet, add the serrano, and bring to a boil. Cook 3 to 5 minutes until the serrano is soft. Remove from the pan and add the asafetida, chard, and flour. Mix thoroughly. Cook until thickened and creamy. If desired, garnish with the reserved swiss chard. Warm the tortillas in oven or in a skillet over medium heat. Spoon about 3 tablespoons of the soup mixture into the center of each tortilla. Then add about 1/2 teaspoon of bread crumbs or as needed. Roll and tuck the chard under, and serve.

title: Mexican Party Rocks (Pixie Pop)
ingredients: 10 cloves, peeled | 4 cups fresh ice | 3 1/2 cups fresh lime juice | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine cloves, ice, and lime juice in a blender.

Random Ingredients: rose water,prosciutto,taco seasoning mix,red enchilada sauce,salt pepper,zucchini blossom,cottage cheese,baby carrot
title: Mexican Vegetable Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 2 zucchini blossoms | 4 baby carrots | 4 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce, mild | 3 tablespoons low fat cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon rose water | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In a medium bowl combine all ingredients. Transfer to a large casserole dish. Bake 30 - 45 minutes or until hot and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,butter,coriander root,cheddar cheese,coconut cream,serrano chile,chocolate chip,grain rice
title: Chiles Con Coco (Rice With Coconut and Chocolate)
ingredients: 200 ml of coconut cream | 150 g good quality coconut cream | 200 g long grain rice | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 75 g mature cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon butter | 3 -4 serrano chilies | 1 tablespoon desiccated coriander roots
instructions: In a pan, pour the coconut cream, coconut cream, rice and bicarb soda. Cook on low heat until the rice is cooked, around 20 minutes. When cooked, stir in grated cheese, and keep on very low heat until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. In a different pan or skillet, add some butter and when it melts, add the chilies, desiccated coriander roots and let them cook on medium heat, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, add the mixture to the cooked rice. Cut chilies into strips when soft.

title: Homemade Polish Sausage
ingredients: 3 white sweet onions | 3 bottles ketchup
instructions: Slice the onions in half lengthwise. Sprinkle the entire onion slices with the ketchup. Place the onion slices into a small mixing bowl. With wet hands, mix everything together and leave in the refrigerator for at least one hour. If you want to serve the sausage at the end of christmastime, place the onion slice under a hot broiler for just a minute or two before putting it into the oven to brown it. If desired, serve with poultry, meat dishes, and fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: gnocchi,english mustard,ham hock,pineapple juice,sherry wine vinegar,rye flour
title: Swedish Ham Bock With Pineapple Mustard
ingredients: 2 lbs english ham hocks | 4 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons rye flour | 1 package fresh gnocchi
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the rice gnocchi. Set aside. In a large skillet, heat up the pineapple juice and vinegar. Add the ham hocks and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes. Remove the ham hocks from the skillet and brown the inside of the pot, in batches so it doesn't stick. Transfer the ham to a small platter to rest. In the same skillet add the sherry and mustard to the pan in which the ham was browned. Slice the meat and add to the pan along with the crème fraîche, stir to combine, place over medium heat. Once the sauce has begun to bubble, reduce the heat, and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes. Preheat the broiler. Cut the gnocchi into 3 or 4 inch lengths, and submerge them in plenty of boiling water to prevent them from sticking together. After five minutes stir the gnocchi, making sure the gnocchi is not sticking all the way to the bottom, and place on a baking sheet. Broil the gnocchi until crisp, and then remove them from the oven, and let cool a few minutes. Transfer the cooked ham to a serving platter while they cool a bit. Cut the ham into 1 inch cubes, and serve them alongside the cooked gnocchi.

title: Ethiopian Flat Bread
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Whisk the flour into the bell pepper, cardamom powder, and salt in a bowl until thoroughly blended. Add more flour if needed to make a stiff dough. Turn the dough out onto a work surface, and cut into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball, and flatten into a 2 inch circle. Place the flattened bread round onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Score into 2 inch squares with a knife, or press into the scored squares lightly to make a 3 inch square. Bake in the preheated oven until evenly browned, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,spanish onion,white wine,marsala wine,green cardamom pod
title: Fried Onions
ingredients: 6 ounces spanish onions, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 4 green cardamom pods, split | 1/2 cup flour tortilla, cut into fourths
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f place onion slices in 2 quart casserole and bake, uncovered, turning slices once, until deep golden brown and slightly charred, about 15 minutes. Arrange onions in single layer in single layer in large baking dish. Combine wine and next 3 ingredients in small bowl and pour half over onions. Cover and bake until onions are tender and liquid evaporates, about 2 hours. Serve with tortilla.

title: Spicy Spicy Beef on the Barbie
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs red potatoes | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat grill. Slice potatoes 1/2 thick. Place them in a large bowl with the chili flakes. Use a fork to poke each potato all over. Pour oil into a non stick frying pan. Sprinkle with the chili flakes. Cook on both sides or until potato is tender and crisp. Remove from heat and allow to set. Serve in a bowl.

title: Mandy's Excellent Basic Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs italian tomatoes | 4 green cardamom pods
instructions: Wash whole tomatoes and cut in half lengthwise. Take one tomato and take out seeds and the hard skin. Set aside. Put the tomatoes in a large pot with water to cover. Heat to a boil, skimming the scum with a spoon as it rises to the surface. Lower heat and simmer gently until tomatoes are soft and very easily crushed with a spoon. You may need to adjust water to prevent burning at medium heat. This should take about 1 1/4 hours to thicken slightly. You should have about 1 1/2 cups of liquid left and the liquid should have reduced to about 2 cups total. Discard water. Place cardamom pods in a small skillet and toast until very lightly brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove from pan and set aside. Set the pot over medium heat, add a splash of olive oil and the reserved paste. When well browned, add the drained tomatoes and cook until the liquid evaporates, stirring constantly. You may need to add more water if the mixture becomes to thick. Do this to about half the tomatoes, or you may stir in enough tomato liquid to bring to about half the liquid. Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the consistency of thick tomato sauce is not watery and the sauce is fairly dry. This may take about 45 minutes. Stir in the browned cardamom pods and taste for seasoning. The sauce should be thick, but you may need to cook it about 10 minutes longer.

title: Havana Onion and Pine Nut Tender Beef Roast for 2
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube ( knorr ) | 2 cups pine nuts ( or your favourite nuts, like almonds and hazelnuts )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Open the knorr and crumble finely into the center of the beef. Insert a skewer or other length of beef into the skewer to secure the cube onto the surface of the roast. Insert a knife or other blunt object into the center of the meat to keep the cube completely enclosed. Using a large roasting pan that will fit in to the oven and directly on the floor of the oven, place the roast on a rack in the pan. Put the pan on the floor of the oven. Once the pan has reached the temperature, cover with the kitchen towel. Leave the oven door open slightly so the roast can sit in the oven uncovered while the oven is preheating. Once the door is open, use a paring knife to carefully lower the roast in the pan. Carefully remove the meat onto a platter. Let stand for 10 minutes before carving into desired serving sizes. Serve.

title: Mexican Flag
ingredients: 3 canned mandarin oranges | 2 cans tomato puree | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. Pour into a dehydrator friendly container and set a few inches below the hot level of the oven. Every oven setting is different and different so the cooking time and setting are not exact.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,onion,pearl barley,soy sauce,dark chocolate,ricotta cheese,shallot
title: Beef Barley Risotto With Mushrooms (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 1 kg extra lean ground beef | 2 medium onions | 300 ml low sodium ricotta cheese | 80 g dark chocolate | 80 g pearl barley ( gluten-free ) | 3 shallots ( gluten-free ) | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Heat the 1 litre water in a pan. Saute the sliced onion until lightly browned. Stir the mushrooms. When done, drain the water. Combine the beef, chopped onion, ricotta, chocolate, barley and shallots in a bowl. Once the water has almost reached half the boil, add the beef and mix well. Once the meat has been added, stir the contents of the bowl in until well combine. Serve warm with sweet potato chips or toasted bread rolls.

title: Lobia (Ethiopian Potatoes)
ingredients: 7 small baby potatoes | 3 lbs small turnips | 6 lbs fresh corn ( kasha ) | 12 prunes, dried | 1 lb ground pork | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes and turnips place in colander. Add 10 - 15 cups water and salt to boiling pot and cook over heat on range for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender, stirring half way through cooking. While potatoes and turnips are cooking peel and cut up kasha, if using fresh corn bring to boil in large covered saucepan, cover and remove from heat and let steam off until it's just under way. Drain and set kasha aside. In large fry pan cook ground pork, add mustard and turmeric and mix well, allow to cook for a few seconds with the meat, remove from heat and set aside in large bowl. Cut off root end of turnip, carefully peel and cut into wedges, scoop out pulp and then roughly chop with kasha, add to meat mixture and combine well. Add 1 1/2 2 tbsp of cooking oil to the kasha and cook until it's dark, but not burnt, drain and set aside. Tear off roots of kasha, but keep the pieces about 10 - 12 inches long. Dredge the turnips until crisp, fry in small amount of cooking oil until golden brown all over. Drain on paper towels, serve with kasha, tzatziki sauce.

title: Chipotle Chops
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 2-inch x 2-inch squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place chuck beef in a large roasting pan. Pour enough of the drippings to cover all of the beef. Cover, and bake for 2 hours, or until roast is tender and easy to remove from pan. Add salt to taste after cooking. Place meat on serving platter and let absorb some of the drippings.

title: Garlic Cream Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 3/4 cup garlic paste
instructions: Combine cream, garlic paste and a tablespoon of water in a medium saucepan and cook over medium heat until it thickens. If it gets too thick, pour hot cream into a small metal bowl and stir with wooden spoon to cool it.

title: Greek Chocolate & Olives
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn syrup | 1/4 cup catsup | 12 ounces greek olives, drained ( reserve 1/2 cup of the oil ) | 2 cups yellow squash or 2 cups zucchini, cut in half lengthwise and then cut into 1/8 inch slices | 6 ounces white chocolate, chopped
instructions: Put corn syrup, catsup and 1/2 cup water into saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium heat, stirring often. Add olives and return to boil. Reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer until water has almost evaporated, about five minutes. Remove from heat, stir in chocolate, cover and set aside to cool slightly. Place the squash in a greased 9 x 13x2 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Pour the sauce evenly over the squash and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of olives. Let cool to room temperature or slightly warm room temperature and refrigerate until fully chilled, 5 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,cream mushroom soup,egg noodle,watercress,vegetable oil,red pepper flake,yeast,coleslaw mix
title: Mushroom and Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups baking soda | 1 package dry yeast | 3/4 cup warm water ( not hot ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 cups coleslaw mix, coarsely shredded ( about 15-18 stalks ) | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 8 ounces egg noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Sprinkle baking soda into a small bowl. Make a well in the centre.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,chicken,beef tenderloin,bay leaf,cream chicken soup,green onion
title: Beef, Chicken and Orange Bake
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef tenderloin, cut in 1 inch cubes for a bigger casserole | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1 -2 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced green onions | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the beef cubes in the bottom of a casserole dish. Pour the soup, orange juice concentrate, bay leaf and green onions over the beef. Dot with cheese. Top with the yogurt. Cover and bake for 2 hours, uncover and bake until the beef is nicely browned and tender.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,sage leaf,apricot preserve,lime peel,garlic
title: Dried apricot preserves
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon lime peel | 1/4 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash preserves with a fork. Stir in parsley, lime peel, garlic, and sage. Spread mixture evenly over each small piece of bread and spread to cover. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Turn out onto a serving platter and cut into slices.

title: Ancho Chicken With Prosciutto and Almonds Croutons
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, separated into florets | 12 chicken thighs | 4 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1/2 cup almond meal or 1/2 cup almond flour | 3 small fresh ancho peppers, sliced or 3 small dried anchos, seeded, minced | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cauliflower florets and cook until very tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer the cauliflower to a bowl. Drain the skillet and set aside. Season the thighs with salt and pepper. Arrange the chicken in a single layer in a single layer in the bottom of a roasting pan. Place 1 prosciutto strip, 2 scallions, 3 roasted cauliflower florets, and 1 eggplant or 1 yam on top of the chicken in an evenly spaced layer. Pour 1/3 cup of almond meal over the chicken completely covering the chicken and vegetables. Sprinkle evenly with ancho pepper and black pepper. Top with remaining prosciutto strips and whole eggplant or yam. Bake until meat thermometer inserted in center registers 165 degrees f, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bacon,celery rib,saffron,dark corn syrup,mascarpone cheese,snow pea,basil,chervil
title: Saffron-Glazed Vegetables W- Creamy Saffron Sauce (Or Not!)
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cut in 1/2 inch pieces | 3 large celery ribs, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 2 tablespoons dried chervil | 1/2 tablespoon saffron ( about 1/4 tsp. ) | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 1 lb fresh snow pea ( trimmed, preferably unshelled, cut into large pieces, if desired )
instructions: Cook bacon in large non stick skillet over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 6 minutes. Transfer bacon to paper towel lined plate and drain fat from skillet. Add celery, basil, chervil, saffron & 3/4 cup fat from skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until celery is crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining butter and stir to combine, scraping pan bottom and sides with rubber spatula. Stir in cheese & syrup, season to taste with black pepper & salt if substituting fresh ground pepper. Stir in remaining 3/4 cup fat, 1/3 cup at a time & stir until sauce begins to thicken, about 2 minuets worth. Toss vegetables in remaining 2 tblsp fat. Add snow pea pieces to sauce in pan, toss to coat, and serve.

title: Sesame Roasted Corn and Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup chopped chicken | 1 cup fresh corn kernels or 1 cup frozen corn kernels | 1 cup very hot brewed coffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat oil in a medium, heavy skillet over medium heat. Add chicken and cook, stirring about 5 minutes, until golden brown.
