Transfer chicken to a baking dish and nestle corn on top. Bake about 20 minutes, until chicken is no longer pink inside. Stir in coffee and serve.

title: Spicy Shrimp with Green Pepper
ingredients: 1 pound jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the green bell pepper, and return to a boil. Cook the green pepper until just tender, about 3 minutes, and drain. Mix together the shrimp with the green pepper, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,pork shoulder,olive,straw mushroom,cherry tomato,sugar snap pea,sugar substitute,pickling spice
title: Quick and Easy Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1/3 cup pickling spice | 2 cans straw mushrooms, drained and sliced | salt and pepper | 4 cups baby sugar snap peas | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, quartered | 2 -3 pints ripe olives, halved ( optional )
instructions: Mix the meat, pickling spice, mushrooms, salt and pepper in a plastic bag to marinate for 8 to 10 hours, refrigerated. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread the snap peas and tomatoes onto a cookie sheet covered with parchment paper. Bake for 20 minutes or until crisp and just beginning to blacken. Remove and place on a paper towel to drain. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees. Bake for an additional 10 to 12 minutes or until browned. Spoon vegetables into warmed bowls. Top with meat mixture and top with olive slices. Serve immediately.

title: Caribbean Cantaloupe Wedges
ingredients: 4 cantaloupe, wedges | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 3 cloves, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Arrange cantaloupe wedges in a baking dish. Spoon hot pepper sauce over wedges.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,dhaniya powder,rye bread,vanilla ice cream,topping,tarragon
title: French Toast With Chiffonade & Tarragon Yogurt
ingredients: 10 slices robertson's fat free sourdough rye bread ( toasted, buttered, rye bread should work as well ) | 1/2 cup fat-free yogurt | 2 teaspoons tarragon, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon pureed dhaniya powder | 1/2 cup reduced-fat frozen whipped topping
instructions: Spread the yogurt on the bread slices and top with the tarragon, chile powder and dhaniya powder. Spray a griddle or large skillet with cooking spray, and heat to medium. Place the bread on the griddle, sprinkle evenly with the whipped topping. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,apple liqueur,celery,sherry wine,egg yolk
title: Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup apple liqueur | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2 egg yolks, hard boiled | 1/2 cup chopped celery
instructions: Put the cream of mushroom soup, apple liqueur, sherry, egg yolks and celery in a saucepan and heat just to boiling. Beat the egg whites with a fork for a few moments, then move each piece to a plate. Drop a few boiled egg yolks into the soup and immediately pour the rest over the egg whites. Serve with bread and butter.

Random Ingredients: candy sprinkle,yellow onion,baking potato,mexican cheese,apricot preserve,sherry wine vinegar,sirloin steak,chicken meat
title: A Beef-And-Cheese Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated yellow onion | 3 2 lbs sirloin steaks or 3 lbs round steaks, sliced very thinly | 1 package mexican blend cheese, cut into four 1x1-inch slices | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | chocolate sprinkles ( optional ) or cinnamon sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Coat large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Cut potatoes into quarters lengthwise. With sharp knife, score about 1/4 inch deep, into potatoes, leaving 1/2 inch of potato on bottom. Transfer potatoes to prepared baking sheet. Beat together vinegar and onions until blended. Cut 1/8 of steak lengthwise in half and then across the grain into 1/2 inch pieces. Put cheese slices down center of each potato. Arrange 1/4 of the cheese in a row across steak. Repeat layering with remaining steak, cheese, and steak, ending with cheese. Bake potatoes uncovered in middle of preheated oven for about 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly around edges. Top with preserves and sprinkle with sherry vinegar, if desired, and bake until cheese is slightly browned and potatoes are browned crisp, about 12 - 15 minutes longer. Serve with chocolate syrups or cinnamon sugar.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,allspice,pecan,orange juice zest,grain white rice
title: Orange Rice With Pecans I
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice and zest | 1 cup long-grain white rice | 2/3 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Bring orange juice and orange zest to boil in medium saucepan over high heat. Add rice.

title: Linguine With Zucchini and Raisins
ingredients: 16 ounces uncooked fresh linguine | 1 cup diced zucchini | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/3 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme | 1/3 cup rice wine | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chervil
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling water until almost tender.

Random Ingredients: lamb,pork loin chop,grain rice,grape,ancho chile powder
title: Ancho Red Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb frozen ancho chile powder | 1/2 lb lamb, loin cut into cubes | 1 lb boneless pork loin chop | 2 cups uncooked long grain rice, rinsed according to package directions | 1/2 cup grape or cherry tomatoes, cut in halves
instructions: Cook the chile powder according to package directions. Meanwhile, remove all meat from bones and cut into 1 inch cubes. Rinse chile powder in colander to remove any salt. Add chili to meat & stir, coating meat with chili. Add rice and tomatoes.

title: Pierogies
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water to barely tender, not soft. Drain and toss with cheese. Drop noodles into salted boiling water and boil for a few minutes just until beginning to soften.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,mirin,white hominy,baby arugula,beef chuck,guacamole,vegetable oil cooking spray,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Chipotle Mexican Beef and Hominy Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck or 2 lbs skirt steaks, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup fresh tomatillo, husked | 4 canned chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 2 cans white hominy, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons mirin | 6 cups mixed baby arugula, coarsely chopped | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Toss meat cubes with 1/2 teaspoon salt and set aside. Roast meat in an ovenproof dutch oven or other large skillet, stirring or shaking the pan constantly, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer meat to a plate. Add the tomatillos, chipotles, and half the can of hominy. Bring to a simmer, then transfer mixture to a large bowl. Add chilies, remaining hominy, and mirin and mix. Spread in oiled baking dish and top with half of arugula. Roast until arugula is tender, about 20 minutes. Top with remaining arugula and remaining tomatillo. Serve with guacamole, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,beef roast,cream corn,vidalia onion,roquefort cheese,red onion,kale
title: Roquefort Beef and Kale Dinner
ingredients: 1 bag lacinato kale ( about 8 oz/7.14 oz weight ) | 1 lb beef roast ( fresh or frozen ) | 6 cups of prewashed mixed greens ( such as sorrel, beet, and collards ) | 1 large vidalia onion ( about 1/2-1/3 of a large, whole, red onion ) | 1 cup of vidalia onions or 1 cup other sweet onion ( about 1/4-2/3 of a large, whole, and whole red onion ) | 1/2 cup roquefort cheese ( crumbled ) | 1 can cream-style corn, including the liquid ( or canned or fresh ) | 1 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( about 4-6 )
instructions: To start the night before, place the kale in a colander and transfer to the sink with the rinsed out juice from the bag of kale on the top. Cover the bag with a dish towel to get rid of any moisture. Let sit for about 20 minutes. You want it to dry out, but not too dry. Heat the crockpot to high. Cut the onion into half longways and slice thickly. If your onion is very large, the amount of time required will vary greatly depending on the size. Remove the onion from the crockpot and slice thin vertically or crossways depending on the heat you are using. Add the sliced onions to the crockpot. Pour the frozen kale into the crockpot and stir to coat. If using fresh greens, remove as much as possible from the bag of greens and discard. Add the chopped or chopped cilantro to the greens. If using frozen greens, thaw and drain. Place meat in a large skillet and sear over medium heat until the surface is covered in brown and crisp. Place the meat in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish which has been sprayed with cooking spray, set aside. Pour off any fat from the skillet. Place the meat over the kale mixture in a large bowl or platter. Sprinkle the shredded cheese over meat and top with the cream style corn and cilantro/onion mixture.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,lentil,greek yogurt,bacon,monterey jack cheese,rose water,white bean
title: Lentil and Apple Bake
ingredients: 3/4 cup lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 cans white beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tart apples, chopped or 3/4 teaspoon grated apple, of your choice | 6 tablespoons fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup fat free monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon rose water | 8 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Drain lentils, beans and apples in colander.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,green pea,rib beef,grain rice,lime juice
title: Caribbean Beef Rice With Peas
ingredients: 6 large rib-eye steaks ( about 3 pounds total ) | 1/4 cup lime juice | salt and pepper | 1 package frozen green peas | 2 cups long-grain rice
instructions: Trim all fat from steaks and cut into 6 portions. Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper, and place on a rack in an 8x8 or 9x9 inch pan. Sprinkle peas evenly over steaks and place an even layer of green peas over steaks. Pour on more lime juice, and season with salt and pepper. Cover tightly, and refrigerate several hours or over night. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Bake the rice for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in the preheated oven, or until steaks are just cooked through. Serve steaks immediately.

title: Scones I
ingredients: 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together. Use an ice cream maker to freeze the confectioners' sugar in a bowl. Once they have finished baking, roll the confectioners' sugar in half, then cut them in half again until they are completely covered with sugar. I usually leave them whole. Serve these with ice cream.

title: Spicy Pepper Pasta Shells
ingredients: 1 box jumbo pasta shells | 1 large red bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the jumbo pasta shells, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Place the red bell pepper slices on a microwave safe plate, cover, and cook in the microwave on high power until the peppers are very tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Asparagus Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 16 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 2 cups asparagus, coarsely chopped | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together the asparagus, water chestnuts and vanilla. Brush 1 sheet of phyllo dough with some of the vanilla mixture. Spoon 3 to 4 tablespoons of the asparagus mixture onto the bottom of a lightly oiled 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with the remaining phyllo sheets and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until phyllo is puffed and golden, about 12 to 15 minutes. Cool on a rack. Cut into squares and serve warm. Variation, substitute dried asparagus.

title: Mushroom Vinegar and Beans(For diabetics - Oven Fried Rice)
ingredients: 1 lb bean ( dried or presoaked in hot water for 2 min ) | 2 cups button mushrooms ( thinly sliced ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Soak mushrooms in cold water for 20 mins. Drain thoroughly but keep the rest of the water. Dry the mushrooms and set them aside. Drain the soaking water, then put the mushrooms into a blender or food processor with the vinegar. Add the ginger and process until smooth. Add the strained soaking water back into the blender if its too thick. Mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Add the drained mushrooms and stir until well combined. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: dill seed,maraschino cherry,brown sugar,blueberry,apricot preserve,tomato puree,basmati rice
title: American Flag Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon apricot preserves, heated | 1/2 cup diced tomato puree | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot preserves | 1/4 cup chopped dill seed | 1/4 cup chopped maraschino cherry
instructions: Place rice in a mixing bowl and add 1/2 cup of sugar. Stir until brown and sugar are evenly distributed. Stir in apricot preserves, tomato puree, dill seed, and cherries. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 3 days.

title: Tamarind Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: Place the caraway seed and fajita seasoning mix into a small, dry skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Mix the tamarind paste into the skillet and continue cooking until the sauce is completely heated.

title: Savory Horseradish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients.

title: Spicy Sweet Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry jasmine rice or 1 1/2 cups long grain rice, preferably basmati, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon salt | 4 very long red chilies, seeded and sliced thin crosswise | 2 1/2 teaspoons sweet paprika | 1/2 vanilla bean, split ( optional, see note below )
instructions: Note, chillies may be optional, though it is not recommended. Combine rice, salt, chiles, paprika and vanilla bean in medium saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer for 40 - 50 minutes. Fluff rice with fork and stir. Discard vanilla bean.

title: Cherries Baked in Indian Spices
ingredients: 1 cup cherry soda | 2 teaspoons fresh coriander, leaves only
instructions: Combine sugar and cherry soda in a bowl, stir. Add coriander and stir until sugar dissolves. Spoon into a serving dish, chill until completely soft, then serve.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,japanese eggplant,green apple,sirloin,lemon juice,golden syrup,rhubarb
title: Moussaka (Apple and Rhubarb Stew)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 lbs japanese eggplants, cut crosswise into quarters | 2 lbs rhubarb, cut crosswise into chunks | 4 cups thinly sliced tart apples | 2 cups golden syrup or 2 cups light sweetener | juice of a lemon | 2 cups thinly sliced lemons, including soft pulp
instructions: Place beef, eggplant, rhubarb, apples, golden syrup, lemon juice and lemon juice in crockpot. Cover. Cook on high 4 hours and serve.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,puff pastry,thai red curry paste,farina,vegetable broth,anchovy,plain yogurt,tomatillo
title: Thai Red Spinach Pies
ingredients: 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 -2 tablespoon thai sweet red capsicum, diced | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 400 g spinach leaves | 1 large tomatoes, cored and diced | 200 g puff pastry | 2 tablespoons thai sweet red curry paste | 2 -3 anchovies, chopped
instructions: Heat a non stick pan and cook the curry paste until aromatic. Add the vegetable stock and capsicum and bring to the boil. Reduce heat then simmer 1 minute. Stir in yoghurt then stir in the spinach. Spoon mixture into small ramekins and refrigerate until set. Preheat oven to 200c. Line 2 muffin pans with the pastry. Place two sheets of pastry in each muffin and brush with curry sauce. Bake 20 mins or until golden and risen.

title: Bread Machine Panini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 cups white bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 4 cups bread rounds | 2 1/2 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons fast rising yeast
instructions: Add all ingredients through machine in order listed to your bread machine. Use french crust setting for crust, medium or white. Press start.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,chili garlic sauce,corn oil,vegetable juice,garam masala
title: Simple Indian Corn Chips
ingredients: 8 cups mixed sweet corn chips ( see notes ) | vegetable juice | peanut oil | garam masala | chili-garlic sauce
instructions: The day before baking, place the corn chips in a bowl with enough water to cover, then cover with a cloth and set aside.

Random Ingredients: bean,cream mushroom soup,yellow pepper,chicken breast half,corn oil,pork shoulder,key lime juice
title: Chicken and Pork in Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 8 chicken breast halves, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 1/2 cups canned yellow sweet peppers, chopped | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons key lime juice | 2 cans baked beans
instructions: Heat corn oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Celery in Brandy Sauce (Salat Iz Pomokor)
ingredients: 2 heads celery, diced | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 cup brandy, or as needed
instructions: Place celery and cilantro in a salad bowl. Mince about 2 stalks celery stalk and stir into herb mixture. Stir in brandy and pour in enough brandy to cover the leaves.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate molasses,flour,enoki mushroom,crescent dinner,cucumber,burger crumbles,spring onion,jarlsberg cheese
title: Pomegranate Enoki With Prawns
ingredients: 1 package round crescent dinner rolls | 2 pints pomegranate molasses | 1 lb hamburger prawns | 1 bunch spring onion | 1 package enoki mushrooms | 1 1/2 heads jarlsberg cheese | 6 tablespoons flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine prawns, prawn heads, onions, mushrooms and cheese in large skillet. Sprinkle with flour. Dip hands in olive oil and fry in a pan until cooked through. Roll out crescent roll dough, arrange 1 small portion. Place prawn mixture on top, roll into a 1 inch circle. Put on cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining dough and prawn mixture. Bake in oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until golden. Serve with yoghurt and a salad or pita. Note, if you prefer, use the prawn mixture as an appetizer, or serve on tzatziki bread as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,chicken,vanilla,white vinegar,orange juice,vegemite,lemon peel,ginger garlic paste
title: The Best Marinated Chicken Recipe in the World
ingredients: 500 g chicken | 50 ml white vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon fresh grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup fresh squeezed orange juice | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons vegemite
instructions: Mix together all marinade ingredients and then add chicken breasts. Marinade in refrigerator for 1 hour or longer. Grill or fry chicken until brown. Serve with sauce poured over the top.

title: French Baked Sole With Swiss Chard and Guacamole
ingredients: 2 sole fillets | 1 bunch swiss chard, tough stems and leaves washed, tough stems and leaves picked, with any tough stems cut on stems cut on stems left in tact | 1/3 cup guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Lay one sole fillet on top of the other on the baking sheets in a circular, 13 inch by 16 inch rectangle, about 1/2 inch thick. Place swiss chard leaves, tough stems and leaves on top of sole. Lightly spoon guacamole evenly over the chard. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily with a fork, about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,red chile pepper,currant,chinese five spice powder,rose water
title: Chinese Lentils and Currants
ingredients: 3 cups brown lentils, rinsed and picked over ( mung beans ) | 1 tablespoon dried currants | 1 dried red chile pepper, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons red chile-flavored dried rose water | 2 tablespoons chinese five-spice powder ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils, currants, chile pepper, garlic, rose water, and chile powder in a large bowl. Toss until coated. Cover, and place into refrigerator to chill. Break each chile pepper into 4 pieces, and press with the flat side of a teaspoon to release the seeds and heat through. Gently stir occasionally.

title: Okra Walnut Stacks
ingredients: 3 cups okra, chopped | 1 cup italian blend shredded cheese | 1/4 teaspoon rum extract | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf, minced | 1 dash dried oregano | freshly ground walnut halves, for garnish
instructions: Combine okra, cheese, rum extract, basil, and oregano in a medium bowl. Spoon into greased pie plate. Sprinkle top with walnut halves, pressing slightly to coat. Cover with foil. Chill for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake in the deep center of preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden.

title: Japanese Sour Cherries
ingredients: 1 kg sour cherries | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 jalapenos, sliced | sriracha sauce
instructions: Remove the stems from the cherries, cut in half and remove the stone inside. Wash them, remove the pits, and place in a bowl with the remaining ingredients. Stir until all the cherries are covered with the sauce. Cover and leave overnight. Place the cherry pieces in a large bowl with some of the remaining sauce if desired and serve as a side dish in a rice dish with the sour cherry as a garnish.

title: Nana Beeton's Christmas Cranberry 'cranberry'Eggs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 large free-range egg | 2 tablespoons dried bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon brown sugar ( heaped )
instructions: Place the dried cranberries in a medium bowl, add 1/3 cup cold water, and allow them to soak for about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, crack the egg into a small bowl, add the breadcrumbs and sugar and mix. Drain the cranberry mixture from the water with a slotted spoon and put them in a large mixing bowl with the egg, cranberry mixture and the remaining cold water, mixing with your hands so that everything is really well combined. Divide the mixture into 4 smallish portions and shape into large egg sized ovals. Place onto a tray and refrigerate until firm, at least 5 hours or overnight. Pre heat the oven to 350°f. Bake the eggs for about 20 - 25 minutes, or until just set and lightly golden around the edges. Serve with melted butter and extra cranberry flavored syrup.

title: Rice Pot Sticker Cookies
ingredients: 2 -3 cups cooked ditalini pasta, drained ( about 8 ounces, to your discretion ) | 3 tablespoons dried spices ( ditalini, oregano, chile, etc. ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Fill a colander with cold water and in this water drop one tablespoon of the rice vermicelli from a measuring cup into the colander, it should be just slightly moist and gooey enough to hold the noodles together when the cookie breaks apart while they are baking. Drain the noodles and drop them into a bowl of cold water to soak while they are waiting for the water to boil. When the water is boiling, put the noodles in the boiling water to cook, drain thoroughly and repeat till you are able to handle the noodles. While waiting for the water to cook add the 1 teaspoon ditalini spice, 1 teaspoon mace and the 1/2 teaspoon dried mace to the noodles. You will need about a cup. Once the water is at a boil drop a cup full of the noodles into the bowl of noodles and mix thoroughly. If the noodles are too wet add 1 tablespoon of cold water and knead the bowl. Remove the bowl with the noodles immediately from the heat. Drop a teaspoon full of the rice vermicelli mixture into the boiling water, it will look curdled and the noodles will have a more vibrant red color.

title: Stewing Beef
ingredients: 1/2 kg stewing beef, cut into thick slices ( i use chuck steaks ) | 8 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder or 6 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Fry the beef in oil till brown. Add soya sauce and cook for 5 minute. Cover and cook 10 min over low heat on low heat. Serve with rice of your choice and boiled rice of your choice.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,corn oil,ginger,cheese,olive oil,cilantro leaf,chicken breast half
title: Quick and Easy Scallops in Lemon Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into slivers | sea scallops | 1/2 cup grated cheese, divided | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix olive oil, ginger, and corn oil. Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,cake flour,sunflower seed,topping,iceberg lettuce,parmesan cheese
title: The Great Reese Sandwich
ingredients: iceberg lettuce | 1 -2 slice rye bread or 1 -2 slice pumpernickel bread | softened butter and spread | whipped topping | 4 thin slices swiss cheese ( i use the deli type ) | 1 2 small cups sifted cake flour | 10 -15 coarsely chopped sunflower seeds
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce. Cut it into wedges. Wear apron. Spread butter on rye and pumpernickel bread. Place a slice of cheese on top. Add a little softening butter to sandwich. Next top with lettuce leaves on top. Toasted sesame seeds are a wonderful garnish on top for this quick sandwich.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,tiger shrimp,black bean,zucchini,coriander seed,vanilla essence,horseradish,chunky salsa
title: Spiced Black Bean Zucchini Dip
ingredients: 350 g small zucchini | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 teaspoon dried shrimp | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 140 g thick chunky salsa | 140 g chopped fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 180 g black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place the zucchini, coriander seeds, rosemary, shrimp, and essence in a large bowl. Toss well and set aside for 15 minutes. Place the salsa and coriander in a bowl. Add the bean and toss well. Add the zucchini mixture. Gently stir to mix. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes for flavours to develop. Serve topped with extra coriander and black beans.

title: Fresh Fajita Cucumber Salad  (Yogurt Free)
ingredients: 4 medium cucumbers ( i used medium and used a little over 1/4 medium ) | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon ketchup or 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Cut off the ends of the cucumbers, peel and cut the length length into thick slices. Discard the ends of the cucumbers and cut the slices in half. Place the cucumbers in a glass bowl. Add the lime juice, ketchup, chili sauce and cayenne to the bowl. Stir well to mix and set aside. Cover and chill for 2 to 4 hours. Serve immediately.

title: Faux Curd Chocolate Eggplant
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 container sour cream | 250 g milk chocolate ( e.g.cocoa ) | 1 lime, quartered
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place eggplant on a baking tray and place in the oven, or microwave until softened. Set aside. Slice eggplant into thin slices. Sprinkle with coriander and spread thinly across the eggplant. Whip the sour cream with your hands until smooth and creamy. Place the eggplant on top of the sour cream, then spread the coriander mix evenly over the eggplant. Sprinkle with the chocolate, then top with slices of lime. Bake in oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Iranian Lamb Skewers
ingredients: 12 small lamb, cut into thin 1/2 inch long chunks | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon dried chili
instructions: Place lamb between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound with a meat pounder to 1/4 inch thick. Spread mayonnaise over meat, then sprinkle with dried chile. Make slits in meat with a sharp knife. Wrap skewers in foil.

title: Cajun Marinade for Beef
ingredients: 1 cup soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Mix all over cooked sliced meat. Marinade your favorite meat for 1 hour or longer.

title: Greek Gigantes Plaki (Greek Vegetarian Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons greek yogurt ( i prefer natural ) | 3 tablespoons fat free greek yogurt or 3 tablespoons vegan yogurt ( i prefer natural ) | 1/4 lb ground meat | 3 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/8 cup tomato, diced | 1/8 cup canned white beans, drained and rinsed | 1/8 cup gorgonzola, crumbled | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients and let sit in the refrigator for an hour to allow the flavors to blend. If you are using the yogurt, mix well before serving. Note, if making the kefalotiri as i do, the gorgonzola has a better texture but any greek cheesiness can be substituted for the gorgonzola.

title: Egg Drop Nests
ingredients: 6 large egg whites, lightly beaten | 12 large kite string | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded mexican blend cheese | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine beaten egg whites, kite string and cheese in mixing bowl. Stir in lettuce. Line 2 large oven safe serving dishes with foil. Drop mixture by spoonfuls onto foil. Bake 10 to 15 minutes until eggs are cooked but not dry. Serve by placing nests on platter and garnish with salsa.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,lettuce leaf,whipping cream,cointreau liqueur,cremini mushroom,black dal,hot paprika
title: Dal Stacks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 tablespoons chopped black dal | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and finely shredded - or more to taste | 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | 1/2 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | 3/4 cup thinly sliced cremini mushrooms, or to taste | 1/4 cup thinly sliced lettuce leaves | 3/4 teaspoon hot paprika
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons whipping cream in a bowl over hot water in the microwave on medium to high power until hot, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Stir half of the dal and apple into whipped cream. Stir half of the cointreau into whipped cream. Stir remaining dal, apple, and cointreau into whipped cream mixture. Heat 1/4 cup cointreau in microwave on high power about 30 seconds to 1 minute. Stir mushroom into whipped cream mixture.

title: Quick and Easy Italian Sausage Wraps (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 medium steak, cut into strips about 1-inch long ( or any meat cut of your choice ) | 12 lasagna noodles | 1 jar sauerkraut | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | 4 tablespoons tamari, divided
instructions: Prepare the meat strips. Place the meat strips into the bottom of your crock pot. Put one or a few strips of meat on top of the meat. Do not overlap the meat. Spread a small amount of sauerkraut and about a tablespoon or 2 tblsp. Of tamari on the meat. Place in your crock pot and turn on high. Cook for about 3 hours or until the meat is thoroughly cooked and the sauerkraut is very tender.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,garlic crouton,onion powder,muscovado sugar,pork shoulder
title: Memere's Italian Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into one inch cubes | 4 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/4 cups muscovado sugar | 2 tablespoons onion powder | additional pinches of garlic croutons
instructions: Bread the pork in flour on a plate. I find that it does a lot of stretchiness so i always end up putting the whole pile into an 8x8 pan and slice it into thin diagonal slices approximately 1/4 thick. You can do this if you want but i use an electric chopstick to get a small chunk of the meat and push the meat through. Put in medium size bowl. In a saucepan, get all of the seasoning and sugar in, add 1/4 cup of water and 1 1/2 tbsp of oil. Make sure sugar dissolves to get the right consistency but make sure you dissolve any lumps. Bring mixture to a boil and then reduce heat to a simmer. Do not cook more than 15 minuets to an hour or it will be too thick. Remember the gravy is supposed to be thick but you can always turn it down to a sauce consistency. If you need to add water, cook a little longer. Soy sauce is mainly to color the sauces. If you have leftover gravy, i suggest to have this over night if you are in a hurry. When the gravy is ready to eat, pull apart the meat slightly with your fork and pour into soup bowls. Serve with toasted mini muffin cups or fresh bread slices.

title: Quinoa Stovetop - Microwave Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 white onion, small | 1 package chicken wings | 1 cup quinoa | 1 large white onion, large for the glaze
instructions: Microwave whole onion on high power for 2 – 3 minutes, until translucent. Add quinoa, chicken wing bones and stir. Microwave on high power until chicken is cooked, approximately 7 minutes. Let stand until chicken is cool enough to handle.

Random Ingredients: pouring cream,mushroom,sesame seed,rice vinegar,star anise pod,ladyfinger,cheddar cheese
title: Scrumptious Hot Mushroom Dessert
ingredients: 6 large whole star anise pods | 6 -10 sprigs fresh mushrooms, stemmed and cleaned ( optional ) | 8 large ladyfingers ( approx ) | 1 cup whipping cream ( i've also used non-fat plain yogurt ) | 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons coarsely sesame seeds ( not ) | 1 -3 tablespoon rice vinegar ( depending on how tart you want it ) | sour cream, a few tablespoons ( optional )
instructions: Place star anise pods and mushrooms in a small saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cover and poach gently for one or two minutes until aromatic, then remove from heat. Drain mushrooms, reserving water, then chop finely. Place 4 or 5 of the soaked mushrooms into a food processor and chop roughly. Place soaked mushroom chunks in the bowl with the water, remaining soaking water from the mushroom soaking. Reserve in a bowl. Place 5 or 6 of the soaked sprigs of sesame seeds in another bowl. Place remaining sprigs of sesame seeds in food processor and pulse coarsely. Pour the cooking liquid into this sieve, and stir in grated cheese and set aside. Bring pan of water to simmer. Dip the ladyfingers in the beaten cream and place them on a plate as your guests are being prepared for this entrée. Place 1 or 2 soaked mushroom pieces and 1/2 cup of the shredded cheese into the center of each warm, slightly flattened side of each warmed dinner plate. Pour about 1 tablespoon rice vinegar into the empty side of the pan of water left, and stir to dissolve. Pour the vinegar over the top of each serving of the cooked mushrooms, and sprinkle remaining cheese over the top. Serve immediately. Note, i have never had the problem of making this in advance, and had it the first time i made the hot mushrooms for the holidays and assembled them as instructed.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,farfalle pasta,white onion,head garlic,black bean
title: Garlic Black Bean Noodle With Farfalle
ingredients: 7 cups cooked black beans | 1/2 white onion, diced | 1/2 small head of garlic, peeled and finely chopped | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 pound farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Cook the farfalle according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool slightly. Chop the onion and garlic. In a large pot over medium heat, combine the cooked beans, onion, garlic, and sugar. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Add more sugar to taste. Continue cooking 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add farfalle and return to a boil. Cook 5 to 8 minutes, or until tender. Drain pasta and toss with hot bean mixture.

title: Easy Cheese Toast With Bacon
ingredients: 1 slice thick cut white bread | crumbled bacon
instructions: Cut a piece of cheesecloth like a burrito by cutting out the ends about 1 inch in diameter. It takes about 10 minutes per side. Take the bacon slice and spread the bacon fat all over the bottom slice. Spread the crumbled bacon pieces over the bacon fat, covering the entire top of the slice. Wrap the top of the piece of cheesecloth in foil. Set onto the baking tray covered with foil. Bake for 40 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit. Eat warm. Variations, for a crispier taste, bake the bacon with the cheese instead of the bacon. Variations from vegetarian to pork lovers, omit bread and cheese. Instead of bacon, you can use fresh bacon or other cooked meat.

Random Ingredients: ham hock,beef gravy,chicken thigh,canadian bacon,oriental sesame oil,orange bell pepper
title: Soy and Bacon Chicken
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 6 bone-in chicken drumsticks ( can use bone in ham ) | 6 slices canadian bacon | 6 slices orange bell peppers ( can use red pepper ) | 1 jar beef gravy ( or homemade gravy if you wish ) | 1/2 cup oriental sesame oil | 1/2 lb ham hock
instructions: Place all ingredients in bottom of crock pot. Top off with about 3/4 of the beef gravy. Cook on high for 6 hours. I know it sounds like a long time but it's all worth it. Use leftover gravy to make a sauce in pan. Heat sesame oil over medium heat. Take meat out of crock pot and cut in chunks if using. Add meat back into pan and cook about 10 minutes longer. Stir meat, peppers, and gravy to reheat for about 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,cider vinegar,banana liqueur,prosciutto,beef bouillon cube
title: Crock Pot Barbecued Bananas
ingredients: 5 beef bouillon cubes | 3 slices prosciutto | 1/2 onion, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup prepared banana liqueur
instructions: Place bouillon cubes in crock pot. Mix prosciutto with sliced onions, add, vinegar and banana liqueur. Stir. Cover. Cook on low 12 hours or high 2 hours.. Remove bouillon cubes in crock pot.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,mini chocolate chip,orange zest,curd,mini marshmallow,almond extract,monterey jack cheese
title: Gobbled Mini Mexican Mushrooms with Oranges
ingredients: 1 lb large mushroom, such as oyster mushroom, shiitake or 1 lb green mushroom, such as shiitake | 1/2 cup small curds | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup mini marshmallows | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place mushrooms on a sheet of foil. In a small bowl, combine the curds, orange zest and tomato puree and whisk until well combined. Spread over the mushroom caps, leaving about 1/4 inch of space for each mushroom. Place the marshmallows on another sheet of foil. Using a vegetable peeler, shave the mini marshmallows onto the mini marshmallows. Sprinkle generously over the top of each mushroom. Divide the cheese evenly among the mushrooms. Place on a broiler pan and broil until nicely browned, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Vanilla
ingredients: 1/4 cup cinnamon | 3 tablespoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a blender until well blended to form a thin frosting. Store in airtight container.

title: Garden Fresh Tahini Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini and oregano. Serve.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,thyme,liquid smoke,nonfat milk,beer,lemon zest,pesto sauce,cumin
title: Liptauer Beer (Belgian Wheat Beer)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk ( or skim milk ) | 5 tablespoons lowfat pesto sauce ( or olive oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry thyme | 1/2 - 1 1/2 cup beer ( your favourite such as a budweiser ) | 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Using a large measuring cup, stir together milk, pesto, cumin, lemon rind, and thyme. Add beer if using, and stir thoroughly. Cover pot and freeze overnight. At the end of freezing, transfer beer to baking sheet lined with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat. Allow to sit at room temperature for 3 - 4 hours until it has expanded and darkened. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake beer at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until it is bubbly and dark with a thick, grainy color. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Strain beer through a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth lined sieve. Stir to blend. Allow to cool, stirring and refrigerate overnight. You can use a fine mesh strainer to transfer beer to bottles, give bottles a shake, and then store for up to 1 month. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,pasta shell,cheddar cheese,sea salt,vinegar,red wine,cherry
title: Celery Pasta Bowl
ingredients: 1/3 cup celery rib, chopped | 1/3 cup red wine or 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon red wine or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon sea salt | 16 ounces medium pasta shells, cooked | 1 package frozen sour cherry, sliced ( thawed and excess liquid squeezed out ) | 2 cups cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients together in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,rigatoni pasta,olive oil cooking spray,egg yolk,oil black olive,turkey breast,tilapia fillet
title: Italian Style Turkey and Tilapia With Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turkey fillets, chopped into 1/4 inch pieces | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta ( about 1 cup or so ) | 8 ounces tilapia fillets or 8 ounces tuna steaks, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 medium yellow red peppers or 1 medium orange pepper, sliced into thick strips | 8 large eggs | 8 oil-cured black olives, pitted and sliced | 8 oil-cured black olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Set oven mitts down to 425°f line a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Spray pan with olive oil cooking spray. Spread meat and cooked pasta in prepared dish. Combine fish, pepper and remaining dip ingredients. Pour mixture over top in baking dish. Sprinkle with sliced olives. Cover top with foil. Bake until fish is cooked through and pasta is tender, about 30 - 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,mozzarella cheese,pumpkin seed,scallion,baby spinach,dark brown sugar
title: Wild Rice Spinach
ingredients: 1 box uncle bill wild rice | 4 cups baby spinach | 1/3 cup pumpkin seeds, toasted | 1/3 cup scallion, sliced | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to in a large pot bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add rice and stir, let cook for about 10 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat, drain well and place in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Rinse the spinach well under running water so as to squeeze out the water and dry leaves.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,thyme,beef chuck roast,string bean,beef roast,wine vinegar,sage leaf,chive
title: Beef and Beans
ingredients: 4 lbs beef bones with marrow | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 3 -4 tablespoons dried thyme | 5 tablespoons dried chives | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 -2 lb beef shoulder, cut into pieces | 2 lbs string beans ( the small ones )
instructions: Using a sharp knife and a heavy blanching knife, carefully slit off the dark bone from the marrow bone. Rinse well. Place bones and marrow in a large pot and add cold water just enough to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer until the marrow is very tender, about 2 hours. When it reaches an internal temperature of 140 degrees f, remove marrow, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. Using a skimmer, skim fat from the meat. Drain and remove pot from heat. Remove the marrow marrow and bones from the pot. Place beef and reserved cooking liquid in a kettle. Cover and simmer over low heat, stirring often, 2 hours or until meat is very tender. Skim fat from cooking liquid. Drain meat and vegetables. Stir in herbs. Reheat gently and cook 2 or 3 minutes. Stir in 1/2 cup reserved cooking liquid. Season to taste, adding more cooking liquid if desired. Serve over mashed potatoes or with crusty french bread and crusty french bread, if desired.

Random Ingredients: oregano,kaffir lime leaf,pimiento,icing sugar,pear,jalapeno pepper,soy sauce,peanut
title: Kaffir Lime Jalfrezi
ingredients: 4 ounces pears, ripe, cored, seeded and chopped | 1 can bartlett pears, drained, reserve juice | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 1/2 cup peanuts, roasted unsalted, chopped | 1/4 cup icing sugar, sifted | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 pinch dried oregano
instructions: Combine pear juice, pears, jalapeno peppers, peanuts, sifted icing sugar, soy sauce, lime leaves and oregano in small bowl over high heat until boiling. Reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,red wine vinegar,corn,apricot,italian seasoning
title: Slow Cooker Italian Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, fat trimmed | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 3 cans petite diced tomatoes ( or equivalent ) | 8 ounces frozen corn, thawed
instructions: Combine all ingredients except corn in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 7 - 9 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours.

title: Southwest-Lentils
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs stewing beef ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 container thick & chunky salsa | 1 can lentils, drained ( white or dark kidney beans ) | 1 -2 cup watermelon or 1 -2 cup pineapple, seeded, chopped | 1/2 cup shredded ladyfinger
instructions: Place beef and salsa in a crock pot. Stir to mix. Cover.

title: Ricotta & Szechuan Peppercorns: Ricotta, Yellow Peppers & Elegant Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb ricotta cheese | 1/2 lb yellow pepper, finely chopped | 4 ounces celeriac, very finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
instructions: Preheat a hot broiler. In a large bowl, mix the cheese, pepper, celeriac, sichuan peppercorns & paprika very well. Stir for 1 minute. Roll the mixture into balls of roughly the size and about 2 inches in diameter. Arrange on a rack to cool slightly. Put them in an airtight container & cover tightly.

title: Apple Cheesecake With Lemon Lime Raita
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, baked ( or your own recipe ) | 8 large tart apples, peeled | 3 -4 tablespoons gingerroot, freshly grated | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon ricotta cheese | 1/8 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut the crust into two 1/2 in. Pieces. Cut each half into 3/4 in. Pieces and core the apples. Put half of the apples in the shell of each pastry ring, then the gingerroot, juice and salt. Sprinkle with the remaining apple. Make the lemon lime raita. In a small bowl, mix ricotta cheese with the lime juice with a fork until smooth. Drizzle half into the crust mixture. Press the raita onto the remaining in the crust. Decorate the top with the remaining ginger slices. Bake in center of the oven for about 30 - 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: fig,pizza crust,celery rib,filet mignon,kosher salt,self rising flour
title: Individual Caponata
ingredients: 1 lb unbleached self-rising flour | 1/2 cup unsalted self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 lb filet mignon | 2 small celery ribs, chopped | 2 ounces dried figs, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. In a large bowl sift the self rising flour with the salt. Slice the filets into 1 inch wide ribbons with a sharp knife. Place the steaks into the bowl and toss to coat generously with the flour. Place on a large sheet or shallow baking pan. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, or until cooked through. Remove the steaks to a plate and arrange on a plate. Place the celery and figs on the top of the steaks while also tossing to coat with flour. Serve with pizza toppings such as mozzarella cheese, basil, and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,pearl barley,apple cider vinegar,white pepper,wine vinegar,brandy,lime
title: Barley Pearl Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pearl barley | 2 teaspoons white pepper | 1 cup water | 2/3 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup brandy | 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the barley and pepper in a bowl and rinse well. Return to the pot and cook, covered, over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes, until tender. Drain well and transfer to a bowl. Add the water, apple cider vinegar, brandy, cider vinegar, and parsley. Whisk well and refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours. Let sit at room temperature for 1 - 2 hours to marinate.

title: Cottage Cheese Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 250 g fresh cottage cheese, cubed | 1 cup fresh tomato, diced | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme | 1/2 cup canned button mushrooms ( sliced into halves )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish, cover with foil. Bake at 180 degrees celsius for 35 minutes.

title: Cheese Spoon Sweet
ingredients: 350 g romano cheese, grated | 5 ml cornflour | 4 -5 ml green cardamom pods, seeds from | 5 ml rosemary, crushed | 3 1/2 pints apple juice
instructions: Mix the cheese, cornflour, one teaspoon of rosemary and 2 1/2 pints of apple juice together in a bowl,. Place in a freezer to speed up the process. When the mixture has thickened, press the cheese mixture into a lined, deep, jelly roll tin. Trim and cover with aluminium foil. Bake at 350f for 40mins.

title: Tomato Pear and Belly Tiramis (Elegant Recipe from Elegant Italian Cooking)
ingredients: 2 bottles italian-style tomatoes | 2 bosc pears, sliced | 1 packet ladyfingers ( i prefer king arthur tricolore savoiardi brand )
instructions: Wrap ladyfingers around slice of bosc pears and tie them with cotton kitchen twine. Line a small dish or baking sheet with towels. Drain canned tomatoes, then place all of them into a large, heavy, nonreactive pan. Sprinkle the tops of the ladyfingers with a dry layer of salt and lightly drizzle with about 1 1/2 cups of tomato juice. Cover and cook over low heat until the pears are tender and crisp, 45 - 60 minutes. Serve warm or, refrigerate, and serve cold, on the side of a toasted, crusty loaf of bread which will keep for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,matzo meal,portabella mushroom,cointreau liqueur,pork,heavy cream,mango chutney,hominy
title: Pork-Chicken Mole
ingredients: 12 small portabella mushrooms | 1 1/2 lbs ground pork | 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup dry mango chutney | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur or 2 tablespoons apricot liqueur | 1 1/2 cups matzo meal | 1/3 cup pepsi cotija cheese, crumbled, sprinkled on top of chili
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Remove stems from mushrooms and slice in half. Cut each half in half again lengthwise and remove any coarse bits. In a large skillet melt a little oil over medium heat.

title: Sticky Rice and Seafood Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 bunch fresh basil | 1 quart hoisin sauce | 1/2 a loaf bread | 2 lbs mussels, cleaned | 3 cucumbers, peeled
instructions: Soak the rice in water till soft for at least 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the seafood, using about 1/3 cup of water. Once the rice is soft, chop and mix in the garlic, basil and hoisin sauce. Put in a 9 x 13 dish, cover with foil and warm till warm. When you are ready to eat remove the foil, slice the bread in 1 inch cubes. Arrange on a plate, lay the mussels around the plate, pour the tomato sauce/juices over the top. Top with remaining bread, cucumber and any other toppings you choose.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,basmati rice,pork shoulder,italian dressing
title: Sweet Pork Rice Bowl
ingredients: 3 tablespoons italian dressing | 8 ounces sweet pork shoulder, trimmed of fat | 8 kaffir lime leaves, chopped | 1 cup basmati rice, freshly cooked ( or jasmine rice )
instructions: Stir together the italian dressing and pork in a large bowl. Fold in the lime leaves. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Meanwhile, bring 3 cups of water to a rolling boil. Add rice and stir. Cover and return to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer until the rice is tender, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Serve the pork mixture over the rice.

title: Apple Pan Apples With Caramel Sauce ( Apples De Rhone)
ingredients: 2 -3 medium tart apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced | 12 tablespoons caramel sauce, made with caramels ( i like amore's )
instructions: Lay the apples in a roasting pan. Drizzle caramel sauce over them. Cover and bake in a preheated 350 f oven 60 - 75 minutes or until apples are tender and caramelized.

title: Guava and Apple Mash With Pilsner Beer
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons guava paste ( see guava paste all fruit mashed potatoes ) | 2 tablespoons pilsner beer ( unfiltered ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried mace | 1 medium potato, peeled and finely chopped | 1 small apple, peeled and finely chopped | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: To make the mashed potatoes, melt guava paste in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently until smooth. Don’t let it brown, that’s ok. If you do this, it means that you have stirred the guava into the potatoes to reduce the fat content. Pour guava paste into a medium bowl. Add mashed potato, mace and apple.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,brown mustard seed,chilies,dark sesame oil,chicken stock,turnip,cream mushroom soup
title: Wild Rice Chow Bake
ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 5 ounces turnips, peeled, cut into chunks | 2 chilies, deseeded, deveined and finely chopped | 12 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 3 ounces brown mustard seeds | 7 ounces bean sprouts | brown mustard seeds
instructions: Heat the stock in a pan and add the sesame oil. Add the turnips. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes until almost tender. Stir in the chillies and continue cooking until tender. Blend together the cream of mushroom soup, sugar, mustard seeds and black pepper and stir into the rice. Sprinkle with some mustard seeds.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,jalapeno pepper,panko breadcrumb,pork tenderloin,allspice,grain white rice,onion salt,green bell pepper
title: Spanish Spiced Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork tenderloin | 2/3 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1 dash each allspice | 1 dash onion salt | 1 dash pimento-stuffed jalapeno pepper | 2 tablespoons uncooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Place pork between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound to an even 1/4 to 1/2 inch thickness. Mix the panko crumbs, bell pepper, onion, allspice and onion salt together in a bowl. Dip each pork tenderloin in the rice seasoned with the pimento stuffing. Place pork in a well oiled roasting pan. Insert a skewer through center of tenderloin to give a pocket. Cover and bake in a 375 degree f. Oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven and let stand for 20 minutes before slicing. Sprinkle with additional fresh coarse ground pepper. Serves. Serve with warm homemade corn bread. Note, if the pork does not want to fall off the bone, slice the pork, using a slotted spoon, in 1/4 inch thick slices.

title: Coconut-Heart Healthy Mayo for Fish or Chips
ingredients: 1 iceberg lettuce | coconut milk, for dipping
instructions: Cut the head of iceberg lettuce lengthways in half and shred the stalks using a salad spinner or your hands. Put the shredded lettuce in a serving bowl and drizzle with coconut milk. Serve warm with cold chips or other savoury side dishes.

title: Molho
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger meat ( lean ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt ( to taste ) | 12 rice paper, squares | 2 -3 tablespoons plain extra-strong black pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and form into 1 inch patties. Grill patties about 4 to 6 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through. Serve with additional black pepper.

title: Chinese-Style French Toast
ingredients: 4 slices country bread, or to taste | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons other sweet-hot dry sherry
instructions: Spread one side of each slice of bread with rice wine, then season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,beef roast,nut,bacon,jiffy cornbread mix,granny smith apple
title: Apple Beef Stew With Yoghurt Croutons
ingredients: 1 lb beef roast, trimmed of fat ( i use topside ) | 1 lb granny smith apple ( unpeeled ) | 2 bunches mixed nuts | 1 package jiffy cornbread mix | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 12 slices bacon, crisp and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Prick the beef with a fork several times throughout. Place in a large pan and place over medium heat. Add the apple and nuts and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove beef, remove cover and cook an additional 6 minutes or until meat is brown. Set beef into a plate. To the pan add the cornbread, yoghurt and bacon if using and mix well. Add enough water to moisten the cornbread mixture. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 20 minutes until thickened and crunchy.

title: Cherry, Red and Green Cherry Salad
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup pitted red cherries | 1/2 cup olive
instructions: Pit and pit the cherries. Dry the olives and mix all ingredients together. Enjoy.

title: Beef Rolls
ingredients: 8 beef chuck roast | pepperoni | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 ounce rum | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Combine rum, chili oil, pepperoni slice& cornflour mixture& roll beef. Refrigerate for several hrs&deg.
