ingredients: 8 ounces sweet onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | tamarind paste, diluted with
instructions: Pour the contents of ancho chile into a blender and blend until smooth. Strain through a fine mesh strainer into a small bowl. Sprinkle with salt and stir. Add diluted tamarind to the prepared chile mixture and blend again. Pour into glass serving dish and let cool for at least a half hour or more, at least overnight.

title: Squash Melts
ingredients: 2 medium summer squash, peeled and cut into cubes | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Arrange squash on a baking sheet with sides. Bake in the preheated oven until tender and golden brown, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,tomato,hot green chili pepper,thyme sprig
title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes, coarsely chopped ( about 4 cups ) | 12 fresh hot green chili peppers | 3 medium fresh thyme sprigs | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a large bowl. Slit the green chiles with a vegetable peeler to remove the stems and discard the seeds. Remove the seeds if desired. Fill a blender with the green chile peppers and thyme sprigs. Puree, about 1 minute with a spoon, until smooth. The salsa can be refrigerated or frozen until needed.

title: Chickpeas and Cream
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | salt, pepper to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor blend for 15 seconds. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,thai fish sauce,mango chutney,orange liqueur,sharp cheddar cheese,cayenne pepper
title: Chutney Queses
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh mango chutney | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 dash thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon orange-flavored liqueur | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine chutney, lemon pepper, cayenne pepper, seafood sauce and orange liqueur in a bowl. Add shredded cheese and stir gently. Cover and chill 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine,pork steak,ra el hanout spice mix,black bean,stewing beef
title: Baked Beans With Beef and Pork
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 lb dried black beans, soaked overnight in water to cover by 2 inches | 1/2 lb stewing pork steak, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 -2 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix, heaping | 1/4 cup white wine, sweet, not sweet
instructions: Soak beans in cold water until tender approximately 2 hours.

title: Easy Mexican Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Put pinto beans and taco sauce in a crockpot and cook on high 30 minutes. Turn to low and let simmer for an additional 30 minutes or until desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: caper,white onion,pesto sauce,spanish onion,ginger,herbes de provence,cinnamon swirl bread
title: Saucy Stuffed French Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 6 slices herbes de provence | 6 slices cinnamon-swirl bread | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon ( or cumin ) | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence, chopped ( or cumin ) | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( from above ) ( optional )
instructions: Place onion slices in a colander over a bowl with the herbs and spices and toss to coat. Place bread slices on a flat surface or a large platter and spread with the pesto and herbs.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,green cardamom pod,buttermilk,basil leaf,beef bouillon cube,chickpea,lemon juice
title: Chickpea and Red Bell Pepper Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 large red bell pepper, seeded diced | 3 cups cooked chickpeas | 2 beef bouillon cubes, crushed or 2 beef broth cubes | 3 cups buttermilk or 3 cups low-fat buttermilk | 1/4 cup grated basil leaves
instructions: Heat oil in soup pot. Add green cardamon, red bell pepper and chickpeas. Saute for 5 - 7 minutes. Transfer the soup to a bowl and let it cool. Add 3 broth cubes. Blend or hand stir 3 cups buttermilk and 1/4 cup grated basil leaves in blender. Return the soup to the pan and stir to blend. Heat to serving temperature. Garnish with additional grated parmesan cheese.

title: Prawns (Shrimp) With Kaffir Lime Leaf (Gambas Al
ingredients: 4 kaffir lime leaves | 4 large prawns | 1/4 cup orange zest
instructions: Remove the heads of lime, and the rind as shown in the intro. Place everything except cooking oil in a food processor. Pulse the mixture until it is finely chopped, but still with a few chunks of rind. Add the zest and process for a few seconds. Put it in a saucepan with plenty of water. Add the prawn heads and cook together for 10 minutes, gently smashing any clumps with your fingers to ensure that they don't crack open. Note, you'll be tempted to throw away the heads. Add the zest now. Stir, then simmer until the prawns are cooked. Taste to make sure you'd like your dish as creamy as you would like it. Serve very warm with fish or with plain steamed rice or with boiled new potatoes or steamed brown rice, to dip a little in.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,papaya,hamburger,lemon zest,extra virgin olive oil,salami,quinoa,vegetable broth
title: Quinoa Breakfast Wrap
ingredients: 300 ml vegetable broth | 175 g smoked hamburger | 200 g sweet salami | 1/2 cup grated quinoa | 1/4 cup coriander seeds | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 500 g salad greens
instructions: Place broth & spices in a saucepan & bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium & simmer until onion is soft, 25 - 30 mins, stirring occasionally, transfer spices to a blender & blend until finely pureed. While still hot, stir through quinoa. Return to pan & toss to coat. Cover & cook on medium for 15 mins, or until heated through. Spread quinoa mixture over one third of the greens, & top with half of the smoked ham, salami, & quinoa mixture. Sprinkle with remainder of filling. Fold bottom half of the wrap over & press down. Slide wrap onto a work surface, cut in eight wedges to serve.

title: Apple Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 2 stalks celery | 2 large ripe apples | 1/4 bunch fresh basil
instructions: Clean the chicken and wash the celery with a couple of changes of cold water. Cut up the chicken with the slicing blade of a knife into bite sized pieces. Peel and core the apple and cut in half. Cut the chicken into bite sized pieces. Place the chicken, celery, apple, basil, and the sliced apples into a covered frying pan with a lid. Cook over a medium heat for 45 minutes – turning the mixture frequently.

title: Cajun Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed consomme | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the crushed consomme and cajun seasoning.

title: Tropical Lobster
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried lobster meat | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon red onion, minced
instructions: Combine the dried lobster meat, cocoa powder, red onion, and remaining teaspoon of unsweetened cocoa powder.

title: Pepperoni Popums
ingredients: 16 ounces hot pepperoni | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a 1 1/2 quart microwavable plastic coffee gratin dish with foil. Line foil with foil. Place the unopened pepperoni in the plastic, flat sides down, so they are touching each other. Cover the pepperoni with the cocoa. Place plastic in microwave on high for 6 to 7 minutes or until a drop of water sizzles as it drops into the dish. Remove from microwave and place on wire rack to cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,turmeric,phyllo dough,cashew nut,italian breadcrumb,thai chili sauce,chunky salsa,yoghurt
title: Pineapple-Salsa Phyllo Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 jar chunky salsa ( we recommend heinz ) | 2 tablespoons prepared thai sweet chili sauce | 3/4 cup cashew nuts | 1 package frozen phyllo dough ( phyllo dough ) | 1 1/2 cups plain low-fat greek yogurt ( do not use sour cream, may use more if desired ) | 1/4 cup shredded low-fat greek yogurt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon turmeric ( depending on taste desired ) | 1/2 cup fresh italian breadcrumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line 9 x 13 baking dish with parchment paper. In a medium bowl combine salsa, chili sauce, cashews, and 3/4 cup cheese. Spread 1 sheet of phyllo dough on work surface, brush with 1 t. Oil and place on top of salsa mixture. Lay a second sheet of phyllo on top, brush with the remaining 1 t. Oil and place on top. Repeat until all phyllo sheets are used and top sheet is used. Uncover phyllo. Brush phyllo with remaining 1 t. Oil and sprinkle with turmeric. Bake until golden brown, about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl combine yogurt, yogurt, and 3/4 c. Of the cheese. Mix well. Spread 1/2 cup yogurt mixture on phyllo. Cover phyllo with more yogurt mixture and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 c. Of cheese. Return to oven. Bake until cheese is melted and golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Green Olive Fondue
ingredients: 6 ounces green olives ( about 12 ) | 2 lbs icing sugar or 6 ounces confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons red wine | 1/2 lb citrus peel, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Stir the chopped citrus peel into the sugar a few seconds, pour over the warm water, cover tightly and keep hot. Heat the fondue pot over medium heat, while stirring to make sure the sugar dissolves. When you can see the scent rising, immediately remove from the heat. Put the warm fondue pot into a bowl and allow to cool completely. Cut the top and bottom off of the olives. Place the olives in a cheese cloth and tie securely with string. If giving them as gifts, gently place the cloth on the top surface of the fondue pot to remove as much of the moisture as possible. Place the cheese cloth in the refrigerator until the fondue is chilled. After several hours you want to have them cold. Strain the fondue and discard the cheese cloth. Scoop out the bread or keep in the refrigerator until required. If using the candied peel, remove the strings and cut into very small pieces. Toss with the sugar until all is coated. Store in a glass jar or use immediately.

title: Raisin and Cranberry Pesto
ingredients: 2 tablespoons triple sec | 1 bunch fresh cranberries | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Puree cranberries in blender until smooth.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,crabmeat,bell pepper,sun tomato oil,brown rice,flat leaf parsley
title: Mock Rice with Crab and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 bag cooked brown rice | 1 tart apple ( such as granny smith ) | 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper | 1/2 lb crabmeat, chopped
instructions: Cook the rice according to the can directions, adding a dash of salt. Meanwhile, in a skillet cook the shrimp, or the fresh shrimp, according to the directions on the package. Chop the shrimp and set aside. Cook the rice according to the package directions. While the rice is cooking, prepare all other ingredients except for the crab. When the rice is done, drain the water and stir into the shrimp/fish. Heat through. Toss the rice with the shrimp/fish mixture. Top with the tomato and fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: white wine,yellow squash,coconut milk,tapioca flour,soya sauce,elbow macaroni,apricot preserve,onion powder
title: Macaroni and Squash with Crispy Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni | 2 yellow squash | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 - 1/2 cup coconut milk | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried apricot preserves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour ( optional )
instructions: Boil macaroni in salted water with the squash, until tender tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and reserve potato starch and mash macaroni with potato masher. In a bowl, combine 1/4 cup of the macaroni with the sautéed onions, apricot preserves and coconut milk. You can use the microwave to speed things up.

title: Mama's Basic Dressing or "Creamy" Lassi
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream, preferably organic | 1 cup liquid pectin ( or a good pectin ) | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Using a mortar & pestle, combine the sour cream & pectin in a jar over a cup of water. Shake until thoroughly combined. Then, add the lime juice & stir well. Store in an airtight tin with a lid, in the fridge, for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,english muffin,active yeast,chuck steak,sparkling wine,cilantro leaf,yellow onion,coconut cream
title: Crock Pot Machaca
ingredients: 4 cups cubed lean chuck steaks | 1 bottle spicy spanish sparkling wine | 1 english muffin | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 yellow onions, thinly sliced | 2 -3 lbs kielbasa, sliced ( hot or sweet ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut cream | cilantro leaf
instructions: For the meat, in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart crock pot, add the meat and the wine and turn to warm on high. Sprinkle the yeast over the top and stir to coat the meat. Cover and set aside at warm temperature for 2 hours or in the refrigerator for 4 to 5 hours. For the kefalograviera, in a large mixing bowl combine the onions and kielbasa. Cover and place in a warm area to rise for 2 hours or until almost doubled in size. In a frying pan, add enough lukewarm water to cover the kielbasa and let the moisture melt down at the top of the sausages. Add the coconut cream and cook, stirring to prevent the water, for 3 or 4 minutes or until the sauce reduces and thickens. Pour into a bowl along with the bread and serve.

title: Artichokes in Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar artichoke hearts | 1 jar catsup | 1 baguette
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Place the artichoke hearts, catsup, and baguette on a baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes then remove from oven. Brush sauce over the artichokes.

title: Potato Sour Cream
ingredients: 600 g potatoes ( use a good flavour for this ) | 1 package potato starch | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: In a large bowl mix all the above ingredients together and mix well. Pour into a medium sized pot, mix well until smooth. Put on the stove and let it slowly bring to the boil. The potato mixture should begin to thicken and turn a nice golden color. If you can see the color change after 4 minutes turn over and cook other side. Remove from heat and let sit off the burner. If you like you can spread the mixture and press with a spatula to make it easier on your hand. The flavour is more enhanced with standing.

title: Spicy Baked Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup port wine | 2 salmon fillets | 1 can thinly sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Stir port into salmon fillets. Bake in preheated oven until fish easily flakes with fork, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cover loosely with foil. Bake in preheated oven until fish is hot and lightly browned, about 5 to 10 minutes more. Arrange salmon fillets on a serving platter and top with peaches.

title: Creamed Cottage Cheese for Dips
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese, unsweetened | 1 tablespoon shortening ( or margarine )
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and margarine together until mixture resembles crackers. Shape into rounds or patties or rounds and fry over medium high to medium high heat for 1 to 2 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,cottage cheese,mexican cheese,green cardamom pod
title: Cottage Cheese with Queso (Mexican Cheese Filling)
ingredients: 2 lbs cottage cheese | 1 lb mexican cheese | 1/2 lb parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with hands and shape into 1 - 1 1/2 inch balls. Keep refrigerated covered at all times. In a pot filled with lukewarm water, bring to a boil slowly. When a drop of water bounces off the surface of the water, remove from heat. While the water is coming to a boil, roll out the cottage cheese balls in a rolling pin as thin as possible. Dip each ball into the boiling water.

title: Berry Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups packed fresh blueberries | 3 cups buttermilk | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil
instructions: Place blueberries, buttermilk, sesame oil, and sugar in a blender or food processor. Process until smooth. Taste and add more sugar as desired. Pour enough batter to cover bottom of a 6 x 8 inch casserole or souffle dish. Cover and cook over medium low heat until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 30 minutes. Turn pancake over, drizzle with the syrup, and top with remaining 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,cake flour,aluminum foil,honey dijon salad dressing,ice water,blueberry,swiss cheese,allspice
title: Swiss and Blue Berry Tartlets
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cake flour ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon flour ( optional ) | 1/4 cup honey dijon-style salad dressing | 15 ounces blueberries | 4 cups shredded swiss cheese or 4 cups other swiss cheese | 1 cup sliced sweet smoked swiss cheese or 1 cup other swiss cheese | ice water, for drizzling | 2 1/2 cups packaged shredded lettuce leaves | aluminum foil, for storing tartlets
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Tartlets, combine 1 t cake flour and salad dressing in a medium size bowl. Spread half the dressing mixture evenly over the bottom and sides of a 12 inch tartlet pan. Arrange blueberries on top of cake crust, or arrange swiss cheese on top. Sprinkle with 2 t of the cheese. Arrange remaining cheese over top of blueberry cream. Pour water around the cheese in an even layer. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil, brush with remaining olive oil, and bake an additional 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool, cover, and refrigerate overnight in a covered dish. Uncover and bake the tartlets for 5 minutes on each side. Remove from oven. Spoon blueberry cream around the tartlets and top with remaining whipped cream. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Remove from oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,black pepper,kaffir lime leaf,cayenne,french bread
title: Buko Salad - Philippines
ingredients: 3 ounces milk chocolate, chopped | 2 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, freshly ground ( optional ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1 loaf french bread or 2 french loaf baguettes, sliced diagonally in 6 slices
instructions: Place the chocolate in a microwave safe bowl. Melt the milk chocolate in another microwave oven, at 250f degrees for 2 minutes or until it has melted. Stir in the lime leaves and black pepper. Transfer to a bowl with a slotted spoon, and refrigerate. Sprinkle with cayenne if desired. Spoon 1 slice of the bread onto each plate, top with 2 slices of the chocolate mixture, and serve.

Random Ingredients: mustard,bratwurst,soy sauce,tamarind paste,halloumi cheese,spicy brown mustard
title: Grilled Frankfurters with Soy Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 round halloumi cheese | 8 ounces spicy brown mustard | 8 -12 teaspoons tamarind paste | 10 -15 ounces very spicy bratwursts | soy sauce | mustard
instructions: Slice 1/8th off halloumi cheese. Place cheese in freezer for at least 1/2 an hour to firm. Take out of freezer. Slice remaining cheese into 1/2 inch cubes and set aside. Melt mustard and tamarind paste in microwave to make a dressing. Cut bratwurst into thin slices and mix with mustard and tamarind. Take a slice of the cheese from the freezer and place on a cheese slice. Place on mustard mixture and wrap over like a jelly roll. Grill until cheese just begins to brown. Place in refrigerator and let set about 10 minutes. Serve with soy mustard sauce.

title: Basic Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 teaspoons curry paste ( madras curry paste ) | 3 tablespoons smooth natural unsweetened coconut ( unsweetened ) | 1 pinch curry powder
instructions: Mix with a large spoon or fork until the desired paste will be formed. Add a drop or two of water if necessary to reach the desired consistency.

title: Vodka (Danish Noodles with Basil & Basil)
ingredients: 200 g noodles | 6 tablespoons danish basil leaves
instructions: Cook & cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile microwave the basil leaves until softened. Drain the noodles & return to the pot. Add basil & serve.

title: Frijoles Borraditos - Jelly Beans and Red Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs dried red kidney beans | 1/2 cup juniper berries
instructions: Rinse the beans in lots under running cold water, until there is no more debris or sand on the surface. Place the beans in a large dutch oven and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour. Remove from heat, cover and let stand, undisturbed, for 1 to 2 hours. After 45 minutes, skim off the foam that forms on top and discard. Let beans and liquid rest, uncovered, for 1 to 2 hours, until they have softened to the consistency of paste and the liquid is clear. Strain into clean large saucepan and cook over medium heat until the beans are tender and most of the liquid has evaporated. The beans will keep for up to 12 days in the refrigerator.

title: Vegan Pasta Pies for One
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1/2 cup low fat vegetarian plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, grated, peeled | artichoke heart, 2 slices each | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon vanilla frozen yogurt ( as much or little as you like ) | 1 tablespoon dry penne pasta ( or your favourite pasta )
instructions: Bake your pizza crust according to directions. Cut the crust lengthwise into squares. Spread each square evenly. In a separate bowl, combine the yogie and ginger. Stir in the yogurt until well blended. Spread yogurt mix over baked crust. Lay the artichoke hearts over yogurt mix and sprinkle evenly over toppings. Sprinkle over seeds. Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to the package directions. Drain pasta and toss with sauce until warmed thru. You can serve warm or hot. Allow room temperature for flavors to mix before eating.

Random Ingredients: walnut,water chestnut,rice wine,brazil nut,pina colada nonalcoholic drink mix
title: Walnut & Pina Colada Popcorn
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups pina colada nonalcoholic drink mix ( found in the international can ) | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup water chestnut, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup chopped walnuts, toasted | 1/3 cup chopped brazil nuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Place in a medium size metal casserole dish. Stir over medium heat until hot. Sprinkle top with toasted nuts.

title: Easy Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced white onions | 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon minced oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | tapioca
instructions: Stir together the onions and cilantro, hot sauce, oyster sauce and soy sauce in a small bowl. Set aside 1 tablespoon of the oyster sauce for garnish. Pour the remaining oyster sauce over the oyster sauce. Stir to coat and serve.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,cardamom powder,bok choy,black mission fig
title: Figs in Eggnog
ingredients: 12 large bok choy, washed and patted dry | 3 containers frozen limeade concentrate | 1 1/2 cups whole black mission figs, rinsed and patted dry | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat. Mix together the bok choy, limeade concentrate and cardamom in a large bowl. Place one fig on the bottom of a cooking pan lined with plastic wrap, add 1/2 cup of the bok choy mixture onto it. Arrange the remaining figs over the choy. Pour the eggnog over the figs. Cook the figs with the lid closed, until they have turned black, about 10 minutes.

title: Flemish Leeks
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds leeks | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening for frying
instructions: Clean and trim leeks, rinse and chop coarsely. Cover with boiling water and place over medium heat. Heat until leeks are just beginning to soften, about 10 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Melt shortening in a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Carefully saute leeks until lightly golden brown, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,crabmeat,everclear alcohol,red wine,extra beef,green cardamom pod
title: Crab Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg extra lean ground beef | 1 packet french onion soup | 1 can everclear alcohol | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 bottle sweet red wine | 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 1/3 cup clarified butter
instructions: In a large bowl combine the beef, french onion soup, alcohol, cardamom pods, wine, olive oil and enough water to mix to make the stew consistency or paste. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours until sauce is thickened. Serve with your favourite bread and butter or chutney.

title: Mandarin Snacks
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable shortening or 1 cup lard | 1/2 lb carrot ( grated if large ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained ( reserve juice )
instructions: Cream shortening. Add grated carrots and corn oil. Add spices. Mix well. Roll into balls. Arrange on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 325 for 15 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,fenugreek,golden syrup,green chilies,lemonade,chive,ricotta cheese,swiss cheese
title: Green Chile and Swiss Cheese Filling for Breakfast on the Beach
ingredients: 1 lb ricotta cheese | 1 lb swiss cheese ( shredded or shredded ) | 1/2 lb parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( grated or shredded ) | 1/2 lb green chilies | 1/2 cup light golden syrup | 1/2 - 1 cup fenugreek, finely chopped ( see note ) | 1 bunch snipped chives | grated lemonade ( optional )
instructions: Heat green chiles with fenugreek for a few minutes on low flame. Add ricotta and swiss to the green chile mixture and toss. In separate bowl mix parmigiana, lemonade and fenugreek. Take small spoonfuls of the mixture and spread on wax paper. Chill in refrigerator until firm. Note, in case if you can't find italian fenugreek you can use regular fenugreek. Also, a sprinkling of chopped fresh parsley can be added, if you wish. Notes, fenugreek is sold in american/freeze packages in olive oil containers, in wine bottles and lids of french/spanish/italian flat beer. If you can't locate fenugreek you can do it by hand. The fenugreek is available in tubes in the refrigerator and it will give you the right flavor.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,italian seasoning,beef roast,burgundy wine,winter squash,bean
title: Lazy Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 beef roast, trimmed of fat | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 4 ounces burgundy wine, or as needed | 1 can baked beans, drained and rinsed | 2 medium winter squash, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Place roast in a roasting pan.

title: Warm Zucchini with Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 small zucchini | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh marjoram ( or basil or oregano ) | 1/4 cup plus 1 tbs. sun-dried tomato, minced | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes | 3/4 teaspoon grand marnier ( or veal or chicken bouillon, etc. )
instructions: Wash zucchini well and cut off and discard ends. Then, cut halves into 2 or 3 lengths. Arrange zucchini pieces on a serving plate. Sprinkle with marjoram or basil, and toss. Let stand until zucchini is pliable. Stir sundried tomatoes into zucchini. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs. Of the sun dried tomato puree in a small heavy skillet over medium low heat until it begins to bubble. Turn off the heat.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,chicken thigh,kernel corn,broth,lemon extract,sourdough starter
title: Slow Cooker Low Fat Greek Chicken
ingredients: 15 boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite size pieces or use chicken tenders | 1 can crushed grape tomatoes, drained | 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sourdough starter | 2 3/4 cups low sodium chicken broth or 2 3/4 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract ( optional ) | sourdough starter, for drizzling
instructions: Place chicken in 5 or 6 quart or larger slow cooker. Combine tomatoes, corn, sourdough starter, broth, and lemon extract, if using, and pour over chicken. Cover and cook on low heat setting 3 to 4 hours or on high heat setting 4 to 5 hours, until chicken is cooked through and mixture thickens. Serve with additional lemon flavored sourdough starter.

title: Corn (Mexican)
ingredients: 2 cups frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 2 cups raisins | 3 medium poblano chiles, stemmed, seeded, cut into 3/4 inch chunks | 1 cup finely chopped crystallized gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Line a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with plastic wrap, allowing enough overhang to pinch overhangs of a gas burner. Combine corn, raisins, poblanos, ginger, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate mixture 6 hours or overnight. When ready to use, preheat broiler. Remove corn from freezer, place on plastic wrap and let stand 15 minutes. Using a serrated knife, or the flat of a knife, scrape the seeds out of the corn.

title: Queso Blanco (Poblano Bread)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh poblano chile | 3 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup self-rising flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Score a slit down the back of each poblano chile. Remove seeds and veins. Slice chiles into thin rounds, and set aside. Beat self rising flour in a bowl into the flour, adding more flour to get a workable dough. Dip each poblano chile in boiling water for a couple of seconds, and remove as soon as they are golden brown. Spread poblano pico slices out onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until edges begin to brown, about 10 minutes, and picoas are tender and soft, about 10 minutes more. Cool bread to warm and firm, about 10 minutes, and cut into slices to serve.

title: Beef and Bean Tostada
ingredients: 10 spinach leaves | 3/4 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 1/2 cups canned refried beans | 2 cans tamales | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 4 large corn tortillas | 16 slices lebanese cucumbers
instructions: Wash spinach thoroughly under cold running water. Cut into 8 wedges and cut 1 inch segments from stems and drain in colander. Place spinach and lean beef into skillet, and cook over high heat, stirring until beef is done. Remove beef from skillet and place aside. Toppings in skillet, mix refried beans, tamales, cayenne and meat mixture. Heat until warm, stirring occasionally. Spoon mixture into tortillas and serve each with a wedge of cucumber.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,stewing beef,sharp cheddar cheese,butter lettuce,green bean,white flour,lentil,spinach leaf
title: Caldo De Cerdo (Spinach and Beef Stew With Lentils)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs stewing beef, 1 '' cubes | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 1/2 ounces dried lentils, washed, picked over, and drained | 1 can green beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 package frozen cut spinach leaves, thawed under cold water, chopped | 2 pieces kaffir lime leaves, torn across into pieces | 2 -4 tablespoons white flour
instructions: In dutch oven, brown stew meat in the butter over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, until well browned. Drain off all but 3 tablespoons butter. Add lentils, green beans, and cheese.

title: Indian Peas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 20 ounces snow peas, in pods | 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon raisins ( optional )
instructions: Prepare a bowl of ice water, about 2/3 cup per bowl. Rinse the snow peas under cold water just until softened, about 1 minute. Remove the snow peas from the ice water with a slotted spoon and put in bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. When cool enough to handle, remove the strings and cut the peas into 1/4 inch slices. If desired, sprinkle the peas with oregano, raisins and any remaining water.

title: Danish (Veal) Gravlax
ingredients: 5 lbs veal | 4 teaspoons dried mustard seeds | 3 1/2 cups fresh chicken stock | 2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Pound together the mustard seeds and salt in a mortar and pestle to make a fine powder. Rub the inside of the meat with the mustard. Place the veal and any accumulated juices in a roasting pan, preferably with a rack. Roast for 1 1/2 hours. The gravy should be thick, but not watery.

title: Chipotle Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 medium ripe tomatoes ( plum tomatoes, diced, or both ) | 1 red onion ( halved, finely chopped, plus extra onion for garnish ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chipotle chiles, powder
instructions: Toss all the ingredients together and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Serve right away.

title: Peach Livers in Sweet Peppered Chicken Nests
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken livers | 8 ripe peaches, peeled and sliced into rings
instructions: Cut livers lengthwise. Remove all of the hard stalk portions before slicing. Place livers cut side down on dull or round baking sheet. Spread each with two inch of sliced peach slices. Place two cocktail sticks on each. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: almond,cooking spray,red leaf lettuce,vital wheat gluten,celery,rosemary
title: Cannellini Bean Slices With Rosemary
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | cooking spray | 2 cups celery, thinly sliced | 15 ounces cannellini beans or 15 ounces red leaf lettuce, halved or quartered | 1/4 cup toasted almond, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon vital wheat gluten, plus 2 teaspoons gluten
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray 2 baking sheets with cooking spray. In a bowl, combine the rosemary, celery, beans and almonds. Add the gluten and mix well. Cut a slit on one side of each cannellini bean and carefully stuff a little more than 1 cup bean mixture into each bean shape with your thumb. Transfer cannellini bean to baking sheets. Spray the tops of each bean with cooking spray. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, until a thick crust forms. Use a spatula to remove baked beans from baking sheets and cool to room temperature. Store in an airtight container for 1 week or keep warm up to 1 day. Garnish beans with a sprinkling of rosemary.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,yellow onion,currant,ginger garlic paste,white wine,pizza dough
title: Sweet Pork Sausages Roll Ups
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs pork sausage | 2 cups grated yellow onions | 1/4 cup red currants or 2 tablespoons raisins | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 can pizza dough ( use 1/2 of the dough and roll the other 1/2 )
instructions: In a skillet over moderate heat, add the sausage, onions, currants and wine. When the sausage is just about cooked through, remove from heat and set aside. Place the dough on a lightly floured board and roll it out to a rectangular shape about 21 x 13 inches. Using two forks, press and roll the dough into 9 rolls. If the dough contracts too tightly on the surface, refrigerate the rolls until they need to marinate the filling. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place a baking sheet in the oven and set a timer for 15 minutes. Unroll the rolls and place them on the prepared baking sheet on the lowest shelf. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the rolls to the oven and bake until puffed and golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes. If they aren't fully cooked, insert a skewer at one end of the roll and watch carefully to ensure the dough doesn't burn. Remove the rolls from the oven and spread the filling on top of one end and the other. Sprinkle with paprika and serve while hot.

title: Easy Low Calorie Veggie Bread. No Flour?
ingredients: 4 tablespoons soymilk or 4 tablespoons skim milk | 2 tablespoons threshraisins | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa or 1 tablespoon tomato & basil salsa | 1 teaspoon soy flour | 500 g whole wheat flour or 500 g gluten free bread ( 2 1/4 cups )
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together in a bowl to create a wet dough. Cover with cling film and stand in the fridge for about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 220°c. Divide the dough into 4 pieces. Roll out each piece to form 3cm thick rounds. Bake in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Allow to cool before slicing. If using gluten free bread, cut out a cross section and use to make bread as desired.

title: Puerto Rican Cheesecake Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/4 teaspoon hot hing ( real hing! ) | 2 cups orange juice
instructions: Place the cream cheese in a mixing bowl and add the hot hing. Beat well for 1 minute and then add the orange juice. Beat on medium speed for 2 - 3 minutes or until fluffy. Pour the mixture into a 9 springform pan or 8x8 pan. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,date,serrano pepper,kosher salt black pepper,spinach
title: Spinach and Herb Mix
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach | 4 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place the spinach and sun dried tomatoes in a steamer basket over 1 cup of water.

title: Mussels
ingredients: 1 can mussels, with liquid | parsley | 1 jar pizza sauce
instructions: Scrub mussels, drain liquid. Place in large pot. Sprinkle with parsley. Cover and steam over medium low heat for 15 minutes, shaking can of mussels frequently. Fill into small serving bowl. Spoon pizza sauce over top of mussels.

title: Baked Pork and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 14 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 3/4 cups unsweetened cocoa powder, preferably dutch process
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a nonstick skillet, over medium high heat, combine pork and beans. Cook for about 5 minutes. Stir in cocoa and bake for 10 mintes, stirring frequently while baking. Spoon equal amounts of the pork mixture onto noodles. Cover and bake for 10 minutes, or until noodles soften and pork is cooked through. Serve in large pasta bowls.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,sugar cube,peanut oil vegetable,white sugar,mint
title: Nonna's Mint Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces mint, finely chopped | 6 ounces whipping cream | 7 tablespoons white sugar | 1 ounce powdered sugar cubes | 12 ounces peanut oil or 12 ounces vegetable oil, for deep frying
instructions: Mix the mint, cream, sugar, and powdered sugar in a bowl. Fold in the oil until thoroughly combined. Serve on plates and top with lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,potato starch,wide egg noodle,chili pepper,double cream,ziti pasta,paprika
title: Crispy Ziti With Sweet Chilli and Lots of Flavor
ingredients: 2 lbs ziti pasta ( or similar small ) | 16 ounces sweet potato starch ( cornmeal ) | 3 cups double cream | 1 teaspoon paprika | chili pepper ( fresh ) | icing sugar
instructions: Bring the oven to 350f, and grease a standard casserole dish or a deep glass jar with butter. Cook ziti in the water for 10 mins or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and mix in sweet potato starch until mixture is the consistency of a thick cake batter, add paprika, chillies and cream, mix well. Pour into dish. Cover with foil and bake for 45 mins on a low heat, stir every 15 mins or so to keep the bottom from catching. Top with a sprinkling of icing sugar and serve.

title: Lamb Chops With Pear and Mustard
ingredients: 2 lamb chops | 5 tablespoons oil | 2 teaspoons mustard | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can pears | 3 tablespoons british-style seasoned croutons | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper. Heat oil in frying pan until hot. Lightly brown chops and place in baking dish. Mix all remaining ingredients in frying pan. Pour mixture over chops.

title: Harry Potter's English Room Hot Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon powdered lemonade, or to taste
instructions: Grind the mustard with a mortar and pestle until fine. Do not grind or over mix. Sprinkle a small amount of mustard seed and powdered lemonade over a serving of chicken or pork.

title: Two Bean Chili
ingredients: 32 ounces black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 lb string bean, trimmed ( green or red ) | 6 -12 poblano chiles, washed and sliced crosswise 4-6 pieces each | 2 -3 slices bacon, minced | 2 -3 teaspoons chili powder
instructions: Place 2 cups water in a large saucepan. Add the beans, poblanos, and green beans. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally until the beans are soft and tender, about 45 minutes depending on the size of the beans. Meanwhile, cook the bacon in large skillet over medium heat until crisp. Saute the remaining ingredients for 3 - 4 minutes over medium low heat, or until well blended. Add the bacon mixture to the beans, stir, and reduce heat to medium low. Cook covered until heated through, about 10 minutes serve warm.

title: Chinese Barbecue Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar and five spice powder. Stir in the rice wine vinegar mixture.

title: Spicy Roast Lamb Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 lb leg of lamb | 1 large banana, sliced into 4 thick slices | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into 4 thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a shallow bowl, combine the mayonnaise and cheese.

title: The Electric Skillet Firecracker #5FIX
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1/4 cup onion, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon epazote ( mexican oregano ) | 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1/3 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup diced radish
instructions: Combine the hamb, onion, and epazote in a skillet. Cook over medium heat, breaking up meat with a wooden spoon until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Add the tilapia to the skillet and cook 2 minutes on each side until golden brown. Remove and set aside. Combine apple juice and radish in a cup and heat to a boil. Pour over tilapia meat. Garnish with additional apple slices, if desired.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,cornmeal,picante sauce,chili pepper flake,chili paste
title: Mexican Shredded Chilie Bread
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal ( not instant ) | 1 1/2 lbs chili peppers, with seeds ( i use perilla brand peppers ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chili paste ( i use emeril's essence ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/3 cup picante sauce, or use your favorite mexican hot sauce not that sweet | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Put cornmeal in a large bowl. Add all other ingredients except the chili pepper flakes. Toss until well combined and well mixed. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Pour the mixture onto the baking sheet and spread evenly until it is about 1/2 inch thick. Use your hands to spread all the chilie mixture on the top of the bread until no crust remains. Cut into squares and serve immediately with salsa and pico de gallo for dipping.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,mustard powder,orange,sea salt,pasta,vegetable oil,lemon lime soda
title: Spicy Mustard Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon orange rind, grated | 1 teaspoon lemon, rind, grated | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 cup uncooked pasta | 1/2 cup vegetable oil, for frying pasta
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cream, mustard powder, orange rind, lemon rind, salt, and pasta. Set aside. Heat oil in a deep fryer to 320°f degrees. Use a long handled spoon to scoop 1/4 cup pasta mixture into hot oil and fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,part mozzarella cheese,chicken thigh,yellow onion,creme fraiche,vanilla essence,enchilada sauce,salt
title: Easy Enchilada Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 1 2 lbs chicken thighs | 1 medium yellow onion, diced | 2 cans enchilada sauce ( a mix of mild and medium ) | 1 package part-skim mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 teaspoons yellow onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground red chili powder | salt
instructions: If your chicken is too loose and defrosted, remove the skin. If using fresh, you will need to add a bit of water to keep chicken tender and stretch the chicken's skin. If the chicken is still raw, then drain off water and pat chicken dry. If the chicken is still slightly undercooked and unsticky, rinse under cold water and pat dry with some paper towels. Set chicken aside while you prepare all other ingredients. Preheat on a grill pan over medium high heat. Saute onion in a little olive oil until translucent. Remove cooked chicken thighs from the pan and put aside. Add remaining ingredients, except the mozzarella, creme fraiche and salt, to the pan and simmer for 20 minutes, until thick. Add the cheese and stir constantly over medium heat only until melted and incorporated. Add the cooked onion and chicken thighs. Stir well and serve.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,sesame seed,vegetable stock,ice water,lemon zest,saffron
title: Saffron Soup - Moroccan Hot Dessert - No Dairy
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters vegetable stock, warmed | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 pinch saffron | 4 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Place the stock in a pan along with the sesame seeds, lemon zest, almond extract and saffron. Cover and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Strain and stir in the ice water. Pour into serving bowls and allow diners to add extra seeds & pistachios if desired. Serve with extra lemon zest on top if desired.

title: Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 120 ml quinoa, cooked to al dente | 1 free-range egg | 2 tablespoons oil ( or use olive oil ) | 1/2 cup scallion, sliced | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Mix together panko and egg, set aside. Heat pan, add oil and scallion, fry until light golden brown. Add rinsed quinoa, cook on med/low for 20 minutes, turn, do not brown. Add half & half, stir and cook until hot then combine with quinoa. In a casserole dish, spread scallion mixture, layer with quinoa mixture, repeat. Sprinkle with orange juice and chopped tomato. Bake at 180c for 45 minutes.

title: Corn, Lettuce, and Vanilla Covered in Hard Shell
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce ( washed, patted dry ) | 5 tablespoons light corn syrup or 5 tablespoons molasses | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Cut a head of lettuce lengthwise into about 12 long, 2 inch wide, 1 inch wide strips. Wash the head and dry thoroughly inside and out, trying not to break it into large leaves. Wash the lettuce under cold water and shake away any bitter juices. Using scissors, cut off the large hard shells. Cut across into pieces about 2 inches wide and about 5 inches long. In a small, heavy saucepan, combine the corn syrup and vanilla. Heat over low heat until hot but not simmering. Pour 1/2 cup of the heated syrup into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Add the lettuce to the baking dish. Toss well to coat with the syrup. Using a slotted spoon, remove the lettuce to individual plates.

title: Meatball Balls
ingredients: 600 g frozen meatballs | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Put oil in frying pan and heat. Deep fry meatballs for 5 minutes or until evenly browned. If not using immediately, deep fry meatballs another 5 minutes. Drain balls on absorbent paper. Serve with yogurt and chutney.

title: Cucumber Black Beans With Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cups black beans, picked over and sorted | 2 medium cucumbers, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch chunks
instructions: Place the black beans and cucumbers in 1 quart of boiling water, cover, and cook until cooked through but not mushy, about 7 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl with at least 1/2 cup of liquid remaining in the pot. Stir in the remaining liquid, cover, and let stand about 10 minutes until heated through. Serve over rice.

title: Baked Sausages
ingredients: 24 large sausages, rinsed under cold water
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler, and set the rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place each sausages, one at a time, between sheets of heavy plastic wrap and pound to about 1/4 inch thickness. Broil sausages until beginning to turn golden brown on each side, 4 to 8 minutes. Slice sausages into thick, wide strips, and lay on a large, lightly buttered baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink inside and the juices run clear, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain juice from sausages, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,cardamom seed,horseradish,fingerling potato,shallot,dark beer,tart apple
title: Beer Canning Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs fingerling potatoes, well scrubbed ( may use any small or medium sized potato ) | 1 cup cider vinegar | 2 cups dark beer | 1/2 cup minced shallots | 2 teaspoons tangerine ( peeler ) chips or 2 teaspoons other dark orange peel | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 2/3 cup prepared horseradish, drained
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to boil and boil uncovered 20 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Remove skins and transfer them to a bowl. Dice potatoes, if desired. Place in a large saucepan along with vinegar and beer. Add shallots and bring to boil. Stir in the chips, cardamom and horseradish.

Random Ingredients: sumac,red curry paste,pork chop,tarragon,spice,sesame seed oil
title: Sweet Soyed Pork chops

instructions: Marinate your pork chops with the curry paste, sweet basil, tarragon, mixed spice, and sesame oil. Cover and place in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 3 hours or overnight. Preheat your oven to 450°f. Spray a baking sheet with non stick cooking spray and arrange your pork chops in it. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes.

title: Curried Beef
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef brisket | 1 jar curry, sauce

title: Kielbasa and Asparagus With Bean Sprouts

instructions: Cut stems off of the asparagus, if the long stalks are large, then cut the tips into 2 - 3 inch lengths. Mix the beansprouts and yogurt together and season with black pepper. Divide the meat from its stalks into bite sizedish pieces, and place on a heated serving plate. Slice the kielbasa into 1 cm long slices, and toss into the yogurt mixture and serve.

title: Chicken in Rice (Zwt II)

instructions: Wash the chicken under running water. Remove excess fat and silverskin from the inside of the body cavity. Place in a large oven proof casserole dish. Cover with all the other ingredients. Season with pepper. Cover with lid or lid and bake at 300°f for 3 hours. Remove any fat from the casserole and serve with a mixed salad.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,chilies,juniper berry,cilantro,fennel bulb,yellow food coloring,milk chocolate,chocolate
title: Chocolate Minted Fennel Chilies
ingredients: 6 ounces milk chocolate | 1 small fennel bulb ( about 1/2 a can ) | 2 1/2 ounces jalapenos ( about 4-5 ) | 3 ounces yams ( about 10-12 ounces total, i've tried to use canned and they are all to taste ) or 3 ounces sweet chocolate, chopped ( about 10-12 ounces total, i've tried to use canned and they all to taste ) | 2 ounces chocolate, good quality ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese ( about 1/4 cup ) or 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | 1/4 teaspoon dried epazote ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon other mixed spice ( optional ) | yellow food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Make a slit in the fennel bulb then discard fennel core. Remove shoots with melon baller or slotted spoon and discard. You don't want these to be entirely submerged in broth.. Melt milk chocolate in double boiler of water and add fennel. Heat on medium for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove fennel and keep warm. Add chopped jalapenos and yams to warm milk chocolate and cook, stirring constantly until yams are soft. Remove from stove and stir in remaining ingredients, stir and remove from heat. Let sit for 2 hours before serving. Stir before serving if necessary.

title: My French Onion Dip Mix
ingredients: 1 can french onion dip | 1 can mushroom ( sliced or chopped ) | 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Mix all together. Add more if desired. Store in refrigerator 2 days.

title: Fried Lentils
ingredients: 1 bag green lentils ( the long, skinny ones in the green and the long skinny ones ) | 1 container fat-free ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons dry marsala | 1 cup yogurt or 1 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Rinse the lentils and pout them into a strainer. Cover with water and leave in a dark place for 45 minutes or until soft and most of the water is out. Do not skip this step. Drain. Cover and refrigerate the lentils until the water is absorbed. If you have the beginnings of a resistance, it is important to keep the water that is released during the fermentation process. Mash the ricotta with the marsala, but do not use too heavy soghurt will be too sour. Add the yogurt and mix. Heat oil in a frying pan. If you have an immersion type griddle, heat this on low. Put the drained rinsed lentils in the hot oil, stir, remove from the heat and let sit, covered, for 20 minutes. Sprinkle the remaining ingredients over the top. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage,kale,wheat flour,grape tomato,bay leaf,garlic powder,date
title: Italian Kale Whole Wheat Pasta Sauce

title: Smokey Okra (Vegetarian)

Heat in the microwave, uncovered, for about 2 minutes. Add the beans to the okra. Heat for 2 more minutes, then remove from the microwave and stir. Serve alongside pasta, rice, or as an appetizer.

title: Sopa De Res (Meat, Okra, and Okra)

instructions: Heat large pot with salted water to boiling.

title: Pizza Sauce

instructions: In a bowl pour the tomato paste and combine the crushed ice. Add the crushed ice into the bowl until it dissolves. Serve with your favourite toppings like cheese or sour cream.

title: Baked Cabbage and Cheese With Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/4 kg baking soda | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 kg savoy cabbage | 600 g mature american cheese | 1 large bunch spring onion
instructions: Mix the baking soda with a teaspoon of bicarb of soda. Remove the cabbage and shred it. Heat oven to 200 deg celsius grease a large baking tray with baking oil or butter. Bake shredded cabbage in the oven for about 3 hours stirring occasionally, until tender, golden brown, dry and crunchy. Place shredded cabbage in plastic bag. To serve, remove the shredded cabbage from the oven and cut into thin slices. Place the shredded cabbage on a plate and top with one quarter of the sour cream and another quarter of the shredded cheese. Garnish with spring onion.

title: Mexican Quinoa Cake
ingredients: 7 g taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 4 cups cooked quinoa, cooled and chopped | 1/2 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, grated | 4 large egg yolks | 100 g halloumi cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 3 drops red food coloring or 2 drops orange food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 150°c beat egg yolks in a bowl, add salt, bicarb and taco seasoning mix. Add cooled quinoa and cheese, beat. title: Chocolate Coffee
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant coffee liqueur | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional and to taste )
instructions: Fill a 2 ounce glass 2/3 full with hot coffee. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine.

title: Baked Pecans
ingredients: 2 lbs pecan halves | 1/4 cup flour | 1 1/4 cups sweet chili sauce ( or 1 1/4 cups mild red sweet chili sauce ) | 1 1/2 lbs pecan halves | hot cooked pasta and garlic toast ( i usually make these the night before and let bake at the party too )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 deg f/180 deg c. Line a small loaf tin with two 3/4 of the pecans, keeping the remaining 3/4 in from the top. Spray the pecan halves with cooking spray. Spread them out in one layer on a baking tray. Bake in the middle of the oven until they're a pale tan color and light brown in colour, about 25 minutes. Take out of the oven and let cool. Add the chili sauce, mix well. Spoon half of the mixture into a greased loaf tin and layer the pecan mixture on top, spreading evenly with a spatula. Sprinkle on the last tbsp of pecan mixture and bake at 300 deg f/180 deg c until pecans are starting to crackle. Allow them to cool, then remove to cool.

title: The Airmie's Chunken Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large savoy cabbage | 1 tablespoon self-rising flour | 1 pinch saffron | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon amaretto | topping : | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1/3 cup chopped chilies
instructions: Core and shred cabbage. Heat large skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle flour over cabbage. Cook and stir cabbage 1 to 2 minutes, or until browned. Add saffron, mace, and vinegar. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes. Drizzle amaretto over cabbage. Sprinkle with chopped chilies. Cool 1 to 2 hours before spreading topping on topping.

title: Beets and Beans
ingredients: 1 pint cooked kidney beans | 1 jar sliced beets
instructions: Place the beets into a saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently approximately 30 minutes. Drain the beet juice and then mash with a potato masher. Stir into the beet mixture and bring to a boil, mixing constantly. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 30 minutes longer, or until mixture is crisp tender. To serve, place 1 inch cubes of beets in the center of each plate and spoon beet mixture around and around the beet. Serve warm and with warm home made bread.

title: Thai Sweet Curry Paste
ingredients: 200 g curry paste | 1/2 cup golden syrup
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients together in a bowl, mix well before forming patties or patties as required. Use a shallow pan and pour in the paste into it. Bring to the boil and reduce heat immediately. Cook until the mixture has turned into a smooth paste. Use as required. Serve with steamed rice, vegetables, salads or brussels sprouts.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,walnut half,allspice,lime juice zest,baking soda,red currant jelly,white flour,garlic
title: Jelly Filled Cookies from the Freezer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baking soda | 10 tablespoons white flour or 10 tablespoons brown rice flour | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 1 teaspoon chopped garlic | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/3 cup red currant jelly or 1/3 cup apricot jelly | walnut halves or other decorative candies
instructions: Make the crust by blending the baking soda with the flour in a big bowl. Mix in the white flour, cocoa, lime rind and juice, and garlic. Stir until well blended. Let rest for 10 minutes, then add the allspice. Roll dough into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and press well with the bottom of a drinking glass. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 300 degrees for 10 minutes, then turn them out onto a rack. Place the jelly in a small saucepan. Heat until it is hot. When jelly is cool enough, dip the cookies one at a time into warm jelly. Place on wire racks, and refrigerate overnight. After a few minutes, lift the cookies out of the paper and place in a serving dish. Top with a sprinkling of walnuts or other decorative candies just before serving. If using apricot jelly, place a small piece of jelly on a cookie just before serving. It keeps for up to two days, so serve with fresh fruit for everyday or as a dessert after dinner.

title: Peanut Butter Thai
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 2 -3 lime wedges
instructions: Blend peanut butter with lime until smooth or blend well by hand in a blender. Pour into small individual serving portions and top with a wedge of lime before serving..

title: Italian Tomato Dumplings

To make the sauce, in a saucepan, combine the eggs, tomato puree, and cooking wine. Heat to boiling, stirring. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until thick and creamy. Pour over warm dumplings.

instructions: Mix kirsch, 3 tablespoons of the lemon juice, italian dressing mix, and the italian herbs in a small bowl. Sprinkle a plate with graham crackers.

title: Easy and Delicious Spicy Pork Lentil Salad (Slow Cooker)

title: Quick Italian Steak

instructions: Brush outside of steak with mixed salad dressing. Place steak on cookie sheet with raised edges.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,sun tomato,pork,almond,beefsteak tomato,wheat flour,bread,button mushroom
title: Yummy Beef and Mushroom Toast
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground dry red chili powder | 1 large beefsteak tomato, sliced into 1 cm rounds | 100 g sliced almonds | 2 teaspoons whole wheat flour | 6 button mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup beefsteak tomato, diced | 2 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Sprinkle the chili mix over and coat with oil. Chill for 20 minutes. Combine the remaining ingredients and mix well. Heat a griddle/pan over a medium heat, and add 2 teaspoons of the spice mix. Place all ingredients except toast under the griddle and turn often until the meat is cooked. Serve the toast with the tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,vanilla bean,dark chocolate,white wine,chili garlic sauce,creole seasoning,blueberry
title: Blueberry Chili Concoction
ingredients: 1 pint fresh blueberries or 1 pint frozen blueberries | 4 ounces dark chocolate | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons creole seasoning | 2 -3 tablespoons wine or 2 -3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the berries of your choice in a 9 x13 baking dish. Set aside. If using frozen blueberries, thaw them if frozen. Using a food processor mince 2 or 3 of them until finely minced. Add the remaining berries then the chile garlic sauce, creole seasoning, wine or vinegar and vanilla bean. Set aside. Drizzle the chocolate mixture from the food processor on top of berries and toss gently. Place in the oven and bake 30 minutes stirring once or twice until the chocolate is melted and the berries are warmed up. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: tomato,curry leaf,chinese five spice powder,red potato,avocado,rice vinegar,brown rice
title: Curried Brown Rice with Tomatoes, Avocados and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice, uncooked | 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, quartered | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar, divided | 2 tablespoons tomoto yams ( in tomato sauce ) or 2 tablespoons avocados, diced | 4 -5 curry leaves | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Set aside. In a 10 inch nonstick skillet, add a splash of oil if necessary, then place the potatoes on the pan and cook, covered, over medium high heat for 15 minutes without disturbing them, or moving them. When the edges of the potatoes are browned and crisp, remove the skillet from the heat, then, with a slotted spoon, turn the whole potatoes over. Add remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons rice to the skillet and, using the back of a large spoon, sprinkle over 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper. Add rice, tomatoes, curry leaves and five spice powder. Stir well or mash with a potato masher to a puree, then pour mixture in the skillet. Sprinkle with more salt and cayenne pepper if desired. Simmer over low heat, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the liquid evaporates and the potatoes are tender. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,red chilies,plum tomato,ranch dressing,yellow cornmeal
title: Mexican Cabbage & Cornbread
ingredients: 1 small savoy cabbage | 1 plum tomato | 2 ounces yellow cornmeal | 1 teaspoon red chilies, chopped | 4 teaspoons ranch dressing
instructions: Cook the cabbage in the microwave uncovered for 5 minutes or until slightly tender, then peel. Cut the cabbages into 3 quarters and place half into a greased baking dish. Peel and deseed the tomato and slice it in quarter and place it on top of the cabbage. Sprinkle the cornmeal over this then the chilies and seasoning then pour the dressing over the top. Bake in a preheated oven at 200c for 40 minutes.

title: Pickled Eggs (Huachéos)
ingredients: 10 guajillo chilies or 10 spanish spanish spanish chiles | white flour, for dusting
instructions: Slit a chile lengthwise into 5 or 6 slices. Place the chile slices on a flat surface about 2 inches wide and 1 inch long. Brush with some of the water that has been collected in a small bowl. Sprinkle with some salt. Let stand 15 minutes. Cut into fingers about 2 or 3/4 inch wide and 1 or 2 inches long. Sprinkle with a little more salt. Fry a few at a time in just enough hot oil to darken the skin. Drain on paper towels, sprinkle with fresh epazote, and keep hot. Note, epazote keeps bugs out. Serve with hot tortillas or other filling.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,apple juice,golden raisin,mushroom stem,amaretto,button mushroom
title: Amaretto-Marinated Onions
ingredients: 2 cups apple juice | 1 1/2 cups sliced mushrooms, or more to taste | 1/4 cup golden raisins, or more to taste | 1/4 cup amaretto, or more to taste, divided | 2 jars sliced fresh mushrooms stems and pieces, drained | 1 spanish-style onion, cut into eighths
instructions: Combine apple juice, mushrooms, green raisins, 1/4 cup amaretto, mushrooms stems, and onion in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,mix,red wine,ra el hanout spice mix,lamb shoulder,msg,horseradish,buttermilk
title: Tashreeh
ingredients: 600 g lamb shoulder, cubed | 1 1/2 cups fresh buttermilk | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon ground horseradish | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons hosaradish-flavored mix | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: Place the lamb in your favourite container and add the remaining ingredients, apart from the papadsha. Cover the container and refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours, although ideally, overnight is better. Remove the lamb from the marinade and grill on a bbq or under the grill until desired doneness, about 40 minutes for medium. Serve at once, accompanied with rice and salad greens, and a fresh vegetable such as cauliflower florets, chopped tomatoes and cucumbers or potatoes, or as required.

title: Coffee Pudding - a Japanese Sweet Dish
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 tablespoon dashi ( instant ) | 1 cup coffee, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon orange juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bring to boil on low heat, stirring occasionally to avoid burning.

title: Spicy White Chocolate Bark
ingredients: 2 lbs unsalted white chocolate | 1/4 cup cardamom seed | 1 3/4 lbs cheese, grated ( preferably marble-type )
instructions: Melt white chocolate at a double boiler over hot water, with the cardamom seeds. Stir. Stir frequently until melted and thick. Stir in cheese. Pour into waxed paper lined jelly roll tin. Cool slightly, spread if desired. Cut Bark with cookie cutters.

title: Cheese Sticks (South Beach Indian Snack)
ingredients: 24 slices american cheese ( about 1/8-inch thick ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( or to taste ) | 3 - 3 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning
instructions: Preheat wok and fry cheese slices over high heat until browned. Put cheese to the side. Add the salt and taco seasoning to the fried cheese and mix them together. You may want to use 1 - 2 teaspoons of salt per cheese slice. Put all the cheese into a paper bag and let sit a little bit before cutting into squares.

title: Vegetable Crumble
ingredients: 1 medium yellow squash | 1 medium zucchini | 1 cup dried apricot, sliced | 125 g mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries | 2 ounces goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cube the vegetables and place into a lightly oiled casserole pan with the dried fruit and mushrooms. Season and sprinkle crumbs on top. Sprinkle cheese over mixture and put the whole in a preheated oven at 220c for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Pork Gravy
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 3 cans or bottles beer | 1 container half-and-half cream
instructions: Place pork in a plastic freezer bag with enough space to freeze. Freeze until solid, about 1 hour. Reserving the freezer bag, remove meat from freezer bag, and discard the bag. Place pork in a slow cooker, cover, and fill with beer. Cover, and cook on low, 8 hours. Remove pork cubes, discarding their fat, and let cool slightly. Strain liquid, and pour back into the slow cooker. Place the half and half in a large bowl, and stir in pork, then cover and continue cooking on high until liquid is reduced to about half, about 1 hour.

title: Kurdish Sour Cream Choux
ingredients: 200 g fresh sour cream cheese, at room temperature | 1/2 cup urad dal | 10 saffron strands
instructions: Mix all together in a bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,porcini mushroom,moisture part mozzarella cheese,plain flour,balsamic vinegar,lasagna noodle
title: Quick Mushroom Lasagne
ingredients: 5 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 500 g marinated porcini mushrooms | 8 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 6 sheets lasagna noodles | 1 cup shredded low-moisture part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat over to 180c. Toss mushrooms in the flour to coat and heat a frying pan. Add the boullion and cook over a high heat until the boullion has evaporated. Add balsamic vinegar and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until the stock is reduced and starting to smell lovely and syrupy. Drain mushrooms and add to the stock mix. Allow the sauce to thicken slightly and add shredded cheese. Boil lasagne sheets for 8 - 10 minutes and remove from heat. Scoop a small amount of the sauce onto each warmed lasagne sheet and spread with a little of the sauce from the frying pan. Add mushrooms and sprinkle with mozzarella. Return to a boil.

Random Ingredients: broth,grainy mustard,italian tomato,ranch salad dressing,spring onion,red chili pepper,nutmeg,cocoa powder
title: Homemade Chunky Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup canned whole italian tomatoes ( drained ) | 1 cup leftover broth | 2 tablespoons ranch salad dressing | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon grainy mustard ( to taste ) | 1 -2 red chili pepper | 3 -4 spring onions | 1/2 - 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Rmove all the crusts from the tomatoes, place in food processor and process until smooth. Add a couple tbsp of broth and blend til smooth. Add the rest of the ingredients and process till smooth or thick. If too dry add more broth.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,green lentil,cumin seed,snow pea,cake flour,button mushroom,poppy seed
title: Muamba De Porco
ingredients: 8 ounces pork loin or 8 ounces leg of pork | 1 cup green lentil, washed | 8 ounces button mushrooms, washed and stemmed and chopped, about 3 cups | 12 ounces snow peas, trimmed and washed, tips trimmed | 1 cup pepsi or 1 cup sour doughnuts, cut in half if they are in a box or ( 200 g ) box, toasted | 1 teaspoon dried cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Slice the pork into thin strips, about 2 inches long, and place in a bowl with the lentils. Add half the mushrooms and stir to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 1 hour and up to 1 day. Wash, trim and deseed the snow peas. Drain the meat and mushrooms. Drain the meat, reserving the liquid and any liquid. Slice meat across the grain very thinly, including the fat into strips. Set the meat and mushrooms aside. Put the flour on a clean work surface. Add about 5 tbsp of the soaking liquid from the meat and lentils and mix together. Add the poppy seeds and cumin. Toss the flour around the meat and lentil mixture until you have a nice sticky dough. Transfer the dough to a flat tray or a large nonstick pan, dust the bread with a little more flour and roll the dough into a round 10 in diameter. Flute the bread. Cut into 2 equal triangles about 4 in width and then use a spoon to place a 1/4 of a cup of meat mixture along the bottom. Add a few pieces of snow peas, a few pieces of pork and a few mushrooms. Alternate the filling and meat, laying them together as you go, arranging them in the pan, arranging them in a circle 3/4 in from the other side of the pan. Continue until all the ingredients and wrappers have been used. Spread the pepsi or sour dough over the vegetables. Fold the bottom one of the triangles up over the filling, and roll up, using a second piece of dough to make a roll that is 2 in diameter and 2 deep. Unroll the first roll and transfer it to the pan.

Random Ingredients: lemon jell o gelatin,chuck,garlic paste,cake flour,almond extract,mushroom,acorn squash,pizza crust
title: Crispy Roasted Vegetable Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 unbaked pizza crust | 1 lb ground chuck | 1/4 lb mushroom, cleaned chopped | 1 box pillsbury refrigerated reduced-fat cheddar-jack cheese blend | 1 cup acorn squash, peeled, seeded, coarsely chopped | 1 jar sliced almonds, drained | 2 tablespoons lemon jell-o gelatin | 1 teaspoon garlic paste, if required | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. Place squash slices on a wire rack to drain off excess moisture. Sprinkle squash with 1/2 tsp salt and allow to dry on a rack 15 - 25 minutes. Cut crust into eight 3x8 inch rectangles and place on a rimmed baking sheet. For each roll up, place 1/2 lb of beef and sliced mushrooms around edge of a rectangular shaped glass baking dish or roasting pan. Cover beef with chopped onion. Cover mushrooms with cheese and then top with acorn squash, spreading evenly. Cover with thickly sliced almonds. Combine gelatin, garlic paste, and almond extract, if desired, and mix well. Pour the cheese mixture over the top cover with aluminum foil. Bake 40 - 50 minutes. Remove foil and cook 5 - 6 minutes longer. Allow to stand 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,coconut cream,golden raisin,sumac,coriander powder,beef sirloin steak,cider vinegar,bay seasoning
title: Grilled Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon golden raisin | 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 1 cup coconut cream | 13 ounces coconut cream | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the coriander powder, curry powder, and golden raisins until well blended. Brush the beef with 1/4 cup coconut cream and sprinkle evenly with the coriander mixture. Press the beef onto the coconut mixture with your hands to coat each side evenly. Grill over medium hot coals or medium high heat, until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. While meat is grilling, combine coconut cream, coconut cream, old bay seasoning, and cider vinegar. Stir to combine.

title: Jalisco Escarole
ingredients: 1 lb escarole, washed well, chopped | 1 medium green pepper, deseeded and chopped | 1 large orange peel, cut into four 1 inch strips ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bowl of a heavy 5 quart crockpot, cover and cook on high until greens are tender and liquid has reduced to about 1 1/4 1 1/2 cups, 3 - 4 hours. Stir well before serving if using crockpot.

title: Yogurt (Lebanese Style)
ingredients: 3 vidalia onions, thinly sliced | 1 cup non-fat powdered milk | 1 1/4 cups prepared harissa | 2 1/4 cups broth | 8 -10 flour tortillas
instructions: Saute onions in butter.

title: Cheese Cubes
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/3 cup ginger-garlic paste | 2 bags velveeta cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the cheese is fully melted. Take off heat. Serve immediately.

title: Dairy Free Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dairy free cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon vegetables | 5 seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Keep refrigerated and use within 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,jasmine rice,arugula,agave,chocolate ice cream,malibu rum,soy sauce,ice water
title: Malibu Rum Roll
ingredients: 4 cups ice or 4 cups water | 2 cups unsweetened chocolate ice cream | 1/2 cup light agave silver dragees | 1/2 cup malibu rum | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 10 maraschino cherries | 1 cup arugula ( baby greens ) or 1 cup boston lettuce, washed
instructions: Crush ice cream into a large bowl. In the bottom of the bowl add the shaved ice to keep from softening or cracking when stirred. Dipped shaved ice cream will add a nice aroma and flavor to the ice cream. Next add the malibu rum and soy sauce and mix together. Next add the chocolate ice cream and mix in gently. Next add the agave silver slivers of ice and mix in gently. Pour into a small container and then in the fridge for 30 minutes and once the chocolate ice cream has been set pour it onto a cutting board and divide the arugula or lettuce leaves evenly. Place a spoonful of chocolate ice cream in the center of each leaf and roll up tightly. Repeat the process until all is used up.

title: Pepperoni Kolaches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 package cellophane noodles | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/2 cup molasses | 3 ounces sliced pepperoni, chopped | 1 1/2 cups fresh cherries, quartered | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint, or more to taste | tabasco sauce, to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar, for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Grasp the edge of a chilled or slightly wet towel with the shiny side of the towel. Heat 2 tablespoons of molasses in a small saucepan over low heat until the molasses is melted, about 2 minutes. Gradually stir 2 tablespoons of confectioners' sugar into the hot molasses mixture. Set aside remaining molasses mixture and set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Drop in the noodles, and cook until tender yet firm to the bite, about 3 minutes. Drain. Place one tablespoon of spaghetti sauce in a separate bowl and place a few cherry pieces into the sauce. Place cooked noodles on serving plates. Top noodles with a small spoonful of melted pepperoni.

title: Aussie Lamb Meatballs and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground lamb | 1 yellow onion, finely diced | 2 teaspoons tamari | 2 fresh hot peppers, finely diced or 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons jam, of any flavour
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f. In a bowl combine the lamb, onion, tamari chillies and pepper. Mix well then form into walnut sized meatballs and arrange on a tray lined with foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 400f and bubble or steam the meatballs for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,baby spinach,mint,german chocolate cake mix,baking potato,irish whiskey,onion,prune
title: Kittencal's Irish Mint Muffins With Potted Spoons
ingredients: 1 cup frozen baby spinach, defrosted | 2 large baking potatoes, halved and cut in 4 diagonal slices ( about 2 pounds ) | 3/4 cup irish whiskey ( such as jameson ) | 1 3/4 cups prunes, pits removed and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon minced of fresh mint | 1 small onion, minced | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 1/2 cups german style chocolate cake mix
instructions: Preheat over to 400f or 180c. Spray 12 muffin pans and set aside. Combine spinach, potatoes, wine liqueur, prunes, mint, onion and garlic. Set aside. Stir together in one bowl the chocolate and the spice mixture. Stir in the mix and the 1 1/2 cups of the chocolate mix to just combine and set aside. Fold 1/3 of the potato mixture and then stir in the remaining potato mixture to just combine and then stir the potato mixture into the coated muffin pan.
