Bake until the muffins t spring back when lightly pressed and lightly golden on top, abut 30 to 35 minutes. Remove and let cool 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Peachy Peaches with Feta Cheese
ingredients: 1 can beef stock | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 ripe peaches, pitted and sliced | salt and chopped fresh peaches
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the beef stock and taco seasoning. Toss in the sliced peach slices. Serve with fresh bread slices.

title: Macaroni Cheese Filling for Pierogi (Pierogi)
ingredients: 2 lbs macaroni, cooked al dente
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package direction.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,chipotle chile,penne,cauliflower floret,puff pastry,cashew nut
title: Penne With Cauliflower, Macadamia, and Cream
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | 1 cauliflower floret, cut into florets | 1 tablespoon cashew nuts | 8 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 dried chipotle chile ( in adobo ) | 1 sheet smoked pasta ( short or tube shaped )
instructions: In a large pot, bring water to a boil and add salt. Add pasta and cook per package directions, only if using small pasta like prawns. Drain pasta and place into medium bowl. While pasta and pasta are cooking, steam cashew nuts in a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat until slightly golden, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove nuts from skillet onto paper towels and set aside. Add chili pepper to skillet and remove chile from heat. Using a mortar and pestle, pestle, or a wooden spoon, mash chile into the cashew nuts until smooth. Add thyme and nut mixture and combine. Set aside. Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Remove the pastry sheet with a spatula from the refrigerator. Cut into twelve squares. Place a teaspoonful of the filling onto each square. Fold up the pastry dough and pinch the edges of the pastry around the filling to form a half moon. Place on baking sheet. Repeat with remaining pastry, filling, and pastry. Place baking sheet in oven and bake until pastry is puffed, bubbling, and golden, about 25 minutes. Let cool for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Roasted Corn, Mascarpone and Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 1 can creamed corn | 1 cup mascarpone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a food processor, grind the creamed corn into a fine crumble. Transfer to a mixing bowl and stir in the mascarpone. Transfer mixture to a shallow baking dish. Bake, covered, for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and pour roasted corn mixture into a blender or bowl.

title: Quick and Easy No-Yeast Roast Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 jar mascarpone cheese | 1 1/2 cups rye flour
instructions: Place roast in a roasting pan. Mix mascarpone cheese and rye flour together, and scatter over roast roast. Let stand at room temperature for an hour or a less, to allow the juices to redistribute. Bake at 300 degrees f for 3 hours, turning, until the meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f for medium rare at the bone. Let stand for 15 minutes before slicing, to let juices and gravy develop.

title: Cuban Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless chuck roast | 1 package frozen orange juice concentrate | 4 yellow squash
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cover and heat on low for 8 hours. Shred beef with fork and serve on buns.

title: Italian Nuts (Cooks Hen)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frozen mixed nuts ( if you don't have time to prepare fresh nuts ) | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon cinnamon ( or more ( if your taste is sour ) | 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter, melted
instructions: Put butter in a large bowl and blend in the hot nuts. Mix well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,bean sprout,duck breast,pork,beef chuck roast
title: Beef and Pork Curry With Mustard Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef chuck roast ( very tender and can be cut up into 8 individual servings ) | 8 pieces pork ( or cut into thin strips or slices and fry in a bit of oil or butter ) | 1 lb beef chuck roast ( or cut into slices and fryin a bit of butter or olive oil mixed with the flour ) | 1 can roasted red curry paste ( more if desired ) | 1 cup bean sprouts ( optional, about 10 or 15 )
instructions: Trim the beef chuck roast or pork of any visible fat, and slice into 4 individual portions or into smaller sizes. Cut the pork into 2 inch squares or even smaller chunks. In a large pot, place the beef and the pork pieces and add the sliced beef and pork pieces, the curry paste, the remaining 1/2 cup water or broth, and about 3/4 cup of water or broth. Bring to just a boil and then turn the heat to simmer, partially covered, for 2 hours. Stir the contents of the pot every 15 or 30 minutes to ensure that the meat pieces are well cooked and then remove from the heat when needed to keep warm. You may add sliced mushrooms on top for flavor or serve as the main dish with the curry. You can also serve this dish with steamed white rice, as part of a quick lunch for a quick lunch on a lazy, or just use leftover beef as a substitute for beef or pork. Use a little bit of butter or olive oil, if you'd like, to keep the pot clean. I've never tried it, but it may be good to add cooked shrimp, sliced red capsicum, fresh ginger, or even a can of diced tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: scallion,bean,head cabbage,white wine vinegar,raisin,cherry tomato,soy sauce,sriracha hot sauce
title: Vegetarian Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 4 medium cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, thinly sliced ( beef tips ) | sriracha hot sauce ( or other hot sauce ) | 3 scallions, minced | 3 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 2/3 cup raisins | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, quartered ( about 15 ) | 1 1/2 lbs beans, prepared ( about 1 lb )
instructions: Remove the rind from the cabbage and cut into six even squares. Separate the cabbage leaves lengthwise and discard the hard core. Cut each leaf crosswise into 4 strips. In a large bowl, combine the steak, scallions, vinegar, soy sauce and hot sauce and combine well. Spread the mixture evenly over most of the prepared cabbage leaves making sure to leave a few bare spaces along the edges. Arrange the tomato and bean quarters on top of the steak mixture and gently press the edges. Wrap each with aluminum foil and place on a cookie sheet. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 - 5 hours or until serving time. Preheat the oven to 450°f. Remove the aluminum foil and bake for 10 - 12 minutes until the cabbage is crisp and the filling is warmed through. Cut into 4 rolls and serve as directed.

title: Oven-Fried Rice Noodles With Clams
ingredients: 6 cups prepared fresh rice noodles | 2 cups frozen cooked clams, thawed | 2 -3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh minced onions ( i usually just use a jarred onion ) | 2 -3 tablespoons drained chopped pimientos | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles and set aside place all of the rest of the ingredients except for the fried noodles in a heavy duty freezer bag. Add noodles to the bag. Seal bag and let sit 15 minutes to marinate. Heat oil in a wok or large fry pan over medium heat. Add noodles and marinate 1 to 2 minutes. Drain noodles, sprinkle with cinnamon and serve.

title: Spaghetti with Chicken and Eggplant
ingredients: 16 ounces whole wheat spaghetti or 16 ounces other long, thin spaghetti, i prefer spaghetti | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs or 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 lb eggplant, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2 inch dice | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1/2 cup currants | 1/2 cup grated fresh lime zest | 1 -2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package, draining when done. Meanwhile, in large skillet, heat 1/2 inch olive oil over medium heat, add chicken, and saute until almost done, about 10 minutes or until cooked through. Remove chicken and set aside. Add eggplant in batches, and saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes or until tender. Remove from skillet. Drain fat from skillet. Return skillet to medium heat, add remaining olive oil. Add eggplant and serrano pepper. Saute until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. Deglaze skillet with currants and lime zest. Add chicken and vegetables, and stir. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes or until mixture thickens, stirring constantly. Season with salt and pepper. Serve warm.

title: Mint Liqueur
ingredients: 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa | 24 mint leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 ounces dried cranberries
instructions: Place the cocoa and mint leaves in the bottom of a glass jar or jar with a lid. Pour the liqueur into the jar and shake until the mint leaves are coated with the flavored liqueur. The liqueur should cover the mint and cocoa within a few seconds. Stir in the dried cranberries. Fill the jar with ice.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,thai fish sauce,mint leaf
title: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 4 leaves fresh mint leaves, chopped | 4 teaspoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Melt the paste in a small frying pan. Once it’s fragrant, add mint leaves, stir fry for one minute. Add fish sauce and stir fry for one minute. Taste to test the seasoning. Enjoy note, you can substitute any other herbs for the mint and other dried spices.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,half cream,feta,chili sauce,cream chicken soup,white miso,maraschino cherry,lamb
title: Baked Feta
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground lamb | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup white miso | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries, chopped | 1/4 cup feta, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Mix the ground lamb with the half and half, cream of chicken soup, and chili sauce. Add the miso and apple juice, and mix thoroughly. Place in a baking dish just a bit smaller than the feta. Drizzle with the feta cheese. Bake in preheated oven for about 25 minutes, or until the feta is bubbly and lightly browned. It should take about 15 minutes in the oven.

title: Smothered Mexican Tilapia
ingredients: 3 tilapia fillets | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon paprika | 4 bananas | 2 cups mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to high and line a baking sheet with foil. Combine cream of tartar and paprika and rub half of paste onto tilapia fillets. Place tilapia fillets on prepared baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Spread remaining paste onto remaining tilapia fillets. Top fillets with pan juices and sprinkle with cheese. Broil 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts and fish is lightly browned.

title: Baby Bok Choy With Lemon Juice
ingredients: 1 package baby bok choy, rinsed and trimmed | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat. Place the baby bok choy in the skillet, cover, and steam until tender. Remove cover and add the lemon juice to the cooked bok choy.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,active yeast,head cauliflower,chinese celery,pea,chicken broth,coconut milk
title: Thai Curried Cauliflower and Peas
ingredients: 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1 1/2 cups small cubes chinese celery | 1 can light coconut milk
instructions: Place the broth, yeast, garlic salt, cauliflower, peas and celery in a large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 45 minutes. Add the coconut milk and stir together. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Pour the curried sauce into the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Spareribs and Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 beef flank steak, trimmed | 3 tablespoons light-colored liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 cabbage or 2 cups cabbage with leafy greens, thinly sliced and stems left on | 8 ounces topside mince
instructions: Heat a heavy 10 skillet on medium high heat. Sprinkle beef with liquid smoke flavoring. Layer with cheese/green pepper, meat, cabbage and mince. Cover pan, and cook until desired doneness, about 10 minutes.

title: Ginger Vegetables
ingredients: 2 teaspoons gingerroot, minced or 2 teaspoons ginger, grated | 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped | 1/4 cup oatmeal | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup boiling water
instructions: Mix all above ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate up to 2 hours. Serve cold with your favourite sauce.

title: Spiced Beef & Apricots
ingredients: 1 lb filet of beef, sliced | 4 ounces gorgonzola | 1 medium onion, sliced | 1/2 ounce dry onion soup mix | 1/4 pint coffee | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Preheat a pan very hot. Add one ounce of butter. In a dish with a lid, place the beef slices and a half ounce of gorgonzola and stir. Add two slices of onion, stir. Pour over the coffee, add the packet of onion soup mix and stir the contents of the pan up a little bit. Add beef slices after several minutes. Cook the beef for a total of 90 seconds. When the beef is cooked in 90 seconds most of the liquid should have come out. Cover and set aside for at least ten minutes. Once the beef has finished cooking place a slice of gorgonzola on top of the beef. Then cover and heat until it begins to melt. It is very important to not get the cheese burned. Serve over boiled potatoes, or at your preferred meal.

Random Ingredients: white miso,colby monterey jack cheese,farfalle pasta
title: American Miso Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 tablespoon white miso | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: potato,chocolate curl,blueberry,monterey jack cheese,button mushroom,sesame seed
title: Blueberry and Mashed Potatoes Surprise #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 8 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup frozen blueberries | 3 ounces canned button mushrooms | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | chocolate curls ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl combine everything and blend till well incorporated. Place mixture in 8x4 baking dish then sprinkle with chocolate curls. Bake 30 minutes to 1 hour or until top is golden brown and potatoes are tender and browned in spots. Variation you can add 1 - 3 tblspn cornstarch to the blueberry and milk mixture or add a few drops of brown syrup and sugar before serving if desired.

title: Easy Mustard and Red Pepper Scallops
ingredients: 4 teaspoons whole black mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons roasted red peppers, drained & chopped | 1/2 cup fat-free evaporated milk | 18 sheets aluminium foil | aluminum foil
instructions: Mix mustard seeds, red pepper, and evaporated milk in a bowl. Place 4 sheets of aluminium foil on a work surface, and coat with non stick cooking spray. Place scallops in a microwave safe bowl, and cook on high power 2 - 3 minutes. Carefully remove scallops onto foil, and spread mustard mixture onto each one. Wrap scallops in foil, and place on plate. Microwave on high 1 minute, then cover tightly. Microwave on high 20 - 25 minutes, or til scallops are no longer opaque. Remove foil, and let sit 5 minutes, then cut into four large squares for serving.

title: Angel Hair Pasta Chips
ingredients: 2 cups angel hair pasta | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Boil a pot of salted water for angel hair pasta. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook angel hair pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain. When angel hair pasta is done, drain well and toss with hot angel hair pasta in the pan.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,yellow squash,olive oil,swiss cheese,mace,mustard powder,ricotta cheese
title: Squash Calzones With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese, finely shredded | 1 yellow squash, halved, seeded and thinly sliced ( about 4 cups ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil, plus extra | olive oil, for cooking | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon mace | 1 container ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke, plus extra | liquid smoke, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the cheese, squash, 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, mustard powder, and mace. Divide the squash mixture between 2 clean, rimmed, large baking dishes, and press down with your hands to create a well. Fill each cavity with about 1/2 cup ricotta. Using your fingers, sprinkle on 1 teaspoon of liquid smoke over each filled cavity. Cover the stuffed dish with plastic wrap, then refrigerate 1/2 hour. Preheat an oven to 375°. Drizzle the remaining 1 - 2 teaspoons of olive oil over the casseroles. Bake until hot, about 10 minutes. Transfer to warm platters, drizzle with remaining 1 teaspoons of olive oil, and serve.

title: Catherine's Honey Glazed Chicken Wing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat bread flour | 1 - 1 1/2 cup unsulfured sultana | 2 tablespoons capers | 2 lbs chicken wings ( or wings of your choice ) | 2 lbs russet potatoes ( peeled and skinned ) | 1 pineapple ( leaves ) | 1/2 cup chopped apricots ( to decorate ) or 1/2 cup sultana ( to decorate )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f coat a pyrex baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, mix the flour, sultanas, capers and raisins. Toss with the chicken wings and potatoes. Spread the coated potatoes evenly in the baking dish. Bake about 40 minutes or until thoroughly glazed and golden on top. Cool. Add apricots or sultanas to decoration. Enjoy. Notes, you can use this to decorate chicken and duck breasts. Just use more or less of each according to the size of the wings and potatoes. I have made this with duck breasts.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,ghee,red cabbage,monterey jack cheese,provolone cheese,sugar snap pea,cremini mushroom,chili pepper
title: Mushroom, Lentil and Cheese Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 cup light brown lentils or 1/2 cup brown rice, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon ghee, divided | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stemmed ( about 2. 5 ounces ) or 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, cleaned and sliced ( about 2. 5 ounces ) | 8 ounces red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup shredded carrot ( or 1/2 cup shredded carrot ) | 1/4 cup shredded reduced-fat monterey jack cheese | sugar snap peas, trimmed and diagonally sliced | hot chili pepper, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: In a 12” nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium high heat. Add mushrooms and sauté 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add remaining olive oil to pan. Stir fry mushrooms 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer to bowl. Add remaining ingredients to pan.

title: Lemongrass and Soy Bean Dip
ingredients: 400 g soybeans | 1 small stalk lemongrass, cut lenghtways | 6 whole cloves | 2 tablespoons fish sauce, as per taste ( nam pla )
instructions: Boil your whole pods for about 5 minutes or just till they start 'bloom'. While they still warm, put them in a blender. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix. Serve as accompaniments with your favourite veggies such as chinese rice, noodle noodles, or anything else you please. Note, if you are using regular soy beans, then you may want to wash them first in a tea towel then in a sink full of cold water. It should leave plenty of fiber.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,mirin,oil,chicken breast,rye bread,orange flower water,yellow squash,green apple
title: Crunchy Summer Rolls
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( about 3oz ) | 8 slices rye bread | 4 ounces fresh snow peas | 2 -3 oranges, depending on size and colour ( optional ) | 1 green apple, sliced | 1 yellow squash, sliced | 2 tablespoons sesame mirin ( sweet soy sauce, or tamari ) | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Place a grill pan on the low heat and place the chicken breasts on grill pan. Turn the chicken breasts over and spray them lightly with canola oil. Cook the chicken until it is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 160°f transfer to a plate. When the chicken is cool enough, slice the bread into thin slices and place in a bowl. Add the peas, orange slices and sliced apple to the bread and stir gently. Arrange the chicken on plates, place 4 slices of chicken on each plate. Sprinkle the sesame mirin over the chicken and eat from the side of the plate.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,pea,alfredo sauce,hard egg,green chili pepper,kaffir lime leaf,lemon wedge
title: Spicy White Clam Chowder
ingredients: 3 anaheim chilies | 1 can chopped green chili peppers | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 25 alfredo sauce | 3 fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn into small pieces | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas | lemon wedge
instructions: Place anaheims, green chilies, chopped eggs, alfredo sauce, lime leaves, and frozen peas into a large pot of simmering salted water. Cook until shrimp is pink and tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a soup crock and toss with lime juice.

title: Peanut Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 package of tostados | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts | 12 sweet italian sausage rolls | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese or 1/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Open chiles lengthwise and remove seeds. In ungreased pan combine sausage, onions, chopped peanuts and cheese and fry together until cooked through. Arrange on rolls and bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Chinese White Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil
instructions: Spread the bean curds onto a plate, and microwave 30 seconds. Heat the sesame oil in a small skillet over medium high heat. Scoop the bean curds into the skillet using a spoon, and cook until the mixture has browned and started to turn from a toasted appearance. It should take about 10 seconds. Stir the bean curds gently to distribute the juices. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,bulb garlic,chicken wing,salt water,currant,white bread dough,nonfat cream
title: Banh Mi Baked Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh lemon grass ( about 3/4 pound total ) or 2 bunches fresh lemongrass | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 4 lbs fresh chicken wings, tips trimmed | 6 slices white bread dough ( about 10 inches long ) | salt. water | light nonfat sour cream
instructions: Gather lemongrass stalks and trim ends. Cut stalks into 2 inch lengths with root ends attached. Cut crosswise into 2 inch lengths. Place leaves in large bowl. Pour boiling hot water over lemongrass until water is 1 inch above leaves. Add currants. Let stand 1 hour. Squeeze leaves well to remove excess water. Pat leaves clean with paper towels. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Bring 2 quarts of water to boil. Add remaining 3 pounds of chicken wings. Cover. Bake 40 minutes. Discard water. Drain wings and reserve stock. Place bread dough in large bowl. Add 1 cup reserved stock and 1 pound of chicken wings to bread dough. Using fingers, stir until blended. Mix with enough of stock to make a smooth paste. Place 2 wings on each prepared baking sheet, leaving at least 1 inch space between wings. Brush wings with water. Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Serve with light nonfat sour cream.

Random Ingredients: red potato,banana,tandoori paste,parsnip,plain yogurt,vodka,chinese egg noodle
title: Tandoori Noodles #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages fresh chinese egg noodles | 2 bags fresh sweet potatoes | 1 large red potatoes | 1 medium parsnip | 1/2 cup tandoori paste ( or to taste ) | 2 -4 bananas | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Wash, peel and dice sweet potatoes, sweet potatoes and parsnip into 1/4 inch cubes. Peel and dice banana into strips. Dice tandoori paste into 1/4 inch pieces. Set aside in sink. Rinse hot noodles until the water runs clear or place in a plastic zipper bag and add to bag. Shake to mix, and set aside. Chop bananas into slices and add to bag. Shake to mix. Shake to mix. Add yogurt and mix. If noodles aren't as dry as the label suggests, add more oil or yogurt to moisten noodles. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pasta with the Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine | 1 1/4 lbs small white mushrooms | 6 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 lb small dried chinese noodles, of your choice
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil to cook the noodles. Combine the wine, mushrooms, thyme, and 3/4 cup of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook, uncovered, until the dish is reduced to about 1 cup, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. Drain the pasta, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid, and toss with the sauce in a large bowl. Serve with additional sauce if desired.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,black mustard seed,white baking chocolate
title: St. Joseph's Day Triple-Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 2 cups white baking chocolate, finely chopped | 1 can maraschino cherries, drained and patted dry | 4 -6 teaspoons black mustard seeds, lightly toasted
instructions: In a double boiler heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons of reserved maraschino cherry juice over medium heat, stirring as it melts until thick. Remove from heat and stir in the rest of the cherry juice. In a small bowl combine the mustard seeds and pepper and sprinkle over the tops of the cookies. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: brandy,margarine,rice noodle,red bean,chicken bouillon cube,pea,pinto bean,saffron strand
title: Taste of the Islands
ingredients: 600 g pinto beans, dried | 600 g red beans, from a tin | 600 g raw carrots, peeled, cut into chunks | 200 g margarine | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand, crushed | 2 tablespoons brandy | 200 g rice noodles, dry, cut into large squares | 100 g peas ( frozen or fresh )
instructions: Place the pinto beans, red beans, carrots, butter, bouillon, saffron, brandy and a little water into a large saucepan and bring to the boil over medium heat. Cover tightly and simmer for 40 minutes or until the beans are tender and the sauce thick. Stir in the noodles and cook uncovered for a further 15 minutes, or until they are tender and have absorbed most of the water. Stir in peas during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Discard the saffron strands.

title: Chocolate Steak
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa ( dutch's preferred brand ) | 2 lbs stewing beef ( cut into cubes )
instructions: In a glass or ceramic bowl, combine cocoa and beef. Cover and let marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: green chili sauce,cayenne,beef bouillon cube,soy cheese,red onion,hot sauce
title: Sneaky Chili Cheese Steaks
ingredients: 1/3 cup green chili sauce | 1/4 cup red onion, chopped | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 7 tablespoons soy cheese, grated | hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine the ingredients and whisk together. Pour over steaks. Simmer for 30 minutes or until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: pickle,cake flour,pork,cardamom pod,caramel topping,chinese cabbage,pesto sauce,baking potato
title: Chilled Pork Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs lean pork, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup prepared caramel topping | 1/3 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 3 carrots, cut into rounds | 6 large baking potatoes, peeled, cut into wedges | 3 packages chinese cabbage, cut into wedges, with stems left on. | 1/4 cup cake flour, sifted in a strainer
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine pork with caramel topping in large plastic bag. Marinate up to 8 hours. When ready to bake, arrange carrots and potatoes in 3 to a large shallow baking pan. Remove pork mixture from marinade and place meat on top of veggies. Toss lightly to coat. Pour marinade over meat making sure it is completely coated. Place in oven with vegetable wedges around the edges to prevent burning. Bake at 300 for about 2 hours or until tender and meat is falling off the bones. Serve with remaining caramel sauce, if desired. Makes approximately 30 servings. Note, you can prep and bake carrots and potatoes as above if baked in advance or refrigerate for later. Just add the carrots and potatoes as above.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,scallion,black bean,shell pasta,asiago cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,cod,peppercorn
title: Asiago Cod With Tomatillo Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 ounces fresh shucked cod, cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 large white cayenne pepper or 1 large black pepper pod | 1 can whole tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups lightly packed chopped ripe tomatoes with stems, such as a mexican, or can rotel tomatoes seasoned with garlic and olive oil, undrained | 10 -12 peppercorns | 1/2 lb medium shell pasta or 1/2 lb macaroni | 4 scallions, sliced into rings | 1/2 cup coarsely grated asiago cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet that can be covered and preheated over medium heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add cod to skillet and sear, turning, until browned deeply and flaky outside but still juicy in the center, about 8 minutes. Transfer fish to shallow bowl. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and cook undisturbed until just firm, 5 to 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat oven to 375°f in small bowl or measuring cup, combine remaining ingredients except cheese. Set aside. Remove fish from skillet and place in an ovenproof 6 to 8 quart baking dish, spreading evenly. Cover and bake until fish is just cooked through and flakes when pierced with a fork, about 45 minutes. Discard remaining sauce. Serve sprinkled with asiago cheese.

title: Filled Flatbread With Sweet Potato & Rice Flour Topping
ingredients: 1 pita bread, split | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 tablespoons club soda, or to taste ( optional ) | 5 sweet potatoes ( optional ) | 1 envelope frozen sweet potato flour, for topping
instructions: Place enough rice flour into a resealable plastic bag to cover 1/4 inch in depth. Add club soda to taste if using. Add sweet potato flour and resealable plastic bag to bag.

title: Quick and Easy Vietnamese Salad
ingredients: 1 red leaf lettuce, washed and dried | 1 tablespoon fish sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place lettuce in large lettuce bowl. Arrange red leaf on top. Sprinkle with fish sauce.

title: Rainbow Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 cups seedless watermelon ( about 5 lbs. ) | 1/4 cup rice wine or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: Wash the watermelon and place in a mesh strainer. Gather all the strings from the skin and remove the fibers with the fingers. Place the watermelon in a microwaveable bowl& mince with a fork. Combine in a large salad bowl or serve as desired.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,orange juice,red chilies,pickling spice,leek,ginger syrup
title: Crispy Fried Brown Rice (Porridge)
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice ( cold ) | 4 leeks ( white and pale green parts only ) | 1 red chilies ( seeded and finely chopped ) or 1 red pepper ( seeded and finely chopped ) | 1 orange, juice of | 2 teaspoons pickling spices | 1 teaspoon ginger syrup
instructions: Place all ingredients except the last 2 teaspoons salt in a pan and cook covered over a low heat, turning once for 15 - 20 minutes or until most of the water has absorbed and the rice is tender. When most of the water is absorbed remove from the heat. Serve sprinkled with remaining teaspoon salt.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,butter,jalapeno pepper,ancho chile powder,beef broth,angostura aromatic bitter
title: Buffalo Blueberry Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried blueberries ( can use more ) | 5 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 3 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 6 ounces sour red-pack blueberries or 6 ounces white berry cranberries, rinsed | 1 -4 jalapeno pepper ( or habanero pepper, if you're using it ) | 6 -10 dashes angostura aromatic bitters
instructions: Pour the blueberries into a food processor. Add the melted butter. Season with the chile powder, and pour into a small bowl. Cover, and let chill for at least 30 minutes. Drain the berries, and purée in a blender until they have a finely ground consistency, about ten to fifteen seconds. Add the sour red thawed strawberries, and pulse a few times to combine. Add the chile powder, and pulse briefly. Taste for salt and pepper, and add more if needed. You can refrigerate the soup for several hours or overnight, or even several days, before serving.

title: Puerto Rican Molasses Egg Jam
ingredients: 1 lb hard egg | 2 cups molasses
instructions: Slice the hard boiled egg, then put it in a food processor or blender and pulse into tiny bits a few inches long. You can also put it in a bowl with ice cubes and grind it well, if you like a smoother paste. Scrape into a storage container and add molasses.

title: Jamaican Okra
ingredients: 2 packages frozen okra, thawed, and peeled | 1 tablespoon ground allspice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place frozen okra in the boiling water, and cook 3 to 5 minutes. Drain okra, and remove skins. Scoop out and discard any remaining water. Spread okra on a microwave safe plate. Microwave on high 5 minutes. To serve, drizzle with allspice.

title: Aussie Risotto
ingredients: 1/4 cup long grain rice | 2 cups fresh coriander, chopped | 1 green chili pepper, chopped | 2 cans refrigerated biscuits, cut into chunks | pepperoni, sliced | 4 cups spinach leaves, rinsed
instructions: Cook rice in 4 cups of boiling water for 2 minutes or until tender. Drain rice through colander, pressing on rice to extract most of moisture and discarding any rice that does not. Chop coriander and chilies roughly. Place biscuits in a food processor and process until coarsely chopped. Spoon rice and biscuits into a large bowl. Add pepperoni and coriander mixture. Mix well. Add spinach and mix well. Spoon mixture over biscuits in bowl, pressing gently with fingers to shape mixture into a ball. Repeat until biscuits and crumbs are used up. Cover. Refrigerate for 20 minutes or until biscuits set.

title: Curry Parsnips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh minced parsnip | 1/2 teaspoon thai red curry paste | 1/2 lemon
instructions: Peel parsnips.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,basil,pine nut,grain white rice,romano cheese,dark brown sugar,curry paste,chicken bouillon
title: Simple Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice or 2 cups brown rice | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 1/4 cups dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil or 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/4 cup freshly grated romano cheese
instructions: Place the rice in a bowl and sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch. Pour enough lightly salted water into the rice to cover the rice by 2 inches, and leave the water level clear. Cover and let sit for 20 - 25 minutes. Rinse the rice in a 2 cup measure, or alternatively 1 3/4 cups water and 1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed in 1 teaspoon water. Soak the pine nuts in 2 tablespoons unsalted sunflower oil, and drain before adding them to the drained rice. In a small bowl, whisk together 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1/4 cup brown sugar, and 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon until a mixture forms a thin paste. Stir in the basil. Pour into 2 quart microwavable casserole, cover, and microwave on high for 15 - 18 minutes, until thick but stirring gently with a wooden spoon. Remove cover, stir rice gently into caramel sauce, and spread rice evenly in a grainy 2 quart baking dish, making an even layer. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup grated cheese, and microwave on medium, uncovered, for another 5 minutes, until browned and slightly bubbling.

title: Fettuccine With Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry fettuccine pasta | 1/4 cup a.1. original sauce | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | pepperoni | 1 celery rib, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.

Random Ingredients: coconut rum,anchovy fillet,ramen noodle,roast beef,worcestershire sauce
title: Rae (Jaegerlander) on the Run
ingredients: 1 can anchovy fillets, sliced | 1/2 lb thinly sliced roast beef | 5 ounces coconut rum | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 packages ramen noodles
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and pour over prepared beef. Toss well to coat all sides. Refrigerate 3 hours to marinate.

title: Borlotti and Risotto
ingredients: 350 g borlotti beans ( italian beans ) | 2 sprigs arborio rice | 1 liter vegetable stock | 1 carrot, grated | 1 liter ginger ale | 40 g blanched almonds ( optional )
instructions: Start by cleaning and deseed the beans, and then soak overnight in 2 liters of water. The next day, drain in a colander. When the beans are ready, rinse in cold water, and then drain again. Put the beans and vegetable stock in a large saucepan, and bring to the boil. Meanwhile, make the risotto. Cut the rind from the carrot and grate over a handful of almonds. In a large bowl, put the risotto, carrots, and almonds and mix together with the beans and vegetable stock. Reduce the stock and simmer for five minutes, then stir in the grated carrot. If the liquid evaporates, add some more. Simmer for five minutes. Then mix in the rind, and cook for a further five minutes. Remove from the heat and pour into a large, heat proof bowl, and allow to cool. The risotto should be slightly creamy as it will continue to swell as it cools. Reheat before serving.

title: Pumpkin and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 fresh pumpkin, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 english cucumber, chopped | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat. Lightly oil grate. Place pumpkin and cucumber in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cilantro, tumeric and salt and pepper. Toss to combine. Grill for 2 minutes per side, or until heated through. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,monterey jack cheese,tilapia fillet,coriander seed,italian bread,horseradish,sharp cheddar cheese,cream tartar
title: Tilapia in Horseradish Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 3/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 small yellow squash, sliced | 1 loaf round italian bread
instructions: Heat broiler. Dry fry coriander just until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add horseradish cream and stir to blend. Grill tilapia over hot coals, about 3 minutes for rare, 10 minutes for medium. Combine monterey jack cheese, yellow squash and horseradish sauce together in a shallow ovenproof dish. Place bread cubes on a baking sheet and drizzle with horseradish cream sauce. Top with tilapia and cheese. Broil tilapia 5 minutes to melt cheese.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,elbow macaroni,corn tortilla chip,parmesan cheese,beet,sirloin,spinach
title: Beef and Potato Lasagna - Ww Core
ingredients: 8 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 lb sirloin, thinly sliced ( or other lean meat of your choice ) | 2 ounces spinach, torn into small pieces ( or more ) | 1 cup corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed ( or fresh ) | 1/4 cup lemon peel, grated ( can use more for garnish if desired ) | 2 ounces parmesan cheese, shredded ( or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place macaroni in a large, shallow baking dish. Toss with meat, then top with spinach and crumbled tortilla chips. In a small bowl, lightly mix together grated lemon peel and parmesan cheese. Sprinkle over top. Bake, covered, 45 minutes on middle rack of oven, or until bubbly and cheese is beginning to brown. Serve.

title: Homemade Sage Pesto
ingredients: 1 bunch washed fresh sage leaf | 1/2 cup fresh romano cheese or 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place the sage leaves and cheese in a blender and pulse well until all the ingredients are finely chopped. Pour into a bowl and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,chili pepper,cayenne,amaretto,mexican cheese,cornflour,green lentil,green coriander
title: Mexican Nachos
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow green lentils | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon ground chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 7 -9 ounces processed mexican cheese ( or similar ) | 3 teaspoons superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons black mexican dried chili peppers ( or other cayenne pepper flavour ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon pure amaretto ( optional )
instructions: Place lentils in a large bowl and cover with water. Soak over a gentle heat in a saucepan for approximately 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain, then mash with a potato masher. Whisk cornflour, chili pepper, cayenne and salt in a small bowl and gradually whisk in sugar. Stir through cheese and continue whisking until melted and combined. Pour into frying pan, then heat. Stir in chilli/cilantro and cook until cheese melts and sauce is thickish. Serve sprinkled with black mexican spices.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,italian seasoning mix,white chocolate chip,portabella mushroom,thyme leave,bean,italian seasoning
title: Italian White Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup dry white chocolate chips | 1/2 cup dried portabella mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning ( mix or powder ) | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 0.5 can fat-free refried beans
instructions: Dump everything into blender and process until smooth. You may need adjustments to the bean/yogurt and/or seasonings. Serve chilled or hot with indian bread to dip.

Random Ingredients: peanut,romaine lettuce,fine sea salt,peanut oil,pasta,gouda cheese,cashew
title: Cashew Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces cashews | 1 small romaine lettuce, finely shredded | 1/2 cup roasted salted peanuts, finely chopped | 1/2 cup shredded smoked gouda cheese, plus extra to sprinkle on the pasta | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 pinch fine sea salt | 9 ounces cooked short pasta or 9 ounces cooked ziti pasta, drained
instructions: Put the cashews, romaine lettuce, peanuts and cheese in a large bowl. In a small saucepan, heat the oil over moderate heat. Season with salt and pepper and stir until the cheese melts. Pour the hot dressing over the salad and toss to combine. Divide the salad among 4 chilled plates and sprinkle with cashews and nuts. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Cannelloni Soup
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, broken into florets | 1 can elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
instructions: Cook elbow macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Add broccoli florets, cooked and drained macaroni to soup. Heat over medium heat for 1 minute.

title: Apricot And-Or Apricot Toss
ingredients: 1 pint apricot preserves | 2 pints lettuce leaves | 4 ounces ladyfingers | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon almond essence or 1/2-1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix apricot preserve and jam in a pan. Cook over a low flame with a lid on until thick and jam like. Remove from heat. Cut and arrange on a plate. Decorate with lettuce, and almond. Enjoy.

title: Corn Wine Balls or Mash
ingredients: 1 -2 cup fresh corn | 1 can sweetened condensed milk ( full fat ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon spices, of your choice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chardonnay wine or 1/2-3/4 cup other dessert wine
instructions: Place all of the ingredients except the chardonnay or dessert wine into the blender jar. Blend at the highest speed, stopping to scrape down the sides of the jar, occasionally scraping down the sides. The sauce will thicken into a smooth paste and hold its shape in jar for up to 3 cups when it is poured into jars. Place the chardonnay or dessert wine in a pot or deep skillet, heat the mixture over moderate heat until it just begins to boil, stirring frequently or stirring in no additions. Lower the flame and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until the mixture is thick and smooth, stirring often. Remove the mixture from heat and set aside to cool.

title: Simple Mexican Meat Dip - Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 package soft tortilla chips | 1 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 1 tablespoon of lemon zest | 1/2 lb salsa ( i love pace medium ) | 15 ounces of your favorite prepared tamales ( we use la victoria brand ) | 2 cans whole wheat flour ( i use gold medal brand )
instructions: Drain the tortilla chips. In a large bowl combine the cheese, tortilla chips, lemon zest, and salsa. Mix until combined. Place the prepared tamales in the slow cooker with the cheese mixture. Add the whole wheat flour to the cornmeal. Slowly mix into taco/starch mixture. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour, turn down by half, and slow cook another 2 hours. Serve hot with tortillas and guacamole..

title: Thai Chilled French Bread
ingredients: 3/4 lb stale white bread ( whole wheat ) | 10 -15 small dried red chiles, stems removed
instructions: Soak chiles in hot water for 20 - 30 minutes. Pour chiles on a shallow plate or bowl and let sit for 20 more minutes until they are limp and pliable. Slice bread 1/3 inch thick. Arrange the chiles on a plate or flat grill and grill, turning over a couple of times, until lightly toasted. If you want, you can slice a couple of times and dip them in chili oil. These should have nice grill marks and feel like they are cooked. Serve with more chili oil or vinegar.

title: Grilled Indian Spiced Oil
ingredients: 1/3 cup peanut oil | 1/3 cup cardamom seeds
instructions: Combine the oil, cardamom seeds and peanuts in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth and creamy. Store in a container or sealed container away from light.

title: Mint Salad
ingredients: 1/2 head arugula, chopped | 2 ounces bow tie pasta, cooked | 1/8 cup fresh mint, chopped | 1/8 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds, not sure what | 1 tablespoon crushed dried mint
instructions: Put cooked bow tie pasta, mint, cilantro, and mustard in large serving bowl. Add chopped, still fresh mint. Stir. Sprinkle with more mustard.

title: Roast Bacon
ingredients: 2 slices bacon | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Place bacon on a piece of heavy foil. Drizzle the honey on top. Wrap it all up and place in the center of the foil. Roast under a hot broiler until the bacon is crisply browned and crispy.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,white radish,okra,basil leaf,dark soy sauce,corn,chipotle pepper,cucumber
title: Okra and Corn Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds okra, ends trimmed, rinsed and sliced | 1 seedless cucumber, sliced thin | 1 cup chopped white radishes | 1 can sliced okra, drained | 4 whole chipotle peppers, seeded and minced | 1 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: In a large bowl combine okra, cucumber, radish, okra, chipotle peppers, basil, soy sauce and brown sugar. Toss with dressing and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to develop flavors.

title: Sichuan Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/3 cup molasses | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon whole szechuan peppercorn | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped toasted hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh galangal ( about 2 large cloves, or more ) or 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the molasses, cardamom and peppercorns. Stir in nuts and oil. Add the beef, turn to coat. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator, about 2 hours. Remove beef. Preheat the broiler to high, and broil the beef, turning once, until medium rare, about 12 minutes total. Slice the meat on the diagonal as thinly as possible.

Random Ingredients: bread,tortilla,anaheim chile pepper,thyme sprig,vegetable oil cooking spray,clove,bread crumb,beef bouillon cube
title: Chermoula Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 large roasted anaheim chile peppers | 1/2 teaspoon minced thyme sprig | 1 beef bouillon cubes ( dissolved in 2/3 cup boiling water ) or 1 beef bouillon granules ( dissolved in 2/3 cup boiling water ) | 1/4 cup soft bread crumbs, divided | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 8 -10 torn bread rolls | tortilla ( optional ) | chopped mild red bell peppers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place 2 whole anaheim chile peppers on an oven sheet or cookie sheet fitted with a rack. Broil 5 minutes, or until flesh is charred and blackened with charred spots. Immediately transfer to a large bowl. Sprinkle the blackened chiles with thyme and add the broth. Let cool to room temperature, about 25 minutes. Transfer the broth to a bowl and gradually stir in 1/4 cup bread crumbs. Spread the bread crumb mixture on a clean work surface and sprinkle with 1/4 cup soft bread crumbs. Working from the center outward, roll each pepper, starting at the small end, until the pepper is completely covered. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup soft bread crumbs. Place the stuffed peppers in a single layer on a broiler pan or cookie sheet and broil 1 minute more or until charred and crisp all over. Remove from oven. To serve, remove the peppers from oven and cut a slit lengthwise down one side of them. Insert a slice or two of bread into the slit and, if using, cut 1/2 inch slices of the roasted bell peppers. If desired, serve drizzled with a little additional broth and sprinkle with red bell pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: havarti cheese,oregano,grand marnier,watercress,romaine lettuce,parmigiano reggiano cheese,golden raisin,green onion
title: Italian Herb Mix with Grilled Cheese and Raisins
ingredients: 1/2 lb grated havarti cheese or 1/2 lb grated muenster cheese | 1/4 lb grated romano-reggiano cheese or 1/4 lb grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 8 green onions, sliced finely | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano | 3 cloves green onions, chopped ( with tops ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier or 1 1/2 teaspoons orange liqueur | 3 tablespoons watercress, chopped | 6 leaves romaine lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and reserve for basting. Brush grill with oil. Put 1/4 of the cheeses on the grill and baste with the herb mix.

title: Lightly Roasted Cremini Mushrooms, Tomatoes and Blueberries
ingredients: 1 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 4 large cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup tomato juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Drizzle the tomato juice evenly over the mushrooms. Cut the mushrooms slices crosswise into quarters lengthwise and set aside. Roast the mushrooms, uncovered, in the preheated oven, stirring once until lightly blackened on both sides, about 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and serve while hot..

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,savory,italian salad dressing mix,cherry tomato
title: Italian Pizza Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pizza crust, unbaked | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 3 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f. Place pizza crust on cookie sheet. In bowl, mix salad dressing mix, and savory. Spread over crust. Top with cherry tomatoes. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Spicy Baked Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled | 2 carrots, peeled and peeled | 1/4 cup chopped italian seasoned bread, divided | 1/2 cup shredded white cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 4 radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove potatoes and carrots from refrigerator and place on a pan. Cover with water and bring to a boil, then simmer until potatoes are tender, approximately 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well. Place potatoes, carrots, 1/4 cup bread and cheddar cheese into a large baking dish or 2 quart casserole dishes. Sprinkle over paprika and toss to coat. Bake in preheated oven until top is lightly browned and bubbly, approximately 30 minutes. Remove from oven and carefully spread the radishes on top of the casserole. Return to oven and cook additional 5 minutes until golden.

title: Homemade Veggies
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds carrots | 2 tablespoons kosher salt, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of well salted water to a boil. Add carrots, and cook uncovered for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cooking will dry the vegetables. Drain, and cool. When vegetables are cool enough to handle, peel off the skins. Place 1/4 cup of the carrot scrapings in the work bowl of a food processor, and pulse until finely chopped. Add 1 cup of the scraped carrot scrapings, and process well. Transfer the shredded carrots to a bowl, and add 1 more cup of the scraped carrot scrapings, and 1 tablespoon of salt. Combine all the ingredients. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 day until vegetables can be peeled and chilled.

Random Ingredients: absolut vodka,soymilk,beef gravy,cold water,thyme sprig,oil,chocolate,pepper sauce
title: Beef Gravy With Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 2 ounces absolut vodka | 2 cups cold water | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | grated chocolate, for garnish
instructions: In small saucepan, stir together oil, unsweetened chocolate, soymilk, and olive oil. Place over medium low heat and cook, stirring frequently, until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth and smooth. In a large frypan, heat soy milk, olive oil, and brown beef over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes or until meat is browned and lightly charred at edges, stirring frequently. Add thyme and black pepper sauce. Cover and simmer until beef is cooked to desired doneness, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove beef and stir in cold water and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until heated through. Serve with chocolates.

Random Ingredients: celery root,cream,boston lettuce,gingerroot,vanilla powder,ice water,nutmeg,napa cabbage
title: Sweet N Sour Soup
ingredients: 1 cup cooked napa cabbage ( or green cabbage ) | 1 cup iceberg lettuce ( or red cabbage ) | 1 cup cooked celery root ( or celery leaves, and about 1/3 cup white cabbage ) | 1/2 cup diced raw gingerroot ( or 1 teaspoon ground ginger ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla powder | 2 cups light cream or 2 cups light cream | ice water, as needed | freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: In a large soup bowl, combine the napa cabbage, lettuce, celery root, ginger, and 1 teaspoons vanilla extract. Pour enough ice water into the bowl to cover the vegetables. Toss to thoroughly combine. Stir in the cream to combine. Add the remaining 3/4 cups vegetable stock to the bowl, cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Beef Tenderloin Pasta
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons dried small new york | 32 ounces pasta, cooked per box instructions ( i prefer spaghetti )
instructions: Cut tenderloin very thin. Place pepper strips in a small casserole dish. Sprinkle the cheese and cardamom over both sides of the meat. Pour the hot pasta over all. Cover casserole and refrigerate until served. Slice the meat as desired and serve. Note, you may serve this with a mixture of sliced onions, broccoli florets, carrots, and celery if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,red wine vinegar,ladyfinger,key lime zest,cornflour,baking potato,baby spinach,oyster mushroom
title: Lettuce Potatoes Tacos
ingredients: 6 small baking potatoes, preferably red skinned and quartered | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 400 g baby bella mushrooms, quartered | 100 g oyster mushrooms, quartered | 1 teaspoon finely grated key lime zest, plus extra zest to garnish | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 leaves romaine lettuce | 100 g romaine lettuce | 16 ladyfingers, warmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees c. Place the potatoes on 1 baking sheet, and bake them for 40 minutes. Allow them to cool. Mix cornflour with 3 tbsp water and then stir into the sliced potato. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes until the potato is tender and the cornflour has absorbed all of the water. While the mixture is still warm, stir in the baby bella mushrooms, oysters, lime zest, and vinegar. Line oven trays with parchment paper. Tuck half of the slices of potato into the muffin cases. Scatter on the lettuce, making sure they are covered by the liquid, then spoon over the mushroom/onion sauce. Scatter over the herbs. Cover with the remaining slices of potato. Serve with fresh lime slices and lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: lemon,chorizo sausage,caster sugar,thyme sprig,green chili pepper,chicken breast fillet
title: Chorizo-Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets, cubed | 30 g lemons or 30 g lime juice | 20 g caster sugar | 8 ounces chorizo sausage or 8 ounces sweet potato slices | 1 small green chili pepper, chopped finely | 12 fresh thyme sprigs, plus extra to serve
instructions: Put the chicken and the juice into a ceramic or glass bowl. Add the sugar, chorizo, chile and thyme. Mix together with your hands until everything is coated in the juice. Set aside. Preheat the grill to moderately hot, 200c or 400f or gas put the chicken onto a rack in a roasting tin and cook for 40 minutes, basting frequently with the juice and sugar. Leave to rest for 5 minutes, then take out and cut into thick slices. Scatter over the sprigs and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,red wine,jalapeno pepper,mango chutney
title: Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar mango chutney | 1/3 cup finely cut fresh jalapeno pepper | 1/3 cup dry red wine | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the mango chutney, jalapenos, red wine and parmigiano reggiano cheese until well blended. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: broccoli stem,green chili pepper,canola oil,black eyed pea,sun tomato oil
title: Bean-Topped Veggie Medley
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained ( do not rinse ) | 4 broccoli stems, cut into 3 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 -8 tablespoon chopped green chili pepper | 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Combine black eyed peas, broccoli stems, canola oil, chile pepper, and tomatoes in serving bowl. Stir just until vegetables are coated.

title: Baked Sausages
ingredients: 1 package hot italian sausage ( about 2 1/2 lbs ) | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: In a large, lightly greased baking dish, spray with nonstick coating spray. Prick sausage several times with a fork. Sprinkle flour and vinegar over sausage. Pour sausage into baking dish. Bake, uncovered for 40 minutes or until browned and cooked through.

title: Raspberry Basil Cheese Dip
ingredients: 500 g raspberries in light syrup ( not syrup packed ) | 250 g ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 teaspoon sweet basil, shredded | 2 teaspoons malt vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill till ready to use.

title: Grandma's Irish Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 2 cups egg substitute ( or egg and potato ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier ( or other orange extract ) | 2 tablespoons raisins or 2 tablespoons sultanas
instructions: Boil water. Add salt. Crack eggs into water and add to boiling water, stirring until they are all broken up, don't cook too long. Don't overcook the eggs, they will take on it's own color. Remove from heat and add grand marnier/orange extract. Put in bowl with raisins and sultanas.

title: Turnip Salad With Tahini Dressing
ingredients: 1 large cucumber | 2 medium spanish onions | 1 medium turnip ( about 2 lbs, can use any other vegetables that you like ) | 1 tablespoon saffron, crushed | 1 tablespoon souchron | 1 cup tahini
instructions: Using a food processor, slice up the cucumber and onions and set on paper towel. The easiest way to do this is to wet your hands and your hands with cold water, not the hot water.

title: Lemongrass Smoked Paprika Paste
ingredients: 5 stalks lemongrass | 2 cans pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Cut lemongrass into 1 inch pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the lemongrass, and cook until tender, about 3 minutes. Remove and discard lemongrass. Stir in the pimientos and vodka. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 20 minutes, stirring a few times, until flavors have blended and sauce is reduced. Allow to cool. Use in bread, crackers, or as a condiment for seafood.

title: Mango Chutney and Okra Saute
ingredients: 8 ounces okra | 1 tablespoon mango chutney
instructions: Wash and trim okra. Remove stems and center stalks. Place okra on cutting board and chop. Place in saute on pan with mango chutney. Cover and cook on medium low heat 10 minutes, or according to how thick you want your saute. Serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,star anise,vanilla bean,pizza dough,hard egg,date,topping
title: Cajun Spice Bread
ingredients: 3 cups whole wheat flour | 2 cups chopped hard-boiled eggs | 1 1/2 cups dates, chopped | 1 1/2 cups pizza dough | 1 teaspoon star anise | 1 vanilla bean, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together the flour, eggs, dates, and anise. Mix in the cheese and vanilla. Turn the dough out onto a cutting board, and knead for 1 minute. Using a floured rolling pin, roll out the dough into the shape of a large pancake. Slip a spatula under the bread, and gently spread out the dough to cover completely. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow bread to cool. Whip topping, if desired, and serve with the warm bread.

Random Ingredients: chile powder,adobo sauce,leek,vegetable bouillon cube,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chile and Leek Adobo Veal
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray ( for the oven ) | 4 medium leeks, white and light green parts only, very thinly sliced ( white part only ) | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce ( from a can of chipotle or two tomates ) | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | chile powder
instructions: Spray a 10 x 15 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place each sliced leek into a microwave safe bowl. Heat on medium for 4 minutes or until warm, stirring every few minutes as it caramelizes. Combine in dish with lemon slices. Stir in adobo sauce and bouillon cube. Microvave on high for a couple of minutes, covered, stirring twice. Check for chile seasoning. Microwave on high for another 2 minutes, covered, stirring twice. Repeat twice, again covered. This should give you nice and tender adobo or a juicy sauce or enough for 2 pounds of vegies like mine. The more leeway in the zaar that you use, the hotter it gets. That sauce should thicken and thicken to your desired thickness and aroma. Note, to cook on the stove, make sure your leeks are very trimmed, using only as much white on the white as the green parts. I like to use my non stick mandoline for this step.

title: St. Patrick's Day Mussels in Chocolate!
ingredients: 4 kg mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 8 ounces dark chocolate melts ( or use soft butter melts ) | pepper sauce, to taste ( i like frank's red hot ) | onion powder, to taste | sauerkraut, to serve
instructions: In a large bowl, put mussels in a wide mouth jar or bowl with plastic wrap. Cover tightly and shake to mix all the sand from the mussels throughout. Melt chocolate and stir in pepper sauce to taste. Pour over the mussels. Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Serve warm with sauerkraut if desired.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,yogurt,herb,egg noodle,sherry,chili pepper flake,dill weed,taco seasoning
title: Chi Chi's Yogurt Cheese Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 can diced mild chili peppers | 1 can diced green chilies, undrained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed ( optional ) | 1 -2 dashes hot chili pepper flakes | 3 packets taco seasoning
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Combine sour cream, yogurt, chilies and dill in a medium bowl. Stir in noodles. Sprinkle with chili flakes and more chile flakes, if you like. Serve with chips.

title: Quick Microwave Corned Beef & Barley
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 3 tablespoons shortening or 3 tablespoons butter | 3 cups vegetables, of your choice
instructions: Add the pearl barley to the hot shortening and cook on high for 1 minute. Add the vegetables and cook on high for 1 minute. Remove from microwave, and stir or roll and place on a microwavable paper towel until needed. Serve with butter, milk or tomato gravy or fresh vegetables for dipping.

title: Figs in Espresso Sauce
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper | 1/4 cup molasses | 2 kaffir lime leaves, sliced | 1/2 cup espresso, hot | 1 cup chopped fig
instructions: Heat a grill pan, grill, or broiler. Peel and slice the bell pepper into thin strips across the long axis. In a medium bowl, stir together the molasses and kaffir lime leaves. Stir the espresso into the molasses mixture, then stir in the figs. Set aside. Place the pepper strips on the hot grill, and cook until the blackened skin has darkened and softened, about 5 minutes. Slide the vegetables off the grill or broiler, and transfer to the bowl with the olive oil. Place both pans under the broiler. Cook the sliced vegetables until they are tender and have begun to lightly caramelize, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,tomato sauce,corn tortilla chip,apple cider vinegar,tomato juice,fenugreek
title: Apple Nachos
ingredients: 1 bag cornmeal | 1/3 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 cup tomato juice, from bag | 1 cup tomato sauce, from canned tomato concentrate | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Mix cornmeal, cornmeal, tomato juice, tomato sauce, vinegar and fenugreek. Spray or spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Pour some of the nachos on the baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Turn nachos, and continue baking for 1 more minute.

title: Beef Tenderloin Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 package cellophane noodles ( optional ) | 2 jars cashews, chopped | 20 sheets frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed and sliced thin | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: In a large pot of water, add the beef tenderloin and boil until very tender. Remove from heat and cut in the desired serving size pieces. Let cool and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Preheat the ove to 400°f. Remove the beef from the refrigerator, cut it into 1/4 inch slices and cook over low heat in a large non stick skillet for 10 minutes, stirring periodically. Add the noodles to the noodles and heat through and turn the heat back on to medium to heat. Drain the noodles, reserve the noodles and beef mixture. Roll out the phyllo pastry sheets to about 1/8 inch thick and cut the sheets into 5 inch squares. Place 1 tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of a square and brush the sides with water. Bring 6 inch sides together.

title: Hungarian Garlicky Spinach
ingredients: 10 ounces baby swiss chard, stemmed with coarse stems | 12 ounces frozen whole baby sweet corn, thawed | 1 1/2 cups fresh baby spinach, washed thoroughly | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Cook chard, sweetcorn and spinach according to packet directions. Meanwhile crumble paprika over spinach.

Random Ingredients: green onion,kosher salt,mango chutney,mint leaf,japanese eggplant,oatmeal,molasses
title: Tibetan Style Eggplant Bread
ingredients: 3 japanese eggplants, with skin on | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 cup light-colored soy sauce ( tamarind sauce ) | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh mint leaves | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup old fashioned oatmeal, or more as needed | 1/4 cup mango chutney, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil and spray it with cooking spray. Cut slits in eggplant with a sharp knife in 1/3, then stuff with molasses and soy sauce. Bake in the preheated oven until tender and slightly crisp, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven and allow the to cool until completely cool enough to handle. Using hands, slice eggplant into 1/4 inch slices to create breadcrumbs. Arrange bread crumbs in a large shallow dish. Stir green onions, mint, kosher salt and chopped mango chutney in a kitchen towel. Cover and towel dry the eggplant. Place eggplant on a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,thai red curry paste,salt pepper,dark brown sugar,blueberry,lima bean,vanilla extract
title: Spicy Blueberry and Lima Beans
ingredients: 1 lb lima beans | 2/3 cup light rum or 2/3 cup dark rum | 1/3 cup thai red curry paste | 2 -3 tablespoons dark brown sugar, packed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | salt and pepper | 1 bag fresh frozen blueberries, thawed
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan or wok. Add lima beans and red curry paste and cook, stirring constantly until beans are tender. Stir in brown sugar, vanilla and salt and pepper. Stir in blueberries and cook, stirring occasionally until heated through.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,red cabbage,sea salt,cayenne pepper,cumin powder
title: Spicy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage | 1 tablespoon creme fraiche | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Cut in half lengthwise and core the cabbage. Slice 1/4 inch thick. Boil the head in salted water for 5 minutes, then plunge into ice water to stop the cooking and further soften the outer layer. Remove each half and cut to desired size. In a bowl, blend together creme fraiche, cumin, salt and cayenne. Divide cabbage half into 4 portions. Take each portion and roll each piece in the creme fraiche/cumin mixture. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,salmon steak,sesame oil,coriander leaf,spanish onion,red chilies,green curry paste
title: Salmon With Spicy Curried Onions
ingredients: 2 salmon steaks | 100 g smoked green curry paste | 1/2 cup coriander leaves | 60 ml dark brown sugar | 1/2 small spanish onion | 2 -4 small red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c trim and discard the bones from the fish. Rinse and cut the fish into 8 equal portions. Place fish on a large baking tray and brush all over with the curry paste. Place coriander leaves, sugar, onion, chilies, sesame oil, chillies and salt in a small frypan, gently cooking over a low heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until sugar has dissolved. Pour hot mixture over fish, turning to coat. Place fish on the baking tray and bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until fish is cooked through and the mixture has turned brown. Serve with rice and fresh steamed vegetables.

title: Italian Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups dry quinoa | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Rinse quinoa. In a large bowl, combine quinoa, cheese and lemon juice. Mix well. Chill.

title: Hot Dogs (Pennsylvania Dutch )
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, quartered | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 2 bay leaves
instructions: In a medium saucepan over low heat, combine the onion with the light corn syrup and bay leaves. Increase heat and warm until the mixture just begins to boil. Remove the bay leaves and spoon off any foam that forms on top. When it is cooked, spoon the hot dogs onto a baking sheet and brush with melted butter. Bake at 425 degrees f, turning occasionally, until the dogs are dark brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,red pepper flake,walnut,bread crumb,gouda cheese,rotel tomato chilies,spice,brown rice
title: Spanish Brown Rice and Walnuts
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 6 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies | 12 ounces smoked gouda cheese, sliced | 1/3 cup bread crumbs | 1/4 cup roasted walnuts | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Rinse and drain rice and set aside. In a bowl, mix together 1 cup water with rotel, cheese, bread crumbs, almonds, cardamom, red pepper.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,corn tortilla,tequila,cinnamon sugar,chinese mushroom,apple pie spice
title: Cuatro En Cazuela (Cheese Filled Enchiladas from Casa Marcela)
ingredients: 2 cans chinese mushrooms, drained | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese ( or monterey jack cheese, if you have a mexican blend ) | 6 tablespoons cajun sage cinnamon sugar, or | 3 teaspoons apple pie spice | 12 corn tortillas | 1 tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a large bowl combine the mushrooms, 1 cup of cheese, sage cinnamon sugar, and 1½ teaspoons of the apple pie spice and mix well. Wrap each tortilla with plastic wrap, and place on a nonstick cookie sheet. Fill each warmed tortilla with the cheese mixture, and place them in the oven. Bake until cheese is melted, about 30 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cherry,sesame oil,baby shrimp,apple juice,liquid honey,corn syrup,thyme leaf
title: Baby Shrimp With Cherries
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs baby shrimp, with shells on | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 3 tablespoons dried cherries, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a nonstick frying pan over medium heat, stir together corn syrup, apple juice, honey, sesame oil and thyme. Toss baby shrimp with syrup mixture and saute until shrimp are light pink and shrimp are light brown. Place shrimp on a platter and spoon hot cooking juices over the shrimp. Sprinkle with dried cherries. Serve warm.

title: Wasabi Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 envelope wasabi paste
instructions: Mash cream of mushroom soup with wasabi paste as directed on can.

title: Jamaican Drunken Cured Bacon
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs thick-cut bacon | 1/2 inch fresh ginger, peeled left whole
instructions: If bacon is smoked, wash it before starting. If it's not, leave it for 10 minutes. After rubbing the outside of the bacon with your hands to remove some of the excess moisture. In a large skillet over medium heat, render about 1/4 inch of bacon fat. Do not crowd the bacon or it will dry out.

Random Ingredients: red chili,blueberry,beef rib,ham,lime juice zest,tahini,granny smith apple
title: Seared Beef Short Ribs on a Bed of Baby Fruit With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 cup lime juice, fresh | 2 tablespoons lime zest | 3 tablespoons granny smith apples, chopped | 4 tablespoons red chili, chopped | 1/4 lb beef short rib | 1 medium granny smith apple, chopped | 1 bag fresh blueberries
instructions: Whisk together the tahini, lime zest, apple, chili and 2 tablespoons of the water. Set aside. Place the beef short ribs in a baking pan. Pour the tahini sauce over. Turn the ribs over and coat with tahini. Cover and refridgerate at least 6 - 8 hours, turning in the ribs once or twice. Preheat the oven to 325°f and remove the cover for the braising dish. Scatter the apple and blueberries evenly over the braising dish. Cover and return to the oven and bake for 1 hour or until the basting juices glaze is reduced and the meat is tender. If not eating immediately, refrigerate covered for up to 2 days.. Remove the meat from the pan and remove the foil and vegetables. Cut the meat into slices.

title: Potato and Ouzo Pizza
ingredients: 1/8 cup ouzo ( italian flavored ) | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish, minced | 1 medium idaho potato | 1/2 cup garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces thinly sliced smoked mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place the ouzo, horseradish and potato on a baking sheet, and bake, covered, for 15 minutes. Spread the garbanzos on the potato and drizzle with the ouzo mixture. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,red onion,pecorino romano cheese,chili,caraway seed
title: Cock-Ahead Italian Noodle Salad (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 package corned chili | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons finely minced fresh chili ( about 1/3 cup ) | 3 cups shredded coarsley grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 medium red onion, minced
instructions: Using long, thin slices of chorizo soaked in water for 20 minutes, snip off the stems and roughly slice the meat into 1/8 inch wide strips. Place the chorizo in a heavy medium saucepan or deep non stick pan and, over medium low heat, warm the broth. Bring the broth to a boil, then stir in the powdered chicken bouillon and chili. Simmer for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and mix in the cheese. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Pour the hot noodle salad into individual bowl or plates. Sprinkle the onion on top and serve.

Random Ingredients: apple,walnut half,vegetable stock chicken,whipping cream,dill,baby spinach
title: Spinach & Apple Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock or 1 liter chicken stock | 1 apple, very ripe washed and chopped to about 1 cm | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 100 g baby spinach, trimmed & washed | 142 ml whipping cream
instructions: Combine stock with apple, dill and spinach in a pot. Bring up to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 - 12 mins or until spinach is tender. Remove from heat and add cream and adjust seasoning, stir, serve.

Random Ingredients: beetroot,anise seed,red enchilada sauce,speck,roast beef,chinese mushroom,cranberry,green olive
title: Mushroom and Roasted Beef Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces dried chinese mushrooms | 1 pint red enchilada sauce | 12 ounces roast beef, cut in bite-size pieces | 1 pint beetroot, peeled and rough chopped | 12 ounces speck, sliced, chopped | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 cup green olives | 4 ounces dried cranberries
instructions: Soak mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes. Rinse under water. Remove stems, slice off caps, trim off any tough ribs and cut off hard center of any bruised ribs. Remove and discard mushroom tops, cut caps into thin slices. Bring 4 1/2 cups water to boil. Add mushrooms, 1 can enchilada sauce, and beef.

Random Ingredients: lentil,blue cheese,tomato juice,cold water,pickle juice,yogurt,white onion
title: Lentil Dressing
ingredients: 1 package dried lentils | 1/4 cup ice cold water | 1/2 cup diced white onion | 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons pickle juice | 1/2 cup bottled cold water | 1 cup crumbled blue cheese | 1 teaspoon tomato juice
instructions: Place the lentils in a large pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 12 minutes or until lentils are tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid. Gently stir and set aside. Place onion in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until tender. Stir in yogurt, pickle juice, 2/3 cup reserved cooking liquid, 1/2 cup cold water and cheese. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Spoon the lentils into a serving bowl. Top with blue cheese, cover and microwave on high for 30 seconds.

title: Simple Mashed Potatoes for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 package dry brown gravy mix | 1 pound steak, diced | 2 pounds salt pork, julienned
instructions: Combine the brown gravy mix and salt pork in a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker. Stir well. Place salt pork in the slow cooker, and pour in the gravy mix and bring to a boil.
