Add the beef, and cook on high for 2 hours, or low for 4 to 5 hours. The last hour before serving, add the chopped vegetables.

title: Pancake, Steamed Buns
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon corn flakes | 2 ounces yoghurt | 1 tablespoon cognac | 1 tablespoon beer or 1 tablespoon red wine
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and put in a heat proof bowl. Steam for about 20 - 25 minutes.

title: The Queen's Day Breakfast Risotto
ingredients: 3 cups short-grain white rice, washed | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh chives | 1 teaspoon dry coriander | 1 teaspoon fresh horseradish
instructions: To make yoghurt, combine all the ingredients in a small bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Set aside for at least 2 hours to develop flavour. When ready to serve, rinse the grains well under cold water. Drain well, then place under the grill or under a preheated broiler and set on one side. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 160c/gas wash and drain the rice. Place in an ovenproof dish and cover with a little water. Place over a medium heat and bring to the boil. Once boiling, cover the pan and reduce the heat to low. Simmer until the rice is cooked, about 20 - 25 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave for 15 minutes before removing the lid and fluffing before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,kidney bean,alfredo sauce,red chili powder,dill,asafoetida powder
title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups tomato soup ( low sodium ) | 1 can kidney beans ( or beans of choice ) | 1 can asafoetida powder ( or equivalent ) | 1 dash red chili powder | 1 dash dried dill ( or equivalent ) | 1 dash dried dill ( or equivalent ) | 1 can tomato soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and blend until smooth. If it is too thick stir in water until desired thickness is achieved. Serve chilled.

title: Hot Oyster Mushrooms Tea Eggs
ingredients: 3 ounces soft tea ( i use decaf brand ) | 8 ounces hot soya sauce | 3 ounces tamales, canned ( i use a mixture of the two ) | 6 small rock oyster mushrooms, sliced ( or more, if preferred ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine the tea, soy sauce, and tamale can in a small saucepan. Put on the stove and bring to a simmer. Simmer for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add oysters, egg, and any extras you like. Serve. Note, you can use more oysters, or less, depending on how full your ingredients are.

title: Paneer-Wrapped Popcorn With Chocolate Salted Pine
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegan margarine ( smart balance or earth balance ) | 1/3 cup cocoa powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant coffee ( or more to taste ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 cup sugar | 4 corn on the cob ( husked or unshelled ) | salad greens ( mixed salad greens ) | fried panir ( optional )
instructions: Combine vegan margarine, cocoa powder, and 1 1/2 tablespoon of coffee in a small bowl.

title: Piquant Saffron Fruity Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 tablespoon dried cherries, chopped | 1/2 green pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 celery, finely chopped | cooking spray | 1 pinch saffron ( can use more to taste ) or 1 pinch saffron strand, if desired ( can use more to taste )
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients and mix well. Spray salad pan with cooking spray. Arrange fruit in one layer in pan. Sprinkle top with saffron, if using. Cook on high for 2 minutes or until just lightly toasted.

title: Melon Balls from Korean Style Restaurant
ingredients: 3 medium cantaloupe | 8 ounces white flour | 8 ounces white miso | 1/2 cup white wine ( kikkoman brand, korean-style )
instructions: Clean cantaloupe and wash in cold water until clean. Cut cantaloupe in half and remove seeds. In a bowl mix the miso and red wine. Add cantaloupe pieces and stir. Take 2 heaping tbs of mixture and roll into balls. Then make the balls from all the melon. Put in a glass baking dish. Bake in the preheated Korean oven at 325°f for 20 minutes, or in the top part of a broiler if you have it. Remove from oven and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,mango cheek,parmesan cheese,ancho chile powder,pumpkin seed,tomato puree,macadamia nut
title: Spicy Mango Chutney
ingredients: 450 g ripe mango cheeks, peeled and cut into 2 | 400 g canned tomatoes puree | 1 cup raw macadamia nuts, kernels | 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds, shelled ( salted ) | 2 teaspoons coarsely crushed dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds or 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, slightly crushed | 1 ounce parmesan cheese, grated, to serve
instructions: Place the mango chunks, tomatoes, macadamia nuts, pumpkin seeds, ancho, fennel and parmesan in a large bowl. Add just enough water to mix, season and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Serve with pitta bread.

Random Ingredients: multigrain bread,lemon pepper,chili oil,bourbon,pecan,fast rising yeast,sauce,caper
title: French Onion Bread Appetizer
ingredients: 6 cups multigrain bread, loaf | 6 tablespoons bourbon | 4 tablespoons hot sauce ( i prefer tabasco ) | 4 ounces fast rising yeast | 8 tablespoons capers, drained and minced | 2 1/2 tablespoons unsalted dry berry mix ( i prefer pecans ) | 4 tablespoons lemon pepper | 3 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread. Place in a 2 qt pan. Place pan into a warm oven and turn down to 350f. Bake in a pre heated oven for about 1 1/4 hours. Remove from oven and let cool until easy to handle. Using a sharp knife, slice bread as desired. This bread can be served warm or cold. Variation, add other flavors like dijon mustard.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,tarragon,serrano chili pepper,poblano chile,sunflower seed,bean sprout
title: Tarragon-Chile Pudding
ingredients: 250 g baked beans with sprouts | 1 serrano chili pepper | 400 g vanilla instant pudding mix | 5 -6 poblano chiles | 3 -4 tablespoons tarragon, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons sunflower seeds or 3 -4 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/400f. Pour dry beans into a big baking pan with the two serrano peppers, poblano chilies, and tarragon. Wash thoroughly, slit open the garlic and finely chop. title: Beef Kelaguen With Napa-Chipotle
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/3 cup low-sodium taco sauce | 2 cups sliced shiitake mushroom caps | 1/3 cup pecans, or
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir kielbasa in the hot skillet until browned, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir mushroom and pecans into kielbasa, reduce heat to low. Cover skillet and continue cooking in the preheated oven until the mushrooms are tender, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,pineapple juice,orange,beef brisket,rice wine vinegar,apple juice,pepper sauce,orange zest
title: Caribbean-Style Corn and Pineapple Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 1 lb whole-grain, trimmed corned beef brisket | 1/2 cup corn kernels ( frozen or fresh cooked frozen )
instructions: For sauce, in a small bowl, whisk together orange zest, orange juice, apple juice, rice vinegar, hot pepper sauce, and hot pepper sauce. Trim fat from brisket. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine brisket, apple juice mixture, corn, and corn mixture.

title: Easy 'N Easy Curry N Veggies
ingredients: 3 stalks celery, chopped | 2 tablespoons green curry paste or 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Sauté celery in oil until it is just starting to turn slightly translucent. Add other ingredients, then cook till celery is tender. Serve hot.

title: Apple & Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 4 ounces smoked salmon fillets, thinly sliced | 10 ounces white tuna in water, drained & broken into pieces ( not broken ) | 2 ounces veal demi-glace ( or plain or sweet potato ) | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 9x13 baking dish, mix well. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Yar Swiatevio
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked salmon steaks | fresh mint | cheese ( optional ) | 8 wonton wrappers ( or use a large package of wonton wrappers ) | 1/4 cup tequila ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint ( optional ) or 3 tablespoons dill ( optional )
instructions: Mash about half the mint leaves and set aside. If using cheese, spread the cheese evenly over 2 of the wonton wrappers and place 2 tsp of the chopped mint over them. Place 1 oz. Of salmon over the mint. Place another 1/4 cup chopped mint and 1/4 tsp tequila if using, along with 2 tsp mint to serve. Dip the wontons into the tequila to coat, and then the wontons into tequila to serve.

title: Pork Posole
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fresh lean pork shoulder, trimmed of any extraneous fat, cut into 3/4-inch dice | 1/3 lb lean ground pork | 6 slices prosciutto ( very thin slices, about 1/4-inch thick, sliced into 1/4-inch slivers ) | 1/3 cup burgundy wine | 1/2 cup hominy | 1/4 cup vanilla extract
instructions: Using a sharp knife, make a deep horizontal slit in the pork shoulder, cutting about 2 1/2 deep in the meat. Insert meat, prosciutto and any extraneous fat and any other excess fat into hole left in the meat. Reserve some of the fat for use in another recipe, if desired. Rinse the remaining pork and pat dry. Prick skin of meat with a shallow, sharp knife and rub half the salt and pepper over the meat. If the posole sticks, soak it in the tap water for about 15 or 30 minutes. If you don't want to use the salt, rub a little more inside, then wipe all around the meat with damp paper towels and rub with more salt. Sprinkle salt and pepper inside the cavity, then fill the center of it with the meat. Cover the posole and allow it to marinate in the refrigerator for 24 to 48 hours. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover the posole. Heat the remaining 1/4 cup of wine in a saucepan until it begins to boil. Add the hominy. Bring to a boil, stirring and scraping the dumpling shells into the liquid, and cover the pan. Place the dumplings on a lightly oiled rimmed baking sheet and bake for about 1 1/2 hours or until the filling is fairly dry. If mixture gets too dry during the first 10 minutes of baking, stir occasionally. If it becomes too dry, cover loosely with foil or a tent of aluminum foil. Remove from the oven and allow to stand for 15 or 20 minutes. Remove the foil, then stir in the vanilla. If it becomes too dry, stir in some of the reserved marinade. Serve with extra drizzled on top of the posole.

Random Ingredients: vermicelli,cold water,ketjap manis,flat leaf parsley,chocolate,sriracha sauce,sherry
title: Kara Kebab (Noodle-Vietnamese Stir-Fried Noodles)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cold water | 1 lb vermicelli, broken into two pieces ( about 3/4-inch long ) | 1 can fire-roasted unsalted sherry ( sweetened sweetened asian ) | 1/4 cup ketjap manis ( sweet soy sauce, or tamarind paste ) | 1/2 cup hot sriracha hot sauce ( or more, to taste ) | 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, for garnish
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring the water to a boil over high heat. Add the vermicelli and boil until the noodles are tender and slightly translucent, about 12 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain in a colander and immediately transfer the noodles from the colander to a large mixing bowl. Add the sherry and soy sauce and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Drain the noodles well and discard the liquid. Melt the chocolate in a microwave safe bowl set over the simmering water and add the parsley, stirring to combine. Heat a dry large nonstick skillet or wok over moderate heat. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and a few noodles at a time and stir fry until lightly golden brown, about 1 minute. Transfer the noodles to a platter and serve the warm choclo sauce over top.

title: Indian Cabbage and Gorgonzola Salad

instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Enjoy chilled.

title: Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 2 large tortillas, sliced | 8 slices torn fresh salad greens, such as arugula
instructions: Place tortillas on a plate.

instructions: Combine vinegar, applesauce, chives, lemon juice, madeira, butter/oil and sauces in a bowl. Whisk to blend. Add more sugar and tabasco to your taste.

title: Tahini Fish

instructions: In a small bowl, mix tahini, 3 tpsps hp sauce, ginger and hot sauce. Place fish in 1/2 t of hot sauce mixture and marinated it in refrigerator for several hours. title: Perfect Noodle Salad

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Peanut Oil III

instructions: Combine bouillon granules and oil in a gallon size zipper type plastic bag. Shake to dissolve the granules. Seal and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Bangers and Mash

instructions: Crumble meat into a large bowl. Sprinkle in the flour, and then mix in the sausage. Turn mixture to coat with the flour. Heat a non stick frying pan and cook the sausage until brown all over. Drain, and serve straight away.

title: Vietnamese - Thin Spiced Stock

instructions: Heat a medium sized saucepan over medium high heat until a bead of water vaporates on the surface. Quickly pour into the pan the 2 tablespoons of infused vietnamese vermicelli and stir to mix. If the noodles become a little brown, a little longer. Cover and allow the vermicelli to soften. After 15 - 17 minutes, remove from heat and remove cardamom pods. Let sit for 5 minutes and strain through a fine mesh strainer. Serve at once or store in a tightly closed plastic container for up to 5 months.

instructions: Toss the chickpeas, nuts, cucumber, and egg yolk mixture together in a bowl.

instructions: To make the dressing, whisk together the buttermilk, honey and vinegar in a small pan and simmer, stirring occasionally, until it is reduced slightly. instructions: Place ingredients in crockpot. Cover and cook on low about 6 - 8 hours, until beef is tender. Serve over steamed rice.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f prepare coleslaw mix by slicing coleslaw mix as thinly as possible. Place coleslaw in a large bowl. Add all remaining ingredients. Stir well. Bake for 15 minutes or until the center of the cookies turns slightly brown.

title: Savoury Chicken With Mustard Greens

instructions: Mix farina and 1 cup of blueberries in a bowl. Stir to blend smoothly. Add the rice and blueberries. Season with tabasco/chicken heat some cornstarch/salt to your liking, and a dash of hot sauce, or whatever optional ingredient you like to taste..

title: Jerk Chicken II
ingredients: 1 pound chicken thighs, thinly sliced | 2 hard-cooked eggs, finely chopped | 1 cup chicken fat, cooked and shredded | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Place chicken slices in a shallow dish. Sprinkle the eggs over chicken.

title: Fennel for the Grill - Home Made
ingredients: 10 fresh sage leaves | 1 small fennel
instructions: Wash fennel, wash with plenty of good water and remove root end. Thinly slice fennel. Place fennel in the freezer for 1 to 2 hours, depending on how hungry you are and how big/small you like it. When fennel is very cold, place it in a plastic bag. Using a fork, poke holes all over the fennel, using as many holes as possible. This way, it will help prevent the fennel from drying out. Place in a hot oven and leave to dry out. After a while, check on it every so often that the surface is getting brownish and soft at the edges, but not brown, stirring to keep from burning. The more fennel it gets, the more pronounced it is and it will take a while for the fennel to dry out. Dough can be stored in the freezer for up to six months. Note, for the grill, check the fennel thoroughly. Remove and let dry out slightly. Wash thoroughly under running water, to remove any sand, before rubbing. The fennel will swell and turn dark in color. Remove fennel from the bag, cut off stem and remove feather shaped seeds. Place fennel on a cutting board and slice to about 1/4 inch thick by 1/4 inch wide, keeping a small pile. Place sage leaves in a saucer and top with 1/4 inch or a little fennel bulb on them to keep them fresh. This keeps them from drying.

Random Ingredients: sultana,tandoori paste,worcestershire sauce,bay scallop,green olive,beer,eggplant,cocoa powder
title: Barbecued Scotch Scallops
ingredients: 4 green olives | 8 ounces sultanas | 3 ounces tobasco beer | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon sultana | 1 -2 teaspoon tandoori paste | 4 bay scallops
instructions: Place all ingredients except the scallops in a food processor or blender and whiz till smooth and creamy. Add the scallops to the sauce and allow the flavours to mix gently together. If all four scallops are in one pan or one blender and not in one dish, make sure they are well coated with sauce. You can also just place the scallops in a single layer, place in a pre heated oven, reduce heat to 300f and bake uncovered for 25 to 35 minutes, basting every 20 minutes until cooked through. Serve with bread, noodles or potatoes.

title: Quick and Easy Italian Style Corn
ingredients: 1 can sweet corn, drained | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 dash garlic powder
instructions: Stir the corn, mozzarella cheese, garlic powder and italian seasoning together in a glass casserole dish. Heat in microwave on high 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Stir before serving.

title: Amaretto Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 225 g cottage cheese or 225 g ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur | 1 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Drain the cottage cheese and place in a mixing bowl or food processor. Add the amaretto liqueur and tamari, mix well.

title: Microwave Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn, shucked | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Place corn on microwave safe baking sheet and cover with heavy duty aluminum foil. Microwave on high for 7 minutes. Combine the cream and salt, stir to dissolve. Pour over corn and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Serve cold.

title: Ole! Banana Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 large banana, halved and peeled | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese ( about 3 slices, more if desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut 1/4 lb of the banana into thin slices, then cut them into 1/4 strips. Scoop the banana into the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade and pulse until the banana is coarsely chopped. Add the feta and process until the mixture becomes smooth and creamy. Transfer the mixture to a shallow bowl and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes so it will blend well. Transfer the mixture to an 8 inch pie plate that has been completely lined with parchment paper. Bake 10 minutes or until golden. Move the pie plate to a rack and let it cool for 10 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Sweet and Sour Parsnips
ingredients: 1/2 pound parsnips - peeled, cored and sliced | 1 medium banana, sliced | 1/3 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 small green chile pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Place the parsnips and banana in a steamer basket or stock pot. Cover the vegetables with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook, covered, until tender, about 1 hour. Drain, then cool, then slice into wedges. Meanwhile, mix the sherry vinegar, sugar, and chile pepper in a glass or ceramic bowl. Serve warm, garnished with slices of the banana.

title: Fried Turkey with Scallops
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons karo syrup | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 slices fine breadcrumbs | 12 scallops, cleaned of all extraneous fat
instructions: In a bowl, mash the turkey and the eggs. Stir in the bread crumbs, karo syrup and cayenne pepper. Form the turkey mixture into a log. Arrange the scallops in a baking sheet, and cover with foil. Bake in a preheated oven to 350 degrees f. For 20 - 25 minutes, until puffy. Remove the foil and bake for another 20 - 25 minutes, until cooked through.

title: Chinese Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, cut into chunks | 4 kaffir lime leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine ingredients, adding a little hot pepper juice.

title: Beer and Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dried rigatoni pasta | 1 can or bottle beer
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,confectioner sugar,active yeast,chicken bouillon,balsamic vinegar,green chili
title: Confusion® Italian Chicken-Hamburger-Crock Pot
ingredients: 1/4 ounce active dry yeast | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ( or other balsamic vinegar substitute ) | 12 ounces cooked fresh hamburger, cubed | 1 cup diced green chili | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, sprinkle yeast over warm water. Let stand for 5 minutes or until foamy. Pour into crock pot and add ingredients. Cover and slow cook on high for 10 to 12 hours. Stir in confectioner's sugar and chicken bouillon. Cover and continue to cook on high until thick. My note, i used 3 tablespoons of chicken boullion instead of the flour to flavor my crock pot and had extra sauce for dipping my meatballs inches this is a great make ahead dish. It took 6 hours to thaw and put in crock pot then the 3/4 cup of sugar added in the crock pot when we did the meatballs the sauce was great too and i used the 3/4 cup of sugar splenda instead of the honey. I also used 1 tsp of cayenne pepper and it was very good. As others mentioned the chicken was too strong after the first day and that was never the same. Instead, i used the entire 1/4 oz. Of yeast and 1 part bouillon. I had to put the 1/4 cup of balsamic vinegar in the next day to get it to dissolve and then sub the honey in the sauce, which was great i did as a side dish for dinner and it turned out great.

title: Dill and Cheese Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained ( 1 15 oz. can ) | 2 slices swiss cheese, shredded | 1/4 banana, mashed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 2 1/2 cups fresh breadcrumbs | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Mix beans, cheese, banana, dill, flour, salt and pepper and set aside. Place bread crumbs in separate bowls. Drain beans, add bread crumbs until all is used. Drop crumbs by tablespoonsful into hot oil for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Baked Halibut
ingredients: 4 teaspoons white flour | 2 tablespoons vermouth | 4 halibut fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Put the flour in a shallow dish. Place fish in the flour, dip it in the flour, shaking off any excess, and place it on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Cook the fish in a shallow ovenproof frying pan for about 15 minutes, brushing regularly with the remaining oil, for or about 15 minutes with the vermouth. Serve with your favourite salad or vegetable accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: banana,red snapper,pork loin roast,serrano pepper,cod fish fillet,canning salt,cottage cheese,soya sauce
title: Smoked Baked Fish With Pork Stew (Low Fat Version)
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast or 1 other lean meat, cut to small cubes | 1/2 lb smoked pork loin roast or 1/2 lb smoked boneless pork steak, cut into small cubes | 1/2 lb smoked cod fish fillet, cut into small cubes | 1 -2 serrano pepper, thinly sliced ( optional ) | canning salt | soya sauce | avocado dip or cottage cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place all ingredients in roasting pan/pan except soya sauce, avocado dip/cottage cheese & salt. Place roaster pan on middle rack of oven. Bake for 1 hour, basting frequently with soya sauce. Garnish with avocado dip/cottage cheese & serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,red chile,white wine,yellow squash,buttermilk,red pepper,sherry wine
title: Chicken, Squash and Chile Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine | 1/4 cup canned crushed red chiles | 1 chicken breast, cut into chunks | 1 can chopped red chile | 1 yellow squash, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Combine the wine, sherry, chiles and chicken in a medium pot or dutch oven and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn the chicken pieces into a bowl. Stir the squash and squash into the broth and cook until tender. Remove from the heat and stir in the buttermilk and any accumulated juices from the vegetables. Place the chicken and vegetables back on the heat and stir to heat through. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Noodles
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2 packages noodles | 2 1/2 cups finely diced carrots | 12 ounces fresh baby spinach | 1 1/4 cups chopped spring onions | 1 dash hot sauce | 1 package ramen noodles ( with seasoning packet )
instructions: Start with the noodles, so that they boil when ready. Drain noodles and let them cool until room temperature. Heat oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Add carrots, and cook about 2 minutes, stirring often. Add all the baby spinach and some hot sauce. Remove from heat, and set aside. Toss noodles with enough oil to coat. Add noodles and carrots into skillet, and cook through 3 - 4 minutes. Stir and mix in the chopped onions and hot sauce. Toss 3 - 6 minutes longer, add spinach mixture back into skillet, and toss again. Serve at once with additional hot sauce and soy sauce added, if desired.

title: Chai Coleslaw in Crumbs
ingredients: 16 large savoy cabbage ( about 3 lbs or 2 lbs. ) | 16 ounces graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook cabbage in salted boiling water, adding graham cracker crumbs until desired doneness, and drain well. Return cabbage to heat, stir to mix, and cook 3 minutes or until coleslaw is crisp and hot. Transfer to a large bowl, cover, and refrigerate at least 1 day before serving, tossing and adding more graham cracker crumbs as needed.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,cream tartar,lemon peel,couscous,beef stew meat,tahini,coriander seed
title: Beef Couscous
ingredients: 4 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1/2-1-inch cubes ( such as chuck steak ) | 2 tablespoons cayenne | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground coriander seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 3 1/2 cups cooked couscous, warm | 2 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Combine the beef, cayenne, coriander, cream of tartar, lemon peel and salt in a large ziploc bag. Add the beef to the bag.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,steak,dark rum,serrano chili,chicken bouillon cube,whipping cream
title: Aka Strapaccio
ingredients: 4 slices mozzarella cheese | 6 tablespoons whipping cream | 1/2 ounce dark rum | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 serrano chili, minced | 1 lb steak
instructions: Slice the steak thin. In a medium bowl, add all the ingredients, except the steak and place in the refrigerator for 2 hours or over night. When ready to grill or to finish off, bring a pan of water and a chicken bullion cube to a boil. Add the steak and lower the heat to keep them covered. The longer the better. Remove the meat from the water and place in a serving bowl. Drain the liquid from the pan and pour over the steak. Grate some of the mozzarella cheese on top. Eat.

title: Escarla's Specialty Mojo Chicken
ingredients: 4 lbs lean boneless chicken breasts, with skin and fat | 1/2 ounce instant espresso powder, such as espresso or 1/2 ounce instant espresso | 1/2 cup tap water | 3 1/2 tablespoons instant espresso powder, such as espresso powder | 1 -2 teaspoon instant espresso powder, such as espresso powder | 10 slices deli hamburger
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large freezer bag with meat to coat. Marinate refrigerated in resealable plastic bag 6 - 8 hours, but no longer than 2 - 3 days from marination. Heat griddle or large pan to high. Cook chicken breasts 4 - 5 minutes on each side until well browned. Top with desired amount of sauce and meat.

title: Neso Fresco Appetizers
ingredients: 2 lbs green apples, peel and cored, about 3 or 4 pounds | 1 lb queso fresco, about 2 1/2 ounces
instructions: Remove the cores from the apples and cut them into thin strips. Bring them to room temperature. In an electric coffee grinder, pulse the apple strips to remove as many as possible. Dry out the food processor. Add a few of the apple shreds, with the cheese, to the grinder and pulse until the desired consistency is achieved. Drop the neso fresco by half teaspoonsfuls onto parchment paper with a large star nozzle. Let them stand in the freezer overnight.

title: Creamy Almonds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons slivered almonds | 2 tablespoons broth | 1 teaspoon dry roasted peanuts | 1/4 cup fat-free mayonnaise | 4 ounces shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat oven to in small bowl, mix together almonds and broth. Remove almonds and let stand 1 hour, then drain and discard liquid. Spread unto greased cookie sheet. Bake in 425 degree oven until lightly golden. Remove from oven. Spread mayonnaise over top. Sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,corn tortilla chip,tomato soup,yellow onion,chicken stock cube,veal,tilapia fillet
title: Italian Tilapia and Chips (Quick and Easy)
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1 soup bone ( beef or veal ) | 1 red onion ( chopped ) | 4 large corn tortilla chips | 1 can tomato soup | 1 chicken stock cube ( optional ) | balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place the tilapia fillets in a large pot on the stove. Pour soup bone, onion, and tomato soup into the pot. Cover pot with enough water to cover the tilapia, and cook for about 30 mins on a medium heat. Cover and turn off heat. When liquid is slightly reduced, remove the pot from the stove, and let it sit in the turned off oven. The tilapia will be cooked shortly after it's done. Put 2 to 3 heaping tbsp of the chips on your plate. Lay each tilapia fillet on the chips, cover with the remaining chips, and enjoy.

title: Homemade French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 cup white pepper | 1 can vegetable broth ( or chicken broth. )
instructions: Combine ground pepper and vegetable broth in a saucepan. Heat to boiling, but do not boil. Remove from heat. Cool soup until warm. Pour in to soup bowl or crockpot. Top with grated cheese until just about melted. Variation, a favorite is finely chopped and placed under broiler to brown.

title: Coconut Spiced Sirloin and Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, trimmed and cut into 2-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, lightly roasted | 8 whole allspice | 1/3 cup pistachios, shelled roughly chopped | 1 lb shell pasta ( or any pasta )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f in a large pot heat cumin seeds over medium high heat, stirring frequently, for 1 minute. Add the allspice and cook over high heat for 1 minute, stirring. Add beef and stir until well seared. Add pistachios and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and add pasta or shells. Cover pot and transfer to oven. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes, or until tender, stirring occasionally.

title: Greek Seasoning Cookies
ingredients: 7 egg whites, room temperature | 1 1/3 cups oregano ( fresh, fresh and chopped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper. With an electric mixer, beat egg whites on high speed until foamy, but not dry. Reduce speed to medium. Beat in oregano until incorporated, then stir in 1 cup of the cookie crumbs. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets. Sprinkle tops with remaining cookie crumbs. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from pan and cool on cookie sheet 5 minutes. Remove and place on wire rack. Store in airtight container.

title: Potted Aromatic Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Heat the milk over low heat, stirring frequently. Do not boil, but leave a small amount of milk in the milk. Do not boil over. Add the hot sauce, mace and salt. Pour directly into cold sterilized glass jar or bottles.

title: Frijoles Borrachitos
ingredients: 3 cups dry kidney beans | 1/2 cup corn oil ( or vegetable oil ) | 1/2 cup nicoise olives, chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon orange juice, fresh if you prefer your drink sweeter
instructions: Place the beans in a small pot and cover with water, add enough water to just barely cover the beans. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer about 30 minutes, or until the beans are tender but still a little firm. Drain them in a colander, rinse in cold water, drain well, and set aside. In a frying pan, heat the corn oil over medium high heat. When hot, add the olives. Cook, stirring often, about 5 - 6 minutes, or until the olives have begun to brown on the bottom. Turn down the heat slightly. Add the drained beans and the orange juice to the pan. Stir well and cook just until warmed through. Makes about 8 servings. Variations, • frijoles borrachitos may be served over black beans, but they are delicious on their own.

title: Leek and Chocolate Ties
ingredients: 2 leeks, chopped | 3/4 cup white chocolate chips | 4 cups broth or 4 cups water | 1 1/2 teaspoons turbinado sugar or 1 1/2 teaspoons honey | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dry cayenne
instructions: In a large, heavy saucepan melt the chocolate chips in the water. Bring the mixture to a boil or simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly. As soon as the dark chocolate is melted, add the leeks and sugar and stir to blend. Cover and cook until soft and the leeks are tender, about 5 - 7 mintues. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, beat together the carob mixture and sugar. Scoop out as much of the leeks as possible, and reserve any liquid. Return the liquid to the saucepan. Heat, stirring frequently, until boiling. Remove from heat. When the ties are completely cool, scrape off the inside of the rings and place a small spoonful of the caramel on a tie and press out the caramel on top of the tie. Cool and store in a small airtight container.

title: Burgers With Thyme Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb cooked shredded ham | 1/2 lb sliced deli ham | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow pepper
instructions: Heat heavy cream in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Add fenugreek and yellow peppers. Simmer for five minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: beer,monterey jack cheese,mint sprig,lemon extract,nutmeg,kidney bean,parsley flake
title: Mexican White Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1 can beer | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons oregano mint sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | lemon extract | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans, and reserve. Put them all in a large, heavy pot. Cover and simmer on low heat, for 45 more minutes, or until the beans are soft. Add the beer and stir well, simmer for 5 minutes, or until heated through. Taste and add lemon and oregano. Stir in the parsley. Serve with grated cheese. Optional topping,. 1 tablespoon lemon juice. 2 teaspoons melted butter. 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch, mixed with 1 1/2 teaspoons of water, stir well, then stir into the chili. Continue cooking until thick like cornbread.

Random Ingredients: tequila,macadamia nut,caster sugar,kaffir lime leaf,cheesecloth,walnut oil,red onion
title: Kaffir Lime and Macadamia Slice
ingredients: 1 packet kaffir lime leaves | 3 tablespoons macadamia nuts ( roughly chopped ) | 150 g/ 3/8 cup cheese cloth ( available at asian markets ) | 1/2 cup sunflower oil or 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons tequila | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 small red onion, finely sliced
instructions: Place kaffir lime leaves in a baking tray lined with non stick baking paper on the centre rack of an oven preheated oven 160°c.. Place macadamia nuts on a plate and set aside until needed. Place cheese cloth on a clean tea towel and place on the baking tray. Place on oven tray and press 2 tablespoons macadamia nuts into the paper for 10 seconds. Place the remaining chopped macadamia nuts on cutting board to form rough triangles. Using one round cutter, cut the edges of each triangle in half. Heat 1 tablespoon tequila in a small saucepan. Add the onion and cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Add remaining tequila, sugar, remaining chopped macadamia nuts and the fried macadamia nuts. Stir fry for 3 minutes. Spread 1/4 of the lime mix over the base of a slice tin. Place the slice tin on a baking tray lined with non stick oil. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven or until golden.

title: Fish Polevano
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato | white pepper ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon white pepper, ground
instructions: Marinate the tilapia fillets with peppers and add more salt. Brown in a skillet till the fish turns orange. Drain off the oil. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream,parsnip,beef stock,orange bell pepper,red potato,lavender,sesame oil
title: Lavender Mashed Parsnips With Beef
ingredients: 4 small red potatoes | 2 small parsnips | 300 ml beef stock ( or your homemade beef stock ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil ( or olive oil, extra virgin ) | 3 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon fresh lavender, minced ( or 1 tsp dried )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to the boil. You can serve these as is, if you like. Or you can transfer to a crockpot and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours, until completely cooked.

title: Sweet Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen beans sprouts, thawed | 1/2 cup ketchup, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bean sprouts in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until bright green and slightly tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Reserve any remaining sprouts for another salad. Drain well and spread on a plate. Add ketchup to taste, and mix together. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Grown Ups Mint and Amaretto Jalapeno Pepper Fajitas
ingredients: 1 jalapeno | 1 -2 tablespoon amaretto | 1 teaspoon white pepper ( or adjust to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: To a small skillet add the mint and olive oil. Heat over medium high heat until warmed. Split the fresh pepper on one side, remove the seeds, and slice the pepper into a thin half moon shape, then remove the seeds and membrane with a spoon. Brush pepper with the amaretto and sprinkle dry with the white pepper and dried mint. Serve warm.

title: Anaheim Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 bunch italian parsley, finely chopped | 2 stalks white onions, peeled and finely chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 can anchovy fillets | 1/2 cup lightly packed brown sugar | 2 lbs whole green olives, pitted | 1/4 cup fresh sage, leaves only
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl, cover and refrigerate over night, stirring occasionally. Bring to room temperature before processing or chilling. Refrigerate 24 hrs, stirring occasionally. Store in an airtight container at room temperature until service. If storing longer, make sure the pesto is covered with plastic wrap and refrigerate a few hours to firm. Lasts up to a week.

Random Ingredients: bratwurst,grain cereal,parsley flake,sauce,anise seed,orange zest,italian bread,orange
title: Grilled Bratwurst (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bratwurst | 2 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs or 2 tablespoons coarse breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon crushed anise seed | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley flakes | 3/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon coarsely chopped orange rind | 3 tablespoons orange sauce
instructions: Cut bratwurst in half lenghtwise. Then cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Combine first 7 ingredients. Add bratwurst.

title: Orange and Marmalade Fajitas
ingredients: 2 tortilla strips | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade | 1 pinch ground black pepper, or to taste
instructions: Slice the tortilla strips crosswise in half, so they line up in a crosshatch pattern. Drizzle with marmalade and pepper.

title: Oriental Peaches
ingredients: 4 yellow bell peppers ( sliced 1/2 inch thick slices ) | 3/4 cup bamboo shoot ( sliced thinly ) | 6 eggs | 2 tablespoons peach slices, chopped
instructions: Combine eggs and peach slices in a medium bowl.

title: Stilton Cheese & Buckwheat Flour Pudding
ingredients: 225 g buckwheat flour | 225 g stilton cheese, cut into small cubes
instructions: Pre heat oven to 150c/gas dust your work surface with flour. Put the flour in a bowl & make a well in the centre. Using your fingertips make a well in the centre & pour the whey through it, then add the stilton. Stir well to combine. Don't beat with a spoon, it will make the crumble cheese sizzling as it hits the work surface. Now knead the dough till it is smooth & smooth. You should have a smooth, thick porridge type batter. You may need to add an extra tablespoon of flour while kneading, depending on the thickness of the dough.. Transfer to a shallow, ovenproof dish. Bake for approx 55 - 60 mins until golden.

Random Ingredients: nectarine,cinnamon,red pepper,ra el hanout spice mix,pepperoncini pepper,tortilla
title: Moroccan Nectarine Burritos
ingredients: 40 small nectarines | 1 red pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 -2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( or make your own ) | sugar-free tortilla or fat-free flour tortillas | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers, drained and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Peel nectarines, then cut in half and remove the pit. Place nectarines and 1/4 of the pepper slices on a foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle evenly with cinnamon and ras el hanout. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until very soft. Remove from oven. Place peppers in tortilla. Top with remaining pepper slices and sprinkle with some sugar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,beef soy crumbles,cornflour,anise seed,tagliatelle pasta noodle,romaine lettuce,red pepper flake
title: Marinated Beef and Romaine Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces tagliatelle pasta noodles or 6 ounces other dry pasta, cooked | 2 roma/berg lettuce | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Rinse and dry the pasta. Cut lettuce into chiffonade and place in the bowl. Cut the beef very thinly across the grain. Combine cornstarch and balsamic vinegar with a tbsp of water in a small bowl and stir in. Add beef to the cornstarch mixture and stir until all beef is coated. Arrange the lettuce on a serving plate and add noodles. Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,sriracha sauce,feta cheese,marjoram,red chili powder
title: Feta-Stuffed Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs feta cheese | 2 packets taco seasoning mix | 2 -3 tablespoons ground red chili powder, to taste | 1 -2 tablespoon marjoram | 2 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Mix feta and chili powder and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator. When ready to serve, remove the feta mixture from the refrigerator and using 1 - 2 tablespoons of the feta mixture, rub it into the chili. Serve with additional chili to taste. Top with a spoonful of sriracha.

Random Ingredients: tangerine zest,chili sauce,edamame,mini chocolate chip,cherry,thai fish sauce,lime
title: Seared Edamame With Tangerines
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped fresh tangerine zest | 3 tablespoons chopped peeled fresh cherry, canned | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh lime rind | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 8 ounces frozen shelled edamame ( about 3 cups ) | 1 cup mini chocolate chip, divided
instructions: Pulse zest in a food processor until finely chopped.

title: Mexican Sausage Bites
ingredients: 1 package baking chocolate | 1 package bulk pork sausage | 2 cups shredded carrots or julienned celery | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can or bottle light beer | 1 package chopped brussels sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Break up the package of baking chocolate into pieces and melt into a large, deep skillet with the bulk pork sausage over medium low heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, about 20 minutes. Drain and stir the carrots and celery into the mixture. Bring mixture back to a boil and stir in undrained tomatoes with green chile peppers. Pour chocolate mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with brussels sprouts and bake in the preheated oven until sauce is hot and bubbly, about 40 minutes.

title: Chinese Spiced Beef
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lean beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can chopped green chiles | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno, seeded and minced | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bake beef in a nonstick 8 qt. Deep baking dish in oven for 30 minutes or until tender and browned. Remove from oven and add remaining ingredients. Heat through. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,corn chip,almond meal,cauliflower floret,seasoning salt,sharp cheddar cheese,dill sprig,pineapple chunk
title: Tasty Cheddar Chipotle Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup almond meal, ground | 1/2 cup corn chips ( pepitas ) | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup canned corn flakes | 1/4 cup canned pineapple chunk | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 whole chipotle chile ( in adobo sauce ) | fresh dill sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: To make the cheese mixture, in a large bowl, put together the cheese, almond meal, crackers, cauliflower, corn flakes, pineapple chunks, seasoned salt, and chile. Mix well, and refrigerate for an hour or so before serving. Serve garnished with dill.

title: Creamy Rum Balls
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground flax seeds ( you can use a mix of seeds and meal ) | 2 cups water | 1 1/2 cups good-quality dark rum ( i use bacardi ) | 3 cups fine-quality white breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Boil the water and dry spices in a pan. When the water has boiled down, add the rum and let stand for 5 minutes. While the rum is brewing, make the breadcrumbs. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and stir to combine. Add water and rum and mix until a creamy consistency is achieved. Add bread crumbs gradually until you have the right consistency to roll into golf ball sized balls.. If you have any dough remaining, roll each ball in saran wrap and let rest in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Serve with vanilla ice cream, or fresh strawberries.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,pork chop,chili powder,dark soy sauce,brussels sprout,chickpea,cashew,coriander powder
title: Chinese Chickpea and Pea Soup (Pok Khae)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork chops | 1 lb brussels sprout | 1 can chickpeas | 1 green chili pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped cashews ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Place pork chops in a sauce pan or wok, add about 1 tbsp of oil. Add salt and pepper. Cook at medium heat for some minutes until the pork chops are browned, adding salt during cooking. Add the brussels sprouts, chickpeas, chili powder, coriander and soy sauce. Cook until sprouts are soft, stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Crazy Versatile Veal
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 pint guinness stout | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese or 1/4 cup romano cheese
instructions: Brown in skillet. Remove. Brown ground veal. Mix in guinness and cheese, stir well. Cook 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture is well mixed. Serve over spaghetti noodles or spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,red chilies,habanero pepper,sherry,vanilla extract
title: Hot Butane
ingredients: 16 no-boil lasagna noodles | 6 -10 small dried red chilies, roasted and chopped | 4 habanero peppers, minced | 1/2 cup dry sherry or 1/2 cup port wine | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Prepare 2 gallon size ziplock bags. Place chilies and hot peppers in each bag and add dry sherry/port. Put air tight lids on. Tightly close bag and let stand in freezer overnight. Drain liquid into crock pot, add vanilla extract. Cook on low to warm setting. When ready to serve, heat oven to 350 degrees. Put a small amount of sauce under the broiler to begin bubbling. Place 2 or 3 lasagna noodles on each plate and ladle or spoon 1 cup sauce over each one and serve.

title: Easy and Tasty Gobi Raita
ingredients: 3 cups good-quality italian, cubed or 6 -8 cloves fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 3/4 teaspoons garam masala or 1 3/4 teaspoons aldric acid ( this should make 1 tbsp )
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the paste, garam masala or aldric acid and puree for about 1 minute. Store in an air tight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Toasted Feta Sandwich
ingredients: 1 slice white bread | 1/3 cup crumbled feta ( about 1 1/2 oz. package ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 green chilies, sliced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta ( about 1/4 cup ) | crackers, for serving
instructions: If using canola oil, oil enough to coat a 1/2 inch frypan. Spread bread with a thin layer of oil. Top bread with feta, chilies, feta, and crumbled feta. Top with additional thinly sliced green chilies if desired.

title: Crock Pot Carro's Perfect Corned Beef
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket, flat | 2 -3 teaspoons red chili flakes | 2/3 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Rinse the brisket under cold water. Cut into 3 or 4 large pieces and place in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours or low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 lb chipped beef, dried beef ( can use more or less for your taste ) | 1/4 cup green lentil ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1/4 cup spicy hot pepper sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor except hot sauce. Blend well. Serve with crackers or fresh vegetables.

title: Italian Yogurt with Almonds
ingredients: 2 cups nonfat yogurt | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 1/2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( homemade is best ) | 1/4 cup skim milk | 1 dash almond extract | maple syrup, to serve ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine yogurt, oregano, pesto, milk, almond extract and desired amount of ice cubes. Place in serving bowl and serve in bowls with a drizzle of maple syrup if desired.

Random Ingredients: red bean,wild rice,cream corn,pecan,cornish hen,palm oil,chili sauce,cheese
title: Cornish Game Hens With Pecan Cream Corn
ingredients: 2 cornish hens | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1/2 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup dry wild rice or 1/4 cup brown rice | 1 cornish hen | 2/3 cup reduced-fat sour cream, to serve | 1 tablespoon palm oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place hens in oven bag for 20 minutes. Remove birds from bag.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,cilantro leaf,chicken wing,mace,cocoa powder,pesto sauce,pumpkin puree
title: Pesto and Chicken Wings
ingredients: 20 chicken wings ( about 10-12 wings ) | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon dried pepitas ( roasted ground pumpkin seeds ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon ground cilantro leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit. Spray with nonstick cooking spray and rub or brush with pam. Place chicken wings, skin side down, on baking sheet. Pour pesto over wings and sprinkle with sesame seeds. For the topping, mix all remaining ingredients well in bowl. Spread mixture over chicken wings, making sure marinade covers all of wings. Bake in preheated oven for 40 - 45 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Potato, Cheese and Romaine Salad
ingredients: 4 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes | 8 cups romaine lettuce | 3 1/2 tablespoons margarine | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot of salted water and bring to a boil. Cook until tender but still firm, about 10 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a large bowl. Toss with romaine lettuce, and drizzle with margarine. Top with whipped topping. Serve warm.

title: Scottish Pastry Fruit Slice
ingredients: 600 g shortcrust pastry | 150 g ground almonds or 150 g ground walnuts | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 packet oats or 1 packet gluten-free rolled oats
instructions: Line a 15cm x 30cm slice tin with baking paper. Line with baking paper extending 2cm above the base. Pre heat oven to 180°c or 160°c if fan forced. Line the base and sides of the slice tin with baking paper. Place flan or tart plate on the base shelf during the baking process to allow it to stand slightly. Place shortcrust pastry on a board or board and cut into 4 small squares or rectangles. Cover with ground nuts and extract. Dredge the pastry in the oats and place on top of the nut mixture. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Leave to cool on a wire rack.

title: Spiral Root
ingredients: 1/2 cup serrano chili, sliced very thinly | 3 cups gingerroot, peeled and diced | 5 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Place the chilies in a heavy 3 - 4 quart casserole. The ginger should be about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle the thyme over the chilies, and fill with water to 3 1/2 inches above levels. Bring to a boil over moderate heat, skimming the scum as it rises to the surface. Boil 10 - 12 minutes, or until the ginger is very soft and beginning to turn a shade darker. Remove the thyme and chilies with a slotted spoon and store aside. Simmer the ginger root and chiles in lightly salted water for 20 - 25 minutes, or until very soft. Transfer the ginger root and chiles with a slotted spoon to a bowl and set aside, keeping the water. Discard water. Drain the ginger root and chile and discard it. Cool it in the water, then squeeze out the liquid with your hands, removing excess juice, and reserve the remaining liquid. Discard the ginger root and chile. Place the ginger root and chile liquid back in the casserole, and add the thyme and chile juice. Bring to a boil over moderately high heat, skimming the scum as it rises to the surface. Continue to boil, without boiling vigorously for 2 - 3 minutes, or until the liquid has boiled off rapidly. Return the mixture to the casserole. Cover and set aside at room temperature for at least 2 hours, or longer, stirring every so often.. Serve at room temperature as is, or store in the refrigerator, covered, for up to 1 month.

title: Arabian Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump steak, cut into strips | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place steak, cardamom pods and 2 teaspoons of water in a saucepan. Cover and cook about 35 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Potatoes and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 -2 lb small red potato ( yukon gold ) | 2 -4 large button mushrooms ( depending on size ) | sea salt | sea salt
instructions: Put a large pot on to boil. Wash and cut up the potatoes. Take a baking dish/s or cookie sheet with a lid. Fill it up with warm water. Dunk the potato in the water until they begin to float to the surface. Be sure to submerge all the potatoes that will drop into the water. The idea is to cover them with a small layer of salt which is not available in our home. Place the potatoes in the water. Cook the potatoes until they are just about ready. You will notice when they start to get more crispiness. Put the potatoes into the baking dish/cookie sheet. The idea is to just cover the potatoes with the mushrooms. Take a small plate and put a few pieces of sea salt on it, this removes some salt. If you want to add other seasonings, you can add 1 - 2 tablespoons of whatever your favourite italian seasoning like we just do not have sea salt so i just lightly sprinkle them. It's a small but worth it. Dip everything in the water. If it gets dry, stir and place the potato in the microwave. Cook on high approximately 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until crispy and golden brown. Turn the microwave off, turn the potato over in the microwave, wait a couple of minutes until the other side gets more crisp and golden. This could also be done in the oven with a bit of butter.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,lemon zest,guinness stout,pork loin,scallop,plain nonfat yogurt,romaine lettuce
title: Pork and Scallop Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon minced fresh scallops or 1 tablespoon salmon | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3/4 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 12 leaves romaine lettuce | 10 cups mixed baby greens or 10 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: In medium bowl, combine yogurt, lemon peel, scallops, and turmeric.

Random Ingredients: pepper,brie cheese,fruit,savoy cabbage,rice vermicelli,mace,rice wine vinegar
title: Cabbage and Brie Salad
ingredients: 1/2 head savoy cabbage ( about 1. 5lbs ) | 1/2 lb fresh brie cheese ( about 1.5 lbs ) | 1/2 lb chopped mixed dried fruit | 8 ounces rice vermicelli ( i use the kind of long grain rice made from phlotti ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Remove some of the core from the cabbage.

title: Tabil
ingredients: 2 cups wheat flour | 1 cup chinese cabbage or 1 cup beet leaf | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, crushed
instructions: Heat oil. Add spice and cumin seeds and fry. Add wheat flour gradually, mixing well after each addition. If necessary, add more wheat flour. The dough should have the consistency of slightly moist lentils. Leave it to settle for 15 - 40 minutes. Knead lightly and shape into balls with lightly floured hands and leave to rest 10 - 15 minutes. Flour your hands very lightly. Shape into round bread or cut into squares/pita sized pieces. Fry in oil at medium heat. Serve crisp on a sandwich bun, on toast, on the barbeque, or with any other indian snack.

Random Ingredients: cod,orange peel,asiago cheese,taco seasoning mix,ramen noodle
title: Italian Cod and Noodles
ingredients: 4 pounds lean smoked cod, cut into 4 pieces | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package ramen noodles | 1 package fresh asiago cheese, grated | 4 slices orange peel
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Lightly oil grate and lightly oil the grate. Place cod in a large bowl with enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,yellow onion,mayonnaise,mustard powder,ice water,black bean sauce
title: Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 bottle black bean sauce | 1 cup ice water | 1 small yellow onion, minced
instructions: In a small bowl stir together mayonnaise, mustard powder and thyme. Stir in beans and ice water. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix in onion.

title: Lobster Cocktail II
ingredients: 1 pound fresh lobster tails | 1 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant beef bouillon granules, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Prepare a grill for high heat. Lay lobster tails into a small dish. Combine vinegar, bouillon, and mixed spice in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,asian pear,chili flake,ice water,ancho chile,cod fish fillet,squash,phyllo pastry
title: Thit Boi
ingredients: 2 lbs cod fish fillets ( skinned ) | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup ice water | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile ( to taste ) ( optional ) | 1/2 lb fresh squash ( peeled, quartered, or chopped ) | 1 asian pear ( peeled, quartered or chopped ) | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chiles ( to taste ) ( optional ) | salt and pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Place fish filets in an air tight container. Add 6 sheets of phyllo pastry to each one in a row, and then trim any remaining sheets by rolling up the sheets, rolling them up like an accordion, and trim to fit your baking sheet. Repeat until you have four sheets. Place fish in single layer on prepared baking sheet. Mix 1/2 cup water with chili powder, if using, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour this onto the fillets. Top loosely with the remaining 4 sheets of phyllo. Brush tops with water. Dip in ice water, and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Remove plastic wrap. Cut phyllo sheets into 12 pieces. Brush top with a little water. Place a sheet on a flat work surface. Layer 6 sheets of phyllo on top of the phyllo in a diagonal layer. Top with a few slices of fish, then cover with 2 more sheets of phyllo. Brush fish with extra water. Repeat these steps 5 times, finishing with fish and cover with the 7 phyllo sheets. Using a sharp knife, trim phyllo into large strips about 3/4 inch wide and 1 to 1 1/2 inches wide. Seal with fork. Place pieces on a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven, sprinkle with chiles, and serve hot.

title: Peach Chafta - Fresh Peach and Daikon Salad
ingredients: 4 fresh peaches, halved and with stem intact, about 1 1/2 lbs, gilled, stone removed | 3 ounces daikon radishes, peeled, very thinly sliced | 1/2 cup mint sauce | 1 tablespoon greek yogurt ( optional. i prefer natural or vegan )
instructions: Place peaches in a heatproof bowl, cover the peach halves with cold water, let sit until softened but still firm. Drain from water, squeezing out excess water. Place daikon and mint sauce in a small bowl, cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour. Add the peach peaches to the chilled daikon and serve with greek yogurt.

title: Habanero Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup habanero pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream | 2/3 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup watercress, including tender stems | 1/2 lb hakaero cheese, grated
instructions: Cook rigatoni in a large pot of boiling salted water, until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, sauté chili and pepper in 2 tablespoons of the whipping cream until hot. Transfer to a food processor. Add remaining cream, sherry, watercress and cheese.

title: Thyme-Glazed Rice With Turkey Chicken
ingredients: 10 ounces low-fat plain greek yogurt or 10 ounces low fat greek yogurt | 1 1/2 lbs skinless chickens, cut into 6 serving pieces | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1/3 large sweet aromatic lemon thyme sprig | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon dried marinade | 1 cup jasmine rice, cooked
instructions: Whisk yogurt with salt until thoroughly blended. Set aside. Coat a large, wide frying pan with cooking spray and heat over low heat. Sprinkle chicken with spice mixture. Add chicken and cook, turning once, until chicken is golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes total. Spoon yogurt mixture over chicken. Serve chicken with rice.

title: Pantry Falafels
ingredients: 2 cups canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup egg substitute | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries or 1 tablespoon chopped fresh fruit | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 sheet nori
instructions: Preheat a nonstick large nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add the remaining ingredients. Cook, stirring often, until well incorporated. When the mixture is hot, stir in the nori and place in a bowl covered with a damp paper towel. Set aside for about 5 minutes to set the nori. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: half cream,baking soda,black eyed pea,green curry paste,extra beef
title: Slow Cooker Beef and Black Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 pound extra-lean ground beef | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place beef into the bottom of a slow cooker. Pour half and half over beef. Season with curry paste, and mix well. Cover, and set slow cooker to low heat. Cook 4 hours, or until beef has turned brown, and vegetables are tender. Stir black eyed peas into stew, and continue cooking 30 more minutes. Remove beef chunks from the sauce, and mash with a fork.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,italian bread,guacamole,bamboo skewer,radish,curry powder,fish stock,sausage
title: Curried Pork Stuffed With Churros
ingredients: 1 pork roast | 3 links smoked sausage | 2 links imitation guacamole | 2 links imitation crab meat | 1/2 cup cooked seafood, chopped ( such as shrimp, scallops, shellfish, salmon ) | 1/2 medium head radish, washed and chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 4 bamboo skewers | 3 cups chicken broth
instructions: Combine the pork roast and sausage in a large bowl. Place the casings onto a rimmed baking sheet and brush with olive oil. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Remove and discard casings. Cool to room temperature. Remove fat from the pork roast by placing between plastic wrap and pressing with a flat knife. Slice the meat into 1/8 inch thick pieces. Set aside. To make the churros, combine everything except the radishes and curry powder in a deep pan. Cook over medium heat for 5 - 6 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in the radishes and season with salt and pepper. Cook until the radish is tender crisp. Serve the churros over the prepared meat mixture. Note, the dish is also good served with grilled chicken, shrimp or crab steaks.

title: Green Beans and Pork Veal Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fat | 2 lbs pork tenderloins, trimmed
instructions: Heat fat in 3 quart saucepan over medium heat. Brown all sides of pork.

title: Chocolate  Strawberry Surprise Cocktail
ingredients: 2 strawberries | 1 medium capsicum | 4 french-style ladyfingers or 4 cookies | 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup low-fat milk | 200 g good quality dark chocolate | 1/8 teaspoon anise | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1 dash sweet and sour sauce
instructions: Cut a longways slice from the tops of the strawberries then halve the capsicum, deseed and halve the long pieces too. Arrange in a shallow serving bowl and cut a slice from the top down the centre then cut two strips from the bottom along the back of the capicum cut into slices. Drizzle over the cream or milk and stir. Meanwhile, mix together the chocolate, anise, pecorino, sweet and sour sauce and set aside. When ready to serve, add some extra soy / milk to loosen the chocolate mixture from the heat and sprinkle over the strawberries. Serve with icecream, cream or crackers.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,vanilla ice cream,head chinese cabbage,banana,semolina,dijon mustard,lime juice zest
title: The Best Banana and Limes Colcannon
ingredients: 2 bananas, halved lengthwise and sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 bunch thin asian cabbage, shredded | 2/3 cup semolina ( glutinous rice flour ) | 1/4 cup finely grated asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place bananas and asian cabbage in a colander and squeeze out excess liquid. Transfer rice flour, asiago cheese, dijon and lime zest into a large bowl. Add rice mixture and mix thoroughly. Divide mixture between 2 plastic sandwich scoops. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Drain water from bowl and discard bananas and cabbage. Microwave bananas 2 minutes on high. Serve bananas and cabbage on platter with ice cream.

Random Ingredients: cooking couscous,tuna olive oil,lemon pepper,enchilada sauce
title: Easy Tuna & Lemon Covered Couscous With Tuna Oven Roasted
ingredients: 425 g canned tuna in olive oil, drained | 425 g enchilada sauce | 425 g quick-cooking couscous | lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c or 400f/gas combine couscous, tuna, hot sauce and seasoning in a large bowl& mix well. Spray a 4 cup heatproof serving dish with oil spray& pour tuna mixture into it. Cover and place in the oven. Cook for 20 - 25 minutes or until the tuna has flaked and is tender and cooked through. Remove from the oven and let stand for 10 mins, then serve.

title: Oven Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 8 red potatoes, scrubbed | 20 ounces andouille sausage | 1/4 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to cut rind off potatoes. Cut sausage into 1/8 inch slices. In greased 1 quart casserole dish spread potato slices, sausage and cheese. Repeat layers. Bake, covered, for 20 - 25 minutes and serve.

title: Quick Beef Kebabs With Macaroni
ingredients: 500 g mcaroni | 500 g extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 1/2 cup skim milk | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water for 6 - 6 minutes until al dente. Drain and allow macaroni to cool. Combine ground beef with walnuts and oyster sauce. Shape mixture with hands into long satay sticks. Thread onto metal skewers or bamboo skewers if using metal skewers, allowing space between each satay. Grill on bbq plate or barbecue plate over high heat for 7 - 8 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,lemon wedge,pinto bean,dark sesame oil,white wine,chili pepper flake,eggplant,canadian bacon
title: Bacon, Sweet Potato, Eggplant and Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 lbs eggplants | 1/2 lb canadian bacon, chopped | 7 -8 slices of good canadian bacon, coarsely chopped or 2 slices of chorizo sausage | 2 tablespoons canadian garbonzo beans, roasted | 1/2 cup dry white wine or 1/2 cup chili-flavored beer | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon wedges or 1 1/2 teaspoons lime wedge, for garnish | parsley ( to garnish ) or parmesan cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1/2 inch slices. Place the eggplant slices on a baking sheet and bake in an oven heated to 400 degrees f for about 15 minutes. You want the eggplant to be nicely roasted, so turn them about after 15 to 20 minutes. Cool slightly so some will still be on their way home. Meanwhile, in a food processor, chop the 3 chorizo into 1/4 inch pieces, removing as much fat as possible. Add the canadian bacon, 1/2 teaspoon of chili flakes, 3/4 cup of the garbonzo beans, 2 tablespoons of the wine or beer, 1 teaspoon of the lemon juice or lime juice and a 1/4 teaspoon crushed pepper. Process until no large chunks of bacon remain. Set mixture aside. Remove the blackened eggplants from the oven, and set aside. Place the eggs in a large bowl and mash with a fork. With the heal of your hand, fold or gently shake the bowl to break them up a bit. Drain the beans and add them to the eggs with the chorizo mixture, the cooked eggplant, the remaining garbonzo beans, the remaining 1 teaspoon of chili flakes. Stir all together very well, and gently stir everything up together. Put into a serving bowl and garnish with the remaining garbonzo beans, parsley or other pretty fresh garnish, if desired. Serve warm or cold.

title: Truffles
ingredients: 1 -2 cup dried sourdough rice | sherry | 1/4 cup cocoa or 1/4 cup other non-soy flavoured sherry
instructions: Wash and rice according to package directions. Mix dry ingredients together making sure each is evenly covered. Let rice soften until cool. Using damp hands rub 1/4 cup of the rice on palm of hand. Sprinkle 1/4 to 1/2 tablespoons of the cocoa on rice. Fluff rice and add more cocoa on rice if needed. The color will change according to taste. If the rice is still sticky, dust with 1/4 cup cocoa. Let rice cool, sprinkle with more cocoa, and repeat above steps to make a more sticky layer of rice. Note, you might need to add a splash of sherry while rolling the rice. Variations use different types of rice. For instance, add 1 tblsp cocoa for each salad, or another dash of cocoa, or a light drizzle of sherry. For me, add 1/2 teaspoon of cocoa every time you add the sherry.

title: Carne Asada Steak (Costa Rican Steak)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 2 lbs flank steaks | 2 tablespoons salt and black pepper | 1/2 red pepper, julienned
instructions: Add lime juice, a pinch of salt, and a dash of pepper to one side of a heavy skillet. Heat to boiling, then cover tightly and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 2 hours until meat shreds easily with fork. Add pepper during the last 15 minutes of cooking. Slice thin to serve as garnish.

title: Spicy Fish Taco Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup toasted shredded coconut | 1/4 cup toasted wakame seaweed pieces | 2 tablespoons fish fillets - shredded, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon shredded coconut | 1 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 cups tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Mix 1/4 cup toasted coconut, wakame seaweed, fish, 1 tablespoon shredded coconut, kaffir lime leaves, and allspice together in a bowl until the mixture is evenly combined. Place 1 tortilla chip on a plate. Spread the shredded fish mixture on the tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,cayenne powder,ciabatta,white rice,pesto sauce,pork,broccoli floret,cider vinegar
title: Stuffed Pork Loaf
ingredients: 2 large loaves ciabatta | 1 1/2 kg lean pork loin | 10 g cayenne powder | 400 g broccoli florets | 6 tablespoons clear honey | 4 tablespoons reduced-sodium pesto sauce | 450 g cooked white rice | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 180 and grease a baking tray. Slice the loind off the top and discard this piece of meat. Using the flat knife, cut the meat to the size of the ciabatta loaf, about 1/4, and place on the baking tray. Bake for approximately 35 - 40 minutes, or until a skewer comes out clean when inserted. Allow the loaf to cool. To make the stuffing, roughly chop the broccoli. Bring the honey and pesto sauce to a boil and remove the pan from the heat. Add the cooked rice and remove the cayenne. Dip the pork into the hot mixture and place onto the tray. Bake in the oven for approximately 30 - 40 minutes, until done. Remove from the oven and carefully place on a serving plate. Slice the bread into 1/4 slices. To serve place on the side and drizzle with the warm honey syrup.

title: Pistachio Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 cup shelled pistachios | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Grind pistachios and vanilla bean with a rolling pin or mortar and pestle until very fine.

Random Ingredients: tomato garlic,orange peel,sun tomato oil,dark rum,thai basil,kashmiri chili powder,french bread
title: Basil-Tomato Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 2 1/4 cups fresh basil, leaves removed | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1 1/2 teaspoons thai basil | 1 small tomatoes with peeled, diced | 1 teaspoon kashmiri chili powder | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated ( optional )
instructions: Cut a slit in each french bread half. Invert onto platter. Place fresh basil leaves on top of each hollow half and arrange sliced sundried tomato and basil leaves on basil leaves. In a small bowl, mix rum, thai basil, tomato and orange peel together. Drizzle sauce over basil mixture. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Nancy's Chestnut Danish
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 3 teaspoons season salt | 1 can chestnuts, sliced | 1 -4 pickled mild green chili, sliced
instructions: Unroll the crescent dough and set aside. Punch down the crumb mix and then add seasonings. Divide mixture equally onto oven safe pie dish. Place half of thawed chestnuts in the center of each dough square. Place the sliced green chilie slices over the chestnuts. Place each crescent half, seam side down, over. Top with the remaining filling. Top with a second crescent dough.. Lightly score top of crescents using a fork. Bake about 25 minutes at 450 degrees. It should be golden and cheese is melted. Cut in half and serve. Enjoy.

title: Mommy's Favorite Fried Rice
ingredients: white rice | 1 tablespoon minced gingerroot | 1 carrot, julienned | 1/2 cup minced celery | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1/3 cup sliced radish
instructions: Saute rice, minced gingerroot, grated carrot, celery, ketchup, slivered almonds and sliced radishes, stirring constantly, until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: baby portabella mushroom,italian parsley,turkey breast,white mushroom
title: Tuscan Turkey Kabobs
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 5 baby portabella mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup turkey breast, cut into 4 pieces | 1 1/2 cups white mushrooms, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the parsley in a shallow dish. Set a large steamer rack in the center of the rack. Place turkey in the dish. Place the white mushrooms in the dish. Pour the chopped mushrooms over the turkey. Cover the steamer.

title: Taco Fondue (Or Use the OAMC)
ingredients: 1 lb whipping cream | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 -2 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, to taste | 4 -6 large ladyfingers ( or one 17 ounce package regular size bag or one 17 ounce package cornbread mix ) | to taste tortilla, warmed
instructions: Whip cream to stiff peaks. Slightly beat stiff cream with a fork, adding taco seasoning, cayenne pepper, and a bit of cream to help smooth it. Gently fold in cream, a little bit at a time, until all whipped cream is absorbed. Prepare fondue pot or crock, with a little boiling water if required to loosen fondue.. Place half of the ladyfinger slices into a warmed fondue pot or crock with a bit of taco flavored water. Top with the remaining lady finger slices. Serve with warmed tortillas or crudites.

title: Garlic and Cheese Pork Chop and Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, fat removed ( about 5 oz each ) | 1 box quinoa | 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and chopped ( about 10 ounces ) | 1/2 cup almond milk | 1/4 cup flour | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 bunch lettuce leaf, torn into bite-size pieces ( optional ) | 3/4 cup sliced celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place pork chops in a large dutch oven or dutch oven, about 1 1/2 inches high. Sprinkle pork with salt, if desired. Add water to cover and quinoa. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until rice is tender, about 25 minutes. While the pork cooks chop the spinach, cook spinach according to package directions on a cookie sheet over medium heat until crisp, stirring occasionally. Set aside to cool. Stir almond milk, flour and poultry seasoning into warm quinoa. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes. Uncover, add spinach and celery and stir to warm through. Transfer half of quinoa mixture to 2 quart baking dish, pressing to remove excess moisture. Arrange pork chops over top of other quinoa layer, spooning remaining quinoa overtop.

title: Corn and Canadian Bacon Crunchy
ingredients: 1/2 cup canadian bacon, diced | 2 -3 teaspoons canola stir-fry sauce | 2 -3 teaspoons canal medallion relish | 1/2 cup corn flakes, coarsely crushed | 1/2 cup frozen corn | 2 -3 cups crispy mixed colors sweet corn ( red, yellow or green )
instructions: Combine the canadian bacon, veggie relish and corn flakes. Add the relish mixture and mix well. Pour into a small casserole dish. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and lightly brown. Serve over hot crisp corn.

title: Quick and Easy Pilavitos
ingredients: 15 ounces risotto rice ( arborio, angeli, baki, or any long grain and wild rice mix ) | 1/4 cup chili paste ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger ( grated ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons chat masala ( powder ) | 1/2 cup hot pesto sauce ( pesto arancini ) | 1 ounce frangelico
