instructions: Soak the rice for about 20 minutes in plenty of water. Meanwhile heat a non stick pan, add the chilli paste, ginger and chat masala. Stir for a couple of minutes, until fragrant, but not browned. Toss in the rice and pour in the hot pesto, stir. Cover with a lid, and reduce heat to a simmer, then cook for about 12 minutes. Remove the lid, stir the rice vigorously and cook for another 3 - 5 minutes. Tip the arancini into a large bowl, stir in the rest of the pesto and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,coriander,breadcrumb,mozzarella cheese,velveeta cheese,italian seasoning,ladyfinger,center pork chop
title: Crock Pot Pulled Pork and Cheese
ingredients: 4 lbs center-cut pork chops | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 boxes of seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 package mozzarella cheese | 4 cups velveeta cheese ( or cream cheese ) | 28 ounces condensed tomato soup | 20 ladyfingers
instructions: Spray slow cooker with pam. Place pork, seasonings, bread crumbs, cheese into crockpot on top of a layer of bread crumbs. Drizzle with soup and layer of ladyfingers. If there is no soup left in the base of your cooker, make a second layer of bread crumbs and continue to repeat. Set crockpot to warm for 4 hours or until pork and cheese are tender.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,coriander seed,kosher salt black pepper
title: Homemade Sesame Crescents
ingredients: 1/2 lb coriander seed, coarsely ground in a spice grinder | 2 tablespoons kosher salt, plus more for seasoning | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil
instructions: For the spices, toast the coriander seeds in a heavy skillet over moderate heat, shaking the pan well, until golden. Transfer to a pestle and mortar and grind with 1 tablespoon salt. Stir in the sesame oil and pulse until finely ground and evenly distributed. Store in an airtight jar in a cool place but not to the freezer, for up to 1 year.

title: Chinese Steamed Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 large steamed snow peas | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 4 slices french bread, 1 cm thick
instructions: Put the snow peas in a steamer on a pan with the sugar and 1/4 cup of water. Cover and steam for 10 minutes or until crisp tender. To serve place bread on 4 serving plates. Spoon snow peas around the bread and serve with syrup.

Random Ingredients: corn,poblano chile,tomato juice,guajillo chilies,wine,navy bean,large shrimp
title: Shrimp in Red Clam Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 2 large pasilla chiles, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 cups poblano chiles, canned diced ( wear gloves to handling poblano chiles ) | 1 lb guajillo chilies, deseeded and torn into pieces | 1 cup dried navy beans, rinsed until just soft but not mushy | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 cups wine
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil. Drop in the poblanos and beans and cook for 5 minutes. Immediately drain and reserve the cooking water. Add the shrimp to the water and cook for 1 minute. Drain and set aside. Add the guajillos to the water and cook over low heat until barely softened, about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add the tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Add the rum to the cooking liquid. Heat for about 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to low. Stir in the shrimp and cook, stirring, for another 2 minutes. Pour into serving bowls. Pass additional cooking water at the table.

title: Smoked Tilapia and Ham Pizza
ingredients: 8 ounces pre-made pizza cheese | 6 ounces smoked ham | 2 sheets puff pastry | 1/4 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Place pastry on pizza pan, stretch pastry to form a 7x8 rectangle. Place on pizza peel and brush edges with olive oil or corn oil. Top with smoked ham and cut into 6 diagonal slices. Add the marsala and top with the puff pastry. Put on the pizza peel in the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until bottom slightly brown. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing into 4 squares.

title: Pork Chops With Applesauce
ingredients: 4 large tart apples | 1/2 cup dry curd cottage cheese | 2 lbs pork chops, thickly sliced
instructions: Peel the apples, and place them in a slow cooker. Add the cottage cheese, stir to mix, and season to taste with salt. Layer the pork slices lengthwise, on top of the applesauce and dot with the remaining cottage cheese. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours, or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Serve warm.

title: Barley Crab, Feta Stuffed Grape Leaves, and Rice (Bengali)
ingredients: 1/2 lb crabmeat ( fresh or imitation ) | 1/2 lb fresh prawns, shelled and deveined or 1/2 lb imitation crabmeat | 1/2 lb lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon jalapeno, minced ( remove seeds if other marinade is in hand ) | crushed barley, for plating and serving | 2 cups rice flour | 1/2 lb feta cheese, grated
instructions: Cut stems off grape leaves and drain well. Wash in cold water and dry well. Cut off greeks' tips, as above. Cut grape leaves in half lengthwise. Remove membrane by using paring a knife or a small spatula. Rinse well and squeeze out most of excess water. Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Place grape leaves, hollow sides up, on a lightly oiled baking sheet and place in the oven for 30 minutes. Meanwhile in a large mixing bowl, beat together crabmeat, prawns, lemon juice, jalapenos, rice flour, and feta. Pour 1/2 cup hot water into a large shallow bowl. Remove grape leaves from oven and place 1 rounded tablespoon of crab mixture in center of each grapeleaf, then fold in the remaining two portions of crab mixture. Scoop out filling from grape leaves and place about 1 teaspoonful of stuffing in center of each grapeleaf, smoothing the top surface with a spoon. Pile the stuffed grape leaves in a baking dish, cover with foil and bake in the oven for 1 hour. Remove foil and continue cooking 1 hour longer.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,heavy cream,vegetable broth,beef gravy,wheat bread,head cabbage
title: Creamed Cabbage with Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 small head cabbage, cored and leaves separated | 3 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 cup beef gravy | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 loaf whole wheat bread, torn into 3 pieces
instructions: Place the sliced cabbage in a colander set in the sink, pour enough water into the colander to cover, and toss in the sugar until the cabbage wilts. Press the cabbage into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and spread it out into a thin layer on the top of the baking dish. Set aside. Bring the beef gravy and cream to a simmer in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the cabbage, and cook, stirring often, until tender and slightly browned at edges, about 15 minutes. Place the bread pieces on top of the cabbage, and spoon the cabbage into bowls. Serve with the beef gravy spooned over the bread.

title: Persian Roasted Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup cream cheese, softened | 1/8 cup finely chopped pimiento | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Mix well and place in medium bowl. Beat with mixer on high for 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally. Using plastic wrap lightly roll cheese to coat, then shape into round 8 slices about 1/2 thick and about 2 1/2 long. Arrange in ungreased 13x9 inch baking dish, overlapping rows of cheese, if necessary.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,tomato sauce,goat cheese,chipotle chile,garam masala,yellow tomato,tahini
title: Spicy Tomato Dip
ingredients: 1 medium tomatoes, diced | 1 cup yellow tomatoes, diced | 3/4 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 cup goat cheese, grated | 2 chipotle chiles, canned minced | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a serving bowl and stir well. Garnish with cheese slices. Serve with toasted pita chips.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,salt,maple syrup,peppercorn,camembert cheese,tarragon,parmesan cheese
title: Maple-Glazed Camembert Cheese With Tomato-Camembert Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces camembert cheese, cut in half horizontally, then cut in half horizontally | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, freshly ground | 2 -3 canned chopped tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill pan over high heat. Coat cheese with maple syrup in a small skillet over medium heat and salt and pepper pepper to taste. Cook cheese in broiler until lightly browned, 2 - 3 minutes. Arrange on a platter to serve. Top cheese with tomato chilies and tarragon and serve with french bread or crackers. Yields 4 servings.

title: Avocado and Jamaican Bacon Mashed
ingredients: 3 avocados - peeled, pitted and diced | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh herb, divided | 1 pound chopped streaky bacon | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper | 2 fresh pickled jalapeno peppers, chopped, or to taste | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 dash ground nutmeg, or to taste
instructions: Place the avocado, 3 tablespoons herbs, bacon, bell pepper, jalapeno peppers, ginger, 1 1/2 tablespoons cilantro, and half and half into a blender, and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,garlic salt,cream tartar,tuna steak,radish,grain rice
title: Herb and Tuna Rice Crisps
ingredients: 2 tuna steaks or 2 salmon steaks | 1/2 cup long grain rice ( uncooked ) | 1 tablespoon dried mixed italian herbs | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon radish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place salmon steaks on a baking dish. In a bowl combine rice, herbs and cream of tartar. Sprinkle seasonings over fish steaks. Bake, uncovered, for 40 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve warm with salad and crusty french bread if desired.

title: Cheddar and Roasted Okra
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted | 4 baby carrots | 1/2 lb white cheddar cheese, grated | 3 cups okra, fresh, frozen, and thawed | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet japanese cooking wine )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Toast the hazelnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan occasionally, until golden brown, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cherry,vanilla vodka,salsa verde,parmigiano reggiano cheese,bean sprout,chipotle powder,sesame oil
title: Chipotle-Salsa Verde Noodles (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 ounces sesame oil | 2 1/2 ounces vanilla flavored vodka | 1/3 ounce semi-sweet salsa verde ( green or red ) | 1/2 ounce dried chipotle powder ( or more and half or any other hot sauce or other liquid ) | 10 -15 cherry or 10 -15 grape tomatoes | 8 ounces bean sprouts, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Chop tomatoes in half crosswise and then spread out on a plate. Add salsa verde, chocolate or any other hot sauce as listed above. Mix well to combine. Pile bean sprouts on top and serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk powder,chocolate chip,cream tartar,olive oil,tomato,green bell pepper,yellow mustard
title: Microwave Chocolate Chip Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon light cream of tartar | 1 cup plain dorsey's coconut milk powder | 1/2 cup sweet potato chips, coarsely grated | 1 cup chopped green bell pepper | 2 tomatoes, chopped | 1/3 cup olive oil
instructions: Combine yellow mustard and cream of tartar in a large bowl.

title: Authentic Mexican Restaurant-Style Beef Taquitos
ingredients: 2 lbs skirt steaks or 2 lbs flank steaks | 1/4 cup flour
instructions: Thoroughly clean steak and cut to size specified on skirt steak.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,angostura bitter,meatball,dill sprig,bulk italian sausage,italian parsley,portabella mushroom cap,chicken bouillon cube
title: Dill Polish Meat Stuffed Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 large portabella mushroom caps ( or just large enough to hold about 1 cup of filling ) | 24 frozen precooked meatballs | 18 slices leftover cooked bulk italian sausage | 3 dill sprigs italian parsley | 1 1/2 cups philadelphia cream cheese with a touch of philadelphia | 3 tablespoons angostura bitters | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 3 ounces fresh dill sprigs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove 1/3 of cap from mushroom caps and set aside. Discard the remaining caps. Separate the remaining 2 cap halves from caps and discard. Set aside. Carefully remove 1/4 of the mushroom caps from the underside and discard. Set aside at least 1/2 cup of stuffing for the filling. Lay out the mushroom cap halves so they are flat on the bottom and the top and sides of the mushroom. Using the back of a spoon and gently press the stuffing from each mushroom cap to create an open space for stuffing. Place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Using your thumb, carefully separate the mushroom tops from the bottom. Carefully place the portabella mushroom tops into a mixing bowl, taking care not to hit the bottom of the bowl you just had to move the mushrooms from the top to bottom. To make the italian cream, puree the cream cheese with an immersion blender. Add in the angostura bitters, whisking until creamy. Add 3 t of the cream cheese mixture and whisk until well blended. Taste for salt and pepper. Add in 1 1/3 cup of the cream cheese mixture to the softened cream cheese, and whisk thoroughly. Transfer to a small bowl. Repeat with the remaining 1/3 of cream cheese mixture. Dice the remaining fresh mushroom, place in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Add the fresh dill and 1/2 cup of cream cheese mixture, whisking until well incorporated. Drain the mushroom cap tops from the tops and scoop out the mushroom tops. Place the reserved stuffing into a small saucepan and add 1 boullion cube. Stuff the filled mushroom caps with the creamy stuffing mixture and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20 minutes, or until nicely browned and filling is heated through. Remove the tray from the oven and allow to cool for about 10 minutes. Remove foil from the topping and drizzle each mushroom with a little extra cream cheese mixture. Repeat with the remaining stuffing and mushroom tops. Serve immediately.

title: Bread and Avocado Oil
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs day-old loaf of white bread | 1/2 lb ripe avocado packed in oil, peeled, flesh mashed
instructions: Cut a slit through the crusts of the bread on both sides, then slash the loaf in 1/2 thick slices and put them into a small, flat bowl. Stuff the avocados inside of the slice. Dot some avocado flesh inside of each loaf and press it together with your fingers to make 4 large, round, well stuffed loafs. Place them on foil covered baking sheet and bake at 325°f for 30 minutes, turning once. Cool before removing the bread from the pan.

title: Buckingham Palace Blue Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups white breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup salad oil | 2 ounces blue cheese | 1 1/4 cups mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl combine bread crumbs and oil.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,brown onion,cream cheese,ricotta cheese,rye bread,english mustard,lamb,basil
title: Herby Lamb Burgers
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread | 1 package cream cheese | 1 package ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup red onion, finely sliced | 1 cup lamb, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1 tablespoon italian herb | 1 tablespoon brown onion
instructions: Combine ingredients. Using a tablespoon, form 4 patties. Cook on a preheated griddle pan or pan for about 6 minutes on each side. Serve with a tossed salad.

title: Chinese Beans with Sweet Onion
ingredients: 2 cups beans sprouts | 1 red onion, chopped
instructions: Place the beans and the red onion into a large skillet, cover with approximately 2 inches of water and bring to a boil. Cover the skillet and steam for 7 minutes. The onions should be translucent, about 3 to 5 more minutes.

title: White miso Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white miso | 1 banana, sliced | 1/2 cup watermelon, halved cubed ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 bananas, sliced | 1/4 cup sweetened dried apricot jam | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1 -2 sprig fresh basil
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the miso and 1/2 cup water until smooth. Set aside to use as garnish. In a 2 to 3 quart bowl, toss together the sliced banana, watermelon and sliced bananas.

title: Coco - An Absolute Gem of Hades - Jamie Oliver and Jamie
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons tracle ( coconut flavour ) | 1/2 bunch treacle | 1/2 teaspoon salt | angel flake coconut, flakes for garnishing
instructions: Mix the tracle, treacle and salt in a bowl. Strain the mixture into a small pot. Add your coconut flakes and whisk briskly until thoroughly combined. To serve, cut a hole through the palm of your hand. Pour your teacups into the hole. Sprinkle each with the tracle mixture and serve immediately. Garnish with lots of choc. These are supposed to be eaten either hot or cold.

title: Lemongrass & Coconut Sorrel
ingredients: 600 g fresh squid | 2 stalks lemongrass, white flesh only, finely chopped | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 150 ml creme fraiche
instructions: Cut the tentacles from the squid and slit them lengthways. Tear off the gills and discard, then cut the body into slices. Finely chop the flesh and place the flesh in a bowl with the lemongrass, sugar and creme fraiche. Mix well. Cover the bowl and leave in a cool, dry place for one hour. To serve, cut the squid into slices and arrange over a bed of sorrel or other tropical seafood. Serve.

title: Pan Fried Asiago Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 jar ragu asiago cheese | butter or margarine | bacon drippings
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 cups of a 1/2 cups of cake flour in a large fry pan at low temperature until a thick paste forms. While holding this pan, slice the tenderloin thin using sharp knife. Don't cut all the way through the center, just the ends. Cut out a 1/4 1/2 inch wide strip of dough on each side of tenderloin. You should have 18 strips, total. You will need 1/4 1/2 wide strips. Mix 1 1/2 cups of a 1/2 cups cake flour with 1 1/2 cups of a 1 1/2 cups of cake flour. Dab each strip with wet fingers.

title: Blue Blac
ingredients: 2 ounces blue curacao | 2 ounces raisins
instructions: In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, shake the curacao and raisins. Pour into a hurricane glass so that some of the raisins are in the bottom. Enjoy.

title: Broccolini (Couscous)
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered almonds flour or 1/2 cup almond meal | 1/2 cup blanched slivered almond flour | 1/4 cup milk | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh fruit juice | 1 cup fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Place almond flour in a processor. Process until very fine, add the milk, almonds and shallot, process until mixture forms a fine paste, scraping down the sides while you do so. Add the broccoli and continue to process until the broccoli is finely chopped. Add the raisins, mustard seeds and reserved raisins. Cover and chill the mixture overnight. The next day, remove the broccoli flowerets and discard. Place the mixture into an 8 inch x 8 inch baking dish. Sprinkle top with slivered almonds. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes until crispy. Serve warm with a bowl of hot custard.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,wheat tortilla,spring onion,grand marnier
title: Quesadillas With Chilies, Tomato & Treacle
ingredients: 1 whole wheat tortilla | 2 tablespoons chilies, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon tomatoes and green chilies, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons rosemary or 2 tablespoons thyme, chopped finely
instructions: Warm the barbecue.. Add the chilies, tomatoes and olive oil in a saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until chilies start to soften. To plate, spread some chilies over the plate, top with tomato, sprinkle with rosemary or thyme.

title: Elegant Mango Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup diced mango chutney | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon, or to taste | 1 tablespoon irish cream
instructions: Mix mango chutney, chicken bouillon, rum and irish cream together in a bowl.

title: Guava Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken meat, chopped | 2 guavas
instructions: Cook guavas in boiling water 5 to 10 minutes then drain and peel. Place guava in skillet with 2 cups water, add and mix well.

Random Ingredients: baguette,grain rice,pinto bean,superfine sugar,fontina cheese,grain white rice
title: The Great Beans and Rice
ingredients: 14 ounces pinto beans | 14 ounces fontina cheese, sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped unsalted butter | 1 baguette, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 baguette, cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 -3 tablespoons coarse grain white rice
instructions: In a large saucepan with a tight fitting lid, heat the pinto beans and 3 cups water. Boil for 15 minutes. Drain, add fontina and stir fry over medium heat for three minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp water and heat to a simmer again. Preheat the broiler, line a baking sheet with foil. Arrange the baguette chunks on a baking sheet, slightly overlapped. Using a slotted spatula, drain the beans and pinto broth, then spread the fontina mixture evenly over the toast. Season with salt and pepper. Broil for 3 minutes, until the bread is golden brown.

title: Portuguese Pork
ingredients: 1/4 kg pork shoulder ( in a cube about 5/8 inch ) | 1/8 liter of sweet white pepper ( portuguese sweet pepper )
instructions: Wipe off each piece of pork and cut it in a cross shape. Sprinkle the pork with the white pepper. Keep the rest of the pepper and pepper for later use. Place this in an iron pot or a wok. Turn the flame to high and when the surface of the skin starts to crackle, put the pot on a burner or a gas flame that is designed to take the pork out of its skin. Leave it there until the white pepper stops crackling. Repeat this step with the pork every 6 - 8 hours. This takes about 6 weeks. Remove any skin on the pork and discard it. The meat should be shredded as fine as possible. Serve this on top of mashed potatoes or with rice, pasta and asparagus.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,fish,peanut oil,pico de gallo,oyster sauce
title: Khao Pla (Napa cabbage Salad)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 head savoy cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 cup finely chopped peanuts or 1/4 cup margarine | 1 tablespoon fish or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sate pico de gallo | 1 dash oyster sauce
instructions: Place shredded cabbage in a small bowl, or platter with a lid. In a small bowl, make a small patty. Add fish sauce, pico de gallo and oyster sauce. Using a toothpick, poke some holes in the cabbage with your finger. Pour dressing over cabbage and let salad sit for 8 to 18 hours for flavors to blend.

title: Popsicles
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | 3/4 cup pearl onions
instructions: Place kiwifruit in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until kiwifruit is easily peeled apart with a sharp knife. Drain. Fill with enough kiwifruit to cover, and place another kiwifruit piece on top. Set aside to macerate for at least 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,maraschino cherry,lamb cutlet,ancho chile powder,rice wine
title: Tacos à La Morue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb cutlets | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 4 maraschino cherries
instructions: Place lamb between 2 sheets of waxed paper, pound with a mallet until 1/8 inch thick. Rub lamb with chili powder and oregano, dredge in rice wine, place on a rack in a roasting pan and roast in a 400 degree f oven for 40 minutes or until desired doneness. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cherries.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,picante sauce,red chili pepper,thai basil
title: Mexican Style Spicy Basil Baked Bread  (B.c. Bread)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce, mild, medium or hot | 3 tablespoons fresh red chili peppers, minced | 3 tablespoons fresh thai basil, chopped
instructions: Warm your favorite recipe with red hot chilies and a good pinch of cayenne pepper in the microwave for added protein. Combine all ingredients. If making for a buffet style dinner, leave the extra tomato juice in the bowl if it becomes too strong. For serving as a meal, place a large piece of bread on a work surface, and spread with tomato/veggie mix. Top with desired toppings.

Random Ingredients: broth,curry paste,curry powder,havarti cheese,tabasco sauce,cilantro leaf
title: Curried Havarti Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups leftover brocolli thai stewed shrimp, shredded | 1/3 cup purchased curry paste | 3 cartons low-fat chicken broth, any low-sodium broth can be used | 2 tablespoons mild curry paste | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1 -2 teaspoon hot sauce | 3/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 3/4 teaspoon hot sauce, for a milder taste | 4 tablespoons chopped cilantro leaves
instructions: Place curry paste in a wide bowl. Add the stewed shrimp, broth and tabasco. Beat with a fork. Stir with a fork until all the broth has been incorporated. Place the cheese mixture in a food processor and pulse until smooth. If the mixture is too soft, mix in a little of the reserved broth or water. Transfer the smooth mixture to a mixing bowl and fold in the remaining ingredients. Serve immediately in bowl, with indian bread, crackers, or toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,tamari,stilton cheese,italian parsley,red chili pepper,sausage,vodka,pineapple tidbit
title: Sausage & Spicy Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 lb raw smithfield sausage ( we use johnsonville sausage ) | 1 cup pineapple tidbits ( drained ) | 1/2 cup grated fresh italian parsley | 1 red chili pepper ( halved seeded if you want it more fiery ) | 1/4 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 80 g tijol seasoning or 80 g similar vodka | 100 g stilton cheese ( crumbled )
instructions: Heat a large non stick pan over med high heat and add the sausage. Cook until browned all over and remove from pan and slice in halves lengthways. Set aside. In the same pan, add the pineapple, parsley, chile and sugar and whisk to combine and cook for approx 3 minutes stirring occasionally. Add the tamari and tijol seasoning stir in evenly and cook for a further 3 minutes. Add the sausage and pineapple to the salad and mix until heated through. Serve topped with crumbled cheese. A tossed salad, i suggest to serve this up straight from the pan with a bowl of steamed greens. The salad also goes great with a green tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: red chile,chicken broth,ancho chilies,liquid smoke,cider vinegar
title: Hot Red Chili Sauce
ingredients: 20 ancho chilies, stemmed and seeded ( fresh chilies in pods ) | 2 cups chicken broth | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 2 -4 cups thinly sliced red chiles, seeded and separated
instructions: Set aside 30 chilies for later use. Cut off the stems and discard the stems. Remove and discard the seeds from the ancho chiles. Wash the chiles in warm water until fresh. Dry them on a paper towel, and set aside. Bring broth and vinegar to a boil. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,black sesame seed,spaghetti,sea salt,honey,tarragon
title: Sweet & Sour Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 quart white wine vinegar ( see note ) | 1/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed | 1/2 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook spaghetti until al dente. Cook spaghetti in boiling water as directed on package. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, mix together the vinegar, honey, tarragon, sesame seeds and salt. Combine with the drained spaghetti and toss to coat pasta. Serve warm. Note, if you prefer a sweeter sauce, mix in additional honey or vinegar to balance it. Note 1, to speed up the cooking, add 1/4 to 1/2 cup water and mix rapidly. If you are adding dry to stir before serving, stir vigorously after adding the 1/4 cup water. Note 2, to speed up the cooking, add 1/4 cup water and stir quickly before adding the 1/4 cup water.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,anchovy paste,wheat bread,grain white rice,rice wine,rice wine vinegar
title: Rice & Anchovy Volgo's Pastry Rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry sheet, thawed | 3/4 cup uncooked coarse grain white rice, rinsed well | 1 cup leftover whole-grain white rice, rinsed well | 1/2 cup fermented anchovy paste, mashed with | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Roll out the pastry sheet on a floured surface and cut out 5 rounds. Using a teaspoon, lightly prick the top of each round with a fork. Divide the rice and anchovies in half and combine with the rice wine. Stir in the rice wine mixture. Place 1 tablespoon of the mixture onto each pastry round, and pinch and fold pastry over to make a half circle. Seal the edges. Transfer to a pastry bag with a large ziploc. Pierce the tops a few times with a sharp knife. Bake the volgo's rolls in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Pork Shoulder of Red Cabbage With Dals
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg red cabbage ( or other firm green cabbage ) | 750 g channa dal ( chana kaali dal ) | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs
instructions: Heat the oven to 200c. Cut off a large piece of cabbage and remove the tough outer leaves. Separate the tough leafy part at the top of the cabbage and slice downwards. You should now be left with a medium sized cabbage. Pour boiling water over the cabbage to leave 1cm space at the top of the cabbage. Place the sliced cabbage upright on a sheet of aluminium foil and place on the oven rack. Repeat the two steps with the remaining cabbage. Warm up the chana kaali or bahrat. Strain the water from the channa and allow to cool a little under running water. Take a handful of chana and slice diagonally into about 5cm lengths. Remove the fat and silverskin from the pork. Slice the pork into approximately 5cm lengths. Put the dals in a roasting tin. Pour boiling brine over it, turning to coat all sides.. Cover tightly and store in the fridge for 24 hours up to 2 weeks. When you can take out the pork from the fridge, remove all the excess fat and discard. Return the pork to the roasting tin, cover tightly and place in the preheated oven for 1 hour, then raise the temperature to 220c and continue cooking for 40mins. Serve with polenta, dals and a side salad.

title: Lamb Shank - Chops With Hazelnuts, Hazelnuts, and Honey
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 1 cup hazelnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Score the surface of each chop a few inches deep with a sharp knife. Place into a baking dish, and drizzle with a little olive oil. Wash hazelnuts in a sink of cool water. Place in a pan of hot water, and roast until the skins are light brown, about 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and immediately rub the hazelnuts through a kitchen towel. This makes the hazelnuts easier to peel. Wrap them in a clean towel, and allow them to steam while you roast the chops. Place the chops into the pan on top of hazelnuts, drizzle with some of the drippings, and sprinkle with enough honey or seson to taste. Bake in the preheated oven 8 to 10 minutes, until done.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,broccoli,sherry vinegar,greek oregano,jalapeno pepper
title: Broccoli Masala
ingredients: 1 lb fresh broccoli, washed and trimmed | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 3 tablespoons dry sherry vinegar | 2 teaspoons dried greek oregano
instructions: Cook broccoli in 4 cups boiling water just uncovered, about 2 minute remove broccoli from water.

title: Linguine With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 cup pearl barley ( uncooked ) | 1/4 cup orange zest | 3 tablespoons fresh garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. While pasta is cooking, place the remaining ingredients into a small crockpot and stir to combine. Drain pasta and add to crockpot. Blend pasta and dressing for at least 30 seconds before serving.

Random Ingredients: mung bean sprout,sesame oil,red chili pepper,white bread,pork chop,mung bean
title: Mung Beans (Chao Nao)
ingredients: 2 -3 slices firm white bread, cut diagonally into 1-inch cubes or 2 -3 slices soft white bread | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 cup mung bean sprouts ( you can use any green sprout ) | 2 -3 pieces pork chops, cut diagonally in thin slices | 16 -24 dried red chili peppers, halved or 16 -24 dried aji sazon goya ( for more heat substitute 1 t each ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked mung bean sprouts
instructions: Soak dried red chile peppers in water for 1 - 2 hours or overnight. Place soaked chilies in a heavy skillet over medium heat, and cook until darken, about 2 minutes on each side, to flavor chile peppers. Remove from heat, transfer to a bowl, and set aside to cool. Heat seasame oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add bread cubes, and fry until lightly browned, about 2 - 3 minutes. Turn over and stir constantly for additional 2 - 3 minutes, till golden brown. Remove, remove and set aside. Wipe skillet w/paper towel, and return skillet to low heat. Drain and rinse mungs well, then dry using tea towels. Add pork, mungs, red chili or aji sazon, and dried ground red chile or aji sazon. Stir and fry over low heat for about 3 minutes, till heated through. Serve immediately, accompanied by white rice or fried rice. Note, you can also serve mungs as a soup or for a change, replace the pork pieces with shrimp, or add any other meat substitute.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,pepperoncini pepper,mango,salt black pepper,amarula cream liqueur,salmon fillet,cardamom seed,vanilla wafer
title: Amarula & Mango Salmon With Creamy Cardamom Crusted Onions #2
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 2 yellow onions, halved and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon ground caramula cream liqueur | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 4 mint sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: In a shallow baking dish, place salmon fillets.

Random Ingredients: blackberry,curry powder,dark chocolate chip,brown sugar,red cabbage,pancetta
title: Curried Cabbage With Pancetta and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 3/4 lb red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 lb pancetta, chopped finely | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark chocolate chips | 3 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/4 cups blackberries, quartered | 2 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: In a medium sized skillet or heat resistant bowl, saute pancetta until crispy. Remove pancetta from skillet and set aside. Add cabbage and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes. Stir in chocolate chips, curry, blackberries and brown sugar, stirring until chocolate chips are melted and curry is fragrant. Serve warm from the skillet or over hot cooked egg noodles.

title: Vanilla Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup dry wine | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Remove the meat from the chicken and discard the skin and bones. Cut into pieces about 1 thick. Place it in a shallow dish and add 1/2 cup of cream and the wine, then the vanilla. Pour the sauce over the chicken, cover and marinate at least 3 hours, or overnight. Bake it in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 45 minutes, basting every 15 minutes. When ready to serve, reheat the remaining cream in a chilled or hot saucepan. When hot, stir in the whipping cream. This is the way to serve it.

title: Coconut Meatballs in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef sausage | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form mixture into 10 meatballs the size of a golf ball. Cook and enjoy note that you can substitute any other ingredients for the coconut meatballs, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,pork tenderloin,chocolate chip,cake flour,feta cheese,salmon,red pepper
title: Grilled Sirloin with Chocolate Chip Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon instant minced chocolate chip | 1 pound boneless beef sirloin | 1 pound salmon, cut into 4 pieces | 1 red pepper, julienned | 1/2 pound feta cheese, crumbled | 2 ounces semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Whisk cake flour, 1 tablespoon chocolate chips, and 1 pound of meat together until well mixed. Place salmon in a shallow dish. Turn salmon 2 or 3 times with fingers until coated in flour. Refrigerate marinated salmon while preparing other ingredients. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Grill salmon 3 to 5 minutes per side for rare. Remove from grill. Cover fish with a lid for about 3 minutes so fish can absorb moisture. Set aside to rest. Place pepper and feta cheese in food processor and process until smooth. Melt 1 ounce of chocolate chips in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave, stirring after every minute. Add melted chocolate to salmon, season with salt and pepper, and mix well. Place salmon on a plate and spread with remaining chocolate.

title: Bananas Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 medium bananas | 1 cup vinegar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Slice bananas lengthwise and crosswise.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,dill weed,lemon,romaine lettuce,white pepper,loaf bread,seasoning salt,chuck roast
title: Beef and Roasted Lemon Sandwich
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast, cut up | 6 black pepper, whole | 4 tablespoons dill weed, fresh | 2 teaspoons coarse black black pepper, powder | 4 -5 lbs loaf bread, white, cut in two lengthwise ( day old bread ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 16 medium romaine lettuce | 1 large lemon, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place roast in 3 to 4 quart dutch oven large enough to hold it in single layer. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons dill weed and 1/2 teaspoons coarse black pepper powder and mix well. Sprinkle roast with 3/4 teaspoon coarse black pepper powder and 1/4 teaspoon course black pepper powder. Place in single layer on a lightly greased roasting rack. Roast for about 1 1/2 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove from oven and set aside, covered, to rest. When cool enough to handle, remove roast from the oven and let cool slightly. Place the cut up lettuce in a large bowl. Arrange the sliced lemon on top of the lettuce leaves and toss together with the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano or dried oregano. Add the roast, 1 tsp finely grated lemon peel and 1/2 teaspoon white pepper to taste and mix well. Spoon over the remaining lettuce and mix well to combine. Cover and let stand in refrigerator 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: lite olive oil,red curry paste,red potato,peanut oil,basil leaf
title: Thai Shaky Red Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs russ red potatoes ( scrubbed and cut into 2 inch pieces ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons small red curry paste | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, tightly packed, chopped
instructions: Place potatoes in a steamer basket in a large saucepan of hot cold water. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Drain and cool slightly. Cut each potato in half lengthwise, then crosswise in half again. Scoop out and discard flesh and skin. Cut potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Heat peanut and curry oils in a 10 in skillet over low heat, stirring constantly, until curry has melted. Add potatoes to oil mixture. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Add basil and cook 1 minute more. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,yellow pepper,yellow mustard,apple juice,red chile,salt black pepper,squid
title: Calamari in Salsa With Pickled Calamari
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs assorted squid, cleaned of tentacles and bodies, slit in rings | 1/2 small yellow pepper, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1/2 small red chile, chopped | 1/4 cup apple juice, can use bottled | 1 tablespoon prepared yellow mustard, or more to taste | 2 1/2 cups thick and chunky salsa ( homemade or store-bought ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place cleaned squid bodies, yellow pepper, red chili, apple juice, mustard, salsa, and 1/4 teaspoon salt into a large soup pot and barely bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to moderate and simmer until squid is just cooked but still firm to bite, 2 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and let squid cool for 5 minutes, then carefully remove tentacles and bodies.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,soya sauce,egg white,green cardamom,lime juice,puff pastry,golden syrup,mirin
title: Cauliflower Turnovers
ingredients: 1/2 cauliflower, broken into flowerets and washed until almost cooked | 1/8 teaspoon finely chopped green cardamoms | 3 teaspoons soya sauce | 4 tablespoons mirin | 1 egg white | 1 -2 tablespoon light golden syrup | 1 tablespoon lime juice | puff pastry sheet
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients for a marinade and pour over cauliflower to coat. Refrigerate for about 15 mins. Line the baking tray with aluminium foil and spoon the mixture into the pastry cases, leaving a space 1/2cm over the top. Bake at 190 for 15 mins. Turn over and bake for 15 mins more.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,cumin powder,chocolate baking square,honey,alfredo sauce,celery,chocolate
title: Cheesy Chocolate Baskets--Gluten Free
ingredients: 8 ounces chocolate baking squares, 2 or 3 squares separated | 6 stalks celery, chopped ( i used two ) | 1 jar honey | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning ( to taste ) | 1 pinch cumin powder, ground | 16 ounces alfredo sauce | 8 ounces squares semi-sweet chocolate ( hershey's brand is best if these are not sweet )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease or spray baking sheet. Combine glaze ingredients in a mixing bowl and set aside. Melt chocolate on oven rack. Stir and drizzle melted chocolate over cooled chocolate. Let set 10 minutes. Remove chocolate from oven and place in an airtight container in refrigerator until hard. Add to cookie crumb mixture and mix until well blended. Add alfredo and mix well. Drop cookie mixture by 1/5 cup sized balls onto prepared baking sheet. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet. Top each cookie with 2 tbsp chocolate shavings and place on baking sheet 3 - 4 inches apart. Let stand an additional 10 minutes or until glaze is set. Remove from baking sheets and place on serving platter. I used this as a dipping sauce for the cookie bites.

title: Serve with Mousse
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared sweet-and-sour mix ( kool-aid ) | icing sugar
instructions: Mix sweet and sour mix with sweetened whipped cream. Chill well for several hours. Top with icing sugar just before serving.

title: Veal With Sweet Prunes (Schweizerse Med Zwiebelkuchen)
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut into 2 inch cubes | 2 -3 cups prunes, pitted and cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Put meat in roasting pan, sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,swiss chard,palm sugar,artichoke heart,saffron,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Artichoke Swiss Chard With Melting Cheese
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, chopped ( i use about 7 cups packed ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, cut in half | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Cook swiss chard in 1 tablespoon boiling water over medium heat 3 - 5 minutes, or until tender crisp. Drain and transfer to an ovenproof bowl and sprinkle with saffron. Melt remaining 1/2 cup of palm sugar in small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until light golden brown. Bring artichoke hearts and next 3 ingredients to a boil, stirring constantly. Pour over chard mixture. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 350f oven for 20 minutes, or until hot and beginning to brown slightly.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,extra virgin olive oil,salad oil,mint leaf,lamb
title: Lamb Fritters With Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh lamb, trimmed and cut into 3/4-inch wide strips | 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil, divided | 4 teaspoons salad oil, divided | 4 teaspoons thick and chunky salsa | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, torn, divided
instructions: Place lamb in a small ovenproof bowl. Using 2 teaspoons oil for each pound of meat, toss the lamb with 2 teaspoons salad oil and half of the salsa. Bake at 475°f for 8 minutes. Cook maccarronio cheese over medium heat for 1 minute or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,spaghetti sauce,chive,black olive,oat,green bell pepper,spelt flour
title: Spelt-Arib Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spicy ground beef chuck, browned | 3 -4 cups spaghetti sauce ( or spaghetti sauce of your choice ) | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 2 teaspoons spelt flour | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1/2 cup rolled oats
instructions: Prepare browned and drained ground chuck, while mixing the rest of the ingredients listed under'spaghetti sauce' in a large bowl, combine the ground chuck and the next 5 ingredients, blending well. Pour the meat and egg mixture into a greased 13 x 9 baking pan. Bake at 350 f until browned, about 25 - 30 minutes. Remove meat mixture from oven let stand 10 minutes and slice, removing any excess fat if desired.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,monterey jack cheese,sweetcorn,liquid smoke,mint leaf,water,romaine lettuce leaf,rye bread
title: Corn on the Cob with Swiss Honey and Jack Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh sweetcorn, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 4 medium roma lettuce leaves, halved | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 12 slices rye bread, toasted ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1/3 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss together the corn, lettuce, honey, liquid smoke and water. In a large, deep skillet, cover the corn with a layer of sliced rye bread. Evenly arrange the lettuce salad around the bread slices, placing each lettuce leaf heart near the cheese. Top with the cheese, then spoon the corn mixture on top of the cheese and bread. Serves.

title: Peanut Butter Snack
ingredients: 1 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup chopped pumpkin seeds | chopped scotch bonnet peppers ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional )
instructions: Place ingredients in a food processor and process. Process until well mixed. Spoon into a cookie sheet sprayed with olive oil flavored cooking spray. Bake at 375 degrees f for 10 - 12 minutes. To serve transfer to a dish, sprinkle with more chopped scallions and marjoram.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,calrose rice,grain rice,hard egg,potato flour,beer,egg yolk
title: Guinness and Egg Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 2 ounces potato flour | 8 ounces hard-boiled eggs | 6 fluid ounces chilled light beer | 2 fluid ounces hard boiled egg yolks | 1 hard boiled egg yolk | 4 green cardamoms
instructions: In a medium sized saucepan, combine rice and potato flour. Add eggs and gently mix. Add beer and allow to simmer, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, heat egg yolk in a small non stick pan. Remove egg yolk from heat using the side of a knife, brush back and forth around the edge with the egg yolk. Turn over and cook egg yolk for only about 1 minute. Remove and stir into the rice. Remove the cardamom pods and stir well. Add more salt. Place back onto stove and bring to a boil over a high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and leave for about 10 minutes. Leave on the stove for 5 minutes. Place a serving dish on top and turn over. Spread some thickened cream over the top. Spread some of the halwa over it and scatter some hard boiled egg on top. Eat or refrigerate. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup xanthan gum | 3 chinese cabbage
instructions: Finely shred or shredded cabbage. Combine all ingredients and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour before using. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,tart apple,flat,green cabbage,liquid smoke
title: Apple and Tart Cabbage
ingredients: 4 medium tart apples, unpeeled and thinly sliced | 1 medium green cabbage, shredded | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 cup flat leaf lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Place the apples in a medium ovenware baking dish. Sprinkle them with half of the cabbage and the crumbled beef bouillon cube. Drizzle with remaining cabbage and the liquid smoke, if using. Top with the remaining cabbage, and cover with foil. Cook very slowly in a 400 degree f oven for about 30 - 40 minutes or until all the moisture has dried out and the cabbage has begun to soften. This should take only a matter of 30 minutes per pound of cabbage. Remove the foil, bake uncovered for about 10 minutes or until the cabbage is tender and the crusty crust has crisped up.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cumin,spinach,basil,monterey jack pepper cheese,caraway seed,cherry
title: Savory Cherry Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced cooked cherries, drained well | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil or 1 tablespoon dried basil, can use 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh caraway seed | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 8 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 bag fresh spinach, coarsely chopped
instructions: Spray a 2 quart baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a bowl, combine all ingredients except spinach. Add fresh spinach and stir to combine. Transfer to the baking dish and sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Bake at 375 degrees uncovered for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,champagne,white sugar,red chile,confectioner sugar,saffron,burgundy wine,cornflour
title: Chilli & Wine Saffron Balls
ingredients: 200 ml white wine | 100 ml burgundy wine | 1/8 teaspoon chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 4 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 -3 chiles, chopped finely | 2 -3 tablespoons champagne
instructions: Place the wine, chile paste and saffron in a saucepan. Bring to the boil, while whisking. Set aside. Mix the cornflour with half of the confectioners' sugar and chilli. Using a teaspoon, mould the mixture into 2 balls. Make a slit down the centre. Dip balls into the chilli wine mixture, then coat them with the rest of the confectioners' sugar. Arrange them in a warm serving dish. Spoon the remaining chilli & wine mixture over them, then garnish with the remaining confectioners' sugar. Serve with plenty of chilies on the side.

Random Ingredients: currant,tomato paste,savoy cabbage,extra tofu,beef tenderloin,chili oil
title: Chinese Lion's Head (Slightly Asian Tofu)
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu | 1/3 cup chili oil ( to taste ) | 1/2 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed and julienned | 1/3 cup tomato paste ( ktchup ) | 1/3 cup currants | 1 savoy cabbage, shredded & rinsed, for garnish
instructions: Cut tofu into 1/2 inch slices. Heat oil in skillet, brown tofu, and remove from pan. Brown other side of beef. Add tomato paste, stir to mix and melt. Add currants, cabbage & tofu. Cover and simmer 10 - 15 minutes or until beef is cooked through. Garnish with additional sour cream, mint sprigs or parsley. Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Walnut Curry
ingredients: 1 cup walnut oil | 2 cans minced clams with juice | 6 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 4 tablespoons hot curry sauce | ice
instructions: Heat peanut oil in a saucepan over low heat until peanut oil is shimmering. Place minced clams in a large bowl. Pour in worcestershire sauce, hot curry sauce and ice. Mix well but gently so as not to break up clams. If you prefer to serve this way, you can stir to heat the sauce first and then gently mix together. Garnish with a little bit of parsley. If cooking this way, it is done the following way. For a little more spice, add an onion and a little cayenne pepper.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,ice cube,yellow hominy,cream chicken soup,italian bread crumb,red potato
title: Pigs in Tomato Tomato Pie
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 yellow hominy, or more to taste | 2 red potatoes, cubed | 1 teaspoon mustard powder, or more to taste | 1 cup unseasoned italian-style dry bread crumbs | 1 gallon ice cubes, or as needed | 1 cup pickled mustard powder, for garnish, or as desired
instructions: In a large bowl, mix soup, hominy, potato, and mustard powder. Dip crocks into bread crumbs just to coat bottom of each crock. Spoon soup mixture into each crock. Cover with water to 2 inches from top of each crock. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,allspice,thai fish sauce,nutmeg,red food coloring,grainy mustard,swiss cheese,cumin seed
title: Spicy Fish Quesadilla
ingredients: 4 thick slices firm-flavored whole grainy mustard such as quesadilla, such as hillshire farm | 1/2 cup finely shredded swiss cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 10 -12 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce ( optional ) | 12 tortillas
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the mustard, swiss cheese, cumin, allspice, and nutmeg. Dip 1 tortilla at a time over the hot nonstick skillet of your choice, turning until both sides are golden brown, 1 to 2 seconds per side. Carefully transfer to a paper towels lined plate and repeat with the remaining tortilla slices. Spread the mustard mixture on the tortillas and top with the red cheese mixture. Serve immedigately or refrigerate up to 2 hours for flavor to develop. Serve with steamed greens and red wine, if desired.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,red capsicum,corn oil,asparagus spear,oil,soya sauce,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Asparagus Chips With Capsicum
ingredients: 4 asparagus spears | 2 red capsicums | oil | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons light soya sauce | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 teaspoons dark rum
instructions: Cut asparagus spears into 4 diagonal slices. Cut capsicums into 8 slices lengthways and remove seed and white pith. Cut inti 2 triangles to make chip shapes. Soak asparagus chips in hot water for 20 minutes. Heat 1 teaspoon of the corn oil in a non stick frying pan. Fry asparagus until golden, then toss them with capsicum strips. Drain the fried asparagus on paper towel lined oven trays. Meanwhile, heat the other teaspoon of corn oil in a small pan, add the light soya sauce, parmesan and rum. Stir until well mixed but not boiling. Serve warm or leave cold.

Random Ingredients: sage,fajita seasoning,american cheese,cinnamon,pork rib,hot chili sauce
title: Crock Pot Pork (Or Beef) Chops, Carnitas and Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless country-style pork ribs, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 packet dry fajita seasoning ( or seasoning of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce ( to taste ) | 1 lb medium american cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Place pork in crock pot. Combine the fajita seasoning, cinnamon, sage and chili sauce and pour over pork. Cover and cook on low 8 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours. Serve pork chunks on flour tortillas with cheese slices on top. For best results, refrigerate overnight. Note, in lieu of serving pork and cheese, you can prepare a simple beef or chicken stir fry, using only 2 cans of stewed tomatoes with jalapenos, garlic powder and a touch of cayenne pepper.

title: Spiced Egg Yolk Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw chicken broth | 2 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Put chicken broth in a medium saucepan on the stove. Bring to a boil then turn down the heat to low. In a small bowl mix egg yolks and fenugreek together well then stir into the hot broth. Turn heat back up to medium then stir in harissa. Simmer to thicken. Ladle hot soup into bowls, and serve.

title: Roasted Shallot Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shallots, minced | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme | 2 tablespoons extra virgin reg ; oil
instructions: In a small bowl, mix shallots, thyme and 2 tablespoons of the oil. Season to taste with salt.

title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 8 -12 chicken thighs, cut in halves lengthwise | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 32 ounces crushed pineapple chunks, drained
instructions: Prepare sauce. Sprinkle chicken, dip in confectioners' sugar, lay pineapple chunks on top, coating completely. Chill in refrigerator overnight, basting frequently with the pineapple juice. Place chicken in a dutch oven or large, deep skillet, and cover with sauce. Bake in 350°, oven for 1 hour.

title: Gramma Sayfield's Sauerkraut and Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cans or bottles beer | 3 cans chicken broth | 1 package jumbo shrimp - peeled, deveined and tails removed | 1 can sauerkraut, undrained | 1 jar oysters, drained
instructions: In a deep pot over medium heat, heat the oil. Cook and stir the stew beef cubes in the hot oil briefly until browned, about 5 minutes. Pour in beer, scraping up any browned bits with a wooden spoon. Pour in chicken broth, bring to a boil, and cover the pot. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 hour. Toss in shrimp and sauerkraut, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until shrimp are opaque and meat is no longer translucent in the center. Stir in chopped oysters.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,ziti pasta,beef stew meat
title: Beef Picnic Beef Tips(Paleo)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless beef stew meat | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, zest of | 1 lb uncooked ziti pasta or 1 lb penne
instructions: Cut beef into 1 1/2 inch cubes, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Remove strings with a large fork. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, cook beef until browned and tender, about 3 minutes on all sides, stirring occasionally. Remove beef and drain on paper towels. Add lemon juice to skillet and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. Pour into the skillet with the beef. Toss ziti with beef mixture, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring every few minutes, until pasta is tender but firm, about 30 minutes.

title: Tomato-Basil Sauce
ingredients: 4 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil leaves, or to taste | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon, or to taste
instructions: Combine the roma tomatoes and basil, and stir in the tarragon. Chill to serve.

title: Wild Blueberry & Romaine Slaw
ingredients: 2 packages coleslaw mix | 2 roma tomatoes, diced | 1/3 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/3 cup packed brown sugar
instructions: In a large bowl or slotted spoon, combine coleslaw mix, tomatoes, and apple juice. Stir in marjoram, and brown sugar.

title: Mexican Party Appetizers
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans ( drain liquid ) | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese or 1 cup queso panela cheese | 1/4 cup salad greens | 1 -2 tablespoon minced serrano chilies
instructions: Mix everything. Spoon into 2 tb size muffin tin. Bake at 450°f for 10 minutes or until well heated. If you are serving party guests, warm in saucepan on low heat.

title: Mushrooms With Harissa
ingredients: 12 ounces button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons harissa | 1/4 cup strawberry jam | 2 tablespoons fresh thai basil
instructions: Rinse mushrooms with warm water. Pat dry with a paper towel. Slice mushrooms. Combine harissa with about 1/2 cup of the jam and stir into mushrooms. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Remove mushrooms from marinade. Grill over hot coals for about 5 - 7 minutes, turning and spraying with remaining marinade until mushrooms are tender and glazed. Top with chives and fresh basil.

title: Struffoli (Mango Stuffed Pastries)
ingredients: 4 cups icing sugar, sifted | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup finely grated dried mango | 2 teaspoons finely grated seeded serrano peppers | 1/3 cup brewed coffee liqueur | 6 -12 cups miniature marshmallow flutes ( see note ) | crushed pistachios ( to garnish, optional )
instructions: Cream together the sugar, honey, mango, chilies and coffee liqueur. Add the mint and blend well. Remove a cup of the icing mixture and pulse the remaining icing mixture together with the marshmallows. Divide this mixture among serving bowls. Garnish with chopped pistachios if desired.

Random Ingredients: banana,flounder fillet,savoy cabbage,clam juice,chili paste,russet potato,pasta,red chilies
title: Fish & Chips With Vietnamese Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, large, quartered, lengthwise, cut crosswise into 6 slices | 4 bananas, medium, large | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, peeled & sliced | 2 dried red chilies | 15 ounces canned clams in juice, in shell, in the juice, drained | 1 1/4 cups bottled clam juice | pasta, cooked al dente, tossed with reserved skillet juices | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste ( thai )
instructions: Place potato slices on baking sheet, bake in 400f oven 20 to 30 minutes or until tender and lightly browned. While potatoes are baking, place sliced bananas on baking sheet & toast in 450f oven about 5 minutes, rotate bananas, roast another 5 minutes. Let cool slightly, peel bananas, slice into 2 pieces. Place sliced bananas in bowl with sliced potatoes. In blender or food processor combine hot peppers, ginger & chilis & puree. Place clam juice/ clam liquid in bowl with shrimp & garlic. Pour shrimp mixture over potato mixture, toss well & serve.

Random Ingredients: loose italian sausage,poblano chile,red chili pepper flake,currant
title: Pilaf Sausages With Chile and Currants
ingredients: 8 poblano chiles ( seeded if desired ) | 1/2 lb loose italian sausage ( casings removed ) | 1/4 cup dried currant | 2 tablespoons dried red chili pepper flakes ( or more to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,peanut butter,chicken breast,confectioner sugar,colby monterey jack cheese,cream chicken soup,potato,tang orange crystal
title: Chicken Nachos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into 1/2 inch dice | 2 potatoes, cut into wedges | 6 tablespoons cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 teaspoon grated lime-colored orange peel | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat the oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and chicken cubes.

title: Cabbage With Apple Sesame Seeds (Kari E Hui)
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage | 1 cup apple juice | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/4 cup guacamole, to serve on the side
instructions: Cut the cabbage into quarters and set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cabbage and bay leaf and boil for 5 minutes. Drain, transfer to a mixing bowl and add the apple juice, sesame seeds and pinch of salt. Mix well and set aside to cool before using a fork to shred the cabbage finely. Add more apple juice if desired. Serve as is or with the guacamole on the side.

title: Luxury of Haiti (Luxury of Haiti)
ingredients: 12 pork loin chops ( approx. 8-10 chops per person ) | veal, for cooking | sliced chili pepper flakes or fresh chili pepper
instructions: Trim the visible fat and gristle from pork chops and discard just lightly coloured bits of fat from the surface. Rinse the chops under cold running water to make sure that any visible bone or bits remain on them. In a large kettle put enough cold water to cover the pork chops, cover and bring to the boil. Add the chops to the pan and boil gently for about 10 minutes, then remove the chops from the kettle. You do not want them to loose any of the sticky residue from the pork as you are cooking them over simmering water. Remove the pork chops from the kettle and, if necessary, set them in the boiling water with a couple of handfuls of salt. Bring the liquid to the boil, cover and reduce temperature to low. Let simmer, skimming the top surface as it goes, for 1 hour. Remove any residue of gristle which is on the surface of the cooking liquid and discard. When the liquid has returned to a boil remove the pan from the heat. Remove and discard from boil. Remove the pork loin chops from the kettle, remove the bone or chop, cut the meat into large chunks and return it to the kettle. Turn the meat over and boil until the meat is dry and tender. Stir occasionally to prevent the meat from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Stir in a tablespoon of chili flakes or chilli flakes or chili flakes and serve warm or at room temperature with rice, pasta or soup.

title: Sbd Pernil
ingredients: 4 ounces penne | 2 1/2 ounces veal, diced | 8 ounces minced lean pork or 8 ounces cooked ham | 1 cup chicken broth | 3 ounces pimientos, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until al dente. Drain. Cut in half lengthwise. Add veal or meat to pan. Heat broth over high heat to scald it. Add pimiento and salt.

title: Mango Walnut Salad
ingredients: 2 ripe mangoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 ripe tomatoes, cut into chunks | dressing : | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup tomato puree
instructions: Toss together the mango chunks, tomato purée, and walnuts in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,red wine,kernel corn,mint leaf,okra,white hominy,bread,mace
title: Oklahoma Indian Pies
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra, thawed and drained well | 3/4 cup chopped frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 1/2 cups cooked white hominy, drained | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 pounds beef tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 slices country bread, toasted | fresh mint leaves, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare a large baking sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine okra, corn, hominy, wine, and mace. Stir in beef. Transfer beef mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, to a large, round glass baking dish or casserole dish. Bake meat mixture in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Toast bread lightly. Spoon sauce over beef in baking dish. Top with toasted bread slices.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,spaghetti,egg yolk,plain flour,part ricotta cheese,pistachio nut
title: Easy Cheesy Spaghetti Squares
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 1 large spanish onion | 1/4 cup pistachio nut, toasted | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup fresh plain flour | 1 large egg yolk
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water for 3 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: sugar,cream cheese,green lentil,grain white rice,pearl barley,broccoli floret,dark chocolate,bacon
title: Choco-Lentil and Rice With Bacon
ingredients: 300 g pearl barley | 150 g green lentils | 100 g broccoli florets | 150 g reduced-fat cream cheese, cut into thin sticks | 1 tablespoon dried bacon, chopped | 150 g dark chocolate, chopped | 1/3 cup sugar | 100 g coarsely chopped dark chocolate, to serve
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to the boil and cook the rice until just tender. Drain and rinse the pearl barley in a sieve and leave to drain to cool slightly. Meanwhile, bring a large saucepan of water to the boil and cook the lentils in the following manner, bring to the boil for 2 minutes and drain. Cook the broccoli in the same manner if necessary to tenderise. Meanwhile, combine the lentils, bacon, frozen broccoli and cream cheese in a bowl and mix gently until the cream cheese is well combined. Stir in the cooled rice, bacon and chocolate then pour the mixture into a well in the center of the pan and stir until well combined. Serve immediately. You can garnish with a sprinkle of dark chocolate.

title: Brazilian Peanut Cod
ingredients: 1 pound cod | 2 cups unsalted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Line foil with foil. Place cod fish on foil, and cover with peanuts. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yeast,shiitake mushroom,white bread,graham cracker crumb,cellophane noodle,ginger garlic paste
title: Gramma's Teriyaki (Mushroom Stuffed) Loaf
ingredients: 3/4 tablespoon dry yeast | 2 cups warm water, about 100 degrees f | 12 ounces mushrooms ( sliced thin ) | 1 cup cellophane noodles ( sliced thin ) | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1 lb fresh shiitake mushrooms ( cleaned and stems removed, caps sliced thin ) | 1 crusty white bread ( sliced into about 40 to 45 slices )
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast over water and let stand 5 minutes. Add 1 cup of the warm water and mix with a fork. Add mushrooms and mix well to coat. Cover and leave to rise about 1 hour or until doubled in bulk. In a large skillet set on medium high heat, cook the ginger garlic paste in the remaining 2 cups of warm water until it gives off a nice aroma, about 1 - 2 minutes. Add the shiitaki mushrooms and cook 5 minutes longer. Transfer shiitaki mushrooms and all of the accumulated juices to a food processor and add to the yeast and ginger water in the skillet. Using a dough hook or fork, mix until dough forms. Stir in the remaining 1 1/4 cups warm water, 2 tablespoons at a time, folding it into the dough. Shape the dough into a loaf. Line a loaf pan with parchment paper that has been sprayed with non stick cooking spray. Punch down the dough and separate into 4 pieces. Using the long side of your hand, flatten each piece out to a rectangular shape about a 12 inch oval about 3/4 inch thick. Brush the top with oil and place 5 slices in the centre followed by a few slices of the crusty white bread, making sure the bread and crust is placed all the way up the sides of the loaf. Cover the loaf with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled in bulk. Bake at 350f for 45 - 50 minutes until crust is golden and loaf sounds hollow when you tap the bottom. Remove parchment and cool on wire rack.

title: Cheater's Taco Shells
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 4 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Beat together mayonnaise and taco seasoning mix. Beat egg yolks and salad oil. Fold into mayonnaise mixture, and spread onto shells. Refrigerate overnight, or at least 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,plain yogurt,elbow macaroni,chicken breast,orange zest,onion,navy bean,serrano pepper
title: Pasta with Yogurt and Chicken
ingredients: 15 ounces plain low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon onion, minced | 1 teaspoon fresh serrano pepper or 1 teaspoon chile powder | 2 cups elbow macaroni | 1/3 cup sour cream or 1/3 cup greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 chicken breast, cooked and sliced | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yogurt, orange zest, onion, chile powder, pasta, sour cream, orange zest, and chicken. Serve with beans and croutons.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,garlic,chickpea,self rising flour,shiitake mushroom,red enchilada sauce
title: Chickpea and Mushroom Enchilidas
ingredients: 8 ounces self-rising flour | 8 ounces chopped shiitake mushrooms | 8 ounces chopped roasted red enchilada sauce | 8 ounces chopped chocolate | garlic | chickpeas
instructions: Preheat oven to make the first 3 ingredients and mix well until you have a smooth dough. Roll the dough into small balls and place them on a baking sheet. Cover with foil and put in the oven to preheat. Bake for 15 minutes until the dough starts to get a nice golden colour. Put the filling ingredients in a pan and mix them over a medium heat until they have melted. Dip one of the filled balls in the chocolate and drop it into the filling. Put it into the preheated oven and bake for another 15 minutes. Eat the rest of the fillings and re dip the filled balls in the chocolate and put them into the bottom of another dish.

title: Coconut Soup With Chicken and Lemons
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock ( the beef stock can be purchased at any asian market ) | 1 tablespoon palm sugar ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Bring stock to a boil and add palm sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve warm as wished.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,dog bun,celery,onion soup mix,wine vinegar,head radicchio,rosemary
title: Lahanorizo (Greek Pork and Carrots
ingredients: 2 pork loin roast | 8 baby carrots | 1 large head radicchio, cleaned ( washed thoroughly ) | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 12 hot dog buns, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Remove most of the fat from the pork loin and place the fat in a foil roasting pan. Tear off two large sheets of heavy duty aluminum foil. Place one of the foil pieces on a baking sheet. Slice the pork into 1/4 x 1 slices. Place the pork on top of the foil and fold the other piece of foil over the pork. Place in the preheated oven. Bake for 2 hours, until the pork is browned. The center of the pork should be browned, and the slices will be crispy. Meanwhile, place all of the vegetables in boiling water and place under a hot broiler. When the pork is done, remove it and place on a plate, and place the vegetables on the plates. Slice the pork across the grain into 1/4 x 1/4 slices. Place the pork slices into a pot, and add just enough water to cover the ingredients. Simmer slowly, stirring occasionally for about 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the onion soup mix and wine vinegar. Add to the vegetables, and cook, stirring, for about 5 minutes. When the pork is done, remove from the pan and place in a bowl.

title: Crispy Bread and Butter Balls
ingredients: 4 slices bread, thick slices | 1/4 cup golden raisins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the slices of bread on a baking sheet. Sprinkle the raisins on top, then cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, until the crumbs are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,coconut,peach,tart apple,beef bouillon granule,egg substitute,jalapeno pepper,red potato
title: Tasty Low Calorie Low Fat Stuffed Cabbage
ingredients: 2 red potatoes, peeled | 1/3 cup reduced-fat egg substitute | 1 tablespoon shredded fat free jalapeno pepper | 1/3 cup shredded coconut, can use low fat variety | 1 small head of cabbage | 1/3 cup low-fat beef bouillon granules | 8 small fresh peaches, peeled and halved ( optional ) | 1 small tart apple, cored and finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut the potatoes into quarters, leaving a stem on the inside of the cabbages. Boil the potato in water with the coconut, a tablespoon or two of lemon juice until tender. Drain well and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the base off the head of cabbage, leaving a good stem to hold the cabbage together. The leaves will hold together in the center of the cabbage. The left stem can then be removed and discarded. Slice the top and bottom off the cabbage, leaving a good amount of leaves on the top and bottom. Try to get all the leaves to touch. Use a large spoon to scoop out as many of the core as possible. Use a spoon to scoop out the inner core of the cabbage leaves. Place a small scoop of the potatoes in the potato water and bring to a boil. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,cayenne pepper,black olive,red pepper flake,jalapeno chile pepper,flat leaf parsley,msg
title: Cajun Black Olives
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds anchovy fillet, rinsed and well drained | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon finely chopped seeded jalapeno chile pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 cup chopped pitted black olives | 1/4 cup hot smoked cajun black pepper powder or other red pepper paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons msg ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place the drained anchovy fillet and crushed red pepper flakes in a bowl. Mix in the jalapeno pepper, 1/4 cup parsley, olives, hot pepper powder, 2 teaspoons black pepper powder, 1 1/2 teaspoons, and 1 1/2 teaspoons msg. Divide the mixture into smaller balls and roll in remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons black pepper powder. Set each piece onto a foil lined baking sheet and spread on the anchovy paste. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons parsley. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes.

title: Pear Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice powder | 1/2 cup refried beans | 1 teaspoon crushed dried pear ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. The pear is added to the dip when you add it to the batter.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,poblano chile,wheat flour,caper,liquid honey,beef rib,kernel corn
title: Beef Carnitas With Corn and Green Chilies
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs, trimmed | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 2 tablespoons capers | 6 large poblano chiles | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained well | 24 -32 slices of your favorite thick grain and chunky deli-style coriander ( coriander leaves )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f mix the flour and honey together in a large bowl. Roll the short ribs in flour mixture. Set aside. Cut the poblano chiles into very fine slices, remove stems and seeds, scrape seeds and veins from the chiles. Set aside about 2 tablespoons of the oil. Reserve the other 2 tablespoons. Put olive oil in a saute pan over medium high heat. Cook the short ribs in batches until crisp, about 3 minutes per side. Remove short ribs to paper towels. Put aside. Add oil to saute pan and add chilies, saute 3 to 4 minutes or until softened. Remove chilies from pan and cut in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and veins. Set aside. Rinse corn well and drain. Cut cob in half. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange corn on the bottom, followed by short ribs on top of the corn. Arrange corn, chiles, and meat on top of the ribs. Brush with any pan drippings. Sprinkle with capers and coriander leaves. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes, or until meat is tender and sauce is bubbling. Remove foil and cook 10 to 15 minutes more, basting often.

title: Xochipilli's Chicken & Vegetable Jook
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast fillets, skinless, sliced into strips | 6 guajillo chilies, finely sliced | 4 snow peas, trimmed, cut into 2 cm lengths | 150 g quinoa, cooked | 2 tablespoons chicken fat, chopped
instructions: Cook the chicken in a wok over high heat for 3 - 4 minutes until cooked through. Remove the chicken and set aside. Add the chilies to the wok, cook for 1 - 2 minutes or until aromatic. Add the snow peas and quinoa and cook for 1 minute. Add the chicken, season and stir through. Divide the mixture between 2 warmed serving plates, spoon over the chicken fat and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon saffron threads
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the saffron threads in a small bag. Place the bag in the oven, and immediately close the door. Allow the turkish spices to infuse the peppers with heat and to infuse all of the flavors for about 30 minutes. Roast in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes, until the peppers are roasted deeply. Stir the pan occasionally during this process. After 45 minutes, remove the foil and discard peppers, and stir in the saffron. Keep in mind, as the oven roasted the vegetables get dryter, they dry out during the final half hour of cooking.
