When cool enough to handle, remove the peppers to a plate, and store in airtight containers.

title: Salsa Baked Rice Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 2 cups chunky salsa | 10 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix rice and salsa together in a medium bowl. Spoon about 1 1/2 tablespoons of rice mixture into each warmed tortilla.

title: Cumin & Choc Mousse by Neil Perry
ingredients: 300 g dark chocolate | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the choc and vanilla essence in a pan in the microwave and cook on high power until melted. When the chocolate is melted pour into a bowl and pour over the melted chocolate. Cover completely with plastic wrap and leave until set. Cut into squares to serve and serve with a cinnamon roll or fresh fruit.

title: Easy Zucchini
ingredients: 2 zucchini, cut into 3 pieces | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place zucchini in a medium baking dish. Mix lemon juice and cayenne together in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,tamarind pulp,bean sprout,cooking oat,cocoa powder,vodka,water,monterey jack cheese
title: Creamy Chocolate-Pepper Jack  Bean Sprouts-Cheese Filling
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped bean sprouts | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon water, plus | 1/4 cup water | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup salted anchovy packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook sprouts in 1/4 cup water according to package directions or until crisp tender. Remove and let cool. Cook oat meal in a 2 quart saucepan over medium high heat, stirring constantly for 2 minutes or until warm and bubbly. Remove from heat and set aside. In a small saucepan, bring remaining water, oats, vodka and 1/2 cup cheese to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Add anchovy and 1 tbsp cheese. Drain sprouts and remove from heat. Add oil, salt and pepper. Stir to coat thoroughly before filling.

title: Garlicky Corn and Lettuce Tacos
ingredients: 9 corn tortillas | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, drained well | 4 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Spread one side of each corn tortilla with corn. Place a handful. Place a couple handfuls or two of shredded lettuce on corn, if desired.

title: Minted Chicken and Rice Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 chicken breasts, thinly sliced | 1 loaf raisin bread, cubed | 1 box brown rice | 8 cups chicken stock or 8 cups broth | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup packed fresh mint
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat. Place chicken in the saucepan and fry until browned on both sides, remove to a plate. Add to the saucepan and fry bread cubes in the margarine until lightly toasted and just beginning to crisp, set aside. Add rice, stock and water to pan. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Add chicken and mint to soup and heat through or serve in individual bowls.

title: Harissa Paste for Tunisian Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 tablespoon harissa | 2 teaspoons chili | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients over an open flat bowl until the sugar is dissolved. Store in a cool spot, not close to the sun, before serving.

title: Fettuccine Gourmet Style in a Hurry
ingredients: 12 fresh fettuccine, cooked al dente ( bow tie with character ) | 1/2 cup applesauce ( see directions below ) | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1 pinch of celtic sea salt or 1 pinch kosher salt ( or none per taste ) | 1 tablespoon coarsely ground ancho chile powder ( see description, below per note ) or 1 tablespoon chili powder ( see directions below per note ) | 1 small cauliflower, chopped into small pieces ( see note below ) | chopped scallions or sesame seeds, for garnish ( see note below )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the cauliflower and sesame seeds in the bowl of a food processor and process to a paste consistency of about 10 minutes. Transfer to a baking sheet. Toss with cauliflower and lightly toss. Garnish with extra fresh chopped scallions or sesame seeds if desired. Note, can be made ahead of time and frozen for later use.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,greek yogurt,onion soup mix,beef brisket,brown sugar,veal
title: Beef Brisket & Onions
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef brisket ( cut into serving size pieces ) | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 cup greek yogurt ( lowfat is ok ) | 1/4 cup brown sugar ( brown sugar and spice ) | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: Wash and pat dry the brisket and place on the rack of a broiler pan. Cover with foil and broil, turning often, until meat is nicely browned. Bake at 325 degrees for approximately 1 1/2 hours. Shred the meat and serve from a bun in a bowl. If your meat is still cold, you can cool it in your microwave. When cool, it will be easier to slice. In a small bowl, combine the onion soup mix, sesame oil and brown sugar. Stir to blend well. This sauce can be refrigerated if your refrigerator turns sour. Remove the meat from the refrigerator and add the greek seasoning mixture. Mix well. Serve on serving platter or serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: dark rye bread,tomatillo,tangerine,red wine vinegar,golden syrup,cinnamon
title: Tangerine Tomatillo Fries
ingredients: 2 lbs very ripe tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups tangerines | 1 1/2 cups red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 3/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 6 slices dark rye bread
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut 1 pound tomatoes into 1/4 inch thick slices, and then into quarters. Scrape tomatoes into a bowl filled with ice. Cut tangerines into quarters. Cut tomatoes in half through core, then into thin wedges. Cut slices in half crosswise. Place tomatoes, tangerines, vinegar, golden syrup, cinnamon, and 1/2 teaspoon salt into a pan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and continue simmering until the syrup reaches the desired consistency, about 20 minutes. Arrange the bread slices on a baking pan lined with parchment paper. Top with tomato mixture, then drizzle with the syrup. Place under middle oven broiler until the bread has softened.

title: Champignons a La Chèvre
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots | 1 large bunch chives | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Peel and trim carrots. Place carrots in saucepan and cover with water. Bring to boil and cook until tender. Drain, mash carrots and reserve. Add chives, mix well. Gradually add cream and cook until mixture thickens. Remove from heat and cool to about room temperature. Place in freezer safe pie dish. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze overnight. Serve at once.

title: Semolina and Beurre Rouge for Skinny Trascals!
ingredients: 1 pint semolina flour | 10 ounces brandy ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar ( optional )
instructions: In the mixing bowl of a stand mixer/mixer put the semolina flour, brandy, and balsamic vinegar. Make a well in the middle and gradually blend in the liquid until the batter is fully combined into a ball. You can use your hands to take the mixture out of the bowl and knead for a few minutes until smooth. Place the mixture in a plastic bag, and coat with the optional optional olive oil or water and refrigerate for about an hour or two to allow the flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,green curry paste,chili paste,cilantro leaf,white bean,swiss cheese
title: Sweet and Sour White Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans, undrained | 1 cup low-fat swiss cheese, shredded | 1 small spicy green curry paste or 1 small thai curry paste | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf | 1 -2 teaspoon chili paste ( to taste )
instructions: Heat in microwave until hot for 1 minute. Spoon into bowls. Sprinkle with cheese, rosemary and cilantro. Serve immediately.

title: Canadian Bacon, Pear & Cheese Pies
ingredients: 250 g ham | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 125 g canadian bacon ( chopped ) | 60 g cooked pears ( peeled & chopped ) | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Combine ham, cheddar cheese & chopped pears in a mixing bowl add ginger paste & pour over ham & mix well. Heat grill in a frying pan & cook the bacon until crisp. Add the pears & coat with the ginger paste. Divide mixture into 6 - 12 equal portions & place one portion on the centre of a hot bun. Make a indentation in the centre of each portion with the stem end & brush the inside of the bun with water. Place bun on grill & cook 2 minutes until well browned & the pears are tender. Turn over & brown the other side. Spoon ham mixture onto the bun & serve.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,masa harina,rom tomato,dark sesame oil,white wheat flour,asparagus
title: Cha Cha (Achiote)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cha cha masa harina | 1/2 cup white whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 4 spears trimmed fresh asparagus
instructions: Mix cha cha masa harina and white whole wheat flour in a medium bowl. Add cornflour and mix. Add tomato and sesame oil and mix.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,frangelico,red wine vinegar,soup mix,ginger garlic paste
title: Spiced Spiced Wine and Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups prepared soup mix | 1/4 ounce fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/4 cups dry red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup amaretto | 2 tablespoons frangelico
instructions: To make the sauce, put the soup mix, ginger garlic paste, wine vinegar, amaretto, and frangelico in a small pan. Stir gently over medium heat until the mixture comes to a boil. Boil for 2 to 3 minutes, then remove from the heat and place on one side to cool. Transfer to a jar in refrigerator, allowing the flavors to blend while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. Let the sauce marinate at least 1 hour in the refrigerator before cooking as directed. Keep a close eye on it as it may splatter.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,vegetable oil cooking spray,cumin,dill weed,green capsicum
title: Stir Fry Capsicum
ingredients: 4 green capsicum, seeds and flesh removed, finely chopped | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place capsicum on a microwave safe plate and cook on full power until just softened, about half 3 minutes. Allow capsicum to sit for 6 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine sugar, cumin and dill weed.

title: Arepas
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 12 ounces apple juice | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 spring onion, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let sit for 15 minutes. Place into a piping bag and fold over to form a cone shape.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,italian tomato,pork shoulder,mustard,catsup,chili flake,fenugreek leaf
title: Chilli & Pork Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( lean ) | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves ( see note ) | 18 corn tortillas ( see note )
instructions: Place the pork shoulder in the slow cooker on low heat, and season with salt, if necessary. Cut a piece of kitchen twine about 3 inches long about the width of the meat. Rub the string through the stuffing mixture to remove some of the salt. Transfer the pork to a colander or sieve, and drain off any excess liquid. Place the stewed tomatoes in a blender or food processor, and blend to a smooth puree. You may have to do this in batches. Return the puree to the slow cooker, along with the catsup. Cover and set the cooker on high heat. Cook for 1 hour, and then turn the cooker to low. Continue to cook for an additional 45 minutes. The amount of cooking time depends on the size of the pork. Remove the pork from the sauce to a small bowl, and shred it. Reserve the sauce. Stir in the chili flakes, dry mustard, and fenugreek. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Fill the warmed tortillas with the pork mixture. Roll up the tortillas, and place seam side down in the baking dish. Pour any remaining sauce into the baking dish. Cover the pan with foil. Bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes, turn off the oven, and set the baking dish over a bowl of ice over. Do not remove the foil in the last 15 minutes or so of baking time, or the tortillas will not be crisp. Uncover the baking dish, and let stand for 10 minutes.

title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 20 links hot dogs | 1 package sliced sausage
instructions: Place hot dogs, meat, and sausage in a pan with a cover. Cover, and simmer over low heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours to set fully.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,apricot,parmigiano reggiano cheese,elbow macaroni,dark brown sugar,vanilla sugar
title: Quick and Easy Baked Mac & Cheese, Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 3/4 lb elbow macaroni, cooked, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 - 1 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon unsalted dry-roasted apricot, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees positioning rack in the center of the oven. Line a 1 1/2 3/4 quart baking dish with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the cooked macaroni, vanilla sugar, and garlic salt. In a small bowl, stir together the brown sugar, apricots, and the cheese. Pour the macaroni mixture in the oiled pan. Sprinkle the cheese over the top. Bake for 25 min or until the underside is browned and topping is set.

title: Borden Bread
ingredients: borden bread or baguette | 1/2 cup vanilla extract
instructions: Butter a baking sheet. Slice baguette into 1/4 inch thick slices or desired shapes. Line them with plastic wrap and cut a slit down the center. With a sharp knife or paring knife, carefully cut about 1 1/2 deep into the bread. Sprinkle with a little vanilla extract. Bake at 400°f/190°c for 45 minutes, or until golden brown. Allow to cool before removing wrap. Enjoy with a fruit salad.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,vegetable oil cooking spray,cranberry juice,golden syrup
title: Cranberry Glaze
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade or 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, from a citrus | 1/4 cup whole cranberry juice
instructions: Prepare and spray cookie sheet with oil. Mix remaining ingredients together in small bowl. Brush on all sides of chicken. Bake in 375 degree oven for 10 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Simple Microwave Coconut Sauce
ingredients: 1 can coconut, frozen ( no peels ) | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and place on high power setting for 5 - 7 minutes stirring after 1 minute with a wooden spoon or rubber spatula.

title: Tostones (Mexican Sopes)
ingredients: 4 fresh tomatillos | 1/2 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to boil in a saucepan. Add tomatillos and cook 5 minutes, stirring often. Strain and rinse with cold water. Let drain well. Cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out as many seeds as possible. Cut away root end, then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place the tomatillos in a bowl, add cumin and toss to combine. Scoop 1/4 inchful of the mixture per slice. Arrange on a baking sheet and let stand in a cold oven, about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 frozen puff pastry sheets ( 1 package each ) | 12 chicken wings, defrosted | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 1/2 fluid ounces cornstarch | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Thaw puff pastry, line baking sheet with parchment paper. Unfold and roll 1 sheet of pastry on lightly floured board.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,chicken bouillon granule,red chili pepper
title: Pollo Con Chile Colorado
ingredients: 1 red chili pepper, seeded, finely chopped | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a clean jar with a tightly fitting lid. Store in a cool, dark place.

title: Aceitunas De Atun (Yogurt Dip)
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 3 large ripe avocado ( peeled and coarsely mashed ) | onion powder, to taste | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped ( garnish )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a medium serving bowl, except for the garnishes. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Shortly before serving, garnish with the parsley.

Random Ingredients: creamy salad dressing,cilantro leaf,broccoli floret,cream coconut,olive oil,poblano chile,chickpea,honey
title: Mexican Chickpea Salad With Poblano Chile
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 cup creamy salad dressing, prepared according to package directions | 2 poblano chiles, diced | 1 container sour cream or 1 container coconut, mayonnaise | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 can cream of coconut
instructions: Heat the olive oil and creamy salad dressing together in the blender or food processor for 30 seconds, or until smooth. Add the poblano chiles, then add the sour cream. Mix thoroughly. Taste and season with honey and cilantro. Add the chickpeas. Mix with a spoon. Cover.

title: Cardamom-Flavored Apples
ingredients: 8 small apples | 1/2 cup fresh apple juice ( not apple vinegar )
instructions: Use an apple corer to remove the ends of the cardamom pods. Cut the apple pieces into chunks and place them into a saucepan with just enough apple juice to keep them submerged. Bring the mixture to a boil and immediately reduce the heat so that the apples are cooked. Cook the apples over a gentle heat, stirring occasionally, until they are soft but not mushy. Drain and transfer to a serving bowl. Stir in the remaining apple juice until it is absorbed. Serve warm and enjoy.

title: American Kitchen Classic® Sweet Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups barbecue sauce, such as hunt's | 1 tablespoon finely grated lime zest | 1 celery rib, finely chopped
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk together barbecue sauce, zest, and celery. Cover and chill 30 minutes to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,green onion,orange liqueur,maple syrup,fennel seed,lemon pepper
title: Tunisian Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 3/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup orange liqueur ( i use grand marnier ) | 1 -2 teaspoon fennel seed ( or 2 teaspoons of fennel powder ) | 2 green onions ( or 1 small onion ) | 2 lemon peels, grated or 1/4 teaspoon lemons, lemon peel, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor. Chill.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,onion powder,jicama,sunflower oil,coriander seed,sea salt,baby pea
title: Jicama, Jicama and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup sunflower oil | 2 cups baby peas | 1/2 large jicama, grated | 1 onion, grated | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 6 slices grape tomatoes
instructions: Heat the oil in a non stick frypan. Add the chopped frozen peas and cook for 3 minutes. Add the grated onion, diced jicama and remaining spices.

title: Chop and Pepper Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary | 2 large curly-edged chile, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup cubed lamb chops | 1/4 cup crumbled instant pierogies | 1 cup sliced cremini mushroom
instructions: Combine espresso and rosemary in small bowl. Add chili.

title: Aji-Style Condiment
ingredients: 1 small yellow onion | 2 -3 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Grate onion finely and mix with all ingredients. Use as a condiment for rice dishes.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,reblochon cheese,granny smith apple,celery leaf,venison,basil,shallot,dill
title: Stuffed Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 cup fig fresh, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon ground dill | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 1/2 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and diced | 1 shallot, minced | 3 tablespoons minced celery leaves | 12 soft fresh sweet bread rolls, split | 4 ounces thinly sliced venison fat from a roast
instructions: To make the filling, combine the figs, dill, fenugreek and basil in a large bowl. Toss with the apple, shallot, celery and mustard. Cover and refrigerate. To make the patties, spread 1 side of each roll with about 1 tablespoon of the venison fat. Spread about 1/2 teaspoon of the filling evenly over the roll and top with the swiss cheese. With a second roll, wrap the sides of each bun, and secure each with toothpicks. Refrigerate rolls for at least 1 hour or up to overnight. To serve, place the patties on a platter and serve with the remaining horseradish dressing.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,garlic clove,cumin seed,green bean,orange juice zest,heavy cream,papaya
title: Spiced Papaya and Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs green beans, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 large paw papaya, peeled, seeded and cut into 2 inch squares | 6 ounces firm black green beans, trimmed | 3 fresh garlic cloves | 1/2 cup canned enchilada sauce | 1 can crushed tomatoes with orange juice and zest | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1/2 tablespoon ground cumin seed
instructions: Cook green beans, paw papaya, black beans, green beans, and garlic in boiling water, covered, for 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander. Place in a large serving bowl. In a blender, combine enchilada sauce, crushed tomatoes with orange juice, orange zest, and cumin seed. Blend well, then pour over bean mixture and stir to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod, deboned and cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 1/4 cups grits | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise ( optional ) | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 2 ounces gouda cheese, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Place cod and grits in a 3 1/2 quart baking dish. Mix mayonnaise and grated cheese, if using, and spread over cod. Sprinkle peaches on top. Bake, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Onion Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 package onion soup mix
instructions: Put graham cracker crumbs in a medium mixing bowl. Add the onion soup. Mix well. Use a small can of gravy.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,salad green,ajwain,italian salad dressing mix
title: Easy Italian Wedding Cakes
ingredients: 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 3/4 cup cake flour | 1 cup salad greens | 2 teaspoons ajwain
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.

title: Pear Rice Powder - Arroz Con Mielo
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous-rice flour | 7 pears ( very ripe )
instructions: Peel and core pears, remove cores & peel if desired. Toss with glutinous rice flour, and add water if necessary to make a smooth paste. Add more water, if needed. The amount of air needed will depend on the size of your pear. Refrigerate for 6 hours or until needed.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,pizza sauce,cardamom powder,apple,orange juice,water chestnut
title: Indian Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 1/2 cups water | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 2 cans pizza sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 can orange juice
instructions: Spray 2 1/2 quart casserole with cooking spray. Add rice, water chestnuts, sauce and cardamom. Cover and bake at 300f for 30 minutes. Add orange juice. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Homemade Tomato and Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: In a bowl, stir together tomato puree, cranberries, and vinegar until evenly mixed. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to boil. Slowly pour tomato mixture into boiling water. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, or until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,green cardamom,mint leaf,thai red chili pepper,flour tortilla,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Mexican Rigatoni and Cheese
ingredients: 5 ounces rigatoni pasta or 5 ounces penne rigate | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamoms, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon thai red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves | 4 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 4 ounces hot fat-free ricotta cheese or 4 ounces cottage cheese
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions while seasoning with chili pepper, mint, and cheese. Drain and place on a platter. Top with remaining cheese. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,star anise pod,lime zest,large shrimp,cherry tomato
title: Shrimp Stock
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 8 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 star anise pod, sliced | 10 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place shrimp into a saucepan, and fill with chicken stock enough to cover. Season with water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,white chocolate,yellow pepper,tahini,chicken turkey,sesame oil
title: Chinese Style Glazed Ribs
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style pork ribs, trimmed | 2 lbs bone-in chicken or 2 lbs chicken thighs, with bone | 4 teaspoons sesame oil | 3/4 cup tahini | 2/3 cup white chocolate, grated | 1 teaspoon peanut or 1 teaspoon cashew pieces, crushed
instructions: Place chicken in large roasting pan with bone in, then sprinkle with 4 teaspoons of the sesame oil. Drizzle with remaining sesame oil. Bake in oven at 375°f for 3 to 4 hours or until chicken is no longer pink when pricked with a fork. Cool and bone.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,mexican cheese,soya sauce,salad green,coconut milk,cherry tomato,berry,midori melon liqueur
title: Mexican Salad
ingredients: 8 medium ripe berry, washed washed, dried and quartered | 1/2 cup reduced-fat mexican cheese blend, grated | 1/4 cup mixed salad green | 1/4 cup mixed salad greens | 1/2 cup soy-free soy milk | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/4 cup tropical fruit salad ( such as pineapple, mango or berries, etc. ) | dried oregano leaves, for garnish ( optional, this is very nice served with a bit of citrus in it, but if you would like it extra spicy, stir in some dried oregano ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine the soy milk with all the seasoning ingredients. This can be made the night before by refrigerating the dish for an hour. Place the salad greens on a large platter just big enough to hold all the salad ingredients. Place the berry quarters on top of the salad greens. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. You can use any combination of cheese. Toss the salad with some of the dressing and enjoy. Goes best with a nice red pepper sauce or chutney.

title: Chorizo Sandwich
ingredients: 100 g chorizo sausage | 1 tablespoon miracle whip
instructions: Take all the ingredients and mix until the mixture starts to come together. The mix will be a little crumbly but it should stick together when working. If the mix becomes crumbly, add a little extra miracle whip. Spread over your favourite bread type. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beer,kidney bean,poultry seasoning,peanut butter,corn tortilla,ziti pasta,white onion,lemon juice
title: Barney Beans and Ziti
ingredients: 1 large white onion, chopped | 2 cans kidney beans, drained | 2 cans baked ziti pasta, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup bottled honey | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/2 cup beer, hot | 1 tablespoon corn tortilla, crumbled | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place onion, beans, ziti, and 1/2 cup water in a large baking dish or roasting pan. Combine honey, lemon juice, beer, and corn tortilla crumbles or poultry seasoning in a small bowl. Pour over vegetables in baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup water over dish when finished.

title: Faux Asparagus - Steamed in White Wine
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus | 1 cup non-dairy whipped topping | 1/8 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup wine
instructions: Cut off asparagus tips and set aside. In a large pot add asparagus pieces and just cover with water. Place lid on pot and bring to boil then simmer for 5 minutes. Add tamari, sesame oil, and wine. Stir once and stir well to mix. Pour mixture into a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap or plastic wrap. Let sit for a few minutes then serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: mexican corn,sea scallop,ginger paste,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Scallops and Corn on the Half Shell
ingredients: 4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 2 teaspoons ginger paste ( can use more ) or 2 teaspoons fresh ginger paste ( can use more ) | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs fresh sea scallops | 1 medium-large box frozen mexican-style corn, thawed | additional fresh ginger paste ( can be purchased at a indian market or indian market )
instructions: In a large shallow bowl, mix together yogurt and ginger paste until smooth. Score scallops, 3/8 to 1/4 inch thick, lengthwise, crosswise, into 3 or 4 horizontal slices about 1/4 inch thick and 2 inches wide. Place in the bowl with yogurt mixture.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,nigella seed,cider vinegar,egg yolk,pecorino romano cheese
title: Nigella's Favorite Italian  Eggnog Salad
ingredients: 6 large egg yolks | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 8 ounces condensed tomato soup | shredded pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons nigella seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Let stand 20 minutes prior to serving, mixing in the cheese at the table.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,rice,tea,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,clam,soymilk,oil,wasabi powder
title: Hot Spicy Tea Snack Mix
ingredients: 1/3 cup soy milk, or more if needed | 1/3 cup egg beaters egg substitute or 1 egg, slightly beaten | 3 tablespoons dried shrimp, minced ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 4 teaspoons prepared wasabi powder | 1 tablespoon chopped chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, or more to taste | oil for deep frying | cooked rice, to serve
instructions: Microwave rice as directed on the package. Stir soy milk, egg substitute, shrimp, curry paste, wasabi, and chipotle pepper into the rice. Cover and refrigerate. Heat oil in a deep fryer or large heavy skillet over medium heat to 375 degrees f. Pour rice into the oil, recoat just enough to make it sizzling, and fry, stirring constantly until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: potato,mint leaf,chili flake,lemongrass,vegetable oil cooking spray,plum,smelt,pea carrot
title: Stir Fry Potatoes With Vegetables
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 1/4 lbs potatoes, sliced into 1 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups plum, sliced | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas and carrots | 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, stir fried in | mint leaf, for garnish
instructions: Prepare potatoes according to package directions. Set aside. Heat a wok or large skillet coated with cooking spray over medium high heat. Add kali methi seeds. Quickly stir fry lemongrass for 10 seconds, or until it begins to turn golden, stirring constantly. Add mushrooms and stir fry for 2 minutes, or until mushrooms begin to release their liquid. Add vegetables, and stir fry for 2 minutes, or until they begin to soften. Add peas and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve hot, garnished with mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,cream mushroom soup,heavy whipping cream,mustard,shiitake mushroom,anjou pear pkg
title: Poor Man's Shishito Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 3 cups shiitake mushrooms | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 8 ounces heavy whipping cream | 2 drops horseradish | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 2 anjou pkgs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Drain mushrooms & reserve liquid. Place mushrooms, mushroom soup, cream, horseradish, & mustard in food processor. Blend until mixed. Stir in liquid & mushrooms. Add pkgs & mix together. Bake for 45 minutes until heated thru & bubbly. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Cabbage Rolls With Brown Rice and Shiitake Mushrooms (Lidia Bastianich)
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage | 2 cups short-grain brown rice | 6 ounces fresh mushrooms | 2 teaspoons freshly grated nutmeg ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese
instructions: Wash and dry the cabbage. Cut out the thick inner core just below the core. Set aside. Place the rice in a heavy saucepan with water to a depth of 2 inches. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce the heat to a simmer. Place a steamer basket over the pot and steam for 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, remove the steamer basket and fluff the rice with a fork.

title: Spicy Russian Stallion
ingredients: 1 ounce vodka | 1 dried red chile, leaves stripped from stems
instructions: Pour vodka around the edge of a stemmed martini glass and tip in a chile and leave in the vodka for 30 seconds. Pour vodka on top of chile and gently drop in a few chile leaves.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 175 ml ice water | 175 ml double cream
instructions: Whip the double cream with a pinch of salt while warm to stiff peaks. Add a few drops each of water and ice to the cream and fold gently. Place in the refrigerator for at least an hour.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,heavy cream,five spice powder,cranberry,lemon zest,paprika,baby arugula,white bread
title: Cranberry-Lemon Mousse
ingredients: 1 large lemon, zest of | 1 3/4 cups heavy cream | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries or 1/2 cup currants | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 150 g thick white bread, such as brioche | 3 lbs baby arugula
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Squeeze the lemongrass with your hands and place them in a bowl with 1 3/4 cups of the cream. Mix in the fruit and seasonings.. Spread half of the mixture evenly over the base of a 2 litre ovenproof. Line the base with a piece of bread, about 20 cm wider than the bread slices. Pour half the cream mixture over then gently spread out until the mixture reaches the edge of the bread, leaving a 5cm border on all sides. Sprinkle with half of the arugula. Repeat these layers until all the mixture is used. Cut the mousse into slices about 2cm wide and 12 to 15 cm long. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and heat in the oven for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake for a further 10 minutes or until top is puffed and golden about 5mins. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,tomato paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,cherry,maraschino cherry,chuck,thyme,olive
title: Picante Meatballs
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 - 3/4 lb ground chuck | 1 tablespoon chopped tomato paste | 1 tablespoon crushed maraschino cherry | 1 tablespoon crumbled olives ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons picante sauce ( or your favorite salsa ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup chopped maraschino cherry | 1 tablespoon chopped ripe olives ( optional )
instructions: Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Over medium high heat, cook beef, stirring until browned. Drain. In a small bowl combine tomato paste, cherries, olives and picante sauce. Mix well. Add to beef mixture. Stir to combine, then add thyme. Shape into 1 1/2 inch balls. Arrange in a lightly sprayed 8 cup baking dish. Bake in a 375 deg. Oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until meatballs are browned.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,onion soup mix,ginger paste,tea,savory,manicotti shell,bechamel sauce,asparagus
title: Beef and Asparagus Manicotti
ingredients: 36 manicotti shells | 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 small onion soup mix | 1 package frozen asparagus, thawed and finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups chinese sweet red sauce or 1 1/4 cups chili sauce | 1 package frozen bean sprouts, thawed and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger-almond extract or 1 tablespoon dried savory | 1/4 cup brewed brewed chamomelachon-flavored amchur
instructions: In a kettle cook bacon and onions over medium heat until meat is browned and onion is tender. Drain, then stir in soup mix, asparagus, chili sauce, bean sprouts and ginger paste. Cook over medium heat until heated through. Meanwhile in a medium bowl combine 1/4 cup or more chamomelachop enchilada sauce with 1/4 cup or more brewed chamomelachon enchilada sauce. Spoon about 1/2 ounce meat mixture in each uncooked manicotti shell and roll up. Place side by side in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Pour enchilada sauce mixture over rolled manicotti. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 5 minutes. Remove foil from dish and sprinkle with remaining chamomolae. Let stand for 5 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,almond,walnut,cider vinegar,ricotta cheese,date,confectioner sugar,basmati rice
title: Sweet and Sour Ricotta Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 6 dates, pits removed and washed | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1/3 cup sliced blanched almonds | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar
instructions: Place the rice into a saucepan, and fill with enough water just to cover the rice. Bring to a boil, then immediately reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender, and the water has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain in a sieve set in the sink, and set aside to steam dry for a minute or two. Rinse with cold water, and drain again. Combine the rice with the ricotta cheese, dates, walnuts, almonds, confectioners' sugar, paprika, and vinegar in a bowl, and mix well to blend. Cover, and refrigerate until chilled, about 4 hours.

title: Italian Pork Tenderloin Sandwich for 2
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | freshly cracked black pepper | 2 avocados | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh green chili pepper | 4 slices pepperoni
instructions: Lightly crush fresh pepper in a small bowl. Cut tenderloins into four portions. Tear off four pieces of plastic wrap about 25x20. Pound tenderloins to flatten, then wrap each piece with a fourth piece of plastic wrap. Rub all surfaces of meat with pepper, then top each with avocados, green chili and pepperoni. Wrap a clean sheet of aluminum foil around the meat in the middle of the sandwich. Cook in a preheated 350f oven for 45 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 170f.

title: Enchiladas De Calabaza
ingredients: 4 -8 flour tortillas | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 1/3 cups gruyere | 1 cup orange juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and lightly butter an 11x5x3 inch baking dish. Warm tortillas in microwave until soft, soft, and pliable. Dip each tortilla into the enchilada sauce until coated, then lay in prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese, then sprinkle with orange juice. Bake in oven until bubbly and lightly browned, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sate Mango Pea Salad
ingredients: 200 g dried apricots | 200 g mangoes | 150 g frozen peas | 150 g chopped thai basil
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160c/180c fan forced. Grind apricots, mangoes through finely shredding them add peas, basil and mix. Heat in oven and put rack in centre of oven for 30 minutes.

title: Yummy Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked jasmine rice, cold | 2 ounces parmesan cheese, shredded | 1 cup light salad dressing ( i recommend miracle whip ) | 2 -3 cups cooked pasta
instructions: Put all ingredients into large bowl and mix thoroughly. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate if not using right away.

title: Bratwurst With Spicy Brussels Sprouts, Potato & Crabs
ingredients: 1 bratwurst sausages | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 medium white potatoes, scrubbed and sliced thinly | 1 1/2 lbs brussels sprouts, quartered lengthwise and sliced thinly | 2/3 cup mixed olives, sliced | 1 cup crabmeat, chopped
instructions: Place bratwurst, in a skillet with enough water to cover.

title: Smoked Pork Chops (Stuffed Sirloin Chops)
ingredients: 4 thin-sliced smoked pork loin chops | 2/3 cup dry rub for stuffing | 2 tablespoons minced fruit | 2/3 cup heavy cream | white pepper
instructions: Rinse the inside of the chops with cold water. Remove the hard, shiny bone on the underside of the meat. Using a spoon, pierce the top several times with a sharp knife. Place the chops on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with the rub. Let stand 15 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from the oven, and pour cream evenly over the chops. Sprinkle with pepper. Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,cream chicken soup,dark rum,garlic,pretzel,sunflower seed
title: Aussie Pots
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup canned pizza sauce | 1/4 cup dark rum, warmed | 1 teaspoon instant minced garlic, or to taste | 1 package frozen miniature pretzels, thawed | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix chicken soup, pizza sauce, rum, garlic, pretzels, and sunflower seeds together in a 9x9 inch glass baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until fragrant and golden, 30 to 40 minutes. Cut with a sharp knife into 6 wedges.

title: Cashew-Meat Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat | 12 ounces cashews, broken into small pieces | 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Combine the brown sugar and cashews in a food processor or blender and process until they are finely ground.

title: Tarragon Corn
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups kernels of fresh corn, rinsed | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder ( or to taste ) | fresh tarragon
instructions: Place the corn kernels and chili powder in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 mts or until the kernels have thickened and the kernels are tender. Remove from the heat. Add tarragon.

title: Tart Apples
ingredients: 2 cups peeled tart apples | 1 cup oiled tomatoes with olive oil, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f degrees. In a shallow baking pan, toss apples with 1 cup oil to coat. Arrange apples in a single layer. Sprinkle with tomato and remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Bake apples, covered, in the preheated oven 40 minutes, or until crisp and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: chilies,monterey jack pepper cheese,flour tortilla,ladyfinger,turkey sausage
title: Mom's Sausage, Ladyfingers, & Pepperoni Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 4 large soft flour tortillas ( whole wheat or half-wheat ) | 1 package sliced cooked turkey sausage | 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( pepper jack cheese can also be used ) | 1 can chopped roasted chilies
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Cut ladyfingers lengthwise into halves, creating 4 serving squares. Using hands, spread each half, 1/4 inch thick, on each of four plates. Arrange one half on top of each ladyfinger square in a cross manner, then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon pepperjack cheese and 1 teaspoon chilies. Top each with another ladyfingers square, making four quesadillas. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Working in batches, add 1 quesadilla after the first and last two layers, cooking until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side, flipping once. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Cut into thirds and serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,taco seasoning mix,cocoa powder,shell macaroni,lasagna noodle,cream mushroom soup,white rum
title: Quick Mexican Lasagna (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( optional ) | 1 pound small shell macaroni | 2 cups baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons white rum
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the lasagna noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Generously butter a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread 1/3 of the taco seasoning mix over the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Layer 1/2 the noodles over the seasoning and spread 1/3 of the soup, cocoa powder, and 1/3 of the spinach. Repeat layering twice, ending with the remaining noodles, soup, spinach, rum, and taco seasoning mix. Cover with foil, and bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 45 minutes. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,ricotta cheese,slab bacon,emmenthaler cheese,bean patty
title: Italian Bread with Cheese and Bacon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 6 slices thick slab bacon | 1 tablespoon fresh jalapeno pepper diced, plus | 3 tablespoons thinly sliced jalapeno peppers ( from a jar ) | 6 ounces shredded sargento emmenthaler cheese or 6 ounces monterey jack cheese | 1 can baked beans, drained and rinsed well
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a large or oval baking dish with plastic wrap. Mix ricotta, bacon, jalapeno and 1 tblsp. Oil in a bowl until well blended. Spread mixture evenly on bread slices. Cover evenly with 1 1/2 cups cheese and 1/4 cup beans. Sprinkle remaining cheese evenly over top, then cover with foil. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes until topping is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,cherry tomato,white tequila,green cardamom pod,turmeric powder
title: Apple Jazzy
ingredients: 150 ml apple juice | 2 tablespoons white tequila | 2 tablespoons dried cherries or 2 tablespoons green cherries | 2 green cardamom pods, split | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Mix together and pour over ice cubes in a highball glass. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,red chili pepper,curry leaf,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cape Cod With Craisins and Cranberries
ingredients: 200 g dried cranberries | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 fresh curry leaves
instructions: Place the cranberries in a glass bowl with the chili and 3 tablespoons of the oil. Allow to sit for 10 minutes then add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Toss to combine, cover and set aside. Remove the stem from the curry leaves, then press out as much water as possible. Discard any damaged fruits but leave them whole. Drain the cranberries, then place in a serving dish or individual ramekin dishes. Spoon over the cedar mixture and top with the remaining oil. Serve warm.

title: Cheat's Rice With Calvados
ingredients: 300 g long grain rice ( sushi rice ) | 2 tablespoons calvados ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( sugar in syrup can be used ) | 3 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Wash the rice in plenty of salt in a colander and drain on a clean tea towel. Set aside to dry. Wash and dry the sugar in a clean tea towel. Add the calvados and leave to swell for ten minutes. Dry the rice and make small round balls with each one with the palm of your hand. Put 1 tsp of the sugar syrup in the palm of your hand. Shape a ring around the sugar in the palm of your hand, then set aside while preparing the rest of the rice. Slide the rice around the ring, palm and syrup. Serve at once using a bamboo skewer in the palm as a gripper or jerk guard for the first person, or store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: water artichoke heart,salt pepper,porcini mushroom,italian tomato,cardamom
title: Portuguese Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups dried porcini mushrooms | 2 cans italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 pinch salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Combine porcini mushrooms, tomatoes, artichoke hearts, cardamom, salt, and pepper together in a large pan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.

title: Quick Fix Cauliflower Fingers
ingredients: 2 medium cauliflower, trimmed and cut into florets | 1 cup green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 cup finely chopped green pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste | 3/4 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Steam cauliflower until tender crisp. Cool. Place cauliflower in a blender or food processor with remaining ingredients and process to a smooth texture. Spoon into a glass bowl, cover and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Pork Loin Roast with Key Lime and Key Lime Juice
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork loin roast | 1 1/2 cups key limes, juice of
instructions: Pierce the roast all over with a sharp, thin knife. Insert the tip of your knife or a small, sharp knife into the cut surface, then carefully insert the tip of the knife all the way back into the cut surface. If it does not reach the desired cut surface, make sure the tip is parallel with the opposite direction on your left and right. Add about 1/4 cup of lime juice to the cut surface of the roast. Place the pan in the oven and place it under a hot broiler or on your broiler rack. Watch closely, so the heat of the meat will be high. Cook the roast 30 - 40 minutes, or until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a roast registers about 145 degrees f. Transfer the pork to large platter and loosely tent with foil. Allow it to rest for 15 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,italian sausage,roast beef,peppermint extract,hot italian sausage
title: My Famous Italian Grilled Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs round roast beef | 2 lbs hot italian sausage | 2 teaspoons peppermint extract | 2 lbs shaved hot italian sausage | 1 ounce lemon peel, finely julienned
instructions: First i make a recipe to go with the 2 meats and then grind that in my food processor so that i have two meats and two seasonings and then store in zipper lock bag for up to a week. When ready to eat i grill the hot meats on a hot indoor charcoal grill. The meat will be just a bit charred on the outside and delicious on the inside. I also add a little italian seasoning on the meat before i slice it and then i brush the meat with lemon peppermint. This recipe is so simple i decided i had to enter that ingredient as a topping. Everyone decided it was a keeper it took almost a weekend to grind up the meat and to mix it up thoroughly. I would say a million grind grinds. After 5 - 6 hours of mix it up and check for salt and additional seasonings to your liking. You will have a thick, slightly thick sausage that stays moist and will slice easily. This will last, refrigerate until ready to serve. Cook time is the same for both meats for both ones.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,lemongrass,kaiser,egg beater substitute,broccoli floret,rice wine,white onion
title: Egg and Lemongrass Burgers
ingredients: 3 large eggs | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 3 tablespoons chopped white onions | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, finely chopped | 2 pounds broccoli florets, trimmed and cut into thirds | 1 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1/4 cup grated confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat your grill for medium high heat. While the grill heats up in the oven, make the egg mixture with the eggs, rice wine and sweet onions in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth and set aside. In a medium bowl, toss together the broccoli, egg beaters, sugar and lemongrass until well combined. Shape into 8 patties. Place on preheated grill and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, flip and cook for 5 to 7 minutes more, or until done to desired doneness. Serve on toasted buns with salsa for dipping.

Random Ingredients: cornflakes cereal,cranberry,tomato paste,banana,orange juice,vodka,red thai chile,peanut oil vegetable
title: Banana Mint Madness in a Flash
ingredients: 1/2 cup cranberries | 2 tablespoons red thai chiles, sliced | 1 can tomato paste | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons pureed banana | 1 1/2 cups cornflakes cereal | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Combine cranberries, thai chiles, tomato paste, oil, and orange juice and mash. Stir in banana until mixed. Place cornflakes cereal in a food processor or blender.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,triple sec,white pea bean,baking soda
title: Easy White Naan bread
ingredients: 1 can white pea beans or ( 16 3/4 ounce ) can pink beans, drained | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine the pea beans and triple sec in a bowl that is filled half way with water. Add the mango chutney and baking soda and stir to combine. Let sit overnight. Using a fork, prick the top of the bread with a fork or fork twice. Bake in a 375°f oven for about 8 minutes, or until the top is dry and lightly toasted. If using canned white beans, drain them and rinse under cold water.

title: Shahi Tukray
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 tablespoon light tahini
instructions: Cut the bread into four 2 - 3 slices. Spread with a little tahini. Top with another slice and cut the ends. Butter the outsides of the bread and press into the sandwiches until coated on all sides. Place on a baking tray and grill till toasted.

title: Melt Your Choice Walnut Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 pint ice cream | 1/8 lb walnut half
instructions: Place ice cream in a large bowl. Sprinkle with walnuts. Place back in the freezer for 20 minutes to solidify. Using a sharp kitchen knife, slice off a 1/4 inch or so strip of waxed paper. Fold paper and top with ice cream. Refrigerate over night. Remove ice cream from the freezer 30 minutes before serving.

title: Hot Spicy Sausage, Onions and Paphettoes
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 1 large purple onion, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Rub sausage with some oil and place in a 9x9 inch casserole dish. Spread onion slices over surface. Sprinkle on black pepper, cayenne, and brown sausage. Spread on sausages. Cover and bake 20 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes. Remove from oven, let cool 10 minutes and serve. Note, it does not really taste like paprika, but that's it.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,kaffir lime leaf,rice noodle,cooking spray,chili paste,cinnamon,cashew
title: Kaffir Lime Kheer
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup cashews | 1/3 cup chili paste | 1/4 cup rice noodles, soaked and drained | 4 kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Spray an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Mix graham cracker crumbs, cashews, chili paste, rice noodles, lime leaves, 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon, and chili paste in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Spread noodle mixture in the prepared baking dish.

title: Mexican  Veggie Rolls (Layered)
ingredients: 1 package corn husks, dry ( i use the yellow kind, but all types of yellow are ok too ) | 1 cup shortening, melted | 12 ounces frozen green beans, thawed ( fresh or frozen are ok too ) | 1 jar pimientos, chopped | 18 large lettuce leaves | 20 sheets phyllo pastry ( thawed in refrigerator ) | sliced green beans ( optional )
instructions: Soak corn husks on a baking sheet for 3 - 5 hours or until they're dry. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. To prepare rolls,. In a medium bowl, mix together flour and melted shortening until mixture forms a crumbly mixture. Add beans, pimentos, and lettuce to the moistened shortening mixture. Mix well, then roll small, flat 1 - 2 inch diameter rectangles of cornhusks lengthwise over a rolling pin. Place 2 - 3 phyllo sheets down on the work surface. Punch a hole in the center of each stacked rectangle, then fill with equal amounts of filling. Fold one end of the phyllo over, allowing a little open edge with a small hole to crimp in the seam to seal. Repeat to make remaining phyllo dough. Place seam side down on a parchment lined baking sheet and top with reserved pastry. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 - 12 minutes, until crisp and golden. Serve immediately with salsa and/or guacamole.

title: Faux Chorizo (Prawns With Tomato Wine)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tomato juice | 4 tablespoons chorizo sausage, chopped ( mexican pate ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon seafood stuffing ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon seafood ( optional ) | filling, of choice ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except for bread in a blender. Process until smooth but not too smooth. Place mixture in a glass dish or bowl. Sprinkle with extra stuffing if desired. Cover with plastic wrap. Freeze for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,sage leaf,head garlic,parsnip,saffron,rump roast,pesto sauce
title: Lori's Roasted Garlic and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 small head of garlic | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons roasted saffron | 4 -5 fresh sage leaves | 1 small onion, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 1 small parsnip, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 4 -5 small rump roast
instructions: Combine saffron in 2 t cold water. Place roast in a shallow roasting pan, and add the saffron water to about one side of the roast. Add garlic, and cover and roast in a preheated 450 degree oven for 1 1/2 hrs or until tender. Drain fat from the roast. Remove roast from the oven and set aside. In the same roasting pan, place parsnips, onion, and roast in the oven for 30 minute. Remove from the oven and let sit for 5 minutes then slice. Strain the juices and reserve for gravy. Toss roast with 1t pesto.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,sherry wine,hot chili sauce,steak,chicken cutlet,chicken tender
title: Chicken Steak With Creamy Chipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless chicken tenders | 3 lbs flank steaks | 2/3 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup hot chili sauce, sriracha | 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Place one fourth of the chicken tenderloins onto each of 2 pieces of double layer aluminum foil. Drizzle with one third of the sherry wine and sprinkle with one third of the chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: green olive,spanish onion,ginger garlic paste,white corn,beef broth,mccormick seasoning,tomato paste
title: Spanish Corn With Green Olives
ingredients: 1 can yellow corn | 1 can white corn | 1/2 spanish onion ( diced ) | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon bottled gingery garlic paste | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/4 tablespoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning
instructions: Rinse and drain corn and corn. Rinse and drain white and green olives. Combine green olives, corn, onions, tomato paste and gingery garlic paste in a crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours. Remove lid and add pepperjack cheese and stir well. Pour contents of crock pot into an oven proof dish and top with montreal steak seasoning. Bake at 225°c for 15 to 20 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Eggs in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 6 uncooked bread, sliced egg whites until they're slightly grainy | 1 package frozen small broccoli, florets only | 1 3/4 cups thick coconut milk | 2 granny smith apples, peeled and chopped small | 1 cup sliced strawberry
instructions: Toast the bread slices on both sides in a lightly oiled skillet, until golden brown and crispy. Cool slightly. Combine the coconut milk, diced apples, and chopped broccoli in a medium saucepan. Boil over low heat for 3 minutes. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until thickened. Spoon the hot coconut milk into 4 individual serving bowls. Top with toasted bread slices and sliced strawberries.

title: Baked Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can canned chickpeas | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer 1/2 cup of the chickpeas to a medium size bowl. Add the allspice and mash well with a fork. Stir in the rest of the beans. Place remaining chickpeas in a casserole dish, cover, and bake at 350 degrees for 50 - 60 minutes.

title: Langosteen (Beggold'or Mancottine )
ingredients: 4 kg aubergines | 400 -500 ml brandy or 400 -500 ml rum | 100 -250 g gourmet gourmet bread | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Clean the aubergines and take all the pith off. You can leave the membrane on but cut all the way through away. Slice the aubergines into thick slanted lengths. Soak them in 100 c rum for 1 hour. Put the sliced aubergines in a colander, sprinkle with baking powder, and shake a few times to ensure they dry out. Repeat with the rest of the aubergine slices and place into a bowl, pour over 100 c rum and cover. Refrigerate and leave to marinade overnight. Preheat oven to 200 c. Remove the cover and bake slowly for 40 - 50 minutes. Drain the aubergines and set aside. Heat the brandy, pour into a large saucepan and bring to a gentle boil. Add aubergine, lower heat and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Cut bread into squares and spread on a tray. Place 2 of the pieces of bread into a bowl. Add a ladle of the hot brandy mix into the bread cubes and stir until moistened by all the brandy. Place half of the remaining mix onto the bread and spread evenly. Place half of the grated cheese onto bread. Place all the grated cheese into the bowl on top of the grated cheese. Close the oven and bake for 30 - 40 minutes. Take out of the oven and remove from oven, cover with foil and place on dinner plates to rest. Serve at room temperature. These can be served either hot or cold.

title: Endive and Scallops in Chocolate-Garlic Sauce on Coconut Roll
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 3 ounces shredded coconut ( coco rico ) | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 scallops | 2 ounces unsalted butter, divided | cool whip or whipped cream
instructions: In medium bowl mix cocoa, garlic and coconut and set aside. Brush each scallop with half the melted butter onto both sides with remaining butter. Place scallops side by side in a plastic bag or shallow glass pan. Place plastic bag over dish and turn over. Let sit 2 to 3 minutes. Remove scallops and discard bag and discard. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place scallops on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake until just beginning to turn opaque, 7 to 10 minutes. Transfer scallops to a platter and cover to keep warm. Meanwhile, spread remaining 1/2 cup butter over a baking sheet at 400 degrees f. Arrange scallops on baking sheet and bake 5 minutes until lightly browned and crispy. Cool slightly. Using a spatula, spread coconut cream evenly over scallops.

title: Raspberry Mint Chutney
ingredients: 5 fresh raspberries | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons ginger paste
instructions: Place the raspberries in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon each salt and ginger paste. Stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,corn oil,graham cracker crumb,herb,asafoetida powder,vegetable juice cocktail,ginger,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Veggie Mix
ingredients: 1 package tortilla ( mexican style or pita size ) | 1 package mexican blend cheese | 1 packet vegetable juice cocktail | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 cup corn oil | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup fresh herb, chopped ( optional ) | 1/3 cup pickled ginger ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat pan of vegetable hotplate to med. Heat and add tortilla. Toast tortilla until dark golden brown. Remove from pan and put on flat surface. Allow to cool. To make dressing, combine all ingredients and whisk until mixed. Place drained tortilla in plastic container with oil. Pour dressing over tortilla and toss to coat. To serve, line cookie sheet with foil and spray with pam. Set aside. To make topping, combine crumbs and cheese with asafoetida, ginger and a drizzle of oil. Sprinkle over vegetables. Sprinkle over asafoetida, herbs, rice crackers and grated cheese. Place in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes until cheese has melted and crumbs have turned golden brown.

title: Grilled Chicken -- Vietnamese Style
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing chicken ( or other white meat of your choice ) | 12 cherry tomatoes, cut into quarters | 1/4 cup thai basil, plus more for garnish
instructions: Prepare the grill or oven. Wear gloves. Remove the skin and most of the fat from the chicken. Pat dry with dry paper towels. Grill chicken for about 3 - 4 minutes per side or until lightly browned on one side. Turn. Place cherry tomatoes around chicken. Arrange basil leaves on top. Close lid or grill for about 10 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Turkish Seasoned Salt for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves, dried | 1 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: In a mortar or mortar, pound paprika, oregano, cardamom, and remaining 1 teaspoon coarse salt in a smooth paste. Rub mixture on fish and chips. Store in an airtight container.

title: Italian Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 5 baking potatoes | 1 large fresh zucchini or 1 large summer squash, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spread potatoes out on baking sheet. Bake for about 20 minutes, until the outsides turn a nice, brown color. Peel the potatoes, peel and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Scrape out the insides of the potato skins, saving about ½ of the potato skins for the zucchini sticks. Cut zucchini sticks into 1 inch pieces. Bake for about 15 minutes, until crisp and very tender.. Cool for a few minutes, and remove the pulp carefully with a slotted spoon.

title: Simple Easy Croquettes
ingredients: 4 -5 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 -2 cup granulated celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Put 1/2 of the bread crumbs in a bowl with some of the celery. Make sure that it fits snugly into the palm of your hand. Form into a ball and roll it in the bread crumbs. Place on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Bake 8 - 12 minutes, depending on size of crumbles, till golden, not browned. Enjoy.

title: Apple Turnip Pie
ingredients: 1 medium turnip | 3 cups apple juice | 2 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Boil, peel and boil turnip until tender. When cool enough to handle, peel off skin and dice into bite size pieces. Place in a 9 x 12 inch baking dish. In a medium saucepan, combine apple juice with a pinch of salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Pour over chopped turnip. Sprinkle top with a little more salt and pepper while continuing to bake in a 400 degree f oven until the turnip is hot and bubbling around the edges, about 40 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Flour Sandwich Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup flour | 1 cup cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix brown sugar and flour well with electric mixer. Mix in grated cheese. Roll out dough into 8 x 8 rectangle. Sprinkle top with granulated sugar. Cut into 4 squares or 1/4 inch slices. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bacon,kalamata olive,basmati rice,white chocolate,bacon bit,spanish onion
title: Spanish Rice with Fried Bacon!
ingredients: 2 cups long grain basmati rice | 8 -10 slices bacon ( slices ) | 3 small spanish onions, chopped finely | 1/2 cup kalamata olive ( sliced very finely ) | 10 -12 pieces white chocolate | 10 -12 bacon bits ( optional )
instructions: Place a large, deep skillet or frying pan on a medium high heat over medium heat. Put in the bacon bits, onions and spanish rice. Stir together until it starts to turn translucent. Don't allow the rice to burn. Add the white chocolate and stir until it starts melting on the bottom a bit. It might make the chocolate smell pretty, but i have deliberately not stirred. Once the chocolate is melted, carefully add and mix in the bacon bits that have been sprinkled on top of the rice. As soon as there is about a minute or two left, remove this from the heat. Stir occasionally, ensuring that the bacon bits are mostly visible on top of the rice. Serve on a plate covered with a towel or a platter, allowing you to be sure that none of your family has anything to eat out of it. Eat with fresh fruit.

title: Sautéed Sun-Dried Tomato and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons chopped peeled fresh oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sun dried tomatoes, oregano, and oil. Shake or toss to coat. Allow mixture to sit 10 minutes, stirring or shaking occasionally.

title: Perfect Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 cup white flour | salad greens (, mixed salad mix ( or vegetables to compliment your meal )
instructions: Place the dried rice on a clean tea towel. Turn on the oven to 375 degrees f. Dry the grains as much as you can. Sprinkle the grains with the flour until the dry is all over the top. Scatter your salad mix as desired and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until the top of salads is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mirin,celery rib,bulk italian sausage,rice vinegar,soya sauce,ginger garlic paste,cardamom powder,salt black pepper
title: Bibimbap Sausages With Lettuce and Salads (Kway Teetaku)
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 5 cups cooked rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( about 1-1/2 tsp ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder or 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, and | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Remove casings from sausage and cut into 1/8 inch rings. Cut rings into 1/2 inch lengths, and cut a slit along the length of the sausage at 1/4 inch intervals. Combine the remaining ingredients and add to sausage slices. Place the casings back in the jar, then seal. Marinate in the refridgerator for up to 8 days. Skewer the sausage and eat from the casings, then keep warm in a dark non reactive bowl in the oven until ready to serve. This recipe can also be made with pork sausages.

title: Cumin-Infused Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules ( or 2 1/2 teaspoons beef base dissolved in 1/2 cup hot water )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small frying pan. Heat over medium high heat until hot. Do not overheat or mixture will begin to dry out.

Random Ingredients: star anise pod,bisquick,chuck roast,white wine,cardamom powder,anchovy paste
title: Foil Wrapped Beef for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chuck roast, trimmed ( a cube of beef, about 2 lbs, or you could use just a little extra ) | 2 cups dry white wine ( i use red ) | 1 can anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 3 tablespoons bisquick or 3 tablespoons potato flour | 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 teaspoon star anise pod or 1/2-1/2 teaspoon anise extract, to taste
instructions: Rub beef with anchovy paste. Place in crock pot. Pour wine over beef. Cook on low for 8 and 1/2 to 10 hours depending on how well done you like your beef. The longer you cook this, the better the meat will taste. Remove beef from crock and discard liquid. Stir the flour into the liquid in crock pot. Cook on high for 2 minutes to thicken slightly. Then remove beef and stir gently. Season with additional salt, to taste.

title: Perfectly Easy Parsley Crusted Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 5 cups shell pasta ( uncooked, or use any macaroni pasta you have at hand ) | garlic powder | crackers or crumb ( i've also used crushed, grated parmesan flavored, etc. )
instructions: Cook macaroni as per package directions. Drain pasta as instructed and spread out on a large rimmed baking sheet or tray. I use 2 baking sheets with enough room at the top to leave room for the cheese sauce to thaw. Preheat oven to 350°f. Sprinkle the tops of the macaroni with garlic powder and lightly dust with cracker crumbs. Top with the cheese. Note, if desired, sprinkle with some more of the cracker crumbs to prevent the cheese from getting soggy. Bake for approx 25 - 30 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Cognac Fondue (Sirloin or Veal, Both Versatile!)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons powdered instant minced onion flakes | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/8 cup freshly grated lemon rind | 2 cans chopped fire-roasted tomatoes, undrained | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1 tablespoon dutch-processed cocoa ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped canned lemons, rinds of ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir together the dried onion and powdered onion/onion flakes. Bring to simmer. Remove from heat. Place cream in a medium bowl. Beat with an electric mixer on high speed until thick. Beat in the onion/onion flakes, lemon rind, both cans of tomatoes, cocoa and 1 tbs cocoa. Stir until combined, adding additional cream if neccesary. Garnish with additional grated orange rind if desired. Serve with your favourite meat dippers.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,lemon juice,golden syrup,wine vinegar,kidney bean
title: Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 400 g kidney beans, cooked | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, cubed | 1 lemon, juice of | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: Throw all ingredients in a bowl and stir through. I usually serve it with a green salad and some french bread slices.

title: Tilapia and Amaretto Crock Pot
ingredients: 12 ounces tilapia fillets | 1 1/4 cups icing sugar | 1/4 cup quick-cooking tapioca | 1/4 cup amaretto | 2 dashes instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Place tilapia fillets in slow cooker. Combine icing sugar and tapioca in small bowl. Brush on top of fillets. Sprinkle with chicken bouillon. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.

title: Spaghetti With Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 package spaghetti, broken into 3/4 inch by 2 1/2 inch pieces | 1 can sliced orange quarters | 1 cup fresh blueberries, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 6 tablespoons light tasting spice cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground sumac | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange rind
instructions: Heat butter in large saute pan over medium heat. Add spaghetti and pasta. Saute for 3 minutes and add orange, blueberries, fish sauce, and spices. Saute for 2 - 3 minutes longer, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with orange rind.

title: Sizzlof (Oriental Sizzlin' Stewed Pork)
ingredients: 1/2 cup yogurt | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoonwasabi paste | 1 1/4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch pieces ( about 4 medium ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked | parsley, chopped, for garnish
instructions: Prepare the wasabi paste, by pouring boiling water over it and crushing it with your fingers. It should look like you have about a cup left. Let it sit to bloom. Place a large pan over medium heat. Add the yogurt and wasabi and cook over medium heat until it is a thick consistency. Place the pork, parsnips, and rue in the pan, stir frequently to coat, remove with a slotted spoon and set aside while pasta cooks. When the pasta is cooked, drain the pasta and arrange on plates. Top with the pork mixture and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Sweet Pork Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup cream | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup romano cheese | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Slice pork in strips 2 long. Heat frying pan. Place cornstarch in bowl and add flour and cream. In separate bowl add 1/4 cup of swiss cream, 1/4 cup of romano cheese, and 1 t of cornstarch. Mix until smooth. Heat cream and pour into flour and cream. Mix until smooth and thick. Set aside. Heat a large pot of water. When it boils add fettuccine and cook until 'al dente'. Drain. Add pork and sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with sour cream.

title: Noori Pudding
ingredients: 400 ml buttermilk | 400 g seedless raspberry vinegar | 400 g crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pod
instructions: Place half of the vinegar and 100ml of water in a saucepan, leave until the vinegar is clear, about 10 - 15 minutes, remove from the heat and then pour the mixture into an 8 inch pudding basin. Wash the raspberries under 2 changes of cold water, remove the skin and cut off the ends. Place the raspberries into a bowl with the remaining vinegar and 300ml water, and leave to marinate for 30 minutes. Place the peanut butter in a bowl and rub in the black cardamom pods. Pour the peanut butter mixture into the pudding basin and stir over direct heat until the mixture just begins to thicken. Season to taste and serve with a spoonful of plain yoghurt.

title: Kahlua Fried Macroons
ingredients: 4 ounces self rising flour ( or a mix of half and half, sifted to remove lumps ) | 4 ounces light cream or 4 ounces dark cream | 1 ounce hot sauce | 3 tablespoons kahlua | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs, chopped
instructions: Sift the flour and kahlua into a bowl. Whisk in the cream or dark. Add the chopped herbs and stir until well blended. Heat a non stick frying pan or electric frying pan over a medium heat. Spoon the batter into the pan. Turn on the heat when the edges are slightly bubbling, and flip the slices. Continue cooking for 3 minutes or until the edges become firm and golden brown. Remove from the pan and set aside. Serve with butter or margarine. Note, kahlua freezes well and is a good choice for flavouring your rooibos. Please note, if you want to make up to three weeks ahead, preheat oven to 350°f. Pour kahlua into a bowl. Place the bowl in a roaster or large baking dish lined with parchment paper. Drizzle the top evenly with olive oil or melted butter. Place in a 400f oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden. This will make the crispy bits of cheese that will have to turn from their chunky, uneven texture to a dull, flat crisp texture.

Random Ingredients: baby potato,lamb shoulder,pepper,mint sprig,dark soy sauce
title: Lamb With Spices and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lamb shoulder | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | pepper | 1 large baby potato | 2 -6 fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Prepare the lamb shanks by trimming off the excess fat with kitchen shears. Cut off any excess fat around the edges of the lamb and stud it with a piece of parchement paper that's been trimmed well. Sprinkle both sides of the lamb with pepper and place the lamb on a board or tray that fits snugly in a roasting tin just large enough to hold all the meat. Brush the outside of the lamb with a little oil and place all on top of the paper and meat. Cover the tin with the lid and place it in the oven. Allow the meat to sit for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the potatoes. Peel the potatoes and cut into quarters. Place the potato into a pan of boiling water, cover and simmer for about 25 minutes or until tender. Drain the potatoes and set aside. Place the lamb onto serving plates and pour over the remaining juices. Garnish with mint and serve as is, if you like.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck steak,chinese cabbage,parsley leaf,herring fillet,russet potato,sea bass fillet
title: Steamed Sole & Herring
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck steak | 3 lbs herring fillets | 1 lb russet potato, peeled | 3/4 head chinese cabbage, cored | 1/4 cup parsley leaves | sea bass fillet
instructions: In a large wok or large skillet, heat the 1/2 pound of beef, with the herring, potato, cabbage and parsley to boiling. Cover and steamed for 1hour steam steaming is critical. Check for doneness. To serve remove fish to a warm platter and cover with foil.

title: Rosemary Oil (For Fish Broiler)
ingredients: 1/4 cup rosemary ( loosely packed ) | 1/8 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cut a small slice off the root end of the rosemary sprig. With scissors, cut away the sprig.. Cut through the stem and continue cutting. You can break it into smaller pieces.
