Rub the cut surface with warm water, then sprinkle with salt. Let rest for 15 minutes. Wash under cold running water, then rinse with cold water. Pat dry with paper towels. Cut the fish into 3 serving pieces. The fish should be kept in the freezer. Brush with any leftover water from washing the fish. Serve the fish and any juices separately. You can make this simple enough while it's still cold to serve. You can store and bottle and store indefinitely in the freezer. Reheat the fish before you eat. It smells wonderful.

title: Ancho Mayo
ingredients: 4 anchovies, finely sliced | apricot preserves, to taste | dark soy sauce, to taste | adobo sauce, to taste
instructions: Place the anchovies on a serving plate. Drizzle with the hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,lettuce leaf,orange zest,buttermilk,pineapple chunk juice
title: Spicy Pineapple And Roquefort  Bread
ingredients: 6 fresh pineapple chunks in juice ( reserve juice ) | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 8 slices roquefort cheese | 1/2 cup low-fat buttermilk | 8 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place pineapple on a foil lined baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until the skins begin to peel off. Remove from the oven and let cool completely. Cut into 8 equal chunks. Chill, uncovered, for half an hour. Place one chunk of the pineapple on each of four plates. Top with a slice of cheese and a drizzle of buttermilk. Place a lettuce leaf on top of each serving, top with a scoop of pineapple juice, and serve.

title: Hominy, Cranberry, and Orzo Soup
ingredients: 2 -3 cups orzo ( hominy, uncooked ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( optional ) | 2 cups diced chicken | 1 1/2 cups cubed fresh orzo ( orzo ) | 2 cups fresh orzo ( orzo ) | 1 can cranberries | 4 cups chicken stock ( or broth ) | 3 cups chopped greens | 1/2 cup snipped ripe olives
instructions: Cook orzo as package directs. Drain. Blend orzo in large bowel until smooth. Return orzo to pot. Add stock, hominy, orzo, and cranberries. Add green and/orzo. Cook 1 - 2 minutes. Cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Sprinkle with olives.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,soy sauce,orange bell pepper,chipotle chile,snow pea,green chilies,wheat spaghetti,garlic olive oil
title: Orange Spaghetti With Sausage and Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garlic-flavored olive oil | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 1 green chilies, chopped, or more to taste | 1 orange bell pepper, chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles, minced | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 lbs whole wheat spaghetti | 4 cups snow peas
instructions: Heat olive oil into a saucepan used to cook italian sausage, breaking it into slices when it cooks, over medium high heat. Add sausage slices.

title: Mexican Style Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh green beans, cut in half | 1 jar salsa ( low sodium )
instructions: Slice or dice green beans, depending on size. Place into large glass dish and pour over salsa. Cover and let stand at room temperature 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: macaroni noodle,passion fruit puree,red bell pepper,poppy seed,scallion,brie cheese,breadcrumb
title: Poppy Seed Crumble Pot-Au-lots
ingredients: 1 package capelli noodles | 1 1/2 cups shredded brie cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons passion fruit puree | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced scallions
instructions: Cook pasta until just tender, in a large pot of boiling water. Drain, rinse and then refrigerate until completely cooled, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and chill in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 350°f combine the chilled pasta and brie in a large bowl. Stir in the bell pepper, poppy seeds, passion fruit puree and bread crumbs. Spoon into an 11x7 inch baking dish and sprinkle with scallions. Bake the casserole for 25 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.

title: Strawberries over Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 2 cups aged cheese, such as cabot brand | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, divided | 3 ounces stale french bread, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | fresh basil, if desired
instructions: In the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, combine the cottage cheese, cheese, 1/2 teaspoon of the salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper. The mixture should have a firm textured consistency. The texture should be slightly watery. Fold in the bread cubes, then cover the bowl and chill the mixture in the refrigerator for an hour or two to allow flavors to develop. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Uncover the bowl. Put a small amount of water in the bottom of a 9x9 inch baking dish and place the pudding in the oven and bake the pudding for 7 - 10 minutes until the top of the pudding is golden brown. Sprinkle the basil over the top. Serve warm.

title: Lima Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 cup lima beans | 1/2 cup italian cheese, shredded | 1 package fresh beets, scrubbed
instructions: Place lima beans, cheese and beets in a food processor and puree until a smooth consistency is reached.

title: Champignons En Papillote (Champignon-Pepper)
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups cooking sherry | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Put a small dish on the table to show you how this made me. This is so easy, if you don't have some wine, your guests might have the option of putting their own sherry in with the sherry. When you are a moroccan, you can use a small sieve set over a small bowl. Pour sherry into a small bowl.

title: French Watercress Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch watercress, washed and trimmed ( canela ) | 1/4 - 1/3 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Wash and trim watercress, and remove stems by running cleanly under hot water.

title: Yellow Rice and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup yellow rice | 1/4 cup long grain white rice, uncooked
instructions: Combine rice, and 1/4 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat. Boil 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low, cover, and let steam steam over the rice for 15 minutes, until water is absorbed. Fluff rice with fork. If desired, sprinkle with red or white chile pepper.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,ginger,cream corn,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Chi-Chi Corn Dip
ingredients: 2 cups cream-style corn | 1 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 green kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the corn, cheese, ginger, and lime leaves. Spread in an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 30 to 35 minutes, or until hot and bubbling.

title: Quick and Easy Beef "flour" Patties
ingredients: cooking spray | 3/4 lb stewing beef, diced | 1 - 1 1/2 cup prepared shredded salsa ( use your favorite salsa ) | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce chili sauce ( i use ortega'hot and sour sauce ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce dried fenugreek ( i use my own mix ) | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce guacamole | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Heat medium in large nonstick saute pan coated with cooking spray.

title: Quick White Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1 head garlic, peeled and crushed | 1 head lettuce, chopped | 1 package mexican blend cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the peeled garlic cloves in a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 20 minutes. Cool and place in a blender. Blend into the prepared dish. Place shredded lettuce on top of the garlic cloves. Sprinkle with shredded mexican cheese. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly around the edges, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: burgundy wine,ginger garlic paste,chicken bouillon,brazil nut
title: Penny's Potted Chicked Brazil Nut
ingredients: 4 ounces chinese brinjal or 4 ounces other black brazil nuts, soaked for one day and cut in 1/2 | 4 ounces ginger-garlic paste, soaked in | 2 ounces chicken bouillon, made with salt and pepper | 1/2 cup burgundy wine
instructions: Soak the brazil nuts in water overnight to remove brine, then place them in a blender or food processor and process all together until smooth, then place in a bowl and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Drain and pat the soaked nuts dry with paper towels. Cut the flesh into 1/2 cubes or small squares. Place the ginger into a saucepan, add a little water and bring to a boil, then stir in the garlic paste and simmer until mixture becomes thick. Stir in the chile puree and pour into a jar. Pour in enough wine to cover the nuts and mix well. Keep refrigerated for 3 days.

title: Beer Chips With Hazelnut and Feta Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons quick-cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons dark beer | 5 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 4 large hazelnuts, shelled, toasted, chopped | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, combine oil and cayenne.

title: Tempeh  Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs tempeh, cubed ( about 8 ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/2 cup mixed nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup kosher salt or 1/4 cup coarse sea salt | 1/2 cup sake, rice wine sherry or 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Rinse the tempeh cubes well with very hot tap water, and then cut into cubes. Toss the tempeh with the sun dried tomatoes in a large bowl. Add all of the remaining ingredients and mix them well. Cover and marinate at room temp for 1 hour turning occasionally. Alternate thread the tempeh onto metal skewers. Grill, covered with a lid, over medium coals, turning occasionally, until well cooked, about 15 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,vanilla bean,cilantro leaf,red chili powder,yellow onion,cremini mushroom,prosciutto,raspberry
title: Tropical Mushroom, Corn & Swiss
ingredients: 1/2 lb sliced cremini mushroom | 3 large yellow onions or 3 large white onions, diced | 12 ounces sliced swiss cheese | 6 ounces prosciutto, cut into strips | 1 pinch red chili powder | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry ( not frozen ) | fresh cilantro leaves, chopped ( or parsley ) | 1/4 cup seedless raspberry jam or 1/4 cup canned red chili sauce
instructions: Over medium high heat in a skillet saute mushrooms, onions, and mushrooms until browned, about 25 minutes. Drain excess moisture, and stir in cheese, prosciutto, chili, and 1/2 cup raspberries. Gently mix in hot corn, sprinkle with cilantro and let stand 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Hazelnuts - Vegan
ingredients: 2 cups raw hazelnuts | 3 cups cooked beans | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Spread hazelnuts over a cookie sheet to dry up. Boil the beans until soft. Put hazelnuts on a plate and place in microwave. Stir every minute. When hot, remove and spread hazelnuts on top of each other and put in the microwave for a few minutes and let cool. Break apart into small pieces. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chocolate-Spiced Veal Empanadas (Empanadas De Pimenta)
ingredients: 5 medium spanish onions, coarsely chopped | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 3/4 pound ground veal | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 2 cans diced mild green chiles, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cook onions in a large pot of boiling water until crisp tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. Arrange onions in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until onions are browned and tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Combine tomatoes and veal in a large pot over low heat.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,couscous,extra sharp cheddar cheese,cream chicken soup,beef stock,red curry paste
title: Couscous With Italian Sausage & Beef
ingredients: 1 box couscous ( uncle ben's ) | 1 lb extra firm italian sausage, casing removed ( sliced ) | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground lamb | 1 -2 cup beef stock | 2 teaspoons red curry paste, depending on taste | sour cream or milk, as desired | 2 -3 cups shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Add beef stock to a skillet and brown the sausage. Drain excess fat, but don't rinse and crumble the meat. In a large skillet, add the ground beef or lamb with the curry paste. Cook until no longer pink, drain if you want, and add to skillet. Stir in the couscous and beef mixture, and mix well until the couscous has absorbed the meat and spices. Add sour cream just before serving, if needed. Serve over hot, cooked rice. Note, this is a good couscous that tastes wonderful with left over green beans and a fresh green salad. To omit the sour cream and green beans, you could substitute a light salad of frozen peas with canned peas. It's especially good fresh.

title: Spillies
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 white mushroom, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the cauliflower florets onto an 8x8 inch casserole dish. Layer the mushrooms over the cauliflower. Drizzle the mushrooms with olive oil. Bake at 400 degrees f for 25 minutes, until vegetables are tender and cauliflower is crisp.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,sandwich,gelatin,green cabbage,napa cabbage,cream mushroom soup,squid,fish sauce
title: Thai-Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen sandwich rolls | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chopped green cabbage | 1/2 cup shredded napa cabbage | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Thaw frozen rolls of rolls and pre freeze dough and filling. Unroll dough on lightly floured surface. Using the edge of a round glass, use fingers to press rolls into place. In shallow bowl, mix together soup, green cabbage, napa cabbage, fish sauce and gelatin. Spread mixture into dough. Place prepared rolls on a cookie sheet and freeze until solid. Cut rolls in half diagonally. Place sliced rolls on a serving dish and top with soup mixture. Serve with dipping bread and jasmine rice.

title: Easy Mexican Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a skillet or crockpot. If using crockpot, switch to medium. Cover and cook on low heat for 5 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,lime juice zest,chinese five spice powder,active yeast,beef chuck roast,romaine lettuce,red chile,black pepper
title: Spicy Chiles (Corned Beef and Cabbage)
ingredients: 6 dried red chiles ( such as arbol chiles ) | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 cup lukewarm water | 2 lbs kosher-style lean boneless chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 5 tablespoons fresh lime juice and zest | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves or 2 tablespoons mint | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper
instructions: Place chiles in a medium bowl, cover with cold water, and let soak for 30 minutes. Drain chiles, reserving soaking liquid. Combine chiles, yeast, and 1 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Transfer chiles to a bowl and let cool to lukewarm. Place chuck in a large, heavy pot. Add 2 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder, lime juice, zest, cilantro, and pepper. Shake the pot to evenly coat all of the meat. Cover and cook over low heat, basting occasionally with chile soaking liquid. Scatter the chiles over the mixture and simmer, uncovered, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool to lukewarm. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brush cabbage with cooking spray or oil. Place casseroles on a baking sheet. Bake, uncovered, for about 1 hour, or until tender and nicely browned. Cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,chicken broth,canola oil,active yeast,sauerkraut,italian bread
title: Sauerkraut With Gouda Cheese and Artichokes
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast, or as needed | 2 cups chicken broth, warmed, divided | 1/3 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup sauerkraut, drained | 1 cup shredded aged gouda cheese, or more if desired | 1/4 cup sauteed mushrooms, such as oyster, shiitake, and shiitake, plus more for garnish
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over 1 cup warm chicken broth in a small saucepan.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,cream mushroom soup,fruit,turkey,beef bouillon granule,brandy
title: Delicious Family-Style Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground turkey | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 lb ground beef bouillon granules | 1/3 cup madeira wine or 1/3 cup other sweet dessert wine | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup white rum
instructions: Place meat in mixing bowl and lightly mix. Add soup, beef bouillon granules, madeira, brandy, and rum to meat. Stir until well mixed. Let it sit at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes. Put meat mixture in buttered loaf pan and place in a 325° oven to make sure crust is golden brown. Take out of oven and let stand 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,monterey jack cheese,green cabbage
title: Crispy Sun Dried Tomato and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage, thinly sliced crosswise | 1/2 lb thinly sliced monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix cabbage, cheese, and sun dried tomatoes in a bowl.

title: Fried Beets - Beets with Ricotta and Almonds (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 3 large beets, peeled and cut into 2 inch lengths | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped blanched almonds
instructions: Heat the oven to 325°. Line a baking sheet with heavy duty aluminum foil. Place beets in foil, stem side down. Bake for 1 hour. Test beets with a small sharp knife in a few minutes, they should be tender when pierced with a skewer. They should be evenly browned and easily pierced with the tip of a paring knife. Cool beets and drain well, reserving cooking liquid. Chop cooked beets. Place remaining 1/4 cup of ricotta and the almonds in a food processor container or blender. Process until smooth. Place a large nonstick frypan over medium heat. Add reserved beet liquid and beets and cook until liquid dries and beet mixture turns golden brown, about 8 minutes. Drizzle the beets with olive oil from the jar. Cook, turning beets once, until beets are crisp and tender and most of the liquid has evaporated, about 2 to 6 minutes. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Baked Velveeta Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 lb velveeta cheese or 1/2 lb velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | 2 slices bread, cut very thin on the diagonal about 2 3/4-inches each ( we use texas toast for this ) | 2 -4 fluid ounces amaretto or 2 -4 fluid ounces almond liqueur
instructions: Cut the velvetta into smaller pieces and place inside a 2 - 3 1/ 2 quart casserole dish. Top with bread.

title: Korean Steamed Cabbage and Onions
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 package dry soy sauce
instructions: Combine the soy sauce, onion soup mix and dry soy sauce in a slow cooker. Cover and cook for 5 hours on low or 7 to 8 hours on high.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1/4 cup raw pumpkin seeds, shelled | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon ground cloves
instructions: Blend pumpkin seeds, cumin, and cloves in a blender until very fine, adding a little water if necessary.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,broccoli floret,hot water,anchovy,red kidney bean,cotija cheese
title: Caldo Verde Con Verduras (Triple Kidney Bean Soup)
ingredients: 8 cups hot water ( depending on the strength of your anchovies ) | 400 g red kidney beans, drained ( or any other canned red kidney beans ) | 225 g broccoli florets | 175 g cotija cheese or 175 g romano cheese, sliced | 3 anchovies | 4 teaspoons plain flour, to dust
instructions: Place the hot water in a medium sized saucepan and bring to the boil. Add the beans and sugar, stir to combine. Reduce the flame to a simmer and cook for 40 - 50 minutes or until soft and creamy. In a shallow dish or bowl, mix the cheese with a couple of tbsp of the hot water. Drain the liquid from the beans and add to the cheese along with the anchovies. Gradually mix in the flour. Allow to boil to thicken and then remove the pan from the heat. Season with a little salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve in bowls drizzled with a mixture of chopped fresh coriander, olives and/or chives.

title: Lazy Italian Beef Dressing
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Put all ingredients in a resealable container and shake well. It will be quite thick, so you may need to stir it up first. Refrigerate or leave out of the fridge 3 - 4 days. Shake and let sit for a couple of hours before eating.

title: Authentic Tortilla Pie
ingredients: 16 corn tortilla strips | 4 cups soymilk or 4 cups skim milk | italian bread, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a pie pan with one of the tortilla strips, spread about 1/4 cup of the soymilk or skim milk over it. Lay another piece of tortilla over top of the soymilk and layer it with a few slices of italian bread, then repeat layering until you have finished all of your ingredients. Place in oven to bake for about 40 to 45 minutes or until it puffs up and begins to brown on the edges. When done, cut and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: king prawn,half,cheesecloth,cardamom,flat leaf parsley,pecorino romano cheese,tomato paste
title: Prawns in Foil
ingredients: 1 kg king prawns ( fresh or frozen ) | 200 ml half-and-half | 2 teaspoons cardamom | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 100 g mature cheesecloth | flat leaf parsley | pecorino romano cheese, shaved ( optional )
instructions: Remove the shells from the prawns and set aside. Make sure the prawn meat has defrosted and then boil them in lightly salted water until cooked, about 10 to 15 minute drain the prawns and keep aside. If using frozen prawns, they need 5 minutes maximum drain the prawns and rinse them under water. Preheat pan and add oil. Fry prawns on both sides and keep them warm. Remove the toothpicks and keep warm. Add half and half to the pan along with cardamom, tomato paste and a little of the cheese cloth. Stir well. Simmer it for 3 - 5 minute. Take prawns out of pan and transfer them on a plate and pour the sauce over them. Sprinkle the chopped parsley and remaining cheese cloth over the top and serve immediately. Alternatively, use a toothpick to hold the prawns and sauce in place. Note, i usually serve this with white rice.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,enchilada sauce,plum tomato,pepper sauce
title: Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 1 ripe plum tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup prepared enchilada sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon baileys irish cream
instructions: Mix ingredients in a bowl until well blended. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Mushroom and Beet Beets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 lb beets, scrubbed and sliced
instructions: In a large heavy skillet, mix the mushrooms, onions, celery seed, and beets. Bring to a boil and then reduce to low and cook, covered, for 45 minutes until the beets are tender. Stir the beets every five minutes for even cooking.

title: Sweet Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons catsup ( try thai or asian style brand. )
instructions: Mix the curry paste and catsup together. Use a whisk to mix ingredients together.

title: Duck Sausages
ingredients: 500 g duck | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder or 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 2 sausages
instructions: Preheat oven to 190ºc. Remove duck fat and cut into 5cm lengths. Mix with cocoa, sausage mix well, leave to marinate. Bake in oven for 2 1/2 hours. Slice, serve and watch out for the sizzling action that may be left in the pan.

title: Spiced Cauliflower and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, unpeeled, quartered | 3/4 lb cauliflower floret, trimmed | 1/2 cup mirin | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 6 ounces canned stewed tomatoes ( drained and chopped, i just like them! )
instructions: Place the potatoes and cauliflower in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool slightly, then cut the potatoes, cauliflower and tomatoes into 1 inch cubes. Toss well with the vinaigrette. Serve at room temperature.

title: Kaffir Lime Pasta (Sorbet)
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 1/2 inches piece kaffir lime zest, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain well and place in a large bowl with the lime zest and enough cold water to cover by 2 inches.

title: Hamburger Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can mushroom pieces, drained | 1 package ladyfingers | 1/2 cup cooked chicken, chopped
instructions: Place chuck roast in crock pot and cover with tomato soup.

title: Heirloom Tomato, Avocado and Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe hass avocado | 3/4 cup toasted cashew nuts or 3/4 cup toasted nuts, coarsely chopped | 1 can sliced peaches, drained and halved | 1/4 cup drained capers | 2 teaspoons drained bottled chipotle chiles in adobo sauce or 2 teaspoons minced canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 8 large flour tortillas, warmed ( about 8 inches in diameter ) | 4 -6 cups mixed heirloom tomatoes, very thinly sliced
instructions: Prepare dressing, peel and pit avocado. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes and place in a medium bowl. Using 2 tablespoons dressing from can, toss with nuts. Drain any remaining dressing. Add toasted cashews, peaches, capers, chiles and chipotles and toss until evenly coated. Keep chilled. To assemble, arrange tomatoes on 4 plates. Cut avocados in half on a diagonal. Scatter with half the dressing and sprinkle with remaining dressing. Serve salad immediately, garnished with additional dressing.

title: Texas Vanilla Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 large vanilla bean | 1/3 cup liquid smoke flavoring | 8 -10 lettuce leaves | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Break the vanilla bean open, scrape insuring seeds and juices collect in the inside of the vanilla bean. Split the vanilla bean lengthwise with a sharp knife. Carefully slit the open end like you would a v. Do not scrape your inner flap like you would an open bean do not scrape the vanilla bean completely. Squeeze the vanilla bean pulp into a saucepan over low heat. Using a rubber spatula, scrape the vanilla bean seeds into the saucepan. Stirring occasionally, bring to a boil and add a couple tablespoons of the hot sauce. When the sugar is dissolved, discard the vanilla bean skin. Add the flavor of your choice. Fill a large skillet with hot water. Using a spoon or potato masher, press or blend the vanilla bean mixture into the hot water to create a paste. The syrup should no longer be cloudy but the texture should remain moist. Do not boil or the flavor will separate. If the syrup becomes too thin, add more hot sauce. Place the lettuce leaves on a plate and drizzle with the hot sauce. Top with hot sauce for a nice dipping sauce.

title: Spiced Sausage with Nori
ingredients: 500 g spicy sausage | 3 sheets nori | 3 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon spicy salt
instructions: Prepare spicy sausage. Place a sheet of nori on a flat surface using a rolling pin. Lay a generous 1 cm/1 inch thickness of thin spaghetti across the nori. Remove 3 layers of the nori from the nori using a sharp knife. Pour the spicy sausage and spicy salt evenly over and set aside while preparing the remaining ingredients. Lay the nori, flat side down, on the nori sheets. With one edge of the nori closest to you, roll it out to the thickness and width of the nori sheet. Place a second edge of the nori over the top and roll into a tube shape. Repeat with the remaining nori. Slice in half widthways. Cut into 1 cm/1 inch slices with a long, thin sharp knife, cut the slices from the nori using a vegetable peeler. Serve on a bed of cooked spaghetti, arranging as desired with spicy or chutney.

title: Simple Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs beef top round steaks | 1/2 cup white flour or 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon rosemary | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Place the steaks in a dutch oven or other heavy saucepan.. Combine the flour and rosemary. Drench the steaks in the flour and rosemary mixture. Pour the chicken broth and any liquid into the dutch oven. Cover and simmer on medium low heat for 2 hours, periodically checking and turning steaks. Do not add any water during cooking time. Remove steaks to a platter and keep warm for service. Strain the cooking liquid, and then return the liquid to the dutch oven and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the liquid has reduced to a thick sauce. The broth should be reduced by about 1/. Taste and adjust seasonings. Cut the steak across the grain into thin slices, about 1/2 inch wide. You want enough of each piece to cover the meat if not using all the fat. Add a few tablespoons of the cooking liquid to the sauce and reheat to desired temperature. Serve with the remaining sauce and steaks.

title: Apricot Spaghetti and Rice
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise and seeded | 1/4 pound ground veal | 1 can apricots, drained and cut in half | 1 1/2 cups uncooked hot cooked rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place spaghetti squash halves cut side up onto a baking dish. Bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, or until tender. Stir the ground veal into the baking dish. Place apricots into a saucepan over medium high heat, and heat until heated through. Spoon apricots and their liquid into a bowl, and stir to combine. Stir the contents of the saucepan into the cooked squash, and pour the vegetable and vegetable mixture into a 2 quart baking dish. Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes to heat through. Garnish with apricots to serve.

Random Ingredients: white raisin,ginger juice,farfalle pasta,coriander root,vodka,thai basil
title: Coriander Pasta With Ginger Wine Reduction
ingredients: 350 g farfalle pasta | 1 1/2 cups white raisins | 1 1/2 cups dark aged vodka ( or more ) | 3 -4 teaspoons grated ginger juice ( fresh ginger is not the easiest, but if you don't mind ginger, go for it ) | 10 sprigs fresh coriander roots, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thai basil or 1 tablespoon fresh parsley
instructions: Cook pasta in rapidly boiling water for 12 minutes, or until al dente. Drain pasta, discarding any excess water and set aside. Meanwhile, heat oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Add ginger and sauté stirring constantly for 2 - 3 minutes, or until fragrant. Remove from heat and crush slightly with a mortar and pestle, or using a spoon. Add the crushed ginger to pan and cook for 1 - 2 minutes. Add wine and raisins. Stir, scraping up the caramelized bits accumulating from the bottom of the pan, until the liquid is reduced by half. Add the basil, or parsley and stir. Pour over the cooked pasta and toss well. Serve.

title: Char Siu Diao (Charcoal Pasta With Scented Fresh Fusilli)
ingredients: 250 g fusilli | 1 1 bunch rocket | 1/2 cup balsamic balsamic black soy sauce | 1 large free range lemonspoon free aceto amarula leaf
instructions: Simmer the pasta in plenty of salty salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, until just tender. Meanwhile, pre heat griller, then spray with olive oil. Cook the rocket for 2 minutes. Drain well and divide between 4 dinner plates. Whisk together the balsamic black soy sauce and aceto amarula leaves and pour over the pasta and Rocket. Serve at once.

title: Shrimp Filling for Pierogi Pritters
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 8 ounces frozen mixed salad shrimp, thawed | 1 tablespoon half-and-half | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed according to package directions | toothpick, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Butter a baking sheet. Combine zucchini, cheddar cheese, salad shrimp, half and half, and pastry sheets on baking sheet. If pastry sheet is not completely covered spread filling evenly over half of each pastry sheet. Bake pritters 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are lightly browned. Serve immediately. Note, prepare by placing pastry sheets in a plastic bag.

title: Mexican Trout
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs whole trout fillets | 2 tablespoons chopped onion | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons rose water | 1 small tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine onion, chiles, rose water, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl. Place trout fillets on broiler rack and arrange in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Broil trout 4 inches from heat until beginning to flake, about 4 minutes for medium rare, 6 minutes for medium. Top fish with the onion mixture, and broil 5 minutes. Spoon tomato halves over fish.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya,sea salt black pepper,triple sec,stewing beef,rice vinegar,celery rib,vidalia onion
title: Beef & Rice Adobo over Rice
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb chuck roast, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 1/2 cup triple sec | 2 tablespoons dried minced vidalia onions | 1 teaspoon sazon goya ( mccormick's seasoned salt ) | sea salt and black pepper, to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons toasted rice vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice vinegar in crock pot in to crock. Cover crock pot and mix well. Cook on high for 5 hours or on low for 8 hours. Turn off crock pot and stir well. Allow to stand, covered for approximately 2 hours before serving. Note, to toast rice, put it on a cookie sheet or in a large dry skillet. Toast at 350 for 10 minutes, then set aside to cool. Note, do not stir while it is cooling that is a draining process. Place rice on a large platter or with tongs. Surround it with the baggy, baguette slices and the other preferred accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: ranch bean,pork loin,spanish onion,tea,red chilies,red pepper flake
title: Mexican Beans
ingredients: 2 cans ranch style beans | 1/4 pound pork loin, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 8 ounces spanish onions, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 12 ounces hot smoked barbeque sauce, or as needed | 1 large red chilies, sliced thinly
instructions: Drain beans and place in a slow cooker. Toss pork, onion, red pepper flakes and hot barbeque sauce with beans, and cover. Cook on high setting for 3 hours. Remove pork and onion from slow cooker and set aside. Place chilies and pork on a clean platter or large baking sheet and warm in the microwave for about 30 seconds. Drizzle with marinade and serve.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,nonfat cream,garlic salt,black pepper,farfalle pasta
title: Nedi Kebabs by Andrew Blake
ingredients: 250 g farfalle pasta | 300 g kidney beans ( drained canned kidney beans ) | 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Boil farfalle in a medium saucepan of water until al dente. Drain well. Meanwhile, finely dice beans and add to a food processor or blender. Add a little of the sour cream, the black pepper and spices so the beans are combined well. Add the beans. Add the rest of the sour cream and pulse until smooth and creamy. Add hot pasta. Blend until well combined and pour into an ovenproof dish or tin lined with silicone paper. Bake at 200°c for 30 minutes until warm and bubbly.

title: Homemade Marinade for Fajitas
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot sauce | 2 tablespoons basil | 4 tablespoons dried marjoram | 2 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Combine hot sauce, basil, marjoram and salt in container of blender. Puree until it is smooth.

title: Broccoli and Banana Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup marinated artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup frozen cut broccoli, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup cut banana
instructions: Combine artichoke hearts, broccoli, and sliced banana in a large bowl. Add the dressing.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,beefsteak tomato,red chilies,pumpkin puree,white chocolate,jalapeno pepper,monterey jack cheese
title: Mexican Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 24 ounces beefsteak tomatoes or 24 ounces stewing tomatoes | 12 ounces canned whole canned pumpkin puree or 12 ounces tomato puree | 8 ounces white chocolate, melted | 2 jalapeno peppers, julienned | 8 large fresh asparagus, stems removed | 2 cans sliced jalapeno peppers, drained ( optional ) | 4 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cut a slit in each tomato half. Place tomatoes in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Pour pumpkin puree over the tomatoes. Bake at 450f for 20 minutes or until the tomatoes are soft. Combine the melted jalapenos with asparagus, jalapeno peppers, remaining pumpkin mixture and cheese. Place in oven for 5 munutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 french baguette
instructions: Cut the tops off the eggplants and score them lengthwise. Preheat oven to 375°f brush with a little olive oil, and sprinkle with the five spice. Put the eggplants into a roasting pan, and roast in the oven for 45 to 60 minutes, or until the tops are well browned. In a bowl, mix together mayonnaise and season with salt to taste. Slice the baguette into 1/2 inch slices, and spread both sides with mayonnaise mixture. Turn over the eggplants, and bake in the oven for 30 to 35 minutes, until they are tender and the bread is crusty.

Random Ingredients: lard,pesto sauce,green olive,vanilla extract,white bread,beef brisket
title: Pesto Crock Pot Brisket
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb of fresh beef brisket or 1/2-3/4 lb prime rib roast | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 7 ounces prepared pesto sauce | 1 cup of sliced green olives | 8 slices white bread, crusts trimmed ( italian or french bread ) | 2 tablespoons lard, melted
instructions: Trim meat of any fat, membrane and tendoniness, and place in a slow cooker. Pound meat until it is about 1/4 inch thick, 1/2 inch thick and 5 or 6 times throughout. In a small bowl, mix the vanilla with half of the pesto. Spread the pesto mixture over both sides and top with the meat. Cover and cook on low all day. Transfer meat to a platter. Skim off excess fat. Toast the bread and spread each side with a thin coating of butter. Divide the cooked meat between 4 shallow serving plates. Spoon the olives, topped with a few croutons and a drizzle of the melted lard. Serve with fresh french bread.

title: Linguine With Mustard Seeds and Kalamata Olives
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine, cooked al dente | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds, coarsely crushed | 1 kalamata olive
instructions: Cook the linguine as directed on package. Combine the mustard seeds and olives. Top with the mustard and olive mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,brussels sprout,bologna,vanilla extract,onion powder,mozzarella cheese,yellow pepper,fine sea salt
title: Bologna, Brussels Sprouts and Peppers
ingredients: 2 lbs brussels sprouts, trimmed and cut in half | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, cut in 1 1/2-inch thick slices | 2 medium onions, cut in half | 2 ounces bologna, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon mild vanilla extract | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1/2 teaspoon dried fine sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 1/2 cups vegan goat cheese or 1 1/2 cups vegan greek feta cheese
instructions: Set aside 1/2 the Brussels sprouts for topping. Use remaining sprouts to make bologna, and set aside with peppers. Prepare grill or broiler and lightly oil grate. Toss brussels sprouts and vegetables with remaining marinade ingredients and let marinate for 20 minutes. Cut reserved brussels sprouts into pieces slightly smaller than brussels sprouts, and set aside. Prepare broiler rack, and heat until hot. Arrange brussels sprouts on hot baking sheet in single layer. Broil brussels sprouts and vegetables, brushing with reserved marinade, until golden brown, and crisp, 12 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,head cabbage,yukon gold potato,bamboo skewer,fennel seed,steak,tea,sea salt
title: Beef and Pearl Onigiri (Korean Beef and Pearl Onigiri)
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 4 tablespoons tequila | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 head of cabbage, shredded | 12 bamboo skewers | 1 1/2 cups grand marnier | 1 large yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into 1-inch wedges
instructions: Trim steak and cut across the grain into thirds across the grain. Cut each piece diagonally at 1/4 inch intervals. Combine 1 tablespoon tequila, salt and fennel seed in shallow glass bowl, turning to coat. Add beef, turn to coat, let stand 30 min. To prepare soup, stir together cabbage, steak, grand marnier and potato. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Preheat grill to high. Remove beef and set aside to warm. Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium rare, or 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium well. To serve, mound beef into bowl, garnish with mint and onion and serve with remaining soup.

Random Ingredients: pickling salt,mexican cheese,pork loin roast,ro tel tomato,green chilies,beef broth,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cheese
title: Rick Bayless' Hot Pork Roulades
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork loin roast, tied | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes ( mexican tomatoes with green chilies, with cilantro ) | 1 can chopped green chilies | 2 tablespoons pickling salt | 1/4 - 1/2 cup beef broth ( depending on desired level of liquidiness ) | 1 -2 cup shredded mexican cheese or 1 -2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Set the pot to a slow boil on high heat and pour in two quarts of water. Add the pork loin and let come to a simmer or about 15 - 20 minutes. Remove pork and reserve the liquid. Pour out all the juices and set aside. Using a slotted spoon or a sharp knife, remove the pork. Let sit for about 10 minutes, then pull the meat out and discard the liquid. You can keep the liquid but it will likely be salty. You want it salty enough to have some salty flavor that the meat tastes salty enough. You may remove enough to remove liquid to equal 4 cups. Slice, if desired, the pork and set aside. Add the can of ro tel tomatoes to the reserved liquid that the pork left in the jar has drained. Add one can of chopped chilies. If adding shredded meat, add more salt. Set heat to high and let come to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to simmer and add broth and simmer until tender, stirring occasionally. You should have about 4 cups depending on the thickness of pork. Place shredded pork with chilies back in sauce and cook until most liquid has evaporated. Remove from heat and stir in shredded cheese and reserved liquid.. Serve in hot flour tortillas with desired toppings. This is delicious on your tortilla or with cheese and hot beans over steamed rice.

title: Ganache
ingredients: 1/2 cup porridge oats | 1 zucchini | 15 sheets phyllo dough | 1 1/2 cups grated zucchini
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees Celcius. Toast oats in a dry fry pan, tossing regularly. When they are a light golden brown colour, take them out and pour onto baking paper lined tray. Cut zucchini into slices about one third of an inch thick. Cook under grill if possible for only a minute, or until lightly golden. Place the oat mixture on a board and roll it out using an 8 inch biscuit cutter, dipped one third in flour, and cut the rolled out biscuit into 10 - 3 squares. Place on baking trays lined with pastry cloth and sprinkle with grated zucchini. Spoon more of the oat mixture in between the squares, to form a nice circle. Place the tray with the ganache onto a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 10 minutes, or until the ganache starts to set. Cut into wedges and serve as a side dish with meats, salads, and breads.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,summer squash,sesame oil,parmesan cheese,worcestershire sauce,cantaloupe,green lentil
title: Lentil and Beef Tenderloin With Veggies
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 cup green lentil, rinsed | 1 large summer squash, halved, deseeded, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup cantaloupe, cut in 1-inch dice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place beef tenderloin on a rack in a foil lined baking sheet and drizzle with worcestershire sauce.

Random Ingredients: pam cooking spray,dijon mustard,white wine,greek olive,tomato puree,green bell pepper,chocolate,red pepper sauce
title: Olive and Pepper Panini Fajitas
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon red hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon smooth pure tomato puree | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup red roasted red pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons finely chopped greek olives, drained | 8 large ripe greek olives, cut into wedges | pam cooking spray
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Grilled Whole-Seed Flank Steak
ingredients: 16 large garlic cloves | 1 1/2 cups fine sea salt, divided | 8 fresh peppercorns
instructions: Pound each clove of garlic with the flat of a chef's mallet to a coarse paste. Add 1/2 cup coarse sea salt and 1 teaspoon whole dried peppercorns. Mix to form a firm, smooth paste. Use a pastry brush to coat each clove tightly. Place on a heavy duty foil lined grill rack and grill over medium heat until the skin blackens to a rich, reddish brown color.

Random Ingredients: date,dark chocolate,walnut oil,red chilies,rice,vanilla bean,broccoli floret,cream
title: Chocolate Steamed Chinese Broccoli With Dates
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 4 large dried red chilies ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup walnut oil ( or more to taste ) | 3 large ripe dates ( to taste, preferably chanterelles ) | 2 tablespoons rice, not chinese peppercorn rice cooking water ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream ( low-fat, low-fat or nonfat ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil.. Drop in frozen broccoli spears a minute shy of last minute. When broccoli has blanched to your liking, remove from heat. Drain broccoli. Remove stems and seeds. Slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place broccoli on a plate with kitchen towels on top. Place chiles in a small bowl and pour boiling water over them. Let drain to remove excess water. Place chiles in strainer and squeeze water into bowl with chile. Place chile in a small sauce pan with walnut oil. When oil is warm, add dates and remove from heat. Pour hot walnut oil in small bowl into oil and allow to come to temperature. If using a nonfat sour cream, stir well and add to walnut oil. Add vanilla bean, and stir until combined. Pour mixture onto steamed broccoli. Serve immediately.

title: Rhubarb Chutney
ingredients: 500 g rhubarb | 1 big big onion | 4 chopped red chilies | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 3 liters stock
instructions: Wash, peel and chop the rhubarb very fine. Peel, dice onion and chillies. Heat in a pan with a tight lid for 2 minutes, and then add the chopped rhubarb. Leave on low heat until the rhubarb is soft and the liquid is reduced. Add salt, and cook for a few minutes until reduced again. Leave to cool off, then store in the fridge, if using a food container, although i use the same amount of time to measure. This chutney freezes very well.

title: Pistachio Soup
ingredients: 1 cup pistachios | 300 ml chicken stock | romano cheese, grated | fresh ice, crushed
instructions: Toast pistachios with skin on for 3 to 4 minutes, remove skin but leave pistachios in for 10 minutes. Cut pistachios to 1/4 inch thickness. Bring chicken stock to boil. Add pistachios, cheese and pistachios and return to boil. When soup is almost ready, stir gently.

title: Gruyere Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces gruyere cheese, finely grated | 1 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients. Transfer to a serving dish lined with plastic wrap, and serve at room temperature.

title: Butter Beer Can Chicken
ingredients: 2 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can butterscotch chips | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in large baking dish combine tomato sauce, butterscotch chips, and cilantro. Add chicken to the sauce and bake, uncovered, 20 minutes or until chicken is done.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,cherry pepper,bulb garlic,chickpea,black bean,veal cutlet
title: Veal With Black Beans and Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb veal cutlet, about 3/4 inch thick, cut crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices, about 3/4 inch wide | kosher salt | 1 tablespoon dried black beans, rinsed | 1 tablespoon cherry peppers, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed | 3 teaspoons finely minced garlic ( bottled or homemade )
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 550 degrees f & place rack in middle position. Line a heavy rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and set aside. Brush cutlets with kosher salt and spread slices out on baking sheet. Bake until lightly charred, 8 to 10 minutes & transfer cutlets to a clean plate. Rinse beans briefly and drain well on paper towels. Arrange beans and cherry peppers in center of 4 large plates. Arrange veal over beans, then sprinkle garlic over all and then top with 1/2 tsp salt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,penne pasta,rice,italian sausage link,mandarin orange,grape tomato,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Cajun Sausage Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage links | 3 cups cooked penne pasta ( i use dreamfields ) | 2 cups grape tomatoes ( can use more... i use the ones that are sweeter, but i prefer the fresh ) | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and thinly sliced, reserving juice | 1 -2 serrano chili, minced | 1 bunch of shredded colby-monterey jack cheese, divided
instructions: Cut links in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1/2 inch dice. Cook pasta until tender. Drain and set aside. Heat sausage over medium heat until browned. Remove from heat and set aside. Add tomatoes, reserved juice, chilies, and reserved juice from oranges. Simmer for 15 minutes or until heated through. Combine cheese and pasta. Add sausage, tomato mixture, and reserved oranges. Serve warm or at room temperature. Note, my family also loves them over linguine, but you can roll them up in your hand. Note, i can add the oranges right in the pan, because of the grape tomatoes and the chilies.

title: Homemade Freezer and Freezing Cream
ingredients: 1 pint whipping cream | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( optional )
instructions: In a 3 quart metal container. In the container add whipping cream, fenugreek seeds, and 1 - 2 teaspoons salt/paneer. Shake container or shake container well. Freeze about 2 months. At the start of the freezing process, you should be able to get pretty good ice cream in the freezer or your ice cream cooler. When serving, you need to let the container rest in the freezer for around 3 - 4 hours. Remove from freezer once the container is thawed and a creamy texture, if desired, and add additional salt/paneer if desired. If you have the time to do this, let the container sit at room temperature for about 15 - 15 minutes before attempting to cut with your knife. Note, the fenugreek can be made with plain yogurt which tastes like sour cream, or more cheese, according to tastes. Note, you may need to thaw to serve. Note, do not use powdered milk. This can vary from store to store, depending on if you are trying to thaw the container first and setting your oven on to warm or not. The freezer makes a huge difference in the texture of your freezer. You do not want a yogurt freezer. Freezer preparation, freeze the fenugreek container well and remove as much air as possible from the container and container. Freeze all the liquid in a plastic container. When the container is solid, transfer to a storage container or freezer container. You can leave it frozen for up to 5 months. It will help to get rid of all remaining air that was in the container. Using a mixer, whip the fenugreek until it is somewhat smooth. Stir in 2 tablespoons sugar and add 2 tablespoons melted butter. This can also be frozen. You can also store fenugreek yogurt in the fridge for up to 2 months.

title: Aloo Ki Dal (Potato Dal With Turmeric)
ingredients: 3 small red potatoes ( kadai, halved ) | 1 teaspoon red turmeric powder
instructions: Pre heat oven to 175c/200°f. Remove skin from potatoes and cut into very small pieces leaving about 2cm of potato uncoated or at least 1cm of thick potato.. Place potato pieces on an oiled baking tray. Cut the remaining potatoes into 5cm cubes and place in a bowl. Sprinkle a little turmeric powder, 1tsp of water and 1tsp sugar in to the potatoes. Place tray in oven and turn heat down to 180c/350f. Cook for about 30 mins or until the potatoes are browned and tender.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,corn kernel,yellow bell pepper,farfalle pasta
title: Beef and Fusilli With Roasted Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, trimmed | 12 ounces dried farfalle pasta | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1 can corn kernels, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray. Combine beef and 1 tsp corn oil in a 2 - 3 quart casserole large enough to hold ingredients. Sprinkle with pepper. Top with pasta. Pour remaining 1 tsp oil over beef. Roast 15 - 20 minutes, turning once, until thermometer registers 130°f for stirfry, or just until no longer pink inside.

title: Pasta With Garlic and Cloves
ingredients: 25 lbs whole bulbs of garlic | 14 lbs pasta ( i prefer small whole bulbs ) | 6 lbs cloves, whole. crushed
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Drop in the whole garlic heads and boil for 15 minutes. Drain, cool and chop. Cover with very cold water, and soak for approximately 3 days. Drain again and place in a very large saucepan. Cover the garlic with very hot water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Drain thoroughly and set aside for at least 5 days. Remove from water and place the whole cloves into a heat proof skillet. Drain the jars in 2 changes of cold water, and set aside. Bring a generous 2 1/2 quarts of salted water to a boil, add in the pasta and cook for approximately 8 to 10 minutes. Drain pasta and then put into a large mixing bowl. Add in the drained garlic cloves, 1 teaspoon of salt, and half of the freshly ground black pepper. Mix it all up. Toss in the drained pasta a little at a time until the pasta becomes an aschidish paste. The garlic should look sort of translucent after a few minutes. Taste about the garlic seasonings, and adjust the amount of garlic as desired.

Random Ingredients: beef,tamari,pepperoni,garlic,pigeon pea,maraschino cherry,cranberry,thai red curry paste
title: Athai Party Dip
ingredients: 1 jar dried cranberries | 1 pound ground beef | 2 packages pepperoni | 2 teaspoons dried maraschino cherries, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed dried chipotle peppers in adobo, or to taste | 1 tablespoon minced garlic, or to taste | 4 tablespoons thai red curry paste, or to taste | 1/3 cup tamari, or to taste
instructions: Cover a 9x5 inch loaf pan with a damp cloth, and set aside. Place dried cranberries in a saucepan, and fill almost to the top with water. Bring to a boil, and boil 5 minutes, or until cranberries are tender. Drain the water, and set aside to cool. Place ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until evenly browned. Season with pepperjack pepperoni, maraschino cherries, chipotle peppers in adobo, garlic, and curry paste. Spread the mixture into the prepared loaf pan. Cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 25 minutes, or until beef is done. Garnish with tamari.

title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb corkscrew macaroni | 1 bunch fresh thai basil ( cilantro )
instructions: Cook about 3/4 1 pound of the noodles in 3 - 4 quarts of boiling water until al dente. Drain and add the basil to the salad and toss. Serve immediately. Note, to save the time for another meal, you can use half and half cream. The taste is much better the next day.

title: Peelee Peaches in Champagne Jelly
ingredients: 4 ripe peaches, peeled ( can substitute any peach of your choice. ) | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 2 tablespoons browning sauce | 3 -5 tablespoons paprika
instructions: Peel the peaches, remove the pits, and cut up into small cubes. In a small saucepan, pour the madeira and the madeira and bring to a boil. Add browning and paprika, then add the peaches. Add wine. Cook for 5 minutes. Place in sterilized bottles and store in the freezer. This can be eaten right away, or the longer it is stored, the better the flavor.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,vegetable juice,lemon juice,cottage cheese,fennel seed,fruit,coconut
title: Italian Sausage With Fruit Curd
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 tablespoons vegetable juice | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 cup mashed drained canned fruit | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 1/4 cups shredded desiccated coconut
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large non stick frying pan and brown over medium heat. Cover, reduce heat and simmer gently until fruit just starts to soften. Turn off heat and stir until liquid and sausage are fully cooked. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,monterey jack cheese,cashew half,orange juice,eggplant
title: Guilt-Free, Low-Carb, Baked Eggplant and Cashew Squits
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes | 1 eggplant ( fresh or unpeeled, about 1 pound ) | 16 cashew halves, roughly broken | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 tablespoon orange juice, more if you wish | grated parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a shallow baking pan with parchment paper or reynolds wrap on baking sheet. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, then stir in the potatoes and whole eggplant. Return the pot of potatoes to a boil, then cook for about 45 minutes, or until tender. Drain, then let cool slightly. Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise. Grate the zest and discard the yellow flesh of the potato. Cut the potato flesh into 3/4 inch cubes. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Line a baking sheet with heavy duty aluminum foil. Place potatoes in the boiling water, then gently slip them into the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Hold the bowl in the water, then turn on the processor. Hold the bowl in the water for a second 30 - 45 seconds, then turn it over. Hold the bowl in the water just long enough to get the potatoes into the skillet. Holding a cashew half by its rounded edge and with a rough blade that you scraped and scraped out of the skin, slide it into the skillet. Using the back side of a knife, make several slits in the top of the yukon gold potatoes so they will stick. Place the yukon gold potato chips directly onto the hot baking sheet, then immediately sprinkle the zest over the potatoes. Bake the chips for 10 minutes, then top with the remaining cashew halves. Bake for another 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and crispy. Remove the baking sheet from the oven, then cool on a rack. Continue with the oven until all the chips are baked or cut into pieces, adding the cheese right before serving, then top the chips with additional cheese before serving.

title: Faux Bistro Black Cod and Squash Rollups
ingredients: 20 g firm sushi grade bicarbonate soda | 15 g imitation thick'fish flavored tuna packed in oil, undrained | 20 g spaghetti squash | 3 sheets nori | 2 tablespoons tapioca starch | 50 g prepared whipped topping, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Using a basting brush, apply 1 tbsp imitation fat to the base of a baking tray and lightly spray with some vegetable oil spray. Use basting brush to spray the top of a baking sheet with some vegetable oil spray. Pierce bamboo skewers in a few places and then score a piece of flesh into 5 cm rounds. Combine the tuna with the bicarbonate soda, spaghetti squash and nori sheets and arrange these ingredients down the length of the bamboo skewers. Sprinkle top of rolls with 1 tbsp tapioca starch, cover with aluminium foil and put in the oven for 20 mins. Uncover and roll the bamboo skewers in the tapioca starch until they are fully coated. Set aside to cool. Serve topped with additional sweetened whipped topping if desired.

Random Ingredients: jicama,mexican chocolate,confectioner ' sugar,chipotle powder,heavy cream,savory,extra virgin olive oil,brown rice
title: Chipotle-Stuffed Jicama
ingredients: 1/2 cup mexican chocolate, roughly chopped ( or chocolate of your choice ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 pinch dried chipotle powder | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 jicama, peeled deveined cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 dash epazote savory | 1 tablespoon finely chopped seeded jicama | 1/2 cup instant brown rice, uncooked, about 4 servings ( can use instant white rice if your brand is not available )
instructions: In a medium saucepan over low heat, melt together chocolate, cream, confectioners' sugar, chile powder, oil, and 1/4 cup water, until smooth and simmering. Remove from heat and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together reserved chocolate mixture, jicama and savory. Using a pastry blender, cut jicama into 1/2 inch wide strips. Divide the chocolate mixture among the four ramekins. Pour enough hot water in a 9 in skillet to reach a depth of 1 inch, place over high heat and heat until the water just starts to boil. Remove from heat. Drop a large spoonful into the skillet, 2 at a time, then the jicama will float to the surface. Cook until crisp, about 2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels or waxed paper. Repeat with remaining jicama and cookies. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,flour tortilla,red pepper,parsnip,red onion,kidney bean,vinegar
title: Barbeque Vegetable Chips
ingredients: 1 flour tortillas or 1 corn tortilla | 1 cup shredded carrot & parsnip | 1/2 cup canned kidney beans or 2 1/2 ounces drained can white kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup shredded red onion | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red peppers | 2 tablespoons seasoned barbeque sauce | 2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Lay tortilla on a cookie sheet. In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients and spread one tablespoon of mixture over each tortilla. Broil tortilla for 2 to 3 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Top with remaining tortilla and serve.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,peach,nonfat plain yogurt,red chili,lime juice
title: Guilt Peach Dip
ingredients: 1 mangoes - peeled, pitted and diced | 1 jar chopped peaches, juice reserved | 1 1/4 cups nonfat plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 dry red chili
instructions: Combine mango, peaches, yogurt, caraway seeds, and chile in a food processor or blender. Process to desired consistency, adding reserved peach juice if you need to, according to desired consistency.

title: Pasta With Jam and Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb raspberries or 1 lb golden raisin | 1 lb pasta | 2 tablespoons fish oil | 20 ounces raspberry jam
instructions: Boil pasta until cooked. Strain the sauce. Put the raisins in a bowl with warm water to cover. Soften them slightly then squeeze them. Mix the raspberry jam and sugar together. Drain the pasta and add it to the jar. Add the raisins and ramekins along with some of the hot sauce. Toss to coat with the jam. Serve immediately, or leave to cool.

title: Stir Fried Zucchini and Yellow Squash Stir Fry in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 large yellow squash, thinly sliced | 2 zucchini, halved lengthways, cut into 1cm slices
instructions: Stir fry the squash, zucchini, oil, oyster sauce, half the spring onions for 3 minutes, or until just tender. Transfer to serving dish, and sprinkle with remaining spring onions.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,greek yogurt,rigatoni pasta,cream chicken soup,egg white,corn tortilla chip
title: Rigatoni and Greek Yogurt Cheese Chicken Chips
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta or ( 16 ounce ) box rotelle pasta, broken into 3/4 to 1 inch pieces | 1 lb frozen chopped onion flakes | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 large egg whites, beaten | 1 cup greek yogurt | corn tortilla chips or dried pimento-stuffed french bread rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Combine pasta, onion flakes, soup and egg whites in large bowl. Add greek yogurt and mix until smooth. Pour into ungreased 13x9 inch baking dish.. Sprinkle lightly with salt and bake 20 to 25 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Serve with corn chips or french bread rounds.

title: Chinese Spicy Pecans
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely ground pecans | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix together the pecans and 1/2 cup of sugar. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the nut mixture onto the center of the pecan mixture, and spread evenly. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Cool, then drizzle remaining 1 tablespoon of honey over nuts before serving.

title: Granita's Famous Citrus Creme
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( or kosher salt ) | 1 teaspoon triple sec | 1/2 orange, juice of
instructions: Pour the orange juice all over the orange. Squeeze the orange and the juice to get all around the oranges. Sprinkle the salt onto the mix. Use your hands to mix with your hands, and let the mix get sticky for a few minutes. Pour into an ice cream maker and freeze. Once solid, serve and eat with lots of crackers on the side.

title: Stuffed Chili Capsicum
ingredients: 3 anaheim chili ( capsicums ) | 300 grams dates ( diced pitted ) | 250 g coriander leaves, chopped ( cilantro leaves )
instructions: Remove stems from Capsicums. Cut out the seeds from the capsicums. Remove the cores by pressing a sharp knife through the membrane. Scoop out the seeds with the spoon. Place the chilies over boiling water of salted water. Boil until tender. Drain. Remove seeds with a teaspoon and reserve. Place capsicums, dates and 2 tbsp of the chopped coriander on a clean tea towel. Fold over the capsicums to create a capsicum shape. Spoon the remaining coriander into a clean bowl. Squeeze handfuls of water from the stem and discard the stem. Gently fold in the capsicum. Spoon the remainder of the coriander, date pieces and a little water into a serving bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with bread for an evening snack or meal.

title: Brazilian Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 2 cups tomato puree ( passata ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 cups shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Bring the rice and tomato puree to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove lid and continue cooking, covered, until heated through. Sprinkle with cocoa and shredded provolone cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,coriander,strawberry,ice water,wooden skewer,vegetable oil cooking spray,italian dressing
title: Strawberry Pickle Appetizer
ingredients: 2 packages frozen sliced strawberries ( about 3 1/3 cups ) | 4 tablespoons italian dressing, divided ( bottled or bottled ) | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh coriander or 4 teaspoons cilantro | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup crushed ice water | 1 bag dill pickle slices | crushed ice water, if needed
instructions: Place defrosted sliced strawberries on a serving platter with 1 tablespoon dressing and 1 teaspoon coriander and 1/4 teaspoon cilantro. Cover and chill in refrigerator about 30 minutes. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Drain strawberries, reserving liquid, and place 1 tablespoon dressing and chopped coriander in a small bowl and toss to coat. Chill another 2 - 3 minutes. Arrange 1 cup crushed ice cubes on the sheet of pickle. Place 2 pieces of the chilled strawberry and 1 tablespoon dressing and 1 teaspoon coriander in a mound on the drizzle with 1/4 cup crushed ice cubes. Top with 1 tablespoon remaining crushed ice cubes. Cut in half with serrated edge of a knife. Serve.

title: Sauerkraut & Herb Lasagna
ingredients: 250 g sauerkraut | 450 g lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs | fresh sage leaf, to garnish
instructions: Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil. Add sausage and noodles and cook, stirring occasionally, for 8 - 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Place sauerkraut on a plate and coat with breadcrumbs. Sprinkle the sauerkraut with sage and bake in a preheated oven for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,mustard powder,chili garlic sauce,mustard seed
title: Chinese Glaze Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups mustard powder | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or indoor grill. Combine mustard powder, chili garlic sauce, mustard seed and salmon filets in a large bowl. Massage this over your choice of meat. Coat grill with oil. Grill salmon 3 to 5 minutes per side or until just white throughout.

title: Pistachio Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons chives, snipped | 1/4 cup roasted pistachios, chopped | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/8 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Cook over low heat to soften. Sauce may be made up to one day in advance.

title: Bourbon Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cup good quality bourbon | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mild salsa
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large fry pan and stir over medium high heat until hot and bubbly. Cover pan with plastic wrap and keep warm over low heat. Best served immediately.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,curd cottage cheese,grenadine,asparagus,red pepper sauce
title: Spicy Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1/2 cup chopped fresh asparagus | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon grenadine
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Pink Mexican Pie
ingredients: 1 can pink lemonade | 2 -3 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 graham cracker, for plating ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large pie pan. Mix well. Cover with foil. Bake at 425 degrees for 25 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Kuwaiti  Sweet Chili & Preserved Lemons
ingredients: 6 serrano chili | 2 cups stock cubes | 1 kg brown sugar | 1/2 saffron
instructions: Heat up the saffron in a cup or saucepan until it just starts to crackle. Remove the saffron threads using a spoon. Heat the juice and saffron in the same skillet over low heat until the liquid is starting to boil. Add the sugar, heat until it starts to melt, take off the heat and pour over the saffron and sugar. Leave this to cool. Cut into small pieces and transfer to a bowl, cover tightly and leave it overnight. Remove the chili pods before serving.

title: Cocoa Herb Chili Powder for Canning Beer Canner
ingredients: 4 tablespoons flour | 1 ounce onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1 teaspoon cilantro, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup cilantro, coarsely chopped | 12 dashes pepper, a dash
instructions: Heat the canning funnel in canner over medium high heat. Dry the canner by dipping a metal spoon into boiling water for 30 - 45 seconds, or dip the canner into water and immediately remove from the canner. Remove the canner from the canner if it starts to crack around the edges. Place the canner on its metal blade and fill a 5l canning funnel about halfway up the canning funnel. Carefully place the funnel back onto the canner and fill about half full. Let the canner stand until the canner reaches full pressure, 10 to 15 minutes if using an automatic canning funnel. Adjust the heat if necessary so the canner continues to heat and does not splatter. Use quick release method favored by the manufacturer. Makes 12 dashes of chili powder.

title: Fig Jam  (Walnut Jam)
ingredients: 8 slices dried figs, pricked all over | 1 1/2 cups walnuts, chopped
instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan, and add the figs. Cover, and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Stir frequently to prevent sticking. Remove from the heat, and let stand for 10 minutes. Place the chopped walnuts in a small bowl, pour the syrup over them, and stir until well coated. Cover, and let stand until all the nuts are coated.

title: Lentil and Pork Stew
ingredients: 1 lb pork, cubes | 1/4 cup dried lentils, rinsed | 1 can cannellini beans | 2 3/4 cups chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Place ingredients in bottom of 3 quart stock pan. Simmer uncovered for 1 hour. Add meat. Simmer for 1 hour more, serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,cider vinegar,almond paste,russet potato,ziti pasta
title: Macrobiotic Ziti
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled | 1 lb ziti pasta ( bow-tie ) | 10 ounces almond paste | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Grate the potato and place into a 2 to 3 quart slow cooker. Trim the ends off the ziti and cut into 1 1/2 inch chunks then place in the slow cooker. Drain and rinse the pasta under cold water, then let it sit in the hot pan with the potatoes. Sprinkle the almonds onto the ziti, tossing to coat them well. Pour the almond paste and vinegar into the slow cooker and stir well. Pour the pasta mixture over the ziti and stir again. Set the cooker to low and let it cook at least 8 hours, or up to 12 hours. Before serving, stir and taste for salt and pepper.

title: Sesame seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sesame seeds | 1 cup chopped green chili | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Place the sesame seeds in a single layer on an ungreased baking sheet and toast in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Toast the sesame seeds for 5 minutes more, or until lightly roasted. While the seeds are cooling, grind the chilies in a spice mill or mortar and pestle. Remove and discard the seeds from the baking sheet. Heat olive oil in a saute pan over medium heat. Add the toasted sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: sherry,cooking oil,colby cheese,pineapple juice,tomato green chilies,cherry tomato,french onion soup
title: Hot Fruity French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 can condensed french onion soup, undiluted | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, drained | 1/2 cup grated colby cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup dry sherry or 1/4 cup picante sauce | cherry tomatoes ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat cooking oil until hot in a 5 quart slow cooker. Add chopped soup, tomatoes, pineapple juice, cheese, and sherry. Cover, and cook on high 6 hours, or on low 3 - 4 hours, or to desired consistency.

title: Risotto Balls With Parsley (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups risotto rice ( see note ) | 2 1/2 cm piece flat-leaf italian parsley, leaves picked from stems | 3 1/2 cm cube cornflour
instructions: Place rice in rice cooker. Stir in 2 teaspoons cornflour and the parsley. Dollop onto a lightly floured surface and use your thumb to gently push and roll to form a 3cm thick round. Arrange on a lightly loured baking tray and refrigerate until set about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cornflour and then press lightly. Bake on a baking tray in the oven at 190° for 15 minutes or until just golden, taking care not to burn. Transfer to a wire rack to cool. Serve warm, dusted with icing sugar.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Bananas
ingredients: 2 -3 bananas, cut into long, thin slices ( depending on the size ) | 2 -3 tablespoons maple syrup ( depends on how sweet you want them ) | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved into | 1 cup broth ( depends on how much liquid you have ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon-sugar blend ( optional )
instructions: Boil the beef boullion cube for a few minutes to dissolve. Immediately add the banana slices in to the sauce, cover and let simmer on low heat for about 5 - 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon, stir and serve.

title: Peanuts Beef
ingredients: 1 beef chuck, trimmed | 2 ounces raisins | 4 ounces cashews | 1 tablespoon triple sec or 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 4 fluid ounces sparkling water, to taste | 4 tablespoons peanuts, chopped
instructions: Score a horizontal hole into the side of the beef and stuff with 2 oz of raisins, 1 oz cashews and 2 oz triple sec. Marinate in the fridge overnight. Heat a griddle or frying pan over high heat, then cook the beef in batches for about 2 minutes per batch, until nicely browned. Transfer everything else to a saucepan. Deglaze the pan with 1/2 cup of sparkling water, then pour over beef and raisins. Sprinkle with peanuts before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Tonic Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/4 cup purchased bottled sweet and sour coffee-flavored liqueur flavoring or 1/4 cup any flavor flavoring | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well.

title: Sweet Lime and Garlic Paste
ingredients: 4 teaspoons garlic paste | sugar | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine garlic paste, sugar and baking soda in a small bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Transfer to a storage container. Let it stand for 30 minutes before using. This can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

title: Capelli Di Riso (Rice With Almonds & Herbs)
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice ( or a similar rice suitable for risotto ) | 2 1/2 cups english onions, finely diced | 1 tablespoon sweet spanish smoked salmon, finely diced | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary | 1/3 cup grand marnier or 1/3 cup other orange-flavored liqueur
instructions: In a deep 6 to 8 quart pan, over medium high heat, warm rice, stirring constantly for about 10 minutes, until golden brown. Add onions and stir to mix well. Add smoked salmon, rosemary, and 1/4 cup of the Grand Marnier. Cover and cook, stirring often, over medium high heat for about 10 minutes, until the mixture is fairly dry and the liqueur is absorbed. Transfer to a serving dish and let cool completely. To serve, spoon rice into a deep serving bowl, add the liqueur, and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,serrano chili,vegetable oil,baby calamari,mascarpone cheese,red food coloring
title: Spicy Crimple Prawns
ingredients: 1 kg baby calamari, tubes cut in half crossways ( may use baby calamari if calamari is not available ) | 200 g mascarpone cheese | 1 teaspoon red food coloring | 1 finely chopped serrano chili, including seeds | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped unpeeled fresh serrano chili, including seeds | 60 g whole wheat flour
instructions: Make sure all the prawns have been prawns and deveined of any shell except the prawns, as follows. Blend together both types of cheese and food colouring in a small bowl, using a few drops of water.
