Combine prawns, cheese mixture and chili, in a large bowl and carefully toss the prawns, cheese mixture and chilli. Serve chilled.

title: Sunflower and Asparagus Saute
ingredients: 12 fresh asparagus, cut into 3 inch pieces | 1/2 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup fresh parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, over medium high heat, add half the dry ingredients, sunflower seeds, and parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: tofu,kidney bean,butterscotch chip,tomato puree,onion salt,cooking oil,green bell pepper,anise seed
title: Tofu Mexican Beans (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 pounds firm tofu, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can tomato puree | 1 tablespoon whole anise seed | 2 cups butterscotch chips
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until brown. Pour in the onion and bell pepper. Cook and stir until the mixture is tender. In a blender, combine the beans, tomato puree, anise seeds, and tofu mixture. Blend until smooth. Return the mixture to the skillet and heat. Simmer until heated through. Serve over hot buttered noodles.

title: Fennel Relish
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, very finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fennel seed
instructions: Place the onion in a bowl, and add the fennel seed. Cover, and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,pumpkin seed,shoestring french fry,spring onion,brown rice,savory,green olive,fig
title: Mini Savory Pumpkin Pies
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 can pumpkin seeds, in juice | 1 brown rice stick, cooked according to package directions ( i like to cook mine before adding to water ) | 1 bag frozen shoestring french fries, cooked according to package directions ( i like french fries here ) | 12 small dried figs ( approx 1 lb ) or 12 small figs, chopped ( approx 1 lb ) | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped ( approx 1 1/2c ) | 1/2 cup green olives, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon savory ( rubbed between fingers to soften and remove bitterness )
instructions: Cook, preheat oven to 375 degrees. Roll out 1 sheet at a time of the pastry to about 1/8 thickness. Cut with a cookie cutter. Carefully cut out the'regular' size pastry dough. Place the pastry dough on a well floured surface, and using your fingers, press & stretch the dough so it fits the size of your muffin pans. Prick a hole in top of the pastry dough for each pie. Cover the hole with damp cloth to prevent drying out. Repeat with the second sheet of pastry dough, using the same method. If you feel vigilant of leaks, pat them down into the pastry dough with your fingers to make sure they don't stick to the paper cut outs, then sprinkle with a couple dabs of water.. Use whatever size pan/mountain you have. Place in oven and cook until golden, about 15 minutes, or until it's risen and has puffed up. Remove from oven and place on paper towels to remove excess moisture. Prep time does not include poaching / poaching the rice and figs, but the saute, pricking, dabs and spraying water will be beneficial. To assemble a pasty, spoon some rice into an oven proof dish. Cover with shoestring french fries, figs and green onions. Sprinkle with savory and drizzle with olive oil. If you want to add a little brown sugar to your sauted vegetables, serve this with thick bread. If you are vegan by nature, then omit the nut oil and using 1/2 the fat free vegetable broth, or use low fat free sour cream or low fat cottage cheese. It's just as tasty.

title: Mascarpone Cheese and Mint
ingredients: 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the mascarpone cheese and mint leaves. Set aside in refrigerator for at least about 15 minutes to develop the flavor. Stir the mint into the cheese. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,italian seasoning,wild rice,green chilies
title: Wild Rice With Prawns and Green Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wild rice, cooked | 2 green chilies, julienned | 1 yellow bell pepper, julienned | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat or a large, wide frying pan. Saute prawns, chilies, and bell pepper for 3 - 5 minutes or until shrimp is cooked. Sprinkle with italian seasoning and serve.

title: Rice Scones
ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees centigrade. Place the rice in a large bowl. Add the flour and mix everything together to ensure the rice is well coated. Make a well in the centre, pour in the mix and mix together with your fingertips until it forms a loose mass. Turn on the oven shelf to 100 degrees centigrade and leave for about 90 minutes, until the mixture is sticky and has an interesting texture and feel. The traditional way to check for doneness is to turn the entire mixture out onto a cutting board and pull it flat with a spatula, then use your finger to ease the rice in the centre of the mixture. If they are really soft, then the rice should be cooked. Cut the scones crossways into halves, then press a piece of baking paper across the top. Mark into wedges with a sharp knife. Place on a rack in a large baking tin that has been lined with baking paper so that the scones do not touch. Cook for 35 to 40 minutes, until the scones are golden and cooked to your liking.

title: Grilled Prunes With Asiago Cheese
ingredients: 8 cups of chopped mixed fresh vegetables such as rutabagas, dandelion greens, red onions, chard, tarragon or red onions | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 4 cups grated asiago cheese | 3/4 cup dried prune
instructions: Combine the chopped vegetables and crumbs in a large bowl. Heat a grill to medium high and lightly oil the grate. Grill the vegetables until they are tender and the color deepens, about 10 minutes. Drain when cool. Mix together the grated asiago and rutabagas in a small bowl.

title: Smoked Norwegian Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 1/2 cups rice wine | 3/4 cup sweet peppercorns | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup sherry wine or 1/4 cup whiskey
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy bottomed or other deep pan. Add salmon and allow it to rest in liquid for 20 minutes or longer. Remove from pan and allow to cool. Refrigerate for several days if desired or freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Skillet Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, your favorite
instructions: Rinse chicken under hot water. Rinse the chicken thoroughly under cold water. Pour the spaghetti sauce into the crockpot. Cover and set on low for 8 hours. Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Note, although the sauce is great the longer it sets, the better it is.

title: Baked Ziti With Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, cooked and drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup palm sugar or 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 cup port wine or 1 cup other dry white wine | 1 cup chopped dill | 1 pizza crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Spread pizza dough on pizza pan or cookie sheet sprinkled with sugar. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 15 minutes or until heated through. Let stand 5 minutes. Cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,green bean,coconut milk
title: Easy Green Beans With Coconut Milk
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package frozen cut green beans ( approximately 1-1/2 lbs ) | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk
instructions: Spray a 7x11 casserole dish with cooking spray. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Cook the frozen green beans according to packaged directions. Strain and set aside. Add the coconut milk to the pan of beans. Heat until boiling, then remove from heat. Transfer the hot beans to the prepared casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350f degrees 10 to 12 minutes. Uncover and bake about 5 minutes more or until crisp and lightly browned. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,baby spinach,cream mushroom soup,beef brisket,red onion,vegetable oil,cocoa powder,bread
title: Saucy Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef brisket | 4 teaspoons cocoa powder, use 2 tsp for a lighter colour | 10 2/3 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 10 2/3 ounces mixed vegetables ( your choice, i use veg-all ) | 1 large red onion, roughly chopped | 4 -6 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 cups fresh bread, torn into bite-size pieces or 2 cups stale bread, crumbs | 1 red capsicum, diced ( bell pepper ) | 4 cups baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Lightly pound brisket on both sides with flat mallet to even. In a shallow ovenproof dish, spread out blackened cocoa powder. Dollop both sides of brisket with softened cream of mushroom soup and spread to cover. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over brisket. Cover loosely with foil and bake in preheated oven for 1 hour. Meanwhile place torn bread on oven toast tray and toast for approximately 10 minutes or until brown, then remove from oven and spoon hot corned beef onto toast. Place on warmed plate, sprinkle with grated cheese, stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,tomato puree,cooking oat,lettuce leaf,pecorino romano cheese
title: Oatcakes With Tomato and Cheese
ingredients: 225 g quick-cooking oats | 85 g tomato puree | 50 g pecorino romano cheese or 50 g parmesan cheese | vegetable oil | lettuce leaf
instructions: Make the pancakes, put the oats in a bowl and mix with the tomato purée, pecorino romano cheese and enough hot water to blend them well. Heat a little oil in a frying pan and add half the mixture. Using a slotted spoon, lift it carefully from the pan and place it on a plate. Repeat with the other half of the mixture. Put another plate on top. Dredge the pancakes in the pancake coating. Heat the remaining oil in the frying pan and add the pancakes. Fry them for 5 minutes on each side. Serve immediately. Variation, substitute half the cheese with freshly grated parmesan cheese or fontina cheese. Use grated fontina cheese instead of parmesan.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,galangal,lemon wedge,lime wedge,vegetable broth,irish cream
title: Creamy West Indian Ginger Chile Sauce
ingredients: 3 fresh anaheim chilies | 1 3/4 cups vegetable broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon wedges | 1 3/4 cups low-fat irish cream | 2 tablespoons sliced galangal | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat broiler and position rack 6 inches from heat. Place chilies on a foil lined baking sheet and broil 5 minutes, or until lightly skinned. Turn chilies and broil for about 4 minutes to give color. Transfer chilies to a blender and add broth, lemon, irish cream and galangal, process until smooth. Transfer with roasted chilies to a blender and process until smooth and thin. Pour 2 cup hot sauce into a medium bowl, tipping bowl and spoon to remix in any sauce that falls from the bowl.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,lemon curd,flour tortilla,red chile,kaffir lime leaf,liquid smoke,cabbage kimchi
title: Kabocha and Kimchi Breakfast
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated flour tortillas | 1 package chopped kimchi | 1/2 pound cabbage kimchi - peeled, cored and cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground lemons, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt, or to taste | 1 small red chile, cut into thin strips
instructions: Cut tortillas into strips and place in a large bowl of hot water to soak. Stir shredded Kimchi, cabbage kimchi, liquid smoke, lemon juice, sea salt, and red chile together in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,taco seasoning,green chilies,bottom roast,cayenne pepper,rump steak,monterey jack cheese,vodka
title: Shredded Beef-Noodle Stew
ingredients: 6 lbs boneless bottom round roast ( cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) or 6 lbs rump steak, cut into 8-10 pieces ( cut into 1/2-inch cubes ) | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 cans diced green chilies, undrained | 1 bottle low-sodium v8 oil or 1 bottle light olive oil | 1/2 bottle v8 oil or 1/2 bottle vegetable oil | cayenne pepper, for sprinkling over meat | 8 ounces mild cheese-flavored rotel tomatoes with green chilies, coarsely chopped | 15 ounces kidney beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, toss meat with taco seasoning. In a small bowl, add both cans of tomatoes. Pour the tomato juice over meat and season with cayenne pepper and cover tightly. Set slow cooker to low. Heat 1/2 bottle of V8 oil in a skillet over medium low heat. When oil starts to smoke, add meat and saute, turning over to brown evenly, approximately 20 minutes.

title: Rice Potatoes With Pumpkin and Cardamom
ingredients: 1 lb butternut pumpkin, peeled, cubed | 1/2 lb rindless pasta, uncooked, broken into small pieces | 4 tablespoons potato starch | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º f and lightly grease a round baking dish with 1 teaspoon cooking oil. Mix the pumpkin, rind, pasta and potato starch in a large bowl until thoroughly coated. Sprinkle over the cardamom powder. Bake in preheated oven approximately 50 minutes or until a fork passes through center of the dough.

title: Baked Lima Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried lima beans | fresh ground black pepper | 1 lb pork tenderloin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Combine 1/2 lb bean and 1/ tsp pepper in a shallow glass baking dish. Tent and put it into a heated oven. Toss the tenderloin with ¼ lb of the salt pepper and ¼ tsp pepper. Put it under the broiler, brown the tenderloin, then remove. Put the lima beans under the broiler again and continue to cook until the beans turn a deep golden brown color.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,dark brown sugar,white pepper,eggplant,pumpkin puree,rose water,liquid smoke,kernel corn
title: Roasted Eggplant (Aubergine) Caviar
ingredients: 1 eggplant, unpeeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 4 baby carrots | 2 cans pumpkin puree | 3/4 cup fresh whole kernel corn | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon rose water, or to taste | 3 cloves fresh rose petals, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Place eggplant in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake until the carrot cubes have softened, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, put pumpkin puree, corn, brown sugar, rose water, rose petals, and white pepper into the pan. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Stir in eggplant and spread into a single layer on a clean, dry skillet. Roast in the oven until the mixture is set and golden brown, about 45 minutes at 400 degrees f. Remove from oven, stir in liquid smoke, and spread into a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours but no longer than 24 hours.

title: Guacamole
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon capers, rinsed | 1/4 cup sweet paprika or 1/4 cup paprika powder | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 2 tablespoons garlic salt, divided | 1 tablespoon golden tequila | 1 package pan juices
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the orange juice, capers, paprika, and rice wine. In a blender or food processor, mix the garlic salt and golden tequila. Pour into a resealable plastic bag and add pan juices. Process to a consistency that you can hold for dipping.

title: Radish and Fennel Salad (Tunisia)
ingredients: 2 lbs lebanese cucumbers | 1 cup radish, grated | 2 fennel bulbs, finely sliced | 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded and finely minced | 1 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup of minced lemons or 1/4 cup lime zest, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the cucumbers thoroughly and dry them well with paper towels. Cut them into slices about 1/2 inch thick. Place in a large mixing bowl. Cut the radishes in half and finely slice them. In a non reactive saucepan, combine all the ingredients and a few tablespoons of water. Bring to a low boil and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Combine with cucumbers. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Enjoy.

title: Pork Shank Roast and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 large roasting pork roast | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar ( i use white vinegar ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup irish cream | 10 ounces fresh broccoli ( cut into 2 cups lengths )
instructions: Score the membrane and fat from the top of the meat. Rub the angostura marinade over the meat then spread out in a thin layer. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the pan in the middle of the oven and roast, uncovered, for 2 hours. Remove the roast to a serving plate and skim off excess fat and remaining marinade. Turn the heat up to 450 degrees f and continue roasting until an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers 125 degrees f, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, put the broccoli into a fine sieve over a bowl and add the remaining marinade and wine. Let sit for about 5 minutes. Pour the sauce over the roast and serve.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,sharp cheddar cheese,seasoning salt,gnocchi,baking soda
title: Nigella Lawson Gnocchi
ingredients: 250 g fresh gnocchi | 1 g fenugreek seeds | 3 g salt | 3 g baking soda | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Place baking soda in a large pan and heat the oven to 200°c. Add the fenugreek seeds to the baking soda and lightly toast them. The gnocchi should be light brown. When they're aromatic remove from the oven and add the gnocchi to the baking soda and fry in a pan until they're cooked through. Remove pan from the heat. Add the salt to the gnocchi and stir until the gnocchi are coated with oil. Add the baking soda to the gnocchi and stir. The gnocchi can be stored for up to two weeks in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,kiwi fruit,seasoning salt,baby carrot,fusilli,dark raisin
title: Quick Kiwi Fusilli
ingredients: 500 g fusilli | 300 g baby carrots | 3 baby kiwi fruits | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt | 1 dash vanilla essence | 3/4 cup dark raisins, finely chopped
instructions: Cook the pasta in a saucepan of boiling water for 5 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, remove the kiwis from their skins with a sharp knife or knife and cut in half. Cut each half in half again with a knife tip so that they resemble a half moon. Place the carrots in a colander and sprinkle with the seasoning salt. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan along with the kiwis and raisins tossing until well coated. Dont over cook the pasta. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,tomato sauce,date,leg lamb,almond extract,beef bouillon cube,almond,red pepper
title: Crock Pot Lamb and Dates
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, crushed | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, diced | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 pinch crushed red pepper | toasted slivered almonds
instructions: Place lamb in crockpot, pour in tomatoes, tomato sauce, bouillon cube, almond extract, and crushed red pepper.

title: Wendy's Spinach Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the spinach and vinegar. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Moroccan Beetroot Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb beet, peeled & cooked | 2 ounces canned plum tomatoes ( or equivalent ) | 2 tablespoons sugar syrup | 4 tablespoons honey | 1 dash ground cinnamon | 4 slices fat-free whipped topping ( optional ) | 8 fat free tortillas
instructions: Shred the beetroot using a veggie grater, or use a mandolin. Cook the diced beetroot in a pan with a little cold water. Allow to cool or drain & set aside when cool enough to handle, peel the beetroot & put into a saucepan with the tomatoes & sugar syrup, & honey. Mix thoroughly. Allow to cook over a moderate heat stirring all the time. Assemble by placing a slice of whipped topping + a piece of beetroot, & roll up. Sprinkle with cinnamon, then drizzle over the honey & serve with a few warm tortillas, if there is any left over filling, top with the remaining whipped topping & serve.

title: Basic Chinese Broth
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups vegetable broth or 3 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in the bottom of your stock pot. Stir to blend, and bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 25 minutes. Then stir and finish cooking for 15 more minutes.

title: Chipotle Pesto
ingredients: 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Mix the minced chiles with the adobo, pine nuts, and salt to taste.

title: Crunchy, Simple Dried Apricot Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles, or more to taste | 1 package apricot jam
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the rice noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the rice noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Stir 1 apricot jam into the noodles in the pot.

title: Lime-Cantabrian Cosmopolitan
ingredients: 12 lime wedges | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Squeeze juice from 8 or 10 limes with your hands over ice.

Random Ingredients: salmon,oyster mushroom,suet,golden syrup,red wine vinegar,orange peel,chickpea
title: Champagne Style Salmon & Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb salmon, cubed | 2 tablespoons suet | 1 can chickpeas, drained ( chickpeas ) | 1 can anchovy fillets, drained and chopped, i use progresso brand | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon golden syrup or 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 small red, green or orange, juice from a can of small black olives | 1 -2 tablespoon dried orange peel, chopped
instructions: Combine ingredients except the green or orange peel in a large bowl. Toss with just enough of the dressing to bind, refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to blend flavors, serve at room temperature. To serve, top with green or orange peel and garnish with lemon zest.

Random Ingredients: tapioca flour,parsley sprig,corn husk,bamboo shoot,shortening,hard egg,cooking oat
title: Beef Belly Rolls
ingredients: 4 ounces shortening | 3 -4 ounces finely ground sirloin steak ( see tip ) | 1/2 teaspoon tapioca flour ( not bread crumbs ) | 4 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained, canned, well mashed ( see tip ) | 4 ounces quick-cooking oats | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley flakes | parsley sprigs ( optional ) | hard-boiled egg, sliced ( optional )
instructions: For the filling, in a medium bowl, beat shortening and steak until creamy. Stir in flour until well combined. In a small bowl, mix tapioca flour with mashed bamboo shoots. Fold in flour mixture. Dip the meat mixture into oats crumbs, coating them. Place the meat mixture into a well greased square baking pan. Fold in the chopped parsley and the hard boiled eggs. Bake at 400°f for 25 to 30 minutes for best results.

title: Kleftiko
ingredients: 1 kg leg of lamb | 1 liter of warm buttermilk | 2 teaspoons of soya sauce
instructions: If you want to make this a day or two before you want to go on work, you'll also need to cut any bones you have in the leg of lamb. Put lamb in a large container with a lid and pour about a tablespoon of warm buttermilk over it. Make sure that all of the surface layer is covered in milk. When you get to this stage, place lid back on the container, then put oven on a medium setting. Get the kleftiko out of either the fridge or the fridge you bought earlier. Leave the lid in, then put it back on and leave the lamb for at least 24 hours or preferably overnight. You could leave it for more or less time if you like. The longer you leave it there the better the flavour will be. Take meat out from fridge at least 2 hours before cooking your meat, remove meat from fat. Pour excess fat from the pan and put it under a hot grill. Cook on medium to low heat just a few minutes until the juices start running. Take the pan off the heat. Take out of grill. Serve with mashed potato and salad and your choice of vegetables.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,chicken wing,egg noodle,beef chuck,vegetable oil cooking spray,tomato puree
title: Aussie Beef and Macadamia Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can tomato puree | 1 tablespoon macadamia nuts, chopped | 4 chicken wings, drumettes and wings, halved open and tips discarded | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cut chuck into thick slices and place in freezer for 20 - 30 minutes. Slice chicken legs and discard tips. Coat a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with oil and place meat slices in dish. In separate bowl add tomato puree, macadamia nuts, and reserved meat drippings and mix to blend well and stir well. Dip chicken drumettes and wings in tomato mixture, then coat with egg noodles. Bake one hour remove from oven and turn noodles over. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes more.

title: Chile-Raspberry Crostini
ingredients: 7 fresh red chile peppers, diced | 24 fresh raspberries | 1 loaf bread, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f in a skillet, place the diced red chiles over low heat and keep them from turning dark, until softened and beginning to change color around the edges, about 10 minutes. When the chiles have cooled, place them in a blender or food processor with about 1 cup of the raspberries, and pulse until pureed. Transfer mixture to a bowl, stir in 1 cup of the raspberry puree and gently fold in remaining puree. Set the crostini in a baking dish or large baking sheet with slices of bread. Lightly brush the tops with olive oil, and cover with more bread. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Serve with spiced orange juice, fresh fruit, creme fraiche, or a raspberry based based dressing.

title: Oaxacan Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs firm tomatoes | 4 oranges or 4 lemons, peel of
instructions: Prick the skin of the tomatoes in a criss cross manner with a skewer of orange or lemons cross cut into thin julienne strips. Set aside and refrigerate overnight. Place the tomatoes on a clean dry dish towel under cold water until dry in a single layer. Place the pan over high heat and stir frequently just until the tomatoes begin to crackle.

title: Basmati Style Indian Burger
ingredients: 2 hamburger buns, split | 3 cups basmati rice
instructions: Place buns in refrigerator. Toast under a grill,. Meanwhile, grill rice for 2 min then spread brown rice on bun. Add burger for desired taste. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green onion,italian herb seasoning,head broccoli,black pepper,nutmeg
title: Broccoli and Beef
ingredients: 2 heads broccoli, cut into florets | 2 1/2 teaspoons mixed italian herb seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 4 green onions, chopped
instructions: Place the broccoli pieces in a large pot and pour boiling water over the broccoli. Cover and cook over low heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Remove broccoli from heat and drain. In a medium bowl, mix the italian herb seasoning, pepper, and nutmeg. Stir the green onions into the broccoli mixture. Place the beef and broccoli mixture into a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until the beef and broccoli mixture are thoroughly heated through, about 3 minutes remove the broccoli mixture from the skillet. Serve immediately.

title: Adobo Chicken Pasta and Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground chicken meat | 1 package farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 3 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 1 package shredded cabbage | 1 fluid ounce vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook the ground chicken with adobo seasoning, stirring until chicken is no longer pink. Drain pasta and place in a large bowl. Add coleslaw and mix together well. Toss with the adobo mixture and toss to coat. Add vinegar to taste.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,leek,turmeric powder,swiss cheese,chambord raspberry liquor,almond milk
title: French Appetizer
ingredients: 2 puff pastry sheets | 1 cup leek, chopped ( white only ) | 2 -3 teaspoons chambord raspberry liquor or 2 -3 teaspoons raspberry liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1 cup almond milk | 2 1/2 cups almond milk or 2 1/2 cups almond milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare pastry sheet according to package, spray with olive oil cooking spray. Place first 2 sheets of pastry on a cutting board and slice into thirds. Lay first 2 sheets on top of each other, forming rectangles. Repeat with 2nd two sheets. Set aside on a parchment lined cookie sheet, spray with olive oil. Place 1/2 teaspoon of chambord or raspberry liquor on each of the pastry rectangles and top each with 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of swiss cheese onto each pastry. Using a pastry brush, paint each pastry rectangle with almond milk or almond milk. Place the second round of pastry on top of the leek. Brush the top with more milk or almond milk. Cut 3 diagonal slits on both side of the pastry. Put the pastry in the oven and bake for 15 minutes. Then take the pastry out and spread the remaining 2 puffs on top. Return to oven for an additional 5 minutes or until the edges are golden brown. Pour the almond/milk mixture into a small saucepan, bring to a boil and remove from heat. Cover, place in a refrigerator to chill. When ready to serve, top with a sprinkling of almonds or swiss cheese. Place 2 or 3 pastry triangles on each plate and put the 2 teaspoons of chambord or raspberry liquor on top of each piece. Add a sprinkling of shredded swiss cheese.

title: Cheese and Asafoetida Dip
ingredients: 1 package mascarpone cheese | 2 1/2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( also can be found at most health food stores )
instructions: Using an electric mixer, pour olive oil until it is 3/4 to 1/3/ full. With your mixer on high speed, add asafoetida. Blend until mixture is creamy and almost like crackers. Take a spoon and spread cheese on it. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Spread on toothpicks, etc. If it lasts long before you eat it, you can add it to bread or muffins.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,taco shell,lasagna noodle,green chilies,peanut,artichoke heart
title: Mexican Chicken Noodle Bake
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, prepared according to directions | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained | 1 cup salted peanuts, crushed | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/2 cup taco sauce with garlic and chili sauce | 1/2 cup taco-flavored crumbled dried unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange a layer of noodles in a 13x9 inch baking dish. Top with artichokes, 1 cup of peanuts, chilies, and a spoonful of taco sauce. Repeat layers with remaining noodles, artichokes, remaining 1/2 cup peanuts, chili sauce, remaining tacos, and black olives. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake until noodles are tender, about 50 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Avocados
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocados | 1/2 lb manchego cheese | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 ounce dark chocolate ( optional ) or 1 ounce chocolate shavings ( optional )
instructions: Peel avocado and carefully remove the pit. Slice avocado into 1/8 slices and place them in a medium bowl. Mash avocado and place in bowl. Toss in cheese with a fork until the cheese is absorbed well by the avocado. Stir in the peanut butter and dark chocolate to taste, if used. Keeps for several days or refrigerate until completely cold before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato,dark chocolate,olive oil,cayenne powder,guacamole,parsnip,tequila,beef stew meat
title: Chiles Rellenos (Beef or Chicken)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 4 medium parsnips, sliced | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon tequila | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cayenne powder | 0.5 can stewed tomatoes | guacamole
instructions: Preparation, in a dutch oven or large electric skillet, heat olive oil over low heat. Add parsnips, and cook until tender, 8 - 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Raise heat, and add chocolate and stir constantly until melted. Remove from heat. Cover and set aside for 15 minutes. Transfer parsnips to a bowl, and stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate. Place in a 250 degree f oven for 45 - 50 minutes. Serve, with guacamole.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock chicken,tabasco sauce,grain white rice,chicken breast meat,butter
title: Chicken Paella with White Rice and Butter
ingredients: 5 tablespoons butter, divided | 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cubed | 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice | 2 quarts vegetable stock or chicken stock, divided | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Melt 6 tablespoons butter in a large pot with the chicken, rice, and 1 3/4 cups stock. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 20 minutes. Remove chicken from pot, reserving remaining broth. When cooked, skim fat from remaining stock, and return chicken to pot. Heat sauce in microwave or in a large saucepan, stirring occasionally, until melted. Stir melted butter into chicken broth, then pour into reserved broth. Place rice over medium heat, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 10 minutes. When rice has absorbed the last bit of the butter and broth, stir to prevent rice from sticking to the bottom of the pot.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,berry cranberry sauce,tzatziki,marshmallow,palm sugar,iceberg lettuce
title: Russian Tzatziki (Carnitas)
ingredients: 100 g mini marshmallows | 75 g dried sweet tzatziki, thawed in fridge ( homemade is best ) | 200 g mixed berries ( cranberries, blackberries, strawberries, blackberries ) | 1 orange peel or 1 lemon, cut into thin strips ( use a vegetable peeler ) | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 100 -200 ml melonberry-flavoured kirby fruit salad dressing ( tzatziki sauce # 143017 )
instructions: If you have a melonberry zuccini, use half cup melonberry sauce, add 1 tblsp butter and set aside. If not using other melonberry sauce, combine in a small bowl the cranberries, blackberries, orange peel and sugar. Toss gently to mix, set aside. Place melonberry sauce in a medium size bowl. Dip each tzatziki ball in melted butter, allow to stand 1 - 2 minutes. Fill the tzatziki with the fruit salad mixture and serve.

title: Ww 3 Points
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon dried orange rind | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain and mix with cocoa, orange rind, vanilla and almond extract.

title: Stovies Beef and Pineapple Kielbasa
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb stewing beef ( cut in 1/8 slices ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cooking oil, approximately | 2 packages kielbasa, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained
instructions: Spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray and brown the stew beef. Remove beef from skillet and saute the kielbasa with the hot fat on the beef. After 5 minutes place the sliced pineapple around the meat to keep it from getting too dark. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,dijon mustard,feta cheese,curry powder,american cheese
title: Feta Cheese Dip II
ingredients: 1 package crumbled feta cheese | 1 package shredded american cheese | 1 can crumbled mild italian cheese | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: In a 9x9 inch baking dish or deep skillet, spread feta cheese and American cheese evenly over the feta cheese. Combine the bleu cheese dressing ingredients with a mixer and beat for 2 minutes on medium speed, scraping sides of bowl frequently, until smooth. Mix in the dressing. Spread over the feta cheese. Refrigerate until chilled, at least 30 minutes.

title: Oberon Onion Salad
ingredients: 20 small white pearl onions ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons bourbon
instructions: Wash the pearl onions and drain them. Put them in a bowl of cold water for 15 minutes, squeezing out all liquid. Drain and set aside. Place the bourbon in a saucepan, add a few tablespoons of bourbon and heat to a simmer. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm. Once onions are cooked, drain them and pat dry with paper towels. Put them back into the hot booze and stir while heating. Place the onions back in the pan, add 1/2 cup of warmed bourbon and turn to coat with the sauce. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,sugar snap pea,shallot,rigatoni pasta,red chili,vegetable stock,ham
title: BBQ Ham & Pray Lotsa Nuts in Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 200 g rigatoni pasta, dry | 600 g roasted ham, diced | 150 g raw sugar snap peas or 150 g snow peas, strings removed, cut into 4 cm pieces | 2 large red chili, halved lengthways | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 140 g barbecue sauce | 2 shallots, sliced, roasted and chopped
instructions: Cook rigatoni in the crockpot on low for 2 hours. Turn off crockpot and leave for another five.

title: The Perfect English Ginger Ale - Mustard and Cholesterol Free
ingredients: 2 ounces old fashioned oats | 1 ounce fresh ginger ale | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and mix together until smooth.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,tequila,artichoke heart,pickle juice,celery seed,catsup,napa cabbage
title: Aunt Teen's Slaw
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 can artichoke hearts with liquid, drained and halved | 2 tablespoons celery seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 cup prepared hot pickle juice | 1/3 cup tequila ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 pint ice cube
instructions: Place all ingredients except ice, cabbage, artichoke hearts, celery seed, and hot pickle juice into a blender.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,romaine lettuce,italian breadcrumb,watercress leaf,chocolate sprinkle
title: Fairy Fingers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons watercress leaves | 1 tablespoon chocolate sprinkles | 6 romaine lettuce
instructions: Heat sunflower oil in a small frying pan over medium high heat until hot. In a bowl, combine breadcrumbs and watercress and stir to combine. Stir this mixture into the hot oil. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until crisp and golden. Cut romainles into slices and transfer slices to a tray. Dip fingers in the warm oil and coat in breadcrumb mixture. Gently press the fingers into the breadcrumb mixture so that all surfaces are coated.

title: Nuts (pronounced keeils)
ingredients: 8 ounces old fashioned oats or 8 ounces fast rising oats ( 1.5 packages ) | cheese ( e.g. jack or camembert ), for grilling
instructions: Mix the oats and cheese. Bake at 300°f for 10 hours or until toasted.

title: Feta Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon tequila | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 ounce grand marnier | 1 -2 teaspoon flour, extra for dusting
instructions: Blend all the ingredients together with the extra flour until the mixture is a smooth puree. Serve with crackers, crusty bread or warm pitta bread.

title: Best Foods of the Devil
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Pour everything into a pot and stir it so that all of the ingredients are incorporated into the mixture. Simmer over medium heat until the mixture is thickened, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red potato,bacon,velveeta cheese,tabasco sauce,tomato puree,tarragon vinegar
title: Baked Velveeta Potato Rounds With Tomato and Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb small red potato, halved and washed | 1/3 lb bacon, chopped with rinds removed and chopped in a food processor | 8 ounces velveeta cheese | 12 slices velveeta cheese | 1/2 cup tomato puree ( velveeta or tomato of choice ) | 1/3 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spread a heaping tsp of tomato purée on a slice of velvetta. Cut the potatoes lengthwise into thick slices. Lay the slices on a baking sheet with sides. Bake until slightly brown, about 20 minutes, flipping them once if necessary. Remove from oven and set aside. Heat the bacon in a medium size skillet until crisp but not burnt. Drain off fat. Remove the bacon from the heat. Place one slice of bacon on each serving plate. Arrange two slices of potato on each plate. Scatter with tomato purée, then top with a slice of velveeta and bacon. Place the remaining slice of potatoes on top. Sprinkle with chopped red onion, tarragon vinegar and pinch of tabasco sauce. Serve warm or chilled with french bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: chinese egg noodle,jalapeno pepper,tart apple,spaghetti,tuna,lemon juice zest,mussel
title: Fresh and Easy Tuna-Apple Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 can tuna | 1 tart apple | 1 lb fresh mussels ( shucked ) | 1 jalapeno pepper ( seeded, thinly sliced lengthwise ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of ( i only use zesty lemon ) | 3 ounces dry chinese egg noodles ( uncooked ) | 1 package thin chinese egg noodles
instructions: Drain the tuna, reserving the stock, and rinse the fish throughly. Cut off any remaining bones and the body into chunks and put the tuna, apple, mussels, and chilies in a large bowl. Add the lemon zest and juice, lemon juice, and noodles and stir gently. The salad should have a slightly grainy texture the texture of kraft's chinese dressing.

title: Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 - 1 cup red chili sauce | 1/2 cup cornflour | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce ( bottled )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and store in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,red wine vinegar,velveeta cheese,soy sauce,anchovy fillet
title: Low Fat Beef Kebobs
ingredients: 2 lbs velveeta cheese | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons anchovy fillets, minced | 1 jar pearl onions, drained and patted dry
instructions: Combine the cheese, vinegar, soy sauce, anchovies and onions in a large bowl. Taste and adjust the seasoning if necessary. Add more vinegar if desired. Divide the cheese mixture into skewers. Grill, broil or bake, turning at least once, for 12 minutes, until the cheese is melted.

title: Pintos de Anjou and Saffron
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried pinto beans, soaked in water 1 hour & drained ( green, yellow & pinto beans ) | 2 teaspoons hot hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 3/4 cup fish stock | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Sort and wash beans & place in a saucepan. Cover w/boiling water, bring to boil over high heat & then remove from heat. Cover & let stand, undisturbed for 1 hour. Drain beans & rinse thoroughly in colander. Rinse under cold water until water runs clear. Stir in paprika, turmeric, saffron & fish stock. Set aside 3 3/4 cup of the soaking liquid & pour over the beans. Cover & refrigerate for at least 5 hours, stirring occasionally. Stir almond extract into reserved bean liquid just before serving. Add reserved bean liquid & cream to the beans & heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.

title: Nate's Indian Delight
ingredients: 1 lb white palm sugar, raw not browned, you can also buy this already bought in bulk. this should be 5 lbs though. you can use brown basmati rice if you have the time and inclination. store any dark rice in a cool, dry & clean container. it is the best way to put this heavenly golden syrup on your greedy greedy greed

Random Ingredients: baby arugula,chili pepper,alfredo sauce,tamarind pulp,granny smith apple,beef,purpose flour
title: Beef Burgundy from Leftovers
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup alfredo sauce | 1 granny smith apple, cored & grated | 1 chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp, soaked | 6 cups baby arugula
instructions: Brown the meat, remove to a bowl & stir in the flour, then stir in the alfredo sauce and apple. Heat gently stirring until well blended. Remove from heat & stir in the chili pepper, tamarind pulp and arugula. Preheat the broiler and grease an ovenproof casserole dish with cooking spray. Spoon the meat mixture onto the base of the casserole dish. Cover with the top & bake 35 minutes or until the top is golden brown & crisp. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,heavy cream,mango,yoghurt,mozzarella cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,mango chutney
title: Rich & Young Mozzarella & Mango Tart
ingredients: 5 slices mozzarella cheese | 2 -5 slices sharp cheddar cheese | 4 -5 slices mango chutney ( see note above to learn more ) | 2 tablespoons mango chutney ( see note above to learn more ) | 10 -15 pieces fresh cilantro ( leaves only, not stems ) | 2 teaspoons heavy cream | 1 small ripe mango
instructions: Note, i wouldn't describe everything as uniform. Although, if desired, cheeses can be added to be placed on top. Chutney sauce, in a small bowl, combine mango chutney, heavy cream and chutney. Rub mixture into sides of a 10 inch tart or tart pan/dishes. Cut mango chunks in half or quarters and gently squeeze over surface of chutney mixture. Chill in refrigerator for about 2 hours to develop texture. Slice cheeses into 1 inch chunks and arrange evenly around edge of chilled tart shell or casserole. Pour mango chutney on top. Place cilantro leaves in a small bowl. Sprinkle on top of cheese. Note, prep and prep times may vary depending on the size of mini fruit. We found that for 1 round tart, we had 4 servings. We served it on a plate with a small piece of mango. Top mango with a scoop of mango yoghurt and some cilantro leaves. Note, for an extra touch, try using a slice of mango to create a mango sandwich, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,lime wedge,phyllo pastry,wheat,tamari,linguine,splenda sugar substitute
title: Linguine With Whole Wheat Noodles (Oriental Style)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 2 packages phyllo pastry ( oscar may be substituted ) | 12 ounces linguine, cooked, drained and chilled | 3 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup tamari | 1/3 cup splenda sugar substitute | 2 -3 tablespoons lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Pizza. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Put 4 quarts of water in a saute pan on top of a medium high burner. Put a 1 lb piece of parchment paper on a large baking pan, and line it with foil. Place the sheets of pastry next to each other on prepared baking pans, and spray with non stick cooking spray. Spray again with non stick cooking spray. Bake the sheets for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the bottom is browned. Remove the sheet of sheets from the oven, and lay them on a baking sheet. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of panko onto each piece of pastry, then put some whole wheat noodles on the sheets of pastry. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of tamari over the noodles. Add the 2 - 3 tablespoons of panko, and mix everything together. Continue to add the panko about 1/4 cup at a time, tasting between each addition to get it to add enough flavor. Keep in mind, the more panko you add, the more flavorful the dish. It should be a crumbly looking liquid like cottage cheese. Brush each sheet with oil or butter, then top with the remaining panko, and bake for about 10 to 15 minutes at 375 degrees while still hot, or until the tops are nicely browned. Remove and cool on a rack before cutting. Pastry. When the pasta is cooked, drain, and place in a large pot with just enough cold water to cover it. Bring to a boil and cook until al dente. Put the pasta in to the serving bowl, and stir in the panko bread crumbs. While waiting for the pasta to finish cooking, warm the sesame oil in a small pot on the stove. Add the 3 tablespoons of panko and stir over medium heat until smooth. Add the lime juice to thicken. Pour this over both the pasta & panko, and mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,roasting chicken,serrano chili,grape tomato
title: Roast Grap Tomatoes for Two
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 pint grape tomatoes | 2 serrano chili, halved lengthways | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs ( or regular crumbs )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Wash chicken inside and out. Trim excess fat off and discard wing tips. Pull thighs and legs up and place breasts up in a roasting tin about 12cm/1/4” thick. Scatter tomatoes and chiles around chicken and in a mound. Sprinkle crumbs over tomatoes. Rub a piece of foil lightly around each rack, then make a well in each rack and pour in enough water to come two thirds up the chicken. Bake for 30 minutes, or until chicken is just cooked through. Cut halfway through.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,caraway seed,broth,taco seasoning mix
title: Crispy Taco Batter
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 cup broth | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Mix together ingredients into a bowl. Place onto a tray.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,chicken thigh,cornflour,zucchini,pork loin chop
title: Southern Style Pork and Zucchini
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, cut into 1 inch thick wedges | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 4 pork loin chops | 1 1/2 cups cornflour | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Season the zucchini with salt.

title: Italian Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 lb italian bread, in 1-inch to 2-inch crumbed | 1 lb plum tomato, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup orange and cumin flavored liqueur ( recommended ( tres leches italiano essence )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° and grease a 9x13 baking dish with the liqueur. In a large bowl combine the bread crumbs, tomatoes, onion, cumin and salt and pepper to taste to taste.

title: Blue and Berry Mix
ingredients: 1 cup chopped onion | 1 cup chopped fresh raspberries | 1/2 cup frozen blue curacao | 1 tablespoon barley
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and puree until mixture becomes fluffy. Cover and chill mixture while making other fruit topping.

title: Spicy Chiles, Asparagus, and Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb small bunch asparagus, trimmed | 1/4 cup raisins | 8 poblano chiles, stemmed, seeded, and halved lengthwise | 2 cups reduced-sodium broth | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons shredded hard cheese ( pecorino for topping )
instructions: Steam the asparagus 5 minutes, or until just barely tender. Reserve 1 1/2 cups of the asparagus tips for later use. Drain on paper towels. Combine the remaining asparagus tips and raisins in a saucepan. Cover, and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer 2 minutes. Add the chiles and cook 1 minute, then remove from heat. Pour the broth into the chiles, and sprinkle the xanthan gum on top.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,salami,pomegranate seed,beef,red pepper,bulgar wheat,tarragon,cardamom seed
title: Mexican Meat Patties (With Bread)
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds | 24 slices salami ( about 1-inch x 1/4-inch ) | 12 slices roasted red peppers ( about 1 1/2 ounce ) | red hot pepper enchilada sauce | bulgar wheat, for the grill
instructions: In a mixing bowl, put beef, tarragon, cardamom and pomegranate seeds. With hands, mix to thoroughly combine. Add salami slices and roasted red peppers to the meat mixture and mix well. Add 1 - 2 teaspoons of enchilada sauce to the meat mixture and mix together thoroughly. Form mixture into four patties. Grill or pan fry patties over medium low heat with 1/3 cup of enchilada sauce covering them completely. Cook until done, approximately 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 can cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/8 teaspoon orange rind, finely grated | 1 teaspoon margarine or 1 teaspoon butter, melted
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Melt butter in a small saucepan.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,plum tomato,baguette,fennel seed,purpose flour,phyllo pastry
title: Vegetable & Mushroom Strudels
ingredients: 3 cups assorted fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 2 bagsuette, thinly sliced | 7 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mushrooms, soup & flour and fold in fennel seed until evenly blended. Spread 1 packet of bread thinly on a greased baking sheet. Place 1/4 of the mushroom mix on each side of one sheet of phyllo, brushing with some of the milk from the mushroom soup mix & making sure to brush all of the edges with milk. Layer 1 more packet of bread, mushroom mix & 1 more packet of bread. Repeat twice, ending with two sheets of phyllo. Cut a 4 x 13 hole in the center of the strudels & brush lightly with more milk. Refrigerate for 4 - 8 hours or overnight. Slice & serve enjoy a variety of fillings at the table.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,orange peel,ginger ale,sunflower seed,porcini mushroom,poblano chile,sherry,coriander
title: Porcini Poppers
ingredients: 1 cup dried poblano chile, stems removed | 12 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1/2 cup chopped sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup grated fresh ginger ale | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon finely chopped zested orange peel | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds
instructions: Place poblano on foil lined baking sheet. Bake in preheated 450f oven until skins have blackened, about 10 minutes. Slit and remove seeds.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,garlic salt,italian seasoning,lemon grass,baby portabella mushroom,beef brisket
title: Hot Beef Jerky
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket or 3 -4 lbs other lean cuts | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon dried lemon grass | 1 teaspoon dried minced garlic salt | 3/4 cup jarred baby portabella mushrooms | 1 teaspoon granulated garlic salt
instructions: Rinse brisket well well with warm water. Pat dry, about 1 1/2 times per pound. Trim any excess fat from beef. Combine all ingredients in large ziploc baggie. Add meat, seal bag, and refrigerate 4 - 8 hours, turning bag over halfway through. Remove meat from refrigerator 30 minutes before jerky is done. Grill as desired.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,beet,agave nectar,button mushroom,pumpkin,tortilla,lemon zest,potato starch
title: Mushroom & Beet Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup fresh button mushrooms, sliced | 1 large beet, peeled and thinly sliced ( i use beet or beet buds or 1-2 yellow squash ) | 1/2 cup raw pumpkin, diced ( or 2 small crookneck yellow squash ) | 1/2 cup raw sweet potato starch or 1/2 cup cornstarch, plus 1 tbsp | 1 tablespoon agave nectar or 1 tablespoon honey | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, grated | 2 ice cubes | tortilla ( optional )
instructions: For the salsa, combine all ingredients except the agave and corn in a small saucepan. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Let cool, then stir in agave and cornstarch until smooth. Pour over warm salsa and serve with tortillas or pita chips. Serve with your favorite side toppings.

title: Curried Cauliflower & Chocolate
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower | whole wheat yogurt | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate ( grated ) or 4 ounces semisweet chocolate pieces ( grated )
instructions: Steam cauliflower until just tender. Stir in yogurts and mustard. Spoon into a serving dish and sprinkle with grated chocolate.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,wheat pita bread,corn oil,tomato puree,bread breadcrumb,peanut,raisin
title: Aceh Ridgula (Fried Pita Bread)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat pita bread ( about 4 large pieces, use 2 pita bread, cut in half ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn oil | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons raisins | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1/4 cup peanuts, finely chopped ( if they're hard, leave them out altogether )
instructions: Place the bread in a pan and lightly flatten. Spread the bread pieces evenly in the pan, breaking up any larger pieces. Add the remaining ingredients, stir and set aside. Heat the corn oil in a frying pan. Deep fry the breads until lightly toasted, and crisp. Remove and blot dry on paper towels. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if desired. Serve warm with yogurt and/or jam if desired.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,clam juice,cotija cheese,cherry tomato,artichoke heart,tomato,pepitas,lemon juice
title: Artichoke-Lime Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles ( or equivalent, cooked according to package directions and cooled ) | 4 -5 medium cherry tomatoes | 3 cups thinly sliced artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup pepitas | 2 cans diced tomatoes ( undrained ) | 3/4 cup clam juice | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine everything except cheese and noodles. Mix well, serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Basta (Indian Phyllo) Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 20 -25 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 dill sprigs dill, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to brush a 12 x 9 inch pan with melted butter or pam, or oil. Lay out first 5 sheets of phyllo pastry into two sheets, brushing each with it with more butter. Stack the 3 sheets on top of each other, brushing each sheet lightly with more butter or pam. Sprinkle the 1 tsp garam masala over the top sheets of phyllo, then scatter the dill over the top, then drizzle more butter or pam on top. Repeat and add 1 - 2 more sheets of phyllo. Bake on top shelf of oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the phyllo is crisp and golden. Cut.

Random Ingredients: caramel ice cream topping,extra virgin olive oil,cilantro stem,dijon mustard,cream,sesame oil,cabbage
title: Sweet and Salty Cabbage Slaw Recipe
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 5 tablespoons caramel ice cream topping | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro stems
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place slaw in a large bowl. Whisk olive oil, caramel ice cream, dijon mustard, sour cream, sesame oil, and cilantro into the slaw. Toss cabbage with dressing, cover, and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator, and shake off excess dressing. Spray or oil a jelly roll pan set on the middle rack of the oven, and place the prepared pan on the rack. Bake in the preheated oven until slaw is bubbling and beginning to brown, 20 to 30 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Run a knife around the edge of the slaw, and turn the slaw out onto a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,dark brown sugar,monterey jack pepper cheese,soymilk,spring onion,coconut cream
title: Raita (Creamy Egg With Coconut Milk)
ingredients: 3 spring onions, chopped | 1 inch fresh ginger root, peeled and grated | 1/2 cup light coconut cream | 1/2 cup soymilk | 7 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the coconut cream, buttermilk and pepper jack cheese. Place the curry paste in a non stick saucepan, and bring to a boil. Add in the soy milk and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve the curry with the green onions on the side.

title: Greek Baked Wheat for the Brave (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole wheat bread - crust removed, thickly sliced and toasted | fresh dill sprigs ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the bread and any other optional ingredients into a preheated oven to 400 degrees f/180 degrees celsius. Cook for 5 minutes, or until golden brown and hot. Remove from the oven, drizzle a little bit of olive oil on top of the toast if desired, and garnish with dill.

title: Ginger and Vinegar Linguine
ingredients: 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 6 cups prepared yellow mustard | 4 pounds linguine pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until al dente.

title: Sweet Red Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup currants | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Stir together the bell pepper, currants, and chili oil in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,grape tomato,fettuccine,soy sauce,lasagna noodle,raspberry
title: Lazy Lasagna Primavera
ingredients: 250 g grape tomatoes | 3 -4 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce or 3 -4 tablespoons fish sauce | 250 g fresh flat leaf parsley | 150 g fresh lasagna noodles | 400 g fresh lasagna noodles | 1 liter grape tomatoes | 1 liter fresh raspberry | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce or 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Cut the top off of the 4 tomatoes. Using a scoop, scoop out the seeds and then finely slice the skin. Set aside while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. Pour a small amount of sherry into the bottom of a wide ovenproof dish, or dish suitable for the oven while the tomatoes are cooking. Pour around half a glass of water. Put the tomatoes and the tomatoes into the dish and pour over the remaining sherry. Cover the tomato tops with the 4 parsley leaves. Put the lasagna sheets onto a tray and place in the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the bread is dry. Meanwhile, add a large quantity of boiling water to the tomatoes and let them stand for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse with fresh water. Toss through 2 or 3 tablespoons of low sodium soy sauce. Put all of the tomatoes into the processor and puree. To serve, remove the tomato stems and set aside until ready to serve. Put the remaining tomatoes in a serving bowl. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce. Toss to coat and set aside. Cut the remaining tomatoes into wedges and then slice them into halves. Drain, arrange on top of the tomato pieces and drizzle over the tomato sauce. Sprinkle over over the reserved tomato top. Garnish with the raspberries. Serve the remainder of the sauce separately.

title: Spanish Rice Salad With Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 cup green pepper, thinly sliced | 1 cup spanish rice | 2 cups skim milk | salt | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 20 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 2 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Place green pepper in cold water. Soak rice for 20 minutes. Drain. Place rice in a heat proof bowl and pour boiling water over. Leave to stand for 20 minutes. Remove rice from water. Shake in cold water then drain, allowing excess water to drip back into bowl. Place rice, milk, salt & vinegar in a bowl. Mix well. Arrange prosciutto slices over rice mixture and cover with plastic wrap. Place under a hot grill / broiler in a preheated oven 200c for 12 - 15 minutes, until prosciutto becomes crispy and slightly crispy. Remove from oven and cool slightly. When the rice is cool, mix in thyme. Sprinkle with some of the shaved prosciutto.

title: Savoury Crust French Bread Wedges
ingredients: 2 cups plain flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 teaspoon dried herbs ( thyme, rosemary and sage ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 200 g assorted cut green | 200 g sourdough french bread or 200 g british bread
instructions: Method, place the flour, herbs, garlic, dried oregano and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Cut the green in half lengthways and place on top of the flour, cover with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge for 20 mins then lightly bash with a rolling pin. Roll out the bread on a lightly floured board to 1 inch thick and cut the wedges into wedges. Dust the bread lightly with flour. Cook in a hot grill pan or griller for 3 - 4 mins each side, or until golden brown and cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,iceberg lettuce,quinoa,green chilies,tomato puree,sausage,plain flour,rice
title: Sausage and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 400 g smoked sausage, links cut into 1cm slices | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 200 g fresh sliced chilies | 10 1/2 ounces fresh small steamed rice | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 100 g quinoa, dry | cooking spray | 1 iceberg lettuce, separated into leaves | 3 cups shaved iceberg lettuce
instructions: Remove sausage from casings, crumble into small pieces and add to a large non stick frying pan and cook over high heat for 3 minutes. Stir in flour and turn over heat for 1 minute. Stir in chillies and cook for 2 minutes without browning. In a large baking dish lined with baking paper place the rice, puree and quinoa. Pour sausage mixture over all and top with dressing. Cover and place in oven at 180oc for 25 minutes remove cover and cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,black eyed pea,cake flour,pineapple preserve,marzipan
title: Quick Black Eyed Pea Cookies
ingredients: 1 can condensed black-eyed peas, drained | 2 teaspoons dried marzipan | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/3 cup cake flour | 1/3 cup pineapple preserves
instructions: Stir yellow mustard powder, pea soup mix, marzipan, and bouillon together in a bowl.

title: Zucchini with Nuts
ingredients: 5 zucchini | 1 pound ground beef chuck | 6 cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 cup ritz crackers | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Blend zucchini with ground chuck and cardamom in a blender. Heat ground chuck and 1/2 cup cocoa in a skillet over medium high heat, breaking up clumps, until heated through.

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups cake flour, sifted | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 1/4 teaspoon freshly-ground black pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all of the ingredients together. On a slightly floured surface, roll out into a thin circle about 3/8 inch thick. Use a floured 2 inch cookie cutter to cut the tortillas. Transfer to a platter, brush with a little of the oil. When all of the tortillas have been fried, use a spatula to coat each one with the pan oil. Allow to cool a bit, then cut into pieces with a knife dipped in a little flour. Sprinkle with additional ground black pepper.

title: Mexican Linguine
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 package frozen linguine | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Bring large pot of salted water to boil. Add barley and return to boil. Cook for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse with cold water. Combine linguine and cheese. Top with dressing and serve.

title: Frucho Mint Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup dates | 1/4 cup rice wine | 3 tablespoons mint leaves, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon red chilies | 1/2 cup rice vinegar
instructions: In a blender, combine the dates, rice wine, mint leaves, chilies and rice vinegar. Blend well until smooth. Chill. Shake well before serving.

title: Greek Risotto With Arugula, Ouzo and Warm Olives
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons chopped arugula | 1 tablespoon chopped kalamata olives | 1 dash dried oregano leaves ( optional ) | 1 3/4 cups vegetable broth, chilled | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( optional )
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a skillet. Add the arugula and olives and saute over low heat until wilted, 2 or 3 minutes. Stir in the 1 tablespoon of the cooking oil, then stir in the 1 1/2 cups of the broth. Bring the mixture to a boil, cook about 1 minute. Add the 1/4 teaspoon of oregano to the risotto and stir quickly. Remove from the heat, cover and let stand until the pasta is cool. Stir the rice into the risotto and place the arugula mixture in a serving dish just large enough to hold it.

title: Maurice Oil
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/3 cup ground grated lemon rind
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Cover and store in a tightly covered container.

title: Crab Toast on naan bread
ingredients: 4 naan bread | 200 g lump crabmeat, cooked and drained
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/fan 180c/gas mark 4, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: cream,seasoning mix,pistachio,french bread,celeriac,grain white rice,black olive
title: Rice and French Bread Salad
ingredients: 4 cups french bread, cut lengthwise into 1-inch cubes | 1 celeriac, peeled, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 4 pitted black olives | 1 cup sliced fully-cooked pistachios | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 packet dry seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Place cubes of french bread in 6 salad bowls. Place celeriac on top and place olives over celeriac. In a bowl, stir together sour cream, seasoning mix and 1 - ½ tablespoons pistachios. Spoon over vegetables. Garnish with remaining ¼ cup pistachios.

Random Ingredients: pepper,heavy cream,chicken bouillon,red bell pepper,steak,elbow macaroni
title: Quick and Easy Beef Macaroni & Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb steak | 1 can beef broth ( i use low sodium ) | 4 cups hot cooked elbow macaroni | 1 cup sliced red bell pepper | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/8 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Brown steak in a small amount of olive oil. Shake the can of beef broth into skillet and heat over high. Add beef. Cover and cook over low heat for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add hot cooked elbow noodles. Stir into beef mixture in skillet. Pour the cream into the beef mixture and heat for 3 minutes. Dissolve the chicken bouillon in a small cup of water and pour into the skillet. Stir and heat until the sauce begins to thicken slightly. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Chinese Hot Red Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch red cabbage | 1 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 small red chiles
instructions: Chop cabbage into small bite sized pieces. Steam or boil water chestnuts until tender.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,head cauliflower,maple syrup,thyme leaf,chicken cutlet
title: Maple Smoked Chicken With Cauliflower
ingredients: 6 chicken cutlets | 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese, cubed | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme leaves | 1 head cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place bread cubes in a large baking dish. Place cutlets in a single layer on top. Spread cream cheese evenly over top. Cover with thyme and top with cauliflower. Drizzle with maple syrup. Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spaghetti and Vegetables in Puff Pastry
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 4 red chilies, finely chopped | 1 frozen fat-free frozen whipped topping, thawed | spam pastry
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to pkg directions. Drain and cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, combine with thawed whipped topping, finely chopped chillies and bamboo shoots. Cut pastry into 6 rounds and line a 20cm loose based cake tin. Place pastry rounds onto top of the spaghetti and spread evenly with the mixture. Cook in a moderately hot oven for 6 - 7 minutes. Remove from oven and turn out onto a cake rack. Serve with extra whipped topping if desired.

title: Avocado and Black Water Chestnuts Salad
ingredients: 4 large avocados ( peeled, stoned and finely chopped ) | 500 g bean sprouts ( trimmed and cleaned ) | 1/4 cup water chestnut ( shucked and finely chopped ) | 150 ml rice wine or 150 ml dry sherry | 2 teaspoons instant skim milk powder
instructions: Combine the avocados and sprouts in a large bowl and mix with the water chestnuts. Heat the dry sherry in a small saucepan until it begins to bubble, then remove from the heat and add the hot sherry mixture and skim milk. Pour the liquid of the hot sherry into the avocado mixture and stir until well combined.

title: Pasta Carbonara
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 1/4 cup sherry | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Cook the spaghetti, drain. Sauté the sherry over a medium heat for about 3 minutes or until lightly coloured. In a large bowl, combine the yolk with the drained spaghetti. Add the pasta and sauce and mix carefully until heated thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: cream,marsala wine,mustard powder,shrimp,lima bean,cherry compote juice,cod,pistachio
title: Mustard and Seafood Feast
ingredients: 2 cups canned shelled cooked shrimp | 2 cups cherry flavored beans or 2 cups fava beans | 2 cups shredded cod | 1 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/2 cup shelled pistachio | 1 cup marsala wine | 1 can lima beans, drained
instructions: Rinse shrimp and reserve juice. Stir together sour cream, mustard and 1/4 cup pistachios. Blend in remaining ingredients, add shrimp and mix well. Spoon over fish, marinate in refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Serve atop crabmeat, shrimp and noodles.

title: Sauteed Lemongrass and Sun Dried Tomato
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, in oil | 3/4 cup fresh italian breadcrumb | 1/4 cup lemongrass, chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, stems removed
instructions: Heat olive oil in heavy nonstick frypan over medium heat. Drain sundried tomato, reserving oil. Add reserved oil to same pan. Add bread crumbs, lemongrass and mustard powder. Cook mixture until thick and toasted, about 3 min. Place mushrooms and tomatoes in a warm shallow dish.

title: Chili Cheese Spread ("crunchsticks")
ingredients: 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh horseradish | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons chili ( or dried, chili flakes to be hot ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine cheese, horseradish, chili flakes, and vinegars together in a bowl. Serve as topping for sandwiches, burgers or sandwiches.

title: Low Fat Mango Chutney Salad With Chipotle Blue Cheese Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup mango chutney, such as major grey | 1/3 cup roasted sweet peas | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, pureed, from a jar | 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, mango chutney, sweet peas, chipotle puree, and blue cheese. Chill until ready to serve. Season with salt and pepper until flavors blend, and serve over greens, chips, or in bread cubes.

Random Ingredients: pork,celery seed,asiago cheese,snow pea,lemon pepper seasoning,turkey
title: Pizzaria
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground turkey | 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/4 cup light asiago cheese ( grated ) | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 lemon pepper seasoning | 6 -8 snow peas
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order to form 1lb meat mixture in a large skillet on medium heat. Cook until desired consistency is achieved. Serve with pasta of your choice.

title: Linguine With Veggies and Tofu
ingredients: 1/4 lb tofu | 1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded | 1/4 celery rib, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1 lb linguine | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. Cut tofu crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Coarsely chop tofu. Toss tofu with 2 tablespoons oil, garlic, rosemary, and green onions.

Random Ingredients: marinade,coriander seed,ginger garlic paste,bow tie pasta,szechuan peppercorn,kielbasa,bread,oregano
title: Ebi (Japanese Home Fries)
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta ( uncooked ) | 1 1/4 lbs kielbasa or 1 1/4 lbs other smoked smoked sausage, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano | 2 1/2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1/4 cup country-style dry bread, crumbs | 1/4 cup marinade
instructions: Heat deep fat fryer to 375°f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie rigate at a boil, stirring occasionally and draining, about 12 minutes. Drain. Heat grill or grill pan to medium high. Add kielbasa or other smoked sausage to skillet.

Random Ingredients: veal,purpose flour,parmigiano reggiano cheese,raspberry,olive oil,brown sugar
title: Fried Sauerkraut With Glazed Fribs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 pounds ground veal | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or other light tasting oil | 1 cup brown sugar | 2 cups raspberries | 1/2 cup coarsely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Mix flour with a pinch of salt in a large bowl. Dredge ground veal in the seasoned flour, tapping off excess. In a deep fryer or large heavy skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. When the oil is ready, add the meat and brown quickly as you can. Drain the meat and return it to the pan. Add the brown sugar and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar is fully absorbed. While the meat is browning, remove raspberries from their shells and stir in. Drain the juice from half a can of juice and scrape the bottom of the pan as you pour a bit of this into the fondue. When the fondue is finished, add the raspberries. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until excess liquid evaporates, about 5 to 10 minutes. The fondue should be deep, golden brown and very sticky. Add the cheese and stir. Serve hot.

title: The Best Simplified Filled Wafer
ingredients: 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 packets vanilla wafers ( optional ) | 1 packet instant vanilla wafers ( dry ) | 1 packet chicken bouillon ( optional ) | 1/4 cup vegetable | 1 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 2 slices prosciutto, finely chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 -3 tablespoons butter
instructions: In a bowl, mix together 1/2 tbsp yogurt, garam masala and vanilla wafers. Spray a 8x8 glass baking dish with pam and press the plain wafers into the dish. Top with the yogurt mixture.. Pour the instant vanilla wafers on top of the toast. Add the chicken bullion, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 3 days depending on how thick you cut the wafers or how thick the yogurt is. About 45 minutes. Remove the cream from the refrigerator 10 minutes before baking the wafers. Spread the cream on the cream. Top with the chopped prosciutto. Heat oil or butter in a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Lightly sprinkle the top of the cream with the yogurt mixture. Spread on the prosciutto. Bake until crispy 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,bok choy,chicken breast,french haricot vert
title: Grilled Lamb and Bok Choy Skewers With French Haricots Verts and Thorns
ingredients: 16 slices boneless leg of lamb | 1 tablespoon dried french haricots vert, broken into 2 lengths | 80 g bok choy | 4 large firm but firm steamed chicken breasts
instructions: Rinse the lamb with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Thread the lamb onto 12 metal skewers and coat with the haricot vermicelli bean and french haricots vermicelli blend. Brush each skewer with oil. Put the chicken on a rack in a broiling pan and top with the steamed bok choy and legs and leave at room temperature for 30 minutes. Cook the skewers by brushing them with some oil and putting them on a grill pan and grill for 7 - 10 minutes or until they are cooked to your liking. Remove the skewers from the pan and leave until required. Meanwhile, cook the bok choy on a grill pan on the high setting for 5 - 7 minutes or until it has softened, then cut through the top just enough to expose the leaves. Serve immediately with steamed vegetables and drizzle over a little melted butter.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,rump roast,olive,green chilies,green bean,milk,nonfat milk,cardamom seed
title: Moorish-Style Beef or Vegetables
ingredients: 1 rump roast ( about 2lbs. ) | 2 cans diced green chilies ( you can sub 1 can of whole and drained green chilies ) | 1 can stuffed olives ( drained ) | 1 can fat-free evaporated milk | 3 1/2 teaspoons cornflour | 2 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds ( optional ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons fat-free evaporated milk | 4 cups chopped mixed vegetables ( as desired ) or 4 cups chopped fresh vegetables ( as desired )
