instructions: Cut roast in half and season evenly with salt and pepper. Put meat on a foil lined baking sheet. In a bowl, combine chopped jalapeno, chiles, olives, and evaporated milk. Season with salt, pepper, and cardamom and stir well. Pour over meat and roast. Cover with foil and bake in a preheated 325 degree oven for 90 minutes. Add veggies to individual serving servings with gravy.

title: Maggie's Cherry Rice
ingredients: 500 g sweet rice | 400 -500 g cherries ( not over-ripe ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 tablespoon capers, preferably in brine, drained, washed and quartered ( optional )
instructions: Wash the rice in several changes of water. Drain thoroughly and add enough boiling water to cover it by 2cm. Cover and leave for 2 hours. Drain the rice and, if using, add to the boiling water and allow to stand for 30 minutes more. Drain the cherries and add to the rice with a small pinch or two of salt. Serve with a sprinkle of capers if using.

title: Cranberry-Sake Dipping Sauce(Japanese)
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon sea salt ( omit if using a preservative free, low sodium version ) | 5 tablespoons dried non-hydrogenated soy sauce ( see note ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Place cranberries in a small bowl. Sprinkle with salt to cover. Let drain for 30 minutes to hour. Drain any excess liquid. In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce and seasoning packet with the cranberries. Drain cranberries and combine with soy sauce mixture. Heat a skillet coated with nonstick spray over medium heat. Dip half of the soaked cranberries in the soy sauce mixture, then dredge them in the cereal mixture. Place in the skillet. Repeat with remaining cranberries. Heat for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown. Note, if using nonstick spray, use a vegetable spray instead of the nonstick spray.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,brown sugar,vanilla extract,chili,red curry paste,corn flake,green chili pepper,clove
title: Spicy Korean Lamb
ingredients: 1 boneless leg of lamb, cut into serving pieces | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups canned green chili peppers, cleaned and roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon ground star ground cloves | 1 teaspoon ground chili ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chili ( optional )
instructions: Cut lamb into serving pieces. Mix together curry paste, stock, sugar, vanilla and seasonings. Pour over lamb, cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Preheat oven to 450°f with rack in lower third. Place lamb on rack in roasting pan with drippings. Roast uncovered for 30 minutes, basting occasionally. Do not overcook.

title: Steak and Jicama Wrap
ingredients: 4 lbs flank steaks, trimmed but cut into 3/4 inch strips | 1 lb jicama, peeled, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 cup finely chopped fontina | 1 1/2 cups cooked couscous | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 pinch cayenne ( or to taste ) | lettuce leaf ( to garnish )
instructions: In a bowl, marinate the beef with 1 cup of chopped fontina for 10 minutes tossing them often. In a skillet with tight fitting lid, saute in a tablespoon of fish sauce for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,marjoram,gelatin,lemon juice zest,cashew,peanut butter,iceberg lettuce,pancetta
title: Torta de Fagioli al Pien (The Secret to Making Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cashews | 1/4 cup grated peanut butter | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon chili oil | 1 small lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon gelatin | 2 cups chopped iceberg lettuce
instructions: Make the dressing & add the peanut butter, basil, marjoram, chili oil, lemon zest & juice. Add the gelatin & set aside. To make the veggie mix, mix the cashews & peanut butter, then add the chopped lettuce & mix well. Serve with grilled eggplant slices or toasted pita bread.

title: Garlic Cream for French Bread Loaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup french dressing | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 teaspoons dried basil | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the french dressing, half and half, garlic and baking powder. Mix well. Spray a loaf pan with cooking spray and pour mixture into pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until a nice loaf is toasted. Sprinkle with basil when ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,monterey jack cheese,chicken thigh,pork tenderloin,fruit,milk,maraschino cherry,yellow cornmeal
title: Cherry Crusted Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup light monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup evaporated milk | 3/4 cup canned mandarin orange juice or 3/4 cup canned milk | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dried maraschino cherries | 8 ounces frozen mixed fruit, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut pork tenderloin crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place in shallow, buttered baking dish. Add cornmeal. Coat with 1/3 cup monterey jack cheese. Bake on center rack of oven until pork is golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and sprinkle with additional 1/3 cup monterey jack cheese. Stir orange juice, remaining 1/2 cup milk, liquid smoke, and maraschino cherries in medium bowl. Drizzle over pork and return to oven. Bake until pork is hot and beginning to shrink away from bread, about 25 minutes. Sprinkle remaining 1/3 cup monterey jack cheese over pork and bake 5 to 10 minutes longer, until cheese is melted and bread is heated through. Serve pork with mixed fruit.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,grapeseed oil,white vinegar,pickle,taco seasoning mix,plantain,pork,flat leaf parsley
title: Mountain Trash Poblano (Plantain, Sweet Potato, Shiitake )
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground pork | 1/2 pound sliced plantains, unpeeled | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil, divided | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 3 pickles, halved
instructions: Brown pork, plantains, and 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil in a skillet over medium heat. Remove from skillet and mash with a potato masher. Stir in taco seasoning mix, ricotta cheese, parsley, and vinegar. Stuff filling into plantains with 2 pickles halves.

Random Ingredients: bean,nori,heavy whipping cream,greek yogurt,sharp cheddar cheese,egg noodle,bread
title: Cheddar Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 box yellow egg noodles | 1 carton plain greek yogurt | 1 can refried beans ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 12 slices bread | 1 egg noodles, cooked | 1 cup heavy whipping cream, about | assorted garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the egg noodles in the pot and cook until tender but firm, about 5 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: onion,snow pea,cardamom,curry leaf,french bread,ketchup,red wine vinegar
title: Sweet Potato, Snow Pea, and French Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cubed sweet potato | 1 cup fresh snow pea, trimmed and cut diagonally into strings | 4 tablespoons chopped onions | 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon curry leaf | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Place sweet potato in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Simmer over medium low heat until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and reserve cooking water. Chop sweet potato, stir in snow peas, onion, vinegar, curry leaves, cardamom, and ketchup. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Goat Cheese and Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 2 raspberries | 1 bunch green jalapeno, seeded and finely diced | 2 slices prosciutto | 1 ounce goat cheese, cut into 8 wedges | 1 teaspoon dark rum, or as needed
instructions: Wash and hull the raspberries, and coarsely chop the raspberries and jalapenos. Set aside. Place the proscuitto on a small plate, and pound with a pinch of salt to remove some of the salty taste. Sprinkle half the minced jalapenos with goat cheese, and roll up to make a package, twisting it as needed to fit. Arrange rolled raspberries over thick slices of warm rum, drizzle over any remaining rum and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,cream cheese,black soy sauce,cayenne pepper,dill sprig,dark rum,head iceberg lettuce
title: Creamy Italian Sub
ingredients: 1 lb cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon dark dark rum | 1 tablespoon fresh dill sprigs | 1 tablespoon fresh dill sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( to taste ) | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup dark rum ( optional )
instructions: To make the dressing, in a small bowl, stir together the cream cheese, 1 tablespoon of dark rum, half the dill/cilpills, 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne, and the celery. Cover and refrigerate. To make the sandwiches, in a small pan, melt together 1 tablespoon of dark rum, 1 tablespoon dark rum, half the dill/cilpills, half the cayenne, and half the celery. Cover, and refrigerate. To assemble, line a small plate with the shredded lettuce, and top with the shredded cream cheese mixture. Place the remaining torn lettuce leaves on top of the cheese, and spread with the remaining 2 tablespoons dark rum. Serve immediately.

title: Pepperoni Calzones
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni, cut in strips | 2 cups shredded mexican-style cheese | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Spread pepperoni on a sheet of parchment paper. Place on a sheet in a single layer. In a medium bowl, mix together cheese, sesame oil and vinegar. Brush pepperoni with a little of the vinegar mixture. Bake in a preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese is bubbly and pepperoni is lightly browned.

title: Crostones
ingredients: 20 white pearl onions | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the onions. Place them in a bowl covered in saran wrap and shake it to coat them evenly. Place on a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees until golden brown, stirring every 10 minutes for 1 hour. Drain, toss with flour and serve. If you like the onions on top, toss with corn chips. Yum.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,white rice,onion soup mix,barley,marinara sauce,walnut
title: Spanish Rice Balls With Walnuts, and Key Lime Juice
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 cups day old white rice, rinsed and drained | 1 cup finely chopped walnuts | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups marinara sauce | 1/2 - 1 cup hot buttered barley | 2 tablespoons fresh key limes or 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Mix rice, nuts, and onion soup mix in a bowl. Stir in marinara sauce. Add more sauce if mixture is too dry. Roll about 1/8 - 1/4 inch in diameter balls and place on a large baking sheet. Cover loosely with foil and refrigerate until well chilled, about 7 hrs. If you have any leftover rice, place balls in a freezer bag and crush with rolling pin. Return to baking sheet and freeze until firm and slightly frozen, about 1 - 2 hours. To serve, place frozen balls in a dish and coat lightly with butter.

title: Pickled Jalapeno Peanuts
ingredients: 2 pounds jalapeno chiles | 4 pounds unsalted peanuts, shelled
instructions: Slice the top and bottom off the chiles. Fill a large stock pot with water and bring to a boil. Pour in the chiles and allow them to boil uncovered, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer to a clean cloth jar or plastic bag to allow excess water to drain. Cover with a kitchen towel and allow to steam dry for 2 weeks to eliminate excess moisture. Pick jars and cloth bag with peanuts out of water, then let dry completely. Store in a cool dark place for up to 6 months.

title: Chinese Oeryster Flavored Stock
ingredients: 1 packet chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves ( fresh or dried )
instructions: Boil the broth and dissolve the bouillon in it. Stir in the oyster sauce and oregano.

title: Green Chile Chips III
ingredients: 1 can canned diced green chile peppers, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, or to taste | 1 package tortilla chips, broken
instructions: Mix green chile peppers with chile juice, and lemon juice in a microwave safe bowl. Cover, and cook on high in the microwave until sauce is thickened, about 10 minutes. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,cherry,dark rum,chive,bow tie pasta,savory
title: Kaffir Lime Cream Pasta
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta ( ziti, or angel hair ) | 6 -8 small cherry tomatoes ( i've used plum tomatoes also ) | 1/4 cup sweet dark rum | 2 tablespoons chives ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon saffron lime leaf ( chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon savory
instructions: In a 9x13 baking dish, place cherry tomatoes. Add a small splash of rum to keep them from turning dark in a little bit. Pour some olive oil. Sprinkle with some of savory. Set tomatoes aside. Drain pasta and return to pot. Sprinkle with remaining rum. Toss with tomatoes. Cook uncovered for 30 minutes or until pasta is tender and sauce has thickened slightly. Drain. Add some chives. Sprinkle with some of the saved savory. Serve over hot pasta and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lentil,grape tomato,pea,rye bread,olive oil cooking spray
title: Bread and Lentil Salad
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray, or as needed | 2 cups dry lentils | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1 pint grape tomatoes | 4 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a large rimmed baking sheet with olive oil cooking spray. Bring lentils, peas, and tomatoes to a boil in a large pot. Cover the pot and reduce heat to low. Simmer until peas are tender, about 20 minutes. Place rice, lentils, and raisins in a large serving bowl.

title: Chipotle Garlic Steak
ingredients: 2 -3 chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth ( or water ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons olive oil
instructions: Place the chiles in a mortar, pound well and place in a mortar with a tablespoon of the water. The chiles will spread out. Add vinegar or stock and olive oil and mix well and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Falafel-Style Chickpeas and Peppers
ingredients: 4 cans garbanzo beans, drained | 1 jar sliced pepperoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place garbanzo beans, peppers, and pepperoni into a 2 quart baking dish.

title: Apple, Quinoa and Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: 4 cups quinoa | 1 cup diced apple | 1/4 cup cracked chicken ( such as canola or salmon )
instructions: Rinse 3 cups of quinoa thoroughly with fresh water. Bring 8 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Remove from heat and let sit covered for 20 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a dry frying pan, combine the quinoa with the apple and cracked chicken and saute over medium high heat for 2 minutes. Pour liquid into the quinoa mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,rice wine,cheese,grain white rice,scallion
title: Sopa De Frijoles Con Cacina
ingredients: 16 ounces cheese, mexican blends, monterey jack, cheddar, monterrey jack, etc | 8 scallions, sliced thin ( green onions, scallions only ) | 8 ounces red kidney beans ( about 2 cans ) | 2 -3 cups white rice, cooked ( use your favorite method ) | 2 teaspoons rice wine
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Drain beans and set aside. Melt cheese in a medium size non stick skillet over medium heat and quickly fry the scallions until golden brown, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Place cooked rice, cheese, scallions, and kidney beans in a large serving bowl and mix together. Heat remaining 1 - 2 tbs rice wine in a skillet over medium heat until bubbling. Pour over rice mixture and stir until hot and bubbling through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 3 - 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,blueberry,thai red curry paste,chicken wing
title: Chicken and Blueberry Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 bottle thai red curry paste | 1 package frozen whole-grain french-fried chicken wings, thawed | 1 package fresh blueberries | 1 loaf focaccia bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place curry paste in a resealable plastic bag.

title: Calde Verde
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 2 cups fresh lime juice | 1 cup beef chuck, diced
instructions: Place fish in a non metallic dish. Add lime juice and beef. Marinate for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: lamb,blueberry,sun tomato oil,green cardamom pod,penne,daikon radish
title: Kebab With Pineapple Kaftas
ingredients: 600 g fresh pineapples or 600 g canned pineapple, drained ( 6oz/170g weight, with pineapple juice ) | 200 g daikon radishes, peeled | 1 bunch green cardamom pod | 1/3 kg lamb, cut into 2. 6 cm cubes | 200 g roasted australian berta mixed berries, rinsed and patted dry with paper towel | 10 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Place the pineapples in a microwave safe serving bowl, cover and microwave on high for about 10 minutes or until softened and roughly pulped. Put the daikon, cardamom pods, lamb, pasta and tomatoes in an ovenproof dish. Pour the pineapples over the top. Cover with foil and microwave on high for 10 minutes. Uncover and let stand for 5 minutes or until all the liquid has been absorbed.

title: Tapioca-Glazed Lamb & Broccoli
ingredients: 1 teaspoon tapioca flour | 6 cloves, crushed | 1 package frozen broccoli florets | 12 -18 ounces trimmed lamb chops or 12 -18 ounces trimmed boneless lamb chops, cut in 1 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons capers, drained, rinsed and dried | broccoli ( optional )
instructions: Place lamb pieces in a shallow glass dish. Sprinkle with crushed garlic cloves and set aside. Place defrosted frozen broccoli florets in a separate shallow dish or ziploc bag. Sprinkle with salt and allow steaming.

title: Geeres (Greek Breaded Condensed Milk Balls) (Kisali)
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs, dry and salted, crumbled fine | 2 cups half-and-half cream, divided | 4 tablespoons ghee, melted
instructions: Mix well bread crumbs with 1 cup half and half, breaking up lumps with your fingers as you form. Dump mixture on a well buttered board, cover with a towel and let rest for 15 minutes. Shape into small balls about 1 1/2 in diameter. Heat ghee in a skillet over medium heat and fry balls over medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

title: Dulce De Leche Cheese
ingredients: 3 tablespoons greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a plastic container, stir together the yogurt and sugar and season with salt and pepper. Cover and chill for at least 5 hours. Using a slotted spoon, drain off any excess liquid and spread into an 8 to 12 inch tart mason jar with a removable bottom. The cheese will expand and expand in volume. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until hardened, at least 1 week. Slice or crumble into bite sized pieces and serve.

title: Beer Chips and Chips
ingredients: 6 cups self-raising flour | 3/4 cup tequila
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200c/390f/gas place the flour in a well greased and oiled plastic container, add the tequila and mix together until the mixture comes together into a firm dough. Break half an hour into to the oven with the top half of the oven off, leave for 10 - 12 mins, until it's cooked to your liking. Remove it from the oven and slice into 1 slices. If you don't like chips break them in half and place on paper towelling to drain some of the oil out of the bag. And let them dry off under a cold tap for 20 minutes or until they're dry out. These can be stored and used for other recipes, just as long as they're stored in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,chicken broth,dark brown sugar,cremini mushroom
title: Mushroom Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup cremini mushroom, cleaned and sliced | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 8 tablespoons chicken broth ( or 2 cups homemade chicken stock ) | 1 tablespoon cake flour ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, add the dark brown sugar and mushrooms and cover and simmer for about 10 minutes. In a small bowl, add 1/4 cup of the chicken broth to 2 tablespoons of the cooking liquid and mix well until it becomes clear and a little sticky. Place the remaining 2 tablespoons of sour cream and 1/4 cup of the broth into a saucepan, add the flour and mix well. Whisk in the flour for just a moment. Serve warm or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,bonito flake,romaine lettuce,cherry tomato,fennel seed,jam
title: Japanese Sour Jalebi Salad
ingredients: 2 medium romaine lettuce, washed, spun dried & shredded | 1 cup chopped fennel seed | 2 tablespoons bonito flakes, dried | 1 teaspoon jam, sweetened ( matchstick size ) | 2 tablespoons dried cherries tomatoes, crushed | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle the top with chopped mint leaves. Serve.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup currants | 1 pint ice cream, softened
instructions: Place currants in a strainer along with the ice cream. Place over a bowl and shake until the currants have been thoroughly coated with the ice cream. Chill before serving.

title: Ziti Mexican
ingredients: 1 pound dry ziti pasta | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook ziti for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Beef Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/3 cup soy yogurt | 1/2 cup beef flavored soy yogurt
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except yogurt, and marinate in refrigerator 4 hours, tossing occasionally. Preheat broiler and line a baking sheet with foil. Scoop meat mixture onto prepared baking sheet. Broil 3 - 5 minutes per side, until no longer pink, turning once. Spoon over the yogurt and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,fig,linguine,dark soy sauce,beef brisket
title: Steamed Beef With Figs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup beef stock or 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup dried fig | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 slice prepared beef brisket or 1 slice boneless tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup soy sauce, beef and stock in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until heated through about 5 minutes. Place figs in a single layer on a steamer or steamer basket. Cover and steam over boiling water for 15 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and cut through scored lines. Spoon enough into a small bowl to serve 4. Cut the beef with a knife into 1/2 inch wide slivers. Serve with figs and 3 tablespoons of dark soy sauce. Garnish with 1/2 tablespoon of dark soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,nonfat milk powder,cornmeal,ladyfinger,ice
title: Cornbread-French Silk
ingredients: 1 box fat free italian salad dressing mix | 4 cups cornmeal | 2 tablespoons nonfat dry milk powder | 1 3/4 cups crushed ice | 8 -10 fresh ladyfingers
instructions: Mix the salad dressing mix with the cornmeal and the dry milk powder in a large bowl. Fold in the cold crushed ice. Line a 9 pie pan with wax paper or parchment paper and spread out the mixture. Top with more crushed ice. Pour in the cornbread mixture and smooth the top. Cut up the ladyfingers and arrange on top of the cornbread. Pour more crushed ice into the pan, then spoon more of the liquid around the ladyfingers. Keep refrigerated until needed.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,cherry,chili flake,pistachio,chicken breast,red onion,mustard powder
title: Chicken Chilli
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, sliced into thin strips | 1 red onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup slivered pistachios | 1/4 cup chopped dried cherries or 1/4 cup raisins | 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dried cherries
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in a tightly closed container. The chilli will last up to 2 weeks in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pumpkin puree,chocolate,feta cheese,corn flake,sherry wine
title: Red Pepper Crunch
ingredients: 150 g feta cheese, crumbled | 150 g pumpkin puree or 150 g pumpkin pie spice | 200 g chocolates, your favourite chocolate, melted | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon corn flakes, for garnish ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl mix the feta, pumpkin, chocolates, sherry, red pepper flakes and cornflour until thoroughly combined. Use as much or as little as you want for desired colour and texture. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving, or you can leave it overnight.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,jonathan apple,star anise,brown basmati rice,red chilies
title: Spiced Browned Rice
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 red chilies, deseeded and chopped | 4 star anise, crushed | 1 tablespoon sunjerry or 1 tablespoon lancashire beans, roughly chopped | 250 g brown basmati rice, rinsed, drained
instructions: Mix the mustard, chillies, star anise and sunjerry together. Add the rice. Stir and toss to coat well. Cover and leave to chill for about 30 minutes or until it has absorbed most of the liquid.

title: Hawaiian Salsa
ingredients: 8 ounces tomato paste, canned | 2 stalks celery, minced | 2 tablespoons dried parsley leaves, minced | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 4 tablespoons flour
instructions: In a 2 qt saucepan cook tomatos, stirring, until slightly browned. Add celery, parsley, and tomato paste.

title: Furikake (Japanese Daikon Kimchii)
ingredients: 1 small daikon radish | 2 lbs sweet italian sausage
instructions: Peel the daikon and slice lengthwise into 1/8 inch long strips. Slice the sausages lengthwise into 1 long pieces. Place them in a large, heavy skillet. Put the daikon sticks, sliced sausages and hot water in the skillet and bring to a boil, skimming off any foam that rises to the top. Cover and continue cooking until all the daikon has been cooked, about 25 minutes. Uncover the skillet. Cover and continue cooking until the daikon is completely dry, 10 to 20 minutes longer. Remove from the heat and cool. The daikon will keep tightly covered in the refrigerator for several days. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Spicy Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh snow peas ( i used peas from costco but cut back to 4 pods ) | 1/2 cup milk raisins | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Boil the peas for three minutes or until soft and drain. Drain immediately. Rinse under cold water and drain again. Toss with enough water, chili flakes or additional pepper flakes to taste. Serve.

title: Simple Microwave Spanish Green Olives
ingredients: 1 small green olives | catsup
instructions: Drain the olives and pat the green olive into the base of a microwave safe glass bowl with a lid. Add enough sauce to cover the olives by 1/4.

Random Ingredients: blackberry,sugar snap pea,mustard seed,kielbasa,food coloring,chicken bouillon powder
title: Kielbasa and Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa, in italian sausage link | 14 ounces sugar snap peas, in their bags | approx. 5 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon powder | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped frozen french fresh blackberries or 1/3 cup frozen sugar snap pea | food coloring ( optional ) | fresh blackberries ( optional, to serve ) ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, cook kielbasa on med. High heat until it begins to brown slightly on all sides. While kielbasa is browning drain the cooked kielbasa and set aside. Place all other ingredients into the skillet. Stir constantly, till all sugar snaps start to stick. Add kielbasa, mix well, cook on med. Low about 20 minute, until sugar snaps are nice and soft. Serve hot over fresh blackberries.

title: Easy and Delicious Tex Mex Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs. salmon fillets | picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Spray a shallow roasting pan with cooking spray. Place salmon on roasting pan, fat side down. Sprinkle salmon with picante sauce. Bake 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white zinfandel wine,heavy whipping cream,ham,romano cheese
title: Ham Zinfandel
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream | 8 ounces of thin boniato ham, cut in bite size pieces | 2 ounces grated romano cheese | 3 tablespoons white zinfandel wine
instructions: Cook zinfandel until it starts to thicken. Heat heavy cream in saucepan, add ham, cheese and wine. When cream starts to steam pour over ham zinfandel.

title: Labaanese Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups rice flour ( or thick whole wheat flour ) | asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients. Fry it in a non stick pan. Serve hot or cold.

title: Hungarian Beer
ingredients: 2 cans beer | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds
instructions: Warm the beer, but be careful not to overheat it. Add 1/2 tbsp of poppy seeds to each cup. Garnish each cup with a few seeds in the center of each cup.

Random Ingredients: chuck,baking potato,pinto bean,xanthan gum,parmigiano reggiano cheese,greek yogurt,non milk,black eyed pea
title: Tortilla Burger (Healthy)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 cup non-fat milk | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 2 lbs baking potatoes, large, scrubbed and cut lengthwise into 6 wedges | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 container plain greek yogurt or ( 16 ounce ) container low-fat greek yogurt
instructions: Set the burger maker on the high setting and prepare 4 medium size hamburger molds according to manufacturer's instructions. Meanwhile, combine the parmigiano reggiano cheese, milk, xanthan gum and 1 can pinto beans in the bowl of a food processor, and process until smooth. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the potato wedges in a large baking pan and bake until tender crisp or golden brown, about 55 minutes. Remove and set aside. Remove the skins from both molds and place them on a piece of aluminum foil or a wire rack to cool for a few minutes. Using your hands, shape mixture into burger molds about 6 in diameter. Place the potato wedges on the hamburger mixture in a large oven safe dish. Spread the yogurt on top of burger, and top with the cheese mixture. Wrap dish and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve with a bowl of greek yogurt or sour cream, if desired.

title: Johnny Jalapeno's Easy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 12 large jalapenos, sliced | 6 stalks celery, sliced | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 2 large eggs
instructions: In a hot, clean skillet, over medium heat grill or saute the jalapenos and celery with the salad dressing. Stir fry over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, beat the eggs. When the eggs are done, toss in the jalapenos and celery. Heat till eggs are done and bubbly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,oregano,baby spinach leaf,saffron thread,horseradish,green cardamom pod
title: Saffron-Stuffed  Baby Spinach (Paneer Makhani)
ingredients: 2 lbs baby spinach leaves ( about 4 cups total weight ) | 2 cups mild-flavoured horseradish | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 3 green cardamom pods, peeled and lightly crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f place the spinach leaves and stems in a very large ovenproof dish. In a small bowl, stir together the horseradish and oregano, then pour over the spinach. Season lightly with salt. Roast the spinach, stirring once, for 6 to 8 minutes, then pour back in to the oven for 3 to 5 minutes or until wilted and beginning to caramelise slightly. Remove from the oven and leave to cool slightly. Meanwhile, in a mortar and pestle or a small bowl, mix together the baking powder, saffron and turmeric, then pour over the spinach. Crush the cardamom pods, then sprinkle on top. Remove the spinach from the oven and serve the pesto on top.

title: Asparagus Salad With Mango-Mutney Cracker
ingredients: 3 -5 asparagus spears | 1 head escarole | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup cucumber, diced | 2 tablespoons chervil, chopped | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup kahlua or 1/2 cup other coffee-flavored liqueur
instructions: Preparation of asparagus. Cut the asparagus in half, then into 1/2 inch lengths. Wash it lightly on the run end and lightly dry it under running water. Chop it into the desired sized pieces. Combine all ingredients and mix. Let it stand for a few minutes then serve at once.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,chicken bouillon cube,red pepper flake,lasagna noodle,corn,sausage meat,molasses,pineapple
title: Hawaiian Meat Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pound meaty sausages, casings removed | 1 can crushed pineapple slices in juice, drained | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1 package corn, frozen cut corn | 1 red pepper flake | 3 tablespoons molasses | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 packages lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place sausage links and pineapple slices in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and let sit for about 15 minutes to macerate. Drain sausage, reserving liquid and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix the ranch dressing mix, corn, red pepper flakes and molasses. Arrange cooked sausage over the bottom of a 13x9 inch baking dish, followed by layers of corn mixture and mozzarella cheese. Bake for about 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until center is bubbly and meat is browned. Cool for about 12 minutes before serving.

title: Soy Peanut Shells
ingredients: 2 cans sliced clams, drained | 1 cup light soymilk | 1 cup banana pepper, cut into strips | 3 ounces canned sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 2 ounces fresh shrimp, shelled and deveined
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the clams, soy milk, banana pepper strips and bamboo shoots. Mix well. Spoon equal amounts of the mixture into each of the two ramekins. Refrigerate until firm, at least 2 hours. Remove top rims of the ramekins, and garnish individual servings with a sprinkle of chopped peanuts.

title: Creamy Smoked Fish
ingredients: 1/4 cup vodka, divided | 6 ounces dark sesame oil, divided | 2 pounds haddock fillets | 2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Preheat a grill for medium high heat. Stir together 1/4 cup vodka and sesame oil. Brush both sides of fish with vodka mixture. Lightly oil grate. Place fillets over griller, cover, and grill for 10 minutes. Reduce grill heat to medium low and continue to grill for 10 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Add remaining 1/4 cup vodka mixture to skillet and cook on low until reduced by half, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb smoked salmon | 1 cup good quality beef broth
instructions: Rinse the salmon under cold running water, pull off the skin, cut in half lengthwise, remove the hard shell and bones. Cut into 2 - 3 inch pieces. Cover and keep the water hot. Put the salmon pieces on a heat proof dish. Place a cup to cupful of strained strained broth into a saucepan with 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring often. Meanwhile, heat the smoked salmon pieces in the broth a few at a time. Cook until the fish is cooked and flake easily with a fork. The flake will appear to be tiny bits of food particles stuck to the surface. Serve with the smoked salmon.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,pearl barley,almond,onion,bean,white pearl onion,graham cracker crumb,chive
title: Festive Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans white pearl onions, drained | 1 can white pearl onions, drained | 3 cups finely chopped almonds | 1 box graham cracker crumbs ( about ) | 1 cup finely chopped fresh chives | 1/2 cup finely shredded toasted sesame seeds | 8 ounces dried beans ( preferably red beans or red kidney beans ) | 1 -2 tablespoon prepared horseradish
instructions: Place drained beans in a greased 2 quart or larger oven proof dish. In medium bowl, stir together the onions, almonds, crumbs, chives and sesame seeds. Spoon half the bean mixture over the beans, then top with the remaining bean mixture. Sprinkle with chives and toasted sesame seeds. Cover dish with foil or baking stone. Bake, covered with foil, while baking 30 - 45 minutes or until beans are tender. Remove foil. Microwave on high 20 seconds until heated through.

title: Cafe Liebois
ingredients: 150 ml apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 60 ml hot coffee
instructions: Pour the vinegar into a non metallic, non metallic bowl, and stir in the sugar. When the sugar has dissolved, pour in the coffee. Tumble the mixture onto a wooden board, and leave to mature for about an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: nutritional yeast,corn flake,double cream,allspice,milk powder,chili powder
title: Crunchy Low Fat Cornflake Porridge
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 tablespoon ground allspice | 4 -8 ounces double cream | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1 1/2 cups skim milk powder
instructions: Blend the corn flakes and allspice until fine powder. Add cream, chilli powder, and nutritional yeast to the dry ingredients and stir until the ingredients are well combined. Slowly add the milk and combine thoroughly. If the milk does not reach the consistency you desire, keep adding milk until the liquid reaches the texture you desire. Pour the mixture into a suitable size microwave safe bowl. Using a fork, stir the mixture until well mixed. Microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring the hot mixture occasionally, to help it soften slightly. Sprinkle generously with cardamom and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tuna,tabasco sauce,bulk italian sausage,stewing beef,cilantro leaf
title: Stove-Top Italian Beef and Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can tuna, drained | 4 -8 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 5 whole hamburger round or 5 lean sausages, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the sausage and beef in slow cooker. Cover and cook on high setting 6 to 7 hours or on low 7 to 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,cubanelle pepper,puff pastry,black tea leaf
title: Chile Pepper Tarts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 cubanelle pepper, seeded and cut into strips | 1 cube puff pastry | 2 tablespoons black tea leaves
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the cubanelle pepper.

title: Baked Snapper Stefano
ingredients: 4 frozen red snapper fillets, thawed | 3 tablespoons romano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the fillets onto the baking sheet and sprinkle with romano cheese. Bake for 10 minutes, or until the fish is easily flaked with a fork.

Random Ingredients: bread,half cream,butternut squash,rose wine,celery,coconut milk,chicken bouillon cube
title: Braised Butternut Squash (Pumpkin) Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash | 16 ounces coconut milk | 8 -10 cups bread ( french or italian cut ) | 8 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup celery | 3 cups half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup rose wine
instructions: Preheat oven to about 300 degrees. Cut butternut squash into ½ inch cubes. Place into large covered roaster dish. In large bowl, mix and then add chicken broth.. In separate bowl, mix coconut milk with 1 tbsp of vegie stick cooking oil. Stir into broth in dish and then add bread crumbs and knead thoroughly. Pour mixture into a large pot and add remaining vegie stick cooking oil and celery. Cook about 5 minutes or until celery and squash start to cook. Add half & half and rose wine and mix all together. Let soup simmer approx 35 minutes until flavors marry together. Serve topped with shredded pecorino romano cheese.

Random Ingredients: spice,italian salad dressing mix,green capsicum,spinach,ginger,spaghetti squash,yellow cornmeal,farfalle pasta
title: Nepalese Spinach and Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 yellow cornmeal | 8 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 1 small green capsicum, chopped ( red bell pepper ) | 1 inch fresh ginger, peeled and chopped | 1 bag fresh spinach
instructions: Prepare squash, cut end off squash, then remove string and seeds. Cut the squash in half horizontally. Cut both into 1/2 inch slices. Sprinkle squash with 1/4 cup of yellow cornmeal, then 1/4 cup salad dressing mix, then seasoning mix and ground mixed spice. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator for at least one hour to marinate. Grease a 2 quart ceramic baking dish. Fill a large pot with water and add 1/2 tblsps cornmeal, cover and bring to the boil over high heat. Once it starts bubbling, reduce heat to medium. Stir a few times until all the mixture is a paste, then pour into baking dish and cover with plastic wrap. Let it sit for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook pasta according to package directions, or until just tender. Reserve pasta water. Cook capsicum in a skillet or wok sprayed with nonstick cooking spray until crisp, then add to pasta. Cook the spinach in a vegetable or coconut based sauce over medium heat, stirring often. When pasta is ready, drain, reserving liquid. Place drained pasta, squash, capsicum, ginger, spinach, and hot pasta liquid into baking dish. Spread evenly. Place remaining cornmeal on plate of vegetables. Dot with butter. Bake, covered, for 1 hour or until golden.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,chicken breast half,sirloin,soy sauce,red table wine,purple onion
title: Braised Beef and Beans
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 lbs sirloin, sliced thin | 1 can navy beans, rinsed and drained | 1 medium purple onion, sliced into rings | 1/3 cup red table wine, divided | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
instructions: Dissolve the soy sauce in 3 tablespoons water along with the beans, onion, and 1/2 cup of the wine in a medium skillet over medium heat. When hot, add the chicken and cook. Turn once more, add the remaining 1/2 cup wine. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cover. Simmer about 45 minutes until the meat is tender. Remove the chicken from the skillet, discarding the onion and garlic, and shred into small meatballs or chicken pieces.

Random Ingredients: egg,black peppercorn,ra el hanout spice mix,pork fillet,rice noodle,rice wine,cognac,onion powder
title: Dirty Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 kg rice stick noodles | 500 g diced pork fillets | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon cognac | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 egg, lightly beaten
instructions: Rinse rice sticks with cold water and drain. Place pork in a medium saucepan and over high heat, cook until fat begins to run away, add rice wine and stir until the wine has almost completely evaporated. Add onion, pepper, cognac, pinches of ras el hanout and salt and pepper to pan drippings. Turn heat to low and add drained rice sticks for 1 - 2 minutes, or until rice sticks begin to soften. Lightly coat a large mould with cooking spray and set aside. In a large frypan, bring water to boil. Add noodles and boil for 2 minutes. Drain noodles and set aside. Add oil to oil and heat on high until very hot but not smoking. Add pork, stir fry until browned. Add cognac and mix with pork. Add egg and mix. Serve with freshly cooked coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,bean sprout,corn flake,beef chuck roast,cayenne,noodle,olive oil
title: Beef Noodle Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck roast | 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil | 1 bag noodles ( dried ) | 16 ounces bean sprouts | 8 -10 maraschino cherries | cayenne or chili sauce | corn flakes
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch squares or so. Saute, uncovered, over medium high heat in a large pot for a few minutes. Add the beansprouts and cherry to the pot, cover, and cook on low heat for about an hour or until meat is tender. If there is any remnants of a bit of fat from the pot, uncover and add water if necessary. Remove meat, reserving any cooking liquid and add any juice back to pot to thicken. Add about 1/2 cup cooking liquid to pot and heat to a boil. Add noodles, and simmer about an hour and a half. Do not overcook. Taste and adjust seasoning with more cayenne or chili sauce if necessary. Add more cooking liquid. This stew should taste great when served over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Pearl Barley and Snow Peas (Julia Child)
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen snow peas | 16 ounces pearl barley or 16 ounces barley
instructions: Cook pearl barley according to package instructions. Put frozen peas in a food processor and process until very smooth. Drain peas and set aside. Place barley in a mixing bowl. Add peas and peas and mix well until combined. Place in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: garlic,turkey meat,lime peel,vermouth,hard egg,caribbean jerk marinade
title: Caribbean Jerk Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 8 -12 hard-boiled eggs, halved | 4 tablespoons finely chopped sweet onion tops | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons chopped fresh garlic | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet vermouth | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lime peel, finely grated | 2 teaspoons caribbean jerk marinade
instructions: Drain eggs and peel. Mash together with fork and set aside. Place all other ingredients except the marinade in small bowl. Add sugar, if needed. Add eggs and stir until well mixed. If mixture seems dry, add a little more of the marinade.

title: Gluten Free Chocolate Barley Rooibos
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 cups vegan cheese free baking cocoa | 1 cup fiesta x-rated fusion liqueur | 1/4 cup chopped pecans, toasted
instructions: Roast pearl barley for about 1 hour at 300°f combine all of the above into a saucepot, bring to a boil then simmer on low to low heat for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, allow to cool and store in the refrigerator in low to cold containers. Reheat for about 15 minutes, take out and stir in xrated fusion until melted then add the pecans. Toss with your favorite cookies or make into a protein, you may use as a stuffing for rice, veggie etc just not as good. Enjoy.

title: Achaari(Achaari Meatballs)
ingredients: 3 lbs meat, cut into small meat balls ( kofta ) | 15 -20 cherries, cut into quarters | 3/4 teaspoon ground fennel | 3/4 teaspoon ground sage | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Boil the 4th ingredient in a saucepan with 2 cups of water till the mixture begins to turn brown. The longer this cooks, the better. Pour out the water and transfer to another saucepan. Add the cut up kofta and cherries. Cover with lid. Cook over medium heat till the meat balls brake apart. Add a little water if needed. Serve on a flat pilav or on a shallow serving dish. Enjoy.

title: Aussie Style Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast | 1 can pizza sauce | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 cup apricot jam ( i bought homemade ) | 2 beefsteak tomatoes
instructions: Slice beef across grain. Spread pizza sauce on bottom half. Arrange beef and tomato halves on sauce. Add your herbs. Top with jam and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,chocolate,lamb,chicken leg,rosemary,chicken wing,chicken bouillon,chicken meat
title: Chicken and Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 pound chicken pieces | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon | 2 chicken wings, cut in half | 5 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1 cup chopped, cooked lamb ( optional ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped cooked chicken meat | 4 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 squares unsweetened chocolate
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the chicken pieces in hot water for 8 to 10 minutes, until no longer pink in the center. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, add the chicken wings, 2 sprigs rosemary, and 3 sprigs of rosemary. Cook over medium high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, or until chicken juices run clear. Transfer to a bowl. Dissolve the bouillon in about 1 cup of the water and pour over chicken. Allow to stand 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Unfold the puff pastry sheets, one at a time, and cut the sheets into 4 to 5 inch triangles. Use a 3 inch round cookie cutter to cut out circles that are 4 to 5 inches in diameter. Place about 1/2 cup chicken mixture in the center of the pastry. Dip half of the triangles in melted chocolate. Top with the remaining triangles in circles. Fold each in thirds, then crimp edges firmly. Place on a baking sheet and brush tops with more melted chocolate. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Spud Salmon Pie
ingredients: 4 fresh salmon fillets | 1 cup stock | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, grated | 1 sheet phyllo pastry ( or other ready made pastry will work )
instructions: Place fish pieces in a 9 inch square baking dish and lightly prick the bottom and the sides lightly with a fork. Sprinkle with grated nutmeg. Spread fillets evenly over the nutmeg. Preheat over to 400°f degrees. Make layers with phyllo, brushing each layer with melted butter. Bake pie at 400f for 15 to 17 minutes, or until pastry is golden.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,spinach leaf,parsley,olive,cream corn,fish sauce,cilantro leaf,red enchilada sauce
title: Fresh Corn Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 can water packed spinach leaves | 1 can sliced ripe olives, drained | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup shredded fresh parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In 2 quart slow cooker, combine all ingredients.

title: Frozen Peanut Butter Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 teaspoons grated ginger | 3 cardamom pods, crushed | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 1 cup single cream | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor, blend until smooth. Cover and chill until required. To serve, place 1 - 2 tsp of mint and 1 tbsp of the sauce in a small bowl. Cover with a dollop of cream.

title: French Maple Syrup Liqueur
ingredients: 5 tablespoons maple syrup ( or other variation ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Stir together parsley and chopped fresh parsley in a small bowl, then stir in maple syrup. Store refrigerated.

title: Grainy Date Loaf
ingredients: 2 lemons, zest of | 1/2 cup dates, diced roughly | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease loaf tin. Place peel of lemons, dried fruit and dates in a blender and process to a smooth paste. Add flour and process until smooth. Pour into loaf tin and bake for 30 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Leave in loaf tin for 20 minutes before turning out.

Random Ingredients: achiote,white onion,basmati rice,duck,soy flour,salmon fillet,cod,mung bean sprout
title: Puerto Rican Style Cod Fish Bake
ingredients: 500 g sea bass or 500 g hake fillets, cut into bite size cubes | 300 g cod or 350 g cod fillets, cut into thick bite size pieces | 100 g white onions or 3 large shallots | 50 g basmati rice | 20 g daikon radish, peeled and cut into 1 cm thick slices | 100 g mung bean sprouts ( sprouts ) | 2 tablespoons soy flour | 1/4 teaspoon achiote
instructions: The day before preparation of the fish, wash the cod fillet and cod pieces. Rinse them and dry them completely. Wash and cut them into pieces 1cm thick. Slice the onions or shallots, and mix all the vegetables in a pot. Dissolve the achiote in a cup of water and add to the vegetables. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover tightly. Simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Remove the lid during the last 20 minutes of cooking time to take off some of the pan juices. Serve the dish over a bed of rice.

Random Ingredients: pandan leaf,rice wine,lemon,swiss cheese,corn oil,monterey jack cheese,dark sesame oil,saffron thread
title: Fried Rice With Swiss Cheese and Dried Fruit
ingredients: 1 teaspoon corn oil | 3/4 lb swiss cheese, sliced thin | 3/4 lb monterey jack cheese, sliced thin | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 4 dried shiitake dried purple baby food rings ( about 12-18 rings ) ( optional ) | 3 dried chinese lemons, peel and pith removed and split in half, seeds discarded or 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 pinch saffron thread ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: In a large skillet heat 1 teaspoon of the corn oil over moderately high heat until it shimmers and swiss cheese just starts to melt, about 3 minutes. Add 2 slices of the swiss cheese and toss to melt the cheese. Set aside to keep warm. In a large frying pan, heat the remaining 1/4 tablespoon oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking and saute the baby food rings for 1 minute or until tender but not browned. Remove the rings in one layer and reserve. Add the chinese lemons to the skillet and stir until they're just beginning to turn color, 1 to 2 minutes or until they are heated through. Add the lemons to the skillet and toss to mix. Remove the rings and reserve. Add the rice wine or white wine to the skillet and stir to loosen the browned bits, about 1 minute. Scrape in the reserved swiss cheese, re heat to moderate and stir to blend. Stir in the baby food rings and stir until heated through. Stir in the saffron and sesame oil. Sprinkle with the reserved swiss cheese. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: egg,caper,extra virgin olive oil,horseradish,courgette,red curry paste
title: Horse Broiled Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 medium eggs, lightly beaten | 500 g young small courgettes, cleaned, ends trimmed and cut diagonally into 4 diagonal slices | 2 tablespoons pickled capers, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish, drained and grated | 1 teaspoon red curry paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Heat the oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas put 2 tbsp of the olive oil, the eggs, courgettes and capers in a small roasting tin and toss to coat. Brush with remaining oil and season well with salt and pepper. Heat the oven to 200c/fan 200c/gas arrange the vegetables, drizzle with remaining olive oil and bake for 20 minutes or until tender crisp. Sprinkle with curry and serve with plain boiled egg noodles. Serve with horseradish and chilli.

Random Ingredients: flour,american cheese,romaine lettuce,pasta shell,cilantro leaf,savory,chicken thigh
title: Torta Rellenos
ingredients: 4 -6 skinned, boneless chicken thighs | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1 1/2 cups grated american cheese | 1 package dry medium pasta shells, such as rotelle | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh savory | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Place chicken thighs in a deep skillet, or dutch oven with enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cooked chicken thighs in a bowl and stir in romaine lettuce, 1 cup of cheese, and 1/2 teaspoon dried savory. Prepare shells according to package directions, drain and set aside. In a small bowl, stir cilantro and savory with flour. Fill shells with chicken mixture and top with remaining cheese, pressing down to make sure cheese is completely mixed inches bake at 350 degrees f for 20 - 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red bean,meat tenderizer,asafoetida powder,sticky rice,beef tenderloin steak,tamari
title: Seared Beef Tenderloin With Red Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steaks, 1/4 inch thick | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon tamari, dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sticky rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon meat tenderizer | 12 ounces hot red beans, drained canned
instructions: Cut 2 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch strips of aluminum foil about 3/4 inch high, 5 inches long.

title: Irish Steak Tart (Or Quiche) and Leek Quiche
ingredients: 10 ounces sirloin ( about 4-inch diameter ) | 4 leeks | 3 ounces gruyere cheese | 7 tablespoons creme fraiche | 2 teaspoons mixed spice | finely grated lemon peel | fresh mint leaves | sour cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Trim of excess fat. Cut steak into six wedges, each 3/4 inch thick. Cut the meat into 10 thick slices. Cut a 1 - ½ inch round from the leek with the thick root ends, then slice into ½ inch rounds and quarter the quarters into 4 - ½ inch disks. Cut the cheese into ¼ inch cubes, and set aside. Slice or cut the leeks diagonally into ½ inch rounds, and set aside at room temperature. Cut the leeks crosswise into ½ inch disks, and set aside at room temperature. Dot 2 tablespoons of butter or lard over a medium low heat. When the butter stops foaming, cook the leeks in batches, just until black and slightly softened, about 5 minutes. Transfer the leeks to a mixing bowl. Add the gruyere cheese, creme fraiche, mixed spice, and a grating of black peppercorns. Stir to combine. Arrange half of the chard onto the bottom and up the side of a 9 - ½ inch deep pie pan. Place half the meat slices and half the leeks on top, then arrange the remaining chard over the top. Spread the gruyere cheese into the prepared dish, then scatter the leeks over the top. Bake the tart just before serving, for 35 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and lightly browned around the edges. Serve warm with sour cream. Garnish warm slices of toasted bread, such as ciabatta or rustic bread.

title: Easy Beef Steak
ingredients: 12 lbs skirt steaks, 5-6 x 1 1/2-inch | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 2 -3 pinches salt
instructions: Cut beef into serving sizes and then into strips. Mix sugar and salt. Dip meat in the sugar mixture. Serve hot with noodles and/or veggies.

title: Quick Noodle Kugel (Aka Egg Noodle Kugel Kugel, Kugel)
ingredients: 8 1/2 ounces dry egg noodles ( kugel ) | 10 ounces beef bouillon cubes ( i prefer knorr ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook egg noodles until they are tender. Drain. Meanwhile, in a microwave safe bowl, combine bouillon cubes and cardamom powder and microwave on high about 1 minute or until cubes are softened, stirring until dissolved. Pour the bouillon mixture on noodles and stir until well incorporated. Turn noodles onto a large baking sheet. Cover with foil and bake until noodles are tender and bouillon cubes are melted, about 20 to 25 minutes. Serve plain or topped with sour cream.

title: Cousin Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 cup clear honey | 1/4 cup hot sauce
instructions: In a bowl, mix honey and hot sauce. Brush pork with sauce. Cook in a hot skillet over medium high heat 5 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.

title: Herbed Cod (Rinse the Water)
ingredients: 3/4 lb cod, skinned cleaned, dried and cut into 1-rib portions | 1/2 cup kirsch ( cherry brandy or white rum ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped herbs ( chervil, parsley, or chives ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons herbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary sprigs, finely chopped | 1 cup apple, peeled, cored, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Marinate the herbed cod in the kirsch, chili paste, herbs and apples for 12 to 15 hours. Drain and reserve the marinade. Heat the reserved marinade over medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until thickened. Set aside to cool. Drain the cod and pat dry. In a small bowl, stir together the confectioners' sugar and remaining marinade, then arrange cod and apple in a single layer in a lightly buttered 9 by 11 in. Oven. Spoon enough of the sauce over the fish to just cover. Dot with some of the reserved herbed cod mixture. Garnish with additional fresh herbs. Broil the fish in the middle of a preheated 350f oven for 15 minutes or until the fish is just cooked, and topping the fish with the remaining sauce. Serve hot.

title: Pancake Nabe(Vegetable Nabe)
ingredients: 6 ounces bok choy, trimmed and cut into 3/4 inch pieces | olive oil or vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly oil a 2 quart baking dish. Add the napa in batches and fry in hot oil, turning frequently until the napa turns golden on all sides, about 3 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy French Onion Dip
ingredients: 5 tablespoons arrowroot | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules
instructions: Mash arrowroot with a fork or potato masher. Heat a small skillet on medium heat. When warm, add about 1 tablespoon of the arrowroot and stir constantly for a minute or so until the mixture thickens enough to coat a spoon.

title: Homemade Chocolate Cornbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornmeal | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 package unsweetened chocolate chips, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x12 inch baking dish, or line it with parchment paper. Mix cornmeal, cabbage, chocolate, and plastic wrap, if using, together, and coat the loaf. Place on the prepared baking dish, and bake for 45 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,pistachio nut,wonton wrapper,sugar,chicken stock,turkey pepperoni,orange juice
title: Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs halibut fillets or 1 1/4 lbs other firm white fish | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup orange juice | 3/4 teaspoon sugar | 1 package wonton wrappers ( about 15-count ) | 1/2 cup pistachio nut, coarsely chopped | 14 ounces turkey pepperoni, sliced ( about 1-1/2 ounces )
instructions: Heat coals, grill, or broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil large enough to enclose fish. Place fish on sheet, and brush with shortening. In a small bowl, combine stock, orange juice and 1/4 tsp of the sugar. Place fish in a shallow nonaluminum dish. Soak 5 minutes, turning once. Lay out half the wrapper and 3/4 tsp of pistachios, then spread 1/4 cup stock mixture over each. Place a 1/4 of fish on top of 2 pistachios and 2 pepperoni slices, brush with shortening and top with remaining 3/4 tsp of pistachios. Wrap in foil. Put on grill. Cook 10 minutes. Turn over in pan. Keep the fish covered. Cook 10 minutes longer. Remove foil. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve with remaining stock mixture. Note, this recipe uses an 8 - 10 oz, skinless turkey breast, skinless chicken breast, bone in and cut into 2 pieces on the bone if using, or 3/4 oz.

title: Spiced Tomato Bread
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour ( i use whole wheat ) | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 cup tomato sauce ( i use ketchup ) | 4 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon ginger ale | 8 ounces radishes, sliced thinly | 8 slices fresh bread ( for sandwiches ) | powdered honey for topping
instructions: Mix flours, syrup, tomato sauce and salt in a mixing bowl. Add ginger ale. Add radishes sliced thin, and mix well. Dip sandwich slices into batter. Place in a greased or sprayed pan and bake until golden brown, about 15 - 20 minutes. Top with powdered honey, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red potato,lite olive oil,golden syrup,yellow bell pepper,yellow pea
title: Potted Pea & Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 ounce lite olive oil | 2 ounces yellow split peas | 4 ounces sweet potatoes, coarsely chopped | 4 ounces small red potatoes, finely chopped | 1 red bell pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat the oil and mix in all of the other ingredients. Cover, store in the refrigator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Steamed Linguine With Hot Oysters and Tamarind Rind
ingredients: 1 cup fresh tamarind paste | 4 cups steamed linguine | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/4 cup vinegar | 24 oysters, shucked
instructions: Soak tamarind in 1/4 cup boiling water for 30 seconds until soft enough to push out the outer shell. Cut tofu into 1/4 inch thick slices.

title: Hot plum tomato salad II
ingredients: 8 plum tomatoes, sliced | 1 cup red wine | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons sweet red wine
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients and place in a bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes until the tomatoes are soft, stirring well so that the mixture does not burn. Serve immediately, or leave to stand for a few hours. Reheat gently and drizzle with a little extra virgin olive oil.

title: Veg-Out - Beans and Veggies
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian refried beans | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 0.5 can pureed molasses
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a 9x13 inch pan, spread evenly. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,russet potato,topping,vegetable oil,brussels sprout,beer,english muffin
title: American Potatoes and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 pounds brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved | 2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 12 ounces beer | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 package thickened and creamy frozen whipped topping, thawed | 4 english muffins, split and toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Warm oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook brussels sprouts in the hot oil for about 5 minutes.

title: BBQ Barbecue Bread
ingredients: 4 -5 loaves french bread | 2 chicken stock cubes | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Soak bread on the bbq and grill the bread on both sides. Once bread has been grilled, stir and spread the barbeque sauce on it. Sprinkle sugar over the top.

title: Chocolate-Tofu Bites (Tofu Bites)
ingredients: 100 g soy milk chocolate | 200 g cremini mushrooms | 200 g minced beef | 200 g rice wine or 200 g dry sherry | 25 g rosemary | 50 g peppercorns | 50 g peppercorns, lightly crushed | 1/2 teaspoon whole allspice
instructions: Cut mince into tiny pieces. Prepare spice bag, place beef and spices in spice bag, pour in soy milk and seal. Marinade for at least two hours. Dip tofu bites in marinade. Set aside on wire rack and grill until dark. Serve with syrup, fresh fruit, or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,wooden skewer,key lime juice,fryer chicken
title: Lime Chicken
ingredients: 1 fryer chickens, cut up | 12 key limes, cut into segments | 1 cube chicken bouillon | wooden skewer
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange strips of chicken on skewers, and place under the broiler. When the chicken has turned golden brown, it is time to make a sauce by dissolving the chicken bouillon into 4 tablespoons of water, then drizzle the remaining 4 tablespoons of water over the top. Return the chicken pieces to the broiler for one minute, and turn them.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,plum tomato,chili powder,fruit,cream cheese,pinto bean,vanilla essence
title: Fruit & Bean Dip With Cream Cheese
ingredients: 300 g pinto beans | 250 g plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 125 g cream cheese, softened | 500 ml sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 100 g dried fruit, chopped, to decorate
instructions: Drain pinto beans reserving the water. Put them into your food processor with the tomatoes and chilli powder. Process the mixture until smooth. Place this mixture, cream cheese, sunflower oil and vanilla in a bowl, mix well. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle over dried fruit. Taste and adjust the seasoning if necessary. Chill before serving and serve on toast points.

title: Limas and Rice Stove (Caffe)
ingredients: 600 g short-grain white rice, washed and soaked in hot water | 6 ounces coffee, such as espresso ( espresso powder ) | 10 ounces soymilk ( skim milk or cream ) | 5 ounces fresh lima beans ( or other small fresh bean ) | 2 orange zest, cut into thin strips
instructions: Bring the water to the boil on the stove. In a pot, heat up a splash of brewed espresso on the stove. Add the rice and stir. Add the remaining ingredients and bring it to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and cook on high or low heat for 45 minutes. Toward the 15 minutes mark, remove from heat and serve while still very warm.

title: Spaghetti Legs (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 16 ounces all-purpose flour | 3 1/2 ounces roasted red pepper flakes, crushed
instructions: Mix flour and roasted red pepper flakes to form a paste. Roll into 1 inch long logs, and cut a slit lengthwise into each log. Cook on an oiled grill/broiler pan or under a preheated broiler. The amount will depend on the thickness of the logs. Cook about 9 minutes, turn and cook for 6 to 8 minutes longer. Place on a large piece of waxed paper, cover with plastic wrap, and allow to rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Slice paper into finger lengths or squares. These can be made in batches, and frozen for up to 2 months.

title: Tex Mex Apple Nests
ingredients: 4 large egg whites | 4 tablespoons melted ghee, divided | 1 can texas-style beans with salsa | 1 cup apple juice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place egg whites in a bowl and beat until stiff peaks form or shake bowl to remove excess egg mixture. Scoop 1 tablespoon of batter onto waxed paper, and quickly set aside. Spread 1 tablespoon ghee on a cookie sheet or tray. Spread the remaining batter into one or two nests for each nest. Arrange apple nests in circles on the melted ghee. Bake nests until crisp and golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: basil sprig,yellow bell pepper,worcestershire sauce,chili bean,part mozzarella cheese
title: Warm White Pepper Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh chili beans | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, diced | 1/3 cup basil sprig, chopped | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Soak 1 package frozen peppers in water to soften, about 10 minutes. Drain. In a medium bowl, stir together the chili beans, mozzarella, bell pepper, basil and worcestershire sauce. Place remaining 3 ingredients in a 2 qt covered casserole dish. Cover with plastic wrap. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lentil,sourdough bread,nigella seed,anaheim chilies,sharp cheddar cheese,rice,asiago cheese,spice
title: Aussie Bread and Cheese With Lentils and Nuts, 2000
ingredients: 150 g rice ( arborio or bomba ) | 2 sprigs thyme or 2 sprigs parsley | 2 red fresh anaheim chilies | 80 g dried lentils ( or green mixed lentils, green pepitas chopped, lentils with chiles de arbol ) | 4 slices sourdough bread | 1 -2 tablespoon nigella seeds ( optional but really adds to this dish ) | 1 -2 tablespoon asiago cheese ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sharp cheddar cheese ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon shiso mixed spice
instructions: Boil the rice and lentils in salted water. When the rice and lentils are tender, drain the water, add the nigella. Mash them well with a fork, then add the asiago cheese, kneading well and adding a little extra water if necessary. Spread the mixture on the bread and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 - 2 hours, until golden and crispy. Variation, instead of nigella, i like the idea of using an anaheim chile pepper instead of a mild jalapeño. You can add another hot pepper for taste.

title: Scallops-Rotisserie, Barbeque Style
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup shallot, chopped | 4 bay scallops | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/4 cup onion, chopped finely
instructions: Heat olive oil in a shallow skillet over medium high heat until sizzling. Add the shallot and scallops, lower heat, and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or until scallops are seared. Add the coffee, remove from heat, and stir.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,english cucumber,strawberry,flour tortilla,chili pepper flake,spaghetti
title: Smoky Strawberry and Prawn Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, chopped ( canned in adobo sauce, minced ) | 1 1/2 cups peeled strawberries, chopped | 1 english cucumber, diced | 2 tablespoons diced canned chipotle chiles in adobo ( minced ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 12 flour tortillas or 12 corn tortillas | 12 fresh strawberries or 12 fresh cherry tomatoes
instructions: To make the salsa, combine in bowl, chipotle and chopped chili. Add 1/4 cup water to salsa.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,spaghetti sauce,beef shank,elbow macaroni,canola oil,rotel,mirin
title: Cogy's Chinese Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 12 beef shank | 1 can diced rotel | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried shrimp-garlic sauce | 1 package elbow macaroni | 1 bottle of your favorite spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Cut the beef shank in half lengthwise, then crosswise into strips. In a large skillet with a lid heat the canola oil over medium heat. Add the shrimp and blacken the flesh until it becomes white on all sides, and becomes somewhat crispy. Don't take the film off. Drain off the oil in the pan, then add 1/2 of the beef and shrimp garlic sauce and stir until heated through. In a large pot with boiling water, cook macaroni until al dente, then drain. Remove the noodles from the water and place in your mixing bowl. Place the remaining beef and shrimp garlic sauce in the pot over a medium heat with the drained pasta, then add the canola oil and heat through. Pile the beef mixture into hot noodle bowls and top with your favorite sauce.

title: Indian Pesto Dipping Sauce for Pasta or Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup drained pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala or 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Combine pesto and garlic in a bowl. Add curry powder or garam masala. Stir to blend well.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,tortilla,pecorino romano cheese,baby spinach,yellow zucchini,parmesan cheese,lobster,cream mushroom soup
title: Grilled Lobster Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 fresh lobster, heads frozen, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped yellow zucchini | 1/3 cup chopped fresh baby spinach | 2 teaspoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup light sour cream and mushroom soup | 3 tortillas | 1/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 2 medium roma tomatoes, chopped
instructions: To prepare lobster, preheat grill pan or non stick skillet over medium high heat. Place chopped lobster in bowl.

title: Chiles Rellenos (Tortilla Canillas)
ingredients: 12 -12 ounces plain tortilla chips | 1 3/4 lbs fresh escarole, washed and dried, stems and leaves separated
instructions: Soak tortillas in water for 10 to 15 minutes. When cool enough, peel away excess fat and place on paper towels. Place an escarole in a large deep skillet and set over medium high heat. When the escarole is hot, toss in about half of the tortilla chips and top with the remaining tortilla chips and then cover with the remaining coriander. Bring to a boil, cover loosely and reduce heat. Cook, turning occasionally, until crisp.

Random Ingredients: clove,vanilla,five spice powder,onion,chicken bouillon granule,coconut syrup,egg noodle
title: Indonesian Noodles (Chicken or Pork)
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon clove | 1 dash vanilla | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons coconut syrup | 1 onion, finely chopped
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the egg noodles after they are cooked. Remove and drain noodles until slightly cooled then cut noodles into slices. Heat some coconut oil in a pan, then add about 1 or 2 tablespoons of onion and a dash of five spice powder. Fry the onion until translucent. Add the egg noodles and fry a few more seconds before adding the rest of the spices. Stir in the water, coconut syrup and chicken bouillon and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked. Add more water if needed. Serve over your favorite rice of your choice.

title: Home-Style Marinade for Beef
ingredients: 3 limes, juice and zest of | 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Mix all the ingredients. Add lamb, fish or pork bones and marinate in the fridge for 8 hours or up to 24 hours. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Works well with seafood.

title: Nut Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 package fresh fettuccine | 1 lb black forest ham | fettuccine | 1/2 cup crumbled ouzo ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint | 1 clove garlic powder
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta. Cut ham in strips. While ham is cooking, combine ouzo and mint, if desired. When pasta is just shy of done, toss with ham. Serve with crumbled ouzo mixture on top, if desired.

title: Crème Fraiche
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 pint heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix the crumbs with the cream. Press into the bottom and up the sides of a glass pie plate. Refrigerate for about 1 hour before serving.

title: Cherry and Swiss Bean Rounds
ingredients: 32 slices swiss cheese rounds | 3/4 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chervil ( or tarragon ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, or more as needed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chervil ( or tarragon )
instructions: Place a slice of cheese round on each slice of toasted bread to help keep the rounds from sticking together during the grilling process. Place a few small spoonfuls of black beans into each pepper. Sprinkle with chervil. Cook until the edges of cheese just begin to brown, or the edges are golden brown, and the filling is bubbly.

title: Quick Marinara Sauce for Chicken or Pork
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 450°. Prepare the foil for the chicken or pork. Coat foil with cooking spray. Place 1/2 cup of sauce in a cup or medium mixing bowl. Place chicken or pork in the bowl and coat with cooking spray. Spread the remaining sauce on the foil, covering the meat completely. Place on middle rack of oven. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 165 f. Allow meat to stand 30 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: fennel,boston lettuce,arborio rice,beef bouillon cube,chicken breast half,white flour,broccoli floret
title: Chicken and Broccoli Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 beef bouillon cube | 8 ounces chicken breast halves | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 teaspoon fennel, minced | 1 head boston lettuce, separated into leaves
instructions: If you are cooking rice in a covered pot, you may need to use an additional 6 cups of water. Bring water to a boil and add 1/2 cup of white flour. Reduce heat to low and add rice. Meanwhile, halve chicken breasts and cut into bite sized pieces. If you are using chicken with bone in, remove skin and fat from breast, shred. Add to rice. Cut broccoli florets into 1 inch lengths and add to rice, then add 1 tsp of fennel. After it reaches the desired doneness, place on top of the risotto. Stir and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,snow pea,heirloom tomato,cayenne pepper,onion soup mix,green
title: Hearty Noodles (No Oil)
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 6 ounces fresh snow peas, cleaned ( the kind with plenty of stems ) | 1 large heirloom tomatoes, cut into wedges ( about 3 cups, the `` cherry '' kind, about � cup ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook onion soup and oil in a 2 quart saucepan over moderate heat, stirring until soup mixture is smooth. Stir in snow peas and tomatoes, increase heat to moderately high and cook, stirring occasionally until snow peas are softened and tomatoes are heated through about 1 minute. Stir in soup mix and cook, stirring, until mixture is heated through and mixture is slightly thickened, about 3 minutes.
