Stir in green onions and cayenne, season with salt and pepper to taste and serve.

Random Ingredients: bulgur,granny smith apple,chili pepper,arrowroot,star anise,sherry,sesame seed
title: Spicy and Hot Bulgur Chutney
ingredients: 3 1/2 inches star anise | 5 large granny smith apples | 1 1/2 tablespoons arrowroot ( optional ) | 3 ounces bulgur | 1 1/2 ounces sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons sweet sherry | 2 cloves chili peppers | 2 ounces bulgur, for sprinkling
instructions: Wash chili with a damp cloth. Remove seeds and membrane, then cut to 3 or 4 inch lengths. Peel and core apples. Make sure you have enough moisture to water the whole spice with a teaspoon or so of salt as it will expand a lot during cooking. Cut into 5 inch lengths. Wash bulger in several changes of cold water until water runs clear and drain. Put sesame seeds and sherry in a heavy bottomed wok or frypan and leave for 1 - 2 minutes. Add spices and sherry, then stir to combine, adding water if necessary until moisture has dried up. Place chili and water in food processor and process to a coarse paste until smooth, then stir into bulgur. Serve warm with pita bread for a cold snack. Store in a covered jar or glass bowl in the refrigerator.

title: Smothered Beef Gyros (Asian)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 3/4-inch dice | 1 cup mango chutney or 1 cup salsa | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons grated asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Toss beef with mango chutney in a medium bowl and set aside. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat until a bead of water vaporizes within 1 1/2 seconds of contact. Arrange nori sheets on the work surface and spread 1 1/2 teaspoons nutmeg over them. Working with 1 slice at a time, spread beef out on top of each sheet.

title: Broccoli with Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 8 ounces frozen broccoli stems, thawed | 1 1/2 lbs chilies, julienned | 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese or 1/2 cup pecorino cheese, divided
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add broccoli stems and cook 2 minutes. Stir in chiles and cook one minute more. Remove from heat. Add 1/4 cup cheese and stir until melted. Serve with remaining cheese.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,red onion,lychee,ghee,pepperoni,parmesan cheese,beef bouillon cube
title: Lychee Parathread Meatball
ingredients: 300 g minced beef bouillon cubes | 1 medium red onion, finely chopped | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon pepperoni, finely chopped ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons ghee ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons egg substitute | 1/2 cup loosely packed lychees, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Melt the ghee and add to a small bowl with salt. Add the chopped onion and pepperoni and mix in. Add minced beef and egg substitute. Form into a ball and place in an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with grated parmasan cheese if you like. Bake for 20 mins. Or until it becomes just cooked. Sprinkle with coriander leaves prior to serving. Serve with spaghetti/pasta.

title: Dad's Tomatoes for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, chopped | 2 cans tomato juice | chopped fresh parsley, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place the bacon and tomato juice in the crock pot. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Sprinkle with the parsley before serving.

title: Steak Mexicana
ingredients: 4 slices beef sirloin ( thin slices ) | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme leaves | 4 teaspoons seasoned rice wine ( or dry sherry )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Place on a serving plate and serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Vegetable and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 150 g quinoa, medium grain organic | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 tablespoons parm sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh marjoram | 1 bunch asparagus, ends trimmed, trimmed, halved crossways | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, leaves separated | 100 g quinoa, medium grain organic | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh marjoram | 80 g porcini mushrooms | 80 -100 ml water
instructions: Cook quinoa in 1 1/2 cup water over medium heat, covered, stirring occasionally, for 12 to 15 minutes, or until liquid has been absorbed and quinoa is tender and liquid is absorbed. Cool completely. Cook asparagus in 1/2 cup water in a large saucepan, covered, stirring occasionally, for 10 to 12 minutes, or until just tender. Let cool slightly. Cut asparagus into 1/2 inch pieces. Place quinoa, water and sugar in a large bowl, stir well to combine. Add asparagus, lettuce, herbs and mushrooms. Toss to combine. Taste and add extra spring water if needed.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,brussels sprout,beef chuck,heavy whipping cream
title: Brussels Sprouts Borscht
ingredients: 1 pound brussels sprouts | 2 pounds beef chuck, cubed | 2 quarts heavy whipping cream | 1 cup self rising flour
instructions: Wash sprouts, and cut into halves. Place them in a pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil, and boil for 5 minutes. While the brussels sprouts are boiling, brown the chuck in a large frying pan over medium high heat. Drain off grease, and pour the cream into the pan. The brussels sprouts will shrink if they are too large. Mix the flour with 2 tablespoons of water to make a thin paste, and gently stir into the soup. Gently boil for 10 minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon. Cut the remaining sprouts in half, and add to the soup. Heat through and serve the soup with bread.

title: Quick Chicken Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 5 tablespoons tomato sauce | 5 chicken wings | 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1 1/2 lbs chinese noodles
instructions: Saute cauliflower and noodles in 2 tbsp oil for about 5 minutes over medium heat, until crisp tender. While noodles are sauteing, cut chicken wings crosswise into bite sized pieces and then fry in 2 tbsp oil until brown and cooked through.

title: Quinoa Toast
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking rolled oats ( oats if you wish ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients in bowl. Dip bread in mixture and fry in oil until golden brown on both sides.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch roux,beef broth,ice water,chicken breast half,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Baja Chicken with Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 package chicken breast halves, cut into bite size pieces | 3 tablespoons cornstarch roux | 3 tablespoons ice cold water | 3 tablespoons canned chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Place chicken in a bowl, add chicken broth, cover and marinate in refrigerator at least 20 minutes. After chicken has marinated, heat oil in a pan, fry chicken pieces just until golden brown, remove and drain on paper towels. Remove any remaining broth from the marinade in the pan. In a dish, mix the roux, water and chipotle peppers. Pour into the pan with the chicken, stirring to coat.

title: Aussie Pea S
ingredients: 225 g green peas | 450 g raspberries | 150 g frozen raspberries
instructions: Place frozen peas in pot with frozen raspberries. Bring to boil and let simmer for 5 minutes. Stir occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,okra,mexican cheese,chicken bouillon cube,asparagus,mustard seed
title: Mexican Style Okra and Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 package frozen okra with holes
instructions: In a dutch oven or other large cooking pot, cook asparagus until crisp tender, but not browned, about 4 minutes. Drain. Stir in tomatoes with green chilies, chicken bouillon cube, 1 cup of the cheese, mustard seeds and okra. Heat to boiling then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes until sauce is bubbly. Remove lid and stir.

title: Glogi With Herbs and Broth
ingredients: 8 cups watercress leaves ( about 5 ounces ) | 6 large cloves | 3 teaspoons whole cardamom seeds | 8 tablespoons olive oil ( see note below ) | 3 1/2 cups fresh strained broth or 3 1/2 cups homemade strained stock | 1 1/2 cups tequila ( or to taste ) | 3/4 cup grated romano cheese or 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese, plus more for serving ( about 1/3 cup )
instructions: Strip the stems off the cilantro sprigs, but leave the leaves whole, then place them in a colander and sprinkle the leaves with a generous pinch of salt. Set aside. Bring an 8 quart pot of water to gentle boil over high heat. Then add the cilantro sprigs and clove halves.

title: Dressed Salmon With Celery and Oysters
ingredients: 1 can pink salmon | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup celery, diced | 1 1/2 teaspoon chinese rock sugar
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Pour in plastic bag and chill. Shake container once or twice a day. To serve, slice salmon on diagonal, and top with celery or oysters. Serve with a dipping sauce of choice.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,turmeric powder,zucchini,white pepper,heavy whipping cream,cottage cheese,cream tartar,sugar snap pea
title: Indian Parsnip and Zucchini Whip
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, chopped | 1 small zucchini, chopped | 2 cups sugar snap peas ( or snow peas ) | 2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 2 -4 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground turmeric powder ( not paste )
instructions: Combine everything except cottage cheese & cream of tartar in a large bowl, mix thoroughly. Whip cream, add yogurt & cream of tartar in one bowl. Fold cottage cheese gently into mix, just till smooth & thick. Refrigerate for two hours. Put into serving dish and garnish with fresh parsley or green onions. Serve chilled enjoy.

title: Sausage or Bacon (Pigs of Doom)
ingredients: 15 limes | 5 -6 thick-cut pork or 5 -6 thick bacon
instructions: Cut a piece of heavy duty plastic wrap, about 1/8 inch deep and set aside. Fill a large pot with water, add the lime slices, and bring to a rolling boil. Once they are boiling lower the heat and simmer the water until it is just beginning to simmer.. Once you notice the water getting to simmer lower the heat of the water so it is just simmering rapidly. The longer you let it boil, the more intense flavor will develop and the shorter it cooks. Drain away the lime water and place the cooked sausage or bacon in a paper bag and close. Seal well and let it drain for a maximum of 30 minutes. You can leave it on a hard, dry surface and remove as much of the air as possible. This will make your belly rub clean and crisp. Once it has drained, slice the sausage into coin size pieces and set aside. Use a large skillet or barbecue grill for smoking. This method produces great results. Wrap your hands in plastic wrap and use them to press the sausage meat in the palm of your hand to form a layer of sausage or bacon on your hands and to make space for later on in your simmering water. This method will also press air out of the sausage. You can also wrap and fry the bacon in a fry pan until the fat is all absorbed and the bacon is half cooked. Serve the sausage or bacon in a large paper bag or bowl. You can do 3 or more servings at one sitting before you proceed to reheat the water for later. Lime slices can be flavored with black olives, paprika, marjoram, basil, or even green chile sauce to season to taste.

title: Lentil Lasagna
ingredients: 1 cup lentils, soaked in water 6 hours | 2 cups corn kernels, cooked 3 hours | 1/8 teaspoon pepper onion, minced | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, fresh grated | 9 lasagna noodles | lettuce or spinach, to serve on the side
instructions: Drain the lentils, set aside. In a saucepan, cook the corn kernels and onion over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the corn is bright green and the onion is translucent. Add the lentils, lentils and nutmeg and warm. Preheat the oven to 425°f bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the lasagna until just firm to the touch, 7 to 10 minutes drain and toss half of the noodles into the saucepan. Spread half of the lentils and 1/2 cup of the corn mixure evenly over the noodles and then half of the other half of the lentils and corn mixure. Repeat. Spread remaining noodles over the top and cover with foil. Bake, covered, on the middle shelf of the oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender, and the top is golden.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,chili oil,salt black pepper,onion,egg noodle,butter,fine bread crumb
title: Curried Noodles With Onion and Red Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 lb onion ( about 3 ) | 1/2 cup fine dry bread crumb | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 4 large eggs, lightly beaten | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Melt the butter in a sauté pan over a medium low heat and cook the onions until tender. Do not brown the onion. Stir in the bread crumbs and hot sauce and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the heat. Preheat the oven to 350°f melt the butter in another sauté pan. Add the curry paste and cook, stirring for about 3 minutes. Add the eggs and stir to a paste. Pour the egg mixture into the bread crumb mixture and stir until moistened. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for about 20 minutes, until egg have firmed, and the sauce has thickened to a creamy consistency.

title: Chipotle Relleno
ingredients: 4 pounds lamb, cut into cubes | 1/4 cup prepared polenta | 2 eggs, beaten | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 1 bay leaf | 3 bananas, halved
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well, assuring all ingredients are well coated with the mixture. Cover tightly and refrigerate the relleno, covered, for 6 days. Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Rinse the relleno under cool running water to remove the salt. Arrange on a cookie sheet and bake in the oven for 1 hour after a half hour turn off the oven at once and take the relleno out of the oven. Open the oven door and place the rellenos on a cookie sheet with the cut side down. Return them back to the oven and bake another half hour.

title: Orange Blossom Water
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice concentrate | 2 cups orange blossom water | salad, to serve
instructions: In large bowl, pour about half of the orange juice concentrate into small saucepan. Stir in remaining orange concentrate and add water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Cool and stir. Pour over salad and serve.

title: El Pato Restaurant Chipotle Liqueur (Chipotle Liqueur and Sherry Sherry Sauce)
ingredients: 1 cup chipotle salsa ( i used rolada brand ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup sweet sherry, chilled ( or white wine for dipping )
instructions: Whip up the chipotle salsa. Add the 1/2 cup of sherry. Mix well. Let sit. Enjoy.

title: Nana's Perfect Nana's Vegan Refritoes
ingredients: 2 cans vegetarian baked beans | 3 tablespoons fireball oil
instructions: Drain all of the excess liquid out of the cans. Place the beans into a skillet and pour the oil on top of them. Do not cover the beans, but cook over medium heat until the hot stuff rises and the oil starts to separate. Let them simmer for 2 minutes or so, then remove the pan from heat and let them sit for at least 5 minutes to cool.. Scoop out portions onto a plate using a fork to fill the centers of your nannas. They look nice with extra fat, but if you prefer a more heartier nannas, you can add a little sugar to your sauce.

title: Baked Summer Squash Pizza With Pinto Beans on Pumpernickel Bread
ingredients: 1 large summer squash, trimmed | 2 cans pinto beans ( pinto beans and red beans may be substituted ) | 1 package refrigerated bread | pesto-pesto sauce ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Cut the squash in half lengthwise and score into 8 wedges.

Random Ingredients: kirsch,onion,spanish onion,anise seed,italian parsley,sea scallop,nectarine,iceberg lettuce
title: Scallops With Nectarine Lettuce and Parsley
ingredients: 2/3 cup thinly sliced spanish onion | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 teaspoon freshly ground anise seed | 1 teaspoon kirsch | 1 tablespoon minced onion | 2 tablespoons chopped pickled italian parsley | 1/2 cup diced nectarine | 3/4 lb sea scallops, rinsed | iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place the onion in a small, heavy nonreactive skillet and cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 6 minutes. Add the parsley, aniseed and kirsch to the skillet and ignite with a match. Pour into a small bowl and reserve. Heat the kirsch and onion in the skillet over moderate heat until the liqueur is syrupy, about 1 minute. Stir in the parsley and toss together with the scallops and lettuce.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,cream wheat,flat leaf italian parsley,taco seasoning mix,white bean
title: Taco Dip for One
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed well | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cream of wheat or 1 -1 1/2 cup whole wheat sour cream ( or a combination of both ) | 1 1/2 cups water chestnuts, drained and minced ( optional ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | to taste flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a crockpot or serving dish and blend well. Cook 7 - 10 hours on high. Serve hot with tortilla chips, salad, or on lettuce leaves, or with tostada shells, etc.

title: Italian Style Salad Dressing - Low Fat!!
ingredients: 1 carrot | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Mix dressing and set aside.

title: Perfect Scandinavian Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 pounds skinless, boneless salmon fillets, cut into 6 pieces, each cut into 4 pieces | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless turkey meat cubed | ice water
instructions: Prepare a hot outdoor grill for direct cooking and lightly oil grate. Toast the mustard seeds in a dry skillet until the mustard seeds turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Transfer the mustard to a small bowl and set aside. In batches, place salmon in a glass baking dish. Mix remaining mustard and mustard into the dish. Sprinkle the fish with water. Cover the bowl with foil so air will circulate. Heat the grill to high. Place mustard seeds over the fish. Cover the fish with aluminum foil. Grill the salmon for 8 to 10 minutes per inch of thickness. Flip salmon and continue cooking for about 5 minutes on each side.

title: Mock Guiness and Tasty Apples
ingredients: 4 apples ( use any combination ) | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 6 slices rindless, grated apples | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | fresh lime slice
instructions: Grill or broil apple until just tender. Let cool slightly, peel and slice. Place apple in a large bowl, stir in yogurt, mustard, and lime zest. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cheese curd,white wine vinegar,chicken bouillon granule,tahini
title: Cheese Gelly
ingredients: 1 container cheese curds | 1/2 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules ( optional )
instructions: Beat the cheese curds and tahini in a bowl with an electric mixer on high speed until smooth, about 1 minute. Reduce the speed to medium, and add the vinegar and chicken granules, stirring well.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,prosciutto,pea,crescent dinner,basmati rice,ranch dressing mix,cayenne pepper,shiitake mushroom
title: Beef Crescent Rice Ring With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups chicken-flavored rice, prepared according to package instructions | 5 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 8 ounces sliced genoa salami ( about 1/3 pound ) | 4 slices prosciutto | 1 package crescent dinner rolls | 2 cups cooked shiitake mushrooms, sliced thick | 3 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 envelope ranch dressing mix | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine chicken and 1/2 cup water in a dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,shortcut bacon,white cheddar cheese,red chile,sauce,jalapeno pepper,sea bass
title: Chile and Bacon Roll Tide (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bottled hot sauce | 2 slices shortcut bacon, chopped | 1/2 cup white cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeno peppers, chopped | 1 small fresh red chile, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 sea bass or ( 20 ounce ) orange roughy, peeled and cut into strips across the grain
instructions: Preheat fan forced oven to 200 c°. Arrange bacon in a nonstick ovenproof dish. Sprinkle each slice with cheese. Top with peppers and tarragon. Bake for 10 minutes until heated through.

title: Baby Peas With Wine
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small boiling shelled baby peas | 2/3 cup dry white wine
instructions: Place peas in a saucepan and cover with water. Add 2 tsp salt and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 7 minutes or until no white particles remain. Drain well under cold running water. Melt 1 - ¼ tsp of the butter in a large, heavy skillet with tight fitting lid over high heat. Add frozen peas and cook, shaking pan until liquid puffs up and peas are golden. Remove skillet from heat. Discard any liquid that may have come to the surface. Return peas to the skillet and add any juices that have collected on the bottom of the pan. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer over low heat until peas look soft, about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Pasta with Apple-Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 package penne | 1 can apple pie filling | 3 chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Cook the penne pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,scotch bonnet pepper,beef broth,worcestershire sauce,turmeric powder,habanero pepper,orange liqueur,currant
title: Habanero Chile Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh turmeric powder | 8 ounces wistershire sauce | 1 ounce orange liqueur | 14 ounces beef broth or 14 ounces beef broth | 1 ounce dried currant | 6 habanero peppers ( jalapenos ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 scotch bonnet peppers, minced
instructions: Place the turmeric in a blender and process until the coarse powder forms a paste, then strain the liquid through a fine sieve into a large saucepan. Add the worcestershire sauce, orange liqueur and beef broth. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 20 minutes. Add black pepper, habanero peppers, worcestershire sauce and scotch bonnet chiles. Simmer gently for 10 minutes.

title: Orange Toast Crunch
ingredients: 12 ounces french bread | 2 cups buttermilk | 2 -3 oranges | chili oil | 8 ounces bread, cubes or 8 ounces sourdough bread, cubed | crackers or bread, toasted ( we prefer multi-serving )
instructions: Using a melon baller spoon, scrape down the insides of the bread. This will help you slice them. Using about a 3/4 1/2'' thinnest end of a large melon baller, gently press it down into the bread cubes, using your thumb to push out any liquid which escapes. Squeeze out all the juice, if necessary, and discard the pulp. Slice the flesh of the melon baller into smaller pieces about one inch in diameter. Slice the oranges into quarters long and then wedge them out with your fingers. Reserve the juice. Cut the orange quarters into 3/4 inch pieces and stick a piece in each slice of bread.. Using a spoon, put a teaspoonful of orange juice into each of the bread cubes in a nonstick frypan, on medium low. Squeeze all the juice from the oranges into the pan until it reaches a syrupy consistency.. When your syrup reaches the syrupy consistency, add the bread cubes. Squeeze 1 - 2 tablespoons lime juice into the syrup as well. Turn each piece of bread over in the pan and cook another 2 - 3 minutes just until golden. You may need to press down on the bread cubes in between turning. Remove from the heat. Add a dash of chili oil to the syrup, if desired. Serve each slice of toast on a warmed platter topped with the syrup and your choice of toppings or as is.. Note, if you have no syrup, you can bake the toast in a 400°f oven for about 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned all over, turning them over once or twice. This serves great on toasted bagels, toasted bagels, or toasted lettuce.

Random Ingredients: penne,ginger garlic paste,spanish onion,flat leaf parsley,hazelnut,chocolate square
title: Spiced Noodles (Chocolates With Onions and Chocolate)
ingredients: 2 ounces semisweet chocolate squares | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely minced | 3 tablespoons finely minced sweet spanish onions | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 12 ounces penne, cooked
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a bowl over low heat. Remove from a heat. While whisking, gradually add the nuts, parsley, onions, ginger garlic paste and the warm chocolate. Toss to combine.

title: Molho Eggs
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 400 g cleaned scallops | 150 g of good quality dark chocolate
instructions: Cut eggplant in ½ x 1 ¾” slices, lengthwise. Place egg plant slices on cutting board and slice into 1/2´´´´´´´´´´ length. Lay slices out on counter with a knife and lightly brush slices with olive oil. Place scallops in a dish large enough to hold them in a single layer. Dip the slices in the beaten eggplant, then coat in eggplant slices. Sprinkle the slices with grated dark chocolate, cover with a clean cloth and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Serve right away.

title: Pesto Green Chili
ingredients: 8 ounces blue cheese | 1 1/2 cups green chili | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 2/3 cup mandarin oranges
instructions: Melt cheese and chillies in a microwave on medium heat. Blend until smooth and stir in orange peel and pesto. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,half cream,lemon orange peel,raspberry,chili pepper flake,broth,vital wheat gluten
title: Roasted Veggie Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 package vital wheat gluten ( i've used gluten free ) | 1 yellow pepper | 1 lemon, juice of | 4 -6 fresh chili peppers, seeded and chopped ( i remove the `` handle '' for a milder taste ) | 3/4 cup unsalted half-and-half cream, warmed | 7 tablespoons raspberries, divided | 1/2 cup unsalted butter | 1/2 cup broth ( your choice ) or 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray two baking sheets with nonstick cooking spray or spray with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the gluten, white pepper and lemon juice and set aside. Cut the pepper and onion in half, removing the core and membrane and seeds.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes 2007
ingredients: 2 packages marshmallows | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso powder ( optional ) | 3 cups confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons espresso powder ( optional ) | 1 head lettuce, torn in pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line cookie sheets with parchment paper. In medium size mixing bowl, mix marshmallows, and espresso powder. Set aside. On a large serving platter, layer 1/3 of the marshmallow mixture, then spread to make 2 cakes. Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups of the confectioner's sugar, 1 tablespoon of espresso powder if using, and 2 tablespoons of espresso powder if using. Repeat layers, ending with marshmallows. Sprinkle with remaining confectioners sugar and a drizzle of espresso powder, if desired.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,cheddar cheese,tabasco sauce,hot pepper,tomato green chile pepper,chard leaf
title: Green Chiles in Spicy Red Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups chopped green chile peppers | 2 cups chopped fresh chard leaves | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 cup hot pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet, over medium heat, stir together green chilies, chard leaves, pudding mix, cheddar cheese, hot pepper sauce, and tabasco sauce. Simmer approximately 5 minutes, stirring frequently.

title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 large boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 egg white | 4 teaspoons chopped of fresh mint | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and sliced
instructions: Combine chicken, egg white, mint and bamboo shoots in a shallow glass bowl. Toss to distribute dressing evenly.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,pork broth,guajillo chilies,white bean,red capsicum,cucumber,sirloin
title: Huey's Beef and Pork Soup
ingredients: 1 can white beans | 4 ounces pork broth | 4 ounces guajillo chilies, deseeded, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 lb sirloin | 4 ounces lean ground beef | 1/2 seedless cucumber, chopped ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded ( or grated )
instructions: Put the beans in a bowl with the pork broth, guajillo and salt. Add the beef and pork and mix together to thoroughly combine. Put a large frying pan over medium heat and add the ground beef and cook until the beef is no longer pink, around 5 - 7 minutes. Add the chopped cucumber. Toss once more and serve with a sprinkling of mozzarella.

title: Grilled Veal Tacos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 lb lean veal, trimmed of excess fat | 3 fresh limes, halved | 12 tomatillos, husked, rinsed, and halved | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar, packed
instructions: To make the sauce, in a medium saucepan, combine the lime juice and sugar. Bring to a boil and simmer until the sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes. Stir in the meat, reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 3 minutes. Remove the meat and add the canola oil and the lime juice and cook for about 10 minutes longer. When the meat is done, remove it from the saucepan, discard the lime juice, and let stand for at least 15 minutes. Stir the tomatillos into the sauce to heat through. Fill the taco shells with the meat mixture. Serve with warm flour tortillas.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,corn,beef sirloin,french green bean,green olive,green chile pepper
title: Sierra Leone Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 pound beef sirloin | 1 pound french style green beans, cut in 2 inch pieces | 1/2 pound frozen green olives | 2 cans beef stock | 2 green chile peppers, chopped | 1 can corn, drained
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, brown sirloin on all sides, 10 minutes.

title: Veal Roll Ups
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs veal | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/4 onion ( chopped )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Open packages of onion soup mix and separate into two equal portions. Put 2 tablespoons of dry onion soup mix into one portion and 1/2 teaspoon of onion from corner to corner on top of each veal roll ups. Place seam side down in a casserole dish. Mix together 2 tablespoons dry onion soup mix with 1/4 cup onion from corner to corner in bag, put mixture onto top of roll ups and seal well. Spray with pam or light cooking oil and cover with foil. Bake in oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,mint leaf,golden syrup,fish sauce,celery salt
title: Golden Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thigh | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | mint leaf | celery salt
instructions: Place chicken in a freezer bag, and put in refrigerator. For 5 - 10 minutes, just until the chicken is semi frozen, this will ensure it will be easy to remove from the bag and cook safely. Remove the chicken from the bag, and put into a non stick pan, or grill pan, on medium low heat, you don't need to grease it. After you put the chicken in the pan, sprinkle the golden syrup into the pan, turn it on medium high heat, but don't let it brown, this will give you a wonderful golden glaze. You want your pan to be very warm, you don't want it to be so hot that you have to be stirly or else the sugar in the pan will burn and get skin on the chicken. I keep a small pan of water handy to keep your eye on when things get to hot, so just be sure to remove any extra pan water, and turn the heat down right now. After it's turned slightly brown on one side, move it to a plate. Let it cool before you begin the sauce. For your sauce, i make a double batch, and freeze half, and place the rest in a separate container, and store the remainder in the freezer until ready to use. I make one double batch, and just let the rest thaw for up to 2 days, to allow for easier separation. You can use any kind of oil, but i usually just stick the chicken in a freezer bag with the rest of the golden syrup, olive oil, and a squeeze of lime juice or lemon juice. You can marinate your chicken, if you want, for at least 30 minutes, or even up to a day in advance. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. After letting the chicken dry out, i put everything under my broiler, about 20 - 40 minutes. You have enough glaze to cover the chicken and you don't need to grease it, just make sure it's bubbling. Check it, and if it is sticking, don't worry, it will be tasty once it has dried out a bit, just make sure it doesn't burn. Serve immediately, or store in the freezer, and reheat if you want until ready to serve it again.

title: Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups parsnips | 2 cups instant tea | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: In crockpot add the parsnips and chicken bouillon. Pour instant tea over. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.

title: Grilled Sausage
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb | 1 whole slab bacon | 1/4 lb italian sausage
instructions: Remove all exterior fat from fennel and discard the feather colored outer leaves and ribs. Trim fronds with a vegetable peeler if desired. Combine fennel bulb fronds and bacon.

title: Mustard Roast Beef Medallions
ingredients: 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 teaspoon grated havarti cheese | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 springs fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In a small roasting pan, combine the beef stock, havarti cheese, fish sauce and rosemary and bring to a boil, then transfer mixture to a pastry bag fitted with a large star tip. Squeeze out excess air, then pipe 3/4 cupfuls of roasting beef mixture onto a skewer. Place on a rack set in a roasting pan and bake in the preheated oven 40 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. Do not overcook.

title: Lori's Kebab
ingredients: 1/4 kg freshly ground beef | 1/4 kg coriander seeds | 3 tablespoons freshly crushed coriander seeds
instructions: Mix and knead together all the ingredients. Take a small lump of this mixture and roll it in the crushed coriander.

Random Ingredients: almond,winter squash,russet potato,water artichoke heart,brown sugar,mandarin orange
title: Rumblethumps
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato, peeled and quartered | 1 can sliced water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 cup thinly sliced almonds | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 6 tablespoons brown sugar, divided | 2 cans sliced winter squash, drained
instructions: Place the potato, artichokes, almonds, oranges, and 1 tablespoon of brown sugar in a large microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Stir the squash with a fork and microwave on high for 1 minute. Uncover the bowl, stir, and microwave covered for a further 1 minute. Stir and microwave for 1 more minute, then remove the bowl from microwave and cut the mixture into 2 1/2 inch cubes. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Puerto Rican Cocoa Shots
ingredients: 1 cup cocoa powder | 2 cups ice cold water
instructions: To make a one cup shot, line two shot cups with 1½ 3/4 teaspoons cocoa. Place 1 teaspoon cocoa powder on ungreased, buttered baking sheet.

title: Homemade Tahini
ingredients: 1 pinch asafoetida powder, or 1 pinch hing | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl. Store in an air tight container.

title: Basic Turkish Chicken
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup warm water | 1 teaspoon yeast | 3 -4 lbs chicken wings
instructions: Place warm water, yeast, and turmeric in large mixing bowl. Mix well. Add chicken wings, one at a time. Cover with plastic wrap, place a large bowl on top and turn the chicken over so that the wings are completely coated with the mixture. Let sit for 2 days. After 2 days, heat oven to 425 degrees. Place chicken on greased cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes or until browned. Turn chicken over, pour off fat. Let bake until chicken is finished cooking all the way through and tender.

title: Mango Tofu Enchilada
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled, pitted and diced | 1 can red enchilada sauce, divided | 1 fuji apple, peeled and diced
instructions: In saucepan over medium low heat, combine mango, 1/2 can enchilada sauce and diced apple. Chili oil, if desired, can be added while whisking. Reduce heat to low.

title: Kittencal's Easy Walnut & Pepper Spread (For Pizza Strips)
ingredients: 2 slices medium size onions | 1/8 cup walnut oil, such as pam | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Put walnut oil into a saucepan and turn the heat on to medium low. When you can smell a nice nutty smell coming out of the oil turn the heat to medium and add the onions. Let the onions begin to caramelize, about 10 minutes. Turn down the heat to a medium or low simmer for another 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid burning onions. While the onions are caramelizing, make your pizza topping. When the onions are ready, cut the pizza into thin slices or use a food processor to combine all the filling ingredients. When the onions are nearly done, turn the heat off and add the topping. It can be stored for up to two days or frozen for up to two months.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,tart apple,red curry paste,parmesan cheese,jalapeno chile,maple flavoring
title: Spicy Red Curry With Maple and Apples
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste with herbs | 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 2 tart apples | 2 tablespoons maple flavoring ( real ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh parmesan cheese ( optional ) | grated cheddar cheese ( optional ) or monterey jack cheese ( optional )
instructions: Heat large skillet. Add curry paste.

title: Corned Beef and Green Onions With Tomato
ingredients: 2 teaspoons plain flour | 3 lbs corned beef brisket, trimmed | 2 medium tomatoes, large | 4 green onions, trimmed, trimmed, tops cut off
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place flour and brisket in a shallow ovenproof dish. Cut a few slits into beef and lay them in the dish. Cut tomato and onion into wedges and lay over meat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.

title: French Potatoes With Cream Cheese
ingredients: 8 -10 medium potatoes ( peeled ) | 1/2 cup cottage cheese, mashed | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 cup fresh green ( including parts of the green stalk ) | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed salad oil
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into slices approximately 1/8 thick and 1/8 thick. Lay on foil and place in cold oven. When the oven has reached 325°f, check every 15 minutes to make sure the potatoes are well done. Place potatoes in colander set over a bowl and allow to rest in a cool location for 15 minutes. Drain the excess water off the potatoes and pat dry using paper towels. Place the cottage cheese, 1 tablespoon salad oil and green parts of the green stalk into a food processor. Add the other 1/2 teaspoon salad oil to the food processor and puree thoroughly. Place potato slices on a large serving platter and sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons of the rosemary and 1 1/2 teaspoons of mixed salad oil. Spoon cottage cheese mixture over the potatoes. Drizzle the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary oil on top. Serve immediately with fresh baguette slices.

title: Chorizo and Tamari Muffins
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage | 1 -2 cup tamari | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 5/8 cup cold water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove chorizo from casing and crumble into medium size bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients. Add any extras you like to the batter. Spoon into ungreased muffin tins and bake until tins are golden brown on top, about 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,tea,green pepper,feta cheese,rye bread,sultana,russet potato,pie crust
title: St. Patrick's Day Leftover Russian Potatoes & Peppers
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes, cleaned and cut into 1/2 inch slices ( you will need 2 cups leftover peeled potato slices ) | 2 -4 slices russet potatoes, cleaned, ends trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch slices ( if you're not using leftover leftovers, i've also used leftover roasted peppers, but i'm not sure about those, ) | 3/4 cup sultana | 1/3 cup plum sauce | 3 tablespoons teapoon light brewed tea | 1/4 cup feta cheese ( can use reduced fat feta ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup green pepper, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1 prepared pie crust, for a double crust pie ( if you do this, use the recipe for a left over potato pie ) or 1 prepared small left over potato pie, for a left over potato pie ( if you do this, use the recipe for a left over potato pie ) | cooked sliced rye bread or bread rounds, to serve on the side
instructions: Preheat oven to 375'f. In a large bowl, combine potatoes, sultanas, plum sauce and tea. Arrange the potato mixture in the pie pan. Add the crumbled feta and green pepper strips to the mixture. Bake in the oven until the crust is golden and the feta is melted~ about 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm, or cool and refrigerate overnight, or serve hot.

title: Apple Surprise
ingredients: 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Pour in a glass container. Gently stir in the Golden syrup and apple juice. Serve.

title: Wild Rice With Mango Spinach
ingredients: 1 package wild rice ( or 4 cups cooked wild rice ) | 1 mango ( chopped and seeded ) | 1 cup spinach leaves | 1/2 cup rotel ( diced ) | 1 red grape ( sliced or quartered )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, adding mango and spinach leaves. Place mixture in bowl and top with grape slices. Serve with additional mango, green onion and/or salsa.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,hard egg,pork tenderloin,rib celery,ice water,rose water
title: Crackling Sea Bass
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, trimmed, fat discarded ( about 4-1/2 lb ) | 1/2 lb sea bass fillet, rinsed and patted dry | 1/4 cup ice water | 1/4 cup unseasoned rice wine vinegar or 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried rose water | 3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced thin ( for garnish )
instructions: Position a rack in the middle of an oven and heat it to 300 degrees. Cut the pork steaks lengthwise into 1/4 slices. Place the fish on a cutting board, flatten down slightly and cut into thin slivers along the spine and all the way down. Using the heel of your hand, press down on each slice to flatten them for a similar size, but do not flatten them too much. Using your hands spread the strips of meat along the length of the fish, then using your fingers place them in 1/2 inch thickness slices. Using your fingers press down on each slice to flatten them, then use your fingers to press down on each slice of meat to flatten them slightly for a similar size, but do not flatten them too much. Using your fingers press down on each slice of fish to flatten them for a similar size, but do not flatten them too much. With your hands spread the strips of meat across the bottom of a foil lined baking pan, forming 3 layers. Cover the meats with a layer of ice water, then sprinkle on the vinegar and cook the fish in the oven for 45 minutes. Remove the fish from the oven and garnish with chopped hard boiled eggs. Serve immediately.

title: Hawaij (Spicy Tea)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon green cardamom packed in oil, thinly sliced for garnish
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a small saucepan or small nonstick skillet over low heat in a heavy 3 quart saucepan. Remove cardamom pods with a strainer placed over a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mirin,white baking chocolate,lemon,white wine vinegar,no boil lasagna noodle,fast rise yeast,chili oil,plum
title: Lemon and Plum Lasagne
ingredients: 1 package no-boil yeast | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon lemons, zested and juiced | 12 no-boil lasagna noodles | 2 cups plum ( plum ) pieces | 2 1/2 cups shaved white baking chocolate | chili oil, for drizzling
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of the wine vinegar. Combine the remaining 1/2 cup vinegar and the lemon juice. Arrange the noodles in a layer on a flat surface. Top with 2 cups of the plum pieces. Drizzle liqueur over the noodles. Place a few chunks of the white chocolate on top of the plums. Sprinkle with a touch more of the chili oil.

title: Onion-Sesame Dip - Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon chopped onion paste ( optional )
instructions: Grind the sesame seeds. Mix all ingredients together. Serve as is or chill for later. This recipe can also be made the way directed for dipping the dip.

title: Hominy, Ham and Hominy
ingredients: 1 ham hock ( optional ) | hominy, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/hominy-hominy-42094 '' > hominy < /a >, < /a >
instructions: Puncture the ham hock with a large fork. Wrap the ham hock tightly into a crock pot. If you don't like it traditional, just throw it away for a few minutes. Add the desired amount of water to the crock pot. If not using the ham hock, add 2 cans hominy or a small can of chopped tomatoes with an appropriate amount of fresh green chiles. Cook on high for 2 - 3 hours. After 2 hours, remove the ham hock and strain the liquid back into the crock pot through a clean cloth, discarding what is remaining in the crock pot. If using canned hominy, add 3 cans of diced tomatoes with an appropriate amount of fresh chiles. Cover and continue to cook for an additional 20 minutes. Discard the potato skins or food residue. Shred the ham and serve..

title: Basic Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried italian herb blend ( or other herbs of your choice, or 2 tablespoons fresh herbs of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon taco sauce
instructions: Follow the directions on the tbs. Package. Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Prawns, Peppers, and Sausage Phyllo
ingredients: 1 lb prawns, raw - peeled, deveined, and butterflied | 1 medium bell pepper, pepper, finely chopped | 8 ounces italian sausage, diced | 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 -2 cup frozen peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 inch baking pan. In a large skillet over medium heat, saute the prawns, peppers, and sausage until just cooked through. Remove from the heat and stir in the shrimp mixture. Spread the mixture over the phyllo pastry sheets. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the shrimp mixture is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,thai fish sauce,green onion,red chili powder,cabbage kimchi
title: Kimchi Kimchi
ingredients: 1 head cabbage kimchi, chopped into chunks | 25 green onions, chopped | red chili powder, to taste | 3 cups prepared pasta sauce | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Put kimchi cubes and green onions into a large saute pan and sprinkle with a little chile powder. Cook for 7 - 9 minutes over medium heat. Add pasta sauce and fish sauce and toss well. Simmer for 2 minutes. Garnish with red chili pepper.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,prickly pear,cooking wine,ginger garlic paste
title: Prickly Pear Soup
ingredients: 1 cup fresh prickly pear, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste, crushed with | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 1/4 cups cooking wine ( red, blush, or other dry white wine ) | 15 whole dried porcini mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Boil the prickley or pear with the wine for 15 to 20 minutes, or until it has reduced to 1 quart for 45 minutes, stirring often. Puree with a blender or in a food processor, then add the garlic paste and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Smoky Kale Salad
ingredients: 8 fresh mushrooms, chopped, or to taste | 9 ounces kale, or to taste - chopped | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 5 tablespoons mexican cheese blend | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine mushrooms, kale, cream, cheese, and dried cilantro in a salad bowl. Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.

title: Obici E Camembert
ingredients: 200 ml heavy cream, hot | 100 g camembert cheese, chopped
instructions: Combine cream, cheese and Camembert in a bowl. Cover and store for at least one hour before serving to let the flavours meld. Can be served hot as a dessert or cold as a side with assorted fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: ice,baking soda,peanut butter,marsala wine,onion soup mix,turnip,beef bouillon cube,cream cheese
title: Peanut Butter Turnips
ingredients: 3 cups peeled cubed turnips | 1 pound cubed lean ground beef or ground turkey | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 3 tablespoons cream cheese | 1 cup sliced nuts | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, or as needed | ice
instructions: Cover turnips with boiling water and cook until done, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool under cold running water. Cut into bite sized sticks. Combine cooked turnips, meat, onion soup mix, bouillon, marsala, cream cheese, and nuts. Stir turnips into sauce and transfer into ice filled ramekins or deep baking cups. Brush tops with egg. Microwave at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes, or until hot.

title: Salmon on the Go
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 4 tablespoons sugar substitute | 1/2 lb salmon, skinned and deboned | 1/2 cup cashews, lightly toasted | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Combine sugar and curry paste in small bowl. Melt sugar mixture over low heat. Add salmon and cashews, tossing gently. Serve salmon on hot platter. Top with guacamole, if desired.

title: Pineapple Dry Rub
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dry mustard, see note
instructions: Make sure the dry mustard is coarse or coarse with a coarse grinder or in a food processor. You can also make the dry mustard by grinding in a mortar and pestle with a small amount of ground mustard and a little water, then using a funnel. Alternatively, you can try making the dry mustard through a clean coffee grinder, using the coarse mustard in a small bowl, then using a funnel. Store in a covered jar in the refrigerator.

title: Sweet Noodles With Cabbage
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 1 small head cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Cook the rigatoni in a large pan of boiling water for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain pasta then place into a large bowl. Add the cabbage and sugar then mix in the rigatoni mixture and cook gently for a further 3 - 4 minutes. Serve immediately or let cool and then store in the fridge. If planning on eating right away, let it rest for 2 - 3 minutes before serving.

title: Pear and Fennel Jam
ingredients: 2 pears, ripe, halved, seeded with skins left on | 5 tablespoons lard | 1 teaspoon dried fennel, crushed | 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Cut the pears and remove the core from the pears. Cut the pears into thick wedges. Heat the lard in a heavy based saucepan over medium heat, and when hot, immediately add the fennel seeds. Lower the heat and fry, stirring often, until the fennel is lightly browned. Stir in the pear wedges with as much ligard as the saucepan contains and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the lime juice, remove from the heat, and leave to cool. Serve at room temperature with cream or ice cream.

title: Italian Crumb Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup flour ( approx. 1 cup ) | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( i used plain panko )
instructions: Place flour in a sieve or large bowl. Place bread crumbs in a small bowl on a plate or in a bowl. Add crumb mixture to flour and press into a small circle using your hands. Repeat these steps. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium low heat. Add a coating of light oil to make a small crouton drop into the pan. Cook, flipping once, until golden brown.

title: Creamy Noodles and Noodles With Curried Catsup and Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 package fine noodles, any brand | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 package cream cheese | 1 tablespoon fine chopped dry noodles | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water until done. Drain well. Place the cooled noodles on a buttered cookie sheet. Mix the catsup, curry, cream cheese, sour cream and drained noodles together until well blended and well coated. Spoon over noodles and sprinkle with fine black pepper.

title: Strawberry Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint strawberry | 3 stalks lemongrass, finely chopped | 1/4 cup tamarind paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or mortar and pestle and process until smooth. The sauce will thicken.

title: Slow Cooker Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloin | 12 ounces dry onion soup mix | 2 large carrots, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 teaspoon minced red chile, or more to taste
instructions: Place the pork tenderloins into the bottom of a slow cooker. Sprinkle the onion soup mix over the pork pieces. Mix the carrots into the meat, pour in enough water to nearly cover the meat, and sprinkle with the red chile. Cover the slow cooker, and cook on high for 5 hours, or on low for 6 to 8 hours. The vegetables will be tender and tender when pierced with a fork. Remove the pork from the slow cooker, and shred. Return to the slow cooker, and reheat if necessary, about 30 to 45 minutes. Season the liquid with more chile powder, if desired.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,guacamole,curry powder,self rising flour,kalamata olive,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Baked Fish Taco Fritters
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 2/3 cups fish sauce | 6 ounces kalamata olives, sliced | 3 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a food processor, chop chipotle peppers and place in a medium bowl. Add self rising flour. Add curry powder to food processor with 1/3 cup plus 2 tablespoons of fish sauce, blending well before adding next 1/3 cup. Add remaining 1/3 cup fish sauce in adobo sauce, mix well, then add olives and chipotle peppers. Mix well by hand or with a spoon or hand blender. Place mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish and top with remaining fish sauce. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until fish is firm and the coating is lightly browned.

title: Cheese & Chunky Salsa Filling
ingredients: 500 g grated cheese | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa | 0.5 can of chopped green chilies
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and stir well to blend all of these ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for upto 1 week. Form into small patties with meat, poultry or anything you want to fill it inches.

title: Oatmeal for Elegant Elegant Earl-Oamc (Oatmeal for Elegant Earl-Oamc)
ingredients: 3 cups raw oats | 2 1/3 cups fresh orange juice ( or juice of 12-14 oranges, divided ) | 4 fresh rosemary sprigs, plus | 8 sprigs
instructions: Place the oats in a large, heavy, dry saucepan and cover generously with water. With the back of a spoon, scrape up any lumps. Cover with the lid and heat over medium low heat until water is simmering and it begins to look like liquid at the edges of the pan, 1 - 1 1/2 hours.. Stir once or twice. While the water looks at the surface of the oats, place a heavy skillet over medium high heat and add 1 cup orange juice. As soon as the water is bubbling and the juice begins to thicken, remove the pan from the heat and stir in the orange flavored juices. Gently stir in the rosemary and remaining 1 cup orange juice using a wooden spoon to scrape up any browned bits. Remove the pan from the heat and discard rosemary. The oatmeal will stay hot and sticky. When rolled into balls, remove from the pan and let cool to room temperature. To serve, place a sprig of rosemary on a plate, top with 1/8 teaspoon of oatmeal and enjoy or store covered in an airtight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,lamb chop,black bean,mustard seed,raspberry vinegar,purpose flour,italian bread
title: Noble House Italian Style Lamb Chops
ingredients: 6 lamb chops, 1/2 inch thick | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon black sesame oil | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Prepare a gas or charcoal grill. Brush lamb with 1/4 cup of raspberry vinegar, 1 tablespoon of dark sesame oil, and 1 tablespoon of black sesame oil. Grill on a rack set 5 to 7 inches from the heat, turning occasionally, until well browned on all sides, about 12 minutes. Transfer to a platter, and keep warm. Stir remaining 1 tablespoon of dark sesame oil, black sesame oil, mustard seed, flour, and bread into the skillet. Heat through, then pour over the lamb and any accumulated juices from the platter. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,citron,tomato sauce,white cheddar cheese,buttermilk,pine nut,tarragon leaf,bay scallop
title: Scallops and Pine Nuts for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 lb bay scallop, raw | 1 pinch tarragon leaf | 1 tablespoon cherry tomatoes or 1 tablespoon grape tomatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon pine nuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon white cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 7 ounces tomato sauce | 1 pinch tarragon leaves | 1 tablespoon buttermilk
instructions: Arrange scallops in a single layer on a plate. Sprinkle with tarragon leaves. Combine cherry tomatoes, pine nuts, and cheese in a small bowl. Combine vinegar and tomato sauce in a bowl. Pour over scallops, sprinkle with tarragon leaves, and let stand 15 minutes. Pour tomato mixture over scallops, sprinkle with buttermilk, and serve.

title: Italian Anchovies Breaded Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried asparagus | 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 1 tablespoon parsley, minced | 1 teaspoon garlic flakes | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Cook asparagus according to package directions. Drain asparagus when done and cool to room temperature. When cool, slice into 1/4 inch lengths. Combine orange juice and remaining ingredients except the bread crumbs. Place the bread crumbs in a bowl and lightly coat with the orange mixture. Place asparagus in a large zip top baggie and shake, coating pieces evenly.

title: Spanish Pig-Licks
ingredients: 8 slices bacon | 8 green olives
instructions: Place bacon in a large cast iron skillet. Sauté until it starts to brown around edges, but before it begins to release its fat. Remove bacon from skillet and set aside. Return the skillet to the stove and add olives. Cook until it begins to get puffed up and olives are slightly browned. Serve immediately.

title: Sassy Guacamole
ingredients: 6 ripe hass avocadoes, peeled, pitted and cubed | 1 ripe mango, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 banana pepper, seeded and chopped ( optional ) | 1 cup packed baby spinach ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, gently stir together avocado, mango, banana pepper and spinach. Sprinkle with sugar.

title: Vietnamese Grilled Ginger
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Combine the lime juice with the garlic paste, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before grilling. Grill to desired doneness, or brown.

title: Strawberry Sestlse
ingredients: 3/4 cup heavy cream | 12 whole cloves | 12 ounces baking chocolate | 6 lbs fresh strawberries, washed and quartered ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 lbs lingine, boiled ( or your favourite ) | 2 lbs sardines, cooked
instructions: Place cream and cloves in double boiler over medium heat. When cream begins to boil, stir constantly with a wooden spoon. When cream starts to bubble, remove from heat and strain cream into clean 2 to 2 1/2 quart kettle. Reserve 2 cups of strained cream for soup. Add chocolate to remaining cream sauce, bring to a boil over medium heat, then remove pan from heat. Add chopped berries and cook until berries are just tender, about 5 minutes. Stir frequently. To serve spoon soup into 6 to 8 individual bowls and float sardines on top.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,parmesan cheese,orange peel,bay leaf,garlic paste,cardamom,sage,parsley
title: Scotch Broth
ingredients: 12 ounces plain flour | 3 ounces parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely diced | 2 cardamoms, finely diced | 7 1/2 ounces parsley, chopped | 1 bay leaf | 2 cloves | 1 dash garlic paste | 3 ounces fresh sage, chopped
instructions: Sift the flour and mix thoroughly with your hands until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Stir in the parmesan cheese, orange rind, cardom, parsley and bay leaf. Stir in the garlic paste and sage. Pour into a greased pan or the stockpot or kettle. Bring the stock to the boil and cover. Simmer for about half an hour or until the top is golden brown. Serve with biscuits or vegetables.

title: Dynamite Creamy Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon powdered gravy | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill for a minimum of 4 hours prior to serving. Serve with vegetables, pita chips, crackers, or as a topping for crackers, chips or as a topping for salads.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
ingredients: 6 ounces risotto rice or 6 ounces arborio rice | 3 ounces double cream | 1 ounce pineapple juice | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 ounces gingerroot, finely grated
instructions: Soak rice in boiling water for about 20 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Mix all ingredients together in medium saucepan. Cook in slow oven for about 20 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Red Curry Green Beans in Soy Syrup
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed | 1 tablespoon coconut sugar ( or honey ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the beans, and cook until tender crisp, about 3 - 6 minutes. Drain, transfer to a bowl, and toss with the coconut sugar. Heat the pan with the soy sauce over medium heat until hot, then pour over the green beans.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,coconut milk,beef tenderloin steak,marinara sauce,palm sugar,jasmine rice
title: Tropical Beef and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 5 beef tenderloin steaks | 1 1/4 cups uncooked jasmine rice | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 cup marinara sauce, canned
instructions: Place coconut milk, beef tenderloin steaks, rice and bouillon in dutch oven. Simmer over medium heat until tender, about 20 minutes. Discard bouillon cubes. Return cover to dutch oven and heat through. Stir in marinara sauce. Cover, and cook over medium low heat until rice is tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Oven Sweetened Chicken Legs (Slow-Cooker or Not)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken legs, whole | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Place onion in slow cooker.

title: Tunisian Onion Soup
ingredients: 6 large onions, thinly sliced | 3 cans condensed beef bouillon | 2 teaspoons saffron, or 1 package of dei fratelli saffron blend | 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 cup grand marnier or 1/2-1 1/2-1 1/2 cup other strong liqueur
instructions: In a pot brown onions in a few tablespoons of butter or oil and reserve. Add bouillon and saffron to the onions to brown. Continue to stir over low heat until onions are golden in color and bouillon is dissolved. Do not allow soup to dry out. Slowly add reserved onions. When soup's as thick as you like stir for a couple of minutes, making sure soup won't stick to bottom of pot. The soup can be reheated in the microwave, but if the soup is too thin, heat it through more or less in small increments. If you like thicker soup, heat soup a couple of minutes longer.

title: Cordon Bleu over Rice
ingredients: 3 lbs beef shank ( bone in and tied ) | 1 cup sliced black olives | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Trim excess external fat from beef. Tie the shank in a double thickness of kitchen foil and place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Unwrap the beef from the foil, leaving the excess fat in the pan. Scatter the olives over the meat, and top with cheese. Set this in the center of the oven. Bake at 325 degrees for about 3 hours or until the meat is tender when pierced with a fork.

title: Garlic-Marinated Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup rice | 1 tablespoon miso | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Make sure all rice is covered. Cover and store it in the refrigerator, it won't last long.

title: Warm Swiss Chard With Swiss Chard and Chocolate
ingredients: 2 cups swiss chard, stems and ribs rinsed and chopped | 4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/4 cups fat-free creamy greek salad dressing, divided
instructions: Lightly oil a large, shallow baking dish.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,sandwich bread,lemon juice zest,green chili,spanish onion
title: Sopa De Frijoles (Green Gazpacho Sandwich)
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup fresh green chili, seeded and finely minced | 1 tablespoon spanish onion, minced | 1/8 - 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, finely minced | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 4 slices sandwich bread, preferably white, crusts removed, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( white or whole wheat )
instructions: Mince the chiles and onions in a food processor. Add the cilantro, lemon zest, and juice. Toss well and set aside. Heat the broiler. When hot, put the bread cubes in the oven for 2 minutes. Serve immediately with the guasado.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,beef consomme,rice noodle,pepperoni sausage,mushroom cap,provolone cheese,cocoa
title: Philly Cheesesteak (Beef) Rollups
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can condensed beef consomme | 1 package fresh sliced mushrooms cap | 1/2 lb pepperoni sausage, sliced into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 cups prepared rice noodles ( i use rice-a-roni ) | shredded provolone cheese ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Prepare rice noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse mushrooms. Set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a small bowl, mix together soup and consommé until blended. Pour into a 9 x 5 inch baking dish. Layer with mushrooms, pepperoni, rice noodles, meat mixture, cheese, and cocoa if desired. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,red chili,basil,pinto bean,horseradish,maple syrup,corn flake,hard cheese
title: Hot Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 3 cups pinto beans | 1 tart apple ( about 2 medium ) | 1/2 cup fresh basil | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh horseradish | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground roasted red chili | 1/4 cup crumbled hard cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place beans, apple, basil, horseradish, maple syrup, chile, and cheese in a shallow, 8 inch glass baking dish. Bake until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Eggplant Fritters
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 eggplant, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced crosswise | 4 floury hoagies | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons lime wedges | 1/4 cup orange peel, finely sliced | 4 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat grill pan to medium high. Coat pan with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,cayenne,pork sausage,yellow squash,tamarind paste,sumac,grain mustard
title: Yellow Squash Sausages With Tamarind Sauce.
ingredients: 250 g boneless pork sausage, thick sliced | 1 large yellow squash, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon pure ground sumac | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon mild white ground mustard | 1 pinch cayenne ( to taste )
instructions: Using a knife, cut the sausages into 5 slices. Put all ingredients through a food processor or blender then process through until smooth. Place the sausage between sheets of aluminium foil, fold over and press down then seal. Refrigerate the sausages for 1 hour. Preheat the broiler or use a large foreman grill and line baking racks with foil. Place sausages and marinade in a shallow metal casserole dish dish and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Serve immediately with steamed white rice or couscous.

title: Roast Pork
ingredients: 1/2 kg whole lean pork shoulder, fat trimmed and with bone | 2 tablespoons fresh marjoram | 1 1 glass turkey stock | 6 small cherry tomatoes ( to garnish each portion )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Place the pork fat side down in a roasting tin over a high head, with a little fat hanging over the edges. Sprinkle with marjoram and season with salt. Pour over the stock and bake, uncovered, for 1 – 1 1/2 hours or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 170c. Slice halfway through to test whether the meat is cooked through. Serve with roasted vegetables sprinkled over the meat.

title: Easy Brown & Gluten Free Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 yellow onion | 1/2 cup raisins ( brown or regular ) | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Rinse the rice with cold water. Finely chop the onion & combine rice & onion & molasses in a large nonstick skillet & cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the rice is light brown & onion is beginning to caramelise. Remove from the heat & cool slightly. In a large mixing bowl rinse the noodles well to remove any sand. Add the drained rice onion mixture, raisins, & molasses to the noodles & mix well. Turn onto a lightly floured board & pat mixture into a 10 x 14 inch baking dish & bake for 45 minutes. Let cool before cutting in squares to serve.

title: Spargels
ingredients: 500 g fresh lasagna noodles | 100 g fresh strawberries | 65 ml amaretto | 2 -3 tablespoons cornflour, to thicken
instructions: Place a little amaretto in a bowl with some cornflour, add some ice cubes to thicken. Boil 2 - 3 tbsp of water, add a tsp of cornflour to water, and add it to the boiling water, stir, then lower the heat to a bubble and cook for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Place the fresh strawberries and 1 tbsp of amaretto in an ovenproof dish or dish and put into a preheated oven. Cook 10 - 11 minutes until the strawberries are soft. Add the lasagne noodles to the cold strawberries and stir to separate them. To serve, sprinkle the cornflour on to each plate, then pour the amaretto/water syrup over the pasta and serve immediately.

title: Mum's Jamaican Burger Recipe
ingredients: 600 ml yogurt ( full fat, low gi ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari | 1/4 teaspoon dried yeast | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon rum ( optional ) | 250 g beef mince
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Line 12 x 7cm tin with baking paper. Place yoghurt in large bowl, add the lime juice, tamari, yeast, garlic creole seasoning, rum & mince. Mix well. Spread mixture onto lined tin. Bake 20 minutes or until firm & golden. Cool in tin, remove paper and serve.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,red wine,tart apple,garam masala,beef sirloin steak,corn oil,beef broth
title: Indian Beef and Apples
ingredients: 1 beef sirloin steak, trimmed | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 3 tart apples, coarsely chopped | 3/4 teaspoon garam masala, divided | 1/3 cup dry red wine | 1 can beef broth | 1 cup button mushroom, sliced
instructions: Slice steak thinly across the grain, across the grain. Heat 1 tsp of oil in 12 inch skillet over medium high heat. Cook steak, in batches, 4 to 5 minutes, until browned and well browned. Remove from skillet.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,red apple,taco seasoning,almond extract,meatball,catsup,chicken breast half,pecan
title: Mexican Applesauce Chicken
ingredients: 8 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 20 frozen meatballs, thawed, divided | 1 jar catsup | 1 can diced red apples, drained | 2 ounces ground mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup toasted pecans
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the chicken in a medium size baking dish. Combine the taco seasoning with 1 inch of water and sprinkle over the chicken. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until juices run clear. Boil the 4 remaining chicken breasts on the stove or in a separate baking dish, until no longer pink. Remove chicken from the baking dish and set aside. Place the 1st 4 meatballs into the baking dish. Set aside. In a separate bowl, mix the catsup, apples, cheese, almond extract, and 1/2 cup of toasted pecans. Place the 4 chicken breasts back into the sauce, and toss to coat. Arrange the remaining meatballs on top.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,chuck,purpose flour,yukon gold potato,tortilla,beef bouillon cube
title: Shredded Hash Brown Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 2 packages refrigerated plain tortillas, cut in half | 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour | 3 beef bouillon cubes, crushed | 2 large yukon gold potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 medium head green cabbage, cored and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a large frypan, brown ground chuck. Drain of excess grease. Add uncooked tortilla strips, flour cubes, and beef bouillon. Cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens. Place hot mixture in dish. Layer half of potatoes, cabbage, and half of the beef sauce on top. Repeat layers. Bake, covered, 1 hour or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,tandoori paste,beef bouillon powder,red cabbage,egg
title: Shwarma Wrapped Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 red cabbage | 1 egg | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon tandoori paste | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon powder
instructions: Slice the cabbage lengthwise, remove the large pieces of skin and outer green leaves. Rice well to remove any excess moisture. Remove the hard core and very old outer leaves. Rice can also be used instead to wrap the cabbage tightly but is not recommended as they can become slim. Wash the cabbage well in warm water. Remove the leaves using water each time you remove a leaf. Rinse well and drain well. Place in a bowl with some plastic wrap and a few salt shavings of coriander and mix well. Set aside for 30 minutes. Cut a slice down the center of the cabbage about 1/4 inch from the bottom so that the spine can reach the top. Remove the white part of the leaf, then slice into 3 or 4 strips. Repeat with the egg yolk. Take your cabbage leaves and fold the top layer over the cabbage leaving a 1 inch gap at the top and bottom, and the bottom side of the leaf that is open at the left. Remove the remaining gap on the egg white at the top and bottom edge. With wet hands, pinch the two red edges together making sure to seal. Use a wet knife to roll the cabbage carefully from the narrow end, and remove any unrolled pieces from the top or bottom. Place the folded slices tightly back together on the work surface, then cut a slice off the top corner to make a sandwich, then set your filled cabbage on top of the slice. Repeat for all 3 or 4 stuffed cabbage rolls. Heat a large frying pan on medium to high heat, or use a medium high to high heat. Beat the egg in a small bowl with a fork or kitchen shears in it for 2 to 3 minutes to make an egg white and to scramble the egg. Keep the egg whites in a separate bowl. When the pan is very hot, carefully place the stuffed cabbage into the pan. When the bottom layer is covered and the edges puffed up, flip it over and cook on the other side. Turn over again when the bottom layer is done. When finished baking, the cabbage should be tender and the bread should be light brown. Remove from heat immediately and set aside on a plate or platter.

title: Hara Meshwi
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 lb fresh bean sprouts ( about 2-1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup lemon yogurt | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Boil in salted water for 2 - 3 minutes drain and rinse well with cold water. Place in a large bowl and toss with remaining ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,hard egg,pizza sauce,green cardamom pod
title: Taco Rings
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups taco seasoning mix, more to your taste | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/4 cup bottled taco sauce | 1 green cardamom pods ( optional )
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning according to package directions.

title: Green Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle green chili sauce | 12 ounces beer
instructions: Serve hot or cold.

title: Tamari Flour Chips
ingredients: 6 teaspoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon tamari | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, roasted and powdered
instructions: Place all the dry ingredients in a mortar. Mix with fingers until they become smooth. Add any remaining water and stir together. Let stand for at least 2 hours before using. Note, this can be used as a dip for chips.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,wine,cocoa powder,oyster sauce,pork loin roast,flour tortilla,parsnip
title: Crock Pot Cantonese Style Pork Loin Burritos on Gasolive Oil and Wine
ingredients: 4 lbs pork loin roast | 12 flour tortillas | 2 cups spaghetti sauce, your favourite brand ( or spaghetti sauce of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon dried parsnips | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder ( optional ) | 1 cup wine ( i've used red or white ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Cut the pork into chunks, and place into crock pot. Sprinkle all of the dry spices in the bag, close bag and shake. Add wine and oyster sauce, stir well and cook on high for about 5 hours, stirring every 15 minutes to keep moist. Remove pork and shred with 2 forks. Wrap tortillas and warm in foil, in a warm place for about an hour. Warm up spaghetti sauce on a large platter, or in a microwave. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the sauce in a tortilla, add about 1 tablespoon of meat and roll. Place in the sauce and serve.

title: Apple and Olive Soup
ingredients: 1 tart apple | 1 cup black olives | 1 cup beef bouillon cube
instructions: Sauté apple with bouillon. You need to remove the skin just before the apples are very soft. After cooking, add black olives and cook for another 20 minutes.

title: Haldi Beet Pies
ingredients: 2 cups beet, cooked ( about 1 pound ) | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 4 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( haldi ) | 2 tablespoons marinara sauce
instructions: Cook the raw beets in a steamer basket in boiling water, removing to a separate bowl when done. Place 1 cup cooked beet in a blender and process to a fine texture. Transfer beet to a bowl, add flour and asafetida.

title: Dijon Russian Dressing
ingredients: 1/8 cup tamari | 1/8 cup vodka | 1/8 cup dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,rice wine vinegar,vanilla essence,chuck roast,pork,orzo pasta,honey,tabasco sauce
title: Orzo With Beef or Pork
ingredients: 4 ounces lean beef or 4 ounces pork | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 3 ounces orzo pasta or 3 ounces elbow macaroni, cooked | 1/2 cup milk chocolate | 4 ounces pork or 4 ounces chicken stock, heated | 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Combine beef or pork, orzo, or any other type of soup, milk chocolate, stock, vinegar, vanilla essence. Melt chocolate and honey together, leave to cool slightly. When cooled, mix with the cooled meat or to pasta and serve.

title: Easy Cauliflower Salad
