ingredients: 6 cups coarsely chopped head cauliflower | 1 english or spanish onion, sliced | 1 hard-cooked egg, chopped
instructions: In a large salad bowl, combine the cauliflower and onion slices. Stir in the hard cooked egg and mix gently. Chill.

title: Couscous Basics (Couscous and Mint)
ingredients: 2 cups dry couscous ( or regular couscous ) | 4 -5 sprigs of fresh mint ( or 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves added 1 1/2 teaspoons to 1/2 teaspoons a 1-1 1/2 teaspoon blend of fresh mint, dry mint and dried mint ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the couscous in a large bowl and sprinkle with hot pepper flakes. Mix quickly, but gently. When couscous begins to foam in the center, scatter in mint leaves and stir. Serve immediately, or refrigerate, covered, for up to 1 hour.

title: Spiced Sultanas
ingredients: 16 ounces sultanas ( sweetened dried fruit, if using plain sultanas, make sure to use a lot of sultanas. ) | 2 tablespoons seasoning ( mccormick's all purpose flour ) | 2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Place sultanas into a bowl and pour in more cold water to cover the sultanas completely and let stand for 15 minutes. Drain well and add almond extract to remaining water in a nonstick frypan. Bring to the boil then reduce heat and cook sultanas for 3 1/4 minutes or until they are just tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,thyme sprig,pesto sauce,corn oil,english cucumber
title: Mixed Greens Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh flat green peppers | 2 english cucumbers, sliced thin ( about 2 inches long ) | 1/2 lb fresh mild pesto sauce | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Slice green peppers into thin strips using a sharp knife. Dice cucumbers into thin strips. Slice pesto into thin strips. Place vegetables near the base of each salad bowl. Top with herb strips. Brush with oil, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mixed salad should be served room temperature.

title: Easy Microwave Pizza Focaccia Filling
ingredients: 1 lb of your favorite favorite dry pizza dough | 10 drops of your favorite marinara sauce ( optional )
instructions: Using a fork or spoon place your sauce in a pie plate or microwavable dish. Stretch out the desired dough until it doesn't stick to the sides or over the bottom. You should have a 14x9 rectangle of dough, spread the sauce over the dough. Using a fork, press down on the dough to form an oval shape. You can also press the dough out with a rolling pin or clean fingers to the approximate shape of your pizza dough. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for 1 hour. After 45 minutes, remove the plastic wrap and slice into four pieces. Enjoy.

title: Cheese Queset
ingredients: 1 lb queso fresco | 1 lb mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the grill. Take a small piece of cheese and slice into approximately two or four triangle pieces. Then put the cheese piece on the grill. Close the lid and shake the cheese so the entire piece of cheese is coated with the inside of each piece of cheese. After about 5 to 10 minutes your queso has begun to smoke. The cheese will begin to float on the grill. It should take approximately 5 minutes per side. You may need to put the pan under the hot grill to get any residual juices out of the cheese. You might have to do this in 2 batches depending on the size of your pan. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Chicken Potatoes With Mancottes
ingredients: 8 new potatoes, scrubbed | 2 chicken, pieces | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate, melted | 1/2 tablespoon fresh marjoram, finely chopped
instructions: Cut the potatoes in half lengthways then scrub over using a knife. Place in a large bowl and pour over enough cold water to cover. Leave for 25 - 30 minutes or until tender. Drain, but save the cooking water. Put chicken on a tray. Brush with milk and marjoram. Grill over a medium heat for 10 minutes until browned. Turn chicken and cook for another 10 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Baked Rice & Feta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup frozen whole kernel corn | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Set oven to 375°f. Mix all ingredients. Spray baking sheet with non stick cooking spray or line baking pan with parchment paper. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until heated through.

title: Vegetable and Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces cannellini beans, drained | 6 cups vegetable and olive soup ( i use progresso brand ) | 1 medium red potatoes
instructions: Cut potato into pieces about the size of a whole nut. Rinse and boil water to boil and add beans. Put pot back on stove, add vegetables & cook till veggies are soft. Serve immediately. Please note, my friend always told me that she can't eat the soup without the shellfish.

title: Lazy Perruso and Blender Balls
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 250 g cream cheese ( room temperature ) | 1 cup parmesan cheese ( grated ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 cup dried cherries
instructions: Sift the flour together in a bowl and make a well in the center. Add cream cheese and beat it until the mixture forms a smooth paste, add grated parmesan cheese, cornflour, pesto and mix well. Make sure the mix doesn't become too thick. Make balls from the dough using approximately 3 tbsp filling from the dried cherries. Refrigerate dough until it's ready to roll out. Spray the bottom. Place an ice cream scoop or ball onto the dough and flatten slightly. Roll out the rest of the dough until it fits the tortilla. Cut into strips 3 - 4 wide and 2 long. These can then be eaten either by dipping them in a marinara sauce or using them for dipping. Enjoy.

title: Pear Soup
ingredients: 12 pears, ripe | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Peel, core and dice the pears. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook for about 10 minutes or until the pear skins float to the top. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the pears to a colander to drain the water. Rinse the pot and return it to it. Add the peeled pear halves to the pot.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,ginger root,catsup,orange peel,salmon fillet,ladyfinger,basil,mint leaf
title: Salmon Steaks With Herb-Sausage Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried basil | 3/4 teaspoon dried orange peel, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 1/2 pounds salmon fillets | 8 thick slices peeled fresh ginger root | 8 ladyfingers
instructions: For the herb rub, in a small bowl, mix catsup, ginger, basil, orange peel, and mint. Reserve 1/2 to 1 cup of the herb mixture for basting. Rub the salmon with 1/2 the herb mix, and sprinkle with 1/2 the ginger slices. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Set aside 1/4 cup of the prepared herb rub. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Arrange the salmon in a large roasting pan. Drizzle with the herb mix and set aside. Brush a little of the reserved spice rub over the top of the salmon.

title: Wild Mushroom Eggplant Soup (Suki No Tempura)
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 4 cups vegetable stock or 4 cups chicken stock | 1 package wild mushrooms | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Peel eggplant. Slice into 1/2 by 1/8 inch/8 inch slices. Place the eggplant slices in stock and cook until tender but not mushy. Drain. Mince mushrooms. Add chopped mushroom, mirin and mirin to the soup. Taste and add salt or other seasoning as desired.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,iceberg lettuce,green olive,arborio rice,mustard seed,radish,tortilla
title: Green Olivada
ingredients: 8 ounces quick-cooking rice | 4 ounces mixed greens ( arborio rice, white or green ) | 6 tablespoons finely chopped green olives | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 3 cups shredded iceberg lettuce ( to garnish ) | 1 ounce tortilla, cut into wedges | cooking spray
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Set aside in a bowl and pour cold water over it to keep it covered. Meanwhile, spray a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Add olive oil to bottom of casserole dish and add mustard seeds. When mustard seeds start to change color, add rice and mix for 10 seconds, being careful not to burn the oil. Add lettuce, cover and microwave on high until just beginning to soften, about 1 to 2 minutes. Remove cover and cook over medium high for 2 - 3 minutes, until lettuce is wilted. Remove from heat. Toss lettuce with tortilla. Spread some of the rice over tortilla, sprinkle with some of the greens and olives and top with the rest of the rice. Wrap and heat in the microwave oven for 10 seconds. Then, serve. Garnish with sour cream, sliced tomato, olives and red onion. Variation, add 3 cups shredded iceberg lettuce after removing the rice from the microwave oven. Variation, if lettuce has wilted, mix it into the rice for a minute or two so that the moisture from the lettuce gets in the rice.

Random Ingredients: cranberry sauce,rump roast,lasagna noodle,graham cracker crumb
title: Cranberry Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 1 tablespoon graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 bottles cranberry sauce | 2 packages thin lasagna noodles ( not the thin wide ones )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch pan with non stick spray. Remove excess fat from roast and place roast in roasting pan, fat side up. Sprinkle the cracker crumbs over roast and sprinkle it evenly over the roast. Spread cranberry sauce evenly over the roast and sprinkle the top with graham cracker crumbs. Cover and bake for 1 hour. Remove roast and cover for 30 minutes. Remove lid. Remove roast carefully from pan, cover and return to oven for about 1 hour and 15 minutes or longer or until roast reaches desired doneness. Take out of oven and allow to rest for 20 minutes. Slice or shred roast and serve.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,monterey jack pepper cheese,black pepper,manicotti shell,leek
title: Manicotti Primavera from Olive Garden
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine, divided | 16 ounces fresh manicotti shells | 1 leeks, white and light green parts only, chopped with tender stalks | freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup grated monterey jack pepper cheese for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f coat a 2 quart casserole with cooking spray. Pour half the sherry in a bowl, and stir in the leeks. Add salt and pepper. Cook the manicotti shells in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes per side. Drain, and set aside. Add the remaining sherry to the same bowl, and simmer. Drain the cooked, drained manicotti, and combine with the leeks. Spread the mixture evenly in the casserole dish, and top with cheese.

title: Pepperoni Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 onion, chopped | 1 slice fresh gingerroot, sliced | 1 dash pepperonn pepper
instructions: In a large saucepan, saute onion, ginger and pepperonn pepper until onions are tender. Add chickpeas, heat through. Use the amount of salt you have available as per the directions in the packet. Enjoy note,. I love to serve this with good rolls.

Random Ingredients: pink bean,greek feta cheese,bread flour,snow pea,dal,beef brisket
title: Baked Corned Beef With Green Beans and Feta
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | sausage or ground beef | 1 can pink beans, undrained | 1 package frozen snow peas | 2 cups bread flour | 2 teaspoons plain unbleached dry dal, plus additional to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Season the brisket with salt and pepper. Insert two toothpicks in the bottom of the brisket and insert the skewers, alternating with two cups of pink beans and one bag of snow peas. Combine the bread flour, dal, and enough water to just cover the meat. Roll the roast in the flour mixture, then arrange the meat on a large platter. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove the toothpicks and serve.

title: Moroccan Eggs and Egg With Salted And
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread ( threads ) | 4 eggs | 1 large romaine lettuce | 2 slices coriander | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander, leaf
instructions: In a small strainer, rinse saffron with hot water. Using a mortar and pestle, crush it to a fine powder. In a medium skillet, pour 1/3 cup of the cold water and bring it up to a boil. In the meantime, place the eggs in another small frying pan and cover them with water. Bring the water to a boil, remove from the heat and slip the yolks in, into the water. Beat the yolks with a fork, add the saffron and 2 tbls. Of the coriander and mix the mixture well, and remove it from the fire. With a long bladed knife, slice the romaine lettuce like chard leaves. Arrange the romaine in a large serving platter or a pretty flat serving dish and surround with the egg yolk side up. Pour 1/3 cup of the saffron oil over the salad and sprinkle with the remaining coriander.

title: Sausages and Peas
ingredients: 100 g sliced sausages | 100 g frozen peas
instructions: Preheat oven to c, 375f, and lightly oil a roasting tin. Layer the sausages, peas, and 1/2 of the tin mix into the tin. Repeat layering twice, until the top is used up. Bake for 1 hr 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pissen- a Pintry With Walnut Shortbread
ingredients: 1 lb bisquick | 3/4 cup walnut halves or 3/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint sprigs ( about 1 tablespoon ) | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Sift bisquick and mint into a clean mixing bowl. Stir in the walnuts and mustard. Dredge each hazelnut half into crumbs. Dry on rack. When cool, sprinkle with additional walnut crumbs, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,hot water,parsley leaf,orange liqueur,sunflower seed,sherry
title: Roasted-Orange Seed Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower seeds | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 tablespoon orange-flavored liqueur | 1/4 cup hot water | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 - 1/3 cup reserved hot water | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves
instructions: Combine sunflower seeds with sherry, orange liqueur, and hot water in a bowl. Cover and set aside. Coat a large, nonstick skillet w/ cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,baking potato,brandy,tomato puree,purpose flour,green pepper,cottage cheese,garam masala
title: Potato Koftas With Brandy And-Or Lamb Gravy
ingredients: 2 cups shredded potato ( about a pound ) | 2 tablespoons brandy ( you may use cognac ) | 2 cups cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped green peppers | 2 teaspoons baking potatoes, mashed | 1/2 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 -3 teaspoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix the potato, brandy, cottage cheese, and chopped green pepper with the garlic, ginger and salt. If you need to make the gravy ahead of time, cover and refrigerate to allow flavors to marinate. Put the prepared potato mixture in a bowl and mix together. Form small oval or 3 inch diameter discs of meat in the batter. Cover and refrigerate until needed. Cook the meat, stirring frequently, over medium heat until well browned, about 10 minutes. Remove meat from skillet and serve with the gravy accompanied with plain rice. You may substitute chicken broth or water for the water. Serve the meat and gravy separately.

title: Spicy Cashew Shrimp
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashews | 1/2 cup roma ( plum ) tomato | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 pounds jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Toast cashews and tomato in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until golden brown and almost dry. Stir in ginger garlic paste and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in shrimp, and cook until shrimp are no longer opaque in the center, 2 - 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: sherry vinegar,home bread,meat,red chili pepper flake,grand marnier
title: Hot Dressed Meat Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sherry vinegar, more as needed | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon dried red chili pepper flakes | 4 slices home-style bread, 1 inch thick ( thin slices of bread, about 1/2 inch thick ) | 2 tablespoons sweet pickled hot pickled red chili peppers or 2 tablespoons hot pickled hot peppers, in oil
instructions: Place a wire rack in a heavy 3qt saucepan.

title: Spicy Indian Halwa
ingredients: 2 cups sifted whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup pimiento ( sesame seed ) | sifted yoghurt | 2 tablespoons red chili paste
instructions: Mix it well. Divide dough into 2 equal parts and roll each into thin round discs, about 10 x 12 inches. Heat a nonstick griddle or skillet on the hob. Put one disc in the pan and turn over. Spread the ghee or oil evenly over the dought. Cook on both sides for a few minutes or until golden brown, flipping. Repeat with the remaining discs. Serve hot with sambar powder.

title: Pesto Roast Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons pesto | 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced chicken tenders, | 6 -8 leaves fresh pesto
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together marinade ingredients and pour over chicken.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,shell pasta,honeydew melon,jalapeno pepper,white pepper
title: Aussie Style Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 225 g shell pasta | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil, sunflower oil extra virgin | 2 small brown onions or 150 g onions, finely diced | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon honeydew melon, finely diced
instructions: Cook the pasta and drain. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the onions until brown. Stir through the jalapeno, white pepper and honeydew. Toss through the pasta and pour on the sauce. Toss until all the cheese is melted and the pasta is heated through. Serve with bread, or a green salad.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom,chili powder,pineapple ring,jarlsberg cheese,almond extract,pancetta
title: Pineapple Treat
ingredients: 1 package jarlsberg cheese, sliced into 1/4 inch thick slices | 3/4 cup crumbled soft pancetta | 1 can pineapple rings, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped almonds, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Spread cheese slices on cookie sheet and place under broiler. Watch carefully, as cheese will burn at the bottom, so watch carefully after a couple of minutes. Watch carefully so cheese does not burn. Sprinkle the almonds and all the other ingredients over the cheese, then sprinkle the chipotle powder over everything. Set the oven on broiler setting. Broil the jarlsberg about 3 - 5 minutes, or until it starts to brown and the crust is golden. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

title: Apricot Salmon
ingredients: 4 fillets salmon | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 cups sour cream | 1/3 cup apricot preserves | 1 cucumber, diced
instructions: Place salmon fillets in a shallow baking dish. Beat together half and half, baking soda, and sour cream and pour over salmon fillets. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 3 days. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour apricot preserves over salmon. Bake about 35 to 40 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Easy Baked Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 320 degrees f. Place cauliflower in a glass and ceramic casserole dish. Cover cauliflower with water. Place in preheated oven. Keep door slightly ajar and bake until cauliflower is tender, 45 to 50 minutes. Remove cover and bake another 10 minutes. If water boils off, cook for 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: silver tequila,red chile pepper,brown rice,rice,island dressing
title: Spicy Brown Rice
ingredients: 6 cups cooked rice | 1/2 cup island dressing | 1/2 cup finely chopped red chile pepper | 2 cups sweetened, frozen sweet rice | 1/4 cup silver tequila
instructions: In a bowl, combine the cooked rice, wasland dressing, red chile, and sweet rice. Chill.

Random Ingredients: beef,chicken stock cube,chipotle chile adobo,spinach,salmon,beef tenderloin,pepper sauce,spice
title: Smoked Salmon Florentine
ingredients: 2 teaspoons spice | 2 lbs ground beef | 2 chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, seeded & chopped | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 3 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 4 salmon, skinned, pin boned and thinly sliced ( about 1lb ) | 4 ounces spinach, shredded
instructions: Position the racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven. Preheat the oven to 400°. Coat a large roasting pan with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, spice, stock cubes, chipotle pepper and hot sauce. Stir to combine. Transfer the beef mixture to the prepared pan. Add the fish and toss to coat.. Spread the spinach over the top. Roast the beef mixture until it reaches 160° on a thermometer, 35 to 40 minutes. For the salmon, remove from the oven and let rest for 10 - 15 minutes before slicing into thin ribbons.

title: Green Goddess Salad
ingredients: 1 package mixed greens salad leaves | 3 tablespoons margarine, melted | 3 tablespoons syrup
instructions: Combine salad leaves, margarine, and rosemary in a large bowl. Drizzle with margarine mixture. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,ghee,iceberg lettuce,kosher salt black pepper,mango
title: Sweet, Savory French Fries With Mangoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces raw sugar snap peas ( about 3/4 pound ) | iceberg lettuce, torn ( about 2 cups ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 mango, peeled, pitted and cut into matchstick-sized chunks ( at least 3/4 pound ) | 1 tablespoon ghee ( see note )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Cut the snap peas open lengthwise and place in a bowl. Toss with water to keep them from browning, then salt to taste. Wash and dry the lettuce and place on a rimmed baking sheet so that it can flat. Working with one at a time, spread the snap peas, about 2 tablespoons per salad, on the prepared baking sheet. Place the remaining 3 tomatoes on the baking sheet, cut side down. Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake until the sugar snaps are crisp and light brown, about 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sugar snaps to paper towels and drain. To serve, drizzle the sliced mango with the ghee and toss to coat. Scatter the crispy sugar snaps and tomatoes over the fries.

title: Chiles Rellenos-Appetizer Pizza Crust (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 2 ounces pancetta, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.

Random Ingredients: mix,sauce,clove,farfalle pasta,red pepper flake,irish cream,baby bok choy
title: Lola Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 1 cup hot sauce ( such as tabasco or louisiana red hot ) | 1/2 cup baileys original steak sauce | 2 bags baby bok choy, cut into 3-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 cup bailey's irish cream
instructions: Cook and pasta according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl.

title: Real Simple Salsa
ingredients: 4 serrano chilies | 2 onions, sliced crosswise into 3/4-inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place chilies on a foil lined baking sheet and broil until blackened and blistered, 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway through. Remove from heat and cool. Peel off and discard stems and seeds from chilies and place in medium saucepan with onions. Bring to boiling, then reduce the heat and simmer until onions are soft and translucent. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Strain onion mixture into a medium bowl and stir in chilies. Transfer to a serving dish and let cool completely. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Vanilla Squash
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash, halved and cored | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place squash cut side up onto a foil lined baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes. Set squash aside. Transfer the squash halves to a bowl of ice water. Remove foil from baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: green,ra el hanout spice mix,ketchup,fennel seed,garlic powder,red pepper
title: Ras el Hanout - Algerian Diced Roasted Red Peppers
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained & membrane removed | 4 -8 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix, for spice | 1 teaspoon of fennel seeds, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a bowl, stir well, cover & chill. Cut the peppers crosswise, into 1/4 inch thick strips. Spread the strips on baking sheet, roast for approximately 20 - 30 minutes, or until dry. Garnish with additional spices. Variation, place roasted peppers into a serving dish, sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoons of fennel seeds.

title: Chinese Pecans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 2 teaspoons corn syrup | 1/2 cup finely ground pecans | 2 tablespoons dashi, roasted
instructions: Combine the chinese five spice powder, corn syrup, and pecans in a bowl. Stir in the dashi, and store in an airtight container.

title: Chilli Beef Salpicon
ingredients: 1 lb beef roast ( chuck or round ) | 1 fresh long red chilies | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: Trim off any fat or membrane outside the roast, cutting 1/2 inch away from the fatty tops. Place the roast in an 11 x 7 inch baking pan. Remove the seeds and membranes from the red chillies. Cut two slits, each from stem to blossom end and into the openings. Brush the top of the roast with water, and sprinkle with coarse salt. Place under about 20 degrees of hot broiler for about 45 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 140 degrees f. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,rom tomato,tomato,golden syrup,cider vinegar
title: Tomato & Brandy
ingredients: 500 g roma tomatoes | 300 ml cider vinegar | 300 ml light golden syrup, warmed to boiling point | 5 g lemon juice and zest, grated fine | 750 g punnet red cherry tomatoes
instructions: Core tomatoes & slice crosswise. Heat remaining ingredients in heavy based saucepan over low heat and keep warm. Using a food process, pulse tomatoes, vinegar and lemon zest for about 3 seconds or until puree is formed. Pour contents of tomato & vinegar mixture back into pan and stir over gentle heat until mixture boils & thickens. Pour off any excess heat. Spoon tomato mixture into sterilised canning jars. Cover with thin plastic wrap and refridgerate for 2 weeks before using.

title: Nori Karaori (Japanese Beef Marinade for Japanese Beef Skewers)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin | 3 tablespoons brandy ( japanese sweet cooking wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 10 minutes. Soak wooden skewers in a bowl of cool water for 30 minutes. Combine mirin, brandy, and paprika in a small bowl. Pour marinade over kebabs.

title: Gluten-Free Fried Pastry Rings
ingredients: 4 cups gluten-free flour ( you can use gluten-free flour if desired, i find it ) | 1/2 cup egg substitute ( can use egg beater ) | dark sesame oil ( for frying )
instructions: Mix ingredients. Let dough rest at least 15 minutes at room temperature.. This will make the coating thinner. On a floured surface, roll dough to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into desired shaped rings. I have found that when i dip my rings into the batter, they have the best results. Cook the rings at a 425° f oven for around 10 - 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Grilled Vietnamese Style Brushing Sandwiches With Vodka
ingredients: 2 lbs ladyfingers | 3 poblano chiles | 2 cups peanut oil | 1/2 cup mirin or 1/2 cup red wine | 2 ounces vodka, sweetened if necessary | 1/8 teaspoon arrowroot
instructions: Prepare lady fingers by brushing with oil and placing on flat baking sheets. Broil on high heat, 4 to 5 minutes. Turn and broil 2 to 3 minutes. Cut chiles crosswise into rings about 1/4 inch thick and remove seeds and core. Brush with oil, drain and cut strips into 1/2 inch strips or smaller. Lay out lady fingers and slice into fingers about 1 inch thick on prepared baking sheets. Repeat with other lady fingers and chiles. Grill in a hot skillet or grill pan about 2 minutes per side, until sizzling and slightly browned.

title: Dolmades (Pita)
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils | 1/2 cup whole wheat cereal ( jazze ) | 1/2 cup mixed candied fruit ( pears may also be used ) | 1/2 cup shredded roast beef ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees, and grease a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. Place the lentils in a pot with enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 1 minute. Drain and rinse with cold water and drain again. Combine the cereals, dried fruit, and beef. Spread evenly in the loaf pan, and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese. Bake for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Sweet and Sour Vietnamese Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, in one piece | 1 fluid ounce beer | 3 fluid ounces rice vinegar | 2 fluid ounces curry paste, more to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro leaf
instructions: Trim the fatty meat from the pork and cut it into 2 inch cubes. Combine all ingridients in a large saucepan, bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes or until pork is very tender. Remove from heat and transfer to a cutting board. Trim excess fat from meat and shred meat into bite sized pieces. Arrange meat on a platter, cover and refrigerate for another 3 - 4 days, or freeze for upto 1 month. Garnish with cilantro.

Random Ingredients: brinjal,parsley leaf,fettuccine,feta cheese,cabbage,baking potato,green enchilada sauce,sage leaf
title: Roasted and Feta Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb fettuccine | 1/2 small cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 small baking potato, thinly sliced | 1 small fresh fetta cheese, diced | 7 green enchilada sauce ( such as valentina or a la victoria 2t. ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/8 cup minced fresh parsley leaves | 1 large sage leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f mix fettuccine, cabbage, potato, fetta, enchilada sauce, feta cheese, parsley, and sage in baking dish. Bake until vegetables are crisp tender and flavors blend, about 35 minutes. Serve hot or warm.

title: Smoked Spicy  Red Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb new potato ( unpeeled ) | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Chop potatoes to a 1 1/2 by 1/2 by 1/2 size. Cook in boiling pot of water for 10 minutes. Drain and place in bowl. Add 2 tbsps. Hot tomato ketchup. Shake potatoes to coat lightly.

title: Cherry Beet Roll Up
ingredients: 3 large beets, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 8 ounces cherry or 8 ounces coconut, chopped into 1 inch pieces | 2 ounces sliced mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook beets in boiling water for about 12 minutes. Remove and allow to cool. Slice into 1/2 inch sections. Place the beet pieces along with asafoetida and cardamom in a shallow dish. Stir to coat all. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Place cherry or coconut on a small plate. Roll up beet slices and lay on top of coconut. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Roll up tightly. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 4 slices fontina cheese | 4 fresh lettuce leaves | 4 slices pear | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed sheets )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the kidney beans, fontina cheese, and lettuce. Arrange pear on the nori strips and spread the cheese mixture evenly over the lettuce, and then sprinkle the nori evenly with the bean mixture. Eat immediately.

title: Mascarpone Bean Frozen Yogurt
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 1 container mascarpone or ( 6 ounce ) container sour cream | 4 ounces vanilla yogurt
instructions: In the crock pot, combine beans, mascarpone cheese, and yogurt. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes to allow flavors to mix. Serve cold.

title: Baked Lebanese Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 package lamb chops, trimmed | 1 package frozen broccoli florets | 1/4 cup kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the lamb chops on a wire rack or broiler pan, and lightly brush with olive oil. Arrange broccoli over the tops, and sprinkle with olives. Place the pan in the preheated oven, and bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until the meat is cooked and broccoli is tender.

title: Chilli Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup mixed fresh herbs, such as oregano, basil or tarragon | 4 tablespoons oil or 4 tablespoons peanut oil | your favorite cooked pasta sauce ( i use the ragu old fashioned pasta sauce )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, sift all ingredients together and knead by hand until all ingredients are incorporated. Divide into 10 equal portions and press perforate each portion into a smooth patty about the size of a ping pong ball and flatten slightly with your hands. Cook in boiling, salted water. Turn the fritters frequently for 3 - 4 minutes or until golden brown, turning once. Drain on kitchen paper. You can use fresh herbs of your choice, such as oregano and basil, or even marjoram.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,tahini,artichoke heart,tamarind paste,white mushroom,alfredo sauce
title: Artichoke Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 2 jars alfredo sauce | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 2 jars marinated white mushrooms | 1 can whole peeled artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: Combine alfredo sauce, tomato soup, mushrooms, artichokes, and tahini in the jar of a food processor. Blend until smooth. Spread sauce into a saucepan over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,dark rum,greek yogurt,cake flour,beef broth
title: Pan Fried Steak
ingredients: 1 lb beef round steak, trimmed of excess fat | 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 cups cake flour ( sifted before measuring ) | 1 cup greek yogurt, thick | 1 -2 teaspoon beef bouillon or 1 -2 teaspoon beef broth
instructions: Combine the flour, 1 t of the greek yogurt and the 1 t of the broth. Place the beef steak in a shallow dish.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,fennel seed,hazelnut,lime wedge,tomato green chile pepper,pickling spice,mustard
title: Smoked Tomato and Hazelnut Chiles
ingredients: 2 pounds tomatoes and green chile peppers, stemmed | 2 tablespoons mustard, or more as needed | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup pickling spices | 1/4 cup coarsely ground hazelnuts, or as needed | 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1/4 cup chili oil, or as needed | 5 lime wedges
instructions: Place tomatoes into a large container, and sprinkle with mustard, hazelnuts, mustard, hazelnuts, fennel, chili oil, and lime juice. Cover, and refrigerate at least 3 days, shaking every 30 minutes, before serving.

title: Chile Con Manchego(Mole Coloradito) With Mexican Chocolate
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1 cup grape leaves ( or other dried fruit ) | 1 cup very warm mexican chocolate | 8 shallots, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Knead to a soft, elastic consistency, adding more sugar if needed. Cover loosely and leave in a very warm area approximately 2 hours. When you are ready to use, knead again to develop gluten and keep dough from drying out.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,rice wine vinegar,yukon gold potato,peanut,italian parsley
title: Potato and Chickpea Salad (Chuka-Koulourakia)
ingredients: 1 pound yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 1 can garbanzo beans | 4 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,white bread,bell pepper,fettuccine pasta,tea
title: Italian Steak Lovers Pasta for One
ingredients: 6 ounces cooked fettuccine pasta | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper | 1/3 cup chopped bell pepper ( any color ) | 1/4 cup teaspsons seasoned black forest ham ( optional ) or 1/4 cup turkey sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degress farenheit. Coat a 9 x 13 x 2 baking dish with vegetable oil cooking spray. In medium bowl, stir together pasta, peppers, bell pepper, and ham or turkey sauce.

title: Salsa Verdi #5FIX
ingredients: 7 ounces vermicelli | 1 cup tuna | 1/4 cup capers ( chopped ) | 1 celery rib ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 2 cups cheddar cheese ( grated )
instructions: Break tuna into bite size pieces and drain. Put in large baking dish and sprinkle with capers, celery and vanilla. Sprinkle cheese on top of all. Set in 350°f oven for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,chili pepper,cream chicken soup,red chili powder,chicken bouillon cube,chicken broth
title: Mexican Hot Dish
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chicken broth | 1/3 - 1/2 - 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1 -2 tablespoon ground red chili pepper
instructions: Combine both cans of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, and ground chile pepper in a glass bowl. Blend well and pour mixture over the chicken.

title: Sausage with Cacahu Al Queso (Stuffed Mushrooms)
ingredients: 4 ounces hot italian sausage | 4 ounces cotija cheese | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | 8 fluid ounces coffee liqueur | 2 tablespoons sliced olive
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, toss together the italian sausages with the crushed caciocavallo cheese, cardamom, coffee liqueur and olives. Scoop out the mixture and wrap each mushroom in papertowels. Wrap the bottom ends tightly with plastic wrap and place on a plate. Refrigerate for 3 hours, or as needed to firm up the mixture before serving.

title: Garlicky Garam Masala
ingredients: 2 teaspoons garam masala | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Mix garam masala together with the rice vinegar, but do not over mix.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,anise seed,pepper sauce,mustard green,lettuce leaf,yellow pepper
title: Pickled Pepper Spread(Masala)
ingredients: 4 lbs mustard greens, washed and coarsely chopped ( or green cabbage ) | 8 lbs yellow peppers, seeded and coarsely chopped | 3 lbs peppercorns in middle, crushed | 4 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 16 -20 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup hot pepper sauce
instructions: Add peppers, pepper corns, and cardamon to a heavy kettle. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes or until peppers are soft. Add peppercorns, cardamom, and anise. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 2 hours, stirring frequently. Allow to cool, then pour into sterile jars. Keep in a cool, dark place until used up.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,green pepper,celery,mace,balsamic vinegar,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Grilled French Feta Cheese With Peppers and Celery
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 lb feta cheese, cut into small cubes | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped celery | 1 medium green pepper, julienned
instructions: Spray nonstick skillet with cooking spray, heat to medium. Place cheese cubes on skillet in a single layer, sprinkling each with ground mace, and saute until cheese is bubbly, 3 to 5 minutes, stirring often. Remove skillet from heat. Spread feta cheese over a medium serving plate. Mix vinegar, celery, and green pepper in a small bowl. Scatter pepper mixture evenly over cheese. Swirl vegetable oil spray over cheese to prevent sticking.

title: Kielbasa, Broccoli, and Peppers
ingredients: 15 green peppers, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 3 -4 heads fresh broccoli stems | 1 lb kielbasa | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Heat a large wok to smoking. Place kielbasa and black peppercorns in hot wok. As soon as kielbasa is about half done toss in broccoli and cook till just a few stalks remain crisp. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,beef chuck,bay leaf,chicken thigh fillet,cardamom pod
title: Cardamom Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg beef chuck | 6 chicken thighs fillets, cut in half | 4 bay leaves | 2 cardamom pods | 6 cups madeira wine
instructions: Trim beef of all sinew and excess fat including the bone and discard. Cut into 5cm cubes that are roughly the same size and thickness of the chuck. Cut two pieces of foil large enough to enclose meat and cut a double line of foil down the middle of the meat so that it rests on the foil in the middle of the meat mixture. Wrap the meat in the foil and place it in the centre of the foil. Put in the bay leaves and cardamom pods. Pour over the madeira and tie tightly around the meat. Place into the refrigerator over night. Pre heat the oven to 160 deg celsius. Place the tin foil on your top shelf in the oven to keep turning the meat. This should take about an hour. You will have to turn the meat every ten minutes and every ten minutes. Do not take off the lid during cooking if you prefer a thicker sauce. Remove the meat from the oven, remove and discard the lining foil and foil and put into an ovenproof baking dish. Pour over the madeira and cover with foil covering the meat. Cook in the oven for about 2 hours turning meat over every 40 minutes to make sure the meat is well cooked. Check the meat, if it is done it should be a rich, dark brown colour and it should feel no more than crunchy. When cooked, remove the meat and leave to stand 5 - 10 minutes. Taste for seasoning and serve. Note, if the flavour is really strong, you can add a touch of cinnamon to taste. You may want to add a couple of drops of brown sugar. To make it hotter add more cinnamon to taste. When adding the cardamon, you need to add at least a teaspoon of ground cardamom into the mix. If you like it to be more tart you can add a touch of cinnamon. This mix should not be too tart. I like a touch of sweet and sour flavour.

Random Ingredients: lamb stock,rice flour,picante sauce,spice,white pepper,red food coloring,hamburger bun
title: Hamburger (Or Sausage)  With  Rice Laps
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 4 ounces rice flour ( rice flour is best, just not plain rice flour ) | 1 tablespoon chili powder mixed spice | 1 1/2 cups turkey stock ( or beef if you prefer or you can use beef broth ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce ( can use more and your heat preference ) | 1 drop red food coloring, if desired | pinch of white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a large bowl. Let sit for 5 minutes while you prepare your final meal. For more flavor, place a small piece of waxed paper between your hands to make certain the surface stays coated with oil or margarine.

Random Ingredients: pork belly,stout beer,garam masala,yellow cornmeal,oregano leaf,amaretto,food coloring,baby carrot
title: Pork and Ale Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground amaretto | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 4 ounces pork belly, thinly sliced crosswise | 4 ounces baby carrots, peeled and thinly sliced crosswise | food coloring ( optional, we like a lot ) | 1/4 cup stout beer, such as guinness
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease an 8 x 3 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. In a medium sized bowl, stir together cornmeal, oregano, amaretto and garam masala. Add the pork and toss to coat. Spread the pork mixture evenly over the bottom of the prepared pan. Arrange 3 carrots over the pork mixture, then spread the remaining carrots over the carrots, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle the top with about 1/4 cup stout, enough to almost cover the dough. Bake in oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until crust is golden brown and pork is cooked through. Remove from the oven and cool for 45 minutes, then cut into chunks. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Apple and Chardonnay Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mirin or 1 tablespoon sweet rice wine | 6 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 firm tart apples | 1 tablespoon fresh orange zest | 1 tablespoon capers ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together the mirin and fish sauce in small bowl. Core and slice apple, then put into bowl with the mirin and fish sauce. Squeeze the zest of one orange into bowl, then throw all apples in bowl. Toss with apple mixture. Let sit for ten minutes over low heat before serving. Use as a dipping sauce for fresh vegies.

title: Fettuccini Con Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 package prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 bunch green fresh coriander, leaves picked
instructions: Heat a generous amount of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Saute the prosciutto for about 10 seconds, to release fragrance. Add the coriander and fry until the liquid is reduced. Cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain and serve hot.

title: Chocolate Minted Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg leg of lamb | 1/2 cup finely chopped white chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon chili paste, paste with mint
instructions: Preheat grill until very hot. Turn oven out on rack 6 inches below element. Prop door slightly ajar with flameproof bowl underneath, and place lamb, fat side up. Place ovenproof dish on grill. Toast about 12 minutes, or until meat begins to crisp. Turn oven off. Pour off fat. Carefully slide lamb onto rack in oven. Turn heat down to 140 degrees celcius. Cook to desired doneness of lamb, about 1 hour. Transfer lamb to plate when fat starts to run off. To serve, remove tray from grill and remove lamb from leg of lamb with forks. Cut meat into thin slices, and arrange on platter. Place dipping bowls or glasses on top.

title: Swiss Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese | 4 spring onions
instructions: Cut the cheese into 2 cubes. Cut the spring onions into slices. Dip the cheese in the spring onion slices, then coat with the swiss cheese. Place into a glass pie pan in a single layer. Bake in a 350º oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,spanish peanut,sherry wine vinegar,ziti pasta
title: Korean Ziti with Ginger and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 pound ziti pasta | 12 slices fresh ginger root, sliced | 4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup spanish peanuts
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, then transfer the pasta to a bowl. Mix in the ginger slices and sherry vinegar until well combined. Sprinkle with peanuts and serve.

title: Bolita (Spanish Beef and Apple Stew)
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 -2 apple, cut into eighths | any flavor apple, cut into eighths
instructions: In 1 1/2 gallon zipper top plastic bag, add meat and shake to combine. Arrange apple eighths around meat. Pour apple slices around meat. Close bag. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 350°f. Unwrap meat. Place on rack in shallow 2 1/2 quart roasting pan. Bake 45 - 50 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Pumpkin Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 500 g farfalle pasta, cooked | 250 g raw ground pumpkin puree | 80 g pancetta, chopped ( pref stifado ) | 30 g marjoram, chopped | 1 lemon thyme, chopped | 60 g sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 500 g lean ground pork, browned
instructions: Mix the farfalle and pumpkin in a bowl with the pancetta, marjoram, thyme and sun dried tomatoes. Add the browned pork and mix together so the meat is all covered. Divide the mixture into about 50cm size balls and place on a baking tray. Flatten the balls slightly with a fork and top with the diced sun dried tomatoes. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 40 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cherry,cranberry,shortening,pork shoulder roast,wild rice,turkey breast,romano cheese,cream tartar
title: Swiss-Style Turkey With Wild Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup shortening | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 cups cubed cooked turkey breast | 2 tablespoons freshly grated romano cheese | 2 tablespoons canned cranberries | 1/4 cup wild rice | fresh cherry ( optional )
instructions: In a large frying pan, melt shortening over medium heat until foaming. Turn heat down to low and add sour cream and cream of tartars and cream of tartar to shortening. In a large mixing bowl, stir together turkey breast, romano cheese and cranberries with poultry seasoning until well blended. Add meat mixture to shortening mixture and toss to coat. Serve turkey warm or at room temperature. If turkey cooks quickly, cover loosely with aluminum foil and reduce heat. Simmer 30 - 45 minutes or until thermometer registers 170f for medium rare. Cooks may also be prepared on grill, pan or griddle. Serve with wild rice and platter.

title: Coffee Substitute (Egg-Filled)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant coffee powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon granule,shortcrust pastry,mayonnaise,orange bell pepper,red potato
title: Orange Pepper Pot Sticker Tartlets
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes, diced | 1 large orange bell pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons mayonnaise, divided | 4 sheets ready rolled shortcrust pastry ( thawed if frozen ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c/425°f/gas mark 5 and line a baking tray with a baking paper. Combine the potatoes and bell pepper in a bowl and toss. Add the 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil and mix. Mix in the remaining oil. Season with pepper and bouillon granules. Spread mixture evenly in a rectangle baking tray. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and crispy. Cool. Remove the shortcrust pastry and cut into rectangles. Roll out the rectangles and cut out the desired shape. Line a baking tray with paper cases. Slice the cooled tartlets into 4 rounds and put on the greased tray. Spread with half the orange and half the peppers. Using the reserved strips of shortcrust pastry, make a cross and pinch the edges. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes under the grill until golden and crisp, and serve hot.

title: Black-Laced Peas
ingredients: 14 ounces frozen tiny peas | 10 sprigs black olives, preferably walnut | 15 slices black olives ( such as castelvetrano or castelvetrano )
instructions: Open frozen peas and place in a serving bowl. Cover peas loosely with plastic wrap and microwave on high, using 1 minute intervals, until peas are thawed and plump. Using slotted spoon, transfer peas to serving bowl, sprinkle with 2 olives and 2 sprigs green olives, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,bosc pear,parsley,french bread,hoisin sauce,chuck,corn oil,baking soda
title: French Dip With Pears and Strawberries
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh roma tomatoes | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon corn oil ( to coat ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can bosc pears, syrup only ( optional ) | 1 loaf french bread, split lengthwise | 1 large head parsley
instructions: Slice the tomatoes in half down one side and then slice those into slices about 1 thick in size. Reserve for another meal. In a medium bowl, mix hoisin sauce with baking soda, and mix well. Cut pears in half and remove the core, leaving a 2 inch half on the fruit. Chop the pears and reserve for another meal. Slice the bread lengthwise into 1 thick slices and rub with some of the corn oil into the slices. Place the bread in a 13 x 9 baking dish. In a bowl, mix tomatoes, hoisin sauce, and reserved fruit. Pour mixture into glass bowl top with slices of the bread and bake at 300 degrees for 30 minutes or until the bread is lightly toasted and the bread has crisped up a bit. Allow to stand for about 10 minutes before topping with pears and strawberries.

title: Filled Dijon Salad
ingredients: dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles | 3 tablespoons hazelnuts | 1/3 cup chopped hazelnuts | 5 -6 fresh spinach leaves, torn ( or fresh spinach ) | hazelnuts, toasted | salad filling, enough to fill salad plate ( or homemade_ recommended ) | filling, enough to fill salad plate ( or homemade recommended ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Make sure the filling is made yourself & let the filling rest before using. The best way to do this is to cut off the stem end of the chiles & pull out the seed then scrape out the pepper seeds. Soak chiles in water until softened, about 30 minutes. Drain & pat dry. Process chilies in food processor till pulverized, add nuts & chop coarsely. Add spinach & process until a chunky texture is reached, 2 or 3 minutes. You may or may not have to do this, but the idea is to wilt the spinach & make sure it is not sticking. If it seems dry add a bit of the filling & keep on going till you get a creamier consistency. Adjust salt & pepper to your own tastes. This is also very versatile, adding herbs in the salad & adding the mayo before serving. Also if using cheese, you may add the optional filling to the salad before serving. This may be served as a topping over fried or poached eggs.

title: Scallion Tomato Sauce (Bread Dip)
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe plum tomatoes, peeled | 3 tablespoons scallions, chopped | 2 cups soft fresh breadcrumbs
instructions: Chop tomatoes finely. Dice scallions. Set to the side. Add bread crumbs to the bread crumbs. Mix well. Serve warm with slices of fresh tomato.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,biscuit,kosher salt black pepper,beef,italian bread,vegetable stock,ginger garlic paste,chicken stock cube
title: Nanaimo Pot With Meat
ingredients: 1 slice whole-wheat bolillie biscuit | 1 1/2 lbs chopped beef | 1 ounce ginger-garlic paste | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 pinch kosher salt and black pepper | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, mixed, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place biscuit on baking sheet. With a meat mallet, pound biscuit until even and about 1/8 thick. Combine with beef and ginger garlic paste in large bowl. Shape mixture into 1 inch meatballs. Toss with half the peanut or vegetable oil. Arrange meatballs on top of biscuit. Season with salt and pepper. Place in oven and bake 60 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Remove meatballs from oven. Remove the meatballs, and place on absorbent paper towel and pat dry. Set aside. For gravy, combine oil, stock and mixed vegetables in saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, over medium heat for 5 minutes. Bring to boil, reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 15 - 30 minutes. Serve meatballs and vegetables with gravy.

title: Lebanese Spiced Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole cumin seed | 1 pint ice water, or as needed to get a good consistency | 1 pinch salt to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place the cumin seeds in a skillet over medium heat, and pour in the water. Stir occasionally until the water comes to a boil. Remove from heat, and allow to steep for about 15 minutes. Add a pinch of salt, if desired. Pour the mixture into a glass container with a tight fitting lid, and allow to sit while you make the rest of the meal. Once the salt is dissolved, store in the container.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,family tea,active yeast,horseradish,nori,lime,gruyere cheese,black peppercorn
title: Baked Onion and Gruyere Samosas
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast, such as rapid release loaves | 3 1/2 cups warm buttermilk, divided | 2 onions, minced | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons crushed dried onion flakes | 1 sheet nori, seaweed sheets | 2 cups grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon horseradish
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup warm buttermilk in a large bowl. Add onions and 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes to yeast mixture and stir to combine. Cover and set in a warm spot until very bubbly, about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, combine oregano, 1 tablespoon oregano, 1 tablespoon oregano, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, pepper, and 1 teaspoon salt in a small bowl or food processor. Using the pulse setting, cut cheese into thin strips 1 to 2 inches wide by 2 inches long. In a small bowl, combine remaining 1 1/2 cups warm buttermilk with remaining teaspoon dried onion flakes and set aside. Place seaweed sheets in a large circle of plastic wrap on a baking sheet. Pour in enough buttermilk to make a batter of medium consistency, about 1 1/2 cups. Place cheese strips in another large bowl and pour the batter through a feed tube or rubber spatula, making sure each slice has a bit of shredded cheese to them. Sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes and dried onion flakes to taste. Spread mixture evenly on the seaweed leaves. Cover with plastic wrap and leave it in a warm spot until bread has doubled in size on baking sheet, about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 450°f spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Bake samosas in center of oven until golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven and brush generously with horseradish. Cool on baking sheet for a few minutes and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,green chilies,triple sec,baking soda,walnut
title: Green Chili Poppers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green chilies, sliced ( can use jalapeno or a combination of other green chilies ) | 1 tablespoon natural peanut butter | 3/4 cup firmly packed walnuts or 3/4 cup cashews | 2 teaspoons triple sec or 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Melt the peanut butter and set aside. In a bowl, dry fry the chilies in the sugar for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove the chillies and set aside. Add all the other ingredients with the reserved chilies to the peanut butter. Mix well. Let stand for 5 mins stir in the chilies and nuts.

Random Ingredients: garlic chive,milk ricotta cheese,lobster,cherry,bread,english cucumber,bisquick,rump roast
title: Lobster-Cucumber-Crustless Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lobsters, cleaned, shelled and halved crosswise | 1 1/2 lbs ricotta cheese, drained | 1/4 cup milk ( or low-fat milk ) | 1/4 cup bisquick | 1/4 cup garlic chives, chopped | 4 slices country bread, 1/2 inch thick | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced, seeded | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a 10 inch cast iron skillet. Spread the lobster meat with half the ricotta cheese, then cover with another third of the cheese. Dredge with the chives. Arrange the bread, lobster, cucumber, tomatoes, and remaining cheese mixture in two large shallow baking dishes. Cover the dishes with a lid or aluminum foil. Bake for 40 minutes or until filling is hot and bubbling..

Random Ingredients: glace cherry,golden syrup,ginger garlic paste,rye bread,extra virgin olive oil,beef tenderloin
title: Australian Meat Kabobs (Kebab Barg)
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | golden syrup, and sweetener to taste | ginger-garlic paste, to taste | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( or less ) | glace cherries, for garnish
instructions: Using a metal skewer, push a piece of rind into each slice of bread. In a large glass or ceramic bowl, mix together the beef.

title: Pastry With Parsnips and Crisp Parsnips Filled Diamonds
ingredients: 500 g cake flour, all purpose ( or use 1/2 cup whole-grain white bread flour ) | 500 g parsnips, peeled and cut into rounds | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley or 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, sift the baking soda and flour into a pile. Add the vegetables and mix together with your hands to make a rough dough. Use your hands to break up the dough into a ball. Turn out onto a floured board, knead briefly, then repeat the kneading and tossing over the work surface until just smooth and elastic. Shape into two balls, wrap in plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator for 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 220c/450f/gas line a 30x20cm baking tray with baking paper. Shape the dough into two discs. Using a rolling pin, roll out each disc until very thin and about 5cm/1 inch thick. Use a sharp knife to cut each disc into 30 triangles, scatter with a little more parsley and cover with plastic wrap. Bake for 30 minutes or until the parsnips are golden and crisp.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,white peppercorn,coriander sprig,apricot preserve,soy sauce,parmigiano reggiano cheese,barley,plain flour
title: Dairy Free Risotto
ingredients: 100 g barley | 250 g good quality soy sauce | 200 g white peppercorns | 2 tablespoons barley flour or 2 tablespoons plain flour | 50 g coriander sprigs | 50 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 100 g dried apricot preserves | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Blanch the barley in a large saucepan with boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain well, place in a large bowl, cover with clean cloth and set aside to steam for 5 minutes. Using a mortar and pestle, pound the grains in a heavy based frying pan or in a grinder for 1 minute. Put in a bowl, add the other ingredients and mix using your hands until the mixture is moist and smooth. Add the marinade mix in increments, little by little to make sure it is absorbed and the final product is creamy. To cook the risotto, heat a well oiled frying pan over a high heat. Form into small, flat balls, then add 2 - 3 tbsp of the rice batter in a thick, flat space. Quickly lift a ball from the risotto and place in a hot frying basket and fry until crisp. The easiest way to handle the risotto is to leave the risotto in the basket sitting in a colander. As the rice rises to the surface it will begin to release its aroma. Turn over and cook the other side. The rice should have a chewy texture when done. As the rice is cooking, place a good handful of rice into a bowl, and cover with a damp towel to keep warm on a warm oven. Pour 2 - 3 tbsp of the leftover water from the rice bowl into a saucepan and bring to the boil, stirring to remove any clumps. Pour this onto one side of the rice, and spread on a flat serving dish. Place another dish on top, and use a spoon to spread the remaining rice around. Cut a circle out of a thin slice from the edge of the serving dish and arrange on top, leaving just the edge uncovered. Leave to dry out in a warm oven with the rice at a low setting for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cheese,orzo pasta,potato starch,pizza sauce,peanut oil vegetable,apple juice,head cauliflower
title: Fried Vegetables With Orzo or Garlicky Noodles (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 1/2 cup orzo pasta ( orzo ) | 2 teaspoons potato starch or 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup pizza sauce ( or to taste ) | peanut oil or vegetable oil | 1 small head cauliflower, trimmed and cut lengthwise into 1-inch florets | 2 cups cheese, of choice such as fontine | 1/4 cup apple juice ( or to taste )
instructions: In a pot with just enough water to cover orzo, bring to a boil over medium high heat, and cook 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain, and rinse with cold water. Combine potato starch with a little water. Add to orzo, and stir until well combined. Heat half the peanut oil or vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet to a low heat. Add cauliflower, and toss until just crisp tender. Remove cauliflower with a slotted spoon or tongs, drain briefly, and place in a large bowl. Stir cheese into the warm oil, and cook about 1 minute, just to melt. Pour over the orzo, and toss until coated. In a small bowl, mix apple juice with the remaining oil and apple juice, and pour over the orzo.

title: Russian Vodka Vodka Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 ounces vodka
instructions: Put tomato paste in one bowl. Add vodka, stir until dissolved.

title: Guacamole - for Two or More!
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes | 500 ml ice cream ( or other dairy product ) | jalapeno, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mash avocados lightly. Add ice cream and jalepeno, mixing well. Refrigerate at least one hour, longer is traditional on me, but it's really up to you when i serve it.

title: Mexican Feijoada
ingredients: 6 ounces serrano chilies or 6 ounces jalapeno chiles, diced in 1/4 inch wide pcs | 1/4 cup dried mushroom | 1 lb monterey jack cheese, cubed | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom ( powdered, add more if you wish ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 -2 teaspoon tea, warmed ( i used a hot tea such as earl grey )
instructions: Soak mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes, then drain. Cut stems off chilies cut to fit inside cheese and set aside. Combine cornstarch with cold water. Dredge chiles in cornstarch mixture. Add to mushrooms and mix. Set aside. In large skillet heat 1 - 2 tablespoons oil until hot. Sautee marinated and mushrooms until soft. In small dish, add the cheese cubes and sautee in remaining oil until melted. Remove from heat and add to skillet with the cheese mixture. Sauté until bubbly. Stir constantly. Add vanilla, spices and tea and mix well. Cool and serve.

title: Cape Malay  Spiced   Baked  -   Brisket of  Beef
ingredients: 12 whole cloves | 4 -5 lbs beef ( i use a tri-tip roast ) | 1/2 bunch scotch bonnet peppers, soaked overnight and then chopped | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 2 tablespoons scotch bonnet peppers, soaked overnight and then chopped | 8 cardamom pods
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a large dutch oven, add 6 cloves. Add the beef and stir with a metal spoon until the pieces are well coated. Place the contents of the dutch oven into the dutch oven, cover the pot and place in the oven overnight. When ready to roast, remove and discard the cloves. After about 15 minutes, remove the meat to a platter. Drain off any grease remaining in the pot. Add the rest of the ingredients to the pot and mix well. Cover and place on medium heat for about 1 hour. Do not allow to boil. Keep checking occasionally to make sure it will not burn. Remove from the oven and put onto a plate, serve and enjoy.

title: Garlic Sausage and Cherry Appetizers
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh sweet cherries, pitted, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, ground | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chili powder or 1 -1 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 10 olives or 10 greek olives, pitted and halved | 2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and stir. Refrigerate overnight if desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,red onion,saffron,part mozzarella cheese,maple syrup
title: Savory French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 loaf thin sliced deli fresh french-style onions | 1/4 cup red onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice french style onion on one side only.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,rigatoni pasta,molasses,kidney bean,hot red chili pepper,cayenne pepper,veal,shallot
title: Spicy Veal Pie
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal, uncooked | 1 small shallot, minced | 12 ounces baked rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces penne pasta | 2 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon molasses, warmed ( optional ) | 4 -5 hot red chili peppers ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 sheet frozen pie shell
instructions: Prepare pie crust, preheat oven to 400°f. Brown veal, breaking up small chunks as you go. Place veal, shallot, 1 tsp molasses, undrained kidney beans into bowl to combine. Place pasta, chili peppers, cayenne pepper and remaining molasses into bowl to combine. Spread meat mixture into pie shell. Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce temperature to 350f, bake an additional 20 minutes or until crust is firm. Serve with your choice of side dishes.

title: Avocados - Portuguese Eggplant and Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, sliced 1/8 inch thick | 2 tablespoons fish stock ( or vegetable stock ) | 1 jar lemonsade, undiluted ( about 5 cups ) | 2 cans bean sprouts, drained | 2 cups avocados, halved, pitted, and sliced
instructions: In a large bowl combine eggplant, fish stock, lemonade, and beansprouts. Toss with avocados and chill well. Serve at room temperature.

title: Baked Mexican Sausages
ingredients: 12 fresh medium shell pasta | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 avocado, chopped | 1/3 cup malt biscuits | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons shredded semisweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a large biscuit size baking dish. Fill each shell with about 3 tablespoons of peanut butter, or to taste. Scatter with mango and avocado slices. In a small bowl, blend malt biscuits with 1 tablespoon peanut butter and 1 tablespoon shredded chocolate. Place mixture in each shell, and bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,salami,mexican corn,green bean,yellow squash,panko breadcrumb,pasta,lime juice
title: Pasta Salad With Creamy Corn Salsa and Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, cooked, drained ( i prefer fettucine ) or 1 lb rotini pasta ( i prefer fettucine ) | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 can yellow squash, drained ( or 2 of each, frozen or fresh ) | 1 can green beans, sliced ( or use fresh and green ) | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 8 ounces salami, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons mexican-style corn or 2 tablespoons green bell peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. If your mixture seems dry, add more panko to absorb any excess moisture.

title: Red-Cooked Beef Shanks
ingredients: 4 pounds beef shank, any type you can manage | 1 cup clementine juice | 2 cans diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar
instructions: Place beef shanks in slow cooker. In a small saucepan, combine the clementine juice, undrained tomatoes with chilies, brown sugar, and enough water to cover meat in slow cooker. Cook on high for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Meat should be moist.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,porcini mushroom,pork shoulder,sea salt,bread flour,celery rib,oyster sauce
title: Pork Loaf
ingredients: 350 g pork shoulder, cut into 5cm cubes | 2 celery ribs, trimmed and chopped | 1/2 cup whole meal flour | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon sea salt ( kosher or fine ) | pancetta or country-style fried mushrooms, thinly sliced | 12 bread slices or 8 pieces crusty bread, crust trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c and lightly grease a loaf pan with margarine or oil. Combine all ingredients except pancetta or fried mushrooms, in a bowl and mix well. Add pancetta or fried mushrooms, stirring to combine well. Spoon mixture into prepared pan. Dot with pancetta or fried mushrooms and bake 20 minute. Remove from oven and leave in to pan, uncovered for 5 - 10 minute until cooked through. Slice loaf into 6 - 8 slices to serve with a nice salad, vegetables and sauces.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,beef bouillon cube,cardamom seed,green cardamom pod,mango nectar,sirloin,pineapple ring
title: Grilled Mahi Mahi (A Hawaiian Beef and Pineapple Stir Fry)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 cup mango nectar ( or pineapple juice ) | 5 -6 pineapple rings, with their syrup | 6 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes | 1 green cardamom pod | 2 -3 crushed cardamom seeds
instructions: Slice beef across grain into 1/4 inch thick strips, removing fat and connective tissue. Slice into thin strips, then put into a zip top bag, pouring the marinade inside, close, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes, turning it once. Place pineapple rings, including syrup, in a 2 quart or larger slow cooker. Turn slow cooker on high and stir beef, reserving marinade. Add oil in a large saucepan to the hot, uncovered, over medium heat. Add bouillon and cardamom seeds. Stir well. Turn heat to high and add beef in a single layer, cook, turning gently, until meat is almost cooked through. Drain any remaining marinade into slow cooker, add mango nectar and stir to combine. Turn slow cooker on high, and cover. Cook for 30 - 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove lid, turn to low, and cook for an additional 25 minutes. Serve over steamed rice, garnished with pineapple wedges. Great served with mango dipping sauce.

title: Sopa Seca
ingredients: 14 ounces rice vermicelli, such as poblano peppers | 12 ounces kosher salt | 14 ounces poblano peppers ( about 1 large )
instructions: Prepare an ice bath. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Drop in the vermicelli and boil for 2 minutes. The noodles will be tender, and will be cooked when they are cool enough to handle, about 10 to 12 minutes. Drain and place the vermicelli in a bowl. Transfer 2/3 cup of the hot water into the bowl to stop the cooking. Squeeze the noodles to remove excess water. Drain the remaining 1/3 cup of hot water from the vermicelli in the bowl, and gently but thoroughly combine with the noodles. Transfer the sopa Seca to the ice bath, and refrigerate, uncovered, until serving for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Teddy's Famous Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons gouda cheese, cubed | 3 tablespoons crispy pepperoni | 1 package ramen noodles ( reserve seasoning packet ) | 1/2 tablespoon minced gingerroot | 1/2 tablespoon rice wine | 1 pint grape, red or ( 16 ounce ) pint schnapps | 1/3 cup pickled gingerroot, sliced ( garnish )
instructions: Toss all ingredients together and refrigerate 1 hour to develop flavors. Serve with additional picks. Garnish with slices of pickled ginger.

title: Tajine
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb or 2 lbs beef | 1 bunch cilantro | 4 plums | 4 hass avocadoes | pineapple ring | mustard | salt
instructions: Place all the ingredients in an oven proof crockpot/pot. Cook on high setting for 1 hour. Serve with rice.

title: Tomato Sauce for Bocconcini
ingredients: 1 cup ripe italian tomato, such as san marzano, cut crosswise into 1/2 `` -inch slices | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Rinse each tomato under cold running water and then pat dry with paper towels. Arrange slices on an ovenproof platter and top with salt. Let stand for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake tomato in shallow baking dish in oven for 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 200 degrees f. Continue baking tomato until just soft and beginning to char, 25 to 30 minutes more. Remove and discard tomato from oven. Using a slotted spoon or strainer, transfer tomato slices and any accumulated juices into a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper and serve hot or warm.

title: Beef and Edamame Sandwiches Ala Rick Bayless
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen peas and edamame, thawed | 3/4 lb boneless beef top sirloin, very thinly sliced | 1/2 cup frozen fully-cooked shelled edamame | 1/4 cup frozen mini chocolate chip | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 1/2 cups hot cooked rice | 3 1/2 tablespoons grated orange zest
instructions: Cook peas and edamame according to package directions, omitting salt and buttering the inside. While peas and edamame are cooking, pulse beef in food processor until finely minced. Add beef, peas and edamame to food processor and pulse just until meat is no longer julienned. To prepare sandwiches, combine beef mixture, edamame, mint, chocolate chips and onion. To assemble sandwiches, put 2 tablespoons of rice and orange zest in each of six separate sandwiches.
