title: Nori Sushi Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 1 lb ripe olives packed in oil, drained | 1/2 cup quick-cooking spray | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/8 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 1 pinch dried rosemary sprig | 1 nori, seaweed | cooking spray | 2 yellow bell peppers, cut into narrow strips | 1/4 cup orange peel, cut into 1/2-inch strips
instructions: In a food processor, blend olive oil, vodka, mustard and herb.

Random Ingredients: ciclon,orange,sugar pumpkin,cooking oil,chili flake,pico de gallo,chicken breast half
title: Stacked Chicken Breast With Spicy Citrus Salsa
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 1/2 cup pico de gallo, salsa fresca | 2 teaspoons sugar pumpkin seeds ( pepitas, or black beans, toasted poblanos can also be used ) | 1/2 orange, zested and juiced | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh pico de gallo
instructions: Mix salsa fresca, sugar pumpkin seeds, and orange zest with the orange juice to form a thick flavored salsa. Arrange the chicken breasts on a work surface. Place a thin layer of the salsa on each piece of chicken. Lay slices on a sheet of foil, and cover with foil. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook the chicken in the hot oil for 5 - 5 minutes or until browned on the outside and cooked through, turning once. Transfer the chicken to a cutting board, and add a little more oil if necessary. Cook the chile for about a minute or so, then remove from the skillet and set aside. Add the orange zest and juice to the skillet, and cook over a medium heat for about 30 seconds. Transfer the orange zest and juice to a measuring cup. Pour the orange juice over the chicken and remove from the skillet. Spoon the chicken and salsa mixture onto plates. Place a few pico de gallo squares on the chicken. Serve the chicken, pico de gallo, and salsa topped with sour cream.

title: Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 1/2 cup mushrooms with cap, thickened | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 3 bananas, sliced into rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange slices of mushrooms and green chile peppers on the bottom of a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with hot sauce, and arrange slices of banana over top. Bake in preheated oven until hot, about 1 hour.

title: Mama Trudy's Margarita
ingredients: 1/2 cup white tequila | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup grape, halved | 30 ladyfingers | 1/4 cup thinly sliced prosciutto | 2 teaspoons table salt
instructions: Pour the tequila into a large shallow dish or pan. Stir in flour, tipping out excess. Dip the ladyfingers into the tequila and set them aside in a small dish or pan. Add the prosciutto and the salt to the tequila, and set aside. Heat a cast iron skillet over low heat, but not smoking. Dip the ladyfingers into the tequila, then into the grape halves. Cook just until the edges begin to darken and they show some resistance. Do not touch the outside of the pan or the margarita may burn, but keep a close eye on it as you want the outside to remain dark. When you need to use your judgement, flip the ladyfingers. Keep one skewer out. When the margarita has stopped steaming, carefully transfer it onto your warm plate. Add the rest of the skewered ingredients to the center of the plate you are working with. Garnish with the fresh spearmint if you wish.

Random Ingredients: pineapple tidbit,thyme leave,mango chutney,sea scallop,lemon zest
title: Sea Scallops With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 sea scallops | 2 tablespoons lemon zest, finely grated | 2 tablespoons thyme leave, finely chopped | 1/2 cup mango chutney, roughly blended | 2 tablespoons pineapple tidbits
instructions: Place the scallops in a bowl, and sprinkle with the zest, thyme and chutney. Add enough water to completely cover the scallops, and allow to stand at room temperature for 2 hours. Preheat the broiler to high. Thread the scallops onto skewers. Discard any remaining marinade. Grill the scallops for 3 minutes on each side, or until crisp, brushing with more water as needed.

Random Ingredients: fingerling potato,graham cracker crumb,kosher salt,white wine,vinegar,sun tomato,greek seasoning,bow tie pasta
title: Greek-Tender Fingerling Potatoes and Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 lbs unpeeled fingerling potatoes | 1 1/4 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 teaspoons white wine or 1 1/4-1 1/2 teaspoons white grape juice | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 8 ounces bow tie pasta | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | grated fresh 2 tablespoons unglazed goat cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large pot, or dutch oven, cook the potatoes in boiling salted water just until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, reserving the cooking water and set the potatoes aside. In a small bowl, combine the greek seasoning, vinegar, salt and 2/3 cups water. Pour over the potatoes in the pot and stir thoroughly. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 3 - 5 minutes. Add the pasta and sun dried tomatoes. Cook until the pasta and potatoes are tender, about 3 - 5 minutes more. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper adobo sauce,red chilies,oil,beef bouillon cube,romaine lettuce,salt black pepper
title: Chipotle Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chilies or 1 tablespoon new mexico dried chipotle peppers, crushed | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 beef bouillon cube | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 4 cups romaine lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
instructions: Stir first 3 ingredients together. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Combine the beef cubes with enough water and adobo paste to cover meat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour to marinate, if possible, up to 4 hours. Toss with the romaine, and serve.

title: Lebanese Restaurant Herb Bread
ingredients: 2 cups greek yogurt | 4 cups baking soda | 2 cups pesto sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together yogurt, baking soda, and pesto sauce. Add more yogurt or pesto if desired.

title: Sultana Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 cups red lentils, washed and drained | 1 cup black-eyed peas, washed and drained | 1/4 cup sultana | 3 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Heat 2 cups of water to boiling point and add the beans and salt. Boil for 2 minutes and drain. Press down with a spoon. Cool down with a spoon, extracting liquid as required. Drain well and add the sultanas. Stir in the amaretto and vinegar. Mix well.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,spaghetti,corn oil,tarragon leaf,confectioner sugar,dark chocolate,lettuce,spring onion
title: Chilli Spaghetti
ingredients: 20 spring onions, chopped fine | 20 small corn oil | 100 g spaghetti | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds, crushed | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon leaves | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 8 -10 lettuce, washed and torn into small pieces | 80 g dark chocolate sprinkles or 90 g other chocolate sprinkles, to serve
instructions: Place the onions and corn oil in a large saucepan, place to one side. Fry the spaghetti. Drain the spaghetti and place in a bowl. Add the remaining oil, cumin and tarragon and the sugar. Stir to coat the spaghetti in the oil, and place on paper towels to soak up the oil. Toss the vegetables with half the grated chocolate and arrange on the spaghetti, top with the remaining grated chocolate. Serve immediately with lettuce, sprinkle with the remaining grated chocolate. The grated chocolate keeps in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

title: Char Siu Bao (Char Peach and Chiles Pepper Sauce)
ingredients: 4 medium ripe peaches ( about 2 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 celery ribs, minced
instructions: Peel and halve the peaches lengthwise.

title: Classic Italian Cheese Spread for Bread
ingredients: 250 g fresh ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon dry mustard ( or more )
instructions: In a small bowl mix ricotta cheese with the mustard. You can add mustard if you like a sweeter cheese. I use my stand mixer. If you can find dry mustard, you can use 1 tsp. Of that. Pour into individual crocks, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with more mustard and bake in an oven for 5 - 10 minutes. Best to serve warm as a cold appetizer.

title: Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark chocolate ( best quality ) | 300 g chicken breast tenders | 50 g blueberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave or in bowl on the stove top. Dip chicken pieces in chocolate. Coat with chocolate mix and place in refrigerator for 2 hours. After 2 hours, drain any remaining chocolate on absorbent paper. Turn pieces over and leave to cool. Top with blueberries and serve.

title: Cornmeal-Kale-Kale Bread
ingredients: 6 cups kale | 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Chop kale finely, place into a large mixing bowl. Add cornmeal and whole wheat flour and mix well. Add kale mixture and knead with hands until well blended. Place in a well buttered casserole dish or loaf pan. Bake at 425°f for about 1 1/2 hours. If using loaf pan remove lid for last half hour to brown up some.

title: Thai Baked Chicken Wings and Rice
ingredients: 1 can chicken wings | 1 cup coconut-flavored bean sprouts | 8 fresh mussels ( shelled ) ( optional ) | 2 -4 tablespoons thai chili | 1 head cabbage leaves ( sliced ) ( optional ) | 8 slices fresh strawberries ( optional )
instructions: If using live mussels, add them to boiling water. Add frozen chicken wings, cover and steam 10 - 15 minutes until the wings are no longer translucent in the center. Remove and discard any mussels that remain closed. Discard any unopened mussels or any broken ones that remain on the bottom of the pot. Set aside. Discard any unopened mussels or shellfish which remain on the bottom of the pot. In a large pot of lightly salted boiling water, cook the cabbage leaves until just softened, about 1 minute. Drain and set aside. In the same pot, add the basil and the chili. Cover and cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Rinse the pot thoroughly but not too often, as the basil will become dark. To save the color in the basil, wash under cold water and blot dry inside and out with a clean cloth. Set out the leaves of the bundle and place them in bowls on the floor of a colander in an even pile. Cover the bundle with a very strong, juicy cloth, which should help absorb the moisture from the basil leaves. Place some of the wrapped cabbage in the center of the bundle and sprinkle with salt and pepper, then place the bundle on top of the cabbage. Arrange the thai mussels in the center of the bundle. Place some slices of fresh strawberries on top of the mussels and place some of the basil bundle on top. Sprinkle with more salt and pepper and close with the wrapped bundle. Close the bundle with the folded edge of a kitchen towel and secure well. Repeat with the mussels, mussels and bundles until all the ingredients are used. Line a baking sheet with foil and preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place the bags, seam side down on the foil and bake in a preheated 425 degree f oven for about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and open each bag and gently squeeze out each air hole.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,salt black pepper,walnut,mexicorn,white breadcrumb,mustard oil,tarragon leaf,arborio rice
title: Mock Cretan Rice Balls in Walnut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup toasted walnuts | 3/4 cup finely chopped arborio rice | 3/4 cup toasted white breadcrumbs or 3/4 cup quick breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 2 teaspoons crumbled dried texas dry texas texas dried texas dried oregano | 1 cup shredded mcintosh applesauce ( `` or '' other brandy and tamarind-flavored beverage ) or 1 cup other hot cooked vegetables ( `` or '' other brandy and tamarind-flavored beverage ) | 2 1/2 cups dry whole grain cereal ( aka rice krispies or rice bubbles ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In medium bowl combine walnuts, rice, breadcrumbs, mustard oil, tarragon and oregano. Form into 1 inch balls, then gently press each ball to form oval shaped crescent shapes. Place on parchment paper lined sheet, spacing evenly. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown, turning halfway through cooking time. To make the sauce. In medium bowl, stir together applesauce and cereal. Pour over rice balls.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,dark rum,streaky bacon,graham cracker crumb,beef stock,crabmeat,chili oil
title: Cheeseburger Beef Rolls
ingredients: 500 g ground beef | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 200 g fresh crabmeat | 150 g yellow squash or 150 g zucchini, cubed | 1/3 cup prepared graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 1/2 cup beef stock ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c. Place 1 tsp of chili oil in a fry pan and saute mushrooms over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Place beef, crab meat & squash in a mixing bowl and season and stir well with a wooden spoon. Pour in 1/3 cup of rum and add another tsp of chili oil and crab meat mixture and stir well to combine. Place meat mixture down the centre of a clean cloth, tie it with a strip of string around the ball, & make a small opening at the centre. Repeat with remaining ingredients until all ingredients are used. Grease a baking sheet and shape meat log into a roll about 2 inches in diameter. Baste with rum and allow to rest in the oven for about 45 minutes. Serve on a buns with salsa & sour cream if desired. Note, for extra spice, some finely chopped walnuts or chopped coriander are also tasty in this beef roll. Note, this roll can also be made into a meat log for up to 6 servings, or with a meat log, or sliced meat on the diagonally. Basting sauce directions,. In medium fry pan, heat remaining chilli oil, add meat and fry over high heat for about 3 - 4 minutes, or until heated through and browned. Drain on paper towel. Place on a plate, cover with foil and keep warm. Add tomato sauce ingredients to pan and simmer over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until thick. Serve.

title: Apple Salmon Bagels
ingredients: 4 bagsels | 2 -3 tablespoons curry paste ( to your own taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 cups sliced smoked salmon | 1 1/2 teaspoons apple pie spice ( spice for taste, i use apple packed, but use your own favourite flavour for spice )
instructions: On the rangetop out the bagels. Brush with curry paste or other curry paste, if using. I usually do this step by pouring my apple pie spice into a pestle and mortar, then add the turmeric, apple pie spice and curry diluted water. Mix well to combine, then put down the bagels on a baking sheet, lined with parchment paper or newspaper. Bake in a preheated oven at 200c, about 15 - 15 min, or until the crust is a nice light brown colour.

title: Feta Spread
ingredients: 100 g feta | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup flour ( to thicken the mixture but not to mix with the feta )
instructions: Cube the feta finely, making sure the cubes are small and pliable you probably won't need them all. Add the chili flakes and flour and mix together very well. Form the mixture into a ball and leave it somewhere cool for about 10 minutes or you can chill it right away, then refrigerate it until needed. When ready to serve, it is nice and cold, too.

title: Kartoflu With Chicken wings (Lihapyoche)
ingredients: 5 lbs chicken wings, trimmed | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary leaves | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon dried mango pulp | 1 bay leaf | 2 lbs potatoes, peeled and cut in 2-inch wedges | salt | jam ( optional )
instructions: Remove the tough ribs from the wings, discarding them. In a large stockpot over a medium hig heeng heat, stir together the rosemary, dill, mango juice, bay leaf and sale. When it begins to boil, skim the foamy liquid from the surface. Boil 10 minutes. Add the duck wings and 2 cups water and simmer, skimming off any scum that rises to the surface, for 30 minutes or until the wings are tender and the sauce thickened. Adjust salt and serve hot accompanied by pieces of bread and jam.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,egg noodle,serrano pepper,chili oil,club soda
title: Noodles with Chili Oil
ingredients: 10 ounces dry egg noodles | 1/2 cup chili oil | 1/2 cup club soda | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 3 whole serrano peppers
instructions: To make all the ingredients, begin to boil water in a large pot. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix noodles. In a small pot add chili oil, club soda and lemon pepper mix. Drain the noodles well and add. The mixture to the noodles in the bowls. Don't stir, the noodles will thicken the sauce, but don't stir again if it doesn't. Serve with sour cream and chili oil.

title: Easy Orange Basil Bean Gratin
ingredients: 400 g red bean, drained shopping list | 200 ml almond milk ( or 1 tsp almond blossom water ) | 1 orange, zest of | 100 slices pancetta ( about 200g ) | canned basil sprigs, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven 190°c. Place the bean, almond milk and orange zest in a pan, bring to a simmer and cook gently for 45 mins or until tender. Spread the pancetta slices on a baking tray and cook in the oven for 10 - 15 mins or until crisp, remove from oven and set aside. Place a layer of bean mixture in a gratin dish and place the remaining bean mixture on top, sprinkle with basil, finish with a layer of pancetta. Cover with a sheet of aluminium foil and bake for 15 - 20 mins or until golden brown and bubbling.

title: The Secret to Perfect Herb Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup liquid honey | parsley flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a small small bowl mix and stir all the ingredients together until well blended. For best results, leave it in for an hour or so to allow the flavors to mingle. This makes a great garlic herb spread for garlic bread or sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: orange sherbet,pork loin roast,meat,cardamom,chipotle pepper,rapeseed oil,breadcrumb,fennel seed
title: Fennel Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 jar orange sherbet | 1 tablespoon poppy seed oil | 1 tablespoon rapeseed oil | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 3 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon grated cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried chipotle pepper | 2 cups dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Prepare the marinade, in a blender or food processor, combine all the marinade ingredients and blend until smooth. Trim all fat from the pork loin and discard the strings. Cut the meat into 1 inch slices and place in an 11 x 7 inch crockpot. Top with the marinade and cook on low for 3 1/2 hours. Let cool slightly. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Spread the bread crumbs on a baking sheet and roast until lightly browned and crusty, about 20 minutes.

title: White Beans and Toast
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained | 1/8 - 1/4 cup sour cream | 2 loaves italian bread
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sized bowl.

title: Tarragon Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese or 2 cups swiss cheese | 3 tablespoons shortening | 4 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: In medium bowl whisk all ingredients, except cream and cheese, together until cheese is blended.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,allspice,meatball,oatmeal,fennel seed,shallot,red pepper sauce,green chile pepper
title: Jamaican Meatballs
ingredients: meatballs : | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 fresh green chile pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 cup dry oatmeal
instructions: Combine onion, green chile pepper, fennel seed, crushed red pepper sauce, mango chutney, and allspice together in a bowl. Roll and shape the meatballs into balls. Add the oatmeal to a skillet, bring to a boil, and cook the meatballs until they are no longer pink inside, 4 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,vegetable broth,beef stew meat,sesame seed
title: Easy Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut in 4 pieces | 2 cans vegetable broth or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) cans broth | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, divided | 1/3 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Coat a large casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a large skillet, layer beef, onion, broth, 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, and cheese. Cover and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.

title: Fork Fried Pineapple
ingredients: 1 fresh pineapple ring | 4 ounces cooked ground meat
instructions: Open the pineapple, remove the fruit and discard as much of the white pith as possible, leaving a firm shell. Carefully remove the white membrane and white base and core from the center of the pineapple. With a small knife, remove the outer rim from the shell with a slight shell to prevent the meat from falling off during frying. If using fresh pineapple, remove the inner core and discard. Cut out the top, and discard. Using your fingers or a spoon, gently flick the shell apart, removing all of the membrane or white inner flesh of the pineapple. Using a large spoon, scrape out the pulp and top with the cooked meat. Fry in a low sided pan, working in batches, until browned lightly. Sprinkle with any reserved white flesh.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,peach,mustard seed,brussels sprout,english muffin,pimiento,pork tenderloin
title: Sesame Brussels Sprouts on English Muffins
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 7 cups brussels sprouts, trimmed | 1 cup canned peach slices | 1/4 cup jarred pimiento, drained, rinsed and chopped | 1/4 cup mustard seeds | 2 english muffins, halved lengthwise and toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat sesame oil in a dutch oven over high heat. Add pork and sauté until browned, about 5 minutes. Cut sprouts in half and toss with pork. Place brussels sprouts in a large bowl. Add peanut, pimento and mustard seeds.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,green bell pepper,onion soup mix,bread,mustard powder,walnut,apricot
title: Walnut and Mustard Crumble-Up
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion soup mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 green bell peppers, sliced | 2 large apricots, sliced | 1/4 cup toasted walnuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Toss bread with salad oil, onion soup mix, mustard powder, and bell pepper slices. Arrange in a lightly oiled casserole dish. Bake for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with walnuts and bake 5 minutes more.

title: Taco Ring
ingredients: 1 jar prepared taco sauce | 1/2 cup finely chopped pimiento | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche
instructions: Mix all the ingredients, except the creme fraiche, together. Pour into a ring mold, leaving 1/2 inch around the outside rim. Refrigerate overnight. Turn out the ring onto a serving dish and top with whipped creme fraiche.

title: Spinach, Pepito and Chili Noodle Salad with Pepito's
ingredients: 8 ounces soft dried pepito ( about 10 pepito leaves ) | 5 ounces fresh spinach leaves, rinsed well, patted dry and finely chopped | 1 large green or white poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1 jalapeno, seeded and chopped | 2 ounces dried guajillo chilies or 2 ounces cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 lb fresh short noodles, broken into pieces
instructions: Put the pepito in a small pot with enough water just to cover and bring to a boil, or enough to cover the pepito by 1 inch, or just so, and boil very gently until the pepito has softened and turned light green. Drain well and refrigerate until cold. When ready to use, drain off any liquid from the pepito and tear into tiny pieces. Put the hot pepito into a serving bowl, and stir in the spinach and chopped chile, jalapeño, and guajillo or cilantro. Taste, adjust the seasonings and toss in the noodles before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian beef,breadcrumb,monterey jack cheese,orange blossom water,baking potato,cumin powder,hot italian sausage
title: Spicy Orange Baked Potato Patties
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes ( or 1 large regular potato ) | 1 lb vegetarian ground beef ( or lean ground beef ) | 1/2 lb hot italian sausage ( or mild italian sausage - cooked, drained, and diced ) | 1 ounce breadcrumbs | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 orange blossom water or 1 -1 tablespoon orange extract ( optional, to taste ) | 2 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f degrees. Wash potatoes thoroughly, pat dry, and cut into 1 inch pieces. Place potatoes in a greased 13x9 inch baking dish, or a shallow baking dish of suitable size. Sprinkle meat with bread crumbs, cumin, and orange blossom water. Bake, uncovered, about 1 hour at 300f degrees, until meat and potatoes are cooked through. Sprinkle cheese over potato mixture, and bake just until cheese melts, about 5 minutes, depending on how hot it gets. Serve warm.

title: BBQ Salmon (Smoked or Barley) With Prosciutto and Mushrooms
ingredients: 16 ounces smoked salmon, whole grain, sliced for basting ( or salmon roe ) | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 8 ounces mushrooms, quartered lengthwise then sliced thinly ( or other mushrooms ) | 4 slices prosciutto ( or other thick slice of bacon ) | 3 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce
instructions: Place smoked salmon in a bowl. Combine brown sugar and mushrooms with sliced prosciutto. Sprinkle generously over salmon. Dot with prosciutto/sauce and grill on high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until prosciutto has become crispy and brown.

title: Red Curry Tea
ingredients: 5 cups tea, cold | 3 teaspoons red curry paste | 3 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon ( i've added a tbls. of water ) ( optional )
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil. Add all the curry paste. Stir until blended and remove from the heat. Add tea to the bowl that you'll brew the tea inches bring to a boil for a full minute. Pour the cooled tea into a teapot and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,mexicorn,taco seasoning mix,fennel,green bell pepper,silken tofu,ginger
title: Mexican-Style Ground Beef and Tofu
ingredients: 1 package silken tofu | 1/2 beef chuck, ground | 1 green bell pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 1 bag frozen corn | 1/2 jar small mexicorn | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon ground fennel
instructions: Cut tofu crosswise into 1 1/2 inch slices. Place in a deep skillet with water to cover.

title: Saffron Macadamia Nuts (Al Jibna Chole Tamarind)

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan & bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover & simmer for 7 minutes.

title: String Beans and Peanuts

instructions: Heat up 1 - 2 tbsp of peanut oil in a large frying pan and fry the string beans and dry french bread until nicely browned. Drain on paper towels and serve over a bowl of chilled sparkling apple cider.

title: Warm Belgian Sprouts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 package brussels sprouts, trimmed and sliced | 2 tablespoons fennel, sliced | 2 tablespoons shelled pistachios, chopped
instructions: Combine worcestershire sauce, soy sauce and fennel in an airtight bowl or plastic bag. Add brussels sprouts and toss to coat. Cover and let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. Drain well. Add to a colander and toss to coat. Transfer brussels sprouts to a large baking sheet.

title: Lamb Loin, Mustard, Lamb Chops and Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons fresh marjoram, chopped | 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons butter | 4 lamb loin chops | 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Preheat oven to in a frypan, heat oil, mustard seeds, marjoram and half the lard or butter. Put chops in and cover with the remaining butter. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes. Spoon some of the gravy over and continue to cook another 15 - 20 minutes, or until chops are cooked to your taste, basting frequently.

title: Palak Phulayto
ingredients: 300 g spinach | 1 vanilla pod | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons low-fat powdered milk or 2 tablespoons low-fat plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Wash the spinach thoroughly, dry it with some paper towels. Break up the leaves and finely chop them. Heat a large, heavy based kadai and put on a high flame. Smear the upper part of the kadai with some non fat butter. Now pour 2 tbsps. Of oil in it. Tightly crack the vanilla pod, drop it into this kadai, and quickly fry the other side of the kadai. Toss in the chopped spinach alongwith two tablespoons of water, powdered milk or yogurt. Cover and cook. Stir every couple of minutes for ten minutes. Garnish with mint leaves. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,bay scallop,vegetable oil,snow pea,sauce,chicken breast half,pear
title: Grilled Creole-Style Scallops with Pears and Snow Peas

instructions: Place chicken in a large bowl. Pour hot sauce over chicken.

title: Picadillo (Mexican Beef Rice and Red Grape Casserole)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 cup dry mustard powder | 2 cans rotel tomatoes ( if canned, drain juice into strainer ) | 8 -10 ounces frozen red grapes, cut in half | 2 cups long grain rice | 4 cups red seedless grapes
instructions: Spray 3 - 9 x 13 baking dishes with vegetable cooking spray. Cut stewing beef into 1 inch cubes. Dredge meat with flour, mustard powder and salt and pepper. Place in greased 13x9 baking dish. Add 1 can of tomatoes and a third can of rotel and 1 cup of red grapes. Mix thoroughly. Pour remaining rotel liquid over the meat. Bake covered at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 1 1/2 hours. Add remaining 3 cans of tomatoes, rice, grape halves and remaining grapes. Cover tightly and bake for 30 minutes or until rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,cajun seasoning,sake,malt vinegar,cinnamon,white mushroom,arborio rice,guinness stout
title: Cajun Sticky Rice

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f with rack in middle. For the marinade, combine cajun seasoning, creole seasoning, malt vinegar, and rice in medium bowl.

title: Low Fat Spicy Snow Peas With Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk, chilled | canola oil, for cooking | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, crushed | 1 package snow peas
instructions: Place the soymilk, cocoa powder and chile into a blender, and process until smooth. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the snow peas, and stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes. Sprinkle with the soy milk, and toss to combine. Serve immediately.

instructions: In a small bowl whisk together 2 cups of the salt, 1 cup of the hazelnut flavored liqueur, and the flour to combine. Mix in the chopped cabbage. title: Mexican Style Chili Gravy for Turkey
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef or 1 lb lean ground turkey | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 12 ounces beef stock ( beef can be substituted )
instructions: In slow cooker, place beef, tomatoes and stock. Drain liquid from can into slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat 8 - 10 hours.

title: Barley Rattle
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked pearl barley | 1/2 head frozen bamboo shoot | 3 whole dried red chilies | 1 dried dates, soaked in water | 4 dried red chilies
instructions: Rinse and drain the barley. Bring the liquid to boil, in a large pot, then add the bamboo and the whole chilies. Lower the heat and simmer, covered, until the barley is tender, about 2 hours. You may need to add a little water to keep the liquid at a simmer. Stir every 15 minutes to prevent sticking and scorching. The barley should be a darker, heavier color. About 15 minutes before serving, garnish rattle with dried red pepper flakes and dried tomato if desired.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,napa cabbage,pork loin,mace,bread flour,corn oil
title: Paleo Chipolte (Torta)
ingredients: 600 g pork loin ( cut into big cubes ) | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 100 g bread flour ( a whole grain bread flour ) | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile ( canned ) | 1 teaspoon mace ( ground ) | 1/2 cup napa cabbage, shredded
instructions: Remove most of the fat from the pork in one piece. Add pork to a bowl. Mix it with the cornflour, chiles and the ground mace, adding water as needed to make a smooth paste. Heat the oil until it gets hot enough to float a piece of bread. Dip the flour/chili mixture in the batter a few at a time, quickly coating it with the oil. Put it into the hot oil and fry it quickly turning once. Remove it and let it brown. Pour off all extra oil. Turn it again and add the shredded napa cabbage.

title: Spiced Indian Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons panko bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed ( about 8 10 sheets ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup panko bread crumbs ( to taste ) | shredded coriander leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine panko and next 5 ingredients in bowl. Coat phyllo well with panko mixture then arrange in 1 layer on lightly floured surface. Brush edges lightly with water, then sprinkle crumbs on top. Roll dough in panko mixture keeping about 1 1/2 inches from edge and 3/4 inch from edges. Wrap each with remaining phyllo sheets, beginning and ending with phyllo. Spray a 12 x 12 inch baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Place seam side down on a large baking sheet. Pour liquid from baking dish over phyllo. Cover phyllo loosely with plastic wrap, then overwrap again with foil then refrigerate overnight. Remove phyllo from refrigerator and pre heat oven to 375°, then bake approximately 20 minutes. Remove cover and sprinkle with more crumbs, if desired, and bake additional 5 - 10 minutes, or until crisp on top. Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Woky Salad (Zucchini)
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, stems trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder ( optional ) | 1/3 cup sherry wine or 1/3 cup white vermouth
instructions: Tear or chop the stems off the chard. Scrub the leaves with cold running water. Cut away the tough leaves and discard them. Cut the leafy parts in half crosswise, then cut the stem into 1 inch pieces. Dry the chard in a dry frying pan. Add the chopped chard to the pan. Sprinkle over the cumin and/or cayenne and bring to a rolling boil. Turn up heat to medium, pour the sherry over all, and turn off the heat. Cool and keep refrigerated for up to 2 days. You can also refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: clove,monterey jack pepper cheese,white cheddar cheese
title: White Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 1 package shredded white cheddar cheese | 1 package shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Melt grated cheese and whole cloves in the microwave on high 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from the microwave and stir. Stir in pepper jack and gruyere cheese. Mix until well blended. Enjoy and/or store leftovers in the refrigerator.

title: Easy Cheezie's Salsa and Tortilla Appetizer
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cashews, finely diced | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 1/4 cups vegetable stock or 1 1/4 cups chicken stock | 1 jar mild salsa
instructions: Heat the stock. When it starts to simmer, add the cashews and stir for one minute. Remove from heat and stir in the salsa until everything is mixed well. Put in a bowl. Spray a cake tray with pam cooking spray. Use your fingers to press the tortilla into the tin and make small holes in the tortilla. Add extra tortillas on top. Press the tortilla into the tin so they are as flat as possible. Spray the entire surface with more pam or butter. Cut into wedges. Serve with warm guacamole on the side.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,palm sugar,chili garlic sauce,peanut,beef chuck,lobster meat
title: Asian Style Lobster Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1-inch dice | 1 can lobster meat | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 2 tablespoons peanuts, crushed | 2 -3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce ( optional ) | fresh ginger juice
instructions: Combine the sugar, peanuts, soy sauce, ginger, and chilli garlic sauce in a small bowl.

title: Enchilada Verde
ingredients: 16 ounces enchilada sauce | 2 cups shredded green cabbage
instructions: Cook cabbage in sauce over medium heat until tender and starting to brown. Drain off any excess water. While cabbage is cooking, combine shredded cabbage in a large bowl. Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine cooked cabbage and cabbage sauce. Spoon approximately 1/4 of the cabbage mixture onto a lightly oiled baking dish. Sprinkle with one cup of shredded cheese. Use a toothpick to hold each toothpick together to help the cheese stick to the toothpicks. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cheese is brown and bubbly.

title: Cranberry Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup greek yogurt or 1/4 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 2 italian stewed tomatoes, chopped | 4 beef round steaks | 1 cup fresh cranberries, stems removed | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Marinade, combine ketchup, chile sauce, yogurt and horseradish. Pour into 12 inch nonstick skillet. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in tomatoes and steak. Season with italian seasoning. Heat a separate skillet over medium high heat. Add beef. Cook and stir until no longer pink, 3 - 4 minutes. Return to skillet. Spoon marinade over meat, cover and grill 6 - 8 minutes or til steak is cooked through. Serve on buns.

title: Mushroom Pate
ingredients: 16 ounces porcini mushrooms ( cleaned, stems removed ) | 1 1/2 cups nonfat milk | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Soak 5 mushrooms in cold water for about 20 minutes then cut off and discard the stem and dark bits, then cut the caps into smaller pieces. Put the mushrooms into a large bowl and add the milk, thyme and salt and pepper to taste. Toss gently to mix, then cover with clingfilm and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, before using.

title: Gruyere Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh gruyere cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 tablespoon berbere
instructions: In a bowl, combine the gruyere cheese and all of the remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Easy and Delicious Black Bean Cilantro Vegetets with Peas
ingredients: 1 jar small black beans | 1 bell pepper, diced | 1 small lemon, juice of | 2 cans peas, drained | 2 packages baby carrots | 1 bunch cilantro, chopped
instructions: Put all in a large crock pot and turn heat on low for 4 - 5 hours, or until all veggies are fully cooked and the sauce has thickened a bit. You can add a bit of garlic powder or other seasonings, but the recipe is just as yummy with this one can.

title: Mexican Red Beans
ingredients: 1 can red beans, rinsed and drained | 2 plum tomatoes, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine red beans, plum tomatoes, and cooked saffron or any kind of saffron that contains small pieces of rind.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,chili powder,burrito flour tortilla,olive oil cooking spray,chicken thigh
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Rollups
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons light olive oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 burrito-size flour tortilla | 1 canned sliced olives ( optional ) or 1 can sliced pimiento stuffed olives ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Trim fat from chicken thighs. Using vegetable mallet or very smooth knife, cut slits down center of each piece. Reserve 1 tablespoon oil, and place meat at one end of each thigh. Wrap each thigh in a slice or two of garlic and sprinkle with chili powder. Place tortilla on a greased baking sheet and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, turning thighs over halfway through. Remove from oven, and top with olives and reserved oil. Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet and serving.

title: Cashew Salad With Peaches
ingredients: 1 can peaches | 1 carrot | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup wheat flour | 1 1/4 cups cottage cheese | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: Drain peaches and cut in half. Grate carrot. Mix with all the other ingredients. Mix well. Put in a buttered glass pan.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,brown sugar,american cheese,cocoa,cocoa powder,dill,pistachio,taco seasoning
title: Tortillas
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese | 6 teaspoons taco seasoning | 3 cups chopped american cheese | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 2 teaspoons dried dill or 1 tablespoon dill weed | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Cut the white cheese into small cubes. Spray a skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Add the taco seasoning, then the cheeses and stir until the cheese is melted. Add the brown sugar, mix well, then add turmeric. Let sit. Mix the dry ingredients, add to the cheese mixture and stir. Add the chopped dill, nuts and mix well. Add the cocoa and mix. Put the tortillas in a hot skillet or griddle, and when heated through, put a few spoonfuls of the cheese mixture over each top and roll up like a cigar. Keep each person to turn them, when the cheese is melted, put another spoonful of cheese on top of them. Serve with yogurt and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,almond extract,vanilla extract,ranch dressing,escarole,raisin,kosher salt black pepper,korean chili flake
title: Lorilyn's Famous Korean-American Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium ranch dressing ( soyboy brand is best ) | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds ( light colored ) or 4 tablespoons sunflower seeds, toasted ( light colored ) | 4 tablespoons finely chopped celery ribs | 6 1/2 tablespoons freshly chopped scallion seeds or 6 1/2 tablespoons chopped chile peppers and garlic, toasted | 2 tablespoons ground almonds or 2 tablespoons ground almonds, toasted ( haloom brand is best ) | 1/3 cup seedless raisin ( golden brown ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground celery rib | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the ranch dressing, sesame seeds, celery, scallions and garlic until evenly coated, then stir in the almonds and raisins. Season to taste with additional salt and pepper. Chill for at least 2 hours, but preferably overnight. Serve on lettuce leaves, on a bed of lettuce or as an accompaniment to rice.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,hot pepper,oregano leaf,veal steak,stock,kaffir lime leaf,fish stock
title: Veal With Coriander  (Spice) Hot Pepper (Pisto Di Vitello Savoiardi)
ingredients: 1 kg boneless veal steaks, skin | 2 tablespoons hot pepper, chopped ( scotch bonnet preferred ) | 1/2 cup fish stock | 1 handful oregano leaves | 1 pinch kaffir lime leaf, and crushed dry leaf ( optional ) | 5 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 tablespoons stock | 3 tablespoons dried porridge or 3 tablespoons white rice
instructions: Cut veal into 1 inch cubes. Place chicken strips in a bowl with hot pepper, fish stock, oregano, lime leaf, mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. Drain meat and marinate the chicken slices. Heat a little oil in a dutch oven. Drain meat, saving marinade. Place a few pieces of meat at a time in the pan. Cook for 2 minutes on each side until lightly browned. Place in the centre of a warm serving dish. Pour hot water all around the meat and cover. Place under a pre heated grill until dark brown and crusty.

title: Tomato Crackers (Tomato Spoon Bread)
ingredients: 7 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, well drained | corn oil ( for deep frying ) | 2 ounces sun-dried tomato packed in oil, well drained
instructions: Slice each sundried tomato into 3 slices. Sprinkle the sundried tomatoes on top of the tomatoes, close with the tops and sprinkle with oil. Deep fry the bread until puffed and golden. Serve with fresh tomato salsa. RecipeVariation, add some dried onion to the bread, but omit this step. Place all the ingredients under a preheated hot broiler until just golden. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: savory,artichoke heart,cheese,bay leaf,sultana,lemon pepper seasoning,szechuan peppercorn
title: Sicilian Cheese and Herb Sticks
ingredients: 1 jar of marinated artichokes hearts, drained | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 tablespoon sichuan peppercorns, cracked | 1 tablespoon roasted crushed dried savory or 1 tablespoon savory | 4 ounces soft cheese, of your choice | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon bay leaf
instructions: Slice cheeses in half. In a bowl, mix all but cheeses. Use your best judgement. You should be getting a coarse paste, not a crumbly paste. Roll each cheese half into a tight spiral around the sausages. Secure with toothpicks. Place on wax paper or plastic wrap, cover and chill 4 - 10 hours. Slice the ends and serve with any kind of sauce it needs. Any cheese stick can be kept, refrigerated, for 1 - 2 days if you have the time. Keeps for up to 3 years.

title: Yellow Cornbread
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 cup cashews
instructions: Put the cashews in a blender to grind them into a fine paste if they aren’t very fine. You can also use a mortar and pestle, as a food processor would do. Put the cornmeal in a bowl, add the cashews, and pulse until it resembles coarse bread crumbs. Add 1 cup water, and mix to a firm dough. Knead for at least half an hour, and press the dough out on a floured surface. You will need to stretch it a bit. Dust a flat surface with flour, and roll the dough out into a rectangle 15 inches long, and 3/4 inch thick. Cut the dough into squares, and bake them in a moderately hot oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown. It should take about 20 minutes for the bottoms to start to brown.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,asiago cheese,green chili,parmigiano reggiano cheese,turmeric,white flour,dark rum,grape tomato
title: Asiago Cheese Rollatini With Rum
ingredients: 12 -24 ounces asiago cheese, whole | 1 tablespoon white flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons grapes or 2 1/2 tablespoons grape tomatoes | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/3 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup asiago cheese | 1/8 teaspoon ground red chili pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Spread a generous 1/4 cup of white flour on the countertop and start rolling the dough out to about 1/8 inch thick. Cut in half vertically. Take each half. Tear off a 1/4 inch or slightly smaller piece of dough. Fold the top half of the dough over the flour like a taco. Roll into a log. Place in your freezer for 5 to 10 minutes. Take the log of dough and lightly flour the top. Roll again to about 1/4 inch thick. Place it on a baking sheet, brush it lightly with olive oil, and bake for 30 to 45 minutes, until the roll is golden brown on top. Cool for about 5 to 10 minutes before topping with 1/4 cup of asiago, and set aside. Add 1/8 teaspoon ground chile pepper to rum, and stir until well incorporated. Remove roll from oven and serve. Enjoy.

title: Swiss Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground meat | 1 pinch wheat germ | 1/4 cup horseradish ( helev )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shape into 1 to 2 inch meatballs. Broil or grill until browned and cooked through.

title: Bunuelos
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 package frozen miniature vanilla pudding ( not instant ) | 2 lbs ground sausage ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1/2 cup coarsley chopped cilantro stem ( or parsley ) | canning, jars
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the pudding with the graham cracker crumbs and the cilantro. On a rimmed baking sheet, combine the sausages and meat. Carefully shape the sausage mixture into one large round balls. Coat each ball with the graham cracker mixture. Place on the baking sheet and continue with the remaining balls.. Sprinkle each loaf with water and let bake at 375° for 30 minutes, then turn off oven and leave the loaf for an hour. Cool completely. Remove the loaf from the loaf pan. When cool, run a sharp knife around the perimeter of the loaf and then slice the loaf into 1 inch slices across the grain.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,sun tomato oil,fennel seed,italian tomato,mace
title: Fennel and Sun-Dried Tomato Paste
ingredients: 3 medium italian tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1 can crushed italian tomatoes ( italian tomato red ) | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 2 kaffir lime leaves or 2 limes, zest of, very finely grated
instructions: Put the chopped tomatoes in a food processor or blender bowl and finely chop. Add the fennel seeds and mace seeds, then process until smooth. Stir in the grated lime peel. Store in a dry airtight container for up to one week.

title: Quick Peach Lassi
ingredients: 1 peach, ripe | 1/2 cup diced canned sweetened fruit | 8 ounces bottled sweetened chili paste | 1 1/4 cups hot water | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Dice the peach and sweetened fruit, removing seeds and coarsely mash the fruit. If you want to use canned sweetened fruit, you need about 1/3 cup of pulp. Add the chili paste and water. Mix to blend and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,potato,almond extract,chicken fillet,mascarpone cheese,vegetable oil,walnut,tortilla
title: Mascarpone Nachos - Chicken Nachos With Hot Potato Nests and Toasted Almonds
ingredients: 2 potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon chicken fat or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 350 g whole-wheat tortillas, cut into quarters | 100 g mascarpone cheese | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons roasted unsalted walnuts, skinned | 3 tablespoons roasted vegetable oil | chili oil, extra, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Boil potatoes in a pan of lightly salted water for 10 minutes or until half cooked. Drain, then mash with egg and 1 tablespoon caster sugar. Whisk in cheese and almond extract.

title: Chili Pepper Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1/4 cup unbleached all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup chili oil | 2 sheets phyllo dough | 1 cup dried cherries, chopped into pieces
instructions: Prepare 2 sheets of phyllo dough and set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pour 1/4 cup of rice vinegar into a measuring cup and slowly pour into a measuring cup until you have 3 tablespoons pour into a medium bowl and gradually blend in 1/4 cup of chili oil. Dip one sheet of phyllo dough in the hot rice vinegar mixture and then in the egg wash, which will coat the entire phyllo. Fold this in half and begin to roll up in a long, thin sheet. Repeat with remaining sheets and egg wash and continue until all phyllo has been used. Lay the phyllo out flat on a work surface and then spread 1/8 of the green chili oil mixture on a flat surface. Lay 1 to 2 cherry pieces on top and wrap the phyllo diagonally in the rolling jelly roll dough. Place seam side down on a parchment covered baking sheet and make 2 more rolls. Brush with remaining peanut or vegetable oil and bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes. Remove from oven, cool slightly and cut into fingers. Serve warm.

title: Chili Chops
ingredients: 36 chilie-size chucks | 1 can diced green chilies | 1/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Spray a large skillet with a pam spray. Brown the chilie pepper halves about 3 minutes on each side. Remove chilie peppers from oil and let them cool a little. Combine all ingredients. Place the melted cheese on top of the melted cheese. Broil the cheese around the cheese to lightly brown the top for about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,yellow pepper,beef shank,cayenne pepper,english mustard
title: Cajun Beef Shanuts
ingredients: 1 beef shank | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 teaspoons dried english-style mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste | 1 yellow pepper, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the shank inside a roasting pan, place in a preheated oven, cover with foil, and place in the oven. Bake in preheated oven until shank is tender, about 1 hour. Remove the shank from the oven, brush with mustard, and sprinkle with cayenne pepper.

title: Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 150 g quinoa, soaked and refreshed following packet instructions | 300 g iceberg lettuce, washed and shredded | 200 g dark soy sauce
instructions: Heat a little oil in a pan. Add the quinoa, and cook, stirring, until the quinoa is slightly browned. Take the quinoa out from the heat and put to one side. To salad, separate the thick lettuce leaves into rings, and arrange in a serving bowl. Place the shredded lettuce on top of the quinoa and sprinkle with the dark soy sauce. Tip, to test whether it suits your palate, carefully drain the quinoa when a sharp knife is inserted into the middle, and then add a small amount of water to the quinoa for your taste.

Random Ingredients: scallop,tarragon,garlic powder,rice wine vinegar,mascarpone cheese,half,ginger paste
title: Scallops in Tangy Mascarpone Sauce
ingredients: 24 scallops | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 2 tablespoons tarragon | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup half-and-half
instructions: Wash scallops and pat dry with paper towels. Combine ginger paste, tarragon, garlic powder, vinegar, mascarpone cheese and half and half in a nonmetal bowl. Put scallops in bowl. Pour sauce over scallops to coat and marinate for 10 to 15 minutes. Garnish with sliced scallions if desired before serving.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,porcini mushroom,shallot,savory,cajun seasoning,bacon,shrimp bouillon cube,bamboo shoot
title: Grilled Shrimp Croustades - Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups shucked oyster mushrooms | 1/2 cup creme fraiche or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried lovage, leaves | 1/4 lb bacon | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 shrimp bouillon cube | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh savory | 1 portabello mushroom | 1 shallot, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix the first 10 ingredients thoroughly. Chill 30 minutes, then place mushrooms, bacon and creme fraiche on a plate. Mound mixture into mushroom caps, using the palm of your hand. Roll caps toward the outside of the mushroom cap to seal in the filling. Place all remaining ingredients, including the bamboo shoots, in a shallow pan with about 1 inch of water. Heat until boiling, then turn down to low, and cook, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Turn shrimp around in the pan, and cook 7 to 9 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked through. Serve over pasta or grits, if desired.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,vanilla ice cream,serrano chile pepper,jasmine rice,yeast,thai fish sauce
title: Thai Sweet and Sour Rice
ingredients: 1 (.25 ounce ) envelope active dry yeast | 2 cups warm water | 3 cups jasmine rice | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1 serrano chile pepper, minced | 5 cups vanilla ice cream, lightly beaten
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a 2 to 3 quart heavy pot. Place rice, fish sauce, serrano pepper, and yeast mixture in a food processor and pulse until mixture forms a fine crumbly texture, about 45 seconds. Scrape into a large bowl and stir in ice cream.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,corn syrup,nutmeg,cottage cheese,pickle juice,gouda cheese
title: Cheesy Cheese and Nuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup light corn syrup | 1 cup shredded aged gouda cheese or 1 cup edam cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped pickle juice | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons finely chopped serrano peppers ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan over low heat, stir together corn syrup, cheese, pickle juice, nutmeg and pepper. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in cottage cheese and serrano peppers. Season to taste with salt. Let cool in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Cardamom Yogurt Sweet Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 -3 teaspoons rice vinegar
instructions: In a bowl, combine the yogurt, cardamom pods, rice vinegar and salt. Mix to blend.

title: Blueberry Refrigerator
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups blueberries or 1 1/2 cups strawberries | 1/2 cup capers ( optional ) | 1 green ( large pinch )
instructions: Put blueberries in a large bowl, and use 2 spoons to scoop out handful sized puddings. Mix well. Add capers, if using, if using. Let the blueberry mixture rest 30 seconds or so, then pour into a freezer safe jar. Add a small, heavy layer of waxed paper or parchment paper to the jar. Place plastic wrap directly on the surface of the liquid. Freeze. After 3 - 4 hours, stir mixture once or twice during freezing. This allows the juices to be absorbed and re hydrated. To serve, place a scoop of ice in the center of a serving plate, and surround with several puddings.

title: Cherry-Stuffed Yellow Squash
ingredients: 9 -10 small yellow squash | 6 -8 tablespoons yellow cherry tomatoes or 6 -8 tablespoons grape tomatoes, halved | 1 hard-boiled egg, halved ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry the squash. Cut away the stalk, leaving about 1/3 inch of the tender top and about 3/4 inch of the tender bottom of a squash. Using a paring knife scoop out and discard the seed portion. Cut the squash into 1 inch strips. Discard pulp from the inside of the squash.. Place the reserved pulp in a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Fill the bowl with cold water. Drain the squash, pat dry with paper towels, and set aside. In a bowl, stir together the tomatoes, reserved pulp and any remaining pulp. Fill the center of each reserved squash stick with the cherry mixture. Place on a lightly greased and floured baking sheet. Drizzle with remaining grape tomatoes. Garnish with egg halves if desired. Bake in the upper and lower thirds of the oven approximately 25 minutes or until browned and tender.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinaigrette,cilantro,green onion,olive oil,tabasco sauce,asparagus,vanilla extract
title: Roasted Asparagus With a Moroccan Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 lbs asparagus, trimmed | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup balsamic vinaigrette | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 2/3 cup chopped green onion | 2/3 cup minced cilantro | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Toss the asparagus with the olive oil and vinegar and place in a 4 to 5 quart oven proof pan. Roast the asparagus 25 minutes or until the tender crisp and crisp. Turn the asparagus halfway through roasting. In a small bowl, combine the green onion, cilantro, and vinaigrette. Spoon over asparagus and serve warm.

title: Grilled Cheese With Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 lb jarlsberg cheese | 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 1/2 ounces mozzarella balls, halved
instructions: Cut the cheese into 1/3 inch thick slices. Place cheese slices in a small bowl. Place the balsamic vinegar in a saucepan and let stand for about 2 minutes. Place the vinegar in a skillet, add the cheese slices and turn to coat. Let cheese cook and melt for about 20 minutes, or until the cheese has brown. Turn with a spatula. Pour the glaze over the cheese, and enjoy.

title: Pork and Cream Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1/2 pint whipped cream | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Crumble the ground pork into a 1 1/2 pint ramekin or basin of decent size proportions. Spread the fat over the meat and cover with a plastic cling wrap or lid. Cook in a very slow oven for 3 hours. If you have a stir fry cooker, add the sour cream to the meat and cream mixture and slowly bring to the boil. When the thickened liquid has thickened to the consistency of gravy, the wine is ready. To prepare, strain the gravy through a cheesecloth or sieve and pour over a large pan of simmering hot, drained wine and serve hot with boiled new potatoes and boiled new potatoes.

title: Simple Vietnamese Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 1/2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 1/2 teaspoon corn oil | 500 ml jasmine rice | 1 tablespoon light fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Wash the cauliflower and chop into small florets. Blanch for 2 - 3 minutes or until bright green. Heat oil in a frying pan on high heat, stir fry cauliflower for 7 - 8 minutes. Turning often. Remove cauliflower from pan and add rice. Stir well. Add fish sauce and dry mustard. Add 2 cups of boiling water or water so that all the water is absorbed. Cover pan, turn heat down to low and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until rice is dry. Check if water has been absorbed into rice. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basil,kosher salt,carrot,red wine vinegar,cilantro stem,lemon juice,water
title: Cilantro Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, peeled, cut on the bias slant a 1/2-inch thick | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 4 cups water | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | fresh basil, chopped | fresh cilantro stem, chopped
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine carrots with salt and water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered, until carrots are very tender when pierced with a fork, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add vinegar, lemon juice, basil and cilantro. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Note, recipe may also be used to stuff cooked meat, poultry or vegetables. A note on the carrot, i used my electric carrots, and it was quick. To cook meat or poultry, follow the package directions. The carrots can be cooked in boiling water for about 20 minutes, remove from the stove and let drain in colander for 15 minutes, before removing from colander. When cool enough to handle, trim off the ends and core, then slice into 1/4 or 1/2 wide by 2 1/2 inch thick pieces. Add more water if necessary to cover the carrot pieces. This makes a large amount. Note, if using poultry, add 1/2 to 3/4 tsp salt to the carrot water before adding meat and poultry. Note on vegetables, i used the quick grilling method but you don't usually have to cook them a long time. Note on wine vinaigrette, i used apple cider vinegar, and the flavor was great as well. It is also wonderful with a touch of cayenne pepper. Note, if using fresh basil, chop off and discard basil stems. Note, i did not have any fresh basil leaves, just a small bunch of fresh leaves. I also added a little dried basil and ground some more cayenne pepper. Note, i took my electric carrots out and had them started to shred the carrots. They were the best. I took about 5 minutes to complete and they were tender and had a great texture.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,coconut,active yeast,swiss chard,beef stew meat
title: Beef & Swiss Chard Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup beef stew meat, chopped | 4 tablespoons dry active yeast | 1/3 cup chopped swiss chard | 1/2 cup garbanzo beans, drained | 1/4 1/4 cup unsweetened dried shredded coconut, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Combine beef, yeast, chard, beans and 1 tablespoon of the coconut in a bowl stir to blend well. Place mixture in a 9x5 inch loaf pan that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Top with remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut and sprinkle top with remaining coconut. Cover with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour and 1 hour or until slightly puffy. Bake at 425 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes or until well browned.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,pistachio,soya sauce,ice cube,broccoli floret,epazote,chunky peanut butter
title: Thin Sichuan Nuts (Peanut Sauce With Broccoli)
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon allspice berries | 6 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 1/3 cup chunky soya sauce or 1/3 cup tamarind concentrate | 1/4 cup pistachios, blanched, shelled, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon epazote, preferably a milder sanjo brand is highly recommended | ice cube
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the broccoli and allspice berries and a pinch or two of salt to taste. Cover the pan and cook over medium heat until the broccoli is bright and bright green. Immediately remove the pan from the heat and stir in the peanut butter and soy sauce. Transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,avocado,ginger,baking chocolate,chicken broth,vanilla extract,plain flour
title: Avocado, Ginger & Chocolate Muffins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 150 g baking chocolate, finely chopped | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 100 g grated fresh avocados
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c grease or line 18 holes of a muffin tin with paper cases. Grease & line with paper cases. Using a electric mixer fitted with a paddle, combine the chocolate, stock & spices in a saucepan over a low heat. Stir continuously over a medium heat until chocolate has melted. Stir in the avocado & remove from the heat. Using an electric mixer, stir the melted chocolate mixture into the flour then mix until lightly combined. Spoon half of the mixture into the lined muffin moulds then press the other half of the mixture into the muffins pressing into the sides. Brush the tops with water then bake for 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,tabasco sauce,buttermilk,lime peel,self rising flour,pecorino romano cheese,apricot preserve,chicken
title: Chef John's Famous Galette
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, thinly sliced | 7/8 cup self-rising flour, divided | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese, divided | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 2 tablespoons finely shredded lime peel | 1/2 cup apricot preserves, divided | 1 whole chicken, quartered | tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a large bowl of cold water, beat one third of the flour with the 1 tablespoon of the grated cheese until smooth. Fold in the buttermilk and lime peel and transfer to a jelly roll pan. Arrange the potatoes in an even layer on the dough. Bake on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper for 20 minutes, then lower the temperature to 200 degrees. Bake until golden brown and crispy, 15 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of the preserves over medium heat until golden brown and bubbly. To serve, carefully remove the potatoes from the oven and set aside. Arrange the chicken pieces on top of the potatoes in a 9 by 12 inch baking dish. Season with tabasco. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of preserves. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes, then broil for 3 minutes to brown the top, 3 to 4 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: boston lettuce,butterscotch chip,spanish olive oil,maple syrup,caraway seed
title: Maple Chips And Taterscotch
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh boston lettuce | 1 cup real butterscotch chips | 6 ounces caraway seeds ( i used to taste about 2.5 cans ) | 2 -3 tablespoons real maple syrup | 1/3 cup spanish olives or 1/3 cup canola oil
instructions: Wash the lettuce well. Cut the lettuce into thin diagonal slices across the stalk. Set aside in a large bowl in the sun. Pour off some of the bitter orange bitter orange sections. Rinse again and pat dry. Add enough butterscotch chips and caraway seeds to coat the lettuce slices. I coated my lettuce with maple syrup, then tossed the lettuce pieces into the bowl. Drizzle the oil over the lettuce. Give a good toss. Transfer the chips and caraway seeds in to a dehydrator. Set on the rack and dehydrate for one hour, tossing every hour or so. Remove the chips and seeds from the dehydrator. Allow the chips to cool in the fridge for at least 1/2 hour. Transfer the chips and seeds to an airtight container and store in the fridge. Note, this is where i added a little water to make the chips crispy. I used the maple syrup and some salt to tone down the bitter orange orange zest.

title: Fish and Potatoes
ingredients: 5 -6 kingfish, depending on size | 1 3/4 kg swedes, or rutabagas, depending on size
instructions: Wash and thoroughly clean the fish with a knife, removing all the bones and white matter. Cut into large cubes, about 1 1/2 cm thick. Place the fish pieces on the large pieces of steamer pan or a grill, cover and heat slowly at least 3 minutes on both sides. Remove the steamer from the heat, or, if necessary, place some oil on the fish pieces and spread a layer of potato and swede on the top. Continue using a layer of the fish until the fish is complete and the potato layer has been used up. It will probably take more than the vegetables. Turn the fish once during cooking.

title: St. Patrick's Day New York Style Brown Beer
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 cup packed dark ginger beer | 1/2 cup chopped dried leaf lettuce
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in the warm beer. Pour in the ginger and the 1/2 cup of chopped lettuce and mix well. Let stand until bubbles form on top of the liquid 2 minutes. Drain liquid and stir into yeast mixture. When cool, cover and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,serrano chilies,orange section,yellow bean,bay seasoning,vegetable,ear corn cob,bacon
title: Mexican Street Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 6 ears corn on the cob, husked | 5 slices bacon, chopped | 1 cup chopped onion ( optional ) | 2 cans yellow beans, drained | 1 serrano chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons orange sections | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil grate. Wrap corn around a metal skewer or chop to fit. Cook corn in grill on the preheated grill until grill marks form, 2 to 3 minutes on each side. While corn is cooking, place bacon in a skillet and cook over medium heat, turning frequently, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain off any excess drippings. Stir in onion, beans, chiles, orange sections, and 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning. Serve hot.

title: Quick Cherries and Roasted Red Pepper
ingredients: 20 cherry | 1 red sweet pepper, roasted, seeded, and sliced
instructions: In an oven proof dish, mix red sweet pepper, red sweet pepper slices, and roasted red pepper pieces in microwave for 2 minutes. The cherry pieces will sink to the bottom of the dish in less than 2 minutes. Serve warm with plain rice or egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: beet,sirloin beef,red currant jelly,lime wedge,pork shoulder
title: Bite Jugo (Pork Stew)
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar red currant jelly | 1 jar pickled beets, drained | 1 lime wedge, for squeezing on the sandwich roll
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Place the pork in a large, heavy baking pan. Add cold water to cover the pork entirely, and soak the meat for at least 4 hours in the refrigerator. Remove any remaining bone, shred the meat, and set aside. Arrange 1 inch of rehvedgeed beef over the pork drippings in the pan. Pour in the jelly and stir well. Arrange the beet slices around the meat in a decorative pattern, sprinkle with lime, and cover. Bake at 300 degrees for 3 - 5 hours and turn once or twice. Serve hot with sandwiches of your choice.

title: Curried Cream of Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Empty cream of chicken soup into a large bowl. Mix all the other spices and spread these over the cream of chicken soup. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,red chili paste,baby green,mexican cheese,turmeric powder,squash,sugar
title: Spicy Pesto Squash
ingredients: 750 g squash, cut into medium cubes | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red chili paste | 10 -15 leaves baby greens | 100 g mexican cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | sugar or artificial sweetener, to taste
instructions: Peel squash and cut into medium sized cubes. Sprinkle turmeric on squash. Place 1/3 of the squash in an oven dish and cover with about 1/3 of the pesto. Repeat twice. Place all of the remaining squash in with the remaining pesto. Spread pesto over squash. Sprinkle cheese evenly on top and cover with aluminium foil or a lid of aluminium foil. Place in oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes to set cheese.

title: Guisado
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas | 1 jar thick'n chunky beef broth
instructions: Wear disposable gloves. Wrap a tortilla tightly in plastic wrap and place on a plate in the freezer for about 30 minutes. When it's slippy, unwrap the wrap and, invert the plate. Remove the tortilla, then cut into 1 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: green onion,onion powder,pork tenderloin,french onion soup,chile powder,salmon fillet
title: Salmon Terrine With Curried Onions and Chiles
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 2 pork tenderloin | 2 cans french onion soup | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon chile powder | 1 green onion, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place salmon and pork tenderloins on a rack in a 9x13 inch pan. Bake 12 - 15 minutes until browned and internal temperature reaches 165 degrees. Cool fish and pork on a wire rack. Remove fat from pan juices. In a saucepan over low heat, combine the french onion soup, onion powder, chile powder, green onion and about 4 1/2 tablespoons of hot water. Bring to a boil and cook 3 min while constantly stirring for 2 minutes. Pour soup mixture over fish and bake until salmon is just cooked and the sauce thickens slightly, about 25 - 30 minutes. Serve warm or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Oven Roasted Turkey
ingredients: 5 lbs turkey | 2 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Rinse turkey under cold, running water. Pat dry and season with salt and pepper. Insert meat thermometer to the thick part of the thigh. Heat the oil in a roasting pan to 375°f. Insert thermometer into cavity of turkey. Place turkey in roasting pan. Tent breast and legs together with aluminum foil. If oven doesn't fit, make a tent of foil to keep turkey snugly in pan. Roast turkey, uncovered in centre of oven for 30 minutes. Remove foil. Continue to roast, uncovered, until thermometer reads 165f, about 2 1/2 hours longer. Cool turkey completely before slicing.

title: Eggplant & Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 3 tablespoons picante sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut stem end off the eggplant, & remove the peel. Slice eggplant into thick slivers. Place in a bowl & cover with boiling water. Let sit for 5 minutes & drain. Let cool. Combine jam & picante sauce in a small bowl. Spoon over the eggplant. Season to taste with cayenne, if desired.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,cider vinegar,lemon juice,limeade concentrate,ham,red radish,fruit,pancetta
title: Barcelona-Style Ham Salad
ingredients: 5 cups diced ham | 1 can sweetened condensed cream of celery soup ( reduced fat ) | 1/2 medium lemon, juice of, fresh | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 3/4 lb pancetta, diced ( optional ) | 1/2 head red radish, sliced ( optional ) | 1 ripe fruit, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pancetta and radishes. You may serve over greens or serve in small pita bread slices on a cold winter's night.

title: Tamarind Mould (Applesmice Pudding)
ingredients: 225 g granny smith apples, unsweetened | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: Peel, core and chop apples. Put them in a small saucepan and add the juice from the tamarind pods and 2 - ½ cups of cold water. Simmer for 10 minutes. Discard tamarind pulp. Remove from heat and add the chopped apples. Cover and leave for 5 minutes. Set aside. Put in an ovenproof dish. Cover with cold water. Cook in a preheated oven at 180° c/350° 375°f/ gas mark 6 for 30 minutes. Take out and leave to stand for at least 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,beef bouillon granule,zucchini,chili garlic sauce,garlic clove,champagne,vanilla bean,oyster
title: Chilled Beef with Zucchini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 garlic clove, peeled and sliced | 1 lb zucchini, halved lengthwise then cut crosswise into long strips | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 2/3 cup champagne | 1/2 teaspoon mild chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup oyster, drained | vanilla bean ( optional ) | fresh seaweed, sliced ( optional ) or berries ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or saute pan. Add garlic. Remove from heat and keep warm. Place zucchini in a large bowl. Sprinkle with bouillon and pour half of marinade over zucchini. Let sit 30 minutes. Drain off remaining marinade mixture. Place zucchini on a plate or platter and keep warm while you prepare the rest of the meal. Boil water for champagne. Turn off heat. Dissolve bouillon in water. Pour back into pan. Add chili garlic sauce, oyster and vanilla bean, if desired.

Random Ingredients: mace,black eyed pea,chat masala,breadcrumb,pork chop,baker yeast
title: Breaded Chops With Black-Eyed Peas (Pork)
ingredients: 1 1/8 lbs pork chops | 1/4 cup of mashed ka dry chat masala | 1/4 lb dried black-eyed peas | 1 teaspoon black magic ground mace | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs
instructions: Start by soaking the dried black eyed beans in warm water for about 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Boil water and add beans to it. Cook until tender, about 45 minutes. In the meantime, mix the other ingredients together. Drain the beans well and add to the mixture. Mix thoroughly, but do not over mix. Place the mixture on oiled pans. Sprinkle generously with chaat masala. Bake in oven for about 10 to 15 minutes, and serve with bread slices with fingers.

title: Grilled Sausage Sandwich With Peanut Butter and Chipotle Peanuts
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage or 1 lb kielbasa | 8 ounces crunchy peanut butter | 1/2 cup peanut butter or 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup hot coffee | 1 tablespoon dried herbs ( basil, oregano, thyme, oregano,... ) | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat a grill for medium heat. While the grill warms up, brown the sausage on both sides with your favorite fuel. Remove from the pan and put into a bowl to cool. Slice the sausage into 1/4 inch slices to allow for easier slicing. In the same bowl as the sausage was cooked in add your peanut butter into the peanut butter and beat on high for a minute or so. Add the hot coffee, herbs, chipotle powder and pepper. Let this mix for an additional minute or two then add the sliced sausage and coat each slice with the peanut butter mixture. Let it marinade for a few minutes then grill the bruschetta. Note on spices, add more chili powder to taste for added flavor. Use your favorite fuel to heat the meats. Serve with a fresh bread slice and your favorite side salad. Note, i used the chipotle chile because it was so spicy and really really added the kick. It took a little while because of the hot stuff in the pepper. I served this on my plate with sesame seeds and a lettuce leaf alongside for the lunch. I loved how it turned out like an oatmeal oat toasty.

title: Veal Sliders
ingredients: 14 ounces sweet sausages | 14 ounces cooked veal | 8 ounces baby spinach | 4 teaspoons xanthan gum | 2 sheets cocoa ( i use hymetschel ) | 12 ounces low-fat quark | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 7 ounces liquid smoke ( optional, i substitute olive oil )
