instructions: Slice sausages thick and then into half moons. Put in large ziploc bag. Take veal, spinach and sausage and cut into half moons. Put in fridge for 15 - 20 minutes. Add to the ziploc bag some cocoa powder, xanthan gum and mix. Put in bag again. Place in fridge and leave overnight, allowing ziploc to cure. Put on plate lined with parchment paper. Add sesame oil to a pan to a depth of 2. Heat pan until smoking then brown. Take off heat. Scoop out of the bag, drizzle with quark and drizzle with sesame oil. I like to roll the meat slices in quark then put back in the pan and fry them. Take out and cut off paper and put on plate lined with parchment paper. Put back in the pan. Enjoy with yoghurt, fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,bacon dripping,ice,lobster,cottage cheese,baking soda,palm sugar
title: Prairie Lobster
ingredients: 1/2 pound cooked lobsters ( tails left on ) | 1/2 pound bacon drippings | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 1/2 cups light cream or 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 5 tablespoons grated palm sugar
instructions: Drain lobster, cutting into halves or thirds. In a medium saucepan, heat bacon grease.

title: Herbed Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo dough ( each sheet ) | 3/4 cup flavor ( store-bought jam, applejack jam, raspberry flavored jam, or just your own choice ) | 2 -3 sprigs fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Unwrap phyllo dough and spread with jam. Use as much or as little as you like. Cover with a damp towel to dry out extra air. Fold in each side or top with a rosemary sprig. Wrap in wax paper to preserve moisture. Bring water to a boil for baking sheet and place on wire rack to dry for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Real Easy Spanish Peanut Dip
ingredients: 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1 cup chunky salsa ( not salsa fresca )
instructions: In a bowl, combine the peanuts and salsa using a fork and stir until combined. If using straight away, put into a crock pot to keep warm. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

title: Slow-Cooker Mexican Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 packet taco seasoning | 2 packages flat-leaf tex-mex blend cheese | 2 cups maple syrup
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet over medium heat, and drain. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker.

title: Tuna Melt With Monterey Jack Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tuna in water, drained well | 2 tablespoons monterey jack cheese, grated, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Stir the tuna into the cheese sauce until melted and smooth. Spread onto a foil lined baking sheet. Bake until set and golden. Serve at once. If you have leftovers of tuna water, it can be reheated in a microwave for 2 minutes, pour over a serving of pasta and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut,sharp cheddar cheese,dill,pasta sauce,phyllo pastry,french bread,chipotle chile
title: Smoked Chile Phyllo Appetizers
ingredients: 12 slices thick french bread ( can use crusty ) | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( i use kraft processed ) | 1 can old fashioned oats, well drained | 1 can refrigerated pasta sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1/2 cup flaked coconut ( or sweetened if you prefer ) | 2 -6 chipotle chiles, canned in adobo or 2 -6 green peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill ( or coriander, or cilantro )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Butter a glass baking dish or pan. Combine dry ingredients, except for dried, in a bowl, and mix well. Reserve 1/4 cup of shredded cheese for topping. Add cheese, coconut, and chiles to remaining liquid in bowl. Stir in dill and mix well. Spoon half of the tomato sauce mixture into baking dish. Spread in a thin layer. Place 6 slices of bread on top. Scatter cheese mixture over half of the bread. Top with the remaining slices of bread, followed by remaining tomato sauce mixture and shredded cheese. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until cheese is brown and bubbly and phyllo is browned.

title: Scotch Shortbread
ingredients: 2 lbs fine flour | 3/4 cup white demerara sugar
instructions: Pre heat oven to 170°c/300°f. Use all the flour and salt in a food processor until fine and a pale tan. Add the sugar slowly then mix in the rest of the flour to a soft dough and knead for approx 5 mins, till the dough is soft. If the dough is too flakey for your taste, if you need it a bit thicker add a bit cornflour or flour. If the dough is too dry add a bit more sugar. If it's too dry add a bit more sugar. Roll out 1/3 of the dough and cut out with cookie cutters. You can also cut out a doughnut shape with a glass/spoon shape cutter. Place on an oven tray and bake for approx 20 mins until well risen and brown. Cut out cookies with a star shaped cutter, or as a traditional scottish cookie. Store the cookies in an airy clean tin or plastic bag. Variation, bake the shortbread by using 2 lbs nutmeats instead of the white and 1 1/2 lbs cinnamon candies. They also work as a delicious filling for chocolate and sugar cookies.

title: Japanese-Style Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3 cups water chestnuts | 3 cups cold, cooked chicken meat | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook the chicken meat in a skillet over medium heat for 12 minutes or until well done. Drain, and cool. While chicken is cooking, combine water chestnuts and red wine vinegar in a bowl. Stir well, then add chicken.

Random Ingredients: cherry,cheese,flat leaf italian parsley,greek yogurt,chipotle chile pepper,chicken thigh,plum tomato,tomato puree
title: Chicken Tzipporah
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/3 cup canned plum tomatoes | 1 can tomato puree | 1/3 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 chipotle chile pepper, minced | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cherries | 2 teaspoons grated cheese
instructions: Cut chicken thighs in half lengthwise, and place into a shallow dish. Mix yogurt, plum tomatoes, tomato puree, parsley, pepper, chipotle chile pepper, and lemon juice with chicken, pour marinade over chicken, coating all surfaces. Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning over several times. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken thighs on a lightly oiled baking sheet, cover and bake in the preheated oven until tender and chicken juices run clear, about 1 hour. Serve warm.

title: Quesadillas
ingredients: 6 small flour tortillas, 6-inch diameter | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Position an oven rack 3 inches from the broiler element and heat the broiler. Heat a 9 inch cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Place 3 tortillas in the skillet in a single layer.

title: Broccoli and Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 ounce beef bouillon cube | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Shake the bouillon cube in a small bowl. Add the broccoli florets and stir to coat with the bouillon cubes. Cook until the broccoli is tender crisp, 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in the cream. Serve. Enjoy.

title: Pasta with Sultana and Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 poblano chiles or 1 anaheim chili, roasted and seeded ( 8 to 10 ounces ) | 1 bunch sultana or 1 bunch green beans, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons capers | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Boil the water. Meanwhile, prepare all your ingredients. Slice the poblano in half lengthwise so it will stand up on its own without creating huge holes in it. Place them in a bowl of water and soak for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil, add salt, add the pasta and cook until al dente. Drain well and season with salt. Set aside until cold. Add the chiles to the cooked pasta with 1/2 of the sultanas, capers, lime juice and cooked pasta. Stir to coat the pasta with the sauce and eat piping hot.

title: Trout Jollof With Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup grated red cabbage | 1/4 lb ground sirloin | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 4 slices jalapeno peppers | 2 cups cooked red cabbage
instructions: Combine the meat, 1 cup water, the chopped peppers and remaining ingredients in a medium size bowl. Divide among 4 dinner size serving bowls. Serve over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,asiago cheese,cold water,brown sugar,broccoli,white chocolate
title: Asiago Cheese & Broccoli With White Chocolate
ingredients: 7 ounces white chocolate | 32 fluid ounces cold water, divided | 2 tablespoons cold water | 4 ounces fresh asiago cheese ( or other mild cheese of your choice ) | 1 small broccoli, broken into florets | 1 bag cherry tomatoes or ( 16 ounce ) bag basil leaves
instructions: Set oven to 350 degrees f. Place white chocolate and 1/4 cup water in a microwavable bowl and microwave on high heat 15 to 20 seconds or until chocolate is melted. In a separate bowl, whisk 1 cup water with 2 tablespoons cold water until mixture is smooth. Pour the chocolate mixture into a 13x9 inch baking dish or pan, spreading to cover the top. Place broccoli in a microwave safe bowl and top with remaining chocolate mixture. Cook on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until broccoli is crisp. Remove from oven stir broccoli and tomatoes into white chocolate until smooth.

title: Blueberry Pork and Fresh Spinach
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach, washed well, stems removed, and coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb kale, stemmed, stemmed, washed, and coarsely chopped | 2 lbs lean pork, trimmed of all visible fat, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices | 12 fluid ounces beer, such as a pale ale | 2 teaspoons grated lime zest
instructions: Put spinach into a colander or strainer with a fine mesh, large holed strainer attached, and squeeze out excess liquid.

title: Spicy Beef Burgers
ingredients: 450 g hamburger | 15 ml red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berries | 285 g frozen corn kernels | 1/2 cup toasted pecans, roughly chopped
instructions: Add the beef to a pan made of very little more than 250gms and cook over high heat, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes. While meat is cooking, mix the curry paste with the allspice and bring to a boil, stirring and breaking up any clumps. Add in the corn, stir well and cover. Cook for 1 - 3 minutes, or until corn is cooked but still has little bite. When meat is cooked, remove from heat. If there is still a little liquid in the pan spoon the curry mixture onto a chopping board and using 2 forks, mash the meat with a fork, then return it to the pan. Add chopped pecans and cook for a few minutes more. Serve immediately. Tip, to toast pecans, place the pecans in a frying pan over medium heat and toast for 1 minute, shaking the pan a few times until golden brown. Store in an airtight container.

title: Pasta With Pork or Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb pork ribs or 1 lb chicken breast, cubed | 1 lb pasta shell, cooked | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Cut the ribs or chicken into 1/2 inch cubes. In a skillet in heated oil, fry the pork or chicken until lightly browned. Remove from skillet and drain. Add the pork or chicken to the hot skillet or stock, and lightly saute over medium low heat, cooking to desired tenderness. Add 1/2 package of pasta shells to skillet.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,bok choy,mango powder,beef broth,arborio rice,lemon juice zest
title: Crockpot Beef Risotto With Mushrooms, Mango and Choy
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked arborio rice | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 3/4 cups beef broth | 1 -2 boscai mushroom, sliced | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 small bok choy, thinly sliced
instructions: Place rice, lemon zest and juice and beef broth in crock pot. Mix gently. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours until rice is cooked through. Remove lid 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,celery root,chicken meat,hot red chili pepper,half cream,lettuce leaf,red wine,catsup
title: Lettuce Wrapped Pork With Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces hot red chili peppers, paste | 18 -24 large lettuce leaves | 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 3/4-inch cubes ( shoulder roast works ) | 1/2 lb celery root, peeled | 1/2 lb chicken meat, with skin | 1 bottle catsup | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 pint half-and-half cream
instructions: Marinade, prepare chili paste to paste mix chili paste and chili powder mix together well and set aside. Coat pork in spice paste and allow to sit at room temperature to marinate for at least 8 hours. Place pork and celery in a dutch oven with water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours. Add catsup and chile paste and simmer for an additional hour. Remove pork and celery and shred using two forks. Combine chili sauce and remaining ingredients in a large bowl and divide amongst lettuce leaves. Garnish with a tablespoon of chopped jalapenos and a toothpick if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,shiitake mushroom,red chili paste,lemon zest,pecan
title: Cherry-Smoked Mushroom and Pecan Pilaf
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces smoked mushrooms or 4 1/2 ounces black mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup pecans or 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 2 tablespoons red chili paste | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and marinate for 30 minutes. Drain mushrooms, reserving marinade. Heat a char grill or an open grill pan, brush the grill with a little of the reserved marinade and grill about 5 minutes on each side. Serve hot, drizzled with remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: garlic herb couscous mix,italian bread,peanut butter,cucumber
title: Italian Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked instant couscous mix | 1 jar peanut butter | 1 cucumber, peeled | 1/3 cup italian style bread or 1/3 cup crusty italian bread, crumbs
instructions: Prepare instant couscous according to box directions. While the couscous is cooking, peel half the cucumber into paper towel and peel the other half. Cut in half lengthwise. Remove core from cucumber, cutting away any dark portion. Place cucumber between paper towels and pat hard with cloth. Squeeze out excess liquid. Drain couscous.

title: Prawn and Spaghetti With Zinfandel Sauce
ingredients: 400 g uncooked spaghetti | 1 tablespoon white flour | 150 ml white zinfandel wine | 100 g rocket, washed | 3 -4 slices pepperoni, thin
instructions: Cook pasta according to pack instructions set aside. In a bowl, mix flour and wine using a pastry cutter or fork, until mixture is like breadcrumbs. Cook or saute bacon till crispy. Combine pasta and flour mixture in a large bowl.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped in a Bacon or Swiss Roll
ingredients: 6 slices prosciutto or 6 slices swiss swiss swiss bacon | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon | 1 beef broth, if necessary | 1 tablespoon chervil, chopped
instructions: Preheat over to 425 degrees. Lay the prosciutto or swiss bacon on a cutting board, and cut down one side of the bacon with a very sharp knife. Do not slice all the way through, just cut small slices, then lay the slices lengthwise over the bacon on the cutting board. Using the tip of a heavy knife, make 3 or 4 small slits into the bacon, cutting through the bacon and through each slit. Place the bacon strips into a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Pour the chicken bouillon over them. Sprinkle the crumbled bacon over the bacon, and dot the crumbled bacon with a bit of the chopped chervil. Make a long roll using the back of the knife, starting on the end, roll up the bacon with a toothpick. Cut the roll into 1 inch pieces with a sharp knife, and place seam side down in the baking dish. Cover with foil, and bake for 20 minutes before serving. Bacon should be very crisp and all the juices should run clear.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,snow pea,red pepper,spaghetti sauce mix,plain flour,almond extract,rice wine vinegar,granny smith apple
title: Chinese Apple Noodle Salad (St. Peter Dietz)
ingredients: 250 g cooked spaghetti in water | 1 small granny smith apple, peeled, cored and sliced thinly | 1 cup fresh snow pea | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 cup cake flour | 2 tablespoons curry powder or 2 tablespoons instant potato flour | 150 g spaghetti sauce mix | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions and then drain. Place the spaghetti in a serving bowl and add the remaining ingredients, toss to combine and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,provolone cheese,cherry,mango chutney,kidney bean,french green bean
title: Mango Chili and French Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can french style green beans, drained | 1 can sweet baby corn with chutney beans, drained | 1 can baked beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mango chutney | creole seasoning to taste | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the french style green beans, sweet baby corn, baked beans, mango chutney, and creole seasoning. Stir until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,tofu,rutabaga,dill,hamburger,artichoke heart,kaffir lime leaf,baking powder
title: Soup Pot
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu | 1 lb rutabagas | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained | 1 dash crushed red pepper flakes | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 1 dash baking powder | toasted dill | toasted smoked hamburger
instructions: Drain tofu overnight. Cut tofu through slabs. Drain artichoke hearts& tear them into bite sized pieces with your hands. Add marinated tofu to the pot simmer for 10 minutes. Taste for salt. Add kaffir lime leaves to pot& cook for 30 minutes. Add red pepper, and stir. When ready to serve, add a couple of tablespoons of chopped fresh dill and sprinkle about 2 - 3 tablespoons of smoke sauce on top, or sprinkle dill on top.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,dark rum,cracker,catsup,ketjap manis,white wine,butternut squash,mace
title: Sailors, Cheese and Vineyard Fondue
ingredients: 8 cups dry white wine | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( see description ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 bag peeled butternut squash, cut diagonally into 1/2-inch slices | 8 slices provolone cheese, 1/4 inch thick ( or swiss, if you prefer ) | catsup, for dipping | crackers, for serving ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, combine the wine, rum, nutmeg and mace and bring to a boil. Add the butternut squash and return to a boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in the cheese. When completely warmed, serve with cocktail wood chips.

title: Mexican Relish - 3 Ww Points
ingredients: 2 cups cider vinegar ( red or white ) | 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 1 orange, zest of, cut into wedges
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan except orange zest. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 3 - 5 minutes, or until reduced by half and syrupy. Taste and adjust seasonings. Allow to cool to room temp.

title: Raspberry & Tahini Risotto
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons raspberry jam ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup rice ( to serve ) | 1/4 cup greek olives ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine tahini, tomato juice & jam in a small sauce pan & heat gently. Add rice & stir until it absorbs the tomato & rice juices. Spoon risotto into a warmed bowl & garnish with olives.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,italian salad dressing mix,spinach,radish,garlic clove,coffee,onion soup mix
title: Mexican Spinach
ingredients: 1 bag frozen chopped spinach | 3 medium sized radishes, thinly sliced | 4 minced garlic cloves ( for the flavor ) | 1 onion soup mix | 1 envelope dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon instant coffee
instructions: Blend ingredients thoroughly and place in 6 qt slow cooker. Cook for 3 1/2 hours, then uncover and cook for an additional 10 minutes or until the spinach is desired texture. Serve over hot rice, refried or topped with cheese and salsa.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,sun tomato oil,oyster sauce,beef,egg wrap,celery salt,shrimp,pork shoulder
title: Beef and Shrimp Egg Rolls!
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 1/2 lb minced beef | 1/2 lb minced pork shoulder | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried shrimp | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 package egg roll wraps | 3 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add the mince and pork and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated. Season with the celery salt and shrimp, tossing until the meats are thoroughly coated. Reduce heat to medium and continue cooking until the shrimp are pink. Remove from the heat and season with the sun dried tomatoes and salt. In a small bowl, combine the egg roll wrapper ingredients and roll the mixture into 1 inch balls. Dip in the egg roll wrapper and fry in the hot oil until all sides are golden brown. Remove from the oil and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with soy sauce if you like.

title: Spice Islands - Okra Snack for Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb okra, cleaned of husk and ends, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 cup yellow green pumpkin seeds, hulled
instructions: Preheat the broiler or grill. Place the okra cut sides down on a foil covered baking sheet, and sprinkle with cayenne. Broil or grill until the okra turns dark golden brown, then carefully transfer to a kitchen towel lined bowl and rub the okra with the cayenne. Sprinkle the okra with the yellow pumpkin seeds and transfer to a serving platter. Sprinkle the sweetened snack with the spicy snack toppings before eating.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,rigatoni pasta,jalapeno pepper,sherry wine,corn,chicken bouillon cube,ketchup,grain white rice
title: Rigatoni With Rice, Jalapenos and Rice
ingredients: 500 g short-grain white rice | 350 g corn | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 500 -750 g rigatoni pasta
instructions: Rinse and boil the rice, corn, ketchup, bouillon cubes and the jalapeno up to 3/4's level. When the rice isn't sticky anymore, but still a little firm to the touch, drain it and return to the heat while continuously stirring. Cook the rice until it is creamy. Add the essence to the rice and mix well. Place a large pot of water on top of the stove and turn on the stove to medium high. Put the pasta in the boiling water and cook until it is cooked al dente. Drain the pasta and put it into a colander with 2 table spoons of cold water and give a good rinse. When all the water is drained and all the liquid is back, mix in the rice and corn mix. Season with sherry, vanilla essence and ketchup, cover and keep on medium low until you are ready to eat. Usually, this takes about 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: whiskey,pearl barley,masa harina,taco sauce,parsnip,corn oil,baby pea,jalapeno pepper
title: Mexican Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 lb baby peas | 1 lb corn, shucked ( frozen or not ) | 1 large parsnip, cut into chunks | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeds and ribs removed, minced | 1 bunch parsley, minced | 1 can chicken soup masa harina | 1 bottle taco sauce | 2 cups mexican hot sauce ( i use peri-peri or other chili sauce to make this a meal that you will enjoy )
instructions: Make the masa harina in your blender or food processor fitted with the metal blade, and whir until well blended and creamy. In a large dutch oven or heavy pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add the peas, parsnip, jalapeno pepper and cook 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in the masa harina and cook 1 - 2 minutes longer, or until slightly thickened. Add the soup and cook 2 - 3 minutes longer, making sure that the soup does not bubble over. Add taco sauce and taco sauce. Bring to a boil, then simmer, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender about 20 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Pies
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 pounds fresh rhubarb, peeled and chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand until creamy, about 10 minutes. Stir rhubarb into yeast and turn into a greased 9x13 inch baking pan. Cover with a damp cloth and let rise to double in volume, about 1 hour. Drain well. Punch down pastry. Roll out dough to fit pan and trim dough as needed. Bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven until bottom is light brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cherry Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 pint cherry
instructions: Combine beans, cherry and water in a large pot over medium heat. Cover and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,phyllo pastry,pork sparerib,orange juice concentrate,cannellini bean,chicken broth
title: Galley Wray's Caribbean Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix | 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate | 1 can chicken broth | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 3 packages frozen pork spareribs | 6 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spread cake batter into a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan, using 1/4 cup of the orange concentrate to coat all pieces of dough. Arrange a rack across the bottom and side of the pan and spray with cooking spray. Spread bean sauce evenly on the cake batter. Arrange a layer of ribs evenly over the bean sauce, followed by a layer of spareribs. Cover with an even layer of bean sauce, and then cover with a layer of phyllo. Fold pastry over the top and bottom, then brush with water. Bake in the preheated oven until pastry is browned, and filling is hot, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,chicken bouillon cube,thai fish sauce
title: Thai Basil Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 3 -6 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small container. Stir before serving.

title: Easy Jook Rice
ingredients: 2 cups fresh snow peas or 2 cups frozen snow peas | 1 cup fresh bean paste ( koon chun brand ) | 1 cup dry macaroni
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook on stovetop until hot.

Random Ingredients: orange flower water,white bread,gruyere cheese,sun tomato oil,yogurt,dill
title: Sun-dried Tomato and Herb Gratin
ingredients: 2 cans sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 1/2 cups crumbled gruyere cheese | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons orange flower water | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon poppyseed
instructions: Pulse the sun dried tomatoes in a food processor until finely ground and set aside. Preheat a gratin dish or gratin dish according to package instructions. In a bowl, stir together the sun dried tomato crumbs, gruyere cheese and yogurt. Pour yogurt mixture into cheese mixture. Mix in the orange flower water, dill, and poppyseeds. Spread mixture onto the top of the gratin. Place gratin over medium heat and grill until bubbly and golden brown, 8 to 12 minutes.

title: Gebhardt Ka Addi (Egg Halves) ( Halberkorpor)
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage link | 1 onion, minced | 3 tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons butter | 1 -2 tablespoon freshly grated cardamom pod
instructions: Cook the sausages in boiling, salted water until done, 3 to 6 minutes, depending on how hot they are. Drain and set aside. Add the onion to the pan and cook over medium heat until the onion is tender and beginning to brown. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, melt the butter or margarine and fry the cardamon pods, stirring until they become aromatic. Add the sausages to the skillet, and stir until heated through. Pour the ghee over all and serve.

title: Roast Aubergines
ingredients: 1 small aubergine | 1 small bread machine yeast | 1/2 cup lukewarm tepid water, lukewarm | 1/2 cup shortening, room temperature | 2 cups breadsticks with 3-inch lengths | 1/3 cup dried figs, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Slice a lengthwise slit along one edge in the core to create a pocket.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,fine breadcrumb,chicken breast,range egg yolk,kalamata olive,mustard powder
title: Limey Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts | 3 free range egg yolks | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 can sliced kalamata olives, drained and halved ( drained ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Place chicken in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and place under running cold water for 10 - 12 minutes until completely cooked. Drain and cool. Place the egg yolks in a bowl and whisk well. Stir in the bread crumbs, olives, mustard and lime juice. In a separate bowl, lightly beat the egg white until frothy and then fold into the egg mixture. Pour into a lightly oiled shallow frypan or grill. Cook over medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes, turning halfway through cooking, until cooked through and golden.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,corn,lime juice,broccoli floret,sugar,dark brown sugar,cooking sherry,rotel
title: Mushroom-Broccoli Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/2 cup low sodium cooking sherry | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 lb fresh mushrooms ( or a mix of shiitake, oyster, and shiitake, sliced ) | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 cup corn
instructions: In a bowl, mix together cooking sherry, lime juice, soy sauce, sugar and brown sugar, until sugar is completely dissolved. Add mushrooms and broccoli, stir to mix well. Heat over medium high heat in a large skillet. Quickly add corn, stir, and cook 3 - 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,balsamic vinegar,poblano chile,flour tortilla,coconut milk,pine nut,extra sharp cheddar cheese,chuck
title: Coco's Monterey Beef Enchiladas Suizas
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 2 poblano chiles, seeds and stem removed | 2 ounces canadian bacon, sliced | 12 flour tortillas, 6-7 inches long | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 cups shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese, divided | 1 can light coconut milk, 398 calories | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Grease pan with olive oil spray, set aside. In a skillet, cook beef until light and cooked through. Add peppers and can of coconut milk and cook until heated through. Spoon 1/3 of meat mixture into each tortilla and roll up. Place tortillas seam side down in baking dish. Blend the cheddar and half of the garlic in a blender or food processor. Add to baking dish and top with remaining meat mixture and the remaining garlic. Bake in oven, covered for 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven, cover and let sit 10 minutes before serving. Serve over spanish rice.

title: Cilantro-Olive Drip Fanta
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 tablespoons creme de menthe ( or a complementary brand ) | coarsely crushed fresh cilantro
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, mix cilantro and creme de menthe. Pour over crushed dried fruit of your choice and toss to coat. Cover and let marinate for an hour or two before serving so flavors will develop.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,chicken bouillon cube,chicken breast,dark sesame oil,tea,brown lentil,molasses
title: Spiced Lentil and Chicken Kebabs W-Gruyere Cheese Blend
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 cup fresh strong brewed tea ( any strong brew ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons instant brown lentils | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 5 tablespoons tamarind packed in oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 tablespoons gruyere cheese
instructions: Cut each chicken breast into 2 - 3 chunks and place into a zip lock bag. Add all the other ingredients to bag and shake. Add the chicken chunks to the bag and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat your grill and bbq. Grill the chicken for 12 - 15 minutes. During the last minute of grilling, place the bag of hot chicken on the heated grill to cook. Turn, baste with the tamarind oil and allow 5 minutes for medium rare, 1 1/2 minutes for well done. Remove from the grill and allow to rest about 5 minutes before slicing, serving with your favourite bread, fresh veggies or fresh salad. Serves.

title: Lebanese Table Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon table salt | fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place each piece of dried wood on its flat surface. Sprinkle the kosher salt over and then rub the salt all around the outside of the slab. Wrap the body in a kitchen towel and tie with kitchen string. Suspend the body for 6 hours, carefully shaking the outside of the towel every so often to make sure that the salt mixture does not stick to the towel. When the salt has soaked into the wood, scrape the salt off the slab with your finger and discard the skin. You will need to place your body in a dry cloth for several days.

title: Spiced Oven Veggies
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans or 1 lb brown beans | 1 tablespoon savory | 1 tablespoon rosemary | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon chili powder or 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise | 2 tablespoons honey mustard | 1 -2 lb pasta
instructions: Rinse the beans well under running water and remove any rocks. Combine the rest of the ingredients except the pasta and heat together on your stove. Pour into the dry pan, add the pasta and mix thoroughly. Heat on your stove until pasta is done, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,kaffir lime leaf,tea,whipping cream,cherry tomato,kosher salt,garlic salt
title: Thai Coffee Cream With Kaffir Lime Cream
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh baby spinach | 3 kaffir lime leaves, roughly chopped | 1 pinch garlic salt | 1/2 tablespoon instant tea | 3 tablespoons whipping cream ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Place the baby spinach in a large skillet with about 2 cups water. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat, cover, and cook until just wilted, about 3 minutes. Drain, and set aside for now to cool. Drain all the water and kaffir lime leaves, and add them to the same skillet along with the garlic salt. Cook until it starts to sizzle. You may take the cover off for a moment or two, but do not burn. Add the instant tea, and cook over medium heat until liquid is reduced to half. This might take a few minutes, depending on how hot the pan gets. Remove the kaffir lime cream from the heat. Cover and keep it for about 15 minutes, or until it starts to thicken slightly. It will thicken as it cools, but it won't be as smooth. Tear off small pieces of kaffir lime leaf from the stems, and add them to the skillet. Stir in cream, salt, and cherry tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable juice,monterey jack cheese,green enchilada sauce,marshmallow,baking powder
title: Green Enchilada Lasagna Chips
ingredients: 12 medium marshmallows | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable juice | 1/8 teaspoon baking powder | 1 1/2 lbs monterey jack cheese, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to spray 1 13x9 pan with pam. Bake marshmallows, stirring often, until they brown. Stir in enchilada sauce, vegetable juice and baking powder and heat until bubbly. Arrange 2 cups of shredded jack cheese in the bottom of the pan. Pour 1/3 of the cooled green sauce over the cheese. Use a spoon to make small holes in the cheese with a fork. Pour the rest of the shredded cheese over top. Bake 20 minute sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of shredded cheese over top and bake for 30 more minutes or until cheese on top is bubbly and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: white bread,rye bread,mirin,rice wine,red chili powder,catsup,basmati rice,coconut
title: Sweet Chilli Toast
ingredients: 6 slices bread | 4 slices rice wine | 4 slices white bread | 2 tablespoons coriander or 2 tablespoons cilantro | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mirin ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry the bread slices. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of coriander/cilantro over the bread slices. Place 1 slice of white and 2 slices of rye bread on top of each slice of bread and press together firmly. Heat a griddle or frying pan on medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon of the remaining coriander/cilantro and 1/2 teaspoon of the chilli powder to the griddle. Cook the toast until crisp and golden in colour. Turn out onto a plate. Add 2 tablespoon of the catsup to the griddle. Add the rice wine to the top of the toast and cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of coriander/cilantro and the red chilly powder and stir. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of catsup and rice wine and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add both pieces of bread and stir in the balance of the catsup. Toast for a minute or two on the underside and flip over to the other piece of bread. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Lentils & Avocados
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread, day old | 1 lb lentils | 2 red apples, cored, cut into thin wedges, about 11/8 '' x 4-1/2 '' slices | 1/2 lb sweet lentils | 2 medium hass avocadoes, cut into thin wedges, slightly pitted | 2 tablespoons mint, packed | spices, of choice ( mccormick spice blend ) or cinnamon stick, to taste
instructions: If the bread is very stale, place in a large bowl with cold water to soak until just soft, about 1 hour, and drain well. Place the lentils in a large pot. Bring water to a boil over high heat, add the lentils, and cook until the lentils are just soft, about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain and set aside. If there is any liquid left in the pan, drain it, and set aside. Turn the oven on to broil. Place the bread slices on a cookie sheet fitted with a rim. Spray lightly with oil and place under broiler, cut side down. Cook until browned. Spread a little of the lentils in the bottom of a 1 quart baking dish. Cover with a layer of bread slices. Top the lentils with apples, avocado, mint, and spices. Drizzle with vinaigrette to taste. Broil 2 to 3 minutes or until the vinaigrette begins to bubble.

Random Ingredients: allspice,pork sausage link,beef stew meat,creamy peanut butter,romano cheese
title: Peanut Butter and Sticky Spicy Sausage
ingredients: 3 beef stew meat | 2 pork sausage links, casings removed ( i have also used pork loin sausage ) | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter ( or more to taste ) | 1/3 cup grated romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place sausage in a large heavy skillet, and cook over medium heat over medium high heat, turning often, until browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Bok Choy in Hot Mustard
ingredients: 2 bunches baby bok choy | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Trim stems of bok choy if desired. Cut stems into 1 1/2 lengths.

title: Chinese Sweet Beans
ingredients: 3 ounces green beans, halved | 2 teaspoons nonfat dry milk | 1 medium bell pepper, cut into 1/4- to 3/4-inch strips ( capsicum )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees celsius or 400 degrees fahrenheit. Put the green beans in an ovenproof dish & lightly dust with a little corn meal, cover with aluminium foil & bake for 40 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the milk in a small pan & warm it through, about 3 - 4 minutes, then spread it over the green beans & season to taste with salt & freshly ground black pepper. Serve the bean strips with the sweet beans & a sprinkle of crushed red pepper.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,baby pea,linguica sausage,corn chip,puff pastry,flat leaf parsley,beef chuck,yellow squash
title: Portuguese Stuffed Beef Brisket (Beef or Turkey)
ingredients: 5 lbs beef brisket or 5 lbs turkey, cut into 8 pieces | 3 lbs whole baby peas | 3 lbs medium yellow squash ( i substitute pumpkin for the pumpkin ) | 3 lbs portuguese sausage, casing removed | 1 lb beef chuck, trimmed of any sinew | 1 large beef frankfurter or 1 large mild turkey ( optional ) | corn chips, for serving ( optional ) | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Remove meat of any fat and discard. Rinse meat well under cold running water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut lengthwise into 8, 2 wide wide strips. Arrange cut sides toward center of a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker. Add peas. Top with all pieces of beef, breaking all the way around the meat. Sprinkle meat with salt. Place in slow cooker. Cut sausage in half lengthwise and scrape out fat. Make slit in meat through meat lengthwise about ¼ inch deep. Using a spoon, scrape out and discard strings of meat. Insert a frankfurter into the slit and insert meat and sausage meat from the end of the flank steak. Place in slow cooker. Cut squash lengthwise into 8 wedges or ¼ inch thick. Place wedges around the meat, covering meat completely. Cover. Cook on 6 to 7 hours on high or 7 to 8 hours on low. When ready to serve, remove cover, add peas and parsley and remove meat. Serve with crisp corn chips as desired.

title: Herbs & Garlic
ingredients: 1 bunch of fresh mint, about 4 cups, chopped | 2 -3 cloves
instructions: Place 2 cups of fresh mint in a food processor fitted with a metal blade and puree until fine. Place the mint and coarsely chopped garlic in a large bowl and add the mint sprigs. Pour enough olive oil in the bowl to make a 1/2 inch depth of 1/4 inch. Stir in the garlic mixture. Toss well and keep at room temperature for 2 hours or until it ferments, then transfer to a glass jar or jar and keep at room temperature 2 weeks.

title: Italian Sausage, Peppers, and Pasta With Espresso
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage, remove from the casings | 2 1/2 cups raw meats, cut into bite size chunks | 1 package frozen peppers, thawed | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon espresso powder | 16 ounces pasta
instructions: Toast sausage throughly. Cool, remove from casing. Slice or shred. In large pot cook meat and garlic. Drain grease. In a large bowl toss sausage with peppers until well coated. Add the parsley. Add the espresso, cooking throughly. Bring to boil and boil to reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add pasta, toss and serve.

title: Italian Flag
ingredients: 1/3 cup bottled clam juice | 1/3 cup crumbled blue cheese | 1/3 cup chopped kalamata olives
instructions: Pour clam juice into a measuring cup or small bowl.

title: Bengali (Steamed and Beer-Braised Fresh)
ingredients: 2 liters stout beer, chilled | 2 green cardamom pods | 300 g fresh kale
instructions: Place the beer, cardamom pods, and kale into the bottom of a steamer. Place a lid over the pan and bring the mixture just to boiling point. Cover and cook over low heat for 1/2 hour. Remove the lid, increase the heat under the beer to medium high and bring the liquid to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, partially cover the pan, and continue cooking for 2 - 3 minutes to steam the kale at a boil. Allow the pan to stand for 2 - 3 minutes, then remove the lid. Use a sharp knife to cut the kale into thin slices.

title: Vietnamese Steamed Meatball Subs
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin or 1 lb pork | 1 -3 cup fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1 can chicken broth or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) can beef broth | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sugar | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla | ice ( optional )
instructions: Drain the beef, chop or shred it if a lot, and combine with fish sauce & broth. Cover & refrigerate overnight. Remove meatball wrappers from refrigerator, if using, for a more elegant look. Bring a small saucepan 1/4 inch of water to a boil & add 1 1/2 tsp of sugar. Using a spoon, scoop out as many air pockets as possible with a circular motion as you can & set aside. Pour the rest of the sugar into a small deep saute pan or wok, then add the meatballs. Stir & cook over medium high heat until most of the water is absorbed but the meat still retains some shape. Don't take the pan off the burner, you don't want to ruin it, but don't put it back on the burner if it does, it is bitter. Remove the meatballs from the heat & set aside in a small bowl. Add the vanilla & reserved sugar to the reserved 1/2 tsp suace, & stir well. Pour 1/2 a cup of the meatjuices into the pan or wok & bring to a boil. When the water begins to boil again, add one or two ice cubes as a precaution. Add the meatballs & simmer over low heat for 10 - 15 minutes, or until they are cooked through. Remove the meatballs from the heat & serve topped with a little of the sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,cream tartar,monterey jack cheese,lime juice,garlic salt,peanut oil
title: Mexican Beef Ranchera
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup creme fraiche | 2 teaspoons lime juice, fresh | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 bag beef, coarsely ground round ( or flank steak ) | 3 teaspoons peanut oil ( or other oil of choice )
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f line 13 by 9 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Combine sour cream, lime juice, garlic salt, and cream of tartar in medium bowl, set aside. In medium bowl, blend ground round. Add beef, mix well until all lumps are gone. Sprinkle with oil and lime juice mixture. Transfer to prepared pan. Bake, uncovered, stirring occasionally, approximately 50 minutes or until internal temperature is 160°f and meat thermometer registers 160f. Drain, reserving drippings in pan. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,italian bread,almond extract,chili paste,watercress,rack lamb,saffron,chicken stock vegetable
title: Rack of Lamb St. Louis
ingredients: 1 lb rack of lamb | 1 ounce chili paste | 1/2 cup blanched almond, toasted | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 5 cups chicken stock or 5 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | sliced italian bread, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Score racks of lamb, then place racks in a large baking pan. Combine chili paste, almonds and garam masala. Coat chops well on both sides of the chops. Spoon the chili paste mixture over the racks. Cover the pan tightly and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Bring stock to room temperature then drain lamb well. Preheat oven to 325°f. Place the rack of lamb on rack in a roasting pan and roast for 1 hour. Brush with almond extract while cooking.

title: Dee's Red Beans & Rice
ingredients: 12 ounces dark red kidney beans, rinsed | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Put the beans, asofetida and a little water into a slow cooker. Cook on high setting for 1 hour until beans are very dark in colour. Alternatively, process in a blender on high for 30 seconds. Serve warm with plain white basmati rice.

title: Mexican Nacho Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 cups enchilada sauce | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: In a medium size bowl mix enchilada sauce and chili powder. Stir. Microwaveable bowl for 60 seconds to 1 minute or until hot. Serve warm with pinto beans, corn tortilla chips, cheese, etc.

title: Pimiento and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 2 ounces sweet pimientos, peeled & very finely chopped | 1 1/2 ounces powdered palm sugar | 1 small green chile pepper ( optional )
instructions: Heat the margarine in a small saucepan over a low heat. Add the pimentos and fry for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring all the time, until the pimentos turn lightly browned. Remove from the heat & stir in the palm sugar. Stir the cooked pimento mixture through the warm jam. Transfer the jam to sterilised jars with a slotted spoon. Seal. Store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,salt black pepper,sake,lentil,onion flake,black pepper
title: Japanese Style Lentil
ingredients: 1 lb dried lentils, washed | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 3/4 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 2 ounces almond paste | 3 tablespoons sake | 1 tablespoon instant mixed dried onion
instructions: Boil 4 cups of water and add the 3 tablespoons instant dried onion. When it boils add the lentils. Cover and let soak for 1 hour at least. The longer the better for flavour. After 15 minutes bring water to boil again and add salt and black pepper. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in dried onion flakes. Serve with rice and garnish with finely chopped raw almonds.

title: Chayote Appetizer (Taquitos Con Amendo
ingredients: 4 chayotes, sliced lengthwise into 1/8-inch-thick rounds | 2 cups ice cream, softened | 4 teaspoons corn oil ( or more )
instructions: Heat oil in pot or deep fryer, and heat until almost smoking. Place chayote in oil, and cook until crisp and golden brown. Place chayote on a paper towel lined plate, and roll up. Remove chayote and repeat process with rest of chayote. Serve warm.

title: Fried Rottles
ingredients: 500 -600 g rye flour | 1 cup oil
instructions: Sift the rye flour into the sieve and add enough rye flour into a large bowl. Mix in oil to make a firm dough. Divide the dough into pieces and roll out into thin discs 3cm thick. Heat the oil in a large heavy casserole or frying pan to 375 grades f. Place one piece of dough on top and flatten the dough slightly. Cut into wedges. Drain and serve the rottles warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,onion powder,meat,star anise,green pepper,salt black pepper,lamb,chunky salsa
title: Spicy Salsa Crusted Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 lb ground lean lamb | 2 medium tomatoes, diced | 2 green peppers, chopped | 2 large onions, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon hot chunky salsa | 3 star anise, broken into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large skillet or over medium high heat, brown the ground meat in the sesame oil, stirring to crumble the meat into small pieces as it cooks. Once the meat has begun to turn brown, add green peppers and onions, stirring lightly to coat in the fat, then season with salt and pepper. Stir in the salsa and star anise and increase heat to high. Cook until the meat is thoroughly cooked, about 7 minutes, stirring often. Transfer the seasoned meat to a colander, and transfer the contents of the skillet to a mixing bowl. Sprinkle the crumb topping over the hot meat, and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,french bread,apricot preserve,fruit,vanilla pod,chipotle chile,mandarin orange,russet potato
title: Smoothie
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled, cut in half lengthwise, rinsed, and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained ( cannellini ) | 1 1/2 cups apricot preserves ( or maple syrup ) | 3 canned chipotle chiles, seeded, chopped, rinsed, and drained | 1 small vanilla pod, split |  french bread, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 12 ounces mandarin oranges, drained, rinsed, and sliced ( or orange slices ) | 1 large dried fruit, of your choice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f. In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, beans, preserves, 1 whole chipotle pepper, a pinch of salt, and some of the juice from the 1 whole chipotle pepper if using. In another large bowl, mix the remaining whole chipotle pepper with 1/2 teaspoon salt, the remaining whole chipotle pepper, sliced tomatoes, and dried fruit. Lay 2 slices of the bread lengthwise in a lightly oiled 2 qt. Ovenproof casserole dish. Arrange 12 ounce orange slices in a 1 inch overlapping pattern in the center of four bread slices, overlapping the slices, leaving a 1 inch border of bread around the edges. Place a layer of the bean/pina colada mixture over the orange layer and top with the remaining bread slices. Cover the tomatoes with another layer of tomato mixture and top with the remaining tomato mixture. Cover the dish with foil. The tomatoes should be just touching. Bake for one hour or until the bread topping has lightly browned. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,linguine pasta,soya sauce,gingerroot,angel hair pasta,grape tomato
title: Soy Spiced Peanut Noodles With Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 200 g linguine pasta | 125 g grape tomatoes | 1 medium gingerroot, thinly sliced | 150 g frozen snow peas with stems | 125 g creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup soya sauce
instructions: Cook the noodles as per packet, keep the pasta covered for 5 mins meanwhile, in a frying pan fry the gingerroot in 1 tbsp oil over a medium heat. When golden add the tomatoes, sprinkle with a bit of salt and a touch of sugar. Cook for about 2 mins stirring occasionally. Drain the noodles, add the noodles to the tomato mix, pour over the peanut butter and soy sauce and mix well. Serve with rice.

title: Pistachio Beef Mince Casserole
ingredients: 1 kg beef mince | 1/2 cup pistachios, blanched | 1 jar of your favorite marinara sauce | lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Pound the pistachios with a rolling pin. Place in the bottom of your a glass 8x8 dish. Mix the mince with the pistachios then add jar of the marinara. Spread evenly. Sprinkle with the grated lemon peel. Cover with foil and bake for approximately 1 hour or until meat is tender and the pistachios are slightly crunchy. Remove from oven/oven and let sit for 5 minutes before slicing into thick slices. Serve with freshly baked vegies, mashed potatoes or biscuits.

title: Pickled Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup habanero pepper, chopped | 2 cups dry white wine
instructions: Heat habanero pepper in a dry skillet over medium heat. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Let peppers cool enough to handle, then place them in a jar with a tight lid. Pour wine over the peppers, and let stand overnight on counter. The next day, the peppers will be light and slightly blackened, wrinkled, and hard to detect. They will become more dark with time. After 30 minutes, remove the peppers and cool them on a clean towel until they are safe. Store in a cool, dark place.

Random Ingredients: cooking sherry,green olive,pizza crust,apricot preserve,broccoli floret,leg lamb,beef loin steak,pinto bean
title: Lamb Pizza With Pan-Fried Lamb
ingredients: 1 medium boneless leg of lamb, trimmed | 9 ounces boneless beef loin steaks, trimmed, cut crosswise into 1/8-inch-thick slices | 1/2 cup cooking sherry | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package frozen broccoli florets | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli florets | 6 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f place lamb steaks in a 14 by 9 inch baking pan and set aside. In a large nonstick skillet, coat lamb well with cooking sherry. Arrange beef slices evenly over lamb and top with broccoli. Pour sherry over all and cover pan with heavy duty foil. Bake uncovered 30 - 35 minutes or until meat is easily pierced with a fork. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, bring beans, broccoli, and 1/4 cup water to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to medium and cook 6 - 8 minutes or until crisp tender. Meanwhile, unfold foil and reserve. In a 13 by 9 inch baking pan, arrange pizza crust on a baking sheet and sprinkle evenly with remaining 1/4 cup of preserves. Brush tomato mixture evenly over crust. Drizzle mushroom mixture evenly over pizza. Bake covered until cheese is golden brown, about 10 minutes. Cover and keep warm. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,prosciutto,turkey bacon,italian cheese,beef stew meat
title: Slow Cooker Baked Chicken Reubens
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves - cut into 1-inch thick strips | 8 slices prosciutto | 1 package italian-style processed cheese, cubed | 1 pound thinly sliced deli thin-sliced turkey bacon | 1 package thinly sliced deli thin-sliced deli thin-sliced deli thin-sliced deli thin-sliced thin-sliced deli slices
instructions: Stir chicken strips, prosciutto, and processed cheese together in a slow cooker. Place turkey bacon in a large, deep skillet, or skillet. Cook and stir turkey bacon in the hot bacon on medium high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,parsnip,bean,italian parsley,bouquet garni,asafoetida powder
title: Irish Parsnips and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 1 bouquet garni ( bay leaf ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 pinch gingersi-garlic paste ( hing ) | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley
instructions: Peel and dice parsnips, then boil just over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Drain, then return them to the pot, fill with water to cover, and heat through. Discard the bouquet garni or remove and reserve parsley. Stir asafoetida into parsnips, adding salt, ginger garlic paste and dried parsley. Mix well, serve.

title: English Cornbread
ingredients: 450 g hamburger | 1 1/2 cups soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups caster sugar or 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 4 tablespoons crushed peppercorns, to taste | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c, gas mark combine all the ingredients together and set aside 30 minutes. Pour ingredients into a 2 lb loaf tin, and bake for 1 1/2 hours. Slice and serve on a platter with fresh salad or vegetables, and fresh crusty breads.

title: Cheesy Beets With Mushrooms and Turnips
ingredients: 6 cups fresh button mushrooms, sliced ( or equivalent amount of fresh shiitake mushrooms ) | 8 cups leftover roast turnip, sliced into 1/4-inch slices ( or equivalent amount of pearl turnip ) | 10 fresh cherries ( or equivalent amount of dried cherries, or equivalent amount of dried cherries, or equivalent amount dried cherries ) | 1 cup reduced fat cottage cheese ( or use low fat sour cream ) | 4 hoagie rolls, split ( or any other type bread will do ) | 1 can beet, drained | 1/4 cup half-and-half ( light cream )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the mushrooms, turnips, cherries, cottage cheese, and beer in a large bowl. Stir well. Add just enough half and half to moisten. Slice the bread into 8 slices and place 1st 3/4 cup of mixture in each bread slice. Dip tops of bread and let absorb some of the beer. Place each bread slice in a separate large baking dish. Bake for about 25 - 30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cottage cheese is bubbly. Sprinkle with additional powdered sugar when serving.

title: Soy Wine Sauce for Beef and Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 1/4 cup light soya sauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Mexican-Style Chocolate Chip Lassi
ingredients: 4 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/4 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 tomato, finely diced
instructions: Blend yogurt, chocolate chips, and tomato in a blender until smooth.

title: Lazy Dogs (Southern Style)
ingredients: 1 cup hot sauce ( frank's redhot ) | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Combine hot sauce and 1 cup flour in small glass bowl, stirring until well blended and smooth. Set aside. Heat an ungreased griddle or cast iron skillet over high heat. Remove dough from bowl, leaving excess oil and floury dough in bowl.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,tequila,apricot preserve,taco seasoning mix,caper,caesar salad dressing,iceberg lettuce,caster sugar
title: TexMex Apricot & Caper Pizza!
ingredients: 250 g pizza dough, thawed | 1/4 cup tequila ( dark ) | 1/4 cup caesar salad dressing | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup cider vinegar, white preferred | 1 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 60 g capers, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degc. Grease 24cm cutter, line base of pan with baking paper.

title: Squash Cocktail
ingredients: 2 cups butternut squash, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 3/4 ounce simple syrup | 3/4 ounce soda ( like sprite or 7-up ) | lettuce leaf, for garnish | pear, slices for garnish
instructions: Mix together the lime juice, ketchup and simple syrup. Place the butternut squash slices in a large serving dish. Pour the lime mixture over the squash. Float lettuce leaves on top.

title: French Celery and Sunflower Oil Dip
ingredients: 500 g celery ribs, very thinly sliced | 50 g sunflower oil | 1 clove garlic, very finely chopped ( or 1 tsp salt )
instructions: Dry the celery in a clean tea towel, and dry with water. Place celery into a bowl, add oil and garlic, and combine thoroughly with hands until vegetables are coated with oil. Serve with crackers, or as a dippers, or simply add to a sandwich, or any other sandwich filling for a vegan dip. This is great with crusty bread, crackers or toasted kielbasa.

title: Sizzlin' Apricot D'chilbasa(Sizzlin' Apricot Apricot Chili)
ingredients: 1 fresh anaheim chilies or 1 hot fresh chili, seeded ( or 1 jalapeno if you prefer ) | 4 -6 large garlic cloves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/3 cup shredded sweetened coconut, toasted | 1 teaspoon apricot jam ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop peppers and garlic. Mince thyme. Drain excess fat off. Finely chop remaining ingredients. Spread over dry surface of chili. Serve with crusty bread, crackers, or as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: caper,heavy whipping cream,tomatillo,sultana,romano cheese,tamarind juice,sea salt
title: Tamarind Caper Ice Cream by Todd Wilbur
ingredients: 4 sheets ripe taro tamarind juice | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon finely grated romano cheese | 1 small vine ripened tomatoes, seeded | 3/4 cup seedless sultana | 1 tablespoon capers, drained
instructions: Using the taro tamarind juice, combine all ingredients in a small food processor and process until blended.

title: Sweet and Spicy Onions
ingredients: 3 pounds white onions, sliced lengthwise | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup hot sauce, or to taste
instructions: Lay the sliced onions in a large skillet with a lid, and set over medium heat. Cook and stir until the onions are lightly browned and tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in the palm sugar, asafoetida powder, and hot sauce. Simmer a few minutes to allow flavors to blend, then remove lid. Remove skillet from heat, and allow to cool for about 30 minutes. Cool to room temperature, cover, and store for up to 2 weeks.

title: Fresh Salmon Cakes With Ginger Rice
ingredients: 2 large salmon fillets, rinsed, well drained and cut into bite size chunks | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons ground gingerroot | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh gingerroot | 4 tablespoons ice cold water | cooked white rice ( to serve ) or cooked brown rice ( to serve )
instructions: Lightly toast breadcrumbs and ginger in a large frypan, stirring often until golden. Cool. In a shallow bowl, combine the chopped fish with the breadcrumb, ginger and water and mix well to combine. Using a teaspoon scoop up portions of the mixture and shape into cakes. Heat a large non stick frying pan on high. Scoop cakes out of bowl and add to pan. Cook cakes 3 - 4 minutes on each side, until golden and cooked through. Serve immediately. Serve with cooked rice or cooked brown rice and ginger chutney.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,red leaf lettuce,carrot,coconut extract,lime wedge,italian bread
title: Healthy Coconut Romaine Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 cups red leaf lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces | 3 cups carrots, shredded | 3 tablespoons unsweetened coconut extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 4 slices italian bread, toasted | 2 -3 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Combine the lettuce in a large bowl. Sprinkle with carrots, coconut extract, cayenne, and cayenne.

title: Lazy Tamale Pie
ingredients: 1 box masa harina flour | 1 cup elbow macaroni ( or more to your desired consistency )
instructions: Pasta. Pasta. Dab of course macaroni. Pasta. Whatever it is. Cook and serve with flour and a little olive oil on top. Cheese. Shreddies or swiss cheese or all of the above.

Random Ingredients: brown onion,green plantain,vinegar,taco flour tortilla,lemon juice
title: Plantain-Pinilla Fajitas
ingredients: 3/4 cup diced brown onion | 3 tablespoons chopped green plantains | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | taco flour tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven on the lowest setting. Saute onions until translucent, about 4 minutes. Stir in chopped plantain and lemon juice. Heat through and serve with taco shells or guacamole. Note, when buying plantains in a pinch, cut off the ends and remove as is. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: pepper,flat leaf parsley,chive,passion fruit nectar,white sesame seed,yukon gold potato,parsley flake,black sesame seed
title: Gramma Brown's Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 yellow yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons white sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons dried chives | 2 tablespoons dried flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons fresh passion fruit nectar | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into 6 wedges each. Cut each wedge into 3 wedges. Place wedges in a medium saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,ice cube,banana pepper,salt,baby bok choy,chicken bouillon
title: Bok Choy Soup
ingredients: 5 -6 large baby bok choy | 2 large vidalia onions ( cut in half ) | 1 banana pepper ( cut in half ) | 4 -5 cups chicken bouillon ( made up of bouillon cubes, water, bouillon powder, and soy sauce ) | salt ( to taste )
instructions: Wash bok choy and remove stems. Cut leaves off bok choy stems if they are small. Cut the stalks in 1 inch pieces and cut leaves in half if the larger leaves are smaller. Slice the onion in about 1/8 inch slices and drop them into boiling water. When the leaves float remove with a slotted spoon. When just limp transfer the vegetables to the large bowl of ice water to soak up any ice water. Drain them, then set aside when all the vegetables are drained. Bring the chicken boullion to a boil and add 4 cup of water into it. Add salt to taste. When the boullion comes to a boil, add the banana peppers, salt, and pepper. Put the bowl back on the stove, add the rest of the vidalia onions, and heat gently for 10 - 15 minutes. Put the bok choy in, remove the leaves only and add them to the soup. Heat another 4 - 5 minutes.

title: Champurrado(Brazilian Snow Pea Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups shelled fresh snow peas | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Combine the snow peas and cream.

title: Peanut Butter Penne
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne pasta | 1 lb fingerling potato | 1/4 cup soymilk or 1/4 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter
instructions: Parboil pasta in boiling water, 10 - 3 minutes, add peanut butter when finished cooking. Drain, let sit 3 - 5 minutes while pasta is sitting. Cook pasta in 4 qt pan with a little bit of oil, stir until well coated. Add potatoes, stir well, cook a few minutes with soysamck, remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,orange zest,lamb cutlet,garlic salt,rice vinegar,chicken stock vegetable,button mushroom
title: Tunisian Lamb Cutlets in Vinegar and Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 4 lamb cutlets, approx | 3/4 cup chicken stock or 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon dried orange zest | 4 -6 button mushrooms, sliced | 2/3 cup rice vinegar | 1 cup cauliflower, florets
instructions: Combine stock and seasonings in a large non stick frying pan and bring to the boil. Add lamb, reduce heat and simmer 8 - 10 minutes till cooked through. Add mushrooms, stirring frequently, and cook 2 - 3 minutes longer. Combine vinegar and stock, pour over meat and vegetables and stir well. Serve immediately or cook on the stove top just till the pasta is just tender and sauce has thickened. To reheat, place cauliflower in a frying pan and dry fry until just crispy, drain and toss onto a warm serving plate. Slice lamb cutlets and serve with sauce poured over.

title: Chicken Flavor   Meat,     "gimmies" Copycat-Style  "
ingredients: 1 lb meat, `` your favorite mix of chopped vegetables | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules ( i use chicken-ove ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 - 1 cup ketchup, to mix
instructions: Pour ketchup into a pie dish, add meat. Sprinkle chicken mixture evenly over the top. Let sit in fridge overnight. The next day, turn into a greased 13x9 baking dish, cook at 350 for about 45 minutes or until internal temp reads 160 and meat is no longer pink. This does not really need cooking but also does not have to be refrigerated.. Note, do not add fat and oils as gravy or fat will separate.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,pork loin roast,yellow cake mix,shrimp paste,corn
title: Chinese New Year Pork Shrimp
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground ginger root, or more to taste | 1 pound boneless pork loin roast, cut in 1 inch cubes | 2 cans shrimp paste | 2 packages yellow cake mix | 12 ears fresh corn, shucked
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place ginger root into a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Add pork.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,italian parsley,red chilies,almond extract
title: Chilies Almond and Italian Parsley Cake
ingredients: 240 g self raising flour | 2 tablespoons finely chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons ground almonds or 2 tablespoons ground flaked coconut | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red chilies | red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or 190°c if fan forced. Line an ovenproof bowl with baking paper, using a silicon pad. Sift the flour and nuts together. Add the chillies and red food colouring if using. Mix well, then pour into prepared pan. Bake at 200°c for 40 minutes. Allow to completely cool, then slice to serve.

Random Ingredients: sauce,red chile,liquid smoke,coconut cream,wasabi,granny smith apple,gruyere cheese,tomato paste
title: Cheesy Apple and Chile Slaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 granny smith apples, cut into small chunks | 3 teaspoons hot sauce, or more | 3/4 cup coconut cream | 1/3 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1 cup crispy aged gruyere cheese, divided | 1 red chile, seeded and sliced | 3 tablespoons wasabi, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Mix tomato paste, apples, hot sauce, coconut cream, gruyère cheese, 1/3 cup gruyere cheese, red chile, wasabi, and liquid smoke in a bowl. Serve with spicy crackers.

title: Gravel (Polish Goulash)
ingredients: 8 medium zucchini ( about 1 pound ) | 4 medium cauliflower, separated into florets ( about 1 pound ) | coarse fine sea salt
instructions: Slice zucchini crosswise into 3 or 4 pieces each, leaving the end pieces intact. Trim ends from cauliflower. Rinse, then pat dry. Cook zucchini in a pot of boiling salted water until bright green and just tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl.

title: Penne Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb penne, cooked thoroughly according to package. | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350°f. In a fry pan, fry a tortilla in olive oil for approximately 20 seconds each side... Drain onto paper towels and then sprinkle with garlic powder or season with salt. Wrap each tortilla in a large piece of wax paper and place the burrito in the middle. Bake for approximately 10 - 20 minutes. Serve while hot.

title: Dee's Beef Soup (For Wonton)
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 teaspoon green peppercorn, crushed | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 cups cooked rice noodles | 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Mix ground beef with the crushed peppercorns. Form the mixture as you would a wonton package. Place on a greased baking tray. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 - 30 minutes or until the mixture starts to brown. Add the water, bouillon cubes and rice noodles. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Turn off the heat and remove the wrap. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: fig,marshmallow,cherry tomato,pork sausage,arborio rice,prosciutto,braising steak,salt pepper
title: Torta Di Manzo Di Salsiccia E Frecco E Freccola
ingredients: 12 ounces ground pork sausage | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice, cooked and cool | 2 slices prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 12 large cherry tomatoes | 10 -12 small marshmallows or 10 -12 miniature marshmallows | 1 2/3 lbs braising steak, cut into 1 1/2-inch wide strips by pounding it repeatedly with the flat of the cleaver blade of your knife | 5 -6 cups good quality cherry tomatoes | salt and pepper
instructions: This recipe can be made at least two months in advance and refrigerated. Carry on making it in advance. Combine the ground pork and prosciutto using a wooden spoon and divide the ham evenly over the sausage. Layer the grape tomato over the meat and top with all the remaining ingredients. Place on a parchment covered foil covered cookie sheet. Place in the upper portion of the preheated oven, 450 degrees f. Bake covered for 2 hours. Remove foil then bake an additional 30 minutes to brown the top. Let cool before slicing. Best eaten immediately.

title: Roasted Turkey Tarte Tatin With Hot Cherry Tomato & Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 ounces puff pastry | 3 lbs turkey, sliced | 2 1/2 cups hot fresh cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Lay sheet of parchment paper on a baking tray. On top of paper, evenly spread out the turkey. Top turkey with 2 tbsp of cherry tomato and 1 tbsp of prepared cherries and 2 tbsp of prepared truffle truffle oil. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until juices run clear. Slice, enjoy.

title: Slow Cooker Maple Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 32 ounces ketchup | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 cup maple syrup | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar
instructions: Cut pork into 6 sections, and place in crockpot. Combine ketchup, tomato ketchup, maple syrup, sugar, and syrup in sauce pan and cook 5 minutes on high. Turn down to low and cook 8 hours. Take out and discard string, but leave some fat in remaining cooking liquid. You can remove pork from the crock and shred it to your liking.

title: Irish Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken | 2 cups egg noodles | 1/4 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Drain noodles and allow water to run through them. Brown meat in large skillet. Boil noodles, drain and add to skillet with chicken and cranberries. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. You may have to add an additional 1/4 cup of water before adding any more.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,pinto bean,golden syrup,celery,glace cherry,bulgur,orange peel
title: Smooth English Bread Crunch for Christmas
ingredients: 1 lb plain rye bread | 1 can pinto beans, well drained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup glace cherries, halved | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | freshly grated orange peel | 1/2 cup celery, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 package dried bulgur, wheat-free
instructions: Wrap bread in foil and roast at 250°f for 40 - 45 minutes. To make a crumbly topping of topping. Grease a 9x13 baking dish or a 1 quart casserole dish with cornstarch mixed with cold water. Combine pinto beans, cherries and syrup in a bowl and stir until pinto beans are well mixed and glace cherries have sweated away. Spread topping evenly over warm breadcrumbs. Sprinkle on orange peel. Place celery and bulgur in separate bowls or a plate covered in parchment paper. Microwave on high for 3 - 5 minutes while still warm, until bulgur is softened. Remove from microwave. Sprinkle bulgur mixture over top of breadcrumbs. Chill 20 minutes before serving. Note, this sounds complicated but trust me it will pay you no end in making it right. I'm esp. Using pinto beans that have not been well drained, i add a small handful of the beans when making, after draining. I also add the oats and celery to soak them in the syrup once done.

title: Tilting Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups dry rotini pasta | 1 teaspoon saffron powder | 1/2 cup sharp low-fat cheddar cheese, coarsely shredded
instructions: Cook rotini according to package directions, in water over medium heat. Drain and rinse cheese under cold water, shaking out excess moisture. Toss hot pastas with saffron in small bowl, add cheese and toss to coat. Serve immediately, or place immediately, over noodles.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,white cheddar cheese,beef chuck,cherry tomato
title: Easy Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs lean boneless beef chuck | 1 cup cherry tomatoes | 1 package snow peas | 1 cup shredded white cheddar cheese
instructions: Cut the beef into cubes, place in shallow casserole. Pour cherry tomatoes over the meat. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350°f for 1 1/2 hours. Stir the snow peas and tomatoes through the cheddar cheese.

title: Roast Veal, Hamburg Style
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs veal | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef soup | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place veal in roasting pan, fat side up. Sprinkle with soup and with seasoning salt, place on cookie sheet. Bake at 500 degrees for 1 hour. Turn veal, fat side up and bake at least 10 more minutes.

title: Creamy French Toast Crunch
ingredients: 3 3/4 ounces french bread or 3 3/4 ounces baguette | 1 cup fresh cream-style corn, well drained | 2 ounces dried cherries | 1 small cauliflower floret | 2 ounces frozen asparagus | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Put casserole dish in oven and preheat on top of broiler. Remove crusts from bread and cut into bite sized pieces and place in plastic bag and crush with rolling pin. Set aside. Reheat oven to 400°f. Remove bag of bread from bag and discard bread shell from crumbs. Drain liquid from bag. Place drained crumbs in bowl of food processor and process until it appears crumbly. Add drained crumbs, cherries, cauliflower floret, asparagus and coriander to crumb mixture. Process until desired consistency. Grease 9 x 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Pour into baking dish and cool for 15 minutes or until warm, uncovered. Remove pan from oven. Cut into squares and place on serving plates. Serve with fruit juices, if desired.

title: Savoury Criss Cross Pot Au Jus
ingredients: 225 g self-rising flour ( all purpose ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 115 g of plain dried ladyfingers | coriander, washed and dried for garnishing
instructions: Sift the flour and coriander powder into a bowl. Add the ladyfingers and toss for 4 minutes or until the ladyfingers are coated with the flour.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,onion soup mix,ouzo,irish cream,rigatoni pasta,tomato
title: Rigatoni Supper
ingredients: 3 cups rigatoni pasta | 1 large head cauliflower, halved and florets cut into half | 1 can tomatoes, cut-up | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 3/4 cup ouzo, divided | 2/3 cup light cream or 2/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water. In a large skillet, boil 3 cups water. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix rigatoni, cauliflower, tomatoes, soup mix, 2/3 cup ouzo and cream. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 40 to 45 minutes, until pasta is tender. Stir in remaining ouzo. Serve over hot, cooked pasta.

title: Crazy Light Hummus (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1 jar chickpeas ( drained ) | 2 medium plantains ( yellow peeled and sliced into 1/8-inch rounds ) | 2 limes, juice and zest of | 6 tablespoons sprite | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder ( or 2 tbsp dried ground black pepper to your liking ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( uncooked )
instructions: Sautee the plantains, add the lemon juice and then turmeric. Sautée over medium heat until they begin to smell roasted and turn golden brown, approximately 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels and allow to cool. When ready to serve, bring a pot of water to a boil and add 1 tsp salt. Add the pasta and cook according to package directions. In the meantime, combine the chick pea/plantain mixture with the lime zest in a jar and shake until well combined. Plate the rigatoni and ladle a heaping tbsp of the hummus on the top. Sprinkle with more lime zest to taste.

title: Tampa Hot Pistachio Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamari ( i use almond-flavored lite powder, also ) | 1/4 cup chopped pistachio nut, toasted (, see notes ) | 1 -2 drop hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Put tamari in a small bowl & set aside. Over medium heat toast pistachios, stirring frequently, until they turn golden brown. Remove the pistachios from the heat & set aside.
