Crush the pistachios with spatula, & return to the pan. Add hot sauce, to taste, & let simmer for 15 minutes. Cool to room temperature or let mellow for a bit of time before serving. My notes, toasted pistachio nuts, see notes.

title: Baked Polish Sausages
ingredients: 2 polish sausage, 1/2 inch thick | 1/8 cup hidden valley original ranch dressing | cayenne | chopped fresh herb ( your favorite, dill, parsley, chives, dill pickle or chives )
instructions: Preheat oven to grease a large, rimmed baking sheet. Cut the sausage links into 1/2 inch pieces and place on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with dill, parsley, chives or dill pickle or chives. Pour ranch dressing evenly over sausage. Bake uncovered for about 30 minutes. Serve. These are great with a green salad, crusty bread or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: black bean paste,yellow onion,lamb chop,pesto sauce,head cabbage,new potato
title: Lamb with Pesto and New Potato Salad
ingredients: 12 large green tiny new potatoes | 4 lamb chops | 4 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 1/2 cups cooked black bean paste | 2 medium yellow onions, finely chopped | 1/2 head cabbage, separated into leaves | freshly made italian style salad dressing, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the potatoes with the skins on for 20 to 30 minutes, or until tender. Cool slightly, and cut into wedges. Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat, and saute onion until golden brown. Set aside. Slice lamb, and arrange in a hot frying pan over medium heat. Cook for 5 minutes, or until browned. Add pesto, and mix in beans. Cover and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly. Combine cabbage and potato wedges in a large bowl. Add salad dressing, and toss to coat evenly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,peach,pepperjack cheese,red pepper,egg noodle,tabasco sauce,english muffin
title: Quick Peach, Pepperjack, and Egg Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 english muffins, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup chopped pepperjack cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup chopped fresh peach | tabasco sauce to taste | 2 eggs | 1/2 cup chopped canned peaches | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce, or as needed
instructions: Place english muffins cut side up on a baking sheet. Broil until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Top each muffin split with pepperjack cheese, mint leaves, and chopped peach. Spoon a handful of egg onto each muffin half. Sprinkle with tabasco sauce.

Random Ingredients: lima bean,taco seasoning,green onion,hot paprika,ice water,orange zest
title: Garden Refresher  (Refresher Friendly)
ingredients: 10 1/2 ounces frozen lima beans ( drained, no peel ) | 5 -7 ounces taco seasoning ( see all purpose simple taco seasoning mix ) | 1 green onion, finely chopped | 2 -3 drops orange zest ( optional ) | hot paprika or other mild paprika ( optional ) | ice water
instructions: Add the lima beans to a large, resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,sesame seed oil,thyme sprig,puff pastry,sherry wine,juniper berry,garlic,pine nut
title: Sweet Onion Jam Tarts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs puff pastry, thawed if frozen, but not frozen | 1/3 cup pine nuts | 3 tablespoons chopped candied orange blossoms or 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 2 teaspoons poppy, ground, not ground | 6 large garlic, chopped | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon light agave syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame seed oil, heated
instructions: Thaw frozen pastry according to package directions. Heat oven to 425°f spray pastry pans with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350°f to toast pine nuts, in small skillet, over medium low heat 1 minute. Set aside to cool and cool to room temperature. In bowl of standing electric mixer, combine pine nuts, orange blossoms, and thyme. Mix in sherry, poppy, garlic, and warmed honey. With dough hook attached, gradually add to nut mixture. Continue to mix until mixture is sticky and elastic. Divide dough in half. Roll out one half onto a lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness. Using a 3 1/2 inch round cutter, cut out dough from pastry dough. Place remaining dough on ungreased baking sheet, leaving 2 inches of excess dough hanging over edges of pan. Cut out rounds from remaining two thirds of dough using cutter. Roll out remaining dough on lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness. Using 3 1/2 inch rounds, cut out additional circles. Place dough on baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Invert tarts onto a serving plate and keep warm in oven. Serve warm. Cooks note, preparation time does not include puff pastry.

title: Spiral Pine Nut Roll
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( optional but very tasty ) | 1 lb pine nuts, whole or 1 lb almond kernels, chopped | 1 lb phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. In a small bowl add grated ginger or garlic paste, pine nuts, and almonds. Mix well. Cut sheet of phyllo dough in half at a time, and keep layered in a stack. Brush edges with melted butter and roll up lengthwise until one long slice is made, leaving some space for rolling. Repeat with other half of sheets. Arrange them in a 9x13 baking dish. Keep sheets covered with a damp cloth while rolling. Cut rolls crosswise into 2/3 inch pieces, and stack on top of logs. Spread rolls lightly with remaining melted butter during the process. Sprinkle with remaining chopped nuts. Bake 20 - 25 minutes. If baking a smaller dish, you may want to sprinkle top with a little paprika prior to baking.

Random Ingredients: almond,serrano pepper,black cumin seed,cumin powder,maple syrup,lamb,chive
title: Spiced Lamb for Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lamb, with bone, cut into 1-inch cube | 1 cup real maple syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 tablespoon ground dried chives | 1 teaspoon ground ground black cumin seeds | sliced almonds or slivered almonds, lightly toasted, to garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place into a 1 qt saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring. Reduce heat, cover pan and gently simmer for 2 hours to 1 hour and 15 minutes or until thick and falling off center. Set aside. Makes about 1/2 cup.

title: Prawn and Cashew Salad
ingredients: 2 large hard-boiled eggs, shelled and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup cashews, finely chopped | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 2 large red onions, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Best eaten at room temperature.

title: Avocado-Fried Onions in Avocados
ingredients: 1 small avocado, cut into sixths | 1/2 cup sliced onion, preferably white ( optional )
instructions: Cut the avocado into sixths. Slice the onions thinly as thinly as possible. Heat a skillet over medium high heat and add olive oil. Add the sliced onions and lightly fry until they are lightly browned. Add a few dashes of salt.

title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork shoulder | 3 hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice krispies | 1/4 cup salad oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except oil, in large mixing bowl. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead about 5 times, adding more oil, if needed, to form soft dough. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate overnight. Divide chilled dough into 4 equal portions & shape into balls. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Heat oil in large skillet. Sear rolls 3 - 4 minutes until golden on each side. Drain on paper towels.

title: Easy Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the chicken in a baking dish sprayed with cooking spray. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over chicken. Cover baking dish with lid or tin foil and bake for 40 - 45 minutes. Serve with your favorite taco fixings.

Random Ingredients: margarine,mozzarella cheese,italian sausage,pork roast,half,broth,spaghetti sauce,serrano chilies
title: Mexican-Inspired Mexican Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 boneless pork roast | 12 slices mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup broth | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce | 4 -7 serrano chilies, stemmed | 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 1 can ro-tel original diced tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pork roast in a 9x13 inch baking dish and evenly coat with the half and half and spaghetti sauce. Bake pork for 50 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 170 degrees f. Meanwhile, drain pork and discard sauce. Slice the pork thinly against the grain. Drizzle melted margarine over pork slices, drizzle tomatoes with any residual sauce, and arrange slices of pork on a platter. Garnish with the chopped chiles. For tomato and chilies on platter, top with a drizzle of melted margarine.

title: Guacamole Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 cup guacamole ( or other prepared guacamole ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 3/4 cup champagne, chilled | 30 corn tortilla chips or 30 flour tortilla chips
instructions: Combine guacamole and garlic powder in a small bowl. Serve warm with chilled champagne. Enjoy.

title: The McCuddy's Beef and Mac (Beef and Mac)
ingredients: 2 pounds lean top round steak, cut into 1 in cubes | 2 tablespoons dried currants or to taste | 6 large egg yolks | 3/4 cup beer | 2 jars salsa | 1/2 cup fresh-grated fresh parsley, divided | 1 package macaroni | 1 can cranberry juice
instructions: Heat griller to high. Place beef cubes between two sheets of wax paper. Gently pound with a rolling pin until thick. Transfer beef to a large dish. Stir together currants or toasted currants, egg yolks and 1/4 cup beer. Spread mixture evenly over beef. Cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Cook macaroni in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender. Drain and return to pot. Mix together 2 tbsp parsley and remaining beer. Stir into macaroni. Add cranberry juice and remaining 1/4 cups parsley. Toss to mix. Transfer to a platter and serve with remaining parsley.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,chili paste,grand marnier,curry powder,russet potato,beef base
title: Ground Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced diagonally | 2 lbs mixed vegetables, sliced diagonally into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 ounce curry powder | 2 teaspoons beef base | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 3 tablespoons mild chili paste, sriracha
instructions: Place potatoes, vegetables, curry powder, and beef base in a crockpot. Cover and cook on high setting for 5 to 6 hours until potatoes are tender.

title: Toad in the Hole
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry oatmeal | 1 package ziti pasta | 24 cherries or 24 grape-sized, hulled, dried
instructions: Cook the ziti as directed. Drain and rinse with cold water. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the oats, cherries and ½ cup of water. Add the cooked ziti and toss to coat. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden. Garnish with more cherries if desired.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,pesto sauce,basil,burgundy wine,beef broth,vegetable shortening,veal
title: Steak With Basil Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons burgundy wine | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 12 ounces halibut fillets ( about 1/2 inch thick ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ( see above ) | 1/2 cup packed fresh basil, cut into thin strips
instructions: Stir broth, pesto and 1 1/2 cups water in medium skillet. Cook and stir over medium high heat until mixture boils. Remove from heat. Heat shortening in 12 inch heavy skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: corn,tart baking apple,cannellini bean,curry,spaghetti,tamarind paste,rye bread
title: Curried Sweet Corn and Crispy Parsley-Apple Fritters
ingredients: 1 package frozen corn, thawed ( from a can ) | 2 packages crispy taco-size bread | 1 -2 tablespoon tamarind paste | curry ( to taste ) | 1 tart baking apple | 1 can cannellini beans | cooked spanish beans ( optional ) | rye bread
instructions: In a food processor, blend the thawed corn. Add in the rest of dry ingredients, including any masala mixture from the thawed package. Blend until the consistency of bread crumbs. Mold the batter through a pastry tube or fork into 4 patties. Steam the corn fritters for around 5 minutes or just enough to crisp the bread up nicely. Add some spanish beans if you prefer or serve with a side of yoghurt and cream.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,oil,oyster cracker,phyllo pastry,spring onion,beef tenderloin,tomato juice,pumpkin puree
title: Pumpkin Roll (Yogurt With Beef Jerky #5FIX) #5FIX
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 8 ounces beef tenderloin, chopped | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/3 cup pumpkin puree | 2 teaspoons oyster crackers ( finely crushed ) | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry ( thawed ) | 4 spring onions, chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to in a skillet over medium high heat, brown meat with tomato onion soup and oyster crackers. Transfer meat to a baking dish and put aside. Cover top of phyllo with a damp kitchen towel and lay on a foil lined baking sheet. Repeat with other phyllo sheets until there are 4 sheets layered and 5 sheets layered. Top layered phyllo rolls with a phyllo sheet and brush well with oil. Top phyllo rolls with 1 layer of beef, then sprinkle with remaining beef. Then top with pumpkin puree, then spread the spring onions evenly and finish with a layer of pepper jack cheese. Bake at 400°f for 15 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and beef is cooked through.

title: Burgundy Wine Jelly for Jelly
ingredients: 2 cups apple cider vinegar | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, bring vinegar to a boil. Reduce heat to low, stir in egg yolk and keep on stirring until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon. Remove from heat and skim off any browned bits. Cover and refrigerate for up to one week.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin,cremini mushroom,italian flat leaf parsley,apple cider,extra sharp cheddar cheese,fish sauce,saffron strand
title: Moroccan Pumpkin and Macaroon Tartlets
ingredients: 150 g cremini mushrooms | 150 g pumpkin ( firm ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 pinch saffron strand | 1 teaspoon fresh italian flat leaf parsley ( chopped ) | 150 g extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Wash, pat dry and slice mushrooms. Cube pumpkin and cut in 1 cm cubes. Toss in apple cider, fish sauce, saffron and parsley. Stir in pumpkin and cover. Place tartlets into a lightly greased baking dish. Spread mixture evenly to cover. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 180 c for 40 minutes or until puffed. Serve in individual pie bowls with steamed couscous, salad, or as an appetiser.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,curry powder,feta,boston lettuce,pecan half,button mushroom,stock cube
title: Steak Tasty
ingredients: 4 beef round steaks ( or a combo of beef and pork, see note below ) | 1 -2 tablespoon curry powder | 1 -2 stock cube | 4 large button mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup feta, crumbled | 3 heads boston lettuce ( use the whole leaves of both! ) | 3/4 cup toasted pecan halves ( optional ) or 3/4 cup hazelnuts ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle each steak with curry powder. Brown both sides in a pan using a little oil. Set aside. Heat the remainder of oil you cooked the meat in. When oil is very hot, add mushrooms. Saute lightly for about 3 minutes. Remove veggies and add stock cube. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes, or until steaks are nearly done but still juicy and tender. Add feta and stir until well mixed. Return steak and mushrooms to the pan. Cover and simmer 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Radish Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb fresh radish | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 -3 whole pickled corn flakes or 2 -3 pickled chard ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice radish into thin matchstick pieces, then toss in corn syrup and crumbled stock cube. Cover and set aside at room temperature. Drain the hot liquid off the radishes. Arrange on a decorative serving platter. Surround with whole pickled corn flakes or chard leaves.

Random Ingredients: hot chicken broth,white wine vinegar,roquefort cheese,white chocolate,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese 5spice Poached Cheese
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh white chocolate, sliced | hot chicken broth or stock | 3 cups roquefort cheese, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder ( or 2 tsp. each for extra sweetness )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to simmer over medium heat. Break up the white cunks with a spoon. If you notice that melted white cunks to the bottom of the pot, remove them. Simmer until the white chocolate is creamy but not browned. Drain off excess water. Place the roquefort cheese in a microwave safe bowl or serving bowl. Sprinkle the white wine vinegar on top. Microwave on high power for 30 seconds. Stir and repeat microwaving. Stir to combine. Remove from microwave and stir in the 5 spice powder. Pour cooled white chocolate into a clean dry bowl or glass container.

title: Spicy Omelet
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 1 1/2 egg yolks | 2 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add pork.

Random Ingredients: avocado,porridge oat,rustic bread,green chilies,egg substitute,walnut half,oyster sauce,red pepper flake
title: Baby's Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons porridge oats | 1 medium red pepper flakes | 4 tablespoons egg substitute | 8 -12 walnut halves | 1 green chilies | 1 small avocado | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 loaf rustic bread
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Combine oats, red pepper flakes, egg substitute and walnuts. Spread mixture evenly onto bread slices and wrap in aluminum foil. Bake for 1 hour then remove foil. Serve.

title: Swiss Chard Lasagna Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup liquid honey | 3 bunches swiss chard, stems and leaves coarsely chopped | 9 lasagna noodles, uncooked
instructions: Spread 2 tablespoons peanut oil over the bottom of a 9 x 9 x2 inch baking dish with a removable bottom. Heat the honey in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until melted and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add the chard.

title: Peanut and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 16 thick ends off green plantains ( about 3 � pounds ) | 5 lbs of trimmed asparagus | 2 tablespoons honey or 2 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Cut off tips of green plantains and slice int 1/4 inch slices. Arrange on large serving platter. Cut asparagus diagonally in 1 inch pieces and arrange in a layer over the asparagus. Drizzle honey evenly over all and sprinkle liberally with sugar.

title: Tuna-Stuffed Fish
ingredients: 1 tuna ( about 8-10 oz. ) | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds ( optional )
instructions: Remove all of the pulp from the tuna with a wet knife. Take a small plate, put the tuna in the plate, pour the mustard seeds into the fish & sprinkle them over the stuffing. Eat as is, with lots of napkins & bread to soak up the sauce. Note, if you don't have a tuna maker, you can also use a spiralizer or a sharp knife to mash/scoop out the flesh into the bowl. If doing this by hand, try stuffing it with a spoon & mix it thru a sieve or food mill. Serve with plain boiled rice or mash potatoes. These fish can also be cooked without stuffing. Note, if using the seeds, sprinkle them a little on their own when done cooking, it will not get that same bready feel to them.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,beer,mozzarella cheese,bailey irish cream,cherry,head garlic,catsup
title: Cherry and Beer Fondue
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups plain flour | 1 1/2 cups ale or 1 1/2 cups water | 1 cup catsup | 7 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2 cm cubes | 2 ounces baileys irish cream | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cherries | 1 small head of garlic, unpeeled
instructions: To make the base, place the flour, garlic and beer in a mixing bowl. Mix to a crumbly consistency and set aside. Combine the cheeses and baileys with a small wire whisk in a ceramic or glass bowl. Dip the cherries in the flour and add to the cheese mixture, tossing until the cheeses are thoroughly coated. To serve, arrange the crumbed cheeses on a plate, then scatter the cherries over the cheese, and garnish with chopped cherries. Serve with french bbq chips or toast.

title: Greeks Vegetarian Eclairs
ingredients: 4 large apples, such as golden delicious, rome or granny smith, peeled, cored and roughly chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons anise seeds or 2 1 tablespoon whole anise oil | 300 g haricot beans, soaked overnight, drained, and rinsed ( can be canned beans ) | 2 slices lemon zest | 1 can reduced sodena beans, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Toss the apples with 1 1/2 teaspoon each of aniseeds and oil. Spread the haricot beans into a shallow sided 8 inch square baking pan or pie plate. Place the apples on top, then arrange the lemon zest on top. Combine the 3 remaining aniseeds and remaining aniseeds in a small bowl, pour over the top and sides of the apple and haricot beans. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes until slightly caramelized and the apple is soft. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,coriander,pine nut,white mushroom,chunky salsa,serrano pepper
title: Mushroom Salsa With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 8 ounces white mushrooms, quartered & washed | 1 green serrano pepper | 1 yellow pepper | 9 ounces chunky salsa | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander, chopped | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Clean the green & the white mushrooms. Cut the white mushrooms & the serrano peppers into 1 inch pieces. Seed & dice the yellow pepper. Combine the salsa & coriander. Place all of the salsa in a large bowl & stir to combine. Place the mushrooms & peppers on a large piece of foil about 2 inches in diameter & place the mushrooms into the bowl. Place the pine nuts on a plate & toss the mushrooms. Serve warm.

title: Fajita-Rolita Seasoned Flank Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steak ( may use skirt steak ) | salt | ketra essence ( i use `` brandy '' brandy ) | 1/2 teaspoon kewra essence ( optional but adds to the taste ) ( optional ) | soy sauce | lemon peel ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Marinade flank steak in kra essence. Marinate in refrigerator overnight. Grill or broil flank steak to desired doneness & brown.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,scotch bonnet pepper,chicken bouillon cube,salmon
title: Scotch Spiced Salmon on the Rocks
ingredients: 1 boneless chicken bouillon cube | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, finely diced | 1 pound smoked and flavorful pork sausage, sliced | 1/2 pound salmon, skin and flesh removed and cut into chunks
instructions: Place the chicken bouillon cube into a saucepan over medium low heat, and place a wok or skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the scotch bonnet pepper. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 20 seconds, then stir in the sausage. Cook and stir until the sausage is heated through, then pour sauce over the sausage. Transfer the cooked toasted wok to a serving platter, spoon sauce over, and let cool. Eat with scotch bonnet pepper flavored chips. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Smashed Potatoes and Apple Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 medium tomatoes, peeled seeded and finely chopped | 2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 large russet potato, peeled and diced | 4 ounces canned chilies, rinsed, drained well, chopped | 3 medium chilies, sliced, with seeds, for garnish
instructions: In a bowl, mix mayo with tomatoes. Add potatoes, chilies and chilies. Cover and refrigerate 12 hours to overnight. Stir potato mixture, remove from refrigerator 15 minute prior to serving. Garnish with chilies.

title: Sauerkraut and Cardamom in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 gallon sauerkraut | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom
instructions: Place sauerkraut in pressure cooker. Fill pressure can with water. Close lid and bring to high pressure. When steam has built, turn down heat to medium. Cook 5 minutes. Remove lid and release pressure. Let stand for 10 seconds. Take out from pressure cooker. Remove sauerkraut and cardamom. Serve with pumpernickel sandwich or rye bread. For a crisper bread, toast or toast bread crumbs. If desired, toast seeds lightly. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,red onion,lao powder,madeira wine,baking soda,demerara sugar,green lentil,limeade concentrate
title: Lentil Salad With Madeira Sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb green lentil, rinse | 9 ounces beet, raw, trimmed and diced | 1 large red onion, finely diced | 1 ounce madeira wine | 6 ounces aubergines, small diced | 2 tablespoons limeade concentrate | 1/2 teaspoon ground lea powder ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons demerara sugar ( optional )
instructions: Prepare, wash and rinse lentils in a large pot of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes then drain. Place the lentils and beet into a food processor or blender. Add onion, madeira, aubergines, limeade concentrate and demerara sugar then process to a smooth paste. Dressing, combine all ingredients together in a jar or large storage container. Keep refrigerated until ready to use, this will mellow the dressing. Toss salad with dressing and serve.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,balsamic vinegar,pasta,quinoa,guacamole,puff pastry
title: Quinoa Wrapped Pasta
ingredients: 1 package cooked quinoa | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 20 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place quinoa in a large bowl. Bring 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar to a boil in a medium saucepan. Remove from heat and set aside to cool until warm. Place puff pastry sheets on a baking sheet and spread each sheet evenly with 1/4 cup of guacamole. Bake pizza in the preheated oven until crisp, 5 to 7 minutes. Using a kitchen brush, brush remaining 1/4 cup of guacamole on each puff pastry sheet. Slice each sheet in half widthwise and stuff with quinoa filling.

title: Dilled Avocado Spread With Sour Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese ( room temperature ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 3 tablespoons dill | 1/2 cup kalamata olive ( or other mild green condiment ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Dough, in small bowl, combine cream cheese and sour cream and beat with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,cheddar cheese,rice vinegar,basmati rice,bread crumb
title: Creamy Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons seasoned bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided | 1 1/2 cups prepared basmati rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix chicken soup, bread crumbs, rice vinegar, cheese, and rice. Roll dough in rice, and place on a baking sheet. Make the balls a few at a time, and place on the baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.

title: Shredded Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 3 ounces canned diced green chilies, drained and rinsed | 1 lb leftover beef chuck roast, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1 can cut-up mixed vegetables | 1 1/2 cups shredded cooked carrots | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dark rum ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat shredded beef over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until heated through. Combine salad dressing ingredients in large mixing bowl and mix well with wire wisk. Add cooked beef and the mayonnaise. Stir until salad dressing is well mixed. Toss with the mixed vegetables. Use a wooden spoon to spread the dressing over the meat mixture while serving.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,chimayo chili powder,liquid smoke,lemongrass,thyme sprig
title: Homemade Beef Jerky
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs ( or 1 tablespoon dried ) | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon hot italian dressing | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: If beef is fatty, cut into chunks, or cut in pieces cut into small chunks. Make 3 batches using 1/2 1/2 cup of meat for each batch. Place meat and remaining ingredients in crock pot and turn on high setting for at least 1 hour or longer. Lemongrass is optional and can be omitted or used as a garnish for other dishes.

title: Cocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce kahlua | 1 teaspoon dried chervil or 1 teaspoon tarragon | 9 tablespoons fresh dill pickles, minced | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheeses in a cocktail shaker and shake very well. Add cheeses and stir well, then strain into another cocktail shaker. Chill until time to serve.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,extra beef,heavy whipping cream,white balsamic vinegar,caper
title: Creamy Balsamic Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs extra lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: Break up the beef with your hands and gently mix with the vinegar, capers, and whipped cream. Add the food coloring and continue to mix until all the ingredients are incorporated. This will take 10 - 15 minutes. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Use at room temperature.

title: Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 3 ounces spaghetti
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti as directed on package. Meanwhile, cut beef in small pieces with a heavy cleaver. Brown the meat in frying pan. Strain beef drippings. Add the spaghetti to the pot and cook until it is hot. Put meat mixture and spaghetti in spaghetti kettle and serve as topping.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,pinto bean,olive oil,vegetable oil cooking spray,bulgur,sauce,brown rice,pimiento
title: Quick Brown Rice Pilaf With Pinto Beans, Cranberries & Pimento
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 3 cups pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( use canola or olive ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil ( use canola or olive ) | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento, green | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce ( i prefer frank's ) | 1 cup dried cranberries | 2 1/2 cups cooked bulgur ( cracked wheat or wild rice works ) | olive oil cooking spray
instructions: Pinto beans & cranberries,. If using berries and not cranberries, rinse and drain them. You may need to add a splash of olive oil when rinsing and draining the beans and cranberries. You will be using them in the dish later so just be prepared for the seasonings and other ingredients. Sauce for pilaf,. Saute rice in oil in a dutch oven over medium high heat until lightly golden on both sides. Add peppers, pimentos & hot sauce.

title: Rice Balls Using Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups carnarola rice | 1 loaf sourdough bread
instructions: Boil water. Let risotto cool. Break bread into small pieces. Cut into 2 inch chunks. Remove skin, but leave 2 1/2 inch of the crust. Roll out dough evenly to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut a small hole in the top of dough with a sharp knife. Dip dough pieces in chilled water, then gently press into bread. Heat a small non stick skillet over medium heat. Drop in rusotto and fry until it begins to float. Add 2 1/2 cups water to the pan. Cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender. Turn off heat, uncover, top with sourdough crumbs and serve.

title: Salsa De Arroz
ingredients: 2 anaheim chilies ( california chilies may be substitued ) | 2 leaves romaine lettuce | 1 small white onion ( approximately 1/4-1/2 cup chopped and sauteed in oil ) | 1 pinch ground coriander
instructions: Place chiles over a flame or two of a gas burner on a medium high flame. Remove from flame and place on paper towels to drain some of the water. Wash romaine lettuce and remove as much of the dark purple flesh as possible. Set aside approximately 1/4 cup of the liquid from the chiles and place them in a medium bowl. Using the same small bowl, add the onion and onion into the same small bowl. Place the lettuce mixture into the bowl with the onion and onion. Pour the reserved liquid over the salad. Allow to sit covered until ready to serve.

title: Amaraschino Blintzer
ingredients: 1 teaspoon herbal cheese blend ( such as arabic, dolcelatte or licorice ) | 2 teaspoons irish cream, preferably dutch-process, see note
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a glass, metal or plastic bowl or other container that has a tight fitting lid. Cover with a cloth or plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least two hours or overnight. Lasts for up to six hours, refrigerating at least 8 hours. Note, arabic is a herbed cheese that comes in a jar with olive oil and herbs.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,ladyfinger,green chili salsa,cooking oil,hot pepper,pasta
title: Quick Green Chili Macaroni
ingredients: 100 g soft pasta, such as ditalini | 1/4 cup finely chopped green chili pepper | 1 tablespoon of chopped hot pepper | 100 g green chili salsa, with herbs | 500 g ladyfingers, finger size, left whole or 8 ladyfingers, cut into four pieces | cooking oil
instructions: Place the pasta in a large pan of boiling, salted water and cook for 10 minutes, or according to packet instructions. While the pasta is cooking, make the sauce. In a frying pan, add the cooking oil and fry the green chilies for one minute or until softened. Add the hot pepper and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or until softened. Add the green chili salsa and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes, or until warmed through.

title: Vermicelli Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces vermicelli ( dried vermicelli ) | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1 1/8 cups green peppers, chopped
instructions: Place vermicelli in a 3 quart pan. Pour cream of mushroom soup over noodles and cover with water, bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered 1 hour.

title: Creamy Poblano Chile Strips
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles, seeded and sliced | 1 can vegetable broth, chilled | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Coarsely chop poblano chiles. Microwave broth, poblano peppers and almonds in a medium mixing bowl at high, about 2 minutes, stirring, until warm and just hot. Stir in chile mixture. Cool and refrigerate 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.

title: Hot Chocolate Broccoli With Carrots in Caramel
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 cup grated carrot | 4 bittersweet chocolate squares, cut into squares
instructions: Place broccoli, carrots and chocolate together in a large saucepan. Melt until smooth. Stir over low heat until chocolate melts, about 1 minute, stirring constantly. Serve immediately.

title: Aubergine and Macadamia Soup
ingredients: 2 aubergines | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can unsalted macadamia nuts, chopped
instructions: Peel and deseed the aubergines and cut into cubes or chunks. In a large soup pot, fry the aubergines in a little butter on all sides until golden. Then stir in the soup. When it looks like it’s bubbling up, stir in the nuts. Let it simmer on low heat until the soup has thickened and some of the nuts have stuck to the sides.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,lamb shoulder,candy sprinkle,black olive,floury potato,water artichoke heart,peanut,oat
title: Lamb and Artichoke Risotto
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups cold water-packed sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 1/4 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3 1/2 ounces floury potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 3 1/2 ounces water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/3 cup sliced black olives | 1/3 cup old fashioned oats | butter-flavored candy sprinkles ( optional ) | rinsed roasted peanuts
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the sun dried tomatoes with 1 cup cold water. Set aside until the water is absorbed. Meanwhile, toss the lamb with 2 teaspoons salt in a large, heavy frying pan over medium high heat until evenly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove lamb to a bowl. Add the potatoes and artichokes to the frying pan and toss to coat with the sun dried tomato water.

title: Green Olives Filling (Zwt II)
ingredients: 2 bunches green olives ( approximately 1 1/2 kgs, approximately 3.5 kgs ) | 1 brown onion, peeled ( about 4 medium onions, peeled ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Dry fry onions until golden brown in vegetable oil, leaving the excess oil behind. Cut the olives into pieces 1 - 3 cm in size. Remove the skin from the olives with your fingers and mix them with the sliced onions. Dry all the ingredients in an electric blender, blend well. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: fruit,dill seed,fish fillet,basil leaf,white wine vinegar,red enchilada sauce
title: Fish Enchiladas with Dilled Basil
ingredients: 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 3/4 cups canned red enchilada sauce | 2 cups diced fish fillets, about 1 1/2 pounds | 3 tablespoons dried dill seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried whole dill seed
instructions: Combine vinegar and basil in medium skillet. Heat just until warm. Drain and stir in enchilada sauce.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,red potato,grand marnier,salt pepper,saffron,hot sauce,pepperoncini pepper,rye bread
title: Spanish Grilled Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs small red potatoes, about 2 inches in diameter | 2 cups thinly sliced pepperoncini peppers | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | hot sauce | freshly cracked pepperoncini pepper
instructions: Preheat grill. Cut potatoes through the cut in quarters lengthwise. Slice peppers lengthwise, remove stems and seeds.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,popped popcorn,white vinegar,italian tomato,pork loin roast
title: Italian Pork and Potions With Crushed Peppers
ingredients: 3/4 cup corn flakes | 3/4 cup popped popcorn | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs pork loin roast ( boneless ) | 2 teaspoons italian-style crushed tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Pour corn flakes evenly on a sheet of foil. Using scissors, tear pork into thin slices. Place pork slices on corn flakes. In a shallow baking dish, combine popcorn, vinegar and crushed tomatoes. Roast pork, uncovered, 25 minutes. Turn and roast. Continue to cook for 20 minutes, or until internal temperature of pork reaches 145f with a fork. Transfer pork to a serving platter or cutting board.

title: Breaded Fingers With Pancetta
ingredients: 8 slices pancetta | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bread crumbs | 4 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves | 2 tablespoons fresh basil | 4 tablespoons orange flower water | 1 1/2 cups dried french breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons dried parsley leaves | 2 tablespoons currants | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Lay 5 slices of pancetta on a piece of wax paper and sprinkle with 1/4 cup of bread crumbs. Using your hands, roll the pancetta around the pancetta, jelly roll fashion, until the pancetta has moistened completely. Repeat with the next 5 slices. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, basil and orange flower water and roll up the pieces tightly from the wax paper. Arrange the rolls on a baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 375°f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll each roll into a long, thin cylinder about 9 inches in diameter. Use your hands to flatten the rolls slightly. Place them on the parchment paper. Bake 10 minutes in the oven, or until crisp. Meanwhile, combine 2 tablespoons parsley, 2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs, 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, currants and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Stir well to blend. Remove the rolls from the oven. Place on a tray and sprinkle with the reserved 1/4 teaspoon parsley mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Tomato Stoup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon diced garlic powder | 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese | 1 1/2 lbs plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium saucepan and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,farfalle pasta,liquid smoke,cardamom,allspice,dark cherry,cottage cheese
title: Gourmet Spiced Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb hot cooked farfalle pasta | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 can dark sweet candied cherries ( with juice )
instructions: Drain the cooked pasta. In a large saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add allspice, cottage cheese and cardamom. Cook and stir for 5 minutes. Gradually add the shredded cheese. Pour about 3/4 cup of the sauce over pasta and mix well. Cover with an oven proof griddle, placing it in a preheated 450f oven about 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,salsa,grand marnier,nonfat cream,sharp cheddar cheese,anaheim chilies,french ladyfinger cooky
title: Mexican Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 2 medium large fresh anaheim chilies, roasted, peeled, seeded, cut lengthwise into halves ( fresh or canned ) | 1 package frozen french-style ladyfinger cookies, cut up ( 3 tablespoons ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded nonfat sharp cheddar cheese ( we like a mild mexican blend but you can use whatever your favourite is ) | 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 3 tablespoons of your favorite salsa | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f or 218°c. In a 9 inch square baking dish, mix together the peppers and frozen cookies. Top with 1/4 cup of the cheese, reserving 1/2 cup for topping later. In another pie pan over medium heat melt the remaining cheese and sour cream. Remove from heat and stir in the 2 t. Sour cream, grand marnier, the remaining peppers and biscuits, and remaining sour cream. Top with the remaining cheese, and carefully top with remaining chopped peppers and chips. Bake for 5 minutes. Transfer to serving platter and enjoy with your favorite mexican foods.

title: Italian Sausage Spread
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 3 tablespoons mild syrup | 3 tablespoons cacao, brown sugar
instructions: Melt the sugar in the microwave for 1 minute and place in a plastic bag, add italian sausage, and shake to mix. Let it cool, then crumble when completely smooth. Add the sweet syrup and cacao, mix thoroughly. Add more sugar if needed to coat the sausage evenly, then let it rest for an hour or two before serving over your favorite pasta and vegetables for a savoury variation.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,salt pepper,meat tenderizer,zucchini lengthwise,banana,icing sugar,tart apple
title: Tenderloins with Apple and Zucchini
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons meat tenderizer | 2 teaspoons salt & pepper | 2 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise | 2 large baking apples, such as fuji or fuji | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 4 large free-range egg-free bananas, peeled and sliced lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly grease a 12 x 8 inch x 2 1/2 inch baking dish with vegetable oil. Cut tenderloins lengthwise diagnally into 5 slices. Dry on paper towel.

title: Baked  Rigatoni stuffed with Ham, Pears and Pricks
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked until just al dente | 1 lb smoked ham, smoked or 1 lb prosciutto, very lean, very lean but not overdone ( or more ) | 12 pitted prickly pears, sliced ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons olive, preferably freshly-chopped | 1/2 cup guacamole, homemade or store-bought
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Grease baking sheets with cooking oil. In a bowl, mix together all of the cooked prwns. In a saucepan, heat the olive oil over moderately low heat. Add the onions, and sauté over medium heat until golden, about 10 minutes. Add the cheese, and stir to coat the pieces with the olive oil. Increase the heat to moderately high and bring the mixture to a simmer. Boil the mixture until it is reduced to a thick, well textured sauce, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. When pasta is cool enough to handle, break into half inch sized pieces, then toss them in a large bowl. Add the cooked prwns and their sauce, guacamole, and cooked prwns to the pasta and toss. Transfer the pasta to a baking sheet, generously sprinkle with more cheese, and bake until the top is golden brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Cafe Supper
ingredients: 1 1/8 ounces soya sauce | 1 teaspoon instant coffee beans | 1/8 teaspoon wasabi | crouton ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve with cafe suppers.

title: Quick and Easy Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can broccoli
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together soup and broccoli. Pour over the cooked pasta and stir to warm through.

title: Curing Apple & Peaches
ingredients: 1 small baking apple, halved | 2 pints canned sliced peach slices, well drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground curing salt
instructions: Place apple in a food processor fitted with 3/8 inch disk. Add remaining ingredients, and process until well mixed. Pour into a shallow non metallic dish or bowl coated with cooking spray. Coat an entire or two large cans of peaches with this mixture.

title: Bahama Mama Daffeeya
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks ( drained ) | 2 bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons bean curd ( soaked overnight ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender or food processor. Stir until smooth.

title: Real Polish Sausages With Tangerine Applesauce
ingredients: 2 lbs polish sausage, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 lb kielbasa, sliced | 1 bottle tangerine ( or juice ) | 1 tablespoon cooking wine | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 2 garlic cloves | 1/2 cup sour cream ( sherry or any kind of sour cream ) | grated cheese
instructions: Put everything in the crockpot on low heat and cook on high for 5 hours. Serve over hot cooked macaroni and potatoes. Garnish with grated cheese if desired.

title: Watermelon Rind
ingredients: 3 cups watermelon rind, pith removed and sliced thin | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Line a large colander with cheese cloth and place over a sink. Place the rind in the colander and press down until the water is almost all absorbed. Sprinkle the marjoram over the rind and cover tightly. Place in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours, until almost ripe. Remove the cheese cloth and cut into 1 inch cubes. Rice water should wash away any remaining moisture from the rind. Rice water should be clear on the outside and the inside liquid should be clear at the end of the hour of preparation.

title: Mexican Fry Bread Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dried chile ( i use serrano ) | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt or 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Whisk together the first seven ingredients and let sit for 5 minutes. Cut into wedge sized pieces and set aside. Stir fry the wedges in olive oil in a large skillet just until the edges are browned and crisp. Set on paper towels to drain excess liquid. Note, you could also do this on a baking sheet in a 375°f oven.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,seasoning,bay leaf,cooking spray,cream chicken soup,salmon
title: Smoked Salmon Orzo
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package uncooked orzo pasta | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 3/4 cup chopped smoked salmon, or more to taste | 1 bay leaf, or as needed | 2 teaspoons seasoning
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Cook the orzo pasta and its cooking water, seasoning packet, and salmon in a saucepan in the preheated grill, cooking until the soup is warm, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,yellow squash,lovage,honey,rice wine,plain yogurt
title: Lavender Squash With Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 yellow squash ( halved, seeded, cut into 1-inch cubes or wedges ) | 1/2 cup bottled italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 teaspoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon lovage | 2 tablespoons fresh lovage, chopped ( can substitute chopped parsley )
instructions: Place all ingredients except lovage in a blender, and blend until smooth. Pour into a serving dish and top with lovage. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours before serving so the flavors can blend.

title: Mustard Butter
ingredients: 16 ounces shortening | 1/3 cup coarse grain mustard
instructions: Use your favourite shortening. I prefer the flavor of butter in this recipe, so i use a good quality shortening such as Crisco or lard. Stir in the mustard. I like to use a mixture of coarse mustard, and white toffee. This mixture will make quite a bit too crumbly. It will not spread well and you will need to be able to roll it together. Shape into a log, wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 24 hours. Slice into 1/8 thick slices and store in an airtight container.

title: Prawns & Green Onions
ingredients: 12 prawns ( raw ) | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped ( including white and green parts ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix
instructions: Boil the prawns for about 2 minutes, or until they are just pink and cooked through. Drain and set aside, then slice prawns lengthwise into rings. Set aside. Heat up taco seasoning mix in a small saucepan. Add onions and saute until translucent. Return prawns to pan. Add enough water to cover prawns. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes or until prawns are cooked. Serve immediately with warm tortillas for a great meal.

Random Ingredients: clove,spinach,star anise,snow pea,cocoa,cilantro stem,asiago cheese,yellow onion
title: Soup Au Poivre
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow onion ( minced, 4 oz. ) | 2 ounces fresh spinach ( packed in net leaves ) | 20 fresh cilantro stems | 10 fresh spinach leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons sifted cocoa | 1 star anise | 1 dash ground cloves | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Place onions and cilantro into a food processor and pulse about 10 times until chopped. Add 1/2 cup water to blender and pulse with asiago, cloves, 1 tbsp cocoa, and rest of ingredients. Continue pulsing until mixture is creamy. Pour soup into a bowl and garnish topped with remaining 1/2 cup cocoa. Serve with crusty french bread, noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,crescent dinner,almond extract,coriander,cooking oil,orange marmalade,french bread,taco seasoning
title: Crispy Orange Taco Bread Wedges
ingredients: 4 large floured cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can refrigerated orange marmalade | 1 tablespoon dried coriander | 1 tablespoon ground almonds, toasted | cooking oil | 1/4 cup thawed reduced fat swiss whole wheat flour or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | cooking oil, for brushing on bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the first seven ingredients. Spoon half the mixture into the middle of each crust. Using a 2 1/2 inch round biscuit cutter or drinking glass with straight edges, make 12 wedges. Pat wedges into 2 inch x 1 inch wide cereal squares. Dust cereal squares with flour. Place wedges on a lightly oiled cookie sheet. Brush wedges with cooking oil. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with maple syrup or fruit flavored preserves.

title: Homemade Buttermilk Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine buttermilk and vinegar. Stir to blend.

title: Maple Butter
ingredients: 4 cups pure maple syrup | 1/2 cup paprika
instructions: You'll have to purchase the french maple syrup. I know the store uses maple syrup, but i just looked at one of the directions on the label. You can use a combination of maple syrup and maple butter. I use about 1/2 cup per pound of butter. It has just come to blend. Add the paprika.

title: Fried Fried Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 5 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Take out all of your chicken and cut along the bone or tenders and discard. Use your fingers to pound off the pieces or shred them into bite sized pieces. Set aside. Deep fry in a hot pan or wok approximately 20 - 30 seconds on each side. Do not overcook. When done drain on paper towel and cut into bite sized pieces. Re fry in oil approximately 20 - 30 seconds or until desired thickness. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red pepper sauce,cumin powder,asparagus,ghee butter,garlic,red chili pepper,hunt tomato sauce
title: Roasted Soba With Chili Sauce
ingredients: 500 g asparagus, trimmed | 3 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons red chili peppers, roasted diced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) | 3 tablespoons hunts tomato sauce or 3 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Roast all the ingredients except for the asparagus in a 400 degree oven for 35 40minutes on a greased baking sheet. Once baked, add the asparagus to the oven. Roast for 15 minutes in the oven. Add the sauce and allow the to rest for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Herbes De Provence(Herbes De Provence)
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried thyme | 2 lemons
instructions: Combine the lemon juice, thyme and freshly ground black pepper. If the lemon juice has already completely blended with the other ingredients you might need to add a little more of the lemon juice. Store in a screw top jar in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

title: Italian Sausage and Lentils Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 3 cups vegetable slices, green parts included | 1/4 cup lentils, frozen and uncooked | 1 cup italian seasoning, divided | 2 cups scallions, cleaned, minced | 1 cup celery, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove sausage from casings, break into chunks and brown with 1/4 cup of the Italian seasoning. Set aside and keep warm. Add remaining seasoning and scallions to sausage and cook until scallion is translucent. Combine lentils with sausage and lentil onion mixture and toss. Arrange sausage mixture in an 8 x 8 casserole dish. Top with reserved sausage mixture and drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup of the italian seasoning. Cover and bake for 70 - 80 minutes. Garnish with cheese and breadcrumb if desired.

title: Rice Cooker-Electric Pressure Cooker Arrabiate
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons old bay seasoning | 3 cups arborio rice ( about 1/2 pound )
instructions: Add contents of old bay seasoning packet to rice cooker. Select pressure cooker and set timer for 45 minutes. Let pressure build up to pressure then turn off heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Remove from cooker. Pressure can be regulated into the rice cooker according to your pressure cooker's manufacturer's instructions.

Random Ingredients: fruit,iceberg lettuce,quince,mozzarella cheese,lime juice zest,cumin powder
title: Maggie's Big Ed's Quince Melts
ingredients: 2 large ripe fruit, sliced in thin rounds | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 cup quince, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed tomatoes packed in adobo sauce | 8 tablespoons shredded mozzarella cheese | 4 cups iceberg lettuce ( or lettuce of your choice )
instructions: Seed & slice the fruit in thin slices.

title: Pimiento Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon maple syrup | 3 tablespoons diced pimiento | 2 2 lbs chicken cutlets or 2 lbs pork cutlets
instructions: Mix the vinegar, maple syrup and pimientos in a shallow dish. Toss the pimento and pork with the marinated fruit and thread onto skewers. Grill, covered, over medium heat or broil 5 - 7 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,macadamia nut,chocolate,chicken,grain white rice,peanut oil
title: Tortilla Chip Chip Macadamia Nut Rice Bowls
ingredients: 5 ounces medium macadamia nuts, lightly salted, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup long grain white rice | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 package of grated mild unsweetened chocolate | 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly coat a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. In a bowl, mix macadamia nuts and rice. Mix in 1/2 cup peanut oil and 1/2 package of grated chocolate. Add chicken and mix well with hands to incorporate. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. Dip a large spoonful of the rice mixture into the remaining peanut oil. Drain off excess oil. Fill bowl with rice mixture, pressing the rice mixture with your hands to shape the rice into a bowl shape, approximately 2 1/2 thick. Using your hands, press the rice mixture against the rice mixture until all the rice has been pressed. Repeat with remaining rice mixture and peanut oil. Place rice bowls on a large baking sheet. Make sure you are using enough baking pans so that you can place into a larger baking dish and not spill the fragrance of the chips and nuts. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until cooked. Let cool slightly and turn out onto a serving plate.

title: Smoky Caviar (Grilled)
ingredients: 8 slices cauliflower or 8 slices other small florets | 2/3 cup coarse grain mustard | 2/3 cup black olives or 2/3 cup other brine-cured black olives, drained ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons kosher salt, more to season
instructions: Prepare your gas grill, set a rack 4 inches below the heating element and heat to high heat. If using cauliflower, cut into small florets. Combine the mustard in a small bowl with the olives and salt. Brush the cauliflower with the mustard mixture and transfer to a shallow dish. Grill the cauliflower for about 10 minutes, turning once or twice, or until opaque and barely tender.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,hoisin sauce,lime juice,italian breadcrumb,pearl onion,italian seasoning,vanilla extract
title: Quick Oven Roasted Pearl Onions
ingredients: 4 medium pearl onions | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1 tablespoon low-sodium taco sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450 degrees f. Place onions into a small baking dish, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, and coat with taco sauce. Roast for 45 minutes to 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until tender and lightly crisp. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together taco sauce, taco sauce, vanilla, and seasoning. Stir in lime juice, and cool slightly. Pour onions into serving bowls, and serve.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,baby spinach,ro tel tomato,worcestershire sauce
title: Simple and Tangy Roast Veggies
ingredients: 500 g baby spinach | 1 tablespoon unrefined worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Line a baking tray with cooking paper. Spray with olive oil spray. Combine the worcestershire sauce with the xanthan gum, add in the Baby Spinach, toss to coat. Divide spinach mix onto the tray and bake until puffy. Serve.

title: Quick Breakfast Wraps or Burritos
ingredients: 3 cups cooked escarole | saffron | 3 cups halved cherry tomatoes | 1 glass grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon flour tortilla | chopped nuts ( optional )
instructions: Prepare ingredients accordingly. Wrap tortillas and nuts with foil. Seal and heat on stove till warm thru, add vegetables and stir once.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,grape tomato,soy sauce,sesame seed,white,nonfat plain yogurt,cooking barley,head cauliflower
title: Barley and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 pints grape tomatoes or 2 pints cherry tomatoes, halved | 2/3 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | cooking barley, to serve
instructions: Place the barley, cauliflower and tomatoes on a plate. Mix the yogurt, vanilla, sesame seeds and soy sauce together in a bowl and spoon over the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,potato starch,thai fish sauce,active yeast
title: Thai Fish Focaccia, #6,
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 2 cups simply potatoes sticks sweet potato spices | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: In large glass mixing bowl combine yeast, 2 cups sweet potato starch and maple syrup. Stir, cover and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes, until it has dissolved. Add fish sauce and mix well. Turn dough onto floured surface and divide into 10 round sized circles that are 1 - 2 inches in diameter. Place on greased baking sheets, brush with more maple syrup. Let rise for 40 - 45 minutes, depending on your oven. When you pull the dough out of the oven, brush again with more olive tapenade. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Remove dough from the pan and spread about 1 1/2 teaspoon of olive tapenade all over. Place a piece of plastic wrap on top, cover with a dish towel, and return pan to oven. Bake at 500° for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven and allow to cool for about 10 minutes before attempting to slice and serving. I enjoy a slice of thai traditional garlic toast. Serve warm.
