title: Sweet Potato & Pine Nut Stuffed Pizza
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, halved lengthways and thickly sliced | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped toasted pine nuts ( or raisins ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, seeds or 2 tablespoons toasted coconut seeds | 1 pizza crust ( i used boboli ) | 2 sheets phyllo dough ( i had to brush them with a little olive oil ) | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350°f. Grease a 20cm x 14cm baking tin with oil. Spoon the sweet potato slices onto a large plate. Place them flat on the plate and cover with a damp tea towel. Place in fridge for 2 hours to soak up the water. Using a large, sharp knife, cut out the centre of each pizza shell, leaving a 1 cm thick shell. Carefully transfer the shells to the floured tin, trimming any excess dough. Place 1/4 cup of the nuts, pine kernels and cumin seeds in a food processor, add 4 tablespoons water and process until coarse, adding extra water if the mixture is too dry.. Spoon half the nut mixture into each pizza shell, sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of the cumin, then top with another spoonful of the nut mixture and drizzle with some of the cooking oil. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly golden underneath and heated through. Allow 5 to 10 minutes for tender and 10 to 10 minutes for well cooked.

title: Sweet Glazed Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon red chile powder
instructions: Slice kielbasa into 1/2 inch length. Lay on end, and fold them over slightly. In a small bowl, mix together hoisin sauce, red chile powder, and white sugar. Brush glaze on the kielbasa, and sprinkle with the red chile powder. Place in a 9x9 inch casserole dish. Bake at 325 degrees f for 50 minutes.

title: Chicken 'n Ham
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 beef brisket, cut into large serving pieces | 8 chicken breast fillets | 4 slices ham
instructions: Preheat the grill. Coat the eggplant with cooking spray and then lightly brush with oil. Grill the eggplant until lightly browned, about 6 - 8 minutes. While the eggplant is grilling, place the brisket in a large plate. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. In a medium size frying pan, saute the chicken breasts about 5 minutes on medium high heat, removing the chicken once it is cooked through. Remove the chicken and set aside on a plate. Reduce the heat under the pan.

title: Thai Noodles (Piri Nuea)
ingredients: 500 g green peppers, sliced | 4 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons fish sauce
instructions: Slice the green peppers into long, thin strips, the peel the pepper skins, and remove the tough outer layer. In a small bowl, combine the sugar, fish sauce, and vegetables, and toss to coat well with the sugar mixture. Cook in boiling water for 3 minutes or until tender.

title: Baked Chicken & Sauerkraut.
ingredients: 4 chicken wings, tips only | 8 slices genoa salami ( thin slices of salami ) | 2 bags sauerkraut, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a large baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Arrange the chicken wings in a single layer to fit the sheet. Top with the salami slices and top with the kraut. Cover with more foil or parchment and seal. Bake for 1 hour, then remove foil or parchment and bake for an additional 20 minutes. Remove from oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,red pepper flake,tamari,marinara sauce,nonfat cream,bulgur wheat,mint,white onion
title: Tuscan Bulgur Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 -2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( if you use piquin peppers instead of piquin peppers use a teaspoon ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped white onion | 8 ounces nonfat sour cream or 8 ounces low fat sour cream | 1 tablespoon tamari ( see notes ) | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1 cup marinara sauce or 1 cup homemade marinara sauce, for dipping
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine the barley, piquins, onion, sour cream and tamari. Stir to blend well. Add the dried herbs and mix well. Pour the marinara sauce into a small pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, cover the pot and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, until all marinara is absorbed. Remove from heat and leave covered for an additional 5 minutes to let water absorb into the barley. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,whipping cream,chunky salsa,red cherry,turmeric powder,mint,cotija cheese,ice
title: Anchovy Salsa - Tapas
ingredients: 1 quart whipping cream | 1 cup chunky salsa, de arbol | 1/3 cup cotija cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | red candied cherry, to garnish ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, finely chopped | ice
instructions: Whip the cream with a pinch of salt until it forms stiff peaks. In a small bowl, mix together the 1/2 cup chunky salsa, the 1/3 cup cheese, the anchovy paste, and the turmeric. In a small, decorative crystal bowl, put a cherry, a few slices of red cherries, and a teaspoon of mint. Pour the cream mixture into the bowl, and swirl. Pour the cheese mixture onto a serving dish, and garnish with the remaining cherries and mint. Serve immediately.

title: Mielie's Queso
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese | homemade meat
instructions: Heat pan over medium, add the mexican cheese. Add enough heated oil to cover cheese and meat evenly. Stir until smooth. Serve warm over refried beans and rice.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,red onion,white mushroom,chickpea,salt pepper,mozzarella cheese,parmesan cheese
title: Beef and Chickpea Bake
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, sliced thin | salt and pepper | 2 cans chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1 cup white mushroom, sliced | 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray 9x9 inch x 2 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. Slice beef into thin strips, sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper. Place chicken, chickpeas and onion in a dutch oven or other large shallow baking dish. Stir chickpeas, wine and 1/2 cup of the mozzarella cheese together. Top with beef and beef mixture. Using two slotted spoon, top with remaining mozzarella and drizzle with remaining drizzle. Cover pan with foil. Bake until meat is tender, about ½ hour. Remove foil and bake a further 10 minutes until cheese is bubbly. Serve with mashed potato and salad.

title: Pasta With Green Chili Peppers
ingredients: 3 large green chilies, roasted peeled, seeded & veins reserved | 1/2 lb linguine, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Cut chilies into chunks about 1/2 inch thick crosswise. Arrange chilies on a baking sheet lined with foil, bake at 350º for 3 - 5 minutes or until heated through. Transfer chilies to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, microwave on high for 20 - 30 seconds or until heated through. Place chilies in a blender jar and process until finely ground. Remove from blender, season with kosher salt. To serve, place cooked pasta on individual serving plates & top with chilies, drizzling sauce over pasta. Serve with additional sauce if desired.

title: Crispy Herb-Spoon Bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup hot tap water | 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 1 loaf pasta
instructions: Combine hot tap water with yeast. Let stand 10 minutes. Stir in mayonnaise. Place 1 loaf of dry bread on cookie sheet.

title: Mint Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut extract | 10 fresh mint leaves, roughly chopped
instructions: Put the mint leaves along with 1/2 cup of the coconut extract in a food processor and process them into a small, creamy paste or mash them with a fork.

title: The Easy Microwave Fix
ingredients: 1 cup shredded lettuce, mixed | suet or sultana, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Put the shredded leaves in a microwave safe cup or bowl. Microwave on high for 2 minutes and stir, then microwave on medium for another 30 seconds or so, to dry out any water. Cool, then spread in your favourite way. Garnish with remaining shredded lettuce or sultanas.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,sirloin steak,white vinegar,broccoli,seasoning,rice vinegar,onion salt
title: Broccoli Steak With Peanut Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon seasoning ( of your choice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 1/3 cup chopped broccoli
instructions: Slice the steak into strips about 1/8 of an inch thick. Mix all ingredients very well and pour over steak strips for marinade. Let stand at room temperature for an hour. Grill, broil or fry over medium heat until rare or desired doneness. Remove from pan and place on a heated platter. Pour reserved marinade over meat. Allow to rest for a minute.

Random Ingredients: beer,rose water,monterey jack cheese,kosher salt pepper,vegetable juice,onion soup mix,white cheddar cheese
title: Beer & Beef Dip
ingredients: 2 cans v8 vegetable juice cocktail ( or your favourite brand ) | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1/2 - 1 cup grated white cheddar cheese | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese ( adjust to taste ) | kosher salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons rose water or 2 tablespoons rosemary, cut into small pieces ( optional, i don't add these )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium glass casserole or baking dish that can stand a little roominess over its surface.. Cover and place in refrigerator to chill. To serve, bring to room temp for 5 minutes before eating. Can be served hot or cold.

title: Beef Tartlet
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh triple sec or 1 teaspoon other orange-flavored liqueur | 8 beef tenderloin steaks, about 1-1/2-inches thick
instructions: Pour half of the triple sec into a small glass measure and add 2 or more teaspoons. Place steak in a shallow dish. Add a second teaspoon triple sec and pour over the steak. Cover and refrigerate, turning once, 6 hours or overnight, turning occasionally.

title: Easy Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/3 cup dark corn syrup | 12 tortillas or 12 corn tortillas, cut into strips
instructions: Combine the vegetable stock and corn syrup in a small saucepan, stirring to dissolve the corn syrup. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook 1/2 minutes, or until heated through. Pour hot soup into small soup bowls and carefully flip over. Use the handle of a wooden spoon to stir soup around, ensuring it doesn't burn on the bottom. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Girl Magazine Lovely Littlefinger
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers, tricolor | 2 -3 serrano peppers, diced up ( to taste )
instructions: First put some paper towels on the counter. Lay it all on a cutting board. Put a few fingers of the serrano in the center of each ladyfinger. Take the top paper over the fingers. Try not to break them. Now, take one finger and rub it around the edges of the finger using your finger. It should look like a finger and nothing if the finger touches the paper towels. Then, repeat. Now, repeat. When all three fingers are done, put the pieces on the cookie sheet. Let sit for about 15 minutes. Then, it will turn into a pretty surprise bowl. Take the top paper and make the same as above. It is done when the ladyfingers are nice and golden brown. Note, if you do not like it like i do, you will need to add a little flour to get the french stick effect on the stick. Try it on the stick.

Random Ingredients: white bread,liqueur,watermelon,grainy mustard,parmigiano reggiano cheese,oregano leaf,allspice berry
title: Watermelon Toast
ingredients: 16 slices of good dense white bread, preferably firm | 1 1/2 cups watermelon, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon light grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon liqueur | 6 whole allspice berries, crushed | 6 slices parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Toast the bread very slowly in toaster and oven while you are preparing your fruit.. Put all the remaining ingredients in a blender, except the cheese, and process until smooth. Cut the bread in slices. Place on serving platter, spoon in a few tablespoons of the fruit mixture and spoon over the remaining fruit mixture. Sprinkle with the cheese. Serve with french bread or crackers.

title: Beef and Vegetables With Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large parsnips | 1 lb lean ground beef, preferably lean ground round | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1 teaspoon crushed dried oregano | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary or 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary leaves | 1/2 teaspoon habanero, chopped ( optional ) | 8 ounces red beans, rinsed and drained | 8 cherry or 8 grape tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Put the parsnips and beef in a large roasting pan, and toss gently together. Spread the tomatoes on top. Sprinkle with oregano, rosemary, dried hot pepper, if using, and habanero, if using. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through. Spoon off any excess fat. Remove the parsnips, and toss them with the tomatoes. Remove the baking pan and arrange the fresh parsnips, or vegetables of your choice, on a platter, drizzle with oil and serve with tomatoes and remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,bacon,green chilies,peanut,red potato,coleslaw mix,onion soup mix
title: Hot Mexican Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 packages coleslaw mix | 1 large red potatoes | 6 slices bacon | 1 cup cucumber ( sliced & peeled ) | 1 can green chilies | 1 cup dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons chopped peanuts
instructions: Cut up potatoes into cubes, add to boiling water & cook till tender apprx 12 minutes, drain well & set aside. Cut bacon to bacon pieces, fry till crisp, remove & crumble. Set aside. Chop cucumber & chillies & set aside. Mix together potatoes, coleslaw mix & dressing. Add bacon & veggies & mix together. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts,. Chill & enjoy.

title: French Poppy Seed Cheese Bread [poppy Seed]
ingredients: 1 lb gruyere cheese | 1 cup poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Grease loaf pan or line it with parchment paper. Using a food processor, process cheese over a cutting board for several minutes until well blended and slightly oily. Don't over process. Add poppy seeds, and work the mixture until smooth. Turn out onto a plate, and let cool. Slice in desired serving size pieces and serve warm. If storing in air tight container or freeze, let cool to room temperature. Do not let the bread dry out before adding any other topping and toppings.

title: Vegan French Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown sugar | 3 1/2 cups xanthan gum
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Makes 4 - 1 loaf. Makes about 3 - 1 lb loaf.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,olive oil,corn tortilla,linguine,basmati rice
title: Chef Rachael Ray's Linguine With Fresh Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | 8 ounces linguine | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 cups olive oil | 1 -2 cup fresh basil, chopped fine, for garnish
instructions: Prepare linguine as directed on the package and set aside. Heat oil in a large sauté pan over a medium heat. Dip tortillas in the olive oil and then fry in hot oil until crispy, flipping carefully but not browned. Set aside on paper towels lined plate and allow to cool. Cook linguine as directed on package, but do not overcook. Combine cooked linguine and salsa in a bowl. Serve at once, garnished with fresh basil.

title: Salsa Crusted Sea Bass
ingredients: 2 sea bass fillets | 2 cups thick & chunky salsa | 1/2 cup 2 % low-fat milk | 1 cup red sweet pepper | 1 lb linguine
instructions: Cook your sea bass and slice into 4 slices, about 3/8 thick and 1/4 thick. Set aside. Rinse salsa in a strainer and drain. In a saucepan, saute red sweet pepper and a couple of tbspns of milk, set aside, in a bowl stir in sauce, cook linguine according to package directions, drain and keep warm. Coat a large baking pan with non stick spray and heat the remaining tbspns of milk and salsa over medium high heat. Add the pepper mixture and mix well. Cook for 5 minutes or more, stirring constantly. Remove from heat, toss with pasta and serve with sauce and enjoy.

title: Fruit Lovers Pecan Stuffed Mushrooms from Bubba
ingredients: 25 g pecans, finely crushed | 1/2 cup reduced-fat baked beans sprouts | 225 g reduced-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 200 g low-fat baked pieized chocolate melts | 20 g seedless strawberries | 100 g low-fat strawberries | celery, leaves for decoration
instructions: Melt chocolate morsel or margarine in microwave, stir in pecans and sprouts & let stand till thickened & golden. Spoon mixture into a large pastry lined, greased & base lined wafer tin. Allow to cool slightly then spread each mushroom with half the chocolate glaze. Cut the strawberries in half crossways and spoon over the pecan mixture. Sprinkle with shredded strawberries & celery leaves & chill to set. Cut the remaining mushrooms into smaller wedges and cut away the stem ends.

title: Treacle Mushroom Mushrooms II
ingredients: 1 kg mushroom | 1 liter treacle ( or molasses )
instructions: Wash mushrooms well, and remove stem. Put mushroom caps on greased oven tray. Sprinkle with treacle. Smooth top layer. Bake 30 minuts at 190 c.

title: Cannellini Beans With Anchovy
ingredients: 2 lbs cannellini beans ( or other white beans ) | 1 1/8 teaspoons anchovy paste | seasoning, to taste ( such as mrs. dash ) | 2 red peppers, seeded and cut crosswise into thin strips
instructions: Rinse the beans. Fill a large pot with water, add 2/3 of the bean beans, salted to taste, and bring to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes. Remove the water, add the rest of the beans, and continue to boil until quite dry, about 2 hours. Drain the beans, return to the pot, and add remaining ingredients. Simmer over low heat, skimming fat as necessary. To serve, top bean mixture with grated cheese and serve immediately.

title: Spiced Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup cranberries or 1 cup blackberries | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper paste | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cranberries, crushed red pepper paste and parsley.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,oatmeal,caster sugar,red pepper,cashew nut,green bell pepper,cilantro stem,white pepper
title: Rooster and Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 cup raw cashew nuts | 2 cups dry oatmeal | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 large green bell pepper, finely diced | 1 small red pepper, finely diced | 1 cup mexican blend cheese, crumbled | fresh cilantro stem ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius. Place cashews in a small pan of boiling water and allow to cool. Place cooled cashews in a food processor, puree and set aside. Place oatmeal and sugar in a large bowl and mix well, place a metal skewer directly on surface of mixture to prevent it from sticking. Pour in the pepper, red and green bell pepper and stir until combined. Divide minceing and cashew mixture between 2 serving plates. Spoon a little bit of the reserved oatmeal cheese mixture around the mince and nuts, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Garnish with fresh cilantro sprigs and serve.

title: Homemade Queso Blanco (Mexican Cheese Quesadillas)
ingredients: 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup mild italian cheese blend | 1 tablespoon red chili powder ( or ancho chili powder, or other hot chili if you wish )
instructions: Spray frying pan or skillet with cooking spray, and heat over medium heat. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on one side of each tortilla. Sprinkle with some of the chili powder and fold and continue cooking over medium heat until mixture is bubbly and cheese is melted.

title: Tamarind Verve
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon creme fraiche, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the tamarind paste in a little water. Stir in the grand marnier and creme fraiche. Transfer to small glasses over medium to hot flame and stir constantly until hot.

title: Homemade Coriander Cheese
ingredients: 6 tablespoons hazelnuts, roasted, shelled | 6 ounces bacon, chopped | 4 dried chilies, soaked and chopped ( dried hot chilies, finely chopped ) | 2 teaspoons tarragon | 2 ounces natural yogurt
instructions: Place all the dried ingredients together in a food processor and pulse until roughly blended. Add the yogurt gradually, until you have a texture like a smooth paste. The amount of yogurt depends on the texture of your cheese, and how thick you want it, but the amount of yogurt is up to you. Refrigerate before using, although it's important to add the yogurt the next day, or it will set a lot like that.

Random Ingredients: key lime,plum tomato,italian sausage,kernel corn,cremini mushroom,peanut,cream mushroom soup
title: Corn Sausage Hash With Creamy Tomato Corn
ingredients: 16 ounces sweet cremini mushrooms ( sliced and chopped for easier texture ) or 16 ounces white button mushrooms ( sliced and chopped for easier texture ) | 1 package italian sausage | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup, cream of mushroom, creamed cream soup | 1 can diced plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup peanuts | 8 key limes, juice and zest of | 3 -4 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 5 cups frozen whole kernel corn ( thawed )
instructions: Brown sausage breaking up into bite size pieces and drain. Remove sausage from pan. Add mushrooms to same pan and saute until tender. Add sausage mixture to mixture in large pot. Add soups, tomatoes and peanuts. Stir and cook until combined. Add lime juice and zest. Reduce heat slightly and allow to simmer for at least 15 minutes or until mixture is heated through, stirring occasionally. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Serve over cooked hot egg noodles or over hot, cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: fruit,milk chocolate,oregano leaf,chili flake,thyme,chunky peanut butter,chili pepper flake,mace
title: Yogurt Dessert for One
ingredients: 3 cups whole milk chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon chunky peanut butter | 3 tablespoons dried sweetened fruit | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Line a small jelly roll pan with waxed paper and set aside. Beat chocolate, peanut butter, fruit, thyme, oregano, chili flakes, mexican chili powder, dried chili flakes, oregano, mace in a bowl using an electric mixer on low speed until smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving. Keep refrigerated until completely set. Can be refrigerated up to 6 hours.

title: Japanese Roasted Stuffed Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 russet potatoes ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon good coffee ( see note ) | 3 slices streaky bacon | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Using the method of your kitchenaid, slice the potatoes and place them on a baking sheet. Mix the coffee and mirin and pour over the potatoes. Roast in a preheated 400 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and cover with foil to keep warm. Reduce oven to 325 degrees and bake potatoes for 1 1/2 hours per pound of potatoes.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,manicotti shell,balsamic vinegar,banana,water chestnut,garlic clove,golden raisin,cardamom pod
title: Balsamic Stuffed Manicotti Shells(Bisengali)
ingredients: 1 package manicotti shells | 6 large garlic cloves, chopped | 1 cup of cubed banana | 1 cup of sliced water chestnuts | 1 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup of your favourite sweet chili oil | 1/2 cup of grated of extra sweetened pomegranate-infused berry | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod ( optional )
instructions: Boil the water in a saucepan and simmer with a pinch of salt. Boil manicotti shells. While waiting for the water to boil, mix together all the other ingredients except for the shell in the same pot. Once the water comes to a boil, remove the pan from the stove and dump the manicotti shell in and stir. Put about 2 tbsps of the banana and water chestnut mixture in the shell and stir. Put another layer of shells in the pot. Mix everything together and put the full pan in the sun. After 15 min, remove the pan from the sun, cover and put in the fridge. Serve with fresh bread and/or your favorite tea.

title: Rump Steak With Capers
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak | 4 ounces self rising flour | 2 ounces capers | 12 ounces bread dough ( i use frozen )
instructions: Trim fat and cut steak into serving sized pieces or chunks. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Prick hole in the rump with a fork to allow steam to escape. Roll out bread dough onto a floured surface and cut into circles or fingers. Place a few pieces of capers onto one end of each pastry circle or fingers. Roll up dough, secure with a toothpick. Place on non stick baking tray in oven or on low temperature for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve with a salad or vegetables.

title: Korean Limas (Sweet Beans)
ingredients: 3 lbs frozen lima beans or 3 lbs fresh peas ( 4 1/2 - 7 lbs ) | 2 lbs ground meat or 2 lbs ground beef | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( not garlic powder ) or 1 tablespoon onion paste ( not garlic powder ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Wash your peas. Cover with water 2 inches above the beans. Add water to 4 inches above your boiling water. Cover, lower the heat, and simmer slowly for 40 to 50 minutes. Drain and let cool. Remove and discard any stringy materials inside the meat or vegetables. Discard any tough pieces of meat or veggies such as onions, garlic, or others that float in the solution. If there is any additional moisture, simply measure out a bit and place your whole pan back over low heat. Add the meat or vegetables and simmer very slowly about 1 - ¼ hours, stirring frequently. When the meat or vegetables are done, add your sugar and stir until dissolved. Serve cold. Variation to test a quick cooking tip, use 1/2 teaspoon of salt to 1 teaspoon of ground meat, add hot water. If you have more liquid, make a paste of it. If not, remove the meat mixture from the stove after the cooking so as not to lose any flavor after the initial cooking and continue cooking it. If using peas, drain the water after cooking, run cold water over them and then cook them until soft. If using meat or vegetables and meat, cook them the same way you cooked the meat. As in the meat mixture you can serve the meat cold at room temperature or you can make individual meat dumplings just throw them into a pot of boiling water and boil until they float, about 3 minutes. They cook the more you boil them because they are softer. Drain the dumplings in a colander lined with several layers of cheesecloth and place under cold running water to stop the cooking and to keep dumplings warm through the cold. These are great served with rice, and can be eaten immediately once they are cooled completely.

Random Ingredients: beer,onion mushroom soup mix,vanilla yogurt,fish,meat,milk,vegetable broth,virgin olive oil
title: Beef, Beer and Meatballs Stew
ingredients: 600 ml vegetable broth | 1/2 cup beer ( i used a light but robust beer. any beer will do. i used guinness so the extra liquid will be absorbed by the meat ) | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 500 g minced meat | 2 onions, finely chopped | 250 g mushrooms, finely chopped | 1/2 - 1 cup milk | 1 package onion mushroom soup mix | 500 ml natural yogurt | 100 g vanilla frozen yogurt
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, lidded saucepan large enough to hold all the meatballs but not to cover the meat. Brown the meatballs in batches if necessary, then remove to a plate when nicely browned. Add the remaining ingredients, except the vanilla & vanilla, into the pan and bring to the boil, scraping any browned bits from the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon. Cover and simmer on low heat for 2 hours, or until the meatballs are cooked. Meanwhile, heat the milk & vanilla in a small pan over medium heat until simmering. Remove from the heat and stir in the yogurt. Set aside for 20 minutes. To serve, place the meatballs atop the sauce & pour the yogurt over them and serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,rice vinegar,bulgur,sun tomato pesto,vanilla bean,rye bread,pimiento
title: Faux English Sundae Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked grain bulgur or 1 cup couscous | 1 can sliced canned pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped sun-dried tomato pesto ( or tomato basil ) | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split and scraped from stem | 1 tablespoon dry roasted sliced almonds or 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato flakes
instructions: Place bulgur in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain off any excess water. Stir in pimentos, sun dried tomato pesto, rice vinegar, cardamom seeds, vanilla seeds and almonds.

title: Deep-Fried Enchiladas (Green Enchiladas)
ingredients: 6 deep-fryer fryer chickens | 1 jar prepared enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup oil, for deep frying
instructions: Rinse the chicken, remove giblets and neck, and remove or cut wings.

title: Hot Chili Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 4 teaspoons pure green chilies | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients to make a smooth sauce or serve in a hot bowl on the table.

title: Adzuki Beans (Adzuki Beans in Rice Vine Leaves)
ingredients: 250 g adzuki beans | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Soak adzuki beans for 8 hours, or overnight. Drain and place it in a large pot containing cold water. Bring to a boil on medium high heat, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat, remove the pot from the heat, and let stand for 15 minutes. Remove the bean skins, and wash the beans in a large pot of water. Return the pot to medium high heat and add the rice wine. Cook for 5 minutes. Drain the adzuki beans and pour them into the pot. Add more water if necessary to cover. Cover and cook for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the corn oil and the coriander powder. Allow to stand for 15 minutes before eating.

title: Easy Vegan Gravy for Spam® (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable broth, warmed | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 -2 drop soy sauce ( to sweeten, optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender, and puree until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour over spam® as desired.

title: Slow Baked Corned Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs corned beef brisket | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place beef brisket on rack in roasting pan and cover with aluminum foil. Spread guacamole on meat. Bake at 425 degrees f for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to stand for 5 to 10 minutes. Slice brisket thinly, wrap and refrigerate.

title: Glutinous Rice and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice | 1 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Soak rice in a bowl of cold water for 3 - 5 hours drain off excess water and dry thoroughly on a cookie sheet. Spread mixture evenly on cookie sheet or in a shallow bowl, with sides about 4' thick. Chill in refrigerator overnight and then spread over cooked rice with cottage cheese. Serves about 6 8.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,pepperoni,panko breadcrumb,beef,cauliflower floret,chicken,hard egg,garlic salt
title: Crispy Ground Beef With Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets | 1 cup beef, ground | 1 large orange, juice | 5 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped | 1 clove garlic salt | pepperoni, sliced | 1 lb ground chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place cauliflower florets in food processor or processor and pulse grind to roughly the size of cauliflower. Mix in ground ground beef, orange juice, panko, eggs and garlic salt. Spread mixture evenly on the bottom and up the sides of a glass casserole dish. Spread ground beef evenly over cauliflower. Bake in preheated oven for 35 - 40 minutes. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Rum-Braised Pork
ingredients: 2 1/4 - 3 lbs medium-rib roast or 2 1/4-3 lbs boneless pork | 4 cups good quality dark rum | 12 mint leaves
instructions: Cover a large roasting pan with foil. Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Add meat and brown on all sides in hot rum. Remove meat from pan and reserve. Add the rum to the rum and ignite. Let the alcohol evaporate, then raise the rum to bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer the sauce for 15 minutes. Add the mint leaves and reduce the liquid to half. Put roaster in the oven. Bake covered for 1 hour, basting half way through cooking, until meat thermometer registers 150°°f about 3 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven and place on serving platter. Slice meat and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: ginger,celery rib,sun tomato oil,broth,beef gravy,coconut cream
title: Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs braising steak, cut in 1-inch cubes | 4 celery ribs, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup beef gravy | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 0.5 can coconut cream
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Place in a shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered for 30/40 minutes, stirring every 5 - 10 minutes. Cool. In a saucepan, cook steak, celery and sundried tomatoes in the beef gravy until tender, about 15 minutes. Pour into a heat proof bowl.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,lemon juice zest,salt pepper,chili oil,sausage
title: Mexican Spiced Bratwacks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs coarse sea bass or 1 1/2 lbs other firm white fish | salt and pepper | chili oil, to taste | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2/3 cup corn syrup, warmed
instructions: Remove the fish from the shell and pat dry. Cut the fish diagonally into 1/2 inch wide crosswise slices. Sprinkle with salt and pepper, about 1 tablespoon. Arrange the fish on a rack in a roasting pan. Set aside. Whisk together the remaining ingredients and pour over the fish. Let stand in a cool, dark place for 2 days, turning as necessary, to cure all sinew. The brats may be prepared a day ahead and kept chilled until beginning to ferment the liquid, turning them as necessary.

Random Ingredients: pear,garlic,wheat flour,corn tortilla,lemon extract,porcini mushroom,bicarbonate soda,wine
title: Vegetarian Tortilla Pate
ingredients: 4 tablespoons wheat flour | 1/2 cup port wine or 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon extract | 1 tablespoon dried porcini mushrooms ( soaked in warm water for approximately 20 minutes ) | 1 teaspoon garlic, crushed | 2 teaspoons corn tortillas, soaked in water for 5 minutes, and crumbled ( optional ) | 2 ripe pears, cored, peeled, and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the tortillas in a bowl. If the ingredients are not well combined, stir in extra flour to the mixture. Stir with a floured wooden spoon until the mixture forms a ball. Divide the mixture into 6 portions, cover in plastic wrap, and chill until required.. Preheat oven to 180°c line an oven tray with non stick paper. Lightly spray the surface of the dough with cooking oil. Using a rolling pin, roll out each portion of dough into a 12 cm circle on a lightly floured surface. Place onto the prepared tray and bake on the preheated 180°c oven for 20 minutes, or until pale golden in colour. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,coconut milk,extra virgin olive oil,fennel bulb,clove,white sugar
title: Warm Coconut Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 small fennel bulb, cut into 1/2 to 1 inch cubes or 1 small scallion, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 3 whole cloves | 1 ounce dried white mushrooms | 1 cup light coconut milk | 1/3 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided
instructions: Place coconut milk and fennel bulb in a saucepan, and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until fennel is tender and the liquid has reduced to about ¾ cup, about 10 minutes. Remove fennel and discard. Meanwhile, set a large skillet over medium heat. Place cloves in a mortar, and pestle, and pound with a rolling pin until fine. Add mushrooms to skillet with the fennel in it, and toast the mushrooms until beginning to brown, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in coconut milk, sugar, and 2 tablespoons olive oil to skillet. Pour into a small bowl, and taste.

title: Oops! Mexican Couscous
ingredients: 1 box couscous | 15 -20 ice cubes | baking cocoa ( optional ) | cumin powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes ( optional )
instructions: Place couscous in a bowl with ice cubes. Pour enough cold water over it until you have just about room to move your fingers around and into the couscous. Stir well. Cover, then leave in fridge for about 15 to 20 minutes. Stir occasionally just to melt the cocoa. Add a splash of baking cocoa, if using. When you are ready to eat your couscous, put aside the extra water to moisten. Place couscous in a wide bowl. Stir in your spices and pour over your couscous and toss lightly so it gets soaked up, but not settled in or sticking. Allow your guests to mix this up a little. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,basil pesto,thyme sprig,peppermint extract,rump roast,coconut milk,wheat tortilla
title: Rump Roast With Chocolate Pistachio-Pesto Quesadilla
ingredients: 4 slices thin whole wheat tortilla ( about 2-inch diameter ) | 3/4 cup thawed unsweetened coconut milk ( or 1 15.25 oz. can ) | 2 teaspoons thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract | 2 -3 tablespoons basil pesto | 2 -3 ounces semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Place tortilla on flat surface. Place on work surface. Combine coconut milk, thyme, peppermint extract, pesto and 1/3 cup of the chocolate chips and spread over tortilla. Drain tortilla of any excess liquid and spread over cheese mixture evenly. Sprinkle remaining chocolate chips over top of cheese. Starting from one end, lightly press with tortilla and jelly roll style. Repeat until tortilla is used up. Cut into wedges. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,sirloin,cornstarch,egg white,creme de cacao,phyllo dough
title: Brazilian Steak  (Sate)
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon creme de cacao | 1 egg white, beaten | 1/2 cup creme de cacao, nibblets ( optional ) | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 3 cups coconut oil, for frying
instructions: If using sirloin, in large skillet, cook beef in cornstarch and creme de cacao over medium high heat until no pink remains, stirring frequently. When cooked through, drain off fat. Set aside. In small bowl, mix egg white and 1/2 cup of the creme de cacao nibblets together. Cut phyllo sheets crosswise into 2 strips. Spray each strip with non stick cooking spray. Working with 1 strip, place 2 tablespoons of meat mixture across the strip closest to you. Starting with a long side, roll up from the short end. Repeat with remaining strips. Heat oil in large pot to 350 degrees. Fry bundles for 2 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,sun tomato oil,fine sea salt,pimiento,pepper sauce,red pepper,corn,basil
title: Basil Corn & Sun-Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 4 ears corn | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 jar sweet peppers, sliced into 1/4 `` strips | 4 ounces pimientos, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 2 -3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/3 cup fine sea salt | 1 -2 tablespoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Boil corn until just tender, about 5 minutes or so, then cut kernels from cob. Rinse corn and cut kernels from cob into bite size pieces. In a large bowl combine corn, sun dried tomatoes, sweet pepper strips, pimento slices, basil and vinegar. Season with salt, hot pepper sauce and additional hot pepper sauce to taste. Toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: carrot,brown rice syrup,bulk pork sausage,tapioca,pine nut,vanilla extract,cranberry,string bean
title: Sweet and Sour Glazed Sweet Stuffed Beans
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed pork sausage | 1/2 cup brown rice syrup | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 jar sweetened mixed pulses ( optional ) | 1 can diced carrots | 3 packages frozen string beans | 1/2 cup minced pine nuts | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a 9x13 inch baking dish. Heat pork sausage in a skillet over medium heat. Drain, and crumble. Bring the brown rice syrup, cranberries, toasted pink pecans, sweet pupus, carrots, beans, and pine nuts to a boil, and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract, and remove from heat. Spoon stuffing into prepared baking dish, and smooth top. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown and heated through. This does not make a giant pork sausage or sweet potato stuffing. Do not freeze or microwave sweet potatoes or carrots. Fill with stuffing, and bake an additional 15 minutes, until stuffing is heated through. Garnish with optional pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: cornbread,gruyere cheese,rice wine vinegar,chile,beef mince,beef brisket,tequila,chickpea
title: Tequila Roast Cornbread Wedges
ingredients: 600 g corned beef brisket, excess fat removed | 1/2 cup coriander cheddar grated cheese, plus extra for sprinkling | 1/2 cup shado beni rice wine vinegar | 150 g beef mince or 150 g beef mince | 125 g chickpeas, soaked in water for 15 mins'or 125 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon chili, finely chopped ( red or green ) | 200 g canned cornbread | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas rub the beef all over with shado beni rice vinegar and leave to marinate at room temperature for 1 hour. Meanwhile, cook the mince with chickpeas and chilli until browned. Place in a baking dish and add the coriander cheddar and 2/3 cup of the cheese. Toast the cornbread on a baking tray on a baking sheet in the oven and crumble with a fork. Scatter over the remaining cheese and bake until golden brown and risen, about 10 mins' serve straight away. Divid the wedges between a shallow ovenproof dish and drizzle with the olive oil.

title: Liptauer
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas | 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1 green bell pepper | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon dried dill or 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 cup frozen whipped topping | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Simmer chickpeas in boiling water about 30 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside. In skillet, combine ground sirloin and 1 green pepper. Cook over medium heat 15 minutes or until browned. Drain. In large mixing bowl, combine green pepper and beef mixture with chickpeas, green pepper mixture, and 1 cup of whipped topping. Mix thoroughly. Spread over serving platter. Sprinkle with toasted dill and brown sugar. Chill at least 3 hours or overnight.

title: Easy Apricot Jerk
ingredients: 25 dried apricots, cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch chunks | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the apricots in a single layer on the foil, and sprinkle with the seasoning salt. Drizzle with the olive oil. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,cardamom pod,iceberg lettuce,cajun seasoning,water chestnut,nutritional yeast
title: Nutty Coconut Nests
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nutritional yeast, dry | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 bags iceberg lettuce or 2 bags baby greens | 10 iceburg stalks with a little stem ( or substitute with other greens ) | 10 cardamom pods | 1 quart bamboo skewer ( soaked in water for 15 minutes before using )
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in warm water. Spray the bamboo skewers with oil spray. In a medium bowl, mix the nutritional yeast and water with a wire whisk using a wooden spoon to dissolve the yeast. Mix in the lettuce and iceburg lettuce. Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours, stirring occasionally. Stir the pods into the chilled yogurt. Preheat the broiler, but be careful not to burn. Place two skewer pieces on a clean work surface and brush the tops with oil. Broil until they are golden, 3 to 5 minutes. Turn and broil until golden, 3 to 5 minutes longer. Remove from the broiler and let cool for 10 to 20 minutes before removing the toothpicks. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheddar cheese,taco seasoning mix,onion powder,mint leaf
title: Mexican-Style Queso Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Spray a 9 inch microwave safe bowl with cooking spray. On the bottom of bowl, spread monterey jack cheese. Sprinkle onion powder and taco seasoning mix evenly over the cheese. Top with mint leaves. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Decrease heat down to medium. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted.

title: Pineapple Crawfish Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 can pineapple in juice | 1 can tomato juice | 1 1/2 pounds crawfish tails, peeled
instructions: Combine the pineapple with the tomato juice and crawfish tails in a slow cooker. Cook at high setting about 2 hours, or low setting 2 hours. Remove crawfish tails, reserving the liquid. Use a stick blender or food processor to puree the reserved pineapple liquid into a saucepan. Stir the pureed pineapple mixture into the jambalaya. Cover and chill before serving.

title: American Cheese Quesadilla
ingredients: 4 large slices american cheese | 1 banana
instructions: Spread one slice of cheese and one slice of american cheese on one half of each slice of banana. Place one slice of american cheese on top of the first slice of american cheese. Wrap up the other slice of american cheese with the two slices of banana. Wrap in parchment paper and set aside. Over a very hot griddle, melt the last piece of cheese for about 15 seconds on each side, until it starts to brown. Slide quesadilla onto a parchment paper lined cookie sheet or large serving platter. Slice into six wedges. Repeat for all slices and serve warm.

title: Crunchy Zucchini
ingredients: 4 zucchini, sliced in half lengthwise and then into 1/2 inch slices | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup currants | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup fat-free greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Saute zucchini in hot butter. Sprinkle with currants and greek yoghurt. Serve warm with a scoop of greek yogurt.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,kaiser,banana,poblano chile,ginger garlic paste,coriander powder,hoisin sauce,wheat bread
title: Beef and Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, 1/2-by-1 inch thick | 1/2 head of cabbage ( about 6 cups or so ) | 2 hoisin sauce | 1 poblano chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 small head of cabbage, about 8 cups | 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1 fresh banana, sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the ginger garlic paste with a little water.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,thyme sprig,mint leaf,rice vinegar,wheat flour,red bell pepper,pumpernickel bread,cilantro
title: Spicy Bread With Red Peppers
ingredients: 1/4 cup spanish rice vinegar | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 3/4 cups whole wheat flour, divided | 4 1/2 teaspoons black peppercorns ( about 12 ) | 2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme sprigs | 1 loaf pumpernickel bread, cut lengthwise at 1 inch intervals ( about 6 cups ) | 1/2 cup minced fresh mint leaves | chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Whisk vinegar, brown sugar and 2 tbsp. Of the flour in large bowl. Gradually whisk in remaining flour until just blended. Stir in peppercorns, thyme, remaining 1/3 cup flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Dough should be just firm. If it is too dry, add more water. Transfer to lightly floured surface and knead 1 minute. Place in large lightly floured bowl, cover and let rest 1 hour. Meanwhile preheat oven to 400°. Spread bread onto greased nonstick large baking sheet. Roast until crust is light brown, about 10 minutes. Transfer to wire rack and cool 10 minutes, then split evenly. Drizzle bread with extra virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with mint and season with salt and pepper. Drizzle with remaining 1/4 cup of flour. Roast bread until puffed and golden, about 20 minutes. Transfer to large platter, drizzle with dressing and garnish with mint leaves and cilantro before serving.

title: Campari Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 packages spaghetti | 1/3 cup dried extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup canned mushrooms, sliced | 1 cucumber, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons sliced green onions | 6 cups water chestnuts
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package, omitting salt. Drain. Meanwhile, heat oil in large skillet. Add mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: pink grapefruit,garbanzo bean,flour tortilla,barbeque sauce,head romaine lettuce,kielbasa
title: Kansas Girl's Southwest Grill Party
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 2 pink grapefruit, sectioned and sliced | 1 cup kielbasa, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 flour tortillas for topping | 1 head romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 bottle barbeque sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Spoon garbanzo beans onto a plate. Slice both grapefruits and cut each piece into thirds crosswise. Combine garbanzo beans, grapefruit sections, kielbasa and tortilla stack onto a serving platter. Arrange romaine lettuce around the edge of the platter. Spoon barbeque sauce over the top, if desired. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,vanilla bean,creme fraiche,red curry paste
title: Red Curried Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 red curry paste ( i prefer thai version ) | 1 1/2 cups creme fraiche ( or sour cream and sugar ) | 1/2 vanilla bean, split and scraped | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine curry paste with enough creme fraiche or sour cream to make a smooth paste. Add vanilla bean scrape seeds from vanilla bean and crush with a mortar and pestle. Add 1/2 teaspoon of baking powder, stir and blend thoroughly. Add the rest of the baking powder to desired consistency. Store in the fridge.

title: Amarula Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces amarula cream liqueur | 4 1/2 ounces half-and-half cream | 4 1/2 ounces chervil | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs | 1/4 cup chile, chopped | 1 1/2 ounces dried apricots, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Chill well in the refrigerator.

title: Hot Fleshed Wine
ingredients: 50 ml dry red wine | 50 ml ghee | 3 tablespoons hot water
instructions: In a heavy based saucepan heat the red wine and the ghee until the sugar melts. Immediately reduce the heat and simmer for a few minutes. Stir all the while until the wine reduces and becomes syrupy. Pour a tablespoon of the hot wine syrup, stir and cook for a few minutes longer. Pour immediately into glasses filled with hot wine. You may need to stir constantly to ensure that the wine does not stick. Remove and let sit for a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,banana,hamburger bun,monterey jack cheese,angel hair pasta,pumpkin seed,red pepper,peanut
title: Quick Pasta Fungus Burger
ingredients: 12 ounces hamburger buns, sliced into 6 even sections | 1 package angel hair pasta | 2 lbs ripe banana | 2 pints peanut, roasted and drained | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon red pepper | 1/3 cup peanuts, chopped, for topping ( or canola, if desired ) ( optional ) | 1 loaf fresh panko breadcrumb ( or homemade breadcrumbs )
instructions: Heat frying pan with peanuts, or a bit of oil, and fry hamburger. Drain hamburger. Put on paper towel to pat out excess grease. Heat a little bit of oil in pan. Dip sliced bananas in the peanut, and dip in the panko. Fry hamburger until browned but still hot. Split buns evenly in half. Spread panko on rolls, and top with slices of hot burger, and peanut mixture.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 1 cup egg yolk | cooking spray
instructions: Beat egg yolk, then beat in cooking spray. Spray a 6 quart pan generously with cooking spray. Pour into the pan. Bake in 400 degree f oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Greek Spaghetti With Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 cup spaghetti | 1/2 pound pork chops, cut into strips | 1 can or bottle italian-style cream | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 4 lemon wedges
instructions: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to an boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking water, and drain pasta. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pork chops in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,red curry paste,lemon essence,chicken bouillon cube,coffee,mustard powder
title: Cafe Rio Instant Minute Lemon & Ginger Pilau
ingredients: 4 cups instant long-grain white rice | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 4 -4 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon lemon essence ( or 1/2 t. fresh grated lemon juice ) | 2 -3 teaspoons red curry paste
instructions: Dissolve the chicken bouillon cubes in the coffee in a measuring cup, and then pour into a microwave safe bowl. Microwave the rice on high in the bowl for about 1 minute, stir. Add 2 - 3 tbls. Of the curry paste or orange juice to the rice and mix, then let sit about a minute. Add the salt, mustard and the lemon essence, stir, and then cook according to your favorite recipe. I have found chicken bouillon cubes to be quite salty, so you may want to add a little salt until water is in the pot. You can use your favourite curry paste for this. Add the remaining curry paste, mix, and let sit for a minute or so, then serve enjoy.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Heat pesto sauce in a small skillet over medium low heat until hot, about 1 minute. Stir in tarragon, remove from heat, and stir in pesto.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,pork belly,lettuce leaf,green chili
title: Green Chile Tacos
ingredients: 1 piece pork belly ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 6 -12 lettuce leaves | 2 ounces fresh green chili ( canned, green hot variety ) | 1/2 - 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Wash the pork belly, and pat it dry with paper towels. Sprinkle the outer layer of fat with water, then add the pork, making sure all of the water gets soaked up by the meat. Cover and let sweat for about 1/2 hour. Remove the meat from the pan and cut off any traces of the fat from the pork. Strain all the liquid from the pan, pressing the meat firmly against the liquid. Cover the pan gently and let the pork rest in the refridgerator for about 1/2 hour, then strain it to remove any remaining liquid. Cut the pork into slices 1/4 inch thick, as if you were preparing tacos from the meat. The thin slices will float to the top but will not be able to reach the edges, as they will absorb the excess oil. When you are done, heat the empty oil in a frying pan. Fry the slices over high heat until they are crisp on the outside. Remove them to a paper towel lined plate, and drain on paper towels. Cut the slices into strips about 1 1/2 x 1/2, producing about 2 strips per taco. Cut the cheese into small squares to fit the tacos, and place on a serving platter. Wear a toothpick, or slice into a small ball, and squeeze and spread it around the edge to seal the tacos. Serve with refried beans and salsa.

title: Roasted Mushrooms for Two
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus or 1/2 lb broccoli, trimmed | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Place the asparagus on the prepared baking sheet. With a fork, prick mushrooms all over with tender stem. Roast mushrooms under the grill or broiler until mushrooms are blackened on all sides, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,red chilies,pork leg,fajita seasoning mix,fennel bulb,beef,jalapeno,grain white rice
title: Tex-Mex Rice and Franks
ingredients: 3 cups beef, cubed | 3 cups long grain white rice | 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless pork legs, cubed | 1 can diced jalapenos | 1 -2 cup mushrooms, sliced | 1 bag fennel bulb, sliced ( about 4 medium bulbs ) | 3 packages fajita seasoning mix | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed red chilies or 1 -2 tablespoon dried crushed pasilla chiles
instructions: Spray or oil a large skillet or dutch oven add half of the dry fajita seasoning packet and brown pork in skillet.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,pearl onion,cauliflower,white onion,self rising flour,cherry
title: Cawl (Cheese Rolls)
ingredients: 12 ounces self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon white onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pearl onions, finely chopped | 1 1/4 pints cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 ounces frozen peas and carrots | 3 ounces cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 dash of your choice of white wine or black pepper
instructions: Sift flour and onion into a bowl. Add the chopped onions and put the tomatoes, peas and carrots into the bowl. Mix well with a spoon. Preheat oven to 200°c. Spoon about 1 tsp of the mixture onto a greased baking sheet. Make shallow cuts in the top with a sharp knife. Brush with cooking oil. Bake for 25 minutes. Meanwhile bring a pan of water to the boil and add the cauliflower. Boil over a high heat for 2 minutes. Drain. Add the peas and carrots and stir through. Turn off heat. Leave to cool. Drain the dough on a floured surface and roll and cut into thin strips with a knife. Tear the strips with two scissors. Roll into balls. Place each piece onto 2 greased baking sheets and put the biscuits on top of each. Brush with cooking oil. Top with more crumbs if required. Bake for 40 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,meat,onion soup mix,flour tortilla,vegetable oil cooking spray,artichoke heart
title: Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 -12 flour tortillas ( i like to use 8-10 per flour tortillas ) | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Brown meat and drain fat. Add soup mix and artichokes. Heat in saucepan. Spray large non stick skillet with oil. Add 1 batch of quesadillas and cook until crisp. Place tortillas on a plate. Top evenly with meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Fold tortillas over. Spray the top of quesadillas with oil. You might need a little more oil or the tortillas will become greasy. Cover and keep warm to make sure quesadillas don't stick. Serve, we like these with lettuce, tomatoes, sour cream, and salsa.

title: The Best Chicken Harb Broth from Coriander
ingredients: 1/2 pint coriander leaves | 1 garlic clove
instructions: Cut a fine slice from the side of garlic cloves. Open out the garlic with the tip of a small knife blade. Open the garlic and squeeze out all the gills and the flesh. Cut the garlic into smaller pieces and add it to a large pan. Add the coriander leaves. Put a lid on and put on low until the stock is simmering and the stock has reduced by two thirds. Do not uncover the pan or the stock will bubble up. Take off the lid and set over a pan of boiling water. The liquid will steam away. The water may bubble up and possibly boil down some. Take the pan off the heat and leave for 10 minutes to allow the stock to cool. Then put the lid back on and leave for a further 15 minutes. Take a sharp knife and carefully cut the chicken pieces. Arrange in a serving bowl with plenty of yoghurt on top and sprinkle the top with a little more chopped coriander. Serve. The chicken should be free of any bones, skin, or bones. This does not matter.

title: Berry Peach Rice Cake W-Caramelized Sweet Peaches
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( or 2 tbsp vanilla bean paste ) | 2 cups uncooked arborio rice ( or longgrain rice such as nishiki ) | 2 cups broccoli florets ( fresh trimmed and sliced on the diagonal ) | 3 ripe peaches, peeled, halved, pitted, coarsely chopped and cut crosswise into wedges ( about 3 c ) | 2 cups low-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 1/4 cups loosely packed fresh blackberries or 1 1/4 cups frozen blueberries, thawed, squeezed dry | 1/2 cup orange rind, grated and zested | 2 teaspoons baking powder | additional broccoli floret, for garnish
instructions: If using vanilla bean paste, in a small saucepan, combine rice and 1 cup water, bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,mexican chicken rice pilaf mix,vegetable stock
title: Simple Microwave Chicken and Vegetable Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 package mexican-style chicken and rice pilaf mix | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups frozen asparagus spears
instructions: Mix rice pilaf mix with stock. Microwave on full power setting for 20 minutes. Add frozen asparagus spears, and cook for 5 - 10 minutes longer. Note, cooking time will vary based on size of ingredients. If rice is still warm, do not remove asparagus.

Random Ingredients: chilies,oyster sauce,poblano chile,white flour,self rising flour
title: Deep-Fried Green Chiles
ingredients: 12 fresh poblano chiles, washed, seeded ( the smaller the 'green'to the lighter ) | 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup white flour | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Place the poblanos in a dry pan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: flour,heavy whipping cream,cinnamon,chili garlic sauce,tamarind paste,quinoa
title: Thai Quinoa and Tamarind Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 1 can tamarind paste | 1/2 cup chili-garlic sauce | 4 tablespoons cinnamon | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup flour
instructions: Place all dry ingredients in a large pan.

Random Ingredients: watercress,onion salt,penne pasta,bean sprout,sea scallop,kangaroo fillet,lobster
title: Penne With Baked Kangaroo and Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces kangaroo fillets | 2 tablespoons onions salt | 1 lb fresh bean sprout | 12 ounces watercress, cleaned | 12 ounces lobsters | 8 ounces penne pasta | 1/2 pint watercress, washed | sea scallops
instructions: Boil water and cook the kangaroo fillet for 15 minutes, until just opaque. Drain and allow to cool a little. Pile onto a baking tray, pour over the onion salt and leave in a cool place. Chop the beansprouts and watercress leaves in small pieces. Cook the pasta, drain and rinse under cold water. Cook the bean sprouts in a saucepan, cook in a little boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain. Dry the lobsters with kitchen paper, remove the meat from the bones if preferred and set aside the skin. Slice the meat into 1/4 thick strips and place into an ovenproof dish. Put the shellfish on top or in the oven. Place the scallops on top of the meat and pour remaining boiling water over them. instructions: Place apples, dates, and bouillon in a saucepan, cover and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes or until apples are tender.
