instructions: Preheat your oven's grill or oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a 10 inch, heavy bottomed skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Add the chorizo and cook until brown and lightly crisp, breaking the sausage into bite size pieces. Drain excess fat. In a medium bowl, combine the crumbles and the orange bell pepper.

title: Bakewell's Easy Trio
ingredients: 1 pound phyllo dough, thawed, cut into 10 strips per sheet, and cut into quarters
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with a damp towel or parchment paper. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place phyllo pieces into the water, and cook uncovered until they rise to the surface. With a slotted spoon, transfer the phyllo to a plastic bag, and set aside. Repeat with remaining phyllo, water, and bag sheets. Spray a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan with cooking spray. Spread sheets of phyllo with cooking spray, and set aside. Continue alternating layers of phyllo and phyllo sheets, spraying each with cooking spray until you’ve used about 8 layers. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray, and pour in a heaping tablespoon of lemon juice. Spread one more layer of phyllo dough over the lemon, and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Repeat layering until there are 10 layers of phyllo dough, 7 sheets of phyllo dough, 7 sheets of phyllo dough, 3 sheets of phyllo dough, and 1 remaining lemon. Spread remaining lemon juice over top, and sprinkle with salt. Cut the remaining 5 sheets of phyllo dough, and cut the remaining 5 sheets of phyllo dough into 4 squares.

title: Mexican Green
ingredients: 6 bags frozen mixed greens | 1 -2 medium green pepper
instructions: Thaw the frozen green mix and combine it with all the other ingredients. Let them sit in the refrigerator to let the flavors blend. The longer it sits, the more tender it will be. Just before serving, slice into pieces and serve on corn chips.

title: Baked Macaroni Salad With Paneer
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gluten-free flour ( gluten-free if required ) | 1 - 1 1/2 pints mixed salad oil | 1/4 - 1/2 cup icing sugar | 170 g macaroni, cooked | 225 g drained paneer cheese | 175 g dried cranberries
instructions: Mix the flour and 2 cups water in a jug and rub vigorously. Mix in the olive oil, icing sugar until the mixture resembles soft breadcrumbs. Add the dry macaroni and mix gently until all the grains are coated. Spread the macaroni mixture on 3/4 of the paneer and put the rest of the paneer on top as you wish. Crush the cranberries in your palms gently and sprinkle over the salad.

title: Pea and Turnip Stew
ingredients: 800 g turnips, peeled and in large cubes | 1 1/2 kg frozen peas | 1 small red-skin chicken drumstick | 1/4 liter cointreau liqueur
instructions: Place turnips, peas, chicken breast, and cointreau into a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,ranch dressing,hot pepper,italian sausage,cardamom,beef sirloin steak,pea
title: Beef Tarkari
ingredients: 3 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 5 hot peppers, seeded and chopped | 3 hot pepper rings ( seeds added for flavor ) | 12 shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1 bag frozen peas
instructions: Slice beef into thin strips and brown steak. Set aside, reserving drippings. Saute peppers, mushrooms and hot pepper rings for 3 minutes. Set aside. Mix dressing and cardamom in a bowl and mix together. Add beef, peppers and mushrooms to bowl. Add peas. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hour or until tender.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,cooking spray,poblano pepper,baby corn,tomato juice,oyster,cornflour,lemonade mix
title: Sara's Killer Corn in a Pate
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 package instant cornflour | 1/4 pint oyster, drained | 1/4 poblano peppers or 1/4 any other hot pepper | 1 package baby corn | 1 teaspoon chili powder | cooking spray | 1 -2 tablespoon lemonade mix
instructions: Place all ingredients on the food processor until just mixed. Pour into a glass or ceramic dish and mix with a spoon. Chill for 1 - 2 hours or until set. Turn out onto a platter and decorate with fresh slices of lemon and basil.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,chili pepper flake,prosciutto,cardamom seed,curry powder
title: Spicy Cardamom and Sweet Chilli Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 5 thin slices prosciutto ( thinly sliced, optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Serve as a condiment to your spicy snacks. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,ice water,heavy whipping cream,vanilla bean,kosher salt,jalapeno,almond,cocoa powder
title: Spicy Whipped Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup ice water | 1 jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped ( seeds scraped out of vanilla bean ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons finely chopped toasted almonds
instructions: Bring cream, cocoa, and ice water to simmer in a large saucepan over medium low heat. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bean scrapings to a bowl and set aside. Add jalapeno and vanilla bean seeds to cream mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until jalapenos are soft, about 2 minutes. Add salt to cream mixture and stir until mixture begins to simmer. Pour cream mixture into bowl with bean scrapings and cool to room temperature. Stir in garam masala. Transfer to a serving plate. Garnish with almonds.

title: Easy Mexican Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, tips trimmed to the tips | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1 tablespoon cinnamon sugar
instructions: Place wings in the crock of a slow cooker. Mix the creole seasoning with the chili paste. Brush onto all surfaces of the chicken wings. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar over the top. Cover and cook on low heat setting 11 to 12 hours. The chicken is done when tender and can easily be separated from its bone.. You may also use an oven dehydrator, which will dehydrate wings about 8 minutes per pound.

title: Garlic & Raisin Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 cups golden raisins | 1/2 cup seedless cucumber, in spears | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in large bowl with a generous amount of flour. May need a few shakes of lemon juice or even white pepper as the brandy has no fattening properties.

title: Quick and Easy Baked  Chicharrones (Chicharrones)
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 8 ounces sliced bacon or 8 ounces pancetta | 12 dates | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 14 -16 slices boneless veal shanks, sliced thin | pepperoni sausage or other spicy sausage, sliced thin | 12 -24 toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine first 5 ingredients in 9x13 inch baking dish. Place skewers on top. Cover with tin foil. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 - 12 minutes until crisp and toasted. Remove skewers from oven and turn over. Cover with foil an bake 15 - 20 minutes longer. Remove skewers from pan and set aside. Heat broiler. Cook bacon until crisp and crumbly. Reserve about 3 tablespoons bacon fat. In a pan, bring orange juice and broth to a boil and then strain into saucepan with reserved bacon fat. Simmer for 10 minutes. Spoon sauce over hot chicharrones. Arrange skewers on top of sauce and sprinkle with remaining bacon pieces. Place under broiler or in oven until heated through.

title: Yogurt Sundae
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vanilla yogurt ( no-fat or nonfat ) | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, finely chopped or 1/4 cup cilantro | 8 fresh basil leaves | 1/4 green onion | 2 teaspoons sherry wine or 2 teaspoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Beat together the yogurt and basil in a small nonreactive bowl. Stir in the onion or green onion and set aside. To serve, place 1 to 2 t. Of the sauce in the center of each serving plate or a bowl.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,reynolds wrap foil,dark brown sugar,tomato puree,serrano pepper,plum sauce,red wine,green olive
title: Caramelised Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup red wine ( not red grape juice ) | 1/2 cup plum sauce | 1 small tomatoes puree | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 large serrano pepper, seeded ( or 1 serrano pepper ) | reynolds wrap foil | 3 -4 green olives, halved
instructions: Combine vinegar, wine, plum sauce, tomato puree, brown sugar and minced serrano in a large sealable jar and shake to combine. Shake jar to combine. Pour into a small saucepan and heat to a boil. Remove from heat, cover and set aside to cool. Place olive halves on a foil sheet with sides or in a shallow roasting pan and cover with warm tomato sauce. Roast in a preheated oven, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 18 minutes or until blackened. Transfer to a food processor and puree, while still hot, into a sauceboat. Discard solids. Place sauce boat on a platter and remove foil. Spoon caramel sauce over the top and garnish with green olives.

title: Melted Arepas
ingredients: 12 anaheim chilies | 1 cup shortening | 2 tablespoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut open the chiles and remove the pods. Remove hard stem, lower chile pods and veins. If desired, press the pods through a food mill and extract seeds. Place the pepper pods on a sheet pan and sprinkle with a light layer of acesterscotch sesame oil or light cooking oil. Roast for 10 minutes, and turn with tongs. Roast for another 10 minutes. Remove chile skins from the pan with tongs and place in a bowl. Strain the water and set aside. Heat shortening in a heavy saucepan, until very hot. Add chile pods and cook over medium heat. Cook for about 3 minutes. Blend the peppers with lemon peel. Place in a warm serving bowl, pour the melted mixture over, and serve.

Random Ingredients: green bean,black eyed pea,bamboo skewer,broccoli,baby green,dark beer,onion salt
title: Holly's Baked Beer Baked Beans and Broccoli
ingredients: 16 bamboo skewers ( about 24 inches long ) | 1 package frozen broccoli, cut up | 2 cans black-eyed peas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 1/2 cups baby greens, cleaned and cut in half | 2 cups dark beer or 2 cups ale | 1/2 onion salt | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Sautéed Seitan With Cumin and Celery (Shanghai style)
ingredients: 500 g chicken | 4 celery ribs | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 400 g seitan, cut into cubes | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup ice
instructions: Cut the chicken pieces into bite sized pieces. Slice the celery. Put the chicken and celery in a pan together with the oil, vinegar and cummin. Mix well. Cook for 25mins. Drain the liquid, save the solids and leave as is. Return 1/2 cup water to pan, if needed to wash away the seasoning. Heat the seitan and bring to the boil in order to heat it through. Sprinkle with the spices. Serve in warm bowls and sprinkle with the reserved solids.

title: Nuoc Cham (Vietnamese Tomato Spread)
ingredients: 1 cup light sour cream or 1 cup vegan sour cream | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 1 tablespoon tomato puree, or to taste | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce, preferably nam pla ( or to taste )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the sour cream, green onions, tomato puree, and fish sauce until well blended. Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

title: Southern Fried Sandwich
ingredients: 1 can pork and chicken flavored sausage, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 1 large leaf lettuce | 1 3/4 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Cook and stir sausage in a skillet over medium heat until evenly brown. Place lettuce in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: celery,tahini,pork,mountain bread,french onion soup,dark chocolate,dark red kidney bean,vegetable oil
title: Mondongoère
ingredients: 500 g beef and pork mince | 500 g french onion soup | 1 liter vegetable oil | 200 g dried dark red kidney beans, soaked for 4 hours | 3 tablespoons tahini | 80 g dark chocolate | 1 large stalk celery, finely sliced | 1 loaf mountain bread, cut diagonally into chunks
instructions: In a pan, add the beef mince and brown quickly. Add the french onion soup and allow to boil. Add kidney beans and continue to boil. Add tahini and half of the chocolate. Continue to boil until it thickens. Add remainder of the chocolate and simmer over very low heat 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Put the loaf of mountain bread on a chopping board and add a little melted chocolate to the top. Cut into slices. Serve with spiced pitzi rice.

title: Homemade Flour Tortillas (Gets Vegan)
ingredients: 3 cups mixed flour ( can be made with plain flour, but i tend to use ap flour ) | 1/4 cup arrowroot
instructions: Mix together the flour and arrowroot. The flour will tend to stick to your hands if it begins to cling together, but eventually this should change to a batter that is a cohesive mass. It does stick a bit but you should be able to pull it out of the way of the batter after a few minutes. Heat a nonstick skillet on medium high. Once it's hot, you will need to add some vegetable shortening, or even a tad of ghee. Spread about 1 - 2 tbls. Of batter in the skillet, and spread out to cover the entire surface. When there is about 1 minute left of cooking time, it will begin looking to bubble around the edge. You want the tortillas to swell up a bit. Move the skillet to the table. Add 1 tbls. Of shortening/dripping and swirl to coat well. When the tortillas are bubbling again, use a spatula to transfer them to a plate or on wax paper or flour towel. Let cool slightly. Repeat steps 4 - 8 until all the flour and batter are used. Spread a sheet of wax paper or plastic wrap on your work surface. Use your hands to quickly and carefully peel the wax paper off your tortillas. Roll or fold one piece into a roll about a 1/4 inch thick and a half in size. Wrap in wax paper/plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour so the tortillas don't dry out. Cut in 1/4 to 1/2 in pieces and place on wax paper/plastic wrap. I like to use a vegetable peeler to wipe off excess paper or plastic wrap. I get a pretty messy round cookie cutter from a local pizza peel shop or a restaurant supply store. Gets perfect fest apx 12 14. Note, i sometimes use a food processor to prep all the ingredients for this recipe. I get about 12 - 15 pieces out of this recipe, depending on how you roll it. It seems that this can sometimes be a pain for your hands, so i tend to use 2 hands per recipe.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,cardamom,dijon mustard,club soda,ice water,daikon radish
title: Fresh Daikon Radish Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 large daikon radishes | kosher salt | 4 -6 large ice cubes | 1/2 cup coarse dry mustard | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Peel the daikon, trim off the ends and the hard outer layer with a sharp knife. Cut the daikon crosswise into 1/4 inch wide slices, then cut slices crosswise into 1 1/2 inch slices. Heat a skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Season the radish slices with kosher salt. Cook the daikon slices until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Transfer the radishes to a plate lined with paper towels. Drain on paper towels. In a small bowl, combine the mustards, cardamom, and ½ cup of the dijon, and stir until well combined. Add the mustard and stir well until the mustard is thoroughly incorporated, about ¼ minute. Add the radishes and continue to stir. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: green olive,sage leaf,cod fish fillet,curd cottage cheese,red chili pepper flake,lobster tail,olive oil
title: Lobster and Cod Baked in Pasta With Green Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 4 medium lobster tails | 5 large fresh sage leaves | 15 -20 large green olives ( i use pimiento stuffed ) | 1 tablespoon dried red chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dried crushed red chili pepper flakes | 300 300 low fat small curd cottage cheese or 300 low fat cottage cheese | 2 lbs cod fish fillets or 2 lbs shrimp, cleaned and uncooked, peeled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Pour a small amount of olive oil into an oven dish, large enough to cover the bottom of the dish. Cut the lobster tails and sage into 2 inch lengths. If using shrimp, remove shells and rinse with cold water. Slice the heads and leaves to form rough little wedges. Add the chiles and toasted chile and chili flakes in a large bowl. Remove the tails and set aside. Wash the sage and put it into a separate bowl. Put out the oven on the stovetop on medium. Squeeze the shells of the lobster and sage, if using, into a bowl. Put a small handful of the spiced herbs in the bottom of the bowl, add the shrimp and shellfish, then sprinkle them with the dried red peppers, and continue to toss into the bowl. Drain the pasta, then put it into the oven, and bake uncovered in 450f oven for 10 to 12 minutes, tossing a few times, or until the lobster meat is cooked through and the pasta is warmed through. Toss everything together thoroughly to coat evenly and place into individual bowls.. Top with crumbled cottage cheese and serve immediately.

title: Homemade Chilies
ingredients: 2 inches dried red chilies | 12 ounces craisins ( candied choc bits ) | 4 teaspoons smoked paprika ( or hot pepper, spice mixture )
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the red chilies and craisins. If using hot pepper, leave out. If using paprika, sprinkle or rub the chilies onto your hands to make them pliable and easy to handle. They may look a bit messy but are not. If you wish, rub the chilies onto your hands to release the aroma. When all the chilies are mixed together, transfer to your kitchen towel and press out excess moisture leaving about 6 - 7 cups of air in the bowl. Cover with a towel and set aside for 10 minutes. Rinse the chilies thoroughly under warm running water. The best way to do this is to place a bowl of cold tap water in nearby nearby a pan of water, as well as a bowl of ice water and a bowl of ice cubes. Bring water to boil and then stir in the water/ice mixture into the chilies. The chilies should be soft and moist. Once the water is at a boil, you need to reduce the heat and simmer the chilies a little longer before adding the paprika. If it starts to dry out just add a bit more water. The chilies should look moist and somewhat dry. Let chilies cool to room temperature before storing in an airtight container until you are ready to eat them. Store chilies in the fridge until use, or you can freeze them up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,polish sausage,brioche bread,pork tenderloin,oil
title: Crispy Baked Polish Sausages (CSAK)
ingredients: 4 ounces pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 4 links polish sausage, cooked | 1 cup prepared pico de gallo | 3 cups dry polenta meal ( made with the flour and salt ) | 1/2 cup oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Spray pam on a large baking sheet and arrange the sliced pork. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes. Remove and set aside while making polenta and polenta and polenta. In a bowl, mix together the polenta meal and oil. Pour polenta into a piping bag and use a pastry tube to pipe in a little of the polenta mixture onto the hot baking sheet. Flip and repeat until entire tray is covered. Place the sausage on top of the polenta and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until hot and crisp. While the sausage is baking, remove the brita dough from the oven and allow it to cool. When sausage is cool cut in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Drizzle sausage with pico de gallo and allow to set. This helps set the juices. Cut the sausage across the grain into pieces just a few inches long. Arrange sausage on a plate, cover with foil and refrigerate until serving time. Serve.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,cumin,avocado,baby spinach,ice,chicken drumstick,buttermilk,ranch dressing mix
title: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup ranch dressing mix | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 4 pounds chicken drumsticks, cut into pieces | 1 package baby spinach, washed and drained | 1 large avocado - peeled, pitted, and cut into small chunks | 1 box ice | 1/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: In saucepan of boiling water, cook ranch dressing mix, bay leaf and cumin until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Drain. Arrange chicken in a 10x15 inch baking dish. Cover with layers of spinach, avocados and ice. Pour dressing over the top. Cover and chill overnight. In a small bowl, stir together buttermilk and 1/4 cup water. Spoon over chicken and serve.

title: Peach and Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 300 g beef chuck roast, cut into chunks | 1 large ripe peach, stones removed and cut into chunks | 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeds removed and cut into chunks | 12 wooden skewers
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large roasting tin, cover, and cook in a preheated oven about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender and vegetables are tender. To serve skewers should not be crowded or they will burn during cooking. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Souvlaki
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons light olive oil | 1/4 cup cognac
instructions: Place all ingredients into a medium hot pan and toast slowly, or over a medium to high heat, stirring constantly. Note,. To reduce sauce, substitute water. Serve straight away. If to keep warm longer than the time listed in the description, add a small amount of canned tomato juice or 1 teaspoon of rum to sweeten before serving.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,monterey jack cheese,almond extract,chocolate,carrot,worcestershire sauce
title: The Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 3 carrots, cut into thin bite-sized strips | 3 ounces unsweetened chocolate | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 romaine lettuce, torn | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place carrots in an iveiveiveggy 3 quart microwave safe bowl. Microwave uncovered on high until softened, about 1 minute. Cool slightly. Place chocolate in microwave safe bowl. Cover bowl and microwave on med. Power until melted, 3 - 4 minutes. Mix in worcestershire sauce, almond extract and cooled carrots. Cover and chill for 1 - 2 hours. Place romaine lettuce in a serving bowl. Stir together monterey jack and cheese. Pour mixture over the romaine and serve.

title: Corned Beef and Cucumber Sandwiches (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, trimmed and cut into 4 equal pieces | 1 cup cucumber, cut into chunks | 1 loaf long thin slices of crusty whole grain bread
instructions: Put the sirloin tip in the crock of a slow cooker. Place the cucumbers over the top of the steak. Top with the remaining sliced beef. Cover and cook on low setting for 6 - 8 hours, or until meat is tender enough to shred with a fork and vegetables are tender. Remove beef and vegetables but save broth for sandwiches, discard liquid. Pull meat out of crock and shred with 2 forks. Pour broth back into the crock and discard vegetables, vegetables and broth from beef and vegetables. Serve over toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,rice wine,apple cider,portabella mushroom,shrimp,cayenne pepper
title: Baked Shrimp with Portabella Mushroom
ingredients: 5 large portabella mushrooms, trimmed, cap left on and sliced | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 lb shrimp, peeled, deveined and shelled | 3/4 cup apple cider | 3 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons rice wine ( or mirin, not dry sherry )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Cut off ends of mushroom caps and remove stems. Place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cayenne or black sesame seeds and toss to coat. Add shrimp in a single layer. Combine cider and 2 tbsp sesame seeds and stir into shrimp with onions. Toss again, coating all shrimp. Pour half of wine in a 13x9x2 baking dish and transfer mushrooms in the baking dish. Bake, stirring mushrooms and wine, for 15 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked through. Stir shrimp mixture and remaining wine into shrimp mixture. Cook, stirring, 1 more minute. Spoon shrimp mixture evenly over vegetables. Cover with foil and bake for 10 minutes, then remove foil and bake for an additional 3 - 4 minutes, or until shrimp are just cooked through. Sprinkle over reserved sesame seeds and serve immediately. Serve shrimp and sauce separately.

title: Irish Blackberry Fool (Or Dessert)
ingredients: 20 fresh blackberries, hulled ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons bailey's irish cream ( i actually like starbucks brand ) | 2 -3 tablespoons granulated sugar, for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Place berries into a small mixing bowl. Sprinkle sugar over berries and mash well with a fork. Cover with a dish towel and set aside to let bugs to macerate until serving. Dust with bailey's or other coffee flavored sugar if desired.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,apricot preserve,pecorino romano cheese,farfalle pasta,milk,cheddar cheese
title: Farfalle With Creamy Cheddar Crumble
ingredients: 3 cups farfalle pasta | 1 1/2 cups low-fat cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup reduced-fat sour milk | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons self raising flour | 1 tablespoon apricot preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c and grease a shallow baking dish. Cook pasta, according to pack instructions, in rapidly boiling water, then drain. Stir together cheddar and sour milk in a bowl. Stir flour and cheese in another bowl, then stir through pasta and cheese mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish, then top with preserves, then bake in preheated 180°c oven for 25 minutes or until golden.

title: Lemongrass and Apple Crumb Topping for Vegetables
ingredients: 8 slices firm white bread, crusts removed | 1 large egg yolk | 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass | cooking apple, eg.granny smith, sliced | 8 slices firm firm white mushrooms | 6 slices soft fresh bread, crusts removed, cubed to 3/4-inch thick | 1/4 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Place bread in a single layer on prepared baking sheet. In a small bowl, whisk together egg yolk, lemongrass, and 1 tablespoon water, and brush onto untoasted bread slices. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake in preheated oven for 2 minutes. Remove from the oven. Slices should be slightly crusty and golden, and there should be no crust. Place sliced mushrooms on top of the baked crumbs. Place cubed bread on top. Sprinkle top with chopped pecans. Bake for about 8 to 12 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: nonfat cream,pea carrot,vanilla bean,taco seasoning mix,pepperoni sausage
title: Mexican Tater Pies (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 3/4 cup frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1/4 cup fat free sour cream ( nonfat is best ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 4 ounces pepperoni sausage, thinly sliced | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375'f. Place peas and carrot in a microwave safe bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high, power shaking the bowl often, until carrots are tender crisp, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Basic Chickpea Ananas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare baking sheet by lining with parchment paper or a silicon mat. Add baking soda in a small bowl. Rinse and drain garbanzo beans. Spread out the soaked garbanzo beans. Fold in the palms to form a cone with the shape of a cone. Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes. Remove when warm.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,thyme,fontina cheese,cracker,poultry seasoning,cream cottage cheese
title: Tilapia With Creamy Cheese and Herbs
ingredients: 1 lb tilapia fillet | 2 cups cream-style cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh thyme | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in tilapia fillet and cook for 4 to 5 minutes. Add cottage cheese, thyme and parsley.

Random Ingredients: shallot,cumin seed,white pepper,liquid smoke,button mushroom,lebanese cucumber,capicola
title: Stir Fry Capicola
ingredients: 8 slices lebanese cucumbers | 8 medium button mushrooms | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke, from capicola jar
instructions: Cut capicola into 1/3 inch slices. Heat oil on medium high in wok or skillet. Add capicola and mushroom. Stir fry for 4 minutes or until mushrooms are soft. Remove from heat. Add shallots. Season with cumin seeds, liquid smoke and pepper. Add cuke. Serve immediately.

title: Prawns in a Yoghurt and Spice Sauce
ingredients: 400 g ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon cumin or 1 teaspoon a mixture of your own spices, to your own taste | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | 1 cup rolled oats bran | saltine crackers, crushed
instructions: Mix together the ricotta, lemon pepper, cumin and cornflour until well combined. You can use an electric hand held blender. Add rolled oats bran and crushed crackers. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Cook your prawns in a little oil or butter in a non stick pan. Keep the prawns warm in a low oven while you make the sauce.

title: Simple, Super Delicious, and Delicious Chocolate Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 yellow onion, medium, chopped | 1 cup vegetable broth ( or water ) | 1/3 cup dark chocolate chips | 1 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Over medium heat add the margarine and onion to a medium sized saucepan over medium heat and cook until the onions begin to brown. Add the stock and chocolate to the pan and heat to a boil. When the chocolate is melted, add the lettuce, stirring to heat everything up a bit. Serve with shredded lettuce.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,bean navy,turkey,rice wine vinegar,maple syrup,white pepper
title: Smoked Turkey and Maple Roasted Bean-N-White Casserole
ingredients: 1 medium smoked turkey | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup fat free sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 pinch cream of tartar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Place the turkey breast side up on a baking sheet and. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown and just cooked through. Transfer the turkey to a bowl. When cool enough to handle, cut it into 2 thick slices. Place the roasting pan on the back burner and place it over medium low heat. Whisk in the vinegar, maple syrup, and sour cream. Mix in the pepper and cream of tartar just before removing from the heat. Arrange the turkey slices over the roasting pan. Drizzle the juices from the pan over the turkey, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,spanish onion,self raising flour,lemon,black pepper,oregano,maple syrup,beef steak
title: Lemon Roast Beef With Red Gravy
ingredients: 500 g beef steaks | 1 spanish onion, sliced | 1 teaspoon oregano | sea salt black pepper | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 6 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 lemon | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/gas mark 1/ place the meat onto a rack in a roasting tin and bake for 20 minutes at 190c/gas mark 2/ in a roasting tin, brown onion and oregano under a high heat in the oil for about 5 minutes add the maple syrup and turn the meat, cook for another 10 minutes add the lemon juice and black pepper to taste cook for 10 minutes take the pan off the heat and allow to stand for 10 minutes. Place meat onto two serving plates, top with gravy. Place 2 slices of lemon and 2 lemon slices over meat. Serve with boiled potatoes and seasonal vegetables.

instructions: In a mixing bowl stir together the coconut paste, coconut and the vodka. Allow to sit for 10 minutes at room temperature. Pour the sugar in, stir and taste.

title: Broiled Peas

instructions: Combine ketchup, cream, and barley in a saucepan. Cook over medium low heat until bubbles rise, and then bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and stir in oyster sauce. Transfer to a small serving bowl, cover, and chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

instructions: Pour the kidney beans into a medium saucepan & cook till soft. Remove from heat & drain off excess water. Combine the biscuits & cream in a bowl & mix well. instructions: Toss the thyme with the swordfish strips to coat. instructions: Pre heat the oven to 375 degrees. Combine the beans, chili sauce, mustard seeds and tomato puree in a saucepan. Cook, covered, over low heat until hot, then reduce the heat to simmer. instructions: Place chicken breast on platter. Add remaining ingredients into saucepan and heat to boiling. Turn down and simmer 5 minutes. Pour over chicken and cook 20 minutes, or until coating is bubbly.

title: Toor Dal and Marsala Wine Sorbet

instructions: In a medium size non aluminum saucepan, gently toast dal until it starts to turn dark yellow. Turn and toast until other side is brown. Turn off heat and let mixture sit for 30 - 30 minutes. Transfer to blender or food processer and process until mixture is smooth but not liquefied. Transfer to the bowl of a food processor and add 1 cup of soaking liquid and process until smooth. Add 4 cups of soaking liquid and process again until mixture is smooth, but not liquefied. Transfer mixture to an airtight container and freeze until mixture is frozen for up to 1 month.

title: Aubergine Fried Capidot
ingredients: 1/4 cup margarine | 1 lb yam ( peeled, sliced in half ) | 1/2 lb cornstarch | 1 lb masa harina | 4 tablespoons white cornmeal | 1 ounce japanese eggplant, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips ( about 20 ) | 24 tortillas | cornstarch, for brushing
instructions: Melt margarine in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium high heat. Cut yam into 1/4 inch cubes and place in skillet. Sprinkle with salt after 5 minutes. Add eggplant and saute until eggplant begins to soften. Remove eggplant and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix cornmeal, masa harina and 1/4 cup oil. Stir into eggplant mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 1 minute. Place one tortilla in a hot dry skillet and brush with some of the remaining oil. Cook until just soft, but not cooked through. Do not over cook the tortilla. Serve with a combination of fried pieces of eggplant and eggplant pieces.

title: Poppy Joes III

instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the peach juice, molasses, apples and savory. Spoon enough yoghurt into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish to cover. Place poppy joes in the dish. Continue layering until the top has been covered with liquid and filling is used. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Slice and serve hot.

title: Wild Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb wild mushroom | dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons turmeric
instructions: Remove any stems from the wild mushrooms and slice them to about the thickness of your thumb. Place the sliced mushrooms into a bowl or baking tin. Sprinkle liberally with half of the mustard. Pour over half of the turmeric. Serve. Note, if you are making this in advance, remove the meat from the wild mushrooms and slice them to the thickness of your thumb. It might not be necessary to do this. Cook in a pan with boiling water approximately 30 - 40 minutes. Strain, remove seeds and skin from the mushrooms. Place on a paper towel lined plate, cover and then allow to drain. Place into a blender or food processer and blend until smooth and creamy. Add the rest of the mustard and turmeric. Blend again until smooth and creamy. Place into a jug and whisk slowly into the mushroom gravy until desired thickness is achieved.

instructions: Mix melted chocolate chips with orange juice concentrate, peppercorns, mixed herbs and coconut milk.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cucumber with the asiago cheese and add the apple juice, grand marnier and enough apple juice to make the granita consistency of a loose creamy consistency. Serve at once or refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: oyster,beef bouillon,yellow bell pepper,poblano chile,italian parsley,gruyere cheese,italian sausage link
title: Gruyere and Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large fresh mushrooms | 1 pound italian sausages, casings removed | 1 pound hot italian sausage links, casings removed | 1 large yellow bell pepper, diced | 1 cup chopped italian parsley, chopped | 1 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese | 2 1/2 cubes beef bouillon, or more as needed | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Clean mushrooms with a damp cloth. Lay a towel on a work surface, and place 1/2 cup of dried mushrooms in the work area. Wrap each mushroom in a strip of cheesecloth, tie with kitchen twine, and fill with sausage and sausages.

Random Ingredients: watercress,raisin,tarragon leaf,avocado,sharp cheddar cheese,matzo farfel,chicken,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Passover Arrabbiata
ingredients: 1/4 cup raisins | 4 ripe avocados, peeled ( halved ) | 2 matzos farfel | 1 1/2 cups watercress | 1 bunch fresh tarragon leaf, chopped | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/8 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian thyme leaves ( optional ) | 3 -4 tablespoons shredded sharp cheddar cheese, if desired | chopped fresh dill ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place raisins in small bowl and cover with warm water. Let stand 15 minutes. Cut avocados in half and remove pit. Scoop out flesh from each avocado half. Combine with other ingredients. Transfer to a shallow serving dish. Sprinkle with cheese and dill, if desired. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Serve with warm harissa if desired. Note, the arrabbiata can be made ahead and frozen for up to 5 days.

title: Roasted Chilli Salmon
ingredients: 100 g frozen red salmon | 40 g lemon juice | 2 dried red chiles
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°c. Spread salmon with lemon juice, and sprinkle with chili. Roast the salmon in the oven about 20 minutes, or until crisp and just cooked through.

title: Cheesy Sausage
ingredients: 2 pounds swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons chili seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix swiss cheese, chili seasoning mix and 1/2 cup water in a 9x5 inch glass baking dish. Cut sausage into 3 or 4 slices. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly, approximately 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,carrot,vermicelli,white truffle oil,rosemary sprig,irish whiskey
title: Irish Root Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 2 ounces dried vermicelli | 2 ounces curd cottage cheese ( can also use cream cheese ) | 2 tablespoons white truffle oil ( can add more if desired ) | 1 small carrot, grated | 1 rosemary sprig, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons irish whiskey
instructions: Soak vermicelli for 30 minutes, drain. Cover with boiling water and bring back to boil. Drain, allow to cool for 2 - 3 minutes then drain again. Add cottage cheese to boiling water and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes until cooked through. Drain and put into a bowl. Add a little bit more truffle oil if desired and add grated carrot. Pour in enough whiskey to create a smooth sauce. Mix well. Add in vermicelli, rosemary sprig and the drained cottage cheese. Mix thoroughly, serve immediately.

title: Gingerbread
ingredients: 1 jar dark corn syrup | 3 ounces worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot
instructions: Mix all together in pan and heat to boiling. Pour into a greased tin. Bake at 170 c for 15 minutes turning frequently. Cool.

title: Tomato Coconut Chutney
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened coconut cream | 1/2 cup canned tomato sauce | 1 green cardamom, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Heat the coconut cream in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat and stir in the tomato sauce. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Uncover and continue cooking until mixture begins to thicken, stirring frequently. Remove from heat, and stir in the cardamom.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,cream mushroom soup,thyme leaf
title: Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and press mixture into a 9x13 inch dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: hot water,sherry vinegar,tortilla,linguine,mexican cheese,tomato,dill weed,chicken bouillon
title: Tortilla Beef Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs beef top sirloin, cut into 1 1/2 inch strips | 2 cans stewed tomatoes, undrained | 4 cups hot water | 5 teaspoons chicken bouillon, crushed | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1/4 cup sherry vinegar | 8 ounces dry linguine | shredded mexican cheese, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a 4 cup nonstick saucepan, combine meat, tomatoes, hot water, bouillon, dill weed and sherry. Heat over medium heat, stirring frequently, until hot and bubbly. Cook linguine according to package directions, drain and rinse under cold water.

title: BBQ Cucumber Clam Salad
ingredients: 5 cucumbers, peeled and quartered | 1/2 cup bottled bottled clam juice | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 10 sprigs fresh thyme | 1/4 cup fresh dill weed | 1 bottle clam juice, or as needed
instructions: Toss cucumbers with clam juice in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,maui onion,garbanzo bean,self raising flour,ranch dressing,red chili powder,epazote,cornflour
title: Quick Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 1 cup garbanzo beans | 2 large eggplants | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 teaspoons self raising flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried epazote | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 small maui onion | 2 tablespoons red chili powder
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Cut the eggplants into chunks. Using a spoon scoop out most of the maui onion and set aside. Add a tablespoon of oil to a fry pan and add the chopped onion and eggplants. Fry for 5 minutes stirring the mixture constantly. Add the 2 pinches salt and 1 teaspoon of pepper. Fry for another 2 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan now add 2 cups of water and red chili powder. Add the chickpeas and fry for 5 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes or until the chickpeas are cooked. Serve with rice or chapaties.

Random Ingredients: harissa,tortilla,maraschino cherry,catsup,cabbage,egg white,cilantro leaf,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Tortilla Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup cabbage, finely shredded | 12 large tortillas | 1 egg white | 1 1/2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1 cup maraschino cherry, crushed | fresh cilantro leaves, to garnish
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f put cabbage in a bowl. Add salt, pepper and 1 tbsp of the cheese.

title: Homemade Roasted Chiles
ingredients: 1 can chipotle chiles | 2 cups oleo
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and lightly grease a 5 1/2 quart baking dish. In a large bowl, mash chipotle chiles with potato masher until ground into a coarse powder. Stir about 2 tablespoons oleo into the ground chipotle powder until completely incorporated, about 1 tablespoons. Spread mixture on top of the chile base and sides of the dish. Smooth the top with a spatula so chiles won't stick, place in oven and roast until golden and a knife inserted into the center comes out clean, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Roasted Fresh Tomatoes for Antrimsics
ingredients: 8 ounces ro tel tomatoes | 1 cardamom pod, cracked open
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f rub rimmed baking sheet with spice grinder, or with metal spatula. Remove tomatoes from jar and discard jar. Put the tomatoes into a bowl, and rub with the cardamon. Transfer the tomatoes to the prepared sheet and bake for 20 minutes. Cool and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,mandarin orange,mascarpone cheese,rice wine vinegar,wheat bran,no salt tomato sauce,risotto rice,taco seasoning mix
title: Healthy Tempered Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons low-sodium tamarind-flavoured soy sauce | 2 tablespoons no-added-salt tomato sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons low-sodium taco seasoning mix ( gluten-free ) | 1/4 cup no-salt-added whole wheat bran | 1 package instant risotto rice or ( 16 ounce ) package carnaroli rice | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped | 1 package low-sodium mascarpone cheese, at room temperature
instructions: In a large glass or ceramic bowl, stir together the rice vinegar, tamarind flavoured soy sauce, tomato sauce mix and taco seasoning mix. Stir in the bran and rice and toss well. The rice can be made up to 2 days ahead and stored in the refrigerator. Bring the rice to room temperature about 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red potato,baking potato,deli ham,marinara sauce,okra,half,serrano chilies,farfalle pasta
title: Greek Seafood Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 lb deli ham, cut into thin bite size pieces | 1 package farfalle pasta | 1/2 large red potatoes, diced | 8 ounces okra, sliced or diced | 8 ounces sweet baking potatoes, diced | 2 cans deli hake and bay shrimp ( or use another brand if you prefer ) | 1 1/2 dozen small red hot peppers or 1 1/2 large serrano chilies, chopped | 1 can marinara sauce
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. In a large skillet over medium heat fry bacon, ham and okra until bacon pieces are lightly browned. Add potatoes, chilies, marinara and simmer until well combined. Remove from heat. Drain pasta, return to pan, place shrimp on top. Plate, pour shrimp over all and top with a sprinkling of the monterrey's monterrey cheese.

title: Aubergines (Eggplant) Steak
ingredients: 1 large aubergine, sliced into circles | 3 capsicums, sliced | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom seed | 8 steaks
instructions: Preheat an oven to 200c or 130c fan forced. Line a shallow, shallow roasting tin with baking paper. Place the aubergine and capsicums onto the roasting tray, drizzle over the lemon rind and amaretto and sprinkle over the ground cardamom. Place each steak on top of the aubergine and capsicum and spoon over the herb marinade to cover both. Leave to stand for 10 minutes. Score the steaks with a knife and set aside for 5 - 10 minutes. Bake for 5 - 6 minutes a side or until cooked to your liking.

title: Ouzo Chocolate Sauce 2
ingredients: 300 g toblerone chocolate bars | 1 tablespoon ouzo
instructions: Grate the toblerone chocolate. Melt the ouzo and pour over hot chocolate. Stir until it melts and gets a little frothy, then enjoy note i use the toblerone for an old family trick. I add 2 tsp of salt and 1 tsp of black pepper to the mix in every bite. If i am making this too creamy, then i will use up the ouzo before adding the ouzo.

title: Butternut Squash With Mustard, Chilli and Butternut
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili peppers, optional
instructions: Cut a few slits in the peel and core, trimming off ends and scoop out the seeds. Cook in a large saucepan of boiling water for about 20 minutes, until the squash is just tender. Drain, mash with a potato masher and add all remaining ingredients. Place on a serving dish, mix well. Serve with crusty bread or roasted vegetables of your choice.

title: Mexican Melon
ingredients: 1 melon, ripe, medium-sized | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Cut melon in half, then peel off pit. Remove flesh and reserve shells. Slice melon into chunks about 1 wide. Combine melon chunks and tomatoes in an electric bowl. Sprinkle with cocoa. Serve.

title: Mujadarra
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice | 2 cups water | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring water, rice, vegetable oil, and turmeric to a boil. Cover, and reduce heat to low. Simmer 25 minutes, or until all water is absorbed. Serve immediately.

title: Caraway(Potted Mustard) Welsh
ingredients: 2 ounces spicy brown mustard | 5 fluid ounces golden syrup | 5 fluid ounces strong hot spicy brown mustard
instructions: Put the mustard in a bowl, pour in the golden syrup and sweet pepper to taste then mix well. Pour into sterilized jars leaving 2½ inches headspace. Seal and process for 15 minutes. Store in a cool dark place. Use the same method as above.

title: Pork Spareribs
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread | 2 lbs pork spareribs, cooked and shredded
instructions: Butter a baking dish, and place the bread slices on it. Mix the pork spareribs. Spread the spareribs on top of the bread. Bake in a 375°f oven for 5 hours uncovered. Serve with meat gravy, rice, or mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,oil black olive,yukon gold potato,flat leaf parsley,veal,green chilies
title: Agnello Con Salvia (Tamarind Potato Salad With Meat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, boiled and chopped | 3 green chilies | 3/4 lb ground veal | 1 cup tamarind pulp, drained | 10 -12 anchovies packed in oil, drained ( optional ) | 1/3 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped ( garnish ) | oil ( for deep frying, if available )
instructions: In a mortar or blender, mash green chilies, potatoes and chilies together. In a large bowl, mix veal, pulp, anchovies and parsley. With floured hands, shape potatoes into little round balls. Heat oil to 375 degrees fahrenheit in deep fryer or deep fryer. Fry the meat until browned on all sides, about half an inch each. Serve hot, garnished with sprigs of parsley.

Random Ingredients: banana,olive oil,vanilla,beef sirloin steak,active yeast,straw mushroom,mint leaf
title: Straw Hats
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast or 1 package frozen yeast | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 2 lbs beef top sirloin steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup olive oil or 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1/2 pint whole pickled whole mushrooms, drained and rinsed well | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In a large bowl or resealable plastic bag, dissolve yeast in the warm water. Cover and let stand 5 - 8 minutes to soften. Remove 1 cup warm water. Add the beef and toss to coat. Cover and let stand until the meat is nearly cooked, about 5 - 10 minutes. Drain off excess water. Return to a warm place and add oil and mushrooms. Turn the heat down to a slow simmer. Toss gently. If you like your mushrooms crispier, stir in more water. Cover and let stand 10 minutes, stirring once. Add mint and vanilla. Cover and let stand for 20 minutes. Turn off heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,red grape,curd cottage cheese,chicken,taco seasoning
title: Grape Avocado Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 cup small curd cottage cheese | 8 ounces shredded rotisserie chicken | 1 packet taco seasoning, divided | 1 1/2 cups diced red grapes | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Mix cottage cheese, chicken, 1 cup taco seasoning, and red grapes together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,mint leaf,coriander powder,vegetable shortening,cumin powder,root beer
title: Root Beer (Savoury Beef) Filets
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin ( any piece of beef ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 14 leaves fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup root beer
instructions: Cut meat into serving sized filets, about 2 1/2 inches long, and marinate overnight in a mixture of the salt, vegetable shortening and spices. If necessary, add a tablespoon of water to the marination liquid to keep its flavor. Drain meat and pat dry. Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange meat on a rack in a pan. Roast for about 30 minutes or until desired doneness. While meat is roasting, make root beer, and remove any pits from the mint leaves by rubbing them on the surface of the meat with your fingers. Pour root beer into a large glass bowl and set aside. In a medium bowl, toss meat with the reserved mint leaves. When the meat is done, remove from oven, and cover to keep warm. Brush the meat with remaining 1/2 cup of the root beer and serve with the root beer.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,oatmeal,red onion,pinto bean,black olive,chicken broth,lime wedge
title: Oatmeal Taco Skillet
ingredients: 1 teaspoon quick oatmeal | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1/3 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/3 cup sliced black olives | 1/3 cup chopped red onion | 1/3 cup crumbled oatmeal | 1/4 cup chopped green bell pepper | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Stir in the oatmeal. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until browned, about 1 minute. Stir in broth and beans. Bring to a boil, then stir in the green pepper and olives. Heat through. Stir in the oatmeal. Cover and heat for about 5 minutes. Top with more red bell pepper flakes if desired. Sprinkle the oatmeal onto your choice of portions.

title: Black Beans and Bread
ingredients: 1 bag dried black beans | 1/2 loaf whole wheat bread, cut into 8 slices
instructions: Preheat the oven at 250 f in a large bowl, place the beans and bread together, spread them over a roasting rack in an unlined or deep roasting pan. Bake, stirring occasionally, for at least 6 hours or overnight.

title: Maple Pate
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: Cut veal into bite size pieces and saute in 2 tbsp maple syrup. When meat is done and seared add 1/4 cup maple syrup. Put into paper cake pan. Top with 1 tsp maple syrup if you so desire. I use the whole stick of maple on top. Let cool completely on the counter before cutting into squares and serving.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 3 ripe italian tomatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons margarine | 3/4 cup fat-free low-sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon vinegar, to taste | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: Core tomatoes, cut up into small pieces. In a large skillet heat margarine. Add tomatoes and cook over medium heat about 5 minutes. Add chicken broth, vinegar, and orange zest. Cover and cook about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add beans.

Random Ingredients: tuna steak,ancho chile powder,beef brisket,cabbage leaf,jumbo shrimp,coriander,celery seed,icing sugar
title: Seared Beef Brisket with Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 16 large raw jumbo shrimp, peeled deveined | 7 -8 beef brisket, trimmed of all fat, flattened into 4 patties | 1/3 cup icing sugar ( confectioners'sugar ) | coriander, chopped ( to garnish ) | 2 tablespoons achi chile powder | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 4 cabbage leaves ( to garnish ) | 24 small dried ancho chiles, stems and seeds removed ( can substitute small dried chipotle peppers )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut patties in half lengthwise and then in half again lengthwise. Spread 1 1/2 tbsp icing sugar all over each patty, then spread lightly with achi powder. Place, side by side, on a piece of wire rack over a baking sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes until tender and golden. Meanwhile, remove beef from packet and allow it to rest for 15 minutes. To make noodles, soak chiles in a small bowl of hot water for 30 minutes, then drain. Heat remaining icing sugar and achi chile powder in a heavy bottomed saucepan, stirring constantly until it dissolves. Add coriander and celery seeds to the saucepan and stir. Turn heat down to low and allow to cook, stirring frequently, for about 5 minutes, until the mixture is bubbly and starting to thicken. Remove from heat. Heat a small saute pan over high heat and lightly oil the insides of the rack with vegetable oil. Quickly sear the shrimp in batches just until golden. Drain on kitchen towel and sprinkle with achi powder, then allow them to cool slightly. When all the grilling is completed, remove racks from baking sheet and set aside. Cook noodles according to package directions, then spread a piece of meat on top. Ladle 1/3 of sauce over the meat and shrimp, then scatter with a spoonful of chopped coriander and serve.

title: Pot Sticks
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped shiitake mushrooms ( about 1/4 pound ) | 2 tablespoons shortening | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | crouton, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix mushrooms, shortening, and caraway seeds. Stir in vinegar. Roll into 1 inch balls. Arrange on a parchment lined baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and keep at room temperature 1 to 2 hours. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven until tender, about 20 minutes. Serve with croutons.

title: Dutch Baby Spinach
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots, washed and trimmed | 2 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place carrots in a large baking sheet with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Add enough water to cover carrots. Bring back to a boil and simmer until tender, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain. In a medium bowl combine cheese with the bread crumbs. Spoon spinach mixture into the cheese. Bake on a large, greased baking sheet 15 minutes, until bubbly. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage Sticks
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 6 slices italian bread | 1/2 cup double cream | 2 pieces orange peel, about to leave a bit of grated peel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cut the sausage in half and arrange the slices on a paper towels to drain excess fat. Place the bread onto a baking sheet and soak them in the cream until pliable like wet sand. Drain the bread of any excess water but keep the bread soft and dry on your cutting board. Cut each slice in half and form sticks about 1 inch wide by 2 inches long. Insert 3 orange peel pieces on each piece of bread and place them on the baking sheet that the sausage was soaked in. Bake for at least an hour or until the bread is dry but not brown. Serve hot or cold.

title: Scrub Dogs
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup sea salt | 2 tablespoons gherkin, finely chopped | 4 cups rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Wrap brown sugar, salt, gherkin slices, and vinegar in aluminum foil. Bake for 1 hour. Stir, then bake for 1 more hour. Allow oven to cool for 15 minutes. Unwrap and break apart, and store in an airtight plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,thyme leaf,ginger,italian sausage,blueberry,streaky bacon,poblano pepper
title: Pork and Blueberry Chops
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cracked wheat bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 2 slices streaky bacon, roughly chopped | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | 4 thick, boneless pork loin chops | 1 cup halved fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Combine the bread crumbs, thyme, ginger, bacon pepper, poblano pepper, and pork loin chops in a shallow baking dish or plate. Arrange the pork chops on the hot grate, and top with the blueberries. Cook until slightly charred on the edges, 4 to 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,cavatelli,sharp cheddar cheese,cumin powder,vodka,lemon juice zest,tomato juice,pork tenderloin
title: Cavatelli and Pork With Avocado Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb dried cavatelli | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 1 1/4 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into bite sized pieces | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/3 cup chopped pistachios | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, drain oil from pan. Place pork and cumin. Toss with pasta until coated. Place drained pasta in a large serving platter. Drain pork. Pour vodka over pasta. Add lemon juice and peel. Toss lightly with cheese. Serve in lettuce lined martini glasses, passing any additional garnishes at table.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,quinoa,sea salt,hamburger,beef stock,chicken bouillon,cream mushroom soup
title: Beef & Quinoa Stuffed Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 -3 cups cooked beef, finely diced | 12 ounces smoked hamburger, finely diced | 2 tablespoons dried saffron strands | 2 2 cups raw quinoa or 2 cups regular quinoa | 2 cups reduced-sodium fat-free cream of mushroom soup | 1 -3 teaspoon chicken bouillon, finely minced or 1 -3 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons fine grain sea salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a frying pan, fry the saffron and meat on medium to high heat until the meat is browned and the saffron is crispy. If a little brown, you probably got too much oil in the pan. Add the soup to the meat and bring to a boil. Drain the meat off. Add the rice and saffron and stir until all the grains are coated evenly with the soup. Mix it all together, making sure all the grains are covered in the soup mixture. You don't want to mash or mush the rice too much. Mix in the beef & quinoa. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Cover and put in oven. After 45 mins or so, remove lid and roast about 15 minutes longer. Remove from heat and fluff up with fork. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,lemongrass,spring onion,strawberry,confectioner ' sugar,green bell pepper
title: Wild Strawberry Confit Salad
ingredients: 120 g strawberries, hulled, halved and sliced | 180 g spring onions, trimmed, thinly sliced | 1/4 orange, zest of | 1 stalk lemongrass, trimmed | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/4 green bell pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Divide mixed greens among serving plates. Sprinkle spring onions over greens. Combine zest and lemon grass. Sprinkle over orange zest and lemon grass mixture. Sprinkle with confectioner sugar. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Couscous
ingredients: 8 ounces couscous | 5 tablespoons peanut oil or 5 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Boil water and cook the couscous. Keep checking until water has cooled. Drain the couscous and stir in the 2 tbls oil. You can serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: turnip,white wine,hot italian sausage,grain brown rice,cornmeal,chicken breast,white chocolate,white vinegar
title: Crazy Brown Sausage Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain brown rice ( not quick brown ) | 1 medium turnip, peeled and coarsely grated | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1/4 lb white white chocolate, coarsely chopped ( not unsweetened ) | 2 teaspoons cornmeal ( for sprinkling on top in the last 10 mins of cooking ) | 2 teaspoons white vinegar, bottled is ok | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup hot italian sausage, cut into 1/2-inch lengths
instructions: Cook rice until al dente. Rinse and cool to warm, about 15 minutes. Place in colander and squeeze excess liquid out. Set aside. Cut chicken into ½ inch pieces. In large bowl, combine choclate, cornmeal, vinegar and white wine. Dip chicken in choclate mixture, coating thoroughly. Arrange into an 8x8 baking dish. Cover with choclate mixture. Cover with foil and bake in 350f oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and discard foil. Stir, then pour over chocolate rice and stir until coated evenly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,parsley leaf,ginger,beef stew meat,apple,phyllo dough
title: Mansaka (Beef and Peach Rolls)
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 2 cups raw apples, peeled & thinly sliced ( i prefer mcintosh ) | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, peeled & minced | 3 cups jasmine rice | 10 phyllo dough, thawed if frozen, thawed if frozen | fresh parsley leaves ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place beef in a saucepan.

title: Vegetarian Brioche Pie
ingredients: 200 ml strong white brie cheese | 1 tablespoon limes, zest ( optional ) | 3 eggs, beaten, for egg wash | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 200 ml sweet-mixed-up instant dry active yeast | 150 g sour mix | 75 g fine semolina, for dusting | 200 g prepared tastygiatto prepared bagoong | 5 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 -2 cup prepared sweet-mixed-up bagoong ( or more ) | 1 egg, beaten | 2 teaspoons finely grated lime zest ( optional ) | 140 g brie cheese | 2 -3 leaves courgettes, for garnish
instructions: First thing you need to do if you have a vegan pie or if you have a tin of tofu crumble brie in a small saucepan and slowly melt over a medium heat with the limes. Remove from the heat and stir in 3 beaten egg until mixed well. Set aside to cool down. Now we can begin to make the recipe. I put on the amount of yeast we can and mix that in, then we have to go back to the pie to make it. Make your yeast starter, dissolve 2 tablespoons of yeast in a cup of warm water. Let sit for 4 minutes, then add 1/3 cup of sour mix to the yeast mixture. Let rest for 1 hour or so. If this becomes too thick, you can add a little flour, or a bit of water. This makes the mixture foamy and will kill any yeast that will stick to the surface. In the meantime, heat up your vegetable oil. Add your remaining 1 teaspoon of lime zest to a frying pan and fry the soured starter for about 3 minutes on medium heat. Drain the sour starter but don't mix in with it. Set for 5 minutes and then mix in the yeast mixture. Add the cooled berry mix and mix together. Now for assembly, take the dough out onto a floured surface and roll out to a thickness of about 3 mm. I have a two round pie tin and a 9 inch pie tin. The pie tin is very flat so the two pies are equal. Dust your flour on your surface and, with your fingers, roll the dough into a rectangular shape. This isn't too thin because the filling won't fill the corners of the tin. This is normal if your oven doesn't go very low or just medium, i used a 9 inch pie tin. Dust the top with a little flour. Then sprinkle half with the fine semolina and make a well in the center of the dough. Pour in the bagoong. Mix the egg with your chopped lime zest for 1 minute and pour onto the bagoong. Sprinkle half of the bagoong and all the courgettes over the bagoong and repeat this 2 times. Top with the other half of the soured starter. Sprinkle the top with fine semolina and bake for 30 minutes at 400 f convection. Remove the pie and let cool slightly. Remove the pie from tin and cut into slices.

title: Baked Mexican-Style Ricotta With Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 large garlic, bulb | 1 small chili, bulb ( or other hot pepper, to taste ) | 1 large orange bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 15 x 10 baking sheet. In medium mixing bowl combine ricotta cheese, garlic, and peppers. Mix well to combine and spread evenly in prepared pan. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Portuguese Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast | 1 can spanish sweet onions, such as vidalia | 7 1/4 cups fish stock
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over the 1 1/2 cups water in a large pot. Heat the water until it begins to bubble. Pour the onion lukewarm water in the pot, and let stand until the water ferments to 100 degrees f, about 7 - ½ hours, stirring once or twice. The water should leave behind flecks of the dissolved yeast. Stir the onions into the yeast mixture, and return the mixture to the top. Add the fish stock, cover, and allow to sit in a warm place for 1 hour. To serve, discard the yeast after 3 - 5 minutes, and stir once or twice, and serve.

title: Red Chili Rice
ingredients: 500 g red chili peppers | 300 ml cream of mushroom soup | 300 g quinoa
instructions: Heat water to boiling point in a saucepan or microwave and add red chilli peppers. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cream of mushroom soup. Serve with warm buttered rice.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon,cheese,drambuie,red kidney bean,dijon mustard,sun tomato,sriracha sauce,thyme
title: Spicy Red Kidney Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces red kidney beans or 8 ounces garbanzo beans | 1 ounce sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup cheese, grated | pimento-piri sauce ( see chef dijon dijon ) | 3 tablespoons drambuie ( see chef dijon ) | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 teaspoon sriracha hot sauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon
instructions: Combine ingredients in your food processor and pulse until it becomes chunky or runny. Transfer to an oven proof casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 400 degrees f. Stir before serving.

title: Cod With Pinto Beans and Prosciutto
ingredients: 2 lbs cod, skin removed ( or any other white fish ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice ( grapeberry juice is best ) | 1/4 cup chopped prosciutto ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Rinse the fish and pat dry. Cut each fish into 6 portions, and place on a roasting pan that has been sprayed with pam or oil. Sprinkle the fish with half of the smoked paprika. Mix pinto beans with juice and parsley in a dish. Top with prosciutto, if using. Pour the pinto bean mixture over the fish. Place fish in the oven and bake for 15 minutes, basting occasionally with pinto bean juice, or until fish and beans are tender.

title: Roast Stilton With Raspberry Vinegar and Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 lb stilton cheese, quartered | 5 gingersnaps ( cracked cracked cookies ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( toasted, approx 120g ) | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons raspberry vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet pickapeppa paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Melt cheese and gingersnaps in the chicken stock until smooth & silky. Remove from heat and transfer to a bowl. Add vinegar& paprika. Toss to combine & set aside. Roast sesame seeds in a dry frypan or in a griddle over medium heat until lightly browned, stirring constantly. Place on a baking paper lined tray, sprinkle with sesame seeds then cool completely. Remove cheese mixture from fridge & leave to set. Roast allspice in an oiled roasting tin on a medium heat for approx 4 - 5 minutes until fragrant. Remove from oven & allow to cool slightly. Cut into approximately 2 x shape by running a knife around the edge of the cheese to loosen any cracks. Remove as much of the soft or hard pith from the top as possible. Slice into approximately 2 x 2 pieces. Spread each slice of cheese with sesame seeds & place on a tray. Serve with pickapeppa & pickapeppa. Note, the original recipe called for 1 cup of cheese mixed with 1 cup of lemon juice but i didn't see how this could be made.

Random Ingredients: white flour,navy bean,lime juice,topping,cooking tapioca,blueberry pie filling,clear honey
title: Baby's Favorite Basic White Bean Pie
ingredients: 1 can navy beans | 2 cartons frozen whipped topping, thawed | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1 can blueberry pie filling | 1 1/2 cups white flour | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca | 2 tablespoons clear honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix navy beans with frozen whipped topping and lime juice in a bowl, and set aside. Prepare crust with flour, tapioca, honey, and 2 tablespoons of the green jelly. Pour pastry onto the baking sheet and spread it out so that it covers the bottom of the pie plate evenly. Spoon the baked beans into the prepared pie crust in a spiral from the floured to the center. Pour the blueberry pie filling over the beans. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes, or until the filling is bubbly and the juices in the crust have formed an indentation in the center.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,beef sirloin steak,vodka,chicken wing,picante sauce,italian sausage,rigatoni pasta
title: Easy Chicken Pasta & Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb johnsonville italian sausage, mild cut | 1 lb beef sirloin steak, medium sliced | 2 packages johnsonville italian sausage | 2 jars picante sauce ( i don't use the safeway brand ) | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced, drained ( drained well ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 3 packages chicken wings ( cooked )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In a dutch oven or other large pot add italian sausage and cook the sausage breaking it up as it cooks. Once it is browned remove sausage into a large bowl add 2 pounds of johnsonville sausages and continue to cook until no longer pink and drain any excess liquid. In a smaller pot cook the sausage breaking it up as it cooks to the sausage fat. Once the sausage is browned, add the picante sauce and water chestnuts. In a bowl add the noodles and cooked chicken pieces. Heat the noodles until they are warm and drain well. Put the pasta and sausage in the bottom of a 9x13. Cover the sausage mixture with the noodle mixture. Top with the rest of the italian sausages. Poke holes in the top a few times in the sausage mixture to allow steam to escape. Cook for 2 hours, covered for the next 2 hours and then remove cover and continue cooking for 3 more hours. Remove cover and stir it until it is thoroughly cooked. Serve with crusty bread on the side to soak up the juices.

title: Lori's English Cold Soup With Asadero (Czechoslovakian Cold Soup)
ingredients: 1 liter half-and-half or 1 liter skim milk | 1 1/2 pints fresh half-and-half ( or milk of choice ) or 1 1/2 pints skim milk ( or milk of choice ) | 3 ounces asadero cheese or 3 ounces other asian melting cheese | 2 tablespoons dried gherkins ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon vodka or 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional )
instructions: Wald 1 liter of half and half and half in a large pot. Remove immediately from heat. When a thermometer reaches at 90 to 120 degrees, mix in the cheese, gherkins and vodka for at least 2 minutes or until all is absorbed. Remove pot from stove and chill thoroughly before serving.

Random Ingredients: basil,pistachio nut,turmeric,orange bell pepper,sirloin steak,mexican cheese
title: Beef and Peppers With Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 orange bell pepper, stemmed, seeded and thinly sliced ( about 1 cup ) | 4 tablespoons pistachio nuts, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 4 ounces sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: On a platter scatter the orange pepper slices over 1/2 of the cheese spread. Arrange the steak strips over it.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken breast,bread,philadelphia cream cheese,chili oil,black olive
title: Italian Chicken in Toast
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts ( approximately 11/4 lbs total ) | 7 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1 cup of shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup canned black olives or 1/4 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 7 slices bread, to spread to about 4 '' depth ( i use french bread )
instructions: Place about 4 cups of the cream cheese in small microwave safe bowl. Heat in microwave on high about 1 minute, or until softened. Stir until smooth.. Add about 3/4 cup of the cream cheese and the pepper. Stir until blended. Set aside. Place the remaining 1/4 cup sour cream in a small bowl. Stir in some olive oil and mix well. Set aside. Cut the chicken breasts into slices about 3/4 inch wide and 2 1/2 by 3 inches long. Spread the sliced bread with a layer of the cheese mixture. Put another layer of the bread, then the rest of the cheese mixture, then a third of the chicken. You should end with a top layer of bread. You should end with a top layer of bread on top of the cheese. Heat the chile oil in a non stick saute pan, adding small pieces of chicken and let cook for about 5 - 7 minutes or until done. Drain on paper towels. Serve with a side of black beans and/or a side of pasta.

title: Creamy Beef Tenderloin With Coconut Milk (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons reduced-fat shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup canned light coconut milk | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 3 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine shredded cabbage, coconut milk, and seasoning in a medium bowl. Wipe beef with a damp towel. Brush the beef with oil and place on the grill. Grill, covered, for about 7 minutes per side, or until desired doneness and internal temperature is 160 degrees. Let rest 5 minutes before slicing. Serve and enjoy.

title: Grilled Salmon & Sausage Sandwiches (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 15)
ingredients: 400 g pork sausage | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 8 slices sweet smoked salmon | 1 cup frozen cool whip
instructions: Preheat grill to moderately high. Cut sausage into 1 cm pieces and place on a work surface. Spread one side of each slice with mustard, then one with salmon and one with remaining sandwich.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,chili paste,chicken,corn oil,feta,rhubarb,fish,french bread
title: Crispy Rhubarb and Goat Meat Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken | 2 tablespoons chopped rhubarb ( i like to use just a little extra to make the batter ) or 2 tablespoons green onions ( i like to use just a little extra to make the batter ) | 1 tablespoon fish, powder or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon corn oil | salt and black pepper | 5 slices crusty french bread ( toasted, for a good crusty finish ) | salt and black pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon chili paste ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl mix the ground chicken or beef, chopped rhubarb, fish powder or soy, corn oil, salt and pepper to taste. Set aside. Brush each slice of bread with some of the chili paste, if desired. Heat a knob of butter or oil in a frying pan to medium until almost smoking. Place 6 slices of bread into the pan, buttered side down, and cook until they are slightly crisp and lightly brown or, about 3 - 5 minutes. Turn the bread over a few times. Turn the heat up a bit and place a few pieces of meat into the centre of the slice of bread until about 1/4 1/2 thick with some space between the meat. Roll it in the toasted bread. Eat while hot. Variations, add a small can of drained canned pineapple to the batter. Add some chopped or julienned fresh parsley or basil or a small handful of fresh mint. Other tasty ingredients can be added if desired.

title: Halloween Meat  (Dry)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 14 cups pineapple ( i prefer red bp )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut off top and thumb from pineapple.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,curry paste,plum tomato,turmeric powder
title: Tomato and Curry Vinaigrette (Peshaw Salat)
ingredients: 2 lbs unpeeled plum tomatoes, halved | 1 cup curry paste, such as maesri brand ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Place tomatoes in a large bowl. Add curry paste and turmeric and toss to combine. Pour vinegar over tomatoes and toss. Let sit at room temperature for up to 3 hours before serving.

title: Turkey Linguine Primavera
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 12 ounces very lean ground turkey | 4 slices prosciutto, cut into 1-inch wide sticks | fresh thyme sprig | 8 ounces fresh broccoli | 4 ounces mini semi-sweet chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons cracked black pepper
instructions: Cook linguine until al dente, 4 - 8 minutes. While linguine is cooking, make your sauce, in a small saucepan, saute the turkey until no longer pink and drain. To this saucepan, add the prosciutto and thyme. Saute just a few seconds, then add the broccoli and the chocolate chips. Cook until the chocolate is melted, then pour the sauce over the turkey linguine and mix well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,chicken stock,cardamom pod,beef chuck roast,ladyfinger,cheese,brown rice
title: Armenian Cardamom-Beef Soup
