ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes | 8 cups chicken stock | 1 cup dry brown rice | 7 cardamom pods | 4 garlic cloves, pressed | 24 whole dried ladyfingers | 16 ounces garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed well
instructions: Put the chuck roast into a dutch oven pot and add just enough water and chicken stock to cover the meat. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour. Remove the beef and reserve the broth. In a second saucepan, bring the reserved broth to a boil with the rice and cardamom pods. Add the beef, garlic, and the ladyfingers, and simmer for about 20 minutes, until the meat is tender. Remove the meat from the broth and discard the garlic and discard the fat. Put the pan back on the burner and add 3 cups of the broth and 1 cup of the reserved broth. Cook until the soup thickens, about 1 hour. Turn off the burner, and stir 1/4 cup of the soup into 2 cups of cooked rice. Reheat the soup over medium heat, just enough to melt the rice, or do as i do and reheat all the time about 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,brown rice,rye bread,poblano pepper
title: Smoky Brown Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole-wheat, brown rice | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons light ground round | 2 tablespoons poblano peppers, finely chopped
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine rice, soy sauce, and poblano peppers. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes. Increase heat to medium high, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer, uncovered, for 20 to 30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. When rice is done, let stand for 5 minutes, and drizzle on the spicy brown rice to finish.

Random Ingredients: roast,garlic clove,orange peel,anise seed,sugar snap pea
title: Beef Stuffed Nests With Orange Peel, Sugar Snap Peas and Raisins
ingredients: 1 package trimmed and bruised anise oil or 1 lb loose bottomed star-leaf focaccia | 2 ounces roasted garlic cloves | 1 ounce shredded orange peel | 3 ounces sugar snap peas, trimmed | 12 ounces good quality dried australian-seasoned roast
instructions: For each nest, lightly crush anise oil or star leaf with two dessertspoons. Combine garlic, orange peel and sugar snap peas in a bowl. To make a paste, add 1 teaspoon grated fresh orange peel to 1 tbsp cream and whisk to blend. Add the paste to the jar of anise oil. Stir to blend. Holding a knife around the inside edge, add as many of the nests as will fit without touching and carefully push them into the oil with the knife. Use the knife to push and squeeze the paste into the nests to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate the nest for at least 2 hours and up to 24 hours before cooking.

Random Ingredients: margarine,coconut flake,thai red curry paste,cream mushroom soup,cabbage
title: Thirsty's Tri tip Slaw
ingredients: 2 cups cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup margarine, softened | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons thai red curry paste, or more to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cabbage, margarine, and 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup until thoroughly combined. Mix in the thai red curry paste.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,white pearl onion,cocoa powder,milk,green cabbage,zucchini
title: White Vegetable & Cheese Gratin
ingredients: 3 ounces white pearl onions, peeled | 1/2 medium zucchini, trimmed and sliced thin | 1 ounce green cabbage, cored and shredded | 12 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup skim milk | 4 tablespoons unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the onions in a small bowl. Place zucchini in another small bowl. Place cabbage in a third small bowl. Coarsely grate the mozzarella cheese then stir in milk with cocoa powder until combined. Spray gratin dish with pam and place onions and zucchini in the dish, spoon layer of cheese on top of vegetables. Pour the cocoa mixture over cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese has melted and starting to brown around edges, about 30 minutes. If gratin gets too brown, cover top with foil. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green onion,red wine vinegar,red pepper flake
title: Vinegar-Infused Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 4 green onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine vinegar and red pepper flakes in jar with lid, or small container. Cover and shake well to thoroughly combine flavors. Serve at room temperature.

title: BBQ Phyllo Dough
ingredients: 1/2 cup barbeque sauce | 1 package frozen phyllo dough | 2 teaspoons minced lemon peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Combine barbeque sauce and phyllo dough in a bowl, and spread over the surface of the grill. Cook, turning once, until the phyllo dough is lightly crisped, 3 to 5 minutes. Cut each piece of dough into four squares. Place 2 phyllo triangles in the palm of your hand. Place a square of barbeque sauce on top, and pinch the edges closed. Repeat with remaining pieces of dough and sauce.

title: Dark Cocoa Powder
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed, crushed
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the dark cocoa and aniseed. Stir with an electric mixer.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,tabasco sauce,sun tomato,butter,brown sugar,milk ricotta cheese,tomato green chile pepper
title: Texas Sun Dried Tomato and Ricotta Fudge
ingredients: 1 package whole milk ricotta cheese, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 12 dried sun-dried tomatoes | 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Blend ricotta cheese, tomatoes with green chile peppers, sun dried tomatoes, brown sugar, butter, and cake flour in a blender until smooth. Spread in the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Pickled Jalapenos
ingredients: 3 cans stewed mixed vegetables | 2 small jalapeno chiles, sliced
instructions: Drain ingredients and combine. Pack into the crock of your crock. Serve with a salsa or guacamole for dipping.

title: Homemade Naan Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 2 cups plain yogurt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar and yogurt. Using a standing mixer, mix ingredients as the mix appears on the mixer but after about 1 minute. Add more yogurt if needed to form a fairly soft dough that is firm enough to knead. Knead in additional yogurt if desired and place into a well oiled bowl. Cover tightly and let rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before rolling out onto a lightly floured surface. Using a 2 inch round cookie cutter, cut shapes out of the dough. Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. When hot add naan and fry until lightly browned for 1 minute per side.

title: Chili Potstickers (Potstickers)
ingredients: 1 pound daikon radishes, peeled and cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili-oil, or more to taste
instructions: Place daikon radishes in a bowl. Stir in chili oil. Cover and let macerate in the refrigerator, 8 hours to overnight, or overnight. Store in refrigerator in a resealable plastic bag.

title: Easy Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar | 500 g cooked skinless chicken breasts | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Mix icing sugar, chicken and tomato juice together till well combined. Roll into small balls and roll again in the icing sugar. Place on baking tray lined with aluminium foil and bake in oven preheated to 180 degrees celsius for 20 mins till golden.

Random Ingredients: haricot bean,tomato green chilies,swiss chard,chili,liquid smoke,currant
title: Spicy Swiss Chard
ingredients: 4 cups swiss chard | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 tablespoon dried hickory-flavored liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried haricot beans ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dried currant
instructions: Rinse and chop swiss chard. Set aside. Wash undrained tomatoes and chiles. In a dutch oven combine chard, tomatoes with green chiles, liquid smoke, haricot bean, chili and currants. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Mash chard in blender or food processor or with fork. Add enough water to mix. Cook until chard is well blended. Serve hot.

title: Steak With Oyster and Fruit
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak, sliced very thin | 1 package extra firm tofu, cut into 1 1/2 x 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar fruit preserves | 24 small oysters, shucked | 1 package frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine steaks, tofu and apricots in a large resealable plastic bag.

title: Prawn and Turnips in Spices With Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb small green beans | 1 lb medium turnip, peeled | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Wash beans and turnip well.

title: Polish Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup rotini pasta or 1/2 cup elbow macaroni, uncooked | 2 cups thinly sliced cabbage | 1 can of ready-to-serve chicken and/or vegetable soup ( with seasoning packet )
instructions: Cook rotini or macaroni according to package directions, drain.

title: Curried Cheddar Cheese Balls
ingredients: 12 ounces aged cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,margarine,self rising flour,molasses,brown sugar,catsup,fennel bulb
title: Baked Calamari (Prawn)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 fennel bulb, chopped | 1 cup self rising flour | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 3/4 cup catsup | 3/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large skillet over medium heat, melt margarine and molasses.

title: Easy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb dry pasta ( any kind of mackerel pasta is fine ) | 6 ounces lemonade | 2 garlic cloves ( finely minced ) | 1/4 cup ketjap manis or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 chipotle chiles, canned in adobo ( seeded and finely chopped ) | 400 g snow peas
instructions: Cook the mackerel in boiling water until al dente then drain & leave to one side. Cook the pasta in a pot of boiling water, meanwhile, dissolve lemonade & garlic in the ketjap manis & stir in the chilies. Drain noodles & toss with lemonade mixture. Add snow peas to the noodles & serve.

title: Rosemary Madras Curry Paste to Be Used in Middle Eastern Recipes
ingredients: 20 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup madras curry powder
instructions: Place rosemary sprigs into a small bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over rosemary sprigs. Leave to marinate in the fridge for 8 hours or longer. Use as a paste with bread, fish, pita or vegetables and serve with crackers.

title: Killer Butternut-Pumpkin Smoothies (Pumpkin)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups butternut pumpkin, peeled, seeded, coarsely grated | 1/2 cup dried apricot preserves | 1/4 cup molasses | 12 cups crushed ice
instructions: Combine the pumpkin, preserves and molasses in a blender. Blend on high briefly until almost smooth. With the blender running add 1 1/2 teaspoons ice and pulse until the ice is finely crushed/shredded, about 7 - 10 seconds. Scrape into a large glass.

title: Easy Fish and Potato Stew
ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 medium orange bell pepper, cut into 1 inch chunks | 4 ounces fish, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup tomato sauce ( kikkoman ) | 1/3 cup canned cantaloupe, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons miso ( i use 2 - 3 tbsp ) | 4 6 cups spaghetti or 6 cups other pastas
instructions: Preheat oven on broil or in a 9x9 inch pan to desired temperature. Mix together the baking potatoes, pepper, fish and tomato sauce. Brush the pan with a little oil or cooking spray and spread some of the mixture into the pan. Sprinkle with miso and lay your veggies over the mixture, spreading evenly. Place in the oven and bake 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook your pasta according to the package directions. Serve the soup with bread and veggies.

title: Grilled Coconut Cauliflower or Veggies
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 cup coconut juice | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar or 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cut cauliflower into 3 inch florets. Grill florets about 8 minutes per side, or until crisp tender. Place on platter. Whisk coconut juice, hoisin sauce, and cream of tartar until creamy.

title: The Best Porridge (Microwave Recipe)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons whole meal or 6 tablespoons porridge oats | 3/4 cup vegetable broth or 3/4 cup water, warmed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Microwave on high for about 5 - 7 minutes, until the porridge begins to thicken. Microwave on high for another 2 - 3 minutes. Remove porridge from microwave, let cool, then serve with a sprinkle of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: chipotle powder,hot italian sausage,espresso powder,bay seasoning tm,white wine vinegar,chinese black bean sauce,vodka,anise seed
title: Black Bean, Vodka, and Sausage Skewers #1
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 2 tablespoons unseasoned instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh ground chipotle powder or 2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning tm, plus more ( to taste ) | chinese black bean sauce, basting sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a non metallic bowl. Reserve half the sauce for dipping. Cut sausage into 1 inch thick slices, 1 to 2 inches long. Thread onto soaked wooden skewers, allowing 4 to 6 slices per skewer. Place on prepared bamboo skewers. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature before grilling or basting. Cooks' note, basting and steaming are not recommended. Slather with sauce, drizzle with remaining sauce, and serve with reserved sauce.

Random Ingredients: halloumi cheese,cherry pie filling,tamarind paste,white pepper
title: Lebanese Baked Gateaux
ingredients: 300 g halloumi cheese | 1/2 cup cherries or 1/2 cup dried cherries | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste | salt or white pepper, to taste
instructions: Cut the cheese into quarters, each about 7 inches square. Make 3 stacks by cutting each quarter into 3 squares using a sharp knife. Brush the cut squares with water so that they don't stick together. Place the pieces of cheese onto a large tray, or lightly buttered, and spread one side with the tamarind paste. Place the cherry or dried cherries or dried cherries over the paste, then cover with the remaining square of cheese and spread out evenly to about 1/2 inch thick. Sprinkle with salt and white pepper. Place the tray under a grill to brown the mixture. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to one week for better flavour.

title: Bailey's Irish Breakfast Drink Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried bean sprouts | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: Using a coffee filter or a fine mesh sieve filter, filter the bean sprouts and put them into a glass jar with 1/4 cup bailey's irish cream, and top with a teaspoon of the bean sprout coffee mix. Close the lid and store in a cool dark place for 3 days. Makes 2 2/3 cups beverage.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,hot noodle,sherry wine vinegar,cardamom seed,mirin,oyster sauce,leg lamb
title: Naked Korean New Year's Beef on Whole Bagels
ingredients: 2 whole leg of lamb, about 8 ounces/1kg | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon mirin | 4 packages hot cooked noodles ( rice sticks )
instructions: Cut lamb lengthwise into six equal pieces. Arrange lamb in a foil lined shallow baking pan. In a small bowl, whisk marinade ingredients, adding some of the reserved marinade to thicken if needed. Pour marinade over lamb and marinate in refrigerator at least 8 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 375°f. Drain lamb, reserving juices. Place meat in a 9x13 baking pan. Bake meat for 40 minutes, turning occasionally, or until done to desired doneness, turning once half way through, or to desired doneness. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together the reserved marinade and hot cooked noodles. Brush over hot meat and serve immediately.

title: Easy and Tasty Pizza Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Dissolve yeast, bouillon cubes, and sunflower oil in 1/4 cup water. Cool for 2 minutes, then pour in 1/2 cups cold water. Combine well. Put yeast mix in bowl, cover and set in warm place. Let loaves rise until double in size. Heat pizza iron on warm. Spread pizza sauce over dough, place lid on and put pizza maker in warm oven. Check after 5 minutes. Slice bread on desired diagonal and put back on pizza maker for 5 minutes.

title: Spinach and Chiles Fajitas
ingredients: 10 fresh hot red chile peppers | 1 bunch fresh baby spinach leaves | 1/4 cup fresh bean sprouts | 20 whole cloves, crushed
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Place the chiles on a baking sheet and broil until browned, about 2 minutes. Be careful not to burn the chiles or they will turn bitter. Place the baby spinach leaves into a bowl, and cover with boiling water. Let sit for 1 minute, then drain in a colander set in the sink. Squeeze out excess moisture, and roughly chop. Transfer the chiles and spinach to a bowl, crushing them with your hands. Stir in the bean sprouts. Season to taste with pepper. Serve warm.

title: Mustards Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 ounces mushrooms | 9 ounces butter | 2 -3 ounces caster sugar | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mustard ( optional ) | 1 -2 pimiento, sliced
instructions: Put oven to 350°f fry mushrooms for about 10 minutes until just starting to colour. Melt butter in a small saucepan.

title: American Cheese (Tortelles Filled)
ingredients: 4 slices american cheese, 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 cup diced red onion
instructions: On a work surface arrange the cheese slices in a single layer. Top each slice with the red onion and place on top of the cheese. Wrap the entire outside of the cheese with foil. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the wrapped cheese on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Wrap the top with tin foil. Bake the sandwiches for 40 minutes. Let the cheese melt.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,yellow pepper,italian salad dressing,rosemary
title: Bangkok
ingredients: 1 pound yellow peppers, seeded and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 tablespoon hot red curry paste | 1 bottle italian-style salad dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a bowl combine peppers, rosemary and curry paste. Top with italian style salad dressing and toss to coat. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until peppers and dressing are crispy and browned.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut,fry bread,chicken bouillon cube,oil,head garlic,brown rice,ice cube,tofu
title: Mock Garlic Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashew nuts | 1/2 cup fried tofu, cut in slices | 4 cubes fried bread, cubed | 1 head of garlic, peeled | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 teaspoon instant fried tofu | 1/4 cup brown rice | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan on medium heat. Add the first five ingredients in the order listed. Fry until golden brown. Add tofu and rice. Add additional seasoning if desired. Turn off the heat. Serve.

title: Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups cold milk | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/2 cup cheese, shredded | 3 cups cold water
instructions: In saucepan bring milk and sundried tomato oil to boil. Remove from heat.

title: Chocolate Sticks
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce chocolate square ( i like ghirardelli, baily's brand is recommended ) | 1 -2 tablespoon palm sugar ( optional, can go up to 1 tsp when adding )
instructions: Put chocolate in the microwave for a short time. Stir in sugar. Add enough to stick to the chocolate after a few seconds by holding a long handled spoon or heat resistant chopstick with a small amount of dough at it. Slice the dough into 3 fingers. You can also use a biscuit cutter to cut into sticks or shapes. Wet one edge of a fork or toothpicks with water until cool. Dip it in water first, then twist it gently to remove the skin. If wooden sticks stick does not stick after dipping the fork, keep it wrapped in water. Let the chocolate stick on the wax paper or cookie sheet until hard, at least 15 minutes.

title: Italian Sausage in Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 head red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium high heat, turning frequently, until browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to cutting board.

title: Lime Fritters - Like Old Lady Cleveland High School Restaurant Style
ingredients: 100 g flour, sifted | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Mix flour, lime juice and lime juice. Use 1 tablespoon for each fritter. Cover and chill 1 hour. Brush fritters with remaining lime juice. Cook fritters on bbq or barbecue plate for 8 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

title: Chile and Pear Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 3 small red potatoes | 6 small bosc pears, peeled, halved | 6 leaves chilies | 1 head celery
instructions: Peal & core bosc pears, removing all the pith, and cut in half or quarters. Core the chilies & cut into thin, slanted pieces. Place the potatoes, pears & celery into a large bowl with a few tablespoons cold water. Add water to cover. Add the chilies and stir to soak them up about 5 minutes or so. Drain veggies and pat dry with paper towels. Add the potato mixture to the vegetable bowl. Tear the chilli around the bowl and then add to the bowl. Taste and add salt & pepper if needed.

Random Ingredients: baby shrimp,black mustard seed,beet,nonfat cream,cake flour,chicken wing,kielbasa
title: Borsht
ingredients: 24 baby shrimp, shelled and deveined | 2 medium fresh beet, peeled, stems removed | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 jar baby shrimp, drained | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 2 1/2 cups sifted cake flour ( to dust ) | 1/2 cup cake flour ( to dust )
instructions: Sprinkle shrimp with salt and pepper. Heat oil in large skillet. Add shrimp.

Random Ingredients: black olive,chinese egg noodle,artichoke heart,salad,asafoetida powder,apricot
title: Chinese Egg Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package chinese egg noodles | 4 asafoetida powder | 4 ounces artichoke hearts, blanched in hot water and drained | 2 tablespoons black olives, sliced | 16 ounces apricots, peeled and sliced thin | 1/3 cup salad dressing
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to package directions, drain and cool under cold water, drain again and set aside. Mix the asafoetida powder with the asafoetida and the artichoke hearts. Fold in the olives. Add in the noodles and apricots. Stir to combine. Add in the salad dressing slowly to coat everything well. Chill until serving.

title: Ramen Noodle Toast
ingredients: 6 -8 pieces bread | 6 -7 ramen noodles ( depending on flavor desired )
instructions: Toast or wrap. Serve with your favorite sauce.

title: Quick and Easy Peas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drain and rinse with cool water ) | sea salt ( to taste ) | pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Drain chickpeas, rinse with cool water and drain again. Spread the beans on a plate or onto two bamboo skewers. This will keep for up to a month. Light coat the beans. Sprinkle evenly with sea salt and fresh ground pepper. Grill at 325 for 15 - 20 minutes or until they are crisp and the cheese has melted. Serve at once.

title: Curried Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 cups berry pieces | 2 cups belgian endive, diced | 3 bananas, sliced | 1/3 cup vegetable shortening | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup frozen mixed berries
instructions: Place the berries in a large bowl. Melt the shortening in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the curry powder, oregano, and banana. Simmer for about 2 minutes, or until bananas are lightly browned and sticky. Stir in the endives.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,white kidney bean,strawberry,apple jelly,orange blossom water,chunky salsa,five spice powder,lemon
title: Spoonful Strawberry and Red-Apple Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon orange blossom water or 1 -2 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 cup strawberries, chopped | 1/2 cup chunky salsa ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup canned white kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup apple jelly ( can use other jelly if preferred ) | 2 slices lemons | anchovy fillet ( optional )
instructions: Add orange blossom water to large non stick frying pan. Add five spice powder to pan and quickly stir. Add strawberries and salsa. Cover pan and cook over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add beans with liquid, jelly, and the zest one of the lemons if using. Stir to combine and heat until hot through. Spoon into serving dish and garnish with slices of lemon. Serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Glazed Dessert Fingers
ingredients: 250 g dark chocolate, finely chopped | 1 orange, zest of | 250 g ladyfingers, split in half | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1/4 cup coriander, chopped | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Place chopped chocolate in a bowl and sprinkle with zest and sugar. Place ladyfingers, cut side down, between a lightly greased 20cm x 30cm piece of baking paper and use a rolling pin to flatten lightly to make 16cm x 25cm fingers. Pour oil and half of the coriander on base of a tray and set aside. Lightly brush the edges of each fingers with the oil. Place one piece of butter at a time lengthways in to the fingers and brush with more oil. Dip, brushing with oil, into coriander and twist together. Place fingers on lined tray and brush with remaining oil. Sprinkle with remaining corriander and chocolate. Place in fridge for 1 hour to set.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,cream cheese,walnut,french dressing,curry paste,mushroom,pumpkin seed,blue cheese
title: Curry Walnut Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon prepared curry paste | 1 tablespoon walnut pieces | 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds | 1/4 cup broccoli or 1/4 cup wild rice blend | 1/2 cup chopped mushroom | 10 3/4 fluid ounces french dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a bowl, chill for 1 hour. Serve with crackers.

title: Kurdish Style Applesauce Cake
ingredients: 150 g raw cashews | 1 kg clams, cleaned | 150 g fresh snow pea ( or shelled, if using frozen ) | 150 g dried pitted prunes ( the small variety ) | cooking oil | 100 g cake flour | 1/4 cup applesauce
instructions: Soak cashews in cold water for about 15 minutes. Drain, then grind them in a blender. In another bowl, place cashews, cashews, chopped snow peas and prunes. Put oil in a pan and let it heat till it gets quite hot. Once it get hot, pour the mixture in the pan. Stir with a skewer. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for approximately 20 minutes. Then remove and serve warm with apple sauce.

title: Cream Cheese With Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 250 g fontina cheese | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Cut the fontina into 1/2 inch cubes and toss it in a skillet over medium heat with 1 1/2 t ginger garlic paste. When the cheese is brown, remove from the pan and drain on paper towels. Return the skillet to the stove and place another tablespoon of the reserved ginger garlic paste in it over low heat. When the paste starts to sizzle, add the fontina cubes and stir to coat the cheese with the ginger garlic paste. Stir occasionally until the cheeses are light golden on top. Remove from the heat. When serving cut into small squares or squares and dip half way into the sauce and toss again.

title: Quick and Easy Salmon Barbecue
ingredients: 2 pounds salmon fillets | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 -2 tablespoon baking powder | 1 cup shredded carrots
instructions: Preheat your grill to high heat. Line the grill grate with the foil, and spray with cooking spray. Place the salmon on top of the foil. Mix together the chickpeas with the baking powder. Sprinkle on the salmon. Top with the chopped carrots. Cook until the salmon is easily flaked with a fork.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,pineapple ring,beef stew meat,peach juice,hamburger,chili paste garlic,plum sauce,five spice powder
title: Sweet and Sour Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 can peach juice, drained | 0.5 can plum sauce | 16 ounces picante sauce | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1 can pineapple rings, drained | 1 dashida ( a+ food coloring/flavor enhancer available in most grocery stores, or use chili-like garlic sauce )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pineapple rings with meat and vegetables in slow cooker. Add meat and vegetables to remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low about 8 hours or on high 3 hours, until meat and vegetables are tender. Do not remove lid during the last 30 minutes of cooking.

title: Quick  Italian Beef  Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck ( or use 2 lbs ground round, or use 2 lb ground sirloin ) | 1 cup ketchup | 2 cans cannellini
instructions: Remove all fat from meat. If using round, cut in 4 pieces. Combine ketchup and meat. Heat slowly over medium heat. Add cannellini. Simmer approximately 15 minutes until hot.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,sun tomato,vegetable bouillon cube,cauliflower floret,purpose flour
title: Cauliflower Fondue
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets | 15 -20 sun-dried tomatoes | 7 -10 vegetable bouillon cubes or 7 -10 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/4 - 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, for dusting | any ice cube, for dipping
instructions: Chop cauliflower to desired bite size pieces, adding a bit of oil to coat the bottom of the fondue pot or skillet. Chop sundried tomatoes well and reserve for garnish. Place cauliflower pieces into the crock and add the rest of the ingredients except the ice cubes. Mix well then transfer to the crock. Tie with butcher string to set fondue to warm place over low heat until fondue has warmed the mixture. Serve with your favorite crackers or with a few crusty french bread pieces for dipping into the fondue.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya,pesto sauce,celery rib,plum tomato,vegetable oil,tilapia fillet
title: Spanish-Style Tilapia (Ceviche)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon sazon goya | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced | 4 plum tomatoes, seeded, chopped | salt and pepper to taste | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce, divided
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Season with sazon goya and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in celery and tomatoes and season with salt and pepper.

title: Coconut Graters
ingredients: 2 cups flaked coconut, toasted | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread coconut onto baking sheets. Stir coconut and italian seasoning, then spread onto baking sheets. Bake until golden and crisp, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: half,corn,salt pepper,blueberry,curd cottage cheese,chicken breast half
title: Blueberry Chicken Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1 can chopped sweet corn | 1 can skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed | 2 cups fresh blueberries | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a large glass jar with a lid, combine the half and half, cottage cheese, corn, chicken, and blueberries. Mix until the chicken is in small pieces. Cover, and refrigerate overnight for flavors to develop.

title: Alaina's Maccha Salmon Fettuccine
ingredients: 1/2 lb salmon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon ground hazelnuts | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1 3/4 cups white flour | 1/4 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons coconut | 1 1/4 cups chicken bouillon | 12 ounces fettuccine pasta | white flour | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut | 1/2 cup sliced hazelnuts
instructions: Combine 1/2 lb salmon and 1 tbsp ground hazelnuts in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to use. Mix 1 3/4 cups white flour, 1/4 cup white flour and 1/4 cup coconut in a shallow dish. Dip salmon pieces first in flour, coat both sides. Set aside. Add 1 3/4 cups of white flour, 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut and 1/2 cup sliced hazelnuts to shrimp paste. Toss to coat. Set aside. Cook pasta until al dente. Drain and arrange on a platter with 1/2 cup sliced hazelnuts on top. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts and 1 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes. Pour white sauce over pasta and serve.

title: Totally Awesome Meatball Lasagna
ingredients: 1 jar dried meatballs, any flavor, any flavor | 1 container monterey jack cheese | 1/3 of a small red onion, diced | 1/3 cup finely chopped dried currant | 1 1/2 pints simple syrup or 1 1/2 pints your favorite liqueur
instructions: Boil 1 liter water and salt the water. Add 2 tsp iodized salt to the boiling water. Add the meatballs and a pinch of iodized salt. Then add about 1/4 cup of the monterey jack cheese to the pot and stir it together with the water. Cover and cook until meatballs have a little bit of softness and are pliable. Add the rest of the cheese and the onion. Remove the meatballs from the water. Place in a double boiler or baking dish. Mix the remaining ingredients and pour on top of the meatballs. Cover and let simmer about 2 - 3 hours until the sauce begins to thicken. Use the spoon to stir it every 15 minutes or so. Serve with any fresh bread or crackers.

title: Prawn and Black Sesame Cakes
ingredients: 600 g king prawns, peeled, deveined, leaving tails on | 20 g black sesame seeds | 1 cup sweet salsa
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c line a tray with paper baking paper. Place prawns in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Stand for 5 minutes until the water is almost completely absorbed. Drain, run under cold water and set aside to cool. Drain thoroughly. Using wet hands, roll 1 teaspoon of prawns in half of the sesame seeds. Transfer prawns to the prepared tray. Bake at 200°c for 10 - 15 minutes, until prawns just turn opaque and cooked through. Meanwhile, combine salsa and remaining sesame seeds in a small bowl. Place 1 heaped teaspoon of salsa over each prawn. Serve.

title: Easy Beet and Mash
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lard, or more as needed | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/2 cup amaretto ( almond flavored liqueur ) | 1 large beet, washed and peeled
instructions: Heat lard in a large skillet over medium high heat until the foam begins to render, 1 to 2 minutes. Turn off the heat. Place the jar of salsa, amaretto, and 1/2 cup water into blender jar and blend until smooth. Pour into warm skillet, cook over medium heat until salsa comes to a boil, and boil until reduced to 1 1/2 cups, about 15 minutes. Slice the peeled beet, discarding the cores and remaining leaves. Place potatoes in a large pot of boiling water, bring water to a boil, and place lid on pot. Cook until easily pierced with a wooden fork, about 25 minutes. Drain the potatoes and reserve. Use some of the reserved salsa for dipping.

title: Creamy Mushroom and Chicken En Cocottees
ingredients: 12 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/4 cup sweet chicken meat, drained for enchiladas
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Mix mushrooms and cocoa powder together in a bowl, and toss with chicken and vegetables until evenly coated. Spread 1 tablespoon enchilada sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the enchiladas on top of the enchilada sauce, and spread remaining enchilada sauce on top. Bake in the preheated oven until enchiladas are heated through and bubbly, 40 to 60 minutes.

title: Chef John's Peach and Saffron Smoked Corned Beef
ingredients: 20 pounds corned beef brisket | 1 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup water | 1/8 cup saffron strands | 10 peach slices, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse brisket in a colander, inside and out, with cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Place brisket in a large dutch oven or other heavy, deep pan or baking dish with a tight fitting lid. Combine white vinegar and water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until hot but not boiling, and then set aside. Pour vinegar water over brisket, making sure to cover completely. Do not add any extra vinegar. Cover the pan or bake in preheated oven until brisket is fork tender and well browned on top, at least 3 hours. When cooled, the brisket will be easy to handle and can be frozen for future use. Serve brisket with a sprinkling of saffron flavored corn flakes and fresh peach slices for garnish.

title: Japanese Fried Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 2 tablespoons japanese pimento stuffed olives or 2 tablespoons pimentos | 2 teaspoons sugar | 2 teaspoons ajinomoto | 2 teaspoons chopped broccoli florets
instructions: Cut steak diagonally into 2 inch wide strips. Dry out olive oil in a large nonstick frypan over high heat. Add ajinomoto, olives and pepper. Add marinated steak and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 1/2 2 minutes or until desired doneness. Serve hot over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: bean,wheat pita bread,loaf french bread,green pepper,kale,lemon grass root,egg
title: Lenten Bread Pockets
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices | 1 pound ground round | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/2 cup chopped fresh kale, stems removed | 2 teaspoons lemon grass root, chopped | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 2 cans baked beans
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Arrange bread slices on grate. Evenly distribute beef, green pepper, kale, lemon grass and egg evenly among bread slices, dividing evenly between bread slices. Place bread onto preheated grill. Grill bread 5 minutes on each side, or until edges are golden brown and cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,raisin,chicken bouillon cube,baby bok choy,yogurt,beefsteak tomato
title: Creamy Choy Salad With Raisins and Beefsteak Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless beefsteak tomato, julienned | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons snipped chinese fresh choy | 1/4 cup reduced-fat natural fat-free yogurt | 4 cups tiny shell pasta, cooked | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( optional ) or 2 beef stock cubes ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced tomatoes with raisins, choy, and about 1 1/2 tablespoons chinese choy and mix, making sure the tomatoes are evenly coated with choy mixture. Set aside. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the remaining choy mixture and chicken bouillon cubes or beef bouillon cubes. Add to the boiling water and cook for 2 minutes, stirring until the soup loses its steam. If the soup gets too thick, cook 2 - 3 minutes more. Remove from the heat and gently stir in the drained cooked pasta, vegetables, and tomato mixture. Cover and refrigerate until serving time or up to a day.

title: Prawns
ingredients: 1 kg medium raw prawns, shelled | 1/2 red capsicum, deseeded and thinly sliced | 1/3 cup lime juice | 3 tablespoons clear honey | 1 tablespoon garlic sauce
instructions: Peel the prawns if they are larger then or smaller. Cut the prawns in half along their backs then make diagonal cuts into the flesh. Place all the ingredients in a large saucepan with the prawns. Bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for about 20 minutes stirring all the time. Stir from time to time, adding the honey before the prawns are cooked, remove from heat. Serve with hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,farfalle pasta,semolina,chicken stock cube,italian bread,black peppercorn,spinach
title: Baked Farfalle With Spinach and Dried White Wine
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta or 8 ounces penne | 1 chicken stock cube ( i use maggi ) | 7 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and dry | 8 1/2 ounces cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons of prepared italian parsley-type dried sweet basil, chopped | 6 tablespoons semolina ( coarsely ground cornmeal ) | black peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: Boil water for farfalle, salt it, then drain. Mix all ingredients together, except the peppercorns. Place mixture in baking dish with tight fitting lid. Score top of farfalle with knife into diagonal lines, then bake 1 hour at 400f degrees. Do not overcook as they will continue to cook as they cool. Note, you will not be able to cook the farfalle in the time given. The baking time is not reflected in the texture of the farfalle, but as it has to be quite close to the original baking time.

title: Turo Kids' Green Tea Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 2 -3 drops green food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Measure and sift the self rising flour into a mixing bowl. Make a well in the center, and pour in the food coloring. Stir the mixture lightly with a spatula or wooden spoon until a ball forms. Drop batter into greased paper lined muffin tins with a teaspoon to fill liners almost to the top. Bake 12 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until the tops spring back when lightly touched.

title: Homemade Panch Phado - A Malaysian Eurasian Thing
ingredients: 1/2 kg white onion portion, roughly chopped ( approximately 5 large onions ) | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely grate | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | sea salt, to taste | 1/4 kg light powdered coffee liqueur | 2 tablespoons white onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dried asian or filipino five spice powder ( asafoetida, if you can get this in asian stores and at ) | 1 cup very coarsely powdered sea salt
instructions: Preparing the dried onions, put onions in clean saucepan or bowl. Add water, enough to cover them, about 2cm of water. Cover with a lid and let soak for 10 to 14 hours. Drain onions when completely dry. Set aside in a small bowl. Boil water, add onion soup/onion soup mix, stir well to dissolve soup mix. Once the onions have soaked, strain water out of them and reserve onion water for another use. Combine onion water, 2tbsp of powdered mix & 3/4 cup of the powdered mix till all onions are completely covered. Add the rest of the powder & sea salt to the fried onions. In separate bowl, combine coffee liqueur & 2 tbsp of white onion soup mix. Stir well & set aside till ready to eat & set aside. Preparing the dough, put a pot on medium high heat till you can smell the aroma of the coffee liqueur. Add 1/2 the powdered dry onion soup mix to the pot. Add enough water to cover completely and mix well till you get a soft dough that can be formed easily & is easy to work with. Turn off heat and leave covered for about 20 minutes. Preparing the filling, mix together 2 tbsp of powdered mix with the rest of the powdered dry onion soup mix till you get a fine paste consistency you can then add the coffee liqueur mix to the mixture in the pot, stir till mixed thoroughly, then add the rest of the powdered mix. Keep stirring till it starts to stick to the bottom of the pot, you can add more or less coffee liqueur to taste. When boiling, put lid on pot, simmer for 10 minutes after that. You can remove lid and simmer till reduced, it will be a thin and thick paste. Cool and serve very cold. Preparing the filling, mix the rest of the powdered dry onion soup mixture with one tsp of five spice powder & 1 cup of water till you get a paste consistency with a lot of little bite. You can also add one packet of dried onion soup mix. Mix well until blended & set aside till ready to use.

title: Japanese Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/2 cup sake | 1/4 cup mirin | 1 1/2 pounds beef tenderloin or tenderloin, cut into 1 inch slices
instructions: Stir together the sake, mirin and beef slices in a large glass bowl. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 2 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Cook the beef, turning once, until evenly browned and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: lamb,basil,green chile pepper,nutritional yeast,vegetable oil,lime,onion powder,extra virgin olive oil
title: Lamb Burgers for 30
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or as needed | 1 tablespoon minced onion powder | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 green chile pepper, finely chopped | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers | 3/4 cup plain dried basil | 2 containers extra-virgin olive oil | 1 lime, juiced, or as desired
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Mix olive oil, onion powder, ground nutmeg, green chile pepper, green chile peppers, and basil in a microwave safe container. Cook in the microwave on high until hot, about 20 seconds. Place the lamb on the prepared grill, and grill for 6 minutes on each side. Squeeze lime juice over the cooked hot lamb, and serve hot.

title: Lobster Tostadas
ingredients: 1 can lobster meat | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Drain lobster meat and place in a medium size bowl. Mash lobster meat with refried beans. Spray skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat. Roll tortillas or cradolees up and place on baking sheet. Bake at 425°f for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Plum Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 can diced plum tomatoes | 1 can creole-style seasoning, or more to taste | 1/2 cup sour cream, or more to taste
instructions: Puree plum tomatoes in a blender into a 2 cup measuring cup.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,marsala wine,curry powder,parsley,serrano ham,rom tomato
title: Curried Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | 3 roma tomatoes, diced and seeded | 4 slices serrano ham or 4 slices other sweet white ham | 1 tablespoon curry powder, more if you like it hot | 2 ounces marsala wine, more if you like it sweet | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Lay out the brisket on a flat surface, lay flat if possible. In a small bowl, mix the diced tomatoes with the jalapeno slices, salt and pepper. Spread one side of each slice of ham with curry powder. Roll up the slices of the ham tightly and arrange side by side in a very thin, straight dish. Sprinkle with the chopped parsley evenly over the tops of the rolls. Repeat on other side of the brisket, securing them with toothpicks. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours, turning over the ends occasionally. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the brisket on a well oiled baking dish and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove and discard toothpicks. Pour off any excess fat and remove the meat from the pan. Re cover the pan and return it to the oven. Bake for 45 minutes, uncover and bake for another 15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened. Serve over mashed potatoes, egg noodles, or crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,pork shoulder,cardamom seed,brown rice,white bread,pork loin roast,maple syrup
title: Pork and Rice Breakfast Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 lean boneless pork loin roast | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 8 bread rolls | 1 cup cooked brown rice | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together chili sauce, bread rolls and cooked rice. Cut pork into thin strips and sprinkle with a few cardamom chips. Heat a large, nonstick pan over medium high heat. Spread chili sauce evenly over the cut surfaces of the rolls. Cook sandwiches until pork is golden brown and heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Linguine With Chicken Stock and Linguine
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters chicken stock | 12 ounces linguine
instructions: Pour the stock into a large pan and heat up gently. While the stock is heating roughly dice the linguine into similar sized bite size pieces. When the stock is hot, add the linguine and cook the linguine until they are cooked. You may need to add a little more stock as not to cook the linguine. Drain the linguine and serve.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,chipotle chile adobo,arborio rice,cheddar cheese,ricotta cheese,corn,garlic powder,romano cheese
title: Chipotle Arrabiata
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice | 2 cups canned corn | 2 red sweet bell peppers | 1/2 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 2 cups cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, minced | garlic powder, to taste
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly under running water. Over pot of boiling water, cook for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and cook for another 25 minutes or until rice is cooked and the sauce thickens. To make arrabiata, remove red sweet bell peppers from the pot, skin and seeds and cut into strips. Remove seeds and membrane, if desired. Combine with rice and stir until all ingredients are mixed well. Serve sprinkled with grated cheese.

title: Quick and Easy Veggie Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 12 corn tortillas, or | 12 sliced radishes, or as needed | 1/2 cup shredded plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a large bowl, mix together 1 cup yogurt, dark brown sugar, 2 corn tortillas, and 1/2 the shredded vegetables. Spoon about 1 heaping tablespoon of the filling into the center of each tortilla, and roll up. Place seam side down in baking dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling. Mix 1/2 cup yogurt with 2 more tablespoons plain yogurt in a small bowl. Spoon half over enchiladas. Top with remaining shredded yogurt, making sure each is covered completely. Bake in the preheated oven, 20 to 25 minutes, until cheese is browned and slightly puffed.

title: Sushi Mushi
ingredients: 9 large nori | 5 3 cups sushi fruit ( or a mixture of fruit )
instructions: Cut off the top portion of each nori sheet with a sharp knife, leaving only the soft white part of the stalk attached. Cut the nori sheets into two or three inch squares of nori. Place the nori in a large skillet, and pour boiling water over them. Heat gently to soften the nori. Serve with fruit flavored liqueur or flavored cream.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,chipotle pepper,jicama,red enchilada sauce,milk,irish whiskey,sugar
title: Irish Jicama and Chipotle Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 3 cans red enchilada sauce ( red enchilada style or mild ) | 1 cup milk | 1/4 cup sugar | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey or 2 tablespoons other dry white wine | 3/4 - 1 cup shell pasta | chopped chipotle pepper
instructions: Place cut jicama in a large saucepan with 1/4 cup of water, enchilada sauce, milk, sugar, and whiskey. Stir gently, simmer over medium heat until jicama is very tender, around 20 to 25 minutes. While the pasta is cooking, cook shell pasta in plenty of boiling, salted water according to package instructions until al dente. Drain well. Place pasta on serving dish, spoon hot jicama over the top, sprinkle with chopped chipotle pepper, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,almond extract,beef tenderloin steak,sea salt,brown rice
title: Beef Tenderloin Sandwich With Brown Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup firmly packed brown rice, uncooked | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract ( to taste ) | 1 dash sea salt | 4 beef tenderloin steaks, about 1-1/2 inches thick | 1 slice focaccia bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Prepare brown rice according to package directions, omitting any oil. Spread the almond extract all over the tenderloins. Sprinkle with salt. Place the steaks on wire rack or shallow baking dish. Roast beef 20 minutes and let stand 10 minutes, then slice crosswise, then thinly across the grain. Serve with brown rice.

title: Hazelnut & Bisquick Crumble - for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 cup bisquick, all purpose soft | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, ground | 1/3 cup shallot, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons instant mashed potatoes | 1 ounce low fat sour cream or 1 ounce low fat sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f mix the dry ingredients together in a bowl, then press into a 30cm x 20cm piece of baking paper. Bake the crumble for 15–20 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven and spread the crumble onto a baking sheet. Combine the remaining topping ingredients together. Spread onto the crumble and serve while warm garnished with a dollop of sour cream if you prefer.

title: Plantain Bread - Abm
ingredients: 1 green plantain | 2 ounces self-raising flour | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Cut the plantain in half lengthways and clean them out with a knife. Sprinkle the flour and cut an x on the side to stop them sticking. Fry the plantain in a frying pan, until golden brown. You can do 2 things here – brown bread in a pan or fry the plantain. Drain the bread on kitchen paper. Place the bread on a shallow ovenproof dish and place the fried plantains inside. Sprinkle with your favourite topping ingredients and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 400°f.

title: Jamaican Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound raw jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup whole, toasted nuts
instructions: Place shrimp in a large, deep skillet with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes. Drain. Place shrimp on a paper towel lined plate, and dry with warm, dry skillet sauce. Place a layer of whole toasted nuts in the bottom of a small cast iron skillet, then arrange shrimp on top in the skillet. Cook and stir 10 minutes, or until shrimp turns pink and shrimp are no longer translucent in the center.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,snow pea,salt black pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,rotel tomato,irish cream
title: Sun-Damp Green Beans With Smoked Sausage, Caramelized Hazelnuts and Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 1/3 cup light-colored spirulina or 1/3 cup chopped hazelnuts | 3 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 12 1/2 ounces smoked sausage ( johnsonville is my choice ) | salt and black pepper | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( or rotelle tomato chunky ) | 1/3 cup irish cream, such as bailey's
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Spread the hazelnuts onto a baking sheet and toast until lightly darkened, shaking the pan frequently to prevent burning. Watch closely they burn easily, so keep an eye on them. When cool, remove and chop coarsely. Stir the parmigiano back into the sausage. Season the sausage with salt and pepper. Cut the sausage into 1 1/2 inch pieces and rub evenly over each piece of hazelnuts. Wrap the sausage in paper towels and place in the refrigerator. Heat the rotel to medium heat in a medium saute pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and season with salt. Lower the heat to low. Cover and simmer with a lid over medium low heat, stirring occasionally until the tomatoes break down and the sauce darkens slightly, 20 – 25 minutes. Uncover and add the irish cream. Allow it to boil for 2 minutes and remove from the heat. Season with salt and pepper. Remove the sausage and nuts and divide among 4 dinner plates. Spoon the tomato sauce over them. Sprinkle the top with the hazelnut paste and drizzle with the grated parmigiano reggiano cheese.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,cooking oil,sultana,flour tortilla,salmon fillet,sea salt,pecorino romano cheese,cumin powder
title: Aussie Steak and Veggies Wrap
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 32 ounces mixed assorted fresh veggie burgers ( or chicken ) | 1 cup flour tortilla, warmed | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon smoked salmon fillet, diced
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Meanwhile, combine the mixed veggies. Cook 4 - 6 minutes, or until all the moisture from the veggies has been absorbed. Remove from heat, sprinkle with salt and cumin and set aside. To wrap the wrap, heat tortilla on a clean nonstick skillet over a medium high heat, flipping the pan, tilting the skillet as necessary until the entire surface is covered with the veggie mix and no liquid remains. Remove the wrap from the skillet, place on a cutting board, and place the two pieces of wrap in a flat circle. Wrap the wrap in the foil and warm over low heat until the meat is cooked, about 15 - 20 minutes. To serve cut in half and serve with additional cheese for garnish.

title: Tunisian Potato Tortilla
ingredients: 3 lbs potatoes, unpeeled, peeled and cut into 1-inch x 1/4-inch sticks ( yukon gold are good or you can use red ) | 1 celery, diced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped ( i don't use them ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet paprika ( can use sweet paprika with hot pepper ) | 3/4 cup half-and-half | 2 -3 tablespoons half-and-half cream or 2 -3 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 tablespoon ground sumac or 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. You will end up with mashed potatoes that will actually not stay together, so if the potatoes are too soft and runny, a spoon will loosen them a bit.

title: Roasted Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 medium yellow bell peppers, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 3/4 cup red currant jelly | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( or to taste )
instructions: Note, if using a glass pan, spray with veggie oil to lightly coat. Place bell peppers in a single layer in a large, heavy duty plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,vegetable stock,mustard powder,pinto bean,bread flour,currant,superfine sugar
title: Best-Ever Easy Non-Garlicky Whole Baked Beans (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 4 tablespoons bread flour | 1 tablespoon plain dried currants | 1 1/2 cups pinto beans | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Bring the water to a boil. In a small bowl, combine the vegetable stock, mustard powder, sugar, and bread flour. Stir to combine, then stir in the currants. Set aside. Bring the beans to a boil with 1 1/2 cups water in a pan. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer until the beans are tender, 15 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peppermint extract,pimento olive,pork shoulder,orange peel,chocolate chip
title: Pork Covered in Peppermint
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder | 4 ounces orange peel, shredded | 1/2 cup pe pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon peppermint extract | 12 ounces chocolate chips or 12 ounces candy coating chips
instructions: Pull the membrane from the roast and discard. With your fingers, rub the remaining slices of pork with the orange strips. Slend the orange peel slices with the black olives and pimento stuffed olives. Sprinkle the peppermint extract on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next morning, preheat oven to 300 degrees. Line a baking pan with foil and place the pork on pan. Dot with chocolate chips. Bake for 2 hours or until pork reaches an internal temperature of 170 degrees.

title: Tangy Chicken in a Cast Iron Skillet
ingredients: 1 cup golden light corn syrup | 1 cup sliced green olives | 3 large chicken legs
instructions: Pour corn syrup into a 12 inch skillet set over medium high heat.

title: Parsley Seed Soup
ingredients: 450 g fresh mustard seeds | 500 ml chicken stock
instructions: Place the mustard seeds in a large frying pan and toast over medium heat till golden brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Add the stock and cook on medium heat until the liquid is absorbed, 10 to 15 minutes, stirring from time to time.

title: Cherry Peppers
ingredients: 2 cans cherry peppers, drained | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the cajun seasoning and the cherry peppers. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Green Beans in Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 dozen fresh green beans, trimmed and cut into 2 inch lengths | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped fresh italian parsley, divided ( or use 1tsp dried parsley flakes )
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling salted water, cook beans until tender, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Green Chile Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh spinach, washed and torn in bite size pieces | 4 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced ( optional ) | 2 green chili peppers, seeded and sliced ( optional ) | 8 cups chicken stock | fresh strawberries, if desired
instructions: In a large pot bring the chiken stock to a boil. Stir in the spinach and greens, lower heat to medium and cook for 5 minutes. Add the sliced kiwifruit and peppers. Cook an additional 5 minutes. Ladle into soup bowls and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,chipotle chile,half cream,date,steak,meat,chardonnay wine
title: Grilled Chilean Sea Bass
ingredients: 4 fresh sea bass fillets, each weighing 10 ounces ( or other dark fish ) | 4 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1/3 cup chardonnay wine or 1/3 cup other dry white wine | 1/4 cup chardonnay wine | 1/4 cup chardonnay wine or 1/4 cup other dry white wine | 14 ounces beef tenderloin, from three ( about 2 fillets ) | 7 ounces chipotle chiles, from a jar of chipotle chiles, from a can, from the can, stems removed | 1/2 cup pitted dates, coarsely chopped
instructions: Trim the scales off the sea bass fillets, if they are large, cut into 3 fillets. Make a béchamel sauce by heating the cream in a saucepan over medium low heat. Do not boil. Add chardonnay and chardonnay and warm over low heat, stirring constantly until the chardonnay is reduced by half, about 15 minutes. Add the beef and cook over high heat until it starts to brown on the top. Meanwhile, preheat the grill to medium high. When the pan is hot, oil the surface of the fillets. Brush the fillets with béchamel sauce.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,chicken thigh,tahini,kraft tuscan house italian dressing,button mushroom,corn tortilla,penne pasta
title: Grilled Chicken and Pasta Toss
ingredients: 18 corn tortillas ( or less ) | 2 cups cooked penne pasta, about 11/2 oz, divided | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 3/4 lb kraft tuscan house italian dressing ( low sodium ) | 2 cups tahini | 1 1/2 cups olive oil | 12 ounces button mushrooms ( or 2 cups sliced mushrooms )
instructions: Heat grill to high. Coat large grill pan with nonstick cooking spray. Wrap tortillas in foil and place on the grill. Grill tortillas until charred on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Heat 1/2 cup sauce in a medium saucepan to boiling over medium high heat.

title: Mock Devonshire
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | 1 ounce marshmallow cream
instructions: Place the marshmallow cream in a bowl and add a little bit of water or so until the mixture starts to cling to your fingers.

title: Earl's Spanish Tilapia
ingredients: 24 slices sourdough bread | 24 slices tilapia fillets | 1 jar salsa
instructions: To make salsa, in a small saucepan, combine salsa and water to make 1 cup. Place the bread slices on a microwavable dish and top with fish.

title: Baked Maple Curry Rub Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: For curry, combine all the ingredients and stir until the curry powder is incorporated. If the curry powder is too thick, add a little more maple syrup.

title: Fried Chicken (Giovannelles Frikadeller)
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour, sifted | 1 1/2 lbs chicken parts | 24 slices prosciutto, thin
instructions: Pour flour and 1 tsp salt into a large bowl. Add the flour and salt and mix until flour is completely dissolved. Dip chicken in flour, then in a large sauce pan of boiling water, making sure to coat chicken thoroughly. Place chicken in hot oil, fry, drain, and fry in deep fat until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Beef Or Venison Ortega
ingredients: 2 lbs prime lean ground beef ( or venison, or a mixture of both ) or 2 lbs venison, thinly sliced ( or a mixture of both ) | 1 yellow onion, chopped | spaghetti, cooked according to package directions ( or fettuccino, or fettucine ) | red wine ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat with onion.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,lettuce,walnut half,italian parsley,parsley,garlic powder,focaccia bread,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Bean Melts for Two
ingredients: 8 -10 fresh garlic powder, or to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup chopped walnut halves | 1/2 cup chopped italian parsley | 1/4 cup chopped walnut halves | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, or to taste | 3/4 cup chopped italian parsley, or to taste | 1 package cooked cannellini beans sprouts | 8 slices focaccia bread | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh italian parsley, or as desired
instructions: Combine garlic powder and 2 tablespoons chopped parsley in a small bowl. Spread mixture over a flat surface, and sprinkle with walnut halves and 1/4 cup parsley. Sauté until parsley and parsley are dry, about 3 minutes. Add chipotle chile, 1/4 cup chopped parsley, 1/4 cup chopped parsley, basil and 2 more tablespoons parsley. Remove from heat, and allow to cool to warm. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread cannellini bean sprouts on a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread on bean sprouts. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, 15 to 20 minutes. Sprinkle with more chopped parsley, and cool. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,celery seed,horseradish,date,baby carrot,pizza crust,sandwich bun
title: Dorsey's Crazy Duper Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon ground celery seed | 2 slices crusty sandwich bun | 1/2 cup baby carrots | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 4 slices dried dates | 1 pinch coarsely ground horseradish
instructions: Spread tomato soup on crusted sandwich roll, sprinkle carrots and a few shakes of celery seed on top of soup. Place an equal amount of dates and some horseradish on top of dates too. Place a piece of bread on top, spread with remaining soup, and top with remaining piece of bread. Cut in half to serve.

title: Bean Sprout Bean Dip
ingredients: 4 cups fresh bean sprouts, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons vegetable seasoning
instructions: Place bean sprouts in a bowl or strainer and sprinkle with the seasoning. Mix well and let sit for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Puffed Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, washed | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour, sifted
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to boil in a large saucepan, then add rice. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain well and allow to steam dry for a further 2 to 3 minutes. Pour sifted flour into a large bowl. Mix thoroughly with rice. Divide into 8 portions. Shape into balls. Roll each ball into a round shaped patty that is about 5 inches across. Place on greased oven tray. Bake in a moderate oven for 12 minutes, or until the underside is lightly browned. Serve hot.

title: Coleslaw II
ingredients: 1 cucumber, cut into thin wedges | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 head red cabbage - rinsed, dried, and shredded
instructions: Mix together the cucumber, beans, and cabbage. Cover with water. Let stand for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,broiler chicken,penne,buttermilk,chicken stock,superfine sugar,grand marnier
title: Portobello, Portuguese Broiled Chicken and Penne
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups chicken stock | 2 anchovy fillets, drained, patted dry | 2 tablespoons grand marnier, fruity flavour | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar | penne | 4 1/2 - 5 1/2 lbs broiler chickens, halved | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: Heat stock, anchovy and sugar in saucepan to boiling. Cook about 3 to 5 minutes. Boil about 2 minutes. Meanwhile, cook pasta in buttermilk water, until al dente. Rinse with cold water, drain well. Dish chicken and penne together and arrange over sauce. Pour milk over. Serve with fresh herbs.

title: Kielbasa and Date Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 2 dried dates | 1/2 lb kielbasa | 4 teaspoons white semolina ( or you may use a multi-grain blend ) | 4 teaspoons dried black cardamom pods | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/2 cup fresh fruit or 1/2 cup dried fruit pectin
instructions: Poke holes through the top of the pork tenderloin lengthwise in a few places with sharp, sharp knife. Place in a 9x13 inch pan. Add 1/2 pound of the dried dates and 1/2 pound of the kielbasa. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon each of the kosher salt and crushed black cardamom seeds. Cut away the center vein of the dried date. Cut the kielbasa into bite sized pieces on 1 side. Place all in a large non stick pan. Cover with 1/2 1 cup water. Bring to a boil then reduce and simmer for 45 minutes, or until meat is tender. Turn up the heat to a boil and add 2 teaspoons of white semolina or mix with a few tablespoons of water, stir continuously for an additional 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in 1 teaspoon each of dried fruit pectin and the lemon juice, cook for 1 - 2 minutes, remove from heat. Drain off the fat from the sausage and place on a serving platter. Spoon the sausage drippings over the top. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: peach,caster sugar,pork,red bell pepper,chicken drumstick,potato flour,brown sugar,sea salt
title: Paleo Chicken and Sweet Potato Pasties from the Food Network
ingredients: 350 g sweet potatoes or 350 g yams | 225 g good quality lean pork | 275 g chicken drumsticks, chopped | 75 ml peach slices | 200 g red bell peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 2 teaspoons caster sugar, extra, extra for dusting
instructions: Boil your diced sweet potato and/or yam in plenty of water. Meanwhile, melt the extra sugar and sea salt in a frying pan, over a moderate heat. Drain the mince then roughly chop. Put the mince and sweet potato/yam mixture into a large bowl with your cooked sweet potato and mix well. Meanwhile heat some oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add your chicken and diced sweetpot/yam mix. Fry the chicken, stirring often, for 5 - 7 minutes until browned. Add your diced sweet potato/yam mix. Bring to the boil.

title: Horseradish & Sun Dried Tomato Baked Figs for the Grill
ingredients: 2 lbs unpeeled figs, quartered | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon fresh horseradish, minced | 1/8 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f coat a 1 1/2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Combine figs, oil, horseradish and red pepper flakes in baking dish. Bake 20 minutes. Remove baking dish from oven and mist with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: mexicorn,lime,flour tortilla,tarragon,soya sauce,cardamom pod,icing sugar,palm sugar
title: Thai Nachos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime, juice of | 400 g mexicorn, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon palm sugar | 2 flour tortillas | 1/2 teaspoon icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Place the lime juice, soya sauce, tarragon, cardamom, and palm sugar into a food processor and process to a smooth paste. Place the nachos onto a baking sheet lined with parchment and drizzle them with the nacho sauce. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from the oven and cut into wedges. Place on a serving plate and sprinkle with icing sugar. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,pineapple juice,shrimp paste,ricotta cheese,garbanzo bean
title: Pineapple and Garbanzo Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 8 ounces unsweetened pineapple juice | 1/4 teaspoon shrimp paste | 3/4 teaspoon ginger paste | 6 ounces ricotta cheese
instructions: Combine garbanzo beans, pineapple juice, shrimp paste, ginger paste and ricotta cheese in a blender container or food processor. Process until smooth. Stir into the drained garbanzo bean mixture. Refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,onion flake,spice,ice water,crisco shortening,pinto bean,chili sauce
title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crisco shortening | 2 medium onions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 cups pinto beans, cooked, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Heat the shortening in a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Add the onions.

Random Ingredients: french fry,red wine,cream mushroom soup,plum tomato,white button mushroom
title: French Fried Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bag bag frozen french fries, thawed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups dry red wine | 24 white button mushrooms | 1 can plum tomatoes, drained and chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the breaded french fries, cream of mushroom soup, red wine, and mushrooms.

title: Spicy Orange Tacos
ingredients: 16 lasagna noodles | 1 jar caramelized carrots ( not caramelized ) | 2 tablespoons capers, minced | pepper | 4 ounces mascarpone cheese | 4 -8 taco shells, warmed ( i prefer to use warmed ones ) | 1 cup orange juice, warmed
instructions: Prepare the taco shells by placing warmed taco shells on a parchment lined baking sheet. Spray the tops of the taco shells with cooking spray. Bake at 350 degrees for 3 - 5 minutes, until lightly browned. While the taco shells are baking, prepare the carrots. In a very large skillet, melt 2 t. Melted butter. Add the caramelized carrots. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the carrots are just beginning to caramelize. Add the capers. Continue to cook until the carrots are soft. Turn off the heat. Using a slotted spoon, scoop the carrots into a bowl of ice water to prevent them from cooking further. Drain the carrots, but save 1 cup of the liquid. Return the carrots to the skillet and add the mascarpone. Cook 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring frequently. Place 2 oz. Melted butter into each taco shell and spoon in the cheese mixture. Wrap the tacos in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve the tacos garnished with the warmed taco shells.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,red kidney bean,oregano leaf,oil,garlic,butter,sherry
title: Greek Style Red Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried red kidney beans | 1 ounce butter | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/4 teaspoon dry oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon italian salad dressing | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons oil ( for frying )
instructions: Rinse and drain the soaked beans. Place the drained beans into a medium sized bowl, add the water to cover and leave to soak overnight. The next day, melt the butter in an old frying pan over medium low heat. Add the garlic and cook, stirring for about 2 minutes. Stir in the oregano and italian dressing and heat through. Preheat the grill to medium high. Drain the beans and add to the pan. Heat to boiling, then simmer until tender. While the beans are cooking, make the sherry. Put the sherry into a small saucepan over low heat and heat slowly, stirring frequently, until it starts to reduce. Pour the sherry over the cooked beans, then simmer for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,active yeast,apple cider vinegar,chili powder,limeade concentrate,red wine
title: Spicy Shredded Carrots for the Slow Cooker
ingredients: 14 ounces canned apple cider vinegar | 14 ounces frozen yogurt-style baby carrots | 1 teaspoon dried active dry yeast | 2/3 cup hot red wine, such as rioja, for dipping | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Empty apple cider vinegar into slow cooker. Add frozen baby carrots & dry yeast. Sprinkle chili powder & vinegar over the carrots & mix thoroughly. Set cooker on high and cook until carrots are soft and all vegetables have softened, about 10 hours. At 20 - 30 minutes, skim any foam before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,extra virgin olive oil,poppy seed,turmeric
title: Poppy Seed Garlic Mixture
ingredients: 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( not ground ) | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Toast poppy seeds in non stick pan until golden brown then remove. Place sausage in a mixing bowl and pour oi in the pan juices stir and let cook until almost completely thickened, about 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in s&p. Stir in poppy seeds and a pinch of turmeric. Serve with grilled or sauteed zatagas, sliced mushrooms, boiled pasta or rice.

title: Chinese Fried Bacon Bits
ingredients: 6 slices bacon bits ( about 2 1/2 ozs. ) | 4 teaspoons chinese dark soy sauce
instructions: Dry fry bacon bits until crisply crispy about 10 to 15 minutes in a hot skillet. Drain the bacon bits on paper towels and allow to cool. Cut bacon into 1/2 inch by 2 1/2 inch squares. Use up all of the bacon fat remaining in the skillet if necessary. Add dark soy sauce to bacon bites and toss until coated and heated throughout. Serve on a platter. This is nice spread with steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,basil leaf,rosemary leaf,monterey jack cheese,egg
title: Classic Egg Halves
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated egg halves | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 -2 tablespoon finely chopped parsley leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon finely chopped basil leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and set aside. Using a brush, coat the halve of each cheese slice lightly with lemon juice over both sides. Transfer the halved cheese to the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle top of halved cheese with parsley and basil. Bake halved cheese until the cheese is bubbly and golden, about 12 minutes.

title: Garbanzo Bean Sushi
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained, rinsed well | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored, and chopped | 4 sheets nori
instructions: Lay out 2 sheets nori. Flatten and shape into a long, narrow siki. Set aside. Press each garbanzo bean against the nori to compact and even it out a little bit. Cut each section into about one half moon sized squares. Arrange one square of nori over the bean base along with the apple and nori.

title: Greek Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups instant cake flour | 1 tablespoon instant fenugreek | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/3 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup frozen peas
instructions: Combine ground fenugreek, garlic powder, triple sec, frozen peas. Add dry ingredients, mix well. If you are not fortunate enough to own a pastry bag, transfer mixture to a zip lock plastic bag. Gently squeeze out the air, seal, and add to mixture. Refrigerate 2 hours, and then work with 1 tablespoon at a time.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,pasta sauce,vanilla ice cream,ramen noodle
title: Easy Red Bean Cream Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package ramen noodles, broken in half ( no seasoning packet included ) | 1 pint vanilla ice cream | 1 jar pasta sauce
instructions: Boil the 3 cans of beans in water until fully cooked. Drain. Heat oven to 350 degrees. In casserole dish, layer noodles, bean mixture, and ice cream. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes.

title: Caramelised Lamb Roasted With Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 lb lamb shoulder, jointed, meaty and sinly scored | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons light rum | 2 large ripe tomatoes, sliced | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Place the quinoa in a large bowl. Pour boiling water over the quinoa and stir well. Leave to soak in a cool, draught free spot for an hour. Place the ribs on a rack over the quinoa and pour off all but 2 tbsp of the soaking liquid. Turn the ribs over. Brush the lamb shoulder generously with rum and rub in with your hands. Place the rims on a cookie tray or baking sheet and brush with rum. Roast in preheated oven at 375°f/160°c for 1 hour. Remove and discard the ribs. Turn the lamb onto its board and shred into slices.
