Return the lamb to the baking tray uncovered and roast for a further 30 - 45 minutes or until the meat is crisp on the outside. Towards the end of cooking remove the pan from the oven and arrange the tomato slices in, overlapping, overlapping, slices around the lamb. Pour over the sugar and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 - 30 minutes. Serve with warm crusty bread.

title: Cheese and Bean Stuffing
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans | 1 package crumbled feta | 1 large butternut squash, seeds removed ( peeled and cubed ) | 1 tablespoon dried herbs ( or of your choice, rosemary, thyme, basil ) | 1 tablespoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. If using dried herbs, add all ingredients in order in a large saucepan. Bring to boil and reduce heat. When mixture reaches desired consistency, add feta cheese and mix well. If mixture has a little bit of its texture, add water. Stir, and cover. Set in oven for 1 hour. Cool completely. Take out stuff in fridge or serve with bread or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: sherry,flat leaf italian parsley,baby spinach leaf
title: Crispy Spinach Leaves with Sherry
ingredients: 1 package fresh baby spinach leaves | 1 cup dry sherry | chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley ( optional )
instructions: Remove thick stems from spinach leaves in a collander.

title: Greek Cheese Balls
ingredients: 3 lbs ricotta cheese | 2 cups golden raisins | 1/2 cup teapsoon crushed dried tea
instructions: Mix together the first four ingredients. Then combine with hands until smooth. Pinch off small walnut size pieces of the mixture. Roll in crumbs and roll in raisins or other edible glitter to cover. Bake in a 350 degree f oven until well browned.

title: Quickie French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 2 -3 mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Slice 2 - 3 large loaves of french bread and stick 2 - 3 slices to each slice. Open and lay the mushrooms on top of the bread. Dollop a dab of creamiie hot sauce into the center of the mushrooms. You can use any leftover crock.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,shaoxing wine,vanilla extract,carrot,chipotle chile adobo,eggplant,mustard seed
title: Mexican Eggplant With Chiles
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, halved crosswise, or more to taste ( about 3 pounds total ) | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 4 large dried chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped, or more to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 6 hard-cooked eggs, peeled | 1 sprig fresh seaweed ( optional )
instructions: Prepare a grill for high heat, or preheat an outdoor grill basket if using an outdoor grill. Lightly oil the grate, and arrange the eggplant halves on skewers. Grill the eggplant until the flesh shimmers and begins to slightly blacken, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Place the eggplant in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until the eggplant has chilled to room temperature, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, make the chili paste by combining the chilies, mustard seeds, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt in a food processor or mortar and pestle, and pounding into a smooth paste. Taste and season with additional salt, lime juice, or chili powder, if needed. Set aside until ready to use. Remove the eggplant flesh from the skewers and pat dry. Place the slices onto a grill rack, or onto a baking sheet. Grill in the preheated grill until golden on the cut side, about 2 minutes on each side, and remove to a platter to serve. Garnish with some hard shelled eggs and serve with any chili sauce alongside.

title: Ravioli with Lime, Capers and Chicken
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen cheese ravioli, thawed | 4 ounces thinly sliced cooked chicken breast | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/4 cup capers | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/3 cup bottled hot capers
instructions: Cook ravioli according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, toss chicken, artichokes, capers, lime juice, and capers with remaining ingredients. Serve with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,spanish onion,extra virgin olive oil
title: Salsa Di Besciamella -- Red Pepper Onion and Red Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 small spanish onion, finely diced ( vidalia or maui ) | 1 small red bell pepper, finely diced ( or green ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,vegetable broth,chili oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Gluten Free Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup mushroom broth | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated | 1 -2 tablespoon hot chili oil, plus more to drizzle ( optional )
instructions: Combine the broth and brown sugar in a small saucepan and bring to boil over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until the liquid begins to thicken slightly, about 3 minutes. Strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a small measuring cup or bowl. Add the cheese and hot chili oil if using. Remove from the heat, remove the chili oil, and reserve 1/4 cup of the sauce. Store the remainder in the refrigerator. Whisk the reserved sauce and reserved cheese mixture into the warm cheese mixture in the saucepan. Add more hot oil, to taste, if necessary. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Note, when adding the hot chili oil, it is always best to remove a small amount at a time so you don't over flavor the final product.

title: Yummy Tandoori Peanut Butter Bread
ingredients: 250 g fresh yeast | 250 g unsalted butter ( no substitutions ) | 350 ml yogurt or 7 fluid ounces vanilla yogurt ( nonfat ) | 450 ml dark rum ( no substitutions ) | 100 g peanut butter ( don't substitute with coconut! ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 3 tablespoons tamari | 500 ml liquid honey
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in a large quantity of water with half the honey and half the sugar. Heat the butter in a very large pan and slowly melt over low heat until foamy. Mix in the yogurt and the remaining honey. Place the bowl, uncovered, in a warm place until the dough becomes smooth and satiny, about 90 minutes or up to 90 minutes. Knock the dough back and forth with your fingers. Turn it out onto a floured board and knead in the reserved honey. Lightly oil a large bowl, place in the dough and turn to coat the sides. Cover loosely and let rise in a warm place until nearly doubled in bulk. Punch down the dough and knead briefly, about 8 or 10 times, in about 10 turns. Knead in the remaining honey. Preheat the oven to 325f and bake the bread for 45 to 50 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the bread sounds hollow when tapped. Cool on a wire rack. Cut into wedges and serve warm. Great with ice cream or whipped cream. Enjoy.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 15 ounces frozen corn, thawed | 3 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 2 quarts salted water to a boil. Add thawed corn to boiling water. Cook 3 minutes, then drain. Transfer drained corn to a bowl. Add 3 ounces cheese to the drained corn and mix thoroughly. Pour into a pasta or meat grinder and pulse until smooth. Return the pasta or grinder to the saucepan and add the remaining cheese. Cook at a simmer until the cheese is melted and bubbly and starts to brown.

title: Caribbean Style Fruity Pickle-Chil Sauce
ingredients: 8 kaffir lime leaves, or 10 green limes | 1 cup coarsely chopped currants or 1 cup raisins | 1/4 cup finely chopped pickle rind ( optional ) | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Place kaffir in a heatproof bowl. Add water to cover. Cover bowl and let soak at room temperature about 1 hour. Strain water and discard kaffir. Transfer kaffir to bowl of cold water until leaves are softened. Drain.

title: Italian Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 cup fresh white flour | 1/2 - 3/4 lb pepperoni, chopped
instructions: Mix together the dry ingredients. Place the pepperoni slices in a dry skillet. Make sure they are laying flat on the skillet. Dip the pepperoni into the flour and then press through a course sieve. Repeat this until all of the pepperoni has been done and placed in a paper bag. After cooking, use a long handled bat to remove any remaining fat which may be stuck to the pan. To serve place pepperoni slices on a warm platter. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Fresh Spinach With Blackberries and Chilli (Paneer)
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach | 1 liter fresh white corn ( i have also used frozen corn kernels and frozen black beans, which are both delicious ) | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed red chili powder, such as jalapeno pepper ( or a teaspoon chopped fresh cilantro ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup blackberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Wash and drain the spinach from completely under running water for 3 or 4 minutes drain completely and put in a blender, along with the corn kernels, chili powder and blackberries. Process until smooth. Add a little water if too thick to process. Serve with pappadums, as an appetiser or cold cuts.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa sausage,chia seed,wheat germ,epazote leaf,soymilk,parsley flake
title: Kielbasa Cheese (Baked in Soy Milk)
ingredients: 200 ml soymilk | 200 ml chia seeds ( optional ) | 200 g kielbasa sausage or 200 g bacon, diced | 1 tablespoon chia seeds | 1 tablespoon wheat germ | 1 tablespoon epazote leaves | 2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients for the kielbasa together in a pan. Heat the milk and simmer on low heat. Add the sausages, chia seeds and parsley flakes and simmer for 4 minutes. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: onion,fine breadcrumb,celery rib,sharp cheddar cheese,monterey jack cheese
title: Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 2 cups onions, medium size, peeled, sliced in circles | 2 celery ribs, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese ( optional ) | 1 container fine dry breadcrumb | 1 1/2 cups plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Place the onions and celery in a baking dish, pour the water. Cover with foil and bake at 400' for about 30 - 40 minutes. Remove the cover, sprinkle with the cheeses and continue baking until the cheeses are melted and starting to brown around the edges, but do not allow to completely melt the cheese. Drain the onions and celery and reserve. Combine the bread crumbs and the bread crumbs and mix well. Add the onions and celery and mix well again. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the cheesy/bread crumb mixture into each onion slice and place in an oiled baking dish. Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes or until the onions are tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken,duck egg,strawberry syrup,pea carrot,half,dill pickle,white wine vinegar
title: Duck Egg and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1/2 duck egg | 1/2 whole chicken | 1/2 cup frozen peas and carrots | 4 -5 strawberries, sliced | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | fresh dill pickle ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Skin and clean the duck, chop in half lengthwise, remove any visible fat.. Break each half into two chunks and place in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine the duck egg and 1/2 cup water. Place the remaining duck egg chunks in a small pot, add cold water to cover the duck as much as possible. Bring to a boil, remove the duck from the pot and place it in the duck's cavity cavity. Turn off the heat and place the duck in the pot with the other half of the water. Cover and let stand for at least 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the duck. Remove the skin, fat, bones and giblets from the duck. Cut the duck meat into bite sized pieces and pour the half and half into the bowl with the duck and veg. Stir until smooth and creamy. Add in the pickles for a garnish. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve and place in the refrigerator 1 - 2 hours before serving to let flavors meld.

title: Black Beans for Two
ingredients: 50 g sliced bacon | 250 g black beans | 2 sage leaves
instructions: Cook the bacon until it is a little crispy, and remove the bacon from the pan. Stir in the beans, and cover, leaving for 10 minutes, then put in an oven for about 10 to 15 minutes at 190 degrees centigrade. Remove the lid, stir, and cook for a further 2 minutes so that the beans soften.

title: Rosemary Lettuce Wraps (A Memory of My Mum's Recipe)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rice wine | 1 bunch fresh rosemary sprigs | 3 tablespoons water | 1 iceberg lettuce, cut into large chunks
instructions: Mix the rice wine and rosemary in to a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,caper,marsala wine,custard powder,maraschino juice,nori
title: Couscous Marsala
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared custard powder | 3 tablespoons marsala wine | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon drained capers | 1 tablespoon drained capers | 1 tablespoon drained nori, rings | 1/2 teaspoon marsala wine | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 splash dijon-style gelatin
instructions: Combine custard powder, 3 tablespoons marsala wine, 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon granules, 1 tablespoon capers, 1 tablespoon drained capers, 1 tablespoon shaved nori, and 1 tablespoon chopped maraschino. Prepare couscous according to package instructions. Meanwhile, whisk 1 tablespoon dijon style gelatin with 1/4 cup dijon style gelatin. Remove lid of a small saucepan.

title: Easy Chef John's Sour Cream Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 carton sour cream | 1/3 cup orange zest | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/8 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/8 teaspoon red chili seasoning or 1/8 teaspoon mexican creole seasoning
instructions: Combine one can of green enchilada sauce and sour cream in a large, microwave safe bowl. Add the orange zest, basil, garlic, chile powder, orange zest and red chili seasoning. Toss to coat. Cover and microwave 20 seconds to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,red pepper powder,thyme,kirby cucumber,yellow pepper,spaghetti,parmesan cheese,grand marnier
title: Spicy Noodle Salad Mix With Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups grated parmesan cheese | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 cups minced parsley & mint, packed | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup accent flavoring liqueur | 1 tablespoon paprika red pepper powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 medium kirby cucumbers, peeled and minced | 1 medium yellow pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Prepare the spicy spaghetti according to package directions using all the vinaigrette ingredients except the parmesan. Drain spaghetti and add all the ingredients to the bowl. Add cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,celery leaf,beef bouillon cube,yellow bell pepper,parsnip,baby carrot,lemon,banana leaf
title: Pepper and Parsnip (Diabetic)  Faux Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 -2 lb trimmed baby carrots ( the smaller, younger stalks should be trimmed ) | 1 large lemons or 2 lemons, juice of or 6-8 lemons | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 -3 fresh hot yellow bell peppers, seeded and sliced | 2 -3 parsnips, grated ( or 1 baby turnip, peeled and grated if you prefer ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped celery leaves | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweet red peppers ( or your choice of color ) or 1/2 cup white pepper ( or your choice of color ) | white pepper | banana leaf, can be used to cover ( just not in a can )
instructions: The original recipe used a 6 oz. Tail from a whole beef tenderloin, not very lean. I did not use a thermometer, just a small plate/pounder that would measure a pound and weigh just shy of 1 pound, or just under 1 pound for tenderloin. A meat thermometer should be able to reach 1 pound after 45 minutes total. You don't need to be able to measure the difference. While the beef is marinating prep, put the juice, bouillon cube, and peppers in a microwave safe cup and heat on high for 1 minute, until hot. Discard solids and return liquid to the microwave safe dish. Add carrots, parsnips, celery and celery to dish. Heat on high for 5 minutes. Add cooked beef, stirring gently to combine. Sprinkle pepper and white pepper over meat. You can season with white pepper if you wish.

title: Zucchini American Cheese Breakfast
ingredients: 1 zucchini, grated 1-inch | 8 slices american cheese | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon, divided
instructions: Slice zucchini into 1/4 inch slices. Spray 2 12x8x2 inch baking dishes with nonstick cooking spray. Lay slices in dishes, top with zucchini slices and 1 tsp ground cinnamon. Coat with remaining 1 tsp ground cinnamon. Cover and refrigerate 30 - 60 minutes, flipping zucchini several times. Microwave on high power 1 1/2 minutes or until zucchini is tender and zucchini is heated through, rotating dish as necessary.

title: Fish with Cherries
ingredients: 8 whole trout, about 4 inches in diameter | 4 -6 tablespoons minced fresh lime zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 2 cans whole cherries, drained and halved
instructions: Lightly oil grill and preheat oven to 350°f. Prepare grill for cooking over hot coals and under a hot broiler, or in a gas grill. Remove fish from skin and discard head or tail fins. Pat dry with paper towels. Rinse fish with cold water. Pat fish dry. Prepare coals for cooking fish, in a small bowl combine lime zest and cumin. Sprinkle zest over fish. Place fish on grill rack or ovenproof platter. Cook 1 minute, or until easily flaked with a fork. Arrange cherries on top of fish, close baking pan and bake until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,puff pastry,cornstarch,feta,bay leaf,buttermilk,italian seasoning,orange bell pepper
title: Crunchy Feta Pastries
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed and defrosted according to package directions | 1 medium orange bell pepper, seeded and cut into large chunks | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried orange bell pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 cup chopped lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400. Lightly spray an 8x8x2 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Toss the cubed pastry with 1/2 cup water and 2 teaspoons salt until the pastry forms a ball that is smooth and holds together without becoming pasty. Place the pastry ball into a lightly oiled bowl and gently stir in the orange pepper until coated. Place the cereal in a food processor with 1/2 cup cold water, then process until a smooth paste forms. Mix the cornstarch, buttermilk, 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning, 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning, 1 1/2 teaspoons orange pepper and 1/2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning together in a measuring cup. Whisk the cornstarch mixture into the cereal mixture gradually, stirring in 1/2 cup of the liquid from the dish to help the stuffing thicken. Portion the mixture into the baking pan. Top with chopped lettuce. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,lemon juice zest,baking powder,lemon peel
title: Lemon and Lemon Salt Salt Body Biscuits (Cookies)
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig, leaves picked from stems | 1 lemon peel, finely shredded | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Sieve the fresh thyme leaves from the stems, discarding the stems and finely shredded thyme. Stir together the lemon peel, lemon juice and baking powder in a bowl and set aside.

title: BBQ Chicken Satay
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground sirloin | 2 slices bacon, roughly chopped | 1 1 lb chicken meat or 1 lb lamb | 1 slice lemongrass | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 cup walnut oil | 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into 4 patties. I cut the meat into strips. Grill over medium low heat for 7 - 10 minutes per side, or until cooked. Serve with satays.

title: Baked Lemon Candies
ingredients: 1 cup packed light brown sugar | 1 1/2 cups candied lemon peel | 1/2 cup melted margarine
instructions: Line an ungreased baking sheet with plastic wrap. In a medium bowl, combine the brown sugar and margarine and mix well. Add the candied lemon peel until evenly coated and thoroughly coated with the mixture. Quickly spread the candies out onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake until the candies turn golden brown around the edges, about 10 to 12 minutes. Cool and store in an airtight container.

title: Auntie Theresa's Mushroom Hot Pot
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 5 tablespoons milk | 1/8 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( chicken meat or beef flavoured chicken bouillon powder ) | 50 button mushrooms, sliced | 1 can bamboo shoots, diced
instructions: Heat the sherry and milk over medium high heat in a flameproof casserole and sprinkle the chicken with the chicken and beef flavoured bouillon. Cover with a lid or foil and cook for 20 minutes. Add the mushrooms and bamboo shoots and cook for another 20 minutes or until the mushrooms are soft. Serve with french bread.

title: Fettuccine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons sultanas, soaked overnight in | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean, scraped | 250 ml tomato sauce | 350 -500 g fresh fettuccine
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200 c/400f degrees. Mix together the ingredients in a dish, making sure they are all well blended. Place a pan of boiling water on the stove. Keep the pan over the heat as it will get dry during the cooking process. Meanwhile, fry the pasta till done and drain. Fold into the sauce along with any extras that have been added from the sauce. Serve.

title: Garam Masala Onion Potato Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 lb bisquick | 1 teaspoon dried hing | 1/2 teaspoon dried bay seasoning | 2 tablespoons onions, minced | 1 package frozen chopped leeks, thawed, well drained ( white and light green parts only ) | 1 can hunt diced tomatoes, undrained
instructions: Place bisquick in a large bowl. Add hing, bay seasoning, onions, leeks and tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,hungarian paprika,chervil,soy sauce,colby monterey jack cheese,cardamom powder,nori,red chilies
title: Grilled Sour Cream Cheese With Chillies (Churrasse)
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon crushed aniseed chilies or 1 teaspoon red chilies | 1/2 cup ground napa nori ( flying fish filipino ) or 1/2 cup shredded nori ( flying fish filipino ) | 1/2 cup grated colby-monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese | grated chervil or parsley, to serve if desired
instructions: Mix sour cream all ingredients together. Cover and chill. To serve, line grill with nonstick foil. Preheat grill to medium high. Grill chillies until just softened, about 3 minutes per side. Cut into halves or quarters, depending on how much more chillies you need. To serve, sprinkle with cheese, garnish with chillies and parsly. Makes for 3 - 4 servings.

title: Steak With a Savory Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth, or as needed | 1 cup uncooked long-grain rice ( i prefer jasmine. ) | 1 stalk fresh lovage, chopped with tough leaves removed | 1/2 teaspoon dried lovage | 1 flank steak, cut into thin strips | 3 cups thinly sliced bok choy | 6 club soda, or as needed | 2 leaves fresh lovage | 6 sprigs fresh lovage
instructions: Combine the vegetable broth, rice, 1/2 the chopped lovage, and 1/2 the chopped lovage in a saucepan over medium bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the broth is absorbed, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, arrange the sliced lovage between 2 sheets of wax paper.

title: Homemade Strawberry Molasses Tea
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups molasses | fresh crushed black pepper | 8 ounces fresh strawberries, quartered
instructions: Wash and dry the berries and sprinkle with 1 c of molasses and grind coarsely over the berries with your hands. In a saucepan, heat the remaining molasses over medium heat until the molasses is hot but not quite boiling. Pour the warm molasses into the bowl with the strawberries. Stir gently to combine. Cover the bowl with a towel and let infuse for 3 minutes.

title: Smoked Nutty Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted and skinned | 2 tablespoons cream cheese | 2 tablespoons rum | 1 teaspoon rum | 1/2 cucumber, peeled and sliced diagonally | 5 cups mixed mushrooms, sliced | 2 cups reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | chives, fresh chopped ( optional )
instructions: Spread nuts on baking sheets and toast in middle of oven until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Blend cream cheese, rum, cucumber, and 1/2 teaspoon rum into cheese mixture until smooth. Spread evenly over cooled nuts. Cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate salad until ready to serve.

title: Zesty Coriander Dipping Sauce - for Cakes or Pastries
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped coriander powder | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon olive, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Pour into a small cup, covered, and refrigerate to serve. If making the danish, for cakes, pour mixture into a small glass bowl and spread with spatula then dip each cake in this fashion.

title: Pasta With Smoked Salmon and Pesto
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 5 ounces smoked salmon fillets or 5 ounces salmon fillets | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Mix ground beef, salmon and parmesan with your hands. Cook penne pasta according to package directions, with just enough water to allow pasta to absorb as it cooks. While the pasta cooks, heat up the smoked salmon in a fry pan, with olive oil spray, and fry it over a medium heat until it begins to brown. When cooked, drain the salmon, reserving fat, then pour the oil through a colander and press all the liquid out. This is called the cooking liquid and it is used as the sauce.

title: Cherry Crusted Sausages
ingredients: 12 medium hot pork sausages | 4 tablespoons clarified butter | 2 cups rye flour ( available at oriental shops ) | 4 tablespoons semolina | 2 tablespoons chopped almonds | 1 tablespoon chopped sweet roasted red cherry | 1 tablespoon chopped jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: To make the batter, combine the butter, rye flour, semolina, almonds and dried chilies in a bowl and mix lightly. Place 1 tablespoon of the batter in the centre of each sausage link, wetting your fingers between the palms to make sure it covers the whole surface, then transfer the sausage to a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Pour 1 tablespoon of oil into a frying pan and fry the crumbled sausages until golden brown on all sides. Drain on absorbent paper and transfer with a slotted spoon to a warming plate. Place the rest of the batter in a bowl and coat the sausage with half of it. Cook under a preheated hot grill for 10 minutes. Serve sprinkled with the remaining half of the butter and the rest of the butter accompanied with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green chile,scallion,corn tortilla,grain white rice,active yeast
title: Soft Chile, Onion & Tortilla Bread
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm water, divided | 2 2 cups coarsely grated short-grain white rice or 2 cups arborio rice ( 12 oz ) | 3 scallions, thinly sliced on the diagonal, 1 1/2-inch long | 2 cups chopped mild green chiles, drained
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water, then stir into 1/2 cup water. Let stand for 5 minutes until foamy about 10 minutes.

title: Chipotle French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf italian bread | 1/3 cup tahini | 1 large chipotle chile, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Slice about 1 inch width of the french loaf lengthwise. In a small bowl combine the tahini, chile and parsley. Spread evenly over the entire french bread. Cut a slash on the top for the steam to escape. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

title: Flounder Tacos
ingredients: 3 white fish fillets, bones and skin removed | masa harina, as needed | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | your favorite masa harina ( homemade is best )
instructions: Place the fish, masa harina as needed, in the plastic bag or a resealable plastic bag on the counter. Squeeze bag to mix and evenly. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to 8 hours. Drain and rinse fish. Cut in half vertically down the center, discard the center cut. Cut each half into 3 pieces. In a shallow plate or bowl, spoon about 1/4 cup batter to cover the bottom of the fish. Arrange fish on the masa, overlapping with the back of a spoon to help them stick together. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes in a cool place before serving. Top with whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,golden raisin,black olive,parchment paper,malibu rum,jumbo shrimp,polish sausage,oregano leaf
title: Pepperjack Encrusted Tilapia and Polish Sausage Wraps Wraps
ingredients: 1 package jumbo shrimp, uncooked, shelled, deveined | 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, cut in 6 pieces | 1 1/2 lbs polish sausage, sliced | 2/3 cup golden raisin | 8 pitted black olives, chopped | 1 tablespoon cracked black olives | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 20 -24 parchment paper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. On a plate add all ingredients, except for parchment paper, and mix well. On each of the 6 parchment paper line wraps, spoon approximately 2/3 to 1 tablespoon of mixture into center of each wrap. Wrap tightly in parchment paper. On a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, place wraps, spaced about 1 1/2 inches apart, and bake at 375 for 10 - 12 minutes, or until golden brown. Allow to cool for 2 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,vegetable,snow pea,parmigiano reggiano cheese,double cream,serrano pepper
title: Ww 3 Points - Vegetables With Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces snow peas, ends trimmed | 4 cups mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 4 ounces parmigianno reggiano cheese, shaved | 8 ounces double cream | 2 serrano peppers
instructions: Wash, pat dry and trim the snow peas. Using an 8 or 10 inch skillet, heat the vegetable oil to medium heat. Add the snow peas and stir fry until crisp tender. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Wipe out skillet using paper toweling and heat the remaining oil to medium heat. Add the vegetable mixture and saute until browned. Add the vinegar and let come to a boil and add the cheese, stirring for 2 minutes. Add the cream and bring to a boil until it thickens. Add the snow peas and cook until heated through. Transfer to a serving bowl or individual plates and top with the serrano and black pepper slices. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 4 pieces of canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons white wine
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium heat. Brush both sides of each piece of bacon with some of the wine and wrap the bacon up. Place on the grill, close the lid and grill for 10 minutes. Turn and continue to cook for 10 more minutes, or until bacon is nicely browned and crispy and there is some grill marks.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cumin powder,spice,graham cracker crumb,fennel seed
title: Lebanese Spice Paste.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 4 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon truffle spice
instructions: Sift the ingredients together, and mix well. Roll the paste into small balls about the size of a small walnut, and roll lightly in toasted graham cracker crumbs. Place in a single layer on a non stick griddle, and fry over medium heat on medium high heat for 5 minutes on each side, until golden. Allow to cool, and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 months.

title: Mexican Radishes
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pepperoncini peppers | 2 radishes, sliced thinly
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large microwave safe bowl. Cover and cook on high for 1 minute, or until heated through. Uncover and cook on high for 30 seconds more. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,red curry paste,red chilies,hot italian sausage
title: Hot Sausage & Chile Relleno on Rice
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut into 1-in pieces | 12 ounces picante sauce, bottled | 2 ounces red curry paste, red & green | 6 ounces red chilies, fresh, julienne cut
instructions: Remove casings from sausage, sprinkle lightly with salt. In a large skillet, brown sausage over medium heat.

title: Anchovy Provencale II
ingredients: 4 large fresh anchovies | 3 cans whole canned tomatoes with juice | fresh parsley sprigs
instructions: Poke deep holes all over anchovies with a fork. Place in 2 pint jars. Scald tomatoes with their liquid, and remove as soon as they start to boil. Pour into the boiling tomatoes with their liquid, and let stand 10 minutes. Place a sprig of parsley on each tomato.

title: Chipotle Pepper Candy
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces of roasted adobo seasoning | 2 -3 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Take 1 jar of chiles and process in food processor with 1/2 1 cup confectioner sugar until they are a powder. Spread on wax paper lined cookie sheets and let dry. Store in air tight mason jars.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,rice vinegar,dark chocolate,chicken breast,green cardamom pod
title: Easy Chipotle Grilled Chicken With Chipotle Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breasts | 2 green cardamom pods | 8 ounces chipotle peppers, preferably fresh, with a small amount of oil, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 4 tablespoons dark chocolate, lightly packed
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half at one joint. Arrange on a square of foil on a large, shallow baking dish or dish. Place cardamom pods on half of the chicken. Combine chipotles, vinegar and chopped chipotle oil in a small saucepan, and heat gently until the chocolate has melted and the mixture starts to thicken. Pour mixture over chicken. Cover the bowl loosely with foil and refrigerate chicken for half an hour, turning once to thoroughly coat. Remove the chicken halves with a slotted spoon and allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Smoked Salmon Fillets
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat your broiler on high. Arrange the salmon on baking sheets, and spray with olive oil. Sprinkle the bread crumbs evenly over the salmon, and sprinkle with the baking powder. Broil the salmon for 4 min, or until easily flaked with a fork. Serve right away.

title: Panir With Crispy Pancetta and Sun Dried Tomato
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cooking sherry | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( or equivalent substitute ) | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon smoked paprika | 2 ounces smoked bacon ( thinly sliced ) or 2 ounces pancetta, thinly sliced ( thinly sliced ) | 2 pieces sun-dried tomatoes ( soaked in sherry over night ) | 4 -6 ounces panir ( thickly sliced ) or 4 -6 slices monterey jack cheese ( thickly sliced ) | 12 -16 sun-dried tomatoes, drained with water ( optional ) | paprika ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Slice sun dried tomatoes very thinly and place on kitchen paper or a plate. Using both your hands, make 6 small, well shaped small cuts through each slice of pancetta about 3/4 inch wide. Stuff each sun dried tomato with 1/6 of the pancetta/sun dried tomato/pancetta slices. Place in baking dish/pan or on a tray lined with large dish cloth or paper towels. Place a second layer of pancetta/sun dried tomato/pancetta/onion stuffed tomatoes in another dish. Cover with 1/2 cup sliced pancetta/sun dried tomato. Spread 1 - 2 tbsps. Dijon mustard over the top of the dish. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoons of the smoked paprika over the top of the dish/platter. Place a slice of monterey jack cheese over the top. Pour paprika/pepper/sauce over the top. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes, until cheese is melted/sour and tomatoes are warmed. Remove from oven with a spatula and serve on a platter/discard side with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,half cream,basil,beef stew meat,sea scallop,nutmeg,blackberry
title: Gourmet Beef Stew & Blackberry Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef stew meat, cubed | 1 can blackberries | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1 dash ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 pound sea scallops, cut in half
instructions: Toss the stew meat, blackberries, half cream, rum, nutmeg, basil, and sea scallops together in a bowl until evenly coated. Cover, and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bring to a boil in a skillet over medium heat. Reduce heat, and simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Baked Potatoes Ole'
ingredients: 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded ( or similar ) | 1/2 cup mild mexican cheese, shredded ( or similar ) | 2 tablespoons shortening ( i used a stick of butter, so that i could use margarine ) | 2 medium yellow potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges ( about 1 1/2 pounds total ) | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Mix all ingredients. Place potatoes on a buttered baking sheet, and bake for 30 minutes, until potatoes are tender.

title: Brandy Coated Chicken Cutlets
ingredients: 6 orange slices | 600 g chicken cutlets, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups brandy
instructions: Arrange chicken in shallow ovenproof dish. Using a sharp knife, cut a 1cm slice of orange along the length of each cutlet and place 1/2 cup brandy in a small saucepan. Bring to boil and reduce by about half. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 180c for 25 minutes until cooked through and golden.. Serve sprinkled with remaining brandy.

title: Rosemary Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken ( about 1.5 lbs ) | 1 1/2 quarts chicken stock | rosemary sprig, to garnish
instructions: Cut off excess fat and discard. Rinse chicken and place in large pan over medium. Add stock. Cover, bring to a boil. Lower heat, simmer for 30 minutes. Remove chicken from pan. Use slotted spoon to remove chicken and reserve stock. Bring stock to the boil. Remove stock from heat. Cover and let stand until chicken is cooked 10 - 15 minutes. Remove chicken, place on platter and cover. Boil juices until reduced to sauce consistency. Remove rosemary sprigs. Pour over chicken and garnish with rosemary sprigs.

title: Parsley Won Tons
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh parsley, finely choppped | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh dill ( use 1 tsp dried for less flavor ) | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley ( optional ) | 1/4 cup guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Slightly mix parsley and dill with minced up up fresh chives. Sprinkle 1 tsp per won ton wrapper. Moisten the edge of each won ton wrapper with warm water. Using the thumb and index finger, carefully lift a small piece of won ton wrapper and sprinkle parsley mixture over the top and pinch it closed. Bring the two point of a knife around the edge of the wrapper to bring together and seal. Makes approximately 24 won ton wraps. Steam the won tons until they are floating and cooked on top.

title: Walnut Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 lb arborio rice, cleaned, rinsed and drained | 1/2 lb ground walnuts
instructions: Place all ingredients in mixing bowl and knead by hand for 2 minutes or until dough is smooth and pliable. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Roll out on floured board about 1/8 inch thick. Cut into 3/4 wide strips. Roll each strip into a small ball. Repeat with remaining rice balls. Bring water to boil in medium 3 to 4 quart dutch oven. Add rice balls. Adjust heat to maintain a boil until water is absorbed, about 45 minutes. Drain rice balls. Cool covered.

title: Beans-Mustard Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey mustard | 2 cups pinto beans | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 2 lbs pork chops or 2 lbs veal, cut across the grain in very thin slices
instructions: In a slow cooker bowl, combine mustard, beans, coriander and rosemary. Slice pork and add to spice mixture. Cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or low for 7 to 8 hours. You cook it in a slow cooker, so if you use your slow cooker, keep an eye on it. Serve as a soup or with rice.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,black pepper,turnip,chili powder,fajita seasoning mix,grain rice,icing sugar
title: Crock Pot Spanish Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup dried mexican oregano | 1/2 - 3/4 cup black pepper | 1 can turnips ( approx ) | 1/4 cup fajita seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons icing sugar
instructions: Trim turnips of all the membrane but leave the hard end intact. Combine oregano and black pepper on a plate, stir in turnips, fajita seasoning, rice and chili powder. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or on high about 2 1/2 7 hours. Towards the end of cooking, add icing sugar and toss to blend. Remove from crock pot and stir.

title: Asian Grilled Steak With Five Spice
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs sirloin steaks, about | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder ( or to taste, i like the one with garlic ) | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Note, if you prefer your meal a little thicker, use 1/4 cup half and half and 2 tbsp each of the powder. If you like a more pungent crust, mix the flour with a little cold water until all is mixed together. Place meat in a gallon ziplock bag with 1/4 cup half and half. Shake or stir the salt and chinese five spice powder into the meat to make sure all is covered with the marinade. Turn the bag to coat evenly. Refrigerate overnight or about 2 hours. Place bag in a shallow dish. Cover bag loosely with plastic wrap, pressing in the air until meat is dry, about 20 minutes.. Place meat on the counter. With your hand, roll the bag around each roll until it's all covered in the seasonings.. Pour off any liquid from bag. Cover bag tightly and refrigerate overnight. Cook time will be one hour and 20 minute. To serve, place meat on a platter or individual plates. Pour half and half over the meat. Serve immediately.

title: Yum Yum Eggs and Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 4 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup fat-free taco flavored taco seasoning ( found in the asian grocer section )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium oven proof skillet, cook egg noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse. Add 1 teaspoon of rice vinegar to noodles. Sprinkle remaining teaspoon of rice vinegar over and continue to cook to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,lemon pudding mix,provolone cheese,heavy whipping cream,clam,sparkling water,turmeric,ginger
title: Lemon Poached Clams and Provolone
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger, finely chopped | 1 bunch spring onion, cleaned washed, trimmed and finely chopped | 2 packages lemon pudding mix | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 8 -10 small clams | 10 slices provolone cheese | freshly grated pecorino cheese ( or a mozzarella cheese, if desired ) | freshly squeezed lemon juice
instructions: Place ginger and spring onion in a small non reactive saucepan and cover with ½ cup cold water. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and beginning to brown, 5 - 8 minutes. Drain liquid and set aside. Prepare lemon pudding according to pkg. Directions. Combine all ingredients and pour into a shallow, well flavored baking dish, or 4 individual individual sized ramekins or 8 - 10 ramekins. Chill until set. Just before serving, top each clam with the cheese slices. Garnish with freshly squeezed lemon juice.

title: Beef Short Ribs With Broccoli and Apple (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low-fat apple juice | 1 large beef short rib, trimmed | 2 cups broccoli florets | 100 g tortillas, warmed
instructions: Place apple juice in a large, non stick frying pan. Arrange beef on top of apple juice, reduce heat to medium.

title: Real Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 white onion | 4 tablespoons chocolate syrup ( not unsweetened )
instructions: Blend everything together in a food processor or blender. Serve immediately or transfer the mixture into a freezer bag. Seal and place in freezer for up to 2 months. Remove after freezing, and transfer to a jar, cover with lid and keep in fridge.

title: Crock Pot Italian Beef for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can mushroom pieces ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 tablespoon orange peel, freshly grated | 2 lbs beef stew meat
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except the beef and mix well. Add beef and mix well. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours..

title: Hannah's Mexican Apricot Soup
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes and green chilies | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 4 spring onions or 4 spring onions, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup apricot preserves
instructions: In a blender, combine all ingredients and puree until smooth. Pour into individual serving dishes. Top with finely chopped spring onions before serving.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,onion soup mix,confectioner ' sugar,flat leaf parsley
title: Quick and Easy French Onion Salad Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine, divided | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine 1 tablespoon of the rice wine and the dry onion soup mix in a bowl until it is well blended. Stir in the parsley and combine. Toss with hot cooked or baked potatoes and spread on a platter.

Random Ingredients: kiwi,fish stock,celery seed,ice water,kirsch,lime juice zest,lobster tail
title: Lobster in the Red Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup lobster tail, finely diced | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( zest of one lime ) | 1/4 teaspoon lime, zest of one lime | 4 tablespoons fish stock | 1 tablespoon kirsch ( cherry-flavoured liqueur ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 8 ice cubes, to serve
instructions: For the fish sauce, combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan and heat over a moderate heat, stirring frequently until the ingredients are well combined. If you have a double boiler, add the ice cubes in a steady stream and whisk until the ice is partially dissolved. Set aside until ready to use. Divide the chopped lobster into six individual serving bowls. Pour over the hot sauce. Serve immediately, garnished with the lime zest.

title: Shrimp With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Clean the shrimp, if the shells are small. Cut them into 1/2 inch pieces. Heat up the shrimp oil in a skillet. When it is hot enough, add the shrimp. Let it cook for about 2 minutes, turn, stir. Add the salad and continue to cook until the shrimp are all pink and the shrimp are pink. Serve at once.

title: Chinese Mushrooms Toast
ingredients: 1 slice soft white bread ( crusts removed or day old bread ) | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 2 -3 fresh chinese mushrooms
instructions: Cut off any hard end of mushrooms and remove stems. Slice the caps thinly from the stems. Slice the caps very thinly. If necessary, trim the ends with kitchen scissors. Heat a pan with a little oil or butter. Place the slices of mushrooms, in a single layer, in the pan and cook on a medium heat for 3 minutes until mushrooms are tender. Turn slices and continue cooking on second side for 2 minutes. Transfer to serving dish. Sprinkle the zest over the cooked mushrooms and serve hot. Note, it is important the bread to soak up all the juice that has accumulated in the bowl.

title: Vanilla Bean Hummus
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Rinse the vanilla bean, then split it open and scrape out the seeds with a spoon. The inside of the vanilla bean should be removed from the pods. Place the vanilla bean and the yogurt in a medium glass bowl. Using your hands gently stir in the vanilla bean pod. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours, until the flavors have blended. Taste and adjust seasonings, then serve with bread, crackers, or vegetables.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 piece meaty stew meat | 2 large potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 1/2 tablespoons grenadine
instructions: Place stew meat, potatoes and grenadine in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours, on low for 2 hours.

title: Lentils With Almonds and Apple Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple butter | 1/2 cup dry lentils | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: In a saucepan, cook the lentils in boiling water until tender but firm. Drain, return to pan and add the apple butter. Season. Serve sprinkled with slivered almonds.

Random Ingredients: vodka,poblano chile,rice flour,egg substitute,chicken,beef chuck,black bean sauce,peanut butter
title: Beef Patties With Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dry rice flour | 1/4 cup shredded parmesean cheese or 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese | 2 lbs lean beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 lbs poblano chiles | 1 can chicken, cut up | 1 can black bean sauce | 1 container fat free egg substitute | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: In a resealable plastic bag, mix the first 5 ingredients. Add meat, marinate at least 3 hours in refrigerator. Remove meat from marinade.

title: Mexican-Style Baked Zucchini
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, about 1 pound | 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese or 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 4 large eggs | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 2 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Slice zucchini lengthwise about 1/4 inch thick. Set aside. Drain cottage cheese well, reserving 1 cup of the reserved cheese liquid. Set aside. Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Add zucchini slices, cottage cheese and reserved cottage cheese liquid. Mix well. Mix baking soda and cocoa powder in small bowl. Spread mixture evenly into a shallow buttered 8 inch square baking dish. Bake until lightly golden, about 35 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,celery rib,yukon gold potato,artichoke heart,spinach,whipping cream,lasagna noodle,rice paper
title: Artichoke Spinach Pie
ingredients: 4 fresh lasagna noodles | 2 fresh anaheim chilies, seeded and minced ( or poblano chilies ) | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 large celery ribs, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 cup whipping cream | 6 ounces marinated artichoke hearts ( drained and chopped ) | 12 sheets rice paper sheets
instructions: In a 12x18 inch baking dish, spread 1/3 cup water on the edges to form a shallow rim. Arrange 3 noodles evenly along the length of the dish. Ladle 1/3 of the potato and 1/3 of the chile mixture over noodles, spreading evenly, and then sprinkle evenly with 1/2 cup water. Place 3 next 4 ingredients in a large bowl and toss to coat. Arrange 3 noodles over potato mixture.

title: Potato Sticks With Sausage and Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage or 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 large potato starch, 1/3 cup | 8 ounces cashews, unsalted | 2 english cucumbers, peeled, with the peel on | 1 cup chicken thigh, skin and skin removed, cut in half
instructions: Put the sausage or bulk italian sausage into a large pan. Cut the potato starch into 2 pieces and drop into the pan of sausage and sausage, breaking the meat as it cooks. Let the mixture continue to pan fry until the sausage is dark and crusty. Add the cashews and let sausages cook longer, stirring as necessary, because the cashews will turn bitter. Cut the chuncks into slices about 1/2 inch thick and remove the crusty outer skins from the cucumber slices with a slotted spoon. Put the chuncks into a colander, pressing out the excess moisture. Toss the chuncks with the potato starch and set aside for 15 minutes. Cut the chicken meat into 1/4 inch slices, 1 inch square and 1/8 inch thick. In a heavy frypan, heat the remaining tablespoon of butter or margarine and fry the chicken pieces, skin side down, until brown, about 4 or 5 minutes. Turn chicken over, turn and fry until browned, about 3 more minutes. Transfer chicken to a platter and cover to keep warm. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of fat from skillet and melt over medium heat. Turn once or twice until the fat is smoking. Toss the cashew pieces, chicken pieces and sausage into the fat and heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Toss the cashews into the potato sticks and transfer to a serving dish. Scatter the cucumber slices over the top.

title: Linguine With Coconut Curried Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, snipped | 1/4 cup reduced sodium worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup low-sodium tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons cucumbers or 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger, flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 green pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling water until done.

title: Korean Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts | 1/2 teaspoon hot chili sauce | 2 ounces sliced black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut each chicken breast into 3 pieces. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange chicken pieces in a single layer in the dish. Stir chili sauce into the top of the chicken. Pour black olives over the chicken. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the sauce is bubbling, about 40 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Meatloaf
ingredients: 600 g beef mince | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 2 tablespoons rolled oats | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas mark mix all ingredients together, roll into a long loaf tin, put into a roasting tin with the ends of the loaf tin overlapping them like dominoes. Cook in the oven for 1 hour, turn down the temperature and leave for a further 90 minutes. Allow to cool completely, slice and serve with lots of roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,sun tomato oil,curry powder,creole seasoning,mustard seed,green bean,beef chuck roast
title: Beef Chuck Roast With Indian Shredded Hash Browns
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 4 1/2 - 6 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup creole seasoning | 1/4 cup curry powder | 2 1/2 lbs green beans | 4 tablespoons pistachios
instructions: Heat oil in dutch oven over med high heat. Add mustard seeds and brown evenly. Add beef to pan. Season with creole seasoning, curry powder, and sundried tomato oil. Brown briskly on all sides. Add green beans. Cover and cook over med low heat for 3 hours or until meat falls off the bone and shreds easily with fork. Discard any remaining liquid and serve hot or cold with naan bread and salad.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,red bell pepper,chive,vodka,coconut milk,garlic paste,cooking wine
title: Coconut-Scented Red Pepper Fries
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( see description ) | 1 teaspoon red bell pepper ( optional ) | cooking wine ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons fresh chives
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small pan. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until coconut milk is thick. Remove from heat. Drizzle with cooking oil or coconut cream. Serve hot or cold. Great with french fries, or a tossed salad. Variation, instead of bell pepper, you can use red bell pepper instead if preferred. Add chopped onion.

title: French Onion and Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb swiss swiss provolone cheese ( fresh, cubed or crumbled ) | 2 medium spring onions, trimmed ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Arrange half of the cheese cubes in a 9x12 inch baking dish. Scatter the spring onion over the cheese. Layer the remaining half of the cheese cubes on top of the onion. Sprinkle the remaining chopped spring onions on top. Cover and cook in the oven until the cheese is melted and the dip is hot and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: topping,italian sausage,plum tomato,garlic powder,egg white,green salsa
title: Green Sausage Soufflés
ingredients: 1/2 lb fully cooked sausage | 1/3 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed ( see note above ) | 6 plum tomatoes, thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 1/2 teaspoons bottled garlic powder | 1/4 cup frozen green salsa, thawed | 3 large egg whites
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f in 10 inch nonstick skillet, heat sausage.

title: Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 cups asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add asparagus and saute 3 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle garam masala and stir to coat.

title: Rooibos Refresher
ingredients: 2 cups cooked black beans or cans black beans, drained | 1 pinch baking soda
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl. Cool for at least 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,rye bread,tuna water,salt pepper,white flour
title: Tuna Melt (From the Roly Poly) Welsh
ingredients: 8 ounces tuna in water | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 plum tomato, finely diced | 2 -3 teaspoons salt and pepper | 14 slices rye bread
instructions: Place the tuna in a small baking dish and pour over the water. Cover and leave to soak for 15 minutes. Remove the tuna and drain well. Preheat the pan and add oil. When just starting to smoke, add the tomatoes and the flour. Mix well and add salt and pepper to taste. Spread a few teaspoons of the tomato mix over each slice of bread and top with the tuna. Put on a piece of rye and cover with the remaining slices of bread. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until the bread is toasted and the tuna and tomatoes have heated through.

title: Grpa - Italian Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon streaky bacon, cut crosswise into 6 equal pieces | 1 teaspoon salad oil | 1 small clove, crushed
instructions: Bake bacon fat in a small frying pan on low heat. Remove the bacon from the pan and place on a plate. Sprinkle flour over the bacon fat. Remove bacon fat from the pan. Dip the bacon pieces into the fat. Sprinkle crushed fresh clove onto the bacon fat and fry in the hot fat until brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: romano cheese,couscous,bread dough,blueberry,farfalle pasta,beef sirloin steak
title: Mama's Big Beef and Couscous
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks ( half inch thick ) | 1 box refrigerated bread dough ( one 15-ounce bag ) | 1 package refrigerated crumbled couscous | 1 package frozen blueberries | 1/4 cup coarsely grated romano cheese | 1 package frozen bread dough, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Slice steak diagonally across the grain into 1/8 inch slices. Roll each slice to coat in the bread crumbs. Arrange slices in a 15x10x1 inch baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn slices over and bake for 15 - 20 minutes more. Remove from oven and top with blueberries, romano cheese and remaining bread crumbs to cover evenly. Bake for 10 minutes more until top is crispy and golden. Variation, after slicing beef, use two sirloin steaks to create one 10 1/2 inch thick meat and 4 - 5 strips of beef. Cut into 1/2 inch wide strips and serve on top of couscous for a quick and tasty side dish. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Cheese With Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 2 slices aged gouda cheese | 8 lemons, juice of
instructions: Place cheese on grill pan or open burner of your grill. Place one or two lemons on each slice of cheese and place under grill. When cheese is light toasty and browned, flip over and grill for a few more minutes. Remove from grill. Drizzle with lime juice.

title: Indian Tossed Lettuce for Two
ingredients: 3 large heads romaine lettuce ( one head ) | 12 -16 ounces mixed bibb lettuce ( about 1 head )
instructions: Separate romaine lettuce leaves, and place on the counter. Using a paring knife, split crosswise on the bottom portion of each head of lettuces. If the head is a bit larger or thinner, cut it into 5 slices. Place 2 slices side by side, and divide lettuce between each piece of bread. Scoop any juice from the lettuce into a shallow salad bowl. Drizzle with a little lime juice to taste, and sprinkle with some more fresh nutmeg.

title: African Rhubarb and Vanilla Powder (SMS)!
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vanilla beans ( split lengthwise ) | 4 green cardamoms | 1 inch piece rhubarb, peeled
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a small, heatproof bowl with a lid. Stir to mix and allow to stand for 1 hour. When ready to use, leave to stand for at least 5 minutes before using. Store in an airtight container.

title: Tibetan Peach Rice and Kale Salad
ingredients: 2 cups rice, cooked | 1 head kale, chopped | 5 tablespoons agave nectar | 1 frozen peach, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix everything in a large bowl. Serve.

title: Easy Spanish Parsnip and Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 large parsnip, peeled and cut into small chunks | 150 g canned water chestnuts, coarsely chopped | 75 g smoked canadian bacon, chopped finely | 3 tablespoons green onions, chopped, mainly the green part ( including the hard parts ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 -2 teaspoon chili sauce or 1 -2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend to desired consistency. Transfer the puree to a large bowl. Cover with a wet paper towel and put in the fridge while you cook the rest. Serve at room temperature or chilled. I served it warm with crusty bread.

title: Shariyah
ingredients: 2 lemons, juice of | 1 tablespoon ground coriander
instructions: Wash, rinse & dry the lemons. Squeeze the juice of the lemons inside the bowl of your choice. If you must, place the lemon juice, coriander and salt into another bowl & mix well... Cover & store in the refrigerator for at least one day & up to a week before serving. Shariyah keeps well for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,mirin,white pepper,lemon juice zest,almond,lemongrass
title: Lemongrass Almond Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sesame ground almonds | 2 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute ( or other sugar substitute ) | 2 teaspoons mirin ( dark japanese sweet wine or honey ) | 1 tablespoon finely minced gingerroot | 1 tablespoon finely minced lemongrass ( or other herb ) or 1 tablespoon finely minced vegetable peeler ( or other herb ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | ground white pepper
instructions: Blend together and store in an airtight container. Garnish with lemon wedge, scallion and almonds just before serving.

Random Ingredients: green olive,genoa salami,popped popcorn,wild mushroom,bok choy
title: Wild Mushrooms Popped in Peanuts
ingredients: 2 cans mushrooms, drained and chopped | 1 can mild green olives, drained | 1/2 cup prepared poppy ( dry or reconstituted ) | 1/2 lb genoa salami, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 20 -24 baby bok choy, leaves only
instructions: Slice off mushroom stems and discard caps and set aside. In large bowl, gently mix the mushrooms, olives and poppy. Add salami slices and bok choy leaves. Mound the filling into mushrooms. If stuffing the mushrooms as you would like, fill the reserved mushroom caps with a little of the prepared sweet cornstarch. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,agave nectar,black coffee,apricot preserve,dark brown sugar,linguine,green cardamom pod,chinese noodle
title: Cafe Linguine Con Gandules (Giant Linguine)
ingredients: 2 packages chinese noodles ( linguine ) | 1 jar apricot preserves | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup agave nectar | 6 green cardamom pods | 3 whole cardamom pods | 4 cups strong black coffee | 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Place noodles in the pot and cook uncovered over medium low heat until tender but still firm to the bite, about 7 minutes.

title: How Do I Make Molasses?
ingredients: 1 can molasses | 1/8 - 1/4 white onion, peeled and finely minced
instructions: Put molasses in a small bowl, then stir in the white onion and cover with plastic wrap until mixture is cold. Store in tightly lidded container in refrigerator up to 4 weeks. After 4 days, make sure you shake the bowl to mix and shake the bowl once a day to get rid of any excess liquid. After 4 days, transfer mixture on cookie sheets to cool. To make a richer molasses, increase the amount of molasses called for in the recipe, amount used and yield to your taste.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,rum extract,cod,tabasco sauce,sage leaf,kaffir lime leaf,spinach leaf
title: Curried Cod
ingredients: 250 g cod, cleaned and scaled | 2 large fresh kaffir lime leaves | 4 fresh sage leaves | 8 -10 fresh coriander sprigs ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons paprika or 2 -3 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1 teaspoon a hot sauce | fresh spinach leaves ( optional )
instructions: Boil water in a wok. Dunk all the fish in the boiling water and set aside to drain. Slice the lime leaves into thin slices. Roughly chop the sage and coriander. Dice the kaffir lime leafs fine, too if you like. Wash the spinach leaves if using. Heat 1 t. Of oil in a large frying pan or wok. Add the sage and coriander and cook till the leaves just begin to soften, about 1 minute or so. Remove from heat. Put together with the smoked cod and paprika or chilli, and stir fry for a couple of minutes. Pour half the coconut water into your wok or pan and add 2 tablespoons of rum, stir fry for a minute. Top with the lime slices for decoration or extra flavour. Put the fish back in the pan and stir over a medium heat for about 5 or 6 minutes. Pour the rest of the coconut water into the wok and sprinkle over the lime leaves. Reduce heat and allow this to simmer for 5 or 6 minutes. The fish will not necessarily float, you may need to add more water, if necessary, before the fish is fully cooked. Serve immediately with freshly steamed noodles or rice.

title: Simple  Smokin  Smokin  (      Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 -2 lb chuck roast or 1 -2 lb arm roast | 8 slices of real smoked banana ( you want them sliced very thin, not cut thin!! )
instructions: Use your choice of meat for cooking in a pot, a crockpot, etc. Cook on your favorite stovetop, or in a crock pot, or place oven method on your stove. Once you can do a hand crank or other electric frying pan, place a couple of slices of a banana in your palm so that it will stick. Place the roast on top of the banana. Then sprinkle the top with pepper. Some recipes say to leave the salt off for all the smokin, so that's how i like it. Wrap the meat up with a nice towel and wrap it all around it. Then press with your hand to squeeze out as much water as possible. Place the wrap in the crockpot. You can then place the roast in the crockpot and cook on high for 5 - 6 hours or low for 3 - 4 hours.

title: Maple Clam Brine
ingredients: 2 cans minced clams | 1 cup maple syrup | 1 cup crushed saltine crackers
instructions: Combine clams and syrup in a saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium heat. Reduce to low and cook 15 minutes or until heated through. Ladle clams into a bowl, stir in cracker crumbs.

title: British Marinated Tuna
ingredients: 2 kg tuna, solid white albacore | 1 teaspoon mace
instructions: Combine all ingredients and add tuna. Close lid and let sit for 10 or 20 minute check for taste. To serve, fill tuna into pitta bread and put on a serving plate. Garnish with a lemon twist or a maraschino cherry.

title: Raspberry Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked white rice | 2 cups water chestnuts, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon savory | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons distilled vinegar | 1 cup diced fresh raspberries
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat 1 cup water chestnuts in a saucepan over medium heat until the water is absorbed and the chestnuts are soft, about 8 minutes. Drain and cool. When rice is done, drain well and add to the rice. Heat 1/2 cup water in a separate saucepan over medium heat until the water is absorbed. Spray a medium size nonstick fry pan with cooking oil spray. Add cooking rice and cook, stirring constantly with a fork, until the rice is slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. In a large bowl, toss together cooked rice, drained chestnuts, savory and 1/2 cup water chestnuts. Spray a large salad bowl with cooking oil spray. Add raspberries, vinegar and remaining 1/2 cup water chestnuts. Gently fold in rice and raspberry mixture. Chill for 30 minutes serve cold.

title: Shrimp Paste Appetizers
ingredients: 1 jar dried herring ( such as haddon house ) | 1/4 lb shrimp paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Clean herring, picking off the skin, removing the eyes, and any tough outer skin. Break up the bones. Remove any hard muscle sections or the beginnings of any crab meat or other material that might have risen to the surface. Chop finely and place in a large, heavy pot. Add water to just cover the top of the jar. Add the shrimp paste. Stir and bring to a boil. Skim any foam and scum that rises to the surface. Immediately lower heat, cover, and let cook for three hours, skimming the foam occasionally. Remove from heat. Drain the herring and reserve the liquid liquid. Place the herring to a food processor with the shrimp paste, then blend until smooth. Stir in nutmeg. If desired, strain into sterilized jars. Store in a cool, dark place for up to three weeks before using.

Random Ingredients: green olive,crabmeat,white fish fillet,worcestershire sauce,red wine,cider vinegar

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place fish and olives on a baking tray. Roast for 10 minutes. Cool completely. To the salad add the wine. Add the worcestershire sauce. Meanwhile mix the vinegar and crab in a jar with a lid. Spoon over the fish. Place in the oven to warm and bubble for 3 - 4 mintues. Serve immediately.

ingredients: 2 cups water or 2 cups broth, see description | 1 can mexican-style tomato sauce, undiluted | 1/2 cup instant basmati rice, or your fav. rice | 1 tablespoon dried mexican oregano
instructions: Simmer basmati rice, or other type of rice for 15 minutes. Turn off heat. Pour tomato sauce, undiluted undiluted tomato sauce, rice, half of the oregano, and remaining oregano over rice. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes, remove lid, stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, fluff with fork. To cook rice as directed, follow package directions. Serve with desired toppings.

instructions: Line 6 cupcake cups with plastic wrap.

instructions: Mix all ingredients. With hands shape into flat breads. Cook on panini grill approximately 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Slice and serve with honey. Serve with maple syrup or syrup flavored gelatin sauce.

 Spray the inside of a small frying pan with a little oil. Heat the pan over a low heat. Add a few drops of the vanilla custard powder to the hot oil on the top of the celery to keep it from separating as you stir. Keep moving the pan as the mixture drips from the sides until it has stopped bubbling. It will not be clear at this point. This will take about 2 to 5 minutes, depending on the thickness of the celery. The celery should not be crisp, and will cook down quickly so that when you turn the celery, it will still have slightly crunchy bits. It will take a little longer, depending on the thickness of your oil, but it will eventually become crisp enough to coat the celery in the custard.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,strawberry,chili oil,onion soup mix,japanese eggplant,sage,spring onion,red enchilada sauce
title: Faux Fried Eggplant and Strawberries
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants | 1 bunch fresh strawberries | 2 tablespoons onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon dried rubbed sage | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup spring onion, sliced ( green onions )
instructions: Wash eggplants. Slice eggplants into quarters lengthwise, lengthwise. Place the eggplant quarters in a bowl of cold water until tender, about 15 to 30 minutes. Drain and cool. Slice the remaining eggplant into 8 to 12 pieces lengthwise. Set aside. Cut strawberries in half and place in a small bowl. Add the onion soup mix, sage, chili oil, garlic salt and enchilada sauce. Mix well. Place the eggplant pieces in a skillet and deep fry until golden brown. Place the slices on paper towels to drain the excess oil and serve.

title: Hot Fruit Whip - a Healthy Alternative to a Simple Blending Blintzer
ingredients: 2 bananas, finely mashed | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 1 pinch tandoori hot sauce or 1 pinch tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves ( or a mixture of dried fenugreek leaves and dried chiles ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl large enough to beat the ingredients together, and whisk until all ingredients are incorporated but still pourable. Pour into a serving dish or one large glass container. To make this a little more enjoyable, if doing in your blender, add a little lemon juice to the blender or mix the contents in between spooning the whipped cream into your blender. Store in a fridge to let the flavors develop together. Makes about 3 cups.

title: Orange and Napa Cabbage
ingredients: 1 napa cabbage | 1/2 small orange bell pepper ( cored and sliced thin )
instructions: Heat napa cabbage in boiling water until tender, approximately 5 - 10 minutes, depending on thickness of leaf. Drain. Garnish with peppers. This can be served on italian rolls if desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,pork loin roast,tequila,oil,bay leaf,graham cracker crumb
title: Margaritas
ingredients: 8 pounds boneless pork loin roast | 1 1/4 cups prepared graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 cup tequila | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown pork on all sides. Reduce heat if necessary to braise in batches. Stir graham cracker crumbs into pork for the last few minutes. Drain pork on paper towels. Place pork in a large dish and cover with graham cracker crumbs. Pour tequila over the meat. Season with garlic salt and the bay leaf. Let marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pork and marinade. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Remove meat to a serving platter and cover to keep warm. Add the left over marinade to the hot skillet and heat over medium high heat for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Turn meat, scraping up the browned bits, and continue cooking until sauce has reduced by half and has thickened slightly.

title: Quick Caribbean Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup ice water | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 cup fresh corn kernel ( or frozen green corn kernels ) | 1 cup frozen unsweetened pineapple | 3 tablespoons grated carrots | 3 tablespoons canned sweet bell peppers | 3 tablespoons sweet corn kernels | 4 1/2 cups cooked pasta, your choice
instructions: Combine water, lemon juice, corn, pineapple, carrots, sweet corn, and pasta in a blender and puree to desired smoothness.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,white vinegar,onion powder,tomato puree,bonito flake,parsley,vanilla bean,cognac
title: Tortilla Espanola
ingredients: 12 tomatoes | 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped parsley | 2 cans tomato puree | 1 bottle cognac | 1/2 cup bonito flakes | 1/2 vanilla bean, split ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Cut 8 tomatoes in half and remove the pulp.. Place in a bowl with the onion and vinegar and mix. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour to develop flavor. Drain and save 1/4 cup of the liquid. Chop 1/4 cup of the liquid from the reserved tomato liquid and add to the tomato and onion mixture, blending thoroughly. Pour into a 2 quart pitcher, cover and chill. Combine the puree, caper and 1/2 cup of the reserved liquid in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until boiling and reduce by 1/. Add vanilla and optional bonito flakes. Pour a 1/4 cup of the tomato puree mixture into the tomato mixture. Stir to combine. Let sit for 15 minutes. Remove the vanilla bean. To serve, place tortilla in a tortilla bowl and pour tomato mixture over it. Enjoy this healthy way to make your meal, place 1 tsp. Of puree mixture and 2 tsp puree mixture and 1/2 cup of reserved tomato liquid into a nonstick frying pan and add 1/2 cup of chopped onion and 1/8 cup chopped parsley.

title: Jimmies Dean Wrapped Sausages
ingredients: 4 -5 links jimmy dean sausage ( cut into thin slices ) | 1 container vanilla yogurt
instructions: Heat skillet on medium and spray with oil. Add prawns. Brown sausages for 3 - 5 minutes. Add vanilla yogurt. Cover to let excess fat melt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,pearl barley,chocolate chip,tequila,fish,beef broth,hot paprika
title: American Kitchen Classic Steak Ties
ingredients: 1 cup beef broth ( can use low sodium as preferred ) | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/2 cup english cucumber, coarsely chopped | 12 ounces raw ground beef | 1 teaspoon hot paprika ( or try mild if you have it ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley ( quick cooking or cook according to package directions ) | 1 teaspoon fish, crunches ( optional )
instructions: Combine beef broth, tequila, and cucumber, let sit for about 3 to 4 minutes. Remove beef mixture from pot and set aside. Brown hamburger and season with paprika and set aside. Drain liquid from pot and place in a 1 gallon plastic bag. Place meat mixture on top of the meat mixture and seal. Place bag in the fridge until completely cold. Prepare steak by placing in a freezer bag and putting in the fridge until firm. Once the time is up, remove meat mixture from freezer and take off any heavy duty pieces that have not flaked. Cut meat in 1/2. Serve with rice and other toppings such as salsa.

title: Cocktail
ingredients: 16 prawns | 500 g sauerkraut, drained | 8 rhubarb, chopped | 2 tablespoons stove top stuffing mix | 8 allspice berries | 8 allspice berries
instructions: Shell the prawns, leaving any remaining shells on. Skewer the prawns, securing with toothpicks and set aside. Bring 3 cups water, the sauerkraut and the rhubarb to a boil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the stuffing and pea pods, and stir, bringing to boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally until the stuffing is thickened. Cool slightly. Serve the mixture over prawns.

Random Ingredients: pear,hickory liquid smoke,anaheim chilies,lamb shoulder,chive,filet beef,swiss cheese
title: Beef Tenderloin With Swiss Cheese St. Patrick's Day Peppers and Peaches
ingredients: 3 tablespoons hickory liquid smoke | 3 lbs boneless lamb shoulder | 1 lb broiled or sliced deli-style pea shoots | 5 ripe hassheim chilies, tops left on ( don't seed ) | 2 small pears, cored and halved | 4 slices swiss cheese | 4 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Make sauce, mix together 3 tablespoons chive sauce with 1 tablespoon water, and heat over medium low heat until steaming. Set aside. Make tenderloins, trim meat of fat. Place meat, fat side up, in a shallow roasting pan. Rub evenly with remaining tablespoon chive sauce. Combine chilies, pea shoots, and meat. Brush over entire surface of meat. Cover roast with cheese slices. Roast, basting with vegetable oil every 30 minutes and turning meat over twice, until meat reaches an internal temperature of 142 degrees f, about 2 hours total. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing. Serve with pepper and chives.

title: Egg Salad
