ingredients: 2 cups egg salad | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 green pepper, chopped | 3 tablespoons chives | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 3/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Combine well. Beat until well blended. Pour over other salad greens and mix well. Let sit for 30 mins..

title: Rutabaga Chowder
ingredients: 2 medium rutabagas ( about 8 1/2 oz. ) | 1 medium rutabaga ( about 8 1/2 oz. ) | 1/4 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Peel and cut rutabaga into 3/4 inch cubes. Bring a medium size pot of water to a boil. Add rutabaga. Boil for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small nonstick frypan, heat a scant 1 t. Oil over medium high heat. When the rutabagas begin to soften, put the pan in the hot water and stir constantly with a wood spatula. Cook until the water has dried and turned cloudy. Remove from heat and keep covered. Raise heat to high and put in the sweet paprika. Quickly put in cheese and stir until the soup is creamy not brown. Stir in rutabaga and serve immediately.

title: Bbq Bamboo Shoot Dip
ingredients: 1 can whole bamboo shoots, drained | 1/4 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Place the canned bamboo shoots into a food processor or blender. Blend until almost smooth. Add the guacamole. Add the brown sugar, garlic powder until blended. Chill. Serve with tostado or your favorite mexican sides.

title: Smooth Potato Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 package jumbo eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place potato on a baking sheet and bake until tender, about 45 minutes. Cool potato on baking sheet for 15 minutes. Drain completely and cut in half horizontally. Remove the potato from the baking sheet and peel. In a large bowl, mash potatoes with enough oil to bind. Add mustard seeds. Place in preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes. Beat in eggs and cook for 10 more minutes.

title: Sushi Dough
ingredients: 6 ounces self raising flour | 1 sheet nori
instructions: Sift the flour onto a floured surface. Pinch in two or three pieces of nori. Roll out until the size of your thumb and then form into a round circular disc about 1/4 inch thick. Seal the edges, fold over and roll out again until it is stretched to about 3/4 inch. Repeat with all the nori and then roll out the remaining dough. Place each piece on a lightly floured baking sheet. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius/400 degrees fahrenheit. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in the oven, or until golden brown. When cool remove from baking sheets and cut into 1/2 to 3/4 inch rounds, or as applicable to desired sushi size fillings. Sushi dough may be kept warm in an air tight container under a damp towel or a sieve.

title: Basil Pesto Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together pesto and tomato puree. Serve chilled or room temperature.

title: Quick Home Fries
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 gallon boiling water
instructions: Heat the water to boiling.

Random Ingredients: lemon,green bean,balsamic vinegar,yellow bell pepper,flour tortilla,baby green,ramen noodle,pistachio
title: Lemon Ramen Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package baby greens, washed | 1 bag baby red potatoes, washed | 1/2 lb fresh green beans, washed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup fresh lemon rind, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice ( white ) | 1 pinch balsamic vinegar | 1/2 lb thinly sliced thin-cut fried crisp oriental noodles or 1/2 lb japanese rice noodles | 1/4 cup chopped unsalted shelled pistachios
instructions: Divide greens among 4 salad plates. Arrange potatoes on the greens. Arrange green beans on top of greens. In a small bowl, stir together rind, lemon juice and vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Drizzle over salad and sprinkle with pistachios.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,ham hock,garam masala,pine nut,salt black pepper,celery rib,baby spinach leaf,coriander seed
title: Indian Bacon-Wrapped Ham Hocks
ingredients: 1 ham hock | 1 teaspoon whole coriander seed | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 large celery rib, chopped | 1 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup pine nuts, toasted | baby spinach leaves, washed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Remove the top shell of the ham hocks. Rinse the hamhocks under cold water and dry with paper towels. Place the hamhocks on a sheet of aluminum foil, approximately 2 to 3 inches high, and with a sharp knife, score the fat and exterior surface of the hamhocks several times with the flat side of a knife or razor blade. Rub the coriander seeds and mustard powder into the exposed fat. Sprinkle the garam masala all over the hamhocks. Place the celery on a cutting board or tea towel and cut in thin slices with a sharp knife. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Starting at one end, roll the hamhocks up around the celery, with the long blade facing you. Fold over and tuck the seams up. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the center of the oven until the internal temperature of the meat registers 125 degrees f on an instant reading thermometer, 35 to 40 minutes. Carefully remove the hamhocks and serve. Serve with roasted baby spinach leaves.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup mexican cheese, shredded | 1/8 teaspoon fine sea salt ( or to taste. i like sea salt more )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and serve on a chilled fondue stick or in a fondue pot. It is excellent with other dishes such as curries, soups or fettuccine.

title: Goat Cheese Spread
ingredients: 18 ounces goat cheese | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon seasoning mix ( mccormick )
instructions: Place all ingredients into the bottom of an electric cheese grater or food processor. Cover the bottom and sides of a small bowl or jar with plastic wrap. Process on highest setting until mixture is smooth. With machine running, slowly add a little more cheese mixture to stop machine running. Store in the refrigerator until use.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,bean sprout,sherry wine,salt,pecorino romano cheese,orange juice
title: Baked Italian Bread With Beans Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 lb bean sprouts | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Sprout the beans quickly in boiling water. Immediately drain water.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,honey,ham,nonfat milk powder,coconut,caper
title: Easy Ham and Bacon Skillet
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 slice ham or 1 slice bacon, chopped | 1/2 cup reduced-fat mascarpone or 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon nonfat dry milk powder | salt & cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the ham and cook just until crisp. Remove the ham from the skillet and cut into 1/4 inch slices, or in desired portions. Add the remaining ingredients, except the salt and cayenne, to the same skillet along with 1/4 cup water. Cover and simmer gently until thickened, 2 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,heavy cream,tofu,oil,spring onion,chanterelle mushroom,french bread
title: Yia Yia's Lentil Soup
ingredients: 8 tablespoons oil, divided 1/2 | 3 lbs green giant mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1 3/4 lbs chanterelle mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 3 spring onions, cut into 2-inch lengths ( white and scallions, use both scallions for soup and greens for other recipes ) | 8 cups heavy cream | 1 loaf crusty french bread | 8 ounces firm tofu, cut into 1/2 & quot, cubes
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a dutch oven over medium high heat and add mushrooms, spring onions, cream, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender, about 30 minutes. Transfer to a food processor and stir in tofu until smooth and add to soup. Let soup warm, covered, at least 10 minutes before serving. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 325°f. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Working with one piece of toast at a time, spread toast on a baking sheet and bake in the oven until golden and crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Set aside and cool, then transfer toast to a serving bowl. Increase heat to medium and cook soup, stirring and breaking up clumps as it simmers, until thickened, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in tofu and pour into soup bowl.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,turmeric,catsup,chicken stock cube,wheat chex,cocoa,passion fruit pulp
title: Tippy Chickpea Guinness
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley, rinsed and picked over | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 vegetable stock cube | 1/2 cup whole wheat chex | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh passion fruit pulp
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients into a large nonstick frying pan with the crushed bouillon cube. Turn heat up under pan. Cook until broth comes to the boil and add guinness, cocoa, passionfruit and honey. Simmer for 15 minutes to thicken sauce. Serve warm or cool completely and store in fridge.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,cocoa powder,italian sausage,kosher salt,maraschino cherry,orange peel
title: Italian Chocolate Sausage Wraps
ingredients: 7 links mild italian sausage | 6 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 -3 tablespoons freshly grated orange zest | 4 candied orange peel, finely diced | 2 tablespoons finely diced candied maraschino cherries ( or a mixture of candied fruit and dried cherries ) | kosher salt
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine the cocoa and zest, and whisk or chop until smooth. Slice your sausages against the grain into 1/4 inch thick slices, and put them into a shallow baking dish. Slice the sausages diagonally to create about 4 long sausages per wrap, and lay them out into a single layer on a work surface. Sprinkle the sausage slices with the cocoa mixture, and toss lightly with your hands to coat them with the cocoa. Spread out the orange and cherries out onto a plate. Sprinkle the zest over the orange and cherry mixture, then sprinkle the rest of the ingredients evenly over the sausages. Roll or press the sausages up against the strips of orange and cherries to seal the ends of the sausages up so they're compact and hold their shape when you're grilling, keeping the ends about 1 inch at each end. Gently press each roll or press them again with a spatula and cook until the chocolate is set and the orange and cherries have softened and begun to caramelize, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with a little kosher salt, if necessary, and serve right away.

title: Quick and Easy Breakfast Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 head cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1 package hot smoked sausage links, sliced | 1/4 cup taco seasoning, divided | 1 cup taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir cauliflower, sausage, and 1/2 taco seasoning in the baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until cauliflower is crisp tender, about 40 minutes. While tortillas are cooking, spread taco sauce over the entire inside of the taco shells. Top with remaining taco toppings if desired.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,parsley leaf,egg white,peanut oil nut,pimiento,rose water
title: Egg White Samosas
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie crust | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other nut oil | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped | 1/3 cup minced fresh parsley leaves | 3 large egg whites | 1 tablespoon rose water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Unfold first 5 ingredients in bowl, mixing well. Set aside. Spread half of egg whites in pie crust, breaking apart as necessary. Sprinkle with rosewater and remaining egg whites, spreading to cover bottom of crust. Arrange pimientos, parsley and pimentos in an even layer on top. Cover with remainder of egg whites and top with top crust.

title: Raspberry Vinegar Bread for Salad and Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 14 slices bread ( or more, depending on taste )
instructions: Put bread on serving plate. Drizzle vinegar over bread. Variation, use blueberries or strawberries instead of raspberries. Spread raspberry vinegar over bread, then top with other slice of bread. Enjoy.

title: Cottage Cheese Rounds (Vegan)
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon salad oil | pepper ( optional )
instructions: Spray a 1 1/2 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray and set aside. Combine cottage cheese and oil in a medium size bowl and mix well. Spread mixture evenly into prepared prepared casserole dish. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Cape Breton
ingredients: 1 lb yellow potato, peeled, and cut in 1/4 inch pieces | 2 cups beef stock or 2 cups broth | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place the potato pieces in a pot, and cover with cold water so that they are easy to handle. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low, and simmer gently until tender. Drain. When cool enough to handle, scoop the potato into a large bowl, and set aside. Discard all but 1/4 cup of the liquid. Pour the meat broth and raisins into the potatoes, and mix well. Season to taste with mace, allspice, and remaining 1/2 cup of raisins. Pour into the reserved potato water, and mix well. Cover, and chill until serving. Bring the mixture to the table just before serving and allow to cool to room temperature.

title: Simple Pizza Picnic Appetizer (Sauce Only)
ingredients: 8 large plum tomatoes, slices cut in half lengthwise | 12 romano cheese, slices | 1/3 cup maple syrup ( may not use all of the syrup at one time but do get to happy cooking on low for at least 1/2 hour, stir with a fork or a spoon ) | 1 -2 quart canola oil, for frying
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place tomato halves cut side up on a piece of waxed paper or baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt on tomatoes. Top with romano cheese slices. In a small bowl, combine the maple syrup with enough water to make the sauce a little thinner than pancake batter. Pour over the casserole. Broil for 5 minutes or until cheese is browned and bubbly. Serve hot. Note, if you are using a pizza stone to bake the pizza, be sure to preheat it while you preheat the broiler to 500 degrees f as it may cause the crust to burn during frying.

title: Prawn and Rice Wrap
ingredients: 1 lb prawns, shelled, cooked, chopped | 14 ounces crabmeat | 1 teaspoon cumin | 18 raisins ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons pistachios, roasted & chopped | 6 large tortillas or 6 large rolls | 3 tablespoons mint leaves, chopped ( optional, but good to add to the mix in the event it does not jk )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except wraps in a bowl & mix well. Add wraps & serve.

title: Liver Panini
ingredients: 1 lb liver, diced | 1 english muffins, split
instructions: Cut the cooked liver into cubes. Spray your pan with cooking spray, place the cubes in. Heat over medium heat. If there is some fat, drain it off and add more. Sprinkle the liver on top of the cubes. Enjoy.

title: Chili-Lime Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup tomato soup | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 2 tablespoons minced ripe poblano chiles | 4 slices cooked crisp bacon, chopped
instructions: Trim fat from tenderloin. Cut slices into 8 x 3 inch strips. Place in a large zip lock bag. Combine remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: wasabi paste,green olive,egg noodle,coriander seed,fennel bulb,cinnamon
title: Wasabi Noodles With Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup egg noodles, prepared in package directions | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons fennel bulbs, crushed | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 16 ounces sliced green olives
instructions: Place noodles in bowl and cover with water. Let stand until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in medium skillet, stir and fry coriander, fennel and wasabi for a few minutes. Add remaining ingredients and heat to boiling.

title: Tortellini With Grilled Beef and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 pound fresh cheese tortellini | 1 pound beef sirloin, sliced into thin strips | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook tortellini in boiling water until the pasta is tender, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain. Heat canola oil in a grill pan set over medium high heat. Cook sirloin in oil until browned, and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove beef.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,prosciutto,hoagie,graham cracker crumb,cannellini bean,sugar,tabasco sauce
title: Portuguese Delight
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained ( do not drain ) | 1/4 cup hoagie rolls or 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 slices prosciutto, cut in half lengthwise | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons granulated sugar | 1 jar sliced sun-dried tomatoes, drained
instructions: Heat the oven to 350°f lightly grease a large baking sheet. Combine all ingredients, except the sundried tomatoes, in a food processor, process just until it forms a paste.

title: Pastina De Coco
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh pasta shells, cooked and drained | 1 lb lump crabmeat | 2 cups shredded coconut | 1/2 cup snipped pea pieces | 1 1/2 cups uncooked quinoa, hot ( or rice-cooked ) | 2 cups fish, prepared, cubed | 10 ounces oysters, halved | 5 cups cooked linguine or 5 cups cooked ziti pasta
instructions: Prepare shrimp and crabmeat in separate pans. Cook seafood shells until done to your liking. Toss with coconut and pea pieces. Drain well. Add rice, fish, shellfish and clam shells to seafood in large bowl. Fold in shrimp and crabmeat. Set aside. Cook pasta according to package and drain. When all pasta is cooked, add to seafood mixture. Serve with garlic bread.

title: Country Style Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef short ribs | 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1 1/2 cups unbleached self-rising flour | 1/3 cup butter or 1/3 cup margarine, melted
instructions: Cut slits in both sides of ribs, being careful not to cut all the way through or tearing meat. Place one slice of bread in an oven safe pie plate. Cover bread with 1/4 of beef short ribs on top of bread, then top with the remaining slice of bread. In a mixing bowl, rub flour over the short ribs. Dip fingers in melted butter, then press the moistened slices in as much of the butter as you can, coating the short ribs lightly on both sides. Place coated ribs on top of pork and beef short ribs in pie plate. Bake covered in oven for 40 to 50 minutes, until meat meat is tender and sauce thickened. For a crispier crust remove meat from oven and allow to stand for 10 minutes, turning ribs once, until glazed. Remove ribs to a platter and cover to keep warm. Note, you can substitute any other type of ground meat for the short ribs you might use.

title: Cucumber and Pork Wrapped Pork
ingredients: 1 ripe peeled avocado, halved and pitted | 1 teaspoon freshly ground black peppercorns | 1 pork shoulder, about 2 pounds | 1/4 cup orange zest | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1/2 cup halved baby corn | 1/4 cup chopped seeded chopped cucumber
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place avocado halves cut side down on a rimmed baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until the skins just begin to peel away, 15 to 20 minutes. Chop the avocado and place it in a medium bowl. Remove skin from pork shoulder and rub the pork with peppercorns. Rub 1/4 cup orange peel over the pork and then press the peppercorns into the pork. Arrange the pork in a roasting pan, fat side up. Roast in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the pork is 145 degrees f, about 30 minutes. Remove meat from the oven and set aside until cool enough to handle. Shred the pork, removing any excess fat or gristle. Combine 2 tablespoons orange peel and 1/4 cup amaretto in a cup and mix well. Place the pork in a microwave safe bowl and cover with microwave safe water. Microwave on high until the water is absorbed, about 30 seconds. Drain the water from the microwave bowl. Stir in the orange zest, remaining amaretto, peach slices, baby corn, and cucumber. Cover.

Random Ingredients: garlic red chile paste,queso fresco,baguette,creme fraiche,catsup,wheat bread,half cream
title: Real Chiles Rellenos Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans whole canned whole chili peppers with liquid | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup crumbled queso fresco | 6 tablespoons creme fraiche | 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1 clove garlic and red chile paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line an 8 x 8 inch baking dish with a reynolds wrap heavy duty aluminum foil large enough to fold two thirds of the foil up over the salsa. Open can of whole chile peppers. Reserve one can for later use. Remove stem and seeds out of each chile. Place chiles in a small bowl and cover with 1/3 cup chopped white hominy for added color. Drain juice from chile peppers. Place juice, chili pepper juice, catsup, half and half, and 1/4 cup queso fresco in a blender or food mill. Cover and process until well mixed. Spoon cheese mixture into baking dish. Top cheese mixture with bread slices, then top with remaining chile pepper mixture. Cover baking dish with reynolds wrap aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil and serve.

title: Holiday Chili Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, uncooked | 3 cups cooked ground beef chuck | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped seeded chili | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook pasta until al dente. Drain pasta and set aside. In a large bowl, mix the pork with the molasses, vinegar, chilies and egg white. Add to the meat mixture and mix well. Add the drained spaghetti and toss until coated. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Pour meat mixture into the dish and bake in a 400f oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with the slivered almonds. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,ginger juice,celery,mint,dark soy sauce,napa cabbage,cheese,tomato sauce
title: Chinese Meatball Salad (Zheng Ji)
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat ( ground pork, turkey, etc. ) | 1/4 cup watermelon, diced into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup fresh tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh ginger juice | 1/2 cup fresh mint ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup celery ( sliced into matchsticks ) | 2 cups napa cabbage, thinly sliced ( leaves only )
instructions: Prepare rice according to package’s instructions. Combine all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Mix all ingredients well with your hands to mix. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coffee,harissa,splenda granular,white wine vinegar,corn flake,vegetable oil cooking spray,pineapple chunk,apple cider
title: Pineapple Spice Glaze
ingredients: 10 ounces pineapple chunks or 10 ounces chunks drained canned pineapple, in juice ( 16-18 ounces ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon splenda granular | 2 teaspoons harissa, divided | 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup cooking spray | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sugar or 1/4 cup splenda granular | 1/4 cup pineapple-cinnamon-flavored coffee
instructions: Preheat oven 325 degrees and coat bottom of a 8 x4 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Mix vinegar, 2 teaspoons of the harissa, splenda and remaining 1/2 teaspoons harissa in small bowl. Pour blended ingredients into prepared baking dish.

Random Ingredients: dill,miso paste,wine vinegar,cottage cheese,serrano pepper,lemon,plum tomato
title: Cottage Cheese Dip
ingredients: 4 packages cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups sweet wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons miso paste | 2 plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 lemon, juice of, and grated rind of | 1 serrano pepper, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and chill until ready to serve.

title: Pork Beans With Sherry
ingredients: 250 g pork beans, in their cooking sheaths | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 cardamom pod
instructions: Soak the beans in salted water for 6 to 8 hours, or up to overnight, in a large saucepan. Drain and discard the cooking water. Place the beans in a saucepan along with the sherry and cardamom pods. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for about 45 minutes, or until the beans are soft and cooked through, reserving the cooking liquid, and serve with some hot plain yogurt for dipping.

Random Ingredients: red onion,peanut oil,pecorino romano cheese,white wine vinegar,sumac,mint,romaine lettuce
title: Shannon's Special Salad
ingredients: 1 large head romaine lettuce | 1/2 red onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground sumac | 2 tablespoons dried shredded mint | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Wash and dry the endive, and cut into thin slices. Wash and dry the lettuce. In a bowl, mix the red onion, vinegar, romano cheese, sumac, mint and oil. Toss with the lettuce, and refrigerate for 30 to 40 minutes before serving.

title: Gurkensalat - Spicy Spiced Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon msg
instructions: Mix well before storing. Will keep for up to 3 months.

title: Rice With Sun Tomatoes and Garlic
ingredients: 2 eggs | white bread ( thickly sliced, not crumbled ) | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato | minced garlic clove | 1/4 cup dry red wine | steamed rice
instructions: Beat the two eggs. Spray a saucepan with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. As soon as the pan is hot, dip the bread in the egg, letting it soak up the excess egg moisture. It will sizzle and become slightly browned. Drain on paper towel. Scoop out the excess oil. Set aside. Spread both sides of each crumbled bread slice with the creamy sour cream, sundried tomatoes, chopped garlic, and red wine. Lay the soaked bread slices on top. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours. Remove the bread from the refrigerator and use an electric rice paddle or fork to push the bread to the edges of the bowl, pushing more crumbs onto the sides. You should create a large crater and have a large crumbly dish at the bottom of the dish. Replace the empty crumb layer. Grate a little more at the sides, if desired. Serve hot.

title: Beer Canee
ingredients: 1 can fava beans or ( 16 ounce ) can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 can beer | 1 can pepperoni, slice ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Drain and discard liquid from fava beans and garbanzo beans. Place beans, beer, pepperoni, if using, and liquid smoke in a pot and bring liquid to a boil. Cook, stirring with a wood spoon, until hot and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened.

title: Toasted Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Place in a frying pan and toast, stirring, until crisp. Watch them carefully it burns fast it burns easily. Put toasted sesame on paper towel or untoasted bread board. Toast sesame in a heavy pan. Cool and use.

Random Ingredients: peach schnapps,heavy whipping cream,jumbo shrimp,milk,granny smith apple,chunky salsa
title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 2 cans jumbo shrimp, drained | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1 cup peach schnapps | 1 cup milk | 1 granny smith apple, peeled and cut into thin wedges
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the shrimp and their juice, the cream, salsa, peach schnapps and milk. Close and and close the bag, squeezing out excess air. Marinate the shrimp in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the shrimp on a foil lined baking sheet, and bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the shrimp are pink. Serve the shrimp drizzled with the melted chocolate sauce.

title: Gavar's Bar Lab Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup vodka | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 3 tablespoons tomato paste ( heinz brand is excellent ) | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 tablespoon spaghetti seasoning
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan over low heat and mix well. Heat for 10 minutes. Allow sauce to cool then store in the fridge for up to 4 days.

title: Italian Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1 package spicy italian sausage or ( 16 ounce ) package pork sausage | 3/4 cup sliced sliced almonds or 3/4 cup slivered almonds | 2 cans sliced canned peaches, drained, juice reserved | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Brown sausage in nonstick skillet, stirring often, about 7 - 10 minutes or until meat is well browned. Stir in remaining ingredients and heat through.

title: Tarragon and Herb-Cream Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 4 ounces cream cheese, softened | 15 teaspoons tarragon
instructions: Mix all ingredients together using only 1 teaspoon for each. Roll into 1 ounce size balls. If desired, place in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour prior to serving.

title: Creamy Chicken Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs ( or any leftover pork, poultry or seafood ) | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded cabbage | 4 cups medium-sized grape tomatoes ( or use cherry tomatoes. i prefer ruby reds )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Use a very large pot. In a medium mixing bowl, mix crumbs and sour cream. Stir with a fork. Stir in 1 1/2 cans soup, reserving 1 1/2 cans. In a 3 1/2 qt casserole dish, place cabbage, tomatoes, 1 cup soup and 2 1/2 cans water. Stir and cover tightly with foil/cooking lid. Bake 25 minutes in oven, uncover and bake another 5 minute. Remove foil and bake 10 minute more or until slightly browned. Add remaining soup and simmer uncovered for another 5 minute, remove and discard the vegetables.

title: Spaties
ingredients: 1 lb veal cutlet | 2 ounces self-raising flour | 1/4 lb baby carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the veal into slices about 3½cm/1½ inch thick. Dredge the veal in flour, tapping off excess. Arrange the carrots around the veal, then sprinkle the flour on. Fold the meat so you can roll it around on all sides. Bake for 2 hours. Serve with cream or chutney.

Random Ingredients: shortening,water chestnut,peach fruit,liquid smoke,tamari,white vinegar,beef chuck roast,corn kernel
title: Sweet and Sour Beef with Dried Peaches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup canned sliced water chestnuts, sliced | 1 package frozen peach slices in syrup, drained and liquid used ( one can ) | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/2 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon coarse grain or coarse grain breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup shortening | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients. Combine meat and marinate at least 3 hours in refrigerator. Drain meat and pat dry. Cook meat, covered, in a large ovenproof skillet with a lid, about 1 hour and 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until meat is tender. Remove meat from pan.

title: Baked Swiss Steak
ingredients: 6 steaks | 6 slicesgerman chocolate ( about 8 x 14 squares each )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a medium bowl, combine steaks and chocolate. Place steaks on a broiler pan and bake for 12 minutes, or until meat is just cooked through.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,italian flat leaf parsley,active yeast,sun tomato oil,cayenne pepper,italian seasoning,lime
title: Sunflower Seed Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped italian flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup pine nuts, or to taste | 2 limes, cut into wedges, for serving
instructions: Mix sun dried tomatoes, yeast, italian seasoning, cayenne pepper, parsley, sun dried tomatoes in a bowl until combined. Add remaining olive oil and sun dried tomato mixture. Beat until smooth and slightly sticky. Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Form dough into a ball. Cover with clean kitchen towels and let rise 90 minutes, or until doubled. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with plastic wrap. Working on a lightly floured surface, roll out dough to fit pan. Transfer to prepared baking sheet. Poke holes in the top with a fork. Brush with warm water. Cover with a clean kitchen towel. Allow to rise 30 to 40 minutes, or until doubled. Bake in the preheated oven until deep golden brown and crusty, about 15 minutes. Serve warm, sprinkled with toasted pine nuts if desired.

title: Crunchy Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 eggs | 4 slices low-fat rye bread | 2 tablespoons diced dill | 1 star anise
instructions: Mix eggs. Soak bread slices, but don't soak too many slices. Spread mustard on bread, and then spread mustard with dill. Add star anise to tea. Spread bread with egg mix and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,tamarind paste,chili pepper flake,italian dressing,corn,buffalo,panko breadcrumb
title: Buffalo and Barley Stirfry
ingredients: 1/4 lb bulk mild pork or 1/4 lb ground turkey | 1 cup sweet corn ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 cup dried panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1/4 cup italian dressing ( bottled or homemade ) | 1/4 cup shredded buffalo or 1/4 cup roasted ham
instructions: In a shallow bowl combine pork, corn, panko, chili flakes, corn tamarind paste and italian dressing. Mix well. Divide meat mixture into 4 equal portions and shape into 4 patties. Place on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or till done.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,extra beef,serrano chilies,green pea,pepper,jumbo shrimp,asafoetida powder
title: Beef, Corn & Chile Prawns
ingredients: 400 -500 g extra lean ground beef | 250 g jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 -4 serrano chilies, finely chopped | 250 ml cream-style corn | 20 g green peas | 3/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Saute chillies in butter. Add ground beef and fry until browned. Add shrimp prawns and fry gently. Add cream style corn. Cook for approximately 7 minutes. Mix the chillies with the shrimp mixture. Sprinkle pepper over prawn mixture. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,cilantro leaf,kaffir lime leaf,ginger garlic paste,yogurt,basmati rice
title: Yogurt Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup brown basmati rice | 3 1/2 cups leftover yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 kaffir lime leaf, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 package shell pasta
instructions: Place a wok or large frying pan over medium high heat until hot. Add the rice to the wok, and stir fry for a few minutes until it begins to turn golden. Add the yogurt, and cook until warm. Stir in the cilantro, minced ginger garlic paste, and lime leaf, if using. Toss with the cooked rice until coated in the yogurt mixture. Cook the pasta as directed on the package, and drain. Place a portion of the rice into each bowl, and top with a portion of the yogurt sauce. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: heirloom tomato,italian plum tomato,chipotle chile adobo,oregano leaf,tabasco sauce,steak seasoning
title: Heirloom Tomato Beef With Chipotle
ingredients: 1/2 lb flank steak seasoning | 2 lbs heirloom tomatoes, stemmed, seeded, and cut into 2 pieces | 4 ounces chipotle chiles in adobo, minced | 1 cup italian plum tomato, seeded and cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Sprinkle flank steak with steak seasoning. Arrange tomatoes, chiles, tomatoes and oregano in a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Heat broiler and set rack 6 inches from broiler element. Broil, turning once, until desired doneness, about 12 minutes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Serve on a platter and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Spinach Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 lb baby spinach
instructions: In a medium bowl mix the flour, cumin and salt together. Toss the spinach evenly using your hands and add 1 1/2 tsp water to the mixture to blend. Cover and place in the refrigerator for 15 minutes. Place 2 tsp of mixture into a plastic bag. Moisten with more water and then use to coat the spinach. After washing, shake off any excess water and then press the spinach mixture firmly into a non stick pan and gently fry on the stove top, or microwave in a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes or just cook on low for longer.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,double cream,greek seasoning,mahi fillet,blackberry,onion soup mix,cornflour,fish fillet
title: Blackberry and Fish Casserole
ingredients: 1 mahi mahi fillet, cut into thick slices | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 600 g fresh blackberries | 1 jar onion soup mix | 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons fish soup mix | 2 tablespoons greek seasoning | 150 double cream
instructions: Toss the blackberries in the cornflour, and leave to drain for 30 minutes in a colander. Cook the mahi mahi fillets in a frying pan for 5 - 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. Mix together the onion soup, rum and fish soup in a saucepan. Remove from the heat. Preheat the oven to 180c/fan 350f/gas lightly grease a 20cm/11x2 dish. Place the blackberry mixture in a bowl. Add the fish fillet and gently toss together. Pour the mahi mahi mixture into the prepared dish. Dot the top with double cream and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until the mahi mahi is golden brown and the berries have burst and settled to the top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,pork tenderloin,butternut squash,calorie sweetener,vanilla bean,tomato,arborio rice
title: Pork & Stuffed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup short-grain rice | 1/4 cup heavy cream ( not nonfat ) or 1/4 cup skim milk ( not nonfat ) | 1/2 cup chopped tomato | 3 tablespoons butternut squash, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sugar-free sweetener | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, seeds scraped | 4 tablespoons cooked pork tenderloin, fat, removed
instructions: Cook rice and cream in a medium pot over medium heat, stirring frequently. Add tomato, squash, sugar and vanilla. Cover and simmer, about 10 minutes or until rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat, stir in pork and season with salt and pepper to taste. Transfer rice to a medium bowl and cool to warm, about 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Lemons
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup fish sauce
instructions: Combine sugar and cayenne in a large, heavy saucepan. Over medium heat, cook, stirring constantly, until sugar caramelizes completely. Watch carefully as sugar will harden quickly. Immediately pour caramel into cup of an electric blender, and process until coarsely ground. Add the fish sauce and mix well.

Random Ingredients: green olive,english cucumber,yellow squash,meatball,purpose flour,ra el hanout spice mix,kalamata olive
title: Mashed Moroccan Salad
ingredients: 1 kalamata olive, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 container kalamata olives, coarsely chopped | 1 jar stuffed green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 english cucumber, coarsely chopped | 1 yellow squash, cut lengthwise in half lengthwise and sliced | 1 package meatballs | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 jar ras el hanout spice mix ( moroccan spice mix )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Prepare all ingredients, then mix well with hands. Divide into 3 or 4 large pita or mini bread patties. Pour 3/4 inch depth of olive oil on a baking sheet, then arrange patties flat. Bake 20 - 25 minutes, or until golden on top.

Random Ingredients: salt,basil,hash brown potato,flat leaf parsley,italian seasoning,chocolate chip,semolina,pear
title: Potato-Pear Bake
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped hash brown potatoes | 1/2 cup frozen chopped pear, thawed | 1/3 cup semolina | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped basil | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped semisweet chocolate chips | 1 pinch salt | 1 teaspoon coarsely chopped basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a 5 qt casserole dish combine potatoes, pears, semolina, parsley, and 1 teaspoon italian seasoning. Bake, uncovered, 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate chips and 1 teaspoon basil leaves.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,monterey jack cheddar cheese,beef bouillon cube,thyme
title: Easy Mexican Inspired Quail
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb italian sausage | 1 teaspoon ground thyme | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes, drained, patted dry and chopped | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
instructions: Heat ground beef or sausage and thyme or sausage in large skillet over medium heat. Add bouillon cubes. Reduce heat. Simmer for 1 hour or until meat is cooked through. Remove from heat. Add sundried tomatoes. Top with shredded cheese and serve at once. Note, for even richer quail toppings, garnish with fresh chopped cilantro or parsley.

Random Ingredients: egg,red radish,serrano pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,asafoetida powder,garnish,sherry wine
title: Asafetida Dukkah
ingredients: 2 lbs red radishes, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1/2 teaspoon cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 4 large eggs, beaten lightly | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine | 4 small small serrano peppers | garnish of sour red radish, optional garnish, optional garnish
instructions: Spray skillet with nonstick spray and heat over medium high heat until it shimmers. Add radishes to pan and sauté, moving radishes with a slotted spoon, 2 minutes. Turn over and sauté an additional 5 minutes or until browned. Remove radishes from pan and drain on paper towels. Remove burned and dried radish bottoms from pan, leaving 1/4 inch of the head. Coat in flour, shaking off excess. Add asafetida to the pan. Push vegetables back into the oil. Pour beaten eggs evenly over the vegetables. Cook, stirring constantly, until just set. Carefully slide rice out of pan and onto plate. Cut into wedges and serve on top.

title: Super Easy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas
instructions: Rinse the chickpeas and put them in the blender. Blend until fine. Add olive oil at the required consistency for your diet if you would like, it makes for creamy texture as well as a wonderful healthy side dish. You can eat this with pita bread or pita chips with your pita bread on the side.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,cherry,honey,serrano chilies,tomato,milk,chile pepper,hot italian sausage
title: Salsiccia Con Salsiccia (Sausage and Cherries in Chili Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 garlic clove, halved | 8 serrano chilies, stemmed and seeded | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 1/4 cup milk or 1/4 cup soymilk | 2 ounces cherries or 2 ounces sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup canned diced tomato | 1 -2 julienned fresh chili pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Remove sausage from casings and cut into 1 lengths. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat with a slotted spoon, preferably with a cast iron griddle spout inserted in it, and brown the sausage pieces well. Add sausage to the hot pan with the garlic, serrano chilies, honey, and milk or soymilk. Cook, stirring, until the chiles soften a little. Add the cherry or sherry vinegar and tomatoes. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring to scrape up the browned bits, until the tomatoes are just warm and begin to thicken the sauce. Remove from the heat. Serve in warmed soup cups and garnish with whole chili, if desired.

title: Chicken Chunk-Up (Australian)
ingredients: 600 g chicken, chopped into 1-1/2 | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 6 red chilies, finely chopped | 125 g self raising flour | 6 tablespoons cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 cups desiccated coconut
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well, but not too much that the chicken gets sticky. Pour mixture into an oiled casserole dish or shallow baking tray, sprinkle on grated coconut and chillies and bake in a moderate oven for about 45 minutes, until the chunk up is golden.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Toast
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, cubed | 2 tablespoons cranberry sauce | 8 slices white bread, toasted
instructions: Place eggplant cubes on griddle over medium heat and cook, turning occassionaly until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Mix cinnamon and cranberry sauce and divide evenly between four slices of toasted bread. Top with eggplant cubes and heat slowly to melt the other side of the toast or alternatively place pieces of toasted bread in a non stick skillet and fry the toast in the sauce then enjoy.

title: Easy Sushi Sandwich (No Rolling!)
ingredients: 1 lime, juice of | 1 nori, seaweed | 1 serrano pepper | 1/2 cup rolled oats
instructions: Take out a bowl. Take a handful of nori seaweed mix in, then squeeze a bit of lime juice until it's a smooth paste thats been sizzling on your fingers. Slice the nori into long ribbons, not thin strips. Put the nori onto a serving plate, then drizzle a little lime juice on top,. Sprinkle with serrano pepper. Slice the nori into thin strips, then press into a bit of lime juice to keep from slimning. When ready, grab the nori and slice it into strips. Repeat with the nori and the hot serrano peppers. Place the nori strips onto a plate, and drizzle a little more lime juice on top.

title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces pancetta, chopped | 4 ounces kielbasa, chopped | 4 ounces chicken wings, chopped | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 tablespoons soda water, or as needed | 4 ounces miniature pretzels
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pancetta in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium heat until browned and crispy. Add kielbasa, and cook to release flavor. Mix in confectioners' sugar, cream of tartar, and soda water. Sprinkle with pretzels before layering sausage and kielbasa mixture in baking vessels. Bake in preheated oven until sausage is hot and bubbly, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,peach,almond extract,pearl barley,parsley leaf,flat leaf italian parsley,rosemary sprig
title: Marinated Italian Peach Barley Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb pearl barley ( about 2 1/2 lbs ) | 1/3 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 4 large fresh rosemary sprigs, leaves picked | 2 large fresh peach slices ( about 3/4-1/2 lb total weight ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves ( optional )
instructions: Prepare barley according to directions on the box. Drain barley and set aside. Using a fine mesh sieve, transfer barley to a large saucepan. Cover with 2 cups cold water and bring to a boil over high heat. Using a wooden spoon, skim off any foam that rises to the surface and stir in 1/3 cup parsley and the remaining 2 basil leaves. Reduce heat to low.

title: Mexican Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 8 ounces lentils, drained and rinsed well | 1 package taco seasoning | 3 tablespoons soymilk, if desired | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 cup cilantro, minced | 1/2 cup dry spanish cooking wine
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat the oil and brown the ground beef. Add the onion and the lentils. Season with the taco seasoning, stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium low. Cover and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until lentils are tender. Drain. Set aside. Heat the corn oil in a saucepan over medium low heat. Add the cilantro and allow to simmer, stirring often. Stir in the wine, and simmer for 2 minutes and season with more salt. Allow the soup to cool slightly so it is very crumbly but still wet to the hand. Shape the meat mixture into one inch meatballs. Return all meatballs to the soup in a slow cooker or slow cooker crock. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours. Serve with croutons.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,red wine vinegar,strawberry,rosemary,cream coconut,cinnamon,water,corn tortilla chip
title: Tortilla-Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 cups water | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary | 1 cinnamon stick | 2 cups small egg noodles, uncooked | 1 can cream of coconut | 3/4 cup sour cream | 2 cups chopped fresh strawberries | 1 package corn tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: Whisk water, vinegar, rosemary and cinnamon stick in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: white bean,cooking onion,dark soy sauce,button mushroom,mozzarella cheese,chili sauce,pine nut
title: Chinese White Bean and Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 puff pastry sheets | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 small cooking onion, sliced | 16 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line 2 pizza pans with parchment paper. Divide both beans between both rounds of pastry, and spread out so it is about 1/4 inch thick. Mix soy sauce and chili sauce. Brush on the onions and mushrooms, and sprinkle each pizza with a good amount of cheese.. Spread a very thin layer of the soy sauce mixture and a little chili sauce on the top of the pastry. Roll out the dough into a rectangle about 9x1 inch. Cut the top half off with a sharp knife. Slice the top off and spread the slices lightly on top. Place the pizza on a cookie sheet and bake for around ten minutes or until crust is golden brown. Serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,extra beef,baking potato,wheat bread
title: Easy Beef Stew W- Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb ground extra lean ground beef | 1 can cut red kidney beans | 1 small baking potato, cut into 2 inch chunks | 3/4 cup low-fat whole wheat french fries ( or regular fries )
instructions: If you're really concerned about the pan drippings, add extra virgin olive oil. If you're not concerned about burning your hands, add more beef. Brown beef with onion over medium heat in a skillet. Drain fat that comes out of the beef. Add the beans, salt & pepper and cover. Simmer until meat tender, about 30 minutes to an hour. While pan is heating, cut potatoes into 1/2 inch thick slices. While it is heating, spray a large casserole dish. Put potato slices into a bowl of water. Drain the fat from onions so they don't brown. When the beef is done, add it to the pot and stir. Mix in drained potato slices. Simmer uncovered an additional 3 - 3 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking. Serve the stew over steamed french fries.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,misto red pepper,pepper flake,red chili pepper flake,black olive,brown gravy mix,pepperoni
title: Cottage Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry curd cottage cheese ( not light ) | 2 teaspoons brown gravy mix | 4 tablespoons chopped black olives ( drained ) | 1 tablespoon crushed red chile pepper flakes ( or more ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes ( or more ) | 7 1/2 ounces sliced pepperoni ( drained ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Heat pizza pan or pizza stone according to appliance directions on microwaveable bowl. Combine cottage cheese, brown gravy mix, olives, salt, red and hot peppers, and cayenne pepper in a small bowl. Put half the cottage cheese mixture in pizza pan or stone until almost covered. Top with second cottage cheese mixture. Then sprinkle with remaining 1/2 tbsp ground black pepper. Place on pizza pan or stone that has been brushed with pam. Cook until bottom crust is light brown, and the top is browned and bubbly, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Green Chile Salsa
ingredients: 2 fresh green chili, stems removed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Blend the green chilies and cream until smooth. Transfer to a double thickness of cheesecloth lined strainer and sprinkle with the salt. Suspend mixture over a large rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or until the mixture has softened and thickened, at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: currant,cream mushroom soup,soy sauce,white fish fillet,spinach leaf,cream chicken soup
title: Creamy Spinach Soup
ingredients: 4 cups frozen chopped spinach leaves ( thawed ) | 2 cans chopped cream of mushroom soup | 10 1/2 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 5 ounces white fish fillets, cooked and diced ( i used ian's ) | 6 ounces dried currants
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a crock pot. Cook on high, stir, allow to reduce and serve.

title: Angelica Ice
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters frozen orange juice concentrate | 18 stalks angelica
instructions: Empty the frozen orange juice into a large freezer container. Trim off any green pieces of the angelica or curly leaves. Coarsely chop the angelica leaves, and place them into the freezer. Once half of the frozen orange juice concentrate has been frozen, remove it from the freezer and stir in the orange juice concentrate into it. Return the frozen mixture to the container, and place the bowl in the freezer for one hour. At about the end of the hour, remove the bowl from the freezer, and give it one last stir. Remove the angelica from the ice and place in a shallow pyrex baking dish or container with a lid. Seal, and place into a freezer. After one hour, remove from the freezer and place in a storage container, or in a small plastic resealable plastic container, and place into a freezer bag. To store or freeze, place in the freezer for 5 to 7 days, then remove from the freezer and place into the freezer container.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,pesto sauce,pea,sage leaf,napa cabbage,french onion ring,shiitake mushroom,romaine lettuce heart
title: Vegetable Saute
ingredients: 12 fresh oyster on the shell, shucked | 1/2 lb shrimp or 1/2 lb chicken | 2 packages frozen peas, thawed- drained | 5 -6 romaine lettuce hearts | 6 ounces napa cabbage | 1 bunch fresh parsley leaves | 4 fresh sage leaves | 1 teaspoon pesto sauce | 1/4 cup french fried onion rings, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place all the ingredients in a skillet and bring to a boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve on warm rolls.

Random Ingredients: beer,puff pastry,pecorino romano cheese,lemon juice,romaine lettuce
title: Easy, No Bake, No Strata
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 6 leaves romaine lettuce, cut into 1-inch strips | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 12 ounces beer
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Lay puff pastry sheets in single layer on baking sheet and bake just until pastry is puffed and golden and edge is golden, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven and cut each sheet in half. Spread each half with 1 tablespoon cheese and 1 teaspoon lemon juice. Top mixture with lettuce.

title: Tuna Sticks (France)
ingredients: 16 puff pastry sheets ( thawed if frozen ) | 2 medium green capsicums | 1 -2 whole anchovy, halved
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c cut each capsicum in half lengthways. Scrape out the seeds using a teaspoon or spoon. Cut all the way through the capsicum to loosen the skin, then remove the seeds and membranes. Slice the capsicums into 1 centimetre lengths and place on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Brush each with about 1/8cm cold water and sprinkle with salt to taste. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden brown. Serve straight from the oven with the extra salad to pass around the table. The tuna sticks can be stored, refrigerated, in an airtight container with a light coating of olive oil. These can also be made the night before and frozen, allowing one quick bake time of no more than 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: manicotti,baby spinach leaf,oyster sauce,wheat pita bread,chili
title: Spinach and Pita Pockets
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat pita bread | 1/4 cup baby spinach | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons chili | 1 1/2 lbs mixed baby spinach leaves
instructions: Separate the pita bread into 2 or 3 portions. Split each pita round into two portions, if possible. Spread a little bit of sesame oil on your right hand and place one portion of fish or chicken on each pita round. Sprinkle a little more fish or chicken on top of the fish and smear it with more sesame oil. Spread about 1/2 tablespoon of oyster sauce between the pita rounds, to color it. Place about 3/4 cup of spinach on top of the fish and spread it on the pita top. Top with another pita, and press. This will prevent the spinach from burning at the bottom, like steam holes. Wipe out the skillet and dry it if you can. Fry the pita pockets, one at a time, in it on each side until they are golden brown. Remove the pita pockets and keep them warm in a 200f oven while you cook the rest of the filling in the skillet. Note, a few pita halves may crack during frying, so be careful. Add water to the spinach in a pan, about 2 tablespoons or so. Squeeze excess liquid out of the spinach, then add enough water to the spinach and cook until all the water has been absorbed. When the spinach is cool enough to handle, squeeze all of the liquid out of it, chop roughly into pieces, then return it to the spinach. If you don't use spinach that is large, they may be tricky to work with, so be very careful when deciding to use greens. Serve the filling on the side with the spinach mixture in the middle of the pita pockets.

Random Ingredients: lite olive oil,red pepper flake,cranberry,seasoning salt pepper,wheat flour,littleneck clam,anise seed
title: Clams & Cranberries With Aniseed and New Year's Oats
ingredients: 2 lbs littleneck clams, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 3 teaspoons seasoning salt and pepper | 2 teaspoons anise seeds, crushed | 1 1/2 cups fresh cranberries
instructions: Clean and debeard clams. Rinse clams & drain juice from clams. In a large skillet over medium high heat, warm olive oil. Add red pepper flakes, and heat 1 minute or until fragrant. Remove from pan, set aside. In a shallow bowl, mix together flour, salt and pepper. Rinse clams well, and drain reserving juice. Toss drained clams with flour mixture. Heat 1/2 inch olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add clams in single layer, and fry until just barely opened, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from skillet, and set aside. Add aniseed and fresh cranberries to the skillet with reserved juice. Heat to boiling, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until liquid is reduced by about half a third. Serve hot, with toast and crackers.

title: Saganaki (Parmesan Puff Pastry)
ingredients: 1 cup shaved camembert cheese | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place shaved cheese on a platter. Combine cornstarch and grated parmesan cheese and sprinkle on top of the shaved cheese.

title: Fiesta Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 package beans, beans with flavor | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Stir together beans, buttermilk, and crushed red pepper. Can also be served on the side with mexican rice.

title: Chicken in a Red Sauce
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs, skinned | 1 ounce dried tomatillo ( optional ) | 1/2 pint tomato juice | 5 ounces soft brown sugar | 1 large vanilla beans or 1 large lima beans, split lengthwise | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Place chicken thighs side by side in a shallow, pan or dish. Pour tomatillo juice over the chicken. Place skinless onion, garlic and sugar in a saucepan and put over medium heat. Stir often until the sugar dissolves. Simmer, uncovered until the sugar caramelizes. Remove from heat. Drain tomatillos, if using, into a frying pan and pour in tomato juice. Bring to a simmer, then lower the heat and simmer until the tomatillos soften. Pour into a small pan and warm it slightly. Add a pinch of salt and pepper. When simmering, pour over the chicken and turn it over so it is evenly coated. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Turn chicken over again and simmer for at least 15 minutes. Transfer chicken to a serving platter and cover to keep warm. Pour cooking juices over chicken. Serve with grated cheese on the side. Note, if you are using fresh tomatillos, you may want to boil them for a bit in a small pan. It will take some of the oil from the tomatillo but can be removed a bit as soon as they are removed from the heat. Also, if you are using frozen lima beans, you may wish to drain them first as the sugar will turn murky. If using fresh lima beans, add them, too. Cover and freeze. The longer the chicken sits, the more flavorful they will be. If frozen, it will need to be fully thawed before freezing. If you are using fresh beans, break them down as soon as they thaw and then use half of the oil to saute the chicken.

title: Beef With Snow Peas(Shrimp) over Hot Pecorino Noodle
ingredients: 1 lb beef, sliced thinly against the grain | 3 cups fresh snow peas, washed and dried | 1 tablespoon parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet, add beef and stir fry over high heat for 10 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Add snow peas, tossing to coat well, and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, or until snow peas are tender crisp. Add parsley, tossing to coat. Serve with hot, cooked noodles.

title: Corn Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn, frozen | 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1 chicken stock cube, crushed or 1 large onion, finely diced
instructions: Put corn on a paper towel and put on the stove. If using a meat cube, add it here. Bring to a boil, stirring often.

title: Greek Tandoori Catfish Flatbread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon greek yogurt | 1 lb catfish fillet, skinned and split in half lengthwise | 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 f. Grease a baking sheet with cooking oil. Line the pan with puff pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges. Brush the surface with yogurt. Spread the fish over the yogurt, leaving 1/2 inch border near the outside edge. Using a rolling pin, roll the dough around the fish to completely enclose the fish completely. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet, brush the tops with yogurt and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake until the fish is cooked through and well browned, about 10 - 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white flour,brown button mushroom,taco seasoning,apricot,baby bok choy,beef sirloin steak,lettuce leaf
title: Aussie Beef Salad W- Mushrooms and Apricots
ingredients: 400 g baby bok choy | 8 thin slice beef sirloin steak ( or any meat you may think, the meat is already cooked ) | 420 g baby bok choy | 8 slices white flour ( white sandwich bread ) | 0.5 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 cup chopped apricot ( for crunch ) | 200 g brown button mushrooms | freshly packaged lettuce leaf
instructions: Get your ingredients ready to cook, i use a grill pan, and as much lettuce as you need to get the mix really good. Cut the whole stack into 8 equal portions. Slice the larger pieces of meat into thin strips. I usually chop them into small pieces, but it's your preference. Cook the slices on a grill or on a frying pan until brown and crispy. You want them a little crispy outside but not too brown, but not too dark either or they'll go soggy. As the beef cooks, cook up the mushroom caps to break up quite quickly. Put a portion of mushrooms on each lettuce leaf, and just as you're waiting for the beef to be cooked, mix in the rest of the prepared ingredients. Tear off pieces of lettuce to eat, and place a portion of the chopped beef and some of the baby bok choy on top of that. You may also pile up some tinned diced tomatoes into a bowl, or chop some bacon to serve on the side. To eat the pile and stack in the traditional manner, put a slice of white soured cream on top of the pile, sprinkle a piece of chopped tomatoes on the pile, add a leaf of shredded cheese on top and some chunks of green and red capsicum around the pile, then some more chopped tomato and a slice of green.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,baker yeast,cumin powder,pineapple juice,clam juice,grape,lime juice,herb
title: Cuban Style Clam Cocktail Appetizer-Bread, "Cobao"
ingredients: 1 ounce baking yeast | 1/2 cup sugar syrup, see note | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, about 1/2 cup | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs, chopped ( rosemary, parsley, chives, dill or chives of choice ) | 1/2 cup grape, seedless | 1 lime, juice of ( optional )
instructions: Put yeast, sugar syrup and ½ cup water in small bowl. Stir. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in remaining water, pineapple juice and spices. Cover and let stand in a warm place for about 45 minutes, or until frothy. Stir again and add enough grape seed to fill. Let stand 30 minutes. Put on a floured surface and knead gently to form a smooth and elastic dough. Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise 1 hour. Punch down, knead briefly, cut into 8 equal pieces. Preheat oven to 350°f roll each out to about ¼ inch thickness and place on prepared baking sheet, making as many as will fit without overlapping. Place at least 3 inches apart. Make as many cocktail in advance as you need for each one. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve hot, or at room temperature. Great for breakfast or snacks, or just good as a snack for a lunch or supper.

title: Rice With Almonds and Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 3 tablespoons pearl barley ( rinsed and drained ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Rinse rice, cover in 1/2 cup boiling water and bring back to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes or until tender and dry.. Meanwhile cook barley until just tender. Drain barley mixture into bowl, let cool slightly. Dump rice into bowl with barley, spread evenly.

title: French Steak With Corn and Herbs
ingredients: 4 lbs beef steaks | 1/2 cup beef broth | 6 ounces beef liver, sliced | 1 3/4 cups canned corn, drained | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 teaspoon savory
instructions: Place meat on rack of broiler pan, fat side down. Broil about 3 minutes or until well browned, turning once. Place on board. In small bowl, combine beef broth, livers, corn, tarragon and savory.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,sticky rice,velveeta cheese,banana,dill weed,pot roast,cranberry
title: Crusty Cheesy Mashed Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 lbs pot roast | 2 bananas | 3 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 1 lb velveeta cheese | 1 bunch fresh dill weed | 2 lbs sticky rice, cooked and cooled | 2 packages frozen whole cranberries
instructions: Preheat a large pan on the stove. Place the dry rice in a ziplock bag or dutch oven bag along with the mustard seeds and place it in the stove. Bake at 375 degrees for 4 minutes. Take off heat. Crumble the velveeta into a medium size bowl, add the mustard and dill weed and stir well. Taste the mixture and add more mustard/dill if needed. Peel the bananas and slice into thick pieces. Place the potatoes in the pan, add 2 cans of water, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low temperature for 90 minutes to 1 hour stirring occasionally. Add the bananas, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Simmer until the rice is tender and has absorbed most of the water. Remove from heat and set aside. Slice the roast into 4 equal portions. Toss with the gravy until coated well in the gravy. Place the chunks of roast and the cranberries in your crockpot, add the potatoes and any remaining gravy, and cover. Cook on low heat for about 3 hours, or on high for 2 - 5 hours, to allow the flavors to meld together. Serve with warm bread.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,caster sugar,mexican cheese,bamboo skewer,hot green chili pepper,orange zest,fava bean
title: Soupa Masala
ingredients: 1 can fava beans, drained and rinsed ( chickpeas ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder, or to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh orange zest, grated | 3 teaspoons hot green chili peppers or 3 teaspoons crushed red chilies | 4 bamboo skewers | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: If using bamboo skewers, soak for 30 minutes. Soak beans slightly. In a large bowl, mix cooked fava beans, curry powder, sugar, orange zest, chillies and bamboo or saran wrap. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with cheese to serve.

title: Baked Italian Sausages
ingredients: 18 links hot italian sausage | 12 large frozen sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°f. Cut sausages lengthwise. Sauté them in saute or skillet, brushing with oil, until golden brown on all sides. Place them in a large casserole. Stir the sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteed sauteese on top of sausages. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,vegetable broth,phyllo pastry,penne pasta,gruyere cheese
title: Baked Penne with Cauliflower and Gruyère
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth or 2 cups chicken broth | 1 head cauliflower floret | 3 ounces penne pasta or 3 ounces rigatoni pasta | 4 ounces gruyere cheese | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. In a saucepan, bring the broth and cauliflower to a boil over medium heat. Cover and cook for 7 minutes, or until tender. In a large pot of boiling water, cook the pasta for 5 minutes. Then drain. Transfer the hot broth to a bowl. Put the penne in the cold water to cook, according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, layer pasta then spoon in the hot broth mixture. Sprinkle with the cheese and cut up pieces of cauliflower. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until pasta is tender.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,brown sugar,pepperoni,taco sauce,wine,beef steak,mustard powder
title: Tasty Italian Steak
ingredients: 4 beef steaks | 1/3 cup steak marinara sauce, your favourite ( or use a homemade marinara sauce ) | 3 slices pepperoni, cut thick | 3 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon powdered brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom pod
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Rub the marinara onto steaks and broil for about 3 mins per side until desired doneness or steaks reach desired doneness. This recipe will yield 6 servings but i have also made this over a plate of pasta. I don't like to serve it with pasta, so i just use the cooked, drained pasta.

Random Ingredients: beef stock bouillon,grainy mustard,roast beef,egg noodle,golden caster sugar,clear honey,white onion
title: Mustard and Honey Noodles for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 ounce roast beef | 1 small white onion | 2 tablespoons golden caster sugar | 1 ounce whole grainy mustard | 1 tablespoon plain honey | 1 pint beef stock or 1 pint homemade beef stock | 1 egg noodles
instructions: Cut the beef into thick slices. Peel and finely chop the onion. Heat a frying pan and fry the beef in the pan until browned. Add the onion and sugar and leave for 3 minutes. Add the mustard and honey and leave to bubble. Stir in the stock and bring to the boil. Put on the lid, put on the pan and simmer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the noodle according to package instructions. Drain and mix with the meat mixture. Serve with lots of mustard and honey.

title: Easy Polenta Chicken and Eggs (Ww 6 Points)
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 1 large egg | 2 slices prosciutto | 3 lettuce leaves
instructions: Turn broiler on high. Place chicken on broiler rack. Spray grill with cooking spray. Place chicken in a shallow baking dish.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,mint,corn kernel,pecorino romano cheese,sherry,italian parsley
title: Italian Chicken and Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley, leaves picked and coarsely chopped | 10 ounces fresh corn kernels, cut into thirds | 1/4 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 12 boneless skinless chicken breasts or 12 chicken thighs, with skin | 1/3 cup finely chopped mint
instructions: In bowl, combine sherry and parsley and let stand at room temperature. Preheat oven to 375°f. Put corn, pecorino romano and chicken in greased 13x9 baking dish, season with salt and pepper, toss gently, then set aside. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour. Sprinkle with mint and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,almond essence,chocolate pudding mix,red cabbage,white chocolate chip,chunky peanut butter,mayonnaise
title: Vegan Chocolate Chippers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chunky peanut butter | 1/8 teaspoon almond essence | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1 cup crushed corn flakes | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.

Random Ingredients: neufchatel cheese,broccoli,spring onion,spanish onion,dark rum,rocket,lemon zest
title: The Real deal - Radiatore's Broccoli & French Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 broccoli | 2 large spanish onions, very thinly sliced | 250 g neufchatel cheese ( 1 package ) | 1 bunch rocket, leaves roughly torn ( rocket is best ) | 250 g smoked fat free french or italian dressing | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 teaspoon dark rum
instructions: Break open the broccoli crown by scooping out the centre. Scoop out the seeds to look like an x. Cut the broccoli crown into 2cm pieces and separate onto individual leaves. Place aside. Cut the onion into wedges and place the wedges into a bowl of cold water. Peel and slice the coleslaw. Place the coleslaw in an oven proof dish and leave to cool in the fridge. Place swiss onion in a large bowl with the cooled broccoli in them. Mash neufchatel into a smooth consistency adding the other ingredients and mix well. Add the grated lemon zest and rum.

title: Chinese Watermelon & Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 4 cups watermelon, cubed | 1 bunch broccoli, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1 bunch iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 star anise | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1 tablespoon dried ladyfingers, crushed | 1 cup shaved iceberg lettuce
instructions: Combine watermelon, broccoli, lettuce and star anise in a medium bowl. Mix in mirin and garnish with sweet rice wine dipped ladyfingers.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,red maraschino cherry,red chilies,pecan,green chili pepper,tomato juice,cardamom seed
title: Tomato-Cherry Pies by Sy
ingredients: 16 large red chili peppers or 16 large orange chili peppers | 1 bunch green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 lb firm ripe tomatoes with juice or 1 lb cherry tomatoes, chopped | 4 ounces creme fraiche | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds | red maraschino cherry, for topping | 1 cup freshly ground pecans, for topping
instructions: Place the chillies, green peppers, tomatoes, creme fraiche, cardamom and red maraschino cherries in to an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over the pecans. Bake at 400° for 10 - 15 minutes or until the tomatoes are bubbling and heated through. Allow to cool and store in an airtight tin for upto 2 months.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,steak,veal,white hominy,chicken broth,white onion,chicken thigh
title: Southern Veal Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 lb ground round | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 cup chicken broth | 14 1/2 ounces white hominy, washed | 6 tablespoons whole wheat flour ( for dredging )
instructions: In a large dutch oven, brown the ground meats with onion and chicken broth. Add the meat to the stew and bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for two hours. Add white hominy and continue cooking for one hour. Wash clean and soak for 2 hours. Put into casserole dish and cover with water and bake at 350 degrees until tender when pierced with a fork. Salt and pepper to taste. The stew can also be made with white corn kernels instead of wheat kernels. I find chicken broth a great substitute when making this.

title: Pineapple & Carrot Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs unsweetened pineapple chunks, packed in juice | 2 carrots, peeled and finely diced | 1/2 cup finely chopped green olives | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | kitchen bouquet, to taste | chives, wedges to serve
instructions: Place all ingredients except chives in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, simmer uncovered 10 minutes to allow flavors to blend. Remove from heat. Divide among hot, sterilized jars or plastic cups. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: date,marshmallow,hot red chili pepper,focaccia bread,chipotle chile,beef
title: Quick and Easy Roast Beef Sandwiches with Chipotle Filling
ingredients: 20 slices focaccia bread | 1/2 lb thinly sliced lean ground beef | 3 -8 fresh hot red chili peppers, drained, minced ( hot red chili peppers can be subsituted ) | 2 -2 chipotle chiles, finely minced | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh mushrooms | 4 dates, thinly sliced unpeeled
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil and 2 tablespoons broth over medium low heat in a large dutch oven until hot and shimmering.

title: Soba Bikini (Beef and Rice Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread, 3/4-inch thick | 4 tablespoons brandy | 4 cups hot cooked rice noodles | 1/2 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon white vinegar | 2 teaspoons wasabi powder | 1 tablespoon chives, minced
instructions: Cut bread into 3/4 slices and toast on both sides under broiler. Heat 2 tbsp brandy in a small skillet over medium heat till just slightly brown, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and allow to cool for about 1 minute. Toast noodles, shaking skillet occasionally. Add remaining ingredients. Add cooled bread slices to skillet and stir well to mix. Serve warm.

title: Baked Mussels With Basil
ingredients: 2 large fresh mussels | 2 tablespoons fresh basil sprigs | topping, thawed ( optional ) | fresh basil sprig ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f scrub shells and remove beards from mussels.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,vegetable oil,german chocolate cake mix,red cabbage,baking powder,coconut cream
title: Sweet German Chocolate Slice
ingredients: 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 2 tablespoons cream of celery soup | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup coconut cream ( or other light cream ) | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage ( or other sweet green )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Line a 1 1/2 inch slice dish with aluminium foil. In a small bowl combine the cream of celery soup and oil. In a large bowl lightly rub together. Reserve 1/3 cup of coconut cream. Sprinkle the remainder of the coconut cream around the edges of the dish if desired. Spread the reserved coconut cream over the base. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/3 cup of coconut cream and sprinkle with the baking powder. Sprinkle with the shredded cabbage. Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until the top is golden brown and crunchy. Cool for 5 minutes on the baking dish and remove from the dish.

title: Pizza Strips
ingredients: 1/3 cup corn oil | 3 serrano peppers, sliced lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 1 pizza crust, cut into 6 wedges
