instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat corn oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir one serrano pepper in hot oil until fragrant, about 1 minute. Spoon serrano pepper oil onto a sheet of aluminum foil with a long side. Holding the foil up around the pepper, fold the two edges of the foil into a tight pouch. Repeat with remaining serrano pepper slices until peppers are used up. Arrange the pizza wedges onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,chicken breast fillet,polish sausage,coffee,vodka,fontina cheese
title: Polish Smoky Beer Can Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/2 cup vodka, 100 ml ( liqueur ) | 6 chicken breast fillets | 100 g polish sausage | 1 cup refried beans | 100 g fontina's cheese, grated | 50 g bamboo shoots, sliced
instructions: Place a layer of chicken breasts on a plate, cover with a layer of sausages, followed by a layer of refried beans. Grate over the fontina's cheese and scatter over a final layer of chicken. Dot with a small amount of extra virgin olive oil and cover with a top layer of sprinkel. Chill in the fridge. Garnish with black pepper.

title: Chile Colorado II
ingredients: 1 jar roasted poblano peppers, drained and sliced | 1 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 3/4 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees f. Place peppers in a single layer in the pan. Stir roast, oyster sauce, and garlic together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Drizzle with remaining sauce. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Asian Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup chinese black pepper paste | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 1 teaspoon arrowroot
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Let stand 2 hours before using as desired.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,celery,chicken leg,double cream
title: Buffalo Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons reduced-fat monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1 package frozen reduced-fat milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup double cream | 2 cooked chicken legs, mashed | 1 stalk celery, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Position rack in lowest position in oven. Prepare idahoan or other specialty hot noodle pot using 2 quarts water. Cook uncovered over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until water is evaporated. Meanwhile, combine pepper jack cheese and ricotta cheese in processor until blended. Whip cream in medium bowl until stiff. Fold cheese mixture into cheese mixture. Slice chicken into 1/2 thick slices and place on a baking sheet, brush both sides of pieces with 1 teaspoon water. Bake 12 to 14 minutes or until instant read thermometer inserted into mixture registers 165 degrees. Top with celery and cook 5 minutes longer or until chicken is tender and juices are no longer runny.

title: Salt and Pepper Seasoning for Saltines and Scallions
ingredients: 1/2 cup rock salt | 1 bunch scallion
instructions: Combine rock salt and all ingredients in a jar and shake well or use coarse salt. Let set to get salt out of refrigerator a few hours before use. You can also rub over a slice of french bread if you like or roll out to eat immediately. You can also roll it into a cylinder with a cheese wrap covering and secure with toothpicks for easy transport when the salt from the cheese sheets has been absorbed. You can also use a meat tenderizer to slice the meat into strips and serve with toast.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,chili powder,enchilada sauce,vegan butter,beef shank,lasagna noodle,eggplant
title: Cajun Style Lasagna
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef shank or 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 eggplant, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons vegan butter | 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/2 medium yellow pepper, finely diced
instructions: Cook the ground beef in nonstick skillet over medium heat until no longer pink. Drain. Drain. Slice the eggplant in thin strips and place in a colander or cheesecloth over a bowl. Sprinkle with the chili powder. Transfer to the colander and let drain 30 minutes. Heat oven to 250°f cook lasagna noodles for about 15 minutes or until al dente. Drain and cool. While the noodles are cooking, fry the peppers in butter and stir in the drained meat and eggplant. When cooked, pour 1/2 enchilada sauce in a 8x8 inch dish and spread evenly. Top with 1/3 c meat mixture and 1/3 c noodles. Repeat with remaining meat mixture and noodles. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour. Uncover and continue to bake until bubbly and dark brown.

title: Skewered Lamb With Golden Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 2 1/2 lbs lamb, cut into large chunks | 1 tablespoon dried spice | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon grand marnier, or other dry sweetener | 3 tablespoons whiskey or 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 lb thin spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Put oil in the bottom of a 6 cup heavy saucepan, add lamb chunks, stir to coat and let stand in pan 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except for spaghetti and heat until hot, stirring frequently. Add spaghetti and continue stirring until sauce is hot, approximately 3 minutes.

title: Melting Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups of grated cheese | 1 cup golden syrup | 1 cup white vinegar
instructions: Sieve the cheese and golden syrup. Pour in the vinegar and mix until it is creamy. Pour into a well buttered pan and chill for at least two hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef shank,lipton onion soup mix,graham cracker crumb,chicken stock
title: Low Fat Shank or Chicken Gravy
ingredients: 1 package lipton onion soup mix | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef shank, cut in 1 inch cubes | 3/4 cup low-fat chicken stock | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f. In a small bowl, mix broth with soup mix. Remove about 2 cups of the soup and reserve the rest to thin the soup if desired. Arrange shank in a roasting pan and pour soup mixture over shank and bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until the meat is tender, stirring about 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven and cool completely, then refrigerate for several hours or overnight. After 1 hour, heat broth mixture until boiling. Add crumbs and simmer 5 minutes. To serve, remove and serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Creme Brulee
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup irish cream ( creamy, heavy-sour cream )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Combine half and half and irish cream together. In 2 quart casserole dish, stir bread crumbs into cream mixture until well mixed. Pour cream mixture into casserole. Bake uncovered 1 hour, or until top is puffed and browned. Serve warm or cold.

title: Easy Basil and Garlic Focaccia
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mixed basil | 4 leaves fresh basil | 1/2 cup fresh cheese ( optional ) | 5 fluid ounces chicken stock cubes or 5 fluid ounces vegetable stock | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Tear the leaves off the basil leaves and reserve. Place the basil, remaining basil, garlic and cheese into a bowl, and toss together. In a microwave safe jug place the stock and garlic powder. Microwave on high for 45 seconds, stir and leave to stand for another 2 minutes, until the cheese has melted. Pour over the basil mixture and toss. Serve warm.

title: Crock Pot Apricot Meatballs (Canned)
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1/2 lb red potatoes ( about 2 medium ) or 1/2 lb swiss potato, peeled and chopped | 1/3 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | feta cheese
instructions: Cook hamburger in a skillet with the vanilla. Drain excess fat. Stir in red wine, apricots, potatoes, peanuts, salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,beef,sharp cheddar cheese,tamari,cornmeal,chicken curry powder,buttermilk,greek oregano
title: Cheesy Beef Curry Cornbread Burger
ingredients: 24 ounces ground beef | 1 teaspoon cornmeal | 1/4 cup tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1/4 cup bourbon ( can substitute other flavors ) | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons greek oregano | 12 inches cornmeal bakes ( patties ) | 24 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Bake cornbread according to package directions.

title: Tastebead
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chicken meat | 1/3 cup greek salad dressing | 1 ounce fresh yeast | 1 ounce tomato puree
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and form into patties. Cover and let rise 15 to 30 minutes. Bake at 400 degrees farenheit for 30 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: pork,fish sauce,sesame seed,peanut butter,bibb lettuce,pesto sauce
title: Pesto Pork Salad (Gesundheitang)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 lbs ground lean pork | 1 1/2 cups roasted peanuts ( or your favourite roasted peanuts, chopped ) | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 head of bibb lettuce ( about 1 quart )
instructions: In skillet toast sesame seeds over medium heat, pressing constantly. Let cool 5 minutes to prevent burning and then grind until fine. Combine ground pork and peanuts in large bowl. Mix in pesto, fish sauce and sesame seeds. Gently mix in lettuce. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,salt pepper,cabbage,sherry wine,garam masala,chicken stock vegetable
title: Baby Blueberry and Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cabbage, finely sliced | 1 bunch fresh blueberries, sliced | 3 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | salt and pepper
instructions: Shred cabbage coarsely. Heat stock and saute cabbage in a large pan until wilted. Add remaining ingredients and simmer, covered, for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of grated fresh red chili sauce | 1 ounce icing sugar | 1 pint vegetable stock
instructions: Pour the chili sauce into a saucepan and add enough vegetable stock so that the chili sauce covers the base of the pan at least 5 7mm in size. Pour over half an ounce of chopped fresh chili.

title: Tropical Fruit Appetizer (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 500 g mascarpone cheese | 4 fresh fruit
instructions: Using a knife, cut through the mascarpone cheese to remove the larger chunks of fat. Use as a spread for fruit compote or to serve the fruit over a plate of freshly made bread to keep moist.

title: Aussie Style Burgers
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef | 1 can sweetened condensed milk of choice | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Mix all well in mixing bowl. Divide the mixture into 12 portions, shaping each part into a 6cm thick patty. Cook on heated bbq plate for 3 - 5 minutes per side, until cooked to your liking. Serve with karo chips, mixed together with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: vegetable juice,chili bean,tomato green chilies,semolina,cooking spray,espresso coffee,cream chicken soup
title: Quick Chili con Chile with espresso and semolina
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups crushed semolina | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can condensed vegetable juice | 1/4 cup instant espresso or 1/4 cup strong coffee | 2 tablespoons chili with beans | cooking spray | chopped tomato and green chilies ( optional )
instructions: Prepare 1 11/2 inch deep dish pizza pans by sprinkling with pam cooking spray. Mix crushed semolina, soup, juice, and coffee together in a bowl until blended. Spread mixture evenly over pizza crusts. Bake at 400 degrees in the bottom third of a preheated oven until crust is browned and center is hot, 15 - 20 minutes. Sprinkle chili with chilies before serving.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,olive oil cooking spray,mustard seed
title: Portabella Mushrooms-Sauteed on the Grill
ingredients: 1/2 lb mushroom, trimmed | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds ( optional )
instructions: Place the cleaned mushrooms and mustard seeds on a cutting board and top each mushroom with about 2 t of olive oil. Grill over low heat, flipping once, until the tops are lightly browned and the mushrooms are soft, about 5 minutes total. Remove onto a serving platter and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pasta,thyme sprig,tabasco sauce,italian seasoning,pizza dough,black bean,asparagus
title: Asparagus-Tear Italian Calzones
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 package refrigerated pizza dough, at room temperature | 12 ounces prepared asparagus, cut into 1-inch pieces | 18 fresh asparagus tips, trimmed, cut in half | fresh thyme sprigs | cooked black beans, for serving
instructions: Position rack in upper third of oven and preheat to 450°f. On a floured work surface, roll out pizza dough to approximately 14 inches in diameter. Using a round cake pan and a glass, trace 1 round circle on top of dough with a 3 inch star shaped cookie cutter. Using an 11'' round pastry cutter, cut out circle from dough. Place asparagus, tips cut sides up, on dough and sprinkle with italian seasoning, tabasco, and thyme. Using a 3'' round biscuit cutter, cut out circles from dough and place on top of asparagus. Spoon 1/4 cup of bean mixture into center of each circle. Fold dough over and crimp bottom edges with fingertips and crimp tops to seal. Place calzones on a baking sheet and bake for 7 minutes or until golden brown. Top with cooked black beans and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,phyllo pastry,cheddar cheese,flat leaf parsley,cider vinegar,corn syrup,yam
title: Corny Yams and Kram
ingredients: 10 yams, peeled and sliced lengthwise | 3 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine yams, 3 cups cheddar cheese, corn syrup, vinegar, italian seasoning, parsley, and remaining cheddar cheese in a large bowl. Brush pastries with water and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cheddar cheese and 1/2 cayenne pepper mix. Place pastry sheets in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake until golden, approximately 10 minutes. Remove and serve.

title: Lecso's Carbonara
ingredients: 10 slices smoked bacon, chopped | 6 -8 pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 4 egg whites | 4 ounces carbonated coconut cream | 4 -5 tablespoons amaretto | 1 -2 sprigs fresh ground pepper
instructions: Saute bacon to taste until crispy and then set aside in a bowl. Wipe out pan. Add eggs and scramble in a small amount of oil. Add cheese and continue to scramble until it starts to melt. Push eggs down carefully with a rubber spatula or spoon and scramble until no egg remains and you get firm peaks on the eggs. Add amaretto and keep stirring. Push egg whites under a paper towel until they show a nice white texture that is starting to stick to the spatula. Add grated pecorino romano to eggs and scramble until creamy. Add bacon and stir until combined and the color is a light, golden brown. Stuff the shells with this and close the outer shells. Place in a 350 degree toaster and pour some coconut cream and amaretto over them, placing a sprig of fresh ground pepper on them. Place oven on broil and bake for about 10 minutes, flipping after 5 minutes. You can be very cautious with the amaretto, the amaretto is quite strong.

title: Grilled Tuna Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tuna | 4 cups rice noodles ( i like japanese 'grain white') | 1/2 cup marinade, mix | mirin ( optional ) or plum sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix tuna with marinade and marinate 1 - 2 hours or overnight. Cook noodles according to package directions. Mix noodles with tuna mixture, place into lettuce wraps and eat.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,lime juice,almond extract,peanut butter,cayenne,black cardamom pod,turmeric
title: Thai Salad (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | black cardamom pods, cracked | 3/4 teaspoon almond extract ( or other flavor enhancer ) | 3 -4 lettuce leaves ( i used romaine )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor and blend until creamy, scraping sides as needed. Taste and adjust flavor to your liking. Serve chilled. Will keep refrigerated for 2 weeks.

title: Roasted Red Pepper With Cumin
ingredients: 2 red peppers | 2 cans italian-style tomatoes | 1 tablespoon italian spices ( see below )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Trim and seed the blackened red peppers and place them in a large pan with plenty of water to cover. Bake until the peppers are very tender and can be mashed with a potato masher, about 1½ hours depending on size. It probably doesn't take long, but you can easily take a whole can of tomatoes and mash with a mortar and pestle. Place them under the broiler and heat until the skin is a little crispy and caramelized.

title: Sage and Peppercorn Shells
ingredients: 300 g shell pasta | 75 g caster sugar | 3 tablespoons green peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried sage
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Meanwhile, place castor sugar, peppercorns and dried sage in a bowl. Add a small quantity of boiling water, stir until it dissolves then add back into the pan and cook for a few minutes to thicken. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. Add the sugar mixture and toss everything together. Serve immediately, with grated parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Chili Cornbread Toasts
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 package jiffy cornbread mix | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1/2 cup mushroom, chopped or 1/2 cup fresh mushrooms, chopped | 3/4 cup prepared horseradish ( i use my cream cheese )
instructions: Put flour in a bowl. Dissolve prepared horseradish in a little water. Dissolve cornbread mix in the horseradish water, making sure that the cornbread mix is moistened not soggy. Add to dry ingredients and stir. You may not be able to get consistent dough. Let dough rest 10 - 15 minutes then roll into 1 inch diameter. Bake at 375 for 25 minutes, remove from oven and cut into 1 inch squares. Serve on crackers.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,muenster cheese,pistachio,red enchilada sauce,white pepper,mozzarella cheese,baby spinach
title: A Mighty Fine Carbombia!
ingredients: 1 cup ice cube | 2 bags baby spinach, drained | 1/2 cup pistachios, chopped | 1/2 cup grated muenster cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1 can red enchilada sauce, mild | 1/4 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Crush the ice and pour on a plate. Add spinach, pistachios and 2/3 c of the cheeses. Mix in 1 1/4 c a box of chiles enchilada sauce with white pepper. Top with remaining cheese. In a blender or food processor pulse the remaining cheeses and spinach mixture until mixed. Pour into four glasses and serve.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,non dairy milk substitute,masa corn flour
title: Arepas
ingredients: 2 cups masa corn flour ( corn flour ) | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons non-dairy milk substitute
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together and stir in the non dairy milk until dough holds together in wet ingredients.. Divide dough into 8 pieces and roll out into a flat 10 inch circle. Slip one edge of each circle with scissors, so the folded edge will be flat at the top when you're finished rolling out the dough. Place the folded edge onto the lightly oiled baking sheet, leaving a 1 inch border around the edge. Flour your hands and wet hands and roll each side until very thin and 6 to 8 inches in diameter, or up to 3 inches in diameter of your baking sheets. Place in refrigerator, covered for 5 days to allow the excess moisture to drain out. Bake at 400°f until golden brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Peanut & Chili Dip
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 1 dash ground cardamom | 2 ounces black slices cooked bamboo shoots, chilled for 10 minutes and drained and shredded | 2 ounces green chili peppers, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons crunchy crackers, such as keebler cheezey's keebler | 1/2 fluid ounce guacamole
instructions: Heat the oil in a small pan, and add the salt, seasoning, and cardamom. Pour over the nuts, and stir until evenly coated. In a separate bowl, stir the green chilies with a pinch of salt. Dip the chilled bamboo shoots into the chilies to soften. Mix together the chili and vegetable seasoning with the crackers and guacamole. Serve the dip warm.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,chili sauce,cauliflower,salmon fillet,vegetable stock,lamb fillet,salad green
title: Asian Lamb & Cauliflower Burgers
ingredients: 500 g lamb fillet, thinly sliced | 1 lamb fillet, thinly sliced | 1 small cauliflower, chopped | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | salad greens | 125 g hamburger | sweet chili sauce
instructions: Combine lamb, cauliflower and stock in medium bowl, season. Make 1 burgers and cover with combined greens. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Heat bbq griddle and cook burgers for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking and cooked. Top with burger, drizzle with sweet chilli sauce.

title: Mexican Baked Onions
ingredients: 16 ounces spanish onions | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Wash and thinly slice the onions. Place the onions and the red pepper in a greased dish. Add the guacamole & vanilla essence.

title: Pixie's Foolproof Mango Flan
ingredients: 2 mangoes | 50 g blanched almond milk | 100 g bacon, diced | 3 tablespoons almond milk
instructions: Grate the mangoes into a medium size bowl. Add almond milk, and bacon, and mix well. Pour the almond milk mixture into the pan, and cook on high heat for 4 - 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: english muffin,catsup,shrimp,cinnamon sugar mixture,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,guacamole,chipotle powder,stock beef
title: Baked Sweet Shrimp Toast With Chipotle Peppers
ingredients: 8 soft, crisp english muffins | 1 bag shrimp ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons catsup ( chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, chipotles ) | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 1 tablespoon vinegar and sugar mixture | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle powder | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon sugar mixture, for topping
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees celcius. Place the muffins on a baking tray and place in oven till they are golden brown. While they're baking, prepare the shrimp. Peel and devein the shrimp, leaving the tails intact. Shred them into smaller pieces with your fingers. When they have cooled a little, combine all the ingredients for the dip. Put the prawns and shrimp into a large bowl and mix all the ingredients together. Divide the shrimp mixture into 8 equal parts. Put the prawns and shrimp into the bread bowls, top with the guacamole mixture and top with the chipotle peperoncinis.

title: Grilled Salmon Florentine
ingredients: 24 ounces salmon steaks | 8 ounces poblano chiles | 4 ounces smoked cheese-smoked salami | 8 ounces pepperoni | 10 ounces grape juice concentrate, low sodium | 1 -4 tablespoon minced garlic | 1/3 cup butter | 2 tablespoons buttermilk or 2 tablespoons milk
instructions: Prepare grill for direct and indirect cooking over medium heat. Remove skin, and place fish on grill. When just cooked, remove from grill and skin.

Random Ingredients: skewer,italian tomato,green apple,candy sprinkle,caper,sun tomato,corn tortilla chip
title: Spicy Sassy Baked Chips
ingredients: 12 corn tortilla chips | 1 quart cherry tomatoes | 1 green apple, peeled, cored and thinly sliced | 1 package light italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 jar pickled capers, drained | 1 jar candy sprinkles, chopped | skewer
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Arrange the chips on the baking sheet.

title: Maple Crunch Mix
ingredients: 1 container cool whip, thawed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spoon the cool whip into a medium baking dish. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of maple syrup onto the whipped topping. Sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon of maple syrup over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until the coconut is light brown, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chili,swiss cheese,marshmallow,vegan margarine,shiitake mushroom,bamboo shoot
title: Vegetarian Shiitake Mushroom Bake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegan margarine | 1 tablespoon vegan margarine | 1 package sliced shiitake mushrooms | 8 large mushroom slices ( canned and liquid drained ) | 1/3 cup light shaved swiss cheese | 1 teaspoon whole red chili ( optional ) | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushroom
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Lightly butter a 9x9 glass casserole dish. Heat 1 tbsp of the vegan margarine in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add half of the mushroom slices, reserving the liquid. Sprinkle with half of the swiss cheese, and add half the mushrooms. Sprinkle with half of the chili, then repeat the layers. End with the remaining swiss cheese and mushrooms. Dot with remaining 1 tbsp margarine. Bake for 15 minutes.

title: Puff Pastry Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 cup cream, whipped
instructions: Place sour cream in a bowl. Sift flour over sour cream, add cream and mix with your hands until dough forms into an even ball. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead until smooth and no longer sticky. Divide dough into 10 equal pieces. Roll each piece of dough into a long sausage shape and pinch off sausage into an even circle, then place over a campfire of simmering water. Cook until puffed and beginning to brown, about 3 to 5 minutes. Repeat with remaining puffs.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,masa harina,mustard powder,artichoke heart,balsamic vinegar,cherry
title: Artichoke Sabayon
ingredients: 6 -7 artichoke hearts, rinsed ( fresh is best if you can find them ) | 3 dried cherries ( fresh or canned for better flavor ) | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3/4 cup masa harina ( cornmeal is the same thing ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: In medium bowl combine masa harina, mustard powder, and vanilla.

Random Ingredients: olive,salmon steak,chicken bouillon,vegetable oil cooking spray,hoisin sauce,tomato juice
title: Chinese-Style Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks, 6 inches thick | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup tomato juice
instructions: Coat a 10 nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Spray with oil. Add salmon to skillet and brown for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Place salmon on a plate and cover to keep warm. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Mix together the hoisin sauce, hoisin sauce, bouillon, and tomato juice in a small bowl, then pour over salmon. Cover tightly and bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: radish,lettuce leaf,salmon,vanilla bean,oatmeal,egg substitute,salt black pepper,english cucumber
title: Salmon Egg Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 small english cucumber, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons oatmeal ( see ingredient note ) | 1 small hard-boiled egg, peeled, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, seeds scraped | 1/4 teaspoon salt-free-ground black pepper, divided | 6 lettuce leaves, washed | 2 teaspoons fat-free egg substitute ( optional ) | 6 large fresh smoked salmon, skinned, cut crosswise into 2 inch strips
instructions: Combine the cucumber, oatmeal, hard boiled egg, vanilla bean seeds, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon pepper in a large bowl. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Fill a large bowl with ice cubes and pour in the egg mixture. Toss to combine and chill. Line 4 large baking sheets with foil, then arrange the salmon on the foil. Spread some of the egg mixture evenly over each lettuce leaf then top with the radishes, cucumber mixture, and remaining egg. Seal and bake until eggs are set, about 8 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat until a bead of water sizzles and evaporates on contact. Add the oil to the skilled and quickly swirl to coat the pan. Add half of the salmon and cook until the salmon just begins to flake. Transfer to a cutting board and place a lettuce leaf on each. Arrange the salmon on top and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: radish,phyllo dough,ice water,ziti pasta,agave nectar,black cardamom pod
title: Spicy Baked Kishkaval (Greek Yummy Ziti)
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 3 1/2 cups ice water | 2 teaspoons agave nectar | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dry crushed radishes, to taste ( or a few cubes of dried ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh greek thyme or 2 tablespoons oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly oil a 9x13 baking dish, line the bottom with parchment paper, then set aside. Boil water and agave nectar in a large pot for approximately 10 minutes. Stir in the black cardamom and black dried radish, then simmer until heated through. Drain ziti and add to the pot. Add the thyme and mix well so that the ziti is coated in the syrup. Pour the pasta mixture into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the top with remaining dried dried radish or oregano.

title: Pizza Corn Pizza
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 2 yellow bell peppers, chopped | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Fill pie shell with corn evenly. Top with bell pepper, mixed vegetables, and crust mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until crust edges have begun to pull away from the sides, about 40 minutes.

title: Chinese 5 Steps
ingredients: 10 lbs mustard seeds | 12 anchovies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix and grind them thoroughly. Grind the seeds with hands or counter top spice grinder. Pack them in a clean and airtight jar. Place them right in the oven and bake for 2 weeks. They are ready when the tops are browned and crisp.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,vegetable broth,salt pepper,onion soup mix,marsala wine
title: Italian Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable broth ( i used low sodium ) | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix ( i use lipton ) | 1/4 cup marsala wine ( optional - optional ) | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Blend the ingredients together and put in the crockpot. Cook on high all day, or low for 4 hours.

title: Authentic Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: paneer : | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Open the can of red enchilada sauce and pour into a saucepan. Add the vodka. Stir in the can of red enchilada sauce without removing the flavoring from the outside of the pan. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat. If cooking for 1/2 an hour, turn off to keep warm. Prepare the filling by scooping enough filling into a small bowl to dip into the water and refilling the filling with your preferred fillings before proceeding with the recipe. This filling recipe makes about 5 cups filling.

title: Chilled Quinoa Burritos (Fakes)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 head lettuce
instructions: Prepare quinoa as per directions on the package. Cut or tear lettuce into medium sized pieces. Warm quinoa so it will not stick to your hands, it makes it easy to find out what you are eating, this can be done the night before and allow it to sit, it can be done the night before. Spread on a clean tea towel lined cookie sheet, or a silicon mat, and flatten out into flat pieces. You may also dust with more garam masala if desired. When the quinoa has set, it can be stored in an airtight container for up to a month. When ready to use, heat a large skillet, like a george foreman frying thermometer. Place a small plate over your quinoa and turn it over quickly. When it stops puffing, place a large scoop of quinoa into a food processor or blender jar with a pouring spout. You may use your hand to carefully pour in the oil from the pan, a tablespoon at a time, or in whatever forms around the quinoa.

title: Homemade Tangerine Noodles
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh tangerine ( or other citrus ) | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 3 lb angel hair pasta, broken into sections
instructions: Start by soaking the tangerines in hot water for at least 30 minutes, then cutting them in half lengthwise and scoop their flesh into a blender. Add the fennel, and pulse on high until the fennel is ground fine. Add the pasta and pulse until it's completely broken up into pieces. The pasta should be a little chunky and pliable. If it's too dry, add a little warmed water. Keep in mind that it will absorb the flavor of the liquid. Let the noodles sit in the refrigerator to dry out further. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt. Add 1 pound of noodles and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.

title: Couscous Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs or 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | 2 large eggs, lightly beaten | spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a nonstick skillet, fry the onion for 5 minutes. Add the chicken and fry it until just cooked through, about 4 - 5 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes, coconut extract and eggs. Spoon mixture into a buttered 3 cup or larger baking dish and bake for 15 minutes. Top with parsley or cilantro.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,green bell pepper,dill pickle,beef tenderloin,caster sugar
title: Beef Tenderloin Rollups With Pickles
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin ( trimmed of fat ) | 3 green bell peppers, trimmed and seeded | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill pickles
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c/fan 160°c/gas mark trim ends of beef.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,turnip,brie cheese,yellow onion,bread,red potato,button mushroom,celery
title: Romesco Burgers
ingredients: 2 slices bread | 150 g brie cheese, cut into 8 equal sticks | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1/2 cup diced red potatoes, peeled and left on | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 220 g button mushrooms, halved | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 large yellow onion, diced | 1 1/2 cups cooked turnips, diced
instructions: Toast bread under grill for 1 - 2 minutes or until golden brown, set aside. Combine all ingredients except cheese, mushrooms, turnips and bicarb soda in a large bowl, add salt and pepper to taste. Knead mixture for 5 minutes. Place 1 tsp of the cheese and 1 tsp of the bicarb soda in the center of each bread slice. Place 2 oz of the potato slices over the cheese, close with a toothpick and then shape into burger shapes. Place on a lined baking tray and bake at 180c until crisp on the outside, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven, brush with bicarb soda and serve hot. This makes around 8 burgers. Tip, if you don't have the bacon flavored soda, use a mixture of olive oil and vegetable oil.

title: Shochu Chocolate Fondue
ingredients: 4 ounces chocolate squares | 2 ounces sprite | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( or to taste ) | 1 ounce triple sec
instructions: Put chocolate in to a medium heat proof jug. Add remaining ingredients, and stir until melted and blended. Enjoy.

title: Japanese Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 3 teaspoons mirin ( sweet japanese rice wine ) | 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed and tied
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Sprinkle the pork tenderloins with a little of the mirin. Cook the pork for 4 minutes on each side, or until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f. Be careful not to lose the internal temperature, or your saucy grill will be dry.

title: Salmon and Cod Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 1/2 lbs cod | 1 lb fresh fish fillet | 2 ounces dark beer ( or stout ale ) | 2 ounces black vinegar or 2 ounces balsamic vinegar | 1 lb mixed cheeses ( mozzarella, provolone cheese, etc. ) | 1 lb boneless turkey or 1 lb canned beef, sliced thin | 1/4 cup sliced fresh green onion ( for topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place all ingredients except turkey in a large casserole dish. Cover the dish with foil to keep warm. Add 1/4 cup water, to the fish. Bake uncovered for 1 hour. Remove foil, top with cheese and meat and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,half cream,salmon,pasta,self raising flour,white sugar,italian bread,baby spinach
title: Salmon and Spinach Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup split lentils | 300 g smoked salmon | 200 g baby spinach, washed | 300 ml half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 100 g dried italian bread | 300 ml half-and-half cream
instructions: Line a 12 hole muffin tin with paper cases. Place the flour, lentils and salt in a large bowl and stir in the salmon. Stir in the spinach and salmon mix well. Make a well in the centre and pour in the cream and sugar. Stir to blend. Spoon the mixture into the paper cases and smooth the top. Place each muffin tin on a baking tray covered with parchment paper or baking paper and bake each muffin until risen and cooked.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,oat,golden syrup,mustard seed,chicken breast,bay leaf,pork roast,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pork Sausage & Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup quick oats | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese, plus | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped cooked boneless pork roast ( deli leaner and boneless would work too ) | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch chunks ( you can use more if you like )
instructions: To make the oats, preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine the oats, cheddar, pecorino and romano cheeses. Add the pork and spices. Add enough water to the oat mixture to just moisten it up a little. Place the rolled mixture into a baking dish and add the chicken pieces, pushing them into the mixture with a spoon. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Mushroom Jelly  - Mushrooms
ingredients: 500 g button mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pulp ( see note in introduction )
instructions: Note, pumpkin pulp can be used in any jelly recipe calling for pumpkin or other flavourings. Make the jelly as per the pack instructions. Pour the pumpkin pulp into a bowl. Add the mushrooms and stir to coat with the juice. Leave to soak in the fridge for a couple of hours or overnight. Stir and re set until it turns jelly like.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,whipping cream,fettuccine pasta,red onion,canola oil
title: Sautéed Fettuccini With Pumpkin Seeds, Dried Onions, and Cream
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 cup minced red onion | 1 cup canned pumpkin seeds | 3/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Cook fettuccini according to package directions until al dente. Drain when done. While fettuccine is still warm, heat canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Saute onions for 1 - 2 minutes. Add pumpkin seeds.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,white miso,cocoa powder,creme de cacao,romano cheese,kaffir lime leaf,bean sauce,jalapeno pepper
title: Tacos de Frijoles (Crispy Bean Dip)
ingredients: 1 can baked beans in tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 2/3 cups shredded romano cheese or 1 2/3 cups cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons white miso | 3 -4 tablespoons creme de cacao ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, minced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees with the rack in the middle. In a medium mixing bowl add the beans, taco seasoning, cheese, miso paste and lime leaves. If the mixture is too dry add water a teaspoon at a time, until the mixture reaches the consistency of a smooth chunky mayonnaise. Place mixture on a lightly sprayed baking sheet, and if it is being prepared ahead of time cut in half. When serving, you can drizzle the dip with a dash of your favorite dip, asparagus, green veggies or guacamole.

title: Nam Prik Swirl Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 red onion | ketjap manis
instructions: Cut the onion into 1/4 inch slices. Spread the onion and 1/2 teaspoon of manis onto 1 slice of bread. Fry in the ketchup until the onion slices are a pale gold brown in color.

title: Low Fat Buttermilk Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 cup diced onion | 1/2 - 3/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: Mix all together and let sit for 2 hrs then let sit on lowest setting til onions are soft. Serve with warm pita bread, crackers, etc. Enjoy.

title: Russian Black Bread for Tea-Time
ingredients: 300 g rye flour ( can use whole flours, rye or wheat if you don't mind dough ) | 2 squashes, of your choice | 1 lb ground shiitake or 1 lb dried shiitake mushroom, washed
instructions: Put shiitake or dried shiitakes/rooms into a large bowl. Add rye flour. Mix well. Put on a lightly floured surface, knead lightly. Cut into 4 squares. Put on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 15 minute. Remove from oven, brush with a little melted butter or margarine and cut each square in half. You may need to add a little more melted butter or margarine here.

Random Ingredients: red onion,dark sesame oil,garlic salt,celery seed
title: Thai Sesame Chicken Marinade
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil |  1/2 - 2 red onions, diced or 1/2-2 cup thinly sliced red onion | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour over your favorite chicken or vegetables and serve over your favorite meat.

title: Cumin Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 -2 teaspoon instant beef bouillon
instructions: Make a bouillon cube in a cup. Put it in the cup and mix well. Put the lid on and leave over night. After 3 hours taste the broth. Pour in water, beef or cayenne and enjoy the flavor as the time is the meat cooks. This is also great at lunch time with vegetables or other indian meal. If you prefer soup, you can also add a few tablespoons of yogurt if you like. If you want to make beef stock, add bouillon one more time and use 2 whole chicken breasts as a substitute.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,beef shank,onion powder,spinach,beef chuck roast,wheat bread
title: Beef Philly
ingredients: 2 pounds beef chuck roast | 4 pounds beef shanks | 3/4 cup wheat bread, cut into quarters | 1/4 cup onion powder, or to taste | 4 fresh mint leaves, torn | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Place the chuck roast, shanks, bread, onion powder, and mint into the bucket of a slow cooker. Add enough water to cover all of the roast. Cover, and cook on high until the beef is tender and falling apart, 7 to 7 1/2 hours. To serve, place some of the hot roast mixture onto a toothpick placed near the base of a bowl, and squeeze some more juice into the bowl.

Random Ingredients: sultana raisin,cilantro leaf,apricot jam,lime juice zest,vegetable,star anise,hot red chili pepper,cooking oil
title: Tropical Appam (South Africa)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sultana raisins | 1 tablespoon sweet unsulphured apricot jam | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 teaspoons ground lime juice or 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice zest | 2 -3 hot red chili peppers, sliced | 1/8 teaspoon ground star anise | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves ( plus more, to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3 medium ripe firm-ripe mixed vegetables or 3 medium assorted fresh vegetables
instructions: Soak the raisins in warm water, about 20 to 45 minutes, until soft and swollen. Drain. Combine the jam and oil, then add the lime or lime peel, chili, star anise and cilantro. Stir in the drained raisins if using. Cut the vegetables across the tops of the fruit in half or quarters if using fresh vegetable. Spoon a small spoonful of the fruit and jam mix into each slice of fruit, keeping them together at the inside edges in order to help them spread out. Cover and chill until serving time.

Random Ingredients: rose water,tomato paste,lime zest,white flour,fennel bulb
title: Fennel Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, sliced crossways | 4 tablespoons white flour | 2 tablespoons grated lime zest | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Cut fennel bulb into thin slices and put into a saucepan with about 2/3 cup water. Cook over medium high heat for 3 - 5 minutes, until softened. Lower the heat and add flour, lime rind and rose water. Stir. Simmer for 2 minutes. Pour into warm pan and stir and bring to the boil, stirring. Simmer for 1 - 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pigeon pea,asparagus spear,tzatziki,pork shoulder,corn syrup,couscous,knorr vegetable soup mix,vegetable
title: Sam's Tzatziki & Vegetable Meatballs-Slow Cooker
ingredients: 4 large asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into large pieces | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of excess fat | 2 1/2 to 3 lbs frozen mixed vegetables ( such as sweet potatoes or cauliflower florets ) | 2 cups bite sized pieces frozen tzatziki | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1 package knorr vegetable soup mix ( or equivalent packet ) | 1 1/4 cups cooked whole-milk pigeon peas
instructions: Set 2 - 4 pound chunks of pork in the bottom of the slow cooker. Place frozen vegetables atop the pork. Strip the strings from the tzatziki and combine in a bowl with the tzatziki, corn syrup, and vegetable soup mix. Pour over the vegetables. Cover crockpot and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Remove meatballs and vegetables from slow cooker. Remove string from meatballs and shred into bite sized chunks. Add back to sauce. Serve over baked, warm tortillas with pita bread and/or fresh veggies for dipping.

title: Almond Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup blanched almond | 1/4 teaspoon mustard
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a jar.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,plain yogurt,lemon juice zest,white wine,chicken stock,farfalle pasta,basil leaf,chive
title: Pasta With Yogurt and Lemon
ingredients: 32 ounces dried farfalle pasta | 2 1/4 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 4 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped | 12 corn tortillas | 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until just tender drain and rinse with cool water and drain. In a saucepan add stock, stir well. Cook over high heat. When it starts to boil, add yogurt, lemon zest and juice. Cook for about 3 minutes while still warm. Pour into bowl and stir in basil and chives. Add the cooked pasta and toss to coat. Serve and garnish with a few corn tortillas.

title: Chinese Broccoli Rabe Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and spun dry | 1/4 lb broccoli rabe, trimmed and separated | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup tahini ( may be found at middle eastern markets )
instructions: Shred the romaine lettuce and broccoli rabe.

title: Irish Potato Heads
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes | 2 cups beef stock
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into 2cm dice. Bring the beef stock to the boil in a large pan. Drop large spoonfuls of potatoes into the simmering stock, and stir gently to ensure they do not stick to base of pan. Leave the potatoes to cook slowly for 20 minutes, then put on a plate covered in tin foil to keep warm. Repeat for a further 15 minutes. Serve with cream, cream, or a green salad.

title: Faux Bagels
ingredients: 3 lbs flank steaks | 1 french baguette ( or other thin, bread ) | 6 cardamom pods
instructions: Rinse steak and pat dry. Cut baguette diagonally into 2 by 2/3 inch thick slices. Brush both sides with 1 to 2 tablespoons of your vegetable oil. Put a slice of steak on the slice of bread and cover with slices of baguette. Sprinkle cardamom pods on top of bread. Cover bread with a plate towel so it doesn't drain while baking. Heat pan or grill over low heat for 10 minutes or until it begins to smoke. Turn bread over and smoke another 10 - 15 minutes or until steak is cooked through. Let stand 3 to 5 minutes before carving.

Random Ingredients: white flour,broccoli,yellow squash,kaffir lime leaf,cornstarch,brown rice,coconut cream
title: Laotian Yellow Squash With Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 cups yellow squash, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( can substitute sweet potato or pumpkin ) | 1 cup broccoli, cut on the diagonal into small florets | 4 -6 cups cooked brown rice | 1 cup coconut cream ( can substitute light ) | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 4 -6 kaffir lime leaves, shredded | 4 teaspoons cornstarch ( or 1 tblsp. lime juice )
instructions: Cook the brown rice. Mix 1 cup of sugar with 1 tblsp of cornstarch in a small bowl and set aside. Dice the rest of the squash into 1/2 cubes and set aside. Cook the rest of the squash in a little olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until just tender. Drain well and reserve. Add 1 tsp oil to the pot while the rice cooks and stir fry the diced squash for 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from pan and stir in the sugar cornstarch, a tblsp lime leaf and a cup of coconut milk. Whisk till combined. Return vegetables to rice and add the rest of coconut milk mix well. Serve over hot rice.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,mace,wild rice,fennel seed,garlic,penne pasta,coriander seed,spinach
title: Saffron Pasta
ingredients: 12 pints washed wild rice | 4 ounces dry penne pasta | 1 pinch saffron thread | 1 pinch ground fennel seed | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 pinch ground coriander seed | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 cups minced spinach
instructions: Wash the wild rice and place it in boiling water. Cover and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain the rice.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,heavy whipping cream,chickpea,sea salt,oriental sesame oil,liquid smoke,honey
title: Quick and Easy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/3 cup peanut butter ( creamy ) | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh-squeezed sweet-and-sour cream or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 1/4 cup sea salt | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( or more, to taste )
instructions: If you like a thicker hummus, stir in 1/2 cup of the can of chickpeas with 1/3 cup of liquid from chickpeas or reserve it for another use. Stir the other 1/2 cup chickpeas with the peanut butter, cream, honey, and sesame oil in a medium bowl until well blended. Stir in salt and liquid smoke. Let stand 30 minutes before serving, in the refrigerator, stirring occasionally. Stir in the extra virgin cream as it has been refrigerated. Tip, to make the hummus spread with the chickpeas that have been drained, stir some of the chickpea and cream into the mixture. Stir in some extra virgin olive oil to give it a slightly smoother texture and add a tiny bit of the remaining 1/2 cup of chickpea liquid to thin it to your desired consistency. Tip, the sauce used to make the hummus is very different. Add a little bit of flour, if you like, along the way. Instead of flour, you can use cornstarch for a milder hummus, if necessary, although the flavor is more intense. Note, this is especially good with rice.

Random Ingredients: egg white,sage leaf,brown lentil,white bread,garam masala powder,pumpkin puree
title: Gramma's Pumpkin Lentil Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground brown lentils | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1 -2 teaspoon sage leaf, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin puree ( optional ) | 2 egg white | 2 slices white bread
instructions: Combine the lentils, 1 tsp garam masala powder, sage, and pumpkin puree in a food processor. Blend until a rough dough has formed. Mix in 1 egg white and then rest of spices, except for bread, to form an oval burger consistency if desired. Shape into 6 patties, each about 1 inch thick. Preheat a non stick griddle on medium heat. When hot, cook patties until golden brown on both sides, about 7 minutes, flipping over halfway through cooking. Place on cooked bread slices when done, and top with the remaining garam masala sauce.

title: Papaya Stuffed With Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 1 papaya | 1 slice mexican cheese ( about 1-1/4 tsp. )
instructions: Open up papaya lengthwise. Smash in a bowl, then wrap in cheese. Microwave on high for about 45 seconds or so, until melted.

title: Baked Beans With Ham and Arugula
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely diced ham,, divided | 1/2 cup finely chopped arugula | 1 packet plain biscuits | 1 can baked beans, heated and slightly warmed ( such as baked beans ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Heat a medium oven proof pan over medium heat. Spread 1 tablespoon of ham in the centre of each biscuit, place 1/2 cup of the beans and 1/2 teaspoon of the garam masala in a bowl. Place in oven and bake 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden.

title: Guacamole Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 2 large pears, peeled, quartered and thinly sliced | 1 red bell peppers, cut into thin strips | 6 chicken drumsticks, bone in | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon guacamole ( optional ) | 2 ears corn, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place pear halves on a baking sheet, not touching. Bake 25 minutes, until tender. Remove and set aside. Place peppers and drumsticks in a large serving dish. Sprinkle with 1 t. Soy sauce.

title: Taco Sauce III
ingredients: 1 jar taco sauce | 1/2 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger | 1 pinch dried oregano
instructions: Stir taco sauce with guacamole, ginger, and oregano in a bowl. Chill until flavors blend, at least 2 hours.

title: Cheese & Bacon Pie (Lift-Over)
ingredients: 14 ounces prepared pizza crust ( or your favorite ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sugar syrup ( your favourite flavour ) | 4 -5 3 -5 tablespoons chicken stock ( depending on the amount of fat you get from the meat ) | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Spread the base of the pie crust with the sugar syrup, arrange the slices of swiss cheese over the syrup and sprinkle over the shredded cheese. Bake at 375f for around 20 mins to brown.

Random Ingredients: turkey wing,taco sauce,green curry paste,pasta,duckling,quinoa,beef stock cube
title: Asian Duck and Quinoa (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ducklings, fat trimmed | 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( kecap manis recommended ) | 1/4 cup beef stock cube ( maggi recommends ) | 2 tablespoons taco sauce ( i recommend sweet'taco sauce - low fat ) | 1 package small pasta ( i recommend campanelle's ) | 1/2 cup quinoa, cooked | shredded wheat noodles or cooked spelt cheese
instructions: In a frying pan cook the ducklings in batches in medium hot oil for about 4 minutes per batch. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels. Wipe out frying pan, add remaining oil. Reduce heat to medium and add curry paste and cook, stirring frequently for 1 minute. Add ducklings, stock cube and taco sauce. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Add quinoa and stir and cook until liquid is absorbed stir in duckling/quinoa mixture and cook for 2 minutes or until quinoa is heated through. Serve warm and garnish with shredded cheese if using and/or sprays of your choice.

title: Nepalese Beet and Orange Chicken (Paeng Manar)
ingredients: 3 large beets, washed and thinly sliced | 1 large chicken | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated
instructions: Wash, peel and cut the chicken into 2 inch pieces. Heat oil in a wok until its smoke starts crackling. Add asafetida and stir fry for 2 minutes. Stir fry all the ingredients until they turn golden brown. Add the chicken. Stir fry for 1 - 2 minutes and then add the orange zest. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Moroccan Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/3 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons gingerroot, freshly grated | 2 teaspoons blackened italian seasoning | 2 carrots, sliced ( about 1/4 pound ) | 2 boxes cremini mushrooms, quartered ( about 18 - 22 ounces ) | 2 1/2 lbs okra, halved ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | sliced black figs ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine tahini, ginger and italian seasoning in a small bowl. Add cubed pork and mix well. Add carrots, mushrooms, okra and figs to pork and stir to combine. Bring pork and vegetables to a boil and simmer, covered, about 30 - 45 minutes or until meat is very tender and liquid has thickened. If liquid separates from pork pieces, transfer pork and vegetables to a bowl and skim excess fat. Cover loosely and refrigerate for a few hours, stirring vegetables every so often. Scoop pork stew into bowls and garnish with sliced figs, if desired. Serve with couscous, pita triangles or bread. Note, i had a problem once it was removed from the saucepan, because the sauce was hot and it was hot, then instead of cooking pork and veggies, i added 2 pounds of italian ham and 1lb of sliced jalapeno peppers, and used half of them for the stew. You can add your own zucchini.

Random Ingredients: cheese,lemon verbena leaf,tea,pistachio nut,taco seasoning mix,breadcrumb
title: Mexican Stuffing (Healthier Version #5)
ingredients: 12 ounces low fat breadcrumbs | 5 cups low fat cheese, divided in half ( i used a cheese mexican cheese blend ) | 8 ounces instant tea ( i used decaffeinated tea ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( i used ortega brand ) | 1/2 cup fresh lemon verbena leaves | 2/3 cup pistachio nut, crushed ( optional, i have used walnuts with other nuts as well )
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs and seasoning in processor.

title: Mashed Spicy Cashews
ingredients: 4 cups raw unsalted cashews | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup unsweetened natural greek yogurt | 1/2 cup thousand island dressing | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 tablespoon nutmeg | 1 tablespoon dried chives, chopped
instructions: Toast cashews in a 325 degree oven until lightly browned, stirring every now and then to prevent burning, about 10 minutes. Cool cashews so they can steam easier. Combine the roasted cashews with the yoghurt, chili powder, and 4 tablespoons of the dressing. Add all spices and mix to coat thoroughly. Chill the cashew mixture for 2 hours to an hour before serving. Store the cashew mixture in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 15 ounces pinto beans or 15 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 lb dry farfalle pasta
instructions: Drain the beans, reserving the liquid. Place the beans in food processor along with the reserved liquid, sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon. Pulse about 4 or 5 times or until mixture reaches the consistency of ground nuts.

title: Apple Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rainbow trout, fresh, cleaned and head removed | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 3 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup apple vinegar | 2 tablespoons sweet stuffed olives, sliced
instructions: Place the trout in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, combine the olive oil and orange zest and set aside. Brush the trout with the oil and marinade fish sauce. Remove the trout from the marinade and place skin side down over the fish. Place the olives over the top and sprinkle the top with salt and pepper and the orange zest mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate for 1 hour. Preheat the broiler. Remove the fish from the marinade, pat dry, and season with salt and pepper. Brush on the olive oil and lightly coat with orange juice. Place back under the broiler and broil for 8 to 10 minutes, brushing once or twice. Serve with the apple slices as a sauce for the fish on the side.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Rice
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 1/4 cup cake flour, seasoned with salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons pancetta, chopped | 1 cup watermelon, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 leaves iceberg lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bacon on an ovenproof skillet and cook in the preheated oven until crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove bacon from the skillet, leaving about 2 tablespoons of fat in the pan. Brush pancetta with the fat. Place pork in the pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 145 degrees f. While the pork is baking, slice the tenderloin into 1/4 inch slices. Heat 1 tablespoon of flour in a skillet over medium heat until hot. Stir in watermelon and lettuce. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Pour pork and vegetables over the salad. Cook until pork slices are heated through.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,white wine vinegar,calamari,cottage cheese,chicken wing
title: Cottage Cheese Mushroom and Crab Rolls
ingredients: 32 ounces cottage cheese, drained | 2 eggs | 1 lb fresh crab legs or 1 lb crabmeat, cooked and drained | 4 cups calamari, cooked and diced ( or other small firm white fish ) | 6 no-boil lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cook crab and marinade in a small amount of water with 1/4 cup of vinegar for 2 hours. Drain crab and set aside. Cook noodles.

title: Spiced Turkey Salad
ingredients: 1 fresh ripe pear ( or 2 tsp dried pears ) | 10 leaves romaine lettuce | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 medium granny smith apple ( or other orange )
instructions: Peel and remove the core from the pear with a vegetable peeler remove all the seeds using your hands. Slice the pear into thin wedges, and place into a bowl. Dice the apple into thin round slices, then cut into thin slices, adding a bit of the juice from the granny smith apple can to the pear.

title: Crispy Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled, cut into cubes | 1 teaspoon pickling spices | 1 tablespoon anise | 1 tablespoon salsa
instructions: Bring a pan of salted water to a boil. Add the parsnips and cover. Cook until the parsnips are tender, but still firm. Drain and leave to stand for 20 minutes. Place the remaining ingredients in a blender or food processor. Add to the parsnips and process well, adding more salsa if desired. Serve.

title: Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard
instructions: Place couscous in a medium bowl. Pour 1/2 cup water and 1 teaspoon mustard into a saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Turn off heat, cover and let sit for 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer couscous to a serving bowl. Make a well in the center and pour the dressing immediately. Toss well and serve.

title: Spicy Green Chili Pie
ingredients: 150 g frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 6 tablespoons amaretto ( almond extract or vanilla extract ) | 7 1/2 tablespoons vegemite | 500 g green chili, chopped | 150 g monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 zest of half a lemon
instructions: Thaw phyllo pastry. Combine almond extract or vanilla extract and zest in a small bowl. Thaw phyllo pastry wrapped in a tea towel if frozen. Place the defrosted pastry on a baking tray in a preheated 180 c oven for approx 5 mins. Cut a circle or two from the thawed pastry, place on baking tray lined with baking paper. Prick dough in a few places and scatter the remaining vegemite over the pastry. Cook for approx 15 minutes until golden brown on all sides. Spoon the hot sauce onto the layered pastry and scatter the chilies over. Pile grated cheese onto top. Bake for approx 10 mins or until cheese is golden and bubbling.

title: Kaffir Lime Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 4 slices provolone cheese | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives, cut into fourths
instructions: Heat a grill to high. Combine the parmesan, kaffir lime powder, olive oil and cardamom in a small bowl.

title: Pesto Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped salted shortening ( such as crisco ) | 1 jar prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Melt shortening in a 9x9x2 inch glass pan in the oven, stirring constantly. Remove pan from oven and spread pesto on top. Bake for 10 minutes, then sprinkle with more coarsely chopped shortening.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,hot sauce,cashew nut,white bread,arborio rice
title: Cashew Nut Rice Balls (Arrabbiata Siciliano)
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice, uncooked | 2 cups roasted unsalted cashew nuts, chopped | 1/4 cup olive oil | hot sauce ( optional ) | soft hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice 3 - 4 cups in lightly salted boiling water, 2 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Add nuts, remaining 2 cups water, oil, and hot sauce to the rice mixture. Toss with hands until mixed. Place rice in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 30 minutes. Roll chilled rice into small balls, and set on a baking sheet lined with wax paper. Chill, 3 - 4 hours, shaking the bowl about 5 minutes after removing from refrigerator. Wet hands a few times if rice is sticking. Lightly coat a 9x13 glass baking dish lightly with oil. Place rice balls on the waxed paper, roll up, and then set aside in the pan. Remove plastic wrap, and refrigerate until rice balls are chilled. Serve rice balls drizzled with remaining oil, with condiments of choice.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,graham cracker crumb,rotel tomato chilies,beef,mexican oregano,thyme sprig,floury potato
title: Sizzlin' Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef, cooked | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, hot, drained ( with liquid ) | 1 cup fenugreek seeds | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons floury potato flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine beef, tomatoes and next 5 ingredients. Press into a loaf pan. Sprinkle each with crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with more cracker crumbs.

title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 teaspoon grated fresh lemon rind | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup coarsely grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Mix the cheese, soup, lemon rind and cayenne together until well blended. Drop spoonfuls of the cheese mixture onto a baking sheet. Bake for 8 minutes or until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,kosher salt pepper,tarragon vinegar,sirloin,chipotle chile adobo
title: Mark's Baked Chimichurri Roast Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons kosher salt | 4 cups kosher salt | 3 lbs top sirloin, center cut ( top loin ) | 1/2 green pepper, seeded and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup tarragon vinegar
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons salt with 2 cups water in a bowl and stir to dissolve. Rub water over beef and let stand 1 hour. Drain beef and pat dry with paper towel. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle entire surface of beef lightly with 3 tablespoons salt. Starting at one end of the rind, use a very sharp knife to slice the rind lengthwise intot slanted pattern, cutting as thinly as possible. Repeat with remaining beef. Tuck beef ends into meat, then place in a single layer in two rimmed baking pans. Roast until thermometer thermometer inserted into center registers 140 degrees, about 1 hour and 15 minutes total. Remove beef from oven and place on a cutting board. Cover with foil, loosely tent with foil and let stand 5 minutes then slice between the bones. Reserve pan juices in freezer for another use. Meanwhile, combine remaining 3 tablespoons salt and chipotle in a food processor and pulse until very fine and chunky, about 5 seconds. Stir chile onion puree into chipotle puree, then add vinegar and mix well. Serve beef with spiced chipotle onion gravy. You may use canned chipotles or use fresh chiles. My note, if there is any remaining salt on the beef it is best to make this in the freezer and let it sit out at least 4 hours so it has a bit of that bite, but the flavor is as high as it can get.

title: Homemade Pepperoni Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs pepperoni, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds | 1/2 lb pepperoni | 1 package frozen peas and carrots | 5 teaspoons five-spice powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for up to 2 days.

title: Goat Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled goat cheese ( i used mild feta but you can use parmesean if desired ) | 2 teaspoons olive oil
instructions: Mix cheese together and spread onto bread stick. Bake at 350f 45 - 60 minutes. Eat while warm.

title: Red Curry Squares
ingredients: 1 cup maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( or less ) | 1 teaspoon scotch
instructions: Dice cherries into tiny pieces. I use a ziploc bag. Using a food processor, mince curry paste. Melt scotch in a small pan over medium heat. Add 1/3 cup of cherry mixture and stir. Continue stirring, then when cherry mixture begins to bubble, reduce heat and add scotch mixture. When mixture comes to a boil, reduce heat to low. Continue to stir and add cherries. Continue to stir until all ingredients are moistened. Spread into a 13 x 9 baking dish. Sprinkle with maraschino cherries. Allow to set slightly before cutting, this may make your fingers rubbery.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,red leaf lettuce,thyme,hot paprika,green pea,madras curry powder
title: Curried Green Pea Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons madras curry powder | 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2 cups fresh green peas | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme | 4 cups shredded red leaf lettuce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Combine curry powder, hot paprika, cayenne pepper, and green peas in a medium bowl. Cover and shake to mix. Divide peas among 4 salad bowls. Top with a teaspoon of curry curry mixture. Sprinkle thyme on top. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ghee,ginger,lime zest,dark chocolate,snow pea,tomato green chilies,italian bread
title: Truffoli
ingredients: 250 g fresh snow pea | 1 inch fresh ginger | 2 fresh tomatoes | 2 tablespoons ghee | 200 g dark chocolate | 2 fresh limes, zest of, grated | sliced italian bread
instructions: Trim the snow peas and blanch them in abundant water for 30 to 40 seconds or until they are soft. Drain the peas in a colander and place in a bowl. Cover with cold water and add the chopped ginger. Leave to soak for 15 minutes to soften. Drain well. Break the remaining chocolate into 4 pieces and place over a saucepan of boiling water. When the chocolate has melted, place the limes in 4 small heatproof bowls. Dip 3 of the snow peas in the chocolate, turning to coat both sides. Repeat with the remaining snow peas and ginger. Set aside to cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,chipotle pepper,tomato green chile pepper,balsamic vinegar,pecan,celery salt,russet potato
title: Mexican-Style Shredded Potatoes
ingredients: 3 small russet potatoes, scrubbed, scrubbed, and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained with liquid reserved | 1 -2 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle peppers | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Combine the potatoes, tomatoes with liquid, minced chilies, dry onion, chipotle chilies, pecans, and vinegar in a mixing bowl. Season to taste with celery salt. Cover, and refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.

title: New-N-Hell-Mounds #5FIX
ingredients: 24 ounces frozen new potatoes | 1 lb feta cheese
instructions: Defrost the potatoes in a large pot of salted water.

title: English Suet -  for the Bar Pudding!
ingredients: 1 kg suet, cut into squares and rolled into balls | 1 -2 lemon, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c grease a large baking dish. Combine suet, lemon zest and juice and grated rind. Roll into balls and bake for about 40 minutes until golden, then set to one side. Serve with assorted jam/cream and custard.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,red wine vinegar,garlic powder,salt,salsa,sherry wine
title: Salsa Jalapeno Peppers
ingredients: 6 -8 jalapeno peppers | 1 jar salsa ( i've used mild salsa a good one ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 -3 teaspoons sherry wine ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Wash peppers, cut open lengthwise and remove seeds and membrane and set aside. Rinse peppers under cold water, and remove stems and veins, and place in a bowl. Mash together to desired texture and add salsa, salt, garlic powder, and sherry and mix well. Marinate peppers at least an hour or overnight.

title: Gaspooni (Peamgled Rice and Peach Salad)
ingredients: 10 ounces cellophane noodles ( cellophane noodles ) | 1 cup glutinous rice, rinsed and drained | 2 cups canned whole peaches, cut into small chunks | 1 cup canned jalapeno pepper, halved with seeds removed | 6 tablespoons low-fat yogurt, preferably greek | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish ) | fresh pecan halves, to garnish ( to garnish )
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once it boils, stir in the rice, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 15 minutes, then fluff the rice with your hands. Leave to stand, uncovered, for about 10 minutes, to allow grain to dry out. Remove lid, reduce heat back to medium and simmer the soaked rice, covered, until the rice is tender and fluffy. Stir occasionally while the rice cooks, to make sure the rice does not stick together. Place drained peaches, jalapenos, and yogurt into a food processor. Pulse until smooth. Pour into a large bowl. Top with the cooked rice, pecans, and mint. Serve warm, at room temperature, or refrigerate to serve later.

title: Turnips & Apple Cider (Danish Turnips)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet turnip | 12 -14 peppercorns, cracked | 2 cups apple cider, chilled
instructions: Peel the turnips, wash them in cold water. Place the turnips in a large pot and cover with cold water. When water starts to bubble out of the turnips, add the cracked peppercorns and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Rinse the turnips under running water for several minutes. Drain and set aside in the fridge. When all of the water is out, place the turnips in a large, clean stainless steel or enameled glass bowl. Add the cold cider, and let set in a warm place until cider is almost dry. This will take approximately 40 - 45 minutes to 1 hour, but as the turnips cool, the more time you take off the liquid from the potatoes and the liquid. Use immediately or refrigerate for up 6 weeks.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,bay leaf,swiss chard,ancho chile powder
title: Chile Sauce
ingredients: 5 large achi chile powder | 3 lbs swiss chard | 2 tablespoons ground ancho chile powder | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Combine the chiles in a medium bowl with a cup of water. Let stand 10 minutes. In a blender, puree 1/2 chiles, the chilies and 1 cup of water until smooth. Transfer the puree to a large stockpot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in the ancho pepper powder, bay leaves and seasoning. Simmer over low heat until thickened, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,chili paste,strawberry,guacamole,dark chocolate,cucumber,green bell pepper
title: Spicy Strawberry Chocolate Salad
ingredients: 4 cups sliced strawberries | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 cucumber, chopped | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 1 tablespoon hot chili paste | 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped into pieces
instructions: Place strawberries and peppers in a large mixing bowl. Add cucumber, guacamole, hot chili paste and dark chocolate. Mix well. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: apple,yukon gold potato,cooking spray,red chili powder,rump roast,beef roast
title: Apple Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 1 lb rump roast, trimmed | 8 small yukon gold potatoes, quartered | cooking spray | cooking spray | 3 cups sliced apple
instructions: Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Season beef with salt and pepper. Place meat in skillet, brown on all sides then transfer to slow cooker and set aside. Place potatoes in slow cooker with 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder. Cover and cook on high 5 hours or until potatoes are tender, adding remaining 1/2 tablespoon chili powder during last 10 minutes of cooking. Transfer to cutting board and let rest 10 minutes. Place apples in small bowl. Cut remaining apples into thin wedges. Dice. Place apple wedges in remaining 1/2 cup chili powder.

title: Smokey veal pork sausage
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground veal | 2 lbs thin cut red potatoes ( about 1.5 lbs ) | 2 cans tomato sauce | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 1/2 table spoons maple syrup
instructions: Over high heat, dry grill grill the meats. Remove from skillet. Drain, but don't cool. Dice meat and place in crock pot and dump in tomato sauce and tomato paste, stir to mix sauce and meat well. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent burning. Add maple syrup, stir well and serve over rice.

title: Kittencal's "Best Cauliflower Chips"
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower ( about 1.5 pounds ) | 1 cup pepperjack cheese, shredded ( or as desired )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Add cauliflower and cook for 5 to 7 minutes or until tender. Drain and immediately toss to coat. Spread coated cauliflower on a large baking sheet and sprinkle with cheese. Allow to cool slightly before placing on serving dish.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,fine breadcrumb,cider vinegar,red chile pepper,purpose flour
title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup dry fine breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon minced red chile peppers | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Mix the breadcrumbs, flour, chile peppers and cider vinegar. Add enough water to make a thin paste. Coat the ground meat with the paste and brown it in a hot frying pan. This process can take 2 to 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,pepperoni,crab meat,rigatoni pasta,sriracha hot sauce,sherry wine vinegar
title: Prawn Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 lb uncooked rigatoni pasta, broken into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 lb uncooked pepperoni, cubed ( about 3 slices per slice ) | 1 small cauliflower, shredded | 1 cup leftover cooked prawns, deveined, rinsed | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the meat and the pasta in separate large bowls. To make the cocktail, combine the pepperoni, cauliflower and prawns.

title: Fajita Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup guacamole | 16 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Prep the guacamole. Place all of the ingredients in a food processor or blender and process on medium speed until smooth and thick. Refrigerate for about 5 - 10 hours for the flavors to develop.

title: Napa Style Vinaigrette Dressing (For Salted Dressing)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons oil ( for salting )
