instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,simple syrup,red capsicum,cumin seed,cherry,walnut,flat rice noodle,biscuit mix
title: Stuffed Cherry Tisanees
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked flat rice noodles | 1 cup red capsicum, chopped | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1 cup biscuit mix | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon biscuit mix, for dipping | 1 tablespoon finely chopped walnuts, for garnish | 1/4 cup simple syrup, for dipping
instructions: Mix together biscuit mix with the biscuit mix a little water into a flat disc. Fill into capsicum with noodles followed by capsicum. Sprinkle with extra nuts. Mix together topping ingredients. Dip the cherries into the topping and place onto the top of the cucumber pile. Roll up slightly and secure with toothpicks or toothpicks. Bake at 190c for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple,black cumin,almond extract,corn oil,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Apple & Black Cumin Cheese Appetizer Spread
ingredients: 1 -2 large apple, peeled, cored and finely diced | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 2/3 - 1 teaspoon corn oil | 1 -2 tablespoon finely diced raw almonds or 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients except nuts if using. Blend well. Add nuts and blend thoroughly. Adjust mixture to desired consistency. Cover and chill up to 4 hours or overnight, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,plum tomato,pico de gallo,tamari,orange zest,chicken leg
title: Grilled Chicken Legs With Pomico
ingredients: 6 skinless chicken legs | 2 1/2 tablespoons tamari or 2 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup pico de gallo, or salsa | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Place the chicken legs between 2 sheets of wax paper and lightly pound slightly with a mallet or other pounding tool. Spread each leg with 2 teaspoons of tamari. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of orange zest.

title: Homemade Beef Stock
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 1/4 inch cubes | 3 -4 quarts vegetable stock ( or 3 cups beef broth, enough to cover meat ) | fresh-chopped assorted fresh vegetable, such as as potatoes, carrots, green pea pods, and onion
instructions: Place the meat cubes into a large pot, cover with water, and add enough beef broth to cover. Bring the liquid to a boil, then turn off the heat. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, skim off any foam on the surface of the broth during the cooking. The next day, skim off any fat and discard. The next day skim the fat that will rise to the top, then set up a large pot of well salted tap water on your stovetop. Turn on the tap water, and slowly bring it to a boil. Cover, and cook over medium heat for about 2 hours. Skim fat occasionally during the cooking. Remove the beef cubes, and cool to room temperature. Cover, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, skim and discard any fat that rises to the top, then return the meat and any accumulated liquid to the pot. Cover, and increase the heat. When the pot becomes very hot, and the broth is hot but not boiling, lower the heat to medium low, and simmer about 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until meat is very tender. The stock is ready if you remove some of the fat with a slotted spoon. Strain stock through a sieve into a saucepan, and reheat in a low oven for about 15 minutes. Serve with vegetables.

title: Brandy Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 1 1/2 cups brandy | 1/2 cup sweet paprika
instructions: Grind or grind cumin in spice grinder. Place ground spices in small jar, add brandy. Close lid tightly and shake until well blended. This may take a few hours to blend but is good refrigerate covered at least 3 weeks before using.

Random Ingredients: pineapple preserve,spanish onion,chili oil,red chilies,lemon peel,poblano chile,whipping cream
title: Mexican Pineapple Poppers
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 1/3 cup pignolano chile | 1/3 cup fresh pineapple preserves | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon peel, finely shredded | 1/4 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon spanish onion, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat broiler. In small skillet over medium heat heat, cook poblano chile in hot oil just until softened but not blackened, about 3 - 4 minutes. Drain. Coarsley chop chiles and set aside. Puree poblano and pignolano in blender or food processor. Stir into poblano mixture along with preserves and cream and heat to blend. Stir in lemon peel and chili oil. Spoon into 10 greased or paper lined jelly roll pans. Bake in 375f degrees oven until hot and beginning to turn golden on top, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with onions. Cool 5 minutes. Spoon over pork toasts. Serve with salsa.

title: Guatemalan-Style Chicken, Eggplant and Chickpea Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin | 4 tablespoons guajillo chiles or 4 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers, julienned | 4 pita breads, flat | 1 medium eggplant, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 -3 tablespoons canned chick-peas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Cut tenderloin crosswise into ¼ inch wide strips. Sprinkle with salt. Let sit about 20 minutes. Remove tenderloin from refrigerator and let stand at room temperature 15 minutes to dry fat. Combine chiles with 1/4 cup water and soak until softened, about 30 minutes. Drain chiles and liquid through cheesecloth. Process chile mixture in blender or food processor until smooth. Preheat grill or broiler. Thread eggplant on metal skewers and grill about 10 minutes each side, turning occasionally, until lightly charred outside but tender inside and tender inside. Slice flesh into thin strips about 3/4x1½ inches. Cut pita pockets in half. Place 1 slice each of meat and veggies on skewer. Spoon a 1 tablespoon bean mixture on top of each sandwich. Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

title: Roasted Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 portabella mushroom | 1 tablespoon minced chipotle pepper, or as desired
instructions: Preheat the oven to broil. Wearing rubber gloves, rub one side of the mushroom caps with chipotle pepper until thoroughly coated with the chipotle pepper. Place mushrooms on a baking sheet, and broil until golden brown and softened, about 5 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white italian bread,tomato puree,kumara,tahini,tabasco sauce,sun tomato oil
title: Kumara (Roasted Tomato Soup)
ingredients: 2 lbs kumara | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 10 ounces tomato puree ( crushed canned tomatoes ) | 12 slices white italian bread
instructions: Wash and prick kumara with a fork several times. Place in a roasting pan, cover with water and salt. Bring to a boil and cook until tender. Drain, discarding any excess liquid. Set aside. In a food processor, blend tahini, tabasco and sun dried tomato oil until it becomes light and fluffy. Add crushed tomatoes, kumara and puree. Add bread, stir to mix. Heat on medium low until bread is hot and soup is heated through. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.

title: Potato and Cucumber Rounds
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, trimmed, finely diced ( about 8 oz ) | 1 large red potato, trimmed, finely diced | 1 tablespoon plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 f, 190 c or gas mark. Place diced potato in a bowl and cover with boiling water, toss until just tender, about 5 minutes drain. Combine potato, cucumber and flour and season generously with salt and pepper. Stir until well combined. Spoon into small individual heatproof serving bowls and then fill with potato mixture. Bake 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Spiced Cucumber Yogurt
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber, peeled | 2 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest
instructions: Remove excess moisture from cucumber. Using a vegetable peeler, shave off the peel 1/2 inch piece of peel from the cucumber. Place 1 cup water, drained cucumber in a large bowl and mash with a fork until the liquid runs off. Stir in the orange zest. Cover and refrigerate yogurt for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Easy Mexican Quinoa - Zwt 3
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 60 g margarine | 1 lime, juice and zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c, 400°f. Rinse quinoa under warm water until water is clear. Place quinoa in a medium saucepan, stir in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Place over low heat on a flat surface and cook, covered, for about 25 - 30 minutes or until quinoa is tender. Meanwhile, melt the margarine in a small pan over a medium heat. Add the lime zest and juice and stir until the zest has dissolved. Remove the quinoa from heat and allow to cool, stir once or twice. Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate until cold up to 2 hours. Serve alongside salsa, fresh fruit or rice.

title: Jamaican Steaming Stone  (Oma)
ingredients: cracked ice | 1 -2 scotch bonnet pepper | herbs, mixed, such as sorrel, thyme and basil
instructions: First make the ice. Place it in a metal or ceramic bowl about 8 inches across so that the ice covers it all evenly, but is not touching or breaking up. Using a sharp paring knife, make it look pretty. Rinse the ice lightly with warm water, then pour a tiny piece of the chilled ice into a round hole in the center of the ice. Scatter the scotch bonnet pepper over the ice, scatter on some herbs if using, then cut in half and then cut through the half cross. Scatter on some herbs again, and dig in.

title: Mashed Galangal and Purple Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs purple potatoes | 1/2 bunch fresh corn | 3 large oranges, washed, skin and all | 3 tablespoons maggi seasoning, spice mix | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon ground black grapes | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook gently until potatoes are tender. Serve warm.

title: Ginger and Beer Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cut lengthwise in half | 1 cup sliced yellow onion | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 lbs frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 can light beer, if desired, can be used. ( guinness )
instructions: Cut onions in half and then in half crosswise to make 2 1/2 inch sections. Cut potatoes into 3/4 inch slices. In a large pot, add potatoes, onions and ginger garlic paste and bring to a boil, skimming foam from top as it rises to the surface. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and remove from heat. Let stew slowly thicken to desired consistency.

title: Nettle Stock
ingredients: 32 fluid ounces chicken stock | dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Pour the chicken stock through a fine strainer into a pot and bring to a boil, stirring briskly to make a liquid. Boil for 10 minutes. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, skimming any scum that rises to the surface and discarding the solids. Allow the stock to cool at room temperature to room temperature. Remove the peanuts from the strainer and coarsely crush coarsely, using the back of a spoon. Return the peanuts to the hot stock and simmer for 10 minutes or until the liquid has reduced and the color deepens up. Strain the stock through a fine wire strainer, discarding solids and peanuts. Serve in warm mugs with warm garlic fried shallots for dipping. Also wonderful as a sauce for pasta.

title: Cafe Potatoes French Cut Breakfast With Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 6 cups egg, well beaten | 3 tablespoons coffee | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 12 small russet potatoes, boiled, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 8 small free range egg creams or 8 simple egg noodles
instructions: First, place a large skillet on medium heat and place a rack in the pan. Add the 4 lamb shanks to the hot pan. Sprinkle the lamb shanks with salt and pepper and cook to desired doneness. Add the egg to the skillet. Place the 2 cups of the well beaten egg and worcestershire sauce in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth. Slowly pour in the hot coffee to thin it out to the desired consistency. Slice the shank into 1 inch pieces. Add the sliced shank and potatoes to the skillet and coat well with the egg mixture. Add sliced egg to the skillet. Top with a dollop of egg creme and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,bamboo shoot,cornflour,milk chocolate chip
title: Mock Chocolate Mousse With Corn Tortilla Strips
ingredients: 4 ounces low-fat milk chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 cup mini chocolate chip
instructions: In a bowl, add all ingredients. Cover and chill for at least 8 hours before serving. Serve with corn tortilla strips.

title: Mexican Puffs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 8 ounces puff pastry, defrosted overnight | 1 1/4 cups sliced ham | 1/3 cup salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spray 15 muffin tin with non stick spray. In small bowl, mix vinegar with 1/2 cup water.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,lemon juice zest,szechwan pepper,hamburger,orange bell pepper,golden raisin,basil sprig,tomato onion garlic
title: Gulash With Tomato and Peppers
ingredients: 4 slices lean hamburger | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon szechwan pepper, crushed | 1 1/2 cups canned stewed tomatoes with onion and garlic, undrained | 1/2 medium orange bell pepper, cut into strips | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 8 fresh basil sprigs, for garnish
instructions: In a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat, cook the burger, breaking up the beef, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Transfer the burger to a work surface. Place the burger, cardamom, sichuan pepper and tomatoes in the skillet, discarding the vegetables. Add the orange and bell peppers, cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the raisins. Remove from the heat. Spoon the tomato mixture into individual serving bowls, filling each with about 3 tablespoons of the reserved burger mixture. Serve at once, garnishing with a basil sprig.

title: Spiced Pear French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 pear, small, thin, cubed and cut in half
instructions: Heat olive oil in medium skillet, brown 1/2 yellow pepper until browned. Mix in cubed pear. Let sit at room temperature for about 5 minutes. Heat grill on high. Serve french bread slices with remaining sauce. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Woodruff Preserves
ingredients: 14 ounces red wine | 14 ounces white wine vinegar | 1 lemon peel, minced
instructions: In a small saucepan add all the ingredients and bring to boil, cover and turn off the heat. Cool. The acid will help bind the preserve. To clean preserved lemons, wash them under running water. Lift the lemons from the water and take a tiny bit of the flesh out to use as a guide in your recipe. Put a little bit of the pulp back in to help remove the pulp. This should take about two minutes or less. Add this to the jar, seal and store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,thyme leaf,italian parsley,black eyed pea,ginger,lettuce
title: Black Eyed Peas With Garlic, Fresh Herb and Ginger-Lickly Herbs
ingredients: 1 cup dried black-eyed peas | 3 1/2 cups lettuce, chopped and packed | 3 -4 teaspoons vegetable shortening, softened ( i use 1 ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh fresh herb and ginger ( i use 1/4 and 1/2 ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves ( or 2 teaspoons dried )

title: Aussie Mashed Potato

instructions: Preheat oven to 300ºc. Cook prawns, vegetables and pineapple mixture together on a large oven tray for 8 minutes.

title: Blueberry and Horseradish Hummus

instructions: In a food processor, pulse the water chestnuts, horseradish, milk, cumin and cayenne until thoroughly combined. Add the blueberries and pulse until evenly blended. Transfer to a shallow serving dish and refrigerate overnight or until serving.

title: Corn Dump
ingredients: 2 cans creamed corn | 1 cup buttermilk | 5 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon dashi | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 plum tomato, sliced
instructions: Drain the corn from the can. Add all the rest of the ingredients in a food processor along with any other seasoning. Process until a smooth sauce is obtained. Divide into four equal portions. To serve, scoop into bowls and sprinkle with chopped fresh tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,blueberry,pine nut,pistachio,egg yolk,mustard seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese,russet potato
title: Pistachio-Blueberry Potato Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1 1/2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2/3 cup grated romano or parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano-romano cheese | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 3 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, toss together pine nuts and 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano reggiano cheese. Set a kitchen towel around your work surface and line it with another kitchen towel. Place the potato onto the towel and pat dry with the towels. Place the rest of the parmigiano reggiano cheese, romano cheese, and mustard seeds in a blender or food processor, and process mixture until smooth. Add the egg yolks and enough water to form a smooth, slightly sticky dough. If the dough is too wet, add a little water. Form the mixture into golf ball size cakes. Place onto a floured surface, cover, and set aside. In a small dry skillet, toast pistachios, about 3 minutes per side. Dip the cakes into a bowl of lightly grease the pan, then spread the pistachios onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for about 7 minutes, or until golden.

title: Won Ton
ingredients: 225 g basmati rice or 225 g jasmine rice | 25 wonton wrappers | 1 cup plum tomato, chopped | 100 g puff pastry
instructions: Start by soaking your rice with cold water. Rinse the rice and place in a saucepan with enough hot water to cover a little. Cook until tender. Drain well and refrigerate. On a floured surface take a square of puff pastry and cut into 5 rounds. Using a 2cm round cutter cut the puff pastry into 4 to 6cm squares. Using the edge of a spoon, press a round into the middle of the circle. Cover the round with some rice, spread another 1/4 of the pastry with tomatoe and scatter a teaspoon of plum tomato over it. Place four wontons on top, pressing the edges firmly with your thumb and index finger. Repeat with the remaining pastry, tomatoes and wontons. Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pastry. Lightly grease a large oven tray and leave to cook the won tons. After 15 minutes place the wontons on the tray and bake for 10 minutes or until golden, then cut while warm into slices.

title: Wild Rice Crumble
ingredients: 1 bag wild rice | 1 can pearl barley, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the rice and barley in a bowl, mix well with a fork. Stir in water or milk as needed to form a moist dough. On a floured surface, roll the mixture into a rough circle about 1/8 inch thick and cut into 4 or 5 wedges. Spray a 12x18 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the wedge of dough on top, place in a hot oven and bake about 7 minutes or until crust is lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Cilantro Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cilantro, divided | 3 -6 tablespoons italian spices | 3 1/2 ounces dry-roasted vanilla beans, whole ( about 3 1/2 oz. cans ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground mustard powder
instructions: Finely chop cilantro, measure it and measure out about 3 tablespoons. Stir cilantro into other ingredients in blender or food processor fitted with steel blade. Heat and stir over medium heat, until it begins to steam. It should begin to bubble, but should take about 15 seconds on high. It will bubble and spit and turn dark, like that. Pour into sterilized jar, cover, and let mellow for several weeks, shaking periodically to remove any signs of anything that might have settled in the bottom of the jar. It can also be stored in glass jars in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,barbeque sauce,grenadine,tomato paste,mung bean sprout,artificial sweetener,pie shell
title: Sweet & Savory Vegetarian Stove Top Pie
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell | 1/2 cup frozen mung bean sprouts | 0.5 can low-sodium vegetable broth | 4 teaspoons tomato paste | 2 drops grenadine | 2 teaspoons artificial sweetener | 3 drops barbeque sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread bean sprouts out on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until just soft, about 45 minutes. Mash sprouts with back of spoon and set aside. Drain off any excess liquid. Stir vegetable broth, tomato paste, splenda, artificial sweetener, and barbeque sauce together in a saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly until simmering, 3 to 5 minutes. Pour vegetables into pie crust, and sprinkle with bean sprouts. Sprinkle with additional sweetener if desired.

title: Nuclear Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups water chestnuts, finely chopped | 1/2 cup romano cheese, grated | 1 packet guar gum
instructions: In bowl, stir together water chestnuts, romano cheese and guar gum until mixture starts forming lumpy strands. Transfer to large bowl. Cover, and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours.

title: The Best Vinaigrette for Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves
instructions: In a screw top jar, combine the vinegar and parsley leaves. Shake vigorously and store in the refrigerator.

title: Pinchos Moruno
ingredients: 4 -5 ounces pork loin, cut into small cubes | 14 slices pepperoni | 1/8 cup palm sugar, or to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly blend the pork cubes with pepperoni and palm sugar. Chill in the fridge for 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Sesame Seed Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 2/3 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 2 tablespoons italian-style seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: In a dry skillet over low heat, toast the sesame seeds until fragrant and just beginning to brown, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and let cool. Place the toasted sesame seeds in a small bowl, and add the italian style seasoning, oregano and cooled sesame seeds. Mix well to combine. Allow the seasonings to mellow. Store in a dry, cool place for up to 6 weeks.

title: Baked Rigatoni & Oregano
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rigatoni pasta, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Put rigatoni in a large casserole dish. Add chopped oregano. Cook in preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until pasta is slightly browned.

title: Poblano and Leek With Green Chile
ingredients: 4 poblano peppers | 2 ounces leeks, cleaned
instructions: Roast poblano peppers at 450 degrees f. Until skins blister, which should take about 10 minutes. Immediately put peppers in a plastic bag and cool. Skin and mince the chilies. Skin and devein the leeks. When peppers are cool enough to handle, remove the white membrane and membrane, but do not peel. If you are using the chilies, carefully remove most of the seeds and membrane. Place the peppers in a medium bowl and add 1/4 cup of water, and let sit for 10 minutes. Cut the peppers in half. Scoop the pulp of the peppers and leeks into a blender. You should have 4 cups. Add the chilies, leeks and pulp to blender, and pulse 2 or 3 times, scraping down the sides of the bowl as necessary. The paste should be coarse and very thick. This can be done up to 3 hours ahead. If you plan on storing the paste in the freezer, place your paste in tightly closed plastic containers and put in a warm, dark place to allow the flavors to meld. Note, to remove the skin, remove the entire shell from the peppers. Slit the tops of them and use a knife or melon baller to remove the seeds and membrane. They will expand on standing. These will be difficult to remove once they have cooled. These will keep for up to 3 months in the fridge.

title: Pepper Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dry rice noodles | 1/2 cubanelle pepper | 1 cup rice flavored bread crumbs | 1/2 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Prepare rice noodles as directed on package. Drain. Meanwhile, slice pepper into strips. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and add bread crumbs, pepper, and rice noodle soup mix. Cook over medium high heat until crumbs are golden brown, stir gently until well blended and serve.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,coffee granule,icing sugar,kale,yukon gold potato,raspberry jam
title: Cafe Rio Creme De Leche Potato Salad #5FIX
ingredients: 2 bunches kale, washed stemmed | 1 medium yukon gold potato, peeled and sliced into 6 wedges | 12 ounces of your favorite coffee granules | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 3 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1 cup icing sugar
instructions: Mix all the above together in a bowl and set aside. To prepare, heat a large saucepan on low heat on your stove top. You will see the bottom. Add the coffee and simmer until the foam begins to subside. Add 3 tablespoons of fish sauce and stir. As soon as it begins to bubble and simmer, pour the entire contents into the bowl and stir again. Remove from heat and add the icing sugar stirring until dissolved. Pour into serving bowls and top with raspberry or strawberry jam. Serve immediately.

title: Pear Katsu
ingredients: 2 pears - peeled, cored, and finely diced | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 3/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon dried mint ( optional )
instructions: Stir together the pears, bread crumbs, cayenne pepper, and mint in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: oregano,lime juice zest,stout beer,lime wedge,purpose dinner crepe batter,saffron strand,wheat bread crumb,sesame seed
title: Lime Sesame Beer Breaded Crepes
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose dinner crepes batter ( see ingredient note ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice, fresh-squeezed | zest from 1 large lemon | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano ( or to taste ) | 1 pinch saffron strand ( optional ) | 1 can crushed cocktail tomatoes with their juice | 1 1/2 ounces dry whole wheat bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Note, recipezaar recommends spraying a 10 inch nonstick skillet with nonstick spray. Prepare baking sheet in hot oven, set aside. If you use an 8x8 inch baking dish, spray with nonstick spray and set aside. In medium bowl wisk together the lime zest, lime juice, oregano and saffron. Set aside. In a large bowl stir together the crushed tomatoes with their juice, bread crumbs and sesame seeds until thoroughly mixed then pour the beer mixture over the mixture. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Spoon evenly into the prepared baking dish. Bake 45 minutes, stirring a few times and checking for doneness. Remove from oven, immediately, and allow to cool slightly before cutting with a serrated knife. Serve warm with toppings. Prepare a 12 minute ahead, store any leftover crepes in the refrigerator or freezer. Bake uncovered on a hot baking sheet in a preheated 400 degree oven for 15 - 20 minutes until lightly browned and crisp, turning after 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,spring onion,yellow bell pepper,hash brown,lasagna noodle,dill weed,lentil,yeast
title: Mediterranean Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups frozen mixed lentils, thawed | 1 1/2 cups chopped yellow bell peppers | 1 -2 tablespoon dried dill weed | 2 packages frozen hash browns ( about 36 pieces, such as vigo or skor ) | 1 package dry yeast | 1 -2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 3 cups uncooked lasagna noodles, cooked | 3 tablespoons chopped spring onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Place lentils and remaining ingredients in the bowl of a 3 qt casserole. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and stir well. Cover and let set for 10 minutes. Remove casserole from the oven and allow to cool to room temperature. Place the frozen hash browns into a large ziploc bag, and pour 1 or 2 cups of melted hot melted butter over them. Seal and shake to mix. Lay out the lasagna noodles in the bottom of a large baking dish. Cover with more noodles and repeat with the other ingredients. Cover dish and allow to rise, about 45 minutes. Meanwhile in a small bowl, dissolve yeast in about 1/2 cup boiling water. Let stand until bubbly, about 10 minutes. With a spoon, stir yeast mixture into remaining warm lentils and lentils. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 50 - 60 minutes. Turn down to 325ºf and bake for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven and stir in chopped spring onions. Let cool until warm.

title: Real Mexican Recipes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups queso fresco, crumbled | 1/2 cup yogurt
instructions: Mix all ingredients in an attractive bowl. Serve at once, with tortilla chips. Makes 3 - 4 servings.

title: Cherry Tomato Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa | 5 -7 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 -6 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Drain all the liquid out of the jars. In a large bowl combine the cocoa and vinegar. Add the cherry tomatoes and stir well. Put in the fridge for 3 - 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months. Makes 4 1/2 cups.

title: Perfect Boiled Cod - Boiled Cod
ingredients: 1 whole salt cod fish | 5 -7 -8 tablespoons unsalted butter
instructions: Wash the cod under cold, running water, and set the fish in a large bowl. Cover with cold, running water, and let stand 12 hours, changing the cold water 2 - 3 times. Change the water every hour or so. Drain the fish, and place in a large saucepan with salted cold water to cover. Bring to boil over high heat.

title: Cheese-Kolaches With Olives
ingredients: 2 cups smoked gouda cheese, diced | 2 fresh kalamata olives, chopped | 2 teaspoons garlic granules | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dry white wine | 2 -3 green cardamoms
instructions: In a large skillet combine the cheese, olives and garlic granules and mix well. When the cheese comes to be creamy drizzle the wine on top and stir. When bubbly serve with crackers or as a side with a salad.

title: Scallops on Tomato-Gingerbread Croutons
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1 lb sea scallops | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( lemon, orange or cider may be substituted ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Lay out four bread slices. Set aside in a large skillet and slice the slices into 1 inch thick rounds. Cut the scallops in half lengthwise and cut crosswise into half again, lengthwise into halves, then crosswise again into halves. Repeat the above with the ginger root, vinegar and cardamom powder. Place the bread rounds on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated 400º oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden. Allow to rest for a few minutes then carefully place the toast in a serving dish & serve while warm. To serve, spread the scallops on a serving plate & place warm toast rounds on top or place the toast on an individual serving plate. Remove any scallops from the bread and serve immediately.

title: Sausage, Raspberry and Green Chile Bread Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons yeast | 10 ounces mixed dried fruit & sausages or 10 ounces fresh sausage, and the other fresh vegetables, chopped | 1 -2 green chili pepper, chopped | 4 ounces raspberries or 4 ounces fresh strawberries, chopped | 1 loaf whole wheat bread, baked and sliced
instructions: Mix the yeast with a little warm water and set aside until frothy. Add the sausages and mixed vegetables to the cooled yeast and mix well. Spoon into a greased loaf tin. Cover, leave in a warm place until the rolls double in bulk. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with a little chopped rinds.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,egg noodle,yukon gold potato,black rice,watercress,chilies
title: Asian Style Potato Rice Bowl - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 large yukon gold potatoes | 8 cups watercress | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 6 chilies, roasted | 5 ounces egg noodles, uncooked | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Boil water in a 6 quart crock pot until potatoes are tender. Drain water. Grate potatoes directly into crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or on high for 3 - 4 hours. Remove chiles. Allow to cool for about 15 minutes. Chop chiles into small chunks. Combine 1/4 cup of chile chunks with 1/3 cup of watercress in a bowl. Add the 1/4 cup of sugar, 3 tablespoons of roasted roasted chiles and 1/2 cup of watercress. Pour over rice mixture. Add noodles and 1/2 cup of sugar.

title: Quinoa Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 -2 lb chicken breast, cut in strips | 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup dried apricot, cut into halves ( i sometimes use small fresh apricots )
instructions: Soak the quinoa in water for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the cornstarch and 3 tablespoons of water and stir in the quinoa. Add chicken and apricots and toss to coat. Arrange in a 9x13 baking dish. Bake and stir 10 minutes or until done.

title: Irish Coffee Sandwich - Bread Machine
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 4 teaspoons instant coffee powder ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in bread machine except bread and coffee, and select basic bread setting, such as white or whole wheat. Remove bread when bread turns out onto a cutting board or into a cutting board.

title: Apple Puffs (For the Hot dog Xmas)
ingredients: 12 cups tart apples, peeled, washed and chopped | 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter, smooth or jiffy natural | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Prick apples several times with a fork, then set them out on a plate covered with foil while you prepare the rest of the recipe. Mash the apples with a fork. Stir in the peanut butter along with the liquid smoke. Store and store in the refrigerator for up to one week.

title: Crispy Pancetta
ingredients: 1 package pancetta | catsup ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, fry pancetta until crisp. Remove pancetta from skillet and drain on paper towel. Spread catsup onto pancetta. Roll pancetta up and eat.

title: Aubergine Slice
ingredients: 1/2 aubergine | 250 g cabbage | 2 red chilies | 12 beef tenderloins, minced | 4 egg yolks | 4 tablespoons bicarbonate of soda | 2 cups cooked pasta
instructions: Finely dice the aubergine, cabbage and chillies and place in the freezer for 5 minutes until soft. Place the beef in a bowl, add the salt and pepper and mince finely. Stir in the egg yolks and bicarb soda until well mixed. Add in the pasta and mix. Spread the mixture into a slice tin and freeze once frozen. Allow to dry slightly before slicing.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,turmeric,cottage cheese,chicken stock cube,brown sugar,beef consomme
title: Cottage Cheese Tikkies
ingredients: 1 can beef consomme | 1 beef stock cube, crushed | 1 can condensed chicken stock cubes | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Place all ingredients, except the ground turmeric in a heavy based pan. Cover tightly and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, and simmer for 50 minutes, until thickened. Serve in bowls and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chinese egg noodle,half,italian cheese,saffron thread,green chili pepper,hungarian paprika,fine breadcrumb,serrano pepper
title: Saffron Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 package thin chinese egg noodles | 3 cups half-and-half, divided | 1 -2 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumb | 3/4 cup sweet hungarian paprika, divided | 8 ounces serrano peppers, finely chopped ( about 3-1/2 cups of a small green pepper packed roasted type ) | 4 1/2 ounces mild green chili peppers, finely chopped | 6 large dried hot italian cheese sticks, 1-inch by 2-inch, finely chopped | 1 large pinch saffron thread, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400º. Place noodles in a large pot of well salted, boiling water and bring to a boil. Stir occasionally until the noodles are just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and set the noodles aside. While the noodles are boiling, in a small bowl, combine the half and half, 2 tablespoons of the paprika, 1 tablespoon of the garlic and 1 teaspoon each of salt and pepper. Spoon the noodles onto a large baking sheet which has been sprayed with cooking spray. Pour the 1/4 cup of the half and half mixture on the noodles. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of paprika. Mix well. Spread the bread crumbs evenly over the top of the noodles. Place 1/2 cup of the green peppers on the bread crumbs, 1 tablespoon of the chilies and 1/4 cup of the chili peppers. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of chilies and 1/4 cup of the cheese. Sprinkle the crumbled saffron over the top of everything. Bake, uncovered, for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring 2 - 3 times, until the cheese is slightly browned and bubbly. Cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Grilled Halibut with Mexi-Cream Cheese Relish #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-fat cream cheese | 1/2 cup diced ripe olives | 1/2 cup chopped pimento stuffed olive | 2 teaspoons chopped pickled serrano chilies | 1 cup chopped cauliflower | 6 ounces halibut steaks
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese, olives, chilies, and cauliflower.

title: Okra and Okra Snack Snack Packets
ingredients: 1 lb raspberries | 6 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons chopped white onions | 3 packages goya tennis biscuits | 4 -7 cups frozen okra | 1 package graham crackers, grated | 1 bunch fresh parsley, chopped | dill sprigs, optional
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Spread the mix evenly onto a piece of parchment paper, and spread out until it is 1/4 inch thick or more. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes, until crust is brown.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,celery,half,mandarin orange,italian salad dressing mix
title: Italian Pine Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges, in the juice, drained. | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup half-and-half ( use 2 tbsp less if you wish ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts ( optional ) | 1 stalk celery, chopped fine ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill, serve over hot dogs or as an extra on a bagels bun.

title: Moroccan Chicken-And-Vegetable Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 8 cornish hens | 2 slices baguette, toasted | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek ( or sub other hot sauces ) | 1/4 cup ranch dressing
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the sherry, amaretto and turmeric. Arrange the hens in a baking pan in a single layer. Brush with the sherry mixture. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 45 minutes or until done. While the chicken is baking, toast the baguette slices. To serve, spread a thin layer of the sesame ranch dressing on each slice of bread. Place one hens on top and top with the baguette slices. Serve the chicken and sauce on the side.

title: Smoked Fruit Sandwiches in Ramekins (Pate Yummo)
ingredients: 250 g light dark rum | 10 g rosemary, sprigs | 25 g fresh pineapple, cut into 12 slices | 20 g fresh rye bread, cut into 12 sandwich slices | 1/4 teaspoon arrowroot | 2 ice
instructions: Heat up the rum, rosemary and pineapple on a gas grill, or on the bbq grill. When simmering, lightly toast the rye bread and spread with the arrowroot. Divide the sandwich among the toasted sandwich rolls and drizzle with half the rum. If using the bbq option on the grill, or in a small baking dish lined with foil, bake the sandwich until the rolls are lightly browned and crisp.

title: Danish Sausages
ingredients: 5 lbs polish sausage | 1 package sliced black olives | 6 cups red pepper flakes
instructions: Cut your polish sausage into 1 cubes and put into a large pot. Cover your sausage with enough water to about two inches above the salt level. Bring to a boil. Turn heat down to med/low and put a lid on the pot, it will steam as it cooks. Cook the sausage for about 8 hours, skimming the water as needed. If it becomes dry and starts to burn, remove the lid for about a half hour. When sausage is cold, take off the heat and cut off any extra fat. Slice the sausage into 1 1/2 pieces. Add olives to sausage drippings. Add pepper flakes. Let simmer for about 15 minutes.

title: Fish & Asparagus Crispy (Fyi)
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder. | 1/4 teaspoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon fresh tomato juice | 1 lb tilapia fillet | 1 pastry dough
instructions: Put the fish, cornflour, tomato juice, asafoetida and asafoetida into a food processor and process. It should have smallish chunks about 10 minutes. Heat oven to 400f degrees. Put the tilapia in a large baking pan, spread it with tin foil and bake for 10mins. It should be just starting to be crispy in the center. Put the fish onto a baking sheet and cover with a tin foil. Bake for 10mins or till the fish flakes easily. Take out and put to one side. Take the tin foil off, leave it on the fish to cool slightly before you make the crispy topping. Sauce.

title: Mexican Bread Snack Bread
ingredients: 4 loaves raisin bread or 4 any other bread, cut into cubes | 1 cup brewed coffee | 2 -3 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs, for coating bread
instructions: Cover bread cubes with coffee. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Press on crumbs pressing on crumbs. Bake in 350 degree oven until golden brown.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup teriyaki sauce ( store bought ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix all ingredients, adding more sauce, if desired to taste.

title: Spaghetti With Eggplant and Turnips
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 2 medium turnips, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1 medium eggplant, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Easy Crockpot Sausages and Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs pork sausage links | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4 or 1/2 inch slices. Put into the crockpot. Add the water. Cover and cook on the low setting for 8 hours.

title: Quinoa and Pork With Tomatillas and Jicama
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups jicama ( yellow fingerling sugar cane ) | 2 cups chopped tomatillos | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground pork | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed
instructions: Combine jicama, tomatillos and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt in a medium saucepan. Cover with water, bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer 2 hours or until thick but still firm. Drain and discard jicama. Place pork in 8 inch nonstick skillet. Sprinkle with cumin. Cook over medium high heat 5 minutes, or until just cooked through. Combine pork and tomatillas.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,beef tenderloin,avocado,pesto sauce,black cardamom pod,vanilla,beef stew meat,broccoli floret
title: Persian Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground black cardamom pod, or to taste | 1 can refrigerated prepared pesto sauce | 1 medium avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 8 ounces frozen broccoli florets | 1 cup grated sharp provolone cheese or provolone cheese for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place beef tenderloin in a 3x9 inch oval baking dish. Combine the beef broth, granules, cardamom and black cardamom in a small bowl. Pour into the dish. Smooth top with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven until the meat is browned and the sauce is thick and bubbling, about 45 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f. Cut into 1 cubes. Serve over the provolone cheese or serve as a sandwich spread.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,walnut,pineapple juice,butternut squash,poblano chile,cinnamon
title: Spicy Mexican Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs butternut squash, cut in half ( or 1 2 1/2 c pumpkin, cut up into 1- 1/2-inch pieces ) | 1 lb small poblano chile ( or anaheim or jalapeno or more! ) ( optional ) | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice ( or more! i sometimes use pineapple chunk ) | 1 1/3 cups toasted sliced walnuts ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 cups uncooked sweet potato wedges or 2 cups diced peeled potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 400f degrees. Spray 13x9 pan with cooking spray. In a large skillet, add butternut squash/pumpkin and a few poblans, if using, and cook, covered, with lid, for 5 minutes. Remove lid. Stir. Add pineapple & juice. Stir. Mix. Set aside. In a mixing bowl, add sweet potato wedges, walnuts or pineapple and cinnamon. Stir. Drain squash/pumpkin well, reserving juice mix. Spoon potato mixture in sprayed pan. Cover. Bake for 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle top with cinnamon and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salsa,baby spinach,vegetable oil cooking spray,olive oil
title: Tasteedy Spinach
ingredients: 500 g baby spinach | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup salsa | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200'c or 160'c if fan forced. Place the spinach in a single layer on 2 lightly greased baking trays. Spray with oil. Bake, stirring every 5 - 8 minutes or until spinach has just wilted and starts to dry. Turn out onto a towel and spread the spinach on a large plate, loosely packed together. Serve with salsa.

title: Cottage Cheese and Balsamic Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed chicken stock or ( 15 ounce ) cans vegetable stock | 100 g cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Add all of the soup ingredients into a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer on lowest heat for 2 hours. Add balsamic vinegar and serve.

title: Red Capsicum Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon roasted sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon roasted pecans | 1/4 cup fresh parsley | 100 g red capsicums, very thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Toast sesame then cool and crush in a mortar. Add remaining ingredients and stir fry until capsicums are heated through.

title: Tamarind Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup tamarind paste | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Soak tamarind pulp in 1/4 cup warm water until soft. Combine tamarind pulp and about 1/2 cup of the cheese in a food processor until smooth. Add 2 cups water and process until smooth, about 3 seconds. Mix in remaining cheese and thyme and blend well. Chill while preparing the topping. Using a small spoon, spread about 1 cup of whipped topping on the bottome and top with 1/2 cup tamarind mixture. Repeat with remaining whipped topping.

title: Farfalle With Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups dry farfalle pasta | 2 3/4 cups beef broth ( from cooking the meat ) | 6 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Cook the pasta to your preferred doneness as directed on the box. Drain and set aside. Mix broth with sour cream. Mix hot cooked pasta, sauce and garlic into sauce and serve over pasta. Yum.

title: Homemade Basil and Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 10 large basil leaves, washed and dried, stems trimmed | 6 fresh limes or 6 lemon wedges
instructions: Wash basil and dry using a cloth. Slice into slivers. Put basil leaves in a small saucepan. Pour enough water and lime juice to cover. Bring to boil then turn down to low and let simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain and cool basil. You can refrigerate for up to 2 days before using. To serve transfer to a glass jar with a tight lid or plastic bag. Cover and store for up to one year. Note, do not refrigerate basil leaves that have not been thawed or they will break apart.

Random Ingredients: white bread,vegetable bouillon cube,ramen noodle,brown rice,baby spinach
title: Crunchy Rice Spinach Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 3/4 cup brown rice, cooked | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 package of ramen noodles, dry ( ramen style ) | 1 slice of white bread
instructions: Boil a large pot of water and add the salt. Blend the rice with 2 cube of vegetable bouillon in a blender, adding a little water if the soup is too thick. Add in the ramen noodles. You may like to add about 2 handfuls of spinach to the rice if you’d like. Place the bag of rice into a large bowl, and pour in the noodles. Let sit for 5 minutes. Break the bread in small chunks and lightly toast it in the oven at about 400 degrees for the last minute or two of toasting. Spread the rice evenly on the toasted bread, about 2 tbsp. Topping, if needed. Eat, but if preferred, serve the rice immediately.

title: Cabbage (Shchi) Soup
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 cup shredded meat | 4 cups chopped cooked meat
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Macoyin (Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 8 ounces canned macaroni or 8 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup shallot, chopped | 1 bunch fresh parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup cashews ( such as macadamia nuts ) | 2 1/2 cups ice cubes | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the macaroni, shallots, parsley and cashews. Add ice cubes, and mix well. Divide the macaroni mixture among six tall serving bowls and top with sesame seeds and cilantro.

title: Fychi (Yummy Bread With Cheese)
ingredients: 100 g whey ( for frying ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon, powder
instructions: Heat a pan on high. Warm up the whey till it is at the boiling stage. Place the bowl on the pan and pour over the warm whey. The bubbles will be released but will not rise. Cook over medium heat till the top looks dry and golden brown. It should take about 10 mins on high and 15 mins on low. Remove from heat and let cool. Once cooled, dust with little confectioners sugar. Variation, add some garlic powder. Variation, add pepper flakes to the cheese and bread mixture if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,chicken,lemon peel,radish,lime juice zest,pomegranate,ice water,garlic
title: Moroccan Chicken Salad (No Mayo)
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chicken | 1 tablespoon finely grated lime peel | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon peel | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely minced garlic | 1/3 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice ( from 1/2 fresh lime ) | 1 tablespoon finely minced radish | 1/2 cup ice water | 4 -6 radishes, trimmed to 1/4-inch slices on the bias
instructions: To prepare dressing, pulse the first 6 ingredients in a food processor or blender until the mixture is the texture of a thin dip, about 1 minute. Using a handheld blender or 2 tablespoon measuring mitts, carefully pour the water through the opening in the mitts and process again until the water comes out about 1 1/2 tablespoons. Transfer the dressing to a small bowl and add the radishes. Toss the salad with the dressing and serve.

title: Calimyrna Nyi
ingredients: 1 lb fresh squid ( or other seafood ) | 1 lb albacore tuna ( or other white white ocean fish ) | 2 tablespoons coriander powder ( also called masala ), for colour
instructions: Wash and clean squid, cut into bite size pieces. Slice small pieces. Cut albacore tuna into pieces and combine in large pot with fish and some of the chopped coriander powder. Put lid on pot and leave on heat for 10 min at low heat. Don't stir or touch pot and leave for 7 - 10 minute check if it is cooked to your taste. Don't forget to taste and see if it is..

title: Maharaja Beef Patties (Beans)
ingredients: 1/2 cup beef broth | 12 ounces khoroya, cut on grain and crushed | 1 small banana, crushed | 1 -2 tablespoon orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp
instructions: Combine beef broth, kharoya and spices in a small saucepan and heat over low heat until the broth is almost dry. Add the mashed banana, stir and heat until banana is incorporated and the mixture is reduced a little, about 10 minutes. Add tamarind pulp and warm through for a minute or two. Pour the meat mixture into shallow serving bowls and place warm banana mixture in the center.

title: Greek Stuffed Boneless Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 lb boneless leg of lamb | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 cup greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons diced fresh mushrooms | 3 tablespoons diced bell peppers | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mushrooms
instructions: Place each leg of lamb between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound between paper towels until meat is about 1/4 inch thick. Trim off excess paper. Place on a baking sheet. In a resealable bag, combine vodka and greek yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,baking potato,enchilada sauce,lemon juice zest
title: Eelie's Chicken Stew
ingredients: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into chunks | 2 pounds baking potatoes, quartered | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken in a frying pan and add enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat, then reduce the heat to medium low. Place the potatoes in a saucepan of boiling water. Boil for 15 minutes, then drain. Transfer the chicken to a separate bowl. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Drain the water out of the potatoes and add to the chicken with the enchilada sauce. In a small bowl, stir together the lemon juice and the zest. Ladle 2/3 cup of the cooking liquid from the potato water into a small saucepan over medium heat. Heat the mixture until the liquid is reduced by half, then stir into the sauce. Return to a simmer over low heat. Stir the soup to mix in the lemon juice mixture, then transfer the soup to a greased casserole dish. Add 1/2 can of water to the soup to make a paste. Spread the lemon juice mixture into the soup. Cover the casserole dish with aluminum foil, and bake at 375 degrees f for about 40 minutes. Remove the foil, and bake for 20 more minutes, then remove from the oven. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Fenugreek-Wash Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans or 1 lb frozen green beans, thawed and trimmed
instructions: If using frozen green beans, thaw in cold water for 20 minutes, and drain. Place thawed green beans in slow cooker. Cover beans with cold water.

Random Ingredients: tea,green cabbage,pandan leaf,balsamic vinegar,basil leaf,pecan,maple syrup,margarine
title: Polish Balsamic Scented Coleslaw
ingredients: 3 3 -4 green cabbage or 3 -4 red cabbage | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons maple syrup, to taste | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar or 1 tablespoon maple syrup, to taste | 1 -2 teaspoon basil leaves, to taste | 1/4 walnut pieces or 1/4 pecans, finely chopped | 1/4 cup loosely packed basil leaves, torn | 6 toasted pecan pieces ( optional )
instructions: Slice cabbage thinly. Wrap cabbage in foil and place on the rack in the bottom of the oven. In a small saucepan, melt the margarine with maple syrup in medium saucepan until the margarine is melted. Stir in balsamic vinegar and basil. Simmer on low for 2 minutes. Sprinkle cabbage with pecan or poppy seeds or nuts. Drain dressing and add dressing to cabbage. Stir. Cover and place in refrigerator to marinate for up to 2 hours. Serve.

title: Sweet Onion Parfait
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 cup chopped red sweet onion | 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/2 cup flaked coconut | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon white onion, minced | 2 cups couscous
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add red onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 7 to 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. Add chocolate chips, coconut, triple sec, and 1 tablespoon of white onion to skillet. Stir to combine and melt chocolate, about 3 minutes. Remove skillet from heat. While still warm, transfer 1/4 cup of mixture to a resealable bag. Add 2 more tablespoons of sugar to the remaining mixture and stir until sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes. Remove the cinnamon. Heat remaining white onion mixture over medium heat until hot but not smoking but not browning, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the onion.

title: Kerry's Spicy Spicy Mexican Rub
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork ( boston butt ) | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon orange juice and zest of
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Rub over meat of choice.

title: Lime and Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable broth or 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 cup white flour
instructions: Place ingredients into a saucepan and bring to the boil. Simmer for 3 mins or until thickened and thickened. Pour into a bowl and add extra lime juice. Serve with roasted vegetables or steamed jasmin.

title: Shrimp-And-Scallops-Baked in a Cheese & Tahini Crust
ingredients: 2 lbs medium shrimp, cleaned, peeled and deveined | 2 lbs beef brisket, room temperature | 1 lb cheese, small-grated | 3/4 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon garlic and black pepper | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Line 2 large baking sheets with nonstick foil and place under oven. If you want your crust to flake on the exposed side, brush lightly with olive oil. If not, use a cookie sheet or similar. Place all the shrimp except the beef in a large bowl, add all of the cheese, toss to coat.

title: Aniseed Pecans
ingredients: 1 cup toasted aniseed nuts | 1 cup topping ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut nuts in half and spread open. Place 1 tablespoon on an oiled cookie sheet. Sprinkle each with desired amount of aniseed. If desired, place cookies on sheet to cool. Store in an airtight container. Use within 3 months. To store, place cookie sheet in refrigerator. When cookies are cool, place in freezer bags, then overwrap individually with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,pecan half,pistachio,chicken breast half,kidney bean,dill,currant,sambal oelek
title: Pistachio Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup chopped pecans | 1/2 cup currants | 2 cans baked kidney beans | 1 cup chopped pistachios | 6 tablespoons sambal oelek ( indonesian spicy brown bean paste ) | 1 tablespoon whole peppercorn | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded thin | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking dish. Mix pecans, currants, and baked kidney beans together in a bowl. Sprinkle pistachios over the bean mixture, and stir in sambal oelek. Spread the peppercorns on a plate, and press the chicken breasts into the peppercorns until evenly coated. Place chicken onto the baking dish in a single layer. Sprinkle pistachios on the chicken, then top with a layer of dried red pepper. Place the peppercorns on a plate. Place an additional piece of dried red pepper on top. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken has turned a golden color, and the edges are beginning to brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Roasted Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, coarsely crushed | 2 tablespoons fresh chives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f peel the parsnips and cut them into 3/8 inch slices across the bottom and set aside. Toast the cayenne pepper, ground coriander seeds and chives together in a small frying pan and set aside. Combine the hot mixture with the sliced parsnips and pour them into an ovenproof baking dish. Roast uncovered for 40 to 50 minutes or until tender and well browned.

title: Mildly Saffron Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 tablespoons habanero peppers, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 14 ounces pasta sauce
instructions: In a small skillet, heat all of the ingredients over low medium heat until they begin to bubble, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Burundi Spiced Noodles
ingredients: 1 package of dried linguine | 1 packet turmeric powder | 1/2 package dried black pudding | 4 -6 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Cook pasta and rinse in cold water, then drain. Meanwhile prepare the remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Add curry powder and mix well. Add cooked pasta to bowl and mix again. Serve chilled.

title: Macaroni Vodka With Mac and Wood Polish Cream
ingredients: 500 g macaroni | 200 g macuccine | 3/4 liter vanilla vodka | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water for 15 minutes. While macaroni is cooking, mix the vanilla vodka with the mace. Serve macaroni with vanilla vodka with wood Polish cream and macuccine sticks on the side,.

title: Spanish Bread Wedges
ingredients: 8 slices bread, or | 8 slices provolone cheese | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bread on a baking sheet or tin. Spray bread with olive oil and sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake on the bottom rack of the oven for about 10 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: egg white,spring onion,yellow squash,soymilk,cooking oat,baking chocolate
title: Chocolate Crumble Squash Bread
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/3 cup soymilk | 3 -4 large egg whites, lightly whisked | 4 ounces good quality semisweet baking chocolate | 4 spring onions, finely diced | 2 tablespoons chopped toasted sesame seeds ( very fine ground pistils ) or 2 tablespoons chopped toasted pine nuts ( very fine ground pistils )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Halve and seed the squash then cut crosswise into even pieces about ¼ inch thick. Place in a microwave safe bowl, add the soymilk, cover and microwave on high for 8 - 10 minutes or until softened. Stir well. Whisk in the egg whites and chocolate until combined. Turn the oven off if the microwave is not already hot. Sprinkle the top of the bread with onion, pistils and nuts and bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Easy Easy Tiramisu #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Layer each ladyfinger in a 9 square pan. Mix together soy sauce and sweetener. Spread over lady fingers. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: carrot,water chestnut,tomato soup,yellow cake mix,monterey jack pepper cheese,coconut milk,flour tortilla,lentil
title: Mexican Lentil Burritos
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix or ( 18 ounce ) package white cake mix | 1 cup water | 1 can condensed tomato soup ( plain works too ) | 6 4 ounces cans chunked stewed tomatoes with juice, drained ( can use stewed tomatoes ) | 4 cans canned sliced carrots, drained | 1 can sliced black mushrooms, drained | 1 can lentils, drained | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 8 -10 flour tortillas
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients, add lentils, carrots and water chestnuts. Cut tortillas into 2 inch sections and line baking pan with tortillas. Spoon lentil mixture over tortillas. Cover with remaining tortillas, bake, 350 degrees f. For about 20 minutes. Cut into 5 wedges. Serve topped with sour cream and cilantro if desired.

title: Italian Green Olive Bread
ingredients: 4 cups green olives ( unpitted ) | 2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Put the olives in the pan of a kitchenaid mixer and add the yeast. Mix the mixture thoroughly but gently and slowly and slowly for about 10 minutes to develop the yeast. Add about 1/2 cup of water to the sponge. Mix with the mixer. The dough should pull away from the sides of the mixing bowl. Add about 5 more cups of flour. Mix with the mix again, adding flour as needed, until all the flour is absorbed. Add all the additional flour if the dough is too wet. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it lightly, about 10 minutes. Place the dough in a well oiled bowl and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cherry,no boil lasagna noodle,vegetable stock,vodka,grape leaf,heavy whipping cream
title: Danish Cherry Soup With No-Boil Noodles
ingredients: 1 quart vegetable stock, heated ( or a good flavored broth ) | 12 grape leaves, washed in a little salted water | 1 ounce vodka ( optional or to taste ) | 1 lb fresh cherry, quartered | no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a large pot, bring vegetable stock to a simmer and put in the grape leaves. Stir and simmer for 3 minutes. Strain the soup and add vodka, if using. Set aside. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add no boil lasagna noodles and cook for about 10 seconds. Drain noodles well and rinse with cold water. Drain well again. Place back on the stove and add enough cream just to cover noodles. Heat until boiling. Remove from heat and add no boil noodles. Serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese for garnish and salad.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,beef tenderloin,eggplant,watercress,cumin,asafoetida powder,red salmon
title: Roasted Vegetable Beef Patties
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin ( the thinner you cut, the better, we have 2 lo ) or 2 lbs round steaks ( the thinner the cut, the better, we have 2 lo ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cumin ( or to taste ) | 1/4 lb fresh asafoetida powder ( for sprinkling on tops of meat ) | 1 -2 hot green chili pepper, chopped | watercress, for garnish | coarsely chopped red salmon ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups raw medium eggplants, cut into about 10 -12 chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix ground cumin and asafoetida. Slice beef into approximately 1/2 inch slices, then flatten out with the heel of a cleaver. Place slices into a bowl and sprinkle with cumin and asafoetida mix. Place bread chunks on cookie sheets or cookie sheet and place on the center rack of oven and roast 20 minutes. Turn bread over and roast another 20 minutes or until nicely browned. Remove from oven and set aside. Boil water in a large pot until steaming. Remove meat from water, but save the broth. Use 1 3/4 cup broth to make your filling, or 1 3/4 cups for gravy. For gravy, place beef, asafetida, and chiles into a large skillet and cook just until the onion begins to brown. Remove lid and increase heat to high and add broth. Scrape all the browned bits from the bottom of the skillet from time to time, so that the liquid boils away before the beef dries out. Stir frequently and continue to stir. Add salt if desired. Slice beef and place on baking sheet in oven, spoon a few tablespoons of gravy over them, and bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes, until the beef is browned nicely. Garnish with chopped asafetida and serve. You can also use a can of diced tomatoes, which also have gravy on them while baking if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,green curry paste,triple sec,avocado,cherry,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Bombay Dipping Cheddars
ingredients: 16 ounces cherry tomatoes | 1/4 cup sweet chili pepper ( bottled type ) | 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( i used thai kitchen brand ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons avocado, mashed | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese ( grated or grated ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons triple sec ( optional )
instructions: Place tomatoes on cookie sheet that has been sprayed with oil. Sprinkle green curry paste on top of tomatoes. Top with mashed avocado and cheese. Bake at 350f for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,italian tomato,plain flour,salt,shortening,philadelphia cream cheese,thai chili sauce
title: Spicy Cheese Ball (Pillsbury)
ingredients: 2 lbs monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon dried italian tomatoes | 1 tablespoon sweet thai sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 teaspoon salt | 3 tablespoons shortening
instructions: Mix cheese, tomato sauce, chili sauce flour and salt until smooth. Mix in shortening. Form into ball and chill until firm. Place on tray with plastic wrap to harden. Roll ball in flour and fry in hot oven until golden brown on all sides. Serve warm.

title: Oriental Shrimp
ingredients: 24 large raw shrimp | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 -2 -3 lb roast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Bake the shrimp for about 10 minutes, turning occasionally. Turn the shrimp frequently so they do not burn over the heat. When done, transfer the shrimp with their cooking liquid to a shallow baking dish. Rub the top and tail of each one with the five spice powder. Put in the oven for about 30 minutes or longer, until the shrimp are pink and the coating is a little bit crisp. Serve with rice/chow mein noodles.

title: Leg of Lamb on Toast With Mango and Mango Salad
ingredients: 3 slices whole wheat bread | 250 g leg of lamb, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons mango pickle salad < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/mango-dressing-425441 '' > mango dressing < /a > | 3 tablespoons mango pickle salad dressing < /a >
instructions: Toast bread. Spread 3 tablespoons mango dressing over each slice of toast. Divide sliced lamb between slices of bread.

Random Ingredients: artichoke,mayonnaise,natural peanut butter,clove,passion fruit,lime juice,cheddar cheese
title: Passion Fruit and Peanut Spread
ingredients: 1 small passion fruit ( optional, seeds removed ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 1/3 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 3/4 cup chopped ripe fresh artichoke | 1 clove, grated
instructions: Prepare passion fruit, split the cone shaped side from the passion fruit, peel and core the pulp. Place pulp and seeds in a food processor with poppy and peanut butter. Process until smooth. Fold in remaining ingredients. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until the flavors blend, about 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,baking potato,beef tenderloin,enchilada sauce,liquid smoke
title: Texas Beef Champion
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 1/2 cups enchilada sauce, prepared | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Place meat in a nonstick skillet. Place skillet in a preheated 375 degree oven 20 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 140 degrees. Pour enchilada sauce in a small saucepan. Place potato and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a bowl.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 1 tart apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 1/2 cup mashed banana ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 tablespoon butter, softened
instructions: In a small bowl cream together apple, banana and sumac. Add butter last. Spread mixture evenly in ungreased shallow dish or pie plate lined with waxed paper. Let stand 4 to 5 hours, or overnight, in the refrigerator of up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,grain rice,corona beer,stewing beef,mirin,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Sri Pino
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2-inch chunks | 1/2 cup corona light plus 2 tablespoons corona beer | 4 tablespoons mirin | 3 tablespoons coconut oil | 18 ounces short-grain rice | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Place the beef, beer, 1 tablespoon mirin, and 2 tablespoons corona oil in a large skillet, and cook over medium high heat until the beef is well browned on all sides, stirring frequently to avoid burning the liquid. Transfer the beef to a plate. Skim off any fat from the remaining oil and then stir the contents of the skillet into the pan and return the meat to the skillet. Reduce the heat to low and simmer covered, turning the meat every 20 minutes, or until the meat is very tender, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. If necessary, cook uncovered for an additional 20 minutes to make the meat tender and more evenly browned. When the meat is fork tender, use slotted spoon to remove the meat to a warm platter. Skim any fat from the broth, then set aside. To taste, skim off any fat from the top and then stir to remove any flavorful pieces of meat or bits. Meanwhile, cook half the rice in 4 cups of boiling water, stirring regularly until tender and creamy, 5 to 10 minutes. Drain and stir it into the pan until heated through. Spread the remaining corona over the top of the fried rice, sprinkle with the parsley, and serve.

title: Savoury Dried Coriander (Coriander Balls)
ingredients: 4 cups fresh coriander ( chopped ) | 1 vanilla bean ( split lengthways, scraped ) | 250 g breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean ( split lengthways, scraped )
instructions: Soak the spice essence. Cut 1 teaspoon of vanilla bean into 1/2 inch pieces. Remove shell and coarse outer leaves of the vanilla bean. Place the coriander in a bowl. Add the finely chopped vanilla bean and the breadcrumbs. Mix well to combine. Add a small amount of vanilla essence to the breadcrumb mixture. If using the breadcrumb mixture, coat the dry breadcrumb mixture in the breadcrumb mixture mixture, coating both sides. Place in a plastic bag and cover with a plate. Refrigerate for 20 minutes before shaping into palm sized balls. Store bag in the refrigerator.

title: Sage and Bacon Baked Italian Meatballs in Tomato Cream
ingredients: 6 ounces bacon, chopped | 1 tablespoon meatballs | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | lemon juice and zest
instructions: In a large frying pan with a cover, cook the bacon until crisp, about 8 - 10 minutes. Do not drain. Reserving fat from the pan, crumble the bacon pieces into the bacon fat to get the drippings. Add the meatballs, meatball juice and zest to the bacon fat mixture, stirring to coat the meatballs with the bacon fat. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Cook the meatballs, covered, in the 350°f oven until heated through, about 20 minutes. Use a slotted spoon if needed to remove the meatballs from the pan. Serve meatballs in the tomato cream sauce alongside.

title: Mexican Bean Bread
ingredients: 1 can baked beans | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat the oven 400 degrees. Line a 9 inch loaf pan with waxed paper. Open the can of baked beans, and spread the beans over the bottom of the prepared loaf pan, leaving 2/333 of an inch of space at each of the wide sides. Sprinkle the mace evenly over the beans. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool for 20 minutes before turning out onto a towel. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,romano cheese,raspberry,penne pasta,corn syrup,bread crumb,salmon fillet
title: Grilled Salmon En Papillote With Raspberry and Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet, skin and bones removed | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 cup raspberries | 1/4 cup soft bread crumbs | 12 corn tortillas, warmed | 3 cups cooked penne pasta | 1/4 cup chopped romano cheese or 1/4 cup fontina cheese
instructions: Heat grill. Combine salmon and corn syrup in a medium bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Cut salmon into 1/2 inch thick slices. Add raspberries to fish, toss gently. Mix bread crumbs in a shallow bowl. Dredge tortillas in bread crumbs. Place in a single layer on each of 4 plates. Divide fish and raspberry sauce among tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with remaining bread crumbs. Place under a preheated grill 4 to 5 minutes or until cheese bubbles and is lightly browned.

title: My Favorite Salsa
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 can green chili peppers
instructions: You can also substitute tomatoes with diced cheddar, onion, salsa fresca, etc if desired. I like the green chili peppers but it's a little bit milder than the salsa. You can easily dice or chop for less heat. Serve with chips, fresh veggies, tortilla chips or meat.

title: Spinach and Rhubarb Kugel
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, sliced | 1 lb rhubarb, chopped | 1 bunch fresh spinach, cleaned and rinsed | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Line a 6x8 inch pan with a double thickness of aluminum foil. Coat halved and partially overlapping slices of eggplant with cooking spray. Spread half the rhubarb on the foil to lightly cover the bottom of the pan. Top with sliced rhubarb, spinach and remaining rhubarb. Brush the top with cooking spray. Cover loosely with foil. Cook for one hour. Uncover and bake for an additional 30 minutes. Allow to sit for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Jalapeno Crisp Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups bisquick | 3/4 cup chili powder ( or more, to taste ) | 2 -3 garlic cloves | 2 teaspoons chili powder ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 cup jalapeno pepper, chopped | 6 slices of thin korean firm textured turkish bread
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the bisquick, the chili powder, garlic, chili powder and the jalapenos. If you can't find the chile powder, feel free to substitute with some hot sauce. Shape the dough into balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Place on the baking sheet. Flatten slightly. Bake them for 10 - 15 minutes, on a hot baking stick or until they're cooked through. Turn on oven to 500 degrees and return the fritters to the oven. Cook for about 10 - 15 minutes, until crisp and browned. Serve with korean sweet pickled onions and dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,kaffir lime leaf,rigatoni pasta,adobo sauce,yoghurt,ginger root
title: Asian Beef Tenderloin Rigatoni
ingredients: marinated beef tenderloin | 16 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 piece fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce, or to taste | 4 cloves fresh kaffir lime leaves | 21 ounces yoghurt
instructions: Preheat grill for direct heat. Dry roast the roast on the skewers and brush with olive oil and sprinkle with ginger. Place under the grill.

title: Apricot-Marmmallow French Fries (Quick)
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam or 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup warm water | marshmallow cream
instructions: Put jam in mixing bowl and pour in water stirring until moistened. Put on plate and sprinkle with marshmallow cream to serve.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,green pepper,kikkoman soy sauce,chickpea
title: Hank Aaron's Chickpea Burgers
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( reserve liquid ) | 1 onion soup mix | 1 green pepper ( thinly sliced ) | 1 tablespoon kikkoman soy sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and let stand at room temperature for at least an hour. Then put in fridge. Can be served with french fries, bread or tostados.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,balsamic vinegar,dark sesame oil,white sugar,pork loin chop,water,oyster mushroom,beef steak
title: Beef Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean beef steaks, cut into small cubes | 1/2 lb barbecued pork loin or 1/2 lb pork loin, cut into small cubes | 12 ounces oyster mushrooms | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup water | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine flour, sugar and sesame oil in bowl or food processor and mix until well combined. Add pork and marinade, toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Cook on grill, basting frequently with reserved marinade and reserved marinade, until beef is cooked through and lightly browned, about 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Fried Fish With Green Beans
ingredients: 1 whole fish, about 2 1/2 lbs | 1 -2 teaspoon saffron | 3 garlic cloves, sliced fine | 4 poblano peppers, halved lenghtwise and sliced into strips | 1/2 cup shredded coconut, toasted | warm whole wheat bread, for dipping
instructions: Scale and gut the fish. Cut the fish into 2 equal slices, with all the other ingredients cut into wedges of 3 inches. Place the fish on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 450 for about an hour or until fish flakes easily and is cooked and slightly crispy. Serve with hot flat bread or steamed greenbeans.

title: Dynamite Remedy
