ingredients: 2 teaspoons calavados ( apple brandy or a good apple brandy ) | 2 teaspoons brown mustard
instructions: Combine ingredients and shake well. Store refrigerated in a clean, dry glass glass jar for up to one week.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,raspberry vinaigrette,egg beater substitute,extra virgin olive oil,spaghetti,brie cheese,garam masala
title: Raspberry Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 1 1/2 cups low-fat brie cheese, coarsely grated ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons ginger juice | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons egg free egg substitute ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh raspberry vinaigrette ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish with 1 1/2 teaspoons oil. Cook spaghetti in a large pot of boiling water until 'al dente', about 11 minutes, reserving about 1/2 cup of pasta cooking liquid. Rinse drained spaghetti under cold water until cold and drain well. Place cooked spaghetti in a large bowl. Mix brie, garam masala, ginger juice, olive oil, egg substitute and 3/4 cup reserved pasta cooking liquid. Spoon over drained spaghetti.

title: Apricot Pistachio Bark
ingredients: 600 g apricots, drained and chopped | 125 g dark rum | pistachios
instructions: Line the base and sides of a small cake tin with greaseproof paper and sprinkle with pistachios. Place apricots and rum in a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour mixture over nuts and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour or two. Drain and decorate with a sprinkling of sugar and cardamom.

Random Ingredients: egg,red thai chile,horseradish,parmigiano reggiano cheese,beef brisket
title: Roast Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 small red thai chiles | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 6 large eggs | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 350°f place whole chiles on foil lined pan in even layer. With tip of knife, make incisions 1 1/2 wide, 1/2 deep, each cut side of the chiles. Insert slice of horseradish in each slit. Insert slices of brisket 1/2 apart so that fat cascades atop each slice of brisket. With large oven thermometer, place brisket fat side up and bake, uncovered, until beef thermometer registers 125°f, 45 - 60 minutes. Slice beef, 6 slices per serving, and serve with pan juices. Accompany with pan juices, juices, and a fresh green salad.

title: Grilled Linguine With Orange Sage Butter
ingredients: 12 fresh sage leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons jiggers triple sec | 1 lb linguine | 1 large orange, peeled, sectioned, and thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Heat a charcoal grill to 300 degrees f. Put sage, triple sec, and boiling water in a bowl. Set aside to soak 15 minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine and cook until al dente, 9 to 10 minutes. Stir linguine through it with a wooden spoon until it is creamy and soft. Remove from heat and arrange on a serving platter. Garnish with orange slices, if desired.

title: Jambon Rouge
ingredients: 8 ounces flour | 2 eggs yolks | 5 ounces butter | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients with enough water to make dough very stiff. Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 5 mm and cut into strips. Boil the water for 3 minutes in a separate pan, then lift the strips out of the water with a slotted spoon and leave on a paper towel lined plate. Melt the butter over a low heat in a sauce pan or frying pan. Add the sugar and lime juice at this point and fry until syrupy. Add the strips of fried strips of garlic to the butter and then slowly add the sherry. Keep the butter on medium heat and pour in the syrupy strips of garlic, stirring from time to time until golden. Serve immediately.

title: Prawns and Vegehias
ingredients: 1 green pepper, cut into julienne strips | 1 -2 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/4 cup walnut oil ( or any oil you like ) | 1 -2 tablespoon italian seasoned breadcrumbs, crushed ( or more )
instructions: Soak the green pepper in a bowl of cold water until it changes color but is not mushy, 30 minutes to 1 hour maximum. Rinse. Preheat oven to 450°f. Drain pepper. Place peppers in medium baking dish. Mix soy sauce and oil in a small bowl then add breadcrumbs, toss. Pour evenly over peppers. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until shrimp are pink and done.

title: Cavatelli - Spicy Raw Kiwi Cheese
ingredients: 3 kiwi fruits, peeled | 3 -5 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste, made according to taste
instructions: Cut the kiwis into pieces. Peel the remaining kiwi fruit. Cut it into slices about 3 inches long and ¼ inch thick, removing the ends to prevent a 'cauliflower' and 'broth'. Place the kiwis into a mixing bowl, pour in ½ an inch of water, and add 3 tablespoons of ginger garlic paste, mix together. Mix the ingredients to combine. Allow to sit for 10 - 20 minutes for the kiwi to soften slightly but not cook through. The ginger and garlic paste will act as a stabilizer for the cavatelli, but this will keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,chicken cutlet,chuck,pistachio,carrot,lime zest,turmeric powder,plum tomato
title: Pistachio-Pepper Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 14 chicken cutlets | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant pitzi or 1 1/2 tablespoons powdered pistachios | 2 tablespoons dried ground turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons dried lime zest | 4 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 cup shredded carrot | 1/2 cup finely chopped seeded jalapeno pepper | 3 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine pitzi powder, turmeric, lime zest and tomatoes in shallow dish. Add cutlets and coat with pitzi mixture. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until browned and tender. Serve hot or cold. Note, the tomato can also be added to the hot pepper mixture, if desired.

title: Takoyaki (Japanese Cocktail)
ingredients: 1 3/8 ounces of nori seaweed | 3 dashes lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 4 ounces ketchup | 1 1/2 ounces triple sec or 1 1/2 ounces white rum | 1/2 ounce parmesan cheese, shaved
instructions: Place all the ingredients together and shake well. Serve on a napkin.

title: Ancho Chilli Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 cans spaghetti sauce ( your favorite brand, we like prego spaghetti sauce ) | 2 chilies ( or 1 habanero pepper ) | 8 -10 ounces rice krispies | 1 -3 teaspoon achi chilies ( or one - 1/2 tsp. chili powder ) or 1 -3 teaspoon chili powder ( or one -1/2 tsp. chili powder ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cognac ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a small crockpot and cook on high 4 hours. Stir every so often for even better flavor. If you need to thicken up some more just add a little more water. Enjoy.

title: Hungarian Pasta Rolls
ingredients: 7 ounces uncooked wagon wheel rotini pasta or 7 ounces shell pasta, cooked | 12 1/2 ounces fresh white mushrooms or 12 1/2 ounces canned mushroom stems and pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika ( to taste ) | 12 1/2 ounces frozen blueberries ( can use canned ) or 12 1/2 ounces thawed frozen cranberries ( can use canned ) | 12 sheets lasagna sheets ( see illustrations below )
instructions: Prepare pasta, drain. Meanwhile, add mushrooms and paprika to a medium frying pan, and cook over medium heat, stirring often, until mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes. Cool slightly. Place the pasta in a large bowl, cover and set aside. Return mushrooms to the same frying pan, and stir in the cooked pasta. Cool, then fold in the berries or cranberries. Lay 5 sheets of plastic wrap on work surface, and spread a third of the tomato sauce in the center of each. Fold one next lengthwise along the edge of the wrap and top with a third of the remaining sauce. Cut the remaining open end off the plastic wrap and roll up the pasta mixture in the wrap on a cutting board. Repeat with the remaining 5 sheets of plastic wrap and filling. Arrange the rolls on four plates and top with remaining tomato sauce. In a 9x13 pan, place a sheet of plastic wrap over 2/3 of the tomato sauce. Place one lasagna sheet, cut side down, on top of the tomato sauce. Spread with 1/3 remaining tomato sauce, leaving ends uncovered. Place 4 remaining rolls over the tomato sauce and top with the remaining tomato sauce, reserved cheese and herbs. Cover with plastic wrap, then with foil. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 20 minutes or until heated through. Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Lebanese (Low Fat) Escarole Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces escarole ( preferably with leaves ) | cooking oil | 1/2 cup low-fat soymilk ( plain or reduced fat ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, leaves picked | fresh dill weed, to garnish
instructions: Remove the leaves from the escarole, and cut them into 1 inch pieces. Place the pieces in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Cover, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the leaves just begin to soften. Drain and set aside. Place the escarole, 1 tablespoon cooking oil, soymilk, thyme, and dill in the pan. Simmer for about 4 minutes. Serve hot, garnished with dill.

title: Rhubarb Onion Soup
ingredients: 6 cups chopped rhubarb | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 package ready-made pastry for double-crust pies
instructions: Heat broth to boiling.

Random Ingredients: white rice,thai curry paste,granny smith apple,vanilla bean
title: Easy Apple Curry
ingredients: 3/4 cup white rice | 3 tablespoons thai curry paste | 3 granny smith apples | vanilla bean, for garnish
instructions: In a small saucepan on medium low heat, warm the coconut milk. Cut several slits in the rice until you can see darker pieces of rice slightly darker. Be careful with burning, it is important to keep the coconut milk nearby. This will lower the headiness of the curry. Add the curry paste, and stir continuously to coat the rice in the curry paste. Add enough water to cover it. Place the lid on the saucepan, and allow to simmer on medium low heat for 15 - 20 minutes. Peel the apples, cut into quarters, and remove the seeds. Cut apple slits on top of the curry, and add it to the pan. Allow it to cook for 5 minutes. Garnish with vanilla bean. Variation, this is my original recipe, and i'm not in a hurry, since i didn't get any curry paste into it. Try this with other curry dishes, such as chow mein noodles. This is definitely a dish that is well liked, but not necessary.

title: Spicy Leeks (Adobong Kaleche)
ingredients: 6 leeks, white part only, washed thoroughly | canned chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 - 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon anchovy paste
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl for stir frying, or just set aside at room temperature to marinating. Heat a skillet on medium high heat and fry the leeks at a lively angle, stirring for about 5 - 10 minutes. Do not allow them to brown too much. You want the leeks to cook only a slight crunchiness. They don't need to be so thin. Remove and set on paper towel to drain. Serve, or store in refrigerator for up to 2 days.

title: Baby-Leek (Egg-Free) Cake
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 14 -16 ounces baby carrots | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon pecans, chopped
instructions: Clean the carrots in boiling water for 30 seconds and drain. Rinse them, place the carrots in an ovenproof dish, cover with water and boil for 10 - 15 seconds and run under the water. The carrot should still be somewhat firm. Drain and place in a bowl. To make the cake batter, shift all the ingredients together in a large bowl or a food processor until smooth and creamy. Put the mix in an electric blender and pulse to combine. Sprinkle the batter over the carrots and vegetables in the dish and put in the oven at 170oc for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 package fresh oysters | 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast | 1 bag romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Open oysters and place them on a baking sheet and bake for about 5 minutes. Remove from oven, crack open and set aside. Place the roast in a deep roasting pan and arrange in a single layer. Pour oysters on top of roast and season lightly. Cover and roast in preheated oven for about 3 hours, or until a meat thermometer reaches 145 degrees f. Remove roast, let rest for 10 minutes and slice to desired thickness. Place lettuce on a platter, place tomatoes, kidney beans and shredded meat on top. Serve warm.

title: Amaretto Balls
ingredients: 12 pieces amaretto, chilled | 12 pineapple rings, cut in half | 1/3 cup amaretto ( optional ) | 1/3 cup farina
instructions: Place the 1/3 cup amaretto into a small bowl, and then stir in the amaretto mixture until the amaretto has thickened. Roll the pineapple in the amaretto to coat all sides. Fill a deep frying pan with a small amount of oil, about half full. Place the pineapple rings into the hot oil, and cook, 3 to 5 minutes on each side. Serve the balls warm.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,shell pasta,ginger garlic paste,rhubarb,eggplant
title: Rhubarb and Eggplant
ingredients: 1 package uncooked small shell pasta | 1 eggplant, peeled cubed | 4 stalks rhubarb, cut into pieces | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack 4 to 6 inches from the heat source. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, 8 minutes. Drain. Mix the pasta, eggplant, rhubarb, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl. Continue cooking and stirring the eggplant mixture in the preheated oven until the rhubarb has softened, about 5 minutes. Gently mix in the ginger garlic paste.

Random Ingredients: green lentil,virgin olive oil,potato chip,anise seed,active yeast,lamb
title: Lamb and Potato N Lentils
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 3/4 cup warm potato water, plus | 2 tablespoons warm water | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 2 lbs ground lamb or 2 lbs ground chicken, with a good pinch of fat | 1 1/2 cups green lentils | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup of the warm potato water, sprinkle over the 3/4 cup of warm potato water. Cover and let stand in a warm place for about an hour, or until it has started bubbling. Add the rest of the water, olive oil, lamb or chicken, lentils and aniseed. Heat to boiling, then cover and simmer over low heat until the lentils are soft and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 1 hour. This recipe should take around 25 - 30 minutes to achieve the desired tenderness.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,orecchiette,fennel bulb,porcini mushroom,ice more,italian seasoning
title: Orecchiette With Porcini Mushrooms and Fennel
ingredients: 4 ounces dried orecchiette | 12 fresh porcini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 -3 fennel bulbs | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 1 1/4 cups tomato puree
instructions: Put water on to boil and add uncooked orecchiette. Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 10 minutes until soft. Slice the caps and remove the stems and discard. Cut into thick slices and soak in hot water for 10 minues to soften. Remove the mushrooms and set aside. Chop the fennel into pieces and boil until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. Place the orecchiette in boiling water for a few minutes and drain. Meanwhile, coarsely chop the mushrooms. Remove the stems from the mushrooms and chop the fennel. In a small bowl add the oregano, mushrooms and italian seasoning, and mix well. Drain the orecchiette and add to the mushroom mixture, stirring just until incorporated. If the mixture is too dry, add a little water. Dot with 1 - 2 tbsp of butter and return to the stove. Cook over low heat until the pasta begins to thicken a little bit. If it is still wet after a few minutes, raise the heat a little, stirring for 20 - 30 seconds. Serve warm with parmesan.

Random Ingredients: bechamel sauce,lemon pepper,tart apple,coriander seed,balsamic vinegar,buttermilk
title: Apple Cobbler with Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 1/3 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup bechamel sauce | 1 tart apple, cored and sliced ( i used a granny smith apple ) | 2 pinches coriander seeds, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f. In a small bowl, combine buttermilk and cornstarch. Coat a 9 pie plate with cooking spray. Place apple slices in pie plate. Drizzle with 1/2 of beetel syrup. Sprinkle with coriander and lemon pepper. Pour bechamel sauce over, cover and bake 20 minutes. Remove apple and coriander, sprinkle on a little more beetel if desired. Garnish with lemon slices.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,baby corn,snow pea,green chile,xanthan gum,pork baby back rib,vegetable protein,beef bouillon powder
title: Chile-Ribs Chow Mein Style
ingredients: 20 green chiles, chopped | 1 package frozen baby corn | 2 cans beef bouillon powder | 3 cups dried textured vegetable protein | 3/4 cup dried rice flour | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum, or more to taste | 20 snow peas, ends trimmed and strings removed, or as needed
instructions: Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Add green chiles with liquid. Cook and stir just until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in corn.

title: Farina Sambusa
ingredients: 1/3 cup farina or rice flour | 3/4 cup chickpeas, soaked | 1/3 granny smith apple, peeled and chopped | 1/4 cup button mushroom, finely chopped | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/4 teaspoon sumac
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine farina and chickpeas. Stir in apple, mushrooms, and wontons. Place 1 teaspoons filling into center of won ton wrapper. Brush edges of wrapper with water. Moisten top edges of wrapper with water. Fold bottom edge over filling, pressing down with a fork to seal. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Place samusas on baking sheet. Cook in a 375°f oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb stir-fry vegetables, diced into 1/2 inch cubes ( preferably baby bellas ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fennel seeds ( can sub 1 teaspoon dried fennel ) | 4 tablespoons dried barley ( can sub 1/4 cup red pepper flakes ) | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns
instructions: Mix the vegetables, and peppercorns together. In a wok or large skillet, heat the oil to medium high heat. Add vegetables except nuts. Stir fry for approximately 3 - 4 minutes. Add nuts and mix well. Cook for an additional 30 seconds. Turn heat to medium high and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,rump steak,heirloom tomato,chocolate chip,nonfat cream,green onion,orange bell pepper
title: Chinese Grilled Beef
ingredients: 1 lb boneless rump steak | 1 tablespoon orange bell pepper, sliced | 2 tablespoons green onions, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons heirloom tomatoes, cut in thin wedges | 8 ounces white chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients and pour into a large resealable plastic bag. Add the steak and turn to coat. Marinade in refrigerator 1 hour. Prepare grill. Remove meat from marinade. Discard remaining marinade. Cook steak over hot coals for 3 - 4 minutes on each side. Cut steak across grain into thin slices.

title: Pesto Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 9 ounces yogurt | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Combine the yogurt, romano cheese, pine nuts and the 3/4 cup of the olive oil or 1/4 cup of water. Mix well and store in refrigerator a note in this recipe.

Random Ingredients: vodka,rice,linguine,vegetable oil cooking spray,chili powder,green taco sauce
title: Noodle-Lamb Taco Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb linguine ( or your choice of pasta ) | 1 package frozen cut green taco sauce ( or your favorite brand ) | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup canned green taco sauce ( or your favorite brand )
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, warm the oil. Add the linguine and cook until it is just tender. Add the taco sauce and heat through. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Coke
ingredients: 1 cup cooking oil, for deep frying | 1 celery rib | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed, powdered
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat oil until very warm to 165°f stir in celery until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in brown sugar. Cool to room temperature.

title: Easy and Simple Tomato-Green Jam
ingredients: 1 green cardamom pod | 2 lbs of very ripe plum tomatoes or 2 lbs plum tomatoes, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 ounce simple syrup | 1/4 cup simple syrup ( optional )
instructions: Place cardamom pods in a small pot over med heat, and lightly toast the pods for 1 - 2 minutes, depending on the heat level. Watch to avoid burning. Turn pods often as tomatoes can suddenly burn if left unattended, remove them later. Place pods, cardamom, and simple syrup in a heavy saucepan, heat gently for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 5 more minutes, stirring often. Remove cardamom pods before serving. Remove cardamom pods discard and discard. Store in a jar in the fridge for up to 3 months. To use, remove pods and cardamom, and scrape off the seeds before stirring.

title: Green Chile Dipping Sauce for Pork or Beef in Saucepan
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream or 2 cups half and half | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 3 -5 drops almond extract or 3 -5 drops other almond extract | 3 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3 cans chopped green chilies ( i like to use one of those ) | 2 -3 cups ice water
instructions: In bowl blend cream until it is thick and fluffy. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill.

title: Gruyere and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb canned baked beans | 1 lb grated gruyere cheese or 1 lb swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Put the bean and cheese in a large ovenproof dish or casserole dish. Add spices. Cover with the cranberries. Pour hot water into the corners of the dish. Bake for 1/2 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,blueberry,orange peel,artichoke heart,turkey,brown basmati rice
title: Spice-Baked Turkey & Artichoke Rice With Blueberries
ingredients: 2 cups apple cider | 1 1/2 cups brown basmati rice | 1 cup reduced-sodium turkey fat, chopped into 1 inch chunks | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated zest and juice from a whole orange | 2 cups blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large saucepan, heat apple cider with the rice. Bring to a boil, cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes. Add turkey and artichokes.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,red food coloring,yellow pepper,tilapia fillet,cannellini bean
title: Tilapia Fish
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound tilapia fillets, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a skillet with cooking spray. Place the tilapia in the skillet, and season with a few drops of food coloring. Cook and stir until the fish is just opaque in the center, and is mostly opaque in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. Pour in the cannellini beans, and cook to mash some of the beans into the fish.

title: Pommes Antilles
ingredients: 1 kg red cabbage | 450 g plum tomatoes, roughly chopped | 700 ml chicken stock or 700 ml vegetable stock
instructions: Thoroughly tear the cabbage and cut in half. Place them in a colander. Cover with cold water, and put in the sink to drain thoroughly for up to 1 hour. Cut the tomatoes in half and cut each half into quarters. Combine a cup of fresh stock with the tomatoes. Bring the mixture to the boil and simmer briskly for 1 minute. Allow to cool. Add the cabbage, stir through. Place in sterilized jars and seal in hot sterilized jars.

title: Peanut Oil and Prunes
ingredients: 1 kg pitted prunes | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | salt and black pepper
instructions: Cut the prunes in half, removing the stones. Heat oil until smoking in a frypan. Stir fry prunes for about 5 minutes on each side. Season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

title: Quick and Easy Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 small red onion, diced | 1/4 cup taco-size flour tortilla, warmed
instructions: Heat the grill. Spray the grate with nonstick cooking spray. Place the onion in the center of each grilled tortilla. Roll up and place in a large bowl. Drizzle with taco sauce to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Tasty Shrimp Stock
ingredients: 1 liter beef stock or 1 liter seafood stock | 1 1/2 kg shrimp
instructions: Make your stock. Bring the stock to the boil. Add the shrimp. Boil for 10 minutes. Serve with bread, fresh vegetables, and crackers.

title: Simple Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups snow peas, cut in half | 1 cup bamboo shoot, cut in sticks | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, chopped
instructions: In a serving bowl place the snow peas, bamboo sticks and 1/4 cup of mint. Mix all together and put aside to chill.

Random Ingredients: snap pea,dill,macaroni,brandy,beef broth,coconut milk,mustard seed,new potato
title: Beef With Potato & Dill (Macaroni, Wats & Savoury Dill)
ingredients: 700 g new potatoes | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 cup fat-free beef broth | 1/2 cup reduced-fat coconut milk | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 cup snap peas, halved if large | 1 cup macaroni ( any shape macaroni shape ) | 1 cup fresh dill, roughly chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Pierce potatoes numerous times with a sharp knife. Place on oven tray and bake for 1 hour, or until potato is tender. Meanwhile in saucepan in 2 tablespoons brandy, cook potato in batches over medium high heat for 5 minutes, or until browned. Transfer to plate and keep warm. Increase heat and remaining brandy to high and boil, uncovered, for 1 minutes, or until reduced. Add broth and coconut milk and return to boil. Stir in mustard seeds. Return onion to pan and toss to coat. Bring to the boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until golden. Add snap peas and macaroni and cook for a further 5 minutes, tossing to combine. Add chopped dill and mix well. Add reserved potato slices to pan and heat through. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chocolate icing,thyme sprig,vegetable,taco seasoning mix,enchilada sauce
title: Delicious Vegan Enchilada Bars(Cook's Illust
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 10 ounces mixed vegetables, diced | thyme sprig, to garnish ( optional ) | chocolate icing, to coat the block ( store bought or home made )
instructions: In a bowl combine the 1 can of enchilada sauce with taco seasoning. Add the mixed vegetables and stir well to combine. Pour the mixture into a 9x13 pan or square baking pan. Cover the top with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Remove plastic wrap and slice in half to form two inch thick bars.

Random Ingredients: pea,cooking oil,milk powder,phyllo dough,chicken bouillon cube
title: Cheesey Phyllo Tarts
ingredients: 1 cup split peas | 8 ounces frozen phyllo dough, thawed and unfolded | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oil | 2 tablespoons milk powder
instructions: Cook peas in water to cover over medium heat until soft. Drain. Cool slightly. Add 1 bouillon cube and 4oz. Package of phyllo. Cut phyllo crosswise into 1/8 inch thick strips. Line muffin pans with half of phyllo, leaving 2 inches between each. Cover with frozen peas. Cover with another 2 phyllo sheet and phyllo. Cover with another sheet of phyllo. Cover with phyllo. Cover with thawed phyllo. Frost with remaining oil. Cover with plastic wrap. Chill for 1 hour. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,saffron thread,beef bouillon cube,water tofu,cayenne
title: Tofu
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs water-packed firm tofu | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( melted. i use a lite olive oil from a local grocery store ) | 8 cups water, to dissolve the saffron threads ( they usually come in packs and can be bought already ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Tosha, if you are using a tofu press, peel off all the outer coating from the tofu using a small vegetable peeler or a paper towel, then cut the tofu into 1/2 inch cubes. If using a lite olive oil, brush the tofu lightly with the vegetable shortening. Cover and let drain in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Drain the tofu and pat dry with a clean towel. Set aside. Filling,. While tofu is draining heat the water to boiling in a large pot, dutch oven or enamel pot. Add the saffron threads. Place the tofu cubes into the water and simmer for 15 minutes, or until tender. Strain the water, reserving the saffron water. When tofu is tender, remove tofu and place in the slow cooker. Set the pot aside for about 15 minutes to cool for easy shaping. The tofu can be eaten right away or refrigerated for an hour to set. If you want to keep the tofu at room temperature, reheat the saffron water. Just before serving stir in the saffron water. Spoon the mixture over tofu and serve.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,white peppercorn,ramen noodle,apricot preserve,glace cherry,extra beef
title: Gourmet Beef Ramen Dinner
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated ramen noodles | 400 -500 g extra lean ground beef ( or use extra beef and freeze the rest of the package ) | 1 packet taco seasoning ( i use hot-tasting mix. or use regular taco seasoning ) | white peppercorns | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | glace cherries, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Prepare ramen as per directions on package, then tear them into bite size pieces. Put noodles on a paper towel and put on your plate, then put the ground beef on top. Sprinkle with taco seasoning. Sprinkle peppercorns on top of beef and then cover with apricot preserves. Sprinkle cherries on top, if using.

Random Ingredients: wakame,mint leaf,oxtail,italian parsley,dark brown sugar,ice water,jalapeno pepper,apricot
title: Seared Oxtail With Apricots
ingredients: 8 oxtails, large | 1 cup apricot, chopped | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1 cup dark brown sugar, packed | 2 small fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped ( use 1/4-1/2 tsp or more to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups ice water or 1 1/2 cups water, ice crystals reserved | 5 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, very finely chopped
instructions: Remove the bone pith from the oxtail and cut it into 2 inch pieces. In a heavy dutch oven or other large deep skillet, place the oxtails in a single layer and stud it evenly with the apricots, parsley, brown sugar and chiles. Pour in enough ice water or water to barely cover the oxtails, and bring to a boil. Cover, and simmer over low heat for 6 hours, without stirring. Remove the oxtails and set them aside. In a bowl, using 2 forks, mix the remaining 1/4 cup water with the mint leaves to make a glaze. Remove the oxtails and pour the glaze over them. Cover, and steam for 1 1/2 hours over reduced heat, or until the sauce is thick and brown. Discard the leaves when done. Remove the oxtails, discarding the liquid they were cooked inches.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,wheat flour,lemon,gruyere cheese,epazote,cream cheese,bamboo skewer
title: Ww 4 Points - Pepito Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 ounce neufchatel cheese or 1/2 ounce cream cheese, room temperature | 1 -2 tablespoon soy sauce ( depending on taste ) | 3/4 ounce wheat flour | 1/4 ounce chopped fresh epazote ( or 1/4 teaspoon dried ) | 2 pieces lemon rind, from 1/4 lemon ( peel only, about 2 ounces-1 lemon rind and white pith ) | wooden bamboo skewer, soaked in water for 20 minutes
instructions: Beat the cheese, soy sauce and lemon rind together. Add the flour and mix well.

Random Ingredients: french bread,pork cutlet,rice krispies cereal,mushroom button,red wine vinegar,confectioner sugar,cardamom seed
title: Pork Cutlets With Cinnamon Rolls With Swiss Krispies
ingredients: 4 pork cutlets | 4 cups rice krispies cereal | 2 cups marshmallows or 2 cups sugar | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch slices
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Prepare a 9x13 baking dish. Cut each pork cutlet into 3 pieces.

title: Homemade Spaghetti
ingredients: 9 ounces pasta, any shape | 1/2 cup whiskey | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Boil water. Boil pasta until al dente, about 2 minutes. Rinse with cold iced water until cold to stop the cooking. Pour hot cooked pasta in an oven safe dish. Mix together whiskey, syrup, oregano and seasoning salt.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,anchovy paste,wheat bread,tomato puree,mint leaf,garlic powder
title: Chopstick for the Devil
ingredients: 6 slices whole wheat bread, cut in half horizontally | 2 medium ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and finely chopped | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 clove garlic powder | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste or 1 teaspoon minced anchovy | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | minced fresh mint leaves, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, grind the tomatoes, onion, garlic and anchovy paste into a smooth paste. Place in a shallow ovenproof dish and add the onion mixture. Dot with 2 teaspoons of water and top with remaining bread slices. Sprinkle with a little water, cover and cook in a pre heated 400°f oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until crusty. Garnish with minced mint leaves, if using.

title: Sweet Soy Dipping Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups extra virgin olive oil, plus | 2 -3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or 2 -3 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon garlic-flavored chili paste or 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1/2 medium stalk celery, chopped, including some | 1 cup sweet soy dip ( recommended -- kikkoman sweet soy dip )
instructions: Put a colander or strainer in the sink to catch any drips or other contaminants. Heat 2 - 3 tablespoons of the olive or vegetable oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add in garlic & chili paste or garlic powder, mix for a moment then add in the celery and celery and stir fry for a few minutes or so until the celery is slightly wilted. Add in sweet soy dip. Cook for a few minutes or until desired consistency, stir in a cup or two of warm water to thin out if necessary. Adjust seasoning of dip to your liking. Serve hot or cold with hot, cooked pasta. Keep your eye on it, so the dip does not get soggy.

title: A Scotsman's Stew
ingredients: 300 g pearl barley | 150 g all-purpose flour | 150 g snow peas
instructions: Peel, wash and chop vegetables and combine with barley. Mix well. Add just enough water to come to a boil and cook until the barley is tender.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,white sugar,beet,penne pasta,green cabbage,new potato,red pepper flake,chocolate square
title: Beef and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 8 ounces dry penne pasta | 1 lb beef flank steak, sliced paper thin | 1 package sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced | 8 small beets, peeled, sliced in half with the tops attached | 8 slices green cabbage | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate squares, melted | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Apricot Filling
ingredients: 4 large apricots | 1 1/4 teaspoons accent seasoning ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 4 leaves fresh rosemary leave
instructions: Using a sharp knife cut off the tops and bottoms of the apricots. Slice the fruit into 1/2 inch pieces. Sprinkle with accent, marjoram, and rosemary. Cool and refrigerate for 1 hour before using. Keeps well for up to 2 weeks in an airtight glass jar.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,sugar,italian sausage link,coleslaw mix,rotel tomato chilies
title: Italian Sugar-Sauce Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 8 ounces light turkey italian sausage links | 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies, undrained | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 pint plain low-fat greek yogurt
instructions: Heat oven to grease 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Place coleslaw in large bowl.

title: Swiss Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 sweet onions | 300 ml grape juice | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons double cream
instructions: Quarter the onions and slice thinly. Cover with cold water and bring to boil. Boil uncovered for 10 minutes until soft. Use an open flame. Place in a food processor and pureé until smooth and creamy. Return to a frying pan and fry over medium heat for five minutes, stirring often. Add the grape juice and hot pepper sauce. Heat oven to 200 degrees celsius and place in an oven proof casserole dish. Bake. Heat in oven for 15 to 20 minutes until boiling. Stir. Simmer for five minutes and remove from oven. Stir. Heat in the microwave for one minute or until hot. Pour in cream. Let stand for 20 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,vanilla bean,chuck,triple sec,chat masala,whipping cream,milk chocolate chip,irish whiskey
title: Baileys Hot Pot Chicken
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 vanilla bean ( split in half ) | 2 tablespoons whole irish whiskey | 1/2 cup double sec or 1/2 cup drinking chocolate | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1/4 cup milk chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons light chat masala
instructions: Rinse the chicken under cold running water, and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the pod from its inner end, then remove the peel and pith from the pods. Cut the pods into 2 inch lengths and scrape out any browned skin. Cut each slit into quarters. Tie the dried vanilla bean, and any extra seeds, inside the chicken, in pairs with the cardi. Place the chicken pieces into a large saucepan or dutch oven. Add the whiskey, half of the vanilla pod pod seeds and the 2 tablespoons sugar or water and bring to a boil over moderate low heat. Skim any foam from the surface of the liquid. Add the chicken pieces. Cover pot and simmer, turning once for 1 1/2 hours or until golden and tender. Remove the chicken and vegetables from the pot and save the juices. Save the solids in the saucepan. To make the chocolate topping, add the cream, milk chocolate and chaat masala. Whip to a frosting consistency with a spoon and spooning over the chicken pieces before serving.

Random Ingredients: banana,chili pepper,dashi stock,lemon pepper,white fish fillet,confectioner ' sugar
title: Sweet Chilli Fish With Bananas
ingredients: 1 packet firm white fish fillets | 1 tablespoon dashi stock | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 hot chili peppers, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Rinse the fish filets thoroughly under cold water and pat dry with absorbent paper. Arrange on a non stick baking tray and spoon over the dashi, lemon pepper and chilli. Gently roll up the fillets and cut into 3 cm pieces. Pour the liquid into a frying pan and bring to the boil. Remove the fish pieces and add to the pan to simmer for 5 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in the lemon pepper and icing sugar, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chocolate,chili paste,cilantro,basil,green pepper,button mushroom
title: Chili Chocolate
ingredients: 400 g button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh chili paste | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple juice | fresh cilantro, to garnish | fresh green pepper, chopped to garnish | 3 fresh pineapple slices, to garnish | grated chocolate, to garnish
instructions: Blanch mushrooms for 2 minutes in boiling water. Remove and set aside. Heat sugar to boiling, add toasted basil, chilli paste and parmigiano. Add remaining ingredients and stir until boiling. Immediately remove from heat and stir in mushrooms. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,garlic powder,parsnip,pepperoni sausage,sausage meat,chili paste
title: Chili Potatoes
ingredients: 18 large parsnips, peeled and cut in wedges | 1 cup of loose smoked sausage meat | 1/4 cup garlic powder | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoni sausage, diced
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat lightly cook the sausage meat until evenly browned.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs
ingredients: 5 kg pork ribs | 1/2 lemon peel | 1 liter icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 1 liter cider vinegar
instructions: Cut the pork ribs into serving sized pieces, remove any excess fat and put into a large bowl. Pierce the lemon peel all over. Place the sugar and vinegar in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Place the pork pieces over the boiling sugar syrup. Return to a boil, uncovered, reduce heat to minimum and simmer for about 40 minutes, or until pork is tender. Allow to cool slightly before you begin making the icing, remove the outer coating from the pork, and then coat each piece with the warm icing. Cover and store in the fridge. As the pork marinates in the syrup, you can use your hands to squeeze it from the lemon peel into the vinegar. The trick with making this properly is to rub all the sticky residue off the outer coating off of the pork. If you are using a pork marinator you may need to put the lid on the appliance and set to one side to get the hang of it. After about three hours, the pork will be completely cooked. This is a very easy method but it is also one of the tools that makes giving the pork a distinctive flavour. Remembering the mixture in your bowl is key here to give the pork a good coating with the mixture. Using a slotted spoon, remove the pork from the syrup and place on the plate with the lemon peel on the top. Cover them with the icing sugar, then leave aside. Place a large bamboo skewer on the rack in the oven. Preheat the oven to 150°c heat the racks in the oven for 90 minutes, or until the pork is fully cooked, turning them in the oven every ten minutes or so. Remove the pork from the oven and leave to cool. The racks will last for a good week, and will allow you to make more servings.

title: Aegean Cabbage and Anchovy Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarse sea salt and black pepper | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 -3 stalk fresh cos lettuce or 1 -3 large cos lettuce | 1/4 - 1/3 cup anchovy paste, to taste ( optional ) | 1 -1 teaspoon maggi seasoning or 1 -1 teaspoon seasoning, to taste. ( optional )
instructions: Place salt in a colander inside a cup or non metallic container with a tight lid that fits snugly over it. Rinse well with cold running water until it's cold. It will keep for a couple of weeks as it ages. Place all the ingredients in to your big bowl. You can also use the anchovy paste and maggi for a change of flavor. Taste for any colour or saltyness you like. Taste for seasoning. The anchovies can be bought bottled from a good health or spice and can be added to the salad while it's still in the container at the time. Leave in the fridge for a few hours for flavours to develop. Enjoy.

title: Affogato in Espresso(Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1/2 cup espresso, cold | 1 -2 kaffir lime leaf, finely shredded | 1 pinch ground espresso, extra-virgin if you wish
instructions: Place the espresso in a medium size bowl. Slowly add the lime leaves and a pinch of ground espresso and stir. Strain or pour the warm espresso into the bowl, being careful to remove any loose solids. Taste to make sure it's flavorful enough, or if it's too strong, add a pinch of ground espresso and stir again. Pour the espresso into a serving dish or decorative crystal or whatever container you wish to serve it in.

title: Wassail
ingredients: 32 ounces scallions, chopped ( white and light green parts only ) | 1/2 cup sugar snap pea, ends trimmed ( or snow pea pods ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger or 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 cup orange, juice or 1/2 cup lemon, juice from fresh fruit
instructions: Put the scallions and sugar in a pan of boiling water, cover and stir. Bring to a rapid boil, remove from the heat, and let sit 8 minutes, then drain thoroughly. Combine scallions mixture with the orange juice, or lemon juice. Serve immediately. Variation,. Add 2 tb. Chopped parsley when stirring hot, or cook scallions and sugar in 1/4 cup water 3 minutes. You may use 2 chopped scallions, or only 1/4 cup for color.

title: Indian Green Chilt Chips
ingredients: 4 cups corn tortilla chips | 4 tablespoons green chilies, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand ( optional )
instructions: Break each grain into four. Heat a nonstick skillet on medium. Dry out the tortilla chips by dropping them into the oil, shaking the pan until they begin to pop up a bit. Turn them over with a fork and fry the other side until browned. Remove from pan and place on paper towels to absorb excess oil. In the same pan heat the remaining oil over medium high heat. Add the chilies, marjoram and saffron. Cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the green chiles and cook one minute, stirring. Reduce heat to low, and cook the chips uncovered for 3 minutes. Stir.

title: Simple and Delicious Tofu Burritos
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces firm tofu of choice | 12 ounces canned chopped mild green chilies
instructions: Wet the tofu with cold water, if you can gather it up from the corners of the container and cut down along the width of the block you should be making your burritos. Wash and pat dry. Cut the block in half horizontally. Take one quarter and slice it lengthwise into about 12 equal squares across, but try not to cut right through. If you cut through the middle of each square to make your burritos smaller, leave at least 3/4 inch of space for them when cooking. You will be able to easily make your burritos later. Cook the tofu according to your best method, if necessary. Drain the water if there is any before removing from the pan. Spread a thin layer of melted tofu on a plate, top it with a layer of chilies and repeat until all the tofu is used up. If you have a plate with room between the tofu and the pan, it will help you with your melting of the tofu when you are going to fry them. Let rest at least ten minutes. If you store the tofu at room temperature or freeze it for later use they will last a long time, so start with the re heating method when deciding whether to re heat them the next day.

title: Roasted Mexican Green Tea
ingredients: 6 dry guajillo chilies ( stemmed and seeded ) | 1/2 cup raw rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Wrap 1/2 of the guajillo chilies in aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the oven for about 20 minutes, until the skin is lightly burnt and the chiles are soft. Remove chiles and reserve cooking liquid. Turn chiles over, cool and remove stems and seeds. Place chiles in a saucepan of warm water and bring to a simmer. Dump chiles and water in pan and simmer for about 30 minutes. Remove from heat, cover and let stand for about an hour. Transfer chiles and liquid to blender, add vinegar and coriander, puree until smooth. Use as needed.

title: Mango Chutney Appetizer
ingredients: 1 large sweet mango chutney | 1 large cardamom pod
instructions: Place the mango chutney in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Using a long spatula, scrape down the side of the bowl. Sprinkle with cardamom powder. Store in covered plastic container.

title: Caramelized Buttermilk
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 green sweet bell pepper, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. In a small bowl, dissolve brown sugar in buttermilk. Spoon this carmelized buttermilk over chopped green sweet pepper.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,sirloin steak,honey,chinese five spice powder,plum tomato
title: Spicy Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into chunks | 20 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 4 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a bowl. Marinate in the fridge for an hour or two. Thread beef onto skewers. Preheat broiler. Broil 4 - 5 minutes each side until done.

Random Ingredients: green olive,rice wine vinegar,italian seasoning,vinegar,tomato green chilies
title: Spanish Dip
ingredients: 1 cup green olives | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 2 tablespoons dry rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning, crushed
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine olives, vinegar, tomatoes, and chiles. Season with italian seasoning. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Beef and Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 head garlic, cloves peeled | 2 tablespoons shallots | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 4 ounces chilies, canned or 4 ounces diced red jalapeno peppers | 3 cans beef broth | 8 ounces sourdough bread. can be subbed for sourdough bread | 1 cup buttermilk ( optional )
instructions: Place the cleaned cauliflower head and garlic cloves on to parchment paper and let them sweat off overnight in the refrigerator, then remove and set aside. Next day, finely chop the garlic. Place the beef and chilies in a large pot and add the broth. Bring to a simmer. Then add the peeled cubed cauliflower and garlic. Simmer on a medium low heat for 3 hours. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 250c. Cut bread and place it on a baking tray and bake until golden brown. Remove from oven. Add the buttermilk just before serving or let it sit for a bit before serving. I serve this in bowls with a side of a bowl of sourdough french bread, some meat, garlic bread etc.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,tomato juice,large shrimp,orange peel,heavy cream
title: Shrimp in Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 cup light italian dressing | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon tomato juice
instructions: Combine shrimp, 1/2 cup of italian dressing, cream and orange peel in a medium bowl and toss well. Refrigerate for at least 10 minutes. Heat heavy cream, remaining italian dressing, tomato juice, and orange peel in a small sauce pan over low heat. When sauce begins to boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Orecchiette, Sausage & Oregano
ingredients: 8 ounces orecchiette | 2 ounces smoked sausage or 2 ounces smoked lard
instructions: Cook the orecchiette according to the instructions on the packet and add the smoked sausage or use a sausage fat if you wish. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan which has been coated with the orecchiette. Add the smoked sausage or lard and toss well. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,spanish onion,white bread,chicken quarter,bitter melon,cheddar cheese,flax seed,bacon
title: Grilled Chicken and Bacon Sandwiches with Fax Seed and Onion
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 2 tablespoons ground flax seeds | 2 tablespoons minced spanish onions | 4 slices crisp cooked bacon | 4 chicken quarters, boiled, skinned and shredded | 2 slices cheddar cheese, cut into 1 x 1/2-inch pieces | 1 sweet red bell pepper | 2 slices fried bitter melon
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Make the sandwiches by spreading the flax seeds inside the bread slices. Place the bread on the grill and lightly toast, 4 to 5 minutes per side. Place the bacon, chicken, cheddar, bell pepper, and fried bitter melon around the bread. Serve hot.

title: Orange Pear Salad
ingredients: 1 package reduced fat cream cheese, room temp cream cheese flavor | 1 teaspoon sugar-free orange marmalade | 3 tablespoons freshly grated mixed nuts | 1 pear, cored and coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix cream cheese and marmalade and place on a serving platter. Sprinkle with chopped peaches.

title: Sloppy Giuseppes (Chinese Meat Fritters)
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin, trimmed of fat | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tomatoes, finely chopped | 4 dried jalapeno chilies, stemmed, seeded and finely chopped, about 1 1/2 cups | 1/3 cup light chili-flavored chili sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Cut meat into small dice. Place meat in medium bowl and stir in 2 tablespoons hot sauce, tomatoes, jalapenos, 2 tablespoons chili sauce and oil.

title: Honey Peanut Granola
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry-roasted unsalted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons unsweetened balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 lime, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Transfer 1 1/2 cups of peanuts to a bowl, and toss with the vinegar, molasses, and grand marnier. Spread the mixture out in an 8 inch square baking pan, to form a 9 inch × 8 inch round. Make sure the peanuts are entirely covered. Stir the remaining peanuts and remaining 1 1/2 cups peanut mixture into the peanut mixture, and sprinkle with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons of sugar. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the sauce has reduced and begins to caramelize.

title: Quinoa Burfi
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons ground unsalted butter | 1/2 red bell pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Cook quinoa in a 2 1/2 to 3 quart heavy saucepan over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Drain quinoa in a sieve, discarding cooking liquid. Melt butter in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat until foam subsides. Add quinoa, bell pepper and chocolate.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,navel orange,dill pickle,black olive
title: Baked Cuban Smoked Nuts
ingredients: 1 medium navel orange, peeled | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2/3 cup sliced black olives or 2/3 cup green olives, of your choice | 1/3 cup chopped dill pickle
instructions: Cut top of orange gently off of peel in one long strip of orange peel. Carefully remove peel.

title: Germans Sweet Nests
ingredients: 6 jasmine rice, cooked and cooled | 2 ounces german sweet chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In medium bowl combine rice, sweet chocolate, and cilantro. Place 1 teaspoon of mixture on each of 2 wooden sticks or bamboo skewers. Broil until edges of cookies are browned, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,frying chicken,double cream,maraschino cherry,nonfat plain yogurt,pretzel ring
title: Blue Cheese Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 kg frying chicken ( with wings or other parts of chicken meat in it ) | 1 -2 cup blue cheese ( or your favourite cheese ) | 4 medium size pretzel rings | 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/350°f. Wash chicken well and cut the wing or drumsticks into individual chicken breasts. Place 1 tablespoon of crumb topping in each chicken breast. Place chicken breasts in roasting tin with plenty of surface area, spread blue cheese over chicken. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and pour over chicken. Place tray in oven and bake for 30 - 40 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Frozen Kimchee Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb kimchee, in small pieces | 1/3 cup pistachio nut, coarsely chopped
instructions: Mix together the kimchee and pistachios.

Random Ingredients: margarine,chickpea,coriander sprig,wheat flour,almond extract,cream cheese,seasoning salt
title: Moroccan Cream Cheese Balls With Chickpea Filling
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream ( not lowfat ) or 1/2 cup plain yogurt ( not lowfat ) | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup chopped almonds or 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 2 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 coriander sprig
instructions: Blend dressing ingredients in blender, add cream cheese and blend till smooth. Add almonds and blend till just combined. Shape mixture into 1 inch balls and roll in almonds.

title: Nacho Fettuccine  (Easy and Fast!)
ingredients: 2 cups of your favourite cheese ( i like cheddar, jack, etc ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup chunky salsa | 3/4 cup of your favourite recipe fettuccine ( i like whole wheat ) | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Add rest of ingredients and cook on med low until the pasta and ingredients are heated through. Toss with grated cheese. Garnish with chopped parsley if desired. Freezes well in plastic freezer bags.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,red chilies,apple cider,lobster meat,chickpea,chili pepper,coriander powder
title: Spicy Lobster Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons minced red chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander powder | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 3 tablespoons light soy sauce or 3 tablespoons tamari, to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons apple cider ( i used non-alcoholic cider ) | 1/2 cup cooked lobster meat | 3 tablespoons chickpeas ( cooked )
instructions: Add all ingredients in to the bowl and mix well. Serve with your favourite dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,greek oregano,chili powder,black eyed pea,red chilies,grainy mustard,ginger
title: Chilli Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 300 g frozen black-eyed peas | 2 tablespoons coarse grainy mustard | 2 red chilies, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried greek oregano | chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Place the peas in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes, or until tender. Drain and rinse the peas. Dry fry the peas in hot oil or in the microwave for 6 - 8 minutes, or until dark golden brown, turning now and then. Drain on kitchen paper. Add all of the spices with the meat to the peas. To serve, mound onto a warmed plate and sprinkle the fresh ground black pepper.

title: Jalapeno Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 cans rotel tomatoes, drained | 2 cans jalapeno chiles | 1 can petite diced tomatoes | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 4 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Place in crockpot, tomatoes, ginger and garlic in food processor, and process until mostly smooth. Sprinkle with grand marnier and add basil to blend, pour over tomato mixture and stir. Store in refrigerator.

title: Quick Beef Roulades
ingredients: 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 300 g sweet beef bones with marrow | 1 1/2 cups apricot preserves | 1/3 cup seasoned dry bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200f or 190°c. Place onions, bones, preserves and bread crumbs into a roasting jug. Toss around. Transfer to the oven and bake for 30 - 45 mins until the meat is cooked through, the onions should have turned golden. This could take up to 25 - 30 mins if made in a large bowl. Serve.

title: Blueberry Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 3 1/2 pounds boneless lamb shanks | 2 cups chopped fresh mushrooms | 4 cloves garlic, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried bread crumbs | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Place lamb shanks in a deep pot, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, and cook over high heat until almost all the liquid has boiled away, about 20 minutes. Skim off any scum from the surface. Meanwhile, drain excess fat from the pan, and place mushrooms and garlic in a separate large pot. Cover, and place over high heat. Cook and stir mushrooms and garlic until tender. Set aside to cool slightly. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove scum from lamb shanks. Stuff bread crumbs into the underside of each lamb shank. Place a few crumbs onto a plate, and sprinkle with dried bread crumbs. Roll each lamb shank in the bread crumbs, coating each one evenly. Arrange on a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, or to desired doneness. When the first hour is up, remove from the oven, and let cool about 15 minutes. Place blueberries into a bowl, and sprinkle with a little more crumbs. Slice or chop one or two cloves garlic and serve with the lamb shanks.

title: Authentic Mexican Queso Content
ingredients: 1 teaspoon hot red chili powder | 1/4 ounce cotija cheese ( may use queso fresca )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a mortar or spice grinder until a smooth paste forms. Pour into a medium bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for an hour. Strain out the paste into a small pot, pressing gently on the paste with the back of a spoon. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,apple,water,brie cheese,kalamata olive,japanese eggplant,taco seasoning
title: Baked Greek-Style Omelette (Omurice Kompanosalata)
ingredients: 1 large japanese eggplant | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 3 tablespoons water | 1/2 ounce brie cheese | 1 ounce kalamata olive | 4 large kalamata olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Pierce the eggplant a couple of times with a fork, and place in a roasting pan. Brush the eggplant with water and sprinkle with seasoning. Bake in oven until it tender, about 45 minutes. Remove from oven and slice the roast eggplant in half lengthwise, then slice each half lengthwise into thick slices. Place on a warm serving plate. Warm the taco seasoning mix following package directions, then drizzle a small amount of taco seasoning over the top before tossing to coat. To serve, top with brie, olives, and a few slices of the roast eggplant.

title: Mexican Bratwurst
ingredients: 1 lb lean pork shoulder, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 3 bratwurst | 2 cups canned green chili salsa | 1 cup red wine | 1 green chili salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the bratwurst. Place them on the rack of a roasting pan and sprinkle the brats with salt. Place under the griller and cook for 4 minutes, turning once. When brown on the outside, move to a cooler side of the oven and continue cooking for about 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°f. Let the bratwurst rest in the oven while you cook the rest of the brats. Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the bratwurst for 5 minute drain and place in a baking dish. In a small bowl, mix together the chilies and salsa. Spread the chili and salsa over the brats and bake at 325°f for 15 minutes.

title: Easy Microwave Fish and Rice (Nam Prik Nam Pla)
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed | 4 ounces fish sauce
instructions: Put rice and fish sauce on the bread machine in the order directed by the manufacturer. Start the machine running, using the full two cups of rice. When the bread machine signals the end of the process, start the rice cycle. At the end of the two hours, remove the fish sauce from the heat. If the rice mixture has been drained by the time indicated by your bread machine, stir the rice in the machine before it is done along with the fish sauce. Pour into an airtight container.

title: Blueberry Dijon
ingredients: 16 fresh blueberries ( not frozen ) | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons fresh blueberries ( not frozen )
instructions: Combine mustard and blueberries in a small bowl until coated. Pour into a nonstick frying pan. Cook over medium to low heat 1 minute or till top starts to bubble. Remove from heat and spread to cool. Cover with plastic wrap and chill overnight. Garnish with whole fresh blueberries.

Random Ingredients: margarine,lemon peel,orange bell pepper,kernel corn,white rice,italian breadcrumb,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Zippy Rice Balls With Citrus Crisp
ingredients: 3 3/4 cups uncooked white rice or 3 1/4 cups brown rice, rinsed if not already rinsed | 2 medium oranges ( zest of, no green pith, and most white pith ) or 2 medium orange bell peppers, deseeded and finely chopped ( zest of, no green pith, and most white pith ) | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup raisins or 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel ( or lime peel ) | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Soak raisins in hot water for 30 minutes to plump them, then drain. Spray a 10 inch skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Combine rice, oranges or peppers, corn, raisins, bread crumbs, lemon peel and ras el hanout in a bowl. Roll 2 teaspoons of rice mixture into balls the size of large walnuts, and press them into the palm of your hand. Roll in egg wash and place on top of a greased 12 inch skillet. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake 30 minutes longer, or until browned and cooked through. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing. Serve as an appetizer with pickled beets and green salad on the side.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,chili,lemon zest,tamari,chicken meat,bisquick,italian salad dressing
title: Crispy Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chili | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 1/2 cups bisquick | 1 cup italian salad dressing | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken meat
instructions: Preheat oven to combine all ingredients except chicken in a large bowl.

title: Pork (Or Beef) Fry or Bake
ingredients: 1 kg pork or 1 kg beef | 500 ml water, just enough for the water level to dissolve | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons dried yeast | 1 teaspoon spicy chili oil
instructions: Put the water and dry yeast. Mix, and let sit until foamy. In a fryer put the meat, and fry for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove from water. Put all the other ingredients. Stir till yeast softens. Pour mix into pan, cook on low heat. You will know as the water boils on the burner. The meat will be well covered, take the cover off. It should be cooked through, but not mushy. Serve with toast and vegetables of your choice. I like sliced boiled potatoes, noodles, or green peas.

title: Spicy Scones
ingredients: 500 g plain flour | 150 g jalapeno peppers | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated, from 1 large orange | 500 g poblano chiles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl, except for pepper and pepper. Put the mixture into a food processor and blend it until it is a smooth paste. Add pepper and stir. Dampen hands and shape into small scones. Svek them on baking tray with sides. Bake at 175c for 20 - 25 mins til browned.

Random Ingredients: scallion,ginger garlic paste,extra virgin olive oil,irish cream,ketchup
title: My Dad's Famous Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup ketchup | 1 1/4 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste ( or more, if you're brave ) | 4 scallions, sliced | 1/2 cup irish cream
instructions: In a small microwave safe bowl combine oil, ketchup, ginger garlic paste, and sliced scallions. Microwave on high until blended, about 2 minutes. Stir to mix evenly with oil. Serve immediately over fresh steamed veggies, rice, or your favorite pasta.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,red wine vinegar,white wine vinegar,mace,corn oil,golden syrup
title: Nate's Infused Ripe Vinegar
ingredients: 6 1/2 cups whole grain rice vinegar | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 5 teaspoons ground mace | 1 teaspoon ground white wine vinegar
instructions: Stir the dry red wine vinegar, golden syrup, corn oil and red wine vinegar in a large saucepan until the honey is dissolved, then place on low heat. Simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until reduced to 1 cup, about 45 minutes. Stir in the mace and remove from heat. Sterilize an 8 cup or larger glass jar and pour in the raspberry vinegar mixture. Attach the lid to the jar and refrigerate at least 1 day, shaking the jar about every few hours. Shake before using.

title: Pine Nut Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar salsa, preferably mexican-style | 1 can crushed pineapple in syrup, drained | 1 red chile pepper, seeded and minced | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 cup vinegar, divided
instructions: Rinse salsa until no longer cloudy. Drain. Place pineapple, pepper, and 1 tablespoon rum or sweetener in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,prosciutto,dill sprig,creamy peanut butter,beef stew meat,bread
title: Beef and Barley Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/4 pounds boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 8 slices country bread | 1 cup pearl barley, soaked in water for 15 minutes and drained | 3 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto, chopped | fresh dill sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the meat in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine the peanut butter, and 1/3 cup of the water, and mix well. Remove meat from the marinade, and toss with this mixture to coat. Sprinkle top of the meat with 1/3 cup of the barley, and top with 1/2 the prosciutto and 3/4 cup barley, then 3/4 cup of the remaining barley. Sprinkle with 1/2 the scallions. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until meat is tender and barley is tender.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,nutmeg,rye flour,veal,cooking oat,dark brown sugar,spaghetti
title: Faux Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rye flour | 2 tablespoons quick cooking oats | 1/2 cup ground veal | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 3/4 cup chopped blanched almond paste | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 1 package spaghetti
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the flour, oats, veal, sugar, almond paste and nutmeg until well mixed. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the spaghetti in baking dish, and pour the meat sauce evenly over. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until center is firm.

Random Ingredients: nori,caster sugar,cinnamon,cake,seasoning salt,hot chili pepper,chili pepper flake,cream cheese
title: Crunchy Spicy Sushi Roll!
ingredients: 1 packet cake, cut into 2 cm chunks | 1 can chili peppers, chopped | 2 hot chili peppers, finely chopped | 150 g cream cheese ( room temperature ) | 5 packets maggi seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 teaspoons hot chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup caster sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Grease baking tray with butter. Spray tray with oil spray. Combine chillies, chillies and cream cheese in a bowl. Add salt, cinnamon and chili flakes. Beat with a fork. Gradually beat in sugar. Pour into tray. Mix well. Press 1/4 of the mixture onto the base of the tray. Continue this process until all mixture is used. Spread the rest of the mixture on top. Dip fingers into the prepared icing. Spray fingers with oil spray.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf powder,tamari soy sauce,pecorino romano cheese
title: Quick and Easy Homemade Pecorino Cheese Blend
ingredients: 500 g freshly grated pecorino romano cheese, or a combination of grated parmesan andiago cheese | 1/2 cup tamari soy sauce ( or substitute with dark soy sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon bay leaf powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor and process until smooth and creamy. This can take up to 10 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a medium bowl. Cool to room temperature before storing in the refrigerator. Enjoy.

title: Calvados Salad
ingredients: 2 romaine lettuce, cut into 1/4-inch wide strips, washed and dried | 1 can canned chickpeas, drained and washed | 1 medium jalapeno, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, washed and chopped | 1/4 cup shallot, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup calvados ( apple brandy ) | fresh rind from 1 jalapeno
instructions: Toss greens with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon of salt in a large salad bowl. Add drained chickpeas and jalapej and toss to evenly coat. Sprinkle with parsley and shallots. Drizzle with remaining teaspoon of salt. Garnish with remaining fresh jalapeños.

Random Ingredients: pear,tomato puree,polish sausage,chili pepper flake,cheddar cheese,active yeast,couscous
title: Quick & Easy Stove-Top Pizza
ingredients: 2/3 cup dry polenta or 2/3 cup medium-grain polenta | 1 large unpeeled medium-sized cooked tart fresh pear | 3/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 can tomato puree | 7/8 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3/4 cup warm polenta or 3/4 cup medium-grain polenta | 1/3 cup cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Dough, preheat the oven to 400°f. Butter a 13 x 8 inch baking dish. Finely chop the pear and place in a food processor. Pulse the pear on to finely ground, but not to pureed, in a medium bowl. Add 1/4 teaspoon of the hot pepper flakes and pulse to combine. Add the tomato puree, 3/4 teaspoon of the dry hot pepper flakes and the yeast and process until it begins to mix. Add the warm polenta in a slow steady stream and process well, scraping down any lumps, until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Transfer the dough to the buttered bowl and cover with a kitchen towel. Let rise until doubled, about 40 minutes. Bake the pizza for 15 to 20 minutes, until the bottom and edges are golden.. Pizza sauce, place the polenta in a medium size bowl and sprinkle with the mozzarella and chili flakes. Pour on about 3/4 cup of hot pizza sauce and toss well. Serve the pizza topped with any other dipping sauce.

title: Italian Hot Sausages With Apples
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 cup unsweetened apple, chunks | 4 serrano chilies, roasted, peeled, seeded | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f and line a baking sheet with foil. Cut the sausage into 1/2 to ¾ inch cubes. Place the sausage and apple chunks in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet, and roast in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until tender. Remove to a cutting board. When cool, dice and transfer to a mixing bowl. Add the serrano peppers, cocoa, and hot italian sausage, and stir until everything is well mixed. Use immediately or store in refrigerator.

title: Tomato and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 medium tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 medium red cabbage, finely grated | 1 small red onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 4 medium ounces cooked short tube pasta, small amount uncooked | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar or 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except your pasta and vinegar in a bowl. Toss pasta with dressing until all is coated. You may garnish with additional tomato wedges if desired.

title: Peking a Boozy Champagne!
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 3 -4 cups apple juice ( depending on how you like your champagne ) | 3 -6 tablespoons champagne vinegar, as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f/230°c. Mix together the peppercorns, cumin and apple juice and set aside. Line a large baking pan with aluminum foil and spray with oil. Spray with oil, then the vinegar. Sprinkle with salt. Dump the peppercorns in and bake for 15 minutes. Serve while hot, on the side of the warm champagne.

title: Simple Penne Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 loaf thick crusty french bread | 1 1/2 cups dry penne pasta
instructions: Cut a small slit in 1 crusty loaf of crusty french bread. Then slice the 3 loaves into fourths. Insert 1 piece of bread into the slit. Dip the bread into boiling water until tender. Drain pasta. Put drained pasta into a mixing bowl. Cut an x in the bottom of the bread, so that it will be easy to remove. Then dip bread into the bread mixture. Dip both sides of the bread in the hot water and into the drained pasta. Add more bread to the pasta mixture when desired.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,mushroom,arborio rice,walnut oil,maraschino cherry,nonfat milk powder,tapioca starch
title: Vegetarian Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 cups nonfat dry milk powder, see note | 3 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 3 tablespoons tapioca starch | 4 cups gruyere cheese, shredded fine | 1 cup maraschino cherry, halved ( optional )
instructions: To make the cake, mix nonfat dry milk powder, rice, 3 cups vegetable or fat free dry milk powder and walnut oil. Pour slowly into 8 springform pan or deep 22 inch cake pan lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle top with cheese and swirl. Bake 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Remove from oven place on platter and garnish with maraschinos. Note, to make the cherry filling, mix the 5 tbsp of olive oil and the 3 tbsp of tapioca starch in small pot at medium heat. Stir constantly until thick and bubbly at edges. Remove from heat and stir in cherries. To serve warm, cut cake into 6 wedges. Lay wedges on platter and spoon the hot filling over the wedges.

title: Southern Style Calamonic (Crack)
ingredients: 1 pound squid, cleaned | 3 slices long grain bread
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice the cleaned squid into rings about 2 inches in diameter. Insert a thin slice of bread into each ring. Wear the rings in hot, nonstick skillet over medium high heat until browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: navel orange,lemon peel,french baguette,greek yogurt,bamboo skewer
title: Quick and Easy Greek Cheeseburgers
ingredients: 8 slices navel oranges | 1/3 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 16 large fat free french baguettes | 8 bamboo skewers
instructions: Combine the yoghurt and lemon peel. Cover and refrigerate for up to 1 hour. Thread 1 orange onto each skewer. Preheat grill to medium high heat. Place skewers on grill, close lid. Grill for 3 - 5 minutes until just cooked, turning once. Serve on toasted french baguettes. Use up all remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,hard egg,cremini mushroom,cauliflower,chicken breast half
title: Easy Chicken Breasts With Shiitaki
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 lbs cremini mushrooms, halved | 2 -3 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 2 heads cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Place chicken in a baking dish.

Random Ingredients: double cream,almond,yeast,red lentil,taco shell,tomato soup,tart apple
title: Mexican Style Lentil Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil | 1 can red condensed tomato soup | 1 tart apple, peeled and grated | 3 tablespoons instant yeast | 12 taco shells | 14 ounces double cream | 2 -3 tablespoons ground almonds, toasted
instructions: Rinse lentils under cold water and drain. In a saucepan add lentils, tomato soup, grated apple and yeast.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,milk,beef steak,baby spinach,yellow squash,rice wine vinegar,jamon serrano
title: Caribbean Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 8 frozen boneless beef steaks, thawed ( about 1/2 to 1 pound total, not too thin, like steak fillets ) | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 package yellow squash, sliced lengthwise | 1/2 cup evaporated milk | 2 teaspoons sweet rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 jamon serrano, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place frozen beef steaks and 2 cups of water in a large dutch oven.

Random Ingredients: vegan cheddar cheese,sourdough bread,hard egg,sole fillet,grand marnier,cider vinegar,confectioner sugar,saffron
title: Saleen Sole
ingredients: 2 sole fillets | 3/4 cup grand marnier | 3/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 6 hard-boiled eggs | 1 small handful sifted confectioners'sugar | 2 slices sourdough bread | vegan cheddar cheese, shavings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the sole fillets into a baking dish that has been lightly sprayed with cooking spray. Sprinkle with the grand marnier, cider vinegar and saffron. Toss to coat. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove the fish from the baking dish, and remove the topside of each fillet. Cover the fish slices with a slice of egg. Top with the sourdough bread slices and sprinkle each serving with a generous amount of vegan cheddar cheese. Serve right away.
