title: Pasta With Egg Noodles and Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 3 cups egg noodles, uncooked | 3 cups fresh mustard seeds | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped whole mustard seeds | 8 cups hot cooked rigatoni pasta
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat mustard and mustard seeds in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring. Toast until they begin to sputter, about 4 minutes. Add noodles, spreading thin with hot dry mustard and mustard seeds. Cook uncovered, about 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Pizza Snack
ingredients: 1 package crescent dinner rolls | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup yoghurt | pimento stuffed olive
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spread the dough onto a floured tray. Bake for 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Spread the yoghurt on top of the baked dough, and top with pimentos and olives. Bake for 5 more minutes.

title: Chinese Asafutida Bean Soup
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 6 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 -2 tablespoon of ground dried chili
instructions: Combine asafetida and sherry in a large pot and heat until boiling. Stir in the black beans and simmer till the beans are tender. Turn off the stove and stir in the dark sesame oil and chili pepper. Let sit for 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Roasted Parsnips With Feta and Herbs
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 1 large loaf unsliced italian bread | 1 lb feta cheese
instructions: Cut parsnips lengthwise into four or five pieces, depending on size. Place cut ingredients in a pan or baking dish. Cover with olive oil and bake at 450 degrees f, uncovered, until tender and beginning to brown. Remove from oven, turn on broiler, and broil for a few moments until the parisian topping is bubbling. If you wish, toast the bread and serve toasted in the oven. Remove top crusts of bread before serving as they finish cooking. Serve sprinkled with parsley.

Random Ingredients: apricot,dark soy sauce,green bean,pearl barley,chinese mushroom,parmesan cheese,head iceberg lettuce,walnut oil
title: Chinese Mushroom Stir Fry over Barley
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried chinese mushrooms | 1/3 cup chinese pearl barley | 1 small head iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup dried apricot, soaked and drained | 2 -3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup fresh parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup walnut oil | green beans, cut into 1-inch lengths
instructions: Put dried mushrooms in sieve and rub dry. Add in pearl barley and set aside for several hours or overnight. Chop woody lettuce, apricots and green beans into 1 strips and toss with dark soy sauce. Drain and dry mushrooms. Add in walnut oil, sprinkle with cheese and set in fridge. Heat up in a skillet, or wok, on medium high heat. Add in green beans and mushrooms. Stir fry a few minutes and serve.

title: Quick Sambouseh (Quick Persian Dip)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon olive oil or 1/2 teaspoon clarified butter | 5 -7 green cardamom pods ( or 4 -5 drops grenadine flavored ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste or 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated
instructions: Heat oil in nonstick skillet.

Random Ingredients: jarlsberg cheese,apple juice,water,scotch bonnet pepper,kaffir lime leaf,white flour
title: Fried Cheese With Scotch bonnet and Chiles
ingredients: 1/4 cup unbleached white flour | 1 scotch bonnet peppers or 1 habanero pepper, deseeded and finely chopped ( or substitute red chiles ) | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1 cup grated jarlsberg cheese
instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl. Add the chilies and water and knead until smooth. Cover and allow to rest for 20 minutes. Using a rolling pin, cut the cheese into small pieces, dip into the flour mixture and press flat into a round. Heat a cast iron frying pan over a fairly high heat. Add the cheese to the hot pan and fry for 4 - 5 minutes until it is golden underneath. Carefully transfer the cheese to a bowl with a slotted spoon and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,chili paste,ginger garlic paste,vegetable broth,catsup
title: Easy Chilli Onion Gravy for the Crock Pot!
ingredients: 8 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons catsup ( or ketchup ) | 4 teaspoons chili paste or 4 teaspoons green chili paste | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a slow cooker or crock pot with the lid. Cook on high for 2 to 3 hours or on low for 5 to 7 hours. Serve over cooked vegetables and enjoy.

title: Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 pounds flank steak | 1 jar prepared alfredo sauce | 1 jar chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons chopped shallots | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Place steak in a large skillet with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Transfer steak to a board and slice into thin strips. Shred steak and return it to skillet. Stir in creamy salsa and shallots. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Roll warmed tortillas into enchilada size tortillas, place onto a large baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until warm and beginning to brown, 10 to 15 minutes. Top with desired amount of enchilada sauce.

Random Ingredients: tofu,lemon zest,black pepper,sea salt,soya oil,yellow bell pepper,baby spinach,breadcrumb
title: Tofu and Spinach Croquettes
ingredients: 150 g tofu | 1/4 cup soft breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon soya oil | 1 teaspoon dried lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 60 g baby spinach | 1 small yellow bell pepper
instructions: Wash the garlic, trim off the ends and shred the ends using a garlic press. Place all the ingrdients in a blender and process until you get a thick paste. Cut the tofu in small chunks and mix it all in with the breadcrumbs. Take a heaped teaspoon of the paste and roll and then wrap it with the breadcrumbs to make the meatballs shape. Refrigerate the meatball, take oiled frying pan and pour in the desired quantity of tofu. Fry till golden on all sides about 3 - 5 minutes. Serve with green sauce or chutney.

title: Bunyaka (Sweet Potato and Corn Mashed Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons low-fat soymilk into a small bowl or a small pie pan | 1 1/2 tablespoons low-fat plain soymilk | 1 bag red cabbage, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 bag sweet potatoes, cut in half and in 1 inch pieces | 1 small parsnip, peeled and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 small napaip, unpeeled and cut in half and in 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 small rump roast, cut into 2 pieces ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: In a shallow nonreactive pan, add soy milk, stir the soymilk and bring to a boil, stir in cabbage then sweet potato, the napaip and rump roast or the parsnip. Reduce the heat to simmer and cook covered until the vegetables are fork tender, about 15 minutes the rice can be prepared to this point up to 6 hours ahead of serving. Before adding the rump roast and baking the vegetables, cook until heated through. Garnish with the parsley.

title: Mexican Turkey Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb deli turkey | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/2 cup rice wine ( regular or medium, whichever you prefer ) | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1/2 teaspoon rotel
instructions: Slice in half and skewer with metal egg turner. Sprinkle with paprika and 1/4 cup rice wine. Roll up and place in a medium sized ziploc bag. Cook in bag for about 20 - 30 minutes. Serve as a stuffing, pork sausage or veggie for burritos.

title: Homemade Ancho Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 dried ancho chili ( i find the dried at an arbol market or sometimes in the canning aisle of an electric store ) | 1/2 fresh green chili pepper
instructions: Roast the ancho chile to make it easier to remove the seeds. It can be dried chili powder. Smoke the entire chile or remove it from the can. Remove stems and seeds if desired. Place in a saucepan and grind. Bring to a boil and stir. Place chili in a blender or food processor with all remaining ingredients. Blend in blender until desired consistency is achieved. Pour sauce into sterilized jar leaving 2/3 inch headspace, and seal. Attach lid and turn on. Let chilies sit for 3 days in the refridgerator.

title: Green Pesto Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons chopped mixed fresh herbs ( such as basil, tarragon, cilantro and flat-leaf parsley ) | 1 green olives, coarsely chopped or 1 bunch pimento-stuffed green olives, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch mixed dried herbs ( such as tarragon, cilantro and flat-leaf parsley ) | 1/2 lime wedge
instructions: Combine olive oil and herbs in blender jar. Cover, shake until herbs are well combined. Stir in olives, salt and pepper. Serve in shallow bowl with lime wedges.

title: Savory Quinoa and Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta sauce ( homemade or prepared ) | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme, minced | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 450, line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a saucepan, bring 1 1/2 1 cups water to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and add quinoa.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,cotija cheese,fish fillet,sardine,ice water,onion powder,onion soup mix,caraway seed
title: Cotija Crusted-Fish over Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 can sardines | 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons ice water | 2 tablespoons snipped cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried caraway seed | 2 teaspoons fish sauce or 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 1/2 pounds skinless boneless fish fillets | 3 cups mixed vegetables ( fresh or frozen-cut, french-style )
instructions: To prepare the sardines, remove the skin and membranes from the sardines, leaving the head and tail exposed. Rinse the sardines thoroughly under cold running water.

title: Spiced Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 cup dried red beans or 1 cup white beans | 2 lbs round steaks, trimmed | 1 jar roasted spanish cucumbers, sliced | 1 1/2 cups alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place red beans in a roaster.

title: Mexican Grilled Corn
ingredients: 12 bamboo skewers, soaked for 20 minutes or 12 bamboo skewers, soaked for 20 minutes | 1/8 cup mexican-style corn | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 fresh hot chili pepper | 2 bananas, peeled and sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together corn, horseradish and chili pepper. Thread 3 hot strips onto each skewer. Grill hot strips 4 to 5 minutes per side, or until hot.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,italian parsley,mexican oregano,yukon gold potato,flour tortilla,semolina
title: Cheese Crisp #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated buttermilk-free soft cheese crisps ( 5-count ) or ( 8 ounce ) package mexican-style cheese crisps ( 5-count ) | 1 package flour tortillas | 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch-thick strips | 2 tablespoons minced fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano ( dried ) or 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary ( dried ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Coat 13 by 9 inch glass or ceramic baking pan with cooking spray. Unroll 1 crisped package of cheese crisps into a 12 x 10 inch baking dish, breaking with a rolling pin to fit the dish. Repeat with remaining package. Bake uncovered 15 minutes or until crisp and golden. Remove from oven. Drain crisps onto paper towels. In microwave safe bowl, combine the remaining cheese, potatoes, parsley, oregano and salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,cooking spray,red capsicum,steak,beef gravy,mozzarella cheese,hard clam
title: Grilled Steak Rolls, With a Mod Broth
ingredients: cooking spray | 750 g steak | 1 red capsicum ( thinly sliced ) | 1 red peppers ( thinly sliced ) | 1 large red capsicum ( thinly sliced ) | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese ( grated or sliced ) | 200 g hard-shelled clams
instructions: Brush the meat with some oil and season with pepper season and cook on hot griddle until cooked as preferred. Meanwhile steam capsicum, red pepper and mozzarella, cut side down, on grill rack in oven until slightly softened.

title: Tarragon Sugar-Free (No Nuts)
ingredients: 1/2 cup tarragon vinegar | 1/4 cup sugar substitute ( sugar-free ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( red wine vinegar )
instructions: Prepare 1 qt saucepan and 1 - 2 qt pot. Combine vinegar, sugar substitute and vinegar and bring to a boil over medium heat. Simmer, uncovered, over low heat for 25 minutes or until vinegar thickens. Remove from heat and skim off any foam that rises to the top as it reduces. Return to pot and stir. Let cool at room temperature. Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: orange liqueur,sherry wine vinegar,red capsicum,romaine lettuce,chili flake,oregano leaf,fennel seed
title: Grilled Capsicum Salad
ingredients: 3 red capsicums ( capsicums ) | 1 bunch romaine lettuce | 1 bunch fresh oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Cut the capsicum into 2 inch long by 2 inch wide strips and leave them whole. Slice the romaine lettuce leaves. Chop the oregano leaves coarsely and toss with the oil and vinegar. Place the red capsicums in a bowl and toss with the oregano, fennel seeds and red wine vinegar. When ready to serve, drizzle with the orange liquur and add a pinch of chili flakes.

title: Nori Shoyu Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons dry mustard | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | hing
instructions: Sift together ingredients.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,kielbasa,orange zest,plain yogurt,lime,active yeast,green olive
title: Kielbasa, Green Olives and Lemon Noodle Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup orange zest | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1 small egg, lightly beaten | 1 1/2 cups egg noodles, cooked, and drained | 20 -30 pitted green olives | 20 -30 frozen cooked kielbasa or 20 -30 frozen cooked leinoche sausage
instructions: Combine yogurt, orange zest and lime zest in bowl. Mix well. Add egg and stir. Stir in noodles. Add the olives, sausage or kielbasa. Turn out into greased 5 1/2 3 1l loaf pan and cover. Chill at least 3 hours or overnight. Turn out onto cutting board and slice into 3/4 slices. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Hot Chutney
ingredients: 3/4 cup hot chili sauce | 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar | 1/4 cup hot curry powder | 1 tablespoon ghee, melted | 1/8 cup red or white sweet potatoes or 1/8 cup chopped yellow sweet potato
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and place in refrigerator at least an hour or overnight.

title: Lamb Chops in Chocolate, Avocado, and Onion Gravy with Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/4 cup butter | 1 pound lamb chops | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons ground ghee | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | salt to taste | 2 hass avocadoes, halved lengthwise, pitted and coarsely chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 6x6 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in preheated oven for 8 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Fresh Vegetable Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 large flour tortillas | 1 cup no-salt-added diced tomatoes | 1 cup shredded romaine lettuce
instructions: Stack tortillas. Lightly spread 1 cup tomatoes on one side of tortilla. Sprinkle with lettuce. Place the other 2 tortillas over the lettuce and tomato. When you flip the quesadilla over, place under broiler until cheese starts to melt, about 1 minute.

title: Mexican Polenta With Diced Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 cup canned cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup sliced green | 1 cup mexican blend cheese, grated | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon mexican blend cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Cook and stir cannelini beans and chickpeas in medium saucepan of boiling salted water until beans are tender, about 12 minutes. Remove from saucepan. Drain beans.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,oregano leaf,white fish,garlic powder,black pepper
title: Italian Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 package uncooked white fish, cut in half lengthwise | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 3 cups shredded red leaf lettuce
instructions: Cook fish in a skillet over medium heat until flakes are no longer seen, about 3 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels. Place fish on a paper towel lined plate. Sprinkle with oregano, garlic powder, and pepper. Add lettuce to fish.

title: Spicy Cherry Bark
ingredients: 1 can whole cherries, drained ( about 10 ounces ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried maraschino cherries | 2 whole fresh chilies | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Rinse the cherry cashew nuts and drain. Place a wire rack over a jelly roll pan and set aside. Heat a grill pan over medium heat until very hot. Combine cherries, dried cherries, and whole chilies in a blender.

title: Navy Bean Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 can navy beans | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Drain beans and place in blender. Add vanilla and blend on medium speed till combined. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,pattypan squash,vegetable oil,pork shoulder steak,cardamom,cottage cheese,yeast,table salt
title: Beef & Pumpkin Pulled Pork Roll
ingredients: 2 cups whole meal cottage cheese | 3/4 cup strong table salt | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 2 cups mashed pattypan squash | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 cardamom, capsules crushed | 4 lbs boneless pork shoulder steaks | table salt, for searing
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cottage cheese, 2/3 cup salt, and yeast. In a large saucepan, bring the mashed pumkin to a simmer over medium low heat. Remove the saucepan from the heat. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high. Add the cardamom capsules and cook to release flavor, about 10 seconds. Remove the cardom capsules and discard. Rub the pumkin mixture onto the outside of the pork, and then sprinkle liberally with the remaining 1/4 cup salt. Cook the pork until a thermometer inserted into the center registers 145f for medium rare, about 15 minutes. Let the pork cool on a rack for 20 minutes, then slice into 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Garlic Shredded Leek and Rosemary Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh garlic salt | 1 large leek, sliced | 8 spring onions, sliced ( scallions ) | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Using a knife or kitchen shears, cut away the white base and ends of the leeks and discard. Chop coarsely and combine with the rosemary and garlic salt in a large bowl. Toss well to coat all the leaves and set aside. Heat a large frying pan over high heat for 1 - 2 minutes and then add the ghee and swirl the mixture around to coat the base evenly. When the ghee is hot, add the leeks and cook without moving them for 5 - 6 minutes or until they have softened but are not brown. Remove from the heat. Add the spring onions and toss until they have begun to wilt slightly. Transfer to the serving bowl and add the roasted garlic shredded leeks and gently toss. Serve immediately.

title: The Chipotle Dry Rub
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried chipotle chiles, crushed | 1 cup fresh coriander leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 -4 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 3/4 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in the jar of a blender and blend until thoroughly combined. Store unused portions in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,juniper berry,paprika,baking potato,salt black pepper,dark rum,raspberry,red chili powder
title: Spiced Roasted Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 3 large dried juniper berries | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper | 1 pinch red chili powder | 1 pinch red chili powder | 1 tablespoon raisins or 1 tablespoon raisins, lightly toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Toss potatoes with paprika, chile powder, juniper berries, rum, cheese and salt and pepper. Spread potatoes into a foil lined baking dish. Bake until hot and bubbling, 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Hot Italian Pepper Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and minced | 1 teaspoon instant espresso
instructions: Peel cooled eggs and cut in half lengthwise. Remove the yolks and mash in a bowl with 2 tablespoons water, cornstarch, worcestershire sauce, habanero pepper, instant espresso and 1 tablespoon water. Fill the egg whites with the egg mixture. Serve.

title: Lamb Shank Roll
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks | 1 1/2 cups uncooked instant brown rice | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup yellow squash, chopped, or more to taste | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped yellow squash to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine lamb shanks, instant rice, and uncooked squash in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer gently, about 1 hour. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the puff pastry. Trim any uneven edges with a sharp knife. Place a sheet of the puff pastry onto the baking sheet, and gently press into a rectangle 2/3 inch thick and 2 inches wide. Pile the lamb shanks onto the pastry, leaving about a 1 inch border on each end. Top with 1/4 cup of the squash, if using. Roll up the pastry into a log, and place on the baking sheet with the seams side down. Repeat with the remaining dough and squash. Bake in the preheated oven until the pastry is puffed and golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into slices to serve, or place on lettuce leaves for a tasty topping.

title: Salmon With Sweet Cream Sauce (Dukkah Bi Lahwa)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh salmon, cut into 8 slices | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup sweet wine or 1/4 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons thyme or 2 tablespoons rosemary, minced | 4 green cardamom pods, slightly crushed | 2 slices french bread or 2 slices other bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | herbal or salad syrup, to serve
instructions: Mix cornstarch and wine together in a small bowl, until foamy. Add thyme and marinade salmon for 10 minutes or longer. Dry fish with a towel and pat dry. Arrange 5 or 6 slices on each plate and top with a few tbs of the sauce. Serve with bread, syrup and herbs.

title: Cheese Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups colby cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup creme fraiche or 1/3 cup yogurt ( fat free ) | 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Can serve with crackers.

title: Thai Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef, sirloin | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( to taste ) | hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Cut beef, and cut it into very thin slices. Cut the meat into long 1/4 inch chunks. Soak wooden skewers in water for a few minutes. Take beef from water and soak in cold water for 10 minutes. Slice meat across the grain into 1/4 inch wide strips. Soak wooden skewers in water for a few minutes. Put in a bowl. Put in fish sauce.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,herb,farfalle pasta,dark sesame oil,cardamom pod,black olive,pork chop
title: Shiram Bel Labane (Farfalle Sausage-Stuffed Pork Chops)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom pod, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried herbs, such as basil | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon light sesame oil | 1 lb lean pork chop, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 can sliced black olives, drained ( approximately 5 ounces ) | 1 1/2 cups uncooked farfalle pasta, such as ditalini, broken into 2-inch pieces, cooked
instructions: In large bowl, stir together cardamom, herbs and seasoning salt.

Random Ingredients: capsicum,chipotle chile,cabbage,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ginger juice,romaine lettuce
title: Grilled Chipotle Lettuce Leaves
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 large head cabbage, separated into leaves ( about 2-1/2 lbs. ) | 1 small red bell pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1/2 medium roma lettuce, leaves washed thoroughly and finely shredded | 1 chipotle chile, very finely minced ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice ( from chipotle jar )
instructions: In a medium sized salad bowl, combine the cheese and the shredded cabbage and peppers. Toss well. Let the mixture marinate at least 30 minutes and up to 8 hours in the refrigerator, stirring well after 2 or 3 hours cooking. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Allow to sit at room temp just until the greens are warm. Serve at room temperature. The recommended time is an hour or so before serving. This can be made up to 3 days in advance. Keep in the fridge covered.

title: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 4 large poblano peppers | 1 large eggplant, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Roast the peppers on the preheated oven rack until blackened, about 45 minutes. Immediately rub the peppers with olive oil. Place the blackened peppers directly onto the hot baking sheet. Roast the peppers until blackened on all sides, and beginning to char, 15 to 25 minutes. When peppers are about 1/2 inch from the top, carefully turn the peppers and roast for 10 to 15 minutes, until the skin is caramelized and dark. Remove peppers from oven and place on a plate to cool. Peel away the charred outer skin and discard. Place the eggplant on a clean work surface and cut into slices. Place the eggplant slices on a sheet of aluminum foil, and drizzle with olive oil. Arrange the roasted peppers over the roasted eggplant. Place the roasted eggplant slices on a cookie sheet or baking sheet with the seam side down. Roast in the oven until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Chips
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, cut into thick strips | 4 steaks, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1/2 cup paper baking sheets, such as boboli, dry, about 10 x 7 inches
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place potatoes and steaks in a large sauce pan. Sprinkle each with soya sauce. Scatter with 2 pieces of baking sheets on oven rack, close lid and bake 20 minutes. Turn off oven and transfer potatoes and steaks to a platter. Remove foil and continue to bake potatoes until crisp and golden, about 10 minutes longer. Cool slightly in pans, then transfer to a plate.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,snow pea,banana,pink salmon,sun tomato oil,quinoa
title: Salmon Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 200 g quinoa | 1 cup fresh snow peas or 1 cup frozen snow peas | 200 g canned pink salmon ( i used sockeye ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange liqueur | 2 tablespoons finely shredded coconut sweetened with sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cook the quinoa in 2 cups boiling water for 12 - 15 minutes until it is done. Cook the halibut or salmon. Slice the halibut or salmon into 1/2 rounds. Toss the sliced halibut or salmon with the quinoa. Make sure it is dry. Just before serving, toss with sundried tomato and grand marnier. Sprinkle coconut on top.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,flat leaf italian parsley,red chile,cornflour,coconut
title: Methi Paste (Raw Vegan)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cornflour ( a gluten-free mix of flour and baking powder ) | 1 teaspoon coconut or 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 1 teaspoon dried red chile ( or 1 tablespoon green jalapeno or 1 tablespoon habenero, minced ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Mix all together. Use as bread spread or spread on raw veggies.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,catsup,espresso,double cream,chili pepper flake,sauce,chow mein noodle
title: Linda's Awesome Curried Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup instant espresso | 1/2 cup double cream | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 1 dash hot chili pepper flakes | 1 lb chow mein noodles, cooked
instructions: Place all ingredients in a coffee grinder or blender, mix well and then blend for about 15 - 20 seconds until fully blended. Serve immediately.

title: Rice Cooker (Bengali) Rutabaga
ingredients: 2 rutabagas | 3 2 cups basmati rice
instructions: Rinse rutabagas under running water.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,kosher salt,stewing beef,soya sauce,lime zest,cream tartar
title: Simple Slow Cooker Lime Beef Cannelloni
ingredients: 3 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into cubes | 12 no-boil lasagna noodles | 12 limes, zest of | 2 cups bottled soya sauce, warmed ( no-added-sauce ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon light soya sauce | 1 tablespoon light cream of tartar
instructions: Place meat and the juice from each lime zest into a shallow dish and pour over the sesame seed. Add the salt, lime zest, and light soya sauce and allow to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours or overnight.. Bring a large pot of water to boiling. Cook the lasagna according to package directions and drain. Place 1/4 cup of the prepared meat mixture on the counter top and roll it into a cylinder around the meat mixture. Put the roll in a slow cooker and cook on low for 1 1/2 hours. Add more water if necessary to keep the meat from drying out.. Remove meat roll and serve. Discard the limes. Serve with some corn tortillas, salsa, and pico de gallo.

title: Chipotle Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, cut 1-inch thick ( sliced thin ) | 1 cup sweet corn chips | 1/2 cup milk | 1 package soya sauce | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 1 english muffin
instructions: Boil chips for a few seconds or so until they are soft. Dip in milk, and then into dry chipotle powder. Toss with beef. Cook in hot cast iron skillet until desired doneness. Cool, slice thick. Add soya or chipotle sauce. Top with beef slices. Bake. For added flavour add salt of pepper or a splash of chili sauce.

title: Hot Faux Tomato Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Line a 12 inch microwave safe baking dish with nonstick foil and add the corn, cherry tomatoes and about 1/2 c water. Cover and microwave on high 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chilean Hot Fudge
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 3/4 cup finely chopped baking chocolate, such as skor english toffee | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: In a heavy bottomed heavy saucepan over medium heat, bring cream and chocolate to a boil. Pour chocolate and cream through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing through a sieve with the back of a spoon. Stir in cheese, until completely melted and well blended. Pour into cupcake papers, and press each into a 9 inch square pan or other 9 inch square pan that's been buttered to cover the surface of the pan. Chill in refrigerator until set, about 4 hours. Cut into 12 squares.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,red pepper flake,ginger garlic paste,escarole,lavender,beef sirloin steak,pimiento,rice vinegar
title: Sesame Beef Oriental
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut to 1/4-inch size pieces | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon brown rice flour | 2 teaspoons finely minced bottled or bottled roasted red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup roasted sweet red pepper flakes, crushed | 1/4 cup green pickled escarole, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried lavender | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons pimientos, drained
instructions: Cook and stir beef and next 5 ingredients in a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over moderate heat until beef is lightly browned and cooked to desired doneness, about 5 - 7 minutes. Stir in escarole. Remove beef with a slotted spoon.

title: Chile and Bacon Stuffing - for Turkey or Meat!
ingredients: 10 mature cylon earl grey | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili pepper ( optional ) | 50 g bacon or 50 g bacon fat
instructions: To stuff bird, dry the earl grey with warm water, then remove the skin and string. Using the neck opening of your bird, gently pull the skin away from the bird and remove the skin. Use a turkey's body, shoulder or any other convenient implement to remove the neck. If a knife is used to clean the earl grey, scrape away the spongy white residue, tie with kitchen string, or tie with string. Finely chop the earl grey roughly and place into the bowl of an electric mixer with the crushed chilli, bacon and enough cold water to blend. If using in a regular turkey you may need to do this in a food processor. If using turkey sew it up and tie the turkey around the neck opening. Use the neck opening to remove the stuffing, as desired. Pack into a small dish, or place in an open roasting tin. Push a piece of foil under the turkey to stop the drying process and preheat the oven to 150c/180c fan 160c/350f or until oven shelves are well inchedle and turkey starts to brown around the edges. Turn bird 180c/350f/gas 6 if using turkey.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,chicken thigh,reynolds wrap foil,plain yogurt,cream tartar,dill weed,pinto bean,cream mushroom soup
title: Chicken & Pinto Bean Filler
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1/3 cup low-fat plain yogurt or 1/3 cup sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 -2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | reynolds wrap foil | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, defrosted | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Drain the pinto beans well and remove about 2/3 1/2 cup of beans liquid. In a measuring cup, combine the sour cream, soup, dill weed, lemon peel, and yogurt. Place the chicken thighs in a deep baking pan so that they are all equal sized 1/3 thick. Put the pinto beans into the pan on top of the chicken. Pour a bit of the bean liquid in the pan as it comes to a boil. Bake at 375 degrees for about 45 minutes or until the chicken pieces are cooked through and golden, and no longer pink inside.

Random Ingredients: white flour,cumin seed,habanero pepper,celery seed,egg noodle,pumpernickel bread
title: Kraben
ingredients: 500 g egg noodles ( about 3 cups ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon pumpernickel bread, crumbs ( optional ) | 1/3 habanero pepper, chopped | 4 teaspoons white flour ( or more if required for thickening )
instructions: In a large pan, heat 3 tablespoons of oil on medium high heat. Once hot, gently crack the egg noodles into the pan and allow to crackle. They will take approximately 2 minutes. Transfer any remaining bits of crumbs to a dish. Fry the egg noodles gently in the oil, until they get a light brown colour. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the remaining oil to the pan. Once hot, add the cumin seeds, celery seeds, pumpernickel, and habanero pepper. Fry for 30 seconds or until the habanero pepper is aromatic and starts to become fragrant. Add the flour and continue to fry for a minute or two. Add the noodles and cook on medium heat for about 2 minutes. Lower heat to low and add the egg noodles and stir frequently until the noodle mixture is well coated in the floury spices. Stir through until you have a nice soft batter. Add the remaining 1/3 cup of cooking water if necessary until you achieve the consistency you like. Serve.

title: Halloumi Cheese Spread
ingredients: 500 g halloumi cheese | 1 teaspoon margarine
instructions: Place the cheese into a food processor. Process until smooth. Add the margarine. Process until combined. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Fruit in Romaine
ingredients: 2 -3 firm ripe raspberries ( ripe brand is best ) | lettuce leaf | 4 slices firm ripe raspberries
instructions: Place several raspberries on lettuce. Sprinkle with the entire rasberry.

Random Ingredients: margarine,clove,beef roast,salt black pepper,seasoning salt,sage leaf
title: Roast Beef
ingredients: 3 -6 lbs beef roast | 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaves ( or 1 tablespoon dried ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°. Combine sage, salt, pepper and melted butter. Rub on beef roast. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until tender. Transfer to carving board. Skim as much fat as possible from pan juices. Slice. Insert sliced slices of roast back into pan juices and simmer until sauce is reduced to about 3/4 cup. This should take about 15 to 20 minutes. If it doesn't take any longer, put meat on a piece of foil to keep warm. This will be a nice meal served on sandwich buns and fresh baked potatoes as well. Note, you can add hot pepper sauce to the gravy for a milder taste. For a heartier meal, stir a little of the sauce into the turkey.

Random Ingredients: coffee,sherry wine,tomato green chilies,phyllo pastry,beef liver,salad oil,sea salt,pea
title: Beef With Pecan Chile Sauce
ingredients: 500 g beef liver | 50 ml salad oil | 3 tomatoes, skinned, deseeded, chopped | 1 teaspoon sea salt, plus extra to taste | 225 g peas ( frozen or shelled ) | 125 ml dry sherry wine | 100 ml coffee, dry | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Cut the liver into long strips. Heat 1 cm of the oil in a large pan. When hot, add the liver strips and fry until the liver is browned. Transfer the meat to a large bowl. Add the remaining oil to the pan and cook the tomatoes for 3 minutes, until soft. Season with the salt and add the peas and cook for 1 minute longer. Add the sherry and 1/2 cup of the coffee and simmer for 5 minutes longer. Allow to return to a simmer and add the rest of the coffee, cover and set aside, and allow to cool. Trim the ends from the phyllo pastry sheets and cut into strips. Spoon the meat and peas mixture into a baking dish with a little of the cheese pastry, the fold over and brush with a little of the melted butter. Bake at 180c for about 20 minutes, until well risen.

title: Pumpkin and Prune Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 butternut squash, peeled, seeded | 3/4 cup finely chopped pitted prunes | 1/4 cup cream of coconut | 1 lime, juice of | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Cut the squash lengthways into 1cm slices. Boil the squash in salted water for 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Place the prunes and coconut into a bowl. Stir in the lime juice. Pour into a jug and top up with a squeeze of lime juice.

Random Ingredients: lasagna,monterey jack cheese,self raising flour,dark sesame oil,ketjap manis,egg noodle
title: Noodles with Cheese - Lasagna Catsup
ingredients: 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour, sifted | 7 ounces lasagna sheets | 2/3 cup ketjap manis | 1 egg noodles, cooked & mashed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the noodles for 3 - 4 minutes until golden brown. Drain well and add the cheese to the noodles. Mix well and spread into an ovenproof dish. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and golden. To make the icing, combine the ketjap manis with a little of the egg noodles and pour over the cake while hot.

title: Beef Heart and Sultana Pies
ingredients: 1 beef heart, trimmed of fat and broken into smaller pieces | 1 can pitted black olives | 1 package green ( red ) bean, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon fresh seasoning salt | 1 package sultanas, soaked in warm water for 15 minutes
instructions: Place all ingredients into a roasting dish, excluding the sultanas, and mix well. Score a cross in the top. If it has points of diamond, score lines about 20 minutes, then insert a cube of bread into the oven to keep from burning if you have leftovers.

title: Sauce for Fish, Chips or Chips With Salami and Beer
ingredients: 4 fish cakes or 4 chips | 2 cups salami, chopped | 2 cups icing sugar | 1 cup beer or 1 cup a little less | sea salt ( for salt )
instructions: Bring beer or water to boil. While waiting for it to boil and then cool the salami if you like, cut it in half lengthwise. It should now be roughly the same size pieces as the salami. Add salami and sugar and coat with the beer. Toss all the ingredients together for about 2 minutes and set sauce aside. Drain sauce. Add the chips to the sauce. If you plan to use it immediately, put the chips in a bowl of ice water to keep them nice and wet until it's ready. It should still have a lot of bite in it. Scoop the sauce into a dipping bowl and enjoy.

title: Lamb Shank (Kashmiri)
ingredients: 2 lbs split black cardamom pods | 6 sprigs parsley
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a saucepan and cover with water about 1 inch below the top of the pan. Bring to a boil and cook over medium high heat, skimming any foam occasionally until the lamb is tender, about 1hour. Discard the cardamom stems and parsley sprigs.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,gingerroot,red chili powder,sirloin,onion seed,coriander powder,pasta,sauerkraut
title: Spicy Beef and Sauerkraut in Pasta
ingredients: 625 g sirloin | 1 packet sauerkraut | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 1 teaspoon onion seeds | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 125 ml sweet chili sauce | 375 g pasta
instructions: Cube the sirloin and cut into cubes. Combine all the other ingredients in a large bowl. Heat a little olive oil in a pan add cubed meat. Fry until outside is golden. Remove meat. Add meat back in to pan and stir around to coat with oil. Put on serving plate and pour the sweet chilli sauce over the top. Serve with a salad and crusty bread.

title: Peppered Strawberries
ingredients: 1 bunch of fresh strawberries | 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut oil | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds ( aka instecut or nigella ) | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon madeira wine
instructions: Slice the heads off the strawberries and reserve. Remove the black parts of the stems from the strawberries, and scrape out the white hulls. Trim the fruit of the tough white skin on the top, and finely chop the flesh. Heat the oil in a nonstick fry pan or wok.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,roasting chicken,almond extract,chicken breast,chili sauce,lemon,nutmeg,yellow squash
title: Zesty-Sweet Chicken-Chicken With Spiced Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 4 large garlic cloves, minced | 1 roasting chickens, cut up | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 4 teaspoons almond extract | 1 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 1/2 cups medium yellow squash, chopped | 2 medium lemons | 1/2 cup toasted slivered almonds or 1/2 cup pine nuts, chopped
instructions: Combine rice, garlic and 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper in a medium size glass baking dish. Spread chicken on top. Combine remaining salt and pepper, chili sauce and almond extract and spread mixture over chicken. Cover with plastic wrap. Place in refrigerator for at least 3 hours. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove plastic wrap from rice and place chicken on rack in small baking dish. Roast about 40 min or until chicken is no longer pink when pierced.

title: Czech Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar mandarin oranges, drained and rinsed | 16 ounces cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper, crushed | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Drain the mandarin oranges, rinse well in cold water and drain again. Add 1/2 cup of the drained oranges to a large bowl. Add your cottage cheese and dried chili powder. Combine well. Add your remaining drained mandarin oranges and stir well to mix all ingredients.

title: Hot Crab on the Pine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pineapples, flakes | 2 teaspoons crabmeat | 1 teaspoon basil or 1 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Mix pineapple drippings with crab meat. Add basil or thyme. Toss with ice crackers or your favourite cracker recipe.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,plum tomato,linguine,lettuce leaf,beef shank,garlic clove
title: Shanks With Linguine
ingredients: 3 beef shanks | cooking oil | 6 plum tomatoes | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 cup lettuce leaf | 1/2 cup linguine
instructions: Preheat a barbecue or chargrill pan to medium heat. Put the shanks into a ceramic dish with enough oil to cover. Cook for 10 minutes, turning once or twice, until browned but still pink inside. Remove the shanks from the oil. Add the tomatoes and garlic to the pan and cook for 5 minutes stirring. Add the lettuce and cook for 2 minutes. Drain the pasta and remove the crusts. Shred the meat onto serving plates and place a slice of meat across the pasta. Spoon over the tomato sauce and serve.

title: Spinach With Tomato, Smoked Beef and Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon hot paprika | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1/3 cup teabags or 1/3 cup strong herbal dry tea
instructions: In skillet, sauté beef until no longer pink, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain any excess fat. Stir in tomato paste and vinegar, 1/4 teaspoon of the paprika, and spinach. Heat over medium low heat for 5 minutes or until liquid is almost evaporated. Serve over steamed greens.

title: Arafura(Black Eyed Beans)
ingredients: 200 g black-eyed peas, washed and trimmed | 1 1/2 cups rajad dal, cleaned, washed and finely grated | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda, lightly mixed with | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Place drained and washed black eyed peas in a deep bowl. Add enough water to leave 2 3cm space at the top of the peas after kneading. You should have about twice the volume of black eyed peas. Allow to stand for 10 - 15 minutes, until you become proficient in handling, and transfer to a clean bowl. Add washed, freshly grated bicarb and the 2 teaspoons of bicarbonate of soda mixed in with the 2 teaspoons of water. Mix well. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 - 2½ hours. If there are any gaps between the bowl and the peas, fill them with boiling water. Cover with a tea towel and allow to stand for half an hour, until the water has been absorbed. Gently stir the peas and transfer to an upside down serving plate. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,asafoetida powder,double cream,limeade concentrate,pepperoncini pepper
title: St. Patrick's Shamrock Peppercorn Cream Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup limeade concentrate, frozen, thawed | 14 ounces water chestnuts, drained with liquid reserved | 2 drops pepperoncini peppers, chopped | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 cups double cream | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine limeade concentrate, water chestnuts, pepperoncini, and asafoetida in pot.

title: Homemade Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dried parsley
instructions: Combine ingredients and allow to stand 3 - 4 hours. Excellent for dipping.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,chunky salsa,wild rice,pico de gallo,salt pork,lobster tail,orange bell pepper
title: Wild Rice Ole'
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wild rice | 1/2 cup diced salt pork | 1/2 cup chopped onion flakes | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1/8 cup orange bell pepper | 1/3 cup pico de gallo ( mexican fiesta fiesta dipping sauce ) | 1/2 cup chopped onion
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions, then remove from heat. In a large bowl, mix pork, 1/2 cup onion flakes, salsa, orange pepper, pico de gallo, and 1/2 cup onion.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,spice,chicken thigh,bay scallop,white wine vinegar,rice wine
title: Bilba's Chicken and Scallops in a Jive
ingredients: 3/4 cup rice wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 1/2 teaspoons spike spice ( spike if your brand is very spicy ) | 1 small bay scallop | 1 cup dailey's irish cream
instructions: Combine the wine vinegar, chilli, bay scallops and spicy spice in a large bowl and set aside. Place the chicken thighs in a non reactive bowl, pour the marinade over them, then coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. Place chicken in the oven and heat for 20 minutes at 220°c cut slits in the breadcrumbs used for dredging, and remove most of the flesh but 3 tbsp of the marinade. Dip each piece in the marinade then roll in the breadcrumbs. Arrange on a large baking paper lined sheet. Bake for 15 mins or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a skewer. Remove from oven and serve hot, straight from the oven.

title: Apricot Spiced Cashew Spread
ingredients: 3 cups dried apricots, in water ( about 4oz total weight ) | 6 kaffir lime leaves, torn into small dices ( about 12 leaves ) | 1 3/4 cups cashew nuts, toasted | 3/4 teaspoon ground mixed spice | 1/3 cup dried apricot, in juice, thinly sliced
instructions: Line 1 large nonstick ovenproof nonstick ovenproof serving plate with 2 pieces of parchment paper. Place apricots and kaffir lime leaves in a large bowl and cover with warm water. Let soak 10 minutes. Drain, reserving 5 cups soaking liquid, and place all remaining ingredients in a processor container and process until smooth. Transfer mixture to bowl with reserved soaking liquid, season with salt, and set aside 3/4 cup of filling. Spread cashew paste over parchment paper lined baking sheet. Spoon remaining paste evenly over paste. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown 15 - 17 minutes. Let stand at room temperature 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,kidney bean,russet potato,beef chuck,fish sauce
title: Tibetan Beef Soup (Tse Mac)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, chuck bone cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 cups canned kidney beans or 3 cups cooked cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning ( sub with adobo seasoning ) | 4 lbs russet potatoes or 4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Place beef in a large pot and add enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 hours. Add beans, fish sauce, and italian seasoning. Heat through, but do not boil. Add potatoes. Cook for 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,snow pea,longhorn cheese,white wine vinegar
title: Longhorn Cottage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb longhorn cheese, cut into cubes | 1 lb snow peas, ends trimmed ( french or green beans ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 3 -5 dashes hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine cheese with dressing ingredients and mix well.

title: Orange and Leek Gratin
ingredients: 4 leeks ( green parts only ) | 4 orange bell peppers
instructions: Clean the leeks by trimbing the tops, removing the root ends, and cutting off the main root ends. Slice into rings about 1 1/2 inches thick. Wash, dry, and cut the leeks in half lengthwise. Wrap each leek with a long strip of green parts and then in strips about 1 1/2 inches long. Rinse the strips with cold water, and dry with a towel. Grease an 8x8 inch square glass baking dish. Arrange the leeks in the dish over the tops. Cut peppers into long strips about 1 1/2 inches long. Drizzle with olive oil or lemon juice. Turn on the oven broiler. Broil leeks 10 in from the heat, turning, until they are soft, with darker spots, and beginning to caramelize, 15 - 20 minutes. Watch carefully and observe that the leeks will be tender and not browned serve warm or cool, and refrigerate.

title: Pineapple Passion Fruit Juice (Virgin)
ingredients: 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 1 can passion fruit nectar | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Stir pineapple, passion fruit nectar, and almond extract in a blender until smooth.

title: Lobcradine (Lobscallops in Sauce and Squid Sauce)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh shrimp paste ( if large, thaw shrimp on paper towels and pat dry ) | 1/2 cup broth | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or other hot sauce )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer for about 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Kiev
ingredients: 15 skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 1 pound fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 1 package crumbled feta cheese | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped drained pistachios | 2 tablespoons rum, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange chicken thighs in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread spinach onto the thighs.

Random Ingredients: lemon,sugar syrup,marjoram,parsley,cumin powder,lasagna noodle,carnation milk,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Easy Noodle and Sauce
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 1 container carnation milk | 2 cups carnation evaporated milk ( not evaporated ) | lemon | 1 dash cumin powder | 1 dash marjoram | 1 dash parsley | 1 dash cumin powder | 1 dash sugar syrup
instructions: First, boil your noodles in boiling water, drain and rinse. In the microwave, in 2 quart sauce pan, add 1 cup of carnation milk, lemon juice and spices. Whisk until blended. Keep heating on low for approximately 10 minutes. Now add noodles to sauce and mix. In the meantime, add enough milk until sauce is just over 1 cup, this will make it creamy enough to coat the noodles, then serve it as a sauce for your noodles.

title: Chilean Arugula W-Chili Sauce
ingredients: 12 cups arugula ( washed and stemmed ) | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and roughly chopped in food processor | 1 tablespoon gochujang | 2 tablespoons extra virgin oil | 2 tablespoons garam masala
instructions: Combine all ingredients, stir to mix, and refrigerate until ready to use. Note, prep time does not reflect marinate time. Time does not include refrigeration.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,goat cheese,french onion soup,red wine vinegar,chili paste
title: Dees French Onion Dip
ingredients: 20 ounces french onion soup | 2 ounces red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 8 ounces goat cheese | hot paprika
instructions: Mix, chilli paste, goat cheese and sweet paprika in bowl. Place in air tight container. Freeze approximately 3 days. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: duck breast,tea,peanut oil sunflower,green chile pepper,ham,golden syrup,rutabaga
title: Baked Teacakes
ingredients: 1/3 cup peanut oil or canola oil, for frying | 1/3 cup chopped cooked ham | 2 tablespoons scotch whisky or 2 tablespoons scotch whisky, plus 2 tablespoons scotch whisky to taste | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 green chile pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped cooked duck breast | 3/4 cup peeled rutabagas, mashed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the ham, ham, the 3 tablespoons of whisky or whisky, the golden syrup, chile, duck breast and rutabagas. Stuff the mixture into mini ramekin dishes. Place the ramekins into a roasting pan, and pour in 2 to 3 inches of water. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes more, until the tops are browned and the rutabagas are tender and the filling is hot and bubbling. Serve the buns hot, with plenty of napkins alongside.

title: Vegetarian Lasagne
ingredients: 8 ounces pasta, about 1 1/2 cups | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup packed fresh basil leaf | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat stock and basil. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cook lasagne noodles according to package directions. Drain. Add the hot soup and broth and allow to simmer and reduce until pasta is creamy and soup thickens some. When pasta is done, place on a casserole. Pour soup mixture over top of noodles in casserole and sprinkle with celery seed. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,tea,philadelphia cream cheese,milk chocolate,bean,pesto sauce,italian sausage link
title: Finger-Licking Italian Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 boxes philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1 cup skim milk chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 lb sweet italian sausage links, cooked and sliced | 1 can fat-free refried beans, drained | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard and basil blend, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease and flour a 9 inch springform pan. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the cream cheese, milk chocolate, canola oil and pesto and mix until well blended. Stir in the sausage. Spread mixture in prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Spread cooled meat mixture over the cheesecake. Top with 1/2 the refried beans, 1/2 the mustard and basil blend and drizzle remaining pesto mixture over top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until top is nicely browned. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Simple Lasagna II
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 15 ounces mascarpone
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut ends off of noodles and place on cookie sheet with sides touching. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Ancho Chili Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 whole canned ancho chili peppers, dried, peeled and seeded | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes | 1/2 cup double cream | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ancho chili, leaves
instructions: Using a food processor or large knife, finely chop ancho chiles until finely ground. Add tomatoes, cream and 1/2 cup water.

Random Ingredients: lime,red chilies,rye bread,grain rice,fennel seed,tomato sauce,potato
title: Tomato Rice and Chillies Casserole
ingredients: 2 liters tomato sauce | 2 fresh red chilies | 3 tablespoons long-grain rice | 2 potatoes, grated finely | 4 tablespoons fennel seeds | 4 slices rye bread, toasted lightly | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Soften the chillies in 1 tablespoon of water. Roughly chop, seeds, chillies and then boil them in the tomato sauce for 10 minutes. Add the rice and mash the mixture with a potato masher to obtain a smooth consistency. Tip into an oven proof casserole dish and cover with the sliced toasted rye bread. Lightly press the fennel seeds on the toasted bread. Squeeze the juice from the lime into the tomato sauce and pour it over the toasted bread. Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celcius for 50 minutes until the rice is cooked. Serve with chutney or chutney, extra lime juice and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,chicken stock cube,head broccoli,lemon juice zest,salsa
title: Low-Fat Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces tomato paste | 1 large body broccoli, cut into small florets | 1/4 cup bottled salsa ( optional ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 pieces lemon zest ( optional )
instructions: Bring 5 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Meanwhile, place broccoli in a food processor and add 3/4 cup salsa plus some zest, if using. Blend until smooth. Add tomato paste and blend. Pour mixture into pan and bring to just under a boil. Add more garlic or lemon zest if needed, if used. If the soup gets too thick, add water and tomato paste. Simmer for 10 minutes or until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Quick and Easy Baked Fish
ingredients: 1 head garlic ( not a head ) | 1 whole fish | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f or 180 degrees celsius. Wash your garlic and trim off any dirt. Place in a baking dish and add water to cover. Cover with foil and bake for about 1 hour. Drain the water out of the garlic head and set aside. Using a sharp paring knife, remove the white part of the head of garlic. It will take a little longer to peel off depending on their size and easier to cut the cloves. Place the heads in a blender along with some of the water from the baking dish, the ricotta and some seasoning. Blend on low speed until the mixture is well incorporated. Lay the head of garlic on a cutting board and thinly slice into thick strips. Put half of the ricotta into a small bowl and add half of the fish skin side down. Coat with the ricotta and cover with the chopped garlic and orange zest from the garlic head. This will be a wet dish. Place the fish skin side down on the rack of the oven and bake for about 40 minutes, until the fish is well browned and the sauce is bubbling. Serve over pasta of your choice.

title: Easy Beef Ribs With Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 2 beef ribs ( about 8 pounds total ) | 1 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Spread two inch depth of aluminum foil on a rimmed baking sheet. Place the ribs on the foil and roast for about 2 hours for high heat. Remove from the oven and cool completely. Turn on the oven to broil and place two racks in the oven. Broil for 1 more minute and turn on the broiler. Baste with a little greek yogurt. Broil for another minute and serve.

Random Ingredients: meatball,natural peanut butter,green cardamom pod,beef stock,watercress
title: Easy Beef and Hot Sauce (Dahl)
ingredients: 1 kg meatballs | 200 g natural-style peanut butter ( or use natural-style peanut butter ) | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon watercress | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Place a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the peanut butter and stock and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat, cover, and set aside for 30 minutes. While waiting for the peanut to melt, finely dice the meatballs. Add the meatballs to the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the watercress and cardamom pods and continue simmering for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the meatballs are cooked through. Remove the saucepan from the heat and pour into a bowl. Serve with dali.

title: Hot Chocolate With Dill and Smoked Hash Browns
ingredients: 8 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 3 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 1 teaspoon dill | 1 1/2 lbs sweet potatoes ( about 4 large ) | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°. To make the paste, combine the yogurt, sherry, chili paste and dill in a food processor or blender until smooth, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,green curry paste,garlic powder,dill
title: Fiery Fish (Vietnamese Style)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 can green curry paste | 1 red bell pepper, sliced | 1 pound fresh fish fillets, cut into portions
instructions: Dump first 5 ingredients in a saucepan.

title: Chipotle Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mushroom, sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo, finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/2 cup avocado oil | 1 small apple, chopped to small pieces
instructions: Combine chipotle pepper, orange zest. Add oil and mushrooms. Cook over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes until golden brown.

title: Shrimp Parcels With Cranberry-Cranberry Topping
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, cooked ( i used frozen ) | 1 can whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup italian dressing ( or red, white, or yellow ) | 1/3 cup mayonnaise ( for topping ) | 1 tablespoon cranberries ( for topping ) | heavy cream, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Put the shrimp inside a shallow baking dish that has been sprayed with non stick cooking spray. Mix italian dressing, mayonnaise, and cranberries together. Sprinkle shrimp with this. Drizzle with dressing mixture. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until the parcels are to desired thickness.

title: Banana Chocolate Bites
ingredients: 3 bananas, peeled and seeded | 3 tablespoons chocolate sprinkles
instructions: Place all ingredients except chocolate sprinkles in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,parmesan cheese,almond butter,basmati rice,sauce,white cornmeal
title: Aunt Sharleen's Microwave Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup white cornmeal | 1/2 cup white cornmeal | 2 cups dry basmati rice | 2 1/2 tablespoons sweetened almond butter | 1/2 cup hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a 2 quart casserole dish, stir 1 cup cornmeal, 1/2 cup white cornmeal, and 2 cups white cornmeal together in a bowl, stirring to combine. Place lid on dish and set aside. Topping, in a microwave safe bowl, microwave almonds on high for 2 minutes. Remove lid and micro on high, stirring every 30 seconds, until nuts are toasted and golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Heat sauce, if desired, in a microwave safe bowl until heated through. Stir in 1/4 cup parmesan cheese. Pour topping mixture over cornmeal mixture, turning to coat evenly. Cover tightly, and cook on low in the microwave for 10 minutes, or on high in a 10 inch cast iron skillet, 30 to 45 minutes, or until bubbly and polenta is thickened and has a very dry consistency.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,broccoli floret,plain flour,white onion,chili flake,banana,celery,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Quick and Easy Bean Nests
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans | 1 green white onion, sliced into strips or 1 medium onion, sliced into thin rings | 1 stalk celery, sliced into thin strips | 1 tablespoon plain flour, seasoned with salt, pepper, and chili flakes | 175 g broccoli florets, chopped | 175 g sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 medium banana, sliced thinly with skin on
instructions: Place beans and enough water to just cover them in a medium saucepan. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat to low, partially cover, and simmer gently 20 - 25 minutes until the beans are tender and the water has been absorbed. Stir frequently during this time if necessary to ensure the mixture doesn't stick. Drain and put the beans into a bowl. Place the onion and celery in a little boiling water, and cook gently for 2 minutes or until the onion is tender, but tender. Stir in the seasoned flour. When the beans are cool enough to handle, slice off half the onion and celery. Chop the rest of the onion and celery. You may have leftover bean skins as well if it is too loose to cut your beans. Add the beans, the onion, celery and the broccoli to the beans. Add the cheese, stir well and season with salt and pepper, to taste. You may need to add a little more water, depending on how dry your beans were. Sprinkle the banana over the top of the mixture, then serve immediately.

title: Faux Pears in Vinegar
ingredients: 4 thin cut pears | 12 drops neufchatel cheese | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 2 tablespoons champagne vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pears in a bowl. Peel pears and slice down the center. Place each pear in the bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Potato-Pancho-Vegetable Bouillon Soup
ingredients: 32 -48 bamboo skewers | 1 package frozen sliced potatoes & cheese bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon leek, chopped | 1 -4 teaspoon vegetable bouillon cube | 1 leek, sliced ( white part only ) | 1 small watermelon, cut lengthwise into 8 wedges or 1 small other greens | 5 -8 tablespoons potato starch ( see above note )
instructions: Cut potatoes and cheese into thin slices. Cut leek lengthwise into thin slices, wash and dry with a paper towel. In a large pan, heat a bit of oil to a light sear the leek slices. Put potatoes and cheese into boiling stock, and mix in vegetable bouillon cube and leek slices. If vegetables are not tender and bouillon cube not dissolved, stir in 1/2 cup water. If bouillon cube and leek are not dissolved, stir and add a tablespoon of potato starch dissolved in 1/2 cup of water. Heat soup for about one minute, stir in cornstarch water, and serve soup with chipped assorted fresh herbs, such as leeks, pickled mustard green peppers and/or dill leaves.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,black sesame seed,head cabbage,bean
title: Quick and Easy One Bean Colcannon
ingredients: 4 cans fat-free cream of chicken soup | 1 can refried beans | 1/2 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 cup black sesame seeds
instructions: Place the cream of chicken soup and refried beans in separate bowls. Place cabbage on a microwave safe plate. Place the sesame seeds on top of the cabbage. Set the microwave to high, cover plate, and cook for 1 minute. Remove from microwave. Pour the colcannon over the sesame seeds, stir, cover bowl, and microwave for about 2 minutes. Remove from microwave and cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Pollo E Arrabbiata (Chicken in Champagne)
ingredients: 8 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into cubes | 1 gallon dry champagne | 1 cup grated pecorino cheese | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Place chicken into a large pot. Pour enough boiling water just to cover the chicken. Cover the pot and cook over medium high heat until chicken is tender and opaque in the center, 6 to 8 hours. Remove from heat and let cool.

title: Traditional Moroccan Nisee Salt
ingredients: 300 g berbere | salt, a little
instructions: Grind berberere coarsely or grind in a spice mill. Wet hands and rub with salt. Use immediately or store in an airtight container.

title: Pumpkin Mash
ingredients: organic carrot, peeled and cut into matchsticks or 1 inch matchsticks | organic turnip, peeled and cut into matchsticks ( peeling is optional ) | organic chicke ( peeling completes removing bitterness. have never tried buttermilk though because it makes the masala ) | organic turnip, peeled and cut into matchsticks or 1 inch matchsticks | organic cabbage, unripe, washed, cored and shredded | organic gingerroot, roughly chopped | organic lettuce, trimmed | organic buttermilk, for dunking
instructions: Put all of your ingredients in a blender or food processor and process until well mixed. Add buttermilk and mix until just combined. Serve immediately in your favourite bowls with a leafy greens salad and fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: brandy,salt,cooking spray,meat,baking potato,splenda sugar substitute,head iceberg lettuce,irish whiskey
title: Irish Barm Brandy Salad
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 medium baking potatoes, rinsed well | 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed well | 1 cup grated irish whiskey | 1/2 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute, sugar substitute | 2 lbs coarsely ground meat | 1/2 head whole head iceberg lettuce, rinsed well, spun dry, and torn up
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper and spray lightly with vegetable oil. Peel the potatoes, if using, and cut them in half lengthwise. Cut each half into four wedges, then cut each wedge widthwise into half again lengthwise. Cut the ends off each wedge to make half moon shapes. Turn the oven on and spray both sides with cooking spray. Place the baking sheet in the oven and roast the potatoes until they are fork tender. Remove the potatoes from the oven, add the head of lettuce, drizzle with the whiskey, and brandy. Sprinkle the sesame seeds and the sugar substitute over all. Bake in the oven for approximately 30 minutes, stirring, until the topping is hot and slightly crisp, and the lettuce is warmed through. Serve hot with the additional ingredients for each serving.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,scallion,nigella seed,carrot,bread crumb,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Fried Carrots
ingredients: 2 carrots, sliced crosswise | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 scallion, sliced, with tops | 1/4 teaspoon nigella seeds | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat and spray with pam cooking spray. Combine bread crumbs, salsa, scallion, and red pepper flakes.

title: Baked Halibut in Foil
ingredients: 5 tablespoons plain flour | 1 lb baking potato | 1 lb halibut fillet | 2 ounces canadian bacon
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Mix flour and salt in a bowl and coat halibut with the flour mixture.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,cream,white wine vinegar,sun tomato oil,chili paste garlic
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon chili paste with garlic, ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup light cream | 3 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes in a bowl and add any other ingredients except sour cream and cream. Whisk to combine then drizzle in the cream and stir to combine. Cover and allow to sit to marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Just before serving, add sour cream and stir briefly.

title: Clams and Feta
ingredients: 250 g feta cheese | 300 ml clam juice, from can
instructions: Take a medium size baking dish and pour on about 2 tablespoons of clam juice. Wash and dry the fetta cheese. Put it in the microwave. Heat it for a couple of minutes until melted on medium high. Take the baking dish out of the microwave and pour in the butter. Place the baking dish on top of the feta cheese and put on the lid. Leave for about 10 minutes and then turn on the grill. If you want to, you can remove the lid for a few minutes, or even close lid and turn it over. When you serve it up, i like to serve with mashed potatoes and veggies.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,passion fruit,red kidney bean,pepperoni,parsnip,cake flour,zucchini,baking soda
title: Vegetarian Spanish Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup potato, grated | 1 cup zucchini, grated | 1 zucchini, grated | 1/2 cup sweet pickled pepperoni, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups red kidney beans, drained | 3 tablespoons cake flour | 3 teaspoons baking soda | 3 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine grated potato, zucchini, onion, pepperoni, kidney beans, flour, soda, and seasoning salt. Mix well with hands. Transfer into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 400°f for 70 - 75 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,guacamole,dark soy sauce,dill,chili flake,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Guacamole Cheese Roll - Weight Watchers
ingredients: 1 package extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon ketchup | 1 pinch chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Spread onto a piece of plastic wrap. Dip in flour.

Random Ingredients: brandy,lemon,red chili pepper,cashew half,red onion,chicken breast half,clear honey,margarine
title: Sydney Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, halved | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons cashew halves, slivered | 2 teaspoons ground red chili pepper | 1 red onion, chopped | 125 g margarine | 1 lemon ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken in a shallow dish. Combine brandy, honey and cashew halves. Pour over chicken and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, turning occasionally, or up to 4 hours. Lightly grease the grill with oil. Grill chicken about 5 minutes, skin side down. Turn chicken and continue cooking until chicken is cooked. Mix together onion, butter, chilli and parsley. Top with chicken and serve with lemon wedges if desired.

title: Kavarian Chopped Salad
ingredients: 4 roma lettuce or 4 green leaf lettuce, washed, dried and torn | 2 -3 cups sliced blackberries | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint or 2 teaspoons dried mint, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1 -2 small serrano pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine lettuce and remaining ingredients in a large bowl and toss lightly. May be served immediately or chilled.

title: Strawberry and Olive Panna Cotta Sundae
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese frosting | 1 package frozen sliced strawberries, thawed | 1 cup shredded kalamata olives | 1 cup chopped fresh strawberries | 1 cup finely chopped roasted hazelnuts
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In an 8x8 inch baking dish, mix cream cheese frosting, 1 cup sliced strawberries, kalamata olives, 1 cup chopped strawberries, and hazelnuts. Cover, and bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes. Uncover, and sprinkle remaining strawberries, 1 cup chopped strawberries, and hazelnuts in a decorative pattern on top cheese mixture. Cool 5 minutes.

title: The Real Italian Sandwich
ingredients: 3/4 cup biscuit-sized flour | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 pinch amaretto | 2 slices bread
instructions: Mix biscuit size pieces, mustard powder, milk, oregano and amaretto together. Make 4 small holes in bread to allow steam to escape. Spread mustard mixture between the two slices of bread. Using a spatula, carefully flip half of the pieces over without overlapping the slices, and spread the other half of the coating onto the bread. Cut sandwich diagonally into 4 pieces. Serve warm. If desired, top with sour cream, honey and/or chopped fresh garlic.

title: Beef and Cabbage Stew
ingredients: 3 1/2 pounds lean beef stew meat, cubed | 8 cups finely shredded cabbage | 1 loaf plain white bread, such as coney island, cut into thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place beef in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Stir in cabbage and continue cooking 5 minutes. Place bread slices on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, until lightly toasted and crisp. Drain off excess liquid. Serve stew in shallow bowls, with bread chunks on the side.

title: Leek and Mustard Cured Lemons
ingredients: 1 lb leek | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard ( your favourite mustard )
instructions: Wash the leeks and slice them crosswise into 3/8 slices. Cut a cross in the rind and remove the hard center portion, then slice crosswise int 1/2 thick slices. Spread the mustard onto the leeks in a well oiled, very thin layer. Sprinkle a little water over them. Let stand for a few minutes before turning them over gently on paper towels. You can also use your hands to toss the leeks around in the mustard. When all leeks are lightly covered, drain away any excess water. Place a large heavy frying pan over medium heat and bring to a boil. Brush the leeks with water and add them to the pan with the mustard. Cook for about 10 minutes or until they have just begun to brown and begin to show some signs of burning at the edges. Move them around so they bake at a steady simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Do not over bake or they will be dry. Cool slightly, then remove the leeks and serve at room temperature.

title: Tatties
ingredients: 2 large golden delicious apples | 1/3 cup tamari, plus | 2 tablespoons tamari, for coating ( or to taste ) or 2 tablespoons soy sauce ( or to taste ) | 4 tablespoons sour cream ( nonfat or plain to taste ) | 4 tablespoons vegetables, for dipping ( your choice )

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,no boil lasagna noodle,poblano chile,white breadcrumb,turmeric powder,baking soda,kaffir lime leaf
title: No-Bake Mushroom Lasagna
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 1/2 lb white breadcrumb | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves, finely chopped | no-boil lasagna noodles, cooked ( just before assembling the lasagna ) | white breadcrumb, for crumbing | 1 egg, beaten
instructions: Roast the pablano chilies by first drying them out in the oven at 350f for about 45 minutes or until burned on all sides. Do not put them in there to dry out. When done, remove from oven and put chilies in a bowl of cold water so they stay bright yellow. Peel away the stem outer green leaves from each chili half.
