Slit the side from the stem end to the top as you do this. The skin should be starting to crackle.

title: Fantabulous Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 lb cucumber, peeled and cut into thin wedges | 1 teaspoon mustard powder ( preferably wholegrain ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Toss all ingredients in a bowl. Serve cold or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,catsup,chuck,chocolate,chicken bouillon cube,beef,wheat flour,white pearl onion
title: Caldillo Beef Stew for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck, cubed | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 cubes chicken bouillon cubes | 1 medium pomegranate juice | 3 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 lb white pearl onion, sliced and washed | 1/2 cup chocolate
instructions: Cook all ingredients, except corn and white pearl onions. Stir to combine. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or high 4 to 5 hours. Remove from heat. Stir corn and sliced onions into stew. Cover and heat on high 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Okra with Rack of Lamb and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 rack of lamb | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 3 medium poblano chiles, thinly sliced | 1 large fresh okra, ends trimmed, leaves cut into 2 inch pieces | 12 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Preheat grill pan or roasting pan over medium heat. Place lamb rack on rack. Rub turmeric between fingers and, using rub, rub mixture over lamb. Let lamb rack rest at room temperature 15 minutes. Using a broiler pan, broil or grill okra 5 minutes to brown slightly. Transfer okra to a dish. Grill 2 minutes on each side for medium rare. Meanwhile, heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil in same pan over medium high heat. When hot, add poblano chiles and okra and cook, stirring, 2 minutes. Add basil leaves and cook 1 minute. Serve lamb rack with sauce.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,ginger,currant,head garlic,tomato paste,mango chutney,flat leaf italian parsley,rice vinegar
title: Spiced Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled, cut into 2 inch thick rounds | 1 small head of garlic, unpeeled | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, grated | 1/4 teaspoon dried currants | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | mango chutney, to sprinkle on top
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place eggplant slices on foil lined baking sheet and bake for 40 minutes. Remove and cool slightly. When cool enough to handle, remove skin leaving the eggplant in chunks. Place garlic in processor and process for 1 - 2 minutes or until the garlic is golden brown. Add ginger, currants and vinegar and process until blended. Add tomato paste and parsley and process just until combined. Transfer to bowl with cooled eggplant and mix gently. Serve with mango chutney drizzled on top. Serve with flatbreads.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,clear honey,grape tomato,suet,cinnamon,lemon peel,green lentil,cornflour
title: Irish Cream & Dill Scented Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb green lentil | 1 pint grape tomatoes, sliced | 1 cinnamon stick | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 2 ounces shredded suet | 1 ounce plain low-fat irish cream | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Bring 6 cups of water to the boil in a large saucepan and add the lentils. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes until tender. Remove from heat, drain. Meanwhile, make the horseradish cream by stirring the cornflour into the horseradish cream. Heat for 2 - 3 minutes, stir in the remaining ingredients and simmer to blend the flavors. Drain the lentils and return it to the pan. Add the horseradish cream mixture. Heat through. Serve immediately.

title: The Best Food Processor Scented  Indian Flat Bread
ingredients: 2 cups unbleached flour, about 3-4 tblsps | 1 pinch asafoetida powder or 2 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: Sift flour into the processor, and turn on to a nice, dry, dry texture. Gradually add more flour, mixing lightly to make a medium and stiff batter from the mixture with your fingers. Turn onto clean, dry surface, and knead the dough until it feels firm and pliable. Form into a ball, coat in flour, and roll out into an 3/4 inch round. Cut into six wedges, and place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with a little sugar, or set aside in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Crunchy Peanut Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chopped green peas | 2 teaspoons fruit chutney
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve.

title: My Sweet Onion Pickles
ingredients: 150 g red onions, cut lengthways into rings ( or a mixture of onions and mushrooms, or both ) | 150 ml red wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons light molasses | 3 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Store in tightly covered container for upto 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,garlic,extra virgin olive oil,plum tomato,cold water,curry powder,cooking oat,garlic powder
title: Curried Grap Tomatoes With Tomatoes and Curry
ingredients: 3 medium plum tomatoes ( diced ) | 4 teaspoons good quality curry powder | 4 teaspoons fresh minced garlic | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil ( see instructions below ) | 2 cups fresh grape tomatoes, halved ( or 12-14 oz. pint ones, with the rinsed out ) | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 teaspoon garlic powder, lightly crushed ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon quick cooking oats ( i use quick-cook oats )
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a dutch oven over medium heat until it shimmers. Add the garlic and cook until sizzling, about 30 seconds. Stir in the curry powder and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Turn the heat up to medium high, and add the tomatoes. Cook, stirring from time to time, until the tomatoes have begun to soften, 3 - 5 minute or so, stirring, to prevent sticking. Add the cold water, cover the pan, reduce the heat to medium low, and cook until tomatoes are cooked through and tender and most of the liquid has evaporated, about 3 to 4 minute add the garlic powder and quick oats, and stir to combine. Transfer the tomatoes to a shallow serving dish, and sprinkle with salt. Serve with steamed couscous or rice.

title: Herb Crusted Beef Tenderloin (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat | 2 cups old fashioned oats ( not instant ) | 1/2 cup oatmeal, powder
instructions: Spray the sides and bottom of a heavy 3 1/2 quart crock pot with cooking spray. Place the tenderloin on the bottom of the crockpot and evenly coat with oatmeal powder. Place the crock pot on the centre rack of the crockpot and set to low. Cook for 4 - 5 hours. Turn control to high and serve.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,chicken wing,cremini mushroom,tortilla,rotini pasta,spaghetti sauce,sirloin tip roast,celery rib
title: Italian Chicken Wings in Creamy Tortilla Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs chicken wings | 1 lb carrot, cut to a 1/4 inch thick slices. | 8 -10 cremini mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 medium celery rib, sliced into 1/4 inch thick slices. | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 box rotini pasta ( any flavor ) | 2 packages spaghetti sauce | 15 -20 toothpicks
instructions: Lay chicken out onto wax paper on a lightly floured counter. Place about 6 cups of hot water between each chicken wing so the water doesn't boil out. The reason you are using the paper napkins is to provide steam as pasta cooks. Make sure the water doesn't boil out of the tortillas. Pour a cup or two of cream in the bottom of a 4 qt pot or large roasting pan. Bring to a boil. Dump the carrots in, and when they have risen to the surface, drain. Place in the pot of hot water to steam. When done, remove the carrots. Slice the chicken wings into bite sized pieces, approximately 3 - 4 lbs. You can freeze any kind of meat for later use or do two other things. Once the water is boiling, lay out chicken wings onto a paper towel. Rinse and drain any excess excess water. In the pot, pour the 1/4 cup cream into the 1 qt pot. Turn the heat down to medium or high, bring to a boil and continue to boil. After about 10 minutes, stir in the sliced celery. Remove the pan from heat. In a large bowl, place the cooked carrots, the chopped mushrooms, and the sliced celery, mix all. Place some toothpicks in the sauce. You can also tear the rotini into large chunks to be placed directly on them. I usually use a fork, but you can also make pretty pretty pretty shapes. I place them on a serving rack in a shallow pan of hot water to soak. Place in the refrigerator until ready to use. You do not want the vegetables to get a bit softer than they should be. After about 7 - 8 minutes, remove the toothpicks. You do not want them to become crisp. Turn off the stove and let the chicken legs and wings sit there to cool for a couple of minutes. The longer they sit in the liquid they will cook, the more tender and much richer the chicken will be. If you feel any burning at the bottom of the pan while cooling, place another 3 - 4 inches of water to boil the pasta for 3 - 5 minutes, don't over boil them but just undercook, the pasta will finish cooking. Drain, and quickly toss with the chicken and vegetable mixture. Serve or refrigerate. The best way to do this is to take the toothpicks out from a couple of times, it makes it easier for you to clean, and it seems pretty easy.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,pork shoulder,dill pickle,beef chuck,milk,plum,arborio rice,red cabbage
title: Beef Risotto With Dilly Pickles
ingredients: 2 cups milk | 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 2 inch pieces | 5 cups red cabbage, sliced | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill pickle | 3 cups arborio rice | 6 plum ( very ripe ), sliced | 1 -2 cup lightly steamed fresh dill pickle, chopped
instructions: Bring the milk and pork to a boil in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer the pork for about 1 hour. Add the cabbage, creme fraiche, dill pickles, rice, undrained plum, undrained canoes, red cabbage, and 1 1/4 cups of water. Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture, partially covered, for about one hour.

title: Korean Sweet Chili

instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 degrees celcius. Place the chicken in a large, shallow roasting pan and cover with the walnuts. instructions: Combine all but cheese in a shallow dish. Add half the meat, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, turning over once or twice. Broil on hot grill until done to desired doneness. Spoon yogurt over steak and top with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with chille.

instructions: Mix bananas and tortilla pieces. Arrange in a single layer on a nonstick cookie sheet, cover, and allow the burritos to rest 5 - 10 minutes. Arrange on a serving platter and serve with salsa, cheese and sour cream.

instructions: Slit the tops off of the peppers, remove the seeds and pulp, and clean the insides of the peppers. title: Apple Yogurt Dip

instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric blender and blend well.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread bean shells onto a baking sheet and toast in the preheated oven until lightly browned and heated through, 10 to 15 minutes. Scoop out baked beans with a spoon onto a plate. Pour enough baked beans with liquid to reach a depth of 1/2 inch.

title: Easy Fish-Biscuits

instructions: Break up the fish in a large bowl. Place the salt in the bottom of a large skillet. Heat on medium high. Add the cornbread mix and 1/2 cup of the broth to the fish. Stir until well combined. Spoon a heaping tablespoon of the fish mixture onto a paper towel to keep it moist. title: Irish Stew Stew of Doom
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 4 -5 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 2 -3 quarts water | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs stewing beef
instructions: Cut the pork into 1 - ½ inch cubes. The fat will float to surface so if it does, drain off as much fat as possible and discard. The stock, after washing the meat, will keep the meat warm in a saucepan until ready to receive its seasonings. Strain the stock, discarding solids. Return stock to the pot and bring to a boil.

title: Real French Bread Soup
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty bread ( thick-dressed ) | boiling water
instructions: Use a bread machine or food processor fitted with a coarse loaf. Start your machine to process the bread. After the second bread loaf is processed, stop the machine and check until the bread has enough moisture remaining to stick to the metal spoon. If necessary, add boiling water. This process should take about 10 - 15 minutes. Taste and make adjustments to the consistency of the soup. Adjust salt and pepper or flavorings if necessary.

title: Roasted Portabella Mushroom and Prawn Salad
ingredients: 300 g portabella mushrooms | 400 g prawns | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Wash mushrooms with cold water and dry on a clean cloth. Dry out the mushrooms with a paper towel. Roast each mushroom under a preheated grill for 3 minutes on each side. Remove from the grill and pat dry. Cut each mushroom in half and place on serving plates. Place the prawns in a bowl and add the pine nuts. Toss to combine and serve right away.

title: Spinach and Rice Salad

instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, rinse with cold water. Transfer to a bowl. Meanwhile, microwave pesto, rice, and spinach at high until heated through, about 1 minute. Add spinach mixture and rosemary. Toss to combine. Serve warm.

title: Aussie Pork and Lima Beans
ingredients: 200 g frozen lima beans | 600 g country boneless pork chops | 200 g frozen strawberries
instructions: Blend all ingredients except pork in a food processor or blender for about 15 to 30 seconds, stopping frequently to scrape down the bowl. Transfer to a deep frying pan, making sure to cover the bottom. Spray the top of the pork with oil cooking spray and set aside. Spray both sides of the pork with oil cooking spray and return to the pan. When the pork is brown, add the beans. Cover and simmer on a very low heat for about 30 minutes or until it's cooked. Turn off the heat, press through a fine mesh sieve or with a large spoon stir it through the strainer. The sieve should have removed the fibers from the sieve and the bean mixture is the base of the liquid. Serve immediately.

title: Barbecue Beef Tenderloin or Reubrock
ingredients: 4 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 lbs rump roast or 2 lbs blade roast | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon bacardi vodka | 2 tablespoons crushed pineapple with juice | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a spice grinder, grind the coriander seeds. Rub the mixture into the roast. Sprinkle with lemon pepper and bacardi. Tightly tie the roast, making sure that the roast won't come out of the bone. Pour off any excess marinade. Place the roast or tenderloin on rack in foil lined roasting pan. Roast for 3 hours, or to desired doneness. Insert meat thermometer. Remove from oven. Let sit for 10 minutes. Slice meat. Place on heated platter surrounded by sliced almonds.

title: Blueberry 'n Cheese Mexican Cheese Dip - No Boil!!

instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a crock pot on low until thoroughly mixed. Serve warm, with tortilla chips or your favorite fillings i put mine in a small tupperware casserole dish to freeze for later use.

title: Peach and Provolone Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can sliced peaches, well drained, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon green chili pepper, minced | 3 slices crusty white bread, cut diagonally in half | 1/3 cup romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup prosciutto or 1/2 cup ham, coarsely chopped ( 4 slices ) | grated provolone cheese | blackberries, for garnish
instructions: In bowl, combine peaches & chile. Cut bread lengthwise into four 4x4 inch strips & arrange in a single layer on baking sheet. Broil 3 - 4 inches from heat until just melted, 3 - 5 minutes, serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,pork loin roast,tomato paste,red capsicum,red pepper flake,jalapeno chile,chunky peanut butter
title: Wassail's Chatt

instructions: Place the pork with the fat in a deep saucepan. Add the tomato paste, red pepper flakes, red capsicum, chilies and peanut butter. title: Mama's Noodle Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup crumbed bread crumbs | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup chopped pecan halves | 1/4 cup red pepper | 1 can coconut cream | 1 jar prepared pasta sauce
instructions: Soak pecan halves in a bowl of warm water until softened, about 10 - 15 minutes. Cut coconut cream into thin slices, about 1/4 inch thick. Drain meat mixture in a colander into a bowl. Turn the mixture into a 9x13 baking dish or 8 x2 inch baking pan large enough to hold meatballs in a single layer. Cover and bake in 350°f oven for 20 - 25 minutes, stir the meatballs occasionally, or turn them about halfway through cooking. Uncover during the last 10 minutes of baking. Let sit 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: white onion,shiitake mushroom,beet,mushroom,dark brown sugar,salt black pepper,cumin
title: Mushroom and Beet Pies
ingredients: 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 2 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 1 small slice white onion | 2 ounces dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon salt and cracked black pepper to taste | 1 large can sliced beets, with liquid
instructions: Place mushrooms, onion, dark brown sugar, cumin, salt and pepper into the slow cooker. Stir until well blended. Place beetroots into slow cooker and stir. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours. Turn control to low and continue cooking for 3 - 4 hours.

title: Asparagus and Peppercorn Stir Fry

instructions: Cut asparagus lenghtways and slice diagonally into 2 3inch lengths. Place the asparagus in a pan of boiling water. Cook for 2 minutes. Add in the orange juice and half the sliced lemon zest back into the pan. Stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes over a very low flame. Remove from the heat. Just before serving, mix in the remaining zest & stir through the remaining sliced lemon zest. Serve hot. Use fresh ginger garlic gloves if you can or fresh garlic, as much or little as you prefer.

title: Mixed Vegers (Vegan)

instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl and place in a blender or mixer with a little bit of water. Pulse this constantly until you get a smooth, creamy consistency. Serve with bread sticks. Enjoy.

instructions: Heat oven to 375 fahrenheit. In a large bowl combine mushrooms, oil, maple syrup and mix well. Mix together baking powder and sugar. Cut shortening into mixture until completely absorbed. Add to mushrooms, tossing to coat. Transfer mixture to a lightly greased 9x9 inch baking dish. Bake at 375f until tops are crispy and golden brown, about 30 minutes. Allow to cool for 20 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: oil,turmeric,maple syrup,tabasco sauce,pesto sauce,chicken meat,yellow bell pepper
title: Grilled Chicken Stuffed Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 12 yellow bell peppers, halved | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons prepared tapasco sauce ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or more ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Brush peppers with oil, and sprinkle with salt. Set on prepared baking sheet, and bake at 400° for 20 - 25 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: coconut,gin,basil pesto,avocado,pico de gallo,beef rib,icing sugar,jalapeno pepper milder
title: Coconut Short Ribs (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs beef short ribs | pico de gallo | 1 avocado, halved pitted mashed | juice of one jalapeno pepper ( milder, if you don't like the heat ) | 1 teaspoon basil pesto | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 cup freshly grated coconut (, i use freshly shredded ) | 1/2 medium jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees. Place ribs in a foil lined roasting pan. Rub ribs with pico de gallo. Mix avacado and juice of one jalapeño with pesto and spread on the ribs. Dip ribs in icing sugar. Roast in oven until meat thermometer reads 130 degrees for medium rare or to desired doneness, about 2 hours. During last 15 minutes, spread mango and/or lime juice mixture on top. Serve on a bed of jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,kernel corn,chocolate milk,cayenne powder,pepper,spanish onion,hummus
title: Chunky and Creamy Spanish Onion Dip!
ingredients: 2 large spanish onions, diced | 2 bags frozen whole kernel corn, thawed ( defrosted if frozen ) | 1 jar chunky salsa ( mild, medium or hot works well ) | 1 container low-fat chocolate milk ( or use 2 cups fat free milk and 1 tsp honey or use 1/2 tsp sugar ) | 1 dash cayenne powder | pepper | hummus, to serve
instructions: Microwave onion and corn on high power for 25 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Drain and stir in salsa. Microwave on high for 8 - 10 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the onions are translucent and the salsa thickens slightly. Add milk, honey and cayenne for flavor and texture. Serve with hot chips and enjoy.

title: Pasta 'N' Cheese with Tomatoes, Horseshoes and Oats
ingredients: 150 g dried porridge oats | 250 g farfalle pasta | 125 ml thick tomato sauce | 30 g butter, cut into small pieces | 1/4 cup muenster cheese
instructions: To make the sauce, put the tin foil on a baking tray and cover in some boiling water. Place the oats in a food processor and blitz until finely and crumbly. Add the tomato sauce ingredients and pulse for a few seconds more to combine. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in plenty of boiling, slated water until just tender. Drain well and add to the pan with the butter. Stir in the cheese and heat through. Serve immediately.

title: Golden Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup beef round steak, cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons tortilla chips, crushed
instructions: Place beef in bowl. Combine golden syrup, crushed tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: spicy brown mustard,baby spinach,double cream,heavy whipping cream,rotel
title: Spinach and Tomato Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup double cream | 1 1/4 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 lb baby spinach | 1/2 cup spicy brown mustard | 4 cups fresh baby spinach
instructions: Bring cream and cream to a simmer over medium heat. Drain spinach and roughly chop. Put the spinach in a large pan of lightly salted water and cook for 1 minute. Drain well, reserving the liquid. Turn the heat up a bit and add mustard and spinach stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Pour cream and spinach mixture into pan and stir. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 - 7 minutes, or until thickened. Stir in the baby spinach just before serving.

title: Sweet Potato and Beef Trifle
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and quartered | 1 lb ground pork and beans | 8 ounces beef tenderloin, sliced | 8 ounces mangoes, cut into 3/4 '' chunks | 8 ounces tomatoes, cut into quarters | 15 -20 ladyfingers | 1 cup quinoa, cook
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake the quinoa, covered, for about 25 - 30 minutes. After removing the from oven, remove the cover and allow the quinoa to become cool. Add the mango to the quinoa and mix well. Set aside until ready to serve. Using a mandolin or sharp knife, slice the beef into very thin slices and then slice thinly on the diagonal. Place in a large mixing bowl and add the beef, beans, and pork. Mix well so that everything evenly distribute. Chop up the tomatoes, and add them to the meat mixture. Let sit at least five minutes before slicing. Slice the lady fingers into 3 or 4 pieces and put them on one side. Mix the quinoa with half of the water in the baking dish. Spread the quinoa mixture over the lady fingers. Top with a layer of the mango and beef mixture. Repeat with another layer of the mango and beef, then finally top with a layer of the quinoa mixture. Top with another layer of mango and beef, and repeat with a final layer of the quinoa mixture. Sprinkle with a bit more quinoa if desired. Bake in the oven for approximately 40 minutes. Serve with sour cream and sliced french bread.

title: Creamy German Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, slices chopped | 1 lb lean boneless pork, cut in 2 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons dried cranberry juice cocktail | 6 cups mixed greens, sliced ( i like italian, italian, and mixed greens ) | 1 sprig thyme or 1 -2 sprig rosemary ( optional ) | 1 small cardamom, to taste
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp remove to paper towel, drain. Drain all except one tablespoon of the fat except the for one tablespoon, set aside. Add pork to the bacon grease along with the pesto and cranberry juice cocktail and cook over medium heat until pork is browned on the outside and no longer pink inside. Add green beans and continue cooking until beans are crisp tender or about 5 minutes longer. Taste and add additional spices if desired. Place hot greens on the side of the salad. Cover greens with reserved bacon fat drippings, then garnish with fresh herbs. Serve immediately.

title: Ameilia's Chiles Con Queso
ingredients: 1 large anaheim chilies or 1 large serrano chilies, seeded, and minced | 3/8 lb muenster cheese, shredded ( or other firm white cheese ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot red wine vinegar | 3/8 teaspoon tamari
instructions: Toast and rinse chiles under warm running water. Remove and discard white membrane on chiles. Place chiles in a saucepan on the stove top, cover and heat on low for a few minutes until the chiles blister and soften. This should take 4 to 5 minutes. Turn chiles over and cook a few minutes longer or until they turn from bright green and a little charred on the edges. Remove from heat. Heat the oil in a skillet on medium high heat. Add the cheese and stir until melted. Reduce heat, remove from the heat. Stir in the hot vinegar and tamari. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Rice Krispies Muffins
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers, split | 3 roma tomatoes, halved | 3 chayotes | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1 cup rice krispies
instructions: Line a 12 muffin tin with muffin tin, place 1/3 cup rice krispies in base of tin, sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sherry and cover with half the tomato halves, then sprinkle with remaining rice krispies. Wash chayote and cut into sticks and place into a microwave safe bowl with remaining sherry and oil. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Remove from microwave and let stand, covered, for 12 minutes. Fluff rice krispies with a fork and spread with 1 tablespoon yogurt. Top with ruscheries and remaining tomato halves. Microwave for 1 minute or until topping is creamy. Serve.

title: Spiced Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh brussels sprouts or 2 lbs frozen brussels sprouts | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 dashes ground red pepper
instructions: Cover a small baking dish with aluminum foil and spray top with cooking spray. Wash the sprouts. Cut out the tough center core of sprouts and set aside. In a small bowl combine the apple juice, vanilla, and pepper and set aside. Place a large pot with slightly salted water on the stove and place over high heat. When it's boiling, add sprouts, cooking until just tender, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sultana,kosher salt,black mustard seed,hellmann mayonnaise,arborio rice
title: Rice Pudding With Sultanas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hellmann's mayonnaise, room temperature | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seed | 2 teaspoons coarse kosher salt | 2 ounces sultanas
instructions: Toast the mustard seeds in a dry heavy frying pan over moderate heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Scrape them down the inside of the pan and toast, stirring, over moderately low heat, until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. Heat a dry 4 to5 quart saucepan over moderately low heat until hot but not smoking, then add the rice and toast, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the grains separate. Add the mustard seeds, salt and sultanas, stir to combine, then transfer to a warm serving dish. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,coriander seed,salmon fillet,beef bouillon cube
title: Easy Spiced Coriander Salmon
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup coriander seeds | 3 lbs salmon fillets ( i use a whole skinned head, a 6 inch piece, and 8 to 10 fillets... to keep them in smaller pieces )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine coriander seed powder, garlic powder, bouillon cube and coriander seeds. In a medium size skillet, add the coriander spice mix to the oil. When the coriander seeds are golden brown and fragrant, add the salmon and cook on both sides, until opaque throughout. Serve with rice. Enjoy.

title: Fruity Lamb Chops-Style
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 4 -5 lettuce leaves, cleaned ( or red leaf if you can't find this ) | 4 -6 slices dry-roasted carrots ( or a combination of carrot, potato and bean ) | 4 -6 teaspoons canned chipotle chiles, canned in adobo, finely minced
instructions: Pound the chops with the flat side of a meat mallet or an electric meat mallet until thin, about 3 - 4 mm thick. Arrange them on the lettuce leaves, or on the platters. Put 3/4 tsp chipotle peppers in adobo and use a grind with a pinch of salt.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,rice vinegar,habanero pepper,cremini mushroom,apple juice,chicken wing
title: Apple Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 5 chicken wings | 2 habanero peppers, split | 1 apple, peeled and chopped | 1 bunch cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: Mix cornstarch and juice together to make a runny paste. Place the chicken in a large mixing bowl and add apples, habanero pepper, mushrooms, and rice vinegar. Marinate chicken for 15 minutes to 4 hours. Bake or broil chicken until done, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: english muffin,apple juice,green chile pepper,roquefort cheese
title: Green Apple English Muffins
ingredients: 2 slices english muffins | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup crumbled roquefort cheese | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Prepare grill by brushing with oil. Lightly oil the grill grate. Arrange muffin halves face up on the grill in a nonstick baking dish. In a small bowl combine the apple juice and roquefort cheese. Pour half of the juice mixture over each muffin half.

title: Sautéed Okra -- Fresh Okra
ingredients: 1 dozen fresh okra ( or 12 cups of fresh frozen okra ) | 7 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Slice the ends off the okra, then slice the okra crossways into about 1/2 inch thick slices. Put flour into a large sauté pan. Add water. Bring to the boil over medium heat and simmer for about 10 minutes or until okra is cooked but fresh okra is still firm. Add salt and pepper if needed depending on type of okra and saltiness of okra.

Random Ingredients: frangelico,porcini mushroom,beef tenderloin steak,italian sausage,stewing beef,oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chickpea
title: Porcini Crostini With Sausages and Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed and sliced | 2 lbs lean portuguese sausages | 1 lb stewing beef, drained, and sliced | 1 can chickpeas, drained ( or 4 - 2 cup drained canned chickpeas ) | 4 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 4 ounces dried cannetti mushrooms ( 2 pkgs ) | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | frangelico or maraschino cherry, shavings
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Drain and rinse the casings out of the fresh sausages. Place all the crostini ingredients in a casserole and toss well. Cover and bake for 1 hr, stirring occasionally. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, then toss all the contents of the casserole with the frangelico or the amatraciana and serve. Garnish with freshly grated pepper and serve piping hot.

title: Matzoh
ingredients: 6 cups matzo meal | 1 1/4 pounds pork sausage | 1/2 cup filling for filling | 2 kiwi - peeled, seeded, and sliced | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper | 3 fresh thyme sprigs, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Whisk matzo meal and pork sausage together in a large bowl.

title: Cucumber Tacos
ingredients: 4 medium cucumbers, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Place prepared cucumber slices in a colander over a bowl or plate and squeeze to remove excess liquid. Repeat with remaining slices. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour. Heat charcoal or gas grill. Toss cucumbers with liquid smoke in a large bowl. Season to taste with salt.

title: Linguine Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 pound linguine pasta
instructions: In a bowl, stir together vinegar and linguine. Chill.

title: Quick and Easy Escarole Escarole
ingredients: 6 -8 cups escargot | 1 diced ham | 2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Place the escargots, ham, flour and salt in a medium sized pot. Cover with water, cover and simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes. Remove the cover and continue to simmer on low heat for 25 minutes or until thickened.

title: Balsamic Dippies
ingredients: 1 egg noodle | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Boil noodles, drain and then rinse in cold water. Drain again and mix with vinegar. Add flour and mix well until dough is formed. Roll out lightly and cut out shapes with cookie cutters and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake for 20 mins on a 190c. Mark when cool.

title: Potato and Tortellini
ingredients: 1 lb cooked tortellini | 1/4 cup dry cornstarch | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried orange peel | fresh parsley leaves,, for garnish | 1/8 cup potato, diced ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cornstarch, cream, baking soda and orange peel in a large bowl. Place the chopped potato on top of the cornstarch mixture and toss well to coat, then sprinkle with the chopped parsley. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pork,lemon curd,elbow macaroni,orange zest,tomato puree,cardamom seed,cocoa powder
title: Easy Chocolate Calzone
ingredients: 2 cups canned crushed tomatoes with puree | 1/4 cup sugar or 1/4 cup honey | 2 3/4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon lemon curd or 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed or 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 8 ounces cooked elbow macaroni or 8 ounces rotelle pasta
instructions: Stir ingredients with 1/4 cup of water for 30 seconds to soften the cheese sauce. Pour the cheese sauce in a ziploc zip lock bag with the crushed or ground nuts.. Marinate 3 hours to overnight. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook pasta as directed on package. Drain the pasta and toss with cheese sauce, then put in a well buttered baking dish and sprinkle top with more grated nuts. Allow to stand for about 15 minutes for the toad to absorb the air. Cut into squares and serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: paprika,sirloin steak,vegetable bouillon granule,green curry paste
title: Green Curry Steak
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons thai green curry paste | 1 1/2 lbs top sirloin steaks
instructions: Combine paprika, granules, and curry paste in a large resealable plastic bag, add steak, coat with marinade, and seal bag. Refrigerate at least 4 hours, turning bag occasionally. Remove steak from marinade, shaking off excess. Remove steak, reserving marinade, and wipe off excess. Discard marinade. Grill or broil steak, brushing frequently with reserved marinade until cooked to desired doneness, about 8 minutes for medium rare, or 14 to 20 minutes for medium.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,cardamom seed,puff pastry,chocolate shaving,carrot,cremini mushroom,sparkling water
title: Chocolate Pastry Triangles
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1/4 cup sparkling water | 1/2 cup light brown sugar or 1/2 cup dark sweetener | 1 1/4 cups canned tomato sauce | 1 pinch cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom seed | 1 large carrot, grated | 1 package cremini mushrooms, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place pastry sheets on clean work surface and sprinkle sugar and sparkling water evenly over pastry. Wrap pastry around filling in pastry and pinch ends until dough holds together, then transfer to a cookie sheet sprayed with pam. In a bowl, combine tomato sauce with cardamom, whole cardamom and carrots. Pour over dough, then sprinkle with mushrooms. Let stand 30 minutes in refrigerator before cutting, or refrigerate up to a day or two before serving. Let stand at room temperature for 15 - 20 minutes before serving.

title: Spiced Beef BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup hot barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup water | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir. Use as a sloppy joe with hot rolls.

title: Pesto Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 28 ounces pureed tomatoes with juice | 14 1/2 ounces condensed pesto sauce | 14 ounces tomato juice
instructions: Heat tomato juice on low for 2 min to soften the skin. Then add pesto sauce & tomato juice. Use for dipping foods & salads.

Random Ingredients: ham,sage leaf,chili flake,french bread,active yeast,rice noodle,chili sauce
title: Paneer Bread
ingredients: 400 g dried rice noodles, soaked in water overnight | 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 2 g active dry yeast or 2 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 500 g of thin sliced ham | 4 slices of thick long french bread
instructions: Boil the water and add the dry chili, chili sauce, yeast, chopped sage and chilli flakes. Stir till the yeast dissolves. Turn off the heat. Drain the noodles, reserving the water. Combine the noodles and water in a lrg bowl. Cover and let sit for half an hour, until the liquid is absorbed. Meanwhile, fry the ham on a large flat pan till the fat begins to run and the pieces browned. Drain on paper towels and slice into thin 3/4 inch pieces. Drain most of the fat from the pan and stir in the noodles. Add the ham, bread and any extras you like. Cover and place in a warm spot until the bread has doubled in size. Turn the oven down very low. Bake for 40 50min till light and crusty.

title: Tapioca Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup tapioca | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon sweet rice wine
instructions: Cook the tapioca in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain, place in a serving bowl. Add the cherry tomatoes. Beat with a mixer at medium speed for 3 minutes or until blended. Pour dressing over salad.

title: Basic Onions--Authentic Mexican Recipe
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 yellow onion or 1 jalapeno, finely diced | 2 cups tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Slice baguette into 24 equal slices, 1/3 in thick or 18 in squares, each about a quarter to 1/4 thick and 5 in round. Layer a portion of onions onto each piece of bread until just covered by the salt. Sprinkle with tabasco and continue layering till all ingredients are used. Heat on grill or grill pan until bottoms are light brown, or place on cookie sheet under broiler. Watch closely do not get burnt or burn yourself.

title: Chicken Drumettes With Bourbon
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bourbon, at room temperature | 1/3 cup cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 8 chicken drummettes | oil, for frying
instructions: Combine the bourbon, cream of tarter, and salt in a bowl. Add the oil to a large skillet and set over medium high heat. When the oil is very hot, place chicken in a shallow dish and pour the bourbon mixture over. Turn the chicken several times so that it coats the entire chicken. Cover and cook about 45 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is tender. Turn the chicken over in the sauce, turn off the heat, and set aside. Heat a small amount of oil in a skillet and fry the drumettes for 5 - 6 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper and serve with the bourbon sauce.

title: Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 1 cup taco seasoning | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Combine taco seasoning and lime wedge in small bowl. Place on small plate.

title: Pea Puffs
ingredients: 2 cups frozen peas ( thawed ) | 12 tablespoons frozen puff pastry ( thawed ) | 1 cup shelled raw almonds | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Mix pea mixture, margarine, eggs, almond extract and nuts in bowl. Roll out puff pastry on lightly floured surface. Cut a slit in center to allow filling to spread out. Scoop 1/4 cup filling into each pastry hole. Re roll with the help of your hands. Use a fork to secure edges with long toothpicks. Brush with beaten egg or milk if not using a piping bag. Cook in boiling salted water for 12 minutes.

title: Spicy Oil for Deep-Frying
ingredients: 1 lb chili pepper flakes, dried
instructions: Mix the chili flakes with salt. Use a funnel into your deep fryer to carefully pour the oil into a pan of approximately 300 degrees to reach a depth of 2 inches. Do not crowd the oil. You will need to deep fry in batches. The oil should be ready when bubbles have popped for 5 minutes. Remove immediately, drain. Allow the oil to cool slightly. Use or store in the refrigerator.

title: The Icelandic Style Eggs
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 12 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Slice eggs in half and remove yolks through fine mesh strainer placed over large bowl. Carefully remove shells and yolks from eggs with a slotted spoon and set aside. Carefully scoop yolks into a bowl set over large bowl of ice water, gently shaking bowl to combine. Pour egg whites into egg whites and stir gently to coat. Transfer yolks to paper towels and pat dry. Discard shells and yolks. Using metal spatula, transfer the egg whites to plates. Sprinkle eggs with lime wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,penne pasta,monterey jack cheddar cheese,dill pickle,spaghetti,leek,pastry,apple cider
title: Scalloped Macaroni and Cheese With Mandarin Confit
ingredients: 1 package medium pasta | 1 package miniature penne pasta | 1 leek, white and light green parts only, sliced diagonally 3/4 inch thick | 2 ounces minced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup low-fat monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 1/2 cup low-fat monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 1/4 cup low-fat apple cider ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Cook pasta according to package directions. Cook leek in nonstick skillet over medium low heat until tender. Stir in ginger garlic paste and cook 1 minute. Remove leeks and set aside. Spray medium saucepan with cooking spray. Heat to boiling then stir in 2/3 of the cooked pasta, including the water. Stir in leek mixture and the remaining drained pasta, cheese, apple cider and dill pickles. Transfer to prepared dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 35 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Cannoli Rolls (Caramelized Vegetables)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 1/2 lbs carrots | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons yeast | 2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons cavenders all purpose greek seasoning | 250 g chocolate, melted ( optional and to your taste ) | 12 pieces carmelized chocolate or 12 pieces waxed paper
instructions: Prepare dough by mixing, oil or buttering hands, carrots, ricotta, yeast, thyme leaves, cheese, and greek seasoning until well incorporated. Chill until needed. Preheat oven to 400°f roll dough into 1 1/2 inch thick logs. Lay flat on a parchment paper lined baking sheet 2 inches apart. Poke a hole through the top of each log a few inches apart. Brush with melted chocolate, if using. Bake until very lightly browned. Cool 10 minutes, then cut diagonally into 1 1/2 inch slices. Cool completely and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: white onion,chicken bouillon,baking powder,cod,poblano pepper,red potato,lettuce leaf
title: Potato Cod With Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 medium white onion, diced | 1/2 bunch lettuce leaf, washed and sliced | 2 -4 medium red potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1 lb cod, cut into flounder sized flounder or 1 lb boston bibb lettuce, with thick skin on | 2 poblano peppers, stems and seeds removed and diced small | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Set a dutch oven over medium high heat. Add the diced onion, chopped lettuce leaves and diced potatoes. Add just enough water and chicken bouillon to come just about halfway up the side of the potatoes and keep the pan on the stove. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, until potatoes are soft.. Set a large sieve in a bowl and take the potatoes off the liquid onto the sieve. Add the cod to the liquid over the top and set a lid on the pan.. Steam for about 15 minutes and check for doneness, if it is still slightly warm but has turned slightly crisp, check for doneness. It should almost look a little firmer now. Remove the fish to platter. Take the potato pan off the burner leaving behind all the juices in the pan and pour the liquid back into the sauce pan. Let the liquid return up to boiling point, then stir in the diced poblano peppers. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes longer, or until poblano becomes soft and flavors have blended. Add more liquid to thin any sauce that may easily separate from the liquid.

Random Ingredients: oil vinegar dressing,cornflour,vegetable juice cocktail,seasoning salt
title: Simple and Easy Sweet and Sour Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable juice cocktail ( use a sprite to make up the liquid ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon cornflour | oil ( flavored with vinegar, sunflower seed etc. )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl, using a spoon. Cover with plastic wrap. Leave at room temperature for about 1 hour. Take off plastic wrap and leave in fridge for up to 1 day.

title: Fried Dates With Dates
ingredients: 1 lb dates, in skins | 6 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Cut the dates lengthwise, make a slit crosswise, then slit down one side. Put them into a fry pay, make as many as will fit. Put the oil into each slit. Fry on both sides until dark golden. This takes about 3 - 4 mintues. The yield depends on how fried you like the dates. You can also add a few tablespoons of butter for a richer taste.

title: Perfect Basic Baked Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice, washed | 1/4 cup bread flour or 1/4 cup bread flour | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Rub water in a large bowl and add rice, bread flour, and caraway seeds to the water. Mix with hands to combine. Spread a tea towel over a baking sheet or parchment and press rice into the towel to form a 5 inch long rectangle. Sprinkle the rice with more flour if needed. Place the short sheet in the center of the oven. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the rice is golden and cooked. Fluff the rice with a fork and serve while still hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,season salt,green olive,chicken bouillon granule
title: Mexican Green Olives Soup (Copycat)
ingredients: 20 -40 pitted green olives ( not canned ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 14 ounces tomato puree | 4 tablespoons season-all salt
instructions: Put all ingredient in a food processor and process until desired consistency is reached. Chill until ready to serve for a better taste.

Random Ingredients: bottom roast,part mozzarella cheese,chicken sausage,chicken,swiss cheese,cannellini bean,cumin powder,creme fraiche
title: Cheesy Roast Chicken With Sausage and White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 4 lbs bottom roast, on the bone, skin removed | 4 links chicken sausages, without casing, cut into 1/4 slices | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 2 cups swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh cilantro or 1/4-1/2 cup parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place the roast in a large roasting pan with the cumin and spread half on top of each roast, using the whole slice of sausages. Prick the roast with a fork and place roast in a preheated oven, then roast 2 to 4 hours, checking for doneness and adding a little water if necessary, or until an instant read thermometer reads 160 degrees, or the meat thermometer reads 165 degrees. Drain the roast and allow it to cool slightly before slicing thinly. Toss together, with the cheeses, the beans, and remaining cumin. Adjust the seasonings with salt and pepper. Serve chilled. Garnish.

Random Ingredients: farina,soybean paste market,green jalapeno pepper,anaheim chilies,apricot preserve,ghee,whipping cream,maple syrup
title: Jamaican Jaffrey Kay
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons clarified butter | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 2 anaheim chilies, chopped | 2 green jalapeno peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons soyabean paste ( known as soybean paste ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons soyabean maple syrup
instructions: Heat the clarified butter in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.

title: Simple Enchiladas (No-Yeast Version)
ingredients: 500 g philadelphia cream cheese | 1 pint masa harina | 1 cup vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixer or food processor. Put aside 1/2 of mixture until cool enough to roll out. Then roll into balls and refrigerate or freeze until ready to use. Note, make sure you don't get any dough stuck to your fingers or your hands since they are delicate. For extra air, roll the balls with your hands. For softer and faster results, roll them on a pastry cloth soaked in cold water before rolling them into balls of desired size. If you have the time, you can roll them on a greased cooking sheet until all of the balls have been rolled and refrigerated or frozen. For more dough you may use all of the dough. Roll mixture into balls and put them on the sprayed parchment paper and then freeze. When ready to use, take out and dip each ball into melted caramel on low heat and bake on a baking sheet or tortilla coated with cooking spray for 5 - 10 minutes until crispy. The only time i made these i did not miss it and they seemed the best in my kitchen. Some even liked them with a little sugar. Note, you may use flour, cornmeal or a combination to roll the balls, but it will not taste right to stretch with fingers, so if using cornmeal, just mix a bit more. I prefer flour, but a few tablespoons or so of water in a measuring cup helps to measure out the cornmeal you should probably be able to get away with 1 cups of cornmeal or 4 ounces of flour. Note, the best way to measure out the cornmeal is to look at a 1/4 cup measuring cup, which is about 2 tablespoons/4 ounce in weight.

title: Spicy Scallops
ingredients: 1 lb scallops ( raw ) | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, your favorite variety | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dry fruit | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a large frying pan toast cumin seeds until dark brown and fragrant. Immediately add liquid smoke, remove from stove, and add scallops. Cover, and put on top of stove. Simmer 30 - 45 minutes, until scallops turn white. Serve over noodles cooked al dente.

title: Yogurt and Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 4 ounces roasted chocolate
instructions: Combine yogurt and chocolate in a bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,sherry wine vinegar,lime juice zest
title: A Unique and Yummy Thai Basil Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/4 cup lime juice ( i add extra as the two zest from 1/4 lemon isn't enough ) | 8 ounces thai basil, washed, spun dry, torn into small pieces ( regular is fine )
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine all ingredients and blend well. Place in a covered jar and refrigerate to chill and firm up up.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,beef broth,heavy cream,brussels sprout,sherry wine,wild rice
title: Wild Rice and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2/3 cup wild rice, uncooked | 8 ounces brussels sprouts | 3/4 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions. Trim brussels sprouts, remove bottoms and cut off any tops with a pair of kitchen scissors. Stack them on top of each other, stem side down. Heat beef broth to boiling in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Add saffir lime leaf in 2 batches and cook for 2 - 3 minutes to soften leaves. Add rice, sprouts and sherry.

title: Tofu Hotpot
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu or 1 lb water-packed tofu, drained and diced | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander | sparkling water
instructions: Place tofu, red bell pepper, coriander and enough water to just cover all of the ingredients into a medium saucepan and cover with a lid. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat slightly and simmer for about 15 minutes, until vegetables have softened and the tofu has expanded in bite sized shreds. Serve warm with a sprinkling of chopped parsley or cilantro..

title: Quinoa Tequila Broccoli & Raisins
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli | 1/2 - 1 cup raisins | 1/2 lime | 3 ounces tequila | 3/4 cup quinoa
instructions: Clean the broccoli & break off the tough stalk, cut in bite size pieces if the broccoli wood comes out too dry, use 1/2 cup more water and bring to a boil. Cover, lower the heat and simmer until just tender, 10 - 15 minutes. Rinse, remove and discard the florets. Drain in a strainer, discarding any remaining buds or loose stalks. Bring 2 quarts of salted water to a boil. Add quinoa & boil until all of the water is absorbed. If not using all of the quinoa, it can be left until next day or even up to 3 days. After adding the tequila, boil the quinoa for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat & cool completely. When it has cooled completely, remove the stalks & set aside for a moment to allow the liquid to become absorbed. When all of the quinoa is cooked, add the broccoli pieces & raisins into the quinoa & toss.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,xanthan gum,tomato soup,chicken part,chili sauce,pistachio nut
title: Gluten Free Chicken Lollies
ingredients: 1 lb chicken parts | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup shelled pistachio nut, chopped
instructions: Rinse chicken parts thoroughly and pat dry. Combine chili sauce, chili flakes, xanthan gum, tomato soup, and 1/2 of the pistachios in a bowl, and stir well. Add chicken and stir to coat well. Set aside for 1 hour or more. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a nonstick roasting pan with foil, and spray it with pam. Add chicken to pan. Spoon reserved stock mixture evenly over chicken pieces. Bake covered for 35 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer or until chicken is slightly browned. Turn off oven and place on a wire rack to cool.

Random Ingredients: beef eye,bean sprout,cayenne pepper,garlic paste,flour tortilla,vital wheat gluten
title: Quick & Easy Beef-And-Bean Sprouts-Gluten Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup vital wheat gluten | 1 tablespoon flour | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 dash cayenne pepper | 1 lb boneless beef eye round, cut in 1/2-inch slices | 4 flour tortillas or 4 corn tortillas
instructions: Whisk together dry ingredients in a ziploc bag and add the beef slices and refrigerate overnight. On a second piece of parchment lined baking sheet, spray lightly with cooking spray or brush with oil. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees & place a small amount of meat on the bottom third of the tortilla, then sprinkle a small amount of the gluten mixture over the meat. Roll the tortilla around the meat. Arrange the meat in a single layer onto 6 bamboo or vegetable baking sheets. Bake for 12 minutes, flip over & repeat with another 12 minutes. Remove from the oven & unwrap. Cut into 8 pieces and serve with taco fixings, salsa & guacamole.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,buttermilk,pistachio,thai fish sauce,lamb,soy sauce
title: Spicy Pesto Lamb and Prawns Skewers
ingredients: 500 g lean lamb, cut into 2 cm cubes | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons ground pistachios
instructions: Soak the skewers under running water for 10 - 15 minutes. Mix together the marinade ingredients and pour over the lamb in a shallow dish. Cover with cling film and leave to marinate for one hour minimum. Thread lamb onto skewers and add to hot water, cover, bring to a boil, simmer for 2 - 3 minutes or until cooked. Drain well and transfer to a serving dish. Garnish with pistachios.

Random Ingredients: salami,mustard seed,vanilla essence,pearl tapioca,cheddar cheese soup,bake buttermilk flaky biscuit,onion
title: Cheese and Bacon Tarts
ingredients: 300 g finely sliced salami | 1 container low-fat cheddar cheese soup | 1/2 cup sweet onion | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 50 g pearl tapioca | 40 g baked buttermilk flaky biscuits
instructions: Cut salami into thin strips, then chop onion finely. Place in a bowl with soup, onion, mustard seed and vanilla. Stir in tapioca and 1 teaspoonfuls of water, cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Remove salami mixture from refrigerator and place in the centre of each biscuit.

title: Pine Nut and Chocolate Crisp
ingredients: 4 ounces dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 4 tablespoons pine nuts ( roasted or untoasted )
instructions: Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in a frying pan over a medium high heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the pine nuts to the chocolate, and when melted, fold in the chocolate/pine nuts. Transfer to a serving plate, and cool. Use the melted chocolate to drizzle over any crisp biscott.

title: Homemade Mexican Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mccormick grill seasoning | 1 boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of extra fat | 1 cup shredded colby cheese ( mild, brick or or mild )
instructions: Coat a 15x10x3 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Place pork shoulder fat side down in prepared pan. Drizzle with grill seasoning. Bake in a 375 degree f oven until meat thermometer registers 170 degrees f on an instant read thermometer, 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes. Using sharp, thin serrated knife, cut into large strips. Serve with colby cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,kidney bean,dark soy sauce
title: Quick and Easy Vegan "Rice"
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans or ( 16 ounce ) can cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
instructions: In a bowl, combine beans with soy sauce and red pepper flakes. Let chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,spinach leaf,ice cream,tarragon leaf,parsley flake
title: Green Chilli Spinach Ice Cream
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 2 green chili peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | 4 tablespoons ice cream | 3 pints spinach leaves, washed well
instructions: In a blender, mix the dried tarragon and chilli and pulse till combined. Add the parsley flakes and ice cream and process until smooth. Transfer to a glass bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove the wrap and serve with fresh spinach leaves for garnish.

Random Ingredients: white wine,egg,fritos corn chip,truffle,orange juice,baby spinach
title: Aussie Fried Spinach
ingredients: 2 ounces truffles, finely sliced | 2 ounces baby spinach | 1 egg, beaten | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 ounces fritos corn chips
instructions: Fry the fritos in a pan over a medium heat until golden. Combine remaining ingredients in another pan and heat until sauce has slightly thickened. Tip mixture over spinach and fry for a few minutes until coated.

title: Chickpeas With Capers
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 6 tablespoons drained capers ( to taste )
instructions: Open the cans chickpeas, removing the seeds, and rinse them thoroughly with cold water. Add 1 tablespoon of capers to each can and add enough water to cover the chickpeas. Tightly cover with plastic wrap and heat in a preheated 325°f oven for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,apple juice,pernod,masa harina flour,chive,cream,vermicelli,elbow macaroni
title: Sopa de Fideos (Pastel De El Nogada)
ingredients: 8 ounces vermicelli ( conchigliettes ) | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup cream | 1/4 cup minced onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons pernod ( optional ) | 1/4 cup masa harina flour | 1/4 cup minced chives | 16 ounces elbow macaroni ( conchigliettes )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water just until al dente. Drain, add sour cream and apples, mixing well. Set aside 1 cup pasta water, then drain noodles completely, then rinse with cold water. Mix pasta water, onion, cream, pernod in a large bowl, and set aside to chill for half an hour, then serve in bowls with chopped chives.

title: Pasta With Tropical Salami & Avocado
ingredients: 200 g dry pasta shells | 200 g salami | 300 g montreal steak seasoning ( to taste ) | 300 ml coconut cream ( to taste ) | 500 g meringues | kitchen bouquet | 1 hass avocado ( to garnish ) | 1/4 cup crispy tortilla, to serve
instructions: Cook pasta in large pan for 2 to 3 minutes or until al dente.

title: Quick Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 -10 lb. rump roast | freshly ground coffee or brewed coffee, to cover
instructions: If using coffee coffee, cover with cool coffee just before roasting. Note, if using coffee, add coffee to reach 1/2 cup level. Place roast in a roasting pan and pour coffee over meat. If using coffee, use water to reach 1/2 cup level. Cover roast and allow to sit at room temperature about 30 minutes. Turn roast once after 30 minutes. Slice roast and serve. If you would like to make gravy, heat 1/3 cup liquid and the rest of the liquid in a saucepan to boiling over high heat. If you are using coffee, skim off any foam/margarine. Serve roast pieces as gravy with a bowl of gravy on the side, with plenty of gravy.

title: Easy Carnitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 2 inch squares | 2 packages frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets | 1 loaf crusty bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees and grease a baking dish. Combine pork, 2 packages of frozen pastry in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. On a lightly floured surface, roll out dough into a 12x9 rectangle 6x3 inches. Using a sharp knife, cut 10 strips of the pastry and trim off excess. Starting at a long end of the dough, roll up lengthwise and cut again through dough into 5 strips. Repeat this procedure. Lay strips, seam side down, on top of each other on the baking dish. Sprinkle bread with remaining 2 packages phyllo. Bake 25 - 30 minutes. Turn the oven off and leave door slightly ajar. Let cool. Serve plain, or cut into 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,lemon juice zest,green bell pepper,pita bread,chicken stock
title: Taco Pita Crisps
ingredients: 2 pita bread, halved | 1/2 cup instant chicken stock | 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon lemon juice and zest | 2 tablespoons chopped green bell peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, mash together the chicken soup, seasoning mix, lemon and zest and bell peppers to make the mixture spreadable. Spread the pita bread halves evenly with the soup mixture. Top with the remaining pita halves. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place the pita bread halves in the skillet and place in the oven. Bake until the tops are golden brown, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black bean,almond extract,beef rib,plain flour,manchego cheese,rigatoni pasta,bay leaf
title: Spiced Baked Beef Short Ribs With Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon plain flour | 7 ounces beef short ribs | 10 ounces refried black beans | 6 ounces rigatoni pasta or 6 ounces penne | 1/3 teaspoon almond extract | 6 ounces manchego cheese | 1 large bay leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Coat a shallow ovenproof dish with oil. Dust short ribs with flour shaking off excess. Place beans in a saucepan, cover with 2 cups water and bring to the boil over moderate heat for 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain beans and return to the saucepan, add macaroni and half the beans. Bring to the boil and then place over moderate heat for 8 - 10 minutes or until just tender. Remove from heat and stir in almond extract. Spoon half of pasta mixture into prepared dish. Top with half the short ribs and half over the beans. Drizzle with remaining bean mixture. Spread remaining pasta on top and finally scatter with manchego cheese and then half over. Bake for 25 - 35 minutes or until cheese is melted and starting to brown.

title: Lamb and Hazelnut Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted | 900 g boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 2 cm cubes | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 500 g pinto beans, with some added juice reserved | 2 medium apples, peeled into thick wedges | 1 stalk celery, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 deg celsius. Spread the hazelnuts on an oven tray lined with baking paper and scatter over the toasted hazelnuts. Roast in the oven for 30 mins or until fragrant, stirring every so often. Set aside to cool. Remove the skins from the lamb and cut into small chunks. Place the lamb into a large frypan and stir in the golden syrup. Cook over a high heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins, or until golden. Stir in pinto beans, apples and celery. Return to the oven over a medium low heat for a further 3 mins or until warm. Serve with bread.

title: Simple Pomegranate Snacks
ingredients: 2 pomegranates | 1 chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Remove the seeds from the pomegranates if they are really large. Halve and pit them. Use a vegetable peeler to split each pomegranate to 1/4, right to the stem. Using a serrated knife, take a pomegranate and cut off the bottom layer. Use the knife to cut away the seed. The pomegranate makes a hole in the membrane so it can support a cone shape. Pull the membrane out of the pomegranate, and chop it up. You can use your mandolin to cut the membrane in half to make 2 or 3 little pixie shaped pockets. Place the pixie strips in a non metallic bowl. Pour the chipotle chile into the bowl, and use your hands to rub the chile into the bread. Let sit for 5 to minutes to let it soften. Fill the pixie pockets with the bread, and press a pixie cut out of the bread to make it easier to stuff as you go.

title: Chana Punjabi Kofte (Potato Casserole)
ingredients: 200 g unpeeled potatoes | 300 g chickpeas | 50 g peanut butter | 150 ml sweet vermouth or 150 ml sweet sherry | 150 ml double cream | 1 green cardamom | 1 apple, sliced thinly | 25 g peanuts ( for garnishing )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c/400°f boil the potatoes slightly until just tender but not falling apart, drain. Grate the potato flesh into a bowl, cover with water and leave to drain overnight to give you up to 2 hours. Slice up the chicken or pork and toss through your hands with salt and pepper to remove as much blood as possible, refrigerate for a few hours. Drain the potatoes and place in a pan with the chickpeas, peanut butter, sweet vermouth and cream and heat gently, until boiling. Simmer for 3 - 4 minutes or until the liquid has reduced and the mixture is smooth. Pour mixture into four 6cm deep ovenproof dishes or a similar size pan. Place the green cardamom and apple slices in a food processor with the chickpeas and process for 30 seconds to a few seconds, depending on how much juice they exude from the apples. Spread the tomato and apple mixture over the chicken mixture. Sprinkle with the chopped peanuts and bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with plain boiled noodles or fresh chapatis.

title: Shrimp and Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili oil ( can use vegetable oil ) | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 3 red chilies, chopped ( or use red jalapeno flakes if you prefer ) | 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3 tablespoons flavored bourbon
instructions: Heat chili oil and mushroom soup in a medium sized saucepan over medium heat until hot.

title: Rachael Ray's Mung Bean Belly Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 cups mung bean sprouts | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Add salt and noodles and return to boil. Cook until tender but firm, about 8 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, stir together sprouts and mustard dressing. Assemble lasagna in a shallow pan. Spread half of dressing dressing over noodles and noodles. Put 3 noodles top with remaining salad ingredients. Cover with remaining dressing and sprouts.

title: Ballsy Lamb Fritters (Australia) and Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 2 slices ground lamb | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 6 mixed sage leaves | 2 glace cherries, quartered
instructions: Cut 1 slice of bread diagonally into 1 cm thick slices. Lightly toast remaining slice and cut into thin strips. Cut 2 large eggs into thin wedges. Remove 2 leaves from the sage. Trim edges to form pock marks on base of each fritter, then use a knife to cut around edges just a little. Stuff the lamb with slices of bread, one slice at a time, and then press lightly between fingertips to break up the bread into crumbs. Place the bacon strips on a work surface, and cover with a tea towel. Leave to sit in the fridge for 40 minutes. Meanwhile, unwrap the second slice of bread and discard. Slice the second slice of bread diagonally into thin strips. Heat the oven to 190°c. Line a baking tray with foil and spray with oil. Place the fritters on the tray and then bake in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden and cooked. Remove from the oven, and set aside. Meanwhile, break the egg into two large chunks, and peel the other piece of bread into chunks. Tip onto a chopping board with the sage and leave to rest in the fridge while you prepare the rest of the fritters. When the bacon rashers are cooked, pile them onto the top of the fritters to serve alongside the remaining crumbs for dipping.

title: Chinese Barbecue Pork
ingredients: 8 ounces pork, coarsely ground | 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and stir until well blended.

title: Grilled Aubergine
ingredients: 1 medium aubergine, peeled, sliced, cut lengthwise in half crosswise | 1 boneless pork roast | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 3/4 cup baby greens | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: Preheat grill on high heat. Coat grill or grill pan with cooking spray. Remove aubergine from packaging and place cut side up on grill,. Grill 1 minute. Turn and grill 30 seconds longer. Remove from grill and place on cutting board, cut side down on cutting board. Cut crosswise in half lengthwise. Remove all of shells and leaves and discard. Cut 1/2 inch thick slices from flesh and set aside. Place meat on grill using indirect grill method or other method of choice. Turn meat once or twice. Sprinkle with lemon pepper. Lightly brush meat with oil. Grill approximately 3 to 4 minutes on each side over indirect medium heat, or until meat reaches desired degree of doneness. Top with greens and olives. If desired, serve on lettuce leaf with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,salt black pepper,pineapple juice,sunflower oil,bourbon whiskey
title: Caribbean Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup bbq sauce | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 4 ounces bourbon whiskey | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine the bbq sauce, pineapple juice, bourbon and sunflower oil in a saucepan. Heat, but do not boil serve as sauce over chicken, or shrimp, and serve accompanied by poultry, vegetables and pita wedges.

title: Baileys Irish Pea Dip
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs dried pea | 3/4 cup baileys irish cream | 12 ounces sour cream | 6 ounces pea sour cream | 1/4 cup chives | 1 teaspoon dill
instructions: Cook peas according to package directions, drain. Return to pot, stir through sour cream, chill for 2 hours. Add herbs and chill for 2 hours or more.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,tomato paste,chili pepper flake,butter,iceberg lettuce,syrup,masa harina
title: Mexican Flag Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomato paste | 1 cup masa harina ( indian flat bread ) | shredded iceberg lettuce | sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,rice wine vinegar,orange zest,peanut oil,vodka,asparagus,melon
title: Orange, Bell Pepper and Melon Salad With Rum
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon light dark rum | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated | 500 g asparagus, trimmed | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts, finely chopped | 1 melon, cut in thin slices
instructions: Combine rice wine vinegar, rum, oil and zest in a bowl. Add asparagus and toss well. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: kale,bicarbonate soda,beef,jalapeno chile,red pepper,pickling cucumber,white wine vinegar
title: Beef and Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 500 g beef, cut into 2cm cubes | 1 large cucumber, cut into 2cm cubes | 1 bunch kale, washed, well-rinsed and finely chopped | 2 pickling cucumbers, peeled and quartered | 3 pickling jalapeno chiles, sliced and seeded ( not minced ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Place beef in a saucepan and add any liquid from beef and liquid and bring to the boil. Simmer for 3 - 4 minutes, then drain. Add the cucumber, kale, pickling cucumber and jalapenos. Pour the beef and cucumber mixture into a large bowl and combine with the dressing. Serve immediately.

title: Sambal Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup teriyaki sauce ( your favorite brand or homemade teriyaki sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek ( sriracha, for a kick ) ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients very well. Refrigerate for an hour or so to chill. Serve as a dip. Note, teriyaki sauce can be used on any type of meat, fish, vegs on sandwiches or in the sauce.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,marjoram,black bean,bulb fennel,tuna steak
title: Tuna with French Fried Fennel
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 lb frozen cut fennel | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Spray bottom of wok with oil or shortening. Place tuna steaks in wok and pour water from tuna into wok. Heat till steaks are 4 - 4 inches from medium high or close to full of steam in a nonstick skillet or on grill rack. Baste steaks with vinegar a few times while steaming. While steaming, scrape fennel from stem and cut fronds from fronds. Put fronds, fennel and black beans in a saucepan. Cover and cook over low heat 1 1/2 2 hours, adding more water if necessary. Serve over prepared couscous.

title: Easy Tomato Ketchup
ingredients: 1 cup canola oil | 2 cups good quality tomato ketchup | 1 cup chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Heat oil and ketchup together, then add parsley and stir. Serve hot with assorted breads.

title: Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine beans, onion, cornflour, thyme and bay leaf. Cook, stirring often, until beans are heated through, 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno jack cheese,seasoning mix,apple pie filling,orange,date
title: Mexican Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 3 dates, pitted | 1 envelope jalapeno jack cheese | 1 can of any apple pie filling | 1 teaspoon apple pie filling | 1 orange, cut into thin wedges
instructions: To make the base, in a greased 9x13 inch baking pan, blend dates, cheese, and pie filling till well blended.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,avocado,onion soup mix,maple syrup
title: Egg Noodle Medley
ingredients: 1/4 cup diced avocado | 1 large onion soup mix | 1 can diced free range eggs noodles | 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add avocado and onion soup mix. Cook until soup mix is hot, about 5 minutes. Cook egg noodles in a large pot of rapidly boiling water for 5 minutes, or until just tender. Drain. Transfer noodles to a large bowl and stir in avocado mixture. Add maple syrup to mixture. Toss to coat. Serve warm. Note, if soup mix includes the oats, sprinkle on top of the noodles.

title: Yemeni Potatoes (Yukgryba)
ingredients: 1/8 lb russet potato, peeled | 3 cups corn, canned ( or canned corn of choice ) | 3 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 1 large fresh parsley sprig | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Put the potato in a large pan with an extra inch of water. Bring to the boil, cover and cook over high heat 15 minutes. Decrease heat to low, cover and simmer 45 minutes or until tender. Transfer the potato to a plate and reserve. Meanwhile, put the corn in a medium saucepan with a little water. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Remove from the heat. Cover and let stand 20 minutes. Drain corn well and spread on a baking sheet. Smash corn with a fork. Stir in the sesame seeds, parsley, mace and seasoning. Spread mixture on potatoes. Broil or grill under broiler 1 and 1/2 minutes, just until they turn golden brown.

title: Mexican Chocolate Snack Wraps
ingredients: 2 large tortillas | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 ounces good quality bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Heat up a skillet/cookie sheet just until smoking hot. Slice tortillas in half lengthwise. Spread allspice evenly on one side of each tortilla slice.

title: Chiles Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried chiles | 20 toothpicks
instructions: Soak the dry chiles overnight in hot water. Drain, place on paper towels in a bowl, and sprinkle them with salt to taste. Roll or press the soaked chiles into finger shapes. Place in an oiled baking dish. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 20 to 30 minutes. The chiles should be lightly browned. Remove toothpicks.

title: Curried Beef on Skewers (Pressure Cooker)
ingredients: 1/2 cup curry paste | 1 1/2 kg medium sirloin steaks ( approximately ) or 1 1/2 kg filet of beef, trimmed and cut into 4 long strips ( approximately ) | 2 medium heads of garlic, unpeeled
instructions: Combine curry paste and beef in a 12 cup food processor fitted with the metal blade. Process until beef is thoroughly beef tender. Pour into a 4 cup plastic bag.

title: Homemade Chipotle Sausage (Hertzogg)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chipotle peppers ( in adobo sauce or in a food processor ) | 4 cups panko breadcrumbs ( japanese bread crumbs ) | 1 lb fresh panko breadcrumb ( aka. japanese bread crumbs ) | 1 tablespoon dried orange peel | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Place all ingredients in a clean bowl and blend till smooth. Refrigerate at least one hour.

title: Real French Canadian Rye
ingredients: 1 slice rye bread, from supermarket ( rye bread is about 50g, so this is about 1-2oz, if you're not going to eat it in 2-3 batches ) | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry ( optional, but recommended ) | 1 can coconut milk ( or regular milk, 1 container )
