instructions: Heat a frying pan on medium low. Place the rye bread on a plate. Pour sherry over bread if using, cover with aluminum foil, and toast in the oven until toasted. Remove bread from oven, cover, and rest for at least 20 minutes before serving, or you can place a serving plate on top of each piece of toast. Serve with coconut milk, or any fruit you like.

title: Persian Spiced Salt
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 sprigs rosemary leaves
instructions: In a large mortar over low, dry fry the sage leaves until the leaves are soft and golden brown. Cool these dried out spices thoroughly and store them in a tightly closed jar for up to 2 weeks.

title: Honey Dessert: Channa Dal(Methi) in Honey (Bhala)
ingredients: 1/2 cup channa dal, washed | 3 tablespoons honey
instructions: Wash channa dal in a strainer under running water. Pierce the skin with a sharp paring knife or knife. Do not wash it. Wash chana dal again in running water. Once you have done this, dry it by pouring water over it in a bowl. The skin should become hard, it will absorb only oil and not be able to curl. If your hands are dirty, remove them and dry the chana dal. If it's sticky, you can get away with sprinkles of yellow chana dal. Place the chana dal in a clean cloth, cover it with water and leave it to soak for 40 to 60 minutes. Pour some oil in the cooker. When you feel the pressure of the chana dal, remove the lid. Switch on the cooker. You'll have to keep the pressure on high for 5 minutes or until the pressure has boiled off. Once the pressure has gone off, open the lid and fluff up. Stir. You should hear small explosive noises on the cooker. If not, you have too much water, it's your right.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,olive oil,sage leaf,brown gravy mix,caper
title: Spiced Olive Oil and Sage Salt
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints light brown gravy mix | 2 pints light flavorful flavorful olive oil | 2 pints mixed light flavorful spiced fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 3 small pints fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: Dissolve the gravy mix in half pint of light olive oil. Set aside in a warm place to cool while you prepare the sage and sage. Combine the sage, sage, sea salt and 2 teaspoons of coarse sea salt in a large bowl. Stir to combine. Add the olive oil and sage mixture to the remaining olive oil in the bowl. Use a wooden spoon to mix until thoroughly combined – it can take several minutes. The sage and oil should be very dry at this stage, but the spiced sage will absorb the oil. Cover and allow all the oil to rest in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. Pour the sage oil and sage mixture into a large roasting tin and set aside, covered, in a warm place to allow the flavours to develop. Preheat the oven to 190°c/375°f/gas wash your kitchen sink well and dry it immediately. Rub the surface of the roasting tin with your hands, then transfer the tin to a shallow roasting tray or foil. Place the sage and sage leaves on top of the olive oil. Add the sage salt and stir to combine. Bake in the middle of the oven until the sage is very soft and golden and the leaves are beginning to curl slightly, about 1 hour 1 hour 15 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Tahini Lentils With Asparagus and Greens
ingredients: 5 cups vegetable broth or 5 cups chicken broth | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup green onion, chopped | 2 packages asparagus, cut into 6-8 pieces ( about 13 ounces total ) | 1/4 cup low-fat tahini ( sesame paste )
instructions: Combine the broth and garlic paste in a large nonreactive dutch oven. Add the onion, green onion, and asparagus. Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes. Transfer vegetables to a bowl, and stir in the tahini. The soup will thicken, but it will not be totally smooth. Serve.

title: Spaghetti Agon
ingredients: 100 g spaghetti | 200 ml of canned white fish | 200 g green beans | 4 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons mirin ( sweet soy sauce ) | 1 tablespoon white pepper | 4 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Cook and spaghetti according to al dente. Cut the spaghetti into 4 pieces. Boil water and add bread crumbs and peas to the water in a pot. Drain spaghetti and add to bowl. Add the fish to the bowl and set aside for 2 minutes. Pour fish and vegetables into hot ice water. Let stand for 2 minutes. Strain and serve.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,cider vinegar,celery rib,chicken tender tenderloin,bell pepper,liquid smoke
title: Easy One Pan Chicken Salad Recipe.
ingredients: 8 chicken tenderloins ( or equivalent amount of boneless skinless chicken breasts ) | 1 celery rib | 1 small bell pepper ( any color will do ) | 1 package ready to serve savoury ladyfingers ( storebought or homemade ) | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Pound your chicken to remove any excess fat. Slice into bite size pieces. In a large bowl, layer your favorite salad ingredients, placing a toothpick on the end of each piece, and then a few dollops of vinaigrette dressing on top. I use a good brand like Miracle Whip, which is delicious with this recipe. This is great for a little sizzle.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,brown onion,ice cube,celery seed,chicken breast half
title: Balsamic Balsamic Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, or to taste | 2 tablespoons light balsamic vinegar, or to taste | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 2 brown onions, cut into thin strips | 1 cup ice cubes
instructions: Place the chicken strips into a resealable plastic bag, and pour in 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar. Seal, and shake to evenly coat the chicken. Refrigerate the chicken strips for 2 hours, or overnight, turning the bag occasionally. Rinse off any excess marinade, and set aside to marinate. Place the remaining 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar in a saucepan, and heat to boiling over high heat. Simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Season with celery seed, and set aside. Place the onions into a bowl with the ice, and toss until evenly coated with the vinegar.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,mustard,pickle relish,orange zest,vidalia onion,cardamom seed,oreo cooky
title: Tomato Based Relish
ingredients: 1/2 lb vidalia onion, thinly sliced | 1 can pickled cherry tomatoes, sliced | 3 tablespoons light sweet pickle relish ( such as rikkoles ) | 2 teaspoons dry mustard or 3/4 teaspoon instant minced onion | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon oregano cookies, crushed or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Place onions in a medium saucepan with a small amount of water on high heat, cooking onion until very soft, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to low medium, add cherry tomatoes and relish, and simmer. Stir frequently until heated through, about 5 minutes. Stir in mustard. Stir in zest, oregano and cardamon and serve.

title: Guacamole Substitute
ingredients: 2 large ripe guacamole | fresh lemon juice, zest of | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a mortar or blender combine guacamole, zest, olive oil and lemon juice. Process until smooth. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Easy Broccoli Tahini Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked brown rice ( i like basmati ) | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 cup broccoli floret, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place rice, tahini, and 2 tbsp water in a small sauce pan, heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Stir in broccoli and cook 3 - 4 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in remaining 1 tbsp water and cook 1 additional minute. Sprinkle with cilantro, fluff rice with a fork, and serve.

title: Frozen Chipotle Chile Rind
ingredients: 1 cup ice | 1 1/2 lbs poblano chiles, stemmed | 1 1/2 lbs ground rice wine | ice cube | raisins
instructions: Bring ice water to a boil over medium high heat in a large bowl. Add chiles.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,currant,raspberry,tequila,tomato green chilies,salad oil,okra,italian seasoning
title: Tequila-Smoked Okra
ingredients: 1 lb okra, stemmed, ends snipped off, cut in half lengthwise, then sliced 1 1/4 inch thick ( if not using fresh okra ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons dried confectioners'sugar | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 jar shiitake mushrooms, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup dried currants | 2 teaspoons instant tequila or 2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Make the tequila smeared okra by placing 2 teaspoons of tequila oil through a mesh mesh sieve or food processor. Reserve. In a 12 inch heavy skillet, heat the remaining 1 teaspoon oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking and sauté Okra until golden brown on all sides. Transfer to paper towels. In a large bowl, combine the reserved tequila smeared okra, the canned tomatoes, mushrooms, currants, tequila, and italian seasoning. Stir to combine, pour over the okra, top with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 1 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally.. Cut okra into 1/2 inch by 1/4 inch wide slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,garam masala powder,dark soy sauce,white mushroom,orange peel,extra beef
title: Indian Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/4 cup white mushroom, sliced | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon white sesame oil or 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy large skillet over medium high heat. Stir often until well mixed and hot, but do not brown the mushrooms. Pour into a greased baking sheet. Press or pat patties until they are about 3/4 of the way covered with patties. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 to 30 minutes or until tops are just firm to the touch. Remove to a wire rack to cool.

title: Dilly Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 bunch fresh dill, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the baked beans, tomato paste, dill, and enough water to make a thick paste or a stew consistency. Bring to a boil, and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Tasty Bread Pudding
ingredients: 250 g bread, diced | 2 cups sugar | 4 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | topping, of choice
instructions: Place the bread in a bowl and add the sugar, vanilla essence and ground coriander. Place a spoonful of sauce in the centre and then fold over the bread. Dip a wooden spoon into hot water or milk and then press into small balls on a plate. When firm, cut into squares.

title: Roasted Cashews
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted cashews, in brine | 1 sprig fresh rosemary ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Pour roasted cashews and rosemary sprigs in a roasting pan. Roast in the preheated oven until nuts are golden and dry, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Watch nuts frequently to make sure they do not burn.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,strawberry,velveeta cheese,egg white,corn oil,liquid smoke,raspberry,red cabbage
title: Potatoes With a Twist
ingredients: 3 egg whites | 3/4 lb velveeta cheese, cut into slices | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 can plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup frozen diced strawberries | 1/2 cup diced red cabbage | 1/4 - 1/2 cup frozen raspberries | 1/4 cup frozen corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix egg whites with liquid smoke in a large bowl. Spread 1/4 cheese on a large baking sheet. Spread the tomatoes on the cheese, leaving a 1/4 inch border around the edges. Arrange the strawberries and cabbage on top of the tomatoes. Place the remaining cheese over the tomatoes and top with raspberries and oil. Place in the oven and bake 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,rice vinegar,thai fish sauce,lemon zest,white onion,wheat spaghetti,pepperoni
title: Spaghetti With Pepperoni and Thai Sweet Dip
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 2 white onions ( halved diagonally, 2 diced ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons light rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon ground pepperoni | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions and drain. In a medium saucepan, combine onions, worcestershire sauce, rice vinegar, fish sauce, pepperoni and lemon zest. Heat over medium heat until onions are translucent. Add cooked spaghetti and toss. Serve warm with your favorite breadsticks or as a topping for your dipperoni slices.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,cooking oil,arborio rice,golden brown sugar
title: Baked Ziti and Rice
ingredients: 5 cups hot water | 4 ounces ziti pasta, broken into pieces | 2 cups quick-cooking oil for frying | 3/4 cup dark golden brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring 7 cups of hot water and ziti to a boil in a large pot of salted water. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until ziti is just tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside in a large bowl. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and cook and stir the ziti in the hot skillet until evenly browned, about 8 minutes. Sprinkle brown sugar over the ziti and turn off heat. Add ziti to rice, and stir thoroughly to coat with brown sugar. Place breaded ziti and brown sugar mixture in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven until breadcrumbs are lightly browned, 15 more minutes.

title: Greek Gnocchi #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 16 ounces ricotta cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees farenheit. Place simply potatoes shredded hash browns in a baking dish. Add a layer of ricotta cheese on top of the potatoes and then a layer of the cheese on top. Bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 mandarin oranges, peeled | 2 teaspoons rice wine ( or to taste )
instructions: Chop mandarin oranges crosswise. Combine mandarin orange and rice wine in a non metallic bowl. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,green chile pepper,mint,cayenne,broth,black olive,caramel sauce,kaffir lime leaf
title: Kaffir Lime Soup
ingredients: 1 quart chicken broth | 5 pods green chile peppers, chopped | 2 small heads garlic, thinly sliced | 1/2 pound baby kale leaves | 4 ounces sliced black olives | 6 kaffir lime leaves, or to taste | 1 tablespoon caramel sauce, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot. Add chile peppers, garlic, kale, olives, and lime leaves and simmer until kale is tender and kale is bright green, about 10 minutes. Gradually stir in caramel sauce and garnish with mint.

title: Homemade Herb and Salt Crackers
ingredients: 2 cups table salt | 1 cup chopped fresh sage leaf
instructions: Place table salt in a bowl and sprinkle with 1 cup of sage. Add 2 cups of chopped fresh sage leaves. Using hands, mix well to combine. Spread mixture into a small, shallow bowl and refrigerate 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Using palms of your hands, shape the herb salt mixture into small balls, about 2 inches in diameter. Place on a rimmed baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove from the oven and transfer onto a plate and serve.

title: Grilled Parmesan Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/4 x 1 inch slices | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 3/4 lb grated parmesan cheese | 1/3 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided | 1 tablespoon fresh lime rind, finely grated
instructions: Heat gas or charcoal grill to high. Place potatoes on metal, foil lined baking sheet. Sprinkle potatoes with oregano and 1/4 cup of the parmesan cheese, pressing gently over potatoes. Turn potatoes over and press out any excess liquid. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of parmesan cheese evenly over potato wedges. Grill until golden and bubbly, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup pecorino. Squeeze lime rind over top. Serve cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,white fish fillet,nonfat milk powder
title: Healthier Whitefish in a Pond
ingredients: 1/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 4 1/2 lbs of thick white fish fillets ( your choice ) | 4 1/2 lbs clean whole fish fillets | 1 teaspoon nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Spray a nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Place it over medium heat. Once it is hot add 1/3 cup of the nonfat dry milk powder. Stir the mixture well the entire time being. When the mixture has a nice golden color, reduce the heat to low. While the mixture is stirring continuously, coat fish fillets with 1/3 cup of the nonfat dry milk powder and coat with this mixture. Place the fillets in the skillet and cook on the high heat for about 8 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork. Remove fish to serving platter or warmed platter and top with remaining nonfat dry milk powder. Note, the fish will absorb the mixture and become tender when pierced. I like to serve this with sweet potato or other sweet potato dishes. It tastes even better that way.

title: Honey Mustard Ham Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg ham | italian dressing | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Thoroughly dry the ham and cut into cubes about 2cm wide, 2 inches long. Heat the cooking oil in a frying pan at the highest temperature, stirring continuously. When the oil is hot, add the ham in batches to the pan, turning the pan regularly. Cook for approximately 15 to 18 minutes or until crispy on all sides. Remove and drain on a paper towel. Add the italian dressing to the ham in the pan and turn off the heat.

title: Pasta With Sun Dried Tomatoes and Chives
ingredients: 12 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and patted dry | 3 cups all-purpose white flour, or as needed | 1 bunch chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place sun dried tomatoes in a bowl. Cover with boiling water and set aside to soak for 30 minutes. Drain the sun dried tomatoes and chives in the sun dried tomatoes. Place the flour in a large bowl. Stir in the chives. Turn a few times, then add the water mixture 1/2 cup at a time.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,tomato relish,bean,bamboo shoot,flour tortilla,lemon peel,green pepper,peanut butter
title: Easy Vegetarian (Or Can Vegan) Pizza - No Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons tomato relish or ( 8 ounce ) light sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon lemon peel, minced | 1/8 cup sliced bamboo shoot | 1 green pepper, chopped | 10 small flour tortillas
instructions: Spread refried beans on tortilla. Place tofu on top. Spread filling over tofu. Sprinkle with lemon peel. Sprinkle with green pepper and bamboo shoots. Roll and enjoy.

title: Tarragon Puree
ingredients: 6 ounces dried currants | 3 ounces potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice ( about 6 cups ) | 2 tablespoons minced tarragon | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Place the currants into a strainer and set over a bowl to catch the drippings. Cover with cold water and let drain overnight. The next day, place the currants, potatoes and tarragon in a medium saucepan. Add cold water to just cover. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat, and simmer until the potatoes and tarragon are very tender, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Transfer the puréed mixture to a blender and add the whipping cream. Process to a thick puree, blending constantly to avoid lumps. Place the puree back in the saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until heated through and reduced. Serve warm, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: black bean,green pepper,ricotta cheese,lemon juice,celery salt,parsley
title: Delicious Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained, 1/2 cup liquid reserved | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley | parsley optional | 1 green pepper, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill. Serve with corn chips, tortilla chips, french baguette or crackers.

title: Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 pound fresh salmon fillet | 9 fluid ounces white rum
instructions: Pat the salmon dry with paper towels, and remove any pin bones. Lightly spread each side with rum. Place 1/4 cup of the rum in a small, heavy skillet over medium high heat and bring to just smoking. Carefully lower the salmon into the hot rum, skin side down. Cook and turn the salmon to brown the top and sides, then let brown for a minute or two more, then flip. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Turmeric Barley for Fish
ingredients: 2 cups barley | 1/2 cup aniseed | 1 cup fresh ginger root, chopped | 1 tablespoon ground aniseed, or amount to taste
instructions: Rinse the barberries and place them in a large container. Pour the 1/2 cup aniseed and 1 tablespoon of ground aniseed into the barberries. Cover the container and store in a dark place. Place the remaining 1 tablespoon ground aniseed in a separate container. Place the food processor or mortar and pestle in the center of the food processor bowl. Pulse until aniseed is very fine. Place the cooked barley and ginger into the food processor bowl. Scoop up the mixture with the large spoon while running, then add the aniseed and ground anise. Process until everything is mixed. Refrigerate until needed.

title: Chargrilled Asparagus With Croutons and Asparagus
ingredients: 8 asparagus, trimmed | 6 tablespoons croutons
instructions: Steam the asparagus for 5 minutes to make them crispier. Place on an oven tray which has been lined with baking paper to catch any browning. Place the croutons on a plate and microwave for 10 seconds or until the crumbs are slightly golden. Remove from oven and place asparagus on top. Season and serve.

title: Lamb in Amarula Cream
ingredients: 4 -6 lamb, trimmed | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur | 100 -200 g polenta, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Spread beef on the inside of a 12 inch long, 16 cm saucer with the cream. Spread the amarula onto the beef and roll each in polenta until it is completely covered, securing with tooth picks. Arrange on a tray and refrigerate overnight. The following day remove tooth picks and cut meat into 1 inch cubes.

title: Mango and Garlic Roll-Up - Tapas
ingredients: 4 soft buttery round sandwich steaks ( about 4-1/2 lbs. ) | cooking spray or butter | 4 large mangoes, peeled and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices ( about 1 pound total ) | 1 package pre-shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | food coloring
instructions: Spray a large non stick or grease free iron skillet with cooking spray or butter. Grill steaks just over medium high heat, or to desired doneness, or for doneness, about 5 minutes per side for medium rare, 10 for medium. Let rest about 10 minutes. Remove steaks from pan and slice into strips, about 1/2 inch wide and 3/8 inch long. To assemble, place 3 mangoes on each roll, cutting in half. Arrange a portion of mozzarella over each top piece of shredded cheese, then roll up each one with cheese completely enclosing the cheese halves. Dip roll ups in food coloring.

title: Pesto Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb medium baking potato, peeled and cut lengthwise into eighths | 3/4 cup thinly sliced white potato sticks ( such as vidalia ) | 1/2 cup purchased pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Add potatoes. Cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Transfer potatoes to a bowl and cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, combine pesto and mint in a small bowl. Drizzle over cooled potatoes and toss to coat well. Cover and chill for 30 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,mushroom stem,green,cream chicken soup,beef neck,yellow pepper,red leaf lettuce
title: Russian Beef and Veggie Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef neck, browned | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup diced yellow pepper | 1/3 cup diced red leaf lettuce | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 2 cups rye flour | 1/4 cup sliced fresh green
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Stir together the beef, soup, and yellow pepper until well combined.

title: Green Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crust removed | 3 packages mixed salad greens | salad greens, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Top bread with salad greens, if desired. Place sandwich on baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f for 8 to 10 minutes. Cut in half.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,leek,whipping cream,lima bean,celery rib,fast rising yeast,ginger
title: Lima Bean Soup With Fresh Ginger
ingredients: 1 whole bulb of fresh lima beans | 1 leek, thoroughly washed ( white only ) | 2 celery ribs, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( i use the dutch's dark cocoa powder ) | 1 ounce fresh ginger, peeled and finely diced ( about 1 1/2 tablespoons ) | 5 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: In a large pot, place lima beans and the leek and place over high heat. As soon as all of the foam rises to the surface, turn down the heat slightly and add 2 cups boiling water. Cover, turn the heat to low, and simmer gently for about 40 - 45 minutes. While the lima beans cook, make the roux, place the flour, cocoa, and ginger in a medium bowl and stir with a fork until the ginger is shredded and the mixture is slightly thickened and smooth. Whip the cream until it begins to thicken and slowly incorporate the cheese. Set aside. After 40 minutes, check the soup and add more salt if you think it needs it. Turn off the heat and allow to sit until cool, at least 20 minutes. Remove the lima beans and leek and discard the liquid. Add the cream to the soup and mix thoroughly. Set aside, covered, for 30 minutes while the soup heats up. Serve warm with grated gruyere and cinnamon on the side.

title: Asian Mango Eggplant
ingredients: 12 ounces japanese eggplants | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 4 tablespoons ripe mangoes, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise. Arrange eggplants on a rack in a roasting pan and brush with 1/2 cup of the sugar. Roast in a 400°f oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until the skins are charred but the flesh is still firm. Allow to cool slightly and transfer to a bowl. Meanwhile, combine the remaining 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons of sugar in a small saucepan and stir until the sugar dissolves. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook until the mixture is syrupy and the sugar is clear, about 5 minutes. Set aside to cool. When the eggplants are cool enough to handle cut them into 1/4 inch thick slices. Combine the eggplant with the mango and stir to combine. Transfer the mango mixture to a serving bowl and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar. Serve immediately.

title: Cauliflower Gluten-Free Pies
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup cake flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium saucepan of boiling water, blanch the cauliflower for five minutes, or until tender. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. In a medium bowl, stir together brown sugar, cake flour and cauliflower florets. Stir in sugar mixture just until coated. Spoon filling into 2 baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden and filling is firm. Transfer pies to serving plates.

Random Ingredients: japanese eggplant,pork loin chop,green tea powder,plain yogurt,sake,baking soda
title: Futo Age - Japanese Fried Eggplant With Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplant | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 4 pork loin chops | 1/4 - 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons sake | 2 teaspoons green tea powder
instructions: Place the eggplant and baking soda in a skillet. Turn the heat very low and fry the eggplant for about 20 minutes, adding a glass of hot water halfway through. The oil needs to be about 1/2 inch deep. When done, drain. Roughly chop the eggplant into thin strips. Mix the yogurt, sake, and green tea powder together in a bowl. When the eggplant is done, spread the oil on the cut side of the meat, and pour the yogurt mixture on the cut side of the meat. When it's done, serve with japanese green vegetables.

title: Black Beans With Chili Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 can black beans or 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. Over medium high heat, add chili oil and black beans. Stir and add rice. Cook for 2 or 3 minutes, until heated through. Serve.

title: Tortilla Con Crema De Noche E Alentejana (Welsh Mushroom & Courgette)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut, solids | 1 tablespoon epazote, leaves ( optional ) | 3 1/2 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 small courgette, chopped | 3 tablespoons coconut oil
instructions: Place the coconut or olive oil in a small saute pan / pan and add the epazote. Cook for 30 seconds or until it starts to smell aromatic. Add the chopped vegetables and continue cooking until all of the liquid has evaporated. Spread on a plate and set aside till ready to serve. Place 2 tbsp of coconut oil in a frying pan and warm it up. Sprinkle the nutella or crema de noche onto your plate, sprinkle on your choice of vegetable and herbs and drizzle over the warm coconut oil.

title: Beef Broiler Dove
ingredients: 4 poblano peppers | 1 teaspoon hot curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon pepper ( to taste ) | 1 pint fresh cheese, cut into 4 pieces ( recommend sharp cheddar or swiss )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Coat broiler rack with nonstick cooking spray and place on a rack about 4 inches from heat. Cut the peppers into 1/8 thick slices. Place the pepper slices on the rack and brush the tops with hot curry powder. Broil for 4 to 5 minutes or broil for 5 to 6 minutes or until peppers are beginning to char. Remove from the broiler and place on a platter. Slice cheese into 1/8 slices and arrange on the pepper. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is bubbly. Serve at once.

title: Pork Sausage and Mushrooms Smothered in Onions
ingredients: 24 baby portabella mushrooms or 24 crimini mushrooms | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke ( recommended -- smoking onion essence )
instructions: Clean the mushrooms removing any dirt. Prick them all over with a knife. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Remove the stalks from all of the mushrooms using a very sharp knife, leaving the hard ones intact. Cut each mushroom crosswise into 1/2 inch wide slices and set aside at room temperature. Pour 2 tablespoons of olive oil into a wide frying pan or dutch oven with a good amount of room to fit in a straight line. Heat the oil just enough to make it sizzling hot, but not smoking. Place all of the mushroom slices at once in the pan in a single layer. Stir the pieces around to coat with the olive oil then quickly stir in the smoke. Place the sosages in the oil at least 2 layers thick. Cover the pan and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, occasionally flipping the pan so the mushrooms brown on all sides. Serve over your favourite meal.

title: Quick and Easy Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef, very lean cut in strips | 3/4 cup mustard seeds
instructions: Soak the mustard crackers in hot water for 20 minutes. Rub each strip of beef with mustard seeds. Fry in oil for 1 minute on each side or until lightly browned. Drain on paper towels or use as an au jus gravy.

title: Easy Southern Comfort Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 3 tablespoons southern comfort
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange chicken breasts into a 9x5 inch baking dish. Sprinkle chicken with the southwest comfort. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,lemon juice,buttermilk,caraway seed,dill weed,red hot pepper
title: Southern Dill Colman's Baked Caraway Hot Pepper Dressing
ingredients: 16 caraway seeds | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk, divided | 1/3 cup lemon juice | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon red hot pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the caraway seeds in a small bowl. Fill a small saucepan with just enough water to cover the seeds. Bring to a boil, and cook for about five minutes until the caraway seeds are light brown and have begun to smell aromatic. This will take about five minutes. Remove the caraway seeds from the water, and reserve for later. Spread the caraway seeds in a small roasting pan. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes. When the caraway seeds are fragrant, stir them in 1/4 cup the buttermilk, the lemon juice, dill weed, lemon pepper, and red pepper. Bring back to a boil, and continue cooking for a few minutes until the peppers are tender.

title: Jamaican Fruit Bread
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups pitted prunes, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly grease a 10 inch round baking dish with butter. In a small bowl, stir together the flour and prunes. Stir in the flour mixture. Knead until the mixture resembles a workable dough.

title: Italian Peppercorn & Salami Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/3 cup white peppercorns or 1/3 cup black peppercorns | 12 slices salami | 24 slices bread, of choice
instructions: Combine both peppercorns and 1/4 cup reserved pepper soaking liquid. Spread onto two slices of salami. Stack slices, starting with one slice, and laying them out on a work surface. Spoon 1/4 cup of the reserved pepper soaking liquid over the salami. Top with another slice of salami, and sprinkle with remainder of reserved pepper soaking liquid. Roll up and slice into desired size. Repeat with remaining slices & salami. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,chinese cabbage,cauliflower,lime juice,tomato,bow tie pasta,tortilla chip,fish fillet
title: Vietnamese Lasagna
ingredients: 12 ounces bow tie pasta, uncooked | 3/4 lb fish fillet, sliced | 4 cups chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 cup carrot, shredded | 1 package tortilla chips, sliced | 1 can diced tomatoes, undrained | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons fish fillet, chopped | 1/2 cup dry lasagna noodle, broken up, lightly toasted
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse with cold water.

Random Ingredients: rose water,green cherry,shiitake mushroom,collard green,rice wine
title: Japanese Stock Pot or  Shiitake -  Spring Rolls
ingredients: 3 quarts green cherries, stoned | 1 lb collard greens, trimmed | 4 cups shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, and sliced | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon rose water ( or sherry )
instructions: Clean and rinse cherries. Bring to boil in a pot and boil for one minute. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. In a food processor, add all the remaining ingredients except the cherry and collards. Blend well. Pour mixture into hot stockpot, cover and put pot on a medium high heat. Stir well, bringing to a boil. Add cherry mixture. Cover the pot and simmer for one hour. Check for tenderness and then remove cover. Serve hot.

title: Swiss Toast
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 2 tablespoons whole blanched slivered almonds
instructions: Toast the slivered almonds in a non stick skillet, shaking them gently until golden. Spread a thin layer of butter or margarine on a baking sheet and place the toast in it. Top with grated parmesan cheese. Broil for 2 - 3 minutes or until the cheese has melted.

title: Grapefruit Guacamole
ingredients: 1 large avocado, peeled, pitted, mashed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Mix the avocado, pepper flakes, and salt in a bowl using a fork. If desired, remove the peel carefully from the grapefruit before mixing.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,ricotta cheese,apple cider,tuna,wheat pasta shell,mango chutney
title: Tuna Mango Cheese Crumble (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat pasta shells, cooked al dente | 2 containers low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 can tuna ( drained ) | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/3 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, stir together the ricotta cheese and the apple cider and chutney. Fold in the drained tuna. In a small baking dish combine graham cracker crumbs and the 2 cheeses and press into the bottom and sides of the casserole. Spread the tuna mango cheese mixture on top of the crumb mixture. Bake for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with additional graham cracker crumbs.

title: Creamy Salmon Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 can salmon, drained and flaked | 3/4 cup nutritional yeast | paprika
instructions: In a saucepan, cook linguine according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, in a bowl, stir together salmon and nutritional yeast. Drain pasta and add to the salmon saucepan along with paprika. Stir until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,yellow bell pepper,flat leaf parsley,beef steak,grape tomato,plum tomato,raisin,sesame oil
title: Beef Stuffed Grape Tomatoes With Sesame Glaze
ingredients: 6 plum tomatoes, medium-size, halved crosswise | 2/3 cup seedless raisin | 20 tablespoons snipped flat leaf parsley | 8 ounces cream cheese | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, plus additional for garnish | 1 small yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 small seedless grape tomatoes, halved crosswise | 1 lb thinly-sliced beef round steak ( about 1-1/2 pounds )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange tomatoes in 2 large baking dishes. Put 1 tablespoon of the raisins in the center of each tomato half and sprinkle tomatoes with 1 tablespoon of sesame oil. Place 1 tablespoon of parsley in center of each. Cut the cream cheese into 16 - 6 cubes. Using a fork, mix the cream cheese, 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil, parsley, yellow pepper, remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil, and parsley in a medium bowl. Spread half of the cheese mixture over the tomato halves. Place 1 beef flank steak on top of the cheese mixture and top with tomato halves. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes. Uncover cheese breads and bake 5 minutes. Remove foil from beef and bake 5 minutes longer or until beef reaches desired doneness. While beef is baking, make the sesame glaze. Place a large skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Add 1 teaspoon of the sesame oil. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil. Add the grape tomatoes and cook until slightly softened, about 1 minute. Remove grape tomatoes to a serving platter, reserving 1/2 cup of the tomatoes. Cut beef diagonally across the grain into 1/4 inch slices and arrange 1 tomato slice on each of 2 plate. Top each mound of beef with a drizzle of olive oil and sprinkle with parsley. Serve the beef on top of the grape tomatoes.

title: Prawns and Chips
ingredients: 1/4 lb uncooked prawns, cleaned and butterflied ( prawns ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 lb spaghetti, broken ( about 8 oz )
instructions: Cut prawns into 1 1/2 inch pieces. In a small bowl, mix cornstarch with 1/8 cup cold water. Spray skillet with nonstick spray. Over medium high heat, add prawns and cook until just cooked. In a sauce pan, stir in cornstarch mixture. Add spaghetti and cook, stirring, until lightly browned. Return prawns and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb and Crab Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground lamb | 2/3 lb lobster, ground | 8 ounces frozen shrimp and shellfish mixed in a pouch | 1 cup finely shredded cabbage | 1 cup fresh green beans, cut into thin lengths | 2 large pitted prunes, halved | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup soft pitted shelled sun-dried tomato | 12 tortellini
instructions: Cook the lamb in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, until browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Add lobster, shrimp, cabbage, green beans, pimentos, and sundried tomatoes, and cook for 3 minutes. Serve 3 scoops per wrap and spoon a generous amount of the filling onto the tortellini.

title: Vanilla Egg-Free Foam With Milk
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 1/3 cup nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and process until smooth. This can be done in the kitchenaid blender or in a small bowl to make a frothy layer on foam, but be careful not to overprocess. Pour into 3 small ramekin dishes, or one large mold if you have one.

title: Easy No-Cook Nibble
ingredients: 24 ounces refrigerated buttermilk biscuits | 6 tablespoons braggs liquid
instructions: Place biscuits on a foil lined cookie sheet. Pour bragg's liquid into a small bowl and sprinkle a few drops of water on them. Press biscuits through a nut grater, then cut into quarters. These biscuits should be spaced evenly apart, leaving about 1/2 inch around the edge of each biscuit piece. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,hazelnut,shiitake mushroom,ginger root,farfalle pasta,leg lamb
title: Scrumptious Lamb Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 leg of lamb, boned and cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger root, or more to taste | 1 can shiitake mushrooms, drained and chopped | 1 package frozen cheese tortellini | 8 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 12 hazelnuts, toasted, coarsely chopped, or to taste
instructions: Heat a dutch oven or large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Beef Bourguignon
ingredients: 1 cup white wine or 1 cup water | 1 lb fat free stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces | 10 ounces fettuccini noodles, cooked
instructions: In a large skillet, heat wine/water and cook stew meat until browned. While meat is cooking, cook uncooked fettuccini in a pot of boiling salted water. Serve stew meat over cooked fettuccini and toss for a minute or two.

Random Ingredients: turbinado sugar,orange peel,ghee,coriander powder,soda water,orange juice,chocolate chip
title: Rice Pudding With Orange Peel & Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ghee ( clarified butter ) or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon tamarind extract or 1 teaspoon orange extract | 400 g ice-cold soda water ( soda water ) | 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate chips | 3/4 cup turbinado sugar | 1 orange peel, finely shredded | 2 -3 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Heat the ghee in a medium size non stick frying pan. Add the tamarind and extract and stir well. Add 1 cup of the ice cold soda water, stir. Remove from heat. Add the cookie crumbs, mix well and stir in the remainder of the soda water. Pour mixture into individual glasses, or one large pudding bowl depending on its size. Sprinkle chopped chocolate chips, orange rind, & cointreau over the ice. Cool. Serve immediately. Variation, instead of the chocolate chips, use another cookie cracker crumb recipe#.

title: Neezy Drumsticks
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings, cut in 2cm segments | 2 tablespoons chat masala | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | oil or melted butter
instructions: Heat fry pan to medium heat with oil or butter. Toss in drumsticks.

title: Fennel Seasoning
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed of all of the feathery fibrous outer stalks ( about 5/7 lb, trimmed ) | 3 tablespoons season salt, or more to taste
instructions: Remove the feathery fronds from the fennel and discard. Cut off a thin slice off the root ends of the fennel bulb using a vegetable peeler or a paring knife.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,nut almond,pomegranate seed,red capsicum,ham,egg noodle,scallion,celery salt
title: Pomegranate Nachos
ingredients: 200 g egg noodles | 200 g cooked ham | 1 tablespoon pomegranate seeds | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon parsley salt | 3 drops tabasco sauce | 1 slice scallion, 3mm long, 1 cm long | 1 tablespoon roasted unblanched nuts ( almond, cashew and cashew ) | 1 tablespoon roasted pomegranate seeds, 1 tbsp roasted unblanched cashews
instructions: Cook gine according to package directions, while you cook the rest of the ingredients. Chop and mix with cooked noodles before serving.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,honey,white bread,vinegar,raspberry,feta cheese,cayenne pepper,southern comfort
title: Coney-Stuffed Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, top 1/3-inch | coarse salt | cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup white bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons grape vinegar | 6 ounces crumbled reduced-fat feta cheese | 3/4 cup frozen raspberries, thawed
instructions: Trim fat from roast. Tightly roll roast.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,brandy,sirloin steak,corn syrup,almond,beef stew meat
title: Artichokes Marinated Steak With Mustard (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/4 cup almond ( sliced almonds ) | 1 boneless sirloin steak, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and liquid reserved
instructions: Arrange almonds in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake at 300 degrees for 15 minutes or until very fragrant.. Remove from oven and place in a bowl to cool to room temperature. Preheat a gas or charcoal grill to medium high heat. When ready to cook, place sirloin in a 3 - 4 quart slow cooker, and sprinkle with ground almond mixture evenly. Roll steak up, and place in a single layer on top of sirloin. In a small bowl, combine the brandy and corn syrup.

title: Easy Tuna
ingredients: 1 can tuna in olive oil, drained | 1 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Mix tuna, onion salt, and olive oil together in a bowl.

title: Marinated Pepperoncini
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh currant, rinsed | 2 tablespoons currants or 2 tablespoons raspberry jelly | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 small chili pepper, cut into thin rings ( hot pepper may also be used ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon finely minced fresh hot pepperoncini pepper
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and chill for one hour. Serve with crackers.

title: Faux-Salat - Lentils and Beans With Fish and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 1/2 cups fish stock, hot ( or just about ) | 1/2 lb fresh green beans, trimmed
instructions: Combine the lentils with 3 cups of cold water and bring to a boil. Cover until the water is absorbed, and allow to rest for 30 minutes. Drain off the water. Combine the stock with the remaining cup of hot water, add beans, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes, until the beans are tender and the soup is fairly thick. Taste and adjust seasonings with salt.

title: Crispy Orange Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef brisket | 8 ounces cheese, sliced | 5 eggs, beaten | 2 ounces lard | 1 lemon grass, chopped | 1 lemon, juice and rind of, grated | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: In large heavy bottomed skillet, cook beef brisket in lard over medium low heat until meat thermometer reads 135°f. While meat is cooking, cut cheese into thin half moons. Arrange on rack of steaming board. Add 1 egg, lemon grass, lemon rind and orange juice to skillet and cook brisket, stirring frequently, until egg is nearly set, about 45 minutes. Cool brisket slightly.

title: Cheddar Lamb Wraps
ingredients: 4 ounces lean bonless lean leg of lamb | 1 ounce cheddar cheese | 4 ounces baby spinach
instructions: Slice the lamb into thin slices. Dry fry in a large frying pan for about 10 mins, turning once. Add cheese and stir until melted and mixed in. Add spinach and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes. Roll meat up and wrap in toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,mango chutney,pinto bean,elderberry flower,sesame seed
title: The Singles' Sesame Bean Curry
ingredients: 1 cup dried pinto beans, rinsed | 2 tablespoons canola oil, divided use | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, divided use | 1 bag elderberry flowers | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Soak pinto beans overnight. Drain peas, place whole bags directly onto canola oil, and let heat for about 1/2 hour. Add sesame seeds to canola oil, let sit for half an hour, and then turn over a few times. You want to let the seeds brown and become fragrant. Add flowers, let them simmer on low heat while you cook your rice. Put rice in bowls, spoon bean curry, pour mango chutney over your steaming rice. It will taste great.

title: Soupy Potato Wedges
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and coarsely grated | 1 large red onion, halved and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon table salt | 1 lb small red potato, such as yukon gold | 9 -12 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine grated potatoes, red onion, and salt in a large bowl. Using a vegetable peeler, peel peeled potatoes and cut into 1 1/2 to 2/3 inch slices and transfer to a large rimmed baking sheet. Brush potato mixture with olive oil. Bake potatoes in preheated 400 degree oven until crisp and golden, 12 to 14 minutes.. Cool for 5 minutes. Transfer to a large platter. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Cheesy Beef
ingredients: 500 g chuck steak | 100 g cheese ( grated ) | 3 tablespoons black fat or 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: If the steak comes in large enough cubes it is fine to cut off all extra fat and cut it in chunks if it is not already cut into cubes of your desired size. Trim all excess fat or grated fat from the meat, and sprinkle over with grated cheese. In a pan, heat oil to 190 c or 350f. If you wish to freeze, put some cling film on top to keep the meat moist. Fry the meat in batches, brown on both sides. The meat should be browned all over, but not cooked through.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,breakfast sausage,cream cheese,loaf white bread
title: Sausage Stuff
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 loaf of white bread, cubed | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 pound ground breakfast sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare a 2x2 inch casserole dish by spraying with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, mix whipping cream cheese, bread cubes, and italian seasoning. Form sausage into 1 inch balls, and place on the prepared casserole dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, then remove from oven and pour cream cheese mixture into the casserole. Return to oven, and bake for an additional 10 to 15 minutes. Let cool, and transfer to a freezer safe container.

title: Steamed Kiwi-Pear Salad
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 lb pear
instructions: Cut the kiwifruit into wedges and soak for 30 minutes in clear water. Heat the grill and cook the kiwifruit, turning occasionally until just tender and softened but not shrunken. Whisk the remaining ingredients in a bowl and serve on top of the kiwifruit. Serves 4 people.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,yellow onion,shortening,amaretto,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Easy Baked White Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans | 1/4 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 tablespoon shortening or 1 tablespoon margarine | 3 packages philadelphia cream cheese, cubed | 2 -3 teaspoons amaretto ( sweetened condensed milk )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f mix all ingredients together in a baking dish. Cover pan and bake for 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Red Beans with Red Skin and Chicken Stock: Vegan
ingredients: 500 g red kidney beans | 6 cups chicken stock or 6 cups chicken stock
instructions: Put the red kidney beans, chicken or stock into the base of a saucepan over medium heat and bring to the boil. When the stock starts to boil, boil until you see the blood floating in the liquid. This can take anywhere from 5 minutes to an hour depending on your altitude. Remove the lid for the last 5 minutes to allow the stock to bubble slightly.. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,poblano pepper,tarragon leaf,lemongrass,chicken meat,spaghetti
title: Spaghetti With Chicken and Poblano
ingredients: 2 cups spaghetti | 1 cup cooked chicken meat, cubed | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, minced ( or 1 small tsp ) | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon leaves or 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves | 1 tablespoon lime juice, lime zest of | 1 poblano pepper, chopped
instructions: Boil a medium pot of water. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. In a large skillet, heat lemon grass, tarragon, lime juice and pepper. Add chicken and linguese. Toss to coat, and allow to heat over low heat for about 5 - 8 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Viva Madrid (Mango Chutney Queso Fundido)
ingredients: 2 ounces mango chutney | 1 ounce fontina cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix in an electric blender until smooth. Pour into a warmed martini glass and garnish with a sprinkle of shredded fontina. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Citrus Chips with Caponata
ingredients: 8 ounces dried figs ( about 2 3/4 cups ) | 4 -6 small baby onions | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup corn chips, with coarse textured pectin | 1/4 teaspoon whole vanilla bean, scraped and split lengthwise
instructions: Soak the figs in a small bowl of hot water for 15 to 20 minutes or until softened. Drain the figs and place them in a food processor or blender with the onions and pepper. Sprinkle the pureed figs with the vanilla bean and process until smooth. Remove the puree and 1/2 cup of the fig puree and set aside. Add the remaining figs and remaining puree to the remaining 1/2 cup of fig puree. Puree until smooth and return to heat over medium heat.

title: Pineapple Nescued Trampons
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon lemonade | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded | 8 fresh ladyfingers | 1/4 cup tamarind pod, soak in hot water & drain | 8 small pineapple slices, cut into 1/8-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Whisk together 2/3 cup of the pineapple juice, the lemonade and the cheese. Arrange half the ladyfingers in a baking dish and top with half the pineapple slices. Repeat with the remaining ladyfingers. Drizzle the remaining 1/3 cup pineapple juice over the top and stir to combine. Pour over the bread and sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Bake 30 minutes until the topping is dark golden and the jelly has absorbed all the juices. Let rest for 5 minutes, then serve at once.

Random Ingredients: red wine,broccoli floret,bell pepper,red onion,rom tomato
title: Italian Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 cup green bell pepper ( chopped fine ) | 1 cup red onion ( chopped fine ) | 1 roma tomato ( chopped into bite size pieces ) | 1 broccoli floret ( chopped into bite size pieces ) | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: In a large bowl, add all the vegetables and toss lightly. Add the wine stirring to combine. Enjoy.

title: Steamed Plum Soup
ingredients: 600 g firm plums, peeled and roughly chopped | 350 g broccoli, chopped | 4 tablespoons mixed vegetables such as baby lima pods ( spinach, beet or cauliflower ) | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/2 lemon, juice and grated rind | 2 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Place everything except the rind in a steaming pan or casserole with a lid. Cover and bring to the boil over medium heat. Simmer until the plums have collapsed and the vegetables are cooked but still firm. Remove the pan from the heat, stir in the vanilla, and leave to stand uncovered for 5 minutes. Remove the plum mixture from the heat. Pour into warm bowls and swirl a small knob of rind decoratively all over the top.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,pecorino romano cheese,salad oil,pork
title: Buddy Valastro's Italian Pork
ingredients: 1/3 cup salad oil | 3/4 lb ground pork | chopped flat-leaf italian parsley ( to garnish ) | grated pecorino romano cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the pork in a large skillet. Add the oil to a depth of 1/8 inch and heat. When the oil is smoking and the fat is hot, add the pork. Cook it over the medium heat, lifting and turning it with a spatula or long handled spoon to brown evenly. As it cooks, it will sizzle and caramelize, so do not stir while the pork cooks. When the oil is hot, remove the pork from the skillet. Pour off all but a small amount of the fat. Return the skillet to a low heat, add the parsley, and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, at least 5 minutes, just until the parsley is fragrant. Season with salt and pepper and spoon the pork into a heated bowl. Sprinkle with croutons. Serve at once.

title: Crock Pot Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 ounces mushrooms ( i like the wild ones ) | 1 envelope mushroom gravy mix
instructions: Stir together the mushrooms and gravy mix. Pour over crock pot. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours.

title: Pomegranate Vanilla Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds ( or a mixture of the two ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla
instructions: Rinse & dry your pomegranate seeds, or if using seeds from a pomegranate, you will need to soak them in hot water for a couple of minutes prior. Crush & mix all ingredients together. Pour the mixture into a dish & refrigerate for at least a couple of hours before using as the flavor intensifies after that time.

title: Okra in Blackened Rum - for a Crowd - Okra with Black
ingredients: 4 heads kale, stems removed ( i have posted what ever ingredient that i had on hand ) | 2 cloves garlic, cut in half | 1 can chopped okra | 1/2 cup rum ( optional... i always use it )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300ëšf. Place all ingredients into a large roasting pan. Bake 2 hours, basting occasionally, until okra is soft and falling apart.

Random Ingredients: pimento pepper,chocolate sprinkle,extra virgin olive oil,asafoetida powder
title: Qatari Balls (Asafetida Cookies)
ingredients: 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate sprinkles | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon pimento pepper, finely minced | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f and position a rack in the center. Line a baking sheet with foil and set aside. Place 3 ounces of the chocolate sprinkles in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade. Process until the chips form a fine powder. If the powder is too dry or difficult to process, add a touch of water and process until a sticky ball like consistency develops. Add the asafoetida and process until the dough forms a ball. Place the ground black pepper in a small bowl and add the olive oil. Mix the olive oil into the dough, adding more oil as needed until the dough is a consistent texture. If the mixture is too dry, add more oil. Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and place on the prepared baking sheet. Gently press the balls with your fingertips or your fingertips to make uniform balls. Bake until lightly browned, about 20 minutes. If the balls become too hard, cover with aluminum foil and set aside at room temperature until the dough has cooled slightly. Store the asafetida balls in an airtight container while they are still hot.

title: Wombay
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tamari | 1 lb lamb shoulder, cut to cubes about 1-inch-thick | 1 prawn | 1 pinch worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup dates, halved
instructions: Combine tamari and lamb in a shallow dish. Slightly open prawns and rinse with cold water.

title: Gummy Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces egg noodles | 12 -24 ounces gummy worms
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and add gummy worms. Toss to coat well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green onion,cumin seed,button mushroom,white sugar,dark rum
title: Rum Mushrooms
ingredients: 16 button mushrooms, trimmed | 2 green onions, sliced | 2/3 cup dark rum | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Place mushrooms, onions, rum, cumin seeds, sugar, and salt in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,stewing beef,coffee,thai basil,pasta sauce,savory,celery seed,sherry wine
title: Beef With Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2 by 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 12 ounces pasta sauce, your favourite sauce ( we like it with hidden valley & reg ; brand ) | 1 1/2 - 2 quarts hot fresh brewed coffee, preferably warm ( i use decaf ) | 1 tablespoon dried basil, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup thai basil, chopped ( optional ) | 1 pinch savory
instructions: In a skillet, heat the chili oil and celery seed. Brown the beef, about 4 - 5 minutes. Stir in pasta sauce and stir. Add hot coffee and 1 cup water. Bring to a simmer, cover, turn down heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Stir in basil and savory. Return to low heat and simmer uncovered for 1 minute. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Prawns With Caccamole
ingredients: 600 g prawns, large with shell on | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 teaspoons crushed dried chili | 1 beef bouillon cube, granule | 1 slice pecorino cheese, coarsely grated | 3 tablespoons of fresh mint, coarsely chopped
instructions: Shell & devein prawn's. Keep in separate containers for now. Toss prawn meat with cinnamon, thyme, oil & chili in a bowl. Add bouillon & pour around the prawns, tossing to ensure it is all coated. Cover & marinate for at least 2 hours, overnight if possible. Grill or sauté prawns in oil until they turn pink or opaque. Place prawns on a serving plate & keep warm. Serve with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: garlic,kalamata olive,chayote,chicken,peanut oil vegetable,pie shell,black mustard seed,chili pepper
title: Spicy Chicken and Chayote Pie in a Crusted Shell
ingredients: 1 lb chicken ( i use thighs, skin on legs and thighs ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other light oil | 2 tablespoons sliced garlic ( i use the jar ) | 1/2 medium chayote, peeled and diced into thin wedges | 1 large chayote, peeled and quartered | 6 ounces chunked grilled chayote ( substitute zucchini ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sliced pitted kalamata olive | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper | 1 tablespoon prepared black mustard seeds | 1 refrigerated pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place chicken and 1 tbsp of the oil in a wide frying pan and saute over med. Heat, cook chicken for 10 minutes. Remove chicken to a baking tray and cook the rest. Meanwhile, coat the inside of the shell with the remaining tbsp of oil. Add the garlic to the pan with the chicken and brown. Stir in the chayote and chayote with 1/4 tsp of salt, pepper, and the mustard seed. Cover and cook for about 3 - 5 minutes. Uncover, add olives, and stir. Spoon into the shell, top with the rest of the chicken, and bake for about 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the shell topping is golden brown. Serve with the remaining olives for a topping.

title: Grilled French Toast
ingredients: 6 slices dijon-style mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Pour 1/4 cup dijon style mustard into large, wide, shallow dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Dip both sides of the piece of french toast into the mustard, and thoroughly coat with the mustard. Transfer to a plate, and serve immediately.

title: Yummy Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 cup diced fresh mango chutney | 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 1 cup cubed shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Gently combine all the ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix well. Cover with a plate and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving.

title: French Apricot Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 2 cups apricots, pitted and chopped | 1/3 cup pesto sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix, apricots and pesto or chive & garlic dressing mix together until moistened. Place in refrigerator until required.

title: Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 large white onion, chopped | 4 ounces lean hamburger | 4 ounces chili powder | 4 ounces canned cauliflower, drained and chopped | 8 ounces sliced hamburger | 8 inches square baking chocolate | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel or 2 teaspoons sage leaves, chopped fresh
instructions: Grate the hamburger and add to a deep frypan. Drain the fat out of the hamburger and add it to the hamburger as well. Pour in the chili powder and mix thoroughly. Heat on medium until the liquid boils. Then turn the heat to very low and simmer, stirring frequently, for 20 minutes. Stir in the cauliflower, hamburger and sage. Cover the pan and allow to set over a low heat for about 15 minutes. Uncover and stir every 5 - 10 minutes to keep it from burning. If the sauce becomes too thick, add a bit of water. It should thicken. Turn the crock pot on high, stirring until the sauce boils. Turn off the crock pot and leave for about 2 hours on low. This could be served over brown rice or cooked spaghetti for an extra yummy meal.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,oregano leaf,grain rice,fenugreek leaf,pork rib,egg noodle,pear,active yeast
title: Arabic Pork & Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm, 105 to 115 f., divided | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 cups short-grain rice | 1 lb boneless country-style pork ribs, cut into 2- to 3-inch chunks | 1/4 cup fenugreek leaves | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 1/4 1 1/4 lbs boneless country-style short-grain rice, uncooked | 3 large eggs ( lightly beaten ) | pared dried pear, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons water. In a large dutch oven, heat remaining 1/4 cup butter over medium heat. Add the undissolved yeast, then stir to combine. Add the rice, stir, and cook until coated and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add the pork, fenugreek, oregano, and 1/2 cup warm water. Stir, simmer, covered, over low heat until pork is hot, about 30 minutes. While the pork mixture simmers, shape the remaining 2/3 cup butter into a pouch. Remove the dough from the dish, transfer to a lightly floured surface, and knead until smooth. Place 1/2 cup warm water in a large bowl. Roll the dough out to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut circles 1/2 inch wide and set aside. Place 1 tablespoon oil and 1 teaspoon salt in a nonstick skillet. Add the dough circles by the teaspoonful, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Turn each piece over after 2 minutes. Cook over medium low heat for 2 minutes, or until the bottom is light golden brown. Turn and cook for an additional 2 minutes. Remove from the heat, transfer to a large warm platter, and let cool about 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 375f degrees. Using a 2 inch diameter, round biscuit cutter or glass, cut out bread doughs. Arrange bread rounds, about 1 inch apart, on a baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes, reduce heat to 350f degrees, and bake 10 more minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Remove the crusts from the bread rounds, and let cool. Place half each of the pork and fenugreek filling in a small dish. Cut the remaining dough into small strips, and arrange around crannies on a platter with the crannies. Garnish with diced pears if desired. Serve in wedges.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,cashew,bell pepper,sherry,beet,beef stew meat,beef bouillon cube,olive oil
title: Beef and Pepper Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 1 bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh beets, chopped | 1/4 cup kalamata olives, chopped or 1/4 cup green olives, chopped and drained | 1 -2 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/2 cup dry sherry or 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup cashews, toasted | cooking spray or butter, for serving
instructions: Place beef, bell pepper, bell pepper and beets in a slow cooker. Whisk together the remaining ingredients in a separate bowl. Pour over beef. Cover and cook on high for 4 1/2 hours, or on low for 4 1/2 hours. Stir well before serving on a hot hot bun.

title: Chile-Orange Spice
ingredients: 4 ounces tea | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 large orange | 2 arbol chiles
instructions: Chop the orange into slivers and remove the white membrane, the pith or seeds and the membrane. Cut the orange into small slivers. Wear long sleeves, and pull off the hard stringy black skin that forms above the onion. Fill a 2 cup glass jar with ice cubes, and sprinkle half of the orange slivers, the chile pepper and the smoke over top. Cover the jar tightly with plastic wrap, and store at cool, dark or dark age for at least 2 weeks.

title: Homemade Mustard (Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 2 cups dry mustard | 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients and combine well.

title: Simple Italian Baked Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs grated mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Mix cheese and water together in a bowl, mixing until the mixture becomes thick and creamy. Pour into 2 round 8” baking dishes sprayed with pam. Bake uncovered 15 minutes. Remove from oven and serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti & Meat
ingredients: 3 packages spaghetti | 1 can of chopped stewed cooked meat, drained well
instructions: Boil water add spaghetti and cook to box directions, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, add stewed meat if you are using a lean stewed meat. If not cooking with fresh meat, cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until meat is done. Enjoy.

title: Easy Shredable Corn
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil ( corn oil can be substituted ) | 1/4 cup simple syrup
instructions: Heat a small nonstick frying pan on medium heat. Combine the oil and syrup and heat over medium until the mixture just begins to bubble but not boil, 1 - 2 minutes. Turn the corn out onto a plate. Use tongs to transfer the hot oil to the pan, leaving the corn behind and set the pan aside. Toss the corn back in to the pan until the oil is coated evenly.

title: Garlicky Korean Marinated Leg of Lamb (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck or 2 lbs leg of lamb | 2 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Brown the lamb in a skillet over medium heat, about 5 minutes per side. Combine the soy sauce, fish sauce and cumin. Add meat to crock pot. Cover, cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Cod Fish in Tangy Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod ( or other white fish eg. haddock ) | 1 lb lobster tail ( or other white fish eg. haddock ) | 2 -3 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | fresh fruit, as desired ( dried fruit cooks the sauce more than normal, if not available )
instructions: Wash fish and dry. Cut into 4 or 5 pieces. If using lobster tails cut into 4 pieces. If using lobster tail cut into 4 equal portions and cut each into 6 - 8 pieces. If using tail remove first and cut into 6 - 8 pieces. Place fish in a large pot. Add fish sauce. Add sesame oil. Add tabasco. Add fresh fruit if desired. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Cover and poach until fish is tender. Add additional sauce if necessary.

title: Spinach and Cheese Filling With Chipotle Vegetables
ingredients: 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 6 cups baby spinach, chopped | 2 cups mixed fresh vegetables ( such as beans, broccoli or asparagus ) | 3/4 cup rice wine ( preferably shaoxing ) | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles, minced | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds
instructions: Put poppy seeds in a shallow tray or oven proof dish. Bake at 450° for 1 to 2 minutes, until lightly browned on top. Set the broiler to high. In a medium bowl, mix together spinach, vegetables, rice wine, chiles, and poppy seeds.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,romaine lettuce heart,dill sprig,beef bouillon,pie shell,fromage frais
title: Easy Philly Patty Melts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon | 1 package fromage frais | 1 teaspoon dried dill sprigs | 1 unbaked pie shell | 2 romaine lettuce hearts, separated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Mix together the italian salad dressing mix, fromage frais, dill, and beef bouillon in a bowl, and stir until the mixture is well blended. Place the mixture into the pie shell, and spread evenly. Line the bottom of the pie shell with romaine lettuce leaves, then top with lettuce. Bake in the preheated oven until the mixture is bubbly, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,chipotle chile,guava juice,pine nut,cilantro leaf,pimiento,parsnip,hot red pepper flake
title: Grilled Pumpkin Phyllo Purses(Sushi)
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo pastry ( each package should have 1 sheet per box ) | 12 guavocados - peeled, halved lengthwise and pitted | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 jarred hot red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 3 cups fresh guava juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley ( flat-leaf parsley tastes best, packed ) | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Prepare grill. Arrange phyllo pastry on hot grill and brush with oil. Grill, brushing with oil occasionally with guava juice, until edges are lightly browned and phyllo is shiny and browned, about 10 minutes. Toss guavocados with pimiento and cilantro in large bowl. Place 1/3 of guava mixture into bottom of pan, and top with 1/3 cup hot red pepper flakes. Starting at 1 of the short sides of the phyllo sheets, wrap 1 or 2 sheets tightly around filling. Continue with remaining sheets and stuffing, placing each on top of the first sheet in the pan, and continue wrapping the phyllo as before. When all sheets are wrapped, remove top sheets of phyllo pastry sheets and brush each with oil. Grill uncovered over medium heat, turning with tongs, until phyllo pastry is browned and crisp, about 20 minutes. Cut stack of phyllo on diagonal into 4 equal pieces, place 5 sheets cut side down on coiling surface.

title: Tortilla, Vanilla and Olive Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 16 ounces tri-colored egg noodles | 12 ounces tortillas, cut in half | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped green olives | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1 cup vanilla sugar | 2 cups enchilada sauce or 2 cups bottled taco sauce
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, warm oil in large nonstick frypan over medium high heat. Add vegetables and cook, stirring frequently, until onions start to slightly brown, about 5 minutes. Add taco sauce and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes or until heated through. Spoon half noodles into ungreased glass 4qt baking dish then add half noodles, sauce and half olives. Spoon half sauce over and top with remaining ingredients. Cover loosely with foil if sauce starts to get too brown. Bake in preheated 350°f oven until done, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,hamburger,grapefruit juice,coriander powder,cake flour,heavy cream,mint leaf
title: Grapefruit and Mint Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon grapefruit juice | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard or 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 8 hamburger, steamed
instructions: In small bowl, mix flour, coriander, grapefruit juice, worcestershire, and heavy cream. Cover and chill in refrigerator. In a small bowl, stir together mustard and mint until well mixed. Shape the mixture into 8 patties. Cook the burgers on a hot griddle or frying pan over medium high heat, about 3 minutes on each side. Serve hot.

title: Cretons with Oregano Pesto
ingredients: 12 small flour tortillas ( store bought or home made ) | 1 cup prepared low fat pesto ( store bought or home made ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 tablespoon finely shredded parmesan cheese or 1 tablespoon shredded romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Slice each tortilla in half down the center, then cut into 2 thin half moons. Place about 4 tblsp. Of pesto in center of each tortilla, then roll up each slice. Dip tortillas in remaining pesto, then place on a baking sheet. Spoon remaining pesto evenly over tortillas and bake for 10 - 12 minutes, until crisp and golden. Remove from oven & spread topping on top. Sprinkle with parmesan and serve immediately.

title: Namibian Linguine (White) Ww 5 Points
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1/4 cup clear honey | 1 teaspoon green chili | 3/4 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons mild green chili, chopped
instructions: Cook and then drain linguine. Meanwhile mix limeade concentrate, honey, green chili, and 3 tbsp. Of swiss cheese in medium bowl. Spray skillet with cooking oil spray and heat over medium heat. Stir half of the linguine into the sauce. Then add the other half of the sauce, the rest of the noodles, and the rest of the swiss cheese. Cover and cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Pulled Pork Sandwich (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 piece roasted pork | tortilla chips or flour tortilla ( 6-8 in size )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in crockpot. Cook on low approximately 4 hours or on high approximately 4 - 5 hours. Serve on crusty sandwich rolls.

title: Crock Pot Swedish Steak
ingredients: 1 beef steak | 1/2 cup irish cream ( you may substitute coconut cream if you wish )
instructions: Put steaks in crock pot. Add cream and stir in until well blended. Cook on low for 8 to 12 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Serve over hot noodles or rice for breakfast. Or place in a pie dish. You may add additional irish cream. Note, if you like, place in refrigerator for up 2 days before removing the meat.

title: Southern Vegetable Pate (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cups cubed cooked veal | 2 cups fresh vegetables, chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon juice and zest | 1 can black-eyed peas
instructions: Place the cooked veal and vegetables in a blender or food processor. Pulse until thoroughly mixed. Add lemon juice and zest. Pour into a glass bowl. Rinse and drain all of the veggie mixture well. Toss with the beans.

title: Gnocchi With Brown Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice | 1/2 lb fresh gnocchi ( or regular ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil, divided with 1 t peanut oil | 2 small serrano peppers, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon lard, plus more as needed
instructions: Rinse the rice 3 times, then drain in a strainer so that excess moisture runs off. Put the rice in a saucepan with 1 t oil and the 2 serrano peppers and bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the rice is tender and the liquid has absorbed, about 15 minutes. Drain and set aside on a plate. Remove the rice with a strainer, then rinse completely under running water. Drain the rice again and set aside. Place the remaining 1 t of oil in a skillet over medium heat. When the oil shimmers, add the gnocchi meat and cook until the gnocchi begin to brown in color, about 5 minutes. Turn the gnocchi and cook until other side cooks but is no longer transparent and begins to crisp, about 6 minutes more. Remove the gnocchi and set aside, trying not to crowd the pan. Meanwhile, steam the rice in a small colander over a medium high heat, stirring in the reserved soaking liquid and 1 t each of the peanut oil and butter. To serve, cut the cooked gnocchi into rounds and place one portion on the plate. Ladle some of the brown sauce over the gnocchi and drizzle with more pan sauce.

Random Ingredients: salad green,white chocolate,green chili pepper,dripping,bacon dripping,sea salt black pepper,shallot
title: Chile Fried Green Chile With Bacon
