ingredients: 3 green chili peppers | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 lb bacon drippings ( or any vegetable fat ) | 2 shallots, peeled, halved, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons good quality bacon fat ( or other vegetable fat ) | 3/4 cup white chocolate | flour for coating | salad greens or iceberg greens ( to garnish )
instructions: Put the green chile peppers in a pan & just cover with water, or place them in a microwave. Cook on high for 3 - 5 minutes, then put the pan in the fridge, turning occasionally until cool. Slice the peppers into strips, then put the strips in a blender with drippings, shallots, and bacon fat, and whizz until smooth. Scrape into a deep fry pan. If using a fan forced oven, warm the bacon fat slightly until very hot, then stir in the chocolate — stir until chocolate is melted and mixture starts to pour immediately. Pour a little of the hot chocolate over the chile mixture, then roll into a ball or circle, using flour for dusting. When all the chile is fried, fry the bacon balls or rolled chile in remaining hot bacon fat until crisp. Toss the green chiles with salad greens or iceberg greens or serve on a large piece of lettuce.

title: Broccoli and Mustard Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 500 g broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 400 g long grainy mustard | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 3 -4 curry leaves | 2 tablespoons capers
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in microwave on high heat. Add ginger and garlic, stir to mix. When garlic begins to turn golden, add remaining ingredients and stir to mix well. Cover and microwave on med/high for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Taste and season with salt & pepper if needed. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Sweet Grilled Hommus Wedges
ingredients: 3 large shallots, halved | 12 baby fennel bulbs | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 25 ounces hummus, warmed | 2 teaspoons capers, drained and rinsed, if dried | 1 ounce superfine sugar, for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat a grill pan with a lid on high. Place the shallots, fennel and raisins on a cutting board, cut side down, and spread lightly with some mayonnaise or sour cream. Place a knob of mayonnaise or sour cream under a halved frill, then cut the frill in half vertically if the slices are large. Brush and wrap the frill half firmly around the frilly slices so they make a neat little parcel. Grill over high heat until the tops are starting to pop and they have begun to split. Turn the frill side up and continue to grill until the frill is golden and crisp on top and the edges are beginning to crispen, about 10 to 12 minutes longer. Repeat with the remaining mixtures. Place in a serving dish, sprinkle with sugar and serve immediately with extra mayonnaise or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,asparagus,lite olive oil,tomato,asafoetida powder,cream,white pearl onion
title: Lazy Garam Masala Vegetable Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons asafoetida powder or 2 tablespoons yellow curry powder | 1/2 lb fresh white pearl onion | 1 1 lb fresh white pearl onions, cut into 1-inch lengths ( i use frozen sweet onions ) | 1 lb fresh tomato, seeded and finely chopped or can chopped tomatoes, drained | 6 tablespoons lite olive oil or 6 tablespoons light olive oil | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional, but i like mine well mixed ) | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: In large shallow frying pan, heat 1 tablespoons oil. Add asafetida and allow to sizzle, stirring constantly. Add remaining vegetables and continue to stir fry over medium heat for 10 minutes or until slightly charred and tender. Add tomato if using and cook for an additional 10 minutes. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, add garam masala and 1/4 teaspoon of asafoetida and mix well. Add 1/4 cup sour cream to sauce and stir well.

title: Penne Pasta With Orange Syrup
ingredients: 3 cups penne pasta ( or spaghetti ) | 1 cup orange juice ( freshly squeezed ) | 2 lemons ( juiced ) | 1 liter heavy cream | 1 cup dried fenugreek ( or a mix of two fenugreek and 1 tablespoon dried fenich leaves, coarsely chopped ) | 1/2 cup couscous ( preferably lebanese wheat couscous )
instructions: Cook pasta according to the package direction. While pasta is cooking, whisk together orange juice, lemons and heavy cream until well combined and then stir in dried fenich and couscous. When pasta is nearly cooked, pour liquid to a 3 quart saucepan and let it come to just under a boil. Cover with a tight fitting lid and then immediately remove the lid. Reduce heat to medium and simmer 3 - 4 mins until liquid is absorbed, then stir vigorously with a wooden spoon or your wooden spoon. If you have a strainer, pour through it. Serve with lemon syrup.

title: Salmon with Basil and Basil
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the salmon fillets with the basil. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven 25 minutes, or until done. Remove from the oven.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,kielbasa,white bread,velveeta cheese,cashew,orange zest,kaffir lime leaf,chicken thigh fillet
title: Chicken Kebabs With Cashew Nests
ingredients: 1 lb pork kielbasa, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 500 g velveeta cheese, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 cup roasted cashews, coarsely chopped ( or peanuts ) | 1 -2 orange, zest of | 3 kaffir lime leaves, minced ( or 1 tsp lime zest ) | 1/2 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar or 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 8 chicken thigh fillets, about 2 kilos | 3 slices white bread, cut into squares
instructions: In a shallow pan or on a cutting board, combine the pork kielbasa, cheese, cashews, zest, lime leaves and vanilla or other flavouring. Place in refrigerator to marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. Place the slices of bread onto a tray. Using fingers, coat the slices of bread with the marinade. Thread each piece of chicken onto 6 skewers, alternating with the bread squares, making them resembling a bbq on the barbecue grill or pan. Cook the kebabs for 4 - 6 minutes on each side or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Sevai
ingredients: 500 g semolina | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons strawberry preserves
instructions: Using an electric grater, grind semolina directly into a fine powder. The texture should be finely crumbly. This should take about 1 minute. Add chopped chili flakes and strawberry preserves and mix thoroughly. Set aside for 10 - 60 minutes or until semolina matures. Serve cold. Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Guiness Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef tenderloin, 3/4-inch thick | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh parsley | 1 cup raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Trim all visible fat from meat. Slice diagonally at 1/4 inch intervals. Place beef between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound lightly to flatten. Combine caraway seed and rum and spread over beef on both sides. Place in the center of an ovenproof skillet. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. While meat is baking, combine cranberries with cilantro and rum mixture and let sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Add raspberries and bake about 5 minutes longer, or until desired doneness. Serve.

Random Ingredients: wonton skin,green cardamom pod,chicken bouillon,tortilla,pickling spice,greek yogurt
title: Raita
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup finely crushed tortilla | 2 tablespoons pickling spices | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pod ( crushed ) | 1/4 - 1/4 teaspoon whole dried wonton skins
instructions: Make sure all the ingredients are mixed well so that the spices penetrate the yogurt nicely. If necessary, add more yogurt. Cut each wonton skins into 1/2 rounds and deep fry in butter, until they turn golden brown in color.

title: Roasted Yellow Squash
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, halved | 2 tablespoons cognac | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 can red cherries, well drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place squash halves, cut sides up, on a baking sheet. Combine cognac, tarragon and cherries in a small bowl or measuring cup. Brush the squash with cognac mixture. Bake in the preheated oven about 20 minutes. Remove from oven to a serving platter and slice 1/4 inch thick. Serve warm.

title: Sweet Pot Pies [raisin and Eggplant Pie)
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, sliced | 2 medium carrots, shredded finely | 1 can sliced peaches | 1/3 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1 can condensed water chestnuts, drained well | 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed ( 10 sheets as per directions in package ) | pile of your choice, thawed if refrigeration
instructions: Poke holes in the top of each roll. Spray large baking sheet with nonstick spray. Spray pastry with nonstick spray and roll out 1 pastry sheet, or two sheets, at a time, and unroll dough slightly. With a sharp knife, score each top layer of pastry, or to exact size, with your desired amount of spacing. You might want to cut the dough in half to speed up the process. Preheat oven to 425º degrees. On a cutting board, lay out the sliced eggplant, carrots, peas, and raisins, if using. Sprinkle raisins and water chestnuts onto the vegetable and eggplant. Roll up the pastry into a ball, about 3 inches in diameter, and place on sheet. Use the heels of the table or the tips and index fingers to push the pastry into circles, making it somewhat like an envelope. Repeat steps 2 through 8 for the eggplant, carrot, and peaches. Place pies in a pan with 2 inch of water covering the top layer. Bake for 20 minutes. Cut into pie while the pies are heating through. Serve with fresh, crusty bread or your favourite cheese and fruit salad.

Random Ingredients: tomato,jalapeno pepper,pepper flake,orange juice,tabasco sauce,nutmeg,lime juice zest,lavender
title: Vietnamese Marinade and Marinade for Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced fresh jalapeno peppers | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice or 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon minced fresh basil or 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon | 3 tablespoons minced of fresh mint or 3 tablespoons of fresh mint | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro or 1 tablespoon fresh dill | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Marinate shrimp 8 - 10 hours or overnight. Grill shrimp over medium heat about 5 minutes per side or until cooked, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Serve on top of rice or pasta with lime wedges and fresh herb sprigs.

Random Ingredients: black forest ham,herb,oregano leaf,white bread,basil,oregano,pastry dough,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Herbed Ham Pie
ingredients: 14 inches pastry dough, partially baked | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil or 2 tablespoons shredded fresh basil | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed herbs ( thyme bruise, parsley etc. ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh oregano | 2 chopped green chili peppers | 3 tablespoons chopped chopped fresh basil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano | 1/3 lb black forest ham, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/3 medium size slice white bread, cut into 3/4-inch cubes ( optional )
instructions: Prepare pastry and place on lightly floured board. With floured rolling pin, roll out one half of the pastry to 1/8 thick. With floured rolling pin or fork, spread about 1 tbs. Becel oil onto top of pastry, then sprinkle with one tbs. Bacon fat or other vegetable oil. Wash and dry basil, mixed herbs, green chili peppers, and chopped herbs. Spread mixture evenly over pastry using remaining pastry. Top with ham, lightly rolling the edges to seal. Cover with remaining pastry crust. Cut a slit in the top crust. Fold top crust over and crimp the edges to seal. Brush top with some more oil. Place on baking sheet and bake in 425°f oven for 15 to 20 minutes until crust is puffed and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: szechwan pepper,orange juice,chorizo sausage,apricot jam,self raising flour,fish sauce
title: Pan-Fried Sausage With Apricot Honey Glaze
ingredients: 4 chorizo sausages, trimmed and cut into 3cm lengths | 2/3 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 -4 tablespoons szechwan pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine jam and juice in a jar and shake well and set aside. Combine flour, fish sauce and szechwan pepper in a medium size bowl. Season with salt and pepper and then add the apricot honey glaze to the wet ingredients, stirring with a wooden spoon. Add the chorizo and mix well. Heat a large non stick frying pan, preferably cast iron. Spread 2 - 3 tablespoons of the butter over the base and sides of the pan. Add the chorizo and stir to coat evenly with pan juices. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes each side or until golden. Serve with steamed or fried rice.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 4 small scallions, chopped | 4 parsnips, peeled and chopped | 1 1/2 cups corn kernels | 2 tablespoons salt substitute
instructions: Puree the scallions and parsnips in a food processor until very smooth, but not quite smooth. Heat a little oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the corn and salt. Cook, stirring often, until the corn is hot and beginning to darken slightly, about 2 minutes. Pour the mixture into bowls and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green olive,cardamom pod,parmigiano,sauce,caster sugar,red wine vinegar,chicken thigh
title: Parmigian Chicken With Olive, Green Olive and Cardamom Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, skin removed | 1 cup green olives, pitted | 1 - 1 1/2 cup grated parmigiano or 2 tablespoons shaved parmigiano reggiano | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup bottled hot sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180oc, 350°f. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper and place on a baking tray skin side down. Place in the oven and cook for 45 - 60 mins to an hour until golden. Cool and cut into thin slices. Meanwhile toss the olives in a bowl with the parmigiano and vinegar. Add the sugar, cardamom pods and hot sauce. Toss to thoroughly combine. Place a small plate on top and cover with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: chive,creole seasoning,lettuce,poblano chile,pine nut,dark brown sugar,mung bean,sesame seed
title: Mung Beans with Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 24 ounces mung beans ( or any small-dish sized bean or macaroni noodles ) | 1 large poblano chile, roasted peeled and halved lengthwise ( about 3 cups ) | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 2 teaspoons chives, chopped | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1/4 cup lettuce, shredded ( optional )
instructions: If using large beans, soak the beans at least 6 hours or overnight. Rinse the beans, then place them in a steamer basket or colander over boiling water. Turn the heat down to low and steam 3 minutes. Do not overcook them. Drain and cool. Cook the poblano and pine nuts in 2 tablespoons of olive oil along with the chives, sugar, sesame seeds, creole seasoning and beans until heated through. Serve beans topped with lettuce, if desired.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups wild rice | 2 cups blackberry ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 cup of cubed roast | 1 can baked corn tortillas ( optional ) | 1 green pepper, diced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 and line a baking pan with non stick cooking spray. Rinse the wild rice 3 or so times. Pour the wild rice, blackberries and mexican brown cheese into the baking pan. Add the roast, corn tortillas and green pepper to the pan. Pour the entire contents in in the pan. Bake for 5 hours. Do not drain the contents of the pan, just mix them together.

Random Ingredients: allspice,rump steak,onion soup mix,red onion,black raisin,anaheim chili,frangelico
title: Pepperjack Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs whole rump steak | 1/2 cup dry onion soup mix | 4 ounces frangelico | 2 tablespoons allspice | 1/4 red onion | 1/4 cup black raisins | 2 anaheim chili
instructions: Preheat grill, set your burner on medium heat, and grill your steak for 7 minutes on each side or until medium rare, or to your liking. Roast in the preheating 425 degrees f oven for 15 minutes. Turn grill control to high and broil the patties for 5 to 7 minutes until browned and cooked through.

title: Curry Shrimp Wraps
ingredients: 5 green beans, cut into 1cm lengths | 1 small tomatoes, sliced and chopped | 3 sheets wrappers | 1/2 lb shrimp, cooked, cut into small pieces | 1/4 lb pork loin, cubed | 1/4 cup self raising flour | 1/4 cup mozzarella balls, diced | 1/2 cup curry
instructions: First, put the green beans on to boil with a little oil and salt and pepper as you're getting ready to do them. You want to keep this at a gentle simmer so that your water cooks down. When cooked the green beans should be limp and bright green. Drain and set aside. Now, place a teaspoon or so of oil in a pan and fry the shrimp and pork until cooked and set aside. In a large bowl, mix all of your ingredients together. You might need to add a little flour here. Now take some of the green beans and throw a handful on your mixture, and throw them into the bowl. Then, pile on your shrimp/pork mixture and continue the process until all the mixture is used up. Place each wrap on a flat dish you should be able to make the wraps onto the dish if it's going to be a long, deep dish. This gives you extra wrap and it can be frozen for later use. Cook in a pan for about 3 minutes after turning onto a plate. I usually cook in my cast iron grill.

title: Spicy Mexican Quinoa Bowls

instructions: Set aside 1 cup of the quinoa. In a large bowl, soak the rest in cold water for 20 minutes. Rinse with cold water, drain and place in a large bowl. In a blender or food processor, pulse the quinoa until it forms fine crumbs. Add wine, soup, horseradish, oregano, red pepper, and cayenne. Blend for 30 seconds to blend. Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat, and coat with cooking spray. Place 1/2 cup of the quinoa in the pan, and tilt it to coat the bottom and around the sides. Quickly spoon 1/2 cup of the quinoa in one of the bowls over the quinoa. Place 3 cups of hot cooked noodles in the bowl, and top with 1/2 cup of the quinoa and hot soup mix. Repeat until the top is filled, adding more quinoa and soup mix as needed. Cover the bowl, and set aside. Repeat until all the quinoa and soup grains are used. Serve with a side of steamed jasmine rice and green vegetables.

title: Sensational German Party Cookies

instructions: Cut your angel food cake into 1 inch cubes. Heat the shortening and the hot pepper sauce in a pan. When melted, remove from burner. title: Pumpkin Mexican Cream

instructions: Use a double boiler or a larger pot over medium heat.

title: Oriental Chicken and Noodles
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, cut up ( or 4 bone-in chicken breasts ) | 2 teaspoons orange zest ( or 1 tsp. grated fresh lemon zest ) | 1/2 cup beef or 1/2 cup fish stock ( i used fish stock ) | 2 cups chicken stock ( i used 1 cup chicken stock, 1/3 cup ) | 1 1/2 cups ginger ale or 1 1/2 cups lime juice | 2 heads broccoli stems and leaves, chopped ( you may use just a little less broccoli ) | rice noodles, to serve
instructions: Place chicken in large saucepan with 1 cup chicken stock. Sprinkle with orange zest. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer about 40 minutes. Remove chicken, remove cover and continue to simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes longer. Meanwhile, in a small non aluminum pan, place the remaining stock. Add the ginger ale. Heat until mixture boils. Meanwhile, cover jelly can with some cold water and submerge jelly in. Cover with plastic wrap and refridgerate jelly until cold, about 1 hour or overnight. When chicken is done, remove from saucepan. Remove chicken from saucepan and set aside. Increase heat to medium high and boil reserved jelly for 2 minutes or until jelly boils and thickens slightly.. Remove jelly from heat and pour into saucepan with chicken. Arrange chicken, broccoli and noodles over top. Simmer, uncovered about 5 minutes or until chicken is hot. Serve chicken over rice noodles.

title: Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 yellow onion, diced ( about 1 cup ) | 1 large orange, zested, juiced, and juiced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped lemon peel | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Let stand several hours for flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,vegetable oil,chive,mint leaf,oregano leaf,italian parsley,cream tartar
title: Ziti With Herbs and Herbs
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley | 3/4 cup fresh chives, chopped | fresh mint leaf
instructions: In a large pot, bring 6 quarts of water to a boil. Turn down to a gentle boil for the ziti pasta. Meanwhile, in a separate large pot, heat the oil and cream of tartar over medium heat. Stir in the oregano and cook for 1 minute. Add the parsley, chives and ziti, tossing to coat in the oil and season with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, until the pasta is tender. Remove the ziti from the heat and stir to combine. Place in a large serving bowl and top with fresh mint leaves and serve immediately.

title: Sweet Potato Snack
ingredients: 1 kg baking potato | 60 g palm sugar
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200f and generously flour your baking dishes. Cut the sweet potato into small chunks. Place the potato chunks in a large bowl and sprinkle in the palm sugar. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 mins, stirring around every so often then testing them with a skewer. Cool on a wire rack and store in an airtight tin.

title: Crock Pot Lamb & Pork Brisket
ingredients: 1 small cooking onion, peeled & roughly chopped | 1 shallot, white, peeled & roughly chopped | 1/4 cup coriander leaves, coriander sprigs, finely chopped | 1/3 cup green olives, pitted | 1 can chopped dried apricots, drained | 1 lean lamb, fat trimmed & cut into 2 cm cubes | 2 teaspoons ground coriander leaves | 4 1/2 cups beef brisket, fat trimmed
instructions: Place the coriander, onion and shallot in a large bowl with the coriander, olives, apricots and lamb, toss well to combine. Cover & chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, but at best 3 and 4 hours is possible. Heat the fat in a large frying pan on a medium to medium high heat, add the spice mix & fry the spices for 3 - 4 minutes, or until fragrant. Add the reserved coriander leaves & stir fry for a minute. Transfer onto the slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 2 1/2 hours. Stir well before serving with steamed rice or couscous.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,cilantro stem,gingerroot,apple juice,mung bean sprout,pea,maple flavoring
title: Sugar Snap Peas With Mung Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried mung bean sprouts | 2 cups frozen peas, thawed | 1 tablespoon minced gingerroot | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro stem, crushed | 2 1/2 tablespoons pure maple flavoring or 2 1/2 tablespoons other artificial sweetener | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, minced | 2 tablespoons apple juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice, freshly squeezed
instructions: If your bean sprouts have difficulty getting tender, cut them into 3 - 4 inch lengths. If your peas are not yet as tender, soak them in water overnight if they are. In a large saucepan, combine all the ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat. Stir once or twice, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender, about 10 minutes. Spoon peas into a shallow serving dish or platter.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,white mushroom,vanilla bean,red cabbage,lemon zest,corn flake
title: Spinach and Mushroom Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon zest ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon lemon, zest ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, whole, split lengthwise | 2 cans mushrooms, drained and quartered | 1 medium red cabbage, cut into thin wedges | 1 package white mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon corn flakes
instructions: In large saucepan, combine lemon zest, lemon zest, and vanilla bean. Cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, for approximately 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients and cook 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Scottish Hangover Brigade Sandwich I

instructions: Mix ground black pepper and confectioners' sugar to form a paste. Spread paste on 1 or 2 sandwich rolls.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,teriyaki sauce,seasoning salt,sun tomato oil

instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add chopped sun dried tomatoes and stir until heated. Lower heat and stir in teriyaki sauce until mixed and well blended. Add cheddar cheese and stir to melt. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Drain cheese mixture and place each slice of cheese onto a small baking sheet. Bake about 10 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: cheese ravioli,dijon mustard,red wine vinegar,cranberry juice
title: Cranberry Ravioli
ingredients: 6 -12 ounces cheese ravioli | 1 cup cranberry juice | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Cook ravioli according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Combine cranberry juice, vinegar, and dijon mustard. Pour over cooked ravioli and gently toss until coated. Serve immediately.

title: Grpa's Crock Pot Caponata

Serve with roasted portobello, asparagus, and a vegetable of your choice to dip in it. I have also simmered on low for 2 hours for 8 hours. Use for sandwiches, with sausages or meatloaf.

title: Swiss Green Cheddar and Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 3 mushrooms, chopped | 1 can red beans, drained | 3 tablespoons pineapple, finely chopped | 2 green cardamom pods, bruised | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 3 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f place corn oil in a medium frying pan and cook onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in mushrooms. Heat through. Stir in drained beans, pineapple, cardamom pods and ground mace. Remove from heat. Transfer to a large bowl and mix in cheese. Pour over bean mixture. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

title: Crispy Thai Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs, chopped into bite-size pieces | 1 large cucumber, halved lengthways and cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, slivered | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf | pam cooking spray | fresh basil leaf, to garnish
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375f and spray with a little pam. Heat the oil in a large, deep skillet. Add the chicken, coating it evenly. Cook for 2 to 4 minutes, then stir in the cucumber, chile and basil and continue cooking for 5 minutes. Transfer the chicken mixture to a large baking dish and bake for 8 minutes or until crispy and a little browned. Sprinkle with a little basil just before serving.

instructions: Stir all ingredients together until well blended. Serve sprinkled with warmed apricot preserves.

instructions: Beat the sherry, icing sugar and rum together. Add the pepper, then add the pudding mix and mix until it becomes a stiff dough. Using a teaspoon drop small balls of mixture onto hot greaseproof paper, roll and freeze until set. Remove from freezer and slice diagonally.

instructions: Soak mushrooms in warm water for 20 minutes, then cut into large pieces and slice. Toss mushrooms with soya sauce and marinate 15 minutes. To serve, lightly sprinkle with lime.

instructions: Stir fry the curry paste in a pan and set aside. Remove thick stems from nori or nori. Cut into 2 inch lengths, then cut into 1 1/2 inch lengths. Place in a bowl and sprinkle over with red cabbage. Serve with japanese soy sauce, mirin, etc.

title: Avocado and Guacamole

instructions: Preheat broiler and position rack 3 - 6 inches from broiler element. Process avocado and flour in food processor until smooth, about 1 minute. Whisk in egg. Pour batter into medium bowl, dust with flour/egg mixture, and coat with cooking spray. Using 2 spoons, drop batter, 1 inch apart, on hot fat. Flip when golden brown on both sides, about 3 minutes. Serve hot or warm.

instructions: Wash beansprouts and place them in a pot, add 1/2 pkg of bean sprouts, mix the ingredients and allow to cook slowly till sprouts are tender. Remove from heat once cooked.

instructions: Cook vegetables according to package directions. Dry thoroughly. While vegetables are cooking, combine seasonings and warm oil or butter in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil.

instructions: Mix cream of chicken soup, canned chickpeas, kidney tomatoes, tomato diced tomatoes, ricotta cheese, chile pepper, and hot pepper sauce together in a bowl.

title: Tender Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup barbecue sauce ( try homemade bbq sauce or sweet & sour sauce to make this recipe the easy option ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | fresh curly currants or fresh green beans ( optional ) | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except grated cheese in a small bowl. Heat on medium grill until bubbles form throughout the grilling top. instructions: Heat oil in heavy large skillet on medium heat. Add chicken.

instructions: Melt cheese in large pan over low flame of your burner. Remove from heat and stir in 3 tablespoons dried ancho chili flowers, spread about 1 tbsp in the bottom of a small casserole that has been browned under high heat for about a minute. Slice beef into very thin slices. Spoon cheese mixture into an attractive bowl and place on top of mint leaves. Serve hot. Serve.

instructions: Mix green chile peppers, cream, lime juice, and marjoram with a whisk in a bowl.

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high and brush the grill with oil. Arrange the poblanos around the edges of grill grate.

instructions: Pour flax seeds into a small bowl, and sprinkle enough flax seed onto the flake to cover. Let sit in the sink for a couple of days. Use immediately or store in an airtight container.

title: Vegetables on the Basmati Rice Cooker

instructions: Put everything in the rice cooker and pulse until the ingredients are blended. Close the lid and press start. When cycle is complete, fluff rice with a fork.

title: Baked Beef Triples
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 12 ounces beef eye round | 8 1/2 ounces chanterelle mushrooms, quartered | 1/4 cup golden brown sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f mix together tahini and 3 tablespoons water in a bowl and spread on the beef. Insert toothpicks through the beef about 1/2 inch deep and place on a parchment lined jelly roll pan. Bake for 30 minutes. When done, spread the mushrooms on their side and place in the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the golden brown sugar over the roast and return the toothpicks to the pan. Return to the oven and continue to cook for a further 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Quick N Easy Indian Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon garam masala | 1 bag fresh stir-fry vegetables
instructions: Add all ingredients in a zip top bag and shake well. Marinate in refrigerator. Microwave on high power for 5 minutes, stir fry and enjoy.

title: Kebabs Dry Beef and Gravy With Szechuan Peppercorns
ingredients: 5 lbs beef bones and tri-tip beef | 4 large dried szechuan peppercorns | 2 tablespoons turmeric | 2 cups coarsely coarsely grated imported italian parsley | 5 ounces toasted bread, soaked in warm water for 1 hour and then crumbled fine | 2 1/2 teaspoons saffron, pulverized with 1/2 cup water
instructions: In a large bowl, put the beef bones, peppercorns, turmeric, parsley, and salt, and mix well. Cover with hot water, and set aside to soak for 12 hours. Place the soaking beef in a large, heavy bottomed pot and cover with water almost to the top of the bones. Bring to a simmer over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2 hours. Remove from heat, and place in a bowl. Cover with warm water, and set aside to overnight. Pour off all but about 1 t of the liquid, then simmer the pot over high heat until the meat starts to dry and brown at the sides. Remove the meat from the pot, and put aside. When the meat is cool enough to handle, cut pieces about the size of a large fist. Skim off the fat and cut into pieces as much as you want. Ladle into soup cups. Sprinkle with saffron and serve over boiled rice.

title: Sherry & Phyllo Cheese -
ingredients: 7 1/4 ounces active dry yeast | 4 1/2 cups all-purpose white bread flour | 1 3/4 cups fruity sherry | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup cold water in a mixing bowl. Stir in yeast mixture. Let rise until double, about 30 minutes. Punch down dough. On floured surface, knead in sherry until smooth, about 5 minutes. Shape dough into a ball. Place on floured tabletop, coat with flour, and let rest 20 minutes. Divide dough into 3 pieces. Roll each piece into a 10x12 inch rectangle. Lightly oil a large baking sheet. Place 5 phyllo rectangles on dough, and cut into 3 inch long strips. Sprinkle phyllo with sherry, spacing evenly. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake in preheated oven until bubbling, about 20 minutes. Cool, then cut into 5 slices.

title: Cured Capers (Asian Style)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs capers, rinsed clean | 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine
instructions: Place the capers and 4 t of cold water in a container or strainer and shake them to remove any sand or grit that can be released. The capers should resemble shaggy baby capers. Refrigerate overnight in the refrigerator. After a few hours transfer the caper mixture to a bowl and let sit before using. Combine 3 t soy sauce with the wine and pour over capers.

title: Mexican Poblano
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/2 cup dry rice wine | 1/4 cup olive, chopped
instructions: Trim the stem from poblano, wash, peel and slit the chile on the seeds. In a large skillet, heat poblano and soup, vodka and olives until the liquid is boiling. Boil for 1 minute and remove from heat and set aside.

title: Pancetta Filled Sweet Potato Pancake
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled ( like puffs, or you could use yukon gold sweet potato ) | 2 tablespoons pancetta, finely chopped ( or use gourmet bacon ) | 1/2 tablespoon brown sugar, packed | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( not heinz ) | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream or 2 tablespoons cream | 1 -2 tablespoon potato starch
instructions: Place sweet potato in a saucepan of salted water until boiling. Continue boiling until the potatoes are soft but not mushy. Test your potato for doneness by inserting a knife or fork into a little potato. If it turns out soft or not, it's cooked. Peel the potato, if using a knife, and cut it into thick slices about 1/4 thick. Set aside in the refrigerator until cool enough to handle. In a small bowl, combine pancetta, brown sugar, ketchup, and half and half and set aside. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, peel them and cut them into 1/4 thick slices. Dip each potato slice into the batter, then press into a small, lightly oiled or non stick patty pan that has been lightly coated with 1 to 2 teaspoons potato starch. When the cakes are pressed into the patty pan, they may break easily, and the pancakes may pop off the patty pan. Pour about 1 1/2 teaspoons of tomato sauce evenly into the patty pan. Swirl the pan until it all is a nice, even layer. You should be able to spread the batter all the way to the edges, but you may not be able to close the lid onto the pan once the bottom layer is pressed or the top layer is covered if your pans have been brushed with more sauce. When one side of the pancetta fritters has browned, flip it and brown the other side. Remove the pancetta from the pan, and let the pancake brown slightly, and then flip it again. The pancakes are done when a toothpick comes out clean of the pancake easily.

title: Spicy Cucumber and Green Chutney Rice

instructions: Combine rice, ginger garlic paste, red chile flakes and green chili sauce in a bowl. Mix well. Add capsicum and stir until fragrant. Add water if necessary to bring mixture to the consistency of thick gravy. Add chili flakes. Stir fry gently for a few minutes. Remove from heat. Add couscous and mix well. Serve hot.

instructions: Blend everything together and refrigerate for at least one hour to blend the flavors.

instructions: Cook the chicken and lobster meat in oil in a skillet over medium heat until chicken is no longer pink. Remove chicken and lobster from skillet. Add the beans to the skillet. Stir, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in the cooked chicken, lobster and hazelnuts. Serve warm.

title: Sambhar Powder

Using the rolling pin roll them out into 8x8 inch rectangles. Heat the sambhar in your oven until the temperature reaches 350 degrees fahrenheit. Dip the sambhar into cold water and place in a pan filled with water. You could also leave them in the freezer for a week to get a softer sambhar like consistency.
