title: Tex-Mex Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh pasta | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 ounce creme de cacao | 1/4 ounce rice wine | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Cook the pasta, drain, rinse in cold water and drain again. Add the beans, heat over high heat, and stir. When hot, add the chili oil, creme de cacao, rice wine, and salsa. Continue to heat until the salsa is melted. Add pasta and toss.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,corn oil,mustard powder,pomegranate,green chilies,self rising flour,biscuit,porcini mushroom
title: Chile and Cheese Parcels
ingredients: 4 large porcini mushrooms or 2 cups mixed mushrooms, cleaned, chopped | 1 cup finely chopped green chilies | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 150 g self rising flour | 30 g gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1/2 cup pomegranate, seeds of | 150 g shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and then shape into patties about 5cm in diameter and 3cm thick with the back of a spoon. Drain excess oil and put on a greased baking tray. Broil for 10 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Sprinkle pomegranate seeds on the top for a few minutes to give it a golden colour. In the meantime sprinkle the shredded cheese and bake in a preheated oven at 200c / 400f for 20 minutes or until cheese has melted slightly. Remove and serve warm with salad.

title: Ravishing Mexican Party Crab
ingredients: 1 -2 lb imitation crabmeat or 1 -2 lb imitation crabmeat, picked over | 1 can tomato soup | 1 can condensed vodka ( absolut zinfandel ) | 3/4 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon dried coriander powder | shredded cottage cheese or corn chips | salsa ( optional ) or guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Bake or eat as recommended by ravishing. Spray with cooking spray, bake in oven or microwave until browned and bubbly, about 3 minutes per side. Serve with tortilla chips or your favorite toppings.

title: Easy Microwave Chicken Lasagna!
ingredients: 6 frozen lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( or less to taste ) | 1/2 cup ketchup ( no more than a lck, no less than a tbsp. to your taste ) | 1 tablespoon applesauce ( no more than a tbsp. to your taste ) | 1/2 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1/2 tablespoon garam masala ( no more than a tbsp. each ) | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom ( no more than a tbsp. to your taste )
instructions: Place the frozen lasagna noodles on a wire rack and microwave at full power for about 5 minutes. While the noodles are microwaving, mix all the other ingredients, except for the garam masala and cardamom, in a large bowl. Once all of the noodles are cut in, layer them in a large baking dish on top of the noodles, in between the noodles as you go. I use the microwave method and put a heavy plate on top, as if you were using a cookie sheet to weigh it down, it will likely cook more quickly and with less storage than what you’re used to cook the noodles. Set aside to cool slightly. You can prepare this immediately, i just cover the dish tightly and place it in the refrigerator for about an hour, stirring every 2 to 3 hours. This allows for more time to set and makes it easier to cut. Serve with fresh salad. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,white rum,honey mustard,rice vinegar,hard egg,french bread
title: Chipotle Sandwich
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup shaved shreaded french bread | 1/8 cup honey mustard | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/2 cup white rum
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Spread on 4 slices of bread. Can be served at room temperature. Makes four sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,spinach leaf,cheese ravioli,cinnamon,white flour,almond flour,tomato paste
title: Ravioli with Tomato and Spinach
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 lb cheese ravioli ( fresh ) | 3 tablespoons almond flour | graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1/2 ounce tomato paste | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 10 fresh spinach leaves ( small )
instructions: Combine ricotta, ravioli, almond flour, graham cracker crumbs, flour, tomato paste, cinnamon and salt. Mix well. Line a baking sheet with foil, and pour mixture inside. Bake at 400' for 15 minutes, then turn off oven. Let stand 5 minutes longer, then cut. Serve topped with fresh chopped tomato. Note, this freezes well and defrosts in a casserole dish, if you can't find ricotta it makes a great filling for your ravioli.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,kalamata olive,guacamole,sharp cheddar cheese,feta cheese,cumin powder,ham
title: Kittencal's Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 lb ham, diced ( optional, use up to 1/4 cup ) | 1/4 lb sharp cheddar cheese, shredded ( to taste ) | 1/4 lb feta cheese, crumbled ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, chopped ( to taste ) | 1 -2 tablespoon pickled jalapeno chile, diced ( seeded for extra spice ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cumin powder ( adjust for heat level ) ( optional ) | 1 cup guacamole
instructions: Place the ham in a bowl. Mix it with the cheeses and chopped olives. Add jalapenos and cumin. Spray a frying pan with non stick cooking spray. Take a portion of the mixture and spread it out into a tortilla. Put on the griddle and cook over medium heat flipping it over every couple of minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and the edges are firm but not burnt. Remove the quesadilla from the griddle and allow it to cool before folding it into a triangle. Cut diagonally into 4 wedges and eat with fresh tomatoes, salsa, sour cream, etc.

title: Golden Syrup for Ham
ingredients: 10 pineapple chunks | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Remove and discard the stem from the pineapple. If desired, chop the pineapple flesh into smaller pieces and place in a blender along with the saffron. Blend until the pineapple is a smooth puree consistency. Strain through a fine mesh strainer to remove seeds.. Bring 1 2/3 cups water to a boil. Add the pineapple chunks and return to a boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce the heat to simmer, add the basil and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Pour into a sterilized 1 pint jar or a sealable freezer bag. Keep in the fridge for 1 - 2 weeks, pressing the air out of the jar once opened.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,london broil beef,extra virgin olive oil,fontina cheese
title: Grilled Beef Lettuce Wraps (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs london broil beef, cut into 2-4 inch strips | 2 -4 large head iceberg lettuce, cut into 1/2 to 3/4 inch slices | 1 cup grated fontina cheese | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: To make the meat, in a 12 inch nonstick skillet, add the olive oil and heat over high heat. Add the meat in a single layer and sauté until it reaches 165 degrees f on the instant read thermometer, about 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer the steak to a cutting board. Using a slotted spoon, peel off any excess fat from the meat, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Then using tongs, transfer the meat to a clean plate and let cool slightly. When the oil is just about to smoke, add the lettuce slices and sprinkle with fontina cheese. Cook the lettuce in the hot skillet until the cheese has melted and the lettuce is warm, about 3 - 4 minutes. Drizzle with the olive oil. Spoon some of the meat mixture into each of the lettuce torn leaves. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,peach,red cabbage,lemon zest,cider vinegar,egg wrap,self rising flour,sauce
title: Bite Size Brussels Sprouts Wraps
ingredients: 1 head fresh brussels sprout, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces ( can use frozen ) | 6 ounces small red cabbage | 1/4 cup fresh lemon zest | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup thinly sliced peaches | 16 small egg roll wraps
instructions: Prepare brussels sprouts, preheat oven to 400 degrees ferenhight. Remove outer leaves from cabbage.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,creole seasoning,snap pea,fine white breadcrumb,garlic,turkey
title: Tikka Noodles
ingredients: 1 bag snap peas ( regular or frozen ) | 1 lb lean ground turkey | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1/4 teaspoon garlic clove, minced | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 1/2 cups fine dry white breadcrumbs | creole seasoning, to taste | finely chopped garlic, to taste
instructions: Place snap peas in a large pot of cold water and bring to a boil until crisp tender.

title: Hank Aaron's Awoodeh
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb or 1 1/2 lbs pork, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 green pepper, medium, finely diced | 1 cup quinoa, long grain, unrefined
instructions: In a medium frying pan put the lamb and the pepper. Fry until the lamb is brown and the pepper soft. Stir in 1/4 cup of quinoa. Cover pan tightly and let it cook on very low heat for about 45 minutes without removing it from the heat. Remove lid from the pan and turn the heat up to medium. Add the remaining 1/4 cup of quinoa and stir well. Cover the dish and bring to a boil, then add the meat juices that have accumulated or the meat and cook for an additional 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Brussels Sprouts with Pimento Cheese
ingredients: 1 teaspoon margarine | 3 cups brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil leaves, or to taste | 4 cups crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Melt margarine in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in brussels sprouts.

title: The Easiest and Tastiest Kaffir Lime Marinade
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of mild prepared buttermilk | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon black peppercorns, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice ( spice hunter, spice hunter, d'auver )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl or a small bowl and mix well. This should be a thick paste or thick gravy. Place the keffir in a covered container to keep it fresh in the fridge. If using the spice Hunter spice mix, make it according to the package instructions and store it in its packet, in a cool dark cupboard. Note, this can be kept, refrigerated, for up to six months.

Random Ingredients: pasta,green enchilada sauce,pork chop,date,grainy mustard,jalapeno jack cheese,balsamic vinegar
title: Pork Chops and Cheese Nachos
ingredients: 8 -12 pork chops, cut 1/4 inch thick | 2 cups prepared pasta | 1 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/4 - 1/3 cup chopped pitted dates | 1 tablespoon chopped jalapeno jack cheese | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon grainy mustard
instructions: Boil chops for 5 minutes. While chops are boiling, brown chopped dates, chopped jalapeno jack cheese, and balsamic in a large skillet over medium heat till cheese is melted. Add chopped pork chops to the skillet with the cheese and dates. Drain chops, saving most of the broth. Toss to coat the chops, cheese mixture and the prepared pasta. Pour in the remaining white sauce or enchilada sauce. Stir until mixed well and heated through. Serve with mexican fiesta and corn bread.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,pork rib,corn syrup,veal,lemon zest,picante sauce,cream
title: Picante-Marinated Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 lb country-style pork ribs | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons grated lemon zest | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons veal fat or 3 tablespoons pork fat
instructions: Place ribs in a slow cooker. Mix all remaining ingredients and pour over the ribs. Cover and cook on low heat setting 5 to 6 hours or on high heat setting 4 to 5 hours, until meat is tender. Remove ribs from slow cooker and drain. Place on platter, spoon sauce over and serve at once on the side.

Random Ingredients: pickling spice,mango,cream tartar,cooking oil,spinach fettuccine,white bread
title: Spinach Fettuccine With Mango Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach fettuccine | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 ripe mangoes, cut into slices | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon pickling spice ( aromatic flavor, available at asian foods stores ) | white bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Cook and drain fettuccine until almost al dente. Drain and put in large bowl. Meanwhile, heat oil in skillet. Add mangoes and cook over medium heat until soft, about 3 minutes. Add tomato and blend into cooked fettuccine. Cook over medium low heat for 5 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: clove,chive,sea salt,dark rum,yellow bell pepper,yukon gold potato,beef bouillon granule,tomato soup
title: Brasato Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into long strips | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato soup, tomato-flavored | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules or 1 1/2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark rum or 1 1/2 teaspoons rum, rum-flavored | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon fresh chives, minced or 1 teaspoon dried chives | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place peppers on a foil lined baking sheet to form a single layer. Bake in an 425 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Rinse to cool and pat dry. Place on a baking sheet with side touching to oven rack to catch any drips. Roast in 425 degree oven until tender and lightly browned. Set peppers on a foil lined baking sheet to cool and begin stuffing them with the tomato soup, beef broth, rum and ground cloves. Sprinkle chives on top of each.

title: Quick and Easy Orzo
ingredients: 1 lb orzo pasta | 1 can beef stock | 1/4 cup orange peel
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine the beef stock and orange peel. Heat through but do not boil. When pasta is al dente, drain and quickly add to broth. Serve.

Random Ingredients: floury potato,icing sugar,corn syrup,chili pepper flake,crescent dinner,tomatillo
title: Chili Tomatillo Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large floury potatoes, about 20-25g | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 cup corn syrup | 2 teaspoons crushed chili pepper flakes | 375 g crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 small chili pepper ( red-sized )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Cut 2 large wedges from the core of the potato.

title: Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 2 ounces macadamia nuts | 3 ounces sugar snap peas | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Crush macadamia nuts with a pestle and food or fork. Rinse with warm water and allow to sit for ten minutes, drain and pat the nuts dry with paper towels. Slice the snap peas into short lengths. Whisk the whole egg yolks until thick and pale and fold into the nuts. Spread the mixture evenly on a small baking tray. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: blackberry,sunflower seed,part mozzarella cheese,dark chocolate,corn oil,green taco sauce
title: Wild and Fresh Blackberries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 cup fresh blackberries | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 8 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 can green taco sauce | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place sunflower seeds on a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven 5 to 7 minutes, until fragrant. Cool and coarsely chop. Set aside. Place blackberries in a blender or food processor. Drizzle in corn oil and process until completely pureed. Pour blackberry puree into a 1 quart baking dish. Pour taco sauce over the blackberry puree. Top with grated cheese. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes, until cheese is melted and the topping is bubbling. Serve hot, warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,monterey jack cheese,vanilla ice cream,mint,roquefort cheese,bamboo skewer
title: Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 package monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 package roquefort cheese, grated | 1 cup green pepper, diced | 1 cup fresh mint, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped | 24 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes | vanilla ice cream, for serving
instructions: For each serving, layer 1/2 of the monterey jack cheese, 2/3 cheese, green pepper, and 1/4 of the mint in 3 to 4 individual bowls. Top with additional monterey jack cheese. For each guest, serve a skewer of the remaining 3 cheeses on a skewer. Spoon about 1/4 cup of hot water over the top of the skewer in each bowl. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Toumai (Sweet Japanese Steamed Rice)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 8 cups sushi-style rice ( short grain rice such as nishiki ) | 1/8 cup dark brown sugar ( optional )
instructions: Place 1 - ¼ cups of water near bottom of an 8 - ½ x 4 inch deep nonstick saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in fennel seeds. Transfer to a bowl and let sit 5 minutes, then drain. Preheat grill to high. In a 1 quart saucepan, bring remaining 1 - ¼ cups water to a boil over high heat. Add uncooked rice and sugar, if using. Cover, reduce heat to medium low and simmer 30 minutes. Set aside and allow to steam undisturbed for 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork and serve.

title: Port Wine Roasted Potatoes and Mushrooms (Gluten Free)
ingredients: baking potatoes ( red potatoes ) | 8 ounces fresh porcini mushrooms | 6 ounces port wine | 2 teaspoons peppercorns
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Wash the potatoes and dry them on paper towels. Peel while still slightly warm, cut into large chunks and toss the with the cooking pan. Put them in a roasting tin, drizzle with some olive oil and bake in the oven for about 45 minutes, or until tender. Toss with the port and the peppercorns and let them rest for a couple of minutes. Serve with the roasted potatoes for an evening breakfast or at room temperature.

title: Crock Pot Easy Hamburger Marsala
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger, cooked | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/4 cup marsala wine, warmed
instructions: Spray crock pot with non stick cooking spray. Add all ingredients. Stir. Cover. Cook on cook for 8 - 10 hours or on high setting for 3 hours or until meat is tender & juicy. Serve over cooked spaghetti noodles or mashed potatoes or rice with cheese spread as a side dish..

Random Ingredients: red bean,bread crumb,coffee,golden raisin,chunky peanut butter
title: Sour Red Beans
ingredients: 2 cans red beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 2 tablespoons brown bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon coffee, or more to taste | 1/2 cup golden raisins, for garnish
instructions: Mix beans, peanut butter, bread crumb, and coffee together in a bowl. Fold in raisins. Chill in the refrigerator 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: basil sprig,russet potato,ricotta cheese,tomato sauce,dark sesame oil,lentil,grape tomato,water chestnut
title: Potato Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, cut in 1 1/4 dice | 2 cans water chestnuts, drained and sliced | 4 vine-ripe grape tomatoes, washed, halved and seeded | 3/4 cup dry lentils, rinsed | 1 carton low fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 fresh basil sprigs | 1 can tomato sauce ( with basil seasoning added if desired )
instructions: Cook russet potatoes in boiling water until just tender, about 12 minutes. Cool. Combine water chestnuts and tomatoes and refrigerate 5 minutes. Drain water chestnuts, tomatoes and leaved potatoes. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dried white beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup green onion, chopped | 1/2 cup dry sherry, if desired | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Soak beans overnight, then drain well and place into a 4 quart slow cooker. Heat oil in a small skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir green onions and sherry in the oil until bubbly. Pour sauce around beans and stir. Pour half and half into slow cooker, stir and cover with lid. Set slow cooker to low and cook 9 to 11 hours until beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: savory,cold water,red pepper,cardamom pod,plain yogurt,quinoa,peanut butter,mozzarella cheese
title: Crispy Yogurt Rice Balls
ingredients: 1/4 cup cold water | 1 cup cooked quinoa, rinsed well | 1/2 cup grated mozzarella cheese or 1/2 cup provolone cheese | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 2 teaspoons dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Whisk first 5 ingredients together in medium bowl. Roll into 1 inch balls. Spray large nonstick skillet generously with cooking spray. Add rice balls to skillet.

title: Lasagna Rollups
ingredients: 15 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 2 cups pizza sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large pot of boiling water, cook lasagna until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain. Arrange 1 lasagna noodle at a time on a cutting board. With a long knife, make an x shape in the upper half of the noodle and down one side of the pasta to form a 1/2 inch wide. Roll from the x toward the bottom and let rest 10 minutes. Spread 1/2 cup of pizza sauce evenly over each lasagna roll. Arrange seam side down on a baking sheet. Drizzle with remaining pizza sauce. Bake 20 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: grape juice,coleslaw,pak choi,corn chip,cheese,white vinegar,phyllo pastry,soybean
title: Filipino Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup soybeans, soaked until soft | 1/4 cup grape juice | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets | 1 cup kraft coleslaw, shredded | 8 cups coleslaw | 10 ounces frozen cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 8 -12 sheets frozen corn chips
instructions: Drain excess liquid from soybeans. Stir in grape juice and vinegar. Lay 1 sheet of phyllo out on counter. Coat with cooking spray for easier cutting. Place 1/2 sheet on top. Repeat with last 3 sheets, brushing each with cooking spray. On the last sheet, place 1/2 cabbage and 1 cup coleslaw, then 1/2 cheese. Carefully fold one last sheet on top of the first, brushing each with cooking spray. Cut into 3 triangles or rectangles. Repeat with remaining sheets, placing each on a lightly covered plate. Bake at 450 for 10 minutes or until crisp and golden brown, crisp and heated through. Garnish with remaining coleslaw.

title: Grape Tomato
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh grape tomatoes | 1 lemongrass | 1/2 lb boneless pork loin
instructions: Wash the tomatoes and lemongrass and cut them into slices. Pound the pork with the flat of a cleaver or a cleaver with a cleaver blade. Put them into a mortar with 1/4 cup of the water, just to bruise them, and add the remaining 1/2 cup water, along with 1/2 the salt and 1/2 the lemonmongrass and pounding, pounding with a spoon as you go, until the mixture will produce a soft purée. Put the mixture in a saucepan, bring it to a boil over a high heat and boil it for 40 minutes. Put the mixture into a bowl, cover it with aluminium foil and place it in the refrigerator for 1/2 hour to ferment. Remove the mixture from the fridge 15 minutes before using. The mixture can be kept up to 2 days in the refrigerator or longer if you leave it overnight. Press the mixture through a sieve or cheesecloth, pressing on the purée with the fingers, and place it in a clean, dry frying pan. Make sure the top layer of purée is covered by water.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,chicken wing,sea salt,heavy cream,cardamom,chicken breast half,italian breadcrumb
title: Pannu Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 cup cake flour | 2 tablespoons dry italian breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 2 teaspoons chicken wings, cooked and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degree f. Lay all the chicken breast halves, skin side down, into a 9x13 baking dish. Combine 1/2 cup bread crumbs, 1/4 cup flour, 2 tablespoons seasoned bread crumbs, cardamom, 2 tablespoons sea salt, and 2 teaspoons sea salt in a metal bowl. Dip each chicken breast half into seasoned crumbs, then coat well. Repeat, placing pieces on plastic wrap, for one breast half at a time, then place onto baking pan. Spread remaining 1/2 cup bread crumb mixture, top with remaining chicken breast half, and season lightly with salt. Bake in preheated oven until crumbs have turned pale golden, and chicken is cooked through, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,turkey pepperoni,turkey breast,vinegar,dashi stock,ginger garlic paste
title: Turkey Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/4 lb thinly sliced turkey breast | 1/8 lb sliced turkey pepperoni | 1 tablespoon diced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 packages dashi stock | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 teaspoon vinegar or 1 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Add the dashi and ginger garlic paste to a large, fry pan, cook turkey until cooked through. Remove from pan and slice. Cook pepperoni and turkey pieces in pan, stirring a few times, until crisp and no pink remains, drain on paper towel and sprinkle with a little more ginger pepper paste. Add tomatoes, green chilies, and vinegar and stir. Cook for a few minutes just to heat through, if mixture is dry. Spoon over rice, enjoy.

title: Acapulco Dessert
ingredients: 2 packets mini marshmallows | 1/2 cup light corn syrup ( not corn syrup ) | 1 tablespoon red chili powder, or to taste
instructions: Place marshmallows and corn syrup in small bowl. Mix until smooth. Dip marshmallow halves into mixture, coating both sides. Place into a 9x13 inch baking dish or muffin tin. Drizzle with cooking spray. Sprinkle with chile powder to taste.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,meat,brandy,garam masala powder,active yeast,chicken bouillon granule,slab bacon,cheddar cheese
title: Bacon and Brandy Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups chicken bouillon granules | 2 cups very warm water | 3 pounds shredded, cooked meat, or to taste | 2 tablespoons kosher salt, or to taste | 1 tablespoon kosher salt, or to taste | 1/4 pound coarsely chopped slab bacon, diced | 1 brick cheddar cheese, cut into thick 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder, or to taste
instructions: Place the bouillon granules into a 2 quart bowl with an opening large enough to fit the meatballs inches fill the bowl with the warm water, and stir the granules until dissolved. Place the salt in a small bowl, and stir the salt into the water. Set aside. Place shredded pork into a large saucepan over medium heat, and cook, stirring constantly, until evenly browned. Drain. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. When the meatballs have cooled, remove and discard the meat from the liquid in the bowl. Place the meat into a cheese cloth, and squeeze out as much moisture as possible. Stir in the salt, bacon, cheese, garam masala, and enough water to moisten the cheese.

title: Canadian Bacon and Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 12 ounces medium egg noodles | 12 slices canadian bacon
instructions: Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Add egg noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,green chili,dark rum,marinade,sage leaf,oriental sesame oil
title: Rice Vermicelli Con Sesame (Greens on the Skewers)
ingredients: 1/2 lb rice vermicelli, broken into 6 to 8 long strips | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 20 fresh sage leaves | 4 green chili ( seeded and chopped ) | 1/4 cup rum or 1/4 cup light rum | 2 tablespoons green chili paste with garlic added ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons marinade or 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Soak 2 bamboo skewers in water for 5 minutes. Remove and discard stems from chilis and cut chilis in half. Place the soaked chilis and soaked vermicelli in a large serving bowl and cover with lukewarm water for 30 minutes. Drain the sesame oil from the chilis into a small saucepan and cook over medium heat until hot. Remove from the heat and let cool. Drain the cooked rice vermicelli noodles, then transfer to a clean bowl. Add the rum or light rum to the noodles and mix well. Toss with the chilli paste. Add the noodles to the bowl and toss to coat. Serve immediately, or chill for at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,egg wrapper,salsa,parsnip,quinoa,plum tomato,self raising flour,beef brisket
title: Beef and Spanish Noodles With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1 beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 jar prepared salsa | 1 egg roll wrap | 1 small parsnip, washed and chunked | 1 plum tomato, washed, seeded, and diced small | 4 drops lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Combine the quinoa and 1/4 cup cold water in a saucepan. Bring to the boil, cover, remove from heat and let stand for 20 minutes until water has been absorbed. Coat brisket with cooking spray and set aside. Place flour in a large bowl and add the brisket. Make a well in the center and add salsa and mix until well blended. Remove brisket from salsa and put aside. Lightly spray meat with cooking spray and spread flour mixture across the brisket with your hands to cover. Cover and refrigerate for at least 18 to 20 minutes, turning brisket occasionally. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove brisket from salsa and place on a foil covered baking sheet. Spoon salsa onto flat surface and place brisket on top. Using a rolling pin roll brisket to roughly flatten brisket about 2/3 of the way to the size of a large marble. Spread quinoa on a tray and spread evenly with the back of a wooden spoon. Make a layer of spiced quinoa over the brisket. Repeat with remaining brisket, salsa, parsnip and tomatoes. Cut slits in the brisket with a sharp knife about 1 1/2 to 2 inches deep across and 2 inches deep to allow steam to escape. Bake brisket 40 - 45 minutes, or until cooked through. If sauce starts to burn, cover loosely with foil as is necessary for the first 20 to 30 minutes. Remove brisket from oven and pour off remaining sauce. Serve with the chips and your favorite veggie.

title: Raspberry Broccoli
ingredients: 300 g broccoli, florets only | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 400 g raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Cut the stalks from the broccoli and set aside. Place the defrosted broccoli in a roasting tin. Sprinkle flour over the broccoli and roast for 15 - 20 minutes until the broccoli is tender and starting to colour a little.

title: Vegetable Soup with Dill Weed
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | cooking spray
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, stir together the turmeric and vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer to blend flavors. Stir in dill weed to taste and continue cooking until dill is soft.

title: Cheesy Port Wine Dip (Rajas Da Serra)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons of a mexican cheese blend, shredded ( i use a low fat and high fat blend, so i just add more ) | 1/2 cup port wine or 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Put cheese in a small bowl, stir in dry cheese. Put in bowl and press for a few minutes before putting in oven to warm up while making any dip for fish, other salads and salads. This makes a great snack.

title: Bamboo Shoot Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 bay leaf | 200 g canned bamboo shoots, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add bay leaf and bamboo shoots, and cook for a few minutes, until bamboo shoots are hot.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,tomato sauce,adobo seasoning,cornmeal,red bell pepper,southern comfort,cocoa powder
title: Randy's Spicy Mexican Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 4 tablespoons powdered adobo seasoning | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons southern comfort | 3 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Whisk together the cornmeal, adobo seasoning, tomato sauce, cocoa powder, and bell pepper in a 9x5 inch baking dish.

title: Ouzo-Greek Ouzo Cake
ingredients: 1/2 liter apple juice ( use juice from canned apple ) | 1/8 liter ouzo ( a little less, if you can find it ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Blend well and pour into a greased rectangular cake tin – it should be about 1/2 cm in diameter. Bake at 190 ° centigrade until golden brown. Pour ouzo onto cake when cool. Serve with fresh berries.

title: Olive Garden' own Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup bread, finely chopped | 1/4 cup ground almonds ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 teaspoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond essence | 1 teaspoon salt pepper | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: In med saucepan on stove, toast your chopped bread until light brown around the edges. Turn off heat.. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Let sit for 15 minutes or so to allow flavors to marry. Toss with hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: chocolate wafer cookie,leek,anise seed,fish sauce,sirloin steak,lamb,plain yogurt
title: Chinese Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut to 1-inch cubes | leek, white part only, sliced lengthwise | 2 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons raw peanuts or 2 tablespoons cashews, coarsely chopped | 6 chocolate wafer cookies, crushed, crushed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, fish sauce, and anise.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,black eyed pea,queso fresco,peanut oil vegetable,purpose flour
title: Mexican Green Eyed Pea Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon queso fresco ( mexican feta cheese ), crumbled | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon salted peanuts or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, such as canola
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the flour, buttermilk and cheese. Stir in the peas, adding a little water if necessary. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Drop tablespoonfuls of the mixture into the hot oil and fry, turning once, until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes.

title: French Corn Bake
ingredients: 2 cups frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt, divided | 1/3 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f in medium bowl, stir together corn, cheese, and 1 teaspoon seasoning salt. Transfer to ungreased 11x7 inch glass baking dish. Top with corn mixture. Sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon seasoning salt. Sprinkle with swiss cheese. Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,cake flour,hash brown,marinara sauce,barbecue sauce,quinoa
title: Curried Sweet Potato Squash
ingredients: 2 cups instant mashed potatoes | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 1/2 cups dry quinoa | 2 cups marinara sauce | barbecue sauce | 1/3 cup cake flour
instructions: Brown quinoa in microwave. Sprinkle curry powder over potatoes and cook for 3 minutes on high. Stir in quinoa, then continue cooking on high for 3 - 2 - 3 minutes, or until most of the liquid is absorbed. Remove from microwave and fluff together with fork. Meanwhile, combine marinara sauce, cake flour, and barbecue sauce in a saucepan and heat. Once dry ingredients have blended, pour over potatoes and mix well. Serve warm.

title: Cabbage Tacos #A1
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, finely shredded | 7 ounces chipotle powder
instructions: Wash, core, and shred the cabbage. Place the shredded cabbage in a frying pan with about 1/2 the chipotle powder on top of it, cook until it starts to turn brown, then remove from heat and stir in the remaining chipotle powder. Serve in a taco shell with tortillas, shredded lettuce, salsa, sliced avocados, etc.

title: Chicken Legs and Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried anise seeds | 3 pounds chicken legs
instructions: Place the pinto beans, oregano, and anise seed in a large stockpot. Add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook over medium heat for 1 hour. Place the chicken legs into a pot of boiling water, and continue to cook until the chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 45 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Remove chicken legs to a large bowl, and shred into bite sized pieces using two forks. When cool enough to handle, drain thoroughly, and place in the bowl with the soup. Cover, and cook over medium heat until flavors mesh and flavors blend, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,chicken bouillon,sesame oil,fish sauce,alfredo sauce,saffron
title: Thai Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 7 cups cooked spaghetti | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 cup of saffron | 1 cup alfredo sauce | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 5 tablespoons tomato sauce
instructions: In a small pot mix together bouillon, saffron, alfredo sauce, salt and sesame oil. Heat over a low heat until boiling. Lower heat and let simmer for 20 minutes, stirring regularly. Cook spaghetti as directed on package. When pasta is cooked, drain and reserve. Add sauce mixture back to pot and cook until heated through. Add cooked spaghetti and toss well so the pasta is coated with the sauce. Enjoy.

title: Fajita Pizza Crust Meal Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 tablespoon light rum | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon light rum
instructions: Mix flour, taco sauce, rum, cumin seed in a bowl. Roll out dough to desired thickness, using 1/2 for the crust and 1/2 for the filling. Top with other half cup dough for a rimmed pizza. Bake at 450°, about 12 - 14 minutes, or until light gold in color and a hollow sounding sound comes through the middle when it's tapped. Let cool for 2 minutes, then slice into desired size squares, then store in an airtight container.

title: Spiced Lamb Shank
ingredients: 3 kg lamb shanks | 1 liter oil ( for deep frying ) | 240 g cake flour | 3 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 red capsicum, chopped | 1 teaspoon cardamom, powder
instructions: Pour oil into a deep pan or wok until the oil is 1 cm deep and the oil is just smoking. Season lamb shanks well with the cardamom powder and salt and place in the oil, a few at a time, frying until golden brown on both sides. Remove and drain, cover with foil to keep warm. Add capsicum to the oil and fry until it is softened and slightly crisped. Add flour to the oil, beat well and add the remaining oil. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes. Add cardamom powder to the mixture and toss for one minute. Arrange lamb shanks in a large ovenproof dish and pour the curry over and return covered to the oven for 90 minutes to 1 hour or until tender and cooked through. If the gravy is not thick enough, add hot water. Serve with steamed rice and curries or your favourite vegetable.

title: Island  Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar | 3 tablespoons thousand island dressing
instructions: Add brown sugar to dressing and heat over a low medium heat until sugar is melted. Cool before you use it.

title: Sweet Basil Beans
ingredients: 4 cans cannellini beans | 1 package white sugar | 3 maraschino cherries, sliced
instructions: Place the beans together in a saucepan and fill with enough water to cover the beans. Bring to a boil, and cook uncovered until tender. Drain well. Transfer beans to a large serving bowl, and sprinkle the sugar over. Top with the maraschino cherries to serve.

title: Bourbon-Scented Buns
ingredients: 1 cup cold water | 1/4 cup bourbon
instructions: Put water and bourbon into a blender and blend for about 1 minute. Place the mixture into one 16 ounce glass bottle. Fill glass two thirds full with ice cubes.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,pearl barley,molasses,italian cheese,chocolate pudding mix,miracle whip,plain flour
title: Spinach & Barley Parfait
ingredients: 400 g butternut squash, cut deseeded and cut | 100 g plain flour | 2 cups pearl barley ( aka chickpea ) | 3 tablespoons mixed dried molasses | 250 g italian cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons miracle whip | 250 g instant chocolate pudding mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas mark put 1 tbsp of oil in an oven proof baking dish. Brush with 1tsp of the olive oil. Place potato in the oven and bake for 45 - 60 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile put remaining oil, flour, molasses and chickpeas in a pot. Cook. Remove, stir and set aside. Remove the zest of the squash and cut in half lengthways. Put zest back into potato and mash, ensuring there are no big chunks and that the seeds stay closed. Mix together in the pot the flour and butter and stir until the butter is melted and the mixture starts to come together. Add the 1 tbsp of butter/olive oil to the potato mixture and stir well with the mixer until smooth. To make this parfait, spread half the mix onto the bottom of a 2 1/2 inch size baking dish and spread onto top evenly. Top with remaining mix and bake for 15 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes. When cool, mix it with the chocolate pudding. Cut in squares. Top with chopped cilantro or parsley to serve.

Random Ingredients: red wine,eggplant,green chili pepper,mango chutney,green pea,seasoning,cornflour
title: Spicy Baked Pea Patties
ingredients: 2 large eggsplants | 3 green chili peppers ( deseeded and finely chopped ) | 60 g green peas | 40 g sweet mango chutney | seasoning | 2 tablespoons red wine | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Wash and cut the eggplants in half length ways. Then slice the halves lengthways. To make a patty, lay the eggplants on a baking tray and cover with a damp kitchen towel. Place in a preheated oven and turn up the temperature under the grill for 5 mins and then turn them over and continue to cook for a further 5 mins until they are tender and soft. Meanwhile, heat the chili peppers, green pea pods and sweet mango chutney in a pan. Lightly season with seasoning. Stir in the red wine. Heat through and then mix in the cornflour and mix thoroughly. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly before sprinkling the cooled eggplants with the mix.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,egg yolk,red wine vinegar,sesame seed,mace,extra beef,baking soda,white bread flour
title: Oven Baked Sesame Meatloaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef ( about 85 % lean ) | 1 medium egg yolk | 1/2 cup white bread flour | 1/4 cup extra dry red wine vinegar | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line 2 large rimmed cookie sheets with parchment paper. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat. Add beef and sauté until very well browned, breaking into 1/2 inch pieces with fork. Drain fat from meat, return beef to skillet and add egg yolk and simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes. In bowl, mix flour, red wine vinegar, vinegar, baking soda and mace. Slowly add flour mixture to meat mixture stirring until completely combined. Spread in a 9 inch round on prepared cookie sheets, sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake meat loaf for 20 minutes, or until cooked through. My note, in a big skillet with plenty of oil, heat over medium heat. Add meat loaf and bake in oven for 1 hour. The only thing i changed is to brown the meat loaf in the middle, turn the meat and bake in an oven at 350f for a 1 1/2 hours. Then the wine vinegar was too salty. I also think this would also be great with rice or noodles cooked over medium heat, or with a salad.

title: Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 red chili pepper, diced | 1/2 fresh mild chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 jar taco sauce | jalapeno chile, optional, for a hotter salsa
instructions: Combine ingredients in a medium sized bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Guacamole Stuffed Shells (Huevos Rancheros)
ingredients: 12 large seasoned medium pasta shells | 1 pound cubed lamb meat | 1 jar guacamole | 1 package crumbled goat cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the pasta, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and pat dry with paper towels. Cook lamb in a large skillet over medium high heat until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.

title: Hazelnut Biscotti
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white flour | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc in a large bowl, sift the flour and hazelnuts together. Using a wooden spoon add the flour a little at a time until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Turn onto a greased baking tray. Using your hands form the dough into small balls. Place onto a lightly greased oven tray. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes until the surface appears dry and the loaf is firm to the touch. Remove from the oven and transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Cut diagonally 1 inch slices and serve.

title: Spiced Cherry Chips
ingredients: 30 cherry, halved | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 chipotle chile, seeded | aluminum foil, for the aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Divide the cherries amongst 2 ovenproof serving dishes. Sprinkle with parsley. Sprinkle with chipotles. Roast in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until the cherry has darkened and softened. Let cool to room temperature. Break off small pieces of the plastic with your fingers just enough to make a small pouch. Use a fork to press them into the chips to set up a little crispness. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,double cream,hamburger,curry powder,apple cider vinegar,beef brisket,cannellini bean,tequila
title: Cassic Beef and Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2/3 cup whole meal bread flour | 1/3 cup double cream | 4 tablespoons tequila | 2 tablespoons potato starch or 2 tablespoons rice flour | 1 beef brisket, with bone | 1 teaspoon good curry powder | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 fresh apple, in 6 chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f coat a 2 quart/2 to 3 quart/1 quart casserole dish with no stick cooking spray and set aside. Combine dry ingredients and set aside. Slice brisket across the grain into 1/2 inch wide slices. Toss brisket with curry powder and coat. Add to dry. Stir in apple chunks and any other filling ingredients. If mixture comes off the side of brisket, you can use a spoon or fork, and push down with a finger to pack mixture in tight. Cover and bake. Bake approximately 1 hour.

title: Creamy Low Fat Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat soymilk ( or 100 ml plain soymilk may be used ) | 1 lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine the soymilk and strained water in a small bowl. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Strain and discard the soy milk. Place lettuce leaves on baking sheets or pizza trays. Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat, pour in about 1 tablespoons of yogurt. Tear out a handful of lettuce leaves and scatter around the pan, then top with 2 teaspoons of the yogurt. Spread to taste with more yogurt, and serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Italian Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs chuck roast | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/2 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in crockery cooker. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Shred with two forks.

title: Sweet Potato Chips With Chilli
ingredients: 8 sweet potatoes, scrubbed and sliced in half ( around 1.5 cm ) | 2 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | cayenne ( as much as you prefer )
instructions: Melt the ghee in a frying pan over medium/high heat. Add the potatoes and fry on both sides until golden brown. Transfer to an oven proof dish, then sprinkle with a little freshly ground black pepper, as desired, then place in a preheated oven on 200c for 10 - 15 minutes, until potatoes are cooked through. Allow to cool slightly, then transfer to a serving dish. Drizzle with the fish sauce, then sprinkle with any ground chilli. Serve immediately.

title: Raspberry and Pepper Sticks (Raspberry Bombs)
ingredients: 24 frozen raspberries ( preferably sizeable ones ) | 1/3 cup nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 -2 fresh chili pepper, finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 -3 toothpicks, crushed lightly | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet sherry, for drizzling ( optional )
instructions: Place raspberries into a medium bowl. Combine remaining ingredients in a separate small bowl and add to raspberries. Stir well. Tear off 24 small raspberries from the frozen raspberries and add to the bowl. Stir well. Cover and let rest to thaw. Preferably leave a few raspberries on the raspberries to keep them refrigerated. Fill 2 pint size jar 2/3 full with the raspberries and place rims side down in a large pan filled with gently simmering water to a depth of 1/4 inches. Place a 1 to 2 tablespoon of the prepared sweet sherry if desired over the raspberries.. Cover the pan and simmer gently over low heat for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove rims and tighten screw on rings. Place a toothpick in the hole of each raspberry and squeeze out the excess juice. Serve warm, with a small slotted spoon dipped in a little sherry or honey on the side of each raspberry. Note, sometimes i add a little extra sherry and some cinnamon to the raspberry juice to make a drizzling of some of the juice on the raspberries.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,nutella,bean thread noodle,chili sauce,brandy,confectioner sugar,dark rum
title: Randy's Infamous Bahama Mama's Noodles
ingredients: 1 package fine sea salt | 2/3 package bean thread noodles | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce or 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon light rum
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the fine sea salt, then stir in the bean thread noodles and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, but still slightly firm, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Dump the noodles into a bowl and add the dark rum, brandy, sweet chili sauce, and confectioners' sugar. Toss well to coat. Serve warm, or refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes about 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: kohlrabi bulb,cranberry,parmesan cheese,ginger garlic paste,taco seasoning mix,buttermilk
title: Yummy Korean Grilled Kohlrabi
ingredients: 2 packages kohlrabi bulbs, trimmed | 2 containers buttermilk | 1 package taco seasoning mix, divided | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, or to taste
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat. Lightly oil grill grate. Arrange kohlrabi halves, cut side down, on the grill.

title: Indian Fish Patties
ingredients: 1 lb ground fish | 2 russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped | 2 tablespoons garlic granules, minced | 1/4 cup black olives, halved | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 4 slices bread, toasted and crumbs
instructions: In large bowl combine fish, potatoes, coriander, garlic, olives and yogurt. Shape mixture into 4 patties. Sprinkle bread crumbs on each. Preheat grill. Grill patties about 10 minutes, turning once, until well browned and fish is cooked through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,bok choy,garlic juice,grain rice,lamb stock,cayenne pepper
title: Green Rice With Lamb and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups cooked short-grain rice | 1 cup lamb stock | 1 tablespoon garlic juice ( bottled, bottled ) | 1 -2 dash cayenne pepper ( to taste ) | 2 large bok choy | 1 tablespoon freshly grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Wash and drain rice as directed on package and set aside. Wash and trim vegetables as directed. Boil stock and reserved rice for 5 minutes. Then, rinse lamb pieces. Slice off any excess fat and place them in the stock and rice. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes or until the rice and meat are tender. Mix the garlic juice with the cayenne pepper until well blended. Just before serving stir the bok choy into rice. Garnish with pecorino romano.

title: Soused Lobster Barley Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm white fish, such as lobster, shrimp or 1 1/2 lbs lobster | 1 1/3 1 1/3 lbs rhubarb or 1 1/3 lbs spinach, stems removed and leaves cleaned | 1/4 cup rice or 1/4 cup short-grain rice | 1/4 cup quick-cooking barley or 1/4 cup barley | 1/4 cup mexican-style tomatoes, drained | 25 large lobsters, preferably in shells | 1/4 cup snipped salted peanuts
instructions: Cut a piece of waxed paper or baking parchment if using lobster and pound it or shrimp down so the claws are 1/2 inch thick and claws curl at the top. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. Chop fish in 1 1/2 inch cubes or small bites. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Cut spinach in half lengthwise. Separate leaves and shred coarsely. In a heavy 6 - 7 quart saucepan, combine rice, barley and tomatoes. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes. In a small nonreactive bowl, mash together lobster meat or shrimp, salted peanuts and parsley. Transfer mixture to small bowl, reserve marinade. Rinse shrimp and lobster shells. Remove meat/shrooms from shells and add to bowl of marinade. Add lobster meat/shrooms, shrimp meat or shrimp/shrimp mixture and cook 3 minutes over high heat, stirring quickly to prevent sticking. Reduce heat to low.

title: Melon Ice Cubes
ingredients: 1/2 melon, yielding about 1 1/2 cups | 1 cup cantaloupe, yielding about 1 cup | 1 large hard-boiled egg, about | 1/2 bunch fresh mint leaves
instructions: Peel melon and cut into chunks, removing any pulp or seeds. Chop coarsely in a food processor.. Transfer melon chunks to a large bowl and set aside. Place cantaloupe, egg slices, mint leaves and reserved melon mixture in a mortar. Knead mixture until smooth. Transfer melon mixture to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,monterey jack cheese,balsamic vinegar,cornflour,linguine,serrano pepper,daikon radish,ice
title: Pasta With a Madriy Pickle
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 4 ounces linguine | 1 1/2 cups sliced daikon radishes | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 pinch granulated garlic | 1/3 cup grated monterey jack cheese | pickled serrano peppers or regular serrano pepper, for garnish
instructions: Soak quinoa in slightly salted water overnight to bring out the starch. The next day, drain and rinse quinoa. Bring water to boil and add quinoa. Stir to prevent water from clumping. Cover and reduce heat to low. Cook for 50 minutes or until quinoa grains are tender and all of the water has been absorbed. Remove from heat and stir in radishes, cornflour, vinegar, and garlic. Place in serving bowl and sprinkle with cheese. Garnish with peppers.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,red bell pepper,seltzer water,thai fish sauce,puff pastry,potato starch
title: Thai Sweet Potato Samosas
ingredients: 4 sweet potatoes | 1 tablespoon fresh lemongrass | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons potato starch | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons seltzer water
instructions: Boil potatoes for approx 5 minutes. While the potato is cooking, trim away and discard root and leaves/s. Peel cooked sweet potato, and mash well adding lemon grass, red pepper, potato starch, fish sauce, and seltzer. Strain the potato/mushroom mix through a fine sieve, and pat dry with paper towel. Cut the pastry into rectangles approx 12 x 10. Wet the edges of a pastry bag with seltzer water, then shape this to make a sausage shape, leaving a 1 in. Longest end. Cut each sausage on the diagonal, cutting through to make 6 triangles. Heat a nonstick pan and spray with nonstick spray. Put 4 samosas into the hot pan and cook on one side for 1 - 2 minutes, or until golden brown, then turn over and repeat until all are browned. The last 3 samosas should be a nice golden brown color, and should sound slightly hollow when you remove them from the pan.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,seashell pasta,hot chili sauce,orange marmalade,white sugar,anaheim chilies
title: Fried White Chilies With Soya Sauce
ingredients: 6 hot red chili peppers | 4 ounces dried asparagus chilies | 4 whole white sugar cubes | 8 egg yolks | 1 jar orange marmalade | 6 ounces hot chili sauce
instructions: Cut chilies lenghtwise and open, leaving stems and seeds. Blanch in boiling water for 5 seconds. Drain, rinse, and pat dry with paper towels. Cut into thin strips. Wrap 1 1/2 to 2 strips around each chile and insert sugar cubes in center of chili. Place egg yolks in a sauce pan, and bring to a hard boil. Gradually beat hot yolks into egg, pour in hot sauce and stir, set aside. Place chilies in a deep skillet that has been coated with cooking spray. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes until they darken. Stir the chilies occasionally so they don't burn and cook 10 minutes more. Remove chili strips from sauce. Serve right away.

title: Barbecue Wings (Caribbean Style)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings ( or combination of chicken wings and chicken wings ) | 1 cup chopped banana pepper or 1 cup sweet red pepper
instructions: Place banana peppers and peanuts in to a shallow dish. Place chicken in dish and cover with banana/pepper mixture.

title: Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup chopped cashews | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the soup, rice wine, cashews and flour. Fold in the chicken. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Transfer chicken mixture to 2 ungreased 2x2 inch baking pans. Bake in the preheated oven 30 to 40 minutes, or until chicken is golden brown.

title: Beetroot Puree
ingredients: 4 large beets, with greens | 1 cream of mushroom soup | 10 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 dash ground spice | thyme, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f/200c. Wash the greens, and slice very thinly. Place them in a large oven dish. Heat the cream and add the veg. Season with salt, pepper and spices. Pour over the beetroot puree. Bake uncovered for about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,cashew,savoy cabbage,brown rice,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chinese Coleslaw
ingredients: coleslaw mix ( i use kohlrabi or napa cabbage when i have it on hand for me ) | 125 g cashews ( roughly ) | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/3 cup vegetable oil ( cooking spray or other oil may be used ) | 2 cups savoy cabbage ( or more, depending on desired size of cabbage )
instructions: Wash and dry cabbage. Slice cabbage very thinly and place them in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Note, if preferred, toss everything again after adding cabbage and/or cashews.

title: Baked Wheat
ingredients: 2 cups cracked wheat | 4 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 teaspoons ground black or green cardamom pods
instructions: Place cracked wheat in a large bowl and cover with 3/4 cup cold water. Leave in the bowl overnight. Drain and place cracked wheat in a large bowl. Rub butter over cracked wheat, sprinkle over ground black or green cardamom, and mix well. Spread butter mixture on top or on silpat and bake at 325 to 325 degrees f for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Canadian Bacon-Sticks with Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1/4 cup canadian bacon, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 2 pork tenderloins
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the canadian bacon and the canadian bacon. Place the tenderloins on a baking sheet and sprinkle them with the canadian bacon. Bake them on lowest position in microwave until cooked through, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Greek Yogurt Waffles
ingredients: 2 whole egg whites, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3/4 - 1 cup greek yogurt, to taste | lemon juice
instructions: Place eggs in a medium bowl. Sprinkle vanilla on eggs, then whisk in yogurt. Place egg/yogurt mixture on pan, or griddle over medium heat. Cook until top surface is dry and a knife enters through center, about 4 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Salad (Vegan)
ingredients: 6 medium bananas | 1/2 liter roasted green pumpkin or 100 g canned pumpkin | 200 g mixed peas | 100 g sliced pea pods | 0.5 vegetable bouillon cubes ( i use maggi ) or 2 cinnamon stick | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | syrup
instructions: Wash the pumpkin and leave to cook in plenty of water. Cut off the root ends and remove all traces of the black pulp. Remove the seeds and the pith. Place the pumpkin in a pan with a splash of oil and 2 sticks of cinnamon and some salt. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Leave to cook on low heat. Peel the bananas and cut into small cubes. Cut the prawns into small pieces, boil for 5 minutes and drain. Rinse the peas and add to the pan. Cover and leave to cook on low heat all the time. While doing this, place the veg in a large bowl or pan. Add the mixed peas and 4 to 5 pea pods in and mix until heated through. Remove the cinnamon sticks. Add the cumin and mix well. Serve on warm plates.

title: Italian Pork Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, about 1 1/2 lbs | 2/3 cup walnuts, chopped | 1/4 cup dried basil leaves, torn | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/3 cup shredded fontina cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Remove the giblets from the roast, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Layer it in a single layer in a large bowl. Mix remaining ingredients together in a small bowl until well mixed.

title: Fiesta Limeade
ingredients: 2 large yucca root | 1 lime, juice of | 1 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Scrub yuca. Slice in 1/2 inch thick rounds with a long edge knife or your thumb. Place in crockpot and add the lime juice. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Add more or less of desired taste.

title: Chinese-Style Peanuts
ingredients: 250 g fresh salted peanuts | 1/2 piece preserved crystallized apple ( in natural juice ) | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1 pinch palm sugar ( optional )
instructions: Place peanuts, preserved apple slices and sugar in food processor and process until peanuts are well mixed.

title: Crock Pot Easy Yellow Pea Barley Cakes #1
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split peas ( frozen ) | 4 slices firm white breadcrumbs | 4 cups pearl barley
instructions: Put peas in crock pot. Add breadcrumbs. Top with barley. Cook on high for 20 minutes or low for 2 hours.

title: Vegetable Ranchera
ingredients: 300 g firm tofu | 1/2 liter medium grain short grain pasta, such as fettuccine | 6 -7 cloves | 5 -6 fresh small clusters or 1 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Pierce the tofu with 3 or 2 small, sharp, pointed cuts. Leave it in a microwave for five minutes in a microwave dish so it sweats off oil. Heat a frypan, on top of stove, on medium low and lightly spray with some oil. When its surface starts to puff up, put a few cloves in it. Leave it to heat through just enough to sizzle a little. Turn it over, leave some residue on the top, leave everything to cook through now. When it starts to get crisp, drain thoroughly on paper towel, and keep warm in a low oven. Cook the pasta according to directions on the packet. Add the tofu to the pasta, add your clove, pour over a little more water if the pasta seems dry. Serve hot drizzled with oil and a sprinkling of crushed red pepper flakes if desired.

title: Potato Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs baking potatoes | 1 roasting chickens, cut up | 2 slices of thick sliced hamburger
instructions: Peel the potatoes. Cut into chunks about 1 1/2 x 3 1/4 wide. Boil the chicken, drain the water from it and put it in as a stew pot. Add about 3 tablespoons salt and plenty of freshly ground black pepper. Put the meat on low until it falls off the bone, about two hours.. Remove the meat and set it aside until cool enough to handle. Remove some of the fat from the pot, then slice off the dark colored bits of meat and add them to the pot as the meat was cooked. Dice the meat into 1 1/2 cubes and add to the pot. Cover and let it cook for another 30 - 60 minutes. If you find the potatoes to be too thick and too dry, add more water to the pot to make it the consistency you like. You can even add up to 20 more potatoes if you like your stew a little thinner. Stir well and simmer slowly for an hour and a half to two hours, stirring gently every 15 minutes for even distribution, until potatoes are almost soft. You can either eat it whole or cut up in small bite size chunks and serve it as is, or you can do any other stew to feed a family or as a main dish. If serving as part of an antipasto dinner party, it just takes about 20 minutes to cook.

title: Green Bean, Chicken, and Sun-Dried Tomato Loaf
ingredients: 1 envelope sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 6 cups green beans, trimmed | 1 medium orange, zest of, grated | 8 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into strips | 8 large red chilies ( serrano ) | 1/2 cup water | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons undistilled birds eye chiles, plus more for garnish
instructions: Place a steamer basket over a pot of simmering water and let it stand for 10 to 12 minutes, until the water is bubbling and the tomatoes are soft and pulpy. Remove the tomatoes and their oil and place in a blender with 3/4 cup of the beans, oranges, sun dried tomatoes, and chiles. Blend until the ingredients are completely smooth and creamy. In a large bowl, stir together the yeast and warm water, then add the rest of the beans, tomatoes, and chiles. Pour the yeast mixture into the bowl and combine well. Turn the dough out onto the lightly floured surface and knead for 2 or 3 minutes. Transfer the dough to a large, greased bowl and cover with a towel. Let the dough rise in a warm place until it doubles in size, about 2 hours.. Cut the dough into fourths, then roll each half into long ropes about 1 inch in diameter and 1/2 inch thick. Cut each loaf into 6 or 8 equal segments. Place them on a lightly oiled baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Cover with a towel and let rise until doubled in size, about 40 hours. Preheat oven to 400°f brush the loaves with oil. Roast the breads for 10 to 12 minutes, until they are golden brown and crisp. Remove the loaves from the oven and cut off any excess crusts with a serrated knife. Place on a wire rack and let cool. Warm the remaining 1/4 cup of chiles in a small skillet over medium low heat, remove the seeds, and remove the seeds from the chiles using a mortar and pestle.

title: Homemade Pastry
ingredients: 1 package all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 1 cup unbleached flour
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, stir together the flour, sea salt. Make a well in the center. Sprinkle in the flours. Use your hands to knead with the large, clean spoon, until the dough is smooth and soft. Use the dough hook to form a ball. You may need to divide the dough into pieces, wrap each in plastic wrap, and refrigerate until needed. Turn on the oven to 425°f. Divide the dough into 3 loaves, and form each into a circle about 12 inches long. Place two loaves on a lightly floured, parchment covered baking sheet. Use a spatula to transfer the dough to the preheated oven, and bake for about 30 minutes, or until the dough is puffed up and golden brown, or the top is brown and crusts are crisp.

title: Ancho Chile-Papaya Brown Rice

instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water. Drain, pressing the rice out of the rice, and discard any excess liquid. Mix in all remaining ingredients, except pepitas. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 8 hours, then fluff with a fork, and serve immediately.

title: Prawn Coconut Balls
ingredients: 225 g chopped peeled prawns | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons freshly grated cardamom seeds | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 100 ml coconut milk
instructions: Place prawns in a medium saucepan with celery, water chestnuts and cardamom seeds. Cover and bring to the boil over high heat, stirring occasionally until prawns turn pink, about 5 minutes. Transfer prawn mixture to a plate and reserve. Add yoghurt and coconut milk to the pan, bring to the boil, stirring constantly, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Stir in prawn mixture, transfer to an ovenproof serving dish and bake at 180 degrees c for 15 to 20 minutes or until prawns are opaque and cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Mushroom and Sun-Dried Tomato Bread in the Abm
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 3/4 cup warm water | 3 ounces button mushrooms, trimmed and chopped | 8 -12 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( about 1 3/4 cups ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon coarsely chopped green bell pepper
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm water in a large bowl and let stand for 2 - 3 minutes. In a saucepan, combine the mushrooms, tomatoes, and bell pepper and bring to simmer. Remove from the heat, cover and let stand until the filling is thick, about 15 minutes. Stir the yeast mixture into the mushroom mixture. Beat the mixture with a mixer at medium speed for about 10 minutes. Transfer the dough to a well buttered large, round baking dish, cover, and let rise in a warm, draft free place until puffy, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. With hands, punch down the dough, then separate into 2 or 3 pieces. Working with one piece at a time, gently stretch it into a 6 long rectangle about 1/4 in thick and 7 in diameter. Cut the dough in half onto each piece, pressing the sections of dough to flatten them. Arrange half the dough pieces in a single layer in the baking dish, then spread them evenly with the tomato mixture, leaving a 1/2 rim over each. Cover with the remaining halves of the dough, pressing together lightly. Dust the top with flour. Cover the dish loosely with a kitchen cloth, then spread the top with a clean kitchen towel so it doesn't stick. Let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 45 - 60 minutes. Bake the bread until the tops are lightly browned, about 30 minutes. Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes. Gently run a knife around the inside of the bread to loosen it. Serve immediately.

title: Tamarind Soup
ingredients: 1 chili | 1 cm gingerroot | chili, to garnish
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Chill until required. Serve garnished with thinly sliced chillies.

title: Sicilian Lamb
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch wide strips | 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch wide strips | 3 1/2 teaspoons ground mixed spice ( pimenton de la vera or cuban red spice mix ) | 2 cups liquid smoke | 6 anchovy fillets, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the meat with the spice mix and rub all over it. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or over night. Transfer it to a wire rack set over a bowl and refrigerate. Prepare the barbecue or smoker, fill half of the empty charcoal grill with cold water, just below the surface of the meat. Allow about 40 minutes for medium doneness. Transfer the meat to the meat, reserve the cooking water and add to the smoke along with any leftover water. Cook, covered, over high heat for 10 minutes or until the meat is very tender. Transfer the meat to a platter and tent loosely with foil, transfer to the preheated grill and discard any fat that has accumulated on the work surface. Cover the grill and cook over medium heat with the lid cracked, for about 15 minutes. Turn the meat over and cook on the second side for 10 minutes or until the meat is medium well. Remove the lid and cook for about 10 minutes longer, or until the meat is golden and crusty and no longer pink in the center. Serve with rice pilaf or with crusty side bread.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,button mushroom,broccoli,vegetable stock,palm sugar,mace,thai basil,cider vinegar

ingredients: cooking oil | 1 lb broccoli, cut to florets | 6 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons thai basil, roughly chopped | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan. Add ginger, garlic and mushrooms. Cook 1 minute then add sugar, stock, basil and vinegar. Bring to boil then simmer for 2 minutes. Puree soup in blender until smooth. Return soup to pan, season and serve.

title: Anchovy Dips
ingredients: 4 -5 fresh peaches ( or canned small peas that are drained ) | 2 teaspoons tarragon | 1 -2 teaspoon anchovy paste
instructions: Peach can be canned if desired. Tear off chunks and scoop out the flesh using a spoon. Toss with remaining ingredients. Eat at once. Use with crackers, or spread on bagels.

instructions: Cut steak lengthwise into thin slices. Place in skillet with oil, and sear for 3 minutes on each side. Set aside to drain while warm. Shred lettuce and place on serving plate. Place lettuce on top of lettuce, and top with steaks. Serve with salad dressing.

title: Red Curry Paste for Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup red curry paste | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Mix all well. Serve over steaks or meat of choice in a shallow dish. Note, the paste can be kept in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

title: Crusty English Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 1/2 cups rye flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: In the bowl of a stand mixer, whisk all dry ingredients together. Knead for 2 or 3 minutes on a lightly floured surface. Lightly oil a 5 or 6 cup muffin tin. Pat batter evenly into tins, leaving 1/2 inch rim. Brush top with milk, if needed. Cover with a cloth and rest. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and heat a non stick frying pan over low heat. When pan is hot, add a few drops of oil as needed. Using a brush of oil, spread butter all over the surface of the bread. Carefully remove bread from pan, and place 1 slice onto the centre of each bread slice. Press edges together. Place bread on a lightly greased baking sheet and brush with more heated milk. Bake for 45 minutes, or until golden. Serve warm, reheating as necessary.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,red potato,thyme leaf,coconut milk,wild mushroom,buttermilk,cake flour,golden syrup
title: Italian Sausage and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour ( all-purpose ) or 1 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves, crushed | 1 ounce sweetened dried wild mushroom, chopped | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 2 1/2 cups buttermilk or 2 1/2 cups low-fat buttermilk | 2 cups sliced unpeeled red potatoes | 2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Mix the cake flour, thyme, mushrooms, and italian sausage in a bowl. Cut in the butter until the mixture becomes the consistency of coarse crumbs, adding more butter as needed. Pat mixture into a 9 inch pie plate or large baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes. Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain, and mash until smooth. Stir in the syrup, bring to a boil over medium heat, and boil for 3 minutes.

title: Olive Tapenade (Or Olive Dressing and Cream)
ingredients: 3 -5 olives, pitted ( try a mixture of your favourite olives, garlic and dill ) | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Mix together the olives and cream and store in the fridge for up to a week, if possible, before using.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,marjoram,nonfat plain yogurt,soy sauce,coriander leaf,red wine vinegar,hickory barbecue sauce
title: Spicy Roast Cornflour Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 50 g coriander leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 5 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 2 tablespoons nonfat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon hickory flavored barbecue sauce
instructions: Mix the cornflour, coriander, marjoram, soy sauce, yogurt, vinegar and barbecue sauce in a bowl. Rub the mixture all over the surface of the onion, then leave in the fridge for at least 1 hour to firm up. Serve with toasted pitta bread, crackers, veges or pita chips from a jar.

Random Ingredients: cognac,spinach,lobster meat,pear,orange zest,mexican corn,chicken bouillon cube,ladyfinger
title: Spanish Lobster-Pear Soup
ingredients: 2 lobster meat, peeled & chopped ( fresh is better ) | 1 1/2 cups frozen southern-style frozen mexican-style corn, thawed | 2 ounces frozen chardelles in light syrup ( chard flowers-optional ) | 2 -3 pears, quartered ( optional ; if using a pear, peel them when they are thawed to avoid breaking the shells ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons orange zest ( or 2 tablespoons of your favorite orange zest, if you like ) | 8 -10 soft ladyfingers ( or fresh, if you want ) | 1/4 cup cognac ( optional, i find that the flavor is in the peaches )
instructions: Add the lobster meat to a large stock pot or stock pan. Add the corn, chard, pears, bouillon, shrimp/meat combo or chicken pieces. Add enough water to bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for about 10 - 15 minutes. Add the orange zest. Add the cognac and if desired, adjust the seasonings. Serve with more cognac on the side. Note, i usually put the lobster meat back in the broth until it's cool enough to handle. Once the lobster is cool enough to handle, remove the meat from the sauce and discard. Place the cooked meat in a soup bowl, and add enough of the cooking liquid to just cover. Do not drain. I usually use about 3/4 cup cooking liquid. I like to stir this up a bit and then serve it as is. Goes well with toasted bread. This goes nicely with some of my late mother's cookies, along with a loaf of italian bread, as well as a salad. This also makes a great salad/salad or appetizer presentation. The one i like best is just the british country bread. Note, i have successfully made this with shrimp, lobster meat and fresh veggies and even a mix of your favorites, as well as about 3/4 cup canned baby corn and about 3 tablespoons fresh, chopped carrot. You may like to use the frozen peas or frozen artichokes, if using, as well. I have never tried this yet and it is a good substitute for the lobster meat.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,portabella mushroom,pork sparerib,green chili pepper,mexicorn
title: Slow Cooker Mexican P.
ingredients: 6 pork spareribs | 4 portabella mushrooms | 1 jar mexicorn | 1 can diced green chili peppers | 1 can peas and carrots
instructions: Place spareribs in crockpot. Drain contents of can of mexicorn. Place mushrooms on top of meat. Mix remaining ingredients together and sprinkle over meat. Turn crockpot on high and cook on high for 4 hours stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: lamb,basil leaf,tomato,spring onion,silken tofu,tarragon,red chili pepper,sesame seed
title: Kofta Patties With Tofu
ingredients: 200 g silken tofu | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon spring onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, finely chopped | 1 fresh red chili pepper, seeds and membrane removed, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds | 50 g ground lamb | 2 tablespoons basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place the tofu on a square of reynolds wrap non stick baking paper with the tomatos, spring onion, tarragon and chili. Spread the tofu over the top and then place the ground lamb over. Cover and allow to rest for 10 minutes before grilling. Sprinkle the herbs over the top and set aside for 30 minutes or until required. Shape the lamb mixture using your hands into small patties. Grill the kebabs for 6 minutes, turning regularly and brushing with olive oil. Top with tomato sauce and serve.
