title: Quick and Easy Dutch Sandwich Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 4 crusty sandwich loafs ( or 8 large sandwich buns )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Combine the sugar and 1 1/2 cups water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil, stirring to dissolve sugar, about 5 minutes. Remove the saucepan from the heat. Ladle the hot syrup into the loaf pans. Insert the bread or buns, cut side up, on the sugar syrup. Bake until the tops of the loafs are toasted and golden brown and the loafs are pulling away from the sides of the pan, about 1 hour.

title: Grilled Beef Satay with Prunes, Mint and Cinnamon
ingredients: 1 lb lean sirloin steak, trimmed and cut into long strips | 1 bunch chopped bok choy | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons rice wine | mint, chopped | pepper | 1/2 cup prune, coarsely chopped | 12 large flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat coals or gas grill to high. Combine beef, half and half, honey, rice wine, chopped mint and pepper in a zip lock plastic bag. Refrigerate for 30 minute to marinate. Grill or bbq satay on high, covered, about 10 min or until medium rare. Add prunes and prunes to beef. Heat about 1 minute each side then serve with warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,pico de gallo,cocoa powder,cornstarch,mustard seed,anchovy paste
title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/4 cup cornstarch ( heaping ) | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 cup pico de gallo
instructions: Use blender to blend the mustard seeds and anchovies together.

title: Fish in Orange Juice
ingredients: 3 -4 tilapia fillets ( depending on size ) | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 orange, zested and juice of
instructions: Place tilapia fillets in a glass dish. Combine the wine, water and turmeric powder and pour the mixture over the fish. Marinate for about 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Serve with rice.

title: Spicy Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 -12 medium mushrooms ( or any combination. i use cremini ) | 1 teaspoon crushed saffron, divided | 1 dash hot chili pepper flakes
instructions: Slice mushrooms or leave whole. Sprinkle all with saffron. Pour boiling water over as u touch. Let stand 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve over cooked pasta, rice, or mash with masala for extra flavor.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,cooking spray,lettuce,pork shoulder,white fish fillet
title: Pork Ceviche over Whitefish
ingredients: 2 skinless white fish fillets, 1 inch thick | 8 firm fleshed white fish fillets, approximately 1lb each | 8 lettuce, leaves only | 8 slices thin slice thick cut pork shoulder | cooking spray
instructions: Place fish and vegetables in a medium nonstick frying pan. Spray with cooking oil. Cook over high heat until just cooked, turning once, about 7 minutes. Place in the refrigerator until cool. Remove skin and discard. Cut into ¼ inch wide wedges. Place in a shallow serving bowl. Add cooled vegetables.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,dark soy sauce,greek seasoning,mustard powder,white bread,sausage,green cardamom
title: Meat Patties
ingredients: 2 lbs sausage, cut into 2 inch cubes | white bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup applesauce | 2 -3 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 -2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground green cardamoms ( the small green pods ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( tamari can be substitue )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a big, wide, heavy bottom pot. Let it boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. When the liquid comes to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring frequently, for about 15 minutes. Stir it regularly. Cook for another 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from heat and place on paper towels to drain excess liquid. You have to leave extra liquid because it curdles somewhat on standing. This could also be cooked in a skillet with a little olive oil or some kind of cornstarch. The flavour is subtle, the more you taste it, the sweeter it gets. Allow the to cool completely while you prepare other ingredients. This is an excellent time snack.

title: Fruity Beef
ingredients: 500 g trimmed fat-trimmed beef | 3 teaspoons bottled hot sauce | 2 garlic cloves, crushed or 3 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 can large shrimp, drained | 2 small dried fruit, chopped
instructions: Trim beef of excess fat, fat and gristle. Cut into 2cm cubes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Thread 3cm ginger slices around each cube. Place beef in a large, shallow, non stick casserole dish and cover with the rest of the ingredients. Cover and cook in a moderate oven over high heat for 1 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender and cooked through. Stir occasionally.

title: Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 1 head sharp cheddar cheese | cooking oil
instructions: Slice the top off the chedder cheese, so the cheese is just beginning to melt. Run a sharp knife down the center of the cheese. This helps soften it. When it is melted, pour some of the melted cheese on top and smooth it out. Roll up and tie with string, so that it won't break if you tie the ends all the way around. Place the wrapped cheese in a plastic bag, and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 325 degrees and lightly oil a roasting pan. Remove the cheese from the bag and place onto the oiled roasting pan. Cover and bake at 325 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes, until golden brown. Let cool slightly, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,greek yogurt,beef brisket,swiss cheese,green chili salsa
title: Quick 'n Easy Spicy Beef Brisket
ingredients: 6 -7 lbs beef brisket | 1 can green chili salsa ( or to taste ) | 3/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 cups swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lay brisket in a shallow pan. Mix together salsa, yogurt, cardamom and half the cheese. Spread over brisket. Cover tightly with foil. Bake for 2 hours or until meat is cooked.

title: Vegetable Espresso
ingredients: 1 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 3 chilies, seeded, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons instant espresso | 1/2 head cabbage, finely shredded | 4 radishes, sliced | 1 onion, sliced
instructions: Stir orange juice, chilies and 1 tb. Of the espresso together. Stir cabbage, radishes, remaining espresso and radishes together in a shallow dish. Cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: fruit,self raising flour,snow pea,sesame seed,salt black pepper
title: Crunchy English Snow Pea Sables
ingredients: 200 g sesame seeds | 100 g self raising flour | 450 g baby snow peas | 1/4 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon diced dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Toast sesame seeds until golden. Mix together sesame seeds, flour, snow peas, seasonings and fruit if using to form a batter. Spoon 1 tablespoon of batter onto the baking trays and flatten slightly. Repeat with remaining batter until all the mixture is used. Bake on tray for 15 - 20 mins until golden.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,graham cracker crumb,coconut oil,chicken thigh,farfalle pasta,yellow bell pepper,red wine
title: Coconut Crusted Chicken in Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut oil, divided | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, divided | 1/2 lb fisa or 1/2 lb frisee | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cored, cut into thin 1-inch julienne strips | 8 ounces farfalle pasta | toasted graham cracker crumb
instructions: Position a rack in the middle of the oven and heat the oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. In a medium saucepan, heat 1/2 cup of the coconut oil over moderate to low heat. Add the chicken and 1/4 cup of the parsley and simmer the chicken. Stir in the wine. Cover and simmer the chicken until the wine has been completely absorbed, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes. Add the chicken to the saucepan. Cover and simmer the chicken until the chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 15 minutes longer. Transfer the chicken to a plate and reserve. Add the remaining coconut oil to a medium saute pan and bring the pan to a boil. While the oil is heating, in a large pasta bowl, toss the pasta with 1/2 cup of the parsley. Spoon some of the pasta into a warm serving bowl and nestle the chicken and remaining parsley onto the pasta. Serve the chicken topped with the remaining parsley.

Random Ingredients: topping,pork back rib,spaghetti sauce,fennel bulb,lemon pepper,jalapeno,plain nonfat yogurt,white sugar
title: Spicy Spaghetti Ribs
ingredients: spaghetti sauce | 1 fennel bulb, sliced | 1/2 jalapeno, seeded and chopped | 2 pounds pork back ribs, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 container plain nonfat yogurt | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine the fennel, jalapeno, pork rib pieces, lemon pepper, sugar, yogurt, and whipped topping in a large pot over medium heat. Cover and cook for 30 to 40 minutes or until the meat is tender. Serve immediately.

title: Avocados with Shrimp Appetizer
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes | 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 1/2 tablespoons store-bought store-bought store-bought store-bought store-bought shrimp tapioca ( 4 1/2 cups )
instructions: Cut avocados in half and carefully remove the peel with a thin bladed or vegetable peeler. Slice each half into 1/8 inch thick slices and place in a shallow 2 quart dish. Place shrimp in a small bowl. Combine shrimp with shrimp. Dip each slice of avocado into the shrimp mixture to coat. Transfer to the plastic wrap and squeeze bag to secure tightly. Chill at least 2 hours. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake shrimp in preheated oven for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow creme,cognac,saffron thread,pasta sauce,lemon lime beverage,red chile
title: Lemon-Chile Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces pasta sauce | 3/4 cup cognac | 1/2 cup lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1 large red chile, chopped | 8 -10 fresh hot saffron threads | 16 large marshmallow creme, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring four cups of water to a boil. When at a rolling boil, stir in the pasta sauce, cognac and lemon lime flavored carbonated beverage. When pasta water comes to a boil, stir in the chilies. Once all the ingredients in the saucepan, stir vigorously with a wooden spoon or a wooden spoon to create some small cracks. Cover and remove from heat. After about five minutes, stir in the saffron. Drain the pasta and return to the pot. Gently stir in the marshmallow creme before serving.

title: White Beans and Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs great northern beans, shelled | 4 cups long-grain rice, washed and drained | sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Cover the beans with water and bring to a boil.

title: Potato Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 8 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package crimini mushrooms, drained and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Pour cream of chicken soup into a pot on the stovetop. Stir in potatoes and mushrooms, tossing together with a whisk to combine. Bring to a boil, then pour into the prepared dish. Cover baking dish with foil and bake for 60 to 70 minutes in the preheated oven, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Cranberry-Ginger Jam (Karweta Sjød)
ingredients: 2 lbs cranberries | 2 tablespoons ginger juice ( fresh ginger juice is best, but bottled will work too )
instructions: Puncture the cranberries in the stem with a knife or a fork so that any juice remains in the pan. Put the cranberries in a pan and cover them with cold water. Bring to a boil.

title: Codfish With Sausage and Coriander
ingredients: 600 g cod, skinned and cut into chunks | 1 1/2 kg turkey sausage | 1 shallot, minced ( a small spanish onion is also okay ) | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped | 400 g icing sugar
instructions: Place butter in a deep saute pan over a medium heat. Add shallot and fry until soft. Add coriander and sausage and fry for another 5 minutes. Add in fish. Cook the spices and taste for seasoning and sugar. Place in the freezer for 20 minutes or until fish is well cooked and slightly firm. Strain, then remove casings. Slice the sausage into cubes. Pour in the liquid the fish soaked in and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir through the icing sugar and leave to cool. To serve, put on a hot serving plate with the sausage mixture, and spoon over the gorebs of fish.

title: Kielbasa, Italian Sausages & Barley (Polish Breakfast)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1 lb pearl barley ( uncooked )
instructions: Remove casing from sausage. Cut in 2x2 inch chunks removing the skin. Break off the stem and cut into chunks. Place sausage in a 3 quart dutch oven with the barley, covering the barley. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours, or until the barley is tender and the sausage is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: okra,green bean,yellow bell pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,madeira wine,dill
title: Beef and Okra Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb sliced okra, drained | 1 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 1 cup green beans | 1 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1/2 cup madeira wine or 1/2 cup beef stock
instructions: Cook and stir okra as directed on package, about 5 minutes or until lightly browned and tender. Drain. In a large skillet, add okra, bell pepper, green beans and heat until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with cheese and dill. Drizzle with madeira or beef stock and stir until cheese is evenly distributed. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: spinach,cumin powder,red pepper,tomato juice,black bean,kielbasa,penne pasta
title: Black Beans and Tomatoes With Spinach & Kielbasa
ingredients: 1/2 lb kielbasa, cut into 1-1/2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup chopped red pepper | 1 can tomato juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 cans black beans, drained ( optional ) | 16 ounces chopped fresh spinach | 1 lb penne pasta, uncooked
instructions: In 4 qt casserole dish, combine the kielbasa, red pepper, tomato juice and cumin and stir to combine, then add the beans, cover and heat in oven until heated through, about 30 minutes. Cook penne until it begins to soften to your liking. About 10 minutes before serving, cook pasta to your your liking. Drain pasta and return to dish. Top with kielbasa mixture.

title: Cranberry Chutney Mix
ingredients: 6 dried tart apples | 3/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours, preferably overnight. When ready to use, stir to combine.

title: Linguine With Tangy Citrus  Beef & Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces lo mein noodles | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil or 2 tablespoons other light flavored olive oil | 1 small rib of beef, thinly sliced | 6 tablespoons fresh lime juice, divided | 2 tablespoons tartar sauce | 12 ounces baked beans ( about 3 cups )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain. While pasta cooks, prepare beef. Heat oil in a pan over medium high heat. Fry beef for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring frequently until browned. Stir in lime juice, tartar sauce and beans. Remove from heat. Drain pasta and beef, reserving liquid. Add pasta and beef liquid to the pan. Cook until heated. Serve.

title: My Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 16 sheets phyllo dough ( frozen phyllo dough, no sheets ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon extract | 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Boil ziti until just tender until it just falls apart. Drain & cool. Beat oil & lemon extract until foamy. Stir in ziti til all is well coated. Spread 1 tbsp ziti in the bottom of a 13x9 pan. Spoon 1/4 of the ziti on top of the ziti & then spread 1/4 of the ziti on top. Sprinkle the poppy seeds on top & dot with the remaining ziti. Cover with 2 more sheets phyllo. Fold phyllo up & over the ziti. Cover with 1 - 2 tsp of ziti on top & 1 tsp of poppy seeds. Repeat with 2 more sheets, & cover with the 2nd phyllo sheets. Wrap well in wax paper & frozen. Take out when firm. If there is any film left, moisten with a little more water & then gently cut off pieces. Place on cookie sheet & bake in oven for 25 minutes or until pastry is golden.

title: Macaroni & Sun Pea Supper
ingredients: 1 can hearts of aardine soup ( i prefer creamy ) | 100 g swiss pork | 1/2 cup sultana ( golden raisins ) | 1 cup macaroni | 1 cup snow peas
instructions: Prepare macaroni as per instructions on the packet. Serve macaroni on the side. Sauce, combine onion, sultanas and meat in food processor. Process until very fine. Add water to make a thin sauce consistency. Add soup and noodles. Heat for a further 2 - 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin and Snow Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces dried crabage, leaves | 1/4 cup dried sage | 2 lbs pumpkin, pared, seeded and cubed | 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 cup absa natural nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup fresh snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Soak crabage leaves in a cup of cold water for 10 minutes.

title: Millet Pork Medallions
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork tenderloin, fat trimmed | 1 cup millet | 3/4 cup sour cream | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 1 teaspoon table salt | 4 teaspoons salt
instructions: Place the butter in a large heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Cut several slits into the pork tenderloins with a sharp knife, and season with salt. Add the slits to the meat and sprinkle with orange zest. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes or until an instant reading thermometer reaches 145 to 155 degrees f. Remove and let stand for 10 minutes. Cut into medallions and serve.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,linguine,phyllo dough,ziti pasta,kosher salt,picante sauce
title: Ziti Phyllo Primavera With Picante Sauce
ingredients: 9 ounces dry linguine | 1 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/4 cup kosher salt, plus more for sprinkling | 1 lb ziti pasta, cooked and drained | 9 sheets phyllo dough, defrosted
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain and set aside. For picante sauce, combine picante sauce, syrup, and salt in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until slightly thickened and reduced, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. While sauce is cooling, cook ziti in a large pot of ice water for 8 minutes, or until slightly tender. Drain and place in bowl of ice water to stop the cooking. Cool until no longer warm. To assemble, place 2 sheets of phyllo dough on work surface or cutting board. Working with 3 or 4 sheets of pasta at a time, begin filling each phyllo stack with about 2 tablespoons of ziti, about a spoonful of sauce, and 1/4 cup of picante sauce. The sheets should be 5 inches wide, but not touching. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 2 minutes. Drain pasta well and place on plates with 2 sheets of phyllo, 1 1/2 teaspoons of picante sauce, and more sauce if desired. Top with remaining 2 sheets of phyllo. Slice ziti into 1/3 inch wide strips and arrange on platter with extra sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,salmon fillet,pastry double crust pie,cardamom seed,farfalle pasta,pineapple juice,fish sauce
title: Thai-Style Glazed Salmon With Pastry
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta or 1 package other pastry for double-crust pie | 1 container pineapple juice | 1/2 cup bottled korma barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon barbecke sauce | 1 1/2 lbs skinned salmon fillets, 1 inch thick or 1 1/2 lbs skinless skinless red snapper fillets, cut into 2 1/2 inch strips
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f°. In a large baking dish, place farfalle or other pastry for double crust pie. Sprinkle with the cardamom and barbecke sauce. Lay the fish strips skin side down on top of farfalle/pizza mixture. In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining ingredients. Spread evenly over fish. Top with the remaining farfalle/pizza mixture. In a separate large baking dish, bake at 375 degrees f for 25 to 30 minutes, until the crust is golden brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,kidney bean,chicken flavor bouillon,rotel tomato chilies,red curry paste,italian sausage,beef consomme
title: Spicy Red Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage or 1 lb hot italian sausage, diced | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 2 cans kidney beans, drained | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained | 1 envelope chicken-flavored instant food consomme | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon italian seasoning or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Brown sausage in a large skillet, drain fat. Add all remaining ingredients except for the curry paste, and place in prepared casserole dish. Mix curry paste with a little water to make a runny paste. Sprinkle over the top of casserole. Bake in 350 degree oven for approximately 1/2 hour or until hot.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,farfalle pasta,lime zest,bell pepper,chive,soy sauce
title: Pasta With Bell Peppers and Chives
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 2 large bell peppers, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon lime zest, minced | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 teaspoon minced fresh chives
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: The Irish Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed of the fat | 4 tablespoons irish whiskey ( not lite ) | 12 ounces beef stock | 1 cup small dried dates ( or more ) | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Make slits all over the beef with a sharp knife on each side of the beef. Rub the beef with whiskey. Place meat on baking sheet. Pour beef broth into a large, heavy bottomed sauce pan. Bring broth to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer gently for 2 1/2 hours. Remove foil, add dates, and simmer until tender. Stir frequently and watch carefully for flare up. Remove beef and stir in limes. Serve over noodles.

title: Pinto Bean, Broccoli & Bacon Salad
ingredients: 3 cups fresh broccoli | 3 cups prepared pinto beans | 4 slices thin prosciutto, each slice cut into 10-inch squares | 4 slices smoked provolone cheese | 4 fresh mangoes, sliced | 1/2 lb bacon fat-free prosciutto, diced | 2 tablespoons pernod seeds | 1/4 cup dried parsley flakes | 2 tablespoons minced roasted cumin seeds
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain and cool under cold running water. Break off tough lower stems from broccoli and separate the leaves. Break into bite size pieces. Place broccoli and beans in large bowl. Add prosciutto, cheese, mangoes, bacon fatfree prosciutto, pernod seeds, parsley, cumin, and cilantro. Toss to coat. Serve with crackers or salsa fresca.

title: Mexican Brown Rice (Arroz Blanco)
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder ( to taste )
instructions: Cook the rice in a pot over boiling water until just tender. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together the orange zest and cayenne and set aside. Drain the rice and add to the pan, and mix well. Add the zest mixture and stir to combine. Serve.

title: Sesame Honey Beef
ingredients: 500 g beef, cut into 2 x 1 cm sticks | 75 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 4 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Place flour, orange zest, sesame seeds and raisins in a shallow dish. Coat beef with flour then brown in oil in a non stick pan on both sides. You may need to do this in batches, depending on your pan. Serve with sauce.

title: My Kids Spicy Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 large soft taco-size flour tortilla | 3/8 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons cilantro ( fresh coriander )
instructions: Heat nonstick pan on medium low heat, then spray with cooking spray. Spread tortilla in pan to form a 3/8 inch thick tortilla. Spread half of sweet chili sauce in tortilla. Sprinkle with half of cilantro. Sprinkle with remaining cilantro. Fold tortilla, covering the whole surface. Slide to a cutting board and cut into thin wedges.

Random Ingredients: plantain,chilies,chicken wing,lime wedge,kiwi fruit,sugar,new york strip steak
title: Hot Chicken Steak With Plantains
ingredients: 4 new york strip steaks, each 3 inches long ( or similar size ) | 4 plantains, cut into 1/4 thick slices ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 1/2 cups sliced peeled kiwi fruits | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 8 lime wedges | 16 fresh bird's eye chili peppers, sliced into rings
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut about 5 crosswise slits across both sides of the steaks, forming a cross. To make the marinade, in a small bowl, make a paste. Using a fork, scrape the seeds from the plantains and kiwi fruit, then toss with the sugar. Cut the steaks into 1/2 wide strips. Spray a grill pan or a griddle with non stick cooking spray and heat it over medium heat. Coat the steak with the marinade, then add the slits to the pan or grill. Cook over medium low heat for 7 to 10 minutes, turning once, until desired doneness. Serve the steaks topped with the plantains and kiwi fruit slivers and chili rings.

title: Oven Fruity Baked Raisins
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat bran | 1 cup fresh sage leaves
instructions: Mix the bran and sage and divide it into four equal sized bowls. To make a raisin bread, grease the base of a 10 inch ovenproof casserole with butter and sprinkle some coarse rock salt. Spread two equal portions of the raisin bread with a third portion of the sage mixture, and flatten one portion on top. Repeat until the four portions of bread have been used. Cover the bread with cling film and leave for 30 minutes to dry out. Pre heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Bake the raisins for 30 minutes, and increase the temperature to 400 degrees f if necessary until golden brown.

title: Italian Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 3 lbs lean beef steak, cut up | 1 box spaghetti, broken into pieces | 1 teaspoon vanilla, divided
instructions: In large non stick skillet, cook and stir steak about 5 minutes or until browned, stirring occasionally. Stir in spaghetti and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Cover and cook about 10 minutes or until pasta is tender.

title: Southern Blackberry Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped blackberries, thawed | 1 cup coarsely chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Place blackberries, pecans, and chili powder in a blender, and process until mixture is slushy, about 3 minutes.

title: Lamb and Shrimp Fricassee
ingredients: 1 kg lamb ( kidneys, etc. ) or 1 kg mutton | 2 -3 teaspoon shrimp paste
instructions: Cut the meat of the kidneys into approx 5cm cubes. Put the meat in a pot, cover with water and simmer over medium heat for about an hour until the meat is tender. Add the shrimp paste and stir gently. Serve immediately.

title: Southern Style Buffalo-Style Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 1 yellow pepper, sliced thin
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat the bacon grease over medium heat. When the grease starts to bubble, add the yellow pepper. Cook and stir until the pepper becomes translucent and has a deep orange color. Transfer the skillet to a plate lined with paper towels, leaving any fat in the skillet. Cut the onions with a sharp knife in half and discard the inner rings.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,almond,seasoning mix,celery rib,rice wine vinegar
title: Chinese Snow Peas in Adobo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs snow peas | 3 celery ribs, sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | salt and seasoning mix | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Cut the snow peas in half, remove any strings and any large pieces or small ones. Add to a pot with the celery, the vinegar, salt and pepper and a little water. Bring to a boil, covered for 4 to 5 minutes. Turn the heat down and let sit for 3 hours, covered, before removing the lid and flambeings. Add the slivered almonds just before serving.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,ghee,red cabbage,peanut butter,canadian bacon
title: Low Fat Hot and Smoked Ghee German Slaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons melted ghee | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 6 slices canadian bacon, roughly chopped | 1 red cabbage, cut into thin slaw | 1/2 cup reduced-fat shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese
instructions: Heat the ghee in a wok over medium high heat. Add the bacon and shredded cabbage.

title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 lb top sirloin steak | 1/2 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 12 1/2 ounces cheese, preferably sharp cheddar cheese, 1 `` slices | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: To prepare steaks, dissolve coffee in hot coffee in large, heavy skillet. Add steak. Cook over high heat, breaking up meat with back of spoon, until browned on both sides. Transfer steak to platter. Add bell pepper and cheese. Combine syrup and mustard. Sprinkle over steak. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,lettuce leaf,plain flour,vegetable,garlic clove,steak seasoning,cilantro,flour tortilla
title: Easy Flank Steak Chimichanga
ingredients: 2 flank steaks, sliced across grain into 4 pieces | 1 ounce plain flour or 1 ounce gluten-free flour | 1 ounce cilantro | 4 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 garlic clove, crushed ( i use the jarred ) | 3 ounces cacha vegetarian chili-flavored carbonated beverage or 3 ounces chocolate syrup | 4 slices low-fat baked lettuce leaves | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Place the steak, flour, herbs, garlic and chili paste in a flat metal dish. Pour the soda over. Refrigerate for about 30 minutes or up to up to 3 hours. Heat up your oven to about 450°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Take the tortillas, one at a time, and spread them out over the lined pan. Place them on a baking sheet with raised edges. Bake them for 10 minutes or until they are dark golden. Let cool, cut into 4 wedges, serve, etc.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,american cheese,button mushroom,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,tortilla,leg lamb,hazelnut,heavy cream
title: Smoked Lamb Enchiladas With Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg legs of lamb, sliced | 1 cup hazelnuts | 1/2 cup australian buttery spread ( or cream, 1 oz. ) | 2 red pepper, cut into thin strips | 8 ounces button mushrooms | 3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce ( or equivalent amount of fresh chopped roasted red chiles ) | 2 tablespoons sliced orange peel | 2/3 cup heavy cream | 8 tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c or 160°c if using a fan forced oven. In a food processor, process hazelnuts to a fine meal. Place on a board and chop. Mix hazelnuts, breadcrumbs, red pepper strips, mushrooms in the butter until combined. Divide mixture evenly among 4 tortillas. Roll up each tortilla, place seam side down on a greased/lined baking tray. Brush with beaten egg and bake in oven for 20 minutes or until golden and tender. Meanwhile make the sauce. Heat a dry frying pan and saute the sliced orange peel, peppers, chipotle peppers and chiles until soft. Remove and reserve the peppers, drain the mixture and puree in a food processor or with a stick blender. Bring cream to boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 15 mins. Remove pan from heat and stir in the cream until just thickened. Place 3 enchiladas on each plate and pour sauce over them. Place remaining enchiladas on top and serve piping hot.

Random Ingredients: green chili,corn oil,red chili paste,tomato soup,wonton wrapper,beer
title: Chilli Pot Stickers
ingredients: 1 large green chili, finely sliced | 1/2 teaspoon red chili paste | 24 wonton wrappers | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 2 cups grated cheese of choice
instructions: Combine chili, chili paste, and wonton wrappers, wet hands gently. Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture in the center of the wonton wrapper. Place the wontons in a frying basket over medium heat, then brown lightly on both sides.

title: Gramma's Perfect Easter Eggs (Pudim)
ingredients: 6 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup saffron
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas 7, and line an oven tray with parchment paper. Place the egg yolks in a bowl. In a small jug, combine the saffron and a little water. Add this mixture to the beaten yolks and mix well. Place the mixture in a large pastry bag with a large plain tip or 2 tablespoons of cold water on your finger. Using your finger, pour a little of the egg batter into the bag. Hold bag in the air and gently shake gently so the egg coats the bag to ensure that air remains in the bag. You can either transfer the mixture and the bag to a plastic bag with the egg batter or simply pipe around a little more. Repeat until all the mixture has been used and the mixture has returned to the baking tin. Place the baking tin in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes. Use your finger to lightly shake off excess egg batter. Continue making testes with the egg, to ensure they don't stick to your fingers. These will keep for 2 - 3 days, or freeze for up to 4 months in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,brown mustard seed,mace,pumpkin puree,turkey,egg white,cottage cheese
title: Roast Turkey and Pumpkin Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons packed light brown mustard seeds | 12 lettuce leaves, washed | 2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 2 cups left over cooked turkey, shredded | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1 large egg white, lightly beaten | 12 ounces pumpkin puree, canned or fresh if canned
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly toast mustard seeds in oven until fragrent and seeds begin to brown, about 4 minutes. Stir often. In large bowl combine remaining salad ingredients except pumpkin and egg white. Add to salad and mix well. In small bowl beat egg white until soft peaks form. Gently fold egg white into salad mixture. Spread salad and pumpkin into a shallow, lightly oiled roasting pan just large enough to hold turkey and to hold lettuce leaves together. Place in oven and cook 3 hours or until heated through. Let stand 10 minutes before removing from oven.

Random Ingredients: deli roast beef,teriyaki marinade,basmati rice,artichoke heart,mix,wheat flour,canola oil,red wine
title: Wonderful Beef Gyros
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 3 cups jasmine rice | 1/3 cup teriyaki marinade ( not kikkoman's ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 package sliced deli roast beef, cut into 3/4 inch strips | 1 package mixed-colored-stuffed breadsticks ( such as jarls ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained well, chopped | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, mix water and 1 tablespoons canola oil. Add rice and marinade.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 1 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Rinse the rice under running water, until the rinse water is clear. Drain and place in a 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Mix together the picante sauce and onion powder and spoon over the top. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. In the morning, fluff rice with a fork, and bake for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350 degree oven.

title: Vegan Spicy Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice, uncle ben's suggested | 1 cup chopped mexican onion | 2 jalapeno peppers ( seeded and chopped ) | 1 can low fat sprite or ( 7 ounce ) can other fat free liquid smoke product | 1 can oysters, drained and liquor reserved | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons applesauce or 3 tablespoons your favorite sweetener
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix rice, onion, jalapeno and sprite. Add oysters, liquor and cornstarch. Mix well. Add apple sauce or sweetner to taste. Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Havana - Persian Lemon Candy
ingredients: 1 tablespoon orange flower water ( dibsah ) | colored lemon peel
instructions: Place the orange flower water and the lemon peel in a glass jar. Shake the jar until most of the water is released. Cover the jar with a clean cloth and let sit for at least 4 hours or longer for flavors to blend. Store in the dark for up to a month before using. Note, if you want to increase the amount of lemon peel used in the recipe, increase the amount of orange juice and sugar. Add salt and/or honey to taste if desired. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,single cream,onion powder,button mushroom
title: Easy Microwave Mushrooms
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package button mushrooms | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 1/8 cup single cream
instructions: Preheat grill to high, and place rack 6 inches from heat source. Spray the grill with oil. Put mushrooms, onion and single cream into an earthenware casserole dish, stir through, and cook covered for 8 minutes, then cook a further 7 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender and creamy.

title: Polish Bread Pizza
ingredients: 7 slices bread ( or more ) | 1 1/2 ounces sour cream | 3 ounces cream cheese | 1 1/2 ounces sliced pepperoni | 4 slices kielbasa ( or other polish sausage )
instructions: Spread cream cheese on bread. Place sausage in the middle of cream cheese. Carefully add cheese on top of sausage. Top with slices of pepperoni.

title: Lime Cakes
ingredients: 12 limes | 3 cups white flour
instructions: Pour juice to the bottom of a large freezer plastic bag. Cut off a strip that has the zest of one lime. Pour into freezer to get all the juice into another plastic bag for the lime to have a chance to be frozen. Remove lime zest with the slivered lime, cut off a strip of it, and squeeze it with your finger, then add it to the bag and shake it in the bag with the flour. Put bag in the freezer for about one hour, or until mix is slushy. Remove any lumps, then put out one bag at a time onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Drop 1 teaspoon of mix onto each cookie sheet, using a small circular cookie cutter or two smaller cookie pieces. If they haven't completely covered them, put a toothpick in the center. The dough might sink to the bottom now. I had accidently cut a piece of the cookie that had been inverted onto the cookie sheet and pushed into the mix, but that's how my friend made them. The mix should have a little crumbly but not entirely flaky. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, or other desired topping. They freeze.

Random Ingredients: manila clam,cheddar cheese,orange juice,cabbage,creole seasoning,jasmine rice,bread flour
title: Fried Chicken-Cabbage Loaves
ingredients: 6 ounces manila clams, rinse and pat dry | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 3/4 cup plain bread flour ( or flour or cornstarch ) | 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 4 -6 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded or diced | 2 teaspoons olive creole seasoning ( i use tony chachere's creole seasoning ) | 2 teaspoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Combine garlic, salt and pepper flakes in a cup of water in a small bowl. In a large mixing bowl combine unseasoned flour, rice and wine mixture. Add cheese and olive creole seasoning. Add clams and mix to submerge, making sure all clams are covered. Place on a greased pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until the tops are golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Quick and Easy Warm Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 1/3 cup lime juice and zest of, chopped fresh | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain when done. While pasta is cooking, toss with lime zest in medium bowl and add all remaining ingredients. Mix gently but thoroughly. Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Tater Tot #5FIX
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow-coffee-flavored frozen cubed yukon gold potatoes or 3 lbs gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 16 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon turkey breast, finely diced or 1/2 teaspoon minced meatball, finely minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil. Cook the frozen potatoes in boiling water just until tender but not mushy, 10 to 12 minutes, drain. Stir the cubed yukon, velveta, cinnamon, and meat into the potatoes just until heated through. Spoon the potato mixture into an 8x8x2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with extra cheese. Bake for 25 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve warm, piping hot. The dish is best if allowed to cool for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg white,garlic salt,cocoa,white rice,sirloin steak,button mushroom,arugula,banana pepper
title: Italian Steak Burrito Bowls
ingredients: 4 ounces sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 5 cups cooked white rice | 1 tablespoon cocoa, divided | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon white rice | 8 large button mushrooms, sliced thin | 4 ounces banana peppers | 2 large egg whites
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium high heat, stir fry the sirloin strips until cooked. Remove strips, and drain fat from skillet. Stir in 1 tablespoon of cocoa for color, then mix in the garlic salt and rice. Add the mushrooms, and heat through. Set aside. Whip the egg whites for 15 seconds in a glass bowl until stiff, then fold in with a fork. Coat an empty skillet with cooking spray, then heat the skillet over medium high heat. Stir fry the peppers for about 5 minutes, then remove and slice into a bowl. Pour the beef mixture into the skillet, over the rice, and top with the banana peppers. Wipe the pan clean with paper towels, then stir fry. Cook in the skillet until the peppers are browned on all sides, then remove and set aside.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,salt,lima bean,green onion,flat leaf italian parsley,plain yogurt
title: Limas and Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lima beans, trimmed | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 bunch green onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley or 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh basil leaf or 1/3 cup fresh parsley
instructions: Rinse beans, then drain. In a small bowl, combine yogurt, salt and 1/2 cup water and whisk to blend. In another small bowl, combine green onions, parsley, and remaining 3/4 cup water and stir until water holds it shape. Cut the greens into 2 1/2 inch pieces and set aside. In two small serving bowls, arrange beans in rows, alternating rows if desired. Just before serving, toss with yogurt dressing. Sprinkle with remaining parsley and basil just before serving.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,kidney bean,spring onion,scallion,basil leaf,chevre goat cheese,peach,broccoli floret
title: Capsicum Con Egan-Style Salad
ingredients: 3 leaves basil leaves | 1 spring onion | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1 cup prepared kidney beans, rinsed, drained and mashed | 200 g chevre goat cheese, chopped | 250 g broccoli florets | 1 cup firm ripe peach, peeled, chopped | 2 medium scallions, chopped | 1/4 head cauliflower, chopped coarsely
instructions: In a salad bowl, combine the chopped basil, chopped spring onion and dried basil leaves and set aside. In another salad bowl, mix the kidney beans, soft cheese, chopped boiled vegetables and diced peach. Pour over the bean mix and stir. Add the spring onion and dried basil mix and toss again. Chill. Just before serving scatter the chopped cauliflower around the top, add the chopped scallions garnish and serve.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,parmigiano reggiano cheese,head napa cabbage,cheddar cheese cube,tamarind paste,curry paste
title: Hot Cheese With Cabbage and Masago Cheese
ingredients: 1 small head napa cabbage, cored and shredded ( about 8 cups ) | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup freshly grated cheddar cheese cubes | 1/2 teaspoon hot curry paste ( such as sambal oelek ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Cover cabbage in a colander, rinse under cold running water, drain and pat dry. Combine shredded cabbage, parmigiano reggiano cheese, cheddar cheese, curry paste and tamarind paste in a medium bowl and gently stir until cheese is melted. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Transfer cabbage to a greased shallow serving plate spread with cheese mixture and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Easy Duck Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cooked duck legs, or more to taste | 1 bunch fresh dill, finely chopped | 1 package corn tortilla, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Mix duck meat with chopped dill and cut tortillas into 1-inch pieces. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle one side of each tortilla with about 2 tbsps. Of the duck mixture. Roll tortillas into a tight cylinder. Place in hot skillet and cook until tortillas are crisp on the bottom, about 1 minute per side. Place cooked rolled tortillas and remaining duck mixture in a warm serving dish. Serve with green salsa.

Random Ingredients: lime,chocolate baking square,red bell pepper,fruit,olive oil,red curry paste,red wine vinegar,vegetable
title: Easy Chilled Red Bell Pepper and Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, washed, dried and cut into thin slivers | 1/4 cup red curry paste ( i used red curry powder ) | 1 tablespoon fresh orange rind, finely grated | 1 tablespoon lime rind, finely grated | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 8 cups mixed vegetables, cut into thin wedges ( such as baby sweet potatoes, zucchini, green beans, zucchini ) | 4 semi-sweet chocolate baking squares, grated
instructions: For the dressing, put all ingredients in a small bowl and whisk to combine. Place vegetables in a non reactive serving bowl or other container. Pour dressing over vegetables.

title: Spicy Chicken and Penne with Lime, Poppy and Lime
ingredients: 4 tablespoons poppy seeds, roasted | 4 ounces caster sugar | 8 chicken thighs, skinned | 12 ounces penne | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Heat your oven to 200oc/fan 160oc. Spread the poppy seeds onto a large baking tray and bake until golden and fragrant, 10 - 15 minutes. Transfer to a small saucepan and stir the sugar into the poppy seeds. Place the chicken thighs and 2 1/2 tbsp of water in a roasting tin and stir to coat. Cook under a preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, to a light brown colour and cook through. Turn the chicken thigh and pour over the lime syrup. Roast for a further 20 minutes, or until cooked through and sticky. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to packet instructions. Tip into a large serving bowl with the remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Serve with fresh lime wedges. Recipe courtesy of cooking wine by sunflowercooker. Co.

title: Quick Chili Ragu
ingredients: 5 dried new mexico red chili peppers | 1 cup pasta sauce | 3 tablespoons fresh minced anaheim chili, optional ( or 3 tablespoons dried ancho chili )
instructions: Char chili peppers over gas flame or under broiler, rotating evenly, until blackened. Turn frequently, and move outside of chili peppers to evenly darken, or until evenly blackened. Remove and discard stems. Place in a plastic bag for 15 minutes in refrigerator. Peel peppers, slit down one side, and remove seeds. Chop into 1 inch pieces. Combine chili peppers, pasta sauce and chilies in a saucepan. Bring to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, and simmer covered, stirring occasionally and scraping the bottom of the pan occasionally, until sauce is reduced to about 1/. Remove from heat, and allow to cool to room temperature. Taste for seasoning, and add chili peppers if desired.

title: Barthocha Pancakes
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 1 tablespoon fresh lemongrass, chopped | 1 flour tortilla
instructions: Wash shrimp. Drain well. Rinse shrimp and pat dry. Cut shrimp into pieces. Spread shrimp onto hot tortilla, sprinkle with lemon grass and roll up. Eat immediately.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,catsup,grain white rice,parsnip,rye bread,yellow bell pepper,chili paste garlic
title: Chinese Style Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 2 packages long grain white rice | 1 small parsnip, peeled, halved | 1 small yellow bell pepper, sliced | 4 slices rye bread, cut into 2-inch squares | 1/2 cup catsup ( kikkoman ) | 1/2 teaspoon parsley | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste with garlic
instructions: In large bowl, place the rice, parsnips, and yellow pepper. In a small bowl, stir together catsup, parsley, chili paste, and garlic. Pour over rice and vegetables.

title: Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Rinse quinoa thoroughly with the tap and water it's been soaked inches. In a large bowl combine quinoa, sprouts and bean sprouts and mix well.

title: Creamy Spinach
ingredients: 2 bunches spinach leaves, washed and stemmed, or 2 bunches other medium-sized bunch, washed and stemmed | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: Remove any tough stems from the spinach by washing them under running water. Place the spinach and cream of tartar in a large saute pan and bring to a low simmer over medium heat. Be sure to scrape down the sides of the pan as needed. Cover pan and reduce heat to low. Cook for 20 minutes, stirring often. Check moisture level of spinach according to its volume by pressing between the lid and the pan. If needed, cook until spinach is tender. Stir in hot cooked spinach, mix, and serve warm.

title: Beetroot Chips
ingredients: 4 large beets | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, finely chopped
instructions: Wash the beetroot and trim away any beet roots. Wrap each beet in a foil packet and roast in a preheated oven at 140c for 30 minutes, until tender. Cool and remove the beetroots from the foil packet. Peel off any beetroot that has broken or damaged outer peel and discard. Wrap each piece individually with a piece of cheese cloth, tie with kitchen string and place on a wire rack over a baking tray. Whisk together the chocolate syrup, olive oil and thyme in a bowl, then brush the beetroot chips liberally with the mixture. Bake on the centre shelf of an oven heated to 120c for 10 minutes, until dark brown around the edges and crispy.

title: Yummy Chicken and Rice Noodles Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 8 ounces rice noodles | 1/2 pint grapes
instructions: Slice chicken in thin strips. Cook rice noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse and cool. Rinse and cut grapes into halves. Toss chicken with noodles and grapes. Serve chilled. Garnish with a small bunch of chopped red onion.

Random Ingredients: club soda,vegetable stock,chambord raspberry liquor,pearl barley
title: Choc-Harvest Ripe Barley Soup
ingredients: 25 ml chambord raspberry liquor | 200 ml vegetable stock | 225 g pearl barley, washed | 4 cups hot cooked tapioca pearl barley
instructions: Dissolve the chambord in a 1 quart of hot stock and put into a large heatproof jug or pan with a pouring spout. Dissolve pearl barley in the remaining stock and pour into the pan with the chambord. Cover with a lid and bring the soup to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Towards the end of the recipe pour in another cup of hot stock and stir through the barley and serve with a drizzle of chambord.

title: Easy Chicken and Turnip Casserole
ingredients: 500 g skinless chicken thighs | 300 g turnips ( peeled ) | 4 slices breadcrumbs | 60 g soft white bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200degc. Line with baking paper. Place chicken in large frypan and cover with cold water. Bring to boil and cook for 10 mins, covered. Add turnip and cook for 5 minutes then drain well. Place breadcrumbs in large bowl. Turn chicken in same bowl and coat well with breadcrumbs. Place chicken in baking paper and bake for 15 mins, covered, in oven, until cooked through. Remove cover and cook for 1 minute, then return to oven for a further 2 mins to crisp each side.

Random Ingredients: topping,kidney bean,beef tenderloin,egg white,mayonnaise,ancho chile powder,vodka
title: Pork-Stuffed Beef Tenderloin With Kidney Beans and White Gravy
ingredients: 16 ounces dried kidney beans | 1 teaspoon chipotle powder or 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 3 tablespoons vodka | 2 egg whites | 3 -4 lbs beef tenderloin | top with mayonnaise ( optional )
instructions: Rinse beans and place in a medium bowl with about 2 quarts salted water, and soak overnight. Drain beans thoroughly, and drain water again. Combine 1 tsp chipotle powder, the mayonnaise, chili powder and 2 tsp ancho chile powder, and set aside. Trim all fat from beef. Dry roast under broiler, and place meat on rack in broiler pan about 3 inches from heat, approximately 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Place beef on rack in oven to keep warm. When roast is finished, remove from oven, and tent with aluminum foil. Let meat rest, at least 15 minutes, up to an hour for juices to redistribute. Slice thinly across the grain, about 1/4 inch thick. Top slices with your desired gravy, and serve with a few spoonfuls of mayonnaise on the side. Note, to open crockpot, arrange 1 or 2 layers of bean, meat and a few slices of tomato on the bottom of the oven, alternating as you go along, making sure each layer covers the entire surface of the crockpot.

title: Stuffed Feta Leaves
ingredients: 1 lb feta | 1/4 cup celery, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Cut stalks off feta leaves and discard. Cut sticks in half crosswise, then cut in half crosswise. Put feta sticks in a bowl, add celery and stir in pepsi mirin. Turn upside down and let stand while drying leaves for 2 to 4 hours, until feta is dry. Turn in towel and cut out just enough leaves so the feta can be closed. Place bundles in bowl and fill with feta mixture. If stuffing is too soft, squeeze a little water from the bowl with your hands to loosen. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve at room temp or cold.

title: Beer Cured Salmon With Savory Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 whole bottom round roast, about 9 ounces | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1 head cabbage, quartered ( optional ) | 1 bottle guinness stout | 1 bottle dry chutney | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Cut into serving size pieces, about 9 slices each. Arrange in a very large container. Add celery, cabbage and guinness. Serve with chutney and cornstarch to coat.

title: Beef Fries With Asian Pear Mash #5FIX
ingredients: 12 ounces french fries ( about a 3/4 pound pack ) | 12 ounces steak asian pears, peeled, cored, sliced, and halved ( about 1 1/4 pound pack ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat milk | 1/4 cup dark beer ( or something sweet and sour like brummel & brown ) | 1 -2 tablespoon baking potato ( see note ) ( optional )
instructions: Note, you can serve the beef fries with asian pear mash also. They also can be served plain or they can be mixed up and added to the mash for vegetarian korean style. Cooking time does not include time for steaming the fries. Heat nonstick skillet to medium high. Add pears to pan and cook until they are just tender, 3 - 5 minutes per side. Cut fries into bite sized slices. Place french fries, cut side up in the skillet. Place milk, beer, and baking potato in separate skillet. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cover. Cook until fries are tender, 15 - 20 minutes. Spoon the beef fries into a bowl and mash well with low fat sour cream, minced garlic, and sugar free bread crumbs. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,onion salt,plum tomato,chunky peanut butter,green cardamom,couscous,floury potato
title: Easy Peanut Butter Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 large floury potato, peeled and finely chopped | 1 pinch onion salt | 2 teaspoons plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter, smooth, smooth | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, toasted | 1 dash ground green cardamom | 1 tablespoon chunky peanut butter, smooth, creamy | 1 -2 tablespoon couscous ( plain )
instructions: Cook the potato in boiling water until just tender. Drain, cool, then gently mash with the tomato, onion salt, and remaining ingredients. Season with pepper.

title: Pomegranate Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, trimmed of all visible fat | 5 ounces pomegranate juice | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1 poblano pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari, vegan type | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken stock
instructions: Put pomegranate juice in a bowl. Cut the sirloin into thin strips and pour over the juice, cover and refrigerate for at least an hour or up to overnight. When ready to serve, slice the poblano, remove the seeds, and then slice across the grain in thin strips. In a bowl, combine the pomegranate juice, serrano chile and tamari and mix. Heat a pan until very hot, then toss the beef with the pomegranate paste to coat the meat. Turn down the heat to medium, then cook the beef for about five minutes. Serve with rice, and top with pomegranate sauce.

title: Creamy Jalapeno Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 cups whipped topping | 2 tablespoons yoghurt or 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the first seven ingredients.

title: Singapore Fish Curry
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon green curry paste ( or a little thai kitchen brand ) | 1/2 cup light rum ( or rum verjuice ) | 3 lbs fish, cut in bite-sized pieces ( salmon, tuna, halibut or swordfish work best ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: In a large skillet, heat up curry paste until fragrant. Add fish pieces and simmer, covered for 20 minutes. Add rum verjuice and stir. Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes. Sprinkle sesame seeds over top. Serve hot.

title: Easy Microwave Stuffed Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 loaf french bread, cut in 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Stir together ricotta cheese and cayenne. Place slices of french bread on a plate, and spread each slice with a little of the cheese mixture. Microwave on high power for 4 minutes, or until cheese is melted and begins to bubble. Cut a slice of the bread in half to serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,basmati rice,phyllo dough,green chili,nori,sesame seed,beef brisket
title: Asian-Style Brisket and Pasta (Baked)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked basmati rice ( can sub basmati rice or white converted rice if you have time ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 -2 pinch garlic salt | 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup sliced green chili | 2 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | naity nori, cut into triangles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f spread sesame seeds on a baking sheet, or use your fingers if you're making this. Sprinkle the sesame seeds and garlic salt over the brisket. Mix all the ingredients for the brisket together in a bowl. Arrange the brisket on top of the sesame. Sprinkle the peppers over the brisket. Wrap the sheets of phyllo dough with plastic wrap and set aside. Bake the brisket, uncovered, in the oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until it is cooked and tender. Serve immediately with rice.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,baby portabella mushroom,jumbo shrimp,tabasco sauce
title: Shrimp & Portuguese Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp ( or shrimp of your choice ) | 1 package baby portabella mushrooms ( or sliced portobello mushrooms ) | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon pickled jumbo shrimp
instructions: Peel the shrimp or shrimp of your choice and devein them in a bowl with salt. Rinse the shrimp or shrimp out of the bag. Rinse the shrimp or shrimp and slice them into 3/8 pieces. Set aside. Prepare the spice mix by combining the coriander powder, tabasco, and the shrimp powder with a small amount of water. Set out the shrimp, shrimp, and shrimp in a pan. Sprinkle the spice mix over the shrimp or shrimp. Cover lightly and cook on medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until the shrimp is cooked. Turn off heat. Serve hot on a pretty plate or pasta of your choice.

title: Raspberry and Amaretto Chardonnay
ingredients: 7 ounces tomato puree ( or other fruity flavored ) | 2 tablespoons gravy mix ( see recipe below for other recipes ) | 1 pint fresh raspberries or 1 pint frozen raspberries, defrosted | 6 ounces good beer or 6 ounces light beer | 2 ounces dry sherry wine or 2 ounces bourbon | 1 ounce amaretto ( optional )
instructions: Mix together tomato puree and gravy mix in a bowl. Cut raspberries in half, place into a glass pitcher or serving dish and pour over the tomato puree mixture. Add beer until dish is about 1/2 full, such as wine and amaretto. Cover bowl tightly and refrigerate overnight. Before serving, add a splash of amaretto into the chardonnay and garnish with a fresh raspberries.

title: Mushrooms in Spicy Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups thick mushrooms | 8 fluid ounces chambord raspberry liquor | 3 large cloves | 24 cooked pasta shells | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Cook the pasta in lightly salted water until al dente and drain. Add the mushrooms, chambord and cloves to the pasta. Heat for 8 - 10 minutes, until hot. Serve warm on top of warm sauce, garnished with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: safflower oil,icing sugar,thyme,iceberg lettuce,italian tomato,sesame seed,creole mustard
title: Safflower Seed Salad
ingredients: 2 cups drained italian tomatoes | 1 head chicke lettuce ( rinsed and sliced ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 cups icing sugar | 2 teaspoons creole mustard | 1 teaspoon crushed thyme | 1 -2 tablespoon safflower oil
instructions: Chop the chicke lettuce into bite size pieces and mix with 2 cups of sesame seeds. Beat the 2 cups of icing sugar with the safflower oil and pour over the salad. Toss together and serve.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 cup commercial balsamic vinaigrette | 4 pounds chicken wings, separated at joints
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Stir balsamic vinaigrette and chicken wings together in a large baking dish. Bake the chicken in the preheated oven until the wings are deep golden brown and the sauce is bubbling, about 30 minutes.

title: Burn Hazelnut Apple Juice Bar For Kate's German Kinder Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 2 cups apple juice ( i usually use kirsch )
instructions: Grind the hazelnuts and apple juice in a food processor until it becomes a coarse puree. Pour puree into a clean jar and store in the freezer.

title: Lentils in Oil (Yummil)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil, plus extra for deep frying | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/2 cup dry split green lentils | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a frypay to 200ml/7oz deep fry the lentils until they are well golden brown. Transfer to a bowl. Remove fry pay to a warmed platter or tray and set aside. Add the garlic to the same pan. Cook for 1 minute, then add the tomato sauce. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes, or until thickened slightly. Pour into the lentils. Serve immediately. Serve with rice if liked.

title: Peanut Butter Dessert  (Amarena's Peanut Soup )
ingredients: 1 can cream soup | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 cup single cream | 2 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Blend everything together with a stick blender. Place in bowl and chill. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,beef stock,dressing,red pepper,nonfat plain yogurt
title: Ranch Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 3/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/3 cup instant minced onion | 1/4 cup beef stock | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | shredded lettuce, to top
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a medium bowl, combine ground beef and yogurt. Add minced onion, beef stock and cheese. Mix well. Place dip in an ovenproof serving dish. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve topped with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,puff pastry,cilantro,marsala,chicken quarter,loaf italian bread,soymilk,onion powder
title: Italian Chicken-Puff Pastry Bread Casserole
ingredients: 4 loaves focaccia bread, sliced 2 inches thick | 1 lb ground chicken quarter | 1/4 cup marsala | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup light cream | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 1 deli-style loaf of italian bread, torn into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Arrange bread slices on the bottom and up sides in a 2+4 quart casserole dish, each slice slightly overlapping to cover the tops. In a medium bowl, combine chicken, marsala, onion powder, cilantro and 1 package of frozen puff pastry sheets. Place into dish with the bread. In a small bowl, combine soymilk or light cream and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh cilantro, mix well until well incorporated. Pour evenly over the top of the bread mixture. Place dish on middle rack of oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven, cover loosely with foil and let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with cilantro and serve.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,green chili pepper,apple cider,paprika,dark beer,kosher salt,cherry,spring wrapper
title: Beer and Poppy Dust Pot Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 6 spring roll wrappers | 1 cup dark beer or 1 cup beer | 1 green chili pepper | 1 cup cherries ( chopped ) | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 cup apple cider | kosher salt
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions. Dump quinoa into a large bowl and add all other ingredients. Stir well, then add more beer or wine depending on your tastes. Cover and refrigerate at least overnight. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Line a pizza stone with parchment paper and lightly oil stone. Spread pizza dough onto dough to create a circle that is about 11/2 x 13. Sprinkle more paprika on the pizza while the oven has it preheating. Bake in the middle of oven until top is almost dry, about 12 minutes.

title: Chiletan Kale and Noodles
ingredients: 400 -500 g baby kale, washed | 3 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 200 g egg noodles
instructions: Slice the kale 3/4 inch thick and roughly chop half the more stems if you have it, place in colander, rinse well until you can squeeze out excess water. Crush the kale coarsely using your hands if you wish, but it can be done with your hands if you prefer. Place the oil and egg yolks in a bowl and whisk until well combined. Place your kale in a large frypan or wok. Heat over a medium heat, stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes until wilted. Remove from heat. Drain the kale leaves and place into a bowl with the egg and water mix. Cook over low heat for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve immediately with hot, cooked egg noodles.

title: Halibut in Fruit Compote
ingredients: 2 skinless halibut fillets | 4 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1 can mixed vegetables | 6 ounces lean ground pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f place halibut in a large shallow baking pan. Bake until flaky and lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Peach Soup With Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 package of sliced smoked sausage | 3 boxes frozen broccoli florets | 1 can sliced peaches | 1 tablespoon the rub seasonings from gravy ( you can use any seasonings or salt as needed ) | 3 -4 cups boiling water
instructions: Boil the broccoli with garlic for 5 minutes. Drain it and set aside. Using a wok, add canola oil and sausages. Cook till browned. Add the spices, and cook for 5 minutes. Add the broccoli, simmer for 3 - 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Pea Grilled Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin, cut into 2 x 1/2-inch x 2-inch rectangles | salt substitute | 1/2 lb fresh green peas or 1/2 lb frozen green pea | 1 jar sliced pepperoni, cut in 1-inch pieces ( you may use more, if you wish ) | 3 tablespoons light molasses | grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a large saute pan, add beef and sprinkle generously with salt substitute. Use a meat tenderizer to pound the beef into about 1/4 inch thick patties. Set aside for about 5 minutes per side for medium rare beef, 6 to 7 minutes per side for well done work beef. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, add peas, pepperoni, molasses and salt and pepper. Toss and set aside. Remove beef from heat, let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the meat on two large baking sheets. Heat a large pan over medium heat. Lightly oil the pan. Sear the beef for 3 to 5 minutes to sear evenly then turn and sear 2 to 3 minutes or until desired doneness. Place the cooked meat on a rack set in a roasting pan. Insert a toothpick through the thick part of your meat to hold the filling in place with juices. Pour peas evenly over meat.. Add more salt substitute, if desired. Sprinkle cheese over everything. Cover loosely with foil with foil. Bake for about 35 minutes or until heated through. Remove toothpicks and serve.

title: Apple Sausage With Apple and Pimento
ingredients: 8 -12 ounces smoked hot italian sausage | 2 -3 medium red apples, pared and cored | pimiento | garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Slice apples evenly across grain. Add a little garlic powder if desired. Put apples and the pimentos on a serving platter. Put italian sausage on top of apple mixture.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,lemon juice zest,head cauliflower,blueberry,tart apple,cod fillet
title: Dutch Oven Fish and Barley
ingredients: 2 large heads cauliflower, broken into florets | 4 quarts water, or as needed | 2 teaspoons lemon juice and zest | 8 medium tart apples - peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1 cup pearl barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread cauliflower out onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes, then stir until cauliflower has absorbed the liquid and turned light brown. Serve warm.

title: Greek Couscous
ingredients: 275 g couscous, cooked in boiling water until al dente | 100 ml white wine, warm | 3 -4 anchovies, whole if you like it spicy | 100 -150 g pork, cooked thinly and shredded | 100 -150 g spinach leaves, tough stems removed and washed ( about 150 grams ) | 1 -2 ripe black olives, stoned and sliced | 1 -2 small greek olive, stoned and sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place the hot couscous in a large mixing bowl. Add the warm wine and anchovies. Stir to combine. Add the pork, spinach and olives, if using. Taste and adjust seasoning accordingly. Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,turkey,gin,lemon juice,white wine,fish sauce,onion powder,broccoli
title: Chinese Tea Sandwiches with Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium gin | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped onion powder ( optional ) | 3 cups sliced cooked turkey | 4 cups fresh broccoli, coarsely chopped | 6 crusty white or 6 wheat rolls
instructions: Mix gin and canola oil in small bowl, then stir in lemon juice, fish sauce and onion powder. Set aside. In large bowl, combine turkey, broccoli and onion. Spread 1/4 cup reserved gin mixture on top of turkey mixture, then arrange 1/4 cup turkey mixture on top. Roll up each roll. Serve immediately.

title: Chef Dave's Penne Fettuccine
ingredients: 12 ounces bacon bits | 1 jar sweet italian sausage, chopped | 24 ounces sweet potato sticks | 4 cups salad greens | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1 lb dry fettuccine
instructions: Heat bacon bits over medium heat in a large skillet, stirring occasionally, until grease is rendered and mixture begins to caramelize. Pour the browned bits into a deep colander and let drain to drain completely. Reserve 1/2 cup drippings in skillet, and place sausage in the skillet. Cook 3 minutes, stirring, until browned. Remove sausage with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add potato sticks to drippings and stir to coat. Cook 6 - 8 minutes, stirring once, until slightly tender. Toss with 2 1/2 cups salad greens and 1/2 teaspoon allspice. Stir to combine, and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon butter. Taste and adjust seasoning. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add 1 t. Of reserved bacon grease, and cook pasta according to package directions. Do not overcook pasta, the fettuccine should be al dente and still a little firm. Drain pasta and return to pot, add sausage mixture, and stir to combine. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,mexican cheese,sesame oil,basmati rice,vegemite,shiitake mushroom
title: Super-Easy Shittake Rice With Pesto & Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 shiitake mushrooms, sliced thinly | 2 cups basmati rice | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 teaspoon vegemite | 1/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large non stick pan over a medium heat. Add mushrooms & cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until softened. Add rice & cook for 1 minute, stirring. Add pesto & vegetableite, increase temperature to high & heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until pesto is hot. Garnish with cheese & serve when ready.

title: Adobo Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles, uncooked | 4 ounces ham hocks, cut into strips | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon adobo sauce, from can ( i will go back on one ) | adobo sauce, from can ( i will go back on one )
instructions: Bring 9 quarts of water to a boil in a large deep pot. While the water is coming up to a boil, cut the ham hocks from the can. Put the ham hock pieces inside each lasagna noodle then pour the soy sauce over the ham hocks. After the water comes back up to a boil, take the lasagna noodles from the boiling water and drop them in the water. When the pasta is ready, drain the noodles and add them to the pot. Cook over medium high heat 3 to 4 minutes or until they are crisp. Place the rashers on a plate and put them in the freezer in a freezer bag for 2 hours. In the meantime, reheat the adobo sauce in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave on high. Remove the rashers from the bag and discard the fat. Remove the ham hocks from the bag and add them to the noodles. Heat 3 - 4 minutes on high until the sauce is reduced by half.

title: Avocado Margaritas (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 firm avocados | 1 tablespoon triple sec | celery, lime wedge
instructions: Halve avocados lengthwise and remove pit. Scoop pit into a blender. Puree with triple sec. Place into a margarita glass. Garnish with celery and lime wedge.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,chili pepper flake,corn syrup,linguine,ice water,asparagus spear,bacon
title: Linguini Alla Carbonara
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 12 asparagus spears, halved cut in thirds | 1 -2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 -4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon corn syrup | 1 -2 teaspoon bacon fat | 2 -3 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil with 3/4 teaspoon salt. When boiling add spaghetti and cook for 10 - 12 minute drain and rinse with cold water for pasta to cook. Mix spaghetti sauce ingredients into bowl with drained asparagus and cut up into 1 inch pieces. Add pasta and asparagus to sauce and toss to coat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,leg lamb,pita bread,italian dressing,brown sugar,asparagus
title: Lamb Chops With Broccoli & Asparagus
ingredients: 4 medium boneless leg of lamb, trimmed | 1 bunch asparagus, cut in 1-inch sticks | 2 bunches broccoli florets | 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup italian dressing | 3 pita bread rounds, warmed
instructions: Place lamb in a shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle with sugar and drizzle with dressing. Arrange asparagus and broccoli sticks around lamb. Roast uncovered at 400 degrees for 50 minutes to 1 hour or until tender. Heat oven to broil. Place pita bread on rack set in a baking pan. Place lamb and vegetables on pita breads. Place under broiler until warm and lightly browned.

title: Strawberry Cream Shortbread
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 cup fresh strawberries ( hulled and sliced or frozen ) | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the flour and cream. Add chopped strawberries to the flour and cream, then add the sliced or frozen peppers. Stir in the dry ingredients. Press onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Whip cream until stiff. Spread cream on cooled cookie and return to 350 degrees or 150 degrees for 5 minutes to set crust.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,cocoa,garlic salt,rice,rice wine,french bread,green cardamom,sun tomato
title: Rice Bread and Sun-Dried Tomato Casserole
ingredients: 1 french bread, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs baby carrots | 2 cups fresh baby carrots | 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomato | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1/8 teaspoon green cardamom | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Place bread cubes in a single layer into a 9x9 inch glass baking dish that will fit under your broiler. Cut each piece of bread into approximately 1 cubes. Place 1/2 of the chopped carrots into a food processor along with the baby carrots, sun dried tomatoes, 1/2 cup of rice wine, 1 tablespoon of garlic salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of garlic salt. Pulse mixture until smooth. Remove about half of the mixture per bowl and save and reserve for later. Repeat process with remaining vegetables. Pour 1/4 cup of rice wine in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Cover and shake well to distribute over the rice wine. Sprinkle tomato mixture over the rice wine. Transfer the dish to the oven and cook for 35 minutes, or until liquid in the dish has absorbed. Stir the reserved tomato mixture into the skillet. Cover and continue cooking for about 30 minutes, or until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Stir in 1/4 cup rice wine, 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of garlic salt.

title: Japanese Chicken and Avocado Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups prepared dashi | 3 tablespoons dried chestnut mushrooms | 2 skinless chicken thighs - cut into chunks | 3 hass avocadoes
instructions: Bring the dashi and chestnut mushrooms to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for about 5 minutes. Stir in the chicken and the avocado.

title: Beef, Bhok Choy and Dates in Dates
ingredients: 200 g beef chuck, julienne | 10 -20 dates, whole ( medium ) | 250 g bok choy, trimmed and cut into wedges
instructions: Combine all the ingredients. Cover and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 48 hours, stirring often. Transfer the beef and its marinade to a flat based frying pan or barbecue and fry over a low heat until the beef pieces are dark brown on all sides and cooked to your liking. Serve immediately.

title: Veal Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 lb veal stock or 1/2 lb chicken stock ( or veg stock mixed with chicken fat to make duck stock ) | 1 large rolled up roll ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons strawberry jam | 1/4 cup golden raisin | crushed desiccated coconut ( to sprinkle ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200 deg celsius, grease roll tin and line with baking paper. In a large pan, combine gravy ingredients together and stir over a medium heat, do not boil, stir occasionally till mixture comes to the boil remove from heat, pour carefully onto the baking paper.
