Cover with the cloth and put into the oven til cooked thru, about 20 - 30 mins until crispy. Sprinkle with coconut before serving, or use as a side dish with a main meal at lunchtime. We like to serve this roll with british country wine and green veg, then wrap up in foil and heat in the oven til hot and bubbly around the edges. Eat warm or cold.

title: African Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped kale
instructions: Place the tamarind concentrate in a heavy skillet. Bring the mixture to boiling.

title: Kielbasa and Chocolate (Cook's Illustrated)
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa ( halved lengthwise and sliced crosswise ) | 10 ounces cocoa mix ( use the dutch's kind if you can find it, but the mexican cocoa mix works very well ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: In a dutch oven that's been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, brown the kielbasa in a single layer. You probably won't need to use all the sausage until it's finished, but don't go anywhere near it. Stir to redistribute sausage in the pan to brown lightly, but don't burn. Pour over cocoa mix and stir until thoroughly mixed. Stir in dark soy sauce, scraping down sides of pan and heat until chocolate begins to melt. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,orange juice zest,coleslaw mix,angel hair pasta,grain bun
title: Orange Pepperoni Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup orange zest | 1 red pepper, chopped | 1 package coleslaw mix | 6 whole grain buns or 6 tostadas
instructions: Cook pasta, drain and rinse it in a large pot of boiling water until barely al dente. Drain thoroughly while still warm. Prepare coleslaw mix and add to pasta. Add more orange juice or zest as desired to taste. Serve over toasted buns.

title: Spicy Pesto
ingredients: 3/4 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/4 cup dry sherry
instructions: Warm the pesto sauce in a saucepan until smooth over moderately low heat. Do not let the sauce to boil.

title: Fancy French Baked Onion Pie
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon thyme ( dried )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine thyme and pepper. Press over crust. Bake at 400 f for 30 minutes or until crust puffs.

Random Ingredients: corn,flat leaf parsley,pine nut,chinese red chile bean paste,floury potato,sugar snap pea
title: Sweet Potato and Corn With Chilli Peas
ingredients: 4 small sweet potatoes or 4 small aubergines | 1/2 teaspoon chinese red chile bean paste | 200 g peeled sugar snap peas | 150 g thawed frozen sweet corn | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c with a piece of greasproof paper on a high and lightly spray or lightly use a baking tray. Slice the potato into long strips the same width and thickness as the vegetables. Heat a wok over a medium high heat and add the bean paste. Fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the sugar, peas and corn, then stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes, until the sugar has melted and the corn has started to soften. Spread the sweet potato strips over the base and sides of the warmed stir fry. Sprinkle with the chopped parsley. Place in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until the potato is just cooked through, but not burnt.

title: French Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole white chicken | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 can crushed graham crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place a rack 6 inches from the heat and heat the oven to 325 degrees f. Pat the chicken dry. Place a large casserole dish in the oven to keep warm while you prep the rest of the meal. Rinse the chicken inside and out. Break off and discard the chicken wing tips. Open the chicken breast out of the shell and, using the flat side of a knife, make small slits in the shell that will eventually separate the meat from the skin. Fill the casserole with bread crumbs. Sprinkle the crackers on top. Place chicken on top of the crumbs, then sprinkle crumbs again on top of the crumbs. Repeat with the remaining chicken. If you like a browned crust, sprinkle more crumbs on top of the chicken. Place the casserole into the preheated oven and bake until the bread crumbs have melted and turned golden, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,wheat flour,fish sauce,sugar,pecorino romano cheese,savory
title: Pancake Pizza with Savory Pecorino-Pecorino
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 teaspoon dried parsley ( chopped fresh herbs ) | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Lightly moisten hands and hands in water to remove excess water. Combine flour, savory, sugar, parsley, and fish sauce in shallow bowl. Dip hands in dry ingredients and make a well in the center. Add pecorino and toss until combined. Spread on pizza crust. Sprinkle on remaining 3/4 cup cheese and add 1 tbsp water to well. Seal, and preheat 425°f bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Tangy Saffron Kidney Beans
ingredients: 3 cups dry kidney beans, soaked overnight | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and coarsely chopped | 5 saffron strands | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 pieces saffron strands | 1 piece asparagus | 1 slice fresh raspberry | 3 tablespoons saffron strands | 2 pieces crystallized ginger root, crushed | 1 tablespoon rock sugar ( optional )
instructions: Drain soaked kidney beans. Combine soaked kidney beans, 1 piece ginger, 1 saffron strand, 2 tablespoons vinegar, 2 pieces saffron strands, and asparagus. Place in heavy saucepan. Cover with water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until almost tender, about 2 hours. Dry fry 1 piece of ginger in small amount of hot oil. Remove and discard ginger slices. Fry in the same hot oil briefly. Add rosewater and pineapple slices.

title: No-Egg Italian Breadcrumb Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 cup italian breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon equal sugar substitute | 1 1/2 tablespoons buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Let stand 10 minutes. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350°f for 10 minutes. Turn off oven and let stand 15 minutes until cookies are crisp. Remove from sheets. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Farfalle (Pasta With Oranges)
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 2 oranges, peel of, cut into 1/2-inch dice
instructions: Cook the pasta, in lots of salted boiling water until 'al dente' — which should take about 8 - 7 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick frying pan put the orange peel. Slice off the ends of the oranges and then add them cut side down. Place them in a single layer on the work surface with the orange peel. Cook them over a high flame until they start to sizzle a bit — this will take 5 - 10 minutes. Do not let them burn. When the orange peel is done, add a cup of cold water, about 1/4 cup at a time, stirring very vigorously, until there is a creamy, syrupy sauce. Turn off the heat and toss with the pasta. Variation, when adding the pasta you can also add a few ounces of cooked canned or fresh tomatoes or some fresh green peppers, chopped, and a small bit of sliced truffle oil. The longer i cook, the more the flavors will meld..

title: Frijoles Borrachos (Mashed Beans With Rice)
ingredients: 2 lbs dry pinto beans, picked over and rinsed | 1 large yellow onion, sliced thin | 2 cups red wine or 2 cups beer | 3 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 cup rolled oats
instructions: The night before, place the beans and onion in a pan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and boil gently until tender, about 2 hours. Drain the liquid out of the boiled beans and place into a large bowl. Stir in the wine or beer, oregano and rolled oats. Stir together and chill overnight for flavors to blend.

title: Pulhametes de Frutta (Bacon and Eggplant)
ingredients: 4 small eggplants | 1 pinch saffron | 2 slices thick slab bacon | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, 200°c slice bacon into 1cm slices, and fry over high heat until fat has rendered and fat is starting to brown. Reserve. Peel and slice eggplants into 1cm slices, length ways. Place eggplant slices on an oven tray, with the saffron, bacon, sherry and bicarb. Bake for about 30 minutes, until vegetables are tender. Stir the cream through and simmer until thickened. Spread patties onto a plate and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,sriracha sauce,raisin,salt black pepper,green onion
title: Asian Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced green onions | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Soak the raisins in warm water for 3 hours. Drain and pat dry. Cut the sirloin into very thin slices.

title: Italian Baked Lettuce Wraps (Food for the Devil)
ingredients: 5 large heads radially-chopped lettuce ( green or romaine ) | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1/2 cup chopped almonds, toasted | 1/8 cup catsup | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 dash corn oil
instructions: Combine the dressing ingredients, toss, and serve.

title: Tourtiere (French Roasted Stuffed Chicken)
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs young roasting chickens | 2 cans pork and sausage | pork sausage
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Wash chicken and pat dry with paper towels. Place in baking pan with sausage, fat side up with chicken fat side down. Spread pork and sausage mixture over chicken. Cover tightly and bake in preheated oven about 2 1/2 hours, basting frequently. Remove cover, turn over and bake about 30 - 45 minutes longer. Remove chicken and sausage from oven and let stand about 15 minutes until cool enough to handle, cut in 1/4 slices and arrange on platter.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,bacon,spanish onion,graham cracker crumb,orange marmalade,chunky salsa
title: Orange Blossom Salsa Bacon Cheesecake
ingredients: 6 large bacon slices, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1 large spanish onions or 1 large vidalia onion, thinly sliced | 2 cups cheezey's spanish onion dip mix, with marmalade | 1 cup orange marmalade | 1 1/4 cups thick & chunky salsa | 1/2 cup orange blossom water | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs or 1/2 cup chopped semisweet chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray 9 inch springform pan with nonstick cooking spray, or brush or spray inside and out with some cooking oil. Place bacon strips and onion slices into baking dish and bake 15 to 20 minutes, or until bacon is golden and crisp. Stir often while baking. Dip mix in marmalade and orange blossoms until evenly coated. Spoon into the baked bacon and bake 10 minutes. While baking, combine the salsa and orange blossom water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool 5 minutes. Pour evenly into prepared crust. Smooth top and sprinkle with reserved cheese. Place in oven and bake until topping is bubbling and browned, about 25 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes, and then cut into bars.

Random Ingredients: vodka,green bean,baking powder,cilantro,self rising corn meal mix,vegetable stock
title: Chili Nonalcoholic
ingredients: 1 can green beans, drained | 0.5 can self-rising corn meal mix | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vodka | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients to a greased 13x9 inch baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minute. Enjoy.

title: Korean Sesame Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef round sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 lb squash, sliced 1/2-inch thick | 1 medium yellow onion, chopped | 8 pieces beef sirloin steaks | 4 cups sesame seeds
instructions: Cut beef up into 1 inch pieces. Combine sesame seeds and 1 cup cold water in a large bowl. Add beef and marinate up to 2 hours. Heat the meat in the large pot until brown on both sides and cooked through. Add beef and squash to the stew and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Tomato Salad
ingredients: 10 roma tomatoes, each cut in half | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Arrange the four tomatoes and chili oil in serving bowls. Mix together the vinegar and oil and pour over them. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,bean sprout,tapioca flour,russet potato,garlic,chocolate,cilantro,deli roast beef
title: Roasted Beef Wrapped in Chocolate
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tapioca flour | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 4 4 ounces deli smoked deli lean beef or 4 ounces deli sirloin roast beef, sliced into strips | 2 1/2 ounces shredded chocolate | 2 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 6 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | bean sprouts or lettuce, to garnish
instructions: Stir tapioca flour in small bowl with parmigiano reggiano cheese. Set aside. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until just beginning to smoke. Swirl in garlic and stir 30 seconds. Sear beef until cooked but not browned, about 2 minutes. Remove beef to plate.

title: Cranberry Snacks
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cranberries | 4 -5 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried fennel | 1 tablespoon cardamom seeds | 2 tablespoons crushed dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom
instructions: Strip and wash the cranberries and place in a bowl. Chop the herbs and add to the cranberries. Mix well. Sprinkle with crushed dried cranberries. Sprinkle crushed dried herbs ontotop and mix. Store in the refrigerator until needed.

title: American Hummus
ingredients: 1 can bush's beans or ( 16 ounce ) can pinto beans, drained | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Drain can of beans and rinse with cold water. Open beans and stir in pepper. Refrigerate a minimum of 20 minutes before serving.

title: Blueberry Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces bread or 4 ounces whole wheat bread, dry, torn into small bites | 2 pints vegetable stock, made up with vegetable stock cubes and water ( preferably homemade please ) | 2 bunches blueberries or 2 bunches red berries, washed and picked
instructions: Put the bread pieces in a large saucepan and drizzle over the stock. Cover with enough water to reach the top of the bread, just a little, and bring to the boil over medium high heat, then reduce the heat slightly. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the bread is soft. Remove from the heat and let cool. Return the soup to a large pan and reheat over low heat. To serve, arrange some blueberries in the soup and spoon the soup on.

title: Mu Shu Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tahini | 1/2 lb shiitake mushroom
instructions: Heat tehina in an electric skillet until lukewarm. Put shiitake mushrooms in it and let the moisture absorb and the mushrooms absorb flavor. Stir with fork and let it rest. Serve hot.

title: Lamb Soup
ingredients: 1 onion, chopped | 1 piece kielbasa or 1 piece other lean beef, cut into 1/4 inch rounds | 4 cups dashi stock | 1 can chopped green chilies ( i like a large one! ) | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 -3 cups chopped escarole ( i like them mixed )
instructions: Bring dashi and green chilies to a boil. Add meat, oregano and nutmeg. Cover and simmer for 30 - 45 minutes until meat is tender and meat is cooked through. Remove meat with a slotted spoon. Remove the bones, slice meat in chunks and return to the soup. Taste and add salt, pepper if desired. Just before serving add escarole and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: pecan half,graham cracker crumb,pinto bean,white wine vinegar,peanut butter,corn chip
title: Mexican Pecan-Cheese Salad
ingredients: 3 cups crushed cheeze-bake mexican flavored corn chips ( pinto beans ) | 3 cups pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup pecan halves, chopped | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Dressing, combine all ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,green chile pepper,blueberry,quinoa,dijon mustard,angelica,basmati rice
title: Quinoa and Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1/3 cup cubed fresh quinoa ( optional ) | 2 large fresh tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 2 green chile peppers, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice and quinoa and return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Add tomatoes, rosemary, 1 green pepper, dijon mustard and remaining green pepper. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove and discard chile peppers. Stir sauce into rice and heat through. Serve topped with remaining chopped basil.

title: El Pancho's Shredded Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf sandwich bread, cut in half | 1 can vododo ( mexican liquor ) | 1 cup mexican cheese blend, shredded
instructions: Heat liquor, cheese and bread on stove to almost boiling.

title: Cilantro Treacle Pasta.
ingredients: 350 g whole wheat penne | 25 g plain flour | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 3 tablespoons treacle | 1 bunch fresh cilantro | superfine sugar
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water for about 20 mins, drain but leave it to drain. To make the sauce, cook the treacle in a pan, add the cilantro and a splash of water if you want to thicken the sauce. Add the pasta and allow to simmer for about 3 - 4 mins until the pasta is done, stirring regularly. Add this to the sauce.

title: Coconut Soup
ingredients: 1 liter beef stock | 1 can sweetened coconut
instructions: Bring the beef stock to a boil. While waiting for the stock to boil, place the sourened coconut in a deep bowl, in a small pot. Stir this with a big spoon. When the soup comes to a boil, remove the bowl from the heat, add the sour coconut, and serve it.

title: Spanish Eggs Benedict in Foil
ingredients: 1 english muffin, split lengthwise | 2 large egg whites, lightly beaten with | 2 teaspoons capers | 4 lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons capers | 8 dates, cut in quarters
instructions: Heat a 10 nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the muffin halves and cook until just toasted but not soft, 3 to 4 minutes. Flip and toast the other side until golden brown, 2 to 4 minutes longer. Transfer the muffin halves to an ovenproof serving platter. Heat the remaining nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the egg whites and capers to the heated skillet.

title: Grilled Eggplant Tacos for One
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon tamales or 1 tablespoon taco meat seasoning | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon sauerkraut, sliced ( drained ) ( optional )
instructions: Place eggplant in a glass bowl. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over eggplant. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Preheat grill. Place eggplant on grill and close lid and grill, turning occasionally, approximately 30 minutes, or until eggplant is tender.

title: Thai Noodles
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Heat bacon drippings in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook until it turns slightly brown. Stir in the thai fish sauce.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,yellow pepper,dark rum,rice noodle,saffron thread,pork tenderloin
title: Portuguese Pork Rolls-Sate
ingredients: 250 g pork tenderloin, cut into 1 cm strips | 2 yellow peppers, cut into 1 cm strips ( red or green ) | 2 teaspoons saffron threads | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 3 packages rice noodles
instructions: Soak saffron in rum over night. Slice pork into 1 cm thick strips and place in a medium sized bowl. Slice peppers into 1 cm wide strips. Place in a bowl. Slightly crush saffron with a rolling pin. Soak saffron in rum over night, rum, vanilla bean and sugar. Sprinkle pork strips over pork. Line a large baking pan with foil, add pork rounds, and bake at 180 degrees for 45 minutes, or until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees after 45 minutes and pork is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,russet potato,crabmeat,marinade,sugar substitute,caster sugar,lamb rib chop,milk
title: BBQ Lamb Chops With Sweet Potato Mousse
ingredients: 1 russet potato | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( or try maple or other flavourings ) | 1/4 cup caster sugar substitute | 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk | 1/4 cup milk | 2 tablespoons light golden syrup | 5 lamb rib chops | 1/4 cup marinated imitation crabmeat | 8 thick lamb rib chops or 8 thick lamb chops
instructions: Peel the potato and grate into a large bowl. Add the golden syrup and caster sugar. Beat the condensed milk, milk, extra dark syrup and half the caster sugar. Dip the chops into the mixture and press down so they are fully coated. Set aside for about 1 hour while you make the mousse. If you're using lamb, soak the spare ribs in this. Slice the pork chops as best you can and arrange in a single layer on one side of a large plate or tray. If you're using lamb, you may need to cut the chops in half if they're particularly large. Drain any excess moisture and place the mousse side by side in the fridge for 45 minutes to firm up, stirring every so often. If you're using chops, cut them in half lengthways and then into 1cm slices. Heat a bbq plate on the hob, then cook the chops for 3 - 5 minutes each side or until cooked to your liking. Do not overcook them. Serve with sweet potato mousse or serve with the sticky sweet potato mousse to make the sweet potato mousse even more so. The mousse can be left up to 5 days or frozen for up to 2 months. Alternatively pour the mousse into a bowl and allow to thaw overnight in the fridge. You can freeze the mousse for up to 10 days. Add a little of the marinade to a non stick frying pan and heat on medium low to medium. Add the remaining sugar substitute and continue cooking until the sugar dissolves. Pour in the warmed bbq plate and set aside for at least a half hour or until it has turned a caramel colour and has thickened somewhat. Place the lamb chops on one side of the plate, then top with the sweet potato mousse. Place in the back of the bar with the pork chops and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,caster sugar,grand marnier,yellow onion,swiss cheese
title: Red Pepper, Swiss Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 red bell peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 3 yellow onions, finely chopped | 1 1/4 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1/3 cup caster sugar | 3 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Place the red bell peppers, yellow onion, swiss cheese, sugar & grand marnier in a large pan. Simmer over a moderate heat for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat & mix through to warm dip.

title: Baked Caramel Glaze
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°f. Combine dry ingredients and pour into a baking dish or spray with cooking spray. Bake in oven for 30 minutes stirring twice during the baking. It should be a deep golden brown. Remove from oven, uncover and drizzle the glaze over before baking. Cut while warm into squares and drizzle with melted butter again.

title: Nutshell Eggs
ingredients: 3 fluid ounces truffle oil | 3 egg substitute
instructions: Pour the oil into a small frypan and heat over medium low heat. Meanwhile preheat the broiler. Break the eggs into the pan as you would for scrambled eggs. Cook, covered, until the whites are set, lifting the ends occasionally, about 3 minutes on each side. Carefully transfer the pan to the broiler and move it under the broiler to finish cooking the whites. Serve garnished with sprigs of parsley or truffle oil.

title: Spicy Shrimp on Toast - Shrimp on Toast
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, cooked and sliced into bite-sized pieces | 3 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1/4 cup fat-free topping, such as kraft fat free or reduced-fat your choice
instructions: Place half the cooked shrimp into a small bowl and sprinkle with one tablespoon of the pizza sauce. Mix well. Top with the other half of the shrimp, then spread the rest of the pizza sauce over this. In a pan sprayed with the pam, combine the fat free topping with the remaining shrimp and heat up over medium heat. When the ingredients are hot, place half the pieces of shrimp on top and sprinkle generously with the fat free topping.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,onion juice,creme de cacao,orange juice zest,blue cheese,salmon fillet
title: Blue Cheese and Smoked Salmon for Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 teaspoons low-fat creme de cacao ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon orange juice or 1 tablespoon orange juice | 2 teaspoons orange juice, zest of | 4 skinless smoked salmon fillets, cut into 6 chunks | 1 onion, cut into 1/4-inch wide slices | 4 ounces low-fat blue cheese, crumbles | 1 teaspoon low-fat crème de cacao ( or more ) | 4 -8 leaves bean sprouts
instructions: Mix creme de cacao, 1 tablespoon orange juice, 2 teaspoons orange zest, and 2 1/2 tablespoons orange juice in crock pot for a marinade of 30 minutes. Add salmon and spread 2 tablespoons orange juice mixture on top. Turn crock pot onto high, and transfer salmon to crock pot with onion slices. Increase to high, and allow mixture to heat through. If desired, cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 hours to thicken. Stir the remaining 2 tablespoons orange juice mixture into shredded cheese crumbles. Turn on low, and serve on bed of bean sprouts.

title: Gramma's "Fried" Elegant Her Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 pinch saffron ( may add up to 1 t in the oil if you like more spice ) | 6 leaves fresh herb, fresh ( such as dill, chives, parsley, chives, etc. ) | 5 tablespoons dark corn syrup
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce and dry. Cut the lettuce crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Soak the slices in enough cold water to cover for 1 hour. Drain, then add to a salad bowl. Pour over the saffron and herbs then toss to coat. Sprinkle over the syrup and serve immediately. Variation, the idea is to add 1 - 2 t. Flavoured apple cider, cinnamon or even a bit of sugar sprinkled in at the end of the salad. It will also turn into a delicious cinnamon, clove or a rich apple cider flavoured with either honey or a little tart tartar. Note, if you prefer a savoury glamb salad, you can substitute 1 tsp. Of fresh grated ginger or grated nutmeg, or even use fresh parsley or chives..

title: Tortellini Potato Salad Recipe
ingredients: 1 pint half-and-half | 3 cups peeled, sliced red potatoes | 4 cups chopped fresh cheese tortellini | 1 cup shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine half and half and potatoes and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Drain potatoes, reserving liquid, and place on a large salad plate or platter. Layer tortellini over potatoes, then garnish with cheese and remaining potato mixture.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,pancetta,wheat bread,water,beef stock,white bread,swiss cheese
title: Raspberry French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread, crusts removed | 1 quart beef stock | 2 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon pancetta, cooked finely chopped ( or bacon ) | 1 slice white bread, crusts removed & chopped | 1 slice swiss cheese, sliced | 1 dash raspberry jam
instructions: Place the bread into 6 soup bowls. Set aside, & allow 10 or more minutes of cooling. Add the stock to the soup, & stir to combine. Place the pancetta in the bottom of the soup bowl, then the onion. Top with a slice of the bread. Add another slice of bread, & finally the cheese. Add a tiny splash of raspberry jam on top to taste. Repeat process until all 6 mixture have been used up. Allow 4 serving bowls to sit on their side on top of each other to allow a good amount of time to set. You want the soup to slowly start to caramelize then the fat will separate from the solids. When you remove the soup bowls from the top, you may top with a drizzle of warmed raspberry jam, if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Beef With Parsnips & Hoisin-Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin | 2 medium parsnips | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 1/3 cups hoisin sauce, divided | 1 cup maple syrup | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Cut sirloin into serving sized pieces. Combine the parsnips, oregano, parsley, 2 tbsp of the hoisin sauce and 1 tbsp of the maple syrup in a bowl. Toss to coat. Transfer to the refrigerator. Combine remaining hoisin sauce, 1/2 cup of the maple syrup, the soy sauce, lemon juice and the remaining 1/2 cup of warm maple syrup in a medium bowl. Stir to blend. Place the sirloin in a shallow glass dish. Pour the marinade over and turn to coat. Cover, and place in refrigerator 4 hours and up to 8 hours. Remove sirloin from marinade.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,orange zest,purpose flour,vanilla soymilk,phyllo dough,cilantro,apricot jam,white bread
title: Fruit Strudels
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apricot jam | 1 cup unsweetened vanilla soymilk | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 2 1/2 ounces sliced white bread | 1 package frozen phyllo dough | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Using a fork, spread apricot jam onto the parchment paper. In a large bowl, stir together the vanilla soymilk with the flour, garlic powder and orange zest. Place the bread in the flour mixture, and coat it with the marinade. Unfold 1 sheet of phyllo dough, and cut into triangles. Lay out triangles one at a time, and transfer to the baking sheet. Top with apricot jam, and cover with another sheet or two of sheets, and repeat until dough has been used. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 17 to 20 minutes, and the top layer of phyllo is puffed and golden.

title: Tandoori Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces dry lasagna noodles, no. 1 | vegetable juice, from concentrate | 2 celery ribs, coarsely chopped | 2 fresh strawberries, quartered | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon turmeric | ground white pepper
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions or to directions and rinse. Toss with veggie juice to make salad dressing. Toss with celery, strawberries, and tumeric. Season with pepper. Serve as finger bread or crackers for a meal with other main dishes such as a vegetable course.

title: Cupirk's Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck | vegetable oil, for frying | sourdough bread | cream of mushroom soup | 1 package frozen cornstarch | 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Cut stew meat into chunks and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Drain and pat dry. Shallow fry in a large skillet in 1/4 cup canola oil until brown on all sides. Remove from heat, drain on a paper towel and set aside. Toast sourdough. Split bread in half, lengthwise and toast both halves.. Remove and discard tops. Spread a small amount of sourdough on top of toasted bread and top with more sourdough. To make mushroom soup, empty sourdough cream and mushroom soup into dutch oven. Heat over medium heat until bubbly. Blend cornstarch and sunflower oil until smooth. Stir into soup mixture and heat until liquid just starts to thicken enough to coat beef. Serve immediately. May be served over cooked noodles for a complete meal.

title: Kittencal's Baked Apples
ingredients: 1 package apples ( i use granny smith apples ) | 1 brown sugar | 1/4 cup soft light apple butter ( not necessary with sugar )
instructions: Peel and cut the apples into small wedges or chunks, depending on how crisp you like your apples. Place into ungreased 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with the brown sugar. Bake at 375 degrees f. For 45 to 50 minutes or until apples begin to turn golden. Serve warm, or refrigerate for another 2 to 4 hours. You can also freeze the apples and butter for up to 7 days.

title: Simple Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs cheese, room temperature, shredded | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon apple cider ( or apple juice ) | 1 teaspoon table salt | seasoning salt
instructions: In food processor, place the cheese, italian seasoning, cider and salt. Pulse to blend. Transfer the mixture to a large serving bowl. Gather up the corners of the mound of cheese and roll it around the mixture. If it is too compact to roll, use a teaspoon to gather extra air pockets. Sprinkle salt over the surface, as needed, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. After chilling, transfer the cheese to the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,pistachio,tea leaf,cheddar cheese,chicken thigh fillet,petite potato,rotini pasta,mint
title: Irish Pizza Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable oil or 2 cups olive oil | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thigh fillets | 2 tablespoons dry instant tea leaves | 2 teaspoons dried mint | 4 medium uncooked frozen petite potatoes, thawed | 2 large plain plain baked potatoes ( such as kewpie ) | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped pistachios | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint
instructions: In a large shallow microwave safe bowl, mix oil, chicken, tea leaves and mint. Marinate chicken, covered, in the refrigerator about 10 minutes or up to 2 hours. Using a meat pounder, remove chicken in single layer from marinade. Cook potatoes. Turning as needed, until browned and tender. Spread potato on bottom half of pizza crust, evenly. Spread potatoes on top half of pizza crust and sprinkle with cheeses and pistachios. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with mint.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,aluminum foil,green pepper,tomato,vegetable broth,adobo sauce
title: Easy Easy Green Chile Con Carne,
ingredients: 1 can chopped green peppers, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 1/2 cans vegetable broth or 1 1/2 cans tomato soup, undiluted | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, finely chopped | 1/4 cup vegetable broth or 1/4 cup water | 12 sheets aluminum foil | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Combine all ingredients except foil in a 13x9 baking dish, stirring well. Cover the dish and refrigerate for 24 to 48 hours. Remove foil and spread contents in baking dish. Spray foil with oil, place foil over the mixture in center and bake 3 - 5 hours, or until vegetables are tender. Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,baking powder,baby spinach,cauliflower,chicken bouillon cube,pistachio,provolone cheese
title: Italian Spinach Salad With Prosciutto & Cauliflower
ingredients: 4 cups cubed romaine lettuce | 8 ounces baby spinach | 1/2 cup frozen cauliflower, cooked and broken into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup shredded provolone cheese | 2 cups italian-style stewed tomatoes ( i like san marzano's brand ) or 2 cups tomato sauce with chopped peeled tomatoes | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Mix all ingredients except salad in large bowl. Toss with romaine. Chill in refrigerator 2 - 3 hours if possible.

title: Indian Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1/3 cup peanut oil or 1/3 cup other neutral oil
instructions: Place all in blender. Add enough water until mixture becomes a paste, and process until smooth.

title: Mango Chutney Sweet Treats
ingredients: 6 cups mango chutney | 3 teaspoons mirin ( sweet soy sauce )
instructions: Mix chutney with mirin. Place in small pan with a tight lid or in shallow microwave dish. Microwave on high for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes, until the chutney has melted and is warm, but not too hot. Let cool and then stir again.

title: Farfalle Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange rind, grated or 1/4 cup lime rind, finely grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs farfalle pasta or 1 1/2 lbs penne pasta, cooked al dente | 12 slices prosciutto, diced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine rind, oil, turmeric, and vinegar. Add drained pasta and any citrus juices. Toss until well coated and taste for seasoning, adding more oil if desired. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Spinach With Nutella and Spinach Leaves
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup chopped greens ( such as arugula, sorrel, spinach, basil, bell peppers ) | 1/2 cup nutsella
instructions: Toss greens and nutsella together in a medium sized bowl. Chill. Serve.

Random Ingredients: peel,garlic powder,vegetable oil olive,coffee,pork loin,balsamic vinegar
title: Caribbean Roast Pork Loin
ingredients: 4 lbs pork loin, center cut | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup instant coffee | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon ground mixed peel
instructions: Dissolve the balsamic vinegar well in the coffee. Place pork loin on wire rack in roasting pan. Brush pork with balsamic vinegar soaked in the coffee and olive oil mixture. Set aside to marinate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, coat a large roasting pan with cooking spray. Insert garlic powder in the center of the pork. Rub the garlic in the pork. Remove and discard any excess fat. Bake in 400 degree oven for 50 minutes, basting and turning twice, until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the roast registers 140 degrees for medium rare or 150 degreesfor medium well, 45 minutes longer. Remove from oven and cover with aluminium foil for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 275 degrees f and continue roasting for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, basting and turning occasionally. When meat thermometer registers 170 degrees f, remove from oven and let rest for about 10 minutes before carving into small 1 1/2 inch thick slices.

title: Nutella Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large tomatoes | 4 slices cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon nutella | 1/2 cup soymilk | 3 tablespoons chopped canned tomatoes and green chilies, drained
instructions: Cut an x in top of each tomato. Then fill each with cheese.

title: Taco Seasoning for Shrimp
ingredients: 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 red pepper flakes, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 pounds cooked shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a shallow glass 9x13 inch baking dish, mix together taco seasoning mix and red pepper flakes. Pour taco seasoning mixture over shrimp.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,green apple,coconut extract,kahlua,watermelon,yellow squash,salt pepper
title: Mexican Watermelon Gazpacho
ingredients: 2 quarts watermelon, cubed | 1 lb yellow squash, cubed | 1 green apple, cubed | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/2 cup kahlua | salt and pepper
instructions: Pour the watermelon into a large saucepan and top with yellow squash, apples and coconut. Sprinkle the top with salt and pepper. Add about 1/2 cup of kahlua and enough water to almost cover the fruit. Cook over medium heat for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove cover and continue simmering for 20 minutes, or until squash is tender and mixture is a bit chunky. Remove from heat, stir in kahlua and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,wheat flour,cream chicken soup,red apple,carob powder,pita bread,sirloin tip steak
title: Quick & Easy Sirloin Pitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin tip steaks | 12 ounces light cream of chicken soup | 1 medium red apple | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 3 whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon carob powder ( optional ) | pita bread
instructions: Slice the sirloin tip into matchstick size pieces and place in a large fry pan or skillet over high heat. Cook over high heat for 5 minutes, turning constantly. Remove from pan and set aside. Add heavy cream soup to beef and mix in apple and sesame oil. Place flour, carob powder and meat in large plastic bag. Shake to coat meat. Cook at high heat 4 - 5 minutes or until heated thoroughly. Serve with pita bread.

title: Pan-Fried Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 16 capers
instructions: Place the tenderloins in a plastic or glass dish. Cover with plastic wrap, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 8 hours or overnight. Remove the pork from the marinade, and discard the capers. Cut into strips about 1/2 inch thick, and season with salt and pepper. Heat a wok or large skillet over medium high heat, and add about 1/2 inch worth of oil. When the oil is very hot, add the pork. Saute the pork until it is golden brown on both sides, about 5 to 7 minutes total.

title: El Salvadorean Pepito De Gallo
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale, leaves picked and trimmed. | 6 poblano chiles, stemmed and seeded | 1 cup red grapes, washed | 1/2 cup brown walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh mozzarella cheese, finely shredded | 1/8 cup fresh ginger, peeled, minced very fine | 12 -18 leaves fresh kale ( see notes ) or 12 -18 leaves fresh sorrel ( see leaves )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Wash outer leaves in cold water and put directly on the heat and blanch the greens for a minute or two to save the water. Remove from the heat and immediately put them in a bowl. Allow them to cool, then coarsely chop them and add them to the greens with the grapes and walnuts. Toss in the cheese and ginger. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serve at room temperature.

title: Fiesta Cheese  Apples
ingredients: 1 cup cold water | 1 1/2 lbs carrots | 1 cup chopped tart apple | 1 1/2 cups mild mexican cheese | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cut carrots in half and then cut into 1/2 inch thin slices and set aside. Cut apples into thin slices, about 3/4 inch thick. In a dutch oven, stir water and cheese together, add carrots and apples. Season to taste with salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove lid and continue to boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Pour contents of pan into a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: radish,hamburger bun,cucumber,parsley,red curry paste,brown mustard seed,baby pea,bouillon cube
title: Curried Garlic Beef Burgers (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 6)
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun, halved | 2 tablespoons prepared red curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon parsley | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1/2 small cucumber | 75 g baby peas, rinsed and drained | 1 bouillon cube, crumbled
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl, cover with clingfilm and place in the fridge to chill, for a few hours. Heat a bbq or large non stick frying pan on a medium high heat and dry fry the burgers for 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Serve immediately with salad and green vegetables.

title: Italian Breakfast Casserole-Electric Skillet
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground beef | 2 eggs | 1 package pepperoni | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
instructions: Brown beef, add egg and pepperoni.

title: Creamy Tomato-Corn Relish
ingredients: 4 cups shredded red cabbage | 3 cups chopped tomatoes | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Chili-Flavored Pancake Mix
ingredients: 1 cup dry buttermilk pancake mix | 3 cans diced green chiles | 1/4 cup arrowroot, or as needed
instructions: Prepare batter according to instructions on the package. While the batter is cooking, peel and core the chiles, reserving the seeds for later use. Place the chiles and almonds into a food processor and process until roughly chopped. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a 12 inch skillet. Add the pancake mix in a single layer, spreading evenly and constantly stirring until the sides of the pan are well coated with the olive oil. Cook the pancake mixture over medium heat until browned, about 4 minutes.

title: Pickled Asafoetida
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons white balsamic vinegar | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: In a small saucepan, mix together vinegar, and asafetida. Bring to a boil, then stir to dissolve the asafoetida. Cover, and set aside. To jar asafetida, pour 1 - 2 teaspoons of the hot vinegar mixture into a jar with a tight fitting lid. Close and shake, then let cool completely. Repeat with remaining jars to make 2 1/4 cup jarred jars with asafoetida.

Random Ingredients: date,cardamom powder,white sugar,black cardamom pod,broth,corn flake,italian sausage,savory
title: Garlic-Sage Ramen
ingredients: 8 1/2 tablespoons corn flakes | 8 dried italian sausages | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 3/4 cup white sugar | 2 cardamom pods | 1 star star anise, broken up | 2 black cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon dried savory ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried savory, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place corn flakes in a large resealable plastic bag, add sausage, and toss for 1 minute. Pour chicken stock to cover, squeezing any excess air out of the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Bring a medium pot of water to boil and add remaining ingredients. When water returns to boil, remove sausage from broth, and place in a large, deep pot, setting aside to soak for 15 minutes. Discard casings. Drain sausage from chicken stock and discard. Place sausage in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently to crumble, until no pink remains, about 10 minutes. Toss sausage with stock in the skillet until evenly coated. Turn heat to low, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until flavors are blended, about 5 minutes.

title: Cornmeal Salmon and Sesame Wedges #RSC
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 cup cornmeal | 7/8 cup almonds | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 lb salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat a baking tray with nonstick cooking spray. Toast sesame seeds in a frying pan just until slightly browned. Reserving pan drippings, set aside. Combine cornmeal, almonds and vinegar in a bowl. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Dip salmon slices in cornmeal, then gently toss with reserved seeds and olive oil. Place trout on the tray. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until salmon is cooked through. Wonderful with roasted vegetables, such as chinese greens, bean sprouts, cabbage leaves and chinese greens.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups raw chicken or 2 cups raw turkey | 2 boxes of pre-made chicken and vegetables, prepared according to instructions | chicken stock or veggie juice
instructions: Dip the chicken into a few teaspoons of the stock or vegetable juice, then gently remove it from the bones. Chop the meat and vegetables into chunks.

Random Ingredients: sugar,asparagus,ginger ale,tabasco sauce,wheat flour,hoagie,tamarind paste,white fish fillet
title: Steamed Fish Sandwiches With Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup light hoagie roll | 1 cup lean fresh asparagus, chopped | 5 slices peeled ginger ale | 2 slices firm white fish fillets or 2 slices fish fillets, of choice | 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste, diluted with a little water | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour
instructions: Prepare tamarind sauce, mix 1 cup water and 1/2 cup water in saucepan over medium heat. Bring to boil. Add sugar and tamarind paste and return to boil. Remove from heat and let cool. When cool, stir in tabasco. Stir in flour and set aside. Set oven to 200 degrees. Using a glass or metal spoon, scoop asparagus into bowls, add fish and toss until covered. Place steamed fish and sauces in a large shallow roasting pan. Cover and marinate at room temperature 15 minutes. Place an oven proof skillet in the oven and turn the temperature to broil. Place asparagus on a baking tray coated with cooking spray. Broil 3 - 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove fish and sauce from heat and stir in sugar.

title: Traditional Mexican Fried Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 -2 lb lean cooked lean meat | 2 -3 fresh green chilies | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon dried mixed spice ( any mexican spice blend ) | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Finely chop the chilies and place in a saucepan with the lemon juice. Heat over medium or medium high heat until hot turning often.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,lasagna noodle,chinese cabbage,cilantro,red bell pepper
title: Chili Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb lasagna noodle | 4 red bell peppers ( or more ) | 1/2 - 1 cup sweet italian cabbage, shredded | 2 cups chinese cabbage ( shredded ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook noodles according to package directions. While the noodles are cooking, mix cabbage, chili oil, and salt. Place noodles in a greased baking dish. Fill the jar with the cabbage mixture, and place them on top of the noodles. Bake for 45 - 55 minutes, or until onions are tender. Serve hot.

title: Green Giant Tomato Plantain Togarashi (Yellow Plantains and Smoked Paprika Soup)
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked dashi | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 teaspoon dashi | 2 green tomatoes, sliced into large chunks | 1 plantain, cut into small chunks | 1 jar pimientos, drained and sliced
instructions: In a soup pot, combine dashi, molasses and molasses. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add onions. Add plantains and smoked paprika. Continue boiling until plantain is soft, about 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Rice Noodle Pie
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry | 1 1/4 cups cooked rice noodles | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spread rice noodles on top of sheets of pastry. Sprinkle with bay leaf. Top with cilantro. Cover with remaining sheets of pastry. Cover top and bottom pastry with a sheet of foil. Bake for 20 minutes, remove foil. Reduce oven temperature to 350°f. Remove pie from oven and bake for another 10 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

title: Cheddar and Lime Dip
ingredients: 250 g cheddar cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 -2 sliced kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Cube the cheeses and chop the dried thyme in the mortar or alternatively, pulse in a food processor, using plenty of fine grained steel blade. Add the lime leaves, crush, and then mix altogether with a fork. If you prefer, it can be eaten as soon as it is taken out of the oven.

title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers | 8 ounces half-and-half | 1/3 cup minced fresh watercress | 1 teaspoon mccormick's mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: In a glass bowl, mix the watercress, steak seasoning, lime peel and mustard. Slice the cucumbers lengthwise in quarters about 1/8 inch thick. Gently stir in the dressing to coat all the cucumbers well. Cover and refrigerate for 4 - 5 hours or overnight. Stir before serving.

title: Sweet Red Pepper Paste (Tonggwa) or Indonesian Red Pepper Paste
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons red pepper paste, with seeds | 3 -4 cups granulated sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Using a jar with a lid, mix all ingredients together and store in a cool, dark place for up to 3 months.

title: Rigatoni With Watermelon and Potatoes
ingredients: 400 g rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon herbs, chopped | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon dill | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup seedless watermelon, cut into small chunks | 1/2 cup potato, cut into small chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Boil rigatoni till tender. Drain. Meanwhile heat oil in a frying pan. Add vegetables and herbs. Stir fry until moisture evaporates. Add pasta to vegetables and mix. Transfer to a baking dish coated with cooking spray. Bake for 15 minutes or till vegetables are golden brown. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,cooking oil,egg substitute,catsup,pinto bean,pea corn,dark rum,spanish onion
title: Texas Hashbrowns
ingredients: 5 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 spanish onion ( chopped ) | 5 ounces frozen peas and corn | 4 ounces frozen yellow corn | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 2 teaspoons white pepper | 5 tablespoons catsup | 5 tablespoons egg substitute
instructions: In a pan, heat 1 tbs of cooking oil. Add onion and the peas and cook covered until the onions are limp. About 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and combine with remaining ingredients and toss well. Serve immediately or freeze. Goes well with pinto beans if there's any.

title: Spanish Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 hoagie rolls | 3 tablespoons bouillon cubes | 1 lb boneless beef round steak | 1/2 teaspoon salt pork
instructions: Pierce beef with a fork in a few places. Sprinkle the salt pork on the meat and put into a crockpot. Add bouillon cubes. Cook on low setting for 8 hours or on high setting for 5 hours. Serve on hoagie rolls.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,lettuce leaf,herb,irish cream,lemon pepper,tomato paste
title: The Ultimate Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups full-fat coconut milk | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste ( depending on how sweet you want this salad ) | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs ( rosemary, basil, mint and or or or coriander leaves ) | 4 -5 large lettuce leaves, to serve ( to serve ) | herbs | 1 -2 lemon pepper, halved, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Pour the coconut milk and tomato paste into a small saucepan and simmer over a medium heat for 5 minutes until the curry paste has thickened up. Stir through the herbs and cook for 2 minutes more. Pour sauce mixture into a large bowl. Toss with the lettuce leaves and sprinkle with herbs. Garnish with lemon pepper flakes and a pinch of coconut flakes.

title: Mandarin Pancake, No Boil
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 mandarin orange
instructions: Prepare a non stick frying pan for frying. In a bowl, mix together the flour, mustard seeds, turmeric, red pepper, molasses and mandarin in 1 cup of milk and set aside. Slice the mandarin orange in half. Heat up frying pan over medium high heat. Dredge the orange half through the dry mustard and spices in the batter. Cook for 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and allow to cool. Serve and enjoy.

title: Fritters that look like shoestring steaks
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum or 1 tablespoon guar gum | 1/2 lb flank steak, cut into thin strips ( should look like strips of about 2 to 3 inches long ) | 0.5 jar pimientos, drained well, and chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the cocoa powder, xanthan gum and the drained pimientos. In a large wok, heat about 1/4 cup of water. Dip the steak strips quickly in the wet mixture to coat each side. Turn the steak strips over and cook on medium high for about 2 minutes, each side for rare or to your taste. Serve on a platter with a drizzle of the cocoa sauce and some chopped pimientos or green onions.

title: Beshwarma - Beshwarma Wraps
ingredients: 2 beet, chopped | 2 ounces shredded mexican cheese blend | 1 tablespoon buttermilk | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce, for garnish
instructions: Put the choped beet onto a microwave proof serving dish lined with paper towel. Top with cheese, buttermilk, and shredded lettuce. Place dish under the broiler for 2 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly. Slice up and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,romaine lettuce,flat rice noodle
title: Lettuce Salad Wrapped in Phyllo-Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded romaine lettuce | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 package dried flat breaded rice noodles, about 1 3/4 cups
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a large bowl, tossing to coat. Lay out the flat bread. Spread a layer of the romaine lettuce on a cutting board or work surface. Spread the rice noodles on top of the lettuce.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,fusilli,tangerine peel,vanilla bean,chili flake
title: Chili Vanilla Pasta
ingredients: 500 g fusilli | 600 g dark brown sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons dried tangerine peel | 2 vanilla beans | 2 -2 drops hot chili flakes
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente, and allow to cool whilst preparing the rest of the meal. While cooking the pasta, in a big cast iron/aromatic saucepan, warm the brown sugar over a low heat, or on a low heat for 2 - 3 minutes without colouring. Remove from heat and allow to cool to luke warm, then add the dried tangerine peel into the caramel. Split the chillies in half.

Random Ingredients: emmenthaler cheese,hamburger,chinese five spice powder,vegetable broth,dark sesame oil
title: Hamburger Fondue With Mushrooms, Caramelized Goat Cheese, and Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 3 tablespoons white american cheese, grated ( can sub emmenthaler or gruyere cheese, if desired ) | 1 pinch chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add 3 tablespoons of cheese to the pan. Brown the cheese for about 2 minutes until it turns a dark brown color, then remove from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add another 2 tablespoons of cheese to the pan and brown the hamburger. After one minute, stir to break up the meat. Mix in the onion and brown the beef. When the meat has browned, add 1 tablespoons of white american cheese. When the cheese melts, stir in 1 pinch of green pepper blend, 2 tablespoons of dark sesame oil, and 1 1/2 to 1 - ½ cups of vegetable broth. Stir to combine, then add the meat and cheese mixture to the sauce, stir to combine, cover the pan, and transfer the dish to the warmer spot to keep warm. Keep warm on low heat.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,chicken tender,rump roast,gruyere cheese,white mushroom
title: Rump Roast Beef With Gruyere Cheese
ingredients: 1 rump roast, rinsed or 4 chicken tenderloins | 4 ounces gruyere cheese | 4 ounces small white mushrooms, sliced | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, coarsely grated | 1/4 cup low fat gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Place the meat in a 1 inch thick, 10 inch by 5 1/2 inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle with the gruyere and parmesan cheeses. Cover with the mushrooms and sprinkle on the remaining 1/4 and 1/2 cheeses. Broil or grill for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,kielbasa,cream cheese,red chili pepper,dijon mustard,catsup,chicken thigh,marjoram
title: The Best Chicken Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, minced | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut in half or 2 lbs chicken breast halves, if used ( with skin on ) | 1 red chili pepper, finely chopped ( or poblano pepper for hotter flavor, i used serrano )
instructions: Cream the cream cheese, dijon, catsup, marjoram, 1/2 tsp each of chile, and minced chipotle in a medium bowl. Add chicken and stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 350°f remove chicken from refrigerator, uncover, and spread the warm cream cheese mixture evenly on the chicken. Bake at 350°f for about 35 minutes, or until heated through and the center is lightly browned. Serve warm with the hot spicy dip.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,vegetable oil cooking spray,maraschino cherry,penne pasta,stew meat,fennel seed,cashew
title: Beef Noodle Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup cashews | 1 cup dried penne pasta, cooked according to package directions | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons cooking spray | 1/2 cup roasted salted cashews | 1 cup maraschino cherry | 1 tablespoon oats meal or 1 tablespoon quick-rising oats
instructions: In a large frying pan or wok, dry fry meat over medium heat. After meat is browned, add fennel seeds, cashews, penne and oil. Stir fry until pasta is well coated & heated through. Pour in cherries and continue stir frying until it is coated in cherryy goodness. Goes great with steamed carrots.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,mandarin orange,golden raisin,cornmeal,pineapple juice,green creme de menthe,sea scallop,pumpkin puree
title: Chilled Squash Sushi
ingredients: 1 package whole box cornmeal, blend | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 1 can green creme de menthe, do not dilute | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained, reserve the juice | 1 can whole canned pumpkin puree | 1 bell pepper, chopped ( red or green ) | 1 package sea scallops, fresh | 1/3 cup golden raisin, sliced
instructions: Combine cornmeal, creme de menthe, mandarin oranges drained and juice.

Random Ingredients: pickle relish,coconut cream,brown sugar,ladyfinger,extra virgin olive oil,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,turmeric powder,self raising flour
title: Chipotle & Sweet Potato Crostaters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 cups chopped sweet potatoes or 1 1/2 cups grated tasty sweet potato | 1 1/2 cups chopped pickle relish | 1/4 cup sweet pickle relish | 1 -2 tablespoon chipotle pepper in adobo sauce ( minced and peeled ) | 1 -2 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon low-sodium coconut cream ( coconut milk can be substituted for all or part of the sweet potato ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/3 - 1/2 cup coconut cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, 350°f, gas mark 4/moderate. Mix all of the glaze ingredients together in a medium sized bowl and whisk to combine. Set aside. Mix sweet potato, sweet potato, relish, chipotle pepper and brown sugar in a large bowl until well combined. Make sure all of the sweet potato is covered with sweet potato mixture. Mix the flour, coconut cream and turmeric powder in another bowl and add to the mixture above. Use your hands to mix everything in the bowl, if it doesn't fit you can add a little extra flour, a little at a time, until everything is evenly distributed. Take a teaspoon of dough and form a ball out of your hands, then repeat until all of the dough is used. Dip the ball into the egg wash and then press into a non stick, lightly greased and flour lined muffin tin.. Bake for 25 - 35 minutes. Serve warm with any of your favourite filling.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,baby spinach,head cabbage,garlic powder,lemon zest
title: Spinach with Yogurt and Lemon
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, chopped | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cook cabbage leaves as specified on package. Rinse well. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Dry spinach and place on cookie sheet or parchment lined with aluminum foil. Place lemon zest on top of spinach. Bake until slightly browned. To serve, top leaves with yogurt and lemon.

title: Sauerkraut, Spicy Rib Eye Steaks, or Pot Stickers.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper, depending on your taste | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3 teaspoons accent seasoning | 2 cans sauerkraut, drained well, reserve liquid
instructions: Heat enough oil to cover meat, saute until well browned, about 5 mins.., stir frequently. Set aside. Add 1 tsp of the accent to meat. Slice jalepenos in long, slivers. Place back in oil, saute about 1 min., add 1 tsp of the accent. Add 1 tsp of the cardamom and about 1 tsp of the accent. Remove from heat. Add sauerkraut liquid, stir and cover. Let sit and soak for about 10 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,garlic oil,vanilla ice cream,corn,manchego cheese
title: Grilled Beef Pone
ingredients: 500 g boneless beef top sirloin or 500 g boneless beef bottquarts beef tenderloin ( 8 oz ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic oil or 1/2 teaspoon oil | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ice cream | 1 teaspoon corn | 1/2 cup manchego cheese, grated or 1/2 cup goat cheese
instructions: To make steaks, in a heavy skillet brown the tops of the beef cubes. Transfer to a platter. Reduce heat and add the garlic oil. Stir fry for about 10 minutes. Add the ice cream. Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the ice cream and pour the beef mixture evenly over the cheese. Serve with grilled or broiled sweet potatoes or asian vegetable dip. Variation, for a less peppery flavor, add 1/4 teaspoon of garlic powder to the steak before browning.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,chicken thigh,liquid smoke,bell pepper,cream cheese,self rising flour
title: Smoky Garlic Lover's Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 cup cream cheese, room temperature | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 0.5 can sliced almonds, sliced roasted in pan until golden brown
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place chicken thighs in a large casserole dish. Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl or zip top bag.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,cream chicken soup,lettuce leaf,vegetable,rye bread,red chile pepper
title: Spicy Vegetable Toast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 teaspoons finely chopped red chile peppers | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups mixed vegetables | 40 g bread, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped lettuce leaves
instructions: Mix cornflour, red chilli peppers and condensed soup together in a large bowl. Pour over vegetables and stir until thoroughly combined. Tear bread into bite sized pieces and place into a large mixing bowl, mix well, ensuring each slice of bread has been moistened. Place 1 tablespoon of mixture in the centre of a bread slice, sprinkle with lettuce leaves and roll up. Place on wire trays and refrigerate until required for at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Croutons With Cheese
ingredients: 1 bag seasoned croutons | 1 package cream cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to combine cream cheese and croutons.. Spread on a greased baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes or until browned.

title: Kris' Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Mix crumbles, thyme, and pepper together in a small mixing bowl. Add the cheese, and mix well. Spread the mixture onto a pizza peel or baking sheet with pizza roller. Put on your favorite toppings, and bake for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Indian Lasagna
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti, broken into 2-inch pieces | 16 meat balls | 2 cups dried cranberries | 15 fresh curry leaves | 12 whole wheat lasagna noodles | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the tooth, about 12 minutes. Drain. Place spaghetti, meat balls, cranberries, curry leaves, and bay leaf in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread noodles over meat mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and bubbly, 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork,pomegranate juice,oregano leaf,chicken breast,spaghetti sauce,hazelnut,olive,cooking oil
title: Pomegranate and Hazelnut Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice | 3/4 cup pomegranate juice | 1 cup spaghetti sauce | 3/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1 cup pitted ripe olives, sliced
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into strips about 3/4 inch wide and 1/4 inch wide. In a bowl, mix together the oregano, olive oil, and pomegranate juice. In a sauté pan, preheat the oil to medium. Add the chicken and sprinkle over the oregano, salt heavily, and cook for 10 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink in the middle. Add the pomegranate mixture, spaghetti sauce, and hazelnuts, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer 40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Remove from heat, and stir in olives.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,kielbasa,canola oil,french bread,white sugar,cabbage,cream cheese
title: Polish Cabbage Filled Appetizer
ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced italian bread | 1 package cream cheese | 1 package kielbasa, sliced | 3/4 cup canola oil | 1 package shredded cabbage | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons canola oil, or as needed
instructions: Place bread, cream cheese, and kielbasa in a bowl. Blend canola and 2 teaspoons sugar in blender. Pour canola oil into a 9x13 baking dish. Layer a layer of cabbage, cream cheese mixture, and bread mixture in the dish. Continue layering, ending with bread. Sprinkle top of bread with remaining sugar. Cover, and refrigerate at least overnight, or several hours, until cold before serving.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,green maraschino cherry,yeast cake,spice,beef tenderloin steak,queso blanco,salt pepper
title: Green Tea Beef Roll-ups With Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients: 1 ounce yeast cakes ( scant 1/2 cup ) | 4 cups hot water | 3 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | salt and pepper | 9 tomatillos, husked, rinsed and patted dry | 1 dozen queso blanco, sliced in 12 rounds | spices
instructions: Place the yeast in a large glass bowl and make a well in the center. Pour in the hot water, then stir to remove any lumps. Add the beef to the well and let it come to room temperature. Cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until it has doubled in size, at least 1 hours. Drain the meat, pat it dry with paper towels, and trim any visible fat. Lightly butter the work bowl with a good film of oil and lay it in your hand. Working from the short side, roll a piece of the beef into a log approximately 12 inches long and 6 inches diameter and set aside. Repeat with the remaining meat. Sprinkle the outside of the log all over with salt and pepper. Place the tomatillos, queso blanco, and spices in a deep, heavy, ovenproof casserole. Add the meat, cover and let rise for about 1 hour or until the dough has come half way up the sides of the pan. Then turn the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake the bread for about 40 minutes, or until the sauce bubbles and the beef is cooked. Remove the beef with a spatula and tent it loosely with foil, remove the strings and serve with the tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: pam cooking spray,orzo pasta,white bean,tomato juice,elbow macaroni,ginger ale,bacon
title: Slow Cooker Italian Meal, orzo and Beans
ingredients: 8 slices lean bacon | 1 can white beans | 1 can chopped tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup orzo pasta | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 4 ounces shredded orzo pasta ( optional ) | 8 ounces shredded carrots ( optional )
instructions: Cook and stir bacon in a large skillet over medium high heat until crisp, about 5 minutes. Add white beans, tomatoes with juice, orzo, and 1/2 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to pan.

title: Mushrooms with Portobello
ingredients: 7 portabella mushroom caps | 1/4 cup italian-style breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup bread, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Insert 2 or 3 slices of portobello mushroom cap in cavity. Mix bread crumbs, bread crumbs, and melted butter in medium bowl. Place mushroom caps on sheet pan and drizzle with the melted butter. Bake approximately 15 minutes, until golden.

title: Avocado Croquettes
ingredients: 2 hass avocados | 2 cups whole white breadcrumbs | dill weed
instructions: Pash and peel the avocados and then remove the pit. Mash the avocados together using a fork and combine with the bread crumbs in a bowl. Shape the filling into 8 round patties and press down firmly. Wrap one end of the patties in the bread crumbs and then roll the patties in the crumbs to coat lightly.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,red lentil,white wine,beef tenderloin steak,broccoli floret
title: English Pub Style Beef With Lentils
ingredients: 3 beef tenderloin steaks, 1 inch thick | 4 ounces white wine, about 4 fluid ounces | 4 teaspoons instant red lentils | 2 large broccoli florets | 8 ounces fresh cubed american cheese
instructions: Prepare a fire in a charcoal grill. Rub the steaks with some of the wine until the meat loses its pink colour. Transfer the steaks to a plate. Place the remaining wine in a small bowl. Stir in the lentils, and place the broccoli on top of each steak. Place three slivers of cheese between each steak. Wrap each steak in aluminum foil, and place on a grill rack over a drip pan. Grill for 15 minutes, turning once.

title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 100 g liver, cut in 1 cm slices | 100 g goat meat, sliced | 100 g bambalaya lettuce leaves or 100 g iceberg lettuce, coarsely torn | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 -3 jumbo shrimp, cooked
instructions: Heat a wok, add a tablespoon of oil. Add bambalaya leaves and fry until crunch and aromatic. Remove from wok and serve on individual salad plates. Drizzle with oil. Place the liver slices on top and serve while still hot. Garnish with shredded lettuce, chopped coriander and sliced jalapenos.

title: Applesauce Meat Mix
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon applesauce
instructions: Mix all together and store in airtight container. To use, mix 1/8 cup hot water with 1 tbsp applesauce. To use, combine 1/2 tablespoon of mixture with 1 tablespoon baking powder and 1/8 teaspoon of salt before serving. If mixture seems dry, add a little bit of hot water, then mix again.

Random Ingredients: ice water,puff pastry,french bread,flax seed meal,pastry,peanut oil vegetable,tamarind paste
title: Crunchy Toast
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 2 teaspoons riceflower seed meal ( dry, see note ) | 4 tablespoons ice water | 6 slices french bread | 3 tablespoons flax seed meal ( see note ) | 1 cup peanut oil or 1 cup vegetable oil, divided | 1 freezer ready made puff pastry, defrosted ( see note )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, mix the tamarind paste and riceflower seed meal. Place the bread slices in the freezer for 30 - 40 minutes. Heat 2 tbs. Of oil in a skillet over med high heat. Cut a slit in each bread slice and soak for 1 - 2 seconds. Remove and discard the crusts. Dip the bread slices in the bread batter, coating completely. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes per side until golden brown. In a large shallow dish or on a plate, layer the toast, topping with the flaxseed meal, then the peanut oil, and finally the frozen pastry.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,baby spinach leaf,filet mignon,chicken leg,stewing beef,red chile
title: Spicy Aubergine Beef and Red Pepper Stew
ingredients: 450 g stewing beef, cut into thin strips ( i used sirloin medallions ) | 1 aubergine, cut into medium pieces | 2 large red chile, sliced finely | 2 large baby spinach leaves | 6 beef bone-in chicken legs, with the skin | 1 tablespoon crushed red chile
instructions: In a heavy based saucepan, gently fry the aubergines, chilies, garlic and beef in a little butter until the beef is browned all over. Push the aubergines to the side of pan with the beef. Sprinkle the crushed chile over the beef and aubergines. Tie the chicken legs together with kitchen string if necessary. Add the beef and aubergine to the pan. Bring the base of the pan to the boil and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes. Pour the contents of the pan over the beef and veg. Simmer gently for 2 hours over a low heat.

title: Perfect Soft Shellfish
ingredients: 1 large tart shell, such as a mahogany size | 1 pinch fine sea salt
instructions: Prepare a spot with an oven rack that fits inside the oven. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and set aside. Fill a large bowl with ice and cold water. Sprinkle the salt into the water. Using a sharp knife or clean, dry your hands a few times to release grit. Dump the cooked shells into the water and gently pat them down into the shells with your hands until the shellfish's flat, about 3/4 inch thick. Lay the shells onto the prepared baking sheet, using your hands. Leave the oven rack in there. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the shellfish's puffy and golden brown. Serve at once. Store in an air tight container.

title: Coffee Beet Mold - Microwave
ingredients: 1 kg beet, with greens ( approx ) | 100 g white balsamic vinegar | 50 g white balsamic vinegar | 50 g marshmallows, chopped | 25 g white balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place all the remaining ingredients in a microwave safe bowl, cover with cling wrap and microwave on high power for 2 minutes. Stir to combine. Pour into an 8 cake tray. Cool for 5 minutes, then place the tin in the refrigerator to set up. Cut the cake into 3/4 inch slices/pieces and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Wild German Potato Salad (Kalbsshnitzer)
ingredients: 5 lbs yukon gold hamburger | 1 lb shiitake mushroom | 8 cups thinly sliced savoy cabbage | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 5/8 cup blackberries, for sprinkling
instructions: Cook the hamburger. When fully cooked, remove from heat and crumble into a bowl. Shred the cabbage and add to hamburger. Remove stems from mushrooms and slice them in half. Remove mushrooms, discarding remainder. Add vinegar, cook and stir for 2 minutes. Add the blackberries and mushrooms and stir for another minute.

title: Kidney Beans
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1 can kidney beans
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, mix the cake mix and kidney beans. The consistency of the bean mixture needs to be at least 1 inch thick. Spread onto the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover with some of the bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,puff pastry,saffron thread,white onion,french onion soup mix,bicarbonate soda,pineapple chunk
title: Bread Salad
ingredients: 225 g french onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed ( optional. may omit if not available ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 loaf miniature puff pastry, defrosted | 450 g pineapple chunks, drained canned | 1/4 white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon grainy mustard
instructions: Blend onion soup mix, bicarb soda, saffron and saffron in a blender until well blended. Cut puff pastry in half. Spoon soup mix thickly over pastry. Wrap pastry around stuffing in opposite directions to form a neat bundle, twisting ends as you go to make a neat packet. Place packet in a large baking sheet. Chill for 10 minutes, or until pastry is firm. Cut small circular slits on top of bread using a 2 inch star cookie cutter. Bake at 180oc for about 40mins or until pastry is well risen and golden. Cool slightly, then slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,apple,chicken cutlet,ginger juice,golden balsamic vinegar,flour,serrano pepper
title: Grilled Chicken with Maple Leaf Glaze
ingredients: 4 chicken cutlets, about 3/4-inch thick | 1/8 cup flour | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice ( from 1-inch piece of ginger ) | 2 tablespoons grated peeled ginger-garlic cloves ( about 2 ) | 4 teaspoons golden aged balsamic vinegar | 3 -6 serrano peppers or 3 -6 green sweet pepper slices, cut in half
instructions: Heat grill to medium low. Pat chicken dry on all sides. Sprinkle with flour to coat. Heat maple syrup on grill rack coated with cooking spray until hot, 2 to 3 minutes. Turn and grill 2 minutes more, brushing with maple syrup glaze 2 or 3 times. Transfer chicken to a warm platter. Whisk together ginger juice, ginger garlic and balsamic. Place 2 or 3 serrano chiles cut side down on top of chicken, sprinkle with flour mixed with sugar or brown sugar. Sprinkle generously with salt. Serve warm or at room temperature with remaining sesame sauce. Grill 2 or 3 chiles with marinade for 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until just beginning to char.
