Use remaining chiles to serve as a garnish when grilled. To serve, place 2 or 4 scallion greens on top of the chicken.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,stew meat onion green pepper c,fruit,rice noodle,green pepper,balsamic vinegar
title: Vegetable Beef & Bean Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 400 g stew meat ( such as sirloin or other lean stew meat ) | 1 can stewed mixed fruit | 150 g rice noodles | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green peppers
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pan and stir to combine. Cook on low heat for around 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

title: Mango and Prune Jam
ingredients: 3 cups fresh mango, peeled, pitted and chopped | 6 cups ripe prunes, pitted and chopped | 1/4 cup armagnac | 8 whole mace, leaves only | 4 -6 firm apples, peeled and diced
instructions: Wash mangos, prunes and apples, removing any stones and pits. Put prunes and apples into a roaster or dutch oven, sprinkle the mango, prunes and apples with armagnac, mace and spices. Pour boiling water over everything, cover and let sit for 4 hours, or till fruit is soft, stirring occasionally. The idea is to keep the fruit warm, but the warmth of the water prevents boiling out of the lid. Remove from the pan, break the lid and store in an airtight container up to 3 - 4 weeks.

title: Chili Oil from Coriander
ingredients: 2 bunches flat-leaf parsley, cleaned and washed | 1 bunch coarsely cut red chilies | 125 g shortening or 125 g lard
instructions: Place the parsley, chillies and shortening in a bowl and mix to mix. Wrap the mix in clingfilm and leave to mature for 12 to 24 hours, stirring or kneading occasionally. Heat the oil in a pan on low heat, preferably with a lid so it is just warm to the touch, and add the salt. Leave to stand for 30 minutes or so, and transfer to an ovenproof dish. Turn regularly, checking it is burning and sticking together. Bake in a moderate oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until golden all over. Remove, place on paper towels, cover loosely with foil and leave to drain. The oil must be hot so the taste is brought out. When all oil is ready, transfer to a heat resistant container or storage container and refrigerate for up to 10 days.

title: Cashew Crunch Bread 2007
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bread flour | 1 cup cashew nuts | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven 375º. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or oil lightly spray with cooking spray. In a large mixing bowl sift the corn oil with the flour. Add in the sugar nuts.

Random Ingredients: thai red chili pepper,sauerkraut,taco seasoning mix,pineapple juice,salmon
title: Smoked Salmon & Sauerkraut Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sauerkraut | 2 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 4 1/2 ounces smoked salmon, cut into chunks | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix, mix | 1 thai red chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the sauerkraut in a bowl with the pineapple juice with 1 teaspoon of the taco seasoning mix, the chili pepper, to taste. Mix well. Add the smoked salmon and continue to mix. Pour half of the sauce into a medium size frying pan. Use the skillet to carefully toast your chili pepper. Cook just long enough for the chili pepper to become fragrant and the color of the soy sauce. Watch carefully so it doesn't burn, and you can smell the fragrance of the chili peppers, especially near the end. You can add more of the chili pepper later, if necessary. Add the remaining sauce, stir well and simmer until it thickens. Add the remaining sauerkraut for another minute or two until it's heated through.

title: Rice Blend
ingredients: 3/4 cup long-grain rice, such as arborio | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: Rinse the rice and place it in the blender jar with the molasses. Blend on highest speed until the rice is all ground up. Pour into a shallow bowl and let stand at room temperature about 1 hour before serving. It should have absorbed all the water immediately.

title: Italian Creamy Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing mix | 1/3 cup double cream
instructions: Place all ingredients in the container of a blender jar with 1 tablespoon of the dressing mix. Cover and blend at high speed for 2 minutes. Store in a non reactive container. Note, if a creamier dressing can be made with the cream of celery, add 1 teaspoon to 1/2 teaspoon of orange juice in that ingredient before processing and blending.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,cumin seed,cottage cheese,chicken,curry leaf,red bell pepper,curry powder,cheddar cheese
title: Cheese and Chicken Stir Fry
ingredients: 4 tablespoons grated cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 small red bell pepper, sliced | 1 small button mushroom, sliced | 2 slices rotisserie-cooked chicken | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh curry leaves
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. In a medium bowl, mix together the 2 tb of cheddar cheese, cottage cheese, curry powder, bell pepper, mushrooms, and rotisserie cooked chicken. Cover.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,paprika,dark rum,red chili pepper,thyme leaf
title: Spanish Peppers
ingredients: 3 large poblano peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves, minced | 2 tablespoons dark rum or 2 tablespoons light rum
instructions: Place the poblano peppers, cut side up, on a paper towel lined baking sheet.

title: Spiced Potato Chickpeas With Hoagie Chips and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 jar prepared chick-peas ( i used trader joe's brand ) | 1/2 cup pure maple syrup | 1 teaspoon shallots or 1 teaspoon minced scallion | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 package simply potatoes southwest grill mashed potatoes southwest style | 6 hoagie rolls, crusty type, split in half lengthwise | 1 cup finely chopped dried sweet potato variety ( such as terra chips variety )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place chickpeas in a large saucepan, cover tightly and bring to boil, reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes. Drain. Cool and break into 1/2 in chunks. Place in the bottom of a large mixing bowl, mash the chickpeas lightly with a potato masher and a wooden spoon. Add the maple syrup, shallots, cayenne, and nutmeg to the chickpeas and mash to combine well. Spoon the mixture into the center of each potato half, sprinkle with sweet potato, then fold the halves over the top. Place on non stick baking sheet with sides, and place in oven. Bake, turning half way through, until the hash is golden brown and crispy about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Creamy Beef With Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1/2 teaspoon saltine crackers | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1/4 cup beef gravy concentrate
instructions: Place the beef and kidney beans in a slow cooker. Add the saltine crackers and whiskey. Cover and cook on high for one hour. Turn slow cooker to low and continue to cook for 8 - 10 hours. Remove and discard the spice mixture from the crockpot and set aside for stewing. Stir in cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water until desired thickness is achieved. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Lazy Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast or 1 lb boneless sirloin tip steak | 1 package all-beef flavored half-and-half | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 10 -12 slices baguette or 10 -12 slices baguette
instructions: Trim excess fat from beef, if using beef. Combine beef, half and half and baking powder in a 1 1/4 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting 2 hours, or on high setting for 5 to 7 hours. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove meat from slow cooker and cut into about 3/8 inch slices or cubes. Arrange meat on rack in roasting pan. Bake 10 minutes on each side or until meat is crisp and slightly browned in center. Serve hot. Serve with your favorite mustard.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,green cardamom,serrano chilies,apple,turmeric powder,ricotta cheese,beef stew meat
title: Randy's Swedish Goulash
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 2 green cardamoms ( green top ) | 1 -2 chili pepper, red | 1 1/2 tablespoons caraway seeds ( optional ) | 4 ounces ricotta cheese, low fat | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes and apple
instructions: Cut meat in bite size pieces and set aside. Roast chili and caraway seeds until the seeds start popping. Remove the chili and caraway seeds and set aside. Wash and slice chile thinly and set aside. Remove tops from chile and place in a dry skillet. Add 3 tablespoons of water at a time and roast on medium heat until the water has evaporated then add the chile pepper and cardamoms. Stir to mix. Add 1 tablespoons of water at a time and continue to stir to mix and add. When most of the water has evaporated and all the other ingredients are incorporated, mix in the meat and turn heat to low. Allow to simmer on low heat while you make the sauce. In a large bowl, mix ricotta cheese and tomato with the turmeric. Add meat and stir well. Cook over low heat, covered and stirring often, until meat begins to brown. Adjust seasoning, cover and let simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Charishma's Yummy Curry Powder
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups yoghurt ( thick plain, curd is a good substitute ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons kitchen bouquet ( knorr-type ) | 2 teaspoons grated orange rind | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup orange juice | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Beat yoghurt with the kitchen bouquet in a mixer. Add orange rind, turmeric powder, kitchen bouquet and yoghurt mixture with 1 cup water. Mix well and leave for about 20 - 30 minutes. Add more water if necessary. Heat oil in a small frying pan. Make sure it is not quite 5 mm deep. You do not want it to stick to the outside of the wok. Pour mixture into the fryer and cook on medium heat for about 5 - 7 minutes, or until it turns a light golden colour. Garnish with corriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: rotel,pizza cheese,flat leaf parsley,tamarind juice,almond,large shrimp,masala,lettuce
title: Indian Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 - 1/2 cup tamarind juice | 1/2 - 1 cup rotel, to taste ( i use an italian-style brand ) | 1 cup prepared masala ( can use less ) | 5 -6 cups lettuce ( romaine or cress are good choices ) | freshly grated fresh par-shredded rotel | slivered almonds | 2 -3 tablespoons sliced almonds, toasted | 1 container pizza cheese ( i use kraft brand )
instructions: Put shrimp in a skillet with 1/4 cup of water and tamarind juice. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Drain shrimp and reserve 2/3 c of poaching liquid.. Put remaining shrimp liquid, if using, and drained shrimp in a small saucepan, then heat under medium heat. Whisk in masala until well blended. Remove from heat.

title: Chinese Steamed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 2 -4 drops tabasco sauce | 1/2 leek, slit lengthwise | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Wash meat under cold running water. Trim excess fat and silver skin. Cut into 3 to 4 inch pieces. Place 3 pound pieces flat on wax paper or aluminum foil. Blend together buttermilk and 1 tablespoon sichuan peppercorns. Spread the mixture on meat. Evenly sprinkle on remaining 1 tablespoon sichuan peppercorns. Wrap up meat well, securing with toothpicks. Repeat, laying pieces on plastic wrap several times, until all pieces are covered with peppercorns and salt, about 1 hour.. Let meat stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Steam meat 8 to 10 minutes, or until a meat thermometer registers 145f for medium rare. Serve immediately. Serve steamed meat over chow mein noodles.

Random Ingredients: ca n't believe not butter spray,mustard,chicken leg,half cream,water chestnut,cayenne,milk,bicarbonate soda
title: Chicken Legs With Water Chestnut
ingredients: 300 g chicken legs | 3/4 cup milk | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/3 cup finely chopped water chestnut | 1/4 cup can't believe not butter spray
instructions: Place chicken in a bowl and cover with milk. Place in the fridge overnight. Next day, remove chicken from fridge and place in a roasting dish or pan with the side of a spoon. Stir in half and half, mustard, cayenne and water chestnuts. Cover and cook in a pre heated oven at 220c for 30 minutes. Remove lid and stir and return chicken to oven and cook for an additional 15 - 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Remove from the oven and stir the can't believe not butter spray on top of chicken and serve with mash.

title: Simple, Easy & No Alcohol Cocktail
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers | 4 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( or to taste )
instructions: Prep the ladyfingers in a large, airtight tupperware container or bowl. Add the tabasco, to taste. Allow to marinate overnight. Spray a non stick frying pan with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Arrange the ladyfingers in the pan. Sprinkle over the desired amount of tbsp of cheese. Do not stir them around too much, as they are going to stick to the pan. Allow the cheese to melt completely, and then flip.

title: Brisket With Bread Crumbs Au Jus
ingredients: 10 ounces beef brisket or 10 ounces other lean roast | 1 1/2 cups toasted bread | 1/2 cup mixed nuts, coarsely crushed | 2 bunches mesclun
instructions: Preheat oven to place the brisket on a rack in a roasting pan large enough to contain it. Add enough hot water to the pan to completely submerge the fat layer. Bake until the meat pulls apart easily with a fork, about 4 to 5 hours, depending on thickness of meat and oven. Cool meat, but do not freeze. Slice, and discard meat fat. Remove fat layer from pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs, nuts and mesclun. Return brisket to pan, and cook about 1 hour, or until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f. Be sure to baste occasionally with pan juices.

title: Maufieh (Spicy Maufieh Candy)
ingredients: 20 dried poblano peppers | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 -2 jigger red pepper juice or 1 -2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Soak the poblano peppers in warm water for an hour before preparing the main dish of the dish. Put the water over high heat and bring to a boil. Add turmeric and orange juice. The key to a good masala is the turmeric and orange juice. If it tastes unpleasant, add turmeric powder. If you do not taste it, you may peel the poblano peppers and slice them into strips. Add 2 or 3 strips of pepper to the main dish and mix. Continue to cook at a gentle boil for a few minutes. It is important to keep an eye on it. When ready to eat, remove from heat. Stir in a pinch of asafoetida. When the main dish has finished cooking, add red pepper juice or red pepper powder. The main dish has also served with turmeric and orange juice.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,pine nut,white bread,irish cream,self rising flour,red chile,gin
title: Irish Breakfast Tea Bread
ingredients: 12 slices white bread, crusts removed | 3 tablespoons low-fat gin | 2 3/4 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 cup pine nuts, finely chopped | 1/4 lb unsliced fresh red chile, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons irish cream, plus more for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. To make the tea bread, arrange a single layer of bread slices in a 12x6 inch jelly roll pan. In a medium bowl, add the gin and stir well. Add the flour and stir until just mixed. Drain the bread slices on paper towels and spread on the guisado. Bake for 25 minutes, until golden. Pour the buttermilk into a bowl and add pine nuts, chiles and irish cream.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,salad oil,ladyfinger,sun tomato,rum,five spice powder
title: Mamma's Faux French Balsamic Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves | 4 ounces salad oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 14 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped | 14 ounces sweetened chicken breast halves, in slices | 6 ounces mixed mushrooms, sliced | 9 ounces mixed salad greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f put 2 chicken breast halves through the meat grinder twice. Add salad oil to a shallow dish. Pour 1/4 of the sun dried tomato sundried tomatoes onto the oil, and then the chopped sun dried tomatoes, sun dried tomatoes and chicken. Dollop some palm sized oil, and then add 4 chicken breast slices. Do each taste, and then sprinkle the remaining 1/4's of sun dried tomatoes, sun dried tomato and chicken mixture onto the salad leaves. Place on a baking tray and bake in oven for 90 minutes. Put the remaining 4 chicken breasts onto plates, and serve with mixed salad green and french bread. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mango,sirloin tip roast,worcestershire sauce,wheat flour,black cardamom pod,orange bell pepper
title: Vietnamese Beef Patties
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast ( fat trimmed cut into thin strips ) | 1 large orange bell pepper, thinly sliced ( or red bell pepper ) | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon black cardamom pod ( optional-use 1/2 teaspoon of orange rind if you do not know what this is ) | 1/4 cup diced mango, fresh and unsweetened, if desired ( i used frozen )
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet until smoking and add meat. Season with salt and pepper. Cook meat on high heat until seared on all sides and just a hint of pink remains. Do not over cook.

title: Easy, Quick & Tasty Beef and Green Apple Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 package beef, trimmed of fat | 1 cup basmati rice | 4 small green apples, peeled, cored and sliced ( any size - i like the mini-peeled variety )
instructions: Boil rice and apples in water for 20 minutes in a covered saucepan. Stir once in a while. Remove from heat. Cover pot with a lid and leave for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork and serve.

title: Grape Leaves - a Christmas Eve Special Recipe
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh grape leaves | 1/2 cup grape leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 lemon, juiced | 1 bunch leek, finely chopped | 3 pounds boneless lamb chops | 1 can sliced almonds | 1 bottle ranch dressing | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 jar prepared horseradish, or to taste
instructions: Soak 3 grape leaves in a large bowl with boiling water for 20 minutes. Drain and cool. Place a grape leaf with a stem attached onto a microwave safe plate. Place a small hole in the center of the leaf, and sprinkle with a small amount of chopped or coarsely chopped leeks. Place half the lamb chops into the center and squeeze 1 can of sliced almonds into the center. Place one slice of the reserved grape leaves, along with about 1/4 cup ranch dressing, about 2 tablespoons lemon juice, about 1/3 of the sliced almonds, and one handful of chopped grape leaves. Fold the sides over the filling, then fold in the sides and bottom. Roll the grape leaves around the filling as you roll until they are encased. Secure with a toothpick, and set aside for use. Repeat for the remaining leaves. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. While the water is heating, place each stuffed grape leaf into a steamer set over the boiling water. Cover, and cook until the leaves are tender but not mushy, about 15 minutes. Drain well. While the grape leaves are steaming, fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the grape leaves, and return to a boil. Cook the grape leaves uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well, and set aside to cool slightly. Serve the stuffed grape leaves warm.

title: Thai Chili Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the yogurt and chili sauce until smooth. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: broiler fryer chicken,banana,breadcrumb,active yeast,parmesan cheese,mango,red chilies
title: Roasted Chilli Chicken (Or Chicken) Focaccia
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup soft breadcrumbs | 1 cup soft breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup mango, chopped | 4 1/2 cups broiler-fryer chickens or 4 1/2 cups chicken breasts, cooked | 4 whole red chilies | 8 whole dried mango, sliced
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, use a fork to stir the yeast into the bread crumbs. Stir in the cheese with a large rubber spatula, then stir in the mango and the bread crumbs. Add the chicken and toss until coated. Place in a large, lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp cloth and let rise in a warm, draft free place until doubled, about 45 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f punch down the chicken. Cut into 4 pieces. Place the chicken, chillies and mango in a roasting pan and bake for 10 minutes. Pour the marinade over each piece of focaccia and bake for 20 minutes longer. Serve warm. Mangoes can be served alongside to dip or alongside for dipping.

title: Roasted Beef With Walnuts and Pecans
ingredients: 350 g beef | 50 g butter | 25 g walnut oil | 80 g freshly grated cheese, plus extra to serve | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 loaf fresh bread ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven and gas mark, 230°c, 190°c. Combine the beef, butter and oil in a roasting tin. Cook, in the middle of the oven until the beef is just cooked enough to fall from the bone, 8 to 12 hours, depending on the thickness of your roast. Cool and remove the fat from the meat, if necessary. Cut a slice of cheese, cut into 4 or 5 large chunks, and put ontop of the meat. Serve straight away with extra cheese, nuts and a mixed salad. Roasted walnuts, place a piece of parchment or greaseproof paper in the base of a roasting tin, place the tin in the centre of the oven and roast 200°c for approx 15 minutes until the top crisps up and the nuts are golden brown. Remove the paper and parchment, and turn off the oven. Leave the oven door slightly ajar, and leave the oven to 200°c. Tip the oven to keep the door of the oven open. When the roast is cooked, remove and turn on a wire rack and leave to rest 5 minutes. Unwrap the beef, slice and leave to rest, if necessary, on a board. Meanwhile, prepare your oven. Place oven tray on the rack in the centre of the oven and bring to the middle of the oven and, when it is very hot, put the butter and 1/4 cup of cold water in the bottom of the tin. Bring to the boil, skim off the froth and then whisk in the walnut oil and chilli oil. When the water is foaming fiercely, turn the oven off and, if possible, leave the tin for 30 minutes, to cool. Spoon out the juices into a glass preserving, screwwisk, pour in the remaining cold water and the cheese chunks, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Add the walnut oil and stir to combine. Set onto the rack in the oven and leave to rest for 20 minutes when ready to serve.

title: Baked Pork and Cheese With Mango and Beans
ingredients: 500 g boneless pork fillets, cut into 3mm cubes | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 mango, sliced | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 500 g cheese slices | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place all the ingredients, except the ham, cheese and seasoning in ovenproof dish and cook in oven for 20 minutes. Stir to mix and check seasoning. Arrange ham, cheese and mango slices on plate, pour sauce over and serve.

title: Zucchini Almond French Toast
ingredients: 4 zucchini, grated | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 16 slices hoagie rolls or 16 slices sandwich buns
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, mix together zucchini, half and half, almond extract and 1 teaspoon hot water until well blended. Mound meat and vegetables onto sauteed buns and top with additional almond extract.

title: Crispy Roasted Eggplant and Mushrooms With Portabella Sage
ingredients: 1 eggplant, very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups portabella mushrooms, thickly sliced | 1/2 cup good quality chicken broth | 10 -12 leaves fresh sage | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 package frozen cooked spaghetti, preferably whole wheat | sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. Place sliced eggplant in a small roasting tin, and poke holes into the slices with a fork, making sure they don't burn. Bake eggplant until eggplant is tender, about 20 - 25 minutes, flipping pan halfway through. Meanwhile, place mushrooms on a baking tray. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Turn mushrooms over. Return to the oven. Add chicken broth to the pan, and bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat until liquid is reduced by half. Remove from heat. Pour mushrooms and sherry over the eggplant, and sprinkle with sea salt. Serve over warm spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,red cherry,chicken bouillon cube,green olive,poblano pepper
title: Green olives With Pepitas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | red candied cherry, chopped | 25 g green olives, brine drained
instructions: Put the pepitas in a microwave safe dish covered with a layer of olive brine. Microwave on high for 10 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes. Stir, cover and set aside for 10 minutes, until pepitas are tender. Stir in the cherries, and serve as an accompaniment to pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,mushroom,pork tenderloin,sesame seed,ginger,garlic clove,plum tomato
title: Sesame Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 3 tablespoons sesame paste, peanut oil or 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon ginger paste, ginger garlic paste | 1 teaspoon garlic clove, minced | 8 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 -2 mushroom, sliced
instructions: Lightly oil pan, set over medium high heat. Brown pork tenderloin on all sides for about 4 minutes per side. Toast sesame seeds in dry skillet 1 minute or until fragrant. Set aside. Heat peanut oil in pan at medium heat. When hot, add the ginger and garlic paste and cook 1 - 2 minutes, or until lightly golden brown. Add plum tomatoes and ginger garlic paste. Simmer on low for about 10 seconds. Remove and set aside. Remove meat from liquid and slice into strips about 2 1/2 to 3 inches long. Using a slotted spoon, remove the tomatoes and their liquid from the skillet into the sauce. Return meat to pan. Cover and simmer on low for about 2 minutes. Remove from heat, drain off the liquid and set aside. Heat 1 2t of oil on high. Stir fry sliced pork for about 5 to 8 minutes, or until browned. Remove meat from heat. Add the chopped vegetables and any accumulated juices onto the sauce. Cover and continue to simmer for another 20 to 30 minutes or until pork is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,tomato green chilies,sunflower oil,scallion,green bean,ginger root
title: Spicy Tomato, Browned Onion, Garlic and Green Chili Sticks
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 cup finely chopped green onions ( white part only ) | 2 large scallions, chopped, white and green parts separated | 1 piece fresh ginger root, sliced | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies, drained, with liquid reserved | 2 cups uncooked basmati rice, rinsed, drained
instructions: Heat oil in a small skillet over medium high heat. Add onion, scallion whites, ginger, and green chiles. Saute onion until softened. Stir often while cooking. Reduce heat to low. Add drained tomatoes with liquid and rice, and cook until heated through. Stir in reserved tomato liquid, adjust seasonings, and cover. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Guamanian Spiced Shrimp
ingredients: 3 lbs jumbo shrimp | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons annatto seeds
instructions: Shell shrimp and cook the shrimp in a skillet or the marinade until they turn pink and curl up remove and keep warm. Heat 1 cup of water with vinegar over low heat and let cool a bit. When cool add shrimp and heat until heated through. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,serrano chilies,french bread,chili paste,mace
title: Spicy French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1/2 cup chili paste | 4 serrano chilies, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut top off bread. Scoop out bread from center, leaving at least an inch of crust around the inside. Stuff the inside with chili paste, serrano chilies, mace, and graham cracker crumbs, pressing the filling into the bread. Wrap bread in foil and bake until bread is toasted, about 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Sambusa Recipe
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs roasting chickens | 2 bunches green beans, chopped | 6 roma tomatoes | 1/3 teaspoon sumac | 1 box frozen pastry dough, thawed ( about 24 sheets ) | 1 1/3 cups buttermilk | 3/4 lb potatoes or 3/4 lb carrot, peeled and chopped
instructions: Prick chicken with a fork and place it in an ovenproof pot. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until chicken is no longer pink inside, 1 1/2 hours. Drain chicken and debone, and set aside. Skim fat from broth and discard. Slice chicken into serving sized pieces. Bring broth to a boil in a large skillet. Add green beans, tomatoes, and sumac to skillet and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until tomatoes are tender. Remove mixture from skillet and set aside. Punch down pastry dough and set aside. Roll out pastry on a floured surface until the dough is about 10x7 inches. Prick pastry dough with a fork and place about 4 tablespoons of chicken in the center of dough and cover with a few spoonfuls of greens and potatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Fold dough over and enclose filling. Pinch edges to seal. Place on a baking sheet. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Brush each sambusa with a little oil and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Chinese Garlic and Oyster Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, roughly torn into smaller chunks | 4 tablespoons sea salt | 2 tablespoons fresh oyster sauce
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl and toss throughly. Serve immediately.

title: Prune, Onion and Chocolate Chowder
ingredients: 1 vidalia onion | 6 pitted prunes | 1 cup vegetable broth | 6 ounces white chocolate, grated | 12 tortillas
instructions: Chop onion in thin slices and saute until translucent. Add prunes and veggie broth. Cook uncovered on medium heat about 30 minutes, or until prunes become aromatic. Let cool, and coarsely chop the chocolate pieces.

title: Easy and Delicious Beef Broth for 2
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin beef ( sliced thin ) | 8 ounces soy sauce
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Place the soy sauce in a medium sized bowl or pan.

title: Sesame Pancake for Jian Bing
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 ounce dark sesame oil | 2 -3 drops ajwain
instructions: The purpose of a jiangain is to make a very fine paste that will adhere to pancakes when used. Mix the flour, oil, and ajwain together and gradually pour in half of the batter to obtain a thin batter. Keep stirring the batter in the meantime to prevent it from sticking. Pour a little batter in a small flat dish and use a ladle to pour the remaining batter onto it. Place the skillet on a clean table and cook on medium low for 10 minutes. Turn the pancake over and continue cooking for 3 to 5 minutes more. When done, remove the injwain from the skillet and serve immediately. Note, sometimes i add a bit of sugar to the jiangain. If i am in a fan fryer, i put some paper towels over the pancake and set it over the sink. This way the batter spread out evenly. It will harden when heated. If you get a big piece of pancake, turn it over and let it harden before you put in batter. It tastes the same.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,vegetarian bean,red chili powder,plain flour,chunky salsa
title: Vegan Salsa Beans, Cranberries & Cranberries
ingredients: 500 g vegetarian baked beans | 1 cup frozen cranberries | 1 red chili powder | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1/2 cup plain flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pan & cook for approx 15 mins soya or until tender.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,head broccoli,oregano leaf,tabasco sauce,bacon grease
title: Broccoli Carbonara
ingredients: 4 slices bacon grease | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening or 1/2 cup butter | 1 head broccoli, cut into bite sized pieces | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 8 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, fry bacon until browned but not crisp. Add the shortening and cook until lightly browned. Add the chopped broccoli, oregano and tabasco. Stir fry for a few minutes on medium high heat, then raise the heat to high. Reduce the heat to low and cover. Cook until the vegetables are tender, around 20 minutes. Uncover and continue cooking until the sauce is a consistency similar to spaghetti sauce, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Remove the skillet from the heat and allow it to steam for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime peel,chow mein noodle,jalapeno pepper,basmati rice,pistachio
title: Noodle Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice ( soaked in 3 cups of water for at least 15 minutes and then drained ) | 4 tablespoons chow mein noodles | 4 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 1 lemonade or 1 lime peel, squeezed of | cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large bowl mash together rice, 1 tablespoon of chow mein noodles, 2 tbls. Of pistachios and 1/2 cup of warm water. Stir well and let stand about 15 to 30 minutes. Pour into greased shallow pan and sprinkle remaining pistachios over top. Garnish with remaining pistachios just before serving.

title: Mexican Onion Soup
ingredients: 5 medium white onions, cut into thick rings and separated into rings | 2 serrano chilies, split in half lengthwise, seeds removed | 10 1/2 ounces low fat wheat flour | 3/4 tablespoon flour | 1 bag tortilla chips, coarsely broken
instructions: In a 7 to 8 qt. Saucepan, gently poach onion and chilis in water and tomato juice for 30 minutes while adding flour, stirring until it no longer sticks to sides of pan. Cook, stirring over high heat until boiling, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Sift flour over onion mixture and stir with a spoon or wire whisk until mixture is smooth. To serve, ladle into soup bowls and garnish with chopped tortilla chips.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place the beef tenderloin on a heavy baking sheet and sprinkle with the mustard. Bake until the meat reaches 165f on an instant reading thermometer, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,sherry wine,rosemary leaf,pumpkin pie spice,russet potato,leek,mexican cheese
title: Pumpkin Cheese Potatoes With Leeks
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, peeled if using yukon gold potatoes, and about 2 large ones | 1 1/2 pints pumpkin pie spice | 1 tablespoon baking cocoa | 1 1/2 cups shredded light mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup spanish sweet sherry wine or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 2 ounces fresh rosemary leaves, chopped
instructions: Note, if using yukon gold potatoes, you may use 1 large yukon gold potato, about 2 large potatoes. Cut the potatoes into thin 3/4 inch slices, not too thin. Coat the bottom and sides of a 5 - 6 quart slow cooker with cooking spray. Layer the potato slices in the bottom of the slow cooker, and sprinkle with about 1/2 cup of the pumpkin pie spice and 2 tablespoons of baking cocoa. Layer the leeks over the spice. Layer the rest of the potato slices over the leeks, and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup of pumpkin pie spice and 2 tablespoons of baking cocoa and 1 1/2 cups of the cheese. Carefully pour the sherry wine or vinegar over everything. Cover, and cook on high for 6 - 8 hours, or on medium for 4 - 6 hours.

title: Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the meat, margarine and caraway seed. Shape into 8 patties that are about 1 - 2 inches in diameter. Lightly brown the patties in a large frying pan over medium high heat. Place the patties on paper towels to absorb excess grease. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Herbs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprig, crushed | 4 tablespoons fresh parsley ( packed ) | freshly ground coarse black pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, crush oregano or thyme with a motar, then stir in parsley. Sprinkle with pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,chicken breast half,liquid smoke,chuck steak,arborio rice,pineapple juice
title: Slow Cooker Sweet & Sour Pork and Pineapple
ingredients: 6 boneless chuck steaks | 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 3 cans pineapple juice | 1 package arborio rice | 2 1/4 ounces liquid smoke ( no substitutes )
instructions: Slice steak and chicken into large chunks. Transfer to slow cooker. Add ginger paste, juice, rice, and liquid smoke to slow cooker and stir to mix ingredients. Cover and cook on low heat setting 4 hours or high heat setting 6 1/2 hours turning once. Remove and turn slow cooker to high heat setting. Remove meat and cut into large bite size chunks. Turn slow cooker to low heat setting and stir meat and sauce until well incorporated. Serve over rice.

title: Taquitos
ingredients: 1 corn tortilla, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Combine the tortilla strips and cider vinegar and set aside. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook 1 tortilla strip in the hot oil, turning once, until crispy and browned on the outside and just beginning to crisp, 1 to 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,shrimp,ladyfinger,tequila,salmon,cocoa powder,salt black pepper,tuna
title: Salmon and Fish Tacos (Aussie Style)
ingredients: 24 large shrimp, peeled deveined, tail on | 24 ladyfingers | 24 slices smoked salmon, cut into half | 1/2 red chile pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 ounces smoked salmon, diced | 1 -2 tablespoon tequila | salt and black pepper
instructions: Cook the shrimp in boiling water over high heat until just tender, 1 minute. Drain shrimp.

Random Ingredients: hard salami,spring onion,celery,manchego cheese,red cherry pepper
title: Tuscany Salami Casserole
ingredients: 350 g swiss hard salami | 100 g manchego cheese, crumbled | 3 sticks celery | 1 -2 red chili | 1 large handful spring onion, chopped roughly | 1 bunch spring onion, shredded finely
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Cut salami in half lengthways. Cut out the core and discard. Using a large ovenproof casserole dish, layer the salami, cheese, celery, red chilli and spring onion. Repeat layers, finishing with salami on top. Pour boiling water over the top. Cover tightly and place in preheated oven. Cook in preheated oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the casserole is warmed through and cheese has melted in the centre. Serve warm.

title: Linguine With Zucchini and Chocolate Frosting
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine, or as needed | 2 large zucchini, sliced on a mandoline into 12 strips | 3 tablespoons whipped topping, divided ( such as chocolate frosting ) | 3 tablespoons chocolate frosting | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning tm
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add linguine and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Fruit Skewers With Chipotle
ingredients: 12 canned chipotle chiles | 12 whole maraschino cherries | 1 1/2 lbs ripe mangoes, peeled | 3/4 cup corn flakes
instructions: Place canned chipotles in a shallow dish. Cover and refrigerate. Thread fruit on skewers. Cover and refrigerate, turning skewers several times as they soak. The fruit can be stored and used later as a filler for grilled chicken, turkey or fish skewers.

title: Grilled Aubergines With Smoked Salmon (Svijoi Karpetov)
ingredients: 12 heads of cremini mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed and sliced | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 medium aubergines, cleaned, peeled and sliced | sliced sweet red pepper or yellow pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons good quality sea salt or 2 -3 tablespoons salt, to taste
instructions: Prepare your charcoal grill or broiler for direct heat. Arrange the mushrooms in the direct and not direct heat and grill until tender, about 30 - 45 minutes, turning over after 30 minutes. Remove the mushrooms from the grill or broiler and place in a large bowl. Cover and let cool. Combine the vinegar and the mushroom slices. Add the red pepper. Season with salt or taste.

title: Fresh Lemon and Won Tons
ingredients: 1 lemon, zest of | 1 package wonton wrappers, large | 8 tablespoons ice cream, about 20 per won ton
instructions: Wash and dry the won ton pieces. Cut 4 - 5 pieces from each corner of the won ton. Fill the center of the won ton with about 2 t. Zest, then pinch the edges together, creating small, even parcels. Place the parcels on a plate. Put the rest of the zest into the fridge to chill, then squeeze the juice from the lemon into the zest. Scoop out the lemon zest using a zester or a strainer with a fine blade, the easiest way is to use a fine mesh sieve, but you can also spoon the juice through a fine mesh sieve. You want to do this by putting all of the liquid you've squeezed out of the lemon zest into a small bowl and squeezing it together for a second time. Squeeze half the juice from the lemon zest into the bowl where it's resting. Add one t. Juice and mix until you have a homogenous distribution. Put the ice cream puffs in a large baking dish or tray. Heat the oven to 420°f put the won ton parcels into the oven for about 15 - 20 minutes, or until crisp. Remove from the oven. Place the ice cream puffs over a pan of simmering water. Turn off the oven, and leave the baking dishes in there for 5 - 7 minutes more, until the ice cream becomes golden brown and the ice cream is soft.

Random Ingredients: green bean,dill weed,pearl barley,white vinegar,king prawn,dark rum,epazote,quinoa
title: Lumpia
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked pearl barley | 1 cup cooked quinoa | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2/3 cup dark rum | 1 bunch dill weed, chopped | 24 king prawns | 1/2 pound sliced green beans
instructions: Combine the barley and quinoa in a pot and cover.

title: Rice Bread
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( not instant ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 3 cups whole wheat flour ( not bread flour ) | 4 teaspoons unsalted butter, melted
instructions: Combine rice, allspice and 3 cups of flour, and mix well until a mixture forms a dough. Divide dough into 12 portions, and pat into 4 round, slightly flattened, puffed, loaves. Brush top lightly with melted butter and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes, or until golden brown and dry in areas.

title: Easy Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 cardamom pod, crushed | 1/2 1/2 teaspoon crushed ice or 1/2 teaspoon crushed coconut
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and blend thoroughly. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Overnight French Fondue
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1/4 cup dry red wine | white pepper to taste
instructions: Trim crust from bottom of loaf, cut loaf into cubes, wrap in clean, dry cloth, and place in a bowl. Pour wine over the bread, and place in refrigerator to chill, about 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Line an aluminum, glass, or ceramic fondue pot with aluminum foil. Place french bread into the aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes, then reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f and continue to bake for 45 minutes. Remove bread from the oven and allow to cool completely. Slice to desired serving size, and drizzle with olive oil. Top with red wine, and season with white pepper. Serve warm.

title: Cashew Parfaits
ingredients: 500 g cashews | 300 g greek yogurt
instructions: Toast cashews and cashews with a little butter. Mix cashew mix with yogurt. Enjoy.

title: Toasted Raisin Sandwich(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 container soft cool whip topping | 1 1/4 cups raisins ( golden rails may be substituted ) | 1/4 cup chicken broth or 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup sweet and sour topping, divided
instructions: Place cream topping in to a bowl and whisk well. Stir in raisins. Place in refrigerator to harden at least 2 hours. Spread on bread slice or toast sandwich. Serve with assorted jam as desired.

Random Ingredients: steak,french bread,vegetable bouillon cube,tabasco sauce,stilton cheese,fish stock
title: Steak Au Jus With Henry
ingredients: 1/2 lb steak | 2 -3 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 cup fish stock | 1 loaf french bread | 1/2 lb stilton cheese, crumbled | tabasco sauce
instructions: Make a stock cube, by dissolving 1/2 in wine, then whisking in stock and cube for 2 - 5 minutes until smooth. Soak french bread at least 30 minutes. Score the top of the loaf, hollow out the bread slightly. Place the crumbled cheese on bread and roll the loaf in the cheese. Brush the inside of the loaf with some of the stock mixture and place in a baking dish. Pour remaining stock over the bread. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until done.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,vegetable oil,italian pork sausage,cinnamon,salt pork,soup stock,parsnip
title: Sausage and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sweet italian pork sausage | 1 1/2 lbs veg. soup stock | 4 -5 parsnips, peeled and cut into thick slices | 1 large carrot, peeled and sliced into thin rounds | 4 red bell peppers, sliced thinly lengthwise | 1 cinnamon stick | salt | 1 -2 cup vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat the oven to 350°f. In a deep pot, brown the sausages in 1/2 inch of hot oil, then remove and set aside. Add the veg, the soup and their liquid to the sausage pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Lower the heat and simmer gently until the veg is tender. Meanwhile, in a large casserole dish, place the vegetables and cinnamon stick and add the hot soup. Stir well to mix and season to taste with salt. Cover the casserole and place in the oven. Check in 45 minutes to see if the soup is thickening enough. Serve,.

Random Ingredients: red pepper paste,russet potato,orange marmalade,almond paste,marshmallow,shrimp,heavy whipping cream
title: Shrimp Mozambique
ingredients: 5 large russet potatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup red pepper paste | 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 1 lb shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 lb fresh corned beef, cut in 1-inch pieces ( such as sea shell, rockfish, mahimahi, salmon, shrimps ( etc. ) | 1 lb almond paste | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cook potatoes with 1/4 cup of red pepper paste for 20 minutes. Pour mixture into an ungreased 13x9 inch glass baking dish, making sure the paste comes up the sides of dish. Add shrimp to potato mixture and toss. Turn shrimp into baking dish, spreading shrimp evenly over the top. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until shrimp is pink and shrimp are opaque. Remove from oven and stir in corned beef until coated well. Stir in almonds and remaining red pepper paste. Spoon shrimp mixture over shrimp and stir until shrimp are coated. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of red pepper paste and return to oven. Bake for 5 minutes or until heated through and shrimp are opaque. Stir cream and remaining red pepper paste into shrimp mixture, and serve.

title: Kielbasa and Eggs
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 large hard-boiled egg, peeled and chopped | 2 cups plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high and lightly oil a grate. Thread sliced kielbasa onto skewers and put on grill.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,asparagus,kirsch,coffee granule,rice vinegar,chunky salsa,kale
title: Sticky Rice Vinegar Beet Salsa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa ( mild or medium ) | 6 large asparagus, cut crosswise | 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon kirsch or 1 teaspoon cherry brandy | 1 cup hot cooked rice sticks ( asian style or your favorite ) | 1/4 cup scalded ice cream or 1/4 cup heavy cream, whipped until stiff before serving ( optional )
instructions: Steam asparagus 3 to 6 minutes, until just tender crisp and bright green. Drain, but keep warm. In a large bowl combine salsa and asparagus. To serve, place the frozen pudding mix, instant coffee, kirsch and 1 cup hot rice sticks in a blender.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,mint,ginger garlic paste,spice,molasses,pea carrot,white potato
title: Fancy Spiced Vegetables
ingredients: 3 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon mixed spice ( or use white mix of the spices to your taste, like ginger, cassia, cinnamon, cloves, etc. i like lots of spice mix ) | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 small white potatoes, peeled, boiled and cut into large pieces ( optional ) | 2 large peas and carrots
instructions: In a medium size pot, combine molasses, garlic and ginger and saute on medium heat. Add the mixed spices and potato. Let the mixture cook for 5 minutes. Add the peas and carrots then turn off the heat. Add whatever spice mix you have on hand. Cover and let stand for a few minutes. Serve cold.

title: Okroonos (Grandma's Hominy Pizza)
ingredients: 1 unbaked pizza crust | 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 1 can hominy, drained | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring hominy to a boil in a large pot with a sprinkling of salt. Drain and rinse okra until well rinsed and chopped. Arrange in a single layer in a 9 inch pie plate. Pour hominy over okra. Top with whipped topping. Bake in preheated oven until okroons are golden brown, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,pineapple juice,poblano pepper,lemon peel,beef brisket
title: Easy Shredded Beef Brisket and Pineapple
ingredients: 6 medium poblano peppers | 2 tablespoons lemon peel, finely grated fresh | 3 lbs beef brisket or 3 lbs stew meat | 1 jar fresh pineapple juice | 12 ounces fresh angel hair pasta, broken into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Poke holes all over the brisket with a fork to prevent bursting while cooking. Sprinkle with lemon peel. Place brisket on a rack in a roasting pan. Insert a large sliver of lemon peel into each slit. Place the brisket on a rack above a roasting pan and roast for 3 to 4 hours, or until meat easily shreds with a fork.

title: Roasted Beet and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, peeled and cut into pieces | 3 tablespoons roasted garlic granules | 1 can beets, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch casserole dish with aluminum foil. Place cauliflower in a medium baking dish and sprinkle with garlic granules. Cover with sliced beets. Bake in preheated oven until beets are tender, about 25 minutes.

title: Italian Caponata
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs capers | 1 ounce italian dressing or 1 ounce salad dressing | 1 head lettuce | 3/4 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Chop capers in half. Combine capers with dressing in pan and slowly mix into capers. Serve on bread pieces with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: sage,white pepper,buttermilk biscuit,apricot jam,sauerkraut,red snapper fillet,corn
title: Big Fish Bake
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless red snapper fillets | 1/4 teaspoon sage | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 3 tablespoons buttermilk biscuits, finely crushed ( small ) | 1/2 cup sauerkraut, drained | 1/4 cup corn ( optional )
instructions: Cut snapper in half lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,sharp cheddar cheese,broth,red chilies,gingerroot,rye bread,graham cracker crumb
title: Grammy's Thai Pork Strips
ingredients: 4 pork tenderloin | 2 tablespoons gingerroot, peeled and chopped | 12 ounces roasted red chilies, cut in quarters | 1/3 cup roasted garlic puree | 1 1/2 cups canned broth | 2/3 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut the pork into 16 slices. Mix ginger and 2 tbsp of the red pepper paste together.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,spinach,ginger garlic paste,beef tenderloin,aubergine,cooking spray,lime,baby spinach
title: Aubergine Soup
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 beef tenderloin, cutlets pounded to 1/4 inch cubes | 4 small aubergines, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 cups fresh baby spinach | 1 cup fresh chopped spinach | 1 tablespoon lime, juice of | 1 carton of chilled beef hot ready-to-serve beef stock | 1 cup fresh chopped spinach
instructions: Spray grill with cooking oil. Grill or broil tenderloins, cook until brown on all sides, drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with garlic paste. In saucepan, add 3/4 cup beef broth, spinach and aubergines, cook over medium heat until tender. Spoon soup into bowls, garnish with fresh, chopped spinach.

title: Raspberry and Peanut Butter Puree
ingredients: 4 ounces raspberry jam or 4 ounces peanut butter | 2 ounces smooth peanut butter
instructions: Line a nonstick frying pan with aluminium foil. Place the raspberry jam and peanut butter in a bowl and blend to a creamy paste with a hand blender. Place saucepan over a low heat and stir until smooth. Place pan under a hot grill and cook the puree for 3 - 4 minutes until very thick and creamy. Pour the mixture into a bowl and cool slightly. Place in an ice cream maker and freeze until required. Remove fat from mould and return frozen mixture to freezer until required again. Take mixture out of freezer when the mixture begins to harden. Place onto wire rack and allow to return completely cold to make a thick puree.. Place into an airtight container and store in the freezer for up to 6 months.

title: Carrot Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs carrots | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 orange, grated rind | 2 tablespoons fresh garlic paste | 3 tablespoons peach juice
instructions: Cut the carrots lengthwise, then finely slice crosswise. Combine rum, orange peel, garlic and peaches in a saucepan and heat until the rum is just beginning to boil. Pour into a 1 1/2 quart baking dish and spread over the carrots. Cover loosely and let marinate for 1 hour, or several hours. Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Bake uncovered until the carrots are tender but not browned, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rindless bacon,butter,orange juice zest,green lentil,pumpkin seed,olive oil
title: Fried Lentils With Bacon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 350 g green lentils | orange juice, freshly squeezed, about 1/3 cup | 8 slices rindless bacon | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds
instructions: Melt the butter and oil in a large frying pan over a high heat then fry the lentils for 4 minutes, turning frequently, until golden brown. Tip everything into a large bowl, add the orange juice and lime juice.

title: Cafe Mexicano
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground coffee | 1 tablespoon mustard | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed tortillas | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place all the ingredients, apart from tortillas, in a blender and process until smooth. Divide the mixture into small, airtight containers and freeze for up to 1 month. title: Tandoori Bread

title: Walnut Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, ground | 1 tablespoon rose water | 1/4 cup warm water

Drizzle apple slices with 3/4 teaspoon each of chinese sesame oil, candied tart apple, and 2 1/2 teaspoons of the sesame oil. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and toss gently. Repeat with second 1 1/2 teaspoons or sesame oil, apple, sesame oil, salt, and candied tart apple. Let sit 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,plain yogurt,celery rib,white potato,ice cube,serrano pepper,cardamom powder,catsup
title: Middle Eastern Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb white potato, peeled | 1 teaspoon sea salt ( or kosher salt ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 4 -6 celery ribs | 2 serrano peppers, sliced thin | shredded ice cube | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon dry white wine

ingredients: 2 lobster tails, sliced | 8 ounces chipped pork and beans | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | enchilada sauce ( any flavor ) | 1 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Drain fat from lobster tails. Combine the pork, beans and pesto in a bowl. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Spread the bean mixture evenly across the bottom of the pan. title: Turkey and Guinness Pie

Bake in a preheated oven at 200c for around 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cashews, salted ( unsalted, no skins ) or 1 cup peanuts ( unsalted, no skins ) | 1 celery rib, sliced thin | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa ( low-sodium, low-fat, salsa, etc. ) | 2 teaspoons cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Put cashew or peanuts in food processor. Blend for 30 seconds and add celery and salsa.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,amaretto,button mushroom,peanut butter,coriander seed,great northern bean,lasagna noodle,red wine vinegar
title: Mushroom Lasagna
ingredients: 1 jar button mushrooms, sliced | 1 jar marinated great northern beans, drained | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped coriander seed | 24 lasagna noodles ( cooked drained ) | 1/4 cup peanut butter ( smooth, no-fat ) | 1/4 cup amaretto or 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Repeat layers twice more, ending with noodles. Bake, uncovered, for 40 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Cool and cut into squares. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Orange-Marinated Beef With Toothpicks
ingredients: 12 ounces beef tenderloin, trimmed, cut into 3/8 inch slices | 1 teaspoon honey | 12 toothpicks | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 2 cups orange slices | 1 cup store-bought chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat the grill, to medium. Place the beef slices between two sheets of waxed paper.

title: Tropical Lamb Chops and Scallops
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated original coconut-flavored carbonated beverage, such as coca-cola | 3 tablespoons thawed drained fresh coconut | 7 lamb chops, 1 inch thick ( bone-in or boneless ) | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Place the coconut soda in a small bowl. Coat the tops of the lamb chops with the coconut soda.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,green cardamom pod,green bell pepper,flour
title: Kebadara Chutney
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon green cardamom pods, cracked | 1/4 cup bottled chunky salsa ( such as pace ) | 1/2 cup low-fat flour | 2 teaspoons green cardamom pods, cracked
instructions: Stir together bell pepper, cardamom pods, salsa and flour in medium bowl. Cover.

title: Canadian Bacon Salad
ingredients: 6 slices prosciutto, trimmed and chopped | 1/2 cup reduced-fat plain yogurt | 2 scallions, shredded ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Mix the prosciutto, yogurt, scallions, vinegar, maple syrup, and onion flakes in a medium bowl.

title: Peruvian Green Chile Pecans
ingredients: 2 lbs green chili peppers | 1/2 cup ground pecans ( i prefer pecans of mexico ) | 2 lemons, zest of | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely minced | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: First, dry roast the sichuan pecans to a very dark brown color then roughly chop the nuts. Set aside to cool off. This can be made a day ahead. After preparing the pecans, take all the stems off the green chilies and remove the seeds and membrane but do not take away the core and white part of the chilies. I prefer the white part. You can remove the seeds by putting a knife through a chile's shell about a tablespoon at a time for a few seconds and turning until just heated but not burned. You want just enough heat to loosen all the chilies from their skin. Remove white membrane from the chilies and discard. This process can take about 4 or 5 minutes. Grind together all the ingredients except the cooking oil. If using a mortar & pestle, be sure to wash the mortar/p pestle thoroughly, this only needs to get wet or very sticky and keep grinding all this while you are grinding the chilies with the spices but not burned. If you do this, you can use a food processor and pulse the chilies, first to a fine powder, then to the powder. You might not use all the chilies. You want to get a consistent mix but not dry paste like you’d get at a restaurant. If it’s a little dry it will dilute the mix. Once you get that mix, take about an tablespoon. You want to have about ½ cup of mixture and stuff each chili with pecans. Heat the oil until it shimmers on the top. This will take a few minutes but be careful, don’t rush the shimming process. You want a nice dark and fragrant color. Be careful the fumes from the spice mill to the kitchen, you can get this going for a while and it won’t burn you as much. Don’t inhale the fumes and regulate your heat. Add the pecan mixture to the pan and toss so that the chilies are coated by the oil and the pan heats up. Stir fry about one minute. This should give you browning on the top. This is good as long as it’s stored in the fridge for about 5 hours or so.

title: Aussie Breakfast Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 3/4 cup old fashioned stout beer or 3/4 cup newcastle brown ale
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Form hamburger into 5 patties, 1/4 inch in diameter, 1/8 thick. Grill burgers over medium hot coals 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until cooked thoroughly. Cover with foil. Serve with pan juices in gravy boat for dipping.

title: Saffron Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 3 chicken legs | 1 1/2 cups soy sauce or 1 1/2 cups tamari | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | garlic powder | cornflour, for thickening pasta ( optional ) | 1 package whole wheat pasta ( i think i use rotelle )
instructions: Dissolve saffron in 1/4 cup of the soy sauce or tamari. Cut chicken into bite size pieces and set aside. Melt margarine or butter on low heat and add the chicken and brown. Add the remaining soy sauce, garlic and saffron. Stir fry until thick. Add the rice wine. Stir until absorbed. Drain pasta. Add pasta and chicken to the sauce. Mix well and serve.

title: Scallops With Capers and Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 lb sea scallops or 1/2 lb white sea scallops | 1/2 ounce capers, drained and rinsed
instructions: Rinse the scallops well and put in a bowl with just enough cold water to cover them. Soak for 2 to 3 hours in the refrigerator. Drain the scallops, reserving the water in a strainer, and pat dry with paper towels. Remove the scallops from the water. Rinse the scallops and slice them on the diagonal into 1/2 inch thick slices. In a 6 to 8 qt heavy skillet, bring the capers to a boil and add them to the scallops. Reduce the heat to medium and cook them over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring constantly, or until they are just barely opaque. Place the scallops on a warm serving platter and sprinkle with the capers.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash lengthwise,bicarbonate soda,cumin powder,hard egg,grape leaf,serrano pepper,corn syrup
title: Grape leaves With Bicarbonate of Egg
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh grape leaves or 1 lb yellow squash | 2 1/2 lbs yellow squash, peeled and cut lengthwise | 1 -2 teaspoon corn syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 bunch fresh serrano pepper, finely chopped | 1 cup bicarbonate of soda | 2 large hard-boiled eggs, chopped to serve
instructions: Wash and dry grape leaves, wash and pat dry. If using large grape leaves, place upside down on a tray and dry completely. Wash well in running water and leave drained ends untucked. Halve, seed and cut yellow squash into wedges lengthwise. Place in saucepan with a little water and corn syrup. Bring to boil and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, skimming. Turn heat down, add cumin, serrano chilies and cook gently for 1 minute. Set aside to cool. To make egg nests, using a fork, crack the egg into a bowl and let it sink to the bottom. Cover bowl and leave to harden. When firm, scoop the beaten egg out leaving a small shell of approx 1/4 inch thick. Using a slotted spoon, place the egg on a platter. Remove grape leaves from liquid, place on plate and keep warm on low. Repeat with rest, placing egg shells on plates. Place 2 tablespoons of the reserved juice from grape leaves into a pot with a pinch of oil, bring to a boil, and reduce heat to low. Stir in the chilies and keep warm. Place grape leaves in small bowls with some of the sauce or water used to cook grape leaves in. Serve with extra sauce and chopped egg. Serve with hot rice or pita bread.

title: Homemade Pierogies
ingredients: 8 fresh pierogies | salt and brown rice flour ( for frying )
instructions: Bring about 4 - 4 inches of water to a boil in a deep saucepan, then add uncooked rice flour all at once. Stir vigorously to remove any lumps. When the mixture comes to a boil, turn down heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 - 18 minutes, stirring occasionally. Take off the heat. Keep in a bowl covered with plastic wrap, and refridgerate overnight. In the morning, boil off about half of the rice flour. Stir in the rice flour enough to make a firm dough. Knead for a few minutes on a floured surface, then let rest, covered for about 20 minutes. Form the dough into a ball, and roll out into a strip about 1/8 inch thick. Cut into four wedges. Fry in hot fat over low heat in deep fat until nicely browned on the outside, about 2 minutes. Turn over, and fry on the other side. Remove from the oil so the pierogies don't stick together. Cool and freeze in freezer bags.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,cardamom pod,camembert cheese,herb,wooden skewer,rigatoni pasta
title: Rigatoni With Camembert (Mediterranean Cheese With a Zee)
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange zest | 4 ounces ground camembert cheese or 4 ounces mild provolone cheese | 2/3 cup fresh herbs (, such as parsley, dill, or chives ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 24 12 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine cheese, zest, herbs, cardamom, and 1 teaspoon pepper in a small bowl, mixing well. Set aside. Cook pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente. Drain. Brush 1 tablespoon butter in a 10 inch skillet. Heat until hot but not smoking. Add cheese mixture and saute for 3 minutes. To serve, divide pasta among 4 plates, then divide cheese mixture among each plate.

title: Carnival Blend
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mexicorn | 1 pinch saffron | 1/8 teaspoon angostura bitters
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a crock. Serve.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,chipotle chile,pie crust,pepper jack cheese,rice bran oil,cream cheese spread,molasses
title: Smoky Queso Dip from Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pie crusts | 1 package cream cheese spread, such as korma | 4 chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 cups crumbled queso fresco | 1/4 cup rice bran oil | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Heat oven on the pizza pan. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Unroll pie crust onto the baking sheet. Press the uncooked pie crust in to a flat surface. Set aside. Line the pizza pan on the pizza pan with parchment paper. Spread cream cheese spread over crust, and sprinkle with chipotle peppers. Sprinkle cheese mixture over the chipotle peppers. Sprinkle queso fresco over cheese mixture. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 25 minutes. Spread molasses over the quesadillas, and continue baking until queso fresco topping is set, about 15 minutes.

title: Baked Beans for Two
ingredients: 100 g pinto beans, soaked overnight in lots of water | 80 g snow peas or 80 g pea pods | 200 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Put the soaked beans in a large, deep pan with the water it soaked in. Bring everything to the boil. Cover it very tightly with some lid, put the lid on, turn the heat low, and simmer until the beans are very tender, 1 - 1½ hours. Check them after 30 mins.  to make sure they are cooked through. Turn off the heat. Check the beans for resistance, and if you need more, warm through a sieve. When beans are cooled, break them up into a food processor or blender. Add the peas and the cheese. You can make this the night you serve it up, 8 hours early, or 3 hours later.

title: Roasted Parsnips & Burger (Paella)

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a pan, over medium heat sprinkle saffron over parsnips.

title: Togarashi

instructions: Combine all ingredients through a strainer into a mixing bowl and mix well using a fork. You can use this recipe for cakes, cookies, or in scones. Enjoy.

title: Black Eyed Peas With Red Wine Reduction or Refresher
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender or food mill and process until smooth.

instructions: Drain and rinse black beans. Place in pan with water on high. Add sugar, salt, saffron. Bring to a boil. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Serve warm with chips, vegetables or pita bread.

instructions: Place lobster tails in a large resealable plastic bag and place in freezer. Thaw lobster tails and place, frozen or thawed, in a large pot of hot water. Partially peel potatoes.

instructions: Trim excess fat from pork. Slice into thin strips. Drain tuna well in colander. Heat skillet over medium high heat. Add tuna. Stir fry 2 minutes or until no longer pink. instructions: Put the tortilla chips in a blender or food processor with olives, sesame seeds, oil, cumin, and bay leaf. Pulse for 30 seconds or so to mix.

title: Spanish Eggplant and Pepper Salad (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1 small eggplant ( about 2 to 3 pounds ) | 2 small fresh green bell peppers | 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 3/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat grill. Place eggplant on a foil lined baking sheet and grill 10 minutes, turning over once. Remove and let cool. Slice the eggplant in half lengthwise, lengthwise, and slice crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Place on a plate. Arrange green peppers and eggplant slices on a serving platter. In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, cheese, and garlic powder until blended.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,potato,seasoning salt,radish,romaine lettuce leaf,parmigiano reggiano cheese,vermouth,kale
title: Lettuce and Spanish Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped kale | 1 cup coarsely shredded romaine lettuce leaf ( about 8 cups ) | 1 cup coarsely shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 4 ounces ) | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup dry vermouth | kosher salt | 7 tablespoons vegetable oil or 7 tablespoons olive oil | 6 medium potatoes, peeled, boiled and cut in half crosswise ( about 10 ounces )
instructions: Cook kale in 10 to 12 cups water until tender crisp, about 5 minutes, lifting with a slotted spoon to prevent sticking. Heat the oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the potatoes and cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 12 minutes. Stir the potatoes and kale mixture into the potatoes. Season with salt.

title: Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 500 g natural yoghurt, light is best | 1 tablespoon caster sugar, siefted | 600 g baby spinach, washed
instructions: Wash the spinach well and dry on a paper towel. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds and drain. Place a steamer in the pan and cover. Add the yoghurt and toss gently to combine. Add the sugar. Toss in the spinach just before serving.

title: Homemade Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint sour cream | 1 pint ketchup | 1 pint raspberries
instructions: Mix sour cream, ketchup, and raspberries in large pot. Cook on high heat until sour cream is hot.

title: Spiced Roast Turkey
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 500 g lean turkey | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 140 g condensed beef gravy | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Place the cornflour in a plastic bag. Add the turkey, in batches, and shake to coat. Place the turkey, fat side up, on top of the cornflour. Turn over, and repeat. Place in a roasting dish and cover evenly with foil. Place the roasting dish on a roasting tray. Spoon the beef gravy into a saucepan and stir in the fenugreek. Place over a medium heat for 10 minutes or until the fenugreek is golden. Remove the turkey from the oven and place on a heatproof plate. Pour the gravy over it and set aside. Cook the turkey in the oven for 20 minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 170c for medium rare or until the juices run clear from the turkey when tested with a skewer. Remove and allow to stand for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Ditalini Chicken With Tomato Cream
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 8 ounces canned chicken breasts | 14 ounces ditalini, cooked and drained | 1/4 cup extra crunchy natural-style salad dressing
instructions: Coat a 3 qt pan with cooking spray. In medium bowl combine vinegar and chicken and combine well. Place drained pasta in pan. Pour in chicken mixture and toss to combine. Top with additional salad dressing if desired and a sprinkle of extra crunchy natural style veggie crunch if preferred. Scoop into shallow bowls.

title: Pork and Radish Wraps
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloins, each trimmed | 4 leaves lettuce, shredded | 1/4 cup thinly sliced radish | 2 tablespoons ground pork shoulder | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with foil. Place tenderloins on the baking dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper, then layer the lettuce, radish and crumbled pork on top. Cover and bake for about 30 minutes, or until tender and browned.

Random Ingredients: dill seed,rosemary leaf,spinach,pepper sauce,bean paste,monterey jack cheese,sargento mexican cheese
title: Baked Beans & Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 6 ounces bean paste | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup shredded sargento mexican cheese | 1 teaspoon dill seed | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary leaf, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Remove tips from spinach and coarsely chop. In an 8x12 glass baking dish, mix spinach, hot sauce and spraghettes and spread evenly. Add bean paste and stir well. Sprinkle with shredded cheeses. Cover with chopped rosemary and dill seed. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly. Let stand 5 minutes and sprinkle with chopped fresh rosemary.

title: Barley Kumara Salad With Jam and Rum Reduction
ingredients: 3 -3 kumara, cut into 3 cm slices | 4 teaspoons chamare ( clear grape or cherry brandy ) | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 100 g bar-b-que sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped
instructions: To make the salad, sprinkle kumara with salt, put on a baking tray in a microwave and cook on medium high for 3 - 5 mins for softer kumara, 3+5 mins for medium. Set aside to cool. When cool, peel, cut into strips. To make the remoulade, in a small bowl, combine jam, sauce, catsup, lemon extract and cayenne. Stir to combine. To serve, put salad in a bowl, drizzle with remoulade and garnish with cilantro.

title: Cake Recipe
ingredients: 6 cups mayonnaise | 3 vanilla beans
instructions: Split the vanilla pods and add 1/4 cup of mayonnaise. Split vanilla pods and add 5 cups of mayonnaise. Cut remaining vanilla pods into pieces. Heat the saucepan on medium heat, and add the vanilla pods and pods. Allow to boil 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the heat, and let cool. In a mixing bowl, mix mayonnaise and vanilla pods. Add more mayonnaise for texture and more for spreading. Pour the sauce into the mold, and chill for 2 - 3 hours before serving.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie
instructions: Heat all ingredients in a frying pan. When they start to bubble and puff up and puff up, add the puff pastry and roll into a circle. Place the circle on a lined plate and brush with melted chocolate until all the pixie dust has been absorbed. Store in a cool dry place or on a tray.

title: Peanut Rice -- Peanut
ingredients: 2 cups fresh rice or 2 cups short-grain rice | 3/4 cup chicken stock | peel | 1/2 cup peanut oil
instructions: In a small pot, bring the water to a boil and add rice. Cook over moderate heat for about 20 minutes until almost all the water is absorbed. Remove from heat, fluff the rice with fork and allow rice to cool. Meanwhile, in a separate small pot, heat the peanut oil until golden brown. Drain the rice and discard oil. Add the rice to the peanut oil in a wok. Stir until the rice is well coated with oil and browned. Do not stir or shake. Pour the rice into a serving dish and serve warm or cool.

title: Melon Balls and Fruit
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked cantaloupe | 6 pieces bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon apple juice cocktail cooking oil | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 cup sparkling water
instructions: Slice cantaloupe in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and membrane and cut into cubes. Place all ingredients in blender jar with slivers of bacon drippings and puree. Pour into pan with cantaloupe cubes and stir until batter is smooth. Dip melon balls in batter and fry until crisp on all sides. Plate with fresh fruit or ice cream if desired.

title: Spicy Almonds, Sticks, and Chiles
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed black walnuts, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped roasted chile
instructions: Place nuts in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill before using.

Random Ingredients: hash brown,taco seasoning mix,sun tomato,stewing beef,sherry,cajun seasoning,curd,banana
title: Taco Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 packages frozen, uncooked hash browns, thawed | 1 package thick sliced banana | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/3 cup chopped sun-dried tomato
instructions: In a dutch oven cook beef over medium heat until browned. Stir in taco seasoning mix, cajun seasoning, sherry and hash browns and heat until potatoes are crisp. Mix with banana and sun dried tomato. To serve, toss with hot tortilla strips if desired.

title: Garam Masala Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine ( preferably shaoxing sun crystals ) | lime wedge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer, stirring occasionally, until mixture has reduced by one third. Remove from heat and transfer to a saucepan. Serve over hot cooked basmati rice, garnished with a lime wedge.

title: Oriental Grilled Chicken-And-Vegetable Sandwich With Arugula
ingredients: 1/2 aubergine, halved, peeled, cut crosswise 1/4 - 1/3-inch thick | 1 pkg mixed sprouts | 3 tablespoons dry sherry wine vinegar | 1/4 cup soymilk | 2 hoagie rolls, halved and toasted ( or sub rolls of choice ) | 1/2 large aubergine, halved, peeled, cut crosswise 1/4-inch thick | 1 can mixed sprouts or ( 10 ounce ) can baby mixed sprouts | 1 jar prunes or ( 420 g ) jar red currants
