instructions: To prepare the bbq, line 2 charcoal grill with foil and heat on high. Grill on both sides until golden, about 3 minutes total, measured with meat thermometer. Remove from foil and let stand 5 minutes. Slice diagonally across the grain. To prepare the sandwiches, position a rack in the centre of the grill and heat on medium high. Scatter the sprouts on the grate, then cover with the aubergine slices. Cook, turning the slices, for 4 minutes, or until the sprouts are tender and lightly crisp. While they are still warm, sprinkle them with the vinegar. Let cool for 1 minute, then slice into 1/4 slices. To assemble, on both sides of the bread slice, top the roll with a slice of aubergine and sprouts, then another slice of bread, and sandwich with the sprout and aubergine. Repeat with the remaining ingredients.

title: Broiled Cod With Pasta and Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs cod, cut into 2 x 1/2-inch pieces | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 large orange, zest of, from 1 to 1 1/2 oranges | picante sauce | 8 ounces pasta, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9x13 glass dish with cooking spray. Coat the fish with olive oil spray and place in dish. Sprinkle with zest and cilantro. Cover and roast 2 to 3 hours until fish flakes easily from bones.. Remove fish pieces from bones, serve with picante sauce.

title: Bruschetta
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cracked grain mustard | 1/4 cup fresh basil or 2 tablespoons dried basil, chopped
instructions: Place basil in small bowl. Stir in mustard. Serve immediately.

title: Spanish Beef Skewers
ingredients: 12 skewers ( i use sirloin, rib eye or top round ) | 2 lbs sirloin | 1 red bell pepper | 2 leeks ( white part only ) | 2 oranges ( sections or wedges ) | 1 cup pine nuts
instructions: Cut sirloin into cubes about 1x2 inches. Cut bell pepper into 2 inch long strips. Cut leeks into 3 long pieces. Slice orange segments and zest into 2 long sections, removing pith from rind if desired. Add to beef. Slice oranges and leeks. Mix all ingredients so that everything is well coated. Soak 8 - 10 wooden skewers at least 45 minutes in water. Preheat grill to high, just lightly oil the grates, or broil the sirloin on high about 5 inches from heat, turning frequently, until meat is nicely browned. Serve with rice. Variation, instead of beef, i added mushrooms and peas. Also, the meat on skewers can be browned in oil on high instead.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,mexican cheese,orange peel,lasagna noodle,asafoetida powder,farfalle pasta,cooking oatmeal,spinach leaf
title: Mile High Oatmeal Lasagna
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves | 2 pints medium-size cooking oatmeal | 1 pound shredded mexican cheese blend | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 24 lasagna noodles | 16 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the spinach and oatmeal. Spread 1/2 to 3/4 cup of the oatmeal over the bottom of a large pot on the bottom of the table. Place 1/4 cup spinach mixture over the oatmeal. Over the spinach, place 1/4 cup of the mexican cheese blend. Top with 1/4 cup of the oatmeal mixture. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the mexican cheese blend. Make a well in the center of the mixture, drop 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of the oatmeal mixture in and mix into the center. Make the last layer with 2 noodles, overlapping 1/4 in the same proportions. Cover with remaining oatmeal mixture in the same order. Sprinkle with 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons mexican cheese blend. Cover with foil and refrigerate until ready to bake. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f in a baking dish, place 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of remaining butter in the bottom. Place a sheet of foil over the pan to catch any spills. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove the foil. Bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes to brown the top, bubble a few minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,salmon fillet,chicken stock cube,cream,syrup,bread,red pepper flake,russet potato
title: Potato and Salmon Parcels with Sour Cream (Panzanella)
ingredients: 6 russet potatoes, medium cut into large chunks | 150 ml chicken stock cubes or 150 ml vegetable stock | 1 3/4 cups cream | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 4 salmon fillets ( skin left on ) | 2 slices soft bread | syrup ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oven to 190 c. Place the potatoes in a colander, sprinkle with salt and leave to drain while you work. Place all of the remaining ingredients into a large saucepan, bring to the boil and then remove from the heat. Heat a non stick frying pan over high heat and sear the potatoes until crispy and light coloured, about 15 minutes, turning half way through. Place the salmon on top of the potatoes and gently pat down to make sure the base is covered in water. Place in a baking tray and spray with oil if you wish. Turn the tray over, spoon over the remaining mixture, cover with a sheet of foil and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the salmon is cooked and the potato has turned golden. To serve, place the slices of warm bread on an oven tray and spread with sour cream, top with potato and sprinkle over the hot salmon and drizzle over some syrup if using.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,carrot,pita pocket,sunflower oil,applesauce,romaine lettuce heart,peppercorn
title: Crunchy Apple Shapes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 large romaine lettuce hearts | 1 large carrot | 4 pita pockets | 1 tablespoon applesauce | 8 crushed peppercorns | 20 rice paper sheets, thawed
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok, then scatter over the lettuce hearts, carrot, peppercorns, and rice paper. Fry for 3 - 4 minutes, until all the ingredients are tender and the oil has been absorbed. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Spicy Chickpea and Squash Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas | 1 red squash, coarsely chopped | 1 jar small pimientos, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Cover dried chickpeas with water.

title: Chunky Tempeh Wraps
ingredients: 400 g tempeh | lime wedge, to serve | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Slice tempeh into thin strips. Place on paper towel lined microwave trays and sprinkle with lime juice. Microwave on full power for 3 minutes or until cooked. Spread over a little scallion and serve.

Random Ingredients: egg white,rice,dark chocolate,vanilla flavoring,green olive,club soda,slab bacon
title: Sausage Breakfast Club (From Club C
ingredients: 10 ounces rice ( short or long, italian ) | 4 slices thick slab bacon, chopped ( we like spicy! ) | 10 -12 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/1 cup light dark chocolate shavings, melted | 3 green olives, sliced | 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring ( or 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract ) | club soda ( for dipping )
instructions: Spray a jelly roll pan with vegetable spray and line the bottom with parchment paper. Add bacon and cook, stirring until crisp. Remove bacon and drain on paper towels. Set aside. In a large bowl, mix together hot rice, eggs, chocolate, 3/4 of the chopped olives, 1/2 tsp of the vanilla essence, cooled bacon, cooled crumbled bacon, remaining olives, remaining chopped olives, remaining vanilla essence and refrigerate until mixture gets a nice consistency. Preheat oven to 375°f. Line your baking sheet with parchment paper. Put one layer of uncooked rice mix on the sheet.. When it looks like there is a 'crumple', use a knife to poke several lines in the rice mix. Spread out the cooled mixture on top of rice. Cut into desired shapes with an oiled pastry wheel or sharp knife. Repeat with the top layer of rice and spread out the rest of the mixture on top. Let sit for 20 minutes. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve warm with club soda as an appetizer or on italian toast for a breakfast snack.

Random Ingredients: vegetable chicken broth,heavy cream,cornflour,bean thread noodle
title: Microwave Casserole
ingredients: 500 g mixed beans thread noodles | 200 g veggie chicken broth ( or mushroom broth if using broth ) | 150 g cornflour | 300 ml heavy cream
instructions: Drain the beans, rinse and add to the microwave. If the noodles are medium, cut them in half. If they are smaller, break up in a mortar and pestle. Cook over high for 5 minutes. Stir in the water, bring to the boil, then partially cover and let sit on full power for 3 - 4 minutes. Check to see if noodles are completely cooked. If they look like they are, add some vegetable stock at this stage or steam. If you need to add a little bit more cream, just cook until the noodles are completely cooked, then microwave again for another 5 minutes, until the noodles look cooked. If not, remove half the noodles. If desired, gently fold in half the cream using a fork. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Blueberry Parcels #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed and chilled | 1 bunch blueberries, washed and patted dry | 32 curry leaves, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Unfold the puff pastry and roll it out on a lightly floured work surface until it’s 6 - ½ inches in diameter. Fold the sides and ends over the top of the pastry. Gently stretch the dough to fit a 9 - 9 inch square baking dish. Add the blueberries to the center of the pastry, then sprinkle the curry leaves on top of the blueberries. With the tip of a sharp knife, carefully cut 1/2 inch slits through the top of the pastry. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the top is puffed and the puff pastry is golden and crisp. Allow to cool for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,butter,sesame seed,salad oil,meat,bailey irish cream
title: Bailes (Beer-Glazed Meat)
ingredients: 4 lbs lean meat ( prime rib roast or lamb, or lamb ) | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 3 tablespoons dark beer | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Score meat in 3 to 4 diagonal slices to provide a fluted pattern. Spread meat with salad oil. Pour dark beer over meat. Insert meat skewers through meat, making sure each side is completely coated with oil. Place on a rack in shallow roasting pan and roast for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until a thermometer reads just 125°f. Transfer meat to cutting board and slice into 1 inch strips. Return slices to pan and set aside while preparing sauce. To make sauce, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add sesame seeds. When the seeds give off a pop immediately, add baives and stir until butter is melted. Remove from heat and add meat to sauce.

title: Butternut Squash and Caramelized Sweet Pretzel
ingredients: 1 lb butternut squash, peeled cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 8 medium size ) | ketchup ( optional ) | 1/4 cup whiskey ( optional ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons grated cardamom seeds ( divided ) | 1/4 cup tamarind paste ( koon chun brand works best ) | 1 lb spaghetti
instructions: Place squash on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place in a 450°f oven and bake until soft, about 25 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, mix ketchup, whiskey, yeast, 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, cardamom pod, and 1/4 cup tamarind paste in a small bowl and set aside. Boil a large pot of water with the remaining 1 tablespoon cardamom seeds. Place spaghetti in a large serving bowl, top with squash mixture and toss with remaining 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds and sugar. Set aside to rise for about 15 minutes or until the spaghetti is at the right consistency.

title: Teddy's Simple Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package beef-flavor ramen noodles | 1 cup prunes ( or other nuts ) | 1 spice, as per taste
instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions, do not overcook. Drain and set aside. Mix all the above ingredients and place back in fridge. Allow to rest for 10 - 20 minutes before cutting.

title: Cauliflower & Rice
ingredients: 1 bag cauliflower | 3/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup brown rice | 1/8 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1/8 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions. Remove cauliflower from liquid and add other ingredients. Cook until cauliflower is fully cooked/cooked. Serve with hot cooked or fresh bread.

title: Cucumber Shiitake
ingredients: 1 piece seedless cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 ounce shiitake mushroom, roughly chopped in food processor | 2/3 cup sour cream | 1 lb lard, in the can
instructions: Place the cucumber, shiitake and sour cream in a bowl. Cover and allow to sit for 30 minutes at room temperature. Heat the lard in a heavy frying pan on medium heat. Add the cucumber mixture to the pan and allow to saute approximately 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: reynolds wrap foil,mango,fettuccini noodle,chili flake,angelica,clove,kosher salt
title: Chili Fettuccini With Cinnamon Fettuccini and Mango Salsa #RSC
ingredients: 4 ounces angelica | 1/2 red hot chili flakes ( optional ) or 1/2 yellow chili pepper | 1 can diced mangoes, drained | 1 package preffi fettuccini noodles | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves, toasted | reynolds wrap foil | kosher salt ( optional )
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to boil with red chile flakes and 1/2 tsp of salt add the noodles and stir. Cook the pasta according to the package directions, just until tender. Drain the noodles, rinse and drain again. Transfer to medium bowl. Add remaining tablespoon of oil, and combine with the mango. Add a pinch of ground cloves and a sprinkling of ground cinnamon. Toss to combine all the ingredients and then sprinkle with the remaining ground cinnamon. Note, for color variation, red chile peppers can be substituted for the red chili flakes.

title: Beef Patties (Steamed Rice With Cabbage)
ingredients: 300 g chuck, cut into 4 cm chunks | 1 cup chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 teaspoon sage | 1 - 2 1/2 cup chinese cabbage, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place beef in a large bowl of water with 1/2 teaspoon of seasoning salt and leave to soak for 45 minutes. Add in the rest of the seasoning salt and mix well to coat and set aside, and steam the beef for 5 - 10 minutes or until cooked through. Remove the beef and cut into small chunks and steam for a further 5 - 10 minutes. Serve over the steamed cabbage or mash with a fork. The beef can also be cooked in a wok, a casserole dish of choice, and served with the rice and steamed carrot for a tasty meal.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 loaf lettuce, torn off the leaf like flat bread | 1/2 cup finely shredded lettuce with a touch of salt, for coating
instructions: Heat up a frying pan/dutch oven over a medium heat. Add the sliced beef and cook, covered, for 4 minutes or less. Shred your cooked beef, then pile it in the center in 4 flat flat, large, shallow soup plates.

Random Ingredients: texas toast bread,bacon,picante sauce,ice water,cilantro leaf,lipton onion soup mix,cheddar cheese,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Cincinnati-Style Baked French Bread With a Kick
ingredients: 2 lbs crusty texas toast thick bread, cubed | 6 slices bacon, cooked till crisp, sliced | 2 cans condensed lipton onion soup mix | 2 jars picante sauce | 2 2/3 ounces lipton onion soup mix | 2/3 cup frozen chopped cilantro leaves ( to taste ) | 1 1/4 cups grated cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix ( or to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease baking sheet with butter. Mix all ingredients together except bread. Set aside. Mix bread and the cheese and place in a 13 x 9 baking dish or two baking pans. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until toasted and bubbly. Serve with fresh cilantro.

title: Smoked Halibut in Sherry - Sweden
ingredients: 1 lb dried halibut | 2 ounces dry sherry | 5 fluid ounces whipping cream | 3 sun-dried tomatoes or 3 parsley
instructions: Boil the halibut for about 20 minutes. Let cool under cold water. Remove skin and bones. Cut fish into pieces or bite size pieces. Bring the sherry and cream to boiling point. Add fish. Stir until hot. Serve at once with the sundried tomatoes, fresh parsley or basil.

title: Quick & Easy Turkey and Rhubarb Sausage
ingredients: 2 cups cooked turkey, chopped | 1 package taco seasoning | 500 g rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the crockpot on high setting, then cook turkey for 5 minutes. Remove turkey from crockpot and add taco seasoning to it. Drain liquid if you wish and return turkey to crockpot. Stir to mix and cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until turkey is cooked through. Place meat, rhubarb and 1/4 of the taco seasoning into an 8 1/2'' x 11 1/2'' baking dish. Cover with remaining 1/4 of the taco seasoning. Dot with the remaining teaspoon of taco seasoning. Wrap and bake in the oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,pear,pecorino romano cheese,red wine vinegar
title: Pear Pears With Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 2 pears, cored and 1/2-inch-thick | 1/2 cup finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Prepare grill for direct heat preparation. Spread the mustard seeds on a clean towel and press on the mustard seeds with your thumb to release the air. Sprinkle the peeled and sliced pears with the grated pecorino romano cheese. Drizzle both sides of the pears with a little of the red wine vinegar. Set on a clean tea towl. Close the lid and set a second kefalograviera in it. Close the lid and let it sit for about 15 minutes to allow the flavors to infuse. This is where you want a refreshing refreshing sensation. Use a spatula to move the pears onto the grill, keeping them intact. When they have grill marks on their surfaces, turn them over and continue cooking. Cook until they are done to your liking.

title: Grilled Tuna
ingredients: 1 can albacore tuna | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Drain the tuna and place into a bowl. Using a fork, flake the tuna with a fork into smaller bits as desired. Stir in the cayenne powder and minced dill weed. Taste and adjust seasoning.

title: Dynamite Salad for Two
ingredients: 1 lb collard greens | 2 roma lettuce leaves, washed and torn | 1 can sauerkraut | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili flakes, to taste | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Put together collards, chopped greens and sauerkraut in a large bowl. For dressing, stir together olive oil, chili oil, chili flakes, chili flakes and almonds. Pour dressing onto greens mixture and toss. Chill.

title: Aussie Olive Snack
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup ( any syrup can be used ) | 8 green olives, sliced | 12 slices rye bread ( i like rye bread )
instructions: Spread golden syrup evenly over 2 pieces of rye bread. Place 1 sliced olive stick onto syrup, then top with 2 slices of rye bread, spreading until all of the bread is covered. Place remaining slice of rye bread on top of the rye bread and sandwich, pressing the bread firmly into sandwich. I microwave on medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Allow to re heat for 2 - 3 minutes before serving with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Hainian Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight
instructions: Combine the corn oil and beans in a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: greek salad dressing,white flour,vodka,cooking oat,catsup,red curry paste,flaky pastry dough
title: Awesome Malaysian Pizza
ingredients: 1 package white flour pizza crust | 1 1/2 ounces red curry paste or 1 1/2 ounces white curry powder | 6 tablespoons catsup | 4 tablespoons vodka | 2 tablespoons greek salad dressing | 1 tablespoon catsup, optional ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons vodka, optional ( optional ) | cooking oats ( optional )
instructions: To make the crust, preheat the oven on the 400°f. Mix the dry ingredients in a bowl together. Mix the wet ingredients in a separate bowl. Add a light touch of water if needed. Spray an oven safe pizza pan with cooking spray, and press out the sticky dough. Spread the thin layer of thick dough across the pizza base, and brush liberally with the olive oil. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes, then remove from the oven and brush with the remaining olive oil. For the pizza topping, when pizza is done, spread the sauce over the top of the crust. For the topping, mix the sauce and toppings together. Spread over the pizza or pizza toppings. Sprinkle with the oats if you have them, and return to the oven and bake for a few minutes. Take out of the oven and flip the slice over.

Random Ingredients: ortega chile,feta cheese,swiss cheese,yogurt,coffee granule,yellow bell pepper,cardamom seed
title: Feta Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 3/4 cup coarsely shredded swiss cheese | 2 cups chilled yogurt | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine feta, swiss cheese and crumbled feta cheese. In each serving bowl, beat yogurt with coffee granules, cardamom and pepper until creamy. Fold cheese mixture into creamy mixture. Drop by the spoonfuls onto toasted, lightly oiled cookie sheet, about one inch apart. Let stand until cool, at least one hour.

Random Ingredients: cashew,pork tenderloin,almond meal,green chili pepper,green chile,linguine,bacon
title: Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 whole pork tenderloin, with the thickest portion on top, and the tenderloin on the loin | 6 slices bacon | 2 -3 canned diced green chilies | 1/2 - 3/4 cup roasted diced green chili pepper, with seeds or 2 -3/4 cup jalapeno pepper | 1/2 cup almond meal | 1/2 cup cashews | 1/3 cup chili powder ( optional, but encouraged )
instructions: Put the two loin loins into a ziploc bag with the cashews, green chili peppers, green chiles, and almonds on top. Shake the bag to mix ingredients, and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours or overnight. Turn the bag over a few times to remove the cashewnuts. Grill the tenderloins. Take the loins out of the bag and grill on a rack. Place loins on a warm platter and garnish with chili powder, if desired. Serve.

title: Cheesy Breadsticks and Risotto Topping for Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup whole pearl barley | 1 1/4 cups fontina cheese, grated ( or any other hard cheese ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f mix all ingredients well in large bowl. Using your hands, rub mixture evenly onto baking sheet spread evenly and spread out in a thin layer. When cool, slice diagonally using small circular or star shaped shaped slices from plastic pizza style. Place on rack and freeze to desired thickness, about 4 hours, until firm. Place on rack to cool completely and store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: ice,beef sirloin,mustard seed,plum tomato,vegetable bouillon cube,dark brown sugar,ricotta cheese,red chili pepper flake
title: Beef  Philly  Hot Dog-Style
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cooked beef sirloin | 1 package low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard seed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | crushed ice | plum tomato, slices
instructions: Place beef and cheese in a 3 - 3 quart slow cooker. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and pour over beef mixture.

title: Tasty Herbed Cheese
ingredients: 8 lbs ( preferably artisan blends, not littlenecks ) | 7 lbs mexican blend cheese ( preferably monterey jack, mild and sharp type ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh herb ( such as cilantro, parsley, marjoram, basil ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 1/2 cups grand marnier or 1 1/2 cups triple sec
instructions: Remove stem end flap of each cheese. Mash very coarsely with fork, or if you prefer a smoother cheese, pulse several times it will be a thick paste. Combine minced herbs and grand marnier or triple sec. Taste and adjust seasoning. To stuff cheeses, spread cheese in round casserole or on crackers, then sprinkle with cheese/herb mixture. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let ferment in a warm draft free place for 24 hours, or longer for storage, pressing dough with fist. To use, pat dough into a 2 x 12 rectangle and wrap in wax paper or aluminum foil. Freeze up to two months. To use, thaw in refrigerator up to one week prior to grilling or baking.. Freeze up to three months.

Random Ingredients: scallop,rice wine,cooking spray,hershey chocolate syrup,hot water
title: Scallops With Chocolate Sauce - Yummy!
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 lb scallops | 2 tablespoons sweet rice wine | 2 tablespoons hershey's chocolate syrup | 1/4 cup hot water
instructions: Spray medium skillet with cooking spray, add scallops.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,chili oil,onion flake,feta cheese,chicken breast half
title: Crispy Panko Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup feta cheese | 4 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dried crushed onion flakes | 1/2 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Cut two pieces of aluminum foil into each meat piece. Place chicken between two pieces of foil and flatten to 1/4 inch thickness. In a bowl combine feta, panko, onion and chili oil. Spoon feta/cheese mixture over chicken and roll up. Place chicken in a shallow baking dish. Bake in 375f degrees oven for 45 - 50 minutes, or until chicken is cooked thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,asparagus,irish whiskey,red food coloring,milk chocolate,custard powder
title: Asparagus Chowder
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh asparagus | 2 tablespoons instant custard powder | 1 bunch irish whiskey ( you can make your own irish whiskey but is the authentic ingredient ) | 2 tablespoons irish cream ( i use bailey's ) ( optional ) | 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 pinch red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus and cut the sticks into 2 inch lengths. Bring some water to a boil and cook the asparagus until firm to the touch, about 3 - 4 minutes, until bright green. Meanwhile, make the custard using the whisk attachment of a blender. Combine the asparagus w/the custard powder in a medium bowl and whisk until creamy. Melt the cheddar cheese and irish whiskey together in the microwave until combined. Pour the irish/heavy cream over the asparagus mixture and whisk to combine evenly. Heat the chowder over medium low heat, stirring occasionally so the custard doesn't burn. Do not boil. Pour about 2 cups of the chowder over the asparagus, stir to combine. Add the reserved cheddar cheese and stir until melted. Add more chowder or mixture, a little at a time, and whisking to combine. Just before serving, sprinkle over the chocolate, and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,wheat flour,filet beef,sumac,grain white rice,great northern bean
title: Baked Beef, Rice and Bean Tagine
ingredients: 2/3 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 3/4 lbs ground lean stewing beef | 2 tablespoons ground sumac or 2 tablespoons allspice | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 1 cup canned great northern beans or can navy beans, rinsed and drained | 3 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour, for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f combine rice, beef, sumac, the juice of 1 lemon and 2 1/2 tablespoon of the beans in a bowl and stir to blend. Toss the mixture with the remaining 2 teaspoons of bean. Spread the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and top evenly with the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of bean mixture. Sprinkle with the flour. Bake covered 20 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 minutes longer. Note, you may make the tagine 3 days ahead and store in the refrigerator. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil to the tagine and bring to room temperature before baking.

title: Beef Fondue
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 1/2 lb ground poblano chile ( or other chile ) | 4 tablespoons honey | 1/2 lb bacon, diced ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups cannellini beans | 1 1/2 cups rum | 1/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet that will fit in a crockpot. Place meat in crockpot. Place in large bowl and rinse and separate the beans. Add to skillet. Add honey and mix. Cook on low for 5 - 6 hours. Turn the heat on to high to give the fondue a good stir so everything gets cooked evenly. Add more rum to keep from sucking up any fondue and to help mellow out the alcohol. Turn fondue off the crockpot, take the meat out of the juice, and put in a dish. Pour off any juice but the fondue will keep it warm in the crock pot. If you like, you can mix into it some grated cheese, garlic, ham chunks, etc.. You can use a combination to play with the flavors, but i recommend working with the cheese first to get it right.

Random Ingredients: ham,vanilla essence,green enchilada sauce,bacon grease,beef broth,chive,lard,english mustard
title: Clams' Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs lean stewing beef sirloin steaks | 6 tablespoons bacon grease | 1/2 cup chives, snipped | 4 -6 tablespoons mild english mustard, dry ( use sweet-but-hot style ) | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 2 cans low sodium beef broth | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons chives, snipped | 2 tablespoons creamery flavoring or 2 tablespoons chives, snipped chives | 1 1/2 tablespoons chive, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a large skillet, brown meat and bacon fat. Add 1/2 cup water and simmer over low heat until tender. Add mustard, chives, 1 can enchilada sauce and seasoning. Cook until reduced to 1/. Combine meat with remaining enchilada sauce.

title: Ethiopian Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon split white wine | 1/8 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds, or to taste | 3 ounces bacon, coarsely chopped | 1 green chile, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Mix the yogurt, wine, and cardomom seeds with a fork in a bowl. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Stir the bacon and green chile together, and remove the yogurt mixture from the refrigerator. Bring to room temperature and stir in the yogurt mixture, just until absorbed.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,chicken wing,tarragon,flat leaf parsley,avocado,mexican cheese
title: Tarragon Mexican Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings | 1/8 teaspoon crushed dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground dried mexican blend cheese | 1/8 teaspoon dried flat-leaf parsley | 2 slices ripe avocados, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line baking sheet with parchment paper. Coat chicken wings evenly with tarragon, garlic salt and mexican cheese. Place on prepared sheet and bake until chicken is thoroughly cooked and just cooked through, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Top with avocado slices and parsley if desired.

title: Danish-style Savoury Corned Beef Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs corned round, skin on | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon instant finely chopped lavender | 1 teaspoon instant mixed fruit | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup mixed dried fruit, chopped | 1 cup shredded red cabbage | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard
instructions: In small bowl, combine oil with lavender. In medium bowl, combine remaining ingredients.

title: Arepas
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons buttermilk | pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat until blended. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Shake Nuts of the Earth
ingredients: 2 cups dry coconut flakes | 1 1/2 cups soda water | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 6 leaves of fresh mint, with the tender stems ( to garnish )
instructions: Place coconut and soda water in a blender or food processor fitted with the metal blade. Puree until the coconut is smooth. Place in a large glass bowl and let sit until cool. Mix in the fresh mint leaves, cardamom and grated peel. Set aside in the refrigerator until ready to use. Serve in shaker or tall glass with garnishes.

Random Ingredients: lime jell o gelatin,baby spinach,kosher salt,thyme sprig
title: Green Jell (Zwt 3)
ingredients: 1 package lime jell-o gelatin ( not sureral ) | 2 cups baby spinach, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Sprinkle jelly over spinach. Let stand at room temperature 12 hrs or until jelly softens. Drain spinach on absorbent paper and chop coarsely. Remove jelly packages from can and squeeze out excess moisture. Return 1 cup chopped spinach to kettle. Add remaining spinach, thyme, kosher salt and jello. Bring to a boil and boil for 3 - 4 min uncovered. Cool slightly before stirring. Pour into 9 x13 inch pan. Cover tightly with tin foil and refrigerate. Cut into 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: heirloom tomato,pork,veal,white cake mix,lime wedge,lager beer,chunky salsa,pine nut
title: Pork and Salsa Triscuits
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1 lb ground pork | 1 lb ground veal | 1 loaf raw shrimp, peeled & deveined | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup lager beer ( or another dark beer ) | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Prepare cake as directed using pkg directions, using cake mix as directed on the package, omitting oil. Drain well. Reserve 1/2 cup of the batter. Brown pork and veal, stirring to separate meat. Drain shrimp and reserve juice. Place shrimp into large bowl and pour remaining batter over. Stir lightly until blended. Sprinkle pine nuts and chunky salsa over. Pour the beer over meat mixture, mixing lightly. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Cut cake into 1 inch squares. Place onto greased baking sheets bake at 350 degrees 15 - 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Linguine With Curried Chocolate and Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 350 g linguine, dried | 1/2 cup ground chocolate | 125 g paradachio-flavored chocolate | 1 1/4 teaspoons xanthan gum | 3 cups curry leaves | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the dried linguine in a large bowl and mix with the ground chocolate. Allow to stand 10 minutes. Preheat the grill. Remove the chocolate mixture from the bowl and mix with the vanilla. Cook the linguine for 10 minutes, adding extra water if necessary. Toss with half of the curry leaves and half of the chocolate sauce. Serve with the remaining curry leaves alongside.

title: Simmered Beef on Rye (With Microwave)
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 3/4 cup peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 cup rye bread ( whole-wheat bread for dipping )
instructions: If using fresh peas, cut the pea pods in half if using frozen. If using fresh peas, defrost in microwave and toss to coat the peas with moisture. Add beef pieces to crock pot. Add sugar to broth and stir to mix, then place lid on crock pot. Cook on high 3 hours or low 8 hours. When ready to serve, slice rye bread about 1/4 inch thick, top with beef slices and serve with the warmed broth in a bowl.

title: Creamy Yoghurt With Hummus!
ingredients: 750 ml double cream | 450 g caster sugar | 2 teaspoons wasabi powder | 350 g chickpeas ( drained )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large blender or food processor and blend until the mixture has a thick paste texture. If you have a hand blender, this is the time to blitz and use to thicken to your desired consistency. Serve straight away, sprinkled with sesame seeds, fresh grated lemon zest or black sesame is ideal.

title: Easy and Simple Barbecued Lamb and Noodles
ingredients: 600 g leg of lamb ( very lean ) | 2 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 2/3 cup tortilla chips
instructions: Trim fat from lamb.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 cup chicken breast, diced | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Add cumin seed to a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Toast cumin seeds until fragrant.. Set aside. Coarsely grind chicken with spice grinder or mortar and pestle. Add sliced bamboo to same skillet. Cook and stir over medium heat until chicken is cooked through. Remove from heat. Cool slightly and set aside until cool. On cookie sheet, lay out 1 sheet of thawed pastry. Spoon equal amounts of chicken and vegetable mixture into pastry. Top with remaining pastry and brush with cumin mixture. Use your fingers dipped in water to seal edges of pastries. Cut slits in top of pastries, 1 inch apart. Bake in preheated oven until pastries are golden brown and filling is heated through, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Style Hot Coccoffe (Gao)
ingredients: 4 ounces hot coffee, brewed | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 stick garlic, shaved with the flat of a cleaver
instructions: Stir the hot coffee in a coffee mug until it is dissolved. Fill the hot coffee with the ground garlic. Let the coffee mixture sit and steep for 1 hour before serving.

title: Spicy Baked Ziti (Ziti Pasta)
ingredients: 2 cups ziti pasta ( dry ) | 1 cup shell pasta ( dry ) | 24 cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 cups currants | 2 cups tarama extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine dry ziti with the other dry ingredients in a large bowl. Spread the cut cherry tomatoes on the ziti and coat well. Coat an electric griddle with olive oil and heat, then turn stove over to medium. When the griddle is hot add the ziti. Cook for about 5 minutes each side, and then transfer to a baking dish. After several minutes, sprinkle with tarama and bake in a 400 degree oven for about 30 minutes or until ziti is golden.

title: Homemade Greek Seasoning Salt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 2 tablespoons oregano leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: In a bowl, mix the oregano and pepper with a fork. Use to season to stuff the meat of chicken, pork, tofu, or meat.

title: Italian Banana Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 ripe bananas, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup bottled italian dressing
instructions: Blend yogurt, vinegar, bananas, pepper and italian dressing together. Chill before serving.

title: Parsley for Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 14 ounces corn flakes, rinsed and patted dry | 1 cup water or 1 cup potato water
instructions: Drain the cornflakes, and coat with potato water in a colander. Let drain for one hour. Put the corn flakes in a food processor or blender, and process until fine to resemble a fine meal. Add the water or potato water, and process until a smooth paste forms, adding more liquid for desired consistency, or as desired, with any zucchini chips.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,red leaf lettuce,spaghetti,pepperjack cheese,serrano chili,bulk italian sausage,banana,xanthan gum
title: Spaghetti Breakfast Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 3 bananas, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup chopped sweet pepperjack cheese | 1/2 cup chopped serrano chili | 1/4 cup chopped red leaf lettuce | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | 12 pieces pepperjack cheese or 12 pieces mozzarella cheese
instructions: Brown sausage and banana in a large skillet. Drain well. Add remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes. Divide among the tortillas using spoon. Serve with toppings of choice.

title: Puerto Rican Egg Cake
ingredients: 5 eggs | 4 1/2 ounces chayotes ( guajillo chayotes ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 1/2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice
instructions: Beat together the eggs, chayote, and rum. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f and remove any string from the top of the chayote. Butter and flour a 10 inch springform pan. Spread the egg mixture around the base in a horizontal layer. Beat the egg whites as follows, gradually adding the sugar. Beat until they are stiff and glossy, being careful not to let them foam. Fold in the egg whites. Pour the cake mixture into the pan. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes, until the center is firm and the top is browned.

title: Guar Cubano
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried guar gum | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 2 tablespoons apple cider
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the guar gum, cocoa and coffee. Add the apple cider and mix well. Place dough on a floured surface and roll to about 1/4 inch thickness. Using a floured cookie cutter, cut into cubes or wedges to serve.

title: Carrabba's  Cafe  Beef Tortellini
ingredients: 1 medium loaf fresh filling ( or prepared refrigerated filled tortellini ) | cannellini beans ( i prefer white because of the flavor of the beans and the cannelloni beans ) | 1 jar cashews | 2 -3 lbs beef stew meat | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: If using frozen filling, thaw completely before using. Place one loaf fresh tortellini in a pot with a little water in it, just to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until the tortellini floats a little bit. Drain. Place a little bit of the filling on the tortellini and roll it up. Place in a 9x13 pan, then layer the olives and spices over the olives. Pour the canned beans over the top of everything. Let stand 20 minutes before serving, allowing the tortellini to absorb the flavors. Serve over freshly cooked pasta.

title: Beef Burger W- Bananas
ingredients: 2 3/4 lbs chuck steaks | 2 tablespoons ground sumac ( or more ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 bag tortilla chips | 1 cup lima beans, drained | 2 bananas, sliced lengthwise, then sliced into 1/2 inch rounds | 2 slices apples ( optional ) | 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cut in 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Place meat in skillet and sprinkle with sumac, almond extract, and tortilla chips. Cook, stirring to crumble chips, until lightly browned. Place burger on the chips and top with lima beans and sliced bananas and apples, if using. Top with a sprinkling of salt. Cook, covered, over medium high heat for 10 minutes, or until burgers are hot and cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Vegetable Cuppa
ingredients: 8 ounces portabella mushrooms | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/4 cabbage ( chopped ) | 1/2 leek ( chopped with the white parts ) | 1/2 cup ricotta ( low fat is okay ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon limoncello
instructions: Place the mushrooms on a foil lined cookie sheet. Slice up the leek and place on top of the mushrooms. In a bowl, mix remaining ingredients. Pour mixed vegetable mixture over mushrooms and vegetables.

title: Strawberry and Tomato Toss
ingredients: 20 large strawberries | 20 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 8 tablespoons palm sugar or 8 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon coriander leaves | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Cut strawberries into quarters and squeeze them really hard with your finger. Place the drained strawberries in a large shallow dish. Heat sun dried tomatoes and palm sugar in 2 or 3 tablespoon of water, stirring regularly until sugar is dissolved. Cool slightly and stir into strawberries. Serve at room temperature, sprinkled with coriander leaves and cloves.

Random Ingredients: emmenthaler cheese,avocado,oyster mushroom,mascarpone cheese,basmati rice,brown sugar
title: Mascarpone Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 cup cooked basmati rice | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup emmenthaler cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup oyster mushrooms, quartered | 1 avocado, diced
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients except avocado. Mix well, then shape into 1 inch balls. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,baby spinach leaf,apple cider vinegar,honey,lamb steak,elbow macaroni
title: Sweet Appleseed Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 3 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup elbow macaroni, prepared | 1/2 lb boneless lamb steak, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach leaves
instructions: Combine the vinegar and tamarind paste in a large nonstick skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring often, for about 3 minutes or until mixture is lightly browned. Remove from heat. Add hot cider vinegar mixture and honey to skillet and stir for 1 minute or until mixture is warm to the touch. Meanwhile, cook macaroni until tender but firm, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Season lamb with salt.

title: Scottish Oat Stuffing
ingredients: 3 3/4 cups old fashioned oats or 3 3/4 cups regular old fashioned oats | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 3 packages chicken wings ( cut up in half )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f combine oats, cream of tartar, raisins and wings and mix thoroughly. Spoon into a baking dish and bake 45 - 60 minutes or until topping is golden brown and crunchy and the wings are falling apart.

Random Ingredients: cod fillet,banana,rom tomato,chili sauce,angel hair pasta
title: Easy and Delicious Fish Pasta
ingredients: 2 -4 cod fillets, cubed | 1 can of sweet chili sauce | 1 roma tomato, chopped | 1 package angel hair pasta | 1 -2 firm banana
instructions: Brown cod in a little olive oil on both sides. Add chili sauce, tomatoes and bananas to the fish. Simmer 15 min over medium heat.

title: Cantonese Pecan Minted Green Tea "whipped Cream" Treats
ingredients: 1 ounce porcini mushrooms, finely chopped ( the green stems ) | 3 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 ounce green tea leaves | 1 ounce pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the porcini and prosciutto and cook over high heat, tossing constantly, until the prosciutto melts. Add the soy sauce and peas and cook for 1 minute, then remove from the heat. Stir in the tea leaves.

title: Spicy Pork Satay With Pears, Saffron
ingredients: 5 spring onions, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/2 lb top sirloin or 1/2 lb rib eye steak, thinly sliced | 12 pitted prunes, quartered | 1/2 cup saffron thread | 1/2 cup teriyaki marinade | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: To make the marinade, combine all ingredients, except for pork, in a large nonreactive skillet or bowl. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, for 10 minutes or until warm, but not boiling. Add pork, turning to coat in the marinade.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,rutabaga,pepper,lemon pepper seasoning,tomato sauce,crescent dinner,tuna steak
title: St. James's Beef Tuna Pies
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper seasoning | 1 lb beef sirloin steak, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 2 rutabagas, cubed | 1 can tuna steaks, drained and coarsely chopped | 12 ounces tomato sauce | pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Unroll one can of crescent dough.

title: Lentils With Celeriac (Alokali)
ingredients: 2 large celeriac | 1 large white onion | 1 cup lentils | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup golden raisin | powdered egg white
instructions: Chop celeriac very coarse. Peel onion. Cube. Heat small amount of oil in a skillet to medium high heat and add the onions. Once the onions have softened a bit, add the lentils to the pan and cook them until the lentils have soaked up all the water. Stir often, so you don't burn the onions. This should take around 7 to 10 minutes. Once the lentils are done, mix them with the celeriac that has been soaked in water and turn heat down to low. Cover the pot and let lentils simmer for 30 minutes. Take off heat and sprinkle with the sugar and raisins. Serve over rice, or with chapatis.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,coffee,farfalle pasta,chicken bouillon,italian salad dressing mix
title: Quick Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 package dried farfalle pasta | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 cup chopped cooked chicken | 1 envelope dry italian-style salad dressing mix ( i.e. good seasons ) | 3/4 cup hot coffee
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente, or until al dente, rinse in cold water, drain. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Stir in chicken, and cook until just a little browned on the edges, stirring constantly. Sprinkle with salad dressing and french roast spice mix. Cover pan, and reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 3 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink. Serve with italian chicken flavored croutons and/or freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Fiery Red Rice
ingredients: 1 cup cold water | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup fresh mint, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds ( optional )
instructions: Combine water and rice in a saucepan. Cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes or until rice is just tender, stirring occasionally. Add mint and coriander seeds. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tuna Steak in Brandy
ingredients: 3/4 cup brandy | 2 tuna steaks
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir together the brandy and warm water until almost boiling. Remove from the heat, and strain. Rinse the tuna steaks, and coat with the brandy sauce. Cover, and refrigerate. Preheat the grill for high heat. Grill the tuna steaks on high, 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until no longer pink in the center. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the fish should read 1/4 to 1/2 of the recommended doneness.

title: Pork and Leek Tacos
ingredients: 4 large pork chops | 2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 1/2 cup leeks, white parts only, chopped | 1 box frozen corn-flour tortilla chips, coarsely crushed | 1 can tomatillos, drained ( optional ) | 4 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Cut up pork chops into chunks and brown in a heavy skillet, about two hours. The pork should be dark golden brown at this point. Turn the heat down, add the leeks and cook 1 more hour. Add the corn and cook until it thickens and reduces on the pork, 15 - 30 minutes longer. Toon the mixture into warm tortillas, top with tomatillos and rye bread on top.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,rosemary sprig,greek yogurt,self rising flour,beer,lipton onion soup mix
title: Beer Cakes
ingredients: 11 ounces beer | 10 ounces plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 2 -3 small fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: Mix the ingredients, then shape into balls between your palms. You may have to pat the balls back together in between to help the mixture stick into the pan. Cook 5 - 8 minutes, or until golden brown on the top. Remove from the pan and keep warm in a low oven. Serve while still hot, or warm.

title: Tibetan Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package thin jelly beans, ends trimmed | 1 cup tasty cheese, grated | 1 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spread jelly beans out on aluminum foil. Place the cheese on top of beans, and sprinkle with marsala. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese and jelly are melted on top.

title: Chicken With Olives and Herbs
ingredients: 4 chicken fillets, washed | 8 fluid ounces rose water | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, snipped | 3 ounces black olives, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram, crushed
instructions: Place the olive, chives and marjoram in a shallow dish. Drain the chicken and rub them with the rose water and marinate for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200°c/180°c fan forced or 200°c/180°c if possible. Place the chicken in a shallow roasting tin, brush with olive oil, drizzle with the remaining oil, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven, basting every 10 minutes, for 45 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and golden and cooked through it has a crispy dark colour and is cooked through. Transfer to a serving platter and brush with more olive oil and serve immediately with the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,maple syrup,raspberry,raisin,chipotle chile,orange juice,penne pasta,vodka
title: Raspberry-Raspberry-Raisin Penne
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta, cooked | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile, in adobo, seeded in adobo, thinly sliced | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon raisins | 1/2 - 1 cup fresh raspberries | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until just tender, stirring occasionally. Drain pasta and put in medium bowl. In small saucepan, add orange juice, maple syrup, chipotle and raisins. Heat through, but do not boil. Pour sauce over pasta, and toss. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Chilean Black Beans With Sage
ingredients: 8 ounces raspberries | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 pinch saffron strands | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 scallion, finely sliced | 2 sage leaves, finely chopped | 6 ounces black beans, drained
instructions: Place raspberries and any juice in saucepan and bring to boil. Cover and cook over low heat for about 8 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed. Transfer raspberries to plate. Heat flour, saffron and ketchup in saucepan over medium heat for 1 minute. Add scallion and sage and cook gently, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the beans, stirring gently but continuously until bean sauce starts to thicken and sizzle. Serve sprinkled with chopped chives and a few saffron strands.

Random Ingredients: red chili,salt pepper,panir,beef chuck roast,salt pork,yogurt,cajun seasoning
title: Panir Ke Ataroon (Beef Ke Ataroon Patties)
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | salt and pepper | 1/2 lb panir | 8 -10 dry red chili, chopped | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 8 -10 yogurt
instructions: Heat a large frying pan on high heat. Cut the beef in 1 inch cubes, season with salt and pepper. Sear the meat in its own fat, and pour some water in the pan. Cook until it has the consistency of rice. You might need to do a second or two. Pour some oil in a pan on high heat and add a handful of the beef and panir mix until cooked all the way. Add half of the chili and fry on high heat while stirring constantly, until it starts separating from the oil. Add the rest of the chili and fry on low heat. Add some oil to pan after removing the beef mixture from the frying pan.

Random Ingredients: escarole,beef bouillon cube,cayenne,port wine,red food coloring,rutabaga
title: Peppered Beef Broth
ingredients: 1 lb beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons red food coloring | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant minced onion | 2 cans refrigerated escarole | 1 medium rutabaga, peeled, finely chopped | 1/3 cup port wine
instructions: Place bouillon cube, food coloring and minced onion in dutch oven. Cover, and cook over medium heat 5 minutes. Stir in escarole and rutabaga. Cover, bring to boil, reduce heat to low and simmer about 30 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Blend liquid with fork, and serve.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,lemon lime soda,stewing beef,bulgur wheat,tarragon,cooking spray,kosher salt
title: Stir-Fried Beef and Bulgur Wheat
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes ( chuck ) or ( 5 ounce ) | cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups bulgur wheat | 1/2 cup low-sodium instant lemon-lime soda, dissolved in 1/2 cup of hot water | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon or 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Cook beef and bulgur wheat in large skillet on medium high heat 3 to 4 minutes, stirring to brown evenly, until beef is beginning to stick. Add remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,rump roast,mango chutney,channa dal,oregano leaf,thai chile,rum
title: Chana Dal
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coarse cornflour | 500 ml channa dal ( split chickpeas ) | 2 teaspoons rice flour or 2 teaspoons chana dal | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon light rum | 1 1/2 - 2 -3 small thai chiles, finely chopped
instructions: Place chana dal, rice flour, thyme and oregano in a blender, along with the rum and chilies. Blend. Put into a pan with a lid and bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir the dal again, cover with lid back and simmer for a further 5 to 10 minutes. The mixture may curdle, but keep it moist as it continues cooking. Keep checking on the liquid level by checking if any liquid has cooked away. If the mixture is not creamy, remove the lid and continue till thick. Serve hot or cold.

title: Red Meat Pasta
ingredients: 1 medium onion, sliced thin | 2 lbs raw ground lean turkey | 1/4 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground mustard | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chilies | 1 small savoy cabbage, shredded | pasta, of your choice
instructions: In a skillet, saute onion in oil until soft. Add turkey and seasonings. Brown meat with ancho and cabbage. Add cooked meat and pasta.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,romano cheese,radish,red onion,maraschino juice,apricot jam,mexican cheese,lime
title: Mexican Cheese Enchilada Filling
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | 1 jar apricot jam ( or homemade ) | 1 jar mexican blend cheese | 1 small red onion | 1 small radish | 24 teaspoons maraschino juice | 1 grated lime ( or lemon ) | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Shred red onion and radish. Mash radish up with a fork in a small bowl. Mix the onion, radish. Chop up the package of mexican cheese with grated lime in your mixer. Mix all of these ingredients together with the shredded cheese until everything is well blended. Put a few tablespoons of the cheese mixture over the corn tortillas. Roll tortillas up and place in a lightly greased pan. Spread the remaining cheese mixture over the tortillas. If you use corn tortillas, lay them out on the counter and place them in the pan you will be using them in later. Cover with aluminum film and bake at 350f for 30 min. Remove cover and bake for 10 min.. Remove cover and bake for 1 min. Mix together all ingredients for enchilada filling. If you don't use sour cream, mix 1/4c. Of the sauce into the filling. If you use sour cream, mix 1/4c. Of the sauce in the filling. It should be a bit thinner than sour cream. Let cool for 15 minutes before serving or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,baby spinach,leek,pistachio,lemongrass,mexican cheese
title: Spinach and Pistachio Slice
ingredients: 40 g shelled pistachios, toasted | 1 lemongrass | 3 leeks | 1 small lemongrass | 2 tablespoons kosher salt, plus more to taste | 6 tablespoons shredded mexican blend cheese | 250 g baby spinach, torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: Blend pistachios, lemongrass, leeks, lemon grass and kosher salt in a food processor and process until well combined. Divide mix into 4 portions and shape each into a round slab about 6 3cm thick. Wrap each slab tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. Remove slab from refrigerator and trim fat from inside. Cut slab into 20 equal slices. Stack slices onto two large sheets of wax paper and flatten slightly with the heel of your hand. Preheat oven to 200°c. Place one slice slab on a piece of plastic wrap and lightly press with the palm of your hand to flatten slightly. Repeat with remaining slab until all sheets are used. Bake on a lined tray for 20 minutes, then remove wrap and stand for 5 minutes before cutting. Place spinach into a large bowl, add 1/2 cup more of the cheese and mix well with your hands. Spread spinach over the top of the slab. Return slab to the oven for 5 - 10 minutes until cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,peanut oil vegetable,fig,white sugar,rigatoni pasta,paprika,caster sugar,tart apple
title: Sicilian Fig and Apple Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 3 -4 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 -4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 -6 medium tart apples | 1/2 cup caster sugar or 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 3/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup white sugar | 3/4 cup pitted chopped fresh figs, drained | 3 tablespoons coarsely chopped roasted pepsi hot paprika
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the pack instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large wok over a moderate heat. Core the apples and cut across the middle into 3/4 inch pieces. Add to the pan and cook, stirring often, for 5 mins or until golden brown. Remove the apples to a large bowl and add the sugar and 1/4 tsp paprika. Using a slotted spoon pour off most of the excess oil. Pour all but 1 tbsp of the oil into the pan/wok. When the mixture puffs up, add the apples and cook for 2 - 3 mins, stirring. Add the remaining 1/2 tsp paprika and mix well. Toss together with the pasta. To help the apples melt, stir in the figs and half the pepsi and toss through quickly. Serve the pasta hot, with the remaining pepsi sprinkled on top.

title: Black-Eyed Peas With Sultanas
ingredients: 1 lb black-eyed peas | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons sultanas, chopped
instructions: Soak the peas overnight. Drain the peas, bring to the boil with the sugar and half pint sized water to cover. Reduce the heat and simmer until the peas are soft. Place the frozen peas into a blender and add the sultanas.

title: Egg Rolls II
ingredients: 6 large egg whites | 6 teaspoons sesame oil | cracked black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually stir in sesame oil. Add cracked pepper. Roll egg whites into balls slightly smaller than walnuts. Place on a greased cookie sheet, coat with additional sesame oil. Bake in the preheated oven until slightly browned, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,almond extract,clam juice,yellow mustard,lamb shoulder,cardamom,bay leaf,savoy cabbage
title: Baked Swedish Cabbage "Leg"
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage | 1/4 cup slivered almonds or 1/4 cup slivered slivered almonds, toasted | 1 tablespoon coarse mustard powder | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons bottled clam juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon crushed dried red bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Cut off ends of cabbage, core, and outer leaves and cut leaves about the length of the head.

title: Baked Herbed Yogurt - Kari
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 medium celery rib, chopped | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 handfuls packed whole plain nonfat yogurt | 1 bunch kale, stemmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a shallow baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, stir together 3/4 cup yogurt and celery. Stir in mixed spice. Transfer the mixture to a small bowl. Spoon 1/4 cup yogurt mixture into the yogurt bowl. Top with kale to within 1/2 inch of the top. Repeat with remaining yogurt mixture. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until puffy. Serve topped with 1/2 cup extra plain yogurt for a lighter and more flavorful yogurt.

title: Microwave Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces low-fat margarine | 2 teaspoons sake ( japanese rice wine )
instructions: Cut the margarine up into small pieces. Add the sake to the butter and rub it into the meat. Mix well and use as a dipping sauce for teriyaki strips.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,tortilla,anaheim chili,veal,oregano leaf,chinese cabbage,mexican cheese,cauliflower floret
title: Cheese-Chili Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cauliflower florets, chopped | 1 red anaheim chili, julienned | 1 green chilies, julienned | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, minced or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 lb ground veal, preferably dark meat | 1/4 cup chinese cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | tortilla ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl mix cauliflower, anaheim chili, green chilies, oregano, and veal. Break up meat into small pieces, if desired. Shape into four 1/4 thick patties, each about 2 thick. Place on foil lined cookie sheet. Broil, covered, 5 minutes. Top with cabbage and cheese. Grill 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Artichoke, Peaches and Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh artichoke hearts | 1 package spaghetti | 1 can sliced ripe peaches | 1 can frozen artichoke hearts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the 1 1/2 pound of artichokes in a layer in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, about 2 thick. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 20 minutes to an internal temperature of 140 degrees f. Remove the artichokes and cool on paper towels. Remove the hearts from the frozen artichokes and pat dry with paper towels. Cut each artichoke into 1/2x4 inch pieces. Arrange the artichokes over the artichokes, with the slice of ripe pear around them and on top. Spoon 2 1/2 teaspoons of canola or vegetable oil onto the vegetable oil in a large nonstick frying pan. When the oil is hot, carefully place the cooked pasta, a handful at a time, in the oil, taking care to not tear the spaghetti pieces into smaller pieces, just larger pieces. As the pasta cooks, stir 1/2 cup of cold water into the cooked pasta, one handful at a time, to loosen it all. Spoon another handful at a time, until the pasta is coated, and repeat with the rest of the spaghetti. After all the pasta has been added, spread out the remaining 1/2 cup of oil. Fry the spaghetti until golden brown, about 5 minutes, and drain on paper towels.

title: The Queen's Day Crab
ingredients: 3 crabsmeat, cleaned, picked over | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 fresh orange, bitter | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile, seeded and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried dates, chopped | 1 -2 dashes red chili
instructions: Combine crabs, marjoram, chile, marjoram and orange juice. Add chili powder, red pepper powder and dried chipotle and stir well. Allow to marinate for at least ½ hour. Grill over hot coals until crisp, about 3 - 4 minutes per side. Remove crab from heat and stir in chopped dates and the hot red chile. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,water,pecan half,marsala,orange juice,beer,ricotta cheese,vanilla extract
title: Aussie Beer Balls
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour, sifted | 1/4 cup dry marsala ( use a good brand, if you have some, it's good ) | 1/2 cup water, mixed with | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 250 g ricotta cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pecan halves | 1 cup semi dried apricot halves or 1 cup fresh apricot | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Place the flour, marsala and water in a large bowl, and then stir together with a fork until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Add the orange juice, baking soda and mix together. Add the ricotta, nuts and vanilla, and mix together. Place the dough onto a floured surface, and roll it out to about 6mm/3/8 inch in lenght. Cut the dough into long 3/4 inch wide strips. Cut each strip in half and cut 3 lines across the dough at 1 1/2 intervals. Slightly rounding off the slightly lower corner, add 2 tablespoons of the scraped out stuffing into the centre of each strip, roll up and pinch to seal. Place on a greased baking sheet, and bake for about 15 minutes, or until the outside is golden brown and the stuffing is heated through. Allow the balls to cool on the baking tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a dish. Serve them warm, or warm from the oven, in their skins.

title: Bourbon Beef and Radish Coins
ingredients: 1/2 cup bourbon | 2 -3 lbs round steaks | 1/3 cup dried radish, flakes
instructions: Place the meat in a large freezer bag. Pour the bourbon all over the meat. Push the air out of the bag and allow the meat to come to room temperature before placing in the refrigerator. Slice the meat diagonally into 1/4 slices. Place the slices in a roasting pan, and place in a single layer on the rack. Drain any accumulated fat from the turkey, if any, and scatter the radish flakes over the pieces and toss them around in the pan. Set the pan about 6 inches from the broiler or high rack. Broil the meat 4 inches from the heat until the meat is browned and cooked through. About 15 minutes. Cover the pan tightly with aluminum foil, place in the refrigerator, and allow to mellow and mellow for 2 days.. Slice the meat across the grain, removing the slice attached to the bone. Transfer the meat to a serving platter and keep warm. When serving, place the sliced meat on a platter or individual plates. Spoon some of the drippings from the roasting pan. Garnish with the reserved drippings.

title: Spaghettini (Vegetable Phyllo Pie)
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 230 g phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 120°c line a large baking tray with baking paper and set aside. Place frozen mixed vegetables into a pan of boiling water and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and drain well. Meanwhile, using a fork, separate phyllo sheets to make two sheets, brushing each sheet with a small amount of vegetable oil until the pastry sheets are slightly overlapping. Place a portion of veggies into the centre of a pastry sheet and brush around the edge with some oil. Working from one short side, roll the pastry sheets, beginning and ending with phyllo pastry. Fold pastry over the filling with the short sides, starting from the outer edge and rolling toward the middle. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pudina's Basic Green Beans (Pudina)
ingredients: 400 g mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon chopped green chilies ( optional ) | 1/2 cup water | 1 can fat-free refried beans
instructions: In a med sized saucepan, heat olive oil, then add green chilies if using. Cut open and add mushrooms. Add water, yogurt, then refried beans. Simmer on med heat until creamy, about 5 minutes. Add some chopped green chilies if desired.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,kernel corn,chicken meat,cream soup,canola oil,elbow macaroni,enchilada sauce
title: Delicious Chicken Enchilada Pasta
ingredients: 250 g uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 cup finely chopped chicken meat | 1 can sweet whole kernel corn, drained | 420 g condensed cream soup | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup plain flour
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet. Meanwhile, heat oil in large frying pan. Cook chicken and corn with chili for 5 minutes. Add condensed soup and enchilada sauce over chicken and corn. Heat through. Add flour to thicken. Put pasta on a plate, pour chicken mixture into the middle and dust with shredded cheese and serve immediately.

title: Easy Italian Tomato and Walnut Soup
ingredients: 14 ounces plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 can chicken broth | 1/3 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and puree. Taste and add more salt or pepper as desired.

title: Capsicum and Blueberry Sammies #5FIX
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salt, or as needed | 4 ounces cooked salmon fillet, finely chopped | 1 bunch scallion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped green chile, such as bird's eye, or other hot chili pepper | 1 package spring roll wrappers, thawed | 1 egg yolk, beaten | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 cups egg yolks, beaten | 6 tablespoons green chile, cut into thin strips
instructions: To make seafood dipping sauce, in a bowl with a fork, mix scallions with 1 tablespoon green chili until minced. Stir in salmon and season with salt. To make shrimp dipping sauce, in a small bowl, mix seafood dipping sauce with egg yolk and flour until thoroughly combined. Spoon a little of the mixture onto the center of one of the spring roll wrappers. Moisten edges with water. Place a heaping teaspoon of salmon mixture and a slice of green chile at the top of each wrapper. Moisten edges with cold water and fold wrappers over the salmon mixture to make a triangle shape. Press edges together with the back of a fork to seal. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the sambies, seam side down, on baking sheet. Brush with egg yolk glaze. Bake in the preheated oven until the sambies are puffed and golden, about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Pignoli (Lime Pignoli)
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 small yellow onion, minced | 2 limes, zest and juice of | 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste
instructions: Combine cheese, onion, lime and lemon zest. You can add up to 3/4 cup of water if your dish is dry and dry.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,salt black pepper,queso fresco,colby monterey jack cheese,tart apple,nonfat milk powder
title: Apple Cheese Bake
ingredients: 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 6 medium tart apples | 10 -12 garlic cloves, pressed | 1/4 cup queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix together the colby jack cheese, dry milk powder and salt and pepper. Core the apples and slice into 1/4 inch slices. Using a mandoline or a serrated knife, slice the thin apple into half moons. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Layer half of the apple slices in the baking dish. Sprinkle half of the garlic over the apple slices and top with half of the queso fresco. Repeat layers again layering apple slices and queso fresco. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: bread,butter,molasses,tuna fillet,lemon juice zest,great northern bean,beef chuck,chocolate
title: Caramelized-Grilled Tuna and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 cans white-flavored great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups dry bread, torn into pieces | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder or 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless lamb, cut into pieces | 1 1/2 cups canned tuna fillets or 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked chicken | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium high heat. Increase heat to medium. Add beans. Cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are golden brown and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat. Spread bread on baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Toast bread and rub with nutmeg. Toast bread, about 5 minutes. Spread beans evenly except on baking sheet. Toast pork and tuna for 5 minutes or until no longer pink. Place tuna, bread and black beans evenly over. Sprinkle with lemon zest and chocolate. Heat broiler. Sprinkle top with molasses and broil for 6 - 8 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red potato,oil black olive,cheddar cheese soup,fish,pork
title: Pork, Potato, and Black Olive Casserole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil, or as needed | 1 pound ground pork | 3 cans condensed cheddar cheese soup | 2 red potatoes, cubed | 2 cans sliced black olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 11x7 inch baking dish. In a large skillet over medium heat, stir oil and ground pork until meat is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink. Drain excess grease. Mix cheddar cheese soup, potatoes, and olives into the meat. Spread 1/3 of the potato mixture on the bottom of the prepared casserole. Add half of the meat and vegetable mixture. Repeat layers of potato mixture and meat, ending with remaining mashed potato mixture. Bake in preheated oven until top is golden brown and a knife inserted into the center of the casserole comes out clean, 40 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable juice cocktail,broth,coconut,active yeast,beef bouillon cube,currant,onion soup mix,flat leaf parsley
title: Crock Pot Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut in bite size pieces | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, like carrots, mushrooms, sweet potato, bell pepper mixture | 3 cups beef broth | 1 tablespoon dried currant | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 2 tablespoons dry active dry yeast
instructions: Combine all ingredients except yeast, in crock pot. Cover and cook on high heat setting 7 - 8 hours, or on high heat setting 3 - 4 hours to get desired consistency. Remove from heat and add yeast. Serve over noodles, noodles whatever pleases you.

title: Ouzo Rollups
ingredients: 3 slices provolone cheese, thick slices | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 2 tablespoons quick-rise quick-rise frosting, your favourite
instructions: Preheat oven to 325º f. Place the provolone cheese slice between pieces of waxed paper and flatten out with a rolling pin. Roll up cheese into a sausage about 2 1/2 long and 2 1/2 wide. Place the cheese rollups on a small baking sheet and spread the ouzo on top. Using the long side of the cheese, roll the cheese tightly around it, enclosing what will be in the center of your dough. Bake for 12 minutes, then allow to cool to room temperature. Roll up the dough and cut into desired length.

title: Spicy Onion and Parsley Focaccia
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh italian parsley | 1 1/2 cups unbleached white flour
instructions: To complete the focaccia, place a large saute pan over medium heat, add the onions and parsley, and cook, stirring often, until the onions become tender, about 10 minutes. Add the white flour, about 2 tablespoons at a time, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Be careful not to let the flour brown. Turn the focaccia and brown for about 4 minutes until the top is a nice golden color and crusty.

title: Radishes With Sunflower Oil
ingredients: 2 lbs radishes, washed, peeled and sliced in half | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a large pan. Add the sliced radishes. Reduce to low and cover to stop them drying up. Cook for 15 minutes over a low heat. When serving sprinkle with freshly chopped parsley or coriander.

title: Napa Japanese Eggplant
ingredients: 1 japanese eggplant | 1/2 pound lean hamburger | 1/4 cup peanut nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place a small piece of aluminum foil on a baking sheet and place in the oven. Cut the ends off the eggplant. Cut the eggplant into 1/2 inch slices. Place slices in a colander and drain thoroughly. Place the slices on the foil and drizzle on the vegetable oil. In a medium bowl, crumble the hamburger into 1/4 inch pieces. Arrange the eggplant slices over the meat. Sprinkle with the peanuts, and drizzle with the vegetable oil.

title: Tartiflette
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 -2 clove ( or more ) ( optional ) | 1 small pickled cucumber
instructions: Pile up the hard boiled eggs on the slice of cucumber. Stir a couple of times, until the yolk coats the eggs. Sprinkle with clove and pour wine over the cucumber slices.

title: Cheese Katori (Cheese Filled Dessert)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kasseri cheese, coarsely grated | 2/3 teaspoon kasseri powdered milk powder
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan. Scoop 1/4 cup of the kebab mikki into the center of a dessert spoon, and sprinkle 1/4 tsp kasseri on top. Press the center with fingers until the kasseri begins to form a crust. Turn the knife in both directions, and cook until lightly browned. Serve warm with kasseri preserves.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,monterey jack cheese,active yeast,chervil,yukon gold potato,chili oil,buttermilk,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Tortillas With Grilled Potatoes
