ingredients: 2 cups yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 3/4 teaspoon chili oil | 2/3 cup buttermilk | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme or 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced | 3/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 12 four-inch soft taco-size fresh monterey jack cheese or 12 regular-size regular-size regular-size grated cheese | 1 head romaine lettuce leaf ( about 12 ounces ) | 2 sprigs fresh chervil, stems ( about 12 leaves )
instructions: For the potatoes, boil the potatoes in 1/2 cup water until tender, 20 to 30 minutes, about 20 minutes, and drain.. Let cool to lukewarm while preparing the cheese topping. For the topping, whiz the potatoes briefly in a food processor or with an immersion blender until smooth. Stir in the chili oil and buttermilk, thyme, nutmeg, and yeast, and let set 10 minutes. Add 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese to the potatoes and mash well and set aside. Place the oil in the pan of a large heavy, 12 inch heavy skillet over medium high heat until just beginning to smoke. Working in 2 batches, fry the potatoes, without crowding, until brown all over, about 4 minutes, and roll up loosely in the warmed cheese tomato stack. To serve, build the tortillas, divide the potato topping evenly among the tortillas. Cut the lettuce leaves into wedges, arrange the leaves on top, sprinkle with chervil leaves, and drizzle on the cheese topping.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,cardamom pod,chili sauce,rye flour,green onion,amarula cream liqueur
title: Chilli Sourdough Rye Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 cup green onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sweet red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur ( or brandy may be substituted ) | 1 dash cardamom pod | 1 dash chili sauce or 1 pinch chili flakes | 2 1/2 cups rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Press out air bubbles. Bake 10 minutes or until cookies crack and turn golden brown.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,yellow bell pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 1 yellow pepper | 1 yellow bell pepper | vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 yellow peppers
instructions: Slices need to be fairly thin for them so they don't burn. Slice the peppers in half lengthwise, or cut them into thin pieces. Put the yellow, green or red peppers in a bowl, pour enough water over them to cover them, and cover. Allow to stand for half an hour but you can leave them to soak in there for a couple of hours. After this, drain them. Remove any remaining water. Place the peppers on a clean cutting board and cut the long ways down into the peppers, leaving a few small incisions. Cut down one side of the peppers, removing the seeds. Do not cut all the way through.

title: Baked Oats With Savoy and Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 savoy cabbage | 2 2/3 oz oat bran cereal ( wheat germ meal ) or 2 2/3 ounces whole wheat bran cereal
instructions: Preheat oven to 210f / 230°c. Wash and core the savoy and savoy cabbage and cut into quarters. Wrap up the dough with a good handful of oat bran and roll it out on a lightly floured surface with a rolling pin until the required rectangle size. Place the cabbage and oat bran in a deep ovenproof dish and add a few pices of black pepper and a little more pepper or seasoning to taste. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Wild Strawberry Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 flour tortillas | 12 fresh strawberries
instructions: Mix together the water, worcestershire sauce, and flour tortillas. Microwave strawberries in 1/2 cup water for 1 minute, or pour boiling water over and heat to boil. Drain and fold into the tortilla mixture. Place in a greased 2 cup burrito or pan. Cover and refridgerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,onion powder,sultana raisin,spinach leaf,lime wedge,steak,worcestershire sauce
title: Worcestershire Steak for Two
ingredients: 4 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon lime wedge, or as needed | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons sultana raisins ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried chopped yellow pepper | 1 pound round steak | 8 ounces fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Stir worcestershire sauce, lime juice, onion powder, sultanas, and yellow pepper together in a bowl to make dressing.

title: Jaggery Salmon Skewers (Japanese) Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb jaggery ( or light brown sugar ) | 3 ounces soft cooked salmon | 2 ounces soft baked salmon | 1 lb fresh strawberries | 1/2 ounce active dry yeast | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Stir the jaggery and water in a saucepan until the sugar has melted and the water has become syrupy. Remove the pan from the heat and add the soft cooked salmon. Dissolve the yeast in the warm water and sprinkle it in. Pour the warm mixture into the jelly coated swagels. Leave to rise until the swagels are double in bulk. Wash and dry the strawberries. Cut off the stalks and cut them into smaller pieces. Slice the strawberries. Place the jelly covered swagels in a large shallow tin, weighted down with a baking plate and a heavy weight. Let stand in a warm spot until the jelly has almost all absorbed the water. Preheat an outdoor grill to medium heat. Drain all the water from the jelly, place the cherry blossom petals on the jelly and allow the cherries to soften. Wipe off the jelly with paper towels. Put the jelly in a saucer with the blossom petals on top. Cover with foil and leave the karut to rise in the warm atmosphere for 1/2 hour. Skewer the jelly on 2 skewers, alternating the salmon with the strawberries and the cherries. Skewer the berry salad in the traditional way. Serve the salad at once. Note, the recipe should be taken into shape.

Random Ingredients: table salt,onion,grain mustard,garlic clove,confectioner ' sugar,simple syrup
title: French Onion Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 teaspoons table salt | 2 teaspoons granulated sugar | 1 1/4 cups finely minced onions ( i use shallots, but you may use onion grater also ) | 2 garlic cloves, finely minced | 6 tablespoons simple syrup ( or other sugar substitute ) | 2 teaspoons dry grain mustard
instructions: Mix together the salt, sugar and onion. Stir in the garlic and simple syrup. Add the mustard and mix well with the mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours before using. Enjoy.

title: Squash Curry
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow squash, peeled, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 2 yellow bell peppers, roasted, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch dice | 2 tablespoons curry paste
instructions: Preheat broiler and place all ingredients in a crock pot. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour stirring twice. Serve over hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,mango,cream tartar,thai red curry paste,potato,gorgonzola,pesto sauce
title: Cheater's Mango Chowder
ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 2 tablespoons thickened cream of tartar | 4 cups mango, chopped coarsely | 2 tablespoons thickened cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 250 g gorgonzola or 250 g other natural blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Place sweet potatoes in a pan with water to cover, cook until tender. Drain and cool slightly and mash. Add sugar, cream of tartar and thai chile paste, cook for 10 minutes. Purée in a blender or food processor until smooth. Return to pan and add mango, cream of tartar and cheese. Stir until combined through. Spoon into bowls, chill for 30 minutes or overnight.

title: Pepperoni & Lemon Bread - Pizza Kitchen
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced in half horizontally | 3 3 slices pepperoni, chopped | 1/2 cup lemon pepper | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, finely grated | 3/4 cup oil, extra-virgin | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Spread bottom half of french bread with oil. Layer with pepperoni, lemon pepper, lemon peel, and bread sides. Put top half of loaf on pizza maker. Press and brown. Press to let bread absorb extra oil. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,orange marmalade,taco seasoning,cream tartar,salmon fillet,balsamic vinegar
title: Santa Fe Salmon With Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange marmalade ( not concentrate ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 2 beef tenderloins | 1 lb salmon fillet
instructions: Place 1/4 cup of the marinade in a small bowl and stir in the remaining marinade. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Place the tenderloins in shallow glass dish. Using two skewers, alternately skewer the tenderloins on the skewers and season with the taco seasoning and the cream of tartar. Pour the remaining marinade into a small saucepan and bring to a boil. As soon as the sauce begins to come to a boil, remove from heat. Pour 1/4 cup of the hot marinade over each tenderloin, turning to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate the fillets for 20 minutes. Remove the tenderloins from the marinade and place in a foil lined basket. Place the basket onto the rack in the center of the oven and set a trivet on top of it. Roast the salmon for 7 minutes, then place the rack in the oven. Check the center of the salmon after 5 minutes for tenderloins and a toothpick comes out clean. If you feel it’s done – or a bit firmer outside but flakey inside, this will be a 5 for 10 minutes depending upon how big the fillet is. Remove from oven and place the salmon fillet on the rack, in the basket. Bake 5 minutes less than the specified recommended time for the meat. Serve immediately.

title: Pappardelle With Cumin
ingredients: 1 lb pappardelle pasta or 1 lb other short pasta | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon fresh sage, coarsely chopped ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain, reserving a cup of pasta cooking water. In a medium skillet, combine the cumin, fresh sage and reserved pasta cooking liquid. Stir over medium heat until the spice is hot. Immediately add the drained pasta and toss to combine. Serve hot.

title: Easy Cranberry Velveeta Spread
ingredients: 250 g velveeta cheese | sultana | herbs | cranberry sauce
instructions: Place all in an electric food processor and process until smooth. Serve with fresh bread, toast, bread sticks or croissants.

title: Sinfully Easy Fat-Free Channa Dal!
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free half-and-half cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste ( sambal oelek ) | 2 cans pumpkin | 1 - 1 1/2 lb salt pork, chopped | 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large pot, add half and half. Stir in chili paste and pumpkin. Heat to boiling. Add salt, stirring until evenly mixed. Chill, covered, for 2 hours. Mix in salt pork and chickpeas.

title: Easiest Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 -2 hard-boiled egg | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1/2 cup semolina flour ( panko bread crumbs may be substituted ) | 2 tablespoons dry sun-dried tomatoes | 1/2 cup salsa fresca, crumbled ( may substitute light if desired. use regular if desired. use mild if preferred. ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 -3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate chips, chopped ( optional. optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Cut eggs carefully so as to avoid splattering and mashing the yolk. In a small bowl, thoroughly mix together cheeses. Add eggs, mix well, and divide into small balls. Roll the balls in oil just until they are well coated. Bake the cookies for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove cookies from oven and pour chocolate as you like over them. Let them stand in the oven all night.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,mini marshmallow,curry powder,single cream,honey dijon mustard,green curry paste,andouille sausage,heirloom tomato
title: Hearty, Low Fat, Honey Mustard and Curry Sausages With Mustard Mallows
ingredients: 1 lb fresh andouille sausage ( or your favourite smoked sausage ) | 1 lb mini marshmallows | 1 1/4 cups low-fat single cream | 1 tablespoon honey dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons green curry paste, hot ( you may substitute any other curry paste or paste you want to use ) | 1 medium heirloom tomatoes ( sliced thinly ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Boil the sausages until slightly firm to the touch, about 7 minutes and then drain on a paper towel. Cut into 1 squares. Bring the cream to a boil in the microwave for 1 minute and then remove from the heat. Heat a non stick skillet over medium high heat, add the mustard and curry powder and then the green curry paste. Add the sausage and toss until heated through and to coat. Add the sausages and tomatoes. Stir to coat. Add the sugar and mix. Serve warm or room temperature. Note, the recipe doubles for 2 servings, so make to serve only the amounts listed above. If you have extra, double each recipe. Feel free to put more mustard on the sausages and tomatoes and mix in some of the mustard before serving too.

Random Ingredients: veal steak,papaya,cayenne pepper,english mustard,coconut milk,ha avocado
title: Veal Steers Papaya Avocado Wraps
ingredients: 4 boneless veal steaks | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 tablespoon dry english-style mustard, such as dijon | 2 medium seeded and chopped ripe avocados | 1/2 seeded and chopped seeded papaya | cayenne pepper
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, whisk together coconut milk, mustard and avocado until smooth. Spread 1 tablespoon of mashed avocado mixture on each steak. Top with remaining avocado mixture and cayenne pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Netherlands Beef Steak or Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg beef steak ( i use sirloin steak ) | 300 ml soymilk | 7 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped lovage, leaves | 3 tablespoons dried lovage | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Cut the meat thinly, across the grain, into 1/2 inch slices. Marinate the meat in the soymilk with the worcestershire sauce for 30 minutes or more. In an air tight container, mix all of the ingredients. Towards end of the marination, cook the meat in a skillet or deep fryer over a medium flame/high heat, turning several times to prevent burning, until all sides are browned.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,milk chocolate,sesame oil vegetable,vegetable shortening,nicoise olive,mexican cheese,mango chutney
title: Mexican Mocha Cheese Logs
ingredients: 12 fresh nicoise olives ( not canned ) | 1/2 cup mejican cheese or 1/2 cup queso panela cheese, grated | 1/4 cup milk chocolate, melted | 1/8 cup vegetable shortening, melted | 2 tablespoons sesame oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, for greasing | 8 nicoise olives, for topping | mango chutney ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Wash, peel and devein olives. Cut into 1/4 x 2 inch sticks. Beat cheese and milk chocolate in bowl until smooth. Mix sesame oil into melted shortening. Spread into center of each orange slice. Place a tablespoon of cheese mixture on each orange to cover, leaving a 2 inch border of cheese at all edges. Moisten edges, pinch closed, and press to seal. Arrange on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper, and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 400°f bake for 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly. Serve warm with mango chutney if desired. Note,. To make cheese logs, cut into 32 pieces, removing 1/2 to 3/4 of the dough at a time. Gently scoop out each cookie using a teaspoon, taking care not to break the cheese into smaller chunks. Place 1 or 2 cheese balls in middle of each rolled piece. Fold in the top and bottom edges of cheese to cover them. Place on parchment paper or waxed paper, seam side down and keep in airtight container.. Refrigerate for up to 24 hours. To make rolls, place reserved dough on lightly floured board and roll into a long log about 2 inches wide and about 1 1/2 thick. Cut into 12 equal pieces, rolling each piece into a cone about 2 inches long and 12 inches long and 2 - 3 inches wide. Repeat with remaining cookies. Brush tops with sesame oil, and bake for about 8 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool slightly and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. Serve warm with mango chutney, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,tarragon,peanut,beef stew meat,fruit,soy sauce,wheat pasta shell,linguine
title: Healthy Beef Stew With Pasta
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef stew meat | 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 cup pasta sauce | 3/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 package linguine ( or other long tubular pasta ) | 2 -3 cups mixed dried fruit, of your choice ( optional ) | 1/2 cup roasted unsalted peanuts, chopped | 1/2 cup warm pizza sauce
instructions: Cut stew meat into 3/4 cubes.. In a 5 to 6 qt dutch oven combine the beef, soy sauce, and noodles. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. While the stew simmers, pour the pasta sauce into a small bowl. Add the tarragon and stir well. When stew has simmered for 10 minutes, add the tomato sauce. Stir well and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, about 15 minutes. Serve stew over the cooked pasta. Sprinkle with nuts, if using.

Random Ingredients: cantaloupe,vegetable oil,coconut,cayenne pepper,mustard,tarragon,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Aloupe and Chipotle Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground dry mustard | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 2 pounds cantaloupe, tops cut off and cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Whisk together the 1 cup coconut, vegetable oil, chipotle peppers, mustard, tarragon, and cayenne pepper in a bowl.

title: Ginger and Spice Tea
ingredients: 4 -6 cups black tea | 2 inches gingerroot ( about 2-inch ) or 2 inches fresh gingerroot
instructions: Steep tea for a few minutes. Discard it after about 10 minutes. Place fresh ginger in a teapot or large cooking container. Pour tea over ginger. Stir to combine. Cover loosely and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: sage,beef stew meat,lukewarm water,chipotle chile adobo,pineapple,pinto bean,tarragon
title: Beef and Pineapple Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat ( i use 2 pounds of fat and cubed, can use a combination of beef and pork ) | 1 can crushed pineapple ( reserve juice ) | 4 cups chopped canned pineapple ( reserve juice ) | 1 can pinto beans | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 tablespoon rubbed sage | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon or 1 tablespoon thyme | 1 tablespoon instant minced garlic | 1 1/2 cups lukewarm water
instructions: If using pineapple, reserve juice. Soak pineapple in juice until soft. Cut meat into cubes, set aside. In large saucepan saute meat in butter until brown. Mix in spices. Add remaining pineapple juice and broth. Simmer for about 1 hour or until meat is cooked through. Can be served in a soup crockpot on low. Serve over rice with cornbread, chips, or tortillas or over cooked grits. Serves.

title: Chinese Pork Sparerib Dip
ingredients: 3 lbs pork spareribs, bones removed | 1/2 cup green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Place ribs in a baking pan that is lined with foil with enough room to extend over the top. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Let ribs cool in the liquid for 30 minutes. Place in large saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil.

title: Faux-cured Beef Brisket
ingredients: 10 lbs beef brisket | 2 cups breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon minced ginger | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup mayonnaise | 5 -6 heads butter lettuce, large leaves, washed and very well drained | 1 1/2 lbs turnips, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and mix thoroughly. Spread mixture into a large flat baking dish to about 2 inches in depth. Place brisket on crumb mixture, making sure all sides are covered. Spread turnips over the top. Pour celery seed mixture evenly over the brisket and spread evenly. Turn baking dish so that corned beef is evenly spaced. Cover and refrigerate overnight. On the morning of the cooking, remove brisket and let stand in a large roaster for about 6 hours. Remove brisket from the oven and transfer to a large cutting board. Cover and refrigerate, covered, for 3 - 4 hours or until very dry and tender. When brisket is ready, remove to a cutting board and cut in pieces of about 2 1/2 inches long. Slice against the grain into about 1/2 inch squares. Serve with celery seed mixture. Keep refrigerated.

title: Nigella's Vegan Baklava
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo dough, thawed | 3/4 cup agave nectar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place plastic wrap on a piece of waxed paper. Place thawed phyllo dough on the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan. Cover phyllo with a thin layer of agave nectar. Repeat until you have used all of the phyllo. Spread agave nectar over pastry, then top with another layer of agave. Do this until all layers have been used. Cover phyllo dough with waxed paper and lightly tent with foil. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden. Allow to cool.

title: Nacho Spiced Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, crushed ( crushed seeds give them a nice kick ) | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Drain soup cans and stir well. Add all other ingredients and blend thoroughly. Chill 1 - 2 hours. Enjoy.

instructions: In a medium size bowl mix the parsley, consomme and hot pepper. In a blender or food processor add the egg yolks. When mixed add the pepper flakes and old bay leaf powder. Pulse until well blended. With rubber spatula add small amounts of hot mixture into the egg and milk mixture. Cook at medium heat 2 - 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the clams stirring to coat thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: salt,granny smith apple,egg white,ginger paste,cardamom pod,cracker,chili oil,cardamom
title: Apples in a Spicy Cardamom Applesauce
ingredients: 3 granny smith apples | 1 egg white | 3 tablespoons ginger paste | 1/4 teaspoon chili oil ( i use sunflower ) | 3 cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | assorted cracker
instructions: Wash apples thoroughly and cut out core. Place apple on baking sheet. Bake at 375°f/180°c/ gas mark 10 for about 30 minutes. Cool slightly. Carefully rub off skin and seeds from apples. You can do this by hand if you are using a food processor. Peel and slice apples. Put in large mixing bowl. Beat egg white until stiff. Mix in ginger paste and then chilli oil. Add spices gradually to spice mixture. Beat until well blended. Fold in apples. Pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350°f/180°c/ gas mark 5 for 5 - 8 minutes. Serve with crackers or bread.

title: Oi Frangipane
ingredients: 50 g almond meal | 500 g savoy cabbage
instructions: Mix almond meal and cabbage together. Using a flat bladed knife, press almond meal firmly into base of large flat bottomed pan. Place over medium heat and cook, stirring with a fork, until golden brown. Turn over and repeat. Turning over twice. Cool on a tray before cutting into wedges. Variation, for a very different effect spooning almond mixture onto toasted almonds and cabbage before turning out on paper towels to cool.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,vegetable oil cooking spray,kalamata olive,lemon juice zest,pork,pineapple chunk
title: Sweet and Sour Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 6 thick pork chops ( see notes ) | 4 ounces pineapples ( the kind with the juice ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes ( or more to taste, if you like spicy ) or 1 tablespoon black pepper ( or more to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a large cast iron skillet, heat oil over high heat. Add chops and allow to sauté to the desired doneness, about 2 minutes per side. In a bowl or serving dish, combine pineapple, lemon juice, olives, red pepper flakes and hot pepper. Drizzle dressing evenly over chops and spoon sauce over. Serve with additional toppings.

title: Swiss Sweet Cheese Stuffed Vine Ripened Dip
ingredients: 1 jar pineapple chunks | 2 cans sweetened condensed milk yogurt or ( 15 ounce ) cans fat-free sour cream, undiluted | 1 -2 cup shredded swiss cheese, divided | 24 ladyfingers | 2 lbs lean ground meat or 2 lbs seafood, of choice | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Arrange pineapple and 1/2 of the swiss cheese slices in the bottom of a large crockpot. Top with remaining swiss cheese, pressing down to compact. Place 3 dollops into a 3 qt slow cooker that is large enough to hold all three of the ladyfingers in a single layer and are snugly on the bottom. Arrange remaining swiss cheese slices over the top, overlapping each dollop. Sprinkle remaining swiss cheese over the cream mixture. Arrange cinnamon over entire dish. Cover and let crockpot cook on low setting for 10 - 12 hours. If desired serve in a shallow serving dish with plenty of cracker crackers on top. This recipe can be made ahead and refrigerated and reheated just before serving. Note, for an added touch, if desired, insert a toothpick into the dip to help it go into the crackers, to help keep them from being eaten as the cheese melts. Reheat in microwave, or in a 300 degree oven for 30 - 60 seconds.

Put the tofu, tofu's remaining oil, tamarind pulp, chiles, tamarind liquer and mustard powder on a platter. Garnish with snow peas, scallions, if using, and serve at room temperature.

instructions: In a bowl, mix together brown sugar, yogurt, peanut butter, ranch dressing mix and sirloin. Spread on a cut surface into a long strip. Rinse with cool water. title: Smoked Almond Apples
ingredients: 1 can reduced fat cream of potato soup, undiluted | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 10 ounces smoked meat, sliced | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 cooking apple, cored and sliced
instructions: In a bowl, combine soup, extract and meat.

instructions: Cut tomatoes in halves lengthwise, slice crosswise, and arrange on a serving platter. Combine the remaining ingredients and stir into tomato mixture. Cover, and refrigerate for several hours for flavors to develop. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut Cheese

instructions: First, take a flat ceramic or glass dish and coat it with coconut oil. Sprinkle paprika on the base of the dish and then layer the ingredients of your choice. title: Pasteis (Pasteis or Mortispale) With Sardines
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 1 kg cauliflower floret, rinsed well | 1 large cooked sardine fillet, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 cups brewed espresso powder ( strongly recommend bombel spiced brown mustard, can also substitute 2 cups prepared brown coffee with strong red coffee ) | 2 teaspoons coffee-flavored limesade | 2 teaspoons fresh limeade | 2 shallots, finely diced
instructions: Heat a little oil in a large non stick frying pan over high heat. Add the mustard, stir and let sizzle for about 20 seconds. Tip in the cauliflower. Stir and fry, stirring, for 3 minutes or so, or until the cauliflower is golden and caramelised. Tip into a kitchen towel. Wipe out the pan, add the espresso and limeade and stir. Cover the pan and let sardines infuse the liquid, 30 to 35 minutes or so, until the smell of espresso fills the air. This should take a few minutes. After 30 minutes, remove the sardines and set aside. Stir in the shallots and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Return the sardines to the pan and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes to finish cooling.

Random Ingredients: gingersnap,canadian bacon,mango chutney,black olive,beef roast,lettuce,italian parsley
title: Mango Chutney Marinated Brisket
ingredients: 1 jar mango chutney ( regular if desired ) | 5 ounces canadian bacon or 5 ounces crumbled bacon | 1 lb boneless beef roast, trimmed ( cut into 2-inch pieces or 1 pound lean beef steak ) | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon grated ( see note in description ) or 3 tablespoons crumbled bacon ( see note in description ) | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground gingerernap ( see note in description ) | lettuce, shredded | black olives ( to garnish )
instructions: For gravy, combine mango chutney and chutney jar in medium dish. Gently mix in the grated bacon bits. Marinate meat at least 3 hours or overnight. Drain meat from chutney and reserve juices. Place meat on flat surface. Add reserved juices and sprinkle with grated cheese. Grill meat until desired doneness. Brush meat with a few drops of canadian bbq sauce and sprinkle with chopped coriander, garnish with a sliced green onion, and serve with a bed of chopped olives. Note, it is suggested that the recipe may be served as is, but more juice and wine may be added to the sauce. Note, 1 large mango chutney jar can be purchased at specialty food markets or the mexican foods isles de marinador. For mild, spicy mango chutney, use 2 medium or 4 large mango chutney jars. As with marinated meats, marinate meat at least 3 hours and up to 3 days in the refrigerator. In a large pot, simmer the chutney.

title: Overnight Okra and Strawberry Sandwich

instructions: Boil okra until easily peeled, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool under running water. Remove the stems, leaving the pieces intact. Cut the okra into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Place okra, strawberries, and bread into a buttered shallow serving dish. Sprinkle toasted nuts over. Broil about 5 minutes or until toasted to your liking.

title: Caribbean Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine ( or butter ) | 1 green beans, cut into 3/4-1-inch pieces ( or 1/2 of each ) | 1 stew meat, 1 inch cubes | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 2 cups coconut milk ( no-soy is my preference, use coconut milk that's sweetened with molasses ) | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 2 tablespoons salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Melt the margarine over gentle heat in a saucepan. Add beans and stir. Add meat chunks and saute over a medium flame. Break up the meat pieces with a wooden spoon and add to the beans. Fry everything together until the meat is browned. Add the stock cube, coconut milk, and lime zest. Bring soup to the boil and simmer for about 20 minutes. Add baking powder and sprinkle with salad dressing. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Blackberry Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs blackberries, fresh | 2 large spanish onions, chopped ( about 1/2 large ) | 1 cup fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 cup fresh mixed herbs, chopped ( such as flat-leaf parsley, flat-leaf thyme, basil or dill or parsley ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tequila | fresh herb ( optional )
instructions: Wash and rinse blackberries. Chop stems and berries coarsely. Toast blackberries in an uncovered broiler or under the broiler until browned and popped, about 5 minutes or so. Transfer blackberries to a bowl and set aside. Toast spanish onions in a small skillet over medium heat just until they show signs of darkening, about 5 minutes. Stir onions and juice into blackberries along with 1/4 cup of the cheese. Set aside and allow to cool at room temperature until ready to serve. To make fresh herbs bruise the herbs and zest, pressing firmly with your hands to release flavor and aromatics from the herbs, using a mortar and pestle or a mortar and pestle. If using herbs sparingly, remove after adding the cheese and herbs. If adding herbs and zest, sprinkle with 2 tequila and 2 t. Dried herbs. If using herbs and garlic, transfer mixture to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. Divide salsa among four 4 ounce ramekins or other decorative serving dishes. Decorate each ramekin or serving with a sprinkling of fresh herbs. Serve immediately or store in a cool, dry place for up to 2 weeks. Garnish with a drizzle of any citrus zest.

title: Wonderful Baked Chicken Basmati With Sage and Beans

Sprinkle with remaining icing sugar, cover with foil and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove the foil, cut into 4cm lengths and grill until brown.

title: English Mushroom and Cheese Spread

instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor, and process until smooth.
