title: Roasted Red Pepper Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs red bell peppers, washed | 10 cups fresh ground walnuts | 3 packages fast rise yeast | 2 teaspoons ground thyme | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 cups cornstarch | 1 -2 cup light oil
instructions: Set oven rack in middle of oven and heat to 425 degrees. Roast red peppers in oven for 20 minutes, then slice off the tops and discard seeds and membranes. Place red peppers on wax paper lined baking sheet. Allow skin to drain off oil and discard. Rinse and pat dry. Place peppers in a shallow roasting pan large enough to support at least 2 tablespoons of peppers in a single layer. Add 10 cups of water, cover tightly and bake in 325 degree oven for 2 to 3 hours, or until bell peppers are soft and dry. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Remove peppers from skins and reserve. Place the remaining 2 cups of water in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Add onions and cook until tender and translucent, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer the softened onions to a bowl and stir in walnuts. Allow walnuts to cool completely. Remove and discard stems and seeds from red peppers. Process peppers in a food processor with 3 cups of reserved cooking liquid until coarsely pureed. Stir into reserved cooking liquid and stir in yeast, thyme, mace and cornstarch. Allow liquid mixture to come to a boil, stirring constantly, then simmer for 5 minutes. Cover and allow to rest in a warm place overnight. Stir enough of reserved cooking liquid into dough mixture to form a stiff dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface. Knead dough on a floured surface for about 10 minutes, then place on a well floured surface, sprinkle with salt and work into dough. Shape into a ball and place in a well buttered bowl and turn the dough over so that the seam is on the bottom and the sides of the bowl are overlapping. Cover bowl with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 45 minutes. Sprinkle work surface with bread crumbs and roll out dough until it is about 1/8 inch thick. Place dough on a greased baking sheet and transfer to a baking sheet. Cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled again, about 1 hour. Brush top half of dough with water. Cut crosswise into slices. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until crust is deep golden brown. Remove from oven and immediately brush tops with water. Turn the oven off and let the bread stand an additional 10 minutes at room temperature. Let bread cool for 10 minutes before removing to wire racks to cool completely. Slice and serve with toppings.

title: Lamb and Beans Braised in Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 racks of lamb, frenched | 2 cans pinto beans | applesauce, to cover | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | maple syrup, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160c/gas mark rub the lamb with an oil soaked rag. Place rack in a large roasting tin about 3/4 full of beans. Cover and cook for 6 - 8 hours. Remove the lamb and leave uncovered. Turn the oven to 200c/gas mark 3 and cook for at least 30 minutes extra hour, depending on the lamb your cooking it will be cooked much quicker than the original recipe. Remove the meat from the oven and keep it warm in a closed oven. Skim off any fat that rises to the top and set the lamb aside. Place the tin on the heat and add the pinto beans, applesauce, nutmeg and the juices from the tin. Stir them together, add salt and freshly ground black pepper. Heat until boiling, turn down and simmer, stirring occasionally for 10 minutes. If you are planning on eating the lamb right away, place in a warm oven, remove the tin from the oven and add some warm beer. When it is cooked, remove from the oven and leave it to cool in the tin. When you are ready to eat, either serve it with a thick sliced green salad and the sauce poured over. It's so tasty, and you can cook it that way too.

title: Pizzelles
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 package velveeta cheese, cubed | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 sprig fresh dill
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a 9x9 inch glass baking dish, place the potato slices. Sprinkle cheese cubes evenly over the potatoes.

title: Italian Sausage Rolls (Bangers)
ingredients: 1 lb ground italian sausage | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons accent seasoning
instructions: Mix and shape. Roll out on to an ungreased cooking sheet. Bake in a preheated 400 f oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Pumpkin Vinegar  (for Dipping)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice ( or other spices )
instructions: Mix in a covered casserole or glass dish and freeze about 3 hours.

title: Chinese Potstickers
ingredients: 1 pound baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup margarine, divided | 1 package sliced chinese mushrooms | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the portobello mushrooms slices in a baking dish with 2 tablespoons of margarine, salt, and pepper. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until tender. Drain mushrooms, and mash them with a fork. Stir the mushrooms into mashed mushrooms, and return the mashed mushrooms to the oven. Bake 15 more minutes. Serve warm.

title: Swiss Cheese and Potato Casserole - Gluten Free
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes | 1 1/4 cups swiss cheese, grated ( about 4 ounces or enough ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chocolate, melted | 2 -3 whole cumin seeds, toasted and finely ground | 6 cardamom pods, lightly crushed
instructions: Peel and chop potatoes into medium cubes and boil them in a saucepan in salted water until they are tender. Drain well. When potato pieces are cool enough, finely mince them and mix with about 2 cups of the cheese and all of the spices except the rest of the cheese. Mix well and pour into a baking dish. Sprinkle on the remaining cheese. Bake at 350 degrees f. For 20 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serve hot with sour cream, honey and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: chive,peanut oil,plain flour,sharp cheddar cheese,hash brown potato,red pepper from
title: Cheese and Chive Potato Pizza
ingredients: 4 ounces plain flour | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons chives, finely chopped | 4 ounces frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed, excess juice squeezed out | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper from jar | 3 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Pre heat oven to c degrees f. Line a 14 x 9 rectangle on your baking trays with baking paper, allowing room in between baking sheets. Set aside. Place flour on a flat surface, and sift over the cheese and chives. Mix well. Add the thawed potatoes and pepper and mix until it forms a stiff dough. Roll mixture into a log, and wrap with baking paper. Repeat step 4 with the rest of the dough. Place the log onto the baking tray, and flatten slightly. Brush with oil. Bake at c for 45 minutes or until golden brown and cooked all the way through. Serve hot with a slice of tomato and a sprinkle of parsley.

title: Bread Machine Pizza Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups bread machine yeast | 3 -4 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree
instructions: In the bread machine pan of your choice, sprinkle the top with mustard. Add the tomato puree and then stir in yeast, making sure the entire surface is covered. Set the bread machine on the dough cycle and press the dough down with the dough or turn out onto a floured surface. Lightly flour your hands and divide dough into six sections. Knead each section into a ball and place on a flour covered tea towel. Place the tray in a warm spot for about 20 minutes before baking. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees and brush a baking sheet with veg oil. Roll out dough into a circle or rectangle and place onto the baking sheet. Brush the top with a few drops of water then transfer to the oven. After 30 minutes, the dough should reach the edges of the pan. After 20 minutes, the dough should be just risen.

title: Bacon and Pesto Rounds
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated biscuits ( i used my pillsbury ) | 1/2 cup basil pesto or 1/2 cup asiago-pesto | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to place biscuits on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet.. Spread each biscuit with pesto or the desired amount of pesto and bake for 12 - 15 minutes until golden brown. While still in oven, whip cream until stiff peaks form. Spread cream on top of biscuit and top with asiago or asiago cheese.

title: Italian Sausage Patties
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup italian chicken sausage, bulk | 1 package dry crushed doritos ( about 12 )
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Coat the inside of a 9 x13 inch metal baking dish with cooking spray. Remove sausage from casings and crumble or break into pieces.

title: Easy Crusty Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin steak, cut into thin strips | 1 lb boneless pork chop | 1 kg plain flour | 3 cups bread dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 200ºc. Line a large baking sheet with baking paper. Combine the beef, pork, and bread to make a crust. Knead the dough into a'soft ball' and roll out a little to about 4cm thick. Place 1 tablespoon of the mixture in the centre of each round. Bake for 30 mins or until browned.

title: Classic English Mustard
ingredients: ice water | 1/2 cup plain grainy mustard
instructions: Fill a large mixing bowl with ice and water. Once cold, mix in the mustard. Cover and store in the freezer until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,balsamic vinegar,pizza crust,white cheddar cheese
title: White Cheddar & Balsamic Pizza Strips
ingredients: 3 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried lemon peel | 1/2 cup shredded white cheddar cheese | 2 pre-baked pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven grill. Combine balsamic vinegar, lemon peel and 1/4 cup cheese in small bowl. Rub the mixture onto pizza crust, spreading it out evenly. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray. Brush dough evenly with glaze, then arrange pizza on cookie sheets. Bake 12 to 14 minutes, or until crust is golden.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,golden delicious apple,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Smoked Fish and Apple Dip
ingredients: 3 golden delicious apples, peeled and finely chopped | 4 ounces smoked fish fillets, skin removed and chopped into chunks | 1 ounce sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Stir the apples, fish, cheddar until you have a soft, creamy mixture. Serve with a variety of crackers.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,vanilla bean,chicken soup,worcestershire sauce,chili powder
title: Fast Vietnamese Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chinese broccoli florets | 1 1/2 cups low-fat chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | garlic powder | 1 pinch of dried chili powder
instructions: Steam the broccoli for about 5 minutes. Set aside. Combine soup and worcestershire sauce in a large saucepan. Add beans, chili powder and heat through. Serve over hot cooked white rice.

title: Fennel Tart
ingredients: 2 lbs fennel bulbs | 1 cup citron peel ( chopped ) | 2 1/2 cups phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Trim and remove thick cores from fennel bulbs, place on cookie sheet in oven, and bake for about 45 minutes, or until tender. Allow to cool. Cut off fronds, and slice into 1 inch pieces, set aside. Using an electric knife, slice the stems, leaving the remainder in tact. Trim the fennel fennel bulbs, and remove any dark stalks, then cut in half lengthwise. Using a knife, scrape off the core and seeds, trim the feathery outer fronds, and finely chop. Squeeze to remove excess moisture. Combine fennel, citron slices, and 1 cup of the water in a bowl and mix well. Place half of the fennel fronds in a shallow baking dish, top with half the phyllo sheets, and top with remaining phyllo. Spoon fennel mixture evenly over the phyllo, and sprinkle with remaining fennel fronds. Dot top with remaining phyllo sheets. Place in 300f degree oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until pastry is puffed up.

title: My Own Noodle Lasagna Style
ingredients: 1 jar la famigati lasagna noodles, or 12 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar or 2 cups monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add noodles, and cook until al dente. Drain, and run under cool water. When cool, drain well. In a small bowl, mix the soymilk and cheese and set aside. Spread a thin layer of soymilk mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer noodles using 2 tablespoons soymilk mixture, 2 tablespoons of noodles, 2 tablespoons of noodles. Repeat layers two more times, ending with noodles on top. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350°f for 40 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,cannellini bean,table cream,black olive,lemon juice,tomato paste
title: Cannellini Beef With White Beans
ingredients: 1 lemon juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 6 black olives, pitted and trimmed, cut into thirds | 1 1/2 cups table cream
instructions: In a large slow cooker, mix lemon juice, tomato paste and tomato beans. Add steaks and turn to coat. Cover and cook 2 hours on high, or 10 hours on low. Remove steak from slow cooker and cover with foil. Let stand until meat loses its pink color. Shred steak into thin strips, return to slow cooker and add cannellini beans, olives. Cover and continue to warm until heated through, about 20 to 30 minutes. Serve beans with cream.

title: Favourite Oatmeal - Easy!
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup vinegar, or more to taste, but be careful not to use any vinegar with this recipe | 2 teaspoons quick-cooking oats, or to taste, for softer oats
instructions: Mix 1 cup quick cooking oats and 1/4 cup vinegar in a bowl. Mix in the remaining dry ingredients.

title: Blueberry Sausage Cups
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 teaspoons red onions, finely chopped | 1/8 cup frozen blueberries | 1/8 cup green chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Poke holes in the refrigerated crescent roll dough with the tines of a fork. Separate dough into 2 rectangles on a board. Roll each rectangle in the oil to coat. Set both rectangles aside. Mix the red onion, blueberries, chili, and brandy in a small bowl. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the mixture into each dough square. Re roll and pinch each to seal in the mixture. Place each sausage cup onto a baking sheet. Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,milk powder,reynolds wrap foil,egg noodle,dill weed,peanut butter
title: Noodles and Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles, broken into small pieces | 1 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup milk powder | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine peanut butter, milk powder, cardamom, dill weed and noodles. Wrap up the corner of the reynolds wrap and pinch shut in a ventrom oven. Turn on gas burner on highest setting until very hot. Pour mixture into a very small casserole dish, and place into hot oven to melt the cheese and brown.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,celery leaf,veggie burger,papaya,non dairy topping,olive,feta cheese,calorie mayonnaise
title: Crispy Baked Vegetians on the Barbie
ingredients: 1/2 cup non-dairy topping, mix or 1/2 cup creamy salad dressing ( or sour cream ) | 1/4 cup fat-free mayonnaise or 1/4 cup yogurt | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon celery leaves | 1/4 teaspoon papaya ( optional ) or 1/4 teaspoon mango powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon feta cheese ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon other natural cheese, shredded ( optional ) | 2 cans fat-free other-firm vegetable burgers ( such as morningstar farms )
instructions: Pour the non dairy topping over the salad dressing/dressing. Stir in the mayonnaise/sugar, ginger and celery leaves.

title: Kittencal's Cherry Jam
ingredients: 1 kg whole maraschino cherry | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place cherries and bay leaf in pressure cooker. Pierce dough every 2 - 3 inches. Close pressure cooker and lock lid on. Pressure can go up to 1 whistle. At this point you can set the koulky and allow it to cool slightly under running water on the inside. Fill it, in half, with warm water and stir gently around on the koulky. The cherry water should be mostly evaporated but make sure your hands brake it down the koulky. Leave for 20 minutes to thicken at low heat. This is very different with fresh cherries, so stir after first rising of pressure and check the consistency by touching the sides of the koulky with the finger. At this point i usually remove the koulky to a serving bowl that's placed in the fridge and let it cool down. Remove the koulky from the fridge and use a large spoon to remove any air bubbles. Chill the jam at least a couple of hours before serving the koulky. The mixture should be a little jiggly when chilled.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,pineapple chunk,szechuan peppercorn,marinara sauce,fish sauce,saffron thread
title: Szechuan Pineapple Marinated Fish
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 cup pineapple chunks, drained | 1/4 cup sweet marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 1 pinch saffron threads | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a heavy duty resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: red wine,chunky salsa,pumpkin seed,pudding,season italian dressing,ancho chile powder
title: Ancho Chile-Papaya Salad (Papaya)
ingredients: 1 package frozen pudding, thawed | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon red wine or 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon italian dressing, or more to taste | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds
instructions: Cook pudding according to package directions. Toss warm papaya with salsa.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,pea pod,mint,sherry wine,purpose flour,cilantro leaf,creme fraiche,bacon
title: Creamy Pea Pods With Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 16 frozen pea pods, thawed | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 slices bacon, chopped and slightly browned | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1 fresh green chile pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: In a medium saucepan of hot water, blanch peas for 2 to 3 seconds or until bright green and just tender. Immediately transfer to ice water to cool, then drain and discard skins. Place flour in a medium bowl. Add bacon and cilantro, stirring with a fork or a large spoon until coated. Add peas, creme fraiche, chili, mint, and sherry. Mix well, season with salt and pepper. Fold in flour, mixing well until dough forms. Divide in half. On lightly floured surface, roll into 3/4 inch thickness snakes, and slice 1/8 inch thick. Place on ungreased cookie sheet, brush tops with water, and bake at 400 degrees f for 10 to 15 minutes, or until beginning to brown. Place on rack to cool. Stack peas, cut side down, on a plate. Drizzle with cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,italian seasoning,clear honey,horseradish,garlic clove,red onion,hot water,butter
title: Italian Seasoned Spread
ingredients: 4 tablespoons hot water | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 3 tablespoons crushed dried italian seasoning | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 teaspoon minced red onion | 2 teaspoons creamed horseradish or 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper | 2 teaspoons minced fresh italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor or blender, process until smooth. Pour into small bowl. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,vanilla extract,cooking oil,egg,canadian bacon,steak,lettuce,crescent dinner
title: Canadian Bacon Stradole
ingredients: 2 packages crescent dinner rolls | 3 slices canadian bacon, thinly sliced ( about 1/2 cup total ) | 1 cup lettuce, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 eggs, well beaten | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules, powder ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon granulated garlic ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut a rectangle or rectangle about 1/8 thick by 1 - ½ inches wide and 2 - ½ inches thick. Spread with 1 tablespoon canadian bacon. Wrap up lengthwise and slice into 1/8 wide strips. In a large bowl, stir together the lettuce, bacon, oil, eggs, vanilla and bouillon. Divide the mixture evenly amongst the 2 rectangles and roll up beginning at 1 long edge. Seal the ends with a little water and press. Arrange on sheet tray seam side down. Bake in a 350º oven until golden brown, about 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Easy Channa Dal With Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half ( i often use fat-free, but we are not sure about the exact amount ) | 1 can red enchilada sauce ( we like my grandma's red enchilada sauce, but i usually use more ) | 1 tablespoon channa dal ( or any lentil )
instructions: Open channa dal, and dump into blender or food processor.. Add all other ingredients to blender, mix until almost a paste. Pour hot, thick, enchilada sauce over the top and mix again. You will need to get it to coat the back of a spoon, a spoon works better, or your hand will tear apart. Cover and allow to sit for a couple of hours or at least it will become firmer. Serve over rice or pasta.

title: Chocolate Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed | 8 ounces dark chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Trim excess fat and fat from beef. Preheat oven to 300°f. Place beef and all but 3 tbs. Of melted chocolate in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,italian seasoning,soy sauce,coriander,dark chocolate,cumin,savoy cabbage,whipping cream
title: Choc Chow Mein With Ziti
ingredients: 9 ounces ziti pasta ( farfalle or penne ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 cup savoy cabbage, chopped or shredded | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, grated | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander, chopped or 2 teaspoons dried coriander
instructions: Cook and tripe ziti in a pot of salted boiling water according to package directions.

title: Dilled Zucchini
ingredients: 10 ounces dark beer | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 1/2 tablespoons cinnamon graham crackers, coarsely crushed | 1 zucchini | 1 teaspoon dill
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a large bowl. Rinse the peel from the zucchini, removing the base. Cut the zucchini down the center, and use a slicing blade to cut down between the pulp and the zucchini until the pieces have a coarse texture. Use more or less the sherry, but as the zucchini cooks away, it evaporates. This is optional. Add the dill.

Random Ingredients: orange,egg white,vanilla,bacon,white fish fillet,ham,pearl barley,green bell pepper
title: BBQ Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 4 slices bacon | 1 cup white fish fillet, cubed | 1/2 small green bell pepper, diced | 1 cup diced ham | 1/2 cup chopped orange or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 2 egg whites | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Prepare barley and add to a large skillet with bacon, white fish, bell pepper. Stir fry, egg whites and vanilla together. Place mixture on top of barley and cover. Simmer on low until the bacon and fish mixture are fully cooked.

title: Flamb  (Flammeaux)
ingredients: 1 kg marjoram | 200 ml margarine | 20 ml ginger-garlic paste | 10 ml dark rum | 10 g slivered almonds
instructions: Place all ingredients in small saucepan and cook slowly on low heat, stirring occasionally for about 1 hour. After 1 hour, remove from heat and let cool. When completely cooled, add to food processor and process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,eggplant,hazelnut,flour tortilla,red chili pepper,asparagus,curry leaf,pepper jack cheese
title: Curried Nuts and Spicy Eggplant
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 2 red chili peppers | 10 fresh curry leaves | 2 ounces ground hazelnuts | 1/4 lb pepper jack cheese | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1/4 lb flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Peel eggplants, cut in quarters lengthwise. Trim with root end, cutting from stem to end. Cut crosswise into slices 1/4 inch thick. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons butter in a skillet over high heat until a drop of water jumps out when splashing. Deep fry eggplant until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels. Repeat with remaining eggplant. Toast curry leaves, grind hazelnuts in a food processor set over w/ground nuts and set aside. Cut the chilies in half crosswise. In a bowl mix ground nuts with cheese. Squeeze peppers into bowl and mix through the cheese and garlic. Divide evenly on tortillas. Divide the nut mixture over the tortillas and top with the chilies. Roll up jellyroll fashion and arrange them on a parchment lined jellyroll pan. Brush tops with the remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons melted butter. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,ginger garlic paste,chicken tender,miso,lettuce,soya sauce
title: Teriyaki Chicken Tender
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb chicken tenders ( cut in 1 inch cubes ) | 1 tablespoon light miso | 1 tablespoon light soya sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | lettuce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium to large bowl in a way you prefer. Reserve some lettuce leaves in large pile, mix the rest well. Marinate chicken 30 min in mixture for best flavor. Serve, or cool and freeze the rest on a tray to use as a salad dressing.

title: Cheese With Pine Nuts and Dilled Parsley
ingredients: 2 cups mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1 tablespoon dill weed
instructions: Shake cheese and nuts together while in a bowl add dill weed. Store in a cool dry place. Can be served as an appetizer or an entree.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,english muffin,peach,maple syrup,baby spinach
title: Peach and Cheese Breakfast Melt (Or Wrap With Muffin)
ingredients: 1 english muffin, split and toasted | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/2 cup baby spinach, washed and drained | 1/4 cup sliced peaches ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Toast bun halves or toasted sandwich slices in toaster oven. Spoon maple syrup onto untoasted english muffin halves or toasted sandwich slices. Place spinach and top with apple slices. Sprinkle with cheese. Place remaining toasted bun halves on top of apple slice and cheese. Return to to toaster oven until cheese is melted and warm throughout. Watch out for the steam when you walk by.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,white radish,golden raisin,vanilla sugar,cornflour,lemon juice zest,walnut oil
title: Walnut and Golden Raisin Wheat Salad - Wheat Free
ingredients: 1/3 cup walnut oil | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2/3 cup cornflour, sifted | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, fresh | 3 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1 white radish, sliced | 4 -6 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/2 cup mixed baby greens and wild rice ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine the walnut oil, vanilla sugar and cornflour and beat with a whisk or a hand held mixer until smooth. Stir in lemon juice. In a deep wide bowl, combine the rice and radish slices. Pour the walnut oiled mixture over rice and radish mix gently but thoroughly, until all the rice and radish are coated. Scatter the raisins over the top of the rice mixture and allow to marinate for 30 minutes. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate, covered, for up to 2 week.

title: Easy Arabic Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, shape ( spaghetti or linguine ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup chili oil | 1 dash cardamom powder
instructions: First, you will need you pasta water. Then, fill a large pot 2/3 full with water, and boil it for about 10 minutes, then add all the rest of the ingredients except for the cream and chili oil. Cook for about 25 to 30 minutes, until the garlic and chili oil are both absorbed. When it's done, it should be very thick. Turn the heat off, and pour slowly over the pasta to serve.

title: Pork Roast in Sherry Vinegar
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry wine vinegar or 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 5 lbs pork shoulder, fat cut into 2-inch lengths ( or other pork roast ) | 2 teaspoons jeera powder
instructions: Marinating procedure,. Sprinkle the sherry vinegar over the pork, rubbing it into the meat. The vinegar should almost cover the pork in a few areas. Remove the meat from the vinegar and pat dry. Rub the cayenne pepper and the jeera in the meat. Place the meat in a large ovenproof roasting pan. Pour the vinegar over, cover tightly and roast in a preheated 350f oven, stirring 1 1/2 times. Baste meat every 45 minutes or so until the meat is tender. Roast will be quite rare in my oven. Remove from the oven, tent with foil, and let stand for 25 minutes before carving.

title: Applesauce Dogs
ingredients: 10 -12 cherry rolls | 10 tablespoons applesauce | 1 package bulk pork sausage | 1 can minced green chili | 11 ounces sour cream or 1 1/2 cups applesauce | 10 tablespoons shredded colby cheese
instructions: Split rolls and put together in a bowl. Mix applesauce and sour cream or shredded cheese if using sour cream to make the sauce. Mix in ground pork sausage or other favorite sausage. Pour over the bread. Serve with beans or rice and your favourite side.

title: Pistachio Pizza Bread
ingredients: 4 2/3 cups unbleached all-pounded bread or 4 2/3 cups all-purpose flour | 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 1 can pizza sauce | 1/4 cup instant pistachio nut, finely chopped
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve the yeast in 1 cup of lukewarm water. Beat in coriander and seasonings, and then the remaining 1/2 cup warm water and the pizza sauce. Stir to combine. Add the flour and mix until just combined. Knead for about 5 minutes on a floured surface, and place in a well oiled bowl. Cover with a damp towel, and allow to rise until the dough is 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Place the dough on a greased or floured pizza pan or baking stone, and lightly brush it with olive or corn oil. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. If using an electric pizza stone, slide the pizza stone onto the rack. Allow the dough to rise for 30 minutes, then brush it lightly with olive oil. Spread the pizza with the remaining pizza sauce, and spread the pistachios on top, or on the sides using a spatula. If possible, spread more sauce, then cover with a damp towel. Allow to rise to 1 1/2 times its original size before baking, and bake on the baking rack for about 25 to 30 minutes, or until the crust is browned and crispy. Allow to cool completely before cutting.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,peanut,adobo sauce,ciabatta,cilantro leaf,corn,orange peel,rice wine
title: Pumpkin Fried Ciabatta
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped cilantro leaves | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 pinch adobo sauce | 1/4 cup raw peanuts, roughly chopped | 1 cup canned pumpkin puree, canned in a canning jar of a blender | 2 -3 ciabatta, halved horizontally & opened horizontally
instructions: Place cilantro, orange peel, corn and adobo sauce in a heavy bottomed skillet. Saute over high heat about two minutes or until fragrant. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cilantro mixture to a large dish or bowl. Raise heat to high, add the peanuts and stir fry until golden brown, 1 - 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels, then stir peanuts into the mixture. Spoon the peanut mixture over the ciabatta, then serve.

title: Chocolate and Hazelnut-Soy Chilli Chicken
ingredients: 600 g skinless chicken | 80 g broccoli | 1 large jalapeno chile | 1/4 cup black-eyed peas | 2 tablespoons roasted hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon cocoa ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs
instructions: Put the chicken in a deep ovenproof dish and scatter over the chilli, then cover and leave to marinate in a cool place for 30 minutes. Remove the chilli stalk and cut the remaining chilli leaves into thin strips and place in a small jug and add the beans, hazelnuts and cocoa if using. Stir well and cook over a gentle heat for 10 minutes until the nuts start to wilt. Pour over the chicken, sprinkle with mixed herbs and return to the oven for 30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and tender, stir through the chilli and serve straight from the oven.

title: Naked Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sweet paprika ( spanish ) | 5 ounces red fresno chilies, minced | 2 serrano chilies, minced | 1/3 cup cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In food processor, puree paprika, chiles, cayenne into a smooth paste. Add mushrooms and pulse until mixture forms 2 or 3 clumps. Transfer to a piping bag and pipe an opening in the center of each cube, leaving about 1 1/2 inch in border. Bake 25 minutes or until hot and beginning to brown, stirring every few minutes. Transfer to a large platter and serve immediately with your favorite queso.

Random Ingredients: spice,pepper sauce,pasta,bicarbonate soda,madras curry powder,canola oil,pickle
title: Madras Fried Pasta
ingredients: 200 g pasta ( tri-colour ) | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | pickle, to serve
instructions: Cook the pasta in a pan of boiling water following instructions on the packet. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan and stir in the spices. Stir in the pasta and toss to coat well. Serve with diced pickles, if desired.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,za'atar spice mix,pancetta,greek yogurt,extra virgin olive oil,roquefort cheese,cornflour
title: Za'atar Cheese Filled With Za'atar and Raquefort, Raisin & Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 cup reduced fat mexican cheese blend | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 50 g pancetta, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons za'atar spice mix | 1/2 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c and line a baking tray with baking paper. Use an oiled non stick fry pan and heat olive oil in pan over medium heat until foaming. Add pancetta and cook for about 4 - 5 minutes turning occasionally until golden and crispy. Stir in za'atar and raquefort and mix well. Remove pan from heat and place bowl upright on baking tray. Spread half of cheese mix in to the side of the bowl and top with the raquefort cheese mixture. Spread half of the yoghurt evenly over the cheese, leaving a 2 border around the edges. Dollop extra yoghurt over the cheese. Repeat with remaining cheese and raquefort, topping with crumbled feta and sprinkling of za'atar. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Remove bread/cheese loaf from oven and cut a few small indents to allow steam to escape. Serve, cut into slices and drizzle with olive oil.

Random Ingredients: linguine pasta,pineapple juice,garlic paste,spice,egg yolk,garlic clove,string bean,milk ricotta cheese
title: Pasta and String Bean Casserole
ingredients: 10 -10 ounces dried linguine pasta, preferably whole wheat or 10 -10 ounces other tubular pasta | 2 cans crushed pineapple in juice, drained | 1 1/2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese ( or cottage cheese ) | 3 whole garlic cloves ( use fresh ) | freshly mixed spice, to taste | 2 egg yolks | freshly minced garlic clove ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 3 cups whole milk, warmed, at least | string bean, cooked, to serve
instructions: Bring 6 cups water to a boil and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, add the pineapples to the hot water. Allow to sit 5 minutes before draining, and drain again. Place the drained pasta and pineapple into a saucepan and sprinkle with some mixed spice. Stir in enough hot water to mix. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated thoroughly, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, beat together the ricotta cheese, egg yolks and garlic. In a medium size bowl, mash the garlic with a fork. Slowly pour through a wire strainer into the hot milk while whisking constantly. Stir into the egg mixture. Pour the cheese sauce over the pasta and stir gently to combine. Remove from heat and stir in the cooked pasta. Sprinkle some fresh minced garlic over the top. Serve warm topped with plenty of string beans.

title: Pesto Riggies
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 can chicken broth | 1/3 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce ( i recommend kraft mediterranean herbed cheese )
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook rigatoni until tender but firm, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Transfer pasta to a medium bowl.

title: Smoky Chipotle Cashew Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces roasted cashew nuts | 1/2 cup chipotle chile in adobo, pureed | 1/2 cup sweet chili paste
instructions: Process all ingredients in food processor until smooth. Serve with pita chips.

title: Chinese BBQ Rub
ingredients: 1/2 cup turbinado sugar or 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Stir sugar, oil, and liquid smoke together in a bowl. Store in an airtight container.

title: Sweet and Sour Glazes on a Bun (Sauce for Meat Fondue)
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon golden raisin ( optional, see intro ) | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Heat a small skillet to medium heat. To make a roux, melt the sugar/spice in the bottom or heat a cast iron griddle pan. Pour just enough batter from the bottom of the pan to coat the bottom. Cook until bubbles form and appear. Turn off heat and immediately pour off any excess batter with the pan. Pour 1 tablespoon batter into center of the roux and tilt the pan so that the batter coats the bottom and corners. Turn pan over and spray liberally with oil. Let the other side toast as the batter crisps. If all sides look dry, add a tablespoon or so of oil. Slide onto a rack to cool slightly. Serve at once. Note, to make the syrup, combine in a small bowl the glaze ingredients and stir until smooth. Refrigerate until used up. Note 2, if desired, reheat leftovers in the same pan for about 30 seconds or so before serving. Note 3, if desired, the added glaze keeps for a few days in the fridge.

title: Cherie's Party Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | fresh orange juice ( optional ) | 1 lb hamburger ( can use pork )
instructions: Brown ground deer by heating up the 1/2 cup of cream of tartar with some orange juice, or if using pork you won't need a lot of. If using pork or beef just heat the pan to medium low and add 1 teaspoon of ginger garlic paste. You can add more orange juice if you want to or reduce amount of fat if you want to. Stir in cooked turkey and heat through. You can sprinkle more cream of tartar on top to make it more festive if desired. Eat.

title: Hot Mango and Cashew Cream on Stick
ingredients: 2 sweet mangoes | 1 tablespoon cashew cream
instructions: Peel the mangoes and slice them into half moons. Place about 2 tablespoons of cashew cream in a small plate. Place a mango slice on top of the cream then wrap the whole thing up like you are using a cigar. Wrap some sticks in the remaining cream and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery seed,italian turkey sausage link,barbecue sauce,sirloin tip roast,tuna olive oil,potato traditional,pimiento,pea
title: Italian Turkey Sausage #5FIX
ingredients: 2 pounds sirloin tip roast | 2 tablespoons tuna olive oil | 1 tablespoon barbeque sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon paprika ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 bag simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 2 frozen peas, thawed | 2 roasted turkey sausage links ( i recommend skirt steak bangers )
instructions: Place roast in a large deep skillet or roasting pan. Combine the olive oil, barbeque sauce, paprika, celery seed and sausages. Brush over the roast and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Place the potatoes in another large skillet. Heat to boiling while stirring. Add the frozen peas and cook 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat while gravy simmers.

title: Oven-Baked Fennel With a Kick
ingredients: 1 head fresh fennel, cleaned | pink plastic wrap
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Prepare fennel head by trimming and discarding the tough end and core, then slice off the feathery parts of the fennel with a paring knife tip and discard. Put fennel, cut side down, in a roasting pan and drizzle with a little olive oil. Place roasting pan in your preheated oven and roast for 30 minutes until fennel is tender and beginning to brown, turning as needed. Place fennel on a plate. Drizzle with a little more olive oil. Increase oven heat to 400f and continue roasting, stirring constantly, until fennel is browned and crisp on the inside, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,splenda granular,pear,beer,cotija cheese,rose water,cream tartar,sirloin tip steak
title: Baked Mexican Steaks With Cheddar Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup cheddar cheese ( shredded, 1/2 cup ) | 2 tablespoons cotija cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream tartar | 1/4 teaspoon rose water | 1 teaspoon splenda granular | 1 tablespoon guinness beer | 1 beef top sirloin tip steak, trimmed and tied ( about 1 pound ) | 1 pear, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish or line it with parchment paper. Combine the cheese, cotija, sour cream, rose water, and splenda in a bowl. Add meat and gently coat. Pour the beer into the dish and spread evenly. Bake the steak for 25 minutes, turn the meat and bake 15 more minutes, or until internal temp of meat thermometer reads 140 degrees. Remove meat from the oven, let stand 15 minutes before slicing diagonally across grain. While the steak is warm, toss pear wedges with the cheese mixture in a bowl until coated. Serve over the meat and surround with the pear.

Random Ingredients: apricot,gruyere cheese,dinner,sherry wine,green chilies,chicken stock,soya sauce
title: Lunchy Cheese Tiddy Fondue
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs gruyere cheese ( shredded ) | 12 dinner rolls | 1/3 cup soya sauce | 4 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 3 green chilies | 1 1/2 ounces dried apricots
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place 1/2 of the cheese in one bowl and the other in another. Roll both bowls into long sausages and tie with kitchen twine. Dip in boiling water, shaking excess. In a saucepan combine all but the last three chilis. Simmer until the chilis turn bright red. Remove from heat and pour over cheese. Serve immediately or serve with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,yellow onion,triple sec,peanut butter,pork shoulder,brandy
title: Tropical Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, boned | 1 yellow sweet onion, peeled | 2 red chili peppers, deseeded | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup triple sec or 1/3 cup grand marnier | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c place the pork on a large baking tray and add all of the ingredients on top. Pour over some water to leave 3/4” around the meat. Bake in the oven, uncovered, for 2 hours, basting several times. If the pork begins to burn, cover loosely with foil for the remaining half hour, then remove the foil and cook uncovered for a further 30 to 40 minutes. When cooked, remove from the oven and rest in a warm place for 15 minutes before carving. Serve with plenty of mashed potatoes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: wondra flour,soy mozzarella cheese,cumin powder,radish,purpose flour,phyllo pastry,hot chili pepper,cilantro
title: Pastilla De Arroz con Calabacin (Cheese Empanadas)
ingredients: 1 lb all-purpose flour | 3 ounces wondra flour | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 10 ounces soy mozzarella cheese, shredded and cut in small chunks | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 6 large hot chili peppers, sliced in half lengthwise | 6 radishes, sliced | 1 sprig fresh cilantro, minced
instructions: For easy handling, buy a food processor equipped with a good sized capacity. Wash and clean your hands to remove as many lumps as you can. Dough should be slightly dry. Combine 2 cups of water and a pinch of salt in a medium sized pot and bring to a boil. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, draflour mixture and the cumin powder until completely combined. Place a sheet of phyllo dough on it, and use your fingers to separate the two sheets until all of the dough is used. Cover the phyllo sheet with plastic wrap and with the help of a large spoon, make 4 sheets into balls about 5 inches long. Keep the remaining strips covered with a damp cloth while you assemble the others. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Take one ball of dough and place on a clean surface and using a rolling pin, roll it out to about 3/4 thick. Place on a greased baking sheet and brush it with flour to make a circle approximately 4 inches wide. Repeat until all of the dough is used. Place your pepper slices in the center and cover with a circle of dough, leaving a 1 inch border. Top the pepper with a layer of cheese. Make a second large circle of dough, using your fingers to roll it out. Place your pepper half on top of your cheese, and cover it with a circle of dough. Repeat until all of your dough is used up. Place your pastry in the oven, close the oven and wait for 10 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes, or until the top is browned and crisp. Remove from the oven, cut in half and serve warm.

title: Blueberry Cheese Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta | 1/4 cup pure apple butter | 1 bay leaf | 1 1/2 cups blueberries, fresh, frozen | 1/4 cup cashews, flaked
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Drain and toss with apple butter and bay leaf. Combine drained fettuccine with blueberries and cashews.

title: Korean Gluten Free Beef Rouladen (Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 -2 poblano peppers or 1 -2 crushed red chili peppers | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 1/2 tablespoons ruby port | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the stuffing.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,no salt tomato,orange juice concentrate,risotto rice
title: Pumpkin Risotto W- Fresh Orange Juice and Tomato
ingredients: 1 cup risotto rice | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes, drained ( with no sodium added ) | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate ( the juice can be kept if rice is dried, you may substitute 1 cup of fresh orange juice )
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. Meanwhile, in a large pot heat the orange juice and pumpkin puree on low with lid on for 15 - 20 minutes until heated through, stirring occasionally. Add dry rice and mix well. Serve warm with extra orange syrup and freshly grated romano cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,oyster,active yeast,spice,pork shoulder,apple juice,avocado,ham steak
title: Apple Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 large active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ground lean pork shoulder | 1 lb raw lean ham steak or 1 lb thinly sliced smoked pork shoulder | 1 avocado, peeled pitted and sliced peeled | 2 large diced apples ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter with juice | 2 tablespoons light agave syrup or 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Dissolve yeast and anise in warm water on top or burner. Add ground pork, ham, and apple or apple slices. Mix thoroughly. Knead with floured hands on a lightly floured work surface for about 10 minutes. Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 40 minutes, or until doubled in bulk. Remove and divide dough in half. On a lightly floured work surface, turn each piece of dough into a 15 inch long rope with a long edge. Place the ropes on a lightly greased baking sheet. Loosely twist the rope to separate the two strands and shape it into a tight loaf resembling a wall. Place in a warm place for 20 minutes, turn, and let rise 20 minutes longer. To make the glaze, mix together the 1 tablespoon maple syrup and 1 tablespoon agave syrup in a small saucepan. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Brush the loaf with glaze to glaze the top and sides of the loaf. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven 35 - 30 minutes, or until center of loaf is bubbly. Cool on wire rack.

title: Low Fat Baked Veggies
ingredients: 2 small zucchini, cut in half lengthwise and lengthwise | 2 small cauliflower, cut in half lengthwise and cored | 0.5 package reduced-fat onion soup mix | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fat-free whipped topping, warmed
instructions: Place zucchini in a microwave safe bowl. Cover with vented plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 4 to 5 minutes or until tender. Turn off microwave and stir contents of bowl. Let sit 5 to 10 minutes. Spray two small baking dishes with nonstick cooking spray. Place cauliflower cut sides down, on top of zucchini, and let cool slightly. Stir remaining contents of bowl into zucchini. Pour mixture into prepared dishes. Sprinkle with whipped topping. Cover with aluminum foil, and microwave on high for another 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Bunjons Piri Piri (Fish With Chips)
ingredients: 1/4 cup coriander seed | 2 1/2 lbs cod fish fillets ( such as halibut, snapper, or red snapper, each about 2-1/2 inches thick ) | 1 can bamboo shoots ( in its own juice ) | 2 -3 cups sugar ( may sub light sweetener )
instructions: In a small saucepan, toast the coriander seeds over medium heat 2 minutes, stirring constantly so that they do not burn, remove from heat. Grind coriander seeds into a fine powder. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the fish fillets in a large baking dish, rub the spice mixture all over, and spread it onto the fish. In a small bowl, pour 1 cup water and the can of bamboo shoots, or 1/4 cup water. Heat both for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Pour over the fish, cover, and bake the fish until barely cooked through, about 30 minutes. Remove fish from the oven, cover, and allow it to sit at least 10 minutes. While the fish is cooking, make the dipping sauce by boiling 1/4 cup sugar in 3/4 cup water until it dissolves. Dip the chips into the hot sugar syrup, turn over, and drain on paper towels. Serve the biscuit topped with the chips.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,linguine,salt,cardamom seed,shell pasta,red chile,savoy cabbage,rump steak
title: Sweet Potsticker Rump
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt | 600 g small rump steak, in thin slices | 1 head savoy cabbage, cut into thin slices ( about 3.5 cm long ) | 200 g small dry small shell pasta ( about 750g or 750g tin ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 2 red chiles, deseeded and finely sliced | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Place beef in a medium saucepan, add enough water to cover and simmer over medium heat, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until just cooked. Transfer beef to a plate. Increase heat to high and add cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 - 2 minutes or until cabbage begins to soften. Add cooked beef and return to the boil for 5 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and browned. Stir through noodles, dark soy sauce and cardamom to heat through.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,shiitake mushroom,turmeric,tomato ketchup,marsala wine,chunky salsa,vegetable stock
title: Aussie Salsa Mushrooms
ingredients: 225 g fresh shiitake mushrooms, washed and sliced | 1 red pepper, deseeded and sliced | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon marsala wine | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 300 ml vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan, add the mushrooms and red pepper in it and fry, stirring, for 2 mins, stir in the ketchup, wine, and turmeric. Stir in the vegetable stock and simmer gently for 3 mins stir in the salsa and serve topped with the sliced mushrooms and red pepper, if using.

title: Grilled Pork Skewers with Thai Basil and Raisins
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons thai basil, minced | 1 medium lime leaves | 1 pork tenderloin | 30 -35 whole lime leaves | 2 -4 sprigs thai basil | 1 ham hock
instructions: Soak raisins and thai basil in 1 tbsp boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and set aside. Grill tenderloin on all sides on medium high heat. Remove and allow to cool for few minutes. Slice meat thinly but not all the way through so as to achieve a slice that will fit on a skewers. Soak raisins and thai basil in warm water for 15 minutes, drain and set aside. Grill skewers on both sides or until desired degree of doneness, about 2 minutes per side. Serve with grilled peanuts, chopped fresh basil, thai basil and raisin flavored tortillas.

title: Boiled, Baked, and Roasted Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs beef, cut into large chunks | 1 cup fresh butternut squash, peeled and coarsely chopped ( or use 2 cups frozen diced squash ) | 4 baking potatoes, unpeeled | 1 teaspoon msg
instructions: Add the diced squash, or frozen diced squash, to a large pot and add 2 quarts of water. Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. In a large bowl, mix the beef chunks and salt and pepper. Use 2 forks to pull the meat apart and brown the beef chunks in a little oil and butter. Transfer the meat to a crockpot, add the broth to the pot on top of your meat. Cook on low heat for 3 - 4 hours, or until the meat is tender. Taste for salt and pepper, and serve with grated cheddar cheese or parmesan cheese. This can also be cooked with a meat loaf or make a meal the next day.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,cremini mushroom,celery rib,banana,tahini,currant,corn tortilla chip
title: Quick and Easy Mushrooms, Barbuda Style
ingredients: 3 cups of sliced dried mushrooms | 3 cups thinly sliced celery rib | 1 cup sliced and sliced bananas | 1 cup tahini | 5 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | corn tortilla chips
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the mushrooms, celery, banana, and tahini. Toss well until well mixed and set aside. When the mushrooms are ready, spread one cup of mozzarella on each tortilla chip. Distribute the mushroom mixture evenly over the cheese. Fold into the sides and bottom of the tortillia. Microwave on high power until cheese has fully melted, about 1 min and 1 min. Remove from microwave and top with remaining mozzarella, shredded lettuce and additional tahini. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black olive,baby carrot,corn,pecorino romano cheese,bread flour
title: Crispy Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 1 large egg, lightly beaten | 1 cup bread flour | 1 cup baby carrots, grated | 1 cup corn, fresh, defrosted | 1 cup fresh pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 cup black olives, pitted
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together. Roll mixture into 12 golf ball sized balls. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place the coated polenta wedges into the pan with enough of the oil so they are about 2/3 full. Cook for 3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.

title: Homemade Black Tea
ingredients: 4 cups stronglyavored black tea, cold ( i used decaf ) | 1 bunch cilantro, leaves picked from stems
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large kettle and heat to boiling. Cover, turn off heat and allow tea to steep for 20 minutes. Strain tea through a tea strainer lined with a clean cloth bag or tea towel and discard tea solids. Cover kettle again with a thick cloth and increase heat to high. Allow tea to steep for 5 minutes or until temperature drops below 5 inches. Remove tea from heat and pour into a large tea pot. Cover, remove and discard cloth bag. Allow tea to steep for 10 minutes. Remove tea bags. Enjoy.

title: Crock Pot Beef Cheese and Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef | 8 ounces part shredded gouda cheese | 1 1/2 cups aged provolone cheese or 1 1/2 cups parmesan cheese, shredded | 1 1/2 cups medium aged sourdough bread ( or other )
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain excess fat. Cut bread into 1/2 inch slices. Combine the cheese with the meat and meat mixture until it is well mixed. Spread mixture on bread. Cook on low for 4 - 6 hours.

title: Linguine With Cheese, Tapas and Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 250 g linguine | 100 ml greek yogurt | 100 g old gouda cheese ( or substitute with other mature cheese ) | 1 egg white | 100 ml broth | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 80 ml arrowroot
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the direction of the package. Rinse well and place in a bowl with 3 tbsp water until the pasta is the right texture. Drain thoroughly and set aside until cool enough to handle. Put the yoghurt, eggwhite and broth into a mixing bowl and whisk until they are thick and creamy. Add the icing sugar and arrowroot. Toss the pasta with the cheese sauce, ensuring the all the ingredients are incorporated. Serve piping hot.

title: Creamy Shrimp and Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup dried shrimp | 1/2 cup fresh snow peas, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup coarse superfine sugar | 1 cup hummus
instructions: Combine soup, shrimp, snow peas and sugar in saucepan and simmer over medium heat about 5 minutes. Cool soup to room temperature. Stir in hummus. Stir into soup and refrigerate about 1 hour. Serve at room temp or chilled.

title: Chickpea Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups dried garbanzo beans or 1 1/2-2 cups chicken broth, washed and picked over if necessary | 1 bunch chives, chopped | 2 -3 garlic cloves, chopped | fresh tandoori paste ( optional ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed according to directions for consistency
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a large pot of boiling water, add about 1/3 c, and cook until tender, approximately 15 minutes for dried beans and up to 1/2 c for prawns. Drain chickpeas and rinse well. Place the drained chickpeas in a food processor, along with 2 1/2 cups of the remaining broth and the chives, garlic and tandoori paste if using. Cover and process until the mixture is smooth, about 1 minute. Add salt and pepper to taste and set aside to let flavors develop. Spread the mixture on a serving platter and top with whipped topping.

title: Pounded Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb pork, ground | 1/4 cup coriander, chopped | 4 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,popcorn,milk,red cabbage,cream mushroom soup,button mushroom,cumin
title: Creamy Vegetable Calzones
ingredients: 3 cups skim milk | 1/2 cup light cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup shredded red cabbage | 1 package sliced button mushrooms | 1 package popcorn, crushed
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the milk, light cream of mushroom soup, cumin, and yeast. Beat in the flour 1 cup at a time, stirring until the dough forms a ball. Turn onto a lightly floured surface, knead gently, and cut 3 inch pieces. Place each one into a lightly greased, deep, 9x13 inch pan. Evenly divide the sliced mushrooms and cabbage among the dough, and top with the popcorn.. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Persian Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 cup date, soaked in water at least 2-3 hours | 2 large roast of beef, trimmed, cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons fresh herbs, coarsely chopped, such as tarragon, oregano, chives ( to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 head shredded lettuce
instructions: Soak dates in warm water for 15 - 30 minutes. Drain dates and cut of any that float to the top. In a large soup pot over medium heat, combine dates with 1 - 3 t. Each of dried herbs and water. Cover and cook, stirring often and scraping any browned bits from the bottom of the pan, for at least 20 minutes, or until a deep brown crust forms. Be sure not to boil as this will cause the meat to brown. When the meat is nearly done, add 3 t. Of garam masala and 2 t. Of herbs. Stir until well combined. Reserve half of the marinade in a small bowl and set it aside. Remove crust from the meat and discard. Season all sides with salt and pepper. Sprinkle remaining 1 t. Pasam masala along the edges of the meat. Spoon some reserved marinade into the pot. Add remaining meat slices, making sure that each slice is well coated with the marinade. Pour reserved marinade over meat and stir. Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes or until desired doneness. Meanwhile, make the salad. Tear lettuce into bite size pieces and place on a bed of lettuce. Toss with reserved marinade and serve atop greens.

title: Fried Cheese in Broiler
ingredients: 1 bunch cauliflower, separated into florets | 3 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco | 4 slices rye bread, cut in 1 inch cubes
instructions: Place the cauliflower, tomatoes, and garlic salt into a microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and cook in the microwave until just starting to soften, stirring after 1 minute or so. Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium heat, and lightly spray with nonstick spray and spread bread cubes out in a single layer. Stir cauliflower and tomato mixture until evenly coated and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Spread cauliflower over top of bread cubes in the skillet, and sprinkle with queso fresco. Broil until cheese has melted and is bubbling, about 5 minutes.

title: Blue Cheese-Zucchini Soup With Poached Pears
ingredients: 1 cup halved peeled pears | 16 ounces peeled italian tomatoes, chopped, seeded | 1/2 cup halved halved halved zucchini | 32 fluid ounces dark beer | 1/2 cup crumbled reduced-sodium blue cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook pear slices in beer over high heat 5 minutes, or until tender. Top with zucchini, tomatoes and blue cheese.

title: Garlic and Herb Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 medium zucchini, shredded | 1 can water chestnuts, chopped | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Place the pinto beans, zucchini, water chestnuts, flour, mayonnaise, garlic powder, and coriander in a food processor and pulse to evenly distribute ingredients.

title: Chinese Garlic Croissant Appetizer
ingredients: 5 -6 croissants, cut in 12 pieces each about 1/2 cm thick ( the thinner the bread the better, about 5 tablespoons total works out to about 6 ) | dark soy sauce
instructions: Toast the croissants in a hot dry frypan for about 8 minutes they should be crispy, but not browned. Remove toasted croissants and allow to cool until lukewarm. Preheat oven to 200°c/400°f. Mix the soy sauce and dark sauce together and brush on the cooled croissants, but leave the crust on to cool completely. Cut each croissant into 6 triangles, then place on baking trays, making sure any extra is in the middle of the triangles. Bake on 200°c/400°f oven for 8 - 10 minutes. Serve hot, warm or room temperature. Note, toast a few croissants at a time on a greased, preheated cookie sheet. If you like, toast them in a hot dry pan at the last minute. Place the croissants on baking trays and bake on the last few minutes so the juices have a chance to dribble over the croissants.

Random Ingredients: green chile,black mustard seed,almond milk,chive,white vinegar,taco sauce
title: Creamy Chilies
ingredients: 1 can canned green chilies ( or green chilies ) | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chopped chives | 14 ounces reduced fat taco sauce ( we use homemade ) | 1/2 cup almond milk
instructions: Drain canned chilies and discard liquid. Rinse chilies under warm water, then slice into halves lengthwise, open and remove the seeds. Place in bowl with vinegar and spices. Chill thoroughly. When ready to use, whisk in almond milk. Serve with french toast, cheddar, and or other favorite mexican meal.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad
ingredients: 10 skinless chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons mango chutney | 4 tablespoons marsala | 2 tablespoons pickles, finely diced | 1 head cauliflower, washed and cut into small florets, to serve | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, to squeeze and serve
instructions: Combine chutney and marsala in a small bowl. Place chicken on a plate and cover with a thin layer of chutney. Place into the freezer for 20 minutes to chill the meat. Preheat an oven to 200c. Cook in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until no longer pink. Cool. Meanwhile, cook cauliflower in boiling water for 6 to 8 minutes or according to packet instructions. Drain. Place in a serving bowl and top with chicken. Combine remaining ingredients in another serving bowl. Toss with salad, and serve with mint leaves.

title: Ricotta & Berry Feijoada Cakes
ingredients: 800 g ricotta cheese, at room temperature | 300 g frozen raspberries | 3/4 cup red beans, drained & rinsed | 3/4 cup snow peas, trimmed
instructions: Place yoghurt & ricotta in a bowl & whisk until smooth. Stir in beans & snow peas to taste & season to taste. Shape dough into six cakes & press into a non stick cake tin. Bake in a preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until lightly set & cooked through. Set aside to cool. Repeat with remaining dough.

title: Tamari Beef or Venison Filling
ingredients: 1 package of tamari | 1 lb ground chuck or 1 lb venison | lard
instructions: In a frying pan, add 1/2 lb of tamari or veggie filling. Cook to desired consistency. I like it done the way that you like to do but that is up to you. Once cooked, remove from heat and pour on hot lard for frying. Note, if using venison, you might want to soak the cure in the pan for a little. Note, if using venison, you might also wish to add 2 tsp of tamari to the filling. I usually add to my mixture. So when the filling is done, remove from heat and drizzle on hot sauce and enjoy serve on hoagie rolls.

title: Bacon Veggie Salad
ingredients: 5 -6 medium zucchini | 1 medium apple cider | 3 tablespoons pickle juice | 1 cup fresh broccoli florets ( optional )
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1/4 inch slices, then slice them crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices and in half again into 1/4 inch thick slices.. Combine apple cider and pickle juice in medium frying pan, bring to boil then simmer until reduced to 1 cup, about 2 - 4 minutes. Add vegetables and stir to coat. Cover. Let stand about 1 minute or until vegetables are crisp but still tender. Serve warm.

title: Buckingham Palace Hazelnut Rolls
ingredients: 12 ounces self-rising flour | 3/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 ounces ground hazelnuts | 2 ounces ground mixed dried fruit | 1 ounce mint | 1 drop vanilla essence
instructions: Sift the flour and saffron into a mixing bowl. Add the hazelnuts and mixed dried fruit. Using your hands, mix the mixture together into a rough dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface, knead gently, then roll out to ¾ inch thickness. Carefully transfer the dough to an oven rack and bake, until just firm. Allow to cool. Cut into 12 slices and roll out again to ¾ inch thickness. Cut again to ¾ inch thickness. Cut again and cut out again. Serve rolled up, with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream. Makes six servings. Makes one serving.

title: Raspberry and Chorizo Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 36 ounces rice noodles | 1 package mexican chorizo blend ( i use spicy, sliced links of pork ) | 4 cups raspberries ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) or 4 cups strawberries ( fresh or frozen, thawed ) | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro or 2 tablespoons parsley | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Cook noodles as per package instructions.

title: Spicy Steak With Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef top round steak | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon mild ancho chili pepper
instructions: Cut the steak into thin slices. Place in a zip lock bag with the yogurt, and the chili pepper. Close the bag, and marinate at least 2 hours refrigerated or overnight. Heat oven to 450°f. Place steak on a baking sheet, and bake for 20 minutes or until cooked as desired. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,pine nut,oregano leaf,lime,turmeric powder,pam cooking spray,hazelnut
title: Cousin Pete's Hazelnut Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 cup whole hazelnuts | 3 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon chopped pine nuts | 1 tablespoon coarse ground turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons grated lime rind | pam cooking spray
instructions: Place hazelnuts in a baking dish and, using the tip of a cheese grater, grate the hazelnuts onto a sheet of cheesecloth. Toast until the nuts darken and start to smell fragrant and crunchy, about 10 minutes. Cool, then rub away any ground hazelnuts. In a medium bowl combine the hazelnuts, oregano, sun dried tomato, pine nuts, turmeric powder, lime rind, and pam. Adjust the spices to your liking with additional oregano, sun dried tomato, etc. Serve or keep in the fridge until ready to use.

title: Creamy Chiles Con Queso
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles ( about 6 medium ) | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Cut the chilies in half lenghtwise. Place in a large roasting tin. Mix the soup with corn flour to form a thin sauce. Pour over the top of the chilies. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,shrimp,nam pla,button mushroom,corn tortilla,beef brisket
title: Simple Shrimp and Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef brisket | 3 cups boiling water | 12 ounces medium shrimp, peeled, deveined | 12 ounces small button mushrooms | 12 corn tortillas | 2 tablespoons nam pla ( vietnamese fish sauce )
instructions: Place brisket in crockpot. Add water and cook on high for 10 minutes. Turn over and add the shrimp. Cook for another 4 - 5 hours on high or on low the following day. Turn the meat out. Shred with 2 forks and stir in remaining ingredients. Add more nam pla for a spicier taco. Serve hot with pico de gallo or salsa fresca.

title: Pan Seared Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 1 whole salmon, cut into 6 or 8 pieces ( or more or less of each to taste ) | 1/2 cup italian parsley, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | skewer | anchovy, minced
instructions: Prepare a steamer. Place salmon pieces in a steaming pan or in a bamboo steamer basket and line the basket with one inch of water inches. Bring to a boil over high heat, then steam until the salmon is cooked, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer salmon to a serving platter and spoon parsley over salmon. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: anchovy fillet,vegetable oil,apricot preserve,yellow pepper,wondra flour,peach,broccoli,eggplant
title: Italian Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 large yellow sweet peppers, halved, seeded, cut into 1-inch squares ( about 3 cups ) | 2 large eggplants, skin on, unpeeled, cut lengthwise into thick slices ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons wondra flour ( cornstarch ) | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 lb broccoli, halved lengthwise, cut into florets | 1 can peaches, drained, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat grill. Brush 2 tablespoons 1 tablespoon oil on both sides of vegetables. In 12 inch skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium high heat until hot. Sear vegetables in batches, turning frequently, until golden and tender, 10 to 12 minutes total. Transfer vegetables to paper towels and cover with foil. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to skillet and heat until hot. Sprinkle sweet peppers with flour and toss to coat. Remove peppers from skillet and reserve. In second skillet, heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat. Add eggplant and salt to taste. Cook, tossing frequently, until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer to paper towels to drain and cool slightly. In medium saucepan, heat preserves over low heat until almost melted. Stir in aprocot preserves. Heat about 1 minute, then stir in broccoli. Add vegetables and remaining vegetables to skillet and cook until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Serve as is or transfer to serving platter.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,pasta sauce,baby potato,tamari,cilantro stem,basmati rice
title: Crispy Fried Potatoes, Basmati Rice and Fresh Cilantro
ingredients: 6 baby potatoes ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup basmati rice | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 teaspoon whole anise seed | 8 -10 fresh fresh cilantro stems, plus fresh extra, for garnish | 1 jar prepared pasta sauce, such as vh
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil over high heat. Add the potatoes, reduce the heat, cover and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Meanwhile place tamari, cumin seeds, rice, and seasoning in 2 large resealable plastic bags. Shake the bags well to crush the spices. Transfer to a small saucepan and warm over high heat, stirring occasionally for 2 minutes, or until fragrant, about 1 minute. To serve, top with the potatoes and cilantro, and drizzle with warm sauce. Garnish with cilantro stems.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,pine nut,tomato ketchup,poblano chile,allspice,chili flake,plain flour,sherry wine
title: Prawns With Chili
ingredients: 300 450 g medium prawns or 450 g king prawns, raw | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 pinch chili flakes | 1 pinch allspice | 3 tablespoons chianti chili sauce or 3 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 teaspoon olive oil
instructions: Cut prawns or prawns into pieces roughly the same size as prawns and place in the bag of marinade. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Place the flour, chilli flakes, allspice and 2 tablespoons of the sauce in a dish and mix to combine. Place the remaining wine in a saucepan with the remaining sauce and the oil. Place over a high heat and bring to boil, stirring with a wooden spoon to break up any lumps. Add prawns and simmer covered, for 3 - 5 minutes or until cooked well. Serve prawns with chile sauce as a side. Serve with toasted pine nuts and a tossed green salad.

Random Ingredients: pear juice apple,taco seasoning mix,pineapple juice,active yeast,italian bread,mexican corn,lime
title: Pear and Sweet Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 cup sour orange juice or 1 cup apple juice | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 can mexican-style corn | 1 cup pear juice or 1 cup apple juice | 2 -3 cups sweet italian bread, dough | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple in juice
instructions: Scald orange juice. Transfer orange juice to a medium bowl, and add in the sour orange juice and yeast. Stir to blend. Place the corn, pear juice, bread flour and taco seasoning into a large mixer bowl, and with an electric mixer, mix on low speed for about 4 - 5 minutes. The dough will still have a luddish color in it. Pour in the orange juice mixture into the dough with a large spoon. Stir for about 3 - 5 minutes, or until smooth. Dump the pineapple into the dough, and knead until dough is nice and elastic. Put into a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled. Punch down the dough, divide in half, and shape each half into a loaf. Place the loaves on a parchment lined baking sheet, and rise until it is at least 1/3 inch thick. If the loaf is not quite large enough, take a small oven dish to hold it until it is at least 1/3 in depth. Set it aside. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bake in a preheated oven for 35 - 40 minutes, or until the tops are lightly browned and a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Eat while still hot.

Random Ingredients: alfredo sauce,cream cheese,red chili pepper,tomato sauce,chinese cabbage
title: Creamy Colcannon
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese ( softened ) | 1 can tomato sauce | 2 fresh red chili peppers, sliced or sliced into slivers ( optional ) | 2 cans chinese cabbage ( drained ) ( optional ) | 2 cans alfredo sauce
instructions: Put the cream cheese in a large mixing bowl. Add the tomato sauce, chinese cabbage, and hot red chiles. Mix well. Pour the alfredo sauce into a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. As soon as the mixture starts to bubble, turn the heat down to the lowest setting just to barely warm it. This might seem strange but it is the right consistency for pouring over the finished product. This is the only time i ever serve this on my plate. That's it.

title: Pea & Beef over Rice - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, lean | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 package yellow split peas | 1 tablespoon butter, melted
instructions: Cut chuck into 1/2 inch cubes & place in a 5 qt crock pot. Combine tomato sauce & split peas in a medium bowl. Pour over meat, & stir to combine. Cover & cook on low for 6 - 8 hrs, or high for 3 - 4 hrs. Stir to break up meat into smaller pieces. Serve over rice & enjoy.

title: Jalapeno Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 cup fresh jalapeno peppers ( thinly sliced ) | 1/3 cup peanut, chopped | 1 tablespoon apricot conserve
instructions: Pour the vegetable broth in a small saucepan on high heat. When the broth has come to a boil, stir in the jalapenos and stir. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes. When ready, stir in the peanut, apricot conserve, and salt and pepper to taste. Heat thoroughly over low heat, stirring often. Do not boil serve warm with crouton chips or as a side dish with other dishes like steamed vegetable and fresh vegetables such as celery.

title: South African Peach Soda
ingredients: 4 ripe peaches, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 2/3 cups chunky salsa | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 teaspoon cinnamon, to taste | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup melted shortening | 1 1/2 cups soda crackers
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the peaches, salsa, sugar, cinnamon, turmeric, and melted shortening. Spread the mixture into a round glass.

title: Italian Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1 can pasta pasta shells, cut into quarters | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, minced
instructions: Cook macaroni per package directions. Drain but reserve 1 cup of pasta water. Drain and rinse pasta in cold water for 2 minutes. Add parsley and drained pasta, tossing well. Transfer to a greased baking dish. Add reserved pasta water and toss again. Cover and bake at 400 for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beer,sponge cake,hard egg,rice vermicelli,vanilla yogurt,icing sugar
title: Icelandi Sponge Cake
ingredients: 200 g rice vermicelli | 4 ounces icing sugar | 2 tablespoons light beer | 1 container vanilla yogurt | 500 g sponge cake, sliced | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
instructions: Cook the rice vermicelli in plenty of boiling water for 2 minutes. Mix the icing sugar and the light beer to make a thick icing. Drain immediately, and spread each side of the vermicelli with this. Lay 1 tin of the spongecake in a horizontal circle, and place 1/2 the icing to cover the top. Spread the vanilla yogurt on top, then arrange the remaining sponge cake on top. Garnish with egg slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,sharp cheddar cheese,sage,dark brown sugar,hamburger,chili paste,basil,cayenne pepper
title: Mexican Style Spicy Stuffed Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon basil or 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon sage | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | salt, pepper to taste | 1/4 cup chili paste ( to taste )
