instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine brown sugar, herbs, salt, pepper, togather. Divide mixture into 4 portions and shape into 4 burgers. Seal in toasted hamburger bun. Cook on the preheated grill for approximately 5 minutes each side or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lemon balm leaf,gin,pork,greek seasoning,baking powder,saffron strand,dill,turmeric powder
title: Ladies' Kabobs - Authentic Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g ground pork or 500 g beef | 100 g fresh greek seasoning | 50 g fresh lemon balm leaves, chopped finely | 20 g fresh dill, chopped very finely | 20 g saffron strands or 20 g saffron ( optional ) | 20 g baking powder | 200 g fresh gin | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape meat into large patties. Coat in baking powder and fry in oil. Place on a paper towel and let sit for 5 minutes. Brush outside of kababs with oil. Cook under grill on high heat / medium high until desired crispiness. Serve hot.

title: Salsa and Marinade for Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup salsa ( prepared or your favorite prepared salsa ) | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Marinate up to 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,lemon pepper seasoning,blueberry,hot pepper,dark rum
title: Hot Red Lentils With Blueberry
ingredients: 1 cup red lentil | 1 fresh hot pepper, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning ( or seasoning of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 cup blueberries or 1/2 cup strawberries, coarsely chopped
instructions: Rinse the lentils well under running water and drain. Put everything except blueberries in a bowl and mix well with a spoon. Fold in the cranberries or strawberries. Let sit until ready to serve.

title: Steak Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 package rice wrappers | 2 cups enchilada sauce | 1 lb steak | 1 package feta
instructions: Soak the rice wrapper on a towel for 5 minutes. Roll the wrapper out on a lightly floured board. I make the rolls quite thin so i cut the wrappers at least 1/8 inch thick. Brush the tops with enchilada sauce and dip the center into water. Place a small piece of feta in the middle of the wrapper. Fold the opposite edges over the filling to seal. Place in a baking dish in a 400 degree oven. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes until the cheese has melted and are bubbly. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: walnut,cinnamon sugar,extra virgin olive oil,ketchup,beef eye,tomatillo
title: Molho En Recoiladas Veracruzos (Patties with Tomatillo Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb beef eye round | 2 medium ripe tomatillos ( with husk attached ) | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil ( or regular oil ) | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons cinnamon-sugar blend | 1/2 cup walnuts, lightly toasted, coarsely chopped, optional ( optional )
instructions: Remove the gread from the tomatillos, removing the husks. With your fingers, push away the thick, slightly cracked skin and seeds of the tomatillos through a slit in the tomatillo's top, making a 'well'. Put the tomatoes inside and between the skins into a blender and add the olive oil. Grind the mixture well and place in a bowl. Stir in the ketchup, cinnamon and sugar blend well. Drain the meat and cut in small round patties. Place them into shallow, buttered frying pan with the tomatillo sauce and pour about 1/2 cup of water on top. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking. Remove the lid and continue cooking until the meat is cooked through. Turn half way through. Serve hot with toasted walnut pieces.

title: Artichoke and Asparagus Tarts
ingredients: 1 cake flour | 2 cups warm water | 1 cup asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 10 canned water chestnuts, drained and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Sift the flour into a mixing bowl, and make a well in the center. Make a well in the center of flour. Add the water and mix until the mixture starts to form a dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface. Pinch off walnut sized pieces of dough and roll into balls slightly larger than the diameter of your cake flour balls. Cut into rounds and place on lightly oiled cookie sheets. Bake the tarts 5 to 7 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 medium to large mushrooms | 1 jalapeno pepper ( or other hot pepper ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves, crushed | 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Clean mushrooms and slice open. Chop pepper and crush it slightly with a mortar and pestle. Add to mushrooms along with thyme. Let simmer for about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with oregano before serving.

title: Broccoli Tomato and Apple Soup
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with bouillon | 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 1 lb fresh broccoli floret
instructions: Put all ingredients into slow cooker. Cover. Cook on low for 6 - 7 hours or on high for 3 - 4 hours, stirring every so often.

title: Pasta-Tomato Melt
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated buttermilk biscuits | 1 jar of your favorite spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: Separate dough into 10 biscuits, one with each side touching the underside and other side. Roll each biscuit until evenly covered with tomato, being sure to get all of the juice in the pan. Place all biscuits on a greased cookie sheet. Pour 1/4 cup pasta sauce evenly over the biscuits. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 8 minutes, then turn biscuit over and bake for 8 - 10 more minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with sun dried tomatoes. Enjoy.

title: Maurie's Herb Stuffing
ingredients: 750 g dried currants | 150 g dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c or 310°f bring all ingredients to the boil, stirring well. Once the turkey floats, reduce oven temperature to 180°c / 375°f leave the turkey to rest for 30 minutes before drying it out.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,kosher salt,cream tartar,tony chachere cajun seasoning
title: Cajun Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, trimmed | 1 tablespoon tony chachere's cajun seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Place brussels sprouts in a 3 to 4 quart pot of boiling water. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Transfer to a medium bowl and add water until it reaches the 2 inch mark on top of the sprouts. In a small bowl, combine the creole seasoning and cream of tartar. Stir into the brussels sprouts. Serve and enjoy.

title: Homemade Noodles With Yogurt
ingredients: 450 g fresh spaghetti ( preferably long starchy starchy pasta ) | 1 egg yolk | 300 g fresh yoghurt | salt
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente and then drain. Transfer to a large bowl and keep warm on a medium flame. Place egg yolk, yoghurt, salt and 2 cups of warm water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. When it begins to thicken, transfer to the bowl with the yoghurt. Stir well with a fork and pour over pasta. You might have to add a few drops of water at the time to get rid of any excess water. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,bread crumb,taco seasoning mix,half,cream chicken soup,chunky salsa,white flour,plain yogurt
title: Easy Creamy Mexican Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets ( or any size your family likes, i usually use 4 sheets ) | 1 can reduced fat cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1 cup plain fat-free greek yogurt ( i use low fat ) | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup unbleached white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bake pie crust according to package directions for 6 sheets on a lightly floured surface set aside. In a large bowl, mix the soups with a whisk. Combine the yogurt, half and half, salsa, taco seasoning, and bread crumbs and stir well. Add the bread crumbs and gently toss. Spoon equal amounts of the yogurt mixture onto each pastry sheet and form into 3 inch disks. Bake in oven for 12 - 15 minutes or until puffed and golden.

Random Ingredients: liverwurst,italian dressing,greek yogurt,poultry seasoning,tomato puree,pepper sauce,irish cream
title: Delicious Dogs
ingredients: 3 pounds liverswurst, sliced | 3 cups italian-style dressing, divided | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | tomato puree | 6 tablespoons irish cream, divided | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Place liverswurst in a large, deep skillet. Pour half the italian dressing over top. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer until the livers are tender, and falling off the bones, 50 to 60 minutes. Drain. Place a separate skillet over medium heat. Place remaining dressing in a separate small skillet, and mix in a pinch of poultry seasoning. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat, and pour over the livers in the skillet. Stir in the hot pepper sauce. Spread half the greek yogurt over top. Add the remaining livers and any remaining yogurt mixture over the yogurt. Season with salt and pepper. Repeat the layering process with another layer of yogurt and seasonings. Garnish with a teaspoon of old bay and cream.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,oregano leaf,pesto sauce,celery rib,green cardamom pod,cayenne pepper
title: Creamy Italian Soup
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, coarsely chopped | 7 3/4 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon instant pesto sauce | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: In large saucepan over medium high heat, combine celery, vegetable stock, pesto, cardamom pods, oregano and cayenne pepper. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Add soup heat up to high. Cover and cook 5 to 6 minutes or until soup has reduced to desired consistency. Remove from heat.

title: Coleslaw - Russian Style
ingredients: 16 whole hazelnuts | 2 lbs sugar snap peas | 1 cup pickling salt | 12 bags iceberg lettuce or 12 bags other greens
instructions: Make the nuts on the box grinder. Place nuts on a baking sheet and toast them in 500 degree f oven for 2 minutes, shaking bag constantly, until lightly toasted. Cool. Trim and seed the snap peas, then slice them in 1/4 inch slices and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt. In the same bowl, mix nuts with snap peas and pickling salt. Arrange dressing on salad plates and top with dressing. Serve right away.

title: Pineapple Spread
ingredients: 1 large ripe pineapple | 1 pint half & half | chopped parsley leaves
instructions: Peel the pineapple and cut it in 4 pieces. Using a hand held blender, puree the pineapple, peels and all, through a coarse grater into a smooth thick mixture approximately 8 cups. Using a large bowl, combine the pineapple mixture, and the half & half, making sure to beat well after adding about 3/4 cup or more of the mixture. Transfer the mixture to a crockpot and set it on low. Cook for 6 - 8 hours.. If the mixture gets too thick, add more half & half.

title: Tex Mex Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup half and half | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/2 cup grated mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon dried summer savory | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange peel
instructions: Combine the half and half, tequila, cheese, savory and orange peel in a medium bowl and mix well. Chill until serving time.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,vermouth,quinoa,tomato paste,poppy seed,tomato green chilies,mirin
title: Spanish Quinoa (No Cheese)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, rinsed well under running water | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated | 1/2 cup tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 teaspoons dry vermouth ( plus ) | 1 teaspoon mirin ( plus ) | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | poppy seed
instructions: Place quinoa and 2 cups of the water in the microwave and cook, stirring, on high power for 2 - 3 minutes, or until water is absorbed. Add cheeses, tomato, vermouth and mirin and set aside to cool slightly. Just before serving spread 1 teaspoon poppyseed on quinoa and spread evenly.

Random Ingredients: lipton secret onion soup mix,cilantro,sunflower oil,beef stew meat,coconut extract
title: Crock Pot Carne Guisado
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 3/4 teaspoons coconut extract ( i use an appropiate one ) | 2 packages lipton recipe secrets onion soup mix ( or any instant onion soup mix ) | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro
instructions: Toss the meat in 1/4 tsp of olive oil and place in crock pot. Mix together the second package of onion soup mix, coconut extract and sunflower oil. Pour this over the meat and stir gently. Cook for 6 hours on low, or high for 4 hours remove the meat and cilantro, discard the cilantro and serve over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Ricotta Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese ( whole type, low-fat or skim ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | chipotle powder ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes over low heat.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,pesto sauce,passion fruit,bok choy,soba noodle,italian,dark rum,white pepper
title: Soba
ingredients: 1 package soba noodles | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped bok choy | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped cucumbers | 1/2 cup thinly sliced white pepper ( for more flavor, adjust to your taste ) | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 1/2 fluid ounces italian-style dark rum | 1/4 cup diced dried passion fruit | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place soba noodles in a medium size pot, cover with cold water and set over heat. Bring to a boil, then drain then rinse under cold water. While noodles are still hot, add remaining ingredients, except for pepper, and stir to coat noodles with sauce. Serve over hot cooked soba noodles.

title: French Lentil Salad
ingredients: 180 g french lentils, washed ( see note ) | 1/2 of a shiitake mushroom caps | 1 tablespoon oatmeal | 2 teaspoons cumin
instructions: Soak the lentils in at least 10 c of water for at least 8 hours, and up to 4 hours. The longer it is left in, the more flavorful and tender it will be. After the 8 hours, rinse the lentils. They might sink to the bottom. Cook the lentils in 2 tbsp warm water for up to 30 mins, depending on how watery they are. You might need to add a little more water before they become tender. Note, the shiitake caps are small, tender ones, and should be washed thoroughly and trimmed. It may take up to 5 - 6 hours, depending on the level of doneness. If they look more wrinkly, use a knife and pick out the seeds and dirt. Rinse the lentils and soak in the same water and the mushrooms for at least 15 minutes. Shred and fold together with the vegetables. Taste for seasoning and sprinkle with cumin before serving. Note for vegetarians, use vegetable broth in place of vegetable broth. Use wheat germ in place of the wheat germ, and use the stock as stated in the description.

Random Ingredients: green onion,bow tie pasta,egg noodle,brown sugar,cornstarch,pumpkin pie spice,lime jell o gelatin,cranberry juice
title: Caribbean Egg Noodle Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces uncooked bow tie pasta or 7 ounces egg noodles, refrigerated until needed | 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 1 package lime jell-o gelatin | 3 eggs, slightly beaten | 2 green onions, chopped | 1/4 cup brown sugar ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 2/3 cup cranberry juice ( or strawberries or other fruit )
instructions: Cook noodles in salted water according to package directions. Drain. While noodles are cooking combine pumpkin pie spice with 1/2 the jello, and stir until no lumps are present or there are bubbles. Let cool. Drain noodles and add to pumpkin pie spice mixture along with remaining jello and eggs. Mix thoroughly and then cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour or until set. In a small saucepan combine sugar, cornstarch and cranberry juice, and heat through. Cool before using. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Nuked Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 lb basmati rice | 1 cup jalapeno, roasted and finely chopped
instructions: In a pan, roast the jalapenos and put them in a glass bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Cover the bowl with the roasting pan. Put on low heat until water boils at 50% on stove. Wait until the rice is just starting to steam before you add it. After 20 minutes, fluff up the rice with a fork, stir, add jalapenos, stir, leave on off heat for another 10 minutes.

title: Corn & Blueberry Stir-Fry
ingredients: 200 g fresh corn, cut into thin wedges | 100 g blueberries, washed ( or frozen blueberries ) | 100 ml picante sauce, medium heat ( try low heat ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon light molasses | 1 teaspoon chopped mango | 1 teaspoon cornstarch dissolved in half-ninf. water | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon lime zest ( small, minced )
instructions: In a bowl, mix corn, berries & picante sauce. Stir fry over moderate high heat for 5 minutes, or till corn is crisp tender. Remove from heat. In a small bowl, mix molasses, half ninf of the liquid from picante sauce & the sesame oil. Stir well, then set it aside as the garnish. Stir fry the mango & cornstarch mixture over moderate high heat for about 1 minute, till the mixture is slightly thickened. Sprinkle over the cooked veggies & toss. Add the turmeric & lime zest & serve immediately.

title: Timbales
ingredients: 300 g cabbage ( finely shredded ) | 2 tablespoons pimiento | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons light soya sauce | 1 1/2 cups champagne
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for 1 hour. Shape mixture into patties by rolling and dipping in cold champagne. Eat with lime sticks, celery sticks, or chopped green onions. Great served with chutneys, guacamole, or tomato sauce.

title: Homemade Lemon Pepper Rice
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups long-grain rice | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon pepper ( optional )
instructions: Mix well the lemon pepper and lemon pepper flakes. Boil the rice according to owner's instructions. Serve warm or cold, with desired amounts.

title: Couscous and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked couscous | 2 cups cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Prepare couscous per package directions. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Stir in couscous.

Random Ingredients: coca cola,tomato green chilies,red onion,soy sauce
title: Easy BBQ Chicken (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 large red onion, sliced | 1 cup coca-cola | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot except for chicken and onions. Cook on high 6 - 8 hours. I serve this over my pork chops and it tastes great but anything is fine.

title: Tarragon Salmon
ingredients: 2 fillets salmon | 1 pinch turbinado sugar | 1 pinch dried thyme sprig | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 1/2 ounces macaroni, prepared as per pkg directions
instructions: To steam the macaroni, fill a saucepan with water and bring to the boil. Once boiling, add the macaroni and cook until tender. Drain and stir the macaroni through the fish. Divide between two plates and sprinkle over the turbinado sugar, thyme and cayenne.

title: Rice Noodles With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon chili powder ( can use more or less )
instructions: In a large pot bring water to the boil. Meanwhile prepare the peanut sauce. Place all ingredients together in a small bowl. Toss. Set aside and pour the noodles into the wok or a wide mouthed bowl. When the noodles are done cooking drain the noodles and add them to the peanut sauce. Stir fry 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Sesame & Sesame Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 ounce cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Wash potatoes, cut in half, lengthwise, then cut each half to the same thickness with a sharp knife. Spray or brush tops with oil, and top each potato with sesame seeds. Place the potato on a greased baking sheet, top with cheese. Bake, uncovered, for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,taco sauce,pizza crust,strawberry jam apricot,mutton neck,lemon juice,beet,barbecue sauce
title: Crispy Neck Neck Barbecue
ingredients: 500 g mutton neck | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup tomato-based baked spread pizza crust | 1/4 cup thawed sliced beet ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder cardamom | plain crushed pizza crusts
instructions: Cut Neck under current suggestion to free off some of the bone. Use as required. Cut Neck with cleaver into 3inch thick pieces. Mix taco sauce with barbecue sauce. Place neck on a non stick dish and cover with the paste. Toss to coat on all sides. Place on middle shelf of 200c until just beginning to brown the meat. Remove from oven. Preheat oven to 200c. Spread the baked pizza base evenly with the beet slices, bbq sauce, and baked beef barbeque sauce mixture. Scatter crumpled crumbs of choice and serve. To serve use crushed pizza rolls on the open table. Arrange the meat and veggies on the rolls.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,italian dressing,turnip,blue cheese,soy sauce,red wine,sriracha sauce,chickpea flour
title: Smoky Farmhouse Country Ribs
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup sweet red hot pepper sauce | 3 lbs pork shoulder | 1/2 cup chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 2 lbs turnips, cut into chunks | 4 ounces blue cheese, 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Combine soy sauce, wine, hot pepper sauce and pork shoulder in a large sealable bag. Let marinate in refrigerator for 3 - 6 hours. Sausage, combine flour, sriracha sauce, turnips and blue cheese. Spray a broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray. Remove pork from marinade, pat dry and brown in oven on 400°f for 20 minutes. Remove pork from pan, add bread crumbs and bake in oven for 12 - 15 minutes, basting often.

title: Lamb & Garlic Crescents
ingredients: 2 lbs whole loin lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 package refrigerated crescent roll dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Cut each piece of lamb into 12 equal pieces. Place lamb, breadcrumbs, cornflour, dijon mustard, buttermilk, and half of the cajun seasoning in a large bowl. Form into crescents. Place crescents on a lightly oiled baking sheet.

title: Spicy Chili Sauce Mix for Fish or Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons shortening or 2 tablespoons coconut oil
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Add fish or chicken parts and marinade for at least 2 hours or over night. The longer it marinates, the more flavour the sauce will have. The leftovers of this fish or chicken can be eaten immediately as is or refrigerated to improve flavour.

title: Capers and Chickpea Dip
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour ( garbonzo harina ) | 2 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 jar capers, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix chickpea flour with capers. Place two sheets of filo pastry in a pan and cover with a second sheet of filo. Brush with a little water so that the pastry hangs over the sides and ends of the pans. Place the top sheet on top of the first with the capers to make a double layer. Brush the second top sheet with a little water. Sprinkle with a little more water so that the pastry covered the last sheet with 1/4 inch of caper. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the pastry is golden.

title: Tomato Based  (Ethiopian Spiced Bread)
ingredients: 8 slices white bread | 8 ounces ham ( can use any other vegetarian ham ) | 4 -8 ounces tahini ( can use more if desired ) | 4 -8 ounces romano cheese ( can use more if desired ) | 1 can tomato paste | 1 pint ginger ale
instructions: If the bread is toasted or toasted, you can add a little bit of dry breadcrumbs to the bread to toast it. Cut the ham down the middle of the slice, and then cut into small cubes. Place the cubes of ham on a plate or tray, so they don't touch each other, and then lightly mix with the bread and ham. Add the spices, and combine and eat.

title: Cherry Rangoon
ingredients: 120 g linguine | 1 butternut squash | 600 ml cream | 1/4 cup dried cherries | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 bag frozen raspberries
instructions: Roast linguine according to package directions. Slice squash lengthways and then into 1 cm rounds. Place cubed squash on baking tray and sprinkle with salt. Roast in the oven at 200°c, covered, for 40 minutes. Whisk cream, cherries and vanilla in a bowl. Pour cream mixture over squash and roast for a further 15 - 20 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Remove from oven and stir berries through.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,turmeric,wheat bread flour,green onion,cream tartar,salt pepper,egg,beef
title: Indian Cornbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole kernel corn, drained | 1 lb ground beef | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 pinch turmeric | 3 tablespoons whole wheat bread flour | 1 beaten egg | 1/4 teaspoon green onion ( minced or a small piece of onion )
instructions: Combine corn, ground beef, salt, pepper, tumeric, bread flour, egg, and onion in a large bowl. Mix well. Spoon into a lightly greased 8 inch square pan. Let cool for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or till done. Serve warm. Use your favorite filling recipe, crackers, bread of your choice.

Random Ingredients: halibut,cheddar cheese,navel orange,beef broth,cream cheese,salt,anise seed
title: Italian Halibut
ingredients: 2 lbs halibut | 1 package cream cheese | 1 navel orange, skinned and chopped | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 can beef broth, heated
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large baking dish, place halibut in a single layer. Layer ingredients in order listed below. Pour beef broth over halibut. Bake 5 minutes. Decrease oven temperature to 300 degrees. Continue to cook for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,breadcrumb,thai red curry paste,mace,lemon zest,monterey jack cheddar cheese,sherry,leaf thyme
title: Curried Pepper Crumb Topping
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh leaf thyme, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon fresh leaf thyme, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup crumbled monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs, toasted | 1/2 bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 lemon, zest of, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the dry thyme, thyme and mace in a small bowl. Toast the curry paste in a nonstick fry pan over low heat. Add the cheese and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the sherry and breadcrumbs. Spread on top of a large casserole dish that is lined with foil. Sprinkle the pepper and lemon zest in a decorative pattern over the casserole. Bake until topping is golden and bubbly, about 20 minutes. Note, it may be eaten hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: coriander,mango peach salsa,bamboo shoot,sun tomato oil,american cheese
title: Grilled Mojo Bango Salad
ingredients: 4 slices american cheese | 2 tablespoons mango peach salsa | 1 tablespoon chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/2 cup sliced bamboo shoot, drained | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander
instructions: Arrange cheese slices on hot grill or broiler rack. Grill or broil until golden on both sides. Cut cheese slices in half, and arrange on large platter. Spoon mango peach salsa over cheese and top with sun dried tomato and sliced bamboo shoots. Sprinkle with coriander. Serve immediately.

title: Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white sugar | 1 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1/2 cup white raisins, soaked in water 30 minutes, drained and rinsed | 1/2 can crushed pineapple with juice
instructions: Mix sugar, pineapple juice and raisins in blender. Cover and process until smooth, adding a little water if necessary. Refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: dill,nicoise olive,chili bean sauce,portuguese chourico,farfalle pasta
title: Portuguese Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound portuguese chourico, cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 1 can chili bean sauce | 1/2 cup chopped nicoise olives | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: Cook the bow tie pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, about 8 minutes.

title: Irish Boiled Pot
ingredients: 1 head meaty chuck | 1 cup fish stock | rosemary, chopped ( to taste ) | freshly grated parmesan cheese ( to taste )
instructions: Place chuck on the stove in a large pot or dutch oven with enough water to cover and simmer, covered, overnight. When meat is tender, remove the meat from the pot and reserve. Remove the pot, reserving the broth. Strain broth and place in a pot large enough to fit the meat on top of the skin, adding 1/2 cups more broth if broth is not enough. Bring to a simmer, cover and simmer about 1 hour on low. Slice meat across the grain and serve with sauteed onions and a drizzle of the remaining broth. Sprinkle with fresh rosemary and fresh grated parmesan to serve.

title: Jim T. H. Rocker's Flaming Tilapia and Cloves
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely ground black peppercorns or 1/2 cup coarsely ground black peppercorns | 6 whole cloves
instructions: Grind the black peppercorns with about 1/2 teaspoon of the ground cloves or a spice mill. Spread the peppercorns, powder, and clove nuts in the palm ofyour hand. Lightly coat a large frying pan with cooking oil. Arrange 3 to 4 fillets in each pan and set over a medium high heat. When the fish is lightly golden on one side but without moving or turning, turn and cook until lightly brown on the other side. About 1 minute. Lift out and transfer to a warm serving bowl or plate. Pipe hot, hot cooking oil around each fish fillet.

title: Stir-Fried Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage or 1 teaspoon dried rubbed sage | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 cup tomato juice | 1/4 cup chopped bell pepper ( i use red bell pepper )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 hours.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,rice,black peppercorn,chicken broth,garlic powder,pomegranate
title: Pomegranate and Black Pepper Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 4 cloves garlic powder | 1 large onion, chopped | 1 cup uncooked rice | 2 cups chicken broth | 1/4 teaspoon pomegranate
instructions: Place the peppercorns into a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until they crackle. Remove the peppercorns and allow to cool. Mix in the onion soup mix and the garlic powder. Poke the holes in the rice with a fork or knife. Add the rice and the broth to the skillet. Over high heat, bring the mixture to a boil. Cover and reduce liquid to very low. Cook for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring frequently, or until rice is tender and all of the liquid is absorbed. If necessary, add more liquid. Serve topped with pomegranate seeds and finely chopped fresh parsley.

title: Orange Chilli Fried Onions
ingredients: 4 ounces panir | 8 tablespoons white fish sauce or 8 tablespoons oyster sauce | oil or light olive oil, for deep frying | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade | 3 -4 teaspoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Heat oil or light olive oil in wok over high heat. Coat the chopped onion in the flour and fry, stirring, until golden, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,yellow onion,chicken meat,neufchatel cheese,tomatillo green tomato,horseradish,shrimp
title: Mexican Shrimp and Chicken Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, large shelled and deveined | 12 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded, and cut into wedges | 6 ounces neufchatel cheese, softened | 1/4 cup yellow onion, chopped | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 2 cups boneless skinless chicken meat, cooked, cubed | 1 ounce prepared horseradish, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Arrange shrimp in single layer in 10x15 inch baking dish. Top with tomatoes and onion. Combine chilies, cheese, and onion in processor.

title: Baileys Chocolate Cocktail
ingredients: 80 ml baileys irish cream | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup dry wine
instructions: Pour baileys into a shaker, shake for 2 to 3 seconds or until dissolved.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,red food coloring,italian turkey sausage link,yellow onion,corn chip,orange peel
title: American Turkey Sausage (Or Turkey) and N Chips
ingredients: 12 ounces sweet italian turkey sausage links | 2 cans tomato puree ( muir glen brand, one 28 ounce can ) | 5 tablespoons yellow onions, minced ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: If not using the link sausage in a package, omit the food coloring step and substitute with either green or yellow instead. In a frying pan, saute the turkey and onions until cooked through and browned, approximately 8 minutes per side. While this is cooking, mix the tomato puree, orange peel, food coloring and enough water to make a thick paste. When the sausage is done cooking, drain the grease and return the sausage liquid to the pan, mixing thoroughly. Cover and simmer, stirring often, for about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from heat and serve with tortilla chips, crackers, crackers, or whole wheat crackers for dipping.

title: The Best Hot Italian Celery Soup
ingredients: 5 large stalks celery | 1 quart chicken stock
instructions: Slice the stalks into 2 lengths each, the total length of 2 stalks. Wash the celery and cut off the hard ends of the stalks. Rinse the leaves and the ends well. In a large saucepan bring the chicken stock to a boil and add the celery. Cover and simmer over medium low heat until tender. Uncover the pot and cook for an additional 20 - 30 minutes. Check on the celery stalks and the celery after 10 minutes to make sure they are soft. You may want to skim off some of the liquid or stock before adding salt and/or fresh ground pepper.

title: Spiced Raspberry
ingredients: 2 cups raspberries, hulled | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine the raspberries and cardamom in an old fashioned glass or ceramic bowl. Fill the glass with ice, and then add the raspberries. Cover and shake the bowl to coat.

title: Jelly Creatures
ingredients: 18 ounces raspberry gelatin powder | red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Pour the raspberry gelatin into a pan of boiling water and mix it with the chili until the gel is dissolved. The jelly should have a runny consistency. Add the chopped chilli. Use the gelatin to line 6 moulds, depending on the size & thickness of the moulds. Place in a cold oven. After 40 minutes, remove from the oven and allow them to set before adding any decorations or fruit. Let set at room temperature. Variation,. Use 1 packet of raspberry gelatin powder.

title: Dried Cherry Tomatoes and Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh mixed beans ( or frozen ) | 1 egg yolk | 7 ounces canned italian tomatoes | 1/2 pint bing cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon chopped mint, to garnish
instructions: Drain the tomatoes and beans. In a bowl, beat the yolk and tomato mixture, add the beans, cherries and mint. Mix well and chill. Before serving, garnish with mint leaves.

title: Simple Onion & Garlic Noodles
ingredients: 150 g plain flour | 12 sheets lasagna noodles | 500 g brown onions, sliced | 1/2 cup brown onion gravy or 1/2 cup rosé sauce
instructions: Cook noodles as per directions. Meanwhile grill onions over low to medium heat until slightly caramelished and golden. Remove onions from grill with tongs and combine with flour. Drain noodles well and spread on a large plate. Spread some garlic and onions over noodles. Spread with gravy. Bake at c for about 20 minutes.

title: Italian Panzanella
ingredients: 1/3 cup fresh strawberries, sliced in half, and quartered ( optional ) | 4 cups torn romaine lettuce, about 4 cups | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb ( optional ) | 1 loaf italian bread, cut horizontally into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Arrange the sliced strawberries in the center of 4 dinner plates. Drizzle each with the desired amount of italian herb and/or italian seasonings. Scatter the torn romaine over the top of the fruit and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,corn tortilla,egg noodle,canadian bacon,mushroom,greek yogurt
title: Dynamite Vegetarian Breakfast
ingredients: 2 packages egg noodles | 2 slices canadian bacon, strips | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 10 ounces sliced mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 carton greek yogurt ( optional ) | 1 cup corn tortilla, torn ( optional )
instructions: Cook and drain egg noodles.

title: Shrimp Cashew Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/4 lb medium shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1/4 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 2 tablespoons cashews ( unsalted, coarsely chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: In a 12 inch skillet, heat oil over high heat, add shrimp and sprinkle with cumin. Stir fry for 1 minute. Add mushrooms, cashews and shrimp, stir fry for 1 minute. Drain shrimp, serve.

title: Easy and Delicious Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 6 -7 lasagna noodles, cooked | 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/2 - 1 cup white flour | 1/2 - 1 cup guacamole ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Spread a very thin layer of white flour on a baking sheet. Cover a second sheet of parchment paper with another thin layer of flour. Place a third sheet of parchment covered parchment paper across the middle of the table. With a rolling pin, roll noodles as thin as you can. You want them about 1/2 thick. Place these sheets in a pile on the baking sheet, not overlapping. Spray the second sheet with oil. Keep sprinkling the flour on the baking sheets, so that each layer of noodles gets coated with flour and sticks to each other. Keep doing this for at least one sheet, checking every minute or so. The edges of the sheets should be a nice light golden. Once the noodles are all coated, add a bit of oil to the pan, and quickly add some chopped or chopped or whatever toppings you like. Shake pan back and forth with spatula as the noodles cook on the bottom, so that the noodles won't stick. Spread a few drops of your guacamole across the top to make a nice, flat layer. If you have some more filling for a main dish, just spoon it in and spread with the spatula. Place the first layer of noodles on top and then top with the second one. You want to seal them tightly. If they are close but not close, put on a plate and keep on the side. If you do, sprinkle more flour on the outside. Bake until bubbly and golden brown, about 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Cheesy Coleslaw
ingredients: 3/4 lb coleslaw mix | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: In a bowl, mix together, the coleslaw mix, cottage cheese and mustard. Gradually stir in the flour. Chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Cheryl's Famous Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 10 -12 chicken drumsticks, in the skin, or more, depending on size | 1 cup cilantro, and more if you want more spice | 1/2 cup parsley flakes, or more, if desired ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon clove
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a shallow baking dish with nonstick spray. Place chicken legs into dish and sprinkle evenly with cilantro, parsley, and cloves. Bake in preheated oven for about 75 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Fennel Seed-Radish Tea Ring Braid
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons gelatin ( i use 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Pound fennel seed and ginger in mortar or spice grinder until coarsely grind. Place ground fennel seeds in a large bowl and add dried jello. Stir. Let it rest. Stir in bread crumbs. Use your hands or a pastry bag. The mixture will soften very easily. Wrap well. Refrigerate for 2 - 4 days, refrigerated.

title: Creamy Pineapple Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 500 ml sour cream | 1 pineapple ( small ) | ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Slice the pineapple in half horizontally. Remove the core from the wedge of pineapple and reserve the juice. Wash and drain the pineapple slices. Using a sharp knife, slice a 'jelly roll shape' onto the underside of each slice of pineapple so that it fits neatly over the 'jelly roll'. Carefully add the sour cream to the juice in a small non reactive pan over a med flame and cook, constantly stirring the sour cream, until it begins to thicken. Add a pinch of ginger past a spoonful of water per the point of a spoon and continue to stir until the sauce is thickened. The ginger will dissolve into it a little at a time. It's ok to get it thick, but do not allow to boil, so that it gets absorbed by the sour cream.

title: Cauliflower Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package mostaccioli noodles | 1 package pepper jelly | 1 package cauliflower florets
instructions: Cook mostaccioli in a large pot of boiling water until tender but firm. Drain well. Reserve 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Return to pot and boil rapidly for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish, spread the spaghetti and peppers jelly and top with remaining noodles. Spoon vegetables and reserved cooking liquid evenly over the top. Cover and bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: log goat cheese,vermouth,hamburger,anaheim chilies,palm sugar,swiss cheese
title: Goat Cheese and Ham Appetizer(ATK) - Goetta Style
ingredients: 1 log goat cheese, cut in 1 cm slices | 1 slice swiss cheese, cut in 1 cm slices ( or similarly shredded farmer's cheese ) | 1/2 medium anaheim chilies ( optional ) or 1/2 medium green chili, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sweet vermouth or 2 tablespoons dry white wine | 2 teaspoons palm sugar or 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 4 slices log goat cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Combine goat cheese, swiss cheese, and anaheim or green chili in a small mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,mango chutney,italian seasoning,corn syrup,rotel tomato
title: Quick Microwave Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 can rotel tomatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Place brisket onto microwavable dish. Heat on high for 1 minute. Let rest for 10 minutes. Remove meat and slice across grain making 1/2 inch slices. Heat remaining mixture in microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes or until desired consistancy. Serve with noodles and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,pecorino romano cheese,marjoram,red lentil
title: Lentils with Sirloin
ingredients: 8 ounces red lentils, picked over, rinsed, drained | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 5 sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat | 1 cup freshly grated pecorino-romano cheese
instructions: Place lentils, marjoram and roast in a large saucepan of boiling water. Simmer, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes. Drain the lentils and transfer to a large bowl. Add the pecorino and toss to coat. Adjust seasonings and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,ice water,onion salt,lasagna noodle,hard egg,corn syrup,red bell pepper,sun tomato
title: Italian Sausage Lasagna
ingredients: 2 -3 large hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 2 1/2 cups ice water | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 -2 large red bell pepper, finely chopped | 16 ounces lasagna noodles, no boil | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes ( optional )
instructions: Chop eggs coarsely, reserve for later use. Finely chop onion salt and chicken bouillon. In large non stick skillet set over medium high heat place eggs. Cook and gently beat eggs until they are just set. Drain egg mixture, pour cooled egg mixture into skillet and bring to boil. Add corn syrup, red pepper and stir until incorporated. Remove from heat and stir in cooked egg mixture until well mixed and evenly distributed. Place 1 tsp of sausages lengthwise through the feed tube of a noodle tube onto heated non stick skillet. Place the noodle side by side in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the sausage and egg mixture and spread evenly. Cook uncovered at 350 for 45 minutes. Do not overcook. Remove and sprinkle with tomato slices to serve.

title: Spicy Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, undrained | 1 can sliced water chestnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish. Cover and bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the beans are heated through and the water has been covering the bottom of the casserole for the first 15 minutes of baking.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,green olive,thai basil,cayenne pepper,matzo cake meal,taco seasoning
title: Karen's Famous Taco Matzah
ingredients: 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup matzo cake meal | 2/3 cup chopped green olives | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped | 1 bunch thai basil, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Mix taco seasoning and cayenne pepper together. Place the matzo cake meal and olives in a large casserole dish. Toss with the taco seasoning mixture. Spread onto the top of the casserole. Sprinkle the green olives over. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned. Spread basil over the top.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,coriander powder,cauliflower floret,pasta,red pepper,cardamom seed,habanero pepper
title: Indian "Fried" Cauliflower Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 3/4 lb stir fry beef tri tip steak ( steak, cut into 1/4-inch strips ) | 2 1/4 cups cauliflower florets, coarsely chopped | 1 medium red pepper, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch strips and julienned | 1 jalapenos or 1 habanero pepper, seeded and minced | 2 teaspoons coriander powder, divided | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 3/4 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 cup hot cooked pasta ( such as rotelle ) or 1 cup roti pasta, of your choice cooked
instructions: Prepare all the vegetables and set aside. Season beef with salt and pepper. Add beef to skillet and stir fry over high heat until browned, about 2 minutes.

title: Mandarin Hoagie Chicken
ingredients: 6 hoagie rolls | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cubes | 12 mandarin oranges
instructions: Prepare chicken bouillon cubes as directed on package. Slice open mandarins lengthwise, removing cores and white pulp. Remove seeds as per instructions on package. Remove white flesh from the oranges. Place about 1 teaspoon of orange flesh into each roll. Slice diagonally, and serve. Note, if you prefer a crispy chicken, cut pieces into serving pieces before eating the rolls. These can be frozen in an airtight container for up to 6 months.

title: White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb white beans, washed, dried and rinsed | 1 leek, whole | 1 1/2 cups cannellini beans, drained
instructions: Wash the green and tough part of the leek very thoroughly. Cut about 2 inches off the ends. Cut in half the long side. Trim the white and green parts of the leek, removing the dark green bits from the surface just before the beards. Cut out the very dark green part in the center of each piece. Place them in a pan of boiling water and cook for 3 minutes or until the white beans are nearly cooked. Drain well and set aside.. Drain and combine all the ingredients except the cannellini beans in a pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 40 minutes. Lift out the leeks once they are soft, and cool them completely in the soup. Cover and reserve. Mash the bean puree in a food mill or use an electric food blender for a puree consistency. Return to the soup and reheat. If too warm to handle, add a little water.

title: Cauliflower Pecans
ingredients: 200 g cauliflower florets | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs, chopped | 1 teaspoon mixed cinnamon | 1 pinch green cardamoms | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a saucepan, and sprinkle with mixed herbs, cinnamon, cardamom and pecans. Cover and cook over low heat until the cauliflower starts to soften, for 10 minutes. Season with salt to taste.

title: Polish Haluska (Spicy Bacon Sauce)
ingredients: 7 ounces bacon, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 large onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place bacon in a 10 inch skillet. Cook over medium high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Add onion.

title: Edamame Fish and Cranachill
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, diced ( about 1lb. ) | 1 cup edamame, shelled ( or green beans ) | 1 can salmon, drained and flaked | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 cup broccoli, chopped small | 1 jar rosamtebroth in natural marinade ( including marinade ) | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly grease a 9x12 baking dish or a 6 ounce casserole dish. In a bowl lightly toss the potato, edamame, salmon and worcestershire sauce until evenly coated. Spread the potatoes into the prepared pan. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are just tender. Meanwhile, in a large saute pan over medium heat, place broccoli, artichoke hearts and marinade. Simmer until heated through, about 5 minutes. Serve the fish on top of the vegetables and spoon the broccoli mixture over the fish. Serve immediately.

title: Mixed Rice With Butternut Squash and Red Beet in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 2 cups cooked basmati rice ( or other long grain rice such as jasmine or long grain rice ) | 1/2 small butternut squash, peeled and cut into cubes | 1/2 cup raw unsweetened soymilk | 20 g fresh lemongrass or 5 cm piece fresh lemongrass | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | fresh basil with fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: Prepare and wash the rice and allow them cool. Soak the squash for about 30 minutes in the soy milk until it is very soft. Squeeze the flesh again to get out the excess moisture. If you like a chunkier dish you can peel off the peel now. Grate it on the coarse side of a grater/chopper mill into the coconut milk mixture. Heat a pan and add a tablespoon of coconut flavored oil. Add the diced squash, fresh lemongrass or the grated lemon zest, fresh coconut extract and cook in the pan, stirring occasionally, until it is cooked, and squash is soft, around 20 minutes. Once the rice is cooked, remove the pan from the heat and let it sit until cools a little. Serve warm or let cool completely and serve chilled. I usually let people top their rice by placing rice in bowls, then putting all of the other ingredients in a small bowl and then garnishing with fresh basil leaves, if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,egg,soy sauce,tabasco sauce,cucumber,taco seasoning mix,spinach,baking potato
title: Spinach and Tater Tot #5FIX
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 egg | 1 1/2 cups shredded low-fat tri-colored cheese-and-herb blend ( such as sargento ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2/3 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat the inside of a 9 by 13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Combine potatoes, spinach and egg in a large bowl and mix to combine. Remove 1 1/2 cups spinach mixture and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix taco seasoning with soy sauce, vinegar, and tabasco. Pour into pan and combine with potato mixture. Top with remaining spinach mixture. Bake in medium oven for 30 minutes, or until center is no longer doughy and center is lightly browned. Enjoy.

title: Roast Beef With Garlic
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs roast | garlic clove, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f place roast in roaster that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. With tweezers, poke holes on roast. Rub crushed garlic onto roast. Bake for at 475°f for about 40 minutes to an hour, or longer until desired degree of doneness. Serve at once.

title: Whole Wheat Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 pound butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Combine the flour and butter in a large bowl. Stir until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add the reserved bread ingredients and mix until they form into ball shapes.

title: The Best Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle taco sauce ( hot! ) | chili sauce or salsa, to taste- ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the hot taco sauce with 1/2 cup of water. Stir and add a little of the water if it's not enough, but the more water the stronger. Serve over crushed coarsley, tortilla chips or your favorite mexican meal.

title: Chicken and Barley Risotto
ingredients: 6 ounces pearl barley | 6 ounces chicken breast fillets, skinless & boneless, chopped | 4 3/4 cups raw rice, cooked
instructions: Pour 1 - 2 tablespoons water into large saucepan & cover with lid. Leave to simmer over a low heat. When the steam rises from the lid, stir in the barley & cook for about 12 minutes or until tender. Add chicken & cook for 2 - 3 minutes longer or until just cooked through, stirring frequently, stirring in the rice. Season with salt & pepper if needed.

title: Tofu (Fideo) Nachos
ingredients: 6 slices tofu, about 1/2 inch thick, but still firm | tortilla chips
instructions: Dry the tofu with a paper towel to remove excess moisture. Heat a small nonstick skillet over high heat for 45 seconds. Place a single piece of tofu at the edge of each tortilla in a thin layer. Spread about 2 tablespoons of chips near one end of the tofu. Roll up, using additional tortilla chips, if necessary. Heat a nonstick cooking pan over medium heat with 2 tablespoon nonstick olive oil. Add the bundles to the pan and press with a spatula to flatten slightly. Cook until the tortillas are browned on the bottom, about 1 minute. Turn bundles over and cook until the tortillas are browned on the other side, about 1 minute more. Transfer bundles to a serving platter. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,baby spinach,shiitake mushroom,egg yolk,horseradish,orange,self raising flour
title: Green Fritters With Shiitake Mushrooms and Horseradish Mayonnaise
ingredients: 12 ounces baby spinach | 1/4 cup horseradish ( optional ) | 2 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon orange rind | 7 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 3/4 cup queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Place halved spinach leaves on a board and weight down with some paper towel to remove excess moisture. Allow to drain for 10 minutes until dry. Remove any excess water. Place the horseradish, egg yolks, flour, onion and orange rind in a bowl and whip until pale and creamy. Gently stir in the shiitaki mushrooms with just enough water to leave a creamy paste, to taste if necessary. Stir the mixture into the spinach and set aside. Using two teaspoons, make four 1cm circles on the paper towel. Place 3 teaspoons of the houseradish mixture in the centre of each circle. Add about 2 teaspoons of the spinach mixture to each circle. Fold the two sides to the centre, then fold over the sides. Seal with a little more water. Place the fritters on a large plate or tray and cover with cling film or foil. Bake at c for 5 minutes or until heated through. Serve warm, with a dollop of horseradish mayonnaise.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,part mozzarella cheese,beef broth,white sugar,squid,chicken breast half
title: Chicken and Calamari Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 package frozen cooked squid, thawed and sliced | 2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breast in a large saucepan, and pour in beef broth. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer the chicken until no longer pink, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove chicken, and set aside to cool. Transfer chicken to a large bowl, and reserve broth. Shred the chicken meat, and return it to the saucepan. Stir in the irish cream, sugar, and squid. Mix in half of the grated mozzarella cheese. Transfer to a 13x9 inch baking dish, and top with remaining cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and top is bubbly, 45 to 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,gruyere cheese,white wine vinegar,lipton onion soup mix,range egg,bacon,black peppercorn
title: Guinness and Onion Poached Eggs
ingredients: 16 large free-range eggs | 4 slices bacon, chopped into small pieces | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 12 small kaffir lime leaves, torn | 10 black peppercorns | 1 package lipton onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Place the eggs on half of a large foamy frying pan and broil until puffed up and lightly coloured on the top and just cooked inside. Meanwhile, in a large frying pan, cook the bacon until crisp, remove with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper. In the same pan add the onions and fry for a few minutes or until just beginning to brown. Push the onions to one side of the pan and add the bacon. Crush the lemongrass by crushing with your fist. Add the crushed garlic, chopped kaffir lime leaves and black peppercorns to the pan and fry for 3 minutes or until aromatic. Stir the onion/cheese mixture into the pan and cook briefly to soften the mixture. Stir in the soup mix and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir through the remaining vinegar and allow to cool slightly. Serve warm or at room temp with croutons.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Whole Wheat Curry
ingredients: 12 ounces steel cut oats | 8 fluid ounces sour cream | 8 fluid ounces half-and-half | 2 tablespoons chipotle peppers | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: In a deep pan, layer the steel cut oats and sour cream with the half and half. Add the other seasonings. Use the curry paste for extra flavor or just to dust on top. Serve hot.

title: Chilled Round Steak With Smoked Kale and Smoked Kale
ingredients: 1/2 cup kale ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup smoky portobello mushroom ( smoked ) | 1/2 lb round steak ( trimmed of rib ) | 2 tablespoons beef base | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons champagne vinegar
instructions: Start by cutting the steak into about six equal pieces. Combine beef base and sage and rub a little over both sides of each piece, allowing some flavor to pool inside. Place the kale into your steaming bucket or a large ziploc bag, pour in your beef base or mushroom soaking liquid.. Lay a piece of the steak on top of the marinade. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to cook, remove the steak from the marinade. Heat your grill pan, then place the steaks on the grill top side up. Turn the steaks until the outside becomes a little crusty on the top and the meat is cooked to your liking. About 12 to 14 minutes before the meat is done add your smoked kale. This can take any other side items, it just isn't necessary to tell you how thick the piece is. Serve over a bed of hot greens such as arugula or asparagus. This could also be served on the side with sauteed fresh tomatoes or peppers.

title: Kleftiko (Fried Oysters)
ingredients: 12 large fresh light tasting oysters | 1/2 cup tzatziki | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Rinse the oysters under cold water. Remove the beaks in their liquor by pressing the cap of a sharp knife through the inside of the cap. With a sharp knife, cut a hole lengthwise into top shell of each oyster, making sure it is deep enough so the oysters can stand upright without falling off the cap. Fill a large pan halfway full of water and bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately remove from the heat. Pour hot tap water over the oysters to cover, and let stand for 5 minutes. Drain well, then place the oysters on a large dish, and pour the tzatziki over the top. Squeeze the cap out of the oysters, and sprinkle with cinnamon. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,garam masala,mushroom cap,mint leaf,walnut,lime wedge
title: Mushroom Raita(Food Network Star of India)
ingredients: 16 canned mushroom caps, with juice | 2 tablespoons unsalted walnuts | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock or 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 6 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Drain the mushrooms caps and reserve liquid. Chop the mushroom caps and put into a mixing bowl. Add the walnuts and stir until they are lightly toasted and chopped, or make sure they are coarsely chopped. Add the rest of the ingredients to the bowl with the mushrooms, walnuts, stock and reserved mushroom liquid. Mix thoroughly. Add more of the reserved liquid, if necessary. Season as per your choice.

title: Italian Sliced Onions
ingredients: 1 jar mild italian dressing | 1 can spanish-style onions ( with or without bell peppers )
instructions: In a large, deep bowl, mix 1 jar of each ingredient together. Shake or stir to combine. Place the onions in the dressing and toss until evenly coated.

Random Ingredients: fava bean,chow mein noodle,cranberry,ice water,spaghetti,black eyed pea,white onion
title: Chinese Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cups ice water | 1 cup dried black-eyed peas | 1 cup dried fava beans, soaked in water overnight | 1/2 cup dry chow mein noodles | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 small white onion, chopped | 10 ounces spaghetti, broken into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Place the dried peas in a soup pot with 1 cup water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Boil for 5 minutes. Strain and discard the seeds and membranes. Return liquid to the pot and add the black eyed peas, fava beans, chow mein noodles, cranberries and onion.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,green onion,cannellini bean,coriander,taco seasoning,onion,ramen noodle
title: Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 packages taco seasoning | 2 onions, chopped | 2 green onions, sliced | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 package ramen noodles | 3 cups arborio rice, uncooked | 1 bunch fresh coriander, stemmed and chopped
instructions: Place taco seasoning in the slow cooker. Top with onions, green onions, beans, and noodles. Place the seasoning packet on top of the contents. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Tarragon Applesauce
ingredients: 2 apples | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon cooking oil
instructions: Wash apples thoroughly. Cut apple in chunks. Place apple chunks in a bowl and sprinkle with water to cover. Let stand at least 15 minutes. Drain. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add applesauce and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,jalapeno pepper,mozzarella cheese,kaffir lime leaf,golden syrup,granny smith apple
title: Pumpkin and Apple Pie Appetizer
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped fine | 1 -2 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 large granny smith apples, peeled, cored, sliced thinly ( about 1.5 lbs. ) | 3 tablespoons pure maple syrup ( or to taste ) | 2 -4 kaffir lime leaves, finely minced | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ( about a 5 oz. block or two smaller slabs )
instructions: In a food processor, combine the jalapenos with golden syrup and puree until smooth. Fold in apples and maple syrup. Transfer filling to a shallow casserole dish, spreading it lightly, about 1/3. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 3 days. When ready to serve, sprinkle with minced kaffir lime leaves. Serve with a green salad, such as greens, corn or red cabbage mixed with spallions. The amount of filling depends on the size of the fruit. Note, the traditional filling is pumpkin purée or pure potato masala filling. Note, the traditional filling is pumpkin purée. Note, the traditional filling keeps well, covered and refrigerated, for up to 1 week.

title: Puerto Rican Cilantro Salsa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon unsweetened dried epazote | 2 tablespoons coconut oil
instructions: In a bowl combine the broth, salsa, lemon wedge, and epazote. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with the optional toppings such as pico de gallo or frijoles duros.

title: Alfredo Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Heat up the alfredo sauce and pour into a bowl. Add the coconut milk and stir. Serve over your favorite pasta.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,italian sausage link,dill weed,anise seed,cider vinegar,beef roast,simple syrup,beef chuck
title: Italian Sausage in a Bucket - Crock Pot
ingredients: 5 - 7 lbs lean beef chuck or 5 -7 lbs pork butt | 2 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage links | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons dried dill weed | 2 1/2 tablespoons anise seeds | 3 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the crock pot on high for 4 hours. After 4 hours remove sausage meat and slice into 1 inch slices. Place sliced pieces back and allow to rest under cold running water to help cool slightly. If you're using large pieces of meat, you will need to place in the slow cooker and let them warm up to 5 hours. When finished, place them into a large bowl with the syrup, vinegar, dill, and anise seed. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir to combine. Place meat back into the crock pot and cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours on high. Note, do not remove meat but transfer into an oven safe dish. Cover loosely and refrigerate overnight. After 3 hours, remove meat from the oven and place on a serving platter. Serve on heated hoagie rolls with crackers, french bread slices or toasted bread triangles.

title: Salmon With Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet, skinned, butterflied | 1 1/2 cups oatmeal ( i use nutmeg oats ) | 1/2 cup carrot, grated | 1 scallion, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c, 450°f. Lay salmon on baking tray, and place in oven for 8 - 10 mins, depending on thickness etc, depending on thickness of fillet. Baste with oatmeal. While this is happening, heat a pan with a little oil, and brown the carrot and scallion, then put onto a plate. When salmon is ready, remove and serve with the oatmeal. Enjoy.

title: Zesty Grated Caramelized Oranges
ingredients: 1 lb orange zest, cut into 1-inch-wide strips | 1 lb parmigiano-reggiano cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line a parchment paper covered baking sheet with aluminum foil, shiny side up. Cut off the bottom of the orange peel with a mandoline. Cut the orange peel crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips and place them 1/2 inch apart on the lined baking sheet. Brush with a little of the orange juice from the orange zest strips. Sprinkle with half of the cheese. Top with half of the ortanest strips, then sprinkle with remaining cheese. Repeat with the remaining orange peel and the remaining orange zest strips. Bake until the ortanés are a rich, mahogany color and firm, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder roast,hot paprika,vanilla bean,rice wine
title: Tourtiere de Lapin (Pork and Rice Smoked Paprika Stew)
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder roast | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: The day before cooking, place pork shoulder on a rack of aluminum foil in a roasting pan. Strip off any strings that float around the roast. Pour 1/4 cup rice wine into the cavity of the roast, and place the rack of foil on top of the roast. Wrap with aluminum foil, and place in the center of a 375 degree f oven. Bake in the preheated oven until the temperature registers 160 degrees f, about 1 hour. When the meat reaches 175 degrees f on a meat thermometer, remove the roast from the oven, and place in a baking dish. Strain any accumulated juices from the pan into a measuring cup using a sieve or measuring cup. Measure 1/4 cup cold water into a small saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat. When it comes to a boil, pour into a small bowl. Reserve 1/4 cup of the liquid, and place 1/4 cup of reserved liquid into the saucepan. Place over medium low heat, and cook until reduced to 1 1/4 cups, about 20 minutes. Strain liquid through a tea strainer into the measuring cup, and set the remaining liquid aside. Remove and discard vanilla bean from the juice, and place vanilla bean in the juice. Stir the reserved 1/4 cup liquid into the saucepan with the saucepan juices, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes. Remove the pork roast from the oven, and transfer it to a large bowl. Stir in the reserved 1/4 cup of rice wine. Cover, and refrigerate the meat for about 4 hours, or until it is very tender. Place the pan over medium high heat, and cook until the liquid is reduced by half, about 5 more minutes. Scoop the meat out onto a platter, and let cool until it is warm to the touch. Shred pork, and serve with stew.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,red pepper,tahini paste,cilantro leaf,yellow onion
title: Roasted Onions With Tahini (Spicy Tahini)
ingredients: 16 large yellow onions, peeled | 1 jar roasted red peppers | 1/3 cup extra crunchy tahini paste | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Put whole onions on a rack in a roasting pan. Mix together red peppers, tahini paste, cilantro, and oyster sauce. Drizzle over the onions and toss.

title: Syrniki (Greek Soy Milk Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes or 2 lbs pork chops, cut into cubes | 2 lbs sugar | 6 dried lime leaves, bruised or 3 dried limes, quartered | 5 1/2 cups soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place the pork in a 4 - 6 quart pan in layers and scatter the sugar over it. Press lightly. If the sugar has formed a hard crust, dislodge it. Stir in the lime leaves or the limes. Pour in enough water to cover the meat. Cover and cook over very low heat for several hours, adding water if it evaporates. When the meat is very tender, remove it to a warmed plate, cover and set aside to cool slightly. Skim off the surface of the fat as necessary. Transfer to a food processor or blender. Add the soy milk and the cayenne pepper to the meat juices in the pan. Blend. Reheat slowly, stirring often, but do not boil. When ready to serve, remove the meat from the pan. Transfer to a heatproof bowl. Stir. Pour liquid into a serving bowl and allow to reheat over low heat, stirring frequently, but not boiling. This is quite tasty served with fish dishes, like this.

title: A Little Healthier Turkey Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice ( not instant ) | 2/3 cup vegetable stock ( a must ) | 1 pinch tarragon | 8 ounces cooked shredded turkey | 1/3 cup sour cream ( a must ) | peppermint candy | fresh tarragon
instructions: Cook rice as directed by package. In a large bowl, mix together. Add turkey, sour cream and tarragon. Toss to coat. Add in rice, peppermint candy and hot tarragon to taste.

title: Pineapple Rice Paper Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt, chilled | 4 -8 sheets rice paper | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Place one sheet of rice paper on a large sheet of plastic wrap. Place 1/4 cup of yogurt on top of the rice paper, cover with the remaining rice paper and wrap. Cut a slit in the middle and press the two ends together so the rice paper wrap will be slightly open. Cut one pineapple slice in half and place a toothpick or 2 pineapple wedges on the top. Repeat until rice paper and stuffing are used up. To serve, cut into 8 finger sized pieces.

title: Peach and Olive Filling
ingredients: 4 firm ripe peaches, peeled, cut in half | 1/4 cup light nutella ( or spreadable like nutella )
instructions: Peel the peaches and cut them into 1 cubes. Warm the nutella. In a small mixing bowl, combine nutella and warm peach quarters with the warm peach and nutella. Store mixture in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

title: Cashew-Pepperoni-Bissies
ingredients: 1 box french fries | 1 lb sliced pepperoni | 1/2 cup red onion, sliced thin | 2/3 cup brown sugar, packed | 1/4 cup roasted cashews, chopped | minced coriander ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, toss together french fries and the peppers, onion, brown sugar, and peanuts. Lay on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Sprinkle with coriander, if desired.

title: Easy Spanish Eggs
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup pace picante sauce
instructions: Preheat an oven broiler with a rack 3 inches from the heat. Cut the eggs in half and scoop out the yolks. Mash the yolks in a bowl. Place the bowly egg whites in a saucepan and pour in picante sauce. Stir the egg yolks into the salsa. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking until the salsa has thickened, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Beef and Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 3/4 cup low-fat cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons low-fat feta cheese, crumbled ( or more to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 3 tablespoons of fresh mint, minced | 1 can pinto beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | fresh cilantro, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Lightly spray pan with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, mix together beef, cheeses, marjoram and mint until combined well. Shape into patties about 1 3/4 inch thick. Spray pinto beans with cooking spray and place in pan. Cook, turning often, until well browned about 6 minutes. Sprinkle each burger with fresh cilantro and serve with salsa.

title: Moroccan Turkey Cake
ingredients: 500 g ground turkey | 50 g ground almonds | 50 g icing sugar | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 orange, rind of
instructions: Toast the almonds in a frying pan and crumble roughly into a grinder. In a small bowl, mix together the ground turkey, ground almonds, sugar, bi carb and a grated orange rind. Stir in the grated almond mixture until well combined. Grease and line a 15 x 7 inch baking tin with waxed paper. Turn out the dough onto the waxed paper in a small circular motion and roll it out to an oval about 8 x 11 inches. Transfer the loaf to a rack to cool. Preheat the oven to 180°c, and line with baking paper. Dust the loaf with icing sugar and shape it in to a loaf shape. Bake for 1 1/2 hours, testing for doneness with a toothpick. Allow to cool. Serve slices at once. Store in an airtight container between layers of plastic wrap or baking paper.

Random Ingredients: dill,okra,ginger,mascarpone cheese,garlic clove,purpose flour,red curry paste
title: Spicy Okra and Okra Curry
ingredients: 2 packages okra, thawed | 5 ounces mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, peeled and ground | 1 large garlic clove, peeled and crushed | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Preheat the grill. Trim and discard the ends and ends of the okra. Cut them into 1 in strips. Slice the okra diagonally into 1 1/2 in slices. Put the mascarpone in a bowl and combine it with the ginger, garlic and flour. Add the curry paste and dill, mix well until the ingredients are all incorporated. Heat a wok or frypan over a high and add the okra. Toss around until all the okra has been sliced in the pan, cook for 1 - 2 minutes until the okra is sizzling and coated with the curry. Toss through the okra with a spatula and serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,hamburger,pizza crust,cooking oil,fennel seed,green bell pepper,pork shoulder
title: Fennel and Calamari Pork Rollups
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, chopped | 1 cup fennel seed | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 green bell pepper | 1 can refrigerated egg roll wraps | 3/4 lb hamburger | prepared pizza crust
instructions: Dice the pork into 1/2 inch cubes. Combine pork, 1 cup fennel seed and oil. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Unroll egg roll wrappers on lightly floured board. Place two tablespoons of pork pork mixture in center of one wrapper. Top with second wrapper and pinch to seal shut. Repeat with all three wrappers until all have been used. Line an ungreased casserole dish with foil with a double layer of foil on top. Pour pizza dough into dish and bake for 45 minutes or until the dough is browned. Remove from oven. Remove foil and top with remaining filling and sprinkle with remaining fennel seeds and pepper slices. Cool for 15 minutes before cutting. Delicious served with lots of sauce.

title: Blueberry Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients: 5 zucchini, peeled and halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 150 g dried blueberries | 25 g of ground pistachios | 25 g flour | 8 slices white bread or 8 slices rye bread
instructions: Butter a baking dish and line with parchment paper. Mix zucchini, margarine and blueberries in a large bowl and allow to sit. Sprinkle with pistachios and flour, then roll into 4 oblong patties. Place on prepared baking dish. Slice the bread into wedges and dip each wedge into the nut mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas 4 and bake at 200c/400f/gas 5 for 45 minutes, until tender. Cool on paper towels to keep warm.

Random Ingredients: scallion,coconut flake,white pepper,ghee butter,spanish onion,beef tenderloin
title: Tibetan Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/3 cup shredded coconut flakes | 2 scallions, 1 inch pieces | 1 medium spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cut beef across the grain into thin strips about 1/8 inch wide by 4 inches long. Drain fat. Set beef strips on racks in shallow baking dish. In small bowl, stir shredded coconut with scallions, onion, white pepper and 3 tablespoons melted ghee, pour over beef. Turn beef so coconut mixture covers it. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to overnight. Preheat broiler. Remove beef strips from marinade and pat dry with paper towel. Broil in batches, 3 - 4 minutes per side. Serve on platter with dipping sauce.

title: Pineapple Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 3 cups grated zucchini | 2 cans pineapple tidbits | 3 tablespoons almond paste | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 25 sheets nori | 3 tablespoons curry paste ( or korean chili powder )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place grated zucchini in a colander lined with a paper towel and run under cold water until dry. Place in a bowl and squeeze out excess water. Heat a little olive oil in a pan, and when hot add the almond paste and continue to cook until fragrant. Take off the heat and add the sugar and curry chili powder. Add the pineapple tidbits. Add zucchini and mix thoroughly. Place the cookie sheet of nori on a cookie sheet, or in a shallow baking dish, and lightly grease the cookie sheet. Pour some of the zucchini mixture into the nori, spread evenly, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake 15 minutes, then remove from oven and cool slightly. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 weeks.

title: Shrimp & Chips
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed | 3/4 lb shrimp, raw and peeled | 3/4 lb pepperoni | 1 teaspoon white pepper
