instructions: Wash shrimp. Slice into halves lengthwise. Sprinkle potato with salt and pepper and place over medium high heat, stirring as necessary with slotted spoon. When edges have begun to curl, turn potatoes over and repeat process with other side of potatoes. Place potatoes in a colander and dry them in a warm oven for approximately 10 minutes. Set aside to drain. Turn heat under microwave down to low and drain the shrimp. Set aside to cool. Once crust is cool and very hard, cut in 1/2 inch slices. Place on a lightly oiled tray, cover and refrigerate until solid. Heat oven to 350 degree. Bake potatoes until light brown, about 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Red Potato Crisp
ingredients: 8 cups packed, red potatoes | 1 loaf unsliced white bread, torn into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Place the red potatoes in a large pot of lightly salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, and boil uncovered for 5 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and cover with foil. Use scissors or kitchen scissors to tear the potatoes into chunks. Stir the browned potatoes into the baking sheet, and spread out the bread cubes on the foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until bread is golden and potatoes are tender. Cool, and serve.

title: Warm Swiss and Pineapple Sandwiches
ingredients: 16 ounces sandwich buns ( or other low-fat varieties ) | 2 tablespoons ghee ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tamari ( or more, to taste ) | 1/4 lb thinly sliced thin deli ham ( about 2 cups ) or 1/4 lb thinly sliced prosciutto ( about 2 cups ) | 2/3 lb swiss cheese, sliced | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple, packed in juice and drained
instructions: Heat ghee in 10 inch skillet over medium heat until just beginning to smoke. Quickly cook sandwich buns, one at a time, 1 to 2 seconds per side. Toast sandwiches, cut sides up, in toaster oven just until bottoms are toasted, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove toasted buns from skillet and spread with tamari. Top each with ham, cheese, and pineapple. Cover tightly and heat through but do not burn. Cut in 4 pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,beet,soymilk,limeade concentrate,basmati rice,chinese five spice powder,guajillo chilies,espresso coffee
title: Easy Packed Beet Latte
ingredients: 1 can frozen peas and corn mix | 1 package frozen limeade concentrate | 6 guajillo chilies, sliced and seeded | 1/8 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon instant espresso coffee | 2/3 cup soymilk | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 2 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Combine peas and corn mixture, limeade concentrate, chiles, five spice powder, espresso and soymilk in a blender or food processor and blend well. Pour into a bowl and top with hot pepper sauce. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight. Pour into a serving dish and top with rice, if desired. Makes 3 cups.

title: Cranberry Gravy
ingredients: 5 cups cranberry juice | 1 tablespoon grated ginger root | 3 tablespoons cranberry juice, or as needed
instructions: Puree 1 cup cranberry juice in a blender until smooth.

title: Bread Magic
ingredients: 16 slices white bread | 1 cup poppy seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Slice bread 3/8 thick and place on a baking sheet. Sprinkle poppy seeds on top. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes or until crisp and toasted.

title: Greek Shrimp and Feta Stuffed Prawns
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs peeled jumbo shrimp | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnuts
instructions: Combine shrimp, onion salt, italian seasoning and feta. Taste and adjust seasonings. Chill mixture 30 minutes or longer. Divide mixture among the shrimp and gently flatten with a rolling pin. Place in a baking dish and bake, uncovered, in a 400 oven for 25 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and are firm. Serve immediately.

title: Slow Cooker Kielbasa and Beer
ingredients: 2 kielbasa, cut in half crosswise and then sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1 can beer | 1/2 cup dried lentils ( i prefer puy or mesquite ) | 1 1/2 lbs chicken breast halves
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 4 pieces. Combine pork and kielbasa in 3 1/2 to 4 - 3 1/2 quart slow cooker. Pour beer around kielbasa and add 1 cup of lentils. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours, or on high for 4 hours. Transfer chicken chunks to platter and tent loosely with foil to keep warm. Skim excess fat from accumulated fat. When ready to serve, reheat kielbasa mixture in slow cooker on high setting. Cook, uncovered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until chicken juices run clear.

title: Pesto Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces beef broth | 1/2 cup red pesto sauce
instructions: Combine in large saucepan over low heat until boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and cool. Cover tightly and refrigerate up to 5 days. Sauce can be refrigerated up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: cabbage kimchi,jicama,splenda sugar substitute,breakfast sausage,cornflakes cereal,link sausage
title: Korean Kimchi & Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 package johnson sausage | 1 package low-sodium link sausage | 1 box shredded cabbage kimchi | 1 1/2 cups shredded napa cabbage kimchi ( canned is ok ) | splenda sugar substitute ( to taste ) | frozen cornflakes cereal
instructions: Cut sausage into small pieces and cook until no longer pink. Drain and set aside. Cut kimchi into bite size pieces. Cut cabbage into 1 inch lengths. Sauté sliced sausage in water to cover until no longer pink, then drain. Place shredded cabbage into a bowl. In another bowl or on a serving platter, pour sausage, cabbage, kimchi, napa cabbage and splenda. Toss to coat all ingredients. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,penne pasta,chive,tortilla chip,mccormick taco seasoning mix,vegetable broth
title: Mock Jaffa® Pasta and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon mccormick� taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger juice | 1 bag of fancy tortilla chips | 8 ounces of jumbo sliced fresh frozen vegetables ( such as peppers or zucchini ) | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, snipped ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. In an oven proof skillet combine broth, seasoning mix, ginger juice, and tortilla chips. Cover and place in oven for 20 minutes. Remove cover and stir ingredients. Return to oven and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender and liquid absorbed. Remove pan from oven and stir in chives. Serve immediately.

title: Apricot-Green Chilies French Bread
ingredients: 1 french bread ( cut into 1-inch slices ) | 2 lbs green chilies | 1/2 lb sweet apricot ( cut into 1/4 slices ) | 2 scallions, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. In a heavy baking or roasting pan with a tight cover, lay out three slices of bread to toast. Cut into thick 3/4 slices. Cut the green chilis in half. Separate the chilis and place in a separate bowl. Rinse out one or two of the seeds inside. In a blender or food processor, chop green chilis into smaller pieces, using about 1/4 cup of puree for each. In a large bowl, place bread slices into chilis. Add green chilis and apricots. Top with scallions.

title: Celery Soup Indienne -  for diabetics - Make Ahead and Make Ahead Recipe!
ingredients: 2 stalks celery | 3 cups water
instructions: Wash celery thoroughly. Break off the stalk using a sharp knife and trim off dirt or sand. Place celery in a medium size saucepan and fill with lightly salted water. Bring the water to a boil and add celery stalks. Simmer the celery for 10 minutes, or until the celery is tender. Drain and allow to dry out before using. The celery can be frozen for up to 1 month.

title: Spanish Spinach Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces young spinach leaves, washed | 3/4 cup long grain brown rice ( or 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice ) | 2 medium tomatoes, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Add water, cover tightly, and bring to boil. Turn down to simmer and cook for approximately 20 minutes. Drain the spinach well and add it to the rice. Continue to cook and stir, adding brandy over time. Cook for an additional 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Smoked Oven Browning Sauce
ingredients: 1 large smoked scotch bonnet pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup wild rice or 1/4 cup brown rice, not instant
instructions: Sprinkle the black pepper on the black pepper and saute it in a large nonstick frying pan with a tight lid. Once the browning begins to brown, add the wild rice, stir well to mix. Lower heat and cook, stirring now and then if the pan starts to dry, reduce the burner. The rice will take on a glacy, slightly caramelized appearance just a minute, but this is what is called a browning sauce, not a burnt sauce. Serve with your favourite condiments..

title: Broccoli Sprout With Orange
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli, stems removed | 2 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Blanch the broccoli until just bright green, and then immediately shocking it under cold water. Use a slotted spoon to separate the top and bottom leaves from the water, and then quickly transfer the broccoli into the boiling pan of salted water. Repeat the blanching process until the broccoli is just cooked, then drain the water from the broccoli and florets. Bring the orange juice and orange juice to the boil in a small pan, then place in a serving dish and pour the orange juice/orange mixture over the top with just a little bit of salt. Allow to stand, and serve.

title: Voodoo Bruschetta
ingredients: 24 slices prosciutto ( thin ) | 8 black cardamom pods | 2 ripe bamboo shoots ( optional ) | 3 ounces white rum | fresh rosemary, sprig ( chopped fresh )
instructions: Wrap prosciutto around each piece of parmed ham. Secure prosciutto with two toothpicks. Place on parchment paper lined baking sheet, and chill for 1 hour. Remove toothpicks. Prepare all of rosemary sprigs. Strain rum through a fine mesh strainer into a small bowl to allow a bitter taste to penetrate the pulp. Add rum and garnish with sprigs of rosemary.

title: Simple Coconut Soup
ingredients: 9 cups beef broth | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 can cream ( can use cream of coconut ) | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a large sauce pan, combine beef broth, coconut milk and cream. Heat for 10 minutes. Turn heat to high and add cream of coconut. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,penne pasta,chervil,pork shoulder,pepper flake,sea salt,sherry wine,coffee granule
title: Sherry Braised Pork Shoulder
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried hot pepper flakes | 2 serrano peppers | 5 -6 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 cubes | sea salt | fresh ground pepper | 2 tablespoons instant coffee granules | 1 lb penne pasta | 1/4 cup sherry wine | parsley, stems and all
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the hot pepper flakes in a small saucepan and add the serrano peppers. Place on top of the hot pepper flakes and warm them through. Rub the salt and pepper on the pork and spread out on a board or baking sheet or jellyroll mat, and set aside. Place the roast and browned pieces into a roasting pan. Drizzle with the coffee granules and add the roasting pan with the sherry, then cover the pan with tin foil. Roast for 40 minutes, then uncover the pan and continue cooking for a further 2 hours. The meat should be just well cooked but not crusty and very tender. Check on the meat after 20 minutes and if it falls apart, drain off any excess fat. When done, the meat should come off the bones and be shredded very finely. Stir in a handful of chopped parsley right before you serve. Remove the cooking pan from the oven and place the pasta on a serving plate. Dipping sauce, in a small bowl, combine the sherry and pepper flakes, then mix in the freshly ground pepper and instant coffee granules. Pour this mixture over the hot pasta and mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Tropical Swordfish
ingredients: 2 lbs swordfish steaks, cut into 2 inch cubes | 2 cans coconut milk
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large pot. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minute. Serve over jasmine rice. Note, this is an old trick that i have learned to make. Fish is supposed to be cooked in a pan, put on a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Then it has a crispy coating on the outside and a crispy outside too.

Random Ingredients: black olive,onion,heirloom tomato,cream tartar,wheat spaghetti,dark rum
title: Heirloom Tomato Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package dry whole wheat spaghetti | 1 1/4 cups cream of tartar | 1/2 cup dark rum | 1 jar heirloom tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup sliced black olives
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Chilli Chilli Ham (Ham)
ingredients: 200 g diced ham | 2 chilies, split in half lengthways | 4 coriander roots, crushed | 2 fresh green chile peppers, sliced
instructions: Place the ham in the freezer for about 20 minutes, or until frozen solid. Slice or dice the chillies, and toss with the coriander roots, chilies, and ham. Add water until you have a sticky consistency.

title: Ahi Pods
ingredients: 1/2 kg turkey giblets | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Wash giblets in cold water. Cut the giblets in a sawpaw style, no heads nor tails. Heat a heavy based pan and dry fry the giblets in 2 tbsp of oil until they change colour. Remove the giblets and set aside. Heat up the remaining 1 tbsp of oil in the same pan and fry the birds until they are brown all over. Add the dark soy sauce and stir fry over low heat. Add the fried giblets and serve.

title: Sultana and Pecorino Rava Pudding (Gailor's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 lb sultana, soaked in water for 1 dy ( or brown sugar crystals soaked in tepid water for 1 dy, drained ( see note below ) | 8 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated ( see note below ) | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder ( see note below )
instructions: Note below, a good indication is for any colour that you choose. The sultanas will colour slightly while soaking. Note, if pecorino doesn't grate well then it would be difficult to grate the rava cheese. Boil enough water and sultanas to cover. If using a special cheese like kasseri then you should boil for a further 5 - 15 minutes. Drain a little of the water if you think it needs it. Combine the curd with the cheeses.. Dissolve curry powder in just enough of the remaining water to blend. Pour into the sieved cheese and simmer for about 7 - 10 minutes. Serve with some thick cream.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,sea salt,rice,oil,turmeric powder,turnip,heavy whipping cream
title: Indian Turnips
ingredients: 2 large turnips | 1 cup of thick whipping cream | 3 teaspoons brown rice, raw | 1 pinch turmeric powder | sea salt | oil ( for frying ) | golden syrup
instructions: Halve the turnips and wash. Peel them and slice them thinly. In a large pot, cover the turnips with water and bring to a boil. Once it reaches a boil, boil for approximately 10 - 15 minutes, until the turnips are soft. If there is no turnip remaining, drain and cool. Remove the potatoes, cut them into smaller chunks and stir fry them in a large pot in a thin layer of oil. Add the turnips and fry for about 5 minutes, until golden. If there is any oil left in the turnips, mix it together with the raw rice. Add the turmeric and 1 pinch of sea salt and fry for about 5 more minutes. Add the cream and bring to a simmer. Then add the golden syrup and stir well. Serve with hot bread slices.

title: Rosemary Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce, divided | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the lettuce in a large bowl, cover and refrigerate. Whisk cream soup and rosemary together in a separate bowl. Toss remaining lettuce, cream soup and cheese with enough of the remaining lettuce to moisten. Pour the cream soup mixture into a serving bowl.

title: Seared Mushrooms over Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crushed cumin seed | 4 ounces mushrooms stems and pieces | 3/4 cup low-sodium brown onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/4 cup sake
instructions: Heat oil in a nonreactive wok. Add the cumin seeds and mushrooms and stir fry for 2 minutes. Add the onions and stir fry for 20 seconds, or until onions have carmelized. Combine all ingredients, except the salt, in a glass or ceramic bowl. Serve over rice.

title: Tamari Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Arrange chicken breasts on a baking sheet. Stir the marinade sauce into the chicken. Broil chicken breasts about 5 minutes, or until no longer pink inside.

Random Ingredients: molasses,asian pear,cider vinegar,graham cracker crumb,hamburger,palm sugar
title: Grilled Ginger and Pear Sliders
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 lb hamburger, cooked and drained | 1 1/2 cups asian pears, finely diced | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup light molasses | 4 tablespoons palm sugar or 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the graham cracker crumbs and hamburger or pears. In a small bowl, combine molasses, molasses, sugar, and vinegar. Pour molasses mixture into the cracker mixture and mix thoroughly. If mixture is too crumbly, add more of the vinegar.

title: Lemongrass and Green Beans
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, trimmed | 1 bunch maraschino cherries, pitted | 1 pound salmon fillets, cubed | 1/2 pound fresh green beans
instructions: Blend lemongrass, maraschino cherries, and salmon in a food processor until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Place salmon on work surface, and pour a small amount of the lemon grass filling into a center, and wrap salmon and cherry flavored cherry around salmon.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,chipotle chile adobo,rice noodle,cardamom
title: Chipotle Pepper Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces rice noodles, cellophane | 1/3 cup finely chopped canned chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 cloves, crushed
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain noodles well and set aside. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add chiles, cardamom and garlic. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Immediately toss noodles in pan along with sauce. Cook for 4 - 5 minutes, tossing frequently until heated through.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,beef bouillon,horseradish,vanilla bean,vanilla ice cream,jasmine rice,baking powder
title: Red-Cooked Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/3 cup ground ancho chile powder | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant vanilla beans, scraped | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon instant beef bouillon | 1 dash vanilla bean scraped and crushed | 4 8 inch day old sourdough rolls or 8 inch french breads | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Heat chile powder, horseradish, vanilla bean and baking powder in a skillet over medium high heat. When the horseradish liquefies add the bouillon and cook for a minute. Remove from heat. Split each buns lengthwise in half, and toast on a baking sheet at 400 degrees f. For 1st half of buns, spread about 1/2 teaspoon of the heated horseradish mixture on them. Top with more buns and continue with the remaining horseradish mixture, buns and any garnish as desired. Dust with vanilla bean seeds and serve.

title: Baked Onions and Avocados With Panir
ingredients: 180 g panir ( cubed ) | 2 tablespoons yoghurt ( greek ) | 2 avocados ( peeled, cut into cubes ) | 3 -5 basil leaves ( chopped ) | onion salt | 2 tablespoons salad dressing ( homemade or bought )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Mix panir, yoghurt and onion salt in a large bowl to combine and spread over a baking paper lined tray. Cover with larger tray of baking paper and bake at 200c for 25 - 30 minutes stirring every 5 minutes or so until the base of the avocado is just starting to brown. Cool for 10 minutes then mix in the avocado. Serve.

title: Lebanese Asparagus & Dukkah Bar Mash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus, trimmed | 1 1/4 cups brown lentils | 2 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons other fat | 3 slices black sesame seeds | 1/3 cup freshly roasted black sesame seed | 2 tablespoons low-fat english breakfast tea, warmed
instructions: Cook lentils in a large pan of boiling water for 10 minutes until just tender. Drain, place in a large bowl and allow to cool. Once cool, shred. Heat the fat in a frypan to medium heat, add the asparagus and cook stirring frequently until golden brown. While the asparagus is cooking, place the black sesame seeds in a small frying pan and toast until golden about 1 - 2 minutes. Cool sesame seeds. When ready to serve mash the lentils, add the asparagus along with the sesame seeds to the lentils and pour the warm teabag. Enjoy.

title: Green Beans and Eggs
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed, trimmed | 1/4 cup italian parsley | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and sliced | 3/4 cup half-and-half
instructions: Steam the green beans, covered, in a steamer over boiling water until crisp tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain the peas and toss with the parsley. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Spray a 9 inch skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat over medium heat. When the water comes to a boil, add the eggs. Cover and cook them until the whites are set. Transfer the eggs to a platter and sprinkle with the half and half. When the beans and eggs are done, remove the skillet from the heat and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch
ingredients: 1 slice whole meal bread, such as breakfast bread | 1/4 cup sweet onion powder | 3 tablespoons honey roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Arrange bread slice on a baking sheet with the rim facing up. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp and golden, about 17 minutes. Spread each slice with 1/4 cup of the peanut butter. Return crispy bread to oven and stir until cheese is melted and topping is hot, about 5 minutes. Spread remaining peanut butter over top and serve.

title: Smoky Beef and Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 head cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/2 head cabbage, cored and torn into bite-size pieces | 3/4 lb thinly sliced corned beef ( the thin sliced kind, but not the imitation ) | 3/4 cup evaporated skim milk ( low fat is ok ) | 1/8 cup low sodium soy sauce | 3/4 cup mayonnaise ( good quality ) | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke, such as tabasco
instructions: Trim outer leaves of cabbage, then cut leaves into 1 inch wide strips. In a 4 - 6 qt crockpot, place cabbage, then beef. Pour in evaporated skimmed milk, soy sauce and mayonnaise. Stir well to combine and set aside for at least 4 hours. Stir well after at least 4 hours of cooking. If mixture gets dry before is ready, add a little water. Stir well after every 30 minutes to allow moisture to thicken up. Scoop mixture into bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,chicken bouillon cube,fettuccini pasta,pineapple tidbit
title: Fettuccini in Pineapple-Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces fettuccini pasta ( or spaghetti ) | 1 can pineapple tidbits | 1/3 cup chicken bouillon cube, with 6 tablespoons of chicken broth | 2 tablespoons beef broth
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain. Combine remaining ingredients in a 5 qt sauce pan. Heat until the wine reduces by half. Drain pasta in a colander. Place saucepan over low heat. Pour the sauce in through the colander. Cook until the pasta reaches desired thickness. Serve in a bowl.

title: Cottage Cheese and Porcini Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1/4 cup farina
instructions: Stir mushrooms and cottage cheese together in a bowl until thoroughly incorporated. Make sure the farina is dissolved in 1 tbsp. Of the farina. Serve with pumpernickel bread.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,hot red chili pepper,cilantro leaf
title: Lebanese Style Hot Red Pepper Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hot red chili peppers or 1 1/2 lbs red bell peppers | 1 cup heavy cream | chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( to garnish ) or chopped fresh parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Place a steamer basket in a large heavy saucepan and add water to just below the bottom of the basket. Cover and cook the chilies over low heat for about 20 minutes, until soft and completely collapsed. Remove chilies and discard. Using slotted spoon, cut chilies into thin strips about 1 wide. Place each strip into a blender with a little of the pan juice and puree until smooth. Return the puree to the pan and bring to a boil. Using a slotted spoon, reduce heat to low. Add the cream and simmer just until sauce thickens. Remove from the heat and let stand for 2 to 3 minutes before adjusting seasoning. Strain, and chill until ready to use. You will need to adjust the cream/chili liquid to a thin consistancy and adjust the hotness according to personal taste.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,serrano pepper,garlic clove,haddock fillet,self rising flour,beef brisket,coriander seed,nonfat milk
title: Portuguese Haddock with Coriander-Lickened Flour
ingredients: 8 ounces haddock fillets, skin on | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 2 cups canola oil, for frying | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 large serrano pepper, sliced thin | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 cup nonfat milk
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine the flour, milk, oil, coriander seeds and serrano pepper, stirring with a fork until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Spread the mixture out on a plate and pat dry with paper towels. Dip shrimps in milk, pressing lightly, then dredge in flour. Heat 2 inches of oil to 365°f or until a piece of fish golden brown in 2 batches. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the fish onto paper towels to drain. Repeat with remaining fish. Serve the fish hot.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,poblano pepper,parsley flake,lebanese cucumber,fenugreek seed,soya sauce
title: Hokkien Nasi Lemak
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 lebanese cucumbers, peeled cut lengthwise in half, then halved then cut crosswise into 1/3-thick slices | 2 teaspoons soya sauce | 2 small poblano peppers, roasted & shredded, 1 cup coarsely shredded | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes or 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Place chick peas in a med bowl with cucumbers, soya sauce and poblano pieces. Sprinkle with parsley and fenugreek. Chill till serving.

Random Ingredients: milk,salmon,tortilla chip,egg beater substitute,deli roast beef,whipping cream,yellow squash
title: Easy Salmon and Beef Croquettes
ingredients: 1 can fat-free evaporated milk | 1/4 ounce egg beater substitute or 1 egg | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 6 slices deli roast beef | 3 -4 cups thinly sliced yellow squash | 1/3 cup canned salmon, chopped | 2 cups tortilla chips, divided ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan. Heat and stir until warm, but not boiling.

title: Doughnut Tarts
ingredients: 500 g white chocolate | 1 bunch of fresh mint | 1 bunch of fresh dill | 5 spring onions | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 15 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Put the white chocolate in a pan, bring it slowly until it melts and turn light to dark. Add the mint/dill, spring onions and dill in the same pan and mix well. When it comes to a boil, remove from heat. Cut out dough in four equal sized pieces, roll them into balls and put each one into a tins or pastry bag. Put the filling into one of the tins, put another one on top and put in the fridge till it is time to cook them. Preheat your oven at 220, take off the crust and put it in the oven for 15 minutes now open the tins and check to see if it is ready. It should be a little charred. Enjoy with a glass of white chocolate and a mint leaf sprinkled on top, or.

Random Ingredients: cod,rotelle pasta,lettuce leaf,clam juice,four cheese mexican
title: Baked Fish & Clam Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cooked cod | 1 1/2 cups cooked rotelle pasta ( or linguine ) | 1 cup bottled clam juice | 16 ounces four cheese mexican blend cheese | lettuce leaf, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Combine the fish, pasta and clam juice in a shallow casserole dish. Cover with cheese and arrange in a single layer. Bake or grill, covered, over low heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve hot, with lettuce leaves.

title: Luscious Roasted Beef or Tuna Burgers
ingredients: 1 chuck roast ( about 1-1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup flour | 1 teaspoon dried ground sage | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 4 small cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 small lebanese cucumber, halved and thinly sliced | 1 cup fresh ricotta cheese
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast and cut into 1 inch chunks. Toss with the flour mixed with the sage and pepper and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 500 °f degrees. Mix together the tomatoes, cucumber and ricotta and season with salt and pepper. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray and arrange the roast chunks on it. Cover the roast with the tomato mixture and let it rest 5 minutes. Place the roast on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer and bake in the oven for 12 to 14 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165 °f when taken with a meat thermometer. Remove from the oven and let rest another 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,monterey jack cheddar cheese,cherry tomato,pear
title: Quick Turkey Sandwich
ingredients: 1 boneless turkey breast | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 12 small tostados, halved or 12 small tostados ( golf ball size )
instructions: Slice turkey breast into thin strips. Place turkey and tomatoes on a greased cookie sheet. Drizzle with tomato mixture, sprinkle with cheese blend and sprinkle with pepper. Bake in oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with tostados.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,lemon peel,arrowroot,vanilla pudding mix,bread,french onion,flat leaf parsley
title: Steamed Fish in Pearl Jam
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg kingfish or 1 1/2 kg cod fish fillets | 4 slices bread ( thick slices ) | 50 g french or 2 tablespoons green onions, finely minced | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons arrowroot ( or cornstarch ) | 1 packet vanilla pudding mix | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Cut the fish in 3 5cm pieces and put in a steamer. Place the bread on an oven tray and toast in oven for 8 - 10 mins until lightly browned and dry. Place the cooked fish to one side and set aside. Bring water to the boil in an open saucepan and put the packet of pudding mix with the fish and a splash of fish sauce into the saucepan. Mix well and bring to the boil to thicken. Remove from heat. Dip the bread and the fish pieces in the arrowroot/cornstarch solution, coating the fish pieces evenly. Steam for 5 minutes or until the fish is cooked. Remove from the steamer, top with the french or green onions, parsley and serve hot.

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the pork, pickle juice, walnuts and cheese. Spread 1 tablespoon of stuffing on each bread slice and moisten with more of the jam. title: Hawaiian Popsicles-Dip
ingredients: 1 bone in ham hocks or 1 turkey | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup pineapple juice | toasted crouton | soymilk
instructions: Put ham hocks in a large pan. Pour half and half into pan until the hocks are covered, turn the heat up till meat is covered, stir in pineapple juice. Boil the mixture till it's reduced and thickened. While that is cooking, make croutons for dipping.

title: Fried Green Leaf Lettuce Wraps With Pearl Star nozzle (Pane Integrale)

instructions: For best results, do not overcook. To make a paste, grind coriander and cardamom to a powder. Chop the mushrooms to a paste with a blender or in a mortar & pestle. Serve with fresh fruit and dips of your choice. Can also make into a loaf, sandwich maker sandwich and cook on a flat iron griddle or bread press.

instructions: In a small bowl, mix the vodka and cod. Arrange the lettuce on plates, and spoon vodka mixture over.

Bring sausage mixture to a boil.

instructions: Mix fish, 1 tbsp oil and the horseradish in a bowl, place in refrigerator. Cook the tortillas for 30 seconds each side, or until warm, keep warm. instructions: Coat lamb with flour, pecans, allspice and garlic. Place coated lamb in large resealable plastic bag. Pour liquid smoke over lamb, seal bag, and refrigerate overnight. Leave in fridge to marinate for 30 minutes before serving. The longer you leave it sitting, the more flavors it will have.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Use as directed in recipes.

title: Beer-Steamed Beef With Oranges

instructions: Preheat your broiler or grill, or grill a rack over your choice of side dishes. title: Clam Soup

The goal is to prevent this from happening. Once the onions are a uniform color yellow, they will not need any assistance but are cooked right through and no more raw or greasy. Remove lid and continue with cooking uncovered another 20 minutes, or until your water is absorbed. Remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes. In the meantime, in a small bowl, stir together the milk, adding enough water to measure about 3 cups and stir into soup. You want it to be a little wet with milk this time, but not to runny. The goal is to have a soup that is creamy, but very saucy. You can add up to 1 1/2 cups of water to the soup to loosen it up, if the soup is too thick to stir easily, add more water. Serve in serving bowls, with the cheesecloth or towel over the top to absorb moisture. I recommend pouring hot soup over ice cubes. This soup can also be kept tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

title: Homemade Polish Sausage
ingredients: 1 pound ground sausage | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir sausage in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,pepper sauce,fennel seed,thyme sprig,cornflour,white wine,anaheim chilies
title: Gorgonzola With White Wine and Aromatic Fennel
ingredients: 4 large fennel seeds ( or a combination ) or 4 small fennel ( or a combination ) | 1 lb gorgonzola, cut into 1/2 inch cubes or 1 lb butter | 2 anaheim chilies, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon coarse thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed dried fennel seeds | freshly ground pepper sauce
instructions: Toast fennel lightly under broiler until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Place in a bowl and toss with the cheese. Let stand a few minutes until melted.

title: Tomato Amaretto Braised Beef
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs trimmed sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1/2 cup beef broth | 3 tablespoons pureed cherry tomatoes
instructions: Heat the oven to 450 degrees and heat a 10 inch cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle steaks with salt. Add meat and cook, turning once, until well seared on both sides and cooked to your liking, about 12 minutes. Transfer the meat to a platter and cover with foil. Pour off any fat in pan. Place skillet in oven and heat until smoking. Pour in the amaretto and beef broth. Bake until thickened, about 10 minutes. Divide the meat among warmed plates and top with tomato sauce. Spoon cherry tomatoes onto the meat and spoon sauce over.

Random Ingredients: thai basil,head cauliflower,raisin,salt black pepper,herb,yogurt,rice vinegar
title: Raisin Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 2 cups small head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/3 cup thai basil, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh mixed herbs | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons plain fat-free yogurt ( optional ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Steam cauliflower until slightly tender but still firm enough to cut in a julienne. Reserve 1/4 cup of the cauliflower cooking liquid and combine with the raisins, basil, rice vinegar, yogurt and remaining ingredients in a medium bowl. Toss to mix. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: prawn,spaghetti,olive oil,mace,brown lentil,ginger paste,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Spiced Prawns and Lentils
ingredients: 250 g dried brown lentils | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 500 g raw prawns ( peeled, deveined and tails removed ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace or 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | pappardelle pasta or spaghetti | brown sugar
instructions: Rinse the lentils under running water, then place in a large saucepan along with enough cold water to cover. Bring to the boil then cook over a medium heat for 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Lightly spray a medium saucepan with cooking spray. Heat over medium high heat until hot then add 1 tablespoon of oil. Add the ginger and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes or until fragrant. Add prawns and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes or until golden and cooked through. Season with mace or cinnamon. Random Ingredients: bulgur,rom tomato,pimiento,bulk pork sausage,lemon peel,serrano chili
title: Spanish Rice With Sausage and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 2 teaspoons pimientos, crushed | 8 roma tomatoes, chopped | 2 serrano chili, seeded | 1 lb bulk pork sausage, sliced about 1/4 inch thick | 1 1/4 cups uncooked fine bulgur, threads removed
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the lemon peel, pimentos, and tomatoes. Cook 5 - 10 minutes. Stir in the chiles and pork. Cover and simmer 45 to 60 minutes or until the pork is cooked and the sauce is somewhat thickened. Stir in the bulgur and continue cooking 5 minutes longer. Serve.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,hoisin sauce,peppercorn,lamb,part ricotta cheese,citric acid
title: P F Chang's Tiramisu..just for the Trimmings!!!!
ingredients: 12 slices lamb ( approx. 1-inch thick ) | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese ( not part-skim ) or ( 8 ounce ) cream cheese, softened | 1/8 teaspoon citric acid | 1/8 teaspoon instant espresso powder ( optional, i used white pepper instead of black because it was so easy ) | 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce ( optional, i didn't have any ) | 1 teaspoon peppercorn ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the lamb slices by cutting off any excess fat and slicing them diagonally. Cut a slit down each side or through the meat, being careful to cut the slits diagonally as possible. Reserve one cup of the resulting slivers. Starting with the meat slice, carefully pull the thin slices of meat out of the slice. Place the drained meat slices on an ungreased baking pan. Mix together the ricotta, citric acid and instant espresso powder in a small bowl together and then sprinkle over the meat slices. Add in the slivers from your reserved slice of meat. Stir to mix well and top with peppercorns if desired. Bake in a 350ºf oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until it has a toothpick inserted into the center and the cheese has begun to slightly change in color. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,gingerroot,oat,head cabbage,almond extract,saffron,self rising flour
title: Chipotle Cabbage
ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/4 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 cup almond extract | 1 large head of cabbage | 1 cup rolled oats | 1/4 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place a pan of water on the stovetop, and add 1 cup rolled oats. In a small bowl, mash together the saffron and almond extracts until light and the almond extract is pulverized. Slice the head of cabbage into thin rings, then cut the rings crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Set aside in a small bowl. Add the oats to the boiling water, stir to coat, and remove from heat. Coat the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish with 1/2 cup of the sifted flour. When the water comes to a boil, remove from heat. Place the sago in the baking dish, and add the sliced cabbage, stirring until coated. In a small bowl, stir together the 1/4 cup of rolled oats and the 1/4 teaspoon of ground ginger. Toss in the sliced almonds, and spread over the cabbage. Bake in the 350 degree oven for 50 to 60 minutes, or until a crusty topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,oregano leaf,chipotle pepper,pepper,greek olive,red cherry,grain rice
title: Puerto Rican Chicken (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 lbs skinless chicken drumsticks or 8 chicken thighs | 1 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 1 can chipotle peppers, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 12 stuffed red cherries, cut in half | 12 halved greek olives
instructions: Place meat and rice in slow cooker. Mix pepper, oregano, chili powder, and pepper into the remaining ingredients until well blended. Cover and cook on low setting for 3 hours or high setting for 5 to 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,phyllo pastry,red chilies,egg wrap,graham cracker,puff pastry,flour tortilla
title: Tropical Triangles
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated egg roll wraps | 2 cans red chilies, drained | 4 sheets frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 3 tablespoons flour, or as needed | 3 tablespoons finely diced fresh red chilies | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne | 1 sheet frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets | 1 egg roll wrap, thawed | 1/4 cup shredded graham cracker, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or oiled aluminum foil. Unroll frozen puff pastry sheets on a clean dry surface, and spray with cooking spray. Spread 1 teaspoon of the red chilies over the bottom of each puff pastry sheet and press each sheet firmly into a 9 inch rectangle. Cut each rectangle into 4 rectangles. Spray each rectangle with more cooking spray and top each with a second rectangle. Trim edges of the dough with scissors and cut each rectangle into 4 triangles. Place 1 triangles on the prepared baking sheet, and spray with cooking spray. Repeat layering until all triangles are used. Spread red chiles over the pastry rectangles. Sprinkle 1/4 cup red chiles, 3 to 4 finely diced red bell peppers, and 1 1/2 tablespoon cayenne over red chile mixture. Cut the phyllo sheets into 6 equal triangles, and pinch each one into a 1 inch border on each side of the triangles. Place a second pastry sheet on top of the first, and spray with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush one side of each triangle with egg roll filling. Sprinkle 3 to 4 tablespoons graham crackers evenly over top of the cracker crust. Repeat layering until all triangles are used. Transfer baking sheet with triangles to the oven, and bake triangles until golden brown, 45 to 55 minutes. title: Cambria Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat angel hair pasta | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Cook pasta per box instructions. Drain pasta and combine ketchup, raisins, and sugar. Add pasta and coat well with sauce. Let stand until cold, and serve.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,table salt,green pea,white onion,salsa verde,worcestershire sauce,rom bean
title: Nacho Cheese Filler for One
ingredients: 15 ounces salsa verde ( i use salsa verde salsa verde ) | 6 ounces swiss cheese, grated ( i used sharp parmesan ) | 4 ounces salsa verde ( i use salsa verde salsa verde ) | 1 cup green peas ( i used frozen peas, thawed ) | 1 large white onion, finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1 pinch worcestershire sauce
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a nonstick large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Saute onions for 2 - 3 minutes. Sprinkle table salt over onions. Let stand for 5 minutes. Mix cheese with onion mixture. Spread on 1/2 of the warmed cheese mixture in a 9x13 inch baking pan. Spread on 1/2 of the swiss cheese mixture. Spread salsa verde over cheese. Spread peas over salsa verde. Cover with remaining cheese mixture.. Sprinkle onion over all and refrigerate in covered bowl up to 2 days. Cook for 30 minutes. title: Tommy's Cocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce tomato ketchup | 1 ounce tequila | 1/2 ounce finely chopped celery | 1/2 ounce freshly grated orange peel
instructions: Put everything but the orange peel, into a bowl and stir well. Serve with croutons and fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: white bread,artichoke heart,ginger root,nutritional yeast,red chile
title: Artichoke-Stuffed Bread Pies
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 1 can artichoke hearts, quartered | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 1/2 cup minced fresh ginger root | 1 red chile, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot red chile, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line baking sheets with aluminum foil, and grease with cooking spray. Cut a pocket into the top of each bread slice to allow room for filling. Mix together the artichoke hearts, nutritional yeast, ginger, red chile, and red chile in a bowl so that the mixture is evenly mixed into the bread mixture. Spoon in equal amounts of the filling to fill each pocket. Place the filled bread slices open side down onto the prepared baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 15 minutes.

title: Wasabi-Stuffed Fennel With Brown Rice

title: Prawn Chiller (Prawn, Peaches, Garlic)
ingredients: 2 ounces shortening | 1/2 cup spanish onion, chopped | 1 serrano chile pepper, chopped ( optional ) | 1 cup peach juice | 20 large prawns
instructions: Heat shortening in a skillet over medium heat. Saute onion and serrano pepper until onion softens. Add juice, reduce heat to low setting and cook 2 minutes. Add prawns and cook until prawns are pink on the top.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,cream chicken soup,bacon,celery rib,greek yogurt,peach,egg white

ingredients: 2 bacon, slices ( optional ) | 1 bunch swiss chard or 1 bunch spinach, chopped | 1 celery rib, chopped | 12 slices cooked chicken | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 8 egg whites | 1/3 cup sour cream ( optional ) | 1/3 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Bake the bacon with swiss chard until crisp. Cook the celery and chicken until they are just beginning to get soft, add the broth and soup. In a baking dish layer the swiss chard, bacon, and eggs, ending with the cheese. Bake 350 degrees. Until cheese is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,bread flour,ginger root,coriander,baby bok choy,vanilla extract,oatmeal
title: Baby Bok Choy Crisps
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry bread flour | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root | 3/4 cup oatmeal | 5 baby bok choy, trimmed and washed | 1 1/2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 5 slices peeled fresh ginger root ( optional )

Random Ingredients: black bean garlic sauce,sauce,half,thyme sprig,plain yogurt,orecchiette,banana liqueur,swiss cheese

instructions: In small bowl, stir garlic sauce well. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes or up to 2 days, stirring occasionally. Stir yogurt, thyme, cheese and ½ cup of beans in medium bowl until well blended. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Chipotle Cream Cheese Dip

instructions: Mix cream cheese, dill, and chipotle chiles in medium bowl. Spread cream cheese mixture in shallow baking dish. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Serve chilled.

title: Baked Spaghetti With Broccoli and Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat spaghetti or 1 cup other long pasta, prepared | 1 tablespoon molasses | 2 cups broccoli, cut into florets | 1 cup snow peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup macaroni | 2 tablespoons walnut halves, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease an 8 x8 baking dish. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Add spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine molasses, broccoli, peas and macaroni. Add pasta and sauce and toss to coat thoroughly. Bake, uncovered, until vegetables are crisp tender and sauce begins to bubble, about 40 minutes. Stir in walnuts and peanut butter just before serving.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,fire tomato,yeast,vegetable oil cooking spray,oil,pesto sauce
title: Pesto-Stuffed Pizza
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen yeast or 5 1/2 cups fresh yeast | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 lbs ripe fire-roasted tomatoes | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 cup finely chopped prosciutto | 2 tablespoons minced fresh basil or 2 tablespoons parsley
instructions: To make the sauce, combine all the ingredients in a food processor or blender except for the oil. Process for a few seconds to mix and then set aside. Place the dough in a bowl, cover it with plastic wrap and set it aside to rise for about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f or line a cookie sheet with foil. Punch and knead the dough just until it has a uniform color on the top. Cut a small hole in the crust of the dough to allow it to expand while rising. Spray the top of the dough with oil and spread the pesto on the surface, leaving a rim about 1 1/2 inches wide. Add about 2 tablespoons of the sauce. Distribute the toppings evenly and carefully spread on the top of the dough. Slide the pizza onto the prepared cookie sheet. Place it in the oven and bake for approximately 25 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: currant,italian salad dressing mix,vodka,chili flake,mustard seed,gelatin,alfredo sauce,ham
title: Spicy Barbecue Ham Rollups

instructions: Place ham slices between two sheets of waxed paper on waxed paper. With a sharp knife, score each slice 3/4 inch deep using a serrated knife or biscuit cutter. title: Braised Red Cabbage
ingredients: 2 large plum tomatoes | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 head red cabbage, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the tomatoes on a baking sheet, broil them until blackened, about 10 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to remove the tomatoes, and peel off the skins. title: Artichoke and Rice Krispies Bars

instructions: Combine marinade ingredients and pour over wings. Refrigerate for several hours, turning once. Place chicken wings in pan and grill over indirect heat, until done.

title: Spicy Egg Salad

title: Lemon Pear Sauce
ingredients: 1 ripe pear ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 cup fresh lemons or 1 cup fresh orange juice | 1 cup lemon juice | 1/2 cup unsweetened cranberry sauce
instructions: Peel pear and cut into 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Chipped-Up Charred Dates
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs pitted dates | 1/2 lb unsmoked bacon ( you can use a combo of the two ) | 1 large white onion | 1/2 cup water chestnut | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives | 1/2 cup unsweetened raisins

Remove bacon to paper towel lined plate and crumble. Reserve. In a large bowl, combine bacon, onion, water chestnuts.

title: Grape And Artichokes
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked broccoli florets | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar sliced fresh grapes, drained | 2 tablespoons cold water | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Divide broccoli, artichoke hearts, and grapes into 2 greased and 2 quart round baking dishes or crocks. Prepare cream of mushroom soup according to package directions using water, cream of mushroom soup, chicken bouillon, cardamom, and confectioners' sugar as desired. Spoon soup mixture over vegetables. Cover dish, and let stand at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours to combine flavors. Chill, covered, 5 to 6 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,buttermilk,lasagna noodle,water chestnut,balsamic vinegar,green chile
title: Hot-And-Sour Lasagna
ingredients: 5 ounces lasagna noodles or 5 ounces rotelle pasta | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons minced green chiles | 2 packages refrigerated buttermilk | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in plenty of boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain again and set aside. title: Cheese Salad With Almonds
ingredients: 8 ounces self-rising flour | 2 ounces roasted almonds | 1 -2 tablespoon ricotta cheese | brown mustard | 1 sliced pared bar a rick steak | diced pickle ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oven to 450°f mix the flour, almonds and ricotta together. Spread over a baking paper lined roasting tin. Bake for about 10 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through. Cool. Cut the meat into slices about 3 - 4 oz each. Return the cheeses to the oven for 3 - 4 minutes to soften slightly, then add your mustard, if using. Spoon onto toasted bread and serve with pickle slices.

title: Pork Fried Rice  for 2 (Or more)
ingredients: 1 lb pork or 1 lb beef | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons panir | 1/2 cup cracker
instructions: Take the meat and cut into bite size chunks. Add the beef chunks to a wok, fry them on med high heat until crispy on all sides. Serve with a side salad.

title: Feta and sofrito (Garlic Dip )
ingredients: 1 garlic clove | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/3 cup sofrito sauce | fish, pieces ( optional, for color )
instructions: Place garlic in cheesecloth bag or medium bowl.

ingredients: 1 can green chilies, chopped, with seeds | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 cup grated aged cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon ale
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium saucepan, combine green chilies and cream. Over medium heat, stirring constantly, simmer until cream has reduced to 1/2. In a measuring cup, combine cheese and ale. Heat until melted and smooth. Serve mixture over hot cooked tortilla chips. Top with guacamole and sour cream if desired.

title: Chipotles With Sazon
ingredients: 12 chipotle chiles | 1 lb sazon goya ( goya )
instructions: To make the goya sazon,. 1 1/2 teaspoons sazon goya,. 2 1/2 teaspoons aji or 1 1/2 stalks green peppers,. 1 1/2 teaspoons aji dulce greek dried chili flakes.

instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Arrange the provolone cheese on a grill rack set 6 inches from the heat. title: Simple Pizza Sauce for Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f in small bowl, stir together oregano, pepper and crushed pepper. Spread mixture onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 14 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Tamarind and Chorizo (Sausage and Onions With Limes)
ingredients: 1 small white onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 6 -8 sausages, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 large lime, juice of | freshly-cracked black pepper
instructions: For the marinade, combine all the ingredients in a mixing bowl and whisk together thoroughly. Trim fat from the sausages. Place the sausages on a plate and place on top of a piece of aluminium foil. Spoon the marinade over them, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or for up to 1 week. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place a frying pan on a medium heat and add the remaining marinade. Place the sausages on a roasting tray. Arrange them in one layer over the sausages. Cook in the oven for 40 to 45 minutes, depending on the thickness of the sausages. They are done when a skewer inserted into the thickest part of the sausagemeat comes out clean. Allow to sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Drunken Noodles
ingredients: 6 ounces refrigerated fully cooked cold italian noodles or 6 ounces uncooked fast rise yeast noodles | 1 1/2 teaspoons piri-piri | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 5 tablespoons light teriyaki sauce or 5 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili
instructions: Drain the noodles and rinse well under water. Pat noodles dry with a cloth to remove excess moisture. Dry thoroughly with paper towels.
