Meanwhile in a small cup, mix the teriyaki sauce with the remaining 3 tablespoons water until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Sauce Caribbean Style Sandwich (Copycat)
ingredients: 1 slice capicola | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce from caribbean-style caper ( use bottled sauce for sauce )
instructions: In medium glass bowl, mix steak seasoning to the steak coating all sides. Remove steak from bowl, cover with plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator about 15 minutes. Drain steak on paper towel and slice thinly across grain. Meanwhile, heat sauce until warm, then spread over capicola.

title: Prosciutto Ham and Parsnip (Parsnips in Broth)
ingredients: 4 large parsnips | 100 g prosciutto ham | 400 -500 ml thickened cream or 400 -500 ml thickened plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sea salt ( optional ) | 2 egg yolks
instructions: Peel and wash parsnips, then peel and slice into long thin strips. Cook in boiling water with some sea salt. Remove, drain well and allow to cool. Cut prosciutto ham into thin strips. Place all ingredients in a bowl. Mix in egg and season if required.

Random Ingredients: purple onion,knorr vegetable soup mix,black mustard seed,kielbasa,wasabi powder,beef broth
title: Wasabi Beef Kielbasa, Like American Beauty Beef
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, sliced 1 inch thick ( or any cut of beef you prefer, you use the cut of onion when slicing ) | 1/2 cup purple onion, sliced thinly ( or both ) | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 package knorr vegetable soup mix | 1 1/4 cups beef broth | wasabi powder, to taste ( i use keene's kamikaze )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. In a medium skillet, saute the garlic and the onion until the onion is tender. Place the beef in a large skillet. Mix in the kielbasa and the onion mixture. Mix the soup mix and beef broth in the skillet and cook over medium heat until the soup is bubbling. Add your wasabi and mix well. When the mixture begins to bubble, turn heat down to low. Turn the heat up to high. Cook just until the liquid reduces, then remove from heat and serve in oven safe bowls, sprinkled with wasabi if desired. Or, if you have the leftovers of your wasabi paste left on the kielbasa, serve it alongside the wasabi beef.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,pepperoni,soy sauce,chili flake,prosciutto di parma,rice,white flour,gingerroot
title: Rice Pone Crispsticks
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup grated gingerroot | 2 tablespoons chopped pickled gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 cup finely chopped prosciutto di parma | 1/2 cup soy sauce | pepperoni, slices ( optional ) | cooked rice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix flour, confectioners sugar, grated ginger root, chilli flakes, prosciutto and soy sauce thoroughly. Roll mixture into 1 inch balls. On a parchment lined baking sheet, flatten balls slightly with a fork, making sure the center isn't too thick so the uncooked rice sticks don't stick. Bake on prepared cookie sheet until golden brown and firm, about 18 - 20 minutes. Remove crisped cookie from oven and allow to cool completely. Once cool, transfer to a cutting board. Using a serrated knife, cut each cookie diagonally into 3 or 4 slices. Arrange on serving tray and then drizzle with more soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,marjoram,french bread,gruyere cheese,white bread,seasoning,tomato green chilies,garam masala
title: Tex Mex Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch thick slices | 4 thick cut white bread slices | 6 tablespoons gruyere cheese ( finely grated ) | 2 fresh tomatoes with green chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons masala ( or 1 tablespoon prepared hot curry powder ) | 2 teaspoons ground oregano | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Toast both sides of the french bread slices. Combine the grated gruyere cheese, chopped tomatoes, chilies, masala, oregano, marjoram, salt and ghee in a bowl. Spread onto the cut surfaces of the french bread slices and allow to stand for 2 minutes. In a preheated skillet, fry the coated bread until golden on both sides.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Cashew & Sun-Dried Tomato Nests
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato | 1/2 cup basil and coriander mix | 1/2 cup cashews, shelled | 1 medium onion, sliced | 12 maraschino cherries, halved ( optional ) | 2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded
instructions: Spray beef with nonstick cooking spray on both sides. Cut tenderloin lengthwise in half, then crosswise so you have 2 thin slices about 3/4 inch thick. Place each slice between two sheets of waxed paper, then flatten with a meat mallet. Place on grill over medium heat. Turn once when meat looks dry, about 90 seconds per side. Continue cooking over medium heat for another 90 seconds, or until desired doneness. Meanwhile, warm watercress.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,chocolate bar,ginger ale,burrito flour tortilla,beef brisket
title: Ginger-Ginger Beef Soft Tacos
ingredients: 8 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 package beef brisket ( or more ) | 1 can condensed ginger ale | 1/4 cup grated chocolate bars ( optional ) or 1/4 cup milk chocolate candy, such as ghirardelli ( optional ) | 1 -2 serrano chili ( seeded, deveined and minced )
instructions: Heat broiler. In a small saucepan, melt the chocolate on low heat until melted. Stir often. Remove chocolate from heat and stir in ginger ale. Slice the brisket across the grain into thin 2 or 3 inch slices. Place meat on a broiler pan. Insert a toothpick through the core of each slice. Using a spoon, brush the meat with the ginger mixture. Broil on high for 5 minutes, turn and broil for an additional 5 minutes. Serve meat hot and garnish with minced chiles. Repeat with the remaining tortillas.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,fruit,beef chuck,chat masala,red curry paste,white bread,mayonnaise,spaghetti sauce
title: Curried Beef (Or Pork and Veggies) Sandwich W- Soba Aji
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck, cut into thin slivers | 1 teaspoon red curry paste ( more or less to taste ) | cooking spray | 1/2 cup diced mixed dried fruit ( chutney ) | 1/4 cup mayonnaise ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( more or less to taste ) | 8 slices white bread ( or other bread cut, i like to toast the bread in the oven, it's my fave ) | 1 cup spaghetti sauce ( i like our aji spicy ) | chat masala
instructions: If using aji, spray a non stick frying pan with pam and set it over medium high heat. Saute the beef until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Add the red curry paste and saute 1 - 2 minutes longer. Remove the beef, leaving its fat in the frying pan. In the same pan, add another tablespoon of oil and set it over medium high heat. Saute the fruit until they have just begun to release some of their juices, about 3 or 5 minutes, but are not browned. Remove from the pan and set aside. Preheat the broiler. Cut the bread diagonally to form triangles. Place them on a baking sheet. Brush each with aji and place under the broiler. Watch them for a few minutes. To serve, sprinkle each with aji and a little bit of the sauce. Enjoy.

title: Japanese Sweet Pepperoni Dip or Salad
ingredients: 24 ounces pepperoni | 8 ounces capers | 2 kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 10 -12 tablespoons mirin | 2 -3 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Slice the peppers, remove the seeds, and slice thin. Cut the capers into small pieces, and slice about 1/8, or use all salted capers. Remove the lime leaves and chop them. Wash up the kaffir lime leaves, and place them in a pan with the capers, chili flakes, and kaffir lime leaves, if using. Add the mirin and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat, cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes.. Cool completely, refrigerate for 1 hour, stir, and serve with your favorite cold dishes. The longer it sets, the spicier it will be.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian sausage,orange peel,salt pepper,caper,yoghurt,red curry paste,vegetable oil
title: Thai Style Red Curry Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 cans vegetarian sausage | 1 tablespoon capers, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated | 2 cups yoghurt | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a large wide saucepan. Saute curry paste over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add sausage, capers, orange peel and yoghurt and stir well. Stir in salt and pepper to taste just to combine. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,kahlua,beef chuck,italian salad dressing mix,brown sugar
title: Kahlua Crock Pot Italian Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef chuck ( or other inexpensive cuts of beef cut in a thick slice ) | 1 bottle kahlua ( a coffee liqueur ) | 1 ounce italian salad dressing mix ( i use newman's own ) | 1/2 tablespoon brown sugar ( optional ) or 1/2 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Lay the beef in the bottom of the crock pot. Strain the kahlua, italian dressing mix and brown sugar or splenda and combine in a small bowl, add the meat. Dump the kahlua mixture on top of the meat. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. The meat should be falling apart. Slice to serve.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,orange juice concentrate,hot italian sausage,mustard,curry paste,cashew
title: Spicy Bombay Cashew Nuts With Asian Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, sliced into large rounds | 2 hot italian sausages | 1/2 cup cashews, cashews should be coarsely broken | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 can orange juice concentrate or ( 8 ounce ) can lemon juice concentrate | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 -2 tablespoon curry paste ( your favorite )
instructions: In a bowl, mix together all ingredients except cashews. Set aside. Cook in a skillet with some oil on medium high heat.

title: Broiled Chicken Wings
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | 2 egg whites | 1 cup fat free egg substitute
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Place the chicken wings on the hot grill and cook for about 17 minutes, turning once. Place the wings on a lightly oiled broiler pan. Brush all over with the egg whites. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Turn wings over and broil for an additional 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,black cardamom pod,red curry paste,salt pork,red potato,cream tartar
title: Creamy Curry Salt Pork (Indian-Style)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/4 cup cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon freshly ground black cardamom pod | 1 pound boneless salt pork, thinly sliced | 1 cup red potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce
instructions: Stir the curry paste, cream of tartar, and black cardamom seeds in a large skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Cook and stir the salt pork in the hot liquid until browned all over, about 10 minutes. Add the red potatoes, teriyaki sauce, and enough water to cover the potato slices. Reduce heat to low.

title: Baked Lebs in Cream
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly flour baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, cut puff pastry into rounds about 1/4 thick. Prick with a fork and brush with cream. Bake for approximately 5 minutes, or until golden. Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Giant Shrimp in Fragrant Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 1 small red chile pepper, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 pound medium shrimp, shelled and deveined, tails left on | 24 leaves fresh figs, stems removed
instructions: Arrange the chile pepper slices in a circular fashion on the side of a plate. Sprinkle evenly with salt. Arrange the shrimp on top of the chile pepper slices. Spread the fig leaves around the shrimp. Seal, and refrigerate for 6 hours to set.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,italian salad dressing mix,coriander leaf,tarragon,beef brisket,herb,rye bread,beetroot
title: Brisket of Beef With Herbed Fennel and Rye Wedges
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket ( such as chuck ) | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix | 3 tablespoons dried tarragon | 3 tablespoons dried coriander leaves | 3 tablespoons dried italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 6 pieces rye bread | 3 ounces jarred herbed pickled beetroots, drained of juice | 2 teaspoons ground coriander leaves
instructions: Place a kettle or heavy bottomed pot over high heat and add brisket, fat side down, to the pot. Season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. When the brisket just begins to smoke, put a large slotted spoon or spoonful of italian dressing mixture into the pot. The mustard will be mixed with the dressing. Stir in tarragon, coriander, italian salad dressing mix and fennel seeds. Cover the brisket and place it in the pot. Turn down the heat so the brisket is just covered. Simmer the brisket until almost done, about 1 1/2 hours. Turn off the heat and leave brisket in the pot for at least 24 hours, preferably up to 1 day. Turn off the heat and remove brisket from pot to a cutting board. Reserve broth, refrigerate overnight. Drain brisket and let cool completely. When fully cooled, slice into thin slices across the grain. Place slices in a baking dish. Brush with the remainder of the remaining italian salad dressing. Sprinkle with the toasted bread, herbs and garnishes. Serve hot with remaining coriander.

title: Smoked Salmon With Fennel
ingredients: 4 -6 teaspoons salt | 2 -3 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 -3 lbs smoked salmon | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: To toast fennel, in a dry skillet, toast the fennel seeds until golden brown, 10 to 15 seconds. Place the fennel in a food processor, or spice grinder along with some water.

Random Ingredients: chicken base,extra virgin olive oil,red bell pepper,baking powder,vegetable stock,broth
title: Easy Vegetable Pot Roasted Red Pepper Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided | 8 cups homemade stock | 2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon chicken base | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 2 cups coarsely chopped red bell peppers
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the red bell peppers and stock, and toss to combine. Season the soup base with baking powder and 1 1/4 teaspoons salt. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer 90 minutes. Season the soup base with remaining 1 tablespoon oil.

title: Thai Steak
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 3 1/2 lbs flank steaks ( about 8 ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh basil ( about 1/2, or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons thick & chunky salsa ( can use mild ) | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Melt margarine in 10 inch skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper. Cook, turning once, until browned and cooked to desired doneness, about 4 minutes per side. Transfer to platter and keep warm. Pour off fat from skillet. Add basil, vinegar, salsa and curry. Heat through. Drizzle over steak.

title: Tahini Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1/8 teaspoon rosemary | 1/8 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweet nuts | 1/2 cup very thinly cut radish | 1/4 cup oil for frying | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed
instructions: Stir together tahini, rosemary, 1/4 cup olive oil, raisins, nuts, and radish in a bowl. Gradually stir 2 tablespoon of oil into dressing to make dressing smooth. Serve with hot, cooked tortillas or fresh flatbread. This can be served warm or cold.

title: Spicy Beef Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup packed fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 1 cup shredded red cabbage
instructions: In a serving bowl, lightly mix mint with hot pepper sauce. Stir cabbage into mint mixture. Serve on a bed of the beef.

title: Veal Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup fresh veal, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup dried garbanzo beans | 1 teaspoon triple sec
instructions: Place veal pieces in a slow cooker. Stir in garlic and triple sec.

title: Egg Noodles  - Sausage With Rice Wine
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked egg noodles, about | 4 -5 ounces uncooked sausage ( such as veal ) | 3/4 cup rice wine ( such as chardonnay )
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the sausage until done. Do not overcook, it should still be slightly firm. Drain and discard any casings. Cook the noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again in a colander, then toss with the sausage. Cover and keep warm over very low heat. Add the rice wine to the sausage cooking water and cook until it is reduced by half and the rice wine is absorbed. Serve hot, garnished with sliced scallions and additional sliced scallions, if desired.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,pimento,green pepper,parsley leaf,lamb,wheat bread,tamarind paste,green onion
title: Lamb Meat Kefta Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 cup sliced green pepper | 2 teaspoons chopped parsley leaves | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 -3 green onions, chopped | 1 small jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped, to taste | 1/2 cup pimento, diced ( pimenton de la vera ) | 3 slices whole wheat bread ( toasted or toasted ) | chopped fresh parsley leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Using your hands, mix together the lamb, green pepper, parsley, tamarind paste, green onions, chile, pimento, and pimenton. Divide among the 4 large serving plates. Garnish with parsley leaves to serve.

title: Chewy Roast Pumpkin
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pumpkin, peeled and cut into wedges | 3 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 dash pepper | 1 large tomato, sliced into thin wedges | 1/4 cup frozen tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Mix together the tahini, parmesan, and pepper. Spread mixture over the cut surface of the pumpkin to form a large thick roast. Arrange the tomato wedges around the roast. Place roast on a baking sheet and bake just until heated through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,gruyere cheese,red bean paste,bok choy,artichoke heart,eggplant
title: Artichoke & Gruyere Pasta Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 7 ounces red beans paste | 3 ounces artichoke hearts, drained | 2 ounces leggplant, peeled, cut into cubes | 3 green and white bok choy, chopped ( i use baby bok choy ) | 7 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Place to one side.

title: Hot Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons bottled hot pepper sauce | cooking spray
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, hot pepper sauce and pepper sauce. Spray a small serving dish with cooking spray and pour vinegar mixture into it. Add vegetables, stir, and serve.

title: Lighter Crock Pot Greek Cheese Dip for One (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup ( low fat or fat free ) | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 cup nonfat sour cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients in the crock pot. Cook on low for at least 3 hours.

title: Mushroom and Cabbage (Kai Nei Gai)
ingredients: 7 -10 ounces cabbage | 1/2 head shiitake mushroom | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 tablespoon light golden syrup, warmed
instructions: Break up the cabbage fairly fine as you work. You should have about 1 quart of cabbage. Remove leaves from heads if they are too big, but do not cut into large pieces cut mushrooms in half, and put them in a bowl with the cabbage. Melt a little of the glaze in a small saucepan, remove excess, add a little of the half and half, mix well, bring to a boil and then reduce heat to very low. Put the cabbage mixture in the skillet in the bowl you cooked it inches cook for a minute, taste and add more glaze if needed. This will make a fine paste, you need to take it out before serving, to keep it warm. You can also stir it now, but take it as soon as it's hot and there are any lumps.

title: Canadian Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup maple syrup | 1 lb walnuts
instructions: Mix well and store in a small container. To use, use a baster to brown walnuts in a small frying pan. To serve, use 1 tsp of maple syrup with 1 cup water.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,garlic clove,lite olive oil,tabasco sauce,orange peel
title: Pineapple Olive Oil Marinade for Fish
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice | 1 cup lite olive oil | 4 garlic cloves, mashed | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange peel, grated | 2 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over fish.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,dark soy sauce,chicken stock cube,fish sauce
title: Easy Peasy Rice
ingredients: 1 lb basmati rice | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce ( dark is my preference however ) | 1 chicken stock cube ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Boil water and cook rice according to the directions on the rice package. Once the water is boiling, dump in the rice and stir well. Let cook for about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well and allow to sit for about 3 to 4 minutes, until the fish out of the bag is hot and everything is mixed inches. Enjoy with some thai basil and other fresh vegetables.

title: Scented Beets
ingredients: 1 kg beet, grated | 350 g icing sugar | 300 g ground lamb shoulder | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees celcius. Mix beet, icing sugar and ground lamb. Roll into small balls. Insert vanilla bean inside.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,limeade concentrate,garlic oil,pork chop,quinoa,cottage cheese,onion juice
title: Guilt-Free, Low-Fat Cabbage Baked Pork Chops & Quinoa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon finely minced fresh onion ( or 1 green onion, finely chopped or 1 shallot, finely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons garlic oil | 1 cup finely shredded fresh head of cabbage | 1 can fat-free cottage cheese | 6 pork chops, each cut crosswise into 3/4-inch slices | 2 cups cooked quinoa
instructions: Prepare the quinoa according to package directions, omitting fat and salt. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine limeade concentrate and 1 1/2 tblsps water. Stir & set aside. In a medium bowl, combine the onion and 2 tblsps water. Toss to coat. Cover & refrigerate 12 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350 degrees, then remove pork chops from marinade & discard marinade. In a large shallow baking dish, combine the cabbage, cottage cheese & 1/2 cup water. Spread meat evenly on top of the quinoa. Spoon 1/4 cup of the quinoa mixture over meat. Spread the rest of the quinoa evenly over the quinoa, then top with the pork chops & meat on top of the quinoa. Pour limeade concentrate mixture evenly over meat & quinoa. Bake 1 hour. Remove from oven & top with the remaining 1/2 cup of quinoa mixture. Continue baking for another 20 minutes or until quinoa is hot & meat is thoroughly cooked. Serve over hot cooked quinoa.

title: Fried Dates With Tamarind and Pecorino-Cocoa
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried pears | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 3 tablespoons tapioca | 3 tablespoons chopped pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped dates, to garnish
instructions: Place pears in a small saucepan and cover with boiling water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, reserving the soaking liquid. Let pears cool then peel if desired. Chop pears very coarse and transfer to a mixing bowl. Add the cocoa, turmeric and cheese. Using your hands, mix until all the ingredients are evenly mixed. Stir in the chopped pears and the dates. Chill the mixture completely. Transfer the mixture into a small, heavy skillet. Cook over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes, until you see the bottom of the fritter and the underside of the mixture turn golden brown. Remove from the heat and serve in small individual dishes. This dish can also be made with finely chopped and crushed choped almonds. It also makes great gifts and can be made 2 days in advance. Keep chilled until served.

title: Italian Vegetable Kebabs
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 3 1/2 - 4 cups all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and diced
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine yeast, 2 cups flour, and oregano. Gradually add remaining flour so as to make a smooth, soft dough. Allow to rest about 2 hours in a warm place until doubled in size. Lightly grease the top of a large metal kebab pan with vegetable oil. Cut 2 inch round from side of skewer to top and set aside. Place bamboo on the skewer and push bamboo until it starts to curl. Push bamboo through center of the bread using the kabab's skewer marks and press down lightly. Cut the bread in half. Serve with tomato basil sauce if you like.

title: Austrian Apricot Jam  (Stroopf)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ouzo, melted | 3 packages apricot preserves or ( 4 ounce ) packages other jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Mix together the ouzo and jam in a small pot. Slowly pour the ouzo mixture into the hot pan, stirring in a figure 8 motion to scrape the sides of the pan. Boil briskly until reduced by one third, 5 to 7 minutes. Strain the jam and measure out 1 cup to 1/3 cup of jam. Fill jelly jars leaving 1/3 cup of the liquid in the pot. Close jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace and sealing lids. Heat scalding water in a large skillet over medium high heat 3 to 5 minutes. Working quickly, grasp and turn jars. Return water to a boil, cover and boil for 15 minutes, removing lid and pan. Remove jars and cool completely. Store jam jars in a cool, dark place for up to 1 month.

title: Guilt-Free Japanese Rice (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 2 pints guilt-free soy milk ( soyboy or girl ) | 3/4 cup dry vermouth ( dry white wine ) | 1 can tomato paste ( contadina ) | 1 cup fat free non-adjusted margarine or 1 cup vegan margarine | 3/4 cup sweet rice cereal
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, whisk together the soy milk, vermouth, tomato paste, margarine and sweet rice cereal without overworking the cereal. Pour into 9x13 pan, bake for 30 to 45 minutes and let cool. Serve immediately.

title: Lace Fritters
ingredients: 8 ounces panir | 1 large baking potato, boiled peeled and shredded | 1 ounce graham cracker crumbs | 2 ounces liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine all ingredients. Drop spoonfuls into oil and fry until golden brown on bottom, flipping once. Serve immediately.

title: Lemon Parsnips Roasted in a Salt-Griddle for the Grill
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, washed | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice ( this is not needed for fresh lemons ) | 2/3 cup good quality chicken flavored salt-free lemon juice
instructions: Boil, steam, or steam the parsnips until tender. Do not overcook, the parsnips should be crisp but not soft. Drain, run through a sieve to dry, and pat dry with a paper towel. Combine the lemon juice and salt in a bowl. Pour the lemon juice mixture over the parsnips. Toss. Cover and place in the cool oven to stay cold.

title: Chocolate Chip Fingers
ingredients: 8 ounces good quality unsweetened cocoa | 6 ounces flour | 1 lime wedge | grated lemon peel
instructions: Heat oven to 350&deg.

title: Beet-Apricot Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup canned pear-champ tomato | 1 large plum tomato, cut into wedges | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried chipotle powder | 1 jar apricots, halved | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder
instructions: Place the barley and pear into a saucepan. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat, add the plum tomato and continue to simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the ground dried chipotle and paprika. Continue to simmer until the vegetables are tender. Pour mixture into a bowl, and toss to recombine.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,coriander powder,bouquet garni,white asparagus,espresso powder,ziti pasta,breadcrumb,horseradish
title: Italian Asparagus Ziti
ingredients: 2 cups ziti pasta | 8 -12 slices white asparagus | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1 teaspoon instant horseradish | 15 ounces white asparagus ( canned ) | 1 teaspoon creamed horseradish | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon dry breadcrumbs ( plain or flavored ) | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1 teaspoon instant horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso powder
instructions: Place frozen asparagus in microwave and cover with water. Microwave on high uncovered 1 minute. Using tongs or two forks, remove asparagus and cut each in half lengthwise. Heat up coffee in microwave. Mix 1 tbs. Butter with 2 tbs. Horseradish and 1 tbs. Cream horseradish with remaining herbs in a bowl. Add bread crumbs and espresso powder to butter mixture and blend well. Drain asparagus and then spread on a clean dish towel so as to absorb any extra liquid. Cover dish towel with towel and microwave on high for 10 minute remove asparagus and discard excess moisture and place asparagus pieces onto clean dish towel. Cover dish towel with towel and microwave on high 4 minute. Remove paper towel from oven and stir butter mixture. When serving, top plate of asparagus with grated asparagus and more horseradish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,golden raisin,green onion,self rising flour,tomato,pillsbury fudge brownie mix
title: Brownie Mix Tomato Raisin Bread
ingredients: 1 box pillsbury fudge brownie mix | 1/2 cup pitted golden raisins, thawed | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 3 -4 tablespoons green onions, finely chopped ( aka scallions ) | 28 ounces crushed tomatoes | 1/2 cup self rising flour
instructions: Prepare instant brownie mix per instructions. Combine drained raisins and salt. Dump all ingredients into a large bowl and mix with hands until mixture resembles a coarse meal. Turn bowl onto floured surface and knead 1min or until smooth.. Cut loaf in half diagonally and place half in greased 9 x 15 inch baking dish. Sprinkle half the raisin batter atop the bread and scatter rest of ingredients around, covering entire loaf with batter. Bake at 350 degrees farenheit for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pea,kirsch,kaffir lime leaf,white fish fillet,mint leaf
title: Minted Fish
ingredients: 1 fresh white fish fillet | 2 pkt kirsch | 12 fresh mint leaves, roughly chopped | 2 kaffir lime leaves, torn and finely chopped | 1/4 cup boiled tiny peas
instructions: Preheat grill. Tear 4 sheets of aluminium foil over a large board and scatter with leaves. Rinse the fish fillet under running water and pat dry with paper towels. Brush with kirsch and place on top of the dry leaves. Cut a cross in the top of each fillet and scatter the mint, lime leaves and chopped peas over it. Close the sheet and cut a slit into the centre of each parcel, being careful not to cut into the fish, to allow the steam to escape easily. Repeat with remaining fish and vegetables and cook until cooked. Open the parcels, remove any skin.

title: Crispy Swiss Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup swiss cheese ( cubed ) | 3 ounces caperberries
instructions: Spray a mini muffin tin with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine cheese and capers. Spread mixture evenly evenly into prepared muffin tin. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400 degrees.

title: Cheese Puffs (Peanut or Mushroom)
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes | 0.5 jar sliced mushrooms, drained | 1 envelope chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed | 1 tablespoon chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1 cup shredded mexican melting cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Open one can of stewed tomatoes. Place tomatoes in 2 13x9 inch baking dishes. Place drained mushrooms over tomatoes. Sprinkle with water and bouillon granules, crushing garlic and herbs slightly as desired. Top with peanuts and cheese. Bake 20 minutes. Let stand 2 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: rocket,molasses,sherry wine,cherry tomato,pineapple juice,avocado,kaffir lime leaf,kielbasa
title: Kielbasa Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 4 ounces pineapple juice | 2 ripe kaffir lime leaves | 8 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 avocado, cut into large chunks | salt and chopped cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Brown kiel in a frying pan for about 10 minutes or until just white. Remove from the pan, pour in the molasses, and toss in the sherry. Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, place the pineapple juice, lime leaves, cherry tomatoes, and drained kiel in a bowl, cover and refrigerate until cold, about 30 minutes. Once cold, stir well to loosen the kiel slices. Drain off excess fat and stir in the avocado. Spoon into avocado halves. Serve topped with chopped cilantro. Variation, kielbasa can also be made ahead. Cut the sausages into 1 inch cubes and toss them along with the juices from the dish the original recipe called for, and set aside for about an hour before serving, making sure to keep the juices.

title: Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 2 lbs pork carnitas or 2 lbs pork butt | 1 cup salsa or 1 cup homemade salsa | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves
instructions: Cut carnitas into thirds. Wrap in two 3 inch sections and place in plastic bag. Refrigerate for 1 hour or longer. Place meat on grill and cook on medium high heat, stirring occasionally to prevent burning, for 15 minutes. Cover loosely and let stand 10 minutes. Turn. Grill for 20 minutes. Pour off fat. In small bowl combine salsa, vinegar and oregano. Add to meat and stir to coat. Cover and return to the grill. Cover and cook 10 minutes more. Turn. Grill uncovered 5 minutes more or until meat shreds easily with fork. Discard liquid. Cool until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: pimento,lemon juice zest,granny smith apple,bow tie pasta,rice krispies
title: Apple Strudel #RiceKrispies and Pimentos
ingredients: 1/4 cup red pimento | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, zest of | 6 ounces uncooked bow tie pasta | 1/2 cup crispy rice krispies
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Saute red pimento, apple, lemon juice and zest until fruit is semi soft and syrupy. Add rice krispies and stir. Spread mixture evenly into a 9x13 inch pan spread warm sauce over evenly, sprinkle with crisp rice krispies. Bake 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: juice,taco seasoning mix,cilantro leaf,ear corn cob,fennel bulb
title: Spicy Soft Roasted Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 corn on the cob ( about 2 1/4 pounds ) | 4 ears corn on the cob ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup minced fresh cilantro leaves | 1 package taco seasoning mix, contents | juice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f rub corn well with seasoning mix. Place on rack in roasting pan. Bake, turning every 30 minutes and rearranging husks and corn over the course of the night. Baste every few hours until the kernels are dark and starting to burst, about 45 - 50 minutes for the first 10 - 15 minutes. Baste every 20 minutes during this time on the way out. When the corn is cooked, remove the corn husks onto a rack or cookie sheet and cool completely, about 20 minutes, or more, so the corn can easily separate. When the kernels are cool enough to handle, coarsely chop some of them and set aside. You can put everything in a blender and combine with remaining chopped corn. The texture should be similar to a chunky salsa that the corn was cooked inches. If necessary, thin with a little water to reach the desired consistency. Serve hot, with desired toppings.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,orange,water,grain white rice,self raising flour,pork loin roast,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Pork Rice and Chilies Casserole
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork loin roast, trimmed of visible fat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can chopped green chilies, undrained | 2 cups water | 1 cup medium grain white rice | 4 1/2 cups water | 1 1/2 cups shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 oranges, juice of | 1/4 cup orange rind, minced
instructions: Place pork in a 6 quart slow cooker.

title: Fish in Okra Sauce
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets | 2 okra | 1 red snapper fillet | 12 okra | 1/2 cup fish stock or 1/2 cup fish stock | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | pepper
instructions: Slice the fish fillets very thinly. Chop the okra. Heat the fish and okra to your taste. Pour the fish stock, mustard seeds and pepper into wok. Cook on low heat for about 30 seconds, stirring often. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,taco seasoning mix,french bread,pineapple juice,brown rice,cannellini bean
title: Quick Beef and Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chuck steak | 1 can cannellini beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans | 1 1/2 cups brown rice or 1 1/2 cups white rice, cooked | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 can pineapple juice | 12 -15 slices french bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350 f. Cut beef into 1 inch cubes. In 3 1/2 or 4qt. Dutch oven brown meat in oil until browned. Drain meat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and bake 35 - 45 minutes. Turn control to broil and broil until bubbly, 5 - 7 minutes. Serve over french bread.

title: Cheddar and Tamarind Lasagna
ingredients: 8 slices cheddar cheese, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 lime, quartered | 6 lasagna noodle, broken into sections ( approximately 2-1/2 x 6-1/2 inches ) | 1/3 lb feta cheese, crumbled | lettuce | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with non stick olive oil cooking spray. Pour enough boiling water into a kettle or pan to just under the boiling point and bring to a boil. Drop in lasagna noodles and bake until heated throughly. Meanwhile, heat the ketchup in a small skillet until bubbly and starting to caramelize. Remove from heat and pour over noodles and toss. In a bowl combine feta and the ketchup and mix well until coated. When noodles are done, stir in the feta cheese mixture and lime quarters. Transfer noodles to the prepared pan.

title: Kumquat Spinach Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 3/4 lb kumquats | 4 ounces spinach | 6 chicken quarters | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 7 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Slice off the kombu zest and use for garnishing the chicken as well. Add spinach to a colander and set in microwave for one minute, drain. In a skillet, place chicken breasts in the bottom of a slow cooker pan, then add the sliced kumquats, spinach and alfredo sauce. Prick kumquats in several places with a toothpick to allow steam to escape. Add lemon juice and zest of lemon and lemon. Cook on high for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, then reduce to low and continue cooking for another 2 hours. Add half and half, stir, and serve over cooked egg noodles.

title: Lentils, Tuna  and Mushrooms (Mediterranean) Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup lentils | 400 g tuna | 3 mushrooms
instructions: Place lentils and mushrooms in pot. Add tuna and 1/2 cup water. Cook until water boils. Boil 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Sliced Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 lb leftover roast beef | 2 ounces rye flour
instructions: In a medium bowl mix up cumin and chili powder. Roll roast in rye flour and place in a baking dish. Cover and bake in a 375°f oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with green beans or white rice.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,walnut,carrot,chili flake,green chili pepper,chicken thigh
title: Mexican Lime  Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs or 2 lbs chicken breasts | 2 cups coarsely chopped walnuts | 1 medium sized carrot, finely chopped | 1 chopped chili flakes ( adjust to taste ) | 1 fresh lime, juice of | green chili pepper, chopped ( to taste )

Serve topped with sour cream, cheese, salsa, lettuce or hot cooked tortilla chips.

instructions: Prepare the chicken.

title: A Unique Chicken, Rice & Kale Salad
ingredients: 1/3 - 3/4 cup red wine ( i use merlot ) | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped ( or 1 tsp. dried ) | 2 -3 cups cooked chicken, cubed ( i use cooked turkey but you can use whatever chicken you want ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes, drained ( i use a can of diced tomatoes ) | 1 bunch kale, stemmed and chopped | 1 package uncle bill chicken-flavored rice ( i use lipton ) | 3/4 - 1 cup sweet chili sauce ( i use flying goose brand ) | 12 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except for rice in a large bowl, except the rice. Add the rice. Add the chicken and mix gently. Add the chili sauce and serve with toasted buns or crudites.

instructions: Mix all ingredients.

instructions: Heat grill. In large bowl, combine bread cubes, raspberries, bamboo shoots, corn, tomato puree and cream cheese. Toss lightly. Place in an airtight container and refrigerate for 1 hour. Combine sour cream and kiwifruit in bowl. Spoon into serving dish. Sprinkle with remaining fruit. Sprinkle with mint and mint. May be served immediately.

title: Sweet Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup coconut cream, not sweetened | 1/8 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Mix together and spread on dry cookies or toast. Serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,green lentil,cherry tomato,five spice powder,half
title: Cherry Tomato and Lentil Fritters
ingredients: 100 g green lentils, rinsed | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 pint single serving half-and-half | 1 -2 cherry tomatoes | 1 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mix well and knead gently until combined. Divide mixture into four equal portions and roll each section into an 8 inch round. Roll each round into a ball and flatten out to a circle. Place the fritters onto a non stick baking tray lined with baking paper and bake in a preheated 180°c oven for 20 minutes. Serve straight away, on their own or with salad and bread.

title: Pear Tingles
ingredients: 1 ripe pear ( about 3 ounces, the more pears they're used ) | 1 jar marjoram, well-washed, well-washed and well-washed
instructions: Cut off peel and pith from pear. Cut out core then use elsewhere for the marinade. Use as desired. Tie pear halves in a cheesecloth bag or twist off the bag a few times to make a pouch for the marinade. The pears will be ready when the flesh is light brown. You can keep some of the pears in them to store or use for marinating.

title: Pumpkin Veggie Toasties
ingredients: 1 egg | 2 tablespoons prepared mashed pumpkin | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 slice white bread, torn into small pieces | 1 cup chopped fresh broccoli
instructions: Place egg, pumpkin, flour, and garlic powder in a small bowl and mix well. Remove crusts from crumbled bread. Place bread into a separate bowl using a fork, then place 1/2 cup of the mashed pumpkin mixture on top. Using your hands, blend the bread into the mixture well. Set bread out of the bowl and sprinkle remaining pumpkin mixture over the top. Place sprinh in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat and cook for approximately 1 to 2 minutes, or until golden brown. Turn over and cook for another minute or two, or until lightly browned on the other side. Serve with your favorite veggie toppings.

title: Lazy Pea Dip (With Ramen Noodle)
ingredients: 1 package dried green peas | 1 cup bottled honey-baked ramen noodles | 1/4 cup prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the peas in a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover with foil. Bake in preheated oven 45 minutes. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. Remove the foil and stir in the peas 1 cup at a time. Cover the dish with a lid or a roasting pan. Return to oven for 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Oysters
ingredients: 25 fresh oysters | 1/4 cup tapioca flour | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Place oysters on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes. Place flour on a plate and mix in tapioca until mixture is a smooth paste. Gradually fold in vinegar until it just reaches a creamy consistency. Set aside until cool. Cut into slices and set aside until serving time. Wrap each oyster with a slice of prosciutto. Secure with toothpicks. Place on a small serving platter and serve.

title: Roasted Spanish Onions for One
ingredients: 1 large spanish onion, peeled, cut in half | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh sage, leaves rubbed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the onion halves on a foil lined baking sheet. Rub liberally with sage. Roast until tender about 30 minutes.

instructions: Boil water. Drop the chipotle peppers in until the flesh changes colour. Drain well and puree with the juice in a blender. Add the blueberries and simmer until just tender. Meanwhile, toast the oatmeal in a separate pan to dry, adding the curry powder. Set aside. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Drop in the pasta and cook until just tender.

title: Easy Chinese Dill Puffs

instructions: Mix egg beaters and vinegar in small bowl. Microwave at highest setting 7 minutes or until mixture begins to froth, stirring a few times. Transfer mixture to small bowl. Add pickle pieces. Serve as an extra on sandwiches.

title: Beef Stewed in Red Apples
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless beef stew meat, fat trimmed and cut into 1 inch chunks | 6 red apples or 5 small red delicious apples | 1 can sweetened red wine or ( 4 ounce ) can apple juice
instructions: Spray slow cooker with cooking spray. Place beef in slow cooker.

title: Cashew Crumbs
ingredients: 4 cups cashews, toasted ( raw, unsalted, or coarsely ground ) | 2 teaspoons seasoning ( or to taste )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Break up any large cashews or coarsely ground them. Add the cashews or coarsely ground cashews. Season to taste with salt if needed and sprinkle with the seasoning. Bake until the nuts are golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Aunt Tootie's Famous Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 2 1/3 cups peanut oil
instructions: In a skillet, bring beef to a boil. Stir in a tablespoon of peanut oil, then lower heat and continue cooking, stirring until meat is cooked to your desired doneness, about 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Chocolate Sundae: Frankfurt Pistou
ingredients: 1 ounce sweet chocolate, nibbed, at room temperature | 1/4 cup corn oil, melted | 1 scallion, trimmed, chopped, including green ends | 1/2 teaspoon dry basil | 1/4 teaspoon dry mint | 3 ounces eat apricots, drained ( with dried herbs ) | minced mint, for garnish
instructions: In small bowl, stir together the chocolate and corn oil and set aside until cold. Using a knife, cut the scallion greens crosswise in 1 inch lengths. Stir in the basil, mint, mint and chopped apricots. Add the chocolate and mix just until the mixture begins to melt. Drizzle with a little of the mint oil, if desired. Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with mint leaves.

title: Baked Hawaiian Chicken
ingredients: 1 canned hawaiian steak cutlets | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped shallots | 1 cup finely shredded lettuce leaf | 1 unbaked pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in medium bowl, mash kikkoman style mayonnaise with a fork. Stir in vinegar and shallots. Spread mixture evenly across bottom of dough large enough to hold it. Place 1 kikkoman style mayonnaise on top of mayonnaise. Top with lettuce and top with remaining roll. Press together edges of pastry to seal if necessary. Bake in center of oven 15 to 20 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

title: Spicy Tuna Baked Onions
ingredients: 3/4 pound dried heirloom tomatoes | 1/4 cup minced fresh dill | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed ), cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place tomatoes on baking sheet. Mix dried dill and red curry paste in a bowl and sprinkle evenly over the tops of tomatoes. Bake in the preheated oven until tomato skins shrivel and soften, about 20 minutes.

instructions: Season steaks with grill seasoning. Mix remaining ingredients in a resealable plastic bag. Place bag in breading mixture.

title: Broccoli Con Raisins
ingredients: 3/4 1/4 lb broccoli floret or 3/4 lb baby cabbage | 1/2 cup white sugar or 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1/4 cup dry white wine, good quality | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Heat broiler and line baking sheet with foil. Microwave broccoli in 1/2 tsp salt for 3 minutes at 100 percent power. Cool under running water on wire rack until cool enough to handle, drain. Cut coarsely into thin ribbons and set aside. Wrap each spear with a strip of green onion, a drizzle of sugar and a pinch or two of salt, and place in a bowl or serving dish.

Remove from heat and stir in green salad mixture until well coated.

instructions: Place noodles into a large heatproof bowl. Add yogurt and grated apple and season to taste with salt. Pour brandy and apple juice into a saucepan and heat gently. title: Indian Pizza (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c heat 1/4 cup of oil in a 10cm deep frying pan. Add the lasagna noodles, cook until beginning to soften, stirring regularly. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the filling is hot and bubbling. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Shiitake Mixed Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 bunch red cabbage | 1/2 lb fresh shiitake mushrooms, stem removed | 2 inches ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cut the cabbage lengthwise into six, and then into 3 equal parts. Scald the shiitake in a saucepan of hot water, remove it from the water, and allow to cool slightly. Chop the ginger paste into small pieces. Put the water in a skillet, add the ginger paste, and boil over high heat until the mixture is reduced to a nice glaze, about 12 minutes. Remove from heat and pour over the cabbage. Sprinkle with pepper, and mix everything together well. Serve cold.

title: Bread improver (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 3 g yeast | 500 g bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Put yeast in a large bowl and mix in 1/2 cup warm water. Using a fork, stir to dissolve the yeast. Put flour and fennel seeds in a bowl or bread machine, stir into yeast mixture, and knead for 8 to 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic. Place dough on a floured surface and cover with greased plastic wrap. Let rise for 1 hour in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Knock plastic out of dough with your hands as required. On a floured surface or machine, shape dough into loaves about 2 inches in diameter. Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Place a baking sheet onto oven rack and put baking sheet in oven. Bake until tops are nicely browned, 7 to 10 minutes, and check after 15 minutes to see if dough is set.

title: Mexican Fiesta

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine bisquick and 1 cup of cheese in a medium bowl, mixing well. Fold in broth, coriander, noodles, chicken bouillon, 2 tsp of mint, pepper and remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Spread in a 12x9 inch baking dish. Bake at 400°f for 20 minutes. Or until hot throughout.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,italian bread,bean,frying chicken,cheese,limeade concentrate,vegetable stock,bell pepper
title: Chicken Pesto Lovers Italian Style
ingredients: 2 lbs frying chicken ( thighs, drumsticks & wings ) | 3 packages cheese ( i use low fat ) | 1 bunch fresh basil, leaves picked ( or sub 3 tablespoons dried basil, rubbed between fingers to release flavor ) | 1 package frozen limeade concentrate ( i use progresso ) | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 cans refried beans | 2 boxes pesto sauce ( i like pesto ) | 1 loaf italian bread ( sliced into 1 pieces )
instructions: The first part can be done a day ahead. Remove chicken from packaging and wash off grease. Remove breast/legs from bag and discard, chop all of the meat into pieces as required. I usually cut up the meat into strips about the size from the back of a 1/4 inch by 3/4 inch cube. Put chicken in a dish and pour on the rest of the pesto. Cover and let sit in fridge for an hour or so. Preheat oven. In a large oven safe pan put in the chicken. You will be cooking the chicken and pesto mixture as follows, in a blender put the first 4 ingredients. Blend until smooth, pour into the pan. Cover and put in oven. Turn chicken once to get the bubbling going on. After around 40 - 45 minutes or so of browning on top if you feel the chicken is getting too moist to handle just turn the broiler on for the last ten 15 minutes of baking. Remove from oven and place on plate. Then add to the broiler. Continue to broil till the cheese has begun to brown. Remove and set aside. Then take a nice slice of italian bread and rub both sides of the bread with 2 tablespoons of the pesto. This is very messy. Put bread in the oven and warm up so the bread can get soft with no burning. The next time if you are making pesto ahead for a later meal, remove the crust and add 2 tablespoons pesto in there. You may want to broil the bread slices on first, but take care not to overcook the slices or they will get soggy. When the cheese is browned, just flip over on one side, then remove and put on plate.

title: Coconut Mushroom Dip

instructions: Add all ingredients to blender, except green onion. Blend till desired consistency is achieved. Keep aside. Microwave button mushrooms for about 1 - 2 minute on hi. Stir fry mushrooms in oil and serve hot with naan or chapati.

title: Tzatziki (Vegetarian Mexican Bean Salad)
ingredients: 1 can cannellini white kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( white kidney beans ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro, leaves only | 1 tablespoon garlic granules | 1/4 cup lime juice, fresh lemon only, bottled | 1/2 teaspoon sumaq | lettuce, chopped | lime wedge
instructions: Place kidney beans, vanilla bean, cilantro, garlic, lime juice, and sumaq in a blender and puree. Taste and adjust seasoning. In a bowl, combine cilantro with the marinade. Add lettuce to the bean mixture and stir to combine. Serve over lettuce.

title: Salmon Quiche With Chocolate Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed | 3/4 cup coconut milk | 4 large eggs, lightly beaten | 3 ounces unsweetened chocolate chips | 1 -2 tablespoon choc-covered dried salmon or 1 -2 tablespoon other smoked salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Unfold the dough. Using a 9 inch pie plate, cut a 13 in circle. Prick the circle of dough with a fork and transfer to the baking sheet. Bake until browned and puffed up, 10 to 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooled crust to a plate and refrigerate until cool. For the sauce, pour the coconut milk into a medium bowl and set aside. Whisk in the eggs. Stir in the chocolate chips. Using a pastry brush, generously brush each pastry circle with the choc milk and arrange layers of salmon and chocolate onto half the circle of crust, leaving a 1 border around the edges. Carefully cover the fish with the remaining half crust, pressing gently to seal. Bake on the bottom rack of the oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°f and continue to bake for a further 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool slightly before cutting into wedges and serving.

title: Warming Wine-Grilled Cheese Balls
ingredients: 7 ounces currants | 1 ounce white wine vinegar | 200 g all-purpose flour | 1 ounce instant onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 dash cocoa
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a jug and use to lightly mould into balls. Cover with cling wrap and put into the fridge for two hours for an extra flavoured flavours to develop. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Roll balls out onto a baking tray, then cut into fingers. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,rosemary leaf,ginger garlic paste,tamarind paste,sherry,buttermilk
title: Napa Dave’s Buttermilk Pork Roast
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons dry spanish rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 quart buttermilk | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1/2 lb lean pork roast, cut into 6 pcs
instructions: Heat the oven to 500 degrees. Combine the tamarind paste and ginger garlic paste. Pour 1/2 cup of the buttermilk into the bottom of an ovenproof roasting pan. Add the rosemary& the pinches of the paste& the remaining 1/2 cup buttermilk. Add the roast, cover with aluminum foil& bake about 45 - 50 minutes or until tender and the meat pulls apart easily. If you prefer a medium rare roast, lower the oven heat to 300f & increase the basting time if the roast is exceptionally lean. If the pork feels dry, remove and let rest until it can rest. When the roast is almost ready, cut into slices or thin slices and arrange on a serving platter. Serve with rice bran or other grain.

Random Ingredients: cod,poblano chile,sun tomato,snow pea,beef brisket,vanilla essence
title: Baked Cod and Poblanos (Reduced Fat Baked Fish Tacos)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg fresh cod | 4 poblano chiles ( fresh, dried, seeded and chopped ) | 4 large red fresno chilies ( fresh, seeded and chopped ) or 3 small green chilies ( fresh, seeded and chopped ) | 125 g sun-dried tomatoes | 1 1/2 kg beef brisket ( cut in half ) | 1/2 cup reduced-fat vanilla essence | 50 g snow peas ( chopped ) ( optional )
instructions: Place fish and poblanos in a shallow ovenproof bowl. Add 2 cups water or enough to cover them. Bake at 180 degrees centigrade for 35 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. While cooking, roast the chilies under a very hot griller until the skin is black and softened. Cool and transfer to a dry towel and peel off and discard outer skin and seeds. Cut the fish into 2 - 4 mm dice to make 1 3/4 inch cubes. In a large skillet mix remaining ingredients and simmer on a low heat for 20 minutes. Add the fish and simmer for another 35 - 40 minutes or until the fish is tender and flakes easily with a fork. Transfer and serve with a mixture of warmed tortillas or tostados and steamed green beans.

title: Quick and Easy Rustic Tempura
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rye flour | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix with hands. Divide into 8 equal balls and press slightly. Use a sharp knife to cut in half when both sides are fully set. Place on foil covered baking rack and allow to rest for 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bacon,kiwi,white onion,corn syrup,brussels sprout,jalapeno chilies,peanut oil
title: Brussels Sprouts With Fried Bacon
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 small white onion, cut vertically into eighths | 3 fresh jalapeno chilies, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 2 lbs brussels sprouts, unpeeled, quartered lengthwise | 1 kiwi, peeled and cut lengthwise into 2 wedges
instructions: In a nonstick wok or large skillet, cook chopped bacon over medium hight heat until crisp, 5 - 6 minutes. Transfer bacon to paper towels. Drain fat from pan. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to paper towels to drain. Add onion and jalapenos to bacon drippings in pan. Cook, stirring, until beginning to soften, 1 - 2 minutes. Add corn syrup. Heat to boiling over medium high heat, stirring. Add peanut oil. Return sausage to pan. Add green onion and brussels sprouts. Cook, stirring, until sprouts are tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Transfer to platter. Drizzle with sauce.

Random Ingredients: fava bean,red chilies,gold tequila,icing sugar,bacon,celery seed,pizza dough
title: Foolproof Fava Bean Filling for Calzones
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried fava beans | 1 lb fresh red chilies, stemmed but seeded, washed and halved | 8 ounces fresh pizza dough | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 4 ounces bacon fat | 1 1/4 pints golden tequila | 1 teaspoon celery seed ( optional )
instructions: Soak the fava beans overnight in 4 cups cold water. Drain and pat dry. In a large pot, cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Add the chiles and simmer for 5 minutes. Drain and cool under cold water. Once they have softened but are still bright red in color, transfer to a bowl, cover and refrigerate. Preheat oven to 425°f. In a small bowl, mix together the icing sugar with 2 oz of the bacon fat with the celery seed. Cut the pizza dough into 9 squares. On a floured surface roll out each square until it is about 1/8 inch thick. Spread equal amounts of the fava bean mixture evenly over the dough and roll it up. Place the rolls on the cookie sheet, seam side down. With a sharp knife make a slit on the tops of the calzones and brush with the bacon fat mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the crust is crisp and golden. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cayenne powder,chickpea flour,splenda granular,serrano pepper,white onion,rice,serrano chilies
title: Easy Chili
ingredients: 2 serrano chilies | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 2 cups cooked rice | 1 can chickpea flour ( chickpea flour ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne powder | 1 dash cayenne powder | splenda granular, to taste
instructions: Cut the stem part off the chilies. Remove the seeds and veins and veins and boil them for about 30 to 45 seconds to soften, and remove any veins or seeds or foreign matter. Immediately remove the chilies, and chop off and discard the hard core, but try not to take the seeds out, because you do not want the chili to be as hot. Saute the onion and rice in a 2 - 3 tbsp of oil or ghee until they start to soften and the onion is transparent but not brown. Add the hot mixture to the rice. Stir, bring to a boil, cover and cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes. Stir in the flour, add a bit more water if to dry. At the very end add the sugar. Stir well. Serve hot or warm with pita bread or bread.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,beef stew meat,cooking oil,onion,beef brisket,onion flake
title: Beef & Rice Casserole- Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 1 package long grain rice ( uncle ben's ) | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oil | 1 onion ( medium, chopped ) | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Place rice, meat, chopped onions and beef brisket into a 3 1/2 quart crock pot. Spread rice on top of meat and vegetables. Top with oil, salt, or pepper. Cover. Cook on the low setting for 12 hours. Cook beef in a frying pan, with onion and dried onion flakes. When meat is very tender, remove meat and shred into bite sized pieces. Sprinkle with more onions and parsley before serving. Serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,baking powder,egg white,white mushroom,lamb shank,green chilies,masala,vanilla wafer cooky
title: Lamb Shank Kebabs
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb shanks, trimmed of visible fat, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 bunches fennel seeds | 2 green chilies, finely chopped | 10 large white mushrooms, quartered | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 packet vanilla wafer cookies | 2 large egg whites | 2 tablespoons masala
instructions: First to make your marinade, combine all the ingredients in a small bowl. In a separate bowl, combine the bread crumbs, baking powder and the fennel seeds. Add the dry ingredients to the cubed lamb and stir to coat thoroughly the pieces. Then, cover and set aside for 1 hour in a cool place. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, whisk the egg whites until stiff and set aside. Lightly butter a 2 pound metal skewers or a 6 quart clay stove top casserole dish. Put the lamb and marinade in your prepared casserole dish and nestle in the wafer crumbs. Bake in the center of the oven for 90 minutes and check in the near 20 minutes. If the meat is browning too quickly or if it starts to burn or gets soggy, add a teaspoon of water as needed to get it to the desired consistency. Turn the meat and basting with the reserved pan juices every 20 to 30 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes before removing skewers and placing skewers on a serving dish.

title: Aussie Sweet and Creamy Chiles in Custard
ingredients: 16 serrano chile peppers, halved and seeded | 5 tablespoons low-fat soymilk | 12 tablespoons sweetened soymilk | 1/2 cup custard | 2 ounces mini marshmallows or two ounces finely chopped pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the chiles on a foil lined baking sheet and bake in a 400°f oven for 15 minutes or until tender. Allow to cool and remove the stems and seeds. Remove the chiles from the grill. Cut off the tops and remove the seeds. Cut the flesh and seeds from the peppers and place these into a mortar or mini chopper along with the soymilk, sweetened soymilk and chopped marshmallows. Blend well until smooth. Pour into a medium sized bowl and add a few tablespoons of cool custard. Mix well and chill until ready to serve. Spoon the mixture onto 6 ice cream sheets. Garnish with remaining cherries if desired and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,garlic paste,cocoa powder,broccoli floret
title: Baked Broccoli Burritos
ingredients: 2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place broccoli in a steamer over boiling water, and cover. Cook until bright green and slightly soft, about 15 minutes. Drain, and drain well. Place broccoli in a baking dish, and mix with taco seasoning mix, garlic paste, and cocoa powder. Place on top of hot cooked broccoli burritos, and bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Orange Queso
ingredients: 4 -6 pieces orange peel | 8 -10 soft tortillas
instructions: Cut peel into thin strips. Bring 2 - 3 quarts of water to a full rolling boil. After rolling the tortillas, dip them in the boiling water one by one for 2 seconds, flipping them over and repeating the procedure. Drain excess water. Place tortillas in a deep wide, rich bottomed pan. Add a layer of oranges peel on tortillas. Add a layer of tortillas. Add a layer of the remaining orange peel on top. Finish with the last layer of tortillas then spoon a little bit of the pan juice over the tortillas. Add a small amount of salt on top. Place in a 350f oven for about 1 hour.

title: Baked Okra Wrapped in Banana Leaves
ingredients: 1/2 pound okra, washed and trimmed | 1/2 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/8 teaspoon almond, slivered | 4 slices bananas, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place okra on a baking sheet. Brush oil evenly over okra, and sprinkle with almond slivers. Bake in preheated oven, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Rachael Ray's Penne With Zucchini and Cucumbers
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini, about 1 pound, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 2/3 lb red potatoes, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | ice water, as needed | 1 lb penne | 1 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup corn oil | 5 tablespoons horseradish, drained and minced | 2 tablespoons fresh horseradish, grated
instructions: Combine zucchini, potatoes and water in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,flat leaf parsley,spinach leaf,cumin
title: Spinach and Herb Soup
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach leaves | 1 onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 2 tablespoons finely chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Defrost spinach leaves. Remove tough stems from leaves and chop coarsely. Pour boiling water over spinach and soak about 10 minutes. Add cumin and parsley and continue to cook until soup is thick and leaves are tender.

title: French Apricot Bake
ingredients: 1 can apricot halves, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives ( white and green parts ) | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f combine the apricots, brown sugar and chives. Sprinkle with the cheese. Spread mixture in a greased glass or ceramic baking dish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until heated through and cheese is melted. Note can use fresh apricots.

title: Mexican Quinoa Squares
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( raw, uncooked ) | 1 1/2 cups spring roll wrappers | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa ( or salsa verde salsa ) | 4 tablespoons lemonade | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram ( or oregano, dried herbs ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, dried ( or oregano, dried herbs ) | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/8 teaspoon celery seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Place quinoa and 1 - ¾ cups water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat, cover, and cook until the quinoa is tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain. Combine quinoa and the remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Form the quinoa mixture into 24 even squares, then press squares 1/2 inch apart into the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Buffet Greens
ingredients: 12 collard greens, washed and trimmed | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder
instructions: Trim greens of excess white and brown bits of greens. Bring a large amount of salted water to boiling in a saucepan to a boil. Trim off and discard tough stems. Stir greens, green seasoning and five spice powder together until well mixed. Reduce heat to low and simmer until greens are tender, about 2 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,tomato green chilies,garlic crouton,chili powder
title: Spicy Mexican Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chili powder | 1 can tomatoes with green chilies, well drained | 1 cup dry garlic-flavored croutons | 1 can plum tomatoes, undrained
instructions: In large nonstick skillet, combine chili powder, undrained tomatoes with green chiles, garlic croutons, tomatoes and chili powder.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,fennel seed,basmati rice,rice wine,tabasco sauce
title: Sweet Fennel and Rice Restaurant Basmati and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups medium-grain rice or 1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, washed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( to taste ) or 2 teaspoons other hot pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons sweet rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry, to taste
instructions: Place rice in a shallow bowl or serving dish. In a large, deep frying pan over medium high heat, combine the salt, fennel seeds and tabasco pepper sauce. Sear the rice until lightly golden brown, stirring to coat rice evenly with sauce. Pour syrup over rice and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 5 minutes, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and let stand covered, for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: green apple,provolone cheese,russet potato,coffee,colby monterey jack cheese,hot red chili pepper,beef roast,egg bread
title: The Mighty Chicken French Dip Sandwich
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs boneless beef roast | 6 slices egg bread | 2 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 cups colby lee's colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 cans hot red chili peppers, drained | 6 green apples, diced | 1 cup coffee ( brewed is fine ) | 2 hard-cooked egg slices, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pierce roast all over with a fork, place on a greased rack in a large dutch oven, cover & cook for 30 minutes. Turn off oven, remove roast, & remove roast from pan. Remove meat from pot, reserve drippings. Save drippings, then heat reserved drippings in pot over medium heat. Once heated, add beef & brown on all sides. Drain all but 1 cup of the drippings except 1 tbs. And stir in 1/2 a cup of the colby & 2% of the jack cheese. In a seperate bowl, combine chilies and apples & set aside. Arrange bread slices on oven safe serving tray. Layer pepper mixture, beef in bread slices, then cheese mixture, then repeat with another 1 cup of cheese, colby jack, apple, chilies & cheese. Bake @ 350 degrees f for 35 - 40 minutes, or until cheese is melted & french bread pieces are toasted.

title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb broccoli, florets or 1/2 lb frozen broccoli | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled ( preferably with herbs ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herb ( e.g.garlic, oregano or basil ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste ( chili paste with herbs ) | 4 -8 lettuce leaves
instructions: Cut off lower stem ends of broccoli stalks. Cook broccoli in boiling salted water till just tender crisp. Drain and cool. Peel and coarsely chop. Add feta and herbs to broccoli, stir well. Place on lettuce leaves, lightly stir through. Enjoy.

title: Guacamole Cookie Dough
ingredients: 1 cup honey | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh guacamole | 4 cups all-purpose flour ( bread flour is better )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir the honey, vinegar and guacamole until well blended. Stir in the flour by hand. Cover and let rest at room temperature for at least 3 hours. Divide dough.

title: Chicken Peach Tartar (Melitzanes Tarte Au Manchego)
ingredients: 10 ounces chicken wings, split ( or other white parts, cut on the diagonal from the breast ) | 4 ounces white flour | 1 eggplant, cubed | 2 tablespoons lemon rind, finely grated | 3 tomatoes, sliced | 1/2 cup peach preserves ( peach pie filling ) | 8 ounces miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Place the chicken wings in a roasting pan. Rub the flour over the chicken and roast, uncovered, in the preheated oven for 40 - 50 minutes, or until golden and tender. Meanwhile, wash the eggplant and cube it into small pieces. Place them on paper towels to drain, then set aside. Pour off the juices from the roasting pan. Place the chicken pieces on a large piece of aluminum foil or parchment paper. Fold the aluminum foil over the chicken, and place in the oven. Keep an eye on it so that it doesn't burn. When the chicken is very tender, it should take about 40 minutes for it to be tender. If it is still tough to the touch, place the turkey in the center of a piece of foil. Remove the foil, and slice the chicken pieces as you go. Put on a serving plate and surround with the eggplant, sliced tomatoes, peach preserves, and marshmallows. Serve either at room temperature or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,colby monterey jack cheese,tomato,orange peel,yellow pepper,pearl barley,risotto rice,apple
title: Spanish Rice With Peeled Apple, Pearl Barley & Walnut Stuff
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick risotto rice | 1 apple, peeled, chopped into small bite size pieces | 1 yellow pepper, chopped into small bite size pieces | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and rinsed | 1 can tomatoes | 4 slices orange peel, from a 1-oz. jar | 1 ounce colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup pearl barley, raw
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 9x9 inch casserole dish. Put rice, apple, yellow pepper, water chestnuts, tomatoes and orange peel into the prepared casserole dish. Add the cheese blend, and then add the pearl barley. If you just want to make the casserole more like the normal, do not drain the tomatoes. Bake 25 - 30 minutes, or until browned and crunchy and everything is hot. Let cool slightly and serve immediately with crackers and your choice of red wine.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,self rising flour,cocoa,yogurt,snow pea,red capsicum,tomato paste,red bell pepper
title: Pizza Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup cream cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon cocoa ( optional ) | 1/2 cup green salad green mangoes or 1/2 cup red capsicum, chopped | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup snow peas or 1/2 cup asparagus, sliced | 1/2 cup red capsicum, chopped | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Mix flour, cream cheese, tomato paste and cocoa in a medium bowl. Add mangoes, capsicums, red bell peppers and snow peas. Grease 2 muffin tins. Spoon fulls of mixture into the muffin tins. Bake in oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked through. Serve with extra cheese and chopped parsley.

title: Chocolate Sauerkraut and Sauce (Frosted Version)
ingredients: 3 cans sauerkraut, drained, well-rinsed | 3 pieces semi-sweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Spray a 9x13 or other 2 1/2x4 1/2 quart shallow baking dish with cooking spray. Spread sauerkraut over bottom of baking dish, sprinkle with chocolate, and cover with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Remove from refrigerator 25 to 30 minutes before serving.

title: Pasteis De Carottes - Carrots
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon hot paprika | 1 lb fresh baby carrots, washed with clean, spun-off and trimmed | 1/4 teaspoon ground vanilla extract
instructions: Grind paprika in a mortar with a pestle or in a grinder. Keep coarse salt in a small, heavy saucepan. Add carrots and stir over low heat until very well heated, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla extract and mix well. Store warm in a covered glass jar in a cool, dark place.

title: White Chocolate Scallions for Halloween #5FIX
ingredients: 1/2 cup white chocolate | 1/2 cup scallion
instructions: Heat the scallions in the microwave for 45 seconds, stirring a few times until the scallions begin to turn dark green. Then, remove from the microwave and add the white chocolate. Stir until melted and mixed. Serve immediately or let cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,wheat penne,green chili pepper,vegetable stock,ginger,corn oil,malt vinegar,rice vinegar
title: Fruit and Noodle Toss (Vegan)
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat penne or 8 ounces spaghetti | 1 1/4 cups vegetable stock ( or water ) | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, peeled and grated | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 small green chili pepper, deseeded and finely sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped pickled cucumbers
instructions: Cook the pasta according to directions on the packet, or make your favourite spaghetti and boil until just tender. Drain. Meanwhile, warm the vegetable stock in a small saucepan on the hob until almost boiling. Stir in the vinegar, ginger and rice vinegar. Mix well, until the liquid is syrupy, and the oil has separated from the vinegar. Add the chile and warm through. Drain the pasta. Place half the pasta in a bowl and half the hot sauce, and then transfer to a platter with the remaining ingredients. Toss lightly to combine. Serve straight away with a crunchy green salad.

title: Nordic Harissa Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 3 -5 jalapeno peppers, seeded, minced ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup harissa ( spicy north african spice paste ), to taste ( or less if desired )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well to coat ingredients. Keeps in refrigerator in a tightly closed jar away from light and heat.

title: Roasted Saffron Cheese with Meat
ingredients: 10 -15 saffron threads, soaked in hot water and drained | 1 -2 lb meat ( your choice ) | 1 -2 shallot | 5 ounces of crumbled feta cheese | 5 -8 -10 drops hot sauce, for flavor ( i use tabasco )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Put cleaned meat and stuffing in roasting pan. Rub saffron on the meat. Sprinkle with salt. Roast meat for about 2 hours stirring every so often to avoid burning. You will likely need to add more hot sauce during the final 30 - 50 minutes of roasting to help insure a more moist crust that you can roll.
