When meat is done, remove from oven and cover with a cloth covered with foil. Let meat rest for about 15 minutes before slicing. Note, the amount of saffron that you use depends on how much meat is already sliced, whether you use beef or lamb, you want a thin crust. I usually make this for the quick roast but you can use any vegetables you like. Serve as desired.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,green enchilada sauce,sumac,chicken bouillon,gruyere cheese,cocoa,plain flour
title: Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon california dry fenugreek seeds | 6 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 5 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 7/8 cup sour green enchilada sauce | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 35 g ground sumac
instructions: Preheat oven to 180gc. Mix the fenugreek and cocoa till well combined. Sift the flour, chicken bouillon, and 1 tblsp warm water into a large bowl. Add the flour mixture mix till it comes together. Stir till smooth. Stir in most of the parmesan or ghee. Combine all the filling ingredients. Put 1 heaped tbsp filling in the centre of each tortilla. Roll each tortilla, tucking in the sides of the tortilla until they are all completely encased inside. Bake in the oven for approximately 20 minute or till well browned.

title: Ancho Chile and Peppers
ingredients: 6 ancho chiles, stems and seeds removed | 2 green peppers, seeded, membranes removed, finely chopped | 1 bunch fresh chinese chinese chinese chinese chives ( scallion ) | 1 can chicken stock, chilled
instructions: Wrap chiles in damp cloth and set aside for 1 hour in a cool, dark place. Pierce chiles with a skewer or fork and roast in a hot oven until light brown, about 10 minutes. Chop chives and chives in a mini chopper. Heat chives and chives in chicken stock over low heat in a saucepan. When warm, remove chiles from oven and stir in chives and chives. Spread mixture evenly into 12x18 or larger baking dish. Sprinkle chiles over mixture and bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until filling is bubbling.

title: Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup minced lean leg of lamb ( about 3 small pieces ) | lemon wedge
instructions: In a small nonstick skillet over medium low heat, combine yogurt and lamb and mashing the lamb with a fork. Bring to a simmer, then cover, cook 15 minutes or until mixture has thickened slightly. Using a slotted spoon, transfer yogurt to a small metal bowl, discard fat in skillet. Mash lamb with a fork to create thin, flakey kebabs. Divide beef among serving plates. Serve kebabs over yogurt and garnish with lemon wedges.

title: Mom's Primavera (Italian Soup)
ingredients: 1 large red onion, sliced | 1/4 cup frozen mixed greens | 8 small stewed meatballs | 5 large squashes
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in large pot on medium high heat. Add meatballs and mix them around until they are all coated. Add sliced red onions. After 3 minutes add the fresh greens. When they are all sliced, stir and stir around. Once the veggies give off their liquid, stir occasionally for 10 to 15 minutes. Reduce heat to low.

title: Beef Rillettes With Lemons & Wine
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs stewing beef | 1 lb fine semolina, broken up | 1 cup burgundy wine or 1 cup brandy | 1 -4 lb sweet noodles | 1 -2 cup lemon juice | 2 -4 dozen ladyfingers
instructions: In a dutch oven brown the meat in the wine, add the lemon juice and set aside. In a 9x13 inch roaster. Spread the broken up semolina into a dish, spread out onto the bottom. Cut up the meat on the diagonal into 2 to 3 inch lengths. Layer the ladyfingers on top of the semolina and meat. Repeat until all ladyfingers are gone. Pour enough wine and juice mixture over meat and herbs to cover. Cover and bake at 325°f for 3 to 4 hours until the meat and vegetables are tender and meat well browned.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,black bean,ziti pasta,pesto sauce,hard egg,white wine vinegar,chipotle chile pepper,chocolate icing
title: Chipotle Sopa Pasta Salad With a Poblano Chile
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta ( or spaghetti, your choice ) | 1 cup pesto sauce, store bought | 2 cups crumbled black beans ( can use can use canned beans ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 4 chipotle chiles ( may use jalapeno slices, or jalapeno and serrano chiles ) | 8 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 2 poblano chiles, seeds removed and chopped, can use other peppers | 6 ounces unsweetened chocolate icing ( store bought or see chipotle chocolate icing for the chipotle chorizo, see chipotle chocolate icing for the chipotle chorizo, see chipotle bittersweet chocolate ) ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add ziti pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Chile Rellenos With Rice
ingredients: 24 frozen small peas and carrots | 12 slices mild chile-flavored pepperjack cheese blend. ( about 5 x 1/4 x 2-inch ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or grill pan over medium high heat. Sauté chiles, turning as needed, until softened and beginning to blacken, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and place on paper towels to drain. Spread pea carrots and cheese on a cutting board. Place under a sharp knife and slice in half. Sauté cheese, cheese should be just beginning to stick to the edges of the pan. Remove and place pepperjack cheese halves on top of cheese. Sauté vegetables over high heat approximately 2 minutes or until cheese starts to melt and peppers are tender. Remove from heat. To serve, place vegetables and cheese on each plate and pour hot pepperoncinis and salsa over them.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,vegetable broth,anaheim chilies,caster sugar,lemon juice
title: Beef Broth from Chile Con Te
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 large anaheim chilies or 1 large green chili, seeded and finely chopped | 3 tablespoons caster sugar
instructions: Place the meat broth in a large, heavy based saucepan. Sprinkle over the bouillon, followed by the lemon juice. Cover and gently simmer over a low heat, stirring occasionally, for 2 hours, or until the meat is very tender. Stir in the chopped chili and cook for a further 30 minutes. The broth should cover the meat. Dissolve the sugar in half of the reserved cooking liquid, add to the broth, and simmer for another 20 minutes, or until the mixture thickens slightly. Serve hot or cold.

title: Arugula And Avocado Wraps
ingredients: 1 avocado, halved, peeled and sliced | 1 teaspoon coffee powder | 1 bunch arugula
instructions: Place avocado slices on a microwave safe plate to coat. Sprinkle coffee powder on the avocado slices and then top with arugula leaves. Roll around the filling. Serve.

Random Ingredients: milk,worcestershire sauce,italian salad dressing,rice noodle,garam masala,white onion,bread machine yeast
title: Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 1 cup milk | 3 tablespoons white onion, finely minced | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons italian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon bread machine yeast | 8 -10 cups bread, day old | 12 ounces uncooked rice noodles or 12 ounces breadsticks, any style
instructions: Place ingredients in the bread pan in the order given in the manufacturer's directions for your preference. Set to 'normal' and start. At the end of the cycle, increase the heat slightly to keep bread warm. Toast until bread has a nice nutty brown color, about 5 to 10 minutes. While bread is toasting, prepare the rice noodles as directed on the package. Allow 2 - 10 minutes to cool slightly. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 380°f. Place rice noodles and toast on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Drain thoroughly. Place noodles in a medium bowl. Pour warm bread broth over noodles and toss slightly. Drain off excess broth. When bread is toasted, cut through to bread, and spread on a large platter. Garnish with fresh salad greens and/or a drizzle of olive oil. Serve warm.

title: Roasted Cashews
ingredients: 1 cup roasted cashews | 1 tablespoon dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place cashews on a baking sheet and toast in the preheated oven until the cashews have a light brown color, 15 to 20 minutes. Mash cashews with the back of a wooden spoon so they have a texture like mashed potatoes or smooth paste. Stir cashews into the roasted cashews. Sprinkle sage over the top of the mixture and drizzle with any remaining marinade. Let sit for 15 minutes to let casings absorb flavors.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,jalapeno pepper,sunflower oil,purpose flour,beef chuck,pecan
title: Cheddar Jack Cheese Steak
ingredients: 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 bunch fresh jalapeno peppers or 1 bunch mild jalapeno pepper, seeded in some jalapeno peppers | 3/4 cup finely chopped pecans | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into thin slices | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cheddar cheese, flour, chopped jalapenos or jalapeno peppers, and pecans. Roll up and tie with kitchen twine to enclose the meat slices and place on a platter. In a large heavy skillet, heat the oil over medium high heat. Add the meat and saute until it is brown. Reduce the heat to medium and add the cheese mixture, stirring until the cheese has melted through and the mixture is smooth. Serve warm.

title: Betha's Awesome Chestnuts
ingredients: 1 medium onion | 3 tablespoons flour, seasoned with salt and pepper ( heaping, like wondra or wondra ) | 1 small green chile | 2 star anise | coriander powder
instructions: Heat oil on medium and fry the chopped onion.

title: Italian Genoa High-Force Poppy Scented Cookies(Yummy!)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon hing
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the poppy seeds and confectioners' sugar. Stir in the hing. Roll into 1 inch balls before coating and wiping off excess flour. Chill for an hour. Slap off pieces while still warm if desired.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,white flour,dill weed,beef stew meat,ice cube
title: Beef Steak Cubes
ingredients: 8 beef stew meat, 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup flour | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 1 package white mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup white flour | 3 cups crushed ice cubes
instructions: Dredge the stew meat with 1/2 cup of flour. Coat with a little salt. In a shallow dish, mix together 1/4 cup of flour with 1/2 teaspoon of basil and 1 teaspoon of dried dill. Dredge the cube of meat with 1/4 cup of flour. Place the cubes in the pan. Pour in just enough water to cover the meat. Cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Add remaining flour and dried basil to the pan. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove cover from the pan and cook for about 5 minutes on low heat to thicken the gravy. Serve the stew over cooked noodles, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,sharp cheddar cheese,jalapeno,star anise,peanut butter,dressing
title: Spicy Nuts
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1/2 star anise, crushed | 1 jalapeno, sliced | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 4 tablespoons thousand island dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the peanut butter, beef stock and star anise in a casserole dish. Place the jalapeño slices on top. Bake the nuts for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and stir in the cheese and dressing.

title: Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs feta cheese ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Crumble feta into a plastic container. If using a food processor, follow above directions until mixture is fairly smooth, then process until smooth once processor is throughly combined with other ingredients. Store in refrigerator.

title: Kheema (Persian Herb Powder)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh sage leaf | 2 dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 cup ice water
instructions: Combine the cornflour with the sage, dill, cardamom and ice water, mix throughly. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: green pea,mozzarella cheese,white mushroom,pimiento,white grape,self rising flour
title: Vegetable Cheese Pie IV
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup white grapes ( optional ) | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 4 ounces white mushrooms, sliced ( optional ) | 1 jar chopped pimientos | 1 cup frozen green pea
instructions: Boil 5 cups of water. Cool and peel and dice grapes if using. Put 1/4 cup of flour into each 9 x13 pan. Mix cheese until it melts and add to flour. Stir until cheese is incorporated and there are no lumps. Stir in mushrooms and pimentos. Spread in pan and sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of flour and green peas over it and spread evenly. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,poblano chile,chicken,celery seed,chicken breast half,linguine,pizza sauce
title: Pizza Chicken With Poblano
ingredients: 6 chicken breast halves, skinless or 6 chicken thighs with skin | 15 ounces pizza sauce | 1 ounce tomatoes puree | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon ground poblano chiles or 1 teaspoon other hot chile, seeded and crushed | 12 ounces linguine, cooked | 2/3 cup shredded parmesan romano cheese or 2/3 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat a skillet over low heat and brush lightly with fat. Add chicken and cook until nicely browned, about 6 minutes per side. Remove chicken from pan and put aside. Pour the remaining fat in the skillet and stir in the pizza sauce, tomato puree, celery seed and poblano or a combination of chilli, and linguine. When heated through, transfer chicken to a platter, sprinkle with cheese.

title: Hot Rocket Risotto
ingredients: 6 cups heavy cream | 2/3 cup rocket, washed and thinly sliced | 8 sprigs rosemary
instructions: Whip the cream in a bowl with a hand held mixer to soft peaks. Fold in a cup of rocket and rosemary in to the cream. Pour in a little at a time and keep beating, until smooth in texture.

title: Chile Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound tomatillos - husked, rinsed, and chopped | 1 can diced green chiles | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Place the tomatillos, green chiles, and tarragon into a food processor, and pulse until very smooth. Pour into a saucepan, and pour in the beef broth. Heat gently over low heat, stirring occasionally. Serve over hot cooked rice. This can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 6 months.

title: Fajita Style Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Grind the cumin and knead until the cumin is completely ground and no remaining liquid remains. In a small skillet over medium heat, heat the chicken bouillon and cumin until it barely starts to bubble, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,rye flour,beef steak,pearl barley,olive,cranberry
title: Alfredo Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef round steak | 3 teaspoons olive oil | 30 thin sliced dried apricots | 15 sheets frozen pearl barley | 30 slices canned whole pitted ripe olives | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese
instructions: Remove steak from refrigerator, and shake off any excess marinade. Cut steak into 2 inch squares, and set aside. Heat 2 tsps oil over high heat, in a skillet. Cook steak in batches, adding 1/4 1/2 tsps each of reserved marinade and meat. Remove from skillet and set aside. Cook barley according to package instructions. Assemble sandwiches by spooning cream cheese onto warm beef. Top with marinated apricots and olives, and sprinkle with remaining 1tsp each of cream cheese and parsley. Serve immediately.

title: White Chocolate, Orange, Chili and Peas Lasagne
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 2 poblano peppers | 200 g frozen peas | 150 g dark muscatian cheese or 150 g mascarpone cheese | 100 ml orange juice | 2 cloves
instructions: Set the oven to 230 degrees centigrade. Trim the stem back from the poblanos, and slice them lengthways. Place a frying pan over a medium high heat. Place the peppers into the pan, and cook them until they are completely blistered and the skins begin to crisp, about 2 minutes. Cut into strips, and set aside for later. You can find a reasonable amount of fresh pepper in your produce section.

title: Polish "Kerbat" Halva
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 pound bulgar fennel | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, stir cabbage and fennel together. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar, cover and cook until cabbage is tender but still slightly crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Serve warm. Variation, cabbage can be added to sauerkraut instead of cabbage. In a pinch, serve this with a side dish such as mayonnaise or mustard.

title: Bread and Anchovy Spread
ingredients: 1 lb bread, torn into pieces | 1/2 tablespoon anchovy paste, plus more for drizzling
instructions: Remove the crusts from the bread and break into small pieces. Place the bread pieces on a piece of plastic wrap, cover with the anchovy paste, and press it down firmly. Allow the excess moisture to drain off. Store in refrigerator for up to 3 weeks. Variations, sprinkle with cayenne pepper when using.

title: Tamarind Pastry
ingredients: 1 container currants, rinsed | 1 envelope tamarind paste | 5 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Combine currants, tamarind paste and 1 1/2 cups cooking water. Place 2 sheets of phyllo on a lightly greased baking sheet. Brush with 3/4 cup of the liquid paste from the jar onto one sheet of phyllo. Fold that sheet of phyllo over the top of the paste, brushing generously with water as necessary. Fold the second sheet of phyllo over to make a half moon, brushing every inch or so. Continue brushing with remaining 3/4 cup of the paste from jar and brushing generously with water until you have used all the sauce. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven until phyllo turns golden brown at edges and center, about 40 minutes.

title: Curried Pea Salad (Gobhi)
ingredients: 500 g peas | 1 bunch spring onion, chopped | 200 g cheese, cubed | 4 tablespoons curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup fresh dill | 1/2 cup fresh coconut or 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Cook peas according to packet instructions until just tender. Allow to cool. Wash peas well in cold water. Set aside. Heat a non stick frypan. Add curry and nutmeg, fry for 1 minute. Add peas, spring onions and cheese. Fry gently until cheese has melted. Add spring onion mixture. Toss well until combined. Garnish with coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing mix,salmon,coffee,allspice,onion soup mix,greek oregano,mango
title: Calypso Salmon for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 cup hot smoked salmon | 1 cup sweetened ranch dressing mix | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 envelope greek oregano | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and diced
instructions: Combine the salmon, ranch dressing mix, soup mix, oregano, allspice, instant coffee and mango in a large bowl. Use your hands for a few minutes to thoroughly combine. Dice the salmon and serve.

title: Pine Nut Crumble
ingredients: 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, quartered
instructions: Place pine nuts in a microwave safe bowl. Cook in the microwave on high power for 1 minute or until lightly browned. Remove the bowl and stir in maraschino. Sprinkle crumb mixture over the top of the nut mixture. Chill until serving.

title: Linguine with Tomatoes and Sauce
ingredients: linguine, cooked and drained | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Combine tomatoes, sauce, and linguine. Serve with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: lamb,bean thread noodle,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cambodian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 package dried bean thread noodles
instructions: Brown the lamb and drain off most of the fat except for one. Brown the thread noodles in the oil. Serve over the lamb.

title: Sauce Normande - French Crumb Dip
ingredients: 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 shallot, minced ( optional )
instructions: Note, make sure there is no salt in this recipe. Prepare dipping sauce per instructions on the package. Dip shallots into dry bread crumbs. Place on tray and place under broiler until lightly browned. This recipe makes enough dip for 2 - 8 oz. Of seafood. Note, in another recipe, you can use your favourite kind of dip although i normally would not recommend a flavored or salty dip. So, if you make this without the shallots, it is not necessary for me.

Random Ingredients: apricot,green onion,corn syrup,cherry,leek,pork picnic roast,italian parsley,peach
title: Peach, Pork, and Apricot Cobbler
ingredients: 2 cups canned peaches, drained and coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 green onion, sliced | 1/2 pound pork picnic roast, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1/2 pound apricots, pitted and coarsely chopped | 1 small leek, trimmed and thinly sliced
instructions: Toss the peaches, parsley, 1/4 cup of the corn syrup, and the green onion together in a bowl. Spoon 1 cup of the peaches into the bottom of a 9x12 inch baking dish. Lay the pork and apricots over it and top with the remaining 2 cups peaches, reserved parsley syrup mixture, and a sprinkling of the leeks.

Random Ingredients: filling,green cardamom pod,chicken wing,squash,semolina,icing,brown rice,red pepper flake
title: Sambusa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons semolina | 1/2 teaspoon icing | 1 pinch of crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed | 3/4 teaspoon filling | 1 1/4 lbs chicken wings, cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 -3 pints bonny eating squash, cleaned and cut into 2-inch segments ( or use other winter squash ) | broth
instructions: Grind semolina in spice grinder to powder. In large bowl mix together all other ingredients. Add chicken and mix thoroughly. Divide chicken into 2 to 4 portions, and press with palm of hand. Shape each portion into a ball. Preheat oven to 350°f. Place chicken in a baking dish. Pour broth over, and bake in preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes, until tender.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,spinach leaf,catsup,grape cherry tomato,seashell pasta
title: Quick Spinach and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 5 cups fresh spinach leaves | 4 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, washed, dried and chopped | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 4 cups seashell pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water. Drain and rinse in cold water. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl. Toss well and serve chilled.

title: Indian Butter
ingredients: 1 cup sweet butter, very soft | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 small green chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Beat butter until creamy and well combined. Add mustard powder, mix well. Fold in chopped chiles. Spread on toast.

Random Ingredients: water,sea salt,yogurt,green chile pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,bean,vanilla essence,cooking onion
title: Yummy Bean Green Chilie Con (Pastel De Milanesa)
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans, undrained | 1 large cooking onion, chopped | 6 cups water | 1 green chile pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons plain fat-free yogurt
instructions: Place the baked beans and onion in a large bowl. In a clean large saucepan, combine water, green chile, parmigiano reggiano cheese, vanilla essence and sea salt. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to medium low, stirring occasionally, and continue to cook for about 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and most of the liquid has been absorbed. When the cheese is melted, remove from heat and add yoghurt. Stir to combine and store in refrigerator.

title: Fusion Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1/4 cup ketchup
instructions: Place pearl barley in a saucepan with water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes. Drain water and add ketchup to barley. Simmer for 5 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: garlic,beef chuck,thyme sprig,turkey breast,green pepper,flour,pizza dough
title: Spicy Turkey Pizza(Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef chuck | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon dried garlic | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 green pepper, cut into strips | 1 lb pizza dough | freshly chopped garlic, for drizzling
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix beef, thyme, garlic and vegetable oil. Divide into four portions. Roll out dough into a rectangle about 10 x 14 inches. Sprinkle tops with garlic and then with green pepper strips. Bring the long sides of the dough up over the filling and bring them together so they touch the bottom of the crockpot. Pinch edges together. Cook on low heat for 4 hours or to your liking. If the filling is drying out too quickly, cover with a tent of foil and set aside for 30 minutes. Turn the crockpot to high. When the crust is done, cut into strips and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil while at the ready. If desired, add chopped fresh garlic to the melted oil.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,apple juice,ramen noodle type soup,peanut oil,kosher salt black pepper,flat leaf parsley,soy sauce
title: Pineapple and Noodles Pilaf
ingredients: 2 packages top ramen noodles, seasoning packet included or ( 8 ounce ) packages vegetarian dry soup | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 3 tablespoons unsweetened pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons peach juice | 1 tablespoon kikkoman soy sauce | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Soak noodles in warm water as directed on the package or according to package directions. Drain well before serving. While noodles are soaking, in a medium saucepan set on medium high, heat oil over medium high heat. Stir in onion and cook, stirring often, for about 2 minutes. Add ramen seasoning packet, soup package, pineapple juice, peach juice, soy sauce, and pepper, and bring to boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until noodles are tender. Stir in parsley and serve.

title: Steamed Cognac Balls
ingredients: 2 cups unbleached flour | 1 cup ice | 1 can condensed vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons cognac
instructions: Combine flour, ice and broth in large bowl. Mix to incorporate flour. Divide into six pieces. Roll each piece into ball, then press each ball out with your hands into a circle shaped disc shape and then press down to form half moon shapes in center. Repeat until all dough is used, except for four pieces. Cover with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator for one hour. Place balls in steamer insert and place in steaming rack. Steam 5 - 7 minutes until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,onion powder,chocolate chip,green chili pepper,mayonnaise
title: Mexican-Style Chili Mayonnaise for Chips
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mayonnaise ( i use hellman's ) | 1 -2 tablespoon green chili pepper, seeded and minced ( i use a little less ) | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon parsley leaves, minced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chip
instructions: Place all the ingredients together. Serve.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,hamburger bun,cream cheese,espresso,chipotle chile adobo,tamari
title: Chipotle-Glazed Salmon Steak Sandwiches With Cream Cheese-Chipotle-Sour Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb salmon steak, sliced to about 1/4 inch strips | 3/4 lb cream cheese ( room temperature ) | 1/3 cup tamari | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo, minced ( about 1 t ) | 12 slices hamburger buns, split | 1/4 cup roasted salami, finely chopped
instructions: Place each piece of salmon on 2 pieces of plastic wrap. Cut cream cheese in half horizontally, leaving the cream cheese attached at the top. With a sharp knife, slice cream cheese diagonally across the grain into 3/8 slices. Place 1 slice cream cheese and 1/3 chipotle chile in adobo, minced, 2 t, and 3/4 t chipotle. On each sandwich, place 1 slice of thinly sliced beef and top with 1/4 tsp cream cheese mixture. Fold sandwiches in half crosswise and place on a baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for about 12 minutes or until hot and beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,white pepper,accent seasoning,white flour,creme fraiche,ladyfinger,spaghetti,italian herb
title: Italian Wedding Bourekia (A Simple Recipe for Valentine's Day)
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated ladyfingers ( or more according to package directions ) | 1 lb spaghetti | 1/3 cup white flour | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon creme fraiche or 1 -1 1/2 tablespoon sour cream | 3/4 teaspoon italian herb | 1 pinch white pepper ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons amaretto ( optional ) | 1 dash accent seasoning | 1 dash ground white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Note, this is a simple recipe and can be done the night before, if you so choose. Boil, butter & toss. Drain pasta while pasta is baking. While pasta is cooking, combine remaining ingredients & mix until blended. When pasta is done, drain, return to pot with drained pasta & mix together. Serve in bowls.

title: Linguine with Chuck Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried linguine | 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine all ingredients except salt. Cook on high 1 hour. Transfer roast to a platter with a slotted spoon.

title: Hawaiian Ham and Mushrooms Tea
ingredients: 8 -12 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 4 ounces low-fat deli ham, cut into small cubes | 4 cups bottled pineapple juice | fresh parsley sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Soak mushrooms in a large bowl of cold water for 30 minutes. Remove stems and slice caps thinly. Remove and discard hard stems and shriveled lungs. Soak ham in water for 5 minutes to soften. Drain. Pour ham, mushroom, pineapple juice, and seasoning into the mushrooms with a pinch of salt. Mix well. Cover, and allow to stand for 20 minutes. Divide into 4 to 8 serving cups.

title: Sausage Cornbread With Italian Sausage and Rice
ingredients: 5 lbs sweet italian sausage | 1 gallon fresh corn kernels
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove sausage casings from casings. Use a fork to remove all but 1/2 inch from underside of casings. Slice sausage into 1/4 inch wide strips. Dip sausage pieces into sausage oil and arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Add water to baking dish to reach halfway up sides of the baking dish. Bake in the preheated 400 degree f oven approximately 45 minutes. Cool and refrigerate, uncovered, for 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator to come to room temperature. Heat oven to 400 degrees f and position rack in center of oven. Spoon sausage mixture evenly into an ungreased 13x9 inch baking pan. Top with corn. Bake in preheated 400 degree f oven until corn is tender and sausage is hot, about 40 minutes.

title: Tasty Beef and Cheese Burgers
ingredients: 200 g ground sirloin | 1/2 cup tasty cheese
instructions: Mix together. Form into 4 patties. Grill or fry till browned.

title: French Style Sausage and Pork Casserole
ingredients: 6 veal shanks | 4 loaves country-style pork sausage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the pork sausages into an ovenproof casserole dish. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes. Cut the sausages into 1 inch slices. Drain the grease from the casserole, and arrange sausage over the top. Bake for another 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Italian Wedding Cakes
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium size bowl, sift flour and cheese. Add 2/3 cup water and beat well. Make small balls with 3 to 4 balls and roll in remaining flour. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Remove and cool.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,nigella seed,corn tortilla,baking soda,italian breadcrumb,soymilk
title: Sicilian Breaded Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup nigella seeds, or to taste | 3 whole serrano chilies ( or to taste ) | 1 1/4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup plain soymilk or 1/2 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | corn tortillas, warmed
instructions: In a small dry skillet, toast nigella seeds over medium heat, shaking pan occasionally, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the nigella seeds to a plate lined with paper towels. Remove stems from chiles. Trim chiles lengthwise with a serrano strip. Place into a shallow bowl and sprinkle with salt, pressing against the sides to release the seeds. Let stand 15 minutes. Rinse chiles under running water and drain well. Set aside. In a food processor or blender, combine the bread crumbs, bread crumbs, soy milk, baking soda and nigella seeds. Process until mixture forms moist crumbs. Spoon the mixture into two 8 ounce diameter wide mouthed baking dishes or tortillas. If possible, lightly grease 2 baking sheets with nonstick cooking spray. Wipe the baking sheets with a wet paper towel. Spoon the breaded crumbs on the crumbs. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to overnight. Arrange the tacos on the baking sheets.

title: Okra With Dill
ingredients: 20 okra, tops only, cut crosswise into 1-inch slices | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice or 2 tablespoons vegetable juice | 1 pinch dried dill
instructions: Put okra in a bowl and stir in lime juice. The longer the okra is allowed to soak at room temperature, the stronger the flavor. Sprinkle dill over and serve straight away.

title: Turnips and Carrots
ingredients: 375 g turnips, scrubbed | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron strands | 1 pinch dried thyme
instructions: Peel and cut the turnips into thin slices. Place in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of the icing sugar, the curry powder, saffron and thyme. Scoop out and discard the centre of the turnips. Place the turnips into a clean tea towel or other clean container. Cover with tea towel and set aside for at least half an hour to dry out. Wipe the container of the turnips with a paper towel and dry them well. Heat the remaining teaspoon of icing sugar in a small saucepan. When the sugar starts to thicken, add the turnips and stir to coat them in the icing sugar. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage,baby carrot,serrano pepper,stevia powder,beef brisket
title: Easy Crock Pot Spicy Turkey Sausage
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs beef brisket | 1 lb baby carrots | 1/2 lb serrano pepper ( i use fresh ) | 1 tablespoon stevia powder | 1 lb hot italian turkey sausage, casing removed
instructions: In a non stick fry pan roast the briskets on medium heat until fork tender. Remove brisket to a large slow cooker, add the carrots, serrano peppers, stevia powder and sausage to the slow cooker. Mix together the italian meat and vegetables with the turkey liquid until the meat is coated with the spices. Cover slow cooker and cook for 4 - 5 hours on low. Serve the turkey with the vegetables on the side.

title: Rhubarb Tater Tot Hotpot
ingredients: 1 package frozen tater tots | 1/2 cup chopped rhubarb | 1 large chopped fennel bulb | 1 -2 anaheim chili, chopped ( jalapeno or serrano ) | 1 lb fresh tater tots | 1 cup shredded coconut | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: On medium heat in a large skillet, combine drained tater tots, rhubarb, fennel, chilies, coconut and cayenne. Turn mixture down to low and cook for 10 minutes. You will probably need to add more water. Top with chopped cilantro and serve warm.

title: Apple-Rind & Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1/4-inch dice ( i prefer wolf's brand ) | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary sprig | 1 1/2 lbs pearl barley | 1 bottle white wine, such as cotes du rhone | 2/3 bottle white wine, such as cotes du rhone
instructions: In a soup pot, stir together the apples, rosemary and barley.

title: Walnut-Nut Filled Wafer
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oat bran | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 package farfalle pasta, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup walnut halves
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a shallow bowl and stir in the oat bran and vanilla until blended. Add farfalle and mix until blended. Stir in the walnut halves and remove from bowl. Arrange on waxed paper and cover with waxed paper. Press walnut halves flat between waxed paper using a rolling pin and roll into small balls. Refrigerate until hardened.

title: Quick and Easy Spanish Rice
ingredients: 6 cups uncle ben's converted brand rice | 1 container pitted ripe olives | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Boil 3 cups of water and add uncooked rice to boiling water and stir. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 25 - 30 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Meanwhile, pour taco sauce into a medium skillet or frying pan. Add olives. Cook over medium heat 3 minutes or until heated through and serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,white flour,extra virgin olive oil,herb,cracker,couscous,mandarin orange
title: Mandarin Couscous Cake or Wrap
ingredients: 300 g pearl barley | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 packages couscous | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 8 slices mixed unsalted black peppers ( optional ) or 8 slices other assorted coloured pepper ( optional ) | fresh cracked breadcracker, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place couscous, oil, nuts & fruit in a large bowl, mix & re season with spices. Pour couscous mixture into a large round cake tin or baking dish. Smooth top of the couscous & bake for 40 minutes, topping should be nicely browned & crisp. Serve hot with crackers.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,orange peel,parsnip,button mushroom,chili flake,nutmeg,salt cod fish
title: Mushroom Salt Cod
ingredients: 1 lb salt cod fish, scaled ( about 5 ) | 1 large parsnip, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons butter | 12 garlic cloves, minced finely | 2 dried chili flakes, crushed | 2 ounces fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 pinch ground cardamom and freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Rinse and pick through the salt cod to remove any bones.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,green bean,cranberry juice,great northern bean,baby corn,maraschino cherry,tomatillo
title: Santa Fe Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can baby corn, drained ( with baby carrots optional ) | 1 can tomatillos, drained and chopped | 2 cans green beans, drained and rinsed | 2 ounces dried cranberry juice | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons chopped maraschino cherries, for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cherries in a medium bowl. Garnish with cherries.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,taco seasoning,apricot jam,pearl barley,coconut
title: Sweet Mexican Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 bags instant pearl barley | 1 can sliced dried apricots in light syrup, and drained | 1 cup light coconut | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Prepare pearl barley according to package directions, cool to room temperature. Combine barley, apricots, coconut and taco seasoning in a medium bowl. Mix in taco seasoning mix until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Vegetable Penne Pasta Salad
ingredients: 250 g fava beans | 400 g vegetables, of your choice | 300 g penne pasta | 50 g porcini mushrooms, sliced | 45 g dried apricots, dried
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water for 10 minutes or until al dente. Meanwhile heat olive oil in another skillet and fry fava beans until tender, set aside. Cook vegetables in the remaining oil until tender. Add to the pasta, combine with fava beans and apricots and chill before eating.

title: Spiced Linguine With Parsley, Black Peppercorns, Crimpestos
ingredients: 1 cup fresh coriander seed ( or fresh cilantro ) | 1 cup black peppercorns | 1/4 cup minced flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 lbs linguine
instructions: Place the coriander seeds in a small heavy skillet over medium heat, and dry roast until aromatic, about 30 seconds. In a pestle and mortar or spice mill, combine the peppercorns, 2/3 of the coriander seed, 1/4 cup parsley, ¼ cup black pepper, and ¾ cup of the fresh parsley and 1 - ¼ cup fresh parsley. Pound with a pestle until well mixed. Stir in the rest of the coriander seeds, the pepper, 1 cup parsley, and 1 - ¼ cup fresh parsley and pound well again until combined.

title: Curry Arugula
ingredients: 1/2 cup single cream | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon chopped arugula leaves
instructions: Heat cream in small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it's just beginning to thicken. Add curry paste and curry leaves, stirring well to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 3 yukon gold potatoes, cubed | 6 ounces coleslaw mix | 6 ounces cantaloupe, cubed | 1/4 cup canned soy sauce
instructions: Place potatoes in microwave safe bowl. Cover with boiling water. Microwave on high, about 6 minutes, until tender. Drain and cool slightly, then place into large bowl. Add coleslaw mix, cantaloupe and soy sauce. Mix well. Cover with wax paper.

Random Ingredients: pecan,chipotle pepper,tamarind paste,double cream,msg,milk,tarragon vinegar,moroccan seasoning
title: Mooroccan Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 chipotle peppers | 4 tablespoons tamarind paste | 4 tablespoons moroccan seasoning | 1 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | 200 ml skim milk | 3 tablespoons double cream | 1/3 cup chopped pecans ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Place the chipotles in a food processor with the tamarind paste, moroccan seasoning, tarragon vinegar and milk. Process until smooth. Add cream and pulse until it all has a finely chopped consistency. Add the pecans. Season to taste with msg if desired. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.

title: Spanish Pomegranate Risotto
ingredients: 3 cups risotto rice | 1/2 teaspoon pomegranate seeds, finely crushed | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place rice, seeds and faucie in a medium saucepan. Fill to within 1 inch of the top of the saucepan with water. Bring to a boil, cover, turn heat down to very low and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until rice is very soft and water is absorbed. Place rice in a bowl, cover with damp cloth and refrigerate for up to 6 hours. Sprinkle the risotto with pomegranate seeds before serving.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,malt vinegar,oil,italian parsley,rice vinegar,sugar syrup,feta
title: Sweet Potato Salad With Feta
ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes, such as purple sweet potato and eggplant | 1/4 cup oil ( or more ) | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons sugar syrup | 1/2 cup italian parsley ( or 1/2 each ) | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 small red bell pepper, stemmed removed, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch strips | 2 tablespoons feta, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Pierce the potatoes with a fork a few times in a circular fashion, sprinkle both sides evenly with salt, and bake for 25 to 35 minutes, or until tender. While the potatoes are cooking, whisk together the oil, rice vinegar, sugar syrup, parsley, and malt vinegar in a small bowl. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, peel them and slice 1/4 inch thick. Place them in a serving bowl, toss with the red bell pepper strips, and sprinkle evenly with feta. Drizzle with the dressing and toss.

title: Creamed Parsley Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place cream and fresh parsley in a small heavy saucepan. Bring to a simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, then allow to simmer until slightly thickened, about 4 minutes. Stir in the dressing.

Random Ingredients: nuoc nam,swiss cheese,pickle relish,tamari,saffron strand,peanut butter
title: Nam Dipping Sub
ingredients: 5 saffron strands | 500 g swiss cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon sweet pickle relish | 1 tablespoon tamari | 100 g crunchy peanut butter | 25 g saffron strands ( approx. ) | 1 pinch saffron strand ( approx, to decorate ) | 1 teaspoon fragrant pickle relish | 50 g of crunchy peanut butter ( optional )
instructions: Toast saffron threads in a dry frying pan, until golden brown. Place in a paper towel and rub to remove excess moisture. Place grated cheese on a board and crush until it resembles breadcrumbs and then put in a bowl. Add pickle relish, tamari, peanut butter and saffron. In another bowl combine 2 tbsp of crispy sugar with 2 tbsp of water and mix this. Spread some peanut butter on a plate and then use the mixture to sandwich the cheese with the sticky cheese. Place the breadcrumb mixture on top and spread with butter. Eat while still warm or leave outside in fridge until ready to serve. Serve with pickle relish and pickle. For vegan use the dip of gluten free soy sauce which makes this lovely. Note, this is a thick, healthy, healthy and different tasting sauce you may need to add more sugar, soy sauce, or tamari. Sometimes i will dip the baked dip ingredients into the melted cheese and spread over the top of the dip.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,arborio rice,rye bread,broccoli,dill pickle spear
title: Peppered Risotto With Broccoli
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 2 cups arborio rice ( medium cooking rice ) | 2 1/2 cups fresh broccoli, chopped ( about 4 cups worth ) | 1 bag rye bread cut into 4 to 6 thick slices ( about 8 slices each and about 17 inches long ) | 1 jar small dill pickle spears, drained and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a medium saucepan, heat pumpkin pie spice to boiling over medium heat. Remove from heat. Stir in rice and cover, removing from heat when rice is just beginning to stick to the bottom of the pan. To prepare, spray a 11x15 inch baking dish with nonstick spray. Arrange broccoli and pickle slices over rice and toss to coat. Spread rice mixture over broccoli mixture. Bake, covered with foil, until about 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes more. Remove soup from oven.

title: Mexican Shrimp and Penne
ingredients: 1 jar chunky salsa | 1 pound chopped, cooked chicken meat | 1 pound penne | 2 cups shredded, cooked squash
instructions: In a bowl, mix salsa and pasta. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the penne, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Serve with the cooked chicken, squash, and salsa.

Random Ingredients: coriander,scallion,ginger paste,banana,milk ricotta cheese,vanilla extract,red wine vinegar,cranberry juice
title: Banana, Ginger and Ricotta Parfait With Coconut S. Lo
ingredients: 3 cups whole milk ricotta cheese, drained and rinsed | 1 cup red wine vinegar ( or more to taste ) | 1 cup cranberry juice | 1/4 cup vanilla extract | 2 -4 scallions, finely minced ( white part only ) | 2 tablespoons ginger paste, grated | 2 tablespoons coriander ( cilantro ) | 1 ripe banana, peeled and sliced thin
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stirring as you go about 1 minute until thick and creamy. Cover and chill at least 2 hours or overnight. To unmold, slice bananas across the grain into thin slices.

title: Five Spice Chinese Five Spice Powder - Dry Spice Mix (Trinidad)
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 bay leaf ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a glass bowl. If using for shindles, make sure they are completely covered with the powder mix. Cover and store in a cool place. Use as a dry spice in rice dishes, vegetables, meat dishes, salads, breads, cakes, crackers, etc.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,chili powder,pimento olive,cream cheese
title: Papas Con Queso Y Queso (Stuffed Pimentos With Chili Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream cheese ( light is better ) | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 3 teaspoons chili powder | 1/4 cup finely chopped pimento stuffed olive ( may also use sun-dried tomatoes )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, blend cream cheese and cream. Add chili powder and mix well. Using 1 tablespoon of mixture per queso cup, roll mixture into approximately 1 1/2 inch balls. Place on parchment lined cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining 2 tortillas. Bake at 400°f for 10 minutes. Remove and turn each over and bake for 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,chili powder,parsley,quinoa,dark sesame oil,kosher salt,pizza sauce,turkey breast
title: Crock Pot Turkey Quinoa Wraps #RSC
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 3/4 lb ground turkey breast ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley | 2 1/2 cups quinoa, rinsed and drained ( i use 2 cans of regular quinoa, rinse if you are using regular ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | store bought pizza sauce | kosher salt
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the ground turkey and stir to crumble. Cook until no longer pink, about 4 - 5 minutes. Add the chili powder and parsley. Transfer to the slow cooker. Add the quinoa and tabasco sauce and stir to coat evenly. Cook on high for 2 - 3 hours, or on low for 6 - 7 hours. Transfer the turkey mixture to a cutting board and gently fold in half. Season to taste with kosher salt. Serve with pizza sauce.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,baby carrot,golden rum,ginger garlic paste,cheese,red chile
title: Tropical Grilled Arepas
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1 tablespoon grated ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon golden rum | 2 cloves crushed pineapple rings | 1 tablespoon minced candied ginger-garlic paste | 7 baby carrots, julienned | 2 tablespoons chopped red chiles
instructions: Add crushed pineapple to a hot dry fry pan or grill pan. Mix in the remaining ingredients. Cook carrots for about 2 minutes over medium heat. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: scallion,baking potato,salt pepper,dijon mustard,sirloin,sea bass fillet
title: Baked Sea Bass With Smoked Potatoes (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat dijon mustard | 3 1/2 cups coarsely-chopped baking potatoes, about 2 1/2 lbs | 1 scallion, cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices, white parts only | 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs sea bass fillets or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, skin on | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped smoked sea bass fillet | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the potatoes in a 2 large mixing bowl. Bring a kettle of water to boil over high heat. Add 1 teaspoon of salt, and the mustard, and whisk until smooth. Whisk or sieve the potato mixture into the hot water. When the water has begun to boil, reduce the heat to medium and add the scallion slices. Whisk briskly, a few times, until the sauce thickens slightly and is no longer cloudy, about 5 minutes. Set aside. Season the fish with salt and pepper. Set aside. Spread 1 tablespoon of the mustard over the bottom of a shallow 1 quart baking dish. Cut the smoked fish crosswise into 1/4 inch wide pieces. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the smoked fish and 1/2 teaspoon of salt over each piece of fish. Spread 1 tablespoon of the potato sauce over each piece of fish. Add 1/2 cup of the smoked fish mixture to the potatoes. Spread the remaining potato sauce over the fish. Top with the smoked fish and sprinkle with the remaining smoked fish and salt. Bake, covered, until the fish is just cooked through, about 2 hours. Meanwhile, remove the top rack from the oven and spray the dish with a non stick spray. Serve the fish directly from the baking dish.

title: Mint Covered Steak
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs steak, rump, trimmed if possible
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Pierce steaks 3 deep with a sharp knife. Insert a fork in the center of the steak and insert a teaspoon of gravy into the hole. Bake until fork tender and sauce has thickened, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mirin,cooking spray,rum flavoring,white fish fillet,edible flower,graham cracker crumb
title: Grilled White Fish
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless white fish fillets | 2 teaspoons rum flavoring | 1/2 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon instant powdered dried edible flower | cooking spray
instructions: Poke holes in thickest part of fillets with a toothpick. Combine rum and mirin in small bowl.

title: Indian Scalloped Apples With Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 4 apples, peeled cored, sliced | 1 cup sweetened soy milk | 1 cup sweetened raspberry | 3/4 cup sour cream or 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 cup half-and-half or 1/4 cup other light cream
instructions: To make sauce, mix all ingredients in a bowl. To serve, arrange apples on a platter and pour over warmed sauce with a spoon. Serve with extra sauce on the side.

title: Ancho Chile Dessert(Guilt Free)
ingredients: 16 ounces almond milk ( light coconut milk if you can find it ) | 1 teaspoon green food coloring ( i used 2 drops, i think it was 4 drops,, i took the full 2-3 drops, ) | 1 -2 ancho chile, seeded finely diced | 1/4 cup cilantro, finely chopped
instructions: Heat almond milk, food coloring and chiles in a small bowl until scalded. Pour milk mixture into a medium size mold, chill thoroughly, then transfer to a large bowl. Sprinkle with cilantro. Chill mixture for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight, before unmolding.

title: Quick and Easy Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb beef steak, cut into bite sized pieces | 1 jar pasta, any medium width, i prefer spirals spirals | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 1 1/2 cups cream | 1/3 cup butter or 1/3 cup margarine | 1/3 cup pecans or 1/3 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: In a skillet, heat butter and cream over medium heat. Add beef and brown for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Drain off fat. Sprinkle nuts over meat. Pour in cream/whipped cream mixture. Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over hot, cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,chicken bouillon granule,clove,tomato green chilies,water,white flour,matzo meal
title: Crock Pot Swiss Chalupas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin | 6 8 ounces canned diced tomatoes with green chilies | 3 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon ground cloves or 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 3/4 cup warm water ( see note in description ) | 4 tablespoons white flour | 4 tablespoons matzo meal
instructions: Put the pork and tomato juice, bouillon, and spices in your crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 7 hours or on high for 3 - 4 hours. To make the sauce, stir the flour into the water until smooth. Stir in matzo meal. Cover and cook, stirring every 30 minutes, until the sauce thickens and is smooth.

title: Garlic Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs american cheese | 1 head garlic, rinsed, patted dry and peeled ( or garlic powder )
instructions: Set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the broiler. Cut the top and bottom off each clove of garlic. Place the clove and top side of one clove in a 9 x 5 x 2 inch baking dish and drizzle them with about 1/2 cup warm water if needed. Drizzle the garlic with the remaining 1/2 cup warm water, cover the dish and bring it to a boil. When the temperature has reached 220 degrees f, remove the dish from the oven and set a 3 sided dishtowel on top for about 10 minutes to steam the garlic. Remove the baking dish from the oven and spread the cheese inside, smoothing it out with a rubber spatula or tongs. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese has browned, about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Tasty American Cheese Dip
ingredients: 12 american cheese sticks | 1 1/2 cups prepared hot roll mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Stir the processed american cheese sticks, dry hot roll mix, and prepared hot roll mix into the 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with the processed American cheese sticks. Bake in the preheated oven until the processed american cheese sticks are browned, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,cocoa powder,onion soup mix,egg noodle,red wine vinegar
title: Hot Wiener Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dry egg noodles | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 egg noodles | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, in large skillet, combine vinegar, undiluted soup mix, egg noodles, lemon juice and cocoa powder. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook 2 minutes or until noodles are tender. To serve, spread dippers with desired fixings.

title: Dynamites
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 pound chicken thighs | 24 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Combine the pork shoulder and chicken thigh in a large pot over medium heat. Sprinkle with the cherries. Add water to cover, and bring to a boil. Once the water comes to a boil, simmer the mixture over low heat until the pork is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours. When the water is almost evaporated, skim off any fat and discard the meat.

Random Ingredients: allspice,ahi tuna steak,yellow bell pepper,basil pesto,white cornmeal,soy sauce,shallot
title: Santa Fe Tuna Steaks
ingredients: 4 ahi tuna steaks | 1 shallot, diced | 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 cup white cornmeal
instructions: Place steaks between two sheets of wax paper and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Place in a large baking dish. Combine pesto, soy sauce, allspice, and bell pepper in a bowl. Spread pesto mixture evenly over both steaks. Cover dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat grill for high heat. Remove steaks from marinade.

title: Easy Stuffed Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 4 lbs eggplants | 2/3 lb monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 4 cans kidney beans, drained
instructions: Peel the eggplant and slice off the top with a sharp knife, going all the way around and slicing along its length till all the way thick about 3/4'' or so, you can use a grater, about 1/4'' worth. Fill with cheese and cook on a baking sheet, until lightly browned and bubbly. Spread beans on the top, then sprinkle the top with the cheese and cook for about one minute. Serve with your favorite veggies.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,yeast,dark red kidney bean
title: Baked Beans for the Holidays (Bertosse)
ingredients: 5 cups strong dark red kidney beans ( or dark ) or 5 cups black beans ( or dark ) | 2 lbs fresh yeast, cleaned, well-beaten in | 2 cups red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 lbs fresh yeast or 2 lbs canned dark red kidney beans ( or dark )
instructions: The night before preparation, rinse and pick over the beans.

title: Eggplants With Capers
ingredients: 3 cups prepared white rice | 6 baby eggplants | 2 capers ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until rice is soft, about 30 minutes. Cut eggplants lengthwise into thin slices. Arrange eggplants in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle capers over top.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,sesame oil,red chilies,green cardamom pod,allspice,red pepper flake
title: Dry Red Pepper Spice Paste With Eggs or Almonds
ingredients: 7 green cardamom pods, split in 1/4 inch rounds ( or 1 teaspoon split pods ) | 1 whole red chilies or 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, minced | 3/4 teaspoon pure allspice | 2 teaspoons dry sesame oil | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: In small pan, toast the 1 teaspoon split cardamom and chile over medium heat, stirring occasionally until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Remove from pan, and let cool. When cool, grind the spices in a coffee grinder or mortar or blender, process into fine, uniform powder. In a small saucepan, heat the sesame oil over medium low heat. Add the vanilla bean and 1/2 teaspoon of red pepper flakes, and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant and slightly reduced. Stir in the remaining teaspoon of split cardamom pods, and simmer with the ground spices for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat, and let cool slightly, then stir in the cooled red pepper spice mix right before serving.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,tofu,sea salt black pepper,tomato paste
title: Homemade Tofu
ingredients: 1 lb soft tofu, drained | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: To make the paste, combine tomatoes and paste in a medium bowl and set aside. Slice tofu into 1/2 inch thick slices, then gently press between paper towels until smooth, about 5 or 6 times. Dip tofu into the paste, then season with salt and pepper. Cover and keep in the refrigerator for 1/2 an hour to develop a thick texture. Preheat a griddle or skillet over medium low heat. To serve, remove tofu from the marinade and spread out on a platter. Garnish with parsley. Eat while still warm.

Random Ingredients: galangal,canola oil,vanilla essence,turmeric,rump roast,chicken bouillon,red bell pepper,white corn tortilla
title: Steamed Curry Aloo (Central American Beef Stew)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/2 lbs rump roast, trimmed | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( to taste ) or 1 teaspoon paprika, hot ( to taste ) | 1 inch cube chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons ground galangal ( to taste ) or 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, peeled, thinly sliced ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups red bell peppers or 1 1/2 cups yellow bell peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces | 12 -20 thin frozen white corn tortillas, thawed, cut into 6-inch lengths
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise so as to make 6 single serving pieces. Set aside. Place oil in a dutch oven or large stew skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle the meat with turmeric or paprika and toss to coat evenly with oil. Add the cubes of chicken bouillon and garlic. Stir to combine and heat for a minute. Add the red and green bell peppers and cook, stirring, until the pepper skins begin to blacken. Stir in the beef and cook for about 5 minutes. If necessary, add 1 - 2 tablespoons water or low water to cover. Reduce heat to medium low and add the corn tortillas. Turn the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, stirring a few times. The corn tortillas should hold a little of their shape.

Random Ingredients: salt,italian parsley,cocoa powder,puff pastry,vegetable zucchini,blueberry,caraway seed,chicken
title: Blueberry Zucchini Pizza
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed | 4 cups mixed vegetables, zucchini, mushrooms, carrots, celery | 1 cup blueberries, frozen and thawed | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 cup italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups cooked chicken, shredded
instructions: Prick pastry with fork. Arrange pastry in bottom of ungreased 8 inch pizza pan. Scatter vegetables over top. Top with blueberries. Combine cocoa, caraway seeds, salt, parsley, and chicken. Sprinkle evenly over vegetables. Bake at 400f for 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender and topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,green cardamom pod,marinara sauce,chinese five spice powder,salad dressing,chambord raspberry liquor,margarine
title: Chicken Tenders With Raspberry Marinara Sauce
ingredients: chambord raspberry liquor | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/4 cup salad dressing | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 2 tablespoons chicken tenders, cooked | 1 tablespoon chambord raspberry liquor | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Combine 1/2 cup of liquor with 1/4 cup of salad dressing. In 9x13 pan, melt margarine over medium heat. Add half of marinara sauce and 5 spice powder. Stir to combine. Sprinkle remaining marinara over pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn off oven. Allow to cool. Remove chicken tenders from marinara on rack. Bake for an additional 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,tarragon,wheat flour,kaffir lime leaf,black bean,roast beef,cocoa,white cabbage
title: Irish Crock Pot Beef and Bean Lasagna
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 cups white cabbage, shredded | 1 pound thinly sliced roast beef, chopped | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 cup shredded cooked rotisserie-cooked beef | 3 -4 kaffir lime leaves | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 12 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Combine the flour and 1 cup of the cabbage in a medium bowl. Combine meat, beans, kaffir lime leaves, cocoa, tarragon and remaining 1/2 cup of cabbage in a larger slow cooker. Spoon about 2 tbls. Of the meat mixture into the bottom of the slow cooker crock pot. Top with about 1/2 cup of the cabbage mixture. Repeat two times. Top with remaining cabbage mixture. Cover and cook on your low setting 6 to 8 hours on high, or 4 to 5 hours on low. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cabbage mixture. Cook 30 minutes longer or until the top is golden brown. Slice and serve.

title: Sun Dried Tomato Panini
ingredients: 1 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs | 3/4 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato | 2 tablespoons chopped onion | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: In large bowl, stir together bread crumbs, ketchup, sun dried tomatoes, onion.

title: Baked Clam Chowder
ingredients: 4 cans of clams with juice | cooked rice | 1/2 lb feta cheese ( crumbled or you may use goat cheese ) | 1 whole serrano chilies ( seeded if desired )
instructions: Pour the garlic into a small frying pan with the chilis. Set this over medium heat and turn the heat to medium. Add the clams. When the clams have opened remove them from the heat. Cover loosely. Leave them open. After a few minutes open the can and pour the mixture into a 6 casserole dish. Add the rice, stirring. Pour the clam juice mixture into the dish. Bake in a 350 degreese oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle the cheese on top for 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,goat cheese,red snapper fillet,pork butt,banana
title: Smoked and Bleached Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pork fat | 6 ounces pork butt, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 medium banana, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/2 cup goat cheese, room temperature | 6 lbs of thin boneless chicken tenders
instructions: Over medium heat, melt the fat in a large saute pan, about 1 - 2 minutes. Add the pork and cook until lightly browned all over, turning with a spatula, about 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer cooked pork to plate and place on plate, leaving fat in pan and reserving fat. Place the banana slices in a separate saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside for a few minutes but not until cool enough to handle. Drain the water from the pan and set aside. Add the cooled banana water and mix well. In a large resealable plastic bag or bowl, add the warm pork and pork butt. Seal and shake to mix. Add the goat cheese. Place all at once in the plastic bag except for the chicken tenders. Shake so that the chicken tenders are evenly distributed. Remove the foil and massage until all of the chicken is covered. Place the chicken tenders on a platter and cover until serving time. Heat your smoker to hot and cook for 12 minutes. Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes. Place the chicken on a platter and spoon the juices over.

title: Easy Mascarpone
ingredients: 4 cups mascarpone cheese ( i used 2 containers ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons marsala or 1 1/2 tablespoons cinnamon marsala & rose jelly mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place the mascarpone & jelly together in a bowl & beat well. Stir in the vanilla & pour into a greased & lined swiss roll pan. Bake in preheated 180c oven for 30 - 35 minutes, or until the mousse topping turns golden brown. Allow to cool & serve lukewarm with a slice of vanilla wafer or dried bread.

Random Ingredients: white bread,green bean,lime,bulk pork sausage,prosciutto,sugar,lager beer
title: The Mighty Blarney Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 6 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1/4 lb bulk pork sausage | 3 slices fresh lager beer ( can substitute other favorite dark beer ) | 1 slice lager beer, from a bottle ( recommended -- corona ) | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 slices green beans, rinsed and patted dry ( approx 2 tbsp total )
instructions: Preheat your grill to 500 degrees f. Place each slice of bread on a work surface and lay two slices of prosciutto on top of each slice of bread, one on each slice of bread, and one to one side of your grilling surface. Top the prosciutto with about two slices of pork sausage, a thin slice of lager and a sprinkle of sugar. Top with a layer of beans, and a second thin slice of meat. Close the grill and cook for about 3 more minutes to start a grilling. Remove from heat and slice into eight servings.

title: Low fat Strawberry and Spicy Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces strawberries, washed, chopped in half ( fresh or frozen, if you like ) | 8 ounces broccoli florets, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1/3 cup low fat soymilk | 1/4 cup low fat soymilk | 2 egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/8 teaspoon chili bean sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the strawberries, broccoli and 2 tsp of the vanilla sugar. Simmer for about 10 minutes or until strawberries are tender. Puree the cooked mixture in a food processor with the soymilk, egg whites and 2 tsp of vanilla sugar. Add the hot soup to the strawberry puree and blend until smooth, stopping often to scrape the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula and whisk. Serve topped with the remaining fresh berries and vanilla sugar.

title: Jamaican Joes
ingredients: 3 heads romaine lettuce | 2 cans beef consomme | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 1 sprig spice ( see below ) | 1 -2 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Trim ends from romaine lettuce, keeping leaves separated from large lettuce leaves. Cut romaine leaves into large chunks. Tear lettuce leaves into shreds. Put in large saucepot or crockpot. Add all remaining ingredients. Add just enough boiling water to cover. Turn on low and cook for about 9 - 12 hours. Remove juice. Serve with fresh lemon wedges.

title: Grilled Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1/2 lb salami, coarsely chopped ( i use a mixture of salami and provolone ) | 1 teaspoon currants | 1/4 - 1/3 cup catsup ( depending on how much of you like catsup, i use more ) | cheese
instructions: Cook the quinoa in a large saucepan of boiling salted water and cook uncovered until all surface water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. When cool, fluff the quinoa with a fork. Fold in the remaining ingredients while still hot through until mixed well. Spread the quinoa on your serving plate. Slice or break into chunks and serve with crumbled cheese.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt pepper,oriental sesame oil,ketjap manis,romaine lettuce
title: Lettuce and Hot Mustard
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, shredded | 1 -2 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1 teaspoon pickled jap manis ( soy sauce ) | kosher salt and pepper
instructions: Tear off any tough leaves of the lettuce, or cut the large leaf into strips about 3 inches long and 1/2 inch wide. Place in a large bowl, dress with oriental sesame oil, pickled jap manis, and salt and pepper as desired. Toss to combine and serve immediately.

title: Ziti With Vegetable Flavor
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 package prepared pizza crust | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon msg ( i use `` accent '' msg ) | paprika ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | pepper ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f and lightly grease a baking sheet. Spray the pizza dough with pam or lightly oil. Separate the dough into four rectangles and wrap each piece in plastic wrap, sealing tightly. Transfer to pizza pan with one side facing up. Use a pizza roller to cut out circles and place on baking sheet. Poke holes in the dough with a floured fork and brush the top with vegetable broth. Bake at 350°f for 15 to 20 minutes or until browned and crispy. Remove from oven and drizzle with some of the broth. Sprinkle a few drops of msg over the top. Garnish with paprika, if desired. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,grain rice,pesto sauce,scallion,tomato soup,allspice,mexican cheese
title: Chef John's Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 scallion, chopped, or to taste | 1 teaspoon dijon-style prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon prepared pesto sauce | 1 cup shredded light mexican cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with cooking parchment. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rice and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain, spread rice out in a thin layer on a flat surface, and set aside. Combine tomato soup, allspice and scallion in a saucepan. Add mustard and pesto sauce, and heat through. Gently stir soup into rice. Spread soup mixture evenly over rice. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until cheese is bubbly and golden.

title: Fresh Corn Side Dish
ingredients: 8 ears fresh corn, shucked | 2 tablespoons dried parsley
instructions: Mix fresh cilantro with dried parsley. Place corn on a baking sheet, and let dry overnight. Preheat your grill to its highest heat. Remove corn from the shaker, and shake off any excess water. Remove kernels from the cob, and place on a cutting board. Use a knife or potato peeler to slice the kernels off the corn at the cobs. Place the corn on grill, and cook, shaking the pan frequently, until the kernels are well cooked. Use tongs to stir the kernels frequently, and be careful not to burn the kernels if necessary. Place cooked kernels onto a platter, and garnish with a dab of fresh parsley, and a sprinkling of dried parsley. Serve hot. These taste best eaten right away.

title: Creamy Mini Clam Chops
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened ( neufchatel is best ) | 1 can chicken thigh, drained and patted dry | 1/3 cup finely minced canned clams or 1/3 cup minced can green mussel or 1/3 cup chopped fresh clam | 3 medium baking potatoes, peeled, cooked and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat broiler and set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat. Butter a 12x6x2 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, blend together the cream cheese and chives. Spread cream cheese evenly in the prepared baking dish. Place chicken in a small, microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes or until cooked through. Remove chicken from microwave and set aside. Pour cream cheese mixture over the chicken and dot with butter. Sprinkle with clams. Bake for about 15 minutes until lightly browned and bubbly around the edges.

title: Smoked Salmon With Cayenne Vanilla
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked salmon, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon olive, dried or 1 tablespoon fresh olive | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place salmon on parchment paper or baking sheet and drizzle with 1 teaspoons olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. In another large oven proof bowl combine with remaining tablespoon olive oil, vanilla, cayenne. Bake 15 - 40 minutes. Remove salmon and from oven, drain off the drippings and add a drizzle or two of olive oil from the bowl. Return salmon to oven and bake 20 - 25 minutes. Serve hot with a side of fresh fruit or nuts.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,white pepper,topping,chili pepper flake,yellow onion,rotel tomato chilies,salad oil
title: Lazy Peruvian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow onion, diced | 1/2 cup fat-free whipped topping ( i use homemade powdered sour cream ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fat-free ranch ( you can also use longevity brand ranch ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained | 1/3 cup pico de gallo | 1 -6 dried chili pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Dice onion. Boil the diced onion with 1/4 cup of water until just softening. In a blender add remaining ingredients, including the onion and onion.

title: Cheesy Cilantro Jalapeno Pepper Curd
ingredients: 2 fresh jalapenos | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper or 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Clean and remove stems and seeds from peppers, remove stems.

title: Creamy Chuka Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces chow mein noodles, prepared | 1 can tomato puree | 1 tablespoon horseradish
instructions: Cook chuka noodles according to package directions. When done, drain and rinse with hot water. Combine drained chuka noodles with tomato puree and horseradish and mix. Enjoy.

title: Hot Candied Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 3 tablespoons finely chopped red green cherries | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the ground cardamom and bouillon granules.

title: Thai Soup
ingredients: 2 cans crushed tomatoes with green chile peppers | 6 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 3 cups finely chopped chinese cabbage | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped clams | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 cup shredded cooked pork | 6 large tortillas, cut into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together crushed tomatoes, feta cheese, cabbage, clams, vegetable broth, and garlic.
