Random Ingredients: cooking oil,french bread,oyster,walnut,salt black pepper,potato,mandarin orange,paprika
title: Oysters Baked in Foil in a Bread Bowl
ingredients: 1 lb fresh oyster, shelled, shucked, reserving 4 per person | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon cooking oil | 6 tablespoons walnuts, shelled roughly | 3 -4 potatoes, peeled and diced | 300 g french bread, trimmed of crusts and cut into 1 inch cubes | salt and brown speculaiospirian salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Rinse the oysters under cold water and shake off excess water. Place the oysters in a shallow ovenproof dish and sprinkle with a little bit of the paprika. Pour over the oil. If using wooden spoon, cover the oysters with a clean cloth and bake in oven for about 20 mintes or until they start to bleed and the edges are beginning to turn golden brown and crispy. Using the back of a knife, split open the tops of the oysters and, using the spoons, carefully remove the crusts. Place the bread on a baking tray and brush with oil. Sprinkle over the walnuts, season with salt and pepper and bake for about 10 minutes. Arrange the reserved oysters on top and serve immediately.

title: Champignons Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 small button mushrooms | 6 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Wipe the mushrooms and trim away any dirt. Put the mushrooms in a frying pan. Pour in 3 tbs brandy and leave to simmer over high heat for 5 minutes or so, until the mushrooms are done. Serve immediately.

title: Faux-French Onion Porridge
ingredients: 8 cups cold milk, more if desired | 1/2 lb french onion, finely chopped | 1/2 lb mushroom, chopped
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil over high head. Trim and rinse onion under cold running water. Remove outer layers from saucepan and set aside. In 4 quart saucepan, bring milk to boil over high head. Reduce heat to low.

title: Marrakesh Okra
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs okra | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups kalamata olives, pitted | 1/2 cup baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Wash okra well. Cut or tear okra into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Place okra in a mixing bowl and add enough water to cover. You can also use broth but take care to not wash the okra, just rinse well. Place okra in large baking pan, add 2 cups of water. Bake, uncovered, in oven for 2 hours or until okra is tender. While okra is baking, cook your favorite topping and prepare your toppings. Spread cooked okra on a serving platter. Drizzle with a little more baking powder. Serve with some fresh or toasted chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,beef consomme,caraway seed,barbecue sauce,large shrimp,shrimp,self raising flour,potato
title: BBQ King Prawns (Shrimp) #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag large shrimp, raw peeled and deveined | 8 large shrimp, raw peeled, prawns peeled and deveined | 1 chicken bouillon cube, knorr brand ( i use knorr brand ) | 100 ounces beef consomme | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1/2 lb potato, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 cups fresh large shrimps, in shell or cans
instructions: Cut the raw peeled prawns into 1 inch pieces. Heat krsa in a heavy skillet on a medium heat until hot, stir in chopped prawns. Combine all other ingredients and slowly bring it to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes, stir occasionally. Add the cooked prawns to the stew and bring back to the boil. Serve with the potatoes.

title: Homemade Ricard
ingredients: 2 1/4 ounces caraway seeds, ground | 2 1/4 ounces triple sec
instructions: If a strong flavor, refrigerate the caraway seeds for 3 days. Remove the seeds from the pan. Combine caraway seeds and triple sec in a small saucepan with 2 - ½ cups of water.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,yogurt,active yeast,clam juice,cottage cheese,balsamic vinegar,canola oil,bacon
title: Tilapia Salad With Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup yogurt | 1/2 cup cottage cheese or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 - 2 cups lukewarm clam juice | 3 tablespoons canola oil, divided | 8 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 2 -3 canned tomatillos, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in the yogurt and mix in cottage cheese or sour cream. Stir in 1/4 cup of the clam juice until it dissolves. Place 1 1/2 cups of the clam juice in a small, nonreactive saucepan. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup clam juice. Stir over high heat until bubbling. Remove from heat. Heat remaining 1 1/2 cups clam liquid just until bubbling. Do not boil. Meanwhile, fry bacon in 1/3 cup canola oil until crisp. Remove with slotted spoon and drain bacon on paper towels. Stir cooked bacon into yogurt mixture. Add vinegar and tomatillos to yogurt mixture. Stir in cilantro. Serve warm or cool.

title: Fig and Fig Jam
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh figs | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Trim the figs. If they don't have very long sticks of about 2 inches long, cut away any damaged ones. Put a small, non stick fry pan on your stove over high heat, and add enough water to touch the bottom of the pan with the tip of your finger. Pour in the figs right in a circular motion. The most important thing is that they don't move around in the liquid, but cook them, stirring from time to time, for 15 minutes, then check for color. If desired, cook a little longer. If necessary, cook the jam a little slower. Transfer to a sterile jar and let cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2 weeks, and up to 6 weeks before using. The goal is that the jam will last a few weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Doughnuts
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh lobster meat, coarsely chopped | 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 pounds sliced pepperoni
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the lobster meat, yogurt, pepperoni, and green onion. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours for flavors to blend.

title: Pigs in Ham
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs ham | 2 tablespoons sage
instructions: Bake or bake the ham. Bake this in a 325°f oven for 2 hours or you can brown it. When done, place on a platter and put a piece of ham in it. Slice it or pat it dry with a paper towel.

title: Baked Rose Petals With Cream Cheese and Corn
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 4 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1 tablespoon vodka | 2 -3 sprigs rose petals, from the garden | 1 -2 teaspoon shaved nutella
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Put pasta water on to boil. Add oil. Place rigatoni in a large pan of boiling water. Drain, cool and then put into large bowl. Add cream cheese and vodka. Mix until well combined and then add rose petals. Mix well to coat. Drain rigatoni and toss with nutella. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet, place in the oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or just until golden. Let it cool a few minutes and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,mint sprig,head cabbage,cherry,vegetable oil peanut,chicken bouillon granule
title: Roasted Cabbage and Pork Ribs
ingredients: 8 cups halved and trimmed cabbage | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules, divided | 4 lbs country-style pork ribs | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 cups coarsely chopped medium head of cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450° f. Line large rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment. Place cabbage in a large bowl.

title: Black Beans
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained & rinsed | 2 cans beef broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 5 quart slow cooker. Cook on low heat setting for 10 - 12 hours, until beans are tender.

title: Rigatoni With Chili, Tomatoes and Black Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes, washed, peeled and chopped | 3 cups rigatoni pasta or 3 cups rotini pasta | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until just tender but firm to the bite, about 11 to 15 minutes. Drain. In a large serving dish, mix the sliced tomatoes and black cherry sauce. Drain the rigatoni and toss it with the tomato chilies. Tip, you can also serve the rigatoni with a cheese, cheese cloth, or sliced black olives if you have the time.

Random Ingredients: red onion,tamari,cake flour,bay leaf,orange peel,urad dal,hazelnut,rice noodle
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Noodle Crisp
ingredients: 16 ounces cake flour | 1 envelope tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 3 tablespoons rice stick noodles ( or 1-2 packages gluten-free rice crackers ) | 2 cups shredded orange peel | 2 cups sliced red onions | 2 cups sliced unbleached hazelnuts | 1 bay leaf, or more ( optional ) | tamari ( to garnish ) or soy sauce ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix cake mix, tamari, rice crackers and 2 cups of the orange peel in a bowl. Add 1 cup of the orange juice and 2 more cups of orange peel. Mix until combined well, then knead until dough can be formed into a ball. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured board into a circle 1 1/2 inches thick. Cut out as many circles as possible using a biscuit cutter. Using a 2 1/2 star shaped cookie cutter, cut out as many circles as possible. Repeat, using more dough, and cutting off the remaining circles. Use the remaining orange peel slices to decorate the casserole. Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees f or until firm but not browned. While the treats are baking, place a cup of water into a skillet over high heat. Add 1 bay leaf, if using. Boil the water for 5 minutes until the water is reduced by half. Drain the water into a small bowl and set aside. Once the treats are baked, drain them and set aside as you do. Place the remaining orange peel slices onto a plate and sprinkle with a little tamaraki. The orange peel will absorb the marinade. Once the treats have cool, cut into slices. Arrange the orange peel in a single layer on serving plates that are about 2 inches square. Drizzle a little bit of tamaraki over the orange peel. Top with the noodles, and drizzle extra marinade over everything. Finish with a drizzle of tamaraki on the top.

title: Baked Sausage-Wrapped Pasta With Beans and Corn
ingredients: 20 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 20 ounces frozen corn, thawed and drained | 12 ounces sausages, chopped ( hot or sweet ) | 2 cups fresh vegetables, chopped ( cauliflower, zucchini or carrots ) | 2 cups black beans, cooked and drained ( canned or canned ) | 1/4 cup dried mixed herbs ( see directions for ingredients ) | 1/4 cup creamed coconut | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f grease a 13x9 inch baking dish, and place the pasta and corn on a clean, dry surface. In a large bowl, mix the sausages with the vegetables, beans, and dried herbs. Turn the pasta mixture into the prepared dish and top with the creamed coconut and 1 teaspoon of asafoetida. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes until heated through and the topping is browned and crisp.

title: Apple Beef Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck, at room temperature, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices | 3/4 cup apple juice ( or apple cider )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place roast in a roasting pan and add apple juice. Cover the pan tightly with foil and roast for 55 minutes, basting once or twice. Remove foil and roast for an additional 30 minutes or until fork tender.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,gingerroot,garam masala,liquid smoke,beet,yogurt,coriander powder,okra
title: Okra in Spicy Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 2 large beets, peeled ( or 2 small ones ) | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, minced | 2 tablespoons yogurt ( full fat if using dairy yogurt ) | 1/2 cup okra ( frozen okra will work also ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/8 teaspoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Wash and scrub the beets if using frozen. Cut off the stem end and remove any remaining beet skin. Place beets in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and continue to simmer until soft, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove beets and mash with a spoon. You will have a thick sauce. Strain the beet liquid to remove excess fat. Place beetroot in a bowl and add yogurt and okra. Add the spices and enough ginger to flavor the mixture. The yogurt should soak into the yogurt before adding the yogurt. You could add a bit of lemon juice but your okra will take away some of the moisture from the yogurt. Stir till the yoghurt is incorporated and the okra is coated evenly. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Add more ginger or curry powder if desired.

title: Tortilla Tacos

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Peanut Butter and Matzo Salad
ingredients: 5 ounces elbow macaroni, rinsed and drained | 2 1/4 ounces creamy peanut butter | 1/3 cup green olives, sliced and rinsed | 2 tablespoons matzo meal ( gluten-free if desired )
instructions: Whisk together macaroni, peanut butter, green olives and matzo meal in a large bowl until well mixed. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Gravy for Soup

instructions: Place the cubed beef into a large pot. Add the tomatoes with their juice, blueberries, and marjoram. Stir well, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low.

title: Meatballs and Peanuts

instructions: Combine all ingredients and roll into 1 inch balls. Cook in a 350 f. Oven about 15 mins. Turn over and cook 2 min. Drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

title: Fruit or Nut Mix

instructions: Place chopped nuts or fruit of choice in a pan and cover with a mixture of honey and mix well. Spread mix evenly on baking paper, or use greased paper. Bake at 180 grades c until cooked. Use a pastry cloth covered in icing sugar if desired to remove any excess paper. Store in an airtight container. Variation, add 1 cup crushed sorbet or crushed chocolate chips for a variation.

title: Cheese Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces cheese tortellini | 3 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 pint fresh strawberries in syrup | 2 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto, chopped | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated fresh | 1/4 cup strawberry syrup | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions. While tortellini is cooking, cook farfalle according to package directions. Drain, and rinse. Combine remaining ingredients, reserving 1/2 cup of the strawberry syrup. Toss with hot cooked tortellini and reserved 1/2 cup of strawberries syrup. Garnish with more grated lemon zest if desired.

title: Green Beans With Roasted Bell Peppers
ingredients: 3/4 lb green beans | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 3 tablespoons castor sugar | 1 can rotel tomatoes, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 fahrenheit. Wash first 3/4 pound of green beans, and trim ends. Cut ends from green beans, cut each in half lengthwise. Cut remaining green beans, and add salt and cook until tender crisp. Remove beans and set aside. Cut bell pepper in half, removing stem, seeds and membrane if desired. Combine sesame seeds, and oil in a small bowl, add black beans and stir to coat. Place vegetables on a large baking pan, then roast until tender crisp. Mix into remaining ingredients. Cover and bake 30 minutes longer, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,corn syrup,oatmeal,kaffir lime leaf,edam cheese,beef chuck,cherry tomato
title: Edam, Corn and Beef Slice
ingredients: 1 onion | 1/2 cup corn syrup | 8 kaffir lime leaves | 500 g beef chuck | 1 cup oatmeal | 1 cup fresh cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 cups frozen cauliflower, broken into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 170 c. In a food processor, combine onion, corn syrup, lime leaves and process to release as much juice as possible. Place ground chuck, oatmeal, tomatoes, cauliflower and seasoning in a baking dish. Pour over the mixture and bake uncovered for 30 minutes until well heated through. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Cabbage Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 bag shredded cabbage | 3 cups thinly sliced cooked chicken | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 leaves lettuce
instructions: Heat chicken drippings in a skillet or wok over medium high heat. Stir in cabbage and garlic salt. Cook and stir until cabbage is crisp tender and chicken is heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove cabbage from skillet, leaving 1 tablespoon of chicken drippings in the skillet. Stir cabbage mixture until hot and lettuce leaves are crisp, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Easy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 10 yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Slice potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in a bowl. Pierce with a fork in the center of each slice. Sprinkle potatoes with 1/2 teaspoon cayenne. Top with the whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: tomato olive oil,sirloin tip roast,cardamom,cinnamon sugar,butternut squash lengthwise,vegetable,lamb shank,hash brown
title: Sugar-Laced Beef and Butternut Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless sirloin tip roast, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 lamb shanks | 1 lb chopped vegetables ( i used whole sweet potatoes, broccoli cauliflower, zucchini and carrots ) | 8 ounces stewed tomatoes with piquant olives or 8 ounces rotel olives, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 box frozen mixed frozen vegetables, thawed and drained | baggs mixed cinnamon sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Combine all ingredients except sugar in a 2 to 3 quart slow cooker and set to go. Turn the slow cooker on high for 20 to 30 minutes. Turn down to low and cook for at least 3 to 4 hours, or on high for 8 to 10 hours. While the beef is cooking, preheat oven to 325 degrees. If the beef is browning too quickly, reduce heat if too close, and cook a longer period of time. If the beef is browning too quickly, reduce heat if too close, and cook longer. In a large skillet, heat 1/2 lb. Of beef and 1/2 lb. Of vegetables over high heat until the beef and vegetables are browned and heated through. Remove meat mixture from skillet and place in medium bowl.

title: Baked Onions
ingredients: 3 vidalia onions | 6 garlic-style bread | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 cup butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut the ends off the onions, and slice across on the diagonal into 1/4 pieces. Place the sliced onions on a baking sheet, and drizzle with olive oil. Bake onions for about 20 to 30 minutes, stirring the onions and letting them brown.. Place onion slices on a serving dish, and brush them with the tahini. Sprinkle with butter to serve.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,bean,lime juice zest,pizza crust
title: Cuban Red Bean Pizza
ingredients: 16 slices pizza crust ( store bought or homemade, i don't like bread ) | 1 can baked beans, undrained | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven according to ingredients of crust package. Spread the beans in an overlapping manner onto the pizza crust. Sprinkle zest, juice, vinegar over the beans. Sprinkle pizza crust with dried beans. Note, you can make this pizza at home or make your own with other toppings to this recipe.

title: Poulet Au Rhum
ingredients: 3 -4 chicken thighs | 6 anchovies | 1 rosemary | 300 ml cream or 300 ml beef sherry | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 4 spring onions, in thin slices | 1 pinch salt | 1 package mixed dried fruit, in chunks
instructions: Rinse your chicken joints if they are any thinner then cut into 4 pieces. Pour the cream on top. Mix the anchovies with rosemary then rub the anchovies through the meat, then tie an air tight tin foil parcel around the chicken. Place the sealed tin on your chopping board, and slice down the middle of the breastbone. Remove the breast bone and make sure they are totally closed. Cut your cherry tomatoes in half lenghtwise. Then cut into halves, then length again like you did before. Then cut into 2 or 3 wedges. Repeat the process until you have used up all of the chicken. Remove the chicken carefully from the tin foil parcel and put in the fridge. If not freezing, leave to your side for an hour to thaw. When ready to use, place the chicken in a frying pan, fill with just enough water to cover the chicken and bring to the boil over medium heat. Turn the heat down to simmer and add in the mushroom soup, spring onions. Let it simmer over a low heat until the chicken is tender and falling off the bone. Add in the mushrooms and herbs then taste for seasoning and serve immediately over the dried fruit.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,tea,red cabbage,ice water,sun tomato,feta cheese
title: Miniature Red Cabbage Slice
ingredients: 150 g feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped ( not without oil ) | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 6 sun-dried tomatoes, sliced or 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato paste | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped chocolate chip | 1/2 cup ice cold water | 1 large red cabbage | 1/4 cup tea
instructions: Line base and sides of 18 x 10cm swiss round tin with foil. Heat oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add sun dried tomatoes. Cook stirring, about 1 minute. Remove from heat & stir in cheese & chocolate chips. Spread cheese & tomato mixture evenly in base of prepared tin. Spread cabbage over cheese & sprinkle over sun dried tomato mixture. Bake in a 325°f oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven & stand for 5 mins before serving.

title: Pasta Bean Soup With a Twist
ingredients: 2 cups cannellini beans | 1/4 cup superfine sugar
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 1 1/2 cups water. Meanwhile, bring a kettle of water to an boil. Trim the beans to separate and rinse well. Then place in the saucepan. Bring to a boil. Once boiling, add the beans and stir. Cover and return to the boil. Reduce heat to low, cook for 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the superfine sugar, adjust seasoning if necessary to taste. Cover and chill overnight to develop the flavors. Serve cold.

title: Homemade Chilt-Free Palomones
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped pimento and peanuts | 1/4 cup dijon-style chutney | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 3 tablespoons finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1/2 medium savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 jalapenos or 1 poblano chile, seeded and finely chopped, for garnish | 8 radishes, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl, tossing well.

title: Spiced BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle wine or ( 750 ml ) bottle beer | 1 bouillon cube ( or equivalent amount of liquid smoke ) | 1 teaspoon coarse salt or 1 teaspoon spicy salt | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pan or pan for deglazing. Reduce until well blended.

Random Ingredients: watercress,bulgur,sorrel,pimento olive,white bread,yellow mustard seed,spaghetti seasoning
title: Spaghetti Sauce With Sorrel, Ornish and Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb parsnish sorrel | 4 cups watercress | 1 cup uncooked bulgur | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced | 2 tablespoons white bread, crumbs | 2 1/2 teaspoons yellow mustard seeds ( may sub 1 tsp. white pepper ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons spaghetti seasoning
instructions: Remove spnilla from husks using a fine mesh sieve. Rinse under running water. Cut sorrel, including stems, into small pieces. Place sorrel and 1 cup boiling water in a small bowl. Cover and set aside. Prepare bulgur, bring 4 cups water to a boil, add bulgur. Cover, remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine olives, bread crumbs, salt, hot pepper sauce, and remaining 2 tbsp water in a small bowl. Mix well. Drain sorrel, reserving liquid. Cut away leaves or fiber on sorrel. Cut sorrel into bite size pieces. Place half or, depending on quantity, of bulgur in a food processor. Cover and pulse several times until finely ground. To check for doneness, place a finger in the center and then invert a plate upside down onto a cutting board and the sorrel begins to slide out. When cooked, remove sorrel to a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,chili pepper,brown sugar,cheese,great northern bean
title: Easy White Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans, drained | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons chili peppers, crushed | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon unsalted cheese, grated
instructions: Combine beans, brown sugar, chili peppers, oil, and cheese in a nonreactive baking dish. Bake at 450°f for 20 - 25 minutes, or until heated through and cheese has melted.

title: Santa Fe Fish
ingredients: 1 can solid white fish fillets | 1 can chunky salsa | 1 hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse the fish fillets and pat dry. Stir salsa in a 9x13 inch pan to coat evenly. Place fish in pan. Bake in the preheated oven until the fish is cooked through, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: paprika,green olive,natural yoghurt,taco seasoning mix,tuna,anise seed
title: Moroccan Tuna Fish and Mango Salsa
ingredients: 4 large oranges | 1 1/4 ounces taco seasoning mix | 1 1/8 ounces natural yoghurt | 4 tablespoons paprika | 4 cans tuna | 200 g green olives
instructions: Slice orange into rounds. Place into shallow roasting pan. Mix the taco seasoning, yoghurt and paprika together, then pour over the tuna and olives. Place under a hot grill until the tuna is golden brown and the tuna is golden through.

title: Date and Sesame Dressing
ingredients: 2/3 cup fresh dates, pitted and chopped | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1/3 cup greek salad dressing or 1/3 cup ranch dressing | crushed ice, as desired
instructions: Place dates, sesame seeds and salad dressing in a blender and blend until smooth. Toss with crushed ice and serve.

title: Easy Pizza Ole
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust ( or your favorite your own recipe ) | 1 cup sliced black olives | 1/2 cup sliced yellow pepper | 1/4 cup sliced yellow sweet pepper | 1/4 cup sliced bottled sweetened soup or 1/4 cup grand marnier | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Spread both sides of cheese spread of a pizza crust with soup. Top with olives. Add pepper, sweet peppers, paprika and salt. Top with toppings. Bake at 450' for 10 - 12 minutes depending upon your favorite topping toppings.

title: Pita-Stuffed Pita Bread (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 2 whole wheat pita bread | 1/2 lb ham, sliced | 1/2 green bell pepper, sliced ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh breadcrumb ( from the stale kind ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut each pita into thirds lengthwise. Place the halves cut side up in a loaf pan. Cut the ham into 1 cubes. Arrange the diced ham and green bell pepper on the bread. Place the bread in a 325 degree oven and bake for about 25 minutes. In a medium bowl, combine the bread crumbs and nutmeg.

title: Spicy Satay Pies
ingredients: 30 g plain flour | 30 g ground roasted peanuts, unsalted | 1 maraschino cherry, halved | extra peanut, roasted
instructions: Place flour, peanuts, cherries and seasonings in a food processor, blend until fine. Shape walnut size pieces of dough into 2. Wrap a piece of cling film on a board and press each onto a non stick lined tray. Repeat until all mixture is used. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Makes 15 skewers on a large tray. Preheat grill to medium high or 220 degrees c. Place skewers on grill rack and grill for 4 - 5 minutes, turning regularly until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,olive oil cooking spray,beef eye,strawberry
title: Mexican Martini
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | mexican cheese, grated | 1 lb beef-eye roast | 1 pint fresh strawberries or 1 pint other fresh fruit, halved
instructions: Preheat oven on the broiler setting. Place roast in a large roasting pan with a cover. Spray the top with your favorite cooking oil.

title: Bahama Mama Pork Chops (Crispy)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin or 1 lb pork butt, 3/4-inch thick | 8 ounces dark rum | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 2 quarts canned low sodium broth
instructions: Cut the pork in 1/2 inch slices across the grain. Place the pork in a resealable zipper bag. Add the rum, cayenne, and the 4 quarts of water. Turn to coat the pork. Refrigerate the pork for 4 to 8 hours. Turn the bag a few times to coat. Remove the pork from the bag and place on paper towels. Bring the broth to a boil and add the drained pork. Reduce heat and simmer gently, covered, for about 1 and 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.

title: Green Mexican White Salsa Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 1 can whole green anaheim chilies | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 20 leaves fresh romaine lettuce
instructions: Core the anaheim chilies and cut off the ends so they stand upright. If the chilies are large, halve them vertically if you want more intense color. If you want thin ones, halve them vertically if you want to make them thinner. Cut the chilies into small wedges. Place in a large salad bowl and add the vinegar, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight. Serve with iceberg lettuce leaves as desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian beef strip,chicken stock,hot italian sausage,paprika,cilantro,potato starch,green capsicum
title: A Polish Sausage Stew over Potato
ingredients: 300 g vegetarian beef strips ( or beef strips of any kind ) | 2 links hot italian sausage ( or other hard sausage such as sweet beef strips ) | paprika | 3 tablespoons cilantro | 7 -9 tablespoons potato starch, to make the stew ( all-purpose is what i used ) | 375 ml chicken stock | 1/2 medium green capsicum
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a pan and fry the sausage until cooked thoroughly. Set aside to cool. Cut meat into about 3/4 inch cubes. Add a small amount of potato starch to the pan and cook the potato starch until it becomes dark brown in color. Pour over the sausage and stir. Cut green capsicum into 1/4 inch squares. Pour the chicken stock into pan and cover. Leave to cook over very low flame for around 90 minutes over high heat stirring every 15 minutes for about 45 minutes. Add the green capsicum cubes and cook 5 - 5 minutes more. Serve with polenta for a change of pace.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,golden syrup,salt pepper,sea salt black pepper
title: Gentle Momma's Special Polish Lonavian Grocery Plums
ingredients: 25 -35 large green cardamom pods, lightly smashed | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 2 1/2 cups golden syrup or 2 1/2 cups sugar | 4 -5 lbs mixed plums ( i use greengage plums, but you can black plum types too ) or 4 -5 lbs other plums, such as orange plums
instructions: Place the cardamom pods in a small sauce pan with just enough water to cover the whole spices, and bring to a simmer. When the cardamom starts to swell, remove them from the heat. If you're using black plum plums, drain off all water. Using a slotted spoon or tongs, remove the seeds from each plum and discard. Fill a large non reactive stock pot 2/3 full with water and bring to a boil. Add the sugar and the plums and return to a boil, stirring frequently, until the sugar and plums are cooked but the plums still in a syrup, approximately 20 minutes. The liquid should bubble up. Remove from the heat and discard the whole spices that float to the top. Place a large piece of waxed paper on a flat plate. Remove the seeds from all of the plums and reserve. Cut off the tops using a grapefruit peeler or sharp knife. Cut the plums into the desired length using a very sharp, wet knife, removing the core and all the membrane. Place all of the reserved plum tops in a food processor and pulse to a coarse chop. Scrape into a large serving bowl and stir in the chopped plum puree. Store in the refrigerator for up to 5 days to develop flavor. Note that the flavor will become more enhanced with age. When bomboos are removed from the freezer, it should be stored for up to 3 days to mellow it.

Random Ingredients: pepper,fine breadcrumb,ancho chile powder,cumin seed,cucumber,salad green,turmeric,golden syrup
title: Curried Cucumbers (Tanzwanese)
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced | 1 tablespoon salad green | 1 tablespoon golden syrup or 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb, to sprinkle on salad
instructions: Combine cucumber, salad greens, golden syrup or maple syrup, pepper, chile powder, cumin and turmeric in a nonreactive bowl. Mix well. Top with bread crumbs to ensure a even coating. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Sprinkle salad with remaining crumbs just before serving.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,ice cube,no salt tomato sauce,farfalle pasta,vanilla bean,vanilla soymilk,blue curacao
title: Kielbasa Cheeseburger Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 1/2 cups no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1/4 cup no-added-salt tomato puree or 3/4 cup no-salt-added reduced-sodium tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons vanilla-flavored soymilk | ice cube | ice cube | 2 fluid ounces blue curacao | crushed ice cube
instructions: Cut kielbasa crosswise into 1 inch cubes.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,maraschino cherry,maple syrup,stewing chicken,saffron thread,strawberry yogurt,goat cheese
title: Strawberry Chicken With Goat Cheese(Wienersch Gourmet)
ingredients: 1 cup strawberry yogurt ( or greek yogurt ) | 3 cups shredded cooked stewing chicken | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 teaspoon saffron maple syrup | 12 ounces goat cheese | 1/4 cup shredded maraschino cherry
instructions: Mix, yogurt and stew chicken. Add baking soda, saffron and maple syrup. Place on greased baking pan. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool, stirring occasionally. Cut goat cheese into 1 inch cubes. Spread on the stew chicken mixture and sprinkle with the cherries. Return to oven and bake another 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid burning. Serve in a bowl.

title: Crock Pot Chinese Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 10 ounces pineapple slices in juice | 3 tablespoons steak seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in crock pot. Cook on high for 2 hours then turn to low. Use your wok, saute or bbq sauce on high till desired doneness, and serve with mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,sage leaf,button mushroom,green pepper,nutritional yeast
title: Mushroom and Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 lb fresh button mushroom | 1 medium green pepper | 1 medium onion flakes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast
instructions: Cook mushroom finely to remove any excess moisture or moisture. Cut green pepper into 1 inch cubes and set aside. Finely chop mushrooms and onion and place into a bowl. Add pepper, herbs and nutritional yeast. Mix gently so the spices and butter are incorporated and the vegetables are well coated. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Beer Gaucho Cigars (Pigs)
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/3 cup chopped celery rib | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour ( approximately ) | 12 ounces muenster cheese ( cut into 1/4 inch dice ) or 12 ounces monterey jack cheese ( cut into 1/4 inch dice ) | 1 can beer | 1/2 tablespoon dried basil
instructions: Lay thawed phyllo sheets on cutting board and lightly flute with the flat side of a large table knife. Brush with olive oil and roll 2 sheets at a time, brushing with oil. Cut pastry into 1/4 inch strips. Add celery and continue with remaining sheets, brushing with oil. Spread flour over phyllo. Sprinkle cheese or monterey jack evenly. Working with 1 strip of phyllo at a time, transfer dough directly onto work surface. Roll until smooth and round. Repeat procedure with remaining phyllo, cheese and meat mixture, laying each on one sheet of phyllo and using the other sheet, forming 6 logs. Cut logs crosswise into 3 inch wide strips. Working with 1 strip at a time, transfer strips to dampened hands. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper or foil and with a spatula, transfer parchment paper. Place briquettes in a large baking dish and, using tongs or a large slotted spoon, remove foil. Bake for about 15 minutes, turning briquettes, until golden brown. Transfer to a large bowl and allow to cool. Cut each briquette diagonally into 6 slices. Top with a few slices of muenster cheese and continue with remaining briquettes. To make a simple, sprial smoke effect, combine 2 tablespoons of basil leaves and 1 tablespoon of flavored beer in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Cut briquettes and serve with a light mist of aromatic smoke goodness. To make a smoked effect, spoon 2 1/2 tablespoons of flavored beer into a small, dry skillet and cook over medium heat, reducing heat to a simmer and turning briquettes with a spatula until brown outside and crumbly inside. Repeat process with remaining briquettes.

title: Creamy Dry French Toast
ingredients: 4 slices yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon heavy cream | 1/8 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon finely dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Stir the mustard and cream together in a shallow dish until well combined. Sprinkle the turmeric and breadcrumbs over the top, and sprinkle the breadcrumbs evenly over the surface. Heat a griddle or heavy skillet over medium low heat. Place the breadcrumbs in a single, even layer. Cook, turning once, until golden and bubbly, 4 - 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Tunisian Marinated Steak Sandwiches (Shuku Sate)
ingredients: 1/2 lb sliced sausage | 1/2 of a cucumber | 1 tablespoon minced adobo seasoning or 1 tablespoon minced chiles | 2 -3 lbs steak | 2 tablespoons harissa
instructions: Prepare your favorite steak as specified on the pkg. In a large skillet, the meat will brown on the outside while cooking. Mix together the above ingredients and marinate overnight. The longer the marinate, the more flavorful the meat is. Heat the grill. When the first side is cooked remove, turn over and cover with foil to keep warm. Slice the meat across the grain and grill, or grill, or wrap it in foil and let rest on a paper towel while the second side cooks while the meat rests. Serve with lemon wedges. Note, you can assemble this on a sombrero, sliced sandwich, or into a sandwich size freezer bag. For a party, just unwrap the meat and wrap the entire bag with saran wrap on it, securing the ends with string by sewing two pieces together. You can also wrap the wrap in aluminium foil and put it in a freezer bag to keep warm in a warming oven. You can also freeze up to 6 months. Note, if you can afford the time to grill the meat, this will become just as flavorful. Note, you can also grill the meat, if you don't have a grill option, but can substitute a charcoal grill for the smoke. Note, cooking time will depend on the thickness and variety of your charcoal. This could take anywhere from 15 - 30 minutes.

title: Sage and Lemon Roasted Turnips
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, pared and cut lengthwise into quarters ( about 3 1/4 lbs ) | 1/4 cup fresh lemon rind, chopped | 24 large pitted black olives, such as kalamata | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick spray. Arrange the turnips on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the lemon rind, cover with foil, and roast until tender and beginning to brown, about 35 minutes. Remove foil, and cook until the mixture is dry and caramelized, about 5 minutes longer. Transfer the turnips to a serving platter, and sprinkle with the olives. Add the remaining tablespoon of lemon rind, and sprinkle with sage. Serve warm as a breakfast or as a side dish.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,coconut oil,butternut squash,romano cheese,italian bread,italian,cilantro
title: Cheesy Butternut Squash with Cilantro
ingredients: 1 butternut squash ( about 1 lb ) | 1 romano cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon dried cilantro | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 ounce italian bread or 1 ounce crumbled feta cheese | 3 tablespoons coconut oil, divided | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Slice the butternut squash lengthwise and remove seeds. If whole and then with a knife make a slit in the pulp with the tip of a sharp knife. You don't want to cut all the way through to the bottom of the squash. Place the squash cut side down on paper towel, wring out most of the water, and allow to rest at room temperature until cool enough to handle but still slightly fluffy. Peel the squash and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place all the butternut squash in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with the romano cheese, cilantro, seasoned salt and bread crumbs. Drizzle with half the coconut oil and drizzle with remaining oil. Toss to coat. Bake uncovered in a 350f degree oven for 30 minutes or until the squash is tender and the top is lightly browned. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Baked MEATBALLS WITH RUMIN
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs sirloin beef, trimmed | 8 ounces raisins | 4 ounces chicken livers, trimmed | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 cups cold whipped cream
instructions: Sprinkle the top of the beef with the raisins, then place in a large baking dish. Cut the livers in half at the diagonal, remove their membranes, and place on top of the beef. Mix together the lemon juice and butter, then pour over the top of the beef. Cover and bake in a 350&deg.

title: Cafe Rio Steak Sandwich II
ingredients: 1 pound sirloin tip steaks, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup instant yeast | filling : | 1 can or bottle white beer | 4 hass avocadoes
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of beer in a large glass bowl. Add meat.

title: Moroccan Cigars Using Tomato and Pepper
ingredients: 1 can chopped tomatoes | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( or crushed ) | 30 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Combine tomatoes, green pepper and coriander seed in a bowl. Cut rounds from one sheet of phyllo pastry. Lay out 1 sheet, top with 1/2 cup of mixture, and fold in the sides and the bottom to form a triangle, crimp the edges, and then roll up once more. Repeat with remaining sheets.

title: Tuna Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 cup tuna water, divided | 8 ounces pepperoni | 8 ounces monterey jack cheese | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 3/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil | 2 cups crushed fresh prunes
instructions: To make the crust melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the basil and 1/4 cup of the crushed prunes. Continue to cook until the onions are soft. Remove from the heat and stir in the remainder of the prunes. Spread evenly over the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan lined with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Drain the tuna fillets of any excess liquid and arrange in the crust. Wrap the cheese over the top and bake at 350 degrees f for 5 minutes. Reduce the temperature to 125 degrees f and continue to bake for 1 hour, stirring regularly, until the cheese is melted and the crust is golden. Pour the cheesecake into a serving plate and let it cool for 15 minutes before serving. Crust will bubble over.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,vidalia onion,peanut,avocado,buttermilk,parmesan cheese,soy sauce,cherry juice
title: Easy Avocados and Avocados over Buttermilk
ingredients: 6 avocados | 1 onion, thinly sliced | 1 cup cherry juice | 2/3 cup panko grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons drained chopped peanuts, lightly toasted | 2/3 cup buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Cut avocados in half lengthwise, remove pit and reserve. Scoop out flesh from shells, scoop out and discard membrane, and set aside. Place onion and cherry juice into medium bowl. Place avocado shells in a medium bowl and toss with 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, 1/4 cup almonds, buttermilk, orange zest and 1/4 cup soy sauce. Toss to coat. Divide avocado mixture among avocado shells, and serve.

title: Oysters Pea and Green Chile Salad
ingredients: 3 green peppers, diced | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 6 tablespoons peas | 6 tablespoons oyster mushrooms
instructions: Prepare salad by mixing together peppers, jam, peas, and mushrooms. Allow to sit for 30 minutes. Chill.

title: Mustard Pork (Cock-Adu)
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups coarsely chopped pork loin | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 pound uncooked fresh pasta
instructions: Combine veggie stock and mustards together in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Simmer on low heat, and cook about 10 minutes, uncovered, to develop flavor. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to package directions, drain. Scoop out half of the pasta, return to saucepan with mustard sauce, and mix well with pork.

title: Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 lb bean sprouts | 1 jar cannellini beans | 1/4 cup crushed pistachios | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder
instructions: Drain the bean sprouts and rinse well. Let them stand for 5 minutes. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and simmer for 25 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,broccoli floret,seasoning salt,ricotta cheese,green bell pepper
title: Garlic Veggie Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons seasoned salt | 1 medium green bell pepper, minced | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh broccoli florets | 1 cup coarsely chopped fully cooked meat-filled hamburger buns | 3 tablespoons low fat ricotta cheese
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: beef stock bouillon,chipotle chile,tequila,pepper,white pearl onion
title: Chipotle White pearl onions
ingredients: 8 white pearl onions | 1/4 cup tequila | 2 tablespoons instant beef stock or 2 tablespoons bouillon | 1 chipotle chile, seeded and chopped ( canned chipotle can be used ) | pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat up the oil over medium heat, then add the onions and sweat until the onions are well caramelized and the skins have begun to crackle. This should take about 10 - 15 minutes, but should take less time add the tequila a few minutes before the onions are completely tender and add stock, cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 40 - 60 minutes or until the onions are very tender. Once cooked, stir into the mashed potatoes, season with pepper and serve.

title: Artichoke Stir-Fry
ingredients: 8 ounces artichoke hearts, drained | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons soy sauce
instructions: Remove artichokes from can and slice into strips with a sharp knife. Heat vegetable stock and soy sauce in a high heat and fry artichoke strips for about 2 minutes. Sprinkle with salt. Serve immediately.

title: Mom's Luscious Sweet Bacon Bits
ingredients: 8 ounces bacon bits, i've always used real bacon ( the wee bit bacon bits aren't my preference ) | 1 -2 tablespoon instant dissolving liquid smoke, ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 2 -3 teaspoons milk | peppercorn | corn flakes
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir with a fork. Refrigerate for about an hours or overnight to blend flavors. Taste for seasoning. You can add whatever else floats your boat. You can eat crunchy bits and jam when you're craving sweet things. I used about 1/2 cup.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,cucumber,greek yogurt,beer,dark sesame oil,rosemary,jamaican jerk spice,ketchup
title: Tropical Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 bottle beer | 1 container greek yogurt | 1/3 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon rosemary, chopped | 1/2 cup cucumber, peeled | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 -2 teaspoon japanese jerk spice, to taste
instructions: Combine the beer, yogurt, ketchup, sesame oil, rosemary, cucumber, and cream in a food processor and pulse until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl. Sprinkle the jamaican jerk spice over the top. Serve with your favourite crackers or vegetables.

title: Tostones
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and heat in an iron skillet for 2 minutes.

title: Cranberry and Sun-Dried Tomato Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 package cranberries, chopped | 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Makes about 24 servings.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,anchovy oil,chipotle chile,strawberry,pineapple chunk,corn oil,balsamic vinegar
title: Frozen Strawberries
ingredients: 3/4 cup strawberry, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon anchovy oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons chipotle chiles, minced | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 cup pineapple chunk, chopped
instructions: Drain strawberries place thawed strawberries in a freezer bag, place in freezer for up to 2 hours. Combine oil and seasonings and whisk well. Remove thawed strawberries from bag, place in a shallow serving dish. Pour marinade over thawed strawberries toss to coat. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Goes well with rice.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,almond,cardamom pod,prune,nonstick cooking spray,fontina cheese,mustard,greek yogurt
title: Cheese Stuffed Prunes
ingredients: 8 ounces fontina cheese ( about 4 cups ) | sliced almonds | 1 can prunes | 2 teaspoons mustard, dijon ( or more ) | 4 teaspoons fat free greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1 -2 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Stuff each prune with a slice of fontina cheese and place in a small baking dish. Sprinkle with almonds and top with sliced prunes. Coat prunes with 1 tsp mustard. Combine yogurt, prepared mustard, spices and bouillon and pour over prunes. Mix well and chill in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Preheat broiler. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray and place prunes on sheet 1 1/2 inches apart and broil for a few minutes or until golden and bubbly. Let cool slightly and serve. Can also be served cold from the freezer. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Morii Onigiri (Fried Pancetta With Chili)
ingredients: 3/4 lb pancetta, cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons sake ( mirin ) | 1/2 lb poblano chile | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 tablespoon mirin | kosher salt
instructions: In a medium frying pan over medium heat, fry the pancetta until crisp and brown, about 6 minutes. Add the second 1/4 teaspoon oil to the pan and fry the chile briefly. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Pour the second 1/4 teaspoon oil into the frying pan and, over medium heat, add the 2nd tablespoon oil and fry the pancetta until crisp and brown, 2 to 4 minutes. Return the pancetta and chile to the frying pan, add the mirin and sesame oil and fry over medium heat until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Strain the mixture and discard the chile. Stir in the sake, then drizzle over the pancetta.

title: Cauliflower With Sauteed White Fish With Dried Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 6 large anaheim chilies, stemmed and seeded with cut sides | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 3 lbs white fish, firm and skin on | 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 3/4 - 1 cup half-and-half | vegetable oil, for sauteing the fish and cauliflower
instructions: Grind all cumin seeds to a powder in a mortar. Set aside. Set a saute pan on medium heat. Drizzle in the oil and heat until hot but not smoking. Add the cumin powder and saute until the cumin seeds begin to jump. Add the fish and cook until just beginning to flake, 3 to 4 minutes. Add the peppers, turmeric and reserved cumin powder and saute for 3 minutes longer. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f degrees. Prepare the cauliflower and set aside. Add half and half, cover tightly and cook until barely tender, about 4 minutes. Add cauliflower and toss well to coat. Place in a well buttered baking dish. Bake the cauliflower for 20 to 30 minutes, or until tender. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the reserved cumin powder. Serve with plain white rice.

title: Kofta (Meat Kofta in Microwave)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon allspice | 5 tablespoons caster sugar | 400 g ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon sweet masala
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Cover with cling film and microwave on high 100% power for 12 minutes, until the meat is cooked. Serve either warm or cold. Keep the meat in the freezer and freeze.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,broccoli,italian seasoning,beef tenderloin,chili sauce,white bread,water chestnut
title: Slow Cooker Sausages and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch-thick rounds | 12 ounces broccolini or 12 ounces broccoli, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons chopped water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons chili sauce ( or bottled chili garlic sauce ) | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed ( not quite 1-inch thick ) | 6 slices white bread, lightly toasted
instructions: Spray your crock of the slow cooker with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,mustard green,cream cheese,tart apple,rotel tomato
title: Crock Pot Cream Cheese Apples with Fresh Mustard Greens
ingredients: 4 medium tart apples ( about 8-10 slices or 2-10 large sour apples, such as fuji ) | 4 ounces cream cheese, softened ( can use light or light ) | 2 tablespoons dry mustard greens, minced ( like calamans aka green grits or swiss grits, can sub 2 cups of spinach, about 5 oz ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary leaf ( optional ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes, well drained from can drained
instructions: Spray bottom and sides of a 2 - 3 qt crockpot with cooking spray. Arrange apple slices in crockpot. Beat cream cheese until fluffy with electric mixer. Add mustard greens and rosemary. Mix well. Spoon over cheese. Cover and cook on low heat 3 to 4 hours. During last 30 minutes stir tomatoes into cheese mixture. Cover and cook 15 minutes longer. Remove lid and increase heat to high. Cook for 5 minutes or until center of apple is soft and cheese is melted. Transfer to serving platter.

Random Ingredients: grain bread,hamburger,cool whip,caper,turmeric powder,chinese egg noodle,peach
title: French Toast Sandwich With Chinese Egg Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 ounces chinese egg noodles, soaked in water for 1 hour | 8 slices whole grain bread | 2 tablespoons sweet pickled sliced dried peaches | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 tablespoon crushed turmeric powder | 1 container cool whip
instructions: Prepare dipping sauce/recipe #1. Brown hamburger in skillet drain add drained noodles and saute until hot thru. Drain and set aside. Drain egg noodles, drain and set aside. Place half slices of bread in a skillet and warm. Place each slice of bread in a lightly greased dish. Place a slice of hamburger on the bread and top with some of the pickled peaches and capers. Sprinkle the turmeric and turmeric over the meat and noodles. Spread the sweet pickled pickled peaches around and top with remaining bread. Let sit for about 3 - 5 minutes. Drizzle your warm dipping sauce on top and eat.

title: Tuna Chipotle, Mexican Style
ingredients: 1/2 inch chipotle chile ( canned chipotle ( can take a few seeds ) | 1 can tuna
instructions: Plug in the tuna. Take the lid off and use it to flake the tuna. If not flake easily, just flake and save it on your plate. Empty all of the chipotles over the tuna and spread them out flat. Cover the tuna with a plastic bag. Wrap the bag again and let it sit in the refrigerator for a few hours. This will help it flake into smaller chunks. After 30 minutes, mix tuna, and cheese together. If the tuna and cheese mixture are not fully cooked yet, feel free to add a little extra cheese to keep it at a slight dente texture.

Random Ingredients: chile powder,pork stew meat,beef chuck,white breadcrumb,pepper sauce,tomato puree,horseradish sauce,pineapple chunk
title: Honey Glazed Corned Beef and Pork Burgers
ingredients: 6 slices of dark-red texas toast dark rye bread, cut in 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick slices | 1 lb lean boneless pork stew meat, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 3/4 cup pineapples ( about 4 ounces ) or 3/4 cup apricot preserves, crushed ( about 4 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons honey-roasted tomato puree | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish sauce | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup fresh white breadcrumb, lightly toasted ( see note ) or 1/2 cup fresh greek yogurt, whisked into | white breadcrumbs, for coating
instructions: Note, any crushed pineapple can be used in place of the apricot preserves. In a nonreactive bowl, mix the pineapple/dill paste with the honey or tomato puree, horseradish, and chile powder. In a shallow dish, using a fork, toss the beef, bread, or yogurt to coat. Add the beef mixture to the bread crumbs and toss to coat, pressing crumbs into meat. Press into meat and refrigerate overnight. Preheat grill on medium heat. Heat grill pan until hot but not smoking.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,hamburger bun,rice,black tea,alfalfa sprout,molasses,tomato onion garlic,pearl barley
title: Veggie Barley Beef Tea Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger or 1/2 lb bacon | 1 can crushed plum tomatoes with onion & garlic, undrained | 12 ounces brewed black tea ( no substitutes ) | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 1/2 cups medium grain rice | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves | 1 package sliced alfalfa sprouts | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 4 soft hamburger buns
instructions: Cook bacon in heavy large saucepan over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon on paper towels, retaining drippings. Cook hamburger, breaking into small pieces along with 1/4 cup reserved drippings, in large bowl until brown, breaking up into pieces with back of spoon, about 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and their liquid, black tea and molasses.

title: Sweet Gingered Noodles
ingredients: 2 teaspoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, finely chopped | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 head savoy cabbage, rinsed and thinly sliced | 3/4 lb fettuccine | 1 package snow peas, sliced
instructions: In a large pot combine the molasses and ginger. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until it foams. Add the onion and cabbage, and cook just long enough to soften the vegetables. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook pasta just to al dente, drain. In a large bowl, toss together the noodles and vegetables. Top with snow peas, and serve. Enjoy.

title: Nana's Deliciously Fried Marinated Meat
ingredients: 1 kg finely minced meat | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | mint ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak meat in half the quantity of water for atleast an hour, changing the water at least once. Remove the washed meat and leave for 1 hour. Pour oil into a pan or wok, add the meat and cook over medium heat until it shrinks slightly and turns dark brown. Drain excess water from the outside of the meat and put meat in a bowl. Gently squeeze out excess water and keep aside. Heat ghee in the same pan. Pour the meat into the pan, garnish with onion and oregano leaves and serve hot.

title: Curry Leaf Rollups
ingredients: 2 sheets nori | 3 cups fat free liquid egg substitute | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon curry leaf | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 2 tablespoons curry leaves
instructions: To make the sauce, in a small bowl, stir together catsup, 1 tsp curry leaves, smoked paprika, and the 1 cup of liquid egg substitute. Heat nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Place two sheets of nori. Dip each sheet of nori first into the egg mixture, then into the cat sauce, coat lightly. Heat the remaining sheet of nori in the heated skillet over medium low heat until warm, 2 to 3 minutes. Lay the nori, flat side down, on a clean work surface. Roll up the nori.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,white wine vinegar,whipping cream,sage,picante sauce,cilantro leaf,raisin
title: Wild Rice-And-Sauteed Cilantro-Raisins With Rum & Sage
ingredients: 12 ounces wild rice, cut from a box | 9 ounces raisins, halved if large | 2 cups picante sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons packed fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Rinse wild rice, drain and set aside. Place the raisins in a bowl, pour 2 cups of the picante, vinegar and cilantro over the raisins and set aside. Heat the grill / broiler. In a skillet stir the cream with the sage. When you have a good bubbling mixture on the side of the skillet, pour it over the rice and stir. Cook the rice until heated through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Transfer the rice to a platter and let cool 5 - 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,fast rising yeast,cherry,salmon,water chestnut,romano cheese
title: Cherry Roll (No Rolling!)
ingredients: 300 g chicken stock or 300 g water | 200 g cherry ( quartered ) or 200 g frozen whole cherries ( quartered ) | 1 tablespoon rapid-rise yeast | 200 g smoked pork loin, sliced thin | 100 g smoked salmon, sliced thinly on the diagonal ( boneless ) | 200 g romano cheese or 200 g asiago cheese, grated | 25 g salted anchovies ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine wine vinegar and water, and bring to boil, stirring continuously. Remove from heat, add yeast, and stir. Place the chicken stock, cherries, and cheese in the bottom of your double boiler. Place the sliced meat and salmon in one layer in the bottom of the double boiler. Pour vinegar and water mixture over the meat and bring to boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and let cool. Lighly cut the romano cheese into pieces and place into a small bowl. Place the romano cheese on a cutting board, and place two pieces of plastic wrap between the two pieces. Spread a piece of cheese on the cutting board. Slice in a crosswise motion. Dip the cheese into romano to cover the cheese. Roll it into sausage shapes, pressing gently so the romano does not soften. Place in paper cupcake cases, close lid, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. When ready to serve, remove the romano cheese. Serve in small ramekins or plastic bowls.

title: Cornish Game Hen With Coconut Cream Crumb Topping
ingredients: 2 cornish hens, about 2.5kg | 2 1/4 cups coconut cream | 1 onion, finely diced | 1 tablespoon coconut flour | 1 zucchini, chopped finely | ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees celcius. Place hens on rack at top of a medium size oven dish and season well with salt and pepper, dust with coconut flour. Place over medium heat, and cook, turning as necessary, for about 8 minutes or until cooked through. Add onion and zucchini and cook until tender. Remove hens from oven and set aside. Add coconut cream to sauce and bring to boil. Return hens to oven and continue to cook until liquid is reduced by half. Toss in coconut flour and top with chopped onions and zucchini. Return to oven for another 2 - 3 minutes or until topping is golden.

title: Italian Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 cups cannellini beans | 1 can condensed tomato soup
instructions: Pour bean soup into a large skillet and put on medium heat. When almost hot, pour beans into bean pot. You will now see the redness and the sugar on the top. Slightly lower heat, making sure that the beans don't burn on the bottom and on top of the beans, they will be soft and roasted.

title: Maggie Greenspan's Greek Cornbread
ingredients: 4 ears cornmeal | 1/2 cup quaker nutritional yeast | 1/2 cup sifted consomme | 1 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | chopped parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Place cornmeal in a large bowl. Add rest of ingredients & mix well to combine. Bake in a preheated oven 425°f for 50 - 60 minutes or until desired tenderness. Serve while hot, with a garnish of chopped fresh parsley/extra virgin olive oil.

title: Frozen Chocolate Liqueur Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chilled whipping cream | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 3 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 4 ounces chocolate shavings
instructions: In a bowl, using an electric mixer, whip the cream until it forms soft peaks.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,oyster sauce,hoagie,green salsa,gruyere cheese,pine nut,chipotle chile
title: Beef Salpicao and Pine Nut Heroes
ingredients: 2 hoagie rolls, cut lengthwise | 1 jar green salsa | 1/3 cup canned chipotle chile, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 4 slices gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup shaved gruyere cheese
instructions: Toast hoagie rolls in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix green salsa with chipotles, and top with 2 tablespoons of chipotles. Toast pine nuts in skillet until lightly browned. Transfer to a plate. Top 1/2 of the rolls with a 1/2 amount of the green salsa mixture and a slice of cheese. Return to skillet and top with remaining swiss cheese. Cook until cheese is melted and sandwich is warmed through.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,asafoetida powder,table salt,baking potato,confectioner ' sugar,ginger garlic paste,double cream,onion powder
title: Indian Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 32 medium baking potatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 teaspoon granulated asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar | 1/8 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Wash potatoes and separate into a large bowl. Place 1 cup of water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Turn heat to medium low and add ginger garlic paste and salt. Cook for about 1/2 minute. Add potatoes. Boil the potatoes until soft. Remove from heat and drain excess water.

title: Fava Bean Dip
ingredients: 3 cups cooked fava beans, chopped | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve with assorted tortilla chips.

title: Gougeres (Belgian Leeks)
ingredients: 2 lbs leeks, trimmed, white parts rinsed and well cleaned | 2 3/4 cups chicken broth or 2 3/4 cups water | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 4 slices breadcrumbs | 2 celery ribs, cleaned of any sand etc
instructions: Soak the leeks in plenty of cold water and drain. Slice leeks 1/4 inch thick and set aside. Heat broth to boiling.

title: Rye Salad
ingredients: 1 large head romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 onion and/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 4 slices rye bread, or as needed
instructions: Mix romaine lettuce, onion, and onion powder together in a bowl. Place bread slices on a grill.

title: Cato's Sausages
ingredients: 750 g minced beef, with bone in | 1 tablespoon sage | 1 tablespoon frangelico | 2 tablespoons vodka or 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 cup self raising flour
instructions: Place all ingredients on a plate, mix well. Divide mixture into 10 - 20 sausages or sausages suitable for shallow frying. Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry sausages until cooked through, drain. Serve in a warm soup, pouring over the sauce.

title: Hot Press
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried porcini mushrooms | 2 slices thick sliced toast | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1 carrot, finely diced
instructions: Place dried mushrooms and coffee in mortar and pestle. Add diced carrot and finely diced rind of 1 carrot. Stir well, breaking up coffee.

Random Ingredients: catsup,dark brown sugar,dark sesame oil,salad dressing,chicken stock,sea bass fillet
title: Steamed Sea Bass
ingredients: 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 2 teaspoons dark brown sesame oil | 4 sea bass fillets | salad dressing
instructions: Combine the catsup, sugar, sesame oil and 2 tablespoons of stock in a small pan. Bring to a simmer over a low heat and allow to simmer for five minutes, whisking frequently. Pour over fish and refrigerate for 1 hour or until fish turns white and opaque. Meanwhile, bring remaining stock to the boil and reduce slightly, then stir in dark brown sesame oil. Spoon sauce over fish to cover, then serve.

Random Ingredients: chambord raspberry liquor,sea bass fillet,oregano,nonfat cream,ice cube
title: Sea Bass Chambord
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces sea bass fillets, cut into 2 x 1/2 inch | sea bass fillets, with bones | 1 tablespoon chambord raspberry liquor | ice cube | nonfat sour cream, room temperature
instructions: Spray a 12 count skillet with cooking spray. Dry the sea bass fillets completely. Arrange fillets on top of a sheet of heavy duty foil and drizzle with chambord. Coat each fillet completely with ice and wrap in foil. Place wrapped fillets on grill over medium low heat and cook until done, approximately 6 minutes per side. To serve, spoon 1/8 cup chopped and sour cream onto plate and place flaked sea bass fillet on top and drizzle remaining sour cream on top of fish.

Random Ingredients: green tomato,thai basil,pie shell,chicken tender,mozzarella cheese
title: Chicken and Veggie Quiche
ingredients: 6 chicken tenders ( cut into small squares ) | 1 prepared pie shell | 2 green tomatoes ( cut into 1 inch cubes ) | 12 leaves fresh thai basil, sliced ( not dried!, not dried ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place chicken tenders between two pieces of plastic wrap. Place on a plate and pound gently to flatten slightly. Place each piece of tenders on a piece of plastic wrap and pound lightly using a rolling pin or the flat side of a cleaver. Repeat until chicken tenders are finished. Bake chicken tenders for 15 minutes. Place an oven safe dish on a cookie sheet that will hold them in a single layer. Place a layer of tomatoes over the tomatoes. Cover with a layer of basil, then a layer of cheese. Repeat layers of basil, tomatoes and cheese until they are all gone. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes until warm and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,mexican chocolate,catsup,pasta shell,lime zest,ranch dressing mix,vegetarian bean
title: Mexican Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 24 portobello dry pasta shells, cooked al dente, patted dry | 3 cans vegetarian baked beans, undrained | 3/4 cup catsup | 1 1/2 cups mexican-style hot chocolate | 4 tablespoons taco-style ranch dressing mix | 1 fresh lime, zest of | coconut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix beans, catsup/sweet chocolate, and ranch wine blend well in large bowl, set aside. Dice lime zest and place in bowl along with cooked shells, the lime juice.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,topping,cherry tomato,cumin seed,yellow bell pepper,baby carrot,cooking grit
title: Fritters in Spicy Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen topping sheets, thawed | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking grits, or as needed | 1 pound frozen shrimp paste | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1 large carrot, shredded
instructions: Combine shrimp paste, cumin seeds, cherry tomatoes, and yellow bell pepper in a large pot. Cover and heat over medium low heat until shrimp paste is hot and vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes. Do not boil. Remove from heat. Combine grits with shrimp mixture, and stir until mixture comes together. Form 16 fritters. Place on a large plate, cover, and refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes to chill. Serve with shredded carrot on the side.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups milk | 1 tablespoon lemons, juice and zest of, finely grated ( optional ) | 1 cup cream, whipped ( optional )
instructions: Heat milk in a saucepan over medium heat until almost bubbling.. Stir in lemon zest and lemon juice. Remove from heat. In a medium bowl, stir the whipped cream into warm milk mixture. Pour into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer instructions.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,passion fruit juice,arugula,roasting chicken,pork shoulder,marjoram
title: Pork and Roasted Chicken Wellington #2
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 cup leftover cooked pork shoulder | 1/2 cup passion fruit juice ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 cup prepared marjoram or 1/4 cup fresh marjoram, chopped | 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed | 1/2 cup arugula, well washed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Wrap the outside of the chicken in the pastry sheet. Reserve the inside of the chicken. Use scissors to cut the chicken in half horizontally. Carefully open up the chicken and cut into pieces approximately 1 1/2 inches long. Set the pieces on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Use the scissors to stretch the pastry until it forms an even layer. Place the chicken and all the other ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Pour the mixture over the top. Sprinkle the top with additional marjoram or marjoram, if desired. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees. Remove from oven and serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: wolf brand chili,corn,water chestnut,papaya,cream chicken soup,lemon peel
title: Grilled Peaches with Chili Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 frozen sweet corn, thawed | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon lemons, peel of, grated | 1 teaspoon papaya, peeled seeded and chopped | 3/4 cup canned cornstarch, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Preheat grill to medium low. Mix chicken, soup, water chestnuts, lemon peel, papaya, and cornstarch together in a bowl. Place corn on a plate or in a shallow baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Pasanda
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef ( cut into chunks ) | 2 tablespoons masala
instructions: Season with salt. Simmer in slow cooker for 2 hours. Add masala. Simmer for 30 minutes longer. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,mustard powder,olive,basmati rice,corn chip,salad dressing
title: Basmati Rice Salad with a West Seattle Flair
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup salad dressing | 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon mustard powder ( or sub 1 tsp. dijon mustard ) | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | 2 tablespoons fresh basil ( or 2 tsp. dried basil leaves )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, replacing half of the package with water. Drain in a sieve. Combine dressing, oil, dry mustard and orange juice in a small bowl and stir to blend. Combine drained rice and dressing mixture in a large bowl with a wooden spoon. Place salad in a serving bowl and top with basil.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,tarragon vinegar,beef stew meat,arborio rice,beef broth,dill pickle
title: Beef Risotto-Arrabiata
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef round stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes ( i use chuck ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar | 1 can condensed beef broth ( or other small soup stock ) | 1 bag arborio rice | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh dill pickle ( or 6 8 slices of fresh dill )
instructions: Bring meat, vinegar, and liquid to a simmer in a saucepan, stirring frequently. Boil 1 minute, then remove from heat and add rice, 1 cup of the broth, and cream.

title: Noodles
ingredients: 1 package barbecued noodles or ( 1 lb ) package other small macaroni noodles | 1/2 cup vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Cook or rinse noodles as directed, drain. Toss with vinegar. Toss again to mix before serving.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,chicken drumstick,salt black pepper,white wine,spanish rice mix,beef sirloin,white onion,stewing beef
title: Spanish Chicken & Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 package spanish rice mix | 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken drumsticks | 8 ounces lean beef sirloin | 1 can spanish-style rice with pimientos, cut in half crosswise | 1 -2 white onion, cut in half | 1 container beef stock | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Prepare the spanish rice mix according to package instructions. Meanwhile, season the meat with salt and pepper on all sides, and set aside. Remove the chicken from the freezer and place it in a large pot of boiling water. Bring back to a gentle boil and cook for about 15 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through. Cut the beef in half and cook it over medium heat in a skillet. In a separate pot, cook the onions over medium heat in the beef stock until lightly brown. Add the cooked rice and simmer for about 10 minutes. While rice is simmering, sear the meat pieces in a heavy skillet for a few minutes, and transfer them to the rice, and return the meat to the skillet. Add the wine to the skillet and cook over medium heat for 1 minute. Pour the mixture over the meat and rice and serve.

title: Oven Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces cremini mushrooms or 4 ounces button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon grated or 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix with a spoon. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Microwave. Add to mushrooms. Sprinkle salt and pepper if desired. Roast in a 400º oven for 10 minute.

title: Lori's Beef and Capsicum Bread
ingredients: 350 ml freshly made breadcrumbs ( approx ) or 400 ml unseasoned breadcrumbs ( approx ) | 3 teaspoons fresh yeast | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane sugar | 120 g coarsely crushed red capsicums | 140 g coarsely crushed serrano peppers or 140 g jalapeno peppers
instructions: Place the 2 cups of bread crumbs, the yeast, sugar and salt in a bowl and mix well to combine. Mix in the crushed peppers and 1 cup of water. Turn dough onto a lightly oiled surface, knead in 3/4 cup more water if dough is sticky. Place in a bowl, cover with a cloth and leave to rest in a warm place for 1 hour. Pre heat the oven to 230c or 140c if convection ovens vary to your oven. Grease a loaf tin, line with greaseproof paper and set aside. Place the remaining cup of bread crumbs in a plastic bag or bowl and lightly crush with your hands. Shape the breadcrumbs into 12 balls and place on the greased baking tray. Place in a pre heated oven and bake for 12 - 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and leave for 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and leave to cool on the baking tray. The brie will be soft and quite dry. Turn out onto a large, floured surface. Cut into 12 portions. Serve with a salad or other accompaniment.

title: Homemade Bragg's® Beef Buns
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak | 1 large ( 7 ounce ) package active dry yeast
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, place beef with yeast and let stand for 7 hours or longer. Using hands, pull meat and its liquid into a mixing bowl and add 1/2 cup water to moisten, cover and refrigerate, covered with a light cloth, for 5 to 6 hours. Place the meat and its liquid in a large, heavy duty bowl or roaster. Add all of the buns by hand or with an electric mixer. Pour remaining water over all. Cover with clean kitchen towels and allow to rise until doubled, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease the inside of a 9 inch round cake pan or round cake pan with cooking spray or brush the inside of the pan with oil and slash the top with a sharp knife. Transfer the meat and its liquid into the pan and let cool to 110 degrees f, about 15 minutes. Brush or spread with about 1/3 cup of the cooking spray or spread with oil. Bake in the middle of the preheated oven until the buns appear puffed and golden brown on top, about 25 minutes. Allow the buns to cool for about 5 minutes before slicing. Serve on their own.

title: Salsa Colorada (Fresh Mexican Salsa)
