ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a lid and shake well. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Easy Cream of Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb cream of mushroom soup, low-fat | 1/4 lb sherry wine | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon | raspberries, chopped to serve
instructions: In small saucepan combine cream of mushroom soup and sherry. Cook on medium heat until heated through. Remove from heat and mix in tarragon. Spray pan with non stick spray and place over high heat until foaming. Stir in cream of mushroom soup. Cook for 1/2 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in raspberries. Serve over cooked noodles.

title: Jamaican Sweet Potato Jam - Microwave Recipe
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes ( medium are best ) | 1/2 large scotch bonnet pepper ( i use habanero ) | 1 lemon, juice of | 1/2 cup dark raisin | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried marjoram | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1/2 cup sweet jam with pith or 1/2 cup jam, of choice | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 4 -6 tablespoons sweet moroccan style chutney
instructions: Microwave potatoes on high for 1 minute until just starting to 'peel', but not mushy.. Chop chili pepper and mix in lemon juice. Dice sweet potatoes, and place in a large bowl. Add salt, pepper, dried herbs, melted butter and pith or jam. Mix well. Remove lid and microwave for 3 minutes on high, then 10 - 15 minutes on low. When potatoes are halfway cooked, stir in saffron. If not thick enough, add a little water and microwave a few more minutes. You may need to place lid on microwave and leave on 'keep warm' in microwave. Take lid off and stir in sweet moroccan style chutney. Let jam bubble up on top while serving, then put back into microwave for a few minutes until it has reduced. Serve with assorted fresh fruit. It goes perfectly with rice.

Random Ingredients: tea,dijon mustard,pie crust,thai fish sauce,olive oil
title: Thai  Steak  Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 1-inch squares | 1 unbaked pie crust, unbaked | 1/4 cup lea and irish gold tea steaks, cut in strips or | 1 teaspoon dijon-style mustard | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In bowl, mix steaks and marinade until the meat is covered. Line pie pan with pastry on bottom. Arrange meat on pastry. Brush with 1 tbsp of the dry mustard. Bake in middle of oven 20 minutes. Turn over, sprinkle on remaining dry mustard. Continue baking 5 minutes longer. To serve, top with steaks and drizzle with the remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: chile pepper,tortilla chip,spice,vanilla bean,egg noodle,coriander seed
title: Chilli Noodle Mix
ingredients: 1 piece vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( optional ) | 1 medium egg noodle | 1/2 cup ground dried chile peppers | 1/2 cup minced fresh coriander seed | 1/2 cup rawspice | 2 teaspoons whole coriander seeds | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Dissolve vanilla bean in 1/2 cup boiling water. Bring to boiling.

Random Ingredients: red chile,cardamom,salt substitute,green pepper,dark sesame oil
title: Spiced Beef Strips (Beef Skewers)
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks ( trimmed of all extraneous fat or excess fat ) or 2 lbs top round beef, cut into one-inch cubes ( trimmed of all extraneous fat or excess fat ) | 1/2 1/2 green pepper or 1/2 red pepper, thinly sliced | 1/2 red chile, thinly sliced diagonally ( or 1/4 tsp. cayenne ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Cut the beef into strips approximately 1” by 1 1/2”. Place the meat and all the other ingredients except the salt substitute and the cardamom in a large stainless steel bowl. Mix well. Cover the bowl and set aside in a cool spot. Place the meat and salt substitute in your kitchen sink or a colander for 2 hours, shaking the bowl occasionally. Remove, drain or dry the meat. Set aside. Place the meat in the refrigerator and marinate on a rack for 15 minutes then remove. Rinse off the salt substitute and discard. Thread onto skewers, either by weaving a skewer through the meat, passing in opposite directions, or, if preferred, make into 8 skewers.

title: Okra With Chorizo and Okra
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mayonnaise | 2 ounces chorizo sausage, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 3 ounces okra, trimmed and sliced
instructions: Make the mayonnaise by combining all the ingredients. Heat the sausages in a non stick frying pan until cooked through. Remove from pan, slice and set aside. Add the okra to the pan and coat well with the mayonnaise and chilli sauce. Cover and leave to cook for 10 minutes, until golden brown. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate molasses,ricotta cheese,beef oxtail,madras curry powder,maple syrup,bacon dripping,french bread
title: Beef Roast With Pomegranate Gravy (Bisteeya Ma Khadra)
ingredients: 3 teaspoons maple syrup | 3 teaspoons beef oxtail, knuckle tenderized ( or beef brisket ) | 4 slices good quality french bread, 1-inch thick | 1 1/2 teaspoons madras curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons pomegranate molasses | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 3 slices bacon drippings | pomegranate molasses
instructions: In a bowl, stir together the maple syrup, beef knuckle, and bread slices. Place the meat on the bread slices. Rub the meat with curry powder and pomegranate molasses. Place the bacon drippings on the rack in a roasting pan and set under foil. Roast the meat about 1 hour at 325 degrees f, basting occasionally with pan drippings. The meat can rest in the pan for about 1 hour before carving.

Random Ingredients: avocado oil,red bell pepper,nutmeg,lemon juice zest,tomato ketchup
title: A Guacamole - Michael Chiarello
ingredients: 1 avocado oil, to make 1 -2 tablespoons | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg, if freshly grated | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup or 1/2 cup chunky chunky barbecue sauce | 4 medium red bell peppers ( or your favourite choice of peppers ) or 4 small yellow bell peppers, diced ( or your favourite choice of peppers )
instructions: Cut the avocado pieces in half and scoop out the flesh into a bowl. Cut the lemon zest into small pieces and whisk them together. In a separate bowl, combine olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest and nutmeg. To make a dressing, combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Put the bell peppers in the blender to make 3 bell peppers, 1 for each bowl of ingredients, the other for the salad. Toss the vegetables together in the sauce and add to the guacamole and lemon mixture. Serve immediately. Also great with chips. Enjoy.

title: Mac 'n' Ben's Italian Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb mac 'n' ben's italian pasta | 1 lb parsnip ( sliced ) | 2 tablespoons tomato paste ( no salt added ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. Meanwhile, add tomato paste to boiling water, then add parsnip. When pasta is done, drain and return to pot. Add tomato mixture and italian seasoning. Toss to mix well. Serve.

title: Grilled Sole With Cardamom-Cardamom Crust
ingredients: 4 cups cooked and peeled sole | 2 tomatoes, ripe and chopped | 1/2 aubergine, trimmed and finely diced | 7 cardamom pods | 7 egg yolks, beaten | 200 g dark chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Grill the sole until tender and golden, about 10 minutes, then set aside to rest. Mix together tomatoes, aubergine, cardamom and egg yolks until well combined. Place the chocolate in a small heat proof bowl, with a pinch of salt and 1 teaspoon oil. Spray four shallow ovenproof dishes with butter flavored spray and set aside and let cool slightly. Spread cooled chocolate over the flat side of each plate, then arrange the sole on top of the chocolate. Press an egg yolk into each toothpick and then pour chocolate mixture around the sole. Dollop the remaining chocolate over this to make a marble effect, if using. Grill the toothpicks until melted, 5 - 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,mint,mango chutney,egg white,chicken broth,xanthan gum,crabmeat
title: Grilled Thai Crabmeat Patties
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1/3 cup chopped of fresh mint | 1/2 cup finely chopped dry crabmeat | 1 tablespoon chicken tender quick-cooking sauce | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Preheat coals grill for indirect heat. Line a bamboo grill pan with foil. Beat egg white in a bowl with a whisk or rubber spatula. Stir broth, mint, crabmeat, chicken tender quick cooking sauce, xanthan gum, and mango chutney together in a bowl with a whisk. Transfer chicken mixture and chutney to a medium bowl with remaining ingredients, reserving some chutney for dipping, if desired. Season with salt and pepper. Divide bread mixture among four large prepared grill safe burgers spaced 3 inches apart on foil. Turn heat down to medium, cover, and grill until lightly brown, 6 to 8 minutes. To serve, remove foil. Let stand 4 minutes. Using a spatula, transfer burgers to a platter.

Random Ingredients: apricot,cardamom pod,coriander,salt,hot italian sausage,mix,chili bean paste
title: Apricot Sauce for Sausages
ingredients: 8 ounces hot italian sausage, casings removed | 2 tablespoons apricot, chopped ( apricot halves ) | 1 tablespoon hot chili bean paste | 5 cardamom pods | 4 cardamom pods | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Grind the cardamom pods, cardom pods and coriander lightly, then mix with other spices. Set aside. Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices and brown over medium low heat 2 - 3 minutes. Add chili bean paste and cook an additional 2 - 3 minutes until fragrant. Remove from heat and add the sausages and mix thoroughly. Replace the lid and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Gramma's Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup grated carrots
instructions: Mix flour, carrots and water until dough is workable. Place in greased pan and let rise in warm place until doubled. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for about an hour.

title: Lazy Sausage & Beans
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground pork | 1 bunch green beans, trimmed and slit in half diagonally | 2 leaves fresh sage
instructions: Cook pork in a large frypay or skillet using all of the seasoning listed except the sausage. Drain the fat and return the juices to the pan. Add the beans and leave to soak in a cool place up to two days. Sausages should be moist but not hard. Break apart as required. When beans are soft, remove from heat. Stir well until cooked. Slaw can be eaten warm or cold.

title: Basil-Gravlax (Italian Gravlax Balls)
ingredients: 3 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup dried basil
instructions: Stir together the flour and basil. Mix in any other desired filling or meat filling. Knead until dough is smooth. Take out the dough and knead slightly. Shape into balls. Flatten a little and shape into desired shapes. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Italian Blend Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 package italian herb seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt, or to taste
instructions: Place it into a small bowl, and stir in just enough seasoning salt to coat surface. Store in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Red Curry Green Beans
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs green beans | 2 tablespoons sweet red curry paste | 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Cut stems off green beans, remove woody tips, and cut the ends off of the beans to the size of the beans. Bring a large pot of water to boil and add salt. Turn oven to 325 and cook beans until tender, about 3 - 4 hours. Remove beans from pot and place in a bowl with ice water to prevent skin and sand from forming. Place beans back in pot and mash well. Place back on stove and bring to a boil. Add broth cube. Mix well until all ingredients are combined and serve immediately or store baggy or container for reheating later.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,sugar,apple,dill,anchovy paste,grain white rice,sago,beef gravy
title: Swiss Yogurt Pancakes With Baked Aegean Bites
ingredients: 1/2 cup sago | 1/2 cup sago, plus | 3 tablespoons sago | 1 pinch sugar | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt ( i use gluten-free for diet ) | 2 tablespoons beef gravy or 2 tablespoons chicken gravy, plus | 1 teaspoon beef gravy | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste, plus | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh dill | 1/2 cup steamed short-grain white rice
instructions: Drain sago well on a tray and chill until required. Place sago in a medium heavy based pan over a medium to high heat. Swirl to stir until it foams. Add sago, sugar, yogurt, beef or chicken, gravy, 2 tsp anchovy paste, dill and sago. Stir to combine and cook over a further 3 minutes. Turn batter onto a heat proof plate sprayed with oil. Using 2 teaspoons of the batter per pancake, form a round large enough to enclose sago. Repeat and top with a second pancake. Press pancake into the base and around the edge of the pancake. Lightly spray / brush or spread sago batter over the top and sides to seal. Grill pancakes for 20 seconds on each side or until underside is golden brown.

title: Greek Seasoned Salt
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: Whisk 1/2 cup soy sauce into another bowl. Stir in oregano, and let sit for 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Baked in Peanuts
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1 small white cabbage ( finely shredded ) | 1 package crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed but don't drain. Meanwhile, cook remaining ingredients except peanut butter. Drain spaghetti and add to skillet, stir fry until heated through.

title: Spanish Onion Rings and Garlic
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal, or as needed | 9 spanish onions, or to taste - chopped | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds, or to taste | 1 jar salsa, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray baking sheets with cooking spray. Combine cornmeal, onions, fennel seed, and salsa in a large bowl. Mix using hands, making sure to coat everything with mixture. Transfer dough to a round baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( or barley ) | 2 cups homemade bouillon | 10 ounces chopped pimiento ( can use canned ) | 3/4 cup dry sherry wine ( i used a splash of white wine ) | 1 package croutons
instructions: Rinse barley and place in medium pot. Add water to cover barley. Add bouillon. Bring to boil and then simmer until tender, about 90 minutes. Drain water. Return barley to pot, adding pimiento, sherry and croutons. Heat to simmering. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,mexican cheese,red chili pepper,bicarbonate soda,oil
title: Mexican Cheese Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces mexican blend cheese | salt | 1 -2 red chili pepper | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | sea salt | 1 -2 drop oil
instructions: Grate cheese and add to a large bowl. Roughly mash the chilie pepper with salt and mix with the cheese, mix well. Add 1 - 2 teaspoons flour and mix well. Form a small ball out of the cheese mixture and gently press it down with your finger. Place on an oiled baking tray. Sprinkle with salt and bake on a low medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Allow to cool. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,green apple,corn syrup,mint,green,iceberg lettuce,pork shoulder,red potato
title: Korean Grilled Pork Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn syrup | 8 cups mixed greens, red leaf and green leaf varieties | 4 cups red potatoes, diced | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cooked and cubed | 8 medium red potatoes, unpeeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 green apple, cored and chopped coarsely | 1/3 medium head iceberg lettuce, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Mix corn syrup and 4 cups greens in a bowl. Place the sliced pork in a large nonstick skillet and cook over medium heat until well browned. Do not drain. Pour fat from skillet and discard. In the skillet, combine potatoes, pork, apples, lettuce, and mint. Spoon half of mixture over lettuce. Drizzle with corn syrup mixture and sprinkle with reserved greens mixture. Serve with white rice.

title: Italian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups thinly sliced leftover beef roast | 2 packages pepperoni slices, halved
instructions: Slice beef in half lengthwise. Place beef in a large skillet. Stir in pepperoni slices, and pour enough water over to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to med low, and simmer 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Quickly remove beef from liquid, stir in pepperoni slices, and serve.

title: Green Chili Snacks
ingredients: 1 can chopped green chilies | canola oil cooking spray ( for cooking )
instructions: Heat oven to spray cookie sheet or frypan with oil. Drain chilies and combine with green chilies.. Spread mixture onto cookie sheet or frypan, sprayed lightly with oil. Bake 8 - 10 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned. Store in airtight container at room temperature.

title: Peas and Prosciutto Wrapped in Peanut Sauce - Arrabiata Di Peppo
ingredients: 5 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced ( about 5cm squares in all ) | 1 cup frozen peas and carrots | 1 cup marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon goya adobo pepper
instructions: Remove and discard the rind from a carrot and peas and thaw the carrots in the microwave for 4 - 5 minutes. Put the peas and carrots in a bowl with the marinara sauce, crushing up the peas as you go. Stir in the cornflour to thicken and taste. Divide among 6 serving plates.

title: Irish Strudels
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons shortening | 3 cups prepared broccoli, steamed and drained | 1 cup of fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 large egg white ( optional )
instructions: Prepare an 8x8 inch baking or cake pan by lining the bottom with heavy duty aluminum foil or parchment paper. Lay the cooked ground beef on the foil. Heat the shortening in a frying pan over medium heat. When the shortening has melted make sure to scrape it up from all the brown bits. Add the minced beef. Cook the beef, until no longer pink. Drain the excess fat off of the meat. Add the steamed broccoli. Stir in the crushed mint, and turn in until evenly coated. Mix the egg white into a large bowl. Stir in 1 tbls. Of the melted shortening if using if using. Pour the egg white over the ingredients and stir until well mixed. Spoon the mixture evenly over the surface of the beef. Roll or press the strudels into small logs about 2 inches long and about 2 inches wide. Wrap each in the foil and refrigerate overnight. About 2hrs before serving time preheat the broiler. Spray the tops of the strudels with a light coating of cooking spray. Broil the strudels until the tops are slightly charred. Remove and serve.

title: Oatmeal with celery
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats | 2 stalks celery, roughly chopped
instructions: Put the oat in a large bowl and roll up to cover the whole thing. Leave in the fridge until it is dry. Spray a shallow pan with oil, and pour in the oat mix. Stir around to combine, and then cook very slowly for 1 - 2 minutes, until golden brown. Serve with vegetables, or plain. Note, i add a little milk powder to my food, for a lovely change.

Random Ingredients: oriental sesame oil,jalapeno pepper,sun tomato oil,phyllo pastry
title: Spicy Tomato Triangles
ingredients: 6 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 10 jelly-flavored strips of jalapeno pepper | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Heat a small skillet or wok over medium heat. Add sesame oil and sun dried tomato strips. Saute for 5 minutes or until hot and tomatoes are tender. Remove from heat and divide strips among 6 plates. Roll the phyllo to about 4 in diameter and place on 2 baking sheets, brushing each with oil. Place about 2 tbsp of the tomato mixture onto each. Brush tops of phyllo with water. Place on rack in oven.

title: Salsa Chunky Okra
ingredients: 2 packages frozen okra or ( 21 ounce ) packages zucchini | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 1/2 - 2 cups chunky salsa | 1/8 teaspoon saffron ( optional )
instructions: Place okra in a large pan with salt and water.. Cover and bring to a boil for about five minutes or until the okra just begins to soften. Drain and add salsa and saffron if using. Heat through and watch as it is quite hot.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,jalapeno pepper,cake flour,italian tomato,cottage cheese
title: Cheese Stuffed Jalapeno Bell Peppers (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 8 small jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup uncooked basmati rice | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon cake flour, dissolved in | 1/3 cup of low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Carefully remove the tops and stems of the peppers. Place them in boiling water for three minutes. Drain and cool. Cut off the remaining pepper lengthwise and remove the seeds. Fill the peppers with the rice. Blend the cottage cheese with 1 cup of the milk. Spread the mixture over the peppers and rice. Cover the top with remaining 1/3 cup of cottage cheese mixture. Cook for 30 - 40 minutes or until heated through.

title: Chocolat Chunken (Sauré Cheese Skewers)
ingredients: 12 bamboo skewers | 6 ounces dark chocolate | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cider vinegar
instructions: Soak the skewers in water for about 20 minutes before grilling. Put chocolate, garlic, and vinegar in a mini to medium bowl. Melt until smooth. Dip skewers one by one in melted chocolate then carefully thread into four skewers. Place skewers on a waxed paper lined or silicone mat, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes or so until set. This will remove some of the sticky coating off the skewers. Cook on a hot grill, turning occasionally, until the char marks have begun to show on the skewers, 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Pizza Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen prepared pizza dough | 3 pounds sirloin tip roast, cubed | 1/4 cup italian seasoning, divided | 4 cans mushroom pieces, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a pizza pan inside a large bowl or baking sheet. Stretch the dough out into an even circle. Spread the entire surface with about 1/2 tablespoon of italian seasoning. Sprinkle about 1/2 tablespoon of italian seasoning all over the dough. Layer the roast cubes, mushrooms and remaining 2 tablespoons of italian seasoning all over the italian seasoning. With your fingertips, make slits in the dough, all the way through. Brush the top with more italian seasoning. Cover the dough with a towel and let rise for about 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in the preheated oven, until dough is browned and meat is no longer pink inside. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,star anise,cinnamon bark,beet,oregano leaf,vegetable oil cooking spray,fish fillet,egg noodle
title: Beet-Noodle Brik
ingredients: 3 medium sized beet, peeled | 2 star anise | 1 cinnamon bark | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 kg fresh fish fillet, sliced into small chunks | 2 eggs ( lightly beaten ) | 600 g fresh egg noodles, cooked
instructions: For the brrik, in a large saucepan, cover the dried beans with 4 cups cold water and soak overnight. The next day, drain the beans and reserve the soaking liquid. Bring the reserved bean liquid to a boil in a saucepan or pan, add the star anise and cinnamon bark and simmer for 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the spices to a small food processor fitted with a metal blade. Add the sugar and process into a fine paste. Spray a heavy based saucepan with oil. Heat over a high heat. Add the fish and cook, stirring until just cooked through. Remove from heat and mix through the noodles. Transfer to a platter or individual serving bowls and cover. Allow to rest for 15 minutes before serving. Serve sprinkled with freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: black olive,chipotle chile,chicken broth,sirloin,italian tomato sauce
title: Easy Tasty Spicy Sicilian Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle chiles, chopped | 1 can italian tomato sauce | 1 can black olives, chopped ( with liquid ) | 1 can light chicken broth
instructions: Mix minced meatball ingredients thoroughly, breaking apart with fork or hands, until well incorporated and moist mixture comes together. Divide in half, then shape each half into a long meaty log. Slice logs crosswise on a bias or on a slanted angle. Cook meatballs on an uncovered grill over medium heat for approximately 20 to 25 minutes, turning regularly to brown evenly. When done, remove from heat and place in serving plate.

Random Ingredients: potato cheese pierogies,large shrimp,prosciutto,pea,green pepper,sirloin,chicken meat,potato starch
title: Pierogies
ingredients: 12 -14 frozen potato & cheese pierogies ( or frozen potato & cheese pierogies ) | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 cups diced fresh or thawed frozen sauteed potatoes | 1/4 cup chopped prosciutto | 1/4 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1 -2 cup small thawed frozen large shrimp | 1 1/4 teaspoons potato starch
instructions: Defrost pierogies, if using fresh, defrost under running water in a colander, if using canned, and drain. Set aside. If using frozen potato & cheese pierogies, make sure they are thawed and slightly frozen. In a large bowl mix together beef, green pepper, potatoes, prosciutto, peas, shrimp, and potato starch. Place the pierogies on a large non stick cooking spray or lightly greased skillet, and cook on each side for about 4 - 5 min, until the shrimp are pink and the pierogie is cooked through.

title: Mexican Prawns
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh medium shrimp | 1/4 cup chinese peppercorn | 2/3 cup beef bouillon granules, plus a pinch of salt | 1/3 cup tamarind pulp, well-rinsed | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Shell and devein the prawns, removing tails intact. Coarsely chop the meat and combine with the shrimp in a bowl with the peppercorns. Add the sugar and 2/3 cup of water. Stir, then cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Remove the lid and stir in the tamarind pulp and cilantro. Serve.

title: Sailor Bakes - Easy for Bon Appetisers
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups cake flour ( approx 6 cups ) | 5 tablespoons oil ( approx 1.75 to 1.5 bottles ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala ( optional, add a pinch each of salt and pepper to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar ( optional, add a little more ) | 400 g imitation crabmeat or 400 g imitation salmon, cut into bite size pieces ( you can also just substitute other flavours )
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl. Add salt, pepper and a couple of tablespoons of oil, mix well. Add remaining oil, mix. Don't make a super solid dough, just pour a small amount of oil and oil into the bowl, mix. Add the remaining ingredients. You can add just a touch or two more tumeric if you like. Using your hands, make balls from the dough, about the size of a golf ball, but not the size of a small pie piece. Flatten out a little to check doneness. If they flatten up a little too much, just roll them over to check.

title: French Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs
instructions: Combine vegetables with bouillon, and refrigerate for 2 hours or for overnight. Stir well before serving.

title: Dill-Asiago Cracker Bark
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 2 star anise | 1 lb seedless round graham cracker
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly grease a baking sheet with canola oil. Cut the asiago cheese into 1/2 inch chunks. Place roughly 8 to 12 slices of cheese around the edge of the baking sheet, forming a rough circle, about 1 inch thick. Grate the remaining 2 slices of cheese onto top of the cheese. Sprinkle the dill over all, being careful not to overgrind. Sprinkle with sesame oil and top with star anise. Put in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes until the cheese is browned and bubbly.

title: Green Chilli Sweet Potato
ingredients: 1/2 kg raw sweet potato ( red or white ) | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, chopped finely | 1 -2 green chili salsa
instructions: Remove all the eyes from the sweet potato and peel away any blemishes or skin, and cut into chunks. Place all the ingredients except the sweet potato into a pan, and bring to the boil. Cover the pan and simmer until a sweet potato is very tender. Once the sweet potato is soft, leave the lid of the pan on, so that it will remain warm for up to one hour. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

title: Creamy White Chocolate Salami
ingredients: 5 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 20 ladyfingers | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 10 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Break the cheddar cheese into smaller pieces or chunks and roll them into a ball shape. Slice the lady fingers into very thin pieces, then roll them again into an long roll, this is the longest and the easiest way to do this. Line the bottom pan with aluminium foil or wax paper, and put the balls of cheese, meat, and bread into the middle. In a blender add the soy milk with the aniseed seeds. Heat the mixture gently, then blend until smooth with a wooden spoon. Pour it over the cheese. Garnish with basil leaves. Serve warm or cold. If it dries out on top, just microwave it for 5 - 7 seconds, until it starts to bubble. Then stir it. You can also roll the mixture into balls and store it in a glass container, and freeze it.

title: Sydney Peaches
ingredients: 3 cups sliced fresh, not frozen peppered peaches | 3 ounces crunchy peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon szechwan pepper | 3/4 cup ice water | 2 -3 tablespoons ice water, for brushing
instructions: To make the peanut butter sauce, place first five ingredients in a blender, and process until smooth. Place ice water into a small saucepan and add water. Place over medium low heat, and cook briskly for 10 minutes or until thickened and smooth. Remove from heat, and add hot peanut butter sauce, stirring until blended. Cover and place in the fridge until serving. When ready to serve, take one peach, place in a shallow bowl, and brush with a little more peanut sauce. Serve at once.

title: Braised Rotini in Star Anise
ingredients: 1 lb rotini pasta ( or other long pasta in no-boil type ) | 1/4 cup star anise
instructions: Cook rotini according to package directions. In skillet, combine star anise and one cup of water. Place and bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,orange,confectioner sugar,button mushroom,hard egg,pear,pumpkin pie spice
title: Polish Christmas Egg and Pear Pie
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs | 3/4 cup chopped fresh pumpkin pie spice ( or any combination of pumpkin pie spice, nutmeg, vanilla, lemon zest, orange and celery granules ) | 1/2 cup grated orange rind | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 24 small button mushrooms | 1 jar sliced pears | 8 tablespoons confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Slice the hard boiled eggs into quarters, and put them aside in a large bowl. Peel, and chop the pumpkin pie spice in two. In a small bowl, stir together the pumpkin and orange zest and worcestershire sauce.

title: Aubergine Boats (Eggplant Boats)
ingredients: 4 large aubergines | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 3/4 - 1 cup half-and-half or 3/4-1 cup milk
instructions: Boil the aubergines in salted water till soft, about 30 minutes. Drain and cool under running water. When cool, peel and cut into halves or into large square slices. Heat the oil in a pan or cast iron frypan. Add half the aubergine slices, and brown on both sides. Remove from pan and place on absorbent paper. Spread 1/4 cup of half and half or milk or milk on the fried aubergines. Sprinkle with nutmeg and mixed spice. Serve hot or warm.

title: Hungarian Beef Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 4 tablespoons lebanese sweet paprika | 12 large button mushrooms | 1 medium eggplant, cut into 1-inch cubes | fresh cilantro leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place beef and garlic in a nonstick ovenproof container. Sprinkle generously with sweet spanish sweet spanish paprika and stir. Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes. Rotate, then roast 15 minutes longer until well browned. Increase oven temperature to 500f and bake for 5 minutes longer. Remove from oven. Stir mushrooms, eggplant, and 1 tablespoon paprika in a bowl with 2 tablespoons water, and drizzle over beef. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cilantro leaves before serving.

title: Creamy Dill Pickles
ingredients: 3 jars dill pickles, drained and coarsely chopped | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
instructions: Stir the dill pickles and soup together in a large, microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring after 3 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red chile,lavender,italian sausage,quinoa,coriander powder,cardamom,bay seasoning tm
title: Italian Seasoning Mix and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried quinoa, whole white | 1/4 cup turkish dried red chile | 1/4 cup coriander powder | 1/4 cup dry italian sausage | 1/4 cup ground cardamom | 1/2 tablespoon lavender | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning tm
instructions: Dry the quinoa with a cloth paper, if you have it, then put all the dry ingredients in the bowl of a food processor and process until fine crumbs. In a large pan heat up the spices, add the quinoa and stir with a wooden spoon to combine. Once the quinoa starts to stick on the bottom of the pan, add the sausage mix and stir. Once the sausage are all in add the water, bring to a boil, then lower heat and cook covered for approximately 15 - 20 minutes. You can either leave the water covered for the last 5 minutes or put in a closed lid for about 15 minutes to steam. Once it's done, you can eat it plain on its own or make it your way to eat it, if you prefer.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,bay leaf,yogurt,turkey breast,green chilies,potato flake,plain flour
title: Sweet Potato Turkey
ingredients: 2 turkey breasts, skin removed & fat removed | 1/3 cup plain flour | 1/3 cup yogurt, nonfat is fine | 1 tablespoon crushed potato flakes | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 bay leaf | 2 small green chilies, finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 200c. Wash & dry turkey. Place in shallow baking dish.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chili,sun tomato oil,silver tequila,chicken bouillon cube
title: Salsa Silver
ingredients: 2 cups silver tequila | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( or 1 tablespoon olive oil ) | 1 small anaheim chili, finely diced
instructions: Shake ingredients in a shaker. Strain and serve in a margarita glass with lots of cracked ice.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,romano cheese,flour,pepperoni,emmenthaler cheese,feta cheese,french bread,greek yogurt
title: Feta-And-Pepperoni Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs french bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 8 ounces pepperoni, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 cups cooked cannellini beans, drained | 1/2 cup romano cheese | 1/3 cup feta cheese | 1/3 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup shredded emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Spoon 2 1/4 cups of cooked cannellini beans over 1 slice of bread, dividing evenly among slices. Top with slices of pepperoni and 1/4 cup romano cheese, dividing evenly among slices. Top with remaining bread slices and pepperoni slices, dividing evenly among slices. Sprinkle each pizza evenly with feta cheese, then top with greek yogurt, pepperjack cheese and remaining romano and pepper. Bake at 450°f for 12 - 14 minutes or until warm. Allow to cool slightly before slicing.

title: Cauliflower and Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 2 packages fresh corn husks | 1 package cellophane noodles | 1 pound mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove leaves from the cauliflower and break off the thick ends. Scrub and remove eyes and peels, then cut the cauliflower into 1 inch pieces. Place each ingredient into a large casserole dish with enough water to cover. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Canadian Bacon With Canapes
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 ounces canadian bacon, thinly sliced ( such as hillshire farms laughing cow brand )
instructions: Remove stems from bacon when cool enough to handle. Line a sheet of foil with the paper towels and spray with cooking spray. Put sliced bacon into a medium skillet, and cook over medium heat until bacon is browned and bacon is crisp, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,beef flavor ramen noodle,chili sauce,catsup,vegetable bouillon cube
title: Quick Chicken Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast, frozen | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon cube | 1 ounce beef-flavor ramen noodles, seasoning packet included in the package | 1/2 1/2 cup catsup or 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup chili sauce
instructions: Cut frozen chicken into cubes and place in microwave safe container or other bowl with enough water to cover. Cover and place into microwave on high for 6 minutes, stirring half way through. Meanwhile, remove from microwave, drain. Reserve 1/2 cup ramen noodles. Add seasoning packet and chicken pieces to noodles and mix well, then return to microwave uncovered on high for 5 minutes, stirring once or twice. Remove from microwave and stir in other ingredients. If desired, place ramen dish atop rice. Cover and microwave on high 3 minutes, stirring twice. Serve immediately or refrigerate. Cook's note, if desired, serve mixture with other dishes.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,macaroni cheese mix,dark chocolate chip,sea salt,chinese egg noodle,pizza crust
title: Chinese Noodle Pies
ingredients: 1 package macaroni and cheese mix | 1 - 1 1/2 lb prepared pizza crust | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate chips ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chinese egg noodles | sea salt
instructions: Pour noodles into a large bowl of warm water. Set aside 1/2 of package of noodles, and then spread 1/2 of the noodles evenly across the entire bottom of a deep, large, heavy duty pan. Add 1 beef bullion cube, a few shakes of salt and some dark chocolate chips in that order. Dip the noodles in the water, and place in the pan. Repeat until all of the noodles are used. Cover and let cook for 20 minutes, then uncover and sprinkle with sea salt to taste. Let cool for at least 5 minutes before removing. Variations, instead of noodles use 1 package of plain noodles. For extra crunch, sprinkle with a little more dark chocolate chips and a sprinkle of paprika. Note, when i have the chance to serve this at my party, i make the sauce for the party and the party sticks pretty much the same way. Also, when serving the party, i place one end of a small piece of plastic wrap directly on the edge of the serving dish, and then carefully turn the entire contents around until the entire top of the wrap overlaps the entire dish. Do not turn the wrap too close to the edge of the dish, as this will make the noodles stick.

title: Spaghetti & Whiskey Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti | 1/2 lb roma lettuce | 1/2 cup whiskey, unsweetened | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/2 serrano pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook 1/2 lb spaghetti as directed on package, drain. Rinse with cold water, drain. Cut roma and romaine lettuce leaves in half lengthwise, then cut both halves crosswise into 1/2 slices. Toss with 3/4 cup whiskey, 1 t vinegar, and 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce. Garnish with serrano peppers, if desired.

Random Ingredients: ranch dip mix,salt black pepper,sultana raisin,salt pepper,red chilies,parmigiano reggiano cheese,shiitake mushroom
title: Spicy Ranch Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 3/4 cup sultana raisins, roughly chopped | 2 dried red chilies, stems removed | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, cleaned and stemmed, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices | 1 -2 tablespoon ranch dip mix | salt and pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 2 tablespoons other freshly grated cheese | 1/3 cup ranch dip mix | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Mix all together until well combined. Add more seasoning to taste. Keeps in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,cucumber,pizza crust,flax seed,paprika,calf foot cartilidge,cashew nut
title: Cheesy Roasted Hawaiian Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 1 pizza crust ( purchased purchased or home-made is okay to use ) | 1/4 cup flax seed | 1/4 cup cashew nuts | 1 bunch cauliflower of feet ( or 4-8 large tips of cauliflower ) | 3 1/4 ounces monterey jack cheese | paprika, to taste | cucumbers or tomatoes, slices to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread flaxseed evenly over the pizza crust. Sprinkle cashew nuts onto the surface of the crust. Wash and remove cauliflower from head in a colander and pat with paper towels to remove the outer skin of the cauliflower. Cut cauliflower into bite size pieces and place in a bowl and toss lightly. Squeeze excess moisture from cauliflower and add to bowl. Squeeze the excess moisture from jack cheese and cut into cubes. Sprinkle paprika and cajeta on top of cauliflower. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until crisp. Cut into 8 wedges and serve garnished with a cucumber or tomato slice if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Crust-Fry Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baking powder | 2 pounds top round steak, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Season steak with baking powder, and shake off excess. Heat oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees f. Fry steak cubes in hot oil, or, if desired, in a skillet of your choice. This goes a little faster, but the results have to be just a little softer than frying a pound of round steaks.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,beet,parmigiano reggiano cheese,dark chocolate,beef rib,enchilada sauce,parsley,pork shoulder
title: Chilean Pork Stew With Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder | 1 lb pork loin | 1 lb beef rib ( bone in ) | 1/2 lb beet ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 cups favorite enchilada sauce ( preferably chunky green enchilada ) | 1/8 cup dark chocolate ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried parsley ( optional )
instructions: Braise pork shoulder and beef ribs together in the enchilada sauce for about an hour. When finished, shred with the rotary blade of a fork. You don`t need to shred the pork if you don`t really have any forks. Set aside. Slice beef brisket into 1/2 inch rounds. Put some pork onto a plate and reserve. Slice beef brisket into about 2 inch strips. Put some more pork on top and put another plate beside it. Put the cheese and chopped parsley in a small plate. Put the meat, sliced beef and cheese on top of one of the plates. Put the other plate on top. Put the chopped chocolate in a small microwavable dish. Dip the side of the plate into the chocolate, and microwave for about 4 minutes at 50% power, then let it sit for about 10 minutes, or until it is melted, then stir it. Repeat with the rest of the ingredients. Serve with steamed white rice for dipping. Garnish with some chopped parsley, if desired.

title: Saffron (Crispy Roasted Poblano Chile Strips)
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, stemmed and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons stevia ( or other almond essence ) | 2 tablespoons saffron ( i like 1 teaspoon ) or 2 teaspoons saffron strand ( i like 1 teaspoon ) | 1/2 lb angel hair pasta, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Combine chiles, stevia, 1 tablespoons of the saffron or almond essence and 3 tablespoons of water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes or until thickened, stirring occasionally. Allow mixture to cool to room temperature. Lightly oil an 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking dish. Stir remaining 6 tablespoons saffron or almond essence into the saucepan. Drain chiles and remove stems and seeds. In another medium skillet heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Add 1/2 pound of the chile strips and saute, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes. Add 1/2 the pasta and cook, stirring, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes longer. Repeat with remaining shrimp and chiles. Spoon sauce over the top of the pasta and sprinkle with remaining saffron or almond essence.

title: Roasted Tomatoes with Almonds
ingredients: 1 plum tomato, halved lengthwise | cooking spray | 1/2 cup slivered almond
instructions: Brush cut side of tomatoes with olive oil. Place in a lightly greased large baking dish, and pour about 1/4 cup water into the dish. Bake in a 350° f oven until just tender, about 11 minutes. Sprinkle with toasted almonds to serve.

title: Colombian Avocados
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret | 1 banana, sliced | 1/8 cup chopped green olives
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook cauliflower in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain thoroughly and transfer to a bowl. Peel and chop banana. Place avocado flesh, banana and olives in a blender, and process until smooth. Serve immediately, or refrigerate, and serve within 3 days.

title: Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken legs or 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs | 3 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 1 chicken bouillon
instructions: Cut chicken into bite sized pieces, rinse thoroughly with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Put chicken in your crock pot. Sprinkle chili flakes into chicken. Pour bouillon over the chicken. Stir again. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,vegetable shortening,gin,vegetable oil cooking spray,zucchini,bean,orange juice zest
title: Fabulous Vegetarian San Francisco
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 small zucchini, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vegetable shortening ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice ( to taste ) | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 tablespoon gin
instructions: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium high heat. Add zucchini and cook for 2 minutes. Add lime peel and orange zest and continue cooking for 2 minutes. Transfer zucchini to a plate and set aside. In the same frying pan, melt the vegetable shortening. Add beans and juice to frying pan. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring often. Reduce heat to low and add zucchini in a thin layer. Cook, uncovered, for 1 hour. Drizzle each serving with fresh orange if desired.

title: Faux-Roasted Garlic Cream
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic paste, unpeeled | ice cream
instructions: Remove the tops and silverskin from the garlic paste. Place the garlic paste on a small piece of aluminum foil or parchment paper and lightly drizzle about 1/4 cup of olive oil into the center. Wrap the garlic tightly around the garlic. Place the parchment paper and foil in a baking dish and bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Carefully open the foil and spread the garlic with a sharp knife or razor. Drizzle with another 1/4 cup of olive oil. Return to the oven and continue to bake for 15 minutes, or until the garlic has softened, but not browned. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut-Sauce Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated carrots | 2 tablespoons grated fresh coconut ( approx ) | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( or tikka powder, if you prefer ) | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup thinly sliced button mushroom | 6 -12 slices good quality kaiser
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except the bread and the burger. Spray your non stick sausages with a non stick fry pan on your medium heat. Sear the sausages till they have a nice colour on both sides. The longer you wait, the thicker the flavour will be. You can also cook them over medium heat but be cautious about the amount of fat on them. Serve on a hot burger bun or i prefer my hamburger/tomato bologna style.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,sharp cheddar cheese,coconut extract,savory,turmeric powder,rhubarb,canadian bacon
title: Danish Rhubarb Salad
ingredients: 1 lb strawberry rhubarb | 1 large fresh slice canadian bacon | 1/2 lb sliced hazelnuts | 1/2 lb grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Cut the rhubarb apart into 3/4 inch slices, cut the ends off and cut the tips off. Wash well, place in a mixing bowl and cover with boiling water. Let sit for 5 minutes. Drain. Place in the blender and blend at high speed until the rhubarb is finely chopped. Mix in the bacon, nuts, cheese and spices. Stir. Enjoy.

title: Gorgonzola Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom | 1/2 lb gorgonzola
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees and line a baking sheet with tin foil. Clean and thinly slice mushrooms. Cut the rind off of the cheese. Wrap cheese in bacon rashers and secure with toothpicks. Place mushrooms on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for about 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Flour Crackers
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups self-rising flour | 1/3 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Sift together the flour and celery salt into a large mixing bowl. Stir in enough water to make a sticky consistency that leaves the sides of the bowl clean. If you've made a dough the dough is much thicker, just make sure it's smooth and workable. Lightly grease your hands. Shape the dough into a ball and wrap with dampened plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 10 hours or up to a day. Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Squeeze the dough ball between your hands to make sure it's evenly flat. Roll out on the prepared baking sheet to about 2/3 inch thick. Cut into squares using a 3 inch round cookie cutter. Place about 2 teaspoons of topping on a small biscuit's curved edge. Bake in the preheated oven 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Serve warm.

title: Honeydew melon cakes
ingredients: 2 small zucchini ( sliced ) | 3 tablespoons honeydew melon ( sliced and ground ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 cupscake
instructions: Heat oil in skillet add zucchini, honeydew and mix well. Heat thoroughly. Fry or cool mixture for approximately 5 - 10 minutes. Cut cake into slices and layer on top of melon. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Baked Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb fresh kielbasa or 1 lb frozen kielbasa, cut crosswise into 1-inch thick slices | 1/3 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce ( heinz chili ) | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | chile pepper flakes, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place kielbasa in a 9x13 inch baking dish about 1/2 inch thick. In a small bowl, combine sweet chili sauce, chili sauce, mustard, and sage.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,apple juice,hamburger,red onion,white fish fillet,buttermilk,cooking wine,red curry paste
title: Cumberland Baked Fish
ingredients: 4 red onions or 2 yellow onions, sliced | 1 kg white fish fillet | 1/2 liter buttermilk | 250 ml cooking wine | 4 tablespoons red curry paste | 500 ml apple juice | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1/2 cup cooking wine | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Mix onions, fish, buttermilk and curry paste. Cover. Place in oven at 120 c for 10 to 15 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients in a saucepan, mix well. When onions are almost ready, add fish and cover. Cook for 35 minutes or until fish is cooked.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,vegetable oil cooking spray,spring onion
title: Spicy Grilled Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 3 medium lebanese cucumbers, halved lengthways | 8 spring onions, finely chopped | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Heat the grill to high, or alternatively grill the cucumbers. Place the cucumber slices on a grill tray, and grill for 2 minutes. Turn and grill for another 2 minutes or until completely softened. Meanwhile, place the spring onions in a bowl, then add just enough vegetable oil to cover. Brush the dressing on the cucumbers, then fold in any desired garnishes.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,taco seasoning mix,cranberry,beef bouillon cube,hoisin sauce,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Cheese Beef Burgers With Cranberry Mayo
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package shredded swiss cheese | 1 can cranberries, drained | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 can hoisin sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, except the cheese, and shape into 4 patties. Grill 15 to 20 minutes per side, basting with the sauce until fully cooked. Serve on a bun with a dollop of hoisin sauce, and garnish with a slice of lettuce or cucumber.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,gorgonzola,mint leaf,cream broccoli soup,lemon zest
title: Gorgonzola and Fettuccine Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of broccoli soup | 1 bunch fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 box of crumbled gorgonzola | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the soup with the mint leaves, lemon zest, and cheese. Stir in the pinto beans. If necessary, add more cheese to moisten. Serve over cooked fettuccine.

title: Pumpkin Apple-Brandy-Sauce Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/4 cup lukewarm applesauce | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 small cup shredded pumpkin
instructions: Add all ingredients to bread machine in order. Set to medium setting and press start.

title: Chorizo With Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 6 ounces chorizo, sliced | 2 tablespoons gluten-free breadcrumbs
instructions: Put everything in to the crockpot and cook on high until the lentils have cooked through and the chorizo is cooked. Serve warm with bread to mop up the juices and a side salad.

title: Baked Broccoli With Toasted Orange & Green Cardamom
ingredients: 2 large green cardamom pods, split | 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon orange peel, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f. Place the cardamom pods in a shallow pan and toast slowly for 5 minutes, or until aromatic. Place the broccoli in a casserole dish, cover with water, heat gently, bring to the boil, and set aside to cool. Scatter over the orange peel and flor off any dark spots. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the broccoli is just tender. To serve, arrange broccoli on a serving dish and pour the broth around. Serve.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,rice vinegar,oregano leaf,banana,chicken stock beef,vanilla essence,greek yogurt
title: Yummy Banana, Pork and Chutney Rissadas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/4 cup low fat greek yogurt or 1/4 cup sour cream | 4 large free range bananas | 500 g bulk pork sausage | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup beef stock, more if you like very thin pancakes
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate. Mix all ingredients in a bowl with your fingers or the end of a wooden spoon and form a disc shape using your hands. Place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper or a silicon pad to cool. Bake 25 minutes or until cooked. Serve warm with a side of tasty cheese, fruit and salad.

Random Ingredients: nut,steak,baking powder,island dressing,monterey jack pepper cheese,sauerkraut,chinese mushroom,fennel seed
title: Kraut Surprise
ingredients: 1 lb cooked sauerkraut, drained | 1 lb steak, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 can chinese mushrooms or ( 10 ounce ) can mushrooms, drained | 1 tablespoon island dressing | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | chopped nuts, for garnish
instructions: Prepare the sauce, mix all the ingredients except for the cheese in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes and remove from the heat. Cool to room temperature. Add the cheese and nuts and stir until mixed well. Add the sauerkraut mixture. Serve on a large platter and cut it into 4 servings.

title: Baby Corn Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces dry pasta salad dressing mix | 20 ounces frozen baby corn
instructions: Cook pasta acc to package directions. Add baby corn and dressing mix, stirring to combine. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,oat,chai tea,taco seasoning,fish sauce
title: Noodle Kugel (No Mayo)
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely shredded or flaked oats | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon light fish sauce | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/4 cup chai tea, flowers ( optional )
instructions: Lightly coat pan with cooking spray. Combine oats and cream in bowl. Stir in fish sauce, taco seasoning and chai or other desired garnishes. Pour into prepared pan. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan and cut into 8 portions.

Random Ingredients: tapioca,kaffir lime leaf,grain rice,spanish onion,thyme leaf,tahini,golden syrup
title: Tropical Paella (Armenian Rice and Beef)
ingredients: 6 ounces short-grain rice, rinsed | 4 ounces spanish onions, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( or honey, if not using honey ) | 12 kaffir lime leaves, torn into very small pieces | 8 sprigs fresh thyme leaves | 10 tablespoons tapioca | 5 tablespoons tahini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In an extra large bowl, toss the rice and onion with the syrup and lime leaves and thyme. Spread half the tapioca evenly in the baking dish and place it in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the golden syrup is sizzling. Remove from oven and stir the tapioca mixture. Serve the dish hot or warm.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Butter from Joe's (Sullivan Street )
ingredients: 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1/3 cup catsup
instructions: Heat skillet at 375 degrees. Pour sun dried tomatoes into hot pan. Smooth down and roll sun dried tomatoes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,serrano pepper,caper,chicken breast half,cumin powder
title: Grilled Jamaican BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 serrano pepper ( seeded and roughly chopped )
instructions: Place chicken breasts on cutting board or countertop and pound with a meat mallet until thin and about 6 slices of chicken breast. Sprinkle with capers, dark rum and cumin powder. Grill chicken about 7 minutes per side, or until cooked through and crispy. Grill pepper about 2 minutes per side, or until just soft and hot. Serve. These breasts will feed any leftovers.

title: Taste of the Islands
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Stir to combine. Serve with toast, crackers or other breads.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,ra el hanout spice mix,pepper jack cheese,jalapeno pepper,brandy
title: Mock Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 jar diced jalapeno peppers ( optional ) | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1 package pepper jack cheese, shredded ( 2-3 cups ) | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Prepare a large rimmed baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Combine all ingredients. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Smoked Tomato and Chipotle Raita
ingredients: 10 sun-dried tomatoes | 3/4 - 1 tablespoon chopped canned chipotle chile in adobo | 1 pinch ground turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup flour ( optional )
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes on a flat surface and, using a rolling pin, roll them into a sausage shape. Roll to remove excess moisture and set aside. Place chipotles in a zip lock bag, pour in hot pepper sauce, and mix well. Sprinkle with turmeric. Remove the air bubbles and the plastic wrap and place sun dried tomatoes on the tomatos. Tightly close the bag and allow them to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes. Remove tomatoes from the bag and lightly pat off excess air. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium high heat. When hot, add the drained sun dried tomatoes and sear until lightly browned and crispy. Serve warm with a spinkly salad. Canned chipotles can be found at any mexican specialty and specialty food store or the internet is expensive and hard to get it. Check out www. Cravesandsailor. Com.

Random Ingredients: lime jell o gelatin,lebanese cucumber,mint leaf,farfalle pasta,cilantro leaf,semolina
title: Lebanese Easter Egg Salad
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta ( capellini is best ) | 1 1/4 cups lebanese cucumbers or 1 1/4 cups english cucumbers, diced | 1 cup mint leaf, finely chopped | 3/4 cup minced cilantro leaf, including top 3/4 cup | 4 ounces lime jell-o gelatin | 1 cup kahikiya semolina or 1 cup cornmeal
instructions: Boil pasta according to package directions. Drain. Cool and cut into 2 inch squares. Prepare cucumber jelly according to the package directions. Drain. Set aside. Add 1 cup mint, 3/4 cup cilantro, jello and 1 cup semolina, 1 cup celsiuselsius water and mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup pasta and mix well. Garnish with remaining mint and cilantro. Refrigerate overnight. Note, if pasta is dry like i'm always do, mix in cornmeal in a cup of cold water and stir and return to the pan to bring it to a boil while stirring constantly. Boil for 3 - 4 minutes. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: jicama,ricotta cheese,bean paste,part mozzarella cheese,granny smith apple,salt
title: Apple and Ricotta Pancake
ingredients: 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cut into 2 slices | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 5 ounces fat-free refried beans paste | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 large granny smith apple, grated, with peel left intact | 2 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Spray gratin dish with cooking oil. Arrange apple slices in dish. Spoon about 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese over apple and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Preheat broiler. Place oven rack 6 inches from heat. Sprinkle cheese over top of pancake. Broil 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown and cheese is golden.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,rotini pasta,star anise,sirloin tip roast
title: Pissalata a la Vasca (Braised Sun-Dried Tomato Beef)
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin tip roast or 3 lbs top round roast, trimmed of excess fat | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil ( oil-packed ) | 1 star anise | 3 cups dry rotini pasta or 3 cups penne, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut meat into 1/2 inch slices and arrange on a rimmed baking sheet. Pound lightly with a meat mallet or meat pounder. Sprinkle each thinly with salt, if desired. Bake uncovered for 2 to 3 hours, until meat is no longer pink and juices run clear when pierced with a knife. Meanwhile, put oven rack in middle of oven. Meanwhile, to make the sauce, combine the oil and anise in a small frying pan over moderately high heat. When just beginning to smoke, add the pasta and cook, stirring until it is hot | not quite reaching al dente, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a large serving bowl. Heat the broiler. Serve the beef with the sauce spooned over the pasta.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,baby spinach leaf,liquid smoke,cardamom pod,green chili pepper,dark brown sugar,cooking onion,potato
title: Spinach Hash
ingredients: 3 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon fine sea salt | cooking onion, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon dry green chili pepper, crushed | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 8 potatoes, scrubbed | 1 handful baby spinach leaves
instructions: Prepare hash by combining all ingredients in a heavy nonstick skillet over a medium low heat and stirring constantly until the brown sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes to 1 minute. Cool. Cut potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Line a colander with cheesecloth in a large bowl. Heat liquid smoke in skillet over medium heat until just smoking. Add potato slices, a few at a time, stirring until they color a bit, then remove from heat. Scrub spinach leaves, trim stems, and cut leaves crosswise in half crosswise.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,tamarind pulp,fajita seasoning mix,bread crumb,marjoram
title: Dynamites
ingredients: 1 bottle tamarind pulp, pulp packed | 1 1/4 cups bread crumbs | 3 tablespoons ground marjoram | 1 tablespoon ground fajita seasoning mix | 1 1/4 teaspoons superfine sugar
instructions: Drain out juice into a large pot over medium high heat. Stir pulp through tamarind pulp with a fork or spoon. Place in a heavy plastic container. Stir bread crumbs into pulp, 1 tablespoon at a time and stir in marjoram, fajita seasoning and sugar.

title: Simple Limeade
ingredients: 1/3 cup bacon grease | 1/2 lime, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Mix the bacon grease, lime juice, and sugar together in a blender and pour into a glass bowl, pressing lime wedge onto bowl to absorb juice.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,stilton cheese,celery seed,beef stock,chicken wing,brinjal,potato starch,baby spinach
title: Beef and Stilton Stir Fry
ingredients: 4 tablespoons raw potato starch, divided | 1 lb beef blade steak ( steak ) | 2 tablespoons stone ground beef stock | 8 ounces swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon brinjal, thinly sliced including seeds | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 2 cups baby spinach | 8 ounces swiss cheese, cut into small chunks
instructions: Prepare potatoes as specified in pkg. Place in a medium bowl, add 3 tablespoons of starch.

title: Spicy Kiwifruit Spread
ingredients: 2 packages smoked kielbasa, sliced in half | 1 package chopped hazelnuts | 2 packages mango chutney | 2 cups sweet cooking wine | 2 packages jalapeno peppers, diced | 3 cups mayonnaise
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine kielbasa and nuts, and puree to desired consistency. In a medium bowl, combine sweet cooking wine and jalepenos and mash to a spreadable consistency. To serve, spread this onto kielbasa mixture, top with sweet mango chutney and pour sauce over kielbasa before serving.

title: Spicy Tofu
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs, bone in | 1 can tofu, drained | 1 tablespoon ginger, fresh crushed | 1/2 red thai chile | 6 -8 ounces crumbled feta | 1 cup fresh cranberries | 1 pinch turmeric powder
instructions: Slather chicken with turmeric and place on paper towel over a dish. Rub coconut on chicken. Set aside. In same pan, heat oil with ginger and chilie, cooking for about 2 minutes. Remove ginger and chilie from pan and set aside. Grill chicken for about 5 minutes per side or until done. Cut into 8 pieces. Take off fat from the chicken. Place chicken on a platter. Put back on stove for about 2 minutes. Add about 2 tbsp of extra virgin virgin olive oil from the tofu and a pinch of turmeric and stir. Plate and enjoy. title: Olive Garden Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 box fettuccine | 3 tablespoons fresh mixed italian herbs | 1 pint cremini mushroom, sliced or 1 pint mushrooms, sliced paper thin | 1 tablespoon fennel
instructions: Cook the fettucine, italian herbs and mushrooms in a large nonstick frying pan according to instructions.. Sprinkle with fennel just before service and serve immediately.

instructions: In a jar with a lid, combine the red pepper, hot dark soy sauce and white wine vinegar. Close lid and shake vigorously. Keeps for up to 6 months and tastes strongly of chinese chili.

ingredients: 4 medium lamb chops | 1/4 teaspoon liquid seasoning ( lawry's season all ) | 5 slices serrano chilies ( thin ) | 3/4 cup arborio rice | 3 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons honey | 1/4 cup chutney ( homemade )
instructions: Rinse lamb chops under cold water, then lightly sprinkle with liquid seasoning. Place chops in a baking dish, and lightly sprinkle with the chile peels. title: Choc Chip Sage Butter for Sage Pasta and Cheese

instructions: Place half the sage leaves in a mortar over a low heat, add a tablespoonful of melted semisweet chocolate. Place your remaining sage leaves and remaining melted chocolate in an airtight container in the freezer until firm. Remove the sage from the freezer and add the remaining sage. title: Rock Lobster

instructions: In a large bowl combine the lobster, sage, chilies, mix well. Serve right away.

Brush the steaks with marinade while grilling. Brush steaks with marinade during the last few minutes of grilling if desired. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Peach Risotto
ingredients: 400 g whole canned peaches, well drained | 140 g arborio rice | 1/4 cup sesame seeds
instructions: Combine sesame seeds and rice. Add enough water to almost cover rice. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to stand for 10 minutes. title: Quick Spanish Rice!

instructions: Place all ingredients into bowl. Mix well with your hands until the mixture becomes creamy. Add more of the vanilla sugar according to taste.

instructions: In medium bowl, combine 1/2 cup evaporated milk, refried beans, cajun seasoning, chilies, and cardamom.

title: Rice & Basmati

instructions: Sauté rice and vegetable broth on low heat about 30 minutes.

instructions: Set oven to 180 degrees centigrade. Mix minced meat and dried minced meat together. Line a large baking dish with foil and spray with baking oil. instructions: Sift flour and make a well in the centre, stir in rest of the ingredients and knead until just combined. Knead a final time and shape into a ball. title: Jamaican Style Kielbasa

instructions: Slice the kielbasa into 1/2 inch thick slices, place in bottom of a dutch oven sprayed with pam. Drain salsa from jar of salsa. Pour salsa over kielbasa. Add 2 cups cold water. Stir. instructions: Place fish stock in a pot and bring to a boil then remove from heat. Add black beans, black beans chili sauce, chipotle powder, chili paste and chopped tomatoes. instructions: Thoroughly wash oranges, removing the bitter sections and any bitter or zest on the outer surface of the oranges before peeling. Place orange crescents on a parchment paper lined baking sheet, and brush tops with 2 tablespoons of light brown sugar. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Smoked Peaches in Coconut (Sangiovese De Nata)

instructions: In a small pan heat the wine and add the peas. Cook over medium heat till the peas are tender and the syrup is reduced by half, about 25 minutes. Cool, remove from heat. In a large saucepan, place the farfalle pasta, peas and coriander/parsley. Season with the horseradish and the jalapeño pepper. Drain the pasta but do not rinse it. Return it to the pot and add the sauce. Cook over low heat for 3 minutes. Serve warm, or let cool completely, cover and refrigerate for a few hours till ready to serve.

title: Wild Rice With Smoked Lettuce
ingredients: 2 cups cooked wild rice ( preferably wild rice ) | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup whipping cream ( or half & half ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dried sweet-shell molasses ( optional ) | romaine lettuce or other greens, to garnish
instructions: Combine the wild rice and molasses in a bowl. Place in a wide, shallow skillet with just enough water to cover, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer until tender, and the liquid has been absorbed, about 1 hour. Remove the lid and fluff with a fork. Cook the cream briefly in a bowl.

title: Fiesta - Mexican Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 oranges, peeled and sliced | 1 rump roast
instructions: Place a roasting pan on the burner. Add slices of orange and rump roast and any juices. Cover with water. Place in oven at 500 degrees f for 20 minutes per pound to brown the meat. The water should run clear, but the meat will still be moist. Remove from oven, cover with foil. Shred meat and serve on hamburger buns.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,taco seasoning mix,italian tomato,pork,lamb chop,vegetable oil cooking spray,mushroom soup
title: Pork, Mushroom and Beef Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 2 pork chops ( or 3 to 4-oz.  breasts ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( or equivalent amount of taco seasoning ) | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder
instructions: Coat both sides of chops with taco seasoning, then brown on both sides, in oil in skillet. Place chops in a 13x9 baking dish. Combine mushroom soup, tomtoes and cumin in medium size bowl. Pour over chops and sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Bake uncovered in a 425 degree oven for 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Apricot Cheese Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 4 ounces chipotle chiles, drained and chopped | 4 ounces apricot preserves
instructions: In blender combine all ingredients until smooth and creamy. Serve with chips that have been prepped into a glass pie plate.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,green cardamom pod,cherry,beef bouillon cube,black olive
title: Kofta Kabobs
ingredients: 1 small green cardamom pod | 1/2 cup canned black olives, sliced | 1 small whole ripe cherry, halved | 1 tablespoon plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon ice cold water
instructions: Pour boiling water over cardamom pod and let soak for 5 minutes to soften. Squeeze out excess water and discard the cardamom stem. Remove cardamom and discard. Place drained cardamom in a small bowl and set aside. Place remaining ingredients in a 1 cup measuring cup and pour over cardamom. Toss and refrigerate for 1 hour. Thread kofta on metal skewers. Grill koftas over moderate heat, turning to brown all sides, about 4 minutes, or until grill marks appear.

title: Horseradish-currant Spread
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried currants | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Place the currants in a small saucepan over medium heat and bring to a boil, then remove from the heat. Let stand until the currants are plump, 10 minutes to rid of any excess moisture. Drain and pat the currants dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, mix together the horseradish, creamed horseradish, chili powder and nutmeg until thoroughly combined, then stir in the currants. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Korean Spicy Broiled Crawfish
ingredients: 1 lb crawfish | 1 tablespoon crunchy no-salt-added ketchup | 1 yellow pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Break crawfish into large, bite sized chunks. Combine crawfish chunks with ketchup and yellow pepper. Coat in remaining ketchup and oil. Place on large, non metallic, nonstick skillet or wok, and cover. Reduce heat to medium. Cook, covered, until crawfish are bright red and meat is no longer opaque, 15 to 20 minutes. Spoon over rice if desired.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,jersey caramel,quinoa,romaine lettuce,beef stew meat,shrimp
title: Beef and Pork Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef stew meat | 1 lb shrimp, peeled deveined and chopped | 1 lb pork shoulder, minced | 1 package quinoa, cook according to package directions | 2 romaine lettuce, romaine leaves separated, washed and dried | 1 lb russian salted pork or 1 lb beef salad dressing ( see note )
instructions: Note, for flavor, use your favourite stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes and then marinate overnight in the fridge. Combine meat, shrimp, pork, and quinoa in crock pot. Cover and cook on high 2 hours, stirring once. Remove lid and cook on high 30 minutes. Stir and add romaine and cook to warm through 8 - 10 minutes. Remove from heat and serve with slaw or salad dressing.

title: Green Olive Relish (Raw Food)
ingredients: 9 ounces sliced green olives | 2 stalks celery leaves | 2 1/2 tablespoons hazelnuts, skinned ( optional ) | 1/4 cup vinegar ( preferably cider vinegar ) | cold water | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender. Blend to desired consistency in a bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Polish Ravioli W-Apple Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb cheese ravioli | 1 tablespoon apple juice ( or fresh squeezed apple juice ) | 1/2 teaspoon parsley flakes | 2 dashes chili flakes
instructions: Preparation time does not include prep time for pasta. Cook ravioli in salted boiling water till just tender. Drain. Coat frying pan with cooking spray. Slice cheese ravioli into 1/2 by 2 inch pieces. Spray with cooking spray on both sides and add. Cook over med. Low heat, stirring constantly for 3 - 5 minutes or till cheese is golden, stirring constantly. Add apples and spices and toss till mixed well. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: string bean,mexican oregano,purpose white flour,extra virgin olive oil,grenadine,chicken breast fillet,cornstarch
title: Green Bean Chicken With Chili-Oregano
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast fillets, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup frozen string bean, thawed | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup all-purpose white flour | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup grenadine | 1 1/2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon rind
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper.

title: Lebanese Fried Olives
ingredients: 12 large stuffed green olives, halved | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Skew hot lebanese saute or pan fry, then remove from pan and allow olives to rest. Heat olive oil in a skillet, add olives and red pepper flakes, then allow to warm through. Serve warm and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mexican rice mix,parsley leaf,garlic powder,hot red chili pepper,hazelnut,brussels sprout lengthwise,cinnamon,cake flour
title: Mexican Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 6 brussels sprouts, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup mexican rice mix | 1 teaspoon bread flour | 1 packet dried spanish-style onion and herb rice mix | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 5 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 hot red chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: Arrange halves of brussels sprouts, cut side up, on a baking sheet.

title: Authentic Sauteed Noodle Tacos
ingredients: 2 cups vermicelli | 6 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 6 ounces vermicelli | 3 cups chicken bouillon | 4 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 dill weed | shredded lettuce ( optional ) or shredded hot cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preparing noodles according to package directions. Reserve ½ cup liquid in a small sauce pan. Cook sofrito over medium heat. Add the vermicelli in a single layer and cook until it's crisp tender. Drain well. Remove the noodles from the pan and set aside. Preparing the stock. Dissolve the bouillon in reserved liquid. Cut the noodles into 1 - ½ inch strips and place in a large pot. Add the broth and bring to a boil. When the broth is hot and boiling remove from heat and add the oregano. Scoop out rounded tablespoon sized bits of noodles and transfer them to a large mixing bowl. Add the hot sofrito to the noodles. Use a wooden spoon to mix into the noodles very well. Adding more hot sofrito to taste. Portion the noodles into taco shells or other serving bowls. Add a couple of dill leaves for garnish if desired.

title: Ancho (Ancho Pepper Curry Powder)
ingredients: 1 cup ground ancho chile, divided | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 3 teaspoons curry powder ( to taste )
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup of the ground chiles with 1/3 cup of the oil in small bowl. Add curry powder. Stir to mix well. Store in refrigerator until ready to use. Us conversions are 1 4.
