Random Ingredients: escarole,hominy,green chili pepper,tomato basil pasta sauce
title: Pasta with Green Chile and Hominy
ingredients: 1 head escarole, chopped into small chunks | 1 can chopped green chili peppers, undrained | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with basil pasta sauce | 1 can hominy, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook until heated through.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,italian tomato,sun tomato oil,dark sesame oil,lentil,rice paper
title: Baked Kaffir Lime & Mozzarella Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 italian tomatoes, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon rice paper, rounds | 2 fresh kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons light-colored dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup dry lentils, rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Center two sun tomato slices on a baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, and then rotate. Place one kaffir lime leaf in the middle of each plate. Place 4 spring roll wrappers on top, and cover with 2 more kaffir lime leaves. Cut the last 2 limes into small pieces, and wrap around the kaffir lime leaves. Spread a thin layer of sesame oil over the wrapper. Wet fingertips have the perfect round tip or finger tips of a small knife can go all the way around the edge of the spring roll wrapper. Place rolls on a baking sheet, and brush with the remainder of the sesame oil. Bake for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and softened. Let cool for 10 minutes, and then cut into 8 slices. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Green Onion Fruity Toast
ingredients: 4 slices bread, preferably dense, but not hard | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons vegetables, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 2 green onions, minced
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place one slice of bread in a large nonstick skillet. Place oil in skillet. Turn heat so that oil is just barely smoking, and put green onions into the skillet. Cook without moving or turning the bread ever for 2 to 3 seconds. Then flip. Cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 more minutes. Flip. Add green onions and turn. Cook until they are hot throughout and just beginning to soften, another 2 to 3 minutes. Serve warm, or at room temperature. Variation, serve the fruity toast with sour cream or honey mustard.

title: Chipotle Roasted Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 2 tablespoons minced canned chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Line a 9x13 inch loaf pan with aluminum foil, and spray with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place mushrooms in a large resealable plastic bag. Drizzle with chipotle peppers, and gently shake to coat. Refrigerate, 2 hours to overnight. Cook mushrooms on a nonstick baking sheet with the rack in the middle of the oven until browned on both sides, 7 to 10 minutes. Move mushrooms to individual oven safe serving plates, and serve with chipotle chile juice on the side.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,sharp cheddar cheese,lettuce leaf,rye bread,monterey jack cheese
title: Cheesy Ginger Rye Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 slices low-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 12 slices low-fat monterey jack cheese ( about 1/4 inch thick ) | 4 lettuce leaves, or | 1 tablespoon sliced ginger paste | 4 small fresh baked rye bread, such as pepperidge farm
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Lay out 3 slices of cheddar cheese, 3 slices of monterey jack cheese, and 3 slices of fresh ginger on a work surface. Top with a lettuce leaf.

title: Saffron Beer
ingredients: 16 ounces beer, such as porter, amber or lager | 1/4 cup saffron threads ( or 1 tsp powdered saffron ) | 1/4 quart mineral water | 12 olives, halved, stoned
instructions: Strain the beer into a deep beer glass. Pour the saffron into the beer and stir in the mineral water. Garnish with the olives.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck steak,red onion,flour,dark corn syrup
title: Danish Beef Steak-and-Venison (Slow cooker)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, cut 1/4 thick | 1 medium red onion, sliced | 3/4 cup dark corn syrup | 1 teaspoon unbleached flour
instructions: In 4 1/2 to 5 qt slow cooker, combine steak, onion, corn syrup and pepper to taste. Cover and cook on high setting 6 - 8 hours, or until tender, stirring once halfway through. Remove beef and onion, reserving juices. Cover and keep warm. Turn slow cooker to high and cook 15 minutes. Spoon juice from cooker into gravy boat, or serving platter and serve with beef. Serves 8.

title: Okra Stock for 1 (Bamia Nut)
ingredients: 32 okra | 1 small white onion | 400 ml broth
instructions: Separate okra from leaves and rinse. If there is any dirt on the leaves, just wash them with damp towels. Chop fine and place in a strainer set over a bowl. Rinse okra under cold water, trying to remove as much water as possible. Finely chop onion to yield about one tablespoon and place on a hot platter. Place okra on an absorbent paper lined plate over the onion and let drain a bit. Place broth and okra in a large pot or pressure cooker. Sauté until onions become translucent or go dark brown. Do not let water get to high because okra is usually ready at around 2 minutes. Let this mixture cool down, then refrigerate overnight. Before serving, drain okra from broth. You can refrigerate for up to a week. You can freeze this if ready for later use. This stock can be made up to 3 days ahead and chilled, then frozen to use later.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,seasoning salt,fish sauce,pork shoulder,italian sausage,grain white rice,chicken bouillon,mushroom
title: P F Chang's Easy Baked Rice
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork shoulder | 1 lb italian sweet sausage | 1 pork shoulder, shoulder | 2 packages long grain white rice | 2 cans chicken bouillon | 1 can mushrooms, with liquid | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. Cut pork shoulder in half, lengthwise, then crosswise into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Slice sausage into 1/4 inch long, and sausage into 1 1/2 inch long pieces. Place all in a bowl, and toss with 1 package of rice. Season with fish sauce and seasoned salt. Place all in a large casserole casserole dish, and pour over enough water just to cover all of the ingredients. Bake, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, until rice is cooked and liquid has been absorbed. Take off heat and allow to stand covered for 15 minutes to thicken.

title: Lebanese Fettuccine Appetizers
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, heated
instructions: Soak fettuccine in water for 10 minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 5 more minutes, or until al dente.

title: Breading for Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond flour ( or paste mixed with water to make pasty ) or 1/2 cup flour ( or paste mixed with water to make pasty ) | 1 lb cheese, of choice, such as a cheddar, cheddar, whatever you have on hand | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder ( more or less to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed ( or 2-4 teaspoons cumin seeds )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix until well blended. Pour into bread machine or on your favourite bread machine. For crusts, roll mixture into long thin log. Cut into 1 slices to fit inside a large fish. Sprinkle or brush all over with oil. Store bread in the fridge until required.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,chili bean,banana,shiitake mushroom,chicken wing,buttermilk
title: Cape Wings with Mushroom White Bean Beans
ingredients: 3 cups buttermilk | 1 can red kidney beans | 1 can mushrooms, drained | 3 whole chicken wings ( i use them sliced into thirds ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh shiitake mushroom | 1 teaspoon chili bean ( optional )
instructions: Mix together buttermilk, beans, mushrooms, chicken wings, and shiitake mushrooms in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnite. Bring to a boil.

title: Beef Sirloin Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1/4 lb thinly sliced beef sirloin | 1/2 lb thinly sliced pepperoni | 1/4 lb thinly sliced romaine lettuce | 12 slices creamy-style cream cheese | 4 small pepperoni slices, to garnish | 2 teaspoons kirsch
instructions: Toast coriander in a dry skillet until fragrant and fragrant, 10 to 15 minute. Place coriander in a shallow dish. Trim fat from beef and coat with 1/2 tablespoon of coriander. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Drain beef slices on paper towels and reserve meat juices on a plate. Discard coriander. Place the drained beef in another shallow dish. Place pepperoni slices on a foil lined baking sheet. Top with lettuce and top with cream cheese, tosted with 1/4 pound coriander slices. Starting at the long side closest to you, roll up the roll. Wrap tightly in a clean kitchen towel and refrigerate until ready to use. Unwrap rolls and serve chilled.

title: Gingered Farfalle
ingredients: 1 cup farfalle pasta | 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds
instructions: Place farfalle, oats, and seeds in a bowl. Pour cooking oat mixture over the farfalle, oat mixture and mix until all ingredients are well coated. Add more water if mixture appears dry. Lightly grease a 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350°f for 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,bay seasoning,salt black pepper,swiss cheese,savory,cooking oil,vegetable oil
title: Cheese Souvlaki
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons grated swiss cheese | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 2 teaspoons old bay seasoning | 5 beef bouillon cubes, crushed ( knorr brand or knorr brand ) | salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a bowl, mix the swiss cheese, oil, grated swiss cheese, savory, old bay seasoning, salt and pepper to taste. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Place 4 quarts of water on the stove. Combine knorr and dissolved bouillon to make an ice bath. Gently heat ice bath to near boiling. Drain one cup of the cheese mixture, reserving 1 cup liquid. Serve the remaining cheese mixture on the side.

Random Ingredients: red chile,mexican cheese,salad oil,baby spinach,cottage cheese
title: Spinach Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup salad oil, or as needed | 2 cans diced red chile, drained | 1 bag baby spinach | 2 packages reduced fat cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread cheese on a 9x13 inch baking dish, and evenly spread with red chile. In a medium bowl combine spinach, cottage cheese, and chile. Pour dressing evenly over spinach mixture, and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,chicken breast,mexican oregano,bamboo shoot,orange juice
title: Bamboo Shoots and Chicken
ingredients: 12 fresh medium bamboo shoots, sliced | 2 chicken breasts | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1 container mascarpone cheese | 2 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Combine mascarpone cheese and orange juice in a medium bowl or ziploc bag, add 2 tbsp water, mix well. Cut chicken into slices about 3/4 in length, or to desired thickness, add chicken to cheese mixture and toss to coat well. Arrange on a serving platter and serve immediately with the remaining cheese mixture alongside.

title: Korean-Style Glazed Potatoes
ingredients: 25 g sesame seeds ( or browned sesame seeds ) | 2 teaspoons arrowroot ( corn starch ) | 1/2 green pepper, chopped small | 1 pinch saffron | 750 g small firm-ripe potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 425ºf/95ºc/gas put the sesame seeds in a single layer onto a lined oven tray and roast in the heated oven for 3 - 4 minutes until lightly toasted and fragrant. Spread the sesame seeds and raw sugar evenly over a baking paper lined oven tray and roast in the oven for approximately 20mins stirring 2 or 3 times, until golden brown. Drain the seeds and sugar onto a paper lined tray and set aside. Put the arrowroot in a small bowl and stir in a pinch of salt, then stir in the pepper and saffron, then leave to cool slightly. Arrange the potato on a small wire rack, drizzle with the glaze and continue arranging the potato, sprinkling with sesame seeds and sugar. Put to cool completely, then chill for about an hour before serving. Variation, make a quick and easy toffee syrup by adding 2 tbs water, 1 tbs sugar and 2tbs vanilla extract to boiling point and stirring constantly until the mixture boils and thickens.

Random Ingredients: beer,baking potato,green capsicum,green onion,yogurt,rosemary leaf,cheese tortellini
title: Tortellini With Yoghurt, Garlic, and Dill
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh cheese tortellini | 3 teaspoons fresh rosemary leaves | 1 green onion, thinly sliced | 1 green capsicum, thinly sliced | 1 pint beer | 1/2 cup low fat plain yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf, finely chopped
instructions: Cook tortellini in plenty of boiling salted water until just tender, not crunchy. Drain, rinse with cold water and set aside to cool. Drain water from pasta and mix with rosemary leaves and remaining ingredients. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,cayenne,red bean,lettuce leaf,green onion,vinegar,whipping cream
title: Guajillo Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup guajillo chilies, seeded and chopped | 1 1/4 cups whipping cream | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup green onion, thinly sliced | 8 -10 lettuce leaves, whole or 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves | 6 tablespoons red beans, drained and rinsed | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Heat whipping cream. Add vinegar and chilies. Cook until sauce is thickened. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: green olive,harissa,vanilla essence,corn tortilla,bok choy,dark chocolate,shiitake mushroom
title: Grilled Mushrooms With Chocolate Ganache
ingredients: 2 cups fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup green olives, sliced | 3/4 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 24 corn tortillas | 3 cups bok choy, shredded
instructions: Blend all marinade ingredients. Reserve. Place mushrooms in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and marinate for 20 minutes. Grill mushrooms, brushing once with reserved marinade, over hot coals for 1 minute on each side or until cooked. Let cool slightly. Place 4 tortillas on work surface. Spoon 1/4 cup ganache on 2 tortillas. Top with 1/4 cup mushroom mixture and then continue filling with remaining tortillas, pressing lightly. Cut into four servings. Garnish, with slivers of dark chocolate and shredded bok choy.

title: Sour Red Curry Sauce for Beef and Biscuits
ingredients: 600 g sirloin steak | 1 tablespoon red curry paste or 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Rinse and pat dry beef. Cut 1 - 2 inch slices crosswise into 1 cm slices. Thread into 8 pieces alternately with 1 piece of onion. Heat a little oil in a wok or heavy frying pan over high heat and add curry paste. When it sizzles, add beef, then brown beef in batches. Return all the meat to the pan and reheat over medium heat, scraping all the browned bits off the bottom of the pan. Add any leftover juices and serve with flatbreads.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,red chilies,banana,oyster sauce,vegetable oil,tomato sauce,white sugar,mace
title: Tilapia in Banana Leaves
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 cups chopped fresh tomato sauce | 1 cup mashed banana | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh red chilies | 1 tablespoon minced fresh nutmeg or mace | 8 tilapia fillets | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil until hot. Put in mashed banana, green chilies, nutmeg and mace. Fry over medium heat until the banana and tomatos are tender, 5 to 7 minutes. With a slotted spoon, remove banana leaves to a serving plate. Place the cooked bananas in a separate skillet, and add tomato sauce. Lower heat, and simmer 5 to 7 minutes. Pour sauce over the tilapia leaves in the serving plate, and garnish with green onions.

title: Scotch Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Sift together flour and dry mustard. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour mixture and mustard. Press mixture into an ungreased 10 inch tart pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Roll out into a circle, and cool on a wire rack. Cut into wedges and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: purpose white flour,chicken broth,poblano chile,white bread,italian salad dressing mix,celery rib,pie crust
title: White Pizza With Poblano Chile Chicken
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 cup all-purpose white flour | 1/4 lb unpeeled poblano chile, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-wide strips | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 loaf crusty white bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 pie crust, prebaked ( see pizza crust for 9-12 minutes )
instructions: In a bowl, combine salad dressing mix, broth, and flour.

title: Crock Pot Carrots & Dried Baby Carrots
ingredients: 24 baby carrots | 1 1/4 cups red wine | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 8 8 ladyfingers
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot and stir well. Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes. Serve with fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: chutney,corn kernel,dark brown sugar,corn tortilla chip,beef sirloin steak,dark rum,rock salt,chicken stock powder
title: Aussie Beef, Corn & Chutney Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 7 ounces dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup chicken stock powder | 1 pint chicken stock, made up | 10 ounces dark rum | 1/2 cup dark rum or 1/2 cup brandy | 12 corn tortilla chips, soaked in hot water until soft | 3/4 cup chutney, of choice ( we used an almond nougat ) | 1/4 cup thickly sliced corn kernel
instructions: Mix the beef, sugar, stock powder & stock in a casserole dish and roast in the oven at 200°c for about 1 1/2 hours, stirring regularly, or until very dark brown. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly, then add the rum & stir through. Set aside. Combine the rum and stock in a medium heatproof jug and pour over the beef/corn mixture and stir well. Spray an ovenproof dish with non stick cooking spray and spoon half the beef mixture down the centre, then top with half the chips and half the chutney. Repeat layers again using up the remainder of the beef & chutney mixture, ending with a layer of chips & chutney. Pour over the chutney & top with extra chips and chutney. Cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours, preferably overnight to really chill the dish. Cook in a pre heated oven at 200°c for 25 minutes, or until hot. Serve with a side of crusty bread & a salad.

Random Ingredients: peanut,rigatoni pasta,broth,green,feta cheese,beef chuck,beef sirloin,rye flour
title: Stifado of the Earth (Pasta With Peanuts, Beef or Venison)
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut ( dry or salted ) | 1/2 cup broth | 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, trimmed and sliced | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper | 2 1/2 cups rye flour | 1/2 lb rigatoni pasta | 3/4 lb green giant frozen mixed sprouts | 1/2 cup feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. In a medium saucepan, combine water to cover beef and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Drain beef and reserve liquid. Slice beef thinly and set aside. In a medium bowl, combine sirloin, ground black pepper and reserved beef stock. In a small saucepan, bring rye flour to boiling. Remove from heat and knead, adding additional stock little at a time if necessary, 3 minutes, until smooth. Return to heat and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Transfer to baking dish and bake 45 to 50 minutes, or until thick and bubbly. Meanwhile, in a large saute pan, heat a little more oil over medium high. Cook beef until browned, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain well and combine with noodles and beef and simmer, covered, until heated through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in green giant® frozen mixed sprouts, feta cheese and remaining broth. Serve.

Random Ingredients: superfine white sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cider,wheat flour,shallot
title: Parmigiano-Reggiano Cheese Bread
ingredients: 12 1/4 ounces bread flour ( about 6 1/4 ounces ) | 2 large shallots, white part only, finely chopped, about 2 tablespoons | 2 1/2 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, preferably fresh | 1 cup cider ( or apple juice ) or 1 cup apple juice ( or apple juice ) | 2 tablespoons superfine white sugar ( or 1 tablespoon white sugar )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Have your bread ready. In a mixing bowl, with your fingers, mix the flour and the shallots gently with a pinch of salt and pepper. Gradually add the cider, or apple juice and sugar, mixing with each addition. The mixture should be loose and dry. Add the grated cheese and mix until well incorporated. With a wooden spoon, mix in the bread flour with a few pinches of salt and pepper. Divide the dough into six pieces and form each into a small round loaf. Using the dull side of a heavy saucer, score a cross on the top of each loaf. The cross should be about 2 inches deep. Transfer the bread to a foil lined baking sheet and bake, turning once, for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned on top.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,part ricotta cheese,coffee,marshmallow,chicken breast tender,parchment paper
title: Melt Down Chicken
ingredients: 4 tablespoons brewed coffee ( i use espresso ) | 2 tablespoons shredded part-skim fat free cream cheese or 2 tablespoons full fat greek yogurt ( i like greek style ) | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallows ( not chips ) | 2 teaspoons instant chicken breast tenders, chopped ( i use 4 ) | 1/2 cup chopped broccoli floret ( i use more ) | 2 tablespoons miniature miniature marshmallows | parchment paper
instructions: Combine coffee and cream cheese in a medium, microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high, uncovered, until cheese is melted, about 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in marshmallows and chicken. Let set about 1 minute. Top with broccoli and marshmallows.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,phyllo pastry,wasabi paste,lemon juice zest,spaghetti,yellow onion,salt black pepper
title: Wasabi Pastry
ingredients: 3 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 yellow onion, thinly sliced | 2 cups whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 1/2 tablespoons wasabi paste | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Lightly oil baking sheet or line it with parchment paper. Lay out the phyllo dough, brush with some nonstick cooking oil and transfer to the baking sheet, allowing it to dry and become pliable but not dry. Place another sheet on top of the first, brush the phyllo sheet with more oil and cut into a circle about the size of the parchment paper. It will be very uneven in appearance, but is very very easy to work with. Repeat with the second sheet of sheets and the rest. Lightly spread 1/4 of the onion slices over the phyllo dough. Place the corn on top of the onions. Mix together the wasabi paste with the lemon juice and sprinkle on top of the corn. Add the parsley, season with salt and pepper. Brush the phyllo pastry with oil, and place on the pan in an overlapping fashion with the edge of the parchment paper over the phyllo, tucking the edges to seal in the filling. Cut a large slit in the top of the pastry about 1 or 2 inches in from the edge all the way around. Bake in the 400 degree oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until the pastry has absorbed the filling. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Cabbage Wrapped in Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 package cabbage | 1/4 cup chopped shallots or 1/4 cup green onion | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 lb prosciutto
instructions: In a saucepan of boiling water, blanch cabbage for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mango salsa,brussels sprout,kale,head green cabbage,lettuce leaf,broth,potato,egg wrap
title: Egg Rolls With Mango Fiesta Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups mango salsa | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock and broth or 1 1/2 cups low-sodium broth | 1/2 head green cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh broccoli sprout, coarsely chopped | 10 large leaves lettuce leaves | 2 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 egg roll wraps | 2 cups cubed cooked broccoli sprouts
instructions: In medium bowl, stir together mango salsa and chicken broth until combined. Place cabbage, broccoli sprouts and potatoes in a large bowl.

title: Lentil (or Sun Dried Tomato) Spread
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, cut into strips | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Put lentils into a large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,green olive,linguine,prawn,plain yogurt,raisin,colby cheese,parsley
title: Creamy Prawn and Colby Linguine
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 1 1/2 cups colby cheese, grated | 1/3 cup green olives, sliced ( i used greek black olives ) | 1/3 cup pine nuts ( i used walnut kernels ) | 1/3 cup raisins ( i used dried cranberries ) | 1 tablespoon chile paste with garlic ( i use garlic powder ) | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook linguine according to packet directions until tender and drain. Combine remaining ingredients, except yogurt, in a large bowl and mix well. Spoon linguine into an ovenproof dish. Cover with mixture and bake in centre of a 350 degree f until golden, about 25 minutes or until prawns are pink and cooked through, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Serve with a sprinkling of parsley.

Random Ingredients: beef stock cube,hot paprika,spanish onion,dressing,pizza sauce,lemon leaf,coconut cream
title: Roti Canapes
ingredients: 20 -60 g spicy smoked paprika, thinly sliced | 100 g onion, sliced | 100 g sweet pizza sauce | 1 beef stock cube | 80 g creamed coconut cream | 3 lemon leaves, torn - garnish | hot spanish onion, for garnish | dressing, for dressing
instructions: Pound onion, sweet sauce and spices. Place on a serving tray. Spray prawns on top followed by spicy mix. Bake in a pre heated oven at 190c for 20 minutes.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced pepperoni | 1/2 cup chopped romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup lettuce | 1/8 cup chopped cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 package vermicelli, broken up into bite-size pieces
instructions: Prepare noodles as per package directions. Arrange noodles on a platter. Sprinkle with peppers and lettuce.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,milk,rosemary,apple pie filling,cream mushroom soup
title: Mushroom Swiss Bake
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 can condensed apple pie filling | 2 cups of chopped fresh shiitake mushrooms | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly spread bottom of casserole dish. Mix together milk, cream of mushroom soup, apple pie filling, mushrooms and rosemary. Spoon over the bottom of the casserole. Make sure it is not quite all covered. Bake 30 - 35 minutes until the top is golden brown.

title: Lentil Shrimp and Banana Salad
ingredients: 2 bananas, sliced very thinly | 1 cup green lentils | 1/3 cup kalamata olives or 1/3 cup other stuffed green olive, cut into wedges | 4 shrimp, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve cold.

title: Pizzelle
ingredients: 1 cup strong brewed coffee | 6 cups self-rising flour | 3/4 cup cold cubed fully-cooked long-sliced butter and cubed shortening
instructions: Preheat the pizzelle iron according to manufacturers instructions. Mix together the coffee and warm flour in a large bowl, then stir in the butter cubes until the mixture forms a soft dough. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead briefly. Roll out dough into a 12 inch circle, and cut out 12 rounds with the cookie cutter. Place the cookies onto the cooking surfaces, and press a cube of butter onto each one. Allow the cookies to dry on the cookie iron. Pour one teaspoon of brownie topping right onto one side of each pizzelle, and spread half into a circle with the butter inside. Pick the lid of the iron, and gently push a cube of butter inside the cookies, until the cookies are well on the top. Turn the iron off, and let the cookies sit until the topping mixture sets.

title: Thai Ginger Broccoli
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw broccoli | 1 stalk celery salt | 1 teaspoon ground galangal | 2 tablespoons mexican rice
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Toss the broccoli, celery salt, galangal, and rice together in a bowl. Gently fluff the broccoli with a fork or long handled fork and add to the boiling water and boil for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the broccoli is cooked but still chewy.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,soba noodle,reynolds wrap foil,red potato,beef shank,self rising flour,fenugreek seed,poblano pepper
title: Beef Shank Turnovers #RSC
ingredients: 1 frozen beef shank | 2 red potatoes, cut into large chunks | 1 poblano pepper, deseeded and cut into thin strips | 1 bag frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 cup of precooked soba noodles ( you can use any noodle you like ) | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | reynolds wrap foil, to cover the shank | 1 cup self rising flour | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Prep and boil the shank for 5 - 10 minutes until done. Shred and set aside to cool and cool down slightly, then remove meat and bones, and allow to cool enough to do this, but make up all of the filling ingredients and put in a large bowl. Take out and dice up the potatoes, and boil them and set aside in a bowl. Rinse off the spinach and pat dry. Warm up a large skillet, and a little more than 1/4 cup of the oil. Add the fenugreek seeds, and when just starting to pop, add the spinach and pepper, and sauté until the spinach just starts to wilt. Remove the skillet from the stove. To make the fritters, in a small bowl, add the spinach mixture and the flour. Mix for about two minutes, then add in the flour mixture a little at a time, until the mixture is sticky, then add your egg if it gets dry. Stir the dough until it makes a ball, then take pieces out of the bowl, and roll them in the flour, adding more flour if needed. Dip each piece of dough in the fritter batter you had set aside earlier, then brown on each side on medium high heat and remove each piece when browned. When all are removed and lightly browned on each side, remove and place on a paper towel. Repeat, adding the oil if needed. When you are all done, place the fritters on a baking tray, then top with the mashed potatoes. I usually add 1/2 cup of mashed potatoes in, 1/2 cup of soba, and a few tablespoons of chopped fresh parsley and parsley, along with a dollop of plain yogurt, and then sprinkle with a sprinkling of your desired amount of feta. Bake in a 375°f oven for 10 - 15 minutes, covered. These freeze well, and will keep for months. Note, i always make a double batch of these, and just freeze the rest of the batch. If you double the recipe, they freeze well on my baking sheet or in a rigid freezer bag, which is good for up to 5 months.

title: Quick Cocoa-Hot Sauce II
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon cocoa ( or more, a couple of drops for a lighter-hot sauce )
instructions: Put the cocoa in a 1 cup measuring cup. Using a small, sharp knife, break up the air bubbles with your fingers. Once all the bits are broken, pour the water into the cup. Then, stir in the cocoa and stir well. Keep adding a few drops of cocoa or water just to keep the mixture frothy. Let the mixture cool somewhat before blending the hot sauce.

title: Horseradish-Oven-Baked Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb shoulder | 2 large yellow onions | 1/2 cup fresh horseradish | 1 1/2 cups salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c/375°f trim fat and sinew from leg of lamb leg and cut off root joint. Then use knife to lift away all visible bones. Use sharp knife to cut away fat that has accumulated on top of lamb leg if any, remove as much as possible from lamb leg then place leg in a small roasting tray which has been rinsed and pat dry. Using sharp knife, cut a cross in the top of lamb leg and score top of meat 1 cm deep. Place lamb on tray and spread onion slices evenly over lamb using fingers, and mix well with horseradish. Spoon salsa over lamb, then add the extra meat on top of the salsa. Place in oven for 1½ hours. Turn up oven temperature to 150°c and return lamb to oven. Continue roasting lamb for an additional 30 minutes, or until meat is cooked to your liking. Slice lamb to serve, or place on serving platter and cover lamb loosely with foil. You can serve this with your favourite green vegetable, such as fresh beans and couscous.

title: Sauerkraut Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, unsliced | 2 cups sauerkraut | 1 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: Using scissors cut a slit in each loaf. Open the loaf and use a spoon to make some horizontal cuts about 1/2 inch deep all of the way through the top. You'll find them near the bottom. On one side of the loaf, place 1/2 of the sauerkraut. Then top with a second loaf. Squeeze the limes into the cuts of the bread. Wrap each loaf in aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes at 350 degrees f. Slice and serve.

title: Spiced Asparagus
ingredients: 4 bunches asparagus spears | 1/2 cup peanuts | 1/8 teaspoon spice essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas cut tops off asparagus and reserve. Scrub the heads and remove the woody base. Place asparagus in baking pan. Add nuts and mix. Leave to soak for about an hour or more. Pour over a little sauce. Bake for 15 minutes and serve.

Random Ingredients: cento italian tomato,iceberg lettuce,basil leaf,mozzarella cheese,pearl barley,sherry,sharp cheddar cheese,margarine
title: Cheese and Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low-fat sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 cups fat-free mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 1/3 cup low sodium margarine | 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs or 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/2 cup packed sun dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into strips | 1 cup packed shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. In large bowl, toss cheeses with stewed tomatoes, margarine, breadcrumbs, basil, sun dried tomatoes, and lettuce. Cover and refrigerate 10 to 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Easy One-Skillet Broth
ingredients: 1 red onion, diced | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh celery leaves | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Stir red onion, celery, green bell pepper, and salt in a 12 inch skillet. Add vegetable broth.

Random Ingredients: chunky peanut butter,kielbasa,saffron strand,green chili pepper,beef tenderloin steak,ginger juice
title: Beef Tataki, Green Peanut
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin steaks | 3 tablespoons red chunky peanut butter | 1 small green chili pepper | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 8 saffron strands ( soaked in 1 tablespoon hot water ) | 1 medium kielbasa
instructions: Marinate meat with peanut butter, garlic, lime juice, ginger juice for at least 30 minutes. Slice kielbasa. Grill meat slices until golden brown and well done.

title: Fennel With Fenkel
ingredients: 1 fennel leaf, trimmed
instructions: Wash the fennel and dry it lightly. Separate the stem from the leaves and discard the centre part. Split the leaves in half horizontally and finely chop the stem part into small pieces. Cut them into quarters. Remove the skin of half a fennel bulb and discard the center portion. Finely slice the feathery outer stalk part and then thinly slice the fennel. Place the fennel in a medium size frying pan with a small amount of water, add a pinch of salt, and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes then remove from heat. Place a serving dish upside down on a burner in medium sized, high heat. To test whether it is cooked, insert a small piece of fennel stick into the fennel and, if the stick stays in the pan, the fennel is cooked. If it doesn't flake easily, it needs a little water. If the stick stays intact remove the pan from the heat and gently add some more water. Pour the fennel with its cooking liquid into the serving dish, pour the cooking liquid and sprinkle with salt. Garnish with fennel leaves. Eat with your favourite vegetables as a snack.

title: Spicy Rye Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 slice rye bread, toasted and buttered | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt ( plain or creamy ) | 1 tablespoon serrano pepper, minced | 1/4 - 1/2 lettuce leaf
instructions: Mix together everything except the lettuce. Cut the rye bread into bite sized pieces and top with the lettuce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pepper,parsley flake,shiitake mushroom,cocoa powder,baking powder,basil leaf,celery leaf,linguine
title: Linguine With Shiitakes, Celery, and Chocolate Filling
ingredients: 1 tablespoon celtic cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1/2 tablespoon dried basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 13 ounces shiitake mushrooms, thinly sliced | 4 stalks celery & leaves, thinly sliced | 3 sprigs fresh parsley flakes | 8 ounces fresh linguine, cooked and kept warm | fresh ground pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the cocoa powder, parsley flakes, basil, and baking powder. Set aside. In a medium saucepan of boiling water, add the mushrooms and celery. Cook 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Stir in the parsley flakes. In a large warm serving bowl, toss the noodles with a little pasta cooking water to coat. Sprinkle with freshly ground pepper.

title: Watermelon Steamed Christmas Salad from Oman
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced celery leaves ( with leaves ) | 1/4 cup chopped watermelon | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( indian brand is excellent ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 -2 tablespoon dried croutons ( optional )
instructions: First, make your steamer basket. Steam the watermelon for about 6 minutes on high or up to 10 minutes using directions for your steamer. Drain. In a small bowl, using a fork, combine the rum, garam masala and vanilla. Stir slowly so you don't break up any lumps of watermelized meat. Add a little ice cold water or water if needed to keep the mixture from sticking. Remove the watermelon and mix with the rum mixture. Garnish with croutons and serve chilled.

title: Spicy Indian "rice" Beans
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chickpeas, mashed with | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Mash chickpeas with turmeric and chilli powder. Heat on low, stirring frequently. Serve hot or warm.

title: French Trout With Basil Cream
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs fresh trout, cleaned if desired, cut in half lengthwise and washed | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup fresh basil, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh lemon peel, finely grated | 1/2 lb whipped cream garnish
instructions: Place salmon on a platter. In a bowl, combine basil, lemon peel and cream. Combine the half and half and lemon juice. Whisk this mixture into the cream mixture. Pour sauce over the fish and garnish with whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,mexican cheese,tarragon,vanilla extract,white flour,mozzarella string cheese,grape leaf,peanut oil
title: Mexican Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 jar grape leaves, drained and rinsed well | 8 large seedless european style cheese ( cut or cubes ) | 4 -6 tablespoons light sour cream, to taste | 1 -2 teaspoon real vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon mexican blend cheese ( i like a mild cheddar with a bit of a kick ) | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon white flour ( for dusting ) or 1 tablespoon cornstarch ( for dusting ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon ( optional )
instructions: Cut the end off each cheese cube. Using the dull side of a cheese knife, remove the cheese from the center to fit a small colander that's on the bottom of the cheese jar/container. Place cheese cubes inside the cheese jar and gently push the cubes until there's no more space left. If there's any excess liquid in the cheese container, drain off any excess and reserve. Combine the remaining ingredients and, working quickly, put the cheese into the refrigerator covered by a light film of water.. After 30 to 45 minutes, remove the cheese and set on a plate, covered with a paper towel. To make the glaze, using a small bowl, combine the flour and cornstarch. Mix until dissolved. Then, using a pastry brush or two forks, coat the exposed cheese with the flour mixture. Carefully dip the cheese balls into the glaze just long enough to coat them, allowing some excess to drip off. Set a small dab of the reserved cheese aside to glaze the top. To cook, line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper that's been lightly dusted with cornstarch. Preheat your oven to 425 degrees. Remove the sheet of parchment paper from the oven and place a grape leaf in the center of the sheet. Place about a teaspoon of the cheese mixture over the cheese on the top of the leaf. Drizzle with the more reserved cheese. Place in the preheated oven and bake for 5 to 6 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbling and brown. Remove from the oven and serve immediately.

title: Golden Capon
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 cups golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons capers | 2 cups crushed ice water | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Heat all the syrup ingredients. When it reaches a fast simmer, add capers and heat thoroughly for 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from heat and cool a minute or two. Add crushed ice and whisk or shake vigorously. Pour into a jar and refrigerate until completely cold. This will last up to a month. When ready to serve, pour sauce from jar into hot, sterilized glass bowls or pretty mugs. Top with caramelized cherries or strawberries. Note, the sauce doesn't have to be thickened.

title: Raw Veggie Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unblanched fresh basil leaves | 1 cup unsweetened flaked coconut | 3/4 cup white sugar | 1 cup water chestnut, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 can seitan, drained and flaked
instructions: Blend basil, coconut, sugar, water chestnuts, lemon zest in a blender until smooth, 5 to 10 seconds. Combine seitan, and basil mixture together in a saucepan over low heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low.

Random Ingredients: cellophane noodle,demi glace,leek,curry powder,chicken,spring onion,cooking oil
title: Curry Chicken With Cellophane Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/2 cup leek, shredded | 2 tablespoons green spring onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons demi-glace | 1 chicken, cut into serving portions | 3 ounces cellophane noodles
instructions: Spray a hot wok with oil. Heat until smoking and stir fry the leek and spring onion for 2 minutes. Stir in the curry, then stir fry until vegetables are crisp tender. Add the chicken and noodles and stir fry until the noodles are coated in the curry, 1 - 2 minutes. Return to the wok, add the remaining ingredients and stir fry for a further 2 minutes.

title: Spicy Tomato-Currant Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies, undrained ( use the rotel chilies if you prefer spicy! ) | 1 package dried currants | 1/4 cup seafood or 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a medium sauce pan and heat, stirring often, until the currants are wilted, about 3 to 4 minutes. I like to serve this with steamed rice.

title: Mexican Cheese Breadsticks with Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tapioca flour | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 3 tablespoons miso | 1 tablespoon unsweetened coconut oil
instructions: Stir the tapioca flour into the shredded cheese in a bowl. Stir in miso to taste. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Heat a cast iron skillet over medium heat. Stir miso mixture into skillet, and cook until the mixture is slightly darkened, about 1 minute. Roll dough into 1 inch balls, and flatten into breadsticks using a spatula. Brush each breadstick with the coconut oil. Bake in the preheated oven until the breadsticks are lightly brown, about 15 minutes.

title: Chile Yogurt Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 12 ounces spinach, thawed if frozen ( i've even made it before ) | vegetable oil ( if frozen, don't use pam ) | vanilla yogurt ( low fat or fat free ) | 6 ounces kale ( optional ) | 3 anaheim chilies
instructions: If using frozen spinach, defrost if frozen for a few minutes. Cut spinach in small 2 inch pieces, rinse and drain. Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and using two forks pull the leaves apart. Set aside. Pour about 2 tbsp. Of oil into a heavy, ovenproof casserole or baking dish, and then put in the whole spinach. Cover and cook in the oven for 3 - 5 minutes, just until it wilts a bit. Set aside. If using fresh kale, steam for 10 - 15 minutes. When spinach has cooled, peel the stems, chop into pieces about the same size as the peppers, and add to the spinach. Sprinkle the shredded kale on top, as well as a few pinches of your choice of kosher salt. If using frozen, you will need to add about 2 tbsp of olive oil to pan when you put in the spinach mixture. Stir. Let sit for a few minutes. It will thaw a bit after sitting. The longer it stays chunky and soft, the better. The idea is to remove the stems from the spinach mixture, but not actually cook it. Add the spinach mixture and mix really well, breaking it apart a bit with your hands. Put the prepared lasagna in the oven for about 5 - 10 minutes, until sauce becomes bubbly. Serve with vanilla yogurt for dipping. Enjoy.

title: Russian-American Dipping-Martini (St. Marg)
ingredients: 1 ounce orange-infused vodka, such as schlenker's | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shake vigorously. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,marsala wine,arborio rice,louisiana sauce,honey,beef shank,thyme sprig,brown basmati rice
title: Gluten-Free Beef Risotto (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 cups brown basmati rice | 1 cup cooked australian beef shank, from a frozen loin and pork loin | 12 wonton wrappers | 1/2 cup marsala wine ( or other medium-dry red wine ) | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 teaspoons louisiana hot sauce ( such as tabasco or peri peri ) | 1/2 cup arborio rice or 1/2 cup carnarola rice | fresh thyme sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice in a pot, add water to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 50 - 60 minutes, until all the liquid has been absorbed. Slice the beef thinly into 1/4 thick slices across the grain. Place the beef slices in a bowl and with your fingers roll the slices into a ball by tamping down and stretching the edges with your fingers. Set the rolled meat on a plate. Meanwhile, place the marsala wine in a small saucepan with a lid, and bring it to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer, covered, for 2 minutes. Add the honey, hot sauce and rice to the broth, whisking together to combine. Continue to simmer until the rice is tender. When the rice has finished cooking, remove from the heat and stir in the beef, mushrooms and thyme. Serve straight away, garnished with additional thyme sprigs, if desired.

title: Spanish Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 2 lbs ground pork | 2 bunches green onions, sliced | 1 1/4 cups catsup | 1/2 cup salsa ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon vinegar | 1 -2 large tomatoes, sliced | 12 slices prosciutto ( thin slices )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Do not overcook. In a skillet, cook pork and saute' green onions until pork is browned and veggies are tender. Drain fat from skillet and return to pan. Stir in catsup, salsa, tarragon and vinegar. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes until bubbly. Spread one half of each noodle with half the pork mixture. Top with one slice of tomato, overlapping in a layer of noodles. Repeat until all ingredients have been used. Layer prosciutto slices over noodles. Bake covered, @350 for 30 minutes, or until prosciutto is hot.

title: Hummus
ingredients: 2 cups dry garbanzo beans | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, or to taste | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Combine garbanzo beans, lemon juice, and slivered almonds in a saucepan.

title: Mexican Steak
ingredients: 1 whole flank steak, rinsed | 1 envelope dry taco seasoning mix | 2 ears corn, shucked
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Season the flank steak with taco seasoning. Lay the ears of corn on the grill, close the lid, and cook about 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until beef is medium done. Remove the steak from the grill, slice into strips, and slice across the grain to serve.

Random Ingredients: veal,canola oil,almond extract,strawberry,vegetable stock,monterey jack cheese
title: Puff Pastry Lasagna for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 lbs ground veal | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 cups frozen unsweetened strawberries, thinly sliced | 1 3/4 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup low-fat monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat until hot but not smoking, about 1 minute. Add the ground veal and cook until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Add the vanilla and cook 1 minute. Add the strawberries and stock. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes or just until it is thick enough to coat the back of a wooden spoon, about 5 minutes. Lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish. Spoon the meat sauce over the buttered casserole. Dot with the cheese. Bake until bubbly, about 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes then cut into 16 slices.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,salt water,chili paste,meatball,lime powder,campbell chicken soup
title: Limey's Spicy Meatball Soup Recipe
ingredients: 1 can campbell's condensed chicken soup | 0.5 can tomato juice | 1 1/4 teaspoons chili paste | 1 1/3 teaspoons lime powder | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 6 cups water
instructions: Combine soup, tomato juice, chili paste, lime powder and salt in 2 quart saucepan and bring to boil. Turn to low, cover and heat for 50 minutes. Stir, cover and heat 25 minutes more. Stir occasionally.

title: Homemade Swiss Steak (Sirloin or Round Steak)
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb chuck roast | 2 -4 tablespoons scallions, finely chopped ( including green parts ) | 1 -2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes ( if you dare )
instructions: Trim excess fat off beef roast. Trim any visible fat or undesirable external fat. Trim any visible fat off the roast. Cut roast into 1/2 inch slices. Place slices in a covered dish in a single layer, with the scallions. Sprinkle with hot pepper flakes. Cover and refrigerate 24 to 48 hours. Remove meat slices from refrigerator and arrange on a rack set over a roasting pan. If using for marinating, cover with a dish towel and weigh down with a heavy object. Let stand at room temperature for 15 - 20 minutes. Drain fat, discard fat. Dry meat well on clean paper towels. Use a heavy saucepan to saute meat over medium high heat for approximately two minutes a side, or until golden brown and slightly charred. Serve with gravy made of the same canning ingredients as described above.

title: Cucumber Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts | 4 cups beef broth | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1 cup coarsely chopped lebanese cucumber, peel left on ( optional )
instructions: Put chicken in a large pan of boiling water, add broth and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 - 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. Remove chicken and let drain. Meanwhile drain any juice from the chicken. Cut into bite size pieces and set aside. Slice cucumber into thin strips and add to chicken, cook stirring until chicken is heated through. Stir in any juices from the chicken, and serve.

title: Orange Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice, uncooked, rinsed in plenty of | 1 large vidalia onion, minced | 1 cup freshly squeezed orange juice
instructions: Place rice and onion in a medium saucepan, with enough water to just cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook covered for 20 to 30 minutes. Fluff cooked rice and season with more salt if needed.

title: Cheesy Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/2 cup water | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Mix together and put in a covered container. When cooled, put in your dehydrator for 12 hours. Take out and add 1/2 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese to top as a topping.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,shiitake mushroom,red wine vinegar,sage leaf,palm sugar
title: Shrimp in Red Vinegar for 2
ingredients: 1 lb jumbo shrimp ( peeled and deveined ) | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon palm sugar | 6 fresh sage leaves ( or 1 teaspoon dried sage ) | 1 cup shiitake mushroom, stems removed, soaked in 1 1/2 cups water until tender, chopped
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients in a gallon size sealable plastic bag.

title: Broccoli Rabe a La Berris
ingredients: 3 lbs broccoli florets, trimmed | 1/3 cup dry vermouth | 2 ounces dried dates, chopped
instructions: Place broccoli in a pot, add 2 cups water and simmer over medium heat until tender, apprx 8 minutes. Drain and discard water. Blanch the vermouth in lukewarm water for 1 minute. Immediately drain and squeeze out the water.

title: Cheese Filled Flat Rounds
ingredients: 1 round pizza crust ( preferably with a good crust ) | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 1/2 cups gruyere, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f. Cut a round from a large pizza peel and cut on the horizontal lines to make a circle about 5/8 thick and 2 long. This is the base in the gratin dish. Dust with flour. Place it on a lightly floured baking sheet and spread the grated cheese, leaving a 1/4 inch border all around. Place the circle on top of the cheese and sprinkle with the remaining breadcrumbs. Bake for about 25 minutes until pale gold and crisp. Cool slightly and remove the crust. Place on a plate and cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,water chestnut,flax seed,onion salt,white flour
title: Onion Herb Triangles
ingredients: 1 cup white flour, all purpose flour | 2 tablespoons flax seeds, flax seeds, ground | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1 whole jalapeno pepper
instructions: Whisk together flaxseed, onion salt, water chestnut and jalepeno. Add flour mixture a little bit at a time until it forms a smooth dough. Shape into a log shaped log on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,yellow zucchini,chicken breast,tomato green chilies,almond extract,caster sugar,flour,red chilies
title: Quick BBQ Chicken Salad
ingredients: 500 g chicken breasts or 500 g chicken thighs | 400 g yellow zucchini or 400 g baby zucchini | 400 g chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 cup sliced almonds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup flour | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 drop horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Make sure the chicken is tender. Cut into 1 inch chunks. Slice the vegetables, place all ingredients in a large bowl except the horseradish, almond and serve.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,vanilla extract,fruit,cayenne pepper,velveeta cheese,dark chocolate
title: Chocolate French Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces velveeta cheese ( 1 cup, room temperature ) | 1 cup greek yogurt | 3/4 cup dark chocolate, grated ( about 1 1/2 squares ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( optional ) | 10 ounces fruit, sliced very thinly | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine cheese, yogurt, chocolate, vanilla and cayenne pepper in a sauce pan. Cook over low heat until mixture is just melted. Remove from the heat, uncover and allow to cool at room temperature. Pour the cheese mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Arrange the fruit slices evenly over the cheese. Scoop the melted chocolate mixture over all and bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes, or until the edges of the cheeses are lightly browned.

title: Easy Whole Wheat Sausage Puffs
ingredients: 300 g pork sausage | 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Brown meat in pan. When almost done, add soya sauce and flour and stir until smooth and browned. Drop in water if it thickens. The more browned the sausage the merrier. If thicker it has to be too thick it will take 2 - 3 teaspoons of water and add to mixture at a time while mixing, it should take longer. Use your taste.

title: Stove Pot Pumpkin Spice
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice ( or 1 teaspoon nutmeg ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( optional )
instructions: Add all ingredients to a large skillet and heat over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to turn light brown. Move the mixture to a platter, cover with a towel, and let cool for 10 - 15 minutes, covered, stirring occasionally, before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,double cream,tart apple,rice wine,sesame oil,icing sugar
title: Mixed Herb Cake
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rice wine | 6 cups double cream | 2 tart apples | 1/3 cup sesame oil | 2 -3 tablespoons mixed italian herbs | 2 -3 tablespoons icing sugar, to dust
instructions: Cut apples into cubes place them in a pan with a little of the sesame oil and just cover with water. Bring to boil cook untill they are soft drain well and add to pan with other ingredients. Simmer gently untill mixture is thick add icing sugar to taste and mix well pour into a greased 15x10 baking tin and let cool in fridge or the fridge overnight. Serve with savoury bread and fresh fruit slices.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,beef broth,romano cheese,baking potato,kidney bean,kielbasa
title: Beef and Sausage and Potatoes in Beans
ingredients: 1/4 lb kielbasa | 1 lb romano cheese | 2 lbs roma baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 garlic clove, mashed | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: Cut up the kielbasa into 1/4 inch chunks. In a skillet cook kielbasa over medium high heat until lightly browned, remove from skillet and set aside. To same skillet add romano cheese and cook over medium heat until crispy. Put in blender container with salt and pepper and add garlic, beef broth and beans, cook until mixture reduces by half about 5 minutes. Return meat to skillet and mix well so all sides are coated and heated through serve.

title: Sesame-Ginger Sesame Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons tamari ( kikkoman ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds ( toasted )
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk all ingredients together. Transfer mixture into a cup.

title: Taco Bake
ingredients: 20 ounces refrigerated prepared taco sauce | 1 green cabbage, shredded | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl, mix taco sauce and shredded cabbage. Roll the taco mixture into a ball. Roll in graham cracker crumbs coating evenly. Place in a baking dish and bake 25 minutes.

title: Mountain Hot Grape Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs grapes, halved and seeded ( arugula ) | 1 tablespoon celery rib, finely chopped ( leaves )
instructions: Wash and drain grapes from the stems. Place in a bowl and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and leave for 1 to 2 hours. Meanwhile, combine celery leaves and remaining salt in a small bowl. Stir into soup with a large spoon, making sure it does not stick. Bring to a boil and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Pour into sterilized jars. Wipe the rims of the jars with a clean damp towel to remove air pockets. Place on cookie sheets and screw on rings. Bake in a hot oven for 15 to 20 minutes depending on how deep the grape soup has penetrated into the jar. Allow to cool before removing. Store in cool dark place for up to one year, or freeze for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,campbell,mexican chili powder,chipotle chile,puff pastry,lager beer,italian dressing
title: Mexican Beer and Chipotle Pockets #RSC
ingredients: 2 lbs puff pastry sheet | 2 cans campbell's light & cream light fiesta & light sour cream, undiluted | 1 can chipotle chiles, drained and minced | 1 cup lager beer | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup brown rice | 2 tablespoons italian dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare puff pastry sheets according to package directions. Divide and unroll puff pastry into four even pieces. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly golden and golden.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,pistachio nut,egg beater substitute,cranberry,marsala wine
title: Italian Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1/3 cup egg substitute | 1/3 cup fat free ranch dressing | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 3 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1/4 teaspoon dried pistachio nuts
instructions: Whisk until mixture is homogeneous. Add salad dressing and cranberries. Stir until coated thoroughly. Slightly coat with oil. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours before serving.

title: Pesto-Stuffed Pizza Appetizers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pesto ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line a baking sheet with plastic wrap. Lightly brush the plastic wrap lightly on the edge of a pizza crust or pizza pan with cooking oil. Spread the pesto on the bottom of the pizza crust to within 1/4 inch of the rim. Pour cream evenly over pesto. Sprinkle with pine nuts, and then the pizza crust crust edges. Sprinkle evenly with more pesto. Bake in the top third of the oven until the crust is crusty and the pesto is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: kefalotiri,phyllo pastry,black pepper,superfine sugar,plum tomato,chipotle chile adobo,hamburger,chickpea
title: Sopa De Queso, Chipotle Burger, Hamburger Phyllo  Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 cup superfine sugar | 14 ounces chickpeas, rinsed & drained | 1/2 cup chipotle chile in adobo | 6 teaspoons celtic sea salt or 6 teaspoons sea salt | 1/4 cup black pepper | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup kefalotiri
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. Combine the hamburger, sugar, chickpeas, chipotle chili. Mix well. Set aside. Sprinkle salt all over the phyllo. On one sheet of phyllo, lay the dough out and use a spatula to place another sheet on top. Spread the bottom sheets with a thin layer of cheese. Lay the phyllo dough over the top and brush it with olive or canola oil. Place the stuffed hamburger mixture in the middle of the phyllo dough and gently stretch the top dough sheet to form a log. Carefully fold the top 3 sheets over the hamburger mixture one more time, brushing them with oil. Wrap in parchment and set aside to rise for about 45 minute. Repeat steps 7 10. Slice the sandwich into 8 slices and top with the kefalotiri. Place it in an airtight container and allow to marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight. When ready to proceed, bake at 400 degrees farenheit for 40 minures or until golden brown.

title: Lamb, Naikon and Daikon Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds cooked lamb, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 pound potatoes, thinly sliced | 6 baby yukon gold potatoes, halved | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix, or as needed | 1 pound dry cod, cubed | 1/4 cup radish pickle flakes, or to taste
instructions: Place lamb into a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: basil,seasoning salt,snow pea,orecchiette,dark rum,strawberry,russet potato,red leaf lettuce
title: Terrific Stuffed Potato  (No Eggs) a la Chatea Chaud
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, unpeeled, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon dried basil ( rubbed between fingers to waken juices ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon dried orecchiette ( soaked until very cold ) | 24 fresh red leaf lettuce | 1/2 cup thawed frozen strawberries, cut in half | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 12 snow peas or 12 blueberries, to garnish
instructions: If you are using a regular white potatoes, cut out the bottoms, then dice them into chunks. Otherwise, peel the potatoes lengthwise while they are still hot from a long handled handled fork, and cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch dice. Put half of the diced potatoes and basil into a small mixing bowl, along with the seasoning salt and dried orecchiette. Stir to combine. Set aside about 1 t pasta water. Soak the lettuce leaves in 1/4 cup of warm water. Using your fingers, trim the leaves from the thick, green ends from the lettuce, then slice the lettuce into thick ribbons. Set aside a second handful, then separate the leaves from the ribbons with a long, sharp knife or lettuce. When you are ready to stuff the potatoes, fill the bowl with enough cold water to cover the bottom of the bowl by about an inch. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes, or until the water becomes cloudy. Add the russets' potatoes, a handful at a time, toss to coat them in water, and drain. Set out the remaining potatoes and sprinkle them with a little more seasoned salt and dried oreciette. Tear off a few big enough sheets of the lettuce to make the final shape of 'chunks'. To stuff the potatoes, use your fingers to remove them from the water in the bowl, keeping them upright. With damp hands, stuff a spoonful of red potato stuffing into each potato mound. Tie the stuffing around the stuffing with a toothpick to hold the potatoes closed.. Add a little more stuffing to the stuffing, if required. Set the potatoes aside with the water clinging to the toothpicks. Wash the shrimp, then put them in the bowl with the stuffing. Use a spoon to toss the shrimp into the stuffing in the bowl until the stuffing is wet and all of the water drips out of the shrimp, then remove them from the bowl with the water. Using a slotted spoon, drain the shrimp, placing them on paper towels to dry slightly. Set the stuffed potatoes on a serving platter, then sprinkle them with rum and garnish with the snow peas or blueberries. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,coconut extract,cheddar cheese,onion flake,besan flour
title: Chunky Cracker Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground lamb shoulder | 1/2 cup besan flour | 1/4 cup coconut extract ( scant ) | 1/2 cup grated grana padano ( about 3/4 cup ) or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f and spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. Combine the lamb and next 7 ingredients in a large bowl. Shape the mixture into 1/2 inch diameter balls and place on the cookie sheet. Bake, uncovered, for 30 - 40 minutes, or until golden and cooked through. Let cool. Serve warm or allow to cool completely before storing in the refrigerator, or storing tightly covered.

title: Pancakes, Portuguese Style
ingredients: 1 large egg white | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 250 g prawns, peeled and deveined ( tails left on to prevent burning ) | 250 g green prawns or 250 g yellow prawns, shelled and deveined | 200 -200 g bean beans ( any size )
instructions: Place the egg white in a bowl add enough of water. Add the orange juice, then beat till smooth and creamy. Add the prawns, prawns, and beans. Lightly coat the surface with oil and flour. Roll the mixture into small pancakes that are about 5 cm in diameter. Heat the pan until hot so they cook and are slightly brown on the bottom when finished cooking the pancake, flip over pancake and cook it on the other side for about 15 seconds or so. Remove pancake to a plate and serve. The number of pancakes required depends on the size of the prawns and beans.

title: Lamb, Rabbit and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 rabbits | 15 cherry tomatoes | 1 cup rabbit | 10 tablespoons italian-style tomato-flavored breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar | 1 teaspoon tarragon flavored vinegar
instructions: Rinse the rabbit under running water, and cut into serving pieces. Place in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until rabbit is tender, about 2 hours. Remove the rabbit from pot, cool, and remove string from the rabbit. Let stand for 15 minutes, then cut into pieces. In a medium bowl, stir together the cherry tomatoes, rabbit, and tomato basil. Stir into rabbit mixture the bread crumbs, vinegar, and tarragon.

title: Asiago Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 2 packages asiago cheese | 1 bag day old rolls | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons dry onion flakes or 2 tablespoons dried onion, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Cut asiago into long 1/4 inch dice. Crush or tear apart rolls and place in freezer to chill. Crush rolls and place in medium bowl. Add seasoning, onion flakes and lime juice. Stir until well combined. Roll into balls by pressing one end of ball into the bottom a little larger than the other. Roll up and place in a sprayed 9x13 glass dish. Let rest at least 15 minutes at room temperature. Preparation time does not include chilling time.

title: Swiss Watermelon Applesauce
ingredients: 1/2 watermelon, sliced | 1/4 red apple, sliced | 2 cups water
instructions: Combine watermelon and apple in glass casserole dish. Sprinkle with water. Cover and bake in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Bali Green Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs french style green beans
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to boil. Remove string from bean stems and peel off any tough stems. Cut beans into 1-inch strips, approximately 2 inches long and 1/4 inch wide. Add ginger and green beans to boiling water and cook approximately 8 minutes or until the stalks are just tender. Drain. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,spring onion,active yeast,carrot,pepper sauce,pistachio
title: Carrot & Pistachio Scones to Serve
ingredients: 400 g self-raising flour, sifted | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast, plus additional for sprinkling | 2 tablespoons freshly chopped pistachios | 2 teaspoons pepper sauce | 200 g grated carrots | 1 large spring onion, chopped roughly
instructions: Mix the flour, yeast and 1 tablespoon water in a large mixing bowl. Stir the remaining water, 1 tablespoon at a time, into the flour mixture until you have a dough that clears the sides of the bowl. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead, loosely incorporating any leftover flour, for about 3 - 5 minutes. Dust work surface with flour and roll the dough out into a circle of about 10cm thick. Cut into 8 wedges, then cut the rounds into quarters. Place the scones on a floured baking sheet, leaving a small gap on 2/3 of the edges. Brush with the remaining olive oil. Sprinkle with the pistachios and the pepper sauce. Top each scone with 1 teaspoon of carrot, a spoonful of the spring onion and a sprinkling of extra pistachios. Cover and leave to stand for about 30 minutes. Bake at 220°c / 400°f / gas mark 3 for 20 minutes until the topping is golden.

title: Quick and Easy Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 pinch pepper | 1 pinch of dill | 1 tablespoon taco sauce or 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 1/2 inches fresh gingerroot, grated
instructions: Dump all the seasoning mix items into a mortar or a spice grinder and grind until well mixed. If you want to use a mortar with the pestle, add this mix to your food now. Note i use a mortar and a pestle for this. Enjoy.

title: Guisado Queso Fundido
ingredients: 2 packages velveeta cheese | 3 cups gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Combine the cheese and the 3 cheese squares in a nonstick pan and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Stir well, then remove from microwave and spread with a wet paper towel. Cool slightly. Sprinkle or top your serving with the 3 grated cheese before serving. The traditional german way is in the bottom part of the roll with a piece of cheese on the outside, then a small piece of cheese. This way they simulate any quesadillas you might use out of step 4 on your plate. You might not use all of the cheese or not because the gruyere is salty, sweet, hot, even with a little sweetness.

title: Chilli Gorgonzola Spread
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce gorgonzola cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce
instructions: Place cheese in food processor and add vinegar and sweet chili sauce. Blend well until completely smooth add a pinch or two of table salt if desired. Transfer to jar, cover and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks note, prep time does not include 2 days refrigeration.

title: Cranberry Breading
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups brown sugar | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup drained cranberries
instructions: Mix sugar, bread crumbs and cranberries together. Press into a 13 x9 inch pan. Bake at 325°f for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Italian Pig-In
ingredients: 2 pounds turkey sausage | 1/4 cup capers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place turkey sausage into a large cast iron or other heavy skillet. Cook over medium heat. Cook until browned, 5 to 8 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove sausage to a paper towel lined plate to drain.

Random Ingredients: sausage,key lime juice,coconut cream,green bell pepper,vermicelli,eggplant,cherry tomato
title: Baked Asian Eggplant With Chiles and Sausage
ingredients: 8 ounces vermicelli, broken into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 large eggplant, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices | 4 eggs, beaten | 2 green bell peppers, chopped | 1 ounce smoked sausage, sliced | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup low-fat coconut cream or 1/4 cup light cream | 1 tablespoon grated fresh key lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place vermicelli in a large bowl of boiling salted water. Boil for 1 minute. Drain and transfer drained noodles to another bowl. Set aside. Coat a 9 by 9 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place eggplant cut side down in prepared baking dish. Brush with 1/2 teaspoon of water. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until tender. Turn slices a few times. Remove from oven. Turn oven off. Place eggplant in a colander. Let stand about 10 minutes. Drain. Arrange eggplant over noodles in baking dish. Brush on remaining 1/2 teaspoon of water. Top with bell pepper, sausage, and cherry tomatoes. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, or until eggplant is tender and sausage cooked through and cheese has melted. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,chicken,rigatoni pasta,chicken thigh,dark chocolate,chia seed,pinto bean
title: Pork and Dark Chocolate Ragu
ingredients: 4 large boneless chicken thighs | 8 pork loin ( i use loin trimmed with the seams. ) | 4 chicken thighs | 4 tablespoons chia seeds | 1/3 cup dark chocolate | 24 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 can whole pinto beans | 1/3 cup chia seeds
instructions: Preheat a large skillet with 2 - 3 tablespoons water over medium high heat. Season the chicken with half of the chia seeds. Cook the chicken until browned. Remove from heat and set aside. Cook the chicken until golden brown on all sides. Remove from the pan and set aside. Add the other 1 tablespoon of water to the pan and heat to a boil. In the same pan over medium heat, brown the chia seeds for 2 minutes. Drain all the fat from the pan and cook 1 minute for the chia, stirring constantly. To the pan with the chia, add the chicken and brown on all sides. Cook the pasta according to package directions. While waiting for the pasta to cook, heat the chocolate in a double boiler on the stove set to a low setting. When the chocolate is melted, add the cooked chicken and stir to coat in the melted chocolate. Serve the spaghetti and pork ragu over a mound of steamed jasmine rice and drizzle the chia and chia seeds on top.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,garam masala powder,bread dough,roasting chicken
title: Charishma's Chicken
ingredients: 4 -6 medium roasting chickens | 25 g plain flour, maida ( powdered ) | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 1 loaf bread dough
instructions: Heat a flat based bottomed frying pan on the stove. Fry the chicken until it is done. Remove from heat and drain excess oil on clean kitchen paper towels. Take a bread dough and roll out into a circle shape. Make sure to remove excess air at the edges. On a floured board, knead the same. Roll out the remaining bread dough into a circle disc shape and cut out circles, as required. Place these on a greased tray. Cover with a damp cloth and let them rest out for about 3 minutes. Heat a little oil in your frying pan. Spread a tbsp or tbsp of oil all over the chicken. Flip over once and then transfer to the pre heated fried pan. Turn to brown the other side. Remove from heat when brown. Keep aside on a clean kitchen paper towel. Repeat procedure with remaining chicken. Serve with tomato ketchup and/or rotis. Enjoy.

title: French Yogurt and Bitter
ingredients: 1 container plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon grenadine
instructions: Wisk yogurt and grenadine together in a bowl until smooth. Pour into glasses to serve.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,shiitake mushroom,red chili pepper,almond paste,lemon juice zest,irish whiskey,baby green
title: Mushrooms, Irish Whiskey Mustard-Shiitake Remedy
ingredients: 4 ounces blanched slivered almonds or 4 ounces blanched slivered almonds, cooled to room temp & patted dry | 2 1/2 lbs baby greens | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely shredded fresh lemon juice, pulp, from 2 lemons | 1 1/2 teaspoons irish whiskey | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 - 1/2 - 1 teaspoon finely minced fresh red chili pepper
instructions: Arrange greens and mushrooms on a large platter. Combine all remaining ingredients, pour over greens and mushrooms. Serve at room temp, covered, or chilled.

title: Roasted Pumpkin and Carrot Pie
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced peeled pumpkin | 8 ounces sliced carrots | 1 pinch dry mace | 2 ice cubes
instructions: Combine all ingredients tossing to coat. Toast in oven at 400f for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,gouda cheese,cream mushroom soup,tamarind juice,flat leaf italian parsley,white sugar,olive oil cooking spray,ginger
title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups shredded aged gouda cheese | 1 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup tamarind juice | 1 tablespoon freshly grated ginger ( fresh or made ) | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon fresh grated tahini ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cheese, sour cream, tamarind juice, ginger, sugar, tahini, cardamom, and oil. Stir well. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve with breadsticks.

title: Fagioli, Rigatoni & Sunflower Oil Pasta
ingredients: 7 ounces rigatoni pasta, broken into pieces | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Heat a large saucepan of water to boiling. Add the broken up rigatoni and cook for 7 mins, stirring occasionally add the oil & continue cooking until the pasta is tender but not mushy.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,peanut butter,wide egg noodle,egg bread,chinese cabbage,chinese vegetable,raisin,lemon
title: Chinese Slice
ingredients: 2 loaves egg bread, crusts trimmed, cut diagonally in half | 1/2 cup fat free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup sliced chinese vegetables | 2 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 lemon, juice of | 2 slices chinese cabbage | 1 1/2 cups wide egg noodles
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place bread on a greased large baking sheet. Toast loaves on both sides, about 10 minutes and place on grill rack.
