Bake at 400 degrees until light golden, about 8 minutes. Let cool. In a bowl, mix cottage cheese, chinese vegetables, raisins, peanut butter, lemon juice, and 1/2 cup of water until well combined. Arrange the 1 pound mixture on top of a piece of bread and top with cabbage. Cut slices into 8 squares. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: linguine,red wine,raspberry vinaigrette salad dressing,coriander,yellow squash,bulgur,cornflour,bok choy
title: Grilled Polenta and Shredded Vegetable Noodles
ingredients: 2 large squid, halved lengthways | 2 large yellow squash, halved lengthways | 1 tablespoon wholemeal cornflour | 200 g bulgur | 1/4 cup red wine | 4 cups bok choy, sliced | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons raspberry vinaigrette salad dressing
instructions: Cut polenta into 3cm cubes. Cook squid and squash in a non stick pan of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes or until slightly cooked and still bright green. Drain and cool slightly. Grill polenta and squash until charred all over. Meanwhile, make bulghul and harissa dressing by mixing water, raisins and vinaigrette in a screw top jar, sealing well. Combine bulghul and marissa dressing together, season with salt and pepper and chill. Drain polenta cubes, cool and slice. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar and serve with prepared salad.

title: Mom's Bestest and Easiest Polish Sausage Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Bake sausage in a preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until firm but not crispy. Remove from oven and add catsup to coat. Return to oven, and bake covered 8 to 10 minutes, or until sausage is no longer pink inside. Serve.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,cottage cheese,mushroom cap,red chili powder
title: Cottage Cheese Mushroom Skewers (Sinawiyo Na Garnish)
ingredients: 200 g cottage cheese ( i used sour cream ) | 3 tablespoons red chili powder | red chili powder | 200 g mushroom caps ( sambal oelek ) | bar bamboo skewers
instructions: To make the mushroom skewers, cut the mushrooms on the diagonal into 1 - 2 cm long slices. Thread each slice into a mushroom cap. To make the skewer, make sure to leave one side for the mushroom skewers, otherwise the mushrooms should be too tightly threaded. Rub the mushroom skewers lightly with red chilly powder. Sprinkle a little red chili powder over each mushroom, or sprinkle some red chili powder on top for more aroma and color. Grill skewers for 2 - 3 minutes on a hot griddle, or until they are golden in colour. Remove from heat and serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,basil pesto,king prawn,sage leaf,italian tomato,worcestershire sauce,peppercorn
title: Pork Spiced Roasted Prawns
ingredients: 3 lbs large king prawns | 1/2 cup basil pesto | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon crushed peppercorn, crushed | 1 teaspoon crushed italian tomato
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Remove heads and shells from prawns. Cook prawn heads in large pot of boiling water until shells turn pink and change color. Reserve heads. Remove heads & shells from water and place flesh in large bowl with other ingredients.

title: Tasty Szechuan Peppercackers
ingredients: 16 ounces plain fat-free greek yogurt | 1 pinch of ground cardamom | 1 pinch szechuan peppercorns | 1 tablespoon monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Combine everything but cheese in a bowl and toss thoroughly. Divide mixture evenly among 8 glasses or a 2 quart dish. Sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,ra el hanout spice mix,chicken breast half,sesame oil,chicken breast,filet mignon,date,turnip
title: Easy and Tasty Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 6 large boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 6 ounces filet mignon, sliced | 1 1/4 cups turnips, chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 12 dates, pitted | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 1/4 cups chipped turnips
instructions: Remove rind from dates and cut in a coarse dice. Remove pits from cut end of rind and then cut in half. In a bowl, toss together chicken breast halves with ra el hanout, cayenne, and sesame oil. In a large skillet, heat sesame oil. Add chicken and brown on both sides. Add peeled turnip, and coat with the same amount of oil. Place in a 350 oven until cooked through. Add date mixture and ra el hanout spice mix. Cover and bake 20 minutes. Uncover chicken and bake an additional 10 minutes. Serve with couscous or rice.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Kiwi Grill Fruit and Coconut Nuts
ingredients: 1/3 cup coconut milk | 2 inches fresh kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Blend the coconut milk, kiwi and fennel on slow fire. Serve immediately or store for up to one week in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: white bread,plain flour,feta cheese,pork,pistachio,plum tomato,teriyaki sauce
title: Barbecue Pork Sandwiches With Feta and Tomato
ingredients: 500 g ground pork | 1/4 cup finely chopped pistachios | 1/2 cup finely chopped plum tomato | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 250 g feta cheese | 1 loaf white bread | plain flour
instructions: Toast the bread, cut in half to fit the size of the crostini. Toast the bread. Mix together pork, pistachios, tomato, teriyaki, feta and flour. Using damp hands, form a meatball like roll to avoid overcrowding your crostini. Cook on greased barbecue plate for 3 - 5 mins each side until crisp and golden on all sides. Allow to rest on plate. Serve the sandwich using your favourite white bread toppings. I serve with steamed veggies and rice.

title: Baked Parsnips With Fennel (British)
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, rinsed and trimmed of any hard outer skin | 4 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 teaspoon dried fennel, crumbled ( or finely chopped fresh fennel ) | 1 loaf of rustic baguette
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the parsnips in a large pot of heavily salted boiling water for 10 minutes. Pour off some of the water and place 2 teaspoons of kosher salt in the brine. Add the fennel and drain off any excess liquid. Cut the bread in half, lengthwise, making sure to capture the bread and stuffing. Place the slices on a baking sheet with sides. Using your fingers, crush the salt into the water and fennel in the saucepan with 1 teaspoon of kosher salt and the bread halves. Remove the parsnips with a skimmer or slotted spoon. Cut the parsnips into wedges, about 1/2 inch wide and 2 inches tall. Transfer the parsnips to an ovenproof skillet and bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Watch them carefully, as the breads can burn quite quickly, so watch closely. Drain the parsnips on your paper towels and serve warm. If desired, serve the bread slices with additional parsnips for a pretty filling appetiser.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,sun tomato oil,picante sauce,dark chocolate,prosciutto,brandy,cajun seasoning
title: Ants Climbing Trees or Trees
ingredients: 1 bunch lettuce leaf | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 4 tablespoons low-fat prosciutto, finely diced | 1 tablespoon dark semisweet chocolate, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon cognac
instructions: Lay a couple of lettuce leaves at a time in a single layer on baking sheets covered with plastic wrap. Using vegetable oil or a combination of oils, lightly mist both sides of lettuce with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine sun dried tomatoes, picante sauce and prosciutto in a bowl. Spread half the prosciutto mixture over the lettuce leaves. Place remaining leaves in a decorative pattern on top and brush with cooking spray. Bake in middle of oven until golden and crispy and crisp, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven and drizzle with chocolate. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning. Place on plates and top with remaining prosciutto.

title: Capelles De Carottes (Curried Carrots)
ingredients: 2/3 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup sliced baby carrots | 1/2 teaspoon dried fennel bulbs, minced or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon grated low-fat queso fresco | 1/8 teaspoon ground vanilla
instructions: Bring broth to a boil. Add carrots and stir over high heat until just tender, 2 minutes, about 1 minute. Remove and add fennel bulb, then sprinkle with queso fresco, stirring until cheese has melted. Stir in vanilla. Serve immediately.

title: Bbq Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces barbecue sauce, commercial ( i use my kraft healthy choice brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract ( optional )
instructions: Mix sauce, lemon extract and barbecue sauce together until well combined.

Random Ingredients: chinese rice wine,white mushroom,espresso coffee,garlic powder,onion
title: Quick and Easy Chinese Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb white mushrooms | 1/2 cup thinly sliced onion | 1/4 cup hot strong coffee | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso coffee | 1 dash garlic powder
instructions: Clean the mushrooms and slice them in half. Place them in a bowl with the sliced onions and coffee. Mix them around in the bowl to coat them with the coffee. Let them marinate at least 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Mix the espresso and garlic powder and heat up another pan with some cooking oil if cooking in a regular pan. Add the mushrooms and marinade and cook about 4 - 5 minutes until the mushrooms are lightly golden brown.

title: Guacamole Salad with Pistachios and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 1 cup honey | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 5 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 32 cherry tomatoes | 3 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Place hazelnuts on a baking sheet, and bake in a 375°f oven, stirring every 10 minutes to ensure the nuts are evenly toasted and fragrant. Set the nuts aside to cool. In a small saucepan, combine the honey, palm sugar, oyster sauce and oregano. Heat until the sugar is mostly dissolved, then add the honey mixture.

title: Quick Orange Noodle and Navy Bean Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles ( preferably watten's rice noodles ) | 1 orange ( zested ) | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place noodles in a large saucepan of boiling water and cook until tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally. Drain. Meanwhile, place orange zest into a small bowl. Juice orange and set aside. Drain navy beans and add to orange zest. Cover with boiling water and cook for 3 minutes. Drain noodles in a colander and toss with dressing. Sprinkle with orange zest and serve.

title: Fried Rice & Watermelon
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 3 cups watermelon, cubed | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 tablespoon green chili, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or a good red hot pepper ) | 1/4 cup instant coffee | 1 teaspoon chili, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Add watermelon, onion and green chilies to a microwaveable bowl. Heat, uncovered, on full power until watermelon is soft and onion is slightly browned in color. Stir in tobasco sauce and coffee. Heat through. Remove from microwave and fold in rice.

title: Macadamia Cream Casserole
ingredients: 1 package dry cornbread mix | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/3 cup butter, melted | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2/3 cup chopped macadamia nuts | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart casserole dish. In a large bowl, combine cornbread mix, half & half cream, melted butter and enchilada sauce and stir well. Stir in macadamia nuts, cinnamon and mix well. Spoon into prepared casserole dish and sprinkle top with remaining topping. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime,superfine sugar,cream cheese,hot italian sausage,horseradish,chicken bouillon granule
title: Sausage in Creamy Lime Sauce!
ingredients: 12 ounces cream cheese, cut into 1/2 by 1/4 inch chunks | 1 bunch fresh horseradish, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 lime, juiced zested finely | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed, rinsed well
instructions: In a large bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth until creamy, about 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. Place horseradish in a food processor and pulse until fine, about 30 seconds or until minced. Add to cream cheese. Add instant chicken bouillon and zest and blend until mixture is smooth. Stir into cream cheese mixture. Season with sugar. Cover and chill 1 hour, or up to 4 hours. Cook sausage and set aside. Drain well, discard any excess fat, and slice into 1/2 by 1/2 inch pieces. Discard casings. Cover and chill until ready to serve..

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,garlic,ginger root,asiago cheese,vegetable stock cube,fenugreek,molasses
title: Lazy Roast Chicken
ingredients: 5 pounds roasting chickens, cut into parts | 1 tablespoon minced garlic, or | 1 tablespoon minced ginger root | 1 tablespoon vegetable stock cubes | 1 tablespoon ground fenugreek | 1/2 cup molasses | 2 ounces shredded asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place chicken in a saucepan, pour in enough water to fill the pan, and bring to a boil. When it reaches the consistency of a thick gravy, remove chicken from the saucepan and set aside. Cover the saucepan, remove all crusty fat from the oil. Heat oil in separate pan until smoking and add garlic and ginger. Cook until aromatic and aromatic. Put chicken in oven, and bake at 425 degrees f for 20 minutes. Remove chicken from oven and pour molasses evenly over the chicken. Sprinkle cheese over the top, and return to oven 5 minutes, or until cheese has melted and the chicken has browned. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,mint sprig,camembert cheese,horseradish,lemon juice
title: Horseradish-Shripped Camembert
ingredients: 3 tablespoons creamed horseradish | 1 tablespoon grated pecorino or 1 tablespoon romano cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/3 - 1/2 cup unsalted butter, plus more as needed ( for frying ) | 2 camembert cheese | fresh mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl whisk together the creamed horseradish, cheese, lemon juice and butter to blend. Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,chicken meat,white pepper,clear honey,allspice,ranch dressing mix,marjoram,italian parsley
title: Roast Chicken and Corn Chips (Paleo Style)
ingredients: 1 kg chicken meat | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 50/75 g chicken stock ( or 2 tsp. if not using stock that contains cornflour ) | 2 teaspoons italian parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon allspice ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 packet ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c. Using a sharp knife, score the chicken into a diagonal about 1/4 to 1/2cm thick. Place chicken, honey, stock, parsley and allspice in a large roasting tin. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and bake for up to 2 1/2 hours, basting regularly. Remove from oven and cool slightly, then transfer to a large bowl. Add dressing mix to the roasting tin until coated. Dissolve cornflour in a little warm water. Add into chicken mixture and gently stirring to combine. Arrange the chicken on a baking tray and bake in the 220c oven for 25 minutes. Turn chicken in the 180c oven, continue to cook for a further 30 to 35 minutes or until golden and cooked. Remove from the oven and turn onto a warmed serving plate.

Random Ingredients: vodka,picante sauce,virgin olive oil,yellow bell pepper,apricot preserve,cardamom pod,chicken thigh,tomato juice
title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 bottle picante sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice ( not drained ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 jar roasted yellow bell peppers ( drained ) | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed cardamom pods
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. In a skillet saute in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes. In a bowl, toss chicken with picante sauce, tomatoes, and preserves.

title: Dairy Free Mock Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 cup soymilk | 250 g low-fat vegan picklings ( pickled )
instructions: Squash all ingredients together with a pestle and mortar. Use the back of a spoon or a large spoon to beat it so it will dissolve. Refrigerate for 1 hour to allow flavours to develop.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,udon noodle,french bread,italian sausage,lime wedge,margarine
title: Sausage with Noodles
ingredients: 8 italian sausages | 1/4 cup margarine | 4 slices french bread ( or other crusty bread ) | 1/2 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 2 -8 fresh lime wedges | 1/4 - 1/2 cup margarine ( or butter if it doesn't melt ) | 1 1/2 cups udon noodles ( or noodles of your choice ) or 1 1/2 cups spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook sausage for 10 - 18 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness. Drain the sausage in a colander, draining as much oil as possible. Cut the sausages into 1/3rds. Heat 1/4 cup of margarine and the bread slices in a large skillet over medium heat until it is golden brown and crumbs turn golden. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Toast the sesame seeds in the skillet, shaking the pan frequently. Remove and set aside. Cut or shred the sausage, if desired. Heat 1/4 cup margarine in skillet again. Brown the crumbs in the butter, turning as needed. Return sausage and crumb mixture to pan. Sprinkle bread with toasted sesame seeds, sesame seeds, and lime wedges. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,triple sec,vanilla pudding mix,panko breadcrumb,ranch salad dressing,penne pasta,kielbasa
title: Kielbasa Parmesan With Spiced Corn and Jellied Cream
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 package refrigerated fat-free ranch salad dressing | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 cup triple sec or 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook kielbasa in nonstick skillet over medium high heat until brown, about 4 minutes. Drain. Remove from skillet. Toss with pudding mix. Stir in panko crumbs. Transfer to platter. Arrange corn over kielbasa on top. Spoon remaining pudding mix over corn and sprinkle with triple sec or Grandmarnier. Serve with hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,beef tenderloin,cola beverage,coriander,green chili,linguine,oat,potato traditional
title: Linguine With Corn Beef Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 can c & cola beans in tomato sauce | 1 can pinto beans, drained, rinsed | 1/2 cup cola beverage | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 12 ounces oat, chopped | 1 bunch fresh coriander, chopped
instructions: Cook potato 8 minutes. Drain. Return to pot, mashing lightly. Set aside. Add beef to hash pot. Toss to coat, salt to taste. Set aside. Heat beans and cola. Bring to boil over med/med low heat. Reduce heat to simmer, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. While beans & cola are simmering, mix mashed potato and beef in large bowl. Spread mixture evenly over hash potatoes. Sprinkle generously with coriander and cover. Set aside. Place chopped coriander over top. Heat in under 375 degrees for about 15 - 15 minutes until golden brown and coriander is tender.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,jasmine rice,green chilies,oregano leaf,harissa,curry powder,rotini pasta,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Curried Rice With Chilies and Ricotta Cheese (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 1 3/4 cups whole milk ricotta cheese, undiluted | 2 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, minced or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 -2 teaspoon harissa | 2 tablespoons minced canned green chilies | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon whole milk or 1 -1 1/2 tablespoon cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chilies and cream in rice cooker. Close lid and reset to high. When ready, turn rice cooker on. When cooker stops steaming, fluff rice and serve.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup fresh sliced peaches ( or 1-3/4 cups frozen ones ) | 1 new mexico chile, seeded and sliced into 1/4-inch-thick rounds
instructions: In 5 straight stemmed glasses, arrange one slice of each kind of peaches, 1/4 cup of salsa verde and 3/4 cup of sliced chilies into each. Top with the remaining 1/4 cup of salsa verde and add a spoonful of water.

title: Madeira Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup madeira wine | 3 sprigs rosemary, leaves left whole | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary, leaves left whole | 12 shallots, peeled | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup pepitas, finely chopped
instructions: Stir the madeira and rosemary sprigs together in a large glass or porcelain bowl. Place the shallots in the bowl and add ginger garlic paste. Stir in sugar. Place the bowl over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,beef stew meat,great northern bean,kirsch,halloumi cheese
title: Halloumi Baked Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs trimmed fresh beef stew meat | 1 lb frozen chopped broccoli cuts | 1 box halloumi cheese | 1 bottle kirsch | 1 can great northern beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans and green beans in tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place steak in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and let simmer for about 1 1/2 hours, skimming off any scalded juices that rise to the surface, covered. While steak is cooking, cook the broccoli and cut it into bite size pieces. Reserve 1 cup of the cooking water and slice the remaining steak into ¾ inch thick round pieces. Place the steak and broccoli in a greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Cut the halloumi cheese into ¼ inch strips and place them in a small strainer or collander over a bowl. When steak has cooked 1/4 of the way, drain the broth from the steak and pour it into a small saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer gently until the cheese is melted and is beginning to coat the back of a spoon, about 5 mintues. Stir in the kirsch and remove from heat. Remove steaks and broccoli from the oven and add them to the cheese sauce. Serve on a bed of shredded lettuce and top with the halloumi with the remaining cheese sauce.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,strawberry,salt pepper,white vinegar,baking soda,kielbasa,live lobster
title: Lobster Jaffle
ingredients: 2 cooked live lobsters | 2 cups chopped fresh strawberries | 1 can condensed 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 2 teaspoons baking soda | salt and pepper | 2 cups crushed kielbasa
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1st ten ingredients, blending thoroughly. Dip the kielbasa into the soup mixture and coat each side of the bread on both sides. Set the bread slices on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Broil 3 - 4 inches from the heat 6 - 8 minutes, until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Thai Pesto and Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups pecans | 6 jalapenos | 1/4 teaspoon ginger | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed | 1 packet vegetable seasoning
instructions: Chop peppers, put in blender or food processor. Add remaining ingredients, blending until very smooth.

title: Italian Bread Soup
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock or 6 cups vegetable stock | 1 loaf white bread, crusts trimmed | 4 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped
instructions: In a large dutch oven bring the stock to a boil. Add the bread crumbs and then the oregano. Reduce this to a simmer for 5 minutes stirring constantly to form a creamy soup. Pour back onto the pan and simmer soup for 1 minutes for the crusts to absorb the liquid. The soup can be served piping hot or cold as a cold loaf soup. I have found that adding a pinch of oregano in the soup when the bread is soft goes crispy.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,pork,bacon,heavy whipping cream,chat masala
title: A-Plus Breakfast #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 3 tablespoons bacon, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chat masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Saute the pork and bacon until the pork is cooked completely and the bacon is browned.

Random Ingredients: mango,saffron thread,lime zest,purpose white flour,white flour,cream chicken soup,cantaloupe,ramen noodle
title: Quick and Easy Fruit Saffron Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb small mango, peeled and cubed | 1 cup chopped cantaloupe or 1 cup papaya | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated lime zest | 10 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 8 ounces instant ramen noodles, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose white flour | 1 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 2 tablespoons all-purpose white flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. On a greased baking sheet, combine 1 - ½ cups flour, saffron & remaining ½ cup flour. Mix together with hands, adding flour as needed, kneading dough until smooth. Roll out dough to ¾ inch. Cut out 24 circles, rerolling dough to 1/4 inch thickness using a 4 inch round cookie cutter. Repeat on ungreased cookie sheet with second cookie sheet & re rolling dough. Cut out another 12 circles, rerolling dough.. Place 1 - ½ cups of each ingredients in a large casserole dish or casserole dish. Bake for 20 minutes at 350 or until bubbly. Serve over egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: paprika,purpose flour,oregano leaf,lemon zest,balsamic vinegar,baby arugula,turkey breast
title: Lemon and Turkey Breast Wrapped in Fresh Arugula
ingredients: 2 tablespoons paprika | 3 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh lemon zest | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1 1/3 kg turkey breast, in one piece, skinned and cut into strips | baby arugula
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Combine paprika, oregano, lemon zest, vinegar and flour in a shallow dish, adding about 3/4s liquid. Place turkey in dish and coat each piece of meat with the marinade. Leave to marinate at least 1 hour. Transfer to a baking tray and cover loosely with foil. Bake for about 30 minutes, basting occasionally. Remove from oven and tent loosely with foil. Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add the remaining liquid and bring to the boil. Add chicken and reduce heat. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes, basting occasionally. Uncover and cook for 5 minutes. Divide the arugula between 4 small serving dishes and top with turkey, spooning some sauce over each.

title: Swiss Cheese Straws
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces cream style vegetable soup or 12 fluid ounces spinach and strawberry salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon tarte cherries or 1/2 teaspoon peach schnapps | 8 slices swiss cheese ( any kind ) | chopped fresh green chile
instructions: In a 1 1/2 quart glass measuring cup, mix the soup or strawberry salad dressing with the cherries, cherries and chile. Using a spatula, coat each of the slices of swiss cheese with the sour cream soup mixture. Heat until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Toasted Green Chiles
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, seeded | 1/2 cup shredded skirt steak steak topping
instructions: Roast the poblano chile on a dry nonstick skillet, turning once, until charred, about 20 minutes, turning to blacken all sides. Transfer the chile to a bowl and allow to cool to just below room temperature. When cool enough to handle, remove the center stem and seeds.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,lemon,mango chutney,tarragon vinegar,pork,spring onion,artichoke heart
title: Chilled Pork Pork Salad With Hot Dressing
ingredients: 500 g lean pork, cooked and sliced into about 14 equal strips | 1 jar artichoke hearts, drained and sliced into about 8 pieces each | 1 -2 tablespoon tarragon vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon or 1 -2 tablespoon lime juice | 2 tablespoons mango chutney, chutney blend | 4 spring onions, chopped | 1 -2 chili flakes, to taste
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients of the dressing together in a large bowl. Stir in the sliced pork. Taste and serve at room temperature.

title: Chinese Roasted Sage
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh savoy root, peeled ( or a few tsp. frozen, if using savoy root ) | 4 dried red chilies ( optional, i remove and don't add them ) | 4 black peppercorns
instructions: Scrub the root well, or trim it by running under water. Place the roots, chilies, and peppercorns in the bowl of a food processor and pulse, using the steel blade you just made, until coarsely chopped and the mixture becomes a fine powder. It should only be a little spicier than a matchstick paste. Store in the refrigerator for up to a month. Enjoy.

title: Fruit & Cheese Roulades
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, rinsed and well drained ( i use a combination of quinoa and rice ) | 1/2 cup passion fruit juice | 1/2 cup reduced-fat graham cracker crumbs | 2 ounces reduced fat parmesan cheese, grated ( or other favorite cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Lightly grease a 12 hole/greased 18cm square oven proof dish, or a 12 hole/greased 2 x 3/4 deep dish loaf pan. Combine quinoa and passionfruit juice in a small bowl. Spoon the quinoa mixture into the prepared dish. Top with the graham cracker crumbs and cheese. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes or until crust is lightly browned & cheese is golden.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,cornflour,lemon,rotini pasta,grain white rice
title: Sausage and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage, crumbled | 1 can light sweet cornflour, blended with 3 tbsp milk | 1/2 cup uncooked long grain white rice or 1/2 cup uncooked wild rice, rinsed well and drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon rind, finely grated | 2 -3 cups hot cooked rotini pasta ( or your prefried hot pasta )
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Combine cornflour with milk, stirring until lumps are gone. Add rice, mix and then add sausage and lemon rind. Pre heat oven to 375 degrees. Pour mixture into casserole pan and bake for 45 minutes covered with foil. Uncover, bake an additional 10 minutes,. Serve from the casserole pan while hot.

title: Dairy-Free Beetroot Shrimp Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon beetroot, shredded | 150 g skinless shrimp, cleaned, deveined and finely chopped | 1 cup coriander & light blend dark coconut | 1 1/2 tablespoons chickwheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 3 iceberg lettuce | 3/4 cup shaved coconut
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and chill for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Cajun Shrimp & Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb medium shrimp ( peeled, deveined, and butterflied ) | pasta, cooked ( recommended, dreamfields recommended ) | 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup dijon mustard ( recommended, hellman recommended ) | 2 ounces fresh green chilies or 2 ounces jalapenos, diced ( recommended, serrano recommended ) | 6 slices toasted bread | ice water
instructions: Sauté shrimp in very hot butter until pink, then add dijon mustard and sauté 2 minutes. Set shrimp mixture aside. Toast bread lightly on both sides in the broiler. Dice chilies into small bite sized pieces and add to shrimp mixture while stirring. Pour mixture into a large serving dish and top with toasted bread slices.

title: Aussie Bacon Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 lb canadian bacon, sliced into 1/4 inch strips | 1/2 cup tamari | 1/3 cup finely chopped green onion | 2 tablespoons finely chopped canned pineapple chunks | 1 lime, juice of
instructions: Mix the tamari, green onion, pineapple and lime juice. Pour over salad and chill for at least 30 minutes.

title: Czech Noodle Soup With Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 can navy beans or ( 15 ounce ) can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 1/2 teaspoons pickles, cut into quarters | 1 star anise ( optional )
instructions: Remove any casing from sausage. Cook sausage until browned. Drain excess fat and add remaining ingredients. Heat through.

title: Moroccan Spice Mix
ingredients: 3/4 cup coriander seed | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper
instructions: Grind coriander seeds with lemon pepper powder until ground to a fine powder. Store in an airtight glass jar.

title: Prawn and Saffron Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 4 large salmon fillets | 12 serrano chilies
instructions: In a small bowl, crush the saffron into a grain of powder. Place salmon in a large bowl and pour the saffron mix over all. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Light a grill. Grill salmon for about 5 minutes per side or until fish turns white. Meanwhile, chop chillies.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,beef cube,pimento olive,earth balance margarine
title: Caramelized Garlic Steak
ingredients: 8 beef cube steaks | 2 tablespoons earth balance or 2 tablespoons low-fat margarine | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives ( i get these ) | 2 cups plum sauce
instructions: Coat steaks in margarine. Heat 1/2 cup of the plum sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add olives to saucepan and cook just until warm, then place in pan. Place the remaining plum sauce in saucepan, and bring to a boil. Place steaks over mixture in pan. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook about 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Serve on a plate and top each with 1/8 cup of sauce made of your own choosing. This would also be good with mashed potatoes or noodles.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,italian bread crumb,mint leaf,green chilies,banana,salmon,rice flour,cucumber
title: Smoked Salmon Club
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground salmon | 1/4 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped green chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 cucumber, peeled and finely chopped | 1 bananas, sliced | italian seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Crumble salmon into a small skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring, until evenly browned, and lightly crisp, about 5 minutes. Stir in the green bell pepper and green chilies.

Random Ingredients: green olive,rice vinegar,raspberry,rye bread,part mozzarella cheese,corn syrup
title: Mock Party Rye Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon light flavored rice vinegar | 1 lb thin sliced fully cooked rye bread | 1 1/2 cups cubed part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 cup thawed frozen raspberries | 1 large green
instructions: Combine corn syrup, rice vinegar and rice vinegar in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,chinese wine,jumbo shrimp,peanut,pouring cream,cake,sazon goya,yellow pepper
title: Sazon Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 2 packets sazon goya instant steakhouse whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons chinese wine | 1 package jumbo shrimp, peeled & deveined | 1 - 2 1/2 cup light sopressata oyster sauce | 1 white yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1 jar roasted peanuts, rinsed, and dried | 16 jumbo shrimp, cleaned, deveined, deveined, and quartered | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry sichuan preserved ginger, peeled and shredded ( garnish )
instructions: Cut beef tenderloin into 6 - 8 thin thick medallions. Using a meat mallet or dull side of a cleaver, pound beef medallions between 2 1/2 inch pieces of plastic wrap until about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle beef with some sazon and 1 2/3 cup water. Toss beef with 2 1/3 cup water to coat. Repeat process with remaining beef, then toss with remaining 1 1/3 cup water. Soak 8 wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes. Prepare oyster sauce, and marinate beef with the sopressata oyster sauce and remaining sazon. Prepare pepper and peanuts, and sprinkle them with the sichuan preserved ginger. Grill shrimp, cut side down, until shrimp just turn pink, but are not overcooked about 3 minutes per side. Grill 3 - 4 minutes or until just turn pink. Spoon on top of noodles while still warm. Keep warm.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,cilantro leaf,peanut oil,sparkling water,lentil,tabasco sauce
title: Lentils, Noodle, & Pepper Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces dried large lentils | 1 bunch cilantro leaf | 8 ounces sparkling water | 3 dash tabasco sauce | 1 whole lb lasagna noodle | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Place the lentils in 2 cups water and boil for 30 - 40 minutes. Drain liquid into a basin. Finely chop cilantro leaves and set aside. In a mortar, crush pistachios and blend with a teaspoon or two of tabasco. Bring water in a small saucepan to a boil.

title: Beer and Corn Pie
ingredients: 1 can prunes | 2 cans baby corn, drained | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 cup beer | 1 pie crust, thawed
instructions: Drain prunes, reserving juice. Combine reserved prune juice, corn, and chili powder with reserved liquid and beer. Pour into pie crust. Cover with foil and refrigerate until firm, at least 6 hours and up to 1 week.

title: Aarti (Melon Cottage Cheese)
ingredients: 1 lb melon | cooking spray | 1/4 cup ghee
instructions: Wash melon to remove grit. Cut off the top and peel away all the green stem and any dark pith. Cut melon in half lengthwise. Cut crosswise into very thin slices. Place on a paper towel and sprinkle each slice with ghee. Spray each slice a little with cooking oil. Cover the melon with a clean kitchen towel to absorb some of the oil. After about 45 minutes, turn each slice over and cover with a clean towel until ready to serve. Serve with indian style bread and/or indian chapati or rice. Enjoy.

title: Romaine and Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce ( about 5 cups ) or 2 bunches mixed greens ( about 5 cups ) | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | crouton
instructions: Rinse lettuce leaves. Chop well. Combine with greens. Sprinkle w/croutons and additional vinegar if desired. Refrigerate several hours or over night.

title: Marmie Eisenhower's Potato Salad!
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 2 lbs red potatoes, halved | 12 ounces marshmallows | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Cook florets in boiling water till tender. Meanwhile, fry sweet potatoes till tender & slightly browned. Cool, peel & dice. Place the cooked flakes into a large salad bowl. Add the cauliflower & marshmallows. In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise & vinegar. Pour half over the salad & toss. Sprinkle with remaining mustard & garlic flakes if using. Chill before serving.

title: Spaetzle & Kahlua French Toast
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread, thinly sliced, about 5x2 inches in width | 3 -4 tablespoons kahlua | sea salt
instructions: Spread each slice of rye bread with kahlua, sprinkle with a light dash of sea salt or kosher salt to taste. Preheat electric griddle to medium heat. Ladle 1/4 cupfuls of sticky french toast onto griddle and cook until golden brown on both sides.

title: Super Simple Mushroom
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh mushrooms, cleaned and wiped clean | 1 1/2 cups flour
instructions: Pre heat your grill to medium, this step may take a little practice if you don't have the grill inches clean up your mushrooms clean and wipe with a clean cotton cloth or dry cloth. Tear the stems off the mushrooms. Slice into quarters, then into a smallish balls about 1'. You won't need to cut them up yourself, but they will give as a topping for the finished dish. You can throw all these mushrooms onto the grilling rack. They don't take long in the grill though as the mushrooms cook. Grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side on high, until all is a nice brown colour and mushrooms are tender. Make sure to let any residual grease drip off the grill and sprinkle the flour over all. Let it flour while cooking for 5 more minutes or until the flour is all absorbed. When you turn your grill on high, they will be cooked through but not mushy. Remember, it will be tasty and spicy so don't fight over the grill after 4 - 5 minutes in fact, you can use an electric griddle, or a cast iron skillet, too.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,grapefruit juice,onion soup mix
title: Orange Grapefruit Marinade
ingredients: 1 jar grapefruit juice | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a medium bowl. Place in a resealable plastic bag. Add meat of your choice.

title: Olive Oil's French Thyme Dip
ingredients: 10 fresh thyme sprigs, picked from stems | 150 ml creme fraiche or 150 ml sour cream, thick style | herbs such as dried thyme, lavender, oregano, rosemary, thyme, basil ( optional )
instructions: If using a stainless steel bowl, add half to a cup of water, and let sit for 10 minutes. Rinse with cold water. Remove all of the tender inner leaves. Dislodge any black or purple matter from beneath the stems. Add all of the herbs and mix thoroughly. You can leave the stems or the tops of the herbs in there for extra sprigs. Pour into a sterilized tub or serving bowl, and store in the fridge in a cool dark place for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: baby arugula,pine nut,caper,red grape,cocoa,yellow bell pepper,white wine vinegar
title: Cappuccino With Wilted Arugula W-Pine Nuts and Capers
ingredients: 1/8 cup white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa, divided | 10 ounces baby arugula, rinsed ( about 10 cups ) | 1 cup red seedless grapes, quartered | 1/2 teaspoon crushed drained capers | 8 ounces yellow bell peppers, halved, stemmed, seeded, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Vinaigrette, in a blender combine vinegar, 1 tablespoon cocoa, arugula, grapes, capers, bell pepper, remaining 1 tablespoon cocoa and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Blend on high speed until mixture is moderately thickened, about 10 seconds. Transfer the dressing to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: beet,earth balance margarine,bread crumb,cumin seed,green enchilada sauce
title: Enchilada-Rific Beet Spread
ingredients: 1 can beets, drained and chopped | 6 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed or 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 can green enchilada sauce, divided | 2 teaspoons earth balance margarine, melted
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Combine all ingredients in food processor or blender and blend for 15 - 20 seconds, or until mixture is smooth and creamy. Transfer into a mixing bowl and stir to combine. Refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. Serve with crackers or tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Clams in Hot Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 quarts bottled clam juice | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 3 tablespoons dried whole black peppercorns | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place clam juice, parsley, peppercorns, and hot pepper sauce in a large stockpot. Bring to a boil.

title: Easy Beef on Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 1 jar beef gravy ( i recommend swanson's ) | ground chili powder ( optional, i would add more ) | 1 jar sliced pimientos | pimiento ( optional )
instructions: Saute ground beef and drained noodles. Add gravy, chili and pimiento. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve on platter, garnish with cheese or sliced onion.

title: Homemade Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag frozen cut green beans | 1/2 cup chambord raspberry liquor ( raspberry schnapps ) | 1/4 teaspoon caraway | 2 -3 cups chopped cooked chicken | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup grated grated parmesan cheese ( or pecorino romano cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. In a large mixing bowl, mix the green beans, chambord, and caraway. Pour in raspberry liquor and toss to evenly distribute. Set aside. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, spread green bean mixture evenly. Top with chicken. Sprinkle mozzarella over chicken. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. Bake in preheated oven, uncovered, for 25 - 30 minutes, or until top is lightly browned.

title: Kiwi-Flavored Rice With Brown Beans
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked brown rice, rinsed well | 1 cup kiwi, peeled and sliced | 2 cups fat-free half-and-half cream
instructions: Spray skillet with cooking spray. Add kiwi, sprinkle with salt. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Stir in the uncooked rice. Remove from stove. Add the half and half and heat over medium heat until warmed through, stirring frequently. Serve warm over brown beans.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,coriander powder,mint sprig,confectioner ' sugar,savoy cabbage,pearl barley,sultana,apple juice
title: Barley and Apple Cabbage Enchilada - Enchiladas Verdes
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, soaked for 30 minutes | 1/2 cup sultana | 2 cups siced savoy cabbage, finely julienned | 4 -6 tablespoons sour apple juice | 4 cups enchilada sauce, old el paso | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 4 -6 mint sprigs, to decorate | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, sifted
instructions: Prepare the barley, bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Add the barley and allow to heat for 15 minutes. While the barley is heating, prepare the apple cider, in a small pan, sauté the sultanas in the apple juice for a few minutes, till a light golden colour. Drain and cool. When the barley has cooled, add the siced cabbage and turn it into a large bowl. Use 2 tablespoons of the cabbage mixture for each enchilada, then add the sour apple cider and toss to coat well. Cover and chill the enchiladas until ready to use. Assemble the enchiladas, dip the beans and barley in the enchilada sauce for 5 seconds, then roll them up in the confectioners' sugar. Fill the empty enchilada sauce can with water. Place the enchiladas on a plate or tray and top with the remaining cabbage mixture. Add the coriander and mint sprigs to the enchiladas with a dollop of sour apple cider. Heat in a 350 degree oven for 20 to 30 minutes, until well heated and bubbling. Serve with plain white rice.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,ricotta cheese,pork tenderloin,bell pepper,five spice powder,dark sesame oil
title: Five-Spice Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 cups fat-free ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, finely chopped | 2 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin | 2 yellow bell peppers | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat grill pan to medium high. In a medium bowl, mix ricotta, 5 spice powder, 1 tbsp sesame oil and rosemary. Slice pork and arrange in a single layer in a shallow baking dish. Grill over high heat 3 minutes on each side or until desired doneness is reached. Serve with peppers and remaining 2 tbsp sesame oil.

title: Irish Oxtail Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs oxtail, shucked and cleaned ( or 6 quarts water ) | 6 cups hot water | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 6 sprigs rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup dried cranberries or 1/4 cup dried cherries
instructions: Place whole oxtail shucked in a pot and add water bring to a simmer. Place remaining oxtail into pot for 20 minutes until tender. Remove oxtails and place into a bowl of cool water to harden. Place reserved oxtail and remaining water into soup pot and add chives and simmer 5 minutes longer to allow the oxtail flavour to develop. Strain through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl. Return broth to a boil over medium high heat, stirring continuously until reduced to 2 cups. Add herbs, and simmer another minute. Remove from heat and set aside to cool until it can be handled. Place bones that have been shucked into a pot over low heat, bring liquid to a simmer, and then reduce heat to very low to simmering. Cover and simmer until the oxtails are very tender. Remove the oxtails from the broth and allow them to cool. Discard bones and pass the broth through a muslin lined sieve extracting all the liquid in the sieve. Place the broth and reserved oxtail and reserved liquid in a large roasting pan and cook at 325 f for about 1 hour, stirring frequently to avoid any sticking. Place oxtails back into the soup and serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Italian Sausage
ingredients: 4 -6 links hot italian pork sausage | 2 -3 chicken breasts
instructions: Lay the chicken breast in a crockpot or heavy duty baking dish, and sprinkle the sausage on top. Pour the sausage into the crockpot, pour the sausage juice over the chicken breasts, and set on low for 4 to 6 hours. After 1 hour, open the crockpot and place the chicken pieces on top of sausage. Cook on high for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,yellow onion,italian salad dressing mix
title: Cilantro Onion French Dressing
ingredients: 1 package dry italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup finely diced yellow onion | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro stem
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well.

title: The Perfect White Sauce
ingredients: 300 ml milk | 100 g freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place milk and cheese in a saucepan over a medium heat. Heat until combined, around 10 minutes. Place a small plate over the top and pour in the sauce. Gently shake the pan to distribute the milk and cheese. Continue shaking the pan for about 30 seconds or until the sauce is bubbling and heated through.

Random Ingredients: roast pork,onion salt,mustard seed,masa harina,coconut milk,chickpea
title: Baja-Style Pulled Pork
ingredients: 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 onion salt | 4 pounds coarsely crumbled roast pork | 3 cups can coconut milk | 1 1/2 cups masa harina | 3 packages dried chickpeas
instructions: Heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Stir in mustard seeds, and cook until they begin to sputter, about 30 seconds. Stir in onion salt, and cook until onion is transparent, about 5 minutes. Stir in pork, and cook until pork is browned, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Drain grease, and season with coconut milk. Pour in about 1/2 cup water, stir in masa harina, and bring to a boil. When the mixture comes to a boil, stir in chickpeas, then cover, and simmer until pork is tender, about 2 hours.

title: Spiced French-Germans
ingredients: 1 can french style green beans | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1 tablespoon yogurt | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Drain the green beans, and cut in half or into thirds. Place the beans in a large bowl, stir in the corn oil, yogurt, cumin, and provolone cheese. Toss to blend and serve.

title: Feta Coffee Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled feta | 1 cup hot strong coffee | 3 tablespoons soft brown sugar | 2 teaspoons dried fruit
instructions: Stir together cheese, coffee, sugar and dried fruit.

Random Ingredients: glace cherry,cheddar cheese,red potato,mango rum,thai chili sauce
title: Smokin' Hot Chocolate and Mango Chili Potatoes
ingredients: 1 medium red potato, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 6 tablespoons sweet thai sweet chili sauce ( mae ploy brand ) | 6 tablespoons mango rum ( mae ploy brand ) | 1 small fresh sweet mango ( mango, peeled, finely chopped and seeded ) ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400' degrees. Place potato in a casserole dish and cover with foil. Bake for about 20 minutes or until tender. Remove foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes or until golden brown. In a bowl, toss together the sweet thai chili sauce, mango nectar, and rum. Add the cooked potatoes and toss to coat. Note, for an extra kick, you can add a little mango chutney or a few chopped fresh mango or papaya seeds to the potato mixture.

title: Mustard Seed and Onion Biscuits
ingredients: 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 large red spanish onion, peeled and roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f lightly mix first 5 ingredients with a fork and then add 1 tbsp of the flour, reserving the remainder. Roll the dough until it is as thin as possible. Wrap in waxed paper and chill for 30 minutes. Roll out biscuits using 3 inch diameter and cut into circles with cookie cutter and place on a lightly floured cookie sheet. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Cool on wire rack. These cook quickly, keep at room temperature for 1/2 hour, then reheat on paper towel. Makes about.

title: Crepes With Dried Red Peppers
ingredients: 8 crepes | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes
instructions: Pour a tablespoonful of dry tarragon on a small plate or plate. Roll a crepe up and place in the plate on top of the tarragon. Sprinkle with dried red pepper. Drizzle on a little more tarragon. Eat like a pizza. Enjoy.

title: The Best Corn Dip Ever!
ingredients: corn, fresh or frozen, defrosted and well drained | oil or cooking spray | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon thyme, washed, dried and crushed ( optional )
instructions: Place thawed corn in a food processor and mix until smooth. Add the whipped topping. Sprinkle on the lemon thyme if using. Bake in a medium sized shallow baking dish just large enough to hold and dip the corn into. Goes best in a double boiler with rye, pumpernickel and rye bread.

title: Fettuccini All'onda (Sausage and Orange Pasta)
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion | 1 carrot | 1/2 lb italian sausage | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 packages fettuccine
instructions: Place the onion and carrot in the slow cooker. Slice the sausage into 1/4 inch slices, about 3 tablespoons. Place the sausage and the vegetables in a large skillet with a lid. Pour boiling water over the vegetables, cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. During the last 15 minutes of cooking remove the sausage and vegetables from the water. Stir the mixture thoroughly with the vegetables before serving. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Polish Sausage Roll
ingredients: 3 lbs sausage, peppered sausage | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 cup cake flour | 3 teaspoons sage | 2 lemons, zest of, cut in slices ( or lemon juice ) | 2 tablespoons dried mustard greens
instructions: On a plate sprinkle dry rind and salt onto cold sausage. Mix flour, sage, lemon zest and lemon juice together. Roll sausage onto dry mixture pressing out and then form into long rectangular sausage rolls. Refrigerate rolls, covered with plastic wrap, for about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place sausage rolls on a baking sheet and bake for approximately 40 minutes or until cooked through. Serve on a platter and cover with sliced mustard greens.

title: Spinach Stuffed (Paneer) Savurka (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 pound fresh spinach, stems removed | 3 green cardamom pods | 1 cup dried bread crumbs, or more as needed | 2 squares crumbled dried bread crumbs, or as needed
instructions: Wash and stem the spinach, and remove the spines and leaves. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the spinach in the water, and cook for 3 minutes, until the water is just beginning to release. Drain of excess water, and squeeze out all excess liquid, leaving about 1 cup of the liquid in the pot. Dip the green cardamom pods in a teaspoon of very hot water, and place 4 green cardamom pods into the boiling water to soften. Remove the cardamom pods with a slotted spoon, and set aside to cool. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of spinach, 2 teaspoons of bread crumbs, and 1 tablespoon of cooked water in a bowl, and mix until evenly combined. Form the mixture into marble size balls, about 2 inch diameter, and set aside. Repeat with the remaining spinach and bread crumbs. Bring 5 cups of water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt to a boil in a large pot. Drop the stuffed balls into the boiling water, and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until the shells float to the top, and the water is lightly separating from the spinach with a wooden spoon. Lift out the balls with a slotted spoon, and place the balls in a bowl. Repeat with the remaining balls, draining off all but 1 tablespoon of spinach water. Arrange the stuffed balls in a serving dish, and garnish with remaining 1 tablespoon of crumbs. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,safflower oil,spinach,flat leaf parsley,shortening,onion soup mix
title: Pancakes for the Crockpot
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 20 ounces tomato soup | 2 tablespoons safflower oil | 20 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons shortening ( for frying ) | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine dried onion soup mix, tomato soup, vegetable soup, safflower oil, spinach, and shortening. Stir until thoroughly combined, cover, and cook on low for 8 to 11 hours, stirring from time to time, until thickened.

title: Muesli Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 1 pound cooked lamb, cubed | 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast meat, cubed | 3 cups muesli ( sweetened asian fruit spread ) | 1 cup jigger vodka | 1 cup cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Thread lamb, chicken and muesli onto skewers. Place skewers onto a large bamboo skewer that has been coated with non stick cooking spray. Cook over coals or grill. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. The amount of time required depends on the type of skewers, meat and sauce used. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,baking soda,pepper,salt black pepper
title: Salt-Grilled Fried Rice Chips
ingredients: 6 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Brush 1 tablespoon of dressing on each radish coated with oil. Cover with remaining dressing. Cover and allow to marinate 2 to 4 hours at room temperature, stirring a few times. Prepare rack in center of the grill or preheat a heavy grill. When ready to cook, lightly oil grate.

title: Burdock (Japanese Ginger and Ginger Tea Breadsticks)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1/2 cup ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Put the flour into the bowl of an electric mixer and mix in the ginger and garlic pastes. Slowly pour in the mirin, followed by the sake. Switch the speed to low and knead the dough for about 10 minutes. The dough should be neither sticky nor dry. Form the dough into pencil size sticks about 3 inches long and 1/4 inch thick. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and refrigerate until firm, about 45 minutes. Cut into 1 inch lengths. Store in an airtight container. To use, freeze the dough for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: dark raisin,cornstarch,pimento pepper,white sesame seed,apple cider,black cumin,pine nut
title: Apple Cider Pimento and Black Cumin Jam
ingredients: 6 cups apple cider or 6 cups apple juice | 2/3 cup cornstarch | 3 tablespoons black cumin, with or 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 cup seedless white sesame seeds, toasted | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 cup dark seedless raisin | 1 large pimento stuffed green apple ( optional )
instructions: In a large heavy duty saucepan combine cider or juice with cornstarch with remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil for about 5 minutes. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Uncover and cook for 10 minutes more. Stirring regularly to prevent sticking. Ladle jam into hot sterilized jars. Seal jars and process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes.

title: Berry and Avocado Crostini
ingredients: 1 cup borlotti beans | 1 avocado, flesh of | 6 -7 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Rinse the beans and soak them overnight. Drain the beans, reserving the soaking water. Dice the avocado and toss it into the beans. Place the crostini in a serving bowl. Pour the soaking water or water from the beans over them. Stir gently until the beans are coated. Add the avocado, blueberries and salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: stove stuffing mix,chicken stock,white pepper,cayenne pepper,fish fillet
title: Easy Coiled Fish from the Hags
ingredients: 1 lb sea bass or 1 lb sea bass fillet, washed and scaled | 4 cups chicken broth or 4 cups fish stock | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 package stove top stuffing mix | 1 dash white pepper
instructions: Place fish in a 9x13 pan in a single layer coating each with the cayene pepper. Combine chicken broth and spice and pour over fish. Cover and bake covered in a 325 degree oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, remove fish from pan. Place on serving plates and flake into pieces. Pour fish juices over fish. Serve with mashed potatoes and steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,tilapia fillet,crab,wonton wrapper,gouda cheese,celery seed,ice cube
title: Baja Tilapia & Spinach Ravioli
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet | 1 cup shredded edambert cheese | 1 cup shredded smoked gouda cheese | 1/4 cup chopped celery seed | 12 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup shredded fontina cheese | ice cube, for filling
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400º. In a small dish, combine 1 tbs of the edambert, 1/4 cup of gouda, celery seeds and 1/8 teaspoon of the garlic powder. Lay fish out flat on a lightly oiled grill pan for 3 minutes each side, until fish flakes easily. Brush each won ton wrapper with beaten egg and sprinkle 2 tbs of the cheese mixture on each. Seal edges by pinching together. In a 9x13 baking dish or roasting pan, layer the ravioli, tilapia fillets, and edambert mix, ending with the mozzarella mixed with the edambert. Sprinkle with the rest of the cheese. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until the ravioli are hot and cheese has melted on the top.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,coffee granule,tamarind pulp,icing sugar,couscous,turnip,yellow onion
title: Tamarind-Turnip Burnt Burfi
ingredients: 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 cup chopped turnip | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 1 1/2 cups boiled couscous | 2 cups ice cubes | 1 -2 tablespoon instant coffee granules
instructions: Place the onions and turnips in a glass bowl, then sprinkle icing sugar, stirring to dissolve the sugar. Pour tamarind pulp over vegetable mixture. Put the boiling couscous in another bowl and pour boiling water over the couscous. Let stand for 15 minutes. Place in a bowl with ice cubes and coffee granules, then stir to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 4 hours. Strain burfi and transfer to a serving bowl. Serve at room temperature.

title: Lebanese Lime Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 12 slices lintlle no-boil lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup molasses | 4 lime wedges, for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Add the lentils and return to a boil. Cover the pan and cook until the lentils have lost most of their 1 - ¼ cup of liquid and the lentils are tender, about 15 minutes. Uncover and stir in a little of the cooked lentils. Reserve. In a small bowl, combine the molasses with a small piece of plastic food wrap. Shake the pan to disperse any remaining bits of lentils. Arrange a layer of noodles on the baking sheet. Top with half of the lentils and a layer of noodles. Sprinkle with about 2/3 of the molasses mixture. Repeat layering, topping with remaining lentils and molasses mixture and finishing with the top layer of noodles. If desired, drizzle with lime wedges and serve. Variation, for a milder lentil flavor, increase the molasses and molasses to 3 teaspoons. Serve over more bread.

title: Swiss - Apple Steak
ingredients: 1 1/8 lbs skirt steaks ( about 4-ribs ) | 1 pinch ground black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 3 large apples, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Heat a large nonstick frypan over medium heat. Sprinkle meat with pepper to taste. Add almond extract. Sear meat on both sides until lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer apple slices to a paper towel lined plate, drizzle with oil from frypan, and let drain. Pour fat from frypan, into a small bowl, and toss with slotted spoon to combine with apple mixture.

title: Easy Spanish Oats for 1 (Towards the Border)
ingredients: 1 package oatmeal ( old el paso type oatmeal is best for soaking onions ) | 1 1/4 lbs spanish onions | 4 cloves garlic, minced | 1 jar apricot preserves
instructions: Place everything except the preserves and oats in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then turn down to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes. While oatmeal is simmering, soak the oats for 30 minutes. Drain the oats, and break them into very small chunks. Use more oatmeal as necessary to make a thick consistency to eat after cooking. Stir the chopped oatmeal into the cooked onions. Serve warm, with the preserve drizzled onto each oat.

title: Scottish Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup margarine, chilled and diced
instructions: Stir the flour and margarine together into a dry dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead the dough until it's smooth. Shape the dough mixture into a ball, and divide it into two balls. Wet your hands a little, and shape each ball into a smooth ball. Flatten the dough balls to make a circle about the size of a fifty centre's circle. Set aside onto a lightly floured surface. Flip the dough over onto another, and gently press the edges to seal. Repeat with remaining dough, placing the dough circles on a baking tray, and making sure to leave space between them. Preheat to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9 inch pie dish. Sprinkle the tops with diced cheese or bacon bits. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing into 1/4 inch slices to serve.

title: Spicy Arugula
ingredients: 2 bunches arugula | 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce | 6 cups packed fresh cilantro stems ( about 12 large cilantro leaves with the tough stems ) | 1 1/2 cups unbleached flour
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Cut the arugula crosswise into 12 equal pieces. In a large bowl, combine soy sauce, cilantro, and flour.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Fresh Strawberry and Lime
ingredients: 12 ounces angel hair pasta or 12 ounces fresh baby shrimp pasta | 2 fresh thyme sprigs | lime wedge, to garnish
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente and drain. Place the shrimp in a large bowl with a little olive oil to coat. Slip them around the bowl to coat. Toss with the thyme sprigs. Serve in bowls with lime wedges at the table.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,cheese tortellini,clam shell,farfalle pasta,gingerroot,snow pea,half
title: Faux Campfire Crab and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated cheese tortellini | 1 jar clams in shell, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces frozen snow peas, thawed and drained | 3 -4 tablespoons superfine sugar | 12 ounces extra-sharp reduced-fat kerrygold's sharp sliced cheese tortellini | 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh gingerroot | 1 pint fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. To make the noodles, in a large saucepan of boiling salted water, cook the tortellini for 8 to 12 minutes until al dente.

title: Approximately Rosemary and Fresh Rosemary Puree from the Mids
ingredients: 3 fresh rosemary sprigs, finely chopped | 3 sprigs fresh thyme | 15 ml fresh apple juice | 500 ml approx pure dried fenugreek
instructions: Passionate puree, place rosemary and thyme in the base of your mixer, add a few drops of apple juice and mix well with a large spoon. Add 100ml of apple juice and mix well. Add remaining 100ml of apple juice and mix with a large spoon until well combined and thick. Pour into sterilized jars and place in a dry shelf in a low oven for about 30 minutes. To check if the purée is ready after 10 minutes, you need to stir the mixture around, the oil should not be too hot, you may have to do this in 3 minutes. When the purée has cooled, strain through a fine meshed meshed cloth to remove any pith and loose skins. If any rosemary leaves remain on the surface, drain them and add to the mixture. Passionate should keep in the fridge up to 6 weeks. It should last for 4 months. Use an alcohol free liquidiser to liquify the puree and pour into sterilised jars. This can be bought at asian food stores and is great with the fenugreek blossoms.

title: Beef Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough | 1 pound sliced beef top round steak steak | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 jar pepperoni pieces
instructions: Layer the phyllo sheets into a 9x13 inch pan with a dampened paper towel on the bottom. Evenly layer 1 pound sliced beef on top of sheets, then 1 package taco seasoning on top and 1 jar pepperoni slices on top. Lay the phyllo sheets over beef. Top with remaining sliced beef, and cover with a dampened kitchen towel. Place in the freezer until phyllo sheets are thawed and cold. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until phyllo has puffed and risen well.

title: Thai Peanut Butter Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter or 1 1/2 cups crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon ground lemongrass, minced ( more or less to taste ) | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, well seasoned if desired | 16 -20 slices fresh firm fresh mozzarella or 16 -20 slices fresh basil, if desired ( 8 )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat well using an electric mixer for 1 - 2 minutes. Spread into a serving dish. Cut each slice of mozzarella or basil into 4 strips across. Top with the sliced mozzarella or basil and cover with the peanut butter dip.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,egg white,parmesan cheese,onion soup mix,port wine,topping,vegetable oil,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Egg White & Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 small onion ( diced ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 cup monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded ( divided ) | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons port wine | 4 egg whites
instructions: Melt 1 tblsp oil.

title: Beef Satay
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean beef sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb russet potato, cut into small chunks | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons minced pimentos | 1 tablespoon prepared pimento, sandwich spread ( or more ) | 1 small banana, sliced | toothpick, and bamboo skewers ( soaked in a mixture of hot water and cold water for 15 minutes )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except banana or skewers in crock pot or other large slow cooker/pot and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Remove from crock pot, reserving marinade and use the reserved marinade to brush over satays for another use.

title: English Cottage Pudding
ingredients: 1 package butterscotch pudding mix | 1 cup white flour
instructions: Pour butterscotch pudding mix including all the pudding mixes into a bowl, set aside until all the coolie dough has been made. Put a kettle on the stove. When hot enough, add butter. If using butterscotch, add flour to water in little amounts until mixture forms a soft dough, but not sticky. Turn out dough on a floured board. Roll out to a thickness of 1. Dough should be about 1/2 inch thick, and then cut with a 1/2 inch heart shaped biscuit cutter. Cut out the heart shaped pockets. Prick the tops of the dough with 3 fingers. Bake at 400f for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Chef Bevski's Frito Hot Sauce
ingredients: 6 slices bacon grease | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 jar giardiniera, drained and chopped
instructions: Place bacon grease in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until bacon grease has become a little crispy around the edges. Season with garlic powder and spoon the hot bacon mixture into a jar with lid, filling to the top. Cover tightly, and refrigerate at least 1 hour, shaking container occasionally to prevent excess drips.

title: Chinese Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken | 3 3 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 4 tablespoons unsweetened baking chocolate | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 2 tablespoons fresh chopped squash or 2 tablespoons frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Remove chicken and let stand for 15 minutes. Remove skin and fat. Cut thigh bone into quarters and cut breast into 1/2 inch cubes. Place in large bowl. Add next 6 ingredients, cover and set aside 15 minutes. Add chicken and marinate for 20 minutes. Drain chicken. Rinse and dry thoroughly. Heat oven to 425°f. Arrange chicken in 8 ovenproof dutch oven or roasting pan and bake for 45 minutes. Raise heat to broil and bake until chicken is no longer pink in center and juices run clear about 3 to 5 minutes. Place chicken on platter and cover. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut and Chickpeas With Orzo
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1 can chick-peas, drained and rinsed well, reserving liquid | 1 cup sauerkraut, rinsed and patted dry | 1 cup sliced fresh sweet celery | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup walnut pieces or 1/2 cup chopped pecans, toasted
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions, omitting any oil. Meanwhile, combine chickpeas, sauerkraut, celery and raisins in large bowl. Add orzo, chickpeas, and reserved liquid. Mix with fork until well combined. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,plain yogurt,tea,kidney bean,double cream
title: Lolly's Slow Cooker Irish Potato and Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 cup chopped dried kidney beans | 1 cup double cream | 1 bag frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed | 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon dried instant tea
instructions: Place the dried kidney beans and 4 cups of water in the slow cooker, cover, and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours, or on low for 7 - 8 hours. When fully cooked, thaw the potato bag in the microwave for 1 minute and pour into a bowl of cold water, then place the bag in the sink and repeat the process with the potatoes, using a potato masher to mash the potatoes right into the pot. When the vegetables are thawed, place them into a pot. Using a potato masher, mash the potatoes using the cream and yogurt and stir to combine. When the slow cooker is finished, strain the liquid from the pot through a sieve and discard all solids. Place back into the slow cooker and stir in the instant tea. Stir well to combine, then cook on high for 30 - 45 minutes, or until the potatoes are heated through.

title: Shaker Recipe
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried mexican oregano | 1 1/8 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 1/8 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 5 tablespoons light vanilla yogurt | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice, ground
instructions: Place garlic, oregano, thyme, fenugreek, yogurt, and tahini in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Pour into a small bowl and toss with mixed spice. Cover and chill at least one hour before serving, although overnight is better.

Random Ingredients: sugar,anise seed,flour tortilla,tapioca,dark rum,white rum,millet,orzo pasta
title: Brazilian Bamba
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups orzo pasta | 1 cup flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons tapioca | 3/4 cup milk | 3/4 cup sugar | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 2 teaspoons white rum | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped orzo pasta
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain. In a large bowl, whisk together the tapioca, flour tortillas, milk, sugar, dark rum, anise seeds and white rum. Gradually whisk in the orzo. Remove from the heat and stir to combine. Let cool to room temperature, stir in the chopped orzo and serve.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,wasabi powder,coffee powder,molasses,kaffir lime leaf,kosher salt black pepper,brown sugar,blackberry
title: Blackberry Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package kaffir lime leaves | 1 cup blackberries | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 teaspoon wasabi powder | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/4 cup molasses | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup brewed coffee powder
instructions: Place kaffir lime leaves into large saucepan of water.

title: Raisin & Cashews
ingredients: 4 ounces cashews, raw | 2 tablespoons tarragon, fresh | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans | 2 tablespoons dried mint
instructions: Blanch the cashews & place in a food processor with the tarragon & vanilla bean. Process until nuts are coarsely chopped & well ground. Add the mint & process again until the mint reaches the desired spreadable consistency. Store in an airtight container in a cool place.

Random Ingredients: herbes de provence,cheese tortellini,gelatin,liquid smoke,picante sauce,apple juice,chicken tender,turmeric powder
title: Tortellini in Sweet-And-Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders, bite-size | 1 tablespoon gelatin | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup reduced fat cheese tortellini
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions, drain and set aside. Boil apple juice over medium heat, in a small saucepan add pectin, herbes de provence, liquid smoke and mix well. Blend with the tortellini.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,thai chili sauce,beef chuck,orange,apple juice,garlic,chocolate
title: Chile-Apple Beef Hash
ingredients: 3 pounds lean beef chuck | 1/2 pound minced garlic | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 3 teaspoons fresh orange rind | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Place beef, garlic, baking powder, orange peel, apple juice, and hot chili sauce in a large pot. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add chocolate.

title: Romaine and Romaine Tenderloins
ingredients: 16 ounces new york strip steak, trimmed ( i prefer london broil ) | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, separated and washed
instructions: Trim the excess fat from both sides of the steak. Cut the steak diagonally across the grain in to 1/4 inch slices. Place the sliced steaks on a piece of foil and fold in 4 large diagonal slivers across the meat. Wrap the foil around the steak. Bake in preheated 475 degree f oven for 8 to 10 minutes for medium rare, 10 to 15 minutes for medium. Let rest 5 minutes before slicing. Combine the romaine, red onion, and 1 tablespoon of water in a bowl. Serve warm.

title: Summer SQUASH Compote
ingredients: 2 small summer squash | 1 celery rib, diagonally cut | 3 1/2 cups low sodium chicken broth ( or water can be substituted )
instructions: Slice winter squash lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices in bowl and cover with boiling water.

title: Pizza Crusts
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked spaghetti sauce | 1/3 lb asparagus spear | 1/3 lb raw fennel ( cut into 2 in pieces ) | 1/2 cup self rising flour
instructions: Bring 6 cups of salted water to a boil. Put spaghetti, asparagus and fennel into boiling water and cook till al dente stage. Drain. Place all ingredients in a bowl & mix quickly by hand until the dough mixes it together well. Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Take 1/3 of the dough balls and roll between palms to make balls.. Carefully place balls onto the prepared cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,chicken bouillon,alfalfa sprout,chocolate syrup,natural yoghurt,white chocolate
title: White Chocolate and Red Kidney Bean Hummus
ingredients: 3 ounces white chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon ( vegetarian ) | 1/4 cup natural yoghurt | 400 g red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup alfalfa sprouts | chocolate syrup, to drizzle
instructions: Place chopped white chocolate, chicken stock and yoghurt in a small saucepan. Bring to the boil, then remove from heat and immediately stir in chopped red kidney beans and alfalfa sprouts. Pour into a serving bowl and drizzle with chocolate syrup. Serve with toasted ice caps.

title: Mustard Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 package cannelloni tubes | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
