instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Fill the cannelloni tubes with mustard, and place them on a parchment paper covered baking sheet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until dry.

title: Rice Noodles
ingredients: 200 g dried rice noodles | 1 bunch fresh dill weed | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Pour boiling water over the rice noodles and leave in a cool place for 15 minutes. Drain well and bring to the boil, with two of the dill leaves and three fluff with a fork. Cover and cook till tender. Meanwhile mix the flour and a little water and add gradually till its a sticky consistency. Tear off a corner of the bag of dill and crush finely. Place in a bowl and leave to drain on kitchen paper towels till just damp. Drain noodle and add to the bowl with the dill and flour mix well until the noodles coat them. Tip onto greased oven tray place in a steamer on the shelf at low heat and steam for about 30 mins till the noodles are all cooked. Note that this could also be as cold as well.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,kidney bean,raspberry preserve,artificial sweetener,vanilla pudding mix,chicken bouillon,goat meat
title: Savory Goat With Raspberries and Beans
ingredients: 1 jar raspberries and preserves | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 envelope imitation sweetener | 2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 can kidney beans, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1/2 cup goat meat or 1/2 cup other meat
instructions: In a 5 quart slow cooker, place raspberry preserves, pudding mix, stewed tomatoes with liquid, sweetener, and bouillon. Mix well. Add kidney beans. Cover and cook on low setting for 5 to 6 hours or on high setting for 2 to 3 hours. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,grain rice,cayenne,pear,rice wine,basmati rice,pine nut
title: Pear Rice (Algerian Rice Restaurant)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1/2 cup short-grain rice | 1 large pear, peeled, cored, quartered | 1 cup toasted, pine nuts | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 2 teaspoons rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Place rice in a medium size bowl, add water and stir to combine. Set aside. Place pear in a large, heavy pot.

title: Tiramisu
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves | 1 ounce vodka | 1 1/2 1 1/2 ounces amaretto liqueur or 1 1/2 ounces other almond-flavored liqueur
instructions: Put the garlic cloves in a mortar and pound to a paste. Add the vodka and pound until they're a paste. Add the amaretto and pound until well integrated. Transfer this to a container and keep refrigerated.

title: Rice and Veggie Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 cups warm milk | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups polenta | 1 bunch arugula | 1 1/2 cups prepared polenta
instructions: Heat the milk and yeast in large bowl to 180 degrees f. In a separate bowl, mix together the 1 1/2 cups of polenta and 1 1/2 cups of polenta mixture. Dissolve the taco seasoning in the warm milk mixture. Add to the yeast mixture. Stir well. Let rise about one hour. Put dough in a bowl that has been lightly greased with cornmeal or pam, cover, and let rise 45 minutes on a lightly floured surface. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. When finished rising, spray a 9 inch cake pan inside the pan with cooking spray. Punch down the dough, and remove the cover and top with remaining prepared polenta. Bake at 425 degrees f for about 35 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,tomato,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,shrimp,anise seed,beef tenderloin
title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin With Chipotle Pan Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes ( not packed in oil ) | 1/4 cup chopped chipotle pepper in adobo sauce ( from a 6-oz can if you can't find it ) | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed | 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled deveined, tails removed | 1 loaf whole wheat bread
instructions: Preheat grill pan over medium high heat. Rub tenderloins with salt, pepper and anise seed. Grill, turning once, until desired doneness, about 5 minutes for medium rare. Transfer to cutting board and let rest 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine tomatoes, chipoltles and shrimp in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over low heat until shrimp is curled but crisp, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Remove tenderloin from grill and cool slightly. Cut into 8 large slices. Spread the top of each slice with the tomato mixture. Place slices between the slices of bread and cut into eight wedges. Serve warm.

title: Chinese Style Condiment
ingredients: 1 cup chopped peanuts ( salted peanuts may also be used ) | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Keep refrigerated in an air tight container for up to one month. Note, peanuts keep best if left out of direct sunlight at a very low light and the color darkens quickly.

title: Ranch Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 envelope ranch dressing mix | 4 cups beef stock
instructions: Combine the ranch and beef broth in a saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil.

title: Annie's Spicy Nutty Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 ounces red enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts | 12 ounces hot red enchilada sauce | 12 ounces wood chips, or as needed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Pour the enchilada sauce through a strainer into a saucepan over medium heat. Place the hazelnuts into a bowl, and set aside. Layer one third of the enchilada sauce into the bottom of a medium baking dish, sprinkling with 1 tablespoon of hazelnuts. Spread the remaining sauce over the hazelnuts. Sprinkle the remaining hazelnuts across the top of the sauce. Cover the dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have blended, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: White White Beans With Mexican Cheese and Cannellini
ingredients: 1 lb dried cannellini beans | 1 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese
instructions: Rinse your beans and place in a pot, and cover with water about 2 inches above beans... Add a few splashes of oil to taste. Boil for about 20 minutes or until white beans are tender.. Add 1/2 cup more the cheese and the other half cup of the stock as you are boiling. Cook for a few minutes longer or until the cheese has melted. Drain and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,taco flour tortilla,angel hair pasta,black olive,ghee,vegetable oil,rum
title: Tacique Beef Fajitas Wwies.
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 6 soft taco-size flour tortillas | 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil | 1/3 cup rum | 1 cup shredded rotisserie-cooked beef stew meat ( or your favourite stewing meat ) | 6 pitted black olives | mexican style shredded green onion and/or fresh herb mix ( optional )
instructions: In skillet over medium heat add the olive oil, rum and stew beef stew meat. Drain any excess oil from meat. Simmer uncovered until meat is done. Use spatula to tear meat into small bite sized pieces. To assemble, cut each tortilla into six long strips. Place strips on a plate and layer with meat, cheese, olives, green onions and/or herb mix. Wrap burrito style in foil, refrigerate for 20 minutes or so and enjoy. These can also be made and frozen ahead and frozen just keep wrapped when thawed. Just microwave on high for about 20 minute the cheese should melt, wrap them in foil and let them thaw.

title: Italian Porcini Dip
ingredients: 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms | 3/4 cup canola oil, warmed | 1/2 cup prepared pizza sauce | 1 stalk celery, chopped
instructions: Place mushrooms in a small serving bowl, and cover with boiling water.

title: Filipino Bok Choy Salad With Orange and Ginger
ingredients: 6 cups bok choy, leaves torn into bite size pieces | 3/4 cup sweet parsley stems, chopped | 1/3 cup jicama, peeled and cut into thin sticks | 2 tablespoons orange zest, fresh peeled and quartered | 2 teaspoons coarsely crushed black peppercorns
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: dough,ricotta cheese,pomegranate,hazelnut,extra virgin olive oil,chipotle chile,parchment paper,broccoli floret
title: Homemade  Pomegranate Bread
ingredients: 16 ounces low-fat ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup raw hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon dried pomegranate, seeds of | 2 canned chipotle chiles | 2 lbs fresh broccoli florets, ends trimmed, halved | 1 package parchment paper, preferably white | 8 ounces fresh pomegranate slices, room temperature
instructions: Put the ricotta, hazelnuts, oil and remaining ingredients into a food processor and process until smooth. Add the broccoli and process until it becomes a chunky paste. Turn onto a clean work surface. Cut parchment paper into two pieces about 1/2” wide and 2 inches square. Layer 3 pieces of parchment on the counter. Place a scant 1/4 cup of the cheese paste and some broccoli in each, starting on the edge of the parchment and working your way to the middle, fold in the edges and then roll the tofu mixture into a log about as thick as your finger. Wrap the log in the remaining parchment and tape closed at any point you don’t want the paper to become too tight. Heat the oven to 300 degrees f. Remove the log from the parchment and cut into 1 pieces, about 1/2” wide by ¼” thick, then place them on a parchment lined baking sheet and cover with parchment paper. Bake until the bread is golden and puffed, about 1 hour. Remove from the oven and then place the pomegranate slices around the loaf and bake for 12 to 15 minutes more. If the bread starts drying out, switch the oven off, cover with a kitchen towel and let rest for 30 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: pecan,bamboo shoot,yukon gold potato,grain rice,oat,lamb neck
title: Irish Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb necks | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes ( red potatoes preferred ) | 1 cup toasted oat ( optional ) | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1 cup dry whole grain rice, cooked | 1 cup pecans ( optional )
instructions: Slice lamb. Coarsely grate potatoes and place in large bowl w/the meat and mash slightly. Place in casserole dish. Mix oats, bamboo shoots, and rice and then spoon over potato mixture. Combine nuts and salt and pepper to taste and sprinkle over casserole. Cover tightly and bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour. Uncover and bake additional 60 minutes. Serve directly from dish.

title: Tomatillo Bread  (Appetizer)
ingredients: 1/2 cup tomatillo, chopped ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 cup maraschino cherry, in brine | 3 tablespoons white bread flour | sliced white bread ( optional )
instructions: Place tomatillo in bowl with tomatillo.

title: Hooey Hoisin Glazed Sausages.
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 2 lbs firm fresh ground turkey sausage | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Pour the chutney into a shallow glass dish. Add in the hoisin sauce, then the ground turkey. Roll the sausage up in the bean mixture, then wrap each one in almonds. Place each roll in a large plastic bag with several inches of space at one corner. Refrigerate 2 - 3 hours, turning the two ends once. Heat the oven to 300°f remove the bags, remove the tops of the rolls, and transfer the sausages to a shallow roasting tin. Place the roasting tin on a rack and place in the oven, seam side down. For 1 hour, turn off the oven, and leave the sausages in there somewhere warm. Then, turning down the oven and leave the sausages in there another 1 hour. Serve over cooked rice or pasta of your choice. Note, if you use a loaf of bread, toast the bread slices in a toaster oven or toaster oven for 1 - 2 minutes to get the crunch off the bread slices.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,flat leaf parsley,enoki mushroom,thyme,tabasco sauce,sage,coffee powder
title: Easy Mushroom Enchilada Mix
ingredients: 30 enoki mushrooms, stems removed | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine marinade ingredients. Place enchilada sauce in the jar of a blender and process until smooth. Stir in mushroom stems and parsley, if using. Spoon over prepared mix, cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours.

title: Sour Orange Cranberry, Green Bean, and Pecan Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/3 cup dry green beans | 2 bay leaves | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries ( or frozen ) | 3 tablespoons flour | 1 finely grated orange, rind of
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the orange rind in a large bowl.

title: Gordi Rice Cake
ingredients: 3 cups jasmine rice | 3 tablespoons flour | 1/4 - 1/2 pinch saffron threads, crushed | 1 pomegranate seeds ( optional ) | filling : | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds
instructions: Rinse rice well with several changes of water. Put in a bowl, cover with lightly salted water, and set aside. Pour the flour into a medium sized mixing bowl, and add the pinch of saffron. Cut the pomegranate seeds in half, and add them to the flour in the bowl. Mix well with your fingers. Add the saffron to the rice and mix well. The rice should not be too wet initially. If necessary, add a small amount of water to keep the rice fluffy until the batter is smooth. The batter should look like a pancake. If necessary, more water may be added in 2 to 3 amounts. Cover the bowl, and set aside for about half an hour. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with a clean, wet baking dish. Pour about a tablespoon of the batter into the pan, and spread it around like you would risotto. Cover the pan with clean dishcloth, and place in the oven. Bake rice cake for approximately 25 minutes, or until the cake is lightly golden. It should be slightly brown on the edges. Turn off the heat, and allow to cool at least 20 minutes. If the cake begins to stick to the pan, uncover and cook another 5 minutes. Remove to a rack to cool, and spread with a little pomegranate sauce. Serve warm.

title: Quinoa Salmon Patties
ingredients: 5 green cardamom pods, with some pods reserved ( see tips in introduction ) | 2 tablespoons finely grated fresh ginger | 240 g canned tuna steaks, well drained | 1 1/2 cups prepared tzatziki | 240 g canned low-sodium tuna steaks, drained | 240 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 240 g cherry tomatoes | 300 g dried quinoa, soaked until cold | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger ( optional ) | 150 g bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Note, to make tzatziki, combine the tzatziki and fish, and chill for 10 minutes. If using fresh tuna, cut into chunks. Add the cooked tuna to the tzatziki and refrigerate for 1 hour or until well chilled. Seahwhile, toast the cardamom pods in a dry frying pan until fragrant and beginning to turn golden. Be careful not to burn the spices, as they can easily scorch. Set aside. When cool, crush the pods with a mortar and pestle. Grind the ginger, with a pinch of cardamom, into a fine powder. Divide the tuna into four portions, and place each portion into a large, shallow pan. Add the tzatziki, tuna, tomatoes, and chiskey. Add the quinoa, ginger, and chocolate. Mix lightly.

title: Rice Flour Dumplings (Kon-Adrak)
ingredients: 1 large savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon rice flour | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon vegemite, melted | semolina ( as required )
instructions: Wash and shred the cabbage finely. Make sure all the water is absorbed. Mix together in a bowl with the rice flour, sugar, vegemite and enough water to form a soft dough.

title: Pasta With Chorizo and Sage
ingredients: 200 g dried penne pasta | 2 links chorizo sausage | fresh sage, chopped
instructions: Soak the chorizo in a little water until it takes on a little more moisture. Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling, salted water for about 10 minutes until al dente. Drain and then set the pasta to the side. When you are ready to serve, put your garlic chorizo on a plate, put a good grinding of sage over it, drizzle over the fat from the chorizo, and fry it in a little oil until it is browned some. Put your cooked pasta on the plate, and mix all the ingredients together. Top up with a little more fat and lots of sage if you wish, and serve the chorizo and sage separately.

title: Lebanese Green Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds green olives, halved and pitted | 2 tablespoons orange peel, finely grated | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Combine olives, orange peel, lemon juice, and allspice in a bowl. Cover, and chill in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Serve.

title: Yummie (Indonesian Bread)
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces yeast | 1 lb tofu, cubed | 1/4 lb margarine | 1/4 cup grated coconut | 1/4 cup crumbled pineapple ring | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 scallion, chopped | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in half a cup of warm water. Melt the margarine at a low heat and mix with other dry ingredients. Pour a small amount of the yeast mixture into the margarine/milk mixture and mix. Let proof. When you have a smooth dough, add tofu and mix. Shape into walnut sized balls, brush tops to allow for shrinkage. Sprinkle top with 1/4 cup of coconut, 2 t chopped green onions and 1 tsp garam masala. Bake the bread at 425f degrees for 10 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,cayenne powder,sea salt pepper,pineapple chunk,parmesan romano cheese
title: Pineapple Pesto
ingredients: 200 g pineapples, unsweetened | 1/2 cup grated parmesan-romano cheese | 1/2 cup thai sweet chili sauce ( store bought ) | 3 teaspoons sea salt and pepper | 1 pinch cayenne powder
instructions: Place the pineapples in a bowl with the cheese. Mix well with a fork or pestle. Add remaining ingredients, and blend well, using hands or food processor. Let sit 20 30mins to allow flavors to mix. Can be served cold, or warm, as a topping for your favourite pasta, or just as is.

title: Quick Chicken Veal Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 small ziti pasta or 1 small other bow tie pasta | 2 teaspoons cognac | 2 lbs flank steaks | vegetable oil ( for browning steak )
instructions: Rinse meat well. If using bow tie pasta drain and cut meat into 2 inch cubes. Spray a large skillet with vegetable oil spray. Add in steak cook and reduce to 1/2 inch cube. Add in ziti and brown for 3 minutes. Add in cognac and reduce to 1/2 cup or so. Add in steak in 1/2 inch squares and marinade for 1 hour in the refrigerator. The longer you marinade, the thicker your stew will absorb them and will become crusty. Turn meat and ziti and allow them to brown lightly. Note, if you do not have a steak pan, you can use a pot or stewpot and brown it in the oil for one hour. If you cut this into bite size squares, you can add 2 or 3 pieces of sirloin meat to the stew for added flavor.

title: Beef Brisket in Slow Cooker
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1 eggplant ( peeled ) | 1 yellow squash | 1 cup beef fat | 1 lb farfalle pasta | 1 peach
instructions: Drain beef and cut into serving sized pieces.. Place the bread crumbs on a plate and beat the eggplant into a bowl with a fork. Dip meat pieces into eggplant then dredge in the crumbs. Arrange beef in a slow cooker. Cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 3 hours. Remove beef pieces and discard all but 1/2 cup of fat in the slow cooker. Pare and chop the peach. Return the beef to the slow cooker. Drain the juice from the beef into the slow cooker.

title: Bread Crunchy
ingredients: 500 g bread flour | 100 g sunflower seeds | 200 g asparagus | 1 teaspoon bread flour
instructions: Soak the sunflower seeds in a little bit of boiling water. Cut the asparagus into small pieces, place in a bowl with the bread flour and mix well. Take a teaspoon of bread flour and mix into a ball shape and press into a round or square about 8 inches in diameter. Heat the oven to 230 degrees celcius. Cut into 2 inch squares. Place on an oven tray and bake for around 20 minutes.

title: Red Snapper With Caraway
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 lb red snapper fillet | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine caraway seed and mustard in a shallow bowl. Sprinkle fish with tabasco and add to pan. Bake until fish flakes easily with a fork, 18 to 20 minutes.

title: Swiss Chard Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, stems removed, chopped | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing, divided | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the swiss chard and 1 tablespoon of the italian dressing. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Lightly toss remaining 1 tablespoon italian dressing with the chard. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with poultry seasoning. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,mini chocolate chip,sprite,sauce,rye bread,rice wine vinegar,parmesan cheese,apple
title: Pavlova!
ingredients: 1/2 cup mini semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/4 cup seasoned rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons sprite | 1 large apple, cored and thinly sliced | 1 slice rye bread, cut into 1 inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, stir together the chocolate chip, rice wine vinegar, hot sauce, parmesan cheese, cream and Sprite. Spoon 1 tablespoon of this mixture into each slice of the bread. Place bread on a baking sheet and bake for 3 - 4 minutes, or until golden. Cool 5 minutes on wire rack.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,balsamic vinegar,pepperoni,canola oil,spaghetti,wheat flour,pineapple juice
title: Spinach & Pesto Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 cups baby spinach | 2/3 cup canola oil | 2/3 cup wheat flour | 1/3 cup pineapple juice ( or apple cider ) | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | cooked spaghetti, linguine, aspens
instructions: Cook and drain spaghetti. Wash spinach and drain well. Toss with remaining ingredients. Chill for 4 hours.

title: Savoury Vegetable Enchiladas
ingredients: 400 g savoy cabbage | 3 small turnips | 300 ml marsala wine | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 pinch ground saffron ( optional ) or 1 pinch ground turmeric ( optional ) | cherry juice or beer | tortilla ( optional )
instructions: Cut the cabbage into quarters. Cut two of the turnips in half, cut into quarters. Cut the two turni in half again, so you end up with a large long thin wedge of turnip. Wash the turnip and cut it to size roughly the cabbage, then cut it into very large chunks. Slice the turnip into a big dice. Put all the vegetables in a large saucepan and add the marsala and enough water to cover, the sugar if using. Add the bicarbonate soda, mace and saffron to taste. Stir occasionally so the bicarbonate stays in when the mixture starts boiling. If the mixture tastes too sour towards the end of the cooking, turn off the heat and give it a stir just to warm. Roll or lay 4 heaped tablespoons of the mixture into your tortillas, roll up from one end, securing with toothpicks that have been dipped in water. Put on a greased grill or a paper towel under a preheated grill. When the tortilla starts to crisp up, turn it over and give it another quick stir. Serve with cherry or beer.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,sesame oil,icing sugar,cinnamon,pink grapefruit,lamb chop
title: Mustard Seed Lamb Chops With Sesame Glaze
ingredients: 2 lambs chops ( about 300g each ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 175 g icing sugar | 250 g pink grapefruit ( rinsed )
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, crush mustard seeds and cinnamon in a heavy based frying pan. Gradually add 1 tbsp sesame oil and beat together. Add the chops and turn constantly until they are evenly coated in glaze. Cover with a lid and continue to cook over a gentle heat for 3 - 5 minutes. Turn chops and cook 2 - 3 minutes longer. Remove lid and continue to cook over a moderate heat for a further 2 - 3 minutes or until glaze just begins to bubble. Meanwhile scrape flesh from grapesfruit and remove any excess pulp. Place the grapefruit flesh in another pan and add 125g of icing sugar. Heat gently until icing syrups are completely dissolved and remove from the heat. Dip the chops into the icing, coating both sides well. Place in a large baking dish or pan and cover with the grapesfruit pulp. Put into a preheated oven at 220c/425f/gas 2 for 30 - 40 minutes until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: syrup,corn tortilla chip,date,wheat flour,scallop,raspberry,thai basil,pam cooking spray
title: Scallops With Fresh Raspberries
ingredients: 1 cup fresh raspberries or 1 cup frozen raspberries, thawed | 1/2 cup fresh thai basil | 3/4 cup maple syrup | 1 -3 cup shredded wheat flour | pam cooking spray | 1 package corn tortilla chips | 4 cups crushed maple flavoured scallops or 4 cups scallops | 1/2 cup thawed fresh raspberries or 1/2 cup frozen raspberries, thawed
instructions: Put thawed raspberries in a food processor and process to smooth. Add thawed basil, maple syrup and pulse until berries are pureed, scraping down sides as needed. Add 3/4 cup of the flour and process again until mixture is smooth. Spray pam in 8x8 inch baking dish. Pour pureed berries into baking dish and spread evenly. Arrange scallops over berries and sprinkle top with remaining 1/4 cup of the flour. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 24 hours. Remove from refrigerator fifteen minutes before baking. Bake uncovered in a 375 degree f oven until topping is golden brown, about 40 minutes. Cover and bake 30 minutes more. Meanwhile, prepare rauj, place 1 cup crushed tortillas and the maple flavoured scallops in a small mixing bowl. Dress with remaining 1/2 cup of maple flavoured liquid. Scoop hot scallop mixture evenly over scallops and arrange on warmed serving platter. Garnish with fresh raspberries. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,chili pepper flake,green chili pepper,graham cracker,vegetable oil,emmenthaler cheese,corn tortilla,club soda
title: Cheesy Meatball Submarine Sandwich
ingredients: 1 medium tomatoes, ripe, peeled, seeded, chopped | 1 fresh chili pepper, seeded and chopped, to taste | 3/4 green chili pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs ground pork loin | 1/2 cup graham cracker, grated ( about 10 crumbs ) | 3 teaspoons vegetable oil | 12 large corn tortillas | club soda, as needed | 1/2 cup shredded emmenthaler cheese or 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, for topping
instructions: Prepare grill. Make pickled tomatoes, in a bowl, combine tomato, chilli, green chili and graham crackers.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,arborio rice,swiss chard,onion,fennel seed,vital wheat gluten,golden raisin
title: Swiss Chard Risotto (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, crushed | 3 cans swiss chard, chopped, reserve liquid | 1 box italian-style breadcrumbs | 1/2 lb swiss chard ( not fresh ) | 1/2 cup sweet onion | 1 tablespoon vital wheat gluten
instructions: Heat raisins and fennel seed in 2 quart saucepan in reserved liquid. Remove stems from chard stalks and chop finely. Separate ribs from leaves and stalks by cutting off white layer. Slice ribs into 3 sections. Remove ribs from leaves. Cook chard and onion in 2 batches in a large saucepan of boiling salted water until just limp, about 2 hours. Stir chard and onions into chard, simmer 1 minute, then add greek 7 spice and stir. Add drained chard and rice to bowl of chard and chard mixture with 1/4 of reserved bean liquid. Mix well. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,paprika,tandoori paste,shrimp,sherry wine vinegar,onion soup mix,cashew nut
title: Prawns (Shrimp) with Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 12 large shrimp, peeled and de-veined | 1/4 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup fresh cashew nuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup tandoori paste
instructions: Place the shrimp in a large bowl with the sherry vinegar, paprika, ginger, soup mix, cashews, and tandoori paste. Mix thoroughly to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat a grill. Remove shrimp from the marinade.

title: Tuscany Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 cups cauliflower florets, blanched | 2 cans italian stewed tomatoes | 1/2 cup romano cheese
instructions: Cook the cauliflower for about 5 minutes, add drained tomatoes and heat over low heat. Add salt and pepper to taste. You can serve in bowls, with parmesan if desired. You can also use parmesean cheese to top casserole after rinsing the pan to ensure a nice crust for the last 15 minutes if not to sour your dish.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,cream cheese,red pepper flake,pomegranate juice
title: Pomegranate Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 jar roasted red peppers ( in olive oil ) | 2 packages cream cheese | 1/2 bottle pomegranate juice | lime juice
instructions: Heat red pepper in the microwave on low heat for 1 minute or until hot.

title: Amish Sweet Bread
ingredients: 1 lb raisins | 1 1/4 cups skim milk
instructions: Put the raisons in a heavy, clean saucepan and cover with cold water. This water should just cover the raisins. Bring to a simmer over a medium heat, stirring occasionally until the water is absorbed. If your raisins have swollen during this process, add a few tablespoons of the boiling water and stir constantly until you can see small holes in this. Add the milk and simmer until the milk is thick, about 10 minutes. Serve in sturdy mugs with lots of butter.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,salt,chipotle chile,water,pizza dough,triple sec,dark soy sauce,serrano chilies
title: Chipotle Stuffed Beef Pies
ingredients: 500 g roast beef | 200 g tri-tip beef | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 2 birdseye serrano chilies | 1 chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon salt | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Slice beef thinly and stuff each patty. Insert a slice of beef about one from the side of a serrano chile. Replace the meat and wrap the patty in aluminium foil. Place them on a plate in a roasting pan and pour over about water until they are 1 1/2” above the tops of the patty. Bake in an oven heated to 375°f for about 1 1/2 hours, or until they are cooked thoroughly and tender.

title: Burgers and Sausage Salad With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 cup bulgargur ( i like whole wheat ) | 2/3 cup low-fat yogurt, drained ( or low fat sour cream ) | 1/3 cup chopped peanuts | 1/3 cup chopped green onion | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried hot pepperoni sausage
instructions: Combine bulgur, yogurt, peanuts, green onions and pepperoni in serving bowl. Serve with a nice green salad or grilled burgers.

title: Salsa Mexicana (southwest Style)
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 3 serrano peppers, chopped
instructions: Put ingredients in a medium sized skillet. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

title: Pear Mushrooms from Bahrain
ingredients: 200 g cremini mushrooms | 6 dried pears | 1 teaspoon sumaq | 12 pitted dates
instructions: Soak dates and pears in water for 1 - 2 hours in a bowl. Boil them in water for 10 - 15 minutes, until they change color. Cut dates and pears into quarters. Soak mushrooms in boiling water for 1 - 2 hours, until soft and golden. Slice pears in half lengthwise, then remove stems of pears and slice into ¼ inch slices.

title: Veal with Cream
ingredients: 1 lb veal | 4 tablespoons whipping cream
instructions: Wipe meat off with a damp cloth, trim off excess fat, cut into 2 or 4 equal sized pieces, and roll each piece between the palms of your hands to a roll large enough to submerge meat completely. Roll each piece in cream and fasten with a tooth pick, then tie with string at intervals. Brown the rolls in a skillet over medium heat, turning as necessary, until lightly browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,superfine sugar,lime juice,clove,scotch bonnet pepper,wheat spaghetti,lasagna noodle,italian turkey sausage
title: Scotch Broetchen Noodles With Sausage and Apricot Compote
ingredients: 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 4 teaspoons lime juice, fresh, divided | 4 whole cloves | 2 teaspoons scotch bonnet peppers or 2 teaspoons habanero peppers, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 12 lasagna noodles ( whole wheat or gluten free ) | 2 cans apricot preserves | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Arrange a rack in the middle of the oven. Line a baking sheet with foil, letting the foil overhang the foil on the ends. For the compote mix the sugar, 4 teaspoons of the lime juice, and the cloves in a small bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to use. Using your fingers, tear the sausage into 1/4 inch pieces. Place a large skillet over medium heat. When it begins to shimmer, add the sausage, breaking it up with a spoon so the pieces don't clump together. Cook until golden brown, about 4 minutes. Add the remaining 1 teaspoons of lime juice, stir to combine, and set aside to cool slightly. To assemble the lasagna, place a layer of al dente pasta on the work surface. Spread or press a few apricot preserves into the bottom of each al dente glass. Top the al dente pasta with 1/2 cup pasta water, making sure to leave a 1/4 inch rim. Top with 2 noodles per plate, then one sausage piece, then the compote mixture. Repeat with remaining ingredients and the remaining 3 lasagna noodles, arranging them to completely enclose the top layer of compote. Dot with a spatula and cover the dish tightly with foil. Bake for 25 minutes. While the baking dish bakes, prepare the sauce. In a small saucepan, combine the remaining 1/3 cup of sugar with the lime juice and heat on low until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat. To serve, place the stuffed noodles in a large bowl, top with sauce, and serve warm.

title: Rosemary Crusted Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 tablespoons bacon fat | 3 cups chopped cooked chicken wings | 1/4 cup mini chocolate chip | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1/8 cup white chocolate chips, melted
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove bacon and set aside to cool slightly, reserving drippings in skillet. Pour off any fat from the skillet, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Mix in cooked chicken wings and 1/4 cup chocolate chips into the reserved drippings until coated. Pour remaining sauce and 1/8 cup white chocolate chips into the mixture. Heat and stir until hot. Turn off heat and allow mixture to stand just until chips melt. Sprinkle remaining 1/8 cup dark chocolate chips over mixture and set aside until melted, about 15 - 20 minutes. Heat remaining 1/8 cup of dark chocolate into the melted dark chocolate and stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: grape jelly,marjoram,salmon,artichoke heart,pimiento,asafoetida powder,granny smith apple
title: Smoked Salmon and Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless skinless salmon | 14 ounces jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained well with liquid squeezed out | 1 small granny smith apple, peeled, cored and chopped | 4 ounces jar pimiento, drained | 1 1/4 teaspoons sifted asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 package grape jelly, 1 envelope
instructions: Slice salmon into 1 inch squares and place in freezer for 30 minutes on a plate. Cut artichoke hearts into quarters and transfer to a large, well buttered casserole dish. Cut the apple, pimientos and asofetida into 1 inch pieces and add to casserole dish. Add the salt and pepper to taste. Drain the salmon on paper towels and add all the marinated artichoke hearts. Sprinkle with asafoetida and marjoram. Pour jelly over all and mix well. Refrigerate overnight. Grill on barbecue with mesquite grill lid closed for about 10 minutes. Remove foil and let sit 5 minutes before serving. Serve with fresh french fries.

Random Ingredients: glace cherry,almond,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red chili,black pepper,peanut butter
title: Spicy Hot Fudge
ingredients: 1 medium red chili, minced | 3 teaspoons minced almonds | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon freshly ground white pepper ( to taste ) | 2 -3 drops thiaway sweet red hot chili, minced | 1/2 teaspoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. If you don't have thiaway hot chili, it can be subed to 1/4 hot pepper for some other flavour as well. Put into fridge while you make the fudge.

title: Peanut and Walnut Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles | 2 cups walnuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook noodles according to package directions. Drain thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Transfer to a serving dish. Serve.

Random Ingredients: soy margarine,baby spinach leaf,coriander seed,chuck roast,calvados,shiitake mushroom
title: Smoky Beef and Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy margarine | 1/2 cup calvados | 1 cup fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 cup baby spinach leaves
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 to 1 1/2 inch cubes and place in a shallow dish. Combine the soy margarine and calvados in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,chicken thigh,brown lentil,red cabbage,deli ham,baking soda,romaine lettuce,ramen noodle
title: Quick, Hearty, and Healthy Turkey Noodle Soup
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 2 packages top ramen noodles, crushed | 3 cups cooked ham, cubed | 1 can chicken thighs, drained and finely chopped | 6 cups thinly sliced red cabbage | 1 package brown lentils, rinsed and picked over | 3 teaspoons baking soda | 6 romaine lettuce - washed, dried, and torn into bite-sized pieces
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, combine tomatoes and ramen noodles. Bring to a simmer and cook noodles until softened. Stir in ham, chicken, cabbage and lentils and stir until heated through. In a small bowl, stir together baking soda and 1/2 cup water until dissolved. Add baking soda mixture and stir until incorporated. Divide ramen noodle mixture among 8 soup bowls. Top each with noodle mixture and garnish with romaine.

title: Garden Fresh Vegetable Pasta and Currants
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh beet, about 2 | 1 package pasta, uncooked | 1 large cup frozen mixed garden fresh veg, ( such as veal or chicken )
instructions: Wash and pick through the beets and place in a large soup pot. Put in the peas when you are done. Add the veg and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Simmer until the vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes. Drain well and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,pepper flake,hash brown potato,orange juice zest,ginger ale,asparagus spear,lime zest,chocolate chip
title: Orange-Ginger Sassy Chocolate and Asparagus Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs asparagus spears | 1 lime, zest of, grated | 1 orange, juice & zest of, grated | 1 lime, zest of, grated | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate chips, chopped | 4 cups hash brown potatoes ( about 1-1/2 lbs ) | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Wash the asparagus well and cut off the tips about 1/2 to 3/4 inch into the middle. Cut each spear up like you would for a baby.

Random Ingredients: cocoa mix,pork shoulder,red wine,salt black pepper,guacamole
title: Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch pieces | 4 ounces mild paprika ( not sweet, if using hot, decrease amount to 3 tablespoons but adjust to sweet ) | 1 cup dry red wine | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa mix | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan, combine the pork pieces with water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender enough to pull apart with a fork but not falling apart, about 10 minutes. Drain, reserving the water. Place the pork in a large freezer bag and freeze for about 20 minutes. Remove the cubes of pork from the bag, reserving the water and cooking liquid. When ready to serve, remove the pork from the refrigerator and cut into 1 inch cubes. Transfer the pork to a large bowl. Pour the reserved cooking water off of the pork and discard. Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Add the paprika, wine and cocoa mix to the pork chunks in the pot, adding the reserved cooking liquid. Place pork in a roasting or casserole dish. Cover the pork with foil and bake for 1 hour and 40 minutes. Take the foil off, stir the meat and re bake for 1 1/2 hours. Remove the meat and vegetables from the liquid. Allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Tender Herbed Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking tapioca | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 -2 teaspoon mixed herbs | 2 teaspoons potato starch | 1 small broccoli floret | 4 -6 fillets
instructions: Mix 1 tbsp cooking tapioca, 1 tbsp potato starch, mixed herbs and 2 tsp potato starch together. Stir the potato starch into the tapioca mix to make a runny paste. Coat broccoli with the tapioca mix and place it in a steamer. Cover and steam for about 10 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Heat another wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Coat the pan with cooking spray. Coat one piece of fillet in the tapioca mix and put it in the pan. Cook another couple of minutes. Place fillet in the steamer and top with the broccoli.

title: Smushi Rice
ingredients: 4 cups plain steamed basmati rice | 2 cups sliced cabbage | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oil | 1/2 cup crushed cheese | 1 jar imitation crabmeat, cut into pieces | 2 bottles beer, room temperature | 1 tablespoon dried mint, crushed
instructions: Steam rice until tender, about 20 minutes. Combine cabbage, crabmeat, oil, cheese, rice, beer and mint in a large bowl stir well. Garnish with more mint.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,cilantro,garlic salt,water chestnut,egg noodle,yellow pea,dill weed
title: Adobo Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 bunch fresh dill weed, chopped | 1/4 cup yellow split peas | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions in water, drain. Combine with next 6 ingredients in a large bowl and toss well. Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: leek,green bean,beef steak,margarine,poppy seed,oyster sauce,cooking apple
title: Beef Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 green beans, cut diagonally into 1/2 inch diagonal slices ( or beans of choice ) | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 cooking apple, thinly sliced | 1 leek, diced
instructions: Cut the beef lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices and set aside. In a large skillet brown the beef strips and 1 tablespoon margarine, browning the beef for 3 minutes. Remove to a plate and cover to keep warm. In the same skillet, saute the onions for 3 minutes add the green beans, poppy seeds, oyster sauce and apple and mix well. Return the beef and any accumulated juices to the skillet, cover the skillet and simmer until beef is fully cooked.

title: Garlicky Oven Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 lb ocean spray or 1 lb grouper | 1 egg | 1 lb aubergine | 1 english cucumber | 1/2 lemon, zest of
instructions: Cut the aubergine in half lengthways and score a cross on its side of the fish to vent steam. Spray a non stick frypan and cook the aubergines on a medium/high heat about 7 minutes until soft but not brown. Remove to a plate. Cut the cucumber in half lengthways and slice into very thin sticks approximately 1/2cm wide. Whisk the egg and lemon zest together in a large bowl and season. Drain the fish and pat dry with paper towel. Cut the fish into very thin slices. Using the same pan, lightly spray the fish with water. Place the fish on top of the aubergines and then add the potato chips and toss until the chips are coated well. Top with the potato chips or drizzle with olive oil. Place under a preheated grill for 6 - 8 minutes, turning frequently. Serve.

title: Quick Microwave Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups arborio rice | 3/4 cup cake flour | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Place in a 9 inch round glass baking dish sprayed with pam. Top evenly with extra melted chocolate, if desired.. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave on high 20 to 25 minutes, or until rice has absorbed all of the juices. Let set 20 minutes.

title: Auberge Starbucks' Sweet and Sour Mini-Muffins
ingredients: 400 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/2 cup water | 120 g roasted unsalted peanuts | 1 pizza crust dough, pre-made, with a 'quick'crust, if available | 1 ounce powdered milk ( can use fat-free icing )
instructions: Whisk flour& coffee, add water until it starts to look like a loose paste. Stir in chopped peanuts spread dough, make sure it comes onto a baking tray lined with baking paper cover with lid or parchment paper. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Cardamom Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin, halved | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod ( optional but highly recommended to use )
instructions: Rinse raisins under running water. Place the raisins in a medium saucepan. Pour enough boiling water over the raisins to cover and let stand overnight. Rinse again. Drain well and spread over a piece of parchment paper or waxed paper. Keep halved if using. Sprinkle tops with ground cardamom. This Halwa can be made 3 days in advance and kept covered in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,chicken stock vegetable,cream,avocado oil,rump roast,lemon zest,mustard
title: Salted Beef Au Jus
ingredients: 500 g rump roast ( prime rib ) | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup light cream | 1 tablespoon palm sugar or 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1/3 cup avocado oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c, place meat in a roasting dish, fat side up. Combine stock, mustard and zest, pour over meat. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours or more until tender, basting every 15 minutes. While meat is cooking place cream, sugar, and olive oil in a small saucepan and bring to the boil. Pour warm cream mixture over meat. Bake uncovered for a further 30 minutes, basting every 20 minutes or so. If roast is very lean, place in baking dish to rest for 10 minutes, then remove and slice meat across into thick pieces. Transfer to serving platter and put aside. Pour cream sauce over meat and serve immediately.

title: Pease Pudding from Scratch
ingredients: 250 g frozen peas, thawed | 1 red onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon rose water | 100 -150 ml double cream
instructions: Place the peas, onion and rose water in a large dish.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,sharp cheddar cheese,tamarind paste,bing cherry,kidney bean,pimiento,vodka
title: Nacho Kidney Bean and Dressing
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 jar pimento stuffed olives, drained and quartered | 1 can pitted kalamata olives, drained and halved | 1 jar pimientos, drained and sliced | 1 can tamarind paste | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Combine everything in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium low heat for about 20 minutes, or until flavors are blended and smooth.

title: Chinese Style Pearl Onions
ingredients: 1 lb pearl onion, peeled | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 cup pecans
instructions: Chop onions the thick slices. Heat oil/margarine in a wok or frying pan until smoking. Add all remaining ingredients except pecans and fry, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Cool to room temperature and slice thin, leaving pecans in whole, or to your preference, and toss with onions. Serve in a pita.

title: Berry Mint Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups mixed dried blueberries, white berry or 2 cups wild berries | 3 ounces fresh blueberries, from a jar | 8 large maraschino cherries | 1 1/2 teaspoons grenadine | mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Pour the berries into a blender or food processor and pulse a few times until coarsely chopped. Add the remaining ingredients. Pulse until well combined. Store in a glass jar at room temperature up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,wild rice,potato,salt,chipotle chile adobo,bouillon cube,biscuit mix
title: Mexican Potatoes With Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuit mix | 1 cup sweet potato, cubed | 1 1/2 cups wild rice, cooked and cooled | 3 cups instant bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1 teaspoon minced chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Prepare biscuit mix with biscuit mix according to package directions. Combine sweet potatoes with rice, bouillon cubes, salt, vanilla, and chile in a large bowl. Dived biscuit mix into 8 portions. Spoon each portionful onto a lightly greased baking sheet, making 12 individual pieces. Bake at 400 degrees f, until golden brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Alva's Carnitas
ingredients: 1 can pork spareribs ( carnitas ) | 12 -18 corn tortillas | 4 teaspoons dried marjoram | 6 -8 cups corn flakes | aluminum foil ( for frying tortillas )
instructions: Slice the meat into thin strips and brown the pork in a skillet with 2 tablespoons of oil. Drain off excess fat. In a shallow bowl mix all of the dry ingredients. Coat the cornflakes with cornflakes and fold them in the meat mixture. Fold in all of the cornflakes and put the meat into a 9x13 baking pan. Cover with aluminum foil and put pan under the broiler for 10 - 15 minutes or until the meat is cooked. Note, corn tortillas can be placed on the counter and warmed in the microwave to soften up a bit. This method produces a crispy crispy texture to the meat. You may also put the cornflakes in a blender or food processor and pulse until they are the texture of scrambled eggs. Serve meat and carnitas over rice.

title: Grilled Salmon With Tomatillo Tomatillo Soup
ingredients: 2 fresh tomatillos, husked, washed, and cut into very thin slices ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 can vegetable stock ( low sodium, high fiber ) | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh italian-style bread, finely sliced ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat an indoor or outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate. Arrange tomatillos flat in a single layer on a cutting board. Grill tomatillos, turning once, until lightly marked and tender, 12 to 15 minutes total. Transfer tomatillos and tomatillos to a large bowl.

title: Indian-Style Scallion Relish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon whole cardamom seed | 1/4 cup finely chopped bell pepper
instructions: Grind cardamom and whole cardamom to a fine powder and set aside. Place remaining cardamom in a small bowl. Add bell pepper and toss to coat evenly in bell pepper grease. Transfer pepper to a plastic bag and let sit for 15 minutes before discarding cardamom mixture. Cover bag loosely with a kitchen towel and place inside a shallow tray. Microwave on high uncovered 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: oregano,vanilla sugar,cracker crumb,tomato,five spice powder,chicken breast half,onion,italian sausage
title: Italian Sweet-Sour Sausage Chicken
ingredients: 4 tablespoons italian sausage, sliced | 1 tablespoon instant minced onion | 1 tablespoon instant minced onion | 1 lb chicken breast half, thinly sliced | 1 can tomatoes, drained, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons cracker crumbs | powdered sugar
instructions: Cook the sausage in a sauté pan.

title: Cream Stuffed Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 jar grape leaves, washed well, dried, with 1/8 cup water squeezed out, dry and stems removed | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1/2 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( not flavored with salt ) | 1 -2 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: In a small pan, bring 1/8 cup water and wine to a boil. Using tongs or a strainer, gently squeeze out excess liquid to drain, then add grape leaves and set aside. In a small bowl, stir together cream and bread crumbs. Stir into grape leaves and gently place on parchment lined baking sheets. Add a few drops of tabasco to taste and sprinkle top of leaves generously with this mixture. Bake in a 450 degree oven for 2 or three minutes until bubbly and lightly browned. Serve at once.

title: Hot and Sour Vegetables with Japanese Eggplant (Satsushi)
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants | 250 -500 g lamb or 250 -500 g chicken ( depending on your tastes ) | 2 celery ribs | 1 dried hot pepper | 500 ml of thickened cream or 1 pint of thick sour cream, you may also want to use real sour cream if your taste buds do not like sweet, sour flavour | 1 bay leaf | mixed up serving, sliced meat, sliced cabbage ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice the stem end off of the eggplants and discard. Cut 1/2 x 1 cm slices of eggplant on each side. Cut the slices into slices about 2 cm wide. Cut 1/2 celery stalk into 1cm slices. Wash all your vegetables well. Cut the meat into matchstick sized pieces. Boil the cream, add the meat and cook over very low heat for about 40 - 45 minutes until it has thickened up a little. While the meat is cooking, cook the eggplant slices in plenty of boiling water or under cold water until cooked, drain and slice as thinly as possible. Keep warm. When the meat is done cooking, add the eggplant slices and celery to the soup. Cut the hot pepper into small pieces and add them to the soup as well. Add a bay leaf, cream, salt and pepper to taste. The hot pepper can be adjusted to suit your tastes. Serve with rice, but don't be too generous with hot pepper just use as a topping for a little taste.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,cola,pancake syrup,sugar cube,splenda sugar substitute,saffron thread,beef tenderloin steak
title: Saffron Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup cola | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread | 2 lbs boneless chicken legs | 1/4 cup pancake syrup | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, cut into 1/2 by 1/2 inch slices ( or flank steak ) | 1 knorr cola beer & pineapple flavored beverage ( i used r & b )
instructions: Combine 6 tablespoons cola, 1/2 teaspoon saffron, and 3/4 cup water in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Add the chicken, coating it fully in cola marinade. Place chicken in pan. Cover and allow to cook for 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Preheat oven to 450°f. In a small bowl, combine the pancake syrup and splenda. In a separate small bowl, combine the remaining cola and pineapple flavored beverage. To serve, arrange the chicken, breast side up, on a serving platter and spoon the beverage over it, placing a small plate on top of the plate.

Random Ingredients: almond,chili,ancho chile powder,apricot,lemon zest,wine,ginger garlic paste
title: Chili Nuts
ingredients: 6 dried ancho chiles | 1 tablespoon fresh chili | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup blanched almond ( or roasted ground nuts ) | 6 tablespoons red wine or 6 tablespoons white grape juice | 2 tablespoons fresh paprika or 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder
instructions: Place the ancho chiles on a dry skillet and toast over low to medium heat, turning occasionally, until fragrant and beginning to smoke, stirring often, about 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove chiles and set aside. Soak the chili in hot water until softened enough to break into small pieces, about 1 1/2 minutes. Drain the chiles and discard soaking liquid. Place the chili in a food processor and puree. Set aside. Combine the chili soaking liquid, ginger garlic paste, almonds and red wine. Season with paprika. Stir to blend. Dough can be used immediately or refrigerated for 2 days before using to make the chili nuts. Store in the refrigerator in a airtight container.

title: Pizzas with Eggs (Antilles) in Pink Sauce
ingredients: 6 medium hard-boiled eggs, peeled and chopped | 1/2 lb prosciutto ham or 1/2 lb provolone cheese, thinly sliced | 1/4 lb salami, diced thinly or 1/4 lb thin sliced ham | white vinegar, enough to cover the ham | tortilla, warmed, as needed
instructions: Toss the first five ingredients together, then pour vinegar over and stir well to combine. Spread a tablespoon of the ham in the middle of each tortilla. Slice the other tablespoon of ham across the filling and arrange on top of the ham. Wrap individually in paper towel and place on a baking sheet. Place in a 400 f oven until the tops of the pizzas are golden, about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salsa verde,yellow pepper,grapefruit juice,lemon juice,thyme leaf,pepper sauce,pimiento,lemon zest
title: Grapefruit Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces grapefruit juice | 1 1/2 cups mild salsa verde, divided | 1/2 cup pimentos | 4 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, minced or 2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 4 tablespoons canned diced pimiento, drained ( optional )
instructions: Drain grapefruit juice to remove any excess juice. Combine grapefruit juice with 3/4 cup of salsa verde, 1/2 cup pimentos, lime juice, lemon zest, thyme, hot pepper sauce, and pimentos in a large salad bowl. Toss to mix well. Stir remaining salsa verde and pimentos into grapefruit mixture. Refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight to blend flavors.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 3 cups lettuce | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 package linguine
instructions: Place lettuce leaves in separate dishes and arrange them in the center of each plate. Warm the yogurt in a saucepan over low heat. Place linguines into hot yogurt and place 3 or 4 into each plate. Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Easy Sausages (Or Kangaroo Fingers)
ingredients: 1 pint bamboo shoots, well drained | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the sausages into 3 cm lengths and set aside. Brush the sausages with beaten egg, sprinkle with salt and pepper then set on a sheet of foil. Slice the bamboo shoots lengthwise to make thinner slanted slices. Broil for 2 - 3 minutes until they turn golden, turning from time to time, until crisp and cooked through.

title: The Easiest Focaccia Recipe
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces white flour | 5 1/2 ounces liquid smoke, smoke ( i 'd use mesquite )
instructions: Mix the white flour and liquid smoke in a large bowl. Sprinkle the dough lightly with dry flour, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 2 hours. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Take the dough out of the refrigerator, and shape it into long long, very thin ropes about 4 long. Roll each rope out to about 1/8 thick. Cut each rope into 8 - 3 inch long strips. Cut the strips crosswise into 4 pieces, and place them on the prepared baking sheet. Cook for about 40 minutes in a preheated oven to 425 degrees f. Serve warm, or at room temperature.

title: Lola's Sticky Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus | butter or olive oil | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 packages ladyfingers
instructions: Slice the ends off the asparagus and remove most of the softer bits where the tips tend to form. Slice the ends into bite size pieces. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Pour enough butter or olive oil in a roasting pan to reach about 1/2 inch from the top. Place the asparagus in the pan and rub with olive oil. Arrange the ladyfingers on top. Sprinkle maple syrup over the top of the ladyfingers. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly browned.

title: Glogg
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gochujang ( grapeseed ) | 1 cup blanched almond | 1/3 cup finely chopped cilantro stems | 1/2 teaspoon anise essence | 1 small bosc pear, quartered cored, seeded, and quartered or 1 small other fruit ( 1 cup )
instructions: Finely grind all ingredients. Toss with fruit and refrigerate. The idea is to provide additional flavour, but not to overpowering.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,mango,seasoning salt,tomato juice,bean sprout,pimiento,chicken stock,garlic paste
title: The Mango Chili
ingredients: 400 g mangoes | 400 g bean sprouts | 1/2 chopped pimiento | 3 -4 pinches chili sauce | 3 pinches seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons tomato juice or 2 tablespoons white wine | 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 2 teaspoons garlic paste
instructions: Start by preparing all the ingredients and chopping up the mangoes. Cut the mangoes in half or you can cut it very small if you are concerned about bugs either. Blend the mangoes with all the other ingredients and serve over freshly made toast, rice or pasta. Garnish with red pepper flakes or cayenne pepper from your favourite chili. Serve immediately.

title: Jamaican Chili Paste
ingredients: 2 cups sherry | chili pepper, to taste
instructions: Blend the ingredients.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,wheat bread,romaine lettuce leaf,cream mushroom soup,corn tortilla chip
title: Smothered Mushrooms on Crostini
ingredients: 12 corn tortilla chips | 3 button mushrooms, sliced | 2 -3 teaspoons cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup shredded fresh leaf romaine lettuce leaf | 6 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Spray an 11x7 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Lay 1 tortilla chip on the bottom and 1/6 of the mushrooms in the center. Top with half of the cream of mushroom soup. Repeat layers of tortilla chips, mushrooms and soup. Top with lettuce. Turn heat on stove top to medium high. Cook 10 minutes, or until hot, and cheese melts. Cut into sixths and serve on toasted crostini.

title: Quick and Easy Calzones
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 cans sliced mushrooms, drained | 1 package shredded pizza cheese | 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente, drain.

title: Omelette Quebec City Style (With Wine)
ingredients: 8 ounces egg whites | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 tablespoon wine or 1 tablespoon port wine | 2 slices canadian bacon, 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place egg whites in a clean bowl, gradually add canadian bacon slices. Mix lightly until the whites stick to the bowl. Fold in wine as mixture begins to form ribbons, but don't allow to form clumps. Spread mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes, until golden and set. Remove from oven, sprinkle on any remaining crouton, and serve with your favourite chutney alongside.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,green cardamom pod,mustard powder,grand marnier
title: Theatre Épices (Spiced Mustard) by Sy
ingredients: 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1 stick green cardamom pods | 1 - 2 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Blend the sugar and the cardamom pods with the dry mustard powder. Add the grand marnier and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,new potato,mustard powder,tapioca,canadian bacon,bacon
title: Crispy Canadian Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds new potatoes | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules ( or mushroom powder ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/2 pound canadian bacon, finely chopped | 3 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 2 tablespoons canadian bacon, crumbled
instructions: Slice potatoes into 1/4 inch rounds. Place in a 9x13 inch pan and cover with salted water. Add bouillon and mustard powder. Bring to a simmer and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 450 degrees f. Remove lid and bake for 10 minutes for potatoes to be crisp and brown. Meanwhile, cook bacon in a skillet until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet and crumble. Stir bacon into potatoes along with the crumbled bacon and canadian bacon. Spread on foil covered baking sheet, and bake for another 10 minutes at 450 degrees f. For another minute or so to brown the bacon.

title: Chili Con Pasta Salad With Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 bottle chili | 2 tri-color spiral pasta ( fettuccine ) | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1 loaf crusty bread, cut into 1/2 & quot, cubes ( about 6 cups ) | 2 cups chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 lb roasted salted fettuccine
instructions: Boil the pasta til al dente, drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Mix pasta with chili, coriander, basil, bread, walnuts and vinegar. Garnish with roasted peanuts.

title: Refried Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 pound dried pinto beans | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place the pinto beans into a large container, and cover with several inches of cool water.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,allspice,seasoning salt,chicken breast,tangerine juice,shiitake mushroom,watermelon,milk chocolate
title: Linda's Chicken Tangerine Nests
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage, sliced thin | 20 shiitake mushrooms, sliced thin ( optional ) | 1/2 cup watermelon, diced | 1/2 cup tangerine juice | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1 1/4 lbs boneless chicken breasts or 1 1/4 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/4 x 3/4 inch pieces | 1/2 cup milk chocolate
instructions: Remove and discard leaves.

title: Mexican Style Lasagna
ingredients: 8 lasagna sheets | 1 jar diced pimento peppers | 1 jar diced baking potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place baking potato on a baking square or glass baking dish. Sprinkle with pimentos and bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until potatoes are soft and starting to brown. In a large bowl, stir together diced baking potatoes and diced pimentos. Spread potato mixture evenly over the top of the lasagna sheets. Cover with aluminum foil, and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove aluminum foil, and top with more pimento if desired.

title: Quatre Épices (French Pear Compote)
ingredients: 8 pears | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Peel pears and cut into half on the diagonal. Cut pears lengthwise in half on each pole. Place pears in baking dish with thyme leaves, cayenne and enough water to cover. Sprinkle with black pepper. Cover and place in refrigerator for 48 hours, or until the pears are very tender.

title: Sweet Heat & Low Fat Maple Smoked Beef Kebobs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons currants | 1 tablespoon dried chicken stock or 1 tablespoon reduced-sodium broth | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon dried yellow bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Prepare honey mustard barbecue or grill. In a small bowl combine syrup, currants, stock or broth, ketchup, liquid smoke and yellow pepper. Whisk the ingredients together until combined. Transfer barbecue / grill to high heat source, heat for 1 to 2 minutes, turning to coat both sides. Watch carefully for flare ups.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,simple syrup,picante sauce,hard egg
title: Easy Restaurant-Style Mexican Quiche
ingredients: 4 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese ( low sodium ) | 4 eggs ( or 3 egg whites for 1 cup of mixture ) | 26 ounces picante sauce | 1 can reduced-fat fat fat half-and-half or ( 10 ounce ) can low-fat half-and-half | 1 medium hard-boiled egg, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. If there is such a quiche pan as nesquik, fill it 2/3 full with the ingredients. Bake until top is lightly browned and set, 10 to 12 minutes. Turn over onto a rack to cool for 10 minutes. If there is a quiche pan with a handle on top, remove from oven and allow to cool for 10 minutes before inverting onto a plate. If you wish to serve quiche as a side dish, remove to a serving plate and arrange slices of hard boiled egg on top of quiche. If desired, serve as a garnish with shredded low fat cheddar cheese and sliced ripe olives. Make ahead, the recipe can be made and refrigerated, covered, for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,rutabaga,lemon zest,fatty bacon,meat,lime leaf,grain white rice
title: Rutabaga Rice With Lemons and Smoked Bacon
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 2 slices fatty bacon ( not maple ) | 1 slice smoked fatty bacon | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 2 1/2 cups meat, diced ( from turkey ) | 2 large rutabagas, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes or 6 -8 pieces rutabagas, of your choice | 2 fresh lime leaves, cut into thin slices
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water. Place the uncooked rice in a medium size, heavy saucepan with just enough water to cover the bottom. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat. Cover and simmer until the rice is almost tender and the water has been absorbed, about 20 minutes. In a large skillet, cook the bacon, fat, onion and lemon zest over medium heat until the bacon is browned and the onion has softened, about 5 minutes. Drain the fat. Stir the rice and bacon mixture into the skillet with the cooked onion mixture. Add the meat, rutabagas and lime leaves and stir to blend well. Remove from heat. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,sharp cheddar cheese,yellow bell pepper,apple cider,carrot,hot pepper flake,ciabatta
title: German Grilled Cheese on Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 1 ciabatta, loaf | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced | 2 carrots, scrubbed and sliced into rounds | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 cup apple cider | 2 tablespoons hot pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Cut the ciabatta loaf into small wedges and place on the hot grill. Cut the bell pepper into thin slivers and cover with a plate with aluminum foil. Bake until bread is dry and is slightly toasted, about 10 minutes. Set oven to broil. Place carrots and cheese on a baking sheet. In a small bowl, combine sugar, apple cider and hot pepper flakes.

title: Vegetable Mix With Avocado
ingredients: 2 lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons sultanas or 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 8 button mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons parsley flakes | 3 slices avocados | 1 tablespoon table salt
instructions: Tear lettuce if large leaves from large bunch of chickele leaves. Gently combine all ingredients. To serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,channa dal,beef chuck roast,polenta,wheat bread flour,coriander,breadcrumb,italian breadcrumb
title: Beef Polenta & Chana Dal Burgers
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast or 1 similar leaner | 1 can tomato sauce ( use a good quality brand, we prefer contadina brand ) | 1/3 cup channa dal | 3/4 cup whole wheat bread flour ( or whole rice flour ) | 1 1/2 cups light italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 cup dried breadcrumbs ( or whole wheat bread ) | 1/2 cup unseasoned breadcrumbs | 8 ounces polenta ( or other whole wheat bread flour )
instructions: If using chuck roast, cut into 1/4 inch pieces. If using lean roast, remove visible fat. Cover roast and any juices with tomato sauce. In a large pot, combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. Turn down to medium low or medium low and simmer at least for 1 hour. If the mixture is not thick enough, add a little water or stock, stirring it constantly. Serve as is, or shape into patties, or fry, or fry in the olive oil until crisp and brown. If you are using beef, cut into 1/4 inch slices and brown in a frying pan. If you are using lamb, fry it in the olive oil, and if you are using pork, heat them in a frying pan. Serve with a side of cooked polenta or bread. The recipe editor, if using lean cutlets or hamburgers, use the flat blade on a benchtop grater. If using lean beef, use one of the patties that has been cut into 1/4 to 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Fish Fillets on Artichoke Hearts With Artichokes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white flour | 3 1/2 ounces artichoke hearts ( pre-sauteed with a touch of butter or olive oil added )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f in a small baking dish, mix together the flour and the artichoke hearts. Dip the fish fillets in the flour and artichoke mixture.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,banana leaf,banana,spanish onion,apricot,lemon juice zest,rice,red wine
title: Fruit Salad with Rice Croutons
ingredients: 5 cups rice, cooked ( see notes in description ) | 1/2 cup dried apricot, chopped | 4 bananas, sliced | 1 large spanish onion, peeled and sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons red wine | 1 3/4 cups sugar-free bananas or 1 3/4 cups maple syrup | vanilla essence | 2 -4 teaspoons grated lemon juice or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. Allow to cool and add apricots and mix. In a large bowl, layer all ingredients until all is used. Note, if you find the rice difficult to mix properly, you may need to use a pastry or vegetable peeler to do the job. Sprinkle any remaining fruit onto top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,oyster sauce,arugula,spring onion,palm oil,salt pepper,shrimp paste,green curry paste
title: Green Lettuce With Spring Onion
ingredients: 500 g shrimp paste | 3 spring onions | 100 g palm oil or 100 g vegetable oil | salt & pepper | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 4 cups lettuce | 1 cup arugula
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients except lettuce, arugula and shrimp. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Slice all lettuce leaves into a large square, 2 inches long and remove the choke. Serve with shrimp mixture and lettuce salad in a salad bowl, garnished with spring onions.

title: Vegetable Samosas(Gomen Ka Kaengali)
ingredients: 1/2 lb daikon radish | 1 turnip | 1/2 leek | 1 cardamom pod
instructions: Clean the daikon and turnip with cold water until the water runs clear but no dirt remains. Peel off the outer white pith. Cut off the top and remove any dark inner leaves and the hard rib. Slice into 1/4 inch rounds and place a few in a plastic bag, seal and let marinade in the refrigerator overnight.. Slice the turnip into 1/4 inch thick diagonal slices and place a few on a tray and sprinkle with salt. Slice the leek thinly and place 3 in the center of each slice. Slice the yellow turnip into 1/4 inch thick rounds and place 4 in a large bag. Remove any dark inner leaves in the bag. Slice the radish diagonally across into 1/4 inch slices and place 4 on top and sprinkle with salt. Slice the turnip diagonally across into 1/4 inch thick slices and place 4 on top of the turnip. Slice the cardamom pod and place 1 on top of the turnip.

title: Gorgonzola Soup With Sage Sage
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled ( about 1 1/2 cups, cut into small pieces ) | 3/4 cup fresh sage, finely minced | 2 cups fish sauce | 1 bay leaf | 3 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Toast the sage in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring often until wilted but not browned and fragrant. Transfer to mortar to release all traces of the oils released from the sage and return the mixture to pan. Add the cheese, sage and fish sauce. Bring to a boil over medium heat and reduce heat to low. Cook, stirring constantly so the mixture doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan, for 30 minutes or until the gorgonzola melts into fine, well stirred pieces. Remove from the heat and serve with the bay leaf and ghee.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,lemon extract,baby spinach leaf,wheat pastry flour,chunky salsa
title: Spinach Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 4 2 tablespoons fresh tamarind paste or 5 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | salt and chile salsa
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons each of the tamarind and chili powder in the microwave for just a minute or two at a time. Remove from microwave and stir until smooth. Set aside. In a large, shallow dish, stir together the flour and spinach leaves. In another dish, mix the remaining 3 tablespoons of tamarind paste with the lemon extract and mix well. Sprinkle the seasoned flour mixture over the spinach and mix well again. Dip your hands in water and spread the dough out thinly onto a nonstick pizza pan or baking sheet. Spread all of the spinach mix over the dough. Sprinkle with salt. Cover with a second sheet of parchment paper on top, slightly wetting the parchment if it crisaches. Using your fingers, press together the edges of the parchment paper around the perimeter of the spinach to seal it. Use a sharp knife to score the top of the parchment covered pizza pan with an x or star shaped pattern. Poke the top of the pan with a toothpick in the way you want to insert the filling. Place the pizza pan on a cookie sheet and let it rest for 30 minutes. When the hour is up, preheat the oven 375 and bake the spinach tacos for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown on top. Serve hot with chunky salsa.

title: Peachy Chili Powder
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces hot red chili, chopped | 1 jar crushed pecans
instructions: Pit dry a hot red chili. Place in a clean, dry glass jar or other container with a tight fitting lid that has been filled with water. Turn on the stove to medium high and stir chiles slowly from time to time until the chili reaches a temperature of 230oc for about 15 minutes. Take off heat and stir in crushed pecans. Let the chili cool slightly.

title: Carryback (Canadian)
ingredients: 1 lb lump crabmeat | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Mix all together and place in a 9x13 inch pan or crockpot. Cover and cook in your crockpot for 2 hours on high. Cook on low or low setting for 8 - 12 hours. This recipe doubles or triples to make 8 servings.

title: Tail Burner
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive, finely minced ( optional ) | 1 envelope instant espresso coffee | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon ale ( optional ) | 1/4 cup butter | 4 fillets rainbow trout
instructions: In a small bowl, mix marinade ingredients. Rinse and pat fish dry. Rub spice mixture into fish.

title: Smoky Refreshing Fig (SMS)!
ingredients: 8 dried figs, stemmed removed ( or fresh if using fresh figs ) | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo ( canned chipotle can ) | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 3 -4 tablespoons meat fat, heated
instructions: Soak figs over night remove skins and stems. Cook figs in enough hot fat to cover for 1 - 2 hours, turning several times. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons of water, vinegar, and chipotles.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,chocolate,fruit,sherry wine vinegar,black olive,white wine vinegar,cherry
title: Italian Hot Chocolate Shots
ingredients: 12 ounces semisweet chocolate | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 cup dried fruit, chopped ( like prunes, apricots, apples, applesauce, berries, or pineapple ) | 14 ounces chocolate, chopped | 2 cups cherries, pitted and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Heat chocolate in microwave or saucepan over medium heat until smooth. Add vinegar and stir, about 1 minute. Cool slightly. Fold in fruit and baking soda. Cover and refrigerate until mixture firms up slightly, about 1 hour. Stir every 30 seconds.

title: Simple Chocolate Macaroons
ingredients: 10 ounces chocolate cookie crumbs, fine | 1 cup coconut, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Line 2 cookie sheets with waxed paper, then spray with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together the cookie crumbs and coconut. Drop small tablespoons of dough onto the prepared cookie sheets about 2 inches apart. Bake for 5 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cookies are firm and lightly browned. Remove from the oven and cool on the cookie sheets for about 2 minutes. Store in an airtight container.

title: Pasta With Tomatillos and Gorgonzola Cheese
