ingredients: 1 lb tomatillo | 1 green tomatillo | 3 tablespoons gorgonzola | 1 package pasta
instructions: Dice your tomatoes and tomatillos. Dice your green tomatillos. Heat up a large pot adding your grated gorgonzola cheese. Add your tomatillos, diced green tomatillos and green tomatillo mixture to the pot. Bring to a boil and then simmer until the sauce is as thick as you want it to be. You can also use 2 cans tomatillos with out that's it it.

title: Japanese Beef and Eggs With Sesame Nuts
ingredients: 4 -5 large beef brisket, trimmed ( you can use beef chuck roast or top round ) | 3 teaspoons fresh sesame oil | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet japanese rice wine ) | 6 egg wash ( optional ) | 36 sheets aluminum foil
instructions: Slice brisket across the grain into 8 slices with a sharp knife about 1/4 wide x 3 long. Arrange slices between sheets of plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,yellow pepper,basil,russet potato,hummus,curry powder,sun tomato
title: Savory Roasted Pepper and Herb Dip
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, scrubbed ( about 2-3/4 pounds ) | 1 yellow pepper, sliced into thin half moons | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, sliced thin ( fresh can also use oil packed sun-dried tomatoes ) | 1/4 cup basil, chopped ( i used fresh basil ) | 1/2 cup bottled roasted sweet and sour sauce | 2 teaspoons curry powder | hummus, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 375º. Line 2 large, rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Cut potato into chunks and place in large bowl of cold water. Sprinkle 1/4 cup salt on potatoes. Place potato chunks in food processor. Pulse until coarsely chopped. Add pepper, sun dried tomatoes, basil, sweet and sour sauce, and curry powder. Process until well mixed, about 4 pulses. Transfer to small baking dish. Cover with parchment paper or foil. Bake in oven until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool until warm, about 10 minutes.. Transfer to serving bowl. Serve with hummus.

title: Lemon Pepper Beef and Beans #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck or 1 lb blade steak | 1 jar pinto beans, drained, rinse to get rid of excess liquid | parsley, chopped ( to garnish ) | lemon pepper ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix together the beef, pinto beans drained of any brine and parsley. Sprinkle the lemon pepper over all. Marinade for 3 to 8 hours in the refrigerator, stirring occasionally.

title: Spinach Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 2 )
ingredients: 500 g fresh baby spinach | 5 teaspoons anise seed
instructions: Place the spinach in a large, heatproof dish. Crush the anise seeds and scatter over the spinach. Dust with a little wander. Heat the oven to 200°c, 190°c or gas mark 4. Remove from the oven and leave to sit for 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. To serve, scatter with the remaining anise seeds.

title: Guava and Sausage Stew
ingredients: 12 ounces guavas | 12 ounces italian sausage, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 12 ounces hamburger, cut into 1/2 cubes
instructions: Slice guavas in half, remove seeds and any pith with a knife.

Random Ingredients: mirin,garlic granule,fish sauce,green onion,dark soy sauce,rose petal
title: Thai Noodles (Tirk Pan Noodles)
ingredients: 1 lb fish sauce | 1/2 cup mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce or 1/2 cup tamari | 1 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 teaspoon dried rose petals | 3 green onions, diced
instructions: Whisk together, fish sauce, mirin/ tamari, garlic granules and rose petals in a bowl. Let stand about 15 minutes so all the flavours can develop. Drain any remaining marinade. Place the noodles in cold water to soak for at least 10 minutes. Drain the noodles. Combine with the sauce and green onions.

title: Watermelon Spaghetti (Japanese Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 lb spaghetti sauce | 1 watermelon, about 1 lb ( or 3 of each ) | 1 -2 tablespoon mirin | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 - 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Heat 1/2 inch water to boiling. Drain watermelon to remove the liquid. Cut in 1/4 inch cubes or 1 cubes, depending on desired chunk size. Add spaghetti sauce and toss. Toss again. Add mirin, cardamom and toss. Place on serving plate. Toss in flour. Enjoy.

title: Crusty Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb swiss cheese ( or other mild cheese of your choice ) or 1 lb cheddar cheese, grated ( or other mild cheese of your choice )
instructions: Cut cheese into 3 or 4 chunks. Place into a 9 pie plate or other medium size pie glass casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over the cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes until cheese is browned and bubbly.

title: Mushroom Sushi - Nigella Lawson
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom, washed, trimmed and sliced thinly | 1/2 cucumber, peeled, cut into 2 x 1 inch sticks, washed and sliced | sea salt, to taste | cracked hot water, to taste | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry, preferably an aromatic sweet wine for dipping | 1 round nori ( sushi grade seaweed ) | 6 garlic cloves | 1/3 cup pickled cucumbers | 1 tablespoon pickled cucumbers
instructions: Wash and dry the mushrooms. Trim the ends and cut off the tough bottom portion of the mushroom caps. In a small bowl combine the mushrooms and the cucumbers, season with salt and hot water to taste. Set aside. To make the dipping sauce, mix together the sherry and garlic. Take one nori sheet onto a serving plate, dip into the sherry mixture and then lay it onto a work surface. Take half of the nori sheet it will stick. Place mushrooms, cucumber and salt in a triangle shape on the nori sheet, close up, and place the nori sheet on top of the mushrooms and cucumbers. Put on the pickled cucumbers and cucumbers on top. Serve at once.

title: Mixed Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb macadamia nuts | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Rinse and dry the nuts. Toast them over low heat in a covered skillet for about 10 minutes. Turn nuts over occasionally to avoid burning. Drain any excess fat. Spread nuts in a clean, dry paper towel and rub away the excess fat. Spread nuts on a large platter and sprinkle with salt. Cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,tahini,egg noodle,black eyed pea,cherry tomato,dark soy sauce
title: Pasta and Black-Eyed Peas Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup drained canned black-eyed peas ( black eyed peas or a combo of the two ) | 2 hard-cooked eggs, chopped into small cubes | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped ( plus more for garnish ) | fresh cherry tomatoes
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the black eyed peas, eggs, tahini, soy sauce and chipotles. Garnish with cherry tomatoes. Serve immediately or let stand for up to 2 hours before serving.

title: White Russian Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces cooked cranberry sauce | 4 tablespoons low fat breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup light mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons white wine | 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: In medium bowl, gently toss cranberry sauce, bread crumbs, cheese, wine and nuts. Pour mixture onto a serving plate. Garnish with additional crushed peanuts.

Random Ingredients: loaf french bread,green chilies,poultry seasoning,lemon juice zest,cod
title: Crispy Fried Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cod ( or other firm white fish ) | 3 cans diced green chilies | 12 slices loaf french bread, toasted | 1 -2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | lemon juice and zest of
instructions: In a large skillet or frypan, add the fish and brown on all sides. You will need to do this at least once during the browning process. Remove the fish to a plate. Return the pan to the burner and add the chilies and the juice and zest. Heat on medium heat until hot. Add the bread and cook to a crisp but not burnt. Remove to plate. Cut each piece into 12 pieces and layer them on top of each other in the frypan. Add fish back to the pan one at a time so that they are piled up evenly for your families. This allows for them to absorb the juice more evenly. You might need to add some lemon juice to help them crisp up. Serve with salsa or salsa verde.

title: Egyptian Baked Flounder
ingredients: 4 flounder fillets ( about 4 oz each ) | 3 cups shelled lima beans | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons semolina
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange fish in a lightly greased ovenproof casserole. Sprinkle with lima beans, then sprinkle with vinegar. Bake until the fish is cooked and tender, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with semolina and serve.

title: Curry Cheese Couscous Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces plain yogurt | 12 ounces couscous | black pepper | 3 ounces curry powder | 14 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 2 ounces cabbage, finely shredded | 3 ounces unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Put the yoghurt into a serving dish and stir in half the curry power, black pepper, and most of the curry powder. Bring the mixture to the boil, remove from the heat and stir in the remaining curry power, black pepper, artichoke hearts, and cabbage. Tip into a serving dish.

title: Ginger Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger
instructions: Combine vinegar, minced ginger and rice vinegar in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well. Shake vigorously until combined and cool to room temperature.

title: Shredded Beef and Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 package gruyere cheese | 1 small butternut squash or 1 small zucchini | 3 tablespoons butter | 1 small radish ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 f. Thinly slice the cheese and squash. Heat skillet over medium high heat and add 1 tbsp oil and swirl to coat. Add the meat and lightly brown on it all sides. Remove meat from pan. Place it in a casserole dish or a roasting pan. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp oil and layer over the meat. Scatter with radish if desired and dot with 2 tbsp butter. Cook for 35 minutes or until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,beef bouillon granule,fish fillet,coconut milk,almond extract
title: Coconut Corned Fish
ingredients: 12 ounces beef bouillon granules | 1 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup light coconut milk | 3/4 cup flaked coconut | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped almond extract
instructions: Soak bouillon in water over night. Mix coconut milk and corn syrup and set aside. Preheat a baking sheet to 350 degrees f. Drain bouillon from water and mix in corn syrup/milk mixture until well blended. Line 13x9x2 glass dish with plastic wrap and spray with cooking spray. Arrange fish in the dish and pour marinade over. Cover with plastic wrap and then overwrap with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 hours to marinate. Remove plastic wrap and discard. Slice diagonally. Place sliced tuna on top of plastic wrap with slices of tuna showing along the top and side. Cover with a layer of sliced fish. Repeat layers, finishing with sliced fish on top. Mix remaining marinade with coconut and almond extract. Pour over fish. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, but preferably overnight. Remove from refrigerator and let sit 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

title: Breadfruit-Sirloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs breadfruit | 3 lbs sirloin tip roast or 3 lbs beef roast, cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Cut a slits into the roast in the crown of the roast and insert a little piece of roast in the slits. Place roast on an ungreased large foil large enough to hold roast in a single layer. Roast in the oven for 4 hours, basting frequently with pan juices and turning frequently.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,water chestnut,italian dressing,paprika,chicken breast,tortilla chip,date,kidney bean
title: Tamarind and Date Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups boiling water chestnuts, drained, finely chopped | 14 ounces canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 14 ounces tamarind pulp, drained | 5 ounces chicken breasts, chopped | 4 ounces italian dressing | paprika | 6 ounces tortilla chips | 1/4 cup chopped dates
instructions: Put all of the ingredients into a processor and process until it forms a sauce, season to taste. Place in a separate dish and chill in the fridge until needed.

title: Tarragon Cake (Herb Free)
ingredients: 1/2 cup self rising flour | 2/3 cup hot water | 1 -2 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 deg f/180 deg celsius. Mix the dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl with a fork. Make a well in the flour and pour in the hot water, and stir to mix. Pour 2 tbsp of batter into a 2 - 3 inch round or square tin or springform cake tin measuring 8 by 8 inches. Sprinkle with a little tarragon. Cook in the oven for 35 - 40 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Asparagus Burgers
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup prepared mustard powder | 2 tablespoons grated asiago cheese
instructions: Mix together the asparagus and mustard powder using a fork. Roll the beef mixture into the prepared meat and grill for 5 to 7 minutes on each side, or until cooked through. Top with asiago cheese and serve.

title: Hot Salsa With Raw and Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped mixed dried fruit | coarse kosher salt | 10 teaspoons grated red peppers
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the dry fruits, salt, and red pepper.

title: Sausages with Mustard, Ale and Brandy
ingredients: 1 lb mustard | 3/4 lb of finely ground salt pork | 12 ounces beer | 1 1/2 ounces carabile frangipane ( a mixture of liqueurs ) or 1 1/2 ounces de leche brandy ( a mixture of liqueurs ) | 2 ounces white flour
instructions: For best results, make the mustard at least two days ahead, or make it on the go before you need it. Mix the salt pork into the beer and add the carabile frangipane/brandy and leave in the fridge for a few hours. Heat a little oil in a non stick frying pan and fry the mustard on each side until it is light golden. Serve with boiled and mashed potatoes.

title: Veggies With Crispy Peanuts (Cabbage)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanuts | 3/4 lb cauliflower, cooked and florets, chopped small ( about 1/2 small )
instructions: Heat the oven to in a 2 quart baking dish, combine the peanuts and 1/2 cup water. Let stand 5 minutes. Add cauliflower and toss until coated. Bake uncovered on sides 1 hour 20 minutes or, until golden.

title: Crouton Chicken
ingredients: 1 bag seasoned croutons | 2 lbs bone-in chicken pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Spread croutons on a large baking sheet. Place chicken pieces on croutons. Sprinkle with more croutons. Bake 25 minutes, until golden and crusted. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,worcestershire sauce,red cabbage,cold water,vanilla bean,tomato sauce,irish cream,cardamom
title: Chipotle Red Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup cold water | 1 vanilla beans, split | 4 ounces tomato sauce | 3/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 3 tablespoons dried chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 drops worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup finely shredded red cabbage
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cold water and vanilla bean seeds. With a paring knife, scrape the vanilla bean pod off the vanilla bean and discard it. Transfer to food processor and add tomato sauce, worcestershire, chipotle, worcestershire, cardamom. Mix until blended. Set aside. Add red cabbage to tomato mixture and stir to coat. Cover.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,shiitake mushroom,self raising flour
title: Japanese Mushroom Scones
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 120 g shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped | 1/2 cup key lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Line a well in the base of a baking tray with baking paper and then sift in the flour. Mix together roughly and add the mushrooms. Make a well in the centre using your fingertips rub the key lime juice on top of the well. Gently gather the dough together to form a large, smooth ball. Do not over knead the ball. Roll out to a medium size. Cut with a 7cm scone mould, using a 3cm round cutter, to cut out scones. Place scones and a few mushrooms on top of the grated cheese. Bake for around 10mins or until browned underneath.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,yellow bell pepper,water chestnut,active yeast,beef bouillon cube,brown gravy mix,bread crumb,caper
title: Chile Pepper Steak II
ingredients: 1/8 cup warm water, or as needed | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried active dry yeast | 1 beef base with mixed dry ingredients | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1 pound poblano chiles, sliced | 1 package brown gravy mix | 2 tablespoons capers, drained
instructions: Combine 1/8 cup warm water, yeast, and beef base in a large bowl. Let stand until yeast mixture turns a light, yellow color, about 5 minutes. Stir in water chestnuts, yellow bell pepper, poblano chiles, gravy mix and capers.

title: Cherry and Date Dijon Sausages- OAMC
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1/8 cup dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons sweet hot italian sausage, such as casings ( such as kielbasa ) | 1/4 cup dates, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl combine the tahini, 2 teaspoons of the dijon mustard and the sausage. Split the sausages horizontally and coat with the mustard mixture. Transfer to a baking sheet. Sprinkle the remaining 2 teaspoons mustard and chopped dates on top. Bake in a 450°f degree oven for 10 minutes, or until the sausages are cooked though and slightly browned.

title: Pierogies
ingredients: 1 can chopped shiitake mushrooms, drained | 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 1 package shredded gruyere cheese, or to taste | 1 head lettuce, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil. Stir the mushrooms and mushrooms in 3/4 cup of water together in a bowl. Squeeze and force the filling through a colander into a separate bowl.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,flat leaf parsley,kalamata olive,yellow pea,garlic oil,cayenne pepper,salad dressing
title: Roasted and Crushed Cod With Yellow Pea and Sauteed Green Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken fillets | 1 1/2 cups dry yellow split peas, soaked for 6 hours in cold water | 3 tablespoons garlic oil | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup salad dressing | 12 pitted kalamata olives | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped coarsely
instructions: Pat dry the cod. Place the fish in a shallow roasting pan, and turn the fish to coat well. Let stand for 5 minutes. Preheat oven to place a rack about 6 inches from the heat. Cover the roasting pan with aluminum foil. Place the fish on the rack that will be standing in it. Bake the fish for 45 minutes. Turn the fish over, and bake for 15 minutes longer, or until cooked through. Remove from the oven, and place in a warm serving platter. While the fish is roasting, bring 4 cups of water to room temperature. Bring 2 1/2 cups of water to simmer in a large heavy saucepan. Add the peas, and stir constantly. Reduce the heat to about 1/8 inch, and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the garlic in the olive oil until it foams, and the aroma intensifies. Remove from heat, and stir in the cayenne pepper. Place the cod on the rack that will be standing in it, and roast the fish for 15 minutes, or until the fish is flaky and the peas are golden brown and crisp. Arrange the fish on top of the peas in an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with olives and parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Pork and Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, medium sized | 350 g pork fillets
instructions: Cook spaghetti, remove any skin. Cut the spaghetti squash into small pieces. Toss the spaghetti squash pieces and pork in a bowl of hot water until the pork is cooked and the spaghetti is tender. Eat with grated parmesan cheese and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Guisado De Queso (Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 3 cups cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon angostura bitters
instructions: Cut rind off the pork and shred meat. Combine all ingredients, except bitters, in pot, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour without removing the lid.

title: Smoked Smoked Salmon on Rye
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread, toasted | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 4 slices smoked salmon fillets | 2 -3 plum tomatoes
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Place rye bread on grill. Sprinkle with caraway seeds. Layer salmon with tomato slices. Cover with top slices of bread.

title: Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod ( optional ) | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together all the ingredients. Store in an airtight container.

title: Yogurt Colcannon
ingredients: 200 g plain yogurt | 6 tablespoons cornstarch | 600 g chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 medium fresh chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon freshly chopped thyme sprig | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Wrap the colcannon in foil and place in the refridgerator for 30 minutes. To make the yogurt dressing, in a bowl, mix the yogurt with the cornstarch until it is pale and creamy with a thick consistency. Add the cabbage, chilies, thyme, mace, chinese five spice and chinese chili pepper into the yogurt dressing and mix well. Transfer the colcannon to a serving plate and place under a hot grill for a few minutes to brown the surface and crisp slightly.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,bacon,lemon juice,limeade concentrate,pepper,turmeric powder,flat leaf parsley
title: Cuban Sunset
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 2 teaspoons sweet pepper, chopped | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
instructions: In large skillet, brown bacon and peppers over medium heat until crisp. Stir in limeade, vinegar, lime juice & turmeric powder. Continue to simmer and stir for 20 minutes. Garnish with parsley and serve with your favorite soda.

title: Bread and Butter Puffs
ingredients: 100 ml white flour | 1 -2 tablespoon marsala wine or 1 -2 tablespoon champagne vinegar | 2 tablespoons pimientos
instructions: Preheat oven 190°c/375°f. Put flour into one bowl. Add wine and pimiento's and mix well. Use fingers to squeeze the flour into the liquid. You might need to add a touch of milk. If it's still too liquid, it should be easier to mix. Place mixture onto a greased cookie tray. Bake in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring once or twice for the first 10 - 15 minutes. Remove and let cool. Cut into fingers. Enjoy.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Feta
ingredients: 8 slices prosciutto | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place ham slices on a slice of prosciutto, and top with feta cheese. Place the prosciutto side toward the middle of the ham, and secure with a toothpick that holds it together. Place ham in a lightly greased baking dish, and bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Roast Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 cup prepared roasted australian beef or 1 cup australian lamb leg | 1 - 1 1/2 cup purchased pesto sauce ( or purchased pesto sauce, you may use homemade, can use as a dip ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( or paste of your choice ) or 1 tablespoon curry powder, depending on heat level
instructions: Cut the beef or lamb from the leg into 4 cm long sticks about 1cm thick, each 1 3cm wide by 3cm long. If using the pesto, heat a little oil in a pan or wok and add the curry paste. Stir over a medium heat for a couple of minutes, just until fragrant and fragrant. This will bring out the flavour and aroma of the curry paste. Add the beef, stirring continuously so the mixture will soak in the oil. Cook for two to three minutes until just a bit tender, stirring frequently. Add the pesto stir until heated through, and then set aside to cool. Skelling. Thread the pieces onto soaked bamboo skewers. Cook over hot coals for three to five minutes on each side, turning once, or until cooked to your liking. Serve with crusty bread or crusty buns.

title: Herbed Pasta
ingredients: 500 g pasta ( spiral of your choice ) | herbs
instructions: Place pasta in a large pot of well salted boiling water. Cook as you normally would. This will depend on the pasta of your choice. When it is 'al dente', drain the pasta. Toss pasta with herbs. Serve with parcheese and/or tomato as desired.

Random Ingredients: tagliatelle pasta noodle,bamboo shoot,arugula,clam,ginger root,kaffir lime leaf
title: Vietnamese Clam Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh clam | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 can sliced canned clams, drained | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh ginger root, or more to taste | 1 cup chopped arugula ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped kaffir lime leaves, or more to taste | 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles, crushed
instructions: Mix the catfish, bamboo shoots, clams, ginger, and arugula together in a bowl. Mix the lime leaves into the clamfish mixture until thoroughly combined. Fold in the baguette, and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Avocado Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon smoked caribbean beer or 1/2 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 lb medium mushroom ( any type of fresh ) | 1 1/2 avocados ( small, ripe, peeled, seeded )
instructions: Combine the lime juice, salt and pepper sauce in a small bowl. Coarsely chop the mushrooms and gently saute in the oil until lightly tender. Place the ingredients into a blender and blend for 20 seconds or until smooth. Add the salsa and blend for an additional 5 seconds. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Lebanese Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 lemons, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 cups dark molasses | 1 cup dried mixed diced fruit
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts on a shallow baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink inside, about 45 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center will read at least 165 degrees f. Let rest 10 minutes, then slice into halves or wedges. Squeeze the juice from the juice into a bowl, and stir in the lemon wedges. Stir in the molasses until well combined. Place the mixed fruit into a serving dish, and stir in the chicken pieces. Cover, and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,guinness stout,kahlua,lime juice,pecorino romano cheese
title: Black Pepper and Spice Gimlet
ingredients: 4 medium garlic cloves | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 1/4 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Mince the garlic, add to a food processor along with the guinness and lime juice. Process for 15 seconds, stir in the kahlua. Pour mixture into a non metallic bowl, coat with olive oil if desired. Sprinkle with the grated cheese and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to intensify before serving.

title: Fried Toast - Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for bread crumbs and cinnamon. Shape into patties. Heat a lightly oiled frying pan over medium heat. Add patties and fry, turning and adding bread crumbs to grease pan. When crumbs are firm and golden brown, flip patties. Brown other side.

title: Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian refried beans, rinsed and patted dry | 3 green chilies ( or to taste ) | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven and roast the beans together in a 400 deg. oven. Split beans in half and place on a lightly greased square baking dish. Drizzle the beans with olive oil, and top with the chiles and most of the cheese. Bake at 400 deg. For 15 - 20 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned on top.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,molasses,lime zest,stone mustard,plum,monterey jack cheese
title: Polish Plum and Mozzarella Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb ripe plums or 1 lb other plum | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon stone ground mustard | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 teaspoon fresh lime zest
instructions: Preheat broiler using oven rack 6 inches from heat. Arrange plums in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Combine cheese, mustard, and paprika in a small bowl and set aside. Heat molasses, zest, and remaining 2 tablespoons of molasses in small saucepan over medium heat until mixture just begins to bubble slightly, about 2 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Stirring constantly, pour all molasses mixture evenly over plums. Allow to cool and absorb liquid for at least 10 minutes. Using hands, form mixture into 5 thin sticks or patties. Heat remaining tablespoon of molasses mixture in small saucepan over medium high heat until mixture begins to bubble and foam, about 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Arrange patties on broiler pan, turning once, and brush with molasses mixture. Broil 10 minutes, or until edges are browned and bubbling. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,liquid smoke,salt pepper,italian parsley,breadcrumb,vanilla essence,caraway seed,beer
title: Chili-Beer Flavoured Meatballs
ingredients: 5 lbs lean meatballs | 2 cans mexican beer, of your choice | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon caraway seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons ground italian parsley | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix all the ingredients together, except your bread crumbs in a bowl and roll each meatball into your batter. Put on top of waxed paper with parchment paper to set. Repeat this until all meatballs are rolled, placing the paper in a baking pan. Bake for about 4 - 4½ hours, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,chicken thigh fillet,cannellini bean,mexican cheese,mayonnaise
title: Spicy Chicken & Bean Bake
ingredients: 375 g chicken thigh fillets | 400 g cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup reduced fat mexican cheese blend, shredded | 1/4 cup reduced fat mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons homemade ranch dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Grease a 2 2cm deep, 18cm x 28cm swiss roll pan. Place chicken in pan, trimming if desired. Spoon beans over chicken and then scatter with cheese. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover and bake chicken for 35 minutes or until cooked through. Remove cover and bake 10 minutes or until golden brown and cheese is melted.

title: Sweet and Sour Turnips
ingredients: 4 turnip ( turnip size, about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 5 cups dashi | 3 whole allspice | 5 fennel bulbs, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn
instructions: Cut peel and turnips into 1/2 in cubes. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain and rinse well with cold water. Transfer to boiling water, then simmer about 30 min, until fork tender. Drain, then let stand til cool enough to handle. Drain well and put in blender with allspice. Blend until a thick paste forms. Fry fennel slices in 1/4 cup hot dashi, until starting to turn golden, not crisp. Add turnip pieces, fry about 3 min, then stir in corn. When mixture bubbles, add 1/4 cup reserved dashi, reduce heat and simmer 5min, stirring constantly. Serve hot.

title: Crispy Peanut Stock
ingredients: 2 whole cloves | 1 tablespoon chicken stock powder | 1 tablespoon honey, to taste | 1 tablespoon mustard, to taste | cayenne, to taste
instructions: If the stock powder is not totally binding, add a little bit of cornflour and then gradually add the warm pepper oil. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer on a low heat until desired thickness. Cool and store in an airtight container for upto 2 months.

title: Apricot Cheese Spread
ingredients: 14 ounces apricots, cut into chunks | 1/2 lb american cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric food processor or blender. Process or grind to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,vanilla bean,flour,confectioner sugar,penne pasta,ziti pasta,white bean,thyme sprig
title: Pasta Puttanesca
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 vanilla bean | 1 1/2 cups white beans, soaked and cooked | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprigs | 2 pounds penne pasta | 1/2 pound chili paste | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, pour in ziti, and add the vanilla pod and beans, thyme, and pasta. Bring to a boil over high heat, and cook until pasta is al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup pasta cooking liquid. Rinse a small pan, and add the chili paste, and heat over medium heat until lightly browned. Set aside to cool. In a large bowl, beat together the reserved pasta cooking liquid, and flour. Stir into the cooled chili paste and coat all of the pasta with the liquid. Transfer the pasta to a large, deep serving platter, and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,poblano chile,ham,large shrimp,plain nonfat yogurt,tofu,hazelnut,lemon
title: Toasted Poblanos With Shrimp, Ham, and Tofu #5FIX
ingredients: 20 poblano chiles, halved | 1 box plain nonfat yogurt | 8 ounces tofu, crumbled | 8 ounces ham, diced | to taste hazelnuts, chopped | 4 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 20 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Place peppers on a baking sheet.

title: Mango BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 ripe mango ( about 2.5 lbs, chopped into 2 cubes-about 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup ketchup ( preferably sweet ) | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a bowl, combine mango, ketchup, parsley flakes, and chili powder. Mix well. Taste and adjust seasoning to your own taste.

title: Marinated Steak
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 beef tenderloin steak
instructions: Combine lemon juice, rice vinegar and beef tenderloin in a large glass baking dish or re sealable plastic bag. Marinate in the refrigerator 8 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Remove beef from bag, reserving marinade in bag. Place the beef in a resealable plastic bag with marinade. Refrigerate overnight. Roast beef in preheated oven, basting with reserved marinade, for 10 to 15 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness.

title: Green Chile Beer Fish Tacos
ingredients: 500 g firm white fish fillets | 1 bunch spring onion, finely sliced | 2/3 cup beer ( i use guinness but we like to use somewhere decent ) | 4 fresh green chilies, chopped | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Heat 1 tbs. Oil in medium sized deep frying pan over high heat. Cut fish into 3/4 inch thick slices and add to the hot oil. Fry, turning once, until all sides are golden brown and most of the sauce has reduced. Remove from heat. Wipe the pan clean and repeat process with the remaining 2/3 cups of beer. Keep warm. Heat remaining tbs. Oil in the pan over high heat. Stir fry ginger, spring onions and chilies for about 1 minutes. Add to the sauce and reheat. To serve, spoon fish mixture into tortillas, top with a bit of sauce.

title: Melted Eggplant Fans with Ripe Rye Sauce
ingredients: 2 large aubergines | 450 g chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 jar chargrilled steak tomatoes ( drained ) | 1 tablespoon capers, drained ( drained ) | 1/2 cup fresh maraschino cherry | 1/2 cup mixed nuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c, 190c fan forced. Peel and slice the aubergines into thin wedges. Boil for 5 minutes, drain, place in an ovenproof dish then put under a hot grill until the aubergines are charred on the edges and beginning to soften, turning once. Tip into a colander to cool. Cut each aubergine wedge into 4 strips, season with salt and set aside.

title: Torta Caponati
ingredients: 5 ounces capers | 5 ounces sweet marsala
instructions: Place capers and marsala in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass bottle with a tight fitting lid. Seal well. Refrigerate for 1 week before using.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,hot red pepper flake,asparagus,baby spinach,kidney bean
title: Quick and Simple Red Beans
ingredients: 1 can asparagus, drained | 1 box low-fat kidney beans, drained well | 1 cup maple syrup or 1 cup honey | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 2 cups baby spinach
instructions: Simmer the asparagus and kidney beans until they are just tender. Drain them well and put into a saucepan. Add the maple syrup, red pepper flakes and baby spinach. Bring to a boil on medium high heat.

title: Easy Peppers, Basil and French Bread
ingredients: 1 green bell peppers ( i would use red but use whatever type you like ) or 1 yellow bell pepper ( i would use red but use what type you like ) | 1/2 lb of thick sliced and toasted french bread
instructions: Slice peppers, removing and discarding some of the seeds. Slice bread in 1 inch slices. Spread peppers evenly on the bread slices. Place slices of bread on the top of the pepper slices. Slice french bread in half. Use a spoon to pour hot peppers and french bread mixture onto the tops of the french bread slices until they are covered. Use a spoon to push a slice of french bread down into the sauce. This may make a small batch, so you may want to double or triple the recipe. Let sit for 15 minutes and eat. Keeps well for up to 5 days.

title: Hamburger Helene
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground meat | 1 packet quick-cooking rolled oats | 2 bags prunes or 2 bag golden raisins | 1 package instant egg noodles | 1 jar grape tomatoes, drained and halved | 1 can chickpeas, drained, rinsed and drained, reserving 1/2 cup liquid | 2 cups quick-cooking oats or 2 cups regular oats
instructions: In large skillet, cook meat over medium heat until browned, stirring to crumble meat with a wooden spoon. Drain off any fat. Stir in oatmeal and prunes and cook until lightly toasted. Stir in noodles. Spoon mixture over hot meat. Cover and cook until noodles are tender and mixture is hot, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl. Stir reserved tomato liquid and reserved tomato liquid into soup mixture. Spoon over meat in bowl. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: non milk,cilantro stem,broccoli rabe,mussel,brandy,american cheese,peanut butter
title: Broccoli Rabe and Grilled White American Cheese Steask
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut butter, at room temp | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 cup non-fat milk | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro stems | 1 package frozen broccoli rabe | 1/2 cup chopped toasted peanuts ( optional ) | 6 ounces thinly sliced american cheese
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high. In a microwave safe bowl, stir together the peanut butter, brandy, and milk until smooth. Add the cilantro sprigs, and cook in the microwave for a minute. Stir until fragrant, then remove from the microwave and stir in the broccoli rabe, peanuts, and american cheese slices until coated in the peanut butter sauce. Transfer to a serving dish, and serve.

title: Chicken
ingredients: 8 skinless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 8 chicken drumsticks | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Arrange chicken drumsticks in a lightly oiled baking dish. Sprinkle chicken with thyme and cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 220 degrees f for 35 - 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Discard foil.

title: Hot Red Peppers (Yuca Chir)
ingredients: 1 cup sweet red chili pepper, cut into quarters | 1/4 cup clear honey
instructions: Place the chilies in a small bowl. Add the honey and mix. Place the coated chilies in a small saucepan or frying pan. Stir over the heat until lightly browned. Serve at once accompanied by your favourite meal.

title: Beef & Cashew Ziti Bake
ingredients: 200 g ziti pasta | 500 g ground chuck | 1 cup cashews, unsalted | 1/4 cup corn, unsalted | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons sweet rice stir-fry mix or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 1 bunch coriander or 1 bunch parsley, stems removed, washed and roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/375°f. Cook pasta according to instructions. Mix the ground chuck with cashew and corn. Put back in skillet and fry it until browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Drain. Mix the cashew mixture with the rice vinegar, stir fry mix, salt and pepper to taste. Spread half the mixture in an oven proof dish, top with the ziti and spread the rest of the meat mixture over the top. Sprinkle the coriander over the ziti. Bake for 45 minutes, or until meat is done and ziti is tender.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,red onion,mint sprig,vanilla,yeast,apple,gala apple,apricot preserve
title: Apple, Apricot and Herb Gratin (Abm)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh apricots, pitted, halved | 2 lbs gala apples, cored, quartered and thinly sliced | 1 red onion, halved but very thinly sliced | 4 fresh flat-leaf italian parsley stalks, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons yeast | 1/4 cup sugar | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | fresh mint sprig
instructions: Preheat oven to 350â°f/175°c. Butter a 9 x 13” rectangular baking dish. Line bottom and halfway up sides of dish with the apricots and the apples. Sprinkle with the onions. In a large bowl, mix the yeast with sugar. Add enough lukewarm water to make a sponge. Cover and let sit 7 minutes, allowing yeast to soften. Stir in the preserves. Pour mixture over fruit. Cover and let rise 1 hour in a warm place. Bake until the surface is light golden brown.

title: Spicy Spicy Sizzlin
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 lb cauliflower, cut into 1 inch florets | 1 1/2 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed ( or your fav. beans ) | 1 1/4 cups plain whey ( low sodium is ok ) | 8 ounces mild chili powder ( or equivalent ) | 1/2 cup tamari | 8 ounces chilies ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Arrange asparagus, cauliflower and beans in lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Combine the yogurt, chili powder and tamari. Pour dressing mixture over vegetables and toss to coat well. Sprinkle with any optional ingredients if using, season to taste. Cover and bake 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,cherry brandy,popsicle,curry paste,shiitake mushroom,italian breadcrumb,ricotta cheese
title: Curry Cheese (Microwave)
ingredients: 1/3 cup cracker, crushed ( or crushed ice cream, if using soft crackers ) | 1 large mushroom, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 sprig fresh curry paste | 1/4 pint cherry brandy ( optional ) | 1 pint ricotta cheese ( i use reduced fat reduced, reduced fat ) | 4 ounces sweet italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: If using crackers, place on a baking paper lined tray and toast in the microwave for a few minutes on high, until just starting to melt. If using soft crackers, place on a baking tray and toast in the microwave for a few minutes on high, until just starting to melt. If using ricotta, in a medium bowl, stir flour, curry paste, half of the cherry brandy, and half of the ricotta using a fork to make a paste. Place dry ingredients in the bowl of a spice or coffee grinder. Add half of the melted crackers to the bowl. Add a pinch of cayenne pepper. Turn onto a floured work surface. Pat the remaining ricotta into a 4 circle on the baking paper lined tray. Using a fork, spread the chevre over the cracker crust with a fork. Sprinkle over the remaining cracked crackers and dot with remaining cherry brandy or the sweet italian bread crumbs. Microwave on high for a couple minutes until the chevre starts to form a crust. Flip the cake onto a work surface. Wrap in tin foil. Repeat with rest of the crackers. Keep in the fridge for 20 minutes before serving or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Peanut Butter & Tomato Naan
ingredients: 2 ciabatta, halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 3 tablespoons tequila | 3/4 cup tomato puree | 1 loaf bread
instructions: Cut out the top 1cm of each bread then hollow out the bread on kitchen paper. Spread the bread with peanut butter and put on the top half of the ciabatta. Heat the tequila together then stir in the tomato purée. Slice the loaf of bread and cut out the inside of the bread leaving about 1cm of the bread exposed. Brush the inside with a healthy tap and fill the spaces with the tomato purée. Wrap in foil then cook for 10 - 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and the bread is golden brown.

title: Coconut and Date Rounds
ingredients: 1 cup chopped dates ( i prefer to use laura secord's dark sticky date ) | 1 cup cornstarch | 2 cups flaked coconut | 3 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. In a bowl, stir together dates, cornstarch and coconut. In a small bowl, stir together baking powder and coconut. Add to dates. Blend until smooth. Scrape mixture into a parchment lined baking sheet. Place onto a lightly floured surface. Bake in the preheated oven 45 to 50 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,spaghetti sauce,bucatini pasta,grand marnier,tabasco sauce,andouille sausage
title: Abee's Chicken and and Bucatini Pasta
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs chicken wings, and thighs, drumsticks | 3/4 lb andouille sausage, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( i know these are sausage, i use more sausage in my recipe and they're cooked right away ) | 3 ounces bucatini pasta or 3 ounces other small shell pasta, cooked al dente | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 bottle spaghetti sauce ( i use hunts ) | 1/4 cup tabasco sauce
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a large pot and cook on low heat till the liquid is almost absorbed and the pasta is fully cooked. Serve with crusty italian bread or as directed on the side. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,mexicorn,balsamic vinegar,red chilies,green pepper,red pepper flake,cooking spray,chipotle pepper
title: Chipotle Dip With Blackened Cornbread
ingredients: 2 cans mexicorn, rinsed and drained | cooking spray | 1/2 medium green pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup bottled balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh minced red chilies | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle pepper ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 1/4 cups bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In large bowl, combine corn, green pepper, balsamic vinegar, chiles, pepper flakes, and red pepper flakes. Stir in bread flour until mixture forms a ball.

title: Quick Easy Slow Cooker Pulled Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, fat trimmed ( about 3 ) | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Heat cooker over high heat until hot. Sprinkle roast with flour. Top with lid.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,picante sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato sauce,marjoram,gravy,mint leaf,vegetable stock
title: Spicy Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup cooked tomato sauce | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 -2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons prepared gravy ( see note in directions ) | chopped hazelnuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized serving bowl. Fold lightly together to make a thin dip. Sprinkle with hazelnuts. Notes, to make a thicker, thicker dip, add 2 tbsp prepared gravy. Note 2, to make thinner, add 2 tbsp picante sauce. Note 2, i use the leftover mushroom mixture for a thicker dip.

title: Broccoli With Sugar (Aka Broccoli Con Finocchio)
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, washed, trimmed, and cut into florets ( about 2-1/2 lbs ) | 1 1/4 cups sugar
instructions: Bring about 20 quarts water to a boil in a covered steamer, removing as many of the outer leaves as possible. Add in the broccoli, reduce heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, or until steaming stops, or until tender but still firm. Drain. Scoop out the broccoli florets and set aside. Pour the sugar into another bowl. Drain the broccoli and then steam for a few minutes. Drain the broccoli well, but do not rinse it. Place the broccoli in a serving bowl, with the steaming liquid and sugar. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Crock Pot Stove Top Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef brisket | 1 cup beef tenderloin slices ( thin slices may be used ) or 1 cup deli ham ( thin slices may be used ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 round provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in crock pot. Cover, cook on lo heat 5 to 7 hours until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees. Add cheese, cover, and cook 15 minutes more. Use fork to loosen meat slices from pot.

title: Savoise
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup milk | 2 large egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian sweet paprika | 2 -3 drops pickled peel | white grapes, for garnish
instructions: Mix together the milk, egg whites, and sweet paprika. Add the peel and stir. Pour into 9 inch squares. Sprinkle with some grapes. Bake at 350°f for 10 minutes or till a knife comes out clean. Let cool. Top with a sprinkle of sugar before serving. Note, this can be made 2 days ahead and refrigerated. When served, remove from freezer, slice, and serve.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,baking powder,za'atar spice mix,extra tofu,tomato puree,pizza crust
title: Dairy Free Tofu and Bean Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low fat organic light soy protein extra firm tofu | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground flax seeds | 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 can tomato puree | 1 unbaked pizza crust, 12-inch boboli
instructions: Place tofu in large bowl. Mix with za'atar and flaxseed. Spread onto dough. Sprinkle top with a little more. Bake according to boboli recipe description below. Heat oven to 500 degrees. Add tomato puree to tomato puree and spread on crust evenly. Bake 5 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Cauliflower and Rice
ingredients: 1 cauliflower | 100 -200 g white rice | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Wash cauliflower and slice into 1/2 inch florets. Soak rice in water 10 mins, drain water. Add rice to cauliflower and cover with 1/4 inch of water. Add 1 tablespoon of beef broth and beef bouillon, keep on heating over high until water evaporates. Stir rice into water. Lower heat to medium, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes to an hour to allow flavors to blend and rice to turn dark green in color. When done serve.

title: Corn and Thyme Filling for Perogies
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn kernel, fresh and frozen | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Cover a baking sheet with plastic wrap and spray lightly. Place thawed corn kernels in a small bowl and mash with a fork. Stir in thyme and cornmeal, if necessary, to form a crumbly dough. Transfer to an pastry bag fitted with a 1/2 inch plain tube. Use scissors to cut a 1/2 inch slit in each corner. Brush each with warm water. Gently press a crumbly mixture into the center of the crumbs to form pies. Arrange the pies on the prepared baking sheet. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake pies in preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Yeast Bread
ingredients: 200 g stringy white bread ( i like to use baby english parsley but any type of stringy bread will work fine ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons dry yeast | 100 g fresh yeast | 1 1/4 cups olive oil | 1 dash white pepper | 1 pinch dried parsley ( optional )
instructions: Put some boiling water on the bottom of your mixer and dump your fresh yeast on top of the water.

title: Fettuccine With Olives
ingredients:
1 lb fettuccine, cooked al dente 
 
## ingredients ##
 1 egg yolk | sliced olive ( optional ) | pitted ripe olives, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix half of the egg yolk with the oil. Add the remaining egg yolk then add olives, if using. Heat remaining olive oil in a pan and add the fettuccine to it. Cook until lightly browned and well heated, about 3 - 5 minutes. Garnish with the reserved egg yolk and serve immediately. Note, olives can be stuffed into the middle of fresh olives. Adding sliced olives during the frying process is optional.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,yellow bell pepper,coconut,chili paste garlic,bacon,black coffee,potato
title: Baked Sweet Potato Patties With Coconut
ingredients: 6 large sweet potatoes | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1 3/4 cups sweet potatoes | 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons brown rice flour | 1/4 cup coconut ( grated ) | 1 cup strong black coffee | 1 yellow bell peppers, cut into strips or 1 orange, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 425'f & grease a baking or gratin dish.

title: Basque Garlic Cheese (Salsa Di Pimientos Farcis Con Parma)
ingredients: 4 -6 cloves garlic, peeled | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup basil leaves
instructions: Crush the garlic into fine, tiny pieces. Combine with the cheese and basil in a bowl. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,taco seasoning,filling,green chili,ham,white sugar,loaf ciabatta
title: Tex-Mex Pizza Bread
ingredients: 1 box round crust ready-to-use prepared ciabatta | 8 ounces lean smoked ham | 8 -10 cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 can sliced green chili, drained | 1 package taco soup filling | 2 -3 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Prepare pizza crust according to package instructions until just heated thru. Lay out cooked crust, spread about 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning on crust. Sprinkle sliced chilies and taco seasoning over mixture. Place about 2 tablespoons of filling over chilies. Top with remaining chilies and taco mix. Dredge with sugar. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until crust is beginning to crackle.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,cashew,dark beer,pork,beef chuck roast,granny smith apple,hard egg,lime juice zest
title: Caldo De Res (Cuban Meat & Lentils)
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck roast ( or other ground meat ) | 1 lb pork, ground ( or other cooked pork ) | 1 cup soft brown lentils | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 4 cups hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup cashews ( or pistachios ) | 1 cup dark beer ( or a little less )
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the meat breaking it up until no longer pink and browned, about 15 minute add to the lentils. Pour the lime juice over the meat. Add the salt and pepper to taste and cover. Cook over medium heat for about 25mins. Add the hard boiled eggs, cashews, and pistachios and continue to cook until the egg is firm, about 15 minutes more. Remove the cover and raise heat to medium. Cook until it almost falls apart, then remove the pan from the heat and stir in the beer or water. Transfer to bowls and serve.

title: Yogurt Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 cup white yogurt ( reduced fat ) | 3/4 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup brown rice
instructions: Mix all together until well combined. Pour into a buttered baking dish and bake for 35 minutes in a 350°f oven for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Mushrooms with Sweet Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 package cremini mushrooms | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Rinse mushrooms under cold water and pat dry. Wash mushrooms thoroughly and remove any hard stems. Set aside. Sprinkle sugar over mushrooms and mix well.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,sun tomato,vegetable stock chicken,marshmallow,flax seed
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons flax seeds ( or 1 tsp. ground flax ) | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes ( not oil packed ) | 5 1/4 cups vegetable stock or 5 1/4 cups chicken stock | 4 tablespoons unsweetened roasted unpeeled sun-dried tomatoes, chopped | 1 medium beef bouillon cube | 12 8 ounces assorted miniature marshmallows, divided use
instructions: Lightly toast and lightly grind flax seeds in coffee grinder. In small bowl, add flax and sun dried tomatoes. Blend the flaxseed mixture until fine, about 15 seconds.. Stir in 3 cups stock. Puree remaining stock and process in food processor until smooth. Strain through fine sieve. Add sun dried tomatoes and bouillon to soup and bring to boil, stirring. Add marshmallows and reduce heat. Simmer until hot, about 15 minutes.

title: Chile Sauce Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared hot sauce | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 can chopped green chile peppers
instructions: Mix hot sauce, tarragon, and chiles together in a bowl until well blended. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,white bread,tomato green chilies,asiago cheese,peanut butter,coffee,sticky rice,extra beef
title: Mexican Sticky Rice on the Barbie
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup hot coffee | 1/2 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup shredded asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped canned tomato and green chilies or 2 tablespoons diced canned green chilies, not drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | sticky rice, for serving
instructions: Heat oven to 350f. Spread peanut butter evenly on a foil lined baking sheet and toast in middle of oven 5 to 7 minutes or until just beginning to brown, stirring occasionally. Pour on hot coffee and spread to a thickness of 1/2 of an inch.. Drain beef, cheese, chilies, and pepper and combine. Spread evenly over the peanut butter mixture and bake 30 minutes or until mixture is warmed through and hot and bubbling. Serve in a wide and shallow bowl over sticky rice.

title: Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup grainy mustard | 3/4 cup corn syrup ( i use golden cane syrup ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Combine mustard and corn syrup. Add vinegar. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Beef With Peach Salsa and Chipotle
ingredients: 2 lbs top round beef top round steak, trimmed of visible fat | 3/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup chipotle chile, coarsely chopped, with seeds | 15 ounces can petite peach slices in syrup, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup beer or 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup chopped peeled radish
instructions: Place beef in large, resealable plastic bag. Combine oil, chipotle, and chiles in saucepan. Cook over medium high heat until very hot. Quickly pour oil mixture over beef, then turn bag over and let sit until meat is completely saturated with oil mixture, 30 to 45 minutes. Heat beer or apple juice in saucepan until boiling. Boil briskly for 10 minutes. Transfer beef to medium platter and pour brine over meat. Let sit for 10 minutes, then chill until serving time. Cut slits in steak, using sharp paring knife. Pour salsa over beef, garnish with radishes. Serve. Note, a piece of beef with large, flat ends will make for easy slicing. If grilling this recipe, follow recipe#453224 and set the rack about 6 inches from the source of heat. Brine, if using wooden skewers, cut the beef into 2 inch pieces. Thread the pieces in similar manner, using two skewers per piece of beef. Place on hot coals or in a basket with a heavy rock or heavy object placed directly on top of the beef. Pour beer over, then put rack in a pan or other container which will not interfere with the meat. Heat coals or girll on high. Place skewers, soaked or wood soaked in beer, on grill rack. Grill for 10 minutes. Turn, close grill, close lid, and grill another 4 minutes. The amount of time will vary depending on the size of the skewers you have. Remove to platter or platter and allow to rest for 10 minutes before carving.

title: Simple Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked salmon | 2 teaspoons baking soda ( i like baking soda in germany )
instructions: Wash and pat dry the salmon. Cut into slices lengthwise. Smoke the salmon for 8 minutes before baking. This recipe will serve 3 people as an appetizer or with pita bread.

title: Simple Pesto Ceviche
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups canned black beans ( rinsed, drained and rinsed again ) | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, made with a pestle | 2 small red salmon, peeled and sliced into strips | 1/4 cup shredded palm sugar
instructions: Mash black beans with pesto until paste like consistency. In a large bowl, blend together salmon and pesto. Add bean mixture and a little palm sugar. Mix well until well blended. Serve warm, at room temperature, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: peach pie filling,cider vinegar,garlic clove,coffee granule
title: French Silk Peaches
ingredients: 2 fresh ripe peaches ( i like the ones i buy, though a can of them will be a bit larger ) | 3 tablespoons strong coffee granules ( or more, depending on acidity ) | 1 garlic clove | 1 can peach pie filling ( i like publix pops'brand )
instructions: Slice the peaches in half and remove the pits.

Random Ingredients: meat,mango,green bell pepper,garlic clove,heavy whipping cream,almond,ice
title: Sweet and Spicy Lamb Delight
ingredients: 1 kg minced meat | 8 garlic cloves, minced | 2 green peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup mango, chopped & diced | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons slivered almonds | 5 -6 cubes ice
instructions: Put minced meat in a bowl and season with garlic, peppers. Add mango, cream& almonds. Mix well. Put in a freezer bag& label the freezer section. Label again& freeze for at least 6 hours or for up to one week. Remove the food in the bag from the freezer and let it reach room temperature, stirring occasionally. If it gets cold it is ready. Take out from the bag and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Then slice in med sized pieces& serve with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,parsley flake,prawn,sofrito sauce,red bean,tamarind paste,onion
title: Prawn Tamarind Polenta(Tamarind) Polenta
ingredients: 600 g yellow cornmeal | 600 g red beans, shelled and washed | 1 large onion, chopped | 4 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons parsley flakes | 200 g prawns
instructions: Place cornmeal in bowl and place in microwave for 20 sec. In microwave melt sofrito and onion in microwave for 1 minute. Add tamarind paste and stir. Add the cornmeal mixtur and stir. Add parsley and prawns and stir. Heat in microwave for 1 minute and serve.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,apricot jam,flat leaf parsley,saffron thread,dijon mustard,ginger
title: Gingered Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup smooth apricot jam | 1/2 cup smooth soy sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/4 cup finely minced ginger | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon finely minced flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a small mixing bowl combine jam, soy sauce, saffron, ginger and mustard. Mix ingredients together until well blended, you may add more mustard if required. Store in a closed container for up to a week. To use, spread over chicken, pork or other meats.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,lemon juice,head cauliflower,o'brien potato,almond,pecan,pork leg,turmeric powder
title: Tartiflette
ingredients: 2 tablespoons o'brien frozen potatoes | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons ground almonds | 2 tablespoons ground almonds | 2 tablespoons pork legs | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/4 lb thick cut pork tenderloin | 3 large heads cauliflower
instructions: In a bowl, combine the potatoes, pecans, 1 tablespoon ground almonds, ground pork legs, turmeric powder, and lemon juice. Cut the tenderloins into 1/8 inch slices. Toss with 2 tablespoons ground almonds.

title: White Chocolate Citrus Preserves
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white chocolate chips | 2 cups fresh orange juice | 2 lemons, zest of
instructions: Take the white chocolate chips and place them in a bowl with the orange juice and finely grated lemon zest. In a saucepan or small, heavy saucepan, melt the chocolate chips over medium heat, stirring frequently, until very smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Pour the melted chocolate into a small mason jar, or use a pastry bag. Shake to help smooth out the chocolate and ensure the chocolate is evenly melted. Pipe a small amount of the melted chocolate into the zest as many cups as you can, then press a teaspoonful of the orange zest into each cup.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,chunky salsa,peach,oil,self raising flour,almond extract,creole seasoning
title: Crazy Fruit Scones
ingredients: 3 medium green peaches | 2 cups self-raising flour | cornflour or wholemeal self-raising flour | vegetables or chocolate chips ( you can also do a mixture of both ) | oil | chunky salsa | almonds or pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to moderate. Put all the grated ingredients in a small bowl and mix well with a spoon. Roll the mix into golf ball sized balls and place on a baking tray. Put in the oven and bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through. These are tasty, not undercooked. The kids loved them with everything, salsa, chunky salsa, etc.. If you use instant chocolate chips it is a bit boring, so i just microwave them in a little bowl and pour over a little melted chocolate before serving. I've served these with a mixture of sweetened condensed milk, cream, and guacamole.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,mango chutney,white sugar,brussels sprout,lipton onion soup mix
title: Indian Brussels Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 bag frozen brussels sprouts, thawed overnight | 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons minced garlic powder | 1/4 cup mango chutney
instructions: Combine the dry onion soup mix and sugar in a 3 1/2 to 1 quart pot, and heat gently over low heat. Add garlic powder and mango chutney. Mix into the onion soup mix. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, and cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in brussels sprouts.

title: Raspberry and Red Pepper Damper
ingredients: 2 cups fresh raspberries | 1 cup of coarsely chopped red pepper | 1/2 cup plain flour
instructions: Heat grill / broiler to hot. Spray 2 baking tins with oil spray. Arrange half of the ruffles, half of the red pepper and half of the flour in the tins. Cover with 4 tins of water. Place tins of foil on cookie sheet. Bake at hot temp for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until vegetables are tender and most of the flour is golden. Place remaining rasspberries and red pepper in a bowl or jug and mix well. Spoon into tins or bread tins. Sprinkle with remaining flour. Serve warm.

title: Basil Pesto Grilled Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 2 cups homemade pesto or 2 cups prepared pesto | 1 box pasta, any kind | 1 green bell pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, torn ( optional )
instructions: Place pesto in a blender and process to consistency you wish.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,farfalle pasta,oyster sauce,purpose flour,paprika,butter,lemon peel,ciabatta
title: Pasta With Bacon Cheese and Crispy Lemon Peel
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs farfalle pasta | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 ounces bacon grease | 2 -3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 lemon peel, grated and zested | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 2 ciabatta, thin slices
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente, according to the package directions. Set aside. In a saucepan, melt the butter and add the bacon grease or margarine, over medium heat. Stir in the flour and oyster sauce until there are no lumps. Add lemon peel and paprika and cook for about one minute. Remove dish from heat. Add pasta to bacon mixture, add the drained pasta, mix well and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,farfalle pasta,pork chop,brown sugar,sesame seed,purpose flour
title: Hawaiian Grilled Pork Chop With Pineapple
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon unbleached all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork chops, boned trimmed | 1 1/2 cups canned crushed pineapple, undrained
instructions: Toast sesame seeds in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden.

title: Tarragon Salmon and Noodles
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin | 250 g dried apricot jam | 10 g dried active yeast | 6 1/2 fluid ounces warm water | 8 10 minutes active dry yeast | 7 ounces dried egg noodles | powdered dried tarragon | pickled hot smoked salmon
instructions: Place sirloin in bowl. Add apricot jam and stir until well blended. Add yeast and water. Mix to combine. Cover with plastic wrap. Leave for 25 minutes until bubbly. Put noodles in saucepan of cold water. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring until soft. Put noodles in a large bowl, pour boiling water over. Cover. Leave for 10 minutes until tender. Drain. Mix the dill and pepper mix into noodles. Add tarragon and mix well. Drain ground beef. Brown over high heat, adding a little oil in a pan and browning well. Season and serve with noodles and mustard sauce.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,italian sausage,green pepper,vidalia onion,chili flake,egg wrap,farfalle pasta
title: Italian Sausage Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 lb sweet italian sausage | 3 tablespoons red chili flakes | 1 vidalia onion | 1 green pepper | 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked al dente ( bowtie pasta can also be used ) | 12 egg roll wraps | chopped cotija cheese
instructions: Brown the sausage, breaking it into small pieces, in large skillet. Break any clumps as you go. Cook chopped onion and green pepper over low heat until golden. Cook bowtie pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta and set aside. Brown and drain sausage. Add chili flakes, chile and onion mixture to skillet and sauté 3 - 5 minutes, until onion is translucent. Remove from heat and set aside. Divide pasta into 6 equal portions. Place a portion of sausage mixture into center of each wrapper. Roll or fold the edge of the wrapper up around the sausage mixture. Place seam side down on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Sprinkle with cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: non dairy coffee creamer,guinness stout,thai chili sauce,harissa,red wine vinegar,white flour tortilla,shrimp paste
title: Thai-Spiced Shrimp
ingredients: 8 ounces shrimp paste | 1/2 cup sweet red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup non-dairy coffee creamer or 1/4 cup soy coffee creamer | 1/4 cup thai sweet chili sauce, plus more to taste | 1 teaspoon harissa ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons white flour tortillas, torn into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup guinness stout
instructions: Combine the shrimp paste, vinegar and creamer in a small saucepan over low heat. Cover and leave, and stir occasionally until the mixture thickens, about 25 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in chili sauce, harissa and flour. Set aside. Heat a skillet over high heat and add water to make 2 or 3 cups of water. Cook the tortillas for about 10 seconds or until crisp. Drain, and place on plate with a damp towel. To serve, spoon onto plates, and pile hot shrimp onto top.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,red snapper fillet,baby spinach,mayonnaise,double cream,tequila,green cardamom pod,cottage cheese
title: Fish and Chips With Cottage Cheese Dip
ingredients: 500 g red snapper fillets | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup baby spinach | 1 teaspoon fresh green cardamom pod | 3/4 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon tequila, to taste
instructions: Slice fish into strips. Lightly fry fish in a little oil and set aside. To make dip, mix cream cheese, cottage cheese, spinach, cardamom and 1/2 cup of the sour cream in a bowl. Fold in remaining sour cream and tequila. Toss with fish and serve with chips as an entrée.

title: Easy Microwave Nacho Dip
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce | salt and lemon pepper to taste
instructions: Stir the picante sauce and salt and lemon pepper together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,baking potato,blueberry,horseradish,jalapeno pepper,raisin,kaffir lime leaf,papaya
title: Blueberry and Honey Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 5 large baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 2 cups fresh blueberries | 1 cup fresh pitted bok choy | 1 medium jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish, drained | 4 kaffir lime leaves, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the baking pan with potatoes into the freezer, and while still hot melt the honey. Cool the honey until warm. Place the bok choy and jalapeno pepper into a separate pot and simmer with the raisins, apple juice and horseradish. When the potatoes have cooled enough to handle, mash with the honey and horseradish. Place each potato chunk on the prepared baking sheet, and sprinkle with the kaffir lime leaves, and bake until the tops start to brown. Serve with a scoop of apple and raisin flavored whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,self rising flour,spinach,red chili pepper
title: Achaari Palak
ingredients: 200 g spinach | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper | 1 teaspoon self-rising flour
instructions: Boil the spinach and drain off the water. Mix the spinach with all the ingredients in a bowl. Make sure you mix well so the mixture won't loose its shape. Spray a non stick frying pan. Spread the paste over the pan. Bake in pre heated oven at 200°c. Bake for 10 minutes or until firm.

Random Ingredients: tahini,tomato soup,black olive,tomato green chilies,vermouth,puff pastry
title: Bakewell Tart
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 cup tomato soup | 1/2 cup chopped black olives | 10 ounces frozen puff pastry sheets | 1/4 cup dry vermouth
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine the tahini, onion, and 1/2 can tomato soup in a saucepan, mix well, and cook until onion is transparent. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Mix in the olives. On a floured surface, roll out the puff pastry to 1/8 inch thickness, and cut into 4 - 6 inch circles. Place about 1/2 tsp of the tahini mixture in the center of the circle. Add about 1 tbls of tomato soup mixture on the layer of tahini mixture. Using your fingers, seal the edges. Place tart pastry on a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown. Sprinkle with vermouth to serve.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,chinese five spice powder,hamburger,baby bok choy,rotel tomato,chicken thigh
title: Hamburger Party Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 baked pie shell | 12 baby bok choy, leaves | 1 skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Bake pie shell as directed above. Brown meat on hi heat in skillet. Drain. Stir in cans tomatoes, 5 spice, and 4 tbsp of rotel rotel. Simmer over low heat about 20 minute. Arrange bok choy leaves on plate. Top with meat mixture. Sprinkle with remaining rotel mixture and bake for 25 - 30 min at 400 degrees. Uncover and let stand about 10 minute serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: cantaloupe,peanut butter,liquid smoke,red chili pepper,turkey breast,chipotle chile adobo,marjoram
title: Spicy Thai Smoked Turkey Breasts
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked turkey breast, cut 1 inch thick | 2 cans canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 20 ounces cantaloupe ( small can ) or 20 ounces peach, chopped ( small can ) | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke or 1 tablespoon mesquite wood smoke | 1 tablespoon marjoram | red chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place turkey on rack in broiler pan, cut side up. Broil turkey for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cut cantaloupe in half crosswise, then cut in half crosswise. Remove turkey from broiler and discard skin. Cut each half into 4 slices. Place 1 slice turkey into each of 6 equal portions, shaping each into a total of 12 equal portions. In blender or food processor combine chipoltes, chopped cantaloupe, liquid smoke or mesquite smoke, marjoram and chilies. Process until smooth. Spoon or pipe chipotle sauce mixture over turkey. Return turkey to broiler and broil turkey for 5 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees. Turn turkey over and broil for 5 minutes longer. Serve topped with peanut butter. Note, prep time does not include 1 hour broiling time.

title: Linguine Alla Puttanesca
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 cup prosecco | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Cook linguine.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,chocolate chip,mint,saffron strand,cider vinegar,pork loin roast
title: Grilled Saffron-Minted Pork Loin With Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron strand, threads or 1 teaspoon ground jamaica saffron | 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons fresh mint, minced ( not dried ) | 1 teaspoon saffron extract | 2 2 lbs pork loin roast or 2 lbs pork butt
instructions: In small frying pan, toast saffron threads over medium heat, until fragrant and lightly colored, about 1 minute a syrup spritz the slow cooker. Place chips, vinegar, mint and saffron in pan.

Random Ingredients: tagliatelle pasta noodle,cumin powder,plum tomato,coriander leaf,liquid smoke,butter
title: Smoky Tomato Tagliatelle
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 lbs ripe plum tomatoes, chopped | 3 tablespoons coriander leaves, minced | 4 -6 rueh - teapsoon hot black olive paste or 2 tablespoons paste | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 lb tagliatelle pasta noodles or 1 lb fettuccine pasta, cooked
instructions: Heat the butter in a large nonstick skillet. When foaming, add the tomatoes, coriander and cumin. Sauté over moderate heat, stirring and breaking up lumps with a spoon. Cook until some of the liquid evaporates. Add the tomato paste, stir and simmer a few minutes. Serve over the hot fettucine or fettucine pasta.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,sesame seed,lump crabmeat,taco seasoning
title: Maryland Style Crab
ingredients: 1 can lump crabmeat, drained | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 1/4 cup fine sea salt | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, optional
instructions: In a shallow microwave safe bowl, mix together the crabmeat, taco seasoning, and fine sea salt. Dot the top with sesame seeds as desired. Cover, and microwave on high 5 minutes, stirring once, or twice to spread sesame seeds evenly.

title: Easy English Apricot Balls
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen artichoke hearts, cooked and chopped | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons thinly sliced dill pickle slices or 1 1/2 teaspoons pickled jalapeno slices ( or to your taste ) | 1/2 cup miniature dried apricot
instructions: Chop artichoke hearts, discarding stems, place them in a bowl and drizzle with coffee. Gently fold in cheese until mixture is evenly coated. Spread mixture evenly into an 8x8 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle dill pickle slices over mixture. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Remove from oven and serve. Note, i use jarred dried apricots, packed up, with melted butter on them, and sprinkled on the top as well.

title: Porter Oat Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | 1 tablespoon porridge oats, made into ground oat | parsley leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c. Press the oats into a large, shallow patty on the bottom and side of the pizza base dish. Spread the oats on the toasted surface of your pizza base. Spread the porridge oats over the oat mixture and sprinkle over the parsley. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until the base is golden golden brown.

title: Spinach With Fresh Tomatoes
ingredients: 10 plum tomatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 1/2 lbs fresh spinach, washed and dried ( about 5 1/2 '' in diameter ) | 2 large egg yolks ( about 3 or 4 1/2 '' in diameter )
instructions: Sprinkle the spinach with salt in a large, heavy skillet. Heat to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently. The water will be cloudy and the spinach at the bottom of the skillet.
