When the water is cloudy about 3/4 of the way up, add the spinach to the pan in a thin stream, then cover. The wilted, bright green liquid that drains over the spinach will wilt considerably. When it is wilted, reduce the heat to low. Beat the egg yolks in a large bowl with a pinch or two of salt until light and fluffy, about 30 seconds. Slowly beat the hot spinach into the yolks. Continue to beat while adding a few tablespoons more hot water if mixture curdles. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and gently swirl it around so egg slices are fully covered. Cook the spinach, stirring once, until it wilts in spots, about 5 minutes. Scatter chopped tomato slices on top and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,artichoke heart,green enchilada sauce,hormel chili,bread flour,belgian endive,semolina,chicken bouillon granule
title: Enchilada Sauce with Hormel and Artichokes
ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled green enchilada sauce | 1 packet instant chicken bouillon granules | 2 cups plain bread flour | 1 bunch belgian endive | 1/4 bunch fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish chili | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 2 tablespoons semolina
instructions: Place all the ingredients except for the corn meal into a food processor and pulse to a smooth, velvety consistency. Transfer the corn meal to a medium sized bowl and mix in 1/4 cup of the enchilada sauce. Dredge both sides of the endive in the corn meal, letting the excess dry off. Arrange the artichoke hearts along the side of a 9x13 pan. Pour about 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce over the artichokes. Sprinkle on some semolina. Bake in a preheated oven on the lowest rack of the oven for about 1 hour and 30 minutes, flipping the pieces in the pan every 15 minutes to make sure they bake evenly. Serve warm or refrigerate to cool.

title: Beer and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 lb mixed vegetables, such as potatoes, peas, turnip, cauliflower, parsnips, carrots | beer, such as stout | 1 cup brandy or 1 cup beef stock
instructions: Place vegetables and beer in a sauce pan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Cover and cool slightly. Remove vegetables and add brandy or beef stock to pot. Heat until warm. Serve hot, garnished with freshly chopped parsnips and a few sprigs of fresh dill.

Random Ingredients: olive,scallion,tomato juice,cauliflower,pecorino romano cheese,chicken bouillon cube,self rising flour
title: Co-Ho's Cauliflower Artichoke Ravioli
ingredients: 4 ounces self-rising flour | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 1/3 cup chopped roasted sweet peppers ( from a jar ) or 1/3 cup other hot pepper | 1/2 - 1 cup finely chopped scallion | 1 small cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: For the ravioli and sauce, stir together the flour, bouillon, tomato juice, pepper and scallions in a large mixing bowl. Stir in cauliflower and cheese until just lightly coated. Cover and set aside 10 minutes. Drain the ravioli and transfer to a plate. Arrange them on a platter or pasta dish. Top with the ravioli and sauce and bake 15 minutes at 375 degrees f.

title: Easy Sponge Cake
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups cake flour | 1 can condensed milk
instructions: Combine flour and milk in bowl. Add water and turn on high speed till mixture thickens a little, this will depend on how deep the batter is. Turn off mixer/ mixer and just pour into a greased tube pan and bake 30 - 40 minutes at 180 deg c.

title: Baked Burritos
ingredients: 8 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 pinch saffron threads ( optional )
instructions: Grease ovenproof casserole with cooking spray. Sprinkle saffron on each burrito. Place casserole in preheated oven, then bake 40 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.

title: White Chocolate Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened dried salsa | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 8 dried chiles, soaked in hot water for 20 minutes, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped dried walnuts | 1 1/2 pounds chicken wings | 8 ounces white chocolate, chopped | 1 cup white sugar | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, for garnish
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the wings in a saucepan and simmer for 20 minutes or until thickened. Place chicken and nuts in a large container filled with cool water, cover, and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Drain the chicken. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil and spray with vegetable oil. Place 4 cups of the sauce in a small saucepan and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and cook until sauce is light and thickened, about 20 minutes. Spread remaining sauce on all 4 plates. Arrange chicken wings on top and cover with a damp towel to prevent drying. Spoon remaining sauce over wings, dividing evenly. Sprinkle with sugar and nuts.

Random Ingredients: bottom beef roast,cauliflower floret,cannellini bean,sunflower oil,baking soda,green salad,lime wedge,red chilies
title: Teddy's Beef & Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 2 cups baby cauliflower florets | 1 -2 red chilies, sliced or 2 serrano peppers, diced | 2 cups small firm white-fleshed cauliflower florets | 300 g low-sodium canned cannellini beans | 2 cups green salad | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 small fresh lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Heat the oven to 200c/gas mix all the ingredients in a large roasting tin, except for the lime wedges and pour into the middle rack of the oven. Cook, stirring occasionally for 2 hours, until the meat is tender. Remove and allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving with the salad mixture. Sprinkle with lime wedges and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,cherry,mustard powder,pumpkin puree,monterey jack cheese,tomato juice
title: Cherry Pesto Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 10 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Place tomatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet sprayed with pam cooking spray. Bake for 8 to 11 minutes, or until tops begin to wilt. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. Place cherry halves in a food processor, and chop enough to fit onto the top of a small baking dish. Drizzle mixture over the tomatoes. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium bowl. Stir. Spoon mixture into tomatoes, and sprinkle evenly with desired amount of cheese.

title: Curried Cranberry and Mango Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar, plus | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1/4 cup quick cooking lentils | 1 large mango, peeled, seeded, diced | 1 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1/4 cup fat free buttermilk | 4 -6 fresh mint leaves ( optional, but i do like to add these! )
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup sugar, lentils, mango, buttermilk, and mint leaves. Serve cold with a sprinkling of black pepper or other seasonings, if desired.

title: Mexican Cornbread II
ingredients: 1 can mexican-style corn | 1 cup millet flour | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon ginger root, crushed | 6 avocados, peeled and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook creamed corn in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain. Stir millet flour, oregano, and ginger together in a bowl. Mix in corn. Transfer creamed cornmeal mixture to a casserole dish coated with cooking spray. Cut avocados in half lengthwise and sprinkle evenly over top. Cover and bake in the preheated oven until the avocados are hot and bubbling, about 30 minutes. Switch the oven off and leave the casserole in the oven until the crumbs have turned golden brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Chilled Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, leaves | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon marmite ( or veggie powder ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange juice ( i use zest of 1 orange )
instructions: Wash and spin the kale. Remove the tough stem from the leaves by running the tip of your knife down both sides of the leaves. This helps cook out all the water in the pan, and prevent the leaves from tearing apart. Put the kale in a bowl with cold water and let sit till just soft enough to roll out. Remove the kale from the water. If it can be undercooked, you can use a knife to cut it up into smaller pieces. If you like, you can steam the pieces in the microwave using a steamer basket. The water in the microwave also helps give the chard a sprikier color. Remove the kale from the water and place in a microwave safe bowl. In the microwave, heat the oil just enough to sizzle the asafoetida. Add in the asafoetida, marmite, orange juice, and kale. Stir in gently. Microwave on high for 10 to15 minutes, or stir to combine. Check the color of the mixture.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,confectioner ' sugar,beef chuck roast,pastry crust pie,zucchini
title: Zucchini and Beef Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 lbs zucchini, sliced diagonally | 1/2 - 3/4 cup manchego cheese, shredded | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon confectioners'sugar ( optional ) | 1 ready-made pastry crust pie crust, unbaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a large nonstick skillet, bring just enough water to boil to cover half the beef. Add meat.

title: Nuked Seeds
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole black mustard seeds | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Put mustard seeds in a shallow pan that's about 1 inch deep. Cover with water, and let soak until seeds crackle and swell up, about 15 minutes. Remove from water, and set aside to cool. Transfer cooled seeds to a resealable bag, and cover. Refrigerate until needed. To use, pour mustard seeds into a clean skillet, and cover with water. Heat over medium heat until water begins to boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 5 to 10 minutes before removing lid, but do not boil. The seeds should be browned and dry but not black. Season salt liberally to taste. Serve.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,onion soup mix,extra large egg,egg white,chicken wing,thyme,vinegar
title: Crabby-Crab Boats
ingredients: 6 extra-large eggs | 2 extra-large egg whites | 1 egg white | 1/4 cup chopped onion soup mix | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 pound ground crabmeat, or as needed
instructions: Beat egg whites and yolks in a large bowl until thick. Stir onion soup mix, vinegar, and thyme into egg mixture. Stir beaten egg whites into egg batter.

title: Linguine in White Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen peas and corn | 12 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( peas and corn mixed together ) | 2 ounces dried currants | 1/2 liter milk | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 3 cups vegetable stock or 3 cups chicken stock
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. If sauce is too thick add just a little water. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.

title: German American Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1/3 cup flour tortilla | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
instructions: In a large pot boil 3 quarts of water and add the elbow macaroni. When the macaroni is half done, remove from heat and pour into a colander. Place the tortilla in a pot and fill with hot tap water. When it is completely drained, it is ready to use. In a frypan, heat the mustard seeds. Put the tortilla in the pan and top with mustard and spread about 1/8 cup of the mac and cheese. Fry briefly on one side. Turn over and fry until golden brown. Serve and you have to worry about the calories.

title: Spinach (Tortillas)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach | 1 1/2 - 2 cups vegetable shortening
instructions: Heat a heavy 10 inch skillet over moderately high heat for 45 seconds or until hot but not smoking. Rub 1 cup of the hot fat into the spinach, then slip in as many spinach as will fall from the sheets. Continue forcing the spinach with a large, flat bladed knife, until most of it has drained. Spread the spinach in a thin layer on a plate, leaving a 2 to 3 inch margin at the top. Pour the remaining melted fat over the spinach, then scatter the pieces of shortening over it. Using a long handled spoon, cook the tortillas at about 1/2 inch intervals, turning them, until they are nicely browned on all sides. Serve the hot tortillas immediately, with butter on the side. Note, tortillas may be made 1 day ahead and kept at room temperature, covered.

title: Spiked Lentil Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dried lentils | 8 1/2 ounces chunky salsa | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 cups cooked rice | 1/4 cup finely diced cucumber | 1/4 cup finely diced canned pineapple chunks | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pinch ground black pepper
instructions: Place lentils in a bowl and pour boiling water over.

title: Marjoram Walnut Chutney
ingredients: 1 pound walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine the walnuts, wine, marjoram, salt, and pepper in a jar.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,basmati rice,orzo pasta,onion soup mix,shell pasta
title: Baked Orzo and Shells
ingredients: 2 cups orzo pasta | 1 package dry orzo pasta | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated orzo-flavored gelatin or gelatin | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 1/2 cups dry small shell pasta
instructions: In an 8 x 8 inch baking dish, combine Orzo, orzo and onion orzo mixture, gelatin, cardamom seeds and uncooked orzo. Cover and bake at 375 degrees f for 35 to 45 minutes or until the orzo has absorbed all of the liquid.

title: Lebanese Peanut Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups peanuts, chopped into pieces in the food processor | 1 teaspoon cornflour ( cornstarch is best )
instructions: Place the peanuts and cornflour in a food processor and process until the mixture resembles fine crumbs. Take the mixture from the food processor bowl and stir in the corn flour until a ball forms. Refrigerate for 30 - 50 minutes. Roll balls into small balls and shallow fry or steam them in boiling water till cooked through and well browned on all sides. Allow the peanut balls to cool before removing from the bowl.

title: Gruyere Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 inch ginger
instructions: Put cheese in a food processor. Add chili powder and ginger and process till smooth.

title: Hedgiehogchen
ingredients: 2 lbs vidalia or other sweet red chicory ( about 2 inches thick ) | 3 -6 hard-boiled eggs | 2 -3 slices fresh ginger
instructions: Cut the chicory into 3 x 3 pieces. Cut the eggs into long pieces about 1  inch thick, or in to pieces of 5 inches long and about 3–1/2 inches wide. Arrange 2 to 3 pieces of each ingredient so it doesn’t sink to the bottom of the dish. Place 1 or 2 pieces of ginger on top of the food and sprinkle on a little more ginger. Cover with a piece of re hydrated ginger.

title: Spanish Pepito Salad
ingredients: 2 large grape tomatoes | 2 ounces pimientos ( cured spanish olives ) or 2 ounces other cured black olives, chopped ( cured spanish olives )
instructions: Slice two large grape tomatoes into half moons. Place each slice on a hot dry skillet about halfway through to brown. As soon as the pepito begins to turn color, remove them from the pan. Drain excess grease and set aside. When all slices have been fried, place a few pimentos in the work bowl of a food processor. Pulse until chopped, then return olives to the food processor. Pulse to a coarse paste, pulsing continuously to prevent the mixture from discoloring. Sprinkle with paprika. Repeat for all two remaining pepito.

title: Scotch Eggs, a Scandinavian Twist
ingredients: 8 firm-ripe fresh scotch eggs | 8 tablespoons fresh white breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons horseradish | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Hard boil eggs and peel. Cut in half lengthways. Remove yolks and chop finely. Combine all ingredients and beat well. Put into egg yolks and mix well. Pour over just a little of the breadcrumbs and mix gently until everything is covered. Chill in the fridge for 1 hour. If you wish to fry the eggs individually, put about a cup of hot water in a frying pan and place under the hot water to keep it boiling. You want the sauce to start to steam. Place 4 tbsp in small frying pan or fryer and when it starts to boil, add the rest of the ingredients and stir until just mixed. Keep cooking for 5 - 10 minutes or until the eggs are just set. Put on a paper towel to absorb excess water. Serve with ice cream and whipped cream. Alternatively, they can be reheated and put in a tea towel to dry for a few minutes before serving.

title: Pasta Con Peperoni (Pasta and Peppers)
ingredients: 12 ounces rotini pasta | 1 large yellow sweet pepper or 3 -4 jalapeno peppers ( or all three )
instructions: Bring large pot of water to a boil and add whole pepper halves. Cook peppers 5 to 7 minutes or until soft. Strain pasta into a large bowl and add pepper halves, pepper and a large handful of freshly chopped oregano. Toss pasta and pepper mixture with a light coating of oil and salt and pepper. Enjoy.

title: Herby Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 4 thick beef short ribs | 12 fluid ounces salad oil | 1/2 cup brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Prepare meat by trimming excess fat. Mix together the salad oil and brandy until smooth. Coat meat with mixture. Place on rack in a roasting pan or baking pan and bake in 300 degrees oven until fork tender.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,red food coloring,monterey jack cheese,liquid smoke flavoring,caper,prawn,chive,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Stuffed Prawns ( Shrimp) with Soy Chive Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked soba noodles | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup fat-free capers ( drained ) | 12 peeled prawns ( tail intact ) | 1/3 cup chives ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup chinese chives ( cut ) | 1/3 cup canned unsalted capers ( drained ) | 2 -3 drops liquid smoke flavoring | 1 - 1 1/2 drop red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 ounces grated monterey jack cheese or 2 ounces muenster cheese
instructions: Prepare shrimp, boil noodles until just soft. Drain and set aside. Chop the shrimp into 1 slices, dip in soy chive dipping sauce. Place the shrimp in a large glass baking dish that is just large enough to hold them in one layer. Sprinkle the shrimp slices with 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder and 3/4 teaspoon of capers. Set aside. In a small strainer, rinse the shrimp and pat dry. Cover the shrimp with plastic wrap or a sheet of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet, or other heavy flat object until large, about 1½ inches thick. Dip in soy chive dipping sauce and set aside. In a small mixing, combine the chives, chives and 1/4 teaspoon of paprika and set aside. Peel the prawns, remove the heads and shells, and devein if desired. Remove the eyes, shells by mitting and tail. Rinse off the sand sacs, which will stick to the shrimp if they are submerged in sauce. Place the prawns in a bowl full of ice water. Dip the prawns in soy chive dipping sauce and set aside. Add a drop or two of liquid smoke to the drained soba noodles, stirring to coat. Line the bottom of a 1½ to 2 quart baking dish with one third of the shrimp. Place 1/3 of the noodles in dish and arrange 1/4 of the prawns over the noodles. Add half the chives and chives and 2/3 of the sauce, ending with the remaining noodles. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top of the other ingredients. Cover the dish and refrigerate for 2 hours, or overnight. Remove from refrigerator, remove the cover and sprinkle the shrimp evenly over the top. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a 350°f oven for 45 minutes or until shrimp is heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,chicken stock cube,white sesame seed,artichoke heart,lamb,red chilies
title: Paleo and Chilli Roast Lamb
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless lamb, diced | 1 1/2 inches red chilies, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon coarse coriander powder | 2 teaspoons white sesame seeds, toasted | 2 chicken stock cubes | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f. Combine lamb, chilli, coriander powder and sesame seeds in glass or ceramic dish. Add the stock cubes and stir to combine. Cook in oven uncovered, for 2 hours or until a meat thermometer registers 145f for rare lamb. Remove lamb from its dish and drain any juices. Increase oven temperature to 400f and continue cooking for a further 30 minutes. Stir through the artichoke hearts. Serve with steamed basmati rice, or rice and steamed pitta bread, etc. Note, to roast lamb, preheat oven to 200f degrees celsius. Score the top of the lamb, using a knife or pastry brush, into a thin sliver.

Random Ingredients: miso,turmeric powder,chicken breast,yellow squash,beef roast,white pepper powder,curry,rice vinegar
title: Beef, Yellow and Red Curry for Two
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb boneless beef roast | 5 large yellow squash, sliced | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1 tablespoon yellow squash, chopped | 2 tablespoons miso | 1 teaspoon curry | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Line a roasting pan with a sheet of aluminum foil, buttered on the top with some side to side so the foil does not dry out during cooking. Place each piece of beef on a foil lined roasting pan. Use the foil to lift the meat from the pan and place on the top rack of the oven. After 45 minutes of high temperature, place the beef on top rack of the oven, and let rest at least 15 minutes. When ready to cook, place squash on a baking sheet and lightly brush with water. Bake at 300 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, uncover, and let sit for 15 minutes if the squash is browned, then transfer to an oiled roasting rack. Return to oven for 5 more minutes, or until squash is done. When done, remove from oven. While meat is on the rack to finish cooking rice, combine the soy sauce, vinegar, white pepper, yellow squash, and miso sauce in a small bowl. Place the dish in a roasting pan, and add hot water to the roasting pan to come 1/4 way up the sides of the pan. Bake on middle rack of the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until desired doneness. Serve over brown rice.

Random Ingredients: ice,chunky salsa,bicarbonate soda,tart apple,pita bread,creme de cacao,bread
title: Mountain Dew Bread Pita Sandwich and Apple Salad in a Pockets
ingredients: 4 tablespoons creme de cacao, liqueur | 6 slices crusty bread | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 cup tart apple, sliced thinly | 4 tablespoons chunky salsa | 4 tablespoons creme de cacao, liqueur | 1 cup bread, slices | 3 small gherkins, sliced thinly ( optional )
instructions: Toast bread slices under broiler until crisp. Combine bicarb soda and 1/2 cup water and stir in creme de cacao. Pour over baked bread and top with apple and salsa. Chill until well chilled. Serve with creme de cacao, topping if you like. To make creme de cacao dressing, place 4 - 5 tablespoons of creme de cacao into a small bowl stir in 1/2 cup hot water, then stir in extra creme de cacao. For the croutons, toast bread slices under broiler until lightly crusty. Brush with extra crema de cacao, and top with sliced gherkin sticks.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,cauliflower floret,fruit,brown bread,superfine sugar,french bread
title: Cauliflower and Toasted French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs cauliflower florets | sugar | 2 tablespoons brown breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 cup dried fruits
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Slice french bread on both sides, then lay on rack over a baking pan. Bake for about 30 minutes, then cool. Remove toasted bread from pan, and cut into small squares. In a large bowl, mix cauliflower with ¼ lb sugar, ¼ lb brown bread crumbs or ¼ teaspoon mustard seeds, and dried fruits. Spoon into french crumbs, and then sprinkle bread squares generously with french crumbs. Replace french bread pieces.

title: Italian Asparagus on Red Bell Peppers and Asparagus
ingredients: 20 asparagus spears, trimmed | 12 ounces red bell peppers, cored, seeded and cut into strips | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place a steamer basket over a pot of boiling water.

title: Easy Falafel
ingredients: 1 can chickpea flour | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce | sliced green bell pepper
instructions: Stir chickpea flour in a bowl with a fork. Separate lettuce into individual leaves and place them in separate bowls. Add pepper slices to the bowl and coat with flour.

title: Scottish Ribs
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs beef short ribs | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour, blend or 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs | 4 tablespoons onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons anchovies | 2 teaspoons ground nutmeg | 1 cup good tea | 1/2 teaspoon whole wheat flour, blend or 1/2 teaspoon breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/2 tablespoon 1 % table cream or 1/2 teaspoon milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Cut each rib in half and place on a rack in a baking pan. Combine all of the ingredients, except for the beef, in a large bowl, and using your hands, rub and spread the mixture over the ribs. Bake the short ribs for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Serve with a little stock or a vegetable stew and the stock for a lighter dish. For a thicker mixture, cook the beef in a separate pan for 15 or 20 minutes or until it is tender, removing from the pan and set aside to cool. For a thicker mixture, cook the beef until it is tender.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,quinoa,black bean,pineapple juice,cooking oat,almond extract
title: Quinoa Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked quinoa | 1/2 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can pineapple in juice, drained with juice reserved | 1 package mascarpone cheese, cubed | 1 tablespoon almond extract | cooking oats, as needed
instructions: Combine the quinoa, black beans, tuna, mascarpone cheese and almond extract in a salad bowl. Add just enough quick cooking oats to bind the cheese and mix lightly. Serve.

title: Sugar Snap Pea-Stuffed Wontons
ingredients: 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: If using frozen pea pods use frozen peas in a small dish, thaw at rm temp before using. Stir sugar snaps into bowl of ice water to completely dissolve cornstarch.

title: The Original Curry Flavor
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice or ( 12 ounce ) can vodka, if you prefer. if you are not using vodka, you may need to add some. i usually add about 3 tablespoons. do not use ketchup because ketchup is extremely hot. you may not use any flavoring.
instructions: Empty contents of can into a large saucepan. Over a low heat, stir in the tomato juice or vodka. Use as gravy to dip veggies, or serve hot over hot cooked egg noodles.

title: Mexican Carrots and Truffles (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3 medium carrots, peeled, cut on the diagnol in vertical julienne | 2 tablespoons pimento | 1 tablespoon italian crema ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup mexican crema ( optional )
instructions: Using a 2 quart crock pot, dump all ingredients into crock pot. Cover. Cook on high 4 - 5 hours or on high 4 - 6 hours. When it is cooked, switch to low heat and add cream and crema if using. I add a little sour cream for richness. You might want to use the crema to thin the cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: wheat pastry flour,marinara sauce,brussels sprout,thyme sprig
title: Brussels Sprouts Saute
ingredients: 1/2 lb brussels sprout | 1 tablespoon whole wheat pastry flour | 2 cups marinara sauce | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprigs
instructions: Trim the sprouts and cut into 2 inch pieces. In a medium saute pan add the sprouts and sprinkle with the flour. Season with thyme and saute until tender. Add the marinara to the sprouts, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Mango Mania and Porcini Mushroom Entree
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried porcini mushrooms, soaked and chopped ( chanterelles ) | 2 ripe mangoes, peeled, pitted and diced | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 can enchilada sauce | 4 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the drained porcini mushrooms, mangoes, salt and enchilada sauce. Place in the refrigerator to allow flavors to develop, about 15 - 20 minutes. Cut lime wedges into wedges when ready to serve. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Creamy Carrot and Shiitake Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup baby carrots, with peel | 1/2 cup shiitake mushrooms, shiitake caps, cleaned well stems discarded, caps cut into 1/8-inch wedges | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, firmly packed | 1/3 cup low-fat greek yogurt, stirred
instructions: In blender, combine carrots, mushrooms, cilantro and yogurt, blend until smooth. Pour into soup pot and bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,chicken broth,lime leaf,salsa,beef chuck roast,milk chocolate,jalapeno pepper juice,ice water
title: Lime Grass Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 whole boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups salsa | 3 tablespoons canned jalapeno pepper juice | 1/4 cup fresh lime leaves, torn | 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth | 3/4 cup ice water | 3/4 ounce milk chocolate, chopped
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Season the black pepper on all sides of the beef.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,salmon fillet,beef tenderloin steak,cucumber,za'atar spice mix,german chocolate,watermelon,ziti pasta
title: Beef Tenderloin With Ziti
ingredients: 1 ziti pasta, cooked al dente | 2 beef tenderloin steaks, about 3/4 inch thick | 1 cup zesty french chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons watermelon, peeled and cubed | 1 cucumber, chopped | 4 watercress or 4 english cucumbers, chopped | 1 tablespoon za'atar spice mix | 1 pinch cayenne | 1/2 cup shredded german sweet chocolate
instructions: Prepare zappa. Remove the rib roast and netting from the rib roast. Reserve the rib roast with the cooking juices. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat, add the grated zappa, and lightly brown the beef for about 5 minutes on each side. Transfer the cooked zappa to a plate, leaving the juices in the pan. Add the chopped meat and set aside. To the skillet, add the chocolates and watermelon.

Random Ingredients: dill,ranch dressing mix,yellow white corn,lime,grape,yeast,baking soda
title: Easy Texas Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds yellow ( or other ) corn, kernels and husks removed, or more to taste | 1 package dry yeast, divided | 5 cups freshly grated muir glen fritters, divided | 2 limes, juiced | 1 jar grape flavored limes, drained | 3 cups dry ranch dressing mix | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Line a deep 11x7 inch pan with parchment paper. Line the baking sheet with foil. Butter the pan and place in the oven to warm while you make the bread. Place the corn kernels in a large bowl with water to cover and let them soak until very soft, about 5 minutes, then drain them and set aside in a colander to drain completely. Mash the corn kernels as best you can, using a masher or hand mixer.

title: Jumbo Shells With Sugar and Caramelized Onion
ingredients: 1 package jumbo pasta shells | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon sugar substitute ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Cook prawns in lightly salted boiling water for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and drain. In hot oil in a large fry pan, sprinkle shell with sugar substitute. When shell turns brown, remove to paper towels to drain. Pour the caramelized onion into the pan and cook slowly, stirring constantly and scraping up all the stuck bits. Cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute longer.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,self rising flour,corn tortilla chip
title: Homemade Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 3 cups self-rising flour, divided | 36 corn tortilla chips, divided | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup flour with 3 cups of self rising flour in a bowl. Mix thoroughly. Roll tortillas in the remaining flour until coated with the mixture. Heat oil in a skillet on medium heat. Dip each tortilla into the hot non stick oil for 1 - 2 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Drain on a paper towel. Sprinkle with chili garlic sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,brie cheese,lobster tail,vanilla,poppy seed,beef bouillon cube,cream cheese
title: Lobster and Brie Stuffed Brie
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 lb brie cheese, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1/2 teaspoon instant beef base instant bouillon or 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 4 tablespoons strained cream cheese | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nut
instructions: Preheat broiler or light. Beat cream cheese to soften. Add remaining filling ingredients except nuts. Spread onto a baking sheet to coat the side. Chill in the refrigerator until firm. Cut the cheese with a sharp knife and place in a shallow dish. Shape the cheese mixture into a 12 inch circle, sprinkling each circle with nuts before baking. Broil or sprinkle the top with additional nuts. Broil until puffed and golden, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black olive,yellow potato,grain rice,marjoram,broth,green cardamom pod,lettuce leaf
title: Lebanese Potato, Olive and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow potatoes ( about 3 medium or 1 7-oz. potatoes ) | 1 cup long grain rice ( preferably basmati ) | 4 cups broth ( vegetarian broth ) | 5 ounces green cardamom pods | 7 ounces black olives, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | lettuce leaf ( preferably lemon or lime )
instructions: Boil the potatoes until well cooked but still firm, drain and cut into 1/2 by 1 inch/1/2 inch strips. Preheat grill. Bring broth to a boil in a large saucepan and throw in the cardamom pods and cook for 20 seconds. Throw in the olives and cook for a minute. Toss potatoes with broth and seasonings. Arrange in a shallow serving dish and cook under the grill until golden brown on all sides. Serve warm either warm or at room temperature.

title: Peasant Girls' Bites
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 slice fresh ginger root, peeled and finely chopped | 1 slice provolone cheese, finely chopped
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over low heat. Stir in the ginger and provolone cheese, and continue to cook until cheese is melted into the mixture. Remove from heat, and allow to cool completely.

title: South African Salmon (Jamaican)
ingredients: 1 kg salmon fillet, boned and skinned | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 teaspoons hot pepper | 1/4 cup cake flour | green onion, sliced for garnish
instructions: Place the fish skin side down on a heatproof tray, and add all the other ingredients to the tray. Cover with cling wrap leaving a little gap at the top and a heavy baking paper on the top. Bake at 160c for 20 minutes. Serve with green onion.

title: Easy Creamy Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 1 package cream-style cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place chicken breasts in a baking dish, and bake for 30 minutes. Pour cottage cheese over chicken, and bake 30 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,chicken tender,anchovy,chicken bouillon cube,wine vinegar
title: Hot Cheese Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken tenders ( about 10 oz. each, each cut into 6 servings ) | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped pickled artichoke ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese | 1 -2 anchovy ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 2/3 cup chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Place chicken tenders between 2 sheets of plastic wrap. Using a meat mallet, pound tenders to 1/8 thick. Arrange chicken in a 1 quart baking dish. Sprinkle evenly with pickled artichoke slices and monterey jack cheese. Using a double layer of plastic wrap, roll up each chicken roll to enclose filling. Arrange chicken and roll up tightly. Repeat process to make another 1 1/2 to 2 dozen chicken tenders. Cover and let stand in refrigerator about 20 minutes or up to 2 hours. Preheat oven to 375°f. Dissolve bouillon cube in 1 1/2 cups hot water, if desired. Cut chicken into 1 inch pieces and arrange on a rack set in a roasting pan. Drizzle with bouillon mixture. Sprinkle evenly with coarsely chopped anchovies. Cover and bake 35 - 40 minutes, or until tender. Remove from oven and turn tenders to evenly coat with sauce. Serve hot with tortillas or as a side dish. Enjoy.

title: Gulabeesh
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine yogurt, horseradish, ginger, salt, and pepper in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,coconut cream,onion soup mix,soymilk,shiitake mushroom
title: Vegan French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 cup fat-free soymilk | 300 ml coconut cream | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup shiitake mushroom, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mushrooms in a sauce pan, bringing to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes, or until shiitakes rise to the top. Serve with grated parmesan cheese, if desired, or use in other recipes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,lettuce leaf,beef steak,balsamic vinaigrette,red chile pepper,cardamom pod,colby monterey jack cheese,chipotle powder
title: Shredded Pepper Swiss Steak With Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinaigrette | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons hot red chile peppers | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 1/4 pounds beef round steak, sliced across the grain into strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinaigrette, divided | 4 beef bouillon cubes or other beef broth | 16 lettuce leaves, and tops if desired | 24 large red-leaf pickled jalapeno peppers, thinly sliced, or to taste
instructions: Whisk 1/2 cup balsamic vinaigrette, cardamom pods, chiles, and 2 teaspoons beef broth and 1 teaspoon bouillon cubes in a large bowl to blend. Layer shredded cheese in a second large bowl.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,baking powder,banana,cumin,tortilla chip,grand marnier
title: Chayote and Banana Chip Salad
ingredients: 4 cups finely chopped baby bok choy | 3 large ripe bananas, cut in 1-inch chunks | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup sweet tandoori cumin ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon mild toasted cumin | 1 cup of coarsely crushed tortilla chips ( or use as many crunchy chips as desired ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Cook and stir bok choy in 2 cups water for 4 to 10 minutes, just until bright green and just tender. Drain in a colander and pat dry with paper towels. Cook bananas 1 at a time over medium heat, stirring constantly with a spatula, until just tender. Remove bananas and plunge into cheesecloth to drain oil. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile for dressing, add grand marnier and cumin and stir to combine. Toss with cooled bok choy and season well. Pour dressing over bananas and sprinkle with toasted cumin and toasted chips.

title: Parchment paper
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Soak rice in hot water for 20 minutes. Drain. While rice is soaking, heat oil in a skillet over low heat. Add rice and fry for 5 minutes. Turn over and fry for 5 minutes or until lightly browned and sticky. Add cayenne.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,almond paste,basil pesto,pumpkin puree,red food coloring,fava bean,beef sirloin,plain flour
title: Pumpkin Pesto Baked Beef
ingredients: 500 g jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons almond paste ( from tube ) | 1/2 large red food coloring | 250 ml prepared basil pesto | 350 g beef sirloin | 1/2 cup plain flour | 400 g pumpkin puree | 1 cup frozen fava beans ( cooked )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Rub red food coloring over the meat. Place sliced meat in a roasting dish with enough water or olive oil to just wet it. Slice or shred meat into bite sized pieces. Cover and place in the oven for 30 minutes. Add the mango, pesto and flour. Cover with the brown paste from Tube then bake for 15 minutes. Add frozen fava beans during the last 10 minutes of baking. Serve this with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: yeast,curry powder,serrano chilies,green onion,celery salt,coleslaw mix,red kidney bean
title: Jamaican-Style Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 lb coleslaw mix | 1 small green onion, diced | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon mild curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt | 1 package frozen yeast | 2 cans red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Prepare the coleslaw mix, in a big bowl, toss with onion, chilies, curry powder, celery salt. Slice coleslaw with scissors or in a cheese grinder. Mix well. Spread mixture on baking sheet and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, about 1 hour. Slice remaining green onion and add to crockpot along with drained kidney beans. Set crockpot on low and allow to heat through until beans are hot and bubbly. Do not let it boil.

title: Easy French Fry Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: In a small bowl mix ketchup, tomato paste and ketchup well. Let stand for two hours before using to allow flavors to blend. This is great over cooked egg or noodles, or chicken.

title: Simple Pineapple Butter
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple chunks | 2 tablespoons butter or margarine, melted
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill for several hours.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,macadamia nut oil substitute olive,mustard powder,rump steak,icing sugar,dijon mustard
title: Grilled Macadamia Nut Crusted Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump steak, trimmed of excess fat | 1/2 cup macadamia nut oil substitute ( olive oil ) | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 3/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 -2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Score meat as desired.

title: Lebanese Beef Ribs With Lentils
ingredients: 1 can red lentils ( i use red pinto, but i've added other yellow lentils ) | 2 fresh red chiles, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs beef ribs, bone in, trimmed
instructions: Rinse the lentils and remove any debris. Place the lentils in a large saucepan with enough water to cover them by around 2 inches and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered until the lentils are tender, stirring occasionally. Add the chiles and continue to cook, covered over low heat 10 minutes or until the chiles are softened. Transfer the chili to a food processor. Add the ribs to the saucepan and coat with their cooking liquid. Cook over medium high heat until the ribs are done, 10 to 15 minutes, depending on the thickness. Serve in bowls as part of a main entree.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,chickpea,canadian bacon,feta cheese,italian sausage,vegetable shortening,flat leaf parsley
title: Canadian Bacon and Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon | 1/2 lb italian sausage, preferably extra strength | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 lb frozen mixed beans, defrosted and drained | 1/3 cup chickpea puree or 1/3 cup crushed chickpeas | 1/4 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Trim fat from cheese, then cut into chunks. Cut bacon into thick slices and fry with sausages until browned on all sides.

title: Crispy Chilli and Beef Hash
ingredients: 375 g beef mince | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon sweet chili oil | 1 tablespoon dried chili oil ( sesame oil ) | 1 cup corn chips ( coarsely crushed )
instructions: Combine the beef, chilli paste and sweet chilli oil in a large bowl. Spoon the mixture into hot oil in a wok or frypan, and fry for about 3 minutes or until the meat is cooked thoroughly. Stir in the dry chilli oil and return the hash to the pan. Sprinkle with crushed corn chips. Serve immediately.

title: Agua Fresca
ingredients: 10 jalapeno peppers, stemmed | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup instant espresso | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Place peppers in microwave safe bowl or saucepan with apple juice. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes or until very tender. Stir in espresso, fish sauce, fenugreek and cinnamon. Cover and cook on high 30 seconds or until hot. Cool to room temperature. Store in airtight container for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: ghee,coconut cream,hazelnut,baking powder,cherry tomato,espresso,cooking onion,cheddar cheese
title: Creamy Hazelnut Macaroon Cake
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup sliced cooking onion | 500 g ripe hazelnuts, toasted and peeled | 4 cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 teaspoons instant espresso ( optional ) | 1 cup coconut cream ( not cream or powdered dairy sweetener ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 500 g low fat cheddar cheese ( cut into chunks )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190c. Grease and line with baking paper a 9x13 cake pan. In a medium sized pan, melt the ghee, or butter, and cook the onion until translucent, about 5 minutes. Set aside. Spread the hazelnuts onto a baking tray and roast at a temperature of 160c for about 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from the oven, allow to cool for ten minutes, then peel and chop with the cherry tomatoes. Set aside. In a pan, combine the espresso powder and coconut cream or milk. Bring to a boil until it has nearly completely cooked away, about 5 minutes. Take off the heat, and add the nuts, and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, stir together the baking powder and baking soda in a shallow bowl. Spread the cooled cake mix over the bottom of the prepared cake pan and spread out evenly. Next, spread the cooled hazelnut paste on the cake layer, spreading evenly. Top with the cheddar cheese and bake at 190c for about 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,dark sesame oil,cream tartar,phyllo dough,walnut
title: Ziti With Sesame and Nut Crust
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo dough | 2 cups walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 1/2 cups cream of tartar | 1 lb ziti pasta
instructions: Boil water for pasta. Meanwhile, add walnuts to saucepan of boiling water. When they are all blanched, remove from heat. Drain pasta. Stir fry nuts in 1 teaspoon sesame oil over low heat for 20 minutes. Transfer to a bowl with a slotted spoon. Reserve the rest of the sesame oil for another use. Drain ziti, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water, and add drained pasta to skillet. Add cream of tartar. Cover and heat on low until the mixture begins to bubble. Reduce heat to medium low and add all but 1/3 of the walnuts. Cook the ziti in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain ziti well, then place in a large bowl. Add cream of tartar to walnut mixture. Add remaining walnuts to walnut mixture. Stir until well combined. Place a sheet of filo on a flat surface. Spread 1/3 of the ziti on top followed by 1/3 of the nuts on top. Keep going with the layer of ziti, then top with the second filo sheet.

title: My Favourite Yummy Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated cotija cheese | 1 tablespoon dried thyme
instructions: Mix together and serve. Delicious.

title: Easiest Squychees to Make
ingredients: 1 package jumbo dried pasta shells | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Cook and drain the noodles as directed on the package. Reserve 1 cup of noodles cooking water. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix cream of mushroom soup, saffron, and 1 cup of the reserved cooking water into hot drained noodles. Fold in the marshmallows creating a doughy ball. Line a 10x15 inch baking pan with the remaining noodles. Pour the mushroom mixture into the baking pan. Top with the reserved cooking water. Bake for 20 minutes or until bubbly and the top is golden brown.

title: Fiesta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh bean sprout | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 6 ounces ranch dressing
instructions: Boil water of bean sprouts in a large pot for about ten minutes, or until just slightly soft. Drain. Remove sprouts from water with a slotted spoon.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,wheat flour,lettuce leaf,rhubarb,sun tomato,red chili,canadian bacon,caster sugar
title: Rhubarb Wrapped Garlic and Canadian Bacon Salad
ingredients: 1 head garlic, cloves peeled ( leave intact ) | 1 red chili, seeded and finely chopped ( hot pepper ) | 2/3 cup whole wheat flour | 2/3 cup caster sugar | 1 large head of garlic, unpeeled ( head ) | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato, finely sliced ( oil-packed ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh rhubarb | 1 small head of lettuce leaf ( leaves or a large handful. i prefer baby mixed cabbage, torn leaves )
instructions: Cut off top portion of garlic cloves and discard. Mince cloves with a very sharp knife, peel and finely chop garlic. Heat oven to 350°f grease a large baking sheet and line with foil. Wrap garlic with foil.

title: Spicy Sriracha BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 4 scallions, finely chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons finely chopped fresh mace | 8 ounces sriracha hot sauce, or as needed
instructions: Combine scallions, mace, and hot sauce in a small bowl. Chill 1 hour before using as desired.

title: Quick and Easy Lamb & Pineapple Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 4 chicken breasts, chopped | 1/2 cup unsweetened pineapple juice, drained | 1/3 cup guacamole | 2 cups chopped bok choy | 4 leaves bok choy, chopped
instructions: Mix flour and salt in a bowl or pie plate. Dip chicken in the flour mixture and pat dry with paper towels. Combine pineapple juice, shrimp and guacamole in a medium bowl. Tear 3 leaves bok choy and cut bok choy into 2 or 3 sections. In a flat bottomed skillet, fry chicken over medium heat for about 5 minutes, or until no longer pink inside.

Random Ingredients: creme de cassis,danish blue cheese,kaffir lime leaf,cardamom seed,red potato,mexican cheese,pasta sauce
title: Chilled Potato and Cheese Salad With Salsas
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, about 2 lbs, scrubbed | 1/4 cup reduced-fat mexican cheese blend or 1/4 cup mexican blend cheese | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves or 2 -3 large limes | 4 tablespoons creme de cassis or 4 tablespoons other brandy | 1 cup pasta sauce, prepared ( ketchup ) | 3 cardamom seeds, crushed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup danish blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cut a 6 x 4 deep slabs of potato in half lengthwise. Cut each slab in half again widthwise. Put potatoes in a large bowl and set aside for 15 minutes to absorb liquid. Drain and blot dry. Place potatoes in a bowl and mash with a potato masher or fork until well chunky, about 1 minute. Add cheese, lime leaves, creme de cassis, and 1/2 cup prepared pasta sauce and gently mix together. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Spread potato on a lightly oiled baking sheet and toast in a 350 degree f oven for 45 minutes, or until tender. Cool and cut into 1/2 x 3/4 squares. Spoon cheese mixture onto potato squares. Sprinkle with blue cheese and heat at once in a preheated 450 degree f oven for 2 minutes on each side. If using a baking sheet that has been lightly oiled, turn slices over and allow bubbling to cook on the other side for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, then turn and cook on the second side for 30 to 60 seconds. Serve with lettuce and tomato sauce.

title: Pasta With Spiced Beef and Spices
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Cook beef until browned.

title: Leg of Lamb with Parsley
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds leg of lamb | 2/3 cup chopped fresh parsley | 2/3 cup white pepper, or to taste | 4 ice cubes
instructions: Place the leg of lamb in a large pot and cover with just enough water to barely cover the lamb. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, 90 minutes to 2 hours. When meat is quite tender, remove from heat to cool slightly, about 1 hour. Remove bones. Pull meat into shreds using two forks. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Stir parsley and white pepper into the cooked lamb. Place ice cubes into a baking dish large enough to accommodate it in a single layer. Cover the baking dish with plastic wrap. Place meat in the dish, and cover with plastic wrap. Place dish under oven broiler for 5 minutes at 400 degrees f. Uncover pudding, and immediately place the baking dish under broiler again. Broil until the top of the pudding is deep brown, about 10 minutes.

title: Baked Oranges in Mustard
ingredients: 12 oranges, peeled, but with the membrane cut away ( about 12-1/2 oz each ) | 3/4 cup prepared mustard | 1 1/2 cups orange marmalade, preferably dark ( or apricot preserves )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in a shallow baking dish with a lip, lightly prick oranges with a fork. Insert a rubber spatula, if using, under the skin. Add to the dish. Bake, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes, or until fruit is dry. Turn oranges and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until they turn a rich golden brown color. Stir in the mustard and apricot preserves before serving.

Random Ingredients: oven deli chicken,limeade concentrate,sun tomato oil,ranch dressing mix,phyllo dough
title: Easy & Delicious Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped roasted deli chicken | 8 sheets frozen pastry dough, thawed | 1 envelope ranch dressing mix | 1 1/2 cups chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 cup frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray cookie sheets with nonstick cooking spray. Place chicken in a large bowl. Add the dressing mix, tomato and juice and mix well. Roll out the pastry to 12x8 in size rectangle. Brush the dough with the reserved limeade concentrate, and roll the pastry up tightly. Place one end down on cookie sheets and brush with the limeade concentrate. Using a sharp knife cut into strips about 2 inches wide and 2 inches long. Repeat with the other end of the pastry.. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp. Serve hot or warm.

title: Cheese Filling for Taco Bell 'Nachos
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cheese ( taco bell italian blend ) | 1 1/2 cups milk ( more or less )
instructions: Combine cheese and milk in a mixing bowl. Blend until mixture is creamy and soft. Add seasoning to cheese mixture and mix well. Store in the refrigerator or use in your favorite taco shells or burritos.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,southern comfort,dark chocolate,taco seasoning,walnut oil,escarole,cheddar cheese
title: Mexican Style Cheese & Walnut Salad
ingredients: 1/2 head escarole, chopped into thin strips | 1/2 cup finely crumbled cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon chopped walnut oil | 1 tablespoon light spicy comfort | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 dash taco seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Chill before serving or keep in the fridge. Serve with tortilla chips, or on crackers and/or with assorted crackers.

Random Ingredients: french bread,dill weed,pasta sauce,port wine,blueberry,black pepper,butternut squash
title: Wild West Vegetable Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cubed, peeled butternut squash | 1 can pasta sauce | 1/2 cup sliced port wine | 1 small portugese mushroom with leaves, sliced | 1 cup sliced fresh blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, toss together the cubed butternut squash, pasta sauce, and port. Season with black pepper and dill weed. Stir in the mushrooms and cook on medium low until mushrooms soften, about 4 minutes. Turn off heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Cut the sandwich diagonally into 8 slices. Spoon the topping onto the top of each piece.

title: Spicy Afghan Beans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons margarine | 2 1/2 cups dried chili without beans | 3 cardamom pods, crushed | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, grind
instructions: Heat margarine in a non stick skillet. Fry the chilie and cardamom on very low heat for 3 minutes or until it is reduced by half. Stir in the tomato puree and simmer 5 minutes. Serve over plain yogurt.

Random Ingredients: mustard,colby monterey jack cheese,xanthan gum,french dressing
title: Low Calorie Baked French Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry mustard | 1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, grated coarsely | 2 loaves french dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in large bowl and toss with whisk until well blended. Pour into a sprayed large baking sheet. Slice bread in half diagonally and arrange on top. Bake at 400 degrees f for 18 - 20 minutes or until bread is tender. Serve warm.

title: A Unique Fruity Drumsticks
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings ( about 4.500gram ) | 150 g fresh ginger ( about 7.25cm x 3.5cm ) | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | topping ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken wings in a large saucepan. Add enough water to just cover the wings to a depth of 2, and bring to the boil over a high heat. Remove the lid, add the ginger, allspice and pepper. Reduce the heat to low, and partially cover with a lid or packet. Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until all the chicken is cooked. Stir the drumsticks occasionally during the cooking time. Drain any accumulated juices. Serve the drumsticks on top of fresh fruit or frozen fruit, drizzled with low fat icing if you like.

title: Walnut Pesto Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup pesto sauce | 2 -4 flour tortillas | 1/4 cup walnuts | 3 -5 tablespoons strong coffee
instructions: Place tortilla on work surface spread pesto sauce liberally on tortilla. Sprinkle with walnuts. Wrap tightly. Microwave 30 seconds per side, rotating every 5 seconds, until hot and lightly toasted. Cut into triangles. Serve with hot chips.

title: Gramma's Fried Zucchini With soba
ingredients: 2 zucchini, thinly sliced and chopped | 1 package soba noodles | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons oil
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until al dente. Drain. Heat oil in a skillet. Mix noodles, zucchini, graham cracker crumbs, and sauteeed noodles on the skillet with the oil, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: almond,strawberry gelatin,reynolds wrap foil,oat,serrano pepper,guinness stout,rye bread
title: Kerry Berry Jellies
ingredients: 1 package frozen rye bread, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 10 ounces frozen strawberries in syrup or 10 ounces frozen whole berries | 2 tablespoons guinness stout | 2 ounces strawberry gelatin | 3 ounces oats | reynolds wrap foil, for hanging | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: In a large bowl, combine rye bread and frozen strawberries. Add guinness and knead into a soft dough. Place into a container and freeze until frozen solid, at least 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,pizza crust,green onion,rye bread,cucumber,coconut,surimi,irish cream
title: Vegan Pierogi Sandwich
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 200 g surimi | 1 cup chicken stock cube | 1 slice cucumber ( thin slices ) | 1 -2 green onion ( depending on taste preferences ) | 4 slices rye bread | 1 tablespoon grated coconut | 1 tablespoon irish cream
instructions: First preheat wok. Layer ingredients as follows, toppings on pizza crust. Spread horsey pysi sauce on. Top with toppings as desired.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,green chilies,almond,mustard powder,red chili pepper
title: Lebanese Anise Seed (Yemphal Salata)
ingredients: 2 cups whole blanched almonds | 3/4 cup roasted green chilies | 6 -8 anise seed | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/4 cup dried red chili pepper
instructions: Grind almonds and chilies to a fine powder. Grind to obtain a fine paste. Keep aside. Powder aniseed in a mortar. Keep aside. Grind mustard powder in a pot. Keep aside. In the same pot, heat oil on high flame. Add a pinch of salt. Add mustard powder. Allow it to crackle. Add mustard mixture. Stir and saute for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Sprinkle roasted sesame seeds or roasted coconut powder. Allow to cool. Apply roasted green chilies by pouring a little milk on the masala. Serve chilled with a bowl of yoghurt on the side. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,fiddlehead,tomato basil pasta sauce,beef bouillon cube,celery,chicken breast half
title: Italian Wedding Soup
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes with basil pasta sauce | 1 can chicken breast halves - cooked and cubed | 1/4 cup ground fiddleheads | 1/4 cup celery, chopped | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 3/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: In a slow cooker combine stewed tomatoes, chicken, fiddleheads, celery, bouillon cube and pine nuts. Cover and cook on low setting for 6 - 8 hours. Add more water if needed to achieve desired consistency.

title: Roasted Feta Cheese and Herbs Spread
ingredients: 250 g feta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Preheat your oven to 230 c or 400 f and grease a baking sheet lightly. Place the feta cheese and herbes de provence all around the outside of the baking sheet. Pour on the oil and sprinkle a little bit of the herbs on top. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes at 230 c or 400 f, until feta has melted and it becomes creamy to your liking.

title: Raspberry Vinegar
ingredients: 6 cups raspberries vinegar | 2 tablespoons almond extract | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, minced
instructions: Wash and drain raspberries. Cover with fresh water and let stand 1 hour. Place in a glass jar or container with a tight seal lid. In a glass bowl, combine almond extract and chives. Pour over the drained raspberries, toss to coat evenly.

title: Easy Roast Beef With Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb eye of round roast ( you can also use sirloin steak ) | cooking oat ( for the basting sauce, use gluten-free if you wish ) | 1 can tomato sauce ( any brand ) | 3/4 cup light-cooking oats ( instant or quick-cooking ) | 1 cup dried pretzel ( cut in half or 2 whole wheat pices, your choice of size ) | 1 teaspoon clear honey ( optional )
instructions: Toast the bread in the oven and let dry slightly. Pre heat oven to 275 degrees. Spread a bit of cooking spray on the bottom of a roasting pan. Pour the baked toasts on the pan. Cover with foil. To braise, pour the tomato sauce evenly over the roast. Sprinkle the rye bread crumbs over the roast. Cover tightly with foil and place in fridge for at least 4 hours to let the liquids cook out of the beef. Bake the beef in the oven for about 3 hours. Remove from oven and baste with the heated tomato sauce. To serve, remove the beef from the pan and serve separately, allowing guests to make their own hors d'oeuvres with the hors d'oeuvres, and drizzle the beef on top of the hors d'oeuvres.

title: Souffle in Fragrant Fruit & Coconut. (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 4 -6 large firm fruits, such as rhubarb, apricots, papaya and apple, peeled, cored and sliced into 3/4-inch slices. use a citrus peeler to thinly cut the fruit up into very small pieces. (note, if you can find fruit peeler in your local grocery store, it's pretty easy to peel them. )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Arrange fruit decoratively on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle top with salt and pepper. Bake until dry, about 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: French Canadian Turnip Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb turnip | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( grated ) | 4 -10 leaves fresh italian parsley ( packed ) | cayenne pepper | shortening | beans
instructions: Cook turnip in boiling water until tender, about 15 - 20 mins drain and cool and slice into 1/2 inch slices, about 1/4 inch thick. Mix in 1/2 cup syrup, cheese parsley and cayenne, coating all pieces well. Heat shortening in skillet over medium heat. Add the turnip and cook. Drain and toss with remaining syrup. Garnish with beans and additional cheese.

title: Apple Crumble
ingredients: 500 g apples, small, peeled, cored and very finely cored | 250 g fresh sage, leaves picked or 100 g fresh sage, sprigs | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Line a large baking tray with parchment paper. Place the apples, sage and cornflour in a large bowl, tipping to coat. Spread into the prepared tray, then bake in oven for 30 minutes or until topping is golden and crispy. Serve sprinkled with a little more sage, if desired.

title: Homemade Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, finely crushed ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Put crushed graham cracker crumbs in a bowl. Mix in cream until the crumbs are crumbly. Add more cream if necessary.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,worcestershire sauce,corn tortilla,chili sauce,corn flake,water
title: Yum Yum-Yol-Yum Rice Wraps #RSC
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice, washed and drained | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons corn flakes | 1/2 cup water | 8 -10 corn tortillas ( or flour ) | 2 -3 tablespoons water
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Set aside. Add the chili sauce, worcestershire sauce and fluff the rice with a fork. Bring water to a boil over high heat. Add the cornflakes and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat and stir. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray or use a nonstick skillet. Add the rice and water then fold in the corn tortillas and serve hot. If you like, serve the rice warm with a bit of salsa or guacamole on the side. Enjoy.

title: Quick Thai Chili Poppers
ingredients: 4 thai chiles | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 teaspoon poppy seeds ( optional )
instructions: Peel your chilies and slice them crosswise into long thin strips. Place all ingredients in a large jar, cover tightly and shake to combine. This can be eaten cold or warm right away. Enjoy note, cooking time does not include chillies. If you cook this in a non stick skillet, heat oil over high heat just until a drop of water sizzles. Carefully remove from heat and ladle into bowlsful of chili. Serve with roasted or fried rice. Note, if you like your chili hotter, stir fry in oil only until a darker golden color.

title: Quinoa Smoked Fruit and Quinoa Salad(Gluten Free & Dairy Free)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( dry is recommended ) | 1/2 cup smoked fruit, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 1/2 cup dry instant quinoa | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Cook quinoa per pkg instructions. Drain and rinse quinoa in a colander, and return quinoa to skillet on medium heat.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast strip,wheat flour,romaine lettuce,red leaf lettuce,beer,maraschino cherry
title: Beer and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 cup shredded romaine lettuce | 1 cup shredded red leaf lettuce | 1/2 pound cooked chicken breast strips, chopped | 1/2 pound fresh maraschino cherries, chopped | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 cup ale or can italian-style beer | 1 romaine lettuce, for serving
instructions: Place the shredded lettuce in 4 salad bowls. Place the red leaf lettuce and chicken on top in a separate shallow dish. Sprinkle the maraschino cherries over the chicken and cherries. Dot with the whole wheat flour. Pour in the beer or beer, and stir. Allow the dish to marinate for at least 5 minutes each, or as long as 8 hours. Carefully place the salad plates onto dinner plates. Place some of the grilled chicken on top of the salad, and top with the romaine leaves.

title: Apple Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 small apple - peeled, cored and chopped | 1 teaspoon sesame
instructions: Separate cauliflower into florets and separate.

title: Diner's Hominy and Tzatziki
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces hominy, drained | 6 mint leaves, lightly packed | 3 tablespoons tzatziki | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 3 corn, kernels trimmed, steamed for 10 minutes | 1/4 cup apple juice | chopped nuts for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Rinse hominy under running water and drain. Place in a large deep skillet. Mince mint leaves. Combine 3 tbs of the tzatziki with the drippings from steeping the hominy, the mint leaves, and the rest of the tzatziki. Stir over low heat until heated through. Add the drained hominy and 1/4 c of apple juice. Cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes. Serve topped with chopped nuts and a drizzle of additional sauce. Variation, after draining the hominy, add the remaining apple juice and 1 - 2 tb corn oil. When heated through, add 3 kernels of the steamed corn and 1 1/2 tsp salt. Variation, substitute 3 cups frozen corn kernels for 1 c of the hominy. In a 12 pan, heat oil until it just starts to smoke.. Add corn and toss. Cover pan and cook for 5 minutes on low heat. Serve topped with chopped parsley and pita bread or eat with chips for a healthier meal.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,lemon juice,chili sauce,curry paste
title: Chicken Curry Dip II
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons curry paste, or to taste | 4 tablespoons sweet chili sauce, or to taste | 3 tablespoons lemon juice, or to taste
instructions: Mix chicken soup, curry paste, sweet chili sauce, and lemon juice together in a bowl.

title: Kumquat's Best Potatoes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 package bacon | 4 pounds yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 teaspoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place the canola oil in a large skillet, and place over medium heat. Cook and stir bacon until evenly brown. Pour bacon grease from skillet into a large resealable plastic bag. Drain the bacon slices, and place into the bag. Squeeze the excess bacon grease from the bag, and add bacon to the bag. Cook and stir potato cubes in the hot oil until coated with oil, 7 to 10 minutes. Pour hot pepper sauce over potatoes, and serve warm.

title: Rosemary Meringue Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg white, well beaten | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the egg whites, rosemary and rosemary in a bowl. Stir in the remaining ingredients until no lumps remain, then store in an airtight container at room temperature for upto 2 months.

title: Katherine's Texas Garden BBQ-Gravy
ingredients: 1 quart apple juice | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 zucchini, shredded | 1 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier, or other liqueur, or to taste | 1/2 cup brewed tea, or as needed
instructions: Whisk apple juice, 1 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper, 1 teaspoon seasoned salt, zucchini, grand marnier, and coffee together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,salt pepper,bread,beef eye,mustard seed,cake flour,cooking spray
title: Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 pound lean ground beef eye round | salt and pepper to taste | 1/2 cup bread, stale, cubed | 1 package dry taco seasoning | 1 cup cake flour, or as needed | cooking spray
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add mustard seed and cook briefly. Add beef and cook until browned. Season with salt and pepper. Add crumbled taco seasoning and stir. Spread the bread cubes on a baking sheet. Spray with cooking spray. Spray again with cooking spray and sprinkle with mustard seed. Bake in a preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Thai Oven Corn and Apricot Relish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely chopped peeled fresh lemongrass | 30 dried apricots | 40 corncobs, husk and silk removed
instructions: Combine lemon grass, apricots and corncobs in a medium bowl and sprinkle mixture of lemongrass mixture evenly on top. Cover with plastic wrap or a damp towel and let sit 30 minutes before drying in oven, covered with aluminum foil or parchment paper, on lowest rack of oven. Preheat oven to 200°f remove foil and parchment from mixture and bake 20 minutes. Turn off oven. Open oven door slightly and allow relish to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,lasagna noodle,chicken noodle soup mix,pineapple juice,basmati rice,pork loin
title: Hawaiian Pork and Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh pineapple juice | 2 packages chicken noodle soup mix | 1 lb boneless pork loin | 3 1/2 ounces basmati rice | 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Pour pineapple juice into the bottom of a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Sprinkle soup mix over pineapple juice, set aside. Place the pork in a large nonstick skillet. Sprinkle pork with salt and pepper. Cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and no longer pink inside. Remove with a slotted spoon. Place the noodles in the bottom of the baking dish. Place the pork on top of the noodles. Sprinkle the rice on top of pork. Arrange the beef over the noodles. Spoon the soup mixture over the beef and noodles. Arrange the remaining ingredients over the soup mixture. Cover tightly with foil, bake for 1 hour. Uncover, bake for another 15 minutes or until noodles are slightly browned and the sauce is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,cumin seed,lime zest,green bell pepper,black olive,currant,quince,mandarin orange
title: Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1/2 cup seedless quinces, cut into 1-inch wedges | 1 medium green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 large orange, quartered | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons currants ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried mandarin oranges, chopped | 2 tablespoons sliced black olives
instructions: Drain the soaked beans and quince. Combine the beans, quince, pepper, orange, cumin seeds and currants in a large salad bowl. Toss with mandarin oranges and olives. Serve warm.

title: Red Curry Paste, Like Shop Bought at Massaman's Secrets Food
ingredients: 1/2 cup light red curry paste, such as knorr | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Combine everything in a mortar and pestle over medium heat. Stirring constantly, bring the paste to a boil, allowing it to simmer without burning. Once it begins to thicken, remove from heat. Store in a screw top jar with a tight fitting lid. This is a great dip for chicken, pork or even vegetables.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,gruyere cheese,romaine lettuce leaf,feta cheese,white,cooky
title: Roquefort Gratin Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh small romaine lettuce leaves | 3/4 cup crumbled roquefort cheese | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 cup finely shredded gruyere cheese | 12 decorative frozen cheese cookies ( optional ) | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the romaine lettuce leaves on a baking sheet, and cut lengthwise into 1/3 thick slices. Spoon the cheese mixture onto the lettuce within the leaves of each. Sprinkle the gruyere cheese on top of the cheese, then dollop some of the cheese mixture onto each cheese cookie. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until evenly browned.

title: Spinach Chocolate Fudge
ingredients: 9 ounces baby spinach ( about 1 inch baby weight ) | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup ( or to taste, it's good )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. Wash the spinach and dry well using paper towels. Pour 1/4 cup chocolate syrup on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Spread the spinach evenly on the parchment paper. Spread with a spoonful of the chocolate syrup. Refrigerate until cool, then break into bite size pieces.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,blueberry,white sugar,confectioner sugar,cranberry,mozzarella cheese,cham sauce
title: Blueberry Apple Blueberry Fondue
ingredients: 1 can pitted cranberries | 1 1/4 cups apple cider | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup grated fresh mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh blueberries | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together the cranberries, apple cider, sugar, cheese, and confectioners' sugar. Stir in the blueberries. Transfer to a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, until slightly thickened, and the cheese has melted. Serve warm with fondue forks.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,graham cracker crumb,italian parsley,purpose flour,garlic paste,seasoning salt
title: Gravlax Mushroom Crumbs for Meat With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour ( any type ) | 1 pinch seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons dry mashed button mushrooms | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley | 1 tablespoon graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. In a mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, mushrooms, garlic garlic paste, parsley and graham cracker crumbs. Add the prepared gravy mixture and stir well. Shape into 2 balls and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for about 15 minutes or until well browned.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,sage,basil leaf,watermelon,green chili pepper,italian tomato,cream soup
title: Watermelon Fra Diavolo With Braggs and Parmesan
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese, fresh grated | 1 can cream soup | 1 cup italian tomatoes, diced | 1/2 cup watermelon, diced ( rind only ) | 1 green chili peppers ( or 1/8-1/4 teaspoon of each ) or 1 red jalapeno pepper ( or 1/8-1/4 teaspoon of each ) | 1/2 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients except basil and stir well. Cover and chill until cold. Serve over hot cooked pasta or rice and garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,pine nut,mostaccioli pasta,sesame seed,cucumber,kahlua
title: Giada's Mostaccioli Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 quart cooked and drained mostaccioli pasta | 1/2 small cucumber | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds | 1/4 cup toasted graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Grate cucumber and add to a large bowl. Add crushed graham cracker crumbs, graham cracker crumbs, kahlua and sesame seeds. Stir lightly. If not serving immediately, store in refrigerator, when ready to use. Note, to lightly toast sesame seeds, place one whole egg in a nonstick skillet and heat to medium, stirring just until they start to turn light golden brown. Add unto cooked mostaboli pasta, toss a few times until pasta begins to stick together.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,orange liqueur,catsup,orange juice concentrate,ramen noodle,red potato,mustard
title: Carnival Potato Packets
ingredients: 1 package smoked ramen noodles | 2 lbs small red potatoes, unpeeled and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice concentrate | 1 small orange, zest of | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Soak the ramen noodles in cold water for 3 - 5 minutes only. Drain and set aside. In a large nonreactive bowl, combine all ingredients except the noodles, potatoes, and mustard. Line an orange jar with foil, and place the noodles in the center. Pack the noodles around the oranges, and pack the noodles to make the packets. Wrap tightly in aluminum foil.

title: Japanese Mushrooms (Sushi)
ingredients: 1 pound shiitake mushrooms, cleaned, stems removed | 1 teaspoon cayenne, or to taste
instructions: Cut shiitake mushrooms into 1 inch pieces. Sprinkle with cayenne to taste. Serve hot.

title: Green Polenta
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat buttermilk | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 medium green pepper, finely chopped | 3 croissants, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine buttermilk and spinach in a medium sized mixing bowl, mix well. Stir in green pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
