Line a medium casserole dish with croissants, then cover with the sauce mixture. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until heated through and a nice brown crust forms.

title: Garam Masala Buns
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant chow mein noodles | 1 small cup shredded cauliflower | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the noodles in a large bowl and lightly mash them with a fork. Whisk in the cauliflower, salt, yeast and a couple t. Water until blended. Cover and refrigerate the buns for about 20 minutes. Strain the liquid and spread the mixture on the buns.

title: Feta Pasta With Lemon and Turmeric
ingredients: 3 cups cooked farfalle pasta ( bow ties ) | 1/2 cup feta, crumbled | 2 teaspoons lemon zest, minced | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 3 tablespoons black currants or 3 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Cook the pasta to package directions using 1/2 cup boiling water along with 1/4 of the feta. Drain pasta and reduce heat to low. Add lemon zest, turmeric, cardamom and remaining feta. Stir until well combined, adding black currants or raisins. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,worcestershire sauce,lime,sage leaf,rye bread
title: Grilled Rye Bread Tacos
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 finely grated lime | 1 finely chopped sage leaf
instructions: Cut bread in half crossways. Spread with tamari & worcester sauces. Grind rind into fine mio 2 or other ingredients. Spread with leafy side of lime, then sprinkle with sage. Place bread on wire rack to dry, then grill until crusty and crisp.

title: Zesty Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh salmon, bones removed | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix ( zesty italian or italian flavor ) | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt
instructions: Put the salmon pieces in a large resealable plastic bag. Add the italian dressing mix, curing salt, and seasoning salt, and shake to mix. Put the bag on the salmon with a little marinade in it. Seal bag and refrigerate for 2 to 8 hours, turning the bag occasionally. Remove salmon from marinade, reserving marinade, and grill on lightly oiled grill. Turn once. This meal can also be served with fresh bread or roasted vegetables if desired. Note, when buying canned salmon, they do tend to shrink during marinating time. So check often to make sure salmon is covered with marinade. When ready to eat fish, remove the tails from fish, pull them from the bones, and dice into bite size pieces. Arrange salmon pieces on a platter. Pour reserved marinade over the fish. Note, you may want to put in a saucepan or wok with a lid to help keep skin from drying out. This dish keeps well for up to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,red pepper paste,baby artichoke,lemon juice zest,rice,lite olive oil
title: Artichokes Fiji
ingredients: 1 lb baby artichokes | 1 1/2 cups rice | vegetable oil or lard | 3 red peppers, cut into chunks | 1 -2 serrano chili, roughly chopped | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: In a large skillet saute the artichokes in olive oil till artichokes are wilted and a little bit black and tender. Strain the liquid out of the artichokes. Return the liquid to the pan, add rice and season with salt. When rice is ready add artichokes. Cover, turn burner to very low, and cook for about 20 - 30 minutes until rice is cooked. Garnish with lemon rind, hot peppers, and serrano chiles. Serve as is or with a good pita bread.

title: Roasted Green Bean and Pumpkin Bake
ingredients: 400 g canned pumpkin | 400 g green beans, trimmed | 2 medium celery ribs, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c/350°f. Place pumpkin in oven to heat through. Cut beans in half and toss in a saucepan with celery. Pour off excess water and cook for 10 mins till tender.

Random Ingredients: pimento olive,curry paste,liquid smoke,chicken meat,bouquet garni,cornmeal,garbanzo bean
title: Easy Chickpea-Garbanzo-Flavoured Stew
ingredients: 1 cup dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1/4 cup liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic | 1 bouquet garni ( thyme, rosemary, sage, oregano... or other mixed spice )
instructions: Place dried garbanzo beans in a large pot. Cover with 8 cups water, and set heat to medium. Add liquid smoke and olive slices. Stir well, then cover the pot and cook for 20 minutes. Rinse the garbanzo beans and then place in a blender or food processor with a small amount of water, puree, and set aside. In the same pot, stir in the curry paste. Stir well, then set aside over medium low heat. When it starts to brown, stir in the cornmeal a tablespoon or two at a time. As you stir, the stew will thicken slightly. Turn mixture into a bowl or two or stir with a spoon, coating the chickpeas and then draining them of any excess. Stir in the garlic powder, and when the mixture is quite thick, remove from heat. Garnish with chopped thyme, rosemary, sage, oregano and pimento stuffed olives. Serve hot.

title: Russian Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups red wine ( i used a grape seed type ) | 12 bay seasoning ( i use 2 1/2 teaspoons ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Wash the wine and the bay seasoning in a sink of cold water until dried up. Combine all ingredients in a quart size pot. Simmer for an hour or more, stirring occasionally to ensure flavors blend. Serve at room temperature. This dressing can also be used as a sweet or sour dressing.

Random Ingredients: apple pie filling,russet potato,baking chocolate,orzo pasta,amaretto
title: Amaretto Orzotto #5FIX
ingredients: 6 ounces orzo pasta or 6 ounces vermicelli | 1 can apple pie filling | 1 package grated wafer rolls, such as russell | 1/4 lb grated russet potato | 1 ounce unsweetened baking chocolate
instructions: Cook orzo until al dente. Meanwhile, heat orzo in lightly salted boiling water for 8 minutes or until just tender. Drain. Using 2/3 cup orzo from cooking water, stir into the remaining ingredients. Heat through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili,mozzarella string cheese,taco seasoning mix,rice wine
title: Taco Rice Appetizers
ingredients: 10 loaves miniature shredded mozzarella string cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1 -2 tablespoon rice wine or 1 -2 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 chili ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f cut a rectangle about 1 inch thick, 2 or more inches deep, and 2 - 8 inch long by 2 inches or 3 inch long. Arrange three cheese block slices on top of each other on 1 long side of rectangle. Sprinkle taco seasoning mix on top of cheese blocks. Pour rice wine/sherry over cheese blocks. Wrap with 1 - 2 tablespoons of aluminum foil tightly.

title: Chinese Bro and Garlic Roasted Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oyster sauce or 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( low sodium ) | 4 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 4 tablespoons fresh tarragon, coarsley chopped | 1 ounce broccoli floret, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f in a small bowl, stir together the oyster sauce, bouillon and herbs to make a paste. Toss the florets in this mixture. Spread the paste on a baking sheet and bake until crispy, about 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Briani (Sweet Corned Beef)
ingredients: 15 ounces sweet corn beef ( trimmed of most of the fat ) | 14 ounces reduced-fat half-and-half | 2 tablespoons light dressing or 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 teaspoon whole white peppercorns | 1 ounce unsalted cashew nuts | 3/4 ounce reduced-fat sour cream | 2 tablespoons half and half | 1 piece fresh ginger, peeled and finely chopped
instructions: Slice the beef into 1/8 strips and sprinkle with the olive oil. Cook the beef over high heat for 2 or 3 minutes on each side, then remove from the heat, cover and set aside while preparing the dressing. Add the dressing ingredients and mix well. Add the cashews to the pan and return the meat and cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until just cooked through. Stir in the sour cream and return to the heat to warm through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,salmon fillet,cotija cheese,hot sauce,milk,red chilies,part mozzarella cheese
title: Yummy Salmon and Cotija Dip
ingredients: 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder ( or more, to taste ) | 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, fresh and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 4 4 ounces fresh cotija cheese or 4 ounces gouda cheese, of any type ( 4 ounces ) | 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( sriracha ) | 1 tablespoon fresh red chilies, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine the asafoetida and 1/2 cup of the mozzarella with the remaining cheese. Set aside in refrigerator. In a small bowl, mix together well the condensed milk, hot sauce, and chiles. Microwave a few drops of water on a small plate and put the chile mixture in with the cheese. Mix well. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve. Serve with toasted or crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,red food coloring,bread crumb,graham cracker crumb,grain rice
title: Italian Rice Balls II
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain rice | bread crumbs | italian seasoning, to taste | red food coloring - optional ( optional ) | 1 can refrigerated graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Mix the rice, bread crumbs and seasonings well. Make about 2 1/2 cups balls and roll them in the graham cracker crumbs. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Saffron Batter for Korma Kebabs
ingredients: 2 cups saffron strands | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the saffron into a small bowl and cover with hot water. Let soak for at least 30 minutes. Drain. Place the saffron into a non stick skillet and add the olive oil. Place the saffron mixture into a food processor and process until it is the consistency of cornmeal. Transfer it to a freezer safe container and allow to freeze in a shady place for 1 1/2 to 2 months. Allow to thaw for as long as you need and use in your kababs.

title: Chipotle Cream Corn Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 chipotle chile
instructions: Combine the cream style corn and chipotle chili pepper in a bowl. Chill for a few hours before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Roast Potatoes With Pure Honey and Madeira (Gibt)
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes ( about 8 ounces each ) | 2 ounces pumpkin seeds | 4 ounces madeira wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f mix the pumpkin seeds seeds with the madeira, using a generous amount of vanilla so that they don’t burn.

Random Ingredients: onion,artichoke heart,cheese tortellini,chili powder,cider vinegar,prosciutto,ricotta cheese
title: Artichoke and Prosciutto Tacos
ingredients: 7 slices prosciutto, diced and softened | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 onion, diced | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 teaspoons chili powder, or to taste | 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, drained | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Place the prosciutto pieces in a bowl with the sun dried tomatoes and onion, tossing to combine. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat, and add prosciutto, cooking and stirring until crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove prosciutto with a slotted spoon onto paper towels to drain. Stir remaining ingredients into the skillet and bring to a simmer. Add the prosciutto to the cheese mixture in the bowl and stir lightly. Stir well and simmer about 10 minutes.

title: Easy Cheese Beef Broth
ingredients: 2 lbs 80 % lean ground beef, 1kg | 2 jars cheese-roasted oysters, 1kg | 1 can low fat cottage cheese | seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Mix the cottage cheese and cornstarch in a bowl and add the beef cubes making sure to break the beef up into little chunks. Form the beef into bite size balls and set aside. Saute the beef and drain fat if you want but do not drain the excess fat. You could add a small amount of onion during the last 5 - 10 minutes of cooking. Heat oven to 200c or gas mark once the broiler is hot, put in 1 cup of cheese beef mixture and broil for two minutes, turn and broil for a further two minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve the cheese broth over noodles, rice or toast.

title: Sun Dried Tomatoes With Chipotle
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, in adobe from can whole chipotle
instructions: Heat a 1 to 2 tbl. Salted water to boiling. Immediately add the tomatos and chipoltes. Stir. Cook for about 3 minutes more. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Irish Lamb Rolls with hazelnuts and saffron
ingredients: 6 ounces ground lamb | 1/4 cup molasses | 4 tablespoons irish cream | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 3 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 tablespoons hazelnut-flavored liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place ground lamb in a skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring to crumble, until evenly browned. In a bowl, whisk together the molasses, irish cream and saffron. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Brush 1 sheet of phyllo with 1 tablespoon of the liqueur. Lay down 2 sheets of phyllo and brush with remaining liqueur. Lay down another 10 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with more liqueur. Spread half the ground lamb over the dough in a thin layer. Top with a second 10 sheets of phyllo, brushing with more liqueur. Repeat layering 2 more times, using 2 more sheets of phyllo and a third layer of ground lamb. Spread 2 tablespoons of the hazelnut flavored liqueur on top of the layered phyllo sheets. Cover with the final 10 sheets of phyllo, brushing with more liqueur. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the pastry has puffed and is golden brown and the lamb is no longer pink in the center.

title: Peanut Butter Spiced Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 ounces light peanut butter | 2 sirloin tip roast
instructions: Preheat broiler. Mash butter with a fork and place beef tip roast in a broiler safe dish. Broil 5 inches from the heat, or until desired doneness, about 10 to 15 minutes depending on how well done you like your beef. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,chinese pea pod,pimiento,breadcrumb,double cream
title: Chinese Pea Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 package dried chinese pea pods | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream or 2 tablespoons light cream | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pimientos | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/2 cup double cream | finely chopped crisp breadcrumbs ( optional )
instructions: Soak the prawns in very hot water to cover for 20 minutes or until they are translucent and firm. Wipe the pot dry with a paper towel, and set it over high heat. Add the cream and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Pour in the prawns and pimientos, reduce heat to medium, and continue cooking for 2 minutes. Stir in bread crumbs and cook a minute longer, stirring. Serve pudding warm, garnished with crisp bread crumbs, if desired.

title: Grilled Mussels
ingredients: 1/2 cup water chestnuts, sliced thin | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, sliced thin | 1 cup mussels, cleaned | 1/2 cup lettuce leaf, chopped | 1/4 cup mixed nuts, chopped
instructions: Add the water chestnuts, bamboo shoots, mussels, lettuce and nuts to a large grill pan or other shallow pan and cook on medium high heat for about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally until the mussels and lettuce are open. Serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 16 ounces pizza crust dough ( refrigerated pizza crust dough or homemade one ) | 2 cups collard greens, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Combine salsa and corn starch. Add collard greens to crock pot. Place dough on top of greens add desired amount of salsa blend on top of greens. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Hors D'oeuvre Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 4 slices sourdough bread
instructions: Trim fat from chicken. Cut off bone.

title: Apple Pepper Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef tenderloin | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons dried apples ( i prefer pears ) | 1 cup frozen store-bought broth, thawed
instructions: Trim fat from beef. Cut in half lengthwise. Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Combine chili powder and apples and brush. Sprinkle evenly over beef. Reserve any remaining spice mixture. In heavy 10 - 12 skillet cook beef over medium high heat until almost done. Stir in broth. Cover and cook 15 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Transfer beef to warm platter. Cover.

title: Crunchy Baklava
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove 1 sheet of filo pastry from a large piece of parchment paper placed on 2 sheets of plastic wrap. Brush the remaining pastry with a little water. Spread it evenly in a line about 1/2 inch deep. Sprinkle over a layer of pecans, then top with the remainder of the pastry. Fold the edges in and fold the edges over to make a seal on top of the pastry for a thicker phyllo pastry. Cut a slit down the length of the pastry and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining pastry and pecans. Cover baking sheet with a damp towel and refrigerate until baking time is done. Remove pastry from refrigerator and carefully brush pastry with some of the oil. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f and begin layering the baklava in a line on top of each other. Cover the pastry with a damp towel and continue layering until all baklava are used. Bake approximately 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Beer Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup beer, dark | 1 cup prepared yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Pour all the ingredients into a skillet or blender and mix well. This will create a little bit of a kick if it is stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator or in a jar up to three months.

title: Cheater's Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 package medium noodles | 1 3/4 cups gorgonzola, crumbles | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree
instructions: Rinse the noodles. Cook in boiling water with the sugar. Drain immediately. Mix all the ingredients together into a dumpling like ball, adding the cheese last. If gnocchi is too stiff to shape, add more oil.

title: Frijoles
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix the kidney beans with salt and pepper in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,yellow bell pepper,black olive
title: Marinated Black Olives (Cenouras Verde)
ingredients: 1 lb ripe black olives | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Wash olives. Dry olives. Cut off ends of peppers. Slice green onions about 1 1/2 inches long and add into mixing bowl. Add dry pepper flakes. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Belgian Endive and Noodles With Sage
ingredients: 2 -6 fresh sage, stems cut into 4 -5 sections ( for garnish ) | 4 packages rice noodles or | water-packed artichoke hearts ( with liquid ) | 2 heads belgian endive, about 4 to 1-inch in diameter
instructions: Boil a pot of water with the sage. Prepare the rice noodles or artichoke hearts if using fresh. Rinse the ends and cut lengthwise in 1 1/2 sections. Arrange them on a serving platter, cut side down, and sprinkle with salt. Ladle in the broth and garnish with minced sage leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Herbes De Provence Salt from the Spice Bible
ingredients: 3 quarts salt | 1 cup herbes de provence | 1 orange peel
instructions: The easiest way to obtain herbes de provence is to boil, or you can use 1/2 pound dried herbs de provence ( 3 quarts ) which is roughly 1/2 pound of whole mixed herbs and 1 pound of dried mixed herbs. Boil the herbs 1 1/2 minutes. Using a cheese cloth or mesh sieve, remove the herbs and discard the stems and leaves. You should have 12 cups of herbes de provence. Add to the herbes de provence in a pot along with the reserved herbs. Stick a finger into the center of the herbs to release the herbes de provence. Bring to boiling over medium heat. Lower heat to low and simmer for 1 hour and 45 minutes. Strain and reserve the herbes de provence. The herbs will thicken as they cool, so be sure to reserve them for future use if desired. You can also add additional salt, pepper and freshly grated zest of an orange, but if needed, add a bit of kosher salt prior to serving. Herbs can be kept in the refrigerator for 6 months after cooling. Use as condiment to dip french fries, sandwiches, bread, crackers or to spread on raw vegetables.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard,elbow macaroni,quorn,plain nonfat yogurt,golden syrup,cardamom pod,cauliflower
title: Quorn and Macaroni Salad With Mustard & Yogurt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra light brown mustard | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 250 g quorn, chopped, mixed with | 75 g cooked cauliflower | 450 g plain nonfat yogurt | 400 g spiral shaped macaroni, cooked | 1 cardamom pod, seeds removed & bruised
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius.

Random Ingredients: cream,salt,brioche bread,black eyed pea,acorn squash,rice wine
title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
ingredients: 1 can light cream | 3 fresh peaches or 3 acorn squash | 2 cups cooked rice wine or 2 cups white wine | salt | 8 crusty brioche bread | ground black lava ( to sprinkle on bread and serve with rye or winter squash slices, if possible )
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in a food processor. Process at medium speed, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed, until mixture is well mixed. Transfer the mixture to a glass bowl or shallow dish. Sprinkle the top with a few grinds of black lava if desired. Cover and chill, ideally overnight, for best flavor.

title: Slow Cooker Swedish Meat and Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut into 1 inch pieces | 18 baby carrots | 6 slices orange rind, pith removed | 1 can or bottle beer | 1 teaspoon concentrated orange juice concentrate | 1 lb ground sirloin
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bottom into the slow cooker and top with beef. Cook on low until beef is tender. Serve over egg noodles or white rice.

title: Homemade Soft Taco Filling
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers | 3/4 quart water ( enough to cover peppers ) | 2 cans hominy, drained
instructions: Prep the chilies, split open a fresh can of hominy and empty into a soup pot. Rinse the can with hot water. The water should be almost all of the way drained into the hominy. Turn on the heat to medium and begin stirring the can contents. When the can starts to get a creamy appearance, pour the can on top with the can and stir. Let simmer for a couple of minutes. You want to mash it up a bit. The amount of chili mixture will vary depending of chili peppers used.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,italian herb,asadero cheese,egg wrap,cardamom seed,russet potato
title: Albondigas (Potato Egg Rolls)
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes or 3 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil or 1/3 cup virgin coconut oil | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon asadero cheese or 1/2 teaspoon grated mexican cheese | salt and italian herbs ( optional ) | 20 egg roll wraps
instructions: Boil the potatoes with 1/3 cup water until tender. Drain potatoes and mash them with a fork or potato masher. Heat the 2 tbs. Olive oil in a sauce pan on low heat. Add the fennel, cardamom, and asadero or mexican cheese. Remove from heat when cheese is melted. Add mashed potatoes and stir until well mixed. If the potatoes are too soft, you can add a bit of water. Place a heaping tablespoon of potato mixture in the middle of each egg roll wrapper. Place a few drops of water on top of the potato mixture for more filling. This may be difficult to achieve with a spoon, as water would be too dry. Bring the potato mixture to simmer and cook about 15 minutes. Serve hot or cold on a side.

title: Feta Cheese Spread in a Jar
ingredients: 600 g feta cheese, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts oil | 200 g dijon mustard
instructions: Place all ingredients in jar and shake the jar until the cheese is completely coated with the oil. The mix is ready when the spread resembles breadcrumbs. Leave it in the fridge for at least 5 hours to allow flavours to develop.

title: Grilled Beets With Stilton Cheese
ingredients: 4 large beets | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons fish ball, crumbled | 1/3 cup grated stilton cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. In large saucepan with cover, bring water to a boil. Place beets on top of hot water.

title: Mushroom and Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 can coconut cream | 1/2 cup water | 2 -3 serrano chilies, stemmed, seeded, and very finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pot over medium heat. Cover pot and simmer for 20 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Serve sprinkled with cheddar. Note, this can be served over jasmine rice.

title: Homemade  Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese ( drained ) | 1/4 cup asiago cheese ( grated ) | 1/2 cup white onion ( diced )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Let sit in refrigerator for a couple hours to make it easier to mix up and serve as a topping for your favorite pasta. Add to your favorite pasta salad i prefer spinach with garlic mixed in with it.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,cream,paprika,chicken breast,phyllo pastry,sage,coriander leaf,malt vinegar
title: Poppy Cannon's Chicken Pie from Corfu
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, skinned and boned | 4 tablespoons dried sage | 2 fresh coconuts ( optional ) or 2 frozen phyllo pastry sheets | 8 teaspoons orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons paprika | 4 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves ( cilantro )
instructions: Preheat the oven 400°f place a baking tray in the oven for 10 minutes. Place the chicken skin side down into a small baking dish. Using a brush, brush half the sage over the chicken and roll into a cylinder. Add the chicken to the tray and brush over the remaining sage to coat. Repeat with the remaining chicken, then transfer into the oven. Bake for about 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and drain any excess oil from the oven. Cool, then place the pastry on a clean work surface and cut into a 12 x 8 cm square using a pizza cutter or glass. Place a chicken on pastry square, then spread out with a brush. Spread with the orange juice concentrate, then add the sour cream and sprinkle a little paprika over the sour cream. Sprinkle over the coriander leaves, then place the pastry lid on the dish and loosely cling the top with foil. Place back in the oven for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for a further 10 minutes to crisp the top.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,chili pepper flake,cream chicken soup,oil
title: Devil's Food Polish Pork Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup oil | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes
instructions: Put fryed sausage in frying pan to brown on both sides. Cut into 1 inch squares. Set aside. Mix together the cream of chicken soup and oil. Add chili pepper flakes. Put aside to use as sauce. When sausage is brown, take it out of pan, take out of the pan and put on serving dishes with the sauce. For vegetarian use only the cream of chicken soup. For vegan serve in separate containers,.

title: Homemade Smoked Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | kosher salt, to taste
instructions: Prepare a large non reactive bowl by rubbing it with a little kosher salt. Pour in the soup, and mix with a fork until well combined. Roll the beef Strips into your finger tips, then dip them into the mixture until completely coated. Place on a rack in a roasting pan to dry while the oven is preheating. Bake at 325 degrees f for 40 minutes. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool slightly. Serve warm.

title: Easy Chocolate Glazed Beef
ingredients: 1 boneless beef top sirloin steak | 1 cup chocolate morsel, such as dutch processed
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut a length of the beef cutting board crosswise through the meat, about 3/4 inch wide and 2 inches long. Remove tenderloin steak and arrange on the meat. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate in refrigerator 20 to 30 minutes. Using a sharp knife, cut the meat crosswise into slices. Coat a skillet with cooking spray and set over medium high heat until hot. Fry meat until browned on each side and cooked to desired degree of doneness, about 3 minutes per side depending on your level of doneness. Transfer to a warm platter and keep warm. Bring remaining marinade to a boil in the skillet. Add chocolate morsels and boil to melt. Serve with meat.

title: Easy Toasted French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 orange, zest of, grated | 2 1/2 teaspoons orange-flavored zest, grated
instructions: Cut bread into thin slices. Lightly coat pan with cooking spray. Spread both sides of bread slices with vinegar and orange zest. Sprinkle with grated orange zest. Heat in toaster over high heat, just until hot, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Sausages With Coconut Water
ingredients: 350 g ground sausages | 20 g watercress, finely chopped | 2 green onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut, soaked in water for 20 minutes, then drained | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place sausages, watercress, green onion and coconut in a small saucepan and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes or until heated. Add spices and cook for 1 minute or until fragrant. Remove from heat. Serve hot from a baking tray. Enjoy serves notes, you can cook these in your preferred method. Place the mixture in a bowl, cover and refrigerate for 3 hours before serving. Bring to room temperature before serving and reheat before serving.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,five spice powder,cool whip topping,wheat flour,gruyere cheese,cumin,red pepper,celery
title: Simple Philly Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/3 cup fat free cool whip topping | 6 tablespoons shredded light swiss cheese, divided | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder, divided | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin or 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 8 large red peppers, cut in half and seeds removed | 3 stalks celery, sliced lengthwise into thin strips | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Mix together the cheeses and the 3 tbsp swiss cheese. Stir in cool whip until it just begins to melt, 1 - 2 minutes. Stir in the spice powder and cumin. Spread over the bottom of a 10 pan. Layer peppers and celery on top of cheese mixture. Sprinkle flour over all. Microwave for 5 minutes on 50% power, or until thickened, stirring after 2 minutes.

title: Kidney Sprout Masala
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups sprouted kidney beans | 1 can sago ( black rice flour ) | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut | 1 whole dried red chilies
instructions: Mix well for about a minute. Pour some sago into a cup that's 1 1/2 cup. Add water enough to fill the cup 2/3 of the way up. Microwave for 40 seconds. Take off the microwave. Put the spingakas in a plastic bag with sago to coat. Microwave for 10 minutes on high. Stir. Remove. Microwave another 10 minutes. Put in 3/4 cup sago. Microwave again on high for 30 seconds. Drain excess water. Sprinkle with desiccated coconut and red chillies. Garnish with extra desiccated coconut and red chillies. Serve hot with chapati and white raita.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,farfalle pasta,confectioner ' sugar,beef tenderloin,olive oil,orange juice zest
title: Beef Tenderloin With Noodles and Orange Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed and sliced 1/8 inch thick | 6 wonton wrappers, split ( found at health food stores ) | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: In a saute pan heat oil until hot but not smoking, and saute the sliced beef till desired doneness. Remove beef from pan and let sit for 5 minutes. On a plate place the beef, wrap and tuck the wontons in and roll around the meat to coat the entire beef. In a small bowl combine confectioners sugar, orange juice, orange zest, and a touch of water. Place the pasta in boiling water and cook until al dente. Plate noodles and top with meat. Drizzle with orange dressing and serve with warm sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: date,hake fillet,lager beer,hash brown potato,cottage cheese
title: Cheater's Corned Beef Hash
ingredients: 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1 package hash brown potatoes | 16 ounces dark lager beer | 1/4 cup dates, chopped | 2 lbs lean ground sirloin steaks ( with or without a casings )
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat. Combine the cottage cheese, hash browns, beer, chopped dates, and sirloin in a large bowl. Heat the hash until it just begins to melt, stirring constantly. Drain off the excess grease. Place half of the hash mixture in the bottom of a 1 lb. Ramekin dish. Top with the cooked beef, then finish with remaining hash mixture. Cook until heated through, about 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,grain white rice,creamy peanut butter,meat,liquid smoke flavoring,safflower oil
title: Cocoal Mud Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( uncooked ) | 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 1 lb lean ground meat or 1 lb chicken | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: mango,thai fish sauce,ramen noodle,tabasco sauce,seasoning salt,picante sauce,citron
title: Yummy Thai Ramen Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 cup ramen noodles | 1/2 mango, diced ( i used a whole mango ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce ( or more ) | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/8 teaspoon citron
instructions: Mix together first 5 ingredients and chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes. Mix dressing ingredients together in a bowl and toss with chilled noodles. Chill.

title: Mexican Seafood with Spinach and Beans
ingredients: 1 package dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 4 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 pound scallops | 1/2 cup mild salsa | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in farfalle and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,turnip,sauce,chorizo sausage,bamboo shoot,bouquet garni
title: Spanish Style Chorizo and Turnips
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage | 1/2 lb turnip, peeled & thinly sliced | 1 bouquet garni ( a bay or bundle of leaves ) | 1/2 can bamboo shoots | 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, leaves only, coarsely chopped | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Cook chorizo, turnip, bouquet garni & bamboo shoots for 25 minutes in boiling water, remove from heat & cover. Allow to macerate for 30 minutes. Drain excess liquid, remove bay leaf. Place chorizo mixture, parsley & hot sauce in serving bowl & toss. Serve hot, with crusty french bread & a salad of greens.

title: Barbecued Lamb or Goat Stew
ingredients: 1 kg lamb or 1 kg goat meat | 4 celery ribs, sliced | 2 tomatoes, chopped | 2 small green peppers, chopped | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Cut the lamb or goat meat into large chunks and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the celery, tomatoes, peppers and the lemon juice in a large pan. Place over a high heat and cook until the vegetables soften, about 5 minutes. Serve at once as a starter with bread or as an accompaniment to meat and vegetables.

title: Yummy and Spicy Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 10 tortillas ( we use a cornmeal style for our burritos, usually 3-5 ) | 1/4 cup orange zest | 10 -12 mint leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 cup skim milk | 4 large squashes | cocoa powder, for dusting | apple cider, for accompaniment
instructions: Place 2 tortillas on cutting board and lay down a heavy pan so they form soft spongy biscuits. Coat each with about 1 tablespoon of cocoa. Using a slotted spoon, gently put the biscuit slices onto the baking tray and spread out using the back of a spoon. When biscuits are all coated in cocoa, carefully remove from baking tray and place the biscuit slices onto a tray of paper. Cover with a clean cloth and set aside. Place remaining tortillas on a griddle pan. Heat over medium high heat, taking care as you don't want them to burn. When they are warm, fold the two tortillas over to cover. Cook for a few seconds on the other side, then turn over and cook on the second side. As the tortillas toast the zest will darken into a very dark brown colour. As it cooks, place the toasted tortillas onto a tray of a double thickness of tin foil and stack them, tightly together, on the baking tray until ready to serve. To serve, top with a sprinkling of cacao, mint leaves, and orange slices. Serve with a squeeze of apple cider.

Random Ingredients: jamaican curry powder,lime juice,plain yogurt,caper,lemon lime beverage,spanish onion,seashell pasta,rotel tomato chilies
title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 1 1/2 cups small seashell pasta | 1 can whole canned jamaican curry powder | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies ( with cream ) | 1 large spanish onion, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup reduced sodhell's liquid vegetable carbonated beverage ( i use sprite ) | 2 tablespoons drained capers
instructions: Cook & drain pasta as directed on package, then rinse with cold water. Set aside. Mix together the yogurt & curry, breaking up the lumps with the back of a spoon. Add the next 7 ingredients and stir thoroughly. Let sit at room temperature in fridge to chill several hours. Serve chilled or refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: sage,coriander seed,italian sausage,nutmeg,tomato soup,rice noodle,clear honey,self rising flour
title: Nigella Lawson Sausage With Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb good quality ground italian sausage | 10 ounces dried rice noodles ( approx ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon thyme, ground | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon sage, ground | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 1/2 cups tomato soup
instructions: If you are using fresh rice noodles, boil them according to the package instructions, about 10 mins then drain & reserve the water. In a large skillet over medium heat, add the coriander seeds, thyme & nutmeg, mix well & stir in the ground sausage. When it is well browned and crumbs begin to form, add 1/2 cup of reserved pasta water, and mix well. Add the cooked rice noodles, the remaining water and the honey. Mix well & cover the pan. Leave to cook gently for about 15 minutes, until it is cooked through & the water has dried up. Stir once or twice during this time. Tip, if all of your liquid is absorbed by the noodles, it may take up to an hour or two, depending on how dry your pasta is. If you find the mixture sticking to the pan, add a little of the reserved cooking water. When this has been reducing up, remove from the heat & stir in the tomato soup. Leave this to simmer for about 10 mins, until it is heated through. Serve sprinkled with parmesan cheese.

title: Canadian Bacon & Shrimp
ingredients: 1 cup canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons garlic, minced
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Add bacon to boiling water and stir often over medium heat, about 3 minutes. Drain and rinse shrimp. Arrange in a large lightly oiled 2 quart casserole and sprinkle with garlic. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes. Bake uncovered another 3 - 5 minutes, until shrimp are just pink.

title: Lebanese Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into slices | 4 cubes plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a shallow baking dish, mix together maple syrup and chicken. Cover the dish, and bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes. Turn chicken, and bake an additional 25 minutes, or until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Arrange yogurt on serving plates, and spoon maple sauce over top.

title: Minty's Favorite Beans and Apples
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, in olive oil and vinegar | 1 can mcintosh apples, in natural juice peeled and diced | 1/2 cup dried mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix beans, apples, mint and olive oil and vinegar.

title: Apple Coconut Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup mango chutney ( your own or bought ) | 1/2 cup vegetable juice | 3 -4 chicken thighs, cut up | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in a bowl and mix well to combine. Add chicken and stir well to coat it in the mixture. Place in a shallow dish and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.. Cook time reflects overnight marinating time. Serve with basmati rice. Note, i have used this in bhallas in our indian recipe for an hour or so when there was chicken or meat tenderizer.

title: Cakefish Orzo Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups orzo pasta, dry, uncooked | 1 packet croutons | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1 lb cod, halibut or 1 lb halibut fillet, boneless and skinless
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil, add pasta and cook according to packet directions. While pasta is cooking, spray a 9x13 pan with pam with cooking spray. Drain cooked pasta and peas into a measuring cup. Remove 1 cup croutons from packet and discard. Dip halibut into flour and dip in crumbs. When pasta and peas are almost done, add cod and stir to coat with crumbs, coating completely. Add fish and another 1/4 cup croutons to the bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,sherry,pizza crust,cocoa powder,sunflower oil,garam masala,chardonnay wine,chicken stock cube
title: Linda's Italian Chocolate Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust, bought ready made | 100 g chardonnay wine | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons dried porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dried pinches dry crushed red pepper or 1 tablespoon sun dried crushed red pepper flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place pizza dough onto pizza stone or cookie sheet, brush with oil and preheat pizza stones. Mix together the wine, stock cubes, cocoa powder and crushed pepper in a bowl. Stir in dried mushrooms and pour mixture over pizza base or pizza stone. If dough is too crusty and wet, bake on oven tray for 7 - 10 mins, then remove from oven and cool the pizza on the pizza stone, it should be fairly dry and gooey. Spread on filling and sprinkle with fresh chopped coriander and freshly ground black pepper. Cut into wedges to serve.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,bamboo shoot,white vinegar,english mustard powder
title: Grilled Sweet and Sour Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon white mustard powder | 1 leaf romaine lettuce heart, chopped | 9 slices firm textured bamboo shoots, cut in half, lengthwise
instructions: Whisk together the vinegar and mustard in a shallow bowl. Add the lettuce hearts and bamboo, toss, and let flavors meld. Assemble sandwiches by piling some of the lettuce mixture and topping it with some vinegar dressing. Variation, use chipotle chiles for a twist.

title: Garaghala Polo
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup greek's bomba cereal | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder ( or ground cardamom ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | chopped fresh rosemary ( optional ) | orange peel, optional garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine yogurt and powdered sugar in a small bowl and beat well until creamy. Set aside. Pour yogurt mixture into wide bowl and stir till well mixed. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into a serving dish and serve immediately garnished with fresh rosemary sprig or orange peel.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,gluten flour,rye bread,meat stock,pomegranate,red chilies,asafoetida powder
title: Spicy Pomegranate Meatball Soup - M'hamma
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread, cubed ( a day old bread ) | 100 g pomegranate ( a fresh grapefruit ) | 1 1/2 liters meat stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons gluten flour | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 small red chilies, finely chopped | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Soak the bread in cold water for an hour and then squeeze out the water. Break the bread into tiny pieces and put the bread in a pan with enough water to cover the bread. Simmer to make a thick paste, adding the pomegranate seeds as a last touch. Pour into a blender or food processor the meat into a bowl and puree until smooth. Return this mixture to the pan along with the stock, gluten flour and tomato paste. Bring to the boil. Cover and simmer very gently for 30 mins, or until the meat and soup are completely cooked and the soup thickened. Serve hot with hot flat bread and garnish with a sprinkle of chillies.

title: Lighter Beef Stir Fry With Lime
ingredients: 1 lb steak, sliced thin ( i use lean strips ) | 8 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Marinate sliced meat with lime zest, bullion & vegetable bouillon until ready to be served in pan. Heat wok to medium high heat.

title: Black Pepper and Pepper Ghee (Butter)
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces ghee or 3 1/2 ounces butter | 2 1/2 ounces black peppercorns or 2 1/2 ounces coriander seeds
instructions: Heat the ghee or butter in a small frying pan until it starts to brown. Add the pepper flakes and cook for about a minute, adding a few drops of water to loosen the sediment. Allow to cool, then store in a small jar.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,potato starch,butterscotch chip,artichoke heart,molasses,rosemary,red bell pepper
title: Artichoke Potato Candy
ingredients: 1 box simply potatoes sour cream and choc chip mix | 3 cups broccoli florets | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, roasted, peeled and diced | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts ( reserve liquid ) | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary, minced ( or 1/2 t dried ) | 1/3 cup potato starch ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the crust recipe according to the package directions. Set aside until cool. Combine potato starch and molasses in a small bowl. Set aside, stirring to get rid of lumps. In a deep skillet, heat the red bell pepper over medium high heat with the remaining ingredients for about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove red bell pepper from skillet and set aside. Cut reserved artichoke hearts into wedges and combine with artichoke hearts in skillet. Cook over medium low heat for about 6 minutes, stir, and then remove from heat. Set aside until cool, then store in an airtight container at room temperature until ready to use. Roll dough out on a lightly floured board until about 1/2 inch thick. Cut out stars with star templates. Use a 3 1/2 inch star cookie cutter to cut out 8 stars. Place star cookies on a lightly floured surface. If dough sticks, refrigerate dough for about 20 minutes before using. Place star cookies on a lightly floured surface and roll out into a circle. Place 1 tablespoon of the potato starch in the center of the circle. Wet the fingers where needed, fold one side over the circle, then the other and pinch the dough together. Place an artichoke heart on top and then spoon 1 tablespoon of potato starch in the center of the artichoke heart. Fold the dough around the artichoke heart until it is covered. Fold the dough over, and then wrap around it until it is totally wrapped. Repeat with the rest of the dough, potato starch and dough. Place on a cookie sheet and lightly dust the tops of the cookies with flour. Gently press the dough together to get rid of air pockets. Bake in a preheated 375f oven until the cookies are tan in color and crispy on the outside, about 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Italian Roast Pork (Pork Sausage)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork or 1 -1 1/2 lb other inexpensive roast
instructions: Place roast into a roasting pan or dutch oven. Add vegetable broth. If using a pork roast, pour pan contents into a roasting pan. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Cook on low for 4 - 6 hours. Remove from oven. Allow to cool slightly. Transfer pork slices to a platter. Skim fat from surface as much as possible. Strain juices into a bowl and refrigerate. This will keep them moist and flavorful. When ready to use, drain pork and slice into thin thin strips. This is very confusing if you are not familiar with how to do this. Using a slotted spoon, place pork slices in a gravy boat or small bowl or pot. They will slowly heat and brown on top. This will happen quickly, so don't be alarmed when they become to crispy or brown too much. It is not supposed to do this automatically. They will brown quickly but it won't. They do not come out crispy. When they are almost crispy, place into a bowl. Save broth in a separate bowl. This does work too. Use this strained broth to cook your other meats over medium high heat until browned. This takes about 1 hour before your meat is done. I serve these as sandwiches, over cooked portuguese rice or potatoes, over browned cabbage, for a light meal or as an appetizer with a traditional dippers such as borrekas. Serve with good crusty bread and butter.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,paprika,white bread,tomato puree,garlic powder,oregano leaf
title: Smoky Tomato Bread
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole wheat flour ( use a good 1/4 cup if it has some salt in it ) | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons white bread, such as boboli's | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and knead. Divide dough in half. Form each half into 2 balls. Flatten out each ball between your palms. Cook the bread in a non stick frying pan, turning a couple of times, until bread browns around the edges. Turn and brown the other side. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chinese Sage Eggs
ingredients: 24 fresh sage leaves, washed and dried
instructions: Put the dried sage leaves in a large bowl along with a few spoons of water. Set aside until cool. Remove and squeeze out any excess water. Strain the water from the sage and set aside. Beat the egg yolks with a large pinch of salt. Fold in the egg yolks and half the chopped sage. Heat a large non stick frying pan and pour in enough sesame oil to cover the surface of the pan.. Drop the sage mixture by half teaspoons 1 teaspoons onto the oil. Fry for about 5 minutes, regulating the heat so the oil is not smoking. Using a slotted spoon, remove each sage leaf, and place on paper towels. Lift out and place on a plate while you make the rest of the egg mixture, keeping the cooked leaves covered with a kitchen towel.

Random Ingredients: sushi rice,stew meat,hard egg,currant,basil,green chile pepper,ladyfinger,coconut milk
title: Korean Beef and Egg Roll
ingredients: 36 ladyfingers | 1 lb sirloin stew meat or 1 lb stew pork, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup coconut milk | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, chopped | 4 small red chile peppers, seeded, chopped | 1 cup dried currant | 3 green chile peppers, cut into 1/4 strips | 3 cups prepared sushi rice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil, garnish
instructions: Make the sticky rice, in a large skillet set over medium heat, toast the ladyfingers in the coconut milk for about 10 minutes, turning them over while doing so. Remove the skillet from the heat, spread out the ladyfingers in a single layer, and set aside. Return the skillet to medium high and heat the remaining coconut oil. Saute the onions until translucent, or cook the meat until brown. Add the green chili peppers and currants. Stir to blend. Add the cooked ladyfingers. Turn up heat a little, stir in the sticky rice, and cook for about 10 minutes to warm the rice. Scrape the sticky rice onto a platter. Serve hot. Garnish with fresh basil and a sprinkling of cilantro.

title: Sesame Paste... or Spread
ingredients: 6 -8 tablespoons almond paste | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Mix, store in airtight container or in the refrigerator.

title: Kuwaiti Date Balls
ingredients: 50 dates | 3 tablespoons oil | 500 ml oil
instructions: Put dates in a blender, add oil, stir, grind to a fine paste. Leave aside. On a hot griddle, heat the base for about 2 mins, pour paste onto base to form balls. If the paste is not hard enough, continue till brown. Do not leave the dates whole until serving time. Serve warm or cold as an appetiser.

title: Cheese and Chili Oil Lasagna
ingredients: 32 ounces rotelle pasta | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 tablespoon chili oil, from a jar of chili peppers
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the cheddar and capers. Drain the pasta. Place the drained pasta in a greased 9 x 9 pan. Sprinkle cheese on it. Pour chili oil over it. Bake in preheated oven about 90 minutes or until the top is light golden. I serve this on top of a bed of spinach as its a great base for any meal that calls for cooked tomatoes, green beans and fresh herbs.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,white pearl onion,white flour,green chile pepper,italian salad dressing mix
title: Quick Italian White Applesauce
ingredients: 5 large italian-style peeled white pearl onions | 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 6 tablespoons chopped green chile peppers | 1 package white pearl onions | 1 cup white flour | 2 cans diced green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Place the pearl onions into a medium saucepan with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook gently for 5 minutes, or until the onions are tender and have begun to lose their shape. Drain, and place into a large bowl. Stir in the italian dressing mix, 1 cup chopped green chile, and white onions. Mix in the flour until evenly distributed. Transfer to a large glass jar, and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving, and stir in the green chile peppers. Serve with more chopped green chile peppers on the side.

title: Cheddar Corned Beef and Pistachios
ingredients: 250 g whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 100 g roasted pistachios | cheddar cheese soup, to serve
instructions: Place the flour, coriander seeds and pistachios in a bowl, add some water and knead until it forms a firm dough, about 15 - 20 minutes. Cover and rest. Divide dough into 12 equal portions, shape each into a ball. Cover each ball of dough and let it rest for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 200c, press and roll the dough out into a circle to about 10cm in diameter then line the bottom and sides of an ovenproof dish with half the dough. Mix the cheese with 1 tablespoon water and spread over the dough mixture. Bake in the oven for 30 - 40 minutes, or until puffed and golden.

title: Cabo's Orange Pork over Barley
ingredients: orange roughy fillet | 8 ounces boneless lean pork | 1 cup pearl barley | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | pimientos ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place oven rack in middle of oven. Place pork fillet over barley on a large baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees f until the internal temperature of the pork is 70 degrees f, about 15 minutes. Let cool slightly. Shred the pork with 2 forks. Place in a bowl and crumble 1/2 cup or so of the cheese over it. Stir it into the pork and continue stirring until the cheese is melted. Scoop out and discard any damaged bits with a spoon. Place the soup bowls on kitchen towels to drain any excess liquid. Spoon soup onto plates. Scatter a portion of the pork over the soup and garnish with sliced green onions, pimientos, or whatever else you wish.

title: Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 2 slices kielbasa, thin slices | 1 tablespoon anchovy, minced | 1 -2 leaf arugula leaf | 1 small handful fresh bean sprout | 4 -6 baby arugula leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, mix anchovy with a little bit of water to make a paste. Set anchovy paste aside. Heat the skillet over medium high heat and cook kielbasa about 15 minutes, until lightly browned. Drain off excess fat. In a salad bowl, combine kielbasa, arugula, and bean sprouts. Sprinkle with more anchovy paste and serve.

title: Artichoke Hearts With Queso Anejo from Chile
ingredients: 12 artichoke hearts ( about 12 ounces ) | 8 tablespoons grated queso anejo ( about 3 cups ) | 3 tablespoons finely grated peeled fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place artichoke hearts on paper towels.

title: Salt Crusted Fish
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fish fillets | 1 1/4 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed
instructions: Mix together the fennel seed with a teaspoon of cold water. Brush the fennel with this water, and salt generously.

title: The Essential Minty Limes
ingredients: 1/2 cup mint sprigs, loosely packed | 3 limes, juice of
instructions: Cut a slit of a lime, but not all the way down the fruit, and drop it into a small bowl. Crush the sprigs coarsely with a mallet as before and squeeze over the lime juice.

title: Savory Beef Sauce - 3 Ingredients
ingredients: 6 ounces beef bouillon | 2 teaspoons seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pot. Heat on low heat, stirring occasionally, for 2 hours. Let sauce simmer on low heat for 1/2 the first 20 minutes to thicken.

title: Turnips and Spinach (Arugula Style)
ingredients: 1 large turnip, peeled and cut into wedges | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bake the turnip wedges in the preheated oven until tender and lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain the turnips, removing the browned skin, and place onto a baking sheet. Bake and stir the turnip wedges with the spinach in the baking sheet until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Sicilian Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 can or bottle cola-flavored carbonated beverage | 4 cups crushed corn chips
instructions: Fill a deep metal pan with ice into a depth of 1, and dip the corn chips, one at a time, into the soda so that the corn chips do not fall off while soaking. Arrange the chips in the bottom of a double layer of cheesecloth or paper towels. Seal the ends securely. Place the cheesecloth in the ice water and begin squeezing the water until the mixture has a consistency of thickened ice water. Continue squeezing as needed and working the water through the cheesecloth until the bag is covered. You should end up with a smooth creamy thick mixture. Drain as much water out of the cheesecloth as possible, and place the cheesecloth bag in the ice water.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,palm sugar,green curry paste,chili paste,white pepper
title: Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 cup green curry paste | 1/4 cup palm sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 cup orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce or 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: In a skillet saute green curry paste, brown sugar or brown sugar over low heat for 5 minutes, add remaining ingredients, simmer for 5 minutes or until desired consistency is reached, if it's not yet thicken, cook in batches. If too thick, add water until desired consistency is achieved.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,corn kernel,pita bread,italian breadcrumb,nonfat milk powder,black eyed pea
title: Corn and Pita Bread Pies
ingredients: 4 pita bread | 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed and drained | 3/4 cup frozen nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup frozen black-eyed peas, thawed | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup fat-free italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pita bread on a baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f. For 10 minutes, until lightly toasted. Combine 1 c corn kernels and 1 cup green peas in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat for 2 mins, stirring occasionally. Add the italian breadcrumbs and remaining frozen peas, and mix well. Spoon mixture into each pita bread shell and sprinkle with 1/2 c shredded cheese. Bake for 5 mins for the topping and 5 mins for nachos.

title: BBQ Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite size pieces | 1 cup watermelon | 1 can pitted and sliced black olives | 1 cup bananas, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the chicken, watermelon, olives, bananas, ginger, and green pepper sauce. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Salmon and Pea Pilaf
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken ( approx 5 lbs ) | 3 cups millet ( see notes in description ) | 3 tablespoons salted butter or 3 tablespoons pate ( see notes ) | 300 g frozen peas ( see notes ) | 2 medium tomatoes, sliced ( or 2 small tomatoes ) | 2 tablespoons pickles, pickle slices ( see note ) ( optional )
instructions: Note~ i think I have used sliced smoked salmon which is much better. You can use other types of fish and use what you prefer. Aioli, ranch dressing, pickle relish, or salad dressing are always wonderful variations on this wonderful sauce. The original recipe said to cook chicken in a pan, then cover tightly and simmer until tender. Remove chicken and allow to cool. When cool, remove bones, skin and bones. If using veggies, cut in small pieces and steam or fry them in butter or pate in pan until crisp tender. Cool milk until easy to skim but not liquefied. Bring milk to boil, add millet, stirring constantly until there is a thin, consistent sauce. Reduce heat and simmer, skimming frequently. Keep hot until necessary. If using cooked veggies or meats, simmer until tender. Cool slightly, then add pickles to taste. If using cooked meats, cook until tender, adding more as required. Note~ after cooking the salmon mixture, take out of the pan and slice into rounds, or any type of desired shape. It is possible that the pieces should separate from each other so make sure your ingredients are prepared before you cook them. It should probably be possible to get 4 pieces out of each piece as well. It might be difficult to find exactly what exactly 2 servings are approximate. The reason i have listed 4 servings is because my recipe is relatively low in size so i often just make a portion or 2 or 3 portions. Note~ if making the paella, follow recipe 3 as well, and adjust cooking time accordingly to desired doneness of salmon or meat.

title: Quick Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 tablespoons vegetable broth
instructions: Heat 1/2 tablespoon butter in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place chicken in skillet and cook 3 minutes on each side or until browned. Transfer to plate. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in same skillet over medium heat. Add broth and bring to boil. Return chicken to skillet. Simmer, covered, until broth is reduced to 1/3, about 10 to 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Baked Beef Tostadas
ingredients: 1 pound cubed beef stew meat, cut into bite-size pieces | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line two baking sheets with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Place the browned stew meat on the prepared baking sheets. Sprinkle with cayenne, or to taste.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,pimento pepper,asafoetida powder,apricot jam,green capsicum,honey,ham
title: Peking Ham
ingredients: 2 kg smoked ham | 1 green capsicum ( bell pepper ) | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot jam | 1 dash asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon honey ( optional ) | pimento pepper
instructions: Slice ham open, then score skin with diagonal cut in diamond pattern. Cut stringy string and tie with kitchen twine to secure. Marinade with mixed jam, extra virgin olive oil, salt, pepper, asafoetida and honey for at least an hour. Place ham in shallow roasting tin and pour marinade over ham. Bake at 190c for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Turn ham over, baste with marinade and bake for a further 30 minutes. Turn oven off and leave ham in oven for another 30 minutes, or until cooked. Turn oven off and leave ham in oven until completely cool. If desired, slice ham thinly and layer ham slices between your fingers. Top ham slices with fresh fruit. Serve with fresh fruit and a good salad.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,mace,celery salt,prosciutto di parma,anise seed,egg wrap,watercress,asafoetida powder
title: Asafetida Bites
ingredients: 3 teaspoons fennel bulbs, whole | 3/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil or 3/4 cup canola oil | 3 1/3 cups freshly cut asafoetida ( yellow or green ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons celery salt | generous pinch ground nutmeg ( optional ) | 1 bunch watercress or 1 bunch spinach | 3 slices prosciutto di parma, thinly sliced | 2 egg roll wraps
instructions: Trim and discard the stalk ends of the fennel, then coarsely chop the bulb. Place the oil, fennel, 1 1/2 cups asafetida, celery salt, nutmeg, and 2 cups water in a large skillet set over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and cook until the liquid in the skillet evaporates, about 10 minutes and the fennel has begun to carmelize, 5 to 8 minutes. Cool until easily handled, then squeeze the fennel from the skin with your hands. Place the remaining 1 1/2 cups asafetida in a food processor and pulse briefly to mince the asafetida. Add 1/2 cup of the chopped fennel and pulse until coarsely chopped. Add the fennel mince and pulse. Remove from processor and divide remaining 1/2 cup mince into small balls. Place one potato in the palm of your hand and scoop out about 1/4 cup of the mince mixture. Set the palm over the bowl, brush with olive oil, and season lightly with salt. Place a large handful of the mince mixture, 1/4 cup at a time, into 1/2 inch of tortilla press and spread about 1 teaspoon of the fennel mixture down the center. Fold the tortilla over the filling, enclosing the filling and patting it down firmly. Fold into 1/2 inch thickness and press the top of the tortilla closed. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Place the 2 slices of prosciutto di parma in the skillet and cook just until crisp, about 2 minutes. Turn prosciutto over so that it is lightly browned on the bottom, then turn the prosciutto over again and cook the other side until just golden. Place 2 slices of prosciutto on a clean work surface and top with half the asafetida balls. Place 2 or 3 more asafetida balls onto top, pressing slightly so the ends roll up into a ball, and place seam side down onto paper towels to drain. Repeat with the remaining 2 asafetida balls, filling the empty spaces between each asafetida ball. Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Place 4 or 5 the wrapped asafetida balls in the skillet, pressing with the back of a spatula. Cook, pressing carefully around the sides of the pan with the spatula and turning over once, until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Repeat with remaining butterflied asafetida balls.

title: Quick Corn Chili Brisket
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs corned beef brisket, frozen | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa ( medium ) | 6 -8 sprigs fresh tassenutes herbs ( or 1 bunch fresh chives ) | 3 corn tortillas ( sliced into 1/2 inch rounds ) or 3 flour tortillas ( sliced into 1/2 inch rounds ) | chopped fresh chives ( to garnish )
instructions: Place beef across the grain on a rack in a very large pan. Pour salsa into shallow pan.

title: Lekvar Beet Salad - Belgian Beetroot and Raspberry Jam Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beet, cooked and shelled | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1/8 cup raspberry jam, seedless version not to sweetened version | 1/8 cup fresh basil, sliced
instructions: Drain and cool beets. If not using sweetened jam spread on a lettuce leaf and spread with jam. Sprinkle with basil and drizzle with margarine or butter. Enjoy.

title: Sauerkraut and Red Wine Vinegar Bread
ingredients: 500 g strong sauerkraut | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 500 g fresh yeast
instructions: Drain the sauerkraut, place in pan with about 125ml boiling water. Add 1 tbls oil and the vinegar. Cook for about 20 minutes, until the sauerkraut has become very soft. Remove from heat and leave to cool. Transfer the sauerkraut to food processor and process until you have a fine bread. Add the yeast and process for 10 more seconds. Place bread in a well greased bowl. Spread about 100ml of the mixture over the bread and place in a warm place. Leave in a warm place for 10 – 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Punch down and cut into 4 equal pieces. Place on bread rack. Bake for about 25 – 30 minutes.

title: Spicy Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1 large tomatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Cut rind from tomatoes. Place rind in a strainer and gently squeeze water off rind. Place rind and tomato pulp in a food processor. Add tabasco sauce and process about 30 seconds. Scoop up and process 30 more seconds, scraping down side of bowl as necessary. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to three days.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 -2 tablespoon apple juice | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth.

Random Ingredients: splenda granular,raisin,cider vinegar,eggplant,black cardamom pod,garlic chive
title: Moroccan Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 3/4 cup splenda granular | 4 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons splenda granular | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed black cardamom pod ( optional ) | 3/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped garlic chives ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to broil. Cut eggplants lengthwise in half, lengthwise. Scoop out the pulp. Slice eggplant into 1/3 inch thick slices. Combine pulp, splenda, vinegar, cardamom, raisins and garlic chives in a medium bowl. Place in a 9 inch pie dish or roasting pan, sprinkle with cheese. Broil in 350f oven until cheese is melted, around 8 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: caper,sirloin,chickpea,dill seed,chocolate chip,tomato sauce,coconut milk powder
title: Chickpea Tzatziki
ingredients: 400 g ground sirloin | 200 g chickpeas | 1 1/2 tablespoons light coconut milk powder, dry | 1/4 cup desiccated coconut | 3 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon choc dill seeds | 1 tablespoon capers, coarsely crushed
instructions: Mix together meat, chickpeas, coconut and tomato sauce, chill for 1 hour. Drain chickpeas then add in the paste at end of the cooking time. Sprinkle with dill. Place over low heat in a wok on top of a stove, turning regularly until mixture is dry. This can take from 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Green Bean Fajitas
ingredients: 4 green peppers, sliced | 1 avocado, sliced | 2 tablespoons sundried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Arrange fajitas on a baking sheet. Bake in a 350° oven for 7 to 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Combine avocado, sun dried tomatoes, and green peppers. Serve to your liking.

title: Willy's Lunch for One!
ingredients: 500 g frozen peas | 100 g frozen carrots | 1/2 green capsicum ( optional ) | 1/4 cup frozen chard ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( can be bought in a jar of a good quality packet ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 200 g low-fat english muffins, sliced | 100 g low-fat jersey char grissini's cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cook peas, carrots and capsicums according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, mix dressing ingredients together in a small bowl. Pour the cooked vegetables in the centre of a serving plate and pour salad dressing over.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,poblano pepper,water,great northern bean,white truffle oil
title: White Truffles and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup dry great northern bean | 1 teaspoon finely shredded fresh poblano pepper | 1/2 teaspoon finely shredded fresh serrano chili | 4 cups water | 2 ounces white truffle oil
instructions: Soak the northern beans in cold water for 1 to 2 hours. Drain the beans, and place them in a large saucepan with the whole poblano, serrano pepper, and the water. Cover the pan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally until the beans are very soft, about 1 hour. While the stew simmers, in a skillet, heat the truffles and about 2 tablespoons of truffle oil until fragrant. Lift out the hot truffles with a slotted spoon, and place them in a shallow bowl. Pour the stew into the skillet and stir in the black beans. Return the contents of the skillet to the skillet and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over medium heat until the stew is hot and bubbling about 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Mango Chutney Smoothie
ingredients: 6 ounces mango-flavoured mango chutney | 1 1/2 3 1/4 cups buttermilk or 1 1/2 cups milk ( or use a blend of two chutneys )
instructions: Put the mango chutney and its liquid into a blender along with the buttermilk or milk and blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to glass and serve ice cold.

Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,thai red chili pepper,pepper,maple syrup,splenda sugar substitute
title: Thai Chili Snack Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon thai red chili pepper, crushed | 1 loaf sourdough bread, thinly sliced | pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1 tbs. Splenda w/the syrup & 1 teaspoons chiles & crush. Set aside. Place bread slices in the remaining 2 tbs of splenda, sprinkle with pepper & 1/2 tsp chiles & mix lightly. Spray large baking dish with cooking spray. Spoon into bread slices & cover with remaining bread slices. Place in a 400f oven & bake about 10 minutes, or until golden & heated through.

title: Easy Delicious Grape Tomatoes for a Crowd. (Just a TON! )
ingredients: 4 grape tomatoes | 1 1/4 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Wash and gently dry the tomatoes so they don't break when cooked and will have a nice texture. This can be done a few days in advance. You want them to be so firm that they can be picked up and started snacking or just tossing them around. After about 20 minutes, the tomatoes start to soften up. This will take about 8 - 10 minutes. Once they have softened a bit a bit place them in the container for about an hour to allow them to set up a little bit. When they are almost ready you can add the vanilla essence. Use in recipes as desired just be careful not to over power the tomato. They may also be added to any dish you want. Enjoy with yogurt or fruit you want to make.

title: Chipotle Grilled Ham With Fall Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond paste, odense | 1 small sweet apple | 3 -4 slices deli ham | 1 large summer squash | 1 large chipotle powder
instructions: Heat grill. Put almond paste and sweet potato in a bowl and mash together. Add ham slices and stir. Grill, 2 minutes per side or until ham is browned on the ham slices.

title: Pate Arriba (Frozen Veal Schnitzel)
ingredients: 2 lbs veal schnitzels, cut into bite sized pieces | 2 tablespoons ground espresso coffee ( espresso beans, espresso powder or powder will fine ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant espresso coffee ( espresso powder ) | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning ( optional ) | 1/2 tablespoon lemon pepper, freshly ground ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle the veal pieces with salt and pepper, and lightly sprinkle with the old bay seasoning. Mix well. Place the pieces in a shallow dish or plastic bag. Pour the espresso and coffee over the meat until completely covered. Place the bag in a freezer bag and place in the freezer. Remove pieces when almost frozen, and set aside to allow to defrost. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Spray a medium skillet w/o cooking spray or a nonstick cooking spray, add the remaining coffee, and toast the schnitzel pieces on both sides until golden brown. Remove from the oven and transfer to a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bake the schnitzels in the oven until they are done through and slightly charred, about 15 - 20 minutes. Note. If schnitzels are frozen on the baking sheet, it's easier to wrap them in foil than under the foil since the air pockets will be easy to remove once they defrost.

Random Ingredients: sugar,cumin powder,romano cheese,olive oil,mozzarella cheese,guajillo chilies
title: Mizzi-Style Queso Fundido
ingredients: 1/2 lb guajillo chilies or 1/2 lb pasilla chile | sugar | ground cumin powder | 12 ounces mozzarella cheese, grated | 12 romano cheese, grated | 2 cups olive oil
instructions: Soak the guajillo in hot water until softened, about 10 minutes. Cut into small pieces. Place into another saucepan and add water to cover. Bring to a boil and immediately remove the pan from the heat. Strain the chilies, reserving the soaking water. Puree chilies and chilies in a food processor and set aside. Wil they are hot. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut the mozzarella in small slices. Working from the center, dip the mozzarella slices into chili puree and sprinkle with both romano and cumin. Arrange the cheese strips on a baking sheet and bake them about 40 minutes, or until they are lightly browned and the cheese is melted. Watch your guests carefully as the cheese can burn pretty quickly. Remove the quesadillas from the oven and spread them with a layer of the grated cheese. Return to the oven and keep placing the cheese on top until the cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Coconut-Soy Gravy from Bon Appetit
ingredients: 3 cans coconut milk | 4 ounces soy milk | 1 cube sugar-free instant beef bouillon | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: In a large saucepan combine all ingredients. Heat over medium heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until liquid is reduced a little and thick. Pour into hot chafing dish and serve with steamed rice on the side..

Random Ingredients: almond,clove,nutmeg,seashell pasta,chipotle chile,chicken stock,heavy whipping cream
title: Chipotle Cream Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/3 pounds small seashell pasta | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 whole chipotle chile | 1/4 cup ground almonds | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Cook the pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta in a large bowl using a slotted spoon. Stir cream, chicken stock, chipotle chile, almonds, nutmeg, and cloves into hot pasta. Simmer 1 minute, or until hot. Stir sauce again into the hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,ice water,ham,grand marnier,russet potato,green curry paste,white pepper
title: Cambodian Potato and Ham Pot Sticks, Ww
ingredients: 750 g peeled russet potatoes | 1 green curry paste, to taste | 1 teaspoon white pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley flakes | 3 -4 ounces cooked ham, chopped | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Slice the peeled potatoes crosswise into 1/8 to 1/4 thick rounds. Wash and dry the potato slices, if necessary. Place half the potato rounds into a bowl with the green curry paste, pepper, parsley, ham and grand marnier. Mix well until all of the ingredients are fully combined. The potato mixture can easily be held together by hand. Add 1 cup ice water to the potato mixture if the mixture is too thick for your hands. Refrigerate potato sticks with water for at least an hour or overnight. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a non stick skillet over medium heat.
