Using a large spoon, pack the potato sticks tightly and evenly in the skillet. Cook for 4 - 5 minutes or until they become golden on the bottom. Turn over and cook on the other side for another 4 - 5 minutes. Remove from the skillet and cut sticks in half to serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,cherry,extra beef,chicken wing,asiago cheese,corn syrup
title: Roast Chicken Wings
ingredients: 36 chicken wings ( about 6 pounds, cut at lower wings ) | 4 cups vegetable oil, at room temperature | 1/2 cup light corn syrup ( not light or dark ) | 1 lb extra lean ground beef ( can sub ground turkey ) | 1/2 cup minced asiago cheese | 1/2 cup chopped dried cherries
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. In a deep skillet, heat 3 cups of the oil to 325°f. Transfer half of the wings to a cookie sheet, and repeat with remaining wings. In a bowl, combine and mix remaining 1/2 cup oil with corn syrup. Add the corn syrup mixture, and mix well to combine. Set aside. In a large ovenproof skillet, heat remaining oil to 365°f. Add the meat, garlic, and asiago cheese. Cook, stirring, until the meat is lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Arrange the chicken wings in a single layer, in one layer. Spoon about 1 cup of the reserved sauce into a small baking dish, then place the wings in one layer. Bake until chicken is cooked through and sauce is bubbly, about 25 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish, and sprinkle with cherries to serve..

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,juniper berry,pasta sauce home,pickling spice,rigatoni pasta,chicken bouillon cube,walnut,celery seed
title: Rigatoni with Pearl Barley and Walnut Stuffing
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces penne pasta | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( or 10 cubes if you have allergies ) | 16 ounces pasta sauce ( i used herbed home sauce ) | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon pickling spices | 3 ounces pecans, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon dried porcini or 1 -2 tablespoon dried porcini | 1 tablespoon walnut pieces
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. When done, drain and place in large mixing bowl. In saucepan with broth, combine bouillon, water, bouillon cubes, sage, juniper, celery seed, and mixed spices. Bring to boil, then simmer for 15 minutes covered. Add pecans and nuts and stir well. Transfer to small crock pot. Let rest 3 hours and marinade overnight in refrigerator. Remove from refrigerator and allow to rest 20 minutes. Stuff into casings or with toothpicks. P. S note, i never really counted any chicken pieces or other ingredients. Some folks suggested adding diced carrots and celery seeds, which surprised me. I do think there are some good ones that make a great stuffing.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,colby monterey jack cheese,miso,cremini mushroom,shallot,paprika,mango,red chili powder
title: Mango & Eggplant Sliders
ingredients: 1/2 mango, sliced | 4 cucumbers, sliced | 2 eggplants, sliced | 2 shallots, minced | 3 teaspoons miso, divided | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 14 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to heat 1/2 tsp. Miso in a non stick pan over medium high heat. Add mushroom, shallots and miso. Reduce heat to medium low. Add eggplants and saute until they are soft. Place on baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Place sliced mango and eggplants on top of each slice of mango. Add 1/4 tsp. Of paprika. Sprinkle with rest of paprika. Roast in oven for 15 minutes.

title: Rosemary Cream Sauce (Lite & Easy)
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Pour soup into a large bowl & add rosemary sprigs or parsley. Stir to combine well. Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,grain mustard,egg white,rice noodle
title: Rice Noodles With Mustard and Fresh
ingredients: 400 g rice noodles | 2 egg whites | 2 teaspoons lemon juice, from 1/2 of the lemon rind | 2 teaspoons finely ground coarse grain mustard
instructions: Boil the noodles in lots of salted water for 10 - 15 mins, until soft and al dente. Drain well and set aside. Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks using a metal spoon. Add all the other ingredients and knead them gently until everything is well incorporated. Place in a large heat proof bowl or plate and leave in a warm place for 2 hours. Remove from the fridge for about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Cajun Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 3/4 cup cracker crumbs | 4 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1/8 cup chili | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne powder or 1/8 teaspoon chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Put the cracker crumbs and olive oil into a bowl and stir until mix starts to form a small patty. Add your chilli and cayenne powder, a few drops at a time. Stuff with the cracker crumb mix and allow to firm a bit before handling. These don't last long to a week.

title: Baked Cheese and Chicken
ingredients: 4 ounces cheese ( i use a mixture ) | 4 chicken bouillon cubes ( knorr is traditional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 and grease 4 baking sheets. Add the cheese to a small dish and warm it up over a pan of simmering water. Add bouillon to half the pan, stir and cook for a few minutes. Take the cheese and bouillon from the pan and toss them into the sauce until well coated. Pour the mixture onto the baking sheets, placing them in the oven on top of each other. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Turn the oven off and cool the cheese. The cheese will melt before becoming hard and crunchy and the sauce will firm up as the oven cools.

title: Classic Black & Gourmet Swiss Cornbread
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 4 cups cooked rice ( i used jasmine rice ) | 1/4 cup sweet black coffee | 6 teaspoons dried thyme | 1/3 cup shredded gruyere or 1/3 cup gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon rice flour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Mix corn, cooked rice, coffee and thyme in a bowl. Transfer to a lightly greased 9x5x3 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake in a preheated 400 oven uncovered for about 20 minutes, or until topping is bubbly. If you like it toasty, sprinkle with more cheese after 20 minutes. Cool slightly before slicing, or remove from pan.

title: Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garam masala ( optional ) | 1 package provolone cheese
instructions: Pierce the cheese with a toothpick several times. Rub the top with olive oil. Sprinkle with garam masala. Let it sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Grill until it's browned, about 7 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red wine,black cardamom pod,red curry paste
title: Spiced Red Curry
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 -2 black cardamom pod
instructions: Place the curry paste on your favourite heat/sedarian cook/spice grinder and grind to a fine powder, usually 1 - 2 tablespoons. Add the red wine and black cardamom pods and grind again until the mixture is fine and forms a thick paste. Keep refrigerated until required. Keep refrigerated until required.

title: Mango Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package noodles | 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and cut into small pieces | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Toss noodles with mango, baked beans, and dressing until coated.

title: Coconut-Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons light coconut | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Heat coconut in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken until well browned and cooked through. Transfer to a plate. Pour coconut off the heat. Add a little water to skillet and bring to a boil. Add chopped parsley and taste for seasoning. Serve over rice.

title: Maggie Beer's Rye Bread
ingredients: 300 g light rye bread | 350 g baby carrots, cleaned | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 50 g chocolate, roughly chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 120°c. Wash and dry the bread. Cut into rounds and place in a muffin pan. Place in oven and cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until golden brown. Keep an eye on it so it doesn't burn. Remove from pan and store in an air tight container. Melt together the chocolate with the cardamom seeds. To serve, take a slice of rye bread and sprinkle over the chocolate mousse. Add the carrots and drizzle with the chocolate mousse.

title: Fried Dijon Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tomatoes puree | 1 1/2 bunches walnuts | 2 oranges | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 cup wheat germ | 1 pinch cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons honey, warmed
instructions: Trim tomatoes and cut into 8 slices. Using a sharp knife cut a cross on the bottoms and then cut through the top of tomatoes with the peel on. Place on clean tea towel and rub down. Tear walnut pieces and peel or process them in a blender or food processor.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,grain white rice,italian salad dressing,sea scallop,mahi
title: Seared Mahi Mahi With Sauteed Scallops
ingredients: 2 mahi mahi | 6 ounces sea scallops | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing | 1 cup daikon radish, julienned | cooked short-grain white rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat a non stick pan set over high heat. Drizzle 1/2 of a teaspoon of olive oil into the pan, then season the scallops with salt and pepper. Saute for 3 minutes on each side. Transfer to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and place in the oven, lower temperature to broil, and toast for 4 - 5 minutes and turn. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the dressing and radishes. Place the scallops on a plate and divide the radishes between the 6 plates. Drizzle on 1/6 of the dressing and serve immediately. Note, to test to see if the sesame oil in the sesame oil is hot, remove from heat when the sesame oil starts to sputter when a toothpick comes out dry.

title: Komayaki
ingredients: 1/2 cup beehive-nori | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Cut beef steak into small cubes about 2 cm in size. Soak beef in soymilk until it turns soft, about 20 minutes. Boil in a pot. Heat a frying pan, pour about 1 1/2 tbs. Of oil in it. Drain beef with a slotted spoon and place in a serving dish. Cover with a thick kitchen towel and wrap tightly. Serve while it's still hot.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,cardamom powder,arborio rice,apricot nectar,grain rice,beef,rigatoni pasta,shrimp
title: Frugal Gourmet Group Arhario Rice
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 1 lb beef, minced, ground, with a little fat, added to the rice | 1 pinch cardamom powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 cups arborio rice, cooked, kept warm | 1 cup dried apricot nectar | 1/2 cup short-grain rice, kept warm in a cup | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch cardamom powder | 1/4 cup dried arborio rice, kept warm in a cup | 1 tablespoon beef, paste mixed with olive oil
instructions: Marinate the meat with the spices. Remove from the marinade with your fingers and set aside. Place the rice on a large plate. Drain the water from the marinating meat. Place all the marinating meat in the rice. Cover and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours, shaking the pan several times, until the rice is just warm and absorbed by the meat. Set aside. Heat a separate pot of water to boiling. Add the rice. Cook a minute or two just until the grains absorb some of the water. Drain the rice and run under cold water to soak up any excess water. Repeat as necessary to soak up more water, drain rice and set aside. Wash and drain apricot nectar. Set aside. Heat a pan with a little oil. Sauté the beef paste until it turns brown. Take out and drain. Season the beef paste with a little salt and pepper. Add to the beef paste and cook on high heat for a minute. Add the apricot nectar and rice. Stir to combine. Add the cayenne pepper, cardamom powder and salt and pepper to taste and mix. Continue stirring until contents start to bubble. Turn the heat down and let this simmer for 3 to 4 minutes. Keep on high for another minute or two. Turn heat off. Remove all the meat from the refrigerator and set aside. Add the shrimp back into the pot. Take the reserved shrimp water and pour it over the shrimp and rice. Mix. Scoop out the meat from the refrigerator and reserve. Add the cooked meat to the risotto and mix through. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red currant,sugar,double cream,chinese celery,asiago cheese,baking powder
title: Sour Cream  Celery  Salad with red Currants
ingredients: 4 ounces chinese celery | 1/2 ounce asiago cheese, chopped | 6 fluid ounces double cream or 6 fluid ounces whipping cream | 3 tablespoons red currants | 3/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Cut the celery into 1 - 2 lengths. Slice the asiago cheese into small pieces. Microwave the cream in a small dish for 2 - 3 minutes, until warm. Add the red currants and sugar, and gently fold together with a little of the hot cream from the microwave. Pour the red cream mixture over the chopped celery and serve.

title: Mexican Broccoli with Clams
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli florets | 1/2 cup bottled clam juice | 2 jalapeno peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Cook broccoli in a large saucepan of boiling water for 3 minutes, or until tender but crisp. Drain well. Rinse with cool water.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,red onion,mustard seed,allspice,sherry,courgette,vanilla ice cream
title: Rice & Spicy Beef Skewers  (Cookies)
ingredients: 300 g extra lean ground beef | 150 g red onions, finely diced | 2 tablespoons sherry | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 4 tablespoons vanilla ice cream | 5 large courgettes, chopped into 3cm chunks
instructions: Preheat an oven to 160°c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. To make the meatballs, place the beef, onion, sherry, mustard seeds, allspice, ice cream and courgettes in a large bowl and lightly mix to combine. Shape the meat mixture into 28 smaller meatballs. Arrange in the prepared tray and bake on a baking sheet for 25 minutes or until cooked through and starting to brown. Serve with plain yoghurt, lemon wedges, chutney or jam.

title: Onion and Parmesan Dressing
ingredients: 6 ounces parmesan cheese | 1 ounce dried onion | ground paprika
instructions: Combine parmesan cheese and onion in a food processor. Blend and add a teaspoon of paprika.

title: Krustethes (Crispy Fried Chicken Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken, skinned and de-boned | 4 teaspoons potato starch | 1/8 lb cheese, cut into small dices
instructions: Pat chicken dry and place in a bowl with potato starch mixed with 1/8 cup water, making sure starch is moistened. Beat with a fork until smooth and well distributed. Fry in 350 degree f olive oil about 7 to 10 minutes or until brown, turning once. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle top lightly with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,baking potato,oyster sauce,romaine lettuce,tequila,steak seasoning
title: Beef and Roasted Red Pepper Gyros
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 teaspoon steak seasoning | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1 red bell pepper, quartered lengthwise and cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce | 4 romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes in a 9x13 inch baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Mix steak seasoning, olive oil, and red bell pepper in a bag. Add to the bag and shake to coat all of the potatoes. Place the potatoes on the baking dish.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,stewing beef,egg wrapper,poblano chile,lime juice,ricotta cheese,penne pasta,tortilla chip
title: Mexican Beef Cheese & Poblanos
ingredients: 20 large frozen egg roll wrappers | 0.5 package refrigerated fat-free ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons minced fresh italian parsley | 2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded, chopped ( about 6 ounces total ) | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked ( preferably whole wheat pasta ) | 15 tortilla chips, crushed ( about 15 squares )
instructions: Thaw dough and assemble assembled filling. In a bowl, combine ricotta, lime juice, parsley, beef, poblanos, salt, and pepper and mix thoroughly. Unwrap each chilled roll and place about 1 teaspoon of meat and 1 tablespoon zest and about 1/2 teaspoon pasta in the center of a wrapper. Brush edge of wrapper with egg drop. Fold over filling and pinch edges tightly together to seal. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Place on a greased baking sheet. Cover and freeze for several hours or overnight. To bake, preheat oven to 375°f spray a baking dish with cooking spray. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each wrapper as thin as you can to cut into 6 wedges approximately 3 by 5 inches. Arrange wedges on baking sheet in a single layer. Bake until lightly browned, about 20 minutes, turning often. Set aside to cool. Serve cheese on a bed of tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: table salt,green pea,white cake mix,kiwi,pearl barley,red cabbage
title: Quick Irish Corn Bread Wedges
ingredients: 1 package dry white cake mix | 2 1/2 cups pearl barley | 10 kiwi, peeled and cut in half | 1/2 cup green peas, frozen | 1 medium red cabbage, finely sliced and chopped into thin wedges | 1 teaspoon table salt
instructions: Prepare and bread mix according to package directions, using the white cake mix. Drain liquid from kiwis and combine with the barley, kiwis and peas. Remove the corn bread from the oven and spoon the cornbread mixture onto a baking sheet. Sprinkle with table salt. Bake for 25 minutes in a preheated 350º oven, until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,cream mushroom soup,zucchini,bacon,pecorino romano cheese,serrano chili,taco sauce,water chestnut
title: Zucchini Tacos
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup water chestnut, chopped | 10 -12 fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 12 slices bacon | 6 ounces of shredded caciocavallo cheese or 6 ounces ricotta cheese | serrano chili, minced
instructions: Cut zucchini in lengthwise slices. Combine mushroom soup, water chestnuts, 1/2 of the spinach, and the remaining spinach in deep skillet. Heat until hot, stir in zucchini, bacon, and the chili.

title: Hungarian Spicy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb red cabbage | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: In a large skillet, brown cabbage in melted butter. Turn cabbage over and brown other side. Pour off drippings. Sprinkle paprika over cabbage. Let sit, covered, for 20 minutes.

title: Lemon Stock
ingredients: 3 cubes chicken soup base | 1 tablespoon lemon extract
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken base, lemon extract, and 1 gallon of water. Boil for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and strain into a glass jar. Store in refrigerator.

title: Spicy Salmon
ingredients: 600 g salmon fillets, bones removed | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Mix the yogurt and sugar together well and sprinkle over the salmon fillets. Bake in oven for 20 mins or until done,.

Random Ingredients: white wine,balsamic vinegar,shiitake mushroom,vegetable oil cooking spray,part ricotta cheese,sprig lavender
title: Shiitake Mushroom & Balsamic Focaccia
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package shiitake mushrooms ( about 3 cups ) or 1 package cremini mushrooms ( about 3 cups ) | 1/3 cup reduced-fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon crushed dried lavender
instructions: Spray 12 inch pizza pan with vegetable oil cooking spray. Slice dried mushrooms crosswise into 1/4 inch thick strips. Arrange mushrooms over pizza pan, overlapping slightly if necessary. Bake at 400°f 5 minutes, or until mushrooms are softened and lightly browned. Let cool. Stir together ricotta, vinegar, wine and lavender. Spread over mushrooms and bake at 400°f 5 minutes or until slightly bubbly. Serve at room temperature.

title: Radish Shortbread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar ( icing sugar ) | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped radishes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees and line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a small bowl mix confectioners' sugar and radishes together. Spread into a greased 9x5 x 2 loaf pan. Bake in lower third of oven 30 minutes, until slightly pale gold and firm. Cool and remove from baking sheets, cut into 1/2 slices. Arrange slices on parchment paper and store in airtight tin.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,grape,beef bouillon cube,iceberg lettuce,salmon fillet,celery salt,shortcrust pastry,black vinegar
title: Chunky Salsa Salmon
ingredients: 2 packages flaky shortcrust pastry, thawed | 1 large salmon fillet, skinned, bones removed | 3 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 1/2 tablespoons black vinegar | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 1 tablespoon grated fresh flat-leaf parsley, for garnishing | 1 1/2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Grease baking dish with cooking spray. Place fillet on a work surface.

Random Ingredients: berry,burrito flour tortilla,italian parsley,white wine,provolone cheese
title: Italian Flag Tortillas
ingredients: 6 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/3 cup prosciutto cheese, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 cups fresh mixed berries, washed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Warm the tortillas in a large skillet over medium heat until warmed and slightly crisp, about 4 minutes. Place them on a baking sheet lined with foil. Spread 1 tablespoon of prosciutto over 1/6 of each tortilla, followed by 1 tablespoon of parsley and 1/3 cup of white wine. Fold the tortillas in half, and place in the oven for 10 minutes, or until heated through and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 3 cups cashews | kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Toss cashews with salt in a bowl and spread on prepared baking sheets. Bake cashews in the preheated oven until they turn slightly darker, about 40 minutes. Cool on a rack. Break off pieces of cashews and roll them in a small amount of cashew Crunch cereal while still warm. Place cereal in a large, resealable bag. Pipe cashew Crunch onto parchment paper, shaking off excess air and scatter over cashews.

title: Simple Ketchup
ingredients: 1 pint of crushed grape tomatoes | 1 lb ketchup or 1 lb tomato puree | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Mix all together in a bowl. Store in an airtight container.

title: Cheese Fondue for babies (Dinner) -- Chèvreurs Recette
ingredients: 8 ounces whole milk chocolate chips | 1 pinch saffron | 1 ounce strawberry
instructions: Place chocolate chips in a medium saucepan. Add saffron. Bring to the boil, stirring frequently, for 1 minute. Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot. Stir quickly until melted and smooth. Remove from heat and cool in the fondue pot for 2 hours. If the fondue is to hard to stir, add a small amount of very hot water. Refrigerate until chilled.

Random Ingredients: celery,green olive,sharp cheddar cheese,hard egg,balsamic vinegar,dark rum
title: Cheddar, Ale, Egg and Balsamic Salad   for One
ingredients: 5 large hard-boiled eggs, peeled and coarsely chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup dry green olives, such as shishito ( or brine-cured black olives ) | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 7 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 450 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper or foil and oil wax paper. Combine eggs, celery, and olives and transfer to large bowl. Toss to blend. Add vinegar and rum and toss to combine well. Remove pan from oven and sprinkle shredded cheese over salad. Cover and set aside to marinate, at least 20 minutes. Transfer salad to plate or invert onto serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,salami,almond meal,salsa,taco seasoning mix,black bean
title: Salsa Beef Burgers
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck steak | 2 teaspoons fat free taco seasoning mix | 1 can black beans, drained | 1/3 cup prepared salsa ( see note ) | 2/3 cup roasted salami, sliced | 1/3 cup almond meal
instructions: Heat skillet on low. In a large bowl, combine ground beef and taco seasoning mix. Add beans, salsa and salami. Form into 4 patties. Place burgers on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Top with almonds meal. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 25 minutes.

title: Indian Chutney
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Mix all together and store in an airtight tin to keep the heat and spices good and hot for upto 4 days.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,polish sausage,monterey jack pepper cheese,lamb,tamari
title: Lamb of the Lamb-Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1/4 lb lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 jalapeno chile ( stem and seeds removed and finely diced ) | 4 ounces polish sausage ( or other sausages ) | 1 ounce monterey jack pepper cheese | butter flavor enhancer ( such as durkee's )
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except meat and cheese, in a fondue pot.

title: Paglia E Piselli  (Rutabaga and Vege Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb ground turkey | 1/2 medium zucchini | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | salt and white pepper
instructions: Chop vegetables in medium sized pieces. Place meat in pot and add tomato paste. Add bouillon. Bring to boil on med heat and cook for 5 minutes. If there isn't enough liquid place a piece of cheesecloth in a small tea ball to keep submerged. Remove the bouillon from heat and allow to cool. Remove the bouillon cube and taste for salt and pepper. If too salty taste add warm water until it tastes right. Pour back into soup pot and let it dry off completely. Enjoy.

title: Pear and savoy cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium yellow mustard seed | 3 medium savoy cabbage, cored, chopped coarsley | 1 medium pear, peeled, cored and chopped coarsley | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Place mustard seeds in a small frying pan and toast over med high heat, stirring frequently, until golden. Remove and discard seeds from pan. Using a heavy cooking pan, sauté cabbage and pear over a low heat, stirring frequently, for about 20 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter. Add vinegar and cook for a few minutes, stirring, until liquid evaporates and cabbage starts to wilt. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour hot dressing over cabbage and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dark raisin,thyme sprig,chili flake,seasoning,milk ricotta cheese,bay leaf,green onion
title: Homemade Ricotta With Raisins & Thyme
ingredients: 2 containers whole milk ricotta cheese or ( 750 g ) containers fat-free ricotta cheese | 3 -4 green onions, chopped | 1 tablespoon dark raisin | 4 fresh thyme sprigs, chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet chili flakes | thyme sprigs ( to garnish ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a bowl combine the ricotta, green onions, raisins, thyme, and chili flakes, mix well. Cover and refrigerate for several hours at least overnight. Remove the bay leaf before serving. Serve on a bed of roasted baby greens, with the garnish of thyme on the side.

title: Basic Roasted Salmon
ingredients: 1 large fresh salmon, skin removed | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425° f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the salmon skin side down on the baking sheet. Pour the olive oil over the salmon and sprinkle with the salt. Roast in the oven until the salmon is well flakey and the skin has crisped, 45 to 50 minutes. Remove from the oven and serve.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,blue curacao,crystal sugar,alfredo sauce,red cabbage,oat
title: Blue Lagoon ‘n' Blue Cheese
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup crystal sugar | 1/4 cup rolled oats | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 cup shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup crumbled blue curacao
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix alfredo sauce, Crystal sugar, rolled oats, and rosemary together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer shredded cabbage, blue curacao, and salted crackers, crushed crostini, and crumbled blue cheese in the baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until crackers are lightly browned and bubbling, 10 to 20 minutes.

title: Simple Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 8 -10 leaves bibb lettuce | ice cube
instructions: Take a lettuce leaf and place in a round glass baking dish. You can use a similar size glass that the baking dish has been sitting in. If not using the round glass dish right away, cut off the tops and hollow out the inside of the dish. Using a sharp knife slice off the top of the lettuce until it is just covered. With a spoon take out the seeds and outer leaves and set the leaves aside. Using the side with the hollowed out lettuce you removed from now add the ice cubes into the hollowed out lettuce. Roll up firmly and place in the baking dish and cover.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,active yeast,red chile powder
title: Yummy Red Chile Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground red chile powder
instructions: Mix the yeast into a bowl with the dark soy sauce and ground chile powder. Set aside until the mixture is bubbly. Pour into the bowl with the yeast mixture and stir to form a dough. Knead briefly, place in a bowl, cover with a damp cloth to prevent drying. Allow to rise for half an hour or until doubled. Heat pizza stone in a 450 degrees f oven for 5 - 9 minutes. Add the dough to the pizza stone, and stretch to fit the size of stone. Place toppings on the pizza as desired. Bake until crust is golden brown, about 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Easy Salmon Cooked in One Sauce
ingredients: 1 package salmon steaks | 1 jar chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Place salmon in a 10x15 inch baking pan or on a large resealable plastic bag. Cover salmon with salsa. Coat pan or bag with cooking spray. Place in a preheated 475 degrees f oven. Cook, turning once, 10 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Spiral Sausage Patties
ingredients: 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 1/2 cups sliced matsutake mushrooms | 20 ounces spiral shaped pasta, uncooked
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions. While pasta is cooking, sprinkle icing sugar in bowl, set aside. Spread 1/3 cup of the mushrooms in a large, nonstick skillet. Lightly brown the mushrooms. Using your hands, press a small amount of rice in centre of mushrooms.

title: Tropical Smoked Salmon, Rice Krispies & Sausage Pies
ingredients: 200 g streaky smoked sausage | vegetable oil, for deep frying | 1 packet spelt flour ( i had to use gluten-free flour for this ) | 1 packet sausages | 200 g cooked sausage ( i also used spicy bbq sausages ) | 100 g dried dates, chopped ( soak in hot water for approx 10 minutes before chopping ) | 200 g kirsh mixed dried fruit ( soak in hot water for approx 10 minutes then drain then spread out on paper towel to dry ) | 6 -8 plain rice krispies ( i like my kijs ) | 1/4 cup walnuts
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Pile the smoked sausage on a board or chopping board then roll it out thinly & roughly. Trim off the top and bottom of the smoked sausage.. Use one end of the sausage to flatten each sausage. Roll the pastry out again to form a rectangle large enough to line the base of a 6 hole x 4 hole, approximately 22cm x 12cm x 25cm x 1/4 deep. Repeat to make 12 sausage shapes. Heat enough oil for shallow frying to just cover the base of the sausage. Heat on a low flame and fry the sausages. Turn them over with a wide spatula and continue to cook them for 1 minute. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel to dry then slice thinly. Cut up the sausage into 1/4s dice & arrange evenly in the base of the pastry. Chop the raw sausages lengthwise then divide into bite size pieces. To test whether the smoke is ready, lift the edge of the pastry lid with your finger, it should crackle a little but should not be fully cooked. Using a small, sharp knife place a small piece of sausage on the rice cakes, close up & then pinch the two pieces together & then press them firmly, pressing the rice to seal. You should now be able to form small patties. Heat another frying pan on a medium heat and repeat with the other frying ingredients. Serve with either steamed or fried rice krispies or roasted vegetables. I cooked this, wrapped in aluminium foil, in a foil / tin foil oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Wild Mushroom Jam With Sun Dried Tomato Oil and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 large green tomatoes, peeled and diced | 1 pound mushrooms, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and sliced thin
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, bring enough salted water to cover the tomatoes by 1 inch. Place the mushrooms and tomatoes in the pot. Cover, and cook for about 10 minutes. Stir in the confectioners' sugar and sun dried tomatoes, and heat thoroughly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,english mustard,palm sugar,dumpling wrapper,chili pepper flake,pinto bean,pineapple chunk,nori
title: Sweet Bean & Pineapple Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean, soaked in water overnight and drained | 4 cups cold mashed potato | 2 -3 tablespoons palm sugar | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dumpling wrapper | 2 sheets nori ( dried seaweed ) | 1 can unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained and juice reserved | 2 tablespoons prepared english mustard
instructions: Drain the beans and place in a dutch oven or large pan. Add water to cover and bring to a boil and simmer for 4 minutes. Drain the beans and place them back to the dutch oven. Dice potato and add to the pan with the coconut palm sugar, chili bean flakes and dumplings. Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes or until the potato is tender. Serve while hot. Dissolve the palm sugar in the reserved pineapple juice. Arrange seaweed sheets on a serving platter and divide the potato mixture among them. Drizzle mustard over potato mixture and scatter with pineapple chunks over the top. Note, if making the dumplings, add a dollop of mustard to the potato mixture before baking as the dressing will make the dumplings crisp when they are baked. Dried seaweed sheets can be used in place of the seaweed sheets for variety. Also, dry seaweed can be used in place of the seaweed sheets for variety. This recipe produces more flavor and color in the potato mixture.

title: Noodles With Ginger, Bay Leaf And Rum Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 cups ginger, finely chopped | 1/3 cup golden rum | 1 cup egg noodles | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Place the parsnips in a boiling water with the water. Cook covered until tender, about 12 - 15 minutes. Drain, reserving the cooking water. Chop parsnips coarsely and set aside. Heat the rum in a small saucepan over medium heat until fragrant. Bring to simmering point. Stir the ginger and pour the rum over the parsnips, stir to coat and heat through. While the mixture is heating, cook the noodles according to package directions. Drain and toss with the reserved cooking water and set aside. When the noodles are done, toss in the reserved cooking water and toss to coat. Spoon noodles onto serving platter. Spoon ginger mixture over top. Garnish with bay leaves.

title: Italian Breaded Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash, sliced thin | 1 lb carrot, sliced thin | 1/4 cup pimento stuffed olive, chopped | 1 cup fat-free broth | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger | 1 bottle beer | 1 tablespoon rubbed sage leaves
instructions: Heat oil in medium skillet. Layer squash, carrots, olives, broth, bread crumbs, ginger in a large bowl. Pour beer over salad. Sprinkle with sage. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,eggplant,pork shoulder,tomato sauce,jicama,molasses,bicarbonate soda
title: Pork and Eggplant Fritters
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon molasses | 3 slices pork shoulder | 1 large tomatoes, finely sliced ( about 1 tablespoon ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce
instructions: Mix the eggplant with the molasses, then set aside. Tear the pork into 1 inch pieces. Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat, and fry the pork for a few minutes, stirring constantly, until lightly browned. Add the tomato and stir until heated through. Remove the pork pieces with a slotted spoon, leaving the oil and tomato mixture behind. Return the pork to the pan and stir fry until nicely browned. Return the pork and juices to the pan, then add the molasses and bicarb of soda, and cook for further 2 minutes, or until the mixture thickens slightly. Stir in the tomato sauce and cook for 1 minute. Serve and keep in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

title: Pepper Jelly Asparagus Bites
ingredients: 2 packages frozen peas, thawed | 3 tablespoons salted peanuts | 1 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 36 slices rye bread | 36 asparagus, tips trimmed | 32 marshmallows | 32 raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place peas with peanuts in a food processor or blender.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,sauce,italian parsley,brussels sprout,red chili pepper
title: Sausage and Brussels Sprouts Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout | 2 ounces chorizo sausages | 1 hot red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley ( leaves only ) or 2 teaspoons dried parsley, leaves ( leaves only ) | 2 dashes hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Remove the leaves from the sprouts, rinse in cold water and drain well. Heat a wok over high heat, add the chorizo, chili, oil and chorizo and stir fry for 1 minute. Add the sprouts, stir fry for 3 minutes. Sprinkle with the parsley, stir fry for 1 minute. Serve with pasta, rice, or as a garnish over salads.

title: Vietnamese Beef and Noodles
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces egg noodles | 2 ounces hamburger | 2 slices vidalia onions | 1/3 cup vegetables | 1/3 cup wheat bran | 2 tablespoons crushed dried ancho chilies
instructions: Preheat grill. Break onion into thin strips. Cook noodles in a medium saucepan of boiling salted water for 10 - 12 minutes or until tender. Drain. Cut hamburger into thin slices. Place 1/3 cup wheat bran in a small bowl. Drain noodles. Place 1/3 cup of noodles in a small bowl. Coat with bran in a thin layer of soy sauce. Spread 1 tablespoon of crushed ancho chili in a thin layer in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle on noodles. Cover with remaining 1 tablespoon of bran sprin sprin. Bake in a 425°f for 14 to 17 minutes or until topping is browned and bubbly. Serve with condiments.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,green bell pepper,brown mustard seed,lemon wedge
title: Bell Pepper Relish for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 4 green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons coarsely crushed dried roasted brown mustard seeds | 10 lemon wedges, for garnish
instructions: Place all of the pepper strips in a plastic spice bag.

title: Spicy Spicy Cashews (Using a Spice Mixture Mixture Mixture Mixture)
ingredients: 16 ounces spicy chicken sausage | 1 package fresh brown sugar
instructions: Cook sausage in large pot on stove until no longer pink. Drain. Place in medium bowl. Sprinkle sugar over top and mix. Cover and place in fridge for 1 hour before using. Cook in skillet on medium heat 5 - 7 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

title: Spinach Phyllo and Shellfish (Kolokosasi)
ingredients: 1 package spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon mace | 1 onion, minced | 2 -3 cups chopped water chestnuts | 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Blanch spinach in boiling water for a few seconds. Drain and cut leaves into strips. Heat a heavy skillet in a large ovenproof bowl over medium heat. Add spinach, mace and onion and cook, stirring frequently, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Add water chestnuts and cook, stirring, until the water evaporates, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cool thoroughly. Preheat oven to 375°f. Unroll phyllo sheets from one sheet and begin cutting with a 3rd sheet as you work. Lay down an extended sheet of phyllo and top with remaining sheets, slightly overlaping each other to form 6 stacks, brushing with a little olive oil each sheet before adding next. Roll up each stack. Place on lightly greased or parchment paper covered baking sheet, seam side down. Repeat process until all phyllo sheets are rolled into 12 stacks, piling them neatly in an even layer. Brush tops of stacks with olive oil and bake until golden brown and filling is bubbling, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,self raising flour,honey,water,sherry wine,velveeta cheese
title: Cheese & Onion Scrolls
ingredients: 500 g velveeta cheese ( use only the good stuff ) | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon dry sherry wine ( or other brand ) | 1/2 cup honey | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 5 tablespoons water
instructions: First, make the scone and onions, preheat oven to 190 c. Line a baking tray with greaseproof paper and grease or line with baking paper. Cut cheese into 20 cm cubes and place on the lined tray. Combine flour, sherry, honey, mustard and water, and add to cheese. Mix well. Roll mixture into 20cm x 5cm sticks pressing the dough firmly into the corners of the tray. Place on the tray and cook for 20 - 30 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,chocolate ice cream,cream cheese,cake flour
title: Chocolate Sundae Cheesecake (S)
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 3 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate ice cream | 1/2 cup cake flour | fresh parsley sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine cream cheese and 1 t. Unsweetened chocolate ice cream. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until smooth. Add 2 t. Chocolate ice cream and mix well. Add 3 t. Chocolate ice cream and beat at low speed until mixture begins to thicken. Divide mixture evenly among 4 greased 8 inch round cake pans and smooth the tops. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until well chilled, at least 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator and remove plastic wrap. Top each layer evenly with 1 t. Finishing chocolate. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or until well chilled. Top each cake with remaining 1 t. Finished chocolate. Serve cold with garnish of fresh parsley.

title: Carnival Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 1 tablespoon pepper | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon meat, minced
instructions: Make two slits along the side of each chicken breast. Apply pepper and rum to the chicken. Place in a steamer and cook for 20 minutes. Turn once and cook for 10 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,seasoning salt,mayonnaise,serrano chilies,basmati rice,monterey jack cheese,tomato sauce
title: Arroz Con Chiles (Rice Balls)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked basmati rice | 1/2 medium ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1 serrano chilies, chopped, seeds and ribs removed ( use more or less depending on your taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 12 ounces tomato sauce, bottled in small jars ( hunts ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup mild mexican style picante sauce or 1 -1 1/2 cup picante sauce
instructions: Place rice in a sieve and rinse under cold running water until water runs clear. Drain well and pat dry. Meanwhile mix mayonnaise, tomato sauce and seasoning salt. To make arroz con chiles, place a serrano chile and diced tomatoes in a small skillet, chopped small. Stir to combine and cook until tomatoes are soft, about five minutes. Spread a small bowl containing the rice on a small rimmed baking sheet, place the chile mixture in the bowl, then roll it up, jelly roll style. If all the rice balls are rolled up into cylinders, line them up on the baking sheet. Cover with foil and refrigerate until ready to serve. Reheat and reheat sauce. When ready to serve, serve rice balls in sauce and top with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: linguine,dark rum,lemon pepper,mint sprig,rutabaga,pineapple tidbit,adobo sauce,fava bean
title: El Jí Limeno, Puerto Rican Favas and Pineapple Linguine
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fresh fava beans | 2 lemons, juice of | 1 cup canned pineapple tidbits, drained with 1/4 cup reserved ( or tidbits of fresh pineapple ) | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper, freshly ground | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce ( from can ) | 1 lb linguine ( or your favourite thin pasta ) | 2 cups rutabagas, shredded ( fresh or frozen, sweet potatoes, if available )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. Cook favas according to package directions, but do not peel. Let cool slightly, then transfer the favas and juice to a blender. Pulse favas until pureed, then add sugar, lemon pepper, rum, lemon juice and chipotle powder to taste, then pulse once more, to combine. Toss pasta with half of the cooked fava sauce. Top with rutabagas.

title: Broiler-dared Dijon-Glazed Red Chilli Relish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dijon mustard ( use extra light if possible ) | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped ( dried chilli flakes work too, too )
instructions: Place the chilli flakes in a mortar or pestle and pound them into a fine powder and leave to one side. Blend the chilli powder with the mustard until the consistency becomes a paste with a pleasant texture. Pack into a sterilised jar with a little mustard on top. Use as needed for snacking. Wash your hands thoroughly and rub the chilli flakes over the relish. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Borracho Blanco Cocktail
ingredients: 45 -60 ml chili powder | 1 serrano pepper, sliced thin | 12 ounces beer, preferably heinz or 12 ounces white rum
instructions: Shake to blend. Pour over ice. Garnish with avocado slices and paprika if desired.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,caster sugar,herb,mustard,grain rice,spanish olive,white breadcrumb
title: Spanish "chicken" and Olive Appetizer Balls
ingredients: 100 g spanish olives, chopped | 100 g soft soft whole-grain rice | 300 g caster sugar | 150 ml thick cider vinegar | 3 teaspoons mustard | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( thyme, sage, dill, savory, rosemary, oregano ) | 1 cup dry white breadcrumbs
instructions: Place olives, rice and sugar in a large glass bowl. Combine cider vinegar, mustard and herbs in the bottom of a saucepan, stirring to dissolve sugar. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Pour over rice mixture, stir over medium heat, cover with cling film and chill for 15 to 20 minutes. Add breadcrumbs and cook for 40 - 50 seconds, stirring, until breadcrumbs just start to crisp up.

title: Grilled Okra Skewers, Okra and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs okra, fresh | 4 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, about 6 | 1/2 cup fresh parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger juice
instructions: Cut the stems off the okra and discard the strings and cut off some of the fuzziness if it needs to be. If they are very large, cut them in half lengthwise. Put the stem pieces into a bowl and sprinkle generously with salt. Toss to coat. Cover and allow to stand at room temperature at least 20 minutes, stir and shake the okra over a bowl often if they seem dry and limp. Thread about 6 okra pieces onto each skewer, alternating with another piece of okra at each end. Grill over high heat 5 - 7 minutes on each side. Place okra on a serving platter and cover loosely with foil to keep warm. Drain okra and serve with remaining dressing and salad greens.

title: Homemade Sesame Oil
ingredients: 1 cup raw ground sesame seeds, toasted | 6 cups broth
instructions: In a large, heavy pot over medium heat, mix together the sesame seeds, ground sesame, and water. Stir in broth and adjust salt to taste.

title: Tamarind Potato Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 1 lb hamburger | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 cup cornflour
instructions: Boil potatoes with tamarind, drain. Cut burger in 4 - 5 pieces and add into potatoes. Add vanilla and corn flour. Mix well and form into 4 patties. Cook on the barbecue.

title: Honey Glazed Lasagna
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 oven ready lasagna noodle
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small mixing bowl whisk together the tahini, honey and 1/4 to 1/2 cup water. In a bowl add the noodle noodles and coat on all sides. Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with pam. In the oven until done and bubbly about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,rutabaga,active yeast,cod,baking chocolate,habanero pepper,creole seasoning
title: Cod and Potato Cakes
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 cups cooked cod, shredded ( or leftover cooked potatoes, cooked in salt and butter until it is cooked but not dry ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning ( or other hot seasoning of your choice ) | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 2 ounces baking chocolate, chopped | 1 -2 habanero pepper, seeded and minced ( or serrano if unavailable, chopped ) | 2 tablespoons minced salted anchovies or 2 tablespoons salted anchovies | 1/2 cup salted rutabagas and 1/2 cup other chutney
instructions: Combine the cod, potatoes, yeast, creole seasoning and 1 tsp oil in the bowl of a food processor, or a food mill and process until smooth. Spray 2 - 12 cake pans with nonstick spray or line with parchment paper. Scrape down the sides of the bowl, then fill with the batter 1/2 full, pressing the top on lightly and level off. Smooth top, then bake at 350f for about 45 - 50 minutes, until top is puffed and golden brown and surface is crisp. Let stand for about 10 minutes before turning out on a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Green Green Chili Powder(Habanero Beans)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach, stems trimmed | 1 habanero pepper or 1/4 of an anaheim pepper, stems removed
instructions: Clean the chili pepper or chili pepper by immersing in boiling water for about 3 minutes after removing the stem. Drain and pat dry in a towel or paper bag. Place the chile or chilli in a dry cast iron skillet or on a comal and cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the chile has softened and is aromatic.. Watch the chile often to prevent burning, it should be hot throughout and can be released easily if the chile is not well trimmed. Poke it a few times with a skewer or a toothpick as it cooks. Remove the chile to cool down and discard the stem. Add the chile to the spinach and mix well. Add the habanero pepper or a small piece of habanero pepper and mix thoroughly. Store the chile in an airtight container in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: ice water,orange peel,sirloin tip steak,ziti pasta,capsicum,cool whip
title: No-Cook Australian Ziti
ingredients: 500 g sirloin tip steaks, cut in 8 slices | 2 cups ice water | 1 medium ziti pasta, cooked | 1 cup cool whip | 1/2 medium capsicum, sliced thinly | 1 orange peel
instructions: Heat a little oil in a non stick fry pan. Fry the beef in the pan on each side in a few batches. Reserve about half of the beef. Place the ziti into a colander and press out as much water as possible. Place into a medium bowl. Put 1 cup of the beef, capicum and orange peel in the ziti and mix together. Divide the ziti between individual serving bowls. Pour over the cheese and beef sauce over the top.

title: Hot Sandwich - Starbucks
ingredients: 1 ripe pear, peeled, cored, and diced small | 8 -12 leaves iceberg lettuce, torn into small shreds | 1 jar sliced pimientos | 1/4 cup coffee | cracked iceberg lettuce ( to garnish )
instructions: Place the pear pieces and lettuce in a large bowl. Mix in the pimiento slices and pour the coffee over everything.

title: Chipotle Roasted Duck
ingredients: 5 lbs duck, fresh | 3 1/2 cups kale, raw | 4 cans tomato juice | 2 cans chipotle chiles, diced | 1 can red snapper, diced | 1 large red ripe tomatoes, diced | 12 ounces sake ( rice wine works best ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Score and wash duck under cold running water until any large blood seeps out. Dry well on a rack set over a roasting pan. Bour bones with fat from duck. Rinse duck inside and out, pat dry with paper towels. Place duck in 2 - 11 by 7 inch baking pans spaced slightly apart. Roast in preheated 350f oven about 45 minutes for medium done duck or until the skin browns. Transfer to a jelly roll pan and keep warm. Combine all ingredients except saki in large bowl, cover and let stand overnight. Uncover turkey and bake 45 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325f, carefully remove roasting pan from oven. With back of spoon, spread saki over bottom and sides of duck. Return to oven and bake about 1 hour longer, basting regularly with juices. Remove duck and let stand 5 minutes. If desired, slice turkey.

title: Cherry Tomatoes in Sour Sauce (Spain-Yukon De Vinho)
ingredients: 6 green onions, finely chopped ( scallions ) | 1 1/2 lbs small cherry tomatoes
instructions: Boil tomatoes in water 15 minutes or until tender, drain and reserve. Stir scallions into tomatoes. Stir in tomato juice. Simmer 1 minute. Serve warm or at room temperature. Do not overcook.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,spinach leaf,bread flour,edible flower,rice flour,courgette,baby bella mushroom,pomegranate
title: Spinach Salad With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 medium courgette, washed, peeled and cut into half inch rounds | 8 baby bella mushrooms, washed and sliced | 10 fresh spinach leaves, washed and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon mint, chopped | 1 tablespoon pomegranate, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, dissolved | 1 tablespoon bread flour
instructions: Heat the oil in an earthenware casserole or flat top pan. Add the courgette, mushrooms, beetlla and spinach leaves. In a separate container, mix together the rice flour, mint, pomegranate juice, vanilla bean and bread flour. Dissolve into a thick glaze. Pour over the mixed vegetables. Cover and simmer gently until tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Ww 3 Points - Cheese Baked in Baking Onions
ingredients: 1 cup grated pecorino cheese | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 250f degrees and place baking sheets in oven. Brush onions lightly with olive oil spray, about 30 seconds per side. Place on a baking sheet and bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. When cool, crumble and stir into onion/cheese mixture. Sprinkle ww 3 points over cheese mixture and serve. Goes well with a twisty french bread or fresh veggies. Note 1, if grated cheese mixture is too dry, add a little water. If mixture is too thin add a little more water and cheese.

title: Grilled Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons espresso powder | 3 lbs grated gruyere cheese or 3 lbs cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped sage or 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried apricot | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 12 inch round pan with cooking spray. Combine espresso powder with the gruyere in a large ziploc. Seal bag and shake to coat the cheeses completely. Spread cheese in the pan. Stir sage or rosemary, apricots, and dill into cheese. Arrange lettuce around and over cheese and pour espresso mixture over, smoothing top with a spatula or a fork. Turn the rack in middle position, and place baking sheet on baking sheet. Bake until the espresso starts to brown on top, about 25 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Tuna Patties
ingredients: 1 can tuna in olive oil | 1/2 cup italian seasoned bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons ground coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Mix tuna, bread crumbs, and ground coriander together in a bowl. Lightly form mixture into patties. Heat 2 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown on the bottom.

title: Moroccan Fish
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet, 1 1/2 inch diameter cut into 2 - 3 pieces | 1/2 cup green olives, pitted and halved
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange the fish on a broiler pan or in a shallow baking dish. If there are any gaps between pieces, use your fingers to moisten them with a little water. Broil about 4 inches from the heat for 3 minutes, to the color of the fish, turning over once. Transfer the fish to a work surface. Make several slits, about 1 inch deep on both sides of the fish. Top with olives. Broil about 1 minute. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fish,egg yolk,sherry wine,bermuda onion,cauliflower floret,red onion,dijon mustard,hot green chili pepper
title: Fish Cakes With Cauliflower and Onions (Aruba)
ingredients: 4 ounces sliced fish | 2 tablespoons chopped red onions | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled hot green chili peppers | 1/3 cup chopped cauliflower floret | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon red onion, minced
instructions: Put fish on a plate. Mix together the remaing ingredients and season with a pinch of salt. Stir the sauce, adding a tbsp at a time until it is right to use. Pour over the fish and toss lightly. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Drain off any excess marinade and stir fry the onions. Serve fish cakes along with the onions and sauce.

title: Fried Applesauce II
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa | 3/4 cup white sugar or 3/4 cup brown sugar | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 3 lbs ground veal | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Mix together salsa, sugar, oil, and onion. Set aside 15 minutes to allow flavors to blend. In a large skillet, lightly brown ground veal. Mix in the sauce mixture. Simmer 5 minutes over low heat. Serve on rice.

title: Guacamole Bread & Raspberry Snack
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 cup fresh oregano, chopped | 100 g guacamole | 4 tablespoons marsala wine | 4 tablespoons raspberry, diced | 2 slices french bread, toasted
instructions: Place the flour in a large bowl, add the oregano and mix well to combine. Stir in the guacamole, marsala and raspberries. Use your hands to rub the mix into the toasted bread pieces. Allow bread pieces to absorb the flavours of the mix prior to transferring onto an ovenproof dish. Broil at c for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Easy Creamy Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream mushroom soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced cloves
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let chill overnight on the counter. Serve with bread or rolls.

title: Kormom's Mulled Wine
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces burgundy wine | 1 jar curry paste | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Pour the Burgundy into a large, shallow, glass baking dish. Stir in curry paste, and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 6 hours, shaking the dish occasionally. Stir in the vanilla essence. Turn out onto a large, chilled serving dish, and serve with fresh bread slices or chunks of french bread.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,pie apple,dark sesame oil,mustard powder,coriander powder
title: Apple Sesame Oil Pies
ingredients: 1 medium pie apple, grated or 1 medium onion, finely chopped finely | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda, a baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Peel, core and shred the apple. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, mixing well. Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions and roll each into a 10cm/1in/8in thick patty. Arrange the patties on a lightly greased & floured oven tray, allowing room for rolling. Cook for 12 - 15 minutes, or until crisp & browned on the underside.

title: Smells Pita Bread Pizzas
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( campbell's select harvest ) | 4 pita breads ( i used the pita bread ones )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread one can of cream of mushroom soup on the bottom of a 9x13 baking pan. Spread the pita bread out on the soup spoon. Spread the second can of mushroom soup over the pita bread, using the pita bread. Place under the broiler on the top shelf of the oven and just watch it so it does not burn. Watch it like this. You can also place a baking sheet under it to catch any spillover or drippings. Cut into 4 pieces and serve. If you want to be more labor intensive, use a small, sharp knife to slice them out of the oven before putting in the oven.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom black chinese,pearl onion,thyme sprig
title: Homemade Mushrooms Stock
ingredients: 1 cup whole dried shiitake mushroom ( or chinese dried black chinese mushroom caps ) | 1 dried thyme sprig | 2 pints ready to use stock
instructions: Place dried mushroom caps, 1 mushroom at a time, in cold water to cover. Allow to soak until all liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes, or, if desired, 30 minutes. Rinse mushroom caps with cold water and remove stems, gills, and loose skins. Place mushrooms in a large pot, add the thyme and bring to a boil. Add the stock and bring to a full boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until mushrooms are tender, about 30 minutes. Remove pot from the heat and set aside for 30 minutes. Using an immersion blender, return mushrooms to the stock and heat just to boiling. Serve in soup cups or hot, sterilized tins.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,phyllo pastry,blueberry,splenda sugar substitute,yukon gold potato
title: Potato Phyllo Bundles
ingredients: 6 small yukon gold potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups blueberries, fresh, fresh or frozen | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 1/4 cup fat free fat free egg free lemon-flavored liquid calorie | 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a 13x9 pan with cooking spray and set aside. Layer the phyllo in the bottom of the pan, brushing each with some liquid, then brushing with additional liquid every 4 sheets. Layer the potatoes on top of the sheets, sprinkling them inches. Sprinkle with caraway seeds. Sprinkle with splenda. Layer the blueberries evenly on top of the potatoes. Make a lengthwise slit in each phyllo sheet 1/2 inch deep and brush each side generously with egg and then with fat free liquid. Bake at 375°f for 25 - 30 minutes until browned and bubbly.

title: Broiled Italian Beef With Noodles

instructions: In 8 qt saucepan, place beef over medium heat and brown on both sides, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Remove meat to plate.

title: Budget Tender Steak With Swiss Cheese & Tarragon Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 australian rare beef sirloin steak, about 12 ounces each | 1/2 cup dried tri-colored pasta ( such as orecchiette, gemelli, or rigatoni ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 3 tablespoons red currant jelly | 2 slices swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons tamari ( dark sesame paste can be substituted )
instructions: Soak dried tri colored pasta in boiling water for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cut sirloin into 2 x 1/2. Remove sirloin from water.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,garlic powder,kiwi fruit,prosciutto,stewing beef,button mushroom,white pepper,cottage cheese
title: Fantastic French Slizzle Loose-Wrap Beef Rollups
ingredients: 5 ounces lean stewing beef, cut 3/4-inch thick | 2 tablespoons cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons kraft garlic and herb spreadable cheese | 2 teaspoons dried hawthorne's red wine vinegar or 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon dried garlic powder | 1 small green bell pepper, cut into strips | 1 large kiwi fruit, peeled, cut into sticks
instructions: In 3 1/2 x 3 1/2 inch rectangle on wax paper, spread cottage cheese with garlic spreadable cheese spread, making small rectangle spread with each cheese spread. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon each salt, white pepper and wine vinegar to taste. Starting at short end of long side of long, roll up jellyroll style. Place seam side down on wax paper. Repeat procedure to remove wax paper. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Transfer roll to wax paper lined trays, making 8 equal sections. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours. Combine 1/8 teaspoon red pepper powder and garlic powder. Brush both ends of roll with mixture and sprinkle with more powder mixture. Sprinkle with green bell pepper rings and cut kiwifruit over. Serve with crackers or assorted fruit.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,pecorino romano cheese,emmenthaler cheese,veal,star anise,hot pepper sauce
title: Italian Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs veal | 1/2 cup masa harina | 1 ounce pecorino romano cheese | 1 ounce manjar ground espresso or 1 ounce parmesan cheese | chile hot pepper sauce | 1 star anise ( optional )
instructions: Cut veal into 1/2 inch strips, each about 1/2 inch long and 1/2 inch wide. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. The sauce should be quite thin, although it should not be liquid. You cook it right away, but it can also be kept overnight. Dry the gravy in a paper towel to remove as much excess moisture as possible.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,sunflower oil,pineapple preserve,salsa,green cardamom pod
title: Crispy Pineapple Salad

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat. Fry the cardamom pods for one minutes, then remove from pan, but leave for about five seconds. Remove from heat. Add about 2/3 of the salsa and the pista.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,cardamom powder,anise extract,radish,yeast,maraschino cherry,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Cauliflower Cheese and Smoked Pepper Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 1 tablespoon anise extract | 1 1/2 cups lowfat monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend shredded | 5 cups cauliflower florets | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom powder | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon anise extract ( or to taste ) | 1 medium radish, sliced super thin ( optional ) | 1 jar maraschino cherries ( optional ) or ( 5 ounce ) jar cherry tomatoes, halved ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over 1 cup warm water. Let sit until dissolved and foamy. Add 3 cups cheese, mix well. Set aside. Stir yeast mixture, anise extract, 7 cups cauliflower florets, cardamon, and 1/2 cup arise flavored extract into flour mixture. Add more spices if desired. Cut 12 - 12 slices from mozart's cheddar cheese. Dunk chedderia into filling, coating each with mozart's cheese. Cover and let rise until doubled. Punch down, add remaining cheese. Cover and let rise. Punch down, top each piece with mozart's chedderia slices and enjoy you are done.

title: Yucatan Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head iceberg lettuce | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 1 medium sweet red chilies | 4 medium tomatoes | 12 small thin radishes | 3 tablespoons diced noodle ( to serve )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine all lettuce, pepper and chilies. Finely dice the tomatoes and radishes into thin slices. Dice the noodle into 1 cubes. Mix well with the lettuce mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Rabe and Shell Pasta

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the shell pasta in the pot, and cook 2 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Grilled Apple or Pepper Stripline (Or Bamboo Shoots)
ingredients: 4 large green bell peppers | 4 large apple, cored and sliced | 1/4 cup seasoned rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce | 1/4 cup chopped pitted prune
instructions: Cut peppers into thin strips. Toss with vinegar and adobo. Add prunes.

title: Chinese Steak Ball

instructions: Heat oil in skillet or wok until very hot. Carefully add in the steaks and stir fry, or let brown on both sides. Remove from skillet and set aside. In same skillet, mix the onion and ketchup.

title: Creamy Ham and Bean Scones
ingredients: 1 can black beans ( drained and rinsed well. ) | 1 cup canned pumpkin ( drained & rinsed well, or regular pumpkin ) | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries ( chopped ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 lb ham hock | 8 1/2 ounces self-rising flour ( or wholemeal flour ) | 2 ounces white breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, and using your hands, rub the mix with your fingers until ingredients hold together well. Divide the mixture between two lightly greased 8 inch square baking sheets. Place into oven, turn heat down to 350f and cook for 25 - 30 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve with toast or cream.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,irish cream,chicken bouillon cube,mexicorn,mexican oregano,fruit,yogurt
title: Soupe Momma's Vegetable Soup (Homemade or Not)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 4 cups cubed mixed vegetables | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( i used beef broth cubes or equivalent ) | 2 cups mexicorn ( fresh or thawed ) | 4 tablespoons thickened yogurt | 4 tablespoons orange-flavored frozen fruit, frozen
instructions: Pour brown syrup into a sauce pan and bring to a boil.

title: Tibetan Beef Milkshake
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon dried chives | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon fresh minced chives | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh chives | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder or 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a small bowl, combine marinade ingredients. Add the beef and allow it to marinate for 10 minutes. Remove the beef from the marinade. Heat a wok over medium high heat. Cover and simmer for five minutes, while stirring occasionally. Add in the vanilla, salt, chives and mix well. Serve with jasmine rice and fresh parsley.

title: Carnival Surimi
ingredients: 1/2 pound chopped imitation crabmeat | 1/2 pound rhubarb, chopped | 2/3 cup dry white wine | 12 taco shells
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Drain crabmeat.

title: Italian Sausage and Marinara Sauce (Marinara)
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 28 fluid ounces tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices and cook in a heavy skillet or dutch oven over medium heat, stirring to crumble, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Add tomato paste and oregano leaves. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until sauce is slightly reduced and flavors have blended, at least 2 hours but up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,horseradish,yellow pepper,butternut squash,peanut canola oil,vanilla bean,pearl barley
title: Barley, Squash and Orzo Salad Morocco
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 cups butternut squash or 2 cups hubbard squash, cut into thin, thin wedges | 1 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 orange, juice from | 1/2 vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup chopped salted peanut canola oil | 1/2 yellow pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine barley, squash and orange juice in a large bowl. In a frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon peanut oil over medium heat. Add the bean sprouts and orange juice with the vanilla bean and horseradish. Cook, stirring until the beansare bright in color and the squash is tender crisp, about 5 minutes. In a salad bowl toss the barley, squash, orange juice, and peanut canola oil. Garnish with chopped peppers.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,black tea,peanut oil vegetable,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Arabic Spiced Tea Mix - for Bread, Toast or Toast
ingredients: 4 tablespoons black tea | 1 teaspoon raspberry ground in spice mix | 1 tablespoon rails ( el hanout spice mix ) or 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar )
instructions: Measure 4 cups of fresh tea and add it to a cup of water. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, then pour the tea into a large bowl. Allow the tea to cool and then stir in the remaining ingredients.. Store the tea in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Tamarind Tatin

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine corn and remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl. Divide mixture between two pizza crusts. Bake for 7 - 10 minutes or until crust is golden and bubbly. Remove from oven, and allow to cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: The Best Tamari Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamari, tamarind paste | 2/3 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine tamari and whipped topping in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake bottle until completely mixed, adding more sugar if desired. Serve over greens in large salad bowls.

title: Sweet N' Savory Pasta & Coconut
ingredients: 300 g sweet noodles ( spaghetti, cellophane pasta or other sweet pasta ) | 4 tablespoons arrowroot | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasoning, combined with | 1 fresh thyme sprig | 200 g shredded coconut | 2 bamboo skewers, soaked in cold water
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Dissolve arrowroot in the boiling water. Add Old Bay and thyme and return to a boil.
