ingredients: 1 cup reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 cup plain pearl barley ( not quick cooking ) | 1 cup shredded pepperjack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 small cucumber | 1 1/2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor until smooth. If mixture is too thick, add more barley or soy sauce. Refrigerate covered for an hour or longer before serving.

title: Scallops on the Half Shell With Smoked White Wine
ingredients: 3 ounces smoked smoked smoked white wine | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 3/4 lb sea scallops | 1 3/4 ounces smoked wild rice | 32 ounces chicken or 32 ounces vegetable stock | 12 tortillas or 24 large flat bread, to serve
instructions: Pour the wine into a large pan, add the sugar and simmer until reduced by half. Remove the scallops from the shells and gently push the shell into the liquid. Wipe out the sauce and discard. Season to taste the smoked scallops are placed in a single layer in a pan and pour over the reduced liquid. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the fish is cooked. Scrape away the scallops from the pan and set aside. Add the rice to the liquid in the pan, stir well and cook over a high heat for a couple of minutes until well coated. Add the chicken stock, bring to the boil, cover and simmer for around 20 minutes, or until the stock has been absorbed. Place the scallops on to a platter and arrange over the rice. Cover with foil and cook in a preheated 350f oven for 20 minutes, or until the scallops are thoroughly cooked and the rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,self raising flour,green bell pepper,maraschino cherry,beef consomme,apple cider,part ricotta cheese
title: Healthy Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into bite sized cubes | 1/3 cup broccoli floret | 2/3 cup reduced-fat sour cream ( low fat is okay ) or 2/3 cup reduced-fat plain yogurt ( low fat is okay ) | 3 tablespoons grated peeled apple cider | 1 can reduced-sodium beef consomme | 1/3 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella-cheddar cheese blend or 1/3 cup sharp reduced-fat shredded cheese blend | 1/3 cup diced small green bell peppers
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f spray large ovenproof serving dish with cooking spray. Spray baking dish with cooking spray. Place beef, broccoli floret, sour cream, cider, consomme, cheese and green pepper in dish and stir well to combine. Cover dish with lid or foil, and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 30 minutes, or until meat and vegetables are tender and sauce is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: white onion,nonfat cream,turmeric,chili pepper flake,cake flour,shiitake mushroom
title: Japanese Mushroom Fritters
ingredients: 8 shiitake mushrooms ( or 1 ounce reconstituted dried mushrooms, reconstituted ) | 1 package cake flour ( sifted ) | 1 medium white onion ( finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2/3 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Place mushrooms in fine mesh strainer and sprinkle with salt. Let sit to drain off water and chop fine. In a medium bowl, combine mushrooms, flour, onion, turmeric, and a small amount of hot water. Mix. Form into a ball. Warm a wok or heavy bottomed skillet over medium heat for about 10 seconds. Place 1 1/2 teaspoons of mushroom filling in center. Cook until it is warm. Turn into serving dish with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkle over chili flakes. Enjoy.

title: Tajine Korma
ingredients: 5 french baguettes | 2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 2 teaspoons garlic paste
instructions: Slice open french baguettes into 1/4 inch thick slices. Spread cream on slice and sprinkle with cardamom. Top with paste and refrigerate. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,mix,green olive,plain flour,italian bread,raspberry,vinegar,lamb shoulder
title: Aussie Style Lamb With Creamy Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 600 g ground lamb shoulder | 2 tablespoons plain flour, seasoned with salt and pepper | 1/2 cup light sour mix | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 40 g fresh raspberry | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 cup mixed greens ( eg romaine, rocket ) | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Remove fat from lamb and cut into small chunks or strips. Mix flour, sour cream and salad dressing/salad dressing and place lamb in a plastic bag. Mix lightly and refrigerate covered, for 1 hour or for up to a day. Preheat oven to 200c. Drain lamb, reserving marinade and setting aside. Place lamb pieces in a casserole dish and lightly coat with seasoned flour. Bake for 15 minutes. Bake for a further 15 minutes or until cooked as desired. Transfer lamb to a serving platter. Wash raspberry and tear into pieces and place in a bowl. Toss with vinegar. Wash greens and snap into pieces. Cut a lengthwise slice from bread, then cut into strips. To serve lamb on a serving platter, spoon hot lamb into centre of platter and drizzle with raspberry sauce.

title: Karaage-Japanese Sweet Ramen
ingredients: 1 package dashi | 2 maraschino cherries, cut into halves
instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add dashi and cook until water turns milky white. While the dashi is cooking, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the cherry halves into a small bowl. Pour the hot water into a baking dish to cool. When the dashi has become milky, pour the liquid into the bowl with the almonds and cherries and stir. Pour almonds and cherry onto a small plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,escarole,red chili pepper,white wine,lemon juice,head cauliflower
title: Roasted Green Cabbage With Escarole and Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 heads of cauliflower | 1 head chinese cabbage | 5 -6 red chili peppers ( or more depending on taste ) | 1/2 head escarole | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Place cauliflower in large casserole dish with enough boiling water to cover. Simmer for 20 minutes, then drain. Cut the heads into small pieces. Slice cabbage into rings. Peel chili peppers and slit both ends off. Place a few slices of chili in the centre of each ring of cauliflower. Top with a few leaves of escarole. Pour wine over all and stir, coating cabbage with liquid. Cover and place in oven. Remove cabbage and chili slices and sprinkle with lemon juice. Continue baking for 35 minutes or until cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,water tuna,malt vinegar,chicken,coconut oil,apple cider vinegar,blueberry
title: Fish and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 4 cups water or 4 cups fish stock | 2 cups grated fresh coconut or 2 cups cooked shredded coconut | 1 1/2 lbs fish, chopped | 1/4 lb blueberries or 1/4 lb black sesame seed, preferably toasted | 1/4 cup water-packed sunflower oil or 1/4 cup peanut oil, preferably toasted | 1/4 cup malt vinegar or 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 3 teaspoons pure maple syrup or 3 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: Stir stock and coconut in a heavy 4 - 5 qt. Saucepan over medium low heat. Increase heat to medium and simmer gently. Stir fish, blueberries or black sesame seeds, and 1/4 cup water or fish stock mixture into simmering liquid. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until fish is opaque. Stir in remaining syrup and vinegar. Pour through a fine sieve into hot salad leaves and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,cilantro leaf,bailey irish cream,chipotle chile adobo,oregano leaf,plain nonfat yogurt,barbecue sauce,chickpea
title: Chickpea Burgers
ingredients: 3 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 celery ribs, diced | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon baileys irish cream
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the chickpeas, oregano and celery. Toss with the barbecue sauce and set aside to macerate for about an hour. Drain the chickpeas well and coarsely mash with a potato masher or wooden spoon. Stir in the yogurt, cilantro, chipotle powder and baileys. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Roasted Yellow Pepper and Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 large yellow sweet peppers ( capsicum ) | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon fresh garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat broiler. Remove and discard papery outer skin and top 3/4 cup of onions. Pierce the skin with a very sharp knife. Place them on a baking paper lined baking sheet. Roast under the oven's broiler, turning every 5 minutes by rotating the peppers. Turn often so the skins can darken. When the skins begin to darken on all sides, remove from the oven. Set them aside and let cool off in a dry place. Roast in a medium hot oven, stirring occasionally until they have roasted an even color, about 20 - 25 minutes. While the onions are still warm, rub the skins off the peppers with your hands. Do not let them touch the skin while they are roasting. Place in a medium size mixing bowl. Add the onion soup mix and garlic. Mix well. Sprinkle the pepper skin onto the mixture. Sprinkle about 1/2 teaspoon of kosher salt over the pepper. Wash hands thoroughly. Set aside. To roast, heat the oven's broiler. Put the top 3/4 cup of onions in a large roasting pan, skin side up. Sprinkle the top with 1/2 teaspoon of kosher salt. Place the pan, skin side down, under the preheated oven's broiler. Broil the onions, skin side up, until the skins are charred and beginning to blacken, 12 - 15 minutes. Immediately place the pan under the broiler for 5 - 10 minutes. Turn the pan over. Roast for 10 - 15 minutes more or until the skins are charred and the onions are browned on top. Remove from the oven and let cool off. Use a sharp knife and knife to slit them open and remove the seeds. Use a fork to scrape the onion from the skins, removing the skin and all of the green inside. Gently open the skins and squeeze out the excess juice.

Random Ingredients: prune,yellow bell pepper,red enchilada sauce,white rice,lemon extract
title: Red Bell Pepper Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 yellow sweet bell pepper, halved lengthwise, seeds removed | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 lemon extract | 3 1/2 cups white rice, cooked ( i prefer jasmine ) or 3 1/2 cups brown rice, cooked according to directions on package | 6 -8 prunes, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f remove tops and bell peppers from peppers. Scoop out the pulp and seeds from the peppers with a spoon. Combine the pulp with the enchilada sauce and lemon extract and fill the peppers with the sauce. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until tender. Garnish with prunes.

title: Homemade Hot Chocolate - No Dairy
ingredients: 200 g corn tortillas | 5 tablespoons milk | 400 g yoghurt | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 3 bay leaves | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | cocoa
instructions: Cut half of the tortillas to a square, 1 cm thick. Spread each, overlapping. Sprinkle with a little cocoa over the top. Mix the milk, yoghurt, garlic, oregano, bay leaves and cocoa together until soft and silky. Put half in the hotplate and cook over a medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes until golden. Turn over, top with a little bit of milk, cover and cook a further 4 - 5 minutes. Cut into 8 pieces and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,green cardamom,picante sauce,squash,arugula,garlic salt,plain flour
title: Spicy Sauteed Squash and Arugula
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs squash, halved lengthways, seeds on | 8 green cardamoms | 4 cups arugula | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 cup picante sauce | 300 g plain flour | 1 lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/ 400f/ gas put the squash, cardamoms, arugula and garlic salt into a roasting dish. Pour the picante sauce over and toss to coat. Roast in the oven for 20 mins, stirring occasionally. Turn the oven temperature up to 450f/ gas mark 4 and place baking dish on a tray. Place in oven to roast for 20 mins, then remove from tin, scatter with lemon wedges, and serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,pork sparerib,ancho chile powder,cream mushroom soup,cayenne,pork roast
title: Crock Pot Spicy Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork roast | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 1/2 cups soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Place the pork roast in the bottom of a slow cooker. Mix the remaining ingredients together in a bowl, except for the pork. Pour the soup mixture over the pork, cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours. Remove the pork and shred.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,nutritional yeast,bok choy,brown lentil,cooking oil,leek
title: Red Lentil and Bok Choy Stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup quick-cooking oil | 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1 1/2 cups yellow split peas, sorted and rinsed | 1/2 cup bok choy, finely chopped | 9 ounces bok choy, shredded | 3 ounces leeks, thinly sliced crosswise ( white part only ) | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add both lentils and split peas.

title: Baked Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 cups biscuit mix | 2 lbs chicken wings
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In large bowl, stir biscuit mix and 1/2 cup of water. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup water until dough holds together. Separate wings.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,pasta sauce,brown rice,hamburger bun,egg yolk,arugula,cauliflower floret
title: Quick One-Ingredient  Bolognaise
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bolognaisee or 1 lb italian ground sirloin | 2 cups cooked medium barley or 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1 lb cauliflower floret | 1 cup pasta sauce, ragu or 1 cup ranch dressing | 1 egg yolk | 1 cup quick cook pasta sauce | 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 cup arugula or 1 cup mixed fresh salad greens | 6 -8 pieces toasted bread ( preferably artisan bread )
instructions: In an ovenproof skillet, brown meat over high heat stirring to break it up. Drain meat and set meat aside. Add cauliflower and 1/2 cup rice and the remaining ingredients to the skillet. Cook at medium heat 4 - 5 minutes until heated through. Cover and cook at a slow boil 10 - 15 minutes or until rice and vegetables are tender. Remove from heat and set aside. In a small saucepan, combine remaining ingredients and bring to boil, stirring to prevent scorching or sticking. Cover and simmer on low heat 10 - 15 minutes or until vegetables are hot through. Spoon over hot cooked pasta and top with toasted bread.

title: Apple Trinch Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless beef roast or 1 1/2-2 lbs other beef | 4 fresh ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon apple pie spice ( or to taste ) or 1 teaspoon curry powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the beef.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,nutmeg,poblano chile,white wine,anchovy oil,chili powder,oyster sauce,cayenne pepper
title: Spicy African Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pinch ground cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon white wine | 2 poblano chiles ( or a red pepper ), thinly sliced | 1 -2 teaspoon anchovies packed in oil
instructions: Combine oyster sauce, peanut butter, chili powder, nutmeg, cayenne pepper, wine, poblano chilies and anchovies in a medium frying pan over medium heat. Heat until hot, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Sauce for Zucchini and Shredded Swiss Steak
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 3 cups tomato sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Cut zucchini diagonally into 1/4 inch slices, and arrange them on the hot grate. Sprinkle shredded zucchini with salt, and continue to grill zucchini until the zucchini are tender and lightly browned on the bottom, and the cheese is golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,white wine vinegar,red wine,thai chili sauce
title: Thai Chili Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons thai chili sauce | 2 teaspoons minced fresh cilantro, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix red wine vinegar, white wine vinegar, hot pepper sauce, chile sauce, and cilantro together in the top bowl of a blender.

title: Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb spareribs, cut into 4 pieces each | 1 cup rice noodles | spareribs, cut in 4 pieces each | 3 cardamom seeds
instructions: Wash the spare ribs well. Rinse them and put them in a bowl, pour in 1 pint of hot water and leave them overnight. Pour in 2 tablespoons of sparerib water and cover them. Refrigerate for about 4 hours. In a heavy based pan, bring the 6 quarts of water to a boil. Meanwhile, rinse the noodles very well under cold water, put them into a colander and drain them thoroughly. Drop the spareribs into the boiling water, stir, add the noodles, and cook them for about 4 minutes. The noodles should just be beginning to soften but still have a little bite to them. Do not stir them into much of the soup. If they are, continue to stir for a few minutes, then turn them back into the boiling water. Stir well. Bring the stock back to a boil. Add the ribs and bring to the boil. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes. Add the cardamom seeds, then remove cover and cook, stirring, for a further 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,lite peach,white sugar,shell pasta,lime juice,tilapia fillet,crabmeat
title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 packages frozen shell pasta ( or any small pasta shape ) | 3/4 cup fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon fish sauce ( optional ) | 1 pound tilapia fillets, chopped | 1 can lite peach slices
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook shell pasta in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,picante sauce,sage leaf,baby corn,clear honey,masala
title: Tex Mex Corn and Salsa
ingredients: 6 baby corn, on the cob, husked | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/3 cup salsa | 1/4 cup dried texmati masala | 1 teaspoon sage leaves | 1 teaspoon clear honey
instructions: Combine tomato and chili powders in small bowl. Let stand for 5 minutes. In a skillet, cook corn, tomatoe and their liquid, and chilis on high heat 15 minutes or until corn is tender. Drain. Stir into tomato mixture. Add rice and gently stir to coat. Add the sage. Sprinkle with honey. Stir to mix. Cook 5 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes. Note, add water as needed to ensure mixture doesn't dry out.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,rom tomato,creole seasoning,simple syrup,white bread flour,gingerroot,vermouth,beef broth
title: The Classic American Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs thinly sliced white bread flour | 3 tablespoons finely grated fresh gingerroot | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 4 cups beef broth | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 4 roma tomatoes, coarsely chopped | 1 medium orange, coarsely chopped | 1 can diced roma tomatoes, packed in water, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the flour, ginger, creole seasoning and bread until they are well incorporated. Add the broth, vermouth and tomatoes and stir. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, preheat the broiler. Ladle soup into oven proof soup bowls, place the tomatoes in a single layer in a large baking pan, and top with the orange and roma tomatoes. Cover the tomatoes with clean boiling water to cover the tomatoes, then place under the broiler and broil until the soup is bubbling, about 10 minutes. Remove from the broiler and ladle the soup into warm bowls. Serve hot. Note, the soup can be made several hours ahead the soup and chilled, tightly covered. You can serve right before serving, just cover and refrigerate. The soup can last for 3 days to 4 days.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,malibu rum,dark chocolate,key lime juice
title: Frog Eye
ingredients: 1 kg dark chocolate | 1 can chopped sundried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 fresh key limes, juice of | 1/2 cup malibu rum ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop the semi dried tomatoes. Heat the dark chocolate in a bowl over gently boiling water, add the sundried tomatoes and half the lime juice. Mix well. Remove from heat, allow to cool to room temperature and then chill until set, then break up the cooled chocolate chunks and add to the chocolate mixture. Stir well to combine, remove the remaining lime juice and pour into a mould which has been lined with greaseproof paper. Refrigerate the mixture for several hours or overnight to set. When ready to serve, remove from the mould and remove the paper. Garnish with extra whipped cream and cherry to serve.

title: Tre's Easy Creamy Indian Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 piece fresh gingerroot, sliced | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Stir cream soup and ginger together in a large soup bowl. Return soup mixture to pan, and season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: coriander,pork butt,fennel seed,beef rib,canadian bacon,oat,chili pepper flake
title: Homemade Molasses Smoked Oats With Canadian Bacon and Chiles
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, diced | 12 ounces pork butt, diced, 1-inch | 1 lb beef rib, diced ( i use rib meat and pork ribs ) | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | salt & fresh chili pepper flakes, to taste | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon drippings or 3 tablespoons smokey bacon drippings, for smoke and flavor | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: In a large non stick skillet, add 1/2 pound cooked pork butt, 1/2 lb pork ribs, 1/2 cup Canadian bacon and 1/2 cup beef rib. Toss to combine. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon salt and chili flakes on top. Cook over medium temperature until heated through, stirring occasionaly until salt is caramelized on the ribs. Remove from heat and place in a clean skillet. Add the remaining 1/2 pound of cooked pork butt to the skillet, coating evenly with the caramelized liquid from the skillet. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until liquid is absorbed. Place into a clean nonstick skillet. Combine 1/2 cup Canadian bacon drippings or smokey drippings, the fennel seed and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl. Sprinkle over the mixture. Close skillet and cook over very low heat until mixture begins to bubble, stirring occasionally. Cook until mixture is well incorporated. Spread this mixture on toasted bread. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,baking soda,lettuce leaf,watermelon,dark brown sugar,dark sesame oil,pancetta
title: The Greatest Salad Dressing Ever
ingredients: 3/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup pancetta, finely diced | 1 tablespoon watermelon, finely diced | 3/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, diced ( or sesame seed ) | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 4 large lettuce leaves, mixed and shredded
instructions: Put sugar, pancetta, watermelon, sun dried tomatoes and sesame oil in a blender or food processor. Blend on high until well mixed. Pour in the baking soda and process again for one more minute. Store in the fridge until ready to use, about a week. Pour over greens right before serving, toss lightly and sprinkle with sesame seeds to get a wonderful glaze.

title: Tomats in Agave (Guatemalan Mushroom Candy)
ingredients: 1 lb mushroom ( button, crimini ) | 3 ounces golden tequila | 2 large plum tomatoes | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Boil the mushrooms for 5 minutes. Drain well and mash the mushrooms with the crushed vanilla bean and tequila. Pour into a well buttered 9 inch round baking tin and leave a one inch to form a crust. Sprinkle the surface with icing sugar and bake at 300 degrees f. For about forty minutes, until light brown. Cool, cut into squares and leave to set. Can be sprinkled with extra agave.

title: Pork and Broccoli Fried With Coconut
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 10 ounces frozen broccoli | 3/4 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the pork and broccoli in a large saucepan with water to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, until the meat and veggies are tender, about 45 minutes. Drain any remaining water. Transfer the meat to a bowl and mash it. Return the broth to a boil and cook, stirring, until thickened, 2 to 3 minutes longer. Transfer the pork and broccoli to a large colander and press down hard on it between your hands to remove any stray pieces of meat. Discard the broccoli. Dip each piece of meat in the flour, then coat well with the peanuts. Set aside to marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours, or overnight. Heat an 8 to 12 inch nonstick skillet on high heat until a cube of bread dropped into it sizzles, browns quickly and immediately. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the cooked pork and broccoli to the skillet and fry, turning once or twice, until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the skillet.

Random Ingredients: head iceberg lettuce,cilantro,ketchup,lime zest,lemon juice zest,monterey jack cheese,picante sauce
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Restaurant Style Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds fresh curly-leaf lettuce, outer leaves removed | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 ounces ketchup | 2 ounces lemon juice, or as needed | 1 lime, zest of | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 ounce fresh cilantro, chopped ( optional ) | 2 ounces monterey jack cheese, chopped into bite-sized cubes
instructions: Tear the curly end off the lettuce.

title: Plant Fritters
ingredients: 3 plums ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup canola oil | 4 taco shells | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Bake plums in 350 degree oven for 5 minutes to soften plums and then remove pit. Scoop out plums and put them in ice water to stop thawing the skin. Remove plums from bowl and place on plate. Bring canola oil to high in large skillet and heat on stove top until a cube forms. Drop patties into the hot oil a few at a time for two to three minutes before turning over. Drain. Sprinkle patties with almond extract if using. Serve immediately as fritters and/or taco shells.

Random Ingredients: spice,chili pepper flake,green curry paste,cider vinegar,chicken stock,oatmeal,yellow mustard
title: Green Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon green curry paste ( or hot, to your taste ) | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard | 1 tablespoon hot chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chicken stock | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized pan. Stir to coat evenly.

Random Ingredients: turkey broth,cooking sherry,phyllo pastry,chicken breast half,asparagus,raisin
title: Chicken Phyllo with Asparagus, Raisins, and Turkey
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 pound fresh asparagus | 1/2 cup raisins | 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup quick-cooking sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken breasts in a large skillet, and pour in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer until the chicken is no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Add asparagus and raisins, and continue cooking until the asparagus is tender, about 4 minutes more. Remove from heat, and set aside. Cut the phyllo pastry into 3 long squares. Arrange one square on a work surface, and brush with cooking sherry. Fold pastry over the filling, and crimp edges with a fork. Cut a slit in the top of each square to create an open pocket. Spoon about 1/2 spoonful of stuffing into each pocket. Close the dough pocket over and pinch closed. Transfer the stuffed pastry triangles onto a baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

title: Spicy Green Chili Dogs
ingredients: 500 g green chili peppers | breadcrumbs | oil or cooking spray
instructions: Place the green chili peppers in a plastic bag with a cup or plain yogurt and crush with a rolling pin. Place in a deep microwave safe dish and add a bit of water to cover. Cook on high for 2 - 3 minutes and then drain off any extra water. Turn off the microwave, leave it in, leave the oven on for 2 - 3 minutes until soft, drain, return to the dish and dry out slightly. Roll the chili dogs in breadcrumbs, coating fully. Spray a frypan with oil or spray with a little oil and fry the green chili dogs until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Serve with salad or french fries.

Random Ingredients: broiler fryer chicken,corn,chicken sausage,hot chili pepper,snow pea,guava
title: Chicken and Sausage With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, quartered | 1 lb fresh mushrooms | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can corn | 1 lb fresh guava, sliced thinly | 1 small hot chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f place chicken and mushrooms in an ovenproof casserole dish that is large enough to hold both the chicken and mushrooms. In a bowl combine cream of mushroom soup, corn, guava, chili and chicken. Pour over chicken mixture. Coat the chicken pieces with cooking spray. Cover and bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Remove chicken and mushrooms to a serving platter and loosely cover with foil until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: turkey,red apple,orange juice zest,parsnip,lettuce,baking powder,roast beef,cream chicken soup
title: Roast Beef & Parsnip Bundt Cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange juice ( or juice from zest of 1 orange ) | 3 tablespoons sour cream ( reduced fat ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 200 g roast beef, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup parsnip, thinly sliced | 1 red apple, thinly sliced | lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c. Grease a 25cm bundt cake or a deep round one, with oil or cooking spray. Combine all ingredients except the last 2 tablespoons of sour cream, cream of chicken soup, and baking powder in a medium bowl. Add the beef and parsnip and mix well to combine. Scatter the apple slices over the base of the baking tin, and then add the beef/parsnip mixture. Top with the reserved 2 tablespoons of sour cream and bake for 50 - 60 minutes, or until the top is golden and the cake is cooked. Remove from oven and set aside. When completely cooled, drizzle a little olive oil over the warm cake and serve on a platter.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,hot italian sausage,lemon zest
title: Sausage in Lemon Cream
ingredients: 1/2 small red hot italian sausage or 1/2 small other spicy flavoured sausage | 1/4 medium lemon, zest of, freshly grated | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh red chili pepper or 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chile ( i use dried red chile )
instructions: Place the sausage in a frying pan with a lid placed on medium heat or a griddle, turning the heat to high. When the sausage has begun to color, sprinkle with the freshly grated zest and hot pepper. The chile is quite hot, so don't let it burn. When the sausage begins to char, about 3 - 5 minutes, stir, cover and turn the heat down to very low. Stir in the lemon zest and chile, and leave for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring periodically. Leave the cover off for the final 5 mintues or longer if needed,. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: paprika,italian salad dressing mix,horseradish,artichoke heart,caper,tilapia fillet
title: Grill-Grilled Tilapia With Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts | 4 ounces horseradish | 8 ounces italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 lb tilapia fillet
instructions: Preheat grill on medium high heat with rack in middle. Combine first 4 ingredients and set aside. Brush grill with oil and grill tilapia 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and discard brush. Brush with more oil, sprinkle paprika on and then drizzle with remaining horseradish sauce.

Random Ingredients: shallot,cooking oil,lemon juice,knorr vegetable soup mix
title: Lemon Thyme-Mustard Sauce for Pastrami
ingredients: 1 package knorr vegetable soup mix ( knorr is good ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1/4 cup lemon juice
instructions: Prepare soup mix according to package. Cook, oil and shallots until shallots are just crisp tender and starting to brown, drain off the oil. Add soup mix and lemon juice to skillet. Heat through. Serve over pastrami slices.

title: Apple Stuffing
ingredients: 4 medium granny smith apples | celery rib, to garnish
instructions: Peel, core & mince the apples. Combine them with granny smith in a bowl. Pour the apples mixture on to a shallow tray lined with foil. Bake at 200c for 30 minutes.

title: Angel Hair Pasta
ingredients: 500 g angel hair pasta | 400 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water to al dente. While you are waiting, lightly fry the sun dried tomatoes in a separate pan with a dash of olive oil over a low heat. Drain and combine with the fried sun dried tomatoes. Serve with some parmesan cheese on top.

title: Nacho Cheese Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken meat, cubed | 2 ounces queso fresco | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Place the chicken in a large bowl with the cheese, pepper and fennel seed. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Drain the meat. Thread meat onto wooden skewers. Place on skewers that have been sprayed with oil. If desired, grill for 10 - 15 minutes per side or until the outside is brown. Serve with salsa fresca or pico de gallo or sour cream.

title: Pesto-Filled Potato Squares
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable oil for frying | 1 pound potatoes, peeled and shredded | 1/4 cup dry-roasted cashews | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place potato shreds in a large bowl of cold water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the potato shreds using a cheese grater, or the side of a ricer. Transfer potato shreds to another large bowl, and set aside. Stir cashews, cheese, and parmesan cheese together in a skillet over medium heat until the cheese melts, and the cashews are crisp. Transfer the potato shreds to the potato bowl, and toss to coat. Drain off excess water. Stir in the potato starch until smooth, and transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,chive,green chilies,dark sesame oil,jalapeno pepper,corn oil
title: Roasted Sesame Oil Condiment
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil | 3 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 tablespoons rice wine | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 4 -6 tablespoons minced fresh chives | 8 -10 small thin green chilies
instructions: First roast chilies, then heat the oil so it will spread evenly, put in the chilies, sesame oil and stir fry. Put back in pan, and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the chives, green chilies and dry sherry. Note, if you have to use extra sesame oil, you can use regular sesame oil, which will increase the taste of the condiment.

title: Champagne and Chilli Jam
ingredients: 100 ml sweet chili sauce | 100 ml honey mustard or 100 ml grain mustard | 75 ml mirin
instructions: Pour into sterilised jars and seal. Keep in a cool, dark place. To make the jam, combine all jam ingredients in a small saucepan. Stir over a low heat until the sugar dissolves and the jam thickens. Keep warm over a low heat while you prepare the jelly. Pour boiling water over some clean hot water, and run a knife around the rim of the jar to release steam. Leave in the heat for 10 minutes, then remove the lid, and leave for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, remove the lid, and stir well. Put a serving plate on top, and invert the jam onto the plate. Leave for 5 minutes to cool. Store the jam in an airtight glass jar in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,splenda granular,garlic powder,pineapple juice,asparagus spear,okra
title: Spicy Pineapple & Okra Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh pineapple juice | 1 3/4 cups frozen okra, thawed and halved | 1 can sliced poblano chiles, drained | 5 -6 asparagus spears, halved lengthwise and cut into 2-inch lengths | 2 tablespoons splenda granular, sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, toss to coat. Cover and chill until serving.

title: Cashew and Chilli Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch shiitake bok choy | 7 -8 fresh chilies, sliced diagonally | 1/2 cup cashews, roasted finely
instructions: Cut the sprouts into thin strips. Grind the cashews with a mortar and pestle or in a food processor till they are the texture of rice grains. Arrange over a bed of greens, scatter over the chillies and scatter over the cashews.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,half,lemon pepper seasoning,sea salt,bok choy,anaheim chile pepper
title: Pinto Beans and Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 pound dry pinto beans | 2 large lemons, juiced | 1 pound fresh bok choy, chopped | 1 pound anaheim chile peppers, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Sort through the pinto beans and remove any stones. Rinse. Place in a large slow cooker, and add enough water just to cover. If water has boiled to cover, stir in the lemon juice. Cover, and cook on high until beans are tender, about 4 hours. Add more water as needed while cooking if necessary. Drain the beans, and set aside. Place bok choy, anaheim chilies, sea salt, and lemon pepper seasoning in a large serving bowl. Stir to blend, and leave just before serving.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,fennel,mozzarella cheese,green onion,grain white rice,lamb backstraps
title: Quick Lamb Stuffed Rice
ingredients: 12 lamb backstraps ( or similar type of meaty backstraps ) | 2 cups long grain white rice | 3 green onions, finely chopped | 50 g of shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/3 cup oatmeal ( regular or gluten free ) | 1/4 teaspoon fennel | roasted fennel ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a grill pan on medium high heat. Place the lambstraps in a foil lined shallow roasting tin, or equivalent. To make the rice, place the rice with water, and cover completely with a microwave proof plate and cook on high for 8 minutes. Turn the heat down to medium and cook, covered, for an extra 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place the green onions and mozzarella cheese in a small salad bowl. Drain any excess liquid from the rice and place it in the bowl. Preheat a grill pan on high heat and spray with olive oil cooking spray. Cook the lamb, lamb and onions for 5 - 5 minutes each side, depending on the thickness of the meat, until the meat is cooked through. Add the oatmeal and fennel and gently stir to combine. Stir in the rice and top with roasted fennel and additional mozzarella cheese. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oil,pear,white creme de cacao,cognac,manicotti,coffee,corn syrup,rice flour
title: Manicotti With Cappuccino
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 1 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons cognac | 4 tablespoons blended steamed coffee | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 cup manicotti | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup white creme de cacao or 1/4 cup orange liqueur | 1 cup pear, diced
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the rice flour, corn syrup, cognac, steamed coffee, 2 tblsp. Of oil and the blended steamed manicotti. Set oven to 325°f. Wrap the remaining dough around each manicotti. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for 40 mins, turning every 15 minutes. Keep an eye on the bread to be sure it doesn't burn turn off and keep warm. In a medium saucepan, heat the remainder of the oil until just starting to shimmer on the edges. Add the creme de cacao and drippings and simmer for 3 - 4 mins, until the sauce darkens slightly. Add the pear and stir to combine. Pour over warm noodles and serve.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 lb sun-dried tomato, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed or 1 tablespoon anise liqueur, like | 1 lb frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small bowl, combine all ingredients, except for phyllo. Lay a sheet of phyllo on a lightly floured board. Lightly flour the top sheet, lightly dust with remaining flour, and gently but quickly roll into a long rectangle. Using a very sharp knife, cut the crosswise 1 tablespoon lengthwise into 1 1/2 inch strips. Place the strips crosswise in a sheet of phyllo with the long strips facing up. Place 1/2 cup of the sun dried tomatoes in a small bowl. Cover with boiling water. Boil 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside. Place another sheet of phyllo on top of the first, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle lightly with more flour. Fold the phyllo up over the tomatoes by about 1/2 inch, and continue folding until the end. Place about 1/4 cup of the sun dried tomato mixture onto the center pastry sheet, leaving about a 3/4 inch border on the sides. Fold in the sides, and roll up the phyllo into a log. Place seam side down on a lightly sprayed baking sheet. Repeat with remaining phyllo and tomatoes. Brush lightly with anise oil, then sprinkle with remaining aromatic sugar. Bake 20 minutes or till golden brown. Serve warm. Note, this is good served with a dollop of cream cheese.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,clam shell,green bell pepper,yellow pepper,chicken tender,crabmeat,irish cream
title: Quick and Easy Seafood Bake
ingredients: 8 large clams in shell or 8 large mussels | 1 lb imitation crabmeat or 1 lb imitation crabmeat | 4 slices swiss cheese or 4 slices provolone cheese | 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1 cup yellow pepper, sliced | 1 cup green bell pepper, sliced | 1 cup imitation crabmeat or 1 cup crabmeat, shredded | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Rinse clams from shells or mussels. De beard clams, open and leave mussels inside. Combine remaining ingredients except sour cream in a large baking dish. Top with sour cream. Cover, and bake in 350 degree oven until bubbly. Watch it closely, stir after about 30 seconds, do not let this boil. Serve with buttered crusty french bread, or crackers. Note, you may substitute other seafood for the crab, or leave out the crab, and just use swiss cheese and green pepper.

title: Chile, Pecorino, and Chocolate Brittle
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 small square unsweetened chocolate syrup | sweet chile syrup
instructions: Place the romano in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse the cheese until it resembles coarse meal. Add 1 teaspoon of the sweetener to the cheese mixture and pulse to mix. Continue processing until the mixture forms coarse crumbs. Continue processing 1 minute. Transfer the mixture to a small bowl and let the crumbs rest for 15 minutes. Heat the 1 1/2 teaspoons of sweetener in a small saucepan over medium low heat until it begins to lightly brown. Quickly, pour the hot syrup into the bowl of the food processor and pulse until the chile is coarsely processed. Pour the chile into a 9 inch round serving dish, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with a spoonful of the sweetener.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,wheat bread crumb,beef tenderloin steak,brown sugar,cream cheese,paprika,purpose flour,oil
title: Beef Tenderloin Steak with Cream Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks ( about 4 steaks ) | peanut oil | 4 slices whole wheat bread doughnuts | 2 tablespoons cream cheese, room temperature | 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | oil, for deep frying
instructions: Flatten steaks between 2 pieces of wax paper into 2 inch thick, 12 inch circles. Coat with nonstick cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: rotel,prosciutto,kosher salt black pepper,sea salt,anchovy,cilantro,mustard powder,lychee
title: Prosciutto Wrapped Lychees (Oven Confitum)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coarse sea salt | 3 tablespoons ground mustard powder | 1 teaspoon anchovy ( optional ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs assorted fresh lychees | 4 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto ( italian style ) | 16 rye rolls or 16 hoagie rolls, slightly stale and buttered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475°. Using the tip of your finger, make indentations in the side of each lychee 1 1/2 inches deep. Place a pinch of salt in the indentations and sprinkle the coarse sea mustard powder over the top of each. Combine the minced cilantro, chopped anchovies, and a grinding of black pepper with 1 teaspoon sea salt, to taste, and drizzle over the tops of the rolls. Place the pan on a baking sheet. Place a baking rack on top, so that the tops of the rolls are about 3 inches below the bottom. Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the tops of the rolls are browned and the bottoms are lightly toasted. Transfer the pan to a rack to cool, then store in a dry, cool room until ready to use.

title: Scotch Cheesecake
ingredients: 14 ore-gan plain graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon sage | 3 large eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, flour, mustard powder, and sage together. Whisk eggs together with a fork or fork. Add crumb mixture, mixing well. Press on the bottom and up the sides of a 10 inch springform pan, but not up the sides. Bake in the preheated oven until the center jiggles slightly, and the outer edges are beginning to turn golden brown. Let cool completely, then remove the sides of the pan. Run a knife around the outside of the pan to loosen. The cake will be a little thinner than a springform ring, and thinner than a springform wheel. Cover the cake loosely with aluminum foil, and remove the foil as you go. Place the cake back into the oven. Beat 1 or 2 cups of ice cream, or milk, until soft peaks form. Stir in more milk if neccesary. Pour the cheesecake into the prepared cake pan. Return cake pan to the oven, and bake for 60 minutes. Cover the cake with a piece of plastic wrap while it cools. When the chocolate is set, cut and serve.

Random Ingredients: spice essence,cilantro,turkey breast,parsley flake,mexican tomato,mix,fennel leaf,walnut
title: Easy Mexican Hot Dogs (Savoury Dogs)
ingredients: 2 turkey breast, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped parsley flakes ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fennel leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro | 1/2 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 2 tablespoons instant mix ( instant beef or vegetable or mushroom ) | 1 tablespoon spices, your favourite flavours ( if using dried beef, spice essence, curry powder, onion etc. ) | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts ( optional, toasted if desired ) | spices, your favourite flavours ( optional, toasted if desired )
instructions: In a non stick frying pan, cook turkey in oil. Once turkey is cooked, add spices and let cool for 5 minutes. Mix in walnuts, serve on toasted burger bun or hoagie roll.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,salmon,bean,dark sesame oil,flour,porcini mushroom,italian dressing,butter
title: Best Ever Salmon and Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces salmon, skin on | 3 tablespoons flour | 2 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 3 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 3/4 cups dried mixed beans | 8 tablespoons italian dressing | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Place the salmon in a skillet and coat it with flour. Fry it for 3 - 5 minutes in the butter.

title: Tamarind Crème Brûlée
ingredients: 12 slices egg bread | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp | 3 1/4 cups pure apricots, with skins
instructions: Line cookie sheet with parchment paper. Cut twelve 6 inch squares of foil long enough to completely enclose 4 bread slices. Place a bread slice in each. Using a tablespoon, poke small crisscrossed cracks, about ½ inch deep, on top of bread and fruit. Drizzle lemon juice over and around. Sprinkle with tamarind pulp. Arrange in a circle over a cookie sheet and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Bake at 300 degrees f. For 45 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: oil,sparkling wine,peanut,kosher salt black pepper,vanilla extract
title: Sparkling Spanish Peanuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup unsalted whole peanuts | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | oil ( for deep frying ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup sparkling wine ( or more )
instructions: Dry fry the peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan occasionally, until light golden brown and just beginning to turn color around the edges, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain. Season with salt according to the instructions on the bottle of wine. Remove the pan from the heat and add 1 teaspoon of oil. Add the vanilla. Let cool, 5 to 10 minutes, then spoon off extra vanilla bean oil and puree with or without the peanuts. Stir in the reserved sugar. Add the reserved oil from the peanuts and whisk until smooth. Serve with warmed up spanish wine.

title: The Best Strawberry and Salmon Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package frozen strawberries | 4 -5 large fresh salmon, skin and bones removed as desired
instructions: Thaw the frozen berries and add them when they are thawed. Using a fork, mix the berries well but gently. Spoon the puree onto a lined baking tray. Sprinkle with the smoked salmon pieces. Set the baking tray on the top rack of preheated 450 oven. Bake at 450 for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly on the top. Remove salmon and serve with strawberry sauce or ketchup.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,tortilla,vanilla,pecorino romano cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,self raising flour,bacon bit,whipping cream
title: Pasta & Bacon Salad
ingredients: 150 g self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 250 g dry tortilla, halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons chopped pecorino romano cheese ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 60 g bacon bits or 60 g bacon bits, cooked
instructions: Place flour & cream in a food processor or blender with oil & vinegar. Mix well. Add to dry ingredients & whiz until the mixture is smooth. Season w/salt & pepper if desired. Place the tortilla pieces in a single layer in the base of a shallow tray. Pour half the batter mixture over the tortilla base & flatten carefully so it covers the base & sides & sides w/out touching. Sprinkle the cheese & bacon bits over the top. Repeat the process for all the tortillas. Bake, uncovered on a baking tray in a preheated oven 375°f. For 25minutes or until golden.

title: Homemade Red Curry Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Put cream in a container with tight fitting lid. Cover tightly and shake until the cream gets a thick, light coconut cream consistency. Takes about 2 hours.

title: Quick and Easy Basting Spray
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking spray | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Whisk the quickcooking spray and salt together in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: chuck,sun tomato oil,black peppercorn,tart apple,italian salad dressing mix,pumpkin pie spice,tabasco sauce
title: Pumpkin and Apple Italian Sub Biscuits
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 3/4 cup finely chopped tart apple | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 2 -3 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 2 -4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Toast peppercorns in skillet until fragrant, watching as it can burn very quickly if that happens. Combine all ingredients in large bowl, adding remaining ingredients. Shape into 1 inch balls, place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,dill pickle,active yeast,guajillo chilies,extra virgin olive oil,cooking spray,garlic clove,oat
title: Guajillo, Dill and Garlic Dip With Baked Oats
ingredients: 6 guajillo chilies | cooking spray | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 100 ml extra virgin olive oil | 250 g rolled oats | 4 garlic cloves, thinly sliced | 220 g dill pickles, sliced | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Line an 8cm loose bottomed, 2cm deep ovenproof baking tin with baking parchment. Cut a slit down the side of each chilli, then put them in a small frying pan with 2 tsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp dry yeast and half the freshly ground black pepper. Heat gently, shaking pan occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes. Turn off heat and drain chiles and keep warm in a clean tea towel. Wipe the fryng pan clean, adding the remaining oil, 4 cloves of garlic and 1 tsp ground oregano and fry the remaining chillies until softened, about 3 mins. Add half the reserved chilli liquid. Mix the reserved chilli liquid with the oats, remaining black pepper and cornflour then set aside. Stir fry the dill picklem slices until golden, but not browned, about 5 - 10 mins, stirring now and then. Remove from heat, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper and leave to cool. Spread the pickle mixture on top of the cooled pickle mix and return to oven for 15 minutes until the topping is golden and a little crusty. Transfer to a cutting board and allow to cool slightly. Serve warm with pitta bread for dipping.

title: Fantastic Mexican Scallops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon portabella mushroom cap or 1 tablespoon cremini mushroom cap | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled jalapeno pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions or 2 tablespoons finely chopped greens | 1/4 cup snipped of fresh mint | 1/4 cup cracker crouton
instructions: In large non stick pan over medium heat melt margarine. Add mushrooms, jalapenos, scallions. Stir fry for 3 minutes or until mushrooms are browned, stirring constantly. Stir in mint then toss to coat. Remove and arrange on platter. Spoon mushroom mixture over scallops. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top. Enjoy.

title: Vanilla Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups white sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Place sugar and vanilla into a heavy bottomed pot, on the stove or in the microwave. Bring to the boil, watching carefully so it doesn't burn on the bottom. When it is at a rolling boil, remove from the heat. With a slotted spoon, pour hot mixture into a bowl. Serve warm over hot fluffy vanilla cream, ice cream or ice cream pudding.

title: Beef Shank
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/2 teaspoon chili sauce, and | 1 lamb shank | 4 lbs beef shanks ( each weighing 1-1/2 inches ) | 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, broken into pieces
instructions: Make a slits across the shank lengthwise and set the shanks aside. In a large saucepan, combine vodka and chili sauce and bring to a boil. Add the shanks, cover and simmer gently for 3 hours or until tender. Drain off liquor and skim off any excess fat. Transfer shanks to a platter and keep hot. To make gravy, heat a heavy based saucepan. Cook the chocolate in batches over medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir into the pan with the reserved shank and remove from heat. Serve the beef with rice or potato and sauce if you prefer.

title: Couscous Basics
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot marinara sauce ( bottled or home made or homemade ) | 1 1/2 cups couscous | 2 1/2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( optional ) | 1/2 cup catsup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an oven to 200°c. Warm the saucepan over a slow flame. Remove from heat and add the couscous. Stir well to combine, cover and let stand 10 minutes. Add the garlic, vanilla, catsup and any extras and stir. Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 5 - 10 minutes, or until couscous is lightly toasted. Serve immediately.

title: Chef John's Israeli Party Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked couscous | 1 1/4 cups barbeque sauce | 1/4 cup molasses ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons smoked radish, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 cup barbeque sauce ( optional )
instructions: Fill a small bowl with warm water and place it in the bowl with warm couscous. Cover with the moistened bowl, set the bowl in a warm place, and allow the couscous and water to soak until couscous is just beginning to swell, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, bring 1 1/4 cups barbeque sauce and molasses to a boil in a saucepan over high heat, swirling the heat until the mixture is thick. Remove from the heat, and let cool to room temperature. When the couscous has soaked, pour in 1/4 cup barbeque sauce, the remaining barbeque sauce, and radish for garnish if using. Let cool to room temperature before filling with couscous.

title: Walnut-Baked Wheat Cakes
ingredients: 250 g soft bread | 125 g walnut halves | 125 g currants or 125 g raisins | 125 g dates, chopped | 1 can bamboo shoots, chopped | 1/4 cup dates, chopped extra | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1/4 cup walnut halves | 1 1/4 cups blackberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Cut bread into chunks and put into a large bowl. Pour in the remaining ingredients and stir well. Dry off any excess bread and add to the bowl. Mix with hands until dough becomes homogenous and dough forms into small cakes. Take a walnut sized tablespoon of dough, shape into a cone. Roll the circle in walnut halves. Place the cak on a greased baking tray, cut side down. Bake in the oven on middle shelf for about 25 minutes or until nice and golden. Let them cool while you make a second batch. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Cheesecake
ingredients: 3 packages philadelphia cream cheese | 1/2 lb margarine, softened | 1 cup chopped peanuts | 1 tablespoon ground sage | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 package tostada chips | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In mixing bowl, cream cheeses with sugar till light and fluffy. Add all spices & blend well. Spread cheese mixture on bottom of a 9 inch springform pan. Spread with cream cheese mixture. Top with tostada chips & parmigiano cheese. Let set for 1 hour. Slice & serve.

title: Tunisian Baked Semolina and Date Medley
ingredients: 12 dates | 200 g semolina | 2/3 savoy cabbage, chopped | 2/3 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 c /350°f. Spread the date sticks on an oven tray and bake for about 45 minutes or until light golden brown. Let cool on a baking sheet. Remove pits and finely chop. Mix together the filling ingredients and spread onto the dates. Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes, until the filling is firm and the date medley is firm. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: grapefruit,hoisin sauce,coconut milk,gouda cheese,lavash bread,chipotle chile
title: Smokin Hot Stuffed Grapefruit Toast
ingredients: 1 grapefruit, halved and sliced crosswise | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 4 slices rustic smoked gouda cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh grated peeled chipotle chile | 2 slices canned chipotle chiles | 3 1/2 teaspoons coconut milk
instructions: Place grapefruit on baking sheet. Stir hoisin sauce and next four ingredients in large nonstick frypan over moderate heat until mixture boils and thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Divide cheese between 2 bread slices and top with grapefruit. Toast sandwiches, cut diagonally into 3 portions.

title: Pear Soup - Japanese Pear Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg fresh pears, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon dashi
instructions: Peel the pears then remove the core. Blanch them until they change colour. Cut them into chunks removing all the white pith. Cut the pears into chunks and place in a bowl. Add the saffron, seasoning salt and dashi to taste. Stir well. Cover and set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes to allow the flavours to meld together. Serve hot or cold.

title: Cajun Pork and Hominy Pie
ingredients: 1 lb pork belly, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb pancetta, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 gallon hominy, drained and rinsed | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a large pot, on medium heat, melt pancetta and pork together. Remove pork mixture from pot when brown and pour off any grease. Add chopped pancetta to pork and pork. Place pork back in the pot. Add rinsed and drained black beans. Pour in can of hominy and heavy cream. Add vanilla. Mix thoroughly, adding a little at a time while mixing. Cook for an entire hour, stirring every 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Rosemary Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch rosemary ( small leaves ) | 1 tablespoon rose water | 2 tablespoons salad greens
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,sun tomato,anchovy paste,cumin powder
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self rising flour ( i use all purpose ) | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes ( i use jarred sun dried tomatoes, not the canned ones ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste
instructions: Mix sun dried tomatoes and anchovies. Put flour into a bowl. Add spices and mix well. Add all of the dry ingredients in to bowl, knead lightly. Turn onto floured board, knead once or twice. Turn out onto floured board and knead lightly again till dough is smooth and elastic. Divide into two pieces. Cut into quarters. Place on lightly greased tray. Flatten slightly. Brush each cut piece with a little beaten egg and bake in oven at 220c for 10 minutes. Bread should be golden brown.

title: Irish  Lamb Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 1/2 lbs lamb fillets | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Cube lamb. Fry in large nonstick pan until lightly brown. Place lamb, raisins and cover with water. Simmer until lamb is tender about 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally, or longer if desired. Note that the longer the water boils it will make the gravy..

title: Indian Spiced Green Onion Tea (Microwave)
ingredients: 1 medium green onion, washed and chopped to about 1/2 inch diameter | 1 1/4 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl, stirring to blend completely. Cover and microwave on high power level about 5 minutes or until heated through. Remove from microwave and stir well. Enjoy.

title: Grilled Hazelnut Chocolate Hazelnut Roll
ingredients: 4 ounces hazelnuts, raw and skins on | 8 ounces chocolate, dark | 7 ounces icing sugar, sifted | 7 -9 ounces icing sugar, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/375f/gas 4. Place hazelnuts in a bowl and pour in boiling water which they soaked in for 1 minute. Let stand for 1 minute. Roughly chop. Place two ounces of the chocolate in a heatproof bowl. Place half of the hazelnut butter in a blender and blend until smooth. Gradually pour in the hazelnut mixture whilst continuously watching for it to thicken. Pour the chocolate into a large bowl and stir with a wooden spoon, adding the icing sugar slowly. Spread half of the hazelnut mixture on top of the chocolate followed by the remaining hazelnut mixture. Cut into 2 even pieces. Roll each piece tightly, wrap in foil and chill for 3 hours or until the chocolate has set. Remove from the fridge 15 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with icing sugar.

title: Maple Pork Wraps With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon curry ( or to taste ) | 1 bag mixed chopped brussels sprouts | 1 head lettuce ( leafy greens or red leaf )
instructions: Brown pork in a skillet over medium heat, stirring to separate fat and lumps.. Stir fry another minute or two, or until lightly golden. Transfer to a serving platter and set aside. Add maple syrup to pan. Add curry, sprouts and lettuce leaves to drippings in skillet and cook till wilted to the desired texture. Top with pork just before serving.

title: Pumpkin Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes, toasted and crushed | 1 cup ground pumpkin ( from an 8-oz can )
instructions: Combine the crushed corn flakes and pumpkin in a small bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and press onto the baking sheets. Bake at 400° on a baking sheet for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the baking sheet to a wire rack. Serve warm or chilled with a topping of choice.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,pie shell,mozzarella cheese,banana,chicken rice roni,tarragon
title: Rachael Ray's Hawaiian Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 3 large fat free pizza shells, thawed | 3 cups shredded muir glace mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons minced hot red chili peppers, divided | 2 teaspoons tarragon or 2 teaspoons basil | 2 large free range eggs and 2 free range eggs | 1 banana
instructions: Preheat oven according to directions on pie crust package. Spray a large baking sheet heavily with oil. Thinly slice each pizza shell and top with 2 tablespoons of the muir glace, half of the grated cheese, half the roasted red peppers, and half of the tarragon or basil, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste. In a large bowl, beat the eggs and milk with a fork, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Dip a slice of banana into the egg/milk mixture, and place it in the crust with the cheese crumbles. Using a spatula, lightly press the banana slices down into the dough so the bacon fits snugly. Cover the pizza with some pizza dough, and press the crust down firmly again. Cut a cross in the center to vent the steam. Bake uncovered for approximately 30 minutes, or until the crust has browned a little and the banana is hot and beginning to crisp up. Serve immediately.

title: Cornmeal and Fruit Salsa - Calvese
ingredients: 1 lb tiny red potato ( such as yucca ) | 10 small small squid rings | 1/2 lb small red sweet potato ( such as kumara ) | 4 scallions, chopped | 1/2 cup coarse cornmeal
instructions: Boil the whole sweet potatoes in water for about 20 minutes. While they are boiling, rinse and dry the squids. Cut the sweet potato squash into 1/4 inch slices and cut the squid lengthwise in half. When potatoes are done, drain, cool, and cut into 1 inch pieces. When potatoes are cool, chop the squid into small bite size lengths. In a bowl, soak the cornmeal in a small amount of cold water for a couple of minutes, till the mixture begins to thicken. Add the cornmeal mixture and continue to mix. Season with salt and pepper. If desired, you can also add a sprinkling of finely crushed chia seeds when serving.

title: French Sausage and Cherry Soup
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sweet italian sausage | 2 cups reduced-sodium fat-free vegetable broth | 1 1/2 cups halved pitted cherries | 1 french baguette, cut diagonally into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook sausage until well browned. Drain fat and reserve, pressing on sausage until evenly browned. Stir in broth, cherry halves and reserved sausage. Simmer about 10 minutes, until cherries are tender and flavors are well blended. Meanwhile in a small nonstick skillet, toast bread slices for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. Ladle soup into bowls. Serve topped with toasted bread slices.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,ketchup,cream celery soup,beef stew meat
title: Crock Pot BBQ Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 cans cream of celery soup | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Place meat in crock pot. Combine soup, ketchup, soy sauce, and soya sauce, mix well. Pour mixture over meat. Cook on high 8 hours or low 6 - 8 hours, depending on quality of meat and vegetables your crock pot does not affect the meat's texture, so i use 2 lbs of beef. Add more of each salt, pepper, sugar, and or garlic seasoning if you would like more spice. I also make this with left over pulled beef from our asian noodles.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,dark sesame oil,garlic salt,vanilla pudding
title: Canadian Bacon and Instant Pudding
ingredients: 4 cups of pre-made instant pudding ( instant or prepared ) | 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla instant pudding ( instant or prepared )
instructions: Pour 2/3 cups of pre made instant pudding into a microwave safe bowl and microwave on full power for 3 minutes on full power. Remove from microwave and stir in remaining ingredients. Microwave on full power for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring after one minute. Stir thoroughly. Let sit for about 5 minutes before serving. Enjoy.

title: Broccoli and Salmon Pilaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh salmon, cut into 4 pieces | 1 package frozen broccoli | 3 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons finely grated lemon peel | hot cooked broccoli
instructions: Heat a large skillet or wok over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray, and add salmon. Cook and stir til opaque and opaque about 5 minutes. Add in broccoli, cover, and cook on medium heat about 2 minutes. Stir in rice. Cook and stir until rice is warmed through, about 1 minute. Stir in chicken broth. Simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in lemon peel, and serve over broccoli.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,szechwan pepper,red onion,cider,green leaf lettuce,coconut milk,chili powder
title: Hawaiian Hot and Sour Coleslaw (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 cup peanut butter ( no subs! ) or 1/2 cup vegan margarine ( no subs! ) | 1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1 1/2 green leaf lettuce, finely chopped ( i hate any type of green leaves, but i use the frozen ones ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder ( a spicy chili pepper will do in a pinch! ) | 1/16 - 1/4 teaspoon szechwan pepper, crushed ( a few drops a few drops a few drops a few drops a few drops a a no-no ) | 1 teaspoon cider ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, mix all the ingredients. Chill until ready to serve with your favourite veggies or bread. Enjoy,. I use a hand held immersion blender for this, but you can easily do this in a blender if you prefer a smoother dressing. Enjoy.

title: Yummy & Sinful Chocolate Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 600 g minced meat | 1 cup dark chocolate ( optional, we don't normally use and the dark is a good flavour ) | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Put rice and 1 teaspoon celery salt in a wok and microwave covered for 1 min to steam. Set aside till cool. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Put rice in a large bowl. Top with some melted dark chocolate if it's to drizzle around the top later as it melts. Serve immediatlly.

title: Herb Beef (Beef or Pork) Rice Pilaf (Medianoche) - Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup white rice, uncooked, i prefer jasmine | 1 cup low sodium beef broth ( or chicken broth ) | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs
instructions: Stir the rice and broth in a large casserole or saucepan until the broth and rice are combined. Sprinkle the mixed herbs over the top and bake it in a microwave oven on full power for 2 minutes until the broth is absorbed. Allow standing time of about 4 minutes if possible for the rice to absorb the grain. Serve hot.

title: Low-Fat Baked Garlic
ingredients: 6 cloves garlic, smashed | 2 teaspoons splenda granular or 2 teaspoons sugar | 2/3 cup fat-free half-and-half | 1/2 cup reduced fat parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place the garlic in a small baking dish, and sprinkle with sugar. Combine the cream and half and parmesan cheese in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently. Drain off excess fat and pour cream mixture into the baking dish. Bake until the garlic is warm to the touch and the topping is slightly browned, about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Dansk Tomato
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, undistilled | 1 pint cheap vodka
instructions: Using plastic wrap remove the tomato from its jar and shake to remove the oil produced and the pulp. Heat the vodka with its contents until it begins to bubble. If its mixture reaches boiling point remove the vodka and immediately add it back to the vodka and stir. Leave to cool to room temperature. Put the tomatoes on a baking tray lined with foil and spread them around until they are covered with the oil/vodka. I like my tomatoes to be about to float around the tomatoes. Cut the tomatoes in half and slice into quarters and place in the vodka. I like to put the tomato slices on the tomatoes as well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,black tea,vanilla sugar,white vinegar,mustard,corn,brandy,ginger ale
title: Tea Bread (Australian)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 tablespoon corn | 4 tablespoons brandy | 4 tablespoons nuttelex black tea ( hot but not boiling ) | 1/3 cup bread flour | 1/3 cup rice flour | 2/3 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger ale
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let rest 10 - 15 minutes. Divide into 15 parts, shape into 10 little bread shapes. Bake at 400º 30 minute or until golden brown. Can be served warm or cold. Variation, for a different flavor, add 1 tsp lemon peel for a twist.

title: Crock Pot Cantonese Meatballs
ingredients: 3 large tart apples ( about 2 lbs. ) | 20 ounces frozen miniature meatballs, thawed | 1 cup cornmeal, mix | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons cold water | 2 -3 teaspoons red wine | 1 can of cut cornhill apples ( in juice )
instructions: Prepare apples, cut sides off apples and place on large cookie sheet spoke fashion. Set aside. Combine apples, cornmeal, cumin and tahini in bowl and set aside. Combine water, wine and apples. Pour over apples and let stand for 30 minutes. Put meatballs mixture in crock pot. Cover loosely and cook on high 3 hours. Add more water if mixture is drying out. Cook 1 hour. Turn control to low, leave cover on and cook for 1 hour and turn off. Let meatballs rest on their own for 20 minutes before serving.

title: A Twist on Spinach and Dates
ingredients: 1 jar chopped spinach, drained and chopped | 1 container crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 pound fresh dates, chopped | 1 beets, trimmed and diced
instructions: Place spinach and feta cheese in a microwave safe bowl, and cook in microwave on medium high power for 3 minutes, or until feta cheese has melted and is light brown. Stir in dates and beets.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,parsley leaf,english muffin,shell pasta,pea,corn kernel,grapefruit juice
title: Spinach English Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup grapefruit juice, fresh squeezed | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon dried parsley leaves | 1 garlic clove, minced | 6 english muffins, cut into 1/3/4-inch slices ( preferably whole wheat ) | 3/4 cup small shell pasta | 1/3 cup peas or 1/3 cup red pepper flakes, crushed | 1/3 cup corn kernel, canned or 1/3 cup cooked lima beans, drained
instructions: Mix the grapefruit juice and parsley in a medium bowl. Stir in the garlic and set aside. Arrange the muffin slices in a single layer on a serving plate. Drizzle the grapefruit juice mixture into the muffin slices and gently toss the fruit into the muffin slices. Serve warm, room temperature or cooled. Garnish with crushed or broken, cooked pepper flakes and corn kernels.

title: Gardinhas (Vietnamese Soft Taco Salad)
ingredients: 2 heads iceberg lettuce | salt to taste | 1/2 spanish onion, chopped
instructions: Line a large platter with lettuce leaves, and sprinkle with a bit of salt. Pour over about 2/3 cup of water. Place an onion in a little cup, and sprinkle with a bit more. Place the cooked lettuce in a blender, and pulse several times to make a chunky, coarse puree. This will take a few seconds. Pour the gardinhas over top of the lettuce.

Random Ingredients: walnut,dijon mustard,lime wedge,bow tie pasta,sun tomato
title: Lime and Walnut Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta, cooked per package directions | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomato | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Place cooked pasta on a serving platter and top with the sun dried tomatoes, walnuts and mustard. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Hermsauce for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried herbs ( thyme, oregano, basil, etc. ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning
instructions: Dry herbs on paper towel or brown paper until desired spiciness is achieved. Mushrooms or other dry ingredients of choice may be used in place of dried herbs. May have to be reamended in seasoning. Keep in refrigerator for 30 minutes before using. Brush on oil after removing from heat. Note, this may be prepared in to quantities up to 2 days ahead or can be frozen.

title: Mexican Poached Roast Chiles, Tingales, Appetizer
ingredients: 1 dozen poblano chile, with seeds | 1/2 pound roasted lardons | 1/2 cup coffee, unsweetened | 1/3 cup butterscotch chips | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: In ovenproof skillet, broil chilies in hot oven until charred all over, turning often, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer chilies to small bowl. Stir lardons into chilies and cool completely. Peel and seed chiles. Cut chiles into wedges. Stuff each wedge with a 1/2 teaspoon lardon, a poblano chile, 2 tablespoons chile stuffing mixture, and 2 tablespoons chile mixture. Wrap each pastry sheet around the filling and tuck under. Place in an ungreased 9x9 inch baking pan. Bake in a preheated 450 degrees f oven until golden, 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Real Chiles
ingredients: 4 large red, green chilies | 1 bunch celery, cleaned and finely chopped | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 12 ounces mozzarella cheese, sliced
instructions: Set a large nonstick frying pan or griddle skillet on medium high heat. Heat the chiles in the hot pan until they begin to pop open. Using a slotted spoon transfer the chiles to a small bowl. Sprinkle with salt, and set aside. Bring the pan to medium heat and gently cook the chiles, stiring often, until they are very dark in color and begin to soften, 3 to 8 minutes total. Use a slotted spoon to transfer chiles to a plate lined with a kitchen towel. Set aside and keep warm. Continue to cook the celery and chiles in the same manner. Mix the chile mixture, vinegar, and half of the mozzarella cheese together in the bowl with the chiles. Taste and adjust the seasonings. Spoon the sauce over the cheese mixture.

title: Tamarind Chorizo Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup sour cream | 3 ounces chorizo sausage
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor. Blend until smooth. Serve cold with assorted crackers.

title: Mock House Pasta
ingredients: 450 g spiral pasta | 3 baby dill pickles ( pickled, halved ) | 150 g currants | 1 chicken bouillon | 150 g white flour
instructions: Cook pasta as you normally would. Meanwhile, cook the pickles. When the pasta is done, drain and leave to cool slightly. Mix the chicken boullion with 125 ml water, mix well, add to the hot pasta. Add the pickle halves and currants. Put your hands in the pasta and mix thoroughly, until the pasta is slightly coated, then transfer to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,mung bean sprout,cream mushroom soup
title: Linda's Mint & Stroganoff
ingredients: 600 g dried mung bean sprouts | 400 g condensed cream of mushroom soup | fresh mint sprigs, to garnish
instructions: Place the mung bean sprouts in a large saucepan of boiling water, cook until tender but still crunchy. Drain, place in a bowl & mix with the soup. Serve garnished with mint sprigs.

title: Artichoke Stuffed Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 10 ounces artichoke bottoms | 8 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Blend all the ingredients together in a mixer until smooth.

title: Lentil Pork Chops With Ricotta
