ingredients: 6 pork chops | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup dried lentils | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds
instructions: Prepare the browned pork chops according to the directions on the package. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine the icing sugar, tomato soup and lentils. Mix well. Spread half of the tomato soup mixture over the pork chops. Spread the rest of the sauce over the pork chops and mix. Spread the dill over the tomato soup layer and cover with the rest of the sauce. Sprinkle the sliced almonds all over the top. Chill in the fridge for 1 hour before serving. Garnish with sour cream and parsley if desired.

title: Ethiopian White Beans ("nohis Bil-E Karaf (White Beans Cooked in Niter Kiya)
ingredients: 3 cups dried navy beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons turmeric
instructions: Put beans in a large pot and cover with enough water to cover them by at least 1 1/4 feet. Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat and let stand until most of the water has evaporated. Drain, then return the beans to the pot, cover, and continue to cook over low heat until just tender, about 2 hours. Drain them well. Transfer into a large serving dish, sprinkle with a little turmeric, and let stand for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Lobster Ears
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach - rinsed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh herb | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1 tablespoon herbed blend cheese blend | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spray two 12 inch tart pans with cooking spray. Toss spinach, herbs, cheese blend, and sugar in a medium bowl until coated. Spread spinach mixture in each pan, and bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and the spinach mixture is hot, 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Black & Orange Halloween Fondue
ingredients: 6 ounces egg yolks | 3/4 cup cocoa powder | 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp ( cooked ) | 1 lb chicken | 1 cup fresh strawberries | 1 tablespoon chili ( chopped or ground ) | 1/4 cup fresh chives
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Serve on fettuccine with red, green or yellow jelly beans or as desired.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,squash,anchovy paste,rigatoni pasta,garbanzo bean,orange juice,green onion,romano cheese
title: Pasta with Cavolo D' Angelo
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 5 poblano chiles, chopped | 4 zucchini, chopped | 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 4 romaano cheese, cubed | 1 bottle orange juice, or more to taste | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 bunch green onions, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 13 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,sun tomato,parmigiano reggiano cheese,french onion soup mix,mint sprig,onion salt
title: Sun Dried Tomato and Fusilli Tacos
ingredients: 1 can condensed french onion soup mix, undiluted ( about 1/2 cup ) | 16 large flour tortillas | 1 cup sun-dried tomato | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Stir soup mix and sun dried tomatoes in medium bowl until well blended. Arrange tortillas. Top tortillas with approximately 1 tbsp soup mix mixture along each tortilla. Garnish with remaining chopped sun dried tomato and mint sprigs. Enjoy.

title: The Aztec Oyster
ingredients: 1 package oysters | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1/4 cup capers, drained, rinsed, and minced | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1/4 cup cracked black pepper | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Wash oysters, removing all shells. Wash the shucked shrimps, leave on one side only. In medium saucepan, combine first seven ingredients. Bring to boil and remove from heat. Add oysters, cover and seal tightly. Cook in the rum, about 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and opaque. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,gruyere cheese,pasta,riesling wine,ha avocadoes,black eyed pea,tomato juice,pork tenderloin
title: Black Eyed Pea and Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 loin loins of pork tenderloin, about 5 inches long and 3/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons yogurt | 2 medium ripe hass avocadoes, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 teaspoon fresh black olives or 1 teaspoon kalamata olive oil | 4 tablespoons riesling wine | 2 medium tomatoes with juice, seeded and chopped | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 cup thin noodles or 1 cup any small shell pasta
instructions: Rinse and drain the black eyed peas, discarding the stones, if any. Spread 1 tablespoon of yogurt into the bottom of each of 4 small deep soup bowls. Divide the olives and the olive oil between each bowl. Place the pork tenderloin between 2 layers of plastic wrap, or waxed paper, and pound it with a meat pounder or heavy bottomed cooking mallet so that it is about 1/4 inch thick. Lay the pork in the center of each bowl. Top with the sliced avocado. In a small skillet, brown the sliced tomatoes in the remaining 1 tablespoon of yogurt over very low heat. Serve the teddyos along with the black eyed peas, tomato sauce, and gruyere cheese.

title: Melting Spicy Black Olives
ingredients: 1 can pitted black olives | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped onion | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground poblano chile | 1/8 teaspoon baking cocoa
instructions: Drain the olives well and gently tear them by hand into a bowl using your hands. Place the onion, half of the confectioners' sugar, salt, poblano chile, and the remaining confectioners' sugar in a food processor. Pulse until coarsely chopped.

title: Spicy Chipotle Kale - the Best Ever!
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups light oatmeal | 2 cans petite diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 cups kale, chopped coarse ( i used kale ) | 2 cans chopped jalapenos | 2 cans diced chipotle chiles | 2 -3 cups unsweetened coconut ( optional ) or 2 -3 cups shredded coconut ( optional )
instructions: Mix everything together and add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Roasted Sauerkraut With Chili and Lemon
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut | 2 medium lemons, zest of, grated | 1/2 cup loosely packed cilantro leaf, packed | 5 small red chili peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the sauerkraut in a shallow baking dish. Place the lemon zest in a small, shallow bowl. Add the cilantro to the lemon zest and toss to coat. Add the chile slices and spoon mixture over the sauerkraut. Bake uncovered in a preheated 400 degree oven until the chili just starts to brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,cardamom seed,apple juice,nutmeg,guajillo chilies,pork fillet,kombu,cold water
title: Kombu Jhangen
ingredients: 450 g beef chuck | 50 ml guajillo chilies, seeded, soaked in | 50 ml water | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1 pinch nutmeg | 1 pinch cardamom seed | 500 ml cold water | 225 g kombu ( dried kombu, soaked overnight in cold water, then drained )
instructions: Cut the beef chuck into 1 inch square pieces. Wash the guajillo chilies in hot water, place them in a blender with a small amount of water, the applejuice, nutmeg and cardamom seeds. Blend until smooth. Pour the cold water over the spices and the beef, cover and leave for a few hours. Bring the kombu to boil with a pinch of salt, remove the lid of the kombu and add a cup of cold water to cover for boiling. Cover, turn off the heat, and leave for two hours until it starts to swell. Strain the mixture and put the contents into a container with a lid and leave overnight. Serve cold with rice, enchiladas, chutney or with a fresh leafy green salad and a good red wine. Variation, instead of the coriander seeds used in the paste, you may substitute a tablespoon of cilantro to the coriander. Variation, use 2 teaspoons dried oregano or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary. Variation, substitute a tablespoon of sambal oelek or chile powder with 1/2 teaspoon chopped red pepper. Variation, substitute 1 t dried minced chilies or 1/2 t dried anise for the chile powder.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,mustard,rosemary,corn tortilla,seasoning salt,self rising flour,allspice,spaghetti
title: Savory Mexican Tortilla Cake
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti | 1/2 teaspoon mustard | 1 dash allspice | 12 ounces sour cream or 12 ounces greek yogurt | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup minced dried rosemary | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 12 corn tortillas or 12 slices of your favorite tortilla
instructions: Bring pasta to boil, then cook until al dente. Drain and cool while preparing topping. Mix sour cream and allspice. Add the dry ingredients and mix together. Set aside until ready to use. Spray 2 - 9 inch cake pans with nonstick cooking spray and divide the spaghetti among the cake pans. Mix yogurt and sour cream till well mixed and smooth. Divide evenly among the prepared bowls and top with the prepared sour cream or cheese mixture to cheese. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: pecan,broccoli floret,tarragon,chipotle chile adobo,quinoa,rump roast,self raising flour,sauerkraut
title: Chile, Cheese and Quinoa Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 2 cups broccoli florets | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 2 canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 cups sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 cup pecans, roughly chopped | 5 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 1/2 cups coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c/180c fan forced/325°f/4 5 gas mark grease and line a 12 hole 1 1/2 cup muffin tin with muffin cases. Place quinoa, broccoli, tarragon and chilli in a large frying pan over medium high heat and stir. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes until fragrant. Spoon quinoa mixture into well buttered muffin tin and press down firmly with the back of your spoon. Bake, covered with a baking paper sheet, for 20 - 25 minutes until firm. Remove paper and cool in the tin for 2 minutes on a wire rack. For the topping, combine sauerkraut, flour, 1 1/2 cup pecorino romano and 1 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pecorino. Remove the paper of baking pan, allow rind to harden slightly and then drizzle a tiny amount into the centre, allowing rind to set before removing. Set aside. To serve, preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced/325°f/4 gas mark lightly grease the paper lined muffin tin and sprinkle with remaining pecorino romano. To assemble, cut a circle out of the quinoa mixture. Place a tablespoon of sauerkraut in the centre of each circle, then top with a slice of quinoa mixture, sprinkling cheese over the sauerkraut and then finishing with a layer of the quinoa mixture. Finish with another quinoa layer and cheese. Serve at once. Enjoy your unique luncheon and cheese flavour now & enjoy.

title: Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 3 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Combine beans and chicken broth in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until tender, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,apricot half,farfalle pasta,serrano pepper,button mushroom
title: Garlicky Apricot Noodle With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces dried apricot halves, cut into thin slices from a jar | 8 slices serrano peppers ( about 1/3 pound ) or 8 slices cayenne pepper ( about 1/3 pound ) | 1 lb fresh button mushroom, sliced | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked farfalle pasta, such as bowties or 1 1/2-2 cups any other pasta
instructions: Cover the apricots with hot water and let stand for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a large saute pan, heat 2 cups of the remaining hot water. Add the shrimp or crab meat, if desired, and cook over high heat until pink, about 5 minutes. Drain. Heat the remaining 2 cups of hot water in the saute pan. Add the mushrooms, cover and cook over high heat until they soften, about 3 minutes. Add the apricot and shrimp mixture, stirring and cooking until the liquid comes to a boil. Cook for 1 minute or until most of the shrimp are pink, about 3 more minutes. Stir in the farfalle, cover and cook over low heat for 7 to 8 minutes, until the pasta is al dente. Drain, season with salt and serve.

title: Boeuf En Daube - French Onion Steak With Brandy
ingredients: 1 lb beef boneless chuck steak, thawed if frozen, slice 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Cut beef crosswise into 1/2 inch slices 1/2 inch thick. Stack in a bowl with some of the onion slices. Place 1/4 of the onions in a well buttered 1 gallon plastic bag. Arrange meat slices in bag around onions, pressing air out of bag. Refrigerate, turning bag over halfway through the freezing process. Refrigerate until time to cook. Arrange remaining onions on baking sheet and cover. Bake at 400 degrees f. For 11 minutes, stirring to distribute pan drippings.

title: Pork and Mushrooms Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 package button mushrooms, sliced into 1/4-inch slices | 4 ounces american cheese, shaved | 1 egg yolk | pickled umeboshi ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the pork in a nonstick skillet over medium heat until browned, 5 - 6 minutes. Add mushrooms and sauté 2 - 3 minutes to warm through. Remove from heat and set aside. Lightly stir the egg yolk into the pork and mushroom mixture and sprinkle with umeboshi. Transfer to a large serving platter and garnish with pickled red peppers, if desired.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,spanish onion,kale,dark chocolate melt,snow pea,lettuce
title: Chopstickers With Kale and Chocolate (Chokladbokken)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 1/2 ounces medium-grind dark chocolate melts | 1/2 small spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 1/4 lbs kale, trimmed and coarsely shredded | 2 cups shredded cabbage ( we like red leaf lettuce mixed ) or 2 cups kale, shredded ( we like red leaf lettuce mixed ) | 5 cups thinly sliced kale, from an english bunch ( or green leaves mixed ) | lettuce or spinach ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat wok or large skillet over medium heat until just beginning to smoke. Add oil and swirl to coat pan. Add chocolate and cook, lifting up pan occasionally to prevent butter from sticking, until a light brown color, about 3 minutes. Add onion with 1 1/3 cups water.

title: Swiss Chard With Cranberry Coulis
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs swiss chard, stemmed, coarse-chopped | 1 cup dried cranberries | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour | 4 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the chard with just enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,rigatoni pasta,beef stock,coriander,pork,vanilla essence,hot chili sauce,chili pepper
title: Pasta E Piselli
ingredients: 450 g dried rigatoni pasta or 450 g fettuccine | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 3 tablespoons mild chili paste ( like sambal olek ) | 500 g ground pork | 3 tablespoons ground fresh chili peppers | 1/2 cup beef stock | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 2 teaspoons hot chili sauce
instructions: Mix ground pork with chili paste and coriander in a bowl until combined. Cook rigatoni according to packet instructions, drain. Combine ground pork mixture, chillies stock, vanilla sauce and hot chili sauce in a large saucepan, bring to the boil. Turn heat back up slightly and simmer until sauce thickens. Season with salt and pepper, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,flat leaf parsley,pasta,salami,dark chocolate,mozzarella cheese,lemon juice
title: Hot Chocolate - Fad
ingredients: 400 g pasta, medium shape, penne | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 100 g dark chocolate ( chopped roughly ) | 100 g salami, chopped very finely | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, grated ( approx 4 ounces )
instructions: Cook pasta following instructions on packet. Drain pasta reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water in a medium saucepan. Meanwhile, microwave chocolate and salami for 2 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, or until melted. Add reserved pasta water and lemon juice. Add the italian seasoning, parsley, and mozzarella to the saucepan. Stir over medium heat until cheese has melted and mixed into pasta. Add pasta and mix well. Leave to stand 2 minutes. Serve with extra cheese.

title: Shakewell Refrigerator Ginger and Ginger Ice Cream Ball (Ice Cream Fan)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups ice cream or 1 1/4 cups other cool ice cream | 5 -6 slices peeled fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, grated
instructions: Place ice cream in refrigerator to rest, about 45 minutes. Place ginger in a plastic food storage bag with ginger and shake to blend. Let sit at room temperature 20 - 30 minutes longer until mixture is soft. Drain off liquid from bag and discard ginger. Roll mixture into 1 inch balls and freeze in freezer. Repeat process for 30 minutes or more until mixture is completely frozen. Return ice cream balls to freezer and roll in ginger. Freeze until they are completely cold. Transfer ice cream balls to an airtight container and keep in freezer. Refrigerate any leftover shaker ice cream balls.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,brown lentil,white wine,american cheese,sesame oil,dashi
title: American Cheese With Lentils, Sesame Oil and Mustard (Choy Choy)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry brown lentils | 1 tablespoon granulated salt | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 cups dry white wine, preferably chablis | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 3/4 cups dashi ( made by cooking the red food processed seasoning of your choice )
instructions: In 1 1/2 cup water, bring to a boil the lentils, granulated salt, and 1 teaspoon of the salt. Cover, reduce heat to medium low, and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, until the lentils have absorbed most of the water and the lentils are browned in the pot. Uncover, and bring the second half of the liquid to a boil again. Turn off the heat, and set aside to cool to room temperature. Prepare the mustard. Place the chablis in a small pot with 2 cups of water, bring to a boil, and simmer until the chablis are tender. Drain, and cut in half and set the halves aside. When done, strain the water from the chablis into a saucepan, and set aside for 20 minutes to cool slightly, then remove the chablis, chablis, and water. Combine the sesame oil with 2 cups of the dashi in a small bowl and set aside until needed. Bring the second half of the broth to a boil, then turn the heat to medium low, and add the mustard to the broth. Whisk until smooth, and return the soup to a simmer until thickened and the mustard is slightly creamy, about 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and add the reserved mustard, to the soup. Remove the soup from the heat. Serve the soup warm.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,serrano chili,arborio rice,heavy cream,mirin,bulgar wheat,chicken stock,corn
title: Steamed Rice With Arborio and Black Horns
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 2 cups chicken stock | 2 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 teaspoons sweet mirin | 2 cups julienned corn | 1/2 cup bulgur wheat | 2 serrano chili, seeds and ribs removed, cut into thin rings
instructions: Place rice in a small pot with 8 cups of stock and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook 15 minutes. Allow rice to steam, covered, until all 8 cups of stock have been absorbed and rice is creamy and firm, approximately 25 minutes. In a saucepan over medium high heat add rice and 2 cups of the hot stock, cream and bicarb soda. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes, stirring all the while. Remove from heat and allow to sit covered for 10 minutes. In the meantime, in a medium sized pot using 2 tablespoons of water, boil bulgar wheat, with remaining stock and serrano peppers, stirring often, for about 15 minutes or until tender. Rinse and drain rice and place on a large serving platter. Surround with serrano peppers and green beans.

title: Real Flair
ingredients: 1 cup cornstarch, all type is better | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix the sugar with the salt until dissolved. It should look like a fine powder. Add cornstarch and vanilla and mix well. You can add a small amount of oil to help it along, but make sure it is distributed evenly. It can be used immediately after, but i have found that if spread on the popcorn, it will stick to the oil better. Note, i usually double the recipe for this.

title: Peachy Matzo Pizzas
ingredients: 200 g panir | 6 -8 peaches, peeled | 1 cup matzo meal ( or more ) | 2 -3 tablespoons velveeta cheese ( more if preferred ), cut in half
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c or the hottest you can prepare a pizza stone. If you have one, put it in the oven for about 10 minutes. Put the panir in a pan and warm in the oven until it's melted and has a lovely golden colour on all sides. Cut the panir into 8 even pieces and put to one side. Cut the peach halves into thin slices and put to one side. Slice the peach halves into thin slices and put to one side. Cut the velveeta into cubes as finely as possible, or use a chunkier block of velveeta. Put the matzas into a pan of boiling water and boil for about 12 minutes, or until the matzos are just beginning to soften, drain and spread on two baking trays. Put the cooked matzos onto the plate, top with the cheese and peach slices, put back together and put on the stove. Put the two on the table and enjoy.

title: Easy Simple Gravy for Beef
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: Add all ingredients to a medium skillet and warm through.

Random Ingredients: radish,phyllo dough,flat leaf italian parsley,part mozzarella cheese,plain yogurt,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Baked Phyllo Filled Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 whole chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, coarsely chopped | 5 radishes, coarsely chopped | 10 sheets phyllo dough, thawed if frozen and folded into thirds | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 pounds thinly sliced part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Set the rack in center of the oven. Grease a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. In a large bowl, stir the yogurt and the parmigiano reggiano together. Stir in the chipotle peppers and radishes. Arrange 5 sheets of phyllo dough in the prepared baking dish, brushing each sheet with some of the yogurt mixture. Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the parsley on the phyllo. Place 2 more phyllo sheets in the same way. Top with just the 2 more sheets of phyllo. Cover with 2 more sheets of phyllo, brushing each sheet with more of the yogurt mixture. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parsley, and spread 2 more sheets of phyllo in a horizontal line down the center of the pizza. Top with more sheets of phyllo, brushing each sheet of phyllo with the yogurt mixture. Using a sharp knife, make cuts in the top layer of phyllo all the way down the center of the pizza. Brush the entire top layer of phyllo with yogurt. Sprinkle the rest of the mozzarella and parsley over the top. Bake 45 to 55 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top is golden and bubbly.

title: Simple Herbed Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 2 jars spaghetti sauce ( i prefer ragu or prego ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage
instructions: Cook the spaghetti until you like your sauce, about 10 minutes, depending on the desired doneness. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Tippysweet Apple Pain Perdu
ingredients: 1/2 cup evaporated milk chocolate | 10 slices day-old white bread | 3 cups apple juice | 4 cups white sugar | 1/4 cup sliced almonds
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt chocolate over low heat. Cut off crusts and slice bread into 1/4 inch slices, about 3 1/2 wide. Place 2 slices, cut side down, in a shallow, 10x6 inch baking dish. Pour milk chocolate over bread, turning bread slices over to cover. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 6 hours. In a large saucepan, bring apple juice, sugar and almonds to boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low. Stir until sugar is dissolved, then cover and simmer 30 minutes. Remove cover, increase heat to medium high, and boil 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. When apples come out of the syrup, remove from heat and pour over bread. Let stand for 1 to 2 minutes before serving.

title: Mediterranean Cod
ingredients: 2 cans canned tomato soup | 2 1/2 lbs cod | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 2 1/2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 chicken bouillon ( or 2 teaspoons garlic powder )
instructions: In a dutch oven, cover the bottom with cheese, pesto sauce and tomato soup. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Jalapeño Grilled Pig Shapes
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds pork butt, chopped | 1 can jalapeno chiles, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Mix pork, jalapeno chiles, and chile powder together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,ham,white fish fillet,butter margarine,basil,ra el hanout spice mix,maple syrup
title: Habanoush
ingredients: 400 g white fish fillets, chopped | 200 g dried pinto beans | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 3 tablespoons ra el hanout spice mix ( moroccan spice mix that ms dash uses to be a moroccan spice mix ) | 1/12 bunch fresh basil, chopped finely | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: To make the bahamic, rub all the butter or oil into the leaves of the dried basil, roll or put in a food processor to pureé. To make the harissa, combine all of the ingredients in a medium sized bowl and mix together until smooth. Place the dried beans in a large pan, cover with water and boil for approximately 2 minutes or until almost cooked. Drain the beans and add to the bahamic and mix together. Cook for approximately 3 more minutes. Serve with toasted bread or rice and/or naan bread.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,orange juice,red pepper cayenne,peach,goat cheese
title: Goat Cheese With Peaches
ingredients: 4 firm ripe peaches | 3 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 -2 dash red pepper cayenne
instructions: Remove peaches from pits, discarding pits. Cut peaches in half lengthwise, remove and discard fruit. Slice on the diagonal into slices about 1/4 inch thick, set aside. In a small bowl, combine goat cheese, orange juice, sesame seeds, red pepper and if desired, 1 1/2 tsp. Salt and 1/4 tsp. Hot pepper pepper.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,red wine,clam juice,chocolate chip,grain rice,herb,parsnip
title: German Style Clam Pie
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked chipped clams in juice, drained | 2 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 cup chopped parsnip | 1/3 cup chate cherries or 1/3 cup red wine or 1/3 cup brandy | 1 tablespoon fresh herbs or 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon semisweet chocolate chips | 2 pints clam juice
instructions: In large bowl toss clam juice, rice, parsnips, and cherries. Sprinkle with mustard seed and grated chocolate chips.

title: Easy, Delicious and Tasty Tuna Soup
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, deboned and cut up | 3 tablespoons low-sodium beef bouillon ( i like lawry's beef base because it is sweeter than your bouillon ) | 8 ounces tuna in water, drained and flaked | 1 can chopped mild vegetables ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( heaping, heaping ) | 4 corn tortillas, broken into small pieces | 1 cup pecans, crushed
instructions: Cook the chicken until just a little pink, then remove from the pot. Remove and add 1 tbsp of beef base to the same pot the chicken was boiled inches put this back in. Add the rest of the ingredients except for the tortillas, including the peanuts. Heat on medium hear while stirring frequently. The longer you let it simmer, the spicier your tuna will be. Stir, then cook for about 3 minutes on medium heat. Sprinkle the crushed peanuts on top, if using. Serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brandy,tahini,dark red kidney bean,green pepper,cream mushroom soup,cooking spray
title: Quick & Easy Vegetable Chili
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 can dark red kidney beans ( in can ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon brandy | 2 tablespoons tahini ( sesame seed paste, if you prefer ) | 1 dash grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Add beans & soup, brandy, nutmeg, & olive oil to casserole dish. Cover & bake for 30 minutes. Uncover & bake for 10 more minutes.

title: Mama Corbasi (Stir-Fried Beef With Pistachio)
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, sliced thin | 6 -12 tablespoons pistachios, shelled | lime wedge | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a wok or heavy skillet, stir fry steak until browned and crisp, 3 - 5 minutes, turning over occasionally. Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with salt and freshly ground pepper. Sprinkle pistachios over the steak. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Baked Arugula
ingredients: 1/3 cup wasabi powder | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules ( optional ) | 4 sprigs fennel, coarsely chopped | 3 cups coarsely arugula
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a small bowl, combine wasabi powder, coffee and fennel. Place in a 9x9 baking dish just large enough to hold arugula in one layer. Bake at 300 degrees f for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes, until the arugula starts to wilt and the wasabi has thickened. Remove from oven, stir and serve hot.

title: Saag (Saffron)
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon saffron ( soaked in 1 tbspns water for 20 minutes ) | 1/2 cup boiling water
instructions: Place soaked saffron in a medium sized bowl. Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over saffron. Mix well. When water comes to a boil, add the remaining ½ cup boiling water. Allow the saag to return to a rolling boil. Once this happens, stop stirring the saag and place on a plate covered with a clean damp towel. Allow to stand at room temperature for 20 - 30 minutes, or until the saag has cooled completely. If you want more liquid, you can add up to 1/4 cup boiling water. Stir well and serve.

title: Fold-Fried Fish Tacos
ingredients: 12 cloves | 2 cups white flour | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning ( old el paso brand )
instructions: In a food processor or a blender finely grind the cloves. Add flour and taco spice to the food processor or blender and pulse until completely blended. Pour into a medium size bowl and allow to rest at room temperature for 10 minutes. Stuff the floured fish with the mixture and fry in a medium size skillet with one inch of oil. Serve with your favorite taco toppings, like salsa, guacamole and cilantro. Note, to re heat taco, simply heat the oil in a small skillet until it is extremely hot, or when you use a wooden spoon stir fry the fish in the hot oil several times and add the minced garlic. Serve with your favorite taco toppings.

title: Simple Moroccan Sugar Blend
ingredients: 2 cups molasses | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Blend the ingredients in a food processor or with an immersion blender to a fine powder that will be able to form into small patties. Store in a container with a lid.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,madeira wine,fennel seed,double cream,chili powder,poblano pepper
title: Hot Fennel Sauce
ingredients: 2 whole poblano peppers, seeded | 4 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon dried fennel seed | 1 tablespoon freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 cups madeira wine | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: In a food processor, process poblano peppers until finely ground but not very smooth. Add chili powder, fennel seeds and parmesan cheese.

title: Pansy Buns
ingredients: 2 cups panir | 1 can pecans | 1/2 lb smoked sausage | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 packages dry yeast | 1 can espresso ( optional )
instructions: Mix the ingredients except espresso in a large bowl. Set aside in a warm place for 1 - 2 hours.. After 45 minutes, remove the coffee can from the brew and set aside. Mix the espresso with a large spoon, ensuring the espresso is dissolved. Let the mixture sit in the espresso mixture for 10 mins then, once the foam has started to rise up, mix the dough well. It should make a ball of dough, similar in texture to the dough itself. Add the extra milk or water as needed to knead the dough. Keep the dough in the bowl covered with a damp paper towel covered towel. Refill the bowl with an inverted bowl or paper towels. Allow the dough to rise until double the size, up to 1 hours depending on the size of your pans. When the second rise, place in oven at 350f degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Lamb Neck Bones
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb necks | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon coriander, cracked ( optional )
instructions: Make a neck bone, 1 to 2 feet wide, with the sides of a wooden spoon jointed into a 1 1/2 inch round bone with a bonezaar or other similar product. Trim off the excess fat. Sprinkle the outside of the neck with the garlic powder and cracked black pepper. Coat with the cracked black pepper. Place the neck bone on a rack in a roasting pan, or a deep roasting pan, with a cover on the top. Cover with a lid, and bake in a pre heated 300 degree oven for 3 hours. Turn the neck skin side up, and continue cooking for 45 to 50 more minutes, or until the leg meat becomes very firm and pulls easily off the bone.. Remove the neck from the oven and allow it to rest for 15 minutes. Slice the meat as desired.

title: Kale or Green Leaf Sauteed With Boston Lettuce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried kale | 1 head boston lettuce, washed and dried
instructions: Place the dried kale in a small baking dish and place under the broiler about 6 inches from the heat. Cook just until it begins to wilt or brown. Cool and then tear or tear up into bite sized pieces. Set kale aside. To steam kale, heat oil or spray grill. Place about 1/3 of the browned kale in a bowl. Top with about 1/3 the browned kale or greens. Press greens down and steam for 2 minutes. To steam greens, place on a grill basket or woody cookie sheet, with edges down, and steam until lightly crisped, 2 - 5 minutes. Cut greens into bite sized pieces. Remove greens from grill, remove head from baking sheet and slice thinly or place on a serving plate and serve.

title: Cassava Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 large shiitake mushrooms | 4 fresh rosemary sprigs | 4 ounces cassava ( pumpkin seeds ), skin on | 1/3 cup tomato puree | 16 3/4 fluid ounces warm tomato puree | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon capers, drained ( optional )
instructions: To make the pumpkin mushroom paste, place the peeled cassava, tomato puree and capers into a mortar and pestle or food processor and blend until well combined. Strain through a fine mesh sieve or sieve into a mixing bowl, stopping frequently to scrape down the sides, to remove any chunks of dough. Cut a few holes in the caps of the mushrooms. Carefully spoon a teaspoonful of the mushroom paste into each mushroom, then place them, stem side down, into a lightly greased 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Cover, and cook until the mushrooms are tender, about 15 minutes. Turn the mushrooms, and cook 5 minutes more. Remove from heat, cut in half, and serve as optional side for a vegetable dish.

Random Ingredients: sea bream,beef,pie shell,wine vinegar,tart apple,bamboo shoot,shortening
title: Tart and Apple Crusted Baked Sea Bream
ingredients: 1/2 lb sea bream | 1 tart apple, peeled, cored, sliced | 1 teaspoon shortening | 1 teaspoon apple wine vinegar | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 cup drained canned sliced canned apple ( for a sweet-sour dish ) | 3 unbaked pie shells
instructions: Cut sea bream into 1 inch squares and set aside. Place shredded apple into a medium bowl, reserving any juices. Cut remaining apple into thin slivers and stir into the apples, but do not stir in the butter. Meanwhile, arrange bamboo slivers in a lattice top pie plate, overlapping them slightly. Spoon 1/2 the apple and butter mixture into each crust, making a total of 1 1/2 layers. Spoon remaining apple and butter mixture evenly overtop of the top of the crumbs. Cover with foil or plastic wrap and refrigerate until the fish is cooked. Preheat oven to 450°f bake the sea bream on a large rimmed baking sheet for 10 minutes. Decrease heat to 400°f bake for 8 minutes longer, until fish is well browned and crust is deep golden brown. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,swiss cheese,pecan,brown rice,white chocolate,lite olive oil,pecorino cheese
title: Brown Rice With Swiss Cheese and Pecans
ingredients: 3 cups cooked brown rice | 12 ounces swiss cheese | 1/3 cup lite olive oil | 8 ounces white chocolate, melted ( i prefer semi sweet ) | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted and chopped | 1/4 cup fresh italian dressing | 1 tablespoon chopped pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a bowl, stir together the cheese, olive oil and melted white chocolate. Stir in the cheese mixture. Add in the pecans and italian dressing to the brown rice mixture. Spread in a 10x15, 1 1/2x1 inch jelly roll pan. Bake for 25 minutes or until the middle is set. Allow to cool. Sprinkle with pecorino or shaved parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Fondue (For Griddle Frying )
ingredients: 1 box corn muffin mix | 1/2 cup sour cream ( optional ) | 4 large egg whites | 2 tablespoons kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Prepare a large baking sheet by spraying with cooking spray. Mix the breading and sour cream until well combined. Add 3 eggs to the breading mixture. Add half of the kosher salt to the remaining salt and mix well. You may need to add more or less salt to get the right consistency. Mix in another third of the salt in to the mixture. Fold the corn muffin mix into the egg whites. Heat the cast iron griddle and oil for high heat until quite hot, add 2 ladles full at a time onto the hot griddle. Do not overcrowd the griddle. Turn and continue until all of the dry breading has been used. Fondue is ready to brown on the inside but not falling apart. Cook until golden brown on the outside. You may need to flip them occasionally to prevent burning. Remove to a wire rack lined with wax paper.

Random Ingredients: white flour,garbanzo bean,wild rice,egg noodle,orange zest,sage
title: Welsh Noodle and Bean Bake for Sinterkla
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white flour | 7 ounces dried garbanzo beans | 6 ounces wild rice | 2 eggs | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Cook and drain farfalle noodles according to package directions. Remove skins from garbanzos beans.

title: Spicy Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 1 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup ice water | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 6 bamboo skewers
instructions: Mix artichoke hearts, apricot jam, ice cold water, and hot sauce in a blender until smooth, about 4 minutes.

title: Stewed Beef With Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 kg stewing beef | 1/2 - 1 kg veal | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cut meat into cubes removing fat that might be left after cooking. Add beef, chopped veal and dried chili. Put lid on pan and simmer very slowly about 2 hours. Can be eaten with boiled potatoes.

title: Tahini-Yogurt Sushi (Sushi)
ingredients: 2 cups tahini, sesame-seed blend | 4 cups light white miso ( or more if you like ) | 8 -10 nori ( dried seaweed )
instructions: Toast nori using a baking brush.. Preheat oven to 400°f mix all ingredients together. Spread mixture on sushi mat or lightly roll sushi into a ball. Spread 2 - 3 tablespoons of sushi evenly on the nori. Roll sushi into a tight roll. If you feel a little messy, roll it over to make a tight roll. Slice sushi into 4 to 8 slices, depending on your desire of thickness and thickness desired. Serve immediately.

title: Raspberry Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup raspberries or 1 cup strawberries, cleaned, sliced | 1/2 cup unsweetened soymilk | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 cup brown rice | 1 tablespoon amaretto ( optional ) | vanilla ice cream | 1/2 cup lingonberry sauce ( or jelly )
instructions: Combine berries and soymilk and chill for about an hour. Sift flour and rice together. Mixture should resemble coarse crumbs. Place rattle and amaretto in a small pot on low, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon to avoid any clumps. When mixture becomes dry and becomes slightly thick, add berries, if using.

title: Crunchy Pouches on the Barbie
ingredients: 20 -25 lettuce | 12 -15 cherry tomatoes | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 cup greek salad dressing | 1 tablespoon honey | 0.5 packet plain doritos | 3 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Wash, pat dry, cut top off each cherry then arrange on top of a lettuce leaf. Wash the jar from the shrimp/doritos and place on top of the lettuce. Stir the honey all over the salad making sure everything gets coated. Next, sprinkle the catsup over the cherries. Put small amount of the crushed doritos in, shake around the bottom of the jar. Pour catsup over the cherry tomatoes. You could also use honey and catsup instead if you don't have the desired results. If using honey instead of catsup, just put it in a small, shallow bowl or bowl. Sprinkle with the sugar. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,pinto bean,sage leaf,apple cider,chili oil,plum tomato
title: Auberge Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 cups pinto beans, washed and picked over | 1 apple cider | 6 plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 cup peanut butter ( full fat preferred ) | 1 tablespoon of fresh sage leaves, finely chopped ( or 2 tsp crumbled dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( or other vegetable oil )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f/150c/gas put the beans in a large bowl, pour over enough cold water to come halfway up the beans and allow to soak overnight. If you have a large roasting tin, put a couple of ovenproof ramekins or cake tins on your tray and add the beans. Pour the cider into the tin and add a little water to come half way up the sides of the ramekins. Turn the heat on to medium and stir in the tomatoes, peanut butter, sage and chili and oil. If you need to, put the beans into an ovenproof dish and fill with plenty of boiling water. When the water starts to boil, stir the beans to dislodge any bits of food that may have stuck to the sides. The liquid will gradually bubble up. Bake, covered, for 25 mins until beans are tender and the liquid has reduced and absorbed.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,marinara sauce,chili garlic sauce,ice water,colby monterey jack cheese,pecorino romano cheese,baking soda
title: Caesar-Style Grilled Cheese on a Stick
ingredients: 12 -14 wooden sticks ( like tennis picks ) | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese ( about 1/2 lb. ) | 1 cup dry-roasted pecorino romano cheese or 1 cup asiago cheese, and or 1 cup asiago, grated ( about 1/4 lb. ) | 1 1/4 cups bottled chili-garlic sauce, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/garlic-chili-garlic-sauce-39217 '' > garlic sauce < /a > | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1 cup bottled marinara sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda or 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | ice water, as needed
instructions: Cut the sticks in half lengthwise. Soak the sticks in water in a bowl, cover and refrigerate for about 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Meanwhile, preheat the grill for high heat. If you have an outdoor grill, make sure to wear nonstick aluminum foil in place of the wood sticks when grilling. Combine cheeses, raisins, and sauce in a large bowl. Dip sticks, one at a time, into the cheese mixture, coating both sides of each. Lightly oil grate. Place kebobs on hot grill, close lid, and grill for 3 minutes on each side. Serve hot with warm marinara, garlic or chili garlic sauce.

Random Ingredients: miso,pineapple,yellow squash,zucchini,kaffir lime leaf,pecorino romano cheese,plain flour,thyme sprig
title: Pasta Primavera (Zucchini Chips, Pasta Primavera)
ingredients: 4 zucchini, halved lengthways and cut crossways into 2. 5 cm thick slices | 1 yellow squash, halved lengthways and cut crossways into 2. 5 cm thick slices | 4 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 4 fresh thyme sprigs | plain flour | 2 teaspoons miso | 1/3 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 600 g dried prawns or 600 g red snapper fillets, roughly chopped
instructions: Set the oven to 200c/180c fan/gas for the chips, put the zucchini, yellow squash, kaffir lime leaves, thyme sprigs and cheese in a baking dish. To make the primavera,. ingredients: 8 cups cooked pinto beans, undrained | freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix the pinto beans, black pepper, and salt in a blender. Process until smooth, about 30 seconds. Serve immediately.

title: Indian Beef and Tomatoes With Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces tilapia fillets | 14 ounces can of heirloom tomatoes | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons red wine | 14 ounces can tomato sauce with herbs | 2 red heirloom tomatoes | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Drain the tomatoes, and dice the flesh into small chunks. Dice the tomatoes into small pieces, add, stir in the red wine, tomato sauce, and marjoram. Heat in a large frying pan. title: Bratwurst Salad in Yogurt
ingredients: 5 fresh bratwursts or 3 lb other bratwurst, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 3 cups crumbled feta | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | fruit ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine bratwurst, feta, yogurt, pesto, vinegar and seasoned salt. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight to marinate. Add fruit to salad.

title: Cheese Noodle Pizza
ingredients: 24 ounces refrigerated crust ready pizza crust | 1 egg noodles | 1 can pizza sauce | 2 cups grated american cheese or 2 cups velveeta cheese | 3 eggs | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup italian-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together pizza crust dough and egg noodles. Reserve 4 cups. Spread remainder on pizza crust dough. Pour pizza sauce over noodles. In a medium bowl, stir together grated cheese with 2 beaten eggs and chopped pecans, making sure to mix well. Spread on top of sauce. Top with stewed tomato slices. Bake in a medium baking dish at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes, or until topping is golden brown. Serve hot, warm or room temperature.

title: Pasta Fritta (Spanish Macaroni Salad)
ingredients: 8 ounces shell pasta, cooked | 1 egg white | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Preheat a broiler. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray. Mix cooked pasta, egg white, sherry, and 1 tablespoon of water in a bowl.

title: Chocolate Tortellini
ingredients: 1 container soft cheese tortellini | 1/4 cup dried mint leaves | 2 ounces dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Cook tortellini according to pkg. Directions. Drain. Cool tortellini in colander. Place tortellini in food processor with mint and chocolate. Pulse until mixture is smooth. Tear into chunks and toss with reserved mint leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken Wings
ingredients: 6 large chicken wings | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 12 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Sprinkle the chicken wings with mace and arrange them on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until well browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Simmered Curried Chard, Beans, and Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: 1 large onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon curry | 1 1/2 cups raw quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 cup light sour cream | 1 can pinto beans ( pinto preferred, rinsed and drained ) | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon stevia ( optional )
instructions: Saute onion with curry until onion is transparent, add water if mixture is too dry. Add quinoa and sour cream. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer until most of the water has been absorbed. Simmer 2 minutes. Add beans, and allow to partially thaw, then add cheese. Cook until cheese has melted and mixture is warmed to your taste. Remove from heat. Spoon onto serving platter.

title: Tamarari Zucchini (Zucchini-Stuffed With Saffron)
ingredients: 3 zucchini | 1 package saffron threads | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | garam masala
instructions: Wash, stem and trim zucchini ends.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,pecan,chunky salsa,amaretto liqueur,leek,spice,ginger garlic paste
title: Ginger, Amaretto and Leek Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 500 g mixed sprouts | 1 leek ( white part only ) | 35 g of ginger-garlic paste ( or a mix of the two and a half ) | 45 g amaretto liqueur | 5 g chunky salsa | 1/3 cup pecans ( dry roasted or chopped ) | any spice ( to season )
instructions: Slice leek in thin rings, remove outer layers and set aside. Slice leek in thin strips. Wash sprouts, drain and dry with paper towel. Cut in half. Bring 2 litres of water to a rolling boil in a large saucepan and add sprouts. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and dry. Place leek in a large bowl and add ginger garlic paste, amaretto, chunky salsa and pecans. Mix well and season with salt and pepper. Combine thoroughly then pour over the salad and mix well to combine. Serve at once.

title: Bengali Banana
ingredients: 3 large bananas | 6 cups beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon cardamom powder | 1/4 cup oil
instructions: Peel bananas and cut into chunks. Boil in water for 45 - 50 minutes. Drain and keep aside. Heat oil in a large skillet or wok. Add cardamom. Add bananas.

title: Duck Legs With Mango and Mango
ingredients: 2 teaspoons salt | 2 lbs duck legs ( skin on legs and thighs ) | 1/2 mango, peeled, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup sliced duck fat | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Rub fish with salt and place on a rimmed baking sheet and roast in 425 degree oven for 12 minutes. Turn and roast for 12 minutes. Remove from grill and set aside. Bake duck for 25 minutes. Spread mango on the duck and bake for 12 minutes. Turn and bake for another 12 minutes. Top with 2 tablespoons duck fat and then lime wedges. Can also use duck fat to cook over the duck.

title: Creamy Dijon Mustard Dressing for Fish and Seafood
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup ( 10 1/3 oz. can ) or ( 12 3/8 ounce ) can cream of mushroom soup ( 10 1/3 oz.  can ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry dijon mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well to blend. Place on desired amount of cooked fish pieces/mussels etc and cook as desired before serving.

title: Fruit with a Mango Crackling
ingredients: 1 banana, sliced | 1 mango, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Rinse and core the mango, then slice it into cubes about 4 cubes. Place the cubed mango around the inside of a roasting dish with slices of banana and a muddler. Pour 1 cup water into a bowl to use as a slumet for the stuffing. Insert a sliver of mango into each mango cube. Bake in the oven until the tops are a golden brown, 30 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,onion white,lemon zest,green chili pepper
title: Onion Jam Focaccia (Pinchos Empanadas)
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely diced onion white | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 large chopped green chili pepper ( i use jalapeno ) | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest
instructions: Prepare a skillet by lightly browning the onion white in the hot pan. In a large bowl add the flour, green chile, lemon zest. Add onion white, then mix well. Turn heat to med low heat and gradually stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough. Form the dough into a sausage shape, and then place on a floured surface and knead gently for a few minutes until dough starts to come together. Shape dough into a round ball and place on a greased baking sheet. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut dough in half and set aside. Using fingers flatten each half, creating a 2 inch deep indentation in center of each half. Fill indentation each with about 1 tablespoon of the onion jam. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, or until edges are golden. Let cool 1 - 2 minutes before transferring to a plate and sprinkling tops with additional chopped onion and pepper. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Lime Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks | 4 ounces boxes uncooked dry large pasta shells ( i prefer medium ) | 1 cup fresh broccoli | 4 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 4 teaspoons fresh lime wedges ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 2 -8 large baguette, cut into bite-sized pieces ( toasted and buttered )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook the pasta according to package directions. While the pasta is cooking, cut the chicken into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Place in a small, non reactive baking dish. Place the corn on the cob in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the dark soy sauce and vinegar. Stir in the white vinegar until the sauce is completely emulsified. Store in the refrigerator and stir in the teriyaki sauce until used.

title: Mexican Ziti with Corn and Quinoa
ingredients: 180 g quinoa | 180 g ziti pasta | 2 corn on the cob | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Meanwhile, heat a frying pan. Add the quinoa and ziti. Cook for 2 mins under the grill, until they start to get soft and slightly coloured. Take the quinoa from the pan, drain any excess water, add the quinoa, corn, bicarbonate of soda and seasoning. Return to the pan and stir through until the ingredients are combined. Season if necessary.

Random Ingredients: currant,leg lamb,nutmeg,water chestnut,double cream,curd cottage cheese,rotel tomato
title: Jamaican Curried Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg leg of lamb, cut into 2cm cubes | 3/4 cup currants | 1 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 150 g small curd cottage cheese | 1 can stewed rotel tomatoes | 125 ml double cream | 3/4 cup water chestnut pulp or 3/4 cup frozen small tin of diced water
instructions: Spray large deep non stick pan with a low layer of cooking spray. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper, place in pan & brown all over in batches, then transfer to a bowl. Stir in currants nutmeg & cook over medium heat until currants melt, adding a little water if needed. Mix in cottage cheese & rotel tomatoes, stirring until combined. Place 1 cup of the meat & currant mixture in a casserole dish. Spoon over the cream mix. Spoon remaining currant mixture over top & sprinkle with pepper. Sprinkle water chestnuts. Bake in moderate oven 30 - 40 minutes until browned & bubbly.

title: Saffron Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( already cooked ) | 1/2 cup lentils ( already cooked ) | 1/2 cup green cardamoms | 1 teaspoon saffron | 3/4 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 cup blanched almond, chopped | 1 -3 bagel | 2 sheets phyllo pastry ( to use )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cook the rice with lentils, cardamoms, saffron, anchovy paste and almonds. Put in oven for 10 minutes, turn oven off and leave for 10 minutes longer. Mix bread in with 1 cup of rice, bring to boil and then let soak for 10 minutes. Line pie pan with sheets of phyllo pastry, brushing each one with melted butter. Sprinkle some more sugar on the pastry and lay another sheet on top. Spoon more bread on this and sprinkle the rest of the bread on top. Cut bread into small squares. Pour the rice on top and bake for 20 minutes. Note, if you want to freeze the crust, make small triangles of pastry and put in freezer container. When ready to bake, take it out of the freezer and put on tray. When dinner time arrives, defrost and drain on a baking paper before continuing.

title: Quick and Easy Noodles (Zupa Koperkowa)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground white pepper, or to taste | 12 ounces fresh udon noodles, or more to taste | 3 cups cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1/4 pound cranberries, or to taste | 3 hard-boiled eggs, halved
instructions: Cook udon noodles with white pepper in a large pot of boiling water for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,wheat bread,white wine,nutmeg,red pepper flake,brown rice,garbanzo bean,vanilla ice cream
title: Spanish Rice and Chickpeas Au Gratin
ingredients: 1/2 loaf whole wheat bread, sliced into 4 equal pieces | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup manchego cheese, grated. | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat bread, sliced into 4 pieces | 1 liter vanilla ice cream, softened and lightly beaten | 1/4 cup white wine or 1/4 cup port wine | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon ground red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked brown rice or 2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Place the bread slices into a single layer in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Top bread with beans and cheese. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over the cheese. Bake for 50 - 55 minutes. Serve warm with your brown rice or brown rice.

title: Chicken Kara-Age
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, sliced paper thin | 3 turnips, peeled and sliced paper thin | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange chicken slices in a single layer onto the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle turnips over them. Drizzle sesame oil over the chicken. Bake in the preheated oven until the turnips are lightly colored, about 30 minutes.

title: Tarragon Green Cherry Tomatoes with Lettuce
ingredients: 4 large green cherry tomatoes | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Wash the tomatoes under cold water to remove the outer skins. Slice them horizontally and remove the seeds. Arrange the tomato slices on a baking sheet lined with foil. Broil in the preheated oven about 2 minutes, or until the tomatoes are lightly browned and tender. Remove from the oven and place the cherry tomatoes on each tomato slice. Wash the lettuce and separate into leaves. Place the slices on a salad plate or in a bag placed in the refrigerator for a few hours to allow the flavors to develop. Serve the cherry tomatoes, drizzled with a small amount of olive oil,.

title: Gravy Potato Salad
ingredients: 150 -300 g baby potatoes, peeled, boiled and cooled | 1 carrot, trimmed, cleaned, washed and diced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Allow to sit in refrigerator for at least one hour or overnight.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,spanish onion,mirin,sea salt pepper,harissa,oil
title: Aromatic Pickled Onions(North African)
ingredients: 1/2 cup of finely chopped spanish onions ( approximately ) | 1/4 cup of finely chopped harissa | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 4 tablespoons mirin | sea salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon oil ( extra virgin olive )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Taste and adjust sea and red chili if necessary. Chill for at least an hour before serving. Shake the pickling jar with cold water and pour the mix into the jar. Seal and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

title: Bean & Orange Salad With Wine
ingredients: 410 g black-eyed peas | 2 oranges | 400 g plain flour | 4 tablespoons red wine | 1 cup prepared mix
instructions: Wash, de stem and cut the olives. Peel, quarter and segment the oranges and set aside. Put the flour in a bowl, add the wine and mix till it's blended in with no lumps. Cut the mix into 4 portions and roll each into a ball. Flatten it with your hands and place on a greased tray. Cook for 20mins at 180c for a soft crust.

title: The Best BBQ Coconut Chutney Recipe -
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup coconut water | 1/2 habanero, minced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let stand one hour. Serve cold over bbq meats or poultry.

title: Canned Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar salsa ( medium or hot, to your taste ) | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar ( not cider vinegar ) or 1/2 cup white sugar ( not cider vinegar )
instructions: Combine the salsa, vinegar and sugar in a serving bowl.

title: Roast Figs With Spiced Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed ( trimmed from the beef s ) | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 medium dried figs | 1 medium bell pepper, cleaned, cleaned and cut into chunks | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f / 180°c. Spread the sugar on the beef strip, evenly. Sprinkle the beef with onion powder. Place the figs and bell pepper chunks in the base of a roasting tin and nestle the beef in amongst them. Drizzle the figs and bell pepper chunks with olive oil. Pour the chickpeas over. Cook uncovered for 1 hour. Remove the beef and vegetables from the oven, and cut into serving sized pieces. Serve the beef topped with plenty of beans and plenty of sauce.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,nonfat greek yogurt,beef hot dog,rice wine
title: Hot Dogs With Apple
ingredients: 1 lb hot dog ( i use pepperidge farm ) | 1 bag plain nonfat greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 1 medium fresh tart apple, peeled, cored & amp, sliced thin
instructions: Cut hot dog into 10 bite size pieces.

title: Homemade Lotus Seed Soup
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh lotus seeds | 1 liter chicken stock
instructions: Heat the chicken stock in a deep large pot, or a small pot big enough to give you plenty of room to place you whole seeds in. Add the seeds and bring to a boil. When the seeds start to color, decrease the heat to low and cook for about 8 minutes, or until the seeds are soft and dark brown in color.. Let the seeds cool before removing them from the heat. You can scrape some of the hulls off with a spoon, though i haven't tried to do this so far. Store the seeds in a jar with a tight fitting lid, and use them in place of the remaining seeds in any recipe calling for to use.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,sirloin,baking potato,rump roast,cornstarch,water chestnut,mozzarella cheese,lime juice
title: Santa Fe Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 10 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled but whole | 8 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1 cup canned sliced canned cornstarch
instructions: Place sirloin cutlets in a large pot and add enough water to cover the bottom by an inch or so. Add potatoes, and bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low and simmer for about 1 hour and 15 minutes to make a tender meat.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,pasta,cannellini bean,wonton wrapper,parsley,monterey jack pepper cheese,cherry
title: Pasta W-White Bean & Cherry Dumplings
ingredients: 1 package tri-colored corn flakes, crushed | 15 wonton wrappers | 3 bunches cherries | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 4 ounces pasta, cooked, drained and hot
instructions: Cook corn flakes and cherries in 2 cups boiling water until cherries are softened, about 10 minutes. Drain and rinse well. Drain juice from cherries in saucepan. Rinse corn flakes and cherry mixture. Stir corn flakes and mash until crumbly. Stir in bean and pepper. Place 1 heaping tablespoon of the crumb mixture in heaping tablespoons over the gum on each triangle. Roll up heaping tablespoons, sealing each with a tuck. Arrange on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 425 for 20 - 25 minutes until golden. Combine parmesan cheese and parsley. Sprinkle on dumplings. Serve with a salad.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,italian cheese,bailey irish cream,chili flake,vodka,water chestnut,green chili pepper,ladyfinger
title: Cheese-Stuffed Italian Cookies
ingredients: 8 ladyfingers, split | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, grated ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup italian cheese blend ( such as velveeta ) | 1/2 cup water chestnut, chopped | 12 -15 green chili peppers, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon vodka | 1/3 cup baileys irish cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f on cookie sheet with parchment paper lightly brush 1/8 cup of asiago cheese onto each split ladyfinger. Place 1/2 cup of the grated asiago in a small bowl, with 3 tablespoons of the velty cheese, the chopped water chestnuts and half of the chili. Roll the ladyfingers around the cheese and place seam side down on the sheet. Top with remaining tablespoon of cheese. Bake 15 - 20 minutes until golden.

title: Homemade Cranberry Cream
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cranberries, crushed | 1 cup bailey's irish cream
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kirby cucumber,malt vinegar,corn muffin mix,swiss cheese
title: Cheesy Cucumber & Swiss Muffins
ingredients: 15 ounces frozen corn muffin mix | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/2 medium swiss cheese, grated | 3 kirby cucumbers, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f spray 12 regular size muffin cups with cooking spray. Prepare corn muffin mix as package directs using vinegar and grated cheese, stirring to blend thoroughly after each addition. Spoon equal amounts of filling into prepared muffin cups, dividing evenly. Bake 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden and bubbly. Serve with a sprinkle of chopped sweet pickles, or sliced cucumber for garnish.

title: Champagne Cherry Soup
ingredients: 1 liter cherry, pitted ( or other clear cherry ) | 1 quart beef broth | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet marsala wine ( to taste )
instructions: Add cherries around soup bowl with broth to bowl. Add marsala to soup bowl. Chill for 1 - 2 hours.

title: Turnip and Beans
ingredients: 6 lbs pinto beans ( with or without shells ) | 1 lb turnip
instructions: Rinse, drain and reserve shells. Wash and de stem the turnips, cut off ends, cut into 1/2 inch chunks. Place all ingredients in a pan. Add water to cover. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,tomato puree,red chili pepper,brownie mix
title: Chilli and Yoghurt Crackers
ingredients: 300 g rye flour | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper | 1/3 cup brownie mix, snack size
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160c. Combine the rye flour, tomato puree and chili. Add the brownie mix until it resembles fine breadcrumbs. Stir until all the ingredients are combined. Spoon evenly into a large baking tray. Place in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and sticky, turning once.

Random Ingredients: extra beef,irish cream,baking soda,cayenne,hoisin sauce,malt vinegar,prawn,bacon
title: Scottish Prawns
ingredients: 3 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1/2 lb bacon or 1/2 lb thick sausage | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1 1/2 cups malt vinegar or 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 2 cups hoisin sauce, heated | 4 cups cooked prawns, shelled and cooked | 1 -2 cup whipped irish cream
instructions: Brown the beef in a deep frypan, breaking up any clumps. Drain, remove the excess fat and finely slice. Crumble into small pieces and fry the bacon in a separate pan until golden. Add the soda, cayenne and vinegar. Heat to boiling, stirring to dissolve the soda. Add the meat and prawns. Stir well. Reduce to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes until thick and sticky. Serve topped with the hot, warmed sauces. Dollop with whipped cream.

title: The World's Best Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg swede | 2 red enchilada sauces | 1 liter beef stock | 1 liter red wine
instructions: Wash and chop the swede. Place in a large saucepan and add enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer and cook until tender. Drain, add more water and cover. Continue cooking until tender. Drain off any remaining water, remove the pulp and seeds from the swede and cut into cubes. Heat the enchilada sauce in a pot, adding the beef stock. Stir in the onions and cook gently for 3 - 4 minutes. Add the red wine and stir again. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot over white or brown rice.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,orange bell pepper,green bean,yellow squash
title: Spicy Orange Vegetables
ingredients: 4 cloves kosher kosher green beans, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1-inch pieces | 4 medium oranges, peeled and cut crosswise into 1-inch-thick segments ( see note below ) | 2 tablespoons soy beans or 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 small yellow squash, scrubbed and sliced diagonally thin
instructions: In a bowl, toss the green beans with the oil. Add the orange segments and toss to coat, season with the soy bean mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,nonstick cooking spray,pearl barley,baking potato
title: Irish Potato & Rice
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1/3 cup pearl barley, and veg
instructions: Heat a pan. Coat the nonstick cooking spray in a skillet and drop the frozen potatoes into the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, over medium heat, until the potatoes become tender. Drain the potatoes and toss with the ketchup. Transfer the mixture to an oven proof dish. Bake at 400°f for about 45 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

title: Vegetable Phyllo Purses With Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 large ripe plum tomatoes, cored, seeded, diced | 1 cup coarsely chopped savory ( a spicy spicy herb or herbal, such as oregano, basil or marjoram, may be used ) | 1 cinnamon stick, finely diced ( or 1-2 drops cinnamon sugar ) | 1 vanilla bean, split | 1 teaspoon cinnamon ( or 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( or more, to taste ) | 8 -10 tablespoons rice flour ( may substitute all-purpose flour ) | 8 ounces coarsely chopped black olives ( optional ) | 16 ounces thinly sliced marshmallows, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, gently toss the diced tomatoes, savory, 1/2 the cinnamon stick and vanilla bean with the pepper, cayenne and rice flour. Set aside. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and put in the refridgerator. To serve, divide the vegetable mixture among 6 small haystack containers. Wrap each with a slice of the nut and marshmallows, if using.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,wheat tortilla,salt black pepper,green bell pepper,large shrimp,vegetable oil,sauce
title: Aunt Bert's Shrimp Quesadilla
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 green bell pepper, cut into strips | 1/2 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails left on | 1 teaspoon sauce, or to taste | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 whole wheat tortillas | 1/2 pound provolone cheese, sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the green pepper.

title: Easy Spinach Mustard Cake
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1 package dry baby spinach | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 cup shredded baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch cake pan. In a 1 quart bowl, mix together the cake mix, 1 cup of baby spinach and 2 tablespoons of dijon mustard until well blended. Fold in the 1 cup of baby spinach. Spread batter into the prepared cake pan. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of dijon mustard. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Allow to cool for 3 to 5 minutes before serving.

title: Low Fatohydrate Low-Carb Turkey With Chocolate
ingredients: 12 ounces fat free ground turkey breast | 1 cup nonfat yogurt | 1 pinch cayenne | 12 ounces farfalle pasta ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 semi-sweet chocolate wafers
instructions: Set oven rack to the middle of the oven. Heat a non stick skillet over medium heat. Spray with non stick cooking spray. Add turkey and cook, breaking up chunks of meat, until no longer pink, about 3 minutes. Drain any accumulated fat and stir in yogurt, cayenne and pasta. Stir to combine. Transfer to oven and bake until the pasta is done, about 22 - 18 minutes.

title: Ponzu and Thyme Fajitas
ingredients: 1 can ponzu sauce | 1 tablespoon dried thyme flakes, crushed | 8 flour tortillas | 3/4 cup cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, blend the ponzu sauce and thyme. Brush a large baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place 8 tortillas in the dish and brush with ponzu sauce. Sprinkle with cornmeal. Bake in preheated oven until browned and bubbly, about 25 minutes.

title: Warm Walnut Pudding
ingredients: 3 eggs, beaten | 1/3 cup walnut oil | 1 package white cake mix
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together eggs, sugar and vanilla, beat in walnut oil. In a separate bowl, mix together dry cake mix and dry ingredients. Spray a medium size saucepan, add oil and melt over medium heat. Pour blended cake batter into the saucepan and spread to evenly cover the bottom. Then bake at 350 f for 25 to 30 minutes, until cake tests done. Take out and let cool for about 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon grass,taco seasoning mix,italian seasoning,canola oil,marsala wine,filling,lettuce
title: Mardi Gras (Vine Leaves with Green Filling)

instructions:
Name:- ##
 Mardi Gras (Vine Leaves with Green Filling) 
 
## Ingredients ##
 Spoon out an assortment of filling into a lettuce leaf. Tear off a piece of lettuce or two and set aside. Place a small pat of lemon grass in the palm of one hand and use the other to flatten slightly. Use the palm of the other to crimp the edges of the leaf. Repeat until the filling is used up. Heat a large non stick frying pan over a medium heat. Place several sheets of lettuce or leaf paper towel on your work surface and place 2 tablespoons of filling in the centre of each roll. Fold the roll in half and press gently to seal in filling. Repeat with remaining rolls, placing any unused filling on the lettuce as you cook. Place rolls on a paper towel to dry slightly. Slice off the ends of the rolls and serve. Note, it is important to keep the rolls from drying out. When the rolls are dry, refrigerate them for a few hours or overnight.

title: Mock Pain Perdu
ingredients: fresh black treacle | 5 ounces pine nuts
instructions: Toast the pine nuts if preferred, but i don't recommend burning them as the treacle has a nasty flavour. Spread the treacle over the pine nuts and roll loosely, securing with toothpicks. Serve.

title: Perfect Beef Ribs
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 boneless pork rib
instructions: Place brisket on a baking sheet and place in freezer. Every 20 minutes or so place several slices of pork onto the baking sheet. Place one pound of beef brisket onto the pork, then one slice of pork. Brush some cooking liquid from the pan onto the slices of brisket and sprinkle with some salt.

title: Mashed Potato Gnocchi
ingredients: 5 cups boiled potatoes, sliced thin ( about 2 large potatoes ) | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1/3 cup of fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: Using a potato ricer or hand mixer, mash potatoes until very fine. Combine potatoes with beef broth. Add basil and mix well. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours and as long as the dough is still working its own long way. Remove dough from refrigerator 15 minutes before using. Divide and form into long, thin roll. Cut dough into pieces 1 1/2 wide by 2 wide, but approximately the same size and thickness as a golfball. Place gnocchi on plate and cover with damp towel for 10 - 15 minutes. Using a sharp paring knife that is not too hot to the touch, remove about 1/4 cup of gnocchi from the bowl. Dipping your index finger in boiling water briefly will form marks. Scoop a small handful of the potato mixture into your thumb and index finger, scoop off about 1/4 cup of potato mixture and then place it into the palm of your hand gently and press lightly until almost smooth. Add about 1/4 cup of gnocchi back to the gnocchi and mix until combined and it is incorporated. Repeat until all mixture is used up. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,crouton,cocoa,black pepper,ice water,spaghetti sauce,oyster sauce,lychee
title: Yummy Spicy Chicken With Lychees
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce ( i buy `` parcels '' made with pork and chicken, but make sure you use homemade sauce ) | 4 boneless chicken breast halves | salt and freshly ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 2 tablespoons ice water | 4 ounces fresh lychees | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | crouton ( optional )
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine spaghetti sauce, cooked chicken, salt, pepper and cocoa. Stir to coat the chicken, then allow to marinate for about 10 minute on warm. While the chicken marinates, cut the lychee into bite size pieces. In a skillet, heat water with oyster sauce over medium heat until the water starts to boil. Reduce heat to low and add lychee. Cook mixture for 10 to 15 minutes or until the dish has reduced and the chicken is cooked. Serve chicken on individual plates with croutons, if desired.

Random Ingredients: steak,white flour,chow mein noodle,red capsicum,bulgur,poblano pepper,meat
title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1 red capsicum, diced | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and diced | 1 cup finely chopped cooked meat or 1/2 cup cooked vegetables | 2 cups coarse bulgur, medium grain | 1 1/2 cups strong white rice or 1 1/2 cups brown rice, raw | 1/4 cup finely chopped dried chow mein noodles
instructions: Brown meat in frying pan and remove from pan. Saute capsicum in drippings. Stir in all other ingredients except chow mein noodles. Bring to boil and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Stir in noodles and serve.

title: Baked Potato & Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 medium baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1 eggplant, sliced into very thin slices | 12 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/3 cup dry marsala wine | 1/2 ounce fresh ground black peppercorn ( to taste ) | 1 packet dry dry rub seasoning, blend ( or 2 1/2 tablespoons curry powder )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with foil and spray generously with cooking spray. Cut the potatoes and eggplant into thin slices and place them on the baking sheet. Spread the veggies evenly over the potatoes and eggplant. Drain the chickpeas and add them to the veggies. Sprinkle the black peppercorns over all and toss lightly. Mix the dry rub with 1/2 inch of water to make a paste. Stir this paste well into the vegetables and chickpeas. Bake uncovered for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Chile and Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin or 1 lb top round beef | 4 large fresh serrano chilies or 4 small jalapeno chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh lemon zest | 1/2 cup water | 1 teaspoon finely chopped italian parsley | lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Trim beef of all visible fat. Cut into 3 x 1/2 inch pieces. Mix chiles, mirin and lemon zest in small bowl. Stir in water. Dip beef, one piece at a time, in chile mixture. Transfer to paper towel lined bowl and let drain 10 minutes. Rinse the beef dry with a paper towels. Heat a heavy nonstick skillet over high heat until very hot, then sear the beef quickly, about 2 minutes per side. Place on lettuce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,parmesan cheese,semolina,splenda granular,vinegar,cooking oil,caster sugar,vegetable
title: Dumplings (Pissaladiere)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons splenda granular or 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon splenda granular or 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 ounce semolina or 1 ounce oat, crushed | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese
