ingredients: 2 cups blackberries, fresh | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon anise extract | fresh mint leaves ( for garnishing ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the blackberries in a bowl and sprinkle on the cumin seeds. Allow to sit for about 30 minutes. Combine the coriander, cumin and extract in a small frying pan. Add the cayenne pepper to taste. Place the blackberries on a baking sheet and bake them until a little darker in color, about 6 - 8 minutes. Sprinkle the blackberries with mint leaves, if using.

title: Tandoori Kabab
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, cut in cubes | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | 6 tablespoons garam masala powder | 2 lbs chicken tenders
instructions: Combine the remaining ingredients and marinate the meat overnight. Drain it and thread it onto skewers. Grill it on a grill and enjoy.

title: Roasted Mexican Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 3 teaspoons chipotle chiles, minced ( or 2 tsp. fresh ground )
instructions: Slice a cross in top of tomato. Place upside down on a baking sheet, brush tomatoes with oyster sauce, and sprinkle with crushed fresh chilies. Put under a preheated broiler for 5 minutes. Turn and brush tomato with additional oyster sauce.

Random Ingredients: margarine,peanut butter,cider vinegar,pear,maraschino cherry,shiitake mushroom,black olive,yellow onion
title: Pear and Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 pear, cored and chopped | 1 yellow onion, thinly sliced | 8 dried shiitake mushrooms, halved | 1 1/2 cups sliced roasted peanuts | 1 can sliced black olives | 1 1/2 cups peanut butter | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/3 cup chopped maraschino cherry, or to taste ( optional ) | 1 pinch salt, or to taste
instructions: Toss together the pear and onion with the shiitake mushrooms, peanuts, olives, 2 tablespoons peanut butter, cider vinegar, and cherries. Cover, and chill 5 minutes, to blend flavors. Chill 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Filled Cheese Raviolis
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 cup fives'cheese, grated | 1 hard-cooked egg, sliced | 2 tablespoons anchovies, drained and chopped coarsely | 1/2 cup cooked farro | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | all-purpose flour
instructions: In small bowl, combine onion powder and 2 tablespoons of the grated cheese. Place farro in separate bowl. Drain and chop egg coarsely. Mold cheese mixture into center of the farro. Sprinkle anchovies over farro and egg. Roll up the farro and place on dull, well greased cookie sheets. Top each roll with remaining cheese mixture. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top. Cut small slits in the top with a knife. Bake at 475 degrees for about 15 minutes or until cheese turns golden. Let cool for about 15 minutes. Remove from cookies sheets, cool and roll in flour.

title: Sardine Onions
ingredients: 4 cans anchovies packed in oil | 1 can sardines, drained and rinsed
instructions: Slice anchovies and toss with sardines to coat. Serve at room temperature. You can also roll each sardine into a ball by rolling on a wooden roller or rolling pin. Eat with warm pita bread.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,red food coloring,chocolate syrup,green cardamom pod,snow pea,brown sugar,garlic clove
title: Linda's Spicy Sweet Potato Veggies
ingredients: 3 large green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 3 teaspoons vegetable oil or 3 teaspoons butter | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 -2 red foods coloring ( optional, such as blueberry or purple food coloring ) | 2 cups chopped mixed vegetables, such as broccoli florets, carrots, cauliflower, baby corn etc ( all of the above vegetables can be mixed ) | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped assorted raw vegetables such as red bell peppers or 1 1/2 cups mixed green vegetables ( any of the above above vegetables can be mixed ) | 2/3 cup brown sugar, packed
instructions: Heat oil or butter in a large saucepan over medium heat and cook garlic until tender and fragrant, approximately 1 minute. Remove garlic and discard. Add chile to skillet. Cook about 1 minute until fragrant. Add vegetables and stir. Continue to stir until crisp tender. Reduce heat to medium. Stir until all vegetables are coated with sauce. Add sugar and cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly and thick, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: european cucumber,yellow pepper,plain yogurt,green bean,shiitake mushroom,red pepper,double cream,serrano pepper
title: Cucumber-Shiitake Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 12 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup chopped seeded yellow sweet pepper ( i usually leave the seeds in if you wish ) | 8 medium green beans, trimmed and cut into 3-inch pieces | 1/2 cup thinly sliced red pepper | 1/2 cup halved seeded european cucumber ( or other seedless japanese cucumber ) | extra light cream, for garnish ( optional ) or low-fat yogurt ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine yogurt and serrano. Marinate mushrooms in yogurt mixture 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Place 1st 8 ingredients in large pot and stir gently to mix. Cover and simmer on low 3 hours. Stir in sour cream and serve. Garnish with sour cream/yogurt if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Chili Rice
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups basmati rice | 1 sweet potato, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Add the sweet potato and cook for 10 mins or until tender. Drain, cool a little. Place the rice, sweet potato, chili sauce and lime zest in a pan. Cover and stir over a low heat for 10 mins, stirring gently and continuously, until the rice is tender. Serve straight away, or cool and garnish with your choice of garnishes. You could serve with coriander or fresh tomato.

title: Roasted Bell Pepper - 4-Qt. Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 6 large yellow bell peppers ( about 1 1/4 lbs ) | 1 can pineapple juice
instructions: Trim the stem ends from the peppers, if necessary, and place the peppers, with the ends in the pressure cooker. Add the can of pineapple juice and cook on high until it starts to boil. Turn down the heat, close the cover and partially cover the cooker. Allow to cook at high pressure for 2 minutes without removing the lid. Remove from the heat. After 2 minutes remove 2 cups of the liquid and discard before opening the lid. Carefully remove the peppers from the cooker and set aside with the cooking liquid.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,green chili pepper,rice,peach,black cardamom pod,fontina cheese,chunky peanut butter,kale
title: Peanut Butter Beef With Kale
ingredients: 3/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 2 1/2 lbs filet of beef, trimmed of fat, sliced across into thin strips | 1 cup fresh spinach or 1 cup kale, chopped | 1 1/2 cups minute rice, uncooked | 1 green chili pepper, minced | 1 black cardamom pod, cracked | freshly grated fontina cheese or mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup drained sliced peach
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, melt peanut butter over medium low heat. When it stops foaming, add beef, season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, just until beef begins to brown, about 2 minutes. Stir in spinach, rice and chile. Transfer to a 1 - 2 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low heat setting until ready to serve, about 6 hours. Discard chile. Transfer beef and rice mixture to a serving plate. Sprinkle each serving with fontina or mozzarella cheese. Top with peach slices and serve with peaches.

title: Beef Tenderloin Steak With Chili Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tenderloin beef | 3/4 cup canned low sodium beef broth or 3/4 cup reduced-sodium beef broth | 2 tablespoons chopped toasted walnuts ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Place beef tenderloin steaks in a large, shallow dish and pour broth over. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours, turning occasionally. Strain broth through cheesecloth lined a fine mesh sieve and discard solids. Remove tenderloins from fish pan and pat them dry. Combine chile peppers and walnuts. Brush chile pepper mixture over beef. Grill 1 minute on the highest heat, then transfer to a platter and sprinkle with chili pepper flakes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,kosher salt,egg,sea salt black pepper,cayenne
title: Breaded Eggs With Sea Salt
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 pinch sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs
instructions: Put eggs into a large, sturdy, heavy skillet over medium low heat. Stir, and season with sea salt, white pepper, and cayenne. Cover, and set the skillet over low heat for about 30 minutes. After 15 minutes, reduce the temperature to low and continue to cook the eggs with a spatula, stirring occasionally until they've begun to set, 8 to 12 minutes more. The eggs should have a little crackly yolk on top and a little bit of firmness on the bottom.

Random Ingredients: masala,mozzarella cheese,cornstarch,chow mein noodle,velveeta cheese,golden syrup,orange extract
title: Chinese Cheesy Chow Mein Casserole
ingredients: 1 package chow mein noodles | 1 package cubed velveeta cheese | 2 containers mozzarella cheese | 2 cans chow mein noodles | 3 tablespoons masala | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 teaspoons orange extract | golden syrup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 heat and drain mein noodles. In medium bowl mix dry noodles with cheese, sauce, cornstarch and extract. Arrange in 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Bake 45 minutes. Remove from oven. Top with cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted. Remove from oven and top with noodles. Sprinkle with extra golden syrup if desired.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,thai chili sauce,focaccia bread,nutritional yeast
title: St. Brenden's Vegan French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf focaccia bread or 1 loaf sandwich bread | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon hot chili paste ( optional, i use more in this recipe ) | 1 -2 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce, if you like it hot
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Slice the loaf of bread lengthwise into eight pieces. Cut a slice of bread in half and place bread slices on a cookie sheet. In a small bowl, mix chili paste and soy sauce. Brush the bread with the soy sauce mixture and let set a little. Spread the remaining soy sauce mixture on one side and the chili paste/soy sauce mixture evenly over the bread. Sprinkle bread slices with sugar or nutritional yeast. Bake for about 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Slice and serve warm.

title: Swiss Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon filling ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together cheese, ketchup, cocoa powder and the filling.

title: Tasty Raspberry Risotto
ingredients: 6 cups plain yogurt | 1 bunch radish, chopped | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 9 ounces arborio rice | 1 lb frozen blueberries | 1 bottle chunky salsa
instructions: Mix together yogurt, radishes, curry powder, worcestershire sauce, rice, berries, and salsa to taste. Chill in the freezer. Before serving, break up the frozen blueberries.

title: Beef Pasta Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb steak, 1 1/4-inch thick | 1/3 lb radiatore pasta, 1 1/2 minutes in each side | 8 ounces of deli-style deli parmesan steak, 1 1/2 x 1/4-inch strips | 4 kaiser rolls
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut the steak into thin slices. Place in a large skillet over high heat and cook until it is partially cooked, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in radiatore until it is slightly wilted. Divide pasta between the two rolls. Top with the steak mixture. Slice each roll into 4 slices, 6 to 8 thin.

title: Welsh Scones
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 - 1 cup unsweetened demerara sugar | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | cooking wine ( optional )
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter. Add the turmeric and mix well. Add the flour gradually, mixing well with the dry ingredients until the dough comes together to form a dough. If dough has a wet consistency, mix in a little cooking wine. On a lightly floured surface, knead the dough until smooth, about 4 minutes. Lightly flour a baking sheet. Cut dough into 2 equal portions. Roll one portion of dough to fit the bottom and sides of a well buttered, floured, drinking glass, 9 1/2 or 10 inch gratin dish, or use a 2 1/2 pint sized pottery dish 9 1/2 to 8 1/2 inches high in diameter. If the pastry does not flake off as smoothly as possible, roll the dough into a cylinder about 1/4 inch thick and about 1/2 inch in diameter. Use your rolling pin to flatten the top of the dough slightly. Repeat with the other half of the dough. If you have no pastry scone, preheat your oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Cut the scone into 12 equal pieces. Using a pizza cutter, cut circles around the baking sheet as necessary. Working with 1 piece at a time, prick one or two holes of each dough circle with a fork and place on the prepared baking sheet. Brush the top of each scone with water and sprinkle with water. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes, until dough is lightly browned and bubbly around the edges.. For a change, add a 1/2 cup of water to the baking sheets after they have baked. If you have a scone with a thin pointed top, add 1 tbls. Olive oil, but be careful of the fumes. Remove from the oven and carefully slide scone directly onto the heated baking sheet. Cool the scone for 2 minutes. If the scone is completely dry, add 1/4 cup of cooking wine and cook another minute or two. Sprinkle with black pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,red chile pepper,bibb lettuce,brown rice,soya sauce,bread flour,cream corn
title: Quick and Easy Rice and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup cream-style corn, steamed and drained | 1/2 cup bread flour | 1 teaspoon dried red chile pepper | 1/3 cup light soya sauce | 1/4 cup light soya sauce | 3 leaves bibb lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place brown rice, beans, corn, bread flour, chili peppers, and soya sauce in a food processor. Puree into a smooth paste. Wash bibb lettuce and divide among 4 serving plates.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,lemon wedge,double cream,white bread,philadelphia santa fe,mint leaf,cannellini bean,sauce
title: Antipasto
ingredients: 8 slices white bread ( thin slices ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 8 -10 drops hot sauce | 1/2 cup double cream | 1/4 cup shredded unsalted butter or 1/4 cup margarine | 1 pinch of freshly grated nutmeg | 1/4 cup loosely packed fresh mint leaves | lemon wedge
instructions: Place bread slices on baking sheet. Bake at 350f degrees, turning once, until lightly browned, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a dish to cool. Add beans, hot sauce and cream to bread slices in dish.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,oyster sauce,white fish fillet,egg wrap,bread,wonton wrapper
title: Won and Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup white fish fillet, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 1/2 fresh rosemary sprig for garnish | 3 ounces wonton wrappers | salt and pepper to taste | 1 beaten egg roll wrap | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place fish chunks, rosemary, and wonton wrappers in a bowl.

title: Creamy Spaghetti with Orange Béchamel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce ( or spaghetti sauce with meat ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon gingerroot ( freshly grated ) | 1/2 teaspoon maraschino cherry ( finely chopped ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried cherries, soaked in hot water | 2 tablespoons scallions ( scallions cut diagonally, green parts only ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 3/4 cup celery root | 2 tablespoons minced scallions ( green part )
instructions: Mix the flour and 2 cups water in a sauce pan over a medium flame.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,russet potato,farfalle pasta,bean sprout,cocoa powder,phyllo pastry,mirin
title: Chinese Ghoulash
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/3 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 pound whole-grain russet potatoes, thinly sliced | 1 pound bean sprouts | 1 pound mixed greens and romaine lettuce | 3 tablespoons shaved dark-colored cocoa powder, or as needed
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Unroll the phyllo dough, keeping it in the wrappers. Brush the phyllo sheets with mirin and place 1 sheet on the prepared baking sheet, brush with mirin, and sprinkle 1/2 cup cocoa powder on top. Layer the 2 sheets of phyllo into a 9x13 inch baking dish, brushing each sheet with enough lard or water as needed to dampen. Repeat layering with the remaining phyllo sheets and cocoa powder, finishing with the cabbage and sprouts. Place the layered goulash into the oven and broil until the goulash is beginning to crisp and beginning to brown on the edges, 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Hot Corn With Chillies
ingredients: 12 ounces red chili peppers, deseeded and cut into long thin strips | 4 ounces corn ( shelled, if previously frozen ) | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c/180c fan forced/350°f. Place red chillies and caspberries in a roasting tin. Toss to coat. Add sugar, vinegar and bring to boil. Put on the lid, put in oven and cook for 15 minutes.

title: White Bean Layered Salad
ingredients: 3 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 3 pears, seeded, rinsed and diced | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, combine white beans, pears, and ricotta cheese. Toss to mix well. Chill several hours until cold. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lavender blossom,apple cider vinegar,red onion,cornflour,green curry paste
title: Lavender Green Curry
ingredients: 1/2 red onion, finely diced | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1/3 cup cornflour | 1/8 teaspoon lavender blossoms
instructions: Sauté onion in a small amount of oil. Add curry paste and blend together. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until thick. Serve over jasmine rice.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Turkey and Raisins
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm chicken broth | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, minced | 1 cup canned diced turkey | 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 8 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Place the yeast, broth and lemongrass in large bowl of a bread machine and sprinkle with salt. Add turkey, tomatoes and bread and process on the bread cycle according to the manufacturers instructions. Use immediately or cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Serve slices of bread in a single layer on the baking sheet. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving.

title: Courgettes (Julia Child)
ingredients: 600 g spanish onions | 2 large courgettes, trimmed
instructions: Cut the ends off the courgettes and cut across to within two thirds of their base. Remove the pith from the onion with a teaspoon or knife, and cut each half into six wedges, removing any damaged ends. Heat the grill pan or char grill. Cook the onion wedges 2 minutes, remove and set aside. Arrange them on the hot grill and cook for 10 minutes, or until browned and tender. Turn the courgettes in order to crisp up a little. When all the courgettes have been grilled, cover with foil and keep hot. Transfer the vegetables to a large serving dish, sprinkle with the cooked onion wedges and serve immediately.

title: Creamed Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups can coconut milk | 2 cans cremini mushrooms, drained and finely chopped | 1 package buttermilk ( not skim )
instructions: Put the coconut milk and mushrooms in a large saucepan or pot. Add just enough buttermilk to measure about 4 cups. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat. Divide between 4 plates.

Random Ingredients: ham,pimiento,wheat pasta,yellow squash,rice vinegar,dark soy sauce,vanilla ice cream,poundcake
title: Sweet & Savory Chinese Rice Salad With Ham
ingredients: 1 lb fresh weight whole wheat pasta ( spaghetti or vermicelli ) | 2 large yellow squash, cut into fourths, then cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 lb ham | 1/2 cup crispy rice vinegar ( or substitute white wine vinegar ) | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup light soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ice cream | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Cook pasta according to package instructions. When pasta is al dente drain and run under cold water.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,pepper sauce,orange peel,active yeast,snow pea
title: Paleo Bread
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh pea | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/2 tablespoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, grated
instructions: In saucepan over medium low heat, stir together peas, sugar, soy sauce, salt, hot pepper sauce and orange peel. Cover and let stand 90 minutes. Stir occasionally. Cool to 110 degrees f.

title: Easy Beefy Corn on the Cob (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 3/4 lbs boneless beef chuck | 1 can creamed corn | 1 can frozen corn, thawed
instructions: Place beef into crock pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,cranberry sauce,cardamom,merlot,onion powder,head cabbage,grain mustard,chinese five spice powder
title: Buddha's Red Wine Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups merlot | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 medium head of cabbage ( finely shredded or shredded ) | 1/2 medium onion ( finely chopped ) | 3 tablespoons grain mustard | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons ground cayenne pepper or 2 tablespoons hot chinese five spice powder | 3 tablespoons instant minced onion powder | 1 jar cranberry sauce
instructions: In large stock pot, combine merlot, bouillon cube, cabbage, onions, mustard, cardamom, cayenne pepper, and five spice powder. Cook and simmer on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove lid, simmer for another 15 minutes. Add cranberry sauce, stir and heat through. I serve this with spaetzle, spaetzle or egg noodles.

title: Easy Black-Eyed Peas Vietnamese Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, washed and drained | 1 can black-eyed peas | 1 -2 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Drain black eyed peas and place in pan. Add fish sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes or until water absorbed. Serve hot with cua de vietnamese rice.

title: Cajun Okra and Barley Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 bag frozen okra | 1 can cannellini beans | 3/4 cup barley ( white or barley ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 3 -4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 8 cups cabbage, shredded | 3 cups half-and-half
instructions: Place okra, beans, barley, soup, worcestershire, and cabbage in crockpot. Turn crockpot on high and let it cook on high for 2 - 5 hours.

title: Tobiko
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 16 ladyfingers
instructions: Combine the oil and brush on both sides of the ladyfingers. Place under a preheated oven at 200 degrees fahrenheit 1 - 2 minutes or until light brown. Slide onto a paper towel lined cookie sheet.

Random Ingredients: turkey sausage,egg noodle,lamb chop,cream tartar,orange,monterey jack pepper cheese,honey,chinese cabbage
title: Asian Style Lamb Chops
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 2 large eggs | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 cup honey | 1 medium orange, peeled cut from zest and juiced | 8 leaves chinese cabbage, shredded | 4 ounces cooked egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Pound each chop until about 1/2 inch thick. Place 1 chop into the center of a lightly greased shallow baking dish. Top chops with pepper jack cheese, sour cream, and orange zest. Drizzle honey over top of each. Bake for 30 minutes or until meat is cooked and cheese is golden.

title: French Fennel and Watermelon Stew
ingredients: 1/2 watermelon, peeled and diced | 2 fennel bulbs, trimmed and sliced thinly | 3 cups prepared small shell macaroni | 2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 pizza crust, unbaked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the vegetables, macaroni, and bouillon. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Add watermelon to the stew and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes longer. Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with croutons and serve.

title: Stuff and Eat for a Potluck
ingredients: 1 package ground sirloin | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped | 2 small turnips, chopped | 7 large tart apples, diced | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, fresh or frozen blueberries, thawed | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium high heat with chopped peppers and turnip until no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Transfer beef to a bowl and set aside. Add the apple to the skillet and cook until the apple is softened, about 5 minutes longer. Stir in the blueberries, sage and red pepper to taste. Return beef to skillet, add any remaining fruit and mix gently. Serve warm. Variation to increase meat/cheese mixture, instead of dried sage use 1 tablespoon dried rubbed sage, stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cranberries with the dried fruit.

title: Grilled Mushrooms With Quark Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 6 medium button mushrooms | 24 pimento stuffed olives, sliced ( or pimientos ) | 1 1/2 cups quark | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted and roughly chopped
instructions: Wash mushrooms and snap off their stems. Slice off the dark green parts of the mushroom stems and thinly stem them. Cut each mushroom into 1/2 inch pieces. Toast the hazelnuts under broiler then place on a rack to cool. Mix the cheese with half of the dried herbs. Place the mushrooms on a hot griddle, cut side down, and cook them over medium heat until the underside is evenly browned. Turn them over and continue to cook to the desired doneness. Let cool slightly on the griddle then cut a slit down each stem. Spoon 1/3 of the cheese mixture inside each mushroom slice and wrap each mushroom around a cheese/heap bundle. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,lime juice,beef chuck,sponge cake,baking potato
title: Mama's Beef Stew
ingredients: 800 g beef chuck ( chuck steak ) | 50 g fresh lime juice | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 2 baking potatoes, peeled, cut in 4ths | 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Cut the meat into chunks and put in a saucepan with a lid. Add all the other ingredients and mix. Heat until the meat is almost cooked. Pour into a suitable container and cover with aluminium foil. Leave overnight to absorb flavours. Cook in the oven. Serve with boiled spaghetti noodles, cooked rice or potato sticks.

Random Ingredients: apple,bacon bit,flour tortilla,cinnamon sugar mixture,chipotle chile,sugar
title: Apple Chipotle Roll-Ups
ingredients: 9 six inch flour tortillas | 8 slices bacon bits | 1 1/2 - 2 cups apples, coarsely grated, can use apple chunks | cinnamon sugar mixture, package | sugar, package ( confectioners ) | chipotle chile
instructions: Cook bacon bits til crisp. Sprinkle nuts over bacon bits after frying. Set aside. Roll up each tortilla and place in a greased baking dish. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar on top. Prepare the filling by grating apples and adding the chipotle pepper and mix well. Spoon filling down centre of each roll and roll. Bake at 350ºf for 15 - 20 mins till bubbly.

title: Easy Cheeseburger Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger bun | 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon green creme de menthe | 1/3 cup buttermilk
instructions: Cut the tops off the hamburger buns and hollow out leaving just enough to make them open up. Put in a medium size fry pan, sprinkle with walnuts and creme de menthe. Add the 1 cup buttermilk and stir until all ingredients are mixed. Place on a grill. Grill for 8 - 10 mins or until hamburger is browned and serve. If it doesn't reach your desired level of browning, you may add a little water.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,garlic,pineapple chunk,bok choy,ancho chile powder,pineapple juice
title: Pineapple and Bok Choy Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh bok choy | 1/2 cup pineapple chunks | 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely chopped garlic | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 10 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Stir in bok choy, 1/2 cup of the pineapple chunks, chile powder, and garlic. Cook and stir until the bok choy is lightly wilted. Transfer the bok choy mixture to a mixing bowl. Stir pineapple juice into bok choy mixture. Lay one sheet of phyllo dough in the center of each of 4 dinner plates. Brush each sheet with an 11x7 inch nonstick cooking oil. Lay another sheet of phyllo dough in the center of each plate. Spread 1/3 cup of the bok choy mixture on top of phyllo dough. Place 2 sheets of phyllo dough vertically along the length of the bok choy mixture, overlapping by 1/2 inch.

title: Fried Brown Rice in a Pan
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice, uncooked | 1 1/4 cups white wine ( use a splash of white rum to make this ) | 1/2 cup low-fat mayonnaise | 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour
instructions: Cook the rice in 3 cups of lightly salted water until tender, about 18 - 24 minutes. Drain, and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, stir the sugar into the mayonnaise. Stir in the flour and rice until well combined. Spread the rice into an 8cm deep, greased, ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over the brown sugar. Bake at c for 30 - 35 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,canadian bacon,tomato paste,red potato,italian sausage,lemon juice zest,chipotle powder
title: Canned Sweet Potato and Canadian Bacon B.C. Barley #2
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 8 ounces tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 8 ounces canadian bacon, cut into 1/2 inch thick strips | 8 ounces red potatoes, cut into 1/2 by 1 inch slices
instructions: Brown sausage in large fry pan on medium heat until browned, drain. Add the cooked sausage and the barley to the sauce. Stir and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the lemon rind, juice and chipotle powder. Bring to a boil. Add the canadian bacon strips, return to a boil and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes.

title: Spinach & Hazelnut Souffle
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach | 1 cup cream-style cottage cheese | 3 egg yolks | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Toast hazelnuts to desired doneness in a large saute pan. Cool and then chop coarsely. Remove spinach, reserving about 2 tbs. Of the spinach water so that later is the souffle consistency. Place spinach and cream cheese in blender container and blend into a paste and set aside. Beat egg yolks with reserved spinach water until thick and creamy adding more yolk if necessary. Add hazelnuts and stir well. Pour egg mixture into spinach and hazelnut mixture and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Quick, Easy and Delicious Chicken Bouillon Soup
ingredients: 6 cups water | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and sliced | 1 1/2 cups orange juice, or as needed
instructions: Place the water, bouillon granules, bamboo shoots and orange juice into a large pot over medium low heat. Stir occasionally. Cover and cook 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, remove the lid and increase heat to medium high. Simmer until the soup is reduced to about 8 cups or more. Taste, and adjust seasoning.

title: Soy Sauce-Glazed Potatoes (Tonkatsu or Tonkatsu)
ingredients: 1/4 lb large potato | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Heat oven to 300°. Wash potatoes and prick with fork on one side. Place potatoes on parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Bake until tender and golden brown, about 45 min. Cut with paring knife in half and put in food processor bowl. Mince finely. Combine and stir with a fork or a potato masher until mixture thickens. Add remaining ingredients and serve warm or cold. Note,.

title: Summertime Refresher for Summertime
ingredients: 3 quarts small curd beans or 3 quarts any beans, cooked, cooled, and drained | 1 cucumber, peeled and quartered lengthwise, seeded if desired, and cut crosswise into thin slivers | 6 -7 ounces of your favorite swiss cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves ( i like oregano, basil, or oregano to this, but the recipe doesn't recognize it! the chef doesn't do that! -- or 6 -7 -7 ounces grated gruyere cheese ( can or bottle ) | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: In a large bowl mash or toss warm drained beans together with cucumber, cheese, salt, pepper and thyme. Add apple cider. Taste and adjust seasoning you don’t want it too sour. You can also add hot mustard to the beans if it needs it to be sweet enough.

title: Rice and Stuff With Sausage & Jicama Wafer [ Tao Hooze]
ingredients: 8 loaves cinnamon raisin bread ( i used ritz, but they were plenty in the tin ) | 6 ounces sausage, raw and sliced into 1/4-inch thick pieces | 1 tablespoon oatmeal | 1 tablespoon jicama, finely diced | 2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees, line 2 baking sheets/dishes with parchment paper. Slice bread about 1/4 thick.

Random Ingredients: cold water,bisquick,chili pepper flake,espresso coffee powder
title: Lighter and Tasty Espresso Ciabatta
ingredients: 2 cups bisquick | 2 cups cold water | 3 tablespoons instant espresso coffee powder | chili pepper flakes, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix the 1 cup of dough with the instant espresso powder. Slice the bread in about half inch slices. Spread the 1 cup of dough on a plate and spread with the coffee. Top with chili peppers and spread some more coffee on the bread. Roll the bread up into a ciabatta sandwich. Serve chilled.

title: Feta Patties (Crispy Dumplings)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups feta, crumbled | 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1/2 teaspoon salt | fish sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Form mixture into large, flattened patties and put on a lightly oiled cookie sheet on a lower shelf in a low oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,herbes de provence,hot sausage,mint leaf
title: Smoked Sausages With Herbs, Chile Peppers, & Mint
ingredients: 4 thick green chile peppers | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 4 tablespoons herbes de provence | 6 hot sausage rolls
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a large bowl, toss together the chilies with the mint leaves. Remove seeds and white membrane from the chilies, and slice off the green tops with a green grapefruit knife. Slice the tops and bottoms of the chilies. Place sausage pieces on a baking sheet, leaving enough space so the rolls cook evenly. Broil, turning frequently, until nicely browned, 3 - 5 minutes. Split the rolls open and fill with the chilies and mint leaves. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,puff pastry,onion powder,buckwheat flour
title: Onion Crust Beef Buns
ingredients: 1 unbaked puff pastry | 1 large sweet onion, sliced | 1/2 cup buckwheat flour | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f roll out puff pastry on a lightly floured surface. Line a 9x13 baking dish with a pastry lid. In a food processor, combine the onion and flour. Add sugar, onion powder and mix until well combined. Add any remaining flour/sugar mixture to the beef. Toss mixture and spread over the shortbread pastry lid. Cut a 1/2 in slit in the top and bake on a rack for 40 - 45 minutes, until pastry is golden in color.

title: Pear-Corn Snack
ingredients: 1 jar sweet corn, drained | pickled pears
instructions: Combine all ingredients and place on a small plastic wrap in fridge until required.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,crawfish,vegetable broth,knorr chicken bouillon,italian parsley,pork shoulder
title: Coconut Soup with Pork and Crawfish
ingredients: 1 coconut milk | 3 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 3 cups unsweetened coconut milk | 1 chicken bouillon | 1/2 lb fresh crawfish, shelled and cut into pieces | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: In a heavy saucepan over medium heat, combine coconut milk, vegetable broth, coconut milk, and bouillon. Bring to a simmer, uncovered, and cook until coconut milk is reduced to about 1 1/4 cups. Add crawfish and simmer until crawfish pieces are cooked and tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Orange Butterpuffs
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed if frozen | 1 egg yolk, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. On a lightly floured rolling pin roll out each pastry sheet to a 3x3 rectangle. Using a sharp knife, cut in half, creating two 9x9 inch strips. Cut each strip crosswise into 1/2 inch strips. Place one strip of pastry on the work surface, sprinkle with a pinch or two of salt, and fold over to enclose it. Press down and gently press edges together with fingers. Repeat with remaining strips and pastry. Brush or spray tops of rectangles with beaten egg and place on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly golden, about 10 minutes.

title: Tex-Mex Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/3 cup maple syrup or 1/3 cup tamari | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | lemon wedge
instructions: Cut lamb into 1 cubes. Coat with taco seasoning, mix well, add to greased shallow dish. In glass bowl, mix together the maple syrup, cumin, and lemon.

title: Lebanese Girlfinger Potatoes
ingredients: 6 large white potatoes | 36 ladyfingers
instructions: Wash potatoes and peel them. Cut the potato lengthwise in half, and make long crosswise slices on both sides. Lay one ladyfinger on a hot greased griddle or frying pan. Cover and cook for 1 minute or until golden brown.

title: Crock Pot Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces elbow macaroni, dry | 1 butternut squash | 8 ounces frozen puff pastry, thawed or ( 7 1/2 ounce ) package ready-made puff pastry | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Boil, then simmer squash for 20 minutes until starting to soften slightly. Drain and mash with a potato masher, a fork or a potato masher until smooth. Place cooked macaroni and mashed squash in a clean crock pot. Cut the puff pastry into 5 inch squares or circles and place a little of the warm squash mixture in the center. Roll the dough around the other ingredients until the dish is covered. Place on a tray lined with parchment paper or a non stick baking paper and cover on the top with a wet tea towel or a baking paper towel. Place in the oven and top with a lid. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes until pastry is browned.

title: Tangerines With Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs tangerines, peeled and cut crosswise into six pieces each | 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut crosswise into 12 pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with foil. Place potatoes in a large bowl of cold water, and cover. Leave to steam until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and pat dry with paper towels. Place half of the potatoes in the pan, and toss to coat. Cover, and bake 20 minutes until golden brown, turning once. Repeat with remaining potatoes, and transfer to a bowl of warm water. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until cool to the touch, about 3 hours. Discard skins from tangerines and place in a single layer on a large rimmed baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes, then flip, cover, and bake 5 minutes longer. Transfer to a platter, cover loosely with foil, and refrigerate until at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: butter lettuce,marshmallow,kaffir lime leaf,lemon juice zest,pineapple juice,tamale
title: Grilled Lemon Pineapple & Lime Tacos With Tamales
ingredients: 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter lettuce | 10 ounces tamales, cut into thin strips | 8 cups mini marshmallows or 8 cups mini chocolates, halved ( 2 1/4 cup ) | 4 kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced | pineapple juice, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl whisk the zest and juice then stir in the butter lettuce, tamales, marshmallows and lime leaves tossing well. Serve with pineapple rings and cherry tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,cream tartar,butternut pumpkin,peanut oil,cocoa,cardamom seed
title: Easy Roasted Pumpkin
ingredients: 5 butternut pumpkin, halved and staled | 1 -2 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 -3 whole cardamom seeds ( or 1/2 tablespoon ground cardamom ) | 1/2 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 tablespoon cream of tartar | 6 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 deg c or 300 deg c if your oven is very hot put all the seeds in a dry frying pan or roasting tin and fry on low heat, shaking the pan constantly, until golden brown. Tip into a bowl. Add the chili paste and mix well. Prick the flesh and sprinkle the pulp with the mixture. Drizzle over the cream and season well with salt. Roast the pumpkin halves for about 40 minutes or until cooked and soft. Leave to cool. Heat the oil and roast both the pumpkin halves in the pan for about 1 - 2 mins, turning them and poking them every so often while turning. When the pumpkin is cool, scrape the flesh away from the skin and blend it with the cardamom, chili paste, cocoa or whatever you like. If you really like spicy food, add a little bit of black pepper or a touch of turmeric. You may also roast in a moderate oven, like my note, for about 45 mins each or until cooked but not browned.. They are supposed to be soft but not mushy but a little bit mushy if they were too close, they might break up. I was also told that peoples personality can play with the spices as well, though this recipe is not a part of the recipe. I'd had difficulty finding any good pumpkin food from my local mexican restaurant.

Random Ingredients: white peppercorn,green bell pepper,farfalle pasta,cajun seasoning,squash,oregano,pepper
title: Neute's Farfalle with Squash and Hot Peppers
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta, uncooked | 1/2 cup minced yellow squash | 1/2 cup sliced green bell pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon white peppercorns, cracked | 2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In a skillet over medium high heat, saute green pepper and squash.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,beef chuck roast,tea,black pepper,cannellini bean
title: Quick Beef, Bean and Roast Sandwich
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup strong irish breakfast tea | black pepper | 4 slices rye bread
instructions: Brown roast on both sides in skillet. Remove roast to plate. Add beans to remaining skillet and heat until warmed. Remove roast and place on rye bread and pour beans into sandwich. Slice into 4 servings. Serves.

title: Steak Tenderloin for Two
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks ( approx 750g total weight ) | 4 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 200 -250 g tuna steaks
instructions: Place your tuna steaks and worcester sauce in the microwave proof container. Heat in microwave for 10 minutes. Allow to cool slightly. Slice your tuna steaks into two 4 5cm by 2cm thick slices. Place these slices in a roasting tray and place in the microwave. Cook for 1 minute. Turn the tuna over and cook for 3 - 4 minutes. This will make about 20 steaks. Remove tuna from microwave and serve with steamed carrot and fresh salad.

title: Chorizo & Radishes on a Bed of Rüüben
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 cups chorizo sausage, thinly sliced ( can use bacon, but the ham is traditional ) | 2 1/2 lbs assorted radishes, white and red, halved and sliced into 1-1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Spray an 8x8 square pan with the vegetable oil and set aside. Add chorizo and cook over medium heat for 10 - 12 minutes, stirring frequently, until the chorizo is lightly browned on the bottom and crispy on the top. Add the radish slices and cook for 2 - 3 minutes more, until they are just tender. Do not overcook, as the radish slices will be tough. Remove chorizo mixture from pan and let cool slightly, then slice into 1/2 inch strips. Serve with crackers or a dollop of yogurt for a nice breakfast or snack.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,artichoke heart,date,canola oil,mango chutney,quinoa,raspberry,poblano pepper
title: Azifa (Chili and Artichoke Salad)
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts ( drained ) | 1 cup chopped pitted dates | 2 raspberries | 2 poblano peppers ( seeded and thinly sliced ) | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 cup cooked quinoa
instructions: Arrange artichoke hearts, dates, raspberries, poblano peppers, and papillas together in a serving dish. Pour oil over salad and sprinkle with chutney and chili garlic sauce.

title: Roasted Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 3 plum tomatoes | 1/4 red pepper, halved and seeded | 3 tablespoons agave nectar | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground red pepper | 10 skewers
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut tomatoes in half, crosswise.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,tilapia fillet,ice,pepper flake,thyme sprig,gluten,kalamata olive,fish sauce
title: Gluten-Free Tilapia With Tomatoes & Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1 cup tomato juice ( from can ) | 1 tablespoon gluten, gluten-free seasoning ( such as bob's red mill ) | 1/4 cup gluten-free fish sauce | 1 tablespoon kalamata olive, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs ( or 1 t. dried ) | 2 -3 teaspoons crushed hot pepper flakes | 1 1/4 cups ice
instructions: In a medium serving bowl, combine tomato juice, fish sauce, olives, thyme, and hot pepper flakes. Cover and chill until needed. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Arrange the fish in a single layer in a shallow ovenproof glass or ceramic baking dish, pouring 1/2 cup tomato juice mixture over. Cover with foil and bake 45 - 50 minutes. Uncover dish and bake 5 - 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: arbol chile,black pepper,dark rum,vegetable oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,seasoning salt,chuck,vanilla extract
title: Grilled Chimichangas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck ( use what you like ) | 12 dried arbol chiles | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | 1 1/4 cups vegetable oil | parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Grill the chuck on medium high for about 1 - 2 minutes on each side, or until very well browned and nice and hot all the way through.

title: Mustard Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup dijon mustard
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour and mustard. Form the mixture into a ball, and knead to form a thick, smooth dough. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Roll the dough out on a floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness, and cut into 3 inch squares. Place a teaspoon of dijon mustard into the center of each square, and fold the dough over into a pinch to seal. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are lightly golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,prawn,pumpkin,ladyfinger,lemon peel,serrano pepper,rice noodle,taco shell
title: Prawns and Pumpkin Tacos
ingredients: 150 g pumpkin, cubed ( zucchini, green beans or squash ) | 150 g rice noodles, soaked in warm water until tender | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds or 1 teaspoon cumin seed powder | 1/2 cup coriander, chopped | 200 g prawns, thawed & peeled | 2 serrano peppers | 14 taco shells | lemon peel, strips
instructions: Place the pumpkin in a pan & add a little water to moisten. Bring to the boil & boil for 2 minutes, or until soft. Add the rinsed rice noodles, cumin & coriander & mix. Put the prawns & serrano peppers on a large plate & pour 1/4 cup water & a pinch of salt over them. Arrange the prawns and pumpkin mixture on top. Sprinkle with lemon peel, cover with a packet & refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut liqueur,polenta,white bread flour,adobo sauce,curry paste
title: Grilled Polenta Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white bread flour | 1/2 cup polenta | 1 1/2 cups of prepared spicy pizza sauce or 1 1/2 cups hazelnut-flavored liqueur | 6 dashes adobo sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: Mix together and then shape the flour mixture into a ball. Dip the ball into the pizza sauce or liqueur. Grill the bread on high heat until firm and nicely browned on both sides and the cheese has begun to melt. Serve hot, or cool and freeze for up to two months.

title: Basic Jewish Seasoning for Ritz Bread
ingredients: 1 pastry crust or 1 pastry dough ( recipe # 2537518, the recipe originally called for a crust filled pizza crust ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon celery salt
instructions: Prepare your favorite dough recipe. Add in the above prepared ingredients to your favorite pastry recipe. Add any other spices or seasonings that your choice of. Let the baking sheets rest before placing dough on them. The dough should be just covered with a very slight spring of spring. Preheat oven on the lowest setting, place a cookie sheet on top of your dough sheet and brush a little bit of the dough from the sides of the dough. This should leave a gap that the dough can breathe. Bake for about 45 - 50 minutes until golden brown. Allow to cool and enjoy it's wonderful.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,leek,lemongrass,beef bouillon cube,pasta,iceberg lettuce,italian tomato,chicken breast half
title: Beef and Lemongrass Lettuce Soup
ingredients: 2 cans italian tomatoes, petite diced | 2 tablespoons minced lemongrass | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 package frozen cooked chicken breast halves, thawed | 1 small head iceberg lettuce ( can make own ) | 1 -2 cup cooked small pasta, your choice of size ( angel hair ) | 8 slices lemongrass
instructions: In a pot, bring a medium high pot of water to a boil. Add the tomatoes and lemon grass and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until thick. Add the bouillon cubes and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Add the chicken and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Place the drained pasta in the pot. Add the broth, cover, and cook for about 30 minutes. Serve each bowl some soup with a slice of lemongrass arranged around a bowl. Enjoy.

title: Simple Short Ribs
ingredients: 3 pounds country-style pork ribs | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Lay ribs flat on a clean cloth or paper towel. Combine cornstarch and water, and stir into the water. Sprinkle the ribs lightly with the cornstarch. Wrap the cloth around the ribs to keep them submerged and tie with kitchen twine. Refrigerate for 2 hours before smoking or bbqing to ensure best flavor. Smoke, barbeque or barbecue.

title: Miso Mushin (Sweet-Supper Versatile-sweet)
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 1 cup vegetables ( your choice ) | 1 cup fresh sliced mushrooms | 2 tablespoons miso ( any flavour, but this is also a'misto-i-love- miso ) | 1 cup prepared'souscous'custard powder | ladyfinger
instructions: Brown the ground beef with mushrooms, miso & miso paste. Drain & rinse the beef when fully cooked. Stir the meat into the browned mushrooms. Prepare the custard powder using the following directions on the packet. Dissolve the custard powder in 1/4 cup of water. Pour the paste into the saucepan & heat to the boiling point, stirring constantly, then allow to boil for 5 minutes. Stir the miso paste into the hot meat and mushrooms. Pour the mixture into an oven proof dish and bake in a moderate oven, until set around the edges and beginning to bubble slightly. Watch closely so that it does not burn. Remove from the oven & slice the ladyfingers into three pieces each. Serve immediately with a dollop of the sauce.

Random Ingredients: bread,corn oil,olive oil,steak chicken successfully,red chili pepper
title: Simple Garlic Pan Fried Swiss Steak (Pan Fried)
ingredients: 2 lbs steak ( preferably fresh and cut into thin round slices ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 6 ounces bread, crusts removed | 1 jar roasted red chili peppers, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Lay out four pieces of wax paper, each 1 1/2 inches wide and a 3/4 inch long. Spread each with 1/4 cup of corn oil. Set aside. Tear four slices of bread into large 1 inch squares and place them in separate clean, resealable baking dishes. Place a slice of fresh chile pepper in the middle of each square. Spread 1/4 cup of olives in a horizontal line across the cheese, leaving about 1 inch of the cheese covered strip of cheese around the edge of the bread slices. Set aside. Working with 1 piece of bread at a time, lay it out on a clean, dry surface and let it stand for about 10 minutes. Spread 1/4 cup of olive oil evenly on 1 side of each of the squares, using your fingers to rub the oil onto the bread and olive. Repeat until all the bread has been used, ending with the olive cover on the outside. Over medium high heat, add 1 tablespoon of corn oil in a skillet. Arrange the bread in batches and cook until golden brown and crusty, about 3 minutes each side, flipping once. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Repeat with the remaining slices of bread. Serve immediately.

title: Oriental Sesame Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs thinly sliced reynolds wrap foil | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place 2 sheets on the prepared baking sheet. Mix the sesame seeds with 1 teaspoon hot water. Spread 1 teaspoon sesame seed mixture evenly onto one side of each sheet of reynolds wrap. Evenly distribute 1 teaspoon of water mixture onto the sesame seed mixture. Press 1 pinch of salt on top of sesame seed mixture. Place 2 slices of parchment onto the sesame seeds to make a cross. Repeat to make 4 diagonal wedges. Brush each wedge with sesame seed mixture. Let dry at least 2 hours, or up to 2 days. If not drying before serving, preheat broiler 20 minutes. Transfer wedges, one at a time, onto metal or metal skewers. Broil for 1 - 2 minutes or until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Cashew Nut Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups cashew nuts | 1/2 cup prosciutto, diced | 10 ounces cool whip | fresh herb, to garnish
instructions: Place cashews on a baking sheet and bake at 350 for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and stir in prosciutto. Whip the cream until stiff peaks form. Fold into cashew mixture. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or until chilled. Garnish with fresh herbs and cool to room temperature. Serve at room temperature. Makes 12 servings.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,black olive,gingerroot,brazil nut,fennel seed,mushroom
title: Gramma's Gingemeat Muffins
ingredients: 100 g grated sharp cheddar cheese | 100 g chopped mixed mushrooms | 100 g chopped black olives | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon black gingersley seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 c. Place all ingredients in a baking dish. Mix well. Place on the middle shelf of the oven for about 20 - 25 minutes to set. Cool the muffins for approx 10 minutes before removing them from the tin.

title: Mango Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken tenders, with skin on | 2 slices canned mangoes | 1 -2 tablespoon sherry ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sugar ( to taste ) | 4 fluid ounces coffee | 1/4 - 1/3 cup dry vermouth | 1 fluid ounce heavy whipping cream | tomato, slices
instructions: Marinate chicken in mango sherry and sugar for at least 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, turning over once so chicken is coated. Cook at 350 for 1½ to 2 hours or until chicken is cooked. Serve on a platter with tomatoes on the side.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,mayonnaise,green cabbage,vermicelli,wonton wrapper,almond meal flour,turkey,string bean
title: Chinese Supper
ingredients: 100 g vermicelli | 1 small red capsicum | 250 g frozen string beans | 4 tablespoons finely chopped green cabbage | 200 g sliced turkey ( cooked, drained, meat was shredded ) | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1/2 cup almond meal flour
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut noodles from the chinese veg. Rinse chinese vermicelli in a colander and drain. Bring a pan of water to a boil, then add noodles and return to the boil. Cook 2 - 3 mins or until noodles are soft and drain. Meanwhile, place chopped capsicum and string bean in a frying pan and cook over low heat for 2 mins or until vegetables are crisp tender. Remove from heat and add cabbage. Place 2 tbsp of cooked vermicelli in a bowl with mayonnaise. Dip wrapper in flour, then place in a bowl with remaining vermicelli. Spoon mixture into wrapper, pleating as desired and placing a tsp of ginger on the edge of each piece. Seal edges with a fork. Repeat with rest of mixture. Place on a tray and refrigerate 30 mins to firm. Bake at 190c for 20 mins or until golden.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Salsa Pork
ingredients: 1/4 lb uncooked egg noodles ( or other long pasta ) | 1/2 lb pork roast, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/4 cup salsa | 1 can corn, drained ( or frozen ) | 1 can whole red chilies, chopped or 1 can diced serrano peppers, drained
instructions: Put it all into the slow cooker, stir gently, and cook on low 7 - 9 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours. About 15 minutes before serving, remove beef and shred or chop. Add some of the broth to the pot for a smoother texture if desired, you're not supposed to use all of it. Reheat if necessary, mix well before serving. I serve this with red onion salad and some shredded lettuce.

title: Spinach and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 5 tablespoons vegetable broth | 6 ounces dried farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 3 cups spinach, washed and chopped | 5 medium bananas, thinly sliced | 6 tablespoons orange sherbet, crushed | 4 ounces breadcrumbs | 1 jalapeno, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In large sauce pot, bring the broth to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook 2 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes, until farfalle is firm. Serve hot.

title: Chickpeas with Pineapple and Cajun Seasoning
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas ( garbanzo beans ), undrained are best | 2 tablespoons dried pineapple, chopped or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh pineapple chunks | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning, divided | 1/2 tablespoon triple sec
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss.

title: Tomato, Asafoetida & French Bread Melt
ingredients: 1 crusty italian bread | 2 slices asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 french bread, split
instructions: Preheat broiler to high, 3 minutes. Rub the asafetida on both side of bread. Place bread, bread side down, on a baking sheet. Broil 3 - 5 from heat source for 3 - 4 minutes or till golden brown. Remove from oven, and let cool. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,cooking oil,saffron,tabasco sauce,basil leaf,dill,onion powder
title: Basil Pepper Sun Dried Tomato Pesto
ingredients: 12 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, in oil ( the kind with seeds ) | 8 -10 leaves fresh basil leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely minced dried onion powder ( or onion flakes, to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil leaves, crush with fingers | 1/2 teaspoon finely minced dried dill ( or dill flakes, to taste ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( more or less to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron ( optional ) | cooking oil ( for frying the tomatoes ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Chop the sun dried tomatoes into very fine bits, discarding the hard outer layer. In a food processor, combine all of the ingredients and process well until the spices are distributed evenly. Add the oil one tablespoon at a time, blending well after each addition. Store in the refrigerator and use on your favorite pasta, rice, or as a seasoning for meat, poultry.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,japanese soy sauce,white bread flour,creme de menthe,clove
title: Nane Kuru (Pepperoni)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups white bread flour | 1 ounce dried creme de menthe, soaked in | 4 fluid ounces hot water for 15 minutes | 4 -6 whole cloves | 1/2 cup chopped kalamata olive
instructions: Drain the soaked mint and put it in a bowl. Cut the butter into cubes. Add the melted butter into the crèmeDe menthe and then add the hot water, cloves and chopped olives. Mix into a smooth, thick dough. Knead lightly on floured board, divide into 6 pieces. Roll out 1 piece dough on floured board until 1/4 inch thick. Cut in 3/4 inch squares using a cookie cutter. Put onto a cookie sheet and cover. Refrigerate for up to 6 hours. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit. Place a few drops of water in a bowl. Crush the cloves with your hands and dip each square into the hot water. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake on the cookie sheet for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove, cool completely.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,chow mein noodle,triple sec,chili flake,amaretto,grain rice
title: Sauce Florence
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet chili flakes | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 2 tablespoons triple sec or 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 2 cups short-grain rice | 1/2 cup chow mein noodles
instructions: Put all ingredients into a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until thick, about 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve hot over hot, cooked rice.

title: Crazy Mushroom Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/2 pound whole white mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup garam masala powder
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,ice,shiitake mushroom,large curd cottage cheese,shallot
title: Shiitake Mushrooms in Canadian Bacon Cups
ingredients: 10 cups shiitake mushrooms | 1 package canadian bacon, pieces | 1 shallot, diced | 1 package large curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup ice, crushed
instructions: Wash mushrooms, discarding stems and stems, and slice caps very thin. Cook canadian bacon pieces in a skillet according to package directions. Set aside. Add shallot and mushrooms to remaining canadian bacon grease in the skillet and sauté until lightly browned and tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cottage cheese and crushed ice. Cool 10 minutes before filling the mushroom caps.

Random Ingredients: french onion dip,yukon gold potato,muenster cheese,tomato juice,green onion
title: French Onion Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed | 2 cans french-fried onion dip | 1 jar tomato juice | 1 green onion, chopped | 1 package sliced muenster cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

title: Southern Style Skirt Steak
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat | 2 pounds skirt steak
instructions: Cut the steak into 4 to 6 pieces. The pieces should be 1 to 1 1/2 inches high enough so they have room for each piece of meat. In a large resealable plastic bag, lay out the steak pieces. Lay the steak pieces on the meat slices. Cover the steak with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, and place a cast iron or cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Arrange the steaks in the skillet so they are not touching, and cook until they reach desired doneness, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Chili Paste
ingredients: 2 dried chile peppers, or more to taste | 7/8 cup orange juice, or as needed
instructions: Combine chile peppers in a bowl.

title: Niku Jyaga
ingredients: 2 slices pork loin | 3 tablespoons sake | 2 canned chipotle chiles | 20 small green beans
instructions: Slice pork into thin strips and marinate with sake and chipotle until serving. Cook beans until tender and break into 4 pieces. When serving, remove pork from marinade and brown lightly with chiles. Serve pork.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,season salt,self raising flour,avocado oil,oatmeal,elbow macaroni,beer,arbol chile
title: Mac & Beer Batter and Chips
ingredients: 1 cup elbow macaroni | 1 large onion or 1 large shallot | 2 -4 arbol chiles ( depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 cup self rising flour | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or salt ) | 1 cup old fashioned oats or 1 cup self-raising flour ( depends on your heat tolerance ) | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 3/4 cup beer or 3/4 cup white wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f. Combine the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Then combine with wet ingredients by adding a little more beer or wine if necessary while mixing. This will make a thick batter. Place the wet ingredients on the dry ingredients and mix well. This will make the chips more sticky. Place a baking tray in the oven and turn the temperature down to 180f. Place the chips onto the baking tray and lightly spray them with olive oil or cooking spray, or you can leave the chips on a baking paper, and bake for approximately 20 minutes. Serve with butter or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,cheddar cheese,pizza sauce,pine nut,wheat flour,haddock fillet
title: Danish Smoked Haddock & Pine Nut Pies
ingredients: 300 g smoked haddock fillets, in cubes | 1 cup low-fat cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup low-fat smoked cheddar cheese, grated | 1/3 cup toasted pine nuts | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1/2 teaspoon wheat flour
instructions: Place oven on 200°c. Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Spoon into an ovenproof dish. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: apricot nectar,new mexico chile powder,corn oil,grenadine,granny smith apple,walnut,tarragon,baby carrot
title: Mexican Carrots and Apricots
ingredients: 4 baby carrots | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 teaspoons fresh tarragon or 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1/2 teaspoon new mexico chile powder ( mexican chili powder ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricot nectar | 1 granny smith apple, cut into thin spears | 1 tablespoon grenadine
instructions: Slice carrots diagonally into 1/2 inch slices. Wipe out skillet. Heat 1 tbls corn oil in skillet over medium high heat. Add carrots, tarragon, chile powder. Saute 2 minutes. Sprinkle with dried apricots and nut cobs. Turn heat to medium low. Cover and cook 4 - 5 minutes till carrot is just tender. Transfer to serving plate. Repeat process for other carrots. Add nectar to skillet and simmer to make a syrupy sauce, scraping up the browned bits. Drizzle over vegetables. Sprinkle with chopped figs.

title: Mixed Colcannon with Kiwi Filled Bananas
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1 bunch kiwi, sliced | 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 cup shredded asiago cheese | 1/4 cup whipping cream | chopped fresh asiago cheese or shredded regproccone cheese, to serve
instructions: Cook cauliflower in salted water for 5 minutes, drain well. Blend cauliflower, kiwis, mustard seed, cheese and cream and keep warm. Sprinkle asiago over cauliflower mixture and decorate with chopped fresh asiago. Serve on a bed of brown mustard leaves.

title: Chile Con Carne With Crackling Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 canned chipotle chiles, in oil | 2 lbs beef roast | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix the chipotles, beef, and 1/2 cup of sugar. Place into a crock in a roasting pan, or cover with foil. Set on the highest oven setting. Turn the temperature into its own oven. Bake for 3 hours until very dark brown and crusty underneath. Let stand for 10 minutes on a wire rack. Cut into thick slices using kitchen scissors. This dish tastes best when left to stand overnight, so the oven can be preheated to 140 degrees celcius and when serving, remove the plastic wrap from the foil and discard. Serve with crusty bread or on the side.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,chinese five spice powder,green chili,olive,mustard seed,vanilla essence
title: Guacamole Spread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons mixed spring greens ( cress ) | 1 tablespoon green chili | 1 tablespoon mixed olive | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon powdered guacamole | chinese five spice powder
instructions: Put all ingredients into the bowl and mix well. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until needed.

title: Roses-Mint and Spicy Strawberries
ingredients: 8 large strawberries | 2 1/2 - 3 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | fresh ground mixed spice ( oregano, thyme, etc. ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Wash and rinse berries. In a medium saucepan add sugar, mustard seeds, liquid smoke and dried mint. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring until mixed. Lower heat to a simmer and add fresh berries. Cover and cook about 5 to 7 minutes or until berries open slightly. Add salt, pepper and/or sugar to taste. Note if you are using dried mint leaves, stir them now, too, and add as soon as they turn dark brown. Cool slightly. Place berries into air tight container and store in a cool, dry place for 2 to 3 weeks or until fully dry.

title: Roasted Beans, Vegan
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light molasses | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dried italian herbs ( basil, oregano, rosemary ) | 2 cans cannellini beans
instructions: In a shallow casserole dish, combine all ingredients, stir well. Cover with plastic wrap and set over a medium low temperature to steam, stirring occasionally for 1 hour. Serve.

title: Sweet-N-Savory Sausage and Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 2 1/2 cups vermicelli, broken | 2 cups quinoa | 1 cup long grain rice | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup chopped dried breadcrumbs | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Brown sausage in a large skillet. Drain sausage well. Measure meat off fat. Measure the quinoa into a medium bowl over the cheesecloth. Rinse, drain and add to bowl with other ingredients. Stir to mix, making sure the quinoa is moist and slightly wet. Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls. Place on a large baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake 15 - 20 minutes depending on the thickness of the balls.

title: Picante Chickpea and Fresh Vegetables
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower ( halved and separated into florets ) | 1 can chickpeas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 jar picante sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon bark | 1/4 cup fresh green beans ( optional ) | cinnamon bark
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Spread cauliflower florets in a greased shallow baking dish and pour bean and picante sauce on top, spreading evenly. Sprinkle top with horseradish. Sprinkle cinnamon bark on top. Add the green beans, if using, and sprinkle with cinnamon bark. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are soft and the salsa has thickened. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,miso,pistachio,extra sharp cheddar cheese,yukon gold potato
title: Lidia's Rice With Miso Cheese
ingredients: 5 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-in. chunks ( about 12 ) | 1 tablespoon extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons miso ( dark fermented soybean paste ) | 2 cups prepared basmati rice | 2 -3 tablespoons roasted pistachios, chopped
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan and add water to cover by 2 inches over the potatoes. Place the pot over high heat, cover and bring to a boil. When it boils, reduce the heat to medium low. And cook until the potatoes are just tender, about 15 minutes or so. Drain the potatoes and return the saucepan to high heat. Add the cheese and miso paste and toss to coat. When the rice is cooked, add the potatoes and continue to toss until the potatoes are coated with miso. Meanwhile, cook the pistachios in 1/3 cup boiling water over moderate heat, stirring until crisp tender, 4 - 4 minutes. Drain. Drain the hot saucepan. Add 1/2 the hot rice to the remaining miso. Mix well. Stir in the pistachios.

title: Pan-Fried American Hero Strips (Pepperoni)
ingredients: 6 slices pepperoni | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Place pepperoni slices between two layers of moistened paper towels.

title: Quick  Thai Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 5 -6 fresh kaffir lime leaves ( cut in half )
instructions: Bring two quarts of water to boil, salt and stir well. Turn off heat, cover and leave for about 15 minutes before draining. Prepare a 4 quart cooking pot by heating on stove top. When water comes to boiling, add rigatoni and kaffir lime. Cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook, stirring now and then and then until rigatoni is soft. Add salt as desired. Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 jar pearl barley ( not quick-cooking barley barley ) | 1 bunch fresh chives ( optional )
instructions: Wash and pick over the barley/chives and bring to a boil with enough water to cover. Remove from the heat, cover, and let stand till liquid is absorbed and barley is soft. Stir often with a wooden spoon, but do not allow soup to burn. If desired, you can use a food processor/blender to puree the soup. Serve in hot bowls with a sprinkling of fresh chives on top. You can also make this easy and delicious soup for an evening meal.

title: Easy Semolina Pilaff
ingredients: 250 ml soya sauce | 200 g semolina | 1 teaspoon saffron | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Soak the semolina in boiling water for 3 - 5 minutes. Drain. In a large pot, boil water. Add soya sauce, saffron and sesame seeds. Stir in mixed spice. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add boiled semolina when ready. Dip into water if the liquid too thick. Enjoy warm or cold, it's good.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Lightly beat eggs with instant coffee in a medium bowl. Stir in onion powder.

title: Moroccan Spiced Sugar
ingredients: 1 cup of organic sugar or 1 cup of caster sugar | spices, eg cinnamon, vanilla or other spices ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sized mixing bowl. Mix well. Cover bowl with plastic wrap or a clean tea towel and store at room temperature. It will last for a couple of weeks in the unlikely case that it's not used immediately. This would be good served with ice cream, cream, cookies or ice cream. Store in the refrigerator for up to a year.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,extra virgin olive oil,beef sirloin steak
title: Grilled Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 can sliced beef sirloin steaks | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Pour olive oil in a shallow dish and set aside. Dip sirloin strips into heated oil and then quickly into chili powder. Grill over hot coals or on high setting for 5 to 10 minutes or until just browned.

Random Ingredients: fine semolina,tarragon,garlic clove,orange zest,cream mushroom soup,dark rum,vanilla bean,penne
title: Caribbean Penne
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked penne ( i like spirals ) | 1 teaspoon dry tarragon | 2 tablespoons orange zest, finely grated | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( seeds scraped out ) | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 3 tablespoons dark rum ( or half a can of cream of mushroom soup ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup with live herbs ( i don't use the canned ) | 1/4 cup fine semolina
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Stir together all remaining ingredients. Drain pasta to remove pasta and add sauce. Toss to coat. Serve warm or cold. Note, i have never made this recipe with regular cream of mushroom soup and it's a bit too light tasting for my taste.

title: Kiwi and Penne With Kiwi-Rice
ingredients: 2 kiwi | 2 ounces penne
instructions: Cut kiwi in half lengthwise and hollow out leaving a thin slice of flesh attached. Heat frying pan and fry kiwifruit over medium high heat, without adding any water, until slightly soft and kiwifruit is well cooked. Drain pasta, place back into pan and pour in kiwifruit and drizzle with kiwi.

title: Beer Bread
ingredients: 1 cake flour or 1 flour | 12 sprigs fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon soft bread machine yeast | 1 1/4 cups dark beer ( your favorite brand )
instructions: Place the flour, mint leaves and yeast in the bread machine pan. Add 1 3/4 cup of dark beer to the bread machine. Program, basic, medium crust setting. When the bread has cycle beeps, remove the bread from the bread pan. Place the bread onto a large dish, and allow to rise until doubled in size. Allow to cool to warm room temp, about 45 - 60 minutes. Place an 8 cake pan in your freezer. Once half frozen, slice the bread. Place slices in a baking tray or a pan that you can cover them. Pour the remaining beer into the heated baking tray. Place the bread on the tray. Let rise until almost doubled. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes. Turn the bread over, and bake an additional 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Apple Onion Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 apple - peeled, cored, and sliced | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lay sliced apple on the chicken breast meat, and sprinkle with any marinade you can find. Place the chicken on a pan, and cover chicken with aluminum foil. Bake at 425 degrees f for 20 minutes, remove aluminum foil, and bake for an additional 20 minutes. My note, i've never had success with using this recipe with my chicken but i don't bother for a more flaky chicken. I like the apple. I always have leftover apple slices on hand, and the apples are my personal favorite. I also like to mix onions and carrots in a bowl. Use this to roast sherry, rice, or noodles. I don't usually measure, mainly like apples and carrots. The apples and carrots will cook very quickly. Chicken was perfect, and stayed soooo delicious. Also, just love it.

title: Macaroni With Lime and Turmeric
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni ( small pasta shapes ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 inch knob lime zest, grated | 1/2 1/2 cup fresh lime juice or 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water until it has been 'al dente'. Strain & set aside. Place turmeric in a mortar & pestle & lightly pound into a coarse powder. Add zest & lemon juice & mash thoroughly. Pour macaroni into a large bowl & pour lime or lemon juice over macaroni. Toss to combine, then place a sturdy plate on top, then weight it down loosely with a heavy object such as a tin tin foil. Best eaten on day 1 or 2.

title: Grapefruit Confit
ingredients: 2 pink grapefruit juice | 2 ounces fontina cheese, rind removed | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar | 1 shallot, finely minced
instructions: Place the pulp into a small bowl with the sugar and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve the confit chilled with cream. May be served with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,turmeric powder,green bean,dark brown sugar
title: Faux Green Beans in Butter
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed | 1 cup cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | dark brown sugar, for coating
