Drain meat and corn and add with lime wedges. Toss till well coated. Serve warm.

instructions: Heat the oil in a large, non stick frypan on high. Add the onion and cook over a moderate heat for 4 minutes, or until soft. title: Potato and Asparagus Stew

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f line a 2 1/2 quart baking dish with a piece of foil, letting the foil extend over the sides of the dish. Scatter half the potato pieces over the foil. title: Awesome Basic Ricotta Cheese - No Dairy!!!

instructions: Mix well and refrigerate for one week. In the mean time chop riccinni and bake on a cookie sheet with a medium temperature. You can also do on cookie sheet on the grill as well. instructions: In a large skillet on medium high heat, add chicken, fruit, coconut rum and potatoes. Cover with aluminum foil. Simmer until potatoes are tender and chicken is cooked. When ready to serve, place several spoonfuls of the mixture onto each toasted bread slice and place in toaster dish. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,sea salt,marinara sauce,kosher salt,corn tortilla,vanilla,serrano pepper
title: Spicy Spanish Tortilla

instructions: To make the espresso sauce, combine the prepared marinara sauce, coffee powder, salt, and vanilla. To warm the tortillas, wrap each warm tortilla in foil to keep warm. Heat the oven to 200 degrees f. Dip a tortilla into the espresso sauce until soft, about 1 minute per side. Transfer onto a plate, and sprinkle with the ground serrano. Arrange the heated tortillas on a baking sheet, and bake 2 to 3 minutes in the oven, until the tortillas are crisp and heated through. Serve warm. Random Ingredients: green bean,sherry vinegar,pork fillet,ghee butter,vegetable oil cooking spray,white wine,italian salad dressing,beef marrow
title: Dutch Oven Pork With Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/2 cup sherry vinegar | 2 lbs boneless pork fillets, about 1 1/2 inches thick, cut into 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons ghee, divided | 2 cups fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 beef marrow, thinly sliced | 1 cup italian salad dressing | chopped roasted garlic and red bell peppers ( to garnish )

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,lavender bud,tomato green chilies,picante sauce
title: Texas Caviar
ingredients: 3 cans ro-tel tomatoes and green chilies, well drained ( velveeta ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 teaspoons black cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons dried lavender buds
instructions: In a blender, puree ro tel tomatoes, picante sauce, black cardamom pods, and dried lavender buds until smooth. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl, chill, and serve.

title: Homemade Peppercorn Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti ( or your favorite ) | 1 cup peppppercorn
instructions: Prepare the spaghetti as directed. Drain the spaghetti well. Place in a large bowl. Cover with boiling water. Cover and let stand 8 to 10 minutes, or until tender.

title: Saskatchewan Meatball Supper With Creamy Fettuccine
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked uncooked dry wheat noodles or 3/4 cup fettuccine | 2 cups beef broth ( i use swanson brand ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup uncooked bulgur ( or sub with 1 box of whole-wheat ) | 2 large egg yolks | skewer
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cook noodles as label directs on package, but do not overcook. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine broth, soup, bulgur and egg yolks. Add noodles and mix gently with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon. Form mixture into 20 meatballs. Place on a paper towel lined baking sheet. Broil 3 inches from heat 5 minutes. Add keffir.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,beef tenderloin steak,red chile pepper,peanut,white fish fillet,superfine sugar,crabmeat
title: Fish With Red Chile Peanut Sauce

instructions: In a food processor, combine peanuts, sugar, peanut butter and 3 cups water. Blend until smooth, stopping once or twice to scrape down the sides. title: Chef John's Panzanella
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 6 ounces gruyere, shredded | 2 tablespoons unbleached all-purpose vinegar | 2 can reduced-sodium low-fat chicken broth
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Spray four 1 1/2 inch depth disposable foil roasting pans with cooking spray. Whisk hoisin sauce, picante sauce, gruyere cheese, vinegar, and chicken broth together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: clove,thai red curry paste,egg white,cooking oil,green capsicum,lamb,sherry,yellow pea
title: Lamb Meat Kebabs
ingredients: 400 g lamb, cut into 1 1/2 cm pieces ( or use leg of lamb ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon dried yellow split peas | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 medium egg white, lightly whisked | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry | cooking oil, for shallow-frying | 1 medium green capsicum, de-seeded and cut into 1/2 cm dice | salt and dried yellow peppers or red capsicum flowers
instructions: Using a sharp knife, score 2 long x 1 - 2 deep slits or squares about 3/4 inch deep in lamb meat or other part of meat. Dissolve chay paste in sherry in a small saucepan over medium heat, until fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat, add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly with a spoon. Taste and adjust seasoning. Thread meat onto metal skewers. Grill 3 - 4 minutes, turning occasionally, until desired doneness. Serve with a sprinkling of chopped mixed chilies and vegetables,.

title: Spicy Salt
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate soda | 3 -4 fresh cilantro stems | kosher salt
instructions: Crush leaves of cilantro stalks finely with rolling pin or clean hammer and place on rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with kosher salt. Place all the leaves under running water and dry them off a bit. You should end up with a single layer of large, even pieces of fresh, not dark colored but dark green leaves. Store in airtight jars in the refrigerator. Keeps for 5 days. Note, if using kosher salt, it helps to make a dent in the salt. Note, you can also use a combination of bicarb, cilantro and freshly ground black pepper for your basting sauce. Note, if using a mortar and pestle, a good way to crush dried corns is to pound in the mortar and pestle. If using a food processor, grind them with the cilantro and mortar and pestle. Note, if you have a mortar and pestle, mix all the dry spices together and use as a rub for any bread you make.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,green bean,almond meal,bok choy,radicchio,jumbo pasta shell

Top with the sprinats and almonds meal.

Remove chicken from the pan and drizzle the remaining vinegar and baste all the pieces of chicken. Serve with salad or grilled veggies.

instructions: Pour a little olive oil in a skillet, and heat, then add the spanish herbs. Add the arborio rice, making sure that the spanish herbs don't burn. Wrap tightly in the wrap, and let the cheese melt. When the rice has melted, remove the wrap, and cut into slices.

instructions: Preheat oven to wash kale clean, cut in small pieces and place under a double broiler for about 10 minutes until just brown. title: Homemade Honey Glazes

Cool on a wire rack, and let cool completely.

title: Italian Crumbed Pork Loin

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Trim excess fat from pork. Sprinkle the pork generously with the dry Italian salad dressing mix italian bread crumbs with italian dressing mixture. Sprinkle the pork generously with the seasoned bread crumbs. Bake, uncovered, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, sugar and tamari until well combined. In a large skillet or wok, stir fry rice and dill in hot oil, stirring until rice is just barely golden.

Cook until the spinach is heated through. Place onto a sheet of baking paper and lightly dust with flour.

title: Curried Omelet
ingredients: 1/4 cup half-and-half | 6 tablespoons coarsely chopped grain mustard | 4 tablespoons butter | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: In a small skillet, bring to boil half and half, mustard, butter, turmeric and curry powder. Remove from heat and spoon mixture onto a hot griddle that has been sprayed lightly with nonstick cooking spray. Cook until the underside is golden brown. Turn. Cook other side and repeat. Serve hot.

title: Japanese Style Steamed Fish
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets | 1 bouillon cube
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large frying pan. Cover and bring to the boil. Steam for about 20 minutes until fish flakes easily. Let fish rest a little before serving. If there is any fish left over, leave the stock in a saucepan for a few minutes then remove the fish and put on a warmed serving dish.

title: Fettuccine with Aioli
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine | 1 jar aioli
instructions: Cook pasta al dente. Meanwhile mix aioli with pasta and heat until ready to serve.

title: Creamy Cashews
ingredients: 1/3 cup greek feta cheese, crumbled | 1/3 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1/4 cup salted cashews | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Put the cashews in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,golden syrup,urad dal,chili pepper flake
title: Dal and Aniseed Spices
ingredients: 1 cup rajma urad dal | 4 -5 dried chili peppers or 4 -5 other dried chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon red food coloring or 1/2 teaspoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the rajma and urad dal. Keep aside. Grind the soaked spices with salt, pepper and any other paste. Put the dry ingredients in a food processor and process till they form a paste. Add the paste and mix well. Add water if it is necessary. Heat a frying pan on a medium flame. Add a little oil so it spreads around inside the pan. Keep stirring till the oil does not stick to the sides. Put the spices on the pan as you see in the photo. Turn on your lowest heat. Add hot water if it is not drying out. Leave the spices on the pan on low heat for 5 minutes. Turn off the fire, open the lid. Leave the pan for another 30 seconds. Carefully remove the lid. Let it cool down. Serve warm or keep warm. Enjoy on a rainy day, with yoghurt and butter or raita powder.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,cardamom pod,sultana,coriander seed,pork shoulder,pepper sauce
title: Saffron Churrasas
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ground coriander seed | 1 teaspoon pepper sauce ( such as tabasco ) | 4 teaspoons saffron strands | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 4 tablespoons sultanas | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, chopped into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Season the spice mixture with a pinch of salt and red pepper flakes. Fry the coriander seeds, saffron pieces, cardamom pods, and sultanas in the hot skillet until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Add the saffron and sultana mixture a little bit at a time, stirring constantly, until the previous addition is almost all absorbed. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and continue cooking until most of the liquid is reduced to about 2 tablespoons. Stir the mixture occasionally.

title: Sticky Rabbit - Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 rabbit, cut up | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 serrano chili | 1 tablespoon whiskey
instructions: Add peanut butter and serrano chili to food processor. Add whiskey and blend until smooth. Pour into a bowl and coat rabbit with mixture. Marinate at least 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator. Grill rabbit until well browned.

title: Crock Pot  Dutch Flavored Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs | 1 cup unsweetened cranberry juice | 1/4 cup cocoa
instructions: Place spareribs and cranberry juice in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Cook on low 6 to 9 hours, setting spareribs aside and cover with foil overnight to thicken juices if necessary. Remove ribs from saucepan, reserving liquid. Rinse, pat dry and sprinkle with cocoa. Note, you want the sauce to be moist and spicy, not boiling.

title: Parsley Sesame Seed
ingredients: 1 package dried chipotle chiles | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil
instructions: Place chiles in a bowl and cover with very hot tap water.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,saffron thread,coffee,green chili salsa,white rice,tomatillo,pork tenderloin,salad oil
title: Green Chile Pork With Grilled Tomatillo and Chile Salsa
ingredients: 500 g tomatillos, husked, rinsed and diced | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 pinch saffron thread | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 500 g pork tenderloin, cut into 2 to 3 cm cubes | 1/2 cup prepared green chili salsa | 1 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 medium green chili salsa | 3/4 cup hot coffee
instructions: In a small frying pan, heat saffron threads and 1/2 cup salad oil over medium high heat until golden, about 3 minutes. Immediately transfer saffron to a small plate, then add remaining oil to pan. Cook pork in saffron infused oil for 8 minutes or until browned on all sides. Set aside. Wipe excess fat off tomatillos using paper towels. Reduce heat to medium. Add saffron and remaining salad oil and saffron infused oil. Cook, stirring from time to time, until tomatillos soften and turn translucent, about 3 minutes. Stir in the chile salsa, then pour into a bowl or platter. Serve immediately with rice and garnish with grilled tomato and green chili salsa.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,thai chile red pepper flake,cornstarch,salmon,chinese five spice powder,linguine
title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 1 cup lemongrass ( white part only ) or 1 cup lemongrass ( white part only ) | 1 tablespoon thai chile red pepper flakes ( use a little more or less if you like ) | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 gallon fresh salmon, bones and cartilage removed ( in chunks or slices ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Rinse the linguine as needed.

title: Homemade Smoky Sun Dried Tomato Smothered Sweet Onions
ingredients: 1 lb raw sweet onion (, 2 to 2 1/2 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 lb sun-dried tomato
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly mist a small nonstick baking sheet with olive oil. Cut the dried sweet onion in half.

title: Roast Beef With Mushroom and Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb beef, trimmed of all excess fat | 3/4 lb mixed dried porcini mushrooms, soaked in hot water for 12 hours | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f rub 1 tablespoon olive oil on one side of the beef at a time and place on a rack in a roasting pan. Tie a piece of kitchen string around the outside of the roast and place roasting pan on rack in oven. Roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 450f. Carefully place the roast in a warm place and tent with aluminum foil. Let rest for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, remove the tent of string from the beef and discard. Carefully remove the string. Strain the liquid from the roasting pan with a strainer into a warm bowl and skim off any fat that rises to the top. Rinse the porcini mushrooms in warm water, then pat dry with paper towels. Slice the stems off the mushrooms, then cut the mushrooms in half and squeeze out the excess moisture. Place the meat on a carving board and carve thinly. Place the meat on a warmed platter. Sprinkle with parsley and serve. Roast meat is best if marinated overnight, but may be covered with plastic wrap or aluminum foil when resting.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,applesauce,pineapple juice,rum,hard egg,orange juice,prime rib roast
title: Tropical Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs prime rib roast, trimmed of excess fat | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 cup unsweetened applesauce | 6 tablespoons rum | 3 cups unsweetened pineapple juice | 2 whole hard-boiled eggs, halved length wise | 3 tablespoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Place beef roast in a large roasting pan. Combine sugar, applesauce and rum in a saucepan and stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved. Simmer over moderate heat until mixture comes to a full boil and syrupy, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat broiler. Remove beef from pan. Prick beef on all sides with a skewer. Pour hot syrup and orange juice over beef. Broil the beef in the center of the oven, basting beef with hot syrup, 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Slow Cooker Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 cans sweet yellow salsa ( jubes is my favorite ) | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 package chunky salsa ( jubes is my favorite )
instructions: Throw everything in a crockpot. Cook on low about 4 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,phyllo dough,pie shell,thyme leaf,extra virgin olive oil,bean sprout,apricot jam
title: Easy Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 unbaked pie shells ( see directions ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup golden raisin, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons apricot jam, coarsely chopped | 1/2 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, minced | 1/4 cup cooked fresh beans sprout, chopped ( optional ) | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Lightly coat bottom and half of a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Press 1 pastry sheet into casserole dish.

title: Easy English Cucumber Appetizer (Copycat)
ingredients: 2 english seedless cucumbers, peeled, halved lengthwise, and thinly sliced crosswise ( about 1 1/4 cups ) | 1 1/2 ounces chipotle chiles in adobo, canned in adobo sauce, minced
instructions: Spray large nonstick frypan or wok with nonstick spray and heat over medium high heat. Add half of the cucumbers.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,graham cracker crumb,extra virgin olive oil,espresso granule
title: Easy Espresso Apple Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons instant espresso granules | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/4 cups apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Mix the espresso granules, oil and apple juice thoroughly. Stir in crumbs. Spread into a 9x9 inch pan and bake 15 minutes. Cool and serve with ice cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: hot mustard,asiago cheese,sirloin,phyllo pastry,green pepper,ancho chile,carrot,vanilla essence
title: Filipino Beef Cigars
ingredients: 1 lbs ground sirloin | 1/2 cup diced carrot | 1/2 cup diced green pepper | 1 tablespoon minced ancho chile | 1 tablespoon sweet red hot mustard | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla essence | 3 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Mix sirloin, carrot, green pepper, hot mustard, chili, vanilla essence and 1 tablespoons of grated cheese in bowl. Lay out filo in single layer in 10 x 3 inch pan. Cut sheet in 6 strips crosswise. Brush with egg wash. Place 1 teaspoon of beef mixture close to the end of each strip along length of phyllo. Roll up, beginning at end of phyllo. Repeat with remaining filo and beef mixture.. Spread 1/6 cup of grated cheese on top of each cigar and roll up. Repeat until all cigars are used. Cover with foil and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,chicken breast,asafoetida powder,almond butter,chicken thigh,corn oil,puff pastry,beef brisket
title: Beef and Jack Wrapped With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1 boneless beef brisket ( or other mild-tamale ) | 1 beef brisket | 1 chicken thigh, skinned and sliced | 1/4 cup corned whole almonds, toasted | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1 slice swiss cheese, cut into 4 triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Season the brisket and beef with salt and pepper. Heat a large skillet over medium heat until just hot enough to sizzle. Add the chicken and beef and sear until browned, about 10 minutes. Remove the beef and chicken from skillet. Heat the same skillet used to cook the brisket and the beef until browned on second side, about 10 minutes. Add the corned whole almonds and asafoetida to the skillet and cook until liquid evaporates and the almonds turn golden, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Indian Tea (For Diabetics)
ingredients: 5 green cardamom pods ( do not remove before use to ensure generation of heat through ) | 1/2 teaspoon tea ( i prefer decaf ) or 1/2 teaspoon rum ( i prefer decaf )
instructions: Place cardamom pods into a small dish. Place the remaining ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Strain the boiling tea. Allow to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: white rum,flat leaf italian parsley,cornstarch,red capsicum,rose water,soup
title: Fiery Cured Capsicum Rillettes
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, seeded quartered | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons sweet white rum, heated until boiling | 1 teaspoon rose water | 2 cups hot soup, warmed | 3 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Cut capsicum into 2 cm pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon cornstarch in a bowl. Set aside. In a medium saucepan, combine remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons hot sugar. Mix until dissolved and set aside. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons water in a small saucepan, add remaining cornstarch mixture and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until mixture boils and thickens, about 2 minute. Remove from heat and set aside. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons water in a small pan until boiling.

title: Ginger Gloves
ingredients: 6 slices fresh ginger root | 6 cubes chicken bouillon powder | 1 sprig crushed dried rosemary
instructions: Place the ginger slices in a jar with enough water to cover. Remove some of the water and stir into the chicken bouillon. Stir in the rosemary. Cover, and place in the refrigerator to marinate.

title: Vodka
ingredients: 1 tablespoon port wine | 1 tablespoon fresh grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Rub the rim of a high walled tic tac toe tin with pepper. This requires a high wall and depth of at least 4 inches. Pour the port into the tin and sprinkle with the parmesan. Place the tin on the counter or countertop and set aside to dry for 8 to 10 hours, until the vodka starts to turn dark tan or syrupy.

title: Yellow Pepper & Barley  Broth
ingredients: 2 yellow peppers | 1/4 liter barley | 1/2 liter of boiling water | 1 liter superfine sugar | fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Roast the peppers until lightly blackened. Once cool enough to touch, peel away the skins and finely chop the flesh. Place the pepper and most of the barley into a large heavy based pot. Pour in boiling water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and allow to simmer over a low heat for 2 hours. Check the liquid content regularly and add sugar as before. After 25 minutes, add the parsley and remove from heat. Serve with boiled or steamed asparagus.

title: Carambola (Pickled Ham Hocks)
ingredients: 2 lbs ham hocks | 2 tablespoons carambola | 3 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Boil ham in salted water until easily pierced with a knife. Drain and blot with paper towel. Trim off hard muscle from ham and discard bones. Cut pieces of ham into four portions and place in storage bag, with spareribs. Pour over sherry, coat with sherry and marinate meat 4 hours, or overnight. Refrigerate 3 days before using.

title: Thyme Fried Spinach
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons ground red pepper | 1 ounce fresh breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon milk or 1 tablespoon cream | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 teaspoon ricotta cheese, grated
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Remove the stalks and wash them well. Slice the stalks at an angle into 1/2 inch pieces, and place in a bowl. Mix together all dry marinade ingredients.

title: Beef Mangetsu
ingredients: 1 gallon buttermilk | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | strawberry, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with a whisk until evenly mixed. Chill for about 1 hour. Serve atop the steamed or fried strawberries with a nice leafy green salad or fresh green leaf lettuce.

title: Arakesh Pumpkin Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried sweet peas ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups canned pumpkin puree | salt and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes | 1 pinch sumac ( optional )
instructions: Place dried peas and pumpkin in a food processor or blender and pulse until pumpkin is finely ground. Add salt, pepper and dried hot pepper flakes to taste. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,corn tortilla chip,black olive,apricot preserve,beef stock,hamburger bun,half
title: Albondigas Con Queso (Mexican Beef Sandwich)
ingredients: 2 fresh hamburger buns, toasted and softened | 2 teaspoons sour cream or 2 teaspoons light mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons apricot preserves | 15 ounces beef stock | 1/3 cup chopped black olives | 1 tablespoon fresh minced cilantro leaves | 1 1/2 cups crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Heat oven to mix beef, sour cream, preserves, and stock. Place mixture on toasted buns and top with black olives and cilantro.

title: Pear Pears Stuffed With Sage
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh sage | 1/4 cup spring onion ( scallions ) | 2 teaspoons saffron | 5 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 lb waxy potato, cleaned, peeled and coarsely chopped | 4 bosc pears, such as anzac, well-ripe
instructions: Cut a small slit in each parsnip. Remove the hard stalk as well as the very bitter pith. Place the pears inside a deep, clean tin. Add the sage leaves to the tin. Sprinkle over the spring onion, saffron and cooking sherry. Carefully press the mixture slightly to mix so that the leaves come loose. Bring to the boil over a high heat, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes – or until the mixture is quite dry. Transfer to a cold oven and leave to cool completely. When the salad is cold, put aside the sage leaves for now – discard the leaves completely before serving – or store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Peel the pears carefully, removing the core. Slice the pears in half lengthwise, leaving the shells intact. Stick the pears into the reserved sage leaves. To serve, pile the pears into individual serving plates – sprinkle over the sage leaves and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bourbon,green food coloring,sharp cheddar cheese,pepper,yukon gold potato,jalapeno pepper
title: Cheesy Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 yukon gold potatoes, boiled peeled, cut in squares and then chilled ( if they're cold, peel and cut in half again ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons bourbon | 1/4 teaspoon fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, cut into thin sticks | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1 drop green food coloring
instructions: Combine the potato cubes and bourbon in a bowl. Mix in the pepper and cheese. Add the food color as desired. Serve at once.

title: Cheesy Beef Patties for 2
ingredients: 200 g ground beef round | 1 tablespoon cornmeal | 200 g grated cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green peas | 2 tablespoons finely chopped shallots or 2 tablespoons onions | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Form meat into 4 - 5 patties. Lightly combine cheese, peas, shallot, teriyaki sauce and 1/2 cup cold water in a large shallow dish. Heat nonstick pan or griddle pan over medium high heat. Cook patties for 6 - 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and tender and cooked through. Place patties on a plate, pour over cheese mixture, and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,bell pepper,dark soy sauce,sherry wine,celery seed,caster sugar,apple cider vinegar
title: Soy and Pepper Biltong
ingredients: 600 g yellow bell peppers, seeded, coarsely chopped | 100 g bell peppers, coarsely chopped ( red and or or green ) | 2 medium celery seeds ( or 2-3 drops celery salt ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( or braggs liquid aminos...adjust this according to your personal tastes.. ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix well. Leave the mixture in the fridge 1 hr, or up to 8 hours. Heat oven to 200c. Line 2 baking trays with non stick baking paper. Spread the bell and celery seeds evenly over the baking paper and bake for 10 minutes, stirring or shaking the tray every couple of minutes until the pepper mixture is dark and crisp, and the celery roots start to soften. Stir the biltong into the biltong mixture and heat through, then remove to a serving dish. Serve hot. I don't add the dressing or seasonings to my biltong.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,extra virgin olive oil,pork chop,sumac,cream
title: Pork Kebabs With Mushrooms and Sour Cream
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh white mushrooms, cleaned | 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 teaspoons sour cream, sour cream flavor | 1 tablespoon sweet sumac | 7 -9 boneless pork chops, about 1-inch thick
instructions: Wash mushrooms, remove dark green stems from mushrooms and finely chop. In a non stick large skillet heat oil, then add pork. Season with sumac and add pork. Stir fry about 10 minutes until browned all over and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,natural peanut butter,gingerroot,black olive,apple,pork rib,apple juice
title: Apple-Ginger Pork Ribs (Slow Cooker or Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 lbs country-style pork ribs, fat separated | 1 cup apple juice | 2 slices fresh gingerroot | 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 12 slices apples ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 cup swiss cheese
instructions: Combine the apple juice, ginger root, peanut butter and 3/4 of the swiss cheese in a small bowl. Rub the pork ribs with the peanut butter spice mixture. Arrange the ham, pork and apple slices on your slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: coffee,head garlic,yellow squash,beef broth,white vinegar,poultry seasoning,garlic paste
title: Roasted Garlic Beef and Yellow Squash
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium beef broth | 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow squash | 1/2 cup beef fat packed sweetened condensed milk | 1/4 cup strong brewed coffee | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped garlic paste | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon white vinegar or 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Place broth and squash in a small saucepan. Cover and simmer over medium low heat until squash is tender, about 20 minutes. Combine the remaining ingredients in a small bowl. When ready to cook, preheat broiler. When vegetables are tender, remove from pan.

title: Miniature Pizzas
ingredients: 1 large poblano chile, seeded | 1 large parsnip, peeled | 24 -30 spring roll wrappers | 12 large prepared pepperoni, thinly sliced | 4 ounces confectioners'sugar | 2 ounces sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Cut the skin and seeds from the poblano chile into thin slices. Cut parsnip and poblano into thin slices. Slice and pit the pepperoni to make 8 thin slices. Dip each pepperoni slice into sherry, then place into a paper towel to drain. Place a spring roll wrapper on a work surface. Place about 1 tablespoon of the poblano, parsnip, and poblano slice onto the wrapper. Sprinkle the top of each sandwich with 2 to 3 teaspoons of the confectioner's sugar and 2 tablespoons sherry. Fold the points of the wad of the wrapper over the filling until it is completely folded into the dough. Repeat with the remaining wrappers. Press the tip of a small knife or a sharp knife in the tops of each mini pizzas. Brush the pizzas with sherry.

title: Brochadish Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 beef brisket ( i prefer london broil, but you can grill it yourself if you want ) | ice | 2 bags frozen broccoli, thawed | 2 bags rice krispies
instructions: In a crock pot, cut the brisket in half, lengthwise, and then crosswise across the grain into 1/2. Place the brisket in the bottom of the crock pot that you are going to cook the brisket in.. You may cut out about 12 slices to fit if you wish, i do. You will want to add about 1/2 a cup of the frozen broccoli when ready to cook the brisket. Cook the brisket in the crock pot on high for about 1 hour, checking to make sure it is heated through and the beef is still well covered with gravy. Turn the heat on to high and stir everything together. Keep on high until the broccoli is just about done, about 2 hours. You might need to add more water if the broccoli falls apart. Take the meat out of the crock pot and set it aside to rest. Place the broccoli in a colander and squeeze out as much water as possible. You want the water to drip off through the broccoli, not to get it to drip back into the pan. If you tear it apart, just put it back in the pot and stir. Place the brisket back in the crock pot, pour in the broccoli and season with salt to taste. Cover and cook on low until broccoli is tender and the meat is falling apart, about 4 - 6 hours. Remove the meat from the brisket to a serving platter. Keep warm until ready to make the sauce.

title: Linguine With Tahini and Spinach
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated cooked linguine | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup light sesame tahini | 1/4 cup jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 2 cups fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon baking soda
instructions: In large bowl mash the tomatoes with a fork until smooth. Add the taco seasoning and stir well to mix. Set aside. Cook the linguine in a large pot of boiling water 4 - 5 minutes, or until just tender. Drain. Return pasta to the pot and mix. Return to medium heat and combine the sesame tahini and jalapenos. Stir in the spinach, and cook until just wilted, stir in the baking soda. Add the tomato mixture and toss to combine.

title: Rhubarb and Rose-Infused Eggplant (Aubergine) & Rose-Rose Water-Scented Rose
ingredients: 3 lbs eggplants ( about 12, each weighing 1 lb. ) | 1 1/2 cups rose water | 3 lbs rhubarb ( about 6 cups )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Pierce the eggplants in 3 or 4 places with a fork. Roast the the eggplants on a rack in 2 to 3 pans for 1 hour or until the skin softens and becomes shriveled. Cool on a rack. Make sure the slices are dry before cooking the rhubarb. Cut the rhubarb into 1 inch lengths. Cut a slit at the stem end of each eggplant. Fill the slit with rhubarb, and tie with kitchen string. Cook the rhubarb in boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes. Drain and serve accompanied by a fresh salad and crusty bread for the table.

title: Beef Salsa Verde
ingredients: 500 g lean ground beef | 1 cup mushroom, chopped finely | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/2 cup salsa verde | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 cup nonfat milk | 1 -2 cup caster sugar
instructions: In a large skillet fry beef, mushrooms, onion, 1/2 cup nonfat milk, sour cream, 1/2 cup caster sugar, nutmeg and turmeric over very low heat, until beef is cooked and liquid has evaporated. In a saucepan, heat remaining 1/2 cup nonfat milk, heat for 1 minute, stirring and then pour mixture over beef mixture and heat until bubbling and hot, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,lemon peel,enchilada sauce,romaine lettuce
title: Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 3 heads romaine lettuce, washed ( about 5 pounds ) | 1 cup diced sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lemon peel | 1 jar of thawed enchilada sauce
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients except enchilada sauce. Stir until oil and lemon peel are well blended. Chill covered several hours, stirring occasionally. Toss lettuce with the enchilada sauce and refrigerate.

title: Asparagus Wraps
ingredients: 2 bunches asparagus, ends trimmed | 8 slices deli smoked ham | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard powder | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 tablespoon un-roasted unrefined cane-flavored mixed peel, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Plunge asparagus spears into boiling water until tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Drain, transfer to a large bowl and allow to cool. When asparagus is cool, remove stems and leaves from asparagus. Snap off tough ends of asparagus. Cut tips from asparagus, if desired. Fill each bun with a slice of ham, followed by a drizzle of mustard powder, coriander and chopped asparagus. Serve at once. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,grain rice,chicken meat,baguette,scotch bonnet pepper,green lentil
title: Chicken Rice Bread and Lentils
ingredients: 8 ounces green lentils, rinsed and picked through | 12 ounces cooked chicken meat, chopped ( from a rotisserie chicken breast ) | 1/4 cup chopped scotch bonnet pepper | 32 leaves phyllo dough | 8 ounces quick-cooking long-grain rice | 1 baguette, sliced in 8 thick rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 deg. F. Spread lentils on a parchment or aluminum foil lined baking sheet. Cover with water 1/3 of the way up, and bake uncovered until water has almost evaporated, about 30 - 40 minutes. While lentils are baking, combine chicken, scotch bonnet pepper and rice. Lay phyllo out on a clean surface. Cover with 6 slices of bread, then a layer of lentils. Continue layering, soaking in water until phyllo sheets have soaked up everything. Remove from oven and cut out 4 - 5 strips of phyllo dough from each sheet, and cut along the edge of the bread. Cover with a piece of bread. Bake 1 hour, until phyllo is dark and crisp. Serve with pita bread and sour cream.

title: Nuclear Noodle Tacos
ingredients: 2 packages taco shell | 1 package frozen bean sprouts, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Fill each taco shell with 1/2 the canola or other neutral vegetable flavor snacks. Arrange the bean sprouts on top.

Random Ingredients: red potato,vanilla,topping,creole seasoning,red enchilada sauce,pesto sauce,apple juice,sage
title: Delicious, Fast and Easy Red Waffle-Cakes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag red potatoes, sliced into 1/4 '' rounds | 1 cup canned red enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 8 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed ( i prefer to use fat free ) | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, fresh and crunchy ( i use homemade pesto that's homemade and is not a `` panna cotta '' ) | 1 teaspoon unsweetened apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 pinch dried sage
instructions: Preheat the waffle iron. Combine the first seven ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Combine the pesto sauce, apple juice, cinnamon, and sage. Spray the skillet with nonstick cooking spray and set over medium heat. Dip each potato slice in the pesto, coating both sides. Cook approximately 5 minutes on each side until golden brown and tender. Serve topped with the remaining pesto, drizzled over the top. Serve with warmed tortillas if desired.

title: Mashed Chilies con Jicama
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 large yellow onion, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 lb dried red chilies, stemmed and stemmed | 2 tablespoons shortening ( may need 2 tbls. more )
instructions: In a blender, combine the jicama, onions, cream of tartar, cayenne, and beef broth and process to smooth. Stir in the chilies and heat the mixture over low fire until the chilies are softened and hot, about 10 minutes. Stir in the shortening of the butter. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,yeast,green bean,honey,lemon peel,apple juice,garlic oil
title: Green Beans 'n' Bread
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice or 1 cup v 8 juice | 3 teaspoons yeast | 1/2 teaspoon honey | 2/3 cup white bread, cubed ( see description ) | 2 tablespoons minced garlic oil | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 1 cup apple juice, yeast, honey, bread cubes, 3 tablespoons garlic oil and lemon peel. Drain 1 cup green beans and arrange on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with half the garlic oil and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of the herb rub. Sprinkle with remaining herb rub. Cover and let stand 1 1/2 to 1 1/2 hours in a warm spot until bubbly. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water, cook the beans until slightly softened, 3 to 5 minutes, then drain and rinse in cold water, and drain again. Cover and let stand for 2 minutes or until cool slightly. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with remaining oil and herbs. Serve warm.

title: Hazelnut Pasta
ingredients: 500 g penne rigate, dried ( or penne with a bit of olive oil and salt ) | 300 g button mushrooms | 100 g corn chips | 200 g grated unpast dried hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 orange, rind of, grated | 1/4 cup chili paste ( or more like a chili powder, or more, or ) | 2 tablespoons milk ( or more )
instructions: Put a pot of water on to boil and salt it. Put a baking sheet on the stove and put the oven on. Meanwhile, put the pasta in a large bowl and cover with plenty of freshly salted cold water. Add a teaspoon of salt. Drain the pasta, run it under the cold water and stir it around until it's all in the boiling water. Meanwhile, cut the mushrooms into 1/2 inch pieces and fry them in a little oil in a large frying pan or wok, with a little water until they're soft, then set aside on kitchen paper or brown paper. Put the pan back on the heat, add the hazelnuts and fry until they're a bit golden and starting to smell aromatic and glistening. Take them out of the pan with a slotted spoon and put them aside. Mix together in a measuring cup the flour, orange rind and chili paste to make a thick paste. Heat a wok and add enough oil to coat the bottom. Then pour the sauce paste onto the wok and turn off the heat completely. Put the pasta back on the heat. Dip each rasher of hazelnuts in the hot sauce, just long enough to make a well in the nuts, then put them back in the sauce. Drain the pasta and put it back in the pot. Take all of the pasta pasta, pile the pasta on top and sprinkle with the fried mushrooms. Pour the remaining sauce over the pasta and mix. Eat it as is or with garlic, salad, saucers, vegetables or just eat it with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,tamari,rice noodle,yeast,dark sesame oil,head garlic,jalapeno chile
title: Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 cup chili sauce | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 red jalapeno chile - stemmed, seeded, and chopped | 1 large head garlic, peeled and chopped | 3 cups hot cooked rice noodles
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the yeast evenly over 1 1/2 cups of warm water. Let stand until creamy, about 10 minutes. Whisk in the oil, chili sauce, tamari, and chili until blended. Place the garlic, jalapeno, and rice noodles in a large pot and stir. Pour the hot noodle sauce onto the noodles in the pot. Stir the noodles with the hot sauce to coat and serve.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,pine nut,red wine vinegar,bell pepper,black tea,steak
title: Spicy Beef Rolls with Chili Pepper
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili-garlic sauce | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon black tea, base | 1 lb steak, thinly sliced | 1 medium bell pepper, deseeded and thinly sliced | pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Combine chili pepper sauce, vinegar, pepper brew, steak and green pepper in a medium bowl. Toss gently to combine. Heat a large non stick frying pan or griddle over moderate heat. Coat well with oil. Pour mixture into hot pan, cooking 3 minutes each side or until lightly browned and cooked to your liking. If mixture starts to stick, loosen edges with a spatula and continue cooking, stirring or shaking pan occasionally until mixture becomes sticky. Cut rolls into four, each piece about 3 - 4 inches long. Top with beef mixture. Dollop with chili pepper sauce mixture. Sprinkle with pine nuts. Serve.

title: Coconut Chardonnay Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup minced fresh harissa ( see my recipe ) | 1 can coconut cream ( or other complimentary cream of coconut ) | 3 tablespoons chardonnay wine
instructions: In a skillet, melt butter over medium high heat. Add the minced harissa and stir with the butter until it begins to turn dark red in color. Add the coconut cream and stir well. Reduce to low heat and let simmer. Serve over cooked rice or as a vegan main dish, paired with warm indian bread.

title: Easy Black Olive Latte
ingredients: 1 cup freshly cut black olives, or to taste | 1/2 cup coffee flavored liqueur | 1/4 cup cornflour
instructions: Pour black olives into a bowl, add coffee flavored liqueur, and stir to coat. Stir in cornflour mixture to form a smooth batter.

Random Ingredients: challah,green zucchini,chili pepper,caraway seed,brown onion,red lentil,vanilla pudding,cardamom
title: Zucchini and Lentil Focaccia
ingredients: 10 slices challah ( can also use a pumpernickel/cinnamon flavored loaf ) | 1 medium red lentils, drained and rinsed | 4 slices green zucchini ( or use a combination ) or 4 slices yellow squash ( or use a combination ) | 1 medium brown onion, thinly sliced ( yellow or white ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed ( slightly crushed if not available ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 chili pepper, seeded and minced ( optional or to taste ) | 2 packages of vanilla instant pudding
instructions: Cut the bread into 1 inch cubes. Place bread cubes, lentils, zucchini, onion, caraway seed, cardamom and chili pepper in a 9x13 baking dish/pan. Pour half of the contents of the vanilla pudding mix into the pan, spreading evenly. Cover with remaining contents of the pudding in the pan, spreading evenly. Cover and bake at 425 degrees f for approximately 1 hour. Allow to set up and cool while preparing your toppings. After removing from oven, cut the foccacia into 4 slices and place in a serving bowl. Drizzle a small amount of olive oil/vinegar on top of foccacia. Or you can add other toppings as desired. Serve with a dollop of ice cream or a dollop of coffee drizzled on top. Note if you would like to freeze this, cover and place in a freezer bag for a month or longer. To defrost, place in a small crock pot and turn on low. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours. Note for those that like to freeze, place on waxed paper lined cookie sheets and place in the freezer for a few hours or overnight. Note for those that like to serve this as a wrap or for dinner, prepare the sandwich the night before and wrap in plastic wrap and then wrap in a towel or paper towels before assembling the party. To freeze, wrap in foil and place in freezer. To reheat on stove top, follow the instructions above and transfer to pot of boiling water. When the sauce is hot, uncover and allow to cool down to warm room temperature. You may want to add a small amount of sugar to taste as it will help the sauce to thicken slightly thereby causing you to get a thicker sauce that could be served alongside the focaccia and the other vegetables that you will bake for your guests.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,oyster sauce,pear,apple,artichoke heart,panko breadcrumb,quinoa,grain mustard

instructions: Combine quinoa, artichoke hearts, mustard, oyster sauce and whipping cream in a large mixing bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Mix well. Add panko and parsley if desired. Spoon into a casserole dish and level top, if desired. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Halibut Adobo
ingredients: 4 large halibut | 4 celery ribs, cut into 2 inch lengths
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place fillets on a shallow 2 1/2 6 by 2 1/2 inch baking pan. Broil 4 inches from heat until well browned and just cooked through, turning once, about 2 minutes per side. Allow fillets to rest for 2 minutes before serving. Note, fish can be frozen for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,parmesan cheese,orange,orange zest,dark brown sugar,hamburger,walla onion
title: Holiday Hamburger and Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 small walla walla walla onion, sliced ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup orange zest, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 2 small oranges, zest of, finely grated ( can also use 1/2 cup orange juice and 1/2 teaspoon orange zest ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Brown hamburger meat in fry pan with a little olive oil/butter. Once browned, add onions and brown sugar to hamburger meat and onions. Continue cooking until onions are soft. title: Chocolate Mango Snow Peas

instructions: Place the snow peas on to a sheet of tin foil and steam for 2 mins on each side, until tender. title: Dutch Pepper and Avocado Salad (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet dried peas | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon fresh dill pickle, minced | 1 teaspoon hot pepper, minced | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 2 large yellow tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons dill pickles, finely shredded | 1 teaspoon del monte original hawaij or habanero sauce or 1 pinch hot sauce
instructions: Place the peas in a large bowl. Cover with hot water, cover and soak for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cover and refrigerate another 2 hours or overnight. Drain peas and tomatoes, remove top layer of peels. Chill dressing. Place peels on lettuce leaves, top with pickles and remaining dressing.

title: Chicken Terrine With Irish Cream
ingredients: 600 ml irish cream | 600 g chicken thighs, skinless ( bone-in if you prefer ) | 4 celery ribs, sliced
instructions: Place the cream in a saucepan, bring to the boil and add the chicken. Cover with a lid and simmer gently for 30 minutes on low. Add celery and continue simmering. Remove from heat and place in a plastic bag for 5 minutes for the chicken to swell. When cool, remove the skin and bones with a large sharp knife and chop finely. Place the chicken mixture in a plastic container and freeze. It will keep for up to 5 days. Invert the terrine onto a large chopping board and cut slices across to serve.

title: Broccoli and Spinach Soup

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the broccoli and cook until bright green, then add soup, spinach leaves and stock, if using, and bring to a boil again. Add the pasta and cook, covered, over medium heat until pasta is tender and soup is heated through. Add tarragon, adjust seasoning, and serve.

Random Ingredients: fruit,fish sauce,asparagus spear,coriander powder,lime,cardamom powder,white bread

instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well to coat steaks.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook pasta shells in boiling water to pasta shells, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, drain cod and cut into pieces. Place in a medium bowl with mayonnaise, mint, scallions, and cooked pasta. Toss with desired amount of dressing. Serve and enjoy.

instructions: Cover figs with cold water and soak 20 minutes. Drain and squeeze excess water out. Cover figs with cold water and soak 20 minutes. Drain and squeeze excess water out. Combine chicken with anchovies in a bowl, cover and refrigerate. Place figs, pineapple and chicken on skewers and brush with olive oil. Grill over medium coals for 4 minutes per side.

title: Chile Cabbage Rolls Appetizer
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1/4 head napa cabbage, shredded | 6 ounces cream cheese, finely chopped | 1/4 cup low-fat buttermilk | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 medium anaheim chili, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the shredded cabbage and napa cabbage. Set aside to drain. Blend together the cream cheese, buttermilk, vinegar and soy sauce until smooth. title: Garnish Dip for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, your choice | 1 bottle greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon cracked peppercorn ( optional ) | club soda
instructions: Prepare noodles first. Put in a large bowl, the noodles should not swim in the soda. While the water is coming to a boil put in the cream celery soup and spaghetti sauce. I usually don't drain the soup or spaghetti sauce when it boils though. It should be slightly thickened, like sour cream. Add the cracked peppercorns, if desired. Drain the noodles, but just let them sit a few minutes before using. Add the garnish mixture to the noodles. Serve with cocktail sticks or vegetables. If you're not going to use a non stick frypan, use a large frypan, such as cast iron, to melt the noodles. It's pretty much the same process, with as little fat or other additives. Makes a very rich and creamy dip. We have found it works best to make it a little more to suit our taste. It's nice with toasted, chopped bread or toasted buns to make it more festive.

title: Spinach With Dates and Brandy
ingredients: 300 g baby spinach | 100 g bran cereal bars, finely crumbled | 200 g dates, pitted
instructions: Place the bran in a bowl and add 100ml boiling water. Add the spinach, stirring to ensure that all the ingredients are evenly coated. Allow it to cool then add the crumbled bran and dates. Serve immediately.

instructions: Fill a 9 inch nonstick skillet with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Add broccoli and 1/2 t. Salt. Cook until crisp tender, 2 - 3 minutes, depending on thickness. Rinse with cold water and drain well. Repeat until all the water and broccoli are cooked. Place in a large serving bowl or soup tureen and serve.

title: Rosemary Steak (Low Fat)
ingredients: 800 g beef flank steak ( trimmed or fat trimmed ) | 1/2 cup fresh rosemary leaf | 1 medium eggplant
instructions: Slice eggplant into about 5mm thick rounds approx 12 x 5cm and lightly prick it with a fork and place on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Place in the oven and bake 30 minutes while preparing the steak. Drain the eggplant and slice into 3mm thick rounds using a vegetable peeler or a very sharp knife. Slice the steak diagonally into 2cm thick slices and brush with rosemary and set aside. Remove the eggplant from the oven, and place on top of the rosemary, toss to coat well with rosemary and bake in the oven on the top shelf of the oven for about 20 minutes or until cooked. Serve hot with roast beef on top of the eggplants, or your favourite roast vegetables.

title: Quick Banana Nuts

instructions: In a small bowl combine bananas and yogurt. Sprinkle with peanuts if desired. Serve warm.

title: Ginger Ferrero
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 1/2 inches peeled ginger ale | 1 tablespoon gherkin, chopped | 2 tablespoons asiago cheese, finely grated | 3 cardamoms, roasted in a frying pan | 1/3 teaspoon turmeric powder | pineapple juice
instructions: Make the gingerale by stirring ginger ale into gherkins. Spread ginger ale into a pastry dish or bowl. Wrap pastry tightly with a double thickness of foil. Chill. Preheat oven to 400°f. Place pastry on a tray and bake for 20 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 150°f. Remove pastry from oven and place onto a serving platter. Reduce the oven temperature to 200°f. Place ginger ale into a bowl. Fold in gherkin, cheese, cardamom and turmeric. Add a little pineapple juice to juice if too thick or add to the ginger ale mixture to smooth out. Place ginger ale mixture in a pastry bag fitted with a plain/tangible tip. Press the air outwards. Place a piece of pastry onto a plate. Place a cherry piece onto the plate. Cut a cross on the bottom of the pastry. Dip pastry into the ginger ale, then roll the pastry up like a swiss roll. Repeat with remaining pastry until the pastry has been used all the way through. Pour the juices over the top and sides of the pastry. Serve immediately. Note that the juice is the concentrate, not the apple juice the ginerale.

instructions: Slice the beef into 1/4 inch thick slices and place in shallow glass baking dish. Combine all remaining ingredients and pour over the sausage. Refrigerate covered for 2 hours or up to 24 hours. Preheat grill or broiler. Place the grill or broiler pan over high heat.

instructions: Marinade, mix all ingredients into a jar or a lidded container. Cover and add extra chilli oil if necessary. title: Pico De Gallo Pork
ingredients: 3 -4 slices pork fillets | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar ( rice vinegar is highly recommended ) | 3 tablespoons pico de gallo ( sweet chili sauce made in a jar is preferred ) | 1 cup dry unsweetened coconut flakes
instructions: Cut the pork into 6 or 8 large pieces, if using whole pork fillets. Spray the grill or oven rack with nonstick cooking spray, or place in the bottom of a broiling pan. When cool, add the dried coconut flakes to the coconut flakes to warm and set aside. Heat grill or broiler to high. Place the pork fillets on a preheated grill or broiler pan with the skin side down. Cook on high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. Remove from the heat, and allow to cool slightly, then slice into thick slices. Serve warm with a variety of spuds, rice and beans.

title: Papaya-Potatoes Breakfast
ingredients: 6 ounces papayas, canned | 2 medium potatoes, medium | 8 large egg whites, beaten lightly | 1 tablespoon lemon juice from 1 lemon | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 4 drops tabasco sauce | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Drain and rinse the papayas. Cut into 1 inch pieces and place in a food processor. Add the potatoes and toss together until coated. In a bowl mix the remaining egg whites, lemon juice and mace. Add half the egg whites mixture to the papaya mixture along with the tabasco to taste. Beat until they are well mixed. Pour mixture into a 1 - ½ quart casserole dish sprayed with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350°f. Bake for about 30 minutes or until set. Serve hot with salsa.

title: Basic Shortbread
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the flour, seasoning salt, and flour using your hands. Rub the dough with your fingers until it forms a rough ball. Roll or press the dough into a log using an oiled cookie cutter or a glass. Cut into fingers, and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Gather together the scraps of the dough, and re roll or pinch with your hands to form dough into balls about 1/2 inch wide by 3 inches long. Flatten slightly with a fork, and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Use a metal spatula to shape your dough into a uniform circle. Place the baking sheet in the oven, and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until lightly browned. Remove from the oven, place a slice of ginger in the center, drizzle with butter, and cut into pieces.

Random Ingredients: black olive,pumpkin,lemon peel,coriander seed,tomato soup,cinnamon,chili sauce,walnut oil
title: Nepalese Pumpkin Burgers (Coxin Free)
ingredients: 500 g pumpkin | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 2 teaspoons black olives, chopped | 500 ml sweet chili sauce ( sutter home sweet chilli sauce ) | 50 ml walnut oil | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon peel, finely shredded | 1 can condensed tomato soup
instructions: Cut the top off the pumpkin ‘breast’. Remove the flesh from the outside and reserve the pulp for further use. Cut away the base around the pumpkin ‘breast’ and discard the pulp. Chop the flesh into chunks and set aside. To make the berbere spice mix, mix together the coriander and cinnamon, olives, chilli sauce, walnut oil, lemon peel and tomato soup. Cover and refrigerate for up to one week. To prepare, drain the pumpkin and discard the top and bottom and remove the flesh from the center. Slice the flesh thinly, arrange on baking sheet with the back of a knife, cover and place in the freezer for 20 minutes. Heat a frying pan on low heat, add the berberere powder and cook for a minute, then add the pumpkin ‘breasts’. Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes. Remove the lid and stir to break the potato up, continue to cook until the potato is cooked through and becomes crispy and dry. Remove potatoes from the pan. Cut into 2cm cubes and leave aside. Remove the fat from the frying pan over medium heat and add the tomato soup, stir continuously, allowing the soup to bubble for 3 minutes. Add the pureed potato pieces and mix well. Serve the mix in the baking tray with the potato slices.

title: Rice Noodle Casserole with Strawberries and Provolone
ingredients: 2 packages fresh rice noodles, or more to taste | 1/3 cup milk | 4 large fresh strawberries, thinly sliced | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 2 pinches asafoetida powder | 2 slices provolone cheese | 1/4 cup uncooked arborio rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 10x15 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place rice noodles into the boiling water.

title: Russian-Style Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 7 1/2 cups low-fat plain yogurt ( or sour cream ) | 3 1/2 cups vegetable stock ( or water ) | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 teaspoon caraway ( caraway powder can be substituted ) | 3 teaspoons miso ( or red pepper flakes, for a darker taste )
instructions: In a medium size bowl, whisk together the low fat yogurt and the vegetable stock. In another smaller bowl, dissolve the yeast in 1 teaspoons water and stir it into the potato mixture. Let sit to dissolve the yeast. Stir in the caraway and miso.

title: Quick and Easy Cheesy Roasted Dates
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oleo, butter | 2 tablespoons pitted dates | 1 2/3 cups pasta sauce, such as spaghetti or 1 2/3 cups pizza sauce | 1/2 loaf fresh rye bread, sliced, toasted, cut into 4 diagonal slices
instructions: Heat oven to 250°f. In small bowl, combine oleo and 2 tablespoons water. Brush onto cut sides of bread and sprinkle with salt. Arrange bread slices in single layer on baking stone. Cook 8 - 10 minutes until tops are golden. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,pam cooking spray,swiss cheese,sherry wine,tomato juice,currant,chunky salsa,salsa
title: Zesty Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cup rice wine | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 3 1/2 ounces chunky salsa | 3 ounces currants | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 4 ounces swiss cheese, shredded ( or your favorite ) | pam cooking spray | 1 cup thick & chunky salsa ( or your favorite )
instructions: Add diced tomatoes and chunky salsa. Spray pam in a pan. Heat to boiling. Turn down heat.

title: Spiced Spinach With Rice
ingredients: 3 ounces rice or 3 ounces basmati rice | 2 lbs fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 6 ounces tomato sauce | 3 sprigs fresh thyme | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Put the rice in a bowl with 4 - 6 cups cold water. Cover, allow to stand for 20 - 25 minutes. Rinse with cold water and drain. Bring a pan of salted water to the boil. Place the spinach on to a baking sheet and steam for 5 mins until tender. Rinse with cold water and drain well. Put the rice and water in a bowl and mix. Heat a little oil in a large saucepan. Add the cumin seeds. When they start popping, add the rice and black pepper. Stir fry for a couple of mins until all the water has been absorbed. Reduce the heat, add the tomato sauce and sprigs of herbs and heat over a very low heat for about 10 mins until the sauce reduces a little. Serve hot, with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: saffron,white wine,kaffir lime leaf,basil leaf,fish fillet,cornstarch,rye bread,beef
title: P F Chang's Steamed Fish & Beef Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet | 1/2 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons finely chopped kaffir lime leaves ( with seeds below ) | 20 fresh basil leaves | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup beef or 1 cup vegetable stock | 8 slices rye bread ( i use multi grain or white bread ) | 2 teaspoons saffron | 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Make the meat mixture. Mix the ground beef, minced kaffir lime leaves and beef/vegetable stock in a large shallow pot. Add saffron. Cover and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and let simmer until mixture thickens slightly. Stir in wine. Heat your broiler. Slice the bread into wedges. Spread a thick layer of the meat mixture on each slice of bread. Put each piece of bread on a cookie sheet, and bake in the oven until the top bread is toasted, and the toasted bread is dry too. Set aside on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: date,coconut milk,cooking spray,radish,shallot,serrano chilies,tomato sauce,sea salt
title: Soup Tomatillo
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce | 1 cup cooked medium-grain rice ( arborio ) | 1/2 cup small dried coconut milk | 1/2 cup diced shallot | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 2 red anaheim chili peppers, seeded and minced | 3 serrano chilies, seeded and minced | cooking spray
instructions: Combine the tomato sauce, rice, coconut milk, shallots, salt, chiles and water in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cover and boil 1 minute. Gently stir in the chili, cover and cook for 10 minutes while you make the soup. When the soup is cooked, remove from the heat, and set aside. To serve, ladle the soup into soup bowls, and place a piece of lettuce in the center.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,cream tartar,natural peanut butter,celery,chicken breast half,yellow onion,cremini mushroom,artichoke heart
title: Chicken Peanut Butter Pizza
ingredients: 8 thin slices of baked pizza crust | 1/2 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 medium yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1 large cooked chicken breast half, coarsely chopped | 15 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 16 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 2 stalks chopped celery
instructions: To make crust, preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread peanut butter on pizza crust. Sprinkle with cream of tartar. Mix onion, chicken, mushrooms, artichoke hearts, celery and 1/2 c water in frying pan. Pour over peanut butter crust. Bake in oven for 15 minutes or until crust is lightly browned on top. Cut pizza into 5 individual pieces.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,green bell pepper,mini chocolate chip,bacardi rum,seasoning salt,grape,chanterelle mushroom
title: Cajun Stuffed Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | 1 tablespoon bacardi light rum | 2 pounds pork tenderloins | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 2 green bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips | 6 chanterelle mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon bacardi light rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 13x9 inch baking dish. Place the mini chocolate chip and 1 tablespoon of the rum into a microwave safe bowl, and heat on high power for 5 minutes. Remove, and set aside. Cut side of tenderloins almost all the way through so you have two long slices. Spread a small amount of the rum mixture evenly over the top of each tenderloin. Place the tenderloins on the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with seasoning salt. Repeat for each meat. Smear about 2 tablespoons of the chocolate mixture on top of each tenderloin. Arrange green bell peppers, chanterelles, and mushrooms evenly over the top. Stir the remaining 1 tablespoon of rum mixture into the remaining 1 tablespoon of rum, and pour over all of the tenderloins. Cover, and place into the preheated oven. Bake until tenderloins are no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour. Remove from oven, and allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing into medallions.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,plain yogurt,lettuce leaf,soya sauce,plain flour,brandy
title: Kara Kebab (Beef Roulade)
ingredients: 250 g plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 3 tablespoons brandy | 5 tablespoons plain flour ( plain flour will also do ) | 2 -3 lettuce leaves | 2 -3 slices cheddar cheese
instructions: Cut the kababs into 5mm slices. Spread each base slice with the yoghurt. Place the soya sauce and brandy in a microwave safe jug and heat in the microwave for 4 minutes using 600w/400f/6 minutes, for best results. Sprinkle a little flour over the kababs while grilling. Add grated lettuce and the slices of cheese on top. Microwave for 1 minute or until the cheese melts. Serve with rice.

title: Simple Beef and Bananas
ingredients: 6 lean hamburger, cut into 8 chunks | 1 large carrot, diced | 1 liter fresh broth ( beef or chicken can be used here ) | 3 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 3 bananas, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 1 1 cup apple ( optional )
instructions: In a large nonstick frying pan, over medium high heat, crumble the hamburger into small crumbles. Add carrots to the meat and cook, stirring, until no longer pink, about 4 - 5 minutes. Stir in broth, tamari, and bananas. Cover and simmer over low heat for 2 - 2 1/2 hours or until the meat is very tender. Stir occasionally to make sure liquid doesn't become too thick and brown.

Random Ingredients: greek oregano,chicken breast half,cocktail onion,butter margarine
title: Greek Spice Chicken
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup butter or margarine | 1 teaspoon greek oregano | 2 -3 tablespoons cocktail-size pieces of chopped assorted cocktail onions
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts in half. Heat your favorite nonstick skillet until just beginning to get nice and hot. Brush with margarine then sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of the oregano. Add the chicken and cook on both sides until nicely browned. Cover to keep warm. Place the rest of the oregano and cocktail onion around the chicken. Cook chicken again to lightly brown for just a few minutes. Place the pan under the broiler and brown the meat on both sides.. Serve with a greek salad & a cold beer.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,cantaloupe ball,sharp cheddar cheese,pepperoni,egg noodle,hamburger,pecorino cheese,allspice
title: Quick and Easy Italian Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 lb hamburger sandwich bun or 1 lb sandwich bun, cut diagonally across the loaf | 2 cans condensed milk powder | 1/2 cup finely shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup grated pecorino cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepperoni | 1 box egg noodles, cooked and hot ( about 5 minute and 5 minute portions ) | purchased sliced pecorino cheese ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f lightly spray 12x8 baking dish with cooking oil. Cook hamburger and next 5 ingredients in large skillet over medium high heat until hamburger is brown.

title: German Kielbasa Appetizer – Sausage With an Attitude (German)
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs jock kielbasa, smoked and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar ( or white vinegar of your choice, i prefer the vinegar of anchar ) | 1 can anchovies ( drained and rinsed of their oil ) | boiling water, as needed ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Heat a pot over medium heat. Add oil. When the oil is hot, fry sliced sausage until crisp on both sides. Remove from pan and set aside. Turn the heat down until the oil is hot. Add the vinegar to the pan and raise the heat to medium. Add the drained anchovies and raise heat a little bit. Saute anchovies until they are heated through. Serve in the sausage can, with a nice red cabbage salad. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,chili sauce,beef bouillon cube,balsamic vinegar,saffron,radish,tomatillo,mexican chocolate
title: Paleo and Saffron Beef Soup (Ajiaco)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean beef bones, meaty | 1 pint tomatillo, husked and rinsed | 6 sprigs lemongrass ( use lemongrass stalk ) | 4 chicken bouillon cubes, crumbled | 1 tablespoon spicy chili sauce | 8 ounces mexican chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Heat a large, heavy bottomed pot over medium high heat. Brown the beef in batches. Transfer to a bowl. Drain off all but 1/4 cup of fat in pot. Add tomatillos, lemongrass, bouillon cubes, chili sauce.

title: Almond Chicken Sausages (Cajun)
ingredients: 7 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 3/4 cup prepared hot sauce ( i use frank's hot sauce ) | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 package chicken or sausage links, sliced, i use hot dogs | 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Grease a shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Whisk cornmeal, hotsauce, garlic, and hot sauce mixture in a small bowl. Place sausage in a shallow bowl. Dip 1 slice of almond in hot sauce mixture then drain on a clean kitchen towl. Arrange 1 sausage in the prepared baking dish, and sprinkle with remaining slices. Bake in preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 15 minutes.

title: Chile Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 5 sprigs thyme | 1/4 cup garlic and red chile paste
instructions: Remove thyme sprigs. Sprinkle thyme over the top. Melt the mixture in a skillet over medium heat until a creamy white coating forms on the surface, 2 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir chile paste into the coating, and coat generously. Allow to set, 1 to 2 minutes, then remove from heat.

title: Green Chile Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans diced green chile peppers | 1 1/2 cups margarine | 2 limes, juice of
instructions: Heat margarine. Stir in chiles. Stir in lime juice, cook and stir for 3 to 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: mostaccioli pasta,vegetable broth,pizza crust,tikka paste,jalapeno jack cheese
title: My Italian Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans vegetarian broth | 1 jar tikka paste | 1 package mostaccioli pasta ( spirals, elbow, spiral ) | 1 pre-baked pizza crust | 1 1/2 cups chopped jalapeno jack cheese or 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine broth and tikka paste, and bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes, and then lower heat. Add pasta. Cook until heated through. Pour mixture into prepared oven dish. Distribute pepper jack evenly over the pasta. Cover with remaining cheese. Bake in 400f oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,clear honey,napa cabbage,tortilla,cake flour,meat,pork,gruyere cheese
title: Meat & Gruyere Tortilla (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3 )
ingredients: 100 g lean lean ground meat or 100 g extra lean ground beef | 100 g lean ground pork | 85 g gruyere cheese, finely diced | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1/2 tablespoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons cake flour | 6 slices napa cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup clear honey-roasted sunflower honey-dried tomatoes, finely chopped | 4 soft tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c or 170°c if using lean ground meat. Combine the lean meat, pork, cheese, 1 tablespoon honey, lemon zest, and the cake flour in a bowl. Divide and mix the meat mixture into four equal mixtures.

title: Orecchiette With Pecans, Orecitos and Pecans
ingredients: 100 g orecchiette | 100 g pecan pieces
instructions: Fill 2 liters with water, add 1oz piece of pecan and salt. Cover and bring to boil. After 10 minutes, lower heat and cook for a further 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cook orecchiette until 'al dente'. Remove from heat and set aside. Return the pot to medium heat and add remaining pecan pieces. Stir fry for 4 minutes. Turn off heat. Put orecchiette in serving bowl, pour over pecan mixture and serve.

title: Mexican Steak with Red Wine
ingredients: 2 lbs center cut fat sirloin steaks | 1/2 cup red wine | 1 packet taco seasoning
instructions: Pour wine over steaks and marinate at least 2 hours at room temperature or in refrigerator overnight. Grill steak to desired doneness, basting frequently for 12 - 16 minutes or for desired temperature. Remove steaks and drain excess marinade. Serve on buns.

Random Ingredients: lime,spaghetti sauce,ginger garlic paste,mushroom,tart green apple,lettuce leaf
title: Green Apple spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 cup shredded lettuce leaf | 1/2 cup thinly sliced fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup chopped peeled tart green apple | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 jar prepared spaghetti sauce, chilled | 1 lime
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine lettuce, mushrooms, apple, ginger garlic paste with spaghetti sauce and and lime juice to taste. Toss lightly until evenly coated.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,spinach leaf,raspberry,chicken bouillon cube,beet,superfine sugar
title: Chard, Or Beets, and Raspberry Soup
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups fresh spinach leaves ( or 4 7-oz. rinsed baby beet leaves, trimmed, torn into 1 inch pieces ) | 1 1 cup beet ( or beet, peeled and chopped ) | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2/3 cup raspberries | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a colander, toss spinach with 2 tablespoons water. Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Drain well and discard water. In a heavy large pot, heat the chicken soup base over medium heat. Add the remaining ingredients except the pistine, cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with pistine and serve. Pass the parmigiano reggiano.

title: Lemon Thyme Gruyère With Onions
ingredients: 3 tablespoons water | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 2 cups gruyere cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon minced lemon thyme leaves | 1 cup crushed ice water
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, blend water and soup mix.

title: Italian Spinach Salad

instructions: Toss lettuce with remaining ingredients in a salad bowl to coat. Chill for at least 3 hours.

title: Mashed Potato With Artichokes (Michael Smith)
ingredients: 4 large baby carrots | 1 package of havarti cheese | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 ounces ketchup | 2 ounces marsala wine | 1 teaspoon sumac | 2 -3 dashes black pepper
instructions: Boil up in a large pot, the carrots, artichokes and spices. After boiling, let them cook out about 1 minute so the starch and oil separates from the carrots and artichoke mixture. While the soup is boiling, combine the soup ingredients in a separate mixing bowl and add the mixture on top of the carrots and artichoke and combine thoroughly, then add to the pot along with the sauce. Bring the soup to a boil and then simmer for about 2 - 3 minutes and then serve.

title: Pork and Veal Rounds

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. To make crust.

title: Tortellini With Chili and Black Beans
ingredients: 16 ounces cheese tortellini ( or rotini or cavatappi or penne ) | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil ( optional ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with roasted peppers and their juice | 2 pimento pepper, seeded and diced | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup sherry | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon dry sherry wine ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile in a saucepan over medium heat, warm oil. Sauté pimentos for 1 - 2 minutes or until slightly softened. Add beans and toss to coat thoroughly with oil. Add sherry and stir until heated. Stir in cooked tortellini and heat through. Taste and adjust seasonings. You can serve the hot tortellini with the chili on the side. Serve over your favorite salad and pass extra chili on the side.

title: Coconut and Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 can coconut powder | 1 beef tenderloin ( about 2.5 pound total )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a small bowl, mix coconut powder with coconut milk to make a thick paste. Slice beef into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Nua Sawai Pickled Salmon  (Shrimp )
ingredients: 1 head garlic, cleaned | 3 inches fresh gingerroot | 4 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 4 drops tobasco sauce | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seeds, lightly crushed
instructions: Peel garlic and garlic. Cut 2 inch section of ginger, 1 cm deep, into small slivers. Place ginger and garlic in a bowl and set aside. Finely chop remaining ginger. Drain off excess water from bowl. Cut ginger ginger slivers into slivers and place in mortar. Add mustard powder, mustard powder, tabasco, chili flakes, cardamom and remaining ginger slivers. Mix well. Pack a thin layer of paste all over the fish. Place on a platter and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, up to overnight. Transfer the pickled salmon to a serving platter and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, as best results serve with jasmine and basmati rice.

title: Tofu Soup
ingredients: 250 g tofu, cubed | 1 teaspoon savory
