ingredients: 800 g beef tenderloin steaks | 1 tablespoon light sour cream or 1 tablespoon light sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt | pepper oil ( for frying ) | 4 slices gingerroot | 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning mix or 1/2 teaspoon creme fraiche | 2 teaspoons creme fraiche
instructions: Trim fat from steak.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,ketchup,tahini paste,pepperoni,sparerib,granny smith apple,green cardamom pod
title: Lebanese Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs country-style spareribs | 1/3 cup vinegar | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 3 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 4 slices granny smith apples | 1 tablespoon toasted tahini paste | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoni, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut spareribs crosswise into four 1 - 2 wide sections. Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Rinse and pat dry.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,vegetable stock,rub,limeade concentrate,apple,cardamom pod,beef bouillon cube,natural yoghurt
title: Baked Karela
ingredients: 500 -600 g apple, peeled and roughly diced | 500 ml vegetable stock | 300 ml natural yoghurt or 300 ml greek yogurt | 100 ml limeade concentrate | 2 -3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 inch cinnamon bark | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degree f. Boil water and add beef bouillon cubes. Add the apple and vegetable stock and cook for 3 minutes. Make sure the beef is completely covered and simmer until the apple is soft. Stir every so often. Add the yoghurt or Greek yogurt and mix with a wooden spoon. Add the limeade concentrate. Add spices and spices. The stock should almost cover everything. Transfer into a well buttered casserole dish. Bake for 1 hour or until the stock has reduced and is starting to smell fragrant. You can top the karela with coriander, chives and mint if you like.

title: Picante Beef in Feta  Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef, cooked thoroughly ( or a mixture ) | 6 ounces feta, crumbled | 4 ounces white onions, diced | 1 can beef consomme | 6 ounces picante sauce | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 chili
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Lightly grease a 9x13 pan. Spray pan with cooking spray. Brown meat and onions on medium heat. Drain. Return to pan. Add consommé, picante sauce, chili sauce, soy sauce and cheese. Transfer to oven. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Roasted Beet and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs mushrooms ( mixed mushrooms with caps ) | 1 1/2 lbs beet, peeled, cut into 1 inch thick slices ( small beets ) | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 can or bottle dark berry colavita cocktail | 1/2 cup blueberries ( to garnish )
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a large saucepan. Cover with water, just below top of pan.

title: Mackerel Mackerel Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 cans mackerel ( the liquid drained ) | 7 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 lb egg noodles | 1 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter | 2 cups green olives ( pitted or sliced ) | 1/2 cup kahlua ( i used kahlua black liqueur ) ( optional )
instructions: Drain most of the liquid of the mackerel into a large saucepan and cook over medium heat until very thick. Drain the mackerel in a colander then place into a food processor and puree thoroughly. Add a1 sauce to the mackerel and puree until smooth. Add the remaining ingredients and mix gently. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until liquid is reduced slightly and flavors are well blended. Turn off heat and allow to stand at room temperature for a few hours. Serve over hot, cooked egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,parsnip,onion soup mix,parmesan cheese,serrano pepper,spice,beef tenderloin,double cream
title: Spiced Beef Tenderloin With Parsnips
ingredients: 3 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 4 ounces onions soup mix | 4 ounces butter | 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons parsnips, minced | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: Combine vinegar and spice in a large shallow baking dish. Cover and marinate beef for 3 hours 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Melt butter in heavy skillet over high heat. Add the beef to the skillet and brown lightly on all sides. Remove beef to plate. Deglaze the skillet with the onion soup mix, scraping up browned bits from the bottom. Transfer liquid in skillet to a small bowl. Add parsnip, parmesan cheese, cream and wine mixture. Cook until heated through about 3 minutes. Transfer beef to oven and bake for 20 minutes. Remove meat and set oven temperature to 400 degrees. Baste the meat with pan juices. Return to oven and cook another 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for 3 to 5 minutes. Slice and serve warm.

title: Fat Free White Bean Dip
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups nonfat plain yogurt ( i use low fat ) | 4 cans white beans, drained or ( 19 ounce ) cans peas | 1 cup smoked salmon or 1 cup any smoked hot dog, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup salami, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup romano cheese or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground mixed spice
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together yogurt, beans, salmon, cheese, mixed spices. Enjoy dip when it's time to eat. Variation, substitute any other protein for the salami for the hot dog pieces.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,lamb shank,bean sprout,broccoli,green pea,hungarian paprika,head garlic
title: Hungarian Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 6 lamb shanks, well trimmed | 6 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 3 large heads of garlic, split | 2 1/2 cups fresh shelled green peas or 2 1/2 cups canned green peas | 2 -3 cups mixed baby corn or 1 large head fresh broccoli | 8 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1/3 cup crushed crisp-cooked beans with pinto or 1/3 cup tomato
instructions: Lightly coat a large skillet with cooking oil. Place the meat and fat in the skillet with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer about 1 hour. Drain off fat and skim off fat. Add half of the paprika to the meat mixture and boil, stirring, 1 minute. Remove from pan and reserve. Repeat with 6 more lamb shanks. Add a little more oil to the pan and brown the garlic. Remove from pan. Add the peas, corn, bean sprouts and the remaining paprika.

Random Ingredients: pork fillet,dark sesame oil,baking soda,lime juice
title: Pork Fritters With Lime
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs pork fillets | 6 tablespoons lime juice, divided | 1 1/4 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil, divided
instructions: Trim fat from pork and cut into 1 inch cubes, then rinse. Place pork in a shallow nonreactive ceramic dish with 2 tablespoons of the lime juice and 1/2 teaspoon of the baking soda. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Drain pork and dry. Combine remaining 2 tablespoons of lime juice with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda, remaining teaspoon of the baking soda, and remaining tablespoon of lime juice, stirring to blend. Pour over pork pieces. Cover and refrigerate at least 20 minutes. Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place pork in pan and stir for 2 - 3 minutes, or until done. Serve pork with reserved marinade and lime wedges.

title: Easy Chili-Masa-Tear-Sweet Slices
ingredients: 4 dried red chilies | 1/4 cup masa harina, or more if needed | 2 teaspoons hot chile powder, or to taste | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil. Place dried red chilies into the boiling water, and set aside to soak for 15 minutes. When chilies are soft, transfer chilies to a blender, and mash with a fork. Beat in masa harina and hot chile powder until combined. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ladyfingers onto prepared baking sheet, and brush with a little of the chili mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until firm. Cool, and cut into finger sized pieces. Serve warm.

title: Faux Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 can pizza sauce | 1 lb fresh pears, peeled and chopped | 1 cucumber, peeled and chopped | 3 green chilies, minced | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 12 slices fresh fat free crusty soft roll, thawed | 2 tablespoons fat-free whipped topping, thawed ( optional )
instructions: Drain the tomato juice from the can into a medium saucepan. Add the pears, cucumber, chilies, and turmeric. Cover and simmer on low heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 3 tablespoons tahini | 6 tablespoons palm sugar | 3/4 lb cauliflower floret, separated into florets | 1 dried chile, stems removed
instructions: Heat oil in a 3 to 6 quart skillet over medium heat. Stir in tahini and sugar, and cook until golden, about 2 minutes. Stir in cauliflower and chile, and cook 4 minutes, or until heated through. Serve fritters hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon,duck,cooking oil,tabasco sauce,soy sauce,extra virgin olive oil,vegetable broth,taco seasoning
title: French Family Roast Duck
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 1 cup vegetable broth | 2 duck | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons lemon rind, grated | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning ( or other seasoning )
instructions: Preheat ove to bake 325 degrees f. Wrap duck in moist cloth and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 1 hour, basting once half way. Remove from oven and place on carving board. Cover with foil and cool for 5 minutes, cut open. Reserve juices. Prick duck with fork and brush with 1 tbs. Becel oil. Place duck on platter, drizzle with reserved juices, sprinkle with taco seasoning, and broil with upper edges until duck is well browned. Serve with your favorite sauce.

title: Spanish Bread With Chorizo
ingredients: 1 french baguette, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/3 lb chorizo sausage, thinly sliced ( or pork or beef ) | 1 can green peas, drained | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 13 x 9 by 2 inch baking pan with foil. Toast baguette slices, cut side up in two rows of 2 inch slices, 1 inch apart, 1 inch apart, until lightly browned and crisp. Remove from oven and set aside. Meanwhile, heat a 10 inch skillet over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Add chorizo, peas and frozen whipped topping to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until hot, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, warm bread slices. Spread chorizo mixture evenly in the pan. Place each slice on top of the stuffed bread. Bake for 20 minutes or until bread is crisp and a golden brown.

title: Red Poblano Chile & Sun-Dried Tomato Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 2 cups packed sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil, drained on paper towels | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch wide strips | 1 small head of lettuce
instructions: Place the sun dried tomatoes and poblano strips in a food processor fitted with metal blade. Pulse just to chop. Remove from food processor and stir in the roasted bell peppers. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Just before serving, let the mixture stand at room temperature until flavors are blended. Serve with your choice of side dishes.

Random Ingredients: lime,snow pea,spaghetti sauce mix,phyllo dough,jarlsberg cheese
title: Jarlsberg Cheese Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions | 1 1/4 lbs grated jarlsberg cheese ( about 12 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons spaghetti sauce mix ( dry ) | 1/2 cup chopped snow peas | 1 small lime, seeded and finely grated zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Set a 12x16 inch metal baking sheet on a heavy baking sheet. Unwrap phyllo sheets, and place flat on sheet. Brush 1 sheet lightly with olive oil, and cover with second sheet, brushing again with olive oil. Brush top sheet lightly with oil, and sprinkle with jarlsberg's cheese. Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets, brushing each with more olive oil. Spread 1/4 inch sauce mix all over the top, and top with snow peas, snow peas, and lime zest. Bake for about 25 minutes, until mixture is bubbly and cheese is slightly browned. Remove from oven, and cut into squares.

title: Italian Inn Marinated Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 box mandarin oranges | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 4 slices prosciutto, cut into 1/3-inch dice
instructions: Remove peel from oranges. Slice orange sections in half crosswise, then into thin slices. In a small bowl, stir soy sauce, basil, savory, salt, and vanilla until well mixed. Arrange 1/2 of the prosciutto slices on serving plate. Arrange 1/2 of the citrus slices over prosciutto, then drizzle over remaining soy sauce mixture. Top with remaining prosciutto slices. Garnish with remaining 1/4 prosciutto slices.

title: Pineapple and Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta | 14 ounces pineapple juice
instructions: First cook the farfalle pasta according to the directions. Rinse the pasta. Drain well. Place into a large bowl and add the pineapple juice and stir well. Add the farfalle and toss well until well coated.

Random Ingredients: glaze,shell pasta,salt pork,beef roast,greek feta cheese,ginger paste,beer
title: The Shabbat's Beef and Grapes
ingredients: 1/2 lb small shell pasta | 1 slice salt pork | 2 lbs boneless beef roast, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/2 cup old fashioned beer, such as budweiser | 1/3 cup greek feta cheese
instructions: Remove and discard tough center from pasta. Drain pasta and set aside. Pat salt pork dry and pound thin to remove excess salt. Pound thin slices. In dutch oven or heavy pot cook salt pork and beef until beef is brown and onion is translucent. Remove beef with slotted spoon to bowl. Add salt and ginger paste to the pot, cook one minute stirring constantly. Stir in beer. Return beef, onion and pasta to pot. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Toss with cheese. Serve hot or cold. Note, you can also add mushrooms to the finished dish, for flavor and color. If you do that, the oil and garlic will mix into the pasta and beef.

title: Feta and Corn Crackers
ingredients: 3 cups whole kernel corn, drained | 1 3/4 cups oatmeal | 1/4 cup oatmeal | 1/2 cup rye flour | 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to mix corn, oatmeal, oats, and cheese in large bowl. On small baking sheet pat mixture into 8, 1 1/2 wide, 1/2 thick, 1 1/2 high. Bake 8 - 10 minutes or until browned.

title: Prawns, Raisens and Romas
ingredients: 750 g uncooked medium prawns, shelled | 1 1/3 cups raisins | 1/8 cup catsup | 1/8 cup of roasted chili's basil | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | fresh ground black pepper | 1 -2 leafy mountain lettuce leaf
instructions: Soak the prawns in a small amount of water. Remove the heads, shells and any muscle tabs. Remove the prawns from the shells and set aside. Add the prawn heads, shells and all. Strain the liquid to a separate saucepan and bring to a boil. Add the raisins. Lower the heat and simmer until the prawns are pink in the centre and the liquid is reduced by half. Keep the prawns warm. When the prawn liquid is reduced in half, add the catsup, basil and mixed spice to the liquid. Bring to a boil then simmer, covered, for a further 15 - 20 minutes. Add the prawn heads and prawns and simmer for a further 5 minutes. Serve on a bed of the mountain lettuce leaves. Variation, you may add some chopped tomato, basil/pesto etc. Use a mixture of pesto, chutney or a combination of both. I usually add fresh chopped parsley and a good spoonful of grated cheese, but remember to taste these add to the mixture before it tastes too strongly or else it might become too bland.

Random Ingredients: leek,parmigiano reggiano cheese,beef tenderloin,spinach leaf,albacore tuna,currant,gruyere
title: Tuna & Spinach Gratin in a Truffle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 4 ounces albacore tuna, drained and flaked | 2 ounces beef tenderloin, trimmed, thinly sliced across the grain | 4 cups fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped, divided | 1 leek, white bulb only, sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, minced | 3 tablespoons currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place each of the cheese slices in a shallow 1 1/2 inch ramekin or cake pan.

title: Mexican Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur | 2 cups mexican-style tomatoes, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Place bulgur in large bowl, pour in 1/2 cup water and mix. Add tomato chunks and maple syrup and mix well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,lamb shank,savoy cabbage,oil,lime wedge,pork loin,dijon mustard
title: Lamb Shank and Savoy Cabbage Stew - Pan Seared
ingredients: 2 2 lbs pork loin or 2 lbs sirloin shank | 2 -3 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard or 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 4 cups savoy cabbage ( or 2 cored ) | 8 -10 slices whole wheat bread, toasted | 16 lime wedges
instructions: Remove the shard and as much fat as possible from the meat, cut away any membrane, and pat it completely dry by moistening your hands with water. Trim away the white tendon from the meat and cut off any excess fat. Put the meat with the fat back into a large skillet or a roasting pan, sprinkle on the mustard and half of the cabbage. Cover with the remaining cabbage, pour in just enough boiling water to just below the level of the meat. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce the heat to low and keep the stew gently simmering. The broth should be just below boiling point, or around 1 1/2 lbs. When the meat begins rendering fat, remove the pan from the heat. Cover with a lid and set aside to steep for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400°f slice the remaining cabbage into thin wedges and lay on a baking sheet lined with foil. Brush the bread lightly with mustard. Cover with a lid and place in the oven to toast. As soon as you are ready, toast the bread lightly, taking care not to burn it. Cut into wedges, place on a clean flat tray, sprinkle on the reserved mustard and drizzle with oil. To serve, place a meat tenderiser against the side of the stew, spoon the mustard and chopped cabbage over, garnish with a lime wedge to squeeze over the vegetables and serve with the fried bread.

title: Indian Spice Seasoning.
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 large chicken bouillon cube
instructions: In a spice grinder or blender, process coriander seed and ground chicken bouillon cubes. Add all ingredients and process well. Let stand at least 5 minutes to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,vegetable stock,chili garlic sauce,italian seasoning,clam juice
title: Giant Clam Chowder
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 2 cans minced clams with juice | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: In a large saucepan, simmer the stock with the chili paste and caraway seeds until softened. Add the clams while continuing to cook while stirring constantly so that they open up. Add italian seasoning and heat through. Serve with noodles.

title: Nana's Favourite Potato & Peanut Rolls (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 14 )
ingredients: 6 tablespoons crunchy mashed potatoes | 2 green onions, sliced | 3 tablespoons peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Stir the potato and onion gently in a bowl, season with salt and pepper. Spread the potato mixture evenly over the top of a greased 24 cup baking tin. Sprinkle with the peanuts. Bake in a preheated oven about 40 minutes, or until the potato mixture is lightly browned and the topping is golden with brown.

title: Curried Beef
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut into 3-inch long slices | 2 lbs coconut sugar | 4 tablespoons coconut vinegar | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | piri-piri-piri-piri, for flavor
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix sugar, vinegar, bay leaves, and thyme. Add beef slices and toss well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, tossing a couple times. Cook on a grill, or on preheated grill rack set at medium heat 5 minutes per side, or until the meat is browned lightly on both sides. Top with piri piri sauce for the last 20 minutes of grilling.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,rice wine vinegar,italian sausage,cheddar cheese,raisin,creme de cacao,chicken stock cube,serrano pepper
title: Grilled Sausage Skewers With Raisin and Cheddar Coleslaw
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage | 4 ounces raisins, sliced | 4 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves, chopped | 1/3 cup reduced sodium chicken stock cubes | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon creme de cacao | 1 serrano pepper, seeded & minced | 4 ounces cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cut the sausages in half lengthwise & then crosswise into 1 inch thick slices. Set aside. Stir together the raisins, lime leaves, chicken stock cubes, vinegar and cècao. Add the sausage and marinate for 20 minutes. Thread the sausage onto the skewers, alternating with the raisin mixture. Place on a plate, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to 24 hours. To make the raisin & cheddar coleslaw, toss the cabbage, cheese, and chilli in a large bowl. Serve the skewers on the side.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,log goat cheese,club soda,chunky salsa,thyme sprig,crabmeat,sun tomato oil
title: Smoked and Spicy Grilled Crab Cocktail
ingredients: 1 log goat cheese ( log for australians ) | 12 crabmeat ( imitation for americans ) | 6 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 1/2 fluid ounces chunky salsa | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 sprig thyme sprig | 12 fluid ounces club soda ( to serve )
instructions: Cut open log of goats cheese to expose all of the meat. Remove skin and all visible fat from meat. Break the cheese into 4 equal portions, cut each piece into 4 equal pieces. Add crabmeat, sun dried tomatoes, chunky salsa, hot pepper sauce and thyme. Mix well but gently. Cover with plastic wrap and place in fridge at least 2 hours. Serve on a buns with slices of toasted bread.

title: Tunisian Hard Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs, hard shelled | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 125 g red peppers, finely chopped | 150 g fine dry breadcrumbs | fat or lard ( for deep frying )
instructions: Remove the hard boiled egg from their shells, and cut a lengthwise slit lengthwise through the hard shell using a sharp knife. Open the shell in the centre, carefully remove the yolks. Mix together well. Add the red pepper and bread crumbs and season well to taste. Form patties of the mixture. Heat fat or lard in a deep frying pan and fry the patties several at a time for about 3 to 5 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towels, then keep warm. Serve straight away.

Spoon half of the sausage and the noodles over and top with half the remaining cheese. Spread over the remaining sausage, then scatter the tortilla chips over the cheese. Spoon over the mozzarella cheese. Spread over the remaining mzzarella cheese and top with the remaining toppings. Pour over the mirin and oyster sauce and cover with foil. Bake at c for 50 - 60 minutes or until the top is golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Chicken Strips

instructions: Boil the chicken stock. Add prosciutto and fish sauce. Mix well. Add shrimp or chicken. Serve with jasmine rice.

instructions: Preheat oven to crumble cake mix into a medium bowl.

instructions: Trim any sinew or skin from the salmon and cut off the top and lower portions of the stalks with a sharp knife. Cut into 2 strips and set aside. instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine condensed beef broth and canola oil. Bring broth and canola oil mixture to a boil. Add peas to boiling broth and let cook a few minutes. Stir.

title: Applesauce Pancetta Bites

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes on a wire rack and let stand 30 minutes. Unpeeled potatoes will be easier to handle in general. While potatoes are baking, combine pancetta in small bowl with applesauce and chili oil. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. title: Scallops from the Cape

instructions: Place brisket on the bone rack of a heavy foil pan and insert 2 - 3 spoons of kosher sea water underneath the meat of the brisket. Place the brisket, flat side down, on a clean cutting board and with a meat mallet pound the scallops using a pounder or the back of a large spoon to make them as flat as possible. instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Place salmon in a shallow casserole dish. Slice salmon into rounds or quarters depending how thick your rounds are. instructions: In a saucepan add enough water to the rice to cover 1/2 the amount of artichokes and bring the mixture to the boil over medium heat. Serve the kangaroo in an equal amount of bowls and drizzle with a little sauce.

Add limeade concentrate during the last half hour. The meat should be well browned.

title: Beef Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 350 g bread, sliced | 140 g thin beef gravy | 2 bottles beef gravy | 1 bottle drambuie | 1 tablespoon lime zest, chopped | 1 tablespoon brandy | 250 g dry fettuccine pasta | 1 bag noodles ( optional )
instructions: Boil water and add noodles. Cook on high for 20 mins or until tender and drain. Add zest and brandy.

title: Roast Winter Squash and Marsala
ingredients: 3 large butternut squash | 6 ounces marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Cut squash in half. Remove seeds and place in a roasting pan with lid on it. Roast squash, covered with foil, in oven for 45 minutes. Turn over the squash and roast the other side, uncovered, for a further 45 minutes or until a skewer passes easily through flesh. Cool slightly in the pan before carving. Spoon roasted squash onto a plate and drizzle with marsala.

Random Ingredients: passionfruit syrup,lemon zest,tomato puree,poblano chile,water chestnut,lime zest,turmeric
title: Prawns in Tomato Sauce with Poached Tomatoes and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pint fresh tomato puree, about 1 inch thick | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and chopped ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 small red onion, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped lime zest | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped lemon zest | 1/4 cup passionfruit syrup | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 cups water chestnuts
instructions: Place the tomato puree in a medium saucepan over medium low heat.

title: French Toast With Thyme and Bacon
ingredients: 1 loaf challah, sliced in 1 inch thick slices | 2 cups milk | fresh thyme sprig ( optional, but i like to add fresh. i like to add just! ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Toast french toast. Top with bread slices which have been heated. Combine milk and sour cream. Garnish with thyme. You can eat right away, or refrigerate for at least a few hours, or you can eat right away if you like. You can also use french bread slices as sandwich bread for up to 12 sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,baking powder,green bean,chinese cabbage,pinto bean,yellow squash
title: Chunky Minestrone
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can yellow squash, drained and chopped | 1 cup chinese cabbage, shredded | 3 teaspoons baking powder | 1 bag small shell pasta, cooked and drained | 1 can cut green beans, drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients except green beans in a large saucepan. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,blueberry,chuck steak,black olive,monterey jack cheese,white vinegar
title: Blueberry Steak Sandwich (Burgundy Style)
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck steaks, lean, 3/4-inch to 1-inch thick | 2 cups fresh blueberries, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup blueberries, canned, rinsed, drained, and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons green olives, pitted ( such as nicoise olives or green olives, of your choice ) or 3 tablespoons black olives ( such as nicoise olives or green olives, of your choice ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper. Grill steaks until just cooked through, about 5 minutes per side for rare to medium, about 3 minutes per side for medium rare.

title: Mushroom Baked Salmon
ingredients: 500 -750 g salmon, cut into bite size pieces | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 300 -400 g button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 teaspoon soy sauce or 1 teaspoon braggs liquid aminos
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Dry salmon pieces with kitchen paper towel. Rub seasoning on and layer with ginger, mushrooms and spices. Bake at 190c for a couple of hours. Serve with rice.

title: Spiced Beef Satay
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 chili, halved | 1 loaf french bread, split in half
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine brown sugar, soy sauce and chilli. Place half the bread on the cutting board and spread with a thin layer of brown sugar mixture. Cut bread into 1 inch squares. Using a sharp knife or spatula, make a slit on the bread in the middle of each square. Spread a piece of beef satay on each piece of bread. Serve immediately.

title: Lima Apricots (Canned)
ingredients: 4 ounces dried lima beans ( small ones, they are not the type of dried ones ) | 4 ounces dried pitted apricot halves | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 4 ounces button mushrooms or 4 ounces button mushrooms, sliced thickly
instructions: Soak lima beans at least 2 hours in 3 cups of hot water to cover. Drain thoroughly. Remove peels. Cook in salted water until tender, about 40 minutes or longer depending on type and weight. Drain very well. Place the apricots in a shallow dish. Cover with amaretto. Place mushrooms on top and cover with a lid. Place the lid on dish. Let stand 15 minutes. Drain out 1/2 cup liquid. Place a steamer or 6 cups of water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Place mushrooms on top and cover with lid. Cook until the mushrooms are soft and the filling is thick, 15 - 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Green Tomato Salad With Cardamom
ingredients: 2 lbs green tomatoes, sliced | 1 jar mayonnaise | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 teaspoon false cardamom seeds
instructions: Place tomatoes and lemon zest in a large salad bowl. Stir mayonnaise into the tomato mixture and season with cardamom. Stir until well blended.

Random Ingredients: red onion,onion powder,lemon zest,pancetta bacon,ham,mexican chocolate,granny smith apple,potato starch
title: Mexican Chocolate Apple Potato Galette
ingredients: 1 cup diced potato starch | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon zest | 1/4 cup finely diced red onion | 1/4 cup diced canadian sweet potato | 4 ounces pancetta bacon, diced | 1 small ham slice, cooked and diced | 1 granny smith apple - peeled, cored and diced | 1 dash granulated onion powder, to taste | 1 dash granulated garlic powder, to taste
instructions: In a medium size bowl, add the potato starch, lemon zest, onion, apple, pancetta, ham, and browned ham and mix thoroughly. Stir in the diced potato and mix until well incorporated and the dough has the consistency of a firm pie dough. Grease your largest baking sheet and set the dough aside. Heat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut off the excess dough for the dough and cut the rest of the dough in half to form a half circle. Wrap the dough around the circle and press it firmly together with your fingers. You should have about 1 inch of dough left over for each half. Bake for 25 minutes, remove from oven and continue baking for about 15 more minutes, until golden and puffed. If making a pizza crust, place a circle of parchment or aluminum foil on your pizza pan to prevent drying out of steam. In a small bowl combine the onion powder, garlic powder, and powdered sugar.

title: Nescafe
ingredients: 5 frozen vanilla wafers | 3 jalapenos, seeded and sliced
instructions: Split the vanilla wafers in half horizontally, making sure the seeds have been taken out.

title: Quick Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock ( or beef stock ) | 1/4 cup french mustard | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 lb boneless sirloin, well trimmed
instructions: Combine the stock, mustard and sugar. Place the beef in a large, heavy, heavy zip bag. Pour sauce mix over the beef. Squish bag around a few times to mix, coating beef evenly. Place in the refrigerator and allow to marinate at least 6 hours, but preferably overnight. Heat up a heavy skillet over medium high heat, then reduce heat to low and brown the beef rolls 8 - 10 minutes on each side, or until desired doneness.

title: Chili Dogs (Hawaiian Style)
ingredients: 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 2 -3 lbs hamburger | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 tablespoon chives | 1 tablespoon chili flakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put into a frying pan. Cook at medium heat, stirring constantly until heated through.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,sage leaf,phyllo dough,tomato ketchup,guinness stout,raisin,saffron,grand marnier
title: Burt Reynolds Super Easy Beef Bites
ingredients: 1 box bacon ( bacon bits ) | 12 miniature phyllo dough sheets, defrosted if frozen | 1 can condensed cream mushroom soup | 1 can guinness stout ( not soda ) | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon sage leaf
instructions: Slice bacon into 1/2 inch pieces and fry until no longer pink. Set aside in a bowl and save fat for another use such as sauteeing. You can use frozen bacon bits or frozen pieces for this recipe. Combine the soups, ½ tablespoon of grand marnier, ketchup and saffron in a sauce pot on low heat. Stir until well mixed. Add sage to mixture and whisk. Dip one of the miniature phyllo sheets in the egg mixture in a clean bowl, spraying them with a non stick spray. Place 2 heaping tablespoons of the burt in the center of the pastry and spread it to the edges. Fold the excess pastry over to seal in the filling. Repeat with 6 more sheets of pastry and a second layer of burt. Cut the pastries in half diagonally using scissors. Place on a baking sheet that has been sprayed with non stick spray. Bake for 18 - 22 minutes at 350 degrees. You can also line the baking sheet with parchment and bake these in a convection oven for 40 minutes. The secret is in the oven temperature, your oven has a convection burn so you need to turn it over after 20 minutes.

title: Basil and Spring Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 spring onions, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
instructions: In a bowl with a lid, toss the spring onions and basil with the dressing. Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: flounder fillet,corn oil,jasmine rice,red cabbage,cardamom pod,sun tomato oil,heavy whipping cream
title: Aji Roka (Rice Balls With Cracked Wheat)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups jasmine rice | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and cut into strips | 1 tablespoon corn oil ( or olive oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 large flounder fillets ( or other firm white fish ) | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup thinly sliced red cabbage
instructions: In a 2 quart shallow baking dish combine rice and sun dried tomatoes. In a heavy large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat and when hot, add cardamom pods. As soon as the pods begin to sizzle, add fish and cook, turning once, until fish is no longer translucent. Transfer to a plate to drain and cool, then cut off any skin and bones. With a slotted spoon, scoop out and discard remaining rice, leaving enough rice to stuff 2 soup crocks each. Spoon rice into one soup crock, and top with tomato strips. Stir in cream and pour cream mixture over rice. Serve in bowls.

title: Tasty Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 package instant couscous | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 rotisserie-cooked chicken, shredded
instructions: Bring 3 cups water to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan. Add couscous.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,kalamata olive,large shrimp,bragg liquid amino,harissa,chilies,almond,allspice
title: Lebanese Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup blanched almond | 3 green chili peppers, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1/6 teaspoon ground allspice | 4 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | kalamata olive, pitted, coarsely chopped | 2 fresh chilies, finely chopped
instructions: Position oven rack about 6 inches from the heat and preheat the broiler. Toast the almonds, pressing them a few times, in a skillet over moderate heat until golden, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl. Add chiles, harissa, 1/3 cup oil, and allspice. Stir to blend. Wash shrimp under cold running water. Pat dry with paper towels. Pat shrimp dry. Toss shrimp with remaining oil, olives and chiles. Arrange shrimp on a baking sheet and broil or bake in shallow oven until just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.

title: Blueberry Barley Soup
ingredients: 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1 can reduced sodium chicken broth | 1/3 cup frozen blueberries | 2 tablespoons chopped green onion
instructions: Cook barley in chicken broth and broccoli until done cooking time is approximately 8 minutes at a higher simmer time is desired. Stir before serving. Pour soup into heat resistant bowl and gently toss in 1 tblsps green onion and 1 tspn garlic powder. Serve with a sprinkle of paprika on top if desired.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,lasagna noodle,serrano chilies,sirloin,harissa,tomato puree,ginger garlic paste
title: Lazy Lasagna
ingredients: 1 fresh lasagna noodle, washed and drained | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 serrano chilies, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin, chopped | 2 tablespoons harissa | 2 teaspoons ground ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Make sure all of the ingredients are chopped and ready to go. Cover a large skillet with a thin layer of olive oil, heat over high heat and dry roast the meat until browned all over.

title: Mrs. Sharp's Dried Fruit Seasoning
ingredients: 1 cup sultana | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 3/4 cups brandy
instructions: Place the sultanas in a small bowl. Mash with a fork. Add the lemon pepper and the brandy and mix well. Place in a sterlised jar and store in a cool spot.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,almond extract,nutmeg,red curry paste,chili powder
title: Tasty Red Curry Blend
ingredients: 1/4 cup red curry paste | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 2/3 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Mix curry paste, chili powder, nutmeg, and almond extract in a bowl, sprinkle in cheese, and shake to combine.

title: English Mommages
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, minced | 1 teaspoon whole grain mustard
instructions: Saute the minced onion in the bottom of your saute pan for 15 minutes or until it becomes soft when sauteed. Add the whole grain mustard, then immediately turn heat to medium. Let the mustard brown just a bit, then flip the heat down, allowing it to cook for about 30 minutes, or until desired consistency is reached.

title: Simple Pineapple
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, not drained
instructions: Empty contents of can into bowl. Dump pineapple chunks into the bowl. Slightly mash pineapple with a fork or potato masher. Stir to combine. Use a spoon, or a squirt bottle, to fill empty can with water. The water should be enough so pineapple can sit upright in can.

title: Easy Beef Burrito
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked beef, strips | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1/2 cup guacamole | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin
instructions: Cook ground beef over med high heat, drain. Add beans including their juices, guacamole, and sugar. Stir to mix. Add cumin and taste for spice. Serve warm or cool. Serve with tortillas or pita chips. Enjoy.

title: Rice Cakes (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 2 cups leftover cooked rice | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon light agave syrup or 2 teaspoons light molasses | 1 slice whole wheat bread, cubed
instructions: Combine the eggs and syrup in a small bowl and set aside. Place the rice in a medium saucepan and cover with 3/4 cup boiling water. Bring to boil, and cook uncovered 15 to 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Remove from heat, and set aside to cool. Place the bread cubes into the rice, and then sprinkle with the warm rice mixture. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Heat a nonstick skillet to medium high heat, and cook 1 piece of the dai for about 2 minutes, until golden brown on the outside and tender inside.

title: Honduran Garlic Salad!
ingredients: 1 cup canola oil | 4 cups chopped lettuce leaves | 1 1/4 cups light sour cream | 2 medium garlic cloves, minced | 1 -2 bag maraschino cherries, chopped
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Toss with greens and cherry.

Random Ingredients: vodka,chive,mustard seed,pesto sauce,sesame seed,cooking spray,leek,red bell pepper
title: Pesto Vodka Peppers
ingredients: 4 large red bell peppers ( or any other bright red bell pepper ) | 2 leeks, chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds, coarsely ground | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven to broil or 550 degrees f. Place peppers on baking sheet skin side down. Broil for about 5 minutes until skin blackens and blisters. Immediately place peppers in zip lock bag, seal, and place in refrigerator for 10 minutes or even overnight. Peel off skin from peppers, remove seeds and cut peppers in half lengthwise. Remove peppers from bag, scrape out seeds. Slice thinly across the grain into slices about 1/4 inches wide and 1/2 to 1 1/2 inches long. Spray peppers with cooking spray. Broil or 550 degrees f for about 5 minutes or till lightly charred. In small bowl mix the pesto, vodka, mustard, and chives. Drizzle over peppers before serving.

title: Quick, Easy Chilled Creole Chickpeas
ingredients: 25 baby corn, cut from the cob | 1/2 - 1 lb fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1/4 teaspoon fresh sage or 2 teaspoons dried sage | 10 slices toast
instructions: Spray the bottom of a 2 quart or larger casserole dish with non stick cooking spray. Put the corn between 2 layers of paper towels, or waxed paper. Tie a knot in the corn so that it can't fall apart. In a small bowl, stir together the fish sauce, minced garlic, and sage. Sprinkle over the corn along with the remaining ingredients. Set aside 3/4 cup of the soup mix for sauce.

title: Maple Baked Beef Roll-ups
ingredients: 16 ounces sirloin | maple syrup
instructions: Trim all excess fat from sirloin, then cut the length in half. Slice off the tip and discard it. Sprinkle all of the meat with pure maple syrup. Wrap the roll ups in foil. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: capellini,orange peel,cauliflower floret,arrowroot,barbecue sauce,celery,vegetable shortening,red chili pepper
title: Cauliflower and Cauliflower Glazed Pasta With Red Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 12 ounces capellini | 4 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon ground red chili pepper | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 2 tablespoons chopped celery, including tops | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1 orange peel, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons prepared mild barbecue sauce
instructions: Bring large pot of salted water to boil. Add noodles. Remove from heat. While pasta is cooking, in a large skillet, melt 1 tblsp. Of the shortening until dark brown on all sides. Remove from heat. Drain noodles, then set aside. Add remaining 2 tblsp. Of shortening to skillet and cook onion over medium heat about 1 minute. Then add chili and cauliflower and celery. Cook about 7 minutes more until vegetables are tender. Push vegetables to pan sides. Sprinkle remaining 1 tblsp. Of shortening into pan. Add arrowroot into pan and stir to break up any lumps. Remove from heat. Stir in hot pasta, orange peel and barbecue sauce. Return to heat, stirring constantly for about 2 minutes. The glaze should coat the back of a spoon, but if not, transfer to a bowl and brush down sides and surface of sauce with glaze. Serve immediately.

title: Tuna Tuna With Blueberries and Oats
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats | 2 -4 ounces yellowfin tuna steaks, preferably lean, cooked
instructions: Cut tuna into 6 equal pieces and place on a baking sheet.

title: Tomato Egg Bread
ingredients: 1 large egg white | 2 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Brush a baking sheet with softened butter. Combine egg white and tomato paste in a small bowl. Pour egg white mixture inches. Mix together lightly. Pour into a 1 cup bowl, and freeze on baking sheet for 30 minutes. Remove from freezer, and slice into 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: muscovado sugar,kaffir lime leaf,plain yogurt,guar gum,sherry wine,swiss chard,vegetable oil cooking spray,rice noodle
title: Guar Gung
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1/2 cup plain yogurt or 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon guar gum | 1 cup swiss chard, leaves chopped | 1 tablespoon minced kaffir lime leaf | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 4 kaffir lime leaves, cut in thirds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place rice noodles in a plastic bag. Place in oven for ten minutes or until tender. Drain on paper towels. Using a vegetable peeler, peel chard leaves. Cut stems off leaves. Combine chard leaf, kaffir lime leaves and sherry. Spread the chard mixture evenly over noodles. Spray noodles and chard with oil cooking spray. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until noodles are cooked. Garnish top with extra kaffir lime leaves.

title: Holy Basilico
ingredients: 12 plum tomatoes, very ripe | 2 serrano chili, seeded | 2 tablespoons white rum
instructions: Grill the tomatoes, serrano chiles, and rum until skin begins to turn brown, 4 - 8 minutes. Place the tomatoes on a plate, peel away the stem, and chop off the thick flesh. Place the tomatoes and chiles in a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Add the chopped flesh, and process until smooth. The chiles should not be pureed, and add just enough rum to make a thick paste. Transfer the paste to a small jar and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,brown rice,lemon zest,peanut oil,pecan,shell pasta,thyme sprig,pinto bean
title: Lemon Thyme and Roasted Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans ( about 2.5 cups ) | 4 cups water | 3/4 cup brown rice or 3/4 cup basmati rice | 6 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 lemon, zest of, plus two extra slices for garnish | 3 -4 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 teaspoon brown sugar or 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | lemon thyme sprig ( optional )
instructions: Wash pinto beans well and place in a large saucepan. Pour 2 cups of water over beans, cover with a lid or lid slightly ajar, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and simmer gently 45 minutes or until beans are just tender, stirring a few times during cooking. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine the 2 cups of cooked water, rice, 2 tbsp of oil, lemon zest, and half of the cardamom pods in a small metal bowl and sprinkle with a few dashes more of cardamom pods and sugar to taste. Cover and cook over medium low medium heat for 15 minutes. Pour rice into serving bowl. Add the remaining cardamom pods and lemon thyme sprigs to bean mixture. Spoon the bean mixture into remaining bowl and garnish beans with additional thyme. Serve hot or cold.

title: Tart Apples & Cherry Tomatoes - Applesauce for Dogs
ingredients: 8 -10 tart apples, such as granny smith, granny smith plump, about 2 lbs | 1 1/2 cups canned pitted apricots, with juice, about 3/4 cup pitted, peeled cherries reserved | 1/2 cup finely cut string | 1/3 cup cherries sliced in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Toss apples with apricots.

title: Cheesy Canadian Bacon and Egg Casserole
ingredients: 1 package colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 6 ounces canadian bacon, slices | 4 large eggs, lightly beaten or 1 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a greased 13 x9 inch baking dish. Bake, uncovered at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: salmon,mozzarella cheese,vodka,sourdough bread,romaine lettuce heart,savoy cabbage
title: Cold Russian Sandwich
ingredients: 1 large romaine lettuce hearts or 1 large bibb fresh baby leaf, cleaned | 1/2 ounce vodka | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 slices sourdough bread or 2 slices country bread | 1 thinly sliced smoked salmon | 1 large savoy cabbage, rinsed & finely shredded
instructions: Lay the romaine on 2 large plates. Pour just enough vodka to cover the lettuce. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese very generously over the romaine leaves. Top with the remaining slices of bread, salmon, and cabbage. Ladle 1/2 oz. Of vodka over the bread, dividing it evenly, and use a chopstick or spoon to spread the vodka. Eat or refrigerate until ready to serve. Note, to serve the sandwiches at cool room temperature, wrap the russian around the salad, and let it sit in the refrigerator for 30 minutes or longer.

title: Chef John's Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, rinsed, patted dry and shredded | 1 teaspoon italian-style seasoning, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place shredded cabbage in a serving bowl.

title: Jamaican Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 thick cut pork chops | 1 can whole pitted apricots, drained | 2 slices quick-cooking apple | 1 small bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 jar picante sauce | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place chops on grill rack, fat side down and cook for 4 minutes or until no pink remains and chops are lightly browned. Turn chops and cook for an additional 4 minutes. Meanwhile, remove and discard any fat from the pan. Place apricots, bell pepper and allspice into the pan drippings. Pour picante sauce over chops and vegetables and cook for an additional 3 minutes or until heated through. Spoon sauce over chops. Reduce heat to medium and cook for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, turning chops over. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Pasta Salad With Garlic, Chili and Herbs from California Restaurants
ingredients: 1 package rrigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup mixed salad greens | 1/4 cup roasted red chilies, sliced | 1/4 cup minced roasted garlic
instructions: In a large saucepan of salted boiling water, cook the pasta, uncovered, until just tender but firm to the bite, stirring occasionally. Drain. Combine the salad greens, roasted garlic and roasted red chiles in large bowl. Stir in pasta. Serve warm.

title: Peachy Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can cream halves | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 tablespoon orange peel, finely chopped | 1 bag peaches
instructions: Place beef and cream in a large bowl, stir up any chunks that may form. Add orange peel and allspice, and mix. Soak skewers in water for 1 hour. Remove beef and soak for 15 minutes, drain. Drain beef, reserving liquid. Thread onto skewers. Skewer meat with orange chunks as desired. Cover with plastic wrap, refrigerate for 1 hour and serve with peach sauce. Recipe for peach peach sauce can be made up to this point 8 to 10 hours ahead.

title: Dunkin' Succotash
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cans durkee onions | 1 can del monte french fried onions
instructions: Stir everything together and heat until hot through.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,sirloin steak,broth,black sesame seed,cream celery soup,coconut milk
title: Creamy Beef and Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, sliced | 3 cups broccoli cuts, thawed | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed
instructions: Saute beef and broccoli in peanut oil.

title: Easy Penne with Prawns and Pernod
ingredients: 12 ounces dry penne pasta | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 can cream ( can use evaporated milk ) | 1/2 cup pernod
instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil to cook the penne pasta. Meanwhile, heat a medium skillet with no oil on medium high heat. Add garlic and saute until golden brown. Add the cornstarch and stir constantly. Add cream and mix constantly. Pour the sauce onto the pasta and cook for 2 minutes, until the sauce is slightly thickened. Drain pasta, sprinkle with garlic and serve.

title: Texas Pecan Salad
ingredients: 1 pound tomatillos, husked | 1 cup toasted pecan pieces
instructions: Place the tomatillos, pecans, and tomatillos in a bowl. Toss with the cheese and season with salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,monterey jack cheddar cheese,steak,clove
title: Cheese & Spice Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, diced | 3 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, diced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 cup self-raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Roll out with hands to 1/4 thickness. Roll and cut again as required. Place on greased cookie sheet spacing apart. Bake 5 minutes, turn and bake a further 2 minutes or until desired crispiness. Serve warm.

title: Potato, Chard and Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch chard leaves, rinsed | 12 medium russet potatoes, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup barley | 2 cups kale, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons meat tenderizer | 1/2 cup masa harina | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 cup pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place chard leaves in an electric pressure cooker and cook over high heat, stirring constantly until tender. Remove from the cooker with tongs, leaving about 1 tablespoon cooking water in the cooker, and allow to cool. Meanwhile, place potatoes in a colander, and sprinkle with salt. Place the bowl over a saucepan of warm water. Bring to a boil while whisking in 2 tablespoons oil. Cover and steam for 5 minutes. Remove the lid, raise the heat to high, and boil the potatoes until tender, breaking them up with a spoon or potato masher. Mix in the chard and barley. Blend in kale, meat tenderizer, and 1/2 cup water until smooth. Return to a simmer, cover and steam for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup water if the soup is too thick. Remove soup from heat, add the ketchup and 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Toasted pecans can be placed on a baking sheet. Ladle soup into bowls and sprinkle with remaining pecans.

title: Low Fat Low Calorie Italian Chicken Bake
ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup low-fat italian salad dressing | 1 lb chicken, cut into bite size pieces | 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 1 cup diced apple | 3/4 teaspoon dry crushed onion flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to in large bowl, mix italian dressing, onion, and chicken. Spread chicken mixture evenly in greased 9 x13 pan. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: pumpernickel bread,avocado,salad green,ham hock,cumin seed,cardamom powder,shiitake mushroom,bourbon
title: Smoked Bacon & Avocados Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb smoked ham hock | 1 1/2 smoked smoked ham hocks | 50 g shiitake mushrooms | 1 egg | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 avocado, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons bourbon | 4 pumpernickel bread
instructions: Split honeycomb ham hocks lenghtways and secure firmly with a toothpick. Grill over low heat, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes. Remove from grill and wrap into foil. Refrigerate for further 8 hours. Combine cocktail glaze ingredients in a small pan and simmer gently without bringing to boil, covered, for 10 - 15 minutes or until slightly thickened. Brush a baking tray with olive oil and toast pumpernickel bread, cut side at a angle, for 3 - 5 minutes. Brush the bread with oil and cut into 6 slices. Lay on a platter, drizzle with warmed cocktail glaze and serve immediately with slices of hock.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,wheat breadcrumb,green bell pepper,chili pepper flake
title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb green bell peppers or 1 -1 1/4 lb red bell pepper | 1 cup whole wheat breadcrumbs, about | 1 cup chili pepper flakes | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cut bell peppers lengthwise in half and core to remove seeds & white pith. Slice off both ends of the pepper pods and place into a saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain peppers in a colander and cool under cold water. Drain well. Preheat oven to 400°f. Toast breadcrumbs in a large non stick ovenproof skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown. Remove from pan and place in a mixing bowl. Stir in chili peppers and stir. Season with salt and pepper to taste and spoon into pepper shells or other shallow casseroles. Cover and keep in the oven until bubbly.

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups soymilk or 1 1/2 cups low-fat milk | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 cup quinoa, uncooked | 1/2 cup chopped green apple | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup other mild white cheddar cheese
instructions: In a blender, combine the soy milk, vinegar and hotsauce. Pour over the quinoa. Add chopped apple and cheese. Chill until serving time.

title: Lime Squash

instructions: Preheat broiler. Arrange squash in a shallow roasting pan. Top with orange zest, and cayenne pepper. Broil, covered 7 - 9 minutes, or until squash is bubbly and browned and squash is tender.

title: Smoked Saffron Salmon (Cacoila) over Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saffron strands | 2 cups spaghetti sauce ( i use ragu ) | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 6 ounces smoked salmon fillets, flaked | 6 ounces cauliflower florets, chopped coarse | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | kosher salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place saffron in a small bowl. In a skillet, heat remaining sauce. Stir in rum and bring to boil for 1 minute. Set aside. Cook for an additional 5 minutes or until fish is done. Remove from oven and top with sauce and sprinkle with a few saffron strands.

instructions: Heat oven to 350°f cook turkey as directed on box. Remove turkey.

instructions: Fry bacon over medium heat until cooked through. Drain on paper towels and set aside to cool. Slice into bite size pieces and serve warm or cold.

title: Shoyu
ingredients: 2 lebanese cucumbers | 2 slices french bread | 2 tablespoons sake
instructions: Take a slice of bread and cut it lengthwise in half. Take the crust of the french bread, cut the bread into slices, and cut a wedge into which cucumbers fit. Take the wedge, place it in the middle, and put the piece of bread on top.

title: Indonesian Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 500 g chicken bouillon | 1 liter coconut milk | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Pour coconut milk into a saucepan and add spices. Simmer 10 minutes. Cut chicken into bite sized cubes and add to the marinade. Mix well, cook until chicken is cooked, then add the lemon juice. Serve immediately, as the coconut can become slimy.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,beef broth,ginger garlic paste,chili seasoning mix,white bread
title: Mom's Spicy Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 16 corn on the cob, husked | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon chili seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 slice white bread, crumbled
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and place corn on the rack. Brush corn with oil. In medium bowl combine broth, chili seasoning, and ginger and garlic paste. Pour broth mixture over corn and place bread on top. Cover with aluminum foil and grill about 5 minutes or until bread turns moist.

title: Taco Salad Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 cup vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared guacamole | 1 cup prepared whipped topping ( thawed if frozen )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, guacamole, and whipped topping. Chill 30 minutes, or overnight.

title: Antojitos Breakfast
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers | 5 ounces snow peas | 5 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1/4 cup soymilk mixed sprouts | 10 chocolate shavings
instructions: Chop peppers, remove seeds, and dice into 1/2 inch pieces. Bring soy milk, soymilk, and chipotle to a boil in a saucepan over medium low heat. Add bell pepper pieces and peas. Cook until tender in hot pepper oil, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and toss with chopped proscuitto to garnish. Serve at once. Note, the soy milk can also be used to thin or thin the broth if desired. Note, do not add any soy milk that has a lot of sodium. You can also use the broth for a thickener.

title: Mccormick's Curry Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 container mozzarella cheese | 1 can red curry paste | 1 cup broth | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 -2 lime, juice of | lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,corn flake,sugar snap pea,sunflower oil,cayenne,spring onion,baking soda,vegetable stock
title: Crispy Sugar Snap Peas With Tarragon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 1/2 cups sugar snap peas | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 spring onion, sliced into 3 cm pieces | fresh flat corn flakes ( optional )
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a medium frying pan over low heat. Add the sugar snap peas and cook, stirring often, for 2 minutes or until light golden in colour. Add the vegetable stock and tarragon and stir. Cover tightly and simmer for about 10 minutes or until the tender, sticky and the sugar snaps have burst open. Add the baking soda and cayenne, mix and set aside for about 5 minutes to allow the flavours to develop. When ready to serve, remove the lid from the pan and carefully stir in the spring onion, just enough to coat it in oil. Serve with fresh cornflakes.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,black olive,topping,serrano chilies,ginger garlic paste,double cream,pecorino romano cheese,tortilla
title: Chile and Olive Tortilla Pies
ingredients: 2 tortillas, preferably fresh, cut into 10 slices | 1 tablespoon cornstarch, mixed with | 1/3 cup water | 1 tablespoon grated ginger-garlic paste | 4 serrano chilies, seeded | 1/3 cup chopped black olives | 1 cup shredded cheese-and-herbs mix ( parmesan, asiago, romano ) | 1 cup double cream | 3 tablespoons finely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Dip 1 tortilla slice in the cornstarch mixture, coating both sides. Transfer to a plate and cover lightly with plastic wrap. Place the remaining tortilla slice on a clean work surface. Heat 1 tablespoon chili oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the tortilla and cook, turning once, until lightly golden brown and crispy, about 2 minutes. Transfer the tortilla to platter, allow to cool slightly, and cut into 4 wedges each. Sprinkle the wedges with the remaining chili oil and set aside. Repeat with the remaining 1/3 cup chili oil and 2 tablespoons grated cheese. In small skillet over medium heat, toast the 4 tortilla wedges for about 1 minute on each side or until crisp and lightly browned on the outside. Cut the tortilla into 4 wedges. Serve 1 wedge per pie with a dab of cream sauce and 1 tablespoon of grated cheese per pie.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,green cardamom,golden raisin,baking powder,red cabbage,apricot half,rice wine,kidney bean
title: Sweet & Sour Kidney Bean Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon dried kaffir lime leaf or 1/2 teaspoon fresh lime leaves | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1 small red cabbage, about 4 inches in diameter | 1 cup cooked kidney beans, drained in a sieve and well rinsed | 4 cups cooked rice wine, chilled ( about 3/4 cup ) | 4 teaspoons reduced-sodium instant rice powder ( i make my rice chow fun ) | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh green cardamoms, or more to taste
instructions: Heat a large nonstick frying pan over high heat. When very hot, add the cardamom, lime leaves or lime leaves, raisins and chilis. Quickly cook for 1 minute, stirring until fragrant. Add the cabbage and kidney beans. Cook, stirring often, until the cabbage has softened and the bean/chicken mixture has heated through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and sprinkle the rice powder over. Gently stir in the green cardamoms. Spoon into paper bag or a 2 1/2 cup capacity ice cream maker, or other container with plastic wrap. Freeze until firm, at least 2 hours and up to 3 days.

title: Grilled Salmon With Corn, Mushrooms and Lemongrass

instructions: Place salmon in a freezer, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the freezer. If using a pan, place in the freezer. Preheat grill to medium high or prepare barbecue for direct heat grilling. Place garlic, lemongrass, sesame oil, and sage in food processor or blender. Pulse to chop garlic and combine. Place half of corn in a small saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly. Drain, place in serving bowl, and cover. Place fish on hot grill and cook for 4 minutes on one side. Turn fish over and continue to cook for 4 minutes on the other side. Remove from grill and place the fish on a large platter. Pour mushroom sauce over salmon and top with melon half. Wrap foil around salmon to enclose and refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Quick Beef and Orzo Pasta Salad

instructions: In a large bowl, gently combine the uncooked orzo and cooked beef/orzo and the jicama. In a small bowl, whisk eggs, vinegar, and vanilla, and then slowly whisk into sour cream with spoon until creamy. Pour egg mixture over sour cream mixture and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour to chill. Serve chilled.

title: Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter margarine | 12 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard
instructions: Melt the butter or margarine in a small saucepan on low heat and add the thyme. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove thyme and discard. Spread mustard on the mustard. Cover and keep warm at low heat. Spoon mustard on vegetables you serve.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,butter,puff pastry,italian flat leaf parsley,harissa
title: Spiced Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons finely chopped italian flat leaf parsley, leaves | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Melt the butter in a small sausepan over medium heat. Add the parsley. Stir over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle in the harissa.

title: Frosted Tuna With Cashews
ingredients: 3 tuna steaks | 40 g butter | 1/4 cup fresh cream or 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 20 g frozen sweetened caster sugar-free frosting | 1 teaspoon fresh rose water | 1/2 cup roasted cashews | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Heat butter in a large pan and saute tuna in the butter until cooked through remove from pan and set aside add cream to the pan. Combine the sugar and rose water and whisk in frosting mix until sugar has dissolved. Pour mixture on to the tuna, sprinkle cashews and spice and let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Cucumber Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 small cucumber | 4 kaffir lime leaves, finely sliced | 1/3 cup ketchup | 200 g beans, cooked | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Grate the cucumber on the large holes of a box grater, leaving the skin on, then slice the cucumber very thinly. Squeeze the kaffir lime leaves in your hands and put a layer into your serving dish with half the cucumber, half the kataifi and half the beans. Repeat with more layers, ending with the kataifi and beans. Add the rest of the kataifi and beans. Add a little vanilla sugar.

Random Ingredients: wheat macaroni,white mushroom,cumin,scotch bonnet pepper,french ladyfinger cooky
title: Tibetan Chili Pepper Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces white mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 2 sprigs french-style ladyfinger cookies | 2 scotch bonnet peppers | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 12 ounces whole wheat macaroni, cooked to package directions
instructions: Set the oven to 450ºf. Arrange the cleaned mushrooms on a cookie sheet and place on the rack in the oven. Bake at 450ºf for 5 minutes. Drain the macaroni well under cold water. Squeeze out as much water as possible, and then combine with the cooked mushrooms. title: Vietnamese Cocktail
ingredients: 3 large hard-boiled eggs | 2/3 cup finely chopped onion powder | 1/3 cup finely chopped english cucumber | 2 tablespoons ground coffee | 2 -4 teaspoons sherry or 2 -4 teaspoons other sweetener | 1 1/2 lbs top sirloin ( thinly sliced ) | 2 cups grape tomatoes, cut into quarters
instructions: Cut eggs in half crosswise. Remove yolks and set whites aside. Finely chop egg whites and reserve 2 egg yolks. Combine chopped egg yolks and onion powder. Place beef in resealable plastic bag, add egg whites and allow to marinate in refrigerator for at least 5 hours. Turn bag periodically to allow beef slices to soak up access marinade. Slice 1 or 2 of the grape tomatoes and place on a platter. Arrange the tomato halves on the platter with beef slices on top. Place reserved egg whites, reserved yolks and onions in separate containers in refrigerator to preserve whites and yolks.

title: Mustard Honey Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon honey mustard | 1/2 - 1 cup cornstarch | 1 teaspoon orange rind, grated | 4 oranges, rind of
instructions: Stir cream in a double boiler over simmering water until mixture is warm and foamy about 2 - 3 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch with the orange rind in the hot cream mixture. Bring just to a boil and whisk in the honey mustard. Simmer 5 minutes until sauce thickens. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black olive,red cabbage,pork shoulder,reynolds wrap foil,beef tenderloin
title: Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 12 beef tenderloin | 6 medium cooked pork shoulder | 1 medium red cabbage | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 10 -20 reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Slice tenderloins in half, lengthwise, lengthwise. Turn the wraps over and continue cooking until internal temperature reaches 155 degrees.

instructions: Cook beets in large skillet until tender and bright green, about 15 minutes.

title: Normandy Pork Roast

instructions: Combine amaretto and apple juice in large resealable plastic bag. Add roast and toss to coat. Let marinate at room temperature 30 minutes. Combine cottage cheese, 1/4 cup of parmesan cheese and remaining 1/4 cup of parmesan cheese.

title: Hot and Sour Oyster in Rice Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh oyster | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder | 2 tablespoons flour | 150 g fresh rice noodles | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package instructions. Heat a wok over high heat. Add oysters to wok, stir, and cook for 4 - 5 minutes. Set aside. Add chilli powder to wok and stir. title: Crescent Bread II

instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the crescent rolls in a large baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until the crusts of the crescent roll dough are brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat to a flat surface. Pour about 1/2 cup coconut into a bowl.

title: Tarragon-Crusted Chuck Steak

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Roll the chuck steaks with the tarragon on them, and place the steaks on a roasting rack. title: Eggplant Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 eggplants | 6 tablespoons french baguette | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Slice the eggplants lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place slices in an oven safe baking dish with the pieces face down, close together and bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes. Let cool and slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. Brush with the orange juice and sprinkle with the garam masala powder. Continue baking until bread is dark brown, about 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: cold water,maraschino cherry,flour tortilla,yucca root,mint leaf
title: Baja Yucca Chips

instructions: Cut peel into rounds about 1/4 inch thick. Dry on paper towel for about 1 hr remove roots and place in mixing bowl. Tie into a piece of about the size of a finger and shake off any excess flour. Line a baking sheet with foil and coat with cooking spray. Place chips in a single layer and bake at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes or until crisp. Drain on wax paper.

title: Simple Sun-Dried Tomato and Fish Stock
ingredients: 400 g best quality fish stock ( such as halibut, cod, or haddock ) | 10 -12 pieces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Bring the fish stock to boil in a saucepan. Boil until all of the stock is reduced and syrupy. Strain the stock and place back in pan. Puncture sun dried tomatoes with a knife, and pour the stock over the tomatoes. Simmer for a couple of minutes, then serve immediately.

title: Brochaccino
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornflour | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce ( to taste, we use low-sodium worcestershire sauce ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian spices ( optional ) | freshly ground black pepper | 4 -5 broccoli florets ( to garnish ) | 2 wedges lime
instructions: Mix the corn flour and worcestershire sauce in a small bowl. Add the italian spices and pepper and set aside. Microwave the broccoli for 1 - 2 minutes until tender but firm. Sprinkle with the reserved corn flour mixture and squeeze 4 lime wedges over everything. Serve warm.

title: Basmati Rice

instructions: Boil 1 litres water with a good salt covering the rice. Once it boils, reduce to low and cook until all the water has evaporated. Meanwhile, pre cook rice in a pressure cooker. Your rice is ready place into a large bowl and pour over your steaming liquid and leave for approximately 10 minutes then serve.

title: Tomato Green Chili (Solo)
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes, not drained | 1 small green chili ( canned or frozen ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan. Cover and simmer 30 minutes on med low heat. Enjoy.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, stir together beef, egg noodles slices, mushrooms, orange zest and pepper. Spoon into well buttered loaf tin and bake in lower third of oven for 40 minutes, or until just set and golden.

title: Panch Mole

title: Spicy Tomato and Pepper Mix

instructions: Mix the all the ingredients together. Store in an air tight container.

title: Tequila Beef Pies
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1/2 red bell pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 3 tablespoons dried mint | 1 can cream-style corn | 2 tablespoons tequila | 2/3 cup double cream | 1 teaspoon irish whiskey or 1 teaspoon rum extract
instructions: Preheat oven to c. Grease 4 x 9 inch oven proof texas pete pans. Using electric mixer, combine beef, peppers, dried mint, cream style corn, tequila, cream, and whisky or rum extract. Mix well and place 4 spoonfuls of mixture into each prepared pan. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until heated through. Serve pneadparmesan cheese curls on top.

title: Spiced Cuts for Tea or Dipping
ingredients: 1 cup pecans, toasted and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Spread pecans on a large sheet of aluminum foil. Coat with the garam masala. Tightly seal the edges of the foil with a wet fork so that the spices will absorb as much of the moisture as possible. Bake the nuts for 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until they are crisp and crunchy. Use a metal spatula to remove them from the foil and allow to cool completely. Store in an airtight container. May also be frozen.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,pepperoni,pineapple juice,roast beef,baking soda,white bread,orange zest
title: Roast Beef-Parmesan Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced roast beef ( deli style ) | 1/3 cup canned pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 ounces parmesan cheese | pepperoni ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. In a medium bowl, combine the pineapple juice with the zest, baking soda, grated cheese, and pepperoni. Place the roast beef in a loaf pan, then pour the pepperoni/pineapple mixture around the beef. Place in your oven and cook for 1 hour, to the desired doneness and the juices from the roast beef. This can be served on the side for sandwiches or on toasted toasts as well as over pasta. The recipe may also be served with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Jaffa Rollups (Chakalaka)
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour ( can use all purpose or half and half ) | 1 cup dried dill | 1 tablespoon dried mustard | 1 medium jalapeno pepper
instructions: Combine all of ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat with mixer until smooth. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 200c degrees. Roll out to about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 12 long cylinders, about 1 1/4 inches wide. Brush lightly with olive or canola oil and sprinkle lightly with salt. Bake on greased oven tray for 15 - 20 minutes, turning once or twice. If desired, spread with butter, if desired.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,pecan,ramen noodle,chicken thigh,chicken breast,thai basil,ladyfinger
title: Chicken Phyllo Chicken Bundles
ingredients: 12 pieces of moist moist twine-type moist-textured bread flour | 6 ounces cooked boneless, skinless chicken thighs, thawed ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans | 8 ounces sweet baby-dinner rolls, split lengthwise in half horizontally | 2 packages of ramen noodles | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thai basil, or more to taste | 3 large thin-sliced chicken breasts, cut crosswise into 8 thin bite-size strips
instructions: Preheat the oven on broiler setting. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Mix the bread flour and 3/4 cup water in a large bowl to blend, set aside. Squeeze the crumbly chicken meat to remove excess moisture. Combine in a second bowl pecans, the sweet rolls, ramen noodles, basil, and chicken strips in a third bowl. Place a large piece of plastic wrap over the sides of a work space that is just large enough to wrap the chicken. Roll out one piece of the plastic wrap, placing it slightly diagonally across the sides of the plastic wrap, so that the wrap is flush with the bottom of the plastic wrap. Place the plastic wrap atop the chicken mixture in the center of the plastic wrap. Carefully flip the plastic wrap so the chicken bundles are standing up in a slightly overlapping pile. Repeat with the remaining pieces of plastic wrap and chicken mixture. Place the phyllo bundles on the prepared baking sheet, leaving enough space between each stack to allow for spreading, or refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Remove the plastic wrap, place 2 dinner plates on the counter and, using scissors or scissors, cut a crosswise slit in the top third of the phyllo sheets to let the air escape. Place 2 bundles of chicken pieces on each plate and pour 1/4 cup of thai basil sauce over the chicken. Drizzle with additional basil sauce, if desired. Broil, covered, for 5 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,canola oil,yellow bell pepper,salmon,white wine
title: Grilled Salmon With Yellow Pepper and Smoked Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 - 3/4 lb salmon | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced | salt and pepper
