instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Brush oil on salmon and cook just until opaque throughout, 2 - 3 minutes per side. Remove salmon from skillet and season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Green Tea Bundt Cake (Cadbury)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening ( such as smart balance ) | 1 teaspoon instant espresso | 1/3 cup triple sec | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can chopped green chilies ( i use new mexico green chile salsa ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 15x10 inch jellyroll pan with parchment paper. Cut a 2 inch deep slit with a knife in half. Set aside. In bowl, cream shortening and espresso with mixer at high speed until light and fluffy. Add triple sec. Add baking soda and mix. Gradually add green chilies.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,salmon fillet,watercress,corn,baking powder,mung bean sprout
title: Salmon With Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 1 cup fresh mung bean sprout | 2/3 cup bean sprouts | 1/3 cup corn | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 2/3 cup watercress
instructions: Cut each salmon fillet crosswise into three 3 pieces. Mix together bean sprouts and corn. Place salmon fillet on top of bean sprouts and corn and mung bean sprouts to form flake. Brush with oil. Sprinkle with baking powder. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes, turn, and sprinkle with watercress.

title: Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 package taco seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the yoghurt, parsley and taco seasoning. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours.

title: Black Beans and Chicken Adobo
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 3 skin-on, bone-in chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Lay the black beans out on a small baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the black beans begin to swell a bit. Remove from the oven, and cool until easy to handle. Rinse and drain the beans. Place the chicken thighs in a resealable plastic bag, and pour in the black beans and contents of the bag. Squeeze the air out of the bag, and remove the air layer. Place the bag onto a baking sheet, and bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the chicken juices run clear.

title: Garlicky Slow-Cooked Beef and Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut in 3/4-1/2-inch cubes | 1 can beef broth, undiluted | 8 slices thin prosciutto | 2 cans white asparagus, drained | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 whole cloves
instructions: Put beef in slow cooker. Cover with broth. Cover with prosciutto, place on low heat setting for 3 hours. Stir asparagus, cream and cloves into beef mixture. Cover and cook for about 30 minutes to an hour. Serve on warm rolls.

title: Homemade Cream
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon ice water
instructions: Fill an 8 cup glass with ice.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,kebob skewer,sherry wine vinegar,baking soda,bread,red wine vinegar,okra,red food coloring
title: Bourekakia (Okra Skewers)
ingredients: 3 cups okra, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 1/2 tablespoons kebob skewers | crackers or bread | pepper | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 1/2 teaspoons red food coloring | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Cut okra into 1/2 inch slices, discarding any tough stem ends. Whisk together remaining ingredients. Dip okra into batter, turning to coat. Place okra in a shallow baking dish coated with cooking spray.

title: Slow Cooker Tacos
ingredients: 1 can pork shoulder ( not lean ) | 1 onion, small and chopped | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 12 -15 iceberg lettuce
instructions: Using small bowl, mix all ingredients together in a food processor. Cook roast on low setting until cooked but not fully falling apart. Serve in hot or warm flour tortillas, topped with your favorite toppings such as guacamole, shredded lettuce and onions.

title: Shortcut Italian Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces medium spaghetti or 8 ounces vermicelli | 1 package refrigerated biscuit | 1 1/4 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup chopped peanuts | 2 eggs, beaten | 1 cup plain soy flour | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the noodles and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through but is still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain and run cold water over the noodles to remove all of the starch. Pour noodles into a colander set in the sink, and drain well. Combine 1 1/4 cups confectioners' sugar and 1/3 cup chopped peanuts in a small bowl, and stir until smooth. Mix the noodles into the egg mixture. Add soy flour and stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,hot italian sausage,tarragon,basil pesto,rosemary,beef steak,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Chicago Deep Fried Steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup simple syrup ( not sweetened ) | 2 3/4 inches thick beef steaks | 3/4 ounce tarragon ( minced ) | 3/4 ounce basil pesto | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 sprig rosemary ( to garnish ) | 1 dash hot italian sausage ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for steak, herbs and sausages in a deep fryer or large heavy duty plastic bag and turn on high heat to heat. This helps insure even coating of the meat on all sides before frying. Do not lift the lid during this time or it will be difficult to roll a proper thermometer. When it registers 125 degrees f on thermometer, remove to a rack to drain. Heat steak over medium high heat until brown, 5 to 7 minutes and remove from heat. Arrange steak slices on a heated serving platter. Sprinkle with herbs and sausages. Serve with favorite pasta and pass extra sauce. Serve right away. Note, make sure it is hot before adding ingredients. For that authentic street look, place sausages atop steak and bake at 325 degrees f. For 10 minutes then turn down to 300 degrees f for 45 minutes. Note, cook time varies on your stove, so check for doneness after 10 minutes and flip steaks. They should be tender when pierced the thickest part of the piece. I like mine medium rare and usually move them around for 2 or 3 minutes.

title: Cheated Greek Yogurt Pasta
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated or fresh pasta | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 1 cup sunflower oil | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared polenta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Mexican Marshmallow Bark
ingredients: 2 packages mini marshmallows, divided | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 6 serrano chile peppers, or more to taste, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread half of the marshmallows onto the foil.

title: Lime And Chocolate Souffles
ingredients: 3 large egg yolks | 3 tablespoons romano cheese or 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese, shredded | 12 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. In an extra large bowl beat egg yolks with cheese. Gently fold in egg yolk mixture. Drop by teaspoonsful into buttered 6 ramekins. Place ramekins on baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes. Cool completely. Lime wedges, cut lime segments into thin slices. Place lime wedges into a cocktail shaker, add a few pinches of salt, 1 teaspoon of sugar and 2 tablespoons of water. Serve with ramekins.

Random Ingredients: lemon,pecan nut,beef sausage,golden syrup,lime juice,palm sugar,egg noodle,red bell pepper
title: Zesty Beef Sausages With Noodles
ingredients: 12 -16 ounces egg noodles | 8 ounces sweet beef sausage | 3 tablespoons golden syrup ( i use karo or delta sugar twin ) | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( lime doesn't need to be doubled ) | 4 teaspoons lemon rind, grated ( optional ) | 1 small red bell pepper, cut into 4 thick strips | 1/2 cup toasted, chopped pecan nuts
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot of boiling, salted water. When cooked, drain but reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking water. Meanwhile, break up the sausage into 3 pieces. In a small bowl, stir together the syrup and rind and add to the pork drippings until the pork is coated and heated through. Add the sausage and bell pepper strips and mix thoroughly. Pour the noodle mixture into a large saute pan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly and breaking up the pork. As the meat starts to char, remove from heat and sprinkle with a little sugar. Serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Ginger Beer Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown basmati rice or 1 cup long grain rice | 2 cups ginger ale ( chinese ginger ale or other brand will work ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Boil the rice in a large pot until it is tender. You can leave it in the heat for 1 minute after it is done, but i like it over medium heat for a bit longer. It is very important to reserve about 1/4 cup of the leftover gingerale. Drain the rice after it is done cooking. If your going to freeze, place it in a bowl, cover with a paper towel, and put the bowl over a medium heat on the stovetop. When the rice is hot, add the ginger/ginger ale to the rice in the bowl and stir. If you want to serve this on the show, place some plastic on top of the rice. The liquid in the bottom of the bowl will cause a little bit of the liquid to start to run out, and pour back into the bowl. Add the garlic powder, and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 jar peas, drained | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil
instructions: Blend the peanut butter, palm sugar, catsup and peas with an immersion blender or blender till you have something that becomes smooth. Taste for sweetness. If you have it you can always add some sugar to get the full flavor. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chunky Banana & Peanut Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 cup green chiles ( canned or bottled ) | 1 tablespoon dry cumin powder | 1 banana, thinly sliced | splenda granular, sugar substitute, to taste
instructions: Blend chiles, cumin and banana in a food processor until smooth. Spread mixture over a large, ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with splenda sugar. Bake in a 300 degree f oven until heated through, about 20 minutes, stirring once.

title: Sopa De Albondigas
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1 cup shaoxing wine | 1 can white hominy, drained
instructions: Cook beef and wine in a skillet over medium high heat until beef is browned and liquid is clear. Mix in the hominy and boil over medium heat until heated through, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,white bread,cardamom powder,cilantro leaf,celery rib,fontina cheese,linguine,white sugar
title: Linguine With Fontina Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 pinch ground black pepper | 1 pinch cardamom powder | 4 ounces fontina cheese, cut into cubes | 1 medium celery rib, chopped | 1/4 cup minced cilantro leaves | 1 loaf white bread, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook linguine in the boiling water, stirring occasionally with a fork, until tender yet firm to the bite, about minutes. Drain. Remove 1/2 cup of the liquid from pasta and set aside. Add white sugar, black pepper, and cardamom powder to fontina cheese in a small bowl. Add pasta to the cheese mixture and toss until both ingredients evenly coat the pasta. Transfer the pasta to a small baking dish. Mix in the celery, cilantro, and reserved 1/2 cup pasta liquid. Top with more fontina, spreading lightly. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and beginning to bubble, about 10 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Almond Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs rhubarb | 1/2 lb bamboo shoot | 1/2 lb almonds, blanched and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar
instructions: Remove the rhubarb from its stalk and shred the flesh by rubbing it with your fingers. Cut or tear the rhubarb into bite sized pieces and place them in a wide bowl. Cut the almonds in half horizontally. Remove the stems, if desired.

Random Ingredients: black greek olive,pork chop,glace cherry,pepper sauce,gelatin,havarti dill,dark soy sauce,salt
title: Havarti Kebabs from the City of Rome!
ingredients: 1 piece gelatin, about 1-inch square | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( tabasco, cayenne, or any other hot soy sauce ) | 2/3 cup dark soy sauce ( regular or reduced sodium ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup honey-roasted black greek olive, roughly chopped pieces or 1/2 cup pimento-stuffed olives | 1/2 cup black greek olive, roughly chopped | 4 large pork chops, cut into 4 equal pieces | 12 pink havarti with dill, heads and tails removed, halved lengthwise
instructions: In a non reactive bowl, soak gelatin in 1/4 cup of the dark soy sauce for 15 minutes. Remove gelatin and place it in a saucepan along with the pepper sauce, remaining dark soy sauce, and salt. Stir to combine and heat thoroughly. When the glaze thickens, remove from the heat and add the honey and 1/4 cup extra sauce. Stir to combine and set aside. In a metal bowl, toss the olives with the olive pieces and set aside. Preheat the grill pan or a broiler to high and grease the grates. Thread the pork onto skewers and grill until well browned turning occasionally, about 20 minutes, or place in a broiler pan and broil until the pork is cooked through and the onions glaze has caramelized.

title: Frozen Banana Dessert
ingredients: 1 package frozen cut, peeled bananas | 2 teaspoons nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Line a 9 inch cake pan with plastic wrap. Line the wrap with plastic wrap. Place the banana slices in a dish towel, and toss with the nonfat dry milk powder, until coated. Microwave for 1 minute, and drain on paper towels. Place on the prepared cake pan, and freeze in an airtight container at least 1 hour and up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,dashi granule,red leaf lettuce,molasses,bread crumb,stewing beef,iceberg lettuce
title: Steak Rolls With Chilli, Coriander, and Molasses
ingredients: 3 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 cups shredded stewing beef | 4 teaspoons coriander seed, crushed, divided | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/2 cup fresh bread crumb | dashi granules | 1/2 cup shredded red leaf lettuce, leaves
instructions: Divide shredded beef among 4 large flat bowls. Sprinkle with half a teaspoon of coriander seeds.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,conch,red chilies,confectioner sugar,vegetable,chinese pea pod
title: Spicy Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1/2 pound canned chinese pea pods, drained and sliced | 1 cup chopped fresh vegetables ( like corn, peas and carrots ) | 3 dried red chilies | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons curry leaves, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Heat wok over high heat, then add oil. When oil shimmers, add the vegetables and dried chilies. Fry until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Toss in sugar and curry leaves. Transfer to a bowl. Serve hot.

title: Lamb Chops With Lemon
ingredients: 2 lamb loin chops, fat trimmed | 1 lemon, cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 °f. Season lamb chops with salt and pepper. Arrange on a shallow baking dish and cover the meat with the lemon wedges. Drizzle with some of the lemon juice. Bake for 45 minutes, basting once or twice with juices. Serve the lamb chops with remaining lemon wedges.

title: Smoked Salmon With Apples
ingredients: 2 -3 ounces smoked salmon fillets, cut into chunks | 4 ounces cream of celery soup, low fat | crushed cashews | 1 small red apple, washed, peeled, cored and finely chopped
instructions: Heat up the cashew and apple pieces in a small skillet, but not soak them for 5 mins, toss them in to a warm dish. Spread the cream of celery soup on top of the salmon fillets, and sprinkle over the cashew and apple. Serve.

title: Cheesy Bacon Bits
ingredients: 6 -8 slices bacon bits | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated | 1/4 cup cheese spread, such as kraft singles ( or any cheese dip your choice )
instructions: Spray or brush a small ovenproof skillet or casserole dish with cooking spray. Pour in the bacon bits, sprinkle lemon peel on top. Add cheese spread. Place in oven until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cold cooked rice | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place rice in a 2 1/2 quart microwave safe casserole dish. Heat in microwave until hot but not boiling, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in jalapeno pepper. Cover and cook at high power to 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed, stirring halfway through cooking. Stir rice mixture and cool for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,beet,soymilk,thai red curry paste,egg noodle
title: Red Curry Veggies
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, cut in half and boiled | 4 ounces beet, thinly sliced and soaked ( or other fresh vegetable ) | 2 egg noodles, broken in half | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons soymilk
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, mix well and add a bit more milk if needed to obtain a creamy texture.

title: Olive Oil and Pepper Dip
ingredients: 10 slices white bread ( from day old flat bread ) | 100 g grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons stevia ( or anise extract, found in health food stores )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Put bread on to pizza/dish/cookie tray. Mix the olive oil and pepper extract in a small bowl until well combined. Spread olive mixture evenly over each piece of bread. Sprinkle grated cheese over the top followed by oregano. Bake at 200c for 10 - 15 minutes depending on thickness of crust.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,bok choy,red onion,mustard seed,crouton,soy sauce
title: Chayote Burger
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, lightly crushed | 1 tablespoon bok choy, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon red onion, finely chopped | 100 g chocolate chips, melted | 1 -2 tablespoon soy sauce | crouton
instructions: Place mustard seeds, bok choy and red onion in a large bowl, add cheese and mix well. Add soy sauce to taste. Mix to combine. Form mixture into 4 flat patties about 25cm/1 2cm thick, about 2cm/3 4cm in diameter. Grill over medium coals for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve on bun base with crunchy lettuce, choy and crunchy coriander toppings.

title: Amaretto Sweet Potato and Bean Roundup
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and cut into 5 mm cubes | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon amaretto
instructions: Place potatoes in a large bowl. Place beans in a microwave safe bowl and cook on high for 1 minute or until soft mash well using a potato masher. Add cornflour and amaretto. Mix thoroughly with a fork, then add the potato mix to the bowl. Cover with clingfilm and keep in the fridge until ready to use. Keep in the fridge during the last 30 minutes of baking.

Random Ingredients: chestnut mushroom,scallion,tortilla chip,fennel seed,beef tenderloin,cardamom seed,white miso,olive
title: Beef Nachos (Beef Nauts)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons white miso | 3 tablespoons olive, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon scallion, finely chopped | 1 jar chestnut mushrooms, drained and sliced | tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Combine mushroom and fennel in bowl. Set aside. Combine miso, 1 tablespoon of the oil and 2 tablespoons of the oil in measuring cup. Add fennel, cardamom and scallions. Drain chestnuts and mushrooms. Place in bowl with miso mixture, toss to coat. Spread a few tablespoons of scallion oil in the bottom of a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Arrange nauts over the oiled pan. Dot with more scallion oil. Bake, uncovered, until brown crust is light brown and meat is beginning to jiggle, 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Hot Pepper Candy
ingredients: 1 yellow pepper | 1 1/4 cups corn flakes | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Wash and cut the yellow pepper in half.

title: Orecchiette with bamboo shoots
ingredients: 1 package orecchiette | 1 1/2 cups sliced bamboo shoots, drained well | 5 cups ice water, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil, and cook orecchiette pasta until al dente. Stir in bamboo shoots and ice water. Cover, and continue cooking until orecchiette is tender, about 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Spinach & Zucchini Saute
ingredients: 1 large zucchini, halved lengthwise | 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 2 cups shredded mexican-style cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place zucchini, cut side down, on the baking sheet. Bake 5 to 6 minutes, or until edges are lightly browned. Remove zucchini to platter. Add spinach to saucepan.

title: Spicy Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 small watermelon | 500 g green beans, trimmed | 250 g blueberries ( rinsed ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Halve the watermelon and cut into bite sized pieces. Toss together with the beans, blueberries, and chilli flakes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,green enchilada sauce,lime wedge,snow pea
title: Mexican Snow Peas Salad
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 2 bags fresh snow pea | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 small lime wedge
instructions: Place frozen peas in medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to boil uncovered, uncovered, and simmer until tender. Drain and run cold water over peas.

title: Quick Steak Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb minute steaks | grapeseed oil or grapeseed oil
instructions: Place your steaks between wax paper in a very hot oven or fryer. Pour about a third cup of grapeseed oil into a frying basket and heat on medium high heat. Add the steaks and quickly stir fry until just done. Remove from the heat and serve with salad, or your favorite greens.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,yoghurt,panko breadcrumb,plain flour,cod,vegetable stock,spanish onion,white mushroom
title: Cod With Mushrooms and Yoghurt
ingredients: 200 g white mushrooms | 100 g cod | 1 large spanish onion | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped | 300 ml vegetable stock | 1/4 cup yoghurt | 1 -2 tablespoon panko breadcrumbs or 1 -2 tablespoon kefalotiri
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c mix all ingredients except panko together until it resembles breadcrumbs, stir in panko. Spread panko on non stick baking tray and bake for 20 minutes. When done check for doneness if it browns a little on the underside and then remove from oven. While still hot flake cod, serve over the mushrooms and top with yoghurt to eat as a burger or serve with a side salad.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,confectioner sugar,wild mushroom,yellow bell pepper
title: Confusion Vegetables
ingredients: 1/4 pound fresh wild mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup chopped yellow bell peppers | 2 cans dark red kidney beans, drained | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon melted shortening
instructions: Combine mushrooms, red kidney beans and vegetable oil in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring to coat. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for two to three minutes. Serve hot.

title: Bell Peppers Almond Preserve
ingredients: 4 red yellow bell peppers, halved | 1 package blanched almonds in light syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a medium baking sheet with parchment paper. Place halved bell peppers on prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle evenly with whole almonds. Bake at 425 degrees f for 20 minutes, then lower temperature to 325 degrees f. Continue baking until bell peppers are tender and are slightly colored, about 1 hour 15 minutes longer. Allow bell peppers to cool slightly and remove skin from peppers, being careful not to burn. Using a vegetable peeler, peel the peppers and cut in half lengthwise. Place the halves back together. Cut the halves, in half again, and cut each half into 6 pieces. Place peppers, cut side down, on the parchment covered cooking sheet. Remove skin from peppers. Remove stem from pepper halves.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,pine nut,salmon fillet,taco seasoning mix,garlic granule
title: Baked Salmon Taco Meat
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix ( from a package ) | 2 teaspoons garlic granules | 1 tablespoon pine nuts | 1 tablespoon dry taco seasoning mix ( from a package )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly butter the inside of a 10x15 inch baking dish. Place salmon in baking dish. Sprinkle the taco seasoning on top. Toss with the garlic granules and pine nuts. Bake for approximately 20 minutes, basting once with the taco seasoning mixture. Remove from oven. Serve, with your choice of meat, cheese, crackers or vegetables. Tip, do not remove the fish, it will be eaten in seconds.

title: Garden Baked Nachos With Green Hellman's Hors D'oeuvres
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely chopped greens such as chard, collard, spinach and arugula | 2 small shallots, diced | 2 large seedless cucumbers, peeled, halved lengthwise, sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch slices or 3/4 teaspoon grated fresh cheese | 3/4 cup lima beans, rinsed, drained | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 12 corn tortillas ( about 20 inches across ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f place a wire rack in the center of a ovenproof skillet and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Add half the greens, shallots, cucumbers and beans to the skillet and toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: angel hair pasta,pork roast,pimento olive,cardamom seed,asafoetida powder,fruit pectin,chicken breast half,vinegar
title: Authentic Indian Chicken and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3/4 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast halves - cut into cubes | 1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into cubes | 1 can diced dried fruit pectin | 1 jar diced pimento stuffed olives, drained | 1 cup vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 package angel hair pasta
instructions: Place chicken, chicken, and diced fruit pectin in a large container. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add angel hair pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Mango Pesto Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 2 cups instant polenta | 2 1/2 cups broth, or as needed | 1 can condensed cream of potato soup | 1/2 pound mango, diced | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and diced | 1 jar sun-dried pesto sauce, oil-packed, no sodium
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Mix polenta, broth, cream of potato soup, and mango together in a bowl. Fold chicken and pistachios into the polenta mixture until just mixed. Transfer the polenta mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until deep gold, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,biscuit,jeera powder,rye bread,spinach leaf,beef bouillon,oregano,onion powder
title: Spinach Pakodas (Aka "Tandoori Fry")
ingredients: 2 loaves jerked bread, cut into 1/2 inch wide strips 1/4 inch thick | 1 lb spinach leaves ( stems removed ) | 1 pound ground beef bouillon ( or substitute 3/4 cup beef broth-based stock ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 teaspoon jeera powder | 1/2 package crumbled spaghetti | 2 cups biscuit dough
instructions: Toast the jerked loaves under the broiler and let cool. Cut the slices into the desired length and width. Toast 1/2 pound of the pound of ground beef, drain water, and set aside. Remove the meat from the refrigerator and set aside. Toast 1/4 pound of the pound of ground beef in a skillet, drain grease and set aside. Wipe out the skillet with a paper towel to take as much grease/oil off as possible. Heat the oil/oil to a medium heat. In a mixing bowl put in 1/2 pound of the ground beef, spinach, onion powder, oregano, and jeera powder. Mix together and combine. Make an indentation in the center of each flattened bread slice, and place 1 tablespoon of the meat into the indentation. Close the bread'sandwich', ensuring that the meat is completely covered by the meat. Place the bread'sandwiches' on the oiled/sprayed pan until slightly browned. You may need to brush the bread with more oil if it starts to get too wet. Turn over and brown again on the other side. This is just to toast properly, without it becoming crisp. This is also a very tasty garnish for your bento box. Cook the noodles as manufacturers directions state. Serve each person with 1 cup of the cooked noodles. Each person garnishes his or her own bento box. Serve with extra gravy, sour cream, diced red onion and/or chives. To freeze extras, store in freezer bags in freezer bags after freezing and use. To reheat, thaw in refrigerator a few minutes, then reheat.

Random Ingredients: green onion,chinese wine,ra el hanout spice mix,orange,french mustard,brie cheese,french bread,taco seasoning
title: Peking Brie
ingredients: 6 crusty soft french bread rolls | 2 cups french mustard | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons orange rind, grated | 2 tablespoons chinese wine ( or madeira ) | 1 package of hanout spice mix | 1/2 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 2 ounces of brie cheese ( not shaved or dry whipped )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Split bread rolls in half lengthwise making sure you have 4 equal halves with each half being about 1/2 inch thick. Spread roll halves with french mustard. Mix green onions, orange rind, chinese wine, and hanout/oil. Sprinkle rind mixture over bread. Top with brie, then cover with aluminum foil and bake about 20 minutes.

title: Pasta With Sausage and Braggio
ingredients: 12 ounces hot italian or polish sausage | 12 ounces fresh asian pear slices, sliced or 8 ounces canned italian tomatoes, chopped | 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 1 lb farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta or 1 lb other hard italian pasta | 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: In a large skillet, brown sausage. Remove, drain and set aside. Brown pear slices in same skillet. Drain fat from skillet. Add tomatoes, cheese, mustard and cooked sausage to onion in skillet. Heat thoroughly and reduce heat to low. Add pasta and margarine. Cook pasta and reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,coriander seed,italian breadcrumb,glace cherry,cauliflower,spinach leaf,vanilla extract
title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 3 large eggplants | 200 g spinach leaves | 100 g cauliflower, chopped | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 80 g italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut out the middle of each eggplant, removing the white papery skin from inside. Cut the flesh along the base of each eggplant to get round slices. You should have approximately 2 cm around the skin. Carefully scoop out the seeds with your fingers before stuffing. In a large bowl, mix together the spinach, cauliflower, mustard seeds, chopped coriander and 1/2 of the breadcrumbs. Set aside. Place the remaining breadcrumbs in a small bowl. Mix in the vanilla if using and set aside. Brush the tops of the eggplant with eggtze mixture and place on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with remaining breadcrumb mix. Place in the oven for 30 - 40 minutes until eggplant is slightly charred and the tops are crispy. Serve.

title: Napa Dave's Fennel Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 large fresh button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon minced fennel | 1 1/2 cups grated smoked gouda cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Place mushrooms in the boiling water, and simmer, turning the mushrooms once, until the mushrooms are a rich green color, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain the mushrooms, and set aside. Stir the mint and fennel into the mushrooms. Stir in the cheese. Reduce heat to medium, and cook until the cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

title: Cream of Macadamia and Apple Juice
ingredients: 200 g macadamia nuts | 1/3 liter buttermilk | 10 g saffron | 3/4 liter sparkling water | 1 apple
instructions: Heat the macadamia oil in a pot, add the saffron and simmer for 1 minute, then add the boiling water. Wash the apple, remove core and all soft part, then slice into chunks. Put the apple into blender and add the saffron and stir. Blend until smooth. Add the buttermilk and stir. Blend again. Add the blended contents of the pot to the pot, and add the sparkling water as soon as it comes to boil, so that it is thickened and cold. Chill and then serve in chilled glasses.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,fava bean,nicoise olive,italian parsley,vinegar,spring onion
title: Baby Bok Choy and Fava Bean Salad
ingredients: 200 g frozen fava beans, thawed | 4 baby bok choy, cleaned, washed, trimmed and cut into 3cm lengths | 2 medium spring onions, chopped diagonally | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon nicoise olives, sliced
instructions: Place the fava beans into a large pan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for about 10 mins, until just tender and just cooked through. Drain, transfer to a large bowl and set aside. Add the bok choy to the water, ensuring they are just steaming and bring back to the boil. Cover to keep warm. Place half the cooked fava beans into a food processor and blend until smooth. Drain the beans. Add all of the beans to the bowl with the fava beans, bok choy, spring onions and parsley. Add the vinegar and olives and seasoning to taste. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Cheese and Walnut Soup
ingredients: 1 cup cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 teaspoons pernod ( licorice flavored ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup walnuts, chopped, toasted
instructions: Put cheese and horseradish in soup bowl. Add pernod, and chicken stock. If desired, sprinkle with walnuts and serve hot.

title: Alsatian Apple Tea
ingredients: 2 lbs apples, peeled, cored, quartered and sliced 1/4-inch thick ( i use a combination of white, yellow and sweet apples ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary sprigs | 2 cups chilled half-and-half | 3 cups chilled half-and-half ( heavy cream ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh lemon zest
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, combine apples, rosemary and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and simmer for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and drain off any excess water. Return apple liquid to the pot and cook over low heat for another 5 minutes, or until apples are soft and mushy. Using a slotted spoon, transfer apple liquid to a bowl and allow to cool. Using a hand held blender, puree apples and remaining liquid until smooth and well mixed. Return apple puree to warm slightly cooled pot and add half and half and lemon zest. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until warm through. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,rice wine vinegar,garlic clove,vegetable oil cooking spray,risotto rice,pinto bean,pie shell,cilantro leaf
title: Pinto Bean Rice Wraps
ingredients: 1 medium garlic clove | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil ( or canola oil, just enough to cover the bottom of the pan ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 lbs pinto beans, fresh ( can use other white beans ) | 5 cups leftover crispy rice, cooked ( see directions ) | 3/4 cup loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves, packed | 8 inches pie shells, baked (, see directions ) | 2 cups crispy rice ( see directions ) | 2 garlic cloves, minced | chopped fresh cilantro leaf
instructions: For beans, in a saucepan of boiling water, blanch the beans for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain and allow to cool completely. To prepare rice, in a saucepan bring 2 cups water to boil, and add rice and cilantro. Reduce heat to simmer, cover and cook for 8 - 10 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Drain cooked rice and set aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. To make garlic infused rice, in a small frying pan, add garlic, and saute over high heat until it just begins to golden. Set aside. Remove pan from heat, remove garlic, and set aside. Wipe out pan. When hot, add oil. When hot add rice, stirring until the grains are coated with oil. Scatter garlic over rice, and cook until rice is light golden, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat, and add water and vinegar, and stir until liquid is absorbed. Arrange one or two baked frozen pie shells on a plate. Top each with the beans. Spoon about 2 t. Of the rice mixture ontop of each, and spread evenly, making sure to leave two t. Of rice and beans at the top. Spoon the garlic infused rice over the beans. Spread as much cilantro as can fit onto the top of the rice. Place a piece of parchment paper in the middle, and wrap it tightly. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet. Cover with parchment paper.. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and set aside. When cool, slice through the top of the parchment to create a square. To serve, invert the square, and invert right side up onto plate, making a cone shape around the rice. Wash hands, and dry them, and spread a small amount of oil on top of rice. Fill up with beans, and garnish with cilantro. Serve piping hot.

title: Simple Rhubarb Broth
ingredients: 1 -2 stalk rhubarb | 2 beets
instructions: If using fresh rhubarb remove stems, cut into chunks, remove leaves & wash, cut off hard ends of stems & rinse. Slice rhubarb crosswise into 1/2 pieces. Place in a pan with water to cover & boil gently, uncovered, for about 7 minutes. Add beets & cook for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat & let sit 5 - 10 minutes, then drain beets & serve.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,egg,cherry pepper,beetroot,dark soy sauce,fine sea salt
title: Chinese Beetroot and Squash Pie
ingredients: 500 g butternut squash, peeled and cut into chunks | 400 g raw beets, peeled and chopped | 1 liter cherry peppers, halved | 1 egg, beaten to glaze | 1 tablespoon fine sea salt | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Place squash and beetroot in a large roasting tin and drizzle with just enough white soys to cover the vegetables. Place the cherry peppers on top and sprinkle with salt. Mix egg with remaining glaze in a bowl and pour over vegetables. Place in the oven for 40 minutes or until vegetables are tender and golden. Serve warm.

title: Swiss Gouda Dip (Swedish)
ingredients: 6 ounces swedish gouda cheese, room temperature ( or other mild white cheese ) | 1 green cardamom pod, lightly smashed
instructions: In an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, combine the cheese and the cardamom pod. Process just to blend the ingredients. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding salt to taste. Transfer to an airtight container and chill for a few hours before serving. Garnish with mint or a bit of chopped coriander.

Random Ingredients: chile pepper,pecorino romano cheese,confectioner ' sugar,asafoetida powder,olive oil cooking spray
title: Asafoetida Powder for Grilling
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 bunches fresh asafoetida powder, leaves | 1 teaspoon ground chile pepper | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Lightly grease a shallow pan with vegetable spray. Toss the asafoetida, chile pepper and cheese with the asafoetida mixture. Brush the grilling surface with olive oil and lightly sprinkle with the cinnamon powder. Place the grill on the rack, close lid, and allow to grill for 10 minutes. Turn the grill off and turn off asafoetida mixture and allow to grill for an additional 5 minutes. The mixture should not be solid, but should be soft and sticky. Remove. Serve hot.

title: Pepperoni Patty Melts
ingredients: 12 pepperoni sticks | onion powder
instructions: Arrange 12 pepperoni sticks diagonally in a baking pan. Layer each with onion powder from pepperoni stick and then with remaining ingredients. Let cool slightly before slicing into 1/4 slices or use a 1 inch round cutter the size of a round or rectangle. These can also be done over open flame, grill, grill pan, stove top burner, oven, etc. Let the slices cool slightly before eating them. Note, i put in individual paper cases in the freezer to chill and then serve.

title: Spiced Pecan Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup ground pecans | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Combine the cornmeal, pecans, tamari, cumin, and fish sauce in a large bowl. Add enough water to make a very stiff dough. Divide dough into 4 equal portions and press into 10 inch nonstick baking sheets on the flat side of parchment, leaving at least an inch between each portion. Sprinkle each sheet lightly with salt and pepper and cover until ready to use. Heat a large, nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,italian parsley,sirloin,toothpick,rye bread,coriander,grain white rice,rice wine vinegar
title: Armenian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 1 bag of uncooked long grain white rice ( not instant ) | 1 bunch fresh coriander | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley | 15 toothpicks | 24 slices rye bread ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | rice wine vinegar
instructions: Place meat in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat and simmer on low heat for 2 hours. The meat should easily shred after this time. Remove meat from the pan. Save water in a bowl and set aside. Pick through the coriander, parsley and rice then separate them into coarsely chopped roots, stems and leaves. Rinse and drain the meat thoroughly. Cut the beef into thin slices, about 1/4 inch thick, taking care to remove any bones and excess fat. Arrange the meat on a flat surface. Brush with half of the sherry vinegar. Close the toothpicks with a moist paper towel and sprinkle with half of the tabasco sauce. Place the rye bread on the meat and press together. Roll the beef slices into the bouquet garni and secure with the remaining toothpicks. Repeat with the remaining beef slices, placing each slice on a cookie sheet covered with parchment paper. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a 10 inch skillet. Place the meat into the oil and fry until crispy, turning frequently. Drain the meat on paper towels. Serve hot with the rice wine vinegar. Note, if the water in the pan before removing it from the stovetop is boiling, skim the surface as soon as the water is almost absorbed.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,ice,fajita flour tortilla,clear honey,peach brandy,kosher salt,heavy whipping cream
title: Baked Peach Tacos
ingredients: 1 large onion flakes | ice | 3 ripe peaches, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup prepared mustard or 1/4 cup dry onion flakes | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, chilled | 6 fajita-size flour tortillas | clear honey, for drizzling
instructions: Toast the onion flakes in a dry skillet over medium low heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Be careful of burning. Meanwhile, arrange a wire rack in a foil lined broiler pan and set aside. When the onions have fragrant turned dark orange peel, peel out onion flakes. Coat the edges of a 12 or 14 inch long piece of wax paper with a little extra virgin olive oil and arrange the toast or tortillas in the pan. Place in the oven to keep warm. Warm the cream over medium low heat in a medium sized bowl until it is hot but not boiling. When the cream starts to bubble, add the remaining ingredients and let them bubble until they are heated thoroughly, about 5 minutes. Spoon about 1 tablespoonful of the hot liquid over the warm tortilla and top with 1 or 2 tablespoons of the warm cream mixture and a pinch of the fried onions. Roll up the tortilla around the filling and secure all sides with toothpicks. Place in a shallow serving pan and repeat with the remaining tortillas. Pour off the liquid from the pan. Drizzle with clear honey and serve.

title: Kale and Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup chopped kale, or to taste | 8 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook kale in the boiling water, stirring often, until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside until cool, about 10 minutes. Place frozen phyllo dough in a bowl and cover with a damp cloth. Cover with a cloth towel. Microwave on high power until phyllo dough has crisped, about 1 minute. Uncover phyllo dough and place on a baking sheet. Microwave kale in the microwave on high power until tender and creamy, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir kale mixture with kale, and continue cooking until leaves are very tender, about 2 minutes longer. Let cool before phyllo dough can be frozen.

title: Easy Basil Soup
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock | 1 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: Rinse and tear off stems of fresh basil leaves, making sure to get any of the loose leaves attached. Bring the chicken stock to a boil in a pot. When the stock begins to boil, add the chopped basil and toss to blend.

title: Spicy Indian Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork shoulder, trimmed | 1 teaspoon pickling salt | 1 jar mango chutney
instructions: Combine pickling salt and mango chutney in a heavy saucepan. Heat over medium high heat until hot, but not boiling. Fill pork with pickling liquid.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,fenugreek seed,flax seed,black rice,baby arugula,lemon zest,cornstarch
title: Black Rice (Fenugreek Vegetable with Chicken)
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup cooked black rice ( or use a combination of rice and black rice ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon ground fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | freshly ground fenugreek seeds ( i use about 2 tablespoons ) | 1/2 cup frozen baby arugula, thawed | 1 tablespoon freshly-ground granulated cornstarch | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon ground fenugreek seeds | freshly ground black pepper ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, simmer soup, and bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Stir in rice, and bring to a boil again. Stir in 2 tablespoons of cornstarch and 1/4 teaspoon of fenugreek seeds. Remove from heat, stir in arugula and season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for a few hours for best flavor.

title: Smoked Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 3 cans cheese tortellini | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 carrot | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons stevia powder | 1 teaspoon crushed red chilies or 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Drain tortellini and cut into 3/4 pieces. Wash carrot and slice paper thin. In a large bowl, mix together the first six ingredients and mix well. Add drained tortellini and toss to coat.

title: Ras El Hanout Qibe (Chunky Salsa)
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds ( crushed )
instructions: Mix well. Serve with fresh sliced chourries.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,strawberry jam,guajillo chilies,prosciutto,virgin olive oil,egg noodle,half
title: Noodle-Wrapped Two-Cheese Frijoles
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces plain egg noodles | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 2 slices prosciutto, roughly chopped | 2 guajillo chilies, stemmed seeded, and cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon vanilla ice cream | whole strawberry jam, for garnish
instructions: Place the noodles in a large shallow dish. Cover with lightly salted cold water, and let stand until softened, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain well, and set aside. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in half and half, prosciutto, and half chilies.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone,vegetable juice,green cabbage,sharp cheddar cheese,yellow onion,poppy seed,pistachio nut,cooking sherry
title: Hungarian Nargiot With Sour Cream, Cheddar, and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 lb mascarpone or 1/2 lb light cream cheese, softened | 3/4 cup minced yellow onion | 1/3 cup chopped pistachio nut | 1/3 cup cooking sherry | 1 quart vegetable juice | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: In a mixing bowl, stir together the cheese, mascarpone cheese, onion, pistachios, and sherry. In a large glass or metal bowl, combine the vegetable juice and poppy seeds. Pour the mixture over the cheese mixture and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,chicken wing,garnish,pork roast,bicarbonate soda,sesame oil,white cabbage,silver tequila
title: Mama's Chicken Wings in a Coat - Filipino Pork and Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 kg boneless pork roast or 1 kg other lean pork fat | 100 g white cabbage | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons silver tequila | 2 tablespoons chicken wings | 2 tablespoons sweet pickled silver tequila | salt and sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Cut pork into chunks if the fat is too loose. Heat oils in a pot, add pork and brown lightly. Add cabbage and fry until both are soft and lightly coloured. Add salt and bicarb soda to pork, stir, then remove from heat and set aside. Cut cabbage leaves into thin strips. Add to pork and cabbage. Add tequila and chicken wings. Mix well. Cover with sesame seeds if using and put on the stove for 8 10mins in a medium heat. Uncover and cook until pork mixture thickens. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,red onion,green chili pepper,tamarind paste,ginger paste,cheddar cheese soup
title: Indian Style Cheesy Chutney Dip
ingredients: 1 envelope mild cheddar cheese soup | 1 can condensed apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, canned chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot on low for 4 - 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,white onion,granny smith apple,onion powder,tomato basil,beef stew meat,farfalle pasta
title: Saucy Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon white onion powder | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with basil | 3 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 3/4 package farfalle pasta, cooked | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced white onions
instructions: In dutch oven brown stew meat in hot oil. Add red pepper flakes, tomatoes with basil, and dried onion flakes. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. While sauce simmers, cook pasta in boiling, salted water until al dente. Drain well and set aside. After meat simmers, add cooked pasta to the soup and cook over medium heat, for approximately 10 minutes. Add sliced onions to soup along with the drained pasta and serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,thyme,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pasta sauce,butterscotch chip,pie crust,lemon peel
title: Nemaw's Butterscotch Lemon Gratin
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie crust | 1 box bought butterscotch chips | 1 tablespoon sesame oil, divided | 1 lb grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | pasta sauce, warmed ( optional, for dipping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Grease and flour a 13x9x2 inch casserole dish. Arrange the unbaked pastry crust into the bottom of the dish, and set aside. Place a pot of boiling water on to boil. Meanwhile, mix the butterscotch chips and 1 tablespoon of sesame oil together in a small bowl. Mix until well mixed. Pour into the pastry crust. In a medium bowl, mix together the parmigiano, 1/4 cup of the parmigiano, and zest of lemon peel and thyme. Sprinkle over the cheese mixture on top of the butterscotch chip mixture. Arrange the grated cheese over the top. Drizzle a few drops of water into the top so that the dish will not spill while baking. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature with pasta if desired.

title: Celtic Biscuits
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 3 tablespoons cocoa | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Pour the beans in to a bowl, mix thoroughly and set aside. Sift the flour, cocoa and salt into a large bowl. Add the drained beans and mix thoroughly. Roll dough out on a lightly floured surface to 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 2 inch circles. Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven about 10 minutes. Leave the biscuits on the baking sheet and turn oven off. Leave the biscuits in until 10 minutes before removing them.

title: Tasty Cretons
ingredients: 1/3 lb feta cheese | 1/3 cup chopped lettuce | paprika ( to taste )
instructions: Combine feta, lettuce, and paprika in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: mini marshmallow,green bell pepper,cucumber,russet potato,picante sauce
title: Creamy Rice (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled and cut in 1/2 `` or 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 large cucumber | 1 large green bell pepper ( i used yellow pepper but add more if desired ) | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 package mini marshmallows
instructions: Chop potatoes and cucumber very finely. Mash potatoes and cucumber, using potato masher, until smooth, adding some water.. Add bell peppers.

title: Veal With Blood Oranges and Almonds
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced veal | 1/2 cup almond butter | 1 blood orange
instructions: Prepare the sliced veal. Slice the blood oranges in half so they sit flat. Rinse in cold water. Pat dry. Place slices of meat in a casserole to coat with a layer of the blood orange juice.

Random Ingredients: curry,mace,pear,sage leaf,bulk italian sausage,spanish onion,baby spinach
title: Spinach and Sausage Bake
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 1/2 spanish onion, peeled and thinly sliced | 8 baby spinach, washed | 1/2 medium pear, pared, cored and sliced | 1 teaspoon curry | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9 × 13 x 2 dish with cooking spray. In a heavy skillet, cook sausage, onion, spinach and pear over medium high heat, stirring, until onion is tender. Transfer mixture to a bowel. Drain and set aside. Stir curry, sage, mace and the sausage mixture into sausage mixture just until mixed. Spread sausage mixture into prepared dish. Bake, covered, 40 - 45 minutes or until heated through and lightly browned and spinach has wilted.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,cheese food,blue curacao,chili oil,semolina,beet,butterscotch schnapps,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Baked Blue Hamburgers
ingredients: 3 ounces butterscotch schnapps | 4 ounces chinese five spice powder | 4 ounces soft cheese food | 3 tablespoons semolina | 2 egg yolks | chili oil ( to taste ) | blue curacao ( to taste )
instructions: Beat egg yolks, semolks, sugar, salt and chili oil until very light and fluffy. Fold in cheese food. Roll mixture into large loaf size patties and put in freezer for a few minutes as this will have a bite to it once cold it is ready to come out. Heat grill or barbeque. Place patties on hot barbecue and cook about 5 minutes per side. Slice while warm and serve with syrup or ice cream.

title: Easy Chili Melt on a Bun
ingredients: 2 slices of thin-sliced white bread | 1 whole red chilies, deseeded and sliced | 1 slice mild cheddar cheese
instructions: Toast the bread until lightly toasted on one side. Spread the chilies evenly over the toast and then sprinkle with the cheese. Leave for 5 minutes, or until the cheese has absorbed the flavour of the chillies.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,orange juice,fruit,triple sec,chicken wing,beef sirloin steak
title: Scotch Steak With Orange Glaze
ingredients: 3 3 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | 1 can sliced fruit, drained | 2 lbs beef sirloin steaks, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness ( trimmed, about 4 steaks ) | 1 cup freshly grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon triple sec
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Drain fruits, reserving juice. Place steaks on a rack in roasting pan, and roast until tender, about 20 minutes. Pour off fat, and season with salt and pepper. Remove steaks from oven, and spread orange glaze over both sides, and sprinkle with cheese. Bake until cheese is golden, about 10 minutes. Mound cooked fruit on top of steak, and serve.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,arborio rice,ice cube,kielbasa,cooking sherry,white vinegar,lemon zest
title: Kielbasa Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/3 cup quick-cooking sherry | 1 cup arborio rice | 1 cup ice cubes, or as desired
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray liberally with cooking spray. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the arborio rice, and return to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the pasta is tender, and the rice has absorbed all of the liquid, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Layer the cooked rice with the kielbasa slices and drizzle on the sherry. Sprinkle liberally with salt and black pepper. Bake in the preheated oven until the kielbasa and kielbasa are heated through and beginning to brown, about 10 minutes. Cool before serving.

title: Chutney Canapes With Mango Chutney
ingredients: 250 g smoked salmon ( flaked or chuted ) or 250 g salmon ( flaked or chuted ) | 200 g pearl onions ( thinly sliced ) | 1 cup mango chutney
instructions: Place all ingredients into medium sized bowl or food processor and process to a smooth paste. If mixture seems dry, add a small amount of water or apple juice.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,dill,vanilla ice cream,taco sauce,thyme leaf,parsnip,red bell pepper
title: Dairy Free Parsnips With Tasty Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 1 small red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 cup low-fat vanilla ice cream
instructions: Trim and discard ends of parsnips. Grate the stem part on the top and bottom of parsnips. Rinse parsnips with cold water and shake off any excess starch. Peel the stem out of the pepper. Cut pepper into thin sticks. Crush coriander seeds with a mortar & pestle. Add the coriander, thyme seeds, taco sauce and olive oil and pound. Strain and set aside. Add the juice from the tomatoe, parsnips and red pepper to taste. Toss thoroughly and place aside to cool. When preparing the tacos, take off the tomato & parsnip mixture and place in a medium size bowl. Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream and spread on top of the parsnip mixture. Top with a few sprigs of fresh parsley, shredded low fat cheese and a scoop of taco sauce. Put back in microwave for a few seconds or until cheese is melted.

title: Homemade Mint
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate syrup | 3 serrano peppers, or more to taste, minced
instructions: Mix bittersweet chocolate syrup, serrano peppers, and mint together in a glass or ceramic bowl.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,apricot,pearl barley,gruyere cheese,cream mushroom soup
title: Flaming Swiss Barley Cones
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley ( can use brown rice barley which has been gluten free ) | 3/4 cup cream of mushroom soup | 3/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | chopped maraschino cherries ( optional ) | pearl barley
instructions: Place the barley in a large, shallow casserole pan and add just enough water to cover. Bring the water to a boil, cover and cook for 25 minutes or until tender. Drain the barley and return it to the pan, and mix in the cream of mushroom soup with the grated cheese. Mix thoroughly. Add cherries, if using,. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,bamboo shoot,phyllo pastry,sauce,leg lamb,msg,pesto sauce
title: Shredded Lamb and Spicy Phyllo-Parmesan
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 8 ounces sliced bamboo shoots | 1 envelope hot sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 12 phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Mix together pesto sauce, coriander and msg i like this instead of msg. Cut the lamb into 1/4 1/2 and 1/4 strips. Put in a large bowl and add the spice mix and mix well. Heat a pan to medium and spray with olive oil. Saute the lamb until cooked through. Set aside. Lightly spray a sheet of filo and fold in half lengthwise. Fold in the sides and finally place the folded end on top. Spray the top with the olive oil spray and cover with more pam. Lay the phyllo on a clean counter and lightly flour and top lightly with a little more flour. Repeat with the remaining sheets. When this has finished, place the phyllo on a baking sheet with some of the meat. Brush each piece with the pesto sauce and top with remaining meat. Sprinkle with additional pesto. Bake in a preheated oven at 425 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Cocoa Mix for Meat
ingredients: 1 gallon coffee | 1 can pimento-stuffed peppers, drained | 1 can cranberries, drained | 10 lbs meat ( i like top round, roast chuck, rump... )
instructions: If making your own meat, in a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients in a gallon sized bag. Reseal bag, put in freezer for a few hours. Place all ingredients in a large crock pot and pour in coffee.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,yellow bell pepper,salt pork,allspice berry,rice wine,great northern bean,basil leaf
title: Salsami (Salsami)
ingredients: 2 cups dried great northern beans, picked over and washed | 1/2 pound salt pork, diced | 2 ounces small dried basil leaves | 1 pinch ground allspice berry | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 2 cubes chicken bouillon | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse and pick over beans, and place them in a roasting pan. Drizzle with a tablespoon of olive oil, and toss to coat. Sprinkle with salt. Cover tightly with foil, and cook in preheated oven, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and easily pierced with a fork, about 1 1/2 hours. Once cooked, remove foil, and return to oven.

title: Baked Chestnut and Rice Sausages With Sautéed Chive Basmati Rice
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked sausage meat | 1 cup basmati rice | 1 cup frozen petit chestnuts, thawed | 4 ounces smoked char-grilled sausage meat | 1/4 cup reduced-fat margarine, melted | 1 - 1 1/4 cup tahini paste | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 1 bottle raspberries | 1/4 cup beer
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f place the sausage meat in an ovenproof dish big enough to hold up the cooked sausage. Combine the rice, chestnuts, and char grilled sausages in a bowl. Pour over the melted margarine, tahini, chives, and rice. Bake, uncovered, for 50 - 50 minutes, or until the rice is brown and firm.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,lemon pepper,sourdough bread,pepperoni,bread,chickpea flour,garlic clove,cashew
title: Cashew Chickpea Grissini - Bread Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup cashews | 2 slices sourdough bread ( i use gluten-free, but can use any bread ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chickpea flour | 2 -3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon pepper | 2 slices bread, toasted ( i prefer ciabatta ) | 2 tablespoons green peppers, cut into strips | 1 -3 slice pepperoni, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In food processor or blender, mix cashews, 1/4 cup of the chickpea flour, garlic and seasonings until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and process until smooth, but still a bit coarse, so texture is prevalent. Spread onto baked bread slices and top with remaining chopped veggies. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 20 - 30 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: barley,coriander,chocolate chip,beef eye,poultry seasoning,tomato paste,english cucumber,apricot preserve
title: Easy English Cucumber Chutney
ingredients: 1/4 cup barley | 2 lbs beef eye round, sliced very thin | 1 can apricot preserves | 1 can tomato paste, divided | 1 english cucumber, finely diced | 3/4 cup apricot preserves ( regular or light ) | 1 3/4 cups par-boiled english wafer rice cereal or 1 3/4 cups chocolate chips
instructions: Boil the barley in salted water until well done. Stirring often. Meanwhile, remove and discard the meat from the bones and slice the beef into fine 1/2 inch cubes. If desired, drain the meat, return it to the pan. Add the bones to the meat. Pour half the preserves into a large bowl and add the tomato paste and the remaining preserves. Mix well. Add the grated columbian cheese and stir. In a separate bowl, combine the two tablespoons of rice cereal or chocolate chips. To make extra cheesy chocolate chips, drizzle the melted chocolate over the top before sprinkling over the top or mounding a few chocolate chips atop the hot chutney. Add a pinch of salt to the chutney to taste.

Random Ingredients: cachaca,chili,chunky peanut butter,red food coloring,wide egg noodle
title: Batatas Borracha (Chili Noodles)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 tablespoon cachaca | 1 tablespoon dried chili | 5 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | 4 -6 ounces wide egg noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix the peanut butter and cacaca in a small bowl. Add the chili and food colouring and stir to mix well. Set aside in a small dish. Stir a few drops of red food colouring in the hot noodle and then add noodle mixture.

title: Asparagus in Sour Cream
ingredients: 1/4 lb bulk asparagus | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 ounces chorizo sausage, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 2 pints cream cheese | 3 tablespoons ketchup, extra | 2 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Cook asparagus in salted boiling water, for 2 minutes or so. Drain, reserving cooking water. Mash aspargus, cream cheese and ketchup together in a bowl. Season to taste. Place a small handful of asparagus into the centre of a serving plate or bowl. Spread some of the cream cheese mixture down along the length of each asparagus. Top with a spoonful of asparagus on top of your cream cheese mixture.

title: Tortilla Nests for Two (Faux Sour Snack)
ingredients: 1 package cellophane noodles | 1 large lettuce | 4 slices rye bread | 4 slices fat free crisp-fry tortilla chips
instructions: Rinse cellophane noodles in a mesh strainer. Pat dry with paper towels and set aside. Cut lettuce in half lengthwise, then tear into 1 chunks. On a work surface, lay out 1/2 of noodles and lay the noodles flat. Lay the slices of bread, overlapping them, overlapping them slightly in horizontal lines. Carefully place 1/2 noodle chunk between the bottom of the bread slices and place 2 slices of crisp fried tortilla chips in a criss cross pattern on top of each noodle chunk. Place 1/4 cup hot water in a small saucepan, and place over high heat. When the water comes to a boil, reduce the heat to medium and keep at a slow simmer. Cook the nests, uncovered, for 15 to 20 minutes, until the noodles are tender and the bread lightly crisps. Let cool for 2 minutes, then carefully unmold onto serving plates. Eat warm.

title: Quick Cauliflower Cakes
ingredients: 1 bag cauliflower, florets not too thick | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: If cauliflower is large, cut smaller down to 1/4 thick. Otherwise, use smaller pieces and put flour on a cookie sheet. Set oven to 425 degrees f and spray with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium size bowl place cauliflower and flour. Add water slowly until the dough comes together. Add water if dough is dry. On a floured plate or cookie sheet, with floured hands shape dough into balls. Flatten lightly with your palm and place in the palm of your hand. Take a large handful of cauliflower, place on a floured cookie sheet with floured edges on it, press out in a circular motion with your finger until flat. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Bake about 17 minutes, until crisp and golden brown.

title: Swiss Chard - Apple Chard for Vegetables or Chops
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard or 1 lb spinach, washed and chopped to 1/3 inch in size pieces | 6 tablespoons sunflower oil, divided | 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice ( see notes or suggestions )
instructions: Cook the chard in boiling water for 5 minutes to soften it up a bit. Wash and dry the chard. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil, if necessary, in a large non stick skillet. Add the chard and stir fry for 2 minutes, then add the apple pie spice and stir fry for 20 - 25 minutes on high heat. Sprinkle with salt and serve warm with vegetables.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,sherry wine,tomato,salt black pepper,green chili pepper,red enchilada sauce,mint
title: Green Chili Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium tomatoes | 4 tablespoons sherry wine ( a jigger ) | 6 ounces green chili peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons red enchilada sauce | 2 teaspoons orange peel, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dried mint | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Core tomatoes and tomatoes and remove seed. Peel and dice into 1/2 inch dice. In a very large skillet, bring 2 quarts of water to boil. Add tomatoes and 1 tbsp of sherry. Blend well and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Add 1 1/2 tbsp red enchilada sauce and 1 tsp of orange peel. Cook for 5 more minutes. Add 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 teaspoons pepper. Add 3/4 of the mint and cook for 15 minutes, stirring often. Stir in remaining 2 tbsp sherry. Puree in a blender or food processor. Add remainder of sherry, tomatoes, 1 1/2 tbsp mint and remaining 1/2 tbsp mint. Chill.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,black pepper,rum,currant,celery,cream chicken soup,graham cracker crust
title: Curried Celery
ingredients: 1 lb celery, sliced into 1/4 inch, lengths | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup rum, rum flavoured preferred, can use coconut rum | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 15 fresh curry leaves | 3 graham cracker crusts, each 3/4 inch in size | 2 tablespoons currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix all ingredients in large bowl & set aside in a shallow roasting pan. Add crackers to pan, & bake about 15 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Deidra Imitation Weiners
ingredients: 8 ounces rice vermicelli | 1/4 cup sauerkraut | 1 packet chili seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Place vermicelli in a mixing bowl and cover with boiling water. Let stand for 5 minutes, then drain. Place raisins in a food processor or blender with sauerkraut. Add seasoning and turmeric and process until well combined. Drain excess water from vermicelli and add to the vegetable mixture. Shape into small meatballs, removing any excess fat. Place in a non stick fry pan or wok. Sprinkle with coriander.

title: Thai Parsnips
ingredients: 300 g parsnips, cut lengthwise into thin strips | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced | 200 ml red wine | 1 mango, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Slice the parsnips lengthwise into thin strips. In a wok, stir fry the parsnip and the chilli oil over high heat for 5 minutes, or until the noodles have turned light brown. Add the onion and stir fry for 10 minutes. Pour in the wine and mango and mix lightly. Add the parsnip strips then toss until the noodles are well coated.

title: Pressed Corned Beef Broth
ingredients: 3/4 cup sweet pickle relish | 1/3 cup sugar | 1 3/4 cups chicken or beef broth | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 tablespoon white sugar
instructions: Mix the sweet pickle relish, 1/3 cup of sugar, and remaining ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes to soften mixture. Strain the pickle relish through a sieve and spread on the prepared brisket. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Shred meat prior to using. Serve with baked potatoes or fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,catsup,soy sauce,monterey jack cheese,duck,pepperoncini pepper,mustard
title: Duck in the Oven
ingredients: 1 quart catsup | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 3 tablespoons mustard | 1 yellow onion, diced | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper, crushed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese | 2 duck, disjointed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In bowl mix catsup, soy sauce, onion, pepperoncini pepper, parm, and mustard. Put duck on rack in roasting pan. Turn pan to spread mixture so duck is all in a single layer. Roast uncovered 50 - 60 minutes or until thoroughly cooked and starting to caramelize. Sprinkle with cheese and allow cheese to melt.

title: Easy Sun-Dried Tomato and Bacon Muffins
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes ( peeled or grated ) | 1 can chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Melt cream cheese and sour cream, cool slightly. In bowl combine softened cream cheese, sun dried tomatoes and sun dried tomatoes. Mix together well. Add cooked potatoes and mix until well coated in mixture using a spoon. Spoon into greased muffin tin or muffin tin cups. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until lightly browned. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: shortening,orange juice zest,chicken breast,orange zest,butter,maple syrup,tamari,dill
title: Maple Glazed Chicken Breasts or Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup tamari | 1/2 cup orange juice and orange zest | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon dried chopped dill | 1/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons shortening
instructions: Combine the maple syrup, tamari, orange or lemon juice, orange zest, and orange zest in a small dish or heavy bottomed skillet. Sprinkle on the dill and stir to combine. Add meat and gently toss to coat with syrup. Melt the shortening over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, about 3 - 4 minutes. Add the chicken and coat with the glaze. Cover and cook about 5 minutes until the chicken feels firm to the touch and the liquid has thickened. Serve immediately.

title: Butternut Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 large raw peanuts, chopped | 1 can halved grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 1 bunch fresh broccoli, washed, ends trimmed and cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente drain and rinse under cold water. Set aside. Toss squash, peanuts, tomatoes, and peanut butter with pasta. You can chop up the broccoli and add it now too if you like.

title: Mexican Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 lb sweet vegetable crumbles | 1 lb pork, sliced thin | 1 package veggie crumbles | 1/4 cup creole seasoning | 1/4 cup bell pepper, sliced thin
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except bell pepper, in a large casserole dish. Cook at 350°f for 30 minutes, stirring frequently.

title: Four-Pepper Bread Pudding
ingredients: 4 cups whole wheat bread, cubes | 1 cup dry coconut milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons whole szechuan peppercorns | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Toast szechuan peppercorns in a dry heavy skillet over medium heat until fragrant and beginning to turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl. Place bread cubes in a blender.

Random Ingredients: shallot,vanilla bean,beef chuck roast,shell pasta,blue cheese
title: Beef With Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 12 ounces shell pasta | 12 ounces blue cheese | 1/4 cup shallot ( optional ) | 2 cups canned mixed vegetables ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta to desired doneness, drain and let cool a few minutes. Cut beef into 1/4 inch slices. Heat 1/4 inch saute pan, and cook the beef in the pan over medium heat until browned on all sides. Stir in the 1/4 cup of cheese, and cook until melted. Pour pasta into boiling water and cook according to package directions, and drain. Add back to sauce and toss. Serve with blue cheese if desired.

title: Mexican Pork Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 cup nonfat milk | 8 flour tortillas, quesadilla size | 8 ounces velveeta cheese ( or more to taste )
instructions: Cook pork with 1/2 cup water for about 3 hours or until tender. Shred meat with 2 forks.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,dill pickle,grain white rice,sesame oil,white cabbage,mayonnaise,vinegar,tarragon
title: Japanese Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice, cooked | 1/2 - 1 head white cabbage, cut in 6 wedges | 3 tablespoons white cabbage, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dill pickle, minced ( see # 481191 ) | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut the cabbage wedges in half widthwise and set aside. Cut the leaves into 1 1/2 inch lengths. Wash the cabbage well in several changes of water. Remove all grit or remaining green outer leaves. Place in a colander over a bowl and drain. Sprinkle the rice over the cabbage. Top with the minced pickle and toss to coat. In a small bowl beat the mayonnaise, vinegar and seasame oil with a fork. Combine the rice with the mayonnaise mixture and add the tarragon. If you are making this salad in advance, it may be covered and refrigerated for at least an hour but preferably overnight. Adjust seasonings to taste as the pickles and cabbage lends itself to this salad.

title: Tequila Sunrise
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 ounces tequila ( or any sweet, high-end flavored liqueur )
instructions: In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, combine the olive oil, tequila and mix well. Pour into a funnel and serve immediately.

title: Mango Preserves - by Todd Wilbur
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh mango, peeled, pitted and roughly diced to 1/3 the size | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Place all the ingredients in an electric blender until well mixed. Add salt and pepper to taste. Will keep in an airtight glass jar in the fridge for several weeks until required.

title: Spinach, Pineapple and Nut Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup canned small green beans, drained | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil or 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 12 ounces dry fettuccine | 1 cup coconut milk
instructions: Combine the beans and seeds in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Heat the oil in a small saucepan over a medium high heat and add the sunflower seeds. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 45 seconds. Add the green beans and tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Cook noodles in boiling water for 8 minutes or until tender.

title: Stir-Fried Mushrooms in Brandy
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fresh mushrooms | 1/3 - 1/2 cup dark soy sauce ( i use kikkoman dark soy sauce ) | 1/2 - 1 cup brandy ( depending on size of mushrooms )
instructions: Clean mushrooms and slice them as much as possible into 1/2 to 3 inch. Pour some brandy sauce into wok or large frying pan, then place mushrooms into pan and gently stir them around in the brandy to mix and coat. Heat over low heat, stirring with wooden spoon, until mushrooms are tender about 5 minutes. Don't overcook.

title: Cheese Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups light beer or 1 1/2 cups sparkling beer | 2 cups light ricotta cheese
