instructions: Pour 1½ cups light beer into a medium bowl and set aside. Using a fork, stir together the 2 cups of light beer with the ricotta cheese until completely dissolved and smooth. Add a little more liquid, if desired, to aid in spreading the dip. Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with parsley.

title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 1 1/4 cups apple butter ( i usually sub 1 can of grated parmigiano & 1/4 cup of white sugar crystals )
instructions: Place sugar in a saucepan and melt over medium heat, stirring constantly until it reaches 240&#8260.

title: Nepalese Goya Goya
ingredients: 1 lb dark red kidney beans | 3 teaspoons hing
instructions: Wash the beans very well. Soak them overnight in cold, clean water. Drain them and pour boiling hot water over them for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove and rinse the beans under cold water. Rinse well again under running water. Drain again and drain. Cover and store in the fridge overnight. To serve, sprinkle hing on the beans and toss in a large quantity of goya goya. Smoosh in the air. This is a delicacy in our household that is not only so known as manis. It brings out its unique goya flavour.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage link,plain soymilk,green chile pepper,picante sauce,chicken tender,cajun seasoning,buttermilk
title: Mexican Chicken Taters
ingredients: 1 pound chicken tenders, cut into 3-inch pieces | 1 can white-grilled italian sausage links | 2/3 cup plain soymilk | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 jar mild green chile peppers, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 cup buttermilk, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Place chicken and sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring to break them apart, until juices run clear, about 5 minutes. Drain the cooked chicken.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,dark raisin,kalamata olive,active yeast,mozzarella cheese,spaghetti sauce
title: Lobster Bread
ingredients: 10 -12 ounces uncooked spaghetti sauce | 12 ounces lobster tails, preboiled and chopped into 1-inch pieces ( i prefer fresh ) | 1 cup kalamata olive, pitted and chopped finely ( can use more or less ) | 1/2 cup dark raisin | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ( can use italian cheese blend if desired ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. In a large mixing bowl combine spaghetti sauce, lobster, olives, dark raisins, and mozzarella cheese. Add yeast and stir. In a large bowl, combine 1/2 cup water with salt and the rest of the dry ingredients. Stir into the cheese mixture to combine. Transfer to a greased 9x5 loaf pan and cover. Let rise, in a draft free warm place, to 1½ hours. Bake for 50 - 60 minutes or until done. Let cool, and transfer to a bowl. Cut the loaf at 1½ or 2 inch intervals using a serrated knife. You may need to remove the bread at intervals to make sure the pieces aren’t stuck together. You should have a very flat round shape that is perfect for dipping. Serve hot or warm.

title: White Chocolate Ham Meatballs (With or Without Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles or 1 lb dry multi-colored egg noodles | 1 1/3 cups breadcrumbs | 10 ounces white chocolate ( not unsweetened, melted and chopped ) | 1 package ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare noodles according to package directions. Combine beaten egg noodles, bread crumbs, melted chocolate, and meat in 2 quart baking dish. Bake meatballs, turning halfway through, until cooked through, about 20 minutes.

title: Walnut or Orange Blossom Pecorino
ingredients: 50 g walnut pieces | 100 g pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons white onions, chopped finely | 1/2 cup blanched almond, chopped
instructions: Fry walnuts until they are golden brown, watch them closely. Remove nuts and keep warm. Fry onions in olive oil. Add ginger, nuts and cheese and fry for another few minites. Mix in almonds and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hash brown,allspice,cremini mushroom,ham,tomato ketchup,pizza dough,flour tortilla
title: Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated pizza dough | hollow out round cookie dough | 1 package sliced ham | 1 can sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 can ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | flour tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Thaw pizza dough in refrigerator for at least 20 minutes. Remove dough from refrigerator, and roll out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Spread ketchup onto the top of the dough, and spread evenly. Add a small amount of both types of ham, and top this with mushrooms. Sprinkle cheese over the top and pinch allspice over the pizza. Brush your fingertips with a little olive oil on the top and bottom of the cheese to make an indentation in the top for steam. Slide crust onto a pizza screen or cookie sheet, and bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until crust is light brown and bubbly. Remove from heat, and let cool for at least 10 minutes before cutting into squares or wedges. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,sharp cheddar cheese,bell pepper,chervil,garlic clove,egg white,raspberry
title: Green Chile Chiles Rellenos
ingredients: 15 jalapenos ( green chile peppers or green chile peppers ) | 2 hard-cooked egg whites | 1/4 cup sour cherryvil | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons minced green chile peppers | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped bell pepper
instructions: Place chilies in a heat proof 9 by 13 baking dish. In a small bowl, blend egg whites, chervil, cheese, garlic and chile peppers. Sprinkle the mixture over the chilies. Cover with a lid or plastic wrap and bake at 350ºf for 30 minutes or until mixture is slightly jiggly. Remove from oven and loosen chilies from the baking dish. Arrange the chilies in a warm dish and cover with foil. Bake at 350ºf for 10 minutes or until hot.

title: Cousin Pete's Lamb and Rice with Orange
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 1/4 cups long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained well | 1 tablespoon powdered cumin | 2 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Mix lamb, rice, cumin, orange juice and cayenne pepper into a ball with your hands and roll around in a 9 inch square tin. Put onto a foil lined baking dish and bake, uncovered, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, turning once. For a more crisp, less stringy texture, stir once or twice during cooking.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,dark soy sauce,vermouth,american cheese,green leaf lettuce
title: Homemade Vietnamese Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 pieces boneless white american cheese, 1cm thick | 4 thick green leaf lettuce, leaves | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth, vietnamese style | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Cut both cheeses into 4 equal cubes. Cut lettuce leaves in half or into 2 thin slivers. Wrap each piece of cheese with lettuce and vermouth. Coat a large non stick skillet with cooking spray and heat over high heat. Add cheese pieces. Cook, stirring once, until softened but not browned, 1 to 2 minutes. Turn cheese and cook until the cheese melts, 1 to 2 minutes. Serve on a plate and top with additional soy sauce, dark soy sauce and cornflour to serve, if desired. Note, vietnamese wine vietnamese sauce is made by heating 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce and 2 tablespoons dark brown sauce. Vietnamese dipping sauce, use 1/4 cup regular dry sherry or vermouth.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,cremini mushroom,yellow squash,cabbage,beef bouillon cube,basil leaf,avocado
title: Cabbage & Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 cup sliced cabbage | 1 medium yellow squash, sliced | 1/2 medium avocado | 4 3 cups cabbage, chopped and packed | 1 can cremini mushrooms, drained | 6 beef bouillon cubes | 1 stalk fresh basil leaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large soup pot.

title: Shrimp in Lemon and Apricot Stuffing
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp, large shelled | 2 large lemons, peel and coarsely grated ( about 2 lemons ) | 16 ounces italian bread, crust removed, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon ( i use better than bouillon magi ) | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel or 1 teaspoon dried lemon peel
instructions: Rinse the shrimp well. Place the shrimp in a large saute pan or dutch oven over high heat, and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium high for 10 - 12 minutes or until the shrimp are just just cooked. Reserving the cooking water, they can all be used right away. Remove the shrimp cover and simmer over medium high heat for another 1 - 2 minutes. Rinse out the pan to remove shrimp, then drain the shrimp well, reserving the cooking water. Strain all but 1 - 2 tablespoons of shrimp cooking liquid, then chop the shrimp. Add the shrimp, lemon peel and chicken bouillon. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink. Add 1/2 cup of reserved cooking water, cover and simmer for a final 30 - 45 minutes or until the shrimp are just cooked through. You may add more bouillon or water if you like to thin out the mixture. Remove from the heat and let stand for a few minutes then place it in a covered container and refrigerate until needed.

title: Creamy Eggnog
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon dark rum | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 1/4 ounces fresh lime juice
instructions: Combine cardamom and rum in a small bowl, set aside. Whip cream with an electric mixer on low speed until soft peaks form. Fold in the lime juice and remaining ingredients until combined. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Chili-Baked Manicotti
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour, divided | 2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 packages active dry yeast | 6 cloves | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 jar enchilada sauce, heated ( mild or medium ) | 1 lb manicotti
instructions: Sift half of the flour into a large bowl.

title: Chicken Wings in Cheese
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings | 200 g minced meat ( your choice ) | 1 egg-free stuffing mix ( pita ) | 5 slices quinces ( or other citrus of your choice )
instructions: Preheat oven 180°c. Spread the meat onto a greased baking paper. Spread out the stuffing mix. Lay the chicken skin side down on top, ensuring it is covered. Spoon the quince slices evenly over the quince and sprinkle with the grated cheese. Bake in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is browned. Serve with a salad and crusty french bread..

title: Cajun Deviled Eggs - Eggs
ingredients: 3 eggs | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Put the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring water to a boil, then remove from heat and let eggs stand in hot water for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove cold water, drain and cool. Peel eggs and chop. Place in a bowl with worcestershire sauce and mix well. Add worcestershire sauce and mix well. Mold mixture into 6 wedges. Serve with crackers.

title: Chinese Poached Green Beans
ingredients: 1 cup white hominy, rinsed | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from the green beans. Place the white hominy and the oyster sauce in a blender. Cover and blend on high for 30 seconds to get rid of the yellow flavor. Pour blended mixture into a pot and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Red Grapes
ingredients: 1 jar red grapes, drained well | 2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning | 4 ounces grated monterey jack cheese | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon horseradish
instructions: Slice up grapes and mix with greek seasoning mix. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Add horseradish on top. Place in microwave safe dish, cover with microwaveable paper, and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Serve as a sandwich on rolls.

title: Tomato Simmered Aioli
ingredients: 4 teaspoons pure pure mayonnaise | 6 ounces tomato puree ( approx 3 tbsp ) | 2 tablespoons caster sugar ( or superfine sugar )
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together, and chill for an hour for the flavors to combine well before serving.

Random Ingredients: fennel,vanilla,capicola,pepperoncini pepper,butter,tamarind paste,milk ricotta cheese,anise seed
title: Caperotti Con Queso
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh capicola, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons butter | 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup capers | 2 jars roasted peppery hot pickled peppersoncini peppers, drained, halved | 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed anise extract | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the ricotta cheese, hot capers, and roasted pepperoncini pepper sauce. Remove from heat. Stir in the anise extract, vanilla, and anise flavored extract. Transfer to a small baking dish, cover, and chill overnight to blend flavors. Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil. Fill a bowl with boiling water, and cover the bowl with a double layer of paper towels. Set the dish in the bowl, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Broil until the edges are lightly golden, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Miso Sauce
ingredients: 600 ml tomato juice | 400 g cornflour | 100 g white miso
instructions: Place the liquid in a saucepan and bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes. Heat the cornflour in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add the miso and cook for about a minute. Remove from heat then stir the hot liquid into the cornflour.

Random Ingredients: coffee,red pepper flake,black olive,cheese food,vegemite,potato starch,cashew,wheat flour
title: Coffee Potato Cheese Pastries
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups potatoes starch | 1 cup cracked wheat flour | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/2 cup vegetable powder ( ie vegemite ) | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup roughly chopped cashews | 2/3 cup chopped black olives | 1 cup shredded cheese food ( any flavor )
instructions: Mix potato starch, wheat flour, coffee powder, red pepper flakes, cashews, olives and cheese food until mixture resembles bread crumbs. Line 2 baking trays with parchment paper. Place the mixture evenly onto the baking sheets. Sprinkle with more cheese. Bake at 220°c for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from baking trays and enjoy.

title: Green Apple Curry Apples
ingredients: 5 green apples | 1 tablespoon green curry paste, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Wash, peel, and core apple apples, and cut them into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange apple slices in a baking dish with 1 teaspoon of curry paste, or to taste. Broil to your liking and watch carefully, just long enough to reduce the heat slightly. The curry will continue to cook during the final minutes. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Lori's Vietnamese Style Toothpicks
ingredients: 1 cup toothpicks | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 cup cold coriander, rinsed, dried and finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix oyster sauce and grated coriander. Apply mixture to one side of toothpicks. Heat a non stick frying pan over high heat.

title: Chili Glazed Almonds
ingredients: 20 large almonds | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 drop almond extract
instructions: Cut off the tops of 1/2 of the almonds and place in a non metal pan. Place almonds on a paper towel for a few minutes to dry out a little bit. Remove nuts from pan but watch them so as not to burn your skin. Rinse with cool water. Place almonds on a sheet of aluminium foil. Use a kitchen shears to carefully cut away the excess with a sharp knife. Mix together ginger and chili powder. Using a drop or two, pour spice mixture over each of the almonds. Place on a sheet tray. Wrap up foil and place on a cookie sheet. Place on the cookie sheet with the almonds. Place oven at 350 degrees farenheit and heat for 1 hour. Remove foil.

title: Ancho Chile Pesto
ingredients: 4 dried ancho chilies | 1 1/2 cups loosely packed, fresh-grated nutmeg
instructions: Remove and discard stems of anchoheim chilies.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,coriander seed,monterey jack cheese
title: Bacon Cheese & Pepper Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs deli-style bacon | 8 slices monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 lb shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Fry bacon, drain, reserve 2 t. Fry bacon grease in a skillet, remove, reserve 1 t. Fry bacon on both sides of the bacon. Remove. Reheat bacon grease, add pepper and coriander, cook 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and spread 1/4 slices of pepper cheese over bacon. Place 1 slice of pepper jack cheese on top of pepper jack cheese. Return to skillet with remaining bacon. Cook 1 - 2 min., stirring carefully until cheese is melted. Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream for an extra kick.

title: Spicy Kabob
ingredients: 1 medium summer squash, halved and seeded | 3 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oil on griddle or heavy skillet. Cut squash in half lengthwise. Place cut side down on pan with flesh side uppermost. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Drizzle with tabasco sauce. Cover and cook 3 minutes or until skins turn red, turning to cook all sides.

title: Homemade Singapore Sweet Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely-chopped english-style mustard | 3 tablespoons prepared nam pla ( vietnamese-style chili paste )
instructions: Stir mustard into mustard. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight to develop flavor. To use, stir in 2 teaspoons green chili paste. Note, to make a more pronounced pronounced chile flavor, use 2 tablespoons of chilli paste mixed with 2 tablespoons water.

title: Broccoli with Radish
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli, cut into florets | 8 radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: Place broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover, and steam until just tender, 2 to 3 minutes steamers should remain. While broccoli is steaming, place radishes in a shallow skillet. Fill pan with water to cover. Boil until radishes are tender and starting to brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain broccoli, and add to radishes.

title: Burritos
ingredients: 1/4 cup ghee | 1/4 cup taco sauce
instructions: Place a teaspoon of ghee in a saute pan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: wheat bran,sugar french vanilla pudding pie filling mix,pie shell,chicken bouillon granule
title: French Vanilla Baked Sweet Buns
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat bran | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup sugar free french vanilla instant pudding and pie filling mix | 1 unbaked pie shell
instructions: Cook bran in microwave oven for about 5 minutes. In large bowl, add sweetener, pudding mix & chicken stock powder.

title: Pork in Vinegar
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork roast | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 3 -5 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Place pork roast into a large non reactive dish. Pour broth and balsamic vinegar over the pork. Turn the roast over, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Remove the pork from the marinade and discard the marinade. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Remove it from the refrigerator. Slice the pork crosswise across the grain. Pour the vegetables into a roasting pan. Add the breaded pork and any accumulated juices. Add the hot pepper sauce to taste. Heat in the oven for approximately 1 hour or until internal temperature reaches 175 degrees. You must baste pork frequently during this baking period.

title: Tunisian Hot Rub
ingredients: 1/2 cup mustard seeds | 1/4 cup allspice | 1/4 cup rosemary
instructions: Grind the mustard seeds and allspice together with a mortar and pestle. Stir in the rosemary.

title: Corny Mango Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings, tips removed, wings cut into chunks | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup diced white sugar | 1 can whole mexicorn, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the yogurt, sugar, and mexicorn in a bowl.

title: Broiled Salmon With Cashew, Soybeans and Salted Cashews
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/2 pounds salmon, cut into 10 to 12 bite-size pieces | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 24 ounces soybeans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup roasted unsalted cashew pieces | 14 ounces fresh smoked salmon, cut into 10 slices | 4 ounces salted cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 bottle sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Oysters and Chips
ingredients: 1 lb potato ( peeled if desired ) | 1 cup dark beer ( cold ) | 1/4 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Place potato on baking sheet, prick with fork, bake at 375°f until just tender. Cool slightly and slice into thick rings. Place potato rings in ice water to soak. Mix beer and oyster sauce. Add to potato and toss evenly. Serve.

title: Pear and Anjou Pone (Aji Style Pear Pizza Strips)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons plain flour ( i use king arthur flour ) | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/8 cup chopped anjou pear ( in brine ) | 3 tablespoons picante sauce
instructions: Combine the flour, paprika and garam masala and place in a bag and shake to mix. Add the pear brine and press into a well in the middle. Leave in the fridge for about an hour to macerate. When ready to cook place a large plate over the top and flip and press quickly. Remove the pears but keep in a strainer and pour into the plate. You don't have to leave it all there is. Place the flat of your hand over top of the pizza and gently spread the pizza with a thin flexible movement. Cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until lightly brown. Take the plate out of the fridge and gently place it in a clean, dry skillet or flat baking dish. Slice and serve with your favourite toppings. Can be served warm, room temp or cold before topping.

title: Crispy Pancake and Okra
ingredients: 10 okra, cut in 1-inch size chunks | 1/2 small yellow onions or 1/2 small white onion, diced | 1/4 cup pizza sauce ( i use newman's own pizza sauce ) | 1/2 cup seasoned croutons
instructions: Spray non stick frying pan/pan with cooking spray. Heat to medium. Add okra and onion. Stir fry until okra is soft. Add pizza sauce and bread croutons. Mix well.

title: Anchovy Chips
ingredients: 6 whole anchovy fillets | 6 cups vegetable oil
instructions: Pour the oil into a deep fryer or large, heavy bottomed pan. Heat until hot to 400 degrees f. Place a baking sheet in the oven and place the anchovies on top. Bake until the anchovies turn a light brown and the oil is hot, about 5 minutes.

title: Easy Beef bouillon
ingredients: 1 can beef bouillon | 2 tablespoons green peppers, chopped | 2 celery, chopped
instructions: Saute celery and green pepper until tender. Drain liquid and set aside. Pour beef bouillon in a small saucepan on stovetop. Add the liquid. Simmer until liquid is reduced by about half, stirring occasionally. Stir in the chopped vegetables until heated through.

title: Penne With Cheese, Capsicum & Garlic
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb penne pasta | 1 1/2 cups grated aged english cheese | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon dried small whole salted roasted garlic
instructions: Cook the pasta per directions on the pack. In a small frying pan or a casserole, melt the cheese on a low heat. Stir in the salt, worcestershire and garlic. Toss the pasta well in the heated cheese mixture and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,vanilla essence,plain flour,apple juice,ra el hanout spice mix,dark rum,baking potato
title: Pommes De Terre Brisee (Apple Cake)
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes | 2 1/2 cups apples juice, chilled ( or fresh squeezed juice from 3 cups ) | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 package light ra el hanout spice mix | 1 cup plain flour | 2 large egg yolks | vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c. Butter and flour a 20 cm loose bottomed cake tin evenly. Wash the potatoes, peel them and cut them, if necessary, in half. Boil the potatoes in the apple juice until completely cooked but still slightly tender. Drain, rinse them again and leave to cool under cold running water and cut in half again. Then dice roughly and set aside. Heat the butter in a frying pan and cook the diced potatoes over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until light golden on the outside and crisp on the outside. Remove from the heat and mash with the dry spice mix. Transfer to the prepared pan. Make the caramel sauce by whisking the egg yolks in a bowl and then beating them in the hot apple juice. When the liquid is thick, add a pinch of vanilla essence and pour it all into the cake pan with the caramel sauce. Sprinkle over the diced potato pieces, then return the diced cake back into the pan. Turn the oven down to 180c. Bake for about 45 minutes or until the top is slightly puffed and cake tester comes out clean. Remove the cake from the oven and leave it for 5 minutes before turning out on a wire rack. Serve with warm cream or ice cream.

title: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups frozen stir fry vegetables | 1 can broth
instructions: Cook vegetables according to package directions on package. When vegetables are tender, drain the vegetables and return them to the pan. Stir in the broth and heat until heated through.

title: Mexican Style Party Melt
ingredients: 7 ounces cheddar cheese | 7 ounces taco sauce | 3 sage leaves ( or dried herbs, to taste, or make your own, use fresh herbs that need to be rubbed ) | 10 ounces champagne ( don't use a non-alcoholic beverage like ciney or black-eyed peas )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together all the ingredients. Put a few tablespoons on each american glass, then top with the cheddar cheese. Garnish with sprigs of rosemary and/or thyme or sprigs of oregano or other desired garnish.

title: The Best Broth
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded diced, divided | 1 cup canned rotel | 2 cans broth | 9 pitted dates
instructions: Dice one red bell pepper. In saucepan cook 1/2 red pepper, rotel and broth in 1 qt. Pot over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until the chicken and vegetables are tender. Stir in dates. Cook, stirring often, until dates are heated.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,arbol chile,romaine lettuce leaf,red pepper flake,capsicum,arborio rice,italian seasoning
title: Low-Fat Arroz Con Chiles - Red Rice With Sticky Capsicum and Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 small red pepper, deseeded and finely sliced ( capsicum ) | 1 medium roma lettuce leaf | 2 tablespoons arborio rice | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons of crushed dried arbol chiles | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 80 g roasted red peppers, coarsely chopped | 1 g roasted capsicum, coarsely chopped
instructions: Roast dried chiles under the grill, or under the broiler, and place on a baking tray. Leave to cool. Wash lettuce leaves in a colander, and cut each leaf lengthways into 2 1/2 3inch lengths, keeping separate leaves. Drain and set aside. Rinse rice lightly under tap water and drain, then dry on clean kitchen paper towel. Combine yogurt, chiles, and seasoning together, then chill. Place chiles and rice together in a bowl, adding the red pepper, cheese, and reserved lettuce. Toss until well combined, adding more chile or seasoning, if necessary, and serve immediately.

title: Quick Fix Barbecued Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped bacon | 1 1/2 cups shredded carrots | 1 can sweet bell peppers ( green or red cut in half ) | 1 cup sweet green bell pepper ( cut in squares ) | 24 ladyfingers ( regular size )
instructions: Preheat oil in fry pan or a medium nonstick skillet. Spray bag with cooking spray and add onions, carrots and bell peppers. Cook slowly till carrots are crisp tender. Remove from pan. Prepare barbeque by mixing bacon and peppers in with veggies. Spread the barbeque mixture into a 9x13 inch casserole dish just to cover the top. Add your ladyfingers. Top with remaining bacon mixture. Wrap tightly with foil. Bake in 350 oven 10 - 25 minutes till the tops are crisp and browned.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,red potato,veal stock chicken,tomato green chilies,oil rice bran
title: Veal Chili and Tomato Risotto
ingredients: 2 ounces oil or 2 ounces rice bran | 3 1/4 lbs firm red potatoes, very coarsely chopped | 5 ounces canned tomatoes with green chilies, chopped | 1/3 cup finely chopped tarragon or 1/3 cup parsley | veal stock or chicken stock
instructions: Boil the potatoes for 10 - 12 minutes, or until just beginning to soften, drain and allow to cool. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 3 minutes, or until softened. Add the tarragon and stir. Return all the ingredients except the stock, to the pan, season and simmer gently for about 5 minutes, or until the potato flavour is thoroughly combined. Mash or blend and remove from heat. Pour into soup bowls and serve.

title: Mock Cottage Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 container cottage cheese, at room temperature | 1/2 teaspoon grated lime zest
instructions: Combine the cottage cheese, lime zest, and lime juice in a bowl, and mash with a fork until mixture is smooth. Serve as a topping for fish, chicken, or shrimp.

title: Puff Pastry Coconut Free-Cookers
ingredients: 1 puff pastry sheet | 1 cup desiccated unsweetened coconut oil | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | 2 cups mixed fruit preserves, any flavour | 1/2 cup prepared teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup soft breadcrumbs
instructions: Roll or stretch pastry between 2 sheets of lightly floured waxed paper to 3/4 in thickness. Transfer to lightly floured pan. Brush top with coconut oil. Place 1 teaspoon coconut mixture in centre of pastry. Using a fork, spread preserves evenly over pastry. Spoon more mixture down centre of pastry. Fold pastry over. Using the edge of a rolling pin, press edges together with thumb to seal. Repeat with remaining pastry and filling. To freeze, place mixture in plastic food bag. Freeze until ready to use. Preheat oven to 400°f. Place tray in freezer for 15 - 20 minutes. Meanwhile, while pastry is frozen, prepare fruit and topping.

title: Nasi Goreng
ingredients: 500 g plain flour | 300 g rice ( preferably jasmine ) | 200 g mixed vegetables ( such as choy, snow peas, peas or courgettes )
instructions: Sift the flour with salt into a mixing bowl. Make a depression in the middle and pour in the water. Stir the flour into the water until the surface of the water is clear, about 3 - 4 minutes. You can also use your fingers. If the mixture is firm, refrigerate the dough while you continue to work with it. Preheat oven to 220c/450f/gas mark cut the dough into pieces about 5in x 4 - 8 in. Thick and 10in, and use the palms of your hands to roll the pieces into thin long, thickish discs about 10 inches long and 3 4in across. If your hands are getting dirty, mix a little water with your fingers to make a glue shape. Spray the inside of a baking tray with oil and line it with parchment paper, allowing a 4 5in overhang on each side. Put the paper overhang on top of the tray. Place the tray in the freezer overnight. You can cut into squares or squares as required.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,italian dressing,turmeric powder,sauerkraut,sumac powder,currant,canola oil
title: Baked Sauerkraut With Sumac, Red Pepper and Feta
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 large sauerkraut | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, shredded | 1 1 tablespoon italian dressing | 1 pinch saffron powder, to taste | 1 tablespoon currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Combine oil, sauerkraut, turmeric, lemon peel, dressing, and saffron powder in a bowl. Transfer sauerkraut mixture to the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with currants. Bake at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,chili powder,red wine,green cardamom pod
title: Ethiopian Burger Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs lean hamburger buns | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 -2 green cardamom pod, crushed | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix thoroughly. Heat a non stick griddle or frypan. Brush griddle with a little butter or oil and fry mixture until cooked. Serve on buns.

title: Dutch Hamburgers (Bratwurst)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh bratwursts, cut into 1 1/2- to 2-inch chunks | 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 large lemon, zest of, shredded finely | 1/4 cup ketchup | 6 juniper berries, crushed | 1/2 cup beef broth | ground cinnamon
instructions: Place all ingredients in a non reactive heavy duty freezer bag, seal and transfer to a shallow baking dish, freezer for several hours. Before using remove bag and scrape any bread crumbs or fat from the bag. Remove meat, discarding any chunks of fat and place in a slow cooker. Cover or put lid on cooker and let sit for 5 - 7 hours on low, or 4 - 5 hours on high. After 5 hours remove lid, turn meat on to high, stir up the liquid and serve with cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: white bread,beef brisket,bacon,soymilk,chickpea,heavy whipping cream,green cardamom pod
title: Frikadeller
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried beef brisket | 4 green cardamom pods ( discard pods ) | 1/2 slice dry bread | 3 slices bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil. Trim brisket of any visible fat and add it to the boiling water. Cook brisket for 20 minutes. Transfer brisket to a platter and drain. Place in a roasting pan and cut a slit in the side of each grain of brisket. Place brisket into a shallow pan. Fill pan with water to cover and add cardamom pods. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 15 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup broth. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat until hot. Add bacon and fry for 5 minutes, or until crisp. Drain fat from pan. Pour in the soymilk and simmer for 5 minutes. Add a few tablespoons of the beef broth and continue simmering until liquid has evaporated. Add the chickpeas and then the cream and simmer for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spice,sauerkraut,savory,sunflower seed oil,fruit,caster sugar,chili paste,provolone cheese
title: Homemade Savoury Sauerkraut Balls
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 3/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1/4 teaspoon dried sweet marjoram or 1/4 teaspoon savory | 1 teaspoon sunflower seed oil | 5 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 cups sauerkraut, drained, rinsed and finely chopped | 3 ounces provolone cheese, cut into small cubes | 1 large pinch dried mixed fruit
instructions: Mix the spices together and put aside. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and fry the sugar until it smells caramelised. Tip it into the oil, add the sauerkraut and cook over a moderate heat for about 10 minutes, or until the sauerkraut has softened.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken | 1 can hickory smoke salt | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon meat or 1/2 teaspoon vegetables, for frying
instructions: If using a chicken that's cut in small pieces and not too thin, just thickens the oil a little. Then rinse the chicken well. Preheat your oven to 400 f. Rinse the chicken with your hands until all of the skin is removed. Place the chicken in a roasting pan or dutch oven dish. Season it with your favourite oil, salt, and pepper. Add half of the butter, the corn oil, and the meat or vegetables. Spread or roll the chicken in the oil mixture to cover well. Cook covered in the oven for 40 minutes, flipping the bird halfway through.

title: Simple Beef With Turkey Sausages
ingredients: 4 beef shanks | 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 1/2 packages beef sausages
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450 degrees. In a 13x9 square baking dish, arrange the sausages and the chicken breast in a single layer. Top with the sausages and then put the sausages directly on top of them. In a 450 degree oven place the baking dish on middle rack and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Cheese for Kielbasa
ingredients: 4 lbs kielbasa, sliced into 1/2-inch slices ( i use hillshire farm ) | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 475ºf. Pile kielbasa on a large baking sheet. In a small bowl, combine five spice powder and 1/2 cup water. Spread pepper mixture over both sides of kielbasa slices. Cover and bake for 5 minutes, or until kielbasa is tender and begins to brown. Remove from oven, increase temperature to 450ºf, and bake covered for an additional 10 minutes to brown lightly. Sprinkle 1/4 of the cheese over top and cover with the kielbasa. Return to oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and serve.

title: Cayenne - Cabernet Sauvignon Refrigerator
ingredients: 1 bottle cabernet sauvignon wine ( sauvignon blanc ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Combine cabernet sauvignon, cumin, and cayenne in a sealable container with a lid. Seal and let stand at room temperature for 6 to 8 hours, or until the mixture foams. Transfer the mixture to a saucer, and refrigerate for up to two weeks.

title: Rosemary and Kielbasa Chicken
ingredients: 250 g kielbasa, cut into 2 cm rounds | 4 tablespoons rosemary, leaves picked | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 600 g chicken thighs ( chicken pieces )
instructions: Preheat oven to 165°c. In a large roasting tin, scatter half the kielbasa and half the rosemary on top. Sprinkle with sugar, then add the chicken and turn to coat. Turn the chicken every so often so as not to burn the sugar or cook the kielbasa and sprigs of rosemary throughout. Pour over all and cook for 2 hours. Serve with crusty bread and a tossed salad.

title: Parmesan Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 cups sesame seeds, toasted | 3/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Spread the sesame seeds on wax paper with the back of a spoon and let stand until cool to the touch about 10 minutes. Dry and grind in a food processor in batches until coarsely ground. Stir in the grated cheese and season with more paprika if desired.

title: Mustard & Scallion Jam With Bacon
ingredients: 2 lbs thick slice bacon | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 6 finely sliced scallions
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300f / 190c. Heat a non stick frying pan over a medium heat in a big pinch. Cook the bacon, stirring frequently, until the bacon is nearly crisp. Add the mustard and sugar and continue cooking for 2 - 3 minutes more. Add the scallions and continue to cook, stirring frequently for 2 - 3 mins, or until the onions are softened. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and stir in 1 tbsp warm water to form a paste. Press the paste into the base of a 5cm / 3in / 1in / 10in / 6in / 4in lamington mould, or line with aluminium foil. Place the mould in the hot oven and cook for approx 40 mins or until the jam melts. Leave to set before turning out onto a warm plate.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,beef chuck,stew meat,spinach,rye bread,grape tomato,puff pastry
title: Beef & Spinach Tartlets
ingredients: 1 box frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 lb lean stew meat | 1/2 cup grapes tomatoes, sliced thinly | 1 bunch fresh spinach, chopped | 4 tablespoons hazelnuts, chopped ( or walnuts ) | 1 lb lean stew meat | 1 loaf rye bread, crust removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place puff pastry on a greased baking sheet and bake for 40 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown. Remove pastry from oven and set aside. Heat a 10 inch saute pan over medium high heat and add beef. Cook, stirring frequently, until browned on all sides. Place meat, tomatoes, spinach and hazelnuts in a large mixing bowl. Add stew meat, season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: papaya,ice water,red wine vinegar,honeydew melon,milk chocolate,green cardamom pod,tomato puree
title: Melon Balls With Red Wine Reduction
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe papayas, cut in 2-inch cubes ( about 1-1/2 c ) | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup honeydew melon, cut in 8 pieces | 2 large tomatoes, cut in eighths | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 1/2 cups fresh tomato puree or 1 1/2 cups canned plum tomatoes, pureed | 3 tablespoons honeydew melon puree | 1 1/2 cups ice water | 1 lb milk chocolate, squares, broken into pieces
instructions: Simmer papayas, 2/3 cup vinegar, and honeydew melon cubes in a covered saucepan over medium heat until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. Cool slightly. Process tomato puree in a food processor. Transfer to a bowl and combine with tomato puree, 3/4 cup tomato puree, and 1 1/4 cup water. Whisk in 2 tbsp honeydew melon puree, 1 tbsp puree dissolved in 3 tbsp water, and refrigerate for 2 hours or until fruit is very soft. Add remaining 3/4 cup of tomato puree and 1 1/2 tbsp puree dissolved in 1 1/2 tbsp water and refrigerate until mixture is cold, about 2 hours. Working in batches, transfer papaya mixture to ice cream scoop trays and freeze in an ice cream cone shape, at least 8 hours.

title: Herby Pizza Pastries
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 red bell pepper, sliced ( or roasted pepper, or whatever roasted pepper you have on hand ) | fresh herb ( optional for garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Put oven rack in center of oven. Take the puff pastry sheets and cut each sheet into 8 slices. Brush each with oil and arrange on a baking sheet so that it doesn't stick together. Place in the oven for 10 minutes, then flip and bake for a further five minutes to brown both sides. Remove from oven, sprinkle with salt, if desired. If desired, garnish with fresh herbs of your choice.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,corn tortilla,macaroni,olive oil,chuck,seasoning salt,serrano chilies,tortilla
title: Beef and Macaroni Enchiladas - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs ground chuck | 1 box pasta sauce | 1 can of chopped green chilies | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt ( i used paul prudhomme's ) | 1 teaspoon fresh serrano chilies ( optional ) | 1 package corn tortillas | 1 bag macaroni | olive oil ( for frying )
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the beef. Add the spaghetti sauce, green chilies, seasoned salt and serrano chilies. Stir and remove from stove. In a small sauce pot, bring water to a boil. Meanwhile, rinse corn tortillas. Using a slotted spoon, place about 1 heaping tablespoon of beef mixture in the middle of the corn tortilla.

title: Quinoa Stuffed Plantains
ingredients: 1 box quinoa | 1 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup raw green plantain, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Fill a large bowl with enough hot water to cover quinoa. Add quinoa, and toss to coat. Place plantains in the bowl with the quinoa. Sprinkle cheese over the center of the plantain pieces in a similar way. Scoop a little of the quinoa mixture into the bowl with the plantains. Scoop about 1/4 cup of the quinoa mixture into the center of the plantain pieces. Roll to make an empty roll.

title: Coconut Milk in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 3 lbs beef eye round | 3 cups coconut milk | 1/2 cup finely grated orange peel
instructions: Score the surface of the meat and rub into the oat flour. Place it in the pressure cooker. Pour the coconut milk and orange peel over the meat. Close the cooker, lock on the tight lock, and cook for 90 minutes on high pressure. Set cooker to low pressure according to manufacturer's directions. Allow pressure to release naturally.

title: Mexican-Style Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa, cut in half | 3 fresh tomatillos, husks removed | 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 cups frozen green peas | 2 teaspoons ground coriander
instructions: Place kielbasa halves in a skillet, over high heat. Cook and stir 2 to 4 minutes, or until browned. Add tomatillos and canola oil. Cook 5 minutes, or until heated through. Sprinkle with coriander and serve.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,black olive,golden syrup,red chili powder,green chilies
title: Quick French Onion Soup
ingredients: 500 g french onion soup | 2 green chilies | 20 pitted black olives | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon french onion soup | 5 g red chili powder
instructions: Boil french onion soup with green chilies, black olives, syrup, and french onion soup. Cook 10 mins. Remove from heat. Add red chilli powder and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brie cheese,baby bok choy,red bell pepper,panko breadcrumb,parsley,plum tomato
title: Baby Bok Choy and Brie Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 -5 large baby bok choy ( about 12oz. ) | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 cup baby bok choy, with stem, halved lengthwise | 1 medium red bell pepper | 1 medium plum tomato, halved lengthwise | 100 g brie cheese, cut into 4'sticks | chopped fresh parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: To prepare, cut each tomato in half and cut each round in half crosswise, leaving the others uncovered. Trim as many outer leaves as possible from bok choy and discard about ¼ inch of the green tops and any wilted outer leaves. Cut a slit lengthwise down center of bok choy stalk to release the leaves and discard remaining leaves. Reserve the bok choy leaves for garnish. Cut remaining leaves from stem of bok choy and discard the remainder of the green leaves but retain the remaining leaves to use for garnish. Place breadcrumbs in a shallow bowl and mix in the panko crumbs until evenly coated. Place 2 tablespoons of the panko crumb mixture onto each tomato. Spread bok choy leaves out into a large casserole sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle with tomato halves and capsicum halves. Top each with 2 pieces of brie and sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Preheat oven to 180c and bake the bok choy stems, tomato halves and capsicum until the bok choy tops and tomatoes are just beginning to ‘melise' slightly in the oven, 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until crisp tender.. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,pasta,ketchup,whipping cream,bacon dripping,turmeric,fillet catfish
title: Catfish Yum
ingredients: 1 1/2 gallons whipping cream | 2 ounces lean bacon drippings | 6 fillets catfish | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place cream in a large ovenproof dish and heat. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook bacon over medium high heat until fat is rendered. Remove from heat and stir in the ketchup, turmeric and wine. Spread mixture evenly over the catfish fillets. Bake covered in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Place parsley on top and bake 10 minutes longer or until fish is cooked through. Serve sprinkled with croutons.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,coriander powder,garam masala,wide egg noodle,roast
title: Noodles with Sizzling Beef and Garam Masala
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 lb thinly sliced roast | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. While noodles are cooking, toss roast with coriander powder.

title: Mexican Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hamburger | 1 package bow tie pasta, cooked & drained ( rotelle is the best ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 3 dried chipotle chiles, minced | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain fat. Saute dried chile and cinnamon. Add cooked noodles and spices. Stir well. Serve with cheese, sour cream, grated cheese is optional.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,onion powder,chicken breast half,asiago cheese
title: Asiago Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion powder | 1/4 cup finely chopped chipotle pepper | 1/2 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Place the chicken breasts into a shallow dish. Sprinkle with onion powder and chipotle pepper. Sprinkle with asiago cheese. Marinate at least 1 hour or until the chicken is cooked. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Preheat the grill for high heat. Grill the chicken, skin side down, until the meat is no longer pink, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,red capsicum,white fish fillet,lemon lime beverage,flat leaf parsley,barbecue sauce
title: BBQ Fish With Red Capsicum (Aussie Fish)
ingredients: 1 whole red capsicum, cut into strips | 1 tablespoon bottled lemon lime soda ( not the cheap stuff ) | 2 tablespoons premium barbecue sauce | 5 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 4 white fish fillets ( can use fillets such as cod, halibut, snapper or orange roughy ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the fish in a baking dish. Place capsicum strips on top of the capsicum, and pour over the bbq sauce. Divid the fillets evenly amongst the fish. Cover with plastic wrap and put into the fridge for an hour to marinate. Preheat the barbecue high. When just cooking, remove the fish from the marinade and dry with kitchen paper. Place a piece of foil in the hot bbq, and bake for 2 - 3 minutes, until golden. Remove foil, then scatter parsley over fish and serve with dipping sauces and steamed green beans or potatoes.

title: Black Olive Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces pitted black olives, chopped | 4 ounces pitted kalamata olives, chopped | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl. Serve with roasted vegetables.

title: Limes and Corn
ingredients: 2 large limes, juiced | 2 cans chicken broth
instructions: Stir the lime juice and chicken broth together in a large saucepan over medium low heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, and cook for 45 minutes, occasionally stirring. Pour in more chicken broth if you see it drying out.

title: Chinese Style Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 ounce dried shiitake mushrooms | 3 -4 teaspoons margarine or 3 -4 teaspoons butter | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth ( or beef broth ) | 1 -2 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grenadine sauce or 1 tablespoon hot sauce
instructions: Note, if using dried shiitake mushrooms place in a bowl with water to cover for at least 30 minutes. Drain well and slice away and discard all dried or woody stems. If using fresh mushrooms, place in saucepan and add 4 cups water. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Add margarine or butter, mushrooms or whatever you choose and cook for 3 minutes per side. Mix hot sauce into cream or other sauce. Spoon over cooked mushrooms and serve immediately over rice or noodles.

title: Spicy Lime Curried Chick-Peas
ingredients: 2 cans chick-peas ( reserve liquid ) | 3 -4 tablespoons guacamole | 1 -2 teaspoon red curry paste
instructions: Note for those who would like to spice up their own, substitute 1 - 2 tablespoons of all purpose cooking oil, 2 - 2 tablespoons of your favorite curry paste or 1 1/2 teaspoons of all purpose cooking oil. You can use 1/4 cup of hot or cold water and 1/2 teaspoons of red curry paste or to taste. Note for those who like a little spice, substitute a tablespoon of sweet pickle juice.

title: Easy-Meatballs (Low Fat or Not)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1 cup pitted dates, chopped | 1 cup low-fat half-and-half | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into 1 balls. Place between your palms. Roll in chopped nuts. Cook on high for 3 minutes per side. Let stand until set.

title: Chile-Covered Pork Tenderloin Filled French Bread Loaf
ingredients: 1 boneless pork tenderloin | 2 large eggs, beaten | 2 cans chopped green chilies, drained | 20 croissants, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut a pocket into each tenderloin.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,fast rising yeast,cornstarch,cherry tomato,red kidney bean,herbes de provence
title: Cherry Tomato and Herb Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces fast-rising yeast | 3/4 cup red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Prepare bread, spray a 9x9 inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Pour into loaf pan and let rise until doubled in size, about 40 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place tomatoes in a medium bowl. Stir in provence, 1 teaspoon of herbes de provence, and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch. Pour remaining 1 cup warm water over tomatoes. Add remaining 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon of herbes de provence. Toss gently to coat. Place tomatoes, cut side up, on prepared pan, and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven until tomatoes are tender and edges are golden and hollow sounding, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven and cool to room temperature. Remove pan from oven and let cool slightly. Remove crusts, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,veal,poblano chile,cooking oat,horseradish,curry paste,sun tomato
title: Roasted Sweet Chiles (Somali Ke Kål)
ingredients: 1 lb veal, sliced thin in strips | 3 fresh poblano chiles ( chopped in 1/4-inch slices ) | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes ( rehydrated ) | sour cream or honey
instructions: In a large bowl combine all of the ingredients and mix well. Place in a small crock pot and cook in the oven on low heat for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Turn occasionally to brown evenly.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,pastry,white vinegar,pasta sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spaghetti sauce
title: Italian Pastry Tacos - Quick and Easy #RSC
ingredients: 2 pastry sheets or 2 crusty italian-seasoned pie crusts | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup prepared pasta sauce ( ragu old world style sauce risotto, ragu old world style tomato based on herbs ) | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( approximation # 1/3 amount ) | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning ( i use mccormick's taco seasoning taco seasoning ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 0.5 jar pasta sauce ( ragu old world style sauce )
instructions: To prepare pastry, unfold pastry on the counter and set aside. You may need to work with your pastry from time to time. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Lightly spray pastry sheet with cooking spray and using a pastry brush, coat the dough on the sheet with spray. You'll also need to add more flour so it will stick. Bake pastry in middle of oven until golden brown, 12 to 14 minutes. Cool 5 minutes before handling.

title: Gran's Crunchy Shortbread
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup orange bell pepper, finely diced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon lemon rind, grated | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Line bottom of a cookie sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, add all ingredients, and mix well with fork. If mixture is too soft, add half of the cake flour to bind. Turn out onto a floured surface, and mix with your hands until it comes together in a ball. Pat into a 9 inch circle. Traditionally, this recipe uses a cookie cutter to press the edge of the dough. If you don't have a cookie cutter, a knife or pastry brush work the work surface. If your hand works well, it should stick all around the cookie. Place on the cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Flour your fingers, and press down on the dough evenly to make sure it's smooth and all the way flattened. Bake at 350f for 10 minutes, then remove from oven and let cool for 20 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,lamb,lettuce leaf,black tea,cream,sun tomato,garlic powder
title: Grilled Lamb Tostadas(Paleo)
ingredients: 8 lamb, tenderloin ( i have used lamb breasts from the deli department to make certain they aren`t too thick ( about 1 1/2 lb. ) | 4 -5 cups torn fresh lettuce leaves ( about 8 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( or to taste ) | 4 large sun-dried tomatoes ( soaked in water for 15 minutes, drained and chopped ) | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup black tea ( warmed ) | 1 tablespoon minced pickled jalapeno pepper
instructions: Cut lamb into 6 equal pieces. Pound into 5 inch strips and put into a ziploc bag, add the lettuce, garlic and tomatoes. Toss lightly to mix. Make 4 or 5 small slits in the lamb loin to allow for absorption of juices. Marinate in refrigerator, covered, for 8 hours. To serve, heat barbecue grill and grill the lamb slices 2 to 3 minutes per side. To serve, spoon a few pieces on a warm serving platter. Spoon a little warm tea over each portion. Sprinkle with jalapeno.

title: Kiwi Sev
ingredients: 1/8 cup teriyaki sauce | 8 slices kiwi | 8 drops salsa | four small cubes frozen sev
instructions: Mix teriyaki, kiwi and salsa together. Bake covered 30 - 45 minutes at 450 degrees fahrenheit.

title: Tamarind Rum Roll
ingredients: 1/2 pint black tamarind pulp | 2 cups dark rum | 6 -8 tortillas | sugar
instructions: First, make the rum.

title: Jalapeno Cheese
ingredients: 1 pastry for double-crust pie ( or 2 crust pie crusts ) | 1 tablespoon skim milk | 1 tablespoon grated extra sharp cheddar cheese | 1/8 teaspoon minced canned jalapeno pepper
instructions: Cut a circle out of the dough. In a small bowl, combine milk, cheddar cheese, and minced jalapenos. Remove half of the dough from the pouch of dough, and roll into a circle, using the dough to cover as much of the dough as possible. Place the rolled circle on a greased cookie sheet, and brush the top with milk and jalapeno mixture. Bake at 425°f for about 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Swiss Rhubarb Pudding Dip
ingredients: 250 g rhubarb, cut into 1 cm pieces | 250 g pineapple preserves | 225 g plain yogurt or 225 g cream cheese | 1 cup pumpkin seeds | rose petal
instructions: Place whole rhubarb stalks into a large pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes until soft. Using a knife cut through rhubarb stalks and then cut into small slices. Place into blender and blend until smooth. Add the rest of the ingredients and blend until well blended. Pour into individual baking containers and refrigerate for at least 2 hours until firm.

title: Strawberry-Chipotle Semolina Pastries
ingredients: 3/4 cup fine semolina | 1 can vegetable broth ( or chicken broth ) | 1 canned chipotle chile in adobo, seeded, minced ( or 1/3 cup chopped canned chipotle chiles ) | 1 cup raisins | 1 -2 whole strawberry, hulled, sliced, for garnish
instructions: Put semolina and broth in blender jar and puree for 30 seconds or so until it becomes smooth, then stir in chipotle and raisins. Put mixture in small bowl and chill for 1 hour or longer if in hurry, refilling or freeze for later. When ready to serve sprinkle with strawberries and enjoy.

title: Walnut Sauce (Hungarian Rote Grüntner)
ingredients: 6 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup walnuts, ground | 5 tablespoons tomato paste, heated
instructions: Place egg yolks in a large bowl and beat with a wooden spoon until light and creamy.

title: Basic Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon peanut oil ( or other vegetable oil )
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in a small amount of warm water, about 4 - 5 teaspoons. Wait 10 minutes, then stir with a fork and let it rise. Dissolve the orange zest in 1 tspn warm water, then stir into the dry ingredients. Put dough on lightly floured surface, and knead in enough of the remaining warm water so it's soft and elastic, but not sticky. Lightly oil a large bowl, or if you do your own rising, put dough in lightly oiled bowl, turn dough over to oil top, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise to double. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Bake the crust on a pizza stone or baking sheet 20 minutes, then remove plastic and bake another 5 - 7 minutes. The top should look dry and slightly crispy. I usually bake it at 450°f for 5 - 7 minutes, or until the crust turns a nice golden brown. Let cool on rack before slicing.

title: Japanese Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 lb stale bread, sliced into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 lb water chestnut, chopped | 2 cloves | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 tablespoons liquid honey
instructions: Grind bread cubes, water chestnuts, clove, sugar, sherry and honey. Add to bread mixture.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,tomato ketchup,rice wine vinegar,chorizo sausage,bay leaf,fine breadcrumb,pineapple juice
title: Chorizo, Pineapple & Pineapple Rissoles
ingredients: 6 chorizo sausages | 2 cans crushed pineapple in juice, undrained | 1 1/2 cups fine fresh breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup
instructions: Using a very sharp knife, cut a pocket into each sausage then slice into halves or triangles. Place chorizo in a frying pan with pineapple, juice, breadcrumbs, pineapple juice, and vinegars. Add the bay leaf & vanilla. Simmer until the pineapple is soft, stirring occasionally, then remove from heat & set aside. Heat a little extra oil or butter in a frying pan, and serve the rissoles with the pineapple sauce for dipping. They should not become soggy or crumbly.

title: Apple & Garlic White Bean Pies
ingredients: 250 g apple juice | 350 g white beans ( white kidney beans, cannellini beans ) | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs ( basil leaves, tarragon etc ) | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon walnuts ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon cashews, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a frying pan, bring the apple juice and the beans to boiling point. Reduce the heat and simmer until the beans are tender and the liquid has reduced by half. Remove from heat. Place in a food processor or blender and blend until it is finely chopped. Stir through the herbs, spices, rum or nuts and add the white beans. Grease a 12 hole muffin pan and heat the mixture until hot. Divide among the muffin holes and bake in a moderate oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm or cool.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,rigatoni pasta,italian seasoning,co lettuce,mango chutney,topping,prosciutto,mustard green
title: The Mango Chutney Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 3 pounds whipped topping, divided | 1 bunch mustard greens | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 2 cups shredded provolone cheese blend, divided | 1 cup chopped and frozen cooked firm tofu, drained | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,snow pea,orange peel,black olive,flour,cherry tomato,pork roast,pie crust
title: Pork Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 - 3/4 lb pork roast, very thinly sliced cooked and cut into strips | 1/2 cup cooked black olives, drained and lightly patted dry with paper towel | 2 tablespoons orange peel, very thinly sliced | 8 snow pea pieces, trimmed | 8 candied cherry tomatoes | 8 thin slices fresh lettuce leaves
instructions: Mix the cornstarch and 1/4 cup of water in a glass or ceramic bowl and stir until the cornstarch mixture is smooth. Add the flour and ginger to the pork and stir until the meat is coated with the cornstarch. Add the sliced oranges, olives, snow peas, candied cherries, lettuce leaves, and remaining 2 t. Of water. Stir gently until all the ingredients make a sticky pliable paste. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate for up to 1 day. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Unwrap the meat mixture, and place on parchment paper. Spread it with some of the zest from the orange and cut lengthwise in half. Place 1/2 cup of the stuffing mixture on each half and roll up tightly. Seal the bottom halves with toothpicks inserted in the center. Bake the rolls until golden, about 25 minutes.

title: Roasted Chiles on Lettuce Leaves
ingredients: 2 fresh poblano chiles | 12 -25 fresh romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat the broiler or grill. Place the poblano peppers on a foil lined broiler pan, skin side down and roast for about 1/2 hour, or until very soft and black. Remove and set aside to cool. Peel the chilies, and coarsely chop them. Place them in a food processor or blender, and process until you have about 8 pulses. Toss with the chilies, lettuce, and 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons salt. Serve to your taste.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,chicken,tortilla,hot red pepper flake,tea,red chili pepper,cremini mushroom
title: Chinese Chicken & Tea Burritos
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken, cut in strips | 1/2 cup fresh cremini mushroom, sliced | 1/2 cup brewed tea | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/8 teaspoon fresh red chili pepper flakes | 3 burritos | 1/2 cup hot red peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Place chicken in a nonstick or oiled skillet and cook over medium heat about 5 - 7 minutes, stirring frequently, until browned and juices run clear. Add mushrooms, stir fry 1 minute, then pour in tea, golden syrup, chile flakes and chilli.

title: Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked spaghetti or 2 lbs spaghetti, uncooked | 5 cups watercress | 1 head red chili pepper, roasted and minced ( or other hot pepper, if you like ) | 1 cup dried crushed nuts | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 teaspoon marjoram or 1 teaspoon marjoram leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente, rinse, and drain. Toss with the watercress, chillies, roasted nuts and peanut butter. Stir remaining ingredients and add to spaghetti mixture mix well. Chill at least 1 hour before serving or serve cold.

title: Mexican Yams
ingredients: 1 lb yam | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Peel and chop yam into chunks. Saute in oil in large saucepan for about 5 minutes, or until tender. Add sugar and raisins and tomato juice and cook for about 5 minutes. Add salt.

title: Italian Sausages and Fritters
ingredients: 2 teaspoons potato flakes | 2 teaspoons walnut oil | 1 lb sweet italian sausage
instructions: Heat nonstick frypan, add oil and sausage. Turn when brown. Drain on paper towel. Let cool. Slice into 8 slices. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,fennel seed,beef bouillon cube,egg substitute,stewing beef,tart apple
title: Sting-Oven French Canadian Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef, cubed | 1 egg substitute, beaten | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, crushed | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 large tart apple, peeled, cored, sliced thin | 1/4 teaspoon ground fennel seed
instructions: Combine beef, egg substitute, vinegar, fennel and bouillon cubes. Combine apple, 1 1/4 cup water and 1/4 teaspoon of sesame seeds. Place on bottom rack of broiler pan. Place apple layer over beef. Pour 1/2 cup water mixture over apples. Place 1/2 teaspoon of sesame seeds on top. Bake at 450° f for 50 minutes, uncovered.

title: Easy Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 package sliced pepperoni | 2 packages frozen cooked shrimp | 1 can or bottle cranberry juice
instructions: Cut the rind off of the pepperoni. Place into a medium size glass jar with the shrimp. Pour a generous handful of cranberry juice around the shrimp. Close tightly and refrigerate for at least one week, but not more than a week. Shake the jar often and allow all ingredients to get throughly coated. This is even better the next day.

title: Black & Tan Buffalo
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon corn oil | 3/4 cup light beer | 1/4 cup triple sec liqueur, like domaine anejo | 1/8 teaspoon cocoa | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Combine all ingredients, in a bowl and whisk to blend. Store in a glass container with a cover.

title: Ajiaco (Chipotle and Pepper Adobo Rub)
ingredients: 6 whole chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped | 6 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a food processor fitted with the metal blade, process chiles until coarsely ground, about 20 seconds. Transfer to a large plate. Finely grind the chiles in the food processor with the thyme until the mixture forms a coarse paste, about 5 pulses. Mix in adobo seasoning. Using the sharpest knife on your processor, chop the adobo until no coarse particles remain. Add to the oiled baking sheet and spread, about 1/2 inch thick, as evenly as possible. Cover with wax paper by at least 1 inch and refrigerate until cold. Preheat the broiler. When ready to use, spread or rub on the hot rack above the grill. Broil for about 5 minutes, just until surface starts to turn slightly crisp and edges are lightly colored. Transfer to a towel and set aside for at least 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Salsa Lasagna for a King
ingredients: 9 lasagna sheets | salsa ( i like pace brand ) | basil leaves, garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In bowl combine a medium sized saucepan with water. Bring to boil and then reduce heat and simmer to blend flavors, approximately 8 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the lasagna sheets in half lengthwise. Remove excess liquid from heated saucepan. Place a single layer of meaty lasagna sheet in a lightly greased baking dish, overlapping each other slightly but not cutting all the way to the edges. Cover lasagna layer with meaty lasagna sheets and cover with sauce. Cover the lasagna with some salsa. Cover with a clean dish towel and bake for about 35 - 40 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted and lightly browned on top. Remove foil and sprinkle with basil leaves. Serve with sour cream and/or sliced green onions.

title: Curry Potatoes and Meat Balls
ingredients: 500 g finely minced meat | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon potato starch or 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice or 2 -3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into 1 inch balls. Heat oil in a large pan and cook around 6 - 7 minutes until nicely browned.

title: Taco Wraps
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 1/2 flour tortillas
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning according to package directions. Spread the taco seasoning over one side of each tortilla to within 1 inch of the edge. Fold tortillas in half and place them side by side on a platter. Serve with salsa and fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,deli roast beef,serrano pepper,chicken wing
title: Crispy Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh chicken wings or 2 lbs frozen wings | 2 -3 tablespoons dried flax seeds | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon fresh serrano pepper | 1/3 cup fat free roasted deli roasted deli roasted beef
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment. Rinse the wings under running water until thawed. Trim off excess fat. Place wings in a large bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the wings and dry seeds and saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Add the remaining 1/3 cup oil and cook until liquid evaporates, about 10 minutes. Stir in the chile peppers and remove from heat. Spread the mixture evenly amongst the wings, covering completely. Bake until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees or 79 to 80 degrees, turning them halfway through. Immediately place the wings on paper towels to dry. Place the roasted deli meat between 2 sheets of waxed paper. Using a slotted spoon, remove the paper. Serve, keeping the hot deli food warm and hot. Variation, substitute chili sauce for the chili pepper powder.

title: Mushroom Cannoli
ingredients: 1 package mascarpone | 12 maraschino cherries | 12 cremini mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prick the mushrooms with a skewer to open up the cherry. Slice off and discard the stems and set aside. In a medium bowl, whip the mascarpone until smooth and creamy. Stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons of the mushroom soaking liquid and the cherries. Stuff mushroom caps with half of the cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,mint jelly,heirloom tomato,chicken bouillon granule,provolone cheese
title: A Madeira Smoked Chicken Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 3 pounds smoked provolone cheese, sliced thin | 4 heirloom tomatoes, sliced or torn into bite-size pieces | 6 squares madeira wine or other dry white wine | 1 packet chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup mint jelly, or to taste
instructions: Combine sliced provolone in a bowl. Layer each tomato, cut side down, in the cheese. Layer with the madeira. Pour hot, smoke flavored port or other white wine over the layered ingredients and mix well. Spoon into small paper freezer bags to store up to 3 months.

title: Easy Salsa #2, #2FIX
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked | 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Put bacon in a deep skillet and cook over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet using a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Cut bacon into 1/4 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Add guacamole to bacon and mix well. Enjoy.

title: Fish With Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets, cut 3/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon za'atar spice mix | 2 teaspoons fresh baby carrots, sliced thin
instructions: Place meat in bag with za'atar. Marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Preheat oven to 400°f brush top and sides of bag with oil. Place meat in center of rack. Insert carrots into meat and arrange vegetables around fish. Bake for 35 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.

Random Ingredients: white flour,biscuit,green bean,lime juice zest,monterey jack cheese,anchovy paste,ketchup
title: Ketchup Bites
ingredients: 3 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 bunch white flour | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 2 cans small green beans, drained | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 can refrigerated biscuits or ( 15 ounce ) can biscuit, biscuits
instructions: Mix the cheese, flour, ketchup, the lime zest and lemon juice together in a wide microwaveable bowl.

Random Ingredients: honey,tea,pizza sauce,sun tomato oil,soy flour,mexican cheese,habanero pepper
title: Spicy Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon low sodium soy flour | 1 - 1 1/2 lb steak ( i get my butt cut crosswise into 8 slices, 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick, and 3 in all ) | 1 -2 tablespoon hoisin sauce ( or a combination of ho and t ) | 1 can pizza sauce ( i use my del monte brand ) | 6 ounces mild shaved reduced-fat mexican cheese blend ( i sometimes use colby-jack ) | 1 -2 large fresh habanero pepper ( pepper optional ) | 12 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped, packed | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Coat an oven proof nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray with cooking spray.

title: French Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, uncooked | 2 teaspoons lard | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 4 -5 lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup creme de banane
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. In 2 t. Butter and 1/2 c water fry the onion in 2 t. Lard over medium high heat for 5 - 10 minutes or until tender. Remove the lidded skillet from the heat. Add the linguine and linguine to the skillet. Turn off the heat. Add the creme de banane and toss until heated through. Turn the linguine into a serving bowl. Garnish with the onion and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Italian Sausage and Walnut Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 teaspoon dried italian sausage | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted | 1/2 cup wild rice, prepared according to package
instructions: Cut chicken in half. Sear in a 10 x 15 inch jelly roll pan on the first side until lightly pink. Turn over, brown the other side. Remove from pan. Cut up sausage into small pieces. Place all three halves back in pan, and sprinkle with italian sausage. Add walnuts and saute for a few minutes longer. Meanwhile prepare rice according to package instructions. While warm, sprinkle wafers with remaining nuts. Cover and set aside to keep warm.

title: Grape Salad
ingredients: 1 grape, peeled | 1 bunch okra, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 4 tablespoons kirsch
instructions: Cut grapes into 1/2 inch pieces. Drop grapes into boiling water and boil. Soak okra, cut side up, in kirsch until tender and bright green, about 1 minute. Drain okra and remove and let water run clear. Combine okra and grapes. Sprinkle with oregano and serve.

title: Polish Sausage (Crock pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh meatballs or 3 lbs pork butt ( 3-1/2 lbs - 3.5-1 lb ) | 1 lb ground lean pork or 1 lb ground lamb | 1 lb cooked polish sausage ( bulk or bulk recommended, sliced, or a mild italian sausage ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/2 cup old fashioned cocoa | 2 1/2 cups salsa ( hot ) | 2 1/2 cups shredded italian cheese blend
instructions: Cook or brown meatballs in lard or olive oil, drain. Drain if meatballs are long. Remove meat meatballs to a bowl. Brown sausage in same skillet. Drain meatballs in same skillet. Remove sausage and drippings from skillet. Combine rest ingredients, except cheese, and mix. Add meatballs and cheese to bowl with remaining ingredients. Pour cheese mixture over meatballs and cheese. Stir until combined. Cover and chill 6 - 8 hours. Serve or remove casings. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. This is a very versatile recipe with no substitutions and is available on zaar. The flavor comes from spanish sausage. The sausage is often sauted as part of our country style meals.

title: Fiery Cabbage and Sultanas
ingredients: 4 medium fingerling potatoes, peeled | 2 medium heads of cabbage, sliced | 7 -8 small dried chilies | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 6 ounces sultanas ( optional ) | 2 ounces sultanas, extra to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the potatoes over a medium to large pan of boiling water, then cover with a lid and leave to simmer gently for 15 minutes or until just tender. Leave for a few minutes more, then drain. Place the cabbage, chillies, and baking powder into a large casserole dish, then add the sultanas if using. Stir well to cover the cabbage with sultanas. Cover then cook on high for 10 minutes until warmed through and golden, stirring every now and then.

title: Prawn and Bacon Melt
ingredients: 8 prawns ( in shell ) | 1 package brownie mix | 1/2 cup dry wine | 1 egg ( beaten ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon brown sugar ( optional ) | 5 hamburger buns
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Shell prawns and boil on high for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Boil brownie package in enough water with a lid on, then drain and plunge in cold water, drain and set aside. Meanwhile mix prawn and onion and season with salt. Heat remaining ingredients in a small microwavable bowl on high for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, but not until the mixture boils. Spread mixture onto hamburger buns and top with prawns and onion mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon sugar,hash brown potato,chicken soup base
title: Easy Chicken Dinner
ingredients: 1 container instant chicken soup base | 2 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 1 pound frozen hash brown potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan, combine chicken soup base and cinnamon sugar. Add frozen potatoes, and heat through.

Random Ingredients: sage,lemon juice,beet,parmesan cheese,limeade concentrate,chicken breast,black mustard seed
title: Grilled Chicken Picnic Sandwich
