title: Almond Milk (Corn Fritters)
ingredients: 1 quart almond milk | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 quart frozen corn | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/3 cup gherkin, chopped
instructions: Blend the milk, bouillon and corn in a blender or food processor until thick but smooth. Pour half of the almond mixture into a large nonstick frying pan with a tight fitting lid. Heat over medium heat. Add the syrup, nutmeg and ghekin and cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce is thick and fragrant, about 20 minutes.

title: Garlicky Dill Pasta and Oil
ingredients: 1 lb penne | 10 ounces fresh dill weed, chopped | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Pour oil into a large skillet with the zest of 2 lemons. Drain the pasta and add it to the heated oil. Drain the water from the dill weed and add it to the skillet. Bring the pasta to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let it sit for 5 minutes. Uncover the pasta pan and stir the dill weed into the pasta. Serve warm.

title: Vegetable Sambol
ingredients: 1 lb medium green beans, tipped and cut into 2-inch pieces | 1/4 lb raw mexican-style tri-colored masa harina | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 garlic clove | 2 ounces maizena pasta | 20 -24 wonton wrappers
instructions: Boil the beans until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Mash beans with masa harina. Combine rice bran, garlic, and mixed spice. Spread 1 - 2 teaspoons of filling in the center of the won ton wrapper. Fold envelope over filling and pinch to seal. If desired, lightly brush the outside of the won ton with warm water. Place won ton wrappers on a baking sheet. Bake in a preheated oven for 25 - 30 minutes, until crispy and golden. Allow to cool before serving.

title: Cheddar Crusted Steak
ingredients: 2 sirloin, trimmed | 1 can sliced mushrooms | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 teaspoon fennel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Using your choice of blade, cut steak in half lengthwise, across 1/4 inch. Combine mushrooms, cheese and fennel together. Sprinkle evenly over both sides of the steak. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes or until desired doneness. Cut steak into 4 serving pieces.

title: Mika's Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces macaroni | 1 small green pepper, cut in rings | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cook macaroni, and let cool for 1/2 hour. Drain. Meanwhile, mix all the ingredients together. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,nutmeg,chocolate syrup,rigatoni pasta,tap water,plain yogurt,green chilies
title: Sweet Yummy Beef Skillet #RSC
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain low-fat yogurt | 1 1/4 cups tap water | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/3 cup chocolate syrup | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 -2 green chilies | 4 ounces mild green chilies
instructions: Heat a large non stick skillet over medium high heat.. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl, whisking to blend well. Add rigatoni.

title: Homemade Adobo
ingredients: 8 cups nonfat dry milk | 5 cups distilled white wine vinegar
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the vinegar. Bring the milk to a boil over medium heat. Pour the vinegar into the milk, whisking constantly. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Pour the hot milk into a sealable container and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before using. Remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before using. Use hot, nonfat dipping sauce, such as sambal oelek, for sandwiches, or in place of salsa.

title: Glazed Turnips II
ingredients: 6 turnips, pared and sliced | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 2 tablespoons dry bread crumbs, divided
instructions: Lightly saute' turnip, bacon and rice wine together over medium heat until turnips are tender and lightly crisp. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon bread crumbs over turnip and sprinkle with sage. Serve with fresh cream if desired.

title: Anchovy Stuffed Indian Bread
ingredients: 4 slices fine semolina ( farfalle ) | 1 tablespoon fine semolina | 2 tablespoons very finely chopped onions | 3 tablespoons finely chopped anchovies | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil. In a medium bowl, stir together the semolina & fine semolina. Stir in the cilantro. Gently mix in the onions & anchovies. Spoon mixture into the prepared pan, 1 cup from the edge of the pan. Broil for 8 minutes, or until edges are lightly browned and top is firm. Serve hot. Variation #1, remove the anchovies before spooning the m&ms over the bread.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,sesame oil,canola oil,tarragon,vegetable oil,tomato soup,yukon gold potato,pasta
title: Swiss Potatoes Ole'
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, washed and cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 0.667 can condensed tomato soup | 0.667 can tomato soup | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons dried tarragon | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups dry pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: In a large pan, place the potatoes, oil, and undiluted sauces on high to heat. Stir in tarragon. In a separate bowl, measure soup, and add a little olive oil to make a slightly runny gravy. Once potatoes are heated through, add to soup, stirring well. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Pour cooked pasta into oven safe casserole dish. Spoon stewed pasta over the top of the noodles. Pour remaining soup over the top. Sprinkle on cheese. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 400 degrees. Remove cover, bake for an additional five minutes. Note, i never bake the dish after the five minutes, so it can stand back a little in the oven for a few minutes, and then re cover.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,coconut cream,red chili pepper,baby spinach,hamburger,cardamom
title: Coconut Barley Burgers
ingredients: 225 g baby spinach | 150 g smoked hamburger | 100 g pearl barley | 200 g coconut cream | 2 tablespoons dried red chili peppers | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Wash the spinach and boil it in a microwaveable bowl for 30 seconds, then squeeze out any excess moisture. Set the cooked spinach aside for a moment to cool. Mix the rice into the cooled spinach, then work in the burger, breaking it into small chunks. Heat a large, non stick frying pan over a medium heat, then add the barley. Stir over a low heat for 5 minutes, until everything is just starting to wilt, then stir in the coconut cream, dried red chilis and cardamon. Bring to the boil, then cover, and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring once or twice. Allow to stand for a few minutes so that the coconut cream thickens, then cut into slices.

Random Ingredients: chili,balsamic vinegar,clear honey,white pepper,onion soup mix
title: Chili Oil Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 250 ml clear honey | 150 g dried onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon dry chili
instructions: To make sauce, mix all ingredients together in saucepan on low heat.

title: Easy Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 can tomato puree | 3 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons lemon zest
instructions: Chop chicken. If using lean beef, shred it coarsely with a sharp knife. Mix tomato puree, garam masala and zest. Place chicken in 2 large buttered baking dishes. Sprinkle the spice mix onto chicken. Cover with foil and bake in 375 degree oven for 40 - 45 minutes or till golden in colour. Serve with rice/chop salad.

title: Chickpea & Watercress Rillettes
ingredients: 6 teaspoons chili pepper ( minced or crushed ) | 1 cup chickpeas ( rinsed, patted dry, soaked in cold water until no longer soft ) | 1 tablespoon watercress ( optional ) | 4 bay seasoning tm ( optional-increase if desired ) | 4 cups fresh water ( or about 1 1/4 - 2.5 cups mixed greens ) | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme ( or a little less than 1/2 tsp chopped fresh thyme ) | crushed ice | 4 -6 teaspoons grated romano cheese, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: Heat your broiler and position a rack 6 inches from the heat. Heat your chile until the tiny dark spots are starting to rise to the surface.. Remove from the heat when the chile is slightly charred and aromatic, about 5 - 10 minutes. If you are using the chile, keep it in a jar in the fridge for up to a couple of days before using. Pour about 3 tablespoons of the chile into a bowl, then stir in the chickpeas. If using the watercress, drain the water in between pressing it down and then stir it inches. Pour the remaining liquid into the same bowl and stir in your watercress. Stir your greens and thyme into the liquid, breaking them into small bits as you go. Place the rillettes on a baking sheet or a tray and sprinkle lightly with crushed flakes. Broil in your oven, using a panni press or a circular motion, moving the rillettes in the residual heat for 3 - 5 minutes, until the water has evaporated and the rillettes show glochy resistance. Serve piping hot, with cheese sprinkled over the rillettes for sprinkling.

title: Crock Pot Rice With Apples (Arroz Con Sal)
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless fish steaks | 1 can rosado mixed apple cider ( or apple juice ) | 6 cups cooked rice | 16 ounces sour cream | 1 package frozen ravioli | 2 -3 cups prepared shredded topping ( optional )
instructions: Mix apple cider and sour cream. Spray crock pot with cooking spray. Add fish to crock pot. Pour apple cider mixture evenly over fish. Cook on low for 3 - 5 hours or on high for 4 - 5 hours. Serve on top of rice with ravioli and shredded cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,goat cheese,sirloin,heavy whipping cream,extra virgin olive oil,wheat spaghetti,cheddar cheese,baking cocoa
title: Beef and Goat Cheese Arepas With Spicy Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup whole wheat spaghetti | 3/4 lb ground sirloin | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 7 ounces goat cheese | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 teaspoons baking cocoa | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Put cornmeal in a food processor and pulse until fine. Sift cornmeal onto a pastry board and put into a mixing bowl. Cook spaghetti in boiling water with 2 teaspoons olive oil until just soft tender and drain. Transfer to a bowl of ice and water. Mash with a fork. Set aside. Mix together ground beef, extra virgin olive oil and goat cheese. Drain spaghetti and mix in well. Add the cornmeal mixture and pulse a few times. Shape half of the pasta mixture into sausages, about 6” in diameter and 2 ½” thick. Pound with a meat mallet until thin and place onto baking sheet. Bake the arepas for about 10 mins each side until golden brown. To serve, place a sausage on top and cheese slice on top. Serve and enjoy.

title: Baked Fennel Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazel hummus | 1/3 cup white rum ( do not use kool-aid type ) | 3 tablespoons miso ( white or brown ) | 2 teaspoons white rum ( do not use kool-aid type ) | 1 large fennel, bulb only, with fronds | cooking spray
instructions: In large bowl mash hazel hummus with a fork or pestle. Make a space around the bowl for the honey to dissolve. Add white wine rum and miso and whisk. Add seeds from fronds and add about 2 tbsp to honey. Spoon into a 9 x13 inch pan and bake uncovered 1 hour at 375°f. Serve warm. If using white rum and or sherry leave as is. Serve with your choice of fruit.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,vegetable stock,jalapeno chile pepper,chili paste garlic,chicken bouillon,green cardamom pod
title: Ethiopian Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 pound cubed, skinless chicken breast meat | 1 jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and minced | 2 stalks celery salt | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1 can vegetable stock | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Place chicken into a medium pot and cover with water.

title: Zucchini Fried With Cheese-Gravy
ingredients: 4 -5 medium zucchini | 2 large eggs | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup half-and-half | salt | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 3 -5 thin slices queso fresco
instructions: Peel zucchini and remove the ends so they can also be cut into 2 inch pieces. Steam the zucchini until soft. Drain liquid but reserve liquid. Beat the eggs lightly. Mix with the ginger garlic paste and half and half. Add salt to taste, grated cheese, sliced green pepper, and desired amount of the reserved zucchini liquid. Stir until all ingredients are mixed. Put mixture in large frying pan at medium high heat until bubbly and browned. Flip zucchini. Use tongs to stir mixture.

title: Chilled Dhal(Bangladesh)
ingredients: 4 cups fresh cooked chickpeas ( not canned ) | 3 cups canned chicken ( your choice of meat ) | 3 teaspoons tobiko nori ( flying fish sauce ) | 1 large fresh cherries ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Puree half of all ingredients in your food processor. Heat the dhal over medium heat in a frying pan and add the puree to the pan. Cook the dhal over medium heat for 5 minutes and then remove from heat, and allow to cool in a refrigerator for 20 minutes. Remove the chilled dhal from the refrigerator and serve with a slice of cherries on top.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,rom tomato,grapefruit,sunflower oil,coriander powder,green olive,olive oil,rice wine
title: Moroccan Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 kg grapefruit | 16 green olives | 3 roma tomatoes ( seeded & diced ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 tablespoon rice wine | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1/3 cup olive oil
instructions: Wash & trim the ends from the grapes & break off the stalks. Discard any discoloured ones. Cut into a rough 2cm x 1cm dice. Place all ingredients into a large glass bowl. Toss well to amalgamate, then cover and leave in the fridge overnight. Remove the bowl mixture from the fridge & leave to come to room temp, about 180 degrees celcius. Remove skins from grapefruit & use a teaspoon or teaspoon to pierce the pulp all over. Slice off the bottom of the grapefruit stalks, remove as much membrane & white pith as possible & set aside. Slice grapesfruit crossways into 1/8 thick slices, then diagonally into 1/4 thick slices. Heat the sundried tomato oil & sundried tomato pbq on a ridged griddle pan until smoking. Brush/spray the tomatoes with oil & cook until just softened & well charred, about 3 minutes on each side. Remove from heat & serve immediately & let cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,chili pepper flake,salmon,panko breadcrumb,pork tenderloin,cranberry,buttermilk,chicken wing
title: Chicken and Pork Taterloin
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/2 cup shredded cooked chicken or 1/2 cup pork tenderloin | 1/4 - 1/3 cup dried cranberries ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried parsley or 1 tablespoon fresh parsley | 1/2 lb cooked cooked salmon | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken wings
instructions: In a shallow bowl, mix panko, chili pepper flakes, taco seasoning and chicken or pork tenderloins to evenly coat. Drain cranberries and place on a paper towel to dry slightly. Using your hands or a spatula, coat cranberries with bread crumbs. Roll salmon in dried cranberries and then into crumbs. Place fish head down on plate with large head down. Tear off two 12 inch lengths of heavy duty aluminum foil, making sure there are no pockets of air at bottom or top. Place 2 pieces of cooked chicken on top of each piece of fish head, then drizzle with taco seasoning and parsley. Wrap foil around chicken and sprinkle with more corn meal, pressing into any openings. Place fish directly on foil with chicken on top. Bake at 425 degrees for 45 minutes or til fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Cauliflower in a Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 lb button mushroom
instructions: Prepare the cauliflower and cut it into 4 to 5 inch florets. If the cauliflower is very small, it is easier to cut out the core and then cut all the pieces into smaller pieces. Steam the cauliflower until fork tender. Cut the mushrooms up into chunks. Bring water to a boil and bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the cauliflower and cook until no longer tough. Drain and rinse in cold water and remove the tough outer leaves. Place the cauliflower on a large serving platter and set it aside. In a small fry pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over a medium high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until they begin to release their liquid. If you are cooking in a crockpot place the cauliflower on top of the mushrooms. Pour the mushrooms over the cauliflower and serve. This is a hearty dish and tastes even better after chilling for several hours.

title: French Bread and Cheese Toasts With Sage Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup swiss gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped | 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 1 loaf french bread, cut in thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a small bowl, stir the first five ingredients together until smooth. Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet. Top each slice with 1 tablespoon of the sage butter and then with 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons grated gruyere. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: mint,apple,coffee extract,chipotle chile,pork loin,sage,red pepper flake
title: Tinga (Apple Meat and Chipotle)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed dried sage | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dried minced sage | 1 can chipotle chiles or ( 10 ounce ) can green chilies, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs pork loin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( i like the small cut-up version which is cut in half ) | 2 tablespoons coffee-flavored extract ( optional ) | 1/4 cup of fresh mint ( dried for garnish ) or 1/4 cup basil ( dried for garnish )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the sage, red pepper flakes, and sage powder. Lightly brown the pork cubes in a skillet.

title: New Potato Sticks With Avocado and Cornmeal Crackers (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1 )
ingredients: 4 medium waxy new potatoes, such as desire, roughly chopped | 1 large avocado, roughly chopped ( ripe ) | 1/2 cup chopped toasted almond | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 cup cornmeal
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Grease a 12x18cm slice of lamington pan. Place potatoes in saucepan of boiling water, then bring back to the boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally for 12 - 15 minutes or until very tender. Drain and mash with avocado and almonds. In a bowl, sift together the flour and cornmeal. Add potato mixture to flour and mix until just combined. Toss flour mixture and transfer to prepared pan. Spread batter evenly over the top of potato sticks, then bake for 5 - 6 minutes or until top is golden and crisp. Allow to cool for 2 minutes. Transfer to wire rack.

Random Ingredients: canadian bacon,espresso powder,oyster sauce,monterey jack cheddar cheese,cheese,pineapple chunk,nonstick cooking spray
title: Cheesy Canadian Bacon & Pineapple-Glazed Cheeseseboard  (Diabetic Version)
ingredients: 1/4 lb deli canadian bacon, sliced | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 12 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 6 tablespoons light soy-free instant espresso powder | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded extra-sharp reduced-fat cheddar cheese ( or more if you desire )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a 9 x 5 x 3 pan with foil. Combine the shredded cheese, espresso powder and oyster sauce in a medium sized bowl and set aside. Spray nonstick nonstick cooking spray over the base of a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Arrange the pineapple chunks over the cheese in an overlapping pattern. Cover with the grated cheese. Top with the grated cheese. Bake until heated thru and the topping is warm, about 8 minutes. Take foil off the cheese and bake until the cheese is slightly golden, about 5 minutes. Serve hot with a side dish of rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,half,guacamole,miso,white wine vinegar,mutton,penne pasta,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Mince and Penne With Miso Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb shredded mince | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/3 cup miso | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar or 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 4 tablespoons ground cajun red pepper ( or to taste ) | sliced scotch bonnet peppers | 1 lb penne pasta or 1 lb other tubular pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package.

title: Thai Basil Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup thai basil, chopped ( loosely packed ) | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Chop basil leaves with a sharp knife. Place basil and black pepper in bowl with remaining ingredients and stir to combine. Serve as a side dip or dipping sauce.

title: Baked Tomatoes In Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium tomatoes, about the size of a small plum, seeded to remove the juice and cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 1/2 teaspoons catsup | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper ( optional ) | 2 -3 lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to arrange the sliced tomatoes close together in a well greased 1 1/2 quart baking dish.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,cooking spray,dijon mustard,malt vinegar,salmon,vanilla extract,sage,chipotle chile adobo
title: Smoked Salmon With Chipotle Mustard
ingredients: 10 ounces smoked salmon, cut into 8 medallions | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped ( or to taste ) | 4 teaspoons chopped fresh sage, plus more for garnish ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 2 teaspoons bacon drippings
instructions: Place salmon on a foil lined baking sheet. Combine chipsotle chiles, sage, and vanilla extract in a bowl. Brush salmon with chipotle mustard, then transfer to sheet, sprayed side down, to marinate for 20 minutes, at room temp. Preheat broiler. Turn oven to broil. Transfer salmon to broiler, and broil 4 to 5 inches from heat about 3 minutes or until just cooked through. Sprinkle the salmon with bacon drippings, and transfer to a serving platter. Garnish with mint, and serve immediately.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 2 roasted red peppers, chopped
instructions: Place the stew meat in a slow cooker. Mix in the roasted red peppers, coating all of the meat. Cover and cook on high until the vegetables are tender, 6 to 8 hours.

title: Cheese & Oat Crust
ingredients: 1 cup old oat | 1/3 cup apple cider, chilled or 1/3 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 1 1/2 cups aged gouda cheese, grated
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°f. Combine oatmeal & cider in a bowl and add hot pepper sauce. Spread over greased or floured 1 1/2 cup cookie sheet. Bake for 25 - 30 mins, or until golden brown & crisp.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,sirloin tip roast,baking powder,ketjap manis,green chilies,mexican cheese,spinach leaf,anchovy fillet
title: Beef and Spinach Sambol
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup ( manis ) | 1 ounce chicken bouillon granules | 3 ounces mexican blend cheese or 3 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, drained | 2 cups frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed in microwave about 30 seconds | 1 can chopped mild green chilies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine. Pour into a 13 x9 glass baking dish, cover and marinate at least 1 hour or overnight. Remove meat from the dish and set aside. Drain and reserve marinade. Preheat the broiler. Remove meat from dish and spread evenly with marinade. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes or until done. Serve with rice and garnish with diced green onions and fresh tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: spanish rice mix,marsala wine,apple cider,cashew,golden syrup,tuna,head cauliflower
title: Tuna & Cashews
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews | 1 medium head cauliflower, separated into flowerets | 1 can tuna, drained | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1 cup dry spanish rice mix | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Cook cashews in boiling water until nuts are crisp.

title: Smoky Baked Plantain and Lamb
ingredients: 5 ripe plantains ( peeled ifn't using, can also use yellow ) | 3 tablespoons hot teriyaki sauce ( light ) | 1/4 loaf crusty bread roll | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 cans plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1 tablespoon horseradish ( a little extra virgin is nice ) | 8 green olives, sliced ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup ( optional )
instructions: Bake the plantains at 350 for 20 minutes, turning halfway through and basting with heated teriyaki sauce. Wrap the bread in foil and bake at 400 for 10 minutes. Open and place the tomatoes, rosemary, horseradish, olives, and golden syrup in a bowl and mix well. Place the plantains in the tomato mixture and gently stir. Cut the bread into bite sized squares, place in the center and spoon over the top with tomato mixture. Put under the grill and bake 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Ouzo
ingredients: 150 g ouzo | 225 g superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Boil the ouzo in a saucepan for about 10 minutes, then remove from heat and stir in 100 g of the superfine sugar. Pour the ouzo mixture into a serving bowl. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of poppy seeds over the top. Serve warm, drizzled with ouzo.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,pernod,tilapia fillet,mirin,parmesan cheese,red capsicum,cornflour,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Tilapia & Pernod Grilled
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pernod ( or a mild white wine ) | 2 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 6 tilapia fillets | vegetable oil cooking spray | 250 g red capsicums, cut into thin strips | 4 cups lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Prepare barbecue. In small bowl, whisk together pernod, mirin & rice wine, cover & refrigerate for 30 minutes. Cook fillets on medium hot grill, brushing with oil.

Random Ingredients: apricot,fast rising yeast,garlic granule,french bread,bacon,vegetable broth
title: Bacon Apricot French Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 3 medium ripe apricots, halved ( about 12 oz. ) | 2 teaspoons dried garlic granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons french bread | 3 tablespoons bacon fat ( optional )
instructions: Place the broth in a small bowl and add the apricots. Set aside. In a small bowl, dissolve the sugar in the yeast. Let stand about 5 minutes. Dissolve the yeast in the broth then add 3 tablespoons of the broth and the yeast mixture. Let stand 10 minutes. Pour the yeast mixture into a large bowl. Add 1 tablespoon bacon fat and 1/4 cup of the reserved broth to the yeast mixture, stirring to dissolve the yeast. Add the remaining broth. Add half the bread. Beat for 30 seconds and then beat in 1/2 cup reserved bread liquid, scraping down the sides of the bowl with a spoon. Stir in the yeast mixture. Turn out on a floured board and knead until the dough is smooth and elastic. Place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1 1/2 hours. Grease a 3 1/2 to 5 3/4 quart loaf pan, or line with parchment paper. Turn the dough out onto a floured board and, turning the dough, punch down to release excess flour and shape it into a loaf. Place on the prepared pan and cover tightly with a towel or lightly oiled plastic wrap. Let rise 1 hour. Meanwhile preheat the oven to 350°f with the rack in the middle of the oven. Bake 20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the center is puffed. Cool on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,cabbage,ginger paste,hot italian sausage,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Slaw
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, finely shredded ( about 1 pound ) | 1 cup thinly sliced red bell peppers or 1 cup red bell pepper | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed or 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Cover and chill for 1 hour, tossing several times. Serve with rice.

title: Italian Muffins
ingredients: 20 slices pepperoni | 3 ounces green olives | 24 teaspoons marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place pepperoni slices on a cookie sheet lined with cooking paper. Bake 8 minutes. Turn and bake 6 minutes. Remove from oven. Pour marsala over pepperoni and olives. Serve warm.

title: Simple Microwave Spanish Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 cups fiesta hot salsa
instructions: Microwave on high 5 minutes. Stir to mix in hot salsa and mix well. Serve warm or let cool and peel well then cut in diagonal slices.

title: Mustard Duck
ingredients: 4 duck, whole | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place duck on a rack in a roasting pan or on a lightly greased baking sheet. Combine salt, thyme and water. Brush mixture evenly on duck. Bake in preheated oven until cooked through, and internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f, 45 to 60 minutes, basting once or twice.

title: Cottage Cheese & Raisin Dip With Dried Fruit & Smoked Fish (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 16 )
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup low fat sour cream | 1/2 cup low-fat irish cream ( plain ) | 1 teaspoon dried fruit, chopped ( apricots, dates, prunes & dates ) | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/3 cup red beans, soaked and drained
instructions: Place cottage cheese in a bowl and add sour cream, and irish cream. Mix with a fork or spoon until smooth. Transfer mixture to an ovenproof dish. Top with dried fruit & raisins. Bake uncovered until golden, 30 - 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,parsley sprig,brown sugar,anise seed,pistachio nut,rosemary,raisin,black pepper
title: Pistachio Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups pure pistachio nuts | 6 cups ketchup | 3/4 cup packed brown sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon dried anise seed | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: In a blender or food processor, process pistachios and ketchup until smooth. Stir in brown sugar, parsley, rosemary, anise seed, black pepper, and raisins.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,ham,black olive,bean thread noodle,pork loin
title: Italian Pork Loin and Bean Thread Noodles
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless pork loin | italian salad dressing | ham or prosciutto | ground black olives ( optional ) | 1 package bean thread noodles
instructions: Cut pork loin into 3/4 inch wide chunks, trimming excess fat if desired. Place in large zip lock bag. Sprinkle with italian dressing, then lay ham or prosciutto slices on top or use prosciutto for ham as desired. Pour enough dressing to cover all of pork. Squeeze bag to soak up the dressing. Refrigerate pork until meat is at room temperature, about 4 hours, turning and rearranging. Preheat grill to high or lower setting. Oil grill or prepare grill for indirect grilling, about 7 - 8 minutes. Place on lightly oiled rack, cover and grill until pork is tender and no longer pink inside, about 25 minutes total cooking time. Remove pork from grill with tongs or spatula and let rest about 5 minutes. Cut pork into 1 1/2 thick slices. Add olives, if using, to cooked bean threads. Serve on warm or at room temperature.

title: Simple German Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup green pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon tomato, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon paprika ( or less ) or 1/8 teaspoon chili powder, for a milder taste ( or less )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over salad. Let it sit in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Sprinkle with paprika/jalapeno seeds if desired.

title: Grilled Pea (Or Pounded) Fudge
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frozen peas | 1/4 cup dry vermouth or 1/4 cup dry sherry | 10 ounces chocolate chips | 2 garlic cloves, peeled and halved | 2 ounces chopped fresh sage | 1 sugar cube
instructions: Put peas into a food processor or blender, and puree, adding the vermouth/sherry, bittersweet chocolate chips, garlic and sage. Grind in batches until all ingredients are ground. Add more vermouth if mixture is too thick, or more chocolate chips if desired. Transfer to a baking dish lined with waxed paper.

title: Edamame Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 2 large raw chicken breasts | 2 frozen shelled edamame, thawed ( shelled frozen will give you a softer consistency, but thawed will give you a firmer texture ) | 5 teaspoons chopped fresh coriander ( fresh coriander is best ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Thaw the edamame in refrigerator and chop off just the beginning bits. I prefer to use a food processor, although fresh is better than frozen. Place all ingredients in a zip lock bag and add a teaspoon of the vanilla. Stir to coat and place in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 2 hours. Heat oven to 450°f place the chicken in a baking dish which has been lightly sprayed with balsamic vinegar, and bake the chicken approximately 10 minutes, turn once, and add more oil if necessary. Baste occasionally and move around the pan so as not to burn the bottom.

title: Alfredo Sauce -Salmon With Poached Pear Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese | 2 cans frozen pears, in juice, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons dried oregano flakes | 1/4 cup shortening | 1 lb salmon fillet
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the cream cheese and pour entire contents into a blender with the pears. Stir in the oregano and oregano flakes. Heat. Meanwhile, place the butter in a non stick pan. Dip salmon fillet in melted butter, then in spice mixture. Add to pan. Cook fillet 5 minutes each side.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,bok choy,kosher salt,orange zest,chicken thigh,coriander seed,taco sauce,confectioner ' sugar
title: Grilled Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 2 teaspoons kosher salt or 2 teaspoons sea salt | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 3 medium bok choy, trimmed and cut into thirds | 1 1/2 cups cream-style cottage cheese | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 2 tablespoons taco sauce
instructions: Make the spice bag, sprinkle the salt and coriander over the chicken skin, rubbing in well. Set aside for 30 minutes, then remove the chicken pieces and discard any skin or excess fat remaining on the chicken. Make the coating, blend all the ingredients together in a blender and process to a fine powder, adding more oil if necessary. Place half the coating mixture in a small, heavy duty plastic bag and gently toss until the coating is just combined. Dip the chicken into the coating, reserving any remaining coating. Grill over hot coals until cooked through, 3 - 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,poppy seed,nori,hamburger,baby pea,vegetable shortening,celery salt
title: Lazy Perosh IIi
ingredients: 1/2 lb hamburger | 1/4 cup peas | 1/2 cup baby peas | 1 vegetable shortening | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons maggi chicken stock granules ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large skillet and cook thoroughly. Serve sprinkled with additional cinnamon flakes if you dare.

title: Chef Filip's Peanut Butter Crunch
ingredients: 5 cups flour, sifted, divided | 5 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 cup italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Mix all ingredients until flour is completely incorporated. If mixture is too dry add more flour. Roll dough into desired size balls. Place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper, and let cool for 15 minutes. Flatten with floured fork.

title: Creamy Apricot Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 egg, beaten | 6 ounces dried apricots, chopped | 9 ounces rice noodles, preferably wheat | 4 cups beef stock | 4 ounces sour cream | 4 ounces american cheese, chopped
instructions: Stir together beaten egg and chopped apricots. Place dried rice noodle in a pot of boiling water, return to the boil, and reduce heat to medium. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes, until tender. Drain, and separate noodles from water. Blend or process the rest of the ingredients in a food processor until smooth, then pour into a pot with the apricot mixture and stir well over low heat before serving.

title: Pasta with Asafoetida and Black Currants
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1/4 cup sliced black currants | 1 tablespoon hungarian sweet paprika, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni to water, and cook for about 8 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Meanwhile, place black currants in a small bowl. Season with paprika. Toss the black currants into the bowl with asafetida until coated. Set aside. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni to boiling water, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until pasta is al dente. Drain. Transfer drained pasta to a large bowl, and toss with black currants and black paprika.

title: Homemade Sourdough Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 8 flour or 8 corn tortillas | flour ( for dusting ) or cornmeal ( for dusting )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees. Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges. Dust the bread with a little flour. Place on a cookie sheet, sprinkle with plenty of cornmeal or other flour, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 200 degrees. When done, let cool for 5 minutes, turn the wedges over, and place on a plate and use a spatula to scrape them out of the oven. Do not over mix. Use more flour or cornmeal to taste.

title: Potato Soup With Raspberries and Mint
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 1 1/2 cups fresh mint leaves | 2 cups raspberry vinegar | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into small dice. Boil them in salted water until soft, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well. Remove the potatoes from the water and set aside to cool. After five minutes, mix in the mint leaves and vinegar. Chill. When you are ready to cook the soup, remove the pot from the heat. Add hot water as needed to cover the pot and return it to the top of the heat. Cook until the soup boils, then remove from the heat. Transfer to an ice cream maker. Add the tabasco®, and freeze until ready to use. When ready to serve, reheat the soup and add the raspberries and mint.

title: Crunchy Cabbage and Onions
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces thinly sliced green cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons light olive oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 16 slices rye bread
instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat in a skillet. Combine all ingredients except bread in a deep serving dish. Gently stir to combine and then add bread. Mix well, serve at once.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,picante sauce,cider vinegar,orange zest,chocolate syrup
title: Mexican Chocolate Marmalade
ingredients: 1/3 cup low-sodium picante sauce | 1 tablespoon orange zest ( to taste ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons bijol curry powder | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon unsweetened chocolate syrup
instructions: Combine. Cover. Chill.

title: Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained and liquid reserved | 1 1/4 cups shredded leeks | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon crushed allspice | 1/3 cup pecan halves | 3 strawberries, sliced
instructions: Place chickpeas, 1 1/2 cups of the reserved liquid, leek, vinegar and allspice in a large bowl. Toss to combine, add pecan halves and strawberries, tossing to coat.

Random Ingredients: turnip,shallot,beef chuck,prune,salad oil,bread machine yeast,italian sausage
title: French Quarter Stew Potatoes #2
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 shallot, chopped | 1 lb italian sausage, cut into small pieces | 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into small pieces | prune, cut in half | 2 packages of bread machine yeast, crumbs | 3 lbs turnips, peeled, chopped and baked
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Using a 10 inch frying pan, add olive oil and shallot over medium high heat. Cook for a couple of minutes, until shallot is translucent. Add the sausage and beef. Cook for a couple more minutes until meats are cooked through. Turn the oven to high and add prunes and let sit for about 10 minutes until prunes soften a bit. Turn burner to low until the oven turns a nice golden red colour. If your oven doesn't have a convection temperature, you can use a convection oven. Add the yeast and cook for 10 minutes. Turn oven off and wait for the oven to set which will take 3 hours for the potatoes to be cooked. Remove dough from freezer, and separate dough into 5 equal sized pieces, or use 1 gallon bowl. Take the dough and cut into 5 equal sized pieces or use 3/4 gallon. Roll out each piece of dough into a rectangle or even a little thicker if it’s wider. Put a small amount of the cooked meat mixture in the centre of the dough and wrap around the meat mixture, pressing edges to seal. Place on a lightly oiled baking pan that has been brushed with oil. Cover and let rise on a warm oven for about 1 - ½ hours, or until dough is doubled in volume and the meat is bubbly. Bake on a lightly oiled baking pan for 20 minutes until golden brown on top.

title: Tahini Crumbles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1/2 cup tahini | 3 tablespoons brandy | 2 1/4 pounds whole squid, cleaned and stems removed | 15 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | romano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix shallots and tahini together in a bowl. Toss in brandy and set aside. Place squid in a medium baking dish and pour the enchilada sauce over the top, spreading evenly. Bake in the preheated oven until squid is tender and the sauce is slightly bubbly, about 45 minutes. Drain squid and arrange on a plate. Remove any remaining sauce. Combine bread crumbs and grated romano cheese.

title: Tart Without the Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups apple juice | 1 pint fresh blueberries or 1 pint frozen blueberries, thawed
instructions: Pour juice into a large saucepan. Add berries. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until fruit is hot and syrup is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: asian chili paste,clear vegetable stock,curry powder,graham cracker crumb,pepper,nonfat milk,egg yolk
title: Tandoori Muffins
ingredients: 8 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon asian chili paste | 5 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1 egg yolk | salt and fresh ground pepper | 6 fluid ounces clear vegetable stock or 6 fluid ounces nonfat milk, from a cube used for boiling
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 300°f. Place the cracker crumbs in a bowl. Whisk the curry paste, hot chili paste, milk and egg yolk together. Add to the crumb mixture and stir until the mixture is smooth. Spoon the mixture into 18 muffin cups or heat proof custard cups, filling almost full. Cook for 20 minutes in the pre heated oven. Serve hot.

title: Düsseldt
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg yolk ( for the egg wash ) | 3 -4 boneless pork chops | layer | pink food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Whip egg and lightly paint the fat from the meat. Pour a layer of the mixture over pork chops. Sprinkle with food coloring and a sprinkling of pink food coloring.

title: Anise Seed tuna salad
ingredients: 1 hard-boiled egg | 1 can tuna in olive oil | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Break the hard boiled egg, and scoop out the white. Chop roughly. Rinse the tuna by draining it from it. Place the egg inside a bowl, and mash by mashing with a fork. Add the tuna, and mash it with a fork. Add the anise seed. Serve immediately, or cover with plastic wrap to keep the tuna moist.

title: Breaded-Chicken With Beef and Cornflour
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 8 slices whole wheat bread | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef chuck | 1 tablespoon cornflour | ice | 1/3 cup nuts, whole ( optional )
instructions: Dredge chicken in cornflour, then press between plastic wrap to flatten into a rectangle about 1/4 in thick. Cook chicken in a pan over medium low heat, turning, until browned on both sides and cooked through. Remove from heat and set aside. Add beef to a skillet and brown over medium high to high heat, breaking up into smaller chunks as it cooks, about 10 minutes. Add the bread and fry until lightly crunchy and golden on both sides. Spread the cornflour on 3 slices of meat and top with the cornflour. Top with another 3 slices of meat and cornflour mixture. Top with final slice of meat and cornflour. Heat a large non stick pan over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon oil. When hot, add the meat and brown it on all sides over medium high heat. Turn and brown it more. When it is all browned, transfer the fried chicken, then slice it thinly and place on top of the meat. Drizzle on a little extra olive oil if desired. Serve as main dish or with rice.

title: Homemade Fruit Dip (Pudding)
ingredients: 8 -10 kg canned tomatoes with ketchup, well washed | 1 kg mixed dried fruit, such as currants and pcs
instructions: Place the water for preparing, but not for washing, in a big pot/saucepan. When it reaches that stage, add the ketchup. Keep on stirring and adding water to obtain a consistency you like. When the juice of the water is absorbed, add the dried fruit, mix well. Cover the pan with a lid. Cook on low flame for about 7 - 10 hours. If the fruits have browned, remove them. Allow to cool for sometime. Transfer the mixture to your own food storage containers. Keep in refrigerator. Do not refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: veal,chicken thigh fillet,bell pepper,asparagus,soy sauce,asafoetida powder
title: Asafetida Meatballs (Labaanee Kebab)
ingredients: 300 g veal, diced | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, finely chopped | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 bunch asparagus, halved lengthways and blanched
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the veg, soy sauce, hing, garlic powder and ginger powder. Combine well, cover with cling film and set aside to marinate for 12 hours. Wash the asparagus and blanch in boiling water until tender, then refresh in ice water. Divide the asparagus among four serving plates. Divide the meatballs between the plates and top with the red pepper and the asparagus sprouts.

title: Broccoli in Orange Peel and Squash Salad
ingredients: 2 cups yellow squash, medium, cut into half moons | 1 cup broccoli, large florets | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated | lettuce, shredded
instructions: Peel and cut the squash into 1 inch cubes. Cook the broccoli in the boiling water 4 - 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain well, return to pan and add the orange peel. Stir to blend. Toss with squash and lettuce. Serve warm.

title: A Farewell to a Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 lb snow peas | 2 tablespoons mirin | 3 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Snap off the strings, just before using, unless the snow is more than 1 inch long. Boil the peas until just cooked. Place peas in cold water to stop the cooking, then drain and rinse in cold water. Transfer the peas to a bowl and stir in the mirin and sour cream. Serve warm or serve cold in a shallow bowl with a sprinkling of soy sauce on top.

title: Chicken With Snow Peas
ingredients: 8 skinless chicken thighs | 8 slices pancetta | 8 snow peas | 2 tablespoons grated carrots, divided | 3 tablespoons fennel leaves, separated
instructions: Heat a large non stick frying pan on high. Toss the chicken thighs in a mixture of 2 tbsp of grated carrots and 3 tbsp grated fennel leaves and cook in the pan until the skin is crisp. Remove the chicken from the pan and rest on a plate. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp of carrots and fennel in the pan. Remove the chicken from the pan and discard the skin and bones. Cook the chicken thighs, skin side down, in the pan for 8 minutes or until browned. Turn the chicken thighs over and brown the other side for an additional 8 - 10 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pan and keep warm. Add the rest of the carrots and fennel to the pan and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Increase the heat to high and add the chicken skin side down. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute more. Add the snow peas and cook for about 1 minute longer or until the snow peas are crisp tender and cooked through. Top with remaining grated carrot and drizzle sauce over.

title: Spiced Eggplant (Aubergine) Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 eggplants | 6 -8 fresh plum sauce | 1 -3 slice ham ( thinly sliced ) | 3 tablespoons half-and-half | 1 dash orange rind | 1 dash green cardamom pod | lemon wedge
instructions: Trim and cut eggplant to 3/4 inch slices. Brush with a couple tablespoons of olive oil. Place in bowl and toss with orange rind and black pepper. Lightly toss in plum sauce. Heat remaining 3 tablespoons of olive oil in skillet, til hot. Arrange eggplant on skillet and lightly brown both sides. Place on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,vegetable bouillon cube,brussels sprout,clove,ginger paste,ancho chilies,blueberry,apple
title: Broiled Brussels Sprouts With Apple, Blueberry and Macadamia Nut Scented Churros
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved | 6 whole cloves | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste | 2 dried ancho chilies ( about 1 teaspoon ) | 1 small apple, peeled, cored and chopped ( such as a mcintosh ) | 1 medium blueberries or 1 medium seedless orange, zested and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped macadamia nuts
instructions: In a heavy 2 to 3 quart saucepan, stir together the bouillon and its liquid and the chilies and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the sprouts, and reduce the heat to low. Boil rapidly, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, transfer to a 9 x 13 inch baking dish and let stand, covered, at room temperature for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, mix together the apple, blueberries and nuts. Sprinkle over the brussels sprouts and place under broiler or on a baking sheet. Broil, turning often, until the top is dark brown and the brussels sprouts are tender, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Barley Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shredded manchego cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro | 1 tablespoon flaked low-fat brie | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup pearl barley ( optional ) | 1/4 cup canned crushed tomatoes or 1/4 cup regular crushed tomato juice | 4 flour tortillas, or as needed
instructions: Mix the montasio cheese, cilantro, bacon, seasoned salt, mixed veggies, and crushed tomatoes together in a bowl.

title: Cinco De Tuna (Brazilian Sweet Tart)
ingredients: 1 canned tuna packed in oil ( or fresh tuna ) | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/2 cup dried currant or 1/2 cup plain white raisins | 1/4 cup of chopped blanched pistachios
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Stir and set aside in refrigerator until ready to eat. Be sure to let the tuna cool completely before using. When ready to use, drain the tuna thoroughly and pat dry. Stir the tuna into the tart and garnish with pistachios.

Random Ingredients: red wine,pizza sauce,water,white sugar,dill pickle,white mushroom,ha avocadoes
title: Giant Pizza Guacamole
ingredients: 3 hass avocadoes, peeled and sliced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill pickles | 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 pounds small white-mexican fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Heat a grill pan or griddle over medium. Toss avocado slices with pickles in a large bowl. When hot, sprinkle with pickles.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,sun tomato,chat masala,beef broth,cabbage,cod,oil,tabasco sauce
title: Indian Fried Cod and Cabbage
ingredients: 300 g cod | 2 teaspoons chat masala | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 cup beef broth | 1 cup chopped cabbage | 1 sun-dried tomato | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Cut cod into 1 cm slices, salt and pepper both sides of cod and cook in oil to your liking in a frypan until golden brown. Add broth and spices, cook for about ten minutes before serving. Garnish with sun dried tomatoes and chopped cabbage.

title: Pistachio Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup shelled unsalted shelled pistachio nuts | 7 -8 dried chilies
instructions: Blend pistachios in a food processor with remaining ingredients until they spread easily. Spread mixture on a cookie sheet, flatten slightly and bake in a 300f oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: arrowroot,cannellini bean,lemon zest,portobello mushroom,lasagna noodle,yellow pepper,oregano leaf,greek yogurt
title: Italian Mushroom Spinach-White Bean Lasagne
ingredients: 2 teaspoons lemon zest, finely grated | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 2 cans cannellini beans ( white, whole, canned ) | 1/2 lb portobello mushroom, chopped | 1/4 yellow peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup natural greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons arrowroot or 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 12 ounces lasagna noodles, pre-made
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. In a small bowl, combine the zest, oregano and 1 teaspoon each of salt and pepper. Set aside. In a medium mixing bowl combine the beans, mushrooms and the remaining 2 teaspoons of salt and pepper. Heat a 9x13 or similar sized glass baking dish in the oven for 45 minutes or until hot. Meanwhile, in a measuring cup, combine the yogurt and arrowroot. If using corn starch, dissolve by mixing in a few tablespoons water, then whisking into the yogurt. When the 45 - 50 minutes are up, remove from the oven, then stir in the yogurt mixture and bring to a boil. Stir well until thickened, about 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and whisk in the 1 teaspoon of lemon rind. Set aside. When the lasagne is cooked, remove from the oven and immediately fill the pan with the bean mixture, leaving about 1/2 inch about on top. Arrange the lasagna on top of the bean mixture, or in one layer if using two sheets of lasagne. Add another 1/2 inch of bean mixture on top and use a spatula to flatten the top of the lasagne slightly. Spread the cooked noodles on top of the bean, then sprinkle with half of the crumbled feta. Place the lasagne top on in the oven. Cook until the cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown, about 30 to 40 minutes or until the top starts to turn golden and the top is starting to brown slightly. Remove from the oven. Let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Ace's Mexican Cold Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh sweet corn oil | 3/4 cup strong coffee granules | 1 tablespoon mccormick's montreal-style instant coffee granules | 1 teaspoon seasoning ( optional ) | 2 cups chopped lettuce or 2 cups a combination of the two, for garnish
instructions: In a 1 1/2 to 2 quart pan or wok, warm the oil over medium heat. Add sweet corn oil, coffee, and montreal seasoning. Cook, stirring constantly so that there are no lumps, for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add lettuce just before serving to heat through, about 3 seconds to 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: topping,canadian bacon,littleneck clam,simple syrup,hot chili pepper,bok choy
title: Linguica
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs littleneck clams, scrubbed, with shells reserved | 1 package bok choy, coarsely chopped | 2 slices canadian bacon, cut crosswise in 1/4 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons simple syrup | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper, hot, seeded | additional chopped fresh hot chili pepper ( to taste )
instructions: If using clams, rinse and drain. Remove and discard tops discarding any clams that do not close when tapped and may have large clams which do not open. In a large bowl, combine clam meat, chopped bok choy, bacon, syrup& chilies. Taste and adjust salt.

title: Quinoa with Tomatoes and Beef
ingredients: 1 bag quinoa, washed | 1 tomato, chopped | 1 lb lean ground beef
instructions: Bring water to a boil, stir in quinoa, cover and reduce heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. While quinoa is cooking, brown ground beef in a large frying pan. Add chopped tomato and a touch of salt. Drain excess fat.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,coriander seed,tomato puree,italian cheese
title: Easy Tomato and Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 10 g coriander seeds | 4 tablespoons dried hot chili sauce or 4 tablespoons mild ground chili sauce | 200 g italian cheese ( eg parmigiana ) | 2 tablespoons tomato puree
instructions: Grind coriander seeds in a spice or coffee grinder or mortar and pestle or a food processor. Add remaining spices and chilli sauce and stir well. Blend puree with cheese in food processor or blender or leave to stand for five minutes on speed scrape down sides and blend again until smooth. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,worcestershire sauce,anaheim chilies,whipping cream,okra,chicken tender,olive,yellow pepper
title: Chicken Tikka With Okra (Aka  Okra Tikka)
ingredients: 4 chicken tenders, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup light sour cream | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 -2 fresh anaheim chilies, stemmed, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 medium yellow pepper, cut into 1/2-inch -inch squares | 10 stuffed olives, halved | 1 package frozen okra, thawed
instructions: Mix first 10 ingredients until well blended. Place chicken pieces in a gallon sized zip top bag.

title: Baked Pears
ingredients: 3 ripe anjou pears, unpeeled | 1 cup light nutella
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f cut pear in half crosswise. Place cut side up on a greased baking sheet. Place on the hot baking sheet. Mix together the nutella and anjou pear pulp. Drizzle over pear halves. Bake in 400f degrees oven just until nuts are lightly toasted and syrupy.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,pasta sauce,cumin powder,honey,garbanzo bean,farfalle pasta,mace,barbecue seasoning
title: Barbecue Pasta With Beans
ingredients: 1 small package farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) pasta, cooked and drained ( approx. 7.5 oz/person pasta water can ) | 1/2 jar pasta sauce, bottled ( i use homemade ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 dash barbecue seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander or 1 dash cumin | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | honey ( optional ) | horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for pasta and top with cheese if desired. Makes about 2 cups of pasta and can be cooked and drained right away. The oil will help to keep the noodles from sticking on the crockpot if you refrigerate them for a few hours.

title: Prawn With Nuts and Asparagus
ingredients: 2 -3 stalks asparagus, sliced | 300 g baby prawns | 125 g snow peas or 125 g baby bok choy, in length | 1 lemon juice | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon dry chili, in color
instructions: Heat a little oil in a heavy pan and cook the asparagus for 2 - 3 minutes. Set aside. Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tail on. Cut the prawns in half lengthways then gently shake off any excess skin with your hands. Cut the ends off the asparagus then cut the remaining asparagus into 4 or 5 inch lengths. Heat the pan and stir fry the asparagus, snow peas, lemon juice, caraway seeds and dry chilies until the vegetables are just cooked. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: squid,orange peel,cocoa powder,veal,lasagna noodle,graham cracker crumb
title: Calabacin Calabodate (Calabodian Lasagna)
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground veal | 1/4 lb ground pork or 1/4 lb italian meat, of choice | 1 tablespoon graham cracker crumbs or 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup shredded orange peel | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 1/4 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs or 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 jar marinated squid or ( 16 ounce ) jar anchovies with sauce
instructions: Brown meat with onion, drain. Mix crumbs, cracker crumbs and orange peel and divide in half. Dip meat mixture into crumbs and place in 13x9. Place 2 to 3 meatballs atop meatballs to make a double layer. Add another layer. Continue layering until meatballs are gone. Cover with sauce, cover and cook at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. If pan gets too dry, mix 1/4 cup water with cracker crumbs and spread over top and reduce heat to medium and cook covered for another 5 minutes. Turn out on plate and cut into 3 squares.

title: Homemade Honey Potato Latties
ingredients: 2 cups hash brown potatoes | 1 1/4 cups unsalted cashews | 1 1/4 cups unsalted dry roasted cashews, coarsely chopped | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup low-fat honey
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Spread hash brown potatoes on large rimmed baking sheet lined with foil and bake in middle of oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender and light golden brown. Let cool until manageable, about 20 minutes. When cooled, cut into 2 thick slices. In large bowl combine chopped cashews with allspice and stir in yogurt until well blended. Cut cooled hash brown potatoes into 2 inch chunks and transfer them to bowl with yogurt mixture. Stir potato mixture until well blended. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Spread 1/3 cup of potato mixture on each plate and top with 1 tablespoon of nuts and 1 teaspoon of the honey. Fold parchment paper tightly over the tops and cut steam vents on the top of tb. Bake in preheated oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: white onion,kosher salt black pepper,dark rum,broth,thai peanut sauce,taco seasoning
title: Homemade Taco Meat
ingredients: 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | kosher salt and black pepper | 1 1/2 cups store-bought broth | kosher salt and black pepper | 1 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons thai peanut sauce | 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in warm water for at least 30 minutes to help remove excess salt. In a saucepan over medium heat, saute onions with ½ teaspoons salt until translucent. Season with pepper and remove from heat. Allow to cool for 15 minutes. Combine the broth with remaining ½ teaspoons salt in a saucepan. Place over high heat.

title: Spicy Beef Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin, thinly sliced and cut into 2 inch matchsticks | 1 ounce noodle, broken in half crosswise | 2 tablespoons oysters, shucked, drained, and quartered | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, minced
instructions: Put the beef into a deep frying pan or wok. Add the water, bring to a boil over high heat, and boil 1 minute. Drop in the noodles and let cook until tender but still firm. Drain on paper towels. In a small bowl, dissolve the bbq seasoning with the chili powder. Stir into the beef mixture and let cook 3 - 4 minutes over high heat or until hot but not boiling. Serve in a wide, shallow bowl sprinkled with minced cilantro.

title: Poppy Seed Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup poppy seed | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup oregano | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Place poppy seeds, cranberries and oregano in a small bowl. Stir in vodka. Add enough to make a sticky paste.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,butternut squash,deli roast beef,extra virgin olive oil,baguette,creamy peanut butter,bean sprout,cajun seasoning
title: Beef and Noodle Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb deli roast beef | 1 cup fresh bean sprouts | 1 cup napa or 1 cup green beans, halved | 1 butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup fresh baguette | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter ( or more as needed ) | 2 teaspoons creamed light unsalted butter | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cook the roast beef in 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil, over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until browned and cooked throughout, 5 - 7 minutes. Slice the roast beef and vegetables into thin strips and set aside. Seed the squash and cut into 1 cubes. Toast the baguette and cut onto 12 slices. Heat 2 teaspoons of peanut butter in a skillet over medium heat, until hot but not browned. Add the cajun seasoning. Cut the baguette into small pieces and dip each piece in the butter mixture before turning over, adding more butter mixture. Place on a serving plate and top with the roast beef and vegetables, sprouts, and the baguette pieces. Serve warm.

title: Almond Barley Broth (Creamy Barley and Barley Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( yellow ) | 3 cups hot chicken stock | 4 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Wash and pick over barley, wash under running water, and drain. Place barley and rice in medium saucepan with boiling stock. Cover and simmer over low heat until barley is tender, about 30 minutes. Transfer barley to food processor or blender. Add almond extract and puree until coarse meal consistency. Pass soup through a fine mesh sieve or sieve to remove all particles.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,ham steak,asparagus,allspice,dark chocolate,salmon fillet,graham cracker
title: Barbecue Asparagus & Salmon Mixturri
ingredients: 4 large salmon fillets | 4 ham steaks | 24 asparagus, tips only | 1 ounce soft dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 teaspoons of grated fresh rind of an orange or 2 teaspoons candied ginger | 6 inches graham crackers, crushed
instructions: Remove salmon, ham & asparagus tips & place on grill over medium heat until golden brown & tender. Remove and cover with foil. Combine the chocolate, allspice, peel & grated orange or candied ginger in a heat proof bowl. Dip roasting pan & grill asparagus pieces on the hot side until golden brown & tender. Add to the chocolate & ginger mixture & stir to combine. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,brandy,ghee,greek yogurt,picante sauce,ice,green chili salsa,red potato
title: Pumpkin-Ghee Chilaquiles With a Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 200 g fresh red potatoes, cut into 1cm cubes, soaked in cold water for 30 minutes and drained | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon ghee | 1 tablespoon brandy | 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | 4 tablespoons sweet green chili salsa | crushed ice | 1 tablespoon crushed picante sauce or 1 tablespoon salsa | 2 -3 tablespoons crushed ice
instructions: Drain the potatoes in a colander until they are dry. Heat the ghee in a frying pan on medium heat until hot. Add the potato and fry, stirring frequently for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden. Add the brandy and cook for 30 seconds. Add the pumpkin puree to the fried potatoes and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring regularly. Remove from heat, stir in the yoghurt and salsa, and serve accompanied by the crushed ice.

title: Easy Chipped Chilies
ingredients: 4 -5 chilies | 100 g chopped nuts | 3 -4 tablespoons brewed coffee | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In saucepan cover chilies with water. Bring to boil and simmer for 2 - 3 mins. Take from heat and let it stand for 5 mins. Place chopped nuts in blender, add coffee and vanilla, then blend until smooth. Strain chilis and set aside. This can be prepared in the oven or deep fryer, i do mine in batches in a non stick pan. Drain excess water if needed, put chilis on greased platter and dot each with a little melted butter.

title: Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 kg portabella mushroom | 1 1/2 cups sultanas
instructions: Wash the mushrooms and cut off stems. Place in a large pot and pour in enough water so that they are fully submerged. Bring to the boil and boil for a few minutes, then drain well and place back in pot. Let sit in the water for 2 hours. Drain off water. Place mushrooms in a baking dish, and spoon on any remaining liquid from the pan, and set oven to 400°f. When the mushrooms bake for an hour, turn the grill off. Spoon onto serving platter and sprinkle with sultanas.

title: Tomato Based Balsamic Sauce
ingredients: 450 ml tomato juice | 6 garlic cloves | 250 ml sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf
instructions: In a blender combine tomatoes, garlic and half sunflower oil, puree until smooth. Add other half of oil, golden syrup and salt to taste. Stir well and chill in fridge. Serve chilled over pasta.

title: Garlic Caesar Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup creamy caesar salad dressing | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk all remaining ingredients together. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Italian Vanilla Dressing
ingredients: 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar. Shake well before using. Store in refrigerator.

title: Scotch Broiled Spareribs
ingredients: 6 ounces country style spareribs | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup chopped red onion | 1/2 cup diced red onion | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped chopped onion salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarsely chopped fresh coarse ground black pepper | 1/4 cup warm dry crushed unprepared macaroni
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place ribs on rack of broiler pan about 2 inches apart. Broil 3 to 5 inches from heat 10 minutes, turning frequently, until no longer pink, 12 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine horseradish, 1/4 cup onion, 1/2 cup onion salt, pepper and remaining 1/4 cup onion salt and 1/4 cup onion salt. Spread horseradish mixture evenly over ribs and broil until lightly browned, 2 to 5 minutes. Serve ribs and onion mixture sprinkled on top of hot macaroni.

title: Veal "Bubble over Wings
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs veal, cut up into large cubes | 2 slices pork belly ( fat removed ) | 4 cracked black peppercorns ( cracked ) | 4 tablespoons margarine, softened
instructions: Wash veal and trim most of the excess fat. Cut into 4 parts, using a meat tenderizer and flatten with meat mallet to 1/4 inch thickness. Dry rub out any bruised or bruised peppercorns. Make layers with the meat and vegetables. Place in a shallow baking pan and cover with a double layer of oil. Cover with plastic wrap and store in the fridge. It will keep for about 4 days.

title: Pasta With Avocado and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup cracked ice | 1 cup grape tomatoes or 1 cup cherry tomatoes | 2 ripe avocados, peeled, pitted and sliced thin | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon paprika | 2 tablespoons toasted slivered almonds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon shredded arugula or 1 tablespoon bibb lettuce
instructions: Pour quinoa into a medium sized bowl, cover with the ice and let stand until completely cooled, at least a few hours. Place quinoa, tomatoes, avocados and breadcrumbs in a food processor and process until smooth. Add paprika and almonds and process until well mixed and well blended. Add quinoa to pasta and stir to combine.. Transfer pasta to a large flat, shallow serving dish. Garnish with fresh sprigs of arugula and serve at once.

title: Korean Chili Pork
ingredients: 5 lbs pork shoulder or 5 lbs beef shoulder, fat trimmed and cut into large pieces
instructions: Make a deep cut in the fat about 1/4 inch deep. Arrange the meat evenly in one layer in a large, heavy skillet. Brown the meat quickly over high heat on all sides, then set aside. Add additional oil as necessary in the skillet. Reduce heat after it is very dark and bubbly, so as to brown only a little, while, and stir constantly to prevent scorching. The meat may then be sprinkled with a little brown sugar. When all meat in the skillet has been browned, pour off excess fat and pour over the pork. You should have a thick, dark colored pork roast. Place a rack in the baking pan so that it is just below the drip of fat. Place the pan in a cold oven, then heat it to 130 degrees f. You may also place your oven on the middle rack. It may be necessary to add a little bit of water to prevent getting temperature down. This is quite a rich slab, so if you want, place the slab in a large disposable baking mold and put a large baking plate upside down on top. Bake the slab for about 45 minutes and remove it from oven. When it has cooled, remove the strings and shred the meat using two forks. You may also use some of the fat in the pork to cook in, or you may use some of the pork fat for other dishes such as stir frying. If you want a creamier sauce, heat up the leftover fat or liquid in the skillet. Serve with korean sweet sticky rice.

title: Quick 'Southern-Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 10 large shrimp | 1 cup spicy hot v8, enough to cover chicken, but not overpowering
instructions: Clean and pat dry chicken inside and out. Cut up any feathers with a cleaver.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,red pepper flake,phyllo pastry,salsa,currant,plain yogurt,tomato
title: Veggie Samosas
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/4 cup salsa ( mild or medium ) | 0.5 can tomatoes, chopped and seeded | 1/8 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon dried currants | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray a 9x9, or similar sized baking dish with cooking spray. Mix the yogurt and sour cream together. Set aside. Add salsa, tomatoes, red chili flakes and currants to bowl and mix well. Spread approximately 2 tbsp of mixture over each phyllo pastry sheet. Carefully fold down the phyllo pastry on the top. Coat the pastry with a nonstick cooking oil spray, place on a baking sheet, and bake in the oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown. Let cool on a wire rack. Slice crosswise and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: french bread,chinese five spice powder,mexican fajita seasoning mix
title: Crispy Chinese Fajita Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mexican fajita seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Cut french bread lengthwise.

title: Mango Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango juice | 2 1/2 ounces mozzarella cheese
instructions: Pour 1/4 cup of the mango juice through a strainer into a medium size bowl. Stir in the mozzarella cheese. Heat a non stick griddle or frying pan over medium high heat. Place the skillet on the pan. Add the remaining mango juice. When it starts to boil, lift the pan and let it heat until the bubbles disappear. Spread 1/4 of the mango cheese mixture onto one side of the hot griddle. Spread with the remaining cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,cornstarch,sunflower seed,oyster sauce,creamy peanut butter
title: Super Easy and Easy Oriental Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 250 ml creamy peanut butter | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon mild vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce
instructions: Boil 1/2 cup of water. While it's boiling mix together all other ingredients. Once that's done, let the mixture cool down completely. Mix it all together and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,baking chocolate,shallot,vegetable oil cooking spray,pomegranate seed,italian bread,baby pea,bacon
title: Chocloaf With Pomegranate Seeds
ingredients: 3 ounces bacon, chopped | 1 shallot, minced | 2 packages baby peas, fresh if possible ( drained canned is best if you can find them ) | 4 ounces baking chocolate, roughly chopped | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 loaf italian bread, crusts trimmed and sliced into 1/2 thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place bacon and minced shallot in a medium sized skillet, over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned. Stir in pea's, breaking them into small bits as they cook, until most of the liquid evaporates. Add chocolate and cook until melted and smooth and no longer grainy. Spread mixture evenly into a loaf pan. Spray pomegranate seeds on toast and toast until lightly toasted, but not brown. Let stand about 5 minutes on rack. Spoon hot chocloaf evenly over toast, smooth top. Sprinkle with vanilla essence, if desired.. Cut crosswise into 1/2 thick slices.

title: Rice Egg Roll
ingredients: 12 egg roll wrappers ( thawed if frozen ) | 1/2 cup long grain white rice or 1/2 cup brown rice | 20 egg roll wrappers ( or use 1 package of each )
instructions: Mix rice with egg roll wrappers, folding them in thirds to make 12 long strips. Dip into egg wash, then roll around the strips of wrapper, letting them fall out of the wrapper to make a roll shape. In a steamer place the rolls in a steamer basket over boiling water, cover and steam for 20 minutes with the lid slightly ajar. Serve with sour cream and sweetened condensed milk. Tips, if you're worried about fat, cook only a small amount of rice and not too much.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,lard,pepper,ice water,lemon juice zest,asiago cheese
title: Aegean Cheese
ingredients: 6 1/2 lbs feta cheese, crumbled | 3/4 cup fresh lemon juice and zest, grated | 6 ounces asiago cheese, grated or 1 1/2 cups parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 cup lard, melted | pepper | ice water
instructions: In a large bowl, mash feta with a mixer fitted with the paddle attachment until it resembles fine crumbs. Stir in zest, half of cheese, and half of melted lard. Stir in pepper and remaining cheese. Place ice water on the countertop until it starts to float, then stir again. Transfer mixture to a marble size loaf pan or a large glass dome shaped baking dish with a rim. Place in the freezer. Let set until it has hardened, about an hour or so, then cut into slices 3/8 to 1 inch thick. Serve at room temperature.

title: Basic Sea Salt for Beef
ingredients: 1 cup fine sea salt | 1 stalk celery ( about 4 stalks ) | 2 teaspoons fine sea salt
instructions: For the finest results, soak the celery in cold water for 4 hours at room temperature or in slightly cold water. Use a vegetable peeler and carefully remove the celery.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,whipping cream,french bread cube,fruit,white miso,italian plum tomato,vodka
title: Spinach, Tomato and Miso Soup
ingredients: 1 cup frozen baby spinach | 7 ounces white miso | 4 ounces baby portabella mushrooms or 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, chopped | 8 ounces italian plum tomatoes | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1 french bread cube
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions, remove and chop if it are dry drain. In a saucepan, heat mushroom, vodka and cream then simmer about 5 - 10 minutes. Add cooked spinach and miso, mix thoroughly and simmer about 3 - 5 minutes. Spoon in french bread cubes and top with croutons.

title: Cranberry Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 lb suet | 3/4 cup dried currant | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Mix together. Pour over brownies and let set in refrigerator for 2 hours or more. Makes a nice holiday topping for christmas.

title: Brazilian Baked Hot Cocoa
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | sea salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Sift cocoa into a bowl. Season with sea salt and ground black pepper.

title: Roasted Red Wine Veal or Veal Rind
ingredients: 1 lb fresh veal | 1 tablespoon guinness stout | 1 whole chipotle chiles
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Wash the veal. Place the veal in a roasting pan and add the guinness, chipoltes and enough water to almost cover the meat. Roast about 6 hours, basting once or twice.

title: Easy Microwave Trout (No Canuck)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic oil | 1 pound trout, cleaned and head removed | 1 carton heavy whipping cream | 3 large mixed frozen vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Saute trout for 5 minutes per side. Arrange on a casserole dish. Cook on high 3 minutes per side or until lightly browned. Place the flaked trout pieces in a separate baking dish. Mix together cream and vegetables in microwave proof bowl. Stir to blend. Pour over fish. Cover, and cook on high for 30 minutes.
