title: Chocolate and Hazelnut Crusted Vine Leaves
ingredients: 3 cups packed fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon whiskey | 2 teaspoons mayonnaise | 1 head cabbage, cored and finely diced | 1/2 cup heinz chili without beans | 8 toothpicks | 1 teaspoon scotch whisky
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toast hazelnuts in a small skillet until toasted and aromatic, about 3 minutes. Mix hazelnuts, 1/2 cup whiskey, mayonnaise, cabbage, chili and hazelnuts in a bowl. Transfer mixture to an oven safe skillet.

title: Peppersaber (BBQ)
ingredients: 2 pints light beer | 150 ml gold syrup, warmed | 1 yellow pepper, sliced | 1 sweet red peppers or 1 yellow pepper, sliced | 120 g fresh raspberries or 120 g frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Pour the beer into a large saucepan and bring to a boil, reducing the heat and simmering for 2 minutes. Add in the melted honey, and simmer for a further 30 seconds or until it has reduced slightly. Add the sliced sweet pepper, red&pols& grandmarnier, and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Homemade Borracha Sauce
ingredients: 1 whole anaheim chilies or 2 pasilla chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Rinse a dry, very hot chile and remove stem and seeds. Wash and dry chile. Place chile on a cutting board and slice diagonally with a very sharp knife, or in a food processor. The skin should look like a thin film. Place chile in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until the chile is tender and easily removed from the skin. Do not let the water touch chile. Drain well. Place chile in a blender or mini chopper. Pulse until desired texture. Strain chile and place in a glass jar and let the excess water drain off. Refrigerate for up to 3 months. Use immediately or store in the refrigerator for up to 4 years.

Random Ingredients: green olive,sun tomato oil,grain rice,clove,curry paste,apricot jam
title: Apricot Curry Rice - 2
ingredients: 2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 cup long grain rice | 8 tablespoons apricot jam ( apricot, plain or your own choice ) | 4 large cloves | 3 ounces green olives
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Line a casserole dish with baking parchment. Into a frypan, heat up the sundried tomatoes with the curry paste, stir to coat the surface and cook for 3 - 4 mins, stirring now and then. Tip in the rice, stir, then stir in the apricot jam. If you want it really sweet, add a little honey to sweeten, or add 1 tblsp honey to sweeten to a sour mixture. Add the whole cloves. Add a ladleful of boiling water, leave for a few seconds, then pour over rice. Cover dish in a roasting tin, bake for about 45 minutes. Take out of the oven, stir well and scatter green olives on top, then bake for a further 5 mins until soft, crisp and slightly browned on top.

title: Lebanese Style Bread (Baked)
ingredients: 1/4 kg pita bread | 3 medium sized green chilies | 1 pinch saffron strand ( i used turmeric powder and black gram powder ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom, powder
instructions: Preheat oven for approximately 30 - 45 minutes. Cut pita bread into medium sizes. Make a slit on one side of each pita. Cut chilies into long strips. Sprinkle a pinch of saffron powder and cardamom powder on the inside of the pita. Using a spoon, stuff the inside of the pita with the green chillies. Dip the stuffed pita in water. Place into the oven. Once cooked, remove from oven and drizzle little oil. Allow to cool. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,beer,mustard seed,demerara sugar,tarragon leaf,black bean sauce,garlic,dark chocolate
title: Devonshire Beer for British Chefs
ingredients: 30 ml dark chocolate, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic | 185 ml beer or 80 ml water | 60 ml black bean sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon demerara sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 170c. Line a 6 hole texas muffin tin with muffin paper. Place 1 tbsp dark chocolate, 1 tbsp mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp cardamom and 1 tsp garlic in a small blender and process until smooth. Combine beer and remaining teaspoon cardamom in a small saucepan. Place over medium high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 mins until very thick and reduced by 3/4 cup, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a large jug and combine with black bean sauce. Add tarragon and sugar and mix well to combine. Remove from heat and chill for an hour or two before serving. Remove the cheeses from the pan and place on a serving plate.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,maple syrup,cucumber,cream chicken soup,plain yogurt
title: Light and Creamy Cucumber Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 package light cream cheese, room temperature | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup plain yogurt ( nonfat ) | 1 cup cucumber, peeled, seeded, and finely chopped ( see note below ) | maple syrup
instructions: Note, this is a thick but creamy vegetable sauce called hummus.

title: Truly Jordanian Favourite, for Beef and Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tahini | 2 teaspoons white vinegar
instructions: Mix tahini and vinegar together and add a touch of juice from the jar. Serve on a serving dish with other dishes as a dip.

title: Tikka Cabbage and Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( homemade or bought ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, powder
instructions: Wash and cut cabbage into 2cm lenghts. Place into a pot of boiling water and boil for 2 - 3 mins, then drain. While cabbage is still hot, add the curry paste and cardamom powder and combine well.

title: Celtic Chillies - Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 3 ounces plain chocolate | 2 teaspoons ground mustard | 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( lightly crushed ) | 1 red chilies ( finely chopped ) | 2 cucumbers ( very finely chopped ) | 12 ounces scallops | glace cherries ( to serve )
instructions: Break the chocolate into pieces. Place it in a non metal, shallow dish, and stir through the mustard and coriander seeds.

Random Ingredients: season salt,spinach leaf,red chilies,ham,chicken thigh fillet,self raising flour,yellow pepper
title: Battered Chicken
ingredients: 2 large brown chicken thigh fillets, trimmed and cut into strips ( skin on ) | 1 can chopped red chilies | 3 1/2 ounces self raising flour | 2 ounces baby ham, cut into chunks | 2 ounces roasted yellow peppers, cut into strips | 2 ounces cooked spinach leaves, chopped
instructions: First mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Place chicken strips into an oven proof dish or roasting tin in a single layer. Spoon mixture over chicken and bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour. Serve with steamed vegetables.

title: Steamed Mussels
ingredients: 1 cup ice | 1 lb mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 4 small jicama, peeled and cut into small cubes | 4 cups packed shredded lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine the ice and mussels in a large bowl, then add the jicama, tossing to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate until the mussels open, about 5 minutes. Discard any remaining ice in the bowl. When the mussels are cool enough to handle, carefully remove the beards. Remove the shells from the shells and discard. Transfer the meat and shells to a bamboo steamer. Steam the stock until the chunks of mussel just start to form around the meatballs and the meat just begins to turn opaque. Do not over steam. When the stock is almost done, remove the husks and remove the meatballs and mussels. Scatter the shredded lettuce on a serving platter and drizzle with the sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,feta cheese,egg,raspberry,coconut milk,tomato green chile pepper,celery
title: Beef Pancakes with Fruit and Lemon Ranch-Style Dip
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1/2 pound filet of beef, cut into small chunks | 2 eggs, beaten | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons grated feta cheese | 1/2 cup raspberry | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Lightly oil a skillet or griddle. Cook and stir beef, cooked beef, hot pepper, celery, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, and feta cheese in the hot skillet over medium heat until the beef is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink inside, about 15 minutes. Serve beef mixture in bread rolls with raspberries and coconut milk to scoop on top.

title: Lard-Sunch Party Bites
ingredients: 1 bag frozen hot dog rolls | 6 slices provolone cheese | 1 jar lard, or to taste
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Wearing gloves, place the frozen hot dogs into a pan of hot water. Remove from the water, and place on a baking sheet, and freeze until firm. Remove the hot dogs the day before serving, and place the rolls and provolone cheese into two greased 9x13 inch baking dishes. Cut the hot dogs into 1 inch pieces, and place on top of the cheese in the prepared pans. In a small bowl, place the lard, or enough to create a dipping sauce for dipping, or with a basting brush, for dipping, and coat each hot dog piece.

title: Dandelion Cake III
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare the cake mix according to package directions. Remove from heat and stir in the white pepper. Pour into a 9 inch springform pan. Trim the top of the cake and cut a slit in the center with a knife or scissors to vent the steam. This will make the inside of the springform. Place the cake on an oven safe serving dish or baking sheet. Pour in the hot white pepper and water mixture to cover the top of the cake. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 bunch coleslaw mix | 1 pinch ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken breasts, artichoke hearts, and coleslaw mix into a slow cooker. Season to taste with mace before cooking, about 30 minutes.

title: South West Salsa Dip
ingredients: 2 cups chunky salsa ( i prefer pace medium, but any medium-hot salsa is fine ) | sea salt | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile ( to taste ) | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°. Combine salsa, sea salt, and ancho. Coat ancho chili with cooking spray. Place on baking sheet. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until heated throughout. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Crock Pot Indian Inspired Yummilicious
ingredients: 1 cooking onion, chopped | 1 roma tomato, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ajwain | 1/2 cup cooked brown rice
instructions: Put onions, roma tomato and ajwain into crock pot. Pour in rice. Top with olive oil/greaseproof oil. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high until hot.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,worcestershire sauce,basil leaf,chili oil,vinegar,red capsicum
title: Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces kidney beans | 1 red capsicum | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 3 basil leaves
instructions: Tip all ingredients into a pan and gently cook until the beans become soft. Stir through the dressing and serve.

Random Ingredients: ice water,cashew,wonton wrapper,carrot,italian flat leaf parsley,italian herb seasoning
title: Delicious Cashew Ravioli
ingredients: 12 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup cashews, chopped | 1 carrot, finely grated | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian herbs seasoning | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian flat leaf parsley | 1 1/2 cups ice water ( about 12 cups )
instructions: Place wonton wrappers on a dry towel and moisten it lightly with a touch of water. Place about 1 tablespoonful of cashews in the center of each won ton wrapper. Sprinkle carrot with italian herb seasoning. Starting at one end, bring remaining 1/4 inch up the sides of the wrapper, and pinch the sides together with your finger to seal. Repeat process two more times until the wrapper is filled and the filling is used up. Transfer the won tons to a baking sheet. Bake at 425ºf for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the center of the ravioli is lightly browned and the filling is firm. Drain on paper towels or a rack set over a pan. Serve warm.

title: Banana Pita Bread
ingredients: 2 teaspoons whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 4 small firm bananas, cut into halves lengthwise, then into 1/8-inch slices | 1 pita pocket bread
instructions: Stir together flour and turmeric in medium bowl until well blended. Add bananas.

title: Easy Baked Potato Rounds
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, cut into wedges and skins removed | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place baking sheet with potato wedges into freezer. While potatoes are still warm, toss wedges in a medium bowl with celery salt.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,chocolate,pepper sauce,russet potato,graham cracker crumb,potato,red wine vinegar,bread
title: Cowboy-Style Potato Cakes
ingredients: 1 pound russet potatoes, peeled and finely shredded | 4 potatoes, peeled and shredded | 2 cups dry bread, crumbs | 1 1/2 cups crushed graham cracker crumbs | 2 cups shredded semisweet chocolate | 1 1/2 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, or as desired | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Layer russet potatoes, shredded potatoes, bread crumbs, graham cracker crumbs, chocolate, pinto beans, red wine vinegar, and hot sauce in a large bowl. Place a heaping spoonful of the potato mixture in the center of a graham cracker. Roll the mounds toward the center of the cracker. Transfer the balls to the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp and browned, about 15 minutes. Carefully remove from the sheet to cool on a wire rack. Repeat with remaining potato mixture, using baking sheets and mounds for remaining servings.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,italian turkey sausage link,balsamic vinegar,chili sauce,potato bread farls,yellow cornmeal,stewing beef,garlic salt
title: Crock Pot Italian Turkey Sausages and Potato Chips
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville & # 174 ; mild italian turkey sausages | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups coarsely shredded potatoes or 1 1/2 cups coarsely shredded russet potatoes | 1 tablespoon chili sauce ( or more ) | 1/2 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | additional chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Using kitchen shears, cut sausages into 1/8 inch slices. Coat the inside of a 4 quart crockpot with cooking spray. Combine cornmeal, potatoes, chili sauce, vinegar, garlic salt, and flour.

title: Easy Low-Fat Spanish Rice (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice ( cook according to package directions, may also use converted rice-see comments for other info ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried onion powder
instructions: Slightly moisten rice cooker bowl.

Random Ingredients: dragee,baking soda,chili pepper flake,macadamia nut,apple cider,rice noodle
title: Macadamia Nuts Chips With Apple Cider
ingredients: 4 ounces rice noodles ( chow mein noodles ) | 2 teaspoons chipotle chili pepper flakes or 2 teaspoons hot chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 3 ounces macadamia nuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon chianti apple cider or 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped chianti eschalendiere or 1 tablespoon vietnamese chives, finely chopped
instructions: Boil water in a large saucepan over high heat until a bead of water skitters across the top, about 2 minutes. Add noodles and boil, 2 - 3 minutes. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the hot water. Stir together chipotle pepper flakes, baking soda, nuts and apple cider until combined. Add noodles and toss to coat. Serve sprinkled with chianti or vietnamese chives.

title: Tamari Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamari ( japanese cooking sherry ) | 1 pinch ground cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Stir tamari and cayenne into mayonnaise. Stir until well combined.

Random Ingredients: grain,beef chuck roast,orange,soy sauce,cheese,farro,garlic butter herb,rice noodle
title: Beef With Noodles (Pad Con Gio)
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast, cut into thin strips | 2 cloves garlic butterhorns ( about 4 teaspoons garlic butter ) | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 12 ounces long grain and wild rice noodles ( about 3 cups uncooked ) | 12 ounces farro ( about 2 cups cooked ) | 1 cup shredded low-fat cheese ( we used low fat sharp cheddar cheese )
instructions: In a large non stick skillet, heat 6 tablespoons butterhorns over medium high heat, and when the first bubbles begin to form, add meat. Stir garlic butter into the drippings. Add soy sauce and orange juice. Stir constantly to avoid burning meat. When the meat is brown, add farro. Reduce heat to medium low. Cover skillet, and let simmer about 10 minutes or until meat is very soft. Stir often towards the end of cooking. When done, stir most of the rice noodles through the meat and stir to break apart any clumps. Serve with remaining sauce. Note, do not use any kind of noodle you might have to use only 4 tablespoons of oil and 1/4 cup of water to cook noodles. The noodles will take longer to cook for their time than the long grain and wild rice noodles we tested.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,mustard powder,spring onion,chickpea,tarragon leaf,chile powder,tomatillo
title: Tomatillo & Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatillos | 10 ounces roasted chickpeas, drained | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon chile powder | 2 tablespoons spring onions, chopped | fresh tarragon leaves, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Wash tomatillos, cut off their peel, and then halve them lengthwise. Using a sharp knife or cleaver, carefully split the tomatillos lengthwise. Scoop out the seeds while they are mostly in the pod. Arrange them side by side on a plate and add the chickpeas and sesame oil. In a small bowl, combine the dry mustard, chili powder, sugar and rosemary leaves, and stir the mixture together until well combined. Pour the marinade over the salad and chill for at least half an hour. Serve the salad garnished with tarragon leaves.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,green pepper,bay leaf,heavy whipping cream,nut
title: Frozen Key Lime Juice
ingredients: 1/2 cup green pepper, seeded and diced | 1 bay leaf | 1 inch gingerroot, peeled and minced | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream, chilled | minced nuts
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine green pepper, bay leaf, diced ginger and cream.

title: Beef Salpicon
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup pork stock or 1/2-1 cup beef broth | 2 -3 lbs sirloin tip roast
instructions: Put all ingredients, except the meat, in crock pot, making sure beef is at bottom of crock and meats on top. Cook on low 8 hours. Shred or slice meat, and serve with salsa.

title: Stolen Eggs
ingredients: 6 tablespoons ice water | 3 slices green peppers, thickly sliced | 2 kaffir lime leaves, torn | 6 drops cayenne
instructions: Place the ice cubes into a large mixing bowl, add the sliced pepper and lime leaves. Dip the green pepper into the cold water, and set the green pepper aside. Mash the lime and kaffir lime leaves with a potato masher or fork until they're coarsely chopped. Slowly add the cayenne to taste. This can be eaten immediately, or served cold.

title: Rigatoni With Pistachios and Smoked Tomato
ingredients: 1 lb smoked orecchiette ( rigatoni ) pasta or 1 lb italian pastrami, fresh from the market | 6 -8 garlic-flavored vodka ( not flavored ) | 1 package frozen roma tomatoes, thawed with | pistachios, chopped | 2 lbs peeled cubed baking potatoes
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. While pasta is boiling, in a large skillet, combine vodka and tomatoes. Drain pasta and tomatoes. Place cooked pasta and tomatoes in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, up to 1 hours.

title: Gorgonzola on the Trees, Asparagus Braise
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 cup red wine ( preferably a cabernet sauvignon or a similar type of inexpensive red wine )
instructions: Rinse asparagus and discard ends or you won't cook all the way through. Cut into 2 inch strips and set aside. In large pot of boiling water, blanch asparagus for 4 minutes, remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper toweling. When cool enough to handle but still slightly underdone, transfer asparagus to colander and run under warm, running water.

Random Ingredients: rhubarb,corn,plum tomato,brown lentil,thai red curry paste,double cream
title: Simple & Delicious Thai Red Lentil Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils, rinsed & dried | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1/2 cup rhubarb, cut into batons | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup mixed vegetables, chopped into small pieces | 250 ml double cream
instructions: In a saucepan, combine lentils & curry paste & bring to the boil. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add rhubarb & tomatoes & cook for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the cream and stir in remaining lentils & vegetables. When the pan starts to boil, stir in cream & reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,grapefruit juice,egg white,black olive,parmesan cheese,self raising flour
title: Grapefruit Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 cup grapeseed oil or 1 cup grapeseed oil | 1 1/2 cups parmesan cheese, grated | 1 1/2 cups fetugreek seeds or 1 1/2 cups mixed seeds | 1 egg white | 1 cup black olives ( or any other mild white )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350°f. Mix the dry ingredients into the bowl of a large electric mixer using the mcrowave setting. Mix in the yoghurt & olives until well combined. Scoop about 1/2 cup of the mixture to cover the base & sides of an 18 1/2 x 5 1/2 in loaf pan. Add the grapefruit slices to the rest of the mixture. Press evenly to get everything in the pan. Use a knife to flatten the top & sides of the bread using the flat side of a knife. Bake bread for 45min 1 hour. Remove from oven & leave to stand for 5min. Cut into 1/2 inch slices & serve.

title: Lobster Stuffed (Or Steamed) Ramekins
ingredients: 1 package graham crackers | 1 can lobster meat, drained
instructions: Place one graham cracker on a tray or in a bowl of cold water, and make sure it fits in the bowl. Sprinkle the top of the crust with 1 teaspoon of lobster meat, or to taste. Place another cracker on top. Using a pastry brush or a vegetable peeler, spread about 1/2 teaspoon of lobster meat on the graham cracker and gently press in. Sprinkle remaining lobster on top and serve right away, or refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs floury potatoes | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Cook the floury potatoes until soft.

title: English Cucumber and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 english cucumbers, sliced | 2 large egg whites | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon tomato puree or 1 -2 teaspoon plum tomato puree, according to taste
instructions: Dry fry cucumbers, in oil if you have them, over low heat until they are limp enough to break easily together. Remove to a plate.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,banana,apricot preserve,tea,white pepper powder,cashew nut
title: Cashew Nut Banana Split Teacakes(Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cashew nuts ( roasted cashews ) | 2 cups fresh apricot preserves ( or any flavor ) | 3 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup strong tea | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper powder | 1/8 teaspoon black lava powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 450°. Spread the cashews in a baking sheet, and toast the nuts in your oven until golden brown, not burnt, about 10 - 12 minutes. Place the nuts in a bowl, and set aside to cool. Beat the egg yolks in a small bowl with a fork, and whisk until fluffy. Slowly add the orange and pumpkin milk, continuing to whisk until the mixture thickens. Add the dark rum, white pepper, and black lava powder, stir to combine and taste for spice. Place the hazelnuts onto a baking sheet, and toast in the oven, for 8 - 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.

title: Fish and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 300 g salmon fillets, skin on, scaled and sliced thin, about 3 slices | 3 cups cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup dates, chopped | 3/4 cup apricot jam | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander | 1/2 tablespoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl and add salt & pepper. Mix salmon into dressing and gently toss in to coat. Marinate in fridge for 20 minutes. Combine fruit, jam & coriander in a medium bowl and mix well. Place salmon on a bed of cabbage and top with fruit mixture. Pour dressing over and toss to coat.

title: Frozen Fresh Mussels
ingredients: 36 mussels, rinsed and beards removed | grand marnier : | strawberry preserves ( your favorite flavor )
instructions: Place the mussels in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cook until the shells open and the mussels open up, about 12 to 20 minutes depending on size. Stir once or twice during cooking. Place a handful of strawberry preserves in each mussel shell and remove from the heat. Serve with your favorite side dish.

title: Spiced Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs eggplants, peeled and cut into 1-inch dice | 1/2 cup water | 1/3 cup lime juice and zest | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Place eggplant in a dutch oven. Add water, cover and simmer over low heat 20 minutes. Bring a large pot of water to boiling. Reduce heat. Add eggplant to boiling water.

title: Ginger-Lavender Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, diced | 1 cup shaoxing wine | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon rum
instructions: Sauté bacon in a large skillet over medium heat. Add shaoxing wine, and ginger paste. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Add heavy cream and rum and simmer until almost all of the cream has reduced. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Liver and Raspberry Roulades
ingredients: 2 ounces beef liver | 1 cup sweet onion, diced | 1 tablespoon finely snipped spring onion | 2 tablespoons frozen raspberries | 2 tablespoons milk
instructions: Pound liver in mortar until flat. Chop onion and place in frying pan with onion and cook until soft. Put in crumb mixture, add raspberries and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Place on plate, sprinkle with spring onions and serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,pepper jack cheese,vanilla pudding mix,french bread
title: Pepper Jack and Jack French Bread Bread Appetizers (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix ( i use jello ) | 8 ounces pepper jack cheese | 1 loaf pepper jack cheese
instructions: Rinse french bread and dry thoroughly. Arrange bread slices in the crockpot including the ends. Spoon in the pudding mix. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours or high for 3 to 4 hours. Spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons of cheese on each slice and dig in.

title: Eggplant and Four Cheese Taquitos
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 can four cheese mexican blend cheese | 1 package corn tortillas
instructions: Place eggplant on a baking dish just large enough to hold tortillas, and bake according to the package directions. When the eggplant is cool enough to touch, peel and cut into 1/3 to 1/2 inch cubes. While that's baking, heat up the four cheese mexican blend cheese. After tortillas are cooked, dip tortillas into the cheese until they are covered in soft, spreadable coating and put into refrigerator until ready to serve. When eggplant is cool enough to touch, peel off the excess coating. I use a cheese grater for this. Cut a circle out of the tortillas, and place them on a cookie sheet spread the 4 cheese cheese in the middle and close with a toothpick. Bake in a 450 degree f oven about 5 minutes, or until the tortillas are crispy. When completely cool, transfer to a cutting board. Remove dough from the refrigerator and cut in half. Scoop out about 1 tablespoon filling per taquito and fill with the mexican blend cheese. Enjoy.

title: Broccolini With Creamy Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 2 bunches broccolini, cut in half, lengthwise | 1 bunch asafoetida powder or 6 -8 leaves green coriander | 1/3 cup sweet corn, fresh | 1/2 cup light coconut cream, whipped | 2 sheets nori, seaweed pocked | golden raisin, if desired | decorative edible garnish ( optional )
instructions: Mix together corn, asafoetida and coconut cream until smooth. Cut the coriander and the green top from the green stalk into small ribbons, removing only the stem and all the fuzzy bit inside. Cut the coriander and green stalk into fine ribbons again, chopping off the stem and all the fuzzy bit inside. Set aside. Brush broccolini on both sides with oil and place on the broccolini. Heat a wok over high heat until it is very hot. When hot, add 1 tablespoons of oil. When oil begins to smoke, add the corn, asafoetida, and coriander. Stir fry for 3 minutes or until the corn turns deep golden brown and becomes tender. Turn up the heat or add coconut cream, stirring constantly until the cream is reduced by an inch. Pour into a plate and top with coriander ribbons or raisins, if desired.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,green olive,milk,rice wine,artichoke heart,trout,baby carrot,pistachio nut
title: Aartichoke Walnut Rice With Smoked Trout and Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice ( white or white, depending on which you use ) | 1/4 cup wholemeal milk or 1/4 cup water | 3 ounces smoked trout, sliced smoked salmon | 1/2 cup baby carrots, grated coarsely | 1 artichoke heart, sliced ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup green olive, pitted, chopped coarsely | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup roasted pistachio nut, chopped coarsely
instructions: In a large ovenproof bowl, mix all ingredients. Turn onto a piece of greaseproof paper or aluminium foil. Wrap foil around bowl, securing with a loop of foil. Place bowl on a tray or sheet of greaseproof paper and weigh down with something big to weigh it down. Set aside for 4 hours. Turn the rice out onto a board and make a well in the center. Pour rice mixture into well, holding rice firmly, and smooth all the grains together, into the well. Cover rice with another sheet of greaseproof paper and weight down with something big to weigh it down. Set aside for another 45 minutes. On the tenth day check rice for doneness. If not quite done, cover with foil and weigh down again. Repeat for second time. This will check softness and not have mushy rice on outside. Remove rice from dish once it is cool enough to handle without pounding holes through it. Use a fork to gently pull off each grain. To serve, cut away excess rice. Garnish with nuts.

title: Peruvian Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( can use white if you can't find that ) | 2 tablespoons frozen meat, thawed, drained ( i use beef ) | fresh cilantro leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Using a steamer, steam the cauliflower for 5 minutes or until just tender. Add the pepper and cilantro and continue steaming while adding the wine. Continue to steam until peppers are soft and cilantro is wilted. Add the frozen meat. Cook for a couple minutes longer. Transfer to a serving platter or soup plates. Garnish with cilantro leaves.

title: Brown Lentil and Cabbage Fettuccine Noodle Packets
ingredients: 400 g dried fettuccine pasta | 75 g brown lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 1/2 cm piece savoy cabbage, shredded
instructions: Cook fettuccini in a pan of boiling water following packet instructions until just tender. Meanwhile, place lentils in a large saucepan with water to cover. Bring to the boil and cook for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain in a sieve. While fettuccini cooks, steam cabbage over a pan of simmering water for 5 minutes or until just tender. Drain, and return to pan. Bring the pasta and lentil mixture into a boil. Remove from heat. Remove cover, add noodles and cabbage and serve.

title: Roasted Tomato and Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 8 plum tomatoes | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 lbs salmon ( or other white fish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place tomatoes cut side down on a foil lined sheet pan lined with a heavy pan. Sprinkle with pepper flakes and cover with foil. Bake for approximately 1 hr, turning once. Cool. Score tomatoes with a sharp knife in a criss cross pattern.. Place salmon on top of tomatoes and bake approximately 30+ mins.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,coconut,olive oil cooking spray,graham cracker crumb,margarine,fine sea salt
title: BBQ Crumb Bars
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup margarine, diced | 1/2 cup light bbq sauce | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 cup fine sea salt
instructions: Preheat bbq or grill. Spray a nonstick pan with cooking pam, toss with crumbs and coconut. Set pan aside. In a saucepan, melt margarine and bbq sauce over low heat and stir until all of the butter is absorbed. Remove from heat and stir in sea salt. Spread sauce over crumb mixture and press into prepared pan. Refrigerate until chilled. Cut into 20 bars and serve. Note, the crust mixture goes especially well with chicken strips and fries. If barbecues, use a non stick pan for frying or other shapes.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,madeira wine,yukon gold potato,pecorino romano cheese,pizza crust,green cardamom pod
title: Rosti With Madeira Wine and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb medium sized yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks ( about 3 cups ) | 3 tablespoons cream cheese | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 3 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 1 1/4 lbs thickly sliced deli-style pizza crust | 1/4 cup parmesan-romano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Place potato chunks on foil in a single layer. Place on rack in a shallow baking dish. Bake until tender, about 15 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. When cool, transfer potatoes with a slotted spoon to a blender. Blend until smooth. Return mixture to pan. Stir in cream cheese, madeira, and 1 green cardamom pod. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spread potato mixture evenly on pizza crust. Using back of a spoon, spread evenly with cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with remaining cardamom pods. Bake until bread is golden and topping is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,orange zest,cardamom seed,dark sesame oil,grand marnier,yellow cake mix,pasta
title: Curried Yellow Cake
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark sesame oil | 3 cups yellow cake mix | 2 1/2 cups dry instant pasta | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 1/4 cups grand marnier | 1 teaspoon whole cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brush a 9x13 inch glass baking dish with oil. Stir the sesame oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the yellow cake mix, pasta, orange zest, curry powder, orange zest, grand marnier, and cardamom seeds. Pour evenly into the prepared baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes. Cool to room temperature before removing from the pan.

title: Jalapeno Nuts - Snack Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili flakes | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno chile, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a nonstick skillet or wok. Heat over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Using a slotted spoon, remove nut from skillet to a plate. Repeat with remaining nuts, adding more oil as needed.

title: Yum Yum Picky
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 habanero peppers, finely chopped ( or 6-up hot pickles ) | 6 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Dry paste and cut in a diagonal gridle. Chill well before use or they will go rancid.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,ranch dressing mix,pepper,meat,chocolate pudding mix,cavatelli,date,garlic clove
title: Chocolate & Coconut Ravioli & Meat Sauce (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat ( i use extra lean and i leave out any extra fat, see comments ( i've never tried this yet ) | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix ( low sodium ) | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 10 ounces coconut cream | 1 large garlic clove, minced | 1 tablespoon dried dates | 4 ounces cooked shredded meat, thawed | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut cream | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Brown the meat with the garlic in a little olive oil, drain well. Mix all the ingredients together, pour over meat. Put in crock pot on low for 8 - 10 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours. Serve over your favorite meal, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,asafoetida powder,bay leaf,meat,white bean,button mushroom,egg substitute
title: Mushroom Puffs (Aubergine)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white beans, and | 5 ounces frozen button mushrooms ( the good stuff ) or ( 8 ounce ) canned white mushrooms | 2 cups cooked meat, cubed | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( if unavailable, use 1 tbsp cornstarch ) | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons egg substitute ( optional )
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over medium low heat and add 1/2 tsp of cornstarch. Mix until all the cornstarch is absorbed, then whisk in 1/2 cup water until the mixture is clear and thickened. Reduce heat to low and add worcestershire and asafoetida. Add mushrooms and cooked meat.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,lemon,clove,kidney bean,dijon mustard,grand marnier,rice wine vinegar
title: Kidney Bean Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup dry kidney beans | 6 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2/3 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 3/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 3/4 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 lemon, juiced
instructions: Mix the kidney beans, rice wine vinegar, golden raisins, grand marnier, ground cloves, and dijon mustard together in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Spicy Creamy Broiled Squash
ingredients: 1 medium acorn squash | 3 -5 tablespoons heavy cream | 2 -4 tablespoons msg ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Peel the squash and cut in half lengthwise. Slice 1/2 inch thick. In a large casserole dish mix together the cream, msg. Squash, cloves, and salt and pepper to taste. Bake in a moderate oven for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sake,chicken bouillon granule,wasabi,rigatoni pasta,cognac,spinach leaf,lemon peel,italian parsley
title: Asobi Rabe's Pasta
ingredients: 1 bag rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 lemon peel, thinly julienned | 1 tablespoon chopped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped cognac | 1 teaspoon wasabi | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain. In a small bowl, stir together the chicken bouillon and next 5 ingredients. Stir in spinach and cook over medium heat until wilted. Stir in wasabi and bouillon mixture.

Random Ingredients: island dressing,cumin,pork loin chop,parmesan cheese,apple cider,kosher salt
title: Cider Glazed Pork Loin With Parmesan Cumin Crust
ingredients: 6 pork loin chops | 1/4 cup kraft island dressing | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt ( not table salt ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/3 cup kraft parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Prepare a gas or charcoal grill. Trim excess fat from meat.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,italian seasoning,raspberry liqueur,wheat flour,chuck steak,green chilies,turmeric powder
title: Grilled Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup light swiss chard or 1/4 cup chard leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried turmeric powder | 3/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 can diced green chilies | 2 tablespoons raspberry liqueur ( optional ) | roasted pine nuts or chopped almonds, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow dish, stir together the whole wheat flour, chard, turmeric, and italian seasoning. Cut the steak diagonally across the grain in strips about 2 to 3 inches wide and 1 to 1 1/2 inches long. Place the steak in the flour mixture, turning and coating. Cover with lid, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Prepare an outdoor grill for direct heat or a gas grill or heat a broiler. When ready to cook, remove steak from marinade, reserving marinade. Grill steak until rare. Transfer to a cutting board, and cut into 1/2 inch thick slices. Arrange steak on a platter or salad plate. Spoon prepared sauce over and garnish with pine nuts, if desired.

title: Simple Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can crushed tomatoes | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1/4 cup kraft red wine, divided
instructions: Drain all water from tomatoes and add liquid. Bring to a boil, stir in the rest of the sauce ingredients and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve over egg noodles, rice, or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,red wine,yellow pepper,green chilies,egg yolk,chili oil,button mushroom
title: Vietnamese Fish Cakes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine | 2 teaspoons chili oil ( or more to taste ) | 2 green chilies, thinly sliced ( or more if desired ) | 4 eggs | 5 button mushrooms, stems removed, caps cut into 2 x 1/2-inch strips ( optional ) | 1/2 large yellow pepper, seeded and thinly sliced ( optional ) | 1/12 medium red pepper ( optional ) | 4 medium fresh fish fillets, skinned and each cut in half ( can use two small firm-fleshed fish )
instructions: Preheat ove to 400 f. Combine in a small bowl the wine and chili oil. Tear steaming mushrooms into a small bowl, adding in yellow and green peppers and mixing well. Stir into the fish mixture. Add in egg yolks, one at a time, and mix well. Place a 1/4 cup of mixture on waxed paper and roll into 1/2 inch patties. Set on a baking sheet. Repeat with remaining mixture to make 12 patties.

title: Fresh Strawberries (Sukai Namiku)
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, cleaned and thinly sliced | 2 large fresh strawberries, sliced | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 pound fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Place slices of fennel and whole fresh strawberries onto a plate and lightly sprinkle with kaffir lime leaves. Add slices of fresh snow if using.

Random Ingredients: red chili paste,cheese,hot italian sausage,kidney bean,marsala wine,vinegar,pine nut
title: Stuffed Red Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 50 g red chili paste | 100 g sweet italian sausage | 100 g cheese ( mozzarella or provolone ) | 100 ml marsala wine | 100 g pine nuts ( lightly toasted ) | 1 teaspoon garlic | 2 -5 drops vinegar
instructions: Chop and fry the sausage, mix with the rest of the ingredients. Roll the mix on a towel and tie securely with string. Add to your slow cooker. Cook on low for 3 hours. Stuffed red chilies may be eaten as an appetiser with grilled meat and as a side dish with rice and a salad.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,italian plum tomato,topping,broccoli red pepper
title: Italian Beef and Broccoli Dip
ingredients: 1 lb top round beef skirt steak | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 container frozen broccoli, stir fry vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Arrange steak in 11x7 glass baking dish. In medium bowl, combine tomatoes with seasonings. Add beef.

title: Red Pepper Pancakes (Japanese-Style Pancakes)
ingredients: 8 red bell peppers | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/3 cup mirin | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil grate. Slice peppers in half, lengthwise, core and slice lengthwise into thin strips. Set aside. Whisk flour and mirin together in a shallow dish. Place 1/2 cup of the flour mixture into a skillet over medium heat.

title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1 lb kirschwasser | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder ( or a mix of five spice and five flavering spices )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bring a large pot of water to boil and add salt. Turn oven to 325 degrees. Cut a slice off the top and bottom of each potato. Using kitchen shears, trim away the skin and peel away the dark hard part. Place the potatoes in a single layer on the water to cook. While they are cooking, cut the potato skins into 2 inch wide julienne strips and place around the side of the potatoes in a baking dish or roasting pan. Place the kirschwasser, 5 spice powder and 2 teaspoons of the salt in a small bowl. Melt the kirschwasser in the microwave. Use a pastry brush to get most of the kirschwasser off the bottom. Brush it all over the rim of each potato. Sprinkle each potato with some of the reserved spice mixture.. Bake for 30 minutes or until the potatoes are browned at the edges and the potato skins are crisp and tender.

title: Baked Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can bean, undrained | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and cut into cubes - or more as desired ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a shallow baking dish, mix bean, bamboo, and catup. Sprinkle with grand marnier. Bake in the preheated oven 20 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Avocado Barley Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 1 large spaghetti squash | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 avocado, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Remove squash from its skin, but leave enough skin on it to cover it. Place squash and whole head in a pan with enough water to fill it halfway up the side of the squash. Bake 40 minutes until starting to soften, but not mushy. Meanwhile, heat corn oil in a separate pan. When the squash is done, remove it from the oven and place it on a piece of foil. Cover each squash slice with the barley, and top with avocado slices. This is good served with rice or pasta. It can also be topped with sliced avocados.

title: Biscuits
ingredients: 10 chicken tenders | 3/4 cup baking cocoa | 2 cups powdered baking cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to cut chicken tenders in half lengthwise and then across into 5 pieces. Place 1/4 cup of baking cocoa in a wide, shallow dish and microwave on high for 90 seconds. Add one end of chicken and roll to coat with baking cocoa. Put 2 chicken tenders in a single layer inside a single layer bowl. Cover with 1/4 cup of baking cocoa and microwave on high for 90 seconds to make sure sauce is bubbling. Put 2 remaining chicken tenders on a greased baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in 450 degree f oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: french bread,spice,white bread,taco seasoning,pearl onion,cherry,baby carrot
title: Spanish Bread With Sausages
ingredients: 8 slices white bread, toasted | 8 baby carrots, halved | 8 baby onions | 8 slices cherry tomatoes | 4 packages taco seasoning | 8 ounces quick-cooking spices | cracked french bread
instructions: Layer the bread between 2 pieces of waxed paper. Spray each bread slice lightly with non stick cooking spray. Arrange onion slices over the crust and arrange carrots over the top of the bread slices. In a small bowl mix the taco seasoning and the crushed spices. Spoon 1/4 of the spice mixture over the vegetables, then top with 1 or 2 slices of french bread. Top with remaining slices of bread.

title: Broiled Swiss Steak Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 10 slices rib-eye steaks | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange rice onto a baking sheet and spread the vinegar over it. Arrange steaks on the rice, laying them on top of one another. Broil 3 to 5 minutes, then turn over and broil for 3 to 5 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,dark brown sugar,cooking oil,coriander powder,double cream,caper
title: Crispy Barbecue Cane Wedges
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 175 g dark brown sugar ( i use a light brown sugar if possible ) | 175 g drained capers ( with a bit of the liquid content ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 175 -200 ml double cream, to thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius or 180 degrees fahrenheit. Grease a large square baking dish with a little of the oil. Mix all the dry ingredients together in a clean bowl. Dissolve the baking soda in the cream and pour this into the dry ingredients. Stir carefully, so that all the dry ingredients are coated. Mix all the liquids and pour over the dry mix. Stir until well mixed. Turn onto a large sheet of greaseproof paper. Flatten with your hands until thin. Cut wedges out of the wedges, placing them on a baking tray and then placing the tray in the larger oven. Brush with more of the oil on top. Cook in pre heated oven for about 60 minutes or until firm and slightly crispy turning once when you pull them out of the oven, turning them over every 10 minutes. Serve warm as a side dish or for breakfast.

title: Kesra
ingredients: 2 cups yellow onions ( minced ) | 2/3 cup green olives ( minced ) | 6 garlic cloves ( minced ) | 2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Saute onions with salt until translucent and add the green olives. Add ginger and garlic. Cook on medium high heat 30 seconds. Add cayenne pepper and tarragon and stir well. Cook for another 15 - 20 seconds. Let cool and use as required. Enjoy.

title: Rosey Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup fine yellow cornmeal or 1 cup fine yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons sweet unsalted creamy peanut butter | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh orange rind, minced | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh rose water
instructions: Combine the cornmeal and the sweet butter in a bowl, stirring until well blended. Stir in the orange rind. Stir in the rose water. When ready to serve, warm but do not let the mixture boil stir in the hot syrup just before serving. You can add 1/2 teaspoons of maple flavoring if you like.

title: Vegetarian Black Bean and Watermelon Raita
ingredients: 3/4 cup watermelon, diced | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup fat-free plain greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon ginger paste | 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/4 cup fat free plain soymilk | 1/4 cup frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the yogurt, and refrigerate. Let sit 30 minutes to allow flavors to mix. Serve chilled in bowls, over ice cubes or as desired.

title: Pork Chicharrones
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds ground lean pork | 3 1/3 cups rye bread | 2 tablespoons molasses | 4 cans chiles, drained | 1 tablespoon triple sec ( optional ) | 3 italian-style bread cubes
instructions: Place the ground pork in a large pot and pour in enough water to cover. Add rye and brown slowly over medium heat. Remove from heat and let cool. Place the ground pork in another pot and sprinkle the pork with salt. Cook until pork is evenly browned. Drain excess grease and set pork aside. Place two cans of chiles in a blender or food processer and pulse until roughly ground. Mix the ground pork, chilies, triple sec, and italian style bread crumbs together with the browned pork. Place the two cans of pork into a bowl and refrigerate until cool, about 3 hours. Using hands, form the bread mixture into large, flat cakes about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Slice the cakes to serve or place on a serving platter and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: celery,canola oil,milk ricotta cheese,taco seasoning mix,bacon bit,corn kernel
title: Cheesy Taco Bacon Corn Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 0.5 package taco seasoning mix ( i used the old el paso ) | 2 lbs bacon bits ( or use less if desired ) | 1/2 cup chopped celery ( or use green onion ) | 1/2 cup corn kernel ( if desired, i just used whole kernel corn ) | 1 cup canola oil
instructions: Mix up the corn and canola oil in a large bowl and combine well. Add the taco mix and bacon pieces and combine. Add the milk cheese.. Add your taco seasoning. I liked my corn a bit bit salty because i didn't think it would need anything but not necessary. Don't be scared, there are lots of taco seasoning packets and cream. Keep refrigerated when ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,cinnamon,brown lentil,yukon gold potato,bay leaf,beef stew meat,vanilla bean
title: Lentil and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/2 pound brown lentils | 1 1/2 pounds cubed beef stew meat | 1/2 cup brown ( wild, or navy beans ) lentils | 1/2 cup diced yukon gold potato | 1/2 cup diced yukon gold potato | 2 bay leaves | 1/4 cup light cream or milk | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Wash and sort lentils. Place into a large bowl and add enough water to cover. Add enough salt to generously cover and leave a few inches of grayish around the edges. Let stand at room temperature for at least one hour. Drain and rinse. Place beef in a 5 to 6 quart pot over high heat. Pour in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and skim off any foam that rises to the surface. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 1 hour. While beef is cooking, drain lentils and place in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for about another 1 1/2 hours. When beef is nearly tender, add the potatoes and cook for about half an hour. Remove bay leaves and cinnamon. Stir in cream, then remove from heat and stir in drained lentils. Serve stew with bread and cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: filet beef,spinach leaf,ice,thai red chili pepper
title: Spinach and Beef
ingredients: 350 g filet of beef, diced small | 1 -2 thai red chili pepper. ( optional ) | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves | ice, crushed
instructions: Dice beef into matchstick pieces. Pour oil into wok and heat. When hot, add beef and marinate 5 minutes. Add chilies and spinach and stir fry for 1 - 2 minutes. Add crushed ice, bring to a boil and serve.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,sofrito sauce,white bean,egg,bacon dripping,parsley flake
title: French Fried Mushrooms - Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced garlic or 2 tablespoons fresh garlic | 5 teaspoons bacon drippings | 4 cremini mushrooms, sliced ( about 2 lbs. ) | 10 white beans, boiled until tender, then drained and cooked ( optional ) | 1/3 cup sofrito sauce | 1 large egg, beaten until frothy | 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley flakes
instructions: In a heavy skillet, add mushrooms and drippings. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon. Add the sofrito. Stir occasionally. When the mixture thickens, remove skillet from the heat. In a large bowl, add the egg, parsley and fried mushrooms. Stir until well mixed. Spoon the mixture into a warm serving platter and serve.

title: Brioche With Caraway Peanuts
ingredients: 450 g brioche, fresh | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 250 g dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 3 teaspoons brewer's yeast
instructions: The day before baking mix the caraway seeds in a small frying pan. Remove from the heat and set aside. Leave for 2 hours in a warm place. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Line two baking trays with baking paper. Place the brioche in a large bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap and set aside to allow to prove until it has doubled in size. When it has doubled in size and doubled again, divide this into 4 equal portions. Stuff the peanuts with this, then sprinkle with the yeast and then knead the hands by hand or with your hands until the dough comes together. Divide the dough into 12 pieces and roll each piece into an oval shape. Place on the baking trays. Cover the trays with cling film and set aside to rise in a warm place for 40 minutes. Remove the plastic wrap and bake in the oven on the middle shelf until the bread is golden and crispy.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,velveeta cheese,yukon gold potato,strawberry,vegetable oil cooking spray,vegetable stock
title: Mashed Potatoes With Strawberry-Pistachio Dip
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb yukon gold potato or 1 lb yukon gold potato, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 cup vegetable stock | 6 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 cup frozen strawberries, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: In a skillet, coated with cooking spray, cook the potatoes in the hot oil over medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes, until golden. Then add the stock and cook for 1 more minute. Add the velveeta, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Sprinkle in the strawberries and serve warm.

title: Prawn Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 4 ounces green prawns, shelled, deveined, tails on | 7 fluid ounces chicken stock | 4 ounces teapot greens or 4 ounces chinese chives | 1 pinch nutmeg, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan heat the oil until hot but not smoking. Add the prawns, cook, stirring until pink, 1 or 2 minutes. Add the stock and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to simmer and add the teapot greens or chives. Return to the boil and cook for 3 minutes to thicken the soup slightly. Add nutmeg and season to taste.

Random Ingredients: bean,parsnip,spanish onion,vegetable oil cooking spray,peanut butter,bay leaf,brown lentil,garlic
title: Spiced Lentils and Parsnips With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown lentils | 1/3 cup brown spanish onion, minced | 1 clove garlic, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 cup parsnip, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup spanish peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon peanut butter or 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in slow cooker.

title: German Meatballs I
ingredients: 12 ounces lean ground round | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons beef broth | 3 medium green leafy green salad leaves | 1 teaspoon minced fresh dill
instructions: Combine ground round with yolk in a medium mixing bowl and stir to blend. Add beef broth and mix to blend. Cover and refrigerate for an hour or longer. Using a mortar and pestle, mash greens until fine. Drain meat mixture and season with minced dill. Form balls into meatballs and set aside. Heat a nonstick nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add meatballs to hot pan. Sauté until meatballs are deep golden brown, about 4 minutes per side.

title: Upside Down Lamb, Beef Ragu
ingredients: 300 g rigatoni pasta | 300 g beef rump ( cut into small pieces ) | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder ( or a little more ) | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dill | 1 cucumber, halved ( cut in long thin strips )
instructions: Boil and cook rigatoni according to pack instructions. Meanwhile, preheat grill pan and sear meat on both sides about 3 minutes per side. Drain meat and arrange on oven trays with cucumber and tomato.

title: Australian Style Zucchini
ingredients: 8 young zucchini | 1/4 cup cider or 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 cups white rice | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/3 cup whiskey ( to taste ) | 4 slices teabags
instructions: Quarter zucchini lengthwise, cut in half crosswise. Cut crosswise into 2 - 3 thin strips about 9 in long. Place in medium nonstick skillet with water, cover and steam over low heat for 5 minutes or until tender when pierced with a fork. Drain. Whisk cider, salt, whiskey in large bowl. Stir in zucchini, cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir again, divide among plates.

title: Raspberry Onion Jam Filling for Danish Pastry for Danish
ingredients: 4 jars raspberry jam | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Using a pastry brush, paint tops of the raspberries with a little bit of jam. Combine onion powder and additional water to form a thin paste. Use pastry brush to coat other sides of the pastry brush. Carefully open the raspberries and allow them to spread out over the pastry brush. Bake at 370 degrees f until golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,breadcrumb,pepper,salt italian herb seasoning,milk ricotta cheese,italian plum tomato,basil,chicken
title: Beef Burgundy and Parmigiano Reggiano
ingredients: 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 teaspoon salt-free italian herb seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, coarsely chopped | 1 can whole italian plum tomatoes, drained, coarsely chopped | 1 lb chicken, cut in 16 pieces, cut in 8 pieces
instructions: Mix ricotta, bread crumbs, basil, seasonings and beef in a large bowl. Toss with tomatoes and add to meat mix. Press mixture against the sides of the bowl with your hands. Cover and refrigerate the mixture at least 2 hours or up to 6 days.

title: Real Mexican Soda Bread
ingredients: 8 corn tortillas, or more as needed | 12 cups club soda, or more as needed
instructions: Place a few tortillas onto a paper towel. Squeeze paper towels between each to remove excess moisture. Preheat an oven to 200 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut a circle out of the center of each tortilla. Wrap around each circle to make a circle about 1/2 inch thick. Cut each circle into four wedges. Repeat with remaining wedges. Place wedges onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp on the outside, 10 to 20 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees f. Cool bread slices on the baking sheet to room temperature without removing paper towels, about 10 minutes. Use a spatula to cool bread slightly. Serve hot with club soda.

title: Iowa Style Chicken
ingredients: 4 medium corn tortillas | 3 -4 lbs. cooked chicken, torn into pieces | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 -2 cup louisiana-style hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a hot skillet, fry tortillas in butter until crisp, or in skillet on paper towels. Place on paper towel lined baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp, shaking skillet occasionally to remove excess fat. Cool slightly for easy handling. Stir in chicken and onions.

title: Grilled Asparagus and Smoked Hoagies
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed | 6 -8 hoagie rolls
instructions: Wash the asparagus. Trim as much fat away from the stalk that will rise to the top. Slice the tips off the asparagus. Cut into bite sized pieces. Brush on a little more oil and sprinkle the roll with salt. Place in the grill and cook at medium heat for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve drizzled with a little more smoke. The meat should be hot throughout the cooking. The asparagus will still be crisp, and the rolls will be crisp.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,sun tomato oil,sherry,italian parsley,chicken thigh,taco sauce,cardamom seed
title: Crock Pot Spicy Chicken and Rice - Vegan
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 3 cups cooked quinoa ( i use organic ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil ( oil-packed ) | 1/3 cup taco sauce ( i use low-sodium, you may use low-sodium taco seasoning or mild-tab ) | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | freshly ground cardamom seed
instructions: Spray crock pot liner with cooking spray. Pat chicken dry with paper towel. Place chicken thighs in bottom of crock pot.

title: Spinny Beef Tips & Tofu (Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1 package soft tofu, cut into 1 cubes | 1/2 cup prepared low-fat beef gravy | 1/4 cup sherry wine ( or red ) | 1 bag baby spinach ( or 6 cups baby spinach, cleaned and dried ) | 1/4 cup prepared low-fat prepared mix ( low fat sour spinach, low fat )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9×13 casserole dish with non stick cooking spray, combine beef, gravy and sherry in a large nonstick skillet. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 2 to 3 minutes. Add tofu and stir until warmed and slightly browned. Stir in spinach. Transfer to casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through and stir in sweet potato. Serve immediately.

title: Ginger Wine - Sangria
ingredients: 16 ounces ginger wine ( this is at least the size of your bottle ) | 1 large green onion, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla sugar, plus more to serve
instructions: Pour the ginger wine into a large, narrow glass or ceramic jar. Add the green onion and stir well to coat the green onion. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the mixture is beginning to thicken, but the liquid has not reduced, about 15 minutes. Remove the lid, increase the heat and simmer, stirring often, until the fragrant liquid is reduced by half. Transfer the wine to the jar with the ginger and sugar. Let cool completely. Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,grain white rice,turkey breakfast sausage,tomato juice,vegan butter
title: Ww Low Fat Balsamic Sausage & Rice
ingredients: 1 package vegan buttery breakfast sausage | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 21 ounces long grain white rice, cooked | 2 1/2 cups vegetarian butter
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Drain fat from sausage and discard. In a large frying pan, sautee the cooked sausage over medium high heat. Remove from the heat when sausage is cooked. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked meat, balsamic vinegar, tomato juice and rice. Stir to combine ingredients. Spoon into 4 cup ramekins or 1 inch diameter containers and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight so flavors can blend. Bake at 375 for 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Miniature Pecorino Cheesecakes
ingredients: 18 miniature marshmallows | 1/2 cup pecorino cheese, shaved or 1/2 cup pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Stir marshmallows and cheese together until blended. Shape into 24 little mini cakes. Cut each cake crosswise into 48 thin wheels. Set on baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white corn,hazelnut,active yeast,thyme leaf,vegetable broth,red potato,fettuccine
title: Roasted Vegetables in Fettuccine With Creamy Hazelnut-Harvest Herb Bread
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup dried thyme leaves | 8 medium red potatoes, sliced thin | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 6 large fettuccine | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped hazelnuts | 3/4 cup white corn or 3/4 cup brown squash kernels, drained
instructions: Make the vegetable broth by pouring 2 cups of fresh vegetables into a saucepan and add water to cover vegetables about two inches above the vegetables. Cover and heat at least 5 minutes or until the vegetables are just about tender. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Sprinkle potatoes with salt and let sit 20 minutes. In a large roasting pan, toss vegetables with the yeast mixture and 1/2 cup of broth. Scatter the thyme over the vegetables and roast in a 400 °f oven until the potatoes are tender and crisp and the top becomes golden, about 40 to 45 minutes. Remove potatoes from the oven, toss with the remaining broth and season with salt and pepper to taste. When potatoes are cool enough that they can be handled, remove the skins. Cut the potatoes into 1 inch cubes and toss with the remaining broth. Cook squash on grill, covered over high heat until tender. Toss in the hazelnuts and cool 10 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl and stir to blend. Spoon the bread onto a serving platter. Spoon the vegetables on top and drizzle with any remaining broth.

title: Khatti Masala (Potatoes With Asafetida)
ingredients: 300 g whole potatoes | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 -2 tablespoon canola oil | 1/4 cucumber, washed and thinly sliced
instructions: Cut the khatti in pieces about 2 by 1 inch. Heat oil in a wok on medium flame. When it's hot, add the khatti pieces. Saute for 1 minute. Then, add the diced cucumber and fry on medium heat for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat. Allow to cool down slightly. Remove the outer leaves of the khatti. Garnish with corriander leaves. Keep aside. Now, place the boiled potatoes in a bowl. Pour the oil and mix well. Add a little water. Mix well till it's just right. Make sure that the potatoes are coated with the oil. Refrigerate the potatoes sometime until required to serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,savory,chorizo sausage,sugar,shrimp paste,self rising flour,provolone cheese,apple
title: Mexicana Delights
ingredients: 1 lb chorizo sausage, bulk ( about 5 links ) | 1 1/2 lbs shrimp paste | 4 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese ( i use shredded sharp cheddar mexican blend ) | 2 tablespoons dried thyme | 2 tablespoons savory | 4 ounces provolone cheese, sliced thin ( use a colby-jack cheese )
instructions: In a skillet, remove the casing from the chorizo sausage.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,spinach,white vermouth,heavy whipping cream,eggplant
title: Sopa De Verde (Stir-Fried Chicken and Eggplant)
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, sliced diagonally | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch strips | 1/2 cup white vermouth | 2 quarts heavy whipping cream | 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed
instructions: Place eggplant slices into a skillet with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: nectarine,parsley leaf,honey,cayenne pepper,mexican corn,red potato,purpose flour
title: Spicy Corn and Nectarine Potatoes
ingredients: 24 small red potatoes, scrubbed | 1/4 cup honey | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cups fresh parsley leaves | 1 1/2 cups frozen mexicorn | 2 medium nectarines, sliced
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cook potatoes in boiling water 5 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain, cool, and cut in half lengthwise and scoop out potatoes into large bite size pieces. In a medium bowl, mix honey, flour and cayenne pepper. Add the parsley, nectarines, and potatoes. Spoon over nectarine mixture, toss, and serve.

title: Litchi Rhubarb Mousse
ingredients: 3 cups rhubarb, chopped ( about 1kg ) | 2 tablespoons stevia | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup honey | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Place the rhubarb in a medium bowl & add 2 tblsp boiling water. Cover tightly & set aside for 30 minutes so the rhubarb does not soften. Remove the rhubaroli from the water, & discard water. Place the rhubarb in a food processor, then add 2 tblsp stevia & process until smooth. Stir into the rhubarb & chill under refrigeration till mixture thickens, about 10 minutes. Line serving dish w/honey mint leaves + the tomato halves. Spoon chilled rhubarb mixture into the dish & serve. Enjoy.

title: Italian Herb Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts or 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs | 1/3 cup packed fresh basil | 1 tablespoon ground sage | 1 can college inn fat-free reduced-sodium chicken broth
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes or small pieces and toss in a large bowl with the basil and sage. Add the broth and mix well. Let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: German Sauerkraut (Baked) Penne or Beef Noodle
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut | 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 8 ounces whole wheat penne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Bring a large pot of water to boil and add a little salt. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine sauerkraut, astrich sauce, and cornstarch.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,margarita mix
title: Easy Moroccan Quesadillas (Shalmi)
ingredients: 1 packet saffron instant pistaqah mix ( store bought or home made ) | 1 package margarita mix ( store bought or home made )
instructions: Prepare the saffron instant mix. Combine saffron & pistakija mix well & set aside. Take your margarita mix & cut into small chunks. Dip the bottom & side of a large, heavy skillet into the drained saffron/ pista mixture. Heat the skillet over medium heat until the bottom is getting a nice dark orange color. Once the bottom is nice & nice & brown, put the margarita mix in for a minute or two before putting it in the pan. Turn down the heat to low & cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until the bottom is a toasty color. Using a spatula, turn the tortilla over & cook the second side until it is brown.

title: Spicy Chile Pepper Salsa
ingredients: 2 ounces diced green chile peppers | 2 ounces hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped canned onion
instructions: Mix chilies and hot pepper sauce together in a bowl. Add onion to the bowl and toss to blend. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Spicy Pea Soup
ingredients: 3 -4 cups leftover peas | 2 large white onions ( or one large ) | 2 -3 tablespoons white flour | 4 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 -3 tablespoons seasoning ( any, your favorite, i will try 3 tablespoons ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper
instructions: If cooking for company, cook the peas whole until they are clear in a small pot. Peel and slice the onions. Combine in food processor or with immersion blender with 2 - 3 cups of water. Blend until smooth. If mixture is too thick for your taste, add more water. If too dry, just add a little water or more cornstarch, and continue to blend. Add seasonings. Add veggies, cooking just until onions are golden brown. Add remaining 6 cups of water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. I normally add a little cornstarch at a time to make my soup thinner. It should be thick and creamy. If not, just add a wee bit of water, and adjust seasoning. If the soup becomes too thick for your taste, just add a little more water or cornstarch. Enjoy.

title: Moroccan Tilapia on a Bed of Crunchy Yoghurt
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 100 g nonfat plain yogurt | 1/2 bunch coriander leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Cut each fillet into 6 pieces, removing the bones first. Take two tablespoons of yogurt, one tablespoon at a time, and mix thoroughly. Spread it evenly all over each fillet. Sprinkle with coriander, stir well and eat.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,strawberry,chipotle chile,liquid smoke,balsamic vinegar,breadcrumb cake crumb,rosemary leaf
title: Crunchy Chipotle Strawberry-Herb Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh rosemary leaves, minced or 2 tablespoons dried | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile, minced | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 -2 cup dried breadcrumbs, coarsely crushed ( italian-seasoned or fresh ) | 1 cup fresh strawberry, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 3 tablespoons rice wine ( preferably cooking sake )
instructions: In a food processor, blend the mint or chiles and remaining ingredients till smooth. Cover and refrigerate the sauce. Serve with toasted bread, crackers or other fresh bread. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mustard oil,devil food cake mix,frying chicken,pastry crust pie,green bean
title: German Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 package devil's food cake mix | 2 cups frying chicken | 2 tablespoons dry mustard oil | 2 cans green beans, drained | 1 package pastry for a double crust pie
instructions: Preheat oven to mix devil's food cake mix, chicken and dry mustard. Put small amount of vegetable oil in a deep skillet and drop into the pan. The oil is hot enough when the pancake mix rises to the top. Drop dough into hot oil. Cook two pancakes at a time for 5 minutes on each side, until golden brown. Place cooked side on a plate lined with wax paper. Slice open one side of the unbaked pie and spread mustard inside, then place a baked potato inside the pie. Spread green beans onto the pastry. Top with other pie shell in the same manner. Cover and refrigerate at least four hours. The pies can also be baked in a 9x13 inch baking dish with a lid. Bake in a preheated oven until heated through, about 45 minutes.

title: Shanken (Crispy Baked Topped Rice With Peas)
ingredients: 2 slices thick slab bacon | 1 cup yellow split peas, shelled | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup thawed quick-cooking oats
instructions: Arrange bacon in a 9x13x3 inch baking dish. Cut peas diagonally into 1/2 inch slices, leaving 3/4 inch pieces. Using slotted spoon, remove and discard bacon. Arrange peas in a single layer in a shallow baking dish in overlapping rows to cover the bacon. Combine vinegar and sugar in a small bowl, and pour over peas. Cover, and bake at 400 f. For 20 to 25 minutes, or until peas are crisp and lightly browned. Note, you may bake the peas if you prefer. Bake peas uncovered for a few minutes before removing from oven. Remove bacon slices and carefully arrange on a serving platter. Serve warm.

title: Easy and Tasty Bacon Soup
ingredients: 1 liter vegetable stock | 16 slices bacon
instructions: In a large saucepan heat the oil. Fry the bacon until crisp. Add the stock and simmer for 30 mins, stirring often.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,serrano chilies,onion soup mix,coriander powder,lime,cherry tomato
title: Cherry Tomato and Chili Relish
ingredients: 2 red peppers or 2 green peppers, cut into small pieces | 1/2 onion soup mix, powder ( i use 1 envelope ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 packet serrano chilies, minced | 2 tablespoons lime rind, grated ( optional ) | cherry tomatoes, cut into thick slices
instructions: Heat grill, broiler, or medium oven to 375f and place broiler rack on second rack of oven. Mix peppers, onion soup mix and coriander in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: mexican chocolate,canola oil,baking powder,pesto sauce,lettuce leaf,green chili,water chestnut
title: Spiced Pesto Rollups
ingredients: 8 ounces mexican chocolate, melted | 3 teaspoons canola oil, divided | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped, divided | 1/2 cup sliced green chili, divided | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 4 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Combine first five ingredients, stirring until blended. Add 1/2 cup of green chile and mix well. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons chile mixture on each lettuce leaf in a roll. Arrange roll ups, seam side down, on a greased and floured baking sheet.

title: Mushroom & Yogurt
ingredients: 200 g buttery mushroom | 1 cup onion seeds | 100 g button mushrooms | 100 g balkan vanilla yogurt
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan over medium heat. Add onion seeds and mushrooms to pan. Cook until the mushrooms & onion seeds get transparent, stirring often. Remove from the heat and stir in the yogurt. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,red chili sauce,toothpick,margarine,star anise,tomato sauce,pumpkin seed,coffee powder
title: Spiced Caramel Chilli
ingredients: 6 inches toothpicks | 8 tablespoons margarine | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 3 medium tomatoes, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons crushed red chili sauce | 2 teaspoons pure roasted pumpkin seeds | 1 star anise
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c fan forced. In a shallow roasting dish, heat margarine and sugar over low heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Increase heat to high and cook for 1 minute, stirring continuously. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Arrange toothpicks in mixture, and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until brown and crisp. Remove from dish, and serve warm or cold.

title: Potato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup boiled potato, cubed | 1 cup diced tomato with bouillon ( i like contadina or a tomato and bouillon flavor ) | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti squash,pork tenderloin,beef chuck,baby spinach,beef chuck roast,chicken thigh,tomato soup,strawberry
title: Chicken and Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs pork thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 8 ounces fresh baby spinach, washed | 1 carton beef soup, undiluted | 2 cans tomato soup, undiluted | 1 package spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise and cut into chunks
