instructions: Heat a large dutch oven or heavy kettle over medium high heat until hot. Brown the pork, beef and beef in the heated dutch oven or kettle and transfer to a large bowl. Add the meat mixture and both soups to the dutch oven. Add the frozen squash.

title: Italian Grilled Cheese With Sauteed Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb fresh broccoli | 1/4 cup green onion ( optional ) | 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon garlic and herb seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Prepare broiler. Line pan with foil. Bend broiler pan or baking sheet with aluminum foil. Cut broccoli into 3/4 inch slices, separating flowerettes with a vegetable peeler. Cut remaining florets into 2 inch segments. Cut green and white parts of green onion into 1 inch half inch pieces. Place broccoli in a large mixing bowl. Mound cheese in center of broccoli. Sprinkle with remaining seasonings. Wrap foil over broccoli and place directly on top of cheese and broccoli. Place under hot broiler for 10 to 12 minutes, or until top is browned and bubbly.

title: Garlic Fettuccine With White and Black Peas
ingredients: 3 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 cup cannellini beans ( reserve liquid ) | 1/2 cup chopped frozen guacamole | 1 tablespoon white flour | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla essence | 1/2 cup whole garlic | 7 ounces uncooked fettuccine
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Drain and return to the pot. Add all other ingredients.

title: Grand Marnier Marinade
ingredients: 4 ounces lean beef brisket ( or a slice of brisket ) | 2 tablespoons anise and oil ( a good one, the one i used was superior in quality ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 1/2 tablespoons daikon radishes
instructions: Rinse beef well. Dissolve anise oil in grand marnier and toss with meat. Let marinate while you prep the daikon radish. Cut the beef into 8 or 10 pieces. Put the meat in a non reactive container, pour marinade over, cover, and marinate for at least an hour or overnight.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,coriander leaf,splenda sugar substitute,leek,serrano pepper,yellow bell pepper
title: Easy Peppered Lemons & Peppers
ingredients: 2 leeks | 5 large yellow bell peppers | 4 serrano peppers, seeded | 3/4 cup sweet picante sauce, of choice | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | fresh coriander leaves ( optional )
instructions: Trim leeks well and slice into 2 inch rounds place in mixing bowl. Slice bell peppers in half lengthwise and remove stems. Slice serrano peppers in 1/4 inch rounds and add to bowl. Cut leeks crosswise into about 2 inch pieces, removing any dark green tops. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until hot. Add leeks and pepper slices and saute about 5 minutes, turning once. Add 1/4 c picante sauce and allow to return to a high simmer. Add 1 t sugar and continue simmering until lemons are soft and sweetened, approximately 20 - 25 minutes. Sprinkle with coriander leaves and serve.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lard | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar or 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 can tomato paste | 1/2 an average beer lager beer | 1/4 cup buttermilk ( add if you do not wish to use buttermilk ) | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 3 -6 tablespoons light flavored buttermilk, for brushing
instructions: Heat the lard in a saucepan to medium heat. Add the vinegar, tomato paste, and beer, stirring. When the liquid begins to boil, add buttermilk and stir until combined. Heat through gently but don't boil. Taste and add more buttermilk if it isn’t enough. Add green chives and serve immediately. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,red capsicum,tart apple,beer,green chilies,large shrimp,wine vinegar
title: Spicy Grilled Shrimp
ingredients: 200 g fresh large shrimp, peeled & deveined | 200 g raw large shrimp, peeled & deveined | 2 medium tart apples | 2 large green chilies, halved lengthways | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons sweet green chilies, coarsely chopped | 200 ml beer
instructions: Place the shrimp, apples, chillies and vinegar in a shallow dish. Pour over enough beer to just cover. Seal and marinade in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or over night. To serve, remove 1/4 of the shrimp and cook on high for 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,beef stew meat,rice wine,tomato sauce,tomato paste
title: Beef Spaghetti and Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef stew meat, cut in chunks | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can tomato paste | 1/2 cup rice wine | hot cooked spaghetti
instructions: Put all ingredients in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting 3 hours or high setting 3 hours. Cook spaghetti.

title: Asian Beef and Squash Teriyaki
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced sirloin | 4 large yellow squash or 4 large vidalia onions, peeled, halved lengthways | 1/2 cup raw cashews | 1/2 cup cashews, toasted lightly and cooled | 1 stalk lemon grass, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, sliced, drained | 2 teaspoons mixed spice or 2 teaspoons mixed herbs, preferably thai basil or 2 teaspoons lemongrass, crushed
instructions: Place the beef, squash, cashews over boiling water to cover and cook about 30 minutes, turning frequently, until beef, vegetables and cashews are tender. Drain beef mixture and transfer to a large bowl. Stir in cashews, cashew mixture, lemon grass and mixed spice. If grilling, allow at least 15 minutes before cooking and cool before using in recipes. Variation, instead of lemon grass and basil, replace lemon grass with 1 - 2 tablespoons fresh minced garlic. Can be made vegan by using vegetable and coconut milk instead of water chestnuts.

Random Ingredients: bloody mary mix,rigatoni pasta,sherry,cumin powder,scallion,wheat penne
title: Pasta With Blood-Mile Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces whole wheat penne | 2 cups uncooked rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup scallion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 cup bloody mary mix
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling salted water, cook pasta until tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Season with cumin and salt to taste and serve.

title: Creamed Pecans
ingredients: 1 cup pecan pieces | 1 stalk celery, diced
instructions: Soak pecans in water for 45 minutes. Drain and rinse pecans over a bowl. Return to the bowl with pecans. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Drain pecan mixture, reserving 1/2 cup for topping and set aside. Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from oven and top with celery. Return to oven and bake for an additional 15 minutes until lightly browned. Allow to cool slightly. Store pecans in refrigerator and top with reserved 1/2 cup.

Random Ingredients: raisin,meat,sauce,kaffir lime leaf,basil leaf,pre mozzarella cheese,shortening
title: Baked Mozzarella Wrapped Meat

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix ingredients together in a large bowl, breaking up meat as it is added. Pinch off 2 tablespoons of meat per slice and roll into balls around the kaffir lime leaves. Place or un rolled meat in a greased 9x13 inch baking pan and cover with remaining meat mixture. Sprinkle the mozzarella on top. Bake 30 minutes or until meat is browned and mozzarella is melted.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,kaffir lime leaf,limeade concentrate,broccoli,sirloin,turmeric,seltzer water
title: Kasri
ingredients: 10 pieces sirloin or 3 lbs sirloin tip steak | 1 can tomato-and-green chilies | 1 lb fresh broccoli | 1 tablespoon instant limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, crumbled | 2 cups seltzer water
instructions: Trim fat from meat and cut into chunks. Place in shallow crockpot. Add the remaining ingredients, except the juice. Cover and cook on lo 2 or 3 hours to desired doneness. Turn off crockpot. When meat is done remove meat from sauce. Stir in lime juice.

title: Lazy Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice, brown ( not short grain ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried tarragon ( or fresh )
instructions: Stir the dried tarragon in with the rice. In a 5 cup measure, pour about 1/2/3 of the liquid in and measure. Put rice in a large, heavy pan and let it absorb the liquid for 3 to 4 minutes without stirring. The easiest way to do this is with your spoon and it will sizzle a little when it hits the rice. This will only take a few seconds. Take the pan from the heat and cover and leave to stand for about 30 minutes. At least, once a day, stir and fluff up with a fork or a wooden spoon. The best way to fluff up the rice is to break it with your spoon and break up. Use more or less if it is too wet, but leave it alone. Note, if you want to fluff up the rice or use to make bacon pieces, then add the bacon pieces to the rice after mixing. You don't have to completely mash the bread, to have a creamier dish, but do the mashed rice as quickly as possible without making any appreciable difference to the flavour.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,poblano pepper,greek yogurt,rice wine vinegar,marshmallow creme
title: Chile Con Queso (Chile Peppers in Sweet Yogurt)
ingredients: 2 cups plain rice wine vinegar | 1 cucumber, peeled and chopped | 1 small poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | 10 marshmallow creme, chopped | 2 cups thin-fat greek yogurt
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the vinegar with the rice wine vinegar until the mixture is well blended. Chop the poblano peppers.

title: Pan-Fried Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 1 kg of stale panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons roasted black peppercorns | 1 loaf crusty bread
instructions: Grind the black peppercorns, or coarsely grind the peppercorns using your hands. Lightly flour the bread and roll the bread out into a rectangle of about 20 cm in diameter. Cut the bread into 5 evenly sized squares. Put the breadcrumbs into a shallow dish. Sprinkle the peppercorns evenly over the breadcrumbs. Set a frying pan over a moderate heat until hot. Add half the oil, tipping the pan to coat the bottom. When the oil is smoking, place the breads in and fry for 4 minutes on each side until golden.

title: Gluten Free Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 7 tablespoons xanthan gum | 6 ounces red bell peppers, roasted, peeled and seeded
instructions: Thoroughly blend the dry ingredients. Use as directed in recipes or store any seasoning mix in a container. Use as needed for stews, meats, roasted veggies, etc. Sprinkle over salads, vegetables, etc.

title: Chilli Con Caramel Rice Salad

instructions: Bring 2 litres of water to the boil. Add salt, rice and carrots. Simmer for 10 minutes. Drain. Mix the lemon juice, evaporated milk, worcestershire sauce and caramel sauce in a jug. Put onto the rice. Add lettuce. Serve.

title: Cottage Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese, well drained | 1/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon harissa ( to taste ) or 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 cup dried bread crumbs
instructions: Note, use fresh cottage cheese if it is not available. Mix all ingredients well. Add more if necessary to make the mixture of desired consistency. Shape into golf ball sized balls. Dust lightly with bread crumbs, coat completely. Chill before using. Variation, for a twist. For a crumbly, chewy cracker like roll, roll it into balls and fry in a little olive oil until golden. Note, for a crisper, chewy cracker like roll, roll it into balls and fry in olive oil until golden. Variation, roll the dough into puffs, then stuff with curried and salted tomatoes, celery sticks, mushrooms or anything else that might add moisture to the roll. For a twist, add a little garlic or a few drops of olive oil. Variation, for a nutty cracker like cracker, roll it into puffs, then stuff with dairy whipped cream or whipped cream.

title: African Dragon
ingredients: 1 ounce amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Pour amarula liqueur into an ice cube tray. Add crushed vanilla ice cubes. Shake. Enjoy.

title: Foil Wrapped Fritters(Mexico) #RSC
ingredients: 2 lbs reynolds wrap foil | 12 ounces ice water
instructions: Place several sheets of reynolds wrap in a 10 inch fry pan or skillet. Heat oil over high heat just until smoking. Drop 1 fritter at a time into the oil, one at a time, until golden brown. Immediately lower one fritter with a slotted spoon over the hot oil and fry for about 3 min on each side. Serve hot.

title: Cherry Bombe
ingredients: 500 g cherries ( fresh, from about 5-10 large ones ) | 1 tablespoon mirin | 500 g yoghurt ( preferably aged ) | 100 g muscovado sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Place cherries in a bowl, pour a little honey and mirin over, and leave for about 30 minutes or over night. In the morning, squeeze the cherries with your hands and purée them. Put the yoghurt into a bowl and add sugar, mix until you get a thick, creamy consistency. Drain cherries well and add them to the bowl with the yoghurt. Stir to mix thoroughly. Line a large oven tray with baking paper and spoon half of the cherries into the tray, and spoon over the remaining cherries. Smooth the top. Put the tray in the oven for about 30 minutes, until the cherries are bubbling and starting to char on top. Let cool slightly. When the cherries are completely cool, transfer them to a wire rack and leave them to dry completely before serving.

Random Ingredients: marmalade,thyme leaf,vegetable broth,fine salt,serrano chilies,bay leaf,pasta shell
title: Spanish Shells and Chiles With Marmalade, Thyme and Chiles
ingredients: 14 -16 ounces vegetable broth | 1 cup fine salt ( coarse such as kosher ) | 3 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 small serrano chilies or 1 small other hot red chili, stemmed, seeded, minced | 2 lbs medium fresh pasta shells ( i recommend macaroni grill all-bowl ) | 3 tablespoons marmalade
instructions: In a saucepan, heat 3 cups or 2 cups of cold broth to boiling. Add the salt, bay leaves, thyme and chili. Stir to combine. Lower heat and simmer until the salt liquid is reduced by half, about 10 minutes. Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of the pasta cooking water. Drain the pasta well, reserving 1 cup of pasta cooking liquid. Ladle 1/3 of the pasta cooking water into a large shallow bowl. Add the pasta and marmalade and toss to combine. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Quick and Easy Tuna Patties
ingredients: 2 cans tuna in water, drained | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon fresh garlic, minced | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 head lettuce, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Combine tuna, soup, molasses, garlic and baking soda.

title: Pesto Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups short-grain white rice | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: Put rice in a bowl and pour enough boiling water over to cover. Let stand 10 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water. In a bowl, whisk vinegar and 2 tablespoons of vinegar until well combined. Add rice and mix well. Let stand until rice absorbs water, about 10 minutes.

title: Bahamian Corn
ingredients: 3 -4 ears corn, cut off the cob, | 1/4 cup rum ( or a mild rum like a liqueur ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place the corn on a square of heavy aluminum foil or parchment paper. Rub the corn with a little salt and pour just enough rum or rum over it to coat the skin. Roll the corn over the top of the foil or parchment, or use tongs to remove any loose bits. Fold the exposed foil over the corn, crimping and folding the ends in the corn as you go, so it will fit tightly into the mixture. If you can, refrigerate and use within 6 days. The idea is to let all the flavors blend. Serve with hot pita bread, hummus or dips/crusts for dipping.

title: Easy and Tasty Taco Pastry Rolls
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry | 1 can taco sauce ( i like hot sauce ) | onion powder or taco seasoning ( i like oxo original taco flavoring )
instructions: Line a baking sheet with puff pastry, set aside. Pour taco sauce into a bowl, sprinkle in onion powder or taco seasoning to taste. Add the puff pastry and roll onto a floured surface. Cut pastry into small squares, place 1 tbls. Of taco sauce in the middle of each square and fold over and pinch edges together. Set on baking sheet and bake at 425 for 10 to 12 minute. Serve when lightly browned and hot.

Random Ingredients: tofu,confectioner ' sugar,garlic salt,button mushroom,green lentil,red onion,beef cube,cauliflower
title: Sensational Beef & Lentil Casserole

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place lentils, cauliflower, tofu, red onion, mushrooms, garlic salt, confectioners' & salt in a large baking dish. Bake for 1/2 hour. Place mixture on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

instructions: Combine both cans of coconut milk, vinegar and cayenne. Add celery and chocolate and mix well. Put in bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours. Stir in just before serving so the candy does not burn on the bottom of the bowl.

title: Mexican White Bean Dip

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the beans, ketchup, chorizo, cream, and parmesan cheese.

title: Oriental Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1 lb chinese sausage, sliced | 1/2 cup white wine, white or 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons cream | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Heat oven to 325&deg.

title: Quick and Easy Tostadas
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils | 4 teaspoons flour tortillas | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 12 ounces apricot preserves
instructions: Place lentils and garlic in a food processor and process until it resembles fine grains. Add the tortilla strips and process just until they become the size and shape of lentils. Drain the noodles and spread half on each tortilla and then evenly spread the preserves on top, leaving about 1/2 inch of dough around each. Place on a baking sheet and bake until the preserves are melted and bubbly, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Guinness Cashew Burgers

instructions: Shape the hamburger into 4 burgers and place with cashews in a baking dish. Sprinkle with lime zest. Divide and top with guinness and scallions. Grill until done, 4 minutes per side, or until topping is firm and cashews turn golden.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Hummus

instructions: In a food processor, process peanut butter into peanut butter. Pour peanut butter into a bowl, and mix in dried cranberry juice. Chill in refrigerator until the flavors combine, at least 30 minutes.

title: Guacamole

instructions: Place the avocados into a mixing bowl. Season with oregano and gruyere cheese. Add and toss, or press the jalapeno pieces into the mixture to help the jalapenos hold their shape. title: Tuna, Broccoli & Tortilla Starter

instructions: Place the stock, tuna, broccoli, paprika & pinch of smoked spanato in a saucepan & add a pinch of smoked paprika or sweet paprika & some salt & bring to the boil. instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Separate cauliflower strands, then cut each floret lengthwise into about 12 wedges. Transfer to a large bowl.  ## Cooking instructions ##
 Place chile peppers on a foil lined pan, skin side up. Roast at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until chile peppers blister. Set aside to cool and slip off the skins. Once cooled rub the chile with the garlic, then place in a plastic bag and process until finely chopped. When peppers are cool peel and devein them and then puree in a food chopper. Heat the olive oil in another large saucepan over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook until soft and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Stir in the chile puree. Add cream and cook down for one minute. Season with salt, pepper, oregano and chili flakes. Simmer until reduced by one third. Remove from heat. Add in the tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes. Puree to desired consistency using a mixer or in a blender. Set aside. Serve on heated platter with grated cheese sprinkled on top. Note, you can make this in advance and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: South African Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh baby spinach, packed | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 4 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl and combine well. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Ham with Pineapple
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks | 1 pound fully-cooked ham slices | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 tablespoon thai basil, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Arrange pineapple chunks in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange ham slices atop the pineapple. In a bowl, whisk together duck broth and thai basil until dissolved. Pour mixture over ham and pineapple. Cover dish loosely with foil, and bake in the preheated oven 1 hour, or until ham is browned and the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: egg bread,pinto bean,bean sprout,coconut milk,salt,curd cottage cheese,cucumber
title: Pancakes With Cabbage and Beans
ingredients: 1 small egg bread | 1/2 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1/2 cup milk ( or use yogurt or coconut milk ) | 1 -2 tablespoon shredded coconut ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon grated cucumber, shredded ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 can refried beans ( with liquid )
instructions: Slice bread into 1/4 inch slices. Place on a cookie sheet or baking sheet and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 8 - 10 minutes. Combine the cottage cheese and milk. Add salt, and shredded coconut if using. Beat until creamy. Add the shredded cucumber and shredded or shredded carrot. Stir well and let sit for 2 - 3 minutes. Dip each slice of bread in the milk mixture, coating both sides. Fry in a little oil on the pan until lightly browned. Turn over and brown other side. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Crock Pot Peaches
ingredients: 6 large sweet peppers | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed well | 1/4 lb lard or 1/4 lb crisco | 8 ounces cooked crabmeat | 8 guajillo chilies ( green mexican chiles ), seeded and minced | 3 canned sliced ripe olives, juice only | 1/2 cup canned sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Place in crock pot the peppers and juice, lard or crisco, crab, and shredded cheese. Cook on high. Turn down heat and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours stirring 2 to 3 times. Remove to a serving platter. Top with the olives and peaches.

title: Mutton Mirch Phakhni
ingredients: 3 lbs mutton ( mutton chops ) | 1 teaspoon ginger paste, powdered | 8 tablespoons chervil, chopped
instructions: Put 1/4 cup cold water on the bottom of a pressure cooker. Add ginger paste and mix well with the mutton. Close the lid and pressure cook for 15 minutes until the chops are done, but not falling apart. Garnish with chervil. Serve hot with indian flatbread.

title: Creamy Jalapeno Cheese Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb queso fresco, crumbled small or 2 cups crumbled blue cheese | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons prepared chile powder | 2 teaspoons jalapeno chiles, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon pickled jalapeno chile, finely chopped | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine all ingredients and puree until smooth, adding in the buttermilk just before serving..

title: Red and Green Berries With Creamy Pesto
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon basil pesto ( a flavorful jarred italian spice blend ) | 8 cups blueberries
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, pesto and blueberries. Chill until the flavors combine, about 30 minutes. Serve at room temperature.

title: Maine Caviar
ingredients: 2 pounds ripe habanero peppers, or more to taste | 2/3 cup matzo meal
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, cut a slit down one side of each habanero pepper, and carefully remove and reserve the seeds and juice. Combine habanero pepper seeds with matzo meal in a bowl. Fill each hot pepper with enough habanero matzo to fully coat. Place seeds in a food processor or blender with 1 tablespoon water, and process until coarsely ground, about 1 minute. Transfer mixture to a serving dish, and chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,sage,pepperoncini pepper juice,coriander seed,cinnamon
title: Spicy Sicilian Pepperoncini
ingredients: 1 jar pepperoncini peppers - juice ( use fresh hot peppers if you have them ) | 1 cinnamon stick | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Fill a sauce pan with water, add 1 teaspoon salt and bring to a boil over high heat. Add the cinnamon stick, coriander seed, sage and pepperoncini and cook for 5 minutes. Once liquid is cool, use a strainer to strain the liquid through the strainer, and reserve until needed. Place pepperoncini and their juice in a blender and blend until smooth. Add cheese, and puree until smooth, and use to stuff the pepperoncini.

title: Sweet and Sour Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds onions, cut in half, lengthwise, and thinly sliced
instructions: Place half the onions in a glass or porcelain bowl and spread out evenly. Sprinkle with remaining onions. Cover and refrigerate, shaking the bowl occasionally, for 2 hours. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Bake onions in the preheated oven until softened, 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Texas Cakes
ingredients: 6 corn flakes, crushed | 1/2 pound boneless leg of lamb, cubed | 1 cucumber, peeled and shredded | 1/2 pound boneless chicken, cubed | 1 jar salsa | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 32 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large bowl, mix corn flakes, lamb, cucumber, chicken, salsa and baking soda. Thread meat onto bamboo skewers. Place skewers on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and bubbly, about 45 minutes. Serve in a bowl with the reserved bamboo skewers.

title: Crescent Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crescent roll | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, chopped | 12 cardamom seeds ( crushed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Separate dough into two pieces. On an ungreased cookie sheet, spread the center of each piece with 2 tblsp. Cherry, leaving about ½ inch border on each side. Press half the crushed cardamom seeds into the dough and sprinkle over the cherries. Roll dough into a rectangle the length of the baking sheet and place it, on the prepared cookie sheet. Pinch edges to seal the dough. Bake at 425 degrees f for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden. Let cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute, then transfer to wire rack to finish cooling.

title: Jicama, Jicama and Herbs on Sannie's Crostini
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1 lime | 1 baguette | minced fresh herb ( to taste )
instructions: Peel the jicama as you would for a new jicama. Cut the fruit into small chunks. Put it in a bowl of cold water and add enough sea salt and lime juice to cover. Let stand for 15 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle about a quarter of a cup of minced fresh herbs on the bread. Sprinkle slices with about a quarter each of a little mixed herbs on each. Cut the baguette in half lengthwise and slice each section diagonally. Place on a baking sheet. Top with mixed herbs. Bake in 400°f oven for a few minutes to get a little color. To serve, cut baguette into small wedges and top with a few sliced jicama. Rub the bread on the side of the bread with a slice of the baguette wedge. Garnish with some more herbs.

instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the pasta until al dente, about 6 - 8 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: nonfat yogurt,chocolate wafer cooky,limoncello,yeast,coriander seed,kimchee,fava bean,snow pea
title: Spooky Cakes
ingredients: 3 packages yeast | 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt, at room temp | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 cup limoncello | 1 cup frozen snow peas | 1 cup frozen mung bean, thawed | 1/2 cup frozen limoncello | 15 kimchee, sliced ( optional ) | 20 candied coriander seeds ( optional ) | 20 nonfat dry yogurt or 25 chocolate wafer cookies
instructions: Put yeast in big bowl and mix in 1/4 cup of the water. Mix until foamy. Add ½ of the yogurt. Add salt, remaining yogurt, limoncello and seeds to the yeast. Beat for 5 minutes. On a cookie sheet spread out the kimchee slices. Place on top of the kimchee slices. Add the other ½ cup of the yogurt to the frozen yogurt. Dough must not be runny or stiff. Spread out evenly onto the cookie sheets. Bake at 375 f for about 15 minutes, until the kimchee is bubbly and golden brown. Turn off the oven. title: Japanese Favourite Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 6 -8 assorted fresh vegetables, such as potatoes, carrots, turnips, turnips or just cauliflower | 4 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons brown gravy mix | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese cooking wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Prepare vegetables, cut potatoes lengthwise into wedges and place into bowl of cold water to stop browning. Drain. Cut carrots into sticks and place onto a clean plate. title: Raspberry Salad Dressing

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes remove from heat and leave, covered, to cool. To serve, stir in some freshly ground black pepper to taste.

title: Pecorino Ripe Cheese

instructions: Wash and rinse cheese well. Using a rolling pin pat cheese to flatten on all surfaces. Cut in small squares when cold you may do this with just the rolling pin for 2 or 3 minutes. title: Moroccan Spice for Pork and Beef Skewers or Beef

instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. Add meat and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours.

title: English Cheese Log
ingredients: 16 ounces cream cheese | 1 lb suet | 4 ounces cheese
instructions: Mix all together. Line baking sheet with greaseproof paper and put a large piece of cheese on the paper, this should come to about 1/16 thick max paper with cheese on the outside of the paper. Cut the log into 1 1/4 wide and 1 thick medallions. Put on the baking sheet and bake at 350 till cheese is lightly browned, about 1 hour. Serve warm. This can also be prepared with ham and sausage, adding some bacon slices to the cheese after placing the cheese on the bread while cooking to make it sandwich tender.

title: Italian Pasta Appetizers
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni ( i prefer curly ) | 1 package crescent rolls | 1 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Remove from heat and stir in a little of the juice from the jar of crescent rolls until well combined. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,cayenne,walnut,corn oil,mint,saffron,spicy brown mustard
title: Saffron Cajwain (Minted Walnut Sauce)
ingredients: 400 g walnuts | 4 -5 tablespoons dark brown mustard | 1 tablespoon crushed dried mint | 1 teaspoon crushed saffron | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 teaspoon light dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Toast the walnuts under the grill, watching the darker, until they are browned and fragrant. Remove the nuts from the grill, leaving the skin on. Place the walnuts in a medium mixing bowl, add 1 tbsp mustard, mint leaves and crushed saffron. Mix well. Add the rest of the mustard and spices and mix. Add the sugar and continue to mix vigorously until you have a thick, smooth sauce. You may need to add a little water during this process if too thick. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, place in the fridge and leave until thickened up and you need to work it through the nuts. When thickened up, beat in a little more yellow food colouring. instructions: Peel zucchini and slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place in a bowl with the caraway.

title: Pineapple-Ginger Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup white potato, washed and chopped | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup curd cottage cheese ( fresh is best, but can use any dry curd cottage cheese ) | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Cook the white potatoes in boiling water until soft. Then, let cool, and then mash them until smooth. Drain off excess water and keep warm until ready to use. Fry the garlic paste and saffron on low heat for a few minutes or until aromatic. Add ginger paste and saffron. Saute till golden brown and dry. Mix in the flour and potatoes. title: Grenaden's Lemon Ice

instructions: Place the ice in a medium sized bowl. Sprinkle the lemon zest over. Pour enough boiling water over the ice to cover the ice in the bowl. Cover bowl immediately, and freeze for 4 hours, stirring every few minutes. Remove the ice from the bowl, and place in a covered container.

title: Curried Kid Beans(Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 bag red beans ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/2 tablespoon curry powder ( or to your taste ) | 2 teaspoons ground pepper
instructions: Pour beans into the crock of your slow cooker. Add curry powder and ground pepper. Mix to combine. Put on lid. Set slow cooker on low and cook 6 - 8 hours. Note, if cooking on the stove, turn slow cooker to high.

title: Guava Curry with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 large broccoli, washed and cut into florets | 1/4 cup margarine | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon sesame seeds | 2 -4 tablespoons curry powder | 2 -3 tablespoons guava nectar
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender, about 8 - 10 minutes or according to package directions, but avoid overcooking. Cut broccoli into florets. Saute pan sprayed with cooking spray over medium high heat until margarine melts, about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir in celery salt, sesame seeds, and curry powder. Cook for 1 minute. Add guava nectar and curry powder. Stir until curry is just a little thin, about 1 minute.

title: Lebanese Apricot & Blueberry Pizza
ingredients: 15 g coriander seeds | 400 g sliced leeks | 200 g fresh apricots | 200 g honey | 400 g pizza crust, ready-made | 1 bunch coriander leaves | 250 g frozen blueberries ( defrosted if frozen )
instructions: Toast coriander seeds in a dry non stick frying pan over medium heat for about 3 minutes or until fragrant. Transfer to a bowl and cool. Finely chop coriander seeds. Trim leeks and cut into 5 cm lengths. Mix chopped coriander seeds with chopped leeks. Arrange leeks, apricots and honey over pizza base then sprinkle with coriander, leaving 2cm border on each side. Place pizza on tray, then top with coriander and blueberries. Bake in a medium oven about 20 minutes or until crust is puffed and golden brown.

Place the fried wontons in batches in a paper towel lined plate and serve immediately.

title: Applesauce on Rice
ingredients: 1 cup apple juice | 4 -6 lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat apple juice in a frying pan. Put lettuce leaves on your rice. Stir a few times so the lettuce leaves and the rice don't stick together, or when the juice is still floating over them, they don't move much. Serve warm.

title: Jollof Tortellini With Chicken

instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, fry chicken thighs in melted butter until lightly browned. instructions: Shell and devein shrimp.

title: Apple Beans and Corn

instructions: Simmer beans, corn and garlic in water with remaining ingredients until tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Korean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen seashell pasta | 4 cups crumbled gruyere cheese, divided | 4 ounces thinly sliced pepperoni, cut in half | 7 ounces sliced fresh belgian endive, tops left whole | 1 ounce belgian blue curacao, halved | 1 tablespoon chutney | 1 fluid ounce sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup prepared sweet chutney
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Toss with 1/2 of the gruyere cheese, the pepperoni, endive and blue curacao. Combine the chutney and chutney in a small bowl. To serve, pour the filling into a serving bowl and top with remaining 2 tablespoons of the gruyere cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Glorious Nachos

instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls into rapidly boiling, salted water. When noodles rise to the surface, they're done. Drain well and place on a plate or platter.

title: Greek Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 package small ladyfingers | 1 package shredded feta cheese | 2 cups milk | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line the bottom of a baking sheet with parchment paper. Lightly coat with cooking spray. Arrange the ladyfingers on the baking sheet, then sprinkle with cheese. Combine the milk and cinnamon in a small bowl, then pour evenly over the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven 12 minutes, until cheese is bubbly and browned. Remove from oven, and top with additional cheese.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,coconut milk,beef stock,vegetable oil cooking spray,aubergine,szechuan peppercorn,currant,celery rib
title: Beef and Pork Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs lean sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups beef stock, divided | 1 teaspoon dried sichuan peppercorns | 2 celery ribs, sliced | 1 aubergine, cubed ( eggplant ), peeled and cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 ounces currants | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Spray a nonstick wok or 2 - 4 tablespoons oil with cooking spray and set over high heat. Add beef and stir fry for 2 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Stir fry celery, 1/2 cup stock and peppercorns for 1 minute. Add aubergine and stir fry for 3 minutes, or until tender. Add remaining 1/2 cup stock and coconut milk and stir fry for 3 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Stir in currants, heat through.

title: Peas With Walnuts
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen peas, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons walnut halves or 2 tablespoons cashew nuts
instructions: Combine the peas and nuts in a medium skillet and saute for about 3 to 4 minutes. Add the walnuts and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Hazelnut Cake
ingredients: 2 cups honey roasted hazelnuts | cornmeal, to dust
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Spread nuts evenly on a flat baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 15 to 40 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, or until lightly colored and fragrant. Watch carefully, as they burn easily, watch carefully, as they burn easily. Remove nuts carefully, and watch carefully they burn quickly. Remove from oven. Cool. Sprinkle with more nutmeg. When completely cool, dust with cornmeal. Store in an airtight container.

title: Pigs in a Blanket
ingredients: 14 ounces pork, very lean | 14 ounces white mushrooms, wiped clean | 2 ounces walnut halves | 8 ounces pepperoni, sliced | white pepper | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Preheat grill. If using all lean pork, cut into 1 inch pieces and remove any membrane or undesirable parts. Using a large roasting pan, place pork on a rack that is slightly larger than the walnut halves. Drizzle with the molasses and season with salt and white pepper. Wrap the walnut halves around the pork so that they will fit snugly. Use foil, or brown garbage bags with a heavy cloth over the ham hock. Allow to dry for 2 days, before using. When ready to cook, use a sharp knife to cut the ham hock into 1 inch wide strips. Wash the mushrooms. Rinse the walnuts well and chop the basil. Remove as many large pieces of ham hock that will fit into your grill and reserve for another use. Scoop out the ham hock into a saute pan, and place in a single layer on the foil. Add the mushrooms and pepperoni slices and continue to saute, stirring as needed, for 10 – 15 minutes until the mushrooms are tender. Remove from heat, and place a strip of ham hock in the center all around and around the ham hock. Fold the ham hock over the ham, and allow to dry for 30 or 45 minutes. Remove the ham hock and place on a heavy plate. Using a kitchen towel, lightly wipe the ham hock. Use a sharp knife to remove the ham hock as many as possible from the foil sheet, and set aside the remaining ham hock for next use. Wash and chop the basil. Place all ingredients in the pan of a blender or food processor and blend on high speed until the walnuts are chopped and well ground. Pour into a bowl, stir, and cover with another piece of foil and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving. Serve with mashed potatoes or spaghetti, if you like.

title: Lebanese Cardamom Hot Cream or Soup
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Combine the hot cream/hot soup or soup stock in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in cardamom. To serve, pour into hot ramekins and serve immediately.

title: Apricot Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces macaroni, cooked | 1/2 cup reduced-fat soymilk | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon apricot, chopped | 2 tablespoons lettuce leaves, finely shredded
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water until just tender. Drain.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,kaffir lime leaf,veal,mint,red enchilada sauce,shoulder lamb chop
title: Minty Veal With Grape Tomato Salad in Tomato-Chile Sauce
ingredients: 8 shoulder lamb chops, trimmed of fat | 2 -3 lbs grape tomatoes, washed, stems removed | 4 -5 kaffir lime leaves, bruised to release flavor | 1 teaspoon dried mint, crushed or 2 tablespoons fresh mint, chopped small | 2 -3 tablespoons vietnamese red enchilada sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup green mint or 1/2 cup basil, chopped
instructions: Place lamb on broiler pan. Season with salt and pepper. Broil on high for 3 minutes per side or until done to your taste. Remove from oven and let rest 10 minutes. Cut the tomatoes into quarters or chunks. Put on a platter, spoon 1 tsp mint and 1 tsp lime juice over them. Put the chops back in and spoon on the remaining mint and lime juice. Spoon the tomato sauce over them. Sprinkle with the crumbled mint and lime leaves. Enjoy.

title: Nigerian Spinach With Hot Rice
ingredients: 1 bag frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup of fresh diced breadcrumbs | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup sweet salsa | 1 teaspoon red chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint | 2 1/2 cups hot cooked rice, preferably basmati or 2 1/2 cups jasmine rice, cooked, chilled and drained well
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Combine chopped spinach, bread crumbs, soup, salsa, chili paste, and mint in a large bowl. Stir in cooked rice. Using a fork, stir to blend. Spoon into a large cookie sheet. Place in freezer. To serve, break apart and serve.

Random Ingredients: biscuit dough,black eyed pea,bell pepper,stew meat,penne,pumpkin,fennel seed,sugar cube
title: Pasta with Stewed Pumpkin, Peppers and Garlic
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough, pillsbury recipe ready made dough | 2 lbs stew meat, stewed | 1 bell pepper ( any color ) | 1 can pumpkin | 1 can black-eyed peas | 1 sugar cube | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 3 -4 bell peppers ( any color ) | powdered sugar cube, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Mix stew meat, bell pepper, pumpkin, chickpeas, fennel seed and sugar. Roll out 1 package of biscuit dough to fit a 9x9 inch baking dish. Place 1/2 mixture in a dish, roll up, place in baking dish, cover with greased plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. The next day, bake covered for about 50 - 60 mins, remove wrap and brush top with a little water, bake for 5 mins more, then sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Baked Doughnuts (Nøderskål)
ingredients: 24 thin springy spring roll tops ( not sure size... ) or 24 small sponge cakes | 24 pieces small dinner rolls ( not sure size... ) or 24 dinner roll sheets ( not sure size... )
instructions: You have two ways to make a very basic danish sponge cake. Place an inverted 18 x 8 cake pan in the freezer until frozen and ready to proceed with recipe. If using doughnuts, roll each one into a log about 8 in long. Cut into four even lengthwise slices, then cut in half crosswise on bias. Repeat with second log. Place all of the slices and doughtnuts on a floured board and use your hands to stretch and stretch them until they are about 1/4 inch thick. Cut each slice into 6 equal pieces and place on a preheated baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes. Meanwhile cook your rolls in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain well and cool on a rack. Slice each cake in half crosswise and arrange cut sides down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cover with waxed paper and set aside in a warm place. Heat your oven to 375 degrees f and lightly grease a large baking sheet. Remove the risen rolls from the baking sheet and gently stretch and stretch them until they are about 1/4 in thick. Place the rounds on the baking sheet leaving space between any of the cut sides. Brush with warm egg white so they will stick to the doughnuts. Bake until golden, about 25 minutes, and carefully remove from baking sheet on a rack. Let cool for 5 minutes before moving the rounds onto a plate for serving. Variation, while the dutchnuts make small indentations in the doughnuts, place a small piece of waxed paper between each. If the bread becomes really crispy you can brush that on while still on the baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,baking potato,kielbasa sausage,cooking oat,risotto rice,port wine,jalapeno chile
title: Kielbasa, Cheese and Corn Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa sausage, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 cups sweet whole kernel corn, cut from the cob | 1 package rice or 2 cups arborio rice | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1 can jalapeno chiles | 1 cup port wine | 1 box refrigerated crispy-cooked sweet potatoes
instructions: Place sausage in skillet.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,turmeric,sticky rice,monterey jack cheese,parsnip,anise seed
title: Pear-Rice Snack
ingredients: 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup quick-cooking yellow rice | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese, grated, divided | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 12 miniature uncooked parsnips, peeled, cooked, and cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Combine syrup, rice, 1/4 cup cheese, turmeric, and anise seed in an airtight container. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to serving. Sprinkle each serving with remaining 1 tablespoon cheese. Note, prep time does not reflect chilling time.

Random Ingredients: water,superfine sugar,vegetable oil cooking spray,mustard oil,garlic clove
title: Garlic and Mustard Sauce for Fish or Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 4 garlic cloves, smashed and peeled | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard oil | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 2 teaspoons finely grated fresh horseradish or 2 teaspoons horseradish | 1/2 cup boiling water
instructions: Dissolve 1/2 cup sugar in the boiling water, add mustard oil, whisk together and set aside. Place remaining sugar/mustard, garlic, oil and 1 teaspoon of the horseradish in an ovenproof frying pan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for a few minutes. Add water and bring to boil. Simmer, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes or until sauce thickens. Remove from heat and add remaining horseradish, stirring until combined, serve with fish or chips. Goes well with chicken as well as carrot sticks.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,pear,dijon mustard,mandarin orange,red pepper flake,dark sesame oil,red capsicum
title: Pear and Mandarin Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 250 g red capsicums, roughly sliced | 225 g fresh papears, roughly chopped | 1 large pear, roughly pared, cored and roughly chopped
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, then stir well. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. When ready to cook, remove the stir fry from the refrigerator 10 minutes before serving. Serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,rice noodle,mirin,maple syrup,mustard,red chile pepper,mint leaf
title: Sauteed Yellow Squash With Rice Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice noodles, soaked in warm water until softened | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1 medium red chile pepper | 3 large yellow squash - halved and seeded, as desired | 3 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, combine rice noodles, maple syrup, mustard, chili, squash, mirin, and mint. Cover and set in the refrigerator to allow flavors to develop, about 15 minutes.

title: Sweet and Smoky Sweetened Scented Tea
ingredients: 32 ladyfingers | 1 bunch broccoli, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup sugar | 6 cups strong black tea
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blitz the broccoli, sugar, and 4 cups water for 10 to 15 seconds. Stir in the tea and refrigerate.

title: Wild Rice
ingredients: 3 cups wild rice, washed and well rinsed | 4 -5 red chilies | 1 bunch radish, washed and cut into long thin slices | 1 1/2 cups yogurt | vegetable shortening ( for frying )
instructions: Wash and rinse wild rice well. Spread the wild rice between two layers of damp cloth, and soak until dry for a couple of hours. Place the chilies, the radishes and the salt in a saucepan and cover tightly with water. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat. Simmer on low heat for 30 minutes. Drain all of the water and stir wild rice into simmering chilies and radishes with fresh cream or yogurt. Serve hot, garnished with the shortening.

title: Black Eyed Pea and Raspberry Riesling (Rajas Con Cebola)
ingredients: 16 ounces black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 lb fresh raspberry
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In a 2 quart casserole dish, combine the black eyed peas, red wine, and raspberries. Mix well and bake for 45 minutes, or until tender and the berries are glazed.

title: Homemade Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 jars of mango chutney | 2 cups white sugar
instructions: Combine mango chutney and sugar in a bowl and mix well. Store covered in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,pepper sauce,extra virgin olive oil,basil
title: Capellini Pepper Oil
ingredients: 8 large peppers | 5 tablespoons hot chili sauce ( try ancho or chipotle ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped basil | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Trim the stem ends off each pepper, and slice off the stem. Slice the pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Heat the remaining olive oil in a skillet, and cook the pepper strips in it over medium heat until they start to change color, 3 to 4 minutes, turning them over to cook all sides. Sprinkle the pepper with basil, and shake the skillet to remove most of the basil. Continue to cook peppers until all of the oil cooks out. Remove from heat, and toss in pepper sauce. Stir in additional basil, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chuck steak,head cauliflower,tamari,irish cream,poblano chile,ancho chile powder,oat,self raising flour
title: Tear and Eat Beef and Cauliflower Croquettes
ingredients: 250 g self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder ( optional ) | 300 g chuck steaks | 1 tablespoon tamari, sauce | 12 poblano chiles, trimmed, cut into small pieces | 2 heads cauliflower, cut into small florets | 1 tablespoon extra oats | 250 ml irish cream
instructions: Put your flour in a mixing bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of tamari and stir to combine. Dip your chuck in the flour, shake off excess. Tear off a piece of tinned foil and put in your tin. Place your beef in your tin and coat with the flour to completely cover. Heat your oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Put the poblanos on a baking tray and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the stalk is charred. Cool for 5 minutes, remove from the oven, cut the meat into small pices and put in a warm oven. While the meat is sitting, put the cauliflower florets in a pan of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes. Drain and put aside. Now put your oven on. Turn your oven down to 150 degrees centigrade and preheat the oven to 220 degrees centigrade. When you feel the oven's hottest remove it from the oven and, with a slotted spoon, put the beef in a large ovenproof dish. Toss it with the roasted poblanos and return it to the oven for 20 minutes until the beef is brown and everything is cooked. Toss it once more, and check that it is cooked through. If it is, put it back into the oven for a few minutes to warm through. Make sure it is warm enough to serve by sitting it on a chopping board with some arugula in it, which should just soak up the flavour. To serve, spread the pocces on a dinner plate and top with the chopped cauliflower, followed by the beef, roasted poblanos, and the cauliflower floret. Top with cream and drizzle with a little extra tamari. Serve with a fresh loaf of bread.

title: Gourmet White Wine Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half cream ( or substitute heavy cream ) | 1/8 cup white vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan. Serve with vegetables, meats or rice.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,cold water,greek seasoning,pecan,olive,celery rib,tabasco sauce,brussels sprout
title: Brussels Sprouts in Pomegranate and Pomegranate Juice
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, trimmed | 2 -3 pomegranate juice or 2 -3 ounces orange juice | 1 tablespoon low-sodium worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon greek seasoning | 1/8 cup light olive ( kalamansi ) | 2 celery ribs | 1/4 cup pecans or 1/4 cup walnut pieces | 1/8 teaspoontabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Bring the brussels sprouts to a boil in 3/4 cup of water. Cover and continue to boil to the very top of the water, approximately 5 to 6 minutes. Drain the brussels sprouts, and rinse well with cold water. Shake the brussels sprouts off the bottom of the pan to remove any excess water. Transfer to a bowl and mix with the remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Blueberry Cherry Soup
ingredients: 250 g blueberries | 100 g dried cherries
instructions: In a small saucepan bring half the water to the boil, add berries and reduce heat. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add the cherries and season to taste. Serve.

Random Ingredients: raspberry vinegar,cream sherry,bean sprout,frangelico,onion soup mix,tabasco sauce,shallot,pork sparerib
title: Baked Pork Sills and Blossoms
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork spareribs | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 cups cream sherry | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 4 shallots, chopped | 1 bunch fresh bean sprouts ( or frozen, chopped green onions, or red shallots ) | raspberry vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Lay out the spareribs and place them on lightly oiled baking sheet. Bake in a moderate oven for approximately 1 hour. Turn them over, and again bake for another hour. After that, remove from oven, cool down any remaining fat. Slice the ribs, and set aside. Prepare the sauce by combining the onions, salt, pepper, hot pepper sauce, and dijon mustard in medium saucepan. Cook until onions are translucent. Add the cream sherry, tabasco sauce, and the rest of the dry onion soup mix to the sauce mixture. Heat through, remove from heat, then cool. When the sills are cool enough to handle, slice them crosswise in half, and spread out each half with the back of the spoon. Place the sliced pork over each half, and spread bean sprouts on top of them. The rusks should cover them. Pour the sauce over all of the meat. Sprinkle with fresh chopped greens of onion or scallions. You can use the vinegar to add flavor or sprinkle with salt, but it tastes quite salty and is hard to ruin the flavor of the rusks. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes, stirring half way through. Serve warm or room temperature with toast.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,linguine pasta,heavy cream,dripping,coconut milk,ricotta cheese,greek yogurt,gruyere cheese
title: Creamy Linguine With Cheese and Coconut Nests

instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add coconut milk, linguine pasta and simmer, stirring often, until pasta is tender but still lightly chewy, about 16 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Whisk together cream, greek yogurt, ricotta cheese and greeere cheese in large bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in cumin seeds. Pour sauce into small flameproof casserole and sprinkle with olive oil. Top with bread crumbs. Serve.

title: Lunchbox Salad (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 romaine lettuce ( enough leaves to leave whole head ) | 4 ounces vanilla flavoured cream or 4 ounces your favorite vietnamese cream cheese
instructions: Wash lettuce. Separate the leaves of lettuce, as any large leaves will be tough. When you're done assembling the pile, place a small slice of cream or vanilla cream in the center of a lettuce leaf. Roll up like a cigar. Repeat till you're done packing in the cream. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,chili sauce,lump crabmeat,thai fish sauce,cornmeal,spinach

instructions: In a small container, combine the sauce ingredients. Set aside. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil.

title: Grilled Thanksgiving Turkey Ham
ingredients: 1 lb turkey ham | 1 large yellow onion, sliced thin | 12 cups mixed marshmallows | 3/4 cup walnut pieces | 1/2 cup chopped dates | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: Grill turkey until no longer pink inside. Spread turkey with maple syrup and sprinkle with cinnamon. Grill onions until limp.

instructions: Mix together all ingredients except soured cream and parsley. Heat over medium high to high heat on griddle. Patties should be brown on the outside, but not burned. To serve, divide meat between buns. Spoon on top of meat. Garnish with a bit of sour cream and cilantro if desired.

title: Zucchini and Peppers With Seasonings and Italian Dressing

instructions: Trim and discard ends of zucchini.

title: Blue Ribbon and Radishes With Fresh Blueberries
ingredients: 32 ounces fresh blueberries, washed | 1 1/2 bunches radishes, trimmed & quartered
instructions: In a 2 1/2 or larger jar, reserve 2 cups of the fresh blueberries. Rinse & drain the remaining 1 1/2 c berry juice. Discard the stems & the rind. Place the berry juice in the bowl of a blender & mix until the liquors are completely dissolved. Strain into a clean container, cover, & freeze overnight. Uncover the container & freeze overnight. The next day, before serving add 5/6 c more of the reserved blueberries. Cover tightly & let it rest for 30 minutes before serving with toast or crackers.

title: Apple Cider BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup french dressing | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Baste on meat during cooking.

title: Mexican Corn Rice
ingredients: 1 bag brown rice, frozen | 24 ounces cream-style corn | hot salsa ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.

title: Aromatic Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 5 tablespoons greek oregano | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce or 1 tablespoon regular soy sauce
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the tomato juice, garlic, and oregano. Stir in the soy sauce. This sauce can keep for up to 3 days or can be frozen for up to 5 months.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,mustard seed,sesame oil,salmon fillet,soy sauce,vanilla bean
title: Italian-Style Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 4 teaspoons dry mustard seeds | 1 vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed & drained
instructions: Dry the salmon well on paper towels, pat dry. Place in a non reactive container & pour the marinade over. Marinate 20 minutes. Drain the beans & combine with the beans in a saucepan, simmer for 5 minutes. Arrange the fish on a plate & coat with the soy sauce to coat. Sprinkle the mustard seeds over the fish & roast at 425 for 10 - 12 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parsley,white onion,celery rib,prune,leek,icing sugar,onion soup mix,taco seasoning mix
title: Pigs in Usual
ingredients: 2 large white onions | 2 leeks, washed well and sliced longways | 4 celery ribs, sliced longways | 3 -4 pints pitted prunes | 2 packages icing sugar | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Put the chopped onions in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until the onions are transparent. Remove from heat and let cool. Drain well and place in a large bowl with the sliced leeks and celery. Put the prunes in a microwave bowl or a bowl with a lid. Microwave on high power for about 3 minutes, or until the prunes are just softened. Drain the prunes and pour into the bowl with the onions and celery. Stir well. Add the icing sugar, onion soup mix, taco seasoning and parsley. Toss to combine. Cover and leave to stand for 2 hours at room temperature before serving.

title: Chili Beef Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 1 loaf beef fresh sandwich crust ( such as texas toast ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Cut beef top and all the way to the bottom of sandwich. Rub chili powder on edge of bread for a crispy crust. Fill inside bread with seasoned beef and onion. Cut french loaf lengthwise into 8 squares, and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,hot chili sauce,macaroni,cayenne pepper,apple cider,active yeast,tomato paste,pepitas
title: Macaroni Apple Crumble
ingredients: 150 g dried macaroni | 1 chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce or 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 3 tablespoons dry pepitas, flakes | 1 tablespoon light apple cider | 1 tablespoon mashed dried active yeast | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce or 2 tablespoons cayenne pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place the macaroni in a large bowl with the stock cube, tomato puree, hot pepper, pepitas flakes, cider and yeast. Stir to combine. Place in a large baking dish or pan and cover with a clean cloth to double wrap. Refrigerate overnight or for up to 3 days before using. To use, drain off excess liquid, then transfer to a clean container. Use to prepare crumble topping on sandwiches or as you fancy. The recipe is fairly flexible so be guided by your macaroni cookbook.

title: Crusty Baked  Bamboo Shoot
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 f or a convection oven.

title: Apple Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 medium beets | 1 tart apple, peeled and diced | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Dice the beet and apple.. Heat cornflour in a frying pan then add the apple, beet and apple. Add a little water and stir well. When it is hot pour into an oven proof pan. Sprinkle with crushed cardamom seeds. Bake at 150c for about 20 - 30 minutes or until the apple is a little mushy. Variation if you want a thicker consistency, add an egg, or add a few drops of cream to the beet soup before adding the egg.

title: Lebanese Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1 cup cream | 1 cup salad oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Work dough. Cut with a cookie cutter to size you prefer. Let dough rest while preparing ingredients. Place mixture on a paper lined baking sheet. Bake at 375°f until just golden brown 15 to 20 minutes for light brown.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,chicken meat,egg yolk,beef brisket,beef stew meat,feta cheese,catsup
title: Crock Pot Beef Pastitsio With Feta Cheese, and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup beef stew meat or 1/2 cup turkey stew meat, chopped | 1 egg yolk | 2 lbs beef brisket, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 -2 lb farfalle pasta
instructions: In crockpot, add the feta cheese, catsup and beef. Add the egg yolk, and then the beef and turkey. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours. Meanwhile, cook the farfalle pasta or other large tubular pasta of your choice. Drain the pasta and toss with some of the cooking liquid. Serve with some of the cooking liquid drizzled over the top.

title: Venison and Chorizo Stuffed Wraps
ingredients: 3 -6 tablespoons spanish chorizo, fat removed | 1 1/2 kg venison, ground | 2 cups nonfat dry milk | 3 1/2 cups nonfat dried milk | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon crushed turmeric powder | 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 2 tablespoons halved dried currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c. Place the chili fat in a small pan, fry the spanish chorizo and ground venison over a medium heat until the fat starts sizzling, add the nonfat dry milk and simmer, stirring occasionally and bring to the boil to reduce the liquid by half pour the liquid through a fine mesh sieve into a large bowl, stir in the dried mixed pulses, salt and turmeric, mix well. Add the walnuts, currants and the dried fruit juices and mix well. Roll the prepared wrap into 20 small long rolls which are 6 in length and about 3/4 thick. Wrap the unfilled wraps in parchment and tie each one with cotton string. Place the wraps in a large baking tin and roast for 1 1/2 hours, turn every so often.

title: Lamb Kebab
ingredients: 1/2 lb lamb shoulder, trimmed and cubed | 1/2 lb red potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1/2 lb baking potato, peeled and cubed | 1/2 lb smoked turkey breast, with bones, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 bunch cilantro leaf, stemmed and loosely packed
instructions: Prepare grill using medium hot grill. Make the spice mixture, combine lamb, potatoes, cilantro and turkey bones. Place meat on skewers. Close grill. Grill until meat is cooked well. If using barbecue mate, turn meat on the grill.

title: Danish Filled Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 2 cups fresh danish cherries or 2 cups frozen cherries | 1/2 cup fresh dill, chopped or 1/4 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: In small bowl, mash cherry or whole cherries with fork. Mix in remaining ingredients. Set aside for 15 minutes for flavors to blend into cherry mixture.

title: Chickpea Salad Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 2 cans chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup golden raisin | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Place noodles in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients except for almond extract. Toss until well combined. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,apple cider vinegar,mexican oregano,red pepper flake,pine nut,chipotle chile adobo,mirin
title: Pine Nut Feta Salad
ingredients: 2 cans chipotle chiles in adobo | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 1/2 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the chipotle chilies, pine nuts, vinegar, mirin, oregano and red pepper flakes. Blend in the cheese just until it is combined.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,nutmeg,egg beater substitute,cottage cheese,celery seed,club soda,celery salt,marshmallow
title: Low Fat No-Yeast Low Fat Stovetop Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sourdough starter yeast | 8 cups fat-free cottage cheese | 1/4 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 12 cups powdered egg whites ( not egg or milk ) | 16 cups club soda
instructions: In large mixer bowl mix together yeast, cottage cheese, egg beaters, and seasonings. Add wet ingredients, blend till combined. Turn onto lightly floured board and knead till elastic, about 10 minutes. Place in buttered bowl, cover and let rise til bubbly, about 40 minutes. Punch dough down and turn onto a lightly floured board. Knead till smooth and elastic. Place on lightly floured board, cover and let rise till light. In medium mixer bowl beat egg whites till stiff. Add club soda, and beat till stiff peaks form. Transfer egg whites to greased 8x8x2 inch loaf pan. Cover. Set aside in a warm place til foamy. Bake at 350°f for 45 - 55 minutes till edges are slightly crispy.

Random Ingredients: mace,broccoli floret,baby carrot,corn tortilla,water,picante sauce,sage leaf
title: Microwave Spicy Vegetable Enchiladas from Campbell's Kitchen

instructions: Mix first 4 ingridients in a microwave safe bowl, cover and cook on high 10 minutes. Pour into 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with mace. Microwave on high 3 to 4 minutes. Sprinkle with desired amount of mace. Microwave on high 2 to 3 minutes, until heated through and vegetables are soft.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,allspice,cashew,parmesan cheese,active yeast,creme fraiche,cumin seed,pork tenderloin
title: Cheeseburger Cashew Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon sour cream or 1 tablespoon cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds, lightly crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground dried active dry yeast | 1 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed of surface fat, pounded to ¼ inch thick ( about 2 ) | 1 tablespoon cashews, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped roasted salted cashews
instructions: Combine creme fraiche, sour cream, parmesan cheese, cumin, allspice, and dried yeast in small bowl and let stand until bubbly, about 5 minutes. Cut pork into ¼ inch wide strips. In large bowl, combine pork with 3 tablespoons cashews, remaining 1 tablespoon cashews, and remaining teaspoon cumin, and 1 teaspoons of allspice.

Random Ingredients: steak,yukon gold potato,farfalle pasta,hot red chili pepper,vegetable stock,broccoli
title: Thai Slow Cooker Beef & Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 500 g whole low-fat flank steak | 1/2 cup uncooked farfalle pasta | 2 large yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 2cm cubes | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 hot red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 3/4 cup broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Trim the steak of any fat or gristle and cut into thin slices. Place the farfalle in a large mixing bowl, add the potatoes followed by the chicken/broccoli and pour over the stock. Toss well. Cover and stand for 12 hours at room temperature, or in the fridge for up to 8 hours.. Drain the farfalle and return it to the base of the slow cooker. Increase the cooking time for the beef and potatoes, if they haven't already cooked enough, after 12 hours, remove it and keep it warm. Increase the slow cooker to high and cook for 30 minutes. Stir the soup, season to taste and serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,chicken broth,lettuce leaf,extra virgin olive oil,red chili pepper
title: Spicy Cauliflower
ingredients: 400 g cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely sliced | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 5 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a large pan of boiling, salted water. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat to medium, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Drain and cool for 5 min, then drain well. Heat oil in a pan, add chili and cook for 1 min stir in cauliflower, stir for 1 minute. Stir in broth, cook for 2 mins, then remove from the heat and cool. Divide between lettuce bowls, pour remaining sauce over and scatter with red chilli.

title: Blueberry Guacamole
ingredients: 4 avocados, mashed | 1/2 cup blueberries, frozen ( reserve 1/4 cup liquid ) | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 fruit, diced
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until well mixed. Add reserved liquid and stir to combine.

Random Ingredients: turkey,lemon peel,green apple,pasta shell,cannellini bean,triple sec,white mushroom,italian plum tomato
title: Pasta Shells and Beans
ingredients: 10 ounces tri-colored cheesecloth, with ties | 1 can white mushrooms | 1/4 lb turkey | 2 cans cannellini beans | 1/3 cup triple sec | 10 ounces italian plum tomatoes | 3 slices lemon peel | 8 ounces pasta shells
instructions: Rinse turkey and brown. Drain. Trim green mushrooms, cut into 2 chunks, dice. Drain cannellini beans, rinse. Dice turkey, shred with cheesecloth in large skillet, drain juices. Pour turkey, beans, tomatoes, lemon peel and juice into slow cooker. Heat until hot, pour over pasta, stir, cover and cook on high until pasta is tender 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Easy Beef and Noodles for Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 4 cellophane noodles ( or 1 package linguine ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Spray a 4 quart slow cooker with veggie cooking spray. Put stew meat in crock pot. Cover with cellophane noodles or linguine. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover. Cook on low for about 7 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours and then turn to high for 5 hour.

title: Baked Tomatoes, Mushrooms & Rice
ingredients: 500 g tomatoes with juice | 400 g stew meat | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1/2 cup mushroom, finely chopped | 3 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150oc/gas cut stew meat into 1cm chunks. Place in a casserole dish with the tomatoes, thyme and mushrooms. Season to taste and cover the dish with foil. Cook in the oven for 2 1/2 hours until the tomatoes are cooked and the juices have reduced and concentrated. Remove the foil, remove the tomatoes, thyme and mushrooms from the casserole and serve from the baking dish.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,bulk italian sausage,arborio rice,cardamom,chicken,wasabi powder
title: Egg Rolls With Sausage & Wasabi - wasabi Rice, Rice & Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces bulk italian sausage | 1 medium chicken, cooked and finely shredded | 12 ounces arborio rice | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips | cardamom | chocolate chips
instructions: Heat oven to in large nonstick skillet, heat sausage until just slightly browned. Drain. In 2 1/2 to 3 quart cassrole, combine sausage, chicken, rice, wasabi and 1/2 cup chocolate chips and mix well, breaking it into pieces. Shape into 12 oblong cylinders. Arrange about 2 inches apart on parchment lined or greased baking sheets. Brush rolls with remaining melted, buttered chocolate and sprinkle with cardamom. Bake in preheated 400 degree oven until tops are golden brown, about 10 - 15 minutes. Cool until almost completely warm, about 10 minutes.. Slice diagonally across. Serve with a dip sauce such as wasabi dipping sauce or wasabi rice dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,sirloin,kaffir lime leaf,topping,red bell pepper
title: Spicy Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: 14 -16 ounces sirloin, skirt steak or 14 -16 ounces other very lean cut steak | 3 kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced | 1 red bell pepper, julienned | fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Trim any visible fat from steak. Remove any fat from steak. In a large ziploc baggie, squeeze out the lime leaves and add the sliced meat. Squeeze out as much air as possible and add the lime leaves. Add the bell peppers. Stir in the chopped cilantro leaves and refrigerate for one hour. Serve on a platter with hot thai chunky style dressing and warm spiced bread.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,rum extract,confectioner ' sugar,chinese noodle,cake flour,clove,lemongrass,chipotle chile
title: Devilled Lentils, Chipotles or Long Beans
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils or 1 cup french green lentils, well rinsed and drained | 1/2 an ounce chinese noodles, soaked 5 minutes in hot water until tender ( can sub short pasta of this ) | 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped | 1/2 inch piece clove | 1 tablespoon chopped garlic | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried chipotle chile ( paste from canned chipotles ) | 2 tablespoons rum extract | confectioners'sugar
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine the lentils, noodles or long beans and lemongrass with water to cover. Bring to boil over moderate heat, reduce heat to lightly simmer, and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes. Stir in the garlic, cloves, chile, rum extract, and 2 tablespoons water. Cover and simmer until noodles are cooked, about 15 minutes, or to desired tenderness. Serve hot.

title: Farfalle With Shrimp and Radishes
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 4 bunches fresh radishes, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4-inch-thick rounds | 2 cups peeled cooked shrimp | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup packed coarsely chopped plum tomato | 1/4 cup icing, for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water until just tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, toss the radish rounds in the remaining 3 tablespoons of icing. Drop the radish rounds, a few at a time, into boiling water just long enough for the radishes to be blanched. Drain the radish rounds, place in a bowl, and toss with enough pasta to coat, about 2 1/2 tablespoons. Add the shrimp and tomato and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Place a few radishes on each plate, spoon 1/2 cup pasta mixture over, and serve immediately.

title: Pork and Mango Sticks
ingredients: 2 -3 large mangoes, peeled, pitted, cut in 1/16 inch slices | 2 -3 green onions, cut lengthwise in half and then into 1/16 inch slices | 3 lbs pork belly, cut about 3 thick slices | 1/4 cup tamarind juice ( i use the juice of 3 medium mangos, peeled and finely grated ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Toss mangoes, green onions, ginger, vinegar, savory and garlic salt together in a bowl. Let sit at least 1/2 hour at room temperature and up to 2 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400°f. Wash, remove thick rib and skewer meat onto each mango by sewing it with cotton or a piece of string. Place on a baking sheet and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Transfer to a serving plate when ready to serve.

title: Brazilian Broccoli (Broccoli)
ingredients: 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 1 can chicken bouillon | 1 bunch broccoli, trimmed and cut into florets
instructions: Place the sliced olives into a saucepan over medium heat, and cook and toss the olives with the chicken bouillon until the chicken bouillon dissolves. Bring the mixture to a simmer, pour in the broccoli, and continue cooking until the broccoli is tender and the sauce has thickened.

title: Chicken Wings (Chicken or Vegetarian)
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | banana ( optional )
instructions: Bake about 12 minutes until crisp and the color turns light brown. Place on baking sheet sprayed with pam.

title: Veal and Rice Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked al dente | 1 lb ground veal | 2 green onions, sliced | 3 cups prepared prepared white basmati rice
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions. Remove from heat and drain well. Brown the ground veal in a large skillet for 5 minutes, remove from skillet. Add the green onions to the pan the browned veal is in, and mix well. Add the cooked noodles to the meat mixture, and stir to combine. Place in an 8x8 inch baking pan. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until set. Remove from refrigerator and bake for 30 minutes. Serve with cooked, drained noodles.

title: Tortillas With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 medium brussels sprouts | 2 tablespoons flour tortillas | 1/2 cup shredded cooked brussels sprout
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut stem from brussels sprouts. Place sprouts in a small roasting pan or baking dish. Drizzle vegetables with extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake vegetables in the center of the oven 3 to 4 minutes, or until brussels sprouts are to desired tenderness, stirring occasionally.
